instructions: Melt butter and mix remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked deep dish pie shell. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake for 50 minutes.

title: Garden Club Dessert
instructions: Combine ingredients; put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Delores' Double Crust Pastry
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt until crumbly. Gently stir in cold water until pastry holds together. Divide into 2 parts. Roll out on floured surface.

title: Tuna Salad With A Twist
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Mini Spinach Quiches
instructions: Separate each biscuit into 3 layers. Fit layers into 30 (1 3/4 x 1-inch) mini muffin pan cups. In a 2-quart saucepan stir together cornstarch nutmeg salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk until smooth. Stirring constantly bring to a boil. Gradually stir about 1/4 cup of the hot cornstarch mixture into the beaten egg until blended. Stir egg mixture into the remaining hot mixture in pan. Cool. Stir in cheese and spinach. Spoon about 2 teaspoons spinach mixture into each tart (should be full). Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from pans and serve. Quiches may be frozen in tightly covered container for 1 month. Bake frozen quiches 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: String Pie
instructions: In a baking dish place cooked spaghetti in bottom of dish. In a separate bowl mix eggs and Parmesan cheese with cottage cheese. Add onto noodles then mix meat spaghetti sauce onion and green pepper and put over cheese mixture. Over the top add shredded Mozzarella and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Round Steak And Gravy
instructions: Put cream of mushroom soup and water in a 5-quart Dutch oven. In large skillet put 1/4 cup oil. Roll steak pieces in flour; brown quickly. Drop in Dutch oven with soup and water. Leave oil in frying pan. Add 1/4 cup flour to pan and brown. Add salt and pepper. Add enough to make thin gravy. Add this to Dutch oven; cover and simmer until meat is tender about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the first seven ingredients. Cook uncovered over medium heat until vegetables are tender about 12 minutes. Stir in spaghetti; heat through.

title: Bucellato
instructions: In a large bowl cream butter and sugar. When thoroughly blended add milk and eggs; mix well and add flour and baking powder. Add raisins anise seed glazed fruit vanilla brandy and rum extracts and Anisette.\tMix well and shape as desired. Decorate top with walnut halves if desired. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for about 50 minutes.

title: Chicken Meatballs Japanese Style
instructions: Mix chicken 1 tablespoon sugar 1 tablespoon soy sauce and egg in mixing bowl. Sprinkle on cornstarch and stir in well. In a saucepan combine the broth remaining soy sauce sugar and sherry. Bring to a boil. Form meatballs with hands or drop from spoon into boiling broth. Poach 5 to 6 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon. You may then poach green beans or other vegetables in broth. Thicken broth with a cornstarch and water paste if desired. Serve over rice.

title: Fruity Tea
instructions: Brew tea bags and water until very strong tasting. Use a gallon jar put tea sugar juice and lemonade in jar; mix well. Fill rest of jar with cold water.

title: Chocolate Fondue
instructions: Mix all except fruit. Heat in fondue pot until chips are melted and mixture is hot.

title: Great Punch
instructions: Mix pineapple juice orange juice ice cubes fruit cocktail and cherries. You can refrigerate overnight before needed or freeze. When ready to use pour into punch bowl. Add 2 quarts of the ginger ale. Mix. Top with sherbet. As needed add more ginger ale.

title: Amaretto Dip
instructions: Mix pudding with 1/2 cup milk (use mixer). Blend in Cool Whip. Add Amaretto liqueur. Let stand for awhile. Serve with fresh fruit. Will keep for several days.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup lukewarm water. Combine 1 cup lukewarm water liquid shortening sugar salt and eggs. Add yeast mixture (after it has dissolved). Gradually add flour; stir until blended and knead until desired texture. Grease bowl; put dough into it and set in warm place to rise. Cover with towel. Form into desired shapes and let rise again. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0 on greased pan.

title: Aunt Betty'S Sherried Chicken And Cheese
instructions: Arrange chicken in single layer in shallow baking pan. Scatter green onions over top; cover with sprinkling of cheese and paprika. Blend soups with sherry; pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for about 2 hours or until fork-tender. (Do not cover; do not salt.) Excellent with pilaf-type rice.

title: Cherry Pie Cobbler
instructions: Sweeten cherries to taste with sugar. Dump fruit in cobbler dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Sprinkle cake mix over all. Chip oleo on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: No-Bake Fudge Clusters
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan; then add milk and syrup stir. Cook to soft ball stage and remove from heat. Add margarine vanilla oats and coconut or walnuts. Stir well and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Shenandoah Apple Cake
instructions: Beat together oil sugar eggs and vanilla about 3 minutes. Add sifted dry ingredients  then stir in apples. Combine walnuts and 1 tablespoon flour; stir into batter. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cake tests done. Cool in pan on rack.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
instructions: Break up chicken and line bottom of dish. Pour cream of chicken soup over chicken. Sprinkle stuffing over top as desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Buns
instructions: Sift flour in large mixing bowl and add remainder of ingredients and stir well mixed cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Sift 1 cup or more of flour on kneading board. Pour dough on board and knead until smooth with palm of the hand add more flour if needed to handle easily. Place in greased bowl in warm place for 1 hour or until doubled. Punch down and let rise again. Then make in little balls place 2-inches apart in greased baking pan let rise about 1 hour or until light bake about 20 to 25 minutes or until well browned in a 400\u00b0 oven.

title: German Chocolate Caramel Bars
instructions: In a pan combine caramels and milk. Heat until all caramels are melted and set aside. In a large bowl combine cake mix oleo 1/3 cup milk and nuts. Press 1/2 of the dough into a greased 9 x 11-inch pan or dish. Save the rest of the dough for topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over the mix. Spread the caramel mixture over the chocolate chips. Then crumble the rest of the cake mixture over the caramels. Bake for 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool before cutting.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa Karo syrup and milk in a heavy boiler. Bring to a boil; turn to medium heat and continue boiling for approximately 5 minutes until a small amount dropped in cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat; stir in oleo peanut butter and vanilla. Beat until candy begins to stiffen. Pour into a buttered dish.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine eggs and milk. Add crumbs and soak 5 minutes. Add ham Worcestershire sauce mustard and cloves; mix well. Pack in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and reset oven to 425\u00b0. Invert loaf in center of greased and preheated plank. Spread marmalade on top and sides of loaf. Bake about 20 minutes until glazed. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crab And Avocado Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix mayonnaise lime juice cumin and paprika. Add crab meat and celery; mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Gently stir in avocado cubes. Divide watercress on 4 plates; top with salad.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Waffles
instructions: Combine the flour baking powder baking soda and salt; set aside. In a mixing bowl beat eggs until light. Add buttermilk; mix well. Add dry ingredients and beat until batter is smooth. Stir in butter. Pour about 3/4 cup batter onto a lightly greased preheated waffle iron. Sprinkle with a few pecans. Bake according to manufacturers directions until golden brown. Repeat until batter and pecans are gone. Yields 7 waffles (about 8 inches each).

title: Choc-Bark Candy
instructions: Put almonds on cookie sheet and roast in oven. Melt chocolate bark in double boiler. Mix nuts in chocolate. Beat until cool enough to form mounds when dropped by spoon. You can make with pecans and peanuts the same way.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Dump pineapple with juice and spread evenly. Dump pie filling and spread evenly. Dump cake mix and spread evenly. Sprinkle with pecans. Place butter pats over pecans.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Simmer beans in 6 cups of water for 1 hour. Allow to stand covered for 2 hours or until softened. Drain. Put all ingredients in a crock-pot. Add 1 cup of water. Stir to blend. Cover pot and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours. Stir occasionally. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: *Do not use Quick Quaker oats!

title: Saucy Pork Chops
instructions: In a skillet brown pork chops on both sides in small amount of oil. Season with salt and pepper. Top with onion slices. Combine remaining ingredients in mixing bowl. Pour over pork chops. Cover simmer 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pies(Makes 3 Pies)
instructions: Mix sugar flour cornstarch and cocoa. Add other ingredients beating eggs well. Add milk then add other ingredients. Pour in 3 unbaked pie shells. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Hamburger And Cheese Pizzas(Low-Fat)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In small skillet brown ground beef; drain. Place pocket breads on ungreased cookie sheet. Top each with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce and 3 tablespoons ground beef. Sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 pizzas. Serving 1 pizza. Calories 180. Fat grams 6.

title: Quick Sheath Cake
instructions: Mix together and beat. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for thirty minutes.

title: Raymond'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugars and flour. Beat in eggs milk and flavoring. Add melted margarine and pecans. Bake in unbaked pie shell 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Old-Fashioned Doughnuts
instructions: In mixing bowl measure 1 1/2 cups flour and remaining ingredients. In mixer beat 1 minute then stir in remaining flour to make soft dough. Refrigerate 1 hour. Roll out 1/2-inch thick and then fry in deep fat fryer with oil at 370\u00b0. Makes 24.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until bubbly. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 15 minutes stirring often.

title: Vanilla Sugar
instructions: Bury vanilla beans in a container holding granulated or confectioners sugar. Cover tightly and \flavor\ for 2 weeks. Replace sugar as used as beans will be effective for many months.

title: Jingle Bell Fudge
instructions: Combine butterscotch chips and peanut butter in top of double boiler. Place over hot not boiling water until butterscotch melts; remove from water. Stir until blended; add milk and stir until blended. Spread in foil-lined 8 inch square pan. Press chopped nuts into surface if desired and chill until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares. Yield 64 servings.

title: Zucchini Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Bring vinegar sugar salt and spices to a boil. Pour over freshly sliced vegetables and let sit for 1 hour. Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes. Pack in hot sterilized jars. Seal. Process 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 7 pints.

title: Ukrainian Canapes
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese onto slices of bread. Top each bread slice with a half slice of each type of luncheon meat. Place one slice of egg pickle and radish on top of meat. Sprinkle chives parsley and cheese to finish the canape. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes approximately 24 canapes.

title: Banana Nut Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups. Beat egg; stir in milk and oil. Stir in remaining ingredients all at once just until flour is moistened. Bake until golden brown about 20 minutes. Immediately remove from pan. Makes about 1 dozen muffins.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook chicken onion and celery together until chicken is tender with salt to taste. Bone chicken and cut in small pieces. Add soup cheese cooked spaghetti and chicken broth. Mix well. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until heated through.

title: Chilled Rice Salad
instructions: Toss rice mushrooms and onion together in large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl or jar with tight fitting lid and blend well.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Dissolve cornstarch in milk; combine all ingredients together. Cook until done.

title: Pat'S Corned Beef
instructions: In medium saucepan combine the corned beef tomatoes diced onion and baby limas. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Serve with creamed potatoes salad and rolls for a quick and easy meal the kids will love.

title: Impossible Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Place all ingredients except coconut into blender or food processor (with chopping blade). Blend for 2 minutes. Pour into lightly greased pie plate preferably glass. Sprinkle coconut on top and pat down with back of large spoon. Let stand 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 4 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Serves warm or cold.

title: Gooey Butter Bars
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Add sugar margarine cocoa salt and milk to saucepan. Boil 1 minute hard. Take off stove; add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Mix well. Drop on wax paper and cool. (Good without cocoa too.)

title: Glazed Acorn Rings
instructions: Cut off ends of squash. Slice crosswise into 1-inch rings and remove seeds. Place in a single layer in large shallow baking dish and add orange juice. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine brown sugar and remaining ingredients; simmer 5 minutes. Pour over squash rings and bake uncovered 15 minutes longer basting occasionally.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour into 2 prepared pie crusts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Minced Lobster
instructions: Pour a small amount of oil and 1 can of tomato paste in pan. Cook slowly for 2 minutes. Pour celery onions and bell pepper in pan and let cook for 5 minutes. Pour diced lobster meat in mixture and simmer for 10 minutes or until fully cooked.

title: Dietetic Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients first. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake in a well-greased square pan at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pepper Cabbage
instructions: Quarter cabbage and remove core. Remove inside seeds from pepper. Grind on course blades of grinder. Make a mixture of water and vinegar (proportion 1/3 cup vinegar to 2/3 cup water). Make enough to thoroughly moisten cabbage and pepper. Some seasoning will be needed (salt pepper a little sugar to taste). Store in refrigerator in covered bowl.

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
instructions: Combine cornstarch and water in small bowl. Stir together all remaining ingredients except cilantro in saucepan. Add the cornstarch water mixture; bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Add cilantro. Garnish with tortilla chips and shredded Cheddar cheese.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in unbaked shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.\tMakes 2 pies.

title: Apple Nut Cake #1
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar and beat. Add oil half the apples and half of the flour and beat. Add vanilla soda salt and cinnamon and beat. Add remaining apples flour and nuts. Beat well and put in a greased tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until well done.

title: Loaded Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil corn and cut off cob. Put in hot sterilized quart canning jars. Add 2 tablespoons of canning or pickling salt to each jar. Fill to neck of jar with boiling water. Seal.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Start with Ragu. Add tomato paste oregano salt and pepper. Let simmer for about 20 minutes. Brown ground round in skillet until done. Drain very well. I use a paper towel to pat meat to absorb all the fat. Add to sauce. Cook lasagna noodles as directed and drain. In a 13 x 9-inch pan alternate noodles meat mixture and Mozzarella cheese. Continue until you have used all mixture finish on top with your Mozzarella cheese. Bake covered for about 35 minutes. There are 8 to 6 grams of fat per serving. Serve with a garden salad and Italian bread sticks.

title: Easy Beans
instructions: Brown bacon until crisp. Remove from drippings. Saute onions and garlic in drippings. Remove from drippings. Mix all ingredients together except onion rings and pour into casserole. Place onion rings on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
instructions: Cream jello with cream cheese. Add 1 cup boiling water. Dissolve. Add 1 cup reserved pineapple juice. Mix well. Put into refrigerator until thickened. Add crushed pineapple marshmallows and Cool Whip. Congeal.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots onions water and salt until tender about 15 minutes. Blend butter and bread crumbs; set aside. Drain vegetable stock from carrots and blend together with butter and flour. Cook until thickened and add cheese. Stir until cheese is melted. Pour over carrots and top with bread crumbs. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine flour 1/2 cup sugar baking powder nutmeg and salt. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients. In another bowl Beat egg slightly; stir in milk and 1/3 cup melted butter or margarine add egg mixture to flour mixture. Stir just until moistened (the batter may be lumpy). Lightly grease muffin cups. Fill cups about 2/3 full with batter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until muffins are golden. Meanwhile in a shallow bowl combine the 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Immediately dip tops of hot muffins into the 1/4 cup melted butter or margarine then into the cinnamon-sugar mixture until coated. Serve warm. Serves 12.

title: Dam Good Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine seasonings. This is enough to coat 4 chickens. Shake all those ingredients in a bag. Wet the chicken; drain it and toss it in the bag. Arrange the coated chicken on an oven pan; brush with melted butter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 without turning!!

title: Kentucky Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour half of mixture into greased iron skillet. Sprinkle with half (1/4 cup) Cheddar cheese. Pour in remaining half of corn bread mixture. Top with remainder 1/4 cup cheese. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Skillet Spaghetti
instructions: Brown the first 4 ingredients in skillet. Drain well. Add the next 3 ingredients to meat mixture and simmer well. Add water and bring to a boil. Add spaghetti and cook until tender. Place in baking pan top with cheese and brown under broiler.

title: Cool And Easy Pie
instructions: Stir boiling water into Jell-O in bowl at least 2 minutes. Add enough ice to cold water to make 1 ; cup. Add Jell-O and stir until ice is melted. Add Cool Whip; stir with whisk until well blended. Refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes or until mixture is very thick and will mound. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.

title: Barbecue Hot Dog Appetizers
instructions: Cut hot dogs and bacon pieces into thirds. Wrap each hot dog piece with 1 piece of bacon and secure with toothpick. Arrange in single layer on cookie sheets or shallow baking pans; bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Pour barbecue sauce evenly over hot dogs; then drizzle molasses lightly over barbecue sauce. Sprinkle brown sugar over all. Return to oven and bake an additional 30 minutes. Serve hot or keep warm in a crock-pot. This will make a crock-pot full of appetizers. Makes 72 to 90 appetizers.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Drain and serve. Makes 7 cups.

title: Louisiana Shrimp
instructions: Saute onions green pepper and garlic in butter. Mix with remaining ingredients. Put in a casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Put aside. In a saucepan melt the butter. Saute the onion and pepper in butter until tender. Set aside. In a bowl place the tuna fish onion pepper butter and macaroni. Add the mushroom soup; mix well. Add grated cheese. Add finally the sugar and pepper. Mix well. Pour milk over top and mix slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Wash eggplant and cut into 1-inch slices. Sprinkle with salt and allow to sit for 1/2 to 1 hour in colander. Squeeze water out of slices and pat dry with toweling. Dip slices in seasoned flour and brown in frying pan. Place in greased 9-inch square baking dish. Top each piece with a slice of Mozzarella cheese. Place a second slice of eggplant on cheese. Pour Ragu spaghetti sauce over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes covered for first 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cut and cook carrots. Drain carrots and mix with other ingredients. Lasts two weeks. Save marinade to reuse.

title: Leek And Potato Soup
instructions: Trim dark green leaves from leeks; slit leeks and clean carefully. Chop fine. Cook the leeks with the onion in butter. Add potatoes and stock. Bring to a boil. Simmer about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Add cream and bring to a boil. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot sprinkled with chives or scallions. Also good served cold.

title: Company Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour oat bran baking soda baking powder salt and cinnamon in a large bowl. Stir in sugar. Add carrots apples raisins and nuts. Stir well. Make a well in the middle. Add oil milk eggs and vanilla. Stir until moistened.

title: Meat Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook meat and onion until browned in large frying pan breaking meat with fork. Blend in tomato paste salt chili powder and garlic powder and pepper; add corn (including liquid) and cook until mixture is thick stirring occasionally. Arrange half the meat mixture over noodles. Repeat layers. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbling. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Berry Cream Dressing
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients except the oil. Add the oil in a slow steady stream until blended. Refrigerate. Use on a spinach-cucumber salad.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Squeeze spinach until dry. In medium bowl stir together spinach sour cream mayonnaise soup mix onions and water chestnuts. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Serve with bread or crackers. May be used as vegetable dip. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Chicken Lindsey
instructions: Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry. Mix salt pepper celery salt and paprika together and sprinkle over chicken pieces. Next sprinkle lemon juice over chicken pieces and place in a crock pot or slow cooker. Mix the two soups together in a bowl. Pour over chicken and sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours. Serve chicken and sauce over hot rice or noodles. Serves 8-12.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine rice 1 1/2 cups milk sugar and salt in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until thick and creamy 15 to 20 minutes. Blend remaining 1/2 cup milk and egg. Stir into rice mixture; add raisins. Cook 2 minutes longer stirring constantly. Add margarine and vanilla. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Banker'S Casserole
instructions: Mix hamburger ketchup onion eggs milk and salt in mixing bowl. Cook macaroni and drain. Add mustard and mayonnaise to macaroni. Alternate layers of beef mixture and macaroni mixture in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with cheese then sprinkle with cornflake crumbs. Drizzle oleo over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Italian-Style
instructions: Saute garlic in olive oil until golden and remove. Chop tomatoes and add to oil with salt pepper oregano and parsley. Simmer uncovered 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Meanwhile pound chicken breasts between pieces of waxed paper until thin. Dip chicken in eggs and then in mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Saute in butter until browned on both sides. Place chicken in shallow baking dish top with sauce and slices of Mozzarella. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Apple-Pineapple Dump Cake
instructions: Place in 9 x 13-inch pan in this order apple pie filling pineapple and dry cake mix. Melt oleo and drizzle over top. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Baked Acorn Squash
instructions: Wash and cut squash in half lengthwise. Scrape out seeds. Brush cut surfaces and cavity with melted butter. Place close together cut side down on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until almost tender about 30 to 40 minutes. Turn cut side up and brush again with butter. Sprinkle cavity with sugar and salt. Add a few drops of sherry. Bake 10 to 15 minutes more until surface is glazed.

title: Cheese Dip Or Spread
instructions: Mix 1 tablespoon cream with softened cream cheese. Add 5 tablespoons oyster hot tomato ketchup and French dressing. Add 1 small finely chopped onion. Season with celery salt. Serve with crackers or potato chips.

title: Lobster Bisque
instructions: This soup is not suitable for freezing. In large pot combine lobster meat and cold water. Simmer covered for 15 minutes. In large saucepan melt butter and blend in the flour. Gradually add the milk and cook until thickened stirring frequently. Add the milk mixture to the lobster mixture. Stir well and reheat. Add salt and pepper and cayenne pepper to taste and serve. Yields 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Cream sugar eggs flour salt and soda with juice from fruit cocktail. Add fruit cocktail and nuts. Pour into a flat pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Perfect White Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; set aside until remaining hot water shortening salt and sugar cool to lukewarm. Stir in 2 cups flour; beat well. Add remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough. Turn on floured surface and knead until satiny 8 to 10 minutes. Let sit 10 minutes and knead again a few minutes. Place in greased bowl turning once to grease surface. Let raise in warm place until double in bulk. Punch down; raise again 1 hour until double. Cut dough in two portions. Place in small ball; set 10 minutes. Place in loaves; let raise until double about 1 hour. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix oil eggs sour cream and vanilla. Pour half of mixture into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle half over batter; swirl with a fork into cake. Pour remaining batter on top and spread. Top with brown sugar and cinnamon; swirl with fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. When done pour glaze on top.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Place layers of vegetables in order given in crock-pot. Season each layer with salt and pepper (if desired). Put hamburger on top of celery. Mix soup and water. Pour into pot. Cover; set on low for 6 to 8 hours. (Stir occasionally.)

title: Lemonade
instructions: Slightly boil together until sugar is dissolved. Cool and store in bottle in refrigerator.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Peel apples and slice into a deep baking dish. Sprinkle with spices (if desired) and granulated sugar. Blend together the oats flour brown sugar cornflake crumbs and oil. Press this mixture on top of the apple slices. Bake for 30 minutes or until apples are tender when tested with a fork. Yields 6 servings. Fat None.

title: 9 Minute Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a glass pan with handles stir together the peanuts sugar syrup and salt. Cook 8 minutes on High stirring after 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla. Cook one minute longer on High. Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and fluffy (foamy). Immediately pour on lightly buttered baking sheet. Spread out thin. When cool break into pieces. Store in airtight container.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Mix cream cheese milk and pudding mix together and sprinkle some crushed cookies in a dish or pan. Spread the mixture on cookies. Repeat. Refrigerate for 12 hours before serving.

title: Farmers Breakfast
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Place oil in large nonstick frying pan. Heat oil until very hot but not smoking. Add potatoes. Cook turning frequently until done but not too brown. Add onion and red pepper. Saute until tender. Add ham. Saute until warmed through. Add eggs/Second Nature. Reduce heat and cover for 3 to 5 minutes. You want the eggs to cover ingredients and cook them as the eggs cook so dont stir the mixture at this point. Remove the lid and turn over the contents with a spatula. Cover and cook 3 to 5 additional minutes. Remove cover; season with salt and onion powder. Add green onions. mix well. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Super Lo-Cal, Lo-Fat Creamy Broccoli Soup
instructions: In saucepan add broccoli onion and water; cover and simmer until florets are tender about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Pour vegetables and liquid into work bowl of food processor and process until smooth; set aside. (Blender can be used but divide mixture in thirds to process.) In same saucepan heat margarine until bubbly and hot. Add flour and cook stirring constantly for 1 minute. Stir in broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and thickened. Add pureed vegetables and seasonings to saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thoroughly combined and heated. Pour into soup bowls and sprinkle with parsley if desired. Enjoy! Makes 4 servings.

title: Grandma Jackson'S Sorghum Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except flour. Add flour gradually enough to make a stiff batter. Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Top will fall.

title: Mexican Manicotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef. Mix with refried beans oregano and cumin. Fill uncooked manicotti shells. Arrange in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine taco or picante sauce and water and pour over shells. Bake 20 minutes. Turn shells over and bake 25 more minutes. Combine sour cream onion and cheese over shells. Bake 5 minutes. Sprinkle with tomatoes. Serves 4.

title: Olive Cookies (Hors D'Oeuvres)
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Take 1 tablespoon and wrap around each olive. You can freeze these then bake when you need them. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until brown. Grease pan.

title: Peanut Brittle Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Grease a 15X10 inch pan. In a medium bowl cream together the butter and the sugar. Mix in egg and vanilla. Sift together the flour baking soda and cinnamon. Stir into the creamed mixture then stir in 1 cup of the peanuts. Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared baking pan. Sprinkle the remaining peanuts over the top. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes until edges pull away from the sides of the pan. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients; set aside. In a large mixing bowl cream butter sugar and eggs. Alternately add milk and dry ingredients beating after each addition. Stir in zucchini peel and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in prepared tube pan or two loaf pans.

title: Plain Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add soda and buttermilk. Add flour gradually. Add vanilla. Bake in Bundt pan 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup Milnot over low heat. Stir often until melted.

title: Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Blend cheese and milk. Add beef onion and pepper to cheese mixture. Blend in sour cream. Put in ovenproof dish. Cover top with crushed pecans. Serve hot with crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Linda'S Zucchini
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Spread into 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar add eggs and beat until light. Sift flour baking powder and nutmeg together and add alternately with milk to the sugar mixture. Gently fold in blueberries. Pour into buttered pans and bake at 350\u00b0 until firm in center and lightly browned about 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Brown the beef in microwave oven. Place in a crock-pot with the other ingredients and cook on low while at work. Delicious over rice.

title: Ham Stuff
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. While pasta is cooking in large frying pan heat oil. Once oil is ready place garlic in pan. Once garlic turns light brown add ham. Stir constantly. Add Parmesan cheese halfway during the cooking of the ham. The ham will be done when it becomes a little crispy usually about 15 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer in order in shallow round casserole dish. Cook in microwave for 5 minutes on High.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into large casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine and pour into baked pie shell. Place in freezer until firm.

title: Tom'S Hot Tomato Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients well and let sit one or two days before eating. Sauce can be made milder using less pepper or hotter using more peppers and pepper sauce. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Ricotta Snowflake Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients; form into a ball and chill for 1 hour. Roll out the dough to a 1/8-inch thickness. Use a round cookie cutter or a fluted cookie cutter and cut out shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Do not let them get too brown.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs melted butter and 1/4 cup sugar. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes at 325\u00b0 then chill. Beat soft butter eggs powdered sugar and vanilla for 15 minutes. Pour over cooled crust. Sprinkle pineapple on top. Next layer bananas. Spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle nuts dot with cherries and drizzle chocolate syrup. Chill overnight!

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix well together and place in a greased casserole. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add enough pineapple juice to make it dipping consistency. Serve with apple slices grapes oranges pineapple chunks banana slices or other fruits of your choice. Easy for children to make and great for showers or parties.

title: London Broil
instructions: Combine soy sauce honey salt pepper sugar garlic and sherry. Spread over meat. Marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour in refrigerator. Place in preheated skillet with 1 tablespoon oil (cut meat in half). Cook for 30 to 45 minutes on slow heat. Turn to opposite side halfway through cooking. May cook on grill.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash chop in small pieces. Combine with bread crumbs cheese onion parsley salt eggs and pepper. Put into buttered casserole. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top. Just before end of baking sprinkle grated cheese on top and let melt.

title: Muddy Buddies
instructions: Pour cereal into large bowl; set aside. In 1-quart microwave-safe bowl combine chips peanut butter and margarine. Microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in vanilla. Pour chocolate mixture over cereal stirring until all pieces are evenly coated then pour cereal mixture into large resealable plastic bag. Add powdered sugar. Seal securely. Shake until all pieces are well coated. Spread on waxed paper to cool. Serve. Store leftovers in airtight containers.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Bring first four ingredients to rolling boil for 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients. Stir and drop by teaspoons on wax paper.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach as directed; drain well. Add bread crumbs and eggs. Add rest of ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Make small balls. Bake on cookie sheet in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 60 balls.

title: Custard Pie(Makes Own Crust)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use shortening and heavily grease and flour deep dish pan. Mix ingredients together. Pour into pan and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cornmeal Drop Biscuits
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Combine milk oil and egg; add to dry ingredients stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on a wire rack. Yields 1 dozen biscuits.

title: Strawberry Kielbasa
instructions: Cut uncooked kielbasa in slices. Sprinkle jello over kielbasa. Spread jam over mixture. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix and serve.

title: Corn And Pea Salad
instructions: At least 24 hours before serving drain corn peas and pimientos. Combine celery green pepper and onion.

title: Pinto Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Cook all ingredients until tender.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Mix sauce together meat oregano pepper parsley onion garlic pepperoni tomato sauce egg and mushrooms. (Best when making mix 1 day before eating.) Put uncooked noodles into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan then add sauce mix then cheese. Repeat layers. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Bring to a boil and cook until thickened. Pour over apple dumplings and finish baking.

title: Broccoli-Bacon Salad
instructions: Mix together broccoli onion raisins and bacon. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over salad adding enough to moisten. Stir gently to mix. Chill.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend graham crumbs and margarine and only 1/3 cup of sugar. Press firmly against bottom and sides of an 8-inch spring-form pan.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and mix well. Mix flour salt and soda; add to batter. Add crushed chips and nuts. Shape into small balls press down on cookie sheet with floured fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Creamed Salmon
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour and blend. Add milk salt and pepper. Cook on medium heat until slightly thick stirring often. Add dill weed grated cheese and salmon. We like this over toast or mashed potatoes.

title: Squash Pickle
instructions: Sprinkle salt over squash and onions and let stand 1 hour. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Add squash and onions. Again bring to a boil. Pack in hot sterile jars and seal. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine ingredients in a 2-cup measuring cup. Microwave on High 3 minutes. Equals 1 can.

title: Baked Potato Mice
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut into thin slices (but not all the way through; use handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way). Put potatoes in a baking dish fanning them slightly. Sprinkle salt and spread butter. Sprinkle herbs. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle on cheese. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes more. Add parsley ears and tail from parsley stem.

title: Dilly Shrimp Dip
instructions: Drain and rinse shrimp. Mix all ingredients together. Serve with crackers fresh vegetables or potato chips.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding flour as needed to roll out and cut with cookie cutter.

title: Sweet Potato Stuff
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread in a 13 x 9 inch casserole dish. Top with topping and cook in 350 degree oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Boil and simmer 20 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 cups sauce. Store in refrigerator. Good on pork or chicken.

title: Appetizer Meatballs
instructions: Combine all but chili sauce jelly and oil. Form into small balls. Brown in hot oil and drain. Add combined chili sauce and jelly. Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Makes about 40 to 60 meatballs.

title: Bacon Tomato Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Chop bacon tomato onion and grated cheese. Mix all ingredients except biscuits. Separate each biscuit into 3 thinner biscuits. Lay each biscuit over a mini muffin pan cup. Press biscuit into cup. Fill cups with bacon mixture and bake 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown. Yields 30.

title: Florence'S Old-Fashioned Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cook this a little longer than\tpreviously and pour on cake.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Blend syrup ingredients (except soda) and boil slowly for 5 minutes. Take off heat. Add soda. Stir until blended. Pour over popped corn and mix. Bake in same pan. Stir until kernels are coated. Place in 200\u00b0 to 225\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. After baked pour on counter to cool. Kernels will be separate.

title: Crab Bites
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Spread on bread (without crust) or English muffin halves. Cut into fourths. Heat until cheese melts in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sesame Chicken(4 Grams Of Fat)
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour over chicken and marinate. Barbecue or bake 40 minutes or until well done.

title: Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Red Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together and chill.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water; add crushed drained pineapple. Add strawberries bananas and walnuts. Pour 1/2 mix in pan; put in fridge until jello is firm (about 1/2 hour) then spread 1 pint remaining jello mixture over sour cream. Chill and serve.

title: Ma-Mae'S Homemade Rolls
instructions: Preparation About 1 hour plus rising time. Cooking Time 10 to 15 minutes. Temperature 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder sugar and salt. Add cornmeal. Beat in a separate bowl the egg. Beat into it butter and milk. Combine all ingredients with a few rapid strokes. Place the batter in the hot pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 9 x 9-inch pan. Serve immediately.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Prepare the instant pudding. Set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Mix the beaten eggs sugar pudding and cream. Put these in freezer can after they are mixed. Add enough milk to have can 3/4 full. Freeze. Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad
instructions: Cook the first 2 ingredients and add remaining ingredients. Chill before serving.

title: Party Fruit Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple to boiling; add gelatin and stir until dissolved. Chill until partially set. Soften cream cheese; stir in pimiento. Add to gelatin mixture and blend. Fold in whipped cream celery and nuts. Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until firm.

title: Squash Relish
instructions: Mix squash and onions. Stir in 5 tablespoons of salt. Let soak overnight. In morning drain and rinse off. Put in large kettle. Add all ingredients. Cook 1/2 hour and put in jars. Really good.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream Crisco vanilla and sugar in a bowl. Add eggs and mix well. Add bananas and mix well. Add flour soda and salt alternating with milk. Add nuts. Spray Pam in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 60 minutes. Should make at least 2 loaves. Let cool and wrap in foil.

title: Benedictine Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients with 1 to 2 drops of food coloring in blender or food processor. Add more color if needed. Blend until smooth. Makes filling for 6 to 8 full size sandwiches.

title: Old Fashioned Sour Cream Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; set aside. Cream together sugar and shortening; add eggs and lemon extract. Blend and add sour cream. Combine this mixture with sifted dry ingredients. Mixture will be stiff. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Brownies
instructions: Beat eggs until thick and frothy; beat in sugar. Melt chocolate and shortening together over slow heat. Add to first mixture. Mix together flour baking powder and salt. For better results sift these together. Add the flour mixture to the first mixture. Stir in vanilla and nuts. To prepare the 8 x 12 pan grease well and line with wax paper. Then grease the waxed paper. Spread into pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into squares and let cool in pan.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute until tender onions in oleo on low heat. Add chicken soup cheese milk broccoli and rice. Mix all together then pour into greased baking dish. Top with a little grated cheese. Bake in 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 oven until bubbly hot.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Use large saucepan to combine and cook all ingredients. Combine cocoa and sugar. Add milk and butter. Then bring to a rolling boil and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Let the peanut butter melt and then add oats. Mix oats well and drop spoonfuls on a piece of wax paper to cool. Then serve.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: In a large bowl mix the ingredients in given order. Spray a muffin tin with nonstick vegetable spray. Fill each cup 2/3 full of mix. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Makes 12 rolls.

title: Pineapple Raisin Muffins
instructions: Beat sugar and margarine until fluffy. Beat in egg juice and orange peel. Combine remaining ingredients; stirring until blended. Spoon batter into greased muffin pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Camp Beans
instructions: Soak beans in water to cover in soup pot overnight. Drain; rinse. Add water to cover onion garlic bay leaves and chicken bouillon. Simmer over low heat for 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes green pepper seasonings ham chunks and brown sugar. Remove bay leaves before serving.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring 1/2 cup of water to a boil then add 2 cups of sugar and 1 cup of white syrup. Stir until dissolved and boil until it will spin a thread. Now add 2 cups of raw peanuts and cook slowly over a low fire until it turns a golden brown. Take from fire and add 2 tablespoons of baking soda and 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Stir quickly. Spread on two large well buttered cookie sheets. Place in cold area.

title: Party Size Fudgy Pudding Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In a large bowl combine baking mix and cocoa. Stir in 2 cups of sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup syrup and vanilla until blended. Spoon evenly into prepared pan. In a small bowl combine rest of milk rest of syrup and hot water. Pour liquid mixture carefully over top of mixture in pan. Do not stir. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until center is set and cake begins to pull away from sides of pan. Let stand 15 minutes. Spoon into dessert dish spooning pudding from bottom of pan over top. Serve warm. Garnish with whipped topping or ice cream. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 16 to 20 servings.

title: Easy Hershey Fudge
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until boiling; boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; let cool for 10 seconds. Add the chocolate bars. Stir until mixed. Pour into a 10 x 13-inch greased glass container.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Dot with butter before baking at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Roll out half the pastry and line a 9-inch pie plate. Place crackers in crust. In saucepan over high heat bring water sugar and cream of tartar to boil; simmer for 15 minutes. Add lemon juice and rind; cool. Pour syrup over crackers. Dot with spread. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Roll out remaining pastry; place over pie. Trim seal and flute edges. Slit top crust to allow steam to escape. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until crust is golden. Cool completely.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well and shape into balls the size of walnuts. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown.

title: Hungry Boy Casserole
instructions: Saute beef onions green pepper and garlic until tender. Add tomato paste water and salt. Mix well. Add beans and mushrooms. Simmer until all ingredients are thoroughly heated. Pour into baking dish and cover with canned biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden.

title: Mom'S Chicken Fricassee
instructions: Take 2 tablespoons oil in large frying pan. Cut up large onions small. Put in large frying pan on medium heat until onions are a bit soft. Take parts of chicken and put salt and paprika on each piece. Put skin side down on onions. Lower to simmer and cook until tender.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Cut chipped beef up small (use scissors or sharp knife). Combine all ingredients; roll in chopped pecans. Chill until ready to eat!

title: Broiled Tomatoes
instructions: Slice tomatoes in half carefully; do not puncture bottom. Squeeze out some seeds and the juice. Add mixture of bread crumbs cheese oregano salt and pepper and a few drops of oil to each tomato half. Put under broiler for 3 to 6 minutes.

title: Sky High Strawberry Pie
instructions: In a large bowl mash enough berries to equal 3 cups. In a saucepan combine the sugar and cornstarch. Stir in the mashed berries and water; mix well. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat; add food coloring if desired. Pour into a large bowl. Chill for 20 minutes stirring occasionally until mixture is just slightly warm. Fold in the remaining berries. Pile into pie shell. Chill for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Bacon Fat Cookies
instructions: Mix bacon fat brown sugar white sugar and eggs until creamy. Add dry ingredients vanilla and nuts. Divide and mold into 2 rolls. Wrap in waxed paper and chill until stiff. Slice and bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Firecracker Casserole
instructions: Cook the meat in skillet until it is no longer pink drain. Add beans chili pwd. cumin and salt. Transfer to a 9 by 13 in. baking dish. Arrange tortillas over the top; combine soup and tomatoes then pour over the tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25-30 min. Yields 8 servings.

title: Decorator Icing
instructions: Mix together. Yields enough icing to do flowers and leaves for 350+ cake squares.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook spinach and drain. Mix rest of ingredients. Mix with spinach. Cut out center of bread. Break into small pieces. Arrange pieces of bread around dip.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Make a paste with food coloring and cocoa and add to mixture. Add salt and flour with buttermilk and vanilla. Alternately add soda and vinegar (mix vinegar and soda together); dont beat hard just blend. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in two 8-inch greased and floured cake pans. Frost with Red Velvet Cake Frosting.

title: Pumpkin Delight
instructions: Mix and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all of above ingredients with a mixer and serve with chips.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Combine sugar syrup water butter and salt. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook until 270\u00b0 or brittle ball in cold water. Remove from heat. Pour over popped corn. Stir and mix. Shape corn into balls and place on wax paper.

title: Fruited Cabbage Salad
instructions: Combine first five ingredients and set aside. In a jar with a tight fitting lid combine the mayonnaise milk sugar lemon juice; shake well. Pour over cabbage mixture and toss to coat.

title: Mignonette Of Beef
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except beef and vegetables then add the beef cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch cubes. Refrigerate at least 5 hours or overnight. Alternate meat and vegetables of your choice on skewer. Broil about 20 minutes brushing with sauce occasionally.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter and sugar until silvery and light. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine milk and vanilla then add to cream mixture alternately with flour mixture. Be sure to begin and end with dry ingredients. Beat\tonly enough to blend. Fold in nuts. Spoon batter into greased and floured 9-inch tube pan.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Cool in pan 15 minutes then remove.

title: Swiss Fondue
instructions: Rub inside of fondue pot or saucepan with cut edge of garlic then discard. In fondue pot simmer apple juice. Blend in soup. Combine cheese and cornstarch; stir into soup mixture. Heat until cheese melts; stir now and then. Spear bread with fondue fork and dip into fondue. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium saucepan melt margarine; blend in flour. Stir in milk salt and chicken broth. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix chicken and noodles with sauce. Pour in pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes to 1 hour until top is lightly browned.

title: One Dish Ham Bake(Chicken, Turkey Or Beef Can Be Used.)
instructions: Mix broccoli soups 1 cup milk meat and onion. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix Bisquick and 1 1/2 cups milk and pour evenly over soup mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 450\u00b0 oven. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Serve with tossed salad and French bread for complete meal.

title: 1, 2, 3, 4 Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs and beat well. Add baking powder to flour. Add alternately with milk to batter. Add vanilla and mix well. Makes 3 or 4 layers. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes. Use favorite filling and icing.

title: Jewel Cookies
instructions: In medium bowl with wooden spoon beat butter sugar egg yolk and vanilla until smooth. Stir in flour just until combined. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Meanwhile preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Using hands roll dough into balls 1-inch in diameter; dip in egg white then roll in walnuts. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. With thimble or thumb press center of each cookie. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until a delicate golden brown. Remove to wire rack; cool. Place 1/4 teaspoon jelly in center of each cookie.

title: Caramel Candy
instructions: Mix sugar milk soda and corn syrup; cook until it forms soft ball in water; remove. Add vanilla butter salt and nuts; beat until stiff. Hurry and drop by spoonfuls onto oiled waxed paper. If cooked too much add a little water to soften.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Boil giblets in salted water with bay leaf and beef bouillon cubes. Brown ground beef and drain. Saute green pepper onion and celery in saucepan with a little butter. Chop cooked giblets after they cook and cool a little. Add giblets ground beef and sauteed vegetables to rice. Add a teaspoon of poultry seasoning and 1/2 teaspoon sage to rice mixture. Cover and cook until rice is done. Serve with baked chicken.

title: Curried Pears
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Use a small baking dish. Peel half and core pears. Combine butter brown sugar curry powder and salt; mix with a spoon. Cook 35 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Jake Kalberer'S Spinach Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients together (except rye bread) in food processor or blender. Hollow out bread; save extra bread for dipping. Pour dip into hollowed out rye bread.

title: Microwave Tomato Jalapeno Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 2-quart glass measure or microproof bowl. Cook 5 to 7 minutes on High or until cheese is melted stirring once during cooking time. Blend thoroughly with electric mixer. Pour into serving bowl. Serve with corn chips or dipping-style potato chips or raw fresh vegetables. Makes about 4 cups. Total cooking time 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: In a small skillet melt margarine and saute onion green pepper and mushrooms stirring often until tender (about 5 minutes). Stir together with next 6 items. Add noodles mixing well. Turn into a greased 2-quart casserole. Top with cheese and bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Beat egg yolks; add condensed milk and lime juice and beat until thick. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Streusel-Filled Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix sugar shortening and egg. Stir in milk. Sift together and stir 1 1/2 cups flour baking powder and salt. The mixture for the struedel is the brown sugar 2 tablespoons flour cinnamon and butter. Spread half batter mixture in greased pan. Sprinkle 1/2 streusel mixture. Alternate rest. Bake in greased and floured pan 25 to 35 minutes at 375\u00b0. Double batter for 13 x 11 x 2-inch pan.

title: Cherry Pie Bars
instructions: Mix margarine sugar vanilla and eggs. Add flour baking powder and salt. Makes soft dough (sticky). Spread 3/4 (plus) of dough on greased sheet cake pan will seem thin (dont have bare spots). Spread on pie cherries (get red everywhere). Take a little at a time part of the 1/4 dough left; add flour and pat out real thin between hands. Place patchy over cherries. Looks real messy cherries and red can show. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes (when it starts to brown and is firm just barely brown).

title: Apple-Pecan Caramel Salad
instructions: Combine apples and pecans in bowl. Mix yogurt light mayonnaise sugar substitute and cinnamon together and pour mixture over apples. Toss gently to coat. Chill until ready to serve. Serves 6.

title: Mrs. Lynch'S Old Country Cake
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Cut in shortening with 2 knives. Add beaten eggs. Stir in raisins and seed. Add milk; stir. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan (or use cooking oil spray). Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 375\u00b0. Can also use 3 small 6-inch round pans and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Pesto Chicken Linguine
instructions: For pesto sauce in blender or food processor container combine spinach parsley chicken broth egg yolk Parmesan cheese basil and garlic. Cover and blend until mixture is pureed. Cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Keep hot.

title: Steak In A Bag
instructions: You can roast the steak in dry heat in the oven if you desire. Roast at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Wipe steak dry. Combine butter garlic oil salt and pepper. Spread butter mixture on both sides of steak. Press crumbs firmly onto steak on both sides. Place in brown grocery type bag. Close with paper clips. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Let stand 5 minutes. Slide onto carving board. Carve into 1/4-inch diagonal slices to serve.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs; cool and remove shells. Cut in half. Remove yolks to mixing bowl. With fork crumble yolks for easy mixing. Add salt pepper sugar green relish and mayonnaise and mix well. Do not use too much mayonnaise or mixture will be runny. Put 1/2 tablespoon of the yolk mixture back in egg white. Garnish with paprika.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and chill.

title: Strawberry Puff
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Beat 2 minutes. Wash and stem berries and put in 8-inch square glass pan. Spoon mixture over berries. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Double recipe for 9 x 13 pan. (Substitute raspberries blueberries crushed pineapple or apples can be used.)

title: Cheese Olive Balls
instructions: Blend cheese and margarine (room temperature). Add flour and other ingredients. Pinch off dough and form into balls around olives. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Fudge
instructions: Stir together first 3 ingredients. Boil 7 1/2 minutes or until it makes a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat and add chocolate chips and marshmallows. Add vanilla. Do not use a mixer! Stir until marshmallows are melted. Add nuts and pour into well buttered pan. Let cool at least 4 to 6 hours. Do not cut until cooled.

title: Quick And Hearty Soup
instructions: In large saucepan brown ground beef; drain off excess fat. Cut up tomatoes slightly. Add beef along with mixed vegetables water onion soup mix salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Stir in macaroni then lower heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips. Pat in pan. Melt chocolate chips in microwave and spread over peanut butter mixture. Cool.

title: Parmesan Round Steak
instructions: Cut steak into 6 servings. Pound each to 1/2-inch thickness. Combine egg and milk. Mix bread crumbs salt and pepper. Dip steaks into egg mixture. Dredge with seasoned crumbs. Brown meat in oil. Add water. Sprinkle oregano on steaks. Place 2 teaspoons Parmesan cheese on each steak. Combine salt and paprika. Sprinkle onions with salt mixture; add to meat. Cover tightly. Cook in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cut fruit in small pieces and mix with nuts and coconut. Combine flour baking powder and soda. Add fruit. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Pour over fruit mixture and mix well. Bake in 2 greased tube pans at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours. Yields 10 pounds. (Use a dishpan to mix fruit and flour and pour egg mixture over it. Makes a big mixture.)

title: Wiener Schnitzel
instructions: Sprinkle veal with lemon juice salt pepper and grated cheese. Let sit for 5 minutes. Then roll in flour egg and breadcrumbs. Fry on one side in hot butter. Turn. Reduce heat. Place cheese slice on each cutlet. Slowly fry other side. Serve with crisp salad.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: When chicken is cool break into small pieces. Store each of the first 3 ingredients in a Ziploc bag until ready to use. In a skillet brown the sesame seed almonds and ginger. Store in Ziploc bag until ready to use.

title: Sausage Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat a wok or large pot until hot. Add a small amount of oil to coat bottom. When oil is hot add cabbage onion and celery and stir-fry until it is about half done. Add sausage rings and continue stirring over high heat until sausage is heated through. Add V-8 juice beef broth soy sauce and pepper. Cook until heated. Thicken with cornstarch and a little of the reserved beef broth. Heat through. Add sesame oil just before serving. Serve over hot fluffy rice.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter; add rice and broccoli. Heat soup in double boiler. Add Cheez Whiz. Stir into broccoli.

title: Easy Deviled Eggs
instructions: Mix yolks of hard-boiled eggs with Thousand Island dressing to desired consistency. Stuff eggs.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: In bowl mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup beef bread crumbs egg and onion. Shape firmly into 6 oval patties. In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon hot oil cook patties until browned. Spoon off fat. Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms. Return patties to skillet. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until done turning patties occasionally.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pudding
instructions: Cream butter sugar and flour together and add egg yolks lemon juice and milk. Fold in egg whites. Pour into buttered casserole. Place in pan of warm water and bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes until firm. Serves 8.

title: Gr. Aunt Frances' Celery Sauce
instructions: Peel tomatoes and squeeze seeds out of them. Mix all ingredients together and boil. Seal while hot.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Separate eggs; let egg whites warm to room temperature. Beat yolks with shortening until well blended. Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add vanilla. Add on low speed and beat in flour alternately with milk. Add coconut and blend well. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in. Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Berry Delicious Fruit Shortcake
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt\tand sugar. Add combined milk melted margarine and beaten egg mixing until well moistened. Spread into greased and floured 8-inch cake pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Layer in loaf pan in order given. Do not mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Place the chicken in a glass baking dish. Make the rice according to the directions on the box. Add the 2 cans of soup and 1 can of water. Pour the rice-soup mixture over the chicken and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Add the cooking sherry and bake approximately 1/2 hour longer.

title: Korean Fried Rice(Bokgeum Bahb)
instructions: Separate cold rice grains with a knife or chopsticks. Chop ham into small pieces. Rinse frozen green peas under cold water and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in frypan and make Egg Pancakes.* Chop Egg Pancakes into thin strips and set aside.

title: Corn Dog Twists
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt margarine in small saucepan over low heat or in microwave on High for 15 to 20 seconds. Unroll dough into 1 long sheet. Seal the short center perforation. Separate into 8 long strips. Wrap each strip around 1 hot dog. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush each corn dog twist with melted margarine. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 16 minutes or until dough is light brown.

title: Fudge Fruit And Cream Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and buttermilk. Fold in whipping cream. Break up cookies and fold into salad. Add oranges and pineapple. Chill.

title: Beer Nuts
instructions: Boil on medium heat 25 to 30 minutes. Stir once or more to keep from burning. Boil until dry. Heat oven 300\u00b0 grease jelly roll pan and spread nuts in pan. Sprinkle coarse salt on nuts. Bake 20 minutes. Stir and salt again. Bake 20 minutes more. Stir so wont stick. Cool and store in container.

title: Cherry Charlies
instructions: Boil cocoa sugar salt milk and corn syrup on medium heat for 2 minutes. Stir in other ingredients. Shape into small balls and drop onto wax paper. Ready to eat when cool.

title: Skillet Or Wok Lasagna
instructions: In a large saucepan cook lasagna or noodles in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes or just until tender. Drain lasagna noodles and set aside. Preheat wok or large skillet over high heat. Break up meat. Stir-fry meat and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes or until meat is brown. Spoon off fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce and cooked noodles.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Beat eggs in a medium bowl. Add milk and vegetable soup mix. Squeeze water out of the spinach. Add to other ingredients. Add the cheese; mix well. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Gloop(Gloop Can Be Pulled To And Fro For A Snap-And-Crackly Tug-Of-War!)
instructions: Pour the white glue into a clean empty peanut butter jar. Add 1/2 cup of water and 10 drops of food coloring and stir. Combine the Borax and a cup of water in a medium size plastic bowl. Slowly pour the glue mixture into the Borax solution and stir until well mixed. The Borax causes the mixture to congeal. Scoop the gloop out of the water and knead it in your hands until it becomes dry enough to play with. If stored in a sealed container or plastic bag it should keep for several weeks. Gloop dries out after a lot of handling.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Mix altogether. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 8 to 9-inch greased square pan for very thick pieces or larger pan for more servings!

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together and pour into hot skillet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can be made into muffins also.

title: Cheerio Bars
instructions: Put the first 3 ingredients in saucepan; cook over low heat until it comes to a full boil. Stir in the peanut butter; stir until melted in. Add rest of ingredients; stir until well coated. Press into a 9 x 9-inch greased pan. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Chocolate Creams
instructions: Melt chocolate with butter in saucepan over very low heat stirring constantly until smooth. Blend in sugar cream and vanilla. Chill about 30 minutes. Shape into 1/2-inch balls and roll in nuts. Store in refrigerator. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Double Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine hamburger crumbs onion pepper egg Italian seasoning and 1/4 cup tomato sauce. On a sheet of tinfoil spread mixture into a 10 x 12-inch rectangle. Sprinkle with cheeses and roll into a log. Seal ends and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. At the end of the hour pour remaining tomato sauce over meat loaf and bake for another 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Peach Cake
instructions: For Cake Cream sugar and butter. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add soda to buttermilk. Then stir into first mixture alternately with flour and salt. Add peaches and nuts. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool.

title: Good Rice
instructions: Mix all together in casserole. Place margarine on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Lamb Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown chops on both sides. Place in greased casserole. Pour drippings over meat. Saute onion in butter until golden brown. Mix onion potatoes cucumbers salt and pepper. Spread over chops. Add tomatoes. Cover. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Cool Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cut vegetables into bite size pieces. Put in large bowl. Mix together and add dressing. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Stir and ready to serve. Serves approximately 10 people.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in large mixer bowl. Blend and beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Stir in nuts and coconut. Pour into greased pan at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Remove from pan and cool on rack.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Stir sugar corn syrup salt and vanilla into margarine. Blend into eggs. Add pecans. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cook meat onion and pepper in oil until browned. Stir in remaining ingredients except rice. Simmer for 45 minutes or 1 hour stirring occasionally. Serve over rice.

title: Garbage Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Stir all ingredients into large bowl in order given. (Butter should be soft.) Mix by hand then beat on medium speed with mixer for 2 minutes. Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1 hour and 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out dry. Cool then top with cream cheese frosting.

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix the last four ingredients together. Fold in 1 (8 ounce) container of Cool Whip. Pour in pie shell and chill. Sprinkle coconut on top (optional).

title: Buttermilk Meat Loaf Ring
instructions: Combine buttermilk bread onion egg salt and pepper. Mix lightly just until blended. Pack firmly into buttered ring mold. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Allow to stand for 5 minutes. Drain off fat. Turn out onto serving dish and drizzle catsup over meat loaf.

title: Sweet Potato Slaw
instructions: Combine vegetables in a bowl. Toss gently. Combine remaining ingredients and stir well. Add to cabbage mixture. Toss well. Cover and chill. Yields 6 servings. Serving Size 1/2 cup. Exchanges 1 bread/starch.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Line with wax paper. Grease again. Sprinkle coconut and pecans onto paper.

title: Refrigerated Cheese Torte
instructions: Save 1/2 cup of this mixture for top. Blend ingredients as for pie crust. Grease 9 x 3-inch loose bottom torte pan and line sides and bottom with graham cracker crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool before freezing.

title: Geneva'S Coffee Bars
instructions: In a large bowl cream together the shortening and sugar. Add the eggs and beat thoroughly. Add the hot coffee. Mix well. Sift together the flour baking powder baking soda and cinnamon. Stir into the egg mixture blending well. Add the chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into a greased jelly roll pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. While still warm frost with a powdered sugar glaze.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and mix until well blended. Add the eggs and beat thoroughly. Mix soda salt and cinnamon with flour. Add to first mixture alternately with the milk. Fold in rolled oats nutmeats and raisins. Drop from spoon onto greased baking sheets. Bake 10 minutes in a hot oven (400\u00b0).

title: Berried Delight
instructions: Combine crumbs 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Bake in a heavy Dutch oven for 3 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. The last 30 minutes cut strings. Serve on sub buns.

title: Seasoned Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Drain peas (if desired instead of soaking cover peas with water and bring to boil then let stand 1 hour). Combine peas water bouillon onion pepper garlic thyme vegetable oil and salt in Dutch oven or large saucepan. Bring to boil then reduce heat and cover. Simmer gently for 1 hour or until tender. Add additional water if pea mixture becomes too thick. Serves 8.

title: Noodle-Pineapple Kugel
instructions: Nadine Shirley one of the volunteers known as Apple Pandowdies passed away before last Apple Jubilee in Waverly Missouri. Her daughter Pat Maycock continues Nadines tradition of baking apple dumplings for the celebration using local Jonathan apples. Baking powder lightens the flaky pastry.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix well. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa cornstarch and milk in saucepan. Heat until smooth and very warm. Stir in margarine vanilla and egg yolks. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0 turn heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 10 more minutes. Prepare Never Fail Meringue while pie bakes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix filling in order given. Pour into pie shells. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center of pie filling comes out clean. Let cool. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Brunch Souffle
instructions: In a large casserole greased with margarine break up bread. Grate Cheddar cheese and mix with bread. In a blender mix quickly eggs and milk. Pour over bread and cheese mixture. Cover with foil and let sit in fridge overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour; 35 to 40 minutes covered 20 to 25 minutes uncovered.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: In bowl combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Cut in Crisco until mixture is coarse crumbs. Stir in buttermilk. Knead dough gently. Roll out to 1/2 inch thick. Cut with 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter and place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 450 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 10 biscuits.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 1/2 cup sugar; beat again. Add 1/2 cup more sugar and vanilla. Take 24 Ritz crackers and crush into mixture. Add chopped pecans. Pour into greased pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Peel onion. Cut in 1/2-inch slices. Separate rings. Combine dry ingredients and stir well. Add eggs milk and teaspoon oil. Beat until smooth. Dip onion rings into batter and fry in deep hot oil until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Crisp Marshmallow Bars
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan melt butter and marshmallows over low heat stirring occasionally until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat; blend in vanilla. In a large bowl add mixture to cereal. Stir to coat. Spread into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool completely. Cut into bars.

title: Beefy Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Combine cornmeal mix eggs buttermilk and corn. Saute ground beef; add onion and cook until onion is transparent then drain. Pour 1/2 of the cornbread mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased liberally. Crumble ground beef over cornbread mix and sprinkle cheese over this. Top with peppers then rest of the cornbread mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Pickle And Onion Salad
instructions: Cut into chunks the onions and pickles. Mix with mayonnaise to make sauce. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve with fried fish.

title: Baked Eggplant Parmesiana
instructions: Dip each slice of eggplant into well beaten egg and into seasoned bread crumbs. Fry breaded eggplant slices in medium to hot oil in frying pan 2 minutes on each side. Drain cooked eggplant slices on paper towels. Layer in glass baking dish some of your favorite tomato sauce then all of the cooked eggplant. Top with more sauce and finish by topping with some grated Mozzarella cheese and dried oregano.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a large plastic food bag or bowl combine all ingredients. Toss until potatoes are coated evenly. Place into shallow baking or roasting pan. Bake stirring occasionally 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley. Per serving 174 calories 9 grams fat.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add flour stirring until smooth and thick. Cook one minute stirring constantly. Gradually add broth and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbly. Stir in all of the remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Add top crust. Make several slits in top crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mashed Potato Candy
instructions: Add sugar and vanilla to cold potato. Roll with rolling pin dusted with flour. Spread with peanut butter. Roll up like a pinwheel; place in refrigerator. Cut into slices. May be frozen. Wrap in wax paper or plastic wrap so it doesnt dry out.

title: Chocolate Boiled Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar milk margarine and cocoa over medium heat until it comes to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add nuts oats peanut butter and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Vegetarian Four-Bean Chili(Low-Calorie, Low-Fat, Low-Cholesterol)
