instructions: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat. Add onion green pepper and garlic; saute 4 minutes or until onion is softened. Add carrot; cover and cook 2 minutes. Add zucchini summer squash chili powder oregano and cumin. Saute 1 minute. Add tomatoes breaking up with wooden spoon the beer and salt. Bring to boiling. Lower heat; simmer partially covered 15 minutes. Stir in all the beans. Simmer stirring until heated through.

title: Rye Snacks
instructions: In a bowl combine the first 7 ingredients. Spread on bread slices and place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix together. Refrigerate overnight or until ready to use. Serve with veggies or chips.

title: Beef And Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: In a small bowl mix beef broth with cornstarch and teriyaki sauce; set aside. In a large skillet heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat; add mushrooms green pepper and onions. Stir-fry until tender. Remove to bowl. Add remaining oil and beef; stir-fry until cooked. Add beef broth mixture and cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add vegetables. Serve in warm pastry shells.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
instructions: Simmer peeled sliced apples in undiluted apple juice until apples are tender. Add cinnamon and cornstarch moistened with a small amount of water. Cook until thickened.

title: Meringue Cake
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder. Mix in order given. Pour into 2 layer cake pans.

title: Biscotti
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and knead. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm. Let cool for 10 minutes. Slice and rebake on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Jerusalem
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan. Dredge chicken pieces in flour and lightly brown in oil. Place in casserole with mushrooms and artichoke hearts. Stir in garlic and spices (with tomatoes). Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender adding sherry during last few minutes of cooking time. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients flour sugar pumpkin pie spice soda powder and salt in one bowl.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Wash stem and\tquarter apples. Place cider in kettle. Add apples and\tcook slowly until soft. Put apples through strainer. Measure apples and for each cup add 1/2 cup sugar. Mix well. Add\tspices. Cook slowly over low heat stirring until sugar is dissolved then\tcook rapidly until butter is thick.

title: Mississippi Pecan Pie
instructions: Boil syrup and sugar together for two minutes. Pour slowly over eggs and stir well. Add margarine vanilla and nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375 degrees for 50 minutes.

title: Easy, Good Salad
instructions: In a bowl mix together cottage cheese Cool Whip and jello. Drain fruit and blend in. Chill before serving.

title: Burrito Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Drain. Add can of beans and taco seasoning. Stuff tortillas and place in casserole dish. Mix chili and picante sauce in separate bowl. Pour over tortillas. Top with cheese and bake at 375\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in casserole. Top with crackers crumbled and 1 stick margarine mixed. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Barbecued Steak Platter(Cube Steaks)
instructions: Combine all ingredients heat and pour over 4 cube steaks. Let stand for 15 minutes. Drain and place steaks on rack 2 inches below broiler. Broil 5 minutes on each side basting once or twice with sauce. Brown 4 bread slices in butter or margarine and arrange steaks on slices. Serve with onion and pickle.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Boil pineapple and sugar together. Add Jell-O; when dissolved add cup water. Refrigerate until almost jelled; add cheese Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain artichokes well and chop. Grate cheese. Combine with mayonnaise and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm with crackers.

title: Cocoa Fudge Icing
instructions: Combine all except vanilla in pot. Slowly bring to a boil. Cook for 4 minutes stirring constantly. Take from heat; add vanilla and beat until spreading consistency. Ready to frost 2 or 3 layer cake. (I usually use Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix for layers.)

title: Italian Supper Casserole
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to directions. Drain rinse and separate. brown the beef and sprinkle the mix over the meat. Add tomatoes and blend well. Whip the cream cheese. In a buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole. Make 2 layers each of noodles meat & dollops of cream cheese. Bake at 350 degree for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chinese Goulash
instructions: Brown beef; drain fat. Add onion and celery and continue cooking until tender but not soft. Add bean sprouts and soup. Heat thoroughly. Add canned mushrooms if desired. Serve over chow mein noodles.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef. While beef is cooking cook all other ingredients together. Drain beef then mix all together in a large pot. Cook for 10 more minutes. Very good!

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar undissolved yeast and salt. Gradually add water and 2 tablespoons peanut oil to flour mixture. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic about 8 to 10 minutes. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Roll dough to a 12-inch circle; place on a greased pizza pan. Form a standing rim on crust. Prick dough with fork randomly. Let rest 10 minutes. Prebake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Cajun Turkey
instructions: Mix together m.s.g. cayenne pepper paprika white pepper and celery salt. Rub into turkey cavity and all over the skin. (Be careful and dont touch your hands to your eyes!) Separate garlic bud and clean cloves. Slit holes all over turkey and insert cloves. Also place cloves of garlic in stomach cavity of turkey. Mix a 4 ounce bottle of shrimp and crab boil with 4 (4 ounce) bottles of water and inject into turkey all over the body. Place turkey in stainless steel roasting pan and cover with foil. Refrigerate for 24 to 48 hours occasionally basting with juices in pan. When ready to cook heat oil. Place whole turkey in oil and fry until tender.

title: Satsuma Salad
instructions: Peel the satsumas and cut crosswise into slices. Sprinkle powdered sugar over satsuma slices. Drain pineapple. Mix all ingredients together and let stand in refrigerator overnight (or at least 3 to 4 hours). To serve spoon mixture onto lettuce leaves.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Beat together all ingredients except bananas. Then mix well. Turn in bananas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Green Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix together peas onions soup bacon and water chestnuts. Place in casserole dish. Top with Stove Top mix and melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 to 25 minutes until brown.

title: Heavenly Fluff
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; chill in a classy glass bowl.

title: Lite Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Shape in 7 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan which was coated with cooking spray (Pam). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Serves 6. Pepper slices can be placed on top of meat loaf before cooking for decoration.

title: Chicken Aspic Salad
instructions: Sprinkle 1 envelope gelatin in tomato juice. Heat stirring until dissolved. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon lemon juice and dash of Tabasco. Set aside to cool. In separate saucepan sprinkle 1 envelope gelatin in chicken stock. Heat; stir until dissolved. Remove from heat and add 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Let cool. Add chicken celery and green pepper. Pour 1/2 of mixture into loaf pan that has been Pam coated. Chill. When firm add tomato aspic mixture. When aspic is almost firm spread last half of chicken mix. Chill. Serve on lettuce.

title: Rigatoni Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Cook spaghetti sauce. Add mix and water. Cook for 20 minutes. Layer all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Mix and bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Chocolate Cookie Sheet Cake
instructions: Remove from heat. Add 1 box powdered sugar. Beat. Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts and 2 teaspoons vanilla. Spread on cake as soon as it is taken from the oven.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In a large bowl beat butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla extract until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate and nuts. Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes until golden brown. Yields 5 dozen cookies (using tablespoons of dough).

title: James Earl Jones' Chilean Sea Bass
instructions: Slice and cook onions in a skillet on low heat until caramelized (between 1 and 2 hours). Puree all ingredients except olive oil and chicken broth. Heat olive oil. Add ingredients and cook on low for 30 minutes. Add chicken broth as necessary. Season bass with salt and white pepper to taste. Cover bass with onions and bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Each of 6 servings should include one piece of bass over about 1/6 of the sauce.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugar syrup and margarine. Add salt vanilla and eggs (one at a time). Stir in pecans. Pour into pie crust. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Smoky Salmon Appetizer Ball
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Place mixture on plastic wrap and form into a ball. Cover and chill overnight. Several hours before serving roll in chopped nuts. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Bake at 300\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Do not bake crust before pouring in the ingredients.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Stir in meat and brown. Stir in flour pepper salt and soup.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine and shape into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Press into center of hot cookies 36 chocolate kisses. Remove to wire rack to cool. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Best Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together by hand until all ingredients are combined. Put in dish and put in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with ketchup. Cook uncovered.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash and cut cucumbers in half lengthwise; pack in hot jars with the last 5 ingredients put in each pint jar. Combine sugar salt vinegar and water. Tie pickling spices in a cheesecloth bag; add to vinegar mixture. Simmer 15 minutes. Heat to boiling and pour over cucumbers; leave 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process pints and quarts 15 minutes in boiling water bath. Yield about 7 pints.

title: Orange Molded Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sherbet and place in refrigerator until partly set (watch carefully). Add other ingredients and fold in Cool Whip last. Chill and enjoy.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chili sauce shrimp and parsley. Spread on plate. Cover with chili sauce then sprinkle tiny shrimp and parsley flakes. Serve with crackers.

title: Aunt Beta'S Beer Bread
instructions: Blend beer egg and sugar then add flour. Put it in a bread pan and cover with towel. It rises in an hour or so. Bake at 350\u00b0 for an hour. Cool and slice bread. Spread real butter on top. Mmmm! Good!

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit well.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat and drain then add seasoning mix taco sauce and kidney beans. Let all this get hot then its ready to eat.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Spoon 1 teaspoon filling into pastry shell. Bake tarts at 350\u00b0 for 17 minutes. Garnish with cream. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add the egg and vanilla. Then the rest of the ingredients. Roll in balls and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Combine ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Walnut Bread
instructions: Chop walnuts. Beat eggs; gradually beat in sugar then oil. Combine first mixture alternating with zucchini. Stir in raisins walnuts and vanilla extract. Turn into 2 greased and lightly floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 or until loaves test done approximately 1 hour. (Bake on lowest rack in oven.) Let stand about 10 minutes turn out onto wire racks to cool. If desired loaves may be lightly frosted with confectioners sugar butter and vanilla mixed to a spreading consistency with milk. Makes two loaves. Freezes well!

title: Onion Pie
instructions: Saute onions until clear. Pour onions into a prepared pie shell. Add grated cheese. Beat eggs; add milk and pour over cheese. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Macaroni-Beef Skillet Supper
instructions: Cook the macaroni in boiling water according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Saute the meat onion and garlic in oil until the meat loses its pink color and the onions are tender. Add salt pepper tomato sauce catsup mushrooms Worcestershire sauce and Italian seasoning. Bring mixture to a boil and then simmer gently for about 5 minutes. Mix in the cooked macaroni and simmer 5 more minutes. Yields 8 servings. Contains 270 calories per serving.

title: Artichoke And Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach. Saute onion in butter. Mix spinach onion artichoke hearts sour cream and 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese in a casserole dish. Add pepper and toss well. Put remaining 1/4 cup cheese on top. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Cabbage
instructions: Brown onions. Remove from pan. Place 1/3 cabbage in pan followed by 1/2 of bell pepper one tomato and half the browned onion. Layer with another 1/3 of cabbage and remaining bell pepper tomato and onions. Sprinkle remaining cabbage on top and add salt and pepper. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in oil until limp. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes. Add cooked meat if desired.

title: Coconut Grouper
instructions: Combine lime juice oregano and half the garlic. Marinate the fish in this for at least 1/2 hour.

title: Candied Dill Pickles
instructions: Dissolve 1 pint of lime in 2 gallons of water. Peel seed and cut cucumbers into strips. (Use large cucumbers even the white ones; use the meat only. You can fix small ones the same way.) Pour lime mixture over cucumbers and let stand for 24 hours. Drain and rinse cucumbers. Fill with ice cold water and let stand for 3 hours. Drain. Mix vinegar sugar salt and spices together. Pour over cucumbers. Let stand overnight. Put on stove next morning and boil for 35 minutes. Put in jars and seal. Makes 10 pints.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat in olive oil with garlic basil parsley and salt. Add tomatoes and paste. Simmer 1 hour. Cook noodles until tender (rinse with cold water). In bowl combining cottage cheese eggs Parmesan cheese parsley and pepper. In 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan put little meat on bottom then noodles half of cottage cheese mixture half of Mozzarella cheese half of meat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Meatballs With Gravy
instructions: Mix well the first 6 ingredients; shape into balls. Brown in the shortening. Mix the soup with water; pour over meatballs. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Crumble
instructions: Combine rhubarb apples and strawberries; spoon into a greased 8-inch square baking dish. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over fruit. Set aside. In a bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Cut in oleo until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in brown sugar and oats. Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve cold or warm with a scoop of ice cream if desired.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Wash and clean peppers. Parboil peppers for 5 minutes. Let cool and drain. Combine rice meat salt pepper and butter; mix well. Stuff peppers; place peppers in a pan uncovered with a little water in the bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (check after 45 minutes). Heat can of tomato sauce and serve with peppers.

title: Barbecue Coleslaw
instructions: Combine vinegar and sugar in small saucepan. Cook over low heat just until sugar dissolves. Stir in barbecue sauce water mayonnaise mustard powder and red pepper seasoning. Combine cabbage and carrots in large bowl. Pour dressing over; toss to combine.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients but potatoes and mix well. Add potatoes and mix gently. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This can be frozen and taken out when needed.

title: Garlic Spread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Slice about 1/2-inch off the top of the garlic. Wrap it in aluminum foil and bake for 35 minutes. Remove foil and press until all flesh squeezes out. You should have 1 heaping tablespoonful of puree. Mix it with the yogurt parsley black pepper and salt.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Melt butter; stir in Eagle Brand milk and Hersheys syrup. For the cake just bake devils food cake and follow directions on box. Cut cake and ice cream in squares and pour fudge over top.

title: Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions without adding fat or salt. Drain and rinse with cold water. Set aside. In a large bowl combine tomato sauce dressing  basil and oregano. Add tomatoes cucumber onion and olives. Stir until coated. Add pasta and gently toss. Refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Bake in Magnolite pot. Pour in cherry filling. Layer can of crushed pineapple on top of cherry filling. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top of fillings. Sprinkle pecans over mixture. Pour melted margarine over mixture. Bake for 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Then turn oven down to 350\u00b0 and bake for 25 more minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in greased iron skillet on 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 until brown.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use 9 x 13-inch pan and 2-quart saucepan.

title: Sea Scallops With Lemon Butter Sauce
instructions: Coat 1 lb. sea scallops in flour. Season with salt and pepper. Saute scallops in olive oil & butter in a large skillet over high heat for 2 minutes on each side.\tRemove scallops. Add butter lemon juice parsley salt & pepper and heat. Serve scallops over rice and top with sauce from skillet.

title: Papa Nick'S Dill Pickles
instructions: Bring water vinegar and salt to boil; let stand 20 minutes. When cool pour over cukes and green tomatoes prepared according to preference. Small tomatoes and cucumbers can be left whole if desired and larger vegetables can be cut into chunks. Cucumbers may be sliced open lengthwise and cut into quarters or eighths. Put vegetables in quart jars; to each jar add 2 sprigs dill and 2 large garlic cloves depending on taste.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Season and cook chicken. Bone and cut in bite-size pieces. Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix soup and sour cream and heat. Pour over chicken. Mix crackers and poppy seed and place on top of meat. Drizzle melted oleo on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until bubbly.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Cut strawberries in half. Slice bananas. Drain pineapple. Cream sugar and cheese together. Fold in tub of Cool Whip and marshmallows. Mix together the frozen strawberries pineapple and pecans. Add to cheese mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Easy Pecan Rolls
instructions: Butter pan. Cover pan with frozen bread dough then add pudding mix brown sugar cinnamon pecans and butter. Cover; let sit out on counter overnight. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes uncovered then 15 minutes covered.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and Miracle Whip and whip the cream in separate bowl. Fold crushed pineapple marshmallows and chopped cherries into cream cheese and Miracle Whip. Last add whipped cream. Put into 13 x 9-inch dish; freeze overnight. Let set at room temperature 1/2 hour before eating.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly all ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12 3/4-inch oblong pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in bottom rack of oven.

title: Quick Fruit Cake
instructions: Combine all these ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes about a 3 pound fruit cake.

title: Johnny Marzetti
instructions: Brown beef onions pepper and mushrooms. Add tomato paste sauce water and Worcestershire sauce. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Arrange in 2 small or one large oblong dish.

title: Apple Snack
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Place apples in a single layer in a large flat baking pan. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven and stir in popcorn and pecans. Mix remaining ingredients in a cup and drizzle over apples popcorn and pecans. Return to oven and bake for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Red Cake
instructions: Mix butter sugar and eggs. Make a paste of red coloring and cocoa. Add to creamed mixture. Add buttermilk alternating with sifted flour and salt. Add vanilla. In small cup mix soda and vinegar then add to rest of mixture blending instead of beating. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 2 (8-inch) greased and floured pans.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid juice and sugar in a gallon jug. Add water to fill jug.

title: Crab Meat Dip
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes and serve with Triscuits.

title: Miracle Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Add shortening eggs vanilla and corn syrup. Mix for 2 minutes at low speed; scrape bowl. Stir in nuts; save some nuts to sprinkle on top. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook pasta as directed; drain. Combine curry yogurt mayonnaise lemon juice mustard and garlic. Add chicken red pepper celery scallions and sunflower seed. Toss lightly. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons into each shell. Chill. Serve on lettuce.

title: Choc' Gravy
instructions: Mix well and cook over medium heat until thick. Serve over buttered toast or biscuits.

title: Party Mints
instructions: Mix with fork until moist. Add milk. Do not get too moist. Mix with hands. Will be very stiff. Push into rubber molds.

title: Joe'S Cheesecake
instructions: Combine ingredients except sour cream. Beat until smooth blending in sour cream. Pour into graham or nut crust trim with reserved crumbs. Bake in moderate (375\u00b0) oven for 35 minutes or until just set. Let cool with oven door open. Do not overheat or cool too rapidly. Chill well.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice onions into thin rings. Saute in margarine until limp or opaque. Pour half of onions into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover with Parmesan cheese then crushed crackers. Repeat layers and bake uncovered in 325\u00b0 oven until golden brown about 30 minutes. Delicious with steak!!

title: Peach Cobbler Cake
instructions: Pour undrained peaches in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle Jell-O over peaches. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Poke holes in cake mix and pour 1 1/2 cups water over all. Dot with 1 1/4 sticks butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients except beef. Mix well. Add ground beef; mix. Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour. Drain; let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Linda'S Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix jell-O with hot water. Add pineapple with the juice and the pie filling; mix well. Place in a 13 x 9 casserole dish. Let congeal in refrigerator. In a small bowl mix cream cheese sour cream and sugar. Pour this mixture over congealed salad.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Combine chocolate cake mix butter water oil and 1/2 can sweetened condensed milk in mixing bowl. Mix well. Pour half of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Kentucky Jam Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil buttermilk eggs blackberry jam and vanilla in large bowl. Beat well on low speed. Add combined ingredients and beat on medium speed to blend well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans for 40 minutes or until tests done. Cool completely and frost with Buttermilk Icing.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all together with your hands. Make into small balls and bake on ungreased baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes until golden brown. Serve hot. These make such a hit with every one and are so easy.

title: Polka Dot Cake
instructions: Mix dates and hot water. Let cool. Cream butter and sugar then beat in eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add to cream mixture. Add dates vanilla and 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Spread batter in greased pan. Top with remaining chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pina Colada Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients and freeze in a covered container. When ready to serve let defrost to a slushy consistency.

title: Applesauce Salad
instructions: Heat applesauce in pan. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add orange juice and pineapple. Stir until smooth. Pour into mold and chill.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Melt butter. Mix all ingredients and roll into balls. Roll in chopped pecans or coconut if desired.

title: Beef And Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions; drain grease. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cup Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Press flat. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately eight minutes. Watch carefully for these goodies burn easily.

title: Pa'S Fruit Bread
instructions: Mix sugar cooking oil and eggs. Add fruit and nuts; mix well. Stir in flour; mix well. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Melt oleo in dish. Combine all other ingredients and mix lightly. Add to butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix sugar eggs vegetable oil mashed bananas and vanilla. Then add sifted flour with baking soda and salt. Add nuts if you like. Pour mixture into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dessert Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Arrange cut cookie dough (1/8 to 1/4-inch) rounds in slightly overlapping pattern on pizza pan. Press dough together to seal. Bake until puffed and golden about 10 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix and store in tightly covered container. Use 3 to 4 teaspoons mixture in cup of hot water.

title: Sugar Pie
instructions: Mix the flour with the sugar. Add the milk. Mix and pour into 1 pie crust and cover with the second crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Lower the heat to 300 degrees and bake for approximately 15 minutes longer.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix with sauce.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Place pastry in pie pan. Arrange rhubarb. Mix sugar with flour and add beaten egg yolks and butter. Spoon mixture over rhubarb. Bake in hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 25 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in their jackets until done. Peel while still hot; let cool. Slice in thin round slices. Mix in mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Grate onion and add with salt and pepper. Mix again. Chill thoroughly for 3 hours.

title: Bluegill Parmesan
instructions: Place butter in a shallow dish. In another dish combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and seasonings. Dip fillets in butter then coat with crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes uncovered or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cook cauliflower in saltwater 10 to 15 minutes; drain. In saucepan cook onion in butter until tender. Blend in flour. Add chicken broth milk and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until slightly thickened. Add cauliflower. Bring to boil; add cheese. Sprinkle chives over each serving.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls on cookie sheet but do not take them apart. Bake until golden brown and let cool. Mix cream cheese and dry seasonings together. Spread mixture on baked crescent rolls and sprinkle on all chopped veggies. Let chill and serve.

title: Billy Faye'S Chip Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Heat on low until melted and fairly smooth. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Scott'S Sour Cream Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spoon in miniature muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar and water (boiled 1 minute to syrup). In bowl mix egg yolks flour and milk; slowly add syrup. Return to stove; boil until thick. Add vanilla; pour into baked pie shell. Sprinkle top with crushed graham crackers.

title: Plum Cake(This Is A Surprise!)
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs plums food coloring and vanilla. Add flour soda salt cinnamon cloves and pecans. Mix well and pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Glaze cake while still warm after removing from pan.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat slowly. Spoon off excess fat. Add next 4 ingredients. Cover and simmer 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Salt to taste. Cook noodles in salted water until tender; drain. Rinse in cold water. Place half of the noodles in large baking dish. Cover with 1/3 of the sauce. Add half of the Mozzarella cheese then half of the cottage cheese. Repeat layers ending with sauce. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove from bone. Line bottom and sides of greased 3-quart casserole dish with layer of tortillas. Sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons chicken stock. Layer with 1/2 can undiluted mushroom soup and 1/2 of other ingredients in the order listed. Cover with another layer of tortillas; sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons chicken stock and remaining ingredients. Top the last layer of cheese with can of tomatoes with chilies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sheila'S Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine in skillet. Add to rest of ingredients in a rectangular dish; cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Cherry Burgundy Ice Cream
instructions: In saucepan dissolve jello in 1/2 cup boiling water and juice from the cherries. Cool slightly. In mixing bowl beat eggs well. Add sugar; beat well. Blend in the half and half. Cut cherries into fourths and add to mixture; stir in vanilla and jello mixture last. Pour into freezer canister. Add milk until about 3/4 full. An electric freezer takes about 15 minutes to freeze.

title: Whipped Cream Supreme
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in flour and nuts. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Serve with assorted vegetables (tomatoes cauliflower green pepper cucumber celery etc.).

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls and press flat into cookie sheet. Join all creases. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool in pan.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add vinegar oil and water. Bring to boil. Add beets and cook over low heat 30 minutes or until thick.

title: Old Fashion Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine pumpkin sugars and all spices well. Beat eggs well with 1/4 cup melted oleo or butter. Add this to the pumpkin mixture and mix well. Pour into 10-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 40 minutes longer.

title: Strawberry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour melted butter into a shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. In a large bowl combine flour 1/4 cup sugar and milk. Pour mixture evenly over butter. Combine strawberries remaining 1/2 cup sugar and water in a separate bowl then spoon evenly over the flour/milk layer. Do not stir. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until it resembles coarse crumbs. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add yeast and buttermilk to dry mixture. Mix well. Roll out desired amount on lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thick. Cut with 2-inch cutter. Let rise 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Watch carefully until you get the time right for your oven. Dough will keep in refrigerator a week in covered container or plastic bag.

title: Icebox Pie
instructions: Blend ingredients well in blender. (If making lemon icebox pie blend juice from 2 lemons in blender with cottage cheese.) Pour mixture into a bowl. Add 1 vanilla supplement and mix well.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
instructions: Remove skin from chicken. Place chicken water salt and pepper in Dutch oven. Heat to boiling reduce heat cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove chicken from broth. Skim fat from broth. Strain broth.

title: Crab Gumbo
instructions: Heat oil in large kettle on medium heat. Add flour stirring constantly until dark brown but not burned. Add onion and garlic. Cook until tender stirring occasionally. Gradually stir in undrained tomatoes. Add sugar worcestershire sauce salt hot pepper sauce and bay leaf. Stir to break up tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes to blend flavor stirring occasionally. Add okra. Cook 5 minutes or until tender stirring occasionally. Add crab. Stir gently and heat through. Discard bay leaf. Serve gumbo over rice. (4 servings.)

title: Tarheel Pie
instructions: Melt margarine; pour over chocolate chips until dissolved. Combine eggs sugar vanilla and nuts. Mix with chocolate mixture. Place in deep dish pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Chili With Rice
instructions: Combine kidney beans Northern beans undrained tomatoes tomato sauce pepper onion chili powder sugar basil garlic and water in a large saucepan. Bring to boiling and reduce heat. Simmer covered for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Top each serving with 1/2 cup rice. Serves 4.

title: Sparkling Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water. Stir in lemonade. Add ginger ale and ice. Serve. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients like pie dough; roll to size of walnut. Set on wax paper. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in a double boiler. Leave the pan of water under the melted chocolate while dipping the balls. Set on wax paper on cookie sheet and cool. Store in tight container in refrigerator.

title: Patty'S Peanut Butter Icing
instructions: Mix together and beat at high speed for at least 5 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza
instructions: You dont have to toast muffins.

title: Mushroom-Cheese Souffle(A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.)
instructions: Start heating oven to 300\u00b0. With hand beater beat egg yolks until light and foamy. Stir milk gradually into flour. Add to egg yolks and beat well. Add salt pepper and cheese and beat until blended. Gently fold in onion mushrooms and egg whites stiffly beaten. Turn into greased 1-quart casserole. Bake about 50 minutes or until golden brown on top. Makes 2 servings.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt the butter in saucepan. Stir in the brown sugar. Cook 2 minutes on low heat stirring constantly. Add the milk stirring until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from stove. Stir in the confectioners sugar gradually. Add the vanilla and mix well. Spread immediately on cake. Frost 1 pound cake or 2 layers.

title: Frozen Waldorf Salad
instructions: Place the eggs pineapple juice sugar and salt in a saucepan and blend and cook until it boils. Cool.

title: Savory Oven-Fried Eggplant
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Slice eggplant into 1/2-inch slices. Beat eggs slightly. Drop crumbs and seasonings into blender jar and blend well. Pour crumbs on plate. Grease 11 x 17-inch jelly roll pan or baking pan with Crisco; heat pan for several minutes in hot oven. Dip eggplant in egg and then into crumbs. Place on hot baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes on each side. Serve immediately with lemon slices.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
instructions: In large bowl combine pears sugar and pecans. Set aside for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour large tube pan. Using wooden spoon stir into pear mixture the oil vanilla and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Bake 1 hour.

title: Cream Of Mushroom Soup
instructions: Chill broth so fat will raise. Mix cornstarch and broth together. Cook on medium heat. Stir in milk Worcestershire sauce and mushrooms. Bring to boil. Cool and garnish with paprika.

title: Sin Cake
instructions: Mix flour melted oleo and nuts. Spread in pan; bake approximately 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until light brown. Mix cream cheese sugar and 1/2 cup Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Mix pudding and milk until thick; spread over 2nd layer. Spread cherry pie filling over all. Cover with the balance of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Drain tuna. Mix with cream cheese until smooth. Add seasoning. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Party Chicken Breast Bake
instructions: Lightly grease baking dish. Flatten breasts and place slice of\tchipped beef and shredded cheese on each breast. Roll up each breast with ends down. Place in baking dish. Combine soup and sour cream and spoon over rolled breasts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Hero Sandwiches
instructions: Saute ground beef and onion in skillet until ground beef is brown. Stir frequently. Add chilies olives catsup salt and chili powder and mix well. Cook for 5 minutes. Stir occasionally. Place one slice Colby cheese on bottom half of each loaf. Spoon ground beef mixture over cheese. Arrange bacon slice and Muenster cheese slice over ground beef. Cover with remaining loaf halves. Wrap loaves with aluminum foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken pieces in beaten eggs. Shake chicken in a bag of flour (plus a little cornstarch). Deep fry until brown. Place chicken in baking dish cover with cashews onion and sauce. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Bites
instructions: Blend all ingredients except muffins. Toast muffins until half dark. Top with mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cut into 4 pieces.

title: Tomato Shrimp Aspic
instructions: Sprinkle gelatine over cold water. Stir in sugar salt lemon juice and hot tomato juice until its dissolved. Add shrimp celery onion and olives. Pour into mold and leave overnight. When ready to serve set in hot water for a few seconds and unmold on platter. Arrange salad greens around outside and serve with side dish of salad dressing.

title: Helen'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar margarine eggs and flavorings thoroughly. Measure flour and sift. Stir flour baking powder and salt together. Blend well and chill at least 1 hour. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on a lightly floured board. Cut with a 3-inch cookie cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 6 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Cut onions celery potatoes and add water. Bring to boil and simmer 15 minutes or until done. Melt margarine; add flour and make paste. Remove from pan; put in milk and heat. Add roux gradually (margarine and flour). Stir until creamy. Add potatoes and corn. Heat and stir. Dont let boil.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Put in glass baking dish. Bake for 45 minutes or until brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Parslied Ham And Swiss Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Blend the first 4 ingredients and spread on sandwich buns. Fill with ham and cheese slices. Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Sprinkle half of cheese over Crispy Pizza Crust; set aside. Saute vegetables garlic and Italian seasoning in hot oil 3 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are barely crisp-tender. Spoon vegetables evenly onto pizza. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 450 degrees 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Yield one 12-inch pizza.

title: Quick Veggie Soup
instructions: In large pot brown meat and onion. Cook until onion is tender. Drain; salt and pepper to taste. Put in remaining ingredients; stir. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer covered for 15 minutes or until noodles are tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Add milk to the line in your churn. Add sugar sweetened condensed milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add the beaten eggs last and keep the paddle on the churn stirring until you get the freezer ready. This will prevent the eggs from settling to the bottom. Churn and enjoy!

title: Three Cheese Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cheese soften at room temperature. Combine all ingredients with hands and form a ball.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken saving 1/2 cup broth. Mix chicken soups and milk. Pour in a greased glass 9 x 13-inch dish. Cover with Stove Top stuffing. Mix 1/2 cup chicken broth with 1/2 stick melted butter; pour over top. Place in oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Mix until crumbly the first 5 ingredients. Press 1/2 of crumbs in greased 7 x 9-inch baking pan. Top with rhubarb. Then combine in saucepan the next 4 ingredients. Cook until thick and clear. Pour over rhubarb. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut in squares and serve with whipped cream.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cut potatoes into small cubes and boil until just tender. Drain and add onion salt and pepper. Combine vinegar 1/3 cup mayonnaise and 2 tablespoons of hot water. Add mixture to warm potatoes and let cool. Add green peppers pimento celery and the other 1/2 cup mayonnaise to potato mixture and mix well. Chill.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Sift flour and cinnamon together and add alternately with milk. Add sherry nuts and fruit. Drop on well-greased cookie sheet and bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Makes about 12 dozen.

title: Chopped Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt and spices. Blend shortening and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with coffee. Fold in chopped apples and raisins. Nuts may be added if desired. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. Cake may be iced when cool.

title: Chicken And Corn Soup
instructions: Bone chicken and discard skin. Mince the chicken and combine with 1 teaspoon cornstarch and the egg whites beaten until frothy. Bring chicken broth to a boil. Dissolve remaining cornstarch in water and add gradually to broth. Add chicken mixture corn sherry and soy sauce and simmer a few minutes. Serve garnished with ham (boiled baked or most flavorful and closest to the Chinese Smithfield ham). Serves 4.

title: Chicken, Zucchini And Red Pepper Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut away tendon and any excess fat from chicken breasts. Place in freezer just until chicken firms up for easier slicing. Do not freeze solid. Meanwhile insert metal chopping blade in mixer bowl of food processor. Process garlic (or chop fine with French knife). Remove chopping blade and insert slicing blade. Place zucchini in feed tube vertically and process (or cut in slices with knife). Insert red pepper in feed tube vertically. Process (or slice into 1/8 inch slices with knife). Insert scallion vertically. Process (or slice by hand). Process water chestnuts (or slice by knife). Put mushrooms on their sides in feed tube. Process (or cut lengthwise into thirds). Set aside in bowl. To process chicken using slicing blade wedge chicken into feed tube so slicing disk will cut against grain (or cut by sharp knife into 1/4 inch thick slices).

title: Summertime Ice Tea
instructions: In a glass or enamel pan bring 4 cups cold water to a boil. Add the tea bags and steep about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Take out tea bags and add the sugar stirring until sugar is dissolved. Place tea mixture in a 1 gallon container and add frozen juices. Stir until juices dissolve.

title: Hot 'N Spicy Sun-Drop Punch
instructions: *Or add to taste.

title: Shoe Peg Salad
instructions: Rinse and drain the corn green beans and garden peas. Bring to boil vinegar sugar oil water salt and pepper. Cool. Mix with corn peas and beans and rest of the ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Mix in shortening. Beat together egg water and vinegar. Add to flour mixture and work well. Can leave in sealed Tupperware container in refrigerator for a week. (I have frozen it.)

title: Etta'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: No-Bake Holiday Cookies
instructions: Finely grind the first 3 ingredients. Add sugar and whiskey and form into small balls. Roll in colored sugar. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Special Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Put first 5 ingredients in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle casserole with paprika and parsley flakes. Bake in a preheated oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Berry Rich Shake
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend. Pour into a glass.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Mix well. Can be mixed in blender but dont process too much or it will be too runny. Makes 5 cups.

title: Busy Day Baked Chicken
instructions: Grease an 11 3/4 x 4 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch pan. Add chicken breasts. Add soup mix on top of chicken. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake 2 hours. Chicken will fall off the bone. Its so tender.

title: Delicious Peach Pie
instructions: Beat egg white until foamy. Brush over the bottom and sides of pastry. In a small bowl combine flour and sugars. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Sprinkle 2/3 into bottom of pastry. Top with peaches. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken Breasts
instructions: Dredge chicken breasts in flour to which salt and pepper is added. Heat mixture of oil and margarine in skillet. Place chicken in the hot oil turning to a light brown. Arrange pieces in a lightly greased baking dish. Blend and heat all ingredients for the sauce pour over chicken. Cover and bake 325 for about 1 1/2 hour or until chicken is tender. Serves 4.

title: Brownies From Scratch
instructions: Mix with electric mixer margarine and sugar. Add eggs vanilla cocoa and flour. Blend all together.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Spread cake with icing.

title: Sweet French Dressing
instructions: Mix sugar and oil in the blender until well blended. Add the next 3 ingredients and blend. Add catsup; blend. You may use more catsup for the taste you desire. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix together and drop on a greased cookie sheet by spoonfuls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 10 minutes. Nuts and/or raisins may be added.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Saute until brown the oil garlic ground beef and onions. Drain fat. Add tomato paste tomato soup tomatoes water coffee salt pepper mushrooms and oregano.

title: Milkless Potato Soup
instructions: Boil the potatoes and process them through a colander then mash them thoroughly. Add 6 cups of water. Brown the flour in the butter and add the potatoes and water with the chopped celery parsley thyme salt and white pepper. Beat in two egg yolks just before serving. You will never miss the cow.

title: Cranberry Sauce Cake
instructions: Cream together sugars butter and egg yolks. Stir in cranberry sauce. Sift together flour cinnamon soda cloves salt and allspice; add to creamed mixture. Stir in pecans and raisins. Fold in egg whites. Bake in tube pan (greased) at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Toad-In-A-Hole
instructions: Melt a bit of butter in skillet. Using the rim of a glass press the center out of the slice of bread. Reserve center circle. Put slice of bread in pan. Crack egg into center hole of bread. Turn when egg is set. Cook over low heat until egg is done. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with bread hole covering egg center (Toad)!

title: Easy Day Lasagne
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Brown hamburger and Italian sausage together; drain. Put together cottage cheese and Ricotta cheese in bowl. Put spaghetti sauce in bowl and add meat mixture after browning. Stir both cheese and meat mixtures good.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together. Dipping hands in water make small balls. Grease pans or use Teflon cookie sheets. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Prepare a 9-inch pastry. Melt butter. Cool. Beat 2 eggs until foamy. Add flour sugar and brown sugar and beat until smooth. Add melted butter. Mix well. Add chocolate chips. Stir. Pour batter into pie shell. Bake for 1 hour. Its heavenly!

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Place dry ingredients (except raisins) in large deep bowl. Gradually add milk and margarine. Mix until firm enough to form ball; if still crumbly add more butter or milk one tablespoon at a time. Pat down to an 8-inch circle. Place on oiled cookie sheet. Cut the dough in the form of a cross to the depth of 1-inch. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Cut skinned and boned fish into 1 1/2 to 2-inch pieces. Then peel and slice potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces. Crush the garlic clove.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into nuggets. Batter chicken in egg and then in flour. Fry until golden brown. Dip chicken into teriyaki sauce and place in dish. Cook chicken for 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Bring tomatoes and peppers to rolling boil. Pour over grated cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Good with crackers Fritos and Mexican food.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Gradually add milk and lemon juice to softened cream cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Kiss Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter sugars peanut butter egg and vanilla. Sift flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Form into balls. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place in oven for 8 minutes. Put chocolate kisses on top. Push them down on the cookie. Put back in oven for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Parboil mushrooms. Mix other ingredients except onions. Pour over parboiled mushrooms and onions. Let stand several days (stir occasionally).

title: Skillet Dinner
instructions: Cook until meat is brown; drain. Add salt and pepper chili powder garlic salt bell pepper and onion. Put in Dutch oven. Put egg noodles on top. Dont stir. Pour water over mixture.

title: Marshmallow Marble-Top Fudge
instructions: Line an 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil and set aside. In a heavy saucepan over low heat melt chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons butter with sweetened condensed milk vanilla and salt. Remove from heat and stir in nuts. Spread evenly into prepared pan.

title: Potato Broccoli Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes onion celery and bouillon in 4 cups water for 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta. Heat stirring often until cheese is melted and soup is smooth. Add broccoli. Continue stirring occasionally until ready to serve.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Mix vegetables. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain well. Cook in kettle for 30 minutes vegetables and vinegar mixture. Pour in jars and seal.

title: Fallen Fudge Cake
instructions: Melt the butter in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix the next 5 ingredients and pour over butter. Mix the next 4 ingredients and pour over the batter. Do not stir. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Makes its own sauce. Serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until fluffy. Add sugar and peanut butter. Beat until smooth. Prepare topping with milk as directed on package. Beat into peanut butter mixture. Pour or spoon into pie shell. Must be refrigerated overnight to set up before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat together the cream cheese eggs sugar and vanilla until well blended; set aside. Slice cookie dough rolls into 1/3-inch slices. Arrange slices from 1 roll over bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Press together so no holes are left in dough. Spoon cream cheese mixture evenly over dough; top with remaining roll of dough sliced. Bake 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown and center is slightly firm. Cool then refrigerate. Cut into bars. May serve with chocolate sauce fudge or Cool Whip.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: In saucepan combine all ingredients except apples. Melt over medium heat stirring constantly. Cool. Slice apples. Dip into mixture and serve.

title: Old-Fashioned Egg Pie
instructions: In a heavy pot bring milk almost to a boil. Remove from heat and sprinkle in nutmeg to taste. Beat eggs and to them add sugar vanilla and a pinch of salt. Add hot milk to egg mixture. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust. Bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Peanut Butter Dessert
instructions: Combine all until crumbly. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Remove from oven and cool!

title: Magic Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar flour baking powder and milk together and pour on butter. Do not stir. Add peaches on top of this in layers. Sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons sugar. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel apples quarter and cut in half. Pat out can of biscuits and put in 1/8 of apple. Seal apple inside biscuit. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 1 cup water 1 cup sugar and 1 stick of melted margarine. Pour over biscuits and sprinkle biscuits with allspice or spice of your choice. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Good hot or cold with ice cream or plain.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cook peas according to package directions; drain. While peas cool break apart cauliflower and slice thin. Combine cauliflower and peas; add celery and onion. Mix together mayonnaise salt and milk. Mix with the cauliflower mixture. Marinate in refrigerator 6 hours.

title: Five Hour Stew
instructions: Do not brown beef. Put all ingredients in casserole. Put bay leaf on top. Cook in oven at 300\u00b0 covered. Do not peek.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix soda with sour milk and add to molasses. Sift together flour ginger and salt; combine 2 mixtures and add butter. Bake in greased pan in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Punch Slush
instructions: Puree the bananas in a food processor along with the thawed lemonade. Then add the other ingredients and mix well. This mixture is frozen and will fit in a gallon plastic milk jug. Before serving partially thaw and add the following 1 (64-ounce) ginger ale and 1 (64-ounce) lemon-lime soft drink. Yields 50 (1/2-cup) servings. You can cut the amount of sugar in half.

title: Koulourakia(Greek Butter Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter gradually beating in sugar. Beat eggs until light; add to butter mixture and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla extract. Add lemon rinds. Sift together flour and baking powder. Carefully blend into butter-egg mixture to make soft dough.

title: Hearty Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water with honey. Melt margarine in saucepan. Cool slightly. When yeast is bubbly add 4 more heaping cups warm water milk salt the melted shortening bran and wheat germ. Mix and add flours (the total amount will equal almost 5 pounds of flour). Knead well. Place in a warm place in greased bowl.

title: Strawberry Topping
instructions: Cook berries 3 minutes until full boil. Add 2 cups sugar and cook 3 more minutes. Add 1 more cup of sugar and boil 3 more minutes.

title: Baked Chicken N' Noodles
instructions: Blend soup and milk. Add chicken noodles pimento and parsley. Spoon into 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until tender and remove bones; save broth. In bottom of casserole dish mix half of dressing with enough broth to moisten well. Pat down and pepper. In bowl mix chicken with soup and enough broth to blend well. Mixture should remain thick. Pour over dressing in casserole dish. Mix remaining dressing with chicken broth to moisten well. Pour over chicken mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Brandied Fruit Salad
instructions: This is good served with the main meal and/or as a dessert.

title: Rosamarina Salad (Or) Hawaiian Macaroni Salad
instructions: Rub a wooden bowl with garlic and mix the dressing right in the bowl. Use a variety of fresh torn greens such as lettuce escarole spinach endive and watercress. Toss well until every leaf is coated with the dressing.

title: Chicken With Bell Pepper
instructions: Brown chicken (unfloured) in shortening until golden brown. Remove chicken from skillet and make gravy in small amount of shortening. In same skillet return chicken and lay peppers and onions over gravy covered chicken.\tSimmer for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Artichoke Nibbles
instructions: Drain liquid from one jar of artichokes into pan. Chop artichokes and set aside. Add onion to liquid in pan and saute. (Add a little garlic salt.) Beat eggs; add bread crumbs and seasonings. Stir in cheese parsley artichokes and onion. Put in greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into 1-inch squares and serve hot or cold.

title: Delicious Zucchini And Yellow Squash
instructions: Fry bacon; when almost crisp add onion squash salt and pepper. Cook until tender (about 10 minutes). Remove from stove; add sour cream and serve. Serves 6.

title: Real Mashed Potatoes!(From Potatoes, Not A Mix!)
instructions: Cut up potatoes and put in a big pot of salted water. Bring to a boil. Put cover on pot and let cook 25 minutes on medium heat. Drain; add butter and milk. Whip using a hand mixer.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together in a baking dish. Place bacon strips on top. Bake about 30 minutes in a medium oven.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Red Rice
instructions: Fry bacon until brown. Remove from pan. Chop onion and green pepper. Saute onion and green pepper in grease. Add tomato sauce. Add one can of water. Mash stewed tomatoes and add to mixture. Break bacon into bits and add to mixture. Add Tabasco sauce and salt to taste. When mixture starts boiling add shrimp and turn fire down low. Stir constantly to keep from sticking. Cook until rice dries out.

title: Spanish Cream
instructions: In top of a double boiler scald milk. Slowly add gelatin and honey. Pour a few tablespoonfuls over egg yolks then add egg mixture to milk mixture in boiler. Place over hot water and cook until thick and smooth. Remove from heat. Add salt and vanilla then fold in egg whites. Pour into a large mold and chill. The mixture will form 2 layers as it sets.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Blend all ingredients in blender for one minute. Pour into pie plate and bake at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Dutch Pot Roast
instructions: Dredge beef in flour and brown in Dutch oven. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly on low heat for about 3 hours. Thicken gravy if necessary.

title: Garlic-Mayonnaise Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until fork goes through but not mashes. Let cool. Cut up into 1-inch squares. Whip up mayonnaise chopped onion cilantro (use less if using fresh) garlic powder salt and pepper. Stir in potatoes and mix well to coat. Maybe eaten cold or warm.

title: Fiesta Nacho Platter
instructions: Combine beans picante sauce and 1 cup cheese; stir over low heat until cheese is melted. On serving platter layer chips bean mixture lettuce sour cream and tomatoes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken. Pull off bones in bite size pieces. Add broth and cream of celery soup. Pour into a greased baking dish. Sift flour salt and baking powder. Gradually add milk then melted butter. Pour this over chicken mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop cranberries in processor or food chopper. Pour 2 cups sugar over cranberries. Add the raspberry and orange Jell-O to juice. Add to cranberries. Mold in pans.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream sugar eggs spices and butter at low speed for 1 minute. Add cream and blend. Put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0. Cool until firm.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Cook and stir constantly until dough forms a ball and leaves side of pan. Store in airtight container. Great for children!!

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: 1st Layer Mix first 3 ingredients. Press in an oblong baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage Roll Casserole
instructions: Brown beef. Add salt pepper onion chili powder rice soup and water. Cook gently for 2 or 3 minutes. Put cabbage in casserole. Pour meat mixture over cabbage. Do not stir. Bake covered for 2 hours at 350\u00b0 or longer if desired.

title: Rancher'S Sunday Chicken
instructions: Wash and dry chicken pieces. Dip into prepared salad dressing. Spoon crumbs over the dressing to cover. Place in foil lined pan. Sprinkle with salt pepper and paprika to taste. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Fresh Corn-On-The-Cob
instructions: Remove husks from ears of corn; brush off silks. Drop in kettle of boiling water to cover adding 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon lemon juice to each quart of water. Cover and cook 5 to 8 minutes or until milk is set and corn is tender. Cooking time depends on maturity of corn. Remove from water and serve with butter salt and ground black pepper.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese margarine and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and cake flour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in a tube pan.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Treats
instructions: Melt chips and peanut butter. Add chow mein noodles and marshmallows. Mix together and spoon out on waxed paper.

title: Cream Of Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook carrots and celery in boiling water until tender. Cook onion in margarine until tender but not brown. Stir in flour. Add milk and chicken broth. Cook over low heat until thickened stirring occasionally. Makes 6 cups.

title: Nanna'S Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Soften cheese (I use microwave) on Low. Add chips and oleo until melted. Let cool for a few minutes and then add sugar. This recipe can be cut in half if you dont want as much frosting. Mix until smooth.

title: Laurene'S Shortbread Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine with sugar. Add vanilla salt and flour; mix well. Add chips nuts and shape into balls and press flat. Bake at 325\u00b0 until light brown (approximately 13 minutes).

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Store in container.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Put in chicken. Place a slice of swiss cheese over each breast. Add soup mixed with the wine. Sprinkle the Pepperidge Farms Dressing over all. Melt margarine and pour over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Steaks Etouffe
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a Dutch oven. Add the meat and cover with the rest of the ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and let cook over low heat for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Fold in one large container Cool Whip.

title: Hash And Corn Bread
instructions: Mix hash onion and egg together. Prepare muffin mix as directed on package. Add salt and cheese. Spread half the batter in greased 8-inch square or round baking dish. Spread on hash mixture. Top with remaining batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 25 minutes until corn bread is golden brown.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix soup cheese onion and sour cream. Mix with vegetables. Place in a dish.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together pretzels butter and 1/2 cup sugar and put in 5 or 6 cup bowl. Cool. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Mix. Pour over pretzels. Cool.

title: Cookie Whip Dessert
instructions: Crumble cookies into shallow dish. Spread Cool Whip over cookies. Chill for one hour.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift together in large mixing bowl sugar and flour. Place in saucepan and bring to a boil butter or oleo cocoa and water. Pour butter mixture over flour and sugar; mix well and add buttermilk eggs vanilla baking soda and cinnamon. Mix and bake on a slightly greased 10 x 15-inch pan at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Before cake is done make icing.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: First mash potato then add flour. Next add powdered sugar and mix until it makes a ball of dough. Next take a sheet of wax paper and spread with dough. Then spread the peanut butter out on the dough. Roll up like a burrito. Chill for a couple of hours then cut in little strips.

title: Chicken Vegetable Pasta Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients in a bowl. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Blueberry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix crumbs and melted butter and press 3/4 of mixture into Pyrex dish. Cream sugar and cream cheese together. Mix milk Dream Whip and vanilla until stiff and add to cheese mixture. Layer on top of crumbs the blueberry filling then cheese mixture and sprinkle with remaining cracker crumbs.

title: Penne All'Arrabbiata(Penne With Hot Pepper And Tomatoes)
instructions: Cut out tomato cores with a sharp knife. Fill a large saucepan 2/3 full with water. Bring water to a boil; add tomatoes. Boil 20 to 25 seconds or until skins begin to split. Place tomatoes in bowl of cold water. Peel cooled tomatoes and cut in half horizontally. Squeeze seeds and juice out of each tomato half. Dice tomatoes. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add hot pepper and garlic. Saute over medium heat about 1 minute. Before garlic changes color add diced tomatoes. Season with salt. Cook uncovered over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in parsley and cook 1 to 2 minutes longer. Fill a very large saucepan 2/3 full with salted water. Bring to a boil. Add penne. Bring water back to a boil and cook penne uncovered until tender but firm to the bite (al dente) 8 to 10 minutes. Drain penne and place in skillet with sauce. Toss penne and sauce over medium heat until sauce coats penne 20 to 30 seconds. Serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and powdered sugar together; smooth into bottom of pie shell. Make hot pudding by mixing remaining ingredients. Pour over filling.

title: Bernie'S Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form meatballs and brown.

title: Pistachio Torte
instructions: Mix well and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Chop cabbage and steam until limp not soft. Drain well. Use a shallow baking dish and place in layers 1/2 of cabbage and 1/2 can of soup (spread over cabbage). Crumble 1/2 can onion rings over this. Then slice Velveeta cheese over all. Repeat layers again. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Crusted Ground Turkey Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package and drain. Mix eggs Parmesan cheese and warm spaghetti. Pour into generously buttered 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate. Pat in bottom and up sides to rim with back of spoon. Spread sour cream over bottom. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat margarine over medium-high heat until melted. Crumble turkey into skillet. Add bell pepper and onion. Cook until turkey is no longer pink; drain. Add tomato sauce garlic salt and oregano. Simmer 10 minutes uncovered. Salt and pepper to taste. Spoon mixture over sour cream. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 25 minutes. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and bake until melted.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies and mix with melted margarine. Press into 9-inch pie plate and freeze (2 to 3 hours). Put ice cream in a bowl and stir until smooth. Place in prepared crust and sprinkle with pecans. Freeze for at least 1 hour (more time in freezer may be needed depending on how much the ice cream has melted). When ready to serve slice pie. Top each slice with hot fudge followed by whipped cream.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins and water 5 minutes; let cool and add baking soda. Let stand. Mix the rest of ingredients together. Combine with raisins. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Very good and stay moist.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Sift and measure flour. Sift again with soda and salt. Cream shortening and sugar well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flavorings. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream. Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes (time will vary with individual ovens).

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on box and drain. In large bowl add remaining ingredients with spaghetti. Refrigerate. Serve cold.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook the spinach according to box directions. Drain well. Mix all other ingredients. Hollow the center of the bread so it looks like a bowl. Save the bread from the middle. Cube into torn bite-size pieces to place around the loaf to use for dip.

title: Easy Cheese Potatoes
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup Colby cheese. Mix well and turn into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Top with remaining cheese and bake 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apricot Mousse(Serves 8)
instructions: Puree the apricots after they have been soaked and cooked according to the package directions; add the sugar and extract. Soak the gelatin in the cold water add the hot milk and stir over hot water until gelatin is dissolved. Add this to the puree. Whip the cream and fold it into the puree. Spoon it into a wet 8-cup mold and chill it in the freezer for about 3 hours. This may be unmolded or served directly from the mold.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix salad well and let congeal. Cream sour cream cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Spread on top of salad. Sprinkle top with nuts.

title: Baked Cranberry Dessert
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together in mixing bowl. Add shortening and milk. Blend other ingredients except cranberries. Beat 2 minutes. Stir in cranberries. Bake in greased 9-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until tested done. Serve with hot butter sauce.

title: Pear Honey
instructions: Cook the pears and sugar until real thick then add coconut and pineapple about 1/2 hour before you take it up. Process in jars for long period of keeping.

title: Raspberry Cream Dip
instructions: In small bowl combine cream cheese brown sugar ginger and vinegar; blend until smooth. Stir in raspberries. Serve as a dip or dressing for fresh fruit. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Santacafe Chile Pepper Brioche
instructions: In the bowl of an electric mixer with a paddle attachment combine the flour sugar yeast salt ground chile and black pepper. Mix briefly on low speed. Increase speed to medium and add the water milk poblano chile and bell pepper; beat well. Add the eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Change to the dough hook and knead for 3 minutes. The dough will be very sticky. Add the butter to the dough one piece at a time and continue to knead until dough is smooth and shiny and the butter is completely incorporated 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Flan
instructions: Burn the sugar on stove top on medium heat; set aside to cool. Use an 8-inch cake pan. Place the last 5 ingredients in blender; blend until smooth. Pour over burnt sugar in pan. Steam approximately 1 1/2 hours on very low heat. Check water level from time to time.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Add nuts. Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry ingredients. Stir only until flour is moistened. Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Then dip into sugar-cinnamon mixture. Coat each piece well. Drop in Bundt cake pan. Sprinkle over the nuts. Then melt the butter and brown sugar. Pour this mixture over biscuits. Place in cold oven. Set at 350\u00b0 and bake for 20 minutes. Turn pan upside down over plate after removing from oven.

title: Kahlua Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well with mixer; fold in chocolate chips. Spray Bundt pan with Pam or grease and flour. Pour mixture into Bundt pan. Bake in the oven preheated to 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. After cake is cooled on serving plate can poke holes in top with toothpick and brush on extra Kahlua.

title: Peach Pudding Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water. Add 2 cups reserved peach syrup (if not enough add water until there is). Put mixture in fridge to set a bit (about 1 1/2 hours). Beat peaches with mixer until very mushy. Beat the whipping cream adding the powdered sugar. Fold in the Jell-O mixture. Stir very well. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and keep in fridge until set.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix filling ingredients in order given. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 45 minutes until knife inserted in center of pie filling comes out clean. Cool. Garnish with whipped cream. Makes one 9-inch pie or two smaller ones.

title: Apple Rings
instructions: Peel and core apples leaving them whole then slice into 1/2-inch slices. Set aside. Mix together the water sugar candies and food coloring in a saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil. Drop in apple rings. Simmer until tender about 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from syrup. Serve as an accompaniment to any type wild meat.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Cook and stir beef and onion; drain. Stir in seasoning. Spread in plate; top with chillies. Beat milk Bisquick and eggs until smooth. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes. Top with tomatoes and cheese; bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Dinner Party Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet. Add salad dressing mix. Add chicken and brown slowly until golden. Place contents of skillet in baking dish. Blend soup (undiluted) cream cheese and wine until smooth. Spread over chicken. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serve over rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Using a large serving bowl or 9 x 13-inch glass dish prepare the Jell-O with the boiling water and 1 1/4 cups cold water. Add the drained pineapple. Chill until firm.

title: Pineapple Butterscotch Squares
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt in small bowl; set aside. Beat together margarine brown sugar and granulated sugar in large bowl until creamy. Add pineapple eggs and vanilla; beat until blended. Stir in flour mixture butterscotch and nuts until blended. Pour in 13 x 9-inch baking pan sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with hands. Roll into balls the size of a walnut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and press with the tines of a fork in a criss-cross pattern. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on a cake rack. Serve at room temperature. They freeze very well.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli crisp-tender. Combine eggs cheeses onion Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Arrange broccoli in baking dish; add cheese mixture and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Add margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Ginger Tea
instructions: Make the tea as instructed on the package. Add ginger slices. Let them remain for a few minutes. Add sugar if needed and serve.

title: Chicken Bologna
instructions: Wipe off bologna and leave skins on. Cut into 4 or 5-inch lengths. Pack in jars lengthwise and add 1/2 cup water to each quart. Cook 1 hour in hot water bath or 30 minutes at 10 pound pressure.

title: Oatmeal M&M'S
instructions: Cream butter sugars and eggs. Add vanilla dry ingredients and M&Ms. Bake 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Flour and brown steaks in a pan. Put browned steaks in a casserole dish. Put chopped onions and cut up mushrooms on steak. Mix soups together and pour over tops of steaks. Bake for 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 in a covered casserole dish.

title: Heavenly Coconut Pie
instructions: In small bowl mix flour melted butter and 1 cup chopped pecans. Press into a 2-quart dish or 10-inch pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Place 1/2 cup chopped nuts in shallow pan and bake in oven with pastry until slightly browned.

title: Chewy Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9x13 pan. Bring sugar butter and water to a boil. (Microwave works well.) Add chocolate and stir until melted. Add eggs vanilla and mix well. Add dry ingredients. Bake 16-20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out sticky.

title: Pimento Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water. Cool until syrupy and beat in cheese spread and pineapple. Let congeal to syrupy stage and fold in prepared dessert topping mix. Refrigerate until set.

title: Strawberry Dream Cake
instructions: Mix well and pour over cake.

title: Egg Strata
