instructions: Brown sausage drain and crumble into a 13 x 9-inch dish. Saute hash browns in oleo then spread over sausage. Sprinkle cheese over potatoes. Mix eggs milk and seasonings. Pour over mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine bread crumbs brown sugar chili powder garlic powder dry mustard celery seed and cayenne. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Brush each chicken piece with butter. Roll in crumb mixture to coat. Arrange chicken skin side up so that pieces do not touch in a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until tender. Do not turn. Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Turkey Loaf
instructions: Mix and put in greased casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Pour into greased dish and dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Corn Bake
instructions: Blend broccoli corn egg 1/4 cup crumbs onion 2 tablespoons melted butter salt and pepper. Turn into 1-quart casserole; top with 1/4 cup crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs; add sour cream. Stir in sugar 2 tablespoons flour vanilla and salt; mix well. Stir in apples. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put can of milk in icebox over night. Add sugar and lemon juice to strawberries. Beat until berries are a fine pulp.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls in a 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Spread hash browns on top. Fry sausage and drain. Spread over potatoes. Whip eggs and pour over; top with cheese. Depending on how many you wish to serve use six to twelve eggs. Use sharp cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one half hour.

title: Cappuccino Pie
instructions: Mix liquids and coffee together with pudding mix and beat with hand. Mix in Cool Whip and put in crust. Freeze. Remove and dollop extra Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with toasted almonds. Serve semi-frozen. Take out of freezer 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spice Candied Nuts
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in saucepan over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture forms soft-ball stage; add vanilla then coat nuts. Turn out onto wax paper. Allow to cool and then separate into pieces. Place in candy dish.

title: Potato-Bean Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan melt the margarine and cook the garlic celery and carrots on medium heat for 4 minutes. Carefully stir in broth potatoes and dill. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Mash about 1/2 of the potatoes in the broth. Add drained beans to mixture.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Saute onion turkey and celery in margarine. Add 1 2/3 cups water and seasoning. Mix. Cook 5 minutes. Then add stuffing mix and let set.

title: Salmon Roll
instructions: Use king silver or red salmon. Stir all ingredients together. Shape into roll ball log or leave in bowl. Chill for 3 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar. Beat eggs in one at a time. Add flour sifted together with salt and baking powder. Alternate with Pet milk. Add vanilla and nuts last. Put a thin layer of dough in a greased angel food pan and sprinkle with cinnamon mixture. Alternate the layers of dough and cinnamon mixture until pan is filled. Do not put cinnamon mixture on top. Bake 60 to 70 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until done.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to box directions. Let cool then crumble half of cake in a punch bowl. Layer strawberries pineapple banana slices and pudding. Repeat layers and top with Cool Whip.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Add egg whites and salt together and beat until stiff. Add sugar and beat. Add chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Bring water to boil in a large deep skillet. Stir in 1 envelope golden onion soup mix and skinned chicken thighs. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in white converted rice and vegetables. Cover again and cook 20 minutes or until rice is tender the liquid is absorbed and the chicken is no longer pink near the bone. Serves 4.

title: Butterscotch Delight
instructions: Make crust from first 3 ingredients. Mix and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Cool well. Mix Cool Whip cream cheese and powdered sugar together. Spread on crust. Mix pudding and milk cook until thick. Let cool; pour over cream cheese mixture. Toast coconut sprinkle over top and let chill.

title: Ultimate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream first 4 ingredients. Add eggs. Mix flour salt and soda; add gradually. Blend well. Stir in 2 cups each chips and pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy 11 to 13 minutes for crisp. Makes 6 dozen (3-inch) cookies.

title: Crock-Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast. Put into crock-pot. Add Lipton onion soup mix and mushroom soup with water and pour over roast. Cook overnight on low. Melts in your mouth!

title: Saucy Chicken
instructions: In a glass 9 x 13-inch pan combine soup mix dressing and liquid. Mix well. Place chicken pieces in sauce. Turn to coat each piece. Cover. Microwave 9 1/2 minutes per pound at 70% power. Rearrange chicken piece halfway through cooking time. Let stand 3 to 5 minutes covered. Serve with rice buttered noodles or stuffing.

title: Spooned Halva
instructions: Melt butter in deep pan; add farina and cook until golden color stirring constantly. Stir in chopped nuts. Reduce heat. Meanwhile bring water and sugar to a slow boil. Cook 3 minutes. Pour syrup slowly over farina stirring with wooden spoon until halva is slightly thickened. Remove from heat. Cover; let stand 10 minutes. Shape with individual molds or with spoon. Place on large platters and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Pour hot water over Jell-O. When dissolved add sugar. Cut orange in pieces with peelings and put in blender with cranberries and orange juice. Blend. Combine all ingredients and chill in refrigerator overnight.

title: Beef Rounds
instructions: Cut round steak into thin strips. Cut onions into chunks. Wrap round steak around onion chunk then wrap with a piece of bacon. Secure with a toothpick. Brown on all sides. Make broth with bouillon cube and simmer for 1 hour. Use tongs to pick up.

title: Spicy Bean Salsa With Tortilla Chips
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except tortilla chips; mix well. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight to blend flavors. Serve with tortilla chips as an appetizer. May also serve as a side dish. Makes 12 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Cook on Full power for 8 to 10 minutes. Stir mixture a couple of times. Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Stir until it thickens or your arms fall off. Pour into buttered pan. Let cool. Enjoy.

title: Rye Loaf Dip
instructions: Shred beef and mix all ingredients. Make the night before. Cut top out of loaf bread. Dig bread out leaving a 1-inch rim. Pour mixture in bowl. Cut bread in dip sizes. When all bread cubes are gone then cut loaf in bite sizes.

title: Baked Spanish Rice(6 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 12-inch skillet over medium heat fry bacon crisp; drain on paper towels. Crumble and set aside.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Add poppy seed and extract. Bake in 2 (9-inch) layer pans according to directions on package. Frost with favorite white fluffy icing.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Combine all ingredients except candy in large bowl. Mix until dough forms. Shape dough into balls using a rounded teaspoonful for each. Roll balls in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss; press firmly so cookie cracks around edge. Return to oven for 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and eggs. Add oil and zucchini. Sift and add dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Cook in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Company Carrots
instructions: Place carrots in an ungreased 9 inch square baking dish. Add water and dot with butter. Sprinkle with oregano and salt. Cover and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325 degrees.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Combine pudding milk and sugar. Beat until thickened. Gently fold in cool whip. Lightly butter bottom and sides of 9 x 13 inch cake pan. Line bottom with whole graham crackers. Pour pudding mixture over crackers. Top with another layer of graham crackers. Spread chocolate frosting over graham crackers. Chill.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Butter bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Line bottom of pan with graham crackers. Prepare pudding with 3 1/2 cups milk and beat until thick. Carefully fold in Cool Whip. Spread 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers. Cover with another layer of graham crackers. Pour the rest of pudding mixture over crackers. Cover with another layer of graham crackers. Cover pan with plastic wrap or wax paper. Chill 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine pancake mix sugar cinnamon ginger cloves pumpkin oil milk and eggs. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Stir in walnuts and turn batter into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from pan and cool. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Welsh Rabbit
instructions: Melt butter add flour and blend. Add milk and cook over low heat until thick stirring constantly. Add cheese and stir over low heat until melted. Add seasonings. Serve over hot toast or crackers. Serves 6.

title: Bohemian Pot Roast
instructions: Combine flour and pepper; dredge pot roast. In a Dutch oven brown roast in oil. Drain. Add water tomatoes caraway seed onion soup mix and bay leaves. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover tightly and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or until roast is tender. Remove to a warm platter. Discard bay leaves.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes 1/2 cup margarine onion soup sour cream and cheese; stir well. Spoon into a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole. Crush cereal and stir in remaining butter. Sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Soup For Freezer
instructions: Cook butter beans until tender. Cook all for about 35 minutes. Cool. Put in containers and freeze.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and clean mushrooms remove stems and mince. To stems add garlic bread crumbs cheese onion salt and pepper parsley butter and half of olive oil and mix well. Stuff mushroom caps use remaining oil to grease baking pan and drizzle over tops of mushrooms. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Slice okra into 1/4-inch slices. Wash okra in cold water. Mix cornmeal flour salt and pepper together. Roll okra in cornmeal mix. Fry in hot skillet for 10 minutes until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Serves 6.

title: Cream Cheese Crescents
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar and egg yolk. Separate dough in 16 triangles. Place on greased baking sheet. Spread 1 tablespoon of cream cheese near edge of the short side of each triangle. Top with 1 tablespoon of pie filling. Fold long section of each triangle over filling and tuck under dough. Lightly beat egg white and brush over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed; rinse and drain. Brown meat; add salt pepper and garlic salt then tomato sauce. Simmer 5 minutes; combine cheese sour cream onions and noodles. In a 2-quart casserole alternate layers of noodle mixture and meat beginning with noodles and ending with meat. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Bring beet juice white vinegar and sugar to a boil. Cool before adding beets and eggs. Start eggs with cold water. Bring to a rolling boil. Turn stove off and let eggs set in water for 20 minutes. Run cold water over eggs and peel. Eggs will pickle overnight.

title: Hot Clam Dip
instructions: Cut top off one loaf of bread and scoop out soft bread. Mix all remaining ingredients (except the other loaf of bread) and fill scooped out bread shell. Replace top. Wrap in foil and bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours. Cut up second loaf of bread to use for dipping.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: In bowl combine dry ingredients. Stir in eggs and bananas. Add melted shortening and nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake 45 to 60 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Audra'S Squash
instructions: Top with bread crumbs over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Mocha Brownies
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan melt chocolate with butter or margarine over low heat; cool. Combine next 3 ingredients; set aside. Beat eggs and sugar at medium speed until light. Beat in chocolate mixture and vanilla extract. Stir in flour mixture cracker crumbs and nuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven 40 to 45 minutes. Glaze while hot. When cold cut into squares using a sharp knife. Makes 25 brownies.

title: Baked Carrots
instructions: Cut up carrots and cook until almost done. Melt butter with cheese. Put carrots in baking dish (approximately 8 x 11-inch). Pour melted cheese and butter over carrots. Crush the crackers and sprinkle over carrots. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 15 to 20 minutes until cheese bubbles. Serve hot.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in graham cracker crumbs and sugar. Pack in a pie shell and let cool for 10 minutes then put in freezer for 30 minutes. Now it is ready to fill.

title: Good Friday Rice
instructions: Saute onions in butter until golden and limp. Add rice and saute until golden. Pour in cans of broth and mix well. Bake in a 2-quart casserole at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 to 45 minutes or until liquid is absorbed (microwave approximately 15 minutes).

title: Cherry Coconut Bars
instructions: Combine flour confectioners sugar and margarine. Press into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Beat pudding mix with juices you drain off fruit. Mix in fruit and Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: No-Knead Dinner Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in 1 cup warm water. Cream sugar and shortening together. Add boiling water mixing well with mixer at medium speed. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix salt and flour together and add to the batter alternately with the yeast. Cover and let rise in a warm place 1 hour. Turn out on a floured surface and pat into a large rectangle. Cut into rounds with a biscuit cutter or floured glass; dip both sides in melted butter and place in baking pans. Cover and let rise an additional hour. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until nicely browned. Makes about 48 rolls.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour salt and sugar in a large bowl. Add shortening and mix until crumbly. In small bowl beat together water vinegar and egg. Combine the 2 mixtures until all ingredients are moistened. Divide dough into 5 portions and shape into flat round patties ready for rolling. Wrap each patty in plastic wrap and chill at least 1/2 hour. When ready to roll lightly flour both sides of patty and roll on lightly floured surface. For shells bake at 450\u00b0. Will keep 3 days in refrigerator. Makes 2 double and 1 single crust or 20 tart shells.

title: Chicken And Andouille Smoked Sausage Gumbo
instructions: Remove excess fat from chicken. Rub with salt garlic powder and red pepper. Let stand 30 minutes. Combine onions bell peppers and celery in a medium bowl; set aside. Combine flour 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon red pepper in paper or plastic bag. Add chicken pieces and shake until chicken is coated. Reserve 1/2 cup of the flour.

title: Hot Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop peppers and onions. Pour boiling water over peppers and onions then drain. Cover with cold water. Bring to boiling point then drain again. Put vinegar salt sugar and mustard seed in another pan and bring to boil. Add to peppers and onions and boil 1 minute. Fill jars and seal.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Peel onions and cucumbers. If cucumbers are large remove the seeds. Slice tomatoes thin. Chop onions cucumbers and peppers small. Cut cauliflower into small pieces. Soak vegetables overnight in brine made of 1 cup salt to 1 quart water. Stir and mix well. Next day drain well.

title: Gaye'S Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim fat from beef. For sauce mix together the water soy sauce cornstarch bouillon granules and pepper. Set the mixture aside. Cook fettuccine according to package directions except omit the cooking oil and salt. Drain well.

title: One Step Lasagna
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups water with spaghetti sauce in bowl. Cover bottom of sprayed 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with 1 1/2 cups of sauce.

title: Hamburger-Meat-Rice-Tomato Sauce Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix well. Put into greased 9-inch pie plate.

title: Baked Eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease custard cup. Crack egg into cup. Sprinkle with cheese. Place custard cup on tray. Bake 18 to 20 minutes. Yields 1 serving.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Beat chicken breasts (any number desired). Mix butter (start with small amount and melt more as needed) with small amount of oregano; brush breasts.\tPut cube of cheese in center; roll up dip in butter and roll in bread crumbs (mixed with Parmesan cheese just guess at amount). Place in greased casserole\tand refrigerate until\tready to bake. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven 45 minutes or until done. This is my favorite company recipe as can be prepared well in advance.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a large greased iron skillet or a 11 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat egg. Add 1/2 cup sugar gradually. Stir margarine in lightly. Alternately add pancake mix and milk-vanilla mixture. Pour into greased 8-inch square pan. Sprinkle with mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon and chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Breast
instructions: Place chicken breast in pan put cheese slices over chicken. Mix soup and water pour over chicken. Spread bread crumbs on top of chicken. Melt butter and drizzle on top. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Zesty Sauerkraut
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in butter. Broil bacon and crumble. Rinse sauerkraut and place in baking dish. Add the beer molasses and mustard to onions peppers and bacon. Cook and stir for 3 minutes. Pour over sauerkraut and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat oil in heavy duty saucepan add garlic onion eggplant zucchini and green pepper; saute vegetables until they are barely tender. Add seasoning mixing well. Add tomatoes and simmer until tender about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: California Blend Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and top with onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Place cooked broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole; cover with chicken. Make a sauce of chicken soup mayonnaise evaporated milk cheese and curry powder. Mix and spread over casserole. Sprinkle with slivered almonds and bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: In 16 ounce Pyrex dish boil yellow squash in 1/2 cup water until slightly tender. Drain off water. Mix milk egg margarine and cheese in separate bowl. Next pour over squash; mix lightly. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top. Bake until golden brown. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Rum Nut Swirl Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8-inch square baking pan. In medium bowl stir butter sugar and cocoa until blended. Add vanilla and eggs; beat with spoon until blended. Add flour baking powder and salt. Beat with spoon until well blended. Spread half of batter into prepared pan. Gently spread Rum Nut Swirl over batter. Spoon remaining chocolate batter over top. With spatula or knife cut through batters to marble. Bake for 25 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0. Continue to bake for 10 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely in pan on wire rack. Cut into 20 bars and serve warm.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Form into 1 1/2-inch balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes until set. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Lucky Cake 1-2-3
instructions: First Layer Mix first 3 ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Chop onion and garlic. Season (with seasoned salt) and brown hamburger meat with onion and garlic then drain. Stir soup into hamburger meat. Place in an ungreased ovenproof casserole dish. Put grated cheese on top. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 and bake uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
instructions: Place lettuce in a 3-quart glass dish. Top lettuce with tomatoes (make layers). Next green pepper red cabbage water chestnuts broccoli red onion cauliflower. Just arrange it colorfully. Use your favorite salad dressing. Creamy Italian is great.

title: Tina'S Hot Crab Meat Dip
instructions: Melt cream cheese in double boiler. Add all ingredients except for crab. When smooth fold in crab. Serve hot (over sterno) with Pepperidge Farm pumpernickel and cheese cracker sticks.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Combine flour and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in flavorings. Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wild Rice With Mushrooms And Onions
instructions: In a 3-quart lidded saucepan bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Add salt and the wild rice. Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes. Add the converted rice mushrooms and onion to the pot without stirring. Cover and continue cooking another 5 minutes. Do not remove the lid. Let the rice sit for 5 minutes after finishing the cooking. Yields 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
instructions: In a covered skillet cook cabbage leaves in boiling water. Drain and set aside. In same skillet heat margarine over medium heat. Add onion; cook until tender. Add tomato sauce sugar 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper; mix well and set aside. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients; divide into 12 equal portions. Place 1 portion in center of each cabbage leaf. Fold leaf sides toward center then from one edge roll up leaf. Place in sauce in skillet seam side down. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes.

title: Bourch
instructions: Cook meat; cool and drain off fat. Combine all other ingredients; add meat back to mixture and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in a saucepan. Combine enchilada sauce and soup and warm. Put a layer of tortilla sauce meat onion and cheese. Repeat layers. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Filete Steak Salteado
instructions: In deep fryer or Dutch oven heat vegetable oil to 350\u00b0. Fry potatoes in hot oil until brown about 10 minutes; drain on paper towels. Cut meat into cubes. In large skillet heat olive oil; brown meat on all sides. Add remaining ingredients except wine. Heat thoroughly; add wine just before serving. Serve over white or yellow rice.

title: Brownie Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and salt. Set aside. Bring to boil the water and margarine. Stir liquid ingredients into flour mixture and add eggs buttermilk baking soda and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes on cookie sheet.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Split Seconds
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and egg. Blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off. Stir in flour and baking powder. Mix well. Divide dough int 4 equal parts. On lightly floured surface shape each part into 12 x 3/4-inch roll. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Using handle of wooden spoon or finger make a depression about 1/2-inch wide and 1/4-inch deep lengthwise down center of each roll. Fill each roll with 2 tablespoons of jelly. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Cool slightly. Cut diagonally into bars. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Cook sausage links in Dutch oven until brown. Drain in paper toweling and remove fat from pan. Brown ground beef and onion well; stir in tomato puree paste sugar pepper 1 teaspoon basil 1 teaspoon salt and 1 cup water. Simmer covered for 45 minutes. Cut sausage into bite-size pieces and add to mixture. Cook 15 minutes stirring occasionally. In the meantime cook manicotti as label directs; drain in colander. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Cook rice and set aside. Drain off old water from beans and add fresh water. Add meat and cook until beans are tender. Add seasoning and serve over rice.

title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
instructions: Heat milk. Add grated cheese and let melt. Add pimientos and mix well. This can be poured up in jars to cool before serving. Use as a sandwich spread a dip or for stuffing celery.

title: Tortellini Salad(Great For A Crowd!)
instructions: Add all ingredients. Toss and marinate at least 2 hours. Add avocado or mushrooms if you like.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat in saucepan. Pour over meat loaf and serve.

title: Punch
instructions: Be careful in your selection. Do not choose too young. When selected give your entire thoughts to preparation for domestic use. Some\twives insist on keeping them in a pickle. Others are constantly\tgetting them in hot water. This may make them sour hard and sometimes bitter. Even poor varieties may be made sweet tender and good by garnishing with patience well sweetened with love and seasoned with kisses. Wrap warm with a steady fire of domestic devotion and serve with peaches and cream. Thus prepared they will last for years.

title: Russian Tea Mix
instructions: Mix above ingredients together and store in airtight container.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender container. Process until smooth. Store in refrigerator until ready to use. Yields about 1 1/4 cups about the same as a 14 ounce can of commercial type milk.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil red potatoes with skins on. Peel after cooked and set aside. Fry bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towel. Reserve 2 to 3 tablespoons drippings of bacon grease. Crumble the bacon. Saute onion in bacon grease until tender. Blend in flour slowly then stir in vinegar and water. Cook until mixture boils and becomes thicker. Add sugar salt and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.

title: Different Chicken Pie
instructions: Put boned chicken in casserole. Put chopped celery over chicken. Pour melted oleo over chicken and celery. Mix flour and dry ingredients with the milk. Pour flour mixture over chicken. Mix cream of celery soup with 1/4 cup chicken stock. Pour over chicken. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with green beans and corn.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad Ring
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Chill until partially set. Blend in mayonnaise. Fold in celery green pepper and cottage cheese. Pour into a 4-cup ring mold. Chill until firm. Unmold on lettuce.

title: Turkey Parmesan
instructions: Pound the turkey breast slices; set aside. Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese; set aside. Combine eggs salt and pepper. Coat turkey breast slices with bread crumb mixture then dip into egg mixture and back into bread crumb mixture. Place coated turkey breast slices on wax paper. Let stand 20 to 30 minutes turning several times. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat. Fry turkey breast slices in oil until golden brown on both sides. Add 1/4 cup hot water to pan. Cover and cook slowly about 30 minutes until tender. Arrange turkey breast slices in baking dish. Pour 2 spoons tomato sauce on each breast slice. Place a slice of Mozzarella cheese over sauce. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix all together and let stand overnight before serving.

title: Flavored Pretzels
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Enjoy.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O according to package directions then add remaining ingredients. Pour into Jell-O mold or bowl and chill until set.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Soak gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water for five minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak bread in milk and water. Add sugar and eggs. Mix well. Add vanilla and raisins. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Pat pieces of margarine over the pudding. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Crevettes Scampi
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp leaving tail intact; arrange in single layer on bottom of broiler pan. Preheat broiler. In small saucepan heat olive oil garlic parsley oregano salt and red pepper. Pour over shrimp; toss to coat. Broil 4 inches from source of heat for about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Serves 6.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Combine dry pudding mix pineapple and juice. Fold in marshmallows and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Hot Cheese And Crab Dip
instructions: Melt cheese and milk in medium saucepan or microwave stirring to smooth consistency. Stir in crabmeat and wine. Heat through. Serve hot with crackers or party rye.

title: Surprise Sherbet
instructions: Mix and put in ice cube tray. Freeze until firm and serve.

title: Piccalilli
instructions: Slice tomatoes and onions thin. Mix with all other ingredients. Boil until tender about 20 minutes. Pack into hot sterilized jars. Seal.

title: Carolina Housewife Wedding Cake Of 1850
instructions: Add cloves to your taste.

title: Fresh Apple Cookies
instructions: Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Charlotte Russe
instructions: Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup milk. Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and lemon colored; stir in gelatin and scalded milk. Cook in top of a double boiler stirring constantly until thickened; cool. Stir in sherry and fold in whipped cream. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold into custard. Line a 3-quart bowl with ladyfingers; pour in filling and chill until set. Yields about 12 servings.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Peel apples and slice thinly. Add sugar and cinnamon; stir and let sit. Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add sugar and beat well until light. Add oil in 2 parts beating well. Add vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to egg and sugar mixture. Stir in orange juice.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef. Pour off grease. Add Ragu sauce to meat; mix well. Mix other ingredients except the noodles. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and layer meat sauce noodles mixture repeat.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let stand at least one hour before using so that flavors blend together. Best served by purchasing round loaf of bread of your choice rye sourdough Italian etc. Cut out center to form bowl. Place dip in bread bowl. Cut bread which was taken from center of loaf into cubes and use to dip along with cut up vegetables of your choice.

title: Great Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix oil vinegar and sugar. Mix with vegetables. Marinate overnight.\tAdd lemon pepper and celery; salt to taste. Can use less oil. Add enough water to make 1/2 cup.

title: Yummy Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add soup and heat through. Add soup to hash browns; stir in onions sour cream and cheese. Mix well. Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Bacon And Cheddar Dip
instructions: Mix packet of dip and sour cream. Add cheese and bacon bits. Mix well. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar eggs and vanilla. Grease nut tassie tins and flour with graham cracker crumbs. Fill 3/4 full with cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen. After cheese cakes cool drop cherry or blueberry filling in center.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Combine broccoli margarine onion broth and the 3 different types of soups together. Cook on low and stir often until broccoli is tender adding either milk to thin or cornstarch to thicken. Add cheese before serving.

title: Yam And Sweet Potato Dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 in an 8 x 12-inch pan (2-quart size) for 30 minutes. Spread 1 1/2 cups small marshmallows over warm cake until they melt. Pour chocolate sauce over and let stand 2 hours.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: At medium speed on mixer beat oil and sugar; beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs and then dry ingredients mixing well after each addition. Stir in bananas and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased loaf pan until done or 35 minutes. Let cool 20 minutes before turning onto cooling rack.

title: Supreme Chicken
instructions: Bone and skin chicken. Stir rice chicken soup broth and mushrooms together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with boned chicken and sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Cover and bake 1 hour at 400\u00b0.

title: Orange Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Combine pie filling water sugar lemon juice and butter in saucepan and heat until boiling. Pour into an 8 1/4 x 1 3/4-inch round ovenware cake dish. Top hot cherry mixture with rolls cut side up. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until rolls are done. Spread tops with the icing that comes in the Danish orange roll package. Good served warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: New Year'S Cookies
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water; add warmed milk margarine and cream. Add salt and beaten eggs then flour and floured raisins. Let rise 30 minutes to 1 hour and fry in hot fat. Drop by tablespoons in hot fat. Drain on paper towels and glaze after they have cooled. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Cream margarine sour cream and cream cheese. Add hot drained potatoes and beat until smooth. Add salt and pepper to taste and them add onion. Put in a well greased two-quart baking dish. Sprinkle paprika on top and bake at 350 for 25 minutes.

title: Apple Chop Suey
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and add next 4 ingredients. Using a 9 x 9-inch pan bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes. Top with Cool Whip. Serves 9.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix ham pork bread water and eggs together. Form into loaf. Mix brown sugar cloves mustard vinegar and 3/4 cup water together and pour over the meat mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours with lid on. Bake at 300\u00b0 basting often until browned.

title: Fish And Cheese Chowder
instructions: Cut fish in 1-inch cubes. Melt butter in large saucepan. Add onion carrot and celery. Cook until onion is transparent. Blend in flour salt and paprika. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add chicken broth and milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add fish; simmer until fish flakes easily (5 minutes for fresh 10 for frozen). Add cheese; stir until melted. Serve hot. Yields 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Combine the margarine flour salt asparagus liquid milk and cheese to make a cheese sauce.

title: Chili
instructions: Smoke all meats using oak and hickory. When meat is almost done in a large pot combine all the ingredients (except the beans) and add a cup of water. Simmer. When meat is done cut stew beef into small pieces and break the beef sausage and turkey up. Add to pot. Continue to simmer for an hour. Add beans and simmer for another hour.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix together flour and sugar. In pan boil water cocoa and butter. Pour this mixture over flour and sugar. Add eggs buttermilk and vanilla. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes in a 13 x 9 pan.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Stir and heat until hot and add 1 chopped onion. Serve with taco chips.

title: Blueberry Lush
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and let cool about 15 minutes. Add blueberries with syrup and pineapple. Let gel completely.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Combine 2 1/2 cups blueberries and 1 tablespoon cornstarch in blender; blend until smooth. Cook puree over medium heat about 15 minutes stirring constantly. Set aside to cool and reserve 1/2 cup for glaze.

title: Honey Glazed Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet melt margarine; add honey mustard curry powder and salt. Mix well to blend. Place chicken in baking dish and pour honey mixture over the top. Turn chicken to coat on both sides. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for one hour; baste often.

title: Mom'S Egg Noodles
instructions: Beat eggs salt and baking powder together good. Then add flour to make a stiff dough. Flour linen table cloth and sprinkle with flour. Put dough on floured table cloth and knead until smooth. Roll out on cloth and let dry. When dry fold in half then in half again until a narrow roll. Then slice to desired thickness. Cook in roast or chicken broth.

title: Fresh Lemon Pie
instructions: Cook the sugar cornstarch and the water until thickened. Beat the egg yolks adding 1/4 cup sugar then pour some of the hot mixture into egg mixture and back into cooking pan to thicken more. Add the lemon juice. When thick enough for pie crust add 1 tablespoon butter and 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Layer cucumbers and onions in a large container (not metal). Mix remaining ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Pour over cucumbers. Let set in refrigerator 5 days before using.

title: Butter-Nut Crunch
instructions: Butter a 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet and set aside. In a medium saucepan combine sugar salt butter or margarine and water. Cook until mixture reaches soft crack stage or 270\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Stir in chopped walnuts. Pour onto prepared cookie sheet.

title: Tea Sparkler
instructions: In a large pitcher combine all ingredients except soda. Chill at least 2 hours. Just before serving add a splash of soda. Pour into ice filled glasses and garnish if desired with orange lemon and lime slices. Makes 5 servings.

title: Texas Barbecue Brisket(6 Pound Brisket)
instructions: Sprinkle lean side of brisket with 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke. Rub in 1/2 teaspoon each of the salts. Place lean side down in large pan. Score fatty side. Rub in rest of liquid smoke and salts. Cover tightly. Refrigerate overnight. Before cooking sprinkle each side with Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Place fatty side up in roasting pan. Wrap in foil. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours for each pound (9 hours for 6 pounds). Last hour of cooking uncover and pour over barbecue sauce. Leave uncovered.

title: French Roll Pizzas(Snack Or Meal)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let sit to blend. Spread on sourdough bread halves. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 until cheese is melted and bread is crispy.

title: Fancy Franks
instructions: In a small skillet or saucepan combine first 4 ingredients. Add cocktail franks and pineapple chunks. Simmer together for 15 minutes. Serve warm with cocktail picks.

title: Grilled Corn
instructions: Strip husks down to the end of the cob but do not tear off. Remove silk. If desired soak in salted ice water to which 1/2 cup milk has been added for about 20 minutes; drain well. Brush with softened butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bring husks up around the corn. Wrap each ear securely in a double thickness of aluminum foil. Twist the ends well. Barbecue on briquets 10 minutes turning once.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt and baking powder together in a bowl. Add egg milk and oil. Mix then add blueberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. (I double the recipe.)

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine cocoa sugar flour and boiling water. Cook until thick approximately 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add a pinch of salt butter and vanilla.

title: My Mother'S Punch
instructions: Mix in large punch bowl and add ice and fruit such as pineapple chunks maraschino cherries or slices of oranges or lemons.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on back of box. Cool completely and make pudding in a punch bowl. Shred cake mix to cover bottom. Layer pineapple cool whip cake cherries cool whip cake (pour vanilla pudding over all ingredients) until you only have room left to top with cool whip. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Praline Cookies(Servings:  48)
instructions: Put 1 layer whole graham crackers in jelly roll pan (approximately 24). Boil and stir sugar and margarine for 2 minutes. Stir in pecans. Pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool in pan for 2 minutes. Finish cooling on rack and break into halves.

title: El Paso Burgers
instructions: Place meat in a large bowl. Add onion green pepper and taco mix. Combine thoroughly. Shape into 8 burgers. Place onto a well-greased oven broiling pan. Spread salsa on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done. Place 1 slice of cheese on each burger and return to oven just long enough for it to melt. Serve on bun.

title: Jello Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Add pineapple juice lemon juice and sugar to jello. Stir. Chill until thick but not firm. Fold in crushed pineapple and cottage cheese. Pour into bowl and chill until set. Unmold onto lettuce. Dot with mayonnaise.

title: Souped Up Chicken Soup
instructions: Save broth from boiled chicken. Add carrots potatoes macaroni and onions to broth; cook until tender. You may need to add more water if too thick. Add chicken tomatoes and spices. Cook 15 to 20 minutes and serve.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Melt margarine; add other ingredients. Place over heat and bringing to boil. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool and whip.

title: Real Key Lime Pie
instructions: Cut off the ends of the lime. Grind up fine and squeeze juice from pulp and use.

title: Holiday Pecans
instructions: Melt oleo in large pan. Mix next 3 ingredients. Stir in pecans then spread in glass dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes stirring frequently. Turn onto paper towel and sprinkle with salt. Let season at least 1 day before serving.

title: Congealed Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello in boiling water; add blueberry pie filling and pineapple. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Arrange apples in well-greased baking dish. Blend remaining ingredients to form a coarse texture. Spread evenly over apples. Sprinkle water over mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat together the cream cheese sour cream oregano garlic powder and red pepper. Spread evenly in 9 or 10-inch quiche pan or pie plate. Spread pizza sauce over the top. Sprinkle with pepperoni green onions and green pepper. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes more until cheese is melted and mixture is heated through.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well. Sift the dry ingredients and stir in. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts. Roll into sugar and cinnamon mixture. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. (These cookies puff up at first then flatten out.) Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables fine and add to crumbled cornbread. Toss with 1/2 large bottle buttermilk dressing. Store in refrigerator. (Keeps well up to 1 week.)

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour and meal in a large bowl. Toss lightly with a fork. Add remaining ingredients; beat with rotary or electric mixer until smooth and thoroughly blended. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell and bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until top is golden brown.

title: Creamed Tuna On Patty Shells
instructions: Melt margarine; add flour and pour in milk slowly until thickened. Season with salt and pepper and whisk in cream and egg yolk. Add tuna mushrooms and peas and serve over patty shells. Garnish top with parsley.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package; drain. In baking dish stir together (gently) the noodles broccoli chicken onion and mushrooms. In a bowl stir together the soup milk cheese salt and pepper (reserve 1/2 cup cheese). Stir all into noodle mixture. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Sprinkle reserved cheese and paprika over all and return to oven for 10 minutes (or until cheese melts). Contains 290 calories per serving and 11 grams fat.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon and then saute chopped onion in bacon grease. Add beans Ro-Tel and brown sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish until bubbly about 45 minutes. Makes 10 servings.

title: Onion Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Saute onion in margarine. Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and pour into greased pie plate. Spread onion over top. Mix sour cream and cheese together; spread over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
instructions: Wipe chicken breasts with paper towels. Sprinkle each half with a portion of the salt pepper and Accent. Place the pancake mix in a paper sack then coat each piece of chicken with mix by shaking up and down vigorously. Heat the oil in a suitable skillet; brown each piece of chicken on both sides. Cook the rice according to directions. Stir the soup and half and half cream into the cooked rice. Put soup and rice mixture into a buttered casserole then put chicken on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage for 8 minutes boiling in water. Melt 1/2 cup margarine in casserole or 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle and mix 1 tube crackers in margarine and flatten on bottom like a pie crust. Place cooked cabbage over cracker crumbs.

title: Scott'S Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and slice boiled potatoes. Pour Italian dressing over potatoes and allow to sit 1 hour. Pour off excess dressing and add eggs onion and spices. Add mayonnaise until desired consistency is obtained. Serve immediately or chilled.

title: Potatoes Baked In Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add catsup paprika and salt. Add milk gradually; then add grated cheese. Cut raw or cooked potatoes in thin slices. Place alternate layer of potatoes and pepper in a baking dish. Cover with sauce and repeat until all is used. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: In 2 quart saucepan stir together 1 cup sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in water until smooth. Stir in egg yolks stirring constantly. Bring to boil over medium heat. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon rind lemon juice and margarine. Cool. Turn into pastry shell. In small bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually beat in 1/3 cup sugar. Continue beating until stiff peaks form. Spread meringue around edge of filling first then fill in center. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Cool. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix the sugar cocoa margarine and milk together in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute then remove from heat. Add peanut butter and stir until dissolved. Add flavoring. Next add oatmeal and beat mixture like fudge. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper and let set.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into bite size pieces. This should take about 2 months. Add brown gravy and simmer. Add salt and pepper to taste. Heat whale oil to brown mushrooms celery and onions. Mix all ingredients and cook over kerosene fire for 4 weeks at 465\u00b0. Yield 3800 or more servings. If more guests are expected 2 rabbits may be added but do this only if necessary as most people do not like to find hare in their stew.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Thaw broccoli in boiling water then add remaining ingredients. Mix. Pour in casserole. Top with 1 stick melted oleo. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt Velveeta and margarine. Mix in cocoa sugar vanilla and nuts (as many as you desire). Mix well. Pat into 4 (13 x 9-inch) buttered pans. Cool. Cut into small pieces.

title: Holiday Apple Cider
instructions: Bring the apple cider cloves allspice cinnamon and sugar to a boil. Lower heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Strain punch and pour into heatproof bowl. Add orange slices. Makes 16 cups.

title: Walnut Bourbon Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except granulated sugar. Roll into balls a small melon scoop works well to measure then roll in granulated sugar. Store in an airtight container. Makes about 48 balls.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes then drain. Mix other ingredients and place in casserole. Top with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and bubbly.

title: Bonnie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour alternately with eggs. Bake in loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lamb Chops With Ratatouille And Couscous
instructions: In a 4-quart flameproof casserole heat oil over high heat. Add chops and brown on both sides 2 or 3 at a time a total of about 5 minutes. Remove to a dish and set aside.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Roll dough into an oblong shape. Brush with olive oil and oregano. Place filling in the center. Fold long sides over and pinch to close. Close ends by rolling once and pinching. Grease pan with Pam. (Or for best results eliminate Pam and bake on stoneware.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Pineapple Carrot Salad
instructions: Heat the pineapple juice and water to boiling. Stir in the lemon Jell-O until dissolved. Cool to room temperature. Meanwhile mix the cream cheese until light and fluffy. Heat milk and add to cheese. Mix until well blended. Then add carrots pineapple and vinegar; put the Jell-O mixture into the cheese and mix well. Pour into container and chill.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate. Great for apples grapes strawberries bananas etc.

title: Famous Amos Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat softened margarine brown and white sugars vanilla water and eggs in a large bowl with electric mixer until creamy and thoroughly blended. Preheat oven to moderate 375\u00b0. By hand stir in flour baking soda and salt until well mixed. Stir in chocolate pieces.

title: Coke Cake
instructions: Heat Coca-Cola butter and cocoa to boiling; mix rest of ingredients and add to mixture; batter will be thin with marshmallows floating. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

title: Bread Dip
instructions: Chop peppers onion and ham. Mix everything together. Hollow out a round loaf of bread and put dip in loaf. Use the insides to dip with.

title: Lemon-Dijon Chicken Breasts
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs and rind stirring well. Combine lemon juice mustard and lime juice; brush mixture over both sides of chicken. Dredge chicken in breadcrumb mixture. Place chicken in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray; sprinkle with any remaining breadcrumb mixture. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn chicken and bake an additional 15 minutes or until done. Garnish with lemon slices if desired. Yield 6 servings (167 calories and 12 percent fat per serving).

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion garlic salt salt and pepper. Place 3 lasagna noodles into boiling water. Dont overcook noodles or they will split. In bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan put thin coating of spaghetti sauce. Put the noodles in bottom of pan and put 3 more in water. Put on top of noodles in layers drained ground beef (cooked) Ricotta cheese Mozzarella cheese sprinkle of grated cheese drizzle with spaghetti sauce sprinkle of parsley flakes and sprinkle a few anise seed (if you like). Do 2 more layers; use plenty of Mozzarella cheese and plenty of sauce. Put too much sauce will make the layers slide apart. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix together. Heat tortillas as directed. Spread evenly on tortillas and roll up. Chill 3 hours before serving. Slice into 1-inch pieces.

title: Maple Nut Bars
instructions: Cream oleo until soft; add powdered sugar gradually and beat until creamy. Add egg maple syrup and soda. Mix in flour. Add nuts. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan. (I had to use a pan much smaller than this size.) Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm and roll in powdered sugar. I put maple icing and walnuts on mine on top.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with soy sauce then sprinkle seasoning salt. Cover well. Spread honey mustard on chicken and bake in glass baking dish with lid for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0 then add honey to chicken and cook for 35 more minutes.

title: Cocoa Mayo Cake
instructions: Melt mayonnaise and sugar. Add part of sifted flour and dry ingredients then the water. Mix well. Add remaining flour and vanilla. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pop Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add soda. While cake is still hot poke holes in top with toothpicks. Slowly allow gelatin mixture to seep through holes. Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
instructions: Slightly beat eggs with sugar salt and vanilla. Gradually add hot milk to eggs; stir in rice. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon and set dish in pan of hot water. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven until set about 40 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Grape Pie
instructions: Pop middle out of grape skins; save skins. Put pulp (middles) in saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes. Put hot pulp through colander or food mill to remove seeds. Combine strained pulp with skins. Add sugar flour and salt. Pour into unbaked crust. Dot with margarine. Add top crust with slits lattice or circular cut outs on top of pie. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Make center in mixture. Add vanilla vinegar and oil. Gradually stir in water until well blended. Pour into 8-inch square greased pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and mix all ingredients together except tortillas and spices to taste. Put a bit of the chicken grease from cooking the chicken in the bottom of a large casserole dish. Start with tortillas then alternate chicken mixture then tortillas. End up with the chicken mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar; combine with sweetened condensed milk and lime juice. Add a few drops of green food coloring. Fold in topping. Pour into crust and chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Place eggs and sugar in mixer. Put on slow. Add butter and melted chocolate. Scrape down. Remove and mix flour by hand; add vanilla and pecans. Put into greased sheet pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly firm to the hand about 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Have eggs butter and milk at room temperature. Combine sugar a cup at a time to the softened butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift flour four times and add to creamed mixture 1/2 cup at a time beating well after each. Stir in milk and flavorings. Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Dilly Casserole
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Heat cottage cheese to lukewarm. Combine cottage cheese next 7 ingredients and yeast in large bowl; mix well. Add enough flour to make stiff dough. Let rise covered in warm place for 1 hour or until double in bulk. Stir dough down.

title: Ceilia'S Potato Salad
instructions: Cook peel and dice potatoes. Add diced celery onion parsley and dill. Add mayonnaise; mix. Then add lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spicy Tomato Juice
instructions: Wash tomatoes. Remove cores and chop. Combine tomatoes onions and celery and bring to a boil. Continue cooking and stirring for 20 minutes. Press through a food mill. Heat almost until boiling. Stir in other ingredients. Adjust seasonings to taste. Process in pints or quarts for 35 minutes. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Play Dough Recipe
instructions: Do not double or halve this recipe. Measure flour and salt into a large bowl. Add only 1 cup of water to the dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly with your fingers adding more water if necessary to make the dough the consistency of pie crust. Remove the dough from the bowl and knead for 4 or 5 minutes on wax paper. Store in tight container until used.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies. Mix oleo powdered sugar and cream cheese until smooth; stir Cool Whip into mixture. Mix milk and instant pudding and vanilla as directed. Mix cheese mixture with pudding.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Cut meat into strips. Combine ingredients to create a marinating sauce. Marinate meat for 12 to 24 hours in refrigerator. Hang strips of meat on toothpicks on oven rack. Cook at 150\u00b0 with oven door cracked open 1-inch for 3 to 6 hours.

title: Hot Cheese Puffs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread; blend well. Cut bread into 1 1/2-inch rounds; spread with cheese mixture. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yield 25 servings.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling water over oats. Let set 20 minutes. Cream oleo brown sugar white sugar vanilla and eggs. Then add oats; mix well. Pour into 9-inch square greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Do not remove from pan until frosting has been put on.

title: Cheese Sticks
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt pepper and cheese. Cut in butter and mix until smooth. Roll 1/3-inch thick. Cut 6 x 1/2-inch. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 24.

title: Rockport Red Sauce
instructions: Mix well and chill. May use more pepper sauce to taste.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese with mixer until smooth. Gradually stir in drained pineapple 1 cup nuts onions peppers and salt. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except raisins. Bake in glass dish at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. If desired add raisins for the last half hour of baking.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake
instructions: Roll wafers into crumbs; put 1/2 in Pyrex dish. Cream butter and sugar; add 2 eggs. Put on top of crumbs. Whip cream and fold in pineapple and nuts. Pour over other. Top with other half of vanilla wafer crumbs. Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Cucumbers In The Cold
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients with water to cover. Let stand overnight or 12 hours. Rinse and drain. Put into jars (glass) the rinsed and drained cucumber mixture.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into shell and bake for 35 minutes at 250\u00b0.

title: The Bungalow'S French Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a jar; shake well. Cover tightly and refrigerate.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes
instructions: Thaw potatoes. Combine margarine salt pepper onion sour cream soup and cheese. Blend together with potatoes. Pour into 3-quart casserole dish or 2 (1 1/2-quart) dishes. Mix crushed corn flakes and margarine together. Sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Shrimp Boats(Appetizer)
instructions: Combine shrimp eggs celery salt salt and pepper. Combine mayonnaise with cream. Fold into shrimp mixture. Spread shrimp mixture between bread slices. Cut into halves diagonally. Fasten corners with wooden picks. Place on cookie sheet; broil 4-inches from source of heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until bread is toasted. Yield 8 servings.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl blend together the flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add raisins caraway seeds egg and buttermilk. Stir until blended. Knead on floured board until smooth. Shape dough into 2 balls and place each in a greased 8-inch round cake pan. Flatten to fill pans. Cut a deep cross in the top of each loaf. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until done. Slice and serve with butter. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Simmer squash onion salt and pepper until tender. Remove from heat. Add crackers cream margarine and beaten eggs. Pour into well buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or firm to touch. Cover with grated cheese and bake until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Celery Sauce
instructions: Put tomatoes onions and peppers through food chopper. Combine with other ingredients; cook over low heat until thick. This takes about all day. Put in jars.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix and marinate overnight. Drain and serve on lettuce.

title: Ham And Onion Wrap-Ups
instructions: Spread about 2 tablespoons of cream cheese onto each slice of ham. Place trimmed green onion (approximately 4 inches long) on cream cheese. Roll tightly. This is a great party snack!

title: Ha'Penny Snacks
instructions: Let butter and cheese come to room temperature and mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and blend. Shape into about 3 rolls 1-inch in diameter. Wrap in wax paper and chill. Slice rolls into slices 1/4-inch thick. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until slightly browned on edges. Keeps well in airtight container. Yields 6 dozen.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In a casserole dish arrange a layer of beans layer of onion rings layer of beans layer of onions layer of cracker crumbs and layer of cheese. Mix soup with water and salt; pour over beans onions etc. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and bake chicken breasts in large casserole dish. Remove skin and bones; cut chicken in bite-size pieces. Combine butter chicken and remaining ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Irish Creme
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in large container. Put into bottles and store in refrigerator. Gets stronger as it ages. To serve mix with half and half over ice.

title: Roasted Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Spray large baking sheet with cooking spray. In small bowl combine corn oil and garlic. Arrange potato slices on baking sheet. Brush with corn oil mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan and pepper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Sprinkle cake mix over mixture. Scatter nuts over cake mix. Drizzle melted oleo over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Cool Fruit Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix baking mix and 2 tablespoons sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture is crumbly. Press in bottom and up side of ungreased glass pie plate (10 x 1/2-inch). Bake about 15 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool. Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff. Fold whipped cream and marshmallows into cream cheese mixture. Spread over crust. Refrigerate any remaining pie. Makes 8 servings.

title: Russian Eggs
instructions: Beat eggs and season to taste. Simmer pepper and onion rings until tender-crisp. Line well-oiled 9 x 12-inch pan with bread slices. Cover bread with meat and layer vegetables (except tomatoes) over meat. Pour eggs over all. Press down. Let stand overnight.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix stewed and chopped chicken breasts cream cheese chicken soup and celery soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly (about 20 minutes). Top with mixture of crushed Ritz crackers melted butter and poppy seed. Bake until bubbly (about 10 minutes).

title: Cheese Wafer
instructions: Combine butter cheese and nuts. Mix well and add flour. Shape into log and cut into wafers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onions. Layer cucumbers and onions. Boil vinegar sugar salt mustard seed celery seed and turmeric. Pour over cucumbers. When cool refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Sauce(Large Recipe)
instructions: In a large pot cook and stir sausage and onions until browned; drain the fat. Add other ingredients except pasta. Mix and bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover slightly and simmer for 2 hours. Stir often. (Sometimes I use a crock-pot.) Makes approximately 36 cups. Cook spaghetti as directed on package.

title: No Brainer Southwest Chicken Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients together in large kettle and simmer about 30 minutes. Serve with crushed tortilla chips grated cheese sour cream and avocado slices.

title: Mr. John'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Heat to a simmer and just keep warm.

title: Corned Beef In Rolls
instructions: Mix ingredients together and toss. Fill 8 hot dog rolls with mixture. Wrap each in foil and heat on cookie sheet for 20 minutes at 250\u00b0. These are simple to make and may be wrapped in foil and frozen for later use.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Bring broccoli to a boil for approximately 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Melt margarine; add chopped onion and saute in skillet. Add garlic cheese and cream of mushroom soup. Place broccoli in greased baking dish. When cheese and soup are melted pour over broccoli. Top with crackers or bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes. Do not cover while baking.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in boiling water. Cool. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add yolks 1 at a time beating well after each. Blend in vanilla and chocolate. Sift flour with soda and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture beating after each addition until smooth. Fold in beaten whites. Pour into three 9-inch layer pans lined on bottom with wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Betty Croome'S Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix ingredients and put in large casserole dish. Top with coarsely crumbled crackers poppy seed and melted oleo. Bake for 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Frosted Orange Pie
instructions: In a saucepan combine sugar flour and salt; gradually add water. Cook and stir over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat. Gradually stir 1/2 C. into egg yolks; return all to pan. Bring to a gentle boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat; stir in orange and lemon peel. Gently stir in juices. Pour into pastry shell. Cool on a wire rack for 1 hour. Chill at least 3 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: *I use cooked chicken boned and skinned.

title: Banana Energy Bars
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg salt and bananas. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuit
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix Bisquick milk and cheese to soft dough. Drop by spoonful onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Mix melted margarine and garlic powder and brush over biscuits while warm.

title: Pesto Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast with sugar in 1/4 cup water. Let set for 5 minutes to proof. In large bowl mix 2 cups flour with yeast mixture together; add remaining water and flour as needed. Mix by hand or electric mixer with dough hook. Knead until smooth and elastic. Put in greased bowl to rise. When doubled in size punch down and divide into 2 balls. Roll dough into rectangle (12 x 8). Spread with pesto mixture roll up and place on baking sheet that has been spread with corn meal. Let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 until lightly browned and hollow sounding to touch. Let cool and feast.

title: Bacon Cheddar Muffins
instructions: Spray muffin pan with Pam. In a large bowl mix flour cheese sugar baking powder and salt. Set aside. In a small bowl mix egg milk and oil. Add to flour mixture. Stir until moist. Batter will be lumpy. Fold in the crumbled bacon. Fill the muffin cups even with the top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins are golden. Serve warm.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Combine butter salt and water. Heat to boiling. Add flour to boiling mixture all at once. Beat vigorously until mixture leaves sides of saucepan and does not cling to spoon. Remove from heat. Cool slightly. Add unbeaten one egg at a time. Beat thoroughly after the addition of each egg until mixture is smooth. Drop by tablespoon into well oiled muffin tin or onto baking sheet 2-inches apart. Shape mixture into rounds and pile slightly in the center. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes until firm and dry. Remove from oven. Cool. Cut a slit in the side of each with a sharp knife. Insert cream filling sweetened whipped cream or fruit. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Makes 12 average size puffs.

title: Favorite Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottoms and sides of 12 medium muffin tins. Beat egg; stir in milk and oil. Mix in remaining ingredients just until flour is moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from pan. If using self-rising flour omit baking powder and salt.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Do not fry meatballs. Add to sauce with ribs or meat sauce.

title: Country Ham Butter
instructions: Combine this and process in food processor until perfectly smooth. Chill. Serve on biscuits buttered toast or crackers.

title: Apple Crisps
instructions: Arrange apples in a buttered 8-inch square pan. Combine oats sugar flour and cinnamon. Cut butter into mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over apple slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream. Yummy.

title: Batter For Fried Chicken
instructions: Shake all ingredients in Ziploc bag. Batter chicken and fry. Refrigerate leftover batter in Ziploc bag for future use. This may remind you of the Colonels chicken (just a little).

title: Glazed Raisin-Cinnamon Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients until dough forms about 20 strokes. Turn into a floured board. Shape into a ball and knead 10 times. Roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 2 1/2-inch cutter. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Spread with Vanilla Glaze while warm (see Miscellaneous for Vanilla Glaze).

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk oleo and cocoa one minute. Must be a rolling boil. Add salt vanilla peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix well and drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and let set up.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple chunks. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Apple Spice Cake
instructions: Cream butter with sugar; beat in eggs then water. In separate bowl sift flour cocoa baking soda cinnamon and nutmeg. Beat into creamed ingredients along with vanilla chocolate morsels and apples. Turn into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Cool thoroughly before slicing. May be topped with whipped cream.

title: Best Ever Coleslaw
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. In saucepan bring vinegar sugar and seasonings to a boil. Pour over cabbage mixture. Place in airtight bowl. Will keep in refrigerator 3 weeks.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients together until smooth.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute broccoli onions and celery in butter. Mix all ingredients except rice. Put rice in bottom of buttered casserole dish. Put mixture on top. Sprinkle paprika on top (for looks). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: 7-Up Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and save juice. Add water to make 1 cup liquid. Heat to boiling and add jello to dissolve. Cool. Stir in 7-Up. Refrigerate to partially set. Mix in pineapple and cranberries. Pour into dish to congeal. Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip and spread on top. Sprinkle with pecan pieces.

title: Pecan Pie Cake
instructions: Mix together 1 egg melted butter and yellow cake mix (except 2/3 cup). Pat into a greased 13 x 9-inch oblong pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 until brown. Mix rest of ingredients. Pour over baked crust. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Take out before completely firm.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cut up potatoes as you would for potato salad. Boil your potatoes then drain. Let your potatoes cool 5 to 10 minutes. In a large deep serving dish cover slightly the bottom with a layer of your cooked potatoes. Then spread a light thin layer of mayonnaise or sour cream or a half and half mixture of mayonnaise and sour cream mixture over the top of your potatoes. Then sprinkle with green peppers Cheddar cheese and chopped ham. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Olive Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except olives). Put 1 teaspoon around each olive. Be sure olive is covered. Cover with Saran Wrap and chill (minimum 1 1/2 hours). Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Best Ever Soup
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add other ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours stirring about every 20 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese slices (batter will be thin). Pour half of batter in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer cheese slices on batter then pour remaining batter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Herbed Cream Cheese For Bagels
instructions: Combine cream cheese whipping cream and garlic in work bowl of food processor or blender. Process until smooth. Stir in chives thyme and pepper. Refrigerate to blend flavors. Allow to stand at room temperature about 30 minutes prior to serving.

title: Sparkling Red Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups hot water. Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Combine all ingredients and freeze. Thaw to slush stage. Pour in ginger ale when ready to serve.

title: Bootsie'S Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Saute chopped onion in small amount of oil. Add meat and cook until done. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add tomato soup catsup and Worcestershire sauce. Stir and simmer. Boil spaghetti.

title: Slammin Jammin Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese well. Add marshmallow cream. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken and pull off bone. Chop chicken and layer in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour chicken broth over chicken. Spread chicken soup (undiluted) over chicken and broth. Melt margarine and combine with flour and milk. Spread mixture on top of other layers and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Butter Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 12 (3-inch) muffin pan cups. Cream the butter shortening and sugar together. Beat in the eggs salt and nutmeg. Stir in the flour alternately with the milk until the mixture is just combined. Fill the muffin cups full. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Fry bacon ends. Saute onion and green pepper in 3 tablespoons of bacon fat in a large skillet until tender. Add all other ingredients. Cook slowly covered approximately 45 minutes. Sprinkle crumbled bacon ends on top and serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mama'S Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients by hand until moist. Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes. Scrape sides of bowl and beat 5 more minutes. Put in cold oven. Do not preheat! Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Pour melted butter onto the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over melted butter or margarine. Sprinkle chopped nuts evenly over crumbs. Scatter chocolate morsels over nuts. Sprinkle coconut evenly over chocolate morsels. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over coconut. Bake in a moderate (350\u00b0) oven for 25 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Cut into bars.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil a fryer. Tear into bite size pieces. Place in a shallow baking dish. Combine soups and milk. Pour over chicken. Mix butter and broth; stir in stuffing. Spread over top of chicken. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sauteed Shrimp And Mushrooms
instructions: Slice mushrooms into 2 or 3 pieces each. Melt butter in a large skillet; add mushrooms. Cook on low heat or high simmer 30 minutes uncovered (until most of the water has cooked out). Add garlic salt and pepper. Stir and add shrimp. Cook covered 5 to 7 minutes until shrimp are done. Stir occasionally. Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In heavy saucepan over low heat melt candy coating with sweetened condensed milk and salt. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter then peanuts and vanilla. Spread evenly into waxed paper-lined 8 or 9-inch square pan. Chill 2 hours. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken 1/2 hour; skin and bone it. Cook broccoli as directed. Arrange broccoli in buttered 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch dish. Tear chicken in strips and place over broccoli. Mix soups with mayonnaise and spread over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and then bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apple Dip
