instructions: Put apples in 2 cups of water 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of vinegar. Cover and when ready to serve drain well. Blend cheese brown sugar and vanilla. Spread in dish. Top with butterscotch topping and nuts. Serve with apples.

title: Italian Country Chicken(6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Heat oil in large heavy skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook until translucent stirring occasionally about 10 minutes. Add chicken and stir until cooked through about 5 minutes. Mix in artichoke hearts (chopped slightly) with liquid peppers (chopped into pieces) with liquid and olives and heat through. Season with salt and pepper. Pour over pasta and toss well. Serve passing Parmesan separately.

title: Mrs. Tran'S Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs in butter and set aside. In wok or large frypan over medium heat saute onion in oil until transparent. Add vegetables and cook stirring for 3 minutes. Add sugar fish sauce and soy sauce and mix well. Add rice and cook about 5 minutes stirring frequently until all food is hot. Chop up scrambled eggs; mix in and serve.

title: Dream Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat until fluffy. Add vanilla and then stir in flour baking powder salt and nuts. Mix until smooth. Form small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down with a fork. Bake in slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until light brown. Makes about 75.

title: Old Fashioned Cheese Potatoes
instructions: In saucepan melt butter. Add flour salt and pepper. Cook and stir until a thick paste forms. Gradually add milk. Cook and stir until mixture begins to thicken. Add cheese. Cook and stir until melted. Place potatoes in a greased 13 x 9-inch dish. Pour sauce over and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Strudel
instructions: In large bowl of electric mixer (or by hand) beat cheese and butter until smooth. Gradually add flour mixed with salt and herbs. When dough holds together form into a ball wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.

title: Carrot And Vegetable Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large pot and start cooking at high heat then reduce heat to medium-high heat when it begins to boil. Cook covered until carrots are tender but not too soft. Then serve over rice or plain.

title: Salt Substitute
instructions: Mix in shaker container and use instead of salt.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Combine in crock-pot and cook for 5 to 6 hours. As mixture thickens add catsup as needed.

title: Bride'S Pink Punch
instructions: Mix jello with hot water. Add Kool-Aid sugar water and juices. Chill. Just before serving add chilled Sprite. In punch bowl pour punch over sherbet.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: Butter Pyrex dish or sheet cake pan. Pour pie filling in pan with pineapple. Pour dry cake mix over fillings. Melt the margarine and pour over the cake mix. Sprinkle nuts over the top and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Cook all ingredients for 30 minutes stirring at all times. Put in jars and seal.

title: Cake That Won'T Last
instructions: Mix by hand in large bowl. When well blended pour into greased and floured angel food or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Do not open door of oven first hour of baking time.

title: Chiffon Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Make a well in middle. Add oil egg yolks water orange and lemon extract; beat. In another bowl beat egg whites with cream of tartar until whites form stiff peaks. Pour egg yolk mixture over beaten whites folding until blended. (Do not stir). Pour into pan bake 55 minutes until light brown.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease baking dish. Place all ingredients in baking dish. (Optional Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese.) Cook at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Pour in milk and stir. Add butter. Cook on low heat. Beat egg yolks. Pour in mixture. Stir while cooking and cook until almost done. Add vanilla and coconut to mixture. Remove from heat. Pour slightly thickened mixture into baked pie crust. Top with beaten egg whites and sugar. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake for 10 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix eggs brown sugar vanilla and oil then add cinnamon flour baking soda and salt. Add to apples and nut mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Use a 9 x 13-inch glass Pyrex dish.

title: Bearnaise Sauce
instructions: Put egg yolks with 1/3 of the butter in top of double boiler. Keep water in the bottom hot but not boiling. Stir eggs and butter constantly until butter melts adding more butter a little at a time and stirring each time until it melts. As soon as the mixture is thick remove from heat and stir in rest of ingredients. Serve at once.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and Jell-O thoroughly; add oil and water. Blend well and add eggs one at a time. Beat according to package (cake mix) directions. Fold in coconut nuts and thawed drained strawberries. Pour batter into tube (greased and floured) or 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake according to cake mix directions at 350\u00b0 (maybe less).

title: Vegetable Dish(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Mix all together and put in casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine the cheese flour salt and cayenne pepper. Using your hands gently stir in egg whites. Pat the mixture into small balls and roll them in cracker crumbs. Heat oil in skillet. When hot put the balls in the pan without crowding them. Cover over medium-high heat turning so all sides become golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Easy Chicken In Wine
instructions: Place chicken breasts in one layer in a shallow baking pan. Mix together all other ingredients. Pour sauce over chicken. Cover with foil. Refrigerate. Spoon sauce over chicken a couple of times.

title: Razorback Burgoo
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large Dutch oven. Bring to boil; cover and reduce heat. Simmer 2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat from broth; cool. Skin bone and chop chicken. Skim off and discard fat from broth. Measure broth and return 3 quarts to Dutch oven. Add chopped meats and remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 4 hours stirring frequently. Add additional broth or water if necessary. Remove red pepper. Double for after the game.

title: Easy Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Grandma Leones' Caramel Frosting
instructions: Put brown sugar milk and butter in saucepan and simmer slowly for about 3 minutes and cool. Add powdered sugar and stir until creamy.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and salt. Beat till stiff egg whites. Fold in dry ingredients vanilla and coconut. Drop on greased sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20-25 mins. If doubled will make approx. 40.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: *If using large package use a deep dish pie shell.

title: Chocolate Animal Crackers
instructions: Melt the chocolate bits and shortening in a saucepan over low heat. Stir until smooth. Dip animal crackers into chocolate and lift with a fork. Place on waxed paper to harden.

title: Stu'S Fine Chili
instructions: Fry ground beef with sliced onions; pour off excess oil (do not overcook). Stir in chili mix. Stir in tomatoes chop or cut tomatoes before adding. Add tomato paste (about 2/3 can). Add jalapeno peppers (split into halves or quarters). Add kidney beans juice and all. Add water to thin out (your choice as to density). Let simmer about 1 hour.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape into patties. Cook at 325\u00b0 on cookie sheet for 1/2 hour. Turn; cook 1/2 hour until brown.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all at once. Pour in 10 x 14-inch greased pan. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop washed broccoli and drain on paper towels. Add onions. Crumble bacon. Reserve 1/4 cup and add to broccoli. Add Ranch dressing and mix well. Top with remaining bacon bits.

title: Bill'S Favorite Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding mix and milk. Add Cool Whip. Layer cookies bananas pudding and repeat.

title: White Bread(Quick Method)
instructions: Scald milk. Add sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water and add to milk. Add half of flour and beat until smooth. Add melted shortening and remaining flour or enough to make easy handled dough. Knead quickly and lightly until smooth and elastic. Place dough in greased bowl cover and set in a warm place. Let rise until double in bulk divide into 4 equal portions and shape into loaves. Place in greased loaf pans. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes longer.

title: Walnut Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli until barely tender. Drain and put in casserole dish. Melt the 1/2 cup butter and add the flour. Remove from heat and add bouillon. Gradually add milk. Return to heat and cook until smooth and boiling. Pour over broccoli. Heat the 3/4 cup water and 6 tablespoons butter. Add the stuffing and walnuts. Sprinkle over broccoli and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Place on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Italiano'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Simmer onion in oil. Add tomatoes paste sauce and water; simmer. Do not burn on bottom. Simmer 1 hour or more. Parboil sausages slowly to get some fat out about 20 minutes. Drain and add sausages to spaghetti sauce. Heat for 30 minutes at a slow simmer. Serve with spaghetti.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix and scald sugar and milk. Stir other ingredients into hot milk and cook until thickened and smooth. After mixture has cooled add sliced bananas.

title: No-Mix Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Stir together berries and 1/2 cup sugar. Melt margarine in casserole dish. Mix flour baking powder salt and rest of sugar. Add milk and mix well. Pour batter into dish with margarine. Do not mix. Put berries and sugar over batter; do not mix. Bake 50 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Raw Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Trim and wash cauliflower and break into small flowerets. Combine all ingredients. Toss lightly and chill well.

title: Fried Scallops
instructions: Combine half and half with Worcestershire powder. Dip scallops in milk mixture and roll in bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove skin and bones. Cut into bite sized pieces. Reserve 2 cups of cooking broth. Saute onion in butter until just heated thoroughly. Add to onion the chili peppers. Then add and heat chicken broth and soups. Stir until smooth and heated. Into large bowl tear tortillas into bites sized pieces; stir in chicken pieces soup mixture and 1 cup Cheddar cheese. Pour into baking dish and top with 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and crushed nachos (if desired). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes in large tube pan greased and floured at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Mother'S Brownies
instructions: Melt together the bitter chocolate with the stick of butter. Mix the eggs sugar flour vanilla and coffee. Blend the mixture with the chocolate and butter. Sprinkle with chopped nuts or marshmallow bits M&Ms or other small edible bits. Bake about 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven in an 8 x 14-inch pan. Test with toothpick for slight moistness. Refrigerate immediately. (This keeps them moist.) Can be frozen.

title: Corn Tomato Chowder
instructions: Cut bacon in small pieces and fry slowly to a golden brown in a large saucepan. Add onion and cook slowly without browning for 5 minutes. Add corn potatoes and tomatoes in alternate layers. Sprinkle with salt sugar and pepper then add water. Cook slowly until potatoes are tender. Remove from heat and stir milk in slowly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add strawberries and stir until thawed. Add bananas and nuts. Pour 1/2 mixture into long dish and put in refrigerator until firm. Combine pineapple and Cool Whip and spread on layer. Top with remaining mixture. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Crumble Blue cheese and mix well with finely grated Cheddar cheese and cream cheese chopped parsley and grated onion. Shape into a ball. Wrap and refrigerate until firm. Reshape ball and roll in dry roasted peanuts or pecans.

title: Best Ever Brownies
instructions: Cream 1 stick of butter and 1 cup of sugar. Add eggs flour chocolate syrup and nuts; mix well. Pour into greased and floured pan and bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes. Top with frosting when cool.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Fry bacon crisp in large skillet. Pour off drippings. Cover bottom of skillet with oil. Saute pepper and onion just until tender. Meanwhile cook rice according to directions. Pour rice over onion and pepper. Add crumbled bacon and soy sauce. Stir slightly to mix. You can add cabbage carrots ham chicken or hamburger meat.

title: Budget Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixer and beat until mixed well approximately 2 minutes. Pour into two 9-inch cake pans that have been greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool before icing with cream cheese frosting.

title: Strawberry Butter
instructions: Cream butter until light and fluffy then gradually add oil beating continuously. Beat in honey strawberries and orange rind (if desired). Store in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to one week. Serve on toast muffins biscuits or other warm homemade breads.

title: Pumpkin Loaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Mix all dry ingredients thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and mix just until blended. Turn batter into pans. Bake about 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Clean in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas until smooth and mush. Mix in order given. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Push batter to side (low in center). Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Crab-Filled Buns
instructions: Combine crab meat olives cheese and onion. Add mixture of mayonnaise and lemon juice; add seasonings. Fill buttered buns with mixture; wrap each in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Jumblet Cookies
instructions: Grind dates with a little flour to keep from sticking; walnuts help too. Fold in egg whites stiffly beaten last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Indian Chicken Curry
instructions: In a large saucepan melt butter and saute onion celery and apples for 5 minutes. Stir in curry and flour. Gradually stir in chicken broth cream of coconut and half and half. Stir over moderate heat until sauce bubbles and thickens. Stir in chicken and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve over rice.

title: Snow Ice Cream
instructions: Whip cream to soft peaks; add sugar. Fold in half and half and vanilla. Add snow and beat. Cover and place in freezer.

title: Greek Roasted Chicken
instructions: Place chicken on a rack in roasting pan. Season with salt and pepper and 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano. Arrange potatoes around chicken; sprinkle with salt pepper and oregano. Pour butter and lemon juice over chicken and potatoes. Add chicken broth to pan bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Baste with juices while baking.

title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine sugar cinnamon allspice and ginger. Add scalded milk slowly to eggs; mix well. Add sugar-spice mixture and butter or margarine; stir until sugar dissolves. Combine bread cubes and raisins in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Pour custard mixture over bread cubes. Place casserole in pan of water. Bake 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Mocha Punch
instructions: Heat 1 cup of the water to boiling; dissolve instant coffee in water. Stir in remaining water dry milk sugar and salt. Refrigerate until chilled 3 to 4 hours. Place softened ice cream in punch bowl. Pour chilled coffee mixture on ice cream. Swirl ice cream throughout coffee mixture. Beat whipping cream in chilled mixing bowl until very soft peaks from. Top chocolate mocha punch with mounds of whipped cream. Sprinkle nutmeg over the mounds of whipped cream.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick butter. Crush 1 package Oreos (save some out). Pour butter over cookies in bowl and mix. Press mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice carton of ice cream and layer over cookie dough. Pour 1 jar caramel ice cream topping over ice cream. Top with Cool Whip and garnish with leftover Oreos.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Layer half of onions and butter in casserole dish. Cover with half of crackers and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Repeat layering. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad No. 1
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and freeze. Serve frozen. Keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Heloise'S Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and milk in a large heavy saucepan. Slowly bring to rolling boil and boil for 8 minutes. Then move the saucepan off the heat and add the butter chocolate chips and marshmallows. Mix only until the chips and the marshmallows are melted. Add the vanilla and nuts and blend. Spread the mixture in a large ungreased pan and let it cool.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Combine aid sugar water and pineapple juice. Just before serving add ginger ale. Pour the entire mixture over ice cream.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt chocolate. Grease and flour 2 large loaf pans. Sift the dry ingredients and set aside. Beat eggs; add sugar oil and chocolate. Stir. Add the sifted dry ingredients and zucchini then add the nuts. Pour into 2 large loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain grease off. Add Manwich and simmer about 15 minutes. While waiting for beef and sauce to simmer make instant mashed potatoes. Add beef mixture into a casserole dish or pan. Add corn on top of beef mixture then add instant potatoes on top of corn then top with grated cheese.

title: Applesauce-Spice Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixer bowl. Blend well then beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 8 x 4 inch loaf pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean and cake begins to pull away from sides of pan. Do not underbake. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan and finish cooling on racks.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Note If you desire to spice it up add 1/4 cup pepper juice.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together and form in bottom and sides of pie pan greased.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 90 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream the sugar shortening salt and nutmeg. Add eggs and ice water; work in flour. Roll out on floured board; cut in desired shape. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. May be sprinkled with sugar while still warm if desired.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium-sized bowl. Pour into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese
instructions: Heat pineapple juice and lime jello. Put pineapple cottage cheese and marshmallows in big bowl. Cool lime jello and pour over pineapple mixture. Add whipped cream. Sets quickly.

title: Nana'S Bean Soup
instructions: Cook beans until mushy. Dice potatoes carrots and onions. Add salt pepper and tomato soup. Add small amount evaporated milk to thicken and cook until vegetables are cooked.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: By hand mix dry ingredients and blend into beer. Pour into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 (350\u00b0 if glass) for 1 hour. Serve warm.

title: Chess Bars
instructions: Melt butter and let cool. Mix with cake mix and 1 egg. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan or Pyrex.

title: Fiesta Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread into serving dish or 9 x 13-inch or larger pizza pan. Top with shredded lettuce grated Cheddar cheese and chopped tomatoes. Chill for at least 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Sparkling Cranberry Apple Punch
instructions: Combine juices and coriander in large pitcher or punch bowl. Just before serving add club soda and stir. Garnish with orange slices and cranberries.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in 2 greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with finely crushed crackers and melted oleo. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese melts and mixture is bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter lightly. Add part of sugar and mix until smooth. Add remaining sugar and beat until smooth and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in flavoring. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream. Bake at 325\u00b0 in greased and floured Bundt or tube pan for 1/2 hour. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and cook 45 to 50 minutes or until cake is done. Cool cake 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Lightly oil a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Stir together sugar oil margarine and eggs. Mix in nuts and vanilla. Stir together flour baking soda and salt; add to sugar mixture. Pour into prepared pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 25 to 35 minutes (until browned and knife comes out clean). Cut into 32 pieces.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook sugar Karo water and salt to 234\u00b0. Add roasted peanuts. Cook to 260\u00b0. Then add butter. Cook to 300\u00b0. Last of all add vanilla and soda. Stir rapidly; pour on tray until cool.

title: Spicy Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Chill and serve with raw vegetables.

title: Moist Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour and baking soda. Cream butter sugars vanilla. Add eggs gradually add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts. Batter will be stiff. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375 degrees for 8-10 minutes. For chocolate lovers use Chocolate flavored instant pudding.

title: German Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cook on medium heat in saucepan until thick. Pour on cake while hot then place in oven broiler until brown 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Potato And Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Cut potatoes in 1/2-inch cubes. Cover with water; heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes until tender. Drain and cool. Slice cabbage. Toss potatoes cabbage and remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown onion in olive oil. Brown and drain hamburger. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Flowerpot Dirt Cake
instructions: You will need an 8 x 10-inch flowerpot.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake 1/2 hour.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix. Put 2 to 3 teaspoons in cup; add hot water.

title: Honey Mustard Dressing(Great Christmas Gift!)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender. Blend until creamy. Refrigerate covered. Will keep for weeks. Yields 2 1/2 cups.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Mix together the mayonnaise and sugar in a small bowl and set aside. Layer the first 6 items in order listed then spread mayonnaise mixture over top sealing edges. Sprinkle cheese and bacon bits over the top. Refrigerate and let sit overnight.

title: Italian Tortellini Soup
instructions: About 45 minutes before serving time in a Dutch oven over medium heat in hot oil cook onion green pepper and garlic until tender about 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and their liquid wine parsley salt basil and oregano. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Increase heat to medium. Add crab and clams; cook for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Add fillet pieces and shrimp. Continue cooking for 5 more minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork and shrimp are tender. Serve immediately in soup bowls. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tortellini And Spinach Tomato Soup
instructions: On top of stove combine soup and consomme; bring to a boil. Add soy sauce. Pour in egg and stir constantly for 2 minutes until egg separates into shreds. Pour and serve.

title: Korean Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken. Mix the night before; let sit out to allow sugar to dissolve. Needs to be at room temperature.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes; cut in slices 3/4-inch thick. Place in baking dish (single layer is best). Mix sugar and flour; spread over potatoes. Heat water and margarine. Add vanilla. Pour over sugar and potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 until potatoes are tender (about 20 to 30 minutes).

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over the baked crust. Top with blueberry pie filling.

title: Lemon-Zucchini Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add 3/4 cup sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add egg and lemon rind beating well. Combine flour baking powder and salt; stir well. Add to creamed mixture mixing well. Stir in zucchini and walnuts. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove to wire racks. Combine confectioners sugar and lemon juice; stir well. Drizzle over warm cookies; let cool completely.

title: Mother'S Lemon Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well but not to the creamy stage. Add sugar; mix well. Add grated rind and juice of lemons. Mix well and last add real cream; mix. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a lightly greased large heavy cast-iron skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Praline Brownies
instructions: Prepare brownie mix according to directions using 1 egg method. Put in pan. Mix other ingredients and sprinkle over top of brownie mix. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Surprise Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and chill. Store in refrigerator.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and pepper in margarine. Cook limas until tender; drain. Add peppers onions and celery soup. Place in a greased casserole dish and cover with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Blend dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until coarse like peas. Make a well in the center. Pour in 1/2 cup of milk; toss or mix. Add egg with rest of milk. Mix lightly with a fork. Roll or pat to 1/2 or 3/4-inch. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Grandma Bella'S Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream the butter cheese and sugar until fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time beating 3 minutes for each egg. Combine dry ingredients and beat in alternately with the milk and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan lined with waxed paper. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Weight Watchers Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy; put bread in blender then add apples. Fold in eggs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hunky Pory Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Roll in balls the size of walnuts. Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons cinnamon and 2 tablespoons sugar. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes.

title: Elephant Ears
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Add salt sugar water shortening and egg. Mix well. Stir in flour 1/2 cup at a time until smooth. Break off pieces the size of an egg. Roll out 1/4 inch thick on floured surface. Deep-fry in shortening. When brown and crisp remove and dust with sugar and cinnamon. Recipe makes 20.

title: Stuffed Sea Shells
instructions: Cook macaroni shells until done. Stuff with mixture of cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese Parmesan eggs spinach salt and pepper. Cover with Prego sauce. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Quick Microwave Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Arrange chicken parts (or 4 breasts) in 12 x 8-inch baking dish bone side down thicker portions toward edges of dish. Top with 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms. Stir 1/2 teaspoon dried basil into 2 cups of pasta sauce (onion and garlic is great) and pour over chicken. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave High for 17 minutes or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease and juices run clear rearranging pieces once. Serve over cooked pasta. Serves 4.

title: Cornflake Chewies
instructions: Mix corn syrup and sugar in saucepan. Bring to a full boil and then add peanut butter. Remove from heat then add vanilla and cornflakes. Stir well and drop by tablespoonful onto greased wax paper.

title: Miracle Pie Crust
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. In a cup mix egg vinegar and water. Add to flour mixture. Makes 5 to 7 crusts. Can be frozen.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bring water to boil. Mix brownie mix water oil and egg in large bowl. Pour into greased and floured 12-inch pizza pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Beat cream cheese sugar remaining egg and vanilla in small bowl at medium speed until well blended. Pour over brownies. Bake for 15 minutes. Cool. Top with fruit; drizzle with chocolate.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind peppers and onions. Pour boiling water over them and let stand 2 hours. Drain and add vinegar salt sugar and mustard seed. Cook until tender. Jar and seal.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pinch and roll mixture into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Beef And Peppers
instructions: Saute beef onion and garlic in oil until meat browns. Add rest of ingredients except rice; bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Cover; let stand 5 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix all together for 2 minutes. Put in two loaf pans or one angel food cake pan. Grease the pans very well and dust with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 to 50 minutes depending on the size of the pans.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Mix dry ingredients; add to egg and sugar mixture. Roll in balls and press with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Cucumber And Green Onion Dip
instructions: Wash and dry cucumber and onions. Chop very fine. For each package of cream cheese you use add cucumber and green onions.

title: Sun-Drop Cake
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and shortening in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add flour and eggs; beat well. Add flavorings; mix well. Stir in Sun-Drop. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Cool in pan for several minutes. Invert onto serving plate. Spread frosting over cake. Yield 16 servings.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Defrost strawberries. Beat eggs in a bowl until fluffy. Add cooking oil sugar and defrosted strawberries. Sift together flour cinnamon soda and salt into mixing bowl. Add strawberry mixture and mix until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done then turn out of pans and cool on racks. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Watergate Jello Salad
instructions: In a large bowl add pineapple (with juice) and pudding; mix well. Add fruit cocktail and marshmallows. Fold in Cool Whip. Put in a pretty glass bowl and top with coconut chopped nuts and cherries.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Chop onion and bell pepper very fine and cook in small amount of water in frying pan (large). Add brown sugar ketchup mustard bacon and beans. Bring mixture to boil. Pour mixture in baking pan and cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix hot rice Cheez Whiz and margarine together until cheese melts. Add rest of ingredients. Put into casserole dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Bermuda Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a jar; shake well. Combine cauliflower onion and olives. Marinate in dressing for 1 hour.

title: Salmon Ball
instructions: Combine all but nuts and parsley. Chill. Shape into ball and roll in nuts and parsley. Chill again.

title: Chick-A-Tini
instructions: In small mixing bowl blend together soup and milk; set aside. Cook rotini according to package instructions. In large mixing bowl combine green peppers onion chicken pimiento cheese and cooked rotini. Pour on soup mixture and mix thoroughly. Pour into 9 x 13 greased casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 7 to 9.

title: Russian Pea Salad
instructions: Thaw peas; add all other ingredients. Chill overnight. Serves 6.

title: Chunky Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes and cook until tender. Drain. Melt butter in 3-quart pot. Add carrot and onion. Cover and cook until tender. Remove from heat. Add flour and milk. Add 1/2 potatoes. Mash remaining. Add to soup with seasonings and bouillon. Heat to steaming hot.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken and cut into bite size pieces. Place in bottom of a 3-quart casserole dish. Combine sour cream and chicken soup; pour over chicken. Crush crackers; put over chicken and sauce. Melt butter; put over crackers. Top with poppy seed until dark; refrigerate for 24 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Bean Soup
instructions: Sort and soak beans with a pinch of baking soda over night. Next day bring to a boil. Rinse and cover with water and add ham or bacon onion salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. Add water as needed during cooking time.

title: Squash Supreme
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Spray a loaf pan or dish with Pam. Sprinkle a layer of Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing on the bottom of the pan. Add squash mixture then cover with another layer of Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing. Dot the top of the casserole generously with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Taco Delight
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet for 5 minutes. Add salsa tomato sauce and bouillon cube; bring to a full boil. Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix well and put into 2 graham cracker pie crusts. Put in refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours before serving. This is rich and delicious.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce(This Is A Mom Original)
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar and salt. Add butter and milk. Bring to a boil over medium to low heat; stir constantly. When sauce thickens remove from heat. Cool 3 to 5 minutes. Serve warm or cold. Use over ice cream cream puffs or eclairs.

title: Cornstarch Pudding
instructions: Put canned milk in a quart jar and fill up with regular milk. Use a double boiler; heat until boiling. Beat eggs and add to milk. Add sugar and cornstarch. Boil until thick then cool. Strain. Add vanilla.

title: Crisp Potato Skins
instructions: Bake potatoes at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tender. Cool then cut into quarters lengthwise. Scoop out pulp leaving 1/8-inch shell. Reserve pulp for use in other recipes. Increase oven temperature to 500\u00b0. Combine butter and soy sauce. Brush on both sides of skins. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp. Top with coarse salt sour cream chives and/or bacon bits. Yield 6 servings.

title: Artichoke Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on the box. Drain; rinse with cold water and put in a large bowl. Add olives artichoke hearts celery dressing and cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Toss together. Cover and let marinate in refrigerator overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cookie Kisses
instructions: Beat the margarine sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour and mix well. Chill the dough. Shape about 1 tablespoon of dough around each chocolate kiss. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. The cookie should be set but not brown. Cool slightly then roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Beef And Biscuit Skillet
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet brown meat with onion; drain off fat. Stir in gravy and 1/2 cup water. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and frozen vegetables breaking apart with fork. Bring to boiling. Cover; reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes. Top with biscuits; simmer covered 15 minutes. Sprinkle biscuits with cheese; heat until cheese melts. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Serves 4.

title: Gooey Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease oblong pan. Mix egg butter and cake mix together. Pat into pan. Pat flat; do not leave raised edges.

title: Southern Stew
instructions: On rack in broiling pan broil steak for 5 minutes on each side; cut into 2- inch pieces and set aside.

title: Whipping Cream Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time and stir until mixed well. Add flour and stir until well blended. Add flavoring. Stir in whipping cream. Bake in a Bundt pan at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Steak Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Strain if desired. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine peas tuna fish corn pimentos and cream of mushroom soup in casserole. Top with shoestring potatoes. Bake.

title: Dedication Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Reserve stock. Debone chicken and cut in bite size pieces. Cook spaghetti in reserved stock; drain to just below top of spaghetti. Saute onion celery and bell pepper in margarine until tender. Add cheese to hot spaghetti; stir until melted. Add all other ingredients together and season with garlic salt. Stir together well. Bake in oblong dish or pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle parsley flakes on top. Serves approximately 12 to 15 people.

title: Mom'S Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Mix baking soda and soup in a bowl; set aside. Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs and soup mix; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients; mix all together. Bake in 9 x 9 or 8 x 9 greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well and form into ball.

title: Star Cookies
instructions: Mix all together and put in icebox overnight. When chilled roll them and cut in star shape. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Goblin Cookies
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together; stir in 1 cup of any dry cereal. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a piece of waxed paper. Put a jelly bean in center of each and refrigerate until firm. Makes 12 cookies.

title: Mushroom Soup
instructions: Mix well. Use more water if needed for thinning. Serve over Swedish meatballs.

title: Cheese Fish Bake
instructions: Arrange fish in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour soup over fish. Sprinkle with pepper cheese and paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Press evenly into ungreased pan first 3 ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Beat cream cheese in 3-quart bowl. Add sugar and cocoa gradually. Beat in eggs one at a time. Pour in vanilla. Pour into spring-form pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 until center is firm about 1 hour. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. Prepare topping. Spread over cake; loosen sides and remove.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Layer the bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan with the pecans and coconut. Pan must be buttered. Mix cake mix as directed on box and pour over pecans and coconut in pan. Mix cream cheese oleo and sugar together and pour over cake mix. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Cheese Puffs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for oil; mix well. Pour about 2 inches of oil into frying pan; get oil hot but not smoking or use Fry Daddy. Drop batter by tablespoons 4 to 5 at a time into hot oil. Fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately. Makes about 24 puffs.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Stir together flour salt spices and baking powder. Add to pumpkin mixture. Spread into greased and floured cookie sheet. Top with nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll towel and cake together. Cool for 1 hour.

title: Merry Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: You will also need artificial holly leaves or other garnish.

title: Green Mountain Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening in bowl. Add sugar molasses and egg. Mix thoroughly. Sift remaining ingredients together. Stir into creamed mixture. Roll into small balls; dip in additional sugar. Place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 (preheated) for 10 minutes. They will still be soft when you take them out. They firm as they cool. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Salad Dressing For Green Vegetables
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Use as a dressing for vegetables.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Add water to heavy skillet and immediately add brown sugar also. Stir continuously over medium heat. Bring mixture to a rapid boil until it reaches the soft ball stage (120\u00b0 to 238\u00b0 on a candy thermometer). Take off heat. Stir in pecans until well coated. Sprinkle cinnamon. Keep stirring until they cool and dry.

title: Prune Spice Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Sift flour baking powder salt and spice then blend into creamed mixture alternately with liquids. Pour prunes into two 8-inch pans that have been greased and floured. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool completely; frost if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Coffeecake
instructions: Cut cream cheese into 20 pieces. Mash biscuits into 3 1/2 inch circle. Place a piece of cream cheese on each biscuit. Mix cinnamon and sugar. Place 1 teaspoon of sugar mixture on each biscuit. Roll biscuits into balls. Melt butter and pour into Bundt pan. Then pour in 1/2 of the nuts into pan. Then pour 3/4 of what sugar mixture you have left into Bundt pan. Then put your 20 biscuit balls into the Bundt pan. Then pour what sugar mixture and nuts you have left over biscuits. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Turn onto plate. Let pan remain a few minutes before removing. Glaze while hot.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in covered casserole at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk and margarine in pot; boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Stir until chips and marshmallows are melted. Pour into a well buttered pan; let cool in refrigerator for 2 hours. Cut into 1 inch squares.

title: Blueberry Trifle With Lemon Curd
instructions: Combine the yolks lemon juice and sugar in the top of a double boiler. Cook over simmering water until sugar is dissolved. Add butter; continue to simmer until mixture thickens. Pour in a clean bowl. Chill.

title: Chocolate Syrup
instructions: Combine cocoa sugar and salt in medium saucepan. Stir in water and mix until smooth. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Cook for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour into container and refrigerate. Use to pour over ice cream or put 2 tablespoons of syrup in an 8-ounce glass of cold or hot milk.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook water sugar and cornstarch until thick and clear about 2 minutes. Add Jell-O (after removed from heat). Pour over sliced berries in baked pie shell.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix in order. Drop by ice cream dipper. Flatten with fork. Bake 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mimaw'S Butterscotch Squares
instructions: In large saucepan melt butter. Remove from heat. Add brown sugar and mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into 8-inch square greased pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheesy Green Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain bacon reserving 1/4 cup drippings. Crumble bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons. Microwave beans as directed on package; drain well. Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in skillet. Cook and stir on medium-high heat 10 minutes; drain. Add bacon hot cooked green beans and pepper; mix lightly. Spoon into 2-quart serving dish. Microwave process cheese spread as directed on label. Pour over green bean mixture. Sprinkle with reserved 2 tablespoons crumbled bacon. Makes 10 servings.

title: Coralie'S Blue Cheese Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and mix until fluffy.

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Cook all ingredients on low heat. Stir constantly to prevent sticking until thickened. Remove from stove. Add lump of butter. Cool; ready for use.

title: Nut Fingers
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and other ingredients in order given. When thoroughly mixed mold and shape into fingers about the size of pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Roll in powdered sugar when cool. Be sure to mix pecans in by hand. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Cucumbers With Sesame Seeds
instructions: Sprinkle salt over cucumbers and let stand about 15 minutes. Squeeze water from slices and combine with remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: Dean'S Perfect Divinity
instructions: Bring to a boil and boil covered 2 minutes. Uncover and cook to a soft ball stage. While cooking beat 2 egg whites until stiff but not dry. Pour the syrup over the beaten egg whites slowly. Beat with electric mixer until thick almost stands in peaks. Quickly add 2 cups pecans and 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla. Drop on wax paper.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift flour baking soda salt baking powder and cinnamon. Combine eggs oil sugar zucchini and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Beat until well mixed. Stir in flour mixture until smooth. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until center springs back. Cool on wire rack.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add banana and egg. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into buttered loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef egg seasonings and bread crumbs with 1/3 can of tomato sauce. Add more sauce and/or breadcrumbs until mixture is moist and well mixed. Place remaining tomato sauce in medium saucepan with sugar and lemon juice. Mix and place over medium-high heat.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Cut butter into dry ingredients. Add egg. Pat into bottom and sides of 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan. Peel core and slice apples (quantity as necessary) and line up in pan.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain off fat. Add pepperoni and pizza sauce. Mix well and simmer 5 minutes. Add cheese just before serving. Spoon onto bun and enjoy.

title: Hot Stuff
instructions: Grind together peppers garlic and onion. Put in crock pan (not aluminum). Add salt and add just enough water to cover. Let set 2 hours and drain. Add oil vinegar and water. Cook 30 minutes. Seal in hot jars. Makes 12 pints.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Melt butter and add chopped onion oregano salt and rice. Stir all the ingredients listed and simmer 10 minutes (can use iron skillet or Teflon). Turn into large casserole and add beef consomme and water. Add drained mushrooms; bake covered at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Stew
instructions: Cook ingredients all together in a pot for 10 minutes. Then pour into a medium pumpkin which has been cleaned out. Replace the top. Put pumpkin in a sturdy baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes until pumpkin turns brown. Remove the top and ladle out the stew.

title: Shrimp Pie
instructions: Saute the shrimp with the butter and seasonings for 1 minute. Add the vermouth and boil for 1/2 minute. Strew shrimp in pie shell. Make custard with eggs and milk or cream. Pour in custard to within 1/8-inch of rim; sprinkle on cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until puffed and browned.

title: Eggs Belmar
instructions: Add flour to 1/4 cup melted butter in saucepan. Stir until smooth; cook 1 minute and gradually add milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add salt and pepper and set aside. Saute bacon and next 3 ingredients in 3 tablespoons butter until vegetables are crisp-tender. Drain. Cook eggs in 1 tablespoon butter without stirring until beginning to set on bottom. Draw spatula across to form large curds. Continue until cooked but moist. Stir in bacon mixture and white sauce. Place in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish (glass). Combine 2 tablespoons butter and bread crumbs to egg mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Make ahead up to 24 hours and refrigerate. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before baking. Leftovers reheat well.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add onion egg and milk; mix well. Drop by spoonful into deep fry; fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Lemon Pie(Old Family Recipe)
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together. Beat egg yolks. Mix all together and cook over boiling water until thick. Put in baked pie shell.

title: Blanche'S Peach (Cake) Cobbler
instructions: Pour peaches and juice into an 11 x 14-inch pan which has been greased. Pour dry cake mix over peaches. Melt margarine and pour over mixture. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugar. Add spices and dry ingredients. Drop by spoonful onto greased baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on rack. Store in refrigerator. Each cookie contains 55 calories.

title: Caramel Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix according to directions on box. Prepare a 13 x 9-inch and a small square pan by greasing pans and sprinkling with powdered sugar. Bake according to box directions. Cool in pans and spread frosting on tops.

title: Banana Split Pudding
instructions: To reserved pineapple liquid add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups. In large bowl combine Eagle Brand milk. Add pudding mix and beat well. Add pineapple. Chill 10 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 1/2 cups pudding into 3 to 4-quart glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of chocolate wafers banana and pudding. Repeat layering twice ending with pudding. Chill thoroughly.

title: Cream Cheese Pastry
instructions: Cream first 4 ingredients together. Butter or Pam spray 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer 1 package rolls filling 1 package rolls and cinnamon-sugar topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Granddad Bill'S T Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 300\u00b0.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder into bowl. Beat eggs with milk; add melted Crisco and whole kernel corn and combine the two mixtures lightly. Drop from a teaspoon into deep Crisco heated to 365\u00b0 (or when an inch cube of bread browns in 60 seconds). Fry until brown and cooked in center (about 4 to 5 minutes). Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Goldline Chili
instructions: If you like it sweet add a Hershey chocolate bar to taste.

title: Grammy'S Brownies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add melted chocolate. Then add flour. Pour into four 8-inch pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats in water with salt for 5 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff. Mix oats egg yolks melted butter honey and raisins. Fold in egg whites. Pour into well-greased 8-inch pan and cook at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until set in the middle and light brown. Recipe may be doubled.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes; skin and slice into pieces. Fry bacon; drain off all fat. Sprinkle flour over bacon; mix it up. Pour vinegar sugar and water over bacon. Simmer until thick. Pour over potatoes; mix well. Serve warm.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all except bacon. Pour into a greased 2 quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Sprinkle top with crumbled bacon. Bake another 5 minutes. Serves 8.

title: One Bowl Holiday Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: Microwave chocolate and milk in 1 1/2-quart microwavable bowl on High 2 minutes stirring after 1 minute. Stir until chocolate is completely melted and smooth. Stir in vanilla salt and nuts. Spread in greased 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Refrigerate until firm about 2 hours. Makes about 2 dozen pieces.

title: Old Fashioned Stickies
instructions: Combine flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Mix well. Add milk. Mix well. Roll out thin. Spread softened margarine over dough. Sprinkle sugar over margarine. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Slice into 1-inch pieces. Place in pan and cook at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Homemade Oreo Ice Cream
instructions: Use only Grade A clean uncracked eggs.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
instructions: Place chicken in a nonstick baking pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover chicken with sauerkraut. Pour dressing evenly over all and top with Swiss cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until fork can be inserted in chicken easily. Sprinkle with chopped parsley to serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage(Rodkaal)
instructions: Melt fat in pan. Add remaining ingredients in layers and cook until very tender. If too dry add water. Garnish with apple slices.

title: Hot Salsa
instructions: Simmer ingredients until vegetables are well cooked. Then can as you would tomatoes.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Saute onion bell pepper and sausage in a large skillet. Add beans and tomato sauce. Cook on low until it thickens for about 45 minutes. Serve with your favorite rice and cornbread cooked according to package directions.

title: Cheese Grits
instructions: Add grits slowly to boiling water and salt. Cook while stirring till thick. Remove from heat add butter and cheese sliced in pieces and stir into grits. Cool slightly and add egg-milk mixture. Pour in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 mins. to 1 hr. till firm.

title: Banana Split Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate milk. Add milk. Pour into 4-quart ice cream freezer bucket and freeze according to manufacturers instructions. Let harden 1 hour before serving. Yields 1 gallon.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well with blender. Pour batter into two greased and lightly floured loaf pans. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. May bake muffins instead. Bake approximately 12 to 15 minutes. Raisins and nuts are optional.

title: Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Heat buttermilk to lukewarm. Add the salt shortening and sugar to the buttermilk. Add the dissolved yeast a cup of the flour with the soda and the egg. Beat vigorously. Beat and fold in the remaining flour until a soft dough. Fold lightly (about 5 minutes). Place in a clean lightly greased bowl. Cover and let rise 45 minutes to 1 hour until double in bulk. Shape into desired rolls. Bake in a 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice; drain. Cook broccoli and drain. Mix together. Add Velveeta cheese and soups. Put in greased casserole dish and top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Wassail
instructions: Mix Burgundy cider and spices to taste. Heat before serving. Float orange slices in wassail.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine eggs celery green pepper pickles and chilled macaroni. Blend mayonnaise buttermilk and mustard. Fold into macaroni mixture. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Chuck Wagon Western Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine meat onion and pepper in skillet and brown; drain off grease. Add other ingredients. Put in a covered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. This is a delicious meal with bread and a salad! So easy!

title: Brittany'S Favorite Pickles
instructions: Peel and thinly slice cucumbers. Slice onion into thin rings. Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight container in refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Stir occasionally.

title: Seafood Etouffee
instructions: Saute butter onion and celery until wilted. Add tomato sauce soup and water. Cook 20 minutes. Add shrimp crab meat and/or scallops. Cook an additional 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Imagination Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and beat to soft peaks. Gradually add sugar and cocoa. Beat to stiff peaks. Make 10 big round cookie \shells\ on a cookie sheet using the egg white mixture. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool. Spread 1 tablespoon Dream Whip on each cookie. Mix rest of Dream Whip with fudge and cream cheese. Spread 2 1/2 tablespoons of chocolate mixture on each cookie. Refrigerate.

title: Nancy'S Chili
instructions: In frying pan cook sausage well and drain off excess fat; set aside. Brown ground beef in frying pan and drain off excess fat; set aside. Brown onions in olive oil in large heavy pot. Add cooked sausage ground beef and remainder of ingredients except green pepper. Stir well and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Add chopped green pepper and simmer 15 minutes longer.

title: Holiday Yam Bake
instructions: Take 1 large ball field half a dozen children 2 or 3 small dogs a pinch of brook and some pebbles. Mix the children and dogs well together; put them on the field stirring constantly. Pour the brook over the pebbles sprinkle the field with flowers spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun. When brown set away to cool in the bath tub.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Saute onion in olive oil. Add hamburg and cook until done. Skim 3/4 of fat from pan. Add tomatoes. Mix together and add to drained macaroni.

title: Hearty Tuna Casserole
instructions: Drain tuna. Cook noodles according to directions. Drain and rinse in hot water. Combine noodles with tuna celery and onions. Blend in sour cream mustard mayonnaise thyme and salt. Spoon half mixture into buttered casserole. Top with half zucchini. Repeat layers. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped tomato.

title: Deep Dish Peach Pie
instructions: Combine peaches lemon juice almond extract sugar and salt. Mix together thoroughly and let stand while rolling pastry.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Spray microwave dish with Pam. Combine all ingredients and stir to mix egg and flour into mixture. Microwave on High for 3 minutes. Remove and stir. Microwave on High again for 3 minutes. Ready to serve.

title: Rice Krispies Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and brown sugar first; then add white sugar and cream together. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add oats and coconut. Fold in Rice Krispies last so as not to break them.

title: Dressing For Fresh Fruit
instructions: Beat all above together at medium speed. Constantly continue beating while gradually adding 1/4 cup salad oil. Cover and chill. If it becomes too thick let stand at room temperature. Use over fresh fruit and walnuts.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler(Mrs. W. A. Broadway)
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of casserole dish. Mix flour sugar and milk. Pour this mixture over margarine in dish and top with peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. You may substitute any fruit you wish to use and also add cinnamon or other spices.

title: Cottage Cheese Dip
instructions: In a large bowl mix garlic salt green onion dip mix Miracle Whip seasoned salt salt pepper and milk. Add cottage cheese. Stir. Let set at least 12 hours. Serve with chips of your choice.

title: Molasses Apple Pan Dowdy
instructions: Pare core and slice apples in wedges into a buttered baking dish 8x13x2. Add water and cook in oven a few minutes until soft. In a saucepan mix molasses sugar cornstarch mace and salt. Boil together thoroughly blended.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Let sausage and cheese get to room temperature. Mix all ingredients well. Make into balls the size of a quarter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Grandmother'S Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and beating until smooth. Pour batter into greased baking dish and put fruit on top. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top. Pour on juice over all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Mix Bisquick with enough milk to form a soft dough. Press dough into pie plate. Slice tomatoes and arrange on dough. Season with salt pepper and garlic salt. Mix mayonnaise and cheese and spread over tomatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain and add fresh water cook slowly with ham bone for 2 hours. Put in onions potatoes celery tomato sauce parsley and seasoning. Cook slowly until vegetables are soft. Remove ham bone. Trim off any meat and cut in small pieces to add to the soup.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Combine 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup powdered sugar. Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Press into a 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into serving pieces. Combine buttermilk and onion. Sift flour with salt pepper paprika and thyme. Melt the butter in a baking pan. Brush each piece of chicken with the buttermilk mixture then sprinkle with the seasoned mix. Place pieces skin down in the baking pan. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn each piece and bake 30 minutes longer or until very tender.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Cook and mash potatoes. Add sour cream salt pepper margarine and milk. Beat until fluffy. Add dill weed or seed chives and broccoli. Place in greased casserole and top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Can be made a day or two ahead and refrigerated.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a deep dish or jar so liquid will cover mushrooms. Chill overnight. Drain and serve.

title: Kahlua Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding sour cream eggs oil and Kahlua until well blended. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Soften margarine. Add all other ingredients and let the dough sit in the freezer for about 30 minutes. Pinch off pieces of dough and dip into flour. Roll into a ball with hands and flatten out on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until edges start turning brown.

title: Chicken Dijon
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cream and allow to marinate for 1 to 2 hours. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake basting occasionally about 30 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove baking dish from the oven and place chicken on a warm platter. Skim off fat from the cooking juices and set the baking dish over medium heat. Add cream. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Spoon sauce over chicken and serve. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bleu Cheese Dressing
instructions: Combine sour cream dry mustard black pepper salt garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce. Mix at low speed for 2 minutes. Add mayonnaise and blend 1/2 minute at low speed then 2 minutes at medium speed. Add crumbled Bleu cheese and beat at low speed for 3 minutes. Store in refrigerator for 24 hours before using.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Mix pulp eggs and sugar together; alternate milk and dry ingredients. Pour melted margarine from pan into mixture. Mix well. Pour mixture into pan. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar oil and flour; add cinnamon and vanilla. Mix apples and nuts; stir until mixed. Pour into a greased tube pan and bake 50 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Three Fruit Punch
instructions: Blend 3 fruits in blender. Add ginger ale right before serving.

title: Fresh Peach Chiffon Pie
instructions: Add sugar to peaches; let stand 30 minutes. Soften gelatin in cold water dissolve in hot water and cool. Add peach mixture lemon juice and salt. Chill until partially set. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into pie shell (graham cracker); chill thoroughly.

title: Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in hot water. Add pineapple juice orange juice lemonade and blended bananas. Freeze mixture in 3 large containers. Take out of freezer 2 hours before serving. For each container of punch mixture add 1 cold bottle ginger ale or lemon-lime soda serve while slushy.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine and beat well with rotary beater.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Add corn to well beaten eggs. Add melted margarine and remainder of ingredients; mix thoroughly and pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven until firm and brown about 35 minutes.

title: Beriox
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet or Dutch oven. Chop onion and brown. Add salt pepper and spice. Then add chopped cabbage and flour. Stir about 2 minutes

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all together. This is really good with turkey or ham.

title: Apricot Casserole
instructions: Place apricots in baking dish cut sides up. Crumble crackers over top. Sprinkle with sugars and drizzle butter over all. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Delight
instructions: Blend sugar flour soda salt and spices. Add oil and eggs. Stir in nuts and apple pie filling. Blend by hand. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in a Bundt pan.

title: Bill'S Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend together. For more cheese taste add more cheese. Serve with fruit.

title: Easy Oven Roast
instructions: Place roast on heavy-duty aluminum foil; brush with steak sauce and sprinkle with onion soup mix. Spoon mushroom soup on top. Wrap loosely with foil. Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients. Let congeal.

title: Quick Pinwheel Coffee Cake
instructions: Separate rolls and spread each with butter. Sprinkle mixture of sugar and cinnamon on rolls. Roll up as directed on can. Arrange in a circle on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Arrange remaining rolls on top. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. (Cover tips with foil so as to brown evenly.) Spoon jelly preserves or relish in center of rolls letting some run between rolls. Combine confectioners sugar and milk; drizzle mixture over the rolls. Serve warm.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in a large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Vanilla Rice Pudding
instructions: Gradually stir milk and egg into pudding mix in saucepan. Add rice and raisins. Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Place plastic wrap on surface while cooling.

title: Texas Cheese Dip
instructions: Cook hamburger meat until brown. Drain well and set aside. Saute onion in butter. Dice cheese and add to mixture. Add rotel hamburger meat and jal. Mix well and serve.

title: Miniature Hot Reuben Sandwiches
instructions: Cut the corned beef and cheese into pieces to fit on the bread. Lightly butter 1 slice of bread; top with 2 slices of corned beef 1 slice cheese 1 teaspoon sauerkraut and 1/4 teaspoon mustard. Top with another slice of bread and bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Makes about 18 sandwiches.

title: Boiled Shrimp
instructions: Wash shrimp; place in boiling salt water. Cover and return to a boil. Simmer 3 minutes and drain. Peel shrimp removing veins. Refrigerate and serve with cocktail sauce as an appetizer or use in any recipe that calls for cooked shrimp. Yields 1 1/2 pounds or about 4 cups cooked.

title: Diabetic Salad Dressing(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Mix low-fat yogurt and lemon juice or relish together. Add Equal to taste; mix well.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix shortening 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs. Blend in flour tartar soda and salt. Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon. Place on ungreased baking sheet.

title: Grilled Garlic Toast Bruschetta
instructions: Slice baguette in 1/4-inch slices. Combine all ingredients mixing well. Using a flat knife spread mixture thickly on slice baguette. Arrange on waxed paper covered tray (no spacing necessary; close together is fine). Place in a 400\u00b0 preheated oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Allow to cool on the tray then transfer to a plate. These are great the day before needed or the day you intent to serve them. If made the day before a double batch may be necessary. Family and friends may want to sample them before you make it to the table! Check after 5 minutes. Cooking times may vary depending upon your oven.

title: Sausage Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage; drain off fat. Combine sausage with remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Place in pan of hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Sour Cream Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Chill overnight. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Sunshine Bars
instructions: Combine sugar oil and sweet potatoes. Add eggs water and vanilla; blend. Sift dry ingredients and add mix only until blended. Do not overmix. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and ice with powdered sugar.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix together. Adjust mixture to your taste. To use add 2 teaspoons of mixture to 6 ounces hot water.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef add next 6 ingredients. Simmer uncovered until thick 30 to 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook noodles drain and rinse in hot water. Combine cottage cheese mixture (cottage cheese parsley flakes Parmesan cheese beaten eggs and salt and pepper). Place half noodles in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spread half of cottage cheese mixture over noodles. Add half Mozzarella cheese and then half of the meat mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Add yeast to 1 cup warm water; combine and refrigerate 3 to 5 days (covered jar).

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Sprinkle sliced bananas with lemon juice to prevent them from turning black. Combine oranges and mix walnuts coconut and cherries; add sugar and mix gently. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir eggs corn syrup sugar butter and vanilla until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour into pie crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool.

title: Chicken Yakitori(Skewered Grilled Chicken)
instructions: You will need 20 to 30 fine metal or bamboo skewers about 5-inches long.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix potato chips and cheese in bowl. Combine half the cheese mixture with next 9 ingredients mixing well. Spoon into shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Arrange egg slices on top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese mixture. Chill for several hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until heated through. Makes 8 to 9 servings.

title: Aunt Sylvia'S Mustard Sauce
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together except butter. Heat butter and add mixture to pan. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes until thick. You can not substitute margarine as it will separate later. This sauce is great for any meats. If you want a good mustard barbecue sauce add 1 to 2 tablespoons of Matouks hot sauce after it cools down and mix in.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Layer pineapple in a 2-quart casserole dish. Mix together the sugar and flour. Sprinkle on top of the pineapple. Layer the cheese and Ritz crackers. Top with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil. Add strawberries and pecans. Mix in lightly; do not beat. Spoon batter into loaf pans. Makes 3 medium loaves or 5 small ones. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Meat Casserole
instructions: Mix the onion celery green pepper and meat with mayonnaise. Beat eggs and milk together. Arrange bread in bottom of pan. Top with meat mixture and rest of bread. Let stand all night. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove. Top with 1 1/2 cups cheese and 1 can cream of mushroom soup. Bake 1/2 hour.

title: Frosties(Rum Balls)
instructions: Melt the chocolate chips. Combine the melted chips corn syrup coffee and rum flavoring. Add the wafers nuts and 6 cups of powdered sugar to the chocolate mixture. Form into balls. Roll into remaining powdered sugar. Refrigerate.

title: Hungarian Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle chops lightly with salt and pepper; flour on both sides. Brown in a heavy skillet; then arrange a layer of kraut then a layer of potatoes with a layer of kraut on top. Sprinkle with paprika and brown sugar. Pour tomatoes over top. Cover and cook slowly on top of stove for 40 to 45 minutes or until chops are very tender.

title: Lemon Ice Cream
instructions: Mix lemon juice sugar and milnot together and fill freezer can with milk. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Stir all ingredients together chill; serve.

title: Marinated Shrimp Kabobs
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp; set aside. Drain pineapple chunks reserving 1/4 cup juice. Set pineapple aside.

title: Raisin Tarts
instructions: Cover raisins with water. Bring to a boil; drain. Stir in egg brown sugar and salt. Mixture is ready to put into unbaked tart shells. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes (small tarts bake 10 minutes).

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix with eggs. Add oil milk and flour then add pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in a greased and floured sheet pan. Pour pineapple juice over cake while still hot.

title: Pecan Puffs
instructions: Whip together pecans cheese steak sauce bacon and mayonnaise until thoroughly blended. Spread on crackers. Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat until lightly puffed. Serve hot.

title: Pea-Peanut Salad
instructions: Cook peas according to directions. Cool. Measure and add equal amount of peanuts. Mix thoroughly with sour cream and salad dressing. Chill before serving.

title: Shrimp Rangoon
instructions: Combine shrimp cream cheese garlic powder and steak sauce. Put 1/2 teaspoon of mixture in center of each wrapper. Roll as directed on package. Deep fry until delicately browned. Serve with sweet-sour sauce.

title: Sourdough Pancakes
instructions: *This is the sourdough starter.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Cream sugars butter or margarine and peanut butter. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Sift together flour soda and salt; stir into mixture. Shape into balls; roll in additional sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; bake in 375 degree oven for 10-12 min. Immediately press a chocolate candy into each cookie. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Taco Soup With Black Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chips shredded cheese and sour cream in slow cooker. Cover. Cook on low 4 - 6 hours or serve as soon as thoroughly heated. Garnish individual servings with chips cheese and sour cream.

title: Waffles
instructions: Add ingredients in order saving egg whites to be added last.

title: Good Corn
instructions: Slowly heat all ingredients until the cheese melts and it is hot.

title: Appetizer Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine Ranch salad dressing mix with dill weed and oil. Pour over crackers; stir to coat. Place in warm oven (250\u00b0) for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir gently halfway through baking. Serves 6.

title: Easy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli according to package and drain. Add cheese and 2 tablespoons margarine. Stir until melted. Add remaining margarine. Pour into casserole. Bake for 25 minutes. Top with cracker crumbs and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Crunchy Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; blend well. Chill. Serve on lettuce cups or use for sandwiches.

title: Sugar-Free No-Fat Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine and mix well all ingredients. Store in a covered container in the refrigerator. Will keep 2 weeks.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onions and celery. Drain and pour into a mixing bowl. Add soup and mushrooms; mix well. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch oblong baking pan. Add Tater Tots to the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Frosting
instructions: Cream margarine. Blend in part of sugar. Add peanut butter. Cream well. Alternate remaining sugar and milk. Beat until of spreading consistency. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Olive Cheese Ball(Makes 3 Cups)
instructions: Blend cheese and butter or oleo. Stir in olives and chives. Chill slightly for easier shaping. Form into ball on serving dish after rolling in or patting on chopped nuts. May be trimmed with parsley. Serve with crackers.

title: Granny'S Homemade Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix nuts cracker crumbs and raisins together in a bowl. Heat milk with marshmallows until melted stirring constantly. Pour mix over crumbs. Pour in square pan and cover with foil. Freeze 4 to 6 hours.

title: Fresh Fruit Bowl
instructions: Over a bowl peel and section oranges reserving juice. Combine reserved juice sugar or honey lemon or lime peel lemon or lime juice and ginger cinnamon or nutmeg. In a large serving bowl place all the fruit except berries. Drizzle juice mixture over fruit. Cover; chill 2 to 24 hours.

title: Icebox Cookies
