instructions: Sift the sugar and cream it and butter together; beat eggs and add to creamed mixture. Sift all other ingredients together and add to first mixture. Knead with hands when mixture becomes too stiff for a spoon. Chill well and slice. Bake in moderate oven.

title: Sunday Glazed Carrots
instructions: Steam carrots. Combine brown sugar and butter. Heat. Mix water and cornstarch until smooth. Heat until thickened. Stir into carrot mixture. Stir nuts into carrot mixture.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars together. Add egg and vanilla and mix well. Put in the sifted flour soda and salt. Mix well and add 1 package of chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Beat together eggs and juice add to dry mixture and cook in double boiler until thick. Stir constantly. Cool.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop up cranberries. Put 1 cup sugar over them and let sit overnight. Next day add marshmallows pineapple and nuts. Fold in whipped cream when ready to serve.

title: Fluff 'N Chip Treats
instructions: In small bowl stir marshmallow cream and peanut butter just until mixture is striped. Spread 1 tablespoon onto each cracker. Dip tops into mini morsels. Makes 20 treats.

title: Savory Potatoes
instructions: Cover all ingredients in saucepan with barely enough water to cover top of vegetables. Cook 15 minutes until tender. Do not add more water but watch to prevent scorching. When tender mash with fork only. Add milk to make consistency that you like.

title: Oven Chicken
instructions: Put together in bag and mix. Shake. Chicken should be coated. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: In a saucepan combine sugar flour and salt. Stir in milk and mix well. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir a small amount into egg yolks. Return all to saucepan. Cook for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Cool slightly. Slice the bananas into pastry shell. Pour filling over. Cool. Before serving garnish with whipped cream and bananas. Refrigerate any leftovers. Yield 6 to 8.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Put in kettle browned hamburger meat (drained). Add onion beans and chili powder. Bring to boil. Add tomato juice. Add more if you need to. Add salt to taste and dash of pepper. Serve.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat egg yolks well. Add sugar and Eagle Brand milk Milnot condensed milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add egg yolks and egg whites and mix well. Dont use chocolate syrup in mixture! It wont freeze.

title: Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Then pour over 1-quart chicken broth. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Half fill a tall glass with cranberry juice. Add a big scoop of vanilla ice cream and enough ginger ale to float the ice cream. This is a very good drink to serve at Christmastime.

title: Kidney Bean Soup
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp and crumble. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings. In a 2-quart casserole dish put bacon drippings diced onion and crushed garlic. Cook in a microwave oven covered for about 3 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water and rest of ingredients including liquid from beans. Mix until well blended. Cook covered for 10 to 12 minutes. Place 1/2 soup in a blender for 10 seconds and return to casserole dish. Repeat with other half of soup. If soup is too thick add water to make it the desired consistency. Cook for another 3 minutes in microwave. Just before serving stir in reserved bacon.

title: Marinated Roast Cookout
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour over roast in glass dish. Let marinate for 6 to 8 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator plus two hours at room temperature. Cook to desired doneness on outdoor grill 1-1/2 hours for rare 2 hours for medium or 2 -1/2 hours for well done. Serves 8-12.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Put all in blender and mix. Pour into a small greased casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until firm.

title: Yellow Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together except cinnamon. Pour 1/2 batter into Bundt pan. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon over batter then pour rest of batter in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Marsha'S Chicken
instructions: Layer chicken and broccoli in 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice cheese; spread over chicken and broccoli. Spread dressing over cheese; top with soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stoecker'S Drum Rolls
instructions: Combine 3 cups flour and yeast. Heat milk sugar shortening and salt until warm (115\u00b0 to 120\u00b0). Stir constantly until shortening almost melts. Add this to dry mixture. Add eggs. Beat at low speed with electric mixer for 1/2 minute scraping bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. Stir in by hand the remaining flour to make soft dough. Shape into ball; place in lightly greased bowl. Turn once to grease surface. Cover; let rest in a warm place until it doubles (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Punch down; turn out on floured surface. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Shape into desired rolls. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled (30 to 45 minutes). Bake on greased muffin pans in a 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cornish Hen Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0 (to sear juices). Meanwhile lay hens in pan. Salt and pepper each hen; rub in good. After oven is hot put hens in oven for 30 minutes or until crispy golden brown. Meanwhile on stovetop saute onions and celery in butter. Put can of cream of chicken and 1 can of water; heat until creamy and set aside until 30 minutes are up then pour mixture over hens and cook for about another 20 minutes or until hens are done. Serve over rice (can substitute chicken if you dont have Cornish hens).

title: Poached Fish With Sauce
instructions: Bring water to boil. Place fish in water; bring to boil again. Turn burner off cover pot and let fish stand for 15 to 20 minutes (1 pound=15 minutes 2 pounds=20 minutes). Toothpick goes through fish easily if done. Remove fish from water and place in platter. Garnish with finely chopped ginger green onions and Chinese parsley. To prepare sauce saute oils and garlic. Add shoyu oyster sauce and mirin. Bring to a boil and pour over fish.

title: Braised Chuck Beef Pot Roast
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of meat with garlic salt. Place in 3-quart (13 x 9-inch) glass baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on Simmer for 45 minutes. Turn meat over; re-cover and continue cooking on Simmer for 40 to 45 minutes or until fork-tender. Remove meat and slice meat approximately 1/4-inch thick. Dissolve onion soup mix in hot meat juices; place sliced meat in seasoned meat juice (add sliced onions on top of beef if desired). Cover with plastic wrap or glass cover. Microwave on Reheat for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through. Let stand covered 5 minutes before serving. Serves about 8.

title: Rosy Pickled Eggs
instructions: In a large bowl or jar combine water beet liquid and vinegar. Add sugar pickling spice salt garlic and bay leaf; mix well. Add eggs and onions; cover and refrigerate several days before serving.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine 2/3 chipped beef with cream cheese green onions Worcestershire and milk. Mix well and roll into a ball and then in remaining beef. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Stir in butter grated cheese and eggs. Form mixture into a crust in buttered 10-inch pie plate (or use 8 x 8-inch square pan). Spread cottage cheese over bottom of spaghetti crust. Brown beef; add onion and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender and meat is browned. Drain off excess fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes tomato paste sugar oregano and garlic powder. Heat through. Turn meat mixture into spaghetti crust. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. Sprinkle on Mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese melts.

title: Spicy Salt Substitute
instructions: Mix the ingredients together very well and put in an airtight container. Store in a cool dry place away from the stove.

title: Creamed Asparagus
instructions: Cook asparagus until tender (steam). Add milk flour and water; cook until thick. Add asparagus and diced hard-boiled eggs.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
instructions: You will need 12 cupcake papers.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Let set overnight in Frigidaire.

title: Apricot Brandy Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine until light. Add the sugar in thirds. Cream again until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Beat for another 3 minutes after the last egg is added. Sift flour salt and soda together. Combine the sour cream and extracts. Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately to the batter. Blend well. Fold in apricot brandy. Bake in a well-greased and floured Bundt or tube cake pan at 375\u00b0 for 70 minutes or until done.

title: Sugar-Free Doughnuts
instructions: Cream shortening and margarine in bowl. Add mashed potatoes potato water sweetener and egg; beat well. Sprinkle with yeast. Stir in gently. Let stand for 1 1/2 hours in warm place. Stir in flour gradually. Knead on floured surface until smooth. Let rise covered in warm place 5 to 6 hours or doubled in bulk. Roll out on floured surface 1/2-inch thick. Cut to desired size. Place on floured towel. Let rise in warm place 1 1/2 to 2 inches or until doubled in bulk. Deep fry in 375\u00b0 oil until light brown. Drain on paper towels. Yields 50 doughnuts.

title: Runzas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Wash the rice about 3 times in cold water. Put the milk in the pan; add rice and cook long and slow (about 30 minutes). Mix eggs sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Add to rice and milk very slowly mixing the milk mixture as you pour in the egg mixture. Bring to a boil again. Sprinkle with cinnamon and refrigerate.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Blend together oleo and cream cheese; add sugar blend until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time blending well. Add vanilla. Blend in flour and salt. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool and dust with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Tortellini Alla Checca
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package. In large saute pan heat olive oil. Add tomatoes garlic lemon juice and basil. Saute gently for 5 minutes. Add cooked tortellini butter Parmesan cheese salt and pepper. Gently toss. Serve.

title: Island Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve on Hawaiian Lavash crackers or serve over grilled chicken. Can be made 3 hours ahead.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package (do not add salt). When finished cooking add remaining ingredients. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Makes 7 cups.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Stir together soup sour cream hash browns 1 bag of cheese melted margarine and hot sauce (if desired). Put in a 9 x 13-inch (or equal quantity) pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until lightly browned on bottom and sides. Add more cheese on top for the last few minutes of baking time and bake till bubbly.

title: Pumpkin Sheet Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat pumpkin sugar and oil. Add eggs; mix well. Combine flour baking soda cinnamon and salt; add to pumpkin mixture and beat until well blended. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool.

title: Coconut Caramel Pie
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet; add coconut and chopped pecans. Cook until golden brown stirring frequently. Set the mixture aside. Combine cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk; beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Layer 1/2 of cream cheese mixture in each shell. Drizzle 1/4 of chocolate fudge topping on each pie. Sprinkle 1/4 of coconut mixture evenly over each pie repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Cover and freeze until firm.

title: Hamburger Skillet Dish
instructions: Brown rice in shortening in heavy skillet stirring frequently. Add ground round onion and celery; brown well. Add tomatoes and other ingredients. Cover and simmer until rice is tender about 45 minutes.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Mix apples and sugar. Let stand 10 minutes. Sift flour salt soda and cinnamon together; set aside. Beat the egg; add oil and blend into apple mixture then add flour all at once. Beat with wooden spoon until blended. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch well-greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Mix confectioners sugar and milk and drizzle over squares.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut chicken wings in half. Discard the tip. In a bowl mix orange juice soy sauce and minced garlic. Add the chicken wings to the mixture and marinate at least one hour. It is better to do this the day before and marinate overnight. Place chicken wings on a cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 45 minutes or until very brown. Let cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Brownies
instructions: Have ingredients at room temperature. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix at medium speed for 2 minutes. Spoon into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 22 minutes or until it tests done. Cool and frost if desired. Recipe can be doubled for a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Cut margarine into flour and powdered sugar until crumbly. Pack into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: In saucepan melt oleo or margarine. Add water and cocoa. Add flour sugar salt and soda. Then add eggs vanilla and sour cream. Bake in a greased and floured 11 x 17-inch sheet pan for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Oven French Fries(Dietetic)
instructions: Slice potatoes in half and then slice each half into 8 thick crescent-shaped pieces. Chill sliced potatoes 10 minutes (or longer) in ice cold water to crisp them. Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Drain potatoes well. Toss lightly with oil. Spray a baking pan with Pam. Arrange the slices in a single layer. Bake 25 minutes turning occasionally. Season and serve. Makes 4 (75 calorie) servings.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until done. Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Pizza Sauce
instructions: Simmer for 1 hour. Seal in pint jars.

title: Green Chile(Soup Or Smothering For Burritos, Chile Rellenos Or Enchiladas)
instructions: Heat oil in large stockpot. Add pork onion garlic salt and pepper. Saute until pork is browned. Drain juice from tomatoes into stockpot. Chop tomatoes and add to pork with chiles and 2 cups water. Stir well and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Whisk together flour and 1/3 cup water until smooth. Add to chile mixture and stir constantly until well blended and slightly thickened. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with warm tortillas. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quick Lime Pie
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients together in blender or food processor. Pour into large bowl and fold in Cool Whip. Add food coloring at this time. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Clean vegetables with a vegetable brush. It takes less time and they come out cleaner.

title: Meat Pie - Good For Holidays
instructions: Simmer first 7 ingredients together until done. Place in crusts. Cover with lattice work crust or rolled top crust and be creative with designs on top. Bake 1 hour at 450\u00b0. Makes 4 pies.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Wash and cut up chicken. Boil chicken in large pot with plenty of water. Add onion pepper salt and butter. After chicken is done use broth and pour over corn bread. Put all other ingredients with corn bread and mix well. Debone chicken and put pieces in with dressing. Pour mixture in a greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Southern Spoonbread
instructions: Pour boiling water over meal. Let stand until cool. Add sugar salt and beaten egg. Dissolve soda into buttermilk and add to batter; mix well. Add melted shortening; pour in greased deep dish or skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hop'N John And Rice
instructions: Boil beans and thyme in 2 quarts of water until peas are tender. Dry onions and bacon until brown. Add to peas; add rice. Season with salt and pepper. Cover tightly over low heat about 3/4 hour.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill in refrigerator for a couple of hours.

title: Cherry Torte
instructions: Combine ingredients in order given except use only 1/2 can cherries. Lastly fold in last 1/2 of cherries. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Cream shortening sugar and salt. Add boiling water and cool to lukewarm. Add well beaten eggs yeast mixture and flour; mix well. Place in refrigerator at least 2 hours (overnight is best). Make into rolls. Let rise 2 hours in warm place. Bake for 15 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and cornstarch in saucepan. Add butter milk eggs and vanilla; mix well. Pour into regular pie shell (not deep dish) and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Lynn'S Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and brown sugar. Add beaten eggs. Mix together flour soda and baking powder. Add with coconut flakes and oatmeal to mixture. Add nuts (optional).

title: Toasted Mixed Nuts
instructions: Place pecans cashews and almonds in 1 1/2-quart micro-proof casserole. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Cut butter into 8 pieces and arrange evenly on top of nuts. Cook uncovered on High for 5 to 6 minutes stirring once or twice during cooking.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine rice milk sugar and salt; cook until creamy (15 to 20 minutes). Blend milk and egg and stir into rice mixture. Add raisins and cook 2 minutes. Add butter and vanilla; sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon (optional).

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Cook chicken in 8 cups water 30 to 40 minutes. Set aside; cool and debone. Add tomatoes bell pepper onion and cilantro to chicken broth. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 20 to 30 minutes then cool to room temperature. Remove tomatoes bell pepper onion and cilantro from liquid and puree. Return pureed mixture and broth to heat. Bring to boil; reduce heat to simmer and add cooked rice deboned chicken cumin salt and pepper; serve hot. Garnish with tortilla strips and guacamole.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Pick over beans; wash. Cover with 3 cups water and 1 tablespoon baking soda. Soak overnight or 8 hours; then add 2 cups water mustard and next 6 ingredients. Cover and boil 20 minutes. Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Cut salt pork into small pieces and place in a bean pot or casserole dish. Cover with hot beans and their liquid. Sprinkle pepper on top. Cover and bake in a slow 250\u00b0 oven or until tender. Add 3/4 water when 2/3 done if necessary.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook sugar and water. Add cranberries. Simmer for 10 minutes. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water then add cranberry mixture and pineapple and chill slightly. Fold in celery and nuts. Put in 5-cup mold or 9 x 9-inch square dish.

title: Pineapple Orange Salad
instructions: Mix jello according to directions. Add pineapple and oranges (drain both). Chill until set. Top with whipped cream. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Cheezy Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Mix baking mix milk and cheese until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls on ungreased sheet. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Mix butter and garlic powder together. Brush over warm biscuits before serving. Makes 10 to 12.

title: Wisconsin Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan melt butter over medium-high heat. Saute celery and onion until tender. Add potatoes and broth. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender. In batches puree potato mixture in a blender or food processor. Return to saucepan. Stir in milk and seasonings. Add the cheese and heat only until melted. Garnish with croutons and parsley. Makes 8 servings.

title: Gingerbread Man
instructions: Thoroughly cream together butter or margarine and sugar. Add egg; beat until light and fluffy. Add orange peel and corn syrup; mix well. Sift together remaining ingredients; stir into creamed mixture. Chill dough thoroughly. On lightly floured surface roll to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with gingerbread man cookie cutter. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool 1 minute; remove from pan. Cool on rack. Decorate gingerbread men with decorating icing and raisins if desired. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Stir boiling water rolled oats molasses salt and butter together.\tLet cool. Dissolve yeast with 1/4 cup warm water; stir in oatmeal mixture. Add 2 cups of flour; beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Mix in rest of flour. Cover and let rise about 4 hours. With wooden spoon beat batter about 75 strokes. Put in two greased bread pans.\tLet rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown meat; mix other ingredients together. Boil 15 minutes. Remove from fire and add 1 1/2 cups corn meal slowly stirring. Salt to taste; pour in long casserole dish. Bake 1 hour in a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Company Chicken Hot Dish
instructions: Dust chicken with flour salt pepper and paprika. Brown in butter. Grease pan with butter large enough to lay chicken in single layer. Put celery on bottom of pan then browned chicken. Mix soup cream onions pimentos and cheese. Pour on top of chicken. Sprinkle bread crumbs almonds and a little grated cheese on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until chicken is done. Serve with rice.

title: Teriyaki Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into burgers and fry or grill.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine the broccoli bacon walnuts (if desired) onion salt and pepper to taste. Blend the mayonnaise sugar and wine vinegar. Pour over the broccoli mixture. Stir until all pieces are coated.

title: Special K Candy
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan. Cook until sugar is dissolved. Add peanut butter; continue cooking until it melts. Add this to cereal. Mix in large bowl until cereal is coated. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let set until firm.

title: Cream Puffs(Yield:  6 Medium Puffs)
instructions: In saucepan melt butter in boiling water. Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously. Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesnt separate. Remove from heat; cool slightly and add eggs one at a time beating with a spoon after each addition until smooth. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven; cut off tops. Turn oven off; return cream puffs to oven to dry 20 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Hot (Soup)
instructions: Slice a large onion and boil until tender in chicken broth; strain and throw away onion. Return to heat. Add one (more if needed) can of pureed tomatoes. Stir. To add a little color and taste season with some black pepper and ground cayenne. Simmer. Pour into cup over a slice of lemon. Strips of corn tortillas dropped in are good.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Marinate cabbage carrots sugar and milk in refrigerator overnight. Drain well. Mix cabbage with mayonnaise buttermilk or sour cream Tabasco onion and celery seed. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Serves 4.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream (1923)(Over 50 Years Old)
instructions: Scald the fresh milk in a double boiler. Mix the 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt. Sift. Moisten with the 3 tablespoons cold milk. Add 1 cup of the scalded milk and mix then add to remaining hot milk. Cook 30 minutes.

title: Pasta With Primavera Sauce
instructions: In a large skillet saute broccoli zucchini red pepper and snow peas in butter until crisp-tender. Add half and half and black pepper. Cook briefly until slightly reduced. Serve over pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Pot Pie
instructions: Mix roast beef and soup in pie pan placing pie crust on top. Bake until golden brown.

title: Honey Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix the milk honey blueberries baking powder egg and shortening. Combine flour and salt; add to the first ingredients. Stir just to moisten. Fill greased muffin pans 1/2 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

title: Microwave Zucchini Bake
instructions: Slice squash in half. Sprinkle with salt pepper and oleo. Cook in microwave until tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Return to microwave and cook until cheese is hot.

title: Rhubarb Kuchen
instructions: Mix and put into a greased and floured 8 x 12 pan. Pat on bottom of pan.

title: Chocolate Nut Caramel Bars(Snicker Bars)
instructions: In microwave on High melt chocolate morsels and shortening together. Stir until mixture is smooth. Pour 1/2 of the melted chocolate into an 8-inch foil lined square pan. Spread evenly. Refrigerate until firm (about 15 minutes).

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: In a large pot boil chicken until tender. Remove from broth and reserve broth. Debone chicken and put aside. To the broth add onion celery green pepper and oregano. Salt and pepper generously. Then add vermicelli. Stir constantly until vermicelli is done. Add deboned chicken.

title: Veal Paprika
instructions: Mix salt pepper and flour. Roll individual servings of veal cutlets in seasoned flour. Brown in hot oil in skillet rubbed with garlic. Add 1 cup hot water; cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Arrange meat on hot platter. Into gravy left in pan stir 1 cup cream. Heat and pour over noodles. Sprinkle with paprika. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Note Omit baking powder and salt if you use self-rising flour.

title: White Icing
instructions: Cook sugar and water to soft-ball stage. Beat egg whites until stiff. Pour 1/2 sugar mixture over egg whites beating constantly. Place remaining syrup back on heat. Bring to boil then pour syrup over egg whites. Add cut up marshmallows to icing and beat until consistency to spread on cake.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Drain. Combine soup eggs mayonnaise and cheese. Mix well. Add broccoli. Pour into buttered casserole and bake in 350\u00b0 until set. Remove from oven. Cover with chips and bake until light brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Skillet Dinner
instructions: Drain beans saving liquid (there should be 1 cup liquid). Mix together meat milk rolled oats and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Shape mixture into 16 balls and roll in flour. Melt shortening in a skillet and brown meatballs on all sides. Reduce heat and add onion; cook slowly until onion is lightly browned about 5 minutes. Add liquid and remaining ingredients except the beans. Cover and cook slowly for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add drained beans; cover and heat thoroughly.

title: Frosted Toffee Bars
instructions: In medium bowl combine oats sugar and margarine; mix well. Spread in greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 13 minutes or until light golden brown; cool. In small heavy saucepan over low heat melt chips. Spread over oat mixture; sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate until chocolate is set. Cut into bars and store in tightly covered container in refrigerator. Makes 2 dozen bars.

title: Asian Beef Noodles
instructions: Cook beef with oil to desired tenderness. Break noodles into 4 sections and cook (save beef seasoning/flavoring packet). Combine cooked noodles steak sauce carrot onion and beef seasoning/flavoring packet. Cook until heated throughout. Add beef. Sprinkle with peanuts. Yield 4 servings.

title: Marinade A La Greque
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large dish. Marinate beef chicken or lamb. You may also use firm fleshed fish steaks.

title: Punch
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup of boiling water. Then add remaining ingredients in punch bowl.

title: Banana Yellow Cake
instructions: Make batter as directed except stir 1/8 teaspoon soda into mix before adding liquid. Use only 3/4 cup water and add 1 cup mashed bananas (2 to 3 medium). If desired fold 1/3 cup finely chopped nuts into batter. Pour into prepared oblong or layer pans. Bake. If desired fill and frost with sweetened whipped cream and sliced bananas.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Hard boil eggs let cool and peel. Cut eggs in half lengthwise and remove yolk. Mix yolk Miracle Whip and olive juice with salt together until smooth. Place egg yolk back into eggs and garnish with one slice of green olives. Chill and enjoy.

title: Aliene'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients until light and creamy. Stir together dry ingredients. Gradually add to creamed mixture and mix well until blended. Form dough into balls. Flatten with glass dipped in sugar or drop by spoon and mash with fork dipped in water. This recipe may be cut down to one half.

title: Mint Cordial
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator. Shake well before serving. Serve chilled. Makes about 4 cups liqueur.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Place drained pineapple in a dish. Mix flour and sugar together. Sprinkle over pineapple. Cover with a layer of shredded cheese. Top with melted butter and crumbled Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until dish bubbles (about 40 minutes). Serve hot. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Beef And Beans Barbecue
instructions: Brown ground chuck in skillet with chopped onions and drain. Then add other ingredients. Either simmer on top of stove or place in oven at 375\u00b0 until all ingredients are bubbly. This will take 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheesie Potatoes
instructions: Spray a glass baking dish with a nonstick spray. In microwave melt cheese butter and cheese. Put sliced potatoes in baking dish. Sprinkle dried onion over potatoes and salt and pepper to taste. Pour cheese mixture over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Kids Favorite Morning Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients in an airtight container. Use 1/3 cup (more or less to taste) per cup of hot water.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
instructions: Open cans; dump contents into crock-pot. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Cook on low setting all day.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine prepared apples and sugar in large mixing bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Sift flour and add soda salt and spices; set aside. Blend oil and egg into apple/sugar mixture. Add dry ingredients stirring just until blended. Stir in raisins and walnuts.

title: Curried Vegetable Medley
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot oil cook cauliflowerets beans mushrooms and carrots with garlic curry and cumin until vegetables are tender-crisp stirring often. In small bowl stir together vegetable juice cornstarch and pepper; gradually stir into skillet. Cook until mixture boils and thickens stirring constantly. Sprinkle with almonds. Makes 4 cups or 8 servings.

title: Prepare Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: For \Mashies\ that stay smooth mash the potatoes with warm milk butter and an egg yolk. Whip an egg white and fold it into the potatoes. Place in a buttered casserole and dot with more butter. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Hearty Bean Stew
instructions: In a Dutch oven combine undrained kidney and garbanzo beans water potatoes carrots onion tomato paste chili powder salt basil garlic powder and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Top each serving with about 1/4 cup of the cheese cubes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in oven. Remove and add seasoned salt and the Worcestershire sauce. Mix the cereal pretzels and nuts in a large pan (oven broiler pan) and pour the butter and seasoning over it. Stir until all the cereal and pretzels are covered. Bake 1 hour at 250\u00b0 stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Batter For Deep Frying
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Use for deep frying vegetables when camping. Use for onions green pepper rings zucchini slices cauliflower mushrooms and cheese as well as hot dogs.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple and juice until hot; but not boiling. Remove from heat and add dry gelatin. Mix well. Stir in buttermilk and fold in Cool Whip. Place in 13 x 9 dish and refrigerate until set congealed.

title: Pecan Thins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour. Add egg yolk and vanilla. Batter will be stiff. Spread as thin as possible on 2 cookie sheets. Lightly beat egg white. Spread on top and sprinkle with nuts. Press in with hand. Bake 1 hour at 275\u00b0 or lower. Remove from oven and cut into squares immediately. Freeze well.

title: Kool-Aid Fizzy
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart pitcher. Mix well.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: In large bowl cream butter; add sugar gradually beating until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Stir flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour. Blend in flavorings. Place batter in greased and floured 10 inch tube pan. Bake at 300 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes or until done. Do not over bake.

title: Ruth'S Dill Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight or for several hours.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Arrange broccoli in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Place cooked chicken on top. Combine soup mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until thoroughly heated. This dish can be prepared a day ahead and put in the refrigerator. It also freezes very well. Dish can also be made substituting asparagus for broccoli.

title: Quickie Brownies
instructions: Stir all ingredients together;\tspread into shallow 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Nutty Yam Bake
instructions: Drain yams. Melt butter in bottom of baking dish. Put yams in bottom of baking dish. You can mash or cut up in small pieces. Sprinkle brown sugar on top along with cinnamon. Add pecans and marshmallows. Bake about 20 minutes. Dont let marshmallows burn.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Put nuts in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Add coconut on top of nuts. Mix cake according to box directions and pour on top. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese and margarine. Whip. Drop over top of cake mix. Swirl around in mixture. Bake according to box directions.

title: Stewed Chicken
instructions: Cut up chicken; clean and wash. Put chicken in stewing pot with water. Keep enough water in pot to cover chicken. Salt and pepper to taste. Stew until almost tender.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix everything together (except bread crumbs) in a bowl. Add bread crumbs slowly until mixture is consistency of cookie dough (sprinkle in more crumbs if needed). Roll into a ball and pat ball into a glass dish (about 8 x 8-inch). Make even thickness. Bake in oven about 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs; beat well. Sift flour measure and add baking powder; sift again. Add to the creamed mixture with milk. Add flavoring last and beat well. Pour into well-greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Onion Pizza Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine onion and garlic with an equal amount of water; set aside 10 minutes to soften. Fit dough into a greased 12-inch round pizza pan. Brush dough with 2 tablespoons of oil. Sprinkle dough with salt and reserved onion and garlic. Dribble remaining 2 tablespoons oil over top of dough. Bake until dough and onion is browned 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into wedges.

title: Lithuanian Boiled Vyritos
instructions: Bring water and ruta to boil. Add all ingredients except whiskey. Squeeze orange lemon and lime into water. After it boils let it simmer until the flavor is in the water. Add whiskey and bring to a boil. Remove immediately and let cool overnight. Pour in bottle.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and oil together. Add eggs vanilla and sour milk. Mix well. Mix together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Beat well. Stir in zucchini. Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle top with chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Bean Pot
instructions: Do not drain beans. Fry hamburger onions and bell pepper (green) until brown (drain). Add beans and other ingredients. Cook in electric fry pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or in slow cooker for 2 to 3 hours on low.

title: 5-Cup Salad
instructions: Mix and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Chinese Spice Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and milk. Add powdered ingredients. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Dip or sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Crawfish Puffs
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Beat egg yolks milk and vegetable oil until blended. Add to dry ingredients and beat until blended. Stir in crawfish rice and green peppers. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry then fold into batter. Add Tabasco sauce to taste. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls into deep hot fat (375\u00b0). Fry until golden 3 to 4 minutes turning once. Drain on paper towel and serve with cocktail sauce or tartar sauce. Makes 24 puffs.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar oil egg yolks pineapple cinnamon and nutmeg in large bowl. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into batter. Fold in pecans. Pour into a 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until cake tests done. Let cool in pan.

title: Christmas Mix (Snack)
instructions: Melt chocolate and oil in double boiler.

title: Butternut Squash
instructions: Place squash cut side up in shallow roasting pan. Place 1 tablespoon butter in each half. Place seasonings on each half. Cover pan with aluminum foil and roast 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Remove herbs spoon squash into a bowl and mash until very smooth. In a saucepan add honey and remaining butter; add seasonings and warm through before serving.

title: Black-Eyed Peas And Spareribs
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil in 4 or 5-quart pot or skillet. Add spareribs and brown. Sprinkle with paprika add peas water and wine. Cover and simmer 1 hour until ribs are tender. Add tomatoes green pepper brown sugar chili powder salt and pepper. Cover and cook slowly for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 4. Good over rice.

title: Frosted Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Reserve juice and make up to one cup with water. Heat to boiling; dissolve jello in hot liquid. Gently stir in ginger ale; chill until partially set. Mix pineapple and the cranberry sauce; fold into jello. Turn into 9 x 9 x 2-inch dish and chill until firm. Mix cream cheese and whipped topping; spread over jello and sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Punch Bowl Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Crumble cake and put in large bowl. Stir half of mix in with cake. Mix strawberries and glaze together and put on top of cake. Put rest of Cool Whip mixture on top. Add whole strawberries on top and side of cake.

title: Hot Water Gingerbread
instructions: Put molasses shortening and\tsugar in mixing bowl. Dissolve baking soda in boiling water and pour into bowl. Mix well and let cool.\tAdd eggs nuts and raisins. Mix and sift remaining ingredients. Add to mixture in bowl mix well until smooth. Pour into 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Lunch Meat Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Layer ingredients in casserole pan and bake until done.

title: Christmas Jewels
instructions: Mix all ingredients except coconut and food coloring. Shape in about 3 dozen small ovals. In two separate pint jars put a few drops each of red and green food coloring. Add 1/2 teaspoon coconut to each jar. Cover and shake until coconut is tinted. Roll ovals in coconut. Chill.

title: Creamed Celery
instructions: Cook celery in lightly salted water until tender; drain. Add water chestnuts soup and pimento. Top with bread crumbs almonds and melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hands-Off Chicken
instructions: Mix rice and soups together. Spray dish (long flat 2-quart dish) with Pam and put soup and rice in the casserole dish. Place raw chicken on top of rice mixture. Then sprinkle onion soup mix over everything. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Soak eggplant in salt water for 30 minutes. Drain. Saute eggplant and onion in butter in frying pan until tender. Mix in cheese bread and milk. Put in casserole dish. Bake 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Dice apples cut grapes in half and slice bananas. Mix together; stir in marshmallows walnuts sugar peanut butter and mayonnaise. Makes a delicious summer salad.

title: White Conch Chowder
instructions: Pound and dice conch. Fry bacon saute onions add conch and all other ingredients except the milk. Simmer for one hour add milk and heat.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Add all ingredients except egg whites. Mix well. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in buttered mold in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Velveeta Fudge
instructions: In saucepan over simmering water beat cheese butter and cocoa. Slowly add in sugar. Add vanilla. Cook 10 minutes over medium heat until thick. Put in buttered 9-inch pan for thick slices or put in 10 x 13-inch pan for thinner slices.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: In a sauce pan stir together half and half margarine and cornstarch over medium heat until it starts to thicken remove from heat. Add marshmallows and stir until dissolved. Add pineapple that has been drained and pecans. Pour into container with a lid and refrigerate over night. Before serving stir in sour cream.

title: Cherry Tart
instructions: Beat until stiff the egg whites and baking powder. Add sugar crackers and nuts. Let set overnight. Butter 2 pie dishes or 9 x 13-inch oblong dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Old Timey Potato Salad
instructions: Take Irish potatoes. Peel and wash and chop small. Put a small amount of salt in the water you boil them in. Cook until real tender. Drain water off and break eggs in the hot potatoes. Mash real good the hot potatoes will cook the eggs. Add onion (chopped fine) mayonnaise sugar vinegar salt and black pepper. Stir all this up real good and taste to see if its flavored to suit your taste.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix both together until smooth. On a small platter or something flat break up lettuce small; chop tomatoes small and sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Dip Fritos chips into dip then scoop up salad. Good!

title: Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Mix together soup onion mayonnaise and lemon juice. Add chicken rice celery and eggs; toss lightly. Put mixture in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; top with bread crumbs. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Zucchini Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook onion and zucchini in butter. Add seasonings. Blend eggs and cheese in large bowl. Stir in vegetables. Put teaspoon mustard in prepared pie shell. Pour in ingredients. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Pot Roast
instructions: Boil roast in a large pot on top of stove until extremely tender. Pour the cream of mushroom soup over cut up roast. Salt pepper and enjoy.

title: Hash Browns
instructions: Heat butter cream and salt. Put 1/2 hash browns in bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle with half of cheese. Top with remaining hash browns. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Pour cream mixture over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peppermint Dessert
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter and spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Melt chocolate and butter (let cool). Add sugar yolks pecans and vanilla. Beat whites until stiff and fold into above mixture. Pour over crumbs and freeze. Spread ice cream over chocolate mixture.\tDrizzle chocolate sauce over mixture and freeze.

title: Cheese Rolls
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixer bowl. Heat milk and oil in saucepan over low heat until warm. Add 1 egg and warm liquid to flour mixture; beat 1/2 minute at low speed and 3 minutes at medium speed. By hand gradually stir 2 cups flour Cheddar cheese and 2 to 3 cups more flour until soft dough. Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise until doubled in size. Punch down dough. Shape into rolls. Place in greased pan. Cover; let rise 15 to 20 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Superb Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Wash the unpeeled sweet potatoes. Cook in a large saucepan in the water with 1 teaspoon salt for about 20 minutes until tender but not mushy. Drain peel and mash to a puree. This may be done in a food processor blender or electric mixer. Add the remaining salt butter pepper and milk.

title: Boursin
instructions: Combine cream cheese sour cream and butter thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Orange-Raisin Fruitcake
instructions: Extract orange juice then put orange pulp rind nuts and raisins through food chopper. Keep 1/4 cup of nut mixture for topping. Mix remainder with orange juice sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add eggs. Mix. Add flour soda salt and buttermilk. Mix well and pour into a tube pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 10 Day Slaw
instructions: Chop or shred cabbage. Add sliced onions and chopped green peppers. Pour white sugar over cabbage mixture and let stand while mixing dressing. Heat oil vinegar celery seed and salt to a rolling boil. Pour immediately over cabbage. Store in refrigerator. Keeps 10 days.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Set over night or for several hours in the refrigerator. Eat cold.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice medium thin. In saucepan melt butter. Blend in flour and add milk. Stir until boiling. Add cheese salt and pepper. Put sliced potatoes and onion in buttered baking dish. Pour cheese sauce over these and bake at 375\u00b0 uncovered for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Mix together in punch bowl the Sauterne champagne and soda. Drop in strawberries. Makes 18 to 20 servings.

title: Squaw Corn
instructions: Cut bacon across strip into 1/4-inch pieces. Chop onion and pepper about the same size. Fry bacon; drain. Discard half of the bacon fat. Add liquid from corn and chopped vegetables. Cook over medium-high heat until thick syrup forms on bottom of pan stirring frequently. Add corn bacon pimento salt pepper and chiles. Stir to mix and continue cooking until corn is heated through. (\Great for company.\)

title: Four Fruit Float
instructions: Use fresh or frozen berries. Put all ingredients into blender container. Blend until smooth. Serves 4.

title: Yummy Potatoes
instructions: Shred potatoes. Mix soup sour cream cheese butter salt and pepper. Mix all together in casserole dish. Top with crushed crackers mixed with butter. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Triple Layer Mud Pie
instructions: Pour chocolate and sweetened condensed milk into bowl; stir until smooth and pour into crust. Press nuts evenly onto chocolate in the crust and refrigerate 10 minutes. Pour milk into large bowl and add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes or until smooth. Mixture will be thick. Spread 1 1/2 cups of the pudding over nuts and chocolate layer in crust. Immediately stir half of the whipped topping into remaining pudding. Spread over pudding in crust. Top with remaining whipped topping. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Mix all but Certo. Boil for 1 minute. Add Certo and boil for 2 minutes. Put in clean jars and seal.

title: Golden Punch
instructions: Mix well. Chill. Serve over ice. Serves 75.

title: Old-Timey Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour and cut lard into mixture. Add sugar and buttermilk; mix well with hands. Roll out and place apart on baking sheet that has been greased with margarine. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 18 minutes or until brown on the bottom then broil tops until golden brown. Brush margarine over the tops while hot.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar cocoa and milk. Boil hard for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add vanilla and oats. Drop by spoon on waxed paper.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie crust. Slice 3/4 stick margarine on top. Bake in 425 degree oven for 30 minutes or till set.

title: Microwave Toasted Butter Pecans
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole place pecan halves. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Cut butter into 4 pieces and arrange evenly over top. Microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes. Mix to evenly distribute butter. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pecan Fudge Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small saucepan over low heat melt chocolate pieces stirring occasionally. In medium bowl beat together next 5 ingredietns. Slowly add melted chocolate stirring rapidly with wire whisk or spoon. Fold in pecans.

title: Pineapple Roast
instructions: In electric skillet brown roast on all sides in butter. Pour enough water to cover roast; simmer 2 to 3 hours. Add more water during simmering if necessary. Drain water (if any) and place potatoes in skillet with roast. Pour in pineapple juice. Cook until juice becomes thick-like sauce and potatoes are tender.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots until just tender. Place carrots into buttered casserole. Sprinkle raw onions over carrots. Spread mayonnaise mixed with lemon juice over carrots and onions; pepper to taste. Add grated Cheddar cheese. Top with bread crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandpa'S Goulash
instructions: Cook hamburger and onions until brown; drain. Stir in tomatoes and juice green peppers water mushrooms salt sugar chili powder and macaroni. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer about 30 minutes. If needed add more water.

title: The Great Pumpkin Cookie
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugars. Beat until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla. Mix well. Add dry ingredients. Mix. Add pumpkin. Stir in chocolate chips.

title: Beef Stew(Caldereta Style)
instructions: Cut beef into desired sizes. Marinate for an hour or two with garlic vinegar soy sauce peppercorn or powder salt to taste Pirims sauce (squeeze of liquid from meat and fry with just enough oil until brown). Then add a little water (enough to cook) sliced onion pickles olives tomato sauce or paste bay leaf red pepper (sliced) the liquid off the meat and a little sugar. Cook until tender (pressure cooker only 15 minutes). This is a Philippine food.

title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
instructions: Rinse broccoli well and cut flowerets into bite-size pieces. Toss with raisins onion and crisp bacon pieces. Combine cream cheese and remaining ingredients in blender. Pour over broccoli. Mix well. Serve well chilled.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
instructions: Use only butter or margarine.

title: Cheesy Mostaccioli
instructions: Mix Ragu sauce and Cheddar cheese soup with 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese in baking dish. Drain grease off ground beef. Mix ground beef in sauce. Add cooked noodles; mix well. Top with 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Vanilla Wafers
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or up to 1 week ahead Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl with mixer at low speed beat all ingredients until blended occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula. Drop dough by 2 teaspoons about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake cookies 10 to 12 minutes until edges of cookies are browned. With pancake turner remove cookies.

title: Annie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray Pam on a 10-inch tube pan. Have all ingredients at room temperature. Cream together the butter shortening and sugar. Add extracts. Beat in eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add to egg mixture alternately with milk. Blend well after each addition. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool 15 minutes before turning gently onto plate.

title: Caramel, Coconut, Pecan Pie
instructions: Bake and cool pie crusts. Toast chopped pecans and coconut. Mix Cool Whip condensed milk and cream cheese. Put a layer of this mixture in bottom of crusts then sprinkle in pecans and coconut. Next drizzle caramel topping over all. Layer again starting with cream cheese mixture and ending with caramel topping. Freeze. Take out about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Georgia Brown Bread
instructions: Cut up dates and sprinkle soda over dates. Pour water over them. Let stand until cool.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach and drain well (squeeze liquid out of spinach if necessary). Mix with other ingredients and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

title: Quick Cheeseburger Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400. Grease rectangular baking dish 13x9x2 inches. Cook beef and onion in 10 inch skillet over medium heat stirring occasionally until beef is brown. Drain. Stir in soup vegetables and milk. Remove from heat.

title: Polka Dot Pudding
instructions: Combine water fruit juice Minute tapioca sugar and salt in saucepan and mix well. Bring mixture quickly to a boil over direct heat. Stir all the time and remove from heat after boiling. Do not overcook. Will be thin. Put in pineapple and nuts. Stir occasionally until cool.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix well and serve chilled. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In 2-quart casserole add oleo peanut butter and vanilla. Put in microwave on High power for 3 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir in sugar. Press in container. Let cool. Cut in squares.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Put all in mixer bowl. Stir on slow to combine. Beat well.

title: Peanut Butter Round Up
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine shortening and sugar in mixing bowl. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat until well blended in peanut butter. Sift together flour salt and soda. Combine with peanut butter. Stir in oats. Roll dough to form small balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet. With fork press cookie balls. If dough sticks to fork dip in flour. Bake for about 12 minutes.

title: D-Gumdrop Fruit Cake
instructions: Cut gumdrops into small pieces. Cream butter and sugar together. Add well beaten eggs. Add flour and applesauce alternately. Stir in baking soda and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Fold in nuts raisins and gumdrops (chopped candied cherries and candied pineapple may be added for variety). Bake slowly in about 250\u00b0 oven approximately 3 hours. Will make 4 small loaves or one large tube pan. I use all orange slices 2 pounds.

title: Chili Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet saute poultry in oil until no longer pink. Set aside. In same skillet cook onion peppers and garlic until tender. Drain. Stir in chili and tomatoes. Add rice and pepper sauce. Arrange chicken on top. Simmer 10 minutes. Top with shredded cheese. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Combine chicken water broth half of the celery carrots onions green pepper pepper and bay leaf; bring to a boil. Simmer 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken. When cool enough to handle remove meat from bones and cut up. Set chicken aside. Strain broth and skim fat. Return to kettle. Add salt and remaining ingredients. Simmer 10 to 12 minutes. Add noodles and chicken. Simmer 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Boil squash until tender. Melt soup and cheese into onions. Add squash beaten egg and crumbled crackers. Salt and pepper to taste. Place mixture in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered until light brown on top.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken in a 13 x 9-inch greased baking dish. Mix soup and broth. Pour over chicken. Break eggs over this.

title: Seafood Platter
instructions: Serve as they come from the can on the crackers.

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Chill the evaporated milk unopened in refrigerator until icy cold.

title: Marinated Artichokes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and allow to marinate for at least 2 hours. Serve with crackers. (Better if made 1 or 2 days ahead.)

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Slowly melt butter being careful not to burn. Add brown sugar while butter is still warm. If brown sugar is clumpy place with butter in microwave until sugar softens. Add eggs and vanilla and beat until creamy and of a slightly lighter color. In separate bowl mix dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Fold in chips. Place 2-inch balls on ungreased sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 12 to 15 minutes. Take out and cool for one minute.

title: Heavenly Onions
instructions: Butter bread on both sides. Saut onions in 2 tablespoons butter. Butter 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer mushrooms onions cheese and bread. Mix soup milk and soy sauce and pour over top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Company Goodies
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts over mixture. Mix cream cheese and box confectioners sugar and spread over nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. When cool cut in squares.

title: Dessert Pizza
instructions: Slice cookie dough 1/4 inch thick. Arrange slices close together in pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown. Cool completely.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Slice carrots and cook in salted water only until barely tender. (Do not overcook.) Drain. Combine soup sugar vinegar and seasonings; blend well and slowly add salad oil while beating until well mixed. Add to vegetables and let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain. Stir in tuna celery mayonnaise onion green pepper and salt. In saucepan combine soup and milk; heat through. Add cheese. Heat and stir until cheese melts. Add to noodle mixture. Turn into 2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered in a 425\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Low-Fat Potato Salad
instructions: Combine veggies in a large bowl. Mix together mayonnaise mustard milk salt pepper and celery seed. Mix until smooth. Pour over veggies and toss to coat. Chill (overnight is best.) The dressing should be a pale yellow color and slightly thin.

title: Cantaloupe Meringue Pie
instructions: Bake pastry shell 9 to 11 minutes. Let cool. Beat 4 egg whites at room temperature and cream of tartar at high speed on mixer for 1 minute. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form 2 to 4 minutes. Combine egg yolks cantaloupe and next 6 ingredients in a heavy saucepan; stir well. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbly. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Pour mixture into prepared pie shell. Spread meringue over hot filling sealing to edge of pastry. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes until browned. Let cool.

title: Laplands
instructions: Grease muffin tin very thoroughly. Sift flour and salt together. Separate eggs and beat yolks until thick and creamy. Whip the cream until it holds its shape. Now add flour and whipped cream to the egg yolks alternately beginning and ending with the flour. Whip egg whites until stiff. Dump egg batter on top of whites and mix with your hands until all the white patches have disappeared. Work quickly. Spoon into muffin tin filling half full. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Lay cooked chicken pieces in bottom of casserole dish. Spread mushroom soup over chicken. Heat 1 can cream of chicken soup with 1 can water or chicken broth. Add 1 package bread crumbs. Spread over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Salmon Pie
instructions: Combine salmon onions and butter; mix thoroughly. Add potatoes and mash. Stir in milk; whip until smooth. Spread mixture in prepared pastry shells; top with crust and crimp edges to seal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Pie may be frozen. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Angel Food Candy
instructions: Boil until syrup reaches 300\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Take from heat. Add 1 tablespoon soda. Pour on a buttered cookie sheet. When hard break in pieces and dip.

title: Chipped Beef Appetizer
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with crackers.

title: Bacon, Cheese And Macaroni Bake
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Cool and crumble. Cook macaroni according to directions. Combine macaroni crumbled bacon and tomato sauce. Cut cheese up in pieces and mix in with other ingredients. Put in a 2-quart casserole dish sprayed with Pam and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Corn Kalasky Soup
instructions: Mix egg sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt and flour. Bring water and 1 cup milk to a boil. Have batter ready. Drop into boiling mixture gently. Turn heat down. Dumplings go to bottom of pan (cover). Add butter corn and 1 cup milk. Cook until warmed through.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingerbread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Beat butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs and molasses mixing well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients. Add to butter mixture alternately with hot water beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Pour batter into a greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream. Makes 9 servings.

title: Surprise Sandwiches
instructions: Prepare the night before. Grease an 8 x 10-inch pan with butter or oleo. Place 6 slices of bread (crusts removed) in bottom of pan. Cover each slice with a slice of American cheese. Then spread each with prepared mustard and cover with any of the listed meats. Butter 6 more slices of bread and place on top buttered side up.

title: Crab Bisque Soup
instructions: Blend soups. Stir in milk and cream. Heat just to boiling. Add crab. Heat. Stir in wine just before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Veal Parmigiana
instructions: Pound cutlets until they reach 3 x 3-inch size. Dip meat into egg and milk mixture then dip into 3/4 cup dry seasoned bread crumbs. Sprinkle freely with Parmesan cheese; allow to stand 15 minutes. Saute in butter or oil until crisp (2 to 4 minutes each side). Place in baking sheet top with your favorite spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Place in preheated oven until cheese melts. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Jim'S Mother'S Beet Pickles
instructions: Cook beets. Peel and cut. Pour liquid over and bring to boil then put in jars and seal.

title: Liver Pat
instructions: Saut chicken livers and onions until done but not browned. Cool slightly. Puree 1 cup at a time in blender. Stir in salt dry mustard pepper and butter. Refrigerate.

title: Half Moon Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost 1/2 chocolate and 1/2 white frosting.

title: Stew
instructions: Put 2 to 3 cups hot water in large stew pan. Add potatoes carrots and onions (all peeled and diced). When halfway tender add tomato sauce corn beef stew mix and hamburger meat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low heat until ready.

title: Dill Sweet Pickles
instructions: Pour juice off pickles and discard. Rinse with cold water. Put in large bowl or crock and add remaining ingredients. Stir well until the sugar dissolves. Let stand for 4 days stirring daily. Pack in sterilized jars or put them back in the gallon jar they came in and store in refrigerator.

title: Quick N Hearty Mushroom Soup
instructions: Saute mushrooms in a little oil; set aside. Brown hamburger draining off fat. Add tomatoes mushroom mix broth water and seasonings. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir in rice and cover. Set aside for 5 minutes. Makes 9 cups.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple and save juice. Put pineapple in a butter dish. Mix sugar and flour and sprinkle over pineapple and add 1 cup pineapple juice. Pour over. Put a cup of grated cheese. Melt 1 stick of butter and 2 tablespoons of brown sugar and stir up crushed crackers (Ritz). Sprinkle over the ingredients. Bake 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: White Buttermilk Sheet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add vanilla and then salt. Add egg whites one at a time beating after each one. Beat in 2 tablespoons flour. Add 3/4 cup buttermilk with baking soda added. Add remaining flour and buttermilk alternately. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in 10 x 15-inch sheet cake pan that has been greased and floured. Cool and frost with buttercream frosting.

title: 5 Cup Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend all ingredients; chill and serve.

title: Oven Barbecue Hamburgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients and make medium size patties. Brown in small amount of cooking oil and set aside. Make the sauce.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients together. Add eggs one at a time. Beat after each egg. Add cake flour 1/2 cup at a time. Beat each time. Add lemon or almond extract. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in greased floured Bundt pan.

title: Chicken And Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Cook and cube chicken. Mix together all ingredients except cheese and tortillas. Put a little of the mixture in the bottom of pan (so they dont stick). Put 2 tablespoons of mixture in tortilla and some of the cheese roll and place in pan. After all are rolled up spread rest of sauce and cheese on top. Bake for about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pistachio Microwave Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 9 x 2-inch or tube microwavable cake pan with solid shortening and line with waxed paper. Blend water egg whites and oil. Stir in cake mix and pudding until well blended. Microwave on turntable 9 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Remove from microwave and cool until warm to touch. Turn out on cake plate and remove waxed paper. Frost with cream cheese frosting if desired.

title: Texas Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain well. Combine everything together. Bake in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa. Add milk and margarine. Bring to a boil for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Add vanilla and oatmeal. Remove from heat. Spoon out on wax paper. Let cool. Cookies will harden while cooling. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Oatmeal Pecan Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil first 4 items. Boil 1 minute and remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Beat until well mixed. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Let stand for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Jubilee
instructions: Whip the Dream Whip. Add sugar and cream cheese. Mix well. In deep dish put 1 layer of ladyfingers. Spread with mixture. Cover with pie filling. Repeat in layers. Chill at least 3 hours. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef in oil in a large skillet stirring to crumble. Drain off pan dripping. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste and seasonings into meat. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Cream together first 5 ingredients. Add flour soda and salt to mixture. Fold in oats then corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes. Makes 100 (2 1/2-inch) cookies. \A dishpan full!\

title: Mexi-Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake until melted.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Cut first 7 ingredients into bite size pieces. Place meat and vegetables layered in\ta roaster or flat in a casserole with lid. Mix remaining ingredients together. Pour over vegetables and meat. Cover. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 hours undisturbed.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook and drain broccoli. Place in bottom of greased glass baking dish (13 x 9-inch). Arrange cooked chicken on top. Mix together soup mayonnaise curry powder and lemon juice. Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli. Top with shredded cheese bread crumbs and paprika. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: No Fail Yeast Rolls
instructions: Stir yeast salt and sugar into flour. Heat milk until hot to touch. Add milk and oil to dry ingredients beating until well blended for about 5 minutes. Then with a spoon add as much flour as needed. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Place into a greased or oiled bowl and cover with a towel. Let rise until double. Punch down and turn out onto a floured surface. Roll out; cut with a biscuit cutter. Put into oiled pan and let rise until double. Cook at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Rotel Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Debone chicken and reserve 1 quart of chicken broth. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth until tender do not drain. Saute bell pepper and onion in margarine. Add to spaghetti. Add other ingredients including chicken and cheese (cut cheese into small pieces). Pour into 1 large or 2 small casserole dishes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. This dish freezes well.

title: Lime Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and confectioners sugar. Add vanilla lime juice and zest of limes. Combine flour cornstarch and salt. Mix into butter mixture. Roll batter onto wax paper. Refrigerate. Slice and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Coat with confectioners sugar.

title: Strawberry Glaze Pie
instructions: In a 9-inch pan place Bisquick and soft butter. Pour boiling water over this and stir with fork until soft-ball. Pat dough in pan over the edge.\tBake 8 to 10 minutes in 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet Potato Chips
instructions: Peel and wash yams. Slice as thin as possible the thinner the better. Heat oil in a deep frying pan; let oil get very hot. Place chips in oil until golden brown. Place cooked chips on a paper towel. Salt to taste and serve.

title: Okra And Tomatoes
instructions: Put fat in skillet. Add onions and tomatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and sugar. Add okra and cover; simmer until okra is tender about 5 minutes. Stir all together. Serve hot.

title: Perfect Every Time Beef Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients in casserole and bake covered at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. One hour prior to finish add the potatoes (cut in halves). Serves 6.

title: Frying Dip And Coating For Seafood
instructions: *For tenderizer trick add a 7 ounce can of beer to the dip.

title: Appetizer Pie
instructions: Blend cheese and milk. Stir in dried beef onion and pepper. Mix well. Add sour cream. Spoon into 8-inch pie plate. Sprinkle walnuts over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers as a dip.

title: Cheezy Chicken
instructions: Dip boneless chicken breasts in butter then roll in cracker crumbs. Place in baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Very Best Burrito
instructions: Combine milk and pudding mix and blend 1 minute. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in 2 cups of Cool Whip. Add about 1 1/2 cups of strawberries. In bowl combine sugar and cinnamon. Butter both sides of tortillas. Sprinkle one side with the sugar/cinnamon mixture. Put in 350\u00b0 oven sugar/cinnamon side up only about 2 minutes until bubbly. Take out of oven and let stand 3 to 4 minutes. Fill shells with sugar side out. Top each with Cool Whip and add sliced strawberries.

title: Old-Fashioned Custard Pie
instructions: Beat lightly; pour into 9-inch unbaked crust. Bake for about 40 minutes or until knife inserted into side of filling comes out clean. Center is soft but will set later. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes then at 350\u00b0 to finish.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating and mixing thoroughly. Sift flour salt soda and baking powder; add buttermilk and rum flavoring. Add vanilla. Pour into tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Harvest Soup
instructions: Add all ingredients except tomatoes to boiling water. Cover and boil gently for 15 minutes. Break up large pieces of tomato and add to vegetable mixture. Continue cooking until vegetables are tender about 20 minutes. Remove bay leaf and serve with grated Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 servings 1 cup each.

title: Small Apple Crisp
instructions: Lightly spray 8 x 8 pan; place apple in pan and sprinkle with lemon juice and water. Combine remaining ingredients and cover apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until apples are done and brown.

title: Barbecued Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Wash and scrub potatoes. Cut slits in tops. Place each potato in a piece of aluminum foil wrapping securely. Cook 6-inches from heat tops down for 20 minutes. Turn and pierce foil tops with a fork. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or longer until done. Cut foil open. Combine cloves and butter. Frizzle over tops. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Two-Handed Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugars peanut butter oleo soda and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly. Drop dough on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Spinach should be thawed and drained. Margarine should be melted. Mix ingredients together except Ritz. Place in casserole dish. Top ingredients with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blintz Souffle
instructions: Place blintzes (partially defrost) in baking dish. Blend remaining ingredients and pour over blintzes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes (mixture should be set). Serves 6 to 8.

title: Red Cabbage - German Style(Sweet And Sour)
instructions: Cut cabbage in half and slice thin. Place in a large kettle of boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain. Put cabbage back in pot and add all other ingredients. Pour the boiling water on last. Bring all to a boil and simmer for 2 to 3 hours. Be sure to use a close-fitting lid.

title: Zucchini Lasagne
instructions: Cook zucchini in boiling salt water for 5 minutes. Cook beef and garlic stir in spices and sauce. Mix Ricotta egg and parsley. Place 1/2 zucchini in greased 8-inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Spread 1/2 of Ricotta 1/2 of beef mixture and 1/2 of Mozzarella. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Yields 5 to 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time. Add drained pineapple then add cherries and nuts; mix well. Pour into crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mixed Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand in refrigerator.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: German-Style New Potato Salad
instructions: Peel strip around center of each potato. Cook potatoes in boiling water. Drain. Halve any large potatoes. In bowl combine cooked potatoes lettuce curly endive eggs radishes and green onion.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together; add eggs and butter. Add milk. Put in well-greased dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until thick about an hour.

title: Christmas Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine oil eggs 1/2 cup water. Stir in the rest of ingredients and put in greased loaf pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Butterfinger Delight
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with graham cracker crumbs. (Before mixing together set aside 1/4 cup of crumbs.) Press in a 10 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Mix egg and milk; dip steak in and then in flour. Brown lightly in shortening. Add onions and green peppers to meat in shortening. Add water and soup; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash in a little water and salt. Drain and mix with soup onion and carrot. Grease a 9 x 12-inch casserole dish and put in all ingredients. Put 1/2 package of stuffing over top and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Deviled Potatoes
instructions: Prepare potatoes according to package directions. Heat sour cream but do not boil. Add mustard salt and sugar. Stir to blend and add to hot potatoes. Stir in onion. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions with the exception of using milk instead of water. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bring to a boil the pineapple and sugar. When cake is done punch holes in it and pour pineapple mixture over cake. Let set long enough to cool. Mix pudding according to package directions with the exception of leaving out 1 cup of milk. Mix softened cream cheese and pudding with mixer. Spread over top of pineapple mixture on cake. Slice bananas over cake. Sprinkle with coconut pecans and cherries.

title: Banberry Surprise
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add strawberry soda pop and cool completely. Mix cake according to package directions (do not use cake mix with pudding in it). Bake in 13 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 2 inch greased and floured pan. Let cool completely. After cake is cooled using potato peeler poke lots of holes all the way to the bottom. Pour gelatin and soda pop mixture over cake. Cover entire top of cake with thick sliced bananas.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli; do not cook. Mix in bacon onion and cheese. Mix together mayo sugar and vinegar and pour over broccoli. Chill. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Senate Bean Soup
instructions: Heat beans and water to boiling; reduce heat. Boil uncovered for 2 minutes; remove from heat. Cover and let stand 1 hour or cover beans with water and let soak overnight. Drain and add 10 cups fresh water. Add salt meat to beans and water. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 2 hours or until beans are tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Makes 12 servings; contains 1 gram fat per serving.

title: Mother'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool 15 minutes. Mix sour cream 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla; pour over cake. Bake 3 to 5 minutes more at 475\u00b0.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
