instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water 30 minutes or until tender. Drain; let cool to touch. Peel and cut into 1/4 inch strips; set aside. Combine 1/4 cup butter and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl; gently stir in potatoes and cheese. Spoon into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine 3 tablespoons butter and stuffing mix; sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yields 8 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Line a Pyrex pie pan or round Corning Ware dish with large size tortilla round. Pour in a can of peaches cherries plums or blackberries sweeten to taste. Tear the second tortilla round into pieces and stick down into fruit. Pat generously with butter. Cut strips from another tortilla and lay on top. Sprinkle with sugar and again pat generously with margarine. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onion rings in 1/4 cup butter. Combine remaining butter with cracker crumbs. Reserve 1/4 of crumb mixture for topping and layer remaining crumbs into bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Spread sauteed onion rings over crumb layer and sprinkle with cheese salt and paprika. Combine eggs and milk and pour over layers. Top with reserved crumb mixture and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Nacho Cheese Chowder
instructions: In a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole crumble meat. Add the green pepper. Cook in microwave covered on High for 2 to 3 minutes until no pink remains in meat stirring once or twice. Drain off the fat. Stir in nacho cheese soup milk corn chopped tomato and minced onion. Cook covered on High for 7 to 10 minutes or until chowder is heated through stirring once. Makes 3 main dish servings. Serve with corn chips.

title: Pineapple Fluff Pie
instructions: Soak gelatine in cold water 5 minutes. Beat egg yolks with 1/4 cup sugar. Add pineapple lemon juice and salt. Cook on low heat until consistency of custard. Add softened gelatine stir and cool. Beat egg whites until white and foamy. Add remaining sugar gradually and continue beating until glossy and holds soft peaks. When mixture begins to thicken fold in egg whites. Beat whipping cream and fold in. Pour into baked pie crust and refrigerate.

title: Pralines
instructions: Cook all ingredients except pecans and vanilla to soft ball stage (240\u00b0).

title: Pineapple Crush Cake
instructions: Cake Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans. Prepare cake as directed on package. Divide evenly in pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Stir together soup chicken and vegetables in dish. Combine flour milk and butter. Stir until smooth. Pour over mixture in dish. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake until center is firm.

title: Hardee'S Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll out on floured board. Cut out and bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown on greased cookie sheet about 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 14 biscuits.

title: Willie'S Homemade Boiled Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken thighs for 1 hour and 45 minutes. Stir in 2 cups rice. Cook covered for 20 minutes longer. Ready to serve.

title: Apricot Foldovers
instructions: Add cut-up margarine to flour. Make well in flour; add egg yolks and sugar thats been mixed together. Mix with fingers; sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cold water. Continue to work with fingers. Make into a ball wrap in wax paper and refrigerate until chilled. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Take dough out and divide into 2 balls; refrigerate one. Roll part of dough to about 1/8-inch thickness on slightly floured surface. Cut into 2 1/2-inch rounds. Put rounds on slightly greased cookie sheet. In center of each put 1/2 teaspoon of apricot preserves and pinch around edge or use fork. Brush top with mixture of egg and milk. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove from rack. Cool. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Martha Washington Balls
instructions: Mix sugar butter milk vanilla and nuts. Roll into balls and chill. Drop in melted candy coating. Spoon onto wax paper.

title: R C'S Fudge
instructions: Cook in 2-quart pan stirring constantly over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Boil and stir 5 minutes. Take off heat; stir in 6 ounces chips vanilla and nuts. Pour in greased pan.

title: Cream Cheese Cut-Out Cookies
instructions: Blend well with spoon the oleo cream cheese and sour cream. Gradually add sugar continuing to beat until light. Add egg yolks (slightly beaten with vanilla). Beat until light and fluffy. Add flour sifted with baking powder and salt and mix

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in lukewarm water. Add the remaining ingredients. This will keep in refrigerator for 1 week. Dip out needed amount in flour; pinch off and place in greased skillet. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Almond Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour baking soda and salt. In a blender grind 1/2 cup blanched almonds to a fine powder add to flour mixture. Cream the sugar shortening almond extract egg and water and add to dry mixture. Mix thoroughly. Form into 1-inch balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Press one of the remaining almonds into the center of each ball while flattening it slightly with fingers. Brush cookie with beaten egg. Bake 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Angel Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugars margarine and shortening. Beat in egg and vanilla. Gradually add flour soda cream of tartar and salt mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts (optional). Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until firm to touch.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions and drain. Cut margarine and Velveeta into small pieces. Place in pan still warm from cooking macaroni and pour warm macaroni over cheese and margarine. Cheese and margarine should melt quickly. Then add 1/2 cup milk. Mix well. Place mixture in a casserole dish and place slices of American cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: 3-Day Brown-N-Bag Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix sour cream sugar and coconut together and keep in refrigerator 24 hours before making cake. Make cake according to directions on box. Make in 3 layers. Let cake layers get completely cool. Spread coconut mixture over layers. Slide cake into turkey-sized brown-n-bag satin refrigerator bag and let stay for 3 days before serving.

title: Caramel Apple Pie
instructions: Combine 10 caramel candies; cut each into 4 pieces. Add 1/3 cup flour. Add 3 cups (cut into 1/2-inch cubes) Jonathan or Rome apples 2/3 cup caramel ice cream topping and 2 teaspoons lemon juice. Mix well. Bake at 375\u00b0 on a preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes. Store at room temperature.

title: Diced Mcintosh Apple Cake
instructions: Add sugar to diced apples and let stand for 10 minutes. Sift flour and spices. Blend oil and egg into apple mixture. Add flour mixture all at once. Beat with large spoon until well blended. Pour into a 9-inch well greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix all ingredients. Roll and pinch off marble size. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes (do not overbake).

title: Homestyle Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole combine gravy and poultry seasoning. Stir in chicken and frozen vegetables. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble.

title: Carla'S Five Can Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a skillet melt butter over medium heat. Saute onions until tender. Stir in potatoes soup and milk. Add cheese green pepper pimento and 1/2 cup of the cracker crumbs. Pour in shallow casserole dish. Top with remaining cracker crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Sort and wash beans. Combine beans and water in large Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat to medium and cook 40 minutes. Add next 8 ingredients; cover. Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Mash most of beans against side of Dutch oven with back of a spoon; stir well. Cover and bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-high and cook uncovered an additional hour or until desired degree of doneness stirring occasionally. Discard bay leaves. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Microwave Chicken Divan
instructions: Pierce hole in broccoli package and cook 3 minutes in microwave oven. In a mixing bowl mix soup sour cream lemon juice garlic powder and soy sauce. Set aside. Put rice and broccoli in greased 2-quart casserole dish and add half of the soup mixture. Add chicken and remaining soup mixture. Top with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook 8 minutes. Turn dish 1/2 turn and cook 6 to 8 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Add extra flour if needed. Roll out; cut into shapes. Bake for 7 minutes.

title: Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Cook rack of ribs in Dutch oven or regular 350\u00b0 oven for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until done. In a bowl mix together remaining ingredients. Pour sauce over ribs and bake uncovered until brown about 20 minutes. Keep basting ribs with sauce.

title: Onion Patties
instructions: Mix together first six ingredients. Stir in enough cold water for thick batter. Mix in onion and drop by teaspoons into deep fat. Flatten patties slightly as you turn them. Fry to a golden brown.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add other ingredients. Stir until well blended. Pour into unbaked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Creole Pork Chops
instructions: Salt and pepper chops; brown well in skillet then put in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chops. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Turn chops after an hour. Have a barbecued taste.

title: Baked Fish
instructions: Bake in baking dish covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Beth'S Cheese And Bacon Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Sprinkle bacon over bottom of pastry shell. Combine eggs cream salt nutmeg and cayenne pepper in a bowl and beat until thoroughly mixed. Sprinkle cheese over bacon and ladle egg mixture over top. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 lower the heat to 350\u00b0 and bake another 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry And Apple Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water. Break up cranberry sauce with fork. Add the gelatin mixture; chill until thickened. Fold in apples and nuts.

title: Crawfish Casserole
instructions: Saute celery bell pepper and onion in margarine. Combine with tomatoes and steam on low fire. Mix in soup. Cook rice according to directions. Mix rice with tomato-soup mixture. Add grated cheese and crawfish. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes or until bubbling. Dont stir. Enjoy with salad and French bread. Serves 8.

title: Miracle Whip-Up
instructions: Brown and cook the ground beef. Add the salad dressing spaghetti sauce and cooked macaroni. Heat on medium heat. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Spread beans on serving platter. Mix sour cream with taco seasoning and spread over beans. Cover with shredded cheese and sprinkle with remaining ingredients.

title: Cheese-Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Put pineapple in 2-quart casserole dish. Mix flour sugar and cheese and cover pineapple. Cover this with cracker crumbs. Drizzle margarine over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly approximately 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: You will need 2 regular size muffin pans.

title: Peppered Steak
instructions: Cut steak in strips. Mix garlic soy sauce salt and 1/4 cup water. Add steak. Marinate steaks 1 hour (longer if possible) tossing occasionally. Drain steak. Save the marinade.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix according to directions on package and bake in 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan. Let cool thoroughly. Spread with pie filling then frost with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated until you serve it.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Sprinkle pudding over pineapple. Add other ingredients and stir together.

title: Mom'S Special Party Cheese Balls
instructions: Cut cheese in small pieces or grate and allow to come to room temperature. In mixing bowl beat cheese and mayonnaise until smooth and creamy. Add onion Worcestershire sauce paprika and parsley. Continue to beat until thoroughly blended. Shape into 2 balls. Roll in nuts. May garnish with olives cherries or parsley. Freezes well.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Stir into margarine mixture with milk. Beat until smooth. Pour into greased baking dish. On top of the batter place peach slices close together. Pour about 1/4 cup of peach juice over the peaches and batter. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with milk or ice cream.

title: Broccoli Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine broccoli corn and egg in a bowl; mix well. Place in a casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

title: Spicy Hillbilly Rice
instructions: In a large kettle (4 to 6-quart) place olive oil over heat (medium-low to medium). Add onion celery bell pepper garlic basil salt and pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir frequently. Add uncooked rice and stir to blend well. Cook for about 2 minutes. Add tomato juice and chili powder. Stir to blend. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low cover and cook until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Serve with shredded Cheddar cheese if desired. Serves about 8.

title: Southwestern Potatoes
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Line 2 large baking sheets with foil.

title: Crumb Crust
instructions: Combine crumbs and sugar. Mix in butter. Press firmly on bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan. For unbaked crumb crust chill 1 hour before filling. For baked crumb crust bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool thoroughly before filling. For ease in serving dip pie pan in warm water for a few seconds then cut and serve.

title: Kraut Relish
instructions: Mix together and store in closed container in refrigerator. Delicious with vegetables.

title: Favorite Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine cranberry sauce dressing and soup mix in small mixing bowl and mix well. Spread half the cranberry mixture over bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange chicken in single layer over prepared layer. Top with remaining cranberry mixture. Bake 30 to 45 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Serve over rice. Yield 8 servings.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Add oleo and mix. Add other ingredients. Add vinegar last. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Aloha Slush
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and divide into 4 separate containers and freeze. When serving add 1 quart of 7-up to each container.

title: The Best Summer Cake
instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch pan bake cake mix according to box direction. While slightly warm poke holes in cake with a wooden spoon handle and press down flatten cake. Pour crushed pineapple including juice and spread evenly. Prepare pudding according to box directions but subtract 1 cup milk. Pour and spread evenly over pineapple. Top with Cool Whip and walnuts. Refrigerate 1 hour prior to serving.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt butter. Add peanut butter then confectioners sugar. Mix well. Put in greased pan (9 x 13-inch or smaller). Sets up in 1 hour at room temperature.

title: Fresh Squash Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute squash and onions with the margarine until tender. Drain. Add eggs milk salt and pepper. Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and top with cheese and crackers. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Green Chili Pie
instructions: Season meat and onion with salt pepper and garlic. Cook until mixture is not pink. Drain meat. Place back in skillet. Add the Ro-Tel tomatoes green chilies and chicken soup. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Chicken
instructions: Line bottom of baking dish with 6 slices of Armour dried beef. Top with boneless chicken breasts.

title: Tiger Butter(Candy)
instructions: Melt vanilla and chocolate almond bark in separate bowls in microwave. Add peanut butter to almond bark and stir in good. Pour vanilla almond bark mixture in deep cookie sheet (pan must be completely dry). Swirl in chocolate almond bark. Let set on counter. Do not refrigerate! Cut and serve.

title: Polly'S Sour Cream Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in bowl mixing well after each ingredient is added. In another bowl sift together salt soda baking powder and flour. Add alternately with sour cream to first 6 ingredients. Fold in nuts. Bake in two large loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Teenage Scramble
instructions: Saute ground beef with onion in oil in skillet until ground beef is browned stirring frequently. Add mushrooms and spinach mixing well. Stir in eggs gradually. Cook until eggs are set stirring constantly. Season with salt and pepper. Yields 6 servings.

title: Quick Fruit Crisp
instructions: Pour pie filling into 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Mix remaining ingredients with a fork. Sprinkle over fruit. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chicken Soup Mother Didn'T Make
instructions: Boil chicken including heart gizzard and liver for about 45 minutes. Use enough water to just float the chicken. Remove pan from heat. Take chicken out and let it cool. Save the pot of water. When chicken is cool pick the meat off the bones (dont start too early or you will invent words the dog wont stay around to hear). Put chicken meat back into the pot of water. Add the complete soup starter the vegetables for seasoning and the sliced carrots. Add any leftover veggies found in the fridge. Cover pot and simmer at least 2 hours. Serve with cornbread. It will fix what ails you!

title: My Favorite Fried Potatoes
instructions: Fry onions bacon and mushrooms together turning frequently until bacon is sufficiently cooked (not crispy). In a separate frypan heat vegetable oil on medium-high temperature for 2 to 3 minutes. Season sliced potatoes with paprika pepper and salt as listed in large bowl. Reduce temperature to low-medium; add sliced potatoes slowly to hot oil; turn potatoes frequently. Fry until light brown color is achieved. Combine all ingredients in one frypan and cook an extra 10 to 15 minutes and serve.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook chicken in seasoned water until tender; reserve broth. Debone. Cook potatoes celery and carrots in broth until tender. Reserve 3 cups broth. Melt butter and flour; stir a few minutes. Add milk 3 cups chicken broth salt and pepper. Mix everything together including peas. Pour in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Shape crusts to fit and put them on top; make a few slits. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Japanese Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice following the instructions on the package. This should take about 20 minutes. Pour the rice into a large bowl to let it cool. Scramble the eggs in a small pan over medium heat. chop scrambled chunks of egg into small pea-sized bits with your spatula while cooking. When the rice is cooled add the peas carrots eggs and onion to the bowl. Carefully toss all of the ingredients together. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium/high heat. When the butter has completely melted dump the rice mixture into the pan and add the soy sauce plus a dash of salt and pepper. Cook the rice mixture for 6 to 8 minutes stirring often.

title: Stroganoff Style Pork Chops
instructions: In a large skillet on medium heat brown pork in oil for 5 minutes. Remove; keep warm. In the drippings saute onion and mushrooms until tender stir in water mustard and salt; bring to boil. Return chops to pan; reduce heat cover and simmer for 15 minutes until chops are tender. Remove and keep warm. Combine flour and sour cream until smooth; add to skillet. Bring to a boil; cook and stir 1-2 minutes or until thicken. Serve pork chops and mushroom sauce with noodles.

title: Twice-Baked Italian Cookies
instructions: In a bowl mix sugar butter anise seed liqueur bourbon almonds and eggs. Beat to blend. Stir together flour and baking powder. Add to butter mixture and blend thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate dough until firm 2 to 3 hours.

title: No-Peek Chicken
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle rice on bottom. Layer chicken skin side up on rice. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken. Mix water with both cans of soup and heat then pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake 2 hours at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy. Remove from skillet and set aside. Into bacon drippings stir vinegar water sugar salt onion and egg. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Add lettuce to skillet and toss with hot dressing quickly. Remove to bowl. Crumble bacon on top.

title: Chocolate Chunk Bars
instructions: Mix flour baking soda and salt in medium bowl; set aside.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Grind vegetables and salt. Let stand for 2 hours then drain. Boil vinegar and spices 5 minutes. Add vegetables and cook slowly 30 to 40 minutes. Seal in hot sterile jars.

title: Old-Fashioned Potato Bread
instructions: Make potatoes for 2 servings as label directs using liquid omitting butter and seasoning. Measure 1 cup. In large bowl sprinkle yeast over water; stir until dissolved. Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved. Add 1 cup potatoes butter and 3 1/2 cups flour. With electric mixer at medium speed beat until smooth 2 minutes. Gradually add 4 cups flour mixing with hands until smooth and stiff enough to leave bowl. Add remaining 1/4 cup flour if needed. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead until smooth electric small blisters appear on surface 10 minutes. Place in greased large bowl; turn over. Cover with towel. Let rise in warm place (85\u00b0) until double 1 hour. Turn out dough onto lightly floured pastry cloth or board. Divide in half. Roll out one-half into a 16 x 8-inch rectangle; roll up from one end. Press ends even pinch to seal and tuck under loaf. Place seam side down in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Brush surface lightly with some of the melted butter. Repeat with other half of dough. Let loaves rise in warm place until tops are rounded 1 hour. Set oven rack at lowest level. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until deep golden brown and loaves sound hollow when tapped. If crust becomes too brown cover with brown paper. Turn out onto wire racks brush tops with remaining butter. Cool. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Nutty Crispies(Easy Cookies)
instructions: Line cookie sheet with sides with foil. Arrange separated crackers on foil side by side. Sprinkle nuts over top of graham crackers. Bring butter and brown sugar to a boil in small saucepan and pour over crackers evenly. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Remove from oven and let set a couple of minutes. Cut apart with knife while still warm and cool on wax paper. Makes about 3 dozen 1 1/2 x 3-inch cookies.

title: Bohemian Turkey Soup
instructions: Make and brown small meatballs and drain well. In large stock pot put chicken broth soup bone and cleaned giblets on medium flame approximately 1 hour. Remove soup one skim off and add vegetables. After another hour reduce flame. Add parsley meatballs and noodles after 10 to 15 minutes should be ready.

title: Cranapple Sherbet Punch
instructions: Mix sugar and water until sugar is dissolved. Mix remainder and stir well. Chill. Just before serving add 1/2 gallon pineapple sherbet. Makes 60 (1/2 cup) servings. Good for wedding and other receptions.

title: Low-Fat Vegetable Soup
instructions: Stir onion cabbage and celery in water. Simmer until tender. Add rest of the ingredients and simmer. Serve the next day. (One pound of ground turkey may be added.)

title: Five Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute celery green pepper and onion in sausage drippings until tender. In large roaster combine all of the ingredients except bacon. Put bacon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Goulash
instructions: Combine flour salt paprika and mustard. Roll meat in flour mixture. Brown meat slowly in hot oil. Sprinkle remaining flour mixture over meat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Then remove vegetables and bay leaf. Pack meat into jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Cover with sauce 1 pint 1 hour 1 quart 1 hour and 15 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar milk margarine and cocoa in a deep saucepan. When it starts to boil time it for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter if you desire. Add vanilla oatmeal and peanut butter. Stir briskly until it loses its gloss. Spoon onto wax paper using a tablespoon.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottom only of muffin tin or line with baking cups. Combine all ingredients except for blueberries. Mix well. Now add blueberries. Mix just until blended. Fill cups and bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Italian Cake With Chocolate Icing
instructions: Beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until stiff peak forms. Set aside. Beat butter and shortening until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well. Add egg yolks 1 at a time beating until blended after each addition. Combine flour cocoa and baking soda; add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Beat at low speed until blended after each addition. Stir in coconut chopped pecans and vanilla. Fold in egg whites. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8 inch cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes our clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove cake layers to wire rack and cool completely.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
instructions: Use wooden spoon to stir up ingredients which are placed into a pot. Cook until tender.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all and add dressing as much as desired. There may be too much dressing for this recipe. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream the butter cream cheese and sugar. Mix milk and pudding; add to butter mixture and mix well. Add Cool Whip; mix again. Crush Oreos; use food processor. Take a new flowerpot and layer Oreos then mixture starting and ending with oreos. You can use gummy worms in the cake and place silk flowers on top.

title: Fried Peach Pies
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and 1 teaspoon of salt; cut in 1/3 cup butter with pastry blender until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle cold milk (1 tablespoon at a time) evenly over surface. Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Shape into a ball. Chill.

title: Snow Salad
instructions: Drop marshmallows in boiling water dissolve well. Add jello and cool. Add pineapple to cheese and mix well then add to cooled gelatin mixture. Add whipped cream and nuts pour into large pan 8 x 14-inch chill well and serve. May use a large jello mold.

title: Diabetic Chocolate Millionaires
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add quick cooking oatmeal to desired consistency. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Place in freezer to harden. (This can be rolled into waxed paper and sliced after hardening.)

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Blend together all ingredients except oil. Turning blender on low speed add oil very slowly in a steady stream. Stir in a few extra seeds. Chill until ready to serve.

title: White Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Cook in chicken broth until soft. Chop onion celery cabbage and garlic. Cook in small amount of oil until soft. Add to beans. Add ham salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Melt margarine in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Place biscuits in pan. Cover with grated cheese. Bake in preheated oven according to package directions.

title: Marinated Shrimp And Artichokes
instructions: Chill marinated artichokes and shrimp. Drain and quarter artichokes and combine with shrimp. Beat together the olive and vegetable oils vinegar mustard chives scallions salt and pepper. Pour over the shrimp and artichokes. Refrigerate several hours. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies in food processor. Set aside.

title: Polly Smith'S Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix the pudding and pineapple. Add remaining ingredients and blend everything together. Refrigerate until cold.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: You will need 2 (8-inch) pans and 1 straw or butter knife.

title: Texas Matador
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions and drain. Brown meat with salt sugar and pepper in a skillet. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and garlic and cook for 10 minutes over low heat. Add the noodles sour cream cream cheese and green onions. Place in a casserole dish and cover with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 8 people.

title: Diabetic Yogurt
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water.\tCombine cold water and\tenough\tice cubes to measure 1 cup. Add to gelatin and stir until\tslightly thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. Stir in yogurt and vanilla. Pour into individual dishes and chill until set about 30 minutes.\tMakes 2 1/2 cups of 5 servings.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dip chicken into eggs then into bread crumbs and arrange in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Take out and pour pasta sauce over chicken and top with cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

title: Taco Burgers
instructions: Crush enough corn chips to make 1/3 cup. Mix ground beef chips and seasoning mix. Shape into 6 patties. Set oven to broil. Broil patties 5 minutes; turn and broil for 3 minutes more. Crisscross cheese strips on each patty and sprinkle with paprika. Broil until cheese is puffed and golden.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook veggies and drain well. Add chicken oleo cheese soup salt and pepper. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 (also good with ham instead of chicken and cream of mushroom soup instead of cream of chicken).

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter or oleo in jelly roll pan. Sprinkle on graham cracker crumbs nuts chocolate chips butterscotch chips and coconut. Pour evenly over top Eagle Brand milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until coconut is brown.

title: Tostado Dip
instructions: Layer refried beans mixed with taco mix. Layer sour cream with carton of avocado dip. Layer grated Cheddar cheese. Layer green onions and black olives. Refrigerate until chilled. Serve with taco chips.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Spread rice on bottom of oblong dish. Dissolve bouillon in water and pour over rice. Place pork chops on rice. Pour mushroom soup and water over chops. Sprinkle onion soup over all. Cover with foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Chicken can be substituted for chops.

title: Hedge Hogs
instructions: Cook first 6 ingredients for 5 minutes. Stir in Rice Krispies. Roll in balls. Then roll balls in mixture of coconut and confectioners sugar. Makes about 24 balls.

title: Golden Potato Squares
instructions: Saute onion in butter add milk and bring to boil. Mix remaining ingredients. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Save 1/2 cup cheese to sprinkle on top and bake 30 minutes more. Cut in squares to serve. Good with ham and cole slaw. May be refrigerated overnight before baking.

title: Frozen Pineapple Torte
instructions: Beat egg yolks salt and 1/2 cup sugar. Add pineapple syrup and lemon juice. Cook in double boiler stirring constantly until thick. Add pineapple. Cool.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: In skillet brown beef. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place ground beef in bottom of glass dish then pour soup over beef. Place Tater Tots on top of meat and soup. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until Tater Tots are brown.

title: Chopstick Tuna
instructions: Mix together and bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Inexpensive and very good for tuna.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Stir apples and sugar together and let stand until sugar is dissolved. Mix in remaining ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes in an 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Lemon Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop from spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0. Garnish with pecan halves if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Low Cholesterol Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Sift baking powder and flour together. Add to sugar mixture with milk. Fold in egg whites vanilla and lemon flavoring. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add broccoli and cook until soft. Mix with remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat together the shortening sugars egg water and vanilla until creamy. Sift together flour salt and soda; add to creamed mixture. Blend. Stir in oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Cook over low heat first 4 ingredients for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/2 cups Rice Crispies. Add rest of Rice Crispies if needed. Prepare aluminum foil with part of coconut; spread over to put mixture on adding more coconut as needed.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Soften butter; dont melt. Cream softened butter with sugar; beat well. Add flour corn meal and eggs. Pour in buttermilk and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs (slightly) and combine sugar salt nutmeg and vanilla slowly. Add milk. Mix well. Pour into 9-inch pie pan. Bake in hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Then in moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter shortening and both sugars. Add eggs and beat well. Blend in flour and soda; mix in vanilla. Roll in small balls. Sprinkle with sugar and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass or refrigerate until firm (overnight) and roll out and cut with cutters. Color may be added. Best when soft (before refrigerating). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Artichoke, Potato And Bacon Salad With Fennel Flowers
instructions: Wash and cook potatoes just until tender. Cut onion lengthways into quarters and cut thinly crosswise. Soak in cold water. Cut peppers into strips 1/4 x 1-inch long. Cut artichokes in half. Slice artichokes crosswise in 1/4-inch slices.

title: Deep Pit(From The Oven)
instructions: You will need freezer paper and string.

title: Hot Chicken, Shrimp Or Crab Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and potato chips; put in casserole. Combine cheese and potato chips and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350 degrees until hot 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Prepare herb stuffing as directed on package. Set aside. Melt 3 tablespoons butter. Add onion and saute until glassy. Add soup and cheese stirring until heated through and cheese is melted. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add the cooked carrots. Turn into greased casserole (2-quart). Cover with stuffing mix. Drizzle 1/3 cup melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Squash Casserole 1
instructions: Mix all ingredients. If bacon drippings are cold melt them first. Pour into ungreased dish. Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs and sugar until light and fluffy. In a double boiler melt chocolate and butter over hot water. Add egg mixture to the chocolate mixture. Combine flour baking powder and nuts in a bowl. Add to chocolate batter and stir until smooth. Put in a greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Let cool and then cut into squares.

title: Rich Lemon Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Press into bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes. Meanwhile in a large bowl combine eggs granulated sugar baking powder ReaLemon and remaining 3 tablespoons flour. Mix well. Pour over baked crust for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Cool. Cut into bars. Sprinkle with additional confectioners sugar. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Holiday Pecan Logs
instructions: Butter an 8 inch square pan with 2 tsp. butter set aside. Combine powdered sugar and dry milk set aside. In a heavy saucepan combine 1/2 cup butter sugar and corn syrup; cook and stir until it comes to a boil and sugar is dissolved. Stir in powdered sugar about 1/3 at a time until blended. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Continue stirring until mixture thickens and mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon. Spread into prepared pan. Cool. Cut candy into four strips. Cut each strip in half. Shape each strip into a log shape. Wrap in waxed paper twist the ends. Freeze or refrigerate until firm. In heavy saucepan or microwave melt caramels with milk. Stir often. Roll logs in caramel mixture then in pecans. Wrap in waxed paper. Store at room temperature in airtight containers. Cut into slices with serrated knife.

title: Cream Puff Dessert
instructions: Cook water and oleo until oleo is melted then stir in flour; beat well. Let cool then add eggs one at a time; beat well. Spread in cake dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown (about 25 minutes).

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with no-stick cooking spray. Dip chicken in margarine and coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in prepared pan. Bake 20-25 minutes or until tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Heat strawberries sugar and Jell-O just enough to dissolve Jell-O; stirring constantly. Let cool. Mix pudding with milk as stated on package. Add sour cream to pudding. Fold in 3/4 of Cool Whip. Layer cake pudding mix and strawberries in a large dish repeating until all is used. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Orange-Pineapple Sherbet
instructions: Mix well. Pour into ice cream freezer can. Freeze until firm.

title: Sage-Onion Potatoes
instructions: Heat butter and oil in a large heavy skillet. Add the sliced potatoes; turn them to coat thoroughly in the butter and oil then cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Turn potatoes often so they cook evenly. Carefully add 1 cup boiling water to the potatoes in the pan. Add the scallions sage parsley and season with salt and pepper. Boil uncovered for 10 minutes until water evaporates. If potatoes arent done add 1/3 cup boiling water and cook 5 minutes more. Serve at once. Serves 4; 315 calories per serving.

title: Cincinnati Chili
instructions: Combine ground beef onions and water in saucepan. Simmer until beef turns brown. Add tomatoes vinegar and seasonings. Cover simmer 3 hours stirring occasionally. Fat will float. If time chill chili and lift off fat layer; if not spoon off fat.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except cheese and chips. Put in a 13 x 9 casserole dish and top with cheese and chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix syrup salt vinegar salt and pepper and butter in 2 quart pan. Stir constantly; bring to a boil over medium heat until mixture reaches the hard crack stage 290\u00b0. Add soda and mix well. Pour foamy mixture over corn.

title: Deer Stew
instructions: Cut deer up into small pieces; boil for about 1 hour and a half on medium-high. Dice onion potatoes and carrots; add to boiled meat after half hour cooking. Add all other ingredients and continue cooking for the other hour. Serves 3 to 6.

title: Seven Layer Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt butter in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter then pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients; press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Cut into bars. Store loosely.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix together dressing vinegar and sugar. Pour over other ingredients. Recipe can easily be doubled.

title: Frozen Orange Dessert
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Set aside 3/4 cup. Press remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Set aside. Combine condensed milk and orange juice concentrate. Fold in whipped topping and oranges. Spoon mixture over crust and sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cover and freeze until firm. Makes 12 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in small amount of oil until golden brown. Stir in tomatoes and paste; simmer 30 minutes stirring often. Stir in oregano and simmer 30 minutes more. Mix eggs and salt. Dip eggplant in eggs; then in bread crumbs. Fry in oil; drain on paper towels. Mix cheeses together. Pour 1 cup mixture in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with 1/3 eggplant and 1/3 cheeses. Repeat until used up. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Fireside Coffee
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in tightly sealed container. Use 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup of hot water.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix and roll into two rolls. Wrap in Saran Wrap and refrigerate 24 hours. Remove from wrap and place on broiler pan; cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chili -- Quick And Easy
instructions: Brown sausage ground beef onion and pepper in large skillet. Drain off excess grease. Put mixture in a large pot; add chili powder salt and pepper. Stir in tomatoes and beans. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Ham
instructions: Split rolls in half and brush with mixture of butter poppy seed mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Layer ham and cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Great for parties.

title: Tuna Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Chill then roll into ball. Roll ball in chopped pecans.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce onion peas and eggs. Sprinkle with bacon. Ice top with mayonnaise. Sprinkle top with shredded cheese.

title: Rice-Con-Queso
instructions: Spray a 1 1/2-quart casserole with cooking spray. Combine all ingredients and pour into casserole. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Microwave 1 pound of frozen bacon at Medium-low for 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Saute butter and onion until tender. Blend in flour. Gradually add chicken broth and cook until it thickens slightly. Stir in wild rice and salt. Simmer 5 minutes. Blend in half and half and sherry. Heat to serving temperature. Add meat and carrots at this time if desired. Mushrooms water chestnuts or chopped bacon may also be added at this time. Top with sliced almonds if desired. Serves 4.

title: Black Forest Cheesecake
instructions: Combine crumbs and margarine. Press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: This makes a very large salad.

title: Our Favorite Chocolate No-Bake Cookies(Kids' Stuff)
instructions: Form cake in a dragon cake mold with your favorite cake mix and bake. Get dry ice; place in small container at mouth of dragon. Decorate with green icing.

title: Pinakbet
instructions: Combine all ingredients except eggplant bitter-melon and okra. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer covered until beef is tender. Add eggplant bitter-melon and okra; cook for 15 minutes. If using canned bitter-melon add last 3 minutes of cooking.

title: Lemon Pepper Catfish
instructions: Wash fish and place in pan. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning. Cover. Broil for 10 minutes then turn catfish and repeat process cooking for another 10 minutes or until fish flakes apart.

title: Diet Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cut cabbage in small pieces. Add 2 cans mixed vegetables (Veg-All). Add 2 cans chicken broth. Add 1 large can whole tomatoes. Add large can tomato juice. Salt to taste. You can add green beans peas carrots or any canned vegetables.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add frozen orange juice vanilla wafers and nuts. Then roll balls in coconut and put in refrigerator.

title: Butterfinger Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix; let cool. Crush Butterfingers; set aside. Melt margarine in saucepan. Mix in sugar and mix well. Remove from heat. Stir in Cool Whip and mix well. Pinch 1/2 of cooled cake into punch bowl or trifle dish. Pour 1/2 of Cool Whip mixture over cake. Sprinkle layer with 1/2 crushed Butterfingers. Repeat layers and chill.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and heat. Serve with egg rolls.

title: Joseph'S Breakfast Drink
instructions: Blend well. Makes 2 (8-ounce) servings.

title: Christmas Hard Candy
instructions: To make this candy you will first need a large slab of marble on which to pour the hot candy. Possibly a large cookie sheet would suffice but Ive always used marble. You will also need several pairs of scissors and at least 3 additional people to help cut the candy before it sets up.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: In a large kettle cook potatoes carrots and celery in water until tender about 20 minutes. Drain reserving liquid and setting vegetables aside. In the same kettle saute onion in butter until soft. Stir in flour salt and pepper; gradually add milk stirring constantly until thickened. Gently stir in cooked vegetables. Add one cup or more of reserved cooking liquid until soup is desired consistency. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Marsha'S Dessert
instructions: Heat oleo nuts and flour in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Press down and let cool. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip on top of cool crust. Mix puddings with milk and let thicken. Pour over cream cheese topping. Top with Cool Whip and a few pecans.

title: Chicken Saltimbocca
instructions: Coat cutlets with mixture of flour salt and pepper. Brown in butter and remove as cooked. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons flour into pan drippings. (You may have to add more butter to drippings.) Stir in wine tomato sauce chicken broth lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste. Cook over low heat until sauce thickens.

title: Chicken Veronique
instructions: Skin and bone chicken breasts lengthwise. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; set aside.

title: Low-Fat Herbal Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Steam potatoes over steamer until sticky and not quite done still hard. Include garlic onion and herbs in steamer. Turn frequently. For serving 4 you may want to steam a batch of potatoes set aside and steam the other half with herbs.

title: Quick Lime Icebox Pie
instructions: Place Cool Whip in bowl and add lemon juice; mix. Stir in jello and sugar. Mix well. May add more sugar if needed for personal taste.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Remove string from around roast and discard. Place roast in roasting pan. Pour liquid from jar of peppers over roast. Remove stems from peppers and discard. Do not discard seeds. Chop peppers and sprinkle over roast. Place in warm oven (200\u00b0) before bedtime or in early A.M.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add your soups milk enchilada sauce and chopped green peppers to meat and simmer for about 10 minutes. In a greased (Pam spray) pan add ingredients as below Layer of meat mixture layer of crumbled Doritos and layer of grated cheese repeating layers until all material is used. Bake at 350\u00b0 in oven for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. All or parts of the casserole can be frozen.

title: Diabetic'S Cake
instructions: Combine applesauce oil egg and sugar substitute. Combine remaining ingredients and add them to applesauce mixture. Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until it tests done.

title: Italian Casserole
instructions: In a Dutch oven over medium heat cook sausage beef onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender; drain. Add tomato sauce and paste water and seasonings; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Add corn and olives; cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in noodles. Pour into two greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dishes; top with cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Yield 16 to 20 servings.

title: Oriental Omelet(From Joslin Diabetic Clinic)
instructions: Combine chicken bean sprouts water chestnuts and soy sauce and mix well. Set aside. Mix eggs water green pepper onion salt and pepper with a fork. Heat butter or margarine in a 10-inch skillet. Pour in egg mixture. With spatula draw cooked portions of egg toward center so that uncooked portions flow to bottom. Cook until bottom is set and lightly browned and top is creamy. Arrange chicken mixture on half of omelet. With spatula fold other half over and turn out on serving platter. Yields 2 servings. Each serving equals 3 ounces of meat and 1 vegetable.

title: Date Bread
instructions: Mix dates butter sugar and boiling water and add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Magic Apple Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and egg. Sift together baking powder and flour then add to sugar mixture. Toss together nuts and apple then add to batter.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix soup 3/4 cup cheese onions and ham together thoroughly. Now fold in broccoli. In separate bowl melt butter and mix in cracker crumbs. Mix well. Take half of crust mixture and spread over bottom of baking dish. Pour in soup mixture. Take remaining crust and smooth over top. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake between 375\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Combine sugar flour and salt; cut in shortening. Pour 1 cup buttermilk on top of flour mixture; add yeast to buttermilk and mix slightly. Add other cup of buttermilk and mix well. Knead on floured board. Store in covered container in refrigerator. Will keep 1 week. Take amount needed; roll or cut biscuits. Dip in melted butter. Biscuits are lighter if dough is allowed to double in bulk before baking. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix well and put in greased baking dish. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Combine all and cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick. Turn out onto floured wooden surface. Knead like bread until no longer sticky. Add food coloring.

title: Easy Rocky Road Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate chips over hot not boiling water stirring until smooth. Spread about 1/3 of the melted chocolate in buttered 8-inch square pan. Cover with marshmallows mixed with walnuts. Pour over remaining chocolate mixing slightly until marshmallows and walnuts are coated. Let set until firm. Cut in squares. Makes 1 2/3 pounds of candy.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Squeeze excess liquid from spinach. Place all ingredients in blender-blend till combined. Butter a souffle dish or 1 1/2 qt. baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 to 2 parmesan cheese - pour mixture in and bake at 375 degrees for 50 minutes or until puffed and golden.

title: Short Ribs
instructions: Sprinkle salt and pepper on all sides of short ribs and put into Dutch oven or a 3-quart covered casserole dish. In a small saucepan combine the tomato soup with the molasses vinegar liquid smoke and minced onion; bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Pour over short ribs; cover and bake in a 275\u00b0 oven for 3 to 4 hours or until very tender. Just before serving spoon off any excess fat. (If you prepare this dish ahead refrigerate it and then lift off the solidified fat before you reheat it.) Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook all ingredients in skillet for 3 minutes except beans; add beans. Put in crock-pot and cook until ready or simmer for 25 to 30 minutes atop stove.

title: Cumber Kimshi(Variation Of Traditional Korean Cabbage Kimshi)
instructions: Slice cucumbers very thinly and wilt with salt. Squeeze out water. Add spices. This keeps in the refrigerator for weeks. It gets hotter the longer it sets.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Bake in 8 x 12-inch pan at 350\u00b0. Batter will be thick depending on how juicy the apples are. If too thick to spread add 1 or 2 tablespoons water. No other liquid is necessary.

title: Grandma'S Brownies
instructions: Stir in a lots of love; mix and bake according to directions on box. Serve with lots of hugs and kisses.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Make cream sauce of butter flour salt pepper broth and milk. This will be thin. Add chicken and drained peas and carrots. Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Make pie crust; roll thin and cut out like biscuits. Place on top of chicken mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine all 7 ingredients and mix well (Jell-O pudding mix last). Bake 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quiche Casserole
instructions: Place bread evenly into a lightly greased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Set aside. Stir garlic powder into quiche filling. Pour over bread. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with pepper rings and bake 5 additional minutes. Let casserole stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all ingredients together into pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Recipe may be doubled to serve 16.

title: Orange Glazed Carrots
instructions: In a small saucepan combine sugar cornstarch salt and ginger. Add orange juice. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir in butter and pour over hot carrots. Stir to coat.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: In a skillet cook sausage until well done drain. Separate crescent rolls into 8-inch triangles. Place dough in 12-inch pizza pan with points toward center. Press over bottom and sides to form crust. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese. In a bowl stir eggs milk and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Carefully pour over mixture in crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or until set. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and eggs together thoroughly. Sift flour cream of tartar soda and salt together. Mix together.

title: French Cherry Delight
instructions: Beat eggs until stiff. Add vanilla. Fold in sugar crackers baking powder and nuts. Spread in loaf pan (grease well). Bake 325 degrees for 20 minutes (let completely cool).

title: Smothered Chicken
instructions: Combine flour salt pepper and paprika. Coat chicken with flour mixture. Melt margarine in heavy skillet. Brown chicken on both sides. Remove from heat. Brown remaining flour mixture in margarine until golden brown stirring constantly. Slowly stir in water to make gravy. Return chicken to skillet and add onions. Cover and cook on low heat until done about 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Auntie'S Green Bean Salad
instructions: Mix sugar vinegar and oil. Pour over vegetables. Cover and place in refrigerator. This salad will keep for weeks and improves with age.

title: Angel Cookies
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in condensed milk to which the extract and coloring have been added. Add nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Top each with a nut half; bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together by hand. Decorate top with cherries and crushed cashews

title: Cousin Susie'S Perfect Fudge
instructions: Combine chips and milk and microwave for 2 1/2 minutes. Stir and microwave 2 1/2 minutes more. Add vanilla and pecans. Pour into greased glass pan and refrigerate.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain and cool. Add tomatoes onion peppers cheese and pickle juice. Mix. Add remaining ingredients. Add celery seed and seasoned peppers to taste.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and flour. Add eggs and milk a little at a time mixing well. Cook on medium heat stirring until thick. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: 5 Day Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Mix sugar cream and coconut; refrigerate overnight. Bake cake as directed on package except use 3 round pans. Remove from pans; freeze then slice each layer in half. Remove filling from refrigerator to soften while slicing cakes. Spread filling on top of each layer stacking them. Refrigerate for 5 days.

title: Chicken And Sausage Gumbo
instructions: Place flour in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until caramel colored stirring flour every 5 minutes. Brown sausage in a Dutch oven or large skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Wipe drippings from Dutch oven. Brown chicken; drain and pat dry. Wipe drippings from Dutch oven. Cook onion green pepper and celery in Dutch oven (coated with cooking spray) until tender; sprinkle with browned flour. Gradually stir in water; bring to a boil. Add sausage (cut into 1/4-inch slices); add chicken garlic bay leaves Worcestershire sauce hot sauce thyme salt and green onions (optional). Reduce heat and simmer mixture (uncovered) for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes and 1/4 cup butter onions soup sour cream and cheese. Place in a buttered casserole. Mix remaining butter and crushed corn flakes and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix together and press into the bottom of a 10 x 13-inch dish the graham cracker crumbs 1 stick of butter and sugar.

title: Green Bean Relish
instructions: Slice beans in thin slivers. Cook 5 minutes. Cool. Cut onions in thin slices. Add beans along with mixture of salad oil lemon juice salt sugar pepper and paprika. Chill in refrigerator several hours to develop flavor. Serve as salad or relish.

title: Chocolate Delite
instructions: Make graham cracker crust in 9 x 9-inch dish by combining melted margarine and 2 tablespoons sugar. Refrigerate for 30 minutes until set. Combine microwaved/soft cream cheese and powdered sugar; mix. Add 1/2 tub Cool Whip; mix. Place next to crust. Cover with chocolate pudding. Finish top off with whipped cream. Chill.

title: Coconut-Orange Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Fold in whipped cream. Chill several hours. Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Dorito Dip
instructions: Brown chopped onions garlic and salt. Add drained tomatoes (puncture tomato in strainer to get out most of juice). Add drained chile peppers. Cook until all moisture is absorbed approximately 45 minutes over low heat stirring occasionally. Add cheese. Stir constantly until melted. Serve warm with Dorito chips. Can be cut in half for small gathering.

title: Brownies
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Cream butter. Blend in sugar and add eggs. Beat until smooth and fluffy. Add vanilla and stir in cocoa. Add flour alternately. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes in a buttered pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Dredge meat with flour. Saute mushrooms and onion in a little oil until onion is clear. Add beef and brown. Add tamari and spices. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Use a three or four pound boneless sirloin or rump roast. Boil on stove top until very tender. Cool and break up into small pieces. Take out all fatty pieces. Add enough catsup to moisten well and reheat. Serve on sandwich buns.

title: Chicken Crescent Casserole
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the first 8 ingredients. Cook over medium heat until hot and bubbly. Place in an 8 x 12-inch ungreased baking dish. Place the refrigerated dinner rolls over hot chicken mixture. Combine the cheese and melted margarine. Spread cheese mixture on rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Flaky Yellow Pastry
instructions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Very gradually add egg/water mixture while gently mixing with fork. Dont overwork dough.

title: Layered Salad(Makes 10 To 12 Servings)
instructions: Place lettuce and spinach in the bottom of a large salad bowl. Top with peas water chestnuts onion crumbled bacon and two sliced hard-boiled eggs. Sprinkle with salt then pepper as desired. Combine mayonnaise and sour cream stirring well. Spread mayonnaise mixture over salad to seal tightly. Sprinkle with cheese then sugar. Garnish with remaining 2 hard-boiled egg slices. Chill 8 hours or overnight.

title: Cornflake Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites sugar and vanilla together until stiff. Add coconut and cornflakes. Mix until blended. Drop onto buttered cookie sheet by teaspoons. Bake at 250\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Easy Asparagus Au Gratin
instructions: Sauce Melt margarine in a saucepan. Stir in flour until well blended. Slowly stir in 2 cups milk. When sauce is smooth and hot reduce heat and stir in cheese. Season with salt pepper Dijon mustard and Worcestershire sauce.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Process vegetables in food processor until well chopped. Mix all with turkey. Form into burger and bake.

title: Chicken Primavera
instructions: Brown chicken. Remove from skillet and blend soups and paprika. Add chicken and vegetables. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until chicken and vegetables are tender. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Layer hamburger carrots onions and potatoes in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour tomato soup over this and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Dessert
instructions: Set out 1/2 gallon ice cream to soften. Roll crackers fine. Melt oleo and combine with crumbs except a handful saved out for on top. Pat mixture on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat together pudding and milk. Fold into the ice cream. Pour over crumb crust. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with crumbs. Set in refrigerator for 8 hours. Cut in squares. Fast and easy.

title: Joan'S Dip
instructions: Chop meat and onions (greens only) and mix with cream cheese soup and sour cream. Serve with Ritz or Club crackers or with party rye bread.

title: Iris' Chicken
instructions: Place chicken thighs in shallow casserole. Mix soup with 1/4 cup of water and pour over chicken. Cover with thin cheese slices then place Stove Top stuffing on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Freezes beautifully. Nice served with asparagus or Chinese pea pods. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 2 tablespoons juice. Combine brown sugar and butter in 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange pineapple slices in pan cutting slices if necessary. Place a cherry half cut side up in center of each slice. Sprinkle with reserved juice and then nuts. Combine cake mix Dream Whip right from envelope eggs and water in large mixer bowl. Blend then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Carefully spoon over mixture in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until top springs back when lightly pressed. Let stand in pan for 10 minutes and then invert onto serving plate. Let stand 1 minute then remove pan. Serve warm or cold. May also be topped with Cool Whip.

title: Turtle Cookies
instructions: Empty caramels in saucepan with 1/3 cup of milk. Melt stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Combine cake mix 1/3 cup milk melted butter and nuts. Press two-thirds of cake mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Spread caramel mixture over top of chips. Add remaining cake mix by spoonfuls on top of caramels. Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while warm. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Nacho Pizza
instructions: Cut tortillas in quarters making 16 wedges. Place vegetables evenly on wedges on 2 baking sheets. Spoon sauce over vegetables and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese starts to brown. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in airtight container. To serve place 1/3 cup mix in cup and add 1 cup boiling water.

title: Hamburg Casserole With Cheesy Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Fry hamburg onion and peppers. Let cool. Cook potatoes and celery and add milk and flour; cook until creamy. Place layer of potatoes then layer of hamburg ending with potatoes on top. Mix biscuit mix (buttermilk kind). Roll biscuit dough out flat and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Roll up like jelly roll and cut; place on top of potatoes. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Tamale Casserole
instructions: Remove tamales from can reserving liquid. Remove husks from tamales cut tamales in half crosswise and place in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish. Spoon reserved liquid over tamales. Spread chili over tamales and sprinkle with cheese. Top with corn chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serves 4.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add beef broth. Cook and simmer. In soup bowls or crocks place croutons and sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Add soup and top with provolone cheese slices.

title: Chicken Budapest
instructions: Soak raisins in mandarin juice. Melt butter brown chicken breasts on both sides. Cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is done. Remove chicken from skillet place on serving platter and keep warm. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of pan drippings and stir in flour paprika salt and pepper mix. Add half and half and cook over low heat until smooth and thick. Stir in raisin and mandarin juice mixture and heat through. Pour sauce over chicken. Serve over wild rice. Serves 6.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan cook onion in margarine until tender. Add potatoes salt bacon bits pepper and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir in clams and milk. Heat. Do not boil. Makes 6 servings about 130 calories each.

title: Jamaican Fruit Cake
instructions: Presoak fruit in wine or rum. Combine fruits and nuts. Sift flour and mix 2 cups with fruit and nuts. Cream butter until soft and blend with sugar. Add eggs singly beating well. Add jelly.

title: Greek Potatoes
instructions: Place all ingredients in plastic Ziploc bag and shake to coat evenly. Place in shallow baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours stirring several times during baking. Cover with foil if it browns too fast.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Cut strawberries in half to use in cake (save other half for icing). Mix all the ingredients. Pour into 2 layer cake pans; bake in 325\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Mama'S Pineapple Salad
instructions: Cook beaten egg yolks pineapple juice sugar and butter in double boiler until done. Thicken with flour. Pour this cooked custard over pineapple apples and nuts and chill.

title: Oriental Dish
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into strips. Marinate chicken strips in soy sauce cherry wine and cornstarch for 20 minutes. Saute chicken in cooking oil until brown. Add onion garlic and bell pepper with carrots. Cook until vegetables turn a bright color. Add broccoli slaw mix sesame seed and ginger. Serve with white rice. Serves 4.

title: Camper'S Cocoa
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Store in an airtight container. Stir in 1/2 to 3/4 cup dry mix into a mug of hot water.

title: Hash Brown Casserole(Low-Fat Version)
instructions: Saute onion slightly in Pam-sprayed pan. Add flour mustard salt and pepper. Gradually add milk and broth stirring constantly. Cook until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream. Combine with potatoes and top with cheese and corn flakes if desired. Bake in 13 x 9-inch Pam-sprayed pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Hello Dollies
instructions: Melt margarine in square cake pan. Add rest of ingredients in layer as listed. Bake at 325\u00b0 until firm 25 to 30 minutes. Cut in small pieces while still warm.

title: Chicken Tarragon
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt pepper and paprika. In skillet over medium-high heat in hot butter or margarine cook chicken pieces until well browned. Sprinkle tarragon over chicken. Add onion and mushrooms to skillet. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 25 minutes or until tender. Skim fat from liquid. Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown steak and saute with onions and mushrooms. Add rest of the ingredients and then add sour cream. Serve over buttered noodles with poppy seed.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine the flour sugar and baking powder. Stir in corn eggs pimentos salt pepper and milk. Pour in buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Dot top with butter. Add decorative dashes of paprika. Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tasty Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients and make a loaf.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs flour buttermilk and vanilla. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: One Pot Pork Chop Supper
instructions: In skillet brown pork chops. Pour off fat. Add rest of ingredients. Cover; simmer 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Reuben Spread
instructions: Mix well all ingredients together. Serve with rye crackers or rye cocktail bread.

title: No Crust Cheesecake
instructions: Beat eggs well in glass bowl. Fold in sugar and softened cheese. Beat until smooth. Grease a 9-inch pie pan (glass) well with oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes filling will sink slightly to form its own crust. Let cool then cover with your favorite topping (cherry pie filling berry etc.).

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread ingredients on tray or platter by layers listed. Top with lots of cheese and arrange olives to look nice. Use taco chips to dip.

title: Long John Silver Fish Batter
instructions: Blend beer flour butter egg yolks and seasoning. Let stand for 10 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into batter. Dip cleaned and deveined shrimp or fish into batter. Deep fry at 375 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Nippy Carrots
instructions: Use pancake mix and in the place of water in the recipe use light colored pop (like 7-Up or ginger ale). It will make the pancakes very light.

title: Tiny Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into 4 rectangles pinch edges to seal. Stir together sugar powdered sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over rectangles. Roll up jelly roll fashion starting with long side. Press edges to seal. Cut each log into 5 slices and place in lightly greased 8 in. round cake pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes. Combine powdered sugar milk and vanilla. Stirring until smooth. Drizzle over warm cinnamon rolls.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Measure raw rice into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix dry onion soup mix cream of chicken soup and 1 soup can of water. Arrange pieces of chicken on top (legs thighs and breasts are good). Sprinkle chicken generously with paprika. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven covered for 1 1/2 hours. Then if chicken is tender let it brown uncovered for 15 more minutes. Watch that the rice mixture stays moist. You might want to add a little hot water. This is good baked in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan covered tightly with foil. The paprika gives the chicken color. Also there is no salt added as the soups give plenty of flavoring.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust. Crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust and brush with beaten egg if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Harvest Bowl Salad
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar salt and lemon juice; cook until thick in double boiler stirring constantly. Cool. Whip the cream and fold into cooled egg mixture. Combine fruits pecans and celery; fold into dressing. Serves 10.

title: Microwave Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in greased 8-inch square dish. Cook at full power for 6 to 7 minutes rotating dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes of cooking.

title: Blueberry Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Put in 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Sausage-Bread Stuffing
instructions: In a large skillet fry the sausage and bacon until crisp and brown. Remove sausage and cut into 1-inch pieces. Replace in skillet and add onion celery mushrooms apples parsley and herbs. Saute stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Stir in bread cubes and chicken broth. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in margarine until tender. Remove from skillet and place in a bowl. Add flour salt and pepper. Mix well and while stirring gradually add beef bouillon. Fry bread cubes or croutons in margarine in the skillet. Combine with onion mixture.

title: Strawberry Dream Pie Filling
instructions: Mix strawberry halves jello and yogurt. Add ice cream and mix well. Pour into a prepared light graham cracker pie crust. Place in freezer for at least 4 hours before serving. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before serving. 8 servings per pie. Calories 212.7 and fat 3.05 grams.

title: Arlene'S Appetizer
instructions: Cut off top of bread and take out insides. Mix all other ingredients in large bowl. Pour mixture inside bread shell. Replace top of bread and wrap in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours stirring every 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix ice cream and peanut butter on low speed. Pour into cookie pie crust. Freeze 3 hours. Top with 1 jar of ice cream fudge topping. Return to freezer. Serve with whipped topping on top of each slice.

title: Tangy Tuna Cocktail
instructions: Lightly mix tuna eggs pickles and radishes. In a small bowl blend mustard lemon juice vinegar salt and cayenne. Gradually stir in salad oil with a fork until dressing is well blended. Mix dressing lightly with tuna mixture. If you wish cover and chill for 30 minutes to 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
instructions: Mix syrup and sugar; bring to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter and then stir in the Rice Krispies. Pour into a greased pan. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Knox Gelatin Squares
instructions: Mix unflavored gelatin into cold water. Mix Jell-O into hot water. Then mix both together. Pour into Pam sprayed glass 9 x 12-inch pan. Set until firm.

title: Potato Stuffing
instructions: Mix together very good. May use in any recipe calling for stuffing.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Stir ingredients by hand until mixed. Plug in freezer.

title: Pasta Con Presto
instructions: Chop 2 cloves of garlic in food processor. While processor is still running add fresh Parmesan cheese Italian parsley pine nuts fresh basil salt and vegetable oil. When mixture is soft and pasty spoon sauce over freshly cooked hot spaghetti and mix thoroughly. Add grated Parmesan as topping.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine. Sift together flour baking powder salt and cocoa. Beat eggs then add sugar. While beating add vanilla and melted margarine. Stir in dry ingredients. Add pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Makes 12 bars.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie(Makes 8 Or 9-Inch Pie)
instructions: Cook in double boiler the egg yolks sugar grated rind and juice of lemon and dash of salt stirring frequently until consistency of thick custard. Dissolve gelatin in water and add to hot custard. Mix well. Cool.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. If desired cover top with chopped pecans before baking.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening. Gradually add sugar beating at low speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add egg chocolate and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk stirring well. Stir in pecans or walnuts. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls about 1 1/2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes or until done. Remove to wire racks. Frost with Chocolate-Coffee Frosting while still warm. Yields about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Strawberry Angel Squares
instructions: Cut half of the angel food cake into 1-inch cubes. Pour boiling water on gelatin in a large bowl; stir until the gelatin is dissolved. Stir in reserved pineapple juice. Place cottage cheese in blender container. Cover and blend on medium speed stopping blender frequently to scrape sides (about 15 seconds). Return mixture to large bowl. Stir in pineapple strawberries and cake cubes. Pour into square baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inches). Refrigerate until firm at least 6 hours. Garnish with fresh strawberries if desired.

title: Tea Cookies
instructions: Mix softened butter with 1/2 cup sugar vanilla flour and baking soda. Mix in pecans and form balls about the size of a round tablespoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and roll in more powdered sugar.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Drain all beans. Cook meats and onion in skillet. Drain. Stir in catsup mustard and vinegar. Combine remaining ingredients in 3-quart casserole stir in meat cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until bubbly. Garnish with bacon if you wish. Serves 8.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in order listed. Refrigerate for 2 hours before serving. Serve with Tostitos.

title: Bubble Bread
instructions: The night before serving Grease a Bundt or tube pan. Evenly place frozen rolls in bottom of pan; sprinkle with dry pudding mix. Next sprinkle brown sugar and pecans over rolls then pour melted margarine over the top. Place pan in cold oven overnight. As rolls thaw bread will rise.

title: Apple Bread
