instructions: In bowl combine flour cinnamon soda powder and salt. Set aside. In large bowl place oil sugar eggs vanilla and apples. Stir flour mixture; add walnuts and mix. Divide mixture between two greased 8 x 4-inch bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until bread tests done. Cool for 10 minutes on rack before removing from pans.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut up sausage into small pieces and cook. Melt cheese add soup to cheese stir until well blended. Cook broccoli. In a seperate bowl mix stuffing sausage celery and onions. Place cut up chicken in bottom of pan then broccoli then pour soup and cheese mixture on top. Top with stuffing mixture. Bake for 40 min. till cheese bubbles and stuffing browns.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Use for dipping apple slices celery crackers etc.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Tetrazzina
instructions: Combine and heat soup water and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted stirring occasionally. Add spaghetti chicken pepper and parsley. Heat through stirring or pour into baking dish and heat in microwave or oven until hot. Serves 4.

title: Spring Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine mixture together. Chill. Serve with fresh vegetables or chips.

title: Garlic Steak
instructions: Dredge steak in flour; pound to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut steak into serving size pieces. Brown steaks in hot oil in a Dutch oven. Remove from skillet and set aside. Add onion to pan drippings; saute until tender. Return steak to Dutch oven; add remaining ingredients except noodles. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until steak is tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Applesauce Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt soda and cinnamon together. Stir in walnuts and raisins tossing to coat well with flour mixture.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add strawberries pineapple bananas and nuts. Pour half into 2-quart mold. Chill until firm. Spread sour cream over.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening; add sugar and beat until smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda. Add to cream mixture alternating with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla; add coconut and chopped nuts. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in a 3 (8-inch) pans greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Beat egg and 1 tablespoon water. Roll chicken in mixture then in bread crumbs. Brown chicken in shortening. Pour off fat. Stir in soup water onion and seasonings. Cover and cook for 45 minutes on low heat stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

title: Queen Victoria'S Soup(Serves 8)
instructions: Put the chicken in a large saucepan. Cover with the stock and parsley. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Curried Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Golden Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops in deep fat quickly. Pour off grease. Add soup water diced celery pepper and onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook for 30 minutes with lid on pan. Cook on medium heat on top of stove.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Mix last 3 ingredients; pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours basting occasionally.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Melt cheese in medium saucepan. Mix Bisquick and sausage thoroughly then add melted cheese and mix. Form into small balls; bake until lightly browned in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 20 to 30 minutes. Can be frozen before or after baking. (Good party recipe.)

title: Nothing Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and brown sugar in mixer bowl until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into 3-quart glass cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream and chocolate or butterscotch sauce.

title: Lesueur Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill on bed of lettuce.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Mix flour soda and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla and flour mixture and mix well. Shape in round loaf. Wrap in waxed paper and chill over night. Cut in thin slices and bake in 350 oven.

title: Trailblazer'S Chili(Serves 10)
instructions: In saucepan heat olive oil. Add onions and cook until tender. Add meat and cook until done. Add chili powder salt and pepper. Stir in tomatoes and beef broth. Bring to a boil then lower heat. Simmer for 30 minutes. The chili will be very thick.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together equal parts of ingredients; keep refrigerated.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix dry goods in a medium bowl. Soften shortening in the baking pan or iron skillet in oven at 300\u00b0. Pour into the bowl with the dry goods. Turn oven to 425\u00b0. Add egg and milk. Stir. Pour into pan/skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden on top. (Clabber Girl recipe.)

title: Barbecue Burgers
instructions: Mix together. Make patties and brown. Place patties in baking dish.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until done. Beat sour cream and cream cheese together. Add hot potatoes and beat until smooth. Add butter chives salt and pepper. Pour into a well-greased 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Can be made the day before. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix pulp eggs and sugar together. Add milk then flour cinnamon and nutmeg. Add butter. Bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Crock-Pot Pork Chops And Stuffing
instructions: Prepare Stove Top stuffing by mixing all ingredients together. Place stuffing in bottom of crock-pot. Brown and season pork chops to taste. Place pork chops on top of stuffing. Cover and cook on low until meat is tender 2 to 3 hours.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
instructions: Place blueberry pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Cover with pineapple. Pour on dry cake mix and sprinkle nuts on top. Melt butter and drizzle over all. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve topped with whipped topping.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cook and stir onion celery green pepper and garlic in oil until tender not brown. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and seasoning. Simmer uncovered 45 minutes. Cook over low heat. Mix cornstarch with 2 teaspoons water. Stir into sauce. Add shrimp. Cover and simmer until tender about 5 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: In a bowl combine cabbage carrots and green pepper. Chill. Mix Miracle Whip sugar vinegar Ranch dressing mix celery seed and salt. Toss with vegetables.

title: Whiskey Slush
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Freeze. Spoon 1/2 cup in glass and fill glass with Fresca Squirt or Wink.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Prepare popped corn. Combine next 4 ingredients. Bring to a boil; boil 5 minutes and stir occasionally. Remove and add soda. Stir and pour over corn. Put on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Glazed Onions
instructions: Peel onions; cut into even slices. Heat butter in large skillet. Add onions and toss for a few minutes until coated with butter. Do not brown. Add vinegar brown sugar and curry powder. Stir to blend. Add parsley. Cook onions for about 5 minutes covered until almost tender-crisp. Remove cover and cook onions for 2 to 3 minutes until glazed. Season with salt black pepper and paprika. Add chili.

title: Homemade Salsa
instructions: Finely chop the first 3 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients. Better to make ahead and let marinate. May need to drain off some of the liquid that forms. Serve with Doritos chips. Delicious!

title: Marinated Sliced Pickles
instructions: In a large bowl marinate at room temperature for 24 to 30 hours. Mix occasionally during marinating. Then you can store in jars (whatever size you want). If spices are in cheesecloth throw them away. Refrigerate. Keeps for weeks.

title: Picklelets
instructions: Beat the egg and sugar until thick and add with the milk to the sifted flour salt and baking powder. Lastly add the melted butter. Mix until smooth and cook in spoonfuls on a hot grease griddle or frying pan. Serve with butter jam or sliced strawberries.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add pineapple (with juice). When cooled add cottage cheese Eagle Brand and nuts. Stir. Congeal.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oil and sifted dry ingredients. Add carrots. Stir nuts in last. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Aunt Sandy'S No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients together until they boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from stove and add the other ingredients all at once. Mix together quickly. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Let harden. The secret to this recipe is to work quickly and time carefully.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together (dont beat) and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: 7-Up Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients into Ziploc bag; shake to mix. Add 4 to 6 turkey tenderloins cut into 2-inch strips. Marinate for at least 2 hours in refrigerator. Great on the grill.

title: Carrots And Walnuts
instructions: Cook carrots with water until tender (5 minutes in microwave or 10 to 15 minutes in covered pan over medium heat). Combine olive oil nuts lemon peel and seasoning salt in a bowl. Add carrots. Toss. Serve warm. Serves 4.

title: Bacon And Egg Bake
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain fat reserving 2 tablespoons. Saute onions in bacon fat. Stir in soup milk eggs cheese and seasonings. Bake in an 8 x 8-inch dish for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with crumbled bacon and serve over muffin halves.

title: Drop Dumplings
instructions: Combine until just moistened. Drop by spoonfuls onto bubbling stew chicken and gravy etc. Cover and simmer 12 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in enough water to cover them and cook until tender. Then add tuna soup and milk. Pour into greased casserole dish. Melt 1/2 stick butter and crumble about 4 slices of bread; mix in the melted butter. Cover top of casserole with mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Japanese Fried Chicken
instructions: Blend all ingredients (except chicken). Add chicken soak for 20 minutes and deep fry.

title: Texas Rice
instructions: In 3-quart casserole combine the water uncooked rice soup mix and onion. Cover cook on 100% power (High) for 4 to 5 minutes or until boiling. Let stand covered 5 minutes. Stir before serving. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add milk oil eggs and corn. Mix well. Add peppers and onions. Pour 1/2 mixture into greased 9 x 14-inch baking pan or 10-inch iron skillet. Sprinkle 1/2 of Cheddar cheese; add balance of mixture. Top with remainder of cheese. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Cornbread Pot Pie
instructions: Mix meat peas corn cheese 1 cup milk onion and Worcestershire sauce. Pour into greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish or shallow 2-quart casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until bubbly at edges. Mix well baking mix cornmeal sugar salt egg and 2/3 cup evaporated milk. Pour on hot mixture leaving center uncovered. Spread to edges. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hot Bacon Dressing
instructions: Brown the Sizzlean on both sides and drain on paper towels. Stir together the dry ingredients. Stir in the egg vinegar and water. Add the bacon. Cook slowly stirring until thickened.

title: Monster Mash Potatoes
instructions: Peel and quarter potatoes. Cook in boiling water until tender. Drain and mash. Add next 4 ingredients and beat at medium speed until smooth. Put in greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peas And Peanut Salad
instructions: Cook peas. Drain and cool. Mix sour cream mayonnaise sugar dill seed mustard vinegar and salt until creamy smooth. (I add garlic powder too.) Add peas; blend. Add peanuts. Best served that same day.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Put in large mixing bowl and mix as little as possible. The batter will be a little chunky. Bake in tube pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pecan Clusters
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler or microwave. Stir in nuts; mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Makes approximately 20 to 25 pieces.

title: Hot Italian Submarine Sandwiches
instructions: Fill sandwich roll with ingredients. Add salt pepper and about two tablespoons Italian salad dressing. Roll in aluminum foil and bake about 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sauerkraut Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream eggs and butter in bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with 1 cup of water beating well after each addition. Stir in sauerkraut. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Frost with favorite frosting.

title: Peanut Butter Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and mix until spreadable consistency.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook water margarine sugar and Karo until it will spin a fine thread in a glass of cold water. Add peanuts and cook until light brown (this takes a bit of time you will start smelling the peanuts cook then cook a bit longer).

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Melt butter; mix crumbs in and press into 9 x 13-inch serving dish. Dissolve sugar in mixture of lemon juice and rind. Dissolve Jell-O in water and chill in refrigerator. Whip milk until thick; gradually add Jell-O beating. Stir in lemon mixture. Put in crust and chill. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs on top for garnish.

title: Seafood Newburg
instructions: Remove lobster from shell. Cut meat in bite size chunks and reserve. Make sauce of butter flour salt pepper milk and evaporated milk. Cook one minute. Beat egg yolks and stir in sherry. Stir in 1 cup sauce into the egg yolk mixture and then add this to the rest of the sauce. Cook for one minute or until thickened stirring constantly. Add lobster chunks scallops and shrimp and heat. Serve over rice.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well. Mix in remaining ingredients. Pour cake into greased round cake pans covered with wax paper. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Oven-Baked Apple-Pecan Pancake
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix pancake mix eggs water and 1 teaspoon sugar; mix well. In ovenproof skillet saute apples in butter until tender. Remove skillet from heat and sprinkle with nuts. Pour batter evenly over apples. Mix remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter. Cover skillet with lid or foil and bake 12 to 14 minutes or until pancake is puffed and sugar is melted.

title: One Dish Supper
instructions: Fry turkey burger in large skillet. Bring tomatoes to boil in turkey (cooked). Add dry rotini to boiling mixture. Cook about 7 or 8 minutes or until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Serve with green peas tossed salad and garlic toast.

title: Down South Marshmallow Brownies
instructions: Melt one stick butter and stir in all other ingredients except the marshmallows. Pour into a greased and floured 8 x 8 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. After baking cover the brownies with miniature marshmallows. Put back into oven long enough to melt the marshmallows but do not let them brown. Cover with icing.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix all ingredients. Toss with the Italian dressing which has been made according to package directions.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening sugars egg water and vanilla together until creamy. Sift flour salt and soda; add to cream mixture and blend well. Stir in oats; drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pistachio Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Lightly grease cookie sheets.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Bring to boiling first 3 ingredients and pour over tea bags. Steam 5 minutes and strain. Add the remaining ingredients and serve either hot or cold.

title: Tuna Or Salmon Dinner
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed. Mix all other ingredients and serve.

title: Orange Fruit Salad(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except jello. Then add jello last. Mix well and keep in refrigerator until firm.

title: Chocolate Chipper Champs
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix brown sugar margarine vanilla and eggs in a large bowl until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls about 3-inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Press 3 or 4 additional candies in each cookie if desired. Bake until light brown 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly. Remove to wire rack. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Buch'Ta
instructions: Warm milk add yeast and sugar; let melt. Add the eggs salt margarine (melted) and oil. Add flour and knead dough approximately 20 minutes. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken With Spicy Fruit Sauce
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large non-aluminum skillet bring to a boil. Add chicken and cover. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm. Bring cooking liquid to a boil; cook 7 minutes or until reduced to 3/4 cup stirring occasionally. Combine strawberry spread and cornstarch; stir into cooking liquid and cook 1 minute or until syrupy. Spoon 3 tablespoons sauce over each chicken breast garnish with green onion strips. Yields 4 servings 215 calories and 1.5 fat.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Sift sugar and flour together in bowl; set aside. In saucepan melt butter; add cocoa and Coca-Cola. Bring to a boil; boil one minute. Add to dry ingredients. Mix buttermilk and soda and add. Add eggs and vanilla; stir until smooth. Last stir in marshmallows. Pour into greased pan (9 x 13-inch); bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and shortening with sugar. Add eggs one at a time and blend well after each. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Delicious Potatoes
instructions: Melt cheese and oleo; mix in half and half all in pan. Pour over potatoes and let stand for an hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy Garden Caesar Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Serve the dip in a shallow bowl or small hollowed out bell pepper. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Ranch House Casserole
instructions: Melt shortening in skillet over medium heat. Place meat in skillet and scramble it. Let it cook until done but not brown. Add all other ingredients and turn heat to low; heat and let it simmer until hot.

title: Sausage Treats
instructions: Mix all together well. Make into very small biscuits. Cook on cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Soup With Matzo Balls
instructions: Place chicken water onions leek celery salt and pepper in 8 to 10-quart Dutch oven. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours. Add carrots and parsnips; simmer covered for 30 more minutes. Remove chicken and refrigerate if you are not planning to use as main meal. Lift vegetables from broth with slotted spoon then strain broth. Return vegetables to broth. Add parsley and dill if desired. Heat through and serve in bowls with Matzo Balls. Serves 15.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine fruit nuts and sour cream. Fold in cool whip and marshmallows. Refrigerate. Yields 10-12.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Put unflavored gelatin in cold water. Mix. Put flavored gelatin in large bowl and add boiling water. Add plain gelatin to flavored gelatin. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate to set (20 minutes).

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Macaroni Pie
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to boil. Add salt and macaroni; cook until tender. Grate cheese coarsely then put in large baking dish layering alternately with cooked macaroni. Beat eggs in milk; pour over this mixture. Take fork; mix well down through pie. Bake at 400\u00b0 or 450\u00b0 until brown about 20 minutes. Black pepper is optional.

title: Italian Love Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 11 x 13-inch pan. Make cake according to box directions; pour into pan. Mix vanilla sugar eggs and cheese. Pour gently over cake mix. Do not blend.

title: Chile Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion together. Layer chiles cheese meat and chiles in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together flour salt eggs milk and hot pepper sauce. Pour over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt together. Add milk beaten egg yolks and margarine. Cook until it bubbles good and gets thick. Let cool. Add 3 cups of sliced strawberries. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Overnight Tuna Casserole
instructions: Reserve 1/4 cup Cheddar cheese. Whisk soup and milk in 2-quart microwave-safe bowl until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients except reserved cheese. Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours or overnight.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion until red disappears. Add garlic onion salt chicken gumbo and catsup. Simmer for 2 hours. The longer it simmers the tastier it gets.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Mix other ingredients together. Add to cooled jello and chill.

title: Velvety Cocoa Frosting
instructions: In large bowl with mixer at low speed beat confectioners sugar cocoa butter water vanilla and egg yolk until smooth occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula.

title: Cherry Christmas Cake
instructions: Beat butter until softened and light. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat after each addition. Stir in almond flavor. Mix flour and salt together. Add to butter mixture alternately with milk (about 1/3 each time). Fold in nuts and cherries. Bake in greased tube or Bundt pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Charlotte Russe(Basic Recipe)
instructions: In a double boiler beat the egg yolks and add 2 tablespoons sugar gradually while beating. Add salt and milk. Cook over hot water until mixture coats the spoon stirring constantly. Soften gelatin in cold water; add to hot custard and stir until dissolved. Cool slightly. Beat egg whites stiff; fold in. Whip the cream; add remaining 3 tablespoons sugar and vanilla extract. Fold in. Line sherbet glasses or spring-form mold with the ladyfingers and fill with the custard. Chill until firm.

title: Minted Lime Mold Salad(Yield:  6 Servings)
instructions: Heat 1 cup water and limeade concentrate to boiling. Pour over gelatin in large bowl. Stir until dissolved. Stir in 1/2 cup cold water ginger ale and peppermint extract. Chill until partially set. Stir in pears and melon balls. Pour into 7 cup jello mold. Chill until firm. Unmold onto lettuce and garnish with extra cantaloupe balls and mint sprigs.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Cook chicken. Chop when cooled. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat the eggs and sugar together. Gradually add oil; add vanilla. Mix flour soda salt and cinnamon together. Gradually add flour mixture to first mixture (will be thick). Fold in apples. Add 1 cup nuts or raisins. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Use greased 9 x 13-inch sheet pan. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Poppy Seed Orange Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat all ingredients at low speed scraping bowl often until all ingredients are moistened. Spoon batter into greased tin. Bake 17 to 22 minutes.

title: Delicious And Healthy Pancakes
instructions: Preheat frypan or griddle. In medium bowl combine dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and skim milk; stir just until combined. Fold in egg white gently; add olive or salad oil. Cook on hot griddle which has been sprayed with nonstick spray. These pancakes contain no cholesterol.

title: Spinach Dip For Fresh Vegetables
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. Stir before serving. Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter sugar and sour cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each one. Add flour and baking soda which have been sifted together. Add flavoring. Bake in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done in center.

title: Sausage Roll-Ups Snacks
instructions: Cut smokey links lengthwise halfway through. Insert long thin wedge of dill pickle (drained) in each cut. Spread triangle of dough of crescent roll as label directs. Lightly spread each triangle with cheese. Place smokey link pickle side down on wide end of triangle and roll up toward point. Repeat with each roll and link. Arrange rolls on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush with melted butter or margarine and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until puffy and golden brown. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fudge Topping For Ice Cream
instructions: Boil chocolate and milk until thick about 3 minutes. Add sugar butter and marshmallows. Add vanilla.

title: Japanese Fruitcake Pie(Makes 2)
instructions: Mix butter sugar and eggs together (after butter has cooled to room temperature). Mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and pour evenly into unbaked pie shells. Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Black Bean Dip
instructions: Mash beans with fork. Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Gingersnap Crust
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in gingersnaps and sugar. Press evenly into the bottom of an oiled 9-inch spring-form pan and freeze until needed.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese onion and Worcestershire together. Form one ball and roll in chopped ham. Serve with crackers.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Stir jello into cottage cheese. Mix well. Add fruit. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill overnight. I sometimes use 3 ounce size fruit cocktail in place of oranges and pineapple.

title: Hamburger Corn Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions. Mix in next 8 ingredients. Stir in 3 cups cooked noodles. Top with bread crumbs. Pour melted butter over bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Buffalo Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together oil shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift in flour baking soda and powder. Mix in oatmeal Post Toasties chocolate chips pecans and coconut. Put 6 scoops on each cookie sheet with an ice cream scoop. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Grease or spray Pam on large square pan or dish. Pour 1/2 cake mixture in pan and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix melted caramels margarine and Eagle Brand milk. Pour over cake thats baked. Pour remaining cake batter over mixture. Sprinkle with nuts if desired. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Butterscotch Pudding Cake
instructions: Cook pudding as directed on box. Let cool. Add cake mix. Mix well. Pour into greased 9 X 13 pan. Add butterscotch morsels on top of cake. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes.

title: Parmesan Dip
instructions: In a small bowl with fork or wire whisk mix mayo anchovy fillets Parmesan cheese lemon juice and black pepper.

title: Lemon-Butter Broiled Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken quarters on both sides with salt and pepper. Melt butter in small saucepan; add lemon juice tarragon chervil and vermouth; brush part over chicken. Place chicken skin side down on rack of broiler. Broil 6 inches from heat for 20 minutes basting frequently. Turn; broil 15 to 20 minutes longer or until nicely browned brushing with remaining lemon-butter. Makes 4 servings.

title: Roasted Salted Pecans
instructions: Toss pecans in bowl with oil until well coated. Spread on cookie sheet; salt to taste. Cook at 400\u00b0 for about 10 minutes. Check; should be a little brown. Remove from oven and cool. Pack into containers.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Prepare Duncan Hines angel food cake mix according to directions on box. Let cool. Break into bite size pieces. Line 13 x 9-inch pan with pieces. Prepare 1 package chocolate pudding mix according to directions. As it begins to boil stir in 1 package chocolate bits. Cool slightly. Fold in 1 carton Cool Whip. Pour over angel food cake bits. Ice with 1 carton Cool Whip. Put pecan bits on top.

title: Asian Beef Stew
instructions: Heat wok over high heat 1 minute. Drizzle 1 tablespoon oil into wok. Heat 30 seconds. Add 1/2 of beef and stir-fry about 5 minutes until brown. Repeat with remaining beef. Remove beef to bowl; set aside. Add 1 tablespoon oil to wok. On medium heat add shallots. Cook 3 minutes. Remove to same bowl. Repeat same for onion and garlic. Return all beef and juices to wok; add water sugar salt anise seed cinnamon pepper and bay leaves. Reduce heat; cover 1 1/4 hours until meat is done. Peel carrots and turnips; cut into 8 wedges. Add carrots turnips shallots and lemon peel to beef. Cook until tender about 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf and lemon peel. Stir in tomato paste. Cook until sauce boils and thickens then serve.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook each separately until done. Season with salt. Drain well.

title: Andes Candies Cookies
instructions: In small saucepan combine margarine sugar and water until sugar has dissolved. Add chocolate chips till partially melted. Remove from heat and stir until chips are totally dissolved and mixture is smooth. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Put pecans in bottom of cake pan; spread cake mix over pecans. Melt stick of margarine; mix with cream cheese and powdered sugar. Pour over cake mix. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees. Serve with whipped topping or vanilla ice cream.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Wash and scrub each potato; dry with a paper towel. Cut each potato into eight wedges; arrange peel side down in a shallow baking pan. Mix the rest of the ingredients and brush over potatoes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until potatoes are golden and tender. Brush occasionally with mixture.

title: Rice Medley
instructions: Add enough water to reserved vegetable liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups. Pour into 2-quart saucepan. Heat to boiling. Stir in peas rice butter salt and carrot. Heat to boiling. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender about 10 minutes.

title: Pan Fried Liver
instructions: You will need an iron frying pan.

title: Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookie Dessert
instructions: Mix pudding and 2 cups of milk until smooth. Add chocolate Cool Whip; set aside. Crumble 1 box of thin mints in bottom of an 8 x 8-inch dish. Pour in half of the pudding mixture. Top with vanilla Cool Whip. Continue to layer saving 1/4 cup of cookie crumbs for top. I use a Tupperware container so I have the cover to store in the refrigerator overnight.

title: Cheese And Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook and stir onion in margarine in large skillet until tender. Stir in chicken 1/4 cup picante sauce and cream cheese; cook until thoroughly heated. Stir in 1 cup cheese.

title: Glaze For Fresh Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix and boil one minute. Pour over fresh strawberries or peaches in baked pie shell.

title: Potato Soup(Microwave)
instructions: Combine potatoes onions and water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish. Cook covered on full power 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir one time. Lightly mash potatoes. Stir in flour. Add milk salt and pepper. Cover and cook on full power 5 minutes longer stirring every minute or until soup boils and is thickened.

title: Miracle Brownies
instructions: Mix all together and beat well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut steak into bite size pieces; place in bowl. Salt and pepper to taste. Place in refrigerator for 2 hours. Brown flour with butter; gradually add beef consomme soup. Add mustard sour cream and catsup. Bring to a boil. Set sauce to one side.

title: Sausage Swirls
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Blend in vegetable oil. Add enough milk to make a stiff dough. Thinly roll out dough (1/4-inch thick) on a lightly floured board into two 10 x 18-inch rectangles. Spread on sausage; roll up lengthwise. Chill well and slice 1/4-inch thick. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Better Than Anything Cake
instructions: Bake yellow cake mix in 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine crushed pineapple and its juice and 1 cup sugar. Bring to boil for 5 minutes. Punch holes in cake and pour pineapple mixture over cake. Let cool. Prepare vanilla instant pudding. Pour over cool cake. Slice 3 bananas and layer over pudding. Spread with 8 once carton Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and coconut. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cut chicken as for frying place with seasonings in a large kettle with enough cold water to cover. Bring slowly to a boil simmer until meat comes off bones. Remove bones cut chicken in fairly large 1/2-inch pieces. Return to pot; add onions potatoes and butter beans. Cook until done; add tomatoes and corn cut from cob. Cook slowly for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cool Whip Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Prune Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar cooking oil and prune baby food well and add other ingredients. Grease and flour pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Italiano
instructions: In a large skillet combine chicken and 1/3 cup Italian dressing. Saute until chicken starts to brown. Add vegetables and remaining dressing. Cover. Simmer 7 to 9 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender stirring frequently. Serve over pasta or mix pasta with vegetables. Sprinkle with cheese. Yields 5 servings.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all together and put in muffin tins. Sprinkle pumpkin seed on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Conga Bar
instructions: Melt margarine and add sugar. Stir and let cool. Add eggs (one by one) flour and vanilla. Stir. Add peanuts and chocolate chips. Stir again. Pour mix in greased rectangular pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Fill a 9 x 9-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan full of apple slices. (Spray pan with vegetable spray first). Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cinnamon and sugar.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix flour honey and salt together. Add milk gradually. Add beaten eggs and butter. Beat for 2 minutes. Add blueberries sprinkled with flour.

title: 6 Layer Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in order.

title: Ms. Carly'S Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spread cooked broccoli in 13 x 9-inch pan. Add chicken salt and pepper lightly. Mix soup mayonnaise and lemon juice and pour over chicken. Top with corn flakes and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Golden Glow Salad
instructions: Prepare jello using pineapple juice for cold water. After thickened add other ingredients.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad #2
instructions: Mix together and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Set aside to cool.

title: Fruit Ice
instructions: Mix above ingredients in blender. Serve in glasses and enjoy; it tastes like ice cream without the fat!

title: Chicken Rice Salad
instructions: Combine French dressing mayonnaise salt and pepper to make dressing.

title: Anise Cookies
instructions: Add salt to eggs and beat until thick; add sugar gradually. Continue beating until sugar is dissolved. Add anise and beat until thoroughly blended. Beat in flour to make a moderately stiff dough. Chill dough for several hours or overnight; roll into a rectangular sheet 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick on floured board. Cut cookies in 1 1/2-inch squares; place on greased baking sheet and chill uncovered for about 1 hour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and store in covered container. These can keep for weeks. Makes 60 cookies.

title: Simple Shortbread Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll out on floured board (1/4 to 1/2-inch thick). Cut into desired shapes and arrange on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package directions in 3 layers. In the bottom of the punch bowl put the strawberry pie filling. Add a layer of cake. Mix pudding according to package directions and add drained pineapple. Spread on top of cake layer then add second cake layer. Top this layer with cherry pie filling and add third layer of cake. Mix second box of pudding as directed and add 3 bananas sliced. Spread on top of third cake layer. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with pecans and cherries.

title: None Such Mincemeat Prize Cookies
instructions: Cream together until fluffy the shortening and sugar. Add eggs; beat until smooth. Stir together the flour soda and salt. Add to first mixture. Stir crumbled mincemeat into dough. Drop onto greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart by rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0 until lightly browned. Makes about 6 1/2 dozen. A tasty mild fruity cookie.

title: Reuben-Wich
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large warm bowl. Add sugar salt margarine and 2 1/2 cups flour; beat until smooth. Stir in enough more flour to make soft dough. Knead 6 to 8 minutes. Place in greased bowl; turn to grease top. Cover; let rise until doubled about 45 minutes. Punch dough down; divide in half. Roll half to 14 x 10-inch spread half dressing down center third of dough length. Layer with half the beef cheese and sauerkraut. Make cuts from filling to dough edges along sides of filling 1 inch apart. Alternating sides fold strips at an angle across filling; place on greased baking sheet. Repeat with remaining dough. Cover; let rise until doubled about 45 minutes. Brush with egg sprinkle with caraway seed. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers; reheat to serve. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Cheesecake Factory Key Lime Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir to coat well the ingredients. Keep it crumbly. Press crumbs on bottom and half way up sides of 8-inch spring-form pan. Bake 5 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar butter or margarine and eggs; mix well. Sift flour and then measure out three cups; add soda and salt and sift again. Add flour mixture to butter mixture a little at a time letting your batter blend well between each addition. Add in bananas and nuts and mix well. Pour into well greased tube or Bundt pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients in order in a 13 x 9-inch dish except Ritz crackers and melted oleo. Roll Ritz crackers to crumbs; toss with stick of melted butter. Top with crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and brown on top (20 to 30 minutes).

title: Quick And Easy Rice Jambalaya
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add sausage; cook and stir until lightly browned. Add chicken onion pepper celery and garlic; cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Stir in tomatoes okra tomato sauce and seasoning. Bring to boil. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Stir.

title: Ruth'S Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shake well. Serve over spinach salad.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Put in small cake pan in layers Bean dip guacamole (avocados mixed with the mayonnaise) sour cream mixed with taco seasoning shredded cheese tomatoes olives onions and shredded cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Irish Kisses
instructions: Beat up the butter and all the other ingredients. Sift in enough flour to make a stiff dough. Drop a teaspoonful at a time on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with 4x sugar. Bake in hot oven.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and mix well. Add all ingredients and blend well. Drop with teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Easy Jello Salad
instructions: * Do not add water.

title: Savory Upside-Down Pie
instructions: Thaw pastry. Mix ground beef salt pepper and onion; bind with egg yolks. Wash and quarter mushrooms. Cover the bottom of an 8-inch loose bottomed cake pan with the bacon. Arrange the cheese herbs and mushroom quarters on top. Cover the meat mixture pressing it down firmly and smoothly on the top.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Make a well in dry ingredients and add egg vinegar and cold water. Prepare as for any pie crust.

title: Cheese Whiz
instructions: Melt cheese and milk. Add mustard and vinegar. Put in container and refrigerate.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Mix all together with hands and shape into a ring. Put strawberry jam or green pepper jam in center and serve with crackers of your choice.

title: Crock-Pot Mushroom Barley Soup
instructions: Microwave meat first or else put in crock-pot and cook until half done. Add barley and mushrooms fill pot to within 1 inch of top with stock or water. Cook 3 to 4 hours until barley is done. Season to taste.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Spread on cake while hot. Brown under broiler until coconut is brown.

title: Short'Nin Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and flour. Add butter. Place on floured board; pat to thickness of 1/2-inch. Cut into shapes desired. Bake in a moderate oven (325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0) for 25 minutes.

title: Neiman Marcus Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and both sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; mix together with the flour oatmeal salt baking powder and soda. Add chocolate chips Hershey Bar and nuts. Roll into balls and place two inches apart on a cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. makes 55-60 cookies.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook water sugar and cornstarch until clear. Add 3 tablespoons jello powder and red food coloring. Let cool. Place washed strawberries in baked pie shell. Cover with above mixture. Chill; serve with Cool Whip.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Put flour salt and pepper in a bag. Put pork chops in and shake until flour covers chops. Put Crisco in frying pan. One at a time put chops in pan. Cook on medium heat until done.

title: Very Berry Surprise
instructions: Drain blueberries and pineapple (save juice). Mix Jell-O with package directions (hot water only). Add juice from berries and pineapple. Let jell. Add pineapple and blueberries to Jell-O. Mix remaining ingredients together. Top chilled Jell-O mixture and chill.

title: Corn Bread Mix
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together and cut in shortening. Store in an airtight container. Take the amount that you think you need and add egg and water. Bake until golden brown.

title: Fiesta Meat Loaf
instructions: *Add more bread crumbs to taste.

title: Watergate Salad(Club Member: Lee Higginbotham)
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in order listed. Cool before serving.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Heat liquid to boil. Dissolve Jello and let cool slightly. By spoonful add ice cream until all is in and melted. Chill for 10 to 15 minutes stirring every 5 minutes and fold in fruit. Mix well. Chill till set.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Combine the sugar with flour salt soda cinnamon ginger and cloves. Cut in shortening until mixture looks like crumbs. Stir in molasses and egg. Mix well. Shape dough into 1 inch balls - no bigger- and roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet immediately because cookies firm quickly as they cool. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies. These are good and easy to make.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Put oleo cocoa and buttermilk in saucepan. Heat over low heat do not boil; remove and stir in sugar pecans and vanilla. Beat then spread while cake is still hot and serve. Wonderful!

title: Sausage Rings
instructions: Mix Bisquick and water well. Roll the dough mixture thin. Spread the sausage in a thin layer over the dough. Roll from each end toward the middle for 2 rolls. Cut down the middle and wrap in Handi-Wrap. Refrigerate overnight for easier slicing or freeze for several weeks. Slice 1/2 inch rings. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until slightly brown around 20 minutes.

title: Texas Cake
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Bring shortening water margarine and cocoa to boil. Pour over flour and sugar mixture. Add buttermilk (sour cream can be substituted) eggs vanilla baking soda and salt. Mix thoroughly. Pour into 12 x 17-inch sheet pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Triple Chocolate Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large pan cook pudding with milk as directed on package. Blend dry cake mix thoroughly into hot pudding; beat one or two minutes. (You dont add eggs or other ingredients listed on cake mix.) Pour into greased floured pan 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch. Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate bits. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Jumbo Pasta Shells
instructions: Save 1 cup Mozzarella cheese for topping.

title: Angel Food Delight
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler; add beaten egg yolk and cool. Add beaten egg whites sugar and nuts. Fold in whipped cream. Put broken pieces of cake in bottom of pan. Pour cool mixture over the pieces of cake. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cook eggs; remove shells and cut each in half lengthwise. Remove yolks. Mix yolks with rest of ingredients. Fill each half white of egg with mixture.

title: Microwave Garlicy Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in a 1 1/2-quart dish. Add remaining ingredients and stir to coat potatoes. Cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap. Cook on High for 10 minutes in a 600 to 700 watt oven or 15 minutes in a 400 to 500 watt oven shaking dish to redistribute potatoes. Potatoes are done when the tip of a small knife easily pierces the potato in the center. Serves 4 as a side dish.

title: Sixty Minute Rolls
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour with the sugar salt and undissolved yeast. Combine milk water and margarine in a saucepan. Warm over low heat to 115\u00b0 to 120\u00b0. (Margarine does not have to be melted.) Remove from heat and gradually add flour mixture. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Add 1/2 cup flour. Beat on high for 2 minutes. Stir in additional flour to form soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl. Turn over and grease top. Let rise 15 minutes. Turn out on a floured board. Divide dough in half and shape into rolls. Cover and let rest in a warm place for 15 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until done.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into a pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown and not runny.

title: Danish Sesame Bran Bread
instructions: Combine boiling water and cornmeal. Combine 1 1/2 cups unbleached flour 1 cup whole wheat flour cereal sesame seed salt and yeast; blend well. Heat milk oil molasses and honey until very warm. Add warm liquid cornmeal mixture and yogurt to flour mixture. Blend well. Stir in rest of whole wheat flour until stiff dough forms. Knead in 1 to 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour about 8 minutes. Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel. Let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dorothy'S Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate very slowly in double boiler; add rest of ingredients. Spread on wax paper; chill. Break into pieces.

title: Ham And White Bean Soup
instructions: Dice and saute celery onion carrots zucchini and ham in dutch oven with olive oil and seasoning. Stir in tomatoes chicken broth spinach 1 can beans (smashed) and 2 cups water. Heat to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Add the rest of beans and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

title: Frosted Coffee Bars
instructions: Mix in order. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven. Frost with powdered sugar frosting flavored with coffee.

title: Stir-Fried Beef And Vegetables
instructions: Trim fat; slice meat into thin strips. Combine salad oil sugar cornstarch and pepper sauce and add meat strips. Cut vegetables up.

title: Crunchy Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise vinegar and sugar to make dressing. Set aside.

title: Marinated Shrimp
instructions: Combine shrimp carrots onions and peppers; set aside. Mix well soup vinegar salad oil sugar and mustard. Pour over shrimp and vegetables. Mix lightly. Refrigerate overnight. Before serving add cucumber slices. (You can also add orange or apple slices dew melon cubes etc.). Serves 6.

title: Potatoes And Tomatoes With Fresh Coconut
instructions: Peel potatoes then dice into 3/4-inch pieces and put into bowl of cold water. Heat oil in heavy 3-quart pot over medium-high flame. When hot add finely chopped garlic. Stir about 5 seconds before adding red pepper and cumin seed. Stir for another 3 seconds. Garlic should brown lightly red pepper should darken and cumin seed should sizzle. Lower heat to medium. Add grated coconut and stir for 10 to 15 seconds.

title: Lemon Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; sift baking powder and flour together and add to butter mixture alternating with egg yolks. Add lemon extract fruits and nuts; add stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Frozen Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix all together and freeze.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Stir eggs into pumpkin. Blend salt sugar and spices. Stir into pumpkin. Add milk and mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell.

title: Chicken Acapulco
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer chicken. Melt margarine and add flour until smooth add sour cream until it just bubbles. Add soup chilies and onion salt. Blend well pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add cheese and bake until melted. Serve over rice.

title: Sour Cream Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar; add eggs. Mix sour cream and soda in separate bowl and let stand until foamy. Add sour cream mixture to egg and sugar mixture and mix well. Pour into four greased and floured loaf pans (or 10 mini loaf pans 2/3 of the way full). Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Cheeseburger Rice
instructions: Brown meat and onion in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Drain. Stir in water catsup and mustard; season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Top with cheese; cover. Let stand until cheese melts. Makes 4.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Cook peel and slice fresh beets in a bowl and set aside. Mix sugar and cornstarch until blended before adding the vinegar. Stir all ingredients together and cook at hard boiling point for 1 to 2 minutes or until clear and slightly thickened. Add butter and pour this sauce over the beets. Serve warm. May be reheated but do not boil. If there is extra sauce it may be used later if stored in refrigerator. A small family would not use 3 cups of beets at one meal.

title: Vegetable Stew
instructions: Soak beans in broth. Cook down with garlic that has been minced. Add onions celery and carrots all chopped. Add eggplant peeled and chopped and olive oil. Season with herbs. Cook on very low burner until done.

title: Favorite Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix squash nutmeg cinnamon and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Add eggs and milk. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until done. (May need to cover edges of pie with foil to prevent overbrowning.)

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Bulls Eye Breakfast
instructions: Cut hole in bread with biscuit cutter. Spray cooking spray in frying pan. Place bread with hole in pan; cook on medium heat. Break egg into bowl then pour into hole in bread. Cook until almost set; turn. Put circle cut from bread into pan while egg finishes cooking. Remove from pan and serve hot. Makes 1 serving.

title: Mandarin Chicken
instructions: Prepare chicken by removing bones and steaming good size pieces (good idea to buy breasts and thighs). Dip in tempura batter and fry in hot deep oil. Slice each piece in 1/2-inch to 1-inch slices. Arrange on a bed of shredded lettuce. Cover with sauce.

title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
instructions: Blend sour cream and dry mustard; set aside. Slice cucumber and place in shallow dish. Pour sour cream mix over all. Chill. Serve cold.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Cook all except vinegar and salt. Simmer 4 to 5 hours. Add vinegar and salt when beans are tender (last).

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on package and drain. Combine ingredients; mix well. Chill. Serve with assorted vegetable dippers. Makes 3 cups.

title: City Chicken
instructions: You will also need sticks.

title: Trifle Pudding
instructions: Mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 340\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown about 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Put in bottom of container and layer shredded lettuce tomatoes and onions. Place cheese on top. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Spam And Macaroni
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed. Drain and set aside. Cut Spam into small cubes. Set aside. In a pot big enough for all ingredients melt margarine. Add Spam and cook it for a few minutes. Add macaroni and all-purpose seasoning and pepper. Serves 3 to 4 people.

title: Fried Squid(Calamari Fritti)
instructions: Cut squid into rings or 3-inch pieces. If tentacles are large cut in half. Toss the squid in flour mixed with salt and pepper; coat as you are frying to avoid flour getting soggy. In a skillet heat enough oil to measure about 1 to 1 1/2 inches deep. When the oil is hot add squid. Lower heat just a little and continue to fry squid until nicely golden. Drain on paper towels. The squid should cook in 2 to 3 minutes. Place fried squid on platter and garnish with lemon wedges. Makes 2 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Krispies
instructions: In a large saucepan mix together the corn syrup and sugar and heat slowly until it boils stirring often. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter until it melts. Then stir in Rice Krispies. Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. When cool melt chips and spread on top.

title: Hawaiian Teriyaki Steak
instructions: Mix together soy sauce sugar ginger and garlic powder. Add meat strips and marinate overnight in refrigerator. Cook on barbecue grill on bamboo sticks after draining.

title: Cheese And Chile Dip
instructions: Combine the first five ingredients in a bowl and beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth. If you use a food processor use the knife blade. Drain the can of chiles. Gently stir in the last three ingredients. Chill well. If you wish garnish with chile strip. Set out at room temperature before serving about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Rock Candy
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Cook over medium heat until mixture is dissolved. Cook over high heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and add desired flavoring or cinnamon oil. Add food coloring if desired. Pour into cookie sheet; allow to cool completely. Crack candy and roll into powdered sugar. Store in airtight container.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a glass pie plate. Needs no crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 until browns on top.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water until fork easily pierces potatoes. Cool slightly. Remove skins. Place cooked and peeled potatoes into a large mixing bowl. Mix with electric mixer until smooth. There should be 3 1/2 cups of mashed sweet potatoes. Stir in butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in spices salt and evaporated milk. Pour into unbaked pie crusts. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Lower heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 30 to 45 minutes longer or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool before serving.

title: Bread Pudding With Lemon Sauce
instructions: Butter square Corning baking dish. Put bread in dish. Mix scalding milk butter salt and sugar. Add eggs vanilla cinnamon and nutmeg stir over bread. Set baking dish in some water in Pyrex pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix in dishpan in order given. Drop by large tablespoon or ice cream scoop and flatten. Place 6 to a cookie sheet. Recipe does not call for flour. Bake for 12 minutes. Do not overbake. Makes 77 large cookies.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl combine oil eggs water and pumpkin. Mix well. In another bowl sift together flour salt baking soda nutmeg cinnamon cloves and sugar. Gradually add dry mixture to liquids and mix well. If you wish stir in 1/2 cup nuts and/or raisins. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake for about 1 hour or until it springs back when lightly touched and sides of the loaf have pulled away from the pan.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water. Add strawberries pineapple and bananas. Stir well. Pour half (about 2 1/2 cups) in a greased pan. Let jell about 30 minutes. Spread sour cream on top. Add the other half of strawberry mixture. Let jell.

title: Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix like pie crust. Add egg yolk and yeast mixture. Divide into 2 parts and roll out on cookie sheet. Top with cream cheese mixture. Top with other crust. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Super Simple Supper Soup
instructions: Bring all ingredients except macaroni to a boil. Add macaroni and simmer until tender. Serves lots.

title: Lemon Pudding
instructions: In saucepan blend sugar cornstarch and salt. Add milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Stir small amount of hot mixture into yolks or beaten egg. Return to hot mixture; cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat; blend in butter vanilla lemon juice and lemon peel. Pour into sherbet dishes; chill. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Pot Roast (Beef Or Pork)
instructions: I add 2 red peppers or 1 fresh jalapeno.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix together. You may add a little more milk if needed. Drop by teaspoon into hot boiling grease. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Frosty Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries and pineapple. Mix powdered sugar and sour cream together. Stir into fruit. Pour into shallow dish and freeze until firm. Remove from freezer and let sit a few minutes before serving.

title: Heavenly Lemon Dessert
instructions: Mix flour and margarine like pie crust add nuts and press into bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes; cool. Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar; fold in 1 c. Cool Whip then spread over crust. Mix the pudding mix using only 3 c. milk and beat until stiff; spread over the cream cheese mixture. Top with the remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped walnuts. Chill well before serving.

title: Sweet-Sour Carrots(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Peel carrots and cut into strips. Cook until just tender; drain. Add butter sugar vinegar and mint or dill. Cook until transparent. Serve hot or as a cold relish.

title: Texas Beef Stew(Serves 6)
instructions: Cut steak in crosswise strips 1-inch wide. Mix water and vinegar with ketchup and other seasonings; pour over meat. Let stand several hours turning meat occasionally. Lift meat from liquid saving vinegar mixture. Place meat in pan top with sliced onions and add 1/2 of the vinegar mixture. Cover simmer gently over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours adding vinegar mixture as required to keep liquid about 1/2-inch deep in pan. Remove meat and onions to hot platter; strain liquid then boil hard 3 to 4 minutes pour over meat and serve while hot.

title: Poteau French Dressing
instructions: This should be made just before serving. Rub the bottom of a small bowl with onion or garlic. Put in 1/2 teaspoon of salt a dash of Tabasco sauce and a tablespoon of cold water (to dissolve salt). Stir until salt is completely dissolved. Now gradually add stirring constantly 6 tablespoons of oil and 1 teaspoon of vinegar or lemon juice. Beat quickly until well mixed.

title: Cherry Supreme
instructions: Mix butter flour and chopped pecans. Press in a casserole dish. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix the cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on crust. Add pie filling. Eat!

title: Date Nut Bars
instructions: Sift flour; add baking soda and salt. Sift again. Combine with brown sugar. Add melted shortening to beaten eggs and combine with dry ingredients. Add nuts and dates. Pour into greased 7 x 11 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut in bars while hot. Sprinkle or roll in powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
instructions: 1. Have all ingredients measured and ready. Line a baking sheet with waxed paper or foil; set aside.

title: Sweetheart Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in cold water set aside. Add pineapple and sugar together in pot on stove. Bring to a boil. Add the gelatine mixture to the pineapple mixture. Stir until gelatine is dissolved. Add lemon and cherry juice let cool. Mash cream cheese and chopped cherries. Add to pineapple mixture. Chill to slightly thickened. Add Cool Whip. Top with chopped walnuts and cherries if desired. Mix with mixer in large bowl.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat oil and sugar together. Add eggs and banana. Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients milk and vanilla. Mix well and stir in nuts. Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 1 hour. Cool well and store overnight before cutting. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Hopel-Popel
instructions: Place potatoes\tin a medium bowl. Cover with boiling water. Let stand for 8 minutes or until water is absorbed. Heat skillet and add bacon. Cook and stir until bacon begins to crisp. Add the onion and mushrooms. Stir until barely tender. Add parsley sprinkling\tit evenly over the bacon mixture and potatoes. Toss together lightly. Adjust heat to low. In a small mixing bowl beat eggs with 1/4 cup of water. Add the salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables in skillet. Sprinkle with cheese. Cook over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until eggs are set. Cover skillet for part of cooking time to help eggs set on top. If desired brown under broiler for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Put water and bouillon cubes in pot; boil until cubes are melted. Add chopped broccoli onion and celery (celery is a must). Let boil until soft. Melt butter and add flour. Heat half and half in microwave then add it to broccoli mixture. Add butter and flour mixture. Let simmer until it thickens. Add parsley and dash of black pepper. No salt is needed.

title: Huckleberry Muffins
instructions: Combine oats and sour milk. Let stand. Combine all dry ingredients. Add egg and melted butter to oat mixture and mix well. Add dry ingredients and stir only until moistened. Fold in huckleberries. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in skins. Peel and slice thin. Cook bacon until crisp then cook onion in bacon fat. Mix in flour sugar salt and pepper. Stir water in gradually. Add vinegar gradually. Cook and stir until it boils for 1 minute. Pour over potatoes. Add the bacon. Cover and let stand until ready to serve.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Add sugar to oil. Add eggs and pumpkin. Sift together dry ingredients. Then add water. Place in greased and floured pan. Add nuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Mix 3 beaten eggs. Mix pineapple and 1 tsp. vanilla. Pour in unbaked pie shells. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and flour long cake pan. Sprinkle on bottom the pecans and coconut. Mix cake mix and pour in pan. Mix butter cream cheese and powdered sugar and spoon on top of cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Raisin Bread
instructions: Prepare sweet dough. Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Roll dough into 12 x 9-inch rectangle. Sprinkle raisins on dough. From short end roll dough jelly roll fashion. Pinch seam to seal. Press ends to seal and tuck under. Place seam side down in pan. Cover and let rise until doubled about 1 1/2 hours. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 35 minutes or until loaf sounds hollow when tapped. Let cool on rack.

title: Oats 'N Pumpkin Pinwheels
instructions: Beat 1 cup sugar and margarine until fluffy. Mix in egg whites. Stir in combined flour oats and baking soda. On wax paper press into 16 x 12-inch rectangle. Spread combined pumpkin 1/2 cup sugar and spice over dough to 1/2 inch from edge. From narrow end roll up dough. Sprinkle sesame seed around roll pressing gently. Wrap in wax paper; freeze overnight or until firm.

title: Zero Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in a jar with tightly fitted top. Shake well and refrigerate. Shake well before use.

title: Mexican Green Peppers
instructions: Cut off tops of green peppers; remove seed. Cook peppers 5 minutes in boiling water to cover (salt added). Drain and set aside. Combine next 7 ingredients. Mix well. Fill peppers with meat mixture. Place in a 2-quart shallow casserole. Pour tomato sauce over and around the peppers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Grease 2-quart casserole. Layer sliced zucchini sliced tomatoes mushrooms and cheese. Repeat to fill dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water in large container. Add cold water and stir. Add sugar and stir. Add lemonade and stir. Add pineapple juice and stir thoroughly. Freeze in appropriate containers (large mouth plastic gallon jugs are good). Let thaw until slushy before serving and add ginger ale.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and nuts; set aside. Drain juice from cherries and pineapple; bring juice to a boil. Pour over jello to dissolve. Let cool; add Coke. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl mix eggs sugar butter buttermilk flour and vanilla until well blended. Pour into pie shell and bake until golden brown (approximately 50 minutes). Let cool before slicing.

title: Party Ham Biscuits
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well. Cut rolls in half. Spread sauce over bottom half of roll. Sprinkle with ham and cheese. Cover with top half of roll. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. May be frozen and reheated.

title: B L T Salad Toss
instructions: Combine tomatoes celery salad dressing green pepper and onion; toss lightly. Chill. Add bacon; toss lightly. Spoon vegetable mixture over shredded lettuce. Garnish with additional cherry tomato halves and bacon curls.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook chicken until tender; allow to cool and cut into bite size pieces. Saute onion and green chilies in butter. Mix soup milk and Velveeta cheese in large pan; heat until cheese melts. Add onions and green peppers. Stir until well combined. Add chicken and mix well. In a large baking dish place a layer of tortillas a layer of chicken mixture and a layer of grated cheese. Repeat layers until dish is filled. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Greek Pizza
instructions: Fry chopped meat and drain. Add tomatoes. Saute eggplant in olive oil then add to meat mixture. Grate cheese. Set aside. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with crescent rolls. Spread meat mixture on dough. Top with cheese and season to taste. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until crust is golden.

title: Fresh Pickle Slices
instructions: Combine cucumbers and onions. Mix remaining ingredients and then pour over cucumbers and onions. Stir gently to mix. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Drop Dumplings
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add melted butter and milk. Blend together. Batter should be moist and stiff. Drop by teaspoon into boiling liquid. Cover and cook 18 minutes. Yields 1 dozen dumplings.

title: Impossible Turkey Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease pie plate (10 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch). Beat remaining ingredients after you sprinkle turkey mushrooms onions salt and cheese in pie plate. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate any remaining pie.

title: Chicken Rice Dish
instructions: Cook chicken; save broth. Remove chicken from bone and cut in chunks. Saute chicken and mushrooms in butter or oleo. Add the chicken broth and\tgreen beans and bring this to a boil. Stir in Minute rice then remove from heat. Cover for a few minutes before serving.

title: Quick Apple Crisp
instructions: Pour pie filling into greased baking dish. Sprinkle top with cinnamon sugar; put dry cake mix on top. Put pats of margarine on top. Bake in 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until top is brown and bubbly. (Any flavor pie filling may be used.)

title: Hungarian Poppy Seed Nut Slices
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg. Beat 2 to 3 minutes; add nuts and poppy seed. Beat 1 minute. Stir in flour and salt. Refrigerate until dough is easily shaped into rolls. Make 2 rolls. Roll in sugar; wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Cut into 1/4-inch slices. Bake on ungreased pan at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until slightly brown. Store in closed tin.

title: Sesame Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Stir-fry garlic and onion 2 minutes. Add broccoli zucchini and mushrooms. Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add water chestnuts and tomatoes; heat through. Add Molly McButter; stir until melted in. Sprinkle with sesame seed basil and pepper to taste. Makes 4 (2 cup) servings.

title: Grilled Salmon Fillets(Easy; See Marinade Variations)
instructions: Make a marinade by mixing 2 tablespoons oil ginger cumin coriander salt and cayenne together in large shallow bowl. Add fish and marinate in the refrigerator for no more than 30 minutes. Meanwhile build a single-level fire. Set grill rack in place. Cover grill with lid and let rack heat up about 5 minutes. Rub cooking grate with oil-dipped wad of paper towels.

title: Irish Whiskey Cake
instructions: Make yellow cake according to directions except substitute double strength coffee for water called for. Bake in two round layers. When layers are cool split them in half. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon whiskey on each cut except for rounded top. Spread Cool Whip on each cut surface and top. Stack layers. Refrigerate 8 hours (24 is better).

title: Salsa Fresca
instructions: Gently stir together all ingredients in a small bowl until blended.

title: Easy Stroganoff
instructions: Put beef soups onion salt and pepper into a large pot. Simmer slowly for several hours. When the meat is tender add sour cream and mushroom pieces. Bring to a boil and immediately serve over hot rice or noodles.

title: Nantucket Cranberry Pie
instructions: Sprinkle 2 cups cranberries into buttered 10-inch pie plate. Combine 1/2 cup sugar and walnuts. Sprinkle over berries.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into crust.

title: Tapioca Jello Salad
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients together until thick; let cool. Mix Dream Whip; add to cooled jello-pudding mixture along with drained pineapple and oranges. Refrigerate.

title: Cheeseburger Logs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine tomatoes and bread crumbs in a large bowl; let stand until liquid is absorbed. Lightly mix in ground beef egg mustard salt and pepper. Divide mixture into quarters then shape into a 5-inch loaf; make a ridge down middle of each with your finger. Place loaves on a rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake 30 minutes. Spoon cheese into hollows. Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese melts and loaves are crusty brown. Yields 4 servings.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut steak into 1-inch strips. Brown on both sides. Mix soup mix in 1 cup water. Pour over steak and simmer on top of stove for 1 1/2 hours or until tender on low to medium heat. Soup mix will thicken into gravy.

title: Chocolate Chippers
instructions: Cream together butter sugars egg and vanilla. Add flour chocolate chips and pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes. (Dough does better if chilled.)

title: Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Heat water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan. Break block of noodles; reserve seasoning packet. Stir noodles chicken bok choy and carrot into water. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 3 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in seasoning packet.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt margarine with cocoa in saucepan. Remove from heat and stir into eggs sugar flour salt nuts and vanilla. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. As soon as it is taken out of the oven sprinkle miniature marshmallows or marshmallow cream on top.

title: Mixed Nut Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. In large roasting pan spread the popped corn and the dry roasted nuts. In heavy saucepan combine the sugar butter and dark corn syrup. Cook until mixture boils. Boil for 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat. Stir in the vanilla and baking soda. Pour mixture over corn and nuts; stir to coat. Bake uncovered at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Cool; break apart. Store in covered container.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to 1/4-inch thickness between 2 pieces of waxed paper. Mix salt pepper paprika and flour in a plastic bag; add chicken one piece at a time and shake to coat. Place butter and oil in a saute pan or large skillet; heat over medium heat until bubbly. Add garlic and chicken; saute turning about 6 minutes or until chicken is brown and fork can be easily inserted. Drain on paper towels and keep warm. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of cooking fat from pan; add wine and deglaze pan scraping up brown bits. Add lemon juice and heat 1 minute; return chicken to pan; add lemon slices and heat 2 minutes. Add capers and pimento. Sprinkle chives over all.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Cook chicken and broccoli. Layer in baking dish. Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli. Top with bread crumbs and small pats of butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until top is brown and bubbly.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Bring all ingredients to room temperature. Cream the butter; add sugar and beat. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Add flour and milk. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Roasted Red Peppers
instructions: Place the peppers on a roasting tray and put in a 350\u00b0 oven. Turn the peppers until cooked on all sides (about 1 hour). When done place the peppers in a paper bag. Wait a few minutes and then peel and slice the peppers into strips. Place in a bowl with fresh garlic and olive oil and let marinate.

title: Salmon Loaf # 1
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a buttered loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is crispy. (Mixture will look sloppy.) Good cold too.

title: Korean Salad
instructions: Cook bacon; drain and crumble. In large salad bowl mix spinach sprouts water chestnuts eggs and bacon. In a jar combine oil sugar catsup vinegar Worcestershire sauce and onion; shake well. Sprinkle dressing on salad and toss. Serve. Dressing refrigerates well and is good on any salad.

title: Chicken Broccoli
instructions: Cook chicken (cut into pieces) in water with 1 teaspoon salt. Strain and debone. Use 2 cups broth to cook rice. Saute onion and broccoli in oleo. Mix all together and put in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Okra Casserole
instructions: Cook and crumble meat. Arrange in layers in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until vegetables are tender.

title: Banana-Nut Muffins
instructions: Combine oat bran brown sugar walnuts and baking powder in bowl; mix well. Combine milk bananas egg whites and oil in small bowl; mix well. Stir into oat bran mixture just until moistened. Fill paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 17 minutes or until brown. Yield 12 servings.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: Cut chicken in serving pieces; set aside. Sprinkle washed rice in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Pour 2 cups water over rice. Place chicken on top of rice. Place parsnips cut in chunks around chicken. Mix soup and milk. Pour over chicken. It will look very soupy. Bake covered with foil at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

title: Potatoes And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel the potatoes (enough to fill a 13 x 9-inch casserole bowl) and slice as thin as possible. Grate the cheese. Brown the sausage. Alternate the layers of each beginning with a layer of potato slices then sausage and then cheese. Add the milk salt and pepper. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. You may have to cover with foil. For softer potatoes you may want to boil them for a few minutes before putting them in the casserole bowl.

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
instructions: Pick through crabmeat to remove cartilage. Mix together all ingredients except crabmeat in medium bowl. Gently fold in crab. Shape into 8 crab cakes and place on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Sprinkle with paprika; place under preheated broiler until golden brown about 7 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
