instructions: Combine beans milk soup pepper and 1/2 can of the French fried onions. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Place chicken sliced onion 2 teaspoons salt and celery in a pot. Cover with water. Cook until tender. Bone and cut chicken into pieces. Reserve broth. Combine soup broth tomatoes and 1/2 teaspoon salt in pan and heat. Layer chicken tortillas cheese chopped onion and heated sauce in a casserole dish. Repeat ending with cheese. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Lower to 200\u00b0 and bake for 40 more minutes. May be frozen.

title: Ron'S Biscuits
instructions: Dump all in big bowl and mix really good. Sprinkle pastry cloth well with flour and roll dough out like a cross. Take left side; fold to center. Take right side; fold to center. Take bottom; fold up. Take top and fold down. Roll over slightly with rolling pin then cut biscuits out with top of drinking glass.

title: Carrot-Raisin Salad(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: Mix shredded carrots with combined ingredients. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: *Suggested Flavors Chocolate flavor pudding with graham cracker crumbs or butterscotch or lemon flavor pudding with gingersnap crumbs.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Microwave the first 4 ingredients on High 2 minutes. Stir. Add the vanilla and nuts. Stir. Pour into buttered dish. Cool on countertop. May be stored in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Lightly cook broccoli. Chop into small pieces (not grated). Saute onion in butter until transparent. Combine all ingredients. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Cut into squares. Serves 12. It is oh so good!

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix flour soda salt cinnamon sugar oil eggs and undrained pineapple. Mix only by hand. Add bananas and nuts and mix again. Bake in a tube or Bundt pan that has been greased and floured. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 5 minutes. Let cool in pan 1 hour before removing to serving plate.

title: Double Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheet. Mix flour mustard and red pepper. Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in Swiss cheese buttermilk and egg until dough forms. Turn dough onto well-floured board; coat with flour. Knead lightly 10 times. Roll or pat dough 1/2-inch thick; cut with floured 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on cookie sheet. Mix egg yolk and water; brush over biscuits. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Serve warm. Makes 10 biscuits.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes into large pot. Grate onion very fine and add to pot with celery seed salt margarine and water to completely cover potatoes. Cook until tender adding water as necessary to maintain level of broth. Mash about half the potatoes and reduce rest to small pieces. Cut up cheese into hot potatoes and broth. Stir carefully until cheese has melted then add milk. Simmer over low heat until desired consistency.

title: Chocolate Rum Souffle
instructions: Soak macaroons in the rum. In a double boiler melt chocolate with water and 6 tablespoons of sugar. Mix well. Remove the chocolate from heat and add the egg yolks one at a time. Let mixture cool. Beat egg whites adding 1 tablespoon sugar to make them more dense. Fold into chocolate mixture gently. Line bottom and sides of an oiled 7 1/2 or 8-inch spring-form pan with split ladyfingers. Add half of the chocolate and then the layer of soaked macaroons. Add the remaining chocolate mixture. Top with remaining ladyfingers and cool for at least 6 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken and apple. Sprinkle with lemon juice and toss together. Mix celery with mayonnaise and add to chicken and apple mixture. Toss lightly. Chill. Serve on lettuce or eat as is. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Grated Potato Casserole
instructions: Place milk eggs salt pepper cheese butter or margarine onion and cubed potatoes in blender container. Blend on high speed just until potatoes are grated. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: My Favorite Tuna Fish Sandwich
instructions: Put tuna in a medium mixing bowl. Add enough Miracle Whip to make it look creamy or to your taste. Cut up pickles and put them in (I like lots of pickles). Stir it all up and put it on the bread or eat with crackers.

title: Texas Style Cornbread
instructions: Grease large pan. Mix all ingredients. Cook 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Pie Crust(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
instructions: Sift into a bowl flour and salt. Mix oil and milk. Add all at once to the flour and stir until mixed Using the hands form the mixture into a smooth ball. Roll the dough between 2 sheets of wax paper until it is a circle about 11-inches in diameter. Remove one sheet of wax paper. Turn the crust into a 9-inch pan. Remove wax paper. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes or until browned. If the crust is to be baked with a filling follow the cooking directions for the filling. Double the recipe for a double crusted pie.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Mix meats together thoroughly. Soak bread in cream about 5 minutes. Cook onion in butter until tender. Mix meats crumb mixture onion egg parsley salt pepper ginger and nutmeg until well combined. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Brown meat balls in 2 tablespoons butter. Remove from skillet.

title: True Texas Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put in a large baking dish sprayed with Pam. Cover top with crisp crumbled bacon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mulligan Stew
instructions: Mix together and cook over low fire for 1 hour or 1/2 hour.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Grease sides and bottom of a 10-inch deep-dish pie pan. In a medium mixing bowl mix together flour salt baking powder and pudding mix. Mix in butter egg and milk. Beat for 2 minutes. Pour mixture into pie pan. Arrange the peach slices on top of the pudding mixture. In a small mixing bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons reserved peach syrup. Beat for 2 minutes. Spoon mixture over peaches to within 1-inch of pan edge.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup milk. Combine chocolate butter remaining milk sugar salt and vanilla in a double boiler. Heat to the boiling point. Add cornstarch mixture and cook 8 minutes. Let cool and pour into a baked pie shell. To serve top with whipped cream.

title: Spice Nut Cake
instructions: In mixing bowl combine flour sugar salt baking powder soda cloves and cinnamon. Add shortening brown sugar and buttermilk. Mix until all flour is moistened. Beat 2 minutes; add eggs. Beat 2 minutes more; stir in nuts. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Frost with Orange Butter Frosting.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Add noodles to boiling water. Boil according to instructions. Dice onion and saute in butter. Add soup milk tuna salt and pepper to onion. Cook together for about 5 minutes; do not boil. Drain noodles. Add tuna mixture to noodles and stir until combined. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes until brown.

title: Vegetables Tossed In Olive Butter
instructions: Mix vegetables and steam until tender. Transfer to a bowl. Toss with Olive Butter. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Combine butter flour and pecans. Mix well. Press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Light Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and strawberries. Bring to hard boil. Remove from stove and add Jello. Cool. Whip milk and add to mixture. Pour into crust. Chill. Add a few drops of red food coloring if desired.

title: Chocolate Lush
instructions: Mix flour margarine and pecans. Press in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and 8-ounces Cool Whip; spread over crust. Mix chocolate pudding and milk. Spread over that layer. Top with another\t8-ounces of Cool Whip and sprinkle chopped pecans on top; chill thoroughly.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill before serving.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges (use juice as a beverage). Combine pineapple oranges banana grapes marshmallows coconut and almonds. Fold in yogurt. Chill. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Individual Pizzas
instructions: Cut one pita bread in half. Spread on ingredients (sauce cheese etc.). Spray a cooking sheet with Pam. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes.

title: Spray And Wash
instructions: Mix together and put into a spray bottle. Use for removing stains before washing clothes. Apply just before placing in wash. Be sure to always check for colorfastness on colored garments.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain. Steam carrots broccoli cauliflower and yellow squash until tender. Drain. To vegetables add cream of celery soup. Season with Italian seasoning. In baking dish build layers of noodles vegetables and grated Mozzarella and Ricotta cheese. Top with grated Parmesan cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is bubbly and brown.

title: Tostado Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Stir. Line bottom of 9 x 11 x 2-inch pan with 2 cups corn chips. Crush remaining chips and set aside. Spoon meat mixture over corn chips. Combine remaining tomato sauce with beans and spoon over meat mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and crushed chips. Bake 5 more minutes.

title: Kayla'S Secret Muffins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add vanilla and eggs one at a time. Add yogurt mix at medium speed. Mix in flour salt soda and poppy seed. Put in muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 14 muffins.

title: Baked Chicken In Sour Cream
instructions: Place chicken in greased flat 2-quart casserole dish. Mix soup sour cream broth water chestnuts and almonds. Heat and pour over chicken. Top with cracker crumbs which have been tossed in oleo. Bake at 375\u00b0 until crackers are browned.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease baking dish. Add crushed pineapple pie filling yellow cake mix and nuts in layers. Pour melted margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Red Punch
instructions: Mix together; add water. Makes 2 gallons.

title: Sausage Strata
instructions: Put croutons in a greased 8 x 12-inch pan; top with cheese. Cook sausage in skillet until brown. Drain on paper towels. Place sausage over cheese.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Melt butter over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar until well blended. Cool. Stir in egg. Sift together and stir in flour baking powder and salt. Then stir in vanilla and walnuts. Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Do not overbake! Cut into bars or squares while still warm.

title: Frosty Pineapple Punch
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a punch bowl. Just before serving spoon sherbet into punch bowl by heaping tablespoonfuls; stir gently. Serve immediately. Yields 3 quarts.

title: White Drop Cookies
instructions: Beat egg(s) add sugar and shortening and stir well. Add soda to your sour milk then add to other ingredients. Add sifted flour baking powder and salt then add vanilla. Finally add chips and walnuts (optional) and stir together thoroughly. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Select fresh even cucumbers. Wash and cut ends off. Place dill in jar and clove of garlic. (If you wish you can use hot peppers.) Pack in sterilized jars. Add 3 level teaspoons of salt in each jar. Boil 1 quart vinegar and 3 quarts water. Pour hot over pickles and seal. Put in cold packer starting with cold water. When water comes to a boil remove jars. Let stand 4 weeks before eating.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add taco seasoning and water. Cook 15 minutes. Cool. In separate bowl chop the lettuce onion and tomatoes. Add ground beef. Refrigerate 1 hour. Before serving add cheese dressing and crushed Fritos.

title: Easy Refrigerator Roll Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl. Stir in sugar shortening beaten egg salt and 3 cups of the flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough flour to make dough easy to handle. Place dough in greased bowl then turn greased side up. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or until ready to use. Dough can be kept up to 4 days in refrigerator at 45\u00b0 or below; keep covered.

title: Nuts Over Turkey
instructions: Combine first seven ingredients. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until heated through. Makes 3 cups. Has 300 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

title: Country Butter
instructions: Note Have oleo and cream cheese at room temperature (soft).

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Cool and enjoy. (When storing keep cloves with beets in juice to keep flavor. Lasts forever!)

title: Continental Round Steaks
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving In large skillet over medium-high heat cook bacon until light brown. Push bacon to one side of skillet.

title: H And J Pizza
instructions: Mix yeast and water together. Set aside. Mix all the rest of the ingredients together. Combine both mixtures. Turn dough on floured board. Knead. Spread on greased pizza pan. Let stand 15 minutes. Spread spaghetti sauce on dough then add cooked hamburger meat mushrooms cheese onions pepper or whatever you like. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Eat and enjoy.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Prepare salad 1 hour before using and refrigerate.

title: Garden Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Add ham and remaining ingredients. Toss well. Chill at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Oreo Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar and fold in Cool Whip. Mix milk and pudding. When thick fold into Cool Whip mixture. Put 1/2 of crumbled Oreos in bowl; layer pudding mixture and top with layer of Oreo crumbs.

title: Potatoes Deluxe I
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup margarine in baking dish in slow oven. Mix potatoes onion cheese sour cream and soup and place in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Mix corn flakes and 1/2 cup melted margarine. Put on top and bake 15 minutes longer. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Sweet And Sour Tofu And Vegies
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in 2 tablespoons of water; add 1/4 cup pineapple juice 1/4 cup water vinegar honey soy sauce ginger and pepper; set aside. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet on high heat. Add onion and stir until strong smell starts to go away. Add carrot and stir a little more. Add tofu and stir until lightly browned. Add green pepper and salt. Stir a minute more then reduce heat to medium and cook uncovered. Colorful rich and juicy with a Chinese flavor. A meal in itself with rice or chow mein noodles.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 9 x 13 pan according to directions on box. When done poke holes in cake. While cake is baking combine pineapple and sugar and boil for 5 minutes. Pour over cake while hot. Let cake cool then prepare instant pudding according to directions on box. Spread pudding over cake. Spread Cool Whip over pudding.

title: Apple Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add cheese and flour. Place apples in a 2-quart dish. Spread batter over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Cook the roast with the dried onion soup and Italian seasoning for 12 hours in crock-pot on low. Cool and slice or shred meat. Save drippings. To drippings add the remaining ingredients. Simmer until ready to serve.

title: Monastery Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute oil onions and carrots for 5 minutes. Add all ingredients to one pot and cook for 45 minutes. Add sherry at end. Serve with Swiss cheese.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix and spread on greased and floured jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Saucy Asparagus
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat combine soup and milk. Heat to boiling stirring often. Add asparagus. Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender stirring occasionally. Serve with grated Parmesan cheese if desired. Makes 8 servings. Preparation time 10 minutes. Cook time 15 minutes.

title: Zombie
instructions: Build in bucket glass with crushed ice. Float rum. Garnish with red cherry and orange slice.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Top with French fried onions last 10 minutes.

title: Yogurt Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream the butter. Gradually add sugar beating until mixture is light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture mixing well. Stir lemon rind vanilla and yogurt into batter. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. (I just spray with Pam no flour.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on a rack. Sprinkle cake with powdered sugar if desired. Yields one 10-inch cake.

title: Cheesy Lasagna
instructions: Saute beef and onion in a deep skillet. Pour off fat then add tomatoes and tomato paste and simmer for 30 minutes. Add 2 beaten eggs to cottage cheese salt and oregano. Place cooked noodles at the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish alternating the meat and egg and cottage cheese mixture. Cover with half of the Mozzarella cheese then a layer of noodles and repeat. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let set about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix together and set aside while preparing dressing.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix vegetables water chestnuts cream of chicken soup onion and mayonnaise (or sour cream) together. Place in a 9 X 13 glass baking dish. Melt butter and mix with crumbled Ritz crackers. Spread crackers over top of casserole. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Mix jello and cold water; set for a couple minutes and add 1/4 cup boiling water until dissolved. Add all ingredients. Chill!

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large casserole dish. Cover. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 5 to 6 hours. Serve with cornbread.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: In fry pan cook chicken with olive oil. Add diced carrots and broccoli. Take a 9 inch pie pan and place a bottom crust. In bowl mix soup with 1/2 c. milk. In pie pan add your chicken broccoli and carrots potatoes. Pour soup over ingredients. Put top on pie. Preheat over 350\u00b0. Cook pie in oven until golden brown or approximately 1 hour.

title: Cheese Quiche
instructions: About 1 1/4 hours before serving prepare pie crust mix as label directs for 1 crust pie; use to line 9-inch pie plate. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In medium bowl with wire whisk or fork mix eggs half and half salt and pepper until well blended. Sprinkle shredded cheese in pie crust. Pour egg mixture over cheese. Bake quiche 15 minutes turn oven control to 325\u00b0 and bake for 35 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center of quiche comes out clean. Makes 6 main dish servings.

title: Favorite Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble reserving drippings. Set bacon aside. Saute onion catsup brown sugar Worcestershire sauce and mustard in a greased 1-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield 4 servings.

title: Baked Chicken Coating
instructions: Brush chicken with oil and coat with this coating. Bake until done.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening beating in eggs one at a time. Sift flours together; add milk and vanilla. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tostada Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown beef and drain fat. Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and the taco seasoning. Mix well. Line bottom of 2-quart flat casserole with 2 cups corn chips. Crush the remaining chips and set aside. Spoon meat mixture over corn chips in dish. Combine remaining tomato sauce and the refried beans. Spread over meat. Bake covered for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese and crushed corn chips. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes more. Serves 5.

title: Broccoli Nut Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Drain. Add soup mayonnaise and nuts. Mix well. Add eggs and onion. Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and top with crumbs. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Joyce'S Fruit Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar. Add eggs. Gradually add flour soda allspice and milk. Fold in candied fruit nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet and bake approximately 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Add salt and soda. Stir well. Add flour and chocolate chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove from oven when light brown.

title: Broccoli & Cauliflower Cheese Soup
instructions: Dehead broccoli and cauliflower. Put in a 3-quart pot with enough water to cover vegetables. Cover and steam until done. Drain. Add 1 to 1-1/2 quarts of milk and 1/2 loaf of Velveeta cheese. Cover. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Homestyle Pot Pie
instructions: Line 9-inch pie plate with 1 crust; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour filling in pie crust. Top with second crust. Seal and crimp edges. Slit top of crust to vent and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar syrup and butter and mix well. Add vanilla; add peanuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 to 50 minutes or until filling is firm and brown. Pie may be soft when shaken gently but will firm as it cools.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Bring to a boil. Turn heat down and simmer 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Polish Mistakes
instructions: Fry sausage and hamburger together; drain grease off. Put in a bowl while warm; mix Cheez Whiz. Put on party rye bread (rye bread) and broil until bread is lightly brown and crisp. Watch close.

title: Spiced Apple Loaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. In a medium bowl mix together flour pumpkin pie spice baking powder baking soda and salt. In a large bowl using a wooden spoon or an electric mixer set on medium speed beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in the apples. Stir flour mixture into the apple mixture until the dry ingredients are just moistened. Spoon batter into the prepared pan. Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean about 1 hour. Transfer the pan to a wire rack to cool for 10 minutes. Turn the cake out onto the rack to cool completely.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
instructions: In a skillet cook sausage and onion until sausage is brown and onion is tender drain. Stir in apples sauerkraut water brown sugar and caraway seeds. Transfer to a 2 1/2 qt. baking dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for one hour. Garnish with parsley if desired. Make 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup; mix well. Add eggs butter vanilla and nuts. Mix well and pour into uncooked pie crust. Bake for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Lower temperature to 300\u00b0 and cook for 35 minutes longer.

title: Ri'S Easy Salisbury Steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except peas and gravy and shape into 2 loaves. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Place loaves in dish lightly spray top with Pam to help brown nicely and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Add gravy and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Then add peas to gravy and steak. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Custard Pie(My Mother'S Recipe)
instructions: Beat egg yolks butter and sugar. Add flour and buttermilk. Cook over low heat until thick stirring constantly. Add extract. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue and brown.

title: Bbq Rice
instructions: Pour rice in a large baking dish. Add soup and mushrooms and stir to mix.\tPlace 1 stick of margarine in center of dish. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix all but bread cubes and raisins. Add bread cubes and raisins. Pour into well oiled baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Shells Florentine
instructions: Cook shells according to package directions. Pour marinara sauce into saucepan and heat. Spoon 1 cup of sauce into bottom of a large roasting pan or 1/2 cup sauce into each of two 2-quart baking pans. Reserve remaining sauce; keep warm.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine the 1 tablespoon flour and the salt; coat meat. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet; add meat and brown quickly on both sides. Add mushrooms onion and garlic; cook till crisp-tender 3 or 4 minutes. Remove meat and mushrooms from pan. Add 2 tablespoons butter to pan drippings. Blend in the 3 tablespoons flour. Add tomato paste; stir in beef stock. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly. Return browned meat and mushrooms to skillet. Stir in sour cream and wine; cook slowly until hot; do not boil. Serve over noodles. Serves 4 or 5.

title: Orange Raisin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites in small bowl; stir in milk juice oil and peel. Add to flour mixture. Stir until moistened. Stir in cereal. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 1 hour.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Defrost hash browns and combine in a large bowl with melted butter salt and pepper. Add onion soup sour cream and cheese. Blend ingredients thoroughly. Pour into buttered 3-quart casserole dish. Mix 1/4 cup melted butter with corn flakes. Sprinkle crumbs over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: French Pea Soup
instructions: Wash peas and put in 6-quart pot. Add 6 cups water and 2 onions. Cook on low heat for 45 minutes. Add carrots and celery. Cook for an additional 30 minutes on low heat continuing to be sure it remains boiling. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Casserole Sauce Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Store in an airtight container and keep in refrigerator. This recipe makes 3 cups mix (equivalent of nine 10 1/2 ounce cans of condensed cream soup).

title: Old-Time Tea Cakes
instructions: Break eggs into mixing bowl. Add margarine molasses sugar nutmeg and baking soda. Cream thoroughly. Work in flour. Transfer dough to a well floured board and knead until it is pliable. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until light brown. Yields 3 dozen tea cakes.

title: Hot Apple Cider
instructions: Combine spices in a spice bag. Add to the other ingredients in a large pan on stove or use large coffeepot. Simmer.

title: Cocoa Delight Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl. Add Crisco and first amount of milk called for. Beat with mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs rest of milk and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Spread batter in 2 well greased and floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch round layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until center springs back when touched lightly. Cook 10 to 20 minutes then remove from pans.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar. Cook until blended and slightly thickened stirring constantly. Cool slightly. Add cream. Beat until smooth. Add confectioners sugar gradually until right consistency to spread.

title: Party Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion; add Ragu sauce and heat to boiling point. Beat cream cheese; add cottage cheese sour cream and olives and mix. In a 3-quart casserole layer 1/2 beef mixture 1/2 noodles cheese mixture remaining noodles and top with remaining beef mixture. Bake.

title: Italian Meatball Soup
instructions: Combine everything in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 8 to 10 minutes or until pasta is tender.

title: Banana Nut Roll
instructions: Lightly grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Line bottom with waxed paper; set aside.

title: Instant Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into 2 graham cracker pie shells. Chill and serve.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Put 5 pats of butter brown sugar sprinkles and pecans in the bottom of pan. Quarter biscuits and roll in white sugar and cinnamon mixture. Melt butter and brown sugar over low heat. Add cinnamon. Pour over biscuits in pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes; then 350 degrees of 20 minutes or until biscuits are done in center.

title: Venison Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put roast in roasting pan. Add water tenderizer and cover. Cook for 1 hour. Peel potatoes and cut in half. Cut celery in half. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and return to oven for 1 more hour. At end of baking time remove from oven. Place roast on platter and surround with veggies.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Sprinkle flour on cheese. Pour on butter. Add salt and red pepper. Add Rice Krispies. Knead by hand. Roll into marble sized balls and bake on ungreased sheet. Flatten with fork and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick butter in frying pan. Salt and pepper pork chops. Brown pork chops in pan until braised on both sides but not until done. Remove from frypan and put aside. Melt rest of butter in frypan. Add rice and brown. Add consomme onion soup and mushrooms. Bring to a slight boil. Pour into a 2 to 3-quart casserole dish. Top with pork chops. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine five ingredients in food processor; process until blended and cheese is fine as you want it. Add pimiento; process just to blend. Store in covered container in refrigerator. Makes 3 cups.

title: Irish Coffee
instructions: Fill a stemmed glass with hot water then empty glass. Refill with boiling water and empty again. Fill the glass more than half full with the coffee and sugar to taste. Stir and add whiskey. Spoon on whipped cream and drink hot coffee through cool cream.

title: Stuffed Mandarin Ham
instructions: Prepare stuffing and let stand 2 minutes. Add oranges to stuffing. Place 1/4 stuffing in each ham slice. Roll ham and place each one seam down in a baking dish. Spoon remaining stuffing around ham slices. Spoon marmalade over all. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Quick Potato Salad
instructions: Cut slightly cooked potatoes into 1 inch cubes. In large bowl combine potatoes onions and salad dressing. Toss gently. Dust with paprika. Garnish with chives and bacon bits. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Baked Potatoes And Onions
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Put into shallow baking pan and mix oil into potatoes. Pour dry soup mix over potatoes and mix well. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Fruit Soup(Servings:  8)
instructions: In food processor blend strawberries until smooth; pour into saucepan. Add water sugar tapioca and salt; let stand 5 minutes. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring constantly; remove from heat and add lemon juice. Chill; add orange sections just before serving.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: In large pan saute onions bell pepper shallots celery and garlic in oil until tender. In small skillet make roux of 1/4 cup oil and 1/4 cup flour and brown; add to onion mixture. Add to onion mixture the tomato sauce tomato paste water and all seasonings except parsley and lemon juice. Simmer 45 minutes. Add shrimp lemon juice and parsley. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until shrimp is done. Serve over rice. Serves 10.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and bake in greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Ice Cream Jello
instructions: Add 4 cups of boiling water to powdered Jell-O. Stir with wooden spoon until completely dissolved. In place of cold water slowly add partially softened vanilla ice cream to Jell-O mixture in pan. Stir until completely melted. Refrigerate in 10 x 13-inch pan until set (approximately 2 to 3 hours). Cut into squares. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Add meat and brown. Add flour salt pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes and cut into squares. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in bag. Soak potatoes in water. Then shake well in bag coating well. Melt margarine in baking dish. Place potatoes in dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn once during baking.

title: Cheddar Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Combine biscuit mix milk and cheese in a large bowl. Mix until a soft dough forms. Drop by spoonfuls onto a baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Mix the butter and garlic powder in a small bowl. Brush the butter mixture over the warm biscuits.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add beaten eggs pumpkin and oil. Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes on a large cookie sheet.

title: Fast Rolls
instructions: Beat well; cover and let rise 30 minutes. Stir and spoon into muffin cups. Let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Passion-Orange Pudding Jello
instructions: Dissolve orange jello\tin boiling water. Add passion-orange juice then add evaporated milk. Whip all ingredients together. Let stand for 1 hour in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Stir in oatmeal. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan or cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Red Rolled Enchiladas
instructions: Fry tortillas in oil in a small frying pan until soft approximately 2 to 3 seconds on each side. Set aside. Place 1 tablespoon of sauce on each and stack. Brown ground beef and drain the fat off. Add one can sauce and simmer together for about 5 minutes or until the beef and sauce are well mixed. Fill tortillas with beef 4 ounces cheese and olives. Roll and place into a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Pour remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle the rest of the cheese and olives on top. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes until cheese is melted. Makes 5 to 6 servings depending on how many enchiladas you can make with this recipe. Also great to reheat. You may use Monterey Jack and can use more or less if you like cheesy enchiladas.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a casserole dish place a layer of peeled sliced potatoes. Spoon mushroom soup and cubed Spam. Another layer potatoes soup and Spam. Fill up dish. Add salt and pepper (to taste). Mix one can water into mushroom soup can; mix. Pour over potatoes Spam and soup. Add more water enough to fill casserole dish up to top layer of potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 until potatoes are tender. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti and celery in chicken broth to package directions. Drain add green pepper onion and diced chicken to spaghetti. Set aside. Prepare cheese sauce milk flour and margarine in medium sized saucepan. Cook until thick stir constantly. Add grated cheese and mushroom soup. Mix cheese sauce into spaghetti mixture. Pour into large oblong baking dish. Top with margarine and cracker crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Blend in margarine buttermilk and molasses. Put in unbeaten eggs and mix. Beat by hand 20 strokes. Butter and flour a 9 x 9 x 5-inch glass pan or 8 x 12-inch aluminum pan. Pour in mixture and bake at 340\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 heat for 45 minutes. The bigger the dish the less heat.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter oil cocoa and water and bring to a boil. Mix with flour and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Then add buttermilk eggs cinnamon and vanilla. Pour into a greased and floured sheet pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Special K Bars
instructions: Bring to boil the white sugar and white syrup; add peanut butter and Special K cereal. Spread on buttered 11 x 16-inch cookie sheet. Melt the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips. Spread on top of mixture on sheet.

title: Chocolate Drops
instructions: Mix sugar butter and milk in a saucepan. Bring to a boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add oatmeal cocoa peanut butter and vanilla. Blend together; drop from teaspoon onto wax paper. Let set for 1 hour.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Eggs We usually do 12 to 18 depends on size of group you are feeding or the size of your deviled egg dish.

title: Linley'S Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello and water. Let cool and add cream cheese. Mash with a fork and stir together. Then add pineapple and Cool Whip. Last add 7-Up slowly. Put into square Pyrex or plastic container. Refrigerate.

title: Black Forest Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool completely. Empty cherries into a baking dish. Bake for 10 minutes. Cool for about 20 minutes. Remove cake from pan sitting right side up. Cut all sides off cake. Slice cake in half lengthwise. Remove top layer carefully a spatula will help. Put bottom layer back in 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread cherries on bottom layer. Replace top layer and spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Spaghetti Pizza
instructions: Cook spaghetti and rinse in hot water. Add beaten eggs and butter; mix well. Brown hamburger and onions. Add Parmesan cheese and mushrooms. Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour spaghetti sauce over meat and top with Parmesan cheese Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagne
instructions: In large bowl crumble beef. Heat in microwave 2 to 3 minutes on High until beef is browned stirring once. Drain. Stir in sauce and water.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix for 5 minutes. Pour into a pint jar. Serve on garden salad.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Have butter and eggs at room temperature. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter until soft; beat in sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and sour cream alternately to creamed mixture starting and ending with flour. Add flavoring and beat until smooth. Pour into pan and bake 1 1/2 hours until golden brown top springs back when touched. Cool on wire rack before turning out.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Pop popcorn; put into a large pan. Mix sugar syrup water vinegar and butter in saucepan; boil until it forms a firm ball in cold water. Pour over popped corn. Stir until all is covered. Use lots of butter or margarine on hands as you form balls. Makes 12 large popcorn balls.

title: Buttercream Easter Eggs
instructions: Note Use 1/4 cup peanut butter in place of 1/4 cup margarine.

title: Mom'S Favorite Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop artichokes to small pieces. Mix artichokes with rest of the ingredients. Place in decorative baking dish in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Five Hour Oven Stew
instructions: Mix the last 3 ingredients and let stand while preparing vegetables.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix creamed corn whole kernel corn and melted oleo. Add Jiffy cornbread mix and sour cream. Beat egg and add to this mixture. Add softened Cheez Whiz. Mix well. Pour into greased baking dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat eggs crumbs onion parsley flakes and Worcestershire sauce together. Season to taste. Shape into meatballs and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Drop into sauce and heat thoroughly. Mix cornstarch and sugar. Stir in reserved pineapple syrup vinegar and soy sauce until smooth. Pour into skillet; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and boiling. Stir 1 minute. Add meatballs and pineapple bits; heat thoroughly.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch dish sprayed with Pam. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Press the liquid from the grated potatoes and discard. Combine grated potatoes with the mashed potatoes egg yolk salt and pepper. Shape into desired size pancakes and fry until brown and crisp on both sides. The pancakes are often served with sauerbraten or other substantial meat dishes or as a luncheon dish together with applesauce.

title: Marinated Sirloin Roast
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over roast. Turn roast over in sauce and cover all sides. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening. Make a well in dry ingredients. Add milk. Roll out or pat down on a floured board and cut. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine 3 cups flour cake mix yeast salt and warm water. Mix until smooth add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth about 6 to 8 minutes. Roll dough into a 9 x 18-inch rectangle. Spread with butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Roll dough jelly-roll style starting with the long end. Slice the dough into 1-inch circles place on greased cookie sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 15 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Frost if desired. Makes about 18 rolls.

title: Ron'S Baked Corn Casserole
instructions: In a small bowl beat the eggs with melted margarine. In a larger bowl combine the corn and sour cream. Stir in the butter and egg mixture. Add the corn muffin mix and mix well. Pour into a well-greased casserole or Pyrex baking dish (9 x 13-inch or smaller). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (will be lightly browned on top). Do not overbake.

title: Mom'S Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats; let stand while you cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Squash
instructions: Place in pot and simmer until tender.

title: Stroganoff
instructions: Fry steak in pan until tender. Mix soup gravy and 1/2 of the sour cream in a pan; heat on low. Cook noodles in boiling water until done. When steak is cooked add to the soup mixture. When noodles are done add to the rest of the ingredients. Mix well and let stand for a minute or two. The extra sour cream is for adding before storing leftovers or if it is not moist enough.

title: Codfish Cakes
instructions: Soak codfish overnight. Drain off water. Run through meat grinder or chop in food processor with onion and garlic. When done mix together with eggs flour and other ingredients. Drop by spoon into shortening or any cooking oil. Fry until golden brown.

title: French Fried Onions
instructions: Peel onions. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Separate into rings. Dip into milk then into combined flour and salt. Fry until light brown a few rings at a time in shallow frying pan. Drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with salt. Serve hot. Great with steak.

title: Thousand Island Salad Dressing
instructions: Put mayonnaise catsup and sugar into blender; blend 10 to 15 seconds. Add relish and blend for 2 to 3 seconds. Pour into jar or container and keep refrigerated.

title: Peanut Pie(From:  Southern Living Magazine)
instructions: Combine cream cheese confectioners sugar peanut butter and milk in a large mixing bowl; beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until well blended. Fold in whipped topping; spoon into crust and sprinkle with peanuts. Chill 8 hours.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Have ready a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix confectioners sugar cracker crumbs peanut butter and butter in medium-size bowl until blended. Scrape into ungreased baking pan and press into an even layer. Spread melted chocolate over top. Refrigerate at least 2 hours until chocolate is firm. Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting with sharp knife into bars. Makes 36 bars at 173 calories per bar.

title: Banana-Nut Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 12-cup muffin pan or use paper liners. Beat together softened margarine and sugar at medium speed until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Beat in bananas until smooth. Mix together flour salt baking powder and soda. Alternately stir in flour mixture and buttermilk into egg mixture until dry ingredients are just moistened. Stir in nuts and vanilla; do not overmix. Fill cups 2/3 full. Bake 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Betty Jane'S Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter until tender. Add dash of Kitchen Bouquet. Add beef bouillon and water. Add sugar and Parmesan cheese. Simmer 1 hour. Add sherry. Put grated Black Diamond in bottom of crock (just enough to cover bottom). Pour hot soup over that and add toasted French bread in slices. Top with more grated Black Diamond cheese. Bake in 500\u00b0 oven until cheese melts and is bubbly almost brown.

title: Scottish Timesavers
instructions: Measure all ingredients into large bowl. Mix at low speed of mixer until a dough forms. Using well floured rolling pin or well floured fingers roll or pat out dough half at a time on ungreased cookie sheet to a 12 x 8-inch rectangle. Cut into 2-inch squares. Do not separate. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Immediately cut into squares along lines. Cool 2 minutes; remove from cookie sheets.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in carrots. Fold in squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix with melted butter. Spread 1/2 stuffing mixture in bottom of a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top. Sprinkle with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cocoa Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together until fluffy eggs sugar margarine and water. Add all dry ingredients to the mixture and mix well. Fold in the nuts chips apples and vanilla. Mix until distributed evenly. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 60 to 70 minutes. Doesnt need frosting.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Crush Ritz crackers and mix with melted margarine. Put the mixture in the bottom of pan. Reserve 1/2 cup of mixture.

title: Eggnog
instructions: Separate yolks from whites of eggs. Beat egg yolks until fluffy and very light in color. Add 1 cup sugar. Add slowly while beating the mixture constantly the bourbon rum and vodka. While still beating mixture add the milk. Reserve 2 tablespoons sherry. Blend remainder of sherry with vanilla ice cream and beat into egg mixture. Whip cream until it forms soft peaks. Whip in 1/3 cup powdered sugar folding into this the 2 tablespoons sherry. Set aside. Beat whites of six eggs until stiff. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Fold whipped cream into egg mixture and top with whites of eggs.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Mix margarine peanut butter and 2 sugars in another bowl. Add flour mixture to the other bowl. Mix well. Roll into small balls and roll in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until they start browning. Place a kiss in each and press down so the cookie cracks. Bake 2 to 5 minutes longer until brown.

title: Hot Artichoke Appetizer
instructions: Mix mayo cheese parsley and hot pepper sauce in medium size bowl until well blended. Fold in artichokes. Spoon into ungreased 2 cup ovenproof serving dish. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Bake 20 minutes or until spread is hot and bubbly.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and flour alternately at slow speed. Stir in flavorings. Pour into a 10-inch greased and floured tube pan. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 2 hours or until cake pulls away from side of pan.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Cook rice in 3 cups water with salt for 20 minutes. While this is cooking brown ground beef in skillet; drain and add taco seasoning and 2 cups water and simmer 10 minutes. Add beans. Spread rice in 9 x 13-inch pan; pour hamburger bean mixture over rice. Spread tortilla chips over hamburger; spread cheese over tortilla chips. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Mix all together except bread crumbs and cheese. Place in greased casserole. Sprinkle bread crumbs and cheese on top. Bake for about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cream Cheese Loaf Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Cream the shortening and gradually add 1 1/2 cups of sugar continuing to cream until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs beating well. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with milk beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Blend well after each addition. Cut cream cheese into 1/4-inch cubes and fold into batter along with orange peel. Turn batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or 12 well-greased muffin tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes for loaves or 20 to 25 minutes for muffins or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli With Rice
instructions: Cool rice; spread in flat casserole dish. Parboil broccoli; arrange on top of rice. Combine mushrooms mayonnaise and seasonings. (For thinner sauce add 1 cup milk.) Top rice with sauce mixture. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Blend together in sifter flour cocoa sugar and soda. Blend in salad dressing and gradually add water to mixture. When mixed thoroughly add vanilla. Cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
instructions: Cream sugar eggs and oleo. Add flour meal vanilla coconut and pineapple. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake slow. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all together and cook until thick; pour into baked pie shell.

title: Fusilli And Chopped Meat
instructions: Put small amount of oil in a large frypan. Cook green pepper and onion until tender. Remove from pan and put on the side. Cook chopped meat then drain all fat. Return chopped meat pepper and onion to frypan. Mix the 2 cans of tomato soup together. Pour into chopped meat and mix. Cook pasta. Drain. Return to pot. Add soup mixture and mix well.

title: Grandma Arp'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Honey Cereal Nibble
instructions: To prepare syrup put honey sugar and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Mix cereals and nuts in roasting pan; pour on syrup and toss. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 45 minutes; stir once 1/2 way through. Remove from oven immediately and spread out on a cookie sheet or Reynolds Wrap in a thin layer to cool. Dont leave in pan or it will stick together. Store in airtight container.

title: Meat Crust Country Pie
instructions: Combine beef crackers onion green pepper 1 1/2 teaspoons salt seasoning to taste and 1/2 cup of tomato sauce. Mix well. Pat into bottom and up sides of a greased 9-inch pie plate.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Toss and brown sausage. Drain. Saute pepper onion and celery in sausage pan. Drain. Boil water and add rice and dry soup mix. Cook until tender. Mix with first 4 ingredients. Bake in casserole dish for 15 minutes.

title: Boudain Dip
instructions: Skin boudain and cut into slices. Microwave for 30 to 45 seconds to soften.

title: Chicken And Grape Salad
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice salt and pepper to taste. Add remaining ingredients. Add more mayonnaise if necessary until chicken barely holds together. Chill before serving.

title: Texas Brag Cake
instructions: Spray Pam in glass dish. Layer pineapple pie filling or peach slices cake mix coconut and oleo. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Add pecans. Bake 15 minutes more. Cool before serving.

title: Rhubarb Crisp
instructions: Mix together the sugar salt flour and rhubarb. Put into an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Mix together the oats cinnamon oleo and brown sugar; sprinkle this mixture over rhubarb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until topping is browned and rhubarb is tender about 35 to 45 minutes. Cool before serving then top with Cool Whip.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Use buttered flat 8 x 8-inch pan. Combine rice sour cream chilies salsa salt and pepper. Put a layer of rice combination and about 1/2 pound Jack cheese shredded. Finish with rice top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can be combined the day before serving and held in refrigerator for baking.

title: Stir-Fried Green Beans
instructions: In skillet brown bacon until crisp. Break into small pieces. Add onion and stir until almost done. Add fresh green beans with 1/3 cup water. Turn to medium heat and cook stirring constantly. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Add more water if needed. Cover and turn heat to low. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes longer. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve.

title: Fresh Spinach Salad
instructions: Wash well and thoroughly dry spinach. Tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and refrigerate. In a heavy skillet fry the bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towel and crumble. Shake the oil vinegar wine soy sauce sugar mustard curry powder salt and seasoned pepper together and pour over spinach. Add bacon and toss lightly. Top with chopped boiled eggs.

title: Pearls 'N Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; set aside. In bowl beat butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla extract until creamy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in Treasures. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 9 to 10 minutes. Allow to stand 2 minutes before removing from cookie sheets; cool completely. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen 3 inch cookies.

title: Jackie'S Broccoli Salad
instructions: Wash and cut broccoli flowerets into bite-sized pieces. Add raisins sunflower seeds and onions. Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Pour over broccoli mixture. Mix lightly. Top with bacon bits. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Fondant
instructions: Microwave candy on Roast - a setting that allows sugar syrup to quickly boil and blend into a candy yet needs little watching. Mix and cook ingredients in a buttered glass mixing bowl or 4-cup glass measure. Bowl or dish must be 2 or 3 times as large as the volume of the candy ingredients so candy syrup will not boil over. Cover candy during cooking when called for in the recipe. Use a glass plate or stretch plastic wrap tautly across the bowl or glass measure; pierce plastic wrap so steam escapes during cooking. There is no need to worry that candy will scorch because microwaves cook from all sides not just the bottom. Candy syrups are usually stirred once during cooking so heat is equalized and candy cooks smooth. Do watch candy closely because a microwave oven cooks fast. When candy is removed from oven it should register 236\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Do not put a candy thermometer into a microwave oven or it will be damaged.

title: Fast Fiesta Dip
instructions: In medium bowl combine sour cream salsa and taco seasoning. Mix well. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 3 cups.

title: Chicken Rolls
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and form into log. Roll in chopped pecans and Parmesan cheese.

title: Cranberry Snap Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large container stirring well. Chill and then serve over crushed ice (2 quarts).

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients reserving 1/2 of onions. Pour into casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
instructions: In a large bowl mix well mayonnaise chili sauce relish onion and salt. Add cabbage and raisins; toss to mix well. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix dough. Chill 2 hours. Roll out and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Place sugar and cinnamon in plastic bag. Add biscuit pieces a few at a time and shake to coat. Place pieces into a well-greased tube or Bundt pan until all are used. Sprinkle layers with pecans raisins or coconut. Bring brown sugar and margarine to a boil in saucepan. Pour over top of biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Allow to cool 15 minutes before removing from pan. Turn top-side up to serve. Pieces can be picked apart.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Cake Combine flour and sugar in large bowl. Heat margarine cocoa and Coca-Cola to boiling. Pour over flour and sugar; stir well. Add buttermilk eggs soda vanilla and marshmallows. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mixed Vegetables Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Break 1/2 stick of Ritz crackers and melted margarine (1 stick) and put on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
instructions: In large saucepan cook onions in3 tablespoons oil until tender. Add potatoes; cover with water. Cook covered 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Blend in soup milk and salt. Heat but do not boil. Serve garnished with bacon and parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Four-Cup Salad
instructions: Drain fruit. Add coconut and chill. Stir in sour cream just before serving.

title: Deep Dish Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a square 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Blend butter sugar and vanilla. Add eggs; beat with a spoon. Combine dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture. Stir in chips. Spread in pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes (slightly less for chewy brownies) or until brownies pull away from the sides of the pan. Cool completely. Cut into squares. Yields 16 servings.

title: Helen'S Fried Rice
instructions: Saute onions in oleo until brown. Add mushrooms and saute for 5 minutes. Add rice and saute another 5 minutes. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; bring to a boil. Pour over rice mixture. Cover and shut off heat.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Put everything in bowl. Beat 20 minutes with electric mixer. Set oven at 350\u00b0 and put cake in cold oven. Bake 1 hour. Do not open oven! Bake in Bundt pan; do not grease or flour pan.

title: Corn Custard
instructions: Double recipe if using large casserole using 1 can of whole kernel corn and 1 can of cream-style corn.

title: Annie'S German Lentil Soup
instructions: Wash lentils in cold water. Drain. Now add lentils to cold water. Saute bacon and onions until golden brown. Stir in tomato sauce or tomatoes add bacon and onions potatoes and rest of ingredients adding more water as needed during cooking. Simmer 30 to 45 minutes; add parsley.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain and cool it. Place in a casserole dish. Blend in sour cream and onion soup mix. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.\tDo not cover. Serves 4.

title: Fried Do-Nut Holes
instructions: Beats eggs; add shortening and sugar and beat well. Add remaining ingredients and stir in. Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease and fry until brown on all sides. Coat hot do-nut holes in cinnamon/sugar mixture. Dough can be made ahead and refrigerated.

title: Cinnamon Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix lemon pudding cooking oil water and eggs all together. Mix in a separate bowl the cinnamon and sugar. Set this aside. Grease a tube pan and sprinkle about 1/2 of the cinnamon and sugar mixture around in pan. Pour your cake mix in pan and then add the rest of the cinnamon and sugar mixture on top. Stir lightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Add cheese and chili to sausage. Heat until cheese has melted. Stir and serve hot. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Yellow Split-Pea Soup With Kielbasa(My Favorite Winter Soup - A Meal In Itself)
instructions: In a heavy kettle cook the onion in the butter over moderately low heat stirring until it is softened. Add the split-peas the sliced carrot the celery the kielbasa the bay leaf and 2 1/2 quarts water. Bring the liquid to a boil skimming the froth and simmer the mixture covered stirring occasionally for 3 hours. Discard the bay leaf and transfer the kielbasa with a slotted spoon to a plate. In a blender puree the mixture in batches. Transfer the puree to the kettle and thin it with hot water to the desired consistency. Cut the kielbasa into 1/4-inch thick slices. Quarter the slices and add them to the soup. Season the soup with salt and pepper. Makes about 9 cups before thinning serving 6.

title: Libby'S Great Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix flour oats baking soda cinnamon and salt in medium bowl. Beat butter sugar and brown sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy. Add pumpkin eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Gradually add flour mixture. Mix well. Stir in nuts and raisins. Drop dough onto greased baking sheet. Spread into 3 inch circle. repeat with remaining dough. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 14 to 16 minutes or until firm and lightly browned. Cool on baking sheets for two minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Beaufort Stew
instructions: Note May increase potatoes corn or shrimp.

title: Peach Preserves
instructions: Combine sugar and water and cook until sugar dissolves. Add peaches and cook rapidly until fruit becomes clear stirring occasionally. Cover and let stand 12 to 18 hours in a cool place. Drain fruit and pack into hot Ball jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Cook syrup rapidly 2 to 3 minutes or longer if too thin. Pour over fruit leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process half pints and pints 20 minutes at 180\u00b0 to 185\u00b0 in hot water bath. Yield About 6 half pints.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs peanut butter vanilla and corn syrup; beating well. Add oats soda and salt stirring well. Stir in the remaining ingredients. (Dough will be stiff.)

title: Frozen Parfait
instructions: Mix orange juice as directed. Add sugar and freeze until like slush. Mix all ingredients and pour into orange juice. Place in parfait glasses; freeze. Take out 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Quesadillas
instructions: Rub both sides of each tortilla lightly with oil; place on waxed paper or a paper plate. Microwave each tortilla on 100 % (high) for 45 seconds. Sprinkle cheese on hot tortilla; fold tortilla in half. Microwave on 100 % (high) for 35 seconds or until cheese melts. Repeat procedure for each tortilla and serve immediately.

title: Sesame Milk
instructions: Bring sesame seed and water to a boil; simmer 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; blend until smooth. Chill and serve.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Dice oranges and apples. Add coconut and sugar. Mix well.

title: Vegetarian Tortilla Soup
instructions: Heat oil over medium high heat in a large saucepan or Dutch oven. Add garlic and onion and cook until tender but not browned. Add tomatoes and cook for a few minutes more. Add the tofu cubes and stir gently until heated through then add the corn black beans green chilies vegetable broth cilantro cumin salt pepper and lime juice.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Prepare lime jello according to package directions but reduce water by 1/2 cup and stir in pineapple. Pour into large dish or pan. Place in refrigerator until firm. Combine cottage cheese lemon juice and sugar and mash with a fork or with mixer until smooth. Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Blend into cottage cheese. Add nuts. Spread over lime jello. Prepare cherry jello according to package directions. Pour over filling. Chill until firm.

title: Pancake Syrup
instructions: Simmer sugars and water for 10 minutes. Add extract. Doesnt need to be refrigerated but may crystallize. Reheat.

title: Cherry-Almond Balls
instructions: Mix Karo light corn syrup orange juice and almond extract. Add crushed vanilla wafers. Mold 1 teaspoon around a candied cherry. Roll in colored sprinkles. Store tightly covered.

title: French Toast
instructions: Heat butter sugar and syrup to boiling; boil 1 minute. Whisk together eggs milk and cinnamon. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice bread into 3/4-inch to 1-inch pieces; place in single layer over syrup. Pour egg mixture over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sonya'S Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Blend the sugar and butter. Add pretzels and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Cooked Onions With A Difference
instructions: Peel onions. Cut off stem area and hollow out an area about the size of a thimble. Insert a beef bouillon cube in each onion and cover with about a 1/2 teaspoon of butter. You may have to push the cube in firmly. Wrap in aluminum foil and place on grill or in a low oven with mixture side up. Cook for about 1 hour or until the onion is tender. You wont believe how good this is! Serves 2.

title: Portuguese Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil just until transparent. Add sausage and brown lightly. Add beef stock and all other ingredients. Bring to a boil stirring often. Reduce heat. Simmer for 45 minutes or more stirring occasionally. Makes 1 gallon plus.

title: One More Chicken Dish
instructions: Cook chicken; cool and dice. Reserve 1 cup broth. Mix soup milk and broth. Cook until smooth. Fill each roll with 1 tablespoon chicken. Roll and seal edges. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour soup mix over. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turkey can be used also.

title: Gruyere Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine next 5 ingredients and pour over potatoes. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake an additional 5 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Make small balls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: No Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine first three ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet. bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
instructions: Combine pudding mix and Bisquick| mix in a bowl. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add egg and milk; blend well. Stir in chips.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except macaroni and egg in large bowl. Add macaroni and egg. Mix lightly. Chill before serving.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until browned; drain off fat. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place in ungreased pizza pan with points toward center. Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust. Seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with cheddar cheese. In bowl beat together eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour into crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken well. Coat with flour. Cook in oil until brown. Remove. Put in remaining ingredients and mix. Return chicken to pan. Cover. Cook 30 to 40 minutes or until tender.

title: Buffalo Chips
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage. Stir in spices and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Put 1 Tbsp. meat mixture on thin slice of rye bread. Cut slices into 4 pieces each. Brown in oven for 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese and Blue cheese with milk and mix thoroughly. Add green pepper pimento garlic powder and salt. Mix well. Form into a ball. Roll cheese ball in finely ground nuts.

title: Kathy Powers Hudson'S Zucchini Loaf
instructions: In a bowl stir together flour baking powder sugar and 2 teaspoons salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Store in an airtight container for up to 6 weeks at room temperature or for up to 6 months in the freezer. Use to make Easy Biscuits Easy Muffins or Easy Pancakes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Sift together into first mixture the flour baking powder baking soda salt and spices. Stir to blend. Add nuts and raisins. Beat 4 minutes. Pour into greased loaf pans and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Bean And Corn Casserole
instructions: First Layer Mix together green beans and corn. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Easy Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage and drain. Sprinkle into the bottom of a 9 by 13 inch pan. Add Italian bread torn into pieces. Beat eggs with milk salt and pepper. Add vegetables if desired. Pour egg mixture over bread and sausage. Refrigerate over night. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 40 minutes. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Pound Cake(The Best Recipe I Have Ever Tried)
instructions: Cream butter. Add confectioners sugar; add eggs and lemon extract. Add 1 confectioners sugar box of flour filled lightly vanilla and milk. Mix thoroughly by hand. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Quick Nut Fudge
instructions: Heat condensed milk on medium heat. Add chocolate chips stir until melted. Add margarine and pecans pieces. Add peanut butter. Stir well and pour in greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
instructions: Boil raisins in water about 5 minutes. Let cool slightly. Add sugar. Add shortening to raisins. Next add dry ingredients and mix. Bake in greased Bundt or tube pan at 400\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes. If necessary bake longer and reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Good luck. Enjoy!

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti in chicken broth after cooking fryers. Saute onion and peppers in margarine. Mix in chicken peas pimento Ro-Tel tomatoes and cheese; cut into chunks. Heat until cheese melts. Stir in spaghetti and broth mixture. Pour into three 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans. Freeze 2 casseroles and bake the other one at 325\u00b0 until hot and bubbly. Garnish with grated cheese.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Boil water bouillon cubes potatoes celery and onion for 20 minutes. Add California mix and boil 10 minutes. Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta cheese. Stir until well mixed and cheese is melted.

title: Hot Sauce(Canned)
instructions: Mix all in large crock. Bring to a boil slowly. Then simmer until as thick as youd like. Set into clean jars (hot). Seal in hot bath for 15 minutes or until pressure cooked 10 minutes at 5 pounds.

title: Tiger'S Butter
instructions: Mix thoroughly by hand the melted white summer coating and peanut butter in a small bowl. Add the melted light chocolate to that mixture and stir slightly. Pour into a wax paper lined pan (approximately 10-inch square) and use a table knife to stir pretty swirls of the dark and light mixtures to give a marbelized effect. Let set at room temperature until solid. Cut into squares and serve as you would fudge or roll into balls and use as centers in a bonbon mold.

title: Herbed Carrot Potato Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise or salad dressing sour cream lemon juice chives Worcestershire salt dill weed mustard and pepper until well combined. In a medium pan heat small amount of water to boiling; add carrots and simmer uncovered for 2 minutes. Drain. Rinse with cold water; drain again. In a large bowl gently toss together the sliced potatoes sliced carrots celery and olives. Add sour cream mixture. Gently toss to coat well. Cover and chill several hours.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Make cake according to directions on box. Melt caramels margarine and milk on low heat. Pour half the batter in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Pour melted caramel mixture over. Top with chocolate chips nuts and coconut over. Pour remaining batter over. Bake 20 minutes more.

title: Quick Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown the beef in a skillet; crumble. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients except rice stir to mix well; bring to a boil. Add the instant rice; cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Potato And Burger Casserole
instructions: Cook in iron skillet that can go in the oven. Brown beef and onion; drain off fat. Blend in 1/4 cup flour ketchup beef broth 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. stir in mushroom soup and sour cream.

title: Burnt Sugar Cake
instructions: Sift flour measure and add baking powder and salt. Sift three times. Cream butter add sugar gradually and cream until light. Add egg yolks and vanilla and beat. Add flour mixture alternately with water or milk. Add caramelized sugar. Fold in egg whites. Bake in two 9-inch layer cake pans in 350\u00b0 oven 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Place mixture in a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle additional cracker crumbs on top of casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Place potatoes in large saucepan; cover with water. Bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes; drain. Set aside. Heat butter in same saucepan over medium heat. Add onion; cook stirring occasionally 1 to 2 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk and water. Cook stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Arrange potatoes in prepared baking dish. Pour milk mixture over potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and cheese is light golden brown.

title: One Dish Chicken & Rice Bake
instructions: In 2-quart shallow baking dish mix soup water rice and paprika. Place chicken on rice mixture. Sprinkle with additional paprika. Cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 4. For creamier rice increase water to 1 1/2 cups.

title: Cranberry Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter and sugars together. Beat in milk orange juice and egg. Stir together flour baking powder salt and soda; blend well with sugar mixture. Stir in nuts and cranberries. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 11 dozen cookies.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix all ingredients except baking soda in skillet. Cook 8 to 12 minutes on medium-low heat. Stir occasionally until golden brown. Remove and add baking soda. Stir fast and pour on aluminum foil.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine until transparent. Add Cheez Whiz and broccoli and when cheese mixture has melted add rice soup and milk. Mix well. Put into 1 1/2 quart casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 for 3/4 hour (covered for 1/2 hour and uncovered for 15 minutes). Stir occasionally. Can use more broccoli or rice if you like.

title: Mexican Delight
instructions: Brown ground beef. Chop onion and saute with ground beef. Add remaining ingredients and cook for 30 minutes or until rice is done. Serve over Fritos corn chips or tortillas. Top with fresh chopped onions grated cheese lettuce diced avocado ripe chopped olives Ranch Style \white cream\ dressing and sour cream taco sauce etc.

title: Kansas City Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup of milk until smooth. Add an additional 1 1/2 cups of milk and cook in double boiler until thick and smooth\tbeating constantly to avoid lumps. Blend sugar eggs salt and evaporated milk in electric mixer. Add hot cornstarch mixture and beat well. Add whipping cream remaining milk and vanilla.\tPour into gallon electric or hand-cranked type freezer. Pack with ice and salt and freeze according to manufacturers directions.\tMakes 1 gallon.

title: Angel Bavarian Cake
instructions: Mix pudding mix by directions on box. Let completely cool. Slice cake in thin slices and lay flat in 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour 1/2 pudding mix over cake. Top with half of Cool Whip. Add another layer of cake then pudding then rest of Cool Whip. Top with package of coconut. Chill before serving.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In heavy pan put sugar milk and oleo stir. Bring to boil. Boil 3 minutes. Turn off heat stir and add rest of ingredients. When starts to set up pour on buttered platter.

title: Two Birds With One Stone
instructions: Boil and mash the potatoes. Add the next 5 ingredients and beat well. Add the chives and dill. Add the cooked drained spinach and beat well again. Put in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pork Supreme
instructions: Cut meat in thin narrow strips. Season with salt and pepper. Brown in oil using an ovenproof skillet. Add celery green onions and peppers. Saute until tender. Stir in rice broth and seasonings. Bring to a boil cover and bake at 375\u00b0 until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Fluff rice with a fork.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Put yeast in warm water; add sugar. Let stand. Put salt and eggs in warm milk and shortening. Add yeast mixture. Stir well. Add flour to make stiff. Set in warm place; let rise then make into loaves or rolls. Let rise and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Combine eggs salt and sugar. Add milk and vanilla. Pour into pastry shell and sprinkle with nutmeg. Cover top with coconut. Bake in very hot oven (450\u00b0) for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Quick Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: In mixing bowl dissolve yeast in water. Add milk half the flour sugar and shortening. Beat with spoon until smooth and batter falls from spoon in sheets. Using your hands mix in enough of the remaining flour until dough cleans the bowl. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Cover and let rest 10 to 15 minutes. Knead until smooth and blistered about 10 minutes. Shape into crescents or any shape. Let rise 1 1/2 hours or until double in bulk. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pistachio Dream Cheesecake
