instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients and pat into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Kraut-Sausage Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place alternate layers of sauerkraut and beans in a buttered 8-quart casserole ending with sauerkraut. Combine water and salt. Mix until dissolved. Add to casserole. Slice sausage roll. Place slices on top of sauerkraut. Bake 40 minutes. Remove from oven. Increase temperature to 400\u00b0. Arrange biscuits on top. Bake 10 to 15 minutes until browned.

title: Pull A Pound Soup
instructions: Cut all vegetables fine. Cover with water. Bring to a boil and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Makes a big kettle.

title: Champagne Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix club soda eggs and oil; beat with mixer then stir in cherries pineapple and nuts with spoon. Make 3 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. For added color use 1/2 jar red and 1/2 jar green cherries.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into a loaf pan or dish and freeze.

title: Raisin Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine brown sugar butter vanilla and boiling water. Pour into 8 x\t8-inch\tglass pan. Pour boiling water over raisins. Cover and let set while mixing batter.

title: Mozzarella In Carrozza(For 6 People)
instructions: Cut bread in shape of a triangle. Place 1 slice of Mozzarella between 2 slices of bread. Cover them with flour then dip in egg then in bread crumbs. Meanwhile get oil ready and hot so you can fry the bread.

title: Buttercream Cookies
instructions: Cut in butter shortening and sugar creaming well. Blend in almond extract and sifted flour mixing well. Roll dough into balls using 1 level tablespoon of dough for each cookie. Press and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cook for 8 minutes.

title: Greta'S Taco Dip
instructions: Mix taco seasoning mix sour cream and salad dressing together and set aside.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix margarine and 1 egg. Press into greased 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan. Mix together powdered sugar cream cheese and 3 eggs. Pour over first mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Let cool; cut into squares.

title: Eszter Hazy(Austrian)
instructions: Dust veal strips with flour salt and pepper. Saute veal in 2 tablespoons butter sauteeing quickly. Remove veal from pan. In skillet heat remaining butter and add onion. Cook until lightly glazed. Add parsley and sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the flour; stir. Add cream and stock cooking over low heat until sauce is smooth. Add meat and cook until tender. Stir in last two ingredients when skillet is removed from heat. Serves 8.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; set juice aside. Mix pineapple apples pecans and cheese. Cook pineapple juice sugar flour and egg on medium heat stirring constantly. Pour over salad.

title: Orsini'S Goulash Soup
instructions: Saute onion garlic and bay leaf in oil until soft and yellow. Add pork and beef; cook until brown. Add tomatoes green pepper potatoes lemon juice and marjoram. Season with salt and pepper. Add bouillon and water to fill 5-quart saucepan nearly full. Stir in parsley. Cook 1 hour.

title: Drop Cookies
instructions: Grease pans. Sift flour before measuring. Mix together dry ingredients. Mix together liquid ingredients. Add dry to liquid and mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonful on greased pan 2 inches apart. Bake in a hot oven (350\u00b0) for 10 to 15 minutes. Nuts raisins or sprinkles can be added on top of cookie before baking.

title: Spiced Orange Gingerbread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except orange marmalade and whipped cream. Beat at low speed 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch baking pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Festivities Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in the bottom of a casserole dish. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Stir together soup and water in saucepan over medium heat to remove lumps. Remove from heat and add sour cream. Stir in cheese and 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seed. Pour over chicken strips. Mix together remaining poppy seed melted butter and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll dough out (must add a lot of flour to make dry enough). Cut cookies with cutters. Decorate. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 6 to 7 minutes or until brown. (Also can be used with cookie press.) Yields approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Potatoes, Cheddar And Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil. Remove from heat and drain. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. While potatoes come to a boil make a white sauce by melting 3 tablespoons butter in saucepan. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat and slowly add milk stirring constantly. Return to heat and bring to boil stirring. When sauce is slightly thickened add cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes in baking dish. Add ham and mix gently so as not to break up potatoes. If desired combine 1 cup dry breadcrumbs and 2 tablespoons melted butter in small bowl and sprinkle over casserole. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Stir in vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients; add to sugar-egg mixture mixing well. Stir in pears and pecans. Batter will be stiff. Pour into a well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until done. Cool about 5 minutes and remove from pan. Freezes well.

title: Irene Enright'S Bailey'S Pie
instructions: Following directions on Knox package thoroughly dissolve gelatine. When slighlty cooled combine with Irish cream and slowly add to heavy cream which has been whipped with sugar and extract until it is almost stiff. Dont add the liquor too soon or it might not stiffen. When combined pour into crumb crust. Garnish with sprinkles or nuts and extra whipped cream (so dietetic). For quick setting place in freezer for a few hours. Can be frozen a few weeks ahead of time and put into refrigerator a few hours before serving.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in pan 9 x 14-inch. Pour batter mixture in melted butter in pan. Add fruit evenly. Do not stir just shake pan a little. Put in 350\u00b0 oven. Bake until brown approximately 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Select a deep wide dish that will hold chicken without crowding and have only one layer. Melt oleo in dish; salt and pepper lightly. Roll chicken in oleo and arrange in dish. Sprinkle dry rice over chicken. Sprinkle soup mix over all. Add water slowly around and over all. Cover with foil or lid and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. At 45 minutes lift chicken up and let rice fall under chicken.

title: Frosting For Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Cook all together until kinda thick.

title: Lemon Custard Cake
instructions: Tear the cake into bite-sized pieces. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In mixing bowl combine the pudding mix milk and sour cream. Beat until thickened about 2 minutes. Spread over the cake. Spoon pie filling on top. Chill until serving time. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Pink Salad
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and chill.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Cake
instructions: Mix gently by hand. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased and floured). Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 to 30 minutes. Frost with dark chocolate frosting.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Cover tightly and place in refrigerator overnight. Bake in a large pan in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. You can add chopped chicken in dressing before baking.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix chicken onions and lettuce. Add sesame seeds almonds and noodles.

title: Vegetable Bundles
instructions: Remove husks from ears of corn. Spread corn generously with margarine and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Wrap each ear in heavy-duty foil sealing and twisting foil around ends. Place on grill for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until they are white and tender. While these are cooking also cook broccoli by package directions. When done debone chicken and cut into bite-size pieces. Spread broccoli in bottom of Pyrex dish. Layer with chicken. Mix soup curry powder mayonnaise and lemon juice together and pour over chicken. Sprinkle cheese on top. Crush crackers and mix with margarine and spread on top. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Barry'S Deer Jerky
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and marinate in the refrigerator for 6 to 10 hours. When ready to dry remove slices and drain on paper towels; may pat dry. To dry spread slices in single layer on oven racks. Place a pan under racks to catch drippings. Set temperature at 140\u00b0 or lowest temperature on your stove. Open door slightly to allow air to circulate and moisture to escape. Drying will take 6 to 10 hours. Turn over after 4 hours. Jerky is done when meat is shriveled dark leathery and chewy.

title: 6-Cup Salad
instructions: Pour pineapple over marshmallows and let stand until mushy. Mix all together and let set. Refrigerate in covered dish overnight. Very good with ham. You can also add maraschino cherries.

title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together flour sugar baking powder milk and melted oleo. Spread in bottom of pan then pour fruit over the top (the fruit needs to be cooked long enough to melt sugar and make syrup). I use blackberries or rhubarb or peaches; use sugar to sweeten as needed. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Sicilian Rice Balls
instructions: Cook rice to tender. Drain and put aside. Fry onions to light brown. Add salami then bread crumbs to absorb oil. When cool mix all ingredients including eggs pine nuts and cheese etc. Shape into meatball size or smaller. Fill dish with bread crumbs and roll balls to cover. Fry in deep oil or fry in pan to golden brown. Drain.

title: Cheezy Italian Macaroni Casserole(Serves 6)
instructions: Use 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Turkey Piccata
instructions: Place turkey slices between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound with edge of heavy saucer until thin. Remove plastic and coat each side of turkey with flavored bread crumbs pressing down firmly. Season each side with a sprinkle of flavored salt garlic powder and black pepper. If time allows refrigerated breaded slices for an hour to set bread crumbs. In large heavy skillet melt 3 tablespoons margarine and begin browning slices over medium-high heat until golden brown. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Add remaining margarine to skillet drippings and saute mushrooms until tender. Add lemon juice and wine or chicken broth and stir to loosen brown particles. Return turkey to skillet and top with lemon slices. Simmer gently 8 to 10 minutes until sauce thickens and turkey is tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oatmeal Toffee Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheet or use parchment paper. Beat butter eggs brown sugar and vanilla extract until well blended. Add flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Beat until blended. Stir in oats and brickle with a spoon. Drop dough by rounded teaspoon about 2-inches apart onto prepared sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool 1 minute. Remove to wire rack. Makes about 4 dozen (large) cookies.

title: Macky'S Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream. Add taco mix. Put mixture in round dish. Layer with lettuce tomatoes cheese and olives. Pour salsa over all. Serve with nachos.

title: Spiced Apple Rings Or Lime Pickles(Takes 3 Days To Make)
instructions: Scoop center out of cucumbers. Cut into 1/2-inch rings. Add lime and enough water to cover all the cukes. Let stand 24 hours in plastic container. Drain and rinse well. Cover with ice cubes. Let stand 3 hours. Drain well.

title: Dottie'S Olive Spread
instructions: Chop olives and pecans finely or in a food processor. Mix in the mayo and softened cream cheese and pepper adding the olive juice to achieve spreading consistency. Refrigerate. Serve on crackers or as a sandwich filling.

title: Featherbed Rolls
instructions: Add shortening to milk while milk is still hot. When milk has cooled dissolve yeast in water and add to milk. Add sugar salt eggs and flour. Mix well and let stand in bowl for 20 minutes. Knead for a minute or two. Shape into rolls and let rise until doubled in size. Bake in hot oven 425\u00b0 until golden brown about 20 minutes. Brush with butter after removing from oven. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix together peanut butter and sugar until they resemble pie crust mix. Gradually stir in Cool Whip; mix until smooth and creamy. Spread hot fudge sauce on bottom of chocolate pie crust. Top with Cool Whip mixture. Spread more hot fudge sauce on top of pie. Sprinkle with walnuts if desired. Freeze for at least 3 hours before serving. Stays fresh in freezer.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until crispy then crumble into small pieces. Cut broccoli into small pieces; mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over crust. Cover and let set in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Place bacon on bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole. Sprinkle rice over bacon; add chicken then salt and pepper. Dilute mushroom soup with milk; pour over chicken. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Lasagna Al Forno
instructions: Brown beef or sausage cut in small pieces in oil in 3-quart saucepan; drain. Add spaghetti sauce and simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook lasagna; drain. (Separate lasagna and lay out flat on wax paper or aluminum foil to keep pieces from sticking together as they cool.) Spread about half cup meat sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Cover with layer of lasagna. Add some Mozzarella and Ricotta cheeses and cover with sauce. Repeat layers of lasagna meat sauce and cheeses ending with a layer of lasagna and sauce. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Remove foil and bake 5 minutes longer. Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting for easier handling.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt the butter and chocolate; cool. Beat eggs with wire whisk; add sugar chocolate and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour and walnuts. Bake in small coffee cake pan at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Frost or cover with powdered sugar.

title: Cheesy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Prepare a 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish. Mix 1/4 cup butter flour milk bouillon seasoned salt garlic powder and pepper until smooth. Bring to a boil and cool until thickened. Reduce heat and add chicken process cheese and sour cream. Stir until melted. Add cooked rice and pour into baking dish. Take 1/4 cup butter and crushed crackers and brown in skillet. Use this as the topping. Bake at 425 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and rice separately. Place melted butter in bottom of 2-quart dish. Mix together cooked broccoli rice soup onion cheese and milk. Place on top of butter. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dollie'S Soup
instructions: Simmer about 1 hour or longer. If you use broth that you have prepared yourself from turkey put it in the refrigerator until fat has risen to top. Skim off fat and use only the broth.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed. Drain well. Combine soup mayo eggs and onion. Blend in cooked broccoli. Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Melt margarine. Add crumbs and mix well. Sprinkle over top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Munching Peanut Brittle
instructions: Microwave on High power. Mix sugar and syrup and microwave for 4 minutes. Add peanuts and microwave for 3 to 5 minutes until peanuts are light brown. Stir in vanilla and butter and microwave 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in baking soda until light and fluffy. Spread on greased cookie sheet to cool 1/2 to 1 hour. When cool break into small pieces.

title: Mary Ball Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and milk together. Bring to a boil and boil exactly 9 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate bits butter and marshmallow cream. Stir until melted and mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Yields about 5 pounds.

title: Wine Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Beat with mixer 5 to 7 minutes. Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar while still warm.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugars together. Add the eggs and vanilla; mix until smooth. Sift flour soda baking powder and salt together; add to creamed mixture. Mix well then add the oatmeal rice cereal and coconut and mix well. Dough will be quite crumbly. Mold with hands into balls the size of a walnut. Place on a cookie sheet and press slightly. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 6 dozen.

title: Seven-Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in dish as given starting with the lettuce. Chill in refrigerator 6 to 8 hours. Do not stir.

title: Real Good Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Mix with sauce. Layer sauce noodles (uncooked) sauce cheeses noodles sauce etc sauce on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Pie
instructions: Place deboned chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan. Bring to boil chicken broth and soup. Pour over chicken; mix flour buttermilk and melted margarine. Pour over first mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Brown at 450\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Family Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a saucepan combine beef onion garlic and 1/4 cup water; cook until onions are tender. Spread half of potatoes in a 3 quart casserole. Top with half of meat mixture then carrots then cheese then remaining meat mixture. Mix soup with 1/2 soup can of water; pour over casserole and top with remaining potatoes. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. When potatoes are fork tender combine biscuit mix with enough milk to make a thin consistency; pour over casserole. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until dough is lightly browned. Yield 6 servings.

title: Mousse(Chocolate Or Lemon)
instructions: Mix flour margarine and pecans together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Quick Mix Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in bowl. Add last 5 ingredients. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Reese'S Cups
instructions: Mix and melt Hershey bar and peanut butter. Set jar of peanut butter in hot water to soften. Line cupcake pan with holders. Spoon in 1 tablespoon chocolate mix then put one tablespoon of peanut butter. Top with 1 tablespoon chocolate. Refrigerate until it sets and becomes firm.

title: Dirt Cup
instructions: You will need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) paper or plastic cups.

title: Aunt Osie'S Plum Cake
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl. Pour in tube pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Golden Glow Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and cool. Melt marshmallows in pineapple juice over low heat. Fold until smooth. Blend cheese carrots and pineapple. When gelatin cools blend together all ingredients. Pour into mold and chill several hours.

title: Lemonade-Watermelon Punch
instructions: Select a melon about 20 inches long with a flat base. The day before serving cut an 8-inch oval section making a sawtooth edge out of the top of the melon. Remove cut portion and reserve. Using a long handled spoon scoop out pulp; remove seeds. Place 1/4 of the pulp at a time in blender container or food processor bowl. Cover blend or process until pureed. (Should have 12 cups.) Place melon shell on a large tray. Return puree to melon shell; stir in water lemonade concentrate and grenadine. Replace cut out portion of melon. Refrigerate overnight. Before serving remove cut portion of melon; pour in lemon-lime beverage to fill 3/4 full. Stir with an up-and-down motion. Ladle punch into cups.

title: Barbecued Rice Entree
instructions: Combine all ingredients except almonds. Simmer about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Stir in almonds and serve. Serves 4.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a wok. (You may use a large pot but is better to use a wok.) Stir ingredients to keep from sticking. Cook until warm throughout.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar. Add eggs then molasses; blend well. Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture. Combine thoroughly. Roll balls size of walnuts in white sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop artichoke hearts and mix with remaining ingredients. Bake in a small casserole dish at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot with Melba toast rounds.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Pound chicken fillets until thin. Lay out flat and sprinkle with parsley. Top each fillet with a slice of cheese then a slice of ham. Roll up tightly. Brush each fillet with mayonnaise and then roll in the bread crumbs. Spray a baking pan or sheet with cooking spray. Arrange the chicken rolls seam side down in a single layer. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes.

title: Dinner Pork Chops
instructions: Wash and drain pork chops. Dip each chop in prepared mustard. Roll in flour salt and pepper. Fry to a golden brown. Drain off fat. Using the cans of soup spoon the rice on top of pork chops and pour the soup around chops. Cover and simmer until tender. If more rice is desired cook the cup of rice and spoon on the chops. (Use an electric skillet.)

title: Merrimont Frankfurters
instructions: Slice wieners in half lengthwise and place in dish cut side down. Pour over barbecue sauce and bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 15 minutes. Baste frequently.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Sprinkle yeast in warm water; let stand until dissolved. Add sugar oils and 2 1/2 cups of the flour beating well. Gradually add the remaining 2 1/2 cups of flour to form a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured board and knead until smooth and elastic adding flour as needed. May take 1/2 to 1 cup. Turn dough into greased bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Let rise in warm place until doubled (2 to 3 hours). Punch down and let rise again. Punch down and divide into 3 balls. Roll out dough adding enough flour to make dough fit pizza pan. Fold under outer edges. Pierce holes in dough with fork. Do a \first bake\ in a 400\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 oven for 5 to 7 minutes. Ready for your favorite pizza recipe. Makes three 13-inch pizzas.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In large pot boil potatoes until they start to fall apart. Drain some of the water. Cook on low constantly stirring until thick. Add salt pepper butter and chives. Stir well. Add enough milk to make soup as thick as you like it. Continue to cook on low until hot.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Put all ingredients in a casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Layered Banana Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs sugar and margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan. Press evenly onto bottom of pan. Arrange banana slices on crust.

title: Pumpkin Ice Cream Squares
instructions: Mix crumbs sugar and butter in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Combine pumpkin sugar salt and spices. Fold in ice cream. Pour over crumbs. Cover. Freeze. Cut into squares 20 minutes before serving.

title: Butter Nut Cheerios
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with Crisco. Beat eggs until light. Beat in sugars vanilla butter and Crisco until creamy. In large bowl combine flour with baking powder and salt. Add sugar mixture to flour. Mix on low and fold in pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Baked Chicken
instructions: Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Pour in dry rice. Lay raw chicken on top of rice. Mix together mushroom soup soup can of water and onion soup mix. Pour this over rice and chicken. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Yield 4 to 5 servings.

title: Layered Summer Salad
instructions: In a salad bowl layer the ingredients as follows lettuce 1/4 cup dressing bacon tomatoes cheese turkey or chicken and remaining 1/4 cup of dressing. Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Rinse chicken breasts in cold water and pat dry. In large bowl combine sour cream lemon juice Worcestershire sauce celery salt paprika salt pepper and garlic; mix well. Add chicken to sour cream marinade covering each piece well. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Squash Supreme
instructions: Put squash in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Drain well. Butter a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Beginning with a sprinkle of cheese alternate ingredients by layers. Save a little cheese for topping. Bake in oven at 350 degrees until contents bubble. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Brown and serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all together except vanilla in heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat as it thickens turn down. Add vanilla and set aside after it thickens. Let it cool then spoon into baked pie shell or you can pour in while it is warm.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Butter casserole dish. Mix soup water and chicken with noodles. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes (covered).

title: Warm Springs Apples
instructions: Put apples in baking dish. Sprinkle jello on top. Mix sugar flour and margarine well. Put on top of apples. Bake 30 minutes until apples are done.

title: Oatmeal Cookies (3)
instructions: Sift flour salt baking powder & soda. Cream brown sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Stir in dry ingredients and rolled oats. Chill dough. Form into balls and roll into powdered sugar until heavily coated. Bake in a moderate oven on greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 8-10 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Beat egg slightly with fork. Stir in milk pumpkin and butter. Measure flour; blend in dry ingredients. Fold in raisins. Fill cups 2/3 full. May sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon sugar over each muffin. Bake 18 to 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Rice For A Crowd
instructions: Bring to boil and boil 13 minutes. Rinse in cold water. Salt to taste. Place in large pan. Cover very tightly with foil. Place in low 150\u00b0 to 200\u00b0 oven until needed.

title: Vacuum Cleaner Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine dry cake mix and 1 of the eggs. Stir together until dry ingredients are moistened. Pat mixture over bottom of well-greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Beat in remaining eggs and sugar. Stir in coconut and nuts. Spread evenly over margarine mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Cool pan on wire rack to room temperature. Cut into bars. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Salary Cap
instructions: Serve in chimney glass.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix milk and soup in a baking dish. Take chicken off bones. Put chicken over soup mixture. Mix dressing with broth and put over chicken or use Stove Top stuffing. Bake until bubbly about 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.

title: Meat Marinade(Chicken, Pork, Beef)
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Marinate meat about 4 to 6 hours. Refrigerate for about 1 hour before grilling.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Beat eggs. Add to flour mixture with milk. Add chopped rhubarb. Add to other mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 until brown and crusty on top. Yields 1 crust pie. Use big pie pan (do not use nonstick).

title: Fruit Jello Salad(Makes One Dish)
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups of hot water. Reserve 1/3 cup to mix with mayonnaise. Add canned pineapple and juice. Stir in cottage cheese. Mix the mayonnaise with 1/3 cup hot jello and add to the rest of mixture. Add nuts last. Set in refrigerator.

title: Aunt Kay'S Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Teriyaki Steak Sauce
instructions: Mix well. Brush on uncooked meat and let stand for 1 hour. Barbecue and keep moist.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cover potatoes with water; bring to boil. Lower flame and simmer until tender. Drain peel and cut potatoes into bite size pieces. Mix onions celery eggs and sweet relish with mayonnaise and mustard. Stir in the potatoes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours. Serves 4 persons.

title: Old-Fashioned Cream Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt; slowly add cream and vanilla. Pour into unbaked shell and sprinkle cinnamon on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Broken Glass Cake
instructions: Dissolve each Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups hot water. Put in square pan. Dissolve gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water then add hot pineapple juice and put in refrigerator and let cool. Add whipped cream sugar and vanilla then fold in cubes of Jell-O. Take half crust mixture and press in bottom of buttered pan. Put in filling and sprinkle remaining crust over top. Put in refrigerator to set for at least 6 hours. Better if left overnight. Allow Jell-O to set overnight then cut into small squares. Set pan into hot water for 1 or 2 seconds. Jell-O will slide right out.

title: Mo-Jo Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Wash and brush potatoes. Cut into wedges. Mix the seasonings into the flour. Mix the egg with the milk. Dip potato wedges into milk. *Dust with seasoned flour. Place on a pastry sheet. Drizzle with oil. Bake in oven 20 to 25 minutes until browned and tender.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: In bowl beat together eggs sugar oil and pumpkin until light and fluffy. Stir together the flour baking powder cinnamon salt and soda. Add to pumpkin mixture; mix thoroughly. Spread batter in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Frost.

title: Grilled Marinated Beef(Korean)
instructions: Cut meat into serving pieces; score on both sides. Place meat in shallow pan. Mix soy sauce onions garlic sugar oil sherry and pepper. Pour over beef and let stand 1 hour at room temperature. Turn once; drain. Place meat over medium coals. Grill until desired doneness (allow 15 minutes for medium). Garnish with additional green onion if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Baked Grits
instructions: Cook grits as directed on box. Add ingredients as listed. Beat hard after each addition. Bake in a moderate 400\u00b0 oven until firm and slightly brown (about 1 hour). Serve at once. Good with barbecue.

title: Meringue
instructions: Beat egg whites gradually adding sugar and cream of tartar until stiff but not dry. Add vanilla and water and stir. Put on a cooled pie filling of your choice. Cook in preheated oven for approximately 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shake 'N Bake Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Wash chicken and pat dry. Drop in milk and coat with crumbs. Arrange in single layers in baking pan. Bake 45 minutes or until done.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Chop and cook the cabbage just until crisp-tender; drain. To prepare cream sauce melt margarine. Stir in flour until smooth and add milk. Cook over medium heat and stir until thick. Saute green pepper and onion in oil until tender. Place layer of cabbage in a lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle with sauteed onion pepper and grated cheese. Cover with cream sauce and bread crumbs. Bake about 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and sugar; layer in large bowl first 4 ingredients. Mix in mayonnaise mixture top with cheese. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Rice Salad
instructions: Mix together; add enough French dressing to cover all. Serve on lettuce leaves if desired.

title: Raisin Sauce(Great On Baked Ham)
instructions: Stir until thick and bubbly.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sugar and water in a quart jar. Boil sugar and water 5 minutes. Add to other ingredients and shake well. Store in refrigerator. Makes 1 quart.

title: Purple Hull Pea Casserole
instructions: In casserole dish layer 2 cups peas tomatoes onion bell peppers and salt and pepper to taste. REPEAT LAYERS. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Place 6 slices of bacon on top of cheese and bake until bacon is done and onions are tender. You may need to place under broiler to get bacon crispy.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Mix chicken with all ingredients. Layer the chicken mixture a layer of Dorito chips a layer of Cheddar cheese and repeat. Add a little broth on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Use a 9 x 9-inch pan. You can prepare this recipe and place in the refrigerator to cook when you get home from work.

title: Deerburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat onions salt and pepper; drain. Add beans and soup; mix well. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Peel potatoes and cook until tender; mash using butter and milk. Pour meat mixture into casserole pan; drop spoonfuls of potatoes on top. Make sure to leave openings in the middle for steam to escape. Bake at 350\u00b0 until potatoes start to brown.

title: Angel Pie
instructions: Whip Eagle Brand milk and juice of 2 lemons. Fold in whipped cream with sugar added. Add pecans and fold in pineapple. Pour into 2 cooked pie shells (or 2 graham cracker crusts). Chill.

title: Cheese Potatoes In Foil
instructions: Slice potatoes into a large piece of foil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Crumble bacon over potatoes. Add onion and cheese. Dot with butter. Wrap loosely and seal well with double fold. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour or until done turning occasionally. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesed Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. In saucepan over low heat combine mayonnaise cheese and milk. Heat stirring until cheese melts. Serve over broccoli. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chewy Bars
instructions: Mix the softened margarine and sugar well. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually add the flour and stir in well. Add vanilla chips and nuts.

title: Coupe De Luxe
instructions: Combine fruit and juices with brandy. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. To serve fill large stem glasses or goblets half full of fruit and marinade. Pour the champagne over the fruit at the table. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix in large mixing bowl chicken potatoes cream of chicken & cream of celery. Place in 9 x 11 baking pan. Melt butter & combine with milk and flour. Pour over top. Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

title: Million Dollar Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Mix well after each. Grease and flour angel food cake pan. Spread in cake pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or when cake springs up when touched.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Have cheese at room temperature. Add onion mix and salad dressing to make smooth. Add pepper and beat with electric mixer. Stir in shrimp. Chill.

title: Oven-Fried Fish
instructions: Heat oven to 500 degrees. Grease baking sheet. Combine milk and salt in a small pan or bowl and stir. Dip fish in milk and roll in crushed corn flakes. Place on baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Red Cinnamon Popcorn
instructions: Melt butter in medium saucepan; stir in sugar corn syrup and cinnamon candy. Bring to boil; continue boiling stirring constantly until candy is dissolved completely. Boil without stirring for 3 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda. Gradually pour over popped corn mixing well. Allow to cool completely. Break apart and store in tightly covered container. Makes about 4 quarts. (Spray popped corn container with Pam.)

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease jelly roll pan 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch. Stir together all ingredients using hands or spoon. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Place in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown. Immediately remove from pan. Serve warm with sauce for dipping. Makes 7 1/2 dozen. I like barbecue sauce.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Slice zucchini and cut into quarters. Cook in 2-quart pot in 1 cup of broth. Cook about 6 minutes or until crispy tender. Add 3 tablespoons chopped scallion greens one more minute. Drain broth back into remaining broth and set aside in small bowl. Peel rest of zucchini and chop. Chop rest of scallions and their tops. Simmer in butter until soft. Add broth. Add heaping tablespoonful of chopped pimento to reserved broth. Add remaining pimento to pot mixture. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Put through blender; add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with croutons.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies in 9 x 13 pan. Leave enough out to sprinkle top of dessert. Mix butter cream cheese and powdered sugar well. May be a little lumpy.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes cheese sour cream and both cans of soup in large mixing bowl. When mixed evenly spread into large casserole dish. Top with cornflakes place into oven and bake at 350 degrees until cheese is bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes and enjoy.

title: Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in a heavy saucepan; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat. Stir in chips until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme nuts and vanilla. Beat until blended. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares. Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Lemon Ice Box Pie
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk egg yolks and lemon. Pour into crust. Whip egg whites and a tablespoonful of sugar until fluffy. Spread on top of pie. Brown meringue.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix together the pudding and milk then add the sour cream and Cool Whip. Layer vanilla wafers sliced bananas and filling until all the filling is used. Makes 1 (11 x 13-inch) pan full.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add remaining ingredients and blend. Shape and chill. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Chicken And Ham Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles per package directions and drain. In a saucepan melt butter. Blend in flour onion garlic powder and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Add chicken broth and milk. Cook and stir until bubbly. Stir in 1/2 cup grated cheese and mushrooms. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish layer half the noodles all the asparagus chicken Mozzarella and 1/3 of the milk mixture. Top with ham remaining noodles and remaining milk mixture. Sprinkle with remaining grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until heated through. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6 to 8 or 10 to 12 on buffet.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
instructions: Put the wafers in a casserole dish; cut the bananas up on top then spoon on the pudding. Repeat 2 or 3 times until you use it all up. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Arrange the broccoli in a 2 qt. baking dish. Place the chicken over the top. In a separate bowl combine soup and milk and pour over the broccoli and chicken. Sprinkle with the cheese combine the butter and breadcrumbs and sprinkle over the top. Bake at 450\u00b0f. 230\u00b0c. gas mark 8 for 20-30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Kosher Dill Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Follow directions on package but substitute sliced green tomatoes for the cucumbers. Process in hot water bath just long enough to seal and change color. They will become soft if processed too long.

title: Crock-Pot Spareribs
instructions: Brown ribs in a pan for 15 minutes. Drain fat. Place ribs in crock-pot. Combine other ingredients and pour over ribs. Cook on medium for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Whole Wheat Rolls
instructions: In a 2-cup container dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water and 1/2 teaspoon sugar. Let stand 1 hour. Cream shortening and 1/2 cup sugar. Add 1 1/2 cups lukewarm water to shortening mixture; add egg and salt. Add part of the flour and mix well then add the yeast mixture. Add remaining flour and mix well. May have to add extra flour if dough is sticky.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: *If you dont have buttermilk add some vinegar to milk.

title: War Time Cake
instructions: In a saucepan combine brown sugar water shortening raisins cinnamon salt and cloves. Bring to a boil. Cool. Add flour and soda. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour and 15 minutes. For a flat cake use a greased 8-inch pan.

title: Homemade Salsa Recipe
instructions: Mix everything together and use with Tostitos chips or garnish on your favorite Mexican dish. Its also very delicious on white chili.

title: Haystacks
instructions: In top of double boiler over hot water melt butterscotch morsels. Stir in salad oil. In large bowl mix noodles peanuts and butterscotch morsels. Mix thoroughly with a fork. Drop mixture onto wax paper by teaspoonful.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Boil ingredients except beets and onion for a few minutes then add beets and onion. For better flavor make a day ahead.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Have first 5 ingredients at room temperature. Mix cream cheese sour cream avocado dip lemon juice and salt well so there are no lumps. Spread on a pizza pan or large plate. Refrigerate for a few hours. Layer in order on top of mixture lettuce tomatoes onion green pepper green onion and Cheddar cheese. Serve with plain corn chips.

title: Salmon Log
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients well. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Form into 2 logs; roll in finely chopped pecans and sprinkle parsley over top. Serve with crackers.

title: Icing
instructions: Beat well. If adding jello do not add any water. Add any kind of jello for any color icing.

title: Chocolate Cake Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pot. Bring to a boil. Boil until a few small drops form a little ball when dropped in a glass of cold water. Remove from heat. Ready for cake.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix together to make crumbs.

title: No Sugar Apple Syrup
instructions: Mix first three ingredients in saucepan. Heat and thicken with cornstarch until desired consistency. Serve over pancakes waffles French toast etc.

title: Marinated Cheese Squares
instructions: Cut cheeses into 1 inch squares about 1/2 inch thick. Cover with dressing and pimentos and marinate several hours or overnight. Serve in shallow serving dish with crackers.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Slice sausage crosswise about 1/2-inch thick. Brown in oil in deep saucepan or Dutch oven. Add garlic onion carrots and basil. Cook for 5 minutes. Add zucchini tomatoes with liquid bouillon cabbage salt and pepper.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Combine dates water soda and butter; let cool. Beat the egg and sugar; add remaining ingredients. Mix all together. Bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0) for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Saute chicken onion and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned about 5 minutes. Stir in cornstarch and cook 1 minute. Add broth carrot lemon juice rind and salt. Bring to a full boil. Stir in pea pods parsley and rice. Cover and remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Makes 4 servings.

title: Honey Date Nut Bread(1 Loaf)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend ingredients in mixing bowl. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Place peeled eggs in bowl or jar. Mix vinegar beet liquid sugar salt onion and cloves. Pour over eggs. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 days. Slice eggs and serve on greens.

title: Lemonade Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in gallon container; fill to the top with water. Serve cold. Perfect on a hot day.

title: Tofu Casserole
instructions: Cut tofu into quarters and boil in salted water for 20 minutes. Drain and crumble. Combine with the other ingredients and bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Soup With Sausage(Yields 6 Servings)
instructions: In a heavy skillet brown sausage over medium heat. Remove sausage and set aside. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of fat; saute celery onion thyme and salt. Cook until onion is tender. Stir in flour; cook 1 minute. Gradually add broth and water stirring until the mixture comes to a boil. Add potatoes; cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Allow soup to cool. Puree 2 cups in blender or food processor. Return to kettle. Add milk beans and sausage; heat through. Garnish with parsely if desired.

title: Pear Cake
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Add oil. Stir in dry ingredients. Add pears. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Carp-A-La-Shingle
instructions: Clean and scale carp. Melt\tbutter; mix with wine. Place fish with butter/wine sauce into aluminum foil wrapping tightly. (Salt and\tpepper\tbefore\twrapping fish.) Place on redwood shingle and bake\tat 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Then remove fish from oven. Throw away and eat shingle.\tServes all.

title: Sunday Favorite Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper roast. Coat in flour. Heat cooking oil in skillet and lightly brown roast. Wash peel and cut potatoes into quarters. Wash and scrape carrots and cut into approximately 1/8-inch slices. Remove roast after browning and place into a large baking dish. Arrange potatoes and carrots (and sliced onions if desired) around the sides of roast. Sprinkle the soup mix onto roast. Brown a tablespoon of flour in the oil remaining in skillet after browning the roast. Pour 1/2 to 1 cup of water over browned flour to make gravy. Add salt and pepper. After the gravy has thickened pour it over and around the roast in the baking dish. Place the dish into a very hot oven (425\u00b0) for about 15 minutes. Place a piece of aluminum foil very loosely over the dish. Reduce the heat to 300\u00b0. Cook for about 15 minutes per pound. (If you have a cooking timer on your oven you can set it for the estimated cooking time and your lunch will cook while you are away at church.)

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter if desired. Add Rice Krispies cereal. Stir until well coated. Using buttered spatula or waxed paper press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook onions until soft. Add artichokes spinach soup eggs and spices. Pour into greased casserole dish. Blend cream cheese Parmesan cheese and milk. Pour over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Pasta With Mushrooms
instructions: Prepare fettuccine as directed on package. Drain and set aside. Gradually add skim milk to fat-free mayonnaise and garlic in small saucepan. Heat thoroughly stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; blend in Egg Beaters. Toss with fettuccine and mushrooms until well coated. Add Parmesan cheese and mix well.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Combine oil water sugar and Starter. Stir well and add flour. Place in greased bowl and turn to cover all surfaces with oil. Let rise in warm place. Bowl may be covered with towel or cookie sheet. Turn dough onto floured surface and knead several times. Shape into loaves or rounds. Place in greased pans. Let rise for at least 8 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 20 minutes for rounds 30 minutes for loaves. May add 1 package of Italian seasoning mix for variety.

title: Betty Jane'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cut up onion and green pepper very fine. Cut fresh lemons; remove seeds. Squeeze juice; cut up rind. Place all ingredients in boiler. Combine all sauces and seasonings and cook slow for 25 minutes. Makes a delicious sauce for ribs chicken etc.

title: South Seas Pot Roast
instructions: Place roast in deep pot or casserole. Mix sugar ginger soy sauce and soup. Pour over meat. Cut onions in thick slices. Place slices over meat. Cover tightly and bake at 300\u00b0 for 4 hours and 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Combine and store in sealed jar. Use 1 heaping tablespoonful per cup of boiling water.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except cheese until all is mixed well. Pour mix in very hot oiled skillet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Spray 1 large bowl or brown paper bag with Pam. Place the sugar butter corn syrup and salt in a glass bowl; microwave on High until boiling then cook for another 2 minutes. Add baking soda; stir well (mixture will become foamy). Place popped corn in bowl or bag; pour syrup mixture over corn. Stir well with wooden spoon sprayed with Pam. Microwave for 1 1/2 minutes on High; stir. Repeat. Microwave for 30 seconds on High; stir. Pour out on cookie sheet. Spread out and allow to cool.

title: Baked Carrots
instructions: Mix and pour into baking dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Nutritious quick and easy.

title: Fresh Lemonade
instructions: Add ingredients and 8 ounces of water. Serves 1 me.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and blend on medium speed for 3 minutes. Pour into 3 cake pans that have been greased and floured. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Green Noodle Casserole
instructions: Saute pepper celery and onion in oleo. Add cheese (cut into small pieces) soup mushrooms pimento and chicken. Cook noodles in broth where chicken was cooked. Add noodles to mixture and pour into casserole dish. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven (covered) for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove cover and cook until brown 5 minutes.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all canned fruits reserving 2 cups mixed juices. Layer drained fruit strawberries cherries and bananas in bowl. Combine pudding mix with reserved juices in bowl beating until thick. Pour over fruit. Do not toss. Chill for 2 hours before serving. Yields 15 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese with soup. Put broccoli in long flat casserole. Pour cheese mixture over broccoli. Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Scald milk and add shortening sugar and salt. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Beat eggs in 1/2 cup cold water and add to scalded milk. Cool until just warm and mix with other ingredients. Add flour and beat until smooth then add enough flour so dough can be kneaded to make it stiff. Set in warm place and let rise until dough is light. Divide dough into two equal parts and roll out into sheets. Smooth melted butter over each sheet. Mix 1/2 cup white sugar 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon and sprinkle over dough. Roll each sheet into a roll and cut. Put 1/2 cup melted butter in baking pan and sprinkle lightly with brown sugar. Put rolls in pan and let rise until light. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Yield 27 rolls.

title: K.K.'S Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into fourths. Fill a small baggie with sugar and 2 tsp. cinnamon. Shake biscuits in baggies. Place into bundt pan. Melt 1 1/2 sticks of oleo and add brown sugar pecans and 1 tsp. cinnamon. Pour batter over biscuits. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and then empty pan.

title: Oatmeal Hermits
instructions: Mix all together well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Tortillas(4 Servings)
instructions: Cut chicken into large pieces. In bowl combine onion soups salsa and milk blending well. In a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole layer half the tortillas chicken sauce and cheese. Sprinkle with green chilies. Repeat layers once more ending with cheese on top. Cover; refrigerate for 24 hours. Remove cover. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pack in a buttered loaf tin and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or moderate oven. Increase heat during last twenty minutes or so. Serve with sauteed pineapple slices.

title: Broccoli Puff
instructions: Place broccoli in baking dish. Mix rest of ingredients and pour over broccoli. Then place topping mixture on top of broccoli and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Season to taste. Combine beans tomatoes and soup. Line a greased ovenproof dish (2-quart) with tortillas. Layer half of ground beef soup mixture and cheese. Add another layer of tortillas meat and soup mixture ending with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Martha'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar until smooth. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine salt and flour. Add to mixture. Beat well and stir in vanilla. Cook in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 300\u00b0 until brown.

title: Salmon Steaks With Dill Sauce
instructions: Place salmon steaks in 10-inch skillet. Add enough water to cover. Top with onion lemon slices and bay leaf; sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Combine milk and flour in a saucepan stirring well. Add mustard dill seed lemon rind 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Gradually stir about 1/4 of hot milk mixture into egg yolk; add to remaining hot milk mixture stirring constantly. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add lemon juice mixing well. Remove salmon steaks from skillet. Spoon sauce over salmon. Garnish with reserved lemon slices if desired. Yields 4 servings.

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Kisses Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In bowl beat the butter peanut butter brown sugar 1/4 cup granulated sugar egg vanilla and salt until fluffy. Add flour and baking soda; beat until thoroughly blended. Shape dough into 48 balls using a rounded teaspoonful for each. Roll balls into 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden. Immediately top each cookie with a candy kiss carefully pressing down firmly. Remove cookies from baking sheets. Cool on racks. Makes 48 (1 3/4-inch) cookies.

title: Sweet And Light Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Measure all of the ingredients into large mixing bowl. Beat on medium speed for 30 seconds. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted. Allow to cool.

title: Holiday Fruitcake
instructions: Put package of mincemeat broken with 1/2 cup water and boil briskly for 1 minute. Cool. Combine the mincemeat nuts candied fruit sweetened condensed milk and egg. Blend well. Stir in flour and baking soda; pour into a loaf pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until center comes back when lightly touched.

title: Moose Shoulder
instructions: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes. Chop garlic. Brown meat in fat. Add garlic and cover with stock. Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Add cattails for the last 20 minutes of cooking.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl stir together flour sugar baking powder cinnamon salt and baking soda. Set aside. In a small bowl beat eggs sour cream and butter. Add all at once to dry ingredients along with apples. Stir just until moistened. Fill well-greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields 24 muffins.

title: Pecan Crispies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars until light. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir together dry ingredients. Blend into creamed mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes. Makes approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: In medium bowl combine milk and Jell-O mix beat until smooth approximately 1 to 2 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Fold in chocolate cookies. Pour mix into pie crust. Add extra cookies either whole or crushed on top for garnish. Freeze for 3 hours before serving. A great treat children love!

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Put 1 cake layer in bottom of a large punch bowl. Starting at top of ingredients layer pudding cherry pie filling pineapple fruit cocktail coconut pecans and Cool Whip; put 1 layer of each. Add other cake layer and start over. Put cherries on top of cake.

title: Oven French Toast
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking pan in hot oven. Add brown sugar and cinnamon; mix well. Arrange bread slices in double layer in prepared baking pan. Beat eggs with milk. Pour over bread slices. Chill tightly covered in refrigerator overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with warm syrup and sprinkle of confectioners sugar.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
instructions: Pour into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish and keep hot 1/4 cup roast beef drippings. Beat until thick and piled softly 2 eggs. Add to beaten eggs and beat with rotary beater until smooth milk flour and salt. Pour mixture over hot meat drippings and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and browned. Cut into squares and serve immediately with standing rib roast of beef.

title: Batter
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Mix with water and egg. Use for onions or vegetables.

title: Maple Pralines
instructions: Cook sugars syrup cream and salt over high heat until mixture forms a soft ball (235\u00b0) when dropped in water. Remove from heat. Add flavoring and pecans. Beat until creamy. Drop from spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and hamburger until crumbled; drain excess grease. In crock-pot melt cheeses. Add meat soup tomatoes green chilies and onions; mix well. Makes a large amount and can be frozen. Serve with chips. Serves many.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Make syrup of sugar water cinnamon and nutmeg; add butter. Quarter peel and core apples. Sift flour salt and baking powder then cut in shortening. Add milk all at once and stir until flour is moistened. Roll 1/4-inch thick; cut in 5-inch squares. Put 4 pieces of apples on each. Sprinkle generously with additional sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Dot with butter and fold corners to center. Pinch edges together and place 1 inch apart in greased baking dish or pan. Pour syrup over dumplings and bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve hot with cream. (This is also great cold.)

title: Frosting Mix
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over cool cake.

title: Shrimp Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Peel shrimp. Rinse in colander. Cook in just enough water to cover. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon crab boil. Cook on high until water begins to simmer. Cover pot. Turn off heat and let stand 5 to 7 minutes. Remove shrimp from water. Save water. Peel eggplant and cut into chunks. Cook eggplant in shrimp water until soft enough to mash. In large skillet heat olive oil. Saute onions bell pepper and celery. When lightly brown and \limp\ add garlic. Saute 2 more minutes. Remove skillet from heat. Mash eggplant until chunks are not intact. Add 1/2 teaspoon herb mix (oregano basil thyme bay leaves powdered). Add remaining salt and red pepper. Add sauteed vegetables. Cut shrimp into 1/3-inch long pieces. Add wine beaten raw egg Worcestershire and Tabasco sauce and mayonnaise. Mix thoroughly. Add bread crumbs. Mix well. Spread in 2-quart greased casserole. Top with grated Parmesan cheese and bake for 30 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven. If mixture is too dry add more mayonnaise or egg. If too moist add more bread crumbs.

title: Coconut Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs together then add all other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Flour Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and add drained green chilies. Blend well with mixer. Spread out tortillas; divide and spread out cream cheese evenly over tortillas. Roll each one like a jelly roll. Wrap and refrigerate. When ready to serve cut in thin slices.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: In large pot boil chicken and keep stock. Bone and skin chicken. Place back in pot. Add vegetables. Salt and pepper. Boil until cooked. Reduce heat to simmer. Keep water level high. Add water to flour to make slightly sticky dough. Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut 1 1/2-inch squares. Drop squares into water and let cook until dough is done. Drain water only as needed to keep from overflowing.

title: Cajun Squash
instructions: Wash unpeeled squash. Slice thinly. Combine 1 teaspoon salt dried green onion and 2 tablespoons butter in saucepan. Cook 15 minutes. Do not add water. Let cook in butter and its own juice. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

title: Hawaiian Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pecan Praline Crunch
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Spray 13 by 9 inch baking pan with non-stick cooking spray. Combine cereal and pecans in pan. In large bowl microwavable combine sugar corn syrup and crisco. Microwave on high for 1 minute and 30 seconds. Stir and microwave again for 30 seconds or until boiling. Stir vanilla and baking soda into mixture. Pour over cereal mixture and stir to coat mixture evenly. Bake 1 hour stirring every 20 minutes. Spread on baking sheet and cool completely. Break into pieces. Store in air tight container. Makes 9 cups.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan. Stir from bottom three times while baking. When knife comes out clean pudding is done.

title: Almond Bars
instructions: Cream butter margarine and sugar thoroughly.\tAdd egg yolk; add flour\tsalt and vanilla. Grease cookie sheet and spread dough with\tfingers dusted with flour. Beat egg white and brush over cookies. Sprinkle almonds over dough and press down with hand. Bake at 275\u00b0 for\t45 minutes or lightly browned. Cut within a few minutes into desired portions. A 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet works well.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in water. Cut cutter into 3 cups flour; blend in eggs milk sugar salt and yeast. Gradually add remaining flour. Mix well after each addition. Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours. Divide in 4 parts; roll out to 10-inch circle. Brush with melted butter. Cut in pie shaped wedges. Start with wide edge and roll up. Place on greased baking sheet. Let rise until double. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Goolash
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions together. Add salt tomato sauce beans and water. Let simmer 45 minutes.

title: Raspberry Jam Strips
instructions: Mix margarine sugars egg and vanilla. Stir in flour and baking powder. (If dough is soft cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.) Heat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Meringue(Swiss)
instructions: Beat egg whites. While beating heat water cornstarch and sugar on stove until it boils then pour into egg whites slowly and add vanilla. Only needs browned if desired.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Note Need 24 paper nut cups 1 1/2 x 1 1/4-inches.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken. Cool and bone. Steam broccoli until tender. Drain. Grease an 11 x 7-inch casserole. Place chicken on bottom and broccoli on top. Combine mayonnaise soup curry powder and lemon juice. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with a mixture of bread crumbs combined with butter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: Separate rolls. Sprinkle chicken over the triangles. Roll up beginning at the large end. Place in a casserole dish. Mix the soup cheese milk and chicken broth and pour over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: New England Style Clam Chowder
instructions: Cook potatoes water and salt until tender. Cut bacon into small pieces and fry until almost cooked. Add onion and cook slowly until bacon is completely cooked. Combine all cooked ingredients in one pot and add milk and clams. Bring to a boil however do not boil.

title: Bread Stuffing For Turkey
instructions: Mix well; stuff bird and bake. Or cook neck and back and put the stock over dressing and bake dressing in casserole at 325\u00b0. This stuffing can be used to stuff whitefish. Eliminate giblets.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix the pudding mix with the milk. Add the sour cream and Cool Whip mixing well. Layer pudding in 5-quart dish with bananas and the vanilla wafers. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter and brown sugar in a large fryer. Beat eggs sugar and vanilla until thick. Add scalded milk with butter. Mix thoroughly with egg mixture; pour over butter sugar and fruit layer in fryer. Place over low heat and bake until done about 35 minutes. During the last 5 minutes tilt cover to aid in drying top of cake. Turn upside-down on a large plate. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Ham And Cheese Party Rolls
instructions: In medium bowl combine mustard onion margarine and poppy seed. Do not separate rolls first. Split entire roll package horizontally and spread each side with mustard mixture. Cut ham and cheese into squares to fit individual rolls. Put one of each on each roll then top with other half of roll package. Separate rolls and return to original aluminum pan. Cover with foil and heat at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Can be made ahead and frozen. Do not heat until ready to serve. Serves 8 to 10 persons.

title: Pie Of Any Flavor
instructions: Bake pie shells and set aside. Place milk into a saucepan and place saucepan of milk into a larger pan of water and turn heat to medium. Add sugar salt Cook & Serve pudding mix and egg yolks. Mix with just enough milk to pour and beat into hot milk. Stir until thick. Set into a pan of cold water and add butter and vanilla and beat well. When slightly cool pour into pie shells. Take whites of eggs and add baking powder and beat until thick. Add sugar and vanilla and pour into pie shells spreading well and brown under broil.

title: Mexican Style Liver
instructions: In large skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserving 3 tablespoons drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon; set aside. Cook onion and garlic in drippings for about 5 minutes or until onion is tender but not brown. Combine flour chili powder and salt. Cut liver into thin strips; toss with flour mixture to coat. Add liver to onion in skillet; brown quickly on all sides. Stir in crumbled bacon undrained tomatoes and whole kernel corn. Simmer covered until mixture is heated through. Serve with tortillas or over hot cooked rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook noodles. Drain and place in large casserole. Add margarine cheese milk and eggs. Mix well. Sprinkle another cup of grated cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and boil the chopped potatoes. Heat in skillet the first 4 ingredients until very hot. In bowl put the chopped cabbage and the chopped potatoes. Pour the ingredients over it; mix well. Return to stove until all is hot. Serve at once.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix together yellow cake mix 1 egg and 1/4 cup of butter. Put on bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Puddles(Candy)
instructions: Melt together the milk and Hershey bars. Take off stove and stir in pecans. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper. Let chill.

title: Tex-Mex Turkey Chili
instructions: Combine onion garlic and oil in a 2-quart glass bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 3 minutes or until onion is tender stirring every minute. Add chili powder and the next 4 ingredients; stir well. Microwave uncovered on High 6 to 9 minutes stirring every 3 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients. Microwave uncovered on High for 6 minutes until thoroughly heated.

title: Peasant Rye
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the bread. Chill mixture for 2 to 3 hours. Then cut top of bread off and pull bread out of inside of loaf to form a cavity. Fill cavity of bread with dip mixture before serving. Use bread cubes for dipping.

title: Low Calorie Apple Pie
instructions: Combine brown Sugar Twin flour cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Add apples and mix together. Place in pie shell and dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 8 servings at 231 calories per serving.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Go to the store and buy a can of chicken soup. Put it in a small bowl then microwave for 15 minutes. You can eat it with a spoon.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Add melted butter into sugar and cream with a wooden beater. Add Karo syrup and beat in good with butter-sugar mix. Add salt and 3 eggs (one at a time) stirring well. Add 1/4 cup milk. Stir and then add 1 teaspoon vanilla; stir and add pecans.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and butter until creamy. Add eggs and peanut butter. Mix soda and flour in with the rest. Place small balls on cookie sheet. Press out with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: The Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix shortening butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Blend in remaining ingredients. (For a softer rounder cookie add 1/2 cup flour.) Drop onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until light brown.

title: Plum Wine Mandarin Glaze
instructions: Heat wine mandarin syrup and corn syrup to a rolling boil. Add the lemon juice. Spread over cake or use as glaze for pork ham or chicken.

title: Ginger Snaps
instructions: Mix in order roll into balls the size of a walnut. Roll in white sugar and bake at 350\u00b0. Cookie will flatten and crack.

title: Veal Veggie Loaf
instructions: In the microwave Mix 1/2 of your spaghetti sauce with all your ingredients. Using a quiche pan (micro-safe) form a loaf in a circle leaving the center empty. Pour the rest of spaghetti sauce over the top of the circular meat loaf. Cook on High for 12 minutes. Pour off drippings. Cook on High approximately 5 minutes more (depending on your microwave). Serve with peas or another green vegetable in the center.

title: The Best Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with their skins until tender (red potatoes are best). Hard-boil 12 large eggs.

title: Five Hour Stew
instructions: Cut chuck roast to chunks. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot; cook on high for 5 hours.

title: Filled Kolackys
instructions: Soften the active dry yeast in warm water compressed yeast in lukewarm water.

title: Pot Roast With Vegetables
instructions: Wipe roast with paper towels. Place oil and butter in 5-quart Dutch oven or heavy kettle. Over medium heat brown roast with sliced onion turning roast with 2 wooden spoons until brown on all sides. Add seasonings to drippings and saute stirring 1/2 minute. Add beef broth; bring to a boil. Reduce to simmer and cook just below the boiling point covered 2 1/2 hours. Turn meat occasionally. Add vegetables and simmer covered for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar flour margarine corn and milk. Bake in greased casserole dish at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream Pumpkin Coffeecake
instructions: Cream butter 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl. Add 3 eggs beating well. Combine flour baking powder and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture alternately with sour cream. Combine pumpkin beaten egg 1/3 cup sugar and pie spice.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Mark and let cool. Makes about 24 (2-inch) servings.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Joe C.'S Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and Cool Whip with dry jello. Add drained fruit. Quick easy and a refreshing taste for any lunch or dinner.

title: Oven Roasted Chicken In Tomato Sauce
instructions: Place chicken in baking pan. Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until chicken is brown. Before serving garnish with lemon slices parsley or cooked green peas if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Quick White Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and flour; stir 3 to 4 minutes until blended. Slowly stir in milk. Cook and stir until thick and smooth.

title: Spiced Winter Punch
instructions: Heat all together for 1 to 2 hours. Great at winter get togethers!

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Pour pineapple juice in large container. Slowly add in cheerwine. Chill.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Magic Lemon Pie
instructions: Blend together milk lemon juice lemon peel and yolks until thickened. Turn into pie shell.

title: Savory Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut round steak into 1/2-inch strips. Coat with mixture of flour salt and pepper. In a large skillet brown strips in shortening.

title: Country Style Chicken Kiev
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In heavy 2-quart saucepan melt butter. Combine bread crumbs and next 4 ingredients. Dip chicken breast halves in melted butter; roll in bread crumb mixture. Place in ungreased 9-inch square baking dish. Bake in center of oven 50 minutes or until golden brown. Meanwhile add diced onion to remaining melted butter (1/2 cup). Saute onion; add wine and chopped parsley. Pour over golden brown chicken breasts. Return to oven 3 to 5 minutes more just to heat sauce. Serve with sauce spooned over breasts.

title: Spinach Salad(If You Like Spinach, You Will Love This Spinach Salad!)
instructions: Wash spinach and break into small pieces in a large bowl. Add bacon eggs and bean sprouts and lightly toss. Top with croutons and this dressing

title: Mini Quiches
instructions: On floured surface roll half of pastry into a 12-inch circle. Cut 6 (4-inch) circles. Repeat with second pastry. Fit into 12 muffin pan cups. Fill each muffin cup with some shrimp green onion black olives and cheese. Beat remaining ingredients and pour over mixture in muffin cups. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 appetizers.

title: Lemon Custard
instructions: Put sugar and rind into food processor. Blend well. Add egg yolks juice and cooled butter; blend. Warm on stove about 10 minutes. Do not boil. Put into puffed pastry.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix; chill and serve.

title: Peach Fuzz
instructions: In blender combine peaches orange juice rum and lemonade concentrate. Blend until smooth. Gradually add ice blending at low speed until slush consistency. Serve immediately.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and spread 1/2 batter in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix together the brown sugar pecans and cinnamon. Sprinkle 3/4 mixture over batter. Swirl with knife. Add remaining batter and top with remaining cinnamon sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove and drizzle with the confectioners sugar vanilla and milk.

title: Seafood Nicolson
instructions: 1. Put butter leeks onion garlic & red pepper into pan and saute. 2. Add 1/2 c. wine parsley lemon juice salt & pepper. Cook 2 minutes. Add cream. 3. Cook several minutes on simmer. Add scallops & broccoli and cook for a few more minutes. 4. Just before serving add shrimp and cook till just pink.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix applesauce sugar butter and egg together and set aside. Combine flour baking soda salt cinnamon and cloves together. Mix well and add raisins and nuts. Stir in applesauce mixture. Pour batter into well-greased tube pan and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until done. Makes 8 servings.

title: Tuna Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except margarine and shape into 6 equal patties. In a 10-inch skillet heat margarine until hot and bubbly. Add patties and cook over medium heat turning once until brown on both sides.

title: Marinated Beef Tenderloin
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a large shallow dish or zip-top freezer bag; add beef. Cover or seal and chill 8 hours turning occasionally. Remove beef from marinade and place on rack in roasting pan. Discard marinade. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or to desired degree of doneness. Cover loosely with foil and let tenderloin stand 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Pluck Cake
instructions: You will need a Bundt or tube baking pan.

title: Oil And Vinegar Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pint jar; shake to mix well.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs together. Add strawberries and lemon juice. Sift together flour soda salt and spices. Gradually stir dry ingredients into strawberry mixture. Mix and add nuts if desired. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon; set aside. In saucepan combine water margarine oil and cocoa; bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add sugar; mix well. Add sifted ingredients beating well. Add buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Spread in a greased and floured sheet cake pan (10 x 14 x 1-inch). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Combine sugar and shortening; add eggs water and pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients. Combine with first mixture. Add nuts raisins and dates. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Original Pecan Pralines
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a 2-quart saucepan. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Stir in pecans. Cook until mixture reaches soft ball stage 235\u00b0. Remove from heat. Stir in butter. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. Let stand until firm. Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Crumble Blue cheese with a fork and mix with mayonnaise Worcestershire sauce garlic powder chives and pepper. Add sour cream and buttermilk. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Add additional buttermilk to achieve preferred consistency. Will keep refrigerated 1 month.

title: Triple Fudge Cake
instructions: Make pudding as directed. Add chocolate cake mix to hot pudding. Mix with heavy spoon. Spread mixture (will be thick) into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle chocolate chip pieces on top and then add walnuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Butterhorn Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water in a large bowl; let stand 5 minutes. Add remaining 1 cup of water and next 4 ingredients stirring well. Add enough flour to make a soft dough.
