Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic (about 4 minutes). Place in a well-greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) free from drafts for 1 hour or until doubled in bulk. Punch dough down and divide into thirds. Roll each portion into a 10-inch circle on a floured surface; spread with 1 tablespoon butter. Cut each circle in 12 wedges. Roll up each wedge beginning at wide end. Place on greased baking sheets point side down. Cover and let rise in a warm place free from drafts for 45 minutes or until doubled in bulk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until browned. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put all together. Bring to boil for 1 minute. Set off to cool. Bake two pie shells. After mixture cools add 1 quart of strawberries and put into pie shells. Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in water; let stand about 10 minutes. Add 2 cups of the flour salt and oil; beat until smooth. Gradually stir in more flour (about 1/2 cup) to make a soft dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic adding more flour (up to 1/2 cup) if necessary to prevent dough from being too sticky. Place dough in a greased bowl. Cover; let raise in warm place until doubled 45 minutes to 1 hour. Punch dough down; divide into 12 balls. Roll each out to form 18-inch rope. Twist into pretzel shape. Let rise uncovered 20 to 25 minutes. Brush lightly with egg white mixture and sprinkle with salt. Bake at 425\u00b0 until well browned 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Put the grated cabbage in a bowl and add salt. Let this stand for 1 hour. Then add the chopped carrot and green pepper. Set this mixture aside.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mixer except chocolate pie crust. Put mixed ingredients in the chocolate pie crust. Freeze for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with foil. Unroll crescent rolls. Beat ingredients and spread on top of the bottom of the pan. Lay second can of rolls on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Emily'S Fudge Cake
instructions: Grease and flour an 8 x 8-inch cake pan; set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients together in large bowl until well blended. Put in pan; bake for 25 minutes until done. When cool frost with favorite chocolate frosting (butter frosting suggested).

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and cauliflower lightly. Layer in greased casserole. Sprinkle celery over top. Mix soup and cheese. Pour over top of vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated thoroughly. Can top with Ritz cracker crumbs and sprinkle with melted margarine over top.

title: Mushroom Garlic Pork Chops
instructions: In medium skillet over medium-high heat heat oil. Add chops and cook 10 minutes or until browned. Set chops aside. Pour off fat. Add soups and water. Heat to a boil. Return chops to pan. Reduce heat to low. Cook 5 minutes or until chops are no longer pink.

title: California Tamale Casserole
instructions: Brown meat add minced garlic onion and celery. Cook until onion is transparent. Add corn salt chili powder and tomatoes and boil slowly about 15 minutes. Slowly stir in olives. Put in a greased casserole dish top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Custard Or Pie
instructions: Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Test by inserting knife.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and cream cheese. Add eggs one at a time; beat thoroughly. Add flour a little at a time; beat well. Add flavorings. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0. May be cooked 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients 3 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let cake cool.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
instructions: Mix brown sugar and butter in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Pour mixture over cream cheese and blend thoroughly. Use as a dip for sliced apples.

title: Angel Puffs
instructions: Beat egg whites until very stiff. Add sugar gradually. Continue beating until very very stiff. Add salt and vanilla. Drop by large heaping tablespoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Using back of spoon make indentation to hold whipped cream. Bake in 250\u00b0 (slow) oven about 1 hour.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Sift all dry ingredients into 8-inch square pan. Make 3 holes with spoon in dry ingredients. In one hole put vanilla. In another put vinegar and in last hole melted butter. Pour lukewarm water over all. Stir mixing well. Bake 30 minutes. Cool in pan; frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Date Nut Cookies
instructions: Stir together the flours wheat germ cinnamon salt and soda. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs; beat until smooth. Stir in flour mixture until well blended. Stir in dates and nuts. Drop by tablespoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen cookies. Very good!

title: Bacon Curry Coleslaw
instructions: Combine raisins and lemon juice; heat gently until hot. Then set aside until raisins are cool and plump. Meanwhile finely shred the cabbage dice onion grate apple and cook and crumble bacon. Combine apples raisins lemon juice and sugar; add mayonnaise and curry powder to apple mixture and blend. Just before serving combine cabbage green onion crumbled bacon peanuts and mayonnaise.

title: Honey'S Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage celery green pepper and onion. Mix together sugar celery seed salt vinegar and mustard seed. Mix sauce before shredding cabbage and let stand after shredding all ingredients. Pour sauce over ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Low-Fat Brownies
instructions: Combine box mix yogurt and egg whites. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 22 to 24 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crabmeat Spread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Put into small casserole dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes. Top with slivered almonds. Serve with crackers.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Stew
instructions: Brown meat after coating with flour salt and pepper in hot oil. Add liquid to meat. Add chopped onion. Cover and cook 45 minutes. Add carrots. Cook until tender.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Combine butter and chocolates in a small saucepan and melt over medium heat. In a large mixing bowl combine beaten eggs sugar baking powder vanilla flour nuts and chocolate mixture. Stir to mix well.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks and milk over medium heat. Add melted and cooled German chocolate. Remove from heat. Add vanilla 3/4 of coconut nuts and softened butter. Cool and pour into baked crust.

title: Caramel Bars
instructions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk over low heat stirring until smooth. Combine remaining milk with cake mix melted margarine and mix well. Press half of cake mix into bottom of 9x13 greased pan. Bake at 350 for 6 minutes. Sprinkle one cup nuts coconut and chocolate pieces over crust pour caramel mixture on and top with teaspoons of remaining cake mix pressing gently into caramel mix. Sprinkle with remaining nuts pressing lightly into top. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes. Cool slightly refrigerate (2 dozen).

title: Vivian'S Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a well-greased sheet cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove cake from pan onto a tea towel covered with powdered sugar. Roll up towel and cake together. Put in freezer for 30 minutes. While cake is cooling make the filling.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzel sugar and butter. Pat on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread on cooled crust. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add frozen berries. Mix until somewhat thick. Spread over cream cheese mix. Refrigerate.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Crumble crackers and add sugar and melted margarine. Use half for crust and half for top. Mix orange juice mashed oranges and Cool Whip. Pour over crust and top with other 1/2 of cracker crumbs.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Place first 6 ingredients in an oblong glass baking dish and broil until vegetables are tender. In a saucepan cook spaghetti and set aside. In another saucepan combine Velveeta and milk over low heat until Velveeta melts and combines with milk to make a cheese sauce. Combine shrimp mixture spaghetti and cheese sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chopstick Veal Bake
instructions: Cut meat in 2 1/2-inch strips. Brown in hot oil. Add remaining ingredients except noodles. Turn into 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Stir occasionally. Last 5 minutes of baking uncover and sprinkle with chow mein noodles. Serves 8.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Cut large shrimp in half. Cook vegetables in butter or margarine until tender; blend in flour and salt. Combine soup and milk; add to vegetable mixture and cook until thick stirring constantly. Add shrimp and pour into a well-greased 1-quart casserole. Combine melted butter or margarine and breadcrumbs; sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mushroom Medley
instructions: Prepare each vegetable separately to obtain right texture. In saucepan cook peas until nearly done. Cover and set aside. Slice onion thickly. Cut each slice into eight pie-shaped pieces. Cook in water until done but still firm. Add margarine; cover and set aside. Wash mushrooms. Stand on end and cut into quarters. Boil hard until done. Strain mushrooms and add to onions. Add peas and enough juice that mixture can be simmered. Add salt. Simmer and taste. Serve hot.

title: Red Cabbage Relish
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in mixing bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Let stand 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill at least 1 hour. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add spices and tomatoes. Heat. Cover bottom and sides of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with tortillas. Pour beef mixture over tortillas. Place a layer of tortillas over meat mixture. Combine cottage cheese Monterey Jack and egg together and pour over tortillas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Cheddar lettuce tomatoes green onions and olives. Serves 10.

title: Texas Dip
instructions: Brown meats and drain. Melt cheese in a microwave-proof dish. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and mix well. Let crock-pot warm all ingredients and keep the crock-pot on low while serving. Stir occasionally to keep it from sticking to the bottom. Serve with lightly salted tortilla chips. Great for tailgating parties or other social gathering. May not look very appetizing but it tastes delicious.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with chopped onion. Add salt and pepper to mixture. Drain any excess fat drippings. Boil whole bag of egg noodles until tender. Drain. Mix meat mixture noodles cream of mushroom soup cheese and whipping cream in a large bowl. Stir until all cheese is melted and all ingredients are blended well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour in a baking dish (greased). Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 until sides bubble about 20 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Serve on crackers.

title: Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Mix milk 1 can pineapple with juice egg whites and oil. Combine with dry ingredients and mix. Add second can of pineapple. Bake after lining muffin pans with paper baking cups at 425\u00b0 for 17 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Korean Salad
instructions: Break and take the spinach stems out. Rinse and drain bean sprouts. Slice water chestnuts. Chop eggs. Cook and break up bacon. Mix the spinach bean sprouts water chestnuts eggs and bacon together.

title: Cheesy Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Put all ingredients into greased casserole in 2 layers with the cheese on top. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Boil chicken and save broth. Debone chicken. Mix bread eggs onion sage broth and soup. After mixing the dressing should be juicy not thick. Add chicken to mixture. Cook until brown.

title: Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Melt butter in a large saucepan and add oatmeal sugar and vanilla. Press down in a pan and cook 12 to 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a skillet melt butter over medium heat. Saute onion until tender. Stir in potatoes soup and milk. Add cheese green pepper pimiento pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs. Pour into a shallow casserole dish; top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Au Gratin
instructions: Mix together the pineapple chunks Cheddar cheese sugar and flour. Put in baking dish. Crumble Ritz crackers over this mixture. Pour melted margarine on top of crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except buttermilk raisins and butter. Gradually stir in buttermilk and raisins; mix until dry ingredients are moistened. Knead until smooth about 1 minute. Shape into a ball. Place on well-greased cookie sheet; flatten to form 7-inch circle. Cut cross in top 1/4-inch deep. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Brush with 1 tablespoon butter. Cool on wire rack. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Cheesecake Topped Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare brownie mix as directed. Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. In small mixing bowl beat cheese margarine and cornstarch until fluffy. Gradually beat in canned milk egg and vanilla until smooth. Pour evenly over brownie batter. Bake 45 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Cool. Spread with frosting. Cut in bars. Store covered in refrigerator. Makes 40 brownies.

title: Pumpkin And Streusel Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 12 muffin cups. In large bowl combine all muffin ingredients; stir 50 to 75 strokes until dry particles are moistened breaking up any lumps. Divide batter evenly among prepared muffin cups.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans. Prepare bake and cool cake following package directions. Place cake layer on cooling racks in jelly-roll pan. Freeze 2 hours or until cake layers are firm. Place cake layer on serving plate. Spread softened ice cream to edges. Place second layer on top of ice cream. Freeze assembled cake until ice cream is firm. Frost sides and top of cake with whipped topping. Garnish with fresh strawberries. Store in freezer until ready to serve.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Cook margarine cocoa sugar and milk until bubbles form around sides of pan; remove from heat. Add oats peanut butter and vanilla. Drop on waxed paper and cool.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine margarine brown sugar and pretzels. Mix well and bake in lightly buttered 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Dissolve gelatin in water. While hot add to strawberries. Cool until mixture begins to set. Meanwhile cream sugar and cream cheese and fold into Cool Whip. Spread cream cheese mixture over cooled crust. When gelatin begins to set pour over top of cheese mixture. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Cheese Petit Fours
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread together. Cut crusts off bread 3 slices at a time. Spread cheese mixture on sides and top of each petit four in 3 slices thick. Freeze on cookie sheet. Put in Baggies for storage. Bake frozen at 350\u00b0 approximately 10 minutes. Before freezing sprinkle on cayenne pepper and dill weed seed (optional).

title: Bourbon Franks
instructions: In large saucepan mix all ingredients except franks. Cover and simmer at least 2 hours stirring occasionally. (Can be made ahead to this point. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours. Reheat sauce until hot.) Add franks and simmer until heated through (about 5 to 10 minutes).

title: Chicken Gumbo Pork Chops
instructions: Wash pork chops. Salt and pepper each side. Smear each side of chop with prepared mustard (about 1 teaspoon). Dredge in flour. Brown in oil on each side in skillet. Empty contents of one can of soup over chops. Cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. All this may be done in electric skillet or you may place chops in covered baking dish and pour soup over them and bake in oven or microwave. Good accompaniments are rice and purple hull peas.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift together flour and sugar. Combine butter cocoa and water and bring to a rapid boil. Pour over sugar and flour. Mix well. Add other ingredients and pour into greased 11 x 16-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Noodles
instructions: Cook in large covered skillet with enough water to cook until tender. Cook noodles as directed on package. When cabbage is tender add salt to taste and butter and drained noodles. Mix well. Turn heat to low and simmer until most of liquid is gone. I like 1 teaspoon sugar in mine.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured cloth covered board. Cut into 1 1/2-inch circles. Place circles on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Yields about 8 dozen cookies. After baking you may \paint\ the cookies different by using food coloring and tiny paint brushes.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Cook ham hock until meat pulls apart. Remove meat from bone. Pour lentils into the ham stock. Refrigerate overnight. Dice onion and carrot; add to stock. Cook until lentils are tender.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix chopped broccoli red onion cheese and crumbled bacon in bowl.

title: Cream Tacos
instructions: Brown hamburger in oil. Add Ro-tel tomatoes and evaporated milk. When boiling add Velveeta cheese; stir until dissolved.

title: Slushy Punch
instructions: Mix and freeze all ingredients. Take out about 3 hours before serving and pour in ginger ale.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Pour cherry filling in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour cake mix on top. Pour melted butter on top of those. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Houska Christmas Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Scald milk and add butter sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add to yeast mixture and well beaten eggs 3 cups flour raisins cherries almonds and pecans. Mix well. Add about 2 1/2 cups flour. Place on lightly floured surface and knead until dough is smooth. Place in a warm bowl. Cover with towel and let rise for about 1 1/2 hours. Punch down dough and turn out on floured surface. Divide dough in half. Divide one half into 3 equal parts. Roll each piece into a strip about 15 inches long. Braid and place on a baking sheet. Divide 2/3 of the remaining dough into 3 equal parts and prepare braid like the first. Place on top of first braid. Make a third braid from remaining dough and place on top of second (center) braid. Brush with butter. Let rise until double in bulk. Beat 1 egg white and 1 tablespoon water; brush loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake pie crust 10 minutes and remove. Reduce oven to 325\u00b0. Over low heat melt chips with butter. In a large mixing bowl beat chocolate mixture with remaining ingredients except nuts until smooth. Then add nuts. Pour into pie crust. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until center is set. Cool. Serve with warm ice cream if desired.

title: Hot Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in small crock-pot until melted. Serve with crackers.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco oleo and 1/2 cup sugar until light in color and fluffy then gradually add the other sugar. Add room temperature eggs one at a time. Beat after each addition. Add flour and milk alternately. I put the vanilla in the milk. Start in a cold oven. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Angel Food Cake
instructions: Fold crushed pineapple into the cake mix. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 35 minutes. May be served with Cool Whip.

title: Get Well Chicken Meal Soup
instructions: Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt and pepper and garlic salt as needed. Add celery. Cover chicken and celery with water. Boil until tender. Take off fire for 15 minutes. Put back on fire. Add 1/2 cup corn meal. Boil 4 or 5 minutes stirring constantly.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Saute and brown beef in frying pan then stir in onion. Stir in tomato sauce water and chili powder. Stir all together until well mixed. Cook for about ten minutes.

title: Swedish Pot Roast
instructions: Mix salt pepper and cinnamon. Rub spice mixture on both sides of roast. Brown roast in some oil in a roaster. Now mix the vinegar and brown sugar together and pour over the roast. Add onions and bay leaves and pot in oven. Bake for 3 - 4 hours at 350 degrees.

title: Brownie Fudge Nut Pie
instructions: In a medium saucepan over low heat stir condensed milk margarine and cocoa until margarine melts and mixture is warm. Remove from heat. Stir in eggs flour vanilla and chopped nuts. Pour into prepared crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until center is firm. Serve warm or cold topped with whipped cream if desired.

title: Impossible Egg Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Grease two 9-inch pans or baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Add one can coconut to make coconut pie.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Chop onions and cook in oleo until transparent. Mash squash with fork. Combine onions and oleo with slightly beaten eggs. Add to soup squash bread crumbs salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Cream jello and oleo. Beat in cake mix and juice. Mix remaining ingredients. Divide equally into 3 layers and bake for 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Mississippi Corn Salad
instructions: Slice green onions and their tops. Stir together all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 24 hours.

title: Country Style Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. In a large skillet melt butter then blend in flour over medium heat. Gradually add broth milk pimentos salt and pepper. Bring to boiling point then simmer stirring constantly until sauce is thickened about 5 minutes. Grease a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Combine noodles chicken and sauce. Top with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cajun Fried Turkey(For A Crowd)
instructions: Thaw turkey completely. Season outside of turkey by personal preference. Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Put turkey in aluminum pan. Add 10 cups boiling water. Seal pan with heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap. Cook 12 to 14 pounds for 1 hour or 20 pounds for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Turn oven off. Leave overnight. This is the crucial key. Do not open oven door at all! (This actually steams turkey.)

title: Banana Coffee Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine bran flour baking soda light salt cinnamon nutmeg and raisins in a bowl. Mix thoroughly. Beat brown sugar molasses oil egg and milk in a bowl. Add wet ingredients to dry and stir until ingredients are moist. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full of batter. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes. Servings equal 1 starch and 1/2 fat.

title: Peruvian Potato Salad
instructions: Simmer scrubbed potatoes in large pan with 1-inch of boiling salted water for 25 to 30 minutes until tender. Drain cool and remove skins. In large saucepan over low heat stir cream cheese and half and half until smooth. Add chopped chili peppers lemon juice turmeric comino and salt. Simmer 1 minute stirring occasionally.

title: Caramel Almond Torte
instructions: In a small mixer bowl combine egg yolks 1 cup sugar the apple cider baking powder and cinnamon. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed for 3 minutes or until light and fluffy. Wash the beaters.

title: Southern Maryland Stuffed Ham
instructions: Cut/tear up cleaned greens. Combine with cabbage celery and red pepper. Place ham on clean cheese cloth. Make small slits all around the ham. Stuff the green mixture into the slits. Tie 1 package cheesecloth around the ham and place in a roaster that is half filled with water. Boil for at least 1 hour or until ham is done. Remove cheesecloth and serve.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Amounts vary according to the size casserole needed.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Simmer all ingredients for 10 minutes; strain and serve hot. Makes 6 cups punch.

title: Skillet Dinner
instructions: Tear tortillas into bite-size pieces and brown in skillet in small amount of oil. Brown and cook the onion and green pepper until tender. Drain oil off all.

title: Rye Bread
instructions: Mix the ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 just to brown the top then at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done and separate. Mix one box stuffing package with chicken broth (or hot water) until moistened. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken on top of stuffing until pourable. Pour on top of chicken. Mix second box of stuffing same as first. Spread on top. Broth from chicken may be poured on top to moisten if needed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot or warm. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Cauliflower Delight(Diet)
instructions: Cook cauliflower in salted water for 6 to 7 minutes or until tender-crisp. Drain. Mix pickle liquid sweetener garlic and onion in a small bowl. Pour over cauliflower pickles and radishes in bowl. Toss to marinate. Cover in refrigerator for 12 hours stirring occasionally. Drain before serving.

title: Blackberry Wine Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients on low speed until moistened. Mix on medium for 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Ham Casserole(Great For Christmas Brunch!)
instructions: Sprinkle cracker crumbs in buttered casserole. On top of cracker crumbs layer half of chopped eggs 1/4 of sauces half of ham and 1/4 of sauces. Repeat layers topping with crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 5 pies.

title: Ladson'S Potato Pone
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook on top of stove in heavy iron skillet stirring frequently. Must cook\tslowly on low heat. When almost done put in baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Fudgsicles
instructions: Mix as directed on pudding package. Pour into Tupperware Ice Tups or popsicle containers. Freeze. Yields 12 Fudgsicles.

title: Beef Roast Of Beef
instructions: Put vegetables in bottom of crock-pot. Salt and pepper meat then put in pot. Add liquid. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours). Remove meat and vegetables with spatula and thicken for gravy if desired.

title: No Roll Pie Crust
instructions: Bring oil and water to a boil. Stir in flour. While mixture is still warm put into 9-inch pie plate and proceed with filling; bake.

title: Jello Salad For Angels
instructions: Tear cake and fill 13 x 9-inch pan with pieces. Mix all other ingredients and pour over cake pieces. Refrigerate until set approximately 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Put roast onions and celery in a large pan with a little water. Cover and cook slowly until done (meat is falling apart). Dont let dry out. Or put in crock-pot or slow cooker and cook overnight. Drain off most of the juice because it is usually greasy. Cut meat into small pieces or pull apart. Add vinegar sugar Worcestershire sauce mustard water or wine ketchup lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste. Let cook until hot. Taste and you may wish to add additional ketchup liquid or other seasonings.

title: Baked Pigs Trotters(Porco Al Forno)
instructions: Boil pigs feet in water for 25 minutes. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a large baking pan and place cooked pigs feet onto pan bone side down. Sprinkle tomatoes and the rest of the ingredients on top of pigs feet in the above order. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes until skin looks browned and a little crispy. Serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Bread Pot Cheese Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Slice off top of bread. Reserve top. Hollow out to 1/2-inch shell. Combine Cheddar sour cream and cream cheese in bowl. Add ham onion chilies and Worcestershire sauce. Spoon cheese filling into bread shell; replace top of bread. Tightly wrap loaf in several layers of foil. Set on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Stir filling before serving. Remaining bread can be made into croutons.

title: Salsa
instructions: Put peppers onion and garlic in blender with juice from tomatoes. Blend a few seconds to chop; add remaining ingredients. Blend a second or two to chop up tomatoes; stir. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: To Turn Cooper Green(Antique Look)
instructions: Use 2 to 1 parts water with muratic acid. Sprinkle salt evenly over copper dipped in acid solution. Let dry.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine jello cornstarch water and sugar. Boil until clear and a little thick then cool completely. Place strawberries in cool baked pie shell. Pour jello mixture over strawberries. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Cukes
instructions: Soak cukes in salt and ice for 2 hours. Drain well. Heat the remaining ingredients (except onions) for 5 minutes then cool. Add onions and mix together. Put into refrigerator in quart or gallon jars or Tupperware.

title: Broccoli Salad(Serves 16)
instructions: Toss first four ingredients when ready to serve. Add dressing last. Serve on bed of lettuce. Serves 16.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet; drain. Put in bottom of casserole dish. Spread 1/2 of cheese on meat. Mix soups and Worcestershire in bowl and spread over cheese. Spread remaining cheese on top. Place Tater Tots on top. Microwave for 30 minutes or bake in oven for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Texas Potato Casserole
instructions: Cover potato mixture with crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (less time if potatoes are thawed).

title: Salad Dressing Cake(Heritage Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Sift all dry ingredients together. Then add others I use Crisco Oil in pan sparingly. (No flour.) Bake.

title: Canned Vinegar Beans
instructions: Boil all ingredients except beans for 25 minutes. Fill jars with beans and pour vinegar mixture over beans. Scald.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients and place in well-greased 6-cup casserole dish. Bake 45 minutes. Serve hot. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Impossible Chicken And Broccoli Pie Or Broccoli And Cheddar Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Rinse broccoli under running cold water to thaw; drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli 2 cups of the cheese the chicken and onion in plate. Beat milk eggs baking mix salt and pepper until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 25 to 35 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake just until cheese is melted 1 or 2 minutes longer. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 400\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine sugar brown sugar salt and cornstarch; mix well. In a heavy saucepan on medium heat cook and stir sugar mixture and milk until mixture thickens and begins to boil. Gradually stir 1/4 of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks; add back to remaining hot mixture stirring constantly. Stir in sour cream and butter; continue to cook until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla mixing well. Stir in chocolate until blended. Pour mixture into pie crust. Refrigerate about 2 hours before serving. Serves 6.

title: Brandy Smash
instructions: Bring to a boil for 1 minute 9 cups of water and 2 cups of sugar. Take off stove and add 1 (12 ounce) can frozen orange juice and lemonade. Let cool. Add brandy. Stir and put in a gallon bucket; put in freezer. Let sit for 24 hours. Put 2/3 cup Smash in glass and add 7-Up to fill glass. Serve with a straw.

title: Andouille (Sausage) And Potatoes
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in a large heavy saucepan over medium-high heat. Saute onions bell pepper and parsley stirring occasionally until onions are clear. Add wine garlic soy sauce and andouille (sausage); mix well. Add salt and soy sauce; stir. Add potatoes and stir. Cover reduce heat to low and simmer stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni. Melt butter in saucepan; take off heat and add flour. Blend well; add milk slowly until blended with flour mixture (no lumps). Return to heat stirring constantly until thickened. Heat oven to 250\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Grate cheese mix all together in baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Crazy Crust Apple Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan lightly. Spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine flour 1/2 cup sugar baking powder salt and nutmeg. Mix well. Add milk and egg and blend well. Spread in greased pan. Sprinkle raisins apples and pecans over batter.

title: Low-Fat Pork Lo Mein
instructions: Slice pork thinly and shred into match-stick sized strips. Shred cabbage. Cut scallions into 1-inch sections. Heat oil until very hot in wok or heavy skillet. Add salt; then scallions. Stir-fry 45 seconds. Add pork. Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes. Add cabbage and mushrooms. Stir-fry 2 minutes. Add spaghetti and soy sauce. Toss with rest of mixture. Cover and cook 5 minutes over medium heat. Serves 6 to 8. Contains 340 calories and 7 grams fat per serving.

title: Molly'S Seafood Crepes
instructions: Use mixing method of your choice. Cook 45 to 60 seconds preferably in crepe iron. Makes 14 to 16 crepes. Prepare crepe filling as follows.

title: Yeast Hot Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Turn to 325\u00b0. Place rolls in oven. Mix yeast in water until dissolved. Mix salt with flour then mix all together well. Make rolls on floured board. Let rise for 3 hours. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven. Heat oven to 400\u00b0; then turn down heat to 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell and top with pie filling. Chill for about 1 hour.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Mix ingredients in a saucepan over low heat. Slice 1 pound frankfurters diagonally into bite size pieces. Add to sauce and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Dip For Fruit
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add sugar and marshmallow cream. Stir well.

title: Sweet Cucumber Relish
instructions: Remove pulp from cukes (do not peel unless ripe). Grind with meat grinder (fine) the cukes onions and peppers. Put in layers and sprinkle salt between each layer. Let stand overnight. Drain well in morning. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a full rolling boil and boil 10 minutes. Pack in hot jars.

title: 6 Weeks Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl mix the first 5 ingredients together. In a small bowl mix the next 3 ingredients together and add to dry mixture. Add nuts and raisins gently. Bake in paper cup in muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Store leftover dough in tightly covered bowl in refrigerator.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown cubed steak with chopped onion until onion is tender and meat is browned on all sides. Add water and simmer covered for 5 minutes. Stir in soup mix and sour cream salt and pepper. Cook until thickened. Serve over egg noodles. Serves 4.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream oleo Crisco and add sugar. Add one egg at a time. Add flour salt and milk. Put in cold oven. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Do not open oven until done. Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan.

title: Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Melt ice cream or yogurt. Pour into pie shell. Refreeze and serve.

title: Butterscotch Cheese Crunchies
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine over hot (not boiling) water the butterscotch morsels and butter. Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth. Transfer to large bowl. Stir in graham cracker crumbs and walnuts with a fork until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Reserve 2 cups for topping. Press remaining mixture into 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch ungreased baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oil and blend well. Add oil last.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine crumbs sugar and butter. Press equal portions onto bottoms of 24 lightly greased* or paper lined muffin cups. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in Eagle Brand milk until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Spoon equal amounts of mixture (about 3 tablespoons) into prepared cups. Bake 20 minutes or until cakes spring back when lightly touched. Cool. Chill. Garnish as desired. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl mixing well. Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Combine sweet potatoes with buttermilk. Stir into dry ingredients. Makes a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead 4 to 5 times or just enough to form a soft ball. Roll dough out and cut out biscuits. Place on lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs until well done. Slice eggs in half placing egg yolks in a bowl. Use a fork to mix all of your ingredients. Use mayonnaise and mustard to your liking. After all ingredients are well mixed add your paprika. You may now put your mixture in the eggs. Place toothpick in each egg chill and serve.

title: Apple Or Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt oleo in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Heat water and sugar in saucepan until sugar melts. Mix flour and shortening until crumbly. Add milk and stir with fork. Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth. Roll dough out into oblong about 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Add fruit on top. Roll up like jelly roll. Dampen edge with water to seal. Slice dough into 16 slices 1/2 inch thick. Place in pan with melted butter. Pour water and sugar syrup carefully around rolls. This looks like too much liquid but the crust will absorb it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Monkey Cake
instructions: Roll biscuit in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Put in a well greased tube or loaf pan. Cream together 1/4 cup margarine and 1 cup brown sugar. Pour over cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pat'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 1/3 cups sugar eggs and 1 tablespoon vanilla. Pour into baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Set aside for 20 minutes; leave oven on. Mix sour cream 6 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons vanilla. Pour on top of cake and spread. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Company Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and press into spring-form pan.

title: Holiday Fruitcake
instructions: Break mincemeat into pieces in medium size saucepan. Add water; stir over medium heat until lumps are broken. Boil 1 minute; stir occasionally. Cool.

title: Carrot-Pineapple Loaves
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour four baking pans.

title: Mom'S Deviled Crab
instructions: Saute vegetables until soft in melted butter. Crumb the bread in a blender or processor. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl (use hands if necessary!). Add mustard Worcestershire sauce lots of salt pepper and celery salt (and a dash of Tabasco). Shape and place in crab shells. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until hot.

title: Old-Time Biscuit Pudding
instructions: Soak biscuits in milk making a thin batter. Add remainder of ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Corn Pudding(Kentucky Style)
instructions: Combine ingredients; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Set in a shallow pan filled to 1 inch with hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand for 10 minutes at room temperature before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pina Colada Dip
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together except the whipping cream. Cook in the top of a double boiler until boiling and thick stirring constantly. Cool in a refrigerator until serving time. Just before serving whip 1 cup of whipping cream until fluffy. Fold whipped cream into mixture and serve.

title: No Crust Pizza
instructions: Fry beef and sausage together until done; drain. Cook and drain macaroni. Divide meat and macaroni equally into 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans. Add equal amounts of sauce; mix well. Top with pepperoni and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. (Can also be frozen before baking.)

title: Golden Cheddar Broccoli Bake
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons margarine; stir in flour and salt. Add milk gradually mixing until smooth. Cook until mixture boils stirring constantly. Add cheese stirring until melted. Mix in 1/4 cup corn flakes and corn. Arrange broccoli in a 7 1/2 x 11 3/4-inch baking dish. Pour cheese sauce over broccoli. Toss remaining 1/2 cup crumbs with 2 tablespoons melted margarine. Sprinkle crumb mixture over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Mix ingredients together and put in greased 9 x 13-inch. Top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes mixed with 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tremendous Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel and slice the potatoes and add chopped onion. Simmer in a very small amount of water for 1 minute. Grate the cheese and combine with mushroom soup. Add no water. Alternate layers of sliced potatoes and cheese and soup mixture in greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Joyce'S Dip
instructions: In crock-pot or double boiler; put tomatoes in and cut up cheese and put in. Let cheese melt. Brown ground chuck or beef and onions; drain. Add to cheese and tomatoes mixture.

title: Chicken And Cabbage
instructions: Cut the cabbage core off then wash cabbage. Peel cabbage leaves so you can make layers.

title: Cream Filled Torte
instructions: Whip cream with powdered sugar and flavoring. Arrange 9 graham crackers in a square on a plate. Spread with a thin layer of whipped cream and top with thinly sliced bananas. Repeat 4 times. Top with another layer of crackers. Frost sides and top with remaining cream. Coat sides with chopped nuts and put remaining on top. Chill about 3 hours and cut in squares. Is better if left overnight.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and cinnamon. Cut biscuits into fourths; roll in cinnamon mixture before layering in Bundt or tube pan. Put remaining cinnamon mixture in 1-cup measuring cup; add enough sugar to make 1 cup. Add 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Melt margarine and mix with sugar mixture. Pour evenly over biscuit pieces in pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan immediately. No need to cut bread just pull apart.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat; drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Heat until bubbly. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles. Place cut side down around edge of casserole pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until biscuits are brown. Take out; top with cheese and return to oven until melted. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Saute bacon. Add hamburger and onion; drain fat. Add rest of ingredients. Bake until it bubbles (approximately 1 hour) at 350\u00b0. Freezes well before baking for later use.

title: Butterscotch Torte
instructions: Beat egg yolks well slowly adding sugar then baking powder and vanilla. Mix well. Beat whites until stiff peaks fold into yolk mix. Fold in crumbs and nuts. Pour into two 9 or 8-inch pans greased and lined with wax paper. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans and frost when cool.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in large mixing bowl. In small saucepan combine butter cocoa and water. Bring to a boil and pour over flour and sugar; mix well. Add buttermilk with soda cinnamon vanilla and eggs. Mix well and pour into greased and floured 16 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Orange Peach Jello Salad
instructions: Cook until thick. Be sure and let cool and mix with one package of Dream Whip prepared as directed. Fold into cool mixture and spread on jello.

title: Great Creamed Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes. Boil until tender; drain. Beat softened cream cheese and sour cream until well blended. Add hot potatoes gradually beating until light and fluffy. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Put in 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Southwestern Shrimp
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp; cut in half. Heat oil in nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Saute onion cilantro and jalapeno for 5 minutes.\tStir in tomato sauce. Add shrimp and stir until shrimp turns pink. Serve over white rice. Serves 2.

title: Puffed Pancake With Strawberries
instructions: Mix eggs milk orange juice sugar flour and salt until blended (if using a mixer batter may remain lumpy). Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish in oven until it sizzles (dont let it brown). Remove baking dish from oven and pour batter into it immediately. Bake in middle of oven for 20 minutes or until puffed and brown. Remove from oven sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Pancake falls quickly so serve immediately with warm Strawberry Sauce and sour cream.

title: Party Pizzas
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add seasoning. Mix with cheese until melted. Spread over rye bread. Broil slices on cookie sheet until golden brown.

title: Golden Glazed Chicken
instructions: In shallow baking dish arrange chicken and brush with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Baste once with pan drippings. Combine remaining ingredients; spoon over chicken. Bake 15 minutes more or until chicken is done.

title: Indian Black-Eyed Peas And Potatoes
instructions: In skillet heat oil. Add mustard seed. Cover and cook until seed begins to pop. Remove from heat. Remove lid stir in cumin. Add onion and garlic. Cook and stir until onion is tender but not brown. Stir in undrained black-eyed peas potatoes ginger turmeric and red pepper. Bring to boil. Reduce heat simmer for 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread. Cut out center of bread and spoon in dip. Slice fresh veggies and cut rest of bread into cubes. Dip and enjoy! (Best if made the day before.)

title: Impossible Spinach Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Mix spinach cheese and onion in plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. About 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Apple Walnut Ring Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Mix and sift flour soda salt and spices. Add gradually to butter sugar and egg mixture. Mix well. Stir in vanilla apples and walnuts. Batter will be stiff. Spoon into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes then remove to rack to cool. Dribble confectioners sugar icing on top and sides if desired.

title: Chocolate Sunshine Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; blend well. Beat 3 minutes. Batter is very thin. Bake 30 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0. Frost with your favorite white icing. Serves 20 slices.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl; toss. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce; add to chicken mixture mixing well. Spoon mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole coated with cooking spray.

title: Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Put into a 9-inch pie pan and bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Set aside. Cream together cream cheese eggs sugar and vanilla. Pour into crust and bake 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook water sugar and cornstarch until thick. Add food coloring and gelatin.

title: Mama'S Homecooking Fried Muskrat
instructions: First trap muskrat. Then skin muskrat then cut into 4 pieces. Once this is completed dip into egg and milk then roll into flour cracker meal salt and pepper.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix broccoli mushroom soup cheese mayonnaise egg and onion together in baking dish. Crumble cracker crumbs on top and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Festive Chicken Dip
instructions: Place chicken in a small bowl. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons lime juice garlic salt and pepper. Mix well. Set aside.

title: Fruit Yogurt Salad
instructions: Cook liquids and cornstarch until thick cool. Combine yogurt sugar and vanilla and mix with cooled mixture. Stir in fruit and chill. Be creative and add different kinds of fruits.

title: Bread Machine Bread
instructions: Add ingredients to the bread pan in the order listed measuring carefully and using a knife to scrape off the excess. Bake as directed by the directions on the bread machine. Makes 1 1/2 lb. loaf. (You may also use the dough setting on your machine and when the dough is ready form it into dinner rolls. Let them rise until doubled in size then bake at 375\u00b0 until brown.)

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole add ingredients in order starting with rice. Salt pepper and flour chicken and dip each piece in liquid shortening. Put chicken into casserole mixture cover and bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix and put in an 11 x 13 baking dish. Top with 1 package of Pillsbury pie crust from the dairy section. I use a small biscuit cutter and lap it but it will still be vented. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Good Rich Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast with 1 teaspoon sugar in lukewarm water. Sift flour with remaining sugar and salt; add eggs milk shortening and cooled yeast. Mix. Turn dough onto floured board and knead. Pinch off and roll into golf ball size balls; place in greased muffin pans. Let rise (covered with light cloth). Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Yields about 36 rolls.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. Pour in greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Have icing ready when the cake is done.

title: Pumpkin Bars(Microwave)
instructions: Blend oil eggs sugar and pumpkin together in large mixing bowl. Measure flour baking powder soda salt cinnamon ginger cloves and nutmeg into 1-quart measure. Mix together lightly with fork. Stir into pumpkin mixture. Divide butter equally into two 8 x 8-inch glass pans. One at a time cover with plastic wrap. Microwave 5 minutes and 30 seconds to 11 to 13 minutes on High or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand until thoroughly cooled. Top with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Manicotti Casserole
instructions: Cook manicotti noodles as directed on package. Let cool. Stuff with grated cheeses. Place manicotti in dish; cover with spaghetti sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and is hot.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring sugar syrup and water to a boil. Add peanuts stirring constantly. Cook until peanuts start popping. Remove from heat and add soda and stir quickly until well mixed. Pour in greased pan. Let cool and break into desired pieces.

title: Special Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Melt half of butter in large skillet; add potatoes and stir until coated. Mix other ingredients and pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole. Melt other half of butter and stir in corn flakes. Spread over top of potatoes and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. For a one dish meal add chunks of chicken or ham.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Combine tomatoes onions sweet and hot peppers sugar and salt. Cook gently 45 minutes. Tie spices in a cheesecloth bag; add them to tomato mixture. Cook until very thick about 45 minutes. As mixture thickens stir often to prevent sticking. Add vinegar and cook slowly until thick as desired. Pour boiling hot into jars leaving 1/8-inch space and seal. Yield 6 pints.

title: Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: Add all ingredients together in a large bowl. Put in muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Mix till smooth. Pour into 3 loaf pans greased and floured and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool.

title: Vegetable Bars
instructions: Spray a large cookie sheet or large pizza pan with Pam. Spread crescent rolls on sheet to make a crust. Bake 7 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Mix together cream cheese Ranch dressing and Miracle Whip. Spread on crust. Sprinkle vegetables on top of crust and cover with shredded cheese/cheeses. Chill. Cut into squares.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pineapple into pan. Place cherries over pineapple. Dump cake mix evenly over filling. Sprinkle nuts over mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool before serving.

title: Ann'S Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown meat celery onion and salt. In a kettle cook cabbage for 5 minutes. After it starts boiling drain and add meat mixture. Then add rice and 1/2 of grated cheese. Put in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. You may substitute bell pepper for celery and chicken soup for mushroom if you desire.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese chicken and pineapple together well. Be sure to drain chicken and pineapple well. Roll in crushed pecans.

title: Cheesy Rice And Broccoli
instructions: Bring broccoli and water to full boil in medium saucepan on medium-high heat. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Add Velveeta. Stir until Velveeta is melted.

title: Cream Of Corn And Crabmeat Soup
instructions: In a large saucepot add Wesson oil corn onion celery and red pepper. Let saute until tender for 20 minutes.

title: Bonnymill Baked Eggs
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well. Pour into an oiled 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until mixture is set and top is golden about 45 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pecan Crispies
instructions: Set oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter and sugars until light. Beat in egg and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients; blend into creamed mixture. Stir in nuts and drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes. Cool slightly before removing from pan. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy skillet; set aside. Layer vegetables in skillet carrots onion celery zucchini and green peas. Top off with cabbage; season and dot with butter. Cover tightly with lid; bring to boil. Let simmer for 6 to 8 minutes until vegetables are done. Best when the vegetables are still slightly crisp.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken and soup. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Place in 9 x 13 covered with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered. Sprinkle with cheese; bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer.

title: Squash Pie (Coconut Flavor)(Tastes Just Like Coconut Pie)
instructions: Mix ingredients; pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Apple Cider
instructions: Heat together in a pan until red hots are completely dissolved. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar brown sugar eggs and vanilla. Set aside. Combine flour salt and baking soda; blend into creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate flavored chips. Drop by teaspoons onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yields 3 to 4 dozen cookies.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Set aside. Bring cream vanilla butter cocoa and water to a boil and pour over dry mixture. Add eggs and soda. Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured sheet at 350\u00b0 until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into 1-inch balls. Press flat on greased cookie sheet with a fork. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Antipasto Casserole
instructions: Boil artichoke hearts for 5 minutes. Drain and quarter. Mix all ingredients except olives. Slice olives. Place on top. Bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes at 450\u00b0 in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Day Before Salad(Serves 10)
instructions: Layer lettuce and chopped vegetables saving enough lettuce for top layer. Layer the peas and last layer of lettuce. Cover with mayonnaise. Add thick layer of Parmesan cheese and refrigerate a day or two. Crumble 1/2 pound of cooked crisp bacon and spread on top. Looks pretty in deep glass bowl.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Place ground meat in bottom of casserole dish. Put green beans on top of meat. Pour Tater Tots on top of beans. Spoon cream of mushroom soup over mixture. Cover with foil and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 10 minutes.

title: Hello Dollies(Makes 24 Squares)
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle the wafers over top evenly. Sprinkle the chocolate chips coconut and walnuts on top. Pour the milk over all and bake at 350\u00b0 for thirty minutes. Cut into squares while warm. (I doubled the recipe.)

title: Rich Yeast Rolls
instructions: Combine scalded milk shortening sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm. Soften yeast in lukewarm water; stir and combine with cooled milk mixture. Add about half the flour; add the beaten eggs and beat well. Add enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough; mix thoroughly. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead about 10 minutes or until smooth and satiny.

title: Muscadine Dip
instructions: Allow cream cheese to come to room temperature. Mix with muscadine hot sauce. Serve with round (small) tortillas chips.

title: * Butterscotch No Bake Cookies *
instructions: Melt butterscotch and peanut butter together in top of double boiler. Add cereal. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: In mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla. Stir in potato chips and chopped nuts. Add flour. Blend well. Form into small balls with hands. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with floured glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Damn Good Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour eggs and butter and put in saucepan. Cook on low heat until butter melts. Add coconut and pineapple. Stir all together and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until pie is golden brown.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake as on box. When warm poke holes in cake. Pour condensed milk and caramel over holes. Refrigerate overnight. Pour Cool Whip over top and top with Heath bits.

title: Biscuit Dough(Very Light; For Obstorte, Roll, Cakes And Cheesecake.)
instructions: Sift flour 4 times. Beat egg yolks until thick and creamy lemon colored. Add water; continue beating until very thick. Gradually beat in sugar then extract. Fold in flour a little at a time. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add cream of tartar and beat until they form moist glossy peaks. Fold in egg yolk mixture. Bake in angel food pan in slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Invert 15 minutes. Use whatever size pan is needed for obstorte cake cheesecake etc. Fill with apricot jam. Top with cream filling. Decorate with cake decorator.

title: Blue Devil Salad
instructions: In a 2-quart dish dissolve gelatin in water. Add pie filling and pineapple. Chill until firm. Combine cream cheese sour cream nuts and sugar. Spread over gelatin mixture. Chill.

title: Crustless Cheesecake
instructions: Mix until well blended. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: In Dutch oven heat water and bouillon until dissolved. Add broccoli; cover and cook until broccoli is tender. Add milk cheese and dash of pepper. Cook and stir until cheese is melted. Combine 1/4 cup flour with 1/2 cup cold water. Stir into broccoli mixture. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Caribbean Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Coat a medium saucepan with cooking spray; heat over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper and saute about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and cumin and cook 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes to blend flavors.

title: German Kuchen
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar beaten eggs flour salt and vanilla. Spread into a 9 x 12-inch greased pan. Reserve 1 cup batter for top. After spreading the portion of batter in bottom of pan spoon pie filling on batter. Drop the rest of the batter on top of filling not completely covering it. When baked fruit will ooze up through batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Bake at 325\u00b0 if using glass dish.

title: Dried Fruit Pie
instructions: Put fruit in bottom of pie shell. Beat egg yolks. Add milk. Mix cornstarch with sugar. Add sugar mixture and butter to beaten egg yolks then add vanilla flavoring. Pour over fruit. Bake at 325\u00b0 until set. Let cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Set aside. Cook wild rice separately; set aside. Saute onion in butter; add soup mushrooms milk and flour and heat until well blended and hot. Make layers of rice chicken sauce and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chili Beans
instructions: Cook beans and barley according to package directions in large pot with onion pepper and celery. Add stewed tomatoes tomato paste and remaining ingredients. Add beans and simmer 45 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo and stir into stuffing. Put 1/2 of this into casserole. Then put chicken over this. Pour broth over this. Mix sour cream and soup togther then put over chicken. Top with rest of stuffing. Spoon a little broth over all. Bake uncovered 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Harvest Fruit Bars
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in medium bowl; set aside stirring occasionally. In large bowl beat together margarine and sugar until creamy. Add flour oats and 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice; mix until crumbly. Save 3/4 cup mixture for topping. Press rest into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Crunchy Chicken N Rice Bake
instructions: Combine rice and cheese. Mix well. Add chicken peas and half of the onions. Mix lightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Little Smokies In Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Smokies. Cook on stove top until thick. Add Smokies. Serve warm.

title: Pie Dough
instructions: Mix the flour and salt. Cut in the shortening with knives. Combine lightly only until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle water over the mixture. Mix lightly with a fork using only enough water so that the pastry will hold together when pressed gently into a ball. Makes enough for a 9-inch 2-crust pie.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Saute beef onion and garlic until brown and tender. Combine beans oregano chili powder chiles tomato sauce and water in separate saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Favorite Fishermans Chowder
instructions: Cut fillets into 2 to 3 pieces. In heavy skillet saute onions in 1/4 cup butter until golden brown about 20 minutes. Add potatoes salt pepper and boiling water. Arrange fish fillets on top. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add scalded milk light cream and 3 tablespoons butter. Heat until very hot. Slice tomato and float on top of chowder.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients with little hands. Store in Ziploc bag. Add food coloring for more fun.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Put graham crackers on top. Put chips on top of crumbs. Put coconut on top of chips. Put pecans on top of coconut. Spread Eagle Brand milk over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Kool-Aid Play Dough
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Add 1 cup boiling water. Stir together. Knead mixture until it forms a soft dough.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli and dried onion in salted water. Before totally cooked add undiluted soup butter and milk. Simmer a little while. Cut cheese into chunks and let melt in soup. Keep stirring as it tends to stick. Serves about 8.

title: Chicken Crescents
instructions: Cream cheese softened. Add butter chicken mushrooms and Lawrys seasoning. Flatten rolls with a rolling pin; put 1/8 of chicken mixture on roll. Roll to form from narrow end. Dip in melted butter and roll into walnuts then in bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes until done. Thicken chicken broth and use as a side dish to pour over chicken.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Beat the eggs until they are creamy. Mix sugar flour and cornmeal. Add to the eggs a small amount at a time. Add liquids slowly in the order they are listed. Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain thoroughly. Add cumin chili powder garlic powder red pepper salt pepper and tomatoes; heat through. Cover bottom and sides of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with tortillas. Pour beef mixture over tortillas. Place a layer of tortillas over meat mixture and set aside.

title: Marinated Chuck
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together first (so mustard doesnt clump). Mix rest. Pour over chuck steaks or Spencer steaks. Marinate 2 to 3 hours. Barbecue or broil.

title: Brown Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown rice in butter in skillet. Mix beef broth bouillon soup French onion soup and browned rice in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Excellent with smothered quail. I usually double this recipe.

title: Vegetable Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oil until thick. Shape into balls. Place into hot oil to fry. Drain and serve warm.

title: Yummy Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs for 15 minutes. Cool off and peel. Slice in half. Place yolks in a bowl. Mash with a fork until smooth. Add salad dressing sweet relish mustard and sugar. Salt and pepper to taste. Spoon up and place in center of each egg half. Sprinkle with paprika and refrigerate.

title: Dark Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate in a double boiler. Cream egg and chocolate mixture with sugar and salt. Beat until the mixture is light and smooth then add vanilla. Sift flour and baking powder. Add the flour and baking powder alternately with the milk into the creamed mixture. Work in the nuts. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until done. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Balcom'S Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in 3-quart covered casserole. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease square brownie pan. Dump cherry filling in pan; add cake mix and pour melted margarine over top. Spread pecans on top. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Luby'S Pan-Grilled Fish(Lo-Fat)
instructions: Combine water lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. In a separate bowl mix flour paprika and seasoned salt. Preheat electric skillet to 325\u00b0 of place a heavy skillet on the stove and preheat on medium-high. Dip fish fillets in liquid mixture and then place in flour mixture covering completely. Shake off excess flour and place fillets meat side down in greased preheated pan. Cook 6 to 7 minutes depending on the thickness then turn over and cook until firm to touch (about 6 minutes more). Garnish each with a sprig of parsley and a lemon twist. Serves 6.

title: Goulash
instructions: In a large pot cook ground beef onion and green pepper until tender. Season ground beef with salt and pepper to taste. Add tomatoes catsup sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Let simmer about 10 minutes. Stir frequently. Add water. Bring to a full boil. Add macaroni. Cook until macaroni is tender. Stir often to prevent macaroni from sticking.

title: Frosted Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain the pineapple and reserve syrup make up to 1 c. with water. Bring to a boil dissolve the gelatin in the hot liquid and allow to cool. Gently stir in ginger ale chill until partially set. Whip the cranberry sauce stir in pineapple and fold in the gelatin. Turn into a mold and chill until firm. Blend together the Cool Whip and cream cheese spread over the gelatin mold sprinkle with pecans.

title: Waldorf Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil chicken and break or tear into bite size pieces; discard the skin. Dice celery ribs into small pieces. Peel and cut oranges into bite size pieces. Take 2 quarts of water and add the lemon juice. Cut up apples into bite size pieces and let soak in water-lemon mixture. (This prevents apples from turning brown.) Add drained apples chicken oranges almonds mayonnaise and sugar together in a bowl and mix together. You may add more mayonnaise and sugar to your own taste.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Heat water and butter to boiling. Stir in Bisquick. Stir about 1 minute or until forms a ball. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs until smooth. Mix in cheese and Italian seasoning. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until puffed and light golden brown.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Store in refrigerator until served.

title: Real Holland Pancakes(Eierpannekoeken)
instructions: Slice bread an hour or two before you make the French toast if you can so that it will dry out. Put oven on low (unless intending to serve as soon as cooked). Beat eggs with milk and stir in vanilla honey cinnamon nutmeg optional orange flower water and salt. Heat butter in a large heavy frying pan over low heat. Dip bread slices into batter on both sides. They should be saturated but not so soggy that they will fall apart. Place in frying pan and continue dipping slices and adding them to pan (but dont overcrowd the pan). Saute slowly until the first side turns golden brown about 5 to 7 minutes. Then turn and saute on the other side until golden brown. Place in oven on a baking sheet to keep warm if you arent serving at once. Serve with honey.

title: Jackie'S Gorditas(Jackie Clotfelter)
instructions: Combine masa flour baking powder and salt. Add water slowly and knead to a stiff dough. Cover dough and let sit for 15 minutes. Divide dough into 6 portions and roll into balls. Roll balls out to 1/4-inch thick. Deep fry until puffed and browned. (They will be hollow.) Cut off the end and stuff as you would a taco.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each one is added. Sift dry ingredients including cocoa. Add alternately with milk and vanilla ending with dry ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. (This makes a big cake.)

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients; roll 1/4-inch thick. Cut and sprinkle with sugar. Bake 5 to\t9 minutes at 425\u00b0 (hot oven); makes about 5 dozen with 2-inch cutter.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine crushed pretzels melted margarine and sugar; mix well. Pour into a 9 x 12-inch dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 4 to 6 minutes. Cool. Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip and spread mixture over cooled pretzels. Prepare strawberry jello and 2 cups boiling water. Add frozen strawberries to jello. Pour onto cheese mixture when slightly thickened. Refrigerate.

title: Lemon Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange chicken in baking dish. Combine other ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover and bake 40 minutes. Uncover and cook an additional 20 minutes or until brown. Contains 242 calories 15 fat and 78 cholesterol.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Form a ball. Sprinkle or roll ball in Ranch mix. Cover with pecans or bacon bits.

title: Mom'S Crushed Banana Cake
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and eggs. Add bananas mashed through a sieve. Add sour milk in which you dissolve baking soda. Lastly add flour baking powder and salt; beat well. Add nuts if desired. Bake in a tube pan in moderate oven for 40 minutes. May ice or glaze if desired.

title: Diet Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello and hot water. Add salad dressing; beat. Stir in cottage cheese oranges pineapple and cherries. Refrigerate until set.

title: Orange Creamsicle Cake
instructions: Mix Jell-O and 1 cup boiling water. Set aside to cool. Bake cake as directed on box in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Let cool slightly. Using a fork poke holes 1-inch apart throughout. Pour Jell-O over entire cake slowly. Refrigerate until cool.

title: Rainbow Twirls
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. In a large bowl toss pasta cheese onions radishes olives and cucumbers. In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Toss with the pasta and spread evenly. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Serve.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on package. Cool cake 15 minutes. Punch holes in top with a fork. Combine milk sugar and coconut. Bring to a boil and simmer one minute. Spoon over cake. Cool cake completely. Top with Cool Whip mixed with 1/2 cup coconut or sprinkle coconut across top.

title: Glorious Macaroni
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Saute onion pimento and mushrooms in butter. Combine macaroni onion mixture and remaining ingredients; mix well. Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together soups and sour cream. Microwave onions on High for 4 to 5 minutes. Add onions potatoes and cheese to soup and sour cream mixture. Add salt pepper and onion powder. Place in greased casserole. Melt margarine and crumble Ritz crackers; mix with hands until all are buttery. Sprinkle over top. Sprinkle topping with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Scones
instructions: Scone dough must be handled minimally and quickly. As soon as the soda makes contact with liquid the rising action has begun. The object is to get the scones into the oven quickly while the dough is still wobbling so the rising is not wasted.

title: Fruit Cocktail Salad
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding mix in fruit cocktail then add apple cherries and bananas.

title: Donna'S Lasagna
instructions: In a Dutch oven brown ground beef and sausage; drain excess fat. Add pureed tomatoes tomato paste sugar 1 tablespoon parsley basil garlic and 1 teaspoon salt. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Lillie Mae'S Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together adding only enough pineapple or applesauce to make cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Tangy Salsa Shrimp And Rice
instructions: In bowl mix shrimp and salsa. Cover and chill 1 hour. Cook rice and add chilies scallions salt and pepper. Mix well. Skewer salsa-coated shrimp; broil or grill. Place on rice. Serves 4.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Oil bottom of casserole dish. Mix all the ingredients. Pour into casserole; top with bacon strips very thin ones. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Ultimate Onion
instructions: Mix the cornstarch flour and seasonings until well blended. Add beer; mix well. Cut about 3/4-inch off top of onion; peel onion. Cut onion into 12 to 16 vertical wedges but do not cut through bottom (root end). Remove about 1 inch of \petals\ from center of onion. Dip cut onion in Seasoned Flour and remove excess by shaking; dip in batter and remove excess by gently shaking. Separate \petals\ to coat thoroughly with batter. Mix batter after standing to blend ingredients. Gently place in fryer basket and deep fry at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 1 1/2 minutes. Turn over and fry 1 to 1 1/2 minutes longer or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Place onion upright in shallow bowl and remove center core with circular cutter on apple corer. Serve hot with Creamy Chili Sauce.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Add other ingredients. Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with reserved coconut. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and grease cookie sheet. Place shortening sugars egg and vanilla in mixing bowl and beat thoroughly. Sift together salt flour and soda and add to shortening mixture. Mix well. Blend in oats and drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet. If you wish you may also add 1/3 cup chopped nuts raisins or shredded coconut to the batter. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until slightly brown at the edges. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Sweet Spice Pickles
instructions: *The oils can be purchased at a drugstore if not found at grocery store.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients; shape dough into balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet and press with a fork. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together Ricotta cheese spinach Parmesan cheese and egg until well blended. Layer 1 cup sauce 3 noodles 1 cup Ricotta cheese mixture and part of Mozzarella cheese in 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Repeat layers twice. Cover with foil. Bake 20 minutes; remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer. Let stand 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Little Debbie Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo sugar eggs and spices. Add rest of ingredients and roll into small balls. Flatten on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0. Fill with filling.

title: Bacon Cheese Fries
instructions: Cook French fries according to package directions. Place fries on a broiler proof dish or platter. Sprinkle with cheese onions and bacon. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve with Ranch dressing. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Combine and pour over meatballs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Salad
