instructions: In large shallow baking pan put 1 layer corn chips (not too thick as it dries out) 1 layer rice and 1 layer hamburger mixture (hamburger onion tomato sauce and chili seasoning). Sprinkle with grated cheese (Cheddar). Put in oven to melt cheese. On top put 1 layer shredded lettuce and 1 layer cherry tomatoes (or cut up whole tomatoes).

title: Tater Tot Hot Dish
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion lightly in skillet stirring until beef is crumbly; drain well. Layer ground beef mixture green beans and Tater Tots in 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Combine soup and milk in bowl beating well. Pour over layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until brown.

title: Chicken 'N Rice
instructions: Place chicken breasts in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Pour salad dressing over chicken. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Place rice vegetables and 1/2 can Durkee French fried onions around and under chicken. Combine chicken broth and Italian seasoning and pour the mixture over chicken and vegetables. Bake uncovered 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake another 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Melt butter and brown steak. Add onions and peppers to meat and add all other ingredients except cornstarch. Cook on low heat 10 to 15 minutes and then thicken with cornstarch. Serve over rice.

title: The Ten Minutes, No Fuss, Healthy Lunch
instructions: In medium bowl combine the chickpeas tomatoes onion and tuna. Mix olive oil vinegar and pepper until blended. Pour over chickpeas-tuna mixture. Toss. Serve with bread. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Melrose'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients good. Roll into a ball then roll in toasted pecans or almonds. Can double ingredients for a larger cheese ball.

title: Chicken Stew
instructions: Cut up chicken in cubes. In pan mix chicken noodle soup (starter) and frozen vegetables (stewed vegetables are best). Add bouillon cubes dissolved in water. Cook all day in crock-pot. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Dump Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 1 hour.

title: Pepper Sauce
instructions: Bring vinegar to boil. Put hot peppers in sterilized jars; pour vinegar over peppers and seal jars. Can put in onions and tomatoes also.

title: Butterscotch Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix into boiling milk. Cook a few minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. In small saucepan melt chocolate with milk over low heat; stir occasionally. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. In large bowl beat butter with peanut butter and sugar until blended. Stir in flour and oats until combined. Measure out 1 cup and set aside. Press remaining oat mixture into pan. Spread chocolate over. Crumble reserved 1 cup of oat mixture over top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mrs. Davie'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add oatmeal and nuts; mix well. Shape into rolls. Wrap in waxed paper and chill thoroughly or overnight. Slice 1/4-inch thick; bake on ungreased sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Grease baking dish. Place bread in bottom of dish then sprinkle cheese and sausage over it. Mix eggs milk salt pepper and dry mustard. Pour over cheese and sausage. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Bonnie'S Sweet Potato Gook
instructions: Drain yams. Add pineapple white sugar cinnamon and 1/4 cup melted butter. Mash until creamy; spread in glass pan. Pour remaining butter over top of mixture. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Combine drained vegetables onion cheese mayonnaise and soup; mix well. Pour mixture into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle crushed crackers over top of casserole. Return to oven and bake until crumbs are lightly browned.

title: Homestyle Boursin Cheese
instructions: Beat cream cheese and all other ingredients with electric beater until blended. Line a margarine tub with foil and pack in mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Turn out on serving plate and peel off foil.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Add dry ingredients together. Mix shortening and sugar. Add beaten egg and applesauce. Fold together with dry ingredients. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Minestrone
instructions: Slice sausage 1/2-inch thick; brown in Dutch oven with olive oil. Add onion garlic carrots and basil; cook 5 minutes. Add zucchini tomatoes and beef bouillon. Simmer 1 hour. Add Northern beans and cabbage. Cook 20 to 30 minutes longer.

title: Home Fries
instructions: Place potatoes in a pot. Cover with water. Boil until tender (20 to 30 minutes). Drain and place potatoes in a bowl. Refrigerate until cool. Cut potatoes in 1/2 to 1-inch pieces.

title: Cheese Cake Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix margarine and 1 egg together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine cheese 4 eggs and sugar. Pour over first layer. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Chicken With Rice
instructions: Salt and pepper fryer. Mix rice water oleo and soup. Place chicken on top of rice mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours without lifting cover.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together. Serve with fresh fruit. Excellent dip and easy too.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Stir all together and put in refrigerator.

title: Roquefort Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients well.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until done. Drain water. Add soup and sour cream. Mix well. Add mushrooms and Stove Top with juice; add onions and 1/2 of each cheese. Mix well. Put in buttered casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Bob Wade Barbecue Brisket
instructions: You may want to trim some fat from brisket but leave a good amount for juice. Soak meat in teriyaki sauce; sprinkle with Tony Chacheres seasoning using a good amount. Sprinkle a lot of black pepper on meat. I do not think you can use too much. Cover meat and put in fridge for 24 hours. Take out and let warm up some. Re-season and marinate. Brown meat on your choice of wood fire. I prefer mesquite. Remove from wood fire and wrap in aluminum foil. Put in a pan that you dont mind getting the bottom black from wood smoke and cook in oven like a roast. When done (not overdone) put back on pit in pan; remove aluminum foil from top of brisket and smoke by using wet mesquites. Do not have fire other than to produce smoke. Baste with natural juices while smoking often. Turn meat over and smoke and baste the other side. Remove from pit when meat is smoked good.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and jello powder; stir in all remaining ingredients. Chill well. Garnish with extra Cool Whip (optional).

title: Country Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in casserole. Add chicken. Mix soup mayonnaise and lemon juice. Pour over broccoli and chicken. Top with grated cheese and bread crumbs that have been sauteed with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine milk cornstarch sugar and salt. Cook over medium heat; stir constantly. Add beaten eggs; cook until thick. Remove from heat. Line bowl with vanilla wafers. Layer with pudding wafers and bananas.

title: Chocolate Toffee Candy
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with well buttered foil. Place saltines side to side to cover. Boil together the butter and brown sugar; pour over crackers. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with the chocolate chips; spread with spatula while hot. They will melt. You can also add chopped nuts or coconut on top of the chocolate. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Break into chunks when chilled. Store in refrigerator.

title: Stacy'S Marinated Potato Salad
instructions: Leave skin on potatoes when boiling. Put in large bowl when boiled and after drained. Make the following to pour over while potatoes are still warm Italian salad dressing sliced green onions and chopped parsley. Pour over the warm bite-size potatoes and let set for about 1 hour to marinate. Toss several times. Then add the mayonnaise. Toss until completely covered. Put in fridge for at least 2 hours. Better to chill overnight so flavors have plenty of time to blend. Just before serving garnish with sliced hard-boiled eggs. Great!

title: Bits 'O Brickle Delight Pie
instructions: In deep bowl using mixer combine cream cheese sugar and milk. Add 3/4 cup Bits O Brickle; fold in whipped topping. Spoon into pie crust. Sprinkle remaining Bits O Brickle over filling. Freeze about 4 hours before serving. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Black Forest Cake
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients in bowl. Beat until smooth. Pour into greased and floured 12 cup Bundt pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 45 minutes or until cake is done. Cool in pan 25 minutes then invert onto cooling rack to finish cooling. Decorate and serve with 1 can cherry pie filling and Cool Whip.

title: Play Dough(Do Not Eat)
instructions: Mix all and have fun.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken in bite size pieces. Combine fat flour salt milk and broth; cook until thickened. Add mayonnaise and lemon juice. Cook broccoli; place in bottom of casserole dish. Combine chicken and sauce. Pour over broccoli. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until well heated and brown. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole (Mexican Style)
instructions: Heat onion soups and Ro-Tel in saucepan then in casserole dish put layer of chicken layer of soup mixture layer of Doritos and top with cheese. Bake in slow oven until mixture bubbles.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Brownies
instructions: Heat margarine until melted and remove from heat. Stir in sugar and eggs. Beat slightly by hand just until combined; stir in flour. Remove 3/4 c. of batter and set aside. Stir melted chocolate into remaining batter. Spread chocolate batter into a greased 9 x 9 x 2 baking pan; set aside. Stir peanut butter into reserved batter. Dollop on top of chocolate batter then sprinkle with chocolate pieces. Swirl batter with a knife. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Golden Cheese Grits
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2-quart casserole. Cook grits in boiling water. When almost done crumble cheese and butter into grits. Blend eggs and milk together. Then mix egg/milk mixture with grits. Pour into greased casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake uncovered 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: Sift flour soda and salt; set aside. Cream Crisco peanut butter sugar and brown sugar. Add milk egg and vanilla. Add dry ingredients to mixture. Shape into balls. Roll in sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Curried Tuna Salad(Serves 10 To 12)
instructions: Cook macaroni; rinse and drain.

title: Wassail
instructions: In large saucepan or Dutch oven combine juices lemonade and cinnamon sticks. Bring to boil; reduce heat cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add water if desired. Serve hot or cold.

title: Turkey Meat Balls
instructions: Mix together ground turkey egg Stove Top seasoning onion and Stove Top dressing. Make small meat balls. Brown slowly in butter. Drain. Add flour to drippings. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat and add milk and water. Cook and stir slowly until gravy is smooth. Add meatballs to gravy. Simmer 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Country Bread Pudding With Custard Sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Pour melted butter into approximately an 8-cup baking pan and refrigerate. Place the bread sliced into a large bowl and pour the milk over them tossing to let the bread absorb most of the milk. Tear sliced bread into pieces.

title: Ginger Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cake mix oil and eggs. Stir in chocolate chips. Place by level teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Philly Three-Step Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs; mix until blended. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Serves 8.

title: Tuna Noodle Bake
instructions: Cook noodles following directions on package. Combine noodles tuna mayonnaise vegetables and salt. Blend celery soup and milk. Heat thoroughly in saucepan. Add cheese to saucepan and stir until cheese is melted; then add to noodle mixture. Turn into ungreased 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake at 425\u00b0 uncovered for 20 mins. or until bubbly.

title: Poppy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Simmer chicken until tender. Cool and remove from bones. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Mix soup and sour cream. Add chicken and chopped boiled eggs.

title: Hot Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix together flour and sugar; set aside. Grease casserole dish. Pour drained pineapple in dish. Add sugar and flour mixture to top of pineapple. Sprinkle cheese over previous layer then the Ritz crackers. Slice margarine in small pieces and place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly and pour into graham cracker crust. Chill in refrigerator overnight.

title: Aunt Dora'S Beef Stew
instructions: Stagger all of the ingredients into a large covered casserole. Cover and bake in a slow oven at 225\u00b0 to 250\u00b0 for about 6 to 7 hours (test meat and vegetables for doneness). Stir once after cooking 3 to 4 hours. Makes 6 servings.

title: Jogging In A Jar
instructions: Mix all together and keep refrigerated. Drink at least 2 ounces per day. This will help to keep your cholesterol down as well as help those with arthritis.

title: Pork Chop  And Potato Bake
instructions: Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside. Combine soup milk sour cream pepper and 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt. Stir in partially thawed potatoes and add 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions. Spoon mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange pork chops over potatoes. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Poppy Seed Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in milk. Sift flour and salt. Cut in shortening. Add vanilla and yeast mixture. Add one egg at a time and beat well after each addition. Place dough in refrigerator overnight.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Soften tortillas by dipping in hot oil for 2-3 seconds drain on paper towels and set aside. In medium size bowl mix sour cream cottage cheese and green chili; set aside. Grate 1 cup cheese; set aside. Cut remaining cheese into 24 slender sticks (about 1/2 x 2 inches). Taking one tortilla shell at a time place a stick of cheese and a heaping tablespoon of sour cream mixture on it and roll. Place the rolled tortillas in a 9 x 13 inch casserole dish. Cover tortillas with enchiladas sauce. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Potato Special
instructions: Put potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour 3 tablespoons melted butter over potatoes. Mix soup cheese sour cream and onion. Pour over potatoes. Mix corn flakes 2 tablespoons butter and 1/2 cup grated cheese over top. Bake 30 minutes at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Cover and cook 10 minutes on High.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Roll chicken livers in flour and saute in shortening until brown. Arrange asparagus in baking dish. Top with sauce made from mayonnaise minced onion and chicken livers. Sprinkle with cheese. Brown lightly under the broiler. The chicken livers and sauce may be prepared in advance if desired.

title: Broccoli And Yellow Rice Casserole
instructions: Simmer onion and celery in margarine. Add mushroom soup cheese and 1/2 cup water heat until cheese melts. Combine all ingredients in a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to directions adding a handful of brown rice to make more (optional). While rice is cooking skin and debone chicken and cut it in small pieces. After rice is soft and dry spread chicken over the top of rice along with the corn (drained); cover dish with no heat for 5 minutes. Mix and serve. Applesauce and biscuits go well with this dish.

title: Edith'S Gourmet Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops and arrange in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine soup water and thyme. Heat. Then add parsley sour cream and 1/2 can of onions. Blend and spread over the chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove cover put remaining onions on top and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Creme Brule French Toast
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan melt butter with brown sugar and corn syrup over moderate heat stirring until smooth. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Cut bread in 1 inch thick slices arrange slices in one layer in baking dish squeezing slightly to fit.

title: Easy Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat eggs in large bowl. Stir in cake mix cherry pie filling and oil until blended. Spread in pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool. Prepare pudding pie filling as directed on package. Let stand for 5 minutes or until thickened. Spread over cake. Garnish with Cool Whip and chopped nuts. Store in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Top with Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crumbs brown.

title: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into chunks. Boil until soft. Drain. Add butter and sour cream. Beat. Slowly add milk*. Continue beating. Shake on cheese. Add parsley and pepper. Whip until creamy.

title: Children'S Snack
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Roll mixture into 1-inch balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Store in refrigerator.

title: Curried Chicken Pufflets
instructions: Split each cream puff in half. Combine undiluted soup curry powder and chopped chicken and heat through over low heat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Fill bottoms of puffs with the hot mixture and replace tops. Serve at once sprinkled with paprika if desired. Makes 36 appetizers.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Melt butter and sharp cheese. Add flour cyapepper and Rice Krispies. Roll into balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Two Cup Citrus Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water in large container. Add lemon juice orange juice and pineapple juice. Add ginger ale just before serving. Serve over crushed ice. Yield 34 servings.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Make a paste of vinegar and cocoa and add to mixture. Sift salt and soda with flour. Add mixture alternately with buttermilk. Blend well. Add vanilla and red coloring. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Favorite Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each. Add flour alternately with 3/4 cup sour cream. Dissolve baking soda in 1/4 cup sour cream; add to batter and blend well. Add extract and salt. Stir. Bake in pan for 1 hour and 5 minutes. Cool 20 minutes in pan. Remove and sift powdered sugar over warm cake. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let stand in refrigerator until cold. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: No Knead Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Add yeast to warm water; let rest for 10 minutes. Mix scalded milk butter sugar and salt. Stir until dissolved. Cool to 85\u00b0. Beat 1 egg and add to yeast mixture. Add to milk mixture. Beat in half of flour (sifted). Beat 2 minutes. Add remaining flour and mix the dough until it blisters. Place in greased bowl; cover place in refrigerator. To bake form into two loaves. Let rise for 1 hour before baking.

title: Cherry Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients and place in greased casserole. Combine brown sugar flour margarine and pecans and sprinkle on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Beat in flour sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Blend in melted butter. Stir in chocolate morsels and walnuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. In a bowl sift flour baking powder and salt. Add with milk to the sugar and butter mixture. Stir by hand just to moisten ingredients. Stir in cranberries. Spoon into 18 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups filling 3/4 full. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

title: Hard Rock Candy
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the flavoring and the food coloring in a saucepan. Let heat until 300\u00b0. Take off of heat. Add coloring and flavoring. Have cookie sheet lined with powdered sugar. Pour in a sheet and allow to cool.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions. Grate cheese. In saucepan melt butter. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add flour stir to mix. Add milk a little at a time stirring constantly. Continue until you have added all the milk. Add grated cheese; melt. Pour over noodles in casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Cook on 450\u00b0 until brown. Let cool about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Honey Coconut Squares
instructions: Bake oblong cake as directed. As soon as cake is removed from oven drizzle 1/2 cup honey over top. Sprinkle with 1 cup coconut and slip under broiler a few minutes to toast coconut. Best when served warm.

title: Hide Ems Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup; bring to a rapid boil. Add peanut butter and stir until well mixed. Pour over corn flakes and mix well. Drop by spoonful on waxed paper and cool. Then hide em.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream sugar oleo and Crisco. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add sifted flour and vanilla. Fold in 7-Up or ginger ale. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0 in tube pan.

title: Honey Oatmeal Drop Cookies(Makes 22 (2-Inch) Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 2 large cookie sheets with Pam. In large mixing bowl combine oat bran oatmeal flour baking powder and allspice. In blender or food processor combine oil egg whites vanilla honey and brown sugar. Blend these liquids into dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoon of batter onto the prepared cookie sheets and bake 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Hoppin Juan Skillet Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In medium bowl coarsely mash black-eyed peas. Add rice onion bread crumbs mayonnaise dressing chili powder cumin and red pepper. Divide mixture into 8 (1/3 cup) portions. Shape each portion into a 1/2-inch thick patty.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Cut up and fry bacon until crisp. Drain and crumble.

title: Cauliflower With Tomato Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Trim cauliflower into small florets. Brush a deep ovenproof dish with melted butter or oil. Place florets in dish. Heat oil in frying pan. Add the fresh bread crumbs and toss over medium heat until crisp and golden. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Combine tomato pasta sauce. Pour over cauliflower in prepared dish. Sprinkle with combined bread crumbs and cheeses. Sprinkle with extra pepper. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cauliflower is tender cheese has melted and top is brown. Serves 4. Prep time 20 minutes. Total cooking time 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peach Crunch
instructions: Place peaches in baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine flour sugar & egg until lumpy. Spread over peaches. Pour butter over mixture. Bake at 375 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put fruit &/or pie filling in bottom of pan. Pour dry cake mix over fruit. Pour melted oleo over cake mix. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Add dry ingredients and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Tomato And Pear Chutney
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pimentos. Boil slowly for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Add pimentos; boil for 5 minutes more. Pack into jars and seal.

title: Lemon Ice Cream
instructions: Combine sugar lemon juice and peel in large freezer container. Slowly stir in cream and salt blending well. Cover and freeze until firm outside but still soft in center. Stir several times. Freeze until firm.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger in oil and drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 3 to 4 hours. Several cans of kidney beans may also be added.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. To this hot mixture add fruit. Place half of mixture in oblong dish. Place in refrigerator and let set. Then spread evenly and thinly 1/2 pint sour cream. Spread remaining half of jello mixture and let set.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix celery soup chicken soup and milk; heat. Add rice to soup mix. Put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and top with pork chops or chicken with 1\tpackage dried onion soup mix. Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in an iron skillet at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: After cream cheese has softened put in a blender or mixer and add each additional ingredient. Keep refrigerated.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix with pepper and pimientos. Stuff mixture into hollow of celery stalk.

title: Italian Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Heat oil in frypan over medium heat. When hot add parsley garlic rosemary thyme sage and vegetables. Cook until vegies are soft. Stir in tomato sauce tomatoes and their liquid (break up tomatoes) plus the red pepper. Chop mushrooms and add to pan along with water. Can use dried Italian mushrooms with this water as a soaking liquid. Cover and simmer until thick about 3 hours. Add salt to taste. Makes about 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together and mold into a loaf in baking dish or pan. Place celery and carrots along sides and at ends of meat loaf.\tSalt vegetables and add water; cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 2 hours or until done.

title: Peanut Butter Maple Syrup
instructions: Heat together in 1 qt saucepan over medium heat about 3 minutes stirring constantly until smooth hot and bubbly. Pour over hot pancakes or homemade biscuits.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Place meaty spareribs in a pan under your broiler until brown on both sides. Transfer the ribs to a deeper pan and cover with barbecue sauce. Cover with a tight lid and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Watermelon Rind Pickle
instructions: Day 1\tPeel and seed chunk cucumbers to make 8 quarts. Cut into chunks and soak 24 hours in 2 cups lime mixed with 8 quarts cool water.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour loaf pan(s). Measure all ingredients into a large mixer bowl; beat on medium speed 1/2 minute. Pour into pan(s). Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from pan(s). Cool thoroughly before slicing.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in salt. Spread into 9 inch pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese. Stir milk eggs and Bisquick mix with fork until blended. Pour on top of ground beef and cheese. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Hot Fish Shop Tartar Sauce
instructions: Chop onion and pickle very small. Mix all ingredients together. Chill.

title: Ft. Henry Dip
instructions: Put in blender and mix well. Serve with assorted vegetables.

title: Quick Candy
instructions: Melt almond bark. Add dry ingredients. Drop by the spoonful on wax paper.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream together shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour and cream of tartar; add. Mix together then roll into small balls. Roll them into cinnamon and sugar mixture. Makes about 5 or 6 dozen. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat together orange juice concentrate and milk until frothy. Add vanilla pudding. Beat for 1 minute (should thicken). Blend in sour cream until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Good luck!

title: Mexican Hominy
instructions: Melt oleo. Saute onion and bell pepper in oleo until tender. Empty the 2 cans of hominy draining one and draining 1/2 of the other can. Mix in with the onion and bell pepper mixture. Stir in Cheez Whiz and pimento until melted and mixed well. Pour into casserole dish. Bake until bubbly.

title: Apple Bits Mold
instructions: Soften gelatin in water. Stir over hot water until dissolved. Add all remaining ingredients except apple. Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Fold in apples. Spoon into individual molds or small ring mold and chill until firm. Makes about 2 1/2 cups 4 servings.

title: Chef'S Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce and put into a large bowl. Cut into strips the chicken ham and cheese; arrange over lettuce. Top with thinly sliced eggs and scatter over with onions.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Roll out the pastry and line a 10-inch pie dish.\tCombine the corn syrup and\tsugar in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cool stirring just until the sugar is dissolved. Beat the eggs in mixing bowl and gradually add the syrup and sugar. Add the remaining ingredients and pour the mixture into the pie shell. Bake 50 minutes to one hour or until the pie is set. Serves 8.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Cut pickles in small pieces. Grate onion. Mix ingredients in large mixing bowl. Beat until well blended (use electric mixer for best results). Chill.

title: Bonnie Butter Cake
instructions: Mix all together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs pecans marshmallows and dates together. Add milk gradually until mixture is moist enough to stick together and roll in logs. Roll logs in graham cracker crumbs. Place logs in aluminum foil and refrigerate. Freezes well.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: In margarine saute bell pepper onion Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce. Add soup and water. Blend shrimp and wild rice into soup mixture. Add water chestnuts. Put in large ovenproof casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Ice Cream And Candy Pie
instructions: Spoon coffee ice cream into pie crust spreading evenly. Freeze until firm. Place candy in plastic bag. Crush with rolling pin mallet or hammer. Spread fudge topping evenly over coffee ice cream. Sprinkle with 1 cup of crushed candy. Spoon butter pecan ice cream over spreading evenly. Freeze until firm 2 hours. Garnish with fresh whipped cream-rosettes around edge of pie. Put remaining candy in middle. Delicious!

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix all ingredients except peaches. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour mix over melted butter. Add sliced peaches; sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with or without vanilla ice cream.

title: Jay'S Chili
instructions: In Dutch oven saute the first 4 ingredients in hot oil or until tender. Add meat 1 pound at a time until meat loses redness. Drain. Add water. Add remaining ingredients stirring after each addition. Simmer 2 1/2 hours stirring frequently. Season to taste.

title: Strawberry Daiquiri
instructions: Mix together in blender. Makes 5 (8 ounce) drinks.

title: Eggplant Dressing
instructions: Peel and cube eggplant and boil until tender. Soak bread in milk. Drain eggplant add bread and milk mixture. Mix well. Stir in beaten eggs onion salt and pepper. Place in well buttered casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Oven Porcupines
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix meat rice 1/2 cup water the onion salts garlic powder and pepper. Shape mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls into balls. Place meatballs in an ungreased baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inch).

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook first 5 ingredients until tender. Add soup and chopped Velveeta. Stir constantly until the cheese is melted.

title: Pimento Cheese Sandwich Filling
instructions: Cream the cheese with mayonnaise and add remaining ingredients; blend together. Use whole wheat bread for a great tasting treat.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix everything except pecans well. Add pecans; pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peach Crunch
instructions: Melt oleo in 8-inch square pan. Stir in flour and pecans and beat in bottom of pan to form crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Peel and mash ripe avocado pulp. Add remaining ingredients. Serve as a salad heaped on tomato slices or as a dip for chips.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar salt syrup and milk in a saucepan. Cook slowly until a boil is reached. Continue cooking until a soft ball forms when a bit is dropped in cold water. Or use a candy thermometer cooking to 260\u00b0.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add sherbet and allow to melt. Add drained fruit and sliced bananas. Chill. Serves 12.

title: Creamy Cheese Soup(Debbie Loves My Cheese Soup.)
instructions: Put milk in a double boiler and cook on medium heat. Melt oleo (this can be done in microwave) and add flour to oleo. Mix well then stir into hot milk. Add cheese ham and carrots and cook for 20 minutes. Do not let double boiler boil dry! Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter And Banana Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter in large bowl until creamy. Add banana and peanut butter; beat until smooth. Blend in egg apple juice concentrate and vanilla. Beat in flour baking soda and salt. Stir in chopped peanuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Top each with one peanut if desired. Bake for 8 minutes or until set. Cool completely on wire rack. Store in tightly covered container. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes
instructions: Grease potatoes and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 or until done. Brown hamburger meat and mix with taco seasoning mix according to package directions. (Be sure meat is drained.) In a double boiler or microwave melt Velveeta cheese mixed with Ro-Tel tomatoes. Stir frequently. To serve slice hot potato and lightly fluff. Layer taco meat cheese mixture sour cream green onions and salt and pepper to taste. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Mix ingredients in bowl. Spread on tortillas. Fold tortilla and dampen edges. Cook in oven at 350 about 15 minutes in greased pan.

title: Tri-Level Brownies
instructions: For bottom layer stir together first 4 ingredients and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Stir in 6 tablespoons melted butter. Pat in a 11 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Mix and put in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet on medium high heat. Add chicken onion and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn broth and salsa; bring to boil. Stir in rice and cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Sprinkle with cheese. Let stand 2 minutes. Serve.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine until tender. Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Cover tightly with foil.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
instructions: Note For a fuller pie use the 4 cups of apples 6 ounces juice and 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Other ingredients remain the same or can be adjusted to suit your taste.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix cream cheese and onion. Put 2 tablespoons on slice of ham and spread. Roll like a jellyroll. Refrigerate 2 hours until cold and cut in bite size pieces.

title: Cake Donuts
instructions: Cream butter potatoes and sugar. Add eggs milk nutmeg and vanilla. Sift baking powder with flour. Stir in mixture and add more flour to make a soft dough. Roll 1/4-inch thick; cut and deep-fry. Drain on paper towels. Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Ranch Style Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef. Combine with all other ingredients in a crock-pot. Heat on low for 2 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken in buttermilk. Combine flour cornmeal salt and pepper in a grocery sack. Place chicken in bag 3 pieces at a time and shake until well coated.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well and let stand several hours. Use with a variety of fresh vegetables.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Mix next 3 ingredients together to make dressing. Pour dressing over salad and let set for at least 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: California Breakfast
instructions: Beat eggs until lemon colored. Add flour baking powder salt cottage cheese shredded Jack cheese and melted butter. Blend smoothly and stir in chilies. Pour mix into well-greased 9-inch square dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 preheated oven 35 minutes or until top is lightly brown and center appears firm. Cut in squares and serve hot. Serve with coarsely chopped and sauteed red pepper and green onions. Accompany with bran muffins.

title: Chocolate Kiss Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening sugar brown sugar and peanut butter. Mix together milk vanilla and egg. Sift together plain flour salt and soda. Mix all ingredients gradually adding flour mixture. Shape into balls about the size of a quarter and roll in white sugar. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes. Take out and press a chocolate kiss on top and bake about 1 to 2 minutes longer.

title: Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Break bread into small pieces in bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Beat until well mixed. Pour into nonstick muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 35 minutes in loaf pan.

title: Lemon Barbeque Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in oil; drain. Place chops in baking dish and top with lemon slices. Mix catsup vinegar water and sugar. Pour over chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or more. Serves 4 to 6. Can prepare ahead of time and be baked when ready to serve.

title: Potato Wedges
instructions: Scrub unpeeled potatoes well. Cut each potato in half lengthwise. Then cut into even wedges. Boil potato wedges for 5 minutes in salted water. Drain. Pat dry. Spread wedges in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with oil spices and herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 for another 10 to 12 minutes or until potatoes are golden brown and cheeses are melted.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Brown salt pork in 3-quart saucepan. Add onions and saute until they begin to turn yellow. Add the water and bring to a boil. Add the potatoes creamed corn and frozen corn; reduce heat and simmer for 35 minutes. Add salt pepper milk and butter; simmer for 5 minutes and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar milk and butter to soft ball stage. Add peanut butter salt and vanilla. Cool to lukewarm. Beat until its ready to set.

title: Strawberry Bread Loaf
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients mixing with a fork. Beat eggs oil and berries until well blended then add flour/ sugar mixture and mix well. Bake in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Spray mold with Pam. In a saucepan heat soup stirring in cheese until smooth. Dissolve gelatin with water; add to soup mixture. Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Pour into mold and chill overnight. Serves 45.

title: Pepparkakor (Swedish Ginger Cookies)
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in molasses egg and vinegar. Stir flour with spices and salt then blend with batter. Chill 3 hours. Roll out to 1/8-inch and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 to 6 minutes. Frost or leave plain. Enjoy!

title: No-Crust Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except coconut; mix well. Stir in coconut. Pour into a 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: In casserole dish layer pineapple and cream cheese. In double boiler mix flour sugar egg and juice. Cook until thick. Pour over pineapple and cream cheese. Top with marshmallows. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until it bubbles good.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in large saucepan over low heat. Blend in flour and seasonings. Cook over low heat stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth and cream. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in wine spaghetti chicken and mushrooms.

title: Last Of The Garden Green Tomato Chow
instructions: Grind first 6 ingredients together. Add salt. Let stand 2 or 3 hours. Drain and rinse well. Add celery seed mustard seed sugar and vinegar; mix well. (No cooking.) Put in jars. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain Veg-All and mix with other ingredients. Top with oleo and crackers. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Blend together milk vanilla instant pudding and Cool Whip. Mix both mixtures together. Crush up Oreos in a blender. Layer crushed cookies and mixture. Start with cookies and end with cookies. You can layer this in a plastic flowerpot and add silk flower in the top. You can also add gummy worms in the layers or on top if desired.

title: Taco Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0 (375\u00b0 for high altitude). Brown meat and onion. Drain. Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Stir in taco seasoning tomato sauce and corn. Sprinkle cheese over top. Stir remaining ingredients until blended. Pour over beef mixture. Bake 35 minutes until lightly browned. Serve with sour cream chopped tomato and shredded lettuce.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Arrange washed dried chicken pieces in a large casserole dish. Pour Ragu sauce over top covering pieces well. Sprinkle Parmesan on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is very well done. Serve over hot buttered spaghetti or fettucine.

title: Crispy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken (Or Pork Chops)
instructions: Mix together and pour over chicken parts or pork chops in a greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours uncovered. Use 6 to 8 chicken parts or 6 pork chops. You can use more or less as desired.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream the cheese and add rest of ingredients. Shape into ball and refrigerate. Roll ball into nuts.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding Cool Whip and pineapple and juice until well blended. Stir in apples marshmallows and peanuts or candy bars until thoroughly combined. Refrigerate until served. Best if eaten within 24 hours. Tastes like a caramel apple.

title: Microwave Country Breakfast
instructions: Microwave sausage and onion uncovered in a shallow 2-quart casserole on High for 4 to 5 minutes or until sausage is no longer pink. Stir twice during cooking. Remove sausage and onion from dish with slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. Add potatoes to the casserole with the sausage drippings and microwave covered until potatoes are cooked about 5 to 6 minutes. Stir in 1/4 teaspoon salt and spread potatoes evenly in the dish. Combine eggs milk remaining salt and pepper in a 2-cup measure. Pour evenly over potatoes. Mix sausage mixture with thyme and sage in a small bowl and sprinkle over potatoes. Microwave uncovered on High for 3 minutes. Lift eggs at edge with spatula to distribute uncooked portion of egg mixture evenly. Do not stir potatoes and sausage. Microwave uncovered at 50% power (Medium) until eggs are almost set about 8 to 10 minutes. Give dish a 1/4 turn twice during cooking. Serves 4.

title: Easy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute minced onion and green pepper in butter to soften. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate first two cheeses and mix with other ingredients. Make rolls or balls and roll in chili powder and chopped pecans.

title: Pea And Peanut Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cool and chill. At serving time add

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions on package. Fill cupcake pans 2/3 full. Cream the cheese with sugar salt and egg; stir in chocolate pieces. Drop one rounded teaspoon cheese mixture into each cupcake. Bake as package directs. When cool frost with any white buttercream frosting. Makes 30 cupcakes. These cupcakes freeze well.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Grate ham or Spam. Mix with cream cheese. Add chopped olives onions lemon juice thyme and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Chill. Serve on black bread or assorted crackers.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix both soups chunk chicken and Veg-All together. Pour in casserole dish. Mix Bisquick milk and butter. Pour over chicken mixture and bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Melt oleo; add sugars and small amount of milk. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add corn meal and remaining milk. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes longer.

title: Tomato Aspic
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together. Pour into individual molds. Chill until firm.

title: Spanish Beef
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and green pepper. Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain and mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Use jelly roll pan. Grease and flour pan. Whip eggs until thick and foamy. Add sugar gradually to eggs. Fold in pumpkin and lemon juice. Sift together all dry ingredients and fold into egg mixture beating just until batter is smooth (can use electric mixer low speed). Pour into pan. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until cake springs back when touched lightly. Immediately loosen cake from edges of pan; invert on towel sprinkled with confectioners sugar. While hot roll cake and towel from narrow end. Cool completely on wire rack.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Coat chicken with flour salt and pepper; brown well in shortening. Place chicken in baking dish. Blend any remaining flour mixture with tomatoes; add Heinz 57 sauce Parmesan cheese sugar and oregano. Pour over chicken. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove cover; top with cheeses. Bake uncovered 25 minutes longer or until chicken is tender. Skim excess fat from sauce.

title: Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Boil water and sugar. Chill. Put bananas in blender. Blend with juices. Before freezing divide in half and freeze. Before serving thaw 2 hours. Place in punch bowl and add 3 quarts of Wink before serving.

title: Currant Wieners
instructions: In a large pot or crock-pot melt mustard and jelly together. Cut hot dogs into bite size pieces. Add to mixture. Bring all this to a boil. Turn heat to low; cook for at least 1 hour. If using a crock-pot just let the mixture cook together for several hours. A wonderful appetizer. Kids love them.

title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven at 400\u00b0.

title: Garlic Bread Sticks
instructions: Trim crust from bread. Cut loaf of bread in half lengthwise then into 8 equal crosswise slices. Combine butter and garlic; mix well. Spread on all sides of each 8-inch slice. Arrange on 15 x 12-inch cookie sheet. Sprinkle with seed. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all together. I knead it with hands like bread as it is stiff. Form into balls (roll in palm of hands) smaller than walnuts. Melt together in double boiler 3/4 of 1 block paraffin wax. Roll balls in chocolate mixture and put on wax paper lined cookie sheet. I use ice tea spoon with long handle to get them out of double boiler. If they stick to pan you can pull them free by pushing them off wax paper by putting your hand under wax paper. Sounds harder than it is. Makes about 60 to 70.

title: Eggplant Roll-Ups
instructions: You will also need baking pans or large foil pans.

title: Molded Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello with 1 cup boiling water. Add frozen strawberries and stir until separated. Add drained crushed pineapple and nuts. Put 1/2 mixture in bowl and set in refrigerator 10 to 15 minutes (until slightly gelled). Remove from refrigerator and spread with sour cream. Pour remaining jello on top and return to refrigerator. (Should remaining jello gel place bowl in warm water and stir until slightly thin.)

title: Lo-Fat Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Coat 18 (2 3/4-inch) muffin tin cups with vegetable cooking spray; set aside.

title: Pasta Shrimp Salad
instructions: Toss first 2 ingredients together and refrigerate overnight. Add remaining ingredients (except shrimp). Refrigerate. Just before serving toss in shrimp meat.

title: Bavarian Goulash
instructions: Heat oil. Add beef and onion saute until meat is browned. Add tomatoes. Season to taste with salt pepper and paprika. Add bay leaf. Pour in stock cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in 1 egg at a time until 3 have been used. Then add some flour. Add 2 more eggs and rest of flour. Then add buttermilk and blackberries. Bake in loaf pan at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Choco-Caramel Squares
instructions: Combine cake mix oleo evaporated milk and chopped nuts. Press 1/2 of the mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Pour melted Caramel Sauce over top. Crumble remaining cake mixture over and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meatless Mexican Beans
instructions: Cover beans with water plus 2 inches more. Soak beans 10 to 12 hours. Put in slow cooker. Add water to cover beans plus 2 inches more and add chili mix garlic and onion. After 4 to 5 hours cooking add liquid smoke and hot sauce. When beans are done add salt. Do not heat beans in microwave as they get hard.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In a large frying pan brown ground beef with onion garlic and bell pepper. Drain excess grease. In a large saucepan (4-quart) combine remaining ingredients. Refill tomato paste and sauce cans with water and add. Add ground beef mixture. Simmer on low heat for about 45 minutes. Makes enough sauce for 1 pound of pasta.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Drain juice off cocktail and add water to make almost 2 cups. Put jello in and add Coke. Place in refrigerator and let almost jel. Pour in pecans and fruit cocktail. Set in refrigerator until jelled.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: In a greased sheet cake pan spread pie filling. Spread pineapple on top of pie filing. Spread cake mix on top of pineapple. Melt butter and pour over mixture. Spread nuts and coconut on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix sausage eggs crumbs salt and poultry seasoning. Melt cranberry sauce and mustard. Mix with meatballs. Serve warm.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Put into a greased (Pam) 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Dill Fish(Makes 4 Servings.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Shake flour in oven bag; place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Add water lemon juice garlic and dill to bag. Squeeze bag to blend ingredients. Add fish fillets to bag. Turn bag to coat fish with sauce. Arrange fish in an even layer; dot with margarine. Close bag with nylon tie; cut 6 half-inch slits in top. Bake until fish is tender 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Chiffon Dessert
instructions: Combine ingredients in large bowl folding together until blended. Spoon into decorative serving bowl. Chill. Makes 12 to 14 servings. Preparation time 5 minutes. Chill time 30 minutes.

title: Turtle Cookies
instructions: Mix and refrigerate until chilled; roll in balls. Put 4 pecan halves to make legs. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Meringue Puffs
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time. After all sugar is added gradually add salt and vanilla. Beat until stiff peaks form and all the sugar is dissolved about 5 to 8 minutes. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on baking sheet. Once cooled remove and store in airtight container. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice in water with oleo until water is evaporated. Cook broccoli with onion celery and green pepper until half done. Do not overcook; drain reserving juice. Mix together broccoli and rice add mushroom soup and 1 can of juice from cooked broccoli. Put in greased Pyrex casserole top with Velveeta cheese and bake in 350\u00b0 oven until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Linda'S Chicken Fingers
instructions: Mix egg milk and poultry seasoning in bowl and set aside. Mix flour dressing mix salt pepper and Accent in large bowl with fitted cover (or gallon Ziploc bag). Heat 2 cups oil on stove in large frying pan. Dip chicken strips in egg mixture and then in flour mixture and fry until golden brown turning once.

title: Western Casserole
instructions: Brown beef onion and bell pepper; drain. Cook tomatoes rice and Italian seasoning; let it go to boiling. Turn down heat; cover and let it simmer until rice is tender. Mix with beef. Pour into baking pan or dish. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and melt in a 350\u00b0 oven. Great.

title: Easy Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes; peel onion and melt 2 tablespoons butter in glass baking dish. Slice potatoes and onion. Alternate layers of each onto melted butter. Top with 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with Saran Wrap and microwave 10 minutes (or until potatoes are tender.) This may also be fixed inside foil and placed on grill just prior to cooking hamburgers.

title: Taco Pizza
instructions: Prepare pizza dough. Spread in round pizza pan. Place pizza dough in oven to rise about 5 to 10 minutes; dough should not be moist at this time. Layer the following items in this order refried beans hamburger (browned) Cheddar cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Put pizza in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until hot and cheese has melted. Sprinkle shredded lettuce completely over pizza along with tomatoes and onions. Spoon picante sauce over all the pizza (sour cream optional). Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Tomatoes Vinaigrette
instructions: Arrange tomatoes on serving plate; set aside. Whisk together oil vinegar sugar and basil. Stir in onions. Season with salt and pepper. When ready to serve pour dressing over tomatoes.

title: Chinese Spareribs
instructions: Mix sauce all together and pour over spareribs. Roast ribs for 2 or 3 hours at 350\u00b0. Baste them while baking.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Beat in egg vanilla and pumpkin. Mix well; add to margarine and sugar mixture. Mix dry ingredients and add all together. Drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost when cool if desired.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix gelatin and pineapple in saucepan. Bring almost to boil; let cool. Add buttermilk whipped topping strawberries and nuts. Spread in 9 x 13 pan. Let congeal in refrigerator.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: In small mixing bowl sprinkle yeast and 1 tablespoon honey into warm water. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture becomes bubbly. In small saucepan combine remaining honey with milk butter and salt. Cook over low heat until butter melts. Remove from heat. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in yeast mixture. Combine wheat germ and whole wheat flour in a large mixing bowl. Add liquid mixture. Stir until smooth. Add enough flour to make a soft dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic about 10 minutes. Place dough in a large lightly greased bowl. Turn dough over to bring greased side up. Cover with greased waxed paper and a towel. Let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk about 1 hour.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Raspberry Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in a blender; blend for about 40 seconds or until dressing has a creamy pink appearance.

title: Pork Chops Hungarian
instructions: Trim fat off chops. Brown chops in small amount of shortening in 8-inch pan. Drain fat. Combine onion caraway salt paprika dill weed garlic powder and water. Add to pan; cover and cook over medium heat for 1 hour until chops are tender. Watch the juice! It evaporates; add water every so often. Transfer chops to warm platter. Stir sour cream into juice in pan. Heat through. Do not boil! Spoon over chops.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in water. Heat milk and shortening together until melted (dont boil). Measure sugar and salt into large bowl. Add hot milk mixture. Stir until dissolved and cool until lukewarm. Add 2 cups of flour to milk mixture. Mix for 1 minute with electric mixer or by hand.\tStir in softened yeast and eggs. Beat well and add more flour to make thick batter. Beat thoroughly until smooth and elastic about 2 minutes. Cover and let rise in\twarm place until bubbly about\t1 hour. Stir down. Place on floured board. Knead lightly and roll out to not quite an inch thick and punch out with cookie cutter. Dip each piece in 1 stick melted butter and drop in Bundt pan. Repeat process layering in tiers in pan. Pour remaining butter on top. Cover again and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Grandma E'S Molded Shrimp Salad
instructions: Mix tomato juice bay leaf salt cayenne pepper chopped onion and celery (also chopped). Put in saucepan and simmer 10 minutes. Soften gelatine in cold water and dissolve in hot tomato juice mixture. Add vinegar remove bay leaf and cool.

title: Jennifer'S Colored Sugar
instructions: You can save money by making your own colored sugar! Put sugar in Ziploc bag. Add 3 or 4 drops of food coloring to bag and seal. Knead the bag until the sugar is uniformly colored. If the sugar is too light add more food coloring. If the sugar is too dark add more sugar. To make unusual colors mix the food coloring in a spoon and stir with a toothpick before adding to the sugar. We use these sugars for decorating cookies etc. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Cook onions celery and pepper in oil until they are clear. In baking dish add milk and butter and spread on bottom. Add layer of noodles. Add layer of celery onions and pepper. Add layer of English peas then add soup. Add shrimp and crab meat. As you make these layers at this point add garlic oregano salt and pepper. Add a little of the sherry. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Add buttered cracker crumbs just before taking the casserole out of the oven.

title: Great Aunt Elsie'S Cream Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream together sugar oleo and eggs. Add sour cream and vanilla. Stir well. Gradually add the remaining dry ingredients. On a well floured surface roll out the cookie dough. Cut with cookie cutters in desired shapes. Bake for approximately 12 minutes or just until lightly brown on bottom. Cool and then frost and decorate.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Add vanilla sour cream and egg. Beat until smooth. Stir in apples and salt. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0. Bake about 30 minutes longer. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with topping crumbs. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fruit Tarts
instructions: Thicken cranberries with cornstarch. Combine flour shortening and milk. Roll out on floured surface. Cut with 4-inch cutter. Spoon 1 teaspoon of cranberries on each one. Go around each with milk to seal edges. Cover and seal with a fork to crimp. Lightly grease sheet to bake. Bake at 375\u00b0 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese
instructions: *Can try Mexican varieties according to taste.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Heat cream until bubbles begin to form around edge. Remove from heat and add chocolate. Stir gently until mixture is smooth and shiny. Stir in brandy.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper. Drain. Mix soups tomatoes chili powder and 1/2 cup cheese. In a 9 x 13 baking dish cover bottom with crushed Doritos. Pour ground beef on top of Doritos then pour soup mixture on top of ground beef. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain green beans and corn then put in oblong glass casserole dish. Then combine soup sour cream cheese and celery. Mix all together.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple and sugar to a boil then cool. Mix Jell-O and water to cool pineapple. Chill in refrigerator. Fold in large Cool Whip. Chill and serve on lettuce or with any vegetable.

title: Party Tea
instructions: Simmer tea cloves and cinnamon sticks in 1 quart of water for about 15 minutes. Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups of hot water then add enough cold water to make 3/4 gallon. Add sugar pineapple juice and lemon juice. Mix all together and serve hot or cold.

title: Magic Coconut Pie
instructions: Put the ingredients in a blender; blend about 1 minute. Pour into well-greased and floured pie plate. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour and 10 minutes. Glass pie plate works well.

title: Mushroom Ring Italienne
instructions: Chop mushrooms and onion very fine. Saute onion and mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter 5 minutes. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and mix in flour. Gradually pour in milk. Stir constantly. Combine with mushrooms. Cool. Add egg yolks. Mix well. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into mushroom mixture with parsley and Cappicola. Add seasonings. Pour into greased and floured ring mold. Place in pan of boiling water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: Pour boiling water over 2 cups all-bran let cool. Cream margarine sugar add eggs. Sift soda in flour. Add to cream mixture buttermilk also add the all-bran mixture and the remaining 4 cups all-bran. Stir until well blended; do not beat. Must refrigerate before using fill well-greased muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Make only what you need as this batter will keep 4 to 6 weeks.

title: Cherry Cream Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Beat pudding and pie filling whipped topping mix milk and almond extract in 2 1/2-quart bowl on low speed until blended. Beat on high speed until soft peaks form about 3 minutes. Fold in cherries. Pour into pie shell. Refrigerate until firm at least 2 hours. Top each serving with 1/2 cup reserved syrup. Makes 8 servings 360 calories per serving.

title: Au Gratin Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes until partly done. Combine soup milk and cheese. Alternate layers of potatoes and soup mixture in a buttered baking dish adding salt and pepper as you go. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and add onion rings partially crumbled. Bake for 10 minutes more.

title: Zucchini Pickles
instructions: Wash zucchini and cut in thin slices. Peel and cut onions in quarters then slice very thin. Add to zucchini. Sprinkle salt over vegetables; add cold water enough to cover. Let stand for 2 hours. Bring all ingredients to boiling point and heat for 5 minutes. Pack hot into hot jars remove air bubbles. Adjust caps. Process for 15 minutes in a boiling watter bath. Makes about 4 half pints.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix lemonade orange juice pineapple juice and bananas together; divide into 3 parts. Put into freezer. When frozen add 1 bottle of ginger ale to each part. Can use all together at 1 time if desired.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring oleo water and cocoa to a boil. Mix sugar flour and salt. Add chocolate mixture to this. Add eggs sour cream and soda. Pour into a greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except butter and nuts together. Pour in ovenproof baking dish.\tSaute 1 cup chopped pecans in 1/2 stick butter for 5\tminutes. Put on top of dip. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot. Serve with Ritz crackers or one of your choice.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Pile lightly in an 8 x 9-inch casserole. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated cheese and 1 cup crushed potato chips (or any kind of crumbs). Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Cornmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease baking sheet. Mix butter or margarine and sugar until creamy. Beat in eggs and flavoring. Mix flour cornmeal baking powder nutmeg and salt thoroughly. Add to creamy mixture. Stir in raisins. Mix well.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender. Melt butter in saucepan; stir in flour. Add milk and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add macaroni salt pepper onion and mustard. Pour in greased dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Dot with butter and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until brown on top.

title: Seafoam Frosting
instructions: Cook sugar and water until it spins a thread. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar. Pour syrup over egg whites; add vanilla and beat until it will stand in patties.

title: Western Fettuccini
instructions: Cook peas as directed on package. Prepare noodles as directed on package. Drain well. Toss lightly with sour cream grated cheese and salt. Add peas to noodle mixture and sprinkle more Parmesan cheese lightly on top. Serve immediately.

title: Omaha Potatoes
instructions: Defrost potatoes. Combine all ingredients except cornflakes. Put them on top. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 60 minutes uncovered in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl except sunflower seeds. Toss with dressing and store covered in refrigerator. Toss in sunflower seeds before serving.

title: Good Layer Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter with Crisco and eggs one at a time. Alternate flour and buttermilk; add vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chocolate No-Bakes
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat stir in peanut butter and vanilla. Stir in oatmeal. Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Easy Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a bowl. Add oil salt and sugar. Mix and add 2 cups flour. Stir well. Add 3rd cup of flour. Leave in bowl cover and let rise until doubled. Pour out on floured board. Knead about 10 strokes. Put in greased pans; let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Sensations
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour soda and salt; set aside. In mixing bowl beat brown sugar butter and vanilla until creamy. Beat in egg. Gradually add flour. Stir in 1 1/3 cups chocolate chips (save 2/3 cups chocolate chips for top). Spread into 9-inch square pan. Bake 23 to 25 minutes.

title: Gingered Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut chicken. Drain oranges reserving 1/4 cup syrup. Cook ginger in hot oil 30 seconds. Add chicken and stir-fry about 3 minutes. Add snow peas reserved syrup and stir-fry sauce. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and cook 2 minutes. Top with orange sections. Serve over rice. Makes 2 servings about 300 calories.

title: Virginia Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Chop onion and garlic. Fry in 2 tablespoons of bacon fat until soft. Add vinegar sugar and mustard. Simmer for 5 minutes. Mix the drained kidney beans and butter beans in a large baking dish with the baked beans. Crumble bacon and add then mix in the onion and sugar mix. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Pour 1/2 of batter into a 10 x 12-inch greased baking dish. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Spread 1/2 over batter and 1/2 of nuts. Then add rest of batter cinnamon and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. You can use any flavor cake mix and instant pudding you like.

title: Orange Punch
instructions: In a gallon jug dissolve acid in 1/4 can orange juice; add remaining juice and sugar. When dissolved finish filling jar with water. Cover and let stand for 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Beat eggs with the salt sugar and baking powder until very light and fluffy. Add the lemon juice and rind. Remove crust from oven. Pour lemon mix over it. Return to oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Party Punch
instructions: In a large punch bowl pour sparkling wine or champagne over thawed strawberries. Allow mixture to stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours. Stir in the wine and lemonade and dilute with ginger ale and ice cubes as desired.

title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine soup mix with bread crumbs. Dip chicken in bread crumb mixture coating well. In lightly greased pan put chicken then drizzle with butter. Bake turning once 10 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Championship Chicken Breasts
instructions: Mix salad dressing mustard and honey. Place chicken on grill or rack of broiler pan. Brush with half of the salad dressing mixture. Grill or broil 8 minutes. Turn; brush with remaining salad dressing mixture. Continue broiling or grilling 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown chuck and onions. Drain off grease. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Blend well. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Puffy Fried Bread
instructions: Sift flour measure and sift again with salt baking powder and sugar. Cut in shortening and add milk to make a soft dough just firm enough to roll. Cover bowl and let dough stand for 30 to 60 min. Roll 1\\4 inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut into diamond shaped pieces. Heat about 1 inch of oil in frying pan 370\u00b0 to 380\u00b0. Add a few pieces at a time; turn at once so they will puff evenly. Then turn back to brown on both sides. Drain on paper toweling. Serve with butter or honey. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Belvie'S Favorite Cake
instructions: Combine eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Mix in dry ingredients beating well. Then add pineapple pecans and bananas. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cold Bean Salad
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine first 5 ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients and store in refrigerator overnight.

title: Banana Pudding Supreme
instructions: Cream the cheese until smooth. Stir in sweetened condensed milk and pudding mix; fold in half of the whipped topping. Layer pudding cookies and bananas in dish; top with remaining topping. Chill.

title: Hershey'S Syrup Cake
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and eggs. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with syrup. Bake 30 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Old Fashioned Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Combine cornmeal baking powder baking soda and salt in a large mixing bowl. Add 2 eggs buttermilk and bacon drippings. Mix well. Place a well-greased 10-inch cast-iron skillet in oven at 450\u00b0 for 4 to 5 minutes or until hot. Pour batter into skillet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and crumble cornbread into large bowl.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: In heavy 4-quart kettle melt 1 tablespoon oleo over medium heat. Add onion and garlic. Saute stirring until onion is transparent and set aside.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Place fruit and nuts in large mixing bowl. Sprinkle sugar over them. Mix well. Beat eggs melted butter and flour together with flavoring. Pour over fruit and nuts. Mix well. Pour in tube pan. Bake for 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add other ingredients and place in mold. Refrigerate.

title: Meat Loaf Layered
instructions: Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Combine beef salt pepper onion and milk. Mix thoroughly. Prepare stuffing mix as directed on package. Fill pan with three layers of meat and two layers of stuffing beginning and ending with meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Makes six servings.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Separate eggs. Beat egg whites and set aside. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and Crisco then add milk flour baking powder vanilla and lemon extract. Add beaten egg whites. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour; last 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Rice Artichoke
instructions: Cook the Rice-A-Roni as directed in large skillet. Add the green pepper onions celery and artichoke hearts to the skillet with the Rice-A-Roni. Mix the mayonnaise lemon juice and dry mustard or curry powder. Mix this into the skillet and serve.

title: Soft And Easy Cheese Ball
instructions: Set cheeses out until softened to room temperature and mix together. Add Worcestershire sauce. Chill for several hours. Form into ball and roll in chopped nuts. Cheese ball will be very soft. Keep cool.

title: Best Ever Brownies
instructions: Mix cake mix 1/3 cup evaporated milk and melted margarine. Add nuts. Press 1/2 of mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt caramels and blend 1/3 cup evaporated milk into caramels. Pour over cake mix. Sprinkle chocolate chips over caramel. Crumble rest of cake mix on top. Bake another 20 minutes.

title: Hasty Hobo Soup
instructions: Saute cabbage and onions in butter until slightly soft. Add drained beans frozen vegetables ham and rice. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes stirring to coat with butter.

title: Beefy Baked Beans
instructions: Cook ground beef until brown stirring to crumble meat. Drain well. Combine beef and next 6 ingredients; stir well. Spoon mixture into lightly greased baking dish. Arrange bacon on top of beans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Beef Stir-Fry With Mushrooms
instructions: Partially freeze beef; cut on the bias into thin bite-size strips. For marinade in a medium mixing bowl stir together water soy sauce wine cornstarch and molasses. Add beef stirring to coat well. Cover and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes or in the refrigerator for 2 hours stirring occasionally. Drain well reserving marinade. Set aside.

title: Baked Butternut Squash
instructions: Skin & extract seeds mash with a fork. Place all ingredients in a baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until baked solid and a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Mix thoroughly the sugar butter and eggs. Stir in milk. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add to the batter stirring well. Toss the fresh blueberries in a little flour then add them to the batter. Pour into greased and floured pan.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Cook and drain tortellini as per package directions. Set aside in a large bowl.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions; add salt and pepper. Add other ingredients and mix all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Heavily grease bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with butter or margarine. Sprinkle brown sugar over the bottom of the pan to cover the butter. Cover this with drained peaches or pineapple. Mix cake mix according to directions. Pour over fruit. Bake as directed or until done. Serve warm with sauce. Turn the piece upside down and put sauce over it.

title: Oriental Chicken Wings And Drummies
instructions: Separate chicken wings at the joints cut off wing tips and discard. Mix all ingredients well and pour over chicken wings and drummies in shallow dish. Cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight. Place wings on a cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and put in slow cooker on low until tender.

title: Chicken L'Orange
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over chicken in baking dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes; uncover and bake for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Adjust oven racks to divide oven in thirds. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spray a 5-cup loaf pan Bundt or tube pan with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Peanut Butter Quickie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Press with a fork (sugar coated). Bake for 10 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Fried Rice And Cabbage
instructions: Fry rice onions and pepper in small amount of shortening until it is brown then add cabbage; cover it with water and add beef and salt to taste. Add tomato paste. Let simmer for about 30 to 35 minutes then serve.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown beef and onion together. Drain away any oil. Brown sausage and drain. Melt cheese add in tomatoes and mix well. Add meats to cheese mixture. Mix well. Put all ingredients into a large crock-pot. Let simmer for 3 to 4 hours. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Chicken Parisenne
