instructions: Place uncooked skinned thighs in 13 x 9-inch Pyrex baking dish. Mix red wine vinegar water brown sugar and soup with wire whisk. Pour over chicken. Top with mushrooms. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. One half hour before serving mix in sour cream with a spoon. Serve with rice.

title: Quick Fudge Cake
instructions: Mix as directed on box and pour into a nonstick 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Bake as directed.

title: King'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together the butter sugars and eggs. Add all other ingredients. Bake for 9 minutes at 375\u00b0. Take out before they look done.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
instructions: Divide the cauliflower into sprigs. Soak in salt water for a while and rinse well. Boil up in slightly salted water. Make a white sauce with the butter flour and milk adding enough cauliflower water to make a soft smooth dough. Allow to cool slightly and beat in the egg yolks one by one. Finally fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites to which the corn flour has been added. Season to taste and line the bottom of a ovenproof dish with the gratin mixture. Add the cauliflower and pour over the remainder of the gratin mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour testing with a knitting needle. Serve with cold or melted butter.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Boil chicken in large pot; cook until it falls off bone. Cool; cut into pieces. Save 1 cup of broth. Cook spaghetti until tender. Cut Velveeta cheese into small cubes. Mix together the chicken celery cream of chicken soup pimento chicken broth spaghetti and Velveeta in large bowl. Salt and pepper to taste. Put into a large long casserole dish.

title: Potato Leek Soup
instructions: In chicken stock cook 2 cups potatoes 2 whole carrots celery leek or onion and bay leaf. When cooked remove bay leaf and carrots. In blender puree the potatoes celery and leeks with chicken stock. Return to pan.

title: Cheez Whiz Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Last 5 minutes sprinkle paprika on top.

title: Best-Ever Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat for 1 minute by hand. Bake in greased but not floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 300\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let cool. Chop 1 large jar maraschino cherries (drained) and put on top of cake.

title: Snow Punch
instructions: Beat together bananas lemon juice and sugar. Pour into punch bowl. Add cream 7-Up and sherbet. Sprinkle coconut on top.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: After macaroni has been cooked and drained add chopped vegetables and salad dressing. Mix and season for taste. Chill. (When I dont have fresh crabmeat I use imitation crabmeat.)

title: Taco Meat Balls
instructions: Mix and make into small balls. Cook in microwave for 3 minutes on High.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Store unused batter in airtight container. Do not stir when ready to spoon into muffin cups to bake. Can sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar or nuts before baking.

title: Green Wonder Salad
instructions: Do not drain liquid from vegetables. Mix all and marinate overnight. Lasts weeks. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 3/4 cup pecans. Mold into 2 small or 1 large ball. Roll in remaining pecans. Wrap in Glad Wrap and chill.

title: Quick Quiche
instructions: Brown sausage with onions and mushrooms; drain well. Mix eggs milk salt and pepper; add sausage mixture. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife comes out clean.

title: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease baking sheets.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 6 Tbsp juice. Mix pineapple cheese flour sugar and juice. Stir well. Pour into dish. Sprinkle on topping.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Use a large glass pie dish or a 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Spread rolls to form crust. (Pam the pan first.) Brown meat and onion. Add taco seasoning and water. I bring to boil. Spread meat mixture over rolls. Spread sour cream over meat. Sprinkle cheese over sour cream. Top with crushed Doritos. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with a salad.

title: Mama'S Lap Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and shortening together. Add eggs and cream. Sift flour and soda together. Add alternately with milk. Form into small balls the size of walnuts; flatten with fork. Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cranberry And Orange Salad Mold
instructions: Dissolve cherry gelatin in hot water. Add sugar and lemon juice. Soak gelatin in pineapple juice and dissolve over hot water. Add to cherry gelatin mixture. When gelatin begins to thicken add other ingredients. Pour into molds.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Grease one large 8 x 12-inch casserole dish. Line with chipped beef. Wrap each chicken breast with a strip of bacon. Place on beef in casserole. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Cherry Chiffon Dessert
instructions: Combine ingredients in large bowl folding together until blended. Spoon into decorative serving bowl. Chill.

title: Tomatoes With Basil
instructions: Arrange tomatoes on a platter. Sprinkle with minced garlic salt pepper oregano basil and cheese. Drizzle oil over all.

title: Fifty Dollar Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and melted chocolate. Sift in flour and baking powder. Add milk and fold in egg whites. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven. When done cool and cover with Fifty Dollar Cake Icing.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Mix hash browns and milk. Add to onion. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted.

title: Weight Watchers Quick Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spoon into muffin pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 muffins. A 1 ounce serving equals 1 Bread.

title: Coconut Bars(Candy)
instructions: Melt oleo; add milk sugar and coconut. Mix well. Chill until easy to handle and then form into small balls. Chill again until firm. Melt chocolate chips over warm water. Stir until smooth then dip the bottom of each ball into the chocolate using a toothpick. Harden on waxed paper.

title: Tex-Mex Meatball Soup
instructions: Chop onion. Cut zucchini into 1-inch pieces. Combine beef chili powder 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Shape into 1-inch balls. In a Dutch oven heat oil over medium heat. Add meatballs; brown well. Remove meatballs and reduce heat. Add onion and zucchini. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Stir in cumin oregano tomatoes with their juice stock hot pepper sauce 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add meatballs; heat through. Sprinkle with fresh coriander.

title: Vegetable Bean Chili
instructions: In a 4-quart kettle or Dutch oven saute zucchini green pepper onion carrots celery and garlic in oil until tender. Stir in tomatoes picante sauce bouillon and cumin; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Add beans and olives; heat through. Garnish with cheese and alfalfa sprouts if desired. Yield 9 servings (2 1/4 quarts).

title: Basic Meringue How-To
instructions: Note A copper bowl is excellent for beating egg whites. The chemical reaction which occurs between copper and egg whites helps to stabilize mixture. Cream of tartar should be omitted when beating egg whites in copper bowl.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Break 4 eggs in a bowl. Beat for several minutes with rotary eggbeater. Add brown sugar and syrup; stir well. Add pecan meats and several little pats of butter. Pour mixture into 2 pie crust shells. Sprinkle top with pecans. Bake slowly about 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Casserole
instructions: Slice potatoes thin in a long baking dish. Add sliced onions and then sprinkle rice over this. Crumble beef over top of potatoes. Pour tomato soup over all in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about one hour.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add yolk of beaten egg. Add pecans and crushed pineapple. Put layer of mixture then layer of vanilla wafers etc. Serve with whipped cream and a cherry.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread cherry pie filling on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan then spread pineapple on top. Sprinkle on cake mix then pour butter over top and sprinkle with coconut and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Wash rice. Combine meat rice salt pepper and onion. Shape into small balls. Heat tomato soup and water in crock-pot. Brown meatballs. Add all to soup mixture; simmer for 1 hour.

title: Hot Apple Cider
instructions: Pour 1/2 gallon apple cider into large pot. Add cinnamon sticks cloves and orange juice. Simmer over low heat for 2 hours. Add more apple cider as needed. Fifteen minutes before serving garnish with orange and lemon slices.

title: Western Sour Cream Dressing
instructions: Blend together all ingredients and chill. Makes 1 1/4 cups dressing.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar well. Add egg yolks and milk. Cook over medium heat until thick stirring frequently. When thick add vanilla and coconut. Pour into cooked pie crust. Add meringue and brown.

title: Fresh Apple Squares
instructions: Step 1 Toss apples sugar and spices together.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar adding eggs one at a time. Beat in sifted flour and pineapple syrup. Mix well. In a 9x13 pan melt butter pour in brown sugar. Then pour in cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. You could place a cherry in the middle of the pineapple rings before baking.

title: Italian Cheese Pie
instructions: Note Can top with any topping or sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Punkie'S Chili
instructions: Brown ground chuck. Rinse and drain. Add ingredients accordingly. Let boil then turn on simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Use 1/4 cup green onion tops for garnish.

title: Donna Connor'S Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 loaf pans.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Dissolve unflavored gelatin in cold water. Stir in boiling water. Stir in pineapple and juice lemon juice and salt. Chill until partially congealed.

title: Yummy Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool before slicing.

title: Rhubarb Cake Pudding
instructions: Spread each ingredient into an oblong cake pan in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Poulet
instructions: Mix stuffing and margarine with water; set aside. Combine onion celery salt and mayonnaise. Mix well with stuffing mix.

title: Crisp Coconut Oaties
instructions: Cream together butter sugars egg vanilla and coconut extract. Combine all other ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Roll dough into balls. Place on greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Biscuits
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; mix well. Add margarine and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until desired thickness. Stir in vanilla. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Snickers Bar Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar brown sugar and peanut butter. Add vanilla and eggs. Mix. Add baking powder baking soda and flour. Mix well. Cut miniature Snickers in halves. Wrap around each bar half forming a ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients reserving 1 cup of pecans. Shape into a ball and roll in the reserved pecans.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain. Combine remaining ingredients and add to ground chuck. Simmer until hot.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0 spray 8 inch square 7x11 or 12 cup muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl combine the cornmeal flour sugar baking powder and the salt. In a small bowl beat the buttermilk over the flour mixture; stir just until blended (do not overmix). Transfer to the pan. Bake until golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean 20-25 minutes. Cool pan on a rack 10 minutes; serve warm. Makes 12 servings.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Blend flour and butter in a large pan. Add cream soup salt and water. Cook over low heat stirring to thicken. Fold in remaining ingredients. Grease a 2-quart casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Quick Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Mix all ingredients. If necessary press dough together. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto cookie sheet. Bake until tops are dry and edges are light brown 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet. Cool completely. Store in airtight container.

title: Picnic Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger loosely in butter with onion; add remaining ingredients. Put in greased casserole dish. Bake slowly at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. (If uncovered a tasty crust forms.)

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Drain pineapple save juice. Put pineapple in baking dish. Combine flour juice sugar and cheese. Pour over pineapple. Combine cracker crumbs and margarine. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Louisiana Jambalaya
instructions: Season meat generously. In a 4 to 5 quart heavy pot heat oil. Brown meat on all sides and remove. Meat can be cut from bone or cut into smaller servings if desired.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Heat milk and marshmallows and stir until melted. Pour over crumbled crackers and add other ingredients. Mix with hands as this is a stiff mixture. Line bowl or pan with wax paper and pack mixture in solid. Put in refrigerator and chill.

title: Microwave Diabetic Apple Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in an 8-inch round microwave dish (glass preferable). Set aside. Mix oil Equal and eggs together. In another bowl mix\tremainder of the ingredients and add to egg mixture. Pour into dish\tand stir or fold in the margarine. Microwave on High\t10 to\t12 minutes turning every 3 minutes.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice by directions on package. Put in buttered casserole dish. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn And Crab Bisque
instructions: In a 2 gallon stockpot melt butter over medium-high heat. Add corn onions celery bell pepper and garlic. Saute five to ten minutes or until vegetables are wilted.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar; add remaining ingredients (except marshmallows) to eggs. Mix well and pour into greased and floured sheet cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. While hot cover with marshmallows. I return cake to oven until marshmallows lose their shape. Let cool.

title: Traditional Chex Party Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Heat margarine in large shallow roasting pan (about 15 x 10 x 2-inch) in oven until melted. Remove. Stir in seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add Chex cereal and nuts. Mix until all pieces are coated. Heat in oven for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Spread on absorbent paper to cool.

title: Holiday Cookies(Sugar Cookies)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl with hands until smooth. Roll dough one part at a time 1/4-inch thick. Cut into desired shapes and place on cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Let cool; decorate. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Olivia
instructions: Mix all except oleo corn flakes and almonds in large casserole dish. In frying pan frizzle corn flakes and almonds in melted oleo for a few minutes. Spread over casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Nothing Cake
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add remaining ingredients mixing by hand. Batter is stiff. Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When cold cut into squares. Dont get upset when the cake looks like it fell.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Add dry ingredients. Add crushed bananas and nuts last. Bake in oiled loaf pan in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain and mash. Mix with other ingredients. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done or light brown.

title: Corn Pie
instructions: Whip eggs thoroughly in bowl. Add sugar flour milk margarine salt and pepper. Stir in corn. Pour into buttered casserole. Set dish in pan of water about 2 inches deep. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until knife blade comes out clean when tested. You also may use fresh or frozen corn.

title: Granny'S Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Layer #1 Mix flour nuts and butter and make crust. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandma Wood'S Butter Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until thick. Serve warm over berry and fruit pies or dumplings. Yields approximately 2 1/2 cups.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil together. Add shredded zucchini. Add flour soda baking powder cinnamon and nuts. Pour all into greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large saucepan combine chicken 1/2 cup of the milk all the soup and sour cream. Bring to boil over medium heat. Remove from heat spoon into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In large bowl beat remaining 3/4 cup milk Bisquick corn meal and butter. Pour over hot chicken sprinkle top with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Very fast and easy. Plus its good. Feeds about 4 to 5 people.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cook chicken in boiling salted water to cover in saucepan until tender; drain. Cool and cut into bite size pieces. Place chicken in 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Pour mixture of soup and broth over chicken. Combine baking mix and milk in a bowl; mix well. Pour over chicken. Bake for 35 minutes. Drizzle melted butter over top. Bake for 10 minutes longer. This easy recipe can be prepared ahead and can be frozen. Yields 6 servings.

title: Peanut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given. Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Test for doneness with toothpick. Cool on rack. Chill for easier slicing.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pineapple and oranges; mix well. Add pineapple and oranges and freeze.

title: Mary'S Goulash
instructions: Cut beef into bite size cubes. Use a large iron frypan and melt oleo then add meat onions paprika salt and pepper. Brown until dark brown stirring often. When meat is brown on all sides of cubes add water and simmer about 35 minutes covered with lid. Dissolve cornstarch in milk and add to mixture. Let simmer 10 minutes longer. Serve over rice noodles or hot biscuits.

title: Chicken Liver Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onions in butter until tender not brown. Add chicken livers. Season with salt and pepper also paprika. Brown livers. Cover; cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Add sour cream; heat thoroughly. Serve over rice. Serve with Sue Tossed Salad in 1988 book page 19.

title: Chicken Broccoli Crepes
instructions: Beat eggs lightly in medium bowl. Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth. Lightly grease crepe pan or 7 or 8-inch skillet and place over medium-high heat. Pour about 3 tablespoons of batter into pan. Tilt pan to spread batter evenly. When crepe is light brown and set turn to brown other side. Remove and repeat to make 12 crepes.

title: Pink Lady Punch
instructions: Mix cranberry and pineapple juice with sugar and chill. When ready to serve add chilled ginger ale. Serves approximately 35.

title: Ham Potato Scallop
instructions: Cut ham in bite-size pieces. Put half the potatoes in greased 2-quart casserole. Cover with ham pieces. Place remaining potatoes on top. Combine soup milk onion green pepper and pepper; pour over potatoes. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour; remove cover and bake 45 minutes longer or until potatoes are done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Make pastry for 2-crust pie; line pie plate with pastry. Fill with sliced apples. Mix sugar flour and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Dot with shortening. Top with pastry. Seal edges and flute. Cover edge with aluminum foil if desired. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Fold dry pudding mix into whipped topping. Add pineapple juice marshmallows and nuts. Refrigerate!

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut squash up and parboil until tender; drain. Add soup and onions to squash. Add several pats of margarine and salt and pepper to taste. Stir until mixed. Pour part of mixture in bottom of casserole dish. Spread crumbled Ritz crackers over mixture then spread a layer of grated cheese. Repeat finishing with cheese on top. Cover and bake at about 400\u00b0 until bubbling through. Take cover off and let cook about 10 minutes more.

title: Cherry Angel Cream Cake
instructions: Cut cake into 1/4-inch slices. Arrange half the slices on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. In a large mixing bowl combine milk water and extract. Mix well. Add pudding mix and beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread half the cream mixture over cake slices. Top evenly with 1 can cherry filling. Top with remaining cake slices cream mixture and cherry filling. Chill 4 hours until set. Cut into squares to serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl sift together flour baking soda and salt. In large bowl combine butter sugars and vanilla extract. With wooden spoon beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add sifted dry ingredients. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Honey Of A Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in greased pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package. Rinse and drain. Brown sausage; add onion pepper and celery. Cook vegetables until tender. Add rice mushrooms and soups. Pour in greased 3-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Blueberry-Orange Bread
instructions: Toss blueberries with 1 tablespoon flour and set aside. Combine remaining flour 1/4 cup sugar baking powder and salt in a bowl. Stir well and set aside. Combine egg water orange juice margarine and 1 tablespoon orange rind. Add to dry ingredients stirring well. Gently fold in berries.

title: Sugar-Free Orange-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Boil water and add jello. Mix thoroughly. Add pineapple and mandarin oranges. Refrigerate until congealed.

title: Baked Hash Browns
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup oleo salt onion soup sour cream and cheese. Blend well. Pour over hash browns and mix. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 1/4 cup oleo and cornflakes and pour over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: German Split Pea Soup
instructions: Dice salt bacon and saute with onion. Pour all ingredients into a Dutch oven and cook for 6 hours. Serves 10.

title: Applesauce Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg. Stir together flour baking soda and spices. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Stir in applesauce raisins and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pan for 10 minutes; remove and cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Golden Cornbread
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes a 9-inch square pan. Delicious with spaghetti or chili.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Boil meat cut into chunks. (Save broth.) Mix stuffing onions margarine and put 1/2 in baking dish. Add meat chunks. Dilute cream of celery soup with can of chicken broth. Pour over chicken. Add another layer of each except this time use cream of chicken soup and broth.

title: Banquet Potatoes
instructions: Thaw frozen hash browns until they can be broken apart and stirred. Combine first 4 ingredients and mix well. Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 1 1/2 hours uncovered in 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 oven. Serves 12. May be made in advance and refrigerated until time to bake.

title: Millionaire Piesmakes 2 Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into pie crusts. Let stand overnight.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Put sugar and water in 2-quart pan. Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in egg. Sift dry ingredients together. Add alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Pour pudding batter into hot syrup being careful not to mix with syrup. Cook tightly covered for 1 hour on medium heat. Do not take cover of kettle off while cooking pudding or pudding will not cook right.

title: Seven-Layer Salad
instructions: In a large bowl layer the following lettuce peas celery onion and mayonnaise. Cover mayonnaise with Parmesan cheese. Top with bacon. Cover and refrigerate approximately 8 hours prior to serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cool Creamy Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine cucumbers onion pimento chives and dill weed in medium size bowl. Add the salad dressing and toss.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; beat well. Bake in a buttered loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool and slice.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Brown sausage with garlic. Add Ragu sauce and tomato paste. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours. Cook 16 ounces ziti according to package instructions. In a large casserole dish place a layer of ziti then layer of sauce followed by cheese. Repeat process ending with sauce. Bake covered for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Cheese Logs
instructions: Mix well. Roll into 2 logs. Roll again in chopped pecans or parsley. Chill. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and squeeze spinach until dry. Combine remaining ingredients and blend well. Add spinach and blend. Chill 2 hours covered.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Let cream cheese and eggs sit out and get room temperature. Mix cream cheese eggs sugar flour vanilla and heavy cream for 15 minutes. Mix graham crackers sugar and oleo. Place graham cracker mixture in 10-inch spring-form pan. Pour cream cheese mixture over graham cracker crust. Bake at 500\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Reduce to 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn oven off (do not open oven) and leave in oven 6 hours. Cool. Remove from pan.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) baking pans in large bowl. Stir together sugar flour cocoa baking powder soda and salt. Add eggs milk oil and vanilla; beat on medium speed of electric mixer 2 minutes. Stir in boiling. (Batter will be thin.) Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes; cool 10 minutes. Frost with One Bowl Buttercream Frosting.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash and slice cukes very thin. Slice in onions. Mix in salt. Add one quart very cold water let stand 3 hours. Drain well and add pickling syrup of 5 cups of sugar 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric 1/2 scant teaspoon cloves 2 tablespoons mustard seed 1 tablespoon celery seed 4 cups vinegar 1 cup water. Scald but do not boil. Seal in jars.

title: Hot Cinnamon Biscuits
instructions: In an aluminum 9-inch or 10-inch pie pan melt butter water sugar and sprinkle of cinnamon over low heat. Open tube of biscuits and dip in mixture. Turn over and put on mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Scallops With Tomatoes(Microwave)
instructions: Pat scallops on paper toweling. Place in a microproof 1-quart casserole with onion wine tomato paste tomatoes and cilantro. Toss together until well mixed. Cover with lid or vented plastic wrap and microwave on High 3 1/2 to 4 minutes or until scallops are opaque stirring once. Sprinkle with pepper and Feta cheese. Toss together. Spoon over rice in deep bowls. Serves 2.

title: Cranberry Slush]
instructions: Combine Jell-O and boiling water; let cool. Add the rest of the ingredients. Pour into freezer container and freeze.

title: Salt Rising Bread
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Add remaining ingredients. Let stand overnight in a warm place. In the morning when it has foam on top remove the potatoes and discard. Add 1/4 teaspoon of soda and thicken with flour. Let rise. Add 1/2 gallon (8 cups) flour to make a sponge. Add risen mixture and let rise again. Make out into 4 loaves. Grease pans well. Bake in moderate 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or more.

title: Vegetable Enchiladas
instructions: Simmer in covered saucepan the water lentils and salt for 15 to 20 minutes. Drain rinse and set aside. Stir-fry carrots and chili powder in hot oil for 2 minutes. Add zucchini; stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in lentils half the undrained tomatoes and half of the cheese. Spoon vegetable mixture onto tortillas. Place seam side down in prepared baking dish. Cover with foil. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes. Remove foil. Bake for 7 to 12 minutes. Heat remaining tomatoes. Spoon over enchiladas. Top with cheese. Bake 1 minute.

title: Granny'S Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onions in 3 tablespoons butter until brown. Remove mushrooms etc. Add 1 tablespoon of butter to pan. Brown meat. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; pour over meat. Add tomato paste mustard and salt. Cover and simmer 45 minutes until tender. Combine flour and water. Slowly stir into meat mixture. Cook stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat. Add mushrooms onions and sour cream. Heat but dont boil. Serve over rice.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Heat a large pot. Cook carrots onion celery and garlic in 1 cup stock until tender. Add remaining ingredients except beans macaroni Tabasco and cheese. Cook until vegetables are tender. In blender or processor process 1/2 cup garbanzo beans and 1/2 cup kidney beans until pureed. Set aside. Add remaining ingredients; simmer 10 minutes. Serve hot. Add cooked macaroni and sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Mix tomato sauce paste oregano basil salt garlic powder or clove garlic. Mix and spread in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Brown and drain ground chuck and mix with remaining sauce.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Oven-Fried Pecan Corn Meal Chicken
instructions: Pound the chicken breast halves to an even thickness. Pour 1/2 cup of oil into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and heat it in the hot oven for 10 minutes. Combine the remaining oil with the mustard salt pepper and paprika in a shallow bowl. Mix well. Combine the pecans and corn meal on a sheet of wax paper. Dip the chicken pieces in the seasoned oil and then in the nut mixture. Remove the pan from the oven and place the chicken pieces in the pan. Bake for 10 minutes then turn with tongs and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Penny'S Baked Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half. Mix sour cream lemon juice and all seasonings. Coat chicken in the mixture. Refrigerate; allow to marinate for 8 hours or overnight. Roll chicken pieces in bread crumbs. Arrange in baking dish. Drizzle 1/4 c. melted butter over breasts. Bake 45 min. at 350\u00b0 F. Drizzle another 1/2 c. melted butter over chicken and bake 15 min. longer.

title: Dutch Potato Filling
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water. Place mashed potatoes in large bowl. Add slightly beaten eggs bouillon cube mixture onion salt pepper and parsley; blend well. Place in a 1-quart greased casserole. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven with chicken or until browned on top.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together making sure spinach is well drained. Let blend for at least 24 hours. You can hollow out round loaf and fill cavity with dip using bread as dippers.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0 (or as directed on package). Spread out refrigerator roll into triangle shape. Spread with mustard. Top with ham then cheese. Roll into crescent shape. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Greek Vinaigrette
instructions: Combine ingredients in a jar with a screw-top lid. Shake well to mix. Store in refrigerator covered for up to two weeks.

title: Mexican Meat Filling
instructions: In large skillet cook ground chuck onion garlic and cayenne over medium-high heat stirring often until meat is no longer pink about 5 minutes. Add chili powder cumin and salt. Cook 1 minute. Add tomato sauce and cook stirring often until thickened about 5 minutes.

title: Easy No Crust Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a blender or electric mixer and pour in a 10-inch buttered Pyrex pie pan. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. This will bake to a delicious crust and a toasted coconut top.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in large cake pan. Mix sugar flour and milk together. Pour over melted margarine. Heat fruit such as apples peaches or strawberries; pour over batter and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Fruit Cheese Ball
instructions: Roll in sliced almonds. Serve with Escort crackers.

title: Fried Ice Cream
instructions: Dip ice cream in egg then roll in crushed cookies. Repeat. Freeze at least 24 hours before frying. Deep fry for 1 minute.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
instructions: Pour sugar over berries; stir. Let stand while you prepare the Sure-Jell. Boil Sure-Jell and water for 1 minute at rolling boil. Pour over berries and stir for 3 or 4 minutes. Put in jars and freeze.

title: Stuffed Jumbo Shells And Tofu
instructions: Cook drain and rinse shells. Combine remaining ingredients except spaghetti sauce and the extra Parmesan cheese. Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce in bottom of shallow baking dish. Fill shells with tofu mix and place in single layer in baking dish. Top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 6 servings. Calories 277.

title: Microwave Sugar Glazed Nuts
instructions: Mix sugar and sour cream in large microwave bowl. Microwave on High a total of 7 minutes 2 minutes and stir 3 minutes and stir 2 minutes and stir. Add vanilla and nuts. Mix well and spread onto waxed paper. Separate as mixture cools.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake pastry shell for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually. Add eggs one at a time beating each time. Add vanilla. Add soda to buttermilk. Add flour and milk alternately to other ingredients. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. This cake can be frozen. It is good plain and/or frosted.

title: Dinner Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli cauliflower lettuce and tomatoes. Place the vegetables in a large mixing bowl. Grate carrots and add to vegetable mixture. Stir in cheese and meat. If adding the hard-boiled eggs slice them and mix into vegetables. Mix with Miracle Whip and refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with crackers or toast.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Press cookie dough in greased pizza pan. Bake and cool. Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Spread on crust. Layer fruits and top with cherry pie filling.

title: Baked Seafood Rice Salad
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients. Put in shallow 2 quart casserole and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix well and place in a greased casserole dish.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into pie shell. Refrigerate.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix together pecan pieces and coconut. Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan. Mix box of German chocolate cake mix according to package directions. Spread over nut/coconut mixture.

title: Pineapple Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese and blend with remaining ingredients except pecans. Chill. Roll in chopped pecans just before serving.

title: Cutout Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening and butter. Add sugar then beat in egg. Add salt almond and vanilla extract. Last add flour 1 cup at a time. Place cookies on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 9 minutes or until edges brown.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Finely chop Prosciutto and cook in 4 Tbsp. butter. Cook until crisp (can do ahead and reheat).

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a 9-inch layer pan. Spread butter evenly. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Arrange fruits and nuts in sugar mixture. Mix 1/3 cup butter with granulated sugar until creamy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Mix flour baking powder and salt thoroughly. Add to creamy mixture alternately with pineapple liquid. Spread batter over fruit in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until cake springs back with touched lightly. Cool a few minutes in the pan. Loosen cake from sides of pan and invert on serving plate.

title: German Potato Salad(Kartoffelsalat)
instructions: *The amount of potatoes used for this tangy hot potato salad will determine the number of servings.

title: Peach Crumble Pie
instructions: Line pie shell with plain pastry. Trim; let rest 10 minutes then flute edge. Do not prick. Combine sugar flour salt and cinnamon. Add butter and work with fingertips until crumbly. Add 1/2 of this mixture to the peaches. Mix lightly and turn into pie shell. Sprinkle the rest of the crumbly mixture over top of peaches. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until peaches are cooked. Cool 2 or 3 hours on rack before cutting. Serves 5.

title: Teriyaki Steak Marinade
instructions: Mix together. Pour over meat. Marinate several hours or overnight. Barbecue or broil meat.

title: Creamy Parmesan Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients until smooth. Cover & Chill. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Libby Danti'S Sauce With Sausage
instructions: In a large pot mix tomatoes seasonings wine and water. Stir and simmer 10 minutes. In skillet fry sausage and remove from pan. Leave a small amount of oil in pan. Saute onions and mushrooms. When cool cut sausage in slices. Add to skillet. Stir and simmer 5 minutes. Add to large pot. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and let simmer slowly covered 1 hour. Uncover and continue cooking for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at low heat. If sauce is too thick add more water to your taste. Stir occasionally during cooking.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Combine apples and sugar. Beat eggs with vanilla and oil and mix with apples. Sift flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Combine with apple/egg mixture. Blend in nuts; spoon into an 11 x 14 x 2-inch pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan. Fry sausage crumbled. Press biscuits into bottom of pan until covered. Sprinkle frozen hash brown potatoes over biscuits. Sprinkle sausage over hash browns. Beat eggs real well with a little milk. Pour eggs over mixture. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Aunt Fanny'S Baked Squash
instructions: Wash and cut up squash. Boil until tender. Drain thoroughly then mash. Add all ingredients except 1/2 of the butter to squash. Melt remaining butter. Pour mixture into baking dish then spread melted butter over top and sprinkle with crumbs. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for approximately 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Revival Goulash
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in small amount of oil. Add ground beef; cook until brown. Add soup and cheese. Use 1/2 can of water to rinse can out. Add to drained cooked noodles. Pour into large baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot. Freezes well.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Rice Soup
instructions: Put chicken broth in large pot with vegetable base. Simmer on low. Next add all vegetables and cooked rice. Stir occasionally and cook covered for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

title: Wendy'S 3 Layer Quick Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese; spread in bottom of dish. Add salsa. Sprinkle cheese on top of salsa. Heat in microwave for 1 minute. Serve with tortilla chips. Enjoy!!

title: Chili-Mac Skillet
instructions: Drain kidney beans. In a large skillet cook meat and onion until meat is brown. Drain fat. Stir in beans tomato sauce undrained tomatoes uncooked pasta green chilies chili powder garlic salt and 1/4 cup water. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover. Simmer 20 minutes stirring often. Top with cheese. Cover. Heat 2 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves six.

title: One Pan Chicken And Gravy
instructions: Mix all together the soups and pour over chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked. Any form or amount of chicken may be used.

title: Spiced Beef With Dumplings
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast and melt the fat in a Dutch oven. Brown roast on all sides in the fat. Add 1/4 cup water and the remaining ingredients except biscuits parsley and flour. Cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours. Place biscuits on roast and sprinkle with parsley. Cover tightly and steam for 15 minutes. Remove roast and dumplings to platter. Add flour and 1/4 cup water to pan juices. Stir until thickened. Serve with roast.

title: Cousin Sallie'S Gingerbread
instructions: Sift flour with baking soda salt and spices. Combine shortening sugar and molasses in mixing bowl and beat to blend. Add eggs; beat until thoroughly blended. Add dry ingredients beat until smooth. All vinegar and milk and stir until thoroughly blended. Pour into greased 9 x 9 inch pan. Bake at 350 degrees 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Slaw Dressing
instructions: Mix sugar flour mustard vinegar sour cream and eggs together. Cook slightly. Stir constantly until dressing is creamy.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Rinse and drain rice sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour 1 c. tomato juice over rice then sprinkle with the onion pepper and celery (if wanted). Then the meat water and 1 1/2 c. tomato juice. Cut the bacon in 1/2 and put on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0F for 1 hour. Uncover and bake for another 1/2 hour or until bacon is crisp.

title: Whole Wheat Bubble Loaf
instructions: Generously grease one 2 qt. deep casserole dish or two 8 x 4 in. loaf pans. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine 1 c. bread flour sugar salt and yeast - blend well. In small sauce pan heat milk and margarine until very warm (120 to 130 degrees). Add warm liquid and egg to flour mixture. Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at med. speed. By hand stir in whole wheat flour to form a stiff dough. On floured surface knead in 1 to 1 1/2 c. bread flour until dough is smooth and elastic about 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel. Let rise in a warm place until light and doubled in size about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: London Broil
instructions: Combine wine soy sauce garlic ginger and parsley in baking dish. Marinate meat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Broil for 30 to 35 minutes at 550\u00b0 turning every 5 minutes. Baste with mixture at each turn.

title: Hot Dog Hash
instructions: Combine potatoes and onion. Sprinkle on flour salt and pepper. Add milk and hot dogs. Put in shallow baking dish. Dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 425\u00b0. Top with cheese until melted.

title: Chocolate Heaven
instructions: Combine flour oleo and nuts and press in thin layer into 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Let cool then let chill in refrigerator. Combine softened cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread evenly over chilled crust and return to refrigerator. Mix instant pudding with milk and vanilla. Beat until thick and spread over cream cheese mixture. Chill. Top with remainder of Cool Whip. Will keep 4 to 5 days in refrigerator.

title: Party Sandwiches
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add ham and Swiss cheese. Split rolls and fill with mixture. Wrap in foil and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Makes 48 sandwiches.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Boil cream butter and sugar for 5 minutes (start time when bubbling). Then add marshmallow cream and then add other ingredients. The strained prunes make this very creamy. Let set for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Dip each tortilla in hot grease just to soften. On each tortilla put some chicken onion and cheese. Roll up and place in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been sprayed with nonstick spray. Mix the soup milk and chilies and pour over the enchiladas. Top with additional onions and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Green Rice Casserole
instructions: Place all ingredients in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar oil and room temperature buttermilk. Stir together well (be sure oil is well blended when adding flour). Add 4 cups flour and mix well. Then add 5 cups flour (more if needed) salt baking powder and soda; mix well. Dough is ready to bake. Seal mixture in an airtight container and refrigerate!

title: Thai Ribbons
instructions: Soak 30 (6-inch) bamboo skewers. Combine teriyaki sauce ginger oil garlic and red pepper. Cut steak across grain into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place meat in plastic bag. Pour marinade over steak and marinate in bag up to 2 hours. Thread slices on bamboo skewers. Place on rack in broiler pan 3 to 4-inches from heat. Broil 2 minutes on each side. Sprinkle with sesame seed. (Can substitute chicken or pork.)

title: Fresh Vegetable Marinate
instructions: Remove flowerets from broccoli cut into bite-size pieces. Break cauliflower into flowerets. Combine broccoli and cauliflower with mushrooms pepper and celery. Toss lightly. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well and pour over vegetables. Chill and serve.

title: Pickled Cukes
instructions: Soak cukes in lime water overnight (cover). Drain and wash 3 times in cold water. Soak 2 hours in salt water. Drain and wash 3 times in cold water. Dissolve alum in warm water. Add enough cold water to cover cukes. Add cukes and bring to a boil. Drain and wash 3 times in cold water. Mix sugar vinegar and spices. Add cukes and bring to a boil turn down heat and simmer 30 minutes. Pack in hot jars. Yield 12 pints.

title: Peanut Butter Temptations
instructions: Mix all ingredients but peanut butter cups. Roll into balls. Place in greased T-cup tins. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Take out of oven; insert peanut butter cups immediately. Let cool.\tRemove from tins.

title: Chocolate Caramel Pecan Fudge
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat melt chocolate chips with milk and salt. Remove from heat; stir in nuts caramel topping and vanilla. Spread evenly in a foil-lined 8 or 9 inch pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off foil and cut into squares. Makes about 2 pounds.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Mix and form into ball and chill.

title: Potato Onion Casserole
instructions: In a 9X13 baking dish layer onions potatoes Velveeta. Repeat onions and potatoes. Salt and pepper. Pour soup over all and top with grated cheese. (soup may be diluted with 1/3 cup milk.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Test potatoes for doneness.

title: Pull Apart Cake (Breakfast Or Brunch)
instructions: Make night before. Cover with plastic wrap to allow dough to thaw and rise. Leave on counter overnight and bake in the morning. Grease Bundt or angel food cake pan. Sprinkle some of the pecans and all the granulated sugar in pan. Place frozen dough balls evenly on top of pecans and sugar. Sprinkle cinnamon and pudding evenly on top. Melt brown sugar and butter together and spoon over dough. (Do not pour over dough.) Add remaining pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Allow to set for 10 minutes before removing from pan. Flip rolls onto a serving dish.

title: Hamburger And Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger. Sprinkle with garlic salt chili powder salt and pepper. Put beans in casserole dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar Worcestershire and ketchup. Stir. Add hamburger and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Pot Roast
instructions: In a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven brown roast. Drain off fat. Add water bouillon oregano basil bay leaves garlic and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer covered 25 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are done.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Brown beef. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour into casserole. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolatetown Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry shell; set aside. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In small mixer bowl cream butter; add eggs and vanilla. Combine sugar and flour; add to creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts; pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until golden. Cool about 1 hour. Serve warm. Garnish with whipped cream.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix all together with mixer and fold in 1/2 cup nuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Cut up and add the cream cheese to the meat; stir until melted. Add the mushroom soup and 1 can of water to the mixture. (Use less water if desired.) Heat through until well blended and hot. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Divinity Candy
instructions: Combine water and sugar. Boil to 265\u00b0 (hard ball stage). Beat egg whites stiff and gradually beat into boiling syrup. Whip until it begins to stiffen. Add vanilla and nuts. Drop on wax paper. Makes about 150 pieces.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch cake pan with butter (very heavily). Sprinkle pecans and coconut in pan. Mix cake mix as usual. Add sugar cream cheese butter and vanilla to cake mix. Mix and pour in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let cool.

title: Oven Apple Pancakes
instructions: With whisk or beater beat eggs milk salt and flour until smooth. Let the batter rest. Combine the sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over the apples; toss to mix. Generously butter two 9 inch pie pans using about 2 Tbsp. for each pan. Divide apples evenly between the pans. Stir the batter and pour it over the apples using 1 c. per pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 30-40 minutes or until pancakes are fluffed golden brown and set. Serve hot in wedges topped with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and chilies. Mix well. Pour 1/2 corn mixture into a greased long casserole dish. Sprinkle chilies over mixture. Top with 1/2 cheese. Repeat corn mixture and cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 until set about 45 minutes. It thickens some as it cools.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Add sugar to butter and heat. Add eggs one at a time. Add coconut vinegar and vanilla. Stir well and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad(For Large Gathering)
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain and let cool. Cut cheese tomatoes cucumbers and bell peppers in little cubes. Mix this with cooled macaroni relish and Miracle Whip to taste. (Original recipe did not list quantities or ingredients.)

title: Winter Vegetable Chowder
instructions: In small bowl cover tomatoes with boiling water; let stand 5 minutes. In large saucepan over medium-high heat bring broth and 1/2 cup water to boil. Add potatoes; return to boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 12 minutes or just until tender. With slotted spoon remove 1 cup potatoes; set aside. Transfer contents of saucepan to blender; puree until smooth. Pour mixture back into saucepan.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Place apples in a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with the mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Melt the butter in a pot. Add the flour sugar egg and walnuts. Spoon over the apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream. Stir in sour cream just before serving. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In large bowl cream the powdered sugar butter vanilla and egg until light and fluffy. Stir in flour and salt; blend well. Fill cookie press; press dough into desired shapes onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes or until lightly browned on edges. Immediately remove from cookie sheets. Makes approximately 5 dozen cookies.

title: Margaret'S Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding Cool Whip and milk. Layer 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers then with pudding mixture; alternate twice ending with crackers. Pour chocolate sauce over all. Refrigerate.

title: Mom'S Pineapple Millionaire Pie
instructions: Cream powdered sugar and oleo. Add eggs salt and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy. Spread mixture evenly into pie crusts. Then chill. Whip the cream until stiff. Blend in powdered sugar. Fold in pineapple and pecans. Spread over top of base mixture and chill thoroughly.

title: Cauliflower Patties
instructions: Cook cauliflower; drain and mash. Add other ingredients; mix well. Let stand about 1 hour before cooking. Drop by tablespoons into hot oil and cook until golden brown on both sides. Can be frozen and then reheated as you need them.

title: Sausage Squares
instructions: Combine the biscuit mix and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Brown sausage in skillet. Add onion and cook until tender; drain well. Spread sausage mixture over first layer. Combine egg grated cheese and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise. Spread over top of sausage mixture. Press lightly. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cook about 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Alessa'S Cornbread Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix sour cream and mayonnaise. Set aside. Place half of crumbled cornbread in a large bowl. Top with half of beans. In a medium bowl combine tomatoes pepper and onions; layer half of this mixture over beans. Layer half of cheese bacon corn and reserved salad dressing. Repeat layers using remaining ingredients. Garnish as desired.

title: German Apple Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix apples and sugar together. Let stand until sugar is thoroughly dissolved. Add eggs and mix well. Sift dry ingredients together. Stir into apple mixture. Add nuts raisins and vanilla. Pour into 8 X 8 inch pan which is slightly oiled. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 - 45 minutes. If preferred use unsweetened can sliced apples instead of fresh apples.

title: Good N Easy Crawfish Jambalaya
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put in rice cooker. After cooker chimes let jambalaya set on warm for 30 minutes before serving. May use shrimp instead of crawfish.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
instructions: Crush crackers and combine with butter and sugar. Press in bottom and up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan. Combine whipped topping pudding and sour cream. Pour half of filling over crust. Slice bananas and layer on top. Pour remaining filling over bananas then sprinkle chopped pecans over top.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Pour in 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce to 350\u00b0 and finish baking. When it doesnt wiggle in the center it is done or when a knife inserted in the center comes out clean (about 20 to 25 minutes).

title: Copper Carrots
instructions: Scrape carrots. Cut into 1/4-inch diagonal slices. Simmer carrots green pepper and onion in small amount of water over low heat until carrots are tender; drain. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Refrigerate several days before serving.

title: Italian S Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Beat eggs. Add sugar vanilla lemon rind and shortening. Mix into bowl with flour to form a soft dough.

title: Ella Davis' Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter and 10x sugar. Add next 3 ingredients. Roll into balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 14 to 17 minutes. Roll in 10x sugar while warm and again when cool.

title: Chicken Surprise
instructions: Wrap each piece of chicken in a piece of bacon. Put each piece of chicken on 2 slices of dried beef in a casserole dish. Use one so the chicken fits snug in the dish. Mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup sour cream together and spread over chicken. Bake at 250 degrees for 5 hours uncovered.

title: Bourbon Pecan Chicken
instructions: Whisk together mustard sugar bourbon soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Set aside.

title: Cheezy Bacon Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes and cut in small pieces; add margarine and milk. Mix until soupy. Add onions green onions and parsley; mix. Add bacon salt and pepper. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes until perfect consistency. Melt cheese on top for last 5 to 10 minutes. Serves 25.

title: Georgetown Red Rice
instructions: Cook bacon remove from pan and crumble. Cook onions in bacon fat until tender then add red tomatoes rice broth catsup seasonings and crumbled bacon. Cook on low heat until rice is done. Stir several times during cooking.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Heat milk in one pan. Heat tomatoes tomato soup butter flour (mix first in some of the tomatoes) and salt in another pan. When hot add pinch of soda. When both milk and tomato mixture are hot mix together.

title: 5 Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Stir in flavorings. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in a 10-inch tube pan.

title: Lazy Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in baking dish or pan. Mix flour sugar and milk together. Pour over melted margarine. Add vanilla to sweetened fruit. Pour over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wassail(Kids Love It!)
instructions: Cut orange into eighths and pierce with whole cloves. Put all ingredients in a crock-pot. Cover. Cook one hour on high then four hours on low. Makes 12 servings. Can be doubled for a six-quart crock-pot.

title: Cheese Fries
instructions: Bake French fries as directed on package. Fry bacon; pinch into small pieces. When fries are baked pour Ranch dressing on them then add cheese and top with bacon pieces. Place back in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Fresh Corn And Tomatoes With Curry
instructions: Shuck the corn. With knife cut kernels off cobs. There should be about 2 1/2 cups. Core the tomatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes. Melt butter into skillet. Add the scallions and curry powder. Cook stirring briefly until wilted. Add the corn tomatoes salt and pepper. Stir and cook for 4 minutes over medium to high heat. Do not overcook. Serve hot. Sprinkle with coriander. Yields 4 servings.

title: Barbecued Beans
instructions: Chop pepper celery and onion. Cook until done then add pork and beans catsup and brown sugar.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients in punch bowl. Float sherbet in punch.

title: Life'S Recipe
instructions: Mix these thoroughly and add tears of joy sorrow and sympathy for others. Flavor with little gifts and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith to lighten the other ingredients and raise the texture to a great height of Christian living. After pouring all this into your daily life bake well with the heat of human kindness. Serve it with a smile.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello according to directions. Beat in cream cheese. Add pineapple after draining. Add nuts if you want. Sprinkle marshmallow topping on top. Chill until firm. Any flavor of jello and fruit combination could be substituted.

title: Frijoles Ala Charra
instructions: *Add more if desired.

title: Boiled Dressing
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add vinegar lemon juice water butter or oleo. Cook on low heat until thickened stirring. Add beaten yolks and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat. Cool. Refrigerate.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Cream sugar with shortening. Add three eggs one at a time beating between each addition. Add soda salt vanilla cinnamon nutmeg and pumpkin. Add flour and beat well. Cook in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix melted oleo and graham cracker crumbs in a bowl. Then press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch bowl or pan. Combine softened cream cheese (8 ounces and 3 ounces) milk and vanilla in a medium bowl. Beat until smooth. Spread the following in order over crust cream cheese mixture whipped topping and cherry pie filling. Chill several hours. Cut into squares to serve.

title: French Chicken
instructions: Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with rice; add broth plus water if needed. Layer chicken over rice. Mix soup sour cream and poppy seed. Pour over chicken. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beach Party Punch
instructions: Pour all ingredients into punch bowl with ice ring. Garnish with orange slices and cherries.

title: Scalloped Chicken
instructions: Mix first 10 ingredients and put into a greased casserole dish. Cover with 1 can cream of mushroom soup. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour then sprinkle with grated cheese and return to oven for another 10 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on package and drain well. Combine spinach with other ingredients and shape into bite size balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Crab Nibbles
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and microwave until cheese is melted. Spread mixture on muffin halves. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until slightly brown.

title: Great Grandma Lockerbie'S Scones
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in skillet on top of stove slowly until done.

title: Ramen Noodle Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix oil sugar and chicken flavor packet in microwavable bowl for 1 minute in microwave. Add vinegar and stir well. Just before serving mix first 4 ingredients together. Add Ramen noodles by breaking them up in mixture. Do not cook noodles. Pour the dressing mixture over and stir well. Serve immediately.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix in bowl. Roll out between 2 sheets wax paper. Makes 2 crusts.

title: Green Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O as directed on package. When it begins to set add rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Let set. Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise and crackers.

title: Cinnamon Hard Candy
instructions: Cook sugar water corn syrup and food coloring to very hard crack stage (300\u00b0). Add oil of cinnamon; stir slightly to mix in oil. Pour onto well-greased cookie sheet cool. Crack into pieces. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter with 1 cup of milk. Let sugar and remaining milk come to a boil then add other ingredients and stir until thick.

title: Margaret'S Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: In a medium bowl lightly mix ground meat bread crumbs onion 1/2 (4 ounces) tomato sauce egg salt and pepper. Shape into loaf in shallow baking pan. Combine remaining tomato sauce with rest of the ingredients. Pour over loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Baste loaf several times. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Make pudding according to directions. Cool slightly. Pour into cake mix; add eggs and blend well. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle on butterscotch chips and nuts generously. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until done. This is a time saving recipe.

title: Re-Baked Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes and grease with corn oil. Bake for 5 minutes in microwave or 20 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Test with fork for tenderness. Wrap in foil and set aside.

title: Fried Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix Cheddar cheese flour salt and cayenne pepper. Add egg whites. Shape into small balls and roll in fine cracker crumbs. Fry in deep oil at 375\u00b0 until golden. Serve hot.

title: Velveeta Salsa Dip
instructions: Stir Velveeta and salsa in saucepan over low heat until Velveeta is melted. Stir in cilantro. Serve hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers. Makes 3 cups.

title: Shrimp Spread - Blender
instructions: Put onion garlic lemon rind vinegar ginger salt and chili powder in blender jar and blend until finely chopped. Toss in shrimp a few at the time. Mix in sour cream until spreading consistency.

title: Scallops And Parsley Sauce
instructions: Heat butter and oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat until butter is melted. Add scallions and 1/2 cup parsley; cook 5 minutes or until scallions are softened but not burned. Add wine; cook 2 minutes. Add scallops. Reduce heat to low; simmer covered for 4 to 5 minutes or until scallops are opaque. Stir in remaining parsley; season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour over spaghetti; toss gently to mix. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Homemade Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put in freezer filling the rest of the way with milk to fill line.

title: Amish Bread Starter
instructions: Stir every day for 7 days.

title: Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: In a large skillet heat the oil over medium-high heat and saute onion bell pepper and parsley until onion is clear. Stirring add the tomato sauce garlic mint and wine then add rice hot sauce smoked sausage and enough water to cover the rice by about 1 inch. Cook until most of the water is gone. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 1 hour; dont lift the lid until it has been simmering for 45 minutes. This makes a red jambalaya. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Granola
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Add sweet rice syrup ice water and olive oil and mix. Spread in deep oblong baking dish sprayed with Pam. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Add pecans walnuts and almonds. Mix and continue to bake 1/2 hour longer. Add raisins and chopped dates. Mix and cool. Store in Ziploc bags.

title: Oriental Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown beef celery and onions. Drain off excess fat. Mix in mushrooms water chestnuts bamboo shoots and soy sauce. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water; stir in mushroom soup. Add to beef mixture. Stir in rice. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8. Delicious.

title: Meatballs(For Macaroni Sauce)
instructions: Mix ingredients well\tand roll into small meatballs. Let 1/2 wedge of lard or some Crisco melt in frying pan. Put in meatballs let brown on all sides and remove.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in broth. Chop celery and add. When potatoes are almost done add cauliflower and cook until tender. The potatoes must be very well cooked otherwise soup will be gluey.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Put scalded milk in breadcrumbs. Add 4 egg yolks sugar butter and grated rind of lemon. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Beat egg whites into confectioners sugar until stiff. Spread over bread pudding to seal. Set into a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Potato Soup
instructions: In a large pot put potatoes and water. Bring to rolling boil. Add salt pepper celery salt and onion flakes. Simmer for 10 minutes then add butter or margarine. Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Rich Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine syrup margarine and sugar in saucepan. Bring to boil; boil gently 5 minutes uncovered stirring occasionally. Cool slightly. Place pecans in pie shell. Mix eggs vanilla and salt in bowl. Gradually stir in cooled syrup mixture. Pour over pecans in pie shell. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Cheddar Cheese Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan melt margarine. Stir in flour and salt. Add milk. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir for one minute more. Add cheese stir until melted. Makes 2 cups.

title: Unbaked Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
instructions: Boil margarine sugar and milk for 1 1/2 minutes. Pour over remaining ingredients in large bowl. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper. Let cool then refrigerate.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Pack small firm cucumbers in jars. For each jar add 1 button of garlic and 1 umbrella of dill or 1 tablespoon of whole dill seed. Boil water vinegar and salt (not iodize) for 3 minutes. Pour over pickles while hot. (To make sure jars are sealed can put in cold pack for few minutes.) Let stand for 4 to 6 weeks before use.

title: Shrimp Cheese Turnovers
instructions: Cut butter and cream cheese into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Work with hands to form ball. Cover and chill 1 hour. On floured surface roll half into 11-inch circle. Cut into rounds with 2-inch floured cutter. Spread each round with about 1/2 teaspoon of cheese spread. Top with a few shrimp. Fold in half and seal.

title: Special K Bars
instructions: Put the cereal in a large bowl. Bring sugar syrup and oleo to a boil; boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter; stir thoroughly and pour over flakes. Mix. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Once the fat has been removed from the chicken place the chicken in ovenware container. Season. Add lemon juice and the chicken broth. Garnish with paprika. Cover and cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Mix sauce and jelly in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until blended. Add wieners and heat thoroughly.

title: Candied Apple Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry of 2-crust 9-inch pie. Fill bottom shell with apples. Combine next six ingredients. Pour over apples. Cover with top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until crust is brown and apples are tender. Remove from oven.

title: Ugly Duckling Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix fruit cocktail with syrup 1 cup of coconut and eggs in large mixer bowl. Blend then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.

title: Simply Delicious Chicken Broccoli Lasagna(6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Will need a 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with nonstick spray. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Dilled Macaroni And Cheese Salad(Cold)
instructions: Cook macaroni omitting salt. Drain well; rinse in cold water. Combine the next 4 ingredients and the cooked macaroni.

title: Chocolate Filled Bonbons
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar brown sugar vanilla and egg in large bowl at medium speed of electric mixer.

title: Creamy Italian Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender except oil. After all is well blended add oil very slowly. Blend until thick. Delicious.

title: Mil'S Dressing
instructions: Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Double recipe for 4 or more people.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
instructions: Measure by tablespoon teaspoon or cup and mix well.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all together; roll into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
instructions: Mix with hands the first 5 ingredients. Remove 2 cups of crumbs and set aside. Mix remaining crumbs with boiling water molasses and baking soda. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Grape-Nuts Bread
instructions: Soak the Grape-nuts in the buttermilk for 10 minutes. Combine other ingredients; beat well. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before putting in oven. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0 in loaf pan.

title: Dolly Parton'S Soup
instructions: Cook cabbage celery onion and carrots until tender in the least amount of water possible. Then add tomatoes or juice and bouillon cubes. Simmer until well done.

title: Easy Refrigerator Dough
instructions: Measure water and yeast into bowl; stir to dissolve. Stir in sugar salt oil and eggs. Mix until dough is soft. Do not knead. Cover with damp cloth; place in refrigerator. Let set at least 2 hours. About 1 to 1 1/2 hours before baking shape into rolls. Cover; let rise until doubled in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done. This dough will keep in the fridge for about 5 days. Just keep the cloth covering it damp.

title: Golden Glazed Ham With Cherry Sauce
instructions: Place ham fat side up on a rack in shallow pan. Heat in a 325\u00b0 oven for time indicated on label. One-half hour before end of time remove ham from oven and score fat in diamonds.

title: Cherry Swish
instructions: Mix together Cool Whip cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla. Pour 1/2 of mixture into each pie shell. Pour 1/2 pie filling on top of each mixture and swish around until white shows through making swirls. Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: 30 Minute Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Put water cocoa and oleo in pan and bring to boil; pour over flour and sugar. Mix well. Add eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 20 minutes until done. Frost while hot.

title: Maple Flavored Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease (with extra amount of softened butter) and lightly flour a 10-inch tube pan. Set aside. Combine the butter and cream cheese in a large mixing bowl. Beat mixture with an electric mixer until well blended and creamy for 2 minutes. Gradually add sugar while continuing to beat on medium speed. Beat until the mixture is light and fluffy for 6 to 8 minutes. Add the eggs one at a time beating after the addition of each egg until it is thoroughly absorbed. Sift together the flour salt and baking powder. Slowly add this combination to the egg mixture blending well. Stir in the coconut flavoring and vanilla flavoring then the flaked coconut. Beat well for 1 minute.

title: Oven Fries
instructions: Cut potato into quarters lengthwise and dry with a paper towel. Coat all over with the oil. Sprinkle with salt pepper and garlic powder. Place in a nonstick pan or a Pam sprayed pan and bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Egg Drop Soup
instructions: In large saucepan boil chicken broth and onions. String beaten egg while stirring. Add salt and pepper. Add cornstarch mixture to thicken. Continue to boil until thickened. Add corn if desired. Serve in bowls. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix sugar vinegar oil salt and pepper; heat until sugar dissolves. Let cool. Add peas corn celery onion green pepper and pimiento. Let chill overnight.

title: Peanut Butter No Bakes
instructions: Mix oleo sugar milk and salt in saucepan. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter vanilla and oatmeal. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Marinade For Deer
instructions: Mix in bowl; marinate the deer for 20 minutes to overnight.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers and chop nuts. Combine with sugar and cocoa. Stir in corn syrup and rum. Wet hands and form mixture into balls (small). Roll in chocolate sprinkles. Freeze on flat tray. When firm put into container.

title: Rich And Charlie'S Salad
instructions: Marinate 3 hours. Add one large head of lettuce. Sprinkle on more Parmesan cheese.

title: Chocolate Bubble Biscuits
instructions: In large bowl combine flour 1/4 cup sugar baking powder and salt. Using pastry blender or 2 knives cut in 1/3 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in chocolate chips. Add milk; stir until dough holds a shape. On floured board knead dough lightly. Roll dough into 16 balls.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Cut apples into chunks but do not peel. In a glass or stainless steel kettle combine apples and cider. Cover and cook over medium-high heat until apples are very soft about 30 minutes. Press through a food mill or fine sieve and return to the cleaned pot. Stir in sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Simmer over low heat stirring occasionally until very thick about 2 hours. Cool to room temperature then refrigerate or freeze.

title: Divinity
instructions: Place sugar syrup and water in saucepan over low heat. Stir until sugar is dissolved then cook without stirring to 252\u00b0 (a little dropped into cold water forms a hard ball). Remove from heat and pour beating constantly in a fine stream into 2 egg whites stiffly beaten. Continue beating until mixture holds its shape and loses its gloss. Add vanilla and broken nuts. Drop quickly from tip of spoon onto wax paper or spread in\tgreased shallow pan and cut into squares when firm.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking soda ginger and baking powder and sift together. Mix salt egg orange juice butter and water together. Add the dry ingredients and mix well. Add the nuts and cranberries to the mixture. Pour into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until the tester inserted in middle of loaf comes out dry.

title: Creamy Chocolate Squares
instructions: Cream confectioners sugar and cream cheese in bowl until light and fluffy. Blend in chocolate and vanilla. Add walnuts; mix well. Pour into buttered 8-inch dish. Chill until firm. Cut into squares. Yield 2 pounds.

title: Shrimp Provencale
instructions: About 45 minutes before serving in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat in 2 tablespoons of oil cook shrimp stirring often about 3 minutes until shrimp turn pink; set aside. In same skillet add 1 tablespoon of oil. Add mushrooms; cook until tender about 3 minutes. Add tomatoes lemon juice salt and pepper. Cook 3 minutes more. Return shrimp to skillet. Heat through. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with rice.

title: Chowder
instructions: Cook hen  beef and bacon in 1/2 gallon of water for 2 hours. Then add onions carrots cabbage green beans and tomatoes. Cook 1 1/2 hours. Then add potatoes sugar salt and pepper. Cook 1 1/2 hours. Then add corn and cook at least 15 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 to 3 gallons. It sticks very easily so cook over low heat and stir often.

title: Cheese Salsa Dip
instructions: Microwave cheese and picante sauce in a 1 1/2 quart microwavable bowl on High for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted stirring after 3 minutes. Stir in cilantro. Serve hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers. Yield 3 cups.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle on onions towards end. Makes 10 servings.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients adding eggs one at a time. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Chili
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat in hot salad oil cook turkey onion and garlic until all pan juices evaporate and turkey is well browned stirring frequently. Stir in chili powder and cook 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes with their liquid water salt sugar and crushed red pepper. Over high heat heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low.
