Simmer uncovered 10 minutes to blend flavors. Gently stir in kidney beans and heat through.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan with margarine. Put coconut and pecans in margarine covered pan. Mix cake mix as directions instruct. Pour cake mix over pecan mixture. Soften cream cheese and 1 stick of margarine. Mix the powdered sugar with enough milk to make a thin cake icing. Now mix cream cheese mixture and powdered sugar. Pour over cake mix. Now bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Cake is done when cracks appear in cake.

title: Mushrooms And Steak
instructions: Cut steak into 4 servings. Melt butter in skillet; add Worcestershire sauce basil and tarragon. Place steaks in skillet. Cook 5 minutes on both sides. Remove to warmed platter. Cover with foil. Place mushrooms in skillet. Add wine salt and pepper. Saute until mushrooms are cooked. In a small bowl toss cheese with flour and stir in with mushrooms. Cook until cheese is melted. Pour over steaks. Great with potatoes (baked) and salad. This is so easy and great.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar together. Beat until smooth. Add pineapple juice and all and sprinkle salt and soda over top of pineapple. Add the flour and mix real good. Empty into greased baking dish and sprinkle brown sugar and nuts over top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: In a bowl combine oatmeal flour sugar and cinnamon. Mix in butter. Peel core and slice apples in a greased 8-inch round pan. Sprinkle topping mixture on apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Slice pepperoni into cubes 1/8-inch thick. Shred Mozzarella. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Using a roller apply flour on surface. Roll dough into a diamond shape; 6 x 6-inch wide starting at the smallest point. Add pepperoni and Mozzarella (small portions at a time). Roll over and continue adding then rolling pinching each end. After roll is completed spread egg white over roll with paper towel. Bake on cookie sheet 15 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Round Steak Bake
instructions: Place steak on foil and sprinkle soup mix on steak. Place potatoes evenly over steak and pour mushrooms with liquid over potatoes and steak. Wrap foil tightly. Bake 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
instructions: Slice steak in narrow strips. Brown steak in 2 tablespoons oil. Combine with garlic salt pepper soy sauce and sugar for 6 to 8 hours in crock-pot on low. Turn to high and add vegetables. Dissolve 1 tablespoon cornstarch in 2 tablespoons cold water. Stir into pot. Cook on high 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Chicken Fajita Sandwiches
instructions: Combine lime juice garlic cumin and red pepper seasoning in medium-size bowl. Add chicken. Refrigerate covered for 30 to 60 minutes.

title: Almond Potato Puffs
instructions: Combine the water and butter in small saucepan and bring to boil over high heat. Remove from heat; add flour all at once and beat until smooth. Add egg blending thoroughly. Let cool. Add potatoes to flour-egg mixture and blend well. Season to taste with salt pepper and nutmeg. Flour hands lightly shape mixture into tablespoon-size balls. Roll balls in chopped nuts. Pour oil into a deep fryer or large saucepan and heat to 375\u00b0. Fry balls in batches until golden about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot. Yield 2 servings.

title: Cranberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple juice and dissolve Jell-O. Stir well. Add cranberry sauce and mix well. Add pineapple and oranges. Mix well and pour into Jell-O mold. Chill.

title: Pork Chops And Kraut
instructions: In casserole dish arrange pork chops in a single layer. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover pork chops with layer of sauerkraut. Cover casserole with aluminum foil. Bake in slow oven 200\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours or until chops are fork-tender.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream the shortening. Add sugar egg and molasses. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Chill at least 2 hours. (You may chill overnight or longer.) Roll in balls the size of a small walnut. Dip the tops of the balls in the 2 tablespoons sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon mixture and place about 3-inches apart on greased (sprayed) cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Butterscotch Crunch Squares(Frozen Dessert)
instructions: Combine flour oats and sugar. Cut in butter until mix resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in nuts. Pat mix into 13 x 9 inch pan and bake in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes. Stir while warm to crumble and then cool.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Place sliced strawberries in jello; congeal overnight. Mix Cool Whip sour cream and pineapple. Spread over jello. Top with chopped pecans. Chill again until firm.

title: Blond Brownies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients and add nuts. Melt butter and mix in brown sugar egg and vanilla. Add flour mixture to butter mixture and mix well. Spread in square baking pan and sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Soda Cracker Candy
instructions: Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Line aluminum foil with a single layer of crackers. In a saucepan combine margarine with brown sugar. Stir and let come to a low boil. Let mixture low boil for about 1-2 minutes. Pour mixture over the crackers. Quickly and carefully spread. Bake 5 minutes at 400 degrees. Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Refrigerate. When very cool break apart. Remove from foil.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together with mixer. Blend in brown sugar and Kahlua. Stir in peanuts and chill. Serve with fresh fruit apple and pear wedges strawberries or banana chunks.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown round steak (cut into thin slices) in hot oil. Remove meat. Cook onion and mushrooms until golden. Stir remaining ingredients except sour cream. Return meat to pan. Simmer about 1 hour or until tender. Gradually stir in sour cream. Heat to almost boiling. Serve over wild rice or noodles. Serves 6.

title: Spanish Sauce
instructions: Simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Cold Pizza
instructions: Press crescent rolls on large baking sheet and bake according to directions. Cool. Spread rest of ingredients on cooled crust. Add shredded cheese green pepper and onion. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Donna'S Dessert
instructions: Break angel food into pieces and place in bottom of 15 x 12-inch pan. Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth then add Cool Whip. Make 3 packages Jell-O with 2 1/2 cups boiling water adding frozen berries after Jell-O is dissolved.

title: Sean'S Favorite Cranberry Pie
instructions: Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Layer with cranberries and apple. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Beat egg until thick; slowly add 1/2 cup of sugar flour and melted butter until blended well. Pour egg mixture over cranberry mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together and chill several hours before serving. Excellent as stuffing in a loaf of pumpernickel bread.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix by package directions. Pour 2 cups batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan; bake 15 minutes. In a heavy saucepan over low heat melt caramels and margarine. Remove from heat. Add sweetened condensed milk. Mix well. Spread caramel over cake. Spread remaining batter over caramel mixture. Top with nuts. Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Cool.

title: Crumb-Coated Chicken
instructions: In small bowl beat together eggs butter and salt. In shallow dish place crumbs. Coat chicken with crumbs then egg mixture and crumbs again. In 2 qt. oblong glass baking dish arrange chicken with meatiest pieces to outside edges of dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave 13 to 16 minutes. Power level high (10)

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cut up potatoes and boil. Add salt pepper vinegar and oil to warm potatoes. Let cool and add remaining ingredients.

title: Stew Beef With Gravy
instructions: Roll stew beef in flour. Heat oil and brown stew beef. When well browned place in saucepan and add Worcestershire sauce and Texas Pete. Cover with water. Cover and simmer until tender. Delicious served with mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil. Set aside to cool. Mix vegetables with kraut. Pour liquid over mixture. Let set in refrigerator for 24 hours. Keeps a long time.

title: Marinated Mushrooms And Veggies
instructions: In saucepan combine vinegar oil onion garlic 1 teaspoon salt sugar basil oregano and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Bring to a boil; simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl. Pour hot marinade over veggies. Stir; chill several hours stirring occasionally. Drain before serving. Serve in lettuce lined bowl. Makes 7 cups. Great Thanksgiving dish.

title: Fruit-Cookie Pizza
instructions: Roll out cookie dough and place on a baking pan. Bake according to pkg directions. Set aside. Mix cream cheese and sugar together and spread over cookie slice fruit and layer on top of cheese mixture. Garnish with pecans and cool whip.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Beat margarine until smooth. Add sugar and blend well. Add eggs one at a time blending well. Add vanilla. Sift flour and soda together. Slowly add flour until all ingredients are blended well. Add sour cream and blend. Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes then turn down to 300\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes. Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Green Beans And Potatoes
instructions: Empty beans into crock-pot. Add drained potatoes onion and bacon. Cook on high for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf Deluxe
instructions: Mix together and form a loaf. Bake 30 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: 7 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all together except sour cream and sugar. Now add sour cream and sugar. Mix well and chill.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes sugar eggs milk vanilla and butter. Add coconut and nuts. Pour into a buttered dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Cover sweet potato mixture with marshmallows. Put back in oven long enough to brown and melt marshmallows.

title: Ice Cream Sodas
instructions: Place flavoring or fruit in a tall glass; add sugar.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar corn syrup pumpkin and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Heat sugar salt oil and vinegar until mixture boils and turns clear (until sugar melts). Pour over cabbage mixture; do not stir. Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Blend shortening and sugar then add eggs and molasses. Mix flour salt soda and spices. Add to creamed mixture. Add raisins and chill 25 to 30 minutes. Roll into balls and dip top into sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet. Place 1 drop of water on top of sugar on each cookie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Wilted Spinach Salad
instructions: In 3-quart casserole snip bacon into 1 inch pieces. Cover with paper towel. Microwave at High (10) 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. With slotted spoon place bacon on paper towels to drain. To bacon drippings add vinegar sugar salt pepper and tarragon. Microwave at High (10) 2 to 3 minutes until mixture boils. Stir in celery and onion. Gradually add spinach to hot dressing tossing to coat each piece. Add crumbled bacon orange segments and cashews. Toss again lightly. Serve immediately. Total Microwave Cooking Time 4 to 6 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in skin and cool. Remove skin and shred coarsely. Mix potatoes and cheese in greased 9 x 13-inch pan or large casserole. Cook onion in 1/4 cup butter until soft. Mix with sour cream and celery soup. Pour over potatoes and mix well. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine oil eggs water and pumpkin; sift together next six ingredients. Gradually beat into first mixture; stir in cherries and nuts.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate and paraffin until smooth. Shape into balls. Melt chocolate and paraffin over low heat. Cool slightly. Dip (toothpick works best) peanut butter balls into chocolate and paraffin. Place on waxed paper to harden.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix and spread over cooked pork roast ribs chicken or whatever you wish to barbecue. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stripe-It-Rich-Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan. Remove from oven. Poke holes once down through the cake to the pan with the round handle of a wooden spoon. Holes should be 1-inch apart. If you dont have wooden spoon you may use a plastic drinking straw using a turning motion to make large holes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes 15 minutes and drain. Cool and cube. Chop onion. Cut up Velveeta cheese. Mix with mayonnaise and cubed potatoes. Spray baking dish with Pam. Spread mixture into baking dish. Sprinkle bacon bits on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Taco Dip Ambrosino
instructions: Cream together with a fork cream cheese and cottage cheese until blended. Layer mixture in bottom of a glass pie plate or serving bowl/plate. Add layer of taco sauce vegetables and Cheddar. Alternate layers until supplies are exhausted. Finish with Cheddar and garnish with parsley. Serve with taco chips to scoop.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cranberries and sugar; this mixture should drain overnight in a colander in the refrigerator. Dispose of juice. Mix cranberry mixture with grapes and pecans. Beat 1/2 pint of whipping cream; add sugar to taste. Mix with cranberries. Makes a festive salad. Delicious when served with turkey.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix the oleo or butter and sugar together until creamy by hand or mixer. Add the eggs cream of tartar vanilla and soda. Mix until well blended. Add the flour one cup at a time blending well after each addition. Roll into small balls and press with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes in a heavy pan or 10 minutes on a cookie sheet. Make sure the cookie sheets are cool and cleaned before putting more cookies on them. The dough may be chilled for awhile or overnight to make it easier to handle.

title: Spring Breakfast Strata
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs; add milk mustard basil and salt. Gently stir in remaining ingredients until well mixed. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or over night. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage celery seed pepper sugar vinegar sour cream and mayonnaise in a large bowl. Mix well chill.

title: Old Fashioned Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes until done and add salt while cooking. When tender drain all water off of potatoes; add butter mustard and mayonnaise. Mix with mixer on low speed. Add remaining chopped boiled eggs diced onion and diced dill pickles. Stir together and really enjoy.

title: Russian Teacakes
instructions: Mix butter sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Measure flour by sifting. Blend flour and salt; stir into butter mixture. Mix in nuts. Chill at least 2 hours. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes while still warm. Roll in powdered sugar. Cool and roll in sugar again. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt the Hershey bar over low heat. Blend into Cool Whip. Pour mixture into the pie crust. Put in refrigerator and chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Mackerel Potato Cakes
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except fat. Put fat in pan and drop cakes in hot pan. Fry.

title: Creamy Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cut shrimp into halves or fourths. Cover and refrigerate. Mix cream cheese sour cream and lemon juice until smooth. Add onions and seasonings; mix well. Stir in shrimp and gradually add mayonnaise to give good dipping consistency. Cover and chill 2 or 3 hours before serving. Serve with crackers and sturdy chips.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: In large bowl combine chicken rice and celery. Add soup mayonnaise onions and water chestnuts. Put in a large uncovered casserole. Top with corn flakes that have been mixed with 1/2 stick melted margarine and almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10. Can be frozen. Freeze unbaked. Bring to room temperature before baking.

title: Ashley'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Stir in all other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake in slow oven at 275\u00b0 for about an hour.

title: Zucchini Bread(Julie'S Favorite)
instructions: Beat eggs until light\tand fluffy. Add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Mix\tlightly but well. Add remaining ingredients mix until blended. Add nuts.\tPut in greased and floured loaf pans.\tMakes 2. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Caramel-Chocolate Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix (dry) melted butter nuts and 1/3 cup Pet milk. Stir by hand. Put 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan; bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0 (ungreased). Combine caramel and 1/3 cup milk. Melt in double boiler. Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mix. Pour melted caramel over chocolate chips. Pour remainder of cake dough over mix. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Pie Crust Supreme
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Add water vinegar and egg all at once to the dry ingredients. Mix. Roll as usual.

title: S'More Gorp
instructions: In a large bag mix the ingredients. Then shake well. This recipe gives you the same Smore flavor without the trouble of roasting the marshmallows and other things.

title: Toasted Pecans
instructions: Measure pecans in a small bowl. Mix vinegar and sugar; pour over pecans and stir to coat thoroughly. Let stand 15 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Place pecans in a shallow baking dish and bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Add melted butter to pecans stir and allow to bake for another 5 minutes.

title: Coconut Pecan Balls
instructions: Mix sugar pecans coconut. Add milk margarine. Mix and roll into balls. Refrigerate to harden. Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler or on very low heat. Dip each ball and place on waxed paper to cool.

title: Butter Rolls
instructions: Use your favorite biscuit dough. Roll out like for jelly roll. Sprinkle with sugar. Cut butter up; put on top. Roll up in rolls; prick with fork. Put rolls in an 8 x 8-inch Pyrex bowl. Pour milk over rolls; milk should almost cover rolls. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until brown. Makes about 3 rolls.

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix shortening sugar butter egg and vanilla in a bowl. Stir in flour baking soda and salt. Add chocolate chips and peanut butter chips. Drop spoonfuls of dough onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake about 10 to 13 minutes or until cookies are golden. Cool.

title: Strawberries(Using Dry Jello)
instructions: Combine milk coconut one box of jello almonds sugar and vanilla. Mix well then hand-shape to form strawberries. Roll berries in other box of jello to coat thoroughly. Set to dry. Pipe green icing on berries to form leaf and stems.

title: Bea'S Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
instructions: Blend cheese and oleo. Add flour and paprika. Take 1 teaspoon of the mixture and wrap around an olive. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. May be prepared early and frozen before baking.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over very low heat for about 30 minutes or until rice is tender and milk is absorbed. Stir mixture occasionally. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Gradually stir about 1/4 of hot rice mixture into egg mixture. Add remaining egg mixture to remaining rice. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Serve warm or cold with fruit or raisins.

title: No Bake Snow Drop Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy. Add sugar very gradually; beat until stiff. Fold in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoons in mounds on baking sheet. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven and turn oven off. Leave 3 hours to overnight.

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Cook rhubarb until tender about 20 minutes. Add the jello and mix well (any flavor may be used). Add sugar with rhubarb.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in saucepan. Let boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add next 5 ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Drop on wax paper. Let cool.

title: Chip Dip
instructions: Cook hamburger and drain. Mix remaining ingredients. Cook until cheese melted. Serve with Doritos or other chips.

title: Sweet Onion Pie
instructions: Saute onion in butter until soft. Mix flour with cold milk until there are no lumps. Add eggs salt pepper and cheese. Add onion and mix well. Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 minutes until brown bake at 350 degrees.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in 2 layers. In punch bowl crumble 1st layer of cake.

title: Cherry Tart
instructions: Mix prepared cheese cake fillings and packages of cream cheese together and set aside. Take melted margarine and pour over both crusts. Put one half of the margarine on each crust. Put a cup of pecans in the bottom of each crust then divide the cheese cake and cream cheese mixture between the two pies. Pour over the pecans. Pour cherry pie filling over each pie then top with Cool Whip.\tChill and serve.

title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cream shortening then add sugar and egg. Stir in one-half of the flour then the milk and then the remaining flour. Stir in oats and raisins. Drop onto lightly greased cookie sheet and bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Cheese Casserole
instructions: Saute zucchini and chopped onion in oil. Whip cottage cheese with basil and oregano in blender. Place alternating layers of zucchini cottage cheese and tomatoes in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet brown chops. Drain on absorbent paper. In buttered oblong baking dish arrange chops potatoes and mushrooms on top. In a small bowl combine water and soup mix. Pour over other ingredients in baking dish.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Put tater tots in bottom of pan. Brown ground chuck drain. Put over tots. Pour soup in layers over ground chuck in any order. Spread cheese and put over soup. Bake at 350 degrees until bubbly about 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli flowerets into smaller than bite-size pieces. Cut off tough outer layer of stalks and chop the tender part into small pieces. You need 8 cups of broccoli. (Do this the day before and store in plastic bag.) Saute bacon until crisp. Slice onion lengthwise. In large bowl combine the broccoli onion and raisins and bacon. In small bowl mix together mayonnaise sugar vinegar and pepper. Combine dressing with the vegetables; refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving. Top with sunflower seeds.

title: Quick Taco Salad
instructions: Step 1 In a large skillet brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Remove from skillet. Set aside.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Double recipe makes 3 pies.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Extract juice from strawberries. Combine dry ingredients for cake then add others. Pour into greased pans. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Delight(Large Portion)
instructions: Take the cubed steak and set it into the pan (with Crisco) on medium-low. While steak is cooking chop the veggies into fine pieces and place them in a bowl (with the cheese). When the meat is done put it in with the veggies. Put the whole jar of Ragu into the pan (simmer with a little bit of water).

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter add egg and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Sift dry ingredients together and stir into first mixture. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Divide dough in half and roll out on lightly floured pastry sheet. Roll thin but thick enough to pick up the design in the cookie cutters. Dip cutter in flour before each cutting. Cut as many cookies from each rolling as possible. The least amount of working with the dough gives the best cookie. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until delicately golden.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat for 3 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Dissolve all ingredients except beets; bring to boil. Add diced or sliced beets until warm. Put in sterile bottles and seal. Cold pack 10 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine the sugar cornstarch jello lemon juice and water. Cook until it becomes thick stirring occasionally. Allow to cool. Put berries in pie shell; pour thickened mixture on top. Chill for at least 3 hours. Serve with whipped topping; garnish with halves or whole berries.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole dish coarsely crumble crackers to cover bottom of dish. Layer asparagus over crackers; slice Velveeta cheese and layer over asparagus then cover with about 1/2 can of mushroom soup. Alternate layers until all ingredients are used. End with a fine layer of cracker crumbs on top. For more moisture you can add 1 or 2 tablespoons of the juice from the asparagus. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Ritz Cracker Dessert
instructions: Beat egg whites stiff and add sugar; then add baking powder vanilla pecans and crackers. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. When cool prepare Dream Whip as directed on box. Mix with cream cheese and pineapple and spread over dessert; refrigerate. Will keep several days.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Blend all ingredients in bottom of an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Add chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 8 to 10 hours. Turn at least once in marinade. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Baste with pan juices and serve over rice.

title: Apricot-Blueberry Coffee Cake(A Favorite Of Family And Friends)
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding eggs oil and sour cream; beat well by hand; add blueberries and apricots. Combine sugar cinnamon and nuts; set aside. Grease and flour a tube pan. Pour 1/2 of the cake mixture into pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the sugar-cinnamon mixture. Add the remaining cake mixture then the remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

title: Crab Treats
instructions: Combine cheese milk onion Worcestershire lemon juice and spices. Stir in crab. Halve English muffins with a fork. Cut halves into fourths and pile each wedge high with crab mixture. Place on baking sheet; dust with paprika and broil until lightly browned and bubbly. Makes about 40.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix together first three ingredients then add the coconut pecans and raisins. Stir well then add vinegar. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 40 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Ham Sauce
instructions: Blend cornstarch mustard and salt into ham drippings. Add water sugar and raisins. Cook and stir until clear and slightly thickened. Blend into vinegar and lemon juice. Makes 3 cups.

title: 24-Hour Salad
instructions: Make 24 hours before serving. Use large casserole or large glass pan. Shred or tear lettuce into dish approximately 1/3 full. Layer on top of the following (do not stir) green peas green pepper celery red onion. Frost entire top with the following mixture mayonnaise sour cream and sugar. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Right before serving sprinkle with bacon.

title: Glazed Waverly Crackers
instructions: Line cookie sheet 12 x 16-inch with Waverly crackers and sprinkle about 1/2 cup pecans on top of crackers. Boil sugar and oleo for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Do not overbake. Remove crackers from cookie sheet while still hot.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat peanut butter cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add sugar and milk; fold in whipped topping. Pour into the crust. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours. Remove from the freezer just before serving. Garnish with peanuts and chocolate curls if desired. Yield 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together with a whisk. Brush on meats or poultry last 20 minutes of cooking or grilling.

title: Kim'S Corned Beef Hash
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes chop into wedges and place in microwave safe dish. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Add butter to potatoes last few minutes in microwave. Cook bacon remove from grease and brown onions. Add to potatoes along with corned beef place on top and do not stir. Cook until done.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Put in saucepan the flour salt cream of tartar and cooking oil. Add the boiling water. Cook until it sticks together and is doughy.

title: Cioppino
instructions: Thaw fish if frozen. Cut fish into 1-inch pieces. In a large saucepan cook green onion onion and garlic in hot oil until tender. Add tomatoes tomato sauce wine parsley oregano basil salt and pepper. Bring to boiling then reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add fish shrimp and undrained clams. Bring just to boiling then reduce heat. Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. This stew is delicious on its own or over rice. Serve with salad and warm bread.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: Mix all together real good then pour in ice cream freezer. Freeze as you would ice cream.

title: Best-Ever Egg Nog
instructions: Beat egg yolks and sugar in medium saucepan. Slowly beat in two (2) cups of the milk. Cook over medium heat stirring frequently until thermometer registers 150\u00b0F. or mixture coats the back of a metal spoon. Remove from heat; strain into pitcher. Stir in remaining milk Jim Beam Bourbon vanilla and nutmeg. Cover and chill at least 8 hours or overnight. Sprinkle with additional nutmeg.

title: Crescent Roll Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Stir in seasoning and tomato sauce. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread 1 can of rolls onto bottom of pan. Spread hamburger mixture on top of rolls. Sprinkle both kinds of cheese on top then top with second can of rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Pare and slice eggplant. Cook in salted water until tender. Drain and mash. Add other ingredients except cheese slices. Place in a greased 1-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Arrange cheese slices on top and bake an additional 20 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Gold Kist Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar creaming until light and fluffy. Add slightly beaten eggs and other ingredients. When all is blended pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake on lower shelf of oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper. Top each breast with cheese slice; set aside. Combine soup and milk stirring until smooth. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with stuffing mix and drizzle with butter. Bake chicken at 350\u00b0 for 150 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Grape-Nuts Pudding
instructions: Soak cereal in warm milk for 10 minutes. Beat eggs with fork; add sugar to taste. Add salt vanilla and cereal/milk mixture. Spoon into a buttered 5 cup casserole dish. If desired sprinkle top with nutmeg. Set casserole into a pan partly filled with water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Stir at least twice during the first 20 minutes of baking. Makes 4 to 6 servings. Serve warm or chilled. Store leftover pudding in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Pinch lettuce in small pieces. Combine all other ingredients except Fritos. Add them just before serving.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Spread in ungreased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan or casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine cream cheese and sugar. Set aside. Mix together pudding and milk until smooth. Mix in whipped topping. Mix in cream cheese mixture. Alternate layers of the crushed cookies and pudding mixture beginning and ending with cookies. Put in refrigerator or freeze until firm.

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into graham cracker crusts. Makes 2 or more pies!

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Fold in sour cream and pineapple. Pour into oiled mold. (Halved works well.)

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Line bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish or pan with graham crackers. Mix pudding according to directions on box and spread over crackers. Spread Cool Whip over that and put in refrigerator until pudding sets. Top with blueberry pie filling.

title: Italian String Beans
instructions: Cook beans until partially tender; drain and saute in olive oil 1 clove garlic and oregano. Add salt and pepper. Cook until tender.

title: Hot And Sour Soup
instructions: In a 5-quart pot heat oil. Add chicken and saute until meat is not pink. Add water mushrooms cabbage bamboo shoots and bouillon cubes. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1/2 hour. In small bowl dissolve cornstarch and stir with fork until smooth. Stir into soup. Add vinegar soy sauce salt and pepper. Stir soup until slightly thickened and enjoy. Unused soup can be frozen for a quick meal anytime.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package and drain. Combine tuna soup onion vinegar milk and Cheddar cheese in a bowl. Mix well. Stir in noodles. Spoon into 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pie De Kahlua
instructions: Dot shell with Kahlua and set aside. Slightly beat egg yolks in top of a double boiler. Add 1/2 cup sugar. Place over simmering water. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Melt chocolate with 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan. Stir melted chocolate mixture into egg yolks. Cook and stir until mixture begins to thicken. Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Add to thickened chocolate mixture. Stir well and remove from heat. Add Kahlua. Place pan with mixture in a bowl of ice water to cool. In small bowl beat cream with 2 tablespoons sugar until stiff. In another small bowl beat egg whites until stiff. When chocolate mixture begins to thicken fold in half of the whipped cream then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Refrigerate remaining whipped cream. Turn chocolate mixture into pie shell chill. Top pie with remaining whipped cream and almonds. Makes one 9 inch pie.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Toss rice and spinach together. Add eggs milk Worcestershire sauce salt and onion. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle butter and cheese over rice. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes to soften.

title: Good Green Beans
instructions: Drain green beans. Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 to 30 minutes until bacon pieces are done.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
instructions: In Dutch oven cook beef sausage onion and garlic. Drain. Add next 7 ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes. Prepare spaghetti as package directs. Drain. Serve sauce over hot spaghetti. Pass the Parmesan cheese. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Place all ingredients except walnuts in a large bowl. Microwave at Medium (50% power) until chocolate chips are melted (about 3 to 5 minutes) stirring once or twice during cooking. Stir in nuts. Pour into well-greased (8 x 8-inch) square baking dish. Refrigerate until set (overnight if possible).

title: Cheesy Green Beans
instructions: Brown the butter; add flour then milk. Stir and cook until smooth. Add cheese and mushroom soup and stir until melted. Pour over beans. Heat.

title: Electric Frypan Swiss Steak
instructions: On a breadboard pound flour into both sides of steak; cut into serving pieces until flour is absorbed. Preheat frypan to 360\u00b0. Add fat and onions; saute until golden in color about 3 minutes. Remove from fat. Change frypan setting to 400\u00b0 and add a tablespoon of fat. Then brown steak on both sides about 10 to 20 minutes. Sprinkle browned meat with salt and pepper; add the sauteed onions garlic celery tomatoes and pepper slices. Cover and set frypan at 220\u00b0. Simmer until the meat is tender about 1 1/2 hours. Sprinkle with parsley when serving.

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: Combine cheese dates and 1/2 cup pecans. Cover and chill 30 minutes. Shape into a ball and roll in remaining pecans. Serve with apple wedges or gingersnaps. Makes 2 cups.

title: Aunt Lettie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Separate eggs. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 6 tablespoons of sugar gradually. Put in refrigerator. Cream butter and add remainder of sugar. Beat at low speed. Add 2 egg yolks at a time. Add milk and flour alternately. Add flavoring and fold in egg whites. Pour into greased steeple pan. Bake 1 3/4 hours in a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Sauerbraten Patties
instructions: Soften bread in water. Add beef onion egg salt and pepper and mix thoroughly. Form into patties. Brown on both sides in butter in heavy skillet. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over meat. Cook covered on low heat for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Garlic Rosemary Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Push garlic and rosemary under skin and in cavity. Cook in Brown N Bag 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours at 375\u00b0.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Cook until cheese is melted. Keep on warmer and serve with Doritos or other chips.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cut up chicken and put in casserole. Combine soup and broth and pour over chicken.

title: Microwave Pralines
instructions: Stir whipping cream and sugar together well. Cook 7 minutes. Stir well then cook 7 more minutes. Remove and add butter and pecans. Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla (optional) then drop on wax paper.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream shortening butter sugar and eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a loaf pan greased and lightly floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Savory Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place chicken breast in shallow baking dish. Combine soup and milk. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle stuffing mix evenly over milk and soup mixture. Drizzle melted oleo over stuffing. Bake covered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove cover and continue baking for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Raisin-Filled Apples
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Peel off a strip around top of apples. Place apples in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish; fill centers with nut mixture. Microcook covered until tender 5 to 6 minutes; give dish a half turn twice. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serves 4.

title: Hamburger Hot Dish
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion together until hamburger is brown and crumbly. Drain off excess fat. Mix all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours until carrots are tender at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix wafers powdered sugar and orange juice and roll in small balls. Then roll these in the coconut.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar flour oats cinnamon salt and raisins. Add eggs and mix well. Add margarine. Mix soda and vinegar together and add to mixture. This dough will be stiff but mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes depending on how crisp or soft you like them.

title: Butternut Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise and discard seeds. Slice into 1/2-inch slices crosswise and remove peel. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with sugar. Heat orange juice in microwave dish. Dissolve candy in the orange juice. Pour over squash. Sprinkle with salt. Cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Place liquid from baking pan into small saucepan and boil until thick. Pour over squash. Yields 4 servings. Has 150 calories fat free.

title: Champagne Salad(Frozen)
instructions: Fold in fruit and nuts with mixture. Freeze in Pyrex dish. Cut into squares. Fills a 7 x 11-inch dish.

title: Chocolate Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour a Bundt pan or tube pan. In large bowl cream together the butter shortening and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. In another bowl combine the flour baking soda salt and cocoa. Stir to mix. Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture alternately with the buttermilk. Add vanilla and mix well. Stir in walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Bake for about 1 hour 10 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake. After the cake has cooled slightly in the pan turn it out onto a cake plate.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Crisscross Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add eggs and beat thoroughly. Stir in peanut butter. Sift dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture. Form into tiny balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with back of fork to make crisscross. Dough may also be rolled and cut if desired. Bake in moderated oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef sausage and onion on low heat; add other ingredients. Cook in a large pot. Serve with nacho chips. Keep warm in crock-pot.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour baking powder and salt. Mix dry ingredients into wet ingredients. Spread 1/2 batter into bottom of 9 x 13 greased baking pan. Spoon pie filling over batter. Drizzle remaining batter over pie filling. Before baking sprinkle with 2 tablespoons white sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon mixed together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Mix cream cheese onion and Tabasco sauce. Spread on ham slices. Roll ham slices and refrigerate overnight. Slice in one-inch pinwheels after chilled thoroughly. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Cook meat and onion until brown; drain fat. Add taco seasoning mix to meat mixture. Add chilies. Cut tortillas into thirds. In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer salsa meat cheese and tortillas in that order. End with layer of tortillas topped with cheese. Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ladyfingers
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll in powdered sugar. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 5.

title: Mom'S Dandelion Wine
instructions: Gather 1 peck dandelion heads. Do not collect from an area sprayed with pesticides or herbicides. Wash to remove bugs. Combine dandelion heads with boiling water in a large container. Let the flower heads steep for 24 hours. Strain the juice. To the juice add sugar yeast and fruit. The amount of fruit can vary depending on the flavor you want. Set it in a warm dark area to ferment. Do not stir. Keep mixture quiet for about 2 weeks. When the mixture reaches the desired potency siphon off and filter through cheesecloth. Refrigerate. Its ready!

title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the flour and sugar. Add potatoes eggs corn syrup nutmeg salt butter and evaporated milk. Beat well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Smoked Salmon Rolls
instructions: Blend softened cheese with capers. Spread on salmon. Roll jelly-roll fashion. Chill. Cut in 1/2-inch slices. Serve on cocktail picks.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix Crisco or oleo powdered sweetener milk almond vanilla and eggs together and add flour baking powder and nuts. Make into logs and refrigerate overnight. Slice and bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. They do not brown like cookies with sugar. Can also add coconut and substitute unsweetened orange juice for the milk. Keep in refrigerator. (Thirteen calories per cookie.)

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Prepare cake batter using first 8 ingredients. Melt 1/3 cup butter and brown sugar in cake pan (10 to 12-inch) or an iron skillet. Put the pineapple in the pan and place a cherry in the center of each pineapple slice if you wish. Then cover with cake batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Loosen cake from sides of pan and invert on large plate. Serve warm or cold plain or with whipped cream.

title: Gone All Afternoon Stew
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes turning once.

title: Turkey Chili
instructions: In large heavy pot brown turkey; pour off any excess fat. Add onion green pepper and garlic; cook 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Add beans water tomatoes tomato paste chili powder oregano cumin and red pepper; cover. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet; drain off fat. Add soup beans green chilies chili powder salt and pepper; simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over rice or with crackers.

title: Crock Pot Pepper Roast
instructions: Place about 5 or 6 peppers in bottom of pot. Put roast on top. Pour remaining peppers and the juice on top.\tCook on low all day while you are at work. You could also put on before bed and allow to cook all night. Refrigerate in the morning.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Brown the steak. Mix the remaining ingredients and put on top of the steak. Bake.

title: Beatnik Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Roll chicken in a mixture of flour salt pepper and garlic powder. Brown in oil. Place chicken in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish; sprinkle with Parmesan and then Mozzarella. Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with spaghetti or vermicelli. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fresh Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Dip into boiling water the peaches. Plunge peaches into cold water. Slip off skins. Cut in half. Discard pits. Press peaches through sieve or food mill into mixing bowl. Stir in 1 tablespoon lemon juice and the sugar. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes. Combine the heavy cream vanilla almond extract and salt. Stir into peach mixture. Fill freezer container 2/3 full of mixture. Cover tightly. Set in freezer tub and freeze until firm.

title: Mountain Dew Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Finish cooling before adding icing.

title: Sauce For Fresh Fruit
instructions: Place beaten egg in top of double boiler and add sugar flour and salt. Mix well. Add butter and pineapple juice. Cook over water until smooth and thickened. Cool then add Dream Whip or whipping cream.

title: Eggplant Souffle
instructions: Peel eggplant and cook in boiling water 7 to 10 minutes. Drain and season with dash of onion powder and dill. Mix remaining ingredients with 1/3 cup cracker crumbs and combine with eggplant. Put in 2-quart greased casserole. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top and dot with butter and dash of paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Famous Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch and lemon juice in pan. Separate 3 yolks from egg whites set the whites aside. Add egg yolks to lemon mixture and stir then add boiling water and cook until thick. Pour into pie shell. Beat egg whites and sugar until stiff peaks form for topping. Spread onto pie and bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until topping is golden brown.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Melt butter and beat eggs slightly.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in an 8-inch dish in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven. Combine sugar flour and milk. Stir into melted margarine. Top with cherries and mix thoroughly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fiesta Onion Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill at least 2 hours. Serve with vegetables fish chicken or tortilla chips. Yield 2 cups.

title: Rudy'S Farm Holiday Dressing
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Cook onion and celery in oleo until tender. Mix remaining ingredients together; dump in sausage onion oleo and celery. Stuff a 14 to 20 pound bird or dressing may be baked in pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Feeds a hungry family!!

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix melted butter and 1 egg. Pour and press into lightly greased cake pan. Mix pumpkin 2 eggs sugar salt cinnamon ginger cloves and milk. Pour over crust mix. Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over pumpkin mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and serve with whipped topping.

title: Spatini Meatballs
instructions: Mix together ground beef Spatini cold water and bread crumbs. Shape into meatballs. Place on cookie sheet. Bake in oven for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in bowl as listed. Let sit 8 hours overnight in refrigerator.

title: North Rim Rolls(Grand Canyon)
instructions: Mix milk sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Add eggs and yeast mixture. Stir in flour. Refrigerate overnight. Roll out dough. Cut or shape as desired. Let rise at least an hour. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Meatball Bites
instructions: Mix ground beef bread crumbs egg and poultry seasoning. Shape into about 2 dozen 1 1/2-inch balls. Brown balls slowly in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat. Pour off excess fat.

title: Cherry Wink Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Blend butter and sugar; add eggs. Beat well. Stir in milk and vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients together with nuts dates and cut cherries. Mix well. Crush corn flakes into fine crumbs. Shape dough into balls using 1 level tablespoon dough each. Roll balls into crumbs. Place on greased cookie sheet. Top each with 1/4 cherry. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Yield 6 dozen 2-inch diameter cookies.

title: Applesauce Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Stir in egg. Sift together the flour soda salt cinnamon cloves and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce. Add oats and blend well. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoons onto well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sensational Celery
instructions: Cook celery in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain. Drain water chestnuts; reserve liquid. Slice water chestnuts. Drain mushrooms and reserve liquid. Mix celery water chestnuts almonds and mushrooms. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add reserved liquids milk and broth; cook stirring until thickened. Stir in celery mixture; pour into casserole. Top with crumbs; sprinkle with cheese. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven until bubbly and brown.

title: Imperial Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar; add soda and vinegar then vanilla and flour. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for about 15 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Place tomatoes with juice in bowl mash tomatoes to desired consistency. Place jalapenos onion and garlic in food processor and chop. In skillet over low heat place vinegar oil and jalapeno mixture until warm to touch (do not boil). Sprinkle with salt several times. Add tomatoes stir well. Place in jars and refrigerate.

title: Israeli Salad
instructions: Dice each vegetable into extremely small pieces. Add oil then squeeze in the juice of 1 to 2 lemons depending on your taste. Add the salt then add lemon oil and salt based on how much salad you need. The salad should be tart and refreshing.

title: Chicken Enchilada(Microwave)
instructions: In 2-quart casserole mix all the ingredients. Microwave on High for 11 to 13 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn; cook 5 minutes.

title: Candy Strawberries
instructions: Combine jello pecans and coconut. Stir in milk and vanilla. Chill 1 hour. Shape into strawberries. Roll in red sugar. If you wish tint sliced almonds with green food coloring and insert in tops of berries to form leaves. Makes 1 pound 3 ounces. Very pretty to use among Christmas goodies.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: In a medium-size bowl put 1/2 cup of coconut then add 4 tablespoons sugar and 3/4 cup of warm milk. Stir well until mixed. Poke cake all over with fork and then pour the milk mixture all over cake then allow to cool and frost with frosting made from Cool Whip sour cream 1/4 cup of confectioners sugar and 1/2 cup of coconut. Then top with remaining coconut. Chill until time to serve. Cake needs at least 3 hours to saturate but overnight in fridge is best.

title: Mashed Potato Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain grease. Peel cut and boil potatoes. Mash potatoes. Add butter and milk; set aside. Drain green beans. Combine tomato soup green beans and browned hamburger in a greased baking dish. Layer mashed potatoes on top of hamburger mixture. Spread evenly. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let set 5 minutes and serve.

title: Spiced Mocha Mix
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Makes 2 1/2 cups mix (12 to 14 servings).

title: Swedish Pineapple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with mixer. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Deer Roast
instructions: You will also need one oven baking bag.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
instructions: Heat apple juice and cornstarch in saucepan until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and cinnamon. Pour over apples in large bowl and mix carefully. Pour into pie crust and cover with second pie crust. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese And Veggie Crescents
instructions: Combine spinach or broccoli cheese spread bread crumbs and bacon in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring occasionally until cheese is melted. Unroll dough and separate into 16 triangles. Cut each triangle in half lengthwise so youll have 32 triangles. Spread each triangle with about 1 teaspoon of mixture. Roll up starting at wide end. Place on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 32 appetizers.

title: Ice Cream Cookies
instructions: Whip Crisco sugar eggs and vanilla together. Mix flour soda cream of tartar and pinch of salt. Combine and drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tamale Pie Casserole
instructions: Butter casserole dish. Spread ingredients in layers (Chili cheese Fritos onion tamales cheese then repeat.)

title: Grits Casserole 2
instructions: Cook grits in boiling water for 15 minutes. Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Delicious with ham.

title: Orange Lemonade
instructions: In medium saucepan combine sugar and water. Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved stirring constantly. Cool. Finely shred enough orange and lemon peel to make 2 tablespoons. Set aside. Squeeze juice from the lemons and 1 1/2 cups orange juice. Add juices and peel to the cooled syrup. If desired pour over mint sprig cover and let stand 1 hour. Strain mixture; pour into jars and cover. Refrigerate. To serve fill glasses or pitcher with ice cubes. Pour equal amounts of fruit syrup and water over ice. Stir to combine. If desired garnish with lemon slices. Makes 6 cups fruit syrup or 12 (8 ounce) servings of orange-lemonade.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in all ingredients. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Christmas House Fragrance
instructions: Mix and bring to boil. Keep simmering. (Crock-pot is great.)

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa\tin microwave-proof bowl. Place stick of butter in center of dry mix. Pour milk over. Do not try to mix!

title: Tomato Parmesan Salad
instructions: In a small bowl or jar with a tight-fitting lid combine oil vinegar garlic salt and pepper; set aside. In a large salad bowl combine all remaining ingredients. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Frito Chili Pie
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion; drain. Add tomato juice beans and seasoning mix; set aside. Layer casserole dish with chips chili cheese chips chili cheese until all ingredients are used. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Frozen Slush
instructions: Mix in order given; put in Tupperware dish. Put in freezer. Whenever you want a slush scrape with ice cream scoop.

title: Fudge Cookie Cake
instructions: Put flour sugar and salt in large bowl set aside. Bring to a boil oleo water oil and cocoa pour over flour mixture and stir until well mixed. In a small bowl beat the eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla. Stir into mixture and beat well. Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan (10 x 15-inch) and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef in frypan or pot. Remove from heat. Drain excess fat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Low-Fat Bran-Apple Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Coat 12 (2 3/4 inch) muffin tin cups with vegetable cooking spray; set aside. In small bowl combine buttermilk bran and baking soda; set aside. In mixer bowl cream sugar prune puree; beat in egg whites and molasses. Stir in buttermilk mixture flour apple and salt. Blend thoroughly. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups dividing equally. Bake about 20 minutes until pick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Turn onto rack to cool completely.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Cream the cheese and sour cream and spread on a platter. Add the taco seasoning to taste. Chop and spread on the cream cheese mixture onion lettuce and tomato. Spread the Cheddar cheese over the top. Use real \nachos\ or Tostitos with dip.

title: Baking Dish Cobbler
instructions: Butter a 9 or 10-inch pie dish at least 1 1/2 inches deep. Place peaches in dish. Spread bread evenly over peaches. Mix melted butter sugar flour and egg together until well blended. Pour evenly over bread making sure all bread is covered. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fried Apple Pies
instructions: Add water to apples and cook until done. Add sugar salt and spices and simmer until jelled. Refrigerate until used.

title: Almond Bark Candy
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Turn off and place pan in oven with peanut butter and Candi-Quick. Mix the next 3 ingredients and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Braised Bratwurst With Spicy Mustard Sauce
instructions: About 30 minutes before serving with sharp knife score sausages for even cooking. In 12-inch skillet over medium heat cook sausages in apple cider until cider evaporates and sausages are browned and heated turning sausages occasionally.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 in oblong pan until cake falls (or about 45 minutes). Cool and cut into squares.

title: Garden Green Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Toss well. Combine lemon juice and remaining ingredients in a jar. Cover tightly and shake vigorously. Pour over lettuce mixture. Toss gently. Yields 4 servings.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to boil stirring constantly. When thickened add apples. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Dot with butter. Cover with top crust. Cut slits for escape of steam. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 50 minutes or until crust is brown and juice bubbles through slits.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix flour butter powdered sugar and salt. Pat in 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes (dont brown). Beat the eggs sugar flour and lemon juice for 3 minutes. Pour over hot crust and bake 20 to 25 minutes more. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar. Double the recipe for 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Relish
instructions: Grind first 5 ingredients in blender. Add 1/2 cup salt. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain dry or squeeze out. Add vinegar sugar mustard seed and celery seed. Mix well; pack into jars and seal. Makes 10 pints.

title: Funny Cake
instructions: Cook 1 cup sugar cocoa and water for a few minutes then let cool. In another bowl mix remaining ingredients together. Pour first mixture into unbaked pie crust then drop second mix by spoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pecan Roll
instructions: Place milk sugar and butter in iron skillet and cook over medium heat. Stir until mixture turns brown and gets thick and sugary. Add pecans and vanilla flavoring. Pour into well buttered plate. Cut into squares before it is completely cool.

title: Grape Finger Jello
instructions: Soften gelatin in juice and cold water. Add the boiling water and stir until gelatin dissolves. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan coated with nonstick vegetable spray. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Belgian Pie
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1-1/2 teaspoons sugar in warm water; set aside until bubbly. Beat 2 eggs 2 tablespoons sugar and salt. Add cream and butter. Beat. Add yeast mixture and slowly blend in flour. Mix well and let stand for 10 minutes. Divide into 5 or 6 parts. Form into balls. Press into greased pans forming a 1/2 inch ridge around outside of the pan. Let rise 15 minutes. Pour rice prune poppy seed apple cherry or any cake and pastry filling over the center. Top with Cheese topping. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Cabbage
instructions: Cook the bacon in iron skillet until crisp. Add the onion and peppers. Add the remaining ingredients. Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts together with mixer until smooth. Add nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Oriental Grilled Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half. Mix remaining ingredients together in a shallow pan large enough to hold breasts in one layer. Place breasts in marinade turning to coat and rubbing marinade into breasts. Marinate at least one hour and as long as overnight. Grill chicken over hot coals or under broiler. Strain marinade bring it to a boil and serve it with chicken. Yield 4 servings. Carbohydrate 5 g protein 21 g fat 5 g calories 186.

title: Pork Chops Au Gratin
instructions: Brown the pork chops. Meanwhile mix remaining ingredients and put into large casserole dish. Place browned pork chops on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Soft Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening add eggs and sour cream. Mix well. Add vanilla. Combine flour baking powder and soda. Add to creamed mixture slowly. After well mixed set overnight in refrigerator. Roll out on a floured surface. Cut into shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8-10 minutes. Frost and decorate.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix flour and cream of tartar in pan. Add water food coloring and oil. Stir over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes. Dont worry if globby. Keep stirring until ball forms in center of pot. Take out and put on floured surface. Squish and punch a bit (kneading). Keep in plastic bag or airtight container. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Fiesta Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease a 9-inch square pan or 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole dish. Layer half the corn chips chili onion and cheese in pan; repeat. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until hot. Garnish with lettuce tomatoes and olives. Makes 4 servings.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large mixer bowl beat egg yolks with Eagle Brand ReaLime and food coloring (if desired). Pour into prepared pastry shell. Bake for 30 minutes. Cool; chill. Top with whipped cream. Garnish as desired. (Refrigerate leftovers.)

title: Cheaters Mexican Bake
instructions: Spray 9 x 13 baking pan with nonstick spray and line bottom with burritos which have been cut into thirds. Mix chili and salsa together and pour over burritos. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple chunks in bottom of glass 10 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix sugar and flour together and sprinkle over pineapple. Then layer cheese and crushed crackers to form top layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Trim beans and pack in 4 pint canning jars. Add 1 garlic clove and 1/4 teaspoon cayenne and dill to each jar. Boil salt water and vinegar. Pour into jars. Cover jars with canning lids. Process 10 minutes. These are great addition to a relish tray and good in Bloody Marys.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Bake 35 minutes in cast-iron pot or medium cast-iron frypan at 350\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Knead 10 times. Cut and bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Toss rice and spinach together. Add eggs milk worcestershire sauce and salt. Pour into ungreased casserole. Sprinkle butter and cheese over rice. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Mix all together green beans peas corn celery onion pimentos and bell pepper and cover with Italian dressing oil vinegar and sugar.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until mixture is light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and baking soda alternately with milk stirring until smooth. Add melted candy mixing well. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool a few minutes and remove.

title: Arame (Sea Vegetable) And Carrots
instructions: *Arame is available at the Grainery and at Mellon Produce.

title: Mike'S Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all. Leave plain or add whatever fruit desired. Freeze in ice cream freezer. Delicious!

title: Fresh Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut up fruit. Mix it in a bowl. Mix 3 teaspoons of plain yogurt and 1 teaspoon of vanilla with fruit.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix bouillon and water. Sprinkle rice over bottom of a casserole dish. Chop onion green pepper and place on top of rice. Place butter pats on top of green peppers and onion. Pour bouillon mixture over casserole. Put chicken on top of rice mixture. Pour the mushroom soup over the chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Ovens can vary so use your own judgement.

title: No Peek Stew
instructions: Put raw meat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Place raw vegetables on top of meat. Combine salt sugar tapioca and pepper; sprinkle evenly over veggies. Pour juice evenly over top. Cover with heavy duty foil and crimp edges to seal tightly. Bake at 250 degrees for 5 hours and Dont Peek!

title: Cole Slaw, Frozen
instructions: Shred cabbage; add salt and set for 1 hour. Mix sugar vinegar water celery and mustard seed. Boil for 1 minute. Let cool. Add pepper and carrot to cabbage. Pour mixture over cabbage. Mix well. Put in containers and freeze. Will keep in refrigerator a week or more.

title: Quick Yellow Split Pea Soup
instructions: Bring water with all ingredients to a boil. Reduce to medium-low. Simmer 30 minutes. Add rice or barley during last 10 to 20 minutes of cooking.

title: Blt Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain and rinse in cold water. In a large bowl combine the macaroni green onions tomato and celery. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise vinegar salt and pepper. Pour over macaroni mixture and toss to coat. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving add bacon. Yield 12 servings.

title: Zucchini Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add oil sugar vanilla and zucchini. Into a separate bowl sift the dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients to zucchini mixture along with nuts. Pour into greased muffin tins or use muffin papers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Ground Beef Basic Mix
instructions: Melt margarine in 8-quart pan over low flame. Add ground beef; turn flame to medium and cook until red color disappears. Add onion celery and green pepper; cook until beef is brown and vegetables are tender. Add soup tomato sauce salt and pepper; cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Cool and divide equally into 5 freezer containers. May be thawed and used in a variety of recipes.

title: Anise Oil Cookies
instructions: Mix together butter and sugar. Add egg wine vanilla and anise oil. Sift flour baking powder salt and remaining ingredients and mix together. Put in refrigerator overnight. Take out and roll out with cookie cutters. Grease pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 minutes.

title: Valley Fresh Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill before serving.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Have butcher cut loin chops with a pocket for the stuffing. Brown onion in butter. Combine with bread crumbs raisins salt and seasoning. Stuff pockets with stuffing. Place in an 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat on stove; season as you wish. Layer the hamburger potatoes and onions in casserole dish. Pour can of cream of mushroom soup over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Hot Sponge Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; beat in sugar. Beat in flour. Melt butter in milk and pour over dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Bake in 10-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. May frost or serve plain with fruit such as strawberries.

title: Ozark Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar egg flour salt baking powder and vanilla. Add apples and nuts and mix well. Bake in greased pie tin at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vanilla Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and beat until mixture is a light lemon color. Add flour and mix well. Form dough in 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or lightly browned.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Mix egg yolks and all other ingredients well. Spoon into egg whites and chill.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pack into a 2-quart casserole dish. Pour 1/2 cup of water over top. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Garlic Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook grits in water and salt. Melt cheese and margarine together. Beat eggs. Finish cup with milk. Mix all ingredients together. Pour in large casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Cabbage Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 as you would for any meat loaf. Time depends on thickness of loaf. Drain juice off as it bakes. Cabbage will produce extra liquid.

title: Lemon Snowdrops
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar; add extract. Sift together flour and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Roll level teaspoonfuls into balls. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets; flatten slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8-10 minutes.

title: Delicious Bread Pudding #1
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Put bread crumbs in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Blend in remaining ingredients and stir. Place baking dish in pan of hot water about 1-inch deep and bake for 45 to 50 minutes until knife inserted comes out clean. Great for holidays!

title: Oriental Marinade
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and pour over uncooked fish or meat. Marinate in refrigerator at least 4 hours. Grill broil saute stir-fry or bake as you desire. Grilling seems to bring out the best flavors. Marinade may be heated and thickened with cornstarch and served as a sauce.

title: Dirt
instructions: Crush Oreos in a blender or food processor. Mix pudding with 3 cups ice water and set aside. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese Cool Whip and margarine together; then add pudding. Line a container with 1/2 of the Oreo cookie crumbs. Pour pudding mixture into crumb-lined container. Top with remaining cookie crumbs. Freeze overnight or at least 3 hours. Take out of the freezer 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Fry together butter and onion until brown. Add flour and stir. Add canned soup milk and broccoli. Simmer 15 minutes or until broccoli is cooked. Add shredded Cheddar cheese and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain peaches and pineapple. Mix all together. Garnish with cherries and pecans. Chill.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix together. Form balls and drop into sauce; cook at least 30 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Spoon Bread
instructions: Scald milk in saucepan. Add cornmeal and cook stirring constantly until thick. Mix in sugar and salt. Mix small amount of hot cornmeal mixture with egg yolks; return to saucepan and mix thoroughly. Stir in butter and cottage cheese. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually fold in cornmeal mixture. Pour into baking dish and bake 35 minutes. Serve with melted butter.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup(Heart Smart)
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium to high heat melt margarine. Add onion and celery. Cook about 4 minutes or until soft stirring frequently. Add potatoes chicken broth parsley thyme celery seed salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer about 15 minutes or until potatoes are almost tender. Add milk. Simmer uncovered 5 minutes stirring occasionally. In blender at medium speed blend about 1/4 of the mixture at a time until smooth. Return to saucepan heat about 1 minute. Makes 4 servings about 1 cup each.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: Fry bacon; set aside. Leave fat from bacon in skillet. Hold ear of corn perpendicular to cutting board. With sharp knife slice downward cutting off tip ends of kernels then scrape milk out of remaining kernels. Heat bacon fat in skillet. Add scraped corn and kernel tips. Fry lightly for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Add enough milk to make creamed corn consistency. Add butter. Cook another 5 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour in serving dish and sprinkle crushed bacon over all. Serves 6.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add flour alternately with milk. Add spices and cocoa. Fold in blackberries. Batter will be thick. Spoon batter into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Crackle Snappers
instructions: Melt chocolate morsels over hot not boiling water. Remove from heat and set aside. Combine shortening 1/2 cup sugar and egg and beat until creamy. Blend in melted chocolate and corn syrup. Sift together flour baking soda cinnamon and salt and stir in gradually. Add nuts and mix well. Shape into balls using 1 level tablespoonful for each. Roll balls in about 1/4 cup sugar. Place 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields 3 dozen 3-inch cookies.

title: Sausage Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop onto baking sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Apple Or Peach Crisp
instructions: Mix sugar flour and egg. Will be dry and crumbly. Sprinkle over fruit. Melt 1 stick margarine. Pour over. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Orange Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Mix soda with sour cream and add to egg mixture. Add all dry ingredients and orange rind. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pizza
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave on High 3 minutes. Stir until all is melted. Stir in marshmallows cereal and peanuts. Pour onto greased or Saran Wrap covered 12-inch pizza pan or smaller plates. Top with red cherries and 1 green for leaf. Sprinkle with coconut. Melt remaining white bark and shortening. Drizzle over coconut. Chill 15 minutes in freezer.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Put flour sugar and milk in the middle of the pie pan. Add oil and mix. Makes a soft ball of dough. Press to bottom and sides of pan evenly.

title: Mother'S Rice Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Scald milk; stir in sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add rice to milk then add the yeast and eggs. Add about half of the flour and stir until mixed well. Add enough of remaining flour to make a very stiff dough. Stir until dough leaves the sides of bowl. Knead until smooth. Place dough in large greased bowl. Brush dough with melted shortening cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Remove from refrigerator 3 to 4 hours before baking. Shape let rise and bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes for rolls. Can be made into loaves and baked at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown. Makes 2 loaves. Dough can be kept in refrigerator for 3 to 4 days.

title: Cinnamon Apple Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello and candy in boiling water. When cool stir in lemon juice applesauce and salt. Pour into mold.

title: Chocolate Scotcheroos
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup in a 3-quart saucepan. Cook over moderate heat stirring frequently until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter; mix well. Add Rice Krispies; stir until well blended. Press mixture into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Trout Meuniere
instructions: Roll trout in seasoned flour. Heat oil in frypan and add trout which should be gently cooked and browned on both sides. When thoroughly cooked transfer trout to heated serving platter and keep hot.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Chill.

title: Diabetic Cookies
