instructions: Combine dates raisins apples and water. Bring to a boil for 3 minutes. Cool and add remaining ingredients. Chill dough. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix well and cook over medium heat until thick. Pour into cooked pie shell. Add egg topping which consist of 3 egg whites 1 Tbsp. sugar and 1/4 tsp. vanilla flavoring whipped together. Place in oven on 325 degrees until topping browns.

title: White Bread
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Pour warm water into bowl. Sprinkle yeast and dissolve. Add milk mixture. Stir half the flour into mixture then add rest of flour and combine. Turn dough onto floured surface and knead. Put into greased bowl. Brush with melted shortening. Cover and let rise 1 hour and 20 minutes. Punch down. Divide into 2 equal parts. Knead. Place in loaf pan. Let rise 55 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Gin Punch
instructions: Pour over block of ice in a large punch bowl. Garnish with slices of orange and lemon.

title: White Trash
instructions: Mix cereal raisins and peanuts in a large container. Over low heat melt margarine peanut butter and chocolate morsels stirring well. Remove from stove and cool; pour over cereal mixture and mix well. Place mixture in large paper bag; pour in confectioners sugar and shake until it is coated. Store in an airtight container. Enough for a crowd.

title: Sesame Loaf
instructions: Saute onions and celery in 1/2 cup water until tender. Blend sunflower seeds and sesame seed. In bowl mix together the oatmeal blended seed pecan meal yeast onion powder garlic powder Soy Supreme bread crumbs then add soy sauce onions and celery. Add water; mix well. Bake in sprayed baking dish at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes until brown. Serve with Creamy Cashew Gravy.

title: Applesauce Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add egg and mix thoroughly. Sift flour cinnamon salt soda and baking powder together. Add to creamed mixture blending well. Add applesauce nuts raisins and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon onto a cookie sheet about 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake in a hot oven (400\u00b0) for about 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Berry Whirl
instructions: Combine the strawberries pineapple raspberries and limeade concentrate in a blender container or food processor. Process until smooth. Pour into 2 goblets. Serve immediately.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake in greased and floured pans about 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Orange-Clove Dried Tea Mix
instructions: Dry peel in 200\u00b0 oven. Store in airtight jar.

title: Mushroom-Chicken Cutlets
instructions: Combine crumbs Parmesan cheese parsley flakes and garlic salt. Mix eggs and water together. Dip each chicken cutlet into egg mixture then into crumb mixture. Heat oil in large skillet and brown cutlets on each side until golden brown. Remove to flat baking dish. Saute mushrooms briefly in same skillet; spoon over cutlets. Combine melted butter and lemon juice; pour over chicken and mushrooms. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin-Pecan Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda salt sugar cinnamon nutmeg and allspice in large mixing bowl. Make a deep well in center. Add pumpkin eggs oil water pecans and raisins. Mix just enough to moisten all ingredients.

title: Stanley Surprise
instructions: Mix ingredients and spread on English muffins. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbles appear about 15 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add enough milk to make dough stiff enough to drop from a teaspoon into hot deep fat. Cook until brown and drain on paper towels.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Brown in oil. Remove chicken and saute onions and garlic until soft. Add chicken and 20 cups of water. Bring to a boil and add salt pepper and Tabasco. Add rice. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer. Stir twice while cooking. Cook until water is absorbed and chicken is tender. Yields 24 servings.

title: Uncooked, Fresh Peach Pie
instructions: Combine peaches sugar and lemon juice; let stand for 1 hour. Drain and measure 1 cup syrup. Add cornstarch to syrup and blend. Cook over low heat until thick. Add salt butter and flavoring; cool. Put peaches in shell. Cover with sauce. Serve with whipping cream or ice cream.

title: Apple Casserole
instructions: Combine cheese flour margarine and sugar. Mix until creamy. Drain apples and pour into baking dish. Spread cheese mixture over top. Pour canned milk over the top of this. Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until well browned.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
instructions: Follow directions on cake box and pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Beat cheese sugar vanilla and eggs. Spread over cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and enjoy.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: In a skillet cook chicken onion carrot and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned about 5 minutes.

title: Aunt Lena'S Chocolate Topping
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar and salt. Add hot water first before cream; cook for 10 minutes at boil. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla; beat with mixer until cool.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Mix soup milk cheese and 1/2 the eggs together. Gently toss with asparagus. Top with remaining eggs and a little more cheese crackers and a few pats of butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Hot Choco-Mallow Mix
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Stir in marshmallows. Store in an airtight container with these serving instructions Combine 1/4 cup mix and 6 ounces boiling water in a mug. Stir and serve.

title: Bagna Cauda(Northern Italian Antipasto)
instructions: Heat butter or margarine and olive oil in saucepan. Add anchovy and garlic. Cook on low heat stirring constantly (if using fillets ensure they dissolve to a paste). Transfer to a fondue pot over fondue burner.

title: Slim Jim Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion in Dutch oven; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer covered 1 to 2 hours. Remove bay leaf. Serve hot. Freezes well. Can use crock-pot. Makes 8 (1 cup) servings with 156 calories each.

title: Molded White Bean Pate
instructions: Place drained kidney beans in a medium bowl and mash thoroughly with a fork. Saute garlic in olive oil until lightly golden about 30 seconds. Do not let it brown. Mix the garlic and the beans and all other ingredients except 1 tablespoon parsley.

title: Aunt Mary'S Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients real good. Then add the recommended amount of water for each can of orange juice and mix well. After this I usually put 1 quart of water and 1 cup of sugar and then stir and taste. I continue putting 1 quart of water and then some sugar (doesnt have to be a cup each time maybe 1/2 cup) and taste each time until I get it to taste like I want it. Everyone has their own taste.

title: Pinwheel Date Cookies
instructions: To prepare filling cook brown sugar water and dates for 5 minutes then add nuts. Allow to cool. To prepare dough cream butter and sugar. Add eggs then salt and flour mixing until dough like. Roll out dough and spread on the filling as for jelly rolls. Roll up chill slice and bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Fabulous Fruit Salad
instructions: All fruits must be fresh not canned or frozen. Prepare and slice all fruit into bite size pieces. Mix instant pudding mix powder (not prepared) with fruit and refrigerate overnight in sealed bowl. Before serving the next day toss lightly mixing thoroughly. The juice and pudding mix make a nice fruit pudding.

title: Newport Seafood Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Make white sauce with margarine flour milk and seasonings. Add cheese stirring until melted. Cook fish; skin bone and cut in pieces. Add fish shrimp lobster and sherry to sauce. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Toss crumbs with margarine; sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Millionaire Candy
instructions: Place caramels and water in double boiler and stir to dissolve. Pur over pecans. Make in flat round balls. Put on buttered platter and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Cheesy Chicken Crescent Supper
instructions: Combine chicken and 1/3 cheese soup. Roll up in crescent rolls. Heat remaining ingredients. Pour 1/2 of soup mixture on jelly roll pan. Arrange rolls on top of mixture and pour remaining soup mixture on triangles. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Dream Bars
instructions: Combine all ingredients with pastry blender or in food processor until crumbly. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Pita Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together and add more flour if necessary. Make into 2 balls. Knead each ball then divide into 12 smaller balls. Cover. Let rise about 30 to 40 minutes. Flatten balls to about 6 inches in diameter with rolling pin on a lightly floured board. Cover and let rise slightly. Flip the dough so that the bottom side of the bread dough is on the top side of baking sheets. Preheat oven as hot as it bakes. Place sheet on lowest rack. Bake about 2 to 4 minutes. Makes 24 pita breads.

title: Country Fair Corn Sticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease well 14 corn stick molds. Place in oven while preparing batter. In large bowl mix corn meal flour sugar baking powder and salt. In small skillet add oil and cook pepper and onions until tender. Remove skillet from heat. Stir in corn and milk then egg until mixed; stir into dry ingredients until batter is just blended. Spoon batter into preheated molds. Bake 15 minutes or until done. Cool in molds on wire rack 5 minutes. Remove from molds.

title: Pork Chop Scallop
instructions: Trim excess fat from chops. Grease 10-inch skillet with fat. Brown chops on both sides; season with salt and pepper. Remove chops from skillet. Empty potatoes and seasoned sauce packet into skillet. Stir in pimiento and amounts of milk and water called for on package. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; place pork chops on top. Cover and simmer 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Cornflake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup. Bring to a rapid boil. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Put cornflakes in a large bowl and pour syrup mixture over cornflakes. Stir until coated. Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch cocoa salt milk and egg yolks together. Cook in microwave until thick about 8 minutes on High. Add oleo and vanilla and beat until smooth. Put in cooked pie shell.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach; set aside. Saute onion and garlic in butter. Add mushroom soup salt pepper mushrooms spinach and eggs. Place in buttered casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Bake 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: Sad Cake Squares
instructions: Combine coconut baking mix brown sugar and nuts. Add eggs. Mix with spoon. Do not overmix! Bake in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan for 40 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Tuna Cheese Wedges
instructions: Drain and flake tuna. Add a few drops of Worcestershire sauce. Add all ingredients together and spread over 12 English muffins.

title: Scallops, Shrimp And Snow Peas
instructions: Saute shrimp and scallops in small batches in a wok until done (shrimp first then scallops; scallops take a few minutes to cook). Set aside in dish keeping warm. Put a bit more oil in wok. Quickly saute garlic green onions and peppers then add snow peas and continue sauteing. Saute until peas are bright green and are cooked yet crunchy. Add scallops and shrimp. Add broth soy sauce and spices. Thicken with a mixture of cornstarch and water (1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon cornstarch). Cook for about 7 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Add onion and cook until transparent; do not brown. Wash and trim broccoli peeling the stems. Add sliced broccoli potatoes and broth to onion in pan. Bring to boil and season. Simmer covered until broccoli is tender 20 to 30 minutes. Add parsley last 3 minutes. Drain broth from cooked vegetables and puree the broccoli mixture in blender. Combine with broth and refrigerate. When ready to serve stir in the half and half. This soup may be served hot or cold.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well using 1/2 cup grated cheese. Put in casserole dish. Put 1/2 cup grated cheese on top of casserole. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Blueberry-Lemon Muffins
instructions: Stir together flour sugar baking powder and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Combine egg milk and oil. Add all at once to flour mixture. Stir until moistened. Fold in blueberries which have been mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar the peel of 1 lemon and the juice of that lemon.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine and let stand Bran Buds and boiling water. Cream sugar margarine eggs then add buttermilk flour sifted with baking soda salt and All-Bran cereal. Add first mixture of bran buds and boiling water and combine with second mixture.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Peel cut and boil potatoes until tender. Cook remaining ingredients slowly in double boiler until cheese melts. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. For a spicier dish use Mexican Velveeta.

title: Best Yet Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients by hand. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan (greased only). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cherried Cranberries
instructions: Put all ingredients and 1 cup water in heavy 4-quart pan. Bring to boil over medium heat. Cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Do not uncover during cooking or cooling. Store in jars in refrigerator.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Saute onions and sweet peppers in butter or margarine for 5 minutes. Add cream of mushroom soup. Add few tablespoons of water if necessary. Add scallions parsley salt pepper and paprika to taste. Add crawfish tails; cook 5 minutes or until done. Serve over white rice.

title: Italian Sausage And Bean Soup
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2-inch pieces; brown in large heavy saucepan over medium heat. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat. Stir in onions; cook 5 to 8 minutes stirring occasionally until soft but not browned. Stir in garlic and celery; cook until soft 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in cabbage tomatoes beans chicken broth thyme basil oregano and bay leaf. Cover and bring to a boil. Simmer 30 minutes. Discard bay leaf. Stir in almonds.

title: Sausage-Egg Bake
instructions: Spread bread cubes in buttered 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Layer sausage and cheese over bread. Combine eggs and mustard with 1 generous cup of milk in a bowl beating well. Pour over sausage and cheese. Blend 1/4 cup of milk with soup until smooth. Pour over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yields 6 servings about 350 calories each.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large ovenproof skillet brown chops in oil. Remove chops from skillet. Pour off fat. In skillet combine ReaLemon and cornstarch. Mix well. Add sugar onion soy sauce and bouillon. Let bouillon dissolve. Add pork chops and carrots. Cover. Bake 1 hour or until tender. Add pineapple chunks. Cover and bake 10 minutes longer. Garnish with green pepper. Serve with rice if desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa and add enough milk to make it like a paste. Then add the egg yolks and beat well. Then add the balance of the milk and cook on top of the stove until thick. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Pare and quarter potatoes. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in a bag. Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in the bag coating potatoes well with cheese mixture. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Place potatoes in pan. Bake at 375 \u00b0 for about 1 hour turning once during baking when golden brown.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease (12) muffin tin. Beat egg then stir in milk and oil. Blend dry ingredients then add the wet ingredients stirring until moist. Add berries and fold in. Fill tins and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: One Pot Dinner
instructions: Brown beef; drain and put in cooker. Brown bacon and onion; drain. Add to cooker. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on low 4 to 6 hours.

title: Yummy Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except soup; shape into balls and place on a greased baking dish. Pour the soup thinned with water over the Yummy Balls and bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Top Of The Stove Baked Beans
instructions: Brown together ground beef with onion powder. Drain off excess grease. Mix together with all other ingredients. Stir and simmer until thick.

title: Butter Rum Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a large bowl and beat until smooth. Pour into well-greased Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Mix last 4 ingredients together in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Poke holes in cake while still in pan and hot. Pour glaze over cake and let set for 30 minutes. Remove from pan and serve.

title: Chicken-Rice Bake
instructions: In bowl stir together mushroom soup milk dry onion soup mix and undrained mushrooms. Reserve 1/2 cup of the soup mixture and set aside. Stir uncooked rice and thawed vegetables into remaining soup mixture.

title: Apple Candy Pie
instructions: Put apples in baking dish (greased) and sprinkle with cinnamon and 1/2 cup brown sugar. Add water. Melt butter and add it to 1/2 cup brown sugar and flour. Mix well and put on top of apple mixture patting it down firmly. Bake 3/4 hour to one hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve with cream.

title: Quick Lunch Box Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine all ingredients except chocolate and nuts. Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at medium speed scraping bowl occasionally. Add chocolate and nuts and mix. Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center.

title: Chicken Taco Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts. (Skin debone and tear into small pieces.) Mix chicken pieces cream of chicken soup (not diluted) onions and peppers. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with corn oil. Layer chips soup mixture and cheese until soup mixture is gone. Final layer of chips and sprinkle top with cheese. Cover with foil. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove foil; cook for 5 more minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Whole Wheat Muffins
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients thoroughly (do not sift). Add shortening unbeaten egg and sour milk. Beat only until smooth. Fill well oiled muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven at 425\u00b0 about 25 minutes.

title: Hard Candy
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a large saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Boil without stirring until temperature reaches 310\u00b0 or until drops of syrup form hard brittle threads in cold water. Remove from heat. After boiling has ceased stir in flavoring and coloring. Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Cool and break into pieces. Store in airtight containers.

title: Peanut Buster Dessert
instructions: Mix together butter and pat 3/4 of the cookie crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with 1/2 gallon of vanilla ice cream that has been softened. Put in freezer until firm. Before serving cover with fudge topping (not syrup); sprinkle with peanuts and cover with Cool Whip. Use the 1/4 cup of Oreo cookies on top.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple water and sugar to a boil; remove from heat. Add jellos. Chill until partially set. Whip slightly before adding other ingredients.

title: Blueberry Pie (Low-Fat)
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a good boil. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt oleo in a Dutch oven. Mix together flour sugar baking powder milk and vanilla and pour mixture over oleo. Using a cup pour berries over the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done about 40 minutes.

title: Crescent Cheese Danish
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay out 1 package of rolls in bottom of pan. Pinch seams together. Mix cream cheese 1 egg and 1 yolk sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Spoon over rolls. Take other package of rolls and spread on top. (I lay rolls out on waxed paper first so I can push out to right size.) Brush slightly whipped egg white on top. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Chill. Great for breakfast or as dessert.

title: Allison'S Peach Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put peach slices in square casserole dish. In separate bowl work together the sugar flour salt cinnamon nutmeg and margarine until crumbly. Add the lemon rind and mix. Sprinkle over top of fruit. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven until the peaches are tender and the top is browned. This takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Enjoy! Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Turkey Barbecue(40 Mini Sandwiches)
instructions: Brown ground turkey in large skillet or saucepan; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except buns. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened. Serve in buns.

title: Belleville Gooey Bars
instructions: Melt margarine in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix cake mix and 1 egg until crumbly. Press into bottom of pan. Mix the cream cheese eggs lemon juice and sugar (except for 1 tablespoon of the sugar) and pour onto cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with reserved sugar and cool. Cut into squares.

title: Cheese Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook veggies to your liking. Saute onion in margarine. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Stir in the milk. Gradually heat to boiling; stir constantly. Reduce heat and add remaining ingredients (broth cheese mustard). Heat thoroughly.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. In oven melt shortening in baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Measure flour salt paprika and pepper into paper or plastic bag. Shake 2 or 3 chicken pieces at a time in bag until thoroughly coated. Place skin side down in shortening. Bake uncovered 30 minutes. Turn chicken and bake until tender 20 to 30 minutes longer.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Cream peanut butter margarine and vanilla together. Add powdered sugar and\tmix well. Form into balls and chill until firm. Using a toothpick quickly dip and swirl balls in Chocolate Dip leaving a tan uncoated area around toothpick to resemble a buckeye. Place on waxed paper and chill.

title: Cassie'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients together except pecans for approximately 2 minutes. Add pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean. Cool before cutting.

title: Eggplant Soup
instructions: Steam onion and celery in hot oil and butter in tightly covered pot for about 10 minutes on low heat. Add eggplant and potatoes and steam 15 minutes. Stir in next 6 ingredients and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Puree in blender. Add cayenne and cream. Serve hot or cold. Freezes well. Yields 1 1/2 to 2-quart. You may add green onion tops if you wish.

title: Hoppin' John
instructions: In a large skillet saute onion celery and garlic in hot olive oil until onion is soft. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to a boil; reduce heat and cover tightly. Simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in proper sized buttered baking dish. Dot generously with butter. Bake uncovered slowly until bread browns a bit at least 1 1/2 hours in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Snickers Pie Or Cake
instructions: Cook cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. When cake gets done take out of oven and poke holes all in the cake. Take your Smuckers caramel and condensed milk already mixed together and pour over cake. Take the Snickers bars sliced thin (to melt) and put on top of cake. Top with Cool Whip if desired. Very rich!

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Blend in large bowl the cream cheese butter and powdered sugar until smooth. Mix pudding milk and vanilla. Mix bowls together. Stir in whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease and flour baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Mix sugars margarine and vanilla. Beat in egg. Stir in flour baking soda and salt. Mix in nuts and chocolate chips. Spread dough in pan. Bake until light brown 12 to 14 minutes. Cool; cut into bars (about 2 x 1 1/2 inches). Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Roll crescent rolls out flat in bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour beaten eggs over dough. Spread fried sausage over eggs. Add hash browns (uncooked) over sausage. Sprinkle cheese over all. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and browned. Serves 6.

title: Pickled Peaches
instructions: Place whole peeled peaches in lightly salted water to soak and prevent darkening no more than 20 minutes. Bring water and sugar to a boil in pot. Add pickling spice. Keep boiling. Drop peaches in hot liquid; they will change color. Spoon peaches into hot sterilized jars. Cover with syrup and seal. Try small pod of hot pepper in a few jars.

title: Peas And Rice
instructions: Fry salt pork to get the fat. Add onion tomato salt pepper and thyme. Stir all together and continue cooking. Add peas and 3 cups water. Let come to a boil and stir in rice. Cover and cook until rice is tender and water absorbed. Add another cup of water and cover to swell the rice. Add more water if needed. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Raspberry Crisscross Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening as for pie. Add eggs and milk. Keep 1/4 of dough out. Spread rest on 10 x 15-inch cake tin. Press dough well up along side of pan. Spread with jam. Sprinkle with nuts. Pinch off pieces of reserved dough with palms of hands and make 1/2-inch strips. Place on top for crisscross at 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let cool in pan. Cut with sharp knife in center of each strip so that each piece has dough around. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Tangy Fruit Salad
instructions: In small bowl combine reserved pineapple juice pudding mix and Tang; set aside. In large bowl combine all the fruit. Fold juice mixture into fruit. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream cheese in bowl. Add pineapple green pepper onion and seasoned salt. Add pecans (reserving some to roll ball into). Form into a ball and chill. Roll in nuts just before serving.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Heat in double boiler until melted then mash up pimiento pepper real good. Remove from boiler and stir for a few minutes longer.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Blend powdered sugar and cocoa in microwave-safe mixing bowl. Merely place milk and margarine in bowl but do not mix. Cook in microwave on High power for 2 minutes. Remove bowl from microwave and stir well. Add vanilla and nuts and stir until well blended and begins to thicken about 2 minutes or so.

title: Top Heavy Coconut Cake
instructions: Make cake by box directions. Bake as directed. When has about 15 minutes left in oven put sugar and pineapple in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil until sugar is dissolved. Poke holes in cake and pour mixture over entire cake. Place in refrigerator. Cool completely. Make pudding and pour over cake. Use 1/2 coconut and Cool Whip. Mix together. Put over cake. Then top with remainder of coconut. Then take your hand and push coconut into Cool Whip so it doesnt fall off cake.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix together all ingredients as you would for meat loaf. Form into small balls; brown in frying pan. Drain grease and place meat balls in a baking dish. Cover with jar of spaghetti sauce. Cover with foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Bubble Up Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Chop all ingredients then add sauce mix. Cut biscuits in half then in half again. Then mix with spaghetti sauce. Put in 13 x 9 pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 23 to 28 minutes.

title: Perpetual Pot Of Fruit With Rum Or Brandy
instructions: Bring water and sugar to a boil stirring until sugar dissolves. Simmer 15 minutes. Cool. Add lemon juice and rum or brandy (or some of both). Pour into a large container with cover. Add fruit to the syrup making sure that the fruit is submerged. Refrigerate replenishing as needed. Keeps beautifully.

title: Dutch Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together beef onion soup egg salt pepper and crumbs. Put in a baking dish. Mix together soup mustard sugar water and vinegar and pour over beef mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes in uncooked pie shell.

title: Carrot Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Beat all ingredients until smooth and even color. Sprinkle paprika or cut chives on top. Serve with carrots.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter; slowly beat in sugar and salt. Add 1 egg at a time and beat briskly. Blend entire mixture. Pour into pastry lined pie pan for 8-inch pie. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake until custard sets about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Viennese Brownies
instructions: In a bowl combine softened cream cheese sugar and 1 egg. Add almond extract; set aside. In small saucepan melt chocolate and butter together. Cool. Beat 2 eggs. Add sugar and chocolate mixture. Beat in sifted and combined flour baking powder and salt. Pour half the chocolate mixture into a well-greased and floured square baking pan (8-inches). Gently spread the cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining chocolate mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 45 to 50 minutes until cake tester inserted in center comes away clean. Cool in pan before cutting into rectangles or squares.

title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
instructions: Mix together the dry ingredients. Add eggs pumpkin and oil. Blend in nuts. Grease and flour 9-inch cake pans. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. You may use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown meat pepper and onion in large skillet. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir once or twice during baking.

title: Raspberry Mousse(Makes 8 To 10 Servings.)
instructions: In small saucepan combine 1 package undrained raspberries and cornstarch; cook and stir until thickened and clear. Chill thoroughly. In blender combine remaining 1 package drained raspberries Eagle Brand and ReaLemon brand; blend until smooth. Place in large bowl; stir in food coloring if desired. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon half the mousse mixture into dessert dishes; top with equal portions of raspberry sauce then remaining mousse mixture. Chill thoroughly. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Tomato Salad In A Bread Bowl
instructions: Cut a thin slice off top of bread. Carefully cut out most of the inside of the bread leaving a shell. Tear insides into large irregular pieces. Toss lightly under broiler. Set aside.

title: Deep Dish Apple Dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease 8-inch glass baking dish. Place half of apples in dish; top with corn syrup. Add remaining apples lemon juice 1 teaspoon cinnamon and nutmeg. Combine 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar salt butter flour and oatmeal. Mix well and press firmly over apples. Bake 50 minutes. Top with ice cream and serve.

title: Triple Layer Party Pie
instructions: In medium bowl combine butterscotch pudding mix 2/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder and 1 1/4 cups water. Mix well using a wire whisk. Pour into pie crust. In medium bowl combine chocolate pudding mix remaining 2/3 cup nonfat dry milk and remaining 1 1/4 cups water. Mix well using wire whisk. Pour over butterscotch layer. Cover and chill in refrigerator until set about one hour.

title: Green Bean Roll-Ups
instructions: Drain juice from green beans and reserve. Cut bacon in half. In each slice of bacon roll up 3 or 4 green beans. Secure bacon with toothpicks. Add part of green bean juice to the roll-ups after placing the roll-ups in a baking pan. Season with salt and pepper. Bake until bacon browns.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars butter and peanut butter in bowl with electric mixer. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Sift together flour soda and salt. Stir into egg batter. Shape into balls; roll in additional granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately press a chocolate kiss into each cookie. Cool on wire racks. Makes 7 dozen cookies.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given and bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned or until done.

title: Kraut Soup
instructions: Boil pork chops and potatoes until cooked. Saute onion in pan and roll in flour. Add 1 large can of tomatoes and string kraut.

title: Gingersnap Cookies
instructions: In large bowl beat together sugar and shortening; add molasses. Mix well. Add beaten egg. Stir together all remaining ingredients. Mix into molasses mixture until thoroughly combined. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or overnight. Roll dough into 1-inch balls then place balls into granulated sugar. Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Frog Eye Salad
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt; gradually stir in egg and pineapple juice. Cook over moderate heat stirring until thickened. Add lemon juice. Cool to room temperature. Bring water to boiling point with salt according to directions on acini de pepe box. Add oil and cook acini de pepe only until tender but firm. Drain and rinse well with cold water. Combine egg mixture with acini de pepe mixing lightly. Refrigerate overnight in an airtight container. The next morning add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly but thoroughly. Refrigerate in airtight container until well chilled. Salad may be refrigerated for a week if desired.

title: Coca-Cola Ham Steak
instructions: Cut each end of ham so ham steak wont curl. Pour the Coke over the ham in skillet. Cook over medium heat. Keep turning until Coke has vanished. Ham will be done. Serve with a slice of pineapple on top.

title: Key Lime Cake With Frosting
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 9x13-inch pan.

title: Children'S Edible Play Dough
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. If it gets too sticky put in a little flour. Feeds six children.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into greased and floured 3 loaf pans size 7 1/2 x 3 x 2-inch. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Very good served with fresh fruit.

title: Hot Chili Dip
instructions: Mix together. Microwave on High until bubbling or bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Melt margarine. With a fork blend in peanut butter. Slowly adding sugar mix together with hands. Roll into 2 or 3 long rolls. Pinch off enough for small balls. Place on wax paper or cookie sheet in freezer for 15 minutes.

title: Mandarin Salad
instructions: Mix the sour cream marshmallows and coconut. Use wooden spoon and stir in oranges and pineapple. Refrigerate overnight. Just before serving add bananas. Serves 6.

title: Quesidillas(Kay-Sa-De-Ya)
instructions: Soften cream cheese; then add olives and enough salsa to make mixture pink. Place 1 tortilla on plate (or server) and spread cheese mixture; repeat process ending with tortilla on top. Cut into small slices like pie. For garnish fasten stuffed olive on each slice with toothpick.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate in double boiler; cool. Beat eggs and salt until light and foamy. Gradually add sugar and vanilla and continue beating until well creamed. With a few strokes (mix manually) combine chocolate into egg/sugar mixture. Before mixture becomes uniformly colored fold in flour. Again before mixing is uniformly colored gently stir in pecans or walnuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and peanut butter. Add sugars and mix well. Add egg milk and vanilla. Add flour baking soda and salt. Mix well.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 then 40 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Cinnamon Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well and bring to a boil. Blend to the mixture the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Barbecued Steak
instructions: Combine all ingredients except round steak in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Simmer gently for 5 minutes. Pound steak (break tissues). Cut into serving pieces. Put in a large pan. Pour barbecued sauce over meat. Cover tightly and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours or until fork-tender.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Drain peas. Mix Miracle Whip with sugar; add vinegar (enough to make very tart). Cut up eggs. Mix all ingredients together. Cover and cool.

title: Red-Skinned Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Add salt and soybean oil to 1 quart water. Bring to a boil and add potatoes until fork-tender. Remove potatoes and add butter heavy cream pepper and sour cream. Mash. Serves 4.

title: Malaysian Beef
instructions: Cut meat into 1/2-inch strips. Mix together ginger chili powder garlic and lemon rind. Dip meat into mixture and brown in butter. Combine sugar jam lemon juice salt and 1 1/2 cups water. Add meat and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine milk margarine sugar and salt in microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on High until margarine melts. When lukewarm add yeast. Stir in flour. Let rise 1 hour and 20 minutes. Roll into balls. Dip in melted butter. Place balls in baking pan. Let rise 45 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pan for 5 minutes.

title: Elephant Ears
instructions: Stir flour 2 tbsp. sugar baking soda and salt. Stir in milk and 3 tbsp. of melted butter. Mix until dough forms. Sprinkle surface lightly with flour. Knead dough 10 times. Roll dough with rolling pin into a rectangle 9x5 inches. Brush with remaining melted butter. Sprinkle mixture of 3 tbsp. sugar and cinnamon. Roll dough up tightly beginning at narrow end. Pinch end of dough to seal. Cut into 4 equal pieces. Place cut side up on greased cookie sheet. Pat into circle. Sprinkle with more sugar. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 8 to 10 min. Remove from cookie sheet immediately. Let cool on wire rack.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Dissolve salt in 1 gallon boiling water and pour over cukes. Let stand 5 to 7 days. Rinse. Dissolve 2 tablespoons alum in 1 gallon boiling water. Let stand 24 hours. Rinse and split cukes (no matter how small); repeat 2 tablespoons alum in 1 gallon boiling water and let stand 24 hours. Rinse thoroughly. Prepare equal parts sugar and vinegar; bring to a boil. Pour over cukes. Let stand 24 hours. Pour off and add equal parts of sugar to vinegar solution. Bring to a boil and pour over cukes that have been packed in jars. Seal.

title: Strawberry Shake
instructions: Combine skim milk strawberries orange juice and sugar substitute in container of an electric blender or food processor. Process until strawberries are pureed and mixture is frothy. Transfer mixture to a small pitcher. Stir in buttermilk. Pour into individual glasses and serve immediately. Diabetic Exchange 1 skim milk. Each serving amount 1 cup. Calories 105.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into casserole.

title: Zesty Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook cream cheese and broth in large saucepan on low heat until cheese is melted stirring frequently with wire whisk. Stir in chicken vegetables and salad dressing mixes. Spoon into 9-inch pie plate. Cover with 1 pie crust; seal and flute edge. Cut several slits to permit steam to escape. Cut remaining pie crust into decorative shapes; arrange on crust. Place pie plate on cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 8 servings.

title: Salted Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Boil dry seeds for 5 minutes. Spray baking sheet with pam. spread seeds on baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Bake at 350 degrees until dry. Serve warm or cool.

title: Rock Road Cake Icing
instructions: Melt butter over low heat in a small pan. Add cocoa conf. sugar and milk. Stir and heat until everything is blended. Pour over cake (leave in pan) and spread.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar and cocoa in mixing bowl. Heat cola and oleo to boiling point. Pour over flour mixture. Add eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla. Mix well. Add marshmallows and stir with spoon until they are coated. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs (Cocktail)
instructions: Mix ground beef bread crumbs onions milk egg and next 3 ingredients. Make 1/2 to 1-inch size meatballs. Put shortening/oil in a skillet and cook until golden brown. Drain grease. In crock-pot preheat chili and jelly. After heated place meatballs in crock-pot. Let simmer approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours on low. Makes approximately 5 dozen.

title: Company Bread
instructions: Trim crust off top and sides of loaf of French bread. Cut Xs across top. Place Swiss cheese cut in small pieces in Xs. In pan melt butter mustard onion poppy seed and lemon juice until all is dissolved. Spoon over bread and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Pour into two 8-inch pie shells or 1 large pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Box Honey Graham Crackers
instructions: Break graham crackers into sections and line bottom of pan. Bring butter to boil 3 minutes stirring constantly. Pour over crackers and add pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Let cool.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: First brown hamburger. Drain the meat. Take 13 x 9-inch glass pan and butter both sides and bottom. Spread biscuits on both bottom and sides. Put meat on top of biscuits then put vegetables on top of meat. Put a little bit of water on top. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Pull out and put potatoes and cheese on top. Put back in oven for 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Chicken And Rice Bake
instructions: Place rice on bottom of casserole dish. Place uncooked chicken on top of rice. Pour onion soup mix over chicken. Mix milk soup and 1 soup can of water together. Pour over top of all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients together. Beat eggs; add sugar oil and pumpkin. Mix dry ingredients gradually into liquid mixture. Pour into four (1 pound) coffee cans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove while warm and wrap in foil.

title: Peachy Cobbler
instructions: Arrange drained peaches in a square baking pan. Pour lemon juice and spread brown sugar over peaches. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt in a bowl; set aside. Bring the oleo cocoa and water to a boil and add to the flour mixture. Mix together the remaining ingredients and add to the other mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes in a well-greased cookie sheet pan.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix one cornbread mix according to directions on box and add 1/2 can corn. Put in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer hamburger picante sauce cheese and the other cornbread mix mixed according to directions adding the other half of the corn. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Cut olives into large pieces. Cut bacon into 1/4-inch strips and cook slowly until crisp. When bacon is half done add onion and cook until soft. Drain off fat. Combine bacon and onion with eggs celery and olives. Add mayonnaise. Mix. Stuff tomatoes and serve on lettuce.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix corns with butter and sour cream. Add eggs and stir in muffin mix. Bake in a 9-inch pie pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Banana Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Combine cake mix pudding eggs oil 3/4 cup water and bananas. Mix well. Pour into greased and lightly floured bundt pan. Bake for 1 hour. Meanwhile combine sugar margarine and 1/4 cup water in sauce pan. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. When cake is done immediately pour sauce slowly over cake allowing time for it to be absorbed. Leave cake in pan for 20 minutes before removing.

title: Cheese And Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Heat milk; pour over bread crumbs. Add pimento parsley onion grated cheese and seasonings then add eggs. Put the vegetables in a greased or oiled 1 1/2-quart casserole; pour milk and cheese mixture over them. Set in pan of warm water. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain excess fat and set aside. Combine cornbread mixes together according to directions on box. Additionally add 1/3 cup milk and can of corn to the cornbread mixes. Using a nonstick spray prepare a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour a small amount of cornbread batter in pan to form a layer. Sprinkle meat mixture on top and then sprinkle grated cheese on top of the meat. Pour remaining cornbread mix on top of all and bake according to box directions.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar salt and nutmeg; add egg yolks. Mix. Add sour cream raisins lemon juice and nuts. Cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Spread meringue on top and brown.

title: Caf Viennese
instructions: Process in blender on liquefies until well blended. Store in airtight container.

title: Savory Fried Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. In large bag combine flour and seasonings. In shallow bowl beat eggs and water. Place chicken a few pieces at a time in bag and shake to coat. Dip in eggs and shake in bag again. Fry chicken until done. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Drink
instructions: Blend all ingredients until creamy looking.

title: Fruited Coleslaw
instructions: Combine cabbage marshmallows pineapple apple celery and enough salad dressing to moisten. Toss lightly and chill.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until lightly browned.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Put vegetables and salt into ice water; let stand for 3 hours. Drain. Bring to boil vinegar sugar and spices.\tAdd squash onions and peppers; boil for 3 minutes and put into jars and seal.

title: Limas In Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Place in casserole and bake for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Biscuit Topped Italian Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 12 x 8-inch (2-quart) baking dish. In large skillet brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Stir in water pepper tomato sauce and tomato paste. Simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vegetables and 1 1/2 cups cheese. Spoon mixture into greased baking dish. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Separate each biscuit into 2 layers. Place biscuits near outer edge of hot meat mixture overlapping slightly. Sprinkle remaining cheese in center and around edge. Gently brush biscuits with margarine and sprinkle with oregano. Bake for 22 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Chocolate-Almond Frosting
instructions: Mix butter with coffee salt and chocolate. Add rest of ingredients and beat thoroughly. Let stand for 5 minutes. Beat until creamy and frost tops and sides of cakes.

title: Rice And Broccoli Dish
instructions: Saute chopped onion in melted margarine until tender. Add the mushroom soup. Cut up 1/3 of a small box of Velveeta or American cheese. Add to onion and soup mixture. Melt cheese with mixture. Add 2 cups cooked rice and 10 ounces of frozen broccoli (thawed and drained). Pour in buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients like pie dough. Put half in 8 inch square pan. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread on crumbs. Put remaining crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Drop on greased sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix all together and put in a greased loaf pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Miss Jean'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine melted butter with dressing mix. Sprinkle small amount in casserole dish. Save enough to cover top of casserole and combine the rest of crumbs with the other ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle the reserved crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly and brown.

title: Shrimp Gumbo
instructions: Peel shrimp (uncooked) and devein. Make roux (dark) of flour and oil. Add shrimp to this for a few minutes stirring constantly. Set aside.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef cubes in oil. Add water salt and pepper for seasonings. Simmer slowly until meat is tender. Add vegetables and cook 30 minutes or until vegetables are done. Yield 6 servings. Carbohydrate 7 g protein 11 g fat 12 g calories 180. One serving = 1 1/2 meat medium fat exchange 1 vegetable exchange 1 fat exchange.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar beat egg and add to mixture. Tear bread slices and add with pineapple to first mixture. Mix together. Place in 1 1/2 to 2-quart greased baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Mix and pour over carrots. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Rachel'S Fruit Cake
instructions: Chop nuts. Place all nuts drained cherries and dates in a large bowl. Sift flour baking powder salt and sugar together. Coat the fruit and nuts with dry ingredients. Add vanilla to eggs and pour over coated fruit and nuts; mix well.

title: Sugar And Spice Pecans
instructions: Mix sugar cinnamon nutmeg and salt together. Beat egg whites and water until its meringue consistency. Add sugar mixture 1 tablespoon at a time. Beat to a stiff peak. Fold in pecan halves.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Mix coconut and pecans and press into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Prepare cake mix as directed. Pour over coconut and pecan mixture. Melt butter and cream cheese. Add powdered sugar. Mix well and drop by tablespoons on top of cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or when cracks form in center of cake. Do not overcook. No icing needed.

title: Surprise Muffins
instructions: Sift flour. Beat eggs in 2 cup measuring cup with wire whisk. Whisk in\tmilk and oil. Stir just until moistened. Do not beat. Fill greased and floured muffin pan 2/3 full. For Surprise Muffins fill 1/2 full then drop 1 teaspoon of jelly or preserves in center. Add more batter to make 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Baked Applesauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first four ingredients in a buttered casserole dish. Put butter on top of applesauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Autumn Pudding
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Pour into a 13x9 inch pan. Top with topping mix.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Add cool water. Set in refrigerator to cool until thick (soft). Add ground fruits nuts and liquids. Mix then pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together.

title: Sponge Cake Roll
instructions: Let egg whites stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Sift flour and salt and set aside. Coat a 15x10x1 baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Line with wax paper and coat the paper with spray. In a mixing bowl beat yolks until slightly thickened. Gradually add sugar and beating until thick and lemony colored. Add orange peel lemon juice and vanilla. Add sifted flour mixture and mix well. Batter will be thick. In another bowl beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Fold into batter. Spread into prepared pan. Bake at 350 for 12-15 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched in center. Cool on wire rack 5 minutes. Turn onto a kitchen towel. Sprinkle with 1 Tbsp. powdered sugar. Gently pull wax paper off and roll cake up jelly roll style starting with short side. Cool completely on wire rack. Unroll cake- spread marmalade evenly over cake within 1/2 inch of edges. Roll up again seam side down. Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Wrap and place in refrigerator one hour. Servings 8 - 5 Points.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix flour and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl. Cut in the Parkay and add the nuts. Mix in egg and soda. Press half of mixture in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into 1-gallon freezer. Finish filling with whole milk. Stir and freeze in ice cream freezer.

title: Chocolate Dream Bars
instructions: Mix until crumbly. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown and firm.

title: Fresh Tomato Soup
instructions: Simmer tomatoes in large saucepan for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add 1/4 cup butter soda 1 teaspoon salt and sugar. Let cool during preparation of next step. Melt the remaining 1/4 cup butter in large kettle. Add flour and 2 teaspoons salt. Add milk; heat and stir to boiling point. Combine the two mixtures and heat slowly. Add salt if needed and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into prepared crust. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Blend half and half and mayonnaise. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased casserole. Cover with 1/2 cup bread crumbs. Dot with butter if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Spread
instructions: Cook chicken in unsalted water to cover until tender. Remove from broth reserving 2 tablespoons broth. Cool. Bone chicken; chop fine. Combine cheese and mayonnaise beating until smooth. Add onion pickle juice celery curry powder salt pepper pimiento hot sauce and garlic powder; mix well. Stir in chicken and broth. Serve on crackers or lettuce leaves. Each tablespoon contains about 22 calories.

title: Chicken Carrie
instructions: Use a skillet or wok. Saute onion green pepper salt and pepper in chicken fat. Place potatoes on top of ingredients in skillet or wok then chicken breasts on top of potatoes. Pour in broth. Cover and simmer gently about 30 minutes. Do not stir.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Bring water gelatine sugar and pineapple to boil. Cook for five minutes. Remove from stove and while hot add cream cheese and cream. Stir until smooth. Add pecans. Pour into mold or decorative bowl. Chill until firm.

title: Dressing For Fresh Fruits
instructions: In small bowl combine all ingredients until smooth. Chill about 2 hours. Serve over fresh fruit salads. Yield 1 1/4 cups.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Melt margarine. Add chocolate chips. Keep over heat until melted. Add other ingredients. Pour into two unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar vanilla and egg. Mix well. Spread on bottom of deep 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Combine canned or cooked pumpkin sugar cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Mix well. Blend in beaten egg and evaporated milk. Carefully pour over cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes or until done. Cool. May be topped with Cool Whip or cream.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Refrigerate prepared pie shell. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl beat eggs well. Add sugar syrup flour salt and vanilla. Combine well. Stir in butter and nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 60 minutes or until filling is set in center. May cover crimped pie crust edges with foil so edges dont overcook.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cube steak and brown in skillet with garlic and pepper and a little oil. Add soy sauce and water. Cover and cook 20 minutes. Add sliced bell peppers and onions. Cook 10 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon cornstarch and cold water to thicken. Serve over rice.

title: Red Hot Salad
instructions: Dissolve red hots in hot water and add Jell-O.\tBlend thoroughly and cool. Add applesauce. Pour in loaf pan and jell.

title: Apple Bars
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking soda together. Add brown sugar and rolled oats. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Spread half the mixture in a greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Whisk together eggs and 3 tablespoons water until well blended. Combine bread crumbs and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Dip the sliced eggplant into the egg mixture then dredge in the bread crumb mixture. Cook the eggplant in 3 batches in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil (per batch) in a large skillet over medium heat 4 minutes on each side or until tender. Arrange 1/3 of eggplant in a single layer in a lightly greased 11 x 7 baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers twice. Spoon 3 cups pasta sauce over top. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Bake 10 more minutes or until cheese melts. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Cake Or Bread
instructions: Mix eggs oil sugar together and add pumpkin. Mix well. Mix flour soda salt cinnamon and baking powder together and add to wet ingredients. Fold in nuts or raisins. Bake in floured bundt pan or loaf pans for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Green Bean And Radish Salad In Sour Cream Vinaigrette
instructions: Bring plenty of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the beans and cook until just tender about 6 or 7 minutes. Drain and run under cold water to stop further cooking. Transfer the beans to a serving bowl. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon vinegar sour cream and oil. Whisk the dressing until smooth. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add the radishes scallions and dressing to the beans. Toss the salad gently with 2 spoons. Let the salad marinate at room temperature for 2 hours before serving. Turn salad to lunch dish by adding smoked turkey Swiss cheese or smoked ham cut into julienne strips.

title: Potatoes With Caraway Seed
instructions: Wash potatoes; do not peel. Halve them and dip cut side in caraway seed and salt. Place on greased baking sheet. Brush on melted butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cut and dice\tchicken breasts; season with seasoned salt pepper and Mrs. Dash. Cook slowly in slightly greased frying pan; do not brown meat. Simmer until done; may substitute chicken with shrimp or beef. Set aside.\tChop and cook green onions in slightly greased pan (drain any excess oil); set aside. Scramble eggs with about 1 tablespoon of cooked green onions; set aside. Begin\tfrying cooked rice (do not boil rice too long) in butter.

title: Whipping Cream Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender but still firm. Drain and let cool. Peel and shred potatoes. In a buttered 2-quart casserole place a layer of potatoes. Sprinkle with Lawrys salt and dot with butter. Repeat until all of potatoes have been used. Pour whipping cream on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Turkey Chili
instructions: Saute onions and garlic until onions are soft. Add turkey; brown. Add remaining ingredients; stir. Simmer over low heat for 1/2 to 2 hours. The longer this cooks the better it gets!

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: All spices should be dehydrated. Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown beef onion and pepper and then drain. Add spaghetti sauce mix and remaining ingredients.

title: Popovers
instructions: Put flour and salt in bowl. Add milk and eggs. Beat with a rotary beater for 3 minutes. Add melted butter and stir. Put in well-greased muffin tins (have tins hot). Bake in hot oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Yield will be 12 muffins.

title: Frozen Lemon Crumb Dessert
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar margarine and nuts until crumbly. Spread on cookie sheet lined with heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 13 to 15 minutes. Cool; break apart into crumbs. Line an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil leaving a 1 1/2-inch collar around top. Spread 2/3 of crumb mixture in bottom. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon color; blend in condensed milk. Add lemon juice and rind; stir until thickened. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into lemon mixture. Pour mixture into prepared pan; sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Freeze until firm. When solid cover with piece of foil the size of the top. Lift from pan and return to freezer. Slice in bars to serve.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake as directed then cool. Mix pudding also as directed. Crumble cake into a plastic square dish (pretty good size). Take half of your bowl of pudding and pour it over the cake. Add half of Cool Whip; stir lightly then add half of sprinkles of Heath bars on top. Repeat process one more time so theres 2 layers. Refrigerate!

title: Orange Cashew Chicken
instructions: Stir together orange juice soy sauce and ginger root. Add chicken. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Drain chicken. Reserve sauce. Saute chicken in olive oil. Stir together reserved sauce and cornstarch. Stir into pan and heat until thick and bubbly. Stir in orange sections and cashews.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix the ingredients together. Make into individual crab cakes. Fry until golden brown.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except almonds and put in ovenproof dish. Top with almonds. Place in oven for 15 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serve with crackers or nachos.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla then add potato chips and nuts; mix well. Stir in flour. Form into balls and press flat with the bottom of a sugar-coated glass on a cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Stuffed Hot Dogs
instructions: Combine onion carrots and hot shortening together; cook slowly for 5 minutes. Add bread cubes milk salt sage and pepper; mix well.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients in 8-inch square pan starting with rice. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie(Easy)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place in uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Pecans will rise to top.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: *I use 4 cups corn from my freezer.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Put the ingredients in a Corning Ware dish in the listed order. Do not stir. Dot 1/2 stick margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat first 5 ingredients together until smooth. Add apple and nuts. Mix well. Pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Speedy Charlie Chile
instructions: Drain the first three ingredients. Mix all together and heat.

title: Best (And Easy!) Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and flour. Beat for 10 minutes. Pour batter into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 until golden brown and toothpick inserted comes out clean. Great with strawberries and whipped cream or for wedding cakes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat the first 3 ingredients well then beat in the baking soda orange peel salt and flour. Mix in the apples and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased and floured Bundt pan for 50 to 55 minutes. Cake is done when toothpick comes out clean. Invert onto rack after cooling for 10 minutes. Serve plain or iced.

title: Carol'S Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix margarine and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs pumpkin and water. Blend in flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and cloves. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into a well-greased loaf pan 9 x 5 x 3-inch. Bake 65 to 70 minutes until toothpick stuck into center comes out clean.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Spray a 9 x 11-inch pan with Pam. Brown meat and drain. Add sauce and paste and all other ingredients except noodles and cheese. Cook until flavors blend.

title: Chopped Beef Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese; add finely chopped onions beef garlic and Worcestershire sauce. Chill; serve on crackers.

title: No Cook Fudge
instructions: Melt oleo and cheese together in a large pan. Be very careful not to get too hot. Add sugar cocoa vanilla and nutmeats. Mix well then spread in two 9 x 13-inch buttered pans. Let cool 30 minutes before cutting in squares. Makes about 7 pounds.

title: Boiled Tongue
instructions: Scrub tongue well. Cover with boiling water and bring to a boil. Skim cover and simmer until tender 3 to 4 hours. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt per pound when partially cooked. Remove skin when tender. To 2 cups strained water in which tongue has been boiled add the rest of the ingredients. Blend together to form sauce. Place tongue in roasting pan; pour over sauce. Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 turning often.

title: Robert Fraga'S Cuban Black Bean Soup
instructions: Preparation Time Soak beans overnight cook for 3 hours.

title: Bubbling Cheese Bread
instructions: In medium bowl combine the first 3 ingredients. Spread cheese mixture on cut side of each bread half. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Broil 4 inches from heat for 3 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Time Out For Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine dressing soy sauce and ginger. Pour over chicken. Marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Place wings on broiler pan. Broil 15 to 20 minutes turning once. Brush occasionally with marinade. Makes 36 appetizers.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook the potatoes in their skins. Cool peel and cut up in fine pieces. Cook the eggs and cool peel and cut up. Chop up the peeled onion. Put all together. Sprinkle the salt pepper and celery seed over them. Then mix the salad dressing vinegar and sugar together. You may have to add more sugar and vinegar to make it taste real tart. Mix all together while potatoes and eggs are still warm.

title: St. Patrick'S Trader Vic Salad
instructions: Mix all but lettuce and croutons. Toss with greens and top with croutons.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spoon into paper lined muffin cup and freeze. Remove from freezer a few minutes before serving. Makes 15 servings.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: In a frying pan brown ground beef. Drain off fat. Mix in Parmesan cheese onion oregano tomato paste and Mozzarella cheese. Cut French bread in half lengthwise. Lay bread cut side up on a cookie sheet. Spread meat mixture evenly over top of bread halves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Old Fashioned Mince Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix mincemeat and apple. Pour into pastry lined pie pan. Cover with top crust which has slits in it. Seal and flute. Cover edge with 1 1/2-inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent excess browning. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until crust is nicely browned. Serve slightly warm with whipped cream on top.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well; roll in pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Herb Biscuits
instructions: You will also need nonstick spray coating.

title: Cream Frosting
instructions: Boil to desired thickness. Large bubbles will form.

title: Dietetic Date Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sweetener vanilla and egg. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to mixture. Add applesauce dates and nuts. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in loaf pan.

title: Quick Uncooked Cookies
instructions: Mix together sugar milk cocoa and butter; bring to a boil. Boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat; then add quick cooking oatmeal vanilla and pecans. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Veal Cutlets
instructions: Pound meat. Sprinkle with salt. Dip first in flour then in eggs and then in bread crumbs. Fry in butter or oil until brown. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut up your favorite fruit into a bowl. Add chopped walnuts and shredded coconut as desired.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a glass 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate overnight. (If you use an aluminum pan store ingredients in a glass bowl and transfer just before baking). Sprinkle crushed potato chips over top and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 12.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onion in butter until transparent. Add ground beef. Cook stirring until beef is light brown. Add the flour salt pepper mushrooms and soup. Cook for 5 minutes. Add the sour cream and simmer for 15 minutes longer. Serve over cooked rice or cooked egg noodles. Garnish with paprika. Makes 4 servings.

title: Seasoned Brussels Sprouts Parmesan
instructions: In large saucepan add brussels sprouts salt and butter to 2 inches of water. Bring to boil cover and cook until tender about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain. Add salad crunches and parsley and sprinkle parmesan to cover sprouts. Serve warm. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Edible Rocket
instructions: Peel the banana. Cut it in half crosswise. Cut the pineapple ring into quarters. Place a banana half on a plate. Place 2 pineapple quarters near the base of the banana. Spoon 1/4 cup of the cottage cheese around the bottom and eat!

title: Easter Lily
instructions: Mix all together. Drop on greased cookie sheet (about 1 teaspoon) six on sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Pinch together while hot in the shape of a lily. Fill open end with Cool Whip and cherry.

title: Marinated Steak
instructions: Mix together the wine soy sauce and seasonings. Place the steak in a long glass baking dish and pour the marinade over the meat. Cover and chill at least 12 to 18 hours turning the meat over once or twice. Preheat the broiler. Remove the steak from the marinade. Pat dry and broil 4-inches from the heat for about 5 minutes on each side. To serve cut thin slices diagonally across the grain. Serve with rice.

title: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix in very large bowl Raisin Bran sugar flour and salt. Add soda cinnamon beaten eggs oil and 1 quart of buttermilk; mix well. Stir all the way to the bottom; refrigerate. Do not stir again. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Keep in refrigerator for 6 weeks. Use just what you need each time. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Johnny Cake
instructions: Heat water to a boil. In a large mixing bowl combine cornmeal sugar and salt. Add boiling water stirring gradually into 3 ingredients. Batter should not be too thin. Add milk and butter. Using a small ladle pour batter onto hot greased griddle forming cakes about 3 inches in diameter. Fry until browned on both sides. Serve with maple syrup. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Banana Cream Pie(No Bake)
instructions: Mix pudding mix with cold milk at lowest speed of mixer for 3 minutes. Remove mixer. Fold in 1/2 cup whipped topping. Slice banana into pie crust. Pour in pudding. Chill 3 hours. Top with remaining whipped topping.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix well. Place mixture into one pie shell. Place the other pie shell on top. Brush top with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix and blend well. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or longer.

title: Pineapple Spoon Bread
instructions: Grease 2-quart casserole. Mix sugar flour and salt. Beat in eggs. Add pineapple. Pour in pan. Tear bread or croissants into pieces and spread over mixture. Pour melted butter over bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour or until it stops jiggling.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a baking pan 9 x 9 x 2-inches. Mix all ingredients except whipped cream or applesauce in a large mixer bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed scraping the bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes on medium speed scraping occasionally. Pour into the pan. Bake 50 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or applesauce.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Mix apples and candy until well blended. Gently stir in whipped topping. Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve. Garnish with apple slices and additional chopped candy bars if desired.

title: Goulash
instructions: Simmer all for 1/2 hour. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking to pan.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain corn peas and beans. Then mix peppers celery and pimientos with first mixture. Bring to boil the oil vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables; mix well. Chill and serve. Keeps for weeks.

title: Day Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together while potatoes are warm. Put in casserole a day ahead. Warm in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Especially good with ham.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine preceding ingredients; chill. Serve with chopped vegetables or cut up dark pumpernickel bread.

title: Mmmmm Impossible Taco Pie
instructions: Cook ground beef onions and seasoning mix together until meat turns color; drain. Put in a greased 8 x 8-inch square pan. Spread beans on top of meat. Mix Bisquick milk and eggs; pour over beans. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Sprinkle cheese on top and put back into oven until cheese is melted. Serve with remaining ingredients.

title: Corn Puddings
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together. Stir in corn and all other ingredients. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake until thick but not too dry (approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0).

title: Smoky Sausage Spread
instructions: Cut up cooked sausage links in small fine pieces; set aside. Combine cheese spread and Monterey Jack cheese; beat with mixer until well combined. Stir in sausage. Spread on bread bagels or English muffins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Pilau
instructions: Cook hen with celery bay leaves salt pepper and enough water to cover. When the chicken is ready to fall from the bones remove from broth; set aside.

title: Apple Pie Mix
instructions: Sprinkle apples with sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Add vanilla and lemon juice. Cook slowly for about 25 minutes stir occasionally.

title: Coconut Surprise
instructions: Mix and bake cake (per directions) and let cool for about 15 minutes. Poke holes in top of cake. Mix together milk and cream of coconut. Pour mixture on top of cake. Put in refrigerator and let set. Sprinkle coconut and/or nuts on top.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until time to serve.

title: A Fall Supper
instructions: Brown slices of country ham in ample grease (I use Crisco). Remove ham. Brown flour very brown put a lot of black pepper in pan and add tomato juice. Add water to desired consistency and simmer. Fry apples in a frying pan adding sugar and bacon drippings until done (add a bit of salt). Add a pan full of steaming hot biscuits that contain chunks of cheese in the center. Together with grits and lots of the tasty tomato gravy you will have a feast incomparable.

title: Cavsa From Peru
instructions: Boil potatoes and mash well. Add lemon juice oil salt and hot pepper. Place a layer of mixture in bottom of serving dish. Saute onion and spread over potato mixture. May add other cooked chopped fine vegetables. Cover with second layer of potatoes. Sprinkle with grated cheese (optional). Garnish with olives sliced hard-boiled eggs and serve on lettuce.

title: Turkey Stuffing
instructions: Soak bread in water for 5 minutes. Cook onions celery and sausage in butter for 10 minutes or until sausage is cooked. Combine with bread and add eggs walnuts salt pepper broth and giblets. Mix well.

title: Lattice Jam Bars
instructions: Mix together the almonds and sugar. Blend in butter and flour. Mix well. Add egg yolks. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thick. Save half for cross bars. Spread on cookie sheet then spread 1 pound apricot jam over dough. Make cross bars by rolling out dough and cutting into strips. Crisscross strips on top of jam to give lattice effect. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until light brown. Great!

title: Dump Delight Cake
instructions: Spread pie filling and pineapple in a 13 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit (do not stir). Top with nuts; add coconut. Pour melted butter over all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Great with ice cream. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Broiled Salmon With Herbed Lemon Butter
instructions: Line broiler pan with foil and place salmon fillets on the well-greased rack. Combine remaining ingredients; baste salmon with mixture. Broil 4 inches from heat allowing 10 minutes cooking time per inch of thickness measured at its thickest part or until salmon flakes easily when tested with a fork. Do not turn salmon. Baste several times during cooking. Makes 8 servings.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Combine and melt over medium heat. Pour over popped corn. Bake at 250\u00b0 in two 15 x 9-inch pans for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes and stirring after removed from oven until cooled. Keeps well in an airtight container or bag. Can halve recipe. Also can use the large bags of popped corn but omit salt if you do.

title: New Uncooked White Mystery Fruitcake
instructions: Bake cake mix following package directions. Cool. Crumble cake into very large bowl or pan. Add fruit to crumbled cake. Make Betty Crocker frosting mix following package directions. Mix with cake and fruit. Pack tightly into foil-lined 10-inch tube pan or two 9 x 3-inch loaf pans. Cover cake with foil and chill in refrigerator at least 24 hours. Cake should be kept refrigerated. Slice with sharp knife.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Strata
instructions: Place bread cubes in 12 x 18-inch nonstick pan. Combine chicken onion celery chilies mayonnaise salt and pepper in medium bowl and spoon over bread. Tear tortillas into bite-sized pieces and place on top. Combine eggs milk cottage cheese and soup in a small bowl and pour over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to blend. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 and bake 50 to 60 minutes or until the dish is firm and set. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8.

title: Texas Potatoes
