instructions: Mix all ingredients but last two. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with crushed corn flakes and dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Lasagna Squares
instructions: Grease square baking dish. Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in dish. Mix cooked beef herbs tomato paste and 1/2 cup Mozzarella; spoon evenly over top. Beat milk eggs Bisquick salt and pepper with a wire whisk until smooth. Pour into dish. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cool for 5 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cafe Au Lait Mix
instructions: Combine 4 tablespoons of mix with 2/3 cup of hot water.

title: Summer Squash Pasta
instructions: Cut zucchini and squash into fourths lengthwise then into 1/2-inch sections crosswise. Dice onion; mince garlic. Fry onion in enough oil to keep it from sticking. Add garlic when onion is soft. Then add squash. Cook on medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture collapses and becomes soft. Remove from heat and add cheese the salt and pepper to taste (cheese is quite salty). Serve over or mix into pasta adding more olive oil as needed. Serve with green salad if desired.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated stirring occasionally. Sprinkle each serving with crumbled bacon and green onions. Makes 1-quart.

title: Applesauce-Raisin Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Sift flour soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon into a bowl. Add rolled oats and raisins. Mix applesauce oil egg vanilla and sweetener together. Add to dry ingredients; mix just until moistened. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done. Yields 2 dozen cookies.

title: Cat'S Meow(Cold Fruit Candy)
instructions: Put all dry ingredients through grinder 2 or 3 times. Knead well after adding butter fruit juice and vanilla. Let stand several hours. Roll out to about 3/4-inch thick; cut into cubes or bars. Sprinkle liberally with powdered sugar; store in covered containers in refrigerator.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Butter a 2-quart casserole. Put 1 can of pineapple on bottom of dish. Mix cheeses together and sprinkle half of cheese mixture on top of pineapple. Mix flour and sugar and sprinkle on cheese. Follow with second can of pineapple and the remaining half of flour-sugar mixture leaving remaining half of cheese mixture for top. Pour 1/2 cup pineapple juice over entire dish and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and brown.

title: Cheese Rolls
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients and form into logs. Roll logs in chopped beef until well covered. Can be prepared ahead of time and kept refrigerated several days. Serve with crackers.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Prepare egg noodles as directed; drain. Brown hamburger meat; drain. Combine all ingredients together. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch dish; sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine Crisco brown sugar egg milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Combine oats flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Mix into creamed mixture at a low speed. Stir in raisins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all together; drop and bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Makes lots.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels
instructions: Mix all together. Spread over tortillas; roll up. Wrap tightly in plastic. Refrigerate overnight. Cut 1/2 to 3/4-inch and serve with salsa.

title: Creamy Vinaigrette Dressing
instructions: Whisk together and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Coconut Flan
instructions: Mix both milks eggs and vanilla until well combined. Stir in the flaked coconut and pour the mixture into 6 individual custard cups or a larger flan mold. Place the cups or mold in a large baking pan and fill it with water to a depth of 1-inch. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean. A flan mold will take longer than individual cups. Allow to cool then refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Crumble half of cake in bottom of bowl. Layer half of pudding pineapple and pie filling. Repeat with second layer. Add large Cool Whip on top. Nuts and coconut are optional. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Fried Fish
instructions: Cut fillets in 4-inch portions. Season with salt and pepper. Mix nuts and cayenne. Dip fillets in egg and water mix; roll in flour. Fry in butter in skillet or microwave 5 minutes with nut mix sprinkled over fillets.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and milk. Bring to a rolling boil cook for 7 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add chocolate chips and marshmallows. Stir until dissolved. Pour into 2- 9 x 13 buttered pans. Cool. Cut into squares. Makes 5 lbs.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In large Pyrex casserole well greased put 1 cup milk and 1 egg. Beat with fork until well blended. Add in layers cooked macaroni grated cheese dots of butter salt and pepper. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Arrange sliced tomatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated through.

title: Green Bean Casserole (Quick And Easy)
instructions: Mix green beans and cream of mushroom soup and top with onion rings. Place in microwave until steaming hot.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: In a large non-stick pot heat oil over medium-high heat. Add beef; saute until browned about 6 minutes. Place on plate.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips and cheese; blend well together. Spoon into a lightly greased 3 quart shallow casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Put sprinkling of potato chips over surface during last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Melt margarine. Add other ingredients and stir together. Pour into a glass casserole dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Melt butter in a pie plate. Beat eggs with mixer (eggs only); then mix in sugar flour sweet milk vanilla and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until middle is done.

title: Chili-Cheese Rounds
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix beans onion and pepper sauce; reserve. Mix baking mix and sour cream until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes. Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth covered board. Knead 20 times. Roll dough 1/4 inch thick. Cut with floured 2-inch cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press a deep indention about 1 1/2 inches in diameter in center of each round with floured hands. Fill each with generous teaspoon of bean mixture; spread within indention. Top each with chilies and cheese. Bake until light brown 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Snicker Bar Salad
instructions: Dice apples with peeling on. Slice bananas and the refrigerated candy bars into bite size pieces. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine all ingredients. In a large baking pan shape into a loaf. Bake 1 hour or until done. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Roasted Garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Trim off each garlic head to expose the tops of the cloves. Place heads in shallow baking dish such as a 9-inch pie plate. Drizzle garlic with oil and sprinkle with pepper salt and thyme. Roast garlic for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and cook for 1 hour longer. Serve garlic with slices of crusty French bread butter and goat cheese such as Feta. Pop the cloves out of the skins and spread on bread. Yield 8 servings.

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine. Mix all ingredients well and bake in greased 8-inch casserole at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Coffee Liqueur
instructions: Mix in blender and drink.

title: Honey Cornbread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Beat eggs add cream oil and honey. Stir into dry ingredients until just moistened. Pour into 9 inch square pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

title: Spiced Coffee
instructions: In saucepan combine all ingredients except coffee. Heat to boiling. Strain. Pour liquid over coffee in heatproof container. Stir coffee until dissolved.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease a 2-quart casserole. Wash pare and thinly slice potatoes; measure 8 cups. Cook potatoes and onions covered in small amount of boiling water with 2 teaspoon salt for about 5 minutes or until slightly tender. Drain. Melt butter or margarine in saucepan; remove from heat. Stir in flour pepper paprika and remaining salt until smooth. Blend in milk. Cook stirring over medium heat to boiling point or until thickened and smooth. In prepared casserole layer one-third of potatoes and onions; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon parsley. Top with one-third of the sauce. Repeat then add remaining potatoes and top with remaining sauce. Bake uncovered for 35 minutes or until top is browned and potatoes are tender when pierced with fork. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Melt margarine with 2 cups flour and 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Put into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased) and press on bottom and sides to form crust. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Beat eggs; add sugar mixed with 1/4 cup flour and the lemon juice. Pour this over baked crust. Return to oven and bake 20 minutes longer. Remove from oven; sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot. Let cool before cutting.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine rice sugar 6 cups milk and water. Bring to a boil. Cook 1 hour covered over low heat stirring occasionally. Mix together the eggs vanilla and 2 cups milk. Add to the heated rice mixture and heat an additional 10 minutes.

title: One Bowl Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Microwave chocolate and milk in a large microwavable dish on High for 2 or 3 minutes until chocolate is melted stirring half way through heating time. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir in vanilla and walnuts. Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mix all the ingredients together. If you are using broccoli thaw it in the microwave and drain well before mixing it in. Place mixture in ungreased casserole bowl and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove and stir well during this cooking time. After it is done let it stand for a few minutes.

title: Meat And Potato Cakes
instructions: Mix ground beef with sauce onion and salt. Shape into patties. Brown on each side. Put hot potatoes on each patty. Sprinkle with cheese and brown or until cheese melts.

title: Cake
instructions: Mix the yellow cake mix one of the eggs and the margarine together and press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat for 3 minutes the other 2 eggs cream cheese and sugar. Pour on top of the \crust.\ Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Luck'S Chili Hot Beans
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan cook beef and onions until beef is brown; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Makes about 7 one cup servings.

title: One Step Lasagna
instructions: Divide noodles into 3 for the 3 layers. Combine water with sauce in bowl. Cover bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with 1 1/2 cups sauce. Arrange layer of uncooked noodles slightly overlapping on top of sauce. Spread 1/2 Ricotta and Mozzarella over noodles. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Add layer of sauce. Layer noodles with the remaining Ricotta and Mozzarella and 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Top with layer of noodles. Pour remaining sauce over spreading evenly to cover edges of noodles. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan. Cover tightly with heavy-duty foil. Set on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand covered on rack for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line baking sheets with parchment paper or coat with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl whisk together the sugar applesauce egg white oil and vanilla until smooth. Stir in raisins. In a medium size bowl stir together the oats cake flour whole wheat flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Using a wooden spoon stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixing just until blended. Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto a prepared baking sheet spacing cookies about 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Transfer cookies to a wire rack; let cool. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Frankie Rouse'S 7-Minute Icing
instructions: Place all ingredients except marshmallows and vanilla in top of double boiler over boiling water and beat with a rotary beater 7 minutes or until mixture holds a peak. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and marshmallows. Continue to beat until well blended and apply to cake.

title: Cheese Souffle
instructions: Line sides and bottom of medium size casserole dish with bread dipped in melted butter or margarine. Mix other ingredients together and pour into bread-lined dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water; add strawberries bananas and nuts. Put 1/2 of mixture in glass bowl or mold and refrigerate until firm. Spread 1/2 of the sour cream on first mixture of Jell-O and pour remaining Jell-O mixture on top of sour cream. Chill again until firm. Spread the remaining sour cream on top. Better if made the day before.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Boil spaghetti according to directions on package. Drain off hot water and rinse spaghetti in cold water 3 times. Add Zesty Italian dressing. Mix well. Add at least a half bottle of seasoning mix. Stir well. Cut up all vegetables and add them to spaghetti mixture. Store in refrigerator. Serve cold.

title: Easy Clams And Linguini
instructions: Fry garlic and onion in oil until lightly browned. Add clams with only 1/2 juice parsley and a little salt and pepper. Add wine; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve over cooked linguini.

title: Microwave Party Mints
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup milk and cream of tartar in a 2-quart glass measure. Cook on High for 6 minutes. Let stand 3 to 4 minutes until slightly cooled. Beat vigorously until creamy. Add peppermint extract and food coloring. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto sheets of foil. Let stand until cool and firm. Store in airtight container. Makes about 36 mints.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers and margarine. Place in a 2-quart buttered casserole dish. Mix crackers with margarine. Sprinkle on top of vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: American Meat Loaf
instructions: Thoroughly combine all ingredients and shape into a loaf pan (8 x 4 x 1 1/2-inches). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Allow meat loaf to stand 5 minutes before slicing. Makes 6 servings.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry for 9-inch crust. Sprinkle bacon cheese and onion in pastry-lined pie pan. Blend remaining ingredients with mixer. Pour into pie pan. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300\u00b0. Bake pie 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean. Let pie stand 10 minutes before cutting. Serve in wedges.

title: Torn Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all the ingredients into blender. Can add roquefort or bleu cheese. Keeps well.

title: Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts in top of double boiler over medium heat.\tStir constantly until smooth. Then add nuts. Spread in 9 x 5-inch buttered pan.\tCool and cut in squares.

title: Chicken Rotel
instructions: Cook spaghetti in 2-quart stock. If you do not have that much stock add a little water. Drain. Add cubed cheese. Add mushrooms onions (cooked in butter) bell pepper and chicken Ro-Tel and Worcestershire. Fold in peas last. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves approximately 8.

title: Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Combine crumbs and melted butter; place in bottom of an 8-inch square pan. Combine cream cheese powdered sugar and whipped cream. Pour in pan and spoon blueberry filling on top. Freeze for 2 hours before serving.

title: Cottage Herb Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. In large bowl combine flour sugar oregano and salt. Mix well. Cut in cold margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Blend in cheese egg and yeast. Turn out on well floured surface. Knead. Shape into ball. Place in well-greased bowl. Brush top with melted margarine; cover. Let rise until doubled. Punch down. Shape as desired. Brush with melted margarine; cover. Let rise again until nearly doubled. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Serve warm. Yield 1 1/2 to 2 dozen.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Appetizers
instructions: Drain crabmeat; press to remove excess fluid. Flake. Mix crabmeat onions cheese seasonings and mayonnaise. Remove stems and scrape gills from mushrooms with a spoon to make deep cups. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Stuff mushrooms generously with crab mixture. Place in ungreased shallow baking dish. Bake 5 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Turn oven to broil. Broil until golden brown about 15 minutes.

title: Apple Punch
instructions: Combine juices in freezer container. Mix well. Freeze for 2 days. Place mixture in a punch bowl. Add ginger ale 1 hour before serving.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Butter a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan. Mix rice and both soups and spread into loaf pan. Lay chicken parts on top of rice. Mix onion soup water and lemon juice and pour over each piece of chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar and milk to soft ball stage then add marshmallow peanut butter and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour into 9-inch pan let cool then cut.

title: Sue'S Shrimp Cocktail
instructions: Mix all ingredients together very thoroughly and chill. Use salt and pepper to taste.

title: Gnocchi
instructions: Beat egg before you mix in rest of ingredients. Flour hands and separate dough into 4 sections. Roll each section into snakes on a floured surface. Cut 1-inch pieces out of the snakes and with thumb press flat. Fast freeze (about 10 minutes) on a cookie sheet. When hard cook in boiling water (salted) for 5 minutes after they rise to the top of the pot. Serve with spaghetti sauce.

title: Whole-Grain Soda Bread
instructions: About 4 hours before serving or early in day preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. In large bowl combine first 6 ingredients and 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour. With pastry blender or two knives used scissor-fashion cut in margarine or butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in raisins and caraway seed. Stir in buttermilk just until flour is moistened (dough will be sticky).

title: Venison Stroganoff
instructions: In large skillet saute onion. (I like to add garlic also.) Add venison and cook until browned. Add mushrooms and brown then add soup and sour cream. Cover and simmer 30 to 60 minutes. Electric fry pan works good. Serve over hot noodles.

title: Cheesy Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni until slightly tender. Drain. Set aside. Brown meat and onions in small skillet. Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Oil a 1-quart casserole dish; spoon in 1/3 of meat mixture. Add cooked macaroni and then add remaining meat. Spread cheese soup over all (may be frozen uncooked). Cover the casserole tightly; bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix together and boil for several minutes. Can add a few marshmallows for a change; let them melt in sauce while hot.

title: Chocolate Chip S'More Cookie
instructions: Microwave Directions Spread 1/2 teaspoon peanut butter on flat side of each cookie. Place marshmallow between peanut butter spread sides of cookies making a sandwich on microwave-safe paper towel. Microwave on High for 6 to 8 seconds or until marshmallow is slightly softened. Squeeze cookie together slightly. Makes 1 cookie.

title: Cuban Black Bean Pie(Yields 24 Servings)
instructions: Combine eggs honey cilantro cumin lime juice lime zest cayenne pepper and salt; reserve. Combine beans rice and cheese; spread in pie shells. Top with reserved egg mixture.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Blend ingredients. Put in a greased bread pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Pickle Chips
instructions: Wash cucumbers; trim ends. Cut cucumbers into 1/4-inch slices. Combine cucumber slices red pepper onion and garlic in a large bowl; add salt and stir well. Pack crushed ice over cucumbers;\tcover and let stand 24 hours. Drain well. Rinse cucumber mixture several\ttimes in cold water; drain well. Remove and discard garlic. Pack cucumber mixture into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace.

title: Venison Ala Desjardins
instructions: In heavy skillet brown salt pork in olive oil. Add vegetables and saute until slightly tender. Remove pork and vegetables leaving fat in skillet. Add 1/4 cup pickle juice to skillet and brown meat. Baste meat with juice while browning. Sugar in juice will caramelize and glaze meat. Turn meat and baste with additional 1/4 cup of juice. Add more juice as needed. Juice will cook off as meat browns. Put all the remaining ingredients in a large covered roasting pan or kettle and cook in 325\u00b0 oven for approximately 4 hours or cook covered on top of stove for 4 hours or until tender. Pour gravy over sliced meat to serve.

title: Black Bean Salad
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain soaking liquid. Cook 1 hour. Rinse and chill beans. Mix all ingredients. Pour over with Italian dressing. Will keep several days.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and broccoli until tender. Do not salt anything. Saute onions and celery in butter. Combine all ingredients. Pour into 11 x 7 inch casserole dish. Let stand in refrigerator for 12 hours. Bake on 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Apple Nut Pudding
instructions: Beat the egg until foamy. Add sugar and beat again. Sift together the flour salt and baking powder and beat into the egg-sugar mixture.\tBlend in the apples nuts and vanilla.\tBake in a pie pan at 350\u00b0 until the top is crisp about 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Baked Beans Supreme
instructions: If using a low watt oven first check the oven cavity to be sure it will hold a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole.

title: Ann Lander'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix and place in loaf pan; add sauce and bake.

title: Candied Ham
instructions: Place ham with pineapple and brown sugar on top in 400\u00b0 oven wrapped tightly in aluminum foil for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Almond Butter Crunch
instructions: Mix everything in a 10 inch skillet. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly until the mixture turns golden brown (about 5 or 6 minutes). Spread in a greased 8 or 9 inch round pan. Cool. Remove from pan and break into pieces.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix juices and sugar; stir in beaten egg. Cook in double boiler for 5 minutes until spoon is coated. Good on fruits and melons.

title: Stuffed Sweet Peppers
instructions: Mix ground beef onion 2/3 cup chopped pepper and cooked rice. Add crumbled bread and tomato juice; mix well. Take seeds out of the 8 sweet peppers and drop peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain and fill with ground beef mixture. Put in a large pot with lid and pour ketchup over top of peppers. Add 1/2 cup of tomato juice to pot. Cover and cook 2 hours in oven at 350\u00b0. Uncover and cook 30 minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Place water in a saucepan. Add cloves and cinnamon. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add the tea at once; stir to distribute and immerse leaves. Cover and steep 5 minutes. Strain. While tea steeps heat orange and lemon juices with sugar added to a boil. Stir into the hot tea and serve at once in teacups. Makes 7 or 8 servings.

title: Blueberry Syrup
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch and blend well. Add water syrup and lemon juice. Mix well. Add blueberries and cool stirring constantly until sauce comes to a boil and is thickened.

title: Stuffed Cornish Game Hens
instructions: Prepare stuffing as directed on package. Do not stuff hens until ready to roast. Rinse hens with cold water. Pat dry. Rub neck and body cavities with salt and pepper. Lightly stuff cavities with prepared stuffing. Roast at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Place any remaining stuffing in a small baking dish; bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. (Meanwhile heat orange juice and butter; baste hens frequently during the last 30 minutes of roasting.)

title: Beef And Potato Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Oil a 2-quart casserole. Chop onion and garlic. Cook in oil the onion then garlic for 1 minute. Crumble beef in pan. Add salt pepper thyme and marjoram; cook until browned. Peel and thinly slice potatoes. Drain and chop tomatoes. Add tomatoes and bread crumbs to beef. Arrange 1/2 potatoes on bottom of pan overlapping halfway up sides. Pack beef into pan. Cover with remaining potatoes. Bake until browned for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except juice potatoes and hamburger). Simmer over medium heat until tender; then discard bay leaf. Add juice diced potatoes and partly fried hamburger. Cook until potatoes are soft.

title: Mexican Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning all together. Shape into a mound on a plate. Spread salsa sauce over top. Sprinkle chopped ingredients over top. Sprinkle cheese over top last. Serve chilled with corn tortilla chips.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Saute hamburger pepper and onion together until meat is brown. Add seasonings and keep mixture warm. Melt cheese and Ro-Tel together. Keep warm. In individual salad bowls layer Fritos meat lettuce and tomatoes. Cover with cheese sauce.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad
instructions: Marinate artichoke hearts in vinegar and oil for 4 to 6 hours; drain and reserve liquid.

title: Baked Beans With Pineapple And Bacon
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon in 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cook bacon crisp; blot on paper towel. Crumble up and add to bean mixture before serving. Very good.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine. Add flour cream cheese salt liquid chicken macaroni and pimiento. Mix well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until slightly browned.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together and set aside. Mix Dream Whip together by directions on box. Fold into cream mixture. Put in chilled crust and top with blueberry pie filling. (Can substitute strawberry or cherry pie filling.)

title: Old Fashioned Pot Roast With Egg Noodles
instructions: Brown rump roast in oil in Dutch oven. Remove meat; drain off fat. Combine mushrooms vegetables garlic 1 1/4 teaspoons salt bouillon cubes pepper bay leaves tomato paste and 2 cups water in Dutch oven; heat to boiling point. Add roast. Simmer covered for 4 hours.

title: Confetti Rice
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet. Add rice toss to coat with butter. Heat on low for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Place rice mixture in a 2-quart casserole bowl; add hot chicken broth. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Cook 5 additional minutes. Serves 4.

title: Surprise Cheese Puffs
instructions: Blend cheese with butter; add flour salt and paprika. Mix well. Pat olives dry on paper towel. Mold 1 teaspoon dough around each olive to cover. At this point you can refrigerate or freeze puffs for up to 10 days. They hold their shape better if frozen first. Bake puffs on lightly greased cookie sheet in a 400\u00b0 oven until lightly golden brown approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Pasta Primevara
instructions: Toss all vegetables in enough olive oil to coat; add herbs. Spread out onto 2 cookie sheets and roast in oven at 400\u00b0 until well done and crispy about 15-20 minutes stirring vegetables at least once during baking.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Torta
instructions: Soak bread in hot milk. Set aside. Beat together eggs and sugar. Add to soaked bread/milk mixture. Add vanilla raisins and grated apple. Add brandy last. Bake in well-greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tasty Carrots
instructions: Grate carrots. Place\tin 8-inch Dutch oven.\tMix the rest of the ingredients and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Enchilada Bake
instructions: Cook meat mix in refried beans taco seasoning mix until hot and blended. Mix enchilada sauce and soup together warm. Put meat mixture in middle of tortilla roll and place in greased baking dish. Pour sauce mixture over rolled tortillas sprinkle with cheese and bake until bubbly.

title: Pickled Shrimp
instructions: Place shrimp in boiling salted water; reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender; drain and rinse with cold water then chill.

title: Shortcut Manicotti
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients; mix well. Spoon into uncooked manicotti shells. Arrange in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine picante sauce and 1/2 cup water; pour over manicotti.

title: Poached Catfish
instructions: In medium sized microwave-safe dish place fish. In cup combine butter wine lemon juice thyme tarragon paprika and salt and pepper to taste. Cover and microwave on High (100% power) 2 1/2 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with fork. Rotate dish one-quarter turn halfway through cooking time. To serve garnish with parsley and lemon.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Mix together sugar butter egg and vanilla. Beat with mixer until creamy. Add baking powder to flour. Alternate flour and milk to mixture beating with mixer until well mixed. Fold in drained blueberries. Spoon out into muffin tins. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together the sugar cornstarch salt eggs and enough milk to make a smooth paste; add to scalded milk. When it comes to a boil boil for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Add remaining milk vanilla and Grape-Nuts. Can add Eagle Brand. Yields 8 quarts. Okay to use for 6 quarts just dont add Eagle Brand.

title: Crunchy Pickle And Ham Appetizer
instructions: Pat ham and pickle spears dry with paper towel. Spread 13 ham slices each with about 1 Tbsp. cream cheese. Top each with 1 pickle spear; roll up. Refrigerate 1 hour or overnight. Cut each pickle roll into 4 to 6 pieces to serve. Makes 62 to 78.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat. Add all ingredients except noodles and cheese. Season to taste. Simmer for at least 3 hours. Do not skim off too much fat or lasagna will be dry. Cook noodles as directed on package but add 1 tablespoon oil to prevent sticking. Place in pan as follows layer of noodles and layer of cheese. Repeat ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Morgan'S Magnificient Obsession
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine sugar and flour; set aside. In a medium saucepan melt butter or margarine with cocoa and water; bring to a boil. Pour mixture over sugar and flour. Mix well. Add buttermilk eggs cinnamon baking soda and vanilla; mix until smooth. Pour into a greased and floured pan; bake 20 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Peanut Butter Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Prepare crust. Cool. Press half of softened ice cream into crust. In small bowl stir corn syrup and peanut butter until blended. Pour half of mixture over ice cream. Sprinkle with half of peanuts repeating layering. Freeze until firm about 5 hours. Let pie stand at room temperature for 5 minutes for easy cutting.

title: Squash Pie
instructions: Mix squash sugar flour nutmeg vanilla and lemon extract together. Add beaten eggs. Add milk to squash. Stir until well blended. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or longer.

title: Mrs. Yoppi'S Nut Roll
instructions: Mix oleo with flour like pie dough. Add egg yolks sour cream and vanilla. Mix together and make 8 balls of dough. Put in refrigerator for 2 1/2 hours or overnight. Roll like pies in powdered sugar. Beat egg whites and 1/2 box powdered sugar together. Spread egg white mixture over dough; sprinkle with ground nuts. Cut with pizza cutter like pie in 8 pieces. Roll outside to center and put on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar until light; add the applesauce raisins flour spices salt soda and baking powder sifted together twice. Beat well and bake in a shallow well-greased pan in a moderate oven 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0. Test with toothpick after 40 minutes.

title: America'S Pot Roast
instructions: Trim all fat from roast brown and drain. Combine 1/4 cup flour salt and pepper. Coat meat with flour mixture. Place all vegetables except mushrooms in crock-pot and top with roast. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 12 hours. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Melt butter and peanut butter then add sugar and mix by hand. Roll out into balls. Set aside. Melt paraffin and chips. Dip balls into chocolate; put on waxed paper to cool.

title: Meatza Pie
instructions: Place beef garlic salt and stuffing in pie pan. Add milk and mix together with fork. Spread mixture evenly over bottom of pan with a rim around the edge. Spread tomato paste over meat. Sprinkle oregano and mushrooms over paste. Top with cheeses. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except drain and save pineapple juice). Beat together pineapple juice water and lemon juice. Then stir into Jell-O until dissolved. Chill until set.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and cream cheese. Spread on a cake plate. Pour picante sauce over and sprinkle cheeses on top.

title: Elk Or Deer Stew
instructions: Cook meat green peppers and onions in oil until browned. Add water salt black pepper bouillon cube and bay leaf. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is tender. Add carrots potatoes and celery. Simmer until vegetables are tender approximately 30 minutes. Shake cold water and flour until completely mixed; add to stew. Bring to boil stirring constantly until thickens like gravy.

title: Quick And Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Mix with spaghetti sauce drained mushrooms and water. Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan meat sauce uncooked lasagne noodles cottage cheese Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese beginning and ending with meat sauce. Sprinkle top with Parmesan. Cover with heavy duty foil and seal tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before removing foil.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine water butter and salt and bring to boil. Remove from heat and flour all at once. Stir vigorously until mixture leaves sides of pan and forms ball around spoon. (If ball does not form immediately hold saucepan over low heat and beat briskly a few seconds.) Cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time and beat until smooth and glossy after each addition. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased baking sheet leaving 2 inches between puffs. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake until no bubbles of fat remain on surface and sides of puffs feel rigid about 30 minutes. Cool. Cut a cap off puff and fill with Pastry Cream. Replace cap. Makes 10 large puffs.

title: Carrot-Dill Soup
instructions: Bake the potato and sweet potato 1 hour until soft. Steam the carrots over boiling water until very tender (8 to 10 minutes).

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Cake Mix all together and add 1 cup sour milk. If you have no sour milk add 1 teaspoon vinegar. Add flour and soda. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gobs
instructions: Cream Crisco; add eggs. Add to flour mixture. Mix. Add sour milk. Last add water. Drop by tablespoon and bake 8 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cook flour and milk until thickened. Beat in Crisco with powdered sugar until fluffy; add cooled paste and vanilla. Beat until creamy and spread between 2 cookies.

title: Pound Cake 2
instructions: Cream butter sugar and Crisco. Add sour cream and blend. Add eggs one at a time. Mix in vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 10-inch tube pan.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef and spices in skillet; drain then add spaghetti sauce and cottage cheese. While cooking meat mixture cook noodles and drain.

title: Shirley'S Snack Crackers
instructions: Put crackers in a large bowl. Pour on oil. In another bowl mix together all dry ingredients. Mix all ingredients together and store in a container with a lid.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Remove chicken from bone and place in dish. Heat celery soup and broth and pour over chicken. Mix flour milk and baking powder with margarine and pour over chicken. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Basic Pudding Mix
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients and store in Tupperware canister. Prepare as directed in individual recipes.

title: Hummus
instructions: In small frying pan toast sesame seed over low heat shaking pan often until golden brown (about 3 minutes). Transfer seed to blender or food processor and add garbanzos 2 tablespoons olive oil lemon juice garlic and 6 tablespoons reserved liquid. Whirl adding more liquid if necessary until hummus is smooth but still thick. Season with salt and pepper. Place in shallow bowl. Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Makes 2 cups.

title: Chicken Strata(To Be Done The Day Before Serving.)
instructions: Butter 2 slices of bread. Cut into 1/2-inch cubes and set aside. Cut remaining bread into 1-inch cubes. Place 1/2 of unbuttered cubes in bottom of pan. Combine chicken vegetables mayonnaise and seasoning. Spoon over bread cubes. Sprinkle remaining bread cubes over chicken. Combine eggs and milk and pour over all. Cover and chill overnight. Spoon soup over top and sprinkle buttered bread cubes over soup. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until set. Sprinkle cheese over top the last few minutes of baking.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Stir together flour sugar salt and baking powder. In large mixing bowl combine all-bran and milk. Let stand about 5 minutes. Add flour mixture and raisins. Stir only until combined. Spray 12 muffin pan cups with no-stick spray. Divide mixture into 12 cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes. For reduced calories use 2 tablespoons sugar instead of above amounts.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
instructions: In small saucepan on low heat melt butter and chocolate. Take off burner. Add sugar and mix. Add one egg at a time mixing after each. Add all remaining ingredients and mix. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Mix all together and chill approximately 2 hours before serving.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and mash. Add eggs milk and other ingredients to squash. Pour into buttered baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Chill and keep in refrigerator for a good long time.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine Bisquick and water. Add sausage and cheese and roll into small bite size balls. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Rice In Green Vegetable Broth
instructions: Remove and discard skin from chicken. In a large sauce pan combine chicken broth water rice thyme and pepper. Add chicken cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Shred cabbage and spinach. Remove chicken to a cutting board. Remove meat from bones and cut into bite size pieces. Return chicken to broth add cabbage and spinach bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil broth just until cabbage and chicken are wilted and heated through 1 minute.

title: Chocolate Caramel Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs sugars dressing and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer; add flour and baking soda. Set aside 1 cup of batter. Spread remaining batter into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Zesta Dessert
instructions: Combine crackers with butter and press on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan reserving 1/4 cup for topping. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form then gradually add sugar salt and vanilla. Spread egg white mixture over cracker crumbs. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Spread pie filling over top. Beat whipping cream until stiff. Add powdered sugar. Spread pie filling and refrigerate. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Wilma'S Salmon Cakes
instructions: Mix salmon onion green pepper (if desired) basil thyme salt pepper egg flour and cracker crumbs (if desired). Form patties and roll in additional cracker crumbs. Fry in small amount of Crisco. Makes 5 to 6 patties.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine beans (drained) milk soup pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts. Chill 3 hours. Shape into ball and roll in chopped nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Heavenly Hash Salad
instructions: Drain liquid from fruits. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook sugar Karo and water together in very heavy skillet or Dutch oven on top of stove until it spins threads. (Pick up spoon and let it run slowly out into hot syrup. Watch for threads.) Or if using candy thermometer cook to hard crack stage. Add oleo and raw peanuts. When candy turns color of peanut hulls it is ready. Remove from heat and quickly add vanilla and soda. Stir and pour into greased cookie sheet. Spread as thin as possible using 2 greased forks pulling it to the edges of pan. Cool. Break into pieces.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Chill enough so it does not wilt lettuce. Chop onion and tomatoes. Cut lettuce to salad size. In large bowl combine lettuce onion tomatoes and taco mix. Add beef. Crunch up the Doritos and add to mixture. Pour dressing over salad just before serving.

title: Skillet Enchiladas
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet brown meat and onion; drain any excess fat (electric skillet at 350\u00b0). Stir in soup enchilada sauce milk and chillies. Reduce heat to 220\u00b0. Cover and cook 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions and separate into rings. Make batter of the beaten eggs and milk. Stir together flour and seasoning. Dip onions into flour and then in batter. Drop onion rings into oil and cook until golden. Serve hot.

title: Coconut Almond Pudding(Great!!!)
instructions: Mix the ingredients together and brown in 325\u00b0 oven until light brown; stir often.

title: Quiche
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Spread broccoli in pie plate. Beat sour cream cottage cheese butter eggs and Bisquick until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Top with tomato. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake about 30 minutes until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Brides Punch
instructions: Chop ice cream and sherbet in punch bowl. Add juice. Stir. Add ginger ale last. Serves 25 people.

title: Coconut Balls(No Bake)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except for powdered sugar). Blend well; roll into small balls. Roll in powdered sugar. Refrigerate.

title: Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Combine cold ground beef and remaining ingredients and mix well in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat until boils stirring often. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease pie plate. Heat salted water; add broccoli. Cover and heat to boiling. Cook until almost tender about 5 minutes. Drain. Mix broccoli onion green pepper and cheese in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand mixer. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown and knife comes out clean at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Apricot Roasted Pheasant
instructions: Place pheasant on aluminum foil in roaster. Rub interior with butter then salt pepper and garlic. Cover bird with uncooked rice. Pour apricot juice and apricots over all. Wrap tightly in the foil. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven until pheasant can be easily pierced with a fork. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spray 2 loaf pans with vegetable spray. In a large bowl using an electric mixer beat together sugar oil and eggs. In a separate bowl stir together dry ingredients. Add dry mixture to batter and mix just until blended. Stir vanilla apples and pecans into batter. Pour batter into prepared loaf pans. Bake for 1 hour or until inserted knife comes out clean. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Place chicken pieces in baking dish. Heat ingredients together in pan and pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Yams Hawaiian Style
instructions: Slice sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch thick pieces. Combine with pineapple butter sugar and cinnamon in 2-quart casserole. Place in microwave oven and cook on High 4 minutes. Stir. Sprinkle top with pecans and brown sugar. Continue cooking 2 to 4 minutes. If dish is not hot and topping melted after 2 minutes give 1/4 turn before continuing to cook. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breakfast Stratta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook ground sausage and drain off all fat. Set aside. Spray 9 x 13-inch baking pan with Pam. Line bottom of pan with bread.\tBeat 8 eggs and pour over bread. Sprinkle dry mustard over eggs. Sprinkle ground sausage over eggs. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over sausage. Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered with foil.\tRemove foil and bake until brown approximately 5 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat with onions salt and pepper. Drain. Add tomato paste and sauce tomatoes and garlic. Bring to boil and let simmer for 1 hour (the longer it simmers the better it is). It may be necessary to add a little water if sauce is too thick. Cook noodles (put a small amount of cooking oil in water to keep the noodles from sticking.) Drain.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
instructions: Cut cheese into cubes in a saucepan; add salsa to keep cheese from sticking. Brown hamburger; drain. Salt and pepper to taste. Add Tabasco sauce. Combine hamburger and cheese. Excellent dip for nachos or taco salad.

title: Holly Taters
instructions: Wash potatoes (medium or large). Cut into wedges. Drop into salted cold water for 1 hour. Drain but do not dry. Put a couple of wedges in Shake n Bake bag. Repeat process until all potatoes are used. Place on greased cookie sheet. Salt potatoes and drizzle margarine over the top of potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together well and shape into balls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown. These can be frozen and reheated as needed.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix mustard and catsup together first to keep from lumping. Add rest and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Soup With Rivels
instructions: Peel pumpkin and cut into small squares. Boil until soft. Do not drain water. Add milk until pumpkin is covered. Bring to a simmer. Add salt and pepper. Beat eggs with fork. Add flour slowly and keep mixing until it gets a little thick (like dumplings). Drop this mixture into pumpkin 1/2 teaspoon at a time; let simmer 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand until double in size about 1 hour. Knead down and let rise again. Roll out on floured board until 1/4-inch thick. Spread with oleo cinnamon and brown sugar. Roll up like a jelly roll. Grease pan with oleo and sprinkle with brown sugar. Let raise until double in size. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Peel and dice baked sweet potato. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Cut shortening and potato into flour mixture. Add milk and sugar; stir until well mixed. Roll out on floured surface 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick. With knife cut into squares and bake on greased baking sheet at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 12 to 18 biscuits.

title: Basic White Sauce
instructions: In small saucepan whisk together broth milk and flour. Insert clove into onion; add to broth mixture along with remaining ingredients. Bring to just below boiling over medium heat stirring constantly. Lower heat to simmer and cook stirring frequently for 10 minutes. Remove onion and bay leaf with slotted spoon. Makes 1 cup.

title: Cheese Logs
instructions: (Have all cheese at room temperature.) Add garlic and pecans to cheese mixture. Divide into logs about size as Ritz crackers. Mix chili powder red cayenne pepper and lots of paprika. Roll logs in this mixture on waxed paper. Wrap in waxed paper and chill overnight. Slice and serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Pour all ingredients in a bowl. Melt 3 minutes in microwave. Stir. Pour in pan.

title: Bread Pudding And Brown Sugar Sauce
instructions: Butter dish. Layer brown sugar on the bottom then layer the bread cubes over sugar. Mix eggs sugar vanilla milk and raisins; pour over bread slowly. Put in pan of hot water. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done about 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Put Velveeta cheese oleo and vanilla in a large pan on stove and melt together. Blend in the dry ingredients together in large bowl. After the dry ingredients are mixed add the melted oleo and cheese mix with a spoon. When the mixture is fully combined place it in a long pan (cookie sheet with wax paper on bottom) and pop it into the refrigerator. Cut into squares when it is firm and cold. Keep refrigerated. Makes 5 pounds. May be frozen for later use.

title: Spinach Parma
instructions: Combine croutons and oleo; pat into quiche pan. Combine 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and remaining ingredients; mix well. Spoon over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Sherbet Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jello in water add sherbet. Stir until melted. Let set until jelly like. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Let set until firm.

title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugars. Add eggs and mix thoroughly. Add flour soda and baking powder with pineapple and vanilla. Mix. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Homemade Pizza
instructions: Follow directions on package for bread dough except use cookie sheet. Spread dough on a greased sheet. Cook hamburger meat sausage onions and green peppers. Spread tomato sauce on bread dough; sprinkle with garlic salt if desired. When meat mixture is about cooked drain and spread over dough. Add mushrooms and pepperoni. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Combine milk and egg yolks gradually stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat stir in 1/2 cup coconut butter and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Cover with meringue sealing edges and sprinkle 1/4 cup coconut on top of meringue and bake in 350 degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except coconut in electric blender (can be mixed with electric mixer if you do not have blender) container. Cover and blend on low speed for 3 minutes. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan. Let stand about 5 minutes then sprinkle coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until a table knife comes out clean when inserted into middle of pie. Serve warm or cool with whipped cream or not. This pie makes its own crust. A great pie when you have unexpected guests.

title: Veggie Pie
instructions: Set oven to 400\u00b0. In saucepan cook broccoli or cauliflower about 5 minutes; drain. Grease one 10-inch pie plate. Mix cooked vegetables onion green pepper and cheese on the pie plate. Beat Bisquick eggs salt and pepper until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Buster Bar Dessert
instructions: Combine the following ingredients and boil 8 minutes stirring constantly powdered sugar evaporated milk chocolate chips and 1/2 cup butter. Add vanilla and cool. Combine cookies and 1/2 cup melted\tbutter. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze until firm. Sprinkle peanuts over cookie crust. Spread ice cream over\tpeanuts and cover with cooled chocolate mixture. Freeze until ready to serve. Serves 16.

title: Ruth Robuck'S Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Mix and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Coconut Yule Trees
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients; mix well. Drop by tablespoon onto a waxed paper-lined cookie sheet. Chill for 1 hour. Shape into trees.

title: Railroad Pie
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet. Pour off excess fat; add the rest of ingredients. Bring to boil and simmer 15 minutes; turn into a large greased casserole dish (1 1/2-quart).

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their jackets until done; peel and mash. Add butter sugar and lemon extract. Combine the beaten egg and milk. Mix with the potatoes until blended. Pour into the pastry shell and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Take 1 cup of cracker crumbs and layer the bottom of the casserole dish. Then be sure you have drained your Veg-All and put them as your next layer. Add your celery soup and pour milk over it. Put margarine and sprinkle salt and pepper over it. Cook for about 25 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Remove then spread with rest of cracker crumbs and cheese. Place back in oven for 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Zucchini Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together. Shape into cakes and roll in crushed cracker crumbs. Fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Black Forest Cake
instructions: Bake the cake in 9-inch pans. Cool thoroughly and split each layer in half. Spread the cherry pie filling between the split layers. Now you have the original 2 layers with cherry filling in between. Reserve 1/2 cup pie filling to go on top of cake.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt margarine in dish you are going to bake in. Beat eggs sugar and cornstarch; add vanilla milk and creamed corn. Pour into dish over butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Do not cover.

title: Remp Eyek
instructions: Grind coriander garlic and nuts. Mix all together into batter adding 2 packages Spanish peanuts. Scoop batter with a hostess spoon and fry until brown.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix coconut and pecans. Place in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix according to package directions. Pour over coconut mixture. Mix margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Pour over chocolate mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Garden Linguine(I Usually Halve This Recipe.)
instructions: Boil broth until reduced to half. Cook broccoli carrots and beans in microwave until crisp tender. In large skillet heat olive oil and saute onion garlic mushrooms broccoli pepper carrots and asparagus until almost soft. Add reduced broth milk basil oregano parsley salt and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes. If needed thicken slightly with 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons cold water. Cook pasta and drain. Combine with vegetables. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. This cooks up quickly if the vegetables are cut ahead of time.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Mix in order first 8 ingredients. Chill 2 hours. Drop on greased sheet and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chili Con Queso Dip
instructions: Cook hamburger; drain well. Put in crock-pot on low; mix in the rest of the ingredients. Cook until cheese melts and serve hot with nacho chips.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O with boiling water. Add rest of ingredients. Place in refrigerator to set. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken 'N Dumplings
instructions: Boil fryer until tender. Remove from broth and set aside to cool. Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add beaten eggs and enough milk to make a stiff dough. Roll out really thin on heavily floured board. Cut into pieces (pizza cutter works great!). Drop into rapidly boiling broth. Cover and simmer on very low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove skin and bones from chicken and pull into bite size pieces. Add chicken to pot and season to taste with black pepper. I pour about a cup of sweet milk in pot just as its finished cooking.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa baking powder and milk together. Bring to boil until mixture forms a soft ball. Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Stir until mixture thickens pour onto buttered plate.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour soda and salt together and add to mixture. Add bananas and nuts. Bake 1 hour in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and pour into a greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together well then drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Cream Squares
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries; stir occasionally until thawed. Add pineapple and bananas and mix. Pour half of mixture into an 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm. Spread evenly with sour cream. Pour remaining jello mixture on top. Chill until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Barbecued Meat Patties
instructions: Mix together all ingredients for patties. When milk is absorbed shape mixture into 12 patties. Cook slowly for 10 minutes or until brown on both sides in a small amount of fat. Mix together all ingredients for Sauce. Add to the meat in skillet and cook slowly turning in Sauce.

title: Coleslaw And Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mayonnaise. Beat well with mixer. Cook until thick. Remove pan from stove and add mayonnaise. Beat well and cool.

title: Dry Beef Dip
instructions: Cut beef with scissors. Mix all together then refrigerate.

title: Crumb Shell
instructions: *For Crumbs Use crisp graham crackers prepared dry cereal zwieback dried bread or cookies such as shortbreads gingersnaps chocolate wafers etc. Roll with a rolling pin to fine crumbs.

title: Southern Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Place berries in 9 inch square baking dish. Combine sugar cornstarch and salt mixing well.\tSprinkle mixture over berries. Dot with butter. Roll out pastry to fit dish. Place pastry over berries. Brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6-8 servings.

title: Broken Glass Cake
instructions: Dissolve each flavor jello separately with 1 1/2 cups hot water. Pour in ice cube trays. Set until firm.

title: Roast Chicken Or Cornish Hens
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Wash chicken or hens and pat dry. Mix all other ingredients and stuff chicken or hens. Place breast down in pan so juice will run downward from juicy birds. Roast uncovered for 1 3/4 to 2 hours or until done. (Drumsticks will move up and down when ready.) Baste occasionally with drippings. Serves 4.

title: Quick Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in punch bowl. Makes 25 to 30 punch cup servings.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients except oil. Drip in oil very slowly; blend well. Store in jar in refrigerator.

title: Alita Darby Arthur'S Classic Pecan Pie
instructions: Stir together eggs sugar corn syrup margarine and vanilla. Add pecans; mix. Pour into pastry shell. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool; serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix together and heat in microwave for 8 minutes. Serve warm with crackers.

title: Tropical Fruit Cake
instructions: Cut dates into thirds add coconut nuts and cherries sprinkled with flour. Add milk and mix well. Butter loaf pan and dust with flour.

title: Gene'S Hop-N-John
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add the remaining ingredients. Add water to cover 1 inch above ingredients. Cook for 1 hour on low heat. Serves 15 to 20.

title: Classic Lobster Seafood Salad(4 Servings)
instructions: Mix lobster mayonnaise celery and onion. Serve on bed of lettuce.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Make applesauce with apples. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients. Boil for 1 1/2 hours in the oven or until thick. Put in jars and seal.

title: No Peek Brisket
instructions: Lay slices of rye bread in bottom of Dutch oven. Place brisket with fat side down on top of the bread in Dutch oven. Sprinkle garlic powder and pepper on brisket. Throw onion slices into pan. Pour beer over the meat. Spread the chile sauce over the meat. Cover Dutch oven.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine; add to stuffing mix. Grease 9 x 13-inch casserole. Cut chicken into small pieces. Combine soup broth and sour cream. Put 1/2 of stuffing mixture in casserole. Layer all of chicken on top and pour broth mixture over it. Top with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbling hot.

title: Dirt
instructions: Make pudding according to directions on box. Mix Cool Whip then cookies. Chill.

title: Barbecued Lima Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except onion. Put into skillet top with onion and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Divinity
instructions: Mix together sugar corn syrup water and salt in a 1 1/2 quart casserole. Cook in microwave on Full power 20 to 22 minutes or\tuntil hard ball stage is reached. Stir once or twice during cooking. While syrup cooks beat egg whites until stiff peaks form in a large mixing bowl. Gradually pour hot syrup over egg\twhites until beating at high speed until mixture is thickened and candy starts to lose its gloss. Beating may require about 12 minutes. Add vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on waxed\tpaper.\tCandy may be tinted for special occasions.

title: Homemilled Corn Meal Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together all the dry ingredients. Add egg buttermilk and oil. Mix well and pour into hot iron skillet. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake 15 minutes. Flip in pan and brown.

title: Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour oats baking soda cinnamon and cloves; set aside. With mixer at low speed cream oil and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg whites and applesauce. Stir in dry ingredients until smooth. Spray baking sheet with vegetable spray; drop dough on cookie sheet. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until brown. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry Valentine Punch
instructions: Wrap cinnamon cloves and mint in cheesecloth or place in a cloth spice bag. Place bundled spices in cranberry-raspberry juice; simmer for 20 minutes. Remove spices and pour juice into a punch bowl. Cool. Add ginger ale orange slices and fresh mint leaves for garnish.

title: Cookies Quick
instructions: Any additional ingredients you wish such as chocolate chips butterscotch chips peanut butter chips etc. depending on your choice of cake mix. (Yellow cake mix is excellent for adding other flavors to.)

title: Giant Burger
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix meat and salt; divide in half. Pat one half evenly in ungreased 8-inch pie pan. Mix cream cheese mustard and horseradish; spread over meat. Shape remaining meat into 8-inch circle. Place on cheese mixture; pinch edges together to seal. Bake 45 minutes. Place onion rings around meat. Cut into wedges.

title: Sweet And Sour Pheasant
instructions: Place pheasant breasts in a steamer and cover. Steam only until meat can be removed from bone (meat should be rare). Cool to room temperature and cube.

title: Angel Kisses
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until thick and foamy. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff. Fold in salt pecans vanilla and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets covered with brown paper. Place in oven close door and turn oven off. Leave in oven overnight.

title: Salmon Dip
instructions: Blend the cream cheese juice of salmon mayonnaise sour cream and onion salt well. Add salmon; blend well. Serve with vegetables crackers or potato chips.

title: Savory Cheese Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 24 mini muffin cups. Stir together flour cheese mustard and chili powder in mixing bowl. Beat eggs in separate bowl; stir in milk and oil. Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients stirring just until blended. Batter will be slightly lumpy. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups filling each 2/3 full. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Drain mushrooms and save juice. Cook broccoli in mushroom juice. Drain broccoli and chop. Saute onion and garlic in oleo until clear. Put broccoli garlic and mushroom soup into double boiler. When hot add cheese and mushrooms and season to taste with Worcestershire sauce. Serve with Melba rounds.

title: Hamburger And Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain off grease. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes.

title: The Trawler Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt oleo chocolate chips and peanut butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add cereal and stir until coated. Pour powdered sugar in Ziploc bag. Add about 1/4 cereal mixture to bag. Shake. Repeat until all cereal has been covered with sugar. Pour onto wax paper to cool. Makes a large batch.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Stir until well blended. Store in refrigerator in covered container.

title: Yummy Fruit Dip
instructions: Whip all ingredients with mixer. Store brands dont work as well.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla together and set aside. Mix jello and water together and place in refrigerator and let jell slightly.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine strawberries and pie filling. Chill for several hours. Add bananas just before serving.

title: Orange Cooler
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve at once.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Blend ingredients and beat 2 minutes. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle with sifted confectioners sugar or glaze. May be baked in loaf pans for banana bread.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Blend together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook yellow squash in water. Drain water. Mix ingredients together and cook 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Finger Paint
instructions: Mix dry starch with 1/2 cup water in a saucepan. Add 1 1/2 cups boiling water and stir rapidly. Add 3/4 cup powdered detergent and stir again until smooth. Add food coloring for desired color.

title: Diabetic Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Beat 1 1/2 minutes at high speed of mixer. Add remaining ingredients except chocolate chips. Chips are added last. Place in 8 x 8-inch ungreased pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 22 minutes.

title: Wash Day Cake
instructions: Slice margarine sticks and distribute evenly over bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour dry cake mix over margarine. Pour peaches including juice over cake mix. Top with coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Apple Rolls
instructions: Stir together apples nuts and sugar. Let stand stirring often until juicy about 1 hour. Stir together flour soda salt and spices. Add apple mixture and stir well. Stir in butter and vanilla. Add eggs. Turn into two greased and floured one pound coffee cans. Tie 2-inch wide band of double foil around top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Onion Dip For Veggies Or Chips And Pretzels
instructions: Boil bouillon cubes with water. Using an electric mixer add cream cheese and onion. Should make a day ahead and refrigerate. Warm to almost room temperature before serving. Stir well and thin with a little milk if needed.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and soda into mixing bowl. Stir in milk until all is wet; then add corn oil. Toss out on floured board. Sprinkle a little flour on dough. Then flatten out and cut biscuits. Grease pan and turn biscuits over in grease and bake at 425\u00b0. Makes 14 large biscuits.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornmeal. Add oleo and cream. Add eggs one at a time and beat thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients to mixture and beat. Pour in pie shell and place in oven. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce to 325\u00b0 and cook 30 minutes longer.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a frying pan. Make sandwiches using 2 slices of bread and 1 piece of cheese for each. Place sandwich in pan and fry until lightly brown; turn over and brown on other side. Fry on medium heat.

title: Caramel Brie With Fresh Fruit
instructions: Place Brie on large serving plate. Melt butter and brown sugar in saucepan; add corn syrup and flour stirring well. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm. Gradually stir in milk. Pour caramel over Brie. Sprinkle with pecans. Combine lemon juice and water. Toss with fruit wedges. Drain. Arrange around fruit.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer bread meat cheese and onion. Melt butter and pour over all. Beat eggs seasonings and milk. Pour over. Chill in refrigerator overnight and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Mix together the flour oleo and nuts. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Sour Cream Dressing For Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Add all ingredients to sour cream.

title: Lime-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Chill. Add remaining ingredients and let set.

title: Boozy Bourbon Balls
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler over hot not boiling water. Remove pan from fire and stir in sugar and corn syrup. Blend in bourbon. Combine crushed vanilla wafers and walnuts in bowl. Add chocolate mixture to it. Form into one-inch balls and roll in sugar. Let ripen in covered container for few days or longer. Then wrap and present to your friends. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Breakfast Cocoa
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar and salt; add water and cook 3 minutes. Stir in milk; heat to boiling but do not boil. Beat with rotary beater just before serving. Serves 6.

title: Coconut Candy
instructions: Melt butter let cool. Pour over sugar and grated orange peel. Add 1 tablespoon orange juice. Add milk nuts and coconut; mix well. Set in freezer to cool.

title: Banana Milk Shake
instructions: Blend ingredients in blender until smooth and foamy. Chill before serving. Makes 2 shakes.

title: Sweet-Sour Cabbage
instructions: Shred cabbage and place in a large pot with 3 tablespoons water and 1 can of stewed tomatoes. Cook until almost tender. In a separate pan melt 1/4 stick margarine. Mix with 1 teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons white vinegar and 1 tablespoon flour. Saute the diced onion in the mixture. Add this to the cabbage when the cabbage is almost tender. Heat until desired tenderness is reached. Add a teaspoon of sugar if needed.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in jackets and dice. Mix cream cheese and milk together. Add all ingredients together in 9 x 11-inch baking dish which has been greased with butter.

title: Baked Diet Chicken
instructions: Line baking dish with foil. Arrange chicken in pan. Add rest of ingredients. Cover pan with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until well done.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix sugar vanilla and cream cheese together. Make a package of Dream Whip. Follow directions on Dream Whip. When you get this mixed up combine Dream Whip sugar vanilla and cream cheese together. Bake pie crust at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Fill pie crust with mixture and top with cherries. Chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Squash And Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until squash and potatoes are tender. Add cheese and melt.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in Pyrex dish. Mix an additional 1 to 1 1/2 cups stuffing with margarine. Crumble on top and bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in crock-pot and cook 8 hours or overnight.

title: Blueberry Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until blended. Add milk and butter; mix well. Combine in separate bowl 3 cups flour baking powder and salt. Stir into egg mixture until moist. Mix blueberries with 2 teaspoons flour until coated. Fold into batter. Spoon into 2 small greased and floured loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until done.

title: Cinnamon Rings
instructions: Combine 1 cup sugar and cinnamon to taste. Melt 1 stick of butter. Roll biscuits in butter then in sugar mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar; add eggs banana and water and mix well. Then add baking powder and baking soda. Mix in flour. Stir well after each addition. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Drain corn and mix all ingredients together. Vinegar oil and a dash of sugar can be added for a tasteful salad.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown beef in hot oil; add garlic and cook for 5 minutes. Add soy sauce salt and water. Cook for 45 minutes. Add vegetables; cook 10 to 15 minutes longer. Stir cornstarch and tomato juice together; add to mixture. Cook stirring constantly until it thickens. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes more. Serve over hot fluffy rice. Serves 4.

title: Long John'S Batter
instructions: Mix all but egg white. Beat egg white until stiff peaks form. Blend into batter. Dip fish or chicken and fry. Enjoy.

title: Everyday Easy Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. In 10 x 6-inch baking dish layer 1/2 of the broccoli 1/2 the soup mixture and 1/2 can of the onions. Top with the remaining broccoli and soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes. May be microwaved covered 8 minutes. Turn half through. Top with onions. Return to microwave uncovered 1 minute.

title: Miracle Soup
instructions: Cut vegetables into medium pieces cover with water; let come to a boil. Your soup mix may be added at this time. After soup has boiled at least 10 minutes lower heat and simmer until vegetables are soft. Can be eaten at any time that you feel hungry as much as you wish as often as you like any time of the day. This soup will not add calories. The more you eat the more you will lose.

title: Microwave Ritz Pizza Snack
instructions: Put sauce on cracker. Put on pepperoni. Sprinkle with cheese. Place in microwave until cheese melts (about 10 seconds).

title: Punch
instructions: Pour all ingredients together.

title: Oven Baked Bourguignonne
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole dish toss beef with flour. Bake uncovered in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Add carrots tomatoes beefy onion soup mix blended with reserved tomato liquid wine and bay leaf. Bake covered for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender. Add mushrooms. Bake covered an additional 10 minutes.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and Crisco. Add eggs and beat well. Add vanilla and dry ingredients. Mix well. Shape into little balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Steamed Fish
instructions: Place fish and ginger in pot of boiling water (water should cover fish). Turn flame off and cover with tight fitting lid. Let stand for 30 minutes or until done. Place fish on platter. Sprinkle with finely chopped green onion.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops. Add rest of the ingredients and simmer 45 minutes. Last 15 minutes add frozen peas.

title: Spaghetti Sauce Seasoning Mix
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a 1-pint jar. Cover tightly and shake well to mix. Store in a cool dark dry place for up to 2 months. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Baked Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Dip sliced eggplant in eggs then bread crumbs and fry until golden. Layer the slices with marinara sauce then cheeses in rectangular baking dish.

title: Chicken Spectacular Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs. Pour into 3-quart greased casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. To freeze do not cook before freezing.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Wash and slice squash; cook in salted water until tender. (Do not overcook.) Saute onion and garlic in butter and add to drained squash. Add 2/3 cup butter sugar salt and pepper to squash mixture. Mix well. Add milk 2 eggs and cracker crumbs. Mix gently. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Dot top with remaining 1/3 cup butter and crushed crackers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until browned.

title: Black Forest Parfait
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine milk yogurt and pudding mix. Stir until it is smooth and thick. Next spoon a layer of pudding mixture into 4 clear glasses. Do the same with a layer of whipped cream. Repeat layering so you will have 4 levels. Chill 1 hour. Top with nuts and drained cherries.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet and brown onions and ground beef. Cut tops out of peppers and clean. Mix rice ground beef mixture and spaghetti sauce and stuff into peppers. Top with cheese. Put some sauce in bottom of pan and place peppers in dish. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of sugar in each pepper (optional). Cover with foil and cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Company Beef Casserole
