instructions: Brown beef and onion together; add tomatoes ketchup steak sauce and parsley. Simmer for 30 minutes. Cook macaroni.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Combine crabmeat and shrimp. Combine mayonnaise French dressing chili sauce horseradish onion lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and seasonings. Pour over crabmeat and shrimp. Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours. Serve on lettuce and garnish with tomato wedges.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Blend beaten eggs canned pumpkin sugar salt cloves cinnamon ginger and nutmeg. Slowly add condensed milk. Mix well. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce temperature to 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until you can cut center with a knife and none of the pie filling clings to it.

title: Pork Chop And Vegetable Skillet
instructions: Fry pork chops until tender and brown. Place onion rings and bell pepper over cooked chops. Put rice inside pepper. Pour tomatoes and celery (mixed) over this and season to taste with salt and pepper. Simmer approximately 1 hour in covered frypan on top of stove.

title: Saucepan Raisin Bars
instructions: Mix well. Pour into\tgreased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Heat oven to broil. Remove mushroom stems; chop enough stems to make 1/4 cup. Saute mushroom caps in margarine 5 minutes. Mix soft cream cheese Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs until well blended; stir in chopped stems. Fill mushroom caps. Broil until browned. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Poor Man'S Soup
instructions: Cook short ribs and stew meat together until done. Add onion celery and seasoning. Cook until done. Add all precooked leftover veggies. Heat thoroughly. Serve with cornbread.

title: Casserole Cheese Bread
instructions: Scald milk; add sugar salt and margarine. Let cool. Dissolve yeast in water. Add milk and cheese and flour. Stir about 2 minutes until well blended. Cover; let rise until more than double. Stir down and beat vigorously for 1/2 minute. Turn in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole or two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour (no second rising).

title: Salmon Balls
instructions: Let cream cheese set out for 1/2 hour. Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl (with gloved hands) until well mixed. Roll salmon mixture in a ball then roll in the walnuts. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Easy Quiche
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Glorified Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Meanwhile in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish arrange chicken skin side up. Drizzle with margarine. Bake 40 minutes. Spoon soup over chicken. Bake 20 minutes more or until chicken is tender and juices run clear. Transfer chicken to platter. Stir sauce. Spoon sauce over chicken. Garnish with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Seven Decker Dinner
instructions: Brown meat. Drain off fat. Arrange in layers cooked noodles 1/2 of the cheese onions ground beef green peppers and diced tomatoes. Mix together tomato juice Worcestershire sauce salt garlic salt herb seasoning and pepper. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. During last 5 minutes arrange remaining cheese over the casserole. Heat until cheese melts. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Biscuit Tortoni(My Version)
instructions: Beat egg whites; slowly add sugar. Fold in Cool Whip macaroons and sherry. Place cupcake papers in muffin tins. Put in mixture and freeze. Decorate. Serve with cookie.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pick chicken off bones. Lay meat in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix soup and milk. Pour over chicken. Melt oleo and mix with stuffing. Spread over casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spray a 9-inch square pan with nonstick spray. Pour batter in carefully. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Can be frozen.

title: Potato-Bean Soup
instructions: In large pot cook and stir celery carrots and garlic in hot margarine over medium heat for 4 minutes or until tender. Carefully stir in broth potatoes and dill. Heat to boiling then reduce heat. Simmer covered for 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender With back of large spoon or masher lightly mash about 1/2 of potatoes in the broth. Add drained beans to mixture.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover bowl and let stand in refrigerator a few hours. Form in balls. Brown in oil. Do not overcrowd. Place in crock-pot with your spaghetti sauce and cook on low for at least 8 hours and serve.

title: Mississippi Potatoes
instructions: Toss together potatoes mayonnaise salt pepper cheese and onion. Place mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon and sliced olives. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wet Burritos
instructions: Brown meat. Add onion tomato soup and Tabasco sauce. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Chop lettuce. Mix enchilada sauce with tomato paste and water as package instructs. Heat up beans. Fold into shells the meat beans and lettuce. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with sauce and cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie(Feeds About 6 People)
instructions: Boil the chicken until tender; cut it into small pieces. Make the mashed potatoes any way you like; you can put garlic and cheese or whatever. After the chicken and the potatoes are done layer it in a big pan cream of celery chicken breasts green beans and mashed potatoes. Keep doing this until you run out of ingredients. Then sprinkle the fried onions and the shredded cheese and put it in the oven until the cheese is bubbling.

title: 10 Minute Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
instructions: Stir together the salt sugar and syrup in one-quart bowl. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Stir in peanuts. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir. Microwave 1 to 3 minutes longer until it is light brown. Remove from microwave. Add butter vanilla and soda. Stir until butter is all melted. Pour out on warm buttered cookie sheet to 1/4-inch thickness. Cool and eat.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in blender or electric mixer. Add oil slowly. Stir in poppy seeds. Serve over fresh fruit or finely shredded red cabbage and seedless fresh grapes.

title: Spring Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together for delicious punch.

title: Chicken Ala King
instructions: Combine and cook all day in slow cooker. Push bread with thumb and index finger into muffin tins and toast in oven at 450\u00b0 about 10 minutes. Dip Chicken Ala King into bread cups on everyones plate.

title: Sweet Trash
instructions: Melt margarine syrup and brown sugar until blended. Pour margarine mixture over cereal mixture. Place in large pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0 stirring 1/2 way through. Immediately spread mixture on wax paper covered cooling rack. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a pan on top of stove. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes and remove. Add marshmallow and peanut butter. Mix and chill.

title: Katie Gooch Wilmot'S Seafoam Candy
instructions: Boil sugar until it forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water. Pour over stiffly beaten egg whites and beat until it cools and creams. Then drop on wax paper by spoon. Put halos of chopped nuts on top of the candy.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Cook celery onion and green pepper in oil until tender. Blend flour into mixture. Stir in chicken broth and milk; cook to a smooth sauce stirring constantly. Add chicken to sauce; season with salt. Heat mixture thoroughly. Serve on rice toast or biscuits. Yields 4 servings.

title: Pain Persille(Parsley Bread)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Split the loaf of bread in half lengthwise. Melt the butter in saucepan and add the garlic stirring. Stir in the parsley and salt and pepper to taste and remove from the heat. Spoon and brush one half of the bread with the mixture. Cover with the second side sandwich fashion. Wrap the bread in a sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil and bake 10 minutes or until piping hot.

title: Cheesy Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes water cubed chicken onion celery and grated carrots until done. Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta cheese.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Peel slice and sugar peaches until they make a liquid. Melt butter in a baking dish. Mix flour baking powder sugar salt and milk in bowl. Pour batter in pan with melted butter. Spoon peaches over batter and bake for about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Praline Muffins
instructions: Place paper liners in a muffin tin if you use them; otherwise butter the tin well. Fill them to 3/4 full and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Makes 1 dozen 2-inch muffins.

title: Scrambled Eggs, Spanish Style
instructions: Slice green peppers; slice onion thinly. In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in tablespoon of hot olive or salad oil cook green peppers onion garlic dried thyme leaves and 1/2 teaspoon salt until vegetables are tender-crisp; add tomatoes and hot pepper sauce. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until tomatoes are softened. Spoon mixture onto warm large platter to keep warm.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in water with chicken bouillon onions celery and carrot until tender. Do not drain. Mash with a potato masher. Add margarine parsley milk salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly.

title: Sparkling Orange Eggnog
instructions: In a large bowl measure 3 cups of the orange juice the lemon juice eggs sugar cinnamon ginger and cloves. Blend with beater. Stir in remaining orange juice. Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving pour eggnog mixture into punch bowl. Spoon ice cream into bowl; add ginger ale. Blend with beater. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Makes 30 servings.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: You will need a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.

title: Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Roll chicken pieces in flour then in eggs and finally in bread crumbs patting it on well. Using a frying pan brown in olive oil until done. It doesnt take long and they are good!

title: Greek Bread
instructions: Blend mayonnaise and oleo. Add other ingredients. Slice French bread in half-horizontally. Spread with mixture. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Slice--serve hot.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Pack eight quart jars with cucumbers. To each jar add 3 teaspoons dill seed 1 clove garlic and 1 teaspoon lump alum.

title: Spicy Pickled Cabbage
instructions: Trim cabbage. Cut heads into small wedges. Pack into jar placing tomatoes and pepper about midway. Pour salt over cabbage and add water. Fill pint size freezer bag with water and weight mixture down. Make sure water covers cabbage. Cover jar with dish towel held in place with a rubber band. Store in warm place 10 to 14 days. Can the same as kraut.

title: Ladies Night Out Jam Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until creamy.\tMix flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Add buttermilk jam and allspice. Mix well. Stir in walnuts raisins and coconut. Pour into lightly greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake 1 hour in preheated 325\u00b0 oven. Cool 15 minutes in pan. Loosen cake and invert onto cooling rack. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Poulet De Normandy
instructions: Mix stuffing chicken broth and butter together. Pat down in a 12 x 8-inch casserole. Add chicken mixed with onion celery mayonnaise and salt; mix 2 eggs with 1 1/2 cups milk. Pour over evenly. Cover with foil and marinate overnight. One hour before serving spread 1 can of cream of mushroom soup over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Put back in oven 10 minutes more.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Scald and measure the milk. Add the yeast cake sugar and salt; mix thoroughly. Add about 1/2 the flour mix well. Add the shortening and remaining flour. Knead the dough quickly and lightly until it is smooth and elastic. Grease lightly. Allow to rise in a warm place (80\u00b0) until doubled in bulk.\tThis will require about 2 hours. Punch down. Let rise about 45 minutes. Mold into loaves and let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 380\u00b0 until done.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar salt spices and milk. Add butter to mashed sweet potatoes. Blend with milk and egg mixture. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0; bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients. Add next 4 ingredients. Roll in balls the size of a walnut. If mixture seems too wet add a little flour at a time until easily handled. Roll these in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon.

title: Italian Spaghetti
instructions: Brown onions and garlic in small amount of olive oil. Add ground beef and cook until tender and meat is brown. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until sauce is thick or the longer you cook the better.

title: Puerto Rico Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in cooking oil and cook until brown. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour. Serve over rice.

title: Best Ever Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar eggs baking soda vanilla and nuts. Add crushed pineapple. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. \Happy eating\.

title: Salsa Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart microwave safe bowl. Microwave on High 5 minutes stopping after 3 minutes. Serve hot with tortilla chips or as a veggie dip. Makes 3 cups.

title: Pork Chop Marinade
instructions: Combine marinade and place pork chops in a glass dish; add marinade. Cover and refrigerate overnight turning occasionally. Grill or broil chops for 8 to 10 minutes; brush occasionally with reserved marinade.

title: Broccoli Corn Muffins
instructions: Turn oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Broccoli does not have to be cooked. Melt butter then add other ingredients. Bake until golden brown (usually about what recipe calls for to make Jiffy mix muffins).

title: Ceviche
instructions: Cut uncooked fish into small pieces. Add lime juice to cover fish; cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or until fish become opaque. Stir occasionally.

title: Creamy Chicken Broccoli Skillet
instructions: Completely cook chicken in Miracle Whip about 8 minutes. Stir in broccoli and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and frothy. Add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13 inch pan. Place peaches in bottom of pan and sprinkle with nutmeg. Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt; set aside.

title: Cecil B. De Mille'S Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain off most of the fat. Add onion to bacon and saute until onion is soft. Drain butter beans and kidney beans. Combine all in large 3 quart casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour uncovered. Serves about 10.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Cut tortillas into 1-inch pieces. Combine with meat soup salsa milk and 1/2 cup cheese. Pour into 9 x 12 pan. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 400\u00b0. Uncover; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Return to oven until cheese melts; serve.

title: Hearty Beef 'N Potato Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes on bottom and up sides of 8 x 12-inch casserole. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Brown beef in large chunks; drain. Place beef broccoli 1/2 can of the onions and tomatoes in potato shell. Combine soup milk 1/2 cheese and seasonings. Pour over beef mixture. Bake covered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Pizza Cookie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 12-inch pizza pan. In medium bowl with electric mixer at medium speed cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg. Stir in flour and baking soda until well blended. Spread dough into prepared pan. Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Sprinkle marshmallows and candies on cookie during the last 5 minutes of baking. Cool 10 minutes in pan on wire rack.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Dough is crumbly. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
instructions: Mix the sugars and shortening peanut butter and margarine together. Stir in flour. Shape dough into balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place on cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 until edges are light brown 8 to 10 minutes. As soon as they are removed from the oven press a chocolate Kiss in center of each cookie.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Grate zucchini and combine with eggs oil and vanilla. Mix all dry ingredients together. Combine all ingredients and put in two loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: First layer First 3 ingredients blend together and press in 9x13 pan. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes. Let cool.

title: Sally'S Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Saut the onion in butter or margarine. Brown pork chops on both sides in separate pan. Layer sauteed onions browned pork chops and onions in a 9 x 13 baking dish. In a small bowl blend chili sauce flour salt pepper and ginger ale. Pour mixture over pork chop/onion mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Avocado Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add tomato sauce and vinegar. When partially set add avocados onion and celery.

title: All American Corn Bread
instructions: Scald cream (half and half) with butter. Add to thoroughly mixed dry ingredients. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beach Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 1 egg together and spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Bake in very hot oven (500\u00b0) for about 10 minutes. Turns out nice in kitchen range. Electric oven not so wise.

title: Party Salad
instructions: Mix milk and Cool Whip; refrigerate for one hour. Add cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple. Mix well; add pecans and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Mix and chill at least 4 hours.

title: Mexican Cabbage
instructions: Brown first four ingredients together in Dutch oven; drain. Add soup Ro-Tel tomatoes cabbage salt and pepper. Simmer 45 minutes. Serve with corn bread.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine cooked rice milk sugar salt and oleo. Cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until thick. Stir in vanilla. Add raisins if desired. Yields enough for one person.

title: Air Buns
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup warm water and 1 teaspoon sugar in a small bowl. Add dry yeast and let stand 15 minutes. In a large bowl mix 3 1/2 cups warm water 1/2 cup sugar shortening vinegar and salt. Mix well and let cool to lukewarm. Add flour. Knead until smooth and elastic. Let rise then punch down and form into rolls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. This is a large recipe and can be cut in half. A full recipe will make 5 to 6 dozen rolls. I usually make a large pan of rolls plus a pan of cinnamon rolls and some hamburger buns. It is also a good recipe for hamburger buns for family gatherings. The extra rolls freeze well.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
instructions: Layer potatoes cheese and ham in casserole. Mix flour and milk; pour over potatoes. Add butter salt and pepper. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours (40 to 60 minutes in microwave) or until hot and bubbly.

title: Banana-Nut Bread Ii
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix butter sugar and eggs together. Fold in dry ingredients that have been sifted together. Add mashed bananas and nuts. Bake in loaf pan 9 x 5-inch for 40 to 50 minutes. When done cool 5 minutes in the pan. Then turn out on rack to cool.

title: Deli-Style Barbecued Beef
instructions: In medium saucepan combine roast beef and barbecue sauce. Cook over medium heat 15 minutes to blend flavors stirring occasionally. Serve in buns. Yields 8 sandwiches.

title: Spiked Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage in 4 quarters; then slice each quarter into 1/2-inch slices. Cut up green pepper and onion. Add about 3/4 cup water cover and cook on medium burner for 15 minutes. To be eaten alone or along with a full meal serving as a vegetable.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients and put the noodles right before serving.

title: Apricot Pinwheels
instructions: Combine apricots and boiling water; allow to stand until most of the water is absorbed; drain. Sift flour and baking powder into bowl. Beat butter or margarine brown sugar sugar substitute and water until well blended. Add the flour mixture; blend with a fork until the dough forms a ball. Place the dough on wax paper; flatten slightly. Wrap in the wax paper; chill in the freezer 20 minutes.

title: Turnip Salad
instructions: Boil turnips and peel; cut in slices. Add chopped onion salt oregano vinegar and oil. Toss gently and top with sliced eggs.

title: April'S Blueberry Salad
instructions: Boil 1 cup water and add 2 packages of jello then add 1 cup cold water. Drain pineapple and mix with jello and add blueberry pie filling. Chill until jelled.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Place all ingredients except cheese meat and pepper in blender and mix. Pour into 9-inch buttered pie pan. Sprinkle meat cheese green pepper or onion over top and push gently under surface with back of spoon. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 after cooking potatoes in jackets in boiling water in covered saucepan until they can barely by pierced with a fork; drain cool and peel. Place in shallow baking dish side by side.

title: Orange-Date Crescents
instructions: Assemble blender. Put water orange juice and dates in blender container. Cover and process at blend for 2 to 3 cycles. Cook mixture on low heat until thickened. Blend chopped nuts. Add to date mixture. Cool.

title: Beef Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill overnight. Roll into balls. Place on serving tray. Sprinkle with paprika. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Spanish Chowder
instructions: Brown hamburger in pan. Add beans tomatoes chopped pepper and onion. Cook 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Caramelitas
instructions: *Note If using coconut add to crumb mixture before pressing into pan.

title: The Obscene Chocolate Cake
instructions: Do not preheat oven. Spray one 12-cup Bundt pan with vegetable cooking spray.

title: Creamy Peach Pudding
instructions: Arrange fruit in the bottom of a shallow 1-quart serving dish. Place remaining ingredients in an electric blender. Cover and blend at medium speed 10 seconds or until smooth and creamy. Pour sauce over fruit and stir gently to mix. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Makes 4 servings.

title: People'S Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt first 4 ingredients until smooth. Add Rice Chex and mix gently until coated. Now put 2 cups of powdered sugar in a brown grocery bag and shake until coated. Leave in bag until cool.

title: Frosted Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Combine chicken eggs olives and mayonnaise. Fill sandwiches (3 slices to a sandwich).

title: Unstuffed Cabbage
instructions: Place the cabbage in a greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. In a skillet cook beef and onion until done. Stir in rice salt and pepper if desired. Spoon over cabbage. Combine soup and water; pour over beef mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until rice and cabbage are tender. Uncover. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chinese Winter Soup
instructions: Saute celery and mushrooms in butter until crisp-tender but not browned. Add cabbage; saute for 3 minutes. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; add to vegetables. Mix well. Add soy sauce water chestnuts and chicken to mixture. Bring to a boil. Cook gently uncovered for 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings. Wonderful!

title: Pecan Crunch Cookies
instructions: Cream together the margarine sugar and vanilla. Add crushed potato chips and pecans. Stir in flour. Form small balls with 1 tablespoon of dough. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press balls with flat bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes or until cookies are light brown.

title: Butterscotch Chews
instructions: Beat eggs. Add all ingredients to beaten eggs and blend well. Spread in a well-greased and floured jelly roll pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. They freeze well.

title: Good Biscuits(Yield: 1 Batch)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F (200\u00b0C). Place biscuits 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 8 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Place bacon in a large deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Drain and set aside.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
instructions: In a saucepan bring pineapple to a boil. Remove from heat; add gelatin and stir to dissolve. Add buttermilk and mix well. Cool to room temperature. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into an 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Cut into squares. Yields 12 servings.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage into wedges; place in saltwater and cook until done. Cabbage should be firm but tender. Drain well. In saucepan combine margarine flour onion bell pepper and milk; cook until thick. Remove from heat; add soup pimento and cheese. Mix well. Combine cabbage with liquid mixture and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly.

title: Old Fashioned Beef Stew
instructions: In oven brown beef in margarine. Add Worcestershire sauce bay leaves garlic paprika ground cloves 1 1/2 cups hot water and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Cook covered for 1 1/4 hours; stir often. Remove bay leaves. Add vegetables; cook covered for 30 to 45 minutes. Drain; reserve liquid. Skim fat. Add water to liquid to equal 1 1/4 cups. Return to oven. Combine cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water; stir into hot liquid. Cook and stir until thickened. Stir in beef and vegetables. Heat through.

title: Stuff An Apple
instructions: Core apple (not all the way through). Peel 1/3 of the way down from stem end. Combine 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon butter. Fill center of apple and sprinkle with cinnamon. Microwave 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High.

title: Jan'S Chicken Stock
instructions: Place all ingredients except the chicken liver into a large pan. Bring to a boil. Turn heat to simmer for 2 hours. Remove chicken strain broth. This broth may be used for soup stew or just eaten like it is. Will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

title: Broiled Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Rinse mushrooms and wipe gently with a paper towel to dry. Remove stems and chop finely. Saute stems in butter for 2-3 minutes. Add bread crumbs nuts garlic chives basil and tarragon. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Best Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except butter. Form into a loaf and place in roaster. Make holes with your finger here and there on top of loaf. Put margarine in holes. Put cover on roaster and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours. I usually double the recipe so we have some left for sandwiches.

title: Melting Moments Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add soft margarine and vanilla. Beat on\tmedium\tspeed of mixer until well blended. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour.

title: Artichokes Parmesan
instructions: Mince artichokes very fine and blend with remaining ingredients. In a small baking dish bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until slightly golden and bubbly around edges. Serve hot with assorted crackers. Especially good with Melba rounds.

title: Snails With Garlic
instructions: Rinse snails with cool water and drain. Melt butter in frying pan and add garlic. Saute lightly over medium-high heat. Add snails and saute. Remove from heat and place 1 snail in each shell. Add the rest of the ingredients to pan and mix together. Stuff some of the garlic mixture into each snail shell. Sprinkle with a little bread crumbs if desired. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until very bubbly. Makes 2 servings. Serve with crusty Italian bread.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop artichokes and add remaining 2 ingredients. Heat in a 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly and brown on edges. Let \sit\ for 10 minutes before serving with crackers.

title: Posole(Yields 12 Servings)
instructions: Boil Posole about 2 hours until it pops. Add pork onion and garlic. Boil until meat is cooked about 1 hour on medium heat. Add chile and tomatoes and season with salt to taste. The tomatoes cut the \hotness\ of the chile (acid neutralizes the base) and gives a tangy flavor. Chicken also makes good posole and is often used in place of pork.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Melt butter with peanut butter on low heat on stove top. Mix the powdered sugar in very thoroughly; you should have a doughy crumbled mixture. Then mix the Rice Krispies in with this mixture. Shape into balls or any shape you like. In a double boiler melt the chocolate chips and enough wax for a creamy mixture. Dip the balls in the chocolate and cool on wax paper.

title: Lemon Jello Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix with electric mixer until well blended. Pour into tube pan and bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 (or bake until done).

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: In long pan spread chicken over entire bottom. Slice boiled eggs and place over top of chicken. Pour mushroom soup over top of this. In separate bowl mix flour sweet milk and margarine. Pour this mixture over chicken eggs and cream of mushroom. Put black pepper on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Orange Punch
instructions: Boil sugar and 2 quarts water. Add Kool-Aid pineapple juice orange and water and frozen lemonade. Add ginger ale before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour baking soda cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Cream butter and sugar. Add applesauce; beat well. Add flour mixture in several additions. Beat gently. Fold in raisins. Turn into a greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Let stand on wire rack for 5 minutes. Turn out. Turn right side up. Good warm.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Wash and boil potatoes in skins until tender. Drain off water and allow to cool. Peel and dice potatoes to desired size. Peel and dice onion. (Dab eyes with dishcloth.) Wash and dice celery. Dice Velveeta into small pieces. (Eat a couple of pieces.) Place all ingredients into a large bowl and mix thoroughly. If too dry add more mayonnaise. Transfer all to a nice clean bowl and garnish with paprika and green olives with tail lights. Serves from1 to 12 depending on appetite.

title: Tempting Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine butter cream cheese mayonnaise garlic pepper worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Mix well. Stir in onion celery and shrimp. Chill well. Serves 8-10.

title: Honey Butter
instructions: Place butter in a bowl; add honey a little at a time stirring until syrupy looking. Great on fresh hot rolls.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream the sugar and oil together. Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well. Sift together the dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients alternately with water. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Delicious Potato Rolls
instructions: Pour 1 1/3 cups hot potato water over shortening sugar and salt. Allow to stand until lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water. Add to first mixture. Then add eggs mashed potatoes and flour.

title: Chicken Cacciatori
instructions: *If you leave these items out I suggest that you increase the tomatoes.

title: Lemon-Honey Carrots
instructions: Mix butter and mustard in saucepan. Stir in honey lemon peel and lemon juice. Heat. Pour over carrots. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix Crisco oil and sugar. Add all other ingredients. Bake in the oven at 350\u00b0. Bake 3 layer pans for 30 minutes. Bake a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan for 40 minutes. Bake a Bundt pan for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Chicken Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine soup milk spices Worcestershire sauce vegetables cubed chicken and 1/2 can of onions. Place in a 10-inch pie pan that has been prepared with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes then stir ingredients. Sprinkle with remaining onions and 1 cup of cheese. Bake for 10 minutes more or until cheese melts. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add vanilla sugar and salt. Stir in pecans and chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet lined with foil. Put in hot oven. Turn oven off. Leave in oven 3 hours or overnight.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Use outside leaves; separate and boil until done (about 8 leaves). Cook rice until done. Put hamburger in pan and cook until brown; remove and add onion chili powder paprika and cooked rice. Put about 3 tablespoons of mixture into each cabbage leaf. Put into baking dish. Pour catsup over cabbage and cook until done.

title: Salmon Souffle
instructions: Melt butter add flour and milk and cook until thick. Add all ingredients above (egg yolks only). Beat egg whites stiff and gently fold into mixture. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until a knife comes out clean about 45 to 50 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grandma'S Gingerbread
instructions: Mix and pour in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Run cheese through meat chopper. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and put in cookie press or roll thin and cut into narrow strips about 4-inches long and twist. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until light brown. Makes about 100.

title: Zucchini Fritters
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Use nonstick skillet well coated with spray. Heat skillet. Drop zucchini mixture by tablespoons into hot skillet. Brown on both sides.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Bubble Rolls
instructions: Mix butter and brown sugar. Separate biscuits and dust with a cinnamon sugar mixture. Place on edge around bottom of greased bundt pan (36 in all). Pour melted butter and brown sugar mixture over rolls. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes. Turn out on large plate when done so caramel will run over rolls.

title: Creamy Old-Fashioned Pralines
instructions: Mix in pot with wooden spoon. Turn fire on medium. Cook for 7 to 8 minutes until soft ball forms in tap water. Remove from heat add 1 tablespoon butter 1/4 teaspoon vanilla and 1 1/2 cup pecans. Beat about 1 minute until thick. Spoon out on greased waxed paper.

title: Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together. Pat out. Place 2 to 3 slices of cheese. Roll up. Place in pan. Baste with ketchup and brown sugar. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Orange Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix jello according to package directions. Let set in refrigerator for about 30 minutes. Remove and mix all other ingredients with it. Return to refrigerator and let it set all night. When ready to serve top with pineapple slices with a cherry in center.

title: Crispy Cocoa Bars
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan. In a large saucepan over low heat melt butter; stir in cocoa and marshmallows. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth and well blended. Continue cooking and stirring for one minute. Remove from heat; add cereal and stir until well coated. Press into buttered pan with a buttered spatula and let cool and then cut into 24 squares.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Add 1/2 stick butter and 1/2 pound Velveeta cheese. Stir until cheese dissolves. Put into greased casserole dish. Crush 1/4 pound Ritz crackers. Mix with 1/2 stick melted butter. Spread over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Weight Watcher Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Saute ground turkey onion and celery in oil in nonstick frypans sprayed with Pam. Add cooked rice spices bouillon V-8 and Worcestershire. Mix well. Spoon into pepper halves. Garnish with a tomato slice and 1 teaspoon grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered 1 hour. Four servings (2 halves each) equals 4 protein and 1 bread.

title: Fruit Leather
instructions: Preheat oven to 140\u00b0. Prepare pan turn baking sheet over bottom up. Cover bottom with plastic wrap. Secure wrap to sheet by taping down edges with masking tape. (This prevents the edges of wrap pulling up while fruit is drying.)

title: Classic Pecan Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir eggs corn syrup sugar butter and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie crust. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Makes 8 servings.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add water and vinegar. Boil for 5 minutes. Drain beets and add. Cook on low heat until beets are heated. Add butter or margarine; season with salt and pepper.

title: Foolproof Dark Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In a heavy saucepan over low heat melt chips with milk and salt. Spread evenly into foil-lined 8 or 9 inch square pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board peel off foil and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Soda-Flavored Ice Cream
instructions: Use any homemade ice cream machine (4 or 5 quart size). Can be increased proportionally (1 quart soda to 1 can milk). Fill ice cream bucket 4/5 full of mixture allowing room for freezing expansion and proceed to chill or make ice cream according to machine directions.

title: Out-Of-This-World Pie
instructions: In a saucepan combine cherry pie filling with sugar pineapple and juice cornstarch and food coloring. Cook until thick. Remove from heat and add gelatin. Allow to cool. Add bananas and pecans. Pour into two baked pie shells. Top with whipped topping. Chill.

title: Meatball Casserole
instructions: Roll the hamburger and onion together. Place in casserole dish then sprinkle garlic salt all over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until done. Boil potatoes until tender. Turn burner on low and mash with a little milk until creamy. Add Cheez Whiz and mix well. Pour over top of the meatballs and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chips Cake
instructions: Pour water over oatmeal and let stand 10 minutes. Add sugar and margarine. Add eggs and mix well. Sift flour soda salt and cocoa. Add to mix. Add half package of chocolate chips. Put batter in pan or muffin pans. Sprinkle top of batter with remaining chips and chopped nuts. No frosting is needed. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zesty Grilled Ham
instructions: In small saucepan bring brown sugar horseradish and lemon juice to a boil. Brush over both sides of ham. Grill over medium-hot coals turning once until heated through and well glazed about 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Skillet Corn
instructions: Combine corn salt pepper sugar butter and water in a 10-inch skillet. Cover and simmer 15 minutes over medium heat stirring occasionally. Combine flour and milk blending until smooth. Stir into corn. Cook 5 minutes over low heat stirring constantly.

title: Corned Beef Hash
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet. Stir in all ingredients mixing together. Cook until browned and potatoes are tender. A little water may be added from time to time if it starts to stick. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put everything in a blender and blend until smooth. It can be mixed until smooth with a mixer or by hand. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake until done.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies; set aside. Cream together cream cheese and butter and set aside. Blend pudding and milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Blend in cream cheese mixture. Layer the cake beginning with Oreo crumbs then pudding mixture and ending with Oreo crumbs.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour salt and shortening together until crumbly. Add hot water mix thoroughly. Divide into thirds. Roll out on floured board. Place in pan crimp edges. Makes 3 (10-inch) pie crusts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until desired brown.

title: Hot Beef Dip
instructions: Cut beef into small pieces. Combine beef and water into 4-cup glass measuring cup. Microwave on High for 3 minutes; drain. Mix in remaining ingredients. Insert microwave thermometer; microwave on Roast to 120\u00b0. Stir.

title: Cinnamon Rolls-Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt and yeast. Heat milk water and margarine. Gradually add to dry ingredients. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed. Add 1 egg and 1/2 cup flour. Beat on high speed for 2 minutes. Stir in 2 1/2 cups to 3 cups flour to make a soft dough. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl and grease top of dough. Cover and let rise until double. Punch down; turn onto floured board. Divide into two parts 1/2 for rolls.

title: Shredded Barbecue Beef
instructions: Mix ingredients all together well. Pour over raw roast. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Remove from roaster and shred with fork. Enjoy!

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole or 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Sour Cream Doughnuts
instructions: Put enough shortening into deep frying kettle to fry doughnuts. Sift flour add salt baking powder soda and nutmeg. Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat. Add sour cream. Add to dry mixture. Remove 1/2 of dough to pastry cloth. Roll about 1/4-inch thick. Cut with doughnut cutter. Fry in hot shortening (370\u00b0). Drain. Roll in powdered sugar or dip in doughnut glaze.

title: Brownie Pudding
instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients together. Spread mixture in 8 x 8-inch pan. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over brownie mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Good either hot or cold.

title: Cherry Pie Filling Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix eggs and oil. Add cherry pie filling. Pour into sprayed 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Sweet Potato, Crunchy Top Casserole
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients. Pour into baking dish.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the pineapple juice. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add pineapple juice and return to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Sandy'S Delight
instructions: Wash and cut strawberries in fourths. Mix in fruit cocktail then add strawberry jel. Mix well; chill. Top with whipped cream and serve.

title: Spice Pecans
instructions: Beat egg and water until it foams. Stir in pecans. Mix sugar and spices. Sprinkle over pecans. Stir; cover all. Pour in pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Chicken 'N' Biscuits
instructions: In medium saucepan saute onion and margarine. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Whisk in 2 1/2 cups milk. Cook until slightly thickened. Add next four ingredients. Divide into 4 (8 ounce) baking dishes. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In medium bowl combine remaining 3/4 cup milk the biscuit mix and parsley. Drop 4 or 5 teaspoons of biscuit mixture on each baking dish. Bake about 15 minutes until mixture is bubbly and biscuits are browned.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash (cut to bite size pieces) onion salt and sugar. Simmer in 1 cup of water until tender. Drain well. Add eggs oleo flour milk and cheese and mix well. Bake in greased casserole in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake per directions in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool. Poke holes in cake. Drizzle with Kahlua and refrigerate overnight. Prepare mousse per directions. Cut cake in small squares. Layer bottom of glass bowl with cake squares. Cover with a layer of mousse then layer with Cool Whip and smashed Heath bars. Repeat layers ending with Heath bars.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Combine juice from beets vinegar and brown sugar; heat to boiling. Put beets in jar then eggs. Pour hot juice over top. After cool refrigerate.

title: Lemon Icebox
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl beat egg yolks condensed milk and lemon juice. Pour into pie shell. Bake 30 minutes. Cool then top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Cut tops off and center out of peppers. Put peppers in boiling water; cook until tender. Saute meat and pepper tops with salt. Drain off excess oil. Mix well the meat rice 1/2 of liquid from tomatoes and soups. If you want it hotter add rest of tomato juice. Place peppers in pan and stuff with mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbling hot.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Drain fruit and set aside. Melt butter in iron skillet. Pour in coconut and brown add vanilla wafer crumbs. Remove from heat. Put aside 1/2 cup of mixtrue. Press immediately in 2 pie plates. Beat milk and lemon juice until peaked add cool whip. Gently fold in fruit and walnuts. Top with crust mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Blt Dip
instructions: Let chill about 1 hour. Serve on crackers or cocktail rye.

title: Mexican Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef onion green pepper and garlic together and drain. Add next 8 ingredients and simmer until slightly cooked. Add meat mixture to noodles and add grated cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and cover with foil. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; put in a jello mold or just a bowl. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter cream cheese and sugar. Add and beat well the almond vanilla and lemon flavor. Add eggs one at a time. Stir in cake flour and mix well. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours (check after 1 hour). Makes a large cake.

title: Baskin Robbins Cake
instructions: Crust Mix flour butter and pecans. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil the chicken until done. Debone and place in a large bowl. Add both cans of soup and sour cream; mix well. Put in a casserole dish. Crumble up the entire sleeve of crackers and sprinkle on top of the chicken mixture. Melt 1 stick of margarine and pour over the top of the crackers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven until bubbly. Throw together your favorite green salad add some rolls and you have a quick meal. Cream of celery or onion soup may be used as the soup.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Combine butter shortening and sugar creaming until light and fluffy. Add vanilla. Work in flour and coconut gradually until well blended. Form into 2 rolls; chill in refrigerator overnight. Heat oven to 275\u00b0. Slice dough 1/4-inch thick. Slices may be cut in fancy shapes. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Dream Pie
instructions: Prepare Dream Whip as directed on package. Combine 1 cup prepared Dream Whip with pudding mix pumpkin 2/3 cup milk and spice. Beat slowly with eggbeater just until mixed. Pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator until set about 2 hours. Top with remaining Dream Whip.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: In a medium mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in ReaLemon. Stir in remaining ingredients except chips. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Applesauce Cake(No Eggs)
instructions: Cream oil and sugar. Add applesauce and flour which has been mixed with spices. Mix in raisins. Mix soda with hot water and add last. Pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with granulated sugar making a light coating. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done. No frosting is needed. Best served warm.

title: Blue Cheese Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks. Position knife blade in food processor bowl. Add yolks Blue cheese and remaining ingredients. Process until smooth stopping once to scrape down sides. Spoon or pipe into egg whites.

title: Kente Cloth Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions on package and bake in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Cool cake 15 minutes in pan. Remove from pan and let cool completely on a rack. Wash and dry cake pan. Return cake back to pan placing top up. Pierce cake with a large fork at 1/2-inch intervals.

title: Pear Marmalade
instructions: Cook pears like salad pears then mash them. Add jello and pineapple. Cook over low heat about 30 minutes then put in jars.

title: Honey Graham Cake
instructions: Crush crackers and mix with chopped cherries and pecans. Melt Parkay margarine and marshmallows together and pour over cracker mixture. Press well into a greased tube pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Garlic salt and flour cubes; brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Drain fat; add next 5 ingredients. Simmer 2 hours. You may add more water and consomme. Cool and add sour cream and soup.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs bananas pecans buttermilk and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients. Gradually add to creamed mix. Beat well. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done when tested.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In bacon drippings cook rice onion and green pepper until onion is tender. Add bacon and other ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat about 30 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix flour and Parmesan cheese in a plastic bag. Shake a few potato cubes in bag at a time and put in buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. With a spatula turn over and bake another 1/2 hour. Leftover cheese may be put in freezer for next time.

title: Peanut Butter Cookie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spoon out on cookie sheet; mash with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: P T A Cookies
instructions: Mix together syrup and sugar in a saucepan. Boil mixture for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla until well blended. Add cereal. Mix until coated. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Creme Sherry Wine Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix pudding eggs salad oil sherry and walnuts or pecans. Grease and lightly flour Bundt pan. Pour in pan and bake at least 45 minutes.

title: Susie'S Chocolate Fudge Icing
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and bring to boil cooking until drops from spoon\tand barely holds its shape. Remove from heat and add butter and dash of salt. Bake 3 thin layers of cake and ice with mixture poking holes in bottom layers so the fudge will soak through.

title: Pecan Crescents
instructions: Cream oleo sugar and vanilla; add flour then nuts mix well. Roll and shape into crescents. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove and cool slightly. Put powdered sugar into a zip lock baggie. When the cookies are cooled a little add a few at a time to the powdered sugar and shake gently. Shake off any extra powdered sugar. Set on paper towels to finish cooling. This makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: A Berry Good Banana Smoothie
instructions: Peel and slice bananas. Wash and cut off tops of strawberries. Put into blender with milk and yogurt and whirl away. Pour into cups and enjoy!

title: Molasses Cookie
instructions: Combine sugar oil and egg; beat well. Add molasses and beat. Combine flour and other ingredients. Stir into sugar mixture. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Fudge Dessert
instructions: Mix crushed Oreos with melted butter. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Freeze.

title: Low-Fat Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Beat egg brown sugar and oil until smooth. Beat in yogurt and vanilla. Add oats flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Beat until well mixed. Stir in raisins. Drop batter by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2-inches apart on baking sheet lightly sprayed with vegetable oil spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned. Cool on wire rack. Each cookie contains 59 calories. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Hello Dollies
instructions: In a large rectangular pan melt the margarine. Sprinkle cracker crumbs chocolate and butterscotch bits coconut and nuts (in this order) over the melted margarine. Pour milk over all of this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Molded Candy
instructions: Add water until until right consistency. Mix in mixer then knead. Roll in small ball roll in regular sugar put in mold remove. Put on wax paper to dry overnight. 1 recipe makes 10 dozen.

title: A-Maze-Ing Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl mix corn brown sugar and white sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add oil; beat until well mixed. Stir in raisins and pecans. Mix together dry ingredients; add to liquid. Stir until well blended. Pour into greased tube pan and bake for 45 minutes or until tests done. Can be used with or without frosting.

title: Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Roll chicken in mixture of flour salt pepper and paprika. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add chicken pieces skin side down. Bake 40 minutes; then turn chicken. Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken. Place biscuits on top and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Bean And Bacon Soup
instructions: In a 1-quart casserole combine onion celery bell pepper garlic and oil. Cover; vent top and microwave on High 3 minutes until softened. Stir halfway through cooking. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Cover and microwave on High 1 minute until thoroughly heated. Serves two 1-cup servings. Contains 164 calories 6 gm fat and 496 mg sodium.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Mix together by hand. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Frost cake while warm.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix everything together. Pour into well-greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream margarine and brown sugar. Add egg and milk alternately with flour and baking powder. Bake in muffin tin and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake in hot oven.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients well adding milk only if mixture is too dry. Fry in heated buttered skillet until done. Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt on each side of patty while frying.

title: Great Northern Bean Stew
instructions: In large saucepan or 4-quart Dutch oven brown sausage and onions; drain. Stir in all remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix Velveeta milk and butter in saucepan until melts. Pour over hash browns. Bake about 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 8 to 10 large portions. Quick and delicious recipe. Easy to make and great for large group casserole. Enjoy it!!!

title: Party Mix
instructions: Melt candy coating in double boiler. Pour over remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Chicken With White Wine
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and paprika. Coat well with flour. Brown in 1/4 cup butter. Remove chicken and add remaining butter. Brown mushrooms scallions celery and garlic. Return chicken to pan. Add wine and simmer slowly for 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Squash Balls
instructions: Mix cooked squash finely chopped onion 1 egg flour and baking powder salt and pepper. Form small balls and roll in crushed corn flakes. Fry in deep oil until golden brown. Serve hot. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Very Good.

title: Crunch Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Line 10 x 15 x 1-inch pan with foil. Arrange saltines in pan. In saucepan melt butter and brown sugar. Heat to boiling; boil for 3 minutes. Pour evenly over crackers. Bake about 7 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over top; spread evenly. Cool. Refrigerate 1 hour. Break into pieces. Store in refrigerator.

title: Nicaraguan Fried Rice
instructions: Wash and drain rice. Set aside. In skillet heat oil and saute onion green pepper and carrot. Add 2 cups water and salt on medium heat until rice is done. Three minutes before spread chopped tomato on top. When rice is done top with lid.

title: Cranberry Cloud
instructions: In processor coarsely grind cranberries. Combine berries marshmallows and sugar in large bowl; stir gently. Cover and chill at least 1 1/2 hours. Add apples grapes and nuts; stir gently. Fold in cream or Cool Whip. Cover and chill 1 hour. Serve on lettuce.

title: Ham Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop ham and crackers together in food processor. Mix together cream cheese Miracle Whip and garlic powder. Add ham and cracker mixture to cream cheese mixture. Form into ball. Roll in nuts. Chill.

title: Elegant Butternut Squash Soup
instructions: Halve the squash lengthwise; peel seed and cut into chunks. Place in a soup pot with the broth. Simmer partially covered until tender 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer the squash to a bowl with a slotted spoon; reserve broth. Melt the butter in the oil in a nonstick skillet over very low heat. Add the onion and cook stirring until wilted about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with the mace and ginger. Cook stirring for 1 minute more. Add the cooked onion mixture and the brown sugar to the squash and stir well. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Crunchy Surprise Bars
instructions: Mix sugar butter molasses egg yolk and vanilla with a spoon. Stir in flour and 1 cup of chocolate bits. Press dough in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake until golden brown 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Infallible Rice
instructions: Saute onions in butter until transparent. Combine onions rice and hot broth. Bring to boil; turn on low heat. Cover and cook for 25 minutes.

title: Robbie'S Favorite Graham Cracker Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix nuts cherries and crackers together. Pour juices into double boiler and melt marshmallows. Pour over mixture and pack back into cracker box.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Wash tomatoes and scoop out pulp. Save caps. Sprinkle inside of tomatoes with salt substitute. Pan broil onions in a little oil until soft. Now mix onions parsley dill raisins or currants nuts rice and more of olive oil. Fill tomatoes with remaining oil and the water. Weigh down the tomatoes with a heavy plate. Cover casserole. Let simmer for 30 minutes or until rice is done. Let cool. May be refrigerated. Serve cold. Serves 6.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well. Put in two quart dish and cover with topping.

title: Poor Man'S Lobster
instructions: Place water salt lemon juice onion and celery in 4-quart pan. Bring to boil. Add fish. Bring to boil again for 3 minutes. Drain. Place fish on cookie sheet. Brush on melted margarine or butter and sprinkle paprika on top. Broil 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Combine cocoa and sugar in a small saucepan. Stir in milk and water with wire whisk until smooth. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Serve warm over ice milk. Yield 1 cup (26 calories per tablespoon plus 100 calories per 1/2 cup ice milk).

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Dump undrained pineapple into pan. Spread evenly. Dump in pie filling and spread evenly. Dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer. Spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts over cake mix. Put butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Very good with whipped cream.

title: Corn Oyster Scallop
instructions: Combine oyster stew corn 1 1/4 cups crumbs egg salt pepper and pimentos. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Combine margarine and 1/2 cup crumbs; sprinkle around edge of corn mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until knife inserted halfway comes out clean.

title: No Cook Recipe
instructions: Load family (husband included) into family vehicle (van preferably for separating kids). Drive to nearest location (cant stand kids for any longer) and release kids on the establishment (hopefully theres a playground). When food is gone (whether in stomachs or on floor) leave to the relief of others sitting around you. Oh! Dont forget your coupons!

title: Coconut Pies
instructions: Beat eggs well. Mix remaining ingredients into beaten eggs. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 2 pies; one to eat and one to share.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Peel and slice onions. In a skillet saute onions in butter over low heat until soft and lightly brown. Sprinkle with flour; add water stirring. Crumble bouillon cubes and add to pan. Add bouquet garni salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Cover; cook for about 20 minutes. Add white wine to soup. Transfer soup to individual ovenproof soup bowls or ovenproof large bowl. Place sliced bread on top. Sprinkle generously with grated cheese. Heat oven to 450\u00b0 for about 10 minutes until cheese melts and turns golden brown.

title: Rice
instructions: Fry bacon; add celery onion green pepper and tomato and saute. Add rice. Let brown with bacon and vegetables; add water or chicken broth. Cover; let come to boil turn heat to low and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Batter Bread
instructions: In a mixer bowl combine 1 1/2 cups of flour yeast oregano and garlic powder. In a saucepan heat water oleo sugar and salt just until warm stirring to melt oleo. Add to dry ingredients in bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. By hand stir in pepperoni and enough remaining flour to make a moderately soft dough. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk 45 to 60 minutes. Stir dough down. Spread evenly in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Let rise 30 more minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Stir in egg yolks one at a time. Add soda to flour. Add flour and sour cream alternately to creamed mixture. Beat egg whites stiff and fold in. Bake in large tube pan greased and floured at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until a toothpick comes out clean. Leave in pan for 15 minutes.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in top of double boiler. Beat one minute at high speed to blend; then place over boiling water and beat until mixture forms peaks when beater is raised about 7 minutes. Remove from boiling water; add vanilla. Continue beating until thick enough to spread.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cake
instructions: First Layer Pinch cake in bite size pieces. Mix with 1 1/2 small boxes of Cool Whip. Put in loaf pan.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies. Melt butter and mix with Oreos. Put aside 1/4 cup of mixture. Put the rest in 9 x 13-inch pan. Soften cream cheese. Mix with pudding and 3 cups milk. Put on top of Oreo mixture. Let set 2 hours in refrigerator. Put Cool Whip and 1/4 cup Oreo mixture on top.

title: New England Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Thicken boiling milk with flour (mix flour with milk and cook until smooth). Mix all other ingredients except egg whites. When thoroughly mixed add slightly beaten egg whites. Bake until brown on top; well done. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven first 15 minutes then 325\u00b0 for 30 plus minutes.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and confectioners sugar with electric mixer until well blended. Cut angel food cake in half horizontally to make 2 layers. Spread cream cheese mixture between layers on sides and on top of the cake. Let it drizzle down the side. Top with cherry pie filling. Place cake covered in refrigerator overnight or several hours before serving.

title: Saucy Smokies
instructions: Place Smokies in medium saucepan; combine with jelly and 1/2 bottle chili sauce. Simmer over low heat until jelly melts stirring occasionally. When sauce is thickened remove from heat and place in serving bowl.

title: 60-Minute Cheese Fondue Boat
instructions: Set aside 1 cup of flour. Mix remaining flour sugar salt garlic and yeast. Stir in water and margarine. Mix in enough reserved flour to make soft dough. Knead 4 minutes. Roll dough 18 x 8 inches. Spread mayonnaise down center third of length. Top with cheese and onions. Seal long edges over filling at 1 inch intervals; seal ends. Set on greased baking sheet. Cover. Place over large shallow pan of boiling water; let rise 15 minutes. Bake for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Cork And Cleaver Mud Pie
instructions: Crush wafers into fine crumbs and mix thoroughly with melted margarine. Press into a 9-inch pie tin about halfway up the sides. Crust should be about 1/8-inch thick. Firm in freezer for 15 minutes. Whip softened ice cream until smooth. Fill pie shell so that top is mounded to 3-inches in the center and less than 1-inch on the edges. Place in freezer to harden. When ice cream is firm spread topping to 1/8-inch thickness all over top and return to freezer to harden. Serve on a chilled plate. (Suggest you also chill server.) Top each slice with whipped cream and sliced toasted almonds.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Layer bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with graham crackers then whip pudding as directed (less one cup milk). Let stand for 1 minute then add container of whipped cream to pudding. Put thin layer on crackers then another layer of crackers and so on until you end up with a layer of crackers on top. Put frosting in microwave until runny and pour on top of mixture. Refrigerate about 3 hours.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mix together and serve.

title: Mina'S Old-Fashioned Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar and shortening; add egg milk and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Bake 14 minutes at 350\u00b0. Drop by spoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Melt together first 3 ingredients. Pour over popcorn peanuts and M&Ms. Mix well and pack into angel food pan (sprayed). Pack well; also can be put into two bread pans.

title: Russian Cream Salad
instructions: Double these ingredients for one jello mold.

title: Chewy Pecan Squares
instructions: Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan. Stir together egg brown sugar and vanilla. Quickly stir in flour soda and salt. Add nuts. Spread in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Should be soft in center when removed from oven. Do not overbake. Leave in pan and cut into 2-inch squares. Makes 16 squares.

title: Quick Taco Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Stir in seasoning mix (dry) tomato sauce and corn. Sprinkle with cheese. Stir remaining ingredients until blended. Pour over beef mixture. Bake 35 minutes or until light golden brown. Serve with sour cream chopped tomato and shredded lettuce if desired. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Raisin Pie(From The Parsonage Kitchen)
instructions: Combine raisins sugar flour vinegar butter and salt in boiling water. Roll pie dough and spread bottom crust with margarine; add raisin mixture. Wet edges of crust with water. Place top crust on top of filling and seal down good. Bake in hot oven at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then lower heat and bake until brown.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole(Serves 12 To 15)
instructions: Mix and put in 13 x 11-inch casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Put buttered crumbs on top of casserole the last 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Peel oranges; grind in blender. Add cranberries a few at a time until all are blended well. Add boiling water sugar and Jell-O; stir until all is dissolved. Add cranberry mixture and nuts; stir. Refrigerate until thickened.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add all wet ingredients and mix well. (Mixture will look like pudding.) Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Frost with Butter Frosting.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Spread\tjam on the bottom only of pie crust and set aside. At medium speed mix cheese and peanut butter. Beat in\tsugar and vanilla. Blend in Cool Whip (or whipped cream) carefully. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Mock Pink Champagne
instructions: Early in day mix sugar with water in saucepan and boil 5 minutes. Cool and add frozen juices. Refrigerate. At serving time add ginger ale and grenadine syrup. Stir lightly. Makes 1 1/2 quarts or 10 servings.

title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter brown sugar and shortening. Gradually add white sugar and beat. Add eggs 1 at a time and beat. Combine baking powder flour and salt. Add alternately with milk. Add vanilla and nuts. Blend well. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool 15 minutes and take out of pan.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix squash soup milk onion pepper and salt with 7 Ritz crackers crumbled. Put in casserole. Top with another 7 crackers. Drizzle margarine over this and cover with French fried onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and eggs. Add sour cream flour salt and baking soda. Mix well. Can also add walnuts or raisins to this recipe. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Potato Leek Soup
instructions: Use white part of leeks clean and chop with garlic in blender or food processor. Saute in butter or margarine until leeks are softened. Add peeled diced potatoes to leeks and garlic; mix to blend together. Add water to cover ingredients and cook until leeks and potatoes are tender. Add salt pepper and dill. If you care to you can add milk sweet cream or evaporated milk.

title: Paul'S Favorite Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine powdered sugar eggs vanilla and almond extract until thoroughly mixed up. Add flour soda and cream of tartar. Cover and chill overnight. Set oven to 375\u00b0. Divide dough. Roll each part of dough to about 3/16-inch thick on a floured cloth covered board. Cut into desired shapes; sprinkle with sugar. Put on baking sheet. Bake about 7 minutes or until they are light brown.

title: Chinese Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Colleen'S Ultra Fudgy Brownies
instructions: Microwave halved chocolate squares and butter in a large glass bowl for 1 minute and 45 seconds or until butter is melted. Stir until chocolate is melted. Let this mixture cool.

title: Edith'S Pineapple Salad
instructions: Add first 4 ingredients and refrigerate. Can also add a container of whipped cream.

title: Golden Glazed Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In shallow baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch) arrange chicken (skin side up). Brush with butter. Bake for 45 minutes. Baste once with pan drippings. Combine remaining ingredients; spoon over chicken. Bake 15 minutes more or until chicken is done. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Tuts Toffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange crackers 7 across and 5 down. Melt butter with brown sugar mix and pour over saltines. Bake 15 to 20 minutes (will bubble and harden when removed). Sprinkle warm toffee with chocolate chips and spread with a spatula when melted. Sprinkle with nuts. Chill until firm. Peel off foil and break into pieces.

title: Betty'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together eggs syrup salt vanilla sugar and butter. Stir in nuts and pour into pastry shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes. Filling should appear slightly less set in the center.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by small spoonfuls into deep hot fat. Puppies float when done.

title: Candy Cane Popcorn Balls
instructions: Keep popped corn in 225\u00b0 oven. Butter sides of saucepan. Combine sugar syrup vinegar 1 1/2 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook until hard-ball stage (250\u00b0 on candy thermometer). Stir in vanilla. Slowly pour over corn; stir just to mix well. Butter hands; shape mixture into balls around candy. Makes 15 to 20.

title: Mountain Dew Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a bundt pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in broccoli and 1/2 can of onions. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Prune Whip
instructions: Crook prunes as package label directs. Drain prunes reserving liquid. Remove 1/2 cup cooked prunes for later. Puree remaining prunes in blender or food mill with 1/2 cup of cooking liquid. Add lemon juice. Let cool. With mixer at high speed beat egg whites with salt until frothy. Gradually beat in sugar beat until stiff peaks form. Add puree of prunes 1/4 cup at a time beating well. Beat at high speed 2 minutes. Chop remaining prunes and fold into mixture along with 1/4 cup cream whipped. Turn into 6 or 8 sherbet dishes. Refrigerate. Garnish each with a little whipped cream if desire or serve with custard sauce. Makes 6 or 8 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Dice chicken and and with mix rice and mushroom soup. Top with cheese. Heat until the casserole reaches 140 degrees and cheese is melted.

title: Fruit Cocktail Frosting
instructions: Add the oleo sugar and evaporated milk and let this boil slowly for 10 minutes stirring often then add nuts coconut and vanilla. Cook for a couple minutes. Let it sit for about 10 minutes then put on a warm cake.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/2-inch slices. Mix flour salt pepper and seasoned salt in one bowl. Mix eggs and milk in another bowl. Dip tomato slices into egg mixture then into flour. Repeat again coating well. Fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain on paper towels. Arrange on platter and enjoy!

title: Homemade Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. This will make the same amount of milk as a can of condensed milk.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together in a bowl. Put in 3-quart casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
instructions: Fry sausage in skillet stirring until crumbly and browned. Combine sausage cheese pepper and biscuit mix. Add water and mix well. Form into small balls. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve hot or cold. May be frozen before baking.

title: Porcupine Balls
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix rice 1/2 cup water onion salts garlic powder and pepper. Shape into balls. Place in ungreased baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs. Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Camper'S Fare Skillet Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add salt and pepper. Pour off fat. Add all other ingredients to hamburger in a skillet. Cook until thickened stirring occasionally about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Spray mini-muffin pan with Pam. Press cookie dough into muffin pan. Bake until done.

title: Rolls
instructions: Let yeast dissolve in 1/4 cup warm water. Mix flour and liquid to form soft dough. Knead gently on floured board. Form dough in 12 small balls and place in muffin pan. Brush with oleo. Let double in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Dip skinned chicken in melted butter. Roll in dry mixture. Bake in a tinfoil lined baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix thoroughly and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine strawberry jello with 1 1/2 cups boiling water; mix. Add strawberries and bananas. Add pineapple; mix and layer with sour cream.

title: Apple Crisp 2
instructions: Slice peeled apples into a 1-quart buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with spices and lemon juice. Work together sugar flour and butter until crumbly. Spread over the apples. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes in a moderate oven (375\u00b0) or until apples are tender. If mixture becomes dry while cooking add a small amount of water. Serve cold with whipped cream or hot with plain cream. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Eight Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Roll graham crackers fine. Heat margarine until melted and add sugar and cracker crumbs. Spread in 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish and bake 8 minutes at 350\u00b0. Set aside and cool. Mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar until creamy. Spread over baked crust. Spread the Cool Whip over the top of cream cheese and sugar mixture. Spoon cherry or strawberry pie filling on top of Cool Whip. Chill for 24 hours before serving.

title: Quick Coffee Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix by directions on package in 2 pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Dribble melted butter over warm cake. Combine sugar coffee and cinnamon and sprinkle over cake. Chopped nuts may be added if desired.

title: Best Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in water about 20 minutes until fork-tender. Drain well. Return to pot. In saucepan beat milk and butter over low heat until butter melts. Stir in salt and pepper. Add to potatoes and mash with potato masher or mixer until smooth.

title: Creamy Coleslaw
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate. Reduce 1/3 to 1/4 for family.

title: Taco Roll
instructions: Brown meat. Mix taco seasoning as directed on package. On a baking sheet roll out crescent rolls. Add hamburger meat and raw onions. Top with crescent rolls. Cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Serve with tomatoes cheese etc.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat. Saute onion and pepper until onion is transparent. Add tomatoes rice seasonings and water. Cook 10 minutes over medium heat. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise; add to skillet; mix well. Cook covered stirring occasionally until liquid is absorbed about 20 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cherry Dream Pie
