instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium bowl beat egg yolks; stir in Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice. Pour into crust; bake 8 minutes. Cool. Chill 3 hours or overnight.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Dice and cook carrots until tender. Combine all the rest of the ingredients; heat to near boiling. Drain the carrots and mix into the sauce; let cool.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and slice. Cook broccoli. Heat soup mayo and curry powder. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place broccoli on bottom. Place chicken on top and cover with soup mixture and sprinkle with grated cheese. Three cups cooked rice can also be used as the first layer. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Snowballs
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients except confectioners sugar. With hands mix until thoroughly blended. Refrigerate dough 30 minutes. Meanwhile preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Form dough into 1 1/4-inch balls. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet; bake 15 to 20 minutes or until set but not brown. Let stand 1 minute. Remove to wire racks; cool partially. Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm; roll again. Makes about 20.

title: Tuna Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium bowl by hand. Take a small handful and form into patty. Fry on medium-high with oil just covering bottom of pan. Fry until lightly brown. Makes 6 burgers.

title: Cheese Fondue
instructions: In large pot on stove rub a clove of garlic and discard. Bring wine to bubble (not quite boil) and gradually add cheese (already cut and\ttossed\twith cornstarch) stirring constantly. When cheese is melted add spices and pour into fondue pot. If too stringy when eating increase heat.

title: Waffles
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Mix everything but egg whites together. Beat egg whites and fold into batter. Makes about 12 waffles.

title: Cherry Crisp
instructions: Mix dry ingredients until crumbly. Pat half of mixture into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Spread pie filling over mixture. Cover with other half of crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Ann Mcgill Erck'S Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and eggs until smooth. Add sour cream and vanilla. Sift flour salt and baking powder and add. Pour half this batter into greased and floured tube pan. Add half of topping of cinnamon brown sugar and pecans. Add remaining batter and remaining topping. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand until cool enough to handle and unmold cake. Freezes well.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook chicken. Cut in chunks and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook broccoli according to directions; layer. Add cheese. Mix 1/2 cup milk with celery soup. Pour on top. Mix dressing according to directions and spread on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Fruit Salad
instructions: In a large bowl prepare 1 package of Jell-O as directions indicate. Add drained pineapple. Sprinkle remaining package of Jell-O over mixture. Stir in cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Blend until smooth. Refrigerate until set in 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch pan.

title: Chicken Roll Ups
instructions: Cook soup milk and grated cheese until cheese is melted. Pour in casserole dish. In each crescent roll put a strip of chicken and a strip of cheese. Roll up and place on top of soup mixture. Cook in 350 degree oven until rolls are brown.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Grease pie pan. Brown meat and onion; drain. Add salt and pepper; spread into pan. Beat milk Bisquick and eggs. Pour over meat. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 then add tomato sauce and cheese over top. Bake until knife inserted comes out clean about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Cut spareribs into servings. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in a roaster pan and cover with onions. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Baste occasionally turning ribs once or twice. Remove cover from roaster during the last 15 minutes of baking to brown spareribs.

title: Mile High Strawberry Pie
instructions: Use a large mixing bowl. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Add sugar and cream of tartar very slowly to stiffly beaten egg whites. Slowly add the nearly unfrozen berries and juice to the egg white peaks. Beat on high with mixer for 15 minutes. Put into pie shell of your choosing and freeze. Add sliced berries and whipped cream for garnish before serving.

title: Broken Glass Dessert
instructions: Make graham cracker crust. (Save some crumbs to sprinkle on top.) Combine ingredients for dessert.

title: Snacks
instructions: Mix well the day before going to use. Turn several times to mix good. You can add 1/4 cup grated cheese or use cheese crackers.

title: Shrimp And Shells
instructions: Cook macaroni. Rinse and drain. Combine with remaining ingredients in large bowl. Gently stir in dressing. Cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together and top with 1 cup corn flakes. Dot with margarine. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Meat Loaf With Zesty Topping
instructions: Pour milk over bread crumbs. Add ground beef salt pepper carrot onion and eggs. Mix thoroughly. Pack in a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and eggs. Add baking powder salt and flour. Stir in chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 10 x 14-inch pan.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; set aside. Cream together all other ingredients; mix well and add to flour mixture. Add chocolate chips and nuts (optional). Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in chilies and barbecue sauce. Spoon into 10 x 6-inch baking dish.

title: Tang Pie
instructions: Mix Tang with Eagle Brand milk. Make sure Tang is dissolved and add sour cream and Cool Whip; mix well. Put in graham cracker pie crust.\tChill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Bake in oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Chop the onions tomatoes green peppers and pickles and mix with the cornbread and bacon. Add pickle juice and mayonnaise to taste for the dressing.

title: Crunchy Fudge Sandwiches
instructions: In a large saucepan melt butterscotch flavored morsels and peanut butter over very low heat stirring constantly until smooth. Stir in cereal. Press half of the mixture in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill. Set remaining mixture aside. Melt over hot (not boiling) water the chocolate morsels sugar margarine and water stirring constantly until smooth. Spread over chilled cereal mixture. Spread remaining cereal mixture evenly over top. Press in gently. Chill until firm (1 hour). Yields 25 squares (1 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch).

title: Boiled Raisin Cake
instructions: Boil together 3 minutes the first 8 ingredients. Cool. Sift together the remaining ingredients. Add to first part and bake. Can be used at holiday time for fruit cake. Improves with time. Can be made ahead to season.

title: Lemon Krispies Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir together dry cake mix butter and eggs in a mixing bowl. Stir in cereal. Roll dough into 1 1/2 inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. bake 8 to 10 minutes until edges are brown. Cool on cookie sheet before moving to a cooling rack.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift together in mixing bowl first 5 ingredients. Add next 4 and stir until smooth. Pour into an ungreased 8x8 square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Use any glaze or icing but must be iced and served from pan. If quantity is doubled bake in 9x13 pan.

title: Vegetable Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust and brush with egg if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie(Lo-Cal)
instructions: Make and set aside.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and pour into crust. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Christmas Brunch Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift the dry ingredients together and add to the butter mixture alternately with the sour cream. Pour half the batter into a buttered tube pan.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Melt butter (2 tablespoons). Add flour and seasonings. Cook over low heat until bubbly. Slowly stir in milk. Heat to boiling. Stir in corn and egg. Pour into casserole dish; sprinkle with crumbs and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in an 8 x 11-inch Pyrex pan in oven. Combine apples water and 1 cup sugar in a saucepan. Cook 3 to 4 minutes. Pour apples in pan with margarine. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Mix flour baking powder milk and 1 cup sugar. Pour over apples. Sprinkle with brown sugar and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Surprise
instructions: Brown meat onions and bell peppers in skillet. Drain excess fat. Add rice and diced cooked potatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Crinkles(Croatian)
instructions: Chop raisins and walnuts finely. Melt chocolate. Blend together butter sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Stir in raisins nuts and chocolate. Mix until well blended.

title: Breakfast Souffle
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Beat eggs with milk mustard and salt. Cube bread and layer with sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour egg mixture over layers; cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 (20 minutes with foil on and 25 minutes with foil off). Do not overbake.

title: Curried Celery And Apples
instructions: In a skillet saute celery and onion in butter until crisp-tender about 5 minutes. Stir in apple. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes. Sprinkle with flour curry powder salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve immediately. Yield 4 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Peanut Butter Pie(Heritage Recipe)
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in 1/2 c. cold water add rest of ingredients. Cook until thick and pour into baked crust. Use egg whites for meringue. Makes 2 pies.

title: Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Saute onions and celery in nonstick skillet sprayed with Pam. Combine flour with 1/2 cup of the broth in a small jar with a lid. Shake until there are no lumps. Add to kettle and slowly add rest of broth and milk. Stir over medium heat until thickened. Add cooked wild rice and chicken. Heat to serving temperature. Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

title: Buffalo Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan blend onion soup mix butter and pepper sauce. Add potatoes and turn to coat. Bake stirring occasionally 45 minutes or until potatoes are crisp. Serve with dressing. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Almond Bark Candy
instructions: Melt together over low heat or on 50% power in microwave the almond bark and peanut butter. In large bowl mix peanuts marshmallows and Rice Krispies. Pour melted mixture over and mix all together. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Refrigerate to set. These freeze well.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add beans with liquid. Add salt and taco seasoning to taste. Simmer 10 minutes. Drain off all liquids and cool. Chill before serving. Gently toss the lettuce tomatoes dressing cheese and chips together. Stir in meat and bean mixture.

title: Fried Dwaine-Feast Breakfast(Fried Potatoes, Fried Apples, Fried Saucy Grits, Fried Eggs)
instructions: Fried Potatoes Fry potatoes onion bell pepper and garlic on medium heat in just enough oil to keep potatoes from sticking (3 to 4 tablespoons of oil) season with salt and pepper.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients until dough is formed; drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump pineapple and pie filling in bottom of oblong pan. Mix and spread evenly over bottom. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over those. Pour melted margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle evenly with coconut and then pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spider Sandwiches
instructions: With a 2 1/2-inch round cutter cut a circle from each bread slice. Spread about 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on half of bread rounds; top with remaining bread rounds. Make 2 small indentations on top of sandwiches for \eyes\. Using peanut butter as glue push one raisin into each indentation.

title: Dried Beef Casserole
instructions: Into greased casserole put soup and milk. Stir and add rest of ingredients; stir. Store covered 3 to 4 hours or overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovering the last 10 minutes to brown.

title: Butterscotch Oaties
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butterscotch morsels and butter; melt over boiling water. Remove from heat. Mix boiling water with baking soda and add to butterscotch mixture. Gradually blend in the remaining ingredients. Drop by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Baked Fruit
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place mandarin orange segments on top of mixed fruit being careful not to break the segments. Pour mandarin orange liquid over all fruit. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Mix the plain salt with enough water to cover cucumbers. Put a weight on cucumbers to keep under water. Stir every day for 15 days. Remove wash and slice. Soak overnight in alum water to cover. Rinse 3 times. Cover with vinegar. Let set overnight. Remove cucumbers and throw away the vinegar. Layer cucumbers sugar and spices in crock. Cover. In a few days enough syrup will be made to cover pickles. Put in jars. Do not have to be sealed.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix everything with 1/2 of the tomato soup. Put in loaf pan. Pour rest of tomato soup on top. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Thaw berries. Mix undrained berries eggs and oil. Sift dry ingredients into strawberry mixture reserving about 1/2 cup flour to sprinkle over nuts. Blend thoroughly. Add flour to nuts coating well. Add to batter. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. If top browns too quickly cover with tent-shaped aluminum foil. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Beat eggs and combine with butter mix. Add bananas beat well. Mix all dry ingredients together and combine to beaten mixture. Add nuts. Grease and flour two loaf pans. Divide mixture between loaf pans and bake at 350 degree for about 45 minutes or until lightly brown and done.

title: Monster Bars
instructions: Mix in order given. Spread on greased cookie sheet pan. Makes 2 (10 1/2 x 15 1/2-inch) pans and 1 (8 x 8-inch) pan or something similar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Crazy Salsa Dip
instructions: Melt Velveeta cheese in saucepan; add salsa. Melt together then add green onion (chopped up). Pour over soft tortillas or chips.

title: Swiss 'N Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except walnuts. Spoon into 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with walnuts. Bake 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Balls
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients. Roll into small uniform balls. Chill. Melt the paraffin and the chocolate chips in double boiler. Dip balls in this kept warm. Chill then refrigerate to keep for serving.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Break angel food cake in small pieces. Layer in pan. Dissolve jello in hot water. Allow to thicken slightly. Add berries to jello pour over cake and chill. Mix instant pudding then whip together with ice cream. Pour this over jello cake. Chill until firm then cover with Cool Whip. Delicious!

title: Cucumber Dill Dip
instructions: In medium bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Stir in mayonnaise cucumbers green onions lemon juice dill and hot pepper sauce. Cover and chill. Serve with fresh vegetables crackers or chips.

title: Chicken-A-La-Can-Can
instructions: Combine soup water and chicken. Add dry rice and 1/2 can French fried onions. Stir to mix. Pour in buttered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle remaining onions on top; bake 15 minutes more.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Combine juice flour and sugar. Put in cheese and pineapple. Put mixture into casserole dish. Mix Ritz crackers and melted butter. Put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish top with more cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Grease loaf pans and line bottoms with waxed paper. Use 2 regular pans (9 5/8 x 5 1/2 x 2 3/4-inch) or 6 mini pans (5 1/2 x 3 x 2 1/4-inch).

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and let stand until you mix and roll out single pie crust. Fill pie crust and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425\u00b0; turn down temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Christmas Holly Wreaths
instructions: Melt marshmallows and oleo over low heat add coloring and cornflakes. Using tablespoon put some mixture on it. Drop onto waxed paper and dip hands into water and shape into wreaths. Decorate with red hots. Makes about 24 wreaths.

title: My Mom'S Roast Beef
instructions: Place meat in an 8 x 12-inch cake pan lined with foil paper (enough to be able to wrap meat after all ingredients have been put in). Place on top of meat the onion green pepper bay leaves garlic and mushrooms. Add tomato soup straight from the can on top of ingredients then add ketchup. Wrap meat up with foil. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Tear up angel food cake and lay in bottom of 9 x 13 pan. In large bowl cream the cream cheese. Add pudding and milk and mix for 1 minute. Stir in drained pineapple. Pour mixture over cake and top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: In a saucepan mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Strain and serve. Yield 8 servings 77 calories.

title: Wonderful Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding as directed on box less 1/3 milk; set aside. Line 9 x 13-inch dish with vanilla wafers side and bottom. Layer bananas fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture. Pour over vanilla wafers and bananas. Crush about 1 c. wafers and sprinkle on top. Chill and serve.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cake can be baked in Bundt pan or made as cupcakes.

title: Frozen Pink Salad
instructions: Thoroughly mix cream cheese mayonnaise and sugar together. Add marshmallows pecans and fruit cocktail. Add desired amount of red food color to the whipped cream. Fold in colored whipped cream. Freeze in thin layer in serving dish. Cut into small squares before serving. Serve frozen or only partially thawed. (This was served on a restaurant buffet on Sundays.)

title: Fireman Hash Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet cook ground beef until crumbly. Drain off fat. Add onions and green pepper. Cook until they are tender. Stir in tomatoes rice chili powder salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients together. Brown hamburger. Drain and mix with taco seasoning mix and 1/2 cup water. Simmer 5 minutes. Let cool then add to salad.

title: Asparagus Salad
instructions: Heat soup to boiling. Remove from heat and add Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Add cream cheese and mix until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: Creamed Spinach
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl. Add cottage cheese grated Cheddar butter spinach flour salt and pepper. Pour into 2-quart buttered casserole. Bake on low uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

title: Elegant Chicken Breast
instructions: Slightly cook bacon. Wrap one piece around each breast. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Mix butter and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over chicken; sprinkle mushrooms and scallions over top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes basting once or twice.

title: Gold Coast Cape Cod
instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice. Put in vodka. Add cranberry juice to top. Squeeze in lime and stir. Serves 1.

title: Frozen Fruit Medley
instructions: Drain apricots and pineapple reserving 1 cup of the combined liquid. Combine the liquid with the apricots pineapple and remaining ingredients. Spoon into cupcake papers put in muffin tins. Freeze until solid then package cups in freezer bags. Remove from the freezer 20 minutes before serving to partially thaw. Makes 30 servings.

title: Slow-Cooked Tamale Casserole
instructions: In a skillet cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink; drain. In a bowl combine the egg milk and cornmeal until smooth. Add corn tomatoes olives chili seasoning seasoned salt and beef. Transfer to a greased slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours and 45 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese; cover and cook 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Yield 6 servings.

title: Low-Fat Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water; let slightly thicken. Add rest of ingredients. Store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil the sweet potatoes until tender about 30 minutes. Remove the skin mash the pulp. Add the fruit juice and margarine and whip mixture until fluffy. Add the nutmeg brown sugar substitute and cinnamon. Spray a baking dish with non-stick spray. Pour mixture into pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Veg-All Chicken Pie
instructions: Combine first six ingredients. Spoon into prepared deep dish pie crust. Place second crust on top. Seal the edges of the crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Salmon Cutlets
instructions: Remove bones and skin from salmon; mash with fork. Add potatoes salt pepper and beaten egg. Mix well. Form into cutlets. Roll in crumbs. Heat oil and fry. Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Baked Rabbit
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Add seasonings to flour. Add rabbit. Heat oil. Add rabbit; brown on both sides. In casserole dish add rabbit mushrooms milk butter and onion. Cover with foil; cook for about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Remove chicken from bone. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. Remove spaghetti from broth. Cook onions pepper and celery until tender. Pour in tomatoes and cheese. Mix all ingredients together. Put in large casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and margarine; add eggs and stir well. Stir in vanilla. Add all dry ingredients and mix well. Shape dough into 2 logs. Refrigerate overnight. Slice and bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: No-Peek Chicken Or Pork Chops
instructions: Mix the soup water and rice and put in a 9 X 13 pan. Put chicken or pork chops on top. Sprinkle with the onion soup mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 hours.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Pat crescent rolls onto pizza pan or cookie sheet to look like pizza crust. Bake as directed on can. Cool.

title: Chicken Drummettes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour over chicken. Soak for 5 to 6 hours or overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Drain marinade and cook at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Toast the English muffins (the longer you toast them the crunchier your pizza \crust\ will be). Add desired amount of pizza sauce to each muffin. Add toppings and cheese (keep in mind that some meats like sausage or beef should be cooked before you put them on your pizza). Bake your mini-pizzas for 5 to 8 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until your cheese melts or heat in the microwave. The time will vary based on the number of pizzas you are heating and the amount of topping on each pizza. Do not heat too long! They should be heated through when cheese is melted.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Layer asparagus peas and potatoes alternately in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Melt the margarine milk and undiluted soup. Mix well and pour over top. Crumble saltines and sprinkle on top. Sprinkle with a little cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Supreme Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Saute onions in a skillet with a small amount of oil. Add onions to the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Pour mixture into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan or large casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake in oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: In a saucepan dissolve the gelatin in boiling water and stir in the orange rind and cranberry sauce. Refrigerate the mixture until it is thickened. Remove from the refrigerator and stir in the pineapple celery and pecans. Pour the mixture into a lightly oiled 1 1/2-quart mold. Refrigerate the salad until it is firm. Unmold the salad on the lettuce leaves. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Beatrice Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Boil the peppers in water until soft. Melt margarine in a large saucepan. Add onion bell pepper celery garlic and parsley. Simmer until tender. Add ground meat to mixture. Cook ground meat until brown. Add shrimp and crab meat. Cook for 15 minutes. Add bread crumbs. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stuff cooled peppers. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 4. Contains 375 calories.

title: Mexican Beef Skillet
instructions: Prepare macaroni as on package; drain. In large skillet combine green pepper garlic and beef; cook until beef is brown and vegetables tender. Drain. Stir in tomatoes sauce corn olives and salt. Add macaroni; mix well. Stir in cheese. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sesame Curry Sauce(Use To Brush Over Chicken, Meat Or Fish When Grilling.)
instructions: Combine in a screw-top jar. Shake well. Brush over grilled items.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add chicken onion and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn broth and salsa. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover. Let stand 2 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cocoa Cola Cake
instructions: Mix in large mixing bowl the sugar flour and baking soda. Mix the butter Coca Cola and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil. Add the hot mixture to the dry ingredients and stir. Add the buttermilk eggs and marshmallows to the mixture. Mix all well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan and bake for 30 - 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Poor Man Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Season to taste - onions optional to brown with hamburger. Drain meat. Place back in skillet. Layer up with corn (either whole or cream) and green beans (drained). Top with mashed potatoes. Garnish with cheese on top. Bake approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Dog Bone Treats
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl until well blended. Roll the dough out on a floured board. Cut out treats with a dog bone shaped cookie cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until dry.

title: Shanghai Chow Mein
instructions: Saute chicken chunks in oil until firm. Stir in celery and cook 2 minutes. (Should be crispy.) Add vegetables soup and soy sauce. Stir in onions. Heat through and serve over rice. Top with noodles.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Dissolve Karo and sugar. Heat thoroughly until blended. Beat eggs; add butter pecans and vanilla. Mix together with Karo and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in medium hot oven.

title: Chicken Rollatini
instructions: Rinse and pat dry cutlets. Dip each cutlet in bread crumbs shaking off excess. Put breaded cutlets on flat surface and place slice of Mozzarella cheese and slice of ham on each cutlet. Roll up cutlets and fasten each one with a toothpick.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Saute onions and celery in margarine until soft. Add everything including fat which adds much of the flavor except the crawfish tails and simmer for 10 minutes sprinkling the flour over the contents of the pan. This is to give the sauce a little body and you can add more if you like. Now add the crawfish tails and water (2 cups or more depending on the fact you may need to serve 2 or more additional persons); simmer for 15 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Holiday Cauliflower
instructions: Bread cauliflower into medium sized flowerets; cook in boiling water until tender about 10 minutes. Drain well; set aside. In saucepan saute mushrooms in butter. Blend in flour gradually. Stir in milk. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until thick. Stir in salt cheese and pimento. Place 1/2 of cauliflower in buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover with 1/2 the sauce. Add remaining cauliflower and top with remaining sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Miracle Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender; mix then pour into two 8-inch pie pans (greased and floured). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. A crust will form on bottom pie filling in center and coconut on top.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl and serve. Yields 25 to 30 cups.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain them. Mix in all ingredients except stuffing and margarine. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with stuffing and dot with margarine. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Goodie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with remaining ingredients mixed together. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pie Crust For Double Crust
instructions: Mix flour and salt together in a bowl. Add the shortening and mix it into the flour and salt with a fork or your fingertips until the mixture has the texture of coarse crumbs. Mix in the water a little at a time. Refrigerate to chill before rolling out the dough.

title: Corn Potato Bake
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes for cooking. Cook until almost done. Transfer to casserole; add corn and salt and pepper to taste. Cover top with grated cheese. Bake until brown in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Icing Or Fudge
instructions: Cook first four ingredients over low heat until margarine melts. Bring to a hard boil. Boil for 1 minute. Take off burner and add 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Beat until almost thick. Add nuts (if desired) for fudge.

title: Spicy Molasses Cookies
instructions: Combine flour soda and spices. Beat butter sugars egg and molasses. Then add dry ingredients. Use a cookie press on cold ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hot Creole Seafood Dip
instructions: In a small skillet melt butter over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and green onions and saute 3 minutes. Set aside.

title: Salmon Corn Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan combine potatoes onion celery broth garlic and marjoram. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer covered about 10 minutes. Stir in milk and oleo. Combine flour and corn; stir into soup. Heat but do not boil until slightly thickened. Gently stir in salmon and heat through. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mucho Nacho Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and cool. Chop lettuce tomatoes and onion. Mix then add shredded Cheddar cheese and creamy Ranch dressing. Sprinkle more cheese on top. Serve with nacho chips. May be crushed and added to each individual salad or served on the side. Use salsa to suit your taste. This makes a very large main salad.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 and then at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Boil noodles and brown hamburger. Blend Ricotta cheese with seasonings and egg. In greased 9-inch square pan alternate layers of noodles sauce Ricotta cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese ending with sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender 10 to 15 minutes; drain. Put in bottom of baking dish. Mix the next 7 ingredients. Place on top of broccoli. Melt butter and mix with bread crumbs; put on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tea Cakes(Old Recipe)
instructions: Beat sugar Crisco and egg together. Add soda and baking powder to buttermilk and stir until it foams. Add to other mixture. Add vanilla and flour. Roll out and cut cookies. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Sausage Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and ground meat. Drain and add melted cheese mixture. Heat in crock-pot.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients and mold into a ball; let set overnight. Can roll in chopped pecans.

title: Seafood Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions; drain. Arrange 4 noodles in bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cook onion in butter until tender; blend in cream cheese. Stir in cottage cheese egg basil 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper; spread half atop noodles. Combine soup milk and wine. Stir in shrimp and crab; spread half over cottage cheese layer. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Top with shredded sharp cheese. Bake 2 to 3 minutes more. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Makes 12 servings. (Garnish with tomato parsley and extra shrimp.)

title: Lo-Cal Strawberry Pie
instructions: Spray pie pan with Pam. Make graham cracker crumbs and mix with margarine cinnamon and 2 Equal. Press into pie pan. Bake 5 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix water and cornstarch. Bring to boil (dont boil) and set aside. Into hot mixture add Jell-O. When mixture cools add 6 packages Equal. Put aside and cool 30 minutes. Add strawberries and pour into baked and cooled crust. Chill. Makes 4 servings. Each serving equals 1 fruit 1 bread 3/4 fat and 38 additional calories.

title: Suzy'S Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix milk until well blended with lime juice. Mix in Cool Whip (may add a few drops of green food color) and pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator until set.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan. In a large bowl mix flour sugar brown sugar baking soda cinnamon and salt. In a small bowl beat eggs slightly; stir in orange juice salad oil and vanilla. Stir egg mixture carrots raisins nuts and apples into flour mixture just until flour is moistened. Pour batter into pan. Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove cake from pan and cool completely.

title: Green Pepper And Mushroom Chili
instructions: In a large saucepan brown hamburger with onion green pepper and garlic; drain. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes 8 servings.

title: Dip For Fresh Vegetables
instructions: Mix sour cream or yogurt with salad dressing. Serve with veggies.

title: Fresh Green Beans And Vinaigrette
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in covered container and shake well.

title: Wyoming Whopper Cookies
instructions: Melt butter over low heat. Blend in sugar eggs and peanut butter; mix until smooth. Add oats soda raisins and chocolate chips (mixture will be sticky). Drop on greased baking sheet with large spoon. Flatten slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes for large cookies. Remove to cooling rack. Yields 2 dozen cookies.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Bake for about 30 to 45 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix fruit in flour to coat. Add salt coconut and pecans. Add Eagle Brand; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool completely. Store in airtight container about 5 days before serving. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Melt shortening. Blend in flour and brown stirring constantly. Add water gradually and cook until thick stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients except rice. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Serve over rice. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Green Enchiladas
instructions: Mix shredded chicken and 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce in saucepan. Fry tortillas in vegetable oil until medium fry. Dip tortilla in green enchilada sauce. Scoop chicken; sprinkle cheese inside and roll tortilla. Repeat steps for each tortilla. Put enchiladas in tray and spread leftover enchilada sauce on top. Sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Cocoa Cream Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa cornstarch sugar and salt. Slightly beat egg yolks. Add to mixture and milk. Cook until thick; stir constantly. Add flavoring. Pour into pie shell. Cover with meringue.

title: Honey Bars(Uncooked)
instructions: Grind raisins and nuts. Mix with honey and press into sheet 1/2-inch thick. Cover and place weight on top for 24 hours. Cut into bars. Roll in white or colored coconut.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Place shrimp in a single layer in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Set aside. Combine next 8 ingredients. Pour over shrimp. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until shrimp is done.

title: Flag Salad
instructions: Dissolve red raspberry Jell-O in 3 1/2 cups water. Chill until firm. Use 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Make mashed potatoes with potatoes and part of milk. Save remaining milk for cheese sauce. Cook noodles 10 minutes; rinse with warm water and set aside. Cook margarine milk onion and cheese until melted. In 9 x 13-inch greased pan add 1/2 of noodles. Spread in pan. Add not quite 1/2 of cheese sauce. Spread evenly. Add mashed potatoes on top of noodles and cheese. Add remaining noodles and cheese sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown or 30 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Place in a well-greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with flour and pour milk to cover. Stir potatoes with a fork so that all are well coated with flour and milk. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with the grated cheese and dot with butter. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Dream Salad
instructions: Sprinkle Jell-O over Cool Whip; mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients; chill.

title: Mayonnaise
instructions: Mix egg mustard salt sugar cayenne tarragon and dill in blender. Add slowly the oil. Blend again until thick.

title: Pumpkin Nut Roll
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar 5 minutes. Mix together pumpkin and lemon juice and add to first mixture. Sift together flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt and add. Spread evenly in a jelly roll pan which has been greased and floured. Line the pan with wax paper. Sprinkle walnuts over the batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle a dish towel with powdered sugar.

title: Italian Lemon Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except chicken. Lay chicken in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. (Use 2 pans if necessary.) Pour ingredient mixture over chicken. Add water enough water to cover chicken. Bake in oven for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn oven down to 350\u00b0 and bake for another 45 minutes.

title: Chicken And Scampi
instructions: Boil chicken quickly. Separate into serving pieces or strips. Cover with spaghetti sauce mix (I use Giants brand). Add vegetables. Simmer on stove or in oven. Just before time to serve add prepared shrimp (the amount and size you can afford that week)! Cook 3 or 4 minutes. Serve on rice.

title: Caramel Candy
instructions: Heat mixture in an iron pot until it starts to boil and lower flame to simmer. Heat sugar in iron pot until sugar melts. Cook the mixture in an aluminum pot until soft ball stage. Beat well. Add the nuts and pour into buttered platter.

title: Cajun Jambalaya
instructions: Brown sausage in large deep pot. Remove and add chicken. Cook chicken until done. Remove. Throw in vegetables and ham and cook until tender. Add spices. Add sausage and debone chicken. Stir thoroughly. Add water to cover. Bring to boil; turn down and cover. Cook about 20 minutes until rice is done. Stir occasionally to avoid sticking. Serve with salad and garlic bread. A Louisiana favorite!

title: Camel Droppings
instructions: Mix together butter cherries nuts coconut and powdered sugar. Form balls; chill. Melt paraffin and chocolate chips. Dip balls and chill.

title: Easy Egg Custard
instructions: Mix well with whisk. Pour in custard cups. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Cheese Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook carrots and onion in boiling water until tender. Stir in soup milk cheese and Worcestershire sauce. Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Garnish with parsley. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lipton'S Party Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cut each biscuit into 4 sections. In saucepan melt butter. Over very low heat stir in Lipton Onion Soup Mix and biscuits; gently toss just until light golden. On a cookie sheet lined with brown paper place biscuits; bake 5 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 40 puffs. Variation Roll baked puffs in Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Fluffy Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes in a 12-inch Dutch oven for 1 hour with 12 coals on top and 10 coals on bottom. Cut baked potatoes in half lengthwise. Scoop\tout potato and mash with milk sour cream margarine\tchives salt and pepper. Mound back into shells. Add grated cheese on top. Sprinkle with paprika. Place in Dutch oven. Bake 25 minutes with 14 coals on top and 12 coals on bottom.

title: Coco-Lopez Coconut Cake
instructions: Cook cake by directions on package; use 13 x 9-inch pan. While still warm punch holes in cake and pour a can of Eagle Brand milk over cake then cool and pour 1 cup Coco Lopez over cake. Spread on a large container of Cool Whip. Sprinkle coconut on top. Refrigerate.

title: Cold Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix vinegar salt celery seed and sugar until dissolved. Pour over rest and put in covered dish. Place in refrigerator. Wait 24 hours before eating. Good for a summer cook out.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Cake
instructions: Blend well. Place in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Garlic And Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Melt butter and mix into all ingredients. Stir and drop onto baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 until browned on top. If desired brush on butter and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Fruit Dump Cake
instructions: Mix fruit tapioca and sugar; set aside. Combine the two cake mixes. Add oil eggs and water and mix well by hand. Add fruit mixture and blend well. (Mixture will be thick and sticky.) Spoon into greased and floured pans (4 round or 2 rectangular) and spread evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Beat the eggs. Melt the Velveeta cheese and margarine together. Add to eggs and scramble. Brown and drain sausage. Saute onion and green pepper together slightly. Into a 9 x 13-inch pan layer half of egg mixture half of sausage half of onion-green pepper mixture and 1 cup shredded cheese. (Do this procedure again ending with shredded cheese.) Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes covered. Remove cover and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes until set-up.

title: Butter Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Combine crackers and butter sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes.

title: Bran 'N Beef Stroganoff
instructions: In large bowl beat egg until foamy. Stir in milk Bran Flakes salt pepper and paprika. Let stand 1 to 2 minutes. Add ground beef mixing until combined. Form into 20 (1 1/2-inch) meatballs. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven about 15 minutes; drain.

title: Orange Slush(Similar To Orange Julius)
instructions: Blend the first 5 ingredients in blender. Add ice cubes 2 at a time. Beverage should be slushy. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tomato French Dressing
instructions: Mix in electric blender. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening; mix with oatmeal. Combine egg with sugar and add oatmeal mixture. Stir soda into milk. Add flour to first mixture alternately with milk. Add flavoring and cinnamon. Stir in floured nuts or raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until lightly browned about 15 minutes.

title: Nut Cake
instructions: Blend eggs butter margarine sugar and vanilla flavoring. Add flour. Blend in applesauce. Roll nuts in flour. Blend in nuts and coconut. Cook at 250\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease loaf pan. Blend egg into salmon. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into pan. Pat into shape. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is golden brown. Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Shape in loaf and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare four 9-inch round cake pans. Mix all ingredients. Pour equally into the 4 cake pans. Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes or until tests done. While layers bake prepare the filling. Cool layers after baking. Stack layers spreading filling between and on top.

title: Rudolph Sandwiches
instructions: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich. Cut it diagonally. Place 2 raisins on the wide side of the bread for eyes a cherry on the tip of the triangle for the nose and pretzels for the antlers. (Use peanut butter to \glue\ the trimmings.)

title: Creamy Corn Chowder
instructions: In medium saucepot saute bacon until lightly brown. Remove bacon and drain. Saute onion and red pepper. Cook 3 to 5 minutes stirring often. Stir in flour. Gradually stir in milk corn Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Bring just to boiling point over low heat; simmer one minute stirring constantly. Sprinkle chowder with sauteed bacon pieces.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Peel your eggplant and slice about 1/4 inch thick. Lightly flour and fry in oil (not a lot). Drain on paper towels and set aside.

title: Okra Fritters
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. Drop by tablespoon into hot oil. Turn once. Drain and serve at once.

title: Sloppy Joe
instructions: Brown meat celery and onion; drain fat. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended.

title: Texas Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add salt pepper herb sauce and sugar. Mix sour cream and cream cheese together. Place noodles first in casserole dish the meat mixture then cream cheese mixture. Keep layering top with American cheese slices. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. This dish will make 2 medium-sized casseroles.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Mix taco seasoning creamed corn and beans with juice into hamburger. Crumble chips in bottom of long casserole dish (any amount you like). Pour meat mixture over chips and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle shredded cheese over top and heat until cheese melts. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Combine all ingredients and roll 1/2 inch thick. Cut with 2 inch cutter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
instructions: Cook onion in oil until soft and golden. Stir all ingredients together. Pack tightly into a casserole greased. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Uncover the last 15 minutes. Allow to stand for 15 minutes before serving. For a moister loaf use less crumbs. You can also use more nuts. Walnuts work well.

title: Margie'S Brown Rounds
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and egg. Add remaining ingredients. Drop and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken legs and thighs in a shallow roasting pan or glass baking dish. Do not grease pan or baking dish beforehand. Sprinkle salt pepper and paprika over the chicken in liberal doses. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours until skin is crisp. Do not turn chicken while cooking. Serve on bed of watercress or as is.

title: Vidalia Onion Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until slightly golden brown. Serve warm with Fritos chips of choice or crackers.

title: Basic Meat Loaf Microwave Special(Cooking Time 15 To 17 Minutes)
instructions: Mix ground chuck thoroughly with onion crumbs egg catsup milk and seasonings. Mold into a rounded flat loaf in 9-inch pie plate. Spread catsup evenly over top of loaf. Cover with waxed paper. Place loaf in microwave oven. Cook 15 to 17 minutes giving dish 1/4 turn every 4 minutes. Let loaf stand at least 5 minutes before slicing. Yields 6 servings.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Add beans and brown sugar to onion cooked in bacon fat. Mix all and place slices of bacon on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour (approximately).

title: Orange Or Lemon Sugar
instructions: Put 1/2 cup of sugar and the peel into blender and process on high until peel is very finely grated. Empty into a bowl add remaining sugar and mix well with a spoon. Sprinkle on hot buttered toast pancakes or coffee cake or use to flavor puddings and cookies. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. In separate bowl mix other 3 ingredients. Put 1/2 of second mixture in with first mixture. Keep 1/2 for icing. Bake cake per instructions on box.

title: Butterballs
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla. Blend in flour and nuts until like pie crust crumbly. Chill 1 hour. Roll in balls. Bake 15 minutes or until light brown at 325\u00b0. Roll in powdered sugar when cool.

title: Microwave Pralines
instructions: Beat until creamy. Wrap in wax paper. Store in airtight container.

title: Rocky Road Candy
instructions: In medium saucepan slowly melt chocolate over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Beat until smooth. Stir in marshmallows and nuts. Spread on buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill and cut in squares.

title: Peach Cobbler No. 1
instructions: Mix sugar flour milk baking powder and salt together. Melt stick of margarine in a pan. Pour sugar and flour mixture in pan. Add peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 until mixture forms a cake and browns approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Garlic Cheese Bread
instructions: Shake Molly McButter on bread. Add both cheeses and garlic powder. Broil until brown.

title: Blueberry Griddle Cakes
instructions: Beat egg well. Add salt and milk. Stir baking powder with flour and stir in other mixture. Beat until smooth. Add blueberries. Drop from spoon and brown both sides. Serves 4.

title: Mom'S Hot Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Add eggs and dry ingredients alternately with milk. Stir in vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 until straw comes clean. Serve with a hot caramel sauce.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Cut up vegetables coarsely and put in large container. Put in pickling salt. Add 2 trays of ice cubes mix through. Cover with cloth and let stand overnight in a very large canner (15 1/2-quart or larger). In morning make syrup of vinegar sugar turmeric and mustard. Cook down until mixed throughly. Mix flour in some syrup and then add to the syrup in pot (canner). Cook until clear by boiling. Turn heat down. Fill a colander with vegetables and then add to syrup. Do this until all vegetables are in canner. Cook until it comes to a boil. Boil slowly for 5 minutes no longer. Fill clean sterilized jars and seal. Yields 16 to 20 pints.

title: Bread Sticks
instructions: In mixing bowl combine flour and butter stirring butter into flour and then add milk to desired consistency. Batter should not be thin but have a texture that will hold its shape when out on flour surface (wax paper).

title: Mrs. Field'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream the ingredients. Recipe can be divided in sections for making different kinds. Can add chocolate chips grated chocolate raisins nuts etc. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Quick Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium size bowl mix cake mix water and peanut butter until blended. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Put the sugar in a bowl and roll the dough balls in it until covered. Place dough balls on a cookie sheet about 1-inch apart. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until cookie separates. Then place chocolate candy on center and press down until cookie separates around edges. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Chill for 2 hours. Roll out cut and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Cool.

title: Albondigas(Meatball Soup)
instructions: Put 1/2 of first 8 ingredients in a large bowl and other 1/2 of same ingredients in a large soup pot. To pot add approximately 4 quarts of water and 1 heaping tablespoonful of flour. Boil.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Melt butter and cream cheese in top of double boiler. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve in a chafing dish. Serve with dip size Fritos or Wheat Thins.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Pour rice into buttered casserole dish; sprinkle with soup mix. Add water. Place chicken pieces on top. Pour soup over chicken. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: A B C Sandwich
instructions: In a bowl combine cheese apple salad dressing and walnuts. Spread on 6 slices of bread and place 2 slices of bacon on each. Cover with egg slices. Top with tomatoes if desired and remaining slices of bread.

title: Strawberry-Lemonade Punch
instructions: In punch bowl combine lemonade juice strawberries and 3 cups cold water. Refrigerate.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim fat from round steak on all edges; cut meat in lengthwise strips; coat meat in flour salt and pepper mixture. Brown meat in oil. Add soup mix and 4 cups of water. Simmer for at least 1 hour; until meat is tender. Add extra water as needed. Add bell peppers cut into strips cook until peppers turn color about 15 to 20 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch and water. Serve over rice.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Add onions and mushrooms to ground beef. Then brown and drain. Add remaining ingredients. Stir and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve over noodles or split hamburger buns.

title: Clo'S Pound Cake
instructions: In a large bowl cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time alternately with flour until all are well mixed. Add salt. Pour into tube pan. Begin baking in cold oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Cleveland Chili
instructions: Saute onion garlic green pepper celery salt and pepper in butter. When cooked remove from pan into bowl. Brown meat. Drain fat. Add bowl of sauteed items to browned meat. Add tomatoes chili beans and spices. Simmer on low for 1 hour. Serve over mashed potatoes (optional).

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Crumble both breads into a large pan; pour 2 to 3 cups broth over breads. Cook celery and onion in remaining broth until tender (oleo can be used instead). Add this to bread then sage and seasonings. Lastly add eggs and sugar; gradually add soup and broth until desired consistency. Punch deboned chicken into dressing. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Check after 30 minutes. Remove cover to brown.

title: Self-Crust Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Put ingredients into blender and blend about 20 seconds. Pour into 10-inch pie pan. Bake until golden brown in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean. Crust forms at the bottom custard in the middle and the coconut on top.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients together. Bet eggs sugar oil and vanilla until creamy. Add zucchini and stir in dry ingredients just until moist. Bake in two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can omit nuts. Freezes well.

title: Peachy Angel Food Dessert
instructions: Tear cake into bite size pieces; set aside. Prepare whipped topping according to package directions; set aside. In a large mixing bowl beat the cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Fold in whipped topping. Add cake pieces; stir gently to coat evenly. Spoon into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Top with pie filling. Chill until ready to serve. Yields 12 servings.

title: Lydia'S Corn Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan combine potatoes water bouillon red pepper and black pepper. Bring to boil reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until potatoes are just tender stirring occasionally. Stir in 2 1/2 cups of the milk and corn.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix well. A delicious spread for crackers and party snacks.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Brown ground chuck with onion and green pepper in large saucepan stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Simmer for 2 hours or to desired consistency. Chill overnight and reheat to improve flavor. Serve with corn bread. Yield 10 servings.

title: Strawberry Mousse
instructions: Place cold water and gelatin in blender and let stand five minutes. Add hot water. Cover and blend on medium speed about one minute or until white and foamy. Add brown sugar and lemon juice to gelatin mixture and blend until throughly combined. Add cream and eggs. Gradually add strawberries. Place in refrigerator until slightly thickened (15 minutes). Pour into serving dishes and garnish with dollop of whipped cream and whole fresh strawberries.

title: Coconut Bread
instructions: Cut bread into oblong shape 2 x 1-inch. Use a teaspoon and put the condensed milk on each side of the bread. Mix the coloring and banana flavoring with the coconut. Spread the coconut over the slices of bread. Place slices on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Christmas Cutout Cookies
instructions: Cream butter well; add white and brown sugar slowly and cream well. Beat eggs cold water and vanilla. Mix and sift dry ingredients and add alternately with liquid ingredients to cream mixture. Chill at least 1/2 hour. (Can be wrapped in wax paper and left overnight.) Roll to desired thickness (about 1/8 or 1/4-inch) and bake for 12 to 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Frost with colored frosting or brush with slightly beaten egg white and sprinkle with colored sugars.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Prepare sausage and peppers. Combine all the ingredients and mix together. Pour into oblong shallow pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until firm. Serves 8.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: In a bowl cream the sugars and shortening. Add eggs beating one in at a time. In second small bowl add vanilla to the water and add to sugar mixture alternately with sifted dry ingredients. Stir in apples and nuts. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured cake pan. Mix up caramel topping and spread on batter before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pretty Patio Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Pretzel Pieces
instructions: Break pretzels into bite size pieces. Then place pretzels in a large mixing bowl minus any crumbs which will soak up the dressing. Mix ingredients in a separate bowl and pour over the pretzels. Mix pretzels and ingredients well. After mixing put pretzels in a pan approximately 11 x 9 1/2-inch. Put in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Then take out. Pour back into mixing bowl and mix well again. Then place pretzels back in oven 5 more minutes. Remove and drain on paper towel.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Place pudding mix in large bowl. Add about 4 tablespoons of the pineapple juice to make a soft paste. Mix well. Add drained pineapple whipped topping marshmallows and chopped nuts. Mix well until mixture is fluffy and increases in volume. Refrigerate until chilled.

title: Pam'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in milk; add meat eggs onion and seasonings. Mix well. Form in individual loaves; place in greased muffin pans. Cover with Piquant Sauce. Bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings. Or form one loaf in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan. Spread with sauce; bake 1 hour.

title: Chili
instructions: *Or whatever you want to use as long as it is 18 ounces of \something.\

title: 24-Karat Cake Or Cupcakes
instructions: To make icing beat butter or margarine with cream cheese in bowl of an electric mixer until very light and fluffy. Beat in powdered sugar followed by vanilla pecans and optional coconut. To frost the cake spread a generous amount of filling between and over the top of the layers leaving the sides of the cake unfrosted. Or use the icing to generously frost the top of the cupcakes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix soup milk sour cream and shredded cheese together and stir into the frozen potatoes. Bake in glass dish or 1 1/2-quart greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Coney Island Sauce
instructions: Mix all together and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Apple Crisps
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place apples into buttered pan. Mix remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over apples. Bake until brown.

title: Sausage And Potato Stew
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan heat potatoes salt and enough water to cover to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender. Drain. While potatoes are boiling in a 12-inch skillet heat butter. Cook onions until tender. Add sausage tomatoes with liquid paprika caraway seed and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in potatoes and serve.

title: Pistachio Pudding Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients and press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Sweet And Easy Corn Pudding
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Conventional oven bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. In microwave oven microwave on High 4 minutes stir; 4 minutes more stir; 4 minutes more. Should be like pudding.

title: Barbecued Shish Kabobs
instructions: Cut the first 5 ingredients into strips or chunks. After cutting veggies and meat saute chopped onion and garlic in oil. Stir in remaining ingredients; cook until slightly thickened. Thread meat and veggies on skewers. Brush with sauce. Place skewers on grill. Cook for approximately 10 minutes or until done. Baste with remaining sauce while cooking.

title: Fruitcake
instructions: (You can substitute other candied fruit.)

title: Hawaiian Baked Chicken
instructions: Skin and wash chicken breasts. Pat dry. Place in a shallow pan. Mix pineapple juice soy sauce oil and ginger. Cover chicken with marinade and cover. Refrigerate for 8 hours; turn pieces over once. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour off marinade reserving liquid. Bake chicken for 20 minutes; baste every 10 minutes. Turn chicken pieces over and bake for another 30 minutes. Continue to baste every 10 minutes until chicken is done. Serves 4.

title: Nancy Luthy'S Festive Chowder
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Stir in celery and chopped onion; cook until tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper if desired. Gradually add milk stirring constantly. Add potatoes. Bring to boil; simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add bacon and Crab Delights. Heat 3 to 5 minutes more. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cafeteria Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter oatmeal and vanilla. Stir. Drop on wax paper. Refrigerate 1/2 hour.

title: Garlic Bubble Bread
instructions: Thaw and soften bread dough. Blend together melted butter egg garlic powder parsley and salt. Cut off pieces of dough about size of small walnuts. Dip into butter mixture. Place pieces of dough into greased loaf pan until all dough is used. Cover. Let rise until double in size. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Brush with melted butter or margarine. Cool on wire rack. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Old Fashioned Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add jam. Beat eggs and add milk. Sift flour in. Add other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Coconut Island Cookies
instructions: In large mixer bowl combine chocolate coffee butter brown sugar egg sour cream flour soda salt and 1/3 cup coconut. Mix on lowest speed until a dough forms. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets 12 to 15 minutes. Frost warm. Sprinkle with remaining coconut.

title: Gay'S Pineapple Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water to make a light syrup. Mix syrup with next three ingredients and pour into small containers to freeze solid. Approximately 1 hour before serving remove containers from freezer and place in punch bowl. Pour ginger ale over frozen ingredients. As mixture thaws rake a fork over ice mixture to make slushy.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: In a Dutch oven bring water to a boil. After rinsing off sprouts simmer for ten minutes. Bias cut celery and onions into semi-large pieces. Add to sprouts and simmer another five minutes. While you are cooking the vegetables cut meat into whatever size pieces you desire.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Stir all ingredients into well-beaten eggs. Pour into greased oven dish. Place dish in pan with some water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until custard is set. Serve hot.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Do not prebake pastry.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well and put into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Pour water over oatmeal; let stand 10 minutes. Add sugar and margarine; stir well. Add eggs. Sift and add dry ingredients. Add 6 ounces chocolate chips. Put in greased cake pan. Sprinkle on top 3/4 cup nuts and 6 ounces chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Put stuffing mix in a greased flat 3-quart casserole. Top with cheese then sausage. Beat eggs milk soup and mustard together then add mushrooms and pour over other ingredients in casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Instant Love
instructions: Take friendship and love and mix them with tenderness. Blend thoroughly with loyalty. Add hope and faith. Sprinkle with forgiveness. Serve daily with abundant laughter.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Best if mixed the day before. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown meat in a small amount of oil. Add chopped onions water and salt. Cover and simmer until tender about 20 minutes. Add green peppers and cook 5 minutes. Blend cornstarch with a little water and add to meat mixture. Cook stirring until thick. Just before serving add tomatoes and soy sauce; heat. Serve over rice.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients; pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Beef And Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in salted water about 5 minutes. Drain well. Cook green pepper and meat until meat is no longer pink. Stir in rice. Blend eggs soup sour cream and seasonings; stirring into meat mixture. Fold in squash mixture. Turn into a greased 11 1/2 X 7 1/2 X 1 1/2 baking dish. Top with cheese. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet-Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef cracker crumbs minced onion egg milk and ginger. Shape into meatballs; brown them on baking sheet in a 350\u00b0 oven. Mix cornstarch and sugar. Stir in pineapple syrup vinegar and soy sauce until smooth. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Put meatballs in casserole; add syrup mixture pineapple and green pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Hamburg Casserole
instructions: Do not salt anything. Brown hamburger in 2 to 3 tablespoons butter add pepper. Remove meat from frypan put in vegetables and cook until tender. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of water to keep from burning. Cook rice when done add soy sauce and canned soups. Add meat and rice mixture to vegetables. Mix ingredients well and put into covered dish and bake 30 to 40 minutes. A half cup water may be added if needed. Can be frozen before baking.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Bring to a boil in 2-quart saucepan in 1 1/4 quarts of water. Add ingredients. After 3 or 4 minutes add rice; cut down heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until rice is cooked. Use bigger pan if needed.

title: Grammy'S Oatmeal Crispies Cookies
instructions: Optional Add raisins or chocolate chips if you drop cookies.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Seal in airtight container. When ready to use put 3 or 4 teaspoons in cup. Fill with boiling water. This mix makes a lovely gift.

title: Wild Rice Rose(Serve With Lamb Or Chicken)
instructions: Soak rice overnight; drain. Wash and drain. Mix with remaining ingredients. Place in buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Beer-Battered Bass
instructions: Combine pancake mix flour baking powder and salt in bowl. Add egg and beer; mix until smooth. Dip fish in batter coating well. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain. Yield 6 servings.

title: Apple Jello Salad
instructions: In a saucepan heat applesauce until it bubbles. Stir in Jell-O and cook until dissolved. Remove and cool then stir in pop orange juice and peel. Chill until partially set then stir in apples and nuts. Chill until set firm.

title: Spicy Orange Chicken
instructions: Combine flour salt pepper and garlic powder in a bag. Shake the chicken pieces individually until coated. Brown in the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat pour off fat. In a bowl combine remaining ingredients. Add to skillet and simmer covered 25 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serves 4.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix with a mixer until dough forms and color lightens. Shape into small balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 until just done not brown. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Grease tube pan. Cut each biscuit into fourths. Shake in a bag with sugar and cinnamon. Put a layer of pecans (1 cup) and 1/2 biscuit mixture in pan and repeat this. Pour mixture of brown sugar and margarine over all of this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Fix Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Garlic powder to taste. Make a day ahead.

title: Fruit Roll
instructions: Mix all together then fix into a roll; freeze. Slice when ready to serve.

title: Sausage Omelet
instructions: Heat sausage in heavy 8-inch ovenproof skillet according to package directions. Remove sausage and keep warm. Saute the onion and green pepper in sausage skillet over medium-high until tender. Combine eggs and milk in bowl. Add the onion green pepper and tomato. Melt the butter in the skillet over low heat. Add the egg and vegetable mixture and cook until eggs are almost set. Arrange the sausage on top of eggs. Place under the broiler and broil until center is firm and top is lightly browned. Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix all but Fritos in large bowl. Chill then make Meat Sauce

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Mix together the Ritz crackers chopped nuts and 1/2 cup sugar. Beat the egg whites vanilla and 1/2 cup sugar. Fold cracker mixture into egg whites. Put in heavily greased pie plate. Bake for 30 minutes at 300\u00b0. Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Sprinkle with grated chocolate.

title: Butterscotch Surprise(Candy)
instructions: Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter in the top of a double boiler. Stir in nuts and shoestring potatoes. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Cool for several hours in the refrigerator. Yields 2 or 3 dozen.

title: Steaming Oyster Stew
instructions: Heat milk and cream together until film shimmers over surface. Do not boil. In separate pan precook oysters and drain. Add oysters (slice if you prefer) and butter to hot milk and cream mixture. Heat but do not boil for 5 minutes more. Add seasonings and serve at once. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Mazzetti
instructions: Cook beef onion and garlic. Add soups and water; cook. Add 1 package wide noodles uncooked. When noodles are done place 6 slices of cheese cover and let stand until ready to eat. This is all cooked in one pot.

title: Grandmother Fowler'S Rolls
instructions: Place warm water in a mixing bowl. Stir in yeast until dissolved. Add shortening salt sugar egg and 1/2 of flour. Mix well with electric mixer. Mix in remainder of flour well with a spoon or dough hooks. Turn out into a well greased large mixing bowl. Grease top of dough (I spray it with Pam). Cover and let rise in a warm place until double.

title: Summer Ginger Ale Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add lemonade concentrate and stir to dissolve. Add ginger ale. Chill until thick but not set. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into 2 1/2-quart mold. Chill until firm. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Roast And Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place roast in medium roaster pan and cover with water. Add chopped onion celery salt and pepper. Cover and let cook 30 minutes. Turn oven down to 325\u00b0. Let cook slowly approximately 4 hours. Check roast to be sure it is covered with water. After 4 to 4 1/2 hours add potatoes and carrots. Cook about 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender with 1/2 cup water and enough ice cubes to fill container. Process until liquified.

title: Fruit Whip
instructions: Prepare Jell-O as directed. Cut Jell-O into cubes and mix ingredients together. Cool.

title: Baked Squash From Black-Eyed Pea Restaurant
instructions: Cut off tips of squash and cut in pieces. Boil until tender. Drain and mash. Add eggs bread crumbs and butter. Then add sugar salt onion and pepper. Bake in greased casserole at 350\u00b0 until top is lightly browned about 45 minutes. Makes 10 servings.

title: Shortbread Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and buttermilk. Add oranges (I drain 1 can) Cool Whip (I use 16 ounces) and shortbread cookies. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Boil first three ingredients 3 minutes. Then add peanut butter and oats. Drop on wax paper.

title: Rolled Oats Cake
instructions: Cook oats in water. Add butter. Let cool. Add sugars coconut and eggs. Mix in dry ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes until light brown.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim fat from meat and bones. Cut meat into 4-6 serving pieces. Grease large skillet season meat on both sides with salt brown meat thoroughly. Set meat to the side; add onion; cook and stir until tender. Stir in broth soy sauce and garlic. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes or until meat is tender. Add green peppers. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Rolled Up Nut Cookies
instructions: Dissolve yeast in milk. Mix all ingredients together and roll up to 90 balls. Cover and set it in the refrigerator overnight until next day. The next day roll the balls on powdered sugar but dont roll too thin. Put the filling in the center of the cookie; fold one side of the cookie and then overlap the other side on top. Slightly greased a cookie sheet using two cookie pans. Place 6 or 7 cookies across and 6 rolls down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Use apricot or nut filling.

title: Crock-Pot Dessert
instructions: Spray crockery with nonstick spray. Stir in peaches and pour into crock-pot. Cook on low for four to six hours.

title: Dieter'S Ambrosia
instructions: Sprinkle gelatine over ginger ale. Heat until dissolved. Do not boil. Cool. Mix in other ingredients. Serves 10 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Veal Marsala
instructions: Season veal with salt and pepper then dip in flour vigorously shaking off the excess. In a heavy skillet melt 2 tablespoons margarine with olive oil over moderate heat. When the foam subsides add the veal 3 or 4 at a time and brown for about 3 minutes on each side. When done transfer them to plate. Pour most of the fat out of the skillet leaving only a thin film at the bottom. Add the Marsala and 1/4 cup of broth and boil briskly over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes. Scrape in any brown fragments clinging to pan. Return veal to pan; cover and simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes basting with pan juices until tender. Transfer veal to a heated platter. Add 1/4 cup broth to sauce in pan and boil briskly scraping in brown bits. When sauce has reduced and is syrupy taste it for seasoning and season as necessary. Remove the pan from the heat; stir in 2 tablespoons of softened margarine and pour the sauce over the veal.

title: Chicken Divon
instructions: Cook broccoli and place in 9x13 baking dish. Debone chicken; place on top of broccoli. Mix mayonnaise soup lemon juice and spread on top of chicken. Brown bread crumbs. Sprinkle on top with cheese. Bake 350 degrees 30 minutes.

title: Soy-Flavored Chicken
instructions: Skin chicken breasts (optional for low-fat). Place into a baking dish the breasts. Add 1/3 cup water and place into a preheated oven at 325\u00b0. After 30 minutes add soy sauce. Continue to cook for another 30 minutes then add chopped pepper and sliced mushrooms. Continue to cook an additional 20 to 30 minutes. Turn breasts several times to allow the soy sauce to penetrate the meat. Brown lightly. Serve with wild brown or white rice. A low-fat dish and low-salt.

title: Spicy Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown beef. Add onion green pepper salt brown sugar chili powder bay leaf and rest of the ingredients. Cook covered until rice and vegetables are done. Stir often. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Jodi'S Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli according to box directions. Drain. Place broccoli in a casserole dish. Add the butter and Velveeta cheese. Crush crackers and spread over top. Dot extra butter on top of crackers. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Orange Pecans
instructions: Combine sugar and milk in saucepan. Add vinegar. Boil until it forms a soft ball in cold water. Pour mixture over pecan halves. Add grated rind of 2 oranges and stir until pecans are coated. Spread on foil to dry.

title: Chicken Baked In Soy Sauce
