instructions: Mix the onions soy sauce and water and put into roasting pan. Put fryer in roaster skin side down. Cook 40 minutes and turn; cook 40 minutes. Serve with Uncle Bens seasoned long grain and wild rice. Serves 15.

title: Quick Kolacky
instructions: Cream the margarine. Add cream cheese and beat until fluffy. Add flour. Chill 15 minutes. Roll out and cut into 2-inch rounds. Make depressions in center of rounds. Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Hillbilly Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage. Cut carrot cucumber bell pepper and radishes in rings. Mix sugar vinegar and oil and pour over vegetables. Toss and refrigerate several hours before serving. Salt to taste before serving.

title: Cream Cheese Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients except honey in a large bowl. Beat at low speed of electric mixer. Fill baking cup lined muffin tins 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Drizzle with honey. Yields 18 muffins.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
instructions: Cut bacon into pieces and fry with onion. Drain off fat. Add vinegar sugar beans and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chicken And Vegetables Pot Pie
instructions: Combine chicken mixed vegetables and soups in bowl; mix well. Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread topping evenly over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until brown. Yield 8 servings.

title: Lasagna
instructions: In skillet saute onion. Add meat and cook until done. Mash garlic with salt. Add to meat\twith pepper oregano parsley tomatoes\ttomato\tsauce and 1 tablespoon Parmesan. Simmer covered 30 minutes.

title: Caesar'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a jar and shake well. Store in refrigerator.

title: Easy As 1-2-3 Microwave Brownies
instructions: In a medium bowl beat together butter sugar eggs and vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy 1 to 2 minutes. Beat in cocoa. Add flour and beat until well blended. By hand stir in pecans. Spread evenly in a wax paper-lined 8-inch square glass dish. Cook in a microwave oven on High for 3 minutes. Turn dish a quarter turn and cook 2 1/2 to 3 minutes longer. Let cool. Sift powdered sugar over top. Cut into 16 or 25 squares.

title: Oatmeal-Raisin Muffins
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture is like coarse crumbs. Stir in rolled oats. Combine egg milk and brown sugar; beat well. Stir into dry ingredients; add raisins. Spoon into paper baking cups in muffin pans. Combine granulated sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Combined crushed frosted mini-wheats with flour cinnamon nutmeg and brown sugar. Mix well. Add margarine mixing until crumbly. Set aside for topping. Place apples in ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle topping evenly over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is browned. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple and fruit cocktail. Reserve to use with pudding. Combine juice and pudding in small saucepan; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Mixture should thicken and become clear. Cool to room temperature. In large bowl gently combine the pineapple chunks oranges and fruit cocktail. Pour pudding mixture over fruit and toss to coat fruit. Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. When ready to serve add bananas and gently combine. Serve immediately. Bananas may darken after a while.

title: Pineapple Rice Salad
instructions: Cooked cup of rice is added to all other ingredients. Mix well. Serve.

title: Basil Tortellini Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan bring broth to a boil. Add tortellini; cook until tender about 6 minutes. Stir in the beans tomato and basil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Add the vinegar salt and pepper. Serve with cheese.

title: Patsy'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add baking powder and sugar to egg whites. Add nuts and crackers. Mix together. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Set and let cool then put Cool Whip or whipped cream on top.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Layer 13 x 9-inch baking pan with dried beef. Place chicken breasts on top. Cut bacon in smaller pieces putting a small strip on each breast. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Mix soup and sour cream. Remove pan from oven and cover chicken well with soup mixture. Cover chicken and return to oven for 30 minutes more. (By covering chicken with tinfoil your gravy will not cook away.) Remove and serve with rice or noodles.

title: Molasses Crinkles
instructions: Mix shortening sugar egg and molasses very well. Either stir or sift flour before measuring. Blend all dry ingredients and stir into wet mixture and chill. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll dough into 1 1/4-inch ball. Dip tops in granulated sugar. Place balls sugar side up 3-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Sprinkle each with 2 to 3 drops water. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or just until set but not hard. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Krum-Kaka
instructions: Melt butter and cool. Beat eggs; add sugar and mix. Whip the cream. Add melted butter to eggs and sugar; add whipped cream. Add vanilla and flour. Use 1 scant teaspoon for each one on Krum-KaKa iron. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool completely. Break cake into pieces. Prepare pudding mix as directed on package. In clear glass punch bowl layer 1/2 of cake 1/2 of pudding 1/2 of cherry pie filling 1/2 of pineapple and 1/2 of Cool Whip. Repeat layers ending with Cool Whip. Garnish with maraschino cherries and nuts. Cover; refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into a buttered 2-quart dish. Crush Ritz crackers over top and dot generously with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cover if crackers tend to burn.

title: Heart-Smart Wacky Cake
instructions: In ungreased 8-inch cake pan mix together flour sugar soda and cocoa. Make 3 wells in flour mixture. Put vinegar in one vanilla in one and corn oil in 3rd. Pour water over all and mix with fork until entirely moist. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes until just done. Ice as desired.

title: Rhubarb Nut Loaf
instructions: Stir together in order given. Pour into 2 loaf pans well-greased.

title: Blueberry Banana Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust and let cool. It is not necessary to bake graham cracker crust. Cover bottom of pie shell with banana slices. Whip cream cheese and combine with Cool Whip. Spoon over bananas in pie crust. Top with blueberries. Chill 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Three Layer Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and Crisco until fluffy. Add sugar gradually. Cream for 10 minutes. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk alternately. Add vanilla; beat for 1 minute after last addition. Bake at 325\u00b0 until brown. Cool; frost with White Cake Icing.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain. Grease 8 x 13-inch baking dish. Place crushed Doritos in bottom. Pour ground beef and onion mixture over Doritos. Mix together the sauce and soup. Pour over mixture. Cover top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cheese is melted bubbly.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Cook meat diced onions and garlic. Mix all well in a casserole. Grate cheese over top and bake 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In medium saucepan melt morsels and margarine. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press 1/2 the mixture firmly into bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In large bowl beat cheese until fluffy then beat in sweetened condensed milk vanilla and egg; mix well. Pour into prepared pan. Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool to room temperature. Chill before cutting into bars. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Frosted Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Combine 2 cups baking mix and milk in a bowl. Mix well. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds adding enough remaining baking mix to make moderate dough. Knead 10 times on floured surface. Roll into 1/2-inch thick rectangle. Spread with butter. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over butter. Top with raisins and nuts. Roll as for jelly roll to enclose filling; cut into 1-inch slices. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Blend confectioners sugar with a small amount of water. Drizzle over rolls. Cool for 5 minutes. Yields 1 dozen.

title: Chicken And Pasta Neapolitan
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat heat oil. Add chicken onion and garlic. Cook 5 minutes stirring frequently or until chicken is no longer pink. Stir in tomato sauce wine sugar and seasonings. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Cook covered stirring occasionally for 20 minutes or until thickened.

title: Banana Bread(Low-Fat)
instructions: Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Add water and dressing. Put 1/2 dressing in casserole (8 1/2 x 10 x 1 1/2-inch). Cook and drain beans. Layer on top of dressing. Add a layer of almonds followed with split up chicken breast pieces. Cover with remaining dressing then combine the soup and chicken broth; blend until smooth. Pour soup mixture over entire casserole. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Penne All'Arrabbiata(Milano, Italy)
instructions: Heat the oil and gently fry the chopped onion and garlic until softened. Add the chili pepper and fry gently for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes with their juice sugar salt and pepper to taste and cook on a high flame uncovered for about 20 minutes stirring occasionally. When the sauce is reduced and thick check the season. If you like a smoother sauce you can pass the sauce through the medium disk of a food mill. I usually just chop up the tomatoes with a fork and leave the sauce a bit chunky. Add the chopped parsley just before serving. Cook the pasta following the directions on the packet very carefully to avoid overcooking.

title: Pam'S Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together and roll ribs in this mixture until well coated. Place ribs in greased roaster pan with lid. Blend together tomato soup vinegar and onion. Pour this over ribs. Bake in oven very slowly at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 for 3 or 3 1/2 hours.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Stir together sugar margarine and milk. Bring to a full boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into greased pans; cool at room temperature. Cut into squares.

title: Rolled Cheese Appetizers
instructions: Mix filling together. Spread onto tortillas. Let refrigerate about 1 hour. Slice into pinwheels and serve. Great to make ahead and serve.

title: Diet Natural Food
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 300\u00b0 until lightly browned stirring often.

title: Dried Beef Spread
instructions: Mix and chill for at least an hour before serving with crackers.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Beat eggs. Add the bananas. Sift the flour. Add the salt and sift together again then add alternately with the banana mixture. Add the nuts. Add last the soda with a little warm water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes in an angel food pan.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and enjoy.

title: Mexican Sausage
instructions: Mix ingredients by hand. Let mixture set overnight in refrigerator. Make into patties and cook on slightly greased grill or frying pan.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Cook corn bread to package directions. Cool. Its better if kept for 24 hours then crumbled. Add all vegetables. Cool in refrigerator about 1 hour. Stir in Miracle Whip. Add cheese.

title: Oatmeal Apple Raisin Muffins
instructions: Beat egg; stir in remaining ingredients mixing just to moisten. Pour into 12 greased muffin cups until 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve cool or hot with butter.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Warm tomato soup; add gelatine to soften. Add other ingredients. Allow to set up in refrigerator.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Place Velveeta and 1 cup milk in thick boiler and melt. Add the Kraft package cheese powder. Beat egg and pour into cheese mixture and stir. Place boiled macaroni in Corning dish. Add cheese mixture over this. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook bacon crumble and set aside. In bacon fat cook onion pepper and mushrooms until tender. Stir in flour chicken broth cream and pimento. Simmer until sauce thickens. Add salt pepper bacon chicken or turkey and cooked spaghetti. Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple. Slice bananas and dip in lemon juice. Mix melted butter and graham cracker crumbs and press into 13X9 pan. In mixer mix powdered sugar butter and eggs for 15 minutes. Spread over crumbs. Cover with crushed pineapple. Cover pineapple with banana slices. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries. Chill overnight.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar mustard seed celery seed and turmeric. Place in saucepan and bring to a boil. Mix onions and salt with cucumbers. Put these in jars and pour cooked spices over cucumbers. Follow directions on lids of canning jars to seal.

title: Health Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl sift together the flour salt and baking soda. In a second bowl place all the other ingredients. Add the flour mixture to bowl 2 and beat until well mixed. Batter will be lumpy. Place in tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Do not open oven. When cooled remove from pan and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream sugar oil and baking chocolate; add eggs and mix. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Spray 3 small loaf pans with Pam; pour batter in and fill halfway. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown steak with green pepper and onion and cut into small bite-size pieces. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over egg noodles or rice.

title: Turtle Brownies
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to box instructions. Generously grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour 1/2 of cake batter into the pan. Bake for 10 minutes at temperature recommended on box instructions. While cake is baking melt caramels in saucepan with the can of milk. Remove cake from oven; pour caramel mixture over hot cake. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top of caramel. Pour remaining batter evenly over the top. Bake for 25 minutes or until top layer is done. Let cool completely; cut into squares. Makes between 30 to 36 squares.

title: Macaroni Lunch
instructions: Pan fry sausage into crumbled pieces and drain on paper towels. In a large boiler bring to boil tomatoes tomato sauce water (add more or less water according to your liking) salt and pepper oil and celery seed. Add sausage and macaroni. Stir well turn off place on lid and leave covered 5 minutes. Serve with crackers and salad or coleslaw.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix and put half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle 1/2 brown sugar mixture on batter and swirl in. Pour rest of batter in and use rest of brown sugar mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt butter; set aside to cool. Mix flour and sugar. Add milk and eggs. Stir in vanilla and vinegar. Add butter and nuts. Put in crust and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crispy Baked Onion Rings(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cut each onion into 4 thick slices; separate into rings (reserve small rings for another use). Set aside. Combine cereal and next 3 ingredients; divide in half and set aside. Beat egg substitute at high speed with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Dip half of onion rings in egg substitute; dredge in half of crumb mixture. Place in a single layer on baking sheets coated with cooking spray. Repeat procedure with remaining onion rings egg substitute and crumb mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until crisp. Serve warm.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries in water until they pop open. Pour in sugar marshmallows and cherry jello. Stir until jello and sugar are dissolved. Refrigerate until mixture starts to set. Add the celery apples and pecans. Pour in mold and chill.

title: Cousin Agnes' Bread Pudding
instructions: Put sugar on bottom of double boiler insert. Add bread. Mix eggs milk and vanilla. Pour over bread. Place insert over hot water. Cook until set 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove insert and let cool. When cool place plate over top of pan and invert pudding. Serve warm or cold.

title: Mostaccioli With Bacon And Mushrooms
instructions: In a medium skillet cook bacon until crisp. Remove from fat and set aside. Add mushrooms to bacon fat. Cook until golden; drain and set aside. Prepare mostaccioli according to package directions. Drain. In same saucepan combine half and half butter parsley flakes salt garlic and hot pepper sauce. Heat just until butter melts stirring frequently. Combine bacon mushrooms hot mostaccioli half and half mixture and Parmesan cheese. Toss to coat. Place on warm serving platter. Garnish with green onions. Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 4 servings.

title: Meat Loaf With Tangy Sauce
instructions: Mix all together well and spread into loaf pan. Spread tangy sauce over meat loaf and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Bohemian Pickles
instructions: Put cucumbers in quart jars. Add garlic dill weed and peppers. Mix all other ingredients. Fill jars with liquid. Store in cool dark place for 2 weeks.

title: Candied Kielbasa
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1/2-inch pieces. Cook in microwave for 5 minutes or until fully cooked. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour mixture over cooked kielbasa and mix together. Heat in microwave 5 more minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk blending thoroughly into mixture. Stir in whipped topping. Pour into prepared crust. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts if desired. Freeze until firm and serve. For storage longer than 4 to 6 hours wrap the pie well for freezing to prevent dehydration.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Saute sausage. Drain. Beat eggs with milk salt and mustard. Line 13 x 9-inch baking dish with bread. Top with sausage then cheese. Pour egg mixture over all. Cover tightly. Refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl; cut in shortening with a pastry blender until shortening is the size of peas. Add buttermilk and stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a heavily floured surface and knead lightly 4 or 5 times.

title: Cool Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed for about 25 to 30 minutes in a rectangular pan. Then remove from oven and punch holes all through the cake with a fork. Then pour the condensed milk on the cake covering it completely. Let cool about 10 minutes. Then mix the rest of the ingredients together and spread over the cake and store in refrigerator.

title: Spam Salad
instructions: Cube Spam into 1/2 to 3/4-inch cubes. Put into a pan. Add cooled cubed potatoes. Add salt and pepper as desired. Add chopped onion. Mix well with sour cream. Before serving add croutons (do not refrigerate with croutons they will get mushy). Serve directly on plate or on lettuce leaf as garnish.

title: Microwave Rice
instructions: Use 1 part rice to 2 parts water. Wash rice and drain. Add water and salt. Cover microwave dish or Pyrex dish with paper towel. Place in microwave and cook on High for 18 minutes. Let set for 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Hominy Bake
instructions: Combine soup peppers celery seed Worcestershire sauce and salt. Place over medium heat until mixture is heated thoroughly. Place hominy in greased baking dish; pour soup mixture over hominy; top with crumbs and almonds. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

title: Boursin Cheese
instructions: Cream butter and cheese together. Mix in all spices. Serve at room temperature. Can be frozen.

title: Love Feast Pumpkin Bread(Makes 4 Loaves)
instructions: Combine sugar pumpkin and eggs in large bowl. Blend well. Add oil. Add remaining ingredients. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Grease baking pans well. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Two Cheese Fettuccine Primavera
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil in medium saucepan. Blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually add milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Toss hot pasta with sauce and remaining ingredients. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown meat and onions; add seasonings. Dip each tortilla in warm oil. On each one spoon 2 tablespoons sauce a generous tablespoon of filling and a sprinkling of cheese; roll up and place together in large pan. Pour remaining sauce and cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meatless Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan under medium heat saute onion garlic and crushed red pepper in margarine and olive oil until tender. Add basil oregano and thyme. Pour in stewed tomatoes roughly chopping up the individual tomatoes to desired consistency. Add tomato paste and mix thoroughly. Mix in the honey and turn down heat to low. Simmer stirring frequently for about 20 minutes. Serve with pasta of choice.

title: Salmon Salad
instructions: Combine salmon sour cream artichokes green onion dill Tabasco sauce mustard and lemon juice in a blender. Process until firmly chopped. Add remaining ingredients. Process for 1/2 minute. Cover and refrigerate overnight before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Duffy'S Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube or Bundt pan. Stir together the poppy seed and buttermilk; cover and refrigerate overnight. Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Beat in vanilla and grated orange rind. Stir in flour mixture alternately with poppy seed mixture mixing until just smooth each time. Turn half the batter in prepared pan; sprinkle with sugar cinnamon mixture; add remaining batter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Place cake on wire rack to cool 10 minutes. Remove cake from pan to cool completely. The cake becomes moist when stored in a tightly covered container for several days.

title: Asparagus Supreme
instructions: Blend ingredients together and add asparagus pieces last. Mix and pour into casserole dish.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate. Form into walnut size balls and roll in sugar. Place on cookie sheet and press out with the bottom of a glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Seasons Green Beans
instructions: Cook beans as directed then add all ingredients until done. Cook bacon; crumble on top of beans.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; add salt and pepper. Add vegetables in layers without mixing. Last sprinkle rice on top (do not stir). Simmer until done (about 30 to 40 minutes). Mix before serving. Serves 6.

title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup milk into bowl. Add pudding mix and beat with wire whisk until well blended 1 to 2 minutes (mixture will be thick). Stir in pumpkin and spices using wire whisk; mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Garnish with additional whipped topping and nuts if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Italian Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant and onions in water to cover 20 minutes. Drain and add remaining ingredients. Place in greased casserole and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown. Serves 6.

title: Veal Piccata
instructions: With meat mallet pound cutlets to 1/8-inch thickness. On waxed paper sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper. Add flour and coat cutlets. In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot olive oil and butter cook veal a few pieces at a time until lightly browned on both sides. Add more olive oil if necessary. Reduce heat to low. Into drippings in skillet stir water wine bouillon and 1/2 teaspoon of salt scraping to loosen brown bits. Return veal to skillet; cover and simmer 15 minutes until cutlets are tender. Cut 1 lemon and squeeze out juice. Thinly slice the other. Remove cutlets to platter; keep warm. Stir lemon juice in pan. Heat until boiling over high heat. Spoon over cutlets. Garnish with parsley. Serves 8.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Melt butter in microwave on High; stir in flour until smooth. Microwave 30 to 45 seconds until heated. Blend in milk smoothly. Microwave 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 minutes until thickened stirring every minute. Stir in cheese until melted 15 to 20 seconds. Mix in macaroni well. Microwave 5 to 6 minutes stirring once.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. Mix soup with milk; stir constantly while heating. Dont boil. Add broccoli pepper to taste butter and herb. Heat to bubbly and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients pour into greased casserole dish and bake 35-45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Sweet Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix flour with sugar salt cream of tartar soda and cinnamon. Cream butter until softened. Add flour mixture milk and vanilla. Mix until all flour is moistened; then beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs and chocolate. Beat 1 minute longer.

title: Hot Crabmeat Spread
instructions: Combine crab cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add lemon juice curry powder Worcestershire sauce and onion to taste. Put in 7 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish; top with cheese and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and cream cheese. Blend well. Put in pie crust and bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool and add pie filling. Top with whipped cream. Chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding and milk. Note recipe calls for less milk than package does. Fold in Cool Whip. Line dish with graham crackers. Cover with pudding mix. Finish with crackers on top.

title: Apple Crisp Pudding
instructions: Butter casserole dish add apples and pour water mixed with cinnamon over them. Mix together sugar flour and butter until crumbly. Spread mixture over apples and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add milk and corn. Mix again. Pour into a casserole baking dish about 2 inches deep. Pour melted butter on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Out-Of-This-World Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. In large bowl combine shortening sugar beaten eggs 1 cup warm water and salt. Stir in softened yeast and 2 1/2 cups flour. Beat until smooth and blended. Add remaining flour to make a soft dough and mix well. Cover and allow to rise in a warm place until double in bulk. This takes about 1 hour. Punch down and place in refrigerator overnight. Divide dough in half and roll each portion into a rectangle 1/2-inch thick. Spread with softened butter. Roll each rectangle jelly roll style and cut into 1-inch slices. Place cut side down in greased muffin tins. Cover and let rise 2 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 2 dozen large rolls.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour baking powder soda dry milk salt and sugar. Add pecans; mix well. Combine beaten eggs butter bananas and lemon juice. Add dry ingredients; mix only until flour is moistened. Divide into 6 well-greased loaf pans (3 1/2 x 8 x 2 1/2-inch). Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Cool thoroughly. Wrap in foil; store overnight. Good for freezing.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a large plastic bag mix all ingredients except parsley. Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes in shallow pan. Bake stirring occasionally for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish with parsley. Makes 8 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into pastry. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Meringue(That Doesn'T Weep)
instructions: Combine in a small saucepan dry ingredients and water over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and clear. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form by gradually adding 4 tablespoons sugar beating well. Slowly add cooled cooked cornstarch mixture beating until stiff glossy peaks form. Spread meringue evenly to edge of pie crust to seal all around. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until meringue is golden.

title: Carrots Supreme
instructions: Cook carrots in a small amount of water until just barely tender; drain. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over carrots. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Cucumber Appetizers
instructions: Combine Miracle Whip cream cheese and Good Seasons mix. Spread on slices of cocktail rye bread. Top with a thin slice of cucumber. Sprinkle with dill weed.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Boil hamburger meat potatoes and onion in water until tender. Add Spanish rice tomatoes salt and pepper. Cook for 20 minutes over medium heat.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift together first 4 ingredients. Bring to boil in saucepan margarine shortening cocoa and water. Remove from heat; add dry ingredients then add buttermilk vanilla baking soda and eggs. Beat and pour into greased and floured large cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. During last 5 minutes of baking time make frosting as follows.

title: Ham And Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes and cube cheese. Mix soup and milk until creamy. Layer potatoes cheese ham and onion in a greased 9 x 13 inch pan. Pour half the soup over and repeat the layers. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Banana Brownie Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake pastry shell 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0. In small saucepan over low heat melt chips with butter. In a large mixer bowl beat chocolate mixture with milk biscuit mix eggs and vanilla until smooth. Stir in walnuts. Place bananas on bottom of pastry shell. Pour chocolate mixture over bananas. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until center is set. Cool. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Bring beets to a slow boil; cook until tender and skins peel off easily. At this stage you just boil the beets in water and then discard this water. Boil remaining ingredients together and add beets. Bring back to a boil. Pack and seal in jars.

title: Peaches N' Cheese Cream Pie
instructions: Beat the first 7 ingredients 2 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch pie pan. Drain the peaches and save juice. Lay peaches on top of batter. Beat the cream cheese sugar and peach juice for 2 minutes. Spoon on top of peaches. Leave a 1-inch margin. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Wild Strawberry Preserves
instructions: To a quart of strawberries add sugar and water. Boil slowly for 15 minutes. Let stand overnight. Next morning bring to a boil and pour into jars while hot.

title: Banana Pepper Pie
instructions: Line an 8 x 8-inch pan with sliced banana peppers. (May use other peppers.) In a large bowl combine eggs corn and cheese. Mix well. Pour over peppers in pan. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill overnight.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Beat the first 4 ingredients well and set aside. Sift together the flour cinnamon nutmeg and allspice. Gradually add dry ingredients to egg mixture. Add prunes vanilla and walnuts. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Glaze while hot.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove caps from mushrooms and chop the stems. Cut up bacon and fry with mushroom stems. Add onion pepper and bread crumbs. Stuff mushroom caps with first mixture. Place in buttered shallow baking dish. Salt cover and refrigerate. Before baking sprinkle with the Parmesan and basil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Longhorn Baked Eggs
instructions: Grease 6 custard cups or other microwave-safe dishes; set aside. Place equal amounts of bacon and cheese in each cup. Break 1 egg into each cup. In small bowl mix sour cream milk and hot sauce until well blended. Spoon 3 tablespoons sour cream mixture around each egg. Gently break egg yolks with fork. Place egg cups in microwave and cover with paper towel. Cook 2 to 3 minutes on Medium power until eggs are set as desired. Garnish with chopped green onions or diced tomatoes.

title: Larry'S Hot Sausage
instructions: Cut sausage into bun sized pieces. Cook for 15 minutes; drain. Slice onions and peppers into 1/2-inch strips. Mix whole tomatoes Sweet N Low and tomato sauce with 1 1/2 cans of water. Cook for 15 minutes. Add vegetables and cook another 15 minutes. Add sausage and cook another 15 minutes. Serve with (soft) sausage buns. Makes about 20 sandwiches.

title: Rotini Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper; drain. Prepare rotini noodles according to package directions; drain. Mix all ingredients together except cheese. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and cover with cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.

title: Jello Popsicles
instructions: Mix pour into molds and freeze.

title: Coney Island Sauce
instructions: Saute ground beef onion and garlic. Stir frequently until meat is no longer pink (do not brown). Drain fat off. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly uncovered stirring occasionally for 2 to 3 hours until sauce thickens. Spoon over hot dogs. Top with chopped onions if desired.

title: Trifle
instructions: Mix pudding mix with milk. Let set until thick. Slice cake very thin. In an attractive bowl layer the following

title: No Roll Pie Crust
instructions: Put all these ingredients in a bowl and stir together. Pat dough on sides and bottom of pie pan same as a graham cracker crust. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 7 to 10 minutes (not too brown).

title: Potato And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: In large pan heat butter and saute cabbage and onions until wilted. Place half of the cabbage onions and potatoes in a 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese. Put remaining cabbage potato and onion on top. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in same pan cabbage was cooked in. Add 1/4 cup flour. Cook 1 minute. Add can of broth. Cook until thickened. Pour over top of cabbage. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pork Chops Sweet 'N Sour
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Melt shortening in skillet. Dredge pork chops in flour mixture and brown in hot fat slowly.

title: Sugar Free Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in water until dry. Let cool. Then mix all ingredients well by hand. Bake in lightly greased bundt pan or 9 x 13 x 2 inch pan for 55 - 60 minutes at 350.

title: My Deluxe Meatballs
instructions: Mix first five ingredients well. Make into medium size balls. Place in a casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs. Cover! Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually. Add egg and molasses. Add sifted flour baking soda salt and ginger. Roll into balls in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Heavenly Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients using electric mixer. Use apple wedges orange slices banana chunks pineapple chunks etc. to dip.

title: Sausage Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage; drain. Brown beef; drain. Cook onion and celery in meat fat until tender. Cook rice and drain. Mix all ingredients together except cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour adding cheese to top during last 15 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Jam
instructions: Mix the rhubarb and sugar together and let set overnight. In the morning boil the mixture for 5 minutes then add the Jell-O. Stir well. Put in jars to seal. Very good if you like rhubarb strawberry on your toast.

title: Fat-Free Carrot Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray muffin pan cups with grease. In medium bowl combine flour 1/2 cup sugar cinnamon salt baking powder and ginger. In a large bowl with whisk or fork mix carrots yogurt egg substitute applesauce raisins brown sugar and vanilla until well blended. With spoon stir together the 2 mixtures until moistened. Spoon batter into muffin pans. Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool muffins in pans 10 minutes and remove. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Makes 8 muffins.

title: Pork And Beans
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours in a casserole dish removing cover last 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix and shape into small balls. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Aunt T'S String Pie
instructions: Cook beef onion and green pepper in a large skillet over medium high heat until meat is brown stirring to separate meat. Drain fat. Stir in sauces; mix well. Combine spaghetti Romano cheese eggs and butter in large bow; mix well. Place in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread Ricotta cheese over top. Pour sauce mixture over Ricotta cheese. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over top. Bake in pre-heated oven 350\u00b0 until cheese melts approximately 20 minutes.

title: Beef Jerky
instructions: Combine sugar seasoned salt and pepper; place mixture in a shaker. In a shallow pan arrange layer of meat strips. Sprinkle with seasonings and cover with liquid smoke; repeat layers to use all ingredients. Marinate meat for 8 hours. Place aluminum foil on oven racks. Arrange meat strips on foil in single layer. Set oven temperature at lowest possible setting leave oven door ajar and bake for 4 to 8 hours or until done to taste.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 4 1/2 x 6 1/2-inch loaf pan. Mix flour and sugar. Stir in pecans. Blend eggs potatoes milk and shortening. Add liquid mixture to flour mixture. Stir until blended. Pour into pan. Press pecan halves in top of batter. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Soppin Chocolate
instructions: Mix and cook sugar cocoa flour and milk in saucepan until thick. Add vanilla and butter. Pour over hot biscuits.

title: Susan'S Salad
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple. Mix all ingredients except gelatin. Sprinkle dry gelatin over salad and toss lightly.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Break cake and press it in a sheet pan bottom. Bring juice and Jell-O to a boil then add can of pineapple cottage cheese and Dream Whip. Mix all up in a bowl and pour over cake. Keep in fridge. Really good if you are on a diet.

title: Chinese Fried Rice
instructions: In heavy skillet or wok saute onion in oil until transparent but not browned. Add rice water bouillon cubes salt and pepper. Bring to a vigorous boil. Cover and cook over low heat until all water is absorbed about 25 minutes. Stir in eggs and green onions. Cook until eggs are set. Stir in soy sauce.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Use 3 teaspoons per cup and fill with boiling water.

title: Granny Little'S Pound Cake(In Loving Memory)
instructions: Cream margarine Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour (presifted with baking powder) alternately with flavoring. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix until thick; pour into pie shell.

title: Shipwreck Stew
instructions: In a skillet brown ground beef with onion over medium heat. Drain fat. In a 3-quart casserole combine beef mixture with all remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 2 hours or until rice and potatoes are tender.

title: Veggies With Horseradish Cream
instructions: In large saucepan fitted with steam basket bring 1/2 cup water to boil; place vegetables in basket and cook covered 4 minutes; remove saucepan from heat.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss together all ingredients except almonds and lettuce leaves. Put almonds on top. Serve 6.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Sweeten this mixture to your taste. Mix cherry Jell-O according to box directions but use pineapple juice instead of water. Let jell until syrupy then add the cranberry relish. Let set at least 2 hours. Best when sets overnight.

title: Swiss Mushroom Chicken
instructions: Flatten chicken to 1/4-inch thick. In a shallow bowl lightly beat the egg. Combine cracker crumbs and salt in another shallow bowl. Dip chicken in egg then in crumbs. Set aside. In a large ovenproof skillet saute mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter until tender. Remove and set aside. In same skillet melt remaining butter. Add chicken; cook over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes. Top with ham mushrooms and cheese. Broil until cheese is melted.

title: Chinese Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Blend well. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Pour marinade over vegetables. Refrigerate at least 2 days before serving. Drain marinade from vegetables to serve. Yields 12 to 15 servings.

title: Hungarian Goulash
instructions: Melt shortening in a large skillet. Add beef onion and garlic. Cook and stir until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in catsup mustard Worcestershire sauce sugar salt paprika and 1 1/2 cups water. Cover simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Blend flour and 1/4 cup water; stir gradually into meat mixture. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir one minute. Serve over buttered noodles. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Special Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Store and pack in jars or tin cans.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook first three ingredients in a small amount of salted water and drain. Mix sour cream and soup with vegetables. Add butter to dressing. Layer dressing then squash in buttered casserole dish and finish with dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except potatoes. Stir in potatoes. Pour into ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes uncovered.

title: Company Shrimp Boil
instructions: Fill a large pot with water to cover ingredients. Add shrimp and crab boil seasoning. When water comes to a boil add sausage and corn. Boil 10 minutes. Add shrimp and boil 3 minutes. Drain and serve with butter for the corn and cocktail sauce for the shrimp. Cole slaw and favorite beverage completes the meal.

title: Orange-Date-Nut Cake
instructions: Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. While hot punch many holes with ice pick. Pour glaze over cake. Let stand several hours before serving.

title: Crunch Bars
instructions: Bring Karo syrup and white sugar to a boil. Add peanut butter. Mix well. Add Special K cereal. Mix well and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt in double boiler the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips. Pour over Special K mixture.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften the cream cheese and mix with the shredded cheese. Drain the pimentos and chilies and mix in with the above ingredients. Put in a wreath mold for Christmas and decorate with sliced green olives and a bow. You can also use chopped walnuts.

title: Turnip Greens Casserole
instructions: Blend all ingredients together except crumbs and cheese. Spoon into casserole cover top with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. This dish multiplies well for a big crowd. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Pour butter over sugar. Add eggs and vinegar. Mix well. Fold in remaining filling ingredients. Pour into pie shell and bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Golden Cream Soup
instructions: In large saucepan combine potatoes water celery carrots onion parsley flakes bouillon and seasonings; mix well. Cover; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Gradually add milk to flour mixing until well blended. Add milk mixture to vegetables; cook until thickened. Add Velveeta; stir until melted. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Fiesta Meat Loaf
instructions: Saute onion celery and green pepper in butter until tender. Stir in chili sauce. Combine 1/2 cup this mixture with ground beef bread crumbs egg salt and pepper. Form into a loaf in shallow baking pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Serve remaining sauce cold or hot over meat loaf. Yields 6 servings.

title: Mexican Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except dressing Fritos and cheese Add the French dressing. Allow a few hours to marinate in the dressing. Add cheese and Fritos before serving.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Cream shortening and butter. Add sugar and beat at medium speed for 5 minutes. Add egg yolks and beat until the yolks disappear. Stir flour baking powder salt and cocoa together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour. Add vanilla. Fold in the beaten egg whites. Pour into a 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cool in pan for 30 minutes. Remove from pan. May be iced with your favorite chocolate icing.

title: Pigs In Blankets
instructions: Take each frank. Wrap 1/2 slice cheese around it. Take 1 piece bacon and wrap over the frank and cheese. Wrap 1 biscuit around frank. Continue until ingredients are used up. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Chewy Bars
instructions: Heat butter in pan in 350\u00b0 oven until melted. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs evenly over butter. Press down with fork. Sprinkle chocolate chips and coconut over crumbs. Drizzle condensed milk evenly over top. Cover with marshmallows. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Refrigerate for one hour before cutting into bars.

title: Friendship Tea Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in tightly closed jar. Combine 1 tablespoon of mix and 1 cup of hot water in a mug; add sugar. Makes 2 1/2 cups of mix.

title: Cherry Nut Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cherries in a mixing bowl. Blend on low speed of electric mixer 15 seconds; increase to medium speed and blend 30 additional seconds. Stir in cherries. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 to 15 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in pan; remove to wire rack and cool completely. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Hot Crab Triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat cheese until fluffy. Combine mustard with milk and add to cheese with salt cayenne crab meat chives and almonds. Mix well and spread generously on bread slices. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Cut each slice in 4 triangles; put on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until well browned.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil potatoes peel and mash while hot. Add butter beat eggs with half of sugar. Add to potatoes and butter mixture. Add milk and rest of sugar. Mix in spices (should be creamy). Pour into pie shells bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until custard is set and a toothpick comes out clean. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: One Step Pie Crust
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. With hands form dough to fit pie pan.

title: Crabmeat Au Gratin
instructions: Cook butter and onion until tender. Add flour until mixed well. Add milk salt and pepper and cook until thickens a little. Add sherry and crab meat.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Spread sliced apples in 9 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with water cinnamon and salt. Work remaining ingredients together until crumbly. Use pastry blender fork or fingers. Spread over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Dessert Cake
instructions: Follow directions on box for cake mix. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. With electric mixer beat cream cheese milk and pudding until thick. Spread over cooled cake. Spread drained pineapple over creamed mixture. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with some chopped nuts and coconut. Keep in refrigerator until served.

title: Round Steak
instructions: Melt shortening in a skillet. Cut round steak in sections. Brown until done. Empty cans of mushroom soup and stir together. Let simmer for about 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Prepare ribs. Remove excess fat wash and pat dry with paper towel. Place ribs in baking pan; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with chopped onions and chopped celery. Sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce. Bake slowly in 325\u00b0 oven until tender (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Drain fat and pour 1/2 bottle or more barbecue sauce over ribs and return to oven for 1/2 hour baste occasionally and remove from oven.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
instructions: Combine and mix first 6 ingredients. Spread in 9 x 13 baking pan. Sprinkle 2/3 of spice cake mix on top. Sprinkle on top of cake mix the chopped walnuts. Drizzle butter over top. Bake for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Poppy Seed Cake With Anise Hyssop
instructions: Combine and set aside buttermilk poppy seed almond extract and anise hyssop flowers. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and beat. Sift together flour soda baking powder and salt. Alternately add with buttermilk mixture. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour half the batter in a greased tube or bundt pan. Sprinkle half of the sugar-cinnamon mixture on batter and add the remaining batter and the remaining sugar mixture. Cut through batter with knife for marble effect. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ice Cream Party Punch
instructions: Put pineapple juice sherbet and ice cream in large mixing bowl and mix together. When ready to serve add ginger ale. Makes 24 servings.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except margarine. Melt oleo and pour into 9 x 12 casserole dish. Pour mixed ingredients over melted oleo. Do not stir. Bake 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Peach Frostee
instructions: In a blender combine canned sliced peaches dry milk powder vanilla and cinnamon. Cover and blend until smooth. Add five ice cubes one at a time with the motor running. Blend until smooth. Makes 4 servings. Calories per serving 115. Diabetic exchanges per serving milk 1 vegetable 0 fruit 1/2 bread 0 meat 0 and fat 0.

title: Bartley'S Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until just done and rinse in cold water. Add enough salad dressing to thoroughly coat the pasta. Add Parmesan cheese and vegetables. You may use any other vegetable you choose. Enjoy! This makes enough for 10.

title: German'S Sweet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool. Sift flour soda and salt. Cream butter and sugar well. Add egg yolks one at a time beating after each. Blend in vanilla and melted chocolate. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk beating after each addition. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour into 3 (9-inch) greased and floured layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pans 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain and add seasoning mix. Let cool. Mix cream cheese and chip dip together. Spread creamed mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer with meat mixture lettuce tomato and cheese. Refrigerate. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Shrimp Chowder
instructions: Cube potatoes and carrots. Add remaining vegetables. Simmer in water with salt and chicken bouillon for 20 minutes. Add cheese allow to melt. Add milk and shrimp and Worcestershire. Simmer gently stirring from bottom frequently. Do not boil. Thicken with cornstarch and water. Serve with salad and toasted French bread.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs. Cook sausage and onion. Drain grease. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. When set in the middle it is ready to eat. Can be prepared the night before and cooked in the morning.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Sprinkle bacon cheese and onion in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. In a bowl add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Pour over the bacon and cheese mixture. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 300\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes; cut into wedges and serve.

title: Dot'S Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onions. In another pan place tomato soup and 2 cans of water. Add chopped green pepper and olive juice. Boil for a few minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce. Cook and drain spaghetti or vermicelli. Put in large container. Add meat sauce and cheese to spaghetti. Mix well. Put in 2 casseroles (13 x 9-inch). Spread can of undiluted mushroom soup on top of each. Decorate with sliced olives. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding beans last. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch flour cocoa and salt. Add eggs butter and milk then coconut nuts and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pastry shell and bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Top should be crusty and firm. The center should become more firm as it cools.

title: Wonderful Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread in milk. Add meat eggs onions salt pepper and soup. Mix thoroughly. Shape in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Combine brown sugar catsup nutmeg and mustard; spread over meat loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: In a 6 to 8-quart saucepot combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium and cook 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf. Immediately fill hot pint or half pint jars with mixture leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Carefully run a utensil down inside of jar to remove trapped air bubbles. Wipe jar tops and threads clean. Place hot lids on jars and screw bands on firmly. Process pints or half-pints in boiling water canner for 15 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 pints or 10 to 12 half pints.

title: Poor Man'S Filet Mignon
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients and 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce. Form into 12 thick patties. Wrap bacon slice around the sides of each patty and secure with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Baste frequently with barbecue sauce the last 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix flour and soda. Combine butter sugar and pudding mix in large bowl. Beat until smooth. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in oats and raisins. Batter will be stiff. Drop by rounded teaspoon about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Ala Carbonara*
instructions: Mix cream egg Parmesan cheese and bacon together. Toss with cooked spaghetti. Sprinkle with salt Parmesan cheese and plenty of freshly ground black pepper. Serve immediately!

title: Italian Chocolate Cookies(A Very Old Recipe)
instructions: Make enough perked coffee to cover raisins. Pour over raisins and let cool.

title: Potluck Potatoes
instructions: Place unpeeled potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water. Cook just until tender but firm. Drain and cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Place in an ungreased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Add pimientos onion garlic and onion salt; toss gently. Sprinkle with cheese. Place bread cubes on top and pour melted margarine over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes or until bread is toasted. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: In a mixing bowl blend cream cheese mayonnaise and salad dressing mix until smooth. Slice a thin slice off tops of tomatoes and carefully remove insides. Invert on paper towel to drain. Fill with cream cheese mixture. Yield 12 to 16 servings.

title: Tutti-Frutti
instructions: Do not drain fruit. Mix and chill first 6 ingredients. Just before serving add bananas. Serve plain or with whipped topping.

title: Chilled Summer Squash Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan place all the squash. Add the onion garlic broth salt and pepper. Bring to a boil cover reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until the vegetables are very tender. Allow to cool slightly; puree in a food processor or blender with basil parsley and lemon juice until smooth. Place in a container cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. When ready to serve add the buttermilk. Whisk until smooth and adjust the seasonings with salt and pepper. Serve chilled and garnished with chopped basil and parsley. Serves 6.

title: Golden Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Peel and quarter potatoes. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in plastic bag. Moisten potatoes. Drop in bag and shake well. Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Arrange potatoes in one layer. Bake at 425\u00b0. Turn once.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and store in a tightly covered jar. Use 1-2 tsp. per cup of hot water.

title: Made-In-The-Shade Pork Chops
instructions: In shaker jar combine lemonade concentrate soy sauce and seasonings. Shake ingredients vigorously to blend. Pour half of marinade into shallow pan and add chops in single layer. Pour remaining marinade over steaks; cover pan and place in refrigerator approximately 24 hours. Meat should be turned once or twice during refrigeration. Remove from refrigerator three or four hours before grilling. Grill over medium coals 40 to 45 minutes. Baste steaks occasionally with remaining marinade.

title: Wilted Lettuce Salad(Microwave)
instructions: Cook bacon loosely covered with paper towel in microwave oven for 3 to 3 1/2 minutes or until crisp. Reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings. Tear lettuce into small pieces and combine with onion in salad bowl. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Combine vinegar reserved bacon drippings sugar water salt mustard and pepper in 1 cup glass measuring cup. Cook uncovered in a microwave for 1 minute or until mixture boils stirring to dissolve sugar. Pour over salad greens tossing to coat well. Garnish with crumbled bacon and radish slices. Serves 6.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Line a 9-inch square pan with whole graham crackers breaking crackers if necessary. Prepare pudding as directed on package. Let stand 5 minutes then blend in whipped topping. Spread 1/2 mixture over crackers. Add another layer of crackers; top with remaining pudding mixture and remaining crackers. Spread pie filling over top layer of crackers. Chill 3 hours. (Best if done a day ahead.)

title: Strawberries In The Snow
instructions: Line bottom of bowl with 1/2 cake that has been broken into pieces. Mix together milk cream cheese and sugar. Mix in Cool Whip and beat with mixer until smooth. Pour 1/2 of the mixture over first layer of cake. Repeat layers. Pour pie filling on top.

title: Cinnamon Pound Cake
instructions: Grease a 10-inch tube pan. Set aside. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Combine flour baking powder 1/2 teaspoon soda cocoa and cinnamon; add alternately with sour cream beating after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 75 minutes or until done. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Take off wire rack; cool completely.

title: Creamy Squash Casserole
instructions: Wash squash. Slice in rounds fairly thin. Salt pepper and roll in flour. Have cooking oil medium-hot and fry until crisp and golden brown. Serve while hot.

title: Turkey Dressing
instructions: Mix together. Add water until soupy. Stuff turkey. Put water in bottom of pan with turkey. Bake 3 hours; 45 minutes at 400\u00b0 and the balance at 325\u00b0.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Mix together oil Parmesan cheese salt garlic powder paprika and pepper. Dip potatoes in mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix and add 1 roll Ritz crackers (crushed) on top. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Granny'S Kitchen
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl. Cut in shortening. Add buttermilk then yeast mixture. Stir until thoroughly moistened. Turn out onto floured board and knead a minute or two. Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with a biscuit cutter. Place on greased baking sheet. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Brush tops with melted butter. Yield 60 (2-inch) biscuits.

title: Lima Bean Soup
instructions: Soak dried beans overnight. Wash thoroughly and put in pot of boiling water. Add chopped onion and cubed potatoes. Add seasonings to taste. Bring to a boil then cook on low until beans are done and soup is thick. Mash beans with wooden spoon while in the pot. Remove hot pepper. Add olive oil and sherry and simmer another 15 minutes. If sausage is added omit olive oil and add sausage along with potatoes and onion but boil sausage separately first to remove fat.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Set aside in bowl the nuts cinnamon and sugar. Cream butter. Add white sugar. Add the eggs and beat fast. Measure flour baking powder and salt. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture alternately with sour cream and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Put 1/2 batter in cake pan. Spread filling over the rest of batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool in pan on rack for 1/2 hour. Freezes nicely. Thaw covered. Better the older it gets.

title: Ed Mcmahon'S Turkey Dressing(Celebrity Recipe)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Stuff into neck and body cavities of turkey. If preferred bake in separate pan. Enough stuffing for a 16 pound turkey.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables tossing lightly. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour over vegetables and toss lightly. Cover and chill overnight. Drain well before serving.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix Veg-All sour cream mayonnaise and cheese. Place in casserole dish. Crush crackers and mix with melted butter. Spread on vegetable mixture and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Goulash
instructions: Brown and crumble hamburger meat in large skillet. Chop up onion and bell pepper. Add to hamburger meat. Brown until soft. Add tomatoes and enough water to make gravy. Add seasonings. Cook on low heat 45 minutes. Add noodles. Cook 10 minutes or until noodles are done. Serve with corn bread and salad.

title: Creamy Dill Dip
instructions: Mix together in blender or food processor until smooth.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Wash chicken pat dry with paper towels. Heat oil and butter in 6-quart Dutch oven. Add chicken a few pieces at a time and brown well on all sides. Remove as browned. Return chicken to Dutch oven; add tomato sauce tomatoes wine basil oregano garlic parsley salt and pepper. Simmer covered for 45 to 50 minutes or until chicken is tender. Combine flour with 3 tablespoons water; stir into sauce. Add mushrooms; cook 10 minutes longer or until sauce is thickened. Makes 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Gradually mix the ingredients except cracker crumbs and melted margarine together into a large bowl then pour into a casserole bowl. Add the crushed crackers evenly on top then spread the melted margarine evenly on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Drain sauerkraut. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly. Use only enough mayonnaise to moisten the mixture. Chill well about 1 to 5 hours before serving.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Spread crumbs into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Make pudding and pour over crumbs. Slice bananas over pudding. Cover with Cool Whip. Layer on strawberries and pineapple. Sprinkle on coconut.

title: Sausage And Salsa Skillet Dinner
instructions: Cut sausage in half lengthwise cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. In 10-inch skillet combine rice sausage tomatoes water salsa and beans. Mix well breaking tomatoes with large spoon. Bring to boil reduce heat cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat let stand covered about 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Roast Fresh Ham
instructions: In a bowl mix all ingredients together except ham. Remove rind from ham. Score fat with a knife. Rub mixture over ham. Wrap ham in foil or plastic and refrigerate overnight. Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Unwrap ham. Place in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Roast uncovered for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0. Baste with drippings every 30 minutes for about 4 hours or until meat thermometer registers 160\u00b0 internal temperature.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces and fry. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon grease. Blend sugar onion flour and seasonings into grease in large frying pan. Gradually add water and vinegar. Boil 1 minute. Add potatoes and bacon. Cook 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Snickers Bar Dessert
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding according to directions on package. Stir in Cool Whip. Add 2 chopped Snickers. Pour over crust. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. This makes 1 large 9-inch pie or 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: 1st Layer Mix 1 cup plain flour 1 tablespoon sugar 1 1/2 cups pecan pieces and 1 stick melted butter. Press in bottom of 12-inch rectangular Pyrex (or 10-inch round). Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until light brown. Chill or allow to cool completely.

title: Hearty Chicken Soup
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until done and cool. Debone and chop into bite sized pieces. Save approximately 3 cups of water boiled in. Chop celery carrots onion and garlic into fine pieces.

title: Somen Noodle Salad
instructions: Rinse lettuce. Drain well. Tear into small pieces. Clean and slice mushrooms. Rinse cucumber green pepper onion and tomatoes sliced. Combine all ingredients in a salad bowl. Garnish with green onions.

title: Squash Souffle
instructions: Chop squash and onion; cook until tender and drain well. Mix in all other ingredients and stir in saltines. Place in buttered casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops on each side; drain. Arrange potatoes in a 9 x 12-inch casserole lightly coated with nonstick spray. Mix water soup and sour cream in small bowl; pour over potatoes. Arrange pork chops on top. Season with salt and pepper. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Caesar Salad(Serves 6)
instructions: Remove\tcrusts\tfrom bread and spread butter lightly on each side. Place in large skillet over moderate heat.\tAdd a little of\tthe remaining\tbutter. Brown\tbread on each side drain on paper towels and\tcube. Beat eggs slightly. Add olive\toil lemon juice Parmesan cheese mustard pepper and garlic.\tBeat until blended. Toss romaine dressing and croutons.

title: Carrot Tuna Noodle Salad
instructions: Mix carrots celery and tuna together. Add mayonnaise. Just before serving add noodles. Serves about 6.

title: Donuts
instructions: Cut small hole in middle of biscuits. I use medicine bottle. Deep fry biscuits and the holes until brown. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Starlight Mint Surprise Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking soda and salt. In separate bowl cream butter sugar and brown sugar. Blend in eggs water and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Put about 1 tablespoon of dough around each mint. Place on greased baking sheet about 3 inches apart. Top with walnut half. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Mix marinade ingredients together and marinate meat overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (uncovered).

title: Mama'S Fudge
instructions: Boil until it forms a ball in cold water then beat and pour into pan to set.

title: Hot! Hot! Dogs
instructions: Mix together and simmer for one hour (covered). Then add 2 cups of water. Cook one more hour. Serve hot. May be put in containers to freeze if desired.

title: Food, Facts And Fancy Cream Of Potato-Vegetable Chicken Soup
instructions: Dice bacon and place in heavy saucepan. Cook but do not brown. Remove extra fat. Add diced onion and diced celery. Saute 2 to 3 minutes. Add potato broth and bouillon. Cook until potato is almost (soft) tender. Add frozen carrots and peas celery slices mushroom slices diced chicken milk chicken broth and herb blend.

title: Cheese Broccoli
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour to make gravy. Add milk to thicken. Once thickened add cheese. Arrange broccoli stems facing in the middle. Pour cheese sauce over the broccoli.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cut peeled eggplant into 1-inch cubes and soak in salt water in refrigerator 6 hours. Drain eggplant. Place in pan. Cover with water and simmer until soft. Soak cornbread in milk. Saute onions green pepper and celery in butter until all are tender. Combine cooked eggplant bread crumbs and sauteed vegetables. Add eggs pimento and seasoning. Thoroughly blend and place in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes then top with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Stir in marshmallows until almost dissolved. Add cream cheese. Fold in rest of ingredients and mix thoroughly. Put in an 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish and refrigerate.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Stir jello sugar and syrup all together. Bring to a full boil. Remove from heat and add the baking soda stirring to mix. Pour over popcorn stirring so all corn is coated. Grease hands with butter and form into balls.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix and cook 1 minute for each batch then stir in oatmeal mixture until thick. Drop onto wax paper. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: In large bowl mix Bisquick cheese and sausage meat; add salt and pepper. Mix well and roll in small ball. Place in refrigerator half a day or night. Cut bacon in three strips and wrap each ball with a strip of bacon. Lap ends and stick toothpick in to hold in place. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl. In a medium bowl beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla until blended. Sift flour baking soda baking powder or salt over sugar mixture. Stir with wooden spoon to make a stiff dough. Shape dough into walnut-size balls. Roll in cinnamon/sugar mixture to coat. Place balls about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on wire racks.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Keep half of egg whites to put in last. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes then to 375\u00b0 to finish. For 2 pies.

title: Cool Veggie Pizza Or Mexican Siesta Pizza
instructions: *For Mexican Siesta add 2 tablespoons of sour cream and 2 tablespoons of taco mix. Omit mayo and dill.

title: Ben Grayson'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook onions in butter until soft. Add other ingredients and simmer 15 minutes (preferably 30). Makes about 2 1/2 cups and will be thick.

title: Chinese Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Place ribs on baking sheet. With sharp knife cut meat between bones. Crush garlic and blend with other ingredients. Spoon sauce on both sides and into cuts. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes on each side. Serves 4.

title: Meal-In-A-Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in covered pan or casserole dish or Dutch oven. Cook in 300\u00b0 oven for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. If it gets too dry add water to make right consistency. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Bone chicken and chip up meat. Boil spaghetti in chicken broth. Cook vegetables in margarine until onions are transparent. Mix chicken spaghetti and vegetables with mushroom soup. Cook around 40 minutes in a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in boiling water. Cool. Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat after each addition. Add chocolate vanilla buttermilk and flour to the egg mixture beating slowly until smooth. Add the soda mixture and fold in the egg whites. Bake in layers or in a long flat pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage drain and place in 2-quart lightly greased casserole dish. Melt cheese in soup pour over cabbage. Place corn bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly or brown.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel core and slice apples. Mix with cinnamon and sugar. Arrange in 9 x 13-inch dish. Melt oleo and add to remaining dry ingredients. Spoon over apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Keep covered with foil and last 15 minutes uncover to crisp up the topping.

title: Estofado
instructions: In 10-inch skillet brown beef cubes in hot oil. Stir in wine undrained tomatoes onion green pepper raisins apricots salt pepper and garlic. In a cheesecloth bag combine basil thyme tarragon and bay leaf. Add to meat mixture and simmer covered for 1 hour. Stir mushrooms and olives into stew. Simmer covered 30 minutes more. Discard herb bag. Blend cold water with flour; stir into stew. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Serve over rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cinnamon Nuts
instructions: Mix cinnamon into sugar; add cream and mix well. Cook on medium-low heat stirring constantly; cook to 240\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir until syrup coats nuts. Spread on wax paper to cool. Break into pieces.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: In medium bowl with fork beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually stir in crushed pineapple 1 cup pecans green pepper onion and salt. Shape into a ball. Roll in remaining nuts. Wrap in plastic film or foil. Refrigerate until well chilled overnight.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix fruit tapioca and sugar. Pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix other ingredients and drop by spoonfuls on top of fruit. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Diet Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Put your sliced cucumbers or any cut up vegetables in mixture. Cover and store in refrigerator. Eat whenever hungry.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Combine ingredients. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Form patties and coat with seafood breader. Pan-fry.

title: Johnny Marzette
instructions: Brown meat in margarine. Mix all ingredients together. Put into a 14 x 9-inch roasting pan. Sprinkle top with 2 cups grated American cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Gloria'S Fried Pie Dough
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together and cut in shortening. Add liquid ingredients and refrigerate. This can be stored several days and used as needed. For fried pies I roll out a thin saucer-sized circle of dough. Fill with desired fruit and fold in half. Press edges with fork and fry in skillet with a little bit of shortening. This dough is very easy to work with and tastes great.

title: Papaya Seed Dressing
instructions: Put vinegar and dry ingredients in blender with motor running. Add oil in steady stream. Add onion then papaya seed and blend until seed looks coarsely ground. Chill for 1 hour. Good on fruit or green salads.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Beat in milk and vanilla. Serve very cold sprinkled with nutmeg. Serve immediately. Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Cauliflower With Cheese
instructions: Let cauliflower stand in salted water 20 to 30 minutes and rinse. Cover with water. Add the salt and garlic (if desired). Bring to a boil. Simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until tests done. Drain and place on serving dish. Top with Cheese Sauce and Buttered Bread Crumbs.

title: Vegetable Quiche
instructions: Saute onions zucchini and garlic in margarine or oil. Prebake 1 pie crust until slightly cooked. Mix together cheese eggs milk and dash of Tabasco sauce. Add sauteed vegetables to egg mixture. Pour into crust. Bake at about 350\u00b0 until set about 45 to 60 minutes. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top after it is baked.

title: Sausage Pepper Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grate cheeses; set aside. Cook sausages and drain. In a skillet saute vegetables in the butter until soft. In a large bowl combine and whisk half and half milk eggs and seasonings. In pie crusts layer sausages vegetable mixture and cheeses two layers per pie. Pour milk over layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan and paprika. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until brown; let sit 15 minutes before slicing to eat.

title: Leota'S Fudge
instructions: Mix syrup sugar milk and chocolate. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves. Increase heat until soft ball stage is reached. Add butter and put in cool water until mixture is lukewarm. Add vanilla and beat until candy stands alone. Add pecans and mix and turn into greased dish.

title: Raspberry Crumb Bars
instructions: Position rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 375 degrees. Butter a 9 x 9 pan.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Whip together the lemonade and the Eagle Brand milk. Pour mixture into pie crust. Place in freezer. Pie is ready to eat when frozen.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to directions. Combine all ingredients and put in a buttered casserole dish. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Blend in eggs; add bananas and mix well. Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture with buttermilk. Bake for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Brown onion and garlic in margarine. Add other ingredients except wieners. Simmer. Add wieners and cook 10 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Peach Cake
