instructions: Mix together cake mix pie filling eggs vanilla and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix together flour sugar butter and flavoring (will be crumbly). Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Combine first\t4 ingredients.\tMix sugar and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; cover. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Pour vinegar mixture over vegetables and toss. Cover and chill at least 2 hours.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Blend in blender. Marinate meat overnight then barbecue. Also good for chicken.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken
instructions: Before you go to church Sunday morning cut up and remove the skin from fryer; salt and flour lightly. Arrange in single layer in slow cooker. Slice onion; spread over chicken. Sprinkle over this the seasoning thyme and celery and parsley flakes. Place lid on cooker; turn on. Come home from church and eat!

title: Summer Punch
instructions: In a large pitcher or punch bowl combine all except sherbet. Stir until all juices are thawed and blended. Top with scoop of sherbet if desired. Makes 18 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Tortoni Squares
instructions: Combine almonds oleo crumbs and extract; mix well. Sprinkle 1/3 of crumbs over bottom of 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan that is lined with foil. Spoon half of ice cream over crumbs. Drizzle with preserves. Sprinkle with crumbs. Repeat layers. Store in freezer. Cut in squares and garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until they begin to peak. Add sugar salt and vanilla. Continue to beat until mixture is stiff. Fold in nuts and chips. Turn oven off. Spoon cookie mixture on cookie sheet (1 teaspoon). Place in oven for 6 hours or overnight. Store in airtight container.

title: Zucchini-Potato Pancakes
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. In large bowl combine zucchini potatoes eggs cracker crumbs salt basil and pepper. Stir until well mixed. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls into heated oil and cook until brown. Add more oil if needed. Serve with grated Parmesan cheese. Makes about 18 medium pancakes.

title: Scalloped Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken; cool and debone. Take bread and tear like you would for dressing. Mix seasoned salt pepper salt and onion with bread. Mix soups broth and chicken. Add to bread crumbs and mix well. Put into two 9 x 13-inch pans. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Wash wild rice. Boil rice for 15 minutes and drain; set aside. Fry bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and discard all but 3 tablespoons bacon drippings. Saute celery onion and green pepper in drippings until onion is transparent. Put in a large kettle and add rice broth mushrooms soup and diced bacon. Cook on low heat for 1 hour or more. Do not add salt.

title: Crepes
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients until smooth. Add flour and milk. Mix in slowly. Put on a small frying pan with Crisco 1/4 cup crepe batter. Flip and fry both sides until golden brown.

title: Italian Cookie Anise Toast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour cookie sheet. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Beat sugar and eggs for 5 minutes. Add anise and beat well. Add dry ingredients and mix at low speed. Make 3 separate long loaves on cookie sheet 3-inches wide. Bake 15 minutes until lightly baked. Remove from oven and cut into 1-inch cookies. Put back on cookie sheet cut side down and bake 10 more minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Lyn'S Dip
instructions: Heat jello cream cheese tomato soup and water until melted and blended well. Cool well. Add Miracle Whip pecans bell pepper and onion; chill overnight. Makes about 2-quarts of dip. Good for a large crowd and good with chips or vegetables.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Put rhubarb in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle Jell-O and sugar over rhubarb. Sprinkle package of dry cake mix over mixture. Mix butter and water together and drizzle over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Best Yet Banana Bread
instructions: Mix in order given and pour in loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine apple celery nuts and mayonnaise. Toss and serve on crisp greens. Serves 4.

title: Corn Flake Chicken
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow dish. Dip each chicken breast in milk. Roll in crumb mixture. Place chicken in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 minutes or until done. Yields 6 servings.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Cream 1/3 of the sugar with butter and salt in a large bowl. Blend extract 2 tablespoons milk and remaining sugar into mixture. Gradually stir remaining milk into frosting until desired spreading consistency is reached.

title: Punch Bowl Party Dessert
instructions: Bake cake in two round 8-inch cake pans according to package directions. Cool. Cut layers horizontally by pulling a string through. You will have 4 layers. Make pudding according to package directions. Cool. Mix 2 1/2 cups boiling water with 2 boxes of strawberry Jell-O mixing until Jell-O dissolves. Chill until slightly thickened (like egg white). Assemble in a punch bowl as follows First layer of cake 1/4 of the Jell-O layer of Cool Whip and layer of pudding. Second layer of cake Jell-O Cool Whip and pudding. Third layer of cake Jell-O Cool Whip and pudding. Fourth layer of cake only topped with thick layer of Cool Whip. Garnish with fresh sliced berries.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Put in 2 (5 x 9-inch) greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Rocky Mt. Apple Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Spread 1/2 mixture evenly in bottom of pie pan. Line pan with quartered or halved apples cut side up. Spread remaining sugar mixture on apples. Drizzle cream over apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Yummy Strawberry Pie
instructions: Crush crackers fine then combine with sugar and butter. Mix well. Press firmly in unbuttered 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Place in refrigerator to cool. Mix milk and lemon juice by hand until thick. Add strawberries and part of the juice for color. Arrange in pie shell. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and oil. Beat into the wet mixture flour baking soda salt cinnamon baking powder and vanilla. Add nuts dates and zucchini to mixture.

title: Fruit Tray And Dip
instructions: Mix together sour cream jelly and coconut for dip mixture. Wash and cut fruit. Arrange on tray. Use decorative toothpicks to pick up fruit and dip in mixture.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Store in refrigerator. Serve with vegetables.

title: Swedish Coffee Bread
instructions: Beat together with enough cream to make it smooth.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small mixing bowl combine green onions parsley flakes salt pepper and garlic powder. Set aside. Place 1 piece of cheese in center of each chicken breast. Top with 1/4 of onion mixture. Starting at narrow edge roll each breast tightly tucking in sides to enclose cheese and onion mixture. Dredge with flour. In small bowl combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Dip each rolled breast in beaten egg then in crumb mixture to coat.

title: Hot Tuna Melts
instructions: Mix ingredients in order using 8 to 12 hamburger rolls. Fill with mixture. Cover with tops. Seal each sandwich inside of foil and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Drain shrimp and rinse in cold water. Gradually blend milk and mayonnaise into cream cheese. Add seasonings and shrimp.

title: The Cake That Won'T Last
instructions: Mash bananas in mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended by hand. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat egg and sugar. Add milk and vanilla. Sprinkle cinnamon on and beat. Set mixture aside. Break bread into bite size pieces in a bowl. Pour water over bread; make soggy. Squeeze water out of bread by handfuls. Put all bread in baking dish. Pour egg and milk mixture over it. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion for 10 minutes until soft and drain. Melt butter and place croutons in skillet. Place them on bottom of cake pan and save the other half for the top. Grate carrots and mix with mushroom soup chicken soup and King sour; mix them with squash. Grate cheese on top. Place Italian bread crumbs on top sparingly and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or longer.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meats; drain. Saute garlic in oil. Add mushrooms basil oregano tomatoes paste salt pepper sugar 1 cup water and meat. Simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Cut broccoli into flowerets. Peel and slice stems. Cook pasta. When pasta has about 13 minutes left to cook heat olive oil and add garlic and red pepper. Stir one minute. Add broccoli. Mix well. Add salt and 1/2 cup water or defatted broth. Use less salt if using canned all chicken broth. Cover with a tight lid. Cook 8 minutes stirring occasionally. Drain pasta and mix with broccoli and its liquid. Serve at once.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix and pour into a casserole dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Garden Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls on cookie sheet and press together. Bake as directed on can until brown. Mix remaining ingredients except vegetables and spread over crust. Top with vegetables.

title: Country Pork Ribs
instructions: Rub ribs with crushed garlic and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in roasting pan rib side downin 350\u00b0 oven. While ribs are roasting put dried fruit in saucepan barely cover with water and simmer covered for 35 minutes. After ribs have cooked for 1 hour add the fruit and its cooking liquid and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes. Make glaze by combining unsweetened orange juice concentrate onion flakes and mustard. Spread over ribs and roast another 15 minutes basting frequently. If ribs dont appear nicely browned bake a little longer until they have a pleasing color. Cut the ribs into serving size pieces and arrange along with the fruit on a platter. A green vegetable and salad will finish meal.

title: Pineapple Date Bread
instructions: Combine egg milk shortening pineapple nuts and dates. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to first mixture and stir just to moisten. Grease baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. A nice holiday bread.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Chill before serving.

title: Lazy Macaroons
instructions: Beat the egg whites with a dash of vanilla until stiff. Slowly add sugar and fold in the coconut. Drop by a teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Makes about 20.

title: Sicilian Meat Roll
instructions: Combine eggs breadcrumbs tomato juice parsley oregano salt pepper and garlic. Stir in ground beef mixing well with hands. On waxed paper pat meat to a 12 x 10-inch rectangle. Arrange ham slices on top of meat leaving a small margin around edge. Sprinkle shredded cheese over ham. Starting from short end carefully roll up meat using paper to lift; seal edges and ends. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours. Place cheese wedges over top of roll. Return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve with watermelon pickle or sweet relish. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Grease baking dish and sprinkle bottom evenly with onion gravy mix. Spread rice evenly over the mix. Cut up chickens; salt and pepper. Place pieces on rice. Mix soup with 1 1/2 cans of water and pour over the chicken. Cover with heavy foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

title: White Chocolate Candy
instructions: Melt stirring constantly over low heat the first three ingredients. Add Rice Krispies and peanuts. Drop by the teaspoon on waxed paper and enjoy.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in a baking dish. Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Mix with sugar; stir in milk. Pour batter over melted butter. Do not stir. Sweeten fruit to taste and pour over batter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Enjoy.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli flowers in small pieces. Cook bacon and crumble. Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Pour over all other ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook rice (unsalted). Melt butter. Mix all ingredients together. Cook at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. May also be put in microwave for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Granny'S Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together then add shortening. Mix until its a cornmeal type texture. Add egg and enough water to make it \a little wetter than pie crust dough.\ Roll out onto floured board and cut into squares. Drop into boiling chicken and broth. Add salt and black pepper to taste and thicken broth with more flour. Dumplings should be ready in 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Split Brownie Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare brownie mix according to pkg. directions. Cut a circle of parchment paper (not wax paper) to fit the 15 inch large round stone. Pour brownie mix onto parchment paper. Spread into 14 inch circle. Bake 15-18 minutes or until brownie is set. Do no overbake. Cool completely. Mix cream cheese drained pineapple and sugar spread on brownie. Slice bananas and strawberries and arrange over the mixture. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and drizzle chocolate topping over. Refrigerate. Cut into 16 wedges.

title: Pinylata Or Sausage Rolls
instructions: Mix flour with hot roll mix flour. Use yeast from mix plus extra yeast dissolved in the warm water. Mix yeast water into flour and mix until dough comes away from side of bowl. Add maybe 1/2 cup flour more and knead 1 minute. Cover and let rise 1/2 hour. Roll 1/3 of dough to size of 10-inch pie shell. Spread 1/3 of cooked and drained sausage on top with some Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese garlic powder and bread crumbs sprinkled on. Roll up like jelly roll. Cut into 3-inch pieces or smaller. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Do 3 times.

title: Cathy'S Crab Brunch Casserole
instructions: Drain crabmeat. Spread layer of croutons in buttered 9-inch square casserole. Sprinkle with crabmeat then cheese. Layer 2 times ending with cheese layer. Beat eggs; add milk and seasonings. Pour over casserole. Bake in oven preheated to 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Check for doneness by inserting knife in center. Will come out clean when finished. Sprinkle bacon on top about 10 minutes before finished baking.

title: Cheesy Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: Brown meat good; cut up vegetables. Add mushrooms soup onion pepper and celery. Cook 45 minutes then add cheese. Stir until melted. Add cooked noodles to the mixture. Put mixture in a large casserole dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Mix strawberries with glaze; set aside. Break cake into bite size pieces. Fold together pudding Cool Whip and condensed milk. Layer cake pudding mixture and strawberries in a punch bowl until reaches top. You may garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix salt sugar and mayonnaise and pour over the vegetables. Sprinkle with cheese and crumbled bacon. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Cream sugars and margarine; add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Measure cocoa in measuring cup and fill to the 3/4 mark with boiling water. Stir to dissolve. Stir into creamed mixture. Mix soda with buttermilk and add to the creamed mixture alternately with flour mixing well. Pour into two greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Creamed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Place cheese slices over chicken. Combine soup and wine. Stir. Spoon sauce evenly over chicken and cheese. Sprinkle with stuffing. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread graham crackers. Add butterscotch morsels then chocolate morsels then nuts and coconut. Then pour Eagle Brand milk over layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool; cut into squares.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all but the last four ingredients in a large bowl and set aside. Brown hamburger meat and drain. Grease an iron skillet. Heat and sprinkle with a thin layer of raw corn meal brown slightly. Pour 1/2 of the corn meal batter into the skillet; sprinkle with the meat cheese onion and chiles. Pour remaining batter on top. Bake in 9-inch skillet at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Italian Rolls
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil. Pour over oil sugar and salt. Cook until only lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in 1/3 c. warm water. Add to cooled mixture along with the eggs and 3 cups flour. Stir until smooth. Add remaining 3 cups flour and blend in. Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead lightly. Shape into rolls and place on greased pans (I use 9 x 13-inch pans). Let rise until doubled. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sugared Popcorn
instructions: Combine sugar butter and water in large heavy pot. Bring to boiling over medium heat stirring constantly. Continue to cook until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture becomes syrupy 4 to 5 minutes. Remove pot from heat. Add the popcorn to the pot. Stir to coat popcorn evenly with sugar mixture. Turn coated popcorn out in thin layer onto sheet of wax paper or parchment paper. Let popcorn cool for about 10 minutes. Serve in a basket or for a festive touch in individual paper cones.

title: Mock Black Forest Cake For Microwave Oven
instructions: Grease or spray with Pam a microwave Bundt cake pan. Sprinkle nuts and put cherries in bottom of pan. Put mixture in pan only 1/2 full. Bake on High for 13 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan well. Dump pie filling and pineapple with juice into it. Dump yellow cake mix on top and spread it around. Drizzle with butter or margarine. Dump nuts and some coconut on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Fry onion and bell peppers in oil until tender. Cook over low to medium heat. Add tomatoes water onions peppers rice salt and black pepper. Stir constantly until done. Serve with crumbled cornbread or cooked cabbage if desired.

title: Healthy Supper
instructions: Cook meat in large pot. Add rice bouillon (dissolved in hot water) and seasoned salt and stir. Add cabbage onions and carrots. Cover and cook slowly until cabbage cooks down and carrots are tender. Can be simmered for an hour and left unattended. Serve with soy sauce if desired. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mostaccioli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown hamburger. Cook noodles according to box directions. In large container combine ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. Top with Parmesan cheese if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes celery onion and salt in 2 cups water about 20 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Lightly mash with potato masher and cook stirring constantly until soup is hot and thickened.

title: Corn And English Pea Salad
instructions: Drain corn and peas. Stir in other ingredients until mixed well. Chill at least 12 hours.

title: Chilled Summer Soup
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add the lettuce watercress and spring onions and fry for 8 minutes. Stir in all but 3 tablespoons of the chicken stock and simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Blend the flour to a paste with the remaining stock and stir into the soup. Add salt and pepper to taste and continue cooking until soup has thickened. Puree in an electric blender. Cool then stir in cream. Sprinkle top with parsley. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Tempting Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature; sift together flour soda and salt. Cream together margarine shortening sugar and vanilla. Add the egg; cream until mixture is fluffy. Stir in dry ingredients until mixture is smooth; blend in milk. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet; flatten the dough with the bottom of a glass which has been dipped in sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 12 minutes. Makes 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Shredded Sweet Potatoes
instructions: *May vary amounts as desired.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix together chicken broth soup and vegetables. Spread into oblong baking dish. Mix flour margarine and milk; spread over chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together the first 4 ingredients then add next 5 ingredients. Combine water oil and eggs. Mix together dry and wet mixtures well. Add raisins and/or pecans to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour in loaf pans.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Put sliced lettuce in bottom of bowl or container you are using (glass allows you to see the layers). Put the other layers of vegetables you are using; try to vary colors for a nice look. The choice is yours except that you need to finish with the peas on top. Mix the sour cream mayonnaise and sugar in small bowl; spread over entire top of salad on top of peas. Cover; refrigerate for at least 8 hours. To serve go down to bottom of bowl with salad fork and spoon to get all the layers and dressing.

title: Nutty O'S
instructions: A blessing be upon the COOK

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with milk until well blended. Pour into large greased tube pan or two loaf pans. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed until smooth. Drain chilies. Gently stir in chilies tomatoes and onion. Put in serving bowl and chill. Serve with taco chips or Triscuits. Makes 2 cups.

title: Ginger Bread
instructions: Mix together sugar shortening molasses and water. Sift dry ingredients into mixture and blend well. Stir in eggs. Pour in greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip and some of the chopped fresh fruit. Spoon into crust. Chill. Arrange fresh fruit on top.

title: Banana Fudge Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of an 8-inch square pan. Melt in a 2-quart saucepan over low heat stirring constantly the butter and chocolate chips. Beat in the remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread in greased pan. Bake for about 30 minutes. Cool; cut into squares. Makes 14 or 16.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Arrange cubes on bottom of dish.\tFold crabmeat mayonnaise onion celery and green pepper together and spoon over cubed\tbread.\tTrim 4 to 6 slices bread and arrange over crabmeat mixture. Beat eggs and milk together and pour over mixture. Chill 8\thours or longer. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 and bake uncovered for 15 minutes. Take out and spread soup over bread and top with cheese and paprika and cook for one hour covered.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; pour off grease. Bring water to boil. Add soup; boil for 7 minutes. Add to sausage and vegetables. Pour into greased casserole pan; sprinkle sliced almonds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pancake Mix
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder into bowl. Add milk melted shortening and egg. Beat well. Pour onto sprayed pan. (For thinner pancakes add more milk.) Makes 12 to 15 (5-inch) pancakes.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Saute together garlic pepper and onion. Add remaining ingredients. Add 1 or 2 cans water. Simmer until peppers are done.

title: Baked Beans With Ground Beef
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and celery. Brown ground beef. Mix beans barbecue sauce catsup and brown sugar. Add beef and sauteed vegetables. Mix everything together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs eggs soup mix and Accent. Roll into bite size pieces. Arrange on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Rolls
instructions: Arrange rolls in well-greased fluted tube pan. Sprinkle pudding (dry) over rolls. Cook butter and remaining ingredients over low heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture bubbles. Pour over rolls. Cover tightly with foil. Let stand overnight on counter. Next morning bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes then invert carefully onto serving dish.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into small bite-size pieces. This will take about 2 months. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Cook over kerosene fire for about 4 weeks at 462\u00b0. This will serve 3800 people. If more are expected the 2 rabbits may be added but do this only if necessary as most people do not like to find hare in their stew. Yield 3800 servings.

title: Fresh Mint Jelly
instructions: Wash mint leaving stems intact. Crush or coarsely chop. Place in a large saucepan. Add sugar water and vinegar. Over high heat bring to a full rolling boil stirring until sugar dissolves.

title: Blueberry Torte
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs (save some for the top) sugar and melted margarine and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Soften cream cheese and beat until smooth. Add eggs remaining 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla and cream well. Pour cream cheese mixture over crust and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool. Spread pie filling over cream cheese mixture. Top with whipped cream and the rest of graham cracker crumbs. Chill overnight.

title: Lolita'S Deep Dish Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and apples. Arrange sliced apples into chilled shell 1/2-inch from edge; work toward center until shell is covered. Add salt cinnamon grated rind of lemon and lemon juice to apple mixture in pie shell. Pile remaining apples on top. Dot with butter. Cover with top crust and seal edges. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Frozen Strawberry Salad(Salad Or Dessert)
instructions: Cream together Cool Whip sugar and cream cheese. Fold remaining ingredients into mixture. Place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and freeze or you may put in individual foil muffin cups and freeze. Enjoy. Serves 10.

title: Fresh Blueberry Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and then add sugar a little at a time creaming again. Add eggs and some flour sifted with the salt and baking powder. Blend slowly adding milk and the rest of the flour. Wash blueberries; dry with paper towel and dust with flour. Add to batter just before baking. Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar nutmeg cloves or whatever appeals to you. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Popovers
instructions: Sift flour; measure. Add salt and sift again. Beat eggs with rotary or electric beater until light and thick. Add flour and 1/3 cup of the milk; continue to beat slowly until all the flour is moistened about 30 seconds. Gradually add remaining milk and melted shortening. Beat until free from lumps 1 to 2 minutes. Fill greased muffin pan. Divide in 6 to 8 large popovers. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except for 1 cup of pecans. Shape into ball and roll in remaining pecans. Best if chilled a day or two ahead of serving time.

title: Pintos And Sausage
instructions: Cook beans as directed on bag (I use more water to give some juice) around 2 1/2 hours. Cut up sausage. Add to beans. Cook about 15 minutes more. Salt and pepper to taste. Great with cornbread and onions.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan put nuts and coconut on bottom of pan and spread evenly. Mix cake mix as directed on box. Pour over nuts and coconut. Melt oleo and cream cheese in microwave or low heat in pan. When melted mix in powdered sugar; should be pretty thick. Spoon all over cake mix; do not spread out. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. You dont have to ice cake unless you want to.

title: Low-Fat Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix the first eight ingredients. Heat to boil and then simmer 5 minutes. Cool to warm and add flour soda and salt. Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan 45 to 60 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until done.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Prepare gelatin as directed. When partly congealed add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into mold and chill to firm.

title: Colorful Vegetable Salad
instructions: Layer half of vegetables in a salad bowl. Repeat layers. Add salad dressing. Cover tightly and chill until ready to serve.

title: Oriental Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove from pan and drain on paper towel. Stir soy sauce into the bacon drippings. Add chestnuts garlic and broth. Bring to a boil and add Brussels sprouts. Return to a boil; cover and reduce heat cooking about 8 minutes or until sprouts are just tender. Combine cornstarch and water and add to the pan liquid. Cook stirring until thickened. Sprinkle reserved bacon over the top to serve. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Oatmeal Crunchies Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Add brown sugar shortening egg and vanilla; beat well. Stir in oats and nuts. Form dough into small balls. Dip tops in a little additional granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Scotch-A-Roos
instructions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil. Boil maybe 1 or 2 minutes no longer or they will get too hard. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and stir together. Add Rice Krispies. Put in bar pan greased with butter or margarine.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix everything together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 to 35 minutes or until browned slightly. Let stand 2 or 3 minutes and cut into 1-inch squares. Serve warm as hors doeuvres.

title: Easy Casserole
instructions: Fry meat until no longer pink. Add onion green pepper and celery. Cook until tender. Drain off excess fat.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: In a large pot cook chicken and spices in water for several hours until done. The meat will start falling off the bone. Take chicken out remove meat from bone and set aside.

title: Hinder Wings
instructions: Mix together. Use only 2 larger sections of wings. Put wings in a shallow pan; pour sauce over. Baste and turn every 15 minutes so they get covered with sauce. Last 10 minutes sprinkle with sesame seed. Drain on cake racks (spread newspaper underneath to catch drippings). Can be eaten cold.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Tear up bread in dish brown and drain sausage spoon over bread and sprinkle on grated cheese. Beat eggs milk salt pepper; pour mixture over sausage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Can prepare the night before. Serves 6.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Stir thoroughly after each addition. Pour batter in two 9-inch greased and floured pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Wanda'S Lasagna
instructions: Boil noodles until done. Brown hamburger meat. In a large bowl combine hamburger meat Ragu sauce sour cream cottage cheese salt and garlic powder.

title: Lemon-Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Mix both packages of Jell-O in the hot water. Let cool. Add pineapple milk salad dressing cheese and pecans. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate until congealed. Cut in squares. If desired top with fresh mint leaf and red and green cherries. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots just until tender. Mix remaining ingredients in a pan. Bring to a boil and pour over cooked carrots. Refrigerate. Will keep up to 6 weeks in refrigerator. Sauce left after other ingredients have been eaten can be used over salads.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Cut hot baked potatoes in half. Scoop out insides; reserve shells. In large bowl with electric mixer beat potatoes and spread until creamy. Gradually beat in milk; stir in onion salt and pepper. Spoon mixture into reserved shells. Sprinkle with cheese. Arrange in baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion; drain. Mash. Add all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on. Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Cook and stir onion in bacon drippings until tender and gold. Stir in flour sugar salt celery seed and pepper. Cook over low heat. Stir until bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in water and vinegar. Heat to boil; stir constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Crumble bacon. Dice potatoes. Carefully stir bacon and potatoes in hot mixture. Heat through. Stir to coat potatoes.

title: Coleslaw Superb
instructions: Combine cabbage onion green pepper and sugar. In saucepan combine 1 tablespoon sugar salt celery seed dry mustard water vinegar and oil. Bring to a boil; pour over vegetables. Cool in refrigerator for 24 hours. Keeps for 3 weeks.

title: Delicious Meatballs And Gravy
instructions: Chop onion; add garlic to oil in a large pot. Saute until soft (do not burn). Strain tomatoes. Add this to the onions and garlic plus puree salt black pepper water and sugar. Cook this for 1 hour low to medium heat.

title: Cranberry Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheets.

title: Pasta
instructions: For pasta drop penne into kettle of boiling water; return to boil and boil gently for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain; toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Return to pan and keep warm. For sauce saute garlic slowly in 3 tablespoons olive oil in skillet until softened but not browned. Add olives basil red pepper and tomato sauce. Heat. Stir in cheeses and heat stirring until chunks begin to melt. Pour over pasta. Pass additional grated Parmesan cheese to sprinkle over if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cold Avocado And Tomato Soup(Gazpacho)
instructions: Put all ingredients into a serving tureen stir and chill well. To serve spoon into individual soup bowls and top each with a slice of avocado and put an ice cube in each bowl.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Make meat balls. Cook meat balls in the tomato soup 1 can water and 1/3 to 1/2 can Healthy Choice spaghetti sauce. Let simmer for a while then add spaghetti that has already been cooked.

title: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt(Diabetic)
instructions: In a large saucepan soften gelatin in water for 2 minutes. Place over medium heat until gelatin is dissolved. Add evaporated milk 1/2 cup of the fructose and salt to gelatin. Stir over medium heat until well blended approximately 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in yogurt and vanilla. Set aside.

title: Double Delicious Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In a 13 x 9-inch pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with chips; press down firmly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool; cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature. Makes 24 to 36 bars.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Mix together and slice apples to dip.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Break spaghetti in half. Cook in boiling salted water until done; drain. While still warm combine spaghetti with eggs and Parmesan. Pour into a well greased 10-inch pie plate and pat mixture up and around sides with a spoon.

title: Baked Eggs
instructions: Layer in order in a small baking dish. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves one.

title: Orange Delight Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water. Use the pineapple juice and enough cold water to make the 2 cups cold liquid. Add to Jell-O and let set until it starts to congeal. Add pineapple and marshmallows. Fold in whipped cream. Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

title: Teriyaki Steak Strips
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except flank steak).\tMarinate flank steak overnight. Grill.

title: Orange-Kissed Pancakes
instructions: Combine the flour sugar baking soda and salt in a medium bowl.

title: Fix Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water. Drain and mash with the rest of the ingredients except for the melted butter. Spoon into a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well. Add 3/4 cup pecans and mix. Shape into a ring and pat remaining pecans on top. Chill. (Put on platter or on sheet of wax paper.)

title: Collards And Cornbread
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly (2 to 3 times) to remove sand. Take out and discard tough stems. Put ham hocks or ham chunks in pot. Add greens and fill half full with water. Let greens come to a boil then turn fire down and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until seasoned and tender. Add salt according to taste when serving. Lift greens out of water into a flat bowl and cut into bite size pieces with a sharp knife. We like to sprinkle pepper sauce or vinegar on our plates.

title: Cracker Pudding
instructions: Mix together the milk crackers coconut salt and sugar; scald. Pour about a cup of this hot mixture over the egg yolks. Blend egg and hot milk together before returning to hot mixture. Cook until thick; add vanilla. Pour into baking dish and cover with meringue.

title: Fruit Cocktail
instructions: Blend with ice and strain champagne flute. Garnish with strawberry.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: In large skillet heat oil and cook beef and onion until meat is browned. Drain fat off then add bouillon and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to boil then reduce heat. Simmer covered for 1 hour. Add mushrooms with liquid. Combine sour cream and flour; blend into meat mixture. Continue cooking about 5 minutes or until thickened. Cook noodles to package directions. Drain; serve stroganoff over hot cooked noodles.

title: *Sweet And Sour Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in slightly salted water for 15 minutes. Add pepper and cook for 3 minutes more; drain. Drain pineapple and save juice. Add water to juice to make 1/3 cup. Combine sugar cornstarch salt liquid vinegar and soy sauce. Cook and stir until bubbly. Add vegetables and pineapple. Heat through. Serves 6.

title: Chinese Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Cut chicken into 2 x 1/2-inch strips. Toss chicken cornstarch salt and white pepper in glass or plastic bowl. Cover. Refrigerate for 20 minutes.

title: Skillet Cabbage
instructions: Combine ingredients in large skillet. Cover and cook 3 minutes. Stir and cook 3 more minutes. Yields about 6 servings.

title: Ole Settlers Baked Beans
instructions: Brown beef bacon and onion then add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Pour all ingredients into a large baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Paper Cup Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream lemon juice sugar salt pineapple bananas and coloring. Fold in nuts. Spoon into paper muffin cup liners in muffin tins and freeze. When frozen remove from tins. Put in plastic bags or airtight container and return to freezer. Will keep for several months. Take out of freezer for 15 minutes before serving. Peel off liners and serve on lettuce. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: No Bake Orange Coconut Balls
instructions: Melt butter and pour over vanilla wafer crumbs and add remaining ingredients. Roll into balls and then roll in the coconut. Place on cookie sheet to let harden.

title: Pork Chop Cheese Pillows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small saucepan melt butter. Saute onion and garlic clove until soft; set aside. Stab small holes in pork chops and sprinkle lightly with garlic powder and seasoned salt.

title: Navy Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Boil ham bone water bay leaf peppercorns and cloves. Add beans; boil 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Last half hour add the rest of ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Makes 6 cups.

title: Italian Squash Pie(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cook vegetables in microwave or skillet sprayed with vegetable spray until tender. Add cheese to egg substitute. Add seasonings; mix well. Place pie crust in glass pie plate; spread mustard on bottom of crust. Add vegetables. Pour cheese and egg mixture over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Easy Combination In A Pastry Shell
instructions: Make the white sauce by melting butter in a large skillet. Take off the heat and add flour to make a paste. Add milk return to heat and stir constantly until thick and smooth.

title: Amish Raisin Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add milk and 2 slightly beaten egg yolks. Cook until thick. Add salt vanilla oleo and cooled raisins. Pour into baked crust.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Mix egg and Parmesan cheese together. Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix in 1 tablespoon butter then mix into spaghetti with the egg and Parmesan cheese. Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with a little oil.

title: Hawaiian Delight Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients put in pie shell and chill.

title: Meat Loaf With Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan mix tomato sauce with brown sugar vinegar and mustard. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Combine egg onion crackers meat salt pepper and 1/2 cup of the tomato sauce mixture. Mix lightly but thoroughly and shape into loaf. Put into baking dish and pour remainder of tomato sauce over mixture over it. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour basting occasionally. Note This recipe may be cut in half and it works fine.

title: No-Bake Peanut Nuggets
instructions: Heat sugar and milk in saucepan to boiling. Boil for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add saltine crumbs peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well so that peanut butter is melted. Add coconut and peanuts and stir until mixture is stiff. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper to form mounds.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Combine vegetables and chicken in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour liquids over chicken and cover with crust.

title: Crisp Candy Bars
instructions: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In saucepan mix syrup and sugar stirring frequently to boil over medium heat. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter then cereal and press into pan. Melt your chips and spread while hot.

title: Plains, Georgia Cheese Ring
instructions: Mix cheese onion pecans and mayonnaise together. Mold mixture with a spoon or hands into a ring. Fill the center with strawberry preserves. Serve with Ritz crackers. Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Remove shells. Cut eggs in half; remove yolks. Mix yolks with ingredients; beat until smooth adding a little cream if necessary. Sprinkle red pepper for garnish.

title: Olive Nut Spread
instructions: Mix well. May be kept a week or more in refrigerator.

title: Bread Stuffing For Turkey
instructions: Cook onion in 2 tablespoons of butter until soft but not brown. Combine with the bread seasonings and stock.

title: Lemony Torte Squares
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour. Batter will be stiff. Pack in 9 x9-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Zucchini And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in oil. Add zucchini garlic salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes until zucchini is bright green. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Add cheese parsley rice and thyme. Add to zucchini mixture and place in a greased casserole. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup bread crumbs and drizzle with olive oil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients and stir constantly over medium heat in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bring to boil and cook for 5 minutes while stirring. Then add remaining ingredients.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Prepare stuffing mix according to box directions. In a 11 x 13-inch baking dish layer all ingredients in order listed. Top with a little Cheddar cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Mash bananas and add last so that they will not turn dark. Bake at 300 degrees in a muffin tin or loaf pan.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease baking dish. Mix uncooked rice mushroom soup and dry onion soup together. Add water. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. May need to add water.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender according to package directions. Combine eggs soup cheese and mayonnaise. Fold in broccoli. Pour into casserole dish cover with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Monterey Beans And Cheese
instructions: Fry the first 3 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients. Cook slowly stirring until blended about 5 minutes. Sprinkle 1/4 to 1/2 pound Cheddar cheese on top. Put lid on for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve on top of rice or mix with rice. Serve with carrots.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in large casserole dish. Stir in rice water and soup. Add green pepper onion and pimentos all chopped. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes.

title: Dilly Bread
instructions: Drain cottage cheese in sieve. Dissolve yeast in water. Mix all ingredients well and let rise in same bowl until doubled. Work down with spoon and transfer to 2 oiled loaf pans. Let rise again. Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Benedict Spread
instructions: Mash cream cheese with grated cucumber pulp. Add onion salt and enough mayonnaise to make a smooth spread. Add small amount of green food coloring to make filling a very pale green. This is one of my favorites.

title: Chocolate Sheath Cake
instructions: In a large bowl sift flour and sugar together. Mix margarine cocoa and water in a saucepan. Bring to a rapid boil. Pour over flour and sugar mixture and stir until well mixed. Add eggs soda cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well and pour into well-greased 11 x 16-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Berries 'N Bits Trifle
instructions: In large bowl combine Eagle Brand milk and water. Add pudding mix and beat well. Chill for 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 2 cups pudding into 3-quart glass bowl. Top with 1/2 of each of the vanilla wafers berries little chocolate bits and remaining pudding. Repeat layers. Garnish with additional little bits wafers and berries. Chill thoroughly. Refrigerate any leftovers. Serves 8 to 10. An elegant delicious treat.

title: Sweet Relish
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add salt. Let drain on a towel 2 hours. Then add remaining ingredients. Cook until done. Boil. Cook about 15 minutes. Put in jars and cool.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and beat until cheese melts approximately 20 minutes. Serve with your favorite cracker.

title: Plan Ahead Pinto Beans
instructions: Note Sprouting the beans helps to remove some of the gas and also brings in extra nutrients.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
instructions: Melt half of shortening and add cocoa. Set aside. Cream the rest of the shortening sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs then cocoa mixture. Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Chill 30 minutes. Drop by spoonful into powdered sugar and roll. Place on greased cookie sheets and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yield 4 dozen cookies.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to form dough. Roll into bite-size balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 30 balls. Serve hot. Freezes well also.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Mix water and salad dressing. Mix the two together gradually and beat. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. May make 1 layer or a 2-layer cake.

title: 3 Layer Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients until crumbly; put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Mix all these together and cool slightly. Pour in casserole dish with a small bag of miniature marshmallows. Let gel.

title: French Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter with sugar. Stir in chocolate. Add eggs one at a time beating 5 minutes after each addition at high speed. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into a cooled 9-inch pie shell. Chill until firm about 2 hours.

title: Cranberry Cherry Salad
instructions: Drain cherries. Reserve juice. Set cherries aside. Add water to juice to measure 1 cup. Transfer to saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add cherry gelatin; stir until dissolved. Whisk in cranberry sauce until smooth. Add cherries; pour into an 11 x 7 pan. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Hamburger With Baked Beans
instructions: Cut bacon strips in small pieces. Add onion and saute. Brown ground beef with the onion and bacon. Add remaining ingredients and pour into casserole or baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Quick Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place one pie shell in bottom of casserole dish. Layer soups vegetables and chicken. Place second pie shell on top and slit with knife several times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until golden and bubbly.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and top with cherries and crushed nuts. Chill.

title: Millionaire Pie - No Bake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and beat for 5 min. Pour into shell mix next three ingredients and spread over first layer. Chill and serve.

title: Okra Gumbo
instructions: Saute meat and drain on paper towel. Combine all ingredients in large stewpot. Cook until okra turns color.

title: Southern Sweet Tea
instructions: Bring the 2 cups of water to a rolling boil. Drop the tea bags in the water and then the soda. Cook about 1 minute. Cover with lid and remove from heat or just turn the burner off. Let steep (sit) for about 15 minutes. Put sugar in a 2-quart pitcher and pour hot tea in and stir to dissolve. Add enough cold water to fill the pitcher. Add the lemon juice and serve over ice.

title: Shrimp-Corn Chowder Soup
instructions: Cook onions with butter until tender. Add rest of the ingredients and heat to boiling. Put pat of butter or oleo in each bowl and fill with chowder. Sprinkle with parsley and paprika.

title: Chicken Pilaf
instructions: Mix rice soup mix soup water and wine in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Let stand 10 minutes. Put chicken parts on top. Brush with butter. Sprinkle with salt pepper and paprika. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour until chicken is done.

title: Sprite Sherbet Punch
instructions: In a punch bowl add 2 1/2 qts. of softened sherbet. Add Sprite gently DO NOT STIR. Add remaining 1/2 qt. sherbet by scoopfulls and float on punch. Serves approx. 30 people.

title: Apricot Almond Brie
instructions: Remove top rind from cheese; place cheese on serving plate. In a small saucepan combine preserves and liqueur. Heat until mixture is hot but not boiling. Pour some of the sauce over cheese (save remainder for adding later if desired). Sprinkle almonds over top. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Tomato
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Bake covered 15 minutes in oven preheated to 425\u00b0; drain. Combine tomatoes cornstarch oregano and pepper sauce. Cook stirring constantly until sauce is thickened. Pour heated sauce over chicken; top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes uncovered. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Briar Patch Bake
instructions: Brown meat; stir in barbecue sauce and onion. Heat. Prepare macaroni dinner as directed on the package except use 1/2 cup milk. Layer half the dinner in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Cover with meat mixture. Top with remaining dinner. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger meat and onions until done in skillet. Cook macaroni and mix with hamburger. Put in a large casserole dish. Add diced up cheese (about 4 slices). Add pimientos and tomato soup. Cover with more cheese slices and crumbled up bread on top of casserole. Bake until cheese melts and bread is brown.

title: Homemade Muenster Cheese
instructions: Dont let new small potatoes go to waste. Scrape them or if you want to do a basketful or more fill your washing machine with cold water and let it run to clean them. Pack them in jars; add water and 1 teaspoon salt to each quart. Cold pack 3 hours.

title: Rigatoni And Cheese Sauce
instructions: Prepare rigatoni according to package directions. Melt margarine. Add flour and cook stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Do not brown. Stir in milk salt pepper and cheese. Cook until smooth and thickened. Pour sauce over hot rigatoni and mix gently. Sprinkle peas on top and place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Green Chili Fritters
instructions: Mix salt masa and flour into bowl. Add beaten egg milk and shortening. Drop chili into batter then drop chili in hot oil.

title: Best-Ever Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir together. Bake in greased 8 x 8-inch dish in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Deluxe
instructions: After topping\thas been added bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Potatoes\tmay be prepared several days ahead and refrigerated. Topping should not be added until you are ready to bake them.

title: Pistachio Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all together and chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Egg Pudding
instructions: Put cubed bread on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt margarine and cheese in double boiler. Pour over bread. Beat eggs with fork and add milk and mix. Pour over mixture. Place in refrigerator overnight. Bake one hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Quick Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage in bowl. Add pinch of celery seed or more if desired. Add cole slaw dressing and stir. Chill and serve or serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream Yeast Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in water; let stand while combining sour cream sugar and baking soda in large bowl. Add 2 cups biscuit mix then yeast mixture. Mix well. Stir in 3 more cups biscuit mix. Turn dough onto board dusted with 1/2 cup biscuit mix; knead to form smooth ball. Shape dough into small rounds the size of a walnut. Place close together in buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Let rise until doubled in bulk. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake rolls 15 minutes or until done. Makes 72 bite size rolls.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Cut cabbage onions and green pepper very thin and sprinkle with salt. Bring to boil oil vinegar and sugar. Let cool. Pour over vegetables. (Better if made one day in advance.)

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven at 200\u00b0. Grease and flour tube cake pan. Mix ingredients and pour into pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cocoa Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring margarine sugar cocoa and milk to a boil for about 3 minutes. Add peanut butter and oats. Then drop on waxed paper and allow to cool.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Wash and break beans into bite size pieces. Wash new potatoes. Cook in a large pot on top of stove until tender. Season to taste.

title: Zucchini-Carrot Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pans (three 5 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 3-inch if double). In large bowl beat eggs with oil. Stir in sugar zucchini carrots and vanilla. Mix flour baking soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. Blend into egg and oil etc. and add raisins. Bake 1 hour or until tested with toothpick. Remove from pan and cool.

title: Butterscotch Balls
instructions: Soften butter (dont melt). Mix powdered sugar peanut butter graham crackers vanilla coconut and butter in large bowl. Roll into 1-inch balls.

title: English Trifle
instructions: Bake cake in oblong pan according to directions on box. This only uses half the cake (you can find someone baking on the same day and share). Break 1/4 of the cake into large pieces and place in a 2-quart serving bowl. Pour half the thawed strawberries over the cake. Spread with half of prepared pudding. Repeat layers. Chill at least 8 hours. Right before serving spread whipped topping on top and sprinkle with almonds. Spoon into dessert dishes to serve.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pour into a graham cracker pie crust and top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Shrimp And Green Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Line a casserole with noodles and make into a nest. In a large frying pan saute the shrimp in 1/2 cup clarified butter until pink and tender about 5 minutes. Cover noodles with shrimp. Combine soup sour cream mayonnaise and chives; add mustard and sherry. Pour sauce over shrimp and sprinkle Cheddar cheese over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until cheese has melted and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients until smooth. Pour into 2 graham cracker pie shells. Freeze until firm. Serve immediately.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Fry onions and garlic in oil until soft 5 to 10 minutes. Add hamburger and cook until brown. Mix in salt pepper rosemary and tomato paste. Gradually add hot water and simmer 30 minutes uncovered. In bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan put a thin layer of sauce then a layer of cooked noodles layer of cottage cheese layer of Mozzarella cheese then repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool 15 minutes before serving.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Blend Crisco with salt and sugars. Add eggs one at a time mixing thoroughly. Add flour baking soda and nuts to mixture. Shape into roll about 2 1/2 inches in diameter or 2 smaller rolls. Roll in wax paper and chill in refrigerator. When ready to bake slice thinly and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or when delicately brown.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender and cool. Mix remaining ingredients into carrots. Place in refrigerator and let set 12 hours or more. Yields 1/2 gallon or enough for 25 people.

title: Quaker Choc Oat-Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add combined flour baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in oats chocolate morsels and nuts; mix well. Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet; remove to wire rack. Cool completely. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Cook Jell-O pudding and water until thick and clear. Chill. Add whipped Dream Whip and oranges.

title: Baby Ruth Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Cream together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg. Stir in Baby Ruth pieces and dry ingredients. Add vanilla and blend well. Chill dough for 30 minutes. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until done. Remove from baking sheet onto wire racks to cool. To enhance flavoring add caramel flavoring.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all together and shape into loaf pan. Decorate top with pecans and cherries if wanted. Can use marshmallows.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add yeast mixture. Add to dry ingredients. Dough should be soft and pliable; work 5 minutes. Roll out; cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. May refrigerate dough overnight.

title: Land And Sea Linguini
instructions: Place water on stove for linguini; follow directions on package to cook the pasta. Place all ingredients except mussels into large pot and simmer for 1/2 hour. While the sausage and sauce are cooking clean mussels according to package directions. Add to sauce and cook for another 15 to 20 minutes until mussel shells open. Serve over linguini. Serves about 8.

title: Erin'S Orange Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with cottage cheese until well blended. Add fruit; be sure oranges and pineapple are drained well. Mix well and fold in Cool Whip. Makes a great low-cal cool salad.

title: Louisiana Pie
instructions: Pour pie filling in buttered deep-dish pie pan. Pour dry cake mix over pie filling. Slice butter evenly over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown (approximately 30 minutes). Stir mixture 1 time while baking. Good served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Glazed Onion Rings
instructions: Peel onions and cut into even thin slices. Heat margarine in large skillet. Add onions; toss until coated with margarine. Do not brown. Add vinegar brown sugar and curry powder. Blend well. Add parsley. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until glazed. Season with salt pepper and curry powder. Serve hot as a side dish or cook as an appetizer. Can be used in greens or potato salad.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bonbons
instructions: In large bowl combine vanilla frosting peanut butter and margarine until well blended. Stir in crumbs; mix well. Form into 1-inch balls. Chill 1 hour.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Beat first 6 ingredients together using only 1 package of pudding for 4 minutes at high speed. Place in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Beat together 1 package of pudding and 1 cup milk. Beat heavy cream until peaks form. Mix with pudding mixture. Use this to ice cake when cake is cool. Store cake in refrigerator.

title: Day-Ahead Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce in pieces. Cook and drain peas. Layer vegetables in a large salad bowl. Spread a layer of mayonnaise sealing the lettuce. Make a second layer of vegetables. Seal with mayonnaise. Top with Parmesan cheese and then black olives. Cover tightly with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight. Toss before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Combine whole wheat flour and yeast. Heat buttermilk molasses honey salt and butter until warm. Add oats whole wheat flour yeast mixture and eggs. Bake at low speed for 3 minutes at medium.

title: Dried Beef Snax
instructions: Spread cream cheese on slice of dried beef. Put slice of pickle on top and roll up. Chill then slice into bite size pieces.

title: Cheese Log
instructions: Note About 1 cup to 1 1/2 cups chopped pecans for outside coating.

title: Ada'S Carrot-Pineapple Jello Salad
instructions: Dilute lemon jello in boiling water. Add cold water and pineapple juice. Let cool. Add the crushed pineapple and 1 cup shredded carrots. Chill until set.

title: Stew
instructions: Fry bacon in a large stew pot. Remove bacon. Add stew meat and sear. Lower heat and add tomatoes beef broth water celery onion garlic Worcestershire sauce and chili powder. Cover and simmer 2 hours. Remove 1/4 cup broth from stew. Cool and mix with flour. Add flour mixture to stew. Season. Add carrots and potatoes and cook 30 minutes. Add corn and bacon. Cook another 5 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Put beans in a baking dish and add onions mustard brown sugar and bacon. Stir to mix. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 1 hour until bubbly and set.

title: Electric 4-Alarm Chili
instructions: In large heavy pot brown beef with onions green pepper and garlic. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients except kidney beans. Simmer uncovered at least 45 minutes stirring occasionally. When thickened stir in drained beans. Heat through and serve.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into large pieces. Combine all ingredients except butter; shake in a large bag. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put potatoes in one layer. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn once during baking.

title: Tammy'S Chicken Fingers
instructions: Beat the eggs in a large bowl and add enough buttermilk to cover the chicken strips. Stir. Coat chicken strips and refrigerate overnight. Remove chicken strips from mixture and shake off excess. Dip in a mixture of flour salt pepper and the seasoned salt. Deep fry until chicken strips are golden brown and drain on a paper towel.

title: Scrambled Tots
instructions: In a large frypan put layer of Tater Tots to cover skillet. Cook Tater Tots until just about done. Mash Tater Tots flat with a spatula. Break open about 4 or 5 eggs over the top of Tater Tots. Mix eggs in with Tater Tots. Season to taste.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased and floured tube pan or make three 9-inch layers. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar water cornstarch and light corn syrup until thickened. After cooking immediately add jello and food coloring. Place fresh strawberries in a baked 9-inch pie shell. Pour the cooled glaze on top of strawberries. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Cheesy O'S
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Melt butter in baking pan. Stir in Parmesan cheese. Add cereal; mix well. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Minestrone
instructions: Put all ingredients into pot except cabbage zucchini and beans. Let cook 1 hour; add rest of ingredients. Let simmer another 1 1/2 hours. Serve with garlic bread and salad.

title: Inside-Out Ravioli
instructions: Brown first 3 ingredients in large skillet. Cook spinach using package directions. Drain reserving liquid. Add water to make one cup. Add spinach liquid and next 5 ingredients to meat mixture; simmer 10 minutes.

title: Milk Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Melt butter over low heat and remove from stove. Add 2 cups sugar. Beat well. Mix in eggs and vanilla; blend well. Sift together flour cocoa and salt. Add to sugar mixture. Mix well. Stir in coconut. Spread into greased 9 x 13 baking pan.

title: Baked Rice Dressing
instructions: Mix all in large bowl. Bake in covered 9 x 13-inch bowl at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put in a 9 x 13-inch cake just as listed. Sprinkle cake mix over the whole top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Cook onions in melted margarine until limp. Add thawed broccoli salt pepper and savory. Cook 5 minutes over low heat. Put spaghetti into greased 3-quart casserole. Cover with a layer of cheese slices. Pour in milk. Add a layer of broccoli then cover with cheese slices. Bake 30 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar well. Add eggs and beat. Sift dry ingredients together. Add this a little at a time while beating the egg mixture. Add bananas and nuts. Bake in greased slightly floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean. Makes one loaf.

title: *No Crust Coconut Pie*
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Add vanilla then add milk and coconut. Grease two 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni Cheese Salad With Dill Weed
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Turn while still hot into a bowl that contains butter and Parmesan cheese; toss to coat. Add celery cheese salad cubes mayonnaise to moisten salt pepper seasoned salt and mustard; mix well and chill. Turn out on salad greens and if desired 2 cups of slivered ham or 1/4 cup of real bacon crumbs may be added to recipe. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Squash Balls
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and form into small balls. Roll in cornflakes. Drop in hot grease and fry.

title: Hamburger Quiche(Serves 4)
instructions: Brown ground chuck; add green pepper and onion. Cook until tender; drain off fat. Mix mayonnaise milk eggs and cornstarch until smooth. Add beef cheese and salt. Stir until well blended. Pour into uncooked pastry shell and bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Its ready when knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Easy Cheese Cake
instructions: Whip the cream cheese. Stir in sour cream then add sugar and vanilla; blend well. Put in graham cracker crust. Bake for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Put granulated sugar and cinnamon in bag. Shake biscuits (quartered) in bag. Layer biscuits in tube pan. Pour extra sugar/cinnamon mixture over biscuits in pan. In a saucepan mix brown sugar and butter for 1 minute. Pour mixture over biscuits as you layer them in tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. To serve dump out of pan onto plate.

title: Pizzarino Green Beans
instructions: Combine drained beans with remaining ingredients. Heat thoroughly stirring gently.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients; let stand a while preparing other ingredients. Add the flour soda salt cinnamon dates and nuts; mix. Add the oil and vanilla; mix well. Cook in tube pan or loaf pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry Relish
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. May be refrigerated covered for 1 month. Makes 5 cups.

title: Berniece Thurn'S Pancake
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside. Mix together yolks and the rest of ingredients; fold in egg whites. Cook on hot griddle or heavy frying pan until bubbly on top; turn once. Cook until golden brown. Serve with hot syrup and butter.

title: Meatball Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients; form into small meatballs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes uncovered in baking dish. Add tomatoes and peas. Return to oven for 15 to 20 minutes with cover on. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Noodles Warsaw
instructions: Chop cabbage into pieces. Brown sausage season with chili powder. Drain sausage. Bring water to a boil and cook noodles for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tootie Fruitie Salad
instructions: In large mixing bowl place peaches pineapple and fruit cocktail if used with all juices; slice strawberries and add to other fruit then add pudding mixes. Do not prepare pudding just dump in bowl with fruit and mix. Add bananas sliced or chunk-sizes. Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: June'S Kidney Beans(Abington Grange Supper)
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Place salt pork in the bottom of a bean pot drain the beans and to pot with all other ingredients. Cover with hot water and bake at 325\u00b0 for 5 or 6 hours. Add more water as needed and reduce temperature to 300\u00b0 for last hour. Add more molasses if desired. Fork test done when beans are tender but not mushy. Serves 10 hungry people.

title: Melanie'S Simple Sorbet
instructions: Freeze unopened can of fruit for at least 12 hours (longer is even better). Dip frozen can in hot water a few seconds to loosen edges and make it easier to get out the contents. Cut the frozen fruit up into chunks and put into food processor. Add lemon juice liqueur and cranberries. Pulse on/off for about 30 seconds. Serve immediately or can be scooped into small balls and stored in freezer until ready to serve. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes (or longer if needed).

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage into large chucks. Put in casserole. Brown ground chuck and onion; drain. Add tomato soup (not diluted). Put over cabbage. Cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Stir in 1/2 hour.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together beans brown sugar barbecue sauce and bacon. Saute onion and pepper; add to other mixture. Put in baking dish; bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Mix all together refrigerate overnight drain and serve.

title: Holiday Eggnog
instructions: Beat eggs and add all ingredients cooking constantly. Chill! Fold in egg whites and cream; fold in brandy and rum. Chill then add vanilla.

title: Honey Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Add vanilla and honey. Bake on greased cookie sheets at 350\u00b0.

title: French Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all the ingredients in mixing bowl. Mix on low for 15 minutes.

title: White Enchiladas
instructions: Crush Doritos. Mix together soup sour cream chilies onion and chicken. In a 3-quart casserole layer Doritos soup mixture and cheese in that order. Make 2 layers. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Lazy Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat in a large saucepan and drain. Add next 4 ingredients. Bring to boil and simmer for 10 minutes. In a small bowl mix Ricotta cheese or cottage cheese egg and Parmesan cheese. Put a little of the meat sauce in bottom of 13 x 9 baking dish and alternate layers as follows noodles 1/3 meat sauce half of cheese mixture. Repeat and then top with remaining meat sauce. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until noodles are tender. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Nanaimo Bars
instructions: Prepare 9 x 13-inch pan with vegetable spray. Cook margarine sugar chocolate and vanilla in top of double boiler over simmering water until blended. Add egg; stir slowly. Cook 5 minutes; stir constantly. Add vanilla cracker crumbs and pecans. Press into prepared pan. Chill 15 minutes. Cream margarine and Neufchatel cheese until fluffy. Add vanilla. Gradually add powdered sugar; beat until smooth. Add color; pour over cracker mixture. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Melt butter and chocolate chips in top of double boiler. Spread over cream filling. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares (36).

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix well pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix soup and broth and pour over chicken. Place sliced boiled eggs over soup mixture. Mix flour margarine and milk. Pour over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until golden brown.

title: Spudnuts
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water. Mix potatoes and milk. Add flour salt shortening and sugar. Add 3 more cups flour and knead. If needed add 1 more cup flour. Let dough double itself then roll out and cut with regular doughnut cutter. Let rise until twice their regular size. Cook in deep oil at 390\u00b0. Makes 4 dozen plus holes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower
instructions: Cook according to directions; drain.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly except only add 1/2 cup of tomato ketchup at this time. Mix with hands. Pack firmly into ungreased baking dish. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. At the last 15 minutes of baking time take the meat loaf out and brush the other 1/2 cup of tomato ketchup over the top. Put back in oven for rest of baking time. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Bake covered for 15 minutes in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven. Drain broth. Combine tomatoes cornstarch basil or oregano and optional pepper sauce. Cook stirring constantly until sauce thickens. Pour heated sauce over chicken. Top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes uncovered.

title: Momma'S Chili
instructions: Cook in at least a 4-quart Dutch oven. Brown the ground chuck and chopped onion until the meat is thoroughly cooked. Add the salt and pepper for seasoning. Then add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil over low heat for 30 to 35 minutes. Stir often to avoid burning. No lid is necessary. Serve hot. Serves 4.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Shape into 1-teaspoon size balls. Put on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 dozen.

title: Strawberry-Banana Whip
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Chill or serve immediately.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Melt Crisco in small pan; blend in flour. Add milk. Cook and stir until very thick and smooth. Remove from heat. Pour into bowl and add onion lemon juice and seasonings. Stir in salmon. Shape into balls. Roll in bread crumbs. Combine egg with water. Dip balls in mixture. Roll in bread crumbs. Deep fry until browned about 3 minutes. Serve plain or with cream gravy with peas.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ground beef lightly with bread crumbs egg milk onion salt and pepper in a bowl. Pack mixture lightly in a 2-quart loaf dish. Cover with waxed paper. Cook in microwave 5 minutes at Medium-high. Top with catsup. Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Cook covered 15 minutes on High or until done. Remove from microwave. Cover with aluminum foil and let stand 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Ham And Cheese Quiche
instructions: Mix sour cream milk Bisquick eggs pepper and salt together; stir in ham cheese and chilies. Pour into deep pie plate. Cook until inserted knife comes out clean at 400\u00b0 (40 minutes). Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in remaining ingredients; beat vigorously 20 strokes. Let rest about 5 minutes.

title: Southern Okra
instructions: Cook okra in boiling salted water 10 minutes; drain. Brown onion and green pepper in salad oil. Add tomatoes and cook slowly for 5 minutes. Add okra and remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until vegetables are just tender stirring as little as possible. One cup canned tomatoes may be used in place of fresh tomatoes. Serves 4.

title: Simple Super Fudge
instructions: Use a double boiler; heat chocolate chips until melted. Add can of condensed milk and vanilla. (Also peanut butter if desired.) Add nuts. Pour into a lightly buttered 8-inch or 9-inch square pan. Cool for 1 or more hours and then cut into squares.

title: Wet Chicken
instructions: Wash and cut chicken. Lightly salt and pepper then place in flour. Place shortening into frypan on medium heat. Brown chicken and then place into a large pot with a lid. After all chicken has been browned pour remaining drippings over chicken and cover chicken with water. Bring to a boil and then simmer 1 hour. Remove chicken. It should have made its own gravy. Pour over rice or potatoes.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Wash and drain celery. Cut into pieces three inches long. Fray ends\tif you want the celery to curl. Chill in cold water overnight. Mix and blend sour cream mayonnaise and pecans. Drain the crisp celery sticks and fill with this mixture.

title: Dirty Rice
