instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Cut up celery onion and bell pepper; add to sausage. Pour in chicken broth. Add uncooked rice. Mix well. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. When cooked fluff with fork.

title: Lime-Sweet Pickles
instructions: Soak cucumbers in lime water for 24 hours. Rinse in clear water several times. Soak in clean water for 3 hours. Drain. Mix the cloves vinegar celery seed salt and mixed spices; pour over pickles. Let stand overnight. Heat to boiling and put into jars.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash and hull berries; set aside. Mix sugar cornstarch and Jell-O. Add water and syrup. Cook over medium until thickened. Mixture wont be real thick. Cool. When cool pour over berries and toss lightly. Pour into baked 9-inch pie shell. Refrigerate until set about 3 or 4 hours. Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Serves 6.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Slowly add scalded milk and stir until well blended. Pour into unbaked deep 9-inch pie shell. Bake 50 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Forget-Me-Not Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs until foamy and white. Add salt. Continue to beat gradually adding sugar until a stiff peak forms. Fold in morsels and pecans. Place on ungreased cookie sheet by the spoonful. Place in oven and turn oven off. Do not open door until the next morning. Yields 40 to 60 cookies.

title: Salmonettes Heloise
instructions: Pour salmon juice into measuring cup and set aside. Put salmon in mixing bowl and 1 egg. Break up salmon and mix the egg real good. Fork in 1/2 cup flour. Mixture is thick. Add a little pepper 1/4 salmon juice and add 1 teaspoon baking powder. Beat with a fork. It must foam. Pour into salmon mixture. Mix with fork. Scoop with small spoons into hot oil. Makes brown tidbits. Stick with toothpick and serve with dip or put a hot sauce over them.

title: German Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables in one and one-half quarts of water until tender. Add other ingredients and cook until cheese is melted.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla in saucepan and cook until it thickens. Add vanilla. This will get thicker as it cools.

title: Double Quick Rolls(Makes 1 Dozen Rolls)
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt and yeast in a large bowl. Add water shortening and egg. Beat until smooth. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk about 30 minutes. Stir down batter by beating about 25 strokes. Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins. Let rise until batter rounds over tops of cups about 20 to 30 minutes. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake until golden brown (15 to 20 minutes).

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes gradually adding the sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Mix together dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture. Spread onto jelly roll pan; bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Unroll onto toweling sprinkled with powdered sugar; spread filling mixture thick over roll. Roll up and allow to cool; slice.

title: Basic Turkey Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients; place in lightly greased 4 1/2 x 8 1/2 x 2 5/8-inch loaf pan or shape in loaf form and place into 1-quart greased baking dish. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes or until meat is no longer pink in center of loaf. Unmold on platter; top with sliced tomatoes and garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Bisquick Butter Biscuits
instructions: Cut cold butter into 1/4-inch pieces. Toss baking mix and butter with fork until coated. Add milk; stir just until milk is absorbed (do not overstir).

title: Microwave Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if skin is tough or just rinse and pat dry. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Place potatoes in microwave dish. Sprinkle with melted butter and herbs. Microwave on High for 10 minutes; rearrange after 5 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese and Parmesan cheese. Microwave for 4 to 6 minutes until potatoes are soft and cheese melted. Sprinkle with salt.

title: Chocolate Coconut Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat chocolate in 2-quart saucepan over low heat; stir frequently until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in coconut walnuts and milk.

title: Stir-Fried Pork With Garlic
instructions: In a bowl combine pork sherry soy sauce vinegar cornstarch ginger sugar and chili paste. Toss to mix. Marinate 30 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple(Side Dish For Ham)
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be served with ham.

title: Ribbon Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve 1 package jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add 4 tablespoons cold water. Set aside 1/2 cup of mixture. Put in 1/3 cup sour cream. Pour remaining in a 9 x 12-inch glass pan. Set until firm at least 1/2 hour. Pour on sour cream mixture; set 1/2 hour.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs and bananas. Sift flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add to mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Put in bottom of an 11 x 14-inch baking dish. Cook celery and onion; drain peas. Spread celery onion and peas over meat. Spread undiluted mushroom soup over all. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 3/4 to 1 hour.

title: Mandarin Pork Chops With Wild Rice
instructions: In large skillet heat 1 tablespoon oil and brown chops. Add water long grain and wild rice with sauce (original recipe) reserved syrup and green onions. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer stirring occasionally 13 minutes or until pork is done. Stir in oranges; heat through.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Cut Twinkies in half. Fill 9 x 12-inch pan. Top with pineapple and bananas and the prepared pudding mix. Last top with Cool Whip. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

title: Red Beans
instructions: Add all ingredients together with enough water to cook until tender and of desired consistency.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Prepare popcorn and add peanuts if desired or any kind of nuts you want. Cook sugar butter salt and Karo for 5 minutes. Take from stove and add baking soda. It will foam then add vanilla. Pour over popcorn and mix well. Spread out onto 2 cookie sheets and bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour. Stir after 15 minutes. Pour onto wax paper and spread apart. Cool and then it can be stored in plastic bags or an airtight container. It will last a while. Yield 8 quarts.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
instructions: Put all in mixer with cake mix and follow directions on box of cake mix.

title: Rice Krispies Raisin Cookies
instructions: Combine flour salt baking powder and soda; set aside. In mixer bowl thoroughly combine sugar brown sugar and margarine. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Add Rice Krispies and raisins mixing until it combines. Drop cookies on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 16 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Tex Mex Dip
instructions: Layer on platter in this order Spread bean dip on a large shallow serving platter. Peel pit and mash avocados. Add lemon juice salt and pepper. Mix well. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning; mix in separate bowl. Layer avocado mixture over bean dip then layer taco seasoning mixture over avocado layer. Top with green onions tomatoes and sliced black olives then sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top of dip mixture. Serve with large round tortilla chips.

title: Strombolis
instructions: Brown meat pepper and onion in 2 tablespoons oil with garlic. Add tomatoes. Drain all liquid so mixture is very dry. Flatten out crescent rolls into 1 sheet mush seams together so there are no holes. Place meat and vegetable mixture on one half and bring other side over. Press edges together. Cook 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 until crust is golden brown. Serves 2 adults and 1 to 2 children. Repeat recipe to make more Strombolis as needed.

title: Sauerkraut And Spareribs
instructions: Rinse kraut and put in roaster. Top kraut with onion slices and sprinkle with brown sugar. Add water so it is almost to the top of the kraut in the pan. Brown ribs in skillet and lay on top of kraut. Mix in a large measuring cup ketchup and Worcestershire sauce and then fill the cup with water so the mixture measures a total of 1 cup. Mix and pour over ribs and kraut. Put in oven for 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Beat egg in large bowl until thickened. Add marmalade and butter until well blended. Sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Combine buttermilk and lemon juice. Alternately add dry and liquid ingredients in thirds to egg mixture stirring until well mixed. Fold in walnuts. Pour batter into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Invert onto wire rack.

title: Cherry Crumb Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Mix with sugar. Cut in butter; add beaten egg and mix to make crumbs. Place 1/2 of crumbs in bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Distribute cherries evenly and top with remaining crumbs. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Serve with ice cream or other topping. Sprinkle crumbs lightly with cinnamon.

title: Garlic Buttered Green Beans
instructions: Cook green beans in water covered until tender. Meanwhile in a skillet saute mushrooms in butter until tender. Add onion powder and garlic powder. Drain beans. Add to skillet and toss. Season with salt and pepper. Yield 6 servings.

title: Mother'S Golden Potato Casserole
instructions: Grate potatoes coarsely. Add other ingredients except last 2 mix thoroughly. Press into casserole dish. Top with mixture of bread crumbs and butter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese And Apple Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Combine all other ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix well. Fold in egg whites. Heat oil or melt butter in a skillet. When it is hot enough to sizzle a drop of batter on contact add spoonfuls of batter. Fry on both sides until firm and lightly browned. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together first 7 ingredients all into a large mixing bowl. Add next 4 ingredients. Beat together until smooth. Add last 2 ingredients.

title: Easy Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with onion and bell pepper. Drain grease. Add spaghetti and tomatoes. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Drain juice off strawberries and pineapple; add enough water to make 3 1/2 cups juice. Heat liquid and pour over Jell-O to dissolve. Stir well and jell slightly. Mash bananas and add strawberries pineapple and pecans. Fold into Jell-O mixture and pour half of mixture into mold. Spread on sour cream. Add remaining half of mixture and chill.

title: Cherry Salad Supreme
instructions: Dissolve raspberry Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in pie filling. Turn into 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Chill until partially set. Dissolve lemon Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Beat together cream cheese and mayonnaise. Gradually add lemon Jell-O. Stir in undrained pineapple and whip 1/2 cup whipping cream. Fold into lemon mixture with one cup of tiny marshmallows. Spread on top of cherry layer. Top with nuts. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chicken Pineapple Salad
instructions: Remove giblets and neck from chicken then rinse chicken well under cold water. Place chicken breast side down in an 8-quart kettle. Add carrots cut up celery onion 1 teaspoon salt the bay leaf and 1 quart of water. Bring to boiling over high heat. Reduce heat; simmer covered for about 2 hours or until chicken is tender. Let stand uncovered and frequently spoon broth over chicken for 1 hour or until cool enough to handle. Remove meat from bones in as large of pieces as you can. Pull skin from chicken. Cut chicken into 1/2 to 1-inch chunks. Chill.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan and spread frozen potatoes in pan. Saute onion (chopped) in 1/4 cup margarine. Mix together onion creamed soup sour cream and shredded Cheddar cheese. Pour over potatoes. Mix together corn flake crumbs and 1/4 cup melted butter. Pour on top of casserole. Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Cross Buns(A Family Tradition On Good Friday)
instructions: Combine sugar salt yeast and flour in large bowl. In 1-quart saucepan over low heat heat milk and butter until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). With mixer at low speed beat liquid into dry ingredients until blended. Increase speed to medium; beat 2 minutes. Beat in egg and 1 cup flour to make a thick batter; continue beating 2 minutes scraping bowl often. Stir in raisins and flour to make a soft dough.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Put tomatoes onions bell peppers and jalapeno peppers through food grinder. Add seasonings and vinegar. Bring to a boil. Simmer about 1 hour stirring often. Pour in pint jars and seal in hot water bath.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat egg; add sugar and salt. Mix baking powder in the flour. Mix soda in buttermilk. Then pour into egg and sugar. Add butter and stir until mixed well. Add all to flour. Mix well; add flour until stiff dough. Roll real thin and sprinkle with sugar. Cut and cook in moderate oven until brown through. Makes 150 cookies.

title: Seafoam Salad
instructions: Make jello with 1 cup of water; let cool. Cream the cream cheese and add jello. Add pineapple and nuts. Fold in whipped cream. Refrigerate. (I use a ring mold.) Serves 10 to 12.

title: White Greek Cookies
instructions: Cream butter well then add sugar gradually. Add egg yolks and vanilla continuing to mix. Fold in almonds and whiskey. Add flour and baking powder and mix by hand until dough is formed. Then make small shaped cookies (round balls flat half moons). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes (almost light gold) on ungreased cookie sheet. Cool cookies before sifting confectioners sugar on top and bottom.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Cut Spam and cheese in pieces. Use food grinder with small attachments. Grind all and add enough Miracle Whip to moisten well. Let set in refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift flour in a large bowl. Make hole in center of flour and put in all ingredients in the hole. Work up as you would for biscuits. When all is mixed together roll out on floured paper and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
instructions: Follow directions on cake package mix. In a separate bowl mix remainder of ingredients. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Pour cake mix into pan. Pour Ricotta mixture over the batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or 325\u00b0 if oven is too hot. Let cool completely before cutting.

title: Cherry Tomato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain and crumble. Combine bacon with tomatoes cucumber and onions. Sprinkle with garlic salt sweet basil and pepper. Mix well and chill. Combine vinegar and salad oil; shake well. Just before serving pour over salad and toss. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Seedless Raisin Tarts
instructions: Beat all ingredients together and fill unbaked tart shells. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Makes about 15. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt butter and sugar; add eggs and flavoring. Sift flour cinnamon and nutmeg and add a little at a time. Beat well; add nuts and fruit. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 275\u00b0. Take out of oven. Put cherries pineapple and pecans on top. Cook 1/2 hour longer.

title: Orange Blossom Cream
instructions: Dissolve sugar in orange juice. Whip evaporated milk until stiff. Combine with juice; mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Independent Dream Cake
instructions: Gradually add orange juice to confectioners sugar blending well. Makes 1/3 cup.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a greased casserole dish. Top with Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Peanut Logs
instructions: Mix well peanut butter Rice Krispies oleo and sugar. Melt chocolate chips and wax. Roll by teaspoon size in hands. Keep your fingers wet and then dip the logs in chocolate mixture. Put on wax paper.

title: Bread-N-Butter Pudding
instructions: Butter glass baking dish. Cut buttered bread into triangles; mix fruit with sugar. Arrange buttered bread fruit and sugar in layers in the dish. Beat the eggs with the milk then pour egg and milk mixture over the bread-butter-fruit and allow this to soak in for 15 to 20 minutes. Then bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until custard is set and top is lightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter Bar Cookies
instructions: Melt together corn syrup and white sugar. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until smooth. Add 7 cups cereal (corn flakes Rice Krispies Cheerios etc.). Mix well. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Pecan Dainties
instructions: Mix butter brown sugar and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar. Blend in flour and vanilla. Stir in nuts. Using about 1 teaspoon of dough shape into crescents or balls. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Cool. Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Mexican White Corn
instructions: Melt the margarine and cream cheese over low heat. Leave all liquid on chilies for spicier flavor. Mix altogether. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrots A L'Orange
instructions: Mix cornstarch and sugar in small saucepan. Pour in orange juice and mix well. Heat stirring until thickened. Stir in butter and ginger. Pour over cooked carrots.

title: Tomatoes With Mozzarella
instructions: Layer slices of tomatoes and Mozzarella. Sprinkle with chopped fresh basil salt and freshly ground pepper. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.

title: Eggplant Supreme
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Fry eggplant and drain on paper towels. Cook spinach according to directions and drain. Mix Ricotta cheese and spincah dont beat just blend. Spread evenly in pan. Layer eggplant on top. Either slice or grate Mozzarella cheese and layer over eggplant. Cover with sauce. Sprinkle grated cheese. Give it a blessing and throw it in preheated oven for 45 minutes until bubbly. Enjoy!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and bake in buttered casserole. Crumble Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mandarin And Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain juice and add to water to make 3 cups; boil. Add Jell-O fruit and cinnamon. Let set serves 8.

title: Pistachio Torte
instructions: Mix nuts sugar flour and butter; press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Peel and cut tomatoes in 8 pieces. Put onions and peppers through grinder. Put all ingredients in large pot and cook until thick. Makes about 8 pints.

title: Cherries In Snow
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Mix in powdered sugar vanilla and milk. Gently fold in Cool Whip. In glass bowl put some of the cake cubes. Drizzle some of the Cool Whip mixture over cake. Spoon pie filling over that. Add another layer of cake Cool Whip and cherries. Keep making layers until all ingredients are used up ending with cherries on top. Store in refrigerator or make ahead of time and freeze. This makes a lot!

title: Layered Spinach Salad
instructions: Cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with cold water. In large clear glass bowl with straight sides or 13 x 9-inch baking dish layer cabbage spinach tortellini tomatoes and green onions. Pour dressing evenly over top; sprinkle with bacon. Cover; refrigerate until serving time. Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water (do not overcook); drain in colander. Pour warm pasta in bowl and pour Wish-Bone dressing over. Stir. Cool at room temperature. Meanwhile dice green peppers and thinly slice onions. Cube the cheese into 1/4-inch cubes. Add all to pasta except cheese and parsley. They can be added just before serving. Serve on a lettuce leaf.

title: Lou'S Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in dish. Cover with potato chips crushed or uncrushed. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Great for after the holiday meals.

title: Mediterranean Vegetable Pie(Yields 8 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Place eggplant between several thicknesses of paper towels. Sprinkle with a teaspoon of salt; weigh down with breadboard or several recipe books and let stand 30 minutes. Cut into 1/4-inch cubes. Heat 1/2 cup olive oil in a large Teflon skillet; add the eggplant and quickly toss to coat with oil. Cook stirring constantly until eggplant is tender about 5 minutes. Remove to a large bowl. Pour remaining olive oil in the skillet add onion green pepper zucchini and garlic. Cook until veggies are tender but do not lose their shape about 5 minutes. Reserve. Combine oregano basil 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper in a small measuring cup.

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: Heat raisins and water just until the mixture comes to a boil. Cool. Add soda and set aside. Mix sugar oleo and eggs and beat until smooth. Add flour salt raisins and water. Beat until smooth. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 until when tested the toothpick comes out clean.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix first 6 ingredients. In a jar or small bowl combine sugar and oil. Pour over vegetables and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.

title: Chinese Country Ribs
instructions: Combine soy sauce marmalade catsup and garlic. Brush both sides of ribs. Place in crock-pot. Pour in remaining sauce. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pecan Crisp Treats
instructions: Melt margarine for 1 minute in microwave. Add sugar and microwave 2 more minutes. Add vanilla and nuts. Grease jelly roll cookie sheet. Carefully break each cracker into 4 pieces and place side by side in a single layer on cookie sheet. Drizzle pecan mixture over crackers. (Do 1 pan at a time.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from pan while still warm.

title: Hamburger Pizza
instructions: Prepare pizza dough according to package directions. Mix together tomato paste and tomato sauce. Add dash of oregano and dash of garlic salt. Spread sauce over unbaked pizza crust. Spread browned ground chuck over the sauce. Top with grated cheese. Bake on lowest rack for 10 minutes at 500\u00b0 or until golden brown. Makes 1 pizza.

title: Mother'S Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Cook onion and celery in part of broth until tender then puree. Crumble cornbread and toasted bread. Mix with rice pureed onion mixture and enough broth to make a fairly soupy mixture. Heat bacon grease in shallow baking pan and add dressing mixture and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown on top and crusty on edges.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut skinned and boneless chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces. Mix slightly beaten egg white 1 teaspoon cornstarch soy sauce and fresh ground pepper in a plastic bag. Add chicken tie bag and refrigerate for up to 1 hour turning bag occasionally. Cut both peppers into thin strips. Slice onion very thin and separate into rings. Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch water sugar and sesame oil. Heat wok until very hot pour oil down sides of wok and rotate to oil all sides. Add onion garlic and ginger. Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes until onion is light brown and softened. Add chicken and stir-fry until chicken pieces turn white. Add hoisin sauce and chili paste; stir for about 30 to 40 seconds. Stir in broth and heat to boiling. Add the green and red pepper strips; stir-fry for about 1 minute more. Add the cornstarch mixture and stir until thickened. If desired sprinkle with roasted peanuts. Yield 4 servings. Carbohydrate 9 g protein 23 g fat 17 g calories 284.

title: Persimmon Marmalade
instructions: Cut core and mash fruit. Add other ingredients and cook until thick. Pour into jars and process 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 6 (1/2-pint) jars.

title: Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt together. Then add to egg yolk and milk mixture. stir into heated milk. Cook over medium heat until thick stirring constantly. Add butter vanilla and coconut banana or cocoa. Pour into baked 9 inch pie shell.

title: Crispy Chocolate Log
instructions: Line a 15 x 10 x 2-inch jelly roll pan with waxed paper; grease the paper and set aside. In a large microwave-safe bowl combine marshmallows butter and peanut butter. Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes; stir until well blended. Stir in cereal until well coated. Spread into prepared pan. In a microwave-safe bowl combine chocolate and butterscotch chips. Microwave uncovered on High for 2 minutes. Stir; spread over cereal to within 1-inch of edges. Roll up jelly roll style starting with a short side peeling away waxed paper while rolling. Place seam side down on a serving plate. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until set. Cut into 1-inch slices. Makes 10 servings.

title: Oven Baked Halibut A La Orange
instructions: Line a 12 x 8 x 2-inch shallow baking dish with foil. Lightly brush both sides of halibut steaks with oil. Arrange in dish. Sprinkle with orange peel and dill. Cover dish with foil and bake at 450\u00b0 allowing 10 to 12 minutes cooking time per inch of thickness measured at its thickest part or until halibut flakes when tested with a fork.

title: Pocket Sandwiches
instructions: Take 1 biscuit and roll flat. Top with a filling of your choice. Take another biscuit and roll flat; cover. Take a fork and crimp edges. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes or until done.

title: Shakertown Corn Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl blend butter sugar flour and salt. Add the eggs and beat well with a rotary beater or mixer on low. Stir in the corn and milk. (If using frozen corn chop it up a little first to release the milky juices.)

title: Chicken Continental
instructions: Saute chicken in oil. Sprinkle with salt; add vegetables and broth. Bring to full boil over medium heat. Separate vegetables with fork stirring frequently. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes. Combine sour cream flour and paprika. Stir into vegetables and heat gently.

title: Potato And Ham Chowder
instructions: Potatoes may be red skinned or other thin skinned; cut in 1/2-inch chunks. Ham is fully cooked smoked and cut in small chunks. Corn may be fresh canned or frozen.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Combine beans; toss all together. Chill overnight. Before serving toss to marinate beans and drain.

title: Ham Cheese Ball
instructions: Put your cream cheese in a large bowl. Chop up your ham in a processor. Pour your ham in another bowl. Chop green onions in food processor. Mix together. Put about 5 or 6 handfuls of chopped ham in the cream cheese and onion mixture. Add Accent. Roll into 2 balls then roll in ham that is left over. Serve with crackers.

title: Carrot Pineapple Bread
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients. Add next 3 ingredients; add remaining ingredients and blend. Its much easier to use Cusinart or blender for carrots. Lightly grease 2 loaf pans and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef; drain fat. Add taco seasoning per package directions and simmer approximately 5 minutes. Layer beef on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish; top with refried beans; layer sour cream and salsa to taste and shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts (approximately 10 minutes). Garnish with diced lettuce tomato onion and black olives. Add salsa and serve with tortilla chips. Enjoy!

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Line crackers on bottom of cookie sheet. Boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes. Pour sugar and butter mixture over crackers. Bake 4 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Let melt. Spread with butter knife. Put in refrigerator for about 10 minutes. Remove and cut into squares. Return to refrigerator. Sprinkle nuts on top if you desire.

title: Sausage Snack Wraps
instructions: Separate dough into 8 triangles. Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds. Place sausages on shortest side of each triangle. Roll up from shortest side to the opposite point. Bake at 375\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes. May be prepared ahead and refrigerated up to 2 hours.

title: Hamburger Dip
instructions: Melt cheese and stir in other ingredients. Simmer for a few minutes. Serve with plain tortilla chips.

title: Nannie'S Apple-Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and put in baking dish then make topping.

title: Cheese Souffle
instructions: Use a casserole dish with a cover. Spray dish with Pam. Alternate bread slices and cheese slices. (I also put mushrooms and chilies on top of cheese.) Pour melted butter over this. Beat eggs well. Add salt pepper mustard milk picante sauce chilies and mushrooms. Pour this mixture over bread and cheese. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours. (Can be made ahead and refrigerated for 2 days prior to baking.) Cook covered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan or 12 cup Bundt pan. In large mixer bowl cream butter. Gradually add sugar beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and flavorings. Sift together flour salt and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in cake comes out clean. Cool about 15 minutes in pan.

title: Tomato Ketchup
instructions: Wash vegetables; slice and remove seeds from peppers. Cook until celery is tender then press through a fine sieve or pureeing device. Boil rapidly for about 30 minutes to evaporate some of the liquid. Add vinegar sugar and spices. Cook stirring occasionally until mixture is thickened. Fill hot sterilized jars and seal at once. This makes 3 to 4 pints of ketchup.

title: Cucumber Pickle Relish
instructions: Mix by hand and put in jars. Makes 2 quarts. Cover with lids (not sealed) and tighten and then loosen a little. Pickles will work a little so it needs a little \working\ space! Refrigerate. Will keep up to a year.

title: Cowboy Soup
instructions: Melt shortening in a large kettle. Add meat and onion. Brown slowly stirring with a fork to break up meat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except apples and pecans mix well. Fold in fruit and nuts. Bake in well greased tube or bundt pan at 350 degrees for approximately 55 minutes. Cool in pan. May serve with whipped cream.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Freeze pineapple juice. Take out 1 1/2 to 2 hours before serving time and partially thaw. Put in a large container and mash up. Add lemonade and orange juice mixed with water as directed on cans. Add ginger ale. Stir and serve.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all together and let set for about 1 hour.

title: Turkey Alfredo Casserole
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Run water over broccoli to thaw.

title: Meat, Potato, Egg Scramble
instructions: Cook hash browns according to directions. Beat desired amount of eggs with 2 teaspoons water then pour over potatoes. Cook eggs turning 1 to 3 times. When eggs are done put cheese on top. Cover pan to melt cheese. Cook in 12 x 14-inch skillet. Five eggs will serve 4 people 4 to 6 ounce portions.

title: Cracked Wheat Cereal(Diabetic Approved)
instructions: Toast cracked wheat and coconut by stirring constantly in a dry pan over medium heat for several minutes until lightly browned. Place in a saucepan andd remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped nut if desired.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer on low for about 20 to 30 minutes. Store in refrigerator.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Layer peeled and sliced potatoes in a 9-inch pan. Mix margarine flour brown sugar and water. Make a hot syrup and pour over potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Squares
instructions: Mix thoroughly and bake 16 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0 in a 10 x 14-inch pan. When cool cut into squares.

title: Tender Roast
instructions: Spray pan with Pam. Slice onion in bottom of pan. Wash; salt and pepper the roast. Lay roast on onion in pan. Cover roast with the undiluted soup. Cover pan with aluminum foil. Cook in a 300\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. This will make its own gravy.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and pack in jars. To each quart jar add 1/2 bunch dill or more 1 garlic button and 1 small onion. Let vinegar water and salt come to a boil; pour over cucumbers. Seal.

title: Orange Supreme Tropical Delight Cake
instructions: Cook cake as directed on box for making 2 (9-inch) round cakes.

title: Pear Butter
instructions: Combine pears and water in a large Dutch oven. Cover and cook over medium-low heat 40 minutes or until pears are soft stirring occasionally. Drain. Press pears through a sieve or food mill; measure 1 quart of puree. Combine 1 quart puree with remaining ingredients in a Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat stirring frequently 15 minutes or until mixture thickens. Remove from heat; skim off foam. Quickly pour hot pear mixture into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace; wipe jar rims. Cover at once with metal lids and screw on bands. Process in boiling water bath 10 minutes. Yield 2 pints.

title: Eisenhower Fudge
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients for 6 minutes (sugar salt butter and evaporated milk). Bring to a boil. Keep at a rolling boil over medium heat. Do not stir. Have a metal or glass bowl ready with the chocolate chips chocolate squares and Fluff. Pour boiling syrup over this and stir until chocolate is melted. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour into buttered 9 x 13 pan. Cool slightly then place in refrigerator to chill and become firm. Cut into squares with sharp knife.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix oleo sugar flour and meal. Add beaten eggs add other ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350 degrees until it does not shake.

title: Julienne Of Beets And Carrots Or Carrots And Parsnips
instructions: Cook beets. Slip off skins and julienne. Julienne carrots or parsnips. Cook to desired tenderness. Melt butter and add to it a little orange juice.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour sugar and cocoa. Add enough hot water to dry ingredients to wet it. Add egg yolks milk margarine (melted) and flavoring. Pour into uncooked pie crust and cook until firm approximately 45 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Pinwheels
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl blend pepperoni cheeses oregano and egg. Roll apart crescent rolls into 8 rectangles (press perforations to seal). Spread mixture on each rectangle making sure to cover to the edges. Starting at shorter side roll up and seal. Cut each roll into 6 pieces.

title: Finger Paint
instructions: Add boiling water to the starch and boil until thick. Remove from heat and stir in the soap; add food coloring.

title: Tank'S Taco Grande(Mom Or Dad Will Help With Hard Parts.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray Pam on bottom and sides of 9 x 13 baking dish. Cook turkey or beef until no longer pink breaking up chunks to small crumbs. Add taco mix and water (see mix directions). Remove from heat. Add 1 cup of salsa.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
instructions: Place skinned chicken breasts in 8-inch square baking dish that has been lightly oiled. Lightly salt and pepper. Place drained sauerkraut over chicken; top with cheese slices one over each breast. Pour dressing evenly over the cheese. Cover with foil and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven about 1 1/2 hours or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease. Sprinkle with chopped parsley. Makes four servings. Baked potato skins can also be baked at the same time.

title: Layered Nacho Dip
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients in a 2 x 8 x 12-inch dish mixing well. Layer with remaining ingredients in order listed. Serve with Tostitos.

title: Columbus Cooler Punch
instructions: Mix all juices except 7-Up or ginger ale. Add just before serving.

title: Squash Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook squash according to directions on the package; drain. Sliver raw carrots on coarse side of grader. Mix squash carrots pimentos sour cream and undiluted soup in saucepan. In separate bowl mix herb stuffing and margarine. Line baking dish with half of herb stuffing mixture. Pour in squash mixture and top with remaining half of herb stuffing mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: Brown ground beef onion green pepper and garlic; drain. Add undrained tomatoes sauce paste undrained mushrooms water and all spices. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf and add cooked noodles.

title: Hearty Lentil Soup
instructions: Wash lentils and let soak overnight; drain. Saute onions celery and garlic in olive oil. Put soaked lentils in large pot and fill with 2 quarts water. Add sauteed vegetables carrots tomatoes (chopped very coarsely) along with all the puree oregano salt pepper parsley and bay leaf.

title: Oatmeal Walnut Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and eggs together until light and fluffy. Sift together flour soda baking powder salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir into creamed mixture. Stir in oats raisins and walnuts. Drop from a tablespoon 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly and remove from pan.

title: Cherry Confetti Cake
instructions: Sift or mix together the flour baking powder and salt. Cream the shortening and confectioners sugar. Blend in the almond extract and eggs. Measure milk and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture. (Begin and end with dry.) Fold in walnuts and cherries. Pour into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Cut gently through batter to break air bubbles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes. Remove from oven and while still warm spread on top with butter and sprinkle with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar.

title: Cheese Crispies
instructions: Combine seasonings with flour. Let margarine soften mix in cheese and flour. If using an electric mixer blend in flour on mixing speed. Mix the Rice Krispies in by hand. Place ball the size of marble on ungreased baking sheet and press with a fork (dipped in flour) to flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove and let cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Blend all together with hands until well blended. Roll into small balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Combine butter or margarine sugar and curry powder. Bring to a boil. Drain the fruit and arrange in a 2-quart baking dish (about 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch). Pour hot sauce over it. Garnish with cherries. Bake at 325\u00b0 until it bubbles (about 30 to 40 minutes). Serve hot. Very good with poultry ham and pork. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Microwaved Bread Pudding
instructions: In a 2-cup casserole slightly beat eggs. Add sugar and blend. Pour in milk and blend with salt and cinnamon. Add raisins and bread cubes. Dot with butter.

title: 12-Hour Cole Slaw
instructions: Layer half of cabbage onions and green pepper. Sprinkle half of sugar over vegetables. Repeat. Let stand while making dressing.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add vinegar and water from beets. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Add beets and simmer 30 minutes. When ready to serve bring to a boil and add butter. Serves 4.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour. Makes a large bowl.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Grind cranberries in blender. Add marshmallows and sugar. Chill covered overnight. Add grapes apples walnuts and salt. Fold in chilled whipped cream. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and rinse with cold water several times. Let drain. Mix other ingredients in a large container. Pour in beans and mix. Let stand in the refrigerator 12 to 18 hours.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle with paprika. Serve with Triscuits crackers or corn chips.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk starting and ending with flour. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Summer Succotash
instructions: Cook corn and lima beans in a small amount of boiling water for 12 minutes or until tender; drain and set aside. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon reserving drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute chopped onion in bacon drippings until onion is tender; remove onion and set aside. Add flour to bacon drippings stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add tomatoes and rest of ingredients. Heat through.

title: Grasshopper Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine first 4 ingredients and beat until stiff. Fold in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls on foil-covered cookie sheets. Turn oven off and leave cookies in oven overnight. Store in tins between wax paper. May be frozen.

title: Ann'S Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

title: Nut Cups
instructions: Mix flour margarine and cream cheese and refrigerate. Mix brown sugar eggs vanilla salt and margarine. Cook over low heat. Watch closely as it burns easily. Add walnuts. Roll out dough 1/8-inch thick. Cut with a scalloped cookie cutter. Press into 1-inch muffin tin. Drop 1 teaspoon of filling into each cup about 3/4 full. They will swell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Avoid overbrowning.

title: Ribbon Mold Salad
instructions: Mix together 3 cups of hot water pineapple juice and lemon Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Pour mixture in pan and refrigerate to cool but not set firm about 1 hour. Mix together lime Jell-O and 1.5 quarts of hot water. Stir until dissolved. Pour lime Jell-O mixture into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan; chill until firmly set. Mix together strawberry Jell-O and 1.5 quarts of hot water. Stir until dissolved. Allow mixture to cool. In a small mixing bowl cream the cream cheese. Add whipped cream. To this mixture add the cooled lemon Jell-O mix and whip until blended thoroughly. Pour the lemon mixture on top of the set lime Jell-O. Refrigerate until firm. Pour strawberry Jell-O on top of the lemon mixture and let set again until firm.

title: Fresh Tomato Sauce For Pasta Or Pizza Crust, Etc.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Add onion and garlic. Saute 3 minutes. Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients. Stir well and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook 10 minutes or until reduced to 4 cups. Keep in freezer for quick pasta dishes.

title: Chicken Nest
instructions: Arrange pasta in skillet. Top with chicken (undrained) frozen peas carrots and sliced onion. Pour on broth. Sprinkle with tarragon. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Gail'S Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crust. Cook in 375\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Mile A Minute Cupcakes(1942 Recipe)
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Add flour sifted with salt baking powder soda and cocoa alternately with milk and vanilla. Add coffee; mix well. Fill greased cupcake pans 2/3 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Melt margarine and stir in pretzels and sugar. Press gently into a 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes (do not overbake). Cool.

title: Tammy'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding according to directions. Add eagle brand milk. Put in refrigerator for 5 to 10 minutes until set. While waiting for mixture to set beat heavy whipping cream (use a mixer) until a soft peek. Fold in to pudding mixture. Start layering in a 2 qt. dish; putting pudding mixture first then cookies and bananas. Refrigerate overnight so cookies get soft.

title: Mama'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Scald milk with margarine. Add with all remaining ingredients to bread and stir lightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour cocoa and salt. Add sugar. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and spread with Marshmallow Creme while hot. Cool 30 minutes and ice.

title: Lemonade Stand Pie
instructions: Beat lemonade concentrate in large bowl about 30 seconds. Gradually spoon in ice cream blending well. Gently stir whipped topping until smooth. Freeze if necessary until mixture will mound. Spoon into crust. Freeze at least 4 hours or until firm. Let stand at room temperature or in refrigerator about 30 minutes or until pie can be easily cut. Garnish with strawberries. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Core the apples and peel them if you like. (We prefer the added texture of the peels but peeled apples look more sophisticated.) Cut the apples crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices. Melt about 2 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet and add a single layer of apple slices. Raise the heat and saute the slices turning occasionally until browned about 5 minutes. With a slotted spoon transfer apples to a bowl. Repeat with more butter and another batch of apples until all have been cooked.

title: Hamburger Stuffed Bread
instructions: Cut off top of loaf of bread and hollow out forming a crust shell. Tear enough bread for 2 cups; set aside. Brown beef and oil; add green pepper Worcestershire sauce and cheese soup. Simmer 5 minutes. Stir in bread crumbs. Fill in bread crust. Place American cheese slices diagonally on top. Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix the cream of mushroom soup and milk together. Add all other ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover and place in fridge overnight (12 hours). Before baking sprinkle buttered bread crumbs on top. Bake uncovered 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Grease the pan before adding ingredients.

title: Ruth'S Crab Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese with 1/2 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce and a little lemon juice. Spread in bottom of pie plate. Pick shells from large can of backfin crabmeat. Spread over cream cheese. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Mix Heinz chili sauce 1 teaspoon Worcestershire horseradish and lemon juice and pour over crab. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in large bowl. Pour into a 10 x 14-inch pan. Top with cheese crackers and melted butter. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice as directed. Set aside to drain. Put veggies in skillet with small amount of oil. Stir fry. Add 3 tablespoons soy sauce. Add rice. Stir fry until hot. Ready to eat.

title: Frozen Passion
instructions: Ice Cream Maker Method Mix and pour into ice cream freezer container. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions. Store leftovers in freezer.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix 1 cup of flour baking powder and butter; add egg and milk. Mix. Press into greased pie pan. Arrange rhubarb in pie shell Sprinkle with Jell-O.

title: Rolls With Gold Medal Flour
instructions: Mix all with flour. May have to add a little more flour but make a soft dough. Knead real good. Put in a greased bowl. Let rise until double in bulk about 1 hour. Work down and make into rolls. Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Applesauce Jello Salad
instructions: Add cup of boiling water to package of jello. Mix until dissolved. Add package of frozen berries; stir until thawed. Add the applesauce and stir well. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill in refrigerator until set. For the topping fold in 1 cup of marshmallows into 1 cup of sour cream or Cool Whip and spread over the set jello.

title: Pasta Alfredo
instructions: Heat butter and cream. Do not boil. Mound pasta in warm buttered bowl and pour on cream; sprinkle generously with cheese and toss thoroughly but lightly. Season to taste.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan stir together 1 cup sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in water until smooth. Stir in egg yolks. Stirring constantly bring to boil over medium heat and boil one minute. Remove from heat. Stir in next 3 ingredients cool. Turn into pastry shell. In small bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually beat in 1/3 cup sugar; continue beating until stiff peaks form. Spread some meringue around edge of filling first touching crust all around then fill in center. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix all together. Put in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Two days before using make sauce Brown onions in bottom of a large Dutch oven. Add meat and brown. Stir occasionally to break it up well. Add salt pepper lots of oregano garlic powder 3 cans of tomato paste and can of puree. Add 1 teaspoon of sugar. Cover. Simmer 2 to 3 hours stirring every 30 minutes or so and taste to season. When done put in a large airtight container. Store in refrigerator at least 24 hours before using.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Blend margarine sugar and egg. Then add pumpkin and vanilla. Sift flour cinnamon baking powder soda and salt. Add walnuts. Drop with spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for almost 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook corn tomatoes carrots and butter beans. Mix all ingredients and heat good. Put in jars and seal. Cook in pressure canner at 10 pounds for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken in water with onion. Remove chicken; drain and set onions aside. Chop chicken; salt and pepper to taste. Combine chicken onion and mayonnaise to taste. Add celery lemon juice pimento eggs and soup. Put into casserole dish. Top with almonds potato chips and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Cheese Grits
instructions: While grits are still hot add cheeses and margarine. Allow to cool; add eggs and milk. Pour into baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. This dish can be made ahead of time frozen and reheated. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Egg Dumplings
instructions: Sift and measure the flour. Cut the butter into the flour. Break the egg into a measuring cup then add enough water to come up to the 3/4 cup line. Add to the flour; mix lightly with a fork. Drop by tablespoonfuls over boiling meat and broth or into well-greased steamer placed over boiling water. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until dumplings are tender.

title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs; beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Combine dry ingredients and add to mixture. Fold in pecans and apples. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake is done.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Dust apples raisins and nuts with some of the flour; set aside. Blend oil sugar and slightly beaten eggs; set aside. Sift together flour salt and soda; add to egg mixture and add vanilla. Fold in coated apples nuts and raisins; pour into a 10-inch greased tube pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cheerios Nuggets
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Grease two 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat brown sugar margarine corn syrup and salt in a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat stirring constantly until bubbly around edges. Cook uncovered stirring occasionally for 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat; stir in baking soda until foamy and light colored. Pour over cereal peanuts and raisins in greased 4-quart bowl. Stir until mixture is coated. Spread evenly in pans. Bake 15 minutes. Stir. Let stand just until cool about 10 minutes. Loosen mixture with metal spatula. Let stand until firm about 30 minutes. Break into bite size pieces. Makes about 10 cups of snack.

title: Lime Salad Chiffon With Graham Crackers
instructions: Make the crust with butter and cracker crumbs. Put into an 8-inch square pan. Chill.

title: Slushy Punch
instructions: Mix jello and sugar with 3 cups boiling water. Stir until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients. Put in freezer. Stir after about 3 hours and every hour thereafter until it is slushy.

title: Harry Potter Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello into boiling water. Add sugar and dissolve. Add cold water pineapple juice and lemon juice. Pour into clean milk or apple juice jugs and chill well or start to freeze.

title: Cake That Won'T Last
instructions: Beat eggs and mix with flour salt cinnamon soda vanilla nuts sugar oil bananas (not mashed) and pineapple. Do not beat. Stir until blended. Pour into greased and floured pan (9 x 13-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Toffee Candy
instructions: Cook butter and sugar on medium heat stirring frequently until temperature reaches 290\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Pour onto greased cookie sheet with sides. Spread out.

title: Oven Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix the tomato soup brown sugar and vinegar together well. Bake meat until it has about 20 minutes left. Pour the barbecue sauce on the meat and continue to bake uncovered until the meat is done. This is great on pork chops some cuts of beef and a great way to dress up leftover meat.

title: St. Timothy'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Sift together flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Add nuts and raisins to dry ingredients. Add eggs sour cream and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon mixture on top before baking. Sprinkle on bottom after baking.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift flour spices salt baking powder and soda together. Cream sugar and oil together while adding one egg at a time. Begin to add flour mixture zucchini apple sauce pineapple raisins and nuts. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour. Makes three loaves. Really really good!

title: Beef Enchiladas
instructions: Brown meat onion and garlic. Fill each tortilla with 2 tablespoons of mixture 1 tablespoon of each cheese and top with onion. Roll and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Put remaining meat mixture over top with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in a large sauce pan and add all ingredients except shrimp. Cook over medium heat for approximately 5 minutes. Add shrimp and saute for 4 minutes on each side. Remove from heat and ladle butter sauce over shrimp. Garnish with fresh parsley and 3 slices of lemon. Serves two.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Take 1 can of beans; drain 1/2 water; put in casserole dish. Add cream of mushroom soup then onions and cheese; mix well. Sprinkle extra cheese on top. Cook in oven for 30 minutes or until onions and green beans are tender.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In a saucepan make a roux with flour and butter. Add mustard. Lower heat and add one-half of the milk stirring so as not to scald. In a pot cook pasta until its half done. Saute onion and add to roux mixture along with cheeses and rest of milk.

title: Paintbrush Cookies
instructions: Give each child 3 large marshmallows and toothpick. Instruct to insert toothpick and to align marshmallows. Decorate snowmen with raisins fruit slices and cereal pieces. Eat as snack.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Slowly cook oil onions celery salt and beef stirring constantly. Add potatoes and tomatoes; stir well. Place in casserole dish. Place strips of pastry on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hershey Bar Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Blend well and add Hersheys syrup. Mix together flour soda and salt. Melt Hershey bars; alternately add buttermilk Hershey bars and vanilla. Bake in stem pan at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Baked Beans With Green Pepper And Carrots
instructions: Wash beans cover with water and cook until soft. Drain not too dry. Add salt and bacon drippings. Mix in baking dish the beans brown sugar onions green pepper and grated carrots. Add catsup. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for one hour or until as dry as desired.

title: Cabbage Goulash
instructions: In a large kettle brown sausage beef and onion. Drain off any fat. Add remaining ingredients except cabbage; mix well. Stir in cabbage and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Serves 8.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
instructions: Add sugar and water to cherries. Bring to a boil. Pour over jello and stir until dissolved. Place in refrigerator until cool. Remove and add Coke pineapple and nuts. Refrigerate until set.

title: Hearty Vegetable Soup
instructions: In 5-quart kettle on medium heat heat oil. Add onion celery and garlic; saute for 2 minutes or until tender. Stir in bouillon cubes water and tomatoes with liquid crushing tomatoes into little pieces. Over high heat add carrots cauliflowerets lima beans marjoram thyme and pepper. Return to boiling reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes longer. Add parsley if desired.

title: Party Style Hot Chicken
instructions: Combine ingredients; put in greased casserole. Put in 1 cup potato chips on top. Cover chips with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 450\u00b0. Should be bubbly.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Mix together until smooth. Dip hot dogs into mix and deep fry. Yields 8 to 10 corn dogs.

title: Unleavened Communion Bread
instructions: Mix flour Crisco salt and sugar until like coarse cornmeal. Add cold water. Roll as for pie dough approximately 1/8-inch thick onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Prick with a fork. Cut into bite size pieces (1/4-inch squares) with a knife before baking. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until very light brown.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar water and cornstarch together. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add\tjello and cool to lukewarm. Pour over berries in pie shell. Chill. When ready to serve top with whipped cream.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Fry onions gently in fat until lightly browned. Add stock and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer about 15 minutes.

title: Dipsy Devil Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vegetables. Beat until creamy. Makes about 1 cup. Use as a vegetable dip.

title: Shirley'S Casserole
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients. Add all other ingredients and bake.

title: Tostadas
instructions: Heat oil in small skillet. Fry corn tortillas one at a time in oil until crisp and hard. Brown ground beef. Add spices and stir. Drain meat. Add refried beans to meat and heat. Spread over corn tortillas. Add lettuce tomatoes and cheese. Sour cream and salsa are optional. Enjoy!! Quick easy and inexpensive.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter shortening and sugars. Add vanilla and eggs. Sift flour salt soda and cocoa together. Add to creamed mixture; mix until blended. Add chocolate chips coconut and nuts. Bake on greased cookie sheet until just set about 6 to 8 minutes at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Do not overbake. They will look a little raw until cool.

title: Chipped Chopped Ham Spread
instructions: In a big bowl mix all ingredients together except semi-hard rolls and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Next day cut the rolls in half on one side smear a little amount of butter and put on spread. Close the roll with the other half and mount in aluminum foil. Heat oven to 350\u00b0F and bake for 15 to 20 minutes. If you do not use up all the rolls at once the rest mounted in aluminum foil can be stored in refrigerator for 2 days.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Stir pudding in pineapple and juice. Mix in nuts marshmallows and cherries. Fold in Cool Whip. Place in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Partially thaw vegetables (enough to break apart) and mix with onions mushrooms and chestnuts. Place into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soup and Cheez Whiz. Heat just enough to be able to mix well. Pour over vegetables. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute tips in butter; add flour and brown. Add hot beef stock and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Reduce wine and vinegar to 1/2 and add to above.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and roll into 1-inch balls.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients into balls. Brown in butter at 250\u00b0 in electric frypan or regular pan on medium high heat. Melt catsup and currant jelly in frypan. Simmer meat balls and sauce together for 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until frothy. Gradually beat in oil; add dry ingredients. Beat at high speed 4 minutes. Add carrots zucchini nuts and currants or raisins. Pour in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Fudge Oat Cake
instructions: Pour water over oats and let stand 20 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients and add cooled oats. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes With Apricots
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Cut sweet potatoes into thick slices. Arrange 1 layer in 10x6x2 greased baking dish. Cover with layer of apricots sprinkled with some brown sugar. Repeat layers. Combine butter reserved apricot liquid and orange rind. Pour over layers. Bake uncovered 45 minutes - basting once or twice with liquid from bottom of dish. Top with nuts during last 5 minutes.

title: Lucy Webb'S Barbecued Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Roll out between waxed paper sheets to a thickness of 1/4-inch. Remove top sheet. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups grated Cheddar cheese. Lift waxed paper and roll like a jelly roll. Turn ends in to keep cheese inside. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with sauce and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Crowd Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; add 2 cups cheese. Mix mayonnaise and sour cream; add to chicken mixture and toss. Spoon into 2 greased 13 x 9-inch baking dishes. Sprinkle with chips. Top with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot. Serves 24.

title: Bread Machine Buttermilk Wheat Bread
instructions: In bread machine pan place all ingredients in order given. Select \white bread\ setting. Bake according to bread machine directions. Makes 1 medium loaf (16 slices).

title: Vegetarian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Crush garlic and chop onion and brown in oil. Add canned tomatoes and tomato sauce mushrooms salt chopped squash (optional) and spices. Bring to boil; simmer for at least 2 hours. Good for weight watchers. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Sticky Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Melt butter; add honey mustard salt and curry powder. Pour over chicken and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. This is good but all chicken is good.

title: Sweet Sour Green Beans
instructions: Cook beans until crisp and tender (6 to 8 minutes). Drain. Plunge into ice water; drain. Set aside. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Keep 2 tablespoons bacon drippings. Stir in flour. Cook until bubbly. Stir in water vinegar and sugar. Heat to boiling and slightly thickened. Add beans and toss occasionally. Sprinkle with salt pepper and bacon.

title: Green Chili Corn Bread
instructions: Mix meal eggs oil and milk. Add other ingredients and stir. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Bread is done when inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Quick Mix Pepperoni Batter Bread
instructions: Set aside 1 cup flour. Mix together remaining ingredients including yeast in a large bowl. Stir in margarine and water into dry mixture. Mix in only enough flour to make very thick batter. Cover; let rest 10 minutes. Turn batter into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover. Let rise in warm draft-free place until double in size about 35 to 40 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Check for doneness. Remove and cool on wire rack.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Saute onions green pepper and celery in oil. Cook a few minutes. Brown meat in Dutch oven. Add onions celery green pepper tomatoes puree and seasonings. Simmer for about an hour. Add mushrooms last 15 minutes. Set off heat and add 1/2 grated cheese. Stir.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion in oleo until soft. Add water and bouillon cubes and dissolve. Add egg noodles and cook 3 minutes. Stir in broccoli garlic and pepper. Cook broccoli until it thaws. Add 6 cups milk and cheese cut in cubes. Stir until cheese melts then cook for 30 minutes on low heat. Do not boil. Serve with a salad and hot French bread. Makes a large pot of rich and delicious soup.

title: Chinese Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Good on spareribs or chicken.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: In a bowl beat egg white and water until frothy not stiff. Add pecans and mix until nuts are covered. Mix sugar salt and cinnamon in a small bowl and pour over pecans. Stir well with wooden spoon until pecans are coated.

title: Chocolate Fondue
instructions: Put chocolate pieces and milk in a bowl. Microwave uncovered on 100% power for 1 minute and 30 seconds. Stir. Add another 30 seconds if needed. Stir in almond extract. Makes 1 3/4 cups. Dip with bananas strawberries pound cake pineapple or apples.

title: Escalloped Potatoes With Ham
instructions: Boil potatoes with skin on. Peel and slice into baking dish. Add ham and mushroom soup. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Quick and good!

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch cinnamon nutmeg water and raisins in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring until thick. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and lemon juice. Cool slightly. Pour into a pie shell. Cut other crust in criss-cross strips. Put on top. Brush melted butter on this and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased baking sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes or until brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Roast & Gravy
instructions: Cook roast and spices until tender. Drain & slice. Add gravy and onion soup mix. Simmer 2 hours until done.

title: Coffee Cake(Easy)
instructions: Put egg in measuring cup and add milk to make one cup. Mix all dry ingredients. Add shortening and mix with pastry blender (or two knives) until like cornmeal. Add egg and milk and put into greased pan. Sprinkle sugar nuts or chocolate chips and cinnamon. Cut dough with knife like you would marble cake. Add some sugar on top with cinnamon.

title: Dorito Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger salt and onion. Layer baking dish with Doritos. Put meat mixture on top of Doritos. Mix soups and Ro-Tel and pour mixture over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles. Remove from oven and top with grated cheese. Return to oven until cheese melts. Sprinkle with crumbled Doritos.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix together in a square baking dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Opossum Pie
instructions: Wash opossum inside and out and salt. Heat lard in roasting pan. Stir-fry garlic onions and ginger. Heat until starts to smoke. Shake flour over opossum and brown in lard for two minutes. Place opossum in roasting pan with paws crossed over chest adding carrots onions potatoes and celery. Add stock and sherry and cook at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Add peas. Recover and heat 8 more minutes. Best served with rice turnip greens and corn bread. Serves 8 to 12 or whoever you can get to eat it!

title: Scrambled Egg Bake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl with a wire whisk or fork beat eggs until frothy. Stir in milk; mix well. Add cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Pour into buttered 2-quart baking dish. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves immediately.

title: Oatmeal Apple Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco brown sugar egg milk and vanilla on medium speed. Combine flour cinnamon nutmeg soda and salt. Beat into creamed mixture at low speed until well blended. Stir in oats. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 13 minutes. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Remove to cooling rack. Makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Sift flour soda and cocoa and add alternately with buttermilk and flavoring. Bake in 4 nine-inch greased and floured cake pans at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Piccalilli
instructions: Chop tomatoes and onions. Sprinkle with salt; let stand for 24 hours and drain. Chop together peppers and celery and add with sugar and vinegar to tomatoes and onions. Tie spices in a bag and add to the ingredients; cook slowly until ingredients are tender about 2 or 3 hours. Remove the spice bag. Place piccalilli in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Soften cream cheese in bowl. Core mushrooms after removing stems.

title: Quickie Barbecue
instructions: Mix corned beef and whatever kind of barbecue sauce you like and heat. Serve on bun with cole slaw.

title: Marshmallow Cloud Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Keep marshmallows frozen until ready to use (they thaw quickly). Combine flour cocoa and soda. Set aside. Combine sugars; blend in butter. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture and chocolate chips. Blend at low speed. Batter will be stiff. Gather 4 to 5 frozen marshmallows in your hand. Cover with heaping teaspoonful of dough. Wrap marshmallows in dough making a 2 inch ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Corn And Sausage Soup
instructions: Slice sausage and brown in heavy soup pot. Add onions and saute until tender. Stir in potatoes water salt basil pepper and parsley. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in corn and milk. Heat to a boil but do not boil. Serve with a tossed salad and crusty bread. Makes 8 bowls.

title: Judy'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Sprinkle more nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Spiced Apple Cider
instructions: Pour brandy and cider into large coffee pot.\tCombine remaining ingredients and pour into the percolator basket. Perk until done. Makes 9 to 10 cups of cider.

title: Creamy Orange Glaze
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well. Pour over hot cake.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Heat soup to dissolve cream cheese in soup. Soften gelatin in 3/4 cup cold water then add to soup and stir to dissolve then cool. Add peppers celery onions and mayonnaise to soup mixture. Add crab meat. Spray mold with Pam.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate. Stir in peanut butter and brown sugar. Cool slightly and then stir in 3/4 of Cool Whip. Pour into 9-inch baked pie shell. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pie.

title: White Chili
instructions: Drain soaked beans. Put beans chicken broth garlic and half of the onions into a large soup pot. Bring to a boil; cover lower heat and simmer until beans are soft about 3 hours adding more broth if necessary.

title: Vodka Slushes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix. Let set in freezer for at least 24 hours. Stir occasionally. Serve with 7-Up.

title: Soft Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs milk and vanilla; mix well. Blend in flour baking soda and baking powder. Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost or sprinkle with sugar just before you put in oven.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups(Old Recipe)
instructions: Mix chicken with 1 1/4 cups cheese. Put mixture in center of each roll and \roll up\. Lay rolls in 9 x 13-inch pans. Heat soup milk and 3/4 cup cheese until cheese melts. Pour over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 400\u00b0 in greased muffin pan until golden brown. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Crab Cakes Canton
instructions: Combine crab meat bread crumbs garlic and ginger in bowl. Mix well. Add egg white and teriyaki sauce; mix well. Shape into patties about 1/2-inch thick and 2-inch in diameter. Heat 1 teaspoon oil into large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot. Add crab cakes to hot oil. Cook 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

title: Easy Bake Cheese Omelet
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Set aside. Slightly beat egg yolks. Add 1/2 cup of the Cheddar cheese soup. Mix well. Fold yolk mixture into white mixture. Spread in an ungreased 8 1/2-inch round baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until puffy and golden brown.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Cut cheese into cubes; place in top of double boiler. Cook over hot water stirring frequently until melted. Place sausage Bisquick and cheese in large mixing bowl. Mix well. Shape into small balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. May be frozen before baking. Place on cookie sheet to freeze until firm then place in plastic bags or container then freeze until needed.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta and drain well. Add dressing as needed to cook pasta. Add feta cheese olives and stir. Add parmesan and stir. Add tomatoes and broccoli. Chill and serve. Top with chopped fresh basil for presentation.

title: Minnesota Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Brown beef. Add next nine ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Add soup and water. Stir and simmer 30 minutes. Can be put in crock pot until ready to serve.

title: Damson Pie
instructions: Put all together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes until crust is pretty and brown and pie does not jiggle (firm). Good with Cool Whip on top.

title: One Hour Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add buttermilk. Add dry ingredients and knead 5 minutes. Roll 1/4-inch. Cut and place on greased pan. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage in small amount of water until tender; drain well. Melt butter over low heat; add flour and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbly. Stir in spices.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: *Lawrys seasoning Johnnys seasoning garlic salt Watkins soup and vegetable seasoning flavor enhancer.

title: Mississippi Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar. Blend in about 1/2 of the flour and all baking powder. Stir in milks and extracts. Then blend in remaining flour. Beat a short while until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Let sit in Bundt pan 10 minutes then turn over on cake plate. When cool sprinkle powdered sugar lightly. Then add fresh fruit to the plate.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
instructions: Lightly spray 9 x 3-inch spring-form pan with vegetable cooking spray. Line bottom of pan with ladyfinger halves split sides up. Cut 10 to 12 additional ladyfinger halves in half. Use to line side of pan allowing cut ends to rest on ladyfingers in bottom of pan. Set aside on baking sheet.

title: Liver Pate
instructions: Saute liver in butter. Mash and simmer. Add onion and spices. Simmer 2 more minutes. Whip until smooth. Serve with crackers.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni; mix with all other ingredients. Season to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Add ground cracker crumbs to top and butter dots for a brown top.

title: Baked Scallop Casserole
instructions: Place rinsed scallops in a greased casserole dish. Pour milk over scallops and sprinkle with salt pepper and lemon juice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10-12 minutes. Add Ritz crumbs to melted butter and mix well. When scallops are finished baking remove from oven and spread crumb mixture evenly over scallops. Place under broiler just until golden brown.

title: Yum Yums
instructions: Mix and pat in a 9 x 15-inch pan.

title: Mexican Casserole Corn Bread
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Brown ground meat. Melt cheese with Ro-Tel tomatoes. Layer 1/2 batter then all of ground meat all of cheese mixture and chopped onions. Top with remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Quick Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar milk butter cocoa and vanilla in pan. Bring to a boil for 1 minute. Add oatmeal and coconut. Using a tablespoon drop mixture about an inch apart on wax paper. Let stand until the cookies have hardened.

title: Pineapple Stuffing
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add bread pineapple and oranges. In separate bowl beat eggs and add to mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Combine flour sugar cocoa baking powder salt and nuts. Set aside; combine oil eggs and vanilla and add to dry ingredients. Do not overmix. Spread in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Yields about 24 brownies.

title: Old Fashioned Lentil Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until lentils are tender (1/2 hour in pressure cooker). Take out ham bone. Strip off bits of meat and return to soup. Remove bay leaf. Serve with 2 tablespoons vinegar on top. Croutons may also be served with soup. Serves 8.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut beef across the grain into thin strips 1/8-inch thick. Combine soy sauce garlic and ginger. Add beef. Toss and set aside while preparing vegetables. Heat oil in large frying pan. Add beef and toss over high heat until browned. If beef is not tender cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over low heat. Turn heat up and add vegetables. Toss until vegetables are tender. Mix cornstarch with water. Add to pan. Stir and cook until thickened. Add tomatoes and heat through. Serve with cooked rice.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large skillet cook and stir meat onion and green pepper. Drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat thoroughly and pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake 1 hour. Serve with salad for complete meal.

title: Chiffon Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and pineapple juice until smooth; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add Jell-O then let cool completely. Whip milk which has been refrigerated overnight.
