Add lemon juice. Fold cooled Jell-O mixture into whipped milk blending well. Place mixture into 2 prepared crusts. Refrigerate and then serve.

title: Castle Hamburgers
instructions: Mix and refrigerate for 2 hours. Make into patties and fry. Put holes in burgers to cook evenly.

title: Manest(Poor People'S Soup)
instructions: Wash lettuce in salt water and rinse. Cut lettuce into 3-inch pieces. Place in large pot; cover with water. cut celery into 1-inch pieces and carrots into 1-inch pieces; add to endive. Add salt to taste. Cover and cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until tender. Cover saucepan lightly with oil. Fry garlic lightly. Add tomato sauce. Add salt pepper and oregano to taste. Simmer until it starts to thicken (10 to 15 minutes). Add beans and simmer about 1/2 hour until thickened. Drain vegetables saving vegetable water. Add vegetables to bean sauce; slowly add water until thick but soupy. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Drain liquid from beets into saucepan. Boil down to half. Shake together vinegar and flour. Stir into boiling mixture. Add sugar and salt; bring to boil. Add beets and butter; heat through.

title: Black Bean And Rice Soup
instructions: Place beans with liquid in blender; blend until smooth. Pour into large saucepan. Stir in water oregano and garlic powder and bring to boil. Stir in rice. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Serve with chopped onions if desired.

title: Stewed Pears
instructions: Pare and core pears. Place in cold water until ready to use. Make syrup. Add fruit cored side down. Boil gently until soft. Add lemon juice before done.

title: Cocoa Fudge Brownies
instructions: Heat shortening and cocoa in saucepan until melted. Stir in sugar and milk; bring to a boil. Add beaten eggs and all dry ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Wait 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with spoon (no mixer). Batter will be stiff. Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Serve with whipped cream ice cream or cream cheese frosting.

title: Cranberry Oatmeal Square
instructions: Mix 2nd mixture well and put half into a 7 x 11-inch pan; press firmly. Pour in cranberry mixture and cool with remaining dry mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Stir in crushed pineapple and bread cubes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour in a 9-inch square pan.

title: Pink Cloud
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Cheese Fritters
instructions: In a medium bowl beat the cottage cheese and egg together. Stir in the half and half flour baking powder salt sugar and nutmeg. Mix until just combined. Fill a deep pot to the 2-inch mark with oil. Heat to 375\u00b0F (190\u00b0C). Drop batter by rounded tablespoonfuls into the hot oil. Fry until golden brown on all sides about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Serve hot!

title: Snack Bars
instructions: In a very large bowl combine the first five ingredients. In a saucepan over low heat cook and stir marshmallows and butter until marshmallows are melted. Add honey and mix well. Pour over cereal mixture; mix well. Add chips M&Ms or raisins if desired. Pat two-thirds into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan and the remaining third into a 9-inch square pan. Cool. Yield 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Blueberry Streusel Cobbler
instructions: In bowl combine berries sweetened condensed milk and rind. In large bowl cut 3/4 cup margarine into 1 1/2 cups biscuit mix until crumbly. Add berry mixture. Spread in greased 9-inch square baking pan. In bowl combine 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar; cut in 2 tablespoons margarine until crumbly. Add nuts. Sprinkle over cobbler. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with ice cream and Blueberry Sauce.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients together. Pour into a well greased 9x13 inch pan. Bake for about 45 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix brown sugar margarine corn syrup water and salt. Bring to a steady boil. Boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda. Stir until thoroughly mixed. (Syrup will be foamy.) Pour over popped popcorn. Mix gently. Bake for 1 hour at 225\u00b0 stirring every 15 minutes. Pour mix onto wax paper or on clean large tea towel separating corn gently. Cool.

title: Rice And Chicken Almondine
instructions: Saute almonds and onion in butter for 10 minutes. Stir in flour. Add bouillon and cream stirring until thickened. Add chicken and remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Grandma Brasch'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Dissolve baking soda in boiling water. Blend together sugar shortening and egg. Add molasses; blend. Carefully add water. Mix in spices (according to your taste). Gradually add in flour until a soft dough. Scoop tablespoon size balls and roll in sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Marbled Angel Food Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare cake according to package directions. Measure 4 cups of batter into separate bowl. Gradually fold cocoa into batter until well blended be careful not to deflate batter. Alternately pour vanilla and chocolate batters into ungreased tube pan. Cut through batter with knife to marble batter. Bake 30 to 35 minutes do not underbake. Invert pan on heatproof funnel or bottle. Cool for 2 hours. Run knife along sides to loosen cake place on platter. May be eaten plain or drizzled with chocolate glaze.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Cut up or tear lettuce. Oil the bowl with oily dressing; toss lettuce with creamy dressing. Then add Parmesan cheese. Toss lettuce with oily dressing then add Parmesan cheese. Add croutons just before serving. Add cucumber and tomato if desired.

title: Cook Frosting
instructions: Cook until thick the flour and milk. Cream the butter granulated sugar and vanilla. Add both mixtures together and beat for 16 minutes. Frost cake and refrigerate.

title: Poppy Seed Muffins(Makes 1 Dozen)
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Make a well in center. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until moist. Spoon into greased muffin pan filling 1/2 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie 3
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together thoroughly. Add the eggs syrup and salt. Mix well. Add the vanilla and pecans. Pour into the pie pan lined with pastry. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Buckaroo Beans
instructions: Boil beans in 6 cups boiling water for 2 minutes. Let stand for 1 hour. Rinse twice. Add 3 1/2 cups fresh water and cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 1/2 hours uncovered. Serves 12.

title: Special French Toast
instructions: Beat eggs and cream together. Add Triple Sec granulated sugar orange zest and cinnamon; whisk until well blended. Pour into shallow bowl.

title: Tapioca
instructions: Soak tapioca overnight in water. Stir in 2 cups whipped topping and some nut meats. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Budget Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute first 4 ingredients in oleo. Remove from heat stir in tomato sauce water and seasonings. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in shrimp. Heat to boiling. Cover and cook 15 minutes. Serve over hot rice. Serves 6.

title: Bean And Sausage Soup
instructions: Pick through and rinse beans. Place in a 4 quart pot and cover with at least 2 inches of water. Bring to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Cover and let stand in the refrigerator overnight. Drain and rinse beans. Place beans in crockpot with canned tomatoes broth wine and vegetables. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. In a skillet cook the sausage over medium heat until done. Slice links into 1/2 inch pieces. Add meat to the crockpot and cook another 30 to 60 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Grandma Straub'S Chili Sauce
instructions: Grind peppers and onions. Mash tomatoes to chunky. Add all other ingredients to mix. Cook slowly until thickens stirring occasionally to prevent burning about 3 to 4 hours.

title: Cabbage Surprise
instructions: Place all ingredients in large pot. Cover with water and bring to boil. Boil 10 minutes then simmer until soft. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Apple Cinnamon Baked French Toast
instructions: Slice bread into 1-inch thick slices. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with oil and arrange bread slices tightly together. Mix eggs milk 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla. Pour half of mixture over bread. Arrange sliced apples on top and pour balance of egg mixture over top. Take remaining 1/2 cup of sugar and mix it with the cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving. Serve with hot syrup.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Melt cheese in crock-pot; add sauce and meat and simmer for awhile. Serve with tortilla chips as dippers.

title: Quick Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Slice cabbage cook 10 minutes in salt water. Drain. Mix soup milk cabbage and cheese. Pour into casserole. Top with crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes in 350 degree oven.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
instructions: Bring to boil the water and sugar. Add Jell-O and pie filling. Mix and bring to boil again then cool slightly and add remaining 4 ingredients. Chill until firm.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl beat eggs and sugar. Add oil salt and flour. Mix well. Add vanilla cinnamon baking soda apples and nuts. Bake 1 hour or more at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 in well greased tube pan.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat milk egg oatmeal onion and salt. Form into balls. Make sauce out of remaining ingredients. Pour over meatballs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Dont cover. Add pepper if desired.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
instructions: Mix dressing and oil; add seasonings. Pour over crackers. Put in warm oven 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Texas-Style Beans And Rice
instructions: Combine beans tomatoes picante sauce beer and brown sugar in large saucepan. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes. Stir in rice and salt; heat through. Sprinkle with onion and cilantro.

title: White Cheese Dip
instructions: Cube cheese and put in a saucepan. Over medium - low heat add just enough milk to melt the cheese to the desired consistency stirring constantly so cheese doesnt burn. Blend in finely chopped jalapenos to taste. Leftovers may be refrigerated and reheated on the stovetop by adding a little milk and stirring over medium - low heat.

title: Amaretto
instructions: Bring brown sugar and water to a boil. Let syrup cool. Mix almond extract and vodka to syrup. Shake well. Let stand for 3 days.

title: Christmas Candy
instructions: With hands thoroughly mix above ingredients. Shape into small balls. Place on wax paper and chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Vidalia Onion Seafood Casserole
instructions: Saute onions celery and green pepper in margarine. Add pimento cream of celery soup milk and cream cheese. Heat slowly until blended. Add rice and shrimp; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Place crushed crackers on top the last 10 minutes of baking. (Cover top of casserole with crumbs.)

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown ground meat; drain fat. Stir in tomato sauce beans and seasoning. Prepare muffin mix according to the package directions. Spread muffin mix batter over chili mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Bake 5 minutes more or until cheese melts. Serves 6.

title: Grandma Stoddard'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Stir sugar oleo and milk together in pan. Boil to soft ball stage (about 5 minutes). Remove from heat. Add peanut butter; stir well. Add vanilla. Pour into a greased pan. Allow 30 minutes to cool.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Put crushed cornflakes on top after baking with dots of butter. Place back in oven for a few minutes.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix until crumbs in a bowl.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar in a bowl. Blend in vanilla and sour cream. Chill about 30 minutes.

title: Green Beans And Corn Casserole
instructions: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish; combine butter and cracker crumbs and press one-half of mixture into the bottom of the casserole dish. Layer remaining ingredients in dish twice; top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until it bubbles.

title: Salted Pecans
instructions: Coat pecans with melted margarine; sprinkle with salt. Bake 20 minutes at 275\u00b0. Cool on paper towels.

title: Beef Cheese Log
instructions: Soften cream cheese. In a large bowl add mayo and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Add olives parsley and onion. Chill until firm. On wax paper shape into a 1 1/2-inch roll. Roll in dried beef. Garnish with parsley. Serve with crackers.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef; stir in tomatoes and tomato paste salt basil oregano garlic powder and water. Cover with lid and microwave 4 to 5 minutes or until boiling. Combine cottage cheese Parmesan cheese egg and parsley. Mix well. Pour in 1 1/2 cups tomato beef sauce in 8 x 12-inch glass dish. Place 4 uncooked noodles evenly over sauce. Top\twith 1/2 the cottage cheese mix spreading evenly. Sprinkle with 1/2 the Mozzarella cheese. Spoon 1 cup sauce over cheese. Place 4 more noodles on sauce top with even layers of remaining cottage cheese Mozzarella\tcheese\tand tomato sauce. Cover lightly with plastic wrap. Microwave 15 minutes rotating dish. Microwave at\t50% power for 15 to 20 minutes or until noodles are tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Microwave uncovered 1 1/2\tto 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.\tLet stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Party Fizz
instructions: Pour the orange juice into a bowl then the pineapple juice and club soda. Add the sherbet and mix everything with an egg beater. Pour the fizz into glasses.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Dredge roast in flour. Brown slowly on all sides in hot fat. Season generously with salt and pepper. Add onions. Mix remaining ingredients except mushrooms and add to roast. Cover and cook slowly at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Then add mushrooms. Blend 2 tablespoons flour to thicken gravy.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine margarine brown sugar and pretzels. Mix well and pat into a lightly buttered 9 x 12-inch Pyrex baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. While hot add strawberries. Cool until mixture begins to thicken.

title: Peanut Butter Health Bread
instructions: In medium bowl stir flour oats baking powder and salt. In large bowl with mixer at medium speed beat peanut butter and sugar until smooth. Beat in egg. Gradually add milk. With mixer on low beat in dry ingredients until smooth. Stir in raisins.

title: Country Sausage
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil and pat mixture into 8 small cakes. Heat oil in large skillet and fry cakes about 20 minutes turning until brown and crisp on both sides. Serves 4.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. The last 15 minutes of baking add crushed potato chips on top.

title: Skillet Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In an electric skillet combine sugar butter and milk. Set the heat control at 280\u00b0. Bring to full boil and boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Turn off heat. Add marshmallows peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until melted. Cool. Cut into squares. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine cocoa flour cornstarch sugar and salt in a saucepan. Add egg yolks butter and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Stir. Cool and pour into baked pie shell. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Within an hour of serving spread whipped cream over top.

title: Gooey Buns
instructions: Grind bologna and cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Butter 6 buns. Fill and wrap individually in tinfoil. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Using your favorite casserole dish layer stuffing asparagus and eggs and sprinkle with pepper and onion. Repeat until dish is full. Pour soup and asparagus liquid on top and spread. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbles up.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar salt eggs margarine milk and vanilla and pour into casserole dish. Combine brown sugar flour pecans and margarine in a medium bowl and sprinkle over potatoes mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fondue
instructions: Combine cornstarch and water in a small saucepan. Add remaining ingredients; stir until smooth. Cook over medium heat until mixture boils stirring constantly. Serve warm as a dip with fresh fruit. Serves 1 cup.

title: Wayne'S Hush Puppies(For Large Gatherings)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Submerge if possible until brown. Enjoy!

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Knead if necessary. Make into walnut size balls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Beginner'S Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and salt together in bowl. Cut in shortening with fork until mixture looks like corn meal. Add water a little at a time. Let set a few minutes. Knead on floured surface and shape into pie shell.

title: Spinach Polenta Casserole
instructions: Saute garlic in oil until crisp. Remove and add the spinach and salt and pepper to taste. Steam until limp. Remove from pan and squeeze dry when cool.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix together 1 hour over low heat until thick. When thick remove from heat. Add 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and vanilla extract. Stir. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Enjoy!

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese together. Slowly add sugar beating until fluffy. Beat in egg yolk. Add flour and vanilla and mix well. Chill dough at least 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Gently press a cherry half or pecan half into each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bottom of cookies start to brown 6 to 10 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Place all ingredients in cooker. Bring to a boil; turn down. When it forms a soft ball in cold water take off stove. Let cool then mix with a mixer.

title: Church Windows Candies
instructions: Melt margarine and chocolate chips. Let cool slightly. Add nuts and marshmallows. Spread coconut on wax paper. Divide mixture into four rolls. Roll in coconut. Wrap in wax paper. Place in refrigerator for 24 hours before slicing. Cut in 1/2-inch thick slices.

title: Corn Custard
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Stir in eggs. Scald milk and 2 tablespoons butter; add to corn mixture. Pour into a greased casserole and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Mix crumbs in 1 tablespoon butter and sprinkle on top. Bake until browned.

title: Ground Meat Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender; add to other ingredients. Pour into baking dish and cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and top with grated cheese if desired. Return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Aunt Jo'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix and boil sugar brown sugar salt and milk for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients and beat thoroughly. Immediately place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate until cool.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Beat eggs brown sugar oil and vanilla until thick and foamy. Stir in rhubarb and nuts. Mix flour baking powder baking soda and spices. Add to the rhubarb mixture and stir until just blended.

title: Hungarian Rhapsody
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet. Over high heat brown the cutlets briefly on both sides; do not overcook. Reserve browned cutlets on a warmed platter. In the same skillet over medium heat saute chopped onion and garlic in the remaining olive oil until lightly browned 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in paprika and cook 2 minutes longer. Blend in sour cream until just heated through. Do not allow the mixture to boil! Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Spoon the sauce over the cutlets; serve with boiled rice.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Heat the oven to 325\u00b0. Mix cake mix oil eggs and sour cream by hand. Pour 1/2 of batter in cake pan (greased and floured). Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour remaining batter on top. Swirl. Bake for 40 minutes. Ice.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Generously grease bottoms only of 2 baking pans 9 x 5 x 3-inches. Beat all ingredients on low speed scraping bowl constantly for 1 minute. Beat on medium speed for 1 minute. Pour into pans. Bake until wooden toothpick inserted into center comes out clean about 1 hour. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 dry ingredients. Add milk vanilla and butter and beat until smooth. Stir in the walnuts and spread the batter in a buttered 6 cup casserole. Over the batter sprinkle the mixture of the brown sugar and cocoa. Over this pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes. Do not attempt to turn out this cake. The bottom is full of fudge sauce. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Christmas Punch(Ison Family Tradition)
instructions: You will need a punch bowl cups potato masher and whisk.

title: Microwave Taco Chops
instructions: Combine taco mix with cornflake crumbs. Dip one side of each chop into egg and then into crumb mixture. Reserve remaining egg and crumbs. Place crumb side up into 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish or large pie plate placing meaty ends of chops toward outside of dish. Microwave uncovered on High for 5 minutes turning dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes. Turn chops over; top with remaining egg and crumbs. Dissolve bouillon cube in water on High for 30 seconds. Stir. Pour around (not over) chops. Cover with plastic wrap; microwave for 6 minutes on High rotating dish once. Let stand covered for 5 minutes. Use pan drippings for gravy if desired. Serves 4. Simply delicious!

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Beat all together with mixer. Makes one 9-inch pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Spiced Sesame Seed Crescents
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder mace and salt. Gradually stir sugar into softened butter. Beat in egg. Add flour mixture gradually mixing after each addition. Let dough stand 30 minutes at room temperature. With fingers on waxed paper shape a rounded teaspoonful of dough at a time into a roll 2-inches long. Taper ends. Roll in lightly toasted sesame seed. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Curve ends to form crescents. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned around the bottom. Cool on wire rack.

title: Quick Fruit Pie
instructions: Roll out biscuits. Fill with fruit and seal edges like fried pies. Place in single layer in casserole dish. Pour liquid mixture over pies. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Disgustingly Rich Brownies
instructions: You will also need measuring cups and spoons a bowl an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan and an oven. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 then smear the inside of the pan with shortening.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Soak chicken pieces in beaten eggs overnight. Roll chicken pieces in Italian bread crumbs and saute in butter. Arrange pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add to the drippings in your frying pan 1 cup chicken broth and 1/2 cup dry white wine. Pour over chicken; top with mushrooms and grated Muenster cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes (decrease oven temperature to 325\u00b0 if using a glass baking dish).

title: Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Put all ingredients in pie plate. Mix well and press into shape partially covering rim of plate. Pinch dough into fluting for edge. Prick bottom and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Burrito
instructions: Lay tortilla on flat surface; spread evenly with peanut butter and raspberry spread. Sprinkle with coconut if desired. Place banana on edge of tortilla; roll up to enclose. Wrap loosely in paper towel. Microwave on High for 35 seconds.

title: Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together ice cream and Cool Whip. Smooth in bowl. Freeze slightly until it mounds then spoon into graham cracker crust. Freeze for 4 hours.

title: No Salt Herb Shaker
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into salt shaker and use instead of salt.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa salt milk and vanilla in a 1-quart glass dish. Cut butter in slices and put on top. Cook on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Stir until smooth. Add nuts. Pour into wax paper lined 8-inch square dish. Chill until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Football Popcorn
instructions: Melt oleo in a saucepan. Stir in brown sugar. Simmer until syrup forms. Immediately pour over already popped popcorn. Stir well.

title: Breakfast Bake
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Combine all ingredients. Pour into two 9-inch pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Ham can be substituted for sausage.

title: Plain Jane Cake
instructions: Mix butter Crisco and sugar together until smooth. Add eggs one at a time until they are mixed in well. Gradually add milk and flour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Croquettes
instructions: Stir onion in melted butter until brown. Blend in dry ingredients. Add water and stir until thick. Add meat and cook 2 minutes. Break in egg. Stir until mixed. Chill. To mold dip in cracker meal seasoned beaten eggs then cracker meal again. Chill. Roll in melted butter; cook on baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for one-half hour. Serve with tomato or mushroom sauce. Makes 6 regular size.

title: Nadine Krall'S Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown chops in frypan. Pour onion soup mix and enough water over chops to keep chops covered. Cook for 1/2 hour. Add Minute rice and simmer. For two people use 1/2 cup rice.

title: Honey Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Place all ingredients into bread machine pan in the order listed. Use \dough\ setting to make dough. Remove when dough setting is done. Use margarine to coat hands for easy removal and roll shaping.

title: Cherry Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend Eagle Brand Cool Whip lemon juice crushed pineapple cherry jello and almond flavoring. Add bananas cherry pie filling and pecans. Fold in. Chill.

title: Creamy Reception Punch
instructions: Spoon vanilla ice cream by tablespoons into a large punch bowl. Add juices stirring to muddle ice cream. Slowly pour in 7-Up or Sprite. Stir to mix.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine egg milk and oil. Add sifted dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Bake on ungreased griddle. Pour batter from 1/4 cup measuring cup. Makes 12 small cakes.

title: Green Stuff Salad
instructions: Heat pear juice to boiling. Pour over jello and dissolve. While hot pour jello over cream cheese. Mix well with mixer until blended. Place mixture in refrigerator or freezer until it starts to set. Add whipped cream with mixer until well blended. Add nuts and pears; pour into serving bowl. Chill until firm.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together in large bowl. May freeze if wanted.

title: Confectioners Sugar
instructions: Whirl together in blender until fine.

title: Hot Cranberry Cider
instructions: In large saucepan combine ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Remove spices. Serve warm.

title: Peppers 'N Potatoes
instructions: In 12-inch nonstick skillet heat margarine until bubbly; add bell peppers onions and garlic. Saute until vegetables are softened. Stir in water broth mix and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Add potatoes cover and let simmer stirring occasionally until tender. (Add more water if necessary to prevent sticking.)

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix together in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Watch carefully they brown quickly. You can make these any size you like.

title: Corn Salad With Mesquite Turkey Breast
instructions: Toss together corn celery bell pepper olives and cilantro in large bowl. Combine dressing and cumin in measuring cup and pour over corn mixture. Toss to coat. Line 4 plates with spinach leaves and place 1 cup corn salad in center of each plate. Fold 4 to 5 slices turkey into fourths and tuck around corn salad or cut turkey into strips and arrange strips around corn.

title: Jalapeno Dip
instructions: This dip is put in layers; either on a glass plate or in a glass bowl.

title: Supreme Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Chop in bite-size pieces. Slice water chestnuts. Crush crackers. Sprinkle 1/2 crackers in bottom of baking dish. Mix chicken soup water chestnuts sour cream and onions together. Pour in baking dish. Top with remaining crumbs and sprinkle butter over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Impossible Taco Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inch). Cook and stir beef and onions until brown; drain. Stir in seasoning mix; spread into plate. Top with chillies. Beat milk baking mix and eggs until smooth 15 seconds in blender or 1 minute with mixer. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes. Top with sliced tomatoes and cheese then bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 8 to 10 minutes or longer. Cool 5 minutes. Serve with sour cream chopped tomatoes shredded lettuce and Cheddar cheese.

title: Diabetic'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix juice from pineapple lemon juice and enough orange juice to make 1 cup. Add sweetener. Dissolve cornstarch in water and add to juice. Boil and stir until thick. Cool. Combine canned fruit and fresh fruit. Mix in fruit dressing; allow to stand to let flavors blend. Makes 1 cup dressing. Leftover will keep or double recipe.

title: Pineapple Shortcake
instructions: Just dip canned biscuits in vegetable oil. Turn in granulated sugar and place on cookie sheet. Flatten each with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 10 minutes in preheated 425\u00b0 oven then on with the golden crushed pineapple and a topping of whipped cream. Garnish with a cherry.

title: Sausage Muffins
instructions: Cook sausage and drain well. Mix flour corn meal egg milk and oil. Add sausage. Place in greased muffin pan and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mustard Potato Salad
instructions: Cool potatoes completely. To make mustard dressing in a large serving bowl combine white wine vinegar Dijon mustard and salt. Whisk in olive oil until well blended. Add sliced red potatoes scallions and roasted red peppers. Toss to coat well with mustard-oil dressing.

title: Caramel-Peanut Pie
instructions: Place 1 cup sugar in heavy skillet; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar melts and forms a light brown syrup. Reduce heat to low; gradually add boiling water in a slow stream stirring constantly with a wire whisk. Remove from heat.

title: Fresh Spinach Salad
instructions: Wash spinach - mix all ingredients - Serve immediately.

title: Sad Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients; beat well. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven. Cake is done when it falls in middle. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Christmas Wreath
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows. Allow to melt gradually over low heat. Stir until creamy. Add food coloring; mix good. Add corn flakes. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Press hole in middle to form a wreath shape. Press cinnamon candy on to appear as berries. Allow to harden. Place layers of wax paper between layers of wreath.

title: Lace Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Pour melted butter over and stir. Add beaten egg and vanilla. Drop by 1/4 teaspoon onto aluminum foil on cookie sheet leaving lots of room in between. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes. Let cookies cool on foil before peeling off. Use new foil for each sheet of cookies. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Good Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat sugar Pet milk and egg yolks until sugar is dissolved. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in with vanilla. Pour in freezer. If not enough to fill to line fill with milk. Any fruit you desire can be added to this.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash in small amount of water until done and drain. Mix all ingredients together. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle top with buttered crumbs. Bake 45 minutes or until set at 350\u00b0.

title: Homemade White Bread
instructions: Heat 4 cups water to 110\u00b0; use 3/4 cup of the water and dissolve yeast and 3/4 teaspoon regular sugar. Stir in flour Sweet N Low salt pepper and Crisco.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients. Microwave until melted. Serve with corn chips.

title: Bacon-N-Eggs
instructions: Cut hard-boiled eggs in half and remove yolks. Mix with mayonnaise salt pepper and crumbled bacon. Put mixture back into eggs and serve. Kids love them. Serve for breakfast with toast.

title: Sarah'S Lasagne
instructions: In large heavy pan lightly brown beef and onion in oil. Drain. Add tomatoes (put through blender) paste water parsley salt sugar garlic powder pepper and oregano. Simmer uncovered stirring occasionally for 30 minutes.

title: New England Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Beat together the sugar and butter. Add eggs and milk. Add dry ingredients and beat for 1 minute. Fold in blueberries.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the pie shell. Pour into shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until set 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Turkey Dressing
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet. In margarine saute chopped onion chopped celery and leaves. Add salt pepper sage thyme (may be omitted and recipe is still just as good) and poultry seasoning.

title: Celery Casserole
instructions: Cook celery in small amount of salt water until tender but crisp. Drain; add remaining ingredients except crumbs. Put in shallow 2-quart dish; sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Fish
instructions: Dip fish in dressing. Melt margarine in flat pan. Pour part off to be used later. Roll fish in cracker crumbs and put single layer in pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice and then chopped onion. Pour remaining margarine over fish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. (May be placed under broiler very briefly after baked for a crisper coating.)

title: Holiday Sweet Potato Surprise
instructions: Cook the sweet potatoes in boiling water 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Drain and cool. Peel the potatoes and mash. Combine mashed sweet potatoes frosting vanilla and cinnamon; mix well. Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes. Sprinkle with marshmallows. Continue baking 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Carved Watermelon
instructions: Mix all ingredients until sugar is dissolved.

title: Sauce For Ribs Or Burgers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. The sauce can then be sealed in a jar and stored in the refrigerator or used at once. Yield Enough sauce for three chickens halved or for 5 to 6 pounds of ribs.

title: Chicken And Biscuit Dinner
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut each biscuit into half. In saucepan put chicken or turkey gravy beans seasoning and pepper. Cook and stir until bubbly. This can be baked in a casserole or individual baking cups. Spoon into dishes and top with three biscuit pieces on each casserole. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until biscuits are golden. This is a fun recipe for kids to do.

title: Scotch Shortbread
instructions: Sift flour measure add salt and sift again. Cream butter gradually add confectioners sugar and beat until light. Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture. Blend thoroughly. Put dough in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut in squares before completely cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix together in saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until comes to boil. Pour in bowl; cool mixture by putting bowl in cold water with ice cubes in it. Stir while cooling until thickens. Add 1 1/2 cups whipped cream or Dream Whip. Mix well. Pour in 9-inch cold pie shell. Refrigerate about 2 hours before serving. Serve with more Cool Whip or strawberries.

title: Diabetic Maple Flavored Pancake Syrup
instructions: In small saucepan combine apple juice and cornstarch. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in butter Equal maple flavoring and vanilla. Serve over pancakes waffles or French toast. Makes 1 cup.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix grape jelly and chili sauce. Warm in microwave. Place meatballs in crock-pot. Pour jelly sauce mix over meatballs. Simmer on low for 1 hour or until heated through.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Sift cocoa and powdered sugar into bowl. Stir in liquor which has been combined with syrup; mix well. Add vanilla wafers and nuts; mix well. Form into 3/4-inch balls and roll in powdered sugar. Dry several hours. Freezes well. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Tea Tarts
instructions: Soak yeast in water until dissolved. Mix dry ingredients and shortening as for pie crust. Combine everything as for pie crust. Combine everything just until blended and chill for several hours or overnight. Roll on sugared board 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick. Cut in squares. Put spoon of jam on center of square and fold three cornered. Press edges together. Place on pans and let raise 30 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Corinne'S Famous Pea Salad
instructions: Place 1/2 head of lettuce on bottom of bowl. Sprinkle with salt pepper and sugar. Layer eggs atop lettuce in bowl. Add more salt. Layer as follows Peas remaining lettuce bacon and Swiss cheese. Spread mayonnaise over top sealing to edge of bowl. Cover and chill 24 hours. Toss before serving.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add ham and a slice of cheese to breast and fold over. Secure with long toothpicks. Coat with flour. In a large skillet add 2 tablespoons butter. Cook about 4 minutes on each side. Melt remaining butter in skillet. Add mushrooms and onion; saute. Add water chicken bouillon parsley and chives. Bring to a boil. Return chicken to sauce. Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Bring sauce to boil again and stir in heavy cream. Cook on low heat until sauce thickens slightly. Pour sauce over chicken to serve. Serves 4.

title: Strawberry Surprise
instructions: Cook cake according to directions on package. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put glaze on top of cake (cooled). Place cut strawberries on top and top with Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Hot Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook covered for about 1 hour at 250\u00b0 in a 2-quart casserole. May add ripened bananas. Serves 7 to 8.

title: Sunflower Seed Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars shortening and eggs. Add water and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 120.

title: Sausage-Peach Breakfast Bake
instructions: Drain peaches and reserve liquid. Cut sausage links crosswise into bite-size pieces. Prepare pancake mix as usual except use up to 1 c. of peach liquid as part of the mixture. Turn into a 9 x 13 baking dish and arrange peaches and sausage on top. Bake 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with syrup.

title: Spiders
instructions: Melt chips and then add peanuts and chow mein noodles. Spoon onto wax paper. Chill.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until brown; drain. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place in an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward the center. Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust; sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese. Beat eggs together with milk salt and pepper. Pour into crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mrs. Fields Cookies
instructions: *Put small amount into blender until it turns to powder. Measure first then blend.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Cook ground beef in skillet. Add onions and green pepper; saute. Add other ingredients. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Mix buttermilk baking mix milk sugar and eggs together and spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Arrange apple slices evenly over the top. Drizzle apples with melted butter. Stir sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle over all. Drizzle with cream. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Wonderful served still warm. Scoop out with a large spoon to serve.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Wash and core apples. Pare apples 1/3 of the way down or slit the skin around the apple about halfway down. Place apples in baking dish. Put sugar and butter in center of each apple. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Pour water around apples to prevent sticking.

title: Josette'S Lasagna Roll-Ups
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet and set aside. Boil noodles until cooked and rinse with water.\tBlend cheeses together and set aside. Add browned ground meat with sauce and seasoning in a pan and simmer. Spread cheeses onto noodle on one side. Roll noodles curly side out. Cut in half. Do so with remainder of noodles. Pour sauce into baking dish and place noodles with non-curly side down into sauce. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve warm.

title: Anytime Dip
instructions: Low-fat sour cream and mayonnaise may be used.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well. Store in jar. Use 1/3 cup mixture to 1 cup boiling water. Delicious!!

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Crumble bread together in a pan and bake at 300\u00b0 until dry and golden brown. Stir often. Once dry add butter eggs baking powder salt pepper celery and onion. Add sage to taste. Add hot broth and mix well. Bake in greased pan at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hungarian Coffee Cake
instructions: Crumble brown sugar butter and flour together like pie dough. Reserve 1 cup for topping. Mix together by hand the beaten eggs and sour cream. Mix soda salt and vanilla with flour mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Crumble on reserved topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Check at 35 minutes.

title: Pudding Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juices from pineapple and mandarin oranges into large bowl. Add instant pudding and Tang. Stir until smooth. Add bananas kiwi fruit pineapple oranges grapes and strawberries. Mix well and chill. Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water and cool until partially set. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into 5-cup mold and chill until firm. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tangy Meatballs
instructions: Combine beef salt pepper egg and cream. Shape into 1/4-inch balls. In skillet brown meatballs in butter turning carefully to avoid piercing. Combine remaining ingredients; add to brown meatballs. Cover; reduce temperature and simmer about 30 minutes. Serve warm. Makes about 4 or 5 dozen.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in casserole dish in microwave. In separate container mix together flour baking powder salt sugar and milk. Pour this mixture over melted butter in casserole dish. Heat berries through. Pour over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Pasta With Chicken
instructions: In large skillet melt butter. Add chicken onion and garlic; cook until chicken and onion are tender. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Reduce heat; simmer covered stirring frequently 10 minutes. Meanwhile cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Serve sauce over hot pasta; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar flour salt and milk in top of double boiler. Cook until mixture begins to thicken. Add a little of the mixture to egg yolks. Then add to mixture and cook about 3 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heap sliced apples in pie plate; add lemon juice and sugar. Add cinnamon as desired. Crumble brown sugar butter flour and salt on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Hamburg Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Cook noodles until not quite done; drain. Put in greased casserole. Put 1 layer hamburg and 1 layer noodles. Cover with mushroom soup. Repeat layers and cover with celery soup. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly and lightly browned on top.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix together oil and sugar. Add eggs. Sift dry ingredients. Blend into first mixture. Add carrots and nuts. Grease and flour 2 (10-inch) pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. When cool ice with cream cheese frosting.

title: Grape Sunshine
instructions: Using real ripe grapes wash and remove stems. Place in large kettle with enough water to cover bottom of pan only. Kettle can be pretty full of grapes. Cook over medium heat until skins pop open. Run grapes skins and seeds through a sieve crushing grapes and skins as much as possible. Stir in 1 box of Sure-Jell with pulp in kettle. Bring to a full boil over high heat. Add sugar at once bringing to a full boil again; stir constantly. Boil 1 minute then remove from heat. Skim off foam. Put hot mixture in jars or glasses and top with melted paraffin.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except chocolate chips. Place chocolate chips on top before baking. Bake in cake pan for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Passover Rolls Or Muffins
instructions: Boil water and oil together. Add matzoh meal sugar and salt. Mix off of the heat. Beat very well. Add eggs 2 at a time beating very well. Bake in muffin tin at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-Os in hot water. Mix together and when thickened pour over mixture.

title: Pizzacato Pizza Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Take sausage out of casing and crumble. Brown and drain off grease. Stir in tomato puree sauce water mushrooms and seasonings. Simmer 15 minutes. Add cooked macaroni and stir well. Put 1/3 of meat and macaroni mixture into a greased 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle with 1/3 Mozzarella cheese. Repeat with remaining 2/3. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Spicy Pecans
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in deep Dutch oven pan. Cook until soft. (Boil at 232\u00b0.) Add pecans and stir until coated. Spread and separate with fork; cool completely. Store in tin box.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease large casserole dish 9 x 13-inch. Unroll crescent rolls. Lay out on bottom of dish. Press together. Cook sausage and drain. Pour over rolls. Beat eggs and add milk together. Pour over sausage. Mix grated cheese. Pour over top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Glazed Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Put butter or oleo in hot mashed potatoes; stir until butter is melted. Add sugar slightly beaten egg and flavoring. Pour into unbaked 9-inch crust. Sprinkle 1/4 sugar over top of pie. Wait until sugar becomes moist then put into oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done and glaze has formed.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; then mix with applesauce. Add sifted dry ingredients raisins and nuts. Beat and pour into buttered floured loaf pan. Bake slowly 1 1/4 hours at 325\u00b0. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Holiday Bourbon Slush
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except Sprite) and freeze 2 days.

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar and beat. Add melted shortening and juice. Mix well. Add salt baking powder flour and mix until smooth and easy to handle. Make into different shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Decorate with colored sugar or frosting.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Place meat in heavy kettle or skillet and cook slowly until meat changes color. Add onions and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Add other ingredients except soup. Simmer for about 1 hour. Add soup and cook a while longer. Salt to taste.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Melt the butter; pour over the dry ingredients. Mix until crumbly. Spread over 1 can of apple pie filling. Bake until brown at 325\u00b0.

title: Pudding Bars
instructions: Mix instant pudding according to directions. Add cake mix then bag of chocolate chips. Mix well. Pour on cookie sheet (greased) and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Pour sugar over chopped apples; let set 10 minutes. Mix eggs and shortening. Add dry ingredients raisins and nuts. Stir in apple mixture. Batter is stiff. Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Needs no frosting. Cool before cutting.

title: Butterscotch Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: In saucepan melt morsels and margarine. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press half of mixture firmly into the bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Long Island Iced Tea
instructions: Mix together to make 1 serving. Multiply times 4 to make a pitcher.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Put tomato paste in large cooking pot. Add 5 cans warm water and bring to a boil. Add sugar oregano Lawrys salt onion and Italian seasoning. Simmer for about 2 hours. Add mushrooms and browned hamburger during last half hour. Serve with pasta. Makes great lasagna too. Serves 4 to 6 people. Recipe can be doubled.

title: April'S Beef Stew
instructions: In a large saucepan brown meat and drain well. Return meat to saucepan. Add onion garlic and thyme. Stir in vegetable juice bouillon and water. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover; simmer 1 hour. Stir in potatoes celery and carrots. Cover; simmer 30 minutes more.

title: Melba Sauce
instructions: Put frozen raspberries into a quart glass measuring pitcher. Heat uncovered in microwave oven 1 minute on High. Stir to break berries apart. Cook uncovered 30 seconds on High or until berries are defrosted. Stir a mixture of sugar and cornstarch into raspberries then stir in currant jelly. Cook in microwave oven 6 minutes on High until sauce thickens.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix powdered sugar and cheese then mix in Cool Whip and peanut butter. Pour in graham cracker crust and chill for 1 hour.

title: Polo Star Candy
instructions: Melt the almond bark and peanut butter. Remove from heat. Stir in peanuts rice krispies and marshmallows. Stir until well coated and drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Honey Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken skin side down in a baking dish. In a separate bowl mix honey mustard lemon juice and salt. Spoon half of mixture over chicken. Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and congeal.

title: Oreo Cookie Cheesecake
instructions: In a food processor whirl 1/2 package of the cookies including filling until they form fine crumbs; mix in butter. Scoop crumbs into a 9-inch cheesecake pan with removable bottom and press crumbs evenly over bottom of pan and about 1/2-inch up sides. Chill crust to firm about 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni in salted water 6 minutes. Drain and rinse well to remove starch. Set aside.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello\tin hot water.\tAdd pineapple and blueberries. Chill until firm.

title: Dee'S Strawberry Pudding Cake
instructions: Crumble cake in baking pan. Put berries over cake. Let set in freezer while you mix pudding and milk. Pour mix over cake. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Coconut Pecan Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl combine brownie mix water oil and egg. Beat 50 strokes by hand. Add frosting and sour cream; mix well. Spread batter in greased pan. Sprinkle pecans and chocolate chips evenly over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 42 to 52 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Combine caramels 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1/4 cup margarine in a double boiler until melted. Combine cake mix 1/2 cup margarine 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1 cup walnuts. Spread half in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Spread caramel mixture over the chips. Top with remaining cake mix. Bake 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. Do not bake longer! Cut into bars.

title: Hot Maple Toddy
instructions: In medium saucepan combine all ingredients (except optional). Over low heat simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Serve hot with butter and cinnamon sticks if desired.

title: Poppy Seed Bread Or Muffins
instructions: Beat all ingredients together in large mixing bowl for 2 minutes. Pour into 2 greased 9-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 15 slices per loaf. (Also can use for muffins.) Contains less than 1 gram of fat per 1/2-inch slice.

title: Mauna Loa Muffins(Third Place Winner Of 1992 Mauna Loa Contest)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray muffin tins with cooking spray. In large bowl\tbeat milk oil and egg. Blend in remaining ingredients until flour is just moistened. Fill in muffin cups 3/4 full; sprinkle with sugar. Bake until tops are browned for 15 to 18 minutes. Makes 10 to 12 muffins.

title: Eggless Spice Cake
instructions: Sift all ingredients. Place in bowl and add 1/2 cup melted shortening 2 cups water and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well and bake in layers in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Spicy Glazed Wieners
instructions: Cut 3 thin gashes on each wiener. In medium saucepan over medium heat cook remaining ingredients stirring until cranberry sauce melts and becomes smooth. Add wieners and heat through. Serve hot with cocktail picks. Makes 48 appetizers.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream (Frosty)
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip then chocolate milk. Put into electric freezer. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Gumbo
instructions: Get a large pot and put in the spareribs beef and chicken wings. Boil spareribs for about 1/2 hour. Saute 1 pound of boneless chuck beef and put in large pot. Saute pack of chicken wings and put in pot. Put in can of tomato puree and tomato sauce. Add diced onions salt pepper mustard ketchup sugar Adobo seasoning and whole tomatoes. Simmer for 2 hours and then add 1 pound of deveined shrimp.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken
instructions: Skin chicken breasts and arrange in baking dish. Place 1 piece of Swiss cheese in each piece of chicken. Stir together soup and wine or water. Spoon over chicken. Top with stuffing mix and drizzle melted butter over each piece of chicken. Bake uncovered for 55 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in beans and 1/2 can fried onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Stir then top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: *Save some nuts and cherries for top.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix well and serve with fresh fruit.

title: Molded Lemon Dessert
instructions: Make jello according to directions. When fairly thick whip the milk. Add to jello (using large bowl). Add sugar lemon juice and vanilla. Put 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add jello mixture. Put remainder of crumbs on top. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pasta With Broccoli Di Rape And Sausage
instructions: Remove the long stems and tough outer leaves from the Broccoli di Rape. Keep florets and small leaves cut up place in colander and wash several times. Pour oil into pan on medium heat. Lightly crush garlic place in heated oil and allow to turn golden then remove garlic if you wish. Remove casing from sausage place meat in pan and cook thoroughly breaking the pieces of meat apart as they continue to cook. If you still have not removed the garlic do so now. Drain all but 1 tablespoon oil from pan; add Broccoli di Rape to pan and mix with cooked sausage. Keep mixing together add your broth mix and cook for approximately 5 minutes. Mix flour and butter together to form a roux and stir into your mixture. Cook approximately 5 minutes more until sauce thickens. Serve over pasta and add the grated Italian cheese of choice.

title: Sausage And Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage. In a large casserole dish slice potatoes and onion (in rings). Put cheese 1 cup on top of potatoes and onion. Layer browned meat on top of potatoes onion and cheese. Then put a can of green beans drained.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in baking dish. Bake until golden brown.

title: Three Layer Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Million Dollar Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Whip Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix pineapple and sugar. In saucepan bring water and gelatin to a boil. Pour over sugar and pineapple and stir. Refrigerate until slightly set. Add carrots celery cottage cheese nuts whipped topping and mayonnaise to pineapple mixture. Refrigerate until set.

title: Marinara Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Saute onion and green pepper until transparent. Add both cans of tomato then remaining ingredients. Stir and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Healthy Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown sirloin with onion. Add other ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes or so. Serve open-faced on bread of choice.

title: Virgin Island Soup
instructions: Simmer first 5 ingredients together 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 more minutes.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels
instructions: Drain chilies and olives. In mixing bowl combine all ingredients except tortillas. Spread mixture onto tortillas and roll up jelly roll fashion. Cover with damp paper towel and plastic wrap to prevent drying out. Chill for several hours. To serve slice tortillas into 1-inch segments. Serve with salsa for dipping.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Cut Crisco and flour together. Mix in salt. Gently mix in ice water with hands. Roll out for pie.

title: Florentine Lasagna Roll-Ups
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook lasagna noodles. Cool in large bowl of cold water; set aside. Saute onions in 2 tablespoons butter until tender.

title: Great Pheasant Or Partridge
instructions: Do not thicken! Pour over meat and bake for 2 hours on low. Serve with rice.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Do not use electric mixer. Use hand wire whisk. Slightly beat egg yolks; stir in 1 cup milk. Then stir in remaining milk sugar and coconut. Beat egg whites and stir in mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until centers jell.

title: Shrimp And Cheese Strata
instructions: Cut each slice of bread in half on the diagonal or cut into cubes. Dip in melted butter. Arrange half the bread slices or cubes in an unbuttered 8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with half the cheese onions parsley and shrimp. Add remaining bread and repeat process. Beat eggs salt mustard milk and sour cream together. Pour over casserole. Cover and chill overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and golden. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Combine sugar water cinnamon and nutmeg. Bring to a boil and add oleo. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Add milk all at once. Stir until flour is moistened.

title: Green Beans Supreme
instructions: Cook green beans; drain. Cook onion and parsley in butter until onion is tender. Blend in flour lemon peel 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Add milk cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Stir in sour cream and cooked beans; heat until just bubbly. Spoon into 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Melt the remaining butter; toss with bread crumbs and sprinkle over beans. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat until cheese melts and crumbs brown 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine corn eggs and salt. Alternate layers of corn mixture and crumbs in greased baking dish. Dot with butter on each layer. Pour in milk. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Pour into pie plate (lined) then layer after mixing ingredients well together. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes to set the rim. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and continue baking for thirty minutes or until custard is set. Sprinkle a little grated coconut on top when removed from the oven.

title: Rice-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter or margarine. Cook broccoli and drain. Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Mix sauce and cream cheese set aside. Put lettuce on platter and spread out. Spread cream cheese mix on top of lettuce. Layer tomatoes peppers onion and olives on top. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add egg yolks. Sift flour and soda together; add alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla coconut and chopped nuts. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Chip Muffins
instructions: Combine just until moistened. Spoon into muffin pan with liners. Bake at 400 degrees for 15-18 minutes or until done. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Aunt Minnie'S Eggs
instructions: Cut bacon into small pieces (or crumble sausage into small pieces); fry. When meat is browned add bell pepper and onion. Cook until onion starts to clear. Beat eggs with milk. Add egg mixture to meat and vegetables. Top with cheese and cover.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar nuts and cinnamon. Pour 1/2 of this over the biscuits. Do other 2 cans of biscuits same as first 2 cans. Pour remaining mixture over top.

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: Put water and raisins in large pan; boil for 5 minutes (cool). While still warm add all other ingredients. Mix together well. Add nuts last. Grease cans fully to top. Half fill them. Bake until well brown in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes. Cool for short time. While still warm tip out of can on wax paper. (Use 3 or 4 No. 2 cans vegetable or fruit.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together until mixture is light and fluffy. Add egg raisins nuts and applesauce and mix together thoroughly. Sift all the dry ingredients together 3 times. Add to the creamed mixture and blend thoroughly. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate oven for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together in large mixing bowl; add pecans and mix. Make a well in the center. Mix the remaining ingredients. Pour into well. Stir enough to dampen all ingredients and then pour into two greased loaf pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: In a bowl mix all ingredients together except the crumbs or chips and put into refrigerator for 8 to 24 hours before serving time. In a baking dish a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole put ingredients and top with crumbled chips or bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Mix carrots onion celery sour cream and cheese. Pour into 1-quart baking dish. Melt oleo; add 1/2 cup cheese and Pepperidge Farm dressing. Mix and sprinkle over carrot mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cover with foil if topping is getting too brown.

title: Blond Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar. Add beaten egg and then dry ingredients. Add nuts and chocolate bits last. Bake in a square pan 8 x 8-inch. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lo-Cal Lemon Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium saucepan melt margarine; remove from heat. Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Press in bottom and up sides of 9-inch pie pan. Bake for 4 to 5 minutes or until crust is lightly browned. Chill.

title: South Of The Border Salad
instructions: Cook meats onion and garlic until meat is browned and onion tender. Stir in flour tomato sauce undrained tomatoes chilies and chili powder. Cook and stir until thickened.

title: Crockpot Chicken And Mushrooms
instructions: Mix salt pepper & paprika. Rub into surface of chicken using it all. Place chicken in crockpot. Alternate layers of chicken bouillion granules mushrooms and onions. Pour chicken soup mixture over chicken. Do not stir. Cover & cook on high for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or on low 5-6 hours until chicken is tender.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook chicken until tender; remove from bones and cut into bite size pieces. Save broth. Fry bacon until crisp. Break into small pieces. Saute onions and celery in bacon fat. Add tomatoes soup drained olives chicken and bacon. Cook spaghetti in broth and add to chicken mixture. Salt and pepper to taste; mix well. Cover with grated cheese. May use two 9 x 9-inch casseroles or one 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Cookie Cups
instructions: You will need one 12-cup muffin tin.

title: Crawfish Stew
instructions: Melt butter in a large heavy pot (iron preferred). Blend flour and stir over medium-low heat until roux is dark brown. Add onions celery and jalapeno pepper; cook until tender and crisp. Stir in water tomatoes crawfish and seasonings. Simmer over medium heat 15 minutes. Add okra pepper and parsley. Simmer until tender-crisp about 10 minutes. Stir in file powder. Ladle stew into soup bowls. Top each serving with 1/2 cup fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir together syrup and sugar in a deep microwave-safe bowl. Cook 4 minutes on High. Stir in nuts. Cook 3 3/4 minutes on High. Add margarine and vanilla; stir. Cook 1 1/2 minutes. Add soda. Stir until light and foamy. Pour on lightly greased cookie sheet. Do not spread. Let cool. Break into pieces.

title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil until soft ball stage the cocoa sugar butter and milk. Remove from heat. Immediately stir in the vanilla oats and nuts. Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls; ready to eat when cool (about 15 minutes).

title: The Best Snickerdoodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix together thoroughly the shortening sugar and eggs. Sift together the next 4 ingredients and stir into creamed mixture. Chill dough.

title: Excellent Crock-Pot Mincemeat
instructions: Mix together in crock-pot. Start out on high; then once simmering turn to low for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Denise'S Prize Winning Chili
instructions: Brown hamburg and onions. Add salt and pepper to taste. In a large pot add hamburg mixture and all the other ingredients except the kidney beans and cook over low heat. Cook uncovered stirring occasionally for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Roasted Pecans
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Add remaining ingredients then pecans. Stir well. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring occasionally until they are golden brown. Remove and drain on paper towels.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well then add sugar. Shape into eggs or balls. Can be eaten plain or dip into melted chocolate.

title: Apple Nut Squares
instructions: Combine eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients. Then add to egg mixture and mix well. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in a slightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in small amount of water. Drain and mash. Fold in butter eggs soup salt and pepper. Place in buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Teddy Bear Popcorn
instructions: Prepare popcorn as package directs. In large bowl combine cinnamon-sugar cocoa and salt. Stir in popcorn tossing to coat well. Stir in graham snacks and M&Ms. Makes 11 cups.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix prepared pasta and vegetables in a large bowl. Add dressing. Mix lightly. Refrigerate several hours. Stir and serve.

title: Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into small balls. Flatten with hand on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Velveeta Fudge
instructions: Melt together Velveeta cheese and oleo. Add cocoa powdered sugar cheese oleo vanilla and chopped nuts. Work together and spread on cookie sheet. Place in refrigerator to set up. Keep in cool place.

title: Squash Casserole #2
instructions: Melt butter and mix in stuffing. Line part of casserole dish with part of stuffing. Spoon in other ingredients (mixed together).\tCover with remainder of stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and Jell-O dry. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Alice'S No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to rolling boil. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour boiled mixture over oatmeal mixture. Stir and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool completely.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pan Cookie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl mix margarine sugars vanilla and eggs with mixer. Gradually add flour until well blended. Stir in chips and nuts. Spread in greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. (Check after 30 minutes.) Cool then cut into squares.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except flour. Gradually add flour stirring lightly. Pour into muffin cup inserts in muffin pans. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 2 dozen muffins.

title: Scalloped Potatoes With Cheddar Cheese
instructions: Empty soup into 2-quart casserole. Stir in milk gradually. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover tightly and microwave on High 20 to 35 minutes stirring every 10 minutes until tender. Let stand covered for 5 minutes.

title: Scones(Recipe From Ireland, 100 Years Old)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with pastry blender. Drop by big spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 6 to 8 scones. Serve warm with jam jelly or honey. Quick easy and good. They freeze well. Heat in microwave a few seconds.

title: Rice And Beef Porcupines
instructions: Combine all ingredients form into small balls. Brown lightly in oil. Drain off excess. Add tomato sauce and water. Cover tightly. Simmer for 45 to 50 minutes until rice is done.

title: Bob'S Creamy Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar condensed milk and water. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils. Cook to 330\u00b0 until soft ball forms in cold water.

title: Miniature Cheesecake(Makes 4 Dozen)
instructions: Drop into inner circle of cooled cakes and bake 5 minutes only at 400\u00b0.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Combine Miracle Whip Italian dressing and cheese. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly. Serve chilled.

title: Hacienda Hamburger
instructions: Brown meat in oil in electric skillet or large frying pan. Add celery and onion; cover and cook slowly 10 minutes. Add tomato paste water noodles cheese olives salt and pepper; stir to combine. Cook slowly until noodles are tender about 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Boil peppers until tender (firm but tender) then drain. Brown hamburger seasoned with chili and set aside. Saute onion and bread chunks in a small amount of leftover hamburger drippings. Add stewed tomatoes and hamburger mixing thoroughly. Fill peppers with mixture. Nice served with jello on the side with a vegetable.

title: Bourbon N' Steak Barbecue
instructions: Mix bourbon and soy sauce in flat roasting pan preferably steel. Marinate steak for at least 5 hours more if you have time. Barbecue as usual seasoning steak as desired while cooking. Sauce may be stored in refrigerator and used again. Double ingredients if necessary as meat should almost be covered while marinating.

title: Chicken Wreath
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients except crescent rolls. Arrange crescent rolls in a circle with the bases overlapping in the middle and the pointed ends outward. Put the mixture in the base part and fold the points inward. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. You can substitute boiled cut up chicken and slivered almonds for canned chicken and water chestnuts.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients and put in buttered dish. Salt and pepper one side of chicken and put seasoning salt on the other side. Stand breast up in dish over rice and soup. Melt 1 stick of butter and pour over top of chicken. Bake for 2 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Simmer on reduce heat for 20 minutes or until tender. Melt butter in small pan. Add flour salt and pepper; blend. Add milk stirring until mixture boils. Add cheese and cook until cheese melts. Stir cheese sauce into vegetable mixture. Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Rich Loaf Bread
instructions: Sift flour before measuring. Scald milk. Add sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Add yeast and beaten eggs. Add half of the flour and beat 3 minutes. Add rest of flour half a cup at a time and stir after each addition. Knead. Shape. Allow to rise until light and bake.

title: Wild Rice And Mushrooms
instructions: Saute onion slowly in butter. Smooth in flour and brown. Add bouillon cube dissolved in boiling water and juice from can of mushrooms. Let simmer for about 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and cook until heated through. Serve over wild rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach according to package. Drain well. Combine ingredients and mix. Shape into 3/4 inch balls. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 11 dozen. Can be frozen before baked. Thaw slightly and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Seven Minute Icing
instructions: Put all ingredients except vanilla in top of boiler. Stir until well mixed. Place over simmering but not boiling water. Cook beating constantly with electric mixer at high speed for about 7 minutes or until icing becomes stiff and glossy. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Stir until blended.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Heat oil in a 10-inch skillet. Add onion green pepper and beef. Cook until brown stirring occasionally. Add the next 6 ingredients. Cover and simmer about 1 hour stirring occasionally. Add more water if mixture gets too thick. Combine garlic and salt then add with kidney beans to the meat mixture and heat through. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine ketchup soy sauce and brown sugar. Add chicken wings and mix well. Put in bowl and cover. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour. Lower to 325\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Apple Muffins
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside. Mix eggs pumpkin and oil. Stir into dry ingredients to moisten. Stir in apples and other fruit. Fill muffin pans 3/4 full. Grease pans or use paper holders. Sprinkle topping on each muffin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Orange Balls(Unbaked)
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs. Add powdered sugar butter orange juice and nuts. Mix well with hands. Form into balls. Chill. Store in refrigerator. If desired roll in coconut immediately after shaping.

title: Enchilada Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet. Drain off fat. Mix together soups enchilada sauce and chilies. Add drained meat to this mixture. Grate and mix together Velveeta and Cheddar. In a deep casserole (9 x 12) alternate layers of 4 to 6 corn tortillas 1/2 meat mixture and 1/2 grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves about 8.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Put over batter; then put rest of batter on top of apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ham And Pasta Salad
instructions: Gently\ttoss ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

title: Chocolate Fudge Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Cream 3/4 cup sugar with 2 tablespoons butter. Stir in milk. Sift flour 2 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and salt together. Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix until smooth. Add chopped walnuts and spread in a buttered 9-inch pan. Mix well 1/2 cup sugar brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa. Sprinkle over the batter. Pour boiling water over the top and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Easy Spinach Casserole
instructions: In a microwave oven cook spinach (without water) covered for about 6 to 8 minutes until spinach is hot. Remove from oven and drain well. Mix together sour cream and salad dressing mix and then stir into the spinach. Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and paprika on top. Return to microwave for 3 to 4 minutes or may be baked in a regular oven for 25 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. (I prefer the regular oven.)

title: Grandma'S Doughnuts
instructions: Cream sugar with shortening. Add eggs unbeaten. Add vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with milk to which baking soda has been added. Roll on floured board. Cut and fry in hot deep fat.

title: Open-Face Apple Pie
instructions: Mix well. Place into uncooked pie shell. Cook for 15 minutes on 325\u00b0. Turn oven to 350\u00b0 and cook 30 minutes more.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Fluffy Banana Pudding
instructions: Pour milk into blender. Add pudding mix. Blend in blender 1 to 2 minutes. Refrigerate 1 hour. Gently stir in whipped topping. Place wafers in bottom and sides of Pyrex dish. Put in pudding mixture. Add bananas and more vanilla wafers. Repeat in layers until reaches top. Last layer is cream mixture. Place in refrigerator until time to serve.

title: Quick And Easy Homemade Biscuits
instructions: Combine all ingredients form a ball\tand knead until smooth. Pat out dough and cut out biscuits. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 10 large biscuits or more smaller ones.

title: Pineapple Cookies
