instructions: Mix shortening sugar and egg well (will look sour). Blend flour soda salt and nutmeg. Mix all together. Chill 1 hour or longer. Drop by rounded teaspoon approximately 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes approximately 5 dozen.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: In a saucepan cook onion garlic and tarragon in margarine. Stir in cornstarch. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly. Gradually add cheeses stirring till melted. Serve with bread or chips. Makes 2 cups.

title: Strawberry Fluff
instructions: Fix jello with hot water as instructed. Instead of cold water use 1 pound frozen strawberries. Mix well. Then add 3/4 of Cool Whip and mix until firm; may need to put in freezer for a few minutes. When firm take angel food and break into small pieces and work into jello mix. Take extra Cool Whip and cover top; also on top cut fresh strawberries and mix a design on top.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Combine blueberries sugar cornstarch and water in saucepan and cook over medium heat stirring until thick. Cool.

title: Pineapple Burgers
instructions: Set oven at broil and/or 550\u00b0. Shape meat into 8 thin patties; sprinkle with salt. Place pineapple slice on each of 4 patties. Top with remaining patties and press edges together to seal. Place patties on rack in broiler pan. Broil with tops 4-inches from heat until brown 3 to 5 minutes. Mix brown sugar ketchup and mustard. Turn patties. Spoon mixture on patties and broil until desired doneness 3 to 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: The day before serving drain and dry fruits on paper towels. Arrange fruit on shallow \bake and serve\ dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Melt butter and add curry powder. Pour over fruit. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Refrigerate and reheat until bubbly hot when ready to serve. Cooking the casserole one day early allows curry flavor to penetrate fruits for best flavor. Serves 12.

title: Syrup Tea Cakes
instructions: Roll 1/4 inch thick. Cut into whatever shape you choose. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Sip And Cheer
instructions: In a 2-quart non-metal container combine bourbon lemonade beer and lemon juice. Refrigerate. Serve over ice and garnish with mint leaves and lemon slices if desired. Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Cheesy Omelets
instructions: Preheat skillet. Mix eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour mixture into skillet. When eggs are done turn burner to simmer. Break cheese into 4ths and place on eggs. Serve after cheese melts.

title: Sloppy Tom
instructions: In a large skillet that has been sprayed with Pam cook turkey until brown. Combine all other ingredients and add to turkey. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.

title: Company Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and hot water; cool. When partially set add pineapple marshmallows and bananas. Chill to set in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cheesy Hash Brown Bake
instructions: Mix all together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Let stand overnight or a few hours to blend flavors. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until golden brown on top. Makes 12 servings.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter. Add Crisco milk and eggs; blend. Add flour salt baking powder and sugar; beat well with mixer 2 to 3 minutes. Pour into well-greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour then at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pasta Supreme
instructions: Cook pasta as directed and cool. Chop up vegetables any size you please. Mix pasta vegetables Italian dressing and Salad Supreme (1/2 to 3/4 jar) to taste.

title: Sour Milk Cookies
instructions: Mix together and bake. Cookies are very good and moist.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix and set in refrigerate or 3 hours or overnight.

title: Golden Smoothies
instructions: Place the first four ingredients in a blender; cover and process until smooth. Pour into glasses; garnish with orange and cherries if desired.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Fully cook sausage and drain well. Mix sausage onions cheese and flour. Beat eggs and milk; pour over the sausage mixture. Mix all well and pour into pie shell. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients. Sprinkle cheese on top. Add cracker crumbs or bread crumbs on top of cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Mallow Fudge Squares
instructions: Boil sugar milk oleo and chocolate to soft ball stage. Beat while cooling. Mix together marshmallows graham crackers nuts and vanilla. Add this to the chocolate mixture. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Check with toothpick.

title: Happiness Cookies(By:  Luerle Ruff)
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Add tears of joy sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith. Blend well. Fold into daily life. Bake well in a warmth of human kindness and serve with a smile anytime. It will satisfy the hunger of starved souls.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix broccoli cheese and 1/4 cup butter together and place in a 2-quart casserole dish. Mix crackers and 1/4 cup butter melted together and sprinkle on broccoli mixture. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer the first 5 ingredients in order given. Top with mayonnaise bacon and cheese. Garnish with tomato wedges and cucumber slices. Refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together and form a loaf. Place in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 90 minutes.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Rub a mixing bowl with the garlic clove which has been cut in half. (I use garlic salt to taste instead of fresh garlic.) Place the cream cheese in a bowl and cream with a spoon until smooth and gradually add the remaining ingredients blending well.

title: Chili For Charlie
instructions: Brown beef in oil. Add onion and pepper. Saute until onion is transparent. Add remaining ingredients. Cover pan and bring to a quick boil. Lower heat and simmer slowly for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Freezes well.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Arrange strawberries cut in half on top of cream mixture. Top with glaze. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Cheesy Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Add water to unpeeled potatoes just to cover. Sprinkle with salt. Bring to boiling for 30 to 35 minutes. Drain. Peel and shred potatoes with a grater. In a large mixing bowl combine potatoes cheese and butter; stir until butter is melted. Stir in sour cream green onion salt and the pepper. Transfer to a greased pan. Bake uncovered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. Makes 8 servings.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together. Just before serving add the can of onions and stir.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except fried onions). Place in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been sprayed with Pam. Bake for 60 minutes covered. Uncover and sprinkle with fried onions. Bake for additional 15 minutes.

title: Joy'S Salmon Spread
instructions: Combine the cream cheese lemon juice horseradish and seasonings in bowl; mix well. Add salmon; mix well. Chill in refrigerator overnight.

title: Grandma'S Peach Crisp
instructions: Arrange peaches in an 8 x 8-inch pan. In a small bowl combine oats sugar flour and spices. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

title: Southwest Stew
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add rest of ingredients. Bring to boil. Simmer 20 minutes. (May include 3 to 4 quartered potatoes.)

title: Quick Mexican Venison
instructions: Brown venison; drain any grease. In a large stew pot add all ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce temperature to a simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes. Season to taste with garlic salt and black pepper.

title: Cherry Nut Icing For Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cook the sugar milk and Karo until soft ball stage. Add dates cherries pecans butter and vanilla.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Soak raisins in hot water for 10 minutes; drain. Mix the flour with sugar. Add beaten egg yolks. Cream together and add cream and raisins. Cook over low heat stirring until thick. Cool and add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Make meringue from egg whites and bake until nicely browned.

title: Rich Waffles
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in mixer bowl. Add buttermilk margarine and eggs. Mix well and beat at medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes. Bake in heated waffle iron.

title: Beef-And-Tater-Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onions; dip off excess grease. Add soups and cook to bubble stage. Pour into greased casserole dish. Put Tater Tots on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until Tater Tots are brown.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix Bisquick 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cocoa in a greased 8-inch square baking dish. Stir in milk and vanilla until well blended. Sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/3 cup cocoa and 1/2 cup sugar. Pour water on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until top is firm. Serve at once topped with ice cream.

title: Cloud Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in Crisco like coarse crumbs. Combine egg and milk. Add to flour mixture. Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead gently with heel of hand 20 strokes. Roll to 3/4-inch thickness. Cut and place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 10 to 14 minutes or until light brown. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Hot Spiced Apple Cider
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a large pot. Heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Be careful not to let mixture boil or the cider will become to heavily spiced. Pour into mugs and serve with cheese or popcorn.

title: Mike'S Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork in oil and set aside. Saute celery and onion in pork juices until limp.

title: Party Meatballs
instructions: In a bowl mix hamburger with onion soup mix. Form into meatballs and fry until done. While frying meatballs put chili sauce and grape jelly in crock-pot with 1 onion and let cook. When meatballs are done place in crock-pot and serve. Great for parties!

title: Spicy Zucchini Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Mix brown sugar margarine eggs and vanilla in large bowl. Stir in flour baking soda cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Stir in zucchini and raisins. Spread in pan. Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean; cool. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting. Cut into 2 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Refrigerate any remaining bars. Makes 32 bars.

title: Fortune Cookies
instructions: In a bowl mix flour sugar cornstarch and salt. Add cooking oil and add white; stir until smooth. Add water and mix well. Make one cookie at a time. Pour 1 tablespoon of the batter on a greased skillet. Spread into a circle. Cook 4 minutes on one side and 1 minute on the other at low temperature. Working quickly put a message in the cookie. Fold in half and in half again.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and eggs. Mix flour powdered sugar and salt. Then mix slowly together. Roll into balls (size of walnuts). Roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place 2 1/2-inches apart on ungreased sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water to beans and top with bacon strips before cooking.

title: Southwestern Gratin Eggs
instructions: On the day before Drain yogurt through cheesecloth and refrigerate. Chop peppers and onions and refrigerate. Grate cheese and refrigerate. Use 9 x 13-inch casserole. Spray with Pam. Spread chopped bell peppers onions and grated jalapeno cheese. In separate bowl beat eggs yogurt milk salt and pepper. Pour over peppers onions and cheese mixture. Sprinkle the one cup grated Cheddar cheese over entire casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Let cool ten minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Vienna Torte
instructions: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored. Add sugar; beat well. Add flour salt and vanilla. Beat egg whites until frothy. Add cream of tartar and beat until very stiff. Add egg yolk mixture to whites folding carefully. Pour into large ungreased angel food pan. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Kim'S Ham And Hash Brown Omelet
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble. Cook ham; crumble. Add potatoes onion and pepper to skillet and cook until brown and crisp. Blend eggs and milk; pour over potatoes. Top with cheese bacon and ham. Cover and cook at low temperature for 10 minutes. Serve in 4 wedges.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease dish. Brown together the beef and onion. Drain off grease. Stir in taco seasoning mix. Spread meat mixture in greased dish.

title: Jack Straws (Candy)
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Add the remaining ingredients and mix very well. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Allow to air dry. Store in an airtight container.

title: Reese Cookies
instructions: Mix all top 4 ingredients together real good. Make into small balls and press 1 Kiss in each. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 5 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Fix 1 large or 2 small boxes of stuffing mix. Fix according to directions but use a little less water so its on the dry side. Boil and chunk up chicken (2 cups or so). Mix with mayonnaise and a little salt. Layer 1/2 of dressing mix in 9 x 13-inch pan spread chicken over it. Then put rest of dressing over this. Mix eggs plus 1 cup milk together pour over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Set out 1 hour before baking. Mix cream of chicken soup with 1/2 cup milk pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground meat; drain. Heat tortillas until soft if you want to roll enchiladas. The fast way is to layer in a greased casserole dish tortillas meat onions and cheese until used up. Finish with tortillas. Mix and heat remaining ingredients. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Arrange apples in pan. Mix remaining ingredients with fork. Sprinkle over apples. Bake until apples are tender and topping is golden brown. Serve with cream Dream Whip or ice cream.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first five ingredients in a Dutch oven or covered baking dish and bake 1 1/2 hours. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all together adding enough ketchup to color. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Individual Ham Loaves
instructions: Mix ground beef ham eggs milk mustard and corn flakes. Grease muffin tins and sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of muffin cups. Spread pineapple over brown sugar. Shape meat mixture into balls and place in muffin cups. This is great for entertaining. (This can be made in 10 x 15-inch pan.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Makes 15 individual loaves.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Place rice on bottom of oblong pan. Arrange chicken parts on top of rice. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken. Spread mushroom soup over the soup mix. Pour in water and bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Uncover and bake another 30 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Crush Doritos and place in bottom of greased casserole. Prepare beef according to taco seasoning directions; place taco meat over crushed Doritos; combine soups and pour over meat. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and serve.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Blend butter sugar flour and salt. Add eggs; beat well. Stir in corn and bake for 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven in a greased casserole dish.

title: Sauerkraut Relish
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Snicker Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Pour half of batter into greased pan (no flour). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Microwave last 3 ingredients until butter melts and then stir and put back in bowl for 2 minutes. Take out and add 1/2 teaspoon soda; stir.

title: Spinach Bread
instructions: Cook spinach 7 minutes. Saute onions in butter and add cheese. Combine spinach with cheese mixture. Spread on French bread. Bake 5 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat. Add salt mustard butter onion pepper and one cup of water. Pressure cook 10 to 12 minutes. Make thickening of 2 tablespoons of flour and water. Stir into cooked meat. Add mushrooms simmer until thickened. Add sour cream. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Microwave Velveeta until smooth. Add the browned drained beef. Add tomatoes drained. Keep warm and serve as dip with corn chips.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: In saucepan cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrots. Fold in drained squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix and butter or margarine. Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture atop. Sprinkle remaining stuffing over vegetables. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Louisiana Whiskey Balls
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well and form into balls. Roll in additional powdered sugar. Makes about 2 dozen small balls.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Dice in apples and add nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in Bundt pan or two 8 x 8-inch pans.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Hickory Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl until light. Add egg mixing well. Stir in flour until well combined. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Shape dough into 2 long rolls; wrap each roll in waxed paper. Chill several hours. Slice rolls into 1/4-inch slices and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil. Beat eggs and add to sugar/oil with flour salt soda and cinnamon. Stir in carrots and nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes or in layer pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a 4-quart Dutch oven. Slowly cook onions in butter until lightly browned. Add bouillon cubes and water to onions. Cover and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Add Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper to soup; stir. When serving soup place a thin slice of French bread into the bottom of the bowl (must be able to go into the oven). Ladle soup into bowls; top with layer of shredded cheese. Place under broiler until cheese melts. Serve at once.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Set cream cheese out to get room temperature. Drain excess oil/water off tuna. Mix tuna and cream cheese together with a fork until tuna is blended well. Can be eaten chilled or as is. Great on crackers.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Saute onion and celery in 1 stick oleo. Add water potatoes salt and pepper. Cook until tender. Add corn soups and milk. Garnish with parsley. Do not dilute soups.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and slice as thin as possible. Chop onions and peppers; combine with cucumbers and salt. Let stand 3 hours and drain. Combine vinegar sugar and spices in a large preserving kettle; bring to a boil. Add drained cucumbers; heat thoroughly but do not boil. Pack while hot into sterilized jars and seal at once.

title: Beef Stew(18 Quarts)
instructions: Put just enough oil in pan to brown meat. Add other ingredients and cook on medium heat until vegetables are done.

title: Country Style Omelette
instructions: In large skillet saute sausage until done; add onion and butter until soft. Add potatoes; saute until lightly browned. Beat eggs salt pepper and water; pour over sausage-potato mixture. Cook until eggs are set. Turn with spatula. Cook other side. Serves 4.

title: Mexican Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine ingredients (first seven) and rub on chicken wings. Let stand for 15 minutes. Saute wings in oil and butter until lightly browned. Drain excess fat. Add garlic jalapeno and beer and simmer until liquid has turned to a glaze.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Frank'S Sausage And Peppers
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from green peppers and cut into chunks. In ovenproof dish saute green peppers in olive oil until soft (on top of stove). Sprinkle with a little salt. Remove green peppers from dish; brown sausage in same dish. Add red wine and cover; bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover add sauteed green pepper and bake 30 more minutes. Serve in same dish.

title: Easy Pralines
instructions: Mix the sugar milk butter and soda in saucepan. Cook to soft ball stage. The soda turns the sugar to caramel taste and color as it cooks. Remove from stove. Cool a few minutes. Add vanilla then beat. Before mixture begins to stiffen add nuts and spoon onto wax paper.

title: No Cook Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Melt margarine; add graham cracker crumbs peanut butter and confectioners sugar. Mix and spread on greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread on top of mixture. Set in refrigerator. Cut into squares when set.

title: Low Cholesterol Zesty Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and onion. Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole at 350\u00b0. Serves 4. Sausage Casserole plus a salad makes a fine low cholesterol meal.

title: Porcupine Balls
instructions: Combine the preceding and shape into balls. Place in roaster with 1 can tomato soup and 1 can tomato sauce well blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or longer.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Wash and slice 6 to\t8 squash and boil until done. Drain excess water and add 1/2 stick margarine and mash. Mix egg sugar and Pet milk. Pour into hot squash stirring fast. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm (20 to 30 minutes). Sprinkle with grated cheese and melt.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Butter a baking dish (8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch). Mix all but cheese and chips in dish. Sprinkle cheese and potato chips on top. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Pronto Pizza Burgers
instructions: In a bowl mix beef Parmesan cheese onion tomato paste oregano salt and pepper just until combined. Toast the muffins in broiler until lightly browned. Divide meat mixture among muffins. Broil 4 inches from the heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until meat is cooked. Top with tomato and cheese slices. Return to broiler until cheese is melted. If desired sprinkle with oregano. Serve immediately. Yields 4 servings.

title: Mexi Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain; stir in beans tomato sauce taco mix onion bell pepper mustard and 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Spread into ungreased pie plate. Spread sour cream on top of hamburger mixture. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon chili powder shredded cheese and chopped tomatoes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Blend egg yolk and vanilla. Add cake mix 1/3 at a time. Cover. Chill for 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Garlic Green Beans
instructions: Steam green beans for 15 minutes. In frypan heat olive oil. Add garlic and green beans; dry beans until done. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Ala Balsamic
instructions: Fry breaded chicken in garlic and olive oil. After frying all chicken saute and cover pan until chicken is fully cooked. Put aside sliced mushrooms red peppers and sliced onion and simmer. Take a little olive oil and garlic; simmer mushrooms red peppers and onions until cooked. When cooked pour over chicken and then pour balsamic vinegar over entire food. Simmer until hot.

title: Fix Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Place cooked potatoes in large bowl. Add butter cream cheese sour cream milk and salt. Mix until well blended. Spoon into 12 x 8 x 2 inch baking dish. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes just before serving time.

title: Oven Bag Chicken Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except chicken. Dust inside of large oven bag with flour and lay bag inside oblong baking pan. Arrange chicken cavity side up in a single layer in bag spooning mixture evenly over top. Tie bag; pierce top with 2 to 3 small slits. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar until blended; add peanut butter and mix well. Roll into balls (size of walnuts). Place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake 12 to 15 minutes in preheated oven at 325\u00b0. Yield 5 dozen cookies.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in large stew pot adding enough water to achieve desired consistency between soup or thick stew. Simmer on low to medium-low for 3 or 4 hours. Makes a very mild but tasty soup.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels 1/2 cup sugar and margarine. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip and\tspread over crumbs. Dissolve Jell-O in hot pineapple juice. Add strawberries and juice to Jell-O. Let set partially.\tSpread\tover top of cream cheese mixture. Chill. Cut into squares.

title: Butter Nut Balls
instructions: Blend shortening butter salt sugar and vanilla. Add flour and nuts. Place in refrigerator for about 1 hour. Place balls of dough on slightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Sift on powdered sugar.

title: Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Cook cauliflower and drain; drain peas. Combine cauliflower peas cheese and sour cream. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Cover with Ritz crackers. Dot with butter. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Country Pork Ribs
instructions: Place pork ribs (at room temperature) in roasting pan with a lid. Mix all the other ingredients together and spread over the ribs. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven until tender. Remove lid and bake 15 minutes longer to brown. This sauce is also good over beef short ribs beef spareribs or brisket.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Mix. Pat in an 8 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool.

title: Milk Chocolate Cake Icing
instructions: Blend together. Beat on high until smooth.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat soup; add cheese. Mix with cooked broccoli. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Graham Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Break each graham cracker in half. Place close together on a 17 1/4 x 11 x 1-inch nonstick cookie pan with side on it. Place butter and brown sugar in a glass measuring cup. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 1 minute or until butter is melted. Remove from microwave. Stir. Let cool at room temperature 2 minutes. Add pecans; mix well. Put a teaspoonful on each cracker. Bake 7 minutes. When cool remove and store.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes and drain. In large bowl combine soup mayonnaise onion and cheese. Add eggs; mix well. Then add chopped broccoli. Pour into 9 x 13-inch sprayed baking dish. Sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers (which have been sauteed in the melted margarine). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Dip I
instructions: In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan spread refried beans on bottom. Next spread cream cheese over beans. Brown ground beef; drain and add taco seasoning mix. Spread on cream cheese. Next spread salsa and top with cheese. Bake 15 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Hummus
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor. Process until well blended. Serve with pita chips celery and carrot sticks.

title: Diabetic Date Nut Cake
instructions: Cream the butter egg sweetener and vanilla. Add applesauce; mix well. Sift dry ingredients together. Stir in dates and nuts. Add to first mixture. Mix by beating at medium speed for several minutes. Turn into buttered loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Meat Ball Sauce
instructions: Mix together and pour over about 40 meat balls and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: English Muffin Loaf
instructions: Mix together yeast flour sugar salt and soda. Warm to 120\u00b0 milk and water. Mix milk and water into the dry ingredients. Add enough of 1 cup flour to make a stiff batter. Grease a loaf pan and sprinkle with corn meal. Put dough into pan. Let rise to double in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes (golden top).

title: Christmas Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and vanilla real good. Add 1 egg to sugar mixture. Beat until light and fluffy. Stir in 4 teaspoons milk. Mix flour and baking powder then add to liquid mixture. Put in refrigerator for 1 hour. Then roll out thin and cut into shapes. Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Frost and decorate.

title: Chicken Marengo
instructions: Pierce sausages; simmer in water to cover for 15 minutes. Drain. Brown sausages in Pam sprayed pot. Remove and brown chicken pieces in pot. Spray again if needed. Remove meat and cook onions until tender stirring frequently. Do not brown onions.

title: Chocolate Angel Food Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Follow directions on angel food mix package stirring cocoa and coffee powder into dry mix. Beat 1 1/2 minutes scraping bowl often. Bake 40 to 50 minutes in unoiled tube pan. Invert and cool thoroughly. Top with Berry Sauce. Makes 12 servings.

title: Dream Whip Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and place in covered container in the refrigerator for 3 or 4 hours before serving. This salad keeps well for several days. When mixing if real thick add some of the pineapple juice.

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: *Can omit m.s.g. if desired.

title: Oatmeal Casserole Breakfast
instructions: Dot peaches with 2 tablespoons butter. Sprinkle lemon juice and cinnamon over peaches. Sift flour salt and baking soda together and mix oats into mixture. Add brown sugar to margarine. Place peaches in bottom of 9 x 12-inch Pyrex baking dish. Combine flour-oats and margarine-sugar mixtures and spread over peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fresh Salad Freeze
instructions: Mash bananas with fork; blend in remaining ingredients. Stir well pour into molds. Freeze until firm.

title: Double Decadence Chocolate Chip Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Beat sugar margarine eggs and vanilla until smooth. Add 1 cup chips melted*; mix well. Add flour oats baking powder remaining cup of chips and the nuts mixing well. Spread into prepared pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownies pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Cut into bars. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Combine Italian dressing dry onion soup mix and apricot or guava preserves. Pour over chicken thighs which have been placed in a large shallow baking dish. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 and baste occasionally with pan drippings. Serve hot with rice and sweet and sour sauce.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mash squash up. Add eggs 1/2 cup crackers 1/4 cup butter milk onions cheese salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour into casserole and top with 1/4 cup melted butter. Sprinkle 1/2 cup crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown around edges. You may garnish with cheese if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Pone
instructions: To grated sweet potatoes add milk and other ingredients. Pour into large greased baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Sausage And Apple Stuffing
instructions: Place bread cubes in a large bowl and set aside. In a medium size skillet over medium heat saute sausage until well browned about 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to paper towels to drain and discard drippings. In same skillet melt butter. Add onion; saute until soft but not brown. Stir in stock apples and raisins; bring to a boil. Pour over bread cubes and mix in sausage salt and sage. (Makes approximately 10 cups). Great for light or dark poultry dishes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs flavorings and salt. Make paste of cocoa and food coloring. Add to first mixture. Alternately add flour and buttermilk. Mix soda and vinegar in small bowl; add to batter. Blend. Bake at 350\u00b0 in three 9 or 10-inch pans for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Orange Bread
instructions: Combine egg orange juice and salad oil. Combine dry ingredients plus cranberries and nuts. Stir juice mixture into dry mixture stirring just until moistened. Bake in greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until tests done. Remove from pan and cool.

title: Forgotten Chicken And Rice
instructions: Put rice mixed with onion soup and mushrooms in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut up chicken; salt and pepper the pieces and place on top of rice mixture. Mix cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup with 2 1/2 cans water. Pour over chicken on rice. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: In a large bowl make layers of cabbage green pepper and onion. Sprinkle 1 cup of sugar over top. In a saucepan combine the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring mixture to a full boil stirring constantly. Pour over slaw. Refrigerate at least 4 hours (best overnight). Mix well. (Will keep for weeks.)

title: Sinful Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O and water; cool. Add bananas pecans strawberries and pineapple to Jell-O. Divide in half. Pour 1/2 into 12 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until set. Spread sour cream evenly over Jell-O. Pour remaining 1/2 Jell-O over sour cream. Cover; refrigerate until set or overnight.

title: Irish Potato Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add potatoes extracts and spices. Mix well. Add milk. Combine flour soda and cocoa. Add the creamed mixtures. Add well beaten eggs. Dredge nuts and raisins with 1/4 cup flour; add to batter. Pour into a greased 10-inch tube pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Couple'S Club Delight
instructions: Mix together nuts flour and oleo; spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool.

title: Pink Lady Day Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; save juice. Add enough liquid to dissolve Jell-O. Mix Jell-O as directed. Place over medium heat stir until marshmallows melt and cool for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into mold and chill.

title: Cookie Clusters
instructions: Melt 2 squares of white bark in a 200\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes in a 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Remove from the oven when completely melted and add peanut butter. Mix. Combine granola and noodles to the mixture and coat well. Drop by tablespoon onto aluminum foil. Will harden when cooled. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape into ball and roll into flour. Cook in hot oil (360\u00b0) until brown about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Cake(No Mixing)
instructions: Spread pineapple in large baking dish. Sprinkle coconut over pineapple. Sprinkle brown sugar over coconut then sprinkle cake mix (dry from box). Slice butter thin and place over cake mix making sure to cover completely. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Nut Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Roll into meat balls. Roll in a little bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 or can be fried. Can be used with spaghetti.

title: Easy Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Press ground beef into an 8-inch buttered dish. Pour over this the can of undiluted soup. Spread frozen vegetables over soup and cover with Tater Tots. Bake about 40 minutes.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Melt butter and add all salts. Mix first 7 ingredients together pour butter and salt mixture with Worcestershire sauce. Put in oven at 200\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Drain on paper towel.

title: You Won'T Believe This Cornbread Stuffing
instructions: Put chicken broth in heavy saucepan. Bring to simmer. Pour corn meal into chicken broth slowly stirring constantly until thick about 10 minutes. Cover and set aside.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix sugar flour milk and peaches together. Put into bowl. Slice 1 stick of butter over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 until top rises and is golden brown.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Cream margarine and cheese together. Add flour paprika and salt. Work together into a roll and slice. Press sliced green olive into center of each circle. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Ranch Crackers
instructions: Coat oyster crackers with vegetable oil. Mix dry ingredients and toss with crackers. Bake 5 to 10 minutes in a 475\u00b0 oven.

title: Italian Cream Cake #2
instructions: Cream Crisco and margarine. Add sugar and vanilla. Add egg yolks one at a time. Sift flour and soda together; add to creamed mixture alternating with milk. Add nuts and coconut. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into the batter. Pour into 3 (9-inch) greased pans; bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Cook peppers in melted butter until tender. Remove peppers and add flour to butter; blend. Add warm milk and cook until thickened. Remove from heat and add well beaten yolks. Place over low flame and cook one minute stirring constantly. Add lemon juice and salt; blend with ingredients.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Mix in blender. Store in icebox.

title: Frosted Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Drain blueberries and pineapple. Measuring liquid add enough water to make 1 cup and add to jello mixture. Chill until jello becomes jelly. Fold in blueberries and pineapple. Pour into long dish and chill until firm.

title: Easy Country Gravy
instructions: Fry your sausage in a large skillet until brown. Add flour to sausage and in skillet and mix together. Brown flour and add milk. on medium high stir mixture often to keep from burning. Add sage salt and pepper. As gravy comes to a boil it will thicken. If it is too thick add 1/4 cup of more milk. Reduce heat after bringing to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. This is excellent served over chicken fried steak biscuits or potatoes.

title: Chinese Beef-N-Rice
instructions: In large skillet cook and stir rice in oil over medium heat until golden brown. Add salt water bouillon cubes and soy sauce. Cover tightly; simmer 20 minutes. Stir in onions celery green peppers and meat. Cover tightly; simmer 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice tender.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Dressing
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to directions on the box. Cut chicken in cubes; brown sausage chicken and onion together. Drain the fat; mix all ingredients together. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until lightly browned.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Add 2 heaping teaspoonfuls of this mix to cup of boiling water.

title: Lipton Cheese
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Cover and refrigerate. Hollow out a loaf of round rye or pumpernickel bread and put mixture in center. Cube the bread taken from the center and spread the cheese on it. Do not let the ingredients deter you from making this as it is really good!

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple and apricots with juices. Add instant pudding and mix well. Add bananas and nuts. Chill.

title: Ranch Biscuits
instructions: Mix yeast with warm water. Mix all other ingredients. Leave in refrigerator and use as needed.

title: Salmonettes Heloise
instructions: Open can of salmon pour the juice into a measuring cup and set aside. Dump the drained salmon in a mixing bowl. Drop in egg. Use a fork to break up salmon and mix the egg real good. When it is gummy add flour. Stir in flour thoroughly with fork. Mixture will be real thick.

title: Butter Crisp Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape in balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 6 to 8 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Southern Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip cheese until light and fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add milk blending thoroughly. Fold in topping. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Freeze and serve frozen.

title: Corn Bread Or Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients. Beat eggs. Add milk and stir into dry mixture. Add the Crisco and mix thoroughly. Pour into \hot\ cast-iron skillet or corn bread stick pan with about 1 tablespoon oil. Bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0 or until golden brown.

title: Helen Green'S Green Chili Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onions and chilies. Add mushroom soup. Layer with chips hamburger mixture and cheese in two layers. Bake until cheese melts in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Walnut Caramels
instructions: In large heavy saucepan combine sugar corn syrup butter and half of the cream. Heat to boiling over medium heat stirring constantly. Stir in remaining cream nuts and vanilla. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture reaches a temperature of 244\u00b0 on a candy thermometer (small amount dropped into very cold water will form a firm ball). As mixture becomes thick stir constantly. Immediately pour mixture evenly into a well buttered 8-inch square pan. Let stand until cool. Cut into 1-inch squares. Wrap individually in waxed paper or plastic wrap. Yields 64 candies (about 1 1/2 pounds).

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems of mushrooms and chop. Combine stems cheese butter and onion. Fill mushroom caps with mixture. Place on rack of broiler pan. Broil until filling is slightly crusty 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Sangria For 32
instructions: Cut lemons limes and oranges in half. Squeeze by hand to remove some juice and mix with the wine. Add brandy sugar and sliced fruit to the wine and let \mellow\ for one day. Serve chilled with maraschino cherry and additional fruit slice.

title: Microwave Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes medium thick. Layer in deep dish glass pie pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Dot with butter. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave 25 minutes on High.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Combine cornmeal flour salt and pepper. Dip tomato slices into cornmeal mixture. Heat bacon drippings until melted. Add tomato slices; cook turning once until golden brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Grandma Hanrahan'S Vanilla Icing
instructions: In a small bowl combine powdered sugar milk vanilla and a few drops of food coloring (if desired) stirring until smooth. The icing should be fluid but thick enough to form a line when drizzled from the tip of a spoon. If necessary add a few drops of milk to thin or a little more sugar to thicken. Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In a large skillet add olive oil and saute garlic and onions until soft about 2 1/2 minutes. Add carrots broccoli peppers mushrooms basil and crushed red pepper. Cook 5 minutes stirring until broccoli and carrots are crisp-tender. Add cream Parmesan parsley salt and pepper; cook until boiling. Pour over cooked linguine.

title: My Favorite Pasta-Garlic Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and garlic in olive oil until translucent. (Add a little water and cover if necessary.) Add mushrooms and continue heating in covered saucepan for about 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients including all liquid from clams; heat until hot in covered saucepan. Serve with 1 cup spaghetti or linguine (2 ounces dry) per serving. Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Strawberry Pineapple Cup
instructions: Drain pineapple. Alternate layers of pineapple and strawberries; sprinkle each layer with sugar. Sprinkle mint over top; chill thoroughly. Serve in sherbet glass. Serves 6.

title: Cherry Cola Salad
instructions: Add water to pie filling in saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add gelatin and stir. Add pineapple cola and nuts. Pour in mold and refrigerate.

title: Quick Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix potatoes cheese soup salad dressing onion and pepper. Spoon into 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with combined crushed corn flakes and margarine. Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese ham green onions accent onions and garlic together and form a ball. Roll in shredded cheddar cheese until completely covered. Reshape and wrap in plastic wrap to chill. Chill for about 2 hours before serving with your favorite crackers.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine broccoli with onion and cook as directed on broccoli package; drain. Combine vegetables with margarine rice cheese spread and mushroom soup. Pour mixture into a greased shallow 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Cookie Salad
instructions: Crumble 3/4 package cookies into bite-size pieces; set aside. Combine pudding and buttermilk thoroughly. Fold in whipped topping and then add the mandarin oranges. Refrigerate until ready to serve. When ready to serve mix in the crumbled cookie pieces and then place the remaining whole cookies on top for decoration.

title: Chicken Orleans
instructions: Roll chicken in seasoned flour (flour 1 teaspoon salt and pepper). Brown in vegetable oil in heavy frypan; remove. Cook onion garlic celery and green pepper until they begin to brown stirring occasionally. Stir in tomatoes rice Worcestershire sauce remaining salt and water. Arrange browned chicken over the top. Cover tightly. Let simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Swedish Heirloom Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually then salt and nuts. Blend in flour and mix thoroughly. Add water and vanilla. Mix thoroughly with fork. Shape into balls or crescents. Bake in greased sheet. Flatten slightly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese until smooth.\tAdd green pepper onion pineapple and 1/4 cup chopped nuts. Mix well. Shape into a ball and roll in remaining nuts. Chill overnight.

title: Rosebud'S Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Make a well in flour patting flour down lightly. Pour milk into the well. Add oil to milk. With hands gradually add flour to make soft dough. Flour hands. Pinch off dough; roll between hands forming biscuits. Place biscuits on pan greased with oil. (I place biscuits touching.) Dab oil onto top of each biscuit. Bake at 450\u00b0 for approximately 5 to 6 minutes or until done. Place on broil to slightly brown tops.

title: Apple Pasta Salad
instructions: Thoroughly combine yogurt pineapple salt spices ginger and honey. Refrigerate. Cook pasta according to package directions omitting salt. Rinse with cold water and drain thoroughly. Cool completely. In a large bowl combine all ingredients including yogurt dressing. Chill thoroughly before serving. Makes 8 (1 cup) servings.

title: Red And Green Christmas Salad
instructions: Place the spinach leaves in a large salad bowl and arrange the avocado slices in a circle around the edge of the salad. Place the pomegranate seeds in the center of the salad. Make the warm dressing. Pour 1 cup of the dressing over the salad at the table; toss and divide between salad plates. Makes 8 portions.

title: Amish Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine sugars oleo and oil. Add eggs and beat well. Add the flour soda cream of tartar and vanilla. Make into balls and roll in sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Beginner'S Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter and pour in baking dish. Mix flour sugar and milk together. Fold in berries and pour over butter. Do not stir. Bake until golden brown.

title: No-Bake Butterscotch Haystacks
instructions: Line cookie sheet with wax paper. Place butterscotch morsels peanut butter morsels and shortening in medium microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high about one minute. Stir. If necessary microwave an additional 15 seconds at a time stirring after each heating just until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred. Immediately add chow mein noodles; stir to coat. Drop mixture by heaping teaspoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheet. Let stand until firm. If necessary cover and refrigerate until firm. Store in refrigerator in tightly covered container. Yield 2 doz.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: In a skillet brown beef and onion. Drain any fat. Add remaining ingredients. Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole. Top with cheese and pepperoni. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Place pork chops in greased casserole dish salt and pepper. Place potatoes on top of chops. Pour mushroom soup on top of potatoes. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: White Chili
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small saucepan over medium heat in hot salad oil cook onion garlic and cumin until onion is tender. In a 2 1/2-quart casserole combine onion mixture with chicken white kidney beans garbanzo beans corn green chilies bouillon and 1 1/2 cups of water. Cover casserole and bake 50 to 60 minutes until chicken is tender.

title: Dole Cole Slaw Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl. Set aside. In small bowl mix seasoning from noodles vinegar oil and sugar. Mix all together and serve immediately.

title: Choc-Oat Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter or margarine and sugar until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats chocolate morsels and nuts. Mix well. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie. Cool 1 minute on pan then remove and cool completely. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onions and green pepper in hot fat until yellow. Add ground beef and fry until mixture falls apart. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Cover and bake 1 hour. Remove cover last 15 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 3 servings.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together. Fold in an 8 ounce container sour cream and a 6 ounce package chocolate chips. Bake in Bundt pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool completely and frost.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs; add strawberries. Combine and sift dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients gradually; mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Great with cream cheese.

title: Fish Patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a bowl. Form into patties. Fry until crisp in hot olive oil. Top with a slice of cheese. Serve with mustard or salsa sauce. Also makes a great burger sandwich. Serve on a bun with lettuce tomato and mayonnaise.

title: Rhubarb Crumb Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine rhubarb egg vanilla 4 tablespoons flour and sugar together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Blend 3/4 cup flour brown sugar and margarine together until crumbly. Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in soy sauce. Place chicken in baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar substitute. Pour remaining soy sauce over chicken. Bake covered for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Uncover and add peppers and pineapple. Bake 1/2 hour longer. Serves two. Each serving exchanges 3 meats 1 vegetable and 1 fruit.

title: Extra Rich Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Combine and bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. You may use any flavor that you prefer i.e. lemon cake mix and lemon pudding mix or white cake mix and vanilla pudding mix etc.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Sauce
instructions: Make paste of cornstarch and water. Combine with rest of ingredients; bring to a boil. Stir until thick.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Brown beef onion salt and pepper. Put into baking dish; add celery salt soups and rice. Add water and soy sauce; stir all together and bake 1 hour covered and 1/2 hour more uncovered at 350\u00b0.

title: Country Hash
instructions: Combine meats in one boiler. Cook until done. Cool for 15 to 20 minutes then chop. Add vinegar butter and onion. Reheat for 15 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quick And Simple Meal
instructions: Brown ground chuck and add chili powder garlic powder and tomatoes. Cook macaroni as directed on package. Mix ground chuck and macaroni. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in a covered casserole dish at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings. Can be frozen.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Spray a casserole dish with Pam. Add your corn and all of the ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve hot.

title: Barbara'S Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine and bake slowly in loaf pan.

title: L-H Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix in blender. Serve on greens and top with bacon.

title: Cornbread Muffins
instructions: Mix all this together. Put in greased muffin pans and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes approximately 12 muffins.

title: Ten-Minute Turkey Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Cover and let simmer about 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put strawberries in pie crust. Then mix sugar water cornstarch\tand jello. Pour over strawberries and bake. Put Cool Whip on top to serve.

title: Dorothy'S Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and flour. Mix together with wooden spoon and stir in soft butter and salt. Pour this over rhubarb in unbaked shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes and then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Kraft Macaroni And Hamburger
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed on package. Brown meat; drain. Add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender. Add soup. Add all together in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Stollen
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over the warm water in a small bowl; add a pinch of sugar stir to dissolve and let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Little Smokies
instructions: Put in pot and let simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: Pimento Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix with heavy-duty mixer until well blended. Refrigerate.

title: Barbecue Burgers
instructions: Fry ground chuck onion celery and mushrooms in shortening. Add ketchup tomatoes water and seasoning. Cover simmer 15 minutes. Add flour cook until slightly thick. Serve over round buns.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar cocoa flour cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Add milk; mix well. Cook stirring constantly until mixture boils. Boil one minute. Add part of cooked mixture to beaten egg yolks stirring to keep from lumping. Put all back into saucepan and cook one minute. Cool. Put in cooked pie crust. Top with meringue.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar vanilla and shortening until fluffy. Add eggs alternately with flour. Beat until well blended. Pour into well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until center is done. Cool about 10 minutes on wire rack. Remove from pan and cool completely. (Lemon flavoring or other flavoring may be substituted.)

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corn flakes. Press into casserole dish and top with corn flakes. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes until bubbly hot. Enjoy!

title: Honey Apple Squares
instructions: Step 1 Spread peanut butter on a cracker.

title: Iced Tea Ala Mode
instructions: Blend tea and ice cream until smooth and pour into a tall glass. Serves 3.

title: Road Runner Cake
instructions: Melt oleo and add to one beaten egg and cake mix. Press into a pan.

title: Shrimp And Pepper Pasta
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in oil in large skillet or wok until onion is tender but not brown. Add shrimp and peppers; cook about 4 minutes or until shrimp is cooked through stirring constantly. Add tomatoes picante sauce basil and oregano; heat through. Toss with linguine. Serve with additional picante sauce.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients and place in mixing bowl. Add cooking oil vanilla and can of pineapple. Mix well. Add eggs mixing well after each addition. Add grated sweet potatoes and pecans. Stir well. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/4 hours. Test with toothpick.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all liquids together. Mix all dry ingredients together then mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Low Fat Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 F. Spray a 9 inch tube pan well with cooking spray and set aside. In a large bowl mix together flour baking powder salt malted milk powder and nutmeg then set aside. In a separate bowl cream sugar together with butter and sour cream until light and fluffy. Add egg then egg whites beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla and milk. Fold liquid mixture into flour mixture until just combined. Gently fold blueberries into batter. Pour batter into pan and gently even out top with spatula or spoon. Bake cake until well browned on top and long skewer inserted in thickest part of cake comes out clean 50 minutes to 60 minutes. Let cake stand in pan for 5 minutes loosen edges and invert onto a serving plate. Sprinkle warm cake with confectioners sugar. Serve cake warm or at room temperature. Before serving refresh cake with a dusting of confectioners sugar if desired. Yield 16 servings 176 calories.

title: Hungarian Goulash(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Put steak cubes onions and garlic in crock-pot. Stir in flour and mix to coat steak cubes. Add all remaining ingredients except sour cream. Stir well. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 10 hours. Add sour cream 30 minutes before serving and stir in thoroughly. \May cook on high for 5 to 6 hours stirring occasionally.\ Serve over hot buttered noodles.

title: Nipponese Eggplant
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1/2-inch to 3/4-inch cubes. Meanwhile in a skillet fry onions in butter. Add eggplant soy sauce water and brown sugar to onions. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Creme Caramel
instructions: Butter eight 6 ounce custard cups. In small skillet over medium heat melt 1/2 cup sugar stirring until it is a light brown syrup. Pour syrup into buttered cups. Place cups in shallow baking pan for easy handling. Glass is best. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. In large bowl with mixer at low speed beat eggs salt and 1/2 cup sugar until lemon colored. Gradually beat in milk and vanilla extract. Pour mixture into prepared cups; put hot water into pan to within 1-inch of top of cups; bake 1 hour until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire racks. Refrigerate. When ready to serve use knife to loosen custard from cups and invert onto dessert plates letting syrup run down sides onto dish.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix all together and let congeal.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes; 325\u00b0 if using glass dish.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: In a small flat bottomed glass dish place layer of onion then a layer of crabmeat then a layer of radish. Repeat step. In a medium bowl whisk together the oil vinegar water lime juice salt and hot sauce. Pour over the last layer. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Serve on a bed of lettuce with cracked pepper crackers.

title: Spice Pork Chop Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Arrange pork chops in a single layer in a 3-quart baking dish. Bake chops for 20 minutes or until they begin to brown; spoon off fat. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl. Spoon mixture over chops and bake 15 minutes or until they are no longer pink. Stir sauce before serving.

title: Chili Chicken Dish
instructions: In large skillet saute poultry in oil until no longer pink; set aside. In same skillet cook onion peppers and garlic until tender. Drain. Stir in chili and stewed tomatoes. Add rice and pepper sauce. Arrange chicken on top of mixture. Simmer 10 minutes. Top with shredded cheese. Serves 6.

title: Apple Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Cut cream cheese and margarine into baking mix. Stir in milk. Turn dough onto surface dusted with baking mix; gently roll in baking mix to coat. Knead lightly 8 to 10 times. Roll into rectangle (12 x 8-inches); place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Spread Cream Cheese filling down center of rectangle. Make cut 2 1/2 inches long at inch intervals on 12 inch side of rectangle. Fold strips over filling overlapping. Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over top. Bake uncovered until golden 12 to 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Carefully place on wire rack; cool completely. Spoon pie filling down center of coffee cake. Sprinkle with walnuts. Refrigerate any remaining coffee cake. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Butter a 9 x 12-inch glass pan. Arrange rolls. Mix together pudding brown sugar and nuts. Sprinkle over rolls. Pour margarine over all. Mix together 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle this over all. Let rise 8 to 10 hours or overnight. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. After top is golden brown (20 minutes) cover with foil and finish baking. Let set for 5 minutes and turn out onto serving tray.

title: Maritime Seafood Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in 3 tablespoons butter. In a large saucepan melt 1/2 cup of butter. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and add onion celery and cheese. Stir until cheese is melted then add seafoods. Pour into a large casserole or individual dishes. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until browned and bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Prepare apples; set aside and cover. Measure oil in large mixing bowl add sugar and eggs and mix well at low speed until creamy smooth. Sift flour and measure. Then sift again with salt soda and baking powder. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture in small amounts. Beat well after each addition. When batter becomes stiff remove beater and finish mixing by hand. Fold in chopped nuts and apples last. Mix well. Spread evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan lined with greased wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 55 minutes to 1 hour. Turn out on cake rack to cool or ice and serve from the pan.

title: Chicken Breast In Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken; place in baking dish. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until brown (if desired). Combine soup mushroom pieces and milk; pour over chicken. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Sift flour alternately with milk and flavoring. Bake in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: In a large casserole dish layer crushed chips. Mix one container sour cream olives cream of chicken soup cream of mushroom soup and green chilies together; heat. Layer over chips. Layer in chicken and some cheese. Add sour cream more olives and chilies. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Feeds 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Bring to a fast boil then reduce heat to medium and cook about 20 minutes or until test for a hard ball. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Mix well. Pour into buttered dish with 1-inch sides. Let cool then cut into squares.

title: Strawberry Fluff
instructions: Combine flour oleo brown sugar and nuts; mix well. Spread on cookie sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 stirring occasionally. Cool then crumble reserving 1 cup. Spread remaining crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Blushing Bunny Sauce
instructions: Put salt pepper and flour with butter in double boiler. When melted add cheese (which has been broken into small pieces) and stir until cheese melts. Then add tomato sauce and beaten egg; stir until smooth. Serve on toast.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for last butter and corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until golden on top. Top with corn flakes and last butter during the last 1/2 hour of baking.

title: Cocoa Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan. Add corn syrup and milk and blend thoroughly; bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in butter and vanilla. Cool without stirring until pan feels warm to hand. Serve. Yields 1 1/2 cupfuls sauce. Very good!

title: Fluffy Frosting
instructions: Mix egg whites cream of tartar and sugar in small bowl with mixer at high speed gradually until smooth and glossy. Gradually beat in corn syrup vanilla and salt until stiff peaks form. If desired beat in food coloring or 1 cup coconut.

title: Shawn'S Deer Steak
instructions: Brown the venison in a skillet with 1/2 stick of margarine. When browned add onion and green pepper. Continue cooking on medium heat. Season with salt pepper and garlic salt. When onion is tender add Worcestershire sauce. Top with one can of diced tomatoes. Cover and simmer until meat is tender.

title: Silly Putty
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a small bowl. Try 1/4 cup of glue and 1/8 cup of starch; mix together. Allow to dry for 30 minutes to 1 hour before it will be workable. Store in airtight container. (This recipe may not work on a humid day.)

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil. Let cool for 2 minutes. Take 4 cans of biscuits and cut each one into fourths. Roll in some sugar and place in a greased Bundt pan. Pour sauce over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let cool. Turn over on plate and serve.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all the ingredients as you do for a cake and mix well. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for one hour and 30 minutes.

title: Finger Salad
instructions: Press the rolls on a cookie sheet and bake according to the package directions. Mix the cream cheese Miracle Whip and Hidden Valley Ranch together. Spread on cooled crescent rolls. Top with the vegetables. Top the vegetables with the Cheddar cheese and cut it into squares.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into desired shape. Roll in finely chopped pecans.

title: Easy Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine crumbs cheese salt and pepper. Dip chicken in butter then into crumbs being careful to coat heavily. Place in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes uncovered. Do not turn chicken. (This can be refrigerated overnight before baking.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place cooked broccoli in an ungreased Pyrex dish. Combine mushroom soup mayonnaise margarine eggs and onion. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle grated cheese over casserole and top with crushed crackers. Press cheese and crackers into casserole lightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Kentucky Hot Brown Sandwiches
instructions: Melt margarine in pan over low heat. Add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk and bouillon cubes. Cover over medium heat stirring until thickened and bubbly. Set aside. Place toast in buttered 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Top each with turkey and ham. Spoon white sauce over meat. Layer cheese tomato and bacon over sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. (Can use thinly sliced country ham or regular ham slices.)

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all together and chill for several hours. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Hershey Pie
instructions: Melt candy bars. Add a large container of Cool Whip unthawed. Pour into Oreo pie crust. Chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Microwave Hot Dogs
instructions: Place hot dog in bun. Carefully wrap single servings in separate paper towel. Smooth wrinkles in paper towel with hand or appropriate utensils as individual taste dictates. Place both items in microwave. Cook on High setting for approximately 40 to 60 seconds. See microwave for further details. When food is cooked to taste remove hot dogs from microwave unwrap from paper towel and add condiments.

title: Mexican Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients as given and bake in casserole for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and oranges and add sugar. Set aside for 1 hour. Mix Jell-O according to directions. Mix apples and nuts to cranberry mixture. Chill.

title: Tuna Melt Sandwiches
instructions: In a medium bowl combine celery cheese tuna onion mayo and salt; set aside. Spread butter over the cut side of buns. Spread tuna mixture on bun bottom; replace top. Wrap in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Lemon Bar
instructions: Mix dry cake mix margarine and egg together. Press mixture into bottom of 12 x 9-inch cake pan then mix powdered sugar 2 eggs cream cheese vanilla and lemon juice together until smooth. Spread second mixture evenly over the cake mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. You may want to sprinkle powdered sugar over top as it cools.

title: Harvard Beet Cake
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking soda together and set aside. In a bowl combine rest of ingredients except nuts and coconut and mix together. If beets are sliced not diced then cut them into smaller pieces. Beat mixture until well combined about 3 minutes; add flour mixture and beat in then stir in nuts and coconut. Batter will be reddish in color but will turn brown when baked. Spoon into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 or 60 minutes testing with a toothpick to see if it comes out clean. For a glass pan reduce oven heat to 325\u00b0. Cool and cut into squares. Keeps well in covered container.

title: Lasagne
instructions: BROWN sausage garlic and onion.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten each cookie with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Cool 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from sheet. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Artichokes And Cheese
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in glass dish at 350\u00b0 until golden brown about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips - El Grande Chips.

title: Roast Pheasant
instructions: Cut off necks of birds close to bodies leaving neck skin on to help hold the stuffing. Remove pin feathers; singe if needed. Rinse inside and out in warm water; drain and pat dry.

title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream together in a large bowl the sugar lard or other shortening molasses and eggs. Sift the flour ginger and salt. Dissolve the baking soda in the coffee. Stir dry ingredients into molasses mixture adding coffee alternately. Chill. Roll out dough to a thick layer 1/2-inch or so. Cut with round cutter. Dip into sugar. Place on greased baking sheet leaving room to spread. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes but do not let brown as they will be too hard. They are a good big soft cookie which keep well. Cool on rack and enjoy with a glass of milk.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening. Gradually add sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour baking powder salt and cocoa. Add milk and flour alternately. Add vanilla. Place in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Heat peppers water vinegar salt and sugar to boiling. Add eggs and simmer for 5 minutes. Store in covered jar in refrigerator for one week. Cut in half and serve as an appetizer.

title: Texas Golden Chicken Breasts
instructions: In a large heavy skillet heat butter and olive oil over low heat. In a separate bowl combine flour rosemary and cheese; mix well. Dampen chicken breasts. Roll in flour mixture then eggs then croutons. Cook in butter 4 minutes per side. Serve with white sauce or milk gravy.

title: Dad'S Chili
instructions: Fry meat in skillet until done; drain well. Put meat chili powder cayenne salt and pepper in large pot. Fill with water. Boil 3 to 4 hours adding water when needed. Add onions. Cook until tender. Add tomato sauce; stir well. Spoon off grease that is floating on top. Add a little cracker meal for grease you cannot remove. This helps thicken chili. Add 2 more teaspoons chili powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add beans. The longer the meat and chili powder boil the better the chili taste.

title: Red Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Brown salt pork in shortening. Brown onions. Add flour browning to form a roux. Add beans and enough water to cover well. Simmer 2 hours. Serve with rice. Serves 8.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool and top with whipped topping or ice cream.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Combine flour and steak in plastic bag. Saute onion and garlic in hot oil in Dutch oven until tender. Add steak; cook over medium heat stirring often until browned. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Happy Holiday Recipe
instructions: Mix well and share.

title: Cheese And Pasta In A Pot
instructions: Cook ground beef in small amount of oil in large deep skillet until brown. Drain excess fat. Add onions garlic spaghetti sauce stewed tomatoes and undrained mushrooms; mix well. Simmer 20 minutes. Cook macaroni drain and rinse in cold water (as per package directions). Pour half of shells into deep casserole. Cover with half of tomato-meat mixture and half of sour cream. Top with Provolone. Repeat layering and end with Mozzarella cheese. Cover casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake until cheese melts and browns.

title: The Day After Punch
instructions: In a large bowl stir together the juices the Curacao the sugar and the cherries and let the mixture stand covered and chilled overnight. Stir in the brandy and champagne; serve over ice. Makes about 18 cups.

title: Chicken In Phyllo Dough
instructions: Mix sauce. Use ingredients from mayonnaise to tarragon from list. Salt and pepper each chicken breast. Use two phyllo sheets per breast. Spread one sheet with melted butter. Spread another sheet with melted butter and lay it on top of first one. Coat a chicken breast with sauce and roll it up in the phyllo sheets tucking the dough around chicken. Repeat with each chicken breast. Place each breast (tuck down) on baking sheet. Dont let them touch. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Freeze or bake. If frozen thaw completely before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sauce For Wieners
instructions: Simmer first 4 ingredients 10 minutes. Add hot dogs. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve. Makes approximately 50. Honey wieners work better. You may add more wieners if you wish.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except paprika with fork until well blended. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with grated sharp cheese and paprika. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Delight
instructions: Blend flour and margarine. Add nuts. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Cool Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mix together and serve. Makes a large bowl; good for a large party.

title: Chocolate Bonbons
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium saucepan combine chocolate chips and margarine. Cook and stir over low heat until chips are melted and smooth. Add sweetened condensed milk; mix well. In a medium bowl combine flour nuts chocolate mixture and vanilla. Mix well. Shape 1 tablespoon of dough around each candy kiss covering completely. Place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Do not overcook. Cookies will be soft and appear shiny but become firm as they cool.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook rotini according to package directions. Drain. Rinse the pasta with cold water and drain. Combine pasta and remaining ingredients. Toss well. Serve immediately or chill until serving time.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Generously grease large baking sheet and set aside. Combine sugar and corn syrup in 2 quart glass measure bowl. Cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts with wooden spoon and cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla and cook on high for 2 minutes. Add baking soda and stir until mixture is light and foamy. Pour on prepared baking sheet. Spread quickly to edges using back of wooden spoon. As candy cools stretch to a thin sheet using palms of hands. Cool completely before breaking into pieces. Store in airtight container.

title: Cheese Treats(Tom'S Grandmother'S)
instructions: Mix flour with corn flakes. Add cayenne pepper. Grate into this sharp\tcheese. Mix well. Pour in melted butter or margarine (a little more butter makes them easier to handle). Put in small balls on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down flat with fork tines. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.\tCut off oven and let them stay 10 minutes longer. Makes 2 cookie sheets full.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water and drain. Add egg yolks. Alternate layers of macaroni and cheese in greased baking dish. Place butter flour salt and pepper in double boiler; mix well. Add milk and cook until thickened. Pour over macaroni and cheese mixture. Fold in egg whites. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Nestle Quik Icing
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening. Add chocolate and sugar. Blend well then add vanilla and milk.

title: Bootjie Bredie(Green Bean Stew)
instructions: Trim fat from lamb. Cut lamb into 3/4-inch cubes. Heat oil in Dutch oven or large heavy pan until hot. Cook and stir lamb in oil over medium heat until brown about 10 minutes. Add water garlic and 1 teaspoon of salt. Cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes.

title: Jeff'S New Potato Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and adjust mayonnaise for desired creaminess. Serves 8.

title: Grandma'S Hot Chili
