instructions: Cook hamburger and onions. Drain grease. Mix tomatoes sauce and paste into mixture. Drain beans and add and mix. Add salt and pepper hot sauce and chili powder to taste. More will be hotter.

title: Sticky Rhubarb Muffins
instructions: With pastry blender mix 1/4 cup cold butter and the brown sugar. Add rhubarb and mix well. Spoon into bottom of 12 greased muffin cups. Cream remaining 1/3 cup butter white sugar and egg. Sift flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk mixing just enough to blend. Spoon into muffin cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Heat small skillet of milk on medium heat. Pour a little warm milk in mixture then mix until smooth. Pour back into hot milk and stir until thick but not too thick. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix the 5 ingredients. Make into balls and drop into melted chocolate chips with little paraffin wax. Set on wax paper until dry.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
instructions: Peel and pit avocados; mash with lemon juice salt and pepper. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix in bowl.

title: Noah'S Ark Clam Chowder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large pot; cover and bake at 200\u00b0 for four hours or simmer for four hours. Stir every hour. If mixture becomes too thick add the extra clam juice. This freezes well.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Add to ingredients. Mix chopped chicken mushroom soup Durkee sauce onion pimiento 1/2 cup grated cheese and chicken broth. Put in casserole dish and add rest of cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Low-Fat Banana Bread
instructions: Mix everything well. Then add 2 cups flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Green Pea Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook\tpeas per package directions unseasoned\tand drained. Set aside. Saute onion and celery in the 1/2 cup margarine. Add drained chestnuts soup flour\tand peas. Mix\ttogether well and cook slightly. Add salt and pepper to\ttaste.\tMelt the 1/4 cup margarine in skillet and add the herb dressing. Set aside. Pour all (except the dressing) into a medium casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until bubbly and hot. Add dressing and brown slightly.

title: Orange Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Stir graham cracker crumbs with sugar and melted oleo. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Mix cream cheese to soften then add to Jell-O a little at a time. Fold in crushed pineapple; do not drain. Add Cool Whip. Pour on graham cracker crust and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate in large bowl. Stir and knead until well blended. Chill 30 minutes. Roll into 1-inch balls. Chill balls on baking sheets until firm. Melt chocolate in glass measuring cup stirring at least once. Dip each ball into melted chocolate. Chill until firm on wax paper. Store in refrigerator. Makes approximately 72 balls.

title: Quick Minestrone Soup
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large pan; bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes until pasta is done stirring occasionally. Yields 9 servings. One cup per serving. Top with Parmesan cheese grated.

title: Raggedy Ann Salad
instructions: Place peach in center of salad plate. Position egg for head celery sticks for arms and legs and lettuce for skirt. Add cheese for hair cherry for mouth and raisins for eyes nose buttons and shoes. Yields 1 serving.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place in deep dish pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Put bread slices in bottom of casserole dish. Put chicken on top of bread. Mix eggs broth milk and salt. Pour this over bread and chicken. Put cheese slices on this then soup on cheese. Brown bread crumbs in 1/4 cup of butter. Spread crumbs on top of casserole. Bake uncovered for 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Melt oleo; mix with flour and sugar. Pat into pie plate. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Cheesy Spicy Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on package; drain well reserving 1/2 cup spinach liquid. Set aside. In pan coated with nonstick cooking spray melt margarine and saute onion until tender. Add flour; stir. Gradually add milk and spinach liquid to make sauce. Cook until mixture thickens. Add cheese and seasonings; cook until cheese is melted. Add spinach to pan combining well. Yields 10 servings. A favorite of spinach lovers.

title: Pierogie Casserole
instructions: Boil noodles and drain. (If using lasagne lay flat until ready to use.)

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Then add oil and other ingredients. Bake in a large square pan for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Yum Yum Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and add other ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Frozen Cucumbers
instructions: Prepare first 3 ingredients and refrigerate in covered container for 24 hours. Drain. Add sugar and vinegar; let stand in refrigerator again for 24 hours. Put in containers and freeze.

title: Crab Mushrooms
instructions: Mix mayonnaise cream cheese lemon juice chili sauce and crabmeat all together and fill mushroom caps with mixture. Cook 1 to 2 minutes on High in your microwave. Watch carefully!

title: Han'S Sauerbraten
instructions: Step 1 In a large bowl combine vinegar wine onions celery spices salt and pepper. Wash meat with a damp cloth put in marinade cover and refrigerate for 3 days. Turn meat occasionally.

title: Hot Cheese Bubble
instructions: Mix together and cook at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes approximately. Serve with Wheat Thins. Serve hot.

title: Muffins
instructions: Let all-bran cereal and boiling water set in bowl. Combine remaining ingredients. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Playmate Pizzas
instructions: Toast muffins\tor buns. Sprinkle with cheese. Spread tomato sauce on. Cut bacon or pepperoni to make 12 triangular eyes and 6 half moon mouths. Arrange the eyes and mouths on muffins. Place the mushrooms and/or olives to resemble hair. Place pizza faces on baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 about 5 minutes or until hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Oven Stew
instructions: In a plastic bag combine flour salt pepper and paprika. Add a few pieces of meat at a time and shake bag coating well on all sides. Repeat until all meat has been floured.

title: Corn Bread Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 8 or 9-inch baking pan. Combine dry ingredients. Stir in milk oil and egg mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour batter into pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm. Makes 9 servings.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except egg roll skins. Spoon 1 tablespoon onto egg roll skin; fold. May use drop of water to seal edges. Deep fat fry until brown on both sides. May also use mixture for won tons. Serve as a snack or as a side dish.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Soften butter and cheese. Gradually add flour and paprika. Roll out and cut with cookie cutter or cookie gun. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Slice vegetables then mix all ingredients.

title: Coconut Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with cream of coconut. (Begin and end with flour.) Stir in lemon rind and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Remove and cool completely on wire rack.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Separate egg whites (keep aside for meringue). Beat egg yolks well. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour mixture into pie crust. For meringue beat 2 egg whites until frothy. Add 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar and continue beating. Gradually add tablespoon of sugar as beating continues until mixture is stiff. Spread meringue over pie filling. (Be sure to seal edges around crust.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 10 to 15 minutes or until meringue is light brown. Chill in refrigerator. Serves 8 people.

title: Homemade Picante Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the peppers and simmer together until onion is nearly done. Add peppers and continue simmering until all flavors are blended. Store in refrigerator.

title: Parmesan Chicken(Serves 8)
instructions: Dip each breast in a combination of eggs and milk then bread crumbs. Saute in a heavy frying pan in hot olive oil. Pour 1/2 spaghetti sauce into 15 x 10 pan. Top with sauteed chicken. In same skillet saute the mushrooms. Spoon over the chicken along with any pan juices. Top each piece of chicken with a slice of Mozzarella and a slice of Swiss cheese wrapping them slightly around meat. Pour remaining sauce over the chicken. Combine Parmesan cheese with leftover bread crumbs and sprinkle over top. Dish can be refrigerated but bring to room temperature before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Caramel Turtles
instructions: Melt caramels and cream in double boiler. Combine oat mixture without chocolate chips. Spread 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Bleu Cheese Dressing
instructions: Blend well. Chill overnight.

title: White Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt white chocolate in double boiler. Add vanilla and stir - add peanuts and mix well. Drop on cookie sheet lined with wax paper. Let cool until firm. Store in cool place. Yield 2 - 3 dozen.

title: Easy Lunch Treat
instructions: Bake fries. Pour heated chili over fries; top with cheese and bake until cheese melts.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise; mix well. Add remaining ingredients one at a time stirring well after each ingredient except pecans. Refrigerate for several hours. Roll into ball and roll in pecans until fully covered.

title: French Onion Soup(Microwave)
instructions: Melt the butter in a 2-quart casserole dish. Add onions and cook for ten minutes. Stir in beef bouillon salt flour and pepper. Cover and cook another 10 minutes. Spoon into individual bowls. Toast bread and add to soup. Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Heat on High for 1 minute and 15 seconds.

title: Divinity
instructions: Stir sugar corn syrup and water over low heat until sugar is dissolved. Cook without stirring to 260\u00b0 on candy thermometer (or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a hard ball).

title: Lemon Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with a spoon. Roll into quarter-size balls. Roll into powdered sugar and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese oleo and Ritz crackers. Spread the cheese on top after putting the ingredients in a casserole dish. Melt oleo; crumble Ritz crackers (use your judgment as to how many). Mix crumbs and oleo. Spread on top of cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain. Add tomatoes with green chilies tomato sauce tomatoes bell pepper lime juice and salt. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Arrange 6 tortillas on bottom and up sides of lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish overlapping as necessary. Top with half the meat mixture. Arrange remaining tortillas overlapping as necessary. Spread sour cream evenly over tortillas. Top with remaining meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Remove from oven; sprinkle with cheeses. Let stand 10 minutes; cut into squares to serve. Garnish with lettuce if desired and olives. Serve with picante sauce if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine and boil sugar butter and milk 1 minute. Stir in oatmeal coconut nuts and vanilla. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Melt cheese in the top of a double boiler stirring frequently. Combine cheese sausage and biscuit mix; mix well. Shape into 1 inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yield about 4 dozen.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Fry beef in the butter and sprinkle with garlic powder. Cook stirring slightly until browned. Remove meat from pan. Add onion and green pepper. Saute about 2 minutes. Return meat to skillet along with tomatoes and bouillon cube. Simmer about 5 minutes. Blend together the next 5 ingredients. Stir into the meat mixture and simmer until tender stirring once in awhile. Add drained mushrooms a few minutes before serving. Serve with hot rice and/or chow mein noodles.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into small pieces. Place in a 9 x 12-inch glass dish. Layer next 6 ingredients in order given. Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over top as you would frosting. Top with grated cheese. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 to 12 hours. Garnish with bacon bits and parsley.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Drain pineapple. Soften cream cheese and combine with other ingredients including 1/2 cup of nuts. Put into refrigerator for 1 1/2 hours. Take out and roll in remainder of nuts.

title: Old-Fashioned Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Place in loaf pan and bake for 1 hour.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: First place the buttered slices of toast on bottom of a Pyrex baking dish. Then add one at a time 1/2 asparagus 1/2 English peas and 1/2 cream of mushroom soup. Repeat the steps as needed to fill up the baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Milk Shakes
instructions: Spin all ingredients together in the blender or food processor. Serves 1.

title: Reese'S Candy(Club Member: Renee Evans)
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Press out onto a 10 x 14-inch cookie pan. Melt chips and wax together and spread over crust. Refrigerate only 15 minutes. Take out and cut into candy squares. Return to refrigerator.

title: Reese'S Candy
instructions: Combine ingredients and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Melt chips in microwave; pour on top of fudge mixture. Chill well several hours. Cut pieces at room temperature.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Grease a 9 x 15-inch pan. Layer onions carrots and potatoes in pan. Salt and pepper to taste and dot with butter.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Make syrup and bring to a hard boil. Add 8 finely chopped apples. Roll dough as for pie crust. Cut into squares. Add a small amount of syrup in bottom of a pan. Peel and core apples. Wrap each apple in a square of dough. Place in pan. Pour half of the syrup over dumplings. Make sure that the top of the dough is secured around apple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until done. Ten minutes before removing from oven pour remaining syrup on top of dumplings.

title: Applesauce Raisin Spice Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients. Pour batter into greased Bundt pan or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Derby'S Easy Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Brown on both sides in the heated oil. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Add green pepper onion and garlic to the skillet and cook stirring frequently until softened about 5 minutes. Return chicken to pan. Cover and cook on medium-low for about 45 to 50 minutes stirring often. Gently stir in frozen peas and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve with potatoes rice or noodles. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hamburger Mac Skillet
instructions: In a skillet cook the beef onion green pepper and garlic over medium heat until meat is not pink. Drain. Add the tomato juice macaroni Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Makes 2 servings.

title: Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Cut up chicken breasts into cubes. Add salt pepper and seasoned salt into flour. Dip chicken into flour then in milk and egg mix then back in flour. Drop into hot grease about 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Turkey And Dressing
instructions: In saucepan combine celery bell pepper and onions. Cook until tender and season lightly if desired. In a large mixing bowl combine crumbled cornbread and crumbled loaf bread. Add sauteed vegetables boiled eggs and seasonings; toss well. You may also add Pepperidge herb dressing for taste. Now add turkey broth and mix until desired consistency is reached. You may stuff turkey and arrange turkey around or just bake in pan until done. Use a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Baked Spinach Cheese Squares
instructions: Thaw spinach. Blend all ingredients and put in an 11 x 7-inch buttered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cut in squares to serve.

title: Pizza Hotdog
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Split buns and hotdogs lengthwise. Place layer of cheese on buns. Add hotdog slices to buns. Top with sauce. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Place on broiler pan until cheese melts.

title: Fruit Punch Bar
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients on high. Add next 4 ingredients and beat on medium. Spread in a greased 13 x 10 x 2-inch pan. Top with coconut and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Casserole
instructions: Grease an oblong pan. Layer sausage bread and cheese in pan. Mix all other ingredients. Slowly pour mixture over layers. Place in refrigerator overnight. The next morning bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables per directions on package. Drain off excess water when done. While vegetables are cooking heat butter celery soup and cheese on low heat until cheese is melted. Add sauce mixture to drained vegetables and pour in casserole dish. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Drizzle a small amount of melted butter over cracker crumbs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until crackers are lightly browned.

title: Fall Vegetable Skillet
instructions: Place ingredients in a large skillet and cook over low heat covered for 25 to 35 minutes to desired tenderness of vegetables. Serve. Enjoy! This reheats well for leftovers.

title: Garlic Roasting Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels. Stir butter (oleo) and garlic together in small bowl until well blended. Using your fingers gently loosen skin on breast and smear about 2 teaspoons of oleo mixture under skin. Spread remaining mixture over outside of chicken. Add salt and pepper. Bake on rack in pan at 375\u00b0 for approximately 65 minutes.

title: Low-Calorie Preserves
instructions: Cook 3 to 4 minutes on high. Sprinkle 1 tsp. unflavored gelatin in cooked fruit dissolve and cool.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening then let cool. Ad sugar molasses and egg. Mix well with mixer. Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture. Chill well. Form into balls and roll in sugar. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees until they start to crack. About 6 - 8 minutes. Remove from oven. Leave on cookie sheets for a few minutes. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: One Hour Italian Casserole
instructions: Brown ground turkey in skillet. Drain off excess fat. Add meat into spaghetti sauce and simmer over stove while preparing the rest of the recipe. Prepare pasta according to directions on box. Spray with nonstick oil; add pasta and pour meat sauce over. Arrange pepperoni on top. Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let sit 10 minutes and sprinkle with grated cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly and blend into liquids. Mix in a large bowl and refrigerate. Use amount as needed to bake. Biscuits do not have to rise.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Cook in small baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

title: Easy Baked Alaska
instructions: Bake cake mix in 2 layer pans 8 x 1 1/2-inches as directed on package. (Freeze one layer for future use.) Line 1 1/2-quart bowl with aluminum foil. Pack ice cream into bowl; freeze until firm. Cover baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place cake layer on baking sheet. Invert bowl with ice cream onto cake; remove bowl and foil. Freeze cake and ice cream until firm. Just before serving heat oven to 500\u00b0. Prepare frosting mix as directed on package. Working quickly completely cover cake and ice cream with frosting carefully sealing it to foil on sheet. Bake 3 to 5 minutes or until light brown. Trim foil to edge of frosting; transfer cake to service plate. Serve immediately. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sunny Jim Peanut Butter Swirls
instructions: Mix shortening sugar peanut butter eggs and milk. Add flour salt and soda. Melt chocolate chips. Divide dough and roll each out into oblong. Spread melted chocolate and roll. Refrigerate for 10 minutes. Slice and cook for 8 to 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Frozen Punch
instructions: Put punch in freezer. Put frozen slushy punch in punch bowl and add ginger ale or Sprite when ready to serve.

title: Angel Sweets
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in small saucepan over low heat. Remove and blend in egg. Stir in the rest except coconut. Shape in balls. Roll in coconut. Refrigerate on waxed baking sheet.

title: Turkey Pie
instructions: *If making your own crust add a dash of thyme or poultry seasoning to flour. If using prepared crust just cut strips to fit whatever pan you use.

title: Violet Jelly
instructions: Fill any size glass jar with violet blossoms. Cover with boiling water. Put lid on jar and let blossoms infuse for 24 hours. The next day open the jar and strain the blue infusion discarding the spent violets. Measure out 2 cups of the infusion and add the juice of 1 lemon and 1 package of Sure-Jell. Bring just to a boil and immediately add sugar. Bring back to a boil and boil hard for 1 minute. Pour into hot sterilized jars or glasses and seal.

title: Graham Cracker Cookie Bar
instructions: Combine nuts sugar and butter in saucepan and boil 2 minutes. In the meantime break graham crackers where scored and place in bottom of a large jelly roll pan or cookie sheet that has been lined with aluminum foil. Placing crackers close together; pour mixture over crackers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Watch closely. Cool and remove from pan with spatula.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Mix all ingredients. Spread in pan. Bake until golden brown about 1/2 hour. Cut into pieces about 2 x 1-inch.

title: Swedish Pancakes
instructions: Add eggs to the milk. Add to flour salt and sugar; beat until smooth. Add butter. Pour on hot griddle as thin as possible to make pancakes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake on lower shelf in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix together in a bowl. Add dressing.

title: Brandy Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat Blue cheese cream cheese garlic parsley and brandy in a small bowl on low speed until smooth. Cover and refrigerate about 6 hours or until firm.

title: Favorite Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Cook macaroni as directed and drain. Combine all ingredients in large casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve topped with Parmesan cheese.

title: Pineapple Lime Ring
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cold water and juice. Gradually add jello to cream cheese mixing well until blended. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in marshmallow pineapple and nuts. Pour in 6-cup ring mold. Chill until firm.

title: Carrot Souffle
instructions: Soak crumbs in milk for 10 minutes. Grease a 1-quart casserole. Combine crumbs egg yolks carrots onion cheese salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold into carrot mixture. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until set.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes and eggs. Melt butter; add sour cream and add to mixture. Pour mixture into casserole. Top with Ritz crackers. Heat thoroughly approximately 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Boil chicken and cut into small pieces. Add ground beef to chicken broth and boil a few minutes. Add vegetables and sauces. Cook about 4 hours.

title: Almond Crescents
instructions: Blend together first 6 ingredients; add finely chopped nuts or mini chocolate chips. Shape into crescents and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 15 to 18 minutes until light golden brown. Sift powdered sugar over crescents while still warm. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Lucille'S Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain. Add beans soup and tomatoes. Simmer for 5 or 10 minutes. Stir often. Place tortilla chips in large casserole dish. Pour meat mixture over chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Place cheese on top during last 5 minutes of baking.

title: Salsa Cheese Bake
instructions: Cook garlic in oil 1 minute. Stir in next 6 ingredients. Heat to boiling constantly stirring. Reduce heat & simmer until thickened about 3 minutes. Cook & drain sausage stir in 1 c. salsa mixture. In ungreased casserole dish layer 1/2 of cheese (sliced 1/4 inches) then sausage mixture. Top with 1/2 cheese. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees 8-10 minutes. Heat remaining salsa mixture & pour over cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt and cream of tartar. Set aside. Cream together shortening sugar and eggs; beat until fluffy. Add flour mixture in small amounts alternately with bananas to egg mixture. Beat until smooth after each addition. Place in well-greased loaf pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour or until bread is done. Makes 1 loaf. (This Banana Bread has cake like texture and flavor and can be served as cake.) One may also add 1/4 cup chopped pecans to dough before baking. When Banana Bread is baked and hot pour the glaze over it.

title: Vegetable-Cheese Bake
instructions: In a saucepan combine frozen vegetables and boiling water. Bring to boil again. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan. Blend in flour. Cook 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk. Simmer stirring until smooth and thickened. Add cheese and seasonings. Mix in vegetables onions and pimentos. Spread into buttered 1-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly and browned.

title: Vegetable Marinade With Tangy Dressing
instructions: Heat together vinegar salt pepper sugar and oil until sugar is dissolved. Set aside to cool. Place vegetables in large bowl and pour dressing over vegetable mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Serves 6 to 8.

title: No Bake Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix pretzels and cracker crumbs with Sweet N Low and melted margarine. Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill overnight.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Smooth the cream cheese over a dinner plate. Pour salsa over cream cheese. Spread black olives over salsa. Sprinkle cheese on top. Serve with Fritos or corn chips.

title: Roasted Chicken And Potatoes
instructions: Oven should be preheated 10 minutes before using it to a temperature of 350\u00b0. Poke holes in chicken and season chicken in holes inside cavity and outside with adobo oregano and garlic. Soften butter stick in microwave and place half of it inside cavity and rub on all of the outside the other half of the softened butter. Place chicken breast down in a pan big enough to also hold potatoes later on. Place in oven and spread melted butter over chicken frequently. As soon as chicken is placed in oven start to prepare potatoes. Chicken should cook in oven for 1 1/2 hours (set timer when chicken is placed in oven).

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Separate biscuits; cut into thirds. Wrap dough around cheese cubes; seal well. Fry in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown. Yield 30 puffs.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Make four small rolls and wrap in wax paper. Place in refrigerator. When ready to bake slice and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about seven minutes.

title: Barbecue Brisket
instructions: Saturate both sides with liquid smoke. Sprinkle with meat tenderizer celery salt onion salt garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce according to personal taste. Marinate overnight in foil. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 5 1/2 hours. Last 1/2 hour uncover and cover with barbecue sauce.

title: County Fair Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg onto wax paper. Combine raisins and water in small saucepan; bring to boiling; remove from heat. Cover; cool to room temperature. Beat shortening and sugar well; beat in eggs and vanilla. Blend flour mixture into shortening mixture until smooth. Add cooled raisins and liquid and oats. Mix well. Cover bowl; chill at least 1 hour. Drop cookies from teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheets about 2 inches apart. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until evenly brown. Transfer at once to wire racks to cool. Store in container with tight fitting lid.

title: Linguine Al Pesto
instructions: Method 1 Drain 1 can of pinto beans. Mash. Cook in bacon grease or lard.

title: Toffee Cookies
instructions: Break graham crackers into fourths and lay them down on a jelly roll pan evenly (should fill the pan). Then bring to a boil the butter and brown sugar on medium-high heat. Let boil 2 minutes.

title: Slime
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of cornstarch in a small bowl. Gradually stir in 1/4 cup of water. If mixture is too dry add more water. If too runny add more cornstarch. Food coloring may be added if desired. Slime will feel dry and solid to the touch but if picked up will dribble through your fingers. If hit it will be solid but if finger is placed in the bowl gently it will be liquid. Have fun!

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine the first 7 ingredients listed in a mixing bowl. Pour the mixture into a pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add whole eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla to milk; sift flour together and add part of the flour mixture. Add milk and then remaining flour to batter. Beat until smooth and thoroughly mixed but do not overbeat. Pour batter into 3 greased and lightly floured cake pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sunday Pot Roast
instructions: Place roast in slow cooker and sprinkle with onion soup mix. In small bowl combine soup and water until blended. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours.

title: Get Together Punch
instructions: Day before Pour 1 can punch into 1 1/2-quart ring mold freeze. Mix remaining punch pineapple juice lemonade and club soda in punch bowl. Just before serving unmold frozen punch ring carefully. Place in bowl garnish as desired. Makes approximately 2 quarts 16 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain all beans. Mix sugar oil vinegar salt and pepper. Add beans green pepper and pimento to oil mixture. Chill. Make at least the night before.

title: Quick Cookies
instructions: Mix cake mix vegetable oil and eggs. Add other ingredients of choice. Mix well then drop tsp. of dough about 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Saute zucchini and onions until tender about 10 minutes. Add spices. Combine eggs and vegetable mixture. Lay crescent rolls in quiche dish to form crust. Rub with mustard. Pour mixture over crust. Bake as you would crescent rolls.

title: Divinity Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and water together and cook stirring occasionally until mixture forms a soft ball in cold water. Beat the egg whites until stiff and pour the other mixture slowly over the egg whites beating constantly while pouring. Beat until thick. Stir nuts in and drop by spoonfuls.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; gradually add sugar and oil. Combine dry ingredients. Add to first mixture and alternate with zucchini. Stir in raisins walnuts and vanilla. Use 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until done.

title: Frosting
instructions: In top of double boiler combine egg whites and honey. Beat 1 minute with electric beater (hand or electric type) to combine ingredients. Cook over rapidly boiling water (water in bottom should not touch top of double boiler) beating constantly until soft peaks form when beater is slowly raised. Allow about 10 minutes for beating to get proper consistency. Remove from boiling water. Add vanilla; continue heating until frosting is thick enough to spread about 4 minutes. Yields enough frosting for a 9-inch 2 layer cake.

title: Cinnamon Twist
instructions: Mix and put on a board and roll to an oblong shape. Melt butter and spread over dough. Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over half of the dough. Fold over other half and pat thin. Cut into 1/2 inch strips and twist. Let rise 1 hour and bake in 375 degrees till light brown This makes 24 twist. May be frosted with powdered sugar frosting.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Steam zucchini onion and carrots for 5 minutes. Drain well. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in zucchini mixture. Spread 1/2 of the stuffing mixture on bottom of greased casserole dish. Spoon in zucchini and top with remainder of stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Choco-Scotch Pound Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate and butterscotch bits over hot water or in microwave. Cool. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and buttermilk. Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture and cooled chocolate mixture and stir well. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cool on rack. Remove from pan. Dust with powdered sugar or glaze if desired.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Shape into 2 smaller balls or logs. Roll in pecans. Wrap in plastic wrap until ready to use.

title: Baked Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix all together. Put in small casserole or souffle dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm with Club crackers.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Peel and cut onions into very thin slices. Cook onion slices in butter over very low heat. Add salt and pepper according to taste. Sprinkle in flour stirring constantly to thicken butter/onion mixture. Slowly add beef broth and water then bring to boil. Simmer with pan covered for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Noodles Romanoff
instructions: Power Level High (100%) and Medium (50%). Total Cooking Time 23 to 29 minutes.

title: Strawberry Jello Cake
instructions: Empty cake mix in a large mixing bowl. Add all other ingredients and beat 3 minutes. Grease and flour 2 round pans or 1 sheath cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (usually about 30 minutes).

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Press graham cracker mixture into cookie sheet or large cake pan. Mix together powdered sugar and peanut butter. Press peanut butter mixture on top of graham cracker layer evenly. Melt chocolate chips and pour on top. Let cool and cut into squares when firm.

title: Baked Fish Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drain and flake fish. Add onion and capers to fish. In separate dish combine mayonnaise water cream salt paprika and stir until smooth. Add 1/2 of this cream sauce to fish and mix well. Place fish mixture in buttered loaf pan or baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Use the remaining sauce after the curry is mixed into it to spread over the fish loaf slices. It can be cut into six slices while it is still hot and the sauce spooned over the slices. This is a good one for dieters.

title: Party Crunch Mix
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine both cereals and noodles in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Set aside. Combine the remaining ingredients in small bowl and pour over cereal mixture. Stir to cool evenly. Bake 1 hour stirring every 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Marinated Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Cook sprouts in 2-inches boiling salted water for 4 to 6 minutes or until just tender; drain. Place in shallow bowl with celery and tomatoes. Pour on dressing; cover and chill at least 2 hours. Drain before serving. Spoon into lettuce-lined bowl. Makes 4 servings.

title: Icy Punch
instructions: 1. Mix packages of jello with 3 cups hot water to dissolve and add 3 cups cold water. Set aside.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook for 15 minutes slowly or until fairly thick. Serve hot on sausage rolls. This sauce may be made up and kept in a covered jar. Put in cool place.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits in fourths. Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Place in plastic bag. Drop pieces of biscuits in the sugar mixture. Shake until well coated. Place coated biscuits in a well-greased angel food cake pan. Mix brown sugar and oleo in a saucepan and heat until mixture comes just to a boil. Pour mixture over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Fluffy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 1 c. juice in small saucepan. Set pineapple aside. To saucepan add sugar flour eggs orange juice lemon juice and oil. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute remove from heat and chill. In salad bowl combine pineapple fruit cocktail oranges and bananas. Fold in Cool Whip and chilled sauce. Chill several hours.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Cook beef until tender enough to mash easily. Add shredded beef to rest of ingredients. Cook down to proper consistency. Add 1 tablespoon A.1. sauce if desired.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs. Mix and stir in dry ingredients and raisins. Drop by spoon onto cookie sheet or roll into 4 logs. Chill and slice. Bake 9 to 10 minutes at 325\u00b0 on greased pan. I steam the raisins for a few minutes.

title: Ritz Torte
instructions: Beat egg whites stiff. Add sugar and vanilla. Beat well on high speed. With rolling pin roll crackers together with baking powder on waxed paper. Stir into egg white mixture. Fold in chopped nuts. Spread into a 9-inch greased pie tin. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. When cool and before serving top with whipped cream and shaved chocolate.

title: Lynn'S Lionel Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and cool. Mix next 4 ingredients with beaters. Combine last 4 ingredients and add to mixture by hand. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix in order as listed. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Combine and stir until thick. Cool and store in refrigerator. Great for pound cake and other desserts.

title: Fabulous Beef Fajitas
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag combine 1/4 cup salad dressing and chili powder; add steak. Seal and turn to coat; refrigerate for 30 minutes. In a skillet saute peppers and onion in remaining salad dressing until crisp and tender. Remove and keep warm.\tDrain steak discarding marinade in skillet saute steak for 6-10 minutes or until no longer pink. Return vegetables to pan. Heat through and spoon meat and vegetables down center of tortillas; fold in sides. Yield 4-6 servings.

title: Cheddar Potatoes
instructions: Mix together and put in 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Mix together 1 1/2 cups corn flake crumbs and 1/2 cup melted margarine. Sprinkle over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Home Baked Beans
instructions: Wash beans; cover with water and soak overnight. Next morning cook slowly until skins burst or until just tender. Drain reserving liquid. Place half the beans in the bean pot or casserole. Bury part of pork in the beans and half of combined remaining ingredients. Add remaining beans and seasonings. Place remaining salt pork over top. Cover with bean liquid and bake in 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 oven between 6 to 8 hours. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook peel and mash potatoes. Beat egg whites and set aside. Using an electric mixer blend potatoes egg yolks sugar nutmeg allspice and margarine until smooth. Fold in egg whites. Pour in pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Indian Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter a deep 2-quart casserole. Heat milk and sugar in a saucepan over low heat until tiny bubbles appear around edge of pan. Gradually stir in corn meal; cook stirring constantly until smooth and slightly thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in eggs cinnamon ginger salt and molasses (syrup). Stir together thoroughly. Pour into prepared casserole. Bake uncovered 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot as is or with vanilla ice cream. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well. Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with spices and salt. Alternately add dry ingredients with soda mixture. Pour into greased loaf or cake pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with cream icing.

title: Icebox Pickles
instructions: Heat vinegar until salt and sugar dissolve. Cool and pour over cucumber slices onions and spices. Refrigerate. Will be ready in seven days.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine cookie crumbs and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Mix flour with soda and cinnamon; add to creamed mixture and mix together. Cut up the candied fruits; add nut pieces and mix with the cookie dough. Spoon onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Thinly slice steak diagonally. Brown with onion in oil. Stir in gravy mix water and soy sauce. Stir until thickened. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add bell peppers cut in thin strips and tomato cut in wedges. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Creamy Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese. Add eggs sugar vanilla and lemon peel. Blend until fluffy. Pour this into unbaked crust. Bake until firm 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. This is better after chilling for at least 8 hours. Top with strawberries; its great.

title: Honey Cakes
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients; add remaining ingredients. Mix and pat out into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Mix together and press into pizza pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Let cool.

title: Basic Pasta(Noodle Dough)
instructions: Put flour and salt in mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and in it put the eggs and oil. Mix together with your fingers. Knead the dough until smooth adding more flour or a few drops of water as necessary. Dough may also be made using a mixer with a dough hook or in a food processor.

title: Texan Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well. Put in 9-inch pastry. Cook for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Italian Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain artichokes and mix all ingredients; sprinkle with black pepper and bake in a quiche dish at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Jonna'S Baked Quail
instructions: Salt and pepper birds. Brown quail in oil. Place in Dutch oven. Saute onion parsley and celery. Add broth and mushrooms and stir well. Pour over quail. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Marinate drained artichoke bottoms in dressing overnight. Drain and place artichoke bottoms in baking dish. Fill each with thawed souffl. Dust with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Chicken Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken onion carrots and parsley until done. Add soup base enough to taste. Remove chicken to cool then pick meat off bones.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into a ball. Save some of the chopped dried beef to roll cheese ball in.

title: Blueberry Dumplings
instructions: In saucepan bring blueberries 1/2 cup sugar dash of salt lemon and water to a boil. Reduce to low heat. Sift together dry ingredients. Cut in butter stir in milk and drop batter by spoonfuls on berries. Dont overlap. Cover. Cook 10 minutes.

title: Cheesy Ham Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender. Add flour and seasonings. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Add 1/2 cup cheese stirring until cheese melts. Add ham and potatoes. Spoon into greased 2-quart shallow baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt shortening. Remove from heat and blend in sugar. Cool. Stir in egg then sifted dry ingredients. Add vanilla and nuts. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Bake 25 minutes. Do not overbake. Makes 16 (2-inch) squares.

title: Triple Cheese Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Refrigerate 1/2 hour. Serve with corn diggers.

title: Creamy Sausage Stew
instructions: Place potatoes in a 5-quart roasting pan. Add onions peppers and sausage. Toss gently. Combine oil basil salt and pepper. Pour over the meat and vegetables; toss well. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes; stir. Add the cream; cover and bake 30 to 40 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Combine cornstarch and water; stir into stew. Place on stove top and bring to a boil stirring constantly until thickened.

title: Pilaf
instructions: In saucepan brown noodles in butter; stir often. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; stir. Cover; cook over low heat 20 to 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Crunchy Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken up and remove skin. Mix flour salt and pepper in a paper bag. Put chicken in and coat well. Combine buttermilk and soda in a bowl dip chicken in milk then reflour and fry.

title: Orange Muffins
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar; add yogurt. Add dry ingredients and then raisins and nuts. Spray a muffin pan with Pam and fill cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 large muffins.

title: Nutrasweet Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well and then fill rest of freezer with skim milk.

title: Maple Apple Muffins
instructions: Spray 12 muffin cups with vegetable spray. Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix well. Add milk margarine syrup and egg whites mixing until just moist. Fold in apples. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Top with pecan halves. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool slightly. Glaze.

title: Carbo Mexicana
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salsa. Toss with salsa.

title: Eggnog
instructions: Combine eggs sweetened condensed milk vanilla extract rum extract and salt until thoroughly blended. Gradually beat in milk. Gently fold in whipped cream. Pour into serving cups or punch bowl. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Baked Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Wash and drain cranberries. In large bowl combine sugar and cinnamon. Add cranberries and mix well. Spoon into a 9-inch square pan and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Add orange marmalade lemon juice and walnuts to hot cranberry mixture stirring well. Store in refrigerator.

title: Krunchy Krazy Korn
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Place popcorn in foil lined pan. In large saucepan combine sugar margarine and corn syrup. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla. Pour mixture evenly over popcorn; mix well. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring twice during baking time. Remove from pan immediately. Cool completely.

title: Rock Candy
instructions: Mix it all up in a pot (dont stir). Boil until its 290\u00b0 on the candy thermometer. Pour into a square pan thinly and let it cool until hard. After it cools crack and eat. I hope you enjoy it.

title: Peach Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Combine flour baking powder salt soda and cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in orange juice concentrate vanilla and peaches.

title: Chicken Fanfare
instructions: Remove skin from chicken. Pound between 2 pieces of waxed paper to 1/4-inch thick. Remove waxed paper. In a large bowl combine stuffing ingredients the mix water butter and raisins. Mix thoroughly. Place 1/3 cup stuffing mix on each chicken breast. Fold ends of chicken over the stuffing. Wrap chicken bundle with 3 slices of bacon. Combine topping ingredients of nuts orange rind and sugar in pie plate. Roll chicken in nut mixture. Place on baking sheet. Sprinkle with remaining nut mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chilled Potato Soup
instructions: Stir potato flakes into hot water until smooth. Blend in butter and milk until well mixed. Add chicken stock base Beau Monde and nutmeg blending well. Stir in scallions. Turn into a 2-quart jar cover tightly and chill overnight. Spoon into small soup cups to serve.

title: Blueberry Pineapple Cream
instructions: You may use 2 cups fresh blueberries 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water. Cook until thick and cool.

title: Mexican Breakfast
instructions: Whisk sour cream soup green chilies salsa cumin and coriander together in a mixing bowl. Saute sausage; drain on a paper towel and crumble. Melt butter in skillet; add eggs and cottage cheese and blend. Add parsley and onion and cook lightly until set. Add 1 tablespoon sauce mixture and the sausage. Remove from heat when set. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine Crisco and sugar. Add 5 eggs (one at\ta time). Add alternately dry and liquid ingredients. Add vanilla and lemon flavorings.

title: Cheese Chile Casserole Dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook pasta according to package and drain. Place ground beef bell pepper and onion in large skillet. Cook and stir over medium heat 6-7 minutes or until beef is no longer pink drain. Add taco seasoning and amount of water listed on package. Continue cooking according to package directions. Using any cookie cutter cut shapes out of cheese; set aside. Chop remaining cheese. Combine chopped cheese macaroni seasoned meat mixture chili beans tomatoes corn and salt; mix well. Spoon into baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Top with cheese shapes; continue baking 1-2 minutes longer or until cheese begins to melt.

title: Taco Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix and spread on tortillas. Roll up tortilla and wrap in Saran Wrap overnight or at least 6 hours. Cut off in 3/4-inch slices. Serve with salsa sauce.

title: Grandma'S Cookies
instructions: Cream together all but flour and nuts. Mix in flour and nuts. Form into logs about 1 1/2-inches in diamater; wrap in wax paper and freeze. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes. Watch color carefully after 7 minutes they go from white to burned. Remove from cookie sheet immediately.

title: Kyoto Stir-Fry(Serves 6.)
instructions: Place thinly sliced beef into wok or large skillet; add cooking oil and brown over medium heat. Add all vegetables and stir constantly; cook until all vegetables are tender. Remove from heat. In small saucepan combine cooking sherry and cornstarch over low heat. Stir until smooth. Stir in soy sauce and all spices. Add sauce to the meat and vegetable mixture over medium to high heat and simmer 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Magic Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Sift flour soda salt baking powder and sugar together. Cut in shortening with blender or fork. Add yeast and milk to dry mixture. Mix to stiff dough. Knead; pinch off biscuits or roll out. Allow to rise for 10 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix melted stick of margarine graham cracker crumbs and the 2 tablespoons sugar together. Pat firmly in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Grandma Lewis' Stuffing
instructions: Fry linguica and onion in small amount of oil. Add parsley.

title: Chewies
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well. Add remaining ingredients; mix until well blended. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar while warm. When center sinks and pulls away from sides of pan Chewies are done.

title: Mud Cake Chocolate Sheet
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients and set aside. Bring all liquid to a boil in a small saucepan. Pour into dry ingredients and mix. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Sift together flour soda cinnamon salt and baking powder. Add to the batter mixing thoroughly. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Wrap the warm bread in foil.

title: Dean'S Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and milk in a 6-quart pan. Put on medium heat. Stir to full boil (soft ball 230\u00b0). Add marshmallow bits and nuts. Stir. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.\tPack in greased loaf pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Cucumbers
instructions: Bone chicken; remove skin and chop into half-inch pieces. Clean scallions; cut crosswise into quarter-inch pieces. Add to chicken. Add sugar salt soy sauce wine egg white and cornstarch to chicken. Marinate for 30 minutes. Peel cukes. Cut in half lengthwise; scoop out seeds. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon salt on cukes. Let sit for 15 to 20 minutes; drain. Cut into half-inch cubes. Smash garlic; chop into rice-size bits. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok. Stir-fry cukes for about 1 1/2 minutes; remove. Add 1 tablespoon water to chicken; stir well. Heat 1/4 cup oil and cook garlic for 15 seconds. Add chicken; cook for 1 minute. Add 2 tablespoons soy sauce and stir-fry for 15 to 20 seconds. Return cukes to pan. Stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Coquilles St. Jacques(This Is A Classic)
instructions: Wash scallops and drain. In medium saucepan cook and stir onion in butter until onion is tender. Add scallops mushrooms lemon juice salt marjoram paprika and sherry; simmer uncovered exactly 2 minutes. Drain liquid from scallop mixture; set aside.

title: Purple Lady Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add the fruit. Mix well and chill until partially set. Fold in the whipped cream and chill until firm. A Bundt pan makes a pretty mold.

title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits(Like The Ones From Red Lobster)
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix baking mix milk and cheese until soft dough forms; beat vigorously for about 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Crackles
instructions: In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt. In large bowl beat margarine and peanut butter until well blended. Beat in sugars until blended. Beat in egg and vanilla. Gradually beat in flour mixture until well mixed. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and quickly press star firmly into top of each cookie (cookies will crack around edges). Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Barbecue Pecans
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Stir in pecans and mix well. Spread pecans evenly in a shallow baking pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring frequently. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with salt if desired. Yield 4 cups.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix filling ingredients in order. Pour into pie shell. Bake in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes; then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 45 minutes or until a knife blade comes out clean. Double this recipe for 2 pies.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: When thoroughly mixed place into prepared pan. On top of mixture add 1 tablespoon butter in small pats or 2 bacon slices cut in half. Bake around 1 hour or until brown. Serve hot or cold. Serves 4.

title: Beef Noodle
instructions: Spread noodles in well- greased casserole. Top noodles with cottage cheese sour cream cream cheese and chives. Cover with remaining ingredients. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix first eight ingredients and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then reduce temperature to about 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix sausage and cheese. Mix in Bisquick thoroughly. Make balls; roll them into bite-size balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. (Dough may be mixed and frozen ahead.)

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast into warm water. Add cooled milk mixture eggs and 2 cups of flour; beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour to make dough.

title: Bush'S Creamy Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat the egg yolks until creamy; set aside. Heat the milk in a double boiler to boiling. Combine the egg yolks sugar peanut butter cornstarch and salt. Stir gradually into the milk and cook in the double boiler stirring constantly until thick. Pour into the pie shell and refrigerate until chilled.

title: Hungarian Keiffels
instructions: Crumble yeast in sour cream. Beat the egg yolks. Add cream then mix with flour mixture. Knead ingredients to form a ball. Roll out in circles; fill with a nut filling. Bake 8 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Brush with egg yolk and return to oven to bake 10 minutes more.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Chop up cooked chicken. Stir together with remaining ingredients. Spoon mixture evenly into 2 lightly greased 8-inch square baking dishes. Wrap one dish in heavy-duty foil and freeze. Bake remaining casserole at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yield 4 servings per casserole.

title: Black Walnut Pie
instructions: Cream butter sugar and salt and mix well. Stir in walnuts. Pour into pie crust. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then lower temperature to 355\u00b0 and bake until firm.

title: Minty Mallows
instructions: Combine over hot (not boiling) water sweetened milk and mint chocolate morsels. Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth. In large bowl combine marshmallows and nuts. Add chocolate mixture; mix well. Spread into foil-lined 9-inch square pan. Chill until firm about 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Tarts
instructions: Drain pineapple from juice. Make a thick syrup of juice and 1 cup sugar. Roll out tart crust and spread thin layer of pineapple; sprinkle with dry sugar. Fold tart and fry slowly until golden brown. Place on platter and cover with pineapple syrup.

title: Orzo Salad
instructions: Drain fruit and boil juice with sugar and egg. Pour over cooked orzo noodles. Let stand overnight. Next day add fruit and Cool Whip. Very good.

title: Basil Tomato Tart
instructions: Unfold pie crust according to package directions. Place in a 9-inch quiche dish or glass pie plate. Flute edge; press with the tines of a fork if desired. Prebake according to package directions. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the Mozzarella cheese. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Mint Julep
instructions: Dissolve sugar in the bourbon. Crush mint against the inside of 10 ounce glass. Pack glass with crushed ice add sweetened bourbon stir top with mint. Relax and enjoy.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Cut bread in 1-inch slices almost down to the bottom crust but not through it. Soften the butter and mix well with garlic. Spread between bread slices. Spread any remaining butter on top of the loaves. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until brown and crisp (10 to 12 minutes). Serves 8.

title: Catalina Dressing Chicken
instructions: Pour dressing over chicken; coat well. Cover. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Heat broiler (not necessary to heat gas broiler). Place chicken on greased rack of broiler pan. Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes turning once.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Cut up dates. Dissolve soda in a little of the hot water then pour all of hot water over dates. Add butter and stir well. Add sugar flour nuts and last add egg slightly beaten. Pour in greased tin and bake. This batter will be thin. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Marshmallow Waldorf Salad
instructions: Place chopped apples in bowl; sprinkle with lemon juice. Add marshmallows celery walnuts and enough mayonnaise to moisten; toss lightly. Serve in lettuce cups; top with apple wedges.

title: Alice'S Butter Cake
instructions: Cream sugar oleo and Crisco. Add eggs; beat well. Add flour milk (3/4 cup milk and 1/4 cup water to make 1 cup) and flavoring; add nuts and cherries. Grease and flour tube pan. Start in cold oven. Turn temperature to 300\u00b0. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Punch Bowl Cake(Put In Punch Bowl)
instructions: Mix up cake in sheet pan. After cake cools cut in half. Crumble half of cake in bottom of punch bowl. Divide ingredients in half and layer over cake. Add second half of cake crumbled. Repeat second half of ingredients. Top with last half of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts or coconut and whole cherries if desired.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Melt white chocolate in double boiler over gently boiling water stirring continually. When melted add peanuts and peanut butter. Pour into pan and cool one hour. Cut into squares.

title: My Mom'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil together until thick 7-Up sugar and cornstarch. Add Jell-O and boil 1 more minute. Let cool. Put sliced strawberries in crust and pour syrup mixture over strawberries.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. In medium bowl mix strawberries eggs and oil. In large bowl mix remaining ingredients. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix just until blended. Pour into pans. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir peanuts sugar and salt; add syrup in 1 1/2 quart glass bowl. Microwave on High 7 to 8 minutes; stir well after 4 minutes. At end of 8 minutes add butter and vanilla. Blend well. Return to microwave and cook on High 1 or 2 minutes more. Remove from oven and add baking soda. Stir until light and foamy. Pour immediately on greased cookie sheet. Cool 30 to 60 minutes. Break into pieces and store in airtight container.

title: Frosted Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine butter oats and boiling water in large mixing bowl. Let stand 20 minutes. Add brown sugar white sugar and 2 unbeaten eggs. Mix well.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Bake crust as directed; let cool. Mix together all ingredients except sugar. Add sugar to suit taste. Pour into pie shell. Let set in refrigerator to thicken.

title: Reese'S Cookies
instructions: Spray 3 tart muffin tins with Pam. Slice and quarter icebox cookies according to directions on package. Drop one-quarter chunk into each tart opening. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. While cookies are baking peel the papers off the Reeses peanut butter cups. (Chill these before using.) As soon as the cookies are removed from oven put a Reeses cup in each cookie. Leave in pan until cool and then place in freezer until chilled. Remove from pan. Keep refrigerated or in freezer until serving time.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Mix together. Freeze for three days. When ready to serve thaw 3 hours then add 2 liters of 7-UP or Sprite.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Candy
instructions: Melt butterscotch chips in bowl in microwave. Stir in noodles. Add peanuts. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let stand until cool about 20 minutes. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except dressing mix and margarine. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle desired dressing mix over top of casserole. Melt margarine and dribble over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for about 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl; pour into melted buttered pan. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese to top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Swordfish Steaks
instructions: Clean steaks and place in shallow pan. Mix all other ingredients. Pour over steaks and refrigerate for 2 hours. Place steaks on greased (Pam) broiler pan. Cook 4 to 5 inches from heat for 8 minutes. Turn baste and cook 5 minutes longer. Top with slivered almonds and thin lemon slices. Serves 4.

title: Mama'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars vegetable oil and peanut butter. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift in flour salt and baking soda. Mix until well blended. Form into 1-inch balls. Press with thumb. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 15 minutes. (All ovens are different)

title: Cabbage On The Grill
instructions: Cut cabbage in 4 pieces. Wrap 1 bacon strip around each quarter or a pat of butter. Season and wrap in foil. Place on grill about 10 minutes. Turn over and cook about 10 minutes more.

title: Mom'S Double-Crispy Chicken
instructions: Put crushed corn flakes cereal into shallow dish or pan. Set aside. In a small mixing bowl beat egg and milk slightly. Add flour salt and pepper. Mix until smooth.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef and onion together in skillet. Drain fat. Add spaghetti sauce mix and tomato sauce. Simmer gently to let flavors combine for 10 minutes.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter and cheese. Add pimentos milk; drop dough the size of an egg on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Garlic powder can be used.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese sour cream dressing and lemon juice well. Add shrimp. Chill for at least 1 hour. Serve on crackers.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients; add apples eggs and melted butter. Stir until well blended. Bake in an 8-inch greased pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cottage Cheese Quiche
instructions: In blender combine cottage cheese eggs milk paprika and salt. Line 10-inch pie shell with caraway seed and your favorite shredded cheese. Pour in cottage cheese mixture. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven on lowest rack for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 20 to 25 minutes longer or until done when knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Buttermilk Yeast Bread
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour the sugar salt baking soda and yeast in\tlarge bowl. Heat buttermilk water and margarine until warm and add to the dry ingredients. Beat with electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes. Add 1 cup flour and beat on high speed for\tanother 2 minutes. Add 3 or more cups of flour to make a soft dough. Knead about 5 minutes. Put in greased bowl; cover and let rise until double. Punch down and shape into 2 loaves. Cover and let rise. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Speedy Apple Crisp
instructions: Spread apples in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Cut butter into remaining ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden. Serve warm. Yields 5 to 6 servings.

title: Chili Cheese Quiche(Appetizer)
instructions: Beat eggs 4 to 5 minutes. Stir flour salt and baking powder together. Add to eggs and mix well. Fold in Jack cheese cottage cheese and chilies. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Can be served warm or cold.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat sugar and eggs. Add 1/2 cup of buttermilk and 1 cup coconut. Melt 3/4 stick butter. Add flavoring last. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown. Makes 1 pie.

title: Yellow Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice following package directions. When done stir in margarine and soup (do not add water to soup). In casserole dish layer rice corn and cheese. Repeat ending with cheese on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or in microwave on High for 7 minutes and allow to stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Holiday Punch
instructions: Combine juices and mix well. Pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale. Garnish with maraschino cherries. Makes 25 punch cup servings.

title: Stir-Fried Broccoli With Mushrooms And Cashews
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in wok or large skillet. Add broccoli sugar and salt. Stir-fry for 3 minutes or until broccoli is tender/crisp. Add remaining oil mushrooms onions and nutmeg; stir-fry until added vegetables are tender-crisp about 1 to 2 minutes. Sprinkle on cashews. Makes 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Saute onion; add ground beef and cook until color changes; drain off fat. Stir in 1/2 can tomato sauce and remaining ingredients and set aside. Cut green peppers in half lengthwise; remove core and seeds. Place peppers hollow side up in shallow casserole dish. Spoon beef mixture into pepper halves. Spoon remaining tomato sauce over peppers. Heat covered loosely with wax paper for 19 to 22 minutes or until peppers change color and become tender. Cover stuffed peppers with cheese (optional). Yields 6 servings.

title: Spinach Trenette Agata(Pasta)
instructions: Cook pasta to al dente and drain. In large skillet melt butter over medium-high heat and saute shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes or until shrimp are firm and opaque. Remove shrimp; set aside. Add tomatoes and mushrooms to skillet and saute for 5 minutes. Stir in brandy basil salt and pepper. Add cream and cook until sauce is reduced by 1/3 about 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in Parmesan. Reduce heat to low and add shrimp to sauce. Stir for 1 to 2 minutes to heat shrimp. In heated serving dish pour sauce over warm pasta toss gently and serve.

title: Easy Honey Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken pieces on all sides. Mix soy sauce ketchup mustard wine and honey in an oblong dish. Add chicken and turn to coat well. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours turning occasionally or refrigerate overnight. Reserve marinade. Preheat grill then turn to low and cook for 50 to 60 minutes with lid closed. Brush with marinade and turn chicken while its cooking.

title: Tried And True Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugars. Add oil eggs and vanilla; mix. Mix dry ingredients and stir into sugar mixture. Chill at least 2 hours. Place 1-inch balls on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass dipped in sugar. (I color my sugar with food coloring.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 12 minutes until bottom is golden brown.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: In a large kettle cook the potatoes carrots and celery in water until tender (approximately 20 minutes). Drain reserving liquid. Set vegetables aside. In the same kettle saute onion in butter until transparent. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Gradually add milk stirring constantly until thickened. Gently stir in cooked vegetables. Add 1 cup or more of reserved liquid until soup is desired consistency.

title: Cottage Cheese Crumb Cake
instructions: In large bowl add the brown sugar butter and flour. Mix as you would for pie dough. Take out 3/4 cup and set aside. To the large bowl add the egg cottage cheese milk and baking soda. Beat on high speed. Stir in your favorite flavoring such as rum or vanilla. Pour into a 7 x 10 loaf pan and sprinkle the saved 3/4 cup of crumb mixture on top. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Fast and easy.

title: Skillet Fish Italiano
instructions: In large skillet cook onion in margarine until tender. Add fish lemon juice oregano zucchini and mushrooms; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Top with tomato and cheese; cover and simmer 2 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar adding sugar a little at a time until stiff peaks form. Add vanilla nuts and crushed soda crackers. Mix well. Place into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Add Cool Whip making high peaks and then add the cherries. Refrigerate any leftovers. Makes 8 large servings.

title: French-Style Green Beans
instructions: Fry and drain bacon. Mix the chopped onions bacon and A.1. sauce into the green beans. Heat 10 minutes.

title: Bogus Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream all ingredients except chocolate chips. Add chocolate chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix in order given. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Walnut Tassies
instructions: Cream the cream cheese flour and margarine together. Shape into little balls. Press in very small muffin tins. Mix together brown sugar egg butter salt vanilla and nuts. Fill the crust with this mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut and arrange cookie dough on pizza pan smoothing dough evenly over pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle confectioners sugar over crust. Blend the cream cheese and whipped topping; spread over cooled cookie crust. Arrange fruit over cheese mixture. Sprinkle pecans over fruit. Pour Orange Sauce over top. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and cinnamon. Mix together eggs oil vanilla and orange juice and add to flour mixture. Add remaining ingredients to mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in a well-greased and floured tube pan. When cool remove and punch holes with a drinking straw in top of cake. Pour Buttermilk Sauce over cake slowly.

title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside. Beat margarine and peanut butter until smooth. Beat in sugars until blended then eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Flatten slightly with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Cheddar Macaroni Salad
instructions: Beat cheese together with 1/4\tcup of the mayonnaise minced onion mustard and pepper sauce until well mixed. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Stir cheese mixture together with the hot macaroni. Let cool. Combine all other ingredients. Stir together with macaroni mixture.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until real tender. Save the broth to prepare the dressing except for 1/2 cup. Pull all chicken meat from bone. Put 1 layer of dressing then 2 chicken breasts and 1 can of soup. Repeat and sprinkle the top with dry mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Potato Soup
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut in cubes; slice celery and carrots. Chop onion and put all in cooking pot. Add water parsley bouillon salt and pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender about 30 minutes. Mix together milk and flour. Add to pot and cook until thick. Cut cheese into cubes and add to soup mixture. Cook until cheese melts.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Hamburger Pan Meal
instructions: Layer hamburger patties potatoes and onions in a rectangular pan. Salt and pepper according to taste. Pour can of tomatoes over layers. Cover with foil. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Birds Nest Cookies
instructions: Melt butterscotch pieces in microwave. Remove and add other ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper. Do not store in refrigerator.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak in thin strips combine with garlic and soy sauce. Heat oil in large frying pan and add beef and brown on high heat. Add vegetables and simmer for 30 minutes. Mix cornstarch and water add to pan and stir until thickened. Makes 4 servings.

title: Raisin Or Currant Buns
instructions: Sift flour once; measure. Add baking soda salt and sugar; sift again. Cut in shortening. Add enough milk to make a stiff dough. Turn onto floured board. Knead slightly. Roll into a rectangle 1/4-inch thick. Spread with soft butter. Sprinkle with sugar cinnamon and raisins or currants. Roll as for jelly roll. Cut in slices 3/4-inch thick. Place cut side down on baking sheet. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 12 buns.

title: Percolator Punch
instructions: Place in basket sugar allspice cloves and cinnamon sticks. Then perk.\tIf you have any leftover it can be put in the refrigerator and then reheated in the microwave.

title: Hoppin Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Mix together with remaining ingredients and simmer until liquid is gone. Stir occasionally.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In medium saucepan melt morsels and margarine; stir in crumbs and nuts. Press half the mixture firmly onto bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Beat in Eagle Brand egg and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into prepared pan. Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool to room temperature. Chill before cutting into bars. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Taco Bell Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Add 1 teaspoon salt chili sauce and pepper. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Combine flour cornmeal and 1 teaspoon salt in mixing bowl. Cut in shortening until particles are fine. Combine egg and water; sprinkle over flour mixture while stirring with fork until dough holds together. If dough is sticky toss on well floured surface. Divide into 12 portions. Roll each portion on floured surface to a 6-inch circle. Fry in hot deep fat at 375\u00b0 until golden brown about 1 minute. Turn and brown other side. Remove from fat and immediately fill each with 1 to 2 tablespoons warm ground beef cheese and lettuce. Fold in half. Makes 12 tacos.

title: Kelly'S Taco Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add taco seasoning and cook according to directions. Spray a large casserole dish with Pam. Line dish with rolls and add about 1 cup crushed Doritos. Top with meat mixture. Spread sour cream and sprinkle cheese over all. Garnish with chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Vegetable Medley
instructions: Arrange vegetables on largest round glass platter that will fit microwave. Place broccoli around edge; arrange cauliflower next to broccoli.
