Alternate squash mushrooms and peppers toward center of dish. Combine melted butter garlic salt and pepper and drizzle over vegetables. Cover with waxed paper and microwave 10 to 15 minutes. Vegetables should remain crisp not mushy.

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Mix yeast and water; stir well. Mix flour salt and sugar then add oil. Stir in liquid; mix well. Let rise double. Spread on buttered cookie sheet and top with sauce and your favorite toppings. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes two.

title: Baked Sliced Potatoes
instructions: Cut prepared potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Place overlapping slices in oven-to-table 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix butter and oil. Brush slices with mixture. Pour remaining over potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic salt and thyme. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned at edges. Serve immediately. Good served with broiled steaks or hamburgers tossed green salad and crusty bread.

title: My Favorite Brownies
instructions: Mix well the eggs sugar and salt. Blend in vanilla. Add mixed flour and cocoa. Stir in melted margarine and pecans. Pour into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in pan. Cut into squares.

title: Herbed Shrimp And Feta Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat bottom and sides of 8 x 12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In separate bowl blend eggs milk yogurt Feta and Swiss cheeses parsley basil oregano and garlic. Spread half of pasta over bottom of baking dish. Cover with salsa. Add half of shrimp. Spread remaining pasta over shrimp. Pour and spread egg mixture over pasta. Add remaining shrimp and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Johnny Mozetta(Large Recipe; Feeds About 30 People)
instructions: Fry onions peppers and celery together. Fry meat and garlic together. Combine with first items in a large roaster. Add to preceeding mixture all sauces soup olives and mushrooms. Let simmer 15 minutes. Add cooked noodles. Mix well. Cover with cheese. Bake 1 hour or until cheese browns. Can be made the day before and put into refrigerator. Uncover and reheat in a slow oven for about 2 hours.

title: St. John Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in\tsifted dry ingredients. Beat in mashed bananas. Add nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Bake at\t350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. While cake is still warm pour melted butter over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Homemade Turkey Soup
instructions: Add all ingredients except egg noodles in large kettle. Add water to cover ingredients. Bring to boil. Turn down to simmer 1 hour stirring occasionally. If using egg noodles add and simmer another 20 minutes before serving.

title: Pretzel Jello
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix pretzels 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine and pat into a 13 x 9 cake pan. Bake 7 to 8 minutes until toasted. Set aside to cool.

title: Creamy Fudge
instructions: Place chocolate in 1-quart casserole and melt 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High power. Turn 1/4 turn halfway through. Add rest of ingredients. Pour into buttered container. Chill until firm. Makes 1 pound.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Take 4 tablespoons shortening and melt in skillet. Then add chopped onions and 1 pound ground beef. Cook until meat loses red color. Then add 36 Dorito corn chips 1 cup grated cheese 1 can enchilada sauce 2 cans tomato sauce and 1 tomato sauce can of water. Add salt and pepper to taste and 1 tablespoons comino spice. Pour into baking dish (8 x 12-inch) greased. Top all ingredients with grated cheese (1 cup) and 1 cup Frito corn chip crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Melt 3/4 cup of butter in a large saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in flour salt and nutmeg. Gradually add 4 cups of milk and stock and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 2 minutes or until slightly thickened. In a small bowl beat egg yolks with remaining milk; pour 2 tablespoons of hot mixture into yolks and then pour yolk mixture into saucepan beating constantly until sauce is hot. Do not boil. Remove from heat and stir in sherry or wine.

title: Cream Of Carrot Soup (Creme Crecy)
instructions: In a large saucepan melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add carrots and onion and cook slowly for 15 minutes. Add rice and 1 quart bouillon. Cook slowly for 45 minutes or until carrots are soft. Puree the soup in a blender a half cup at a time. Return to pan and add 2 cups more bouillon. Bring to a boil and add milk and 1 tablespoon of butter. Serves 4 to 5 big eaters.

title: Jellied Cranberry Relish
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Break frozen relish in chunks. Add to gelatin and stir until thawed. Add cold water and orange juice. Chill until partially set. Stir in celery and nuts. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart mold or individual molds and chill until firm. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pinwheels
instructions: Blend cream cheese onion horseradish and Worcestershire sauce until smooth and spreadable.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rum. Place in blender and process 45 seconds. Chill overnight. Add rum before serving.

title: Pasta Sauce(Large Pot)
instructions: Saute onion in small amount of oil. Add tomato paste. Stir for a minute. Add all other ingredients. Then add 4 cans of water using tomato paste can for measure. Bring to boil. Simmer 3 hours stirring often. Add 1/2 cup grated Italian cheese after cooking 1 hour. (Meatballs can be made and cooked in sauce.)

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding with milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Line bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan with graham crackers. Pour half of pudding mixture over. Line with another layer of graham crackers followed by the remaining pudding mixture. Top with another layer of graham crackers. Melt icing in microwave and pour over top of dessert. Chill and serve.

title: Farmhouse Pork And Apple Pie
instructions: Cook bacon in an ovenproof 12-inch skillet until crisp. Remove to paper towel to drain. Saute onions until tender; remove and set aside.

title: Surprise Salad
instructions: Mix dry jello into Cool Whip. Stir in cottage cheese drained pineapple and chopped pecans. Cover with lid and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Cheeseburger Macaroni
instructions: In a large skillet brown beef and onion; drain. Add tomatoes and water; bring to a boil. Stir in macaroni; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until macaroni is done stirring once. Stir in cheese. Yield 4 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cut butter into flour salt and soda until well mixed. Set aside. Beat eggs; add sugar and vanilla and mix well. Combine both mixtures mixing well. Divide dough into 3 balls and chill for at least 15 minutes. Roll; cut into shapes and bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
instructions: This standard recipe has been in use in Ireland for many years.

title: Edible Dirt
instructions: In blender process cookies until they look like dirt. Combine cream cheese margarine sugar Cool Whip and pudding with milk. Set aside. In a flower pot about 4 to 5-inches deep start dessert by bottom layer of dirt about 1/3 of total. Then pour 1/2 the pudding and cover with another 1/3 of dirt. Layer second half of pudding and top off with last of dirt. Place artificial flower in center. When serving use plastic trowel.

title: Waldorf Whiz
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add other ingredients and mix well. Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Broccoli Rice Whiz
instructions: Cook rice in a large saucepan and drain. Saute onion bell pepper and celery in margarine. Add onion bell pepper and celery to the rice while still hot. Fold in Cheez Whiz chicken soup and milk. Heat on low burner just until cheese and soup are well blended. Fold in chopped broccoli. Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Ritzy-Chicken
instructions: Melt butter. Dip chicken in butter then roll in crushed crackers. Place in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0. Bake approximately 1 hour. Turn chicken after 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve.

title: Apricot Nectar Molded Salad
instructions: Heat apricot nectar to boiling; remove from heat. Add lemon gelatin stirring to dissolve. Stir in crushed pineapple. Reserve 1/2 cup of this mixture. Divide remaining mixture in half. Pour 1/2 into 2-quart mold or 8 x 12-inch pan. Refrigerate until set.

title: Date Rolls
instructions: Cook dates butter yolks sugar and vanilla in heavy saucepan. Stir continuously until boils. Boil 5 minutes. Watch closely will scorch. Remove from heat. Add vanilla wafers and nuts. Shape in rolls. Roll in coconut. Keep in refrigerator. Slice when ready to serve.

title: Mary Pat'S Fudge
instructions: Put butter chocolate and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Then put milk and sugar in a large pot. Put the pot on the stove and turn the stove onto medium-high. Bring the sugar and milk mixture to a boil for 6 minutes. You must stir this constantly or else it will burn. Next take this off the stove and pour it into the chocolate vanilla and butter bowl. Blend this on low power until everything has melted. Now pour this into a cake pan cover and cool. Refrigerate.

title: Canned Green Beans
instructions: Boil for 40 minutes. The beans need to be placed in a large pan covered with water. After your 40 minutes are up place in quart jars and seal.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Mix caramels and condensed milk then mix with cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla. Delicious!

title: Sister Mary'S Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage very fine. Brown almonds a little bit either in oven or in a skillet. Chop green onions and break noodles into small pieces. Add to cabbage.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place ingredients in order listed in a casserole dish and bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: German Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in skin until tender. Cool peel and thinly slice. Fry bacon until crisp. Add onion and cook one minute. Blend in flour salt sugar and pepper. Add vinegar and water. Cook 10 minutes stirring well. Pour over sliced potatoes. Add celery seed and parsley. Toss gently. Serve warm. Yields 6 portions. Great served with roast beef or baked ham.

title: Dove And Rice Casserole
instructions: Clean doves and pat dry. Salt and pepper. Use an 8 to 12-quart covered cooking pot. Melt butter. Add doves to pot equally distributed on bottom. Cook slowly on low heat for 45 minutes. Turn doves once. Cover. Add chicken broth and water to total the amount of liquid needed to cook 3 boxes of rice. Do not cook rice before adding to doves. Bring broth and water to a boil with doves still in butter broth and water. Add boxes of wild long-grain rice and spices without any more liquid. Cook doves and rice for 45 to 55 minutes or until rice is tender. Gently fold in Chinese vegetables. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sweet And Sour Turkey
instructions: Place turkey in pot with 4 cups of water. Add onion garlic bay leaf cloves mustard salt and peppercorns. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer for 2 hours. Remove turkey and strain broth. Return broth to pot; add cornstarch combined with sugar and vinegar. Cook stirring constantly until the sauce thickens. Add turkey and simmer for 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Low-Fat Banana Muffins
instructions: Cream sugar Sweet N Low and Butter Buds. Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Add sour cream bananas vanilla and nuts. Mix gently. Pour into muffin tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a large skillet. Drain and stir in barbecue sauce and brown sugar. Heat until very hot. Set aside. Separate biscuits and place each in an ungreased muffin cup. Press dough to cover bottom and sides of cup. Spoon mixture into cups. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Water Chestnut Salad
instructions: Place first 5 ingredients in order in a big plastic bowl. Mix together mayonnaise and sugar and spread over the top of salad. Sprinkle Romano cheese on top. May use bacon bits and/or hard-boiled egg slices as garnishes. Refrigerate for 8 hours or more before serving. Toss just before serving.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Keep covered 3 days mixing every day. On fourth day roll out in logs. Bake at 175\u00b0 for 8 hours. Turn after 4 hours.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: In a large saucepan combine apple cider or juice brown sugar and nutmeg.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix milk with cream of mushroom soup. Add pepper and half can of dried onions. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Sprinkle rest of dried onions on top and bake for about 10 minutes.

title: Dutch Carrots
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp and remove from pan. Cook onion in drippings. Add carrots. Season with salt and pepper. Turn carrots into hot vegetable dish and garnish with bacon. Makes 6 servings.

title: Creamy Crab Chowder
instructions: Defrost drain and slice frozen crab. Partially fry bacon. Add onion green pepper and garlic and saute lightly. Add potatoes water and seasonings. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add crab corn milk and evaporated milk. Heat slowly to simmer. Combine flour and soft butter. Stir into chowder and heat gently to thicken. Garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Chicken Etouffee
instructions: Lightly season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy pot and saute chicken until brown. Remove chicken from pot. Add 1 tablespoon oil. Saute the onion celery and sweet pepper; cook 15 minutes. Add 1/4 cup water; cook for another 15 minutes. Add chicken and 2 1/2 cups water; cook partially covered for about 1 hour. Sprinkle parsley. Turn off heat. Let stand tightly covered for 10 minutes. Serve over cooked rice. Serves 6.

title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil until smooth about 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter then stir in 2 1/2 to 3 cups of oatmeal. Drop on wax paper and cool.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Line bottom with graham crackers. Mix pudding with milk; blend 2 minutes then blend in Cool Whip. Put 1/2 of mixture over graham crackers. Put second layer of graham crackers and then the remaining pudding mix over this. Cover with graham crackers. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 1-quart glass measuring cup or serving pitcher. Microwave on Medium about 4 minutes or until mixture just starts to boil stirring once during cooking time. Stir to combine ingredients to a smooth sauce. Serve warm over ice cream. Refrigerate leftover sauce and reheat in microwave on Medium as needed. Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and season with salt and pepper. Drain. Add juice macaroni broth and dill weed. Cook until macaroni is done. Add sour cream. Fold into cooked macaroni mixture. Add 1 can French-fried onions.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix well. Chill and serve with cut up fruit.

title: Roasted Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0 (preheating is essential). Separate broccoli into serving size spears. Wash and pat thoroughly. Place on a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with olive oil spray. (If you are not counting calories use regular olive oil.) Spray spears lightly. Cook 10-12 minutes. Can put slices of Kraft Mexican cheese on top.

title: Sausage-Noodle Bake
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients stirring well. Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine margarine and stuffing mix. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Easy Orange Sherbet
instructions: Combine soda condensed milk and pineapple mixing well. Pour into electric ice cream freezer. Ice and salt freezer. Plug in and wait for a great treat.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Put in layers topping with Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Deep-Dish Brownie
instructions: Blend melted butter or margarine sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Add eggs and beat well with a spoon. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture until well blended. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Mix chopped dates soda and boiling water and allow to cool. Add butter sugar and unbeaten eggs (one at a time). Mix date mixture with flour salt vanilla and nuts. Grease and flour 5 (No. 2) gold-lined cans. Fill half full. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done 45 minutes to 1 hour. Take bread out of cans when still warm.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Cook broccoli and Brussels sprouts as directed on packages. After 5 minutes add cauliflower. Cook until tender. Drain well.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add melted butter and sugar. Add mashed bananas. Mix together. Add flour and soda. Add nuts last. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook the spaghetti; drain. Stir in butter eggs and Parmesan cheese. Form spaghetti mixture into \crust\ in buttered 10-inch pie pan. Cook ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in tomatoes paste and spices. Heat. Fill \crust.\ Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and bake for 10 more minutes. Even better the next day.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips. Sprinkle with meat tenderizer. Brown in oil in skillet. Cut green peppers into thin strips. Add onion garlic green peppers and celery to steak. Saute for about 2 minutes or until vegetables are partially tender. Combine cornstarch beef stock and soy sauce; add to steak mixture. Cook stirring until liquid is slightly thickened and begins to simmer. Add salt and pepper. Serve immediately over rice.

title: Never Fail Icing
instructions: In a small bowl beat margarine and cream cheese. Add sugar till desired thickness. Mix well.

title: Sunny Banana Pie
instructions: Slice bananas into crust. Gradually add 1/2 cup milk to softened cream cheese mixing until well blended. Add pudding mix and rest of milk. Beat slowly 1 minute. Pour into crust and chill. Garnish with toasted coconut.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour 1/2 into mold and chill until firm. Spread with sour cream. Top with remaining jello and chill overnight.

title: Cinnamon Sweet Pickles
instructions: Peel and seed cucumbers (slice). Soak cucumbers in one cup of lime per gallon of water for 24 hours. Mix 1 cup of vinegar red food coloring alum and enough water to cover cucumbers. Simmer for 2 hours. Pour off.

title: Rhabarber Kuchen(Rhubarb Cake)
instructions: Combine butter 1/2 cup sugar eggs and salt. Gradually beat until frothy. Add lemon zest. Sift flour and baking powder; fold into egg mixture alternately with milk. Batter drops heavily from the spoon.

title: Sausage Swirls
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Blend in oil. Add enough milk to make a stiff dough. Roll thin on floured board into 10 x 18-inch rectangle. Spread uncooked sausage on top and roll lengthwise. Chill. Slice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Omega Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl. In another bowl place crackers. Pour mixture over crackers. Mix well & let sit for one hour.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Mix. Heat these 5 ingredients. Pour over the first 6 ingredients (bean mixture). Stir. Refrigerate overnight. Heat and stir last 5 ingredients until sugar has dissolved but do not boil before pouring over beans.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Line bottom of baking dish with dried beef. Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon and place on top of dried beef. Cover with a mixture of the soup and sour cream. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours. No watching!

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Stir in 2 more cups flour. Knead until smooth and elastic about 12 minutes. Let rise in warm place until more than double 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and chill in refrigerator several hours before serving.

title: Barbecue Sauce(Servings:  4)
instructions: Blend salad oil with vinegar in saucepan. Add rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.

title: No Eggs Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
instructions: Into large mixing bowl put 2 cups sugar and 2 cups flour. In a saucepan put oleo water and cocoa; bring to a boil. Pour over dry ingredients and mix well. Add eggs and buttermilk to which soda has been added. Add vanilla and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in large pan (cookie sheet size). Ice while cake is still hot.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix milk sugar flour and butter. Place batter in deep baking dish. Pour canned peaches in center of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Date And Nut Loaf
instructions: In a bowl sprinkle the soda over the boiling water. Cool. Add the sugar and egg; beat well. Add the flour baking powder dates vanilla salt and walnuts. Pour in greased pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwaveable Zesty Red Dip
instructions: Place all ingredients in small microwavable bowl and mix well. Place same bowl in center of microwave oven. Heat on High (100% power) for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until warm stirring dip halfway through heating time. Or heat in small saucepan over low heat until warm. Serve warm. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter with vanilla extract; gradually add the sugar until fluffy. Add the egg yolk and beat thoroughly. Sift the flour baking powder and salt together and add to the creamed mixture in fourths. Mix until blended after each addition. Fill mixture into cookie press and form cookies onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Combine hamburger meat salt pepper and onion; brown. Combine meat mixture with Tater Tots. Place in 2 medium sized baking dishes. Mix soups and milk. Pour half of this mixture over contents of each dish. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together and chill 4 to 5 hours or overnight. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburg and sprinkle with garlic salt while cooking. Drain good on paper towels. Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into four pieces; set aside. Mix the sugar and cinnamon. Roll pieces in mixture or put a portion of sugar mixture in a small clean paper bag and drop in a few pieces of biscuit. Shake to coat. Repeat until all pieces are coated.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix and form into bite-sized balls. Bake on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for between 10 and 20 minutes. May be frozen then thawed 1 hour before cooking. If freezing freeze separately then put together.

title: Fresh Peach Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs and add sugar and oil mixing well. Combine flour salt and baking powder; add to egg mixture alternately with orange juice. Add vanilla extract. In a separate bowl toss peaches with sugar and cinnamon. Pour 1/3 batter into a greased lightly floured tube pan. Layer 1/2 peach mixture over it. Cover with 1/3 batter and the remaining peach mixture. Spread remaining batter over all. Bake one hour. Cool cake 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Herb Bread
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl. Spread on one side of each bread slice. Wrap loaf in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mexican Corn And Chicken Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut top off tomatoes; scoop out pulp. Drain tomatoes upside-down on paper towels 10 minutes. Heat oil and saute onion garlic and peppers for 5 to 10 minutes. Add corn chicken seasonings and sour cream. Heat through. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spoon filling into tomatoes and sprinkle the tops with cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all together and let stand several hours in refrigerator.

title: Fat-Free Banana Surprise Muffins
instructions: Spray 14 to 16 muffin cups with a nonfat cooking spray. In a medium-sized bowl combine flour oats sugar baking power baking soda and cinnamon. In a large bowl whisk Egg Beaters. Stir in mashed bananas milk and corn syrup. Add flour mixture; stir until blended. Spoon into muffin cups. Top each with about 1/2 teaspoon of jam each. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 22 to 24 minutes. Cool 5 minutes in pan.

title: Hobo Stew
instructions: Fry hamburger with onion and green pepper. Drain off the grease and set aside. Boil the potatoes carrots and celery together until they are soft but not soggy. Drain off the water. In a large pot put it all together folding it in carefully and then add tomatoes and gravy stirring carefully. Season with salt and pepper. Keep on low heat for about 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over rice mashed potatoes noodles toast or biscuits.

title: Hot Slaw
instructions: Heat vinegar and sugar. Let cool. Chop up remaining ingredients. Add pepper hot sauce and ketchup. Pour vinegar mixture over this and mix well.

title: Pork And Bean Bread
instructions: Add raisins to boiling water and set aside. Mash beans with a fork in a large bowl until very smooth. Add sugar eggs oil and vanilla. Mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and fold in. Drain raisins and fold in with chopped nuts. Spoon batter into three greased and floured loaf pans. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Cut cabbage and place in bottom of casserole dish. Pour cooked hamburger over cabbage. Mix tomatoes salt and pepper together; pour over cabbage. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Cinnamon Rings
instructions: *Note You can quarter these instead of making rings.

title: Bittersweet Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a microwave-safe 1-quart glass measure. Gradually add milk and water stirring with a wire whisk until blended. Microwave on High 3 1/2 minutes or until thick and bubbly stopping to stir again after 2 minutes. Let stand 20 minutes stirring several times with whisk. Serve warm or at room temperature. Great over vanilla frozen yogurt!

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in greased casserole. Mix with rice. Add other ingredients together with rice and cut up ham chicken or turkey. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pickles In A Blanket
instructions: Lay out a piece of dried beef. Coat with cream cheese. Wrap around pickle slice widthwise and stick a toothpick in center of pickle.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar milk margarine and cocoa. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter vanilla and oats until well blended. Drop onto wax paper. Cool until firm.

title: Mango Salad
instructions: Use mango juice and water to make 3 cups liquid. Dissolve jello in heated liquid. Blend mangos and softened cream cheese. Add jello. Chill and serve.

title: Butter Pie
instructions: Warm milk and eggs together on stove. Add sugar vanilla butter and spices mix well and pour in pie dish.

title: Flank Steak
instructions: Brush steak with soy sauce and sprinkle well with salt freshly ground black pepper and dried thyme crumbled. Let stand for an hour. Brush again with soy sauce and grill over brisk fire 3 or 4 minutes on each side for rare steaks. Carve with sharp knife in thin slices on the diagonal.

title: Oriental Cocktail Kabobs
instructions: Cook sausages according to package directions and cut into thirds. Alternate pieces of pineapple sausage water chestnuts green pepper and mushrooms on long toothpicks. Combine remaining ingredients; heat skillet. Add kabobs cover and simmer 10 minutes. Remove from skillet; serve warm as a dinner or appetizer. Yields 40 to 50.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together except corn flakes and melted butter. Put in shallow casserole dish. Mix cornflakes and melted butter; spread on top of potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until lightly browned. Makes a large amount and can be frozen.

title: Browned Butter Frosting
instructions: Heat margarine in saucepan over medium heat until delicate brown. Remove from heat. Stir in powdered sugar. Stir in vanilla and milk. Beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs first. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in preheated oven at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes and then at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Smoked Shrimp
instructions: You will also need a 1 gallon Ziploc bag.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar water and cornstarch until clear; cook slowly then take off stove and add jello and strawberries. Put in baked pie crusts. Makes 2 pies.

title: Easy Marinated Carrots
instructions: Scrape carrots and slice into 1/4-inch slices. Boil until cooked; add chopped onion and bell pepper last 10 minutes of cooking. Drain and toss with dressing. Chill. Serves 4. Goes well with grilled chicken rice and bread.

title: Melting Moments
instructions: In bowl cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg yolk and vanilla. Sift together flour cornstarch salt and baking powder; stir in butter-sugar mixture. Shape into marble-size balls and turn in rolled oats to coat. Arrange cookies on greased jelly roll pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Ever Ready Cheese Log
instructions: Combine cheese with all of the ingredients. Form into rolls and wrap in waxed paper. Refrigerate until firm. Serve with crackers.

title: Snicker Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix cake mix according to package. Pour 1/2 the cake mix in pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spectacular Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare a 2-quart baking dish with Pam. Cook rice for 5 minutes less than package directions. Mix remaining ingredients with rice; sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Makes 10 to 13 servings.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Stir dry ingredients together. Add other ingredients in order and mix thoroughly. Bake in a layer cake pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Bananas Foster
instructions: Heat butter in skillet with sugar. Drop bananas in when sauce bubbles. Saute for 30 to 45 seconds. Add rum; mixture might flame. Add cinnamon and serve over vanilla ice cream.

title: Cucumber Spread
instructions: Mix well and its ready to spread.

title: Zucchini-Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a shallow 1 1/2 to 2-quart baking dish. In a large skillet heat butter and oil. Add onion; cook until tender. Add garlic and zucchini; increase heat to medium-high and stir 5 minutes. Sprinkle with flour and stir 1 minute longer until flour is absorbed. Stir in half and half rice 3/4 cup cheese and the salt and pepper. Pour into prepared dish; sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup cheese over top. Bake uncovered 30 to 35 minutes until golden and bubbly. Remove from oven and let stand 10 to 20 minutes so custard has time to set before serving. Makes 12 servings.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and butter (preparing mix according to package directions). Pour 1/2 of batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 6 minutes or until cake puffs up and is still gooey. Unwrap caramels. Combine caramels and milk in top of double boiler and cook until caramels melt. Pour caramel mixture over baked top layer. Add nuts and chocolate chips over melted caramels. Pour remaining batter over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Frost with whipped cream.

title: Crock-Pot Corn
instructions: Place in crock-pot and cook overnight on low.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Cook and stir celery and onion in melted butter in Dutch oven over medium-high heat until vegetables are tender. Meanwhile heat water in medium saucepan over high heat to a simmer. Stir water chicken carrots bouillon basil pepper and bay leaf into Dutch oven. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Add noodles and parsley. Cook covered 10 to 15 minutes or until noodles are tender stirring occasionally.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Debone chicken breasts and cut in small pieces. Dip in beaten eggs then roll in Italian bread crumbs. Let stand for 15 minutes. Brown in oil. Put in a large casserole dish. Cover with mushrooms Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese. Before baking pour the 1/2 can of chicken broth over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together. Spread 1/2 mixture into a greased 8 x 11-inch casserole dish. Layer chilies evenly over mixture and sprinkle both cheeses over chilies. Cover with other half of mixture. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. This recipe may be doubled.

title: Cinnamon Raisin Bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water. In separate bowl combine sugar salt cinnamon and butter. Stir in mixed yeast. Beat in 1 1/2 cups flour. Add raisins. Stir in remaining flour; knead sprinkling flour on hands and work surface until dough no longer sticks. Knead about 10 minutes. Form into ball and place in a greased bowl turning to grease. Cover and place in warm spot for 1 hour until double in size. Punch down and shape into loaf. Place in greased bread pan. Cover; let rise 30 to 40 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Grandma'S Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into 2 rolls; wrap in wax paper and chill overnight or until needed. Slice to 1/4 to 1/2-inch each and place on pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Beef Porcupines
instructions: Mix beef rice onion and seasonings. Form into small balls. Cook in hot oil in skillet turning frequently until light brown on all sides but not crusty. Add tomato sauce and water. Mix well. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Prepare cake mix by package directions. Bake in 2 layers. Mix pudding with milk by box directions. Layer in a punch bowl or trifle dish as follows One cake layer (crumbled) half of prepared pudding four crumbled candy bars and half of Cool Whip. Repeat layers. Top with 9th crumbled candy bar. Refrigerate for two days prior to serving.

title: Cheese And Onion Bread
instructions: Saute onion in butter until soft. Do not overcook. Remove from heat. Cool. Dissolve yeast in a large bowl. Add honey beaten eggs and salt. Mix well. Add two cups of flour; beat well until sponge is smooth. Add onion and butter; mix. Add cheese. Mix in well. Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour and 1 cup whole wheat flour. Knead on floured board for five minutes or more. Return to greased bowl. Turn kneaded ball over in bowl to grease all surfaces. Cover. Let rise in warm place until double in size. Form into 2 loaves. Brush with glaze.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Simmer chicken and save broth. Remove cooked chicken from the bone and cut into bite size pieces. Cook noodles in broth. Saut onion mushrooms and celery in butter. Mix together milk soup and Velveeta. Warm until cheese melts.

title: Mandarin Orange Pie
instructions: Drain Mandarin oranges. Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shells.

title: Cucumber-Radish Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine yogurt corn oil parsley vinegar mustard and salt. Add cucumbers radishes and green onions. Toss to coat. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Baba
instructions: Clarify butter. Flatten chicken breasts between waxed paper. Brown chicken on both sides in butter over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms; cook about 10 minutes on medium heat. Add Marsala; cook about 5 minutes. Place Mozzarella on top. It will melt quickly and chicken is ready to serve. Goes well with steamed rice. Serves 4.

title: Orange And Tomato Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan slowly saute onions chopped potato and garlic in butter. Add tomatoes orange juice orange rind and broth. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix chicken soup chicken broth and peas and carrots. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Make a crust of Bisquick margarine and milk. Pour over chicken mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until crust is brown.

title: Fried Apple Pie Crusts
instructions: Mix ingredients together and set aside. Beat eggs and cream together. Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Add eggs and cream mixture to the flour and shortening. Cover and place overnight in refrigerator.

title: Drop Rolls
instructions: Mix sugar and melted butter. Add beaten egg and dry yeast dissolved in the warm water. Add flour. Drop by spoonfuls in muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except loaf of bread together in bowl. Cut center out of bread and spoon in dip. Slice celery carrots cucumbers mushrooms green peppers and any other fresh vegetables. Arrange around bread on tray. When vegetables are gone cut bread into cubes and enjoy. This dip tastes best if made the day before it is to be used.

title: Laura'S Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Place in casserole dish. Top with 1 package herb seasoned stuffing. Pour 1/2 cup broth over it. (Laura uses 2/3 to 3/4 of packaged stuffing.) Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Chicken can replace the turkey.

title: Cowboy Bean Soup
instructions: Saute onions and bell peppers. Brown hamburger meat add all other ingredients. Simmer 1 hour.

title: Spicy Shrimp Louisiana
instructions: Cook shrimp about 3 minutes. Set aside. Combine spices* set aside. Slowly add water to flour; mix into paste set aside. Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot. Stir in onion pepper celery garlic and cook until soft. Mix in spices. Stir in broth and tomato paste. Stir in flour mixture. Cook until sauce thickens. Add shrimp green onions. Stir until blended. Serve over rice.

title: Harvest Bread
instructions: Combine sugar shortening and eggs in mixer bowl. Beat until smooth. Add yams and orange juice concentrate; mix well. Mix flour baking soda cinnamon nutmeg allspice cloves and salt together. Add to batter 1/3 at a time mixing well after each addition. Stir in pecans. Spoon into 4 greased and floured coffee cans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until loaves test done. Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Angel Food Delight
instructions: Prepare angel food cake in tube pan; let cool. Cut cake into 1/2-inch serving slices and arrange 1/2 of cake in an oblong pan. Mix together the Dream Whip confectioners sugar and cream cheese until creamy. Spread filling on layer of cake then put another layer of cake on filling. Cover with fruit pie filling. Chill.

title: Vegie Pizza
instructions: Whip slowly with mixer until fluffy. Butter on slices of sourdough French bread. Toast under broiler.

title: Low Calorie Pizza
instructions: Brown burger and drain off grease. Mix tomato paste Italian seasoning onion flakes and garlic salt to burger. Spread over the pita bread and sprinkle cheese over the top.

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: You will need a 1 or 1 1/2-quart mold or 3 soup cans.

title: Steve'S Christmas Cider
instructions: Heat all of apple juice in a large pot until all red hots are melted. Stir occasionally. Serve hot at Christmas parties. (Everytime I drink or make this I remember how A Tree Grows in Brooklyn and think of the wonderful fellowship our church has had together. Always hoping some things stay the same!)

title: Lemon Basil Pasta
instructions: In a small bowl combine butter lemon juice and spices. Toss with pasta. Sprinkle with cheese and serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: In small bowl combine walnuts cinnamon and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9-inch tube pan with removable sides.

title: Three Meat Goulash
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Heat butter in a deep pot that has a well fitting cover available that is oven proof. Saute onions in pot and butter until transparent. Add a third of the meat and stir on almost high heat for about 2 minutes. You are not trying to brown the meat just change its surface from red to white. Add half the remaining meat to the meat in the pot and repeat process until all the meat is cooking in the pan and then stir and cook about 4 more minutes.

title: Oreo Ice Cream Torte
instructions: Mix and press crushed cookies and melted butter into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Freeze until frozen. Spread softened ice cream over frozen crust and freeze again until frozen.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole(Club Member:  Neil H.)
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Sprinkle on topping.

title: Veggie Mound
instructions: The night before spread cream cheese on ham. Roll up into logs. Refrigerate on large tray.

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: Cut bread loaf in half; roll each half into a square. Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper. In a frying pan crumble up sausage and add chopped pepper and onions until done. Drain. Mix with 3/4 of the beaten eggs. Put 1/2 of sausage mixture in middle of each square of bread. Put grated Mozzarella cheese on top and fold bread up letter style. Brush sides of bread with egg mixture to seal edges. Baste top with butter and sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine flour and sugar. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal. Press firmly into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. In a bowl beat milk egg vanilla and salt. Stir in toffee chips and pecans; spread evenly over baked crust. Bake for another 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool then refrigerate. When thoroughly chilled cut into bars. Store in refrigerator. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Spicy Chili-Mac
instructions: Combine carrots onion and water in a large saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring until liquid has evaporated (about 10 minutes). Add V-8 undrained tomatoes beans chili powder garlic and parmesan cheese. Bring to a boil add uncooked macaroni and cook for about 8-10 minutes or until macaroni is tender. If mixture is too thick add additional V-8 juice or if it is too thin boil until it is thicker. Ladle into bowls with yogurt and red pepper flakes on top. Toppings plain nonfat yogurt and/or crushed red pepper flakes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Prepare Creamette noodles according to package. Brown hamburger. Drain. Mix hamburger in sauce and mushrooms. Add salt pepper and garlic to taste. Mix egg with cottage cheese. Layer in large greased pan noodles hamburger mixture and cottage cheese (spread onto meat). Spread Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese on top. Should have 2 layers.

title: Curried Butternut Squash Bisque(A Spicy First Course Soup)
instructions: In a heavy soup pot heat oil over medium heat. Add onions and garlic; saute for 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly softened. Stir in curry and cumin and cook for 1 minute. Add chicken stock cider rice and squash; bring to a boil. Reduce to low heat and cover then simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or until squash is tender. Pour mixture through a strainer set over a large bowl. Puree the solids in a food processor or blender until very smooth. Return the puree and liquid to the saucepan. (May be prepared to this point and stored covered in refrigerator for up to 2 days.) To serve heat gently and season with salt and pepper. In small bowl stir together yogurt and milk and add a tablespoon to each serving drawing a knife through to make swirls. Serves 8.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and garlic in oil; add tomato sauce tomatoes and seasonings. Simmer covered for 15 minutes. Fill casserole with alternating layers of noodles Mozzarella cheese Ricotta cheese meat sauce and Parmesan cheese ending with sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli in flowerets discarding the thick stems. Toss together broccoli green onions bacon and sunflower seeds. Mix together remaining ingredients and stir into broccoli mixture. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Best Ever Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mash bananas with potato masher; set aside. Cream shortening and sugar well. Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour with salt baking powder and baking soda. Add flour mixture alternately with bananas to sugar mixture. Mix until well blended. Stir in walnuts. Pour batter into 1 large or 2 small well-greased loaf pans. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Garlic Rolls
instructions: Thaw and soften dough. Blend melted butter egg garlic powder parsley and salt. Cut off pieces of dough about the size of small walnuts. Dip into butter mixture. Place pieces of dough into greased pans until all dough is used. Cover; let rise until doubled in size. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Brush with melted butter or margarine.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
instructions: Rinse peas in hot water and drain. Combine vegetables nuts and bacon with sour cream. Mix dressing and mustard; pour over salad. Toss gently and chill. Can make the day ahead and refrigerate. Serves 6 to 8.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Heat over medium heat until piping hot stirring occasionally (do not boil). Serve with oyster crackers.

title: Baked Barbecue Steak
instructions: Chop the steak into chunks about 1-inch. Place in bottom of casserole. Put in barbecue sauce then carrots and onions. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Baked Beans-Beef Style
instructions: Saute onions in butter add hamburg and brown. Drain off fat. In 2-quart casserole dish add hamburg salt ketchup mustard vinegar and beans. Mix well and cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Soak gelatine in water. Add to hot soup. Put in cheese salad dressing shrimp salt and pepper. Beat until smooth. Cool. Add onion and celery. Pour into oiled mold. Serve with crackers.

title: Crescent Roll Treats
instructions: Cut Milky Way in half and wrap with crescent roll. Bake according to crescent roll directions and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Garlic Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in skins. Cool and shred coarsely. In greased casserole dish alternate layers of potatoes butter cheese onion sour cream salt pepper and parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Geri'S Crunchy Sweet Dills
instructions: Drain juice from pickles saving 2/3 cup. Put pickle juice sugar water vinegar and spices in a large 3-quart saucepan and bring to a boil. Slice pickles in 1-inch slices and put back into jar. When vinegar mixture has cooled to lukewarm pour over pickles. Replace lid and shake well. Put in refrigerator. Each day for 10 days shake pickles to distribute spices. After the 10 day period you will have great pickles. These make a nice gift especially for the holidays.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In saucepan combine soup and milk. Cook as directed according to can. When soup is just about done cooking add bacon pieces and chives. Stir until well blended. When soup is hot add shredded cheese and stir until all the cheese has melted.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat the cooking oil sugar eggs and vanilla well. Add apples then flour soda salt and pecans last. Bake in a loaf or tube pan for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Party Mints
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Combine with sugar and peppermint extract in food processor using steel blade. Batter will be very stiff. Divide batter and beat the desired color into each half. Pinch off enough dough to make marble size balls. Roll in your hand. Place balls in a single layer on a tray. Air day 30 minutes. Press each dough ball into a small mint mold. Immediately pop from mold and place in single layer to air dry overnight. Makes about 5 or 6 dozen. May be frozen but will keep in refrigerator several weeks. May be chilled but are better at room temperature.

title: Quick, Easy Baby Food Cake
instructions: In large bowl mix sugar with flour cinnamon cloves salt and soda. In a separate bowl mix eggs vegetable oil and apricot and prune baby food. Mix all together with dry ingredients. Pam or grease tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes or until light brown.

title: Cranberry Jello
instructions: Grind the cranberries. Add the juices from oranges and lemon. Add sugar and let sit overnight in refrigerator. Next morning mix jello with boiling water and let cool. Add the cranberry mixture and crushed pineapple to the jello. Chill.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat brown flour in oil until dark brown (not burned) stirring constantly. Add onions peppers and celery and saute until tender. In a large bowl add tomatoes crushed up and water. Season to taste. Add to roux-vegetable mixture. Add consomme and okra and bring to a boil. Then reduce heat to simmer for 30 minutes. Add shrimp; bring back to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Reduce back to medium heat for 15 minutes. Then add crabmeat and simmer for 5 minutes stirring gently. Turn off burner and cover with lid. Serve with rice.

title: Purple Cabbage Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage. Chop onion. Mix. Top with 3/4 cup sugar. Boil vinegar oil 2 teaspoons sugar mustard and celery seed. Cool. Pour over cabbage mixture. Stir. Refrigerate 6 hours. Keeps a long time in Tupperware.

title: Banana Pound Cake
instructions: Mix first five ingredients well then add bananas mixing well. Pour into bundt pan and bake 1 hour at 350 degrees or until done. Take from oven and make glaze.

title: Carrot Crumb Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first 9 ingredients in large bowl stirring well. Pour into greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Combine coconut pecans 1/4 cup baking mix brown sugar and 2 tablespoons softened butter. Sprinkle over batter. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes. Combine powdered sugar and 2 to 3 teaspoons milk; drizzle over warm cake. Cool completely before serving.

title: Pasta And Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except flour. Mix flour in slowly maintaining a smooth consistency. Knead for 6 minutes.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Mix cabbage green peppers and tomatoes with salt and let stand overnight; drain. Tie mixed whole spices in a cheesecloth bag and add to sugar and vinegar. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add all other ingredients and simmer until mixture is hot and well seasoned. Remove spice bag. Pack in hot canning jars and seal at once.

title: Delicious Sweet Rolls Or Doughnuts
instructions: Add butter and sugar to milk. Add yeast eggs salt and flour; beat well. Let rise until double in bulk. Roll out to oblong shape. Spread with melted butter; sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Add raisins if desired. Fold in half; cut into strips. Roll into rolls twisting as you go. Let rise until very light. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ham N' Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in greased casserole dish and cover. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 9-inch pie crust. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook ground beef until brown drain. Put beans tomato paste and 4 cans water. Add other ingredients. Cook for about an hour on low.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Beat egg slightly with fork. Add rest of ingredients and mix until combined. Put in greased muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 6.

title: Filled Star Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla extract. Beat in egg yolks and orange juice. Combine flour and salt; mix in 2 cups at a time until dough is soft. Add flour if needed. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight. Roll out chilled dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Use a star cutter to cut out shapes. Use thimble to cut out 5/8-inch centers (these are the top cookies). Gather dough scraps and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut out stars and put onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool and fill with jam. Sift confectioners sugar on top.

title: Layered Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage into small wedges; cook in boiling salted water until tender. Drain. Place wedges in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Set aside. Melt butter in a small saucepan; stir in flour salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat until thickened stirring constantly. Pour sauce over cabbage wedges. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Simple Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and jello. Stir well. Mix in cottage cheese and oranges. Stir well. Chill before serving.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter Crisco sugar and add eggs one at a time. Beat after each. Add salt and flour. Beat again. Add water cream and vanilla. Mix well. Then add walnuts. Pour in greased tube pan.

title: Simple Salisbury Steak
instructions: In bowl mix thoroughly 1/4 c. of the soup beef bread crumbs egg and onion. Shape firmly into 6 patties. In skillet over medium high heat cook patties until browned on both sides. Remove patties and discard fat. Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms; return patties to skillet. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until done turning patties occasionally.

title: Candy Apple Delight
instructions: Combine whipped topping and pineapple in bowl. Peel core and slice apples. Cut apple slices into quarters. Cut Snickers bars into small cubes. Chop peanuts. Fold in apples candy bars and peanuts to whipped topping mixture. Yield approximately 7 cups.

title: Herbed Bread Sticks
instructions: Chop herbs. Add to dressing. Spread on bread that has been cut into shapes desired. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Yummie Bars
instructions: Combine cake mix eggs oleo and peanut butter; stir until mix holds. Press 2/3 into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread filling over dough. Crumble reserved dough over filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut when cool. Makes 36. Test with toothpick for doneness.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until it starts to brown.

title: Overnight Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place 1/2 the bread cubes on the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Layer meat and vegetables over top. Cover with rest of bread cubes. Beat together eggs milk and mayonnaise. Pour over layered ingredients. Cover. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes uncovered then spread soup over top. Bake 45 minutes more. Sprinkle cheese over top and bake 15 minutes longer. Serves 12.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Combine pineapple oranges grapes marshmallows coconut and nuts. Mix sour cream and sugar. Stir into fruit mixture. Chill. Serves 6.

title: Hot Cheddar Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix grated cheese grated onion and mayonnaise. Put in a small ovenproof dish (like a soup crock). Bake for about 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Serve with crackers while bubbly and hot.

title: Easy Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first four ingredients. Pour sugar over and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve chilled. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: *May substitute apples or pumpkin.

title: Mint Sauce For Lamb
instructions: You will need a pan and spoon.

title: Chicken N Rice
instructions: Grease bottom and sides of large baking dish with butter. Cover bottom of dish with 1 cup uncooked rice. Place several dabs of butter on rice. Salt and pepper fryer pieces and place on top of rice. Spoon 1 can cream of mushroom soup over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top. Add water to almost cover chicken approximately 2 cups. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake 3 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Combine mayonnaise beaten eggs salt pepper onions and soup and add to broccoli. Pour into baking dish and top with cheese; add melted butter to stuffing mix and put on top of cheese and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Line a baking sheet with foil. Trim end stem off each zucchini. Cut a thin slice along bottom of each zucchini so it sets straight. Trim top of length 1/2-inch then hollow out each leaving a 1/2-inch thick shell. Do not pierce. Dice the slices and pulp; add onion. Cook 10 minutes. Add garlic. Stuff each shell. Place on baking sheet. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 25 to 30 minutes more.

title: Cherry Topped Icebox Cake
instructions: Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with some of the graham crackers (break if necessary). Pour cold milk into bowl. Add pudding mix. With electric mixer at low speed beat until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Let stand 5 minutes. Blend with Cool Whip. Spread half of the pudding mixture over crackers in pan. Add another layer of graham crackers. Top with remaining pudding mixture and remaining crackers. Top with pie filling. Chill 3 hours.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate 2 cups raw potatoes into 1/4 cup milk. Drain off milk; add egg and flour. Season with salt and pepper. Add minced onion. Drop by spoonfuls onto well greased pan. Brown on both sides.

title: Pineapple-Lime Float
instructions: Combine pineapple juice water and limeade concentrate. Divide pineapple mixture among 6 tall glasses. Spoon half of the lime sherbet into the glasses; stir gently. Carefully pour chilled ginger ale into each glass. Top with scoops of remaining lime sherbet. Garnish with mint leaves if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apricot Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0.\tSoak dried apricots in the baby food apricots while you assemble other ingredients and grease a 10-inch tube pan lining the bottom with wax paper cut to fit. Mix all at once the sifted flour sugar eggs oil and flavoring beating until smooth. Add apricots and pecans mixing well. Bake about 1 hour or until light brown and firm to touch.\tCool in pan before removing.

title: Grandpa'S Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Sift remaining ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Refrigerate dough and roll 1/8-inch thick. Cut to desired shapes. Bake on greased sheet at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yield 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix crushed pretzels 3 tablespoons sugar and butter. Press firmly into the bottom of a 13 x 9 baking pan. Bake for 10 minutes and cool. Beat cream cheese 1/2 cup sugar and milk until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip gently then spread over cooled crust and refrigerate. Boil water and pour strawberry gelatin in stirring well for about 2 minutes. Stir in the cold water and refrigerate for about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened and gelatin is beginning to set. Stir in the strawberries and carefully spoon over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 5 hours or until completely firm. Cut in squares to serve. Whipped topping may be added as a garnish.

title: Fudge
instructions: Boil first three ingredients together for 7 minutes. Take off fire. Add chocolate chips vanilla to taste marshmallow cream and nuts. Pour and let set. Cut.

title: Simply Easy Chicken(It Really Is!)
instructions: *Do not use fat-free or any of the diet dressings.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except meat until blended. Add meat mixing well. Separate into 3 sausage rolls. If you want hotter sausage you can roll the sausage in cracked black pepper. Roll the sausage in foil separately. Seal ends and put in refrigerator for 24 hours. Remove foil and bake on rack in pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes three rolls. Freezes well.

title: Nana'S Pot Roast
instructions: Brown meat with onion a little butter salt and pepper. Pour water to top of meat and simmer all day on low.

title: Oven-Barbecued Round Steak
instructions: Cut the meat into 6 to 8 servings pieces. Heat oil in large skillet and brown meat over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer the meat to an ungreased casserole.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Mix and press into cavity of celery sticks.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg gradually. Mix salt with flour and add Seven-Up with flour. Use a large pan with hole in it. Bake 2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Apple Dumplins
instructions: Mix all ingredients to make dough. Roll out dough fill with apple sugar cinnamon and butter; freeze. When ready to use thaw and make syrup. Pour over dumpling.

title: Cookies Cake
instructions: Combine milk and egg. Add cake mix and chopped pecans. Pour into pan and top with chocolate chips and Bits O Brickle. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Tastes better if you let set for 1 day.

title: Easy Skillet Supper
instructions: Melt butter in frypan at low heat. Add macaroni; stir to coat thoroughly with butter. Add tomato juice; bring to rapid boil. Stir in beef and onion salt and pepper. Cover; reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove cover and sprinkle with cheese. Serve with tossed salad.

title: Cherry Topped Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Reserve 1 cup of dry cake mix. In a large mixing bowl combine remaining cake mix 1 egg and oil (mixture will be crumbly). Press crust mixture evenly into bottom and 3/4 way up the sides of a greased pan. In same bowl blend cream cheese and sugar. Add 3 eggs and reserved cake mix; beat 1 minute at medium speed. At low speed slowly add milk and flavorings; mix until smooth. Pour into crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes until center is firm.

title: Sloppy Joe
instructions: Brown beef in skillet; drain off juice. Add barbecue sauce (enough to change color of beef from brown to reddish brown). Simmer 10 minutes on medium. Add Velveeta slices; stir frequently until melted. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook grits until thick. While hot add remaining ingredients and stir. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Yield 12 servings.

title: Strawberry Jello Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch well. Add water and salt until it thickens. Remove from heat and add strawberry jello and cool mixture really good. Add cut up strawberries and pour into 2 cooked pie shells. Chill for 2 hours. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Separate eggs. Mix milk and egg yolks. Add lemon juice. Beat egg whites until light and fluffy. Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time; beat until whites stand up in peaks. Fold into pie filling. Pour in crust. Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs. Bake 10 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Pour sugar over vegetables and stir in.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Blend jelly sauce and lemon juice and cook slowly. Season beef with salt pepper garlic and grated potato. Roll to the size of a quarter and drop in cooking sauce. Simmer for 1 hour. Makes about 70 meatballs.

title: Wassail(Hot Beverage)
instructions: One teaspoon ground spices may be substituted for whole ones.

title: Gelatin Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Let stand until firm.

title: Great Fruit
instructions: Combine lemon pudding and orange juice (as liquid) and mix well. Add all other ingredients.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Melt butter until brown. Add brown sugar and cook stirring until sugar is melted. Pour in milk and stir. Cool. Add confectioners sugar and extract. Beat.

title: Popcorn Salad
instructions: In bowl combine the ingredients. Chill. Top with grated cheese and crumbled bacon reserved from mixture. Rest should go into salad. Use within three hours.

title: Jennies Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually. Mix well. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Stir in sifted flour soda and oats. Form into small balls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken (when done pull meat off bones) onions celery salt and pepper. (Reserve liquid.) Cook rice in 2 cups of liquid you reserved. Put rice in casserole dish. Pour English peas over rice. Mix remaining liquid with soup mixture. Put chicken on top of peas; pour soup mixture over that then put a layer of cheese on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 until hot.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar and cocoa. Stir in eggs. Add milk vanilla melted margarine nuts; mixing well. Put in pie crust.

title: Hearty Sausage Stew
instructions: *I use 2 beers. Makes it really good.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Zesty Veggies
instructions: Drain the mushrooms and reserve the liquid. Add enough water to liquid to make 1 cup. In large skillet combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Simmer about 5 minutes. Cool and refrigerate in a tightly covered bowl for at least 24 hours.

title: Hamburger And Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Add other ingredients and cook until the mixture bubbles. Put mixture into casserole dish. Split biscuits uncooked in half and cover top of casserole. Put cheese on top of casserole and on top of biscuits. Bake at 375\u00b0 uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Toasted Deviled Hamburgers
instructions: This wil cover 8 slices of bread. Cut crust from bread. Toast on one side. Spread with hamburger on side not toasted. Return to broiler and let broil for eight or ten minutes. Serve hot.

title: Enchilada Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Slice onions and bell peppers. Mince garlic. Drain tomatoes. Cook beef in a large frying pan until no longer pink. Remove with a slotted spoon. Add onions bell peppers garlic 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Cook until soft about 15 minutes.

title: Easy Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Microwave in safe microwave casserole dish sugar and syrup. Cook 4 1/2 minutes. Add peanuts. Cook 3 minutes. Add butter and vanilla. Cook 2 minutes and 15 seconds. Add baking soda. Stir lightly. Pour onto buttered pizza pan or cookie sheet. Do not spread.

title: Vegetable Couscous
instructions: Heat all ingredients except couscous and cheese to boiling in a 2-quart saucepan. Serve over couscous. Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar thoroughly. Add sour cream egg yolk and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to cream blending well. Chill and shape into balls working with small portions at a time keeping remaining dough chilled. Roll out 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut with floured 2 1/2-inch cutter. Sprinkle cut out with sugar. Bake on greased baking sheet in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Steamed New Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes and place them in a large steam pan. Fill the bottom pan with water (halfway to top). Put garlic and onion in the water. Bring to a boil. Place the steam pan with potatoes over the water pan. Cut the butter up and drop on top of potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover steam pan reduce heat to a simmer and let steam for about 30 to 45 minutes. Check for doneness by pricking with a fork. Before you serve sprinkle with parsley flakes and more butter if desired.

title: Chocolate Turtle Cheesecake
instructions: Place caramels and evaporated milk in a heavy saucepan. Heat over medium-low heat stirring continually until smooth about 5 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped pecans pour into pie crust. Combine cream cheese sour cream and milk in a blender process until smooth. Add pudding mix process about 30 seconds longer. Pour pudding mixture over caramel layer covering evenly chill loosely covered until set about 15 minutes. Drizzle fudge topping over pudding layer in a decorative pattern Sprinkle top of cake with remaining pecans. Chill loosely covered until serving time.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream butter confectioners sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour salt and pecans; mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook sugar Karo and water until threads or crackles in water. Add peanuts. Cook to 290\u00b0 to 300\u00b0. Beat in the butter vanilla and soda quickly. Spread on greased cookie sheet.

title: Lady Fingers
instructions: Mix sour cream 1 Cup margarine and enough flour to form soft dough approximately 1/2 Cup.

title: Potato Sausage Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on high for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli until nearly done; drain. Blend together soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Put broccoli in buttered casserole. Then arrange chicken over. Pour sauce over top. Sprinkle with cheese then bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Boston Brown Bread *
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Spoon into three greased coffee cans or loaf pans. Let stand for one-half hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Molly'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa in saucepan. Beat egg yolks with milk. Gradually add water to dry ingredients; stir to blend. Stir some of the hot mixture into eggs then mix all together. Cook until thick. Add vanilla and butter. Top with meringue.

title: Pizza Horns
instructions: Thaw frozen bread in refrigerator overnight or at room temperature 2 to 3 hours. On lightly floured surface roll out each loaf into a circle about 10 inches in diameter. If dough is difficult to roll pat or stretch dough with your hands until 1/4-inch thick. Brush surface with oil. With pizza cutter or sharp knife cut each circle into 8 triangles or wedges. Generously spread surface with pizza sauce to which oregano and garlic powder are added. Leave about 1/4-inch margin on each side. Sprinkle with cheeses green pepper and pepperoni. Roll up each triangle beginning from the wide end. Curve ends to form crescents. Place on lightly oiled baking sheets. Brush tops with egg white. Sprinkle with additional oregano or Parmesan cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until crescents are golden brown.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion until tender then mash together. Add margarine and eggs. Season to taste with salt and pepper; mix together. Place in casserole dish and top with buttered cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 4 1-pound coffee cans. Roll dates and nuts in flour. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Fill can 1/2 full. Bake 1 hour. Cool in can 10 to 15 minutes. Turn out on rack.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Place warm water in a bowl. Add the dry milk; mix well. Add sugar and mix until smooth.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Do not grease cookie sheet for baking cookies. Very tender cookies after baking. Leave cookies on tray a minute or two before removing. Drop by teaspoonful on tray. Makes 60 cookies.

title: Red Molded Salad
instructions: Combine cheese celery mayonnaise and nuts; let stand at room temperature. Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add applesauce and cinnamon. Pour half of mixture in pan; congeal. Spread layer of cream mixture; top with remaining gelatin mixture and congeal.

title: Trail Mix
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter. Mix. Add corn flakes and drop by spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Zesta Cracker Candy
instructions: Mix milk and sugar. Put in small pot. Come to rapid boil. Stir constantly for 3 minutes. Take off burner.\tAdd crackers peanut butter and vanilla flavoring; mix well. Pour in small square pan or glass with margarine (grease it lightly). Let cool and cut in squares.

title: Maple Syrup
instructions: Combine in saucepan and bring to a boil. Serve hot or cold. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Day Ahead Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix together pudding milk Eagle Brand condensed milk sour cream and Cool Whip. Pour over layered bananas and wafers. Continue this until all of the mixture is used. End with mixture. Garnish with wafers around your dish. Cool Whip as a topping is optional. Refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Fudgies
instructions: Boil first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes. Combine peanut butter with hot ingredients. Add oatmeal stir well; add salt. Drop by spoonfuls on foil and allow to set for at least 30 minutes. (If it thickens too quickly add small amounts of milk.)

title: Delicious Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve cold or heat slowly. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Ditalini & Bean Soup
instructions: In large pot heat oil & saute ham onion & garlic until tender. Add water sauce beans parsley and pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 10 minutes to blend flavors. Add pasta. Serve with grated Romano or Parmesan cheese.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine drained green beans cream of mushroom soup mushrooms half a can of Durkee French fried onions and pepper to taste. Stir until all ingredients are combined. Put in a casserole dish and bake about 20 minutes uncovered. Take out of oven and put remaining dried onions on top. Bake about 5 more minutes. Take out of oven and serve.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Pimiento
instructions: Drain pimiento reserving 1 teaspoon juice; set pimiento and reserved juice aside. Break pasta into thirds; cook according to package directions drain. Place pasta in a serving bowl. Add pimiento reserved pimiento juice cheese and remaining ingredients; toss well. Serve warm. Yield 4 servings.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Beat together cream cheese and sugar then add Cool Whip. Mix well and then spoon over crust. Mix jello with boiling water. Add strawberries with syrup. Let stand 10 minutes. Pour over cheese mixture and refrigerate. When set garnish with nuts.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients using electric mixer. Turn into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn oven to 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes more baking time.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients well and bake for 1 hour or until done at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable-Lentil Chowder
instructions: Combine lentils water and salt in large saucepan. Cook covered over medium heat for 30 minutes. Cook onion and green pepper until tender. Combine all ingredients. Simmer covered for 30 minutes. Makes 6 large servings.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar butter and buttermilk. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs. Beat. Add flour then almond flavoring. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Separate eggs. Beat egg whites. Cream the cream cheese and sugar; add egg yolks sour cream lemon juice and vanilla. Fold in egg whites. Add flour.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form small meat balls. Place in a pie plate and microwave on High until meat balls are almost fully cooked (about 6 to 7 minutes). Rearrange once. Give dish 1/2 turn during cooking. Repeat procedure until all meat balls are cooked. Add to spaghetti sauce the last hour of simmering.

title: Old Fashion Jumbles
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter or Crisco with sugar egg milk and vanilla. Mix all ingredients together. Roll thin. Sprinkle with sugar. Place on slightly oiled sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 approximately 10 minutes.

title: Turnip Casserole
instructions: Combine turnips butter sugar salt eggs pepper and 3/4 cup of the bread crumbs; mix well. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Top with rest of bread crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon of melted butter. Bake until brown about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Microwave potatoes. Slice each potato lengthwise on the top. With a teaspoon remove the center of potatoes to a bowl leaving the potato shells intact. Add 2 tablespoons of butter 2 tablespoons of sour cream salt and pepper to the potatoes in the bowl. Mix until smooth. Divide the potato mixture evenly among the potato shells mounding. Sprinkle with cheese if desired. Microwave at High for 1 minute per potato. If more than 2 potatoes are microwaved at one time arrange in a circle.

title: Cream Cheese Delight
instructions: Melt oleo. Add yellow cake mix and 2 eggs. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Batter is stiff.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. In small bowl mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar until smooth. Add to salad mixing well. Put salad in airtight container and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Paper Mache
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together in large bowl and allow to sit 24 hours. Then add water and flour. Mix thoroughly. Can form over balloon or use in molds.\tAllow to air dry. Depending on the weather sometimes takes 3 days. Sometimes use clear acrylic spray depending on the project. Enjoy!

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Boil sugar syrup and water to 240\u00b0 or until it hardens in cold water. Add peanuts and butter; boil until peanuts are brown. Remove from heat. Add soda dissolved in vanilla. Stir well and pour on slab and spread.

title: Fried Cauliflower
instructions: Wash cauliflower; cut in small pieces with stems. Boil in small amount of water until about half done and still somewhat crisp. Remove from heat; drain and cool just until it can be handled. Dip cauliflower pieces one at a time into mixture made of the egg and milk. Coat generously with flour to which desired amount of salt has been added. Fry in hot oil. (May use deep fryer or skillet with 1/2 inch of oil.)
