Brown lightly on both sides for approximately 5 minutes. Ready to eat as finger food!

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Wash peel and cube potatoes. Combine potatoes water bouillon celery carrot onion parsley and dash of salt and pepper. Boil and reduce heat to a simmer until tender. Add 3 1/2 cups milk flour and butter; heat until hot and serve.

title: Peppery Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; add buttermilk water margarine and eggs. Mix well. Stir in onion and peppers. Carefully drop batter by teaspoon into hot oil (375\u00b0). Fry 3 to 5 minutes turning once until hush puppies are golden brown. Drain well on paper towels. Yields about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Carrie Mae'S Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Stew chicken until tender. Remove bones and dice meat. Melt butter in skillet; stir in starch. Add broth and milk. Stir until thickened over medium heat. Place chicken vegetables and peas in 12 x 8 x 2-inch casserole dish. Cover with sauce. Sprinkle in salt and pepper; mix. Cover with latticed pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 or until golden brown.

title: Artichoke And Shrimp Soup
instructions: Melt butter; saute onion. Add flour and blend. Stir milk in slowly stirring until smooth. Add broth and seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened on low heat. Add cheese parsley and artichokes along with shrimp. Cook about 30-45 minutes. (If fresh cauliflower or broccoli are used parboil until almost tender before adding to soup.)

title: Layered Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: In 2-quart casserole layer half the onion celery and green pepper; season with salt and pepper. Top with beef; season with three-fourths teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Pour on tomato sauce. Top with remaining onion celery and pepper. Arrange potatoes over top; spread with soup. Bake uncovered in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 to 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until potatoes are tender and top is lightly browned. Do not stir. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pork Chops With Herbs
instructions: Brown chops in heavy skillet. In same skillet saute onions until golden. Combine soup milk thyme poultry seasoning oregano water and salt. Remove chops and onions to baking dish. Cover with remaining ingredients. Cook 1 1/2 hours in covered pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in baking dish. Mix flour sugar and buttermilk together in medium size bowl. Pour mixture over melted margarine. Pour fruit on top; do not stir.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice until rice is very tender; cool slightly. Prepare pudding with milk. Mix together rice pudding and Cool Whip. Add cinnamon to taste.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes until done. Cool. Put in refrigerator overnight. Peel and grate potatoes. Put a layer of potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add half of cheese. Sprinkle over cheese 1 teaspoon of onion. Add another layer of potatoes cheese and onion. Pour the milk over the layers. Melt the butter and pour over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello with boiling water. Add fruit juice. Add blueberries and pineapple. Set in fridge overnight.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Drain clams; reserve 1 cup liquid. Fry bacon in skillet until almost crisp. Add onion and celery. Saute until tender; drain. Combine bacon mixture potatoes clam liquid salt pepper and thyme in large saucepan. Simmer 10 minutes. Add milk and clams. Heat thoroughly. Do not boil. Top each serving with 1 teaspoon butter. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken salt pick off bones and set aside (save broth). Melt margarine and stir into dressing. In pan put half of broth dressing and half of chicken on dressing. Put mushroom soup (undiluted) on chicken. Then put another layer of broth and dressing then chicken then chicken mushroom soup on top of chicken (undiluted). Put 3 tablespoons dressing on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit And Cabbage Salad
instructions: Place all ingredients except lettuce leaves in a bowl and toss. Refrigerate until serving time. On individual salad plates place a lettuce leaf and then fill with a portion of the salad; or serve in large bowl (no lettuce leaves needed). Cabbage adds a crispy texture to the fruits in this simply prepared salad. Serves 6.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Wash beets and trim tops leaving 1/4-inch of tops. Do not break the skin. Boil until tender peel beets and pour off juice. Do not reuse. In large pot mix vinegar water sugar and pickling spices. When sugar is dissolved add beets and bring to a boil. Put beets in clean jars. Bring juice to a boil and fill jars. Seal while hot.

title: Cabbage And Tomato Skillet(Serves 4)
instructions: Cook bacon in skillet (large) until crisp; remove bacon reserving drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon; set aside. Add remaining ingredients in skillet; cook over medium heat uncovered for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in bacon.

title: Nanny'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Wet bottom of glass and flatten cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 or 15 minutes or less.

title: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Combine cucumbers onions and peppers. Cover with water and 1/3 cup salt; put several trays of ice cubes on top. Let stand 3 hours. Drain and add vinegar to cover cucumbers. Add rest of ingredients; bring to boiling point. Put in jars and seal.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt in heavy saucepan. Beat egg yolks; combine egg yolks and milk mixing well. Stir into dry ingredients; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Layer 1/3 of wafers in 3-quart baking dish. Slice bananas and layer over wafers. Pour 1/3 of custard over bananas. Repeat layers twice.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in oil. Add ground beef. Cook until browned. Add tomatoes rice and chili powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered in casserole and 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch square baking pan. Mix together first 5 ingredients. Set aside. Combine milk sour cream vegetable oil egg chilies cheese and corn. Stir into dry ingredients. Spoon into prepared pan and bake 30 minutes. Serve warm. Serves 6.

title: Egg Nog(Serves 6)
instructions: Mix eggs with sugar and salt. Add milk and vanilla. Serve cold in tall glasses with nutmeg sprinkled on top.

title: Curry Dip
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients. Cover. Refrigerate for several hours. Serve with vegetable dippers. Makes 2 cups.

title: Nanie'S Banana Bread
instructions: Cream the shortening eggs flour soda sugar salt then mashed bananas and chopped nuts. Grease loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 to 80 minutes.

title: Pigs In A Blanket
instructions: You will need several toothpicks (broken in half).

title: Applesauce
instructions: Peel apples then slice. Put apples and water in pan and cook about 15 minutes or until tender. Use a potato masher to mash apples. Add sugar--about 1 1/2 c. to your own taste. Add cinnamon; heat for 5 minutes.

title: Bonbons Mound Candy
instructions: Roll the first 6 ingredients into small balls. Combine the chocolate and paraffin together in a double boiler. Dip balls into the chocolate mixture and put chocolate balls on wax paper until hardened.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening margarine and sugar. Mix until well blended. Beat in eggs; add flour with all dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add vanilla.

title: Whole-Wheat Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Note Bake bread the same day you plan to serve it.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix and stir over low heat. Slowly continue to stir until it kneads like dough. The salt base allows mixture to crumble when dry not gummy. Store in 20-ounce canister.

title: Herbed Summer Salad
instructions: Note Can use more onion and cucumbers.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Combine egg whites sugar water and corn syrup in top of a double boiler beating with rotary eggbeater until thoroughly mixed. Place over rapidly boiling water; beat constantly with rotary eggbeater and cook 7 minutes or until frosting will stand in peaks. Remove from boiling water. Add vanilla; beat until thick enough to spread. Makes enough frosting to cover tops and sides of two 9-inch layers or 2 dozen cupcakes.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Have all cheese at room temperature. Mix with remaining ingredients. Mix well and roll into balls then roll in chopped pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Health Bread
instructions: Put dates and raisins in a bowl with hot water; let set 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix together and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 2 small loaves. Delicious.

title: Mozzarella Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix turkey Egg Beaters crumbs milk (1 cup skimmed) Parmesan cheese onion salt and oregano. Shape into loaf and place in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until no pink remains; drain. Spoon pizza sauce over loaf and top with Mozzarella cheese slices. Return to oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix in crushed pretzels. Spread evenly in pan. Bake 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Blend the first 3 ingredients together. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool.

title: Heavenly Hash Candy
instructions: Mix the sugar milk and corn syrup in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat to a boil (mixture will be bubbling all over top). Boil and stir another 2 minutes more. Take off heat. Stir in the chocolate chips until completely melted. Cool about 15 minutes. Stir in the pecans and marshmallows. Drop by 2 teaspoons onto wax paper. Chill until firm or put in a buttered pan and cut into pieces.

title: Bean Ham Soup
instructions: Remove 1 1/2 cups of beans and mash. Set aside.

title: Caramel Delight Pie
instructions: In a skillet brown pecans and coconut in butter; set aside. Blend cream cheese and condensed milk together. Add all of the Cool Whip. Divide into pie crusts. Top with the coconut-pecan mixture then drizzle the caramel topping over the top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Using a round pizza pan or a cookie sheet lay crescent rolls out in pan and press edges together to form crust. Brown sausage and cook bacon. Crumble both on crust. Beat eggs; add salt and pepper to eggs to taste. Pour over meat and crust. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until eggs are cooked in the middle.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Stir butter into spaghetti. Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs. Form mixture into a crust in a buttered 8-inch pie plate. Spread cottage cheese over bottom of crust. In skillet cook ground beef onion and green pepper until vegetables are tender and meat brown. Stir in undrained tomatoes paste sugar oregano and garlic salt. Heat through. Turn into crust. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle on cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer until cheese melts.

title: Coconut Refrigerator Cake
instructions: Cake Mix Mix and bake according to directions. Bake in 2 layers. Let cool and split each layer making 4 layers.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Cook chicken in water to cover with carrot onion celery seed and bay leaf. Reserve broth and cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle with lemon juice and curry powder. Bring 2 cups chicken broth to boil. Add rice and cook 20 minutes.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0 and grease a 9 x 13 pan. Combine cake mix and butter until crumbly. Reserve 1 1/4 cups crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs add milk and eggs; beat 2 minutes on high. Pour into prepared pan. Spread berries on top. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Microwave Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine pudding mix and 1 cup fruit juice. Microwave uncovered for 3 to 4 minutes stirring every minute. Add pineapple and oranges. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Add bananas when ready to serve. Decorate with maraschino cherries.

title: Zucchini With Meatballs
instructions: Blend together broth and cornstarch. Stir into zucchini and tomato mixture. Pour over meatballs. Continue baking 10 to 20 minutes longer. Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Mix gelatin sugar and salt in top of double boiler. Add eggs and beat. Stir in undiluted lemonade and water. Cook this custard until it coats a spoon (about 5 minutes). Cool.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook minced onions and peppercorns in butter or margarine over medium heat stirring frequently until onions are light brown. Sprinkle onions with flour. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add beef broth water and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Discard bay leaf. Put soup in ovenproof soup tureen or large casserole. Place toast slices on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Place under broiler or in a 400\u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Beef Stock
instructions: Preheat oven to very hot about 500\u00b0. Place bones in a single layer in a roasting pan. Break carrots and celery into large pieces; sprinkle among the bones ditto with the onions. Roast for 30 to 45 minutes until meat bones and vegetables begin to brown even turn a little. Dump these into a deep stock pot. Pour about a half inch of water into the roasting pan; dissolve any bits which have stuck to the bottom of the pan. Pour over bones. Add more water to several inches above bones. Bring to a boil; stir in tomato paste. Add parsley thyme peppercorns and garlic. Cook barely simmering for several hours adding more hot water as necessary. Strain and boil slowly until reduced and flavor is intensified. Allow to cool; skim any fat from the top. Refrigerate tightly covered or freeze. Makes about 2 quarts.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar syrup water and peanuts in a heavy pan. Bring to a rapid rolling boil. Boil until a drop of water crystallizes or approximately 5 to 7 minutes until golden brown. Add butter vanilla and soda. (This will foam up.) Stir mixture then pour onto a buttered cookie sheet. Then break into pieces when cooled.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Arrange broccoli and cauliflower in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Saute onion and margarine. Add cheese soup and mushrooms. Simmer until cheese melts. Pour sauce over vegetables. Sprinkle with almonds and bread crumbs. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix pumpkin and dry ingredients thoroughly. Add eggs and milk. Pour into 9-inch pie pan with unbaked crust. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Derby Fruit Dip(Especially Strawberries)
instructions: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar in a mixing bowl. Add eggs sour cream and vanilla. Mix. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Beat until combined. Pour half of the mixture into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with half of the topping mix. Add remaining batter and topping. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Taco Layered Dip
instructions: Mix beans seasoning mix and salsa together. Put in a large pan. This is the bottom layer. Top with sour cream then avocado dip then layer cheese and tomato on top. Let set in refrigerator for about 1 hour before serving. Serve with chips.

title: Laura'S Special Dip
instructions: Mix dressing mix and sour cream together. Then use to dip chips vegetables etc.

title: Rabbit With Chestnut Puree
instructions: Roast rabbits until fork-tender in a low uncovered pan in a slow 325\u00b0 oven seasoning only by brushing with melted butter.

title: Snowflake Square
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar slowly while creaming mix. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Combine milk and almond extract. Add flour and milk alternately to creamed mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold in. Pour into 10-inch square shallow cake pan. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Frost as desired. Cut into squares.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender. Drain off water add ham cheese green pepper and cream of mushroom soup. Mix just enough to blend. Put in greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Hunter'S Delight
instructions: After meat is browned add onions and peppers. Add a little water and simmer a few minutes; add rest of the ingredients and simmer until hot. Serves about 40 people.

title: Chicken And Tater Barbecue
instructions: Saute first four ingredients just until tender not brown. Add all but last 2 ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes. Place chicken and potatoes in a roaster. Pour sauce over. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Corn Bread Cake
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and oil together. Add flour vanilla and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in an oblong pan.

title: Pastry
instructions: Pour boiling water over shortening. Stir well. Sift in dry ingredients and stir until nothing sticks to bowl. May be chilled in a large ball or divided into smaller ones. Wrap in foil before chilling. Keeps well in refrigerator. Roll to desired size for pie.

title: Aunt Mollie'S Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except parsley flakes). Bake in greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Use parsley to garnish top of casserole. Serves 2 \oink-oinks\ or 3 normals.

title: Quick Meal
instructions: Cook potatoes onions and ground beef in skillet on medium heat until redness is gone from meat stirring constantly so potatoes and onions wont scorch. Add small amount of water 1/2 cup. Season to taste.

title: Holiday Nuts
instructions: Toast nuts at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in sugar and salt. Slowly fold nuts into mixture and mix until coated.

title: Savory Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In a Dutch oven cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender. Drain. Add the next 8 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Remove the bay leaf. Serve over spaghetti. Yield 4 to 6 servings (about 1 quart).

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Boil until sugar is dissolved. Cool then pour over vegetable mixture and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Place chilies under broiler after washing; make a small slit in each pepper. Blister on all sides. Place in plastic bag for 15 minutes. Put in cold water; peel and seed. Cut Monterey cheese in strips and stuff chilies. Put in casserole dish; sprinkle with Cheddar. Beat egg salt milk and flour until smooth. Pour over and bake 35 to 45 minutes until knife blade comes out clean.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Mix all ingredients together. Shape into round or square shape on waxed paper. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. Place on serving dish and remove waxed paper. Serve with crackers.

title: Easy Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes. Cool and slice with skin on. Cut green onions and blend 2 vegetables with Ranch dressing. Top with Bac*Os and a little black pepper.

title: Artichoke Quiche
instructions: Drain oil from artichoke hearts. Reserve hearts. Put oil into frying pan. Heat. Chop scallions and fry in oil until limp. Drain oil reserve scallions.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain. Combine tuna soup and milk. Fold in macaroni. Bake in 9 x 12 dish at 350\u00b0 until mixture is bubbly. Sprinkle with cheese and brown. May substitute noodles for macaroni.

title: Spinach Bisque
instructions: In 3 quart saucepan saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour salt and nutmeg until smooth. Gradually whisk in milk and water. Add cheese; cook and stir over medium heat until melted. Add spinach; cover and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through. Serve with oyster crackers if desired. Yield 5 to 6 servings.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with soup. Add Tater Tots. Freeze.

title: Beer Can Chicken
instructions: Remove and discard the neck giblets and any excess fat from the chicken. Rinse chicken well inside and out with cold water. Lightly brush or spray chicken with vegetable oil then season inside and out with the rub mixture. Open the can of beer and pour out half. Set the half full can of beer on a flat surface and slide the chicken over the top so the can fits inside the cavity. Transfer the bird to the grill keeping the can upright. Grill over indirect medium heat 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until the chicken juices run clear and the internal temperature reaches 170\u00b0 in the breast and 180\u00b0 in the thickest part of the thigh. Wearing barbecue mitts carefully remove the chicken and beer can from the grill. Be careful not to spill the beer since it will be hot. Let the chicken set for about 10 minutes before lifting it from the can. Discard beer. Cut chicken into serving pieces. Serve warm. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook the squash and onion in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine the soup sour cream and carrot. Fold in the squash and onion. Combine the stuffing mix and melted butter or margarine. Spread half of stuffing mixture in a 9 x 3-inch baking pan. Spoon vegetable mixture on top of stuffing. Sprinkle remaining crumbs over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut with spatula. Serves 10. Travels well. Equally good at room temperature.

title: Johnnycakes
instructions: In large bowl put flour corn meal baking powder and salt in bowl; set aside. Beat shortening sugar and eggs; beat well. Add the milk then the flour mixture. Drop a spoonful of batter onto the frying pan with a large spoon. Brown the cakes on both sides by turning them with the spatula.

title: Chocolate Sauerkraut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and lightly flour two 8-inch layer pans. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Sift flour cocoa baking powder baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternating with water. Stir in sauerkraut. Bake in preheated pans at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Frost with your favorite icing.

title: Oven Steamed Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 2-quart ungreased casserole dish with a tight fitting lid mix rice salt and pepper. Dot with butter. Pour boiling water over rice. Stir to melt butter. Bake covered 45 minutes (do not lift lid). Add green onions. Mix lightly. To serve fluff up rice lightly with fork. Serves 6.

title: Easy Soup
instructions: Brown beef then add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer until done. Serves 6.

title: Corn Relish Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate at least a few hours before serving. Best served with Fritos Scoops.

title: Hamburg Dip
instructions: Brown the first 3 ingredients and drain. Stir in the remaining ingredients except cheeses. Take off heat before adding cheeses. Stir until melted and well mixed. Serve with crackers.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cut and brown bacon with onion and ground beef. Pour in casserole dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Saucepan Cookies
instructions: Pour melted shortening over brown sugar and add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in a 17 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Let cool 10 minutes. Cut into squares and remove from pan when cold.

title: Glaze For Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cook until thick enough to dribble over cake.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in medium bowl. Chill before serving.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Crumble ground beef into 1 1/2-quart glass casserole; add onion and garlic. Microwave (High) 5 to 6 minutes or until set; stir once. Stir to break meat into small pieces; drain. Stir in tomato paste water green chilies olives and salt. Cover with lid. Microwave (High) for 9 to 10 minutes or until flavors are blended and sauce is bubbly stirring twice. Set aside.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Salt chicken. Boil chicken until tender. Remove bones. Cut in chunks. Mix melted margarine cracker crumbs and poppy seed. Pat 1/2 of mixture in 9 x 11-inch casserole dish. Layer chicken on top of crumb mixture.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared crust. Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with cherry pie filling. Ready to serve. Excellent with coffee. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Fresh Vegetable Bake
instructions: Combine veggies and spoon into 4-quart casserole. In small saucepan combine broth and herbs. Pour over vegetables. Cover and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Bring to a boil the squash onion and water. Cover and simmer until tender. While this is cooking mix cornbread crumbs cream of chicken soup margarine and black pepper. Mix with squash mixture and bake in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: French Cheeseburger
instructions: Slice the bread lengthwise and hull out loaf (top and bottom). Brown hamburger and onions then add catsup. Spoon into bottom part of the bread. Put a slice of cheese on top of meat. Place top of bread on sandwich then roll in plastic wrap. Place in oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Slice and serve with salad.

title: The Best Yeast Bread
instructions: Have ingredients at room temperature. Heat milk to lukewarm. Add yeast stirring to dissolve. Cream 1 stick butter sugar and salt. Add milk and yeast to butter mixture. Beat eggs and add. Beat together. Add 1 1/2 cups flour mixing well. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Add 1 1/2 cups flour and mix well. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Drop by spoonfuls into greased Bundt or tube pan. Pour 1 stick melted butter over mix. Let rise 3 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Slice to serve.

title: Autumn Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Combine all other ingredients in large pan. Bring to a boil. Let simmer for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Bacon-Onion Cheese Balls
instructions: Fry bacon; cool and crumble. Mix softened cream cheese salad dressing cheese bacon bits and onion. When well mixed form into ball and chill. Ball may be rolled in finely chopped walnuts or pecans or parsley flakes.

title: Mock Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Blend ingredients; refrigerate if desired. Heat over hot water before serving. Yields about 1 cup sauce.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate overnight. If desired add 2 cups of sliced bananas at serving time.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Beat sugar and shortening together. Then add eggs one at a time and beat. Add rest of ingredients and beat good. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Slice 1/2 stick butter over Veg-All Cheez Whiz and salt and pepper. Crumble crackers and put over mixture. Add other 1/2 stick butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Prime Rib Roast Beef
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients with 3 cups water. Put frozen roast in crock-pot. Pour liquid mixture over it. Put lid on and cook on low overnight. Serve. Cut in thin slices on Kaiser buns. Use juice to dip sandwich in.

title: Mom'S Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk; bring to full rolling boil. Boil and stir for 4 1/2 minutes. Break up chocolate and mix with other ingredients. Pour hot syrup over all ingredients and stir. Pour in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate.

title: Christmas Ruby Red Salad(Good Anytime)
instructions: Mix and refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid according to directions. Add pineapple juice. Chill and serve.

title: Mounds Bars
instructions: Mix coconut milk sugar and butter together. Spread in a sheet cake or cookie pan. Put in freezer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove; cut into bars. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler. Dip bars into chocolate mixture (I dip them with a toothpick). Place on wax paper to cool.

title: Barbecue Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Turn on oven and set at 350\u00b0 (moderate). Mix first 7 ingredients in a 2-quart bowl. Stir in potatoes until well mixed. Put mixture into a shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese and paprika over top. Bake near center of oven about 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Ranch Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening brown sugar and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Mix together and drop by tablespoons on greased cookie sheet (for smaller cookie use teaspoon). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Campfire Macaroni
instructions: Brown and drain meat; add onion. Cook until clear. Add remaining ingredients except beans and cheese. Cook until macaroni is tender. Add beans and cheese. Cook until heated through and serve warm.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Dice tomatoes green pepper cheese and ham. Cook spaghetti; drain and cool with cold water. Toss together. Add Italian dressing.

title: Bonbons
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Roll into small balls. Chill until firm. Dip in melted chocolate.

title: Banana Dream Pie
instructions: Prepare Dream Whip with 1 cup of milk as directed on package using a large mixer bowl. Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Blend then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl. Spoon into pie crust. Chill for 4 hours.

title: Frosted Graham Crackers
instructions: Fill an 11 x 15-inch jelly roll pan with graham crackers. Boil 1 cup butter and 1 cup brown sugar for a few minutes. Add 1/2 cup ground nuts to mixture. Pour over graham crackers and spread evenly. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut while warm.

title: Granola
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix first 5 ingredients. Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes turning and mixing every 10 to 15 minutes. Let cool slightly then add raisins and any other dry fruit you like. Store in an airtight container.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Clean crab meat and pick out all bones. Combine everything and roll in egg then bread crumbs and fry in deep fat.

title: Hawaiian Cheese Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese at medium speed of electric mixer until fluffy; stir in remaining ingredients. Serve on crackers or bread. Yield 3 1/4 cups.

title: Pink Stuff
instructions: Mix ingredients in a large bowl. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oil and vanilla until thick; sift the remaining dry ingredients together. Fold in the dates or raisins and nuts; pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until wood pick comes out clean. Makes two loaves.

title: Special Potato Dish
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan mix all ingredients together. Chill overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Soup
instructions: Cook ground meat until browned. Drain and add taco seasoning stirring well. Add tomato sauce and chopped tomatoes. Stir in corn and simmer over low heat 30 to 45 minutes. Serve with crackers. Serves 6.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients well together. Use enough flour to make a soft dough. Roll out on floured bread board and cut with biscuit cutter. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Will be soft.

title: Mozzarella Munchies
instructions: Mix the cheese onion and Miracle Whip together and spread on party rye. Put under the boiler to slightly brown and bubbly. Serve.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook broccoli only until it separates. Drain. Mix remaining ingredients in greased casserole dish. Alternate first broccoli then mixture. Repeat. Crush Ritz crackers over top. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain well. Pour broccoli back into pan. Add salt and pepper. Stir in cheese and 1/2 stick of margarine until melted. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Melt remaining margarine in pan and stir in crushed Ritz crackers then spread over the broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: Cherry Pie(Makes 10 Pies.)
instructions: Combine sugar tapioca salt and almond flavor. Mix thoroughly with fruit and fruit juices before pouring into shells. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Arkansas Beans
instructions: Fry hamburger meat in large skillet. Drain off fat. Pour pork and beans in with hamburger meat then barbecue sauce. Heat thoroughly.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice until tender in salted water. Mix all ingredients. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes. Add 1/2 cup diced Cheddar cheese. Pour into flat bakeware. Top with cooking cheese. Brown cheese in hot oven. Serve.

title: Sauteed Zucchini
instructions: Heat skillet. Put in oil. Heat and put in garlic zucchini salt and pepper. Cook few minutes until tender. Great taste.

title: Squash Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well and pour the mixture into a greased skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Snowball Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo powdered sugar and vanilla together. Add flour salt and nuts. Put in refrigerator to chill; roll in balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done. While hot roll in powdered sugar. Cool. Roll in plain sugar.

title: Barley With Ham
instructions: Simmer ham in water until ham loosens from bone. Discard bone and fat. Add barley and onion. Cook until barley is tender about 1 hour. Serves 2 as a main course.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind the cranberries and add sugar. Let set overnight in the refrigerator. Dissolve jello in 1 pint warm water and let set until it gets thick as honey. Add all cranberries nuts celery marshmallows apples and pineapple. Add one big cup of Cool Whip. Put in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours.

title: N.D. Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together all moist ingredients. Sift together and add all dry ingredients. Shape into small balls. Dip in sugar. Flatten with fork. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes or until very light brown. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar. Add beaten egg then molasses vinegar and cold water. Sift flour soda and ginger and add to first mixture. Stir in as much of the flour as you can and knead in remainder. Roll out. Cut in desired shapes. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in butter. Add milk to make a soft dough. Turn onto floured board and roll 1/2 inch thick. Cut into small squares. Drop into hot liquid. Cover closely and cook 20 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Fudge Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients excluding confectioners sugar and bring to a boil. Stir to prevent sticking. Remove from heat and add confectioners sugar. Add about 1/3 at a time and use an electric mixer for beating. Add vanilla and continue mixing until mixture is of spreading consistency. Add chopped nuts if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cookie pan and preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare Toll House cookie dough as directed on package of chocolate chips. Place 3/4 of dough on bottom of pan. Mix together cream cheese sugar and beaten eggs. Pour over top of dough in pan. Glob on the rest of the dough. Bake for 30 minutes and touch to see if dough springs back. May need to bake for 40 minutes.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Mix hot water and yeast until dissolved. Stir warm water and brown sugar. Slowly add flour. Mix until smooth. Roll dough until smooth and 16-inches for each pretzel. Twist into shape.

title: Mango-Kiwi Salsa
instructions: Dice fruit and vegetables. Add other ingredients and chill before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Shrimp And Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Blanch asparagus for three minutes in small saucepan. Melt butter and stir in flour. Cook stirring for one minute. Gradually add cream or half and half and milk. Cook until thick. Stir in white wine cream or chicken broth. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in egg yolk cheese and shrimp. Put in buttered casserole dish layered one half asparagus then one half shrimp. Repeat layer and top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fast Strawberry Mousse
instructions: Chop walnuts and mix with sugar and spices. Grease an 11 x 16-inch pan with melted butter. Place 4 filo in pan brushing each with melted butter. Sprinkle with thin layer of nut mixture. Cover with 3 filo brushing each with melted butter. Continue this procedure until all filo and mixture is used. Finish with 4 filo on top brushing each with butter. Cut into about 75 small squares (before baking). Bake in slow oven (300\u00b0) for 1 hour or longer until lightly brown. Remove from oven and cool. Pour warm syrup over pastry.

title: Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Boil 10 minutes and remove from heat to cool dark place. Let stand 3 days stirring 3 or 4 times each day. Can cold in sterilized jars. Seal. The berries remain whole and the juice is thick.

title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 8 x 12-inch pan.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan add water lime Jell-O and cream cheese. Heat on medium heat until cream cheese melts. After cheese melts add marshmallows. Stir until dissolved. Then refrigerate until its almost firm. Then add pineapple juice crushed pineapple and Cool Whip. Beat until mixture is smooth. Pour into bowl. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Work in butter until it disappears. Add eggs and vanilla and knead until soft and pliable. Pinch off piece of dough and roll into length of about 4 to 5-inches twist and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown lamb and onion. Add beans ketchup brown sugar vinegar and mustard in a large casserole. Top with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Biscuits For Your Dog
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well roll out and cut with \bone\ shaped cookie cutter. Bake at 300\u00b0 until very hard. Fido will love these!

title: Cowboy'S Delight(Pineapple Dessert)
instructions: Mix together the vanilla wafers and 1/4 cup melted butter and pack into an 8 x 8-inch dessert dish. Cream the powdered sugar and 1/2 cup butter. Add eggs and beat 10 minutes. Beat whipping cream until stiff (could use Cool Whip). Add drained crushed pineapple and nuts (if desired). Mix the sugar butter and egg mixture. Top with pineapple mixture. Decorate with vanilla wafer crumbs whipping cream cherries and nuts. Refrigerate for 8 hours.

title: Chicken Fried Steaks
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; sprinkle on both sides of steaks. Combine egg and milk in a shallow bowl. Dip steaks in egg mixture then dredge in cracker crumbs. Pour oil to depth of 1/2 inch into large heavy skillet. Fry steaks in hot oil over medium heat until brown turning once. Remove steaks; drain off drippings reserving 3 tablespoons. In skillet add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute. Add broth and 1/2 cup milk; stir constantly until thick. Add Worcestershire sauce; stir. Serve gravy with steaks and cooked rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Mexican Cornbread With Ground Beef
instructions: Combine cornmeal milk salt bacon drippings eggs soda and corn in mixing bowl. Set aside. Saute ground beef in skillet. Drain on paper towels. Grease a large black iron skillet and heat. Sprinkle bottom with a thin layer of cornmeal and brown slightly. Pour half of the batter in hot skillet. Sprinkle cheese evenly over batter then sprinkle on the meat onion and peppers. Pour remaining batter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 8 to 10. Serve with a tossed green salad iced tea and fruit dessert for a complete meal.

title: Barbecued Hamburger-Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger with onion until brown then drain. Stir in brown sugar salt barbecue sauce and pork and beans and heat through. Place in casserole. Separate biscuits and cut in half. Sprinkle with cheese then arrange over hamburger mixture. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven until biscuits are brown.

title: Sarah Matt'S Onion Soup
instructions: Place butter and one \plop\ of oil in a large kettle. Cut up onions and saute in kettle. Add salt as desired and 1 spoon sugar for flavor and browning. When onions are soft and brown sprinkle 2 spoonfuls (1 at a time) of flour and mix into onions. It will be pasty. Add meat and brown about 30 minutes. Add 4 cans of broth and 4 cans of water. Add 3 to 4 bay leaves and a few sprinkles of red pepper. Bring mix to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to simmer for as long as you would like. Serve in bowls with torn pieces of bread and cheese letting the cheese melt. Enjoy!

title: Special White Rolls
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cups flour salt sugar sour cream and milk in mixer at medium speed until blended. Dissolve yeast in warm water and add it along with the melted margarine to the flour mixture; beat until smooth. Remove from mixer and beat with spoon gradually adding the remaining flour. If dough is too sticky to handle add a little more flour and knead for several minutes. Place dough in a large pan in a warm place and let rise until doubled in size.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine broccoli cauliflower bacon onion tomatoes and eggs; set aside. In another bowl combine mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Mix until smooth. Just before serving pour dressing over salad and toss. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Classic Potato Salad
instructions: In a large bowl stir together the first 5 ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Toss to coat well. Cover. Refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors. Makes about 5 cups.

title: Irish Champ
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Just cover with salted water and boil until tender.

title: Banana Oatmeal Drops
instructions: *Use less sugar if using sweetened coconut.

title: Tapioca Pudding
instructions: Boil tapioca water and salt for 1/2 hour. Two hours later add jello and sugar. When cool top with whipped cream and fruit. Mix in marshmallows.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until light and frothy. Add sugar and beat. Mix baking powder and graham cracker crumbs. Then add to mixture. Add vanilla and then the nuts. Pour into 2 layer cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chestnut And Cranberry Dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 2 1/4-3 qt. baking dish. In a small saucepan over medium heat warm stock until steam begins to rise 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and add cranberries; set aside. In a large fry pan over medium heat melt butter. Add onion celery and carrot; saute stirring  until tender and translucent 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon transfer to a bowl. In the same pan saute sausage stirring and crumbling with a fork until lightly browned and cooked through about 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to bowl with vegetables. In a large bowl stir egg white slowly pouring in stock and cranberries. Add bread and stir until well blended. Let stand stirring occasionally until stock is absorbed 6-8 minutes. Add vegetable-sausage mixture chestnuts sage thyme and parsley. Season with salt and pepper and stir to mix well. Transfer to prepared baking dish. Bake until brown and crispy 45-50 minutes. Serves 10-12.

title: Sailboat Salad
instructions: Wash lettuce leaves and stack on four salad plates. Cut the cantaloupe in half and scoop out the seeds. Cut each half into half. Place each piece in the \green sea\ of lettuce. Cut the 2 slices of cheese in half diagonally (from corner to corner). Use a toothpick and make a sail with the cheese and then \raise the sail\ on each \boat\.

title: Walt And Roberta'S Favorite Seven Layer Cookies Or Hello Dollys
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over melted butter then spread crumbs with chocolate chips then butterscotch chips. Sprinkle coconut over this followed by the milk poured evenly over the coconut and add the chopped pecans on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and cut in 1 1/2-inch squares. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Yields approximately 3 dozen.

title: Low-Fat Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes; layer in baking dish with flour and salt and pepper. Cover with canned milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Kathy'S Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Salt and pepper lightly. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Put bread sausage and cheese into pan. Pour egg mixture (beat eggs 2 1/4 cups milk and mustard) into pan. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Blend flour cinnamon and butter with pastry blender. Sprinkle over apples in a 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with ice cream.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: For 9-inch pie pan prepare Dream Whip as on package using vanilla and cold milk. When topping peaks with blender add cream cheese slowly blending. Add sugar and blend. Pour into crust. Chill about 3 hours.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Loaf
instructions: Crush bananas in large bowl. Mix in all other ingredients. Pour into lightly greased loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until knife comes out clean.

title: Quick Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown hamburger in 1 tablespoon fat. Add other ingredients. Cover and simmer for 30\tminutes. Add more tomato juice if it is too dry.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Top with lemon topping. Chill 3 hours. Refrigerate.

title: Self Crust Egg Custard
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Add to well-beaten eggs. Add milk evaporated milk melted butter salt and vanilla flavoring and mix well. Grease a 9-inch pie pan with butter; pour mixture in pan and sprinkle with nutmeg if desired. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Appetizers
instructions: Mix soup dressing and preserves in bowl. Put chicken in a 13 x 9-inch loaf pan. Cover with mixture. Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients together. After combined place uncooked chicken on top of rice mixture. Spoon soup over the top of the chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until rice is cooked.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place drained pineapple in baking dish. Mix flour with sugar and sprinkle over pineapple. Cover with cheese and top with crushed Ritz crackers. Cut margarine into small pieces and place on top of crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Main Dish Salad
instructions: Make tossed salad. Cut up egg and cheese in salad or add cottage cheese to salad. Add dressing. Serves 1.

title: Herbed Halibut
instructions: Mix bread crumbs Parmesan cheese green onions parsley basil and cloves in a bowl. Stir in melted margarine. Brush four 12-inch foil squares lightly with oil. Place 1 fish steak on each square. Drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with crumbs. Spoon wine around each steak. Seal foil securely. Place packets on baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Makes 4 servings.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 4 hours or overnight. Serve with assorted raw veggies.

title: Barbecue Country Style Spareribs
instructions: Brown spareribs in heavy skillet. While ribs are browning make a sauce from remaining ingredients. Cook all for 10 minutes. Pour over ribs and cook for 2 hours in a 375\u00b0 oven. Remove; cover the last half hour to glaze them.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together; form into small balls. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. Let cool on wire racks.

title: Washington Favorite Senate Bean Soup
instructions: Put beans in a large pot. Add the 2 or better quarts of water and soak overnight. Next day drain the beans and add more water more than cover. Add the ham bone to the beans and water cover and simmer for 2 hours. Remove the ham bone from pot and chop the meat and return it to the pot. Then add onion potato celery and garlic. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Be sure there is enough water cook for another hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Add sugar to oil then add eggs pumpkin spices (sifted together with flour) water and nuts. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 1 large or two small loaves.

title: Black-Eyed Bean Salad
instructions: Prepare rice and limas as labels direct. Drain black-eyed peas. Dice red pepper. In large bowl mix peas red pepper parsley lemon juice oil mustard sugar and salt. Add rice and limas. Chill.

title: Maybe Governor Of Texas Chili
instructions: *Favorite meat is to use ground moose if not available use ground beef round. Venison is good to mix in with beef and also you can add ground pork. You need a total of 6 pounds of meat with the sauteed onion.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: In mixing bowl beat milk sour cream and pudding mix until smooth. Place 1/3 sliced bananas into pastry shell. Top with 1/2 pudding mixture. Repeat layers. Arrange the remaining bananas on top. Cover with Cool Whip. Chill at least 2 hours.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt. Spread rice on bottom of greased 3-quart casserole. Layer with mushrooms then chicken. Mix undiluted soups with savory and dry soup mix. Pour over mixture in casserole. Pour broth around sides to moisten rice. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Sassy Cinnamon Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Combine egg milk and oil. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients. Fill greased muffin pan 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken with flour and salt. Brown in oil for 10 minutes; remove from pan. Reserve 1/4 cup pan juice. In pan stir honey teriyaki sauce chives pepper and juice; heat to boiling. Boil for 30 seconds. Add pineapple; heat again. Pour sauce over chicken.

title: Meatball Porcupines
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix thoroughly meat rice 1/3 cup water onion salts garlic powder and pepper. Shape into well rounded tablespoon sized meatballs; place in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs. Cover pan with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer. Serve with pasta if desired.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Tear small pieces of dough off dip in melted butter then in sugar mixture. Drop into Bundt cake pan. Let raise to within 1 inch of top of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Ranch And Cheddar Bread
instructions: Spread each cut side with Ranch dressing. Add cheese and broil until lightly browned. Garnish with parsley.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan. When done remove from oven and prick with fork. Prepare gelatin as on box then pour over cake. Prepare pudding and spread over cake. Put glaze over pudding. Put Cool Whip on top. Slice strawberries and place on top.

title: Cinnamon Rolls Ready In The Morning
instructions: At 4 p.m. boil first 4 ingredients together. Set in sink in water to cool. In a big bowl dissolve the yeast in water. Stir in cooled mixture 2 beaten eggs and enough flour to handle easily. Put in a greased bowl and let rise. At 9 to 10 p.m. punch down. Roll out in rectangle; spread with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon (3 tablespoons cinnamon 1 cup sugar and 1 cup brown sugar). Roll up and cut. Makes about 40 if cut about 1-inch.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
instructions: Prepare angel food cake according to directions. Just before baking add red food coloring and stir into cake. Bake according to directions. Combine egg whites sugar and strawberries in top of double boiler; beat with mixer to mix. Place over rapidly boiling water; beat constantly with mixer. Cook 7 minutes or until mixture stands in peaks. Remove from boiling water; beat until cool. Fold in 2/3 cup strawberries. Spread over cake.

title: Garlic Pork Roast
instructions: With a sharp knife cut deep pockets between each rib on meaty side of roast. Combine green peppers green onion celery and garlic; stuff deeply into pockets. Season roast with salt and cayenne pepper. Insert meat thermometer. Place roast rib side down in a shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours or until thermometer reads 170\u00b0. Let stand 15 minutes before carving.

title: Hershey Easy Pie
instructions: Chop each peanut butter cup into 6 pieces set aside. Microwave kisses in medium microwave safe bowl on high 1 minute or just until chocolate is melted when stirred stir in 3 1/2 c. whipped topping until blended. Spread half of chocolate mixture into crust sprinkle with peanut better cup pieces. Top with remaining chocolate mixture. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

title: Red Velvet Cocoa Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla in a large mixer bowl. Add eggs and food color; blend. Combine flour cocoa and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Stir baking soda into vinegar; fold carefully into batter (do not beat). Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light. Beat in egg yolks. Sift together dry ingredients and add to butter sugar egg mixture alternately with the milk and flavoring. Beat well. Carefully fold in egg whites. Bake in a tube pan or in 2 loaf pans. Pans should be greased and floured. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Snickers Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Pour half of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Melt caramels with milk and butter over low heat. Pour caramel mixture over baked cake. Sprinkle 1/2 of the nuts and all of chocolate chips over mixture. Pour remaining batter over this. Sprinkle with rest of the nuts and bake 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge(Small Batch, Can Be Doubled)
instructions: Remove from heat and add 1/2 stick butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Let cool to 135\u00b0. Add peanut butter. Mix well. Pour into buttered dish. It should be getting stiff as you mix it up. It does not take long to set up.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat sugar and Karo well. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add butter vanilla and pecans. Pour in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown meat in 1 teaspoon oil. Add onions and garlic. Cook until tender. Add bouillon cube with 1 cup hot water then add stewed tomatoes and green pepper. Cook 30 minutes then add cornstarch and soya sauce. Cook 5 minutes longer. Serve over rice.

title: Chili Beans
instructions: Put meat in shortening then add chopped onion and garlic. Next add the kidney beans tomato soup and seasonings. Heat thoroughly. Just before serving top with cheese and place under the broiler to melt cheese.

title: Macaroni Cheese Pie
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Grate block cheese in bowl. Mix powdered cheese milk and eggs together. Layer macaroni then cheese alternately in casserole dish. Pour mixture on top. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook at 450\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
instructions: Mix all together and cook over medium heat until tender. If cabbage seems to be quite moist cut water by 1/2 cup.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine lemon juice and rind. Blend in condensed milk. Beat egg yolks slightly; blend into mixture. Pour into cooled pastry shell. Beat egg whites until foamy; add cream of tartar. Add sugar one tablespoon at a time beating well after each. Continue beating until very stiff peaks form. Pile lightly on pie filling. Brown in oven (350\u00b0) for 10 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Jollof Rice
instructions: Brown beef in 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven. Drain. Add chicken broth mushrooms rice onion green pepper barbecue sauce and seasoning; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Add tomatoes; mix lightly.

title: Spanish Rice(Club Member: Kristi Mayfield)
instructions: Cook rice in boiling salted water until tender. Fry 1/2 cup bacon until crisp. Add onion and green pepper; simmer until onion is soft and yellow. Add tomatoes sugar salt and pepper. Pour rice into strainer and rinse with hot running water. Add rice to onions bacon and green pepper mixture. Mix well and pour into greased casserole dish. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Praline Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix flour oatmeal brown sugar and butter; pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Slush
instructions: In a large saucepan cook the cranberries and 1 1/2 cups water over medium heat until the berries pop about 15 minutes. Stir in raspberries. Transfer to a blender or food processor; cover and process until smooth. Strain and discard seeds reserving juice. Pour the juice into a 2-quart freezer-proof container; set aside. In a small saucepan sprinkle gelatin over remaining water. Let stand for 1 minute. Stir in sugar. Cook and stir over medium heat until gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Add to berry juice. Stir in ginger ale; cover and freeze.

title: Ma Hettie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Crem the butter Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Alternately add 1 cup milk and flour mixture.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat add onion and cook until soft about 6 minutes. Stir garlic and bell pepper and saute 2 minutes. Blend in flour; add tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in water thyme parsley and shrimp. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Noodle Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken. Debone. Add 2 cans cream of chicken soup to broth. Add noodle dumplings. Cook until tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Open-Faced Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Combine chicken and celery. Mix salt onion mayonnaise and lemon juice. Mix into chicken. Split buns. Place cut side down on broiler rack. Brown lightly. Turn and butter cut side. Spread each with 1/4 cup chicken mixture. Toss cheese and corn chips together. Sprinkle over chicken. Broil 3-inches from heat until cheese is melted and slightly browned. Place on tray; garnish.

title: Sauteed Vegetable Medley
instructions: The goal here is to create a variety of shapes colors and tastes. It is not important to do it exactly as I do but to find what you and your family like. I will describe how I do it.

title: Chicken Souffle
instructions: Mix eggs dry mustard salt and milk. Layer bread cheese and chicken in order listed. Pour liquid mixture over bread layers. Refrigerate overnight. In the morning mix 1/3 to 1/2 cup melted butter with 2 1/2 cups corn flakes. Sprinkle over top. Bake 1 hour.

title: Turkey Goulash
instructions: Combine turkey seasonings tomatoes juice green pepper onion flakes sweetener and mushrooms with liquid. Bring to a boil. Add macaroni and continue to boil uncovered until macaroni absorbs all of the juice and is tender about 20 minutes. Divide evenly. Serves 4.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Mix Ricotta eggs 1/2 cup Romano salt pepper and Accent until well combined.

title: Skillet Sausage And Sauerkraut
instructions: Melt butter in heavy pan; add sliced meats. Cook 2 to 4 minutes stirring until brown. Add broth and stir 30 seconds. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly to mix. Cover and simmer over moderately low heat 10 minutes until hot and flavors blend. Makes 3 to 4 servings. Contains 311 calories.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Save the vanilla wafer box. Put all ingredients together and put in the box you saved; place in refrigerator. Cool for 24 hours. Tear box away and serve.

title: Stuffed French Bread
instructions: Slice off top of loaf of bread and carve out center (keep). Brown and drain ground beef sausage onion and bell pepper. Combine egg milk and bread (center). Add to meat. Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on bottom of bread. Add meat mixture on top of cheese. Add cubes of Velveeta on top of meat. Put on top loaf. Brush with butter. Wrap in foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Do not overbake. Take out of foil and slice.

title: Creamy Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a saucepan over medium heat cook onion until tender. Stir in soup and cream cheese cubes. Cook stirring constantly until smooth and hot.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage in wedges or shred and cook in boiling water until tender. Drain and place in casserole dish. For sauce melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook over low heat; stir until smooth. Stir in milk; boil for 1 minute until thick. Spread sauce over cabbage. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Sundae Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Measure flour sugar 2 tablespoons cocoa the baking powder and salt into bowl. Blend in milk and shortening; stir in nuts. Pour into ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Stir together brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa; sprinkle over batter. Pour hot water over batter.

title: Mexican Hash
instructions: Cook and stir beef onion garlic and crushed red pepper in 10-inch skillet until beef is light brown. Drain. Add tomatoes green pepper raisins salt chili powder cumin cloves and cinnamon. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. In separate pan cook and stir almonds over medium heat until golden 2 to 3 minutes. Stir almonds and olives into beef mixture. Serve with rice.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Layer chicken in greased casserole dish. Place cheese over chicken breast. Spread soup and sour cream over cheese. Top with crumbs and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve over noodles.

title: Schnitzel
instructions: Beat each chop with meat beater until about 1/4-inch thick. Add Season-All. Beat eggs with fork on a flat plate. Put breadcrumbs on another plate. Put seasoned chops first in eggs to coat on both sides and then in breadcrumbs. Put breaded chops in medium hot grease in frying pan and brown both sides for 5 to 7 minutes turning each chop only once. Enjoy.

title: Chef Tony Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna according to package directions. Cook beef garlic and onions in large saucepan for 10 minutes. Add next 3 ingredients; mix well and let simmer 15 minutes. In bowl combine cottage cheese and eggs. Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch baking pan. Arrange several alternate layers of cooked and drained lasagna sliced cheese meat sauce and cottage cheese mixture beginning with lasagna and ending with meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix water pudding mix eggs and oil in large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack. Fill and frost with Coconut-Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate with butter over low heat stirring until blended. Remove from heat; gradually blend in milk. Mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually blend in chocolate mixture. Pour into pie shell. Combine coconut and nuts; sprinkle over filling. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Filling will be soft but will set while cooling. Cool at least 4 hours before cutting.

title: Best Homemade Chili
instructions: In a large Dutch oven or soup kettle brown beef with onions; drain. Stir in spices and tomato sauce. Simmer uncovered for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Combine flour and vinegar. Stir into chili. Simmer another 15 minutes or until thickened.

title: Hot Dog And Potato Casserole
instructions: Place layer of half potatoes and onions and half of the hot dogs over bottom of 2-quart baking dish. Drizzle half the margarine. Season with salt and pepper. Repeat using remaining ingredients. Pour warm milk over casserole.

title: Easy Oven Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef and strain and return to pan. Add sauce and water bring to a boil. Remove from heat. In 9 x 13-inch pan add meat sauce noodles and cottage cheese. Repeat in layers ending in layer of cheese. Bake 1 hour. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before cutting. Makes 10 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix the chiles sour cream cream of chicken soup and green onions. Coat tortillas in soup mixture. Place one layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken layer and cheese then repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter soda and sugar. Add as much flour as can be rolled in. Knead well. Cut in squares. Bake at 350 until done.

title: Sugar Cookies(Early 1900'S Recipe)
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients. Add liquids and mix well. Roll out dough 1/8 inch thick and cut in desired shape. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Heat in oven until melted.

title: Country Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 in casserole dish sprayed with Pam for approximately 45 minutes. Add the Cheddar cheese on top after half done.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add all but brown sugar and nuts. Mix well. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on top the brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
instructions: Bake Angel Loaves. Cool. Cut cake crosswise into 1/2-inch slices. Cut each slice in half and put together with matching slice of cherry-nut or vanilla ice cream. If desired top with chocolate sauce. Makes 12 to 14 sandwiches. Use remaining loaf for another dessert.

title: Our Famous Chili
instructions: Drain beans before adding to pot. Put all ingredients into a crock-pot. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or if using high cook 6 to 8 hours.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together with electric mixer. Blend into the Cool Whip. Pour into the graham cracker crusts. Top with chopped nuts. Makes 2 pies or 1 (9 x 13-inch) loaf.

title: Hamburger Chop Suey
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet; add broth soy sauce and sugar. Add vegetables; bring to a full boil separating vegetables with fork stirring frequently until sauce and cubes are blended. Cover and simmer 2 minutes. Bring to a boil again. Stir in rice and remove from heat; let stand for 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil all ingredients except corn and soda for 5 minutes mixing well and stirring. Remove from heat and add soda. Stir in quickly. Pour over popped corn. Mix well. Put in 2 large flat pans and place in a 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Be sure to stir 2 or 3 times. Store in lightly closed container.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except coconut together. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan (or may use small cookie sheet that has deep sides). Sprinkle 1/2 cup coconut on bottom of pan. Then pour batter over the coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Done when pick comes out clean. Cool then frost with thin icing (drizzle on).

title: Chocolate Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: Combine sugar butter and evaporated milk in a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Microwave on High for 9 to 10 1/2 minutes. Add chocolate bits and marshmallow cream. Microwave on High for 30 seconds. Add chopped nuts and vanilla. Stir until chocolate pieces are melted. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Bubble Recipe
instructions: Combine shake and let settle 4 hours. Have fun with bubble wand. Do not eat.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly all the ingredients. Pour into prepared oblong cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Onion Shortcake
instructions: Saute onion in margarine and cool. Add sour cream salt dill weed and half of cheese. Mix muffin mix with corn egg and milk. Pour in 13 x 9-inch cake pan then onion mixture then top with last half of shredded cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Ham Roll Ups
instructions: Blend cheeses and margarine. Spread 1/4-inch on each slice of ham. Roll up; chill several hours or wrap and freeze.

title: E-Z Pizza
instructions: Chop bell pepper and green onion together sprinkle over sauce. Add sausage pepperoni or hamburger. Top with cheese. Cook about 10 minutes or until cheese begins to brown.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
instructions: Grate together cucumber carrots and onion. Drain the juice and save. Cream together the cream cheese and mayonnaise. Heat juice till hot but not boiling let it cool in cold water add pkg. of knox gelation and stir together let cool again until room temperature. Mix cucumber mix and cream cheese mix into juice mixture. Stir well and then beat mixture until it is fluffy and creamy. Refrigerate over night salt to taste and spread onto frozen bread trim off crust of bread and cut into finger sandwiches.

title: Currant Glazed Appetizer Franks
instructions: Heat jelly and mustard together; stir occasionally until blended. Add franks and heat. Serve with toothpicks. Use a fondue pan which keeps just the right heat but does not burn.

title: Franklin Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs. Sift flour salt and baking powder. Add 3 cups of flour mixture. Pour last cup of flour over fruits and pecans. Add this to other ingredients. Add flavoring mix well. Grease and flour a tube pan. Pour cake in pan. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 3 hours.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes and grate or mash with a wire potato masher. Combine cheese and butter. Melt. Add sour cream onion salt and pepper. Fold in potatoes. Put into 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yummy.

title: Fruit Bread
instructions: Blend together the butter and sugar and beat. Mix flour baking powder and soda and add to butter mixture. Add beaten egg and gradually add buttermilk. Fold in raisins. Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Aunt Gin'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar Crisco and butter and add eggs one at a time. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add the creamed mixture to the flour mixture. Add milk and vanilla. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes depending on oven.

title: Russian Tea(Old Recipe)
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put 4 to 5 teaspoons in cup of hot water.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray 2-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray; set aside. In small saucepan over medium heat melt butter. Stir in flour and salt until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to a boil stirring frequently. Boil 2 minutes until thickened stirring constantly. Add cheese and chives; stir until cheese is melted. Arrange potato slices in prepared baking dish. Spoon cheese-chive mixture over potato slices. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake 30 minutes more until potatoes are tender and top is golden brown. Garnish with fresh chives. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Gourmet Deer Chili
instructions: Cube meat and grind with hamburger plate of electric grinder. In a large pot heat olive oil and saute garlic for 1 minute. Add onion and ground meat. Cook until meat is done. Add next 17 ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 1 hour stirring occasionally. Slowly stir in cracker meal. Let simmer 10 more minutes stirring frequently. Serve hot with crackers Fritos or French-style garlic bread.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease two 9 x 11-inch or 9 x 9-inch pans. Pour the batter into the baking pans and spread evenly with a rubber scraper or spoon. Bake in the oven until the bread tests done; a wooden toothpick or metal skewer inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove bread from the oven. Let the pans cool somewhat on metal racks before cutting into serving pieces.

title: Grandma Mary Ann'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortenings and sugars. Mix in honey eggs and vanilla. Stir in cinnamon salt flour baking soda oatmeal nuts and raisins. Drop teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Queen Elizabeth Cake
instructions: Mix together sugar shortening egg and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and soda. Next add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Place cottage cheese in a bowl. Sprinkle dry jello over it and mix. Drain mandarin oranges and add. Add nuts and mix with Cool Whip.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Cook pasta by package directions. Drain. Rinse with cold water to cool quickly; drain well. Combine cooled pasta \\ celery and shrimp. Cover; chill. In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Whip with wire whisk until creamy. Cover; chill. Serve salad on bed of lettuce with dressing drizzled over top or toss until blended.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Mix pineapple and jello in bowl and heat in microwave for 4 minutes. In another bowl mix buttermilk and Cool Whip. Combine with other ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Cottage Cheese Dessert
instructions: Mix together cottage cheese and dry jello. Beat. Add cool whip and mandarin oranges pour in dish. Refrigerate for a couple of hours then serve.

title: Cranberry-Strawberry Relish
instructions: A day before serving mix cranberries and strawberries. Refrigerate.

title: Spice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and applesauce. Sift flour soda and spices together and gradually add to cake mixture. Melt chocolate over hot water and add to cake for a lovely rich color. Makes 3 large 9-inch layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Ice.

title: Dieter'S Fluff
instructions: Mix jello with cottage cheese. Add drained pineapple. Fold in Cool Whip. Any flavor jello can be used.

title: Parslied Potatoes
instructions: Peel a strip of skin off of potatoes in the middle. Place potatoes in cold water. Heat large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil. Saut onion and garlic for approximately 5 minutes. Add broth and 3/4 cup parsley; bring to a boil. Place potatoes (one layer) in skillet. Return to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer covered for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove potatoes with slotted spoon to a serving bowl. Add pepper to skillet mixture; stir. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining parsley.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender. Put into casserole. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over broccoli. Grate cheese and distribute evenly over broccoli. Bake at 300\u00b0 until cheese has melted.

title: Spinach-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook for 40 minutes the brown rice and vegetable broth. Prepare the Cheddar cheese parsley and fresh spinach while rice is cooking. After rice has cooked 30 minutes preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cooked rice with the Cheddar cheese mixture adding garlic powder black pepper and eggs. Spoon mixture into greased casserole dish. Top with mixture of Parmesan cheese melted butter and bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Lettie'S Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Combine first five ingredients and cook until it forms a soft ball. Add peanut butter. Grease cookie sheet. Pour. Cut in squares.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain fat. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix beef green pepper salt and pepper. Add rest of ingredients except Mozzarella cheese. Put in pan and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered. This can also be cooked in a crock-pot.

title: Garlic Pasta
instructions: Chop the garlic and saute in the olive oil. Do not burn the garlic. Add the pinch of red pepper flakes to the olive oil and garlic. Pour the olive oil mixture over the cooked spaghetti. Add the cheese and parsley flakes and toss.

title: Orange Date Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Stir in egg. Mix well. Combine dates juice rind 1 teaspoon soda and hot water. Cool. Add to sugar and butter mixture. Combine flour 1 teaspoon soda and salt. Add to first mixture. Stir in nuts. Pour into standard sized oiled loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Maska
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan. Add shrimp and spices. Saute for 20 to 30 minutes. Add wine and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot with French bread.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
instructions: Heat milk and melt marshmallows in double boiler. Mix crushed graham crackers candy raisins and nuts together. Add milk and marshmallow mixture; mix well. Put in a well buttered 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix jello and Cool Whip. Add cottage cheese; mix well. Add fruit of choice. Pour into mold or leave in bowl. Chill overnight. Garnish with fresh fruit.

title: Green Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef with salt and garlic. Drain well. Set aside. Make sauce heat soup milk and Velveeta until melted. Add green chiles dip mix and pimentos. Add cheese and onions to meat. Mix well. Soften tortillas by dipping them one at a time in hot oil in shallow skillet. Drain. Fill with meat mixture. Roll and place in a greased 10 x 13 casserole dish. Pour cheese sauce over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Maryland She-Crab Soup
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add celery and onions. Saute until tender. Blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually add chicken broth stirring constantly. Heat to boiling. Add cream and crabmeat. Season with nutmeg to taste. Do not boil!

title: Chicken Divan
