instructions: Steam chicken in a little water. Bone and cut chicken into small pieces. Cook and drain broccoli. Place broccoli in bottom of casserole sprayed with Pam. Layer chicken then sauce made of soup mayonnaise lemon juice black pepper and curry powder. Sprinkle with paprika. Top with grated cheese. Last layer with stuffing mix combined with the melted margarine. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 8 servings.

title: Rotini
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef onion salt and pepper. Add Prego tomato juice oregano and sweet basil; simmer 20 minutes. Cook macaroni until tender and drain. Grate cheese. Layer in 2-quart casserole dish the meat sauce macaroni cheese macaroni and meat sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Add remaining cheese on top and bake until melted. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Microwave Cabbage Rolls Italian Style
instructions: In 3-quart casserole place cabbage and water. Cover and microwave on High for 7 to 9 minutes until leaves are pliable. While cabbage is cooking mix together ground beef egg rice onion and salt. Divide meat mixture into 8 equal portions. Place one portion on each partially cooked cabbage leaf and roll meat into leaf securing with toothpick if necessary. Return to 3-quart casserole placing rolls seam side down. Blend tomato sauce sugar and oregano. Pour over cabbage rolls. Cover and microwave on High 15 to 17 minutes rotating dish half turn and basting with sauce after 9 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese with mayonnaise until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and chill. Serve with Toast Squares.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Combine all together. Shape into fairly large balls. Place in shallow dish and bake after pouring sauce over them at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: 24-Hour Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Cut cucumbers in thin slices and soak in lime water for 12 to 14 hours. Wash and soak in salt water for four hours. Bring to a boil in strong alum water. Pour off alum water and dip in hot boiling water. Combine spices (in a bag) sugar vinegar and cucumbers and simmer for 25 minutes. Let cool. Pack in jars and seal. Makes 10 to 11 pints.

title: Easy Holiday Salad
instructions: Make jello as usual using 2 cups boiling water; stir until dissolved. Add frozen raspberries; stir until mixed. Stir in cranberry sauce. Pour half of mixture into dish. Chill until firm. Mix softened cream cheese with small amount of sour cream. Spread over jello mixture. Top with rest of jello mixture. Chill. Cut into squares.

title: Turkey Salad
instructions: Cook turkey until tender debone as soon as cool enough. Put in refrigerator to get cold. Chop all ingredients in food processor individually removing to mixing bowl. Add all ingredients. Mix well. Refrigerate until ready to be served.

title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Add stewed tomatoes and tomato juice. Add spices to taste. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Frogmore Stew
instructions: In large stockpot add seasonings to water. Bring to a boil. Add sausage and boil uncovered 5 minutes. Add corn; count 5 minutes. Add shrimp; count 3 minutes. (Dont wait for liquid to return to a boil before timing corn and shrimp.) Drain immediately and serve. Serve with cocktail sauce sweet and sour mustard or hot mustard. Serves 8.

title: Easy Fall Ratatouille Recipe
instructions: Saute vegetables in sun-dried tomato dressing in large ovenproof skillet until tender. Add diced tomatoes cook about 15 minutes allowing some of the liquid to evaporate. Top with cheeses and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook your squash for 12 minutes; drain. Mix sour cream soup onions pimentos and water chestnuts; set aside. When squash is done mix with sour cream mixture. Mix your dressing with 1 block butter/margarine melted. Put one layer dressing on bottom of casserole dish; add squash mixture. Add remaining dressing to the top. Bake or put in microwave for 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Irish Potato Cakes
instructions: Mix all together and form into little cakes. Fry in butter until brown. Serve hot with syrup or butter.

title: Granny'S Lazy Daisy Cake
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients together. Boil last 2 ingredients add to egg mixture and mix well. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Pushcart Palpetta(Spaghetti Sauce)
instructions: Remove and chop the stems from mushrooms. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in large skillet; saute mushroom caps round side down first for 3 minutes. Turn and repeat. Brown sausages; discard fat. Heat 3 tablespoons oil; saute mushroom stems green pepper onion and celery until brown. Move to side; cook hamburg. Cut sausages into 1/2-inch slices; return to skillet. Add salt oregano basil parsley tomato sauce and dry red wine. Cover; simmer slowly for 45 minutes.

title: Super Seafood Supper
instructions: Cook celery green pepper and onion in butter until partially cooked. Combine these with seafood and pimento.\tMix sour cream light cream lemon juice and seasonings in small bowl. Combine 3/4 cup cream mixture rice\tand drained mushrooms.\t Spread rice mixture evenly in well greased 15\tx 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place seafood mixture on\ttop of rice mixture. Pour remaining 1/4 cup of cream mixture over seafood. Combine bread crumbs with remaining butter. Sprinkle over casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. May be prepared a day ahead\tand refrigerated. Allow 30\tminutes additional cooking time if refrigerated.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Beat prunes cake mix cinnamon and nutmeg real hard. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. While cake is hot poke holes in cake layer. Mix buttermilk sugar and melted margarine together; pour over the cake. Heat and stir until all sugar is melted. Bake in pan that the cake can stay in until all is eaten.

title: Missy Potatoes
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Spoon into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 10 to 12.

title: White Christmas Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate over medium/low heat stirring until smooth. Remove from the heat; stir in candy. Spread on parchment paper-lined cookie sheets.\tRefrigerate for 8 to 10 minutes. Break into small pieces; store in airtight containers.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until fine. Heat milk lukewarm only. Dissolve yeast in milk. Mix with dry ingredients and knead well. Roll out 1/4-inch thick. Cut in rounds or squares. (I prefer squares.) Brush with butter and top with another round or square and butter top. Let rise a few minutes before baking at 350\u00b0.

title: Pilaf Rice
instructions: Saute onion in butter in large skillet until tender but not brown about 5 minutes. Add rice and saute for 3 minutes. Add bouillon and salt. Bring to boil. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in almonds and parsley; fluff with a fork.

title: Bourbon Bread Pudding
instructions: Cube bread; soak in milk. Add sugar eggs vanilla chopped apple raisins and margarine. Mix all together with hands. Put in buttered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until firm.

title: Cheddar Baked Potatoes
instructions: In smal bowl combine soup paprika and pepper. In a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Sprinkle with cheese. Spoon soup mixture over cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover. Bake 10 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender.

title: Cherry Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar with the oil. Add eggs one at a time beating until well blended. Add flour sifted with the baking powder. Pour 1/2 into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread the cherry pie filling over the dough. Sprinkle lightly with sugar and cinnamon. Add remaining dough and sprinkle with more cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Drizzle with powdered sugar glaze when still slightly warm.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix soup and chicken broth and heat. Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole. Top with 1/3 of the cheese. Cover and bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer. Can freeze.

title: Oatmeal, Coconut And Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; mix. Add the flour a little at a time mixing well. In 1 cup of the flour mix the baking soda baking powder and salt; add to dough. After mixing all the dry ingredients add and mix the chocolate chips pecans and coconut. Then add the oats. (The mixture may be so thick that you will have to mix by hand.) Bake at 400\u00b0 on top shelf of oven. Bake until they are light light brown. Take out and let cool 5 minutes on pan then remove to rack to cool. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Pecan Balls
instructions: Mix well. Roll to size of walnut or smaller. Put on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 275\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Super Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix hash brown potatoes grated Cheddar cheese and chopped onion together. Mix sour cream soup and melted margarine together. Combine potato mixture and soup mixture in large bowl. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Everyone loves it.

title: N.Y.  Cheesecake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given beating well after each. Pour in well-greased 10-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Shut off oven. Leave in oven for 2 hours. (Total 3 hours; do not open oven door from start to end!!)

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients in a salad bowl. Pour dressing over and coat well to mix. Serve at once.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Add one egg at a time. Sift dry ingredients together. Mix together then add carrots and nuts. Blend with mixer. Pour in pan and bake (flour pans) at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Dont look until 30 minutes are up. Cool and frost; add nuts on top.

title: Eggless Milkless Butterless Cake
instructions: Mix together and let come to a boil the first four ingredients. When cool add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well and pour into layer pans. Bake in moderately hot oven at 350 degrees until done. Put layers together with Powdered Sugar Icing. Can also be baked in a loaf pan.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl combine dry ingredients. Add eggs milk oil and vanilla; beat medium speed 2 minutes. Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin). Pour in prepared pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Southern Fried Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken; drain on paper towel. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Dip in egg mixture. Add spices to flour; coat chicken. Fry slowly in hot oil until browned on both sides (about 35 minutes) turning as needed.

title: Border Beans
instructions: In a tall narrow ware pot (Mexicans call it a jarrow) the beans nestle closely together and pack while cooking and it means the heat seeps gently through the jarrow as it should in cooking beans. In order that the beans pack right you should use enough to almost fill the pot when they swell never less than 2 pounds. Use Mexican pinto beans. Wash the beans; put them in the pot and fill the pot about half full of water. Never soak pinto beans. It causes them to be mushy. Using a medium flame bring the water to a boil while stirring the beans to keep them from burning. When the water boils turn the fire low so it can barely simmer. It is best if you see a bubbly oozing out now and then. Throughout the cooking keep the water level barely covering the beans. It makes them pack. Be sure any water you add is boiling. After an hour of cooking add several chunks of salt pork. Some people put a lid on the beans but I do not. It chokes off those fine odors and sometimes it causes the juices to boil over. At the end of the second hour cut the garlic fine (I use 6 pods). At the end of another hour add the oregano and chili pequins mashed up (I use jalapeno peppers 2 small ones with seeds taken out). Cook another hour. At the end of 4 hours of cooking add salt one level tablespoon per each pound of beans. Simmer 1 more hour.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Melt butter. Add sugar and flour. Pour over apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Tea Mix
instructions: To use add 1 teaspoon of spiced tea mixture per cup of boiling water. Package tea in small jars. Use a ribbon to tie a cinnamon stick (used to stir tea) to top of jar along with instructions on how to use mix.

title: King Casserole
instructions: Place in baking dish layer of chicken and Doritos. Mix in chopped onion soup and tomatoes together. Pour over chicken and Doritos. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Bean Supreme
instructions: Drain green beans. Combine all ingredients in a 1-quart casserole. Bake 10 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Deviled Ham And Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sunflower seeds or nuts. Refrigerate until firm enough to handle. Form into ball and roll in sunflower seeds or nuts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Eggplant Moussaka
instructions: Steam eggplants for 2 to 3 minutes. Saute onion green pepper garlic and celery in vegetable oil. Add tomatoes and cook briefly (5 to 10 minutes). Add to mixture the cracked wheat cereal and simmer 20 minutes or so until cereal is cooked. (Add tomatoes or tomato sauce if liquid evaporates).

title: Bloody Mary
instructions: Shake with cracked ice. Strain into 6 ounce glass.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into lightly greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Low-Fat Chicken In Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Remove all visible fat from chicken breasts. Place in casserole which has been sprayed with Pam. Top with condensed mushroom soup and add pepper to taste. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. (No additional salt is needed. Can substitute Healthy Request condensed chicken soup if desired.)

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Cream together the 1/3 cup sugar and cream cheese. Add the 1 egg and mix. Set aside. Heat together the baking chocolate butter and water until boiling. Remove from heat. Combine the 2 cups sugar and flour. Stir into chocolate mixture. Mix the 2 eggs sour cream salt and baking soda. Add to chocolate mixture. Pour chocolate batter into a greased and floured oblong cake pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture across top and cut in with a knife to create a marbling effect. Sprinkle top with the chocolate chips. Bake at 355\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Na-Cho Ordinary Potatoes
instructions: In square baking dish covered with plastic wrap steam potatoes with 2 tablespoons water for 10 minutes on High in microwave stirring halfway through. Toss with oleo and seasonings. Sprinkle with 1 1/4 cups cheese. Microwave for 2 minutes on High. Top with chips and remaining cheese. Cook for 2 minutes and 30 seconds on 50% power.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Combine mayonnaise flour milk and beaten eggs; stir until well blended. Then add remaining ingredients. Pour into the pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except chicken and put in a large oblong pan. Put cut up chicken pieces on top of soup mixture. Sprinkle 1/2 package of dry onion soup mix over all of the chicken. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Sift meal with salt and add boiling water. Add butter and stir until smooth. Add beaten eggs and milk. Sprinkle baking powder over top and stir quickly into batter. Pour into greased pan or pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour for large pan or 45 to 50 minutes for 2 pie pan or 1/2 recipe.

title: Oven Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in baking pan. Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken. Add sliced mushrooms and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with Rice-A-Roni pilaf rice.

title: Wanda'S Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer the above ingredients in the order given or toss the ingredients all together.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine gelatin with 1 cup hot water. Add strawberries crushed pineapple and bananas. Pour 1/2 of this mixture into a 1 1/2 to 2-quart mold. Refrigerate and let thicken. When set cover with a layer of sour cream. Spread remaining gelatin mixture over the sour cream. Refrigerate. Unmold before serving. Serves 12. Exchanges 1 serving = 1 fruit 1/2 fat. Calories 1 serving = 83.

title: Meatball Appetizers
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Make into balls the size of meatballs. Cook on a broiler pan at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 30 meatballs.

title: Yeast Dough For Sweet Buns And Cherry Bread
instructions: Mix together yeast milk and flour. Let stand until spongy (20 to 30 minutes). In a large bowl put eggs salt and sugar. Mix well then add 4 cups flour. Youll have a very soft dough. Next add your first mixture. Beat with a spoon. Add 1/2 cup melted butter. Work butter into the dough mixture until smooth. Knead on floured surface adding 1 more cup flour until smooth and elastic. Dough is kneaded enough when it becomes shiny and has little air pockets or bubbles in the surface. Put dough in greased bowl and turn leaving greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Punch down and make cinnamon buns or Cherry Bread.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Heat oven to 350. Roll dough into balls and bake on a cookie sheet or 20 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while hot and again when cold.

title: Philly Beef-A-Roni(In Honor Of Adios)
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Add mushroom soup tomato paste garlic salt pepper and sugar; cook slowly 15 to 20 minutes. Cook macaroni until barely tender; drain. Set oven at 350\u00b0. Mix cream cheese with milk sour cream and onion.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in large mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of mixture.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Place butter/margarine in baking dish and melt in oven. Mix sugar flour & milk. Add peaches to mixture. Pour over melted butter. Bake at 350 degrees until light brown on top. Best to eat while warm.

title: Trail Side Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes large batch of cookies.

title: Golden Medley Orange Candied Yams
instructions: In saucepan melt butter or margarine. Add almonds brown sugar and orange juice; simmer stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Add yams; sprinkle with salt. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes spooning sauce over frequently. Garnish with orange sections. Makes about 8 to 10 servings.

title: Grandmothers Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift dry ingredients then cut in shortening. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Roll out dough and cut as desired. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients; cut in butter with knife or pastry cutter. Add buttermilk unbeaten egg and vanilla; also nutmeg and cinnamon. Pour into greased 9-inch cake pan (round). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix and beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipping cream. Spoon 1 cup banana pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of wafers bananas and pudding. Repeat layers ending with pudding. Chill. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Grease and flour an angel food cake pan or a bundt pan. Pour batter in pan and put in cold oven. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Wendy'S Chili
instructions: In 1 tablespoon of oil brown the ground round. Put the can of onion soup through a blender and add to beef. Add all the other ingredients. Heat 20 minutes on medium to blend flavors. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet. Saute onions over medium heat until soft about 5 minutes. Add spinach and continue to cook stirring often until no liquid is left. Add salt pepper and nutmeg. Stir well and allow to cool. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs and cream together; gradually add to spinach mixture. Stir until smooth. Add cheese and combine. Pour mixture into pie shells. Place shells on cookie sheet and bake 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into pie comes out clean. Serve hot or room temperature.

title: Sour Cream Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Place rhubarb in pastry shell. Blend together egg sugar salt tapioca and sour cream. Pour over rhubarb and bake.

title: Minestrone Vegetable Soup
instructions: In large saucepan saute onions and celery until soft. Stir in broth and tomato sauce; bring to a boil. Add frozen vegetables pasta garlic powder and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Add kidney beans and simmer 5 minutes longer.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding with 1/4 cup fruit juice. Mix rest of juice (not to exceed 3/4 to 1 cup) and add other ingredients. Let stand a few hours or overnight. Keeps well in fridge up to 10 days. Can be served on lettuce as a salad or as a dessert with a red cherry on top. Can be stretched by adding more marshmallows.

title: Coss Hot Cider
instructions: Make in a 12-cup drip coffee maker glass pot or any 12-cup container. Mix together apple cider apple juice lemon juice cinnamon and cloves. Serve hot. This can be heated in a microwave or on top of the stove. Keep hot on a drip coffee maker.

title: Cheesy Hash Browns
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with cheese and corn flakes. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Gingerbread People
instructions: Mix shortening honey egg and molasses. In another bowl sift soda salt ginger cinnamon cloves and flour. Mix wet and dry ingredients to form dough. Roll 1/4-inch thick on floured surface. Cut with cookie cutter. Decorate with raisins nuts licorice and tiny candies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Butter Stickies(From Connie'S Biscuit Mix)
instructions: Make the same way as biscuits but roll the dough into an oblong shape. Spread top with melted margarine. Sprinkle with generous amounts of cinnamon sugar and brown sugar. Roll jelly roll fashion and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Put in greased pan; adding 1 tablespoon water to bottom. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes; turn out onto plate.

title: Chicken Salad (For Two)
instructions: In medium bowl gently stir together chicken apple celery and raisins. In cup stir together dressing and brown sugar; pour over chicken mixture. Toss gently to coat. Serve on lettuce leaves. Yields 1 1/2 cups or 2 servings.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion in butter; add tomato sauce cottage cheese and sour cream. Put cooked noodles in greased casserole dish. Top with cheese mixture. Add meat then sprinkle with paprika. Cover and heat in 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes.

title: Angel Hair Pasta And Tomato Vinaigrette
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Combine tomatoes garlic basil oil vinegar and red pepper flakes in skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until tomatoes are barely heated through and still firm about 3 minutes. Pour over drained pasta. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mom'S Baked Beans Galore
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or cook in skillet; stir regularly for 20 minutes on low heat. Great for barbecues!

title: Granola
instructions: Stir flours together. Toast in heavy frying pan (no oil is needed) until well browned. Do not burn. Place in large mixing bowl. Add wheat germ coconut sesame seed and sunflower seeds which have been toasted individually.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl eggs and sugar. Add salad oil flour soda cinnamon salt pumpkin and vanilla. Put mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased and floured pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Veal With Rosemary
instructions: Cut the meat into cubes and lightly brown in hot oil stirring frequently. Add the onions and cook until golden. Add tomatoes and seasonings. Cover and simmer about 25 minutes. Combine the flour and water and stir into the meat to thicken; stir. Continue cooking until the meat is tender and the gravy thickened. Serve over noodles or rice. Yield 4 servings.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: No Bake Coconut Cake
instructions: Sprinkle gelatine over\tcold water to soften. Cook egg yolks sugar and flour until smooth. Add salt and gradually add milk. Cook slowly until coats spoon. Stir in gelatine. Refrigerate 1 hour until cool.\tBeat egg whites; fold in cooled custard. Tear cake\tinto small pieces. Use half to cover bottom of sheet cake pan. Pour half of custard over cake pieces. Sprinkle half of coconut over that. Put rest of cake then rest of\tcustard then\tcoconut. Put Dream Whip that has been made by directions. (May substitute with Cool Whip.)

title: Mamaw'S Yeast Rolls
instructions: Take sugar salt and yeast mix with flour; add the water. Mix until it gets like bread dough. Keep adding flour until it is thick enough to knead. Put in greased bowl and let rise until double. Roll out and cut into biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown; brush with butter.

title: Cinnamon Toast Cake
instructions: Sift together flour 1 cup sugar baking powder and salt. Blend milk shortening and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes on 11 x 17-inch baking sheet. Drizzle 1/2 cup melted butter over cake.

title: Two-Layer Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Fold in flour alternately with milk. Add salt lemon and vanilla. Bake in 2 greased and floured cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles Or Peppers
instructions: In large pan cover cucumbers or peppers and onions with salt. Fill pan with water. Let stand for 2 hours. Bring cider vinegar celery seed mustard seed powdered ginger turmeric and sugar to a rolling boil. Add drained cucumbers and onions. Heat just to boiling and pack in hot sterilized jars.

title: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
instructions: In large frying pan combine all ingredients; mix well. Cover; simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Stir several times while cabbage mixture is cooking. Serves 6.

title: Smicker Cake
instructions: Mix cake put half of cake batter in pan and bake. While cake is baking melt caramels with milk and butter. When cake is done pour caramel chocolate chips and pecans on top then pour other half of batter on top and bake until done.

title: K F C   Biscuits
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Shape into biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes. Makes 6 biscuits.

title: Carrot Cake 2
instructions: Sift together flour sugar soda salt and cinnamon then add eggs oil carrots and nuts. Mix all together well. Pour into angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Quick Carrot Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch pan (jelly roll pan) or two 8 or 9-inch square pans. In a large bowl blend oil eggs and applesauce 1 minute on low speed. Add cake mix; blend until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in raisins. Pour into prepared pan; spread evenly. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes. Cool completely. Frost with cream cheese frosting. Sprinkle with nuts. Makes 36 bars.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as on package; drain well. Place in casserole dish. Combine soup eggs cheese onion and mayonnaise. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with stuffing mix; dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into quarters. Combine in a bowl white sugar and cinnamon. Place biscuits in bowl and shake until covered. Place in tube or Bundt pan. Melt butter and brown sugar; pour over biscuits in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Velvet Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and save juice. Boil Jell-O and pineapple juice for one minute. Let cool and mix all ingredients together; refrigerate.

title: Chicken Potato And Cheddar Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Spray a 13x9 baking dish. Place chicken in baking dish sprinkle with salt and pepper. Spread broccoli and 1 1/2 c. cheese over chicken. Place potatoes on top; bake 30 minutes. Sprinkle with 1/2 c. of cheese; bake 5 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Oatmeal Bread For Bread Machine
instructions: Measure ingredients carefully. Place all ingredients in bread machine pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select basic cycle. When cycle has been completed remove loaf from pan and cool on wire rack.

title: Hot Dip Delight
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Brown and add onions. Add chopped apple and tomatoes jalapeno peppers raisins olives cinnamon and cloves. Salt and pepper and add ketchup. Add almonds (optional).

title: Steamed Cabbage
instructions: Cut up cabbage then rinse in cold water. Drain and put in 5-quart pot. Add chopped onion salt and pepper. Cover pot and let cook on medium-high until cabbage is tender. Stir often.

title: Luscious Lasagna(Low-Fat Without Meat)
instructions: *Do not have to precook noodles.

title: Russian Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use as a dressing for a salad.

title: Meat Loaf And Gravy
instructions: Add ingredients as listed then mix well and pat into two pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave or in double boiler. Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and beat well. Add melted chocolate and vanilla and mix well. Stir in broken nutmeats. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with sour milk. Shape into rolls on waxed paper; wrap. Chill thoroughly or overnight. Slice thin (1/4-inch or less). Bake slices on greased cookie sheet in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Light Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water. Put sugar shortening and salt in container you are making rolls in. Add 1 cup boiling water to mixture. Stir until dissolved. Add 1 cup cold water. Stir in yeast mixture. Beat egg and add to mixture. Add flour 1 cup at a time stirring. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Apple-Peanut Butter Dream
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Toffee Bar Dip
instructions: Crush Heath bars. Combine all ingredients together and mix. Graham crackers and apples are great to dip.

title: Salted Spiced Walnuts
instructions: Wash chicken wings and pat dry. In a bowl combine the crumbled crackers or bread crumbs herbs and Parmesan cheese. Add seasonings and mix well to blend. Melt butter. Dip chicken wings first in melted butter then into crumb coating. Arrange chicken wings in lightly oiled ovenproof baking dish. Bake chicken wings at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown and done. Chicken wings should be tender.

title: Cheese Cakes
instructions: Blend together with electric beater. Spoon on vanilla wafer about 2/3 full in a cup cake paper. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Combine cake mix with butter chopped pecans and 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Put a thin layer of mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Pour into greased and hot iron skillets. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. May be frozen for later use.

title: 4 Layer Coconut Dessert
instructions: 1st Layer Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan; dump in flour and coconut and spread mixture in bottom of pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool completely.

title: Teriyaki Marinade Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour over meat and let stand at least 2 hours. Refrigerate.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs. Put eggs in cold water. Keep changing the water to keep it cold. Shell the eggs. Put eggs in a container and place in the refrigerator next to the pickled beet liquid. Next day cover eggs with the liquid. Put back in refrigerator for 3 or 4 days. Stir or shake occasionally so eggs color evenly. Serve cold.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy 2-quart saucepan; stir in flour salt and pepper. Remove from heat; stir in chicken broth gradually. Add cream. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add chicken and pimento. Heat to serving temperature. Serve immediately over toast or in patty shells.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Add one ingredient on top of each other. Bake 25 or 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Let cool; cut in squares.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and place in greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Mix above ingredients and press in cookie sheet with sides. Melt 1 stick butter with 12 ounces chocolate chips. Spread over mixture and chill for at least 4 hours better if overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Candy
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk; roll into a ball on waxed paper. Put small amount of powdered sugar on paper to keep from sticking. Roll out ball and spread with peanut butter. Roll out with fingers into a long roll and wrap in waxed paper. Put in refrigerator to harden. Cut into small pieces.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt. Combine egg water and vinegar. Pour liquid into flour mixture all at once. Blend with a spoon just until all is moistened. This is an easy crust to make. I roll the crust between wax paper and fold Put into pan. On the top crust I brush canned cream then cut holes sprinkle sugar on top and put little pieces of oleo on the holes. I like to mix in a large tupperwear container and shape into balls.

title: Cheesies Potatoes
instructions: Melt margarine in pan. Quarter 6 potatoes. In a bag shake potatoes cheese and flour until potatoes are coated. Place in pan and bake until brown. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes in 10 x 12-inch pan.

title: Oyster Sauce Beef And Chinese Peas
instructions: Combine beef cornstarch sugar soy sauce sherry oyster sauce and 1 tablespoon of the oil. Marinate for 20 minutes. In a wok or skillet heat remaining oil and brown garlic. Add meat and onion; stir-fry for 1 minute. Add peas and cook 1 more minute.

title: Baked Brie In Phyllo
instructions: Wrap the Brie in thawed phyllo dough brushing each sheet with butter and keeping unused phyllo covered with a damp cloth. Turn the cheese over after applying each sheet of phyllo for even distribution. Brush phyllo wrapped Brie with butter. Cover and refrigerate. Before serving place the phyllo wrapped cheese in a shallow baking dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden. Let stand 10 minutes. Garnish with fresh dill and fruit. Serves 20 to 30.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake pie shell 10 minutes and remove. Lower temperature to 325\u00b0. In saucepan melt chips with margarine over very low heat. In large bowl beat chocolate mixture with remaining ingredients except nuts until smooth. Stir in nuts and pour into pie shell. Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until center is set. Cool. Serve with ice cream if desired. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Honeyed French Green Beans
instructions: Pour undrained green beans into a 1-quart casserole dish. Drizzle honey and Worcestershire sauce over beans. Place bacon strips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bacon is crisp approximately 30 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Fruit And Nut Pies(Christmas Pie)
instructions: Combine cherries and pineapple in a saucepan. Add sugar and flour. Cook until thickened. Sprinkle orange jello over mixture and stir until dissolved. Cool mixture slightly. Add bananas and pecans or walnuts. Pour into the pie shells. Refrigerate for several hours. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Grandma'S Cranberry Sauce(Yields 20 Servings)
instructions: First grind fresh cranberries (coarse grind). Next slice seedless grapes in half. Then grind one of the oranges rind and all (fine grind). Next juice the other orange. Then add all the sugar to the fruit and juice mixture. Stir. Set aside. Place water in saucepan and bring to a boil. Add both boxes of jello and dissolve. Next add dissolved jello to fruit mixture. Now chop nuts and add to mixture. Place mixture in container that can later be sealed. Put in refrigerator until jelled. Now seal container. Will keep for weeks in refrigerator. Also makes nice jello mold.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain fat. Cook rice as directed on package. Add mushrooms and onions. Serve. Good warmed over with a little water added to moisten.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat; add onions and cook until tender. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste water garlic and seasonings; cover and simmer 30 minutes. In a 12 x 8-inch baking dish layer noodles meat sauce and cheeses; repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook ingredients over medium heat about 1 1/2 hours or until rice is done. Beat 2 eggs and 3/4 cup sugar together. Add this plus 1 teaspoon vanilla to rice mixture. Cook together. Add raisins and cinnamon as desired.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Prepare Jell-O according to directions but cut down on cold water to 1 cup. Mix cranberry sauce and add to Jell-O. Add pineapple juice to Jell-O in place of water. Mix other ingredients and chill.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: In large skillet cook and stir onion and green pepper in oil until onion is tender. Stir in rice water chestnuts mushrooms and soy sauce. Cook over low heat 10 minutes stirring frequently. Stir in beaten eggs. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 5 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

title: Sweet Potato Souffle #2
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Chop Suey Cookies
instructions: Combine the oleo sugars eggs and vanilla; cream together. Mix the flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Add the remaining ingredients; mix all together. Drop mixture by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet.\tBake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Crullers
instructions: Combine cream cheese and margarine mixing until well greased. Add flour and salt; mix well. Shape dough into ball; chill 1 hour. On lightly floured surface roll dough to 12 x 6-inch strips. Fry in deep hot oil 375\u00b0 for 1 to 2 minutes or golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Roll in sugar. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg yolks; slowly stir in condensed milk. Mixing well stir in lemon juice. Pour into graham cracker crust. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove and cool. Spread Cool Whip on cooled pie. Refrigerate for 3 hours before serving.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in baking dish. In a medium bowl combine rice soups cheese celery onion water chestnuts egg and margarine. Pour over broccoli and add 1/4 cup crumbled Ritz crackers on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly hot.

title: Vanilla Pudding
instructions: Warm milk. Mix dry ingredients and pour into milk stirring constantly over low heat. When thickened remove from heat and add vanilla. Chill and serve.

title: Homemade Hot Cocoa
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine all ingredients; blend well. Store in a tightly covered container. Makes 3 3/4 cups mix (15 to 16 servings).

title: Creamy Ham And Cheese Salad
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed on package. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Chill. Add additional salad dressing before serving if desired. Yields 4 servings (you can add tuna instead of ham).

title: Rutabaga Magic
instructions: Combine all ingredients except butter with water to cover in saucepan. Cook until tender; drain. Mash with butter and serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: In a medium bowl thoroughly combine cheese eggs bread crumbs salt pepper and nutmeg. Place about 1/4 cup cheese mixture in center of each flattened chicken breast. Roll up and secure with toothpicks.

title: Ground Beef And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown beef garlic salt salt and pepper. Add tomato soup and then add sour cream and cream cheese. Mix and add noodles. Put in large casserole dish. Top with grated sharp cheese. Heat in moderate oven until bubbly.

title: Tangy Ham Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream deviled ham chopped chives horseradish and Worcestershire sauce in bowl. Blend well. Chill for 1 hour. Serve with potato or corn chips.

title: Lazy Housewife Pickles
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate. Ready to eat in a few hours. Keeps well a long time covered in refrigerator.

title: Orange Slice Cookie
instructions: Dice the pound of orange slices and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of flour. Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add brown sugar and flour and salt. Mix well and add chopped nuts. Turn batter into a greased and floured jelly roll pan or 9 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 340\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cut while still warm and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chow Mein Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate pieces in double boiler until it melts add peanuts and stir in noodles. Mix until well covered. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a waxed paper lined cookie sheet. Chill in refrigerator 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Tropical Fruit Sherbet
instructions: Mix all ingredients in electric blender or food processor until smooth (make sure the top is on the blender or food processor). Pour into 1 gallon ice cream freezer and freeze according to manufacturers instructions. Serve immediately when ready. Makes 7 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Hot Corn Salad
instructions: In saucepan melt margarine over medium heat; stir in green onion and carrot. Cook stirring 1 minute; stir in corn vinegar sugar and zucchini. Cover and cook 5 minutes stirring often until hot.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix the sour cream and 1 1/2 packages Hidden Valley dressing. Fill sour cream container half full with Miracle Whip. Add more if desired. Chop dill and add more if needed.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add liquids. Cook in medium size pot on medium heat until dough pulls away from sides of pot. Add flavoring for smell and cake coloring for color. Do not use Teflon.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp in a wide 6-quart saucepot. Remove bacon and all but 2 tablespoons of fat. Save both bacon and extra fat. Add ground beef breaking it up with a spoon and cook until brown stirring occasionally. Stir in onion green pepper and garlic and cook for 10 minutes. Add more bacon fat if needed. Mash plum tomatoes with a spoon. Stir the tomatoes and tomato paste bacon 1 cup of wine and 4 teaspoons each of oregano and basil; add all remaining ingredients into the sauce. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer uncovered 3 hours stirring occasionally. Taste after an hour of cooking and correct seasoning; herbs vary and so do personal notions of flavor. If you make the sauce early cool and refrigerate it until an hour or two before dinner. Let it warm to room temperature before you reheat it. Ten or 15 minutes before serving blend in 1 teaspoon each of oregano and basil and 1/2 cup of wine. Any leftover can be frozen for later use.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix well. Place 2 to 3 teaspoons in cup. Add hot water; stir.

title: Twinky Cake
instructions: Bake cake. Let cool. Beat other ingredients for 10 minutes. Slice your cake in layers. Spread filling on each layer and refrigerate.

title: Terry'S Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Prepare Oodles of Noodles according to package. Let cook until almost all liquid is cooked out of pot. Add cream of mushroom soup to pot. Add can of chicken to pot. Stir all ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Quick and delicious.

title: Bluebery Crunch
instructions: Cut in 1/3 cup Butter. Sprinkle over the filling and bake for 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: No Cook, No Can Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Fill 1 gallon glass or plastic jug with sliced cucumbers. Dissolve salt in enough water to cover cucumbers. Let set for 3 days. Pour off water rinse 3 times in cold water. Soak 24 hours with alum in water to cover. Pour off and rinse 3 times in cold water. Cover with white vinegar let set for 7 days. Drain vinegar off and throw away. Rinse 1 time. Heat 1 cup vinegar and 3 cups sugar until sugar is dissolved. Cool and pour over cucumbers (will not cover pickles) add pickling spice and turmeric (put spice and turmeric in soft cloth tied up). Let set for 24 hours.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine softened cheeses and mix well with hands. Add green pepper onion Worcestershire sauce lemon juice and salt. Mix well again with hands. Shape into ball. Roll in mixture of paprika and pecans. Chill.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In 3-quart oblong baking dish combine soups milk thyme and pepper. Stir in vegetables and chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble. Meanwhile cut each biscuit into quarters. Remove dish from oven; stir. Arrange biscuit pieces over hot chicken mixture. Bake 15 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Makes 5 servings.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions. Pour 1/2 of batter into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake until done 20 minutes. Melt caramels in 1/2 cup Carnation milk then pour over cake.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix crumbs confectioners sugar and coconut. Add orange juice concentrate and mix well. Form into about 1-inch balls. Roll balls into confectioners sugar. Store in covered container overnight. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Acorn Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half remove seeds and bake cut-side down at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. In skillet cook pork celery and onion until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Drain fat. Stir in salt curry powder and cinnamon. Cook 1 minute more. Stir in applesauce and bread cubes. Place stuffing in squash halves; bake uncovered 20 minutes more. Makes 2 servings.

title: Mama'S Green Junk(Beulah Thomas)
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate. May garnish with cut up maraschino cherries for a festive look.

title: Polynesian Chicken
instructions: Fry chicken pieces in oil until brown. Saute onions in same pan; add sherry (or other liquid). Stir scraping brown bits loose and blending into liquid to combine with chicken in pan. Add crushed pineapple and water or stock and braise 25 minutes. Add bean sprouts and bamboo shoots. Thicken with cornstarch. Serves 20.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put strawberries in pie shell. Cook until clear the sugar cornstarch syrup water and salt.\tCool slightly then add jello and food\tcoloring. Pour over berries. Chill and serve with whipped topping.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Wash cabbage and chop fine then chop onions. Heat ground beef and onions in skillet. Put half of cabbage in baking dish. Cover with beef and onions. Put remainder of cabbage on top. Pour undiluted tomato soup over mixture. Bake 1 hour or longer covered with foil at 325\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Goulash
instructions: In skillet saute onion in oil until tender. Add ground beef and sprinkle with garlic salt salt and pepper. Brown; drain grease. Add pork and beans tomato sauce and hot sauce. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Blend the first 8 ingredients. Blend in small amounts the flour and milk. Bake in cold oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Glazed Pecans
instructions: Heat nuts in oven at 250\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cook sugar water salt and spices to soft ball stage. Do not stir. Add vanilla. Stir in nuts until creamy and thoroughly coated. Pour on waxed paper. Separate nuts as they cool.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix all together; pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set about 45 minutes.

title: Avocado Corn Quiche
instructions: *Using your favorite pie crust recipe fit the dough into a 10-inch false-bottom quiche pan. Line with foil and fill with rice. Bake 10 minutes in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven. Remove foil and rice and bake 5 minutes longer or until lightly colored.

title: Quiche
instructions: Pour into deep dish Pet Ritz pie crust. Bake as directed on pie crust at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm in middle. Let set for a few minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix shortening sugar and salt in second bowl. Add boiling water and mix well. Add eggs; stir well. Add flour and yeast.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into loaf pan or pan of similar shape. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour and 10 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Place bread in greased casserole. Brown sausage and drain grease. Sprinkle sausage over bread. Top with shredded cheese. Combine eggs milk salt and mustard with whip. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Delight Sauce
instructions: Cook sausage until light brown and drain fat. Combine the rest of the ingredients and simmer on low for 30 minutes.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients right in 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Make 3 holes. Put vinegar into one hole vanilla into second hole and liquid shortening into third hole. Pour one cup water over everything. Stir and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Valentine Cookies
instructions: Cream butter or margarine and sugar. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Sift flour baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture with milk to form a dough. Chill. Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with heart shaped cookie cutter. Place half of the cookies on a lightly greased baking sheet; brush each with water. Cut smaller heart shaped centers from remaining cookies and place the heart frames on top of cookies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool; fill center heart space with cherry filling.

title: Lemon Snow Freeze
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs with 2 tablespoons of the sugar and melted margarine. Press mixture on bottom and sides of lightly buttered refrigerator tray; chill. Beat egg yolks until thick. Combine with Eagle Brand milk. Add lemon rind and juice gradually stirring until thick. Stir in 1 cup Bakers coconut. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually beat in rest of sugar. Fold into lemon mixture. Pour into tray. Sprinkle top with remaining coconut. Chill in freezer until firm about 4 to 6 hours. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Dill Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Yum Yum Ice Cream Or Ice Cream Delight
instructions: Mix fruit in bowl and let stand until juices mix. Take one scoop of ice cream and pour or spoon fruit mixture on top. Add dash of Amaretto (almond flavored liquor).

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Mix 3 minutes; bake in two 9-inch buttered and floured cake pans for 20 to 25 minutes or until done. Cool. Frost and fill with Pineapple Coconut Cream Frosting.

title: Shipwreck Hot Dish
instructions: Cook meat and onion with seasonings. Drain. Cook diced celery carrots and potatoes. Reserve liquid. Combine all ingredients in a greased casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla. Slice tart apples to dip.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium saucepan or in the microwave melt the chips and margarine. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press 1/2 the mixture firmly onto bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Cream Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook drain and mash potatoes just like cream potatoes. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour in buttered baking dish and top with more butter and Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quick And Easy No Bake Pineapple Sour Cream Pie(Very Lo-Cal And No Sugar Except In Crust)
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well with spoon or fork (not electric mixer) until thick. Pour into 1 Keebler ready crust (graham or cookie crust). Top with lite Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together crisco margarine sugar and add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Mix together the bananas milk and vanilla add alternately with flour mixture. Bake in greased and floured pan for 1 hour and 40 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Cornbread Skillet Casserole
instructions: Combine eggs corn meal corn milk and oil in a bowl; set aside. Cook beef until browned; drain well and set aside. Pour 1/2 of corn meal mixture into a greased 1 1/2-inch cast-iron skillet. Spread evenly with beef. Top with cheese onion and peppers. Pour on remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Butter Balls
instructions: Cream Crisco and 1/2 cup of the sugar. Stir in flour salt vanilla and nuts. Mix well. Make into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet which has been rubbed with Crisco. Bake in oven 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Roll in sifted confectioners sugar immediately after baking. Cookies may be re-rolled in sugar after cooling if desired.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and margarine. Add to the sugar salt and cocoa and cream 4 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla two at a time. Mix in flour (do not overmix). Add nuts. Spread evenly on greased cookie sheet. Brush lightly with milk or water. Bake 23 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Poncho Dreg'S Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef. Salt and pepper to taste. Add chili to ground beef and heat. Put beef and chili mixture into casserole dish. Spread sour cream over mixture. Place 6 slices of Velveeta cheese on top of sour cream. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and flour. Add pineapple; mix well. Place in greased casserole. Sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Vanilla Sauce(For Baked Apples)
instructions: Add all items except vanilla. Boil until thick (3 minutes). Remove from heat and add vanilla.

title: Poor Man'S Chow Mein
instructions: Brown beef onions and celery (I usually begin beef in a small amount of water and after awhile pour away drippings). To the beef add onions and celery; continue browning. Mix in casserole dish the soups water rice and soy sauce. Add the browned beef mixture and stir. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Place topping of dry chow mein noodles on each serving.

title: Harriet'S Chicken Cantonese
instructions: Heat oil in skillet or wok and saute chicken until brown. Blend rest of ingredients and add to skillet. Mix; cover and simmer for 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Place chicken in platter and coat with sauce.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and Jell-O. Add cottage cheese pineapple and flavorings. Mix and chill.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix in sauce pan. Stir in gradually. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until it thickens and boils. Boil 1 minute. Slowly stir at least 1/2 the hot mixture into 3 egg yolks slightly beaten. Then blend into hot mixture in saucepan. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Stir until smooth. Blend in 3 tablespoons butter 1/4 cup lemon juice 1 tablespoons grated lemon rind. Pour into baked pie shell. Cover with meringue. Bake at 400\u00b0 (moderate hot oven) for 10 minutes.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: In a large bowl sift together dry ingredients. Add beaten egg and buttermilk and stir into a soft dough. With floured hands knead dough lightly and quickly into a ball. Shape dough into approximately a 7-inch round and place in a 9-inch pie plate. Cut a deep cross into the dough. Bake in a preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes and then lower the oven temperature to 350\u00b0 for an additional 25 minutes. Test for doneness as above. Let bread sit for one hour before serving.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Boil water; add tea cover and let stand for 3 minutes. Strain; add sugar salt lemon juice and orange juice. Serve hot or cold.

title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butter sugar eggs and vanilla in large mixer bowl. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes. In separate bowl combine flour cocoa baking soda baking powder and salt. Add alternately with water to creamed mixture. Blend just until combined. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely. Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken. Debone and cut into small pieces. Reserve 2 cups broth. Place chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan. In saucepan mix broth and cream of chicken soup. Bring to boil. Pour over chicken. In a bowl mix margarine flour pepper and buttermilk to form batter. Spoon over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Biscuit Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add soup and ketchup. Pour into casserole dish. Top with biscuits. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until biscuits are done and lightly browned.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and form into balls.

title: Creamy Lo-Cal Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients with hand beater until very smooth. Store in covered jar in refrigerator. Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Poke hole in bag of Doritos and crush the Doritos. Pour both into a large bowl and stir. Add diced tomatoes and lettuce. Stir again. Pour Catalina dressing in and stir until moistened. May need to add more dressing after it soaks in. Store in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Mix soup mayonnaise eggs onion salt and pepper. Add to drained broccoli. Pour into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over mixture. Mix butter with stuffing. Sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Dinner
instructions: Put one layer of each ingredient in order in a large casserole dish. Bake covered in casserole at 375\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Microwave Pralines
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a 4-quart casserole stirring well. Microwave at High 12 to 13 minutes stirring every 4 minutes. Stir in soda. Microwave at High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in vanilla. Beat with a wooden spoon just until mixture begins to thicken. Working rapidly drop by tablespoons onto greased wax paper. Let stand until firm.

title: Coca-Cola Cherry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. You may add Coca-Cola now or later. Add cherries and pecans. When at room temperature place in refrigerator. After jelling cut and place on lettuce leaf.

title: Hungry Jack Biscuit Barbecups
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 10 muffin cups. Brown ground beef and drain. Stir in barbecue sauce onion and brown sugar. Cook 3 minutes to blend. Stir constantly. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Place 1 biscuit in each greased muffin cup. Press in bottom and up sides to rim. Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mixture into each biscuit cup. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are brown. Cool 2 minutes. Remove from pan. Makes 10 servings.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients except cheese and peppers. Add grated cheese and jalapeno peppers. Pour into two 9 x 12-inch pans or one 12 x 18-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese by hand with onion. Mix in mayonnaise. Add chili sauce slowly and mix a little at a time to blend into the cheese. Add Worcestershire sauce and mix.

title: Betty Roger'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute stuffing in butter until golden. Add 3/4 of buttered stuffing to bottom of greased 3 quart casserole dish. Place chicken in dish. Mix together soup sour cream and mushrooms. Pour over chicken. Add remaining crumbs on top.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion. Combine with other ingredients. Put part of crumbs in mixture and save rest to sprinkle on top. Bake in moderate oven until done.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan to bake brownies. Mix eggs butter and sugar. Ad flour baking powder salt and nuts. Melt chocolate and add to mixture. Pour in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon soda over the dates. Pour 1 cup of boiling water over the dates and soda. Let stand. Mix together salad dressing sugar vanilla salt flour and nut meats. Beat well. Add the date mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: 2 Minute Microwave Fudge
instructions: In a casserole stir sugar cocoa salt milk and vanilla. (Mixture will be stiff.) Cut butter over top. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir vigorously until smooth. Blend in nuts. Pour into waxed paper-lined loaf pan. Chill one hour. Cut into squares.

title: Carolina Gold Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients into saucepan over medium heat mixing well with whisk. Heat thoroughly whisking frequently to prevent burning. This is great on pork beef and chicken (see Carolina Gold Barbecue Recipe in the Meat & Main Dishes section). If youre grilling the meat dont put this on until the meat is cooked and ready to serve or it will burn.

title: Spicy Apple Nut Squares
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients by hand. Sift together flour salt baking powder and cinnamon. Add to mixture. Then add apples and walnuts and/or raisins. Mix thoroughly. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread mixture well into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until done. While still warm sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

title: Lemon Whip
instructions: Mix together and press in 9 x 13-inch pan the crackers sugar and margarine. In bowl mix 1 small can frozen lemonade Cool Whip lemon juice and milk. Beat with mixer and spread over crust. Store and serve from freezer.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine pudding and whipped topping. Then add crushed pineapple and juice. Finally stir in mini marshmallows. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Arrange broccoli in a greased 11 x 7 x 4-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top. Combine soup mayo lemon juice and curry powder; pour over chicken. Sprinkle cheese over top. Combine crumbs and butter; sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serves 6.

title: Crab Soup
instructions: Melt butter in top of double boiler; blend in flour until smooth. Gradually add milk stirring constantly. Add crab meat and seasonings. Cook slowly over hot water for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley or paprika. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Garnish with bacon just before serving.

title: Ham Crescents
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Unroll dough into 4 rectangles. Press seam smooth. Place one slice of ham; spread with mustard and sprinkle with cheese. Starting on short side roll up; press to seal and roll in sesame seed. Repeat with other rectangles. Cut each roll into 5 slices (20 in all). Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Place slices cut side down. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut butter into dry cake mix until crumbly. Mix in coconut.\tPat mixture lightly into ungreased oblong pan 13 x 9 x 3-inches building up slight edges. Bake for 10 minutes. Arrange apple slices on warm crust.

title: Texas Brownies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the flour and sugar. In a heavy saucepan combine butter shortening coffee or water and cocoa. Stir and heat to boiling. Pour boiling mixture over the flour and sugar in the bowl. Add the buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix well using a wooden spoon or high speed of an electric mixer. Pour into a well-buttered 17 1/2 x 11-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brownies test done in the center.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Chop onions and pepper. Crush carrots. Mix. Add condensed milk mayonnaise vinegar and sugar; mix well. Let set 3 or 4 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Ambrosia Cream Cheese Mold
instructions: Soften gelatin in water; let mixture stand 5 minutes. Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Add enough water to juice to make 1 cup. Pour juice into saucepan; heat to boiling. Add gelatin mixture; stir until dissolved. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar lemon juice and cream cheese (a wire whisk helps to blend). Chill until gelatin is partially set. Fold in pineapple chunks orange pecans and coconut. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 1-quart mold. Chill until firm. Unmold.

title: Rock Road Fudge
instructions: In double boiler mix and melt milk butter and chocolate morsels. Remove from heat and add marshmallows and pecans. Pour into a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan lined with wax paper. Chill 2 hours. Cut into squares.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Put eggs in a boiler and beat well. Add sugar; mix well. Add milk. Cook slow until it gets to a boil then add vanilla extract then cornstarch (mixed in a little milk just to make a paste). Add to the pudding. This will thicken and will be ready to finish. Cut the bananas put in bowl and add 1 layer of wafers. Add some pudding mix. Continue until all is finished.

title: Shrimp With Vegetables
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium-high heat. Add carrots leeks zucchini and mushrooms. Cook stirring 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low cover and cook until carrots are crisp-tender about 5 minutes longer. Remove vegetables to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter and oil to same skillet and heat unti hot over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and season with salt and pepper. Cook stirring 2 to 3 minutes until shrimp turn pink and are loosely curled. Remove to a plate. Add wine and cream to skillet and boil over medium-high heat stirring occasionally about 5 minutes to reduce and thicken sauce slightly. Stir in Dijon and Pommery mustards shrimp and vegetable mixture. Heat through about 2 minutes. Garnish with snipped chives.

title: South Of Border Dip
instructions: Cook and stir on low heat the cheese tomato soup taco seasoning and Ro-Tel. Add ground beef and rice. Put over chips.

title: Cheese Snacks
instructions: Add red pepper to sifted flour. Work margarine and cheese together. Work in flour and Rice Krispies. Form into very small balls. Place on a cookie sheet. Press each ball flat with the tines of a fork that has been dipped in flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool just slightly before removing from pan.

title: Easy And Fast No Cook Italian Pudding Squares
instructions: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cookies. Mix pudding as directed on package adding 1 teaspoon anise for each package.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Partially freeze steak. Slic across grain in 2 x 1/4-inch strips. Brown steak in oil in a skillet over medium-high heat for 4 to 6 minutes. Add beef broth and next 4 ingredients. Simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Combine cornstarch sugar and soy sauce stirring well. Add to beef mixture. Bring to a boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat add tomato wedges and toss gently. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Millionaires
instructions: Melt caramels with water and butter. Add pecans and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons onto buttered or Pam sprayed wax paper. Chill.

title: Strawberry Salad Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1 cup cold water. Add thawed strawberries diced bananas and pineapple. Pour 1/2 of mixture into mold or glass dish. Place in refrigerator to gel. Leave the remaining mixture at room temperature. Whip cream. Beat cheese and sugar together fold in whipped cream. Beat cheese and sugar together fold in whipped cream. When mixture in refrigerator gels spread cream mixture over it. Chill. Carefully spoon on the remaining half of fruit mixture. Return to refrigerator to chill and set.

title: Cherry Delectibles(May Be Prepared Ahead Of Time)
instructions: Blend cheese and butter; work in flour until stiff dough is formed; chill overnight. Drain cherries reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Combine cherries reserved liquid and brandy; chill overnight.

title: Squash Casserole(Ernestine'S Favorite Recipe)
instructions: Boil squash until tender; drain. Let stand for 8 minutes. Saute bell peppers and onions. Beat eggs separately in bowl. Save enough cheese to top casserole. Combine all ingredients with squash mixing well. Pour into large casserole dish or large baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done or brown.

title: Pauline'S Favorite Appetizer
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Unroll crescent rolls and press into a 10 X 15 inch pan. Seal perforations by rolling or pressing dough and push up the edges to form a crust. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown. Mix mayonnaise sour cream and soup mix. Drain spinach squeeze out all the water and add to mix. Drain artichokes and water chestnuts chop and add. Mix in feta cheese and garlic. Spread spinach mixture evenly over crust. Grate Parmesan cheese over the top. Bake 10 - 12 minutes or until heated through. Remove from oven and cut into squares.

title: Chitterling Fritters(For Bill Colgan)
instructions: Mix all ingredients with enough milk to give a pancake batter consistency. Drop by large spoonfuls into hot oil. Cook until browned. Bon Appetit Bill.

title: Holiday Ham Balls
instructions: Boiling fish is a favorite way of preparing and serving fish in Denmark. Usually only large fish are cooked this way but slices of large fish such as salmon pike halibut or carp are also excellent. You should have a rack with 2 handles so the fish can be lifted out of the water without breaking it. You can tie a cloth around it before it cooks. Wash the fish well; sprinkle with salt and let stand a few minutes. Lay on rack or tie it in a cloth then drop it in cold water to which has been added salt and 2 tablespoons vinegar; bring to quick boil then simmer slowly until done. Test it with a toothpick for tenderness. Serve with lemon sauce and parsley potatoes.

title: Clam Sauce
instructions: In a 2 cup measure put drained clams and enough water to make two cups. Cook garlic in oil until lightly browned. Discard garlic. Add butter and clam juice. Heat to near boil. Add clams and heat through. Do not boil. Add salt to taste and 2 Tbsp. chopped parsley. Serve over spaghetti or noodles.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine sugar and butter in large mixing bowl. Beat at high speed until creamy scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs beating until blended. Stir in flour cocoa powder vanilla and salt. Spoon into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 25 minutes or until edges pull from sides of pan. Cool in pan on wire rack. Spread with Marshmallow Creme. Combine chocolate chips and peanut butter in a 2-quart pan. Cook over low heat until blended stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in cereal. Spread over prepared layer. Chill covered until set. Cut into 36 bars. Store in refrigerator.

title: Peach Passion Salad
instructions: Mix together water boxes of Jell-O and box of vanilla pudding. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Add peaches and juice. Pour into dish and chill.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter; add remaining ingredients. Roll in shape of a pecan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. When cooled roll in powdered sugar.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Cook turkey celery garlic powder salt and pepper in 10-inch skillet. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with vegetables. Pour tomato sauce over that. Cover with Mozzarella cheese then cover with rolled out crescent rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes then serve.

title: Okra Gumbo
instructions: In the early 1900s the Labor Day celebration on the \green\ was a festive affair on St. Helena Island. Visitors joined the crowd of local islanders for a gala celebration at the picnic ground known as the \bay or \green\. Tables and concession stands set up\tby individuals from Ladys Island and St. Helena Island featured delicacies such as red rice Hoppin John (or peas cooked with rice) fish crab shrimp fried chicken and ham.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: In casserole dish combine eggs broccoli soup onion salt and pepper. Mix melted butter and stuffing then combine with other ingredients. Put in ungreased pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Grated cheese can be put on top and melted.

title: Homemade Cheese Dip
instructions: At room temperature cream onion cheese and canned cream together. Add more cream if too thick. Serve with chips.

title: Almond Cake
instructions: Grease pans well then\tflour.\tCream butter margarine and Crisco; add sugar then eggs. After this\tis well mixed add baking powder almond extract flour and then milk. Bake at 325\u00b0. Bake until golden brown (toothpick inserted comes out clean).

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook one fryer; bone 2nd cut into large pieces. Cook one small package spaghetti in chicken broth. Saute in 1/4 cup butter; green peppers celery and onion. Add pimiento soups can milk. Mix all ingredients together and pour into 5-quart baking dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Pork Chops
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a small mixing bowl. Place chops in glass baking dish. Pour marinade over chops. Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours. Drain chops. Reserve marinade. Heat gas grill to medium setting. Cook with cover down for 7 1/2 minutes on each side. Baste with marinade. Enjoy!!

title: Mincemeat Cake
instructions: If you want to frost cake before baking whip one white of egg stiff. Add 1/2 cup brown sugar. Turn over cake and bake.

title: Vanilla Pudding
instructions: Heat milk. Mix sugar flour and egg yolks. Add from warm milk to make pourable. Pour into hot milk; keep stirred. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Cool.

title: Butternut Balls
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Stir in flour and salt. Add nuts; mix well. Form stiff dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Peanut Butter And Walnut Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa salt and 3/4 can of milk well. Cook over medium heat to boiling. Continue boiling until when by dropping in a small glass of cold water beads form in glass. Remove from heat. Stir in margarine peanut butter and nuts. Stir and beat until mixture starts to thicken. Pour onto well buttered cookie sheet. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Soak bread in water. Squeeze out excess water. Combine bread ground beef egg seasonings onion and 1/2 cup tomato sauce. Mix well with a fork. Shape into a loaf in a shallow pan. Combine remaining ingredients (1/2 cup tomato sauce brown sugar vinegar mustard and water). Pour mixture over meat loaf and bake 1 hour basting occasionally.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Boil potatoes (sliced) and drain. Layer beef and potatoes. Mix soup with 1/2 can of water or milk then pour over beef and potato layers. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: The 8-Minute Light 'N Fruity Pie
instructions: Dissolve jello completely in boiling water; stirring about 3 minutes. Add ice cubes and stir until jello is thickened about 2-3 minutes. Remove any unmelted ice. Using a wire whisk blend in Cool Whip; then whip until smooth. Fold in fruit. Chill if necessary until mixture will mound up. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Chill 2 hours. Garnish if desired.

title: Crab Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with slightly moist bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sweet 'N' Sour Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook the cabbage in 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon salt for 7 minutes. Remove from heat drain well and place in a 1-quart casserole. Fry the chopped onion until crisp remove from pan and set aside. Blend the flour and brown sugar into the bacon drippings in the pan. Stir in the beer and vinegar. Add pepper 1/4 teaspoon salt and the onion; cook lightly until onion is limp. Return the chopped bacon to the mixture. Pour this sweet-sour mixture over the cabbage and cook about 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 4 servings.

title: Macadamia Nut Brittle
instructions: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Equally distribute Macadamia nuts over bottom of dish. Set aside.

title: South Of The Border Dip
instructions: Cut cheese into cubes. Put in crock-pot. Add chili when cheese is starting to melt. Keep stirring. Serve with chips.

title: Cayenne Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a large pan sprinkle with seasonings of cayenne pepper and garlic powder. Cover with onion slices; bake at 400\u00b0 until chicken is done. Spread picante sauce over chicken and over sauce the grated cheese. Return to oven just until cheese melts. Serve with nacho chips and salad.

title: Hamburger Junk
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Season with garlic salt oregano salt pepper and Parmesan cheese to taste. Add tomatoes tomato paste and water. Let simmer. Put half of the sauce in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish then half of the macaroni. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and sharp cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Cut 5 or 6 peeled apples into small pieces. Sprinkle with 5 teaspoons cinnamon (or to your taste) and set aside. In a large bowl mix ingredients (except apples) until smooth.
