Pour 1/2 cake mixture into a 10-inch greased and floured tube pan; add 1/2 apple mixture. Add remaining cake mixture to pan and top with remaining apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cake will be golden brown when done. Remove from pan immediately and cool. Best served cool or cold.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Boil all ingredients until thick stirring often. Pour into quart jars and seal. Process in hot water bath for 5 minutes.

title: Jagerschnitzel(Veal In Brown Gravy And Mushrooms)
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Pound cutlets with a meat tenderizer to flatten them. Season cutlets with salt and pepper dredge them in beaten eggs and then coat evenly with bread crumbs. Place cutlets into skillet and fry until golden brown (1-2 minutes in each side). Remove the meat from the skillet and drain on paper towels. Keep the meat warm in the oven while you make the gravy.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Heat soup; add cream cheese stirring until thoroughly blended. Soak gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water. Add to soup mixture. Blend in mayonnaise. Add remaining ingredients and stir until evenly mixed. Pour into oiled fish or any mold. Place in refrigerator to set. When ready to use turn out on platter. Serve as spread on crackers or as a salad.

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
instructions: Cook grits in boiling salted water. Meanwhile melt 1 1/2 rolls of garlic cheese and 1 stick of margarine.

title: Pumpkin Waffles
instructions: Sift together pumpkin eggs milk and butter. In a separate bowl combine flour baking powder salt sugar and nutmeg. Add dry ingredients to pumpkin mixture. Stir until thoroughly combined. Bake in waffle iron.

title: Moravian Mints
instructions: Simmer granulated sugar and water together until syrup threads from spoon. Take from stove; add confectioners sugar cream of tartar and peppermint. Beat until creamy and drop from spoon onto wax paper. For wintergreen flavor use wintergreen extract and pink coloring peppermint extract with green coloring and lemon extract with yellow coloring.

title: Passover Muffins
instructions: Dissolve sugar and salt in boiling water. Add oil. Add matzo meal. Cool. Add eggs one at a time. Beat thoroughly after adding each egg. Place in greased muffin pans. Bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown. Makes approximately 12 large muffins.

title: Summer Chicken
instructions: Mix all the wet* ingredients with ginger and mix well. Cut vegetables and put them all in the marinating dish with the chicken and marinade. Place dish in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. Mix the marinade every once in a while. Place vegetables and sauce in a tin pan or tin foil. Place it on the top rack or on the side of grill. Grill chicken until done. Serve with white or wheat rice. Its good.

title: Braised Cabbage, Kielbasa And Spuds
instructions: Cut cabbage and potatoes in 1-inch chunks. Mix broth with mustard in a large saucepan. Add the cabbage and potatoes; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover; simmer 15 minutes. Add kielbasa; cover and cook 5 minutes or until hot. Serve with mustard. Serves 4.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add egg and milk; beat until light and fluffy. Sift dry ingredients together and blend into creamed mixture. Divide dough in half. Cover and chill at least one hour. On lightly floured surface roll to 1/8-inch thickness. Chill other half of dough until ready to use. Cut in desired shapes with cutters. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly and remove. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Tortilla
instructions: Boil 4 to 6 chicken breasts. Oil a casserole dish. Line with Doritos (regular flavor). Put a layer of chicken that has been taken off the bone on top of the Doritos. Mix together cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups with Ro-Tel tomatoes. Pour on top of chicken. Place a layer of Doritos on top and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into four pieces in 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 tablespoon cinnamon mixture and drop into buttered Bundt pan. In saucepan bring to boil 1/2 cup sugar white corn syrup 1 tablespoon cinnamon butter and nuts. Pour over biscuits and bake approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tasty Potato Salad
instructions: Cook peel and slice potatoes. Combine with celery onions green peppers pimentos and seasoning. Add Dressing. Mix well and chill. Add additional dressing before serving.

title: Pat'S Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Place tomatoes chili peppers coriander and salt in blender; blend until smooth. Add sour cream and blend. Set aside. Mix chicken cream cheese and onion also salt to taste if desired.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Cook and stir onion in oil using 10-inch skillet until tender. Add all ingredients except tomatoes. Cook and cover over low heat for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes. Cover and simmer until green pepper is tender approximately 5 minutes.

title: Chili Con Queso Nacho Dip
instructions: Cut Velveeta into cubes and put into crock-pot or microwave-safe bowl. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes or salsa. Melt together. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Follow directions on back of sparerib mix.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Apple Hill Cake
instructions: Mix apples and sugar (let stand). Mix eggs oil and vanilla. Stir in apples and sugar. Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon. Add to mixture. Mix well adding nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Wine(Makes 4 To 6 Servings)
instructions: Place chicken skin side up in baking dish 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle generously with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Ribbon Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Place in refrigerator to jell. Mix lemon jello and 1 cup boiling water. Add marshmallows and cream cheese. Chill until slightly thickened. Blend mayonnaise Cool Whip and pineapple. Chill until thick then spoon over red jello. Mix lime jello 2 cups boiling water and cold water or ice cubes. When thickened gently pour over lemon mixture and jell.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Grease an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Place bread as a liner in bottom of dish. Sprinkle with cheese then sausage. Mix together eggs milk salt mustard and pepper. Pour over sausage and cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until eggs are set. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Forgotten Short Ribs
instructions: Salt and pepper ribs. Put in Dutch oven. In small pan combine remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Pour over short ribs. Cover and bake at 275\u00b0 for 4 hours or until tender. Spoon off excess fat prior to serving.

title: Dutch Cookies
instructions: Cream butter/margarine. Add sugar and cinnamon; beat well. Add egg yolk; beat well. Sift and add flour. Mix well. Press dough evenly unto greased cookie sheets or 12 x 15-inch pan. Brush with slightly beaten egg white. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and pecans. Bake 30-35 minutes at 300\u00b0. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Black-Bottom Goodies
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine water oil vinegar and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients stirring well. Spoon batter into paper-lined miniature muffin pans filling 2/3 full. Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients stirring well. Stir in chocolate morsels. Spoon about 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture over chocolate batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Beet Wine(5 Gallons)
instructions: *Used in flower and root wines because natural yeast is absent in these crops and it helps to carry fermentation further.

title: Banana Popsicles
instructions: Whiz for 3 minutes in blender. Put in bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Stir and chill. Cut a banana in half. Use a corn dog stick or fork. Roll banana in carob mixture. Then roll in coconut peanuts walnuts or anything else you desire. Place on tray covered with wax paper and freeze. Take out and let the kids or grown-ups have fun. Delicious treat and low-fat.

title: No Salt Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add shortening sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Gradually add by hand rest of flour. Makes a soft batter. Let rise about 30 minutes. Punch down. Beat 25 strokes. Knead lightly. Spread in greased pan; let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Zucchini Slaw
instructions: In large bowl toss zuchini with carrot and green onions. In a small screw-top jar combine remaining ingredients; cover and shake well. Pour over vegetable mixture and toss to combine. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Heat first 4 ingredients until dissolved. Bring to a rolling boil and cook for 1 minute. Set off heat and add vanilla. Beat until right consistency to spread. Spread on cooled cake layers.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 2-quart casserole dish. Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside. In casserole dish beat egg yolks with cream. Stir in flour sugar salt and pepper. Add corn and butter and mix. Fold in egg whites. Pour into prepared pan and sprinkle top with paprika; bake for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight Salad
instructions: Fold all ingredients together.\tChill and serve.

title: Onion Pretzel Snacks
instructions: Break pretzels into bite size pieces. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt butter and add onion soup mix. Stir well. Pour over pretzels and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Let cool completely. Store in tightly closed container.

title: Mock Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix and cook together the first 5 ingredients. Add eggs and lemon extract; cook a little bit more. Cool and pour into baked pie crust. Beat egg whites; add 2 tablespoons sugar. Put on top and brown in hot oven.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat together cream cheese and sugar. Add peanut butter and beat in well. Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip and spoon into pie shell. Top to taste with more Cool Whip. Refrigerate several hours before serving. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in 2 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Start in cold oven. Bake 60 to 70 minutes. Butter top 15 to 20 minutes before done.

title: Mashed Potato Filling
instructions: Saute in olive oil onion celery garlic and poultry seasoning. Mix with bread.

title: Too Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Butter 8 x 8-inch pan. Slice peaches and put in the bottom of the pan. Cut bread into 5 finger slices and put on top of the peaches. Mix butter flour sugar and egg. Pour over bread. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Six Week Muffins
instructions: Mix together all dry ingredients. Add other ingredients mix thoroughly and store in covered bowl in refrigerator. Do not mix second time. Fill muffin cups and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. May add any fruit variation. Will keep well in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Boil Jell-O water and pineapple for 3 minutes. Add marshmallows pecans cottage cheese and whipped cream. Cool in icebox.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
instructions: Break cauliflower into sections. Cook for 10 minutes in boiling water which has been salted. Drain well. Combine cauliflower with 2 tablespoons margarine onion cheese sour cream and salt. Spoon into a 1 1/2 quart casserole. Melt remaining margarine and toss with bread crumbs. Sprinkle over the cauliflower mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Oven-Buttered Corn Chunks
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt into a bowl. Add milk and corn. Stir until soft dough is formed. Turn out on a well floured board or pastry cloth. Knead about 15 times. Roll out in a rectangle 1/2-inch thick. Cut into 1-inch strips and then into 24 pieces. Roll in the melted butter and arrange in the pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Crush taco chips into 9 x 13-inch dish. Brown ground beef; season with envelope taco seasoning. Add refried beans to beef; mix well. Then add layer of meat and chips then 1 layer thick of shredded cheees. Add 1 layer of sour cream. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Leave set 5 minutes before eating. Add 1/2 head of chopped lettuce chopped tomatoes and chopped black olives. Add more Cheddar cheese sprinkled on top; serve.

title: Shrimp Newburg
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot. Add onion and celery; saute about 10 minutes. Add peppers and shrimp; saute 15 minutes more until shrimp are done. Remove from heat. Add flour and sauce mixes; stir well to get out the lumps. Add 1 quart of milk. Return to low heat and bring to a simmer slowly until it thickens. Add more milk; thin out if necessary. Add parsley at the end of cooking. Serve over rice.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Place in casserole dish and cover with slices of Velveeta cheese. Melt butter and combine with crumbled Ritz crackers. Cover casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and crackers are browned.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Melt shortening in saucepan; add sugar and stir until dissolved. Cool 2 to 3 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Sift flour with salt and baking powder. Add to first mixture. Add vanilla water and nuts or coconut. Turn into greased 8 x 12-inch pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or less in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: County Kitchen Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Remove meat from bones. Reserve broth; cut chicken into small pieces and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In a saucepan mix and bring to a boil the reserved broth and soup. In another bowl combine margarine pepper salt flour and buttermilk. Mix thoroughly to form batter. Pour broth mixture over chicken. Spoon batter over top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pig Picking Cake
instructions: Mix together. Bake in 3 layer cake pans at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool before icing.

title: Chinese Fried Rice
instructions: Fry bacon. Remove from fat. Add onions and green pepper. Fry until slightly browned. Pour in soy sauce. Stir. Combine rice and meat. Add to onion mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Heat. Add unbeaten egg and stir until blended well with rice. Crumble bacon over top.

title: Cordon Bleau
instructions: Pound chicken. Season with salt. Place ham and cheese on each. Tuck in sides and roll pressing to seal. Coat with flour. Lightly brown in butter; place in a baking dish. Stir mushrooms water wine and Heinz 57 sauce in butter in skillet. Heat and pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Thicken sauce and serve with rice.

title: Nanaimo Bars
instructions: Combine crumbs coconut and nuts; reserve. Heat butter and 1/4 cup granulated sugar until butter is melted. Stir in cocoa; mixture should be smooth and sugar dissolved. Blend in egg and vanilla mixing well. Combine mixture with crumb mixture. Turn into a lightly oiled (not greased) 8 x 8-inch pan. Press firmly to make a smooth surface. Place into freezer while preparing next layer. Blend the 1/4 cup soft butter the powdered sugar and hot water until mixture is smooth and well combined. Spread over chocolate layer smoothing top. Melt chocolate chips. Spread over top of cookie (sometimes it spreads easier if you add a little butter and milk.) Cover and chill. Cut into 16 bars (288 calories each!).

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Put squash in large casserole dish & mash. Add cheese leaving enough to cover later. Stir in crackers & minced onions. Add eggs & stir quickly to prevent them from cooking. Salt & pepper to taste. Cover with rest of cheddar cheese. Cook at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook an additional 20 minutes or until slightly brown.

title: Tuna-Zucchini Frittata
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in 8 or 9-inch skillet. Add mushrooms and cook until tender 3 to 5 minutes. In large bowl beat eggs with milk. Add mushrooms zucchini tuna salt lemon juice and tarragon. Mix well. Melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter in skillet. Pour in tuna mixture. Cook over low heat to medium heat without stirring until frittata is set on bottom. Place under broiler and cook just until top is set about 3 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Sunflower Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies place half crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese and margarine until smooth. Mix in powdered sugar. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into marble-size balls. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until brown approximately 10 minutes.

title: Honey Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Combine water honey and oil in saucepan and heat to lukewarm. Pour into a large mixing bowl and re-check temperature. Stir in the powdered milk salt yeast and 3 cups whole wheat flour. Mix well. Add the rest of the whole wheat flour and enough unbleached flour to make a nice springy dough. Turn out onto a floured board and knead until smooth about 10 to 15 minutes. Put dough into an oiled bowl turning to coat all sides. Cover and let rise until double about 60 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Line baked cooled pie shell with 2 cups of large uncooked berries arrange hulled side down. Make a sauce of the other 2 cups of berries cut up and cooked until thick with sweetening water cornstarch and salt mixed together. Remove from heat. Add butter and stir well. Cool and pour over berries in the pastry shell. Spread with a thick coating of whipped cream or whipped topping. Serves 6.

title: Mushrooms With Crabmeat Stuffing
instructions: Saute stems onions and celery in butter until celery is tender. Pour into a large bowl. Add breadcrumbs parsley white crabmeat garlic salt & pepper. Mix well and add more melted butter if too dry. Lightly blanch mushroom caps. Drain and cool. Form small balls of stuffing and insert into each cap. (In forming balls stuffing should not stick to your hands.) Lightly sprinkle with garlic. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden. (Excess stuffing may be frozen or formed into crab patties and baked.)

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix cream of chicken and sour cream; set aside. Pour melted butter over potatoes; pour cream of chicken mixture over potatoes and mix well. Add rest of ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well and bake in unbaked crust in 375\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar then add eggs one at a time. Add rum and vanilla. Add alternately flour baking powder and milk then add nuts. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 80 minutes.

title: Beach Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a bowl then pat it out into a 9 x 12 inch pan sprayed with Pam. Mix the next 3 ingredients and pour over crust. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake for 45 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Honey Salad Dressing
instructions: Place ingredients in a jar and shake. Refrigerate. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Rainbow Punch
instructions: Put ingredients in punch bowl and let stand for 15 minutes. Then pour 2-quarts ginger ale over sherbet and strawberries.

title: Rosemary Chicken And Mushrooms
instructions: Cut chicken into 1 1/2-inch cubes. Spread lightly with mayonnaise and sprinkle with salt and lemon pepper. Arrange chicken cubes in shallow layer in nonstick skillet and brown quickly over high heat turning once. Remove and set aside. Combine onions wine rosemary and mushrooms in skillet. Cook and stir over high heat until most of liquid evaporates and onions and mushrooms begin to brown. Return chicken to skillet and heat through. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve over pasta.

title: Sue Siegel'S Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put into ovenproof casserole and cover tightly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Do not remove cover until ready to serve. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Taco Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and stir in the seasoning. In large round casserole layer meat then cheese then tortilla. Repeat until all is used. Put beans and sauce on top. Cover with more cheese. Bake in oven until bubbly and hot for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with sauce and sour cream.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple and sugar to a full boil. Add jello. Stir until dissolved. Add cream cheese. Stir until dissolved. Add ice water and celery. Put into refrigerator until jello starts to mold. Whip evaporated milk and fold into jello mixture. Chill.

title: Hot Cherry Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. To Bisquick add sugar and the drained cherries. Stir in milk to make a stiff dough. Spread in greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan or 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Heat the juice from the cherries with water added to make 1 1/4 cups and the remaining cup of sugar. Also add 1/2 teaspoon almond extract and a few drops of red food coloring. Add butter and bring to a boil. Pour over the dough and bake for 30 minutes. Serve hot with vanilla ice cream.

title: Hungarian  Paprikas
instructions: Saut onions in 2 Tbsp. shortening drain. Add to the onions the red pepper and paprika salt and water. Add cut up chicken and cook until tender about 2 hours.

title: Garden Vegetable Onion Dip
instructions: Stir together sour cream onion soup mix garlic powder and dill weed until well blended. Stir in grated carrots. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Roasted Potato Salad
instructions: Bake small red potatoes. Fry bacon crisp drain. Chop potatoes bacon eggs and onions. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. May be served warm or cold.

title: Hamburger Baked Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions together. Drain excess fat. Mix all ingredients together with meat. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Can be cooked in crock-pot on high.

title: Zucchini Carrot Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or 2 1/2 x 3 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan.

title: Mint Salad
instructions: Melt jelly over low heat. Add salad dressing. Blend well. Stir in marshmallows pears and pineapple. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into 8-inch square pan. Freeze until firm.

title: Leek, Potato And Sausage Soup
instructions: In a dry heavy saucepan toast the cumin and caraway seeds over moderate heat stirring for 2 or 3 minutes. Transfer to a plate. In the pan cook the leeks in the butter stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Stir in the broth and the potatoes (cut into 1/2 inch cubes). Bring the liquid to a boil. Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Stir in the toasted seeds Kielbasa cream and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer the soup for 5 minutes. Just before serving stir in the spinach. Serves 4.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Measure water into large mixing bowl. Add yeast. Stir until dissolved. Stir in sugar shortening salt and egg. Add flour and beat until smooth. Cover. Let rise in warm place for 40 minutes. Stir down. Stir in corn.

title: Canjica(Corn Pudding)
instructions: Cook the corn as you would dried beans or peas until tender (20 minutes in the pressure cooker is one way). Dont use a lot of water. After the corn is done add other ingredients. (You may need more milk coconut and sugar depending on how the corn comes out.) Before serving sprinkle with cinnamon. The texture should be creamy but lumpy and not too thick. Serve warm.

title: Chocolate Cheese Pie(In Microwave)
instructions: Prepare and microwave crust as directed; set aside. Place cream cheese in medium mixing bowl; microwave at power level 5 for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until cream cheese softens. Add sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat at low speed of electric mixer until blended; set aside. Place chocolate in small bowl. Microwave at power level 5 for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes or until chocolate can be stirred stirring 1 or 2 times. Add to cream cheese mixture. Add sour cream; beat at low speed until smooth. Pour into prepared crust. Place on saucer in oven. Microwave at power level 5 for 12 to 15 minutes or until center is slightly set rotating pie plate every 3 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes. Chill for 6 hours or until set. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Sausage Roll
instructions: Make dough with flour and margarine. Roll into a rectangle. Spread raw sausage over dough. Roll as for a jelly roll. Chill slice and bake at 400\u00b0 until sausage is done and dough is brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pineapple evenly over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan (which has been greased). Cover with pie filling. Sprinkle cake mix evenly over top. Sprinkle with nuts. Dot margarine evenly on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Good Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oats and chips. Stir in oats and chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 100 cookies.

title: Baked Ham Slice-Sauterne
instructions: Place ham in a shallow baking pan. Mix sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan. Stir in water and margarine. Cook stirring constantly for 5 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet and saute chopped onion over medium heat. Add meat and saute 5 minutes or until browned. Add remaining ingredients except sour cream in order listed. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream and cook just until heated through. Serve over mashed potatoes rice or egg noodles.

title: Oranged Barbecued Wings
instructions: Split chicken wings at each joint and discard tips; pat dry. Season wings with salt and pepper. Place wings on broiler pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Combine barbecue sauce orange juice Worcestershire sauce rind cloves and garlic in saucepan. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Brush sauce over wings. Yields 8 servings.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Cream together all ingredients. Chill in refrigerator overnight. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Place rice in a buttered 13 x 9-inch Pyrex. Add soup and water; mix well. Place chicken on rice. Bake 3 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Mixed-Up Hamburger
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine soups water onions and cheese. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat together cheese soups Ro-Tel and onions. After cheese melts add broken chips and chicken. Pour into greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: White Punch
instructions: Mix all together in large punch bowl. Serves about 75 people.

title: Red And White Strawberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Mix jello with water. Add partially thawed strawberries stir well. Add bananas and pineapple. Place 1/2 of mixture in 9 x 12-inch pan. Put in refrigerator until firm. Put sour cream on top. Put the rest of the strawberries mixture and refrigerate until firm. Cut into square to serve. Dessert of salad.

title: Sherry Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix and nutmeg in large bowl. Add all remaining ingredients. Mix at low speed until moistened then beat at medium speed 3 minutes or beat by hand 150 strokes per minute! Turn batter into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake below oven center in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until cake tests done. Remove from oven and let stand in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Turn onto wire rack and glass if desired.

title: Cheese Logs
instructions: Grate and mix all cheese together. Add chili powder and garlic salt to taste. Roll in crushed nuts.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Boil the first 5 ingredients until it spins a thread. Then add soda and pour over one gallon popped corn.

title: Low-Fat Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix frozen limeade milk and Cool Whip. Beat with mixer. Pour into pie shell and chill 2 to 4 hours before serving. Garnish with cut-up lime slices and stemmed cherries. Keep any leftovers in refrigerator.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate. Ready to serve when strawberries are thawed. Looks great when served in clear or crystal bowl.

title: Garlic Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream salad dressing\tmix and parsley flakes in a small bowl; chill several hours to blend flavors. Serve with crackers or crisp vegetable sticks.

title: Fruit Wake-Up
instructions: Combine banana pineapple and orange juice in bowl. Chill in refrigerator. Spoon into serving dishes. Top with toasted coconut.

title: Cappuccino Shake
instructions: In a blender combine milk coffee crystals sugar and extract. Blend until coffee is dissolved. Serve with a dash of cinnamon. For a hot drink pour into a mug and heat in a microwave. Yield 1 serving.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs well add sugar. Blend in oil and vanilla. Add zucchini. Add dry ingredients then pineapple raisins nut and coconut. Mix well. Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans (dont fill too full). Bake 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
instructions: Place wings in single layer on baking pan. Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to a simmer. Pour over wings and bake at 350\u00b0 1 hour. Pan may be covered for first 20 minutes of baking.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Chop cherries pineapple dates and pecans in a large pan. Add soda and salt to flour; add to fruit. Mix until fruit is well coated.

title: Banana Nut Loaf
instructions: Hat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Mix together thoroughly sugar shortening and eggs. Stir in buttermilk mashed bananas and flour then soda and fold in chopped nuts. Turn batter into prepared pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Remove and cool completely.

title: Poor Man'S Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Add meat and brown. Add flour salt pepper and mushrooms. Cook about 5 minutes. Add soup and simmer uncovered about 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with noodles. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl combine flour and sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Stir in 1/2 cup chips; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Wendy'S Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Fully cook potatoes in skin in microwave. After cool peel skins off and cut in pinwheels. In casserole dish make a layer of potatoes. Put cheese strips on top of potatoes. Continue to make layers until you have used up the potatoes. Empty cream of chicken soup into separate bowl. Mix well with one soup can of milk then pour over potatoes. Top with cheese strips. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place in oven uncovered at 400\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese is completely melted throughout the casserole dish.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: In heavy skillet brown beef and drain. Add onion salt and pepper then stir. Add sliced potatoes soup and water. Cover and simmer until potatoes are done. Makes 4 servings.

title: Special Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Make mashed potatoes. Add cream cheese eggs flour and minced onion. Put in baking dish. Top with French fried onion rings. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pasta With Artichokes
instructions: Trim artichokes and prepare as for hearts cutting in halves or quarters. Or if using frozen artichokes thaw and use as they come in the package. Saute onion in butter until translucent. Add garlic wine lemon juice and artichokes. Cover and cook over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes. Add heavy cream and cook uncovered 2 to 3 minutes longer until mixture thickens slightly. Add fresh fettuccine cooked chopped nuts and Parmesan cheese. Toss then add salt and freshly ground pepper to taste. Serve with warm soup sourdough French bread and Chardonnay wine for a Monterey Bay California experience.

title: Fourth Of July Dip
instructions: Spread beans in bottom of Pyrex dish. Top with sour cream and then pour melted cheese over sour cream. Top with sliced jalapenos. Serve with chips.

title: Almond Bark Candy
instructions: Melt almond bark in 200\u00b0 oven. Stir in peanut butter; add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper. Cool until hardened.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix first five ingredients together. After this is well blended add flour cinnamon and nuts. Pour in 2 greased and floured loaf pans or 1 (13 x 9-inch) cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Heat peanut butter and syrup over medium heat until warm and soft stirring constantly. Mix in cereal until well coated. Press into greased pan and refrigerate until hard. Cut into 18 bars.

title: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine broth 1 c. water carrots and potatoes in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer over low heat 10 minutes.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Divide the okra evenly between 3 (1 pint) jars. Place one dried chile and one tsp. of dill into each jar. In a small saucepan combine the water vinegar and salt. Bring to a rolling boil. Pour over the ingredients in the jars and seal in a hot water bath for 10 minutes. Refrigerate jars after opening.

title: Chicory(Cooked Greens)
instructions: Clean and wash one head of chicory. Cut into manageable eating size. In a proper size pot place 2 cups water pinch of sugar pepper tomato sauce (for taste and color) and the press of 2 large cloves garlic. Add the cut greens to the pot containing the listed ingredients and cook covered at medium heat until done (about 10 to 15 minutes). Enjoy with toasted French or Italian bread.

title: Sauerkraut And Noodle Dough
instructions: Place sauerkraut and water in 4-quart size saucepan. Begin heating.

title: Basic Crepes
instructions: In mixer bowl beat eggs lightly. Add melted margarine or butter and mix. Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth. (Batter will be thin.) Pour scant 1/4 cup butter into lightly greased and heated 8-inch crepe pan or skillet. Tilt pan to coat bottom evenly with batter. Cook over medium heat until brown; turn crepe to brown second side. Cool pan slightly between crepes. Spoon filling onto center of crepe and roll.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Put all ingredients except milk in pan; bring to boil stirring constantly then add milk and bring to boil again. Boil until it forms a soft ball. Mix with popcorn and form balls.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven covered for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes; add chopped onions. Cover with water. Cook together for 20 to 25 minutes. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes cheese broccoli salt and pepper to taste. Simmer over low heat until cheese melts. Serve with Broccoli Cornbread.

title: Pineapple Almond Slaw
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside. Combine cabbage and remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add sour cream mixture. Toss well cover and chill.

title: Parmesan Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place butter into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and melt in oven. Mix Parmesan cheese flour salt and pepper in a bowl with a cover. Place potatoes into the mixture. Shake until well coated. Place in pan and sprinkle leftover mixture over the top. Bake uncovered for 1 hour.

title: Rhubarb Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine together 1 cup sugar flour butter baking powder and milk; pour into 9-inch square pan. Over this batter put rhubarb 1 cup sugar and boiling water. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine at medium speed with an electric mixer. Gradually add sugars beating well. Add egg substitute and vanilla; mix well. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients. Gradually add to margarine mixture mixing well. Stir in raisins. Drop dough by 2 teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove to wire racks to cool. Yield 3 dozen cookies (60 calories per cookie) 1.5 g fat 00 mg cholesterol.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in olive oil. In casserole dish combine the rest of ingredients. Add the onions and pepper. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until rice is done. Stir to mix the rice and vegetables.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Spoon into buttered casserole dish sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 5.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 3 layer pans and bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Let layers completely cool.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and 3 tablespoons sugar and press into large oblong cake pan. Bake 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool completely. Beat cream cheese and 3/4 cup sugar until smooth; add Cool Whip and mix. Spread over pretzels. Seal edges and refrigerate until firm. Mix jello 2 cups boiling water and berries. Let set up slightly then pour over cream cheese mix and refrigerate. Keeps fine so you can make day ahead.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Add most any kind of fruit except for blueberries. Combine and chill.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in Tupperware bowl the lettuce cauliflower and peas. Sprinkle Italian seasoning mix on top. Cover with mayonnaise and seal around edges. Sprinkle cheese and bacon crumbs on top. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Yogurt Cheese
instructions: Line large sieve with double thickness of cheesecloth. Add yogurt. Set over bowl. Cover and put in refrigerator for 24 hours. Use with baked or mashed potatoes as a spread or in dips.

title: Croque Monsieur
instructions: Cut a slit in each bread slice to form a pocket. Spread 1 tsp honey mustard into each bread pocket. Divide ham and cheese evenly among bread pockets. Combine milk and egg whites in a shallow bowl stirring with a whisk. Dip sandwiches 1 at a time in milk mixture turning to coat. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium high heat. Add 2 sandwiches; cook 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Repeat procedure with remaining sandwiches. Yield 4 servings.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Dessert
instructions: Beat together egg yolks sugar and salt. Add to milk that has been scalded and cooled. Cook over hot water in double boiler until custard coats spoon.

title: Sunday Morning Brunch
instructions: Mix eggs salt 1 cup of milk mustard and soup with remaining 2/3 cup milk. Layer bread sausage cheese mushrooms and egg mixture in a rectangular cake pan. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cut slice from top of bread loaf; remove center leaving 1-inch shell. Cut removed bread into bite size pieces. Saute celery and onion in margarine until tender. Add process cheese spread; stir over low heat until process cheese is melted. Stir in remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly stirring constantly. Spoon into bread loaf. Serve with vegetable dippers and bread.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli (do not add salt). Saute onions in margarine. Add soup mushrooms cheese and broccoli. Heat well and serve with large corn chips.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Mix potatoes and powdered sugar (will turn liquid) until it makes a ball like dough. Divide and roll out on powdered sugar. Spread peanut butter over and roll up jelly roll style. Repeat with remaining dough. Slice and eat.

title: Yulonda'S Homemade Sweet Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Brown hamburger and drain grease from meat. Stir in barbecue sauce and add water and sugar. Stir all together.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a 9 x 13-inch rectangular cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together first 3 ingredients then add the remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Grease and flour pan.

title: Chicken Scala
instructions: Flour chicken breasts and brown in oil. Drain fat from pan and add consomme to chicken; simmer 25 to 30 minutes. Add 1/2 to 1 cup sour cream to make a creamy sauce. Add several shakes of black pepper. Put chicken and sauce in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and brown under broiler.

title: Mock Lobster
instructions: Thaw- have a large pan of water boiling with about 1 cup sugar (1/2 cup sugar/lb. fish).

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: You will also need 3 clean quart jars.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Roll out biscuits real thin and put fruit in side. Cut around edges. Fry in oil. Drain on paper towels.

title: Raspberry Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate. Cream margarine eggs and sugar then add chocolate. Stir in flour and walnuts. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Drop jam by teaspoonfuls over surface of batter. Swirl with fork to mix into batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add flour and eggs; beat well. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Ginger Cup
instructions: Push the cloves into the oranges and let them stand an hour that the flavor may be extracted. Rub the sugar over the rind of the oranges and lemons then add juice of these to the sugar. Add the spices and pineapple and let stand two hours. At the time of serving put in the water and ginger ale and pour over the cracked ice.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Mix and follow advice in Proverbs 2314 for making a good boy. Put all in one pan. Bake for 3 hours in moderate oven.

title: Alabama Apples(Roll Tide!)
instructions: Put butter in bottom of casserole; add sliced apples and sugar. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast in measuring cup with warm water. Stir together flour and salt in large mixing bowl. Cut shortening into flour with pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in dissolved yeast. Turn out onto lightly floured board or pastry cloth and knead just until smooth. Place dough in large greased bowl; turn once to grease top. Cover and let rise in warm draft-free area until doubled in size about 1 hour. Punch dough down. Divide dough in half. On floured surface roll each half into an 11-inch circle. Place rounds on greased 12-inch pizza pans. Make pizza as desired. Bake at 400\u00b0. Makes 2 pizzas.

title: Consomme Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cover. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese-Macaroni Salad
instructions: Chill macaroni. Combine with celery peas carrots and green pepper. Season to taste. Moisten with mayonnaise. Mix lightly with two forks. Serve on any crisp salad greens. Garnish with cheese balls or diced stuffed olives. Yield 6 servings.

title: Beef Goulash(Microwave)
instructions: Place beef in a 3-quart microwave casserole. Peel tomatoes and remove cores. Cut tomatoes in chunks. Place in casserole with beef. Add onion salt and pepper; stir. Cover and cook on Roast for 40 to 50 minutes or until beef is tender. Stir twice during cooking time. Stir sour cream into mixture and let stand covered for 5 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix ingredients until smooth. Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with blueberry pie filling. (May also be topped with cherry pie filling.)

title: Sausage Bake
instructions: Braise sausage and drain grease off. Add flour to sausage and add all ingredients. Place in casserole dish.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream the oleo Crisco and sugar until smooth. Beat in eggs. Sift together the flour and soda; add to creamed mixture. Form into a ball. Roll out on floured board to the thickness you desire and cut out. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen according to thickness.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter beat in sugar and other ingredients. Add enough flour (about 1/2 cup) to make mixture stiff enough for drop cookies (on a greased sheet) with floured fork crisscross. Bake at 350\u00b0. Makes 60.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix sugar milk and butter in pan. Cook 5 or 6 minutes. Add peanut butter Marshmallow Creme and vanilla. Pour in buttered cake pan or plate. Let cool!

title: Company French Toast
instructions: Pour melted butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan and cover with brown sugar. Place a layer of bread (as close as possible) over butter; sprinkle cinnamon and raisins over and cover with another layer of bread. Combine and beat eggs vanilla and milk; pour mixture over bread. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

title: Wild Rose Jelly
instructions: Measure rose petals. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Boil 15 minutes. Strain through a jelly bag. Add strawberry juice and measure the liquid. If you do not have a quart add enough water to make up the difference. Return to kettle. Stir in sugar and bring to a boil. Still stirring pour in pectin and boil 1 minute more. Pour into jelly glasses and seal with paraffin.

title: French Eggs
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay bread in 2 layers in pan. Cover each layer with grated cheese; sprinkle with bacon. Mix eggs milk and salt together; pour over top. Let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Williamsburg Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in a greased casserole. Top with crushed potato chips and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Baskets
instructions: Crush shredded wheat biscuits until fine. Melt chocolate in double boiler until soft. Stir in peanut butter and add mixture to shredded wheat. Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper. Shape into birds nest and place jelly beans in each one. Chill.

title: Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs 2 at a time beating well after each addition. Add self-rising flour; mix well. Stir in vanilla. Combine pecans walnuts and all-purpose flour in bowl; toss to coat. Fold into batter. Stir in apples. Pour into ungreased tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Cool in pan for several minutes. Invert onto serving plate. Yield 16 servings.

title: Green Beans And New Potatoes
instructions: Place beans pork onion salt sugar and water in Dutch oven. Cover and cook 1 hour. Add potatoes and cook 30 minutes longer or until tender.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Gelatin Mold
instructions: Cook sugar and pineapple 5 minutes. Let cool. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add gelatin to sugar and pineapple and chill. Beat in separate bowls the cream cheese and Dream Whip. When pineapple is cold beat in the cream cheese and the Dream Whip until well mixed. Add nuts. Place in mold and refrigerate.

title: Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Put in baking dish sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour batter into two 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Green Beans And Ground Beef
instructions: Brown onion and garlic lightly in fat. Add beef and cook stirring with fork 3 minutes. Add soy sauce and 3 cups of water. Heat to boiling. Add beans and cook 10 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch blended with a little water. Cook slowly 10 minutes longer stirring often. Serve on hot rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches. Mix all ingredients; spread in pan. Bake until golden brown about 25 minutes. Cut into 2 x 1-inch pieces. Makes 4 dozen appetizers.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except cracker crumbs. Put into buttered casserole and top with Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Tasty!

title: Molly'S Pork Chops
instructions: Mix soup and water and set aside. Place pork chops in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Slice onion and green pepper on top of each chop. Pour tomato soup over the top. Cover with tinfoil vent foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Thyme-Lime Chicken
instructions: In a small saucepan over low heat melt butter in olive oil; add lime juice thyme lime peel garlic salt and pepper. Place chicken on a greased broiler pan. Brush with sauce. Broil basting frequently 6 to 7-inches from the heat for 15 to 20 minutes on each side or until the chicken juices run clear. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Slush
instructions: Fix jello accordingly add remaining ingredients and chill in freezer over night. Enjoy!

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour oil and enough water to mix dough well. Let set and rise about 2 hours or longer. Roll out thin; cut in strips. Break into small pieces about 2-inches or shorter. Cook chicken; add bouillon to taste. Add salt if needed. Cook dumplings in broth; add chicken after they are cooked. Add a little yellow food coloring for color.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix at medium speed for 3 minutes. Stir in next 2 ingredients. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. When cool spread with cream cheese frosting.

title: Piccalilli
instructions: Chop the cabbage tomatoes peppers and onions. Mix with the salt and let stand overnight. Next morning drain and press to remove all liquid possible. Boil vinegar water sugar and spices 5 minutes. Add the chopped vegetable mixture. Bring to a boil and pour into sterilized jars to within 1/2-inch of top. Put on cap. Screw band firmly tight. Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes. Yield 6 pints.

title: Gizzard Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours stirring occasionally or until gizzards are tender. Or use a crock-pot reducing water to 1 cup and cooking on low for 9 hours.

title: Cabbage And Beef Soup
instructions: In Dutch oven brown beef. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 hour. Yield 3 quarts.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Melt butter in large pan and add Worcestershire sauce. Mix cereals and seasonings and add to pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Macaroni Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Spray a 6-cup shallow baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut the Cheddar-flavor cheese and the Mozzarella into 1/4-inch cubes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water enough to dissolve it for a few minutes. In mixing bowl combine oil brown sugar and salt and add milk. Stir until cool. Add egg. Add about 2 1/2 cups flour and mix well. Add flour until dough makes a soft mixture. Turn onto floured surface. Cover with greased foil and let rest 10 minutes; knead about 2 to 3 minutes. Put in greased bowl and cover with foil and cloth. Keep in refrigerator overnight; roll out dough to about 1/2-inch. Cut into squares and dip in melted butter and put in pan in layers. Let rise about 3 hours until double in size. Cook in oven at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Heat 1 stick margarine and pour over when it comes out of oven.

title: Lemon Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 baking dishes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine broth celery and onion; cook until tender. Combine chicken broth mixture mayonnaise lemon juice soup eggs 3/4 cup cracker crumbs salt and pepper. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients and mix well; add to the first mixture and beat 1 minute. Pour into 9-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Macaroni Pizza
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Add tomato soup and cook 15 minutes until thickened. Stir frequently. Cook macaroni until tender. Add egg and milk to the macaroni. Spread macaroni mixture in greased jelly roll or cookie pan. Spread tomato beef mixture on top of macaroni. Place thin slices of cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Piggy Wraps
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate rolls into 8 triangles; cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds. Flatten a little or cut corn twists strips into 48 pieces to fit the sausages. Flatten a little. Bake until brown.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. Lastly add zucchini raisins and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Golden Lamb'S Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Grind ham and pork together and saute until brown. Add flour milk and dry mustard and cook until thick. Cook sauerkraut separately. Grind the sauerkraut and meat mixture together. Return to stove and cook until thick. Cool. Shape. Roll in flour. Dip in milk. Roll in cracker or bread crumbs. Fry in deep fat at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Alexandra'S Favorite Drumsticks
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix flour salt paprika and pepper in bowl. Dip drumsticks in margarine. Roll in flour mixture to coat. Arrange in ungreased square pan and bake uncovered until done about 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Bake
instructions: In a large skillet put in a couple of tablespoons olive oil and saute garlic onions tomatoes and green pepper. Saute until pepper is tender and tomatoes are mushy. Set aside. Saute zucchini in some more olive oil. Cook until zucchini is 1/2 done just tender. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix vegetables together with zucchini and put in a large glass or Corning pie or quiche dish. Cover with 2 cups of cheese. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Let cool. Add cottage cheese well drained. Add mayonnaise and salt. Grind or grate vegetables and drain them well. Add to jello and cheese mixture. Let set several hours. Serve on lettuce.

title: Sticky Rolls
instructions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Put frozen roll dough in the bottom of pan. Melt margarine. Add brown sugar and pudding. Stir and pour over frozen rolls. Let rise overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn Bundt pan over onto a large platter and rolls will pop right out. Enjoy!

title: Copper Carrots Glaze
instructions: Heat liquid to boiling. Let stand overnight.

title: Driskill Hotel'S Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute carrots celery and onion in butter. Add flour and cornstarch. Put vegetables in top half of double boiler. Add milk and chicken stock. Heat. Add soda and cheese. Stir until cheese has melted. Add seasonings. Serve hot topped with paprika.

title: Easy Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Gradually add milk and Milnot. Cook on very low heat until thick. Add butter. Pour in baked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Makes 1 pie.

title: Cowboy Cake
instructions: Rub flour shortening sugar and salt to fine crumbs saving 1/2 cup crumbs to sprinkle on top. Add baking powder soda nutmeg cinnamon sour milk and eggs to batter. Mix well. Bake in a square cake pan. Sprinkle crumbs on top before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Tasty Grilled Potatoes
instructions: Mix salad dressing and seasonings in large bowl until well blended. Stir in potatoes and onions to coat. Divide potato mixture evenly among 3 large pieces of heavy-duty foil. Seal each and place on grill approximately 30 to 45 minutes until potatoes are tender. Makes 3 large servings.

title: White Mountain Frosting
instructions: Mix in saucepan and keep covered first 3 minutes then cook to 242\u00b0 on thermometer. Beat 1/3 cup or 3 egg whites until stiff while syrup is cooking. Pour syrup slowly over whites and add 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except margarine together. Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Pour melted margarine over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge
instructions: Cream butter in large bowl at high speed. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Gradually add sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. By hand stir in flour frosting mix and nuts until well-blended.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Add 2 cans mild enchilada sauce and 1 can cream of mushroom soup to hamburger. Spoon a small amount of mixture into a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan. Layer 6 corn tortillas 1/2 mixture Cheddar cheese. Repeat this with shells with remainder of mixture and finish with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Donald'S Honey Chicken
instructions: Season chicken. Bake or fry your chicken. Cover with honey and cook for 5 minutes.

title: Lettuce Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients (not lettuce); mix well. Spread over lettuce.

title: Good Vegetable Salad
instructions: Prepare marinade by stirring together salt oil sugar water vinegar and paprika. Pour marinade over other ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain 1 hour before serving.

title: Friendship Bread
instructions: Do not use metal spoons or bowls for mixing.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together and let stand overnight. Serve with carrots cauliflower bell pepper radishes celery and tiny green onions.

title: Sure-Jell Strawberry Jam
instructions: Mix strawberries and sugar thoroughly; set aside 10 minutes. Stir Sure-Jell with water in pan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy. Pour into plastic containers. Cover. Let stand at room temperature 24 hours. Store in freezer.

title: Creamed Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook slowly about 30 minutes.

title: Royal Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Combine cornstarch cocoa margarine honey and water in a heavy saucepan bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add marshmallow creme and vanilla. Stir until blended. Serve warm over ice cream or as a dip for fresh fruit and cake cubes. Makes 2 cups.

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
instructions: Combine oil vinegar onion salt and pepper in screw-top jar or small bowl. Shake or whip with wire whisk until ingredients are well blended and of a thick and creamy consistency. Use as dressing for fish salads hot or cold vegetables and for marinating meats. Makes 1 cup dressing.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs together and then all other ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees in a 9 x 13 inch pan. Cook for about 35 to 40 minutes. The trick to a good carrot cake is to not overcook. Frost when cool.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large mixing bowl beat at medium speed until blended. Pour batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan set aside. Beat cream cheese until creamy. Gradually add sifted powdered sugar beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Pour cream cheese mixture evenly over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden. Let cool completely in pan or wire rack. Sprinkle with additional powdered sugar.

title: Marshmallow Fudge Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients except marshmallows. Spread on a 10 x 15-inch greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven; cover with marshmallows. Return to oven for 3 minutes or until marshmallows are soft. Cool. Frost with your favorite chocolate frosting.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook well carrots; drain. Mash. Add salt and pepper lots of butter onion green pepper and sharp cheese. Grease casserole dish. Mix all together. Top with 1/2 Pepperidge bread stuffing mix. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: Pour juice into percolator. Put rest of ingredients into the basket of percolator. Perk as if making coffee. Recipe can be halved or doubled.

title: Chicken Relleno(Stuffed Chicken)
instructions: Debone chicken where only skin drumstick and wings are left. Ground chicken meat. Mix chicken meat and all ingredients except boiled chicken and Vienna sausages. Spoon the mixture into the chicken skin. Spread it flat and alternately arrange quartered boiled eggs and Vienna sausage. When done spoon in the other half of the mixture. Close the skin with toothpick. Steam chicken for 3 hours. Serves 20 people.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and drop by tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain off water. Mix in all the ingredients. Put in baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0 then take 1/2 a package Pepperidge Farm dressing and 2 tablespoons margarine melted. Mix together. Pour over top and bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine 1 cup sugar flour cornstarch and salt in double boiler; add boiling water stirring constantly. Cover and cook 15 minutes. Beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup sugar and gradually pour hot mixture over this while stirring. Return to double boiler and cook 5 minutes longer. Just before removing from heat add lemon juice and rind. Mix well. Cool. Pour into pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Juanita'S Cocktail Chicken Balls
instructions: Combine ingredients in order listed except 3/4 cup pecans. Mix well. Shape into small balls and roll in chopped pecans. Keep refrigerated until serving time. These can also be frozen for later use. Try spearing a chicken ball and a pineapple chunk on an hors doeuvre pick.

title: Cream Cheese Peach Pie
instructions: Beat crust ingredients 2 minutes. Pour into 10-inch pie pan.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Stir spices into rice on bottom of casserole. Top with browned pork chops. Add consomme Top chops with sliced onion tomato and bell pepper. Bake covered 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until liquid is absorbed.

title: Pineapple Orange Salad
instructions: Place pineapple in saucepan bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat add gelatin stirring until dissolved. Stir in buttermilk and nuts. Cool. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in dish. Chill.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add all others. Pour into buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm. Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Or Peach Pizza
instructions: Grease a pizza pan. Press the cookie dough in the pan put pecans on top and press them down into the dough. Bake 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes. Cool.

title: Norma'S Breakfast Casserole
instructions: In a well-buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish beginning and ending with cheese layer cheese and chiles. Mix eggs with salt pepper and garlic powder to taste. Pour egg mixture over layered cheese and chiles.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together the ingredients and pour over oleo (melted) in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Squirrel With Rice
instructions: Dice salt pork; saute until brown. Add squirrel pieces; brown lightly. Add water. Simmer until tender. Add rice catsup onion and seasonings. Cook over low heat. Cook until rice is tender.

title: Lemon Chess Pie(A Dessert Of Early Virginia)
instructions: Beat the eggs with a fork or wire whisk and gradually add the sugar. Add the lemon juice and rind; mix well. Slowly add all ingredients until completely blended. Pour into an 8-inch pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown or until a knife inserted into the filling comes out clean.

title: Streusel Coffee Cake
instructions: Stir together the 1 1/2 cups flour granulated sugar baking powder and salt. Combine egg milk and oil. Add to flour mixture; mix well. Stir in raisins. Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine nuts brown sugar 1 Tbsp. flour butter and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter. Bake at 375 for about 25 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Thoroughly cream the shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well. In separate bowl sift together the flour soda and salt. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Pour batter into loaf pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Apricot-Filled Pear Cake
instructions: Drain pears. Save 1/2 cup juice. Blend pears in blender until smooth. In large bowl combine cake mix pureed pears 1/2 cup pear juice and eggs at slow speed until smooth and moistened. Beat 2 minutes on high. Pour batter in a lightly greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Grease a piece of wax paper and fit in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes remove from pan and cool completely. Slice cake in half spread apricot jam over cut half. Replace top cake layer. Spread with topping. Chill well.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Mix in bowl pared and sliced apples cinnamon and sugar. Mix in another bowl flour baking powder salt oil orange juice sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour 1/2 batter in ungreased Bundt pan. Spread 1/2 the apple mixture. Add remaining batter and top with remaining apple slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool 15 minutes before removing.

title: Budapest Tea Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a large Bundt pan and set aside. In a small bowl combine brown sugar cocoa cinnamon raisins and nuts. Set aside. In large mixing bowl cream together margarine and sugar. Add vanilla and eggs mixing to blend. In a separate bowl sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add dry ingredients to the large mixing bowl. Mix well. Add sour cream and mix to blend. By hand fold in brown sugar-nut mixture. Pour batter into prepared Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes until done.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Alternate with flour and milk. Add spices to flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Fillet Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs well and dip chicken in them then dip chicken in bread crumbs. Fry in oil and brown on both sides. Drain on paper towel. Put the chicken in a casserole dish. Dissolve bouillon in a cup of hot water and add reserved mushroom liquid; stir well. Pour over the layered chicken and add the mushrooms. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. At end of baking time remove from oven and add enough slices of cheese to cover chicken. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts.

title: Cocktail Spread
instructions: Mix the ingredients well. Then add mayonnaise Worcestershire sauce and horseradish to taste and spreading consistency. Use any kind of crackers.

title: Chili Corn Muffins
instructions: In mixing bowl combine the flour cornmeal sugar baking powder chili powder and salt. Chop scallion. Beat milk applesauce and egg until just combined and stir in scallion and corn. Stir flour mixture into milk mixture until just combined but still lumpy. Spoon into prepared muffin pans. Bake until edges start to brown. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. They are great with chili and soups.

title: Spider Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt shortening in frypan placed in oven. Beat egg; add 1 cup milk. Stir in cornmeal flour sugar salt and baking powder. Turn into frypan with melted shortening. Pour over remaining milk. Do not stir. Bake 25 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Herman Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil with mixer. Stir Herman soda salt flour baking powder 1 teaspoon cinnamon raisins and 1/2 cup nuts or walnut flavoring together with a spoon. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan or two loaf pans.

title: Baked Brie With Crudites
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons unsalted butter in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; saute until onion is golden brown about 10 minutes. Set aside. Place Brie and cream cheese (cut in large pieces) in a large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on Medium just until melted about 2 minutes. Whisk in onion mixture sour cream fresh lemon juice brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Chicken Paprikas
instructions: In a Dutch oven over low heat cook onions in butter until soft but not brown. Add paprika and rub into onions with wooden spoon. Add chicken meaty side down and stock. Bring to a boil then cover and gently simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Chicken should be very tender and onions mushy. Remove chicken to a platter and debone. Cut larger pieces into serving chunks if you wish. Add 2 tablespoons of cooking liquid to cornstarch and mix well. Add this mixture to liquid in pot. Bring to a boil and stir until thickened. Reduce heat and stir in sour cream heating just to simmer point. Add chicken cover and simmer a few minutes until heated through. Holds well at low heat.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
instructions: Do not use mixer. Pour liquid into crumb mixture and mix with spoon. Pour into greased oblong pan. Place 1 cup crumbs on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peach Tart
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix eggs sugar flour and cream. Pour the mixture over peach slices which have been arranged in the bottom of the pie shell. Dot the top of the tart with butter. Bake for 10 minutes at 425\u00b0; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Meat And Cheese Tartlets
instructions: Mix beef seasoning mix and cold water. Shape in tartlet muffin pans as mini-tartlet shell. Mix sour cream taco sauce olives and chips. Place one teaspoon of filling into each meat shell. Mound slightly. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 425\u00b0. Remove from pan. Serve immediately or freeze and reheat at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 30 tartlets.

title: Wondrous Brownie Pie
instructions: Beat until smooth or blend in blender until smooth. Pour into greased pie plate then pour nuts over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until knife comes out clean.

title: Applesauce Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour cinnamon nutmeg cloves and baking soda. In a large bowl mix margarine sweetener and egg. Mix in dry ingredients alternating with applesauce. Fold in raisins cereal and nuts; mix thoroughly. Drop onto greased cookie sheet by tablespoon. Lightly flatten with a fork dipped in milk. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes. Makes 36 cookies.

title: 14 Day Pickles
instructions: Stir salt in water until salt is dissolved; pour over cucumbers. Let stand for one week; drain well. Add alum; soak 24 hours in the alum water; drain well. Split cucumbers; let them drain. Wash churn; dry it.

title: Spinach Madeline
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions. Drain and reserve liquid. Melt butter or oleo in saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir until well blended but not brown. Add onion and cook until soft and clear. Add liquid slowly stirring constantly until smooth and thick. Continue stirring. Add seasoning and cheese which has been cut into small pieces. Stir until melted. Combine spinach. Pour into casserole and top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Chicken N' Rice
instructions: Spread rice on bottom of small roasting pan. Sprinkle mushrooms and pepper over rice. Lay chicken pieces over this. Dilute mushroom soup and onion soup with water. Pour over chicken. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Apple Glazed Carrots
instructions: Melt butter in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add carrots and saute until carrots begin to brown slightly about 8 minutes. Add apple juice and honey and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender and liquid is reduced to glaze stirring occasionally about 15 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to bowl. Sprinkle with green onion tops and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Mix for one minute in blender.

title: Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Sprinkle ribs with salt pepper and Schilling barbecue spice. Place ribs in broiler pan under broiler for 30 minutes to brown and remove excess fat. Slice ribs into serving pieces and put in crock-pot. Add onion and pour in barbecue sauce. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix together the cake mix oil eggs and lemon extract. Dissolve the jello in the hot water and add to the cake mix; mix well. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes. While hot prick with toothpick and pour on frosting.

title: Rum Duff
instructions: Combine applesauce sugar rum grated orange rind and gingersnaps. Stir until well mixed. Chill. Just before serving fold in whipped cream and pile into sherbet dishes. If desired top with additional cream and nuts.

title: Italian Style Bean Salad
instructions: Rinse and drain green beans chick peas Northern beans and pinto beans. Add onion bell pepper red pepper pimento salt and pepper garlic powder basil and oregano. Heat and stir until dissolved the vinegar sugar and vegetable oil. Mix together. Shake on wine vinegar and olive oil. Garnish with purple onion rings. Enjoy!

title: Double-Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 12 muffin pan cups. In large bowl combine flour corn meal sugar baking powder salt and red pepper. In medium bowl whisk milk butter and egg. Stir into dry ingredients just until combined. Stir in corn. Spoon into prepared pans. Bake 20 minutes. Unmold and serve warm. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in casserole. Cover with chicken. Spread mushroom soup then cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Cajun Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add buttermilk water oleo and egg. Mix well. Stir in onion and peppers. Carefully drop batter by teaspoonful into hot oil. Fry 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown turning once. Yield 2 1/2 dozen.

title: 2 Step Chicken Broccoli Divan
instructions: If using fresh broccoli cut into spears. In a 9-inch pie plate or shallow casserole dish arrange broccoli and top with chicken. Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine butter and bread crumbs; sprinkle over cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes or microwave by covering with wax paper and cooking on High for 6 minutes or until hot rotating dish halfway through heating.

title: Pecan Delight
instructions: To prepare pan line 9 x 13-inch pan with wax paper.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together oil eggs sugar and vanilla in a large bowl. Sift together the flour salt and soda. Add oil mixture and blend well. Add chopped pecans and apples. Stir until well mixed. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour cake mixture into a large tube or Bundt pan and bake for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Mix sugar and Jell-O together. Add boiling water; mix well. Add pineapple and orange juice. Freeze in plastic 1 gallon container or 1 gallon Ziploc bag. When ready to serve add ginger ale.

title: French Ice Coffee
instructions: Mix coffee and sugar together and cool. Add half and half milk and vanilla. Pour into Ziploc bags or milk cartons and freeze. Two hours before serving remove from freezer. Serve with spoons at a slushy consistency.

title: Pinto Beans(German Style)
instructions: Wash beans. Cover beans with plenty of water and bring to boil. Boil 2 minutes set off burner cover beans and let set for 1 hour. Drain off water and rinse beans. Cover with water and cook beans until tender. Add onion and all other ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine meat onion soup mix eggs tomato sauce bread crumbs water and chopped pepper. Shape into loaf and place in baking pan. Bake about 45 minutes or until done. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta to desired state; drain. Dice green pepper and onion; add to pasta. Add cooked and drained sausage. Microwave pepperoni on a few paper towels for 2 to 3 minutes; pat oil off then add to pasta. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Refrigerate until chilled.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with margarine. Add hash brown potatoes (slightly thawed by rinsing with water in colander). Pour 1/4 cup melted butter over potatoes. Sprinkle with onions. Mix together soup sour cream and milk. Pour over potatoes. Top with cheese. Melt 1/4 cup butter in saucepan and mix in bread cubes. Spoon over cheese. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding according to package and cool. Mix pudding and Cool Whip until creamy. Layer graham crackers and pudding mixture keep layering until graham crackers are on top. Top with icing and chill.

title: Crescents
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until creamy. Add 1/2 cup powdered sugar; beat well. Combine flour and salt; gradually add flour mixture to butter mixture beating at low speed just until blended after each addition. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Divide dough into fourths; cover and chill at least 2 hours. Work with 1 portion of dough at a time storing remainder in refrigerator. Divide each portion into 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a 2 1/2 inch log; curve ends of each log to form a crescent. Place crescents 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until very lightly browned. Cool on cookie sheets 1 minute. Carefully roll warm cookies in 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar; cool completely on a wire rack. Roll cooled cookies in remaining 1 cup powdered sugar. Store up to 1 week in an airtight container.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Bake 45 minutes at 425\u00b0 or until golden brown.

title: Crazy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/4 cup stuffing mix on top and dot with 1/2 stick margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes uncovered.

title: Golden Apple Pie
instructions: Peel apples; core and slice thinly to measure 7 cups.

title: Dirt Cake
