instructions: Make pudding. Pour whipped cream (8 ounces) in pudding. Whip mixture. Put cream cheese in mixture. Mix mixture and whip.

title: The Best And Easiest Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients well. Roll into 1-inch balls and place on slightly greased cookie sheet. Press each ball with fork. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or just until cookies start to turn brown.

title: Peanut Butter Crisscrosses
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Thoroughly cream shortening sugars and vanilla. Add\teggs and beat well. Stir in peanut butter. Sift dry ingredients and stir into creamed mixture. Form\tinto tiny balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with back of fork to make crisscross. Dough may also be rolled and cut if desired. Bake 10 minutes.\tMakes 8 dozen.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli spears on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Lay chicken pieces on top. Mix mayonnaise lemon juice and soup together. Pour over chicken. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. May also top with potato chip crumbs or buttered bread crumbs.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: Pound chicken breasts and put in baking dish. Puree apricots in blender and add lemon juice. Pour mixture evenly over chicken. Sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder. Heat Marsala and butter in saucepan until butter is melted. Pour over chicken. Place under broiler approximately 30 minutes until glaze is brown. Serve with rice or rice pilaf and green veggie. Serves 6.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Combine flour and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix just until blended after each addition. Stir in flavorings. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 to 10 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan and let cool completely on a wire rack. Yield one 10-inch cake.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Drain cherries and pineapple thoroughly. Heat juice in saucepan and add jello. Stir until dissolved. Pour into bowl and add Coke. Place in fridge until it begins to jell. Add halved cherries pineapple pecan pieces and cream cheese chunks. Combine and place back in fridge until firm.

title: Graham Cracker Shells
instructions: Grind graham crackers and empty into plastic bowl. Add sugar and melted butter. Mix with both hands until well mixed and all the mixture is moist. Measure out 1 1/3 cups of mixture into each pie pan. Use fork to line side of pan with mixture. Spread remainder of mixture around bottom of pan and press down with bottom of flat glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Warm pie crust in oven about 10 minutes while the oven heats. Shred cheese and place in mixing bowl. Crumble bacon into bits and add to bowl. Whip eggs with fork and add to mixture. Add milk chives salt and pepper to cheese mixture. Stir to mix thoroughly. Pour into crust. Sprinkle surface with nutmeg. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before serving. Makes one (9-inch) pie.

title: Pork Chop And Rice Casserole (Or Chicken)
instructions: Dredge meat in flour. Cook in a little shortening until brown. Put in 2-quart or larger baking dish. Brown pepper celery and onion. Put in dish with meat. Add rice on top then tomatoes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until tender about 45 minutes. Might have to add 1/2 cup water when gets dry.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: In large bowl mix oil eggs and sugar. In separate bowl sift dry ingredients. Add to mixture. Stir in apples and nuts. Spread into well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Distribute chips onto top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. For best results bake at least 2 to 3 days before serving.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix (except onion and bacon) and put in baking casserole. Slice onion and put on top. Put chopped bacon on top. Bake for 1 hour at 400\u00b0 to cook bacon and onion. Reduce heat to 275\u00b0 and bake covered for 2 to 3 hours more.

title: Blend Of The Bayou
instructions: Melt cream cheese and butter. Saute shrimp onion pepper and celery in 2 tablespoons butter and add to first mixture. Add soup mushrooms seasonings crab meat and rice. Mix well. Place in a 2-quart casserole dish and top with grated cheese and cracker crumbs. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly. Serves 8 and leftovers freeze well.

title: Cider Stew
instructions: To cut roast into 1-inch cubes first trim excess fat from roast. Cut roast into 1-inch slices. Cut each slice in half lengthwise then cut into 1-inch pieces.

title: Golden Coconut Balls
instructions: Spread coconut in a large shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes until golden brown. Turn into a small pie pan. Cool.

title: Parmesan Baked Tomatoes
instructions: Cube tomatoes into bite size pieces. Spread tomatoes evenly in a casserole dish. Season with salt pepper and garlic salt. Sprinkle bread crumbs over tomatoes. Sprinkle cheese next. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Oreo Ice Cream
instructions: Coarsely crush Oreo cookies to equal one cup. In a large bowl beat egg yolks stir in condensed milk and vanilla. Fold in cookies and whipping cream. Pour into an aluminum foil lined 9 x 5 inch loaf pan or other 2 quart container. Cover freeze 6 hours or until firm. Scoop ice cream from pan or peel off foil and slice. Store in freezer.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Crush garlic with salt in small bowl. Add crumbled cheese mayonnaise lemon juice Worcestershire sauce mustard paprika and pepper; stir until ingredients are well blended and dressing is smooth and creamy. Chill. Refrigerate in tightly covered container. Makes 1 1/2 cups dressing.

title: Oven-Fried Catfish
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl stirring well; set aside. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice and hot sauce stirring well. Brush mayonnaise mixture evenly over both sides of fillets; dredge in cereal mixture. Place fillets in 9 x 13-inch glass cooking pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 18 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve with lemon wedges. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sour Cream Pumpkin Coffeecake
instructions: Cream butter 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl. Add 3 eggs beating well. Combine flour baking powder and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture alternately with sour cream. Combine pumpkin beaten egg 1/3 cup sugar and pie spice. Spoon half of batter into 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spread to corners. Sprinkle half of Streusel over batter. Spread pumpkin mixture over Streusel. Carefully spread remaining batter over pumpkin mixture. Sprinkle remaining Streusel over top. Bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onion and garlic in butter in a large saucepan. Add flour and seasonings and blend. Gradually add stock and cook until thickened. Stir in turkey mushrooms and cheese. Fold in cooked spaghetti noodles. Turn into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish; top with crumbs and bake 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Rice And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix chicken soup and milk; reserve half of the mixture. Mix remaining soup rice and 1/4 of the onion soup mix. Pour into ungreased baking dish. Place chicken breasts on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken breasts. Sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Favorite Peach Pie
instructions: Peel and halve peaches. Lay face down in unbaked pie shell. Mix coffee cream sugar cinnamon and flour together. Pour over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Cinnamon Christmas Ornaments
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Will be a dense dough. Knead well and roll out to 1/8-inch dough. Cut with cookie cutters. Use a straw to cut out hole for ribbon. Lay on a flat surface to dry for up to 7 days flipping to allow for even drying. Decorate with acrylic paints and glitter. String ribbon through straw hole.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook spinach and drain well. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix ingredients in any order. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let stand for 45 minutes. Cut into squares. Makes a \hit\ served cold at receptions. Serves approximately 35.

title: Cal'S Delicious Chili
instructions: Fry meats celery garlic and onion. Add other ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for 1 hour stirring occasionally.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In saucepan melt margarine; stir in flour and gradually add milk and some of the cheese to make cheese sauce. May need to use more flour before milk is added or more milk. Put cooked macaroni in baking dish; stir in cheese sauce mixture. Add more cheese to taste.

title: Famous Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve yeast in milk or water. Add sugar salt margarine and flour. Mix all ingredients with a wooden spoon. Cover and let rise in warm place for 30 minutes. Form pretzels; brush with slightly beaten egg or a little egg white with a few drops of water. Sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix ground beef eggs evaporated milk bread crumbs onion salt and pepper together well. Form balls. Brown meat balls in small amount of oil. Mix together hot water bouillon cubes mushroom soup and chicken soup and pour over browned meat balls. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Cheese Dish(Great! Xxx)
instructions: Grate 10 ounces sharp Cheddar cheese into a 9 x 13-inch buttered Pyrex dish. Sprinkle 5 tablespoons of finely chopped jalapeno peppers on top. Grate 8 to 10 ounces Monterey Jack cheese on top of peppers. Press down. Pour 6 to 7 beaten eggs onto cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until set and golden. Cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crust Melt butter or margarine. Mix with pretzels and 3 tablespoons sugar. Pat into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie
instructions: Place pie crust into pyrex pie plate and cook as directed on package. Cool. Mix instant chocolate pudding as directed using 1 cup less milk for each box. When well blended pour into cooled pie shell. When pie filling is set spread Cool Whip on top of filling shave Hershey bar into curls. Sprinkle chocolate curls on top of Cool Whip topping--then sprinkle walnuts on top also.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Simmer ingredients for 5 minutes. Pour over chicken pieces and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Trim meat. Cut in strips 1 1/2 x 1-inch. Coat with flour. Melt butter in heavy skillet. Brown meat on all sides. Add onion and garlic. Dissolve bouillon cube in water. Add to meat. Add liquid from mushrooms Worcestershire sauce and catsup. Cover. Simmer until meat is tender and sauce is thick (about 1 1/2 hours). Add mushrooms. Just before serving combine vinegar with evaporated milk and stir in. Heat but do not boil. Serve over hot rice or noodles. Top with chopped parsley.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Combine ingredients and put into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Pour cherry filling in bottom of casserole dish. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Pour melted butter next. Top with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: World'S Best Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugars add egg and mix well. Add remaining ingredients one at a time except pecans. Mix until combined; stir in pecans. Form into balls the size of walnuts; place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown; do not overcook. Allow to cool a few minutes before removing from pan. Yield 6 dozen.

title: Cranberry Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add cold water and ice cubes. Cool until partially set. Stir in all remaining ingredients and pour into molds; chill until set. Makes 2 large jello molds.

title: Old Fashioned Egg Custard
instructions: Mix all in top of double boiler. Cook until thick and pour into a baked pie shell.

title: Mexican Cheese Crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Place crackers in large shallow baking pan. In a small bowl combine butter taco seasoning mix Worcestershire and salt. Pour butter mixture over crackers; stir well. Bake for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Pour onto waxed paper to cool. Store in airtight container. Yields 6 cups snack mix.

title: Peanut Butter Parfait
instructions: Mix Oreo cookies and margarine. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread ice cream on top of cookies. Sprinkle on peanuts and freeze for several hours. Melt chips and stir in sugar margarine and evaporated milk. Bring to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes. Cool completely. Spread cooled fudge on peanuts and freeze.

title: Blender Banana Bread
instructions: Put egg butter bananas sugar and granola into blender. Whirl on low until smooth. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add blender mixture and stir until moistened. Turn into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Yields one loaf.

title: Colwell'S Special Squash
instructions: Cover squash and onion with water and butter and bring to boil. Cook approximately 5 minutes until tender. Drain. Melt Velveeta cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour over squash. Makes 4 servings.

title: Best Ever Deer And Gravy
instructions: Flour deer after salting and peppering. Fry in oil to brown. Meanwhile place a large skillet or pot on another burner. Depending on amount you cook put water in pot. For one package of deer to feed 4 use about 2 cups of water. When meat is browned drop directly into water that is simmering. Do not drain on paper. Continue until all meat is browned. Cook onions in oil until tender. Drain off most of oil. Brown small amount of flour and brown. Add all this to water. Add soup. Simmer adding water if necessary.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix together. Pour into a greased floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Spread icing on hot cake.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Put all ingredients in large bowl; mix well. Shape into small balls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mother In Law Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl stir together dry ingredients. Make well in center; drain pineapple pressing out liquid. Reserve 1/3 cup syrup. Add remaining ingredients.\tBeat with wooden spoon. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan greased. Sprinkle with walnuts and brown sugar. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve cold. Keep refrigerated.

title: Punch
instructions: Add water as directed on lemonade. Mix together and serve.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix oil dill weed and garlic. Pour over oyster crackers; stir to coat. Place in warm oven 15 to 20 minutes. Store in tight container.

title: Crispy Crunchy Brittle
instructions: Place walnuts in 9-inch glass pie plate. Microwave at High 5 minutes stirring halfway through until toasted; set aside. In 2-quart glass measuring cup with handle combine sugar corn syrup water butter and salt. Microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes stirring well at least once until sugar dissolves. Microwave at High 4 1/2 to 7 minutes stirring once after 2 minutes until mixture reaches 300\u00b0. Stir in baking soda; add toasted walnuts. Turn at once into buttered 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Spread thin. Let stand until cooled. Break into pieces. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Best Ever Cookies
instructions: Cream together the sugars and margarine. Combine with remaining ingredients and mix well. Roll in balls the size of a small walnut. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Press with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar. Sprinkle sugar generously on top of each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes. Makes 100 cookies.

title: Green Pepper Pineapple Salad
instructions: Soak gelatin in the pineapple juice and dissolve over hot water. Add to pineapple and cream cheese mixture. Fill green peppers and set in refrigerator to harden. With a very sharp knife cut the stuffed peppers crosswise into thin slices. Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise.

title: Chocolate Chip Kiss Cookies
instructions: Remove foil from Kisses. In a large bowl combine butter sugars and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour; blend until smooth. Stir in chips. Mold scant tablespoon of dough around each Kiss covering completely. Shape into ball and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set. Cool. Remove from cookie sheet. Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies. Drizzle topping over each cookie (optional).

title: Hobo Bread
instructions: Mix; put in loaf pan. Bake for about 40 minutes at 300\u00b0. Serve warm.

title: Chocolate Chip Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugar. Add salt vanilla and flour. Mix until blended. Mixture will be stiff. Stir in chocolate chips. Roll into balls (3/4 inch) and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 12 to 13 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Creamy Honey Butter
instructions: Beat butter until creamy and light. Add honey and orange extract and beat until fluffy. Taste at this point. If you like it sweeter add a little more honey. Refrigerate.

title: Mayonnaise Biscuits
instructions: Mix all together. Do not overmix. Drop in greased muffin tins. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown approximately 20 minutes. An especially good recipe for weight watchers.

title: Thanksgiving Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in one cup hot water and pineapple juice. Melt cranberry sauce in saucepan on low heat until smooth and mushy. Mix with all other ingredients and chill until thickened and then add diced apple. Spoon into 8-inch square dish sprayed with Pam or salad oil for easy removal. Chill until firm. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce with mayonnaise or Cool Whip. Serves 8.

title: Black Bean Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mash beans; stir in tomatoes onion peppers salsa chili powder and cumin. In a small bowl mix ricotta cheese garlic powder and egg. Spread 1 cup tomato mixture over bottom of dish. Top with 1/2 of noodles overlapping a bit. Top with half of the remaining tomato mixture. Spoon ricotta cheese mixture over top and spread. Top with 1/2 of shredded cheese. Top with remaining noodles. Top with remaining tomato mixture. Sprinkle remaining shredded cheese on top. Cover with spray-coated foil. Bake about 45 minutes. Let stand about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Banana Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter together. Add remaining ingredients. Mix together thoroughly. Add egg whites which are beaten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients and form in balls; put in Pyrex pan close together.

title: Lemon Jello Salad
instructions: In blender mix Jell-O and water. Add juice vinegar and milk. Add cream cheese one piece at a time. Add carrots and pineapple. Pour in 2-quart mold and chill.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Melt oleo add brown sugar and pretzels. Spread in a 13 x 9 inch pan. Bake in 350 degree oven until bubbly (3-5 minutes). Combine cream cheese and white sugar beat smooth. Add in 1/2 cool whip mix. Spread over cooled pretzels. Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 c. boiling water add strawberries. Mix well cool. Pour over cream cheese layer and chill. Top with remaining cool whip.

title: White Monkey
instructions: Melt margarine over low heat; stir in flour and cook for one minute. Slowly add milk; cook until thick stirring constantly. Add cheese and stir until melted. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve over toast.

title: Flank Steak Fix-Up
instructions: Rub steak with garlic; sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Cut meat crosswise into 4 to 6 serving pieces. In large skillet cook bacon. Drain bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet. Place slice of bacon on each piece of meat roll up and secure with wooden picks. Coat rolls with flour. Brown rolls in the reserved bacon drippings over medium heat.

title: Party Salad
instructions: Combine Cool Whip and milk in a large bowl. Refrigerate one hour. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Then refrigerate overnight.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Keep in refrigerator. You can also freeze it. I usually do this. I divide it into 8 x 8-inch glass dishes.

title: Diabetic Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix pulp sweetener and egg. Add dry ingredients and a little of the milk. Blend well. Add rest of milk and butter. Bake 55 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Chop chocolate coarsely. Combine with oleo or butter and boiling water in a large saucepan. Heat over low heat stirring constantly until chocolate is melted. Add sugar and corn syrup. Heat slowly to boiling lower heat and simmer gently 8 minutes. Watch carefully but do not stir. Test for thickness on ice cube. Add vanilla. Refrigerate leftover sauce in screw top jar. Reheat in warm water (in jar) until soft enough to pour. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: In a skillet over medium-high heat cook the beef until browned stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup water Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Heat through stirring occasionally. Serve on buns. Makes 6 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a large pot. Boil it on the stove until the mixture becomes thick and the egg yolks have evaporated and there is no lumps. Let this mixture cool for approximately 30 minutes. Put mixture into a ice cream maker until it freezes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and then drain. Pour ground beef in pan (8 x 10-inch). Stir tomato soup in with the ground beef. Pour green beans (drained) and then mashed potatoes until it covers the ground beef. Pour shredded cheese over it. Heat oven to 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Old Fashioned Spice Cake
instructions: Mix baking soda cinnamon nutmeg cloves and olive spice in small bowl; set aside. Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl; pour in baking dish. Sprinkle cinnamon baking soda nutmeg cloves and olive spice over top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
instructions: Peel and mash avocado in bowl with lemon juice and salt. Combine sour cream and mayonnaise with taco seasoning in another bowl. (I use 1/2 of the package of taco seasoning in the sour cream mixture and 1/2 in the refried beans.)

title: Zucchini Cake Squares
instructions: Blend together. Cut like pie dough. Press 1/2 on bottom of lightly greased pan (cookie sheet). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes (on bottom rack).

title: Polish Noodles And Cabbage
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet. Add onion and saute until soft. Add cabbage to skillet. Cook for 5 minutes. Stir in caraway seed salt and pepper.

title: Zesty Grilled Pork Chops
instructions: Combine the first five ingredients. Place chops in a glass baking dish and pour marinade over. Cover and refrigerate 3 to 6 hours or overnight. To cook remove chops from marinade and grill or broil 4-inches from the heat to desired doneness. Brush occasionally with the marinade. Serves 6.

title: Cinnamon Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine flour sugar cinnamon and baking soda. Using pastry blender or fork cut in shortening until mixture resembles course crumbs; stir in raisins. Stirring with fork add buttermilk until mixture leaves sides of bowl and soft dough forms. Turn dough onto floured surface and knead lightly until no longer sticky. Roll out 1/2 inch thick and cut with floured 2 1/2 inch cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet with sides touching. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool 5 minutes on wire rack and frost. Serve immediately.

title: Savory Italian Rice Bake
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni mix as package directs. Remove sausage from casing and crumble. In 12-inch skillet brown sausage and onion; drain reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet. Set aside. Add zucchini and garlic; saute over medium-high heat 1 minute. Cover continue cooking over low heat about 2 minutes or until crisp-tender. Combine prepared Rice-A-Roni sausage mixture 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce and basil; spread into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Heat 2 cups of water to boiling pour over jello in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix in cherry pie filling and the crushed pineapple. Let this mixture jell.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pick meat from chicken (no skin). Mix all ingredients then tear up the bread like for dressing. Stir all together. Add enough broth to make all real moist a cup or more if needed. Pour in large casserole dish or pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Vegetable Stew
instructions: Add meat onion celery and salt to 6 to 7 quarts boiling water. Boil on medium about one hour. Add potatoes carrots bouillon and hot pepper to taste. When beef is well done add tomatoes. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Tossed Fruit Salad
instructions: To make dressing combine sugar vinegar and water in saucepan. Heat and stir just until sugar dissolves. Cool. Stir in celery salt paprika and mustard. Add oil in slow stream beating with electric mixer until thick. Cover and chill. Peel and section orange and grapefruit reserving juices. Peel and slice banana. Brush with reserved citrus juices. Set aside. In large salad bowl combine lettuce and escarole. Arrange orange grapefruit banana avocado and grapes in circle atop lettuce. Pour on chilled dressing. Toss to coat fruit and vegetables. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer the first 5 ingredients. Sprinkle with sugar cheese salt and garlic powder. Just before serving add bacon or bacon bits. Cover with plastic wrap. Can be made the day before needed.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients and serve.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Shred cabbage (food processor or hand grater) and put into pot with 2 quarts water or broth. Add the remaining ingredients after the cabbage shrinks down enough to make room for the rest. Boil on medium-low for a few hours. Yum!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet; add broccoli and onion. Cook until broccoli is thawed. Cut cheese into 1 square. Mix cheese soup milk and rice in large bowl. Add broccoli. Mix and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and rice is done.

title: Fey Family Fruit Cups
instructions: Choose from the fruits selecting a total of 6 to 7 cups of fruit. Mix fruits sugar lightly and coconut. Chill covered. Just before serving pour liquor or juice over fruit for extra pick up. Serve in a beautiful bowl. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Fry meat and drain. Add crunched chips and Tabasco; mix together. Mix other ingredients in bowl; let meat cool and mix with salad.

title: Molasses Pecan Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar egg and molasses until mixture is smooth. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; mix well. Stir in chopped pecans.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Cover the cabbage with 1-quart boiling water. Add the salt; boil 5 minutes drain dry. In the melted oleo add flour and stir well. Add milk and cook until thickens a little. Put cabbage in baking dish. Add cheese to sauce and stir until melted. Pour over the cabbage and cover with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Almond Joy Cake
instructions: Mix chocolate cake mix as directed on box. Bake in two 13 x 9-inch pans for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. While cake is baking mix in large bowl 1 cup Pet milk and 1 cup sugar. Bring to rapid boil and remove from heat. Add marshmallows; stir until melted. Add coconut. Pour over hot cakes; cover completely. In a saucepan heat to a rapid boil 1 1/2 cups sugar 1/2 cup Pet milk and margarine. Remove from heat; add chocolate chips and stir until melted. Pour over cakes to completely cover. Sprinkle with toasted coconut if desired.

title: Noodles And Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage and onion together until cabbage is almost done. Cook noodles; drain. Mix noodles with cabbage onion and sour cream. Mix half of the cheese into mixture. Put in baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and then with bread crumbs. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken-N-Yogurt
instructions: Dip chicken breasts in yogurt. Roll in mixture of bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Place in baking dish. Place tinfoil lightly over dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Soak sliced cucumbers in lime water for 24 hours stirring often. Rinse in cold water until cucumbers are lime free. Water will be clear. Combine cucumbers and onions in salted water. Let stand for 3 hours and then drain. In a large kettle combine vinegar and remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Add vegetables and heat to simmering. Avoid boiling the vegetables for this will make them soft. Pack while hot in sterilized jars and seal. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Oven-Baked French Toast
instructions: Spray 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Cut bread into 1-inch-thick slices; arrange closely in single layer in prepared pan. In large bowl beat eggs whisk in milk 3 Tbsp. of sugar vanilla and salt; pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or over night. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle bread with cinnamon if desired. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven; sprinkle with powdered sugar. Slice strawberries place in bowl. Add lemon zest juice and remaining 1 Tbsp. sugar mix lightly. Serve over warm French toast. Yields 8 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni
instructions: Spray pot with Pam. Combine all ingredients. Stir once. Cook on low 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar and vanilla in small mixer bowl until blended. Add cocoa alternately with milk beating until smooth. Fold in topping until combined. Spoon into pie shell and chill until firm or freeze.

title: Pudding Mix
instructions: Store dry ingredients in airtight container. For pudding combine 1 cup mix with milk in pan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Stir in butter and vanilla. Yields 9 batches (4 servings per batch).

title: Pasta With Vegetables And Goat Cheese
instructions: Combine broth wine shallots and black pepper in large saucepan. Bring to a boil add broccoli breaking florets apart. Add squash and mushrooms reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add cream cheese goat cheese and lemon juice cook on low heat stirring constantly until cheeses are melted. Set aside keeping warm. Cook pasta according to package directions drain. Place in large serving bowl add vegetable/cheese mixture toss gently. Garnish with red pepper strips. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Coq Au Vin
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and garlic. Dredge chicken in flour. Reserve remaining flour. Saute chicken in 3 tablespoons of butter to brown. Transfer to a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Combine dry ingredients and add to butter mixture; mix well. Add eggs bananas and pecans. Add 1 tablespoon vanilla (optional). Grease a loaf pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 then 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Margaritas
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large pitcher. Fill pitcher with ice and water. Serve immediately in salt-rimmed glasses.

title: Dillicious Pot Roast
instructions: In heavy saucepan cook bacon until crisp. Drain off all but 2 tablespoons bacon drippings from pan. Crumble bacon; set aside. Sprinkle both sides of beef with lemon pepper marinade. Brown beef in bacon drippings. Combine mushroom soup dill pickle and Worcestershire sauce; pour over browned meat. Cover; simmer for about 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove to warm platter. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Skim fat from gravy; serve with roast.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots in small amount of water for 8 to 10 minutes until tender. Drain well. Combine onions green pepper and carrots in large bowl. Mix well. Mix remaining ingredients in second bowl. Pour over carrot mixture. Marinate 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Popcorn Surprise Squares
instructions: Melt oleo and marshmallows; add gumdrops popcorn M&Ms and nutmeats. Press into a 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Cut into squares.

title: Easy Brunch Casserole
instructions: Place croutons in greased 9 x 13-inch metal pan. Put grated cheese over croutons. Brown sausage and place on top of cheese. Beat eggs and mix with soup mustard milk and mushrooms. Pour over sausage. Bake covered with foil in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. This recipe may be prepared the night before and refrigerated. Serves 10.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
instructions: Season pork chops and brown. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and mix well. Slowly add milk. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Alternately place potatoes onions pork chops and cream sauce in greased casserole. Cover. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover last 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Michigan White Chili
instructions: *Bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cut into bite size pieces.

title: Green Pea Salad
instructions: Gently add all ingredients to peas. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Maple Nut Chiffon Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Sift the first 5 ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Make a well; add Wesson oil egg yolks water and maple flavoring. Beat until smooth with spoon or mixer on medium speed. Add cream of tartar to egg whites in large mixing bowl. Beat until whites are very stiff then pour egg yolk mixture gradually over beaten egg whites gently folding with rubber scraper just until blended. Pour into ungreased 10 x 14-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Turn pan upside down on bottle until cold.

title: Quick Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt butter and peanut butter. Add vanilla. Stir in powdered sugar. Place in pan; let cool.

title: Cioppino
instructions: About 45 minutes before serving in 8-quart Dutch oven or saucepot over medium heat in hot olive or salad oil cook onion green pepper and garlic until tender about 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes and their liquid wine parsley salt basil pepper and bay leaf. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix salad dressing and ginger together. Add to other ingredients. Serve on lettuce with muffins. Its delicious.

title: Savory Pot Roast
instructions: In a 6-quart saucepan in hot oil brown roast on all sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in mushroom soup onion soup mix and 1 cup water. Reduce heat to low; cover and cook for 2 hours. Add vegetables. Cover; cook for 45 minutes or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender. Remove roast and vegetables. Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth. Gradually stir into soup mixture. Cook until mixture boils and thickens stirring constantly. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Mix confectioners sugar and granulated sugar together. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugars together. Gradually add the rice and unbleached flour. Mix with hands until smooth; do not overmix. Press into baking pan or shortbread mold. Bake for 45 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Polish Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix crumbs with 1/2 cup sugar cinnamon and melted butter. Reserve 3/4 cup of mixture for topping. Press remainder into a 9-inch spring-form pan or a 9 x 13-inch cake pan lining bottom and sides.

title: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers onions and peppers very thin. Salt overnight covered with water. Drain then cook with remaining ingredients. Let stand in hot vinegar for a few hours then reheat and can.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients. Add peanut butter (the kind with oil on top). Mix again. Add M&Ms and chocolate chips mix well; then add uncooked oatmeal. Drop by teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 on greased cookie sheet.

title: Pastitso-Greek Lasagna
instructions: Boil macaroni according to package directions. Melt 3/4 stick of butter until slightly burned. Put in macaroni; mix with some Romano cheese.

title: Lynn'S Meatballs
instructions: Simmer for about (or at least) 1 hour. Making 1 day before is better.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Wash peppers; remove tops. Finely grind peppers and onions; drain. In large saucepan combine peppers and onions; cover with boiling water. Let stand 5 minutes; drain. To pepper mixture add sugar vinegar salt dill seed and 1/2 cup water. Boil gently uncovered 5 minutes. Pack into hot half pint jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes. (Start timing when water returns to boiling.) Makes 10 half pints.

title: All-In-One Muffin
instructions: Beat brown sugar oil or applesauce egg milk and banana until well blended. Stir in flour baking powder and salt all at once. Fold in cereal dates and nuts. Spoon batter into paper-lined 4-inch muffin tins until 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serve warm or cold.

title: Holiday Dessert
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water turn heat to simmer add marshmallows and dissolve. Add drained pineapple. Cool. Whip milk and cream cheese in large bowl add cold jello mixture. mix well. Pour into greased mold and refrigerate. Top with whipped cream in mold pattern if desired.

title: Bev'S Cocoa
instructions: Mix together cocoa and sugar. Add dash of salt and the water. Bring to boil. Stir in milk and vanilla. Remove from heat. Serves 8.

title: Cinnamon Chews
instructions: Combine all ingredients but cereal and melt in top of double boiler. Add cereal mixing quickly. Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan. Chill; cut in 1/2-inch squares. Dust with powdered sugar. Wrap individually in waxed paper.

title: French Onion Dip
instructions: Mix well. Cover. Chill.

title: Western Hash
instructions: Brown onions bell pepper and beef in large skillet. Add tomatoes basil rice salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Pour into casserole dish and cover with slices of American cheese. Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain. Combine all ingredients. Mix together and cook on low until cheese is thoroughly melted.

title: Ballistic Bubbles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy blowing billions of bubbles.

title: Lemon Berry Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in medium bowl using wire whisk until smooth. Stir in lemon peel and juice. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the whipped topping. Spread evenly in bottom of crust. Press strawberry halves into cream cheese layer reserving several for garnish if desired.

title: Green Bean And Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix vegetable/seasoning packet from Stove top Dressing with hot water and margarine in large bowl until margarine is melted. Stir in stuffing crumbs just till moistened. Let stand 5 minutes. Mix turkey and green beans in 2 qt. casserole dish. Mix soup and milk in another bowl until smooth; pour over turkey mixture. Spoon stuffing evenly over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 servings. Easy and delicious!

title: Spiced Peaches
instructions: Combine the vinegar the juice from the peaches sugar cinnamon and cloves. Boil until reduced by about half. Remove the spices. Stick the cloves into the peach halves and pour the syrup over peaches. Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Red Velvet Frosting
instructions: Cook water and cornstarch (stirring constantly until thick). Remove from heat and let stand until cold. Add sugar vanilla and margarine. Beat with electric mixer until smooth. Spread on cool cake.

title: Champignons Bordelaise Mushrooms With A Bordelaise Garnish
instructions: Rinse the mushrooms in cold water and drain well. If the mushrooms are large slice them or cut them in half. In a heavy skillet heat the\toil. When the oil is hot add the mushrooms and salt and pepper to taste. Cook over high heat shaking the skillet and stirring so that the mushrooms cook evenly until they are quite brown and crisp. They should be almost mahogany colored. Pour the mushrooms and cooking oil into strainer or sieve to drain. To skillet add the butter. When melted\tadd mushrooms.\tSprinkle quickly with bread crumbs shallots and parsley. Toss and serve. Serves 4.

title: Toffee Refrigerator Dessert
instructions: Mix crackers and margarine. Press 2/3 cup of cracker mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare pudding with 2 cups milk; add softened ice cream and blend until smooth. Pour over crust. Put in the freezer until set. Remove and spread Cool Whip on the top. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top and crushed Butterfinger bars.

title: Tuna Crunch Casserole
instructions: In 1-quart casserole blend soup and milk. Stir in tuna egg and peas. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with potato chips etc. and bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 3 to 5 servings.

title: Picnic Cake(Very Rich)
instructions: Mix dates in hot water. Set aside. Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs; beat until fluffy. Sift flour salt and soda. Add alternately with date mixture to egg mixture. Mix well each time. Stir in vanilla and 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with remaining chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Sunrise Cherry Pie
instructions: Drain pineapple well reserving two tablespoons syrup. Combine softened cream cheese vanilla and reserved syrup mixing until well blended. Stir in 1/4 cup pineapple and 1/2 cup pie filling. Gradually add sugar to cream beating until soft peaks form. Fold into creamed cheese mixture. Pour into crust. Top with remaining pineapple and pie filling. Chill until firm.

title: Peanutty Chewy Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl stir together flour sugar cocoa brown sugar baking soda and salt. Cut in margarine until crumbly; add eggs. Mix well. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 8 minutes. Remove from oven. Top evenly with chips then sweetened condensed milk and coconut. Return to oven; bake 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove from oven. Let cool. Cut into bars.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Let chicken pieces or steak marinate in this mixture for 6 to 8 hours. Excellent on the grill.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine milk sugar eggs butter and vanilla in electric blender or mixer. Pour into 9-inch pie crust. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cream cheese and margarine. Add chicken salt pepper milk chives and pimento. Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles; seal perforations. Spoon 1/2 cup mixture onto center of each rectangle. Pull 4 corners of dough up to center of mixture and seal. Brush tops with melted margarine; dip in crushed croutons. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pork In A Crock-Pot
instructions: Place in crock-pot. Add dash of seasonings. Pour mixed soup and water over chops. Cover; let cook all day on low.

title: Tuna 'N Noodle Casserole
instructions: Boil noodles according to package directions. Drain. Add drained tuna soup a little butter and some milk. Peas may be added if desired. Mix well. Bake in greased casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening.\tBeat in eggs. Dissolve soda in\tsour milk; add alternately with the flour and baking powder that has been sifted together. Stir in vanilla nuts and\tmashed bananas. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 10 to 15 minutes. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Fresh Apple Bread
instructions: Sift flour soda salt cream 1 cup sugar and shortening. Add eggs; mix well. Add apples milk and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Moist Chewy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Note Buttermilk can be replaced with 1/2 cup whole milk mixed with 1 tablespoon vinegar.

title: Super Nacho Casserole
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and put into baking dish. Add the remaining ingredients in the order given. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Parker House Rolls
instructions: Combine the milk shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add yeast which has been dissolved in lukewarm water; add about 2/3 of the flour and beat thoroughly. Let rise until double; add remaining flour. Knead well. Let rise again until double. Roll dough 1/4 inch thick. Cut with a 3-inch biscuit cutter. Brush rounds with melted butter. Grease thoroughly center with dull edge of knife. Fold double pinch edges together and place on well-greased pan one inch apart. Allow to rise until double in size. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake in hot oven (425\u00b0) for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 30 rolls.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Soak the beans overnight; drain. Add the water. Add the cloves bay leaf garlic celery carrot and onion. Cook slowly for 3 hours. Mash beans. Add the beef broth. Combine the flour and melted butter; add to soup. Add the sherry wine to taste. Adjust seasoning. Serve with slice of lemon.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix dry cake mix eggs and oil. Add raisins nuts or coconut. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix beaten eggs sugar and syrup. Add melted butter vanilla and chopped pecans. Pour into uncooked pie crust. Bake for 20 to 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs and 1 stick melted margarine. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan. In mixing bowl cream eggs 2 sticks margarine (melted) powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat with mixer 15 minutes no less. Spread over crumbs. Slice bananas thin and layer pineapple. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans and cherries. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hot Fudge For Cake
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate chips together. Add powdered sugar. Pour a little milk at a time. Heat on stove. Will not get real thick until after it cools.

title: Southwestern Skillet Supper
instructions: Heat oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add beef and onion and cook until brown. Stir in chili powder and salt. Cook 1 minute longer. Add tomatoes beans and corn. Cook over high heat until bubbling. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Prepare potatoes as directed on package. Stir in cheese and cilantro. Top mixture with 1/2 cup of potatoes and enjoy.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Weigh 7 pounds pickles and put them in salt water that will float an egg. Let them stand 3 days then 4th day change to clear water for 3 days changing the water daily. Cut pickles in chunks put them in weak vinegar. Add a teaspoon of alum to every quart of water to cover them and let them stand a day. Make a syrup out of 3 parts water and 3 parts vinegar 1 tablespoon each cinnamon cloves and allspice 1 teaspoon celery seed and 1 tablespoon mustard seed. Put all spices in a thin cloth and boil it in your syrup for a while. Then fill your cans and pour the syrup over them and seal cans.

title: Cabbage And Sausage
instructions: Cut cabbage up like slaw. Set in bowl aside. Saute pan sausage. Drain grease from sausage. Add stewed tomatoes and let simmer for while. Add cabbage a little at a time. Then let all simmer until cabbage is cooked down. May add a cup or two of water if needed.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Spread crushed pretzels on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Melt margarine or butter with 2 tablespoons sugar and pour over pretzels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store tightly covered. To make tea use about 2 teaspoons of mix per 1 cup hot water. This drink is great in cold weather.

title: Peel A Pound Soup
instructions: May want to use tomato juice.

title: Chicken-In-A-Packet
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Cut four 20-inch long pieces of foil. Divide and layer tomatoes onions mushrooms peppers and potatoes on each foil piece. Place chicken breast on top of vegetables. Mix Worcestershire sauce and pepper in a small bowl. Spoon over each breast. Top with 1 teaspoon margarine and 1 teaspoon honey. Seal packets by bringing opposite sides of foil together and fold over several times. Fold over the other two ends of foil tightly. Pierce top of foil twice with knife to vent. Arrange packets on baking sheet. Bake for about 35 minutes. Can be assembled ahead and refrigerated for up to two days. A great do-ahead main dish for a week-end bar-b-que. Can be grilled as well. Place foil side down about 4-6 inches from heat source for about 15 minutes. Serves four.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Makes a sticky dough. Refrigerate one hour or overnight. Use a lot of flour to roll out. Makes four 9-inch pies.

title: Turkey Bacon Club Sandwich
instructions: Cut each roll lengthwise into 2 halves. Spread mayonnaise on 1/2 of each roll. Place 3 slices of cooked turkey bacon over the mayonnaise. Place tomato slices and lettuce over the turkey bacon. Serve open-faced or as a closed sandwich. Enjoy!!

title: Best Ham Sandwiches
instructions: Melt butter. Add rest of ingredients; stir. Brush top and bottom of bun. Stack with ham and cheese. Wrap in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Red Cake
instructions: Mix vinegar and soda and set aside. Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs. Add a little food coloring to cocoa to make a paste. Add to creamed mixture with rest of coloring. Add flour and salt alternating with milk. Add vanilla then vinegar and soda. Beat well. Use 2 (8-inch) round pans (greased and floured). Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cooked split to make 4 layers.

title: Batter Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Melt butter. Mix all ingredients together. Leave in refrigerator for 2 hours. Fill muffin pan 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and let cool. Add strawberries pineapple cranberry sauce and pecans. Put into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan or mold sprayed with cooking spray. Chill until firm.

title: Mexican Taco Salad
instructions: Add salt and pepper to meat. Toss all ingredients together and serve. Leftovers taste good too only not crunchy.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo Crisco and sugar; add eggs and mix. Add buttermilk. Add vanilla baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in flour until mixed well. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Drop mixture by using a tablespoon on a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 13 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies. May ice with lemon frosting.

title: Quick Microwaved Streuseled Apples
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and place in 8-inch glass dish. Then mix last of ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle crumb mixture over top of apples. Microwave on High for 12 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Can serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Just Delicious Cookie
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Shape into balls on cookie sheet. Dip a fork or glass in sugar and flatten each cookie. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 100 cookies.

title: Onion Pork Chops
instructions: Place chops in 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chops. Add 1/4 cup water and bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients and top with dressing.

title: Banana Freeze
instructions: Combine sugar and water. Boil 3 minutes. Cool. Mash bananas. Add to fruit juices and stir in sugar syrup. Pour into containers and freeze. When ready to serve thaw slightly. Pour carbonated beverage over mixture.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Parboil cabbage to loosen leaves. Mix meat rice onion egg salt and pepper. Roll balls in cabbage leaves. Place in pan and pour mixture of soup sauce vinegar and sugar over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Heavenly Hamburger
instructions: Brown meat garlic salt and pepper in margarine. Drain and add tomato sauce and simmer 20 minutes. Cook noodles as directed on package; drain. Soften cream cheese and add to sour cream and onions. Combine meat mixture and noodles (or lasagna) and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 8 or more.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: To make meatballs Combine all ingredients (mixture will be soft). Shape into walnut size meatballs. Place meatballs in a single layer on wax paper lined cookie sheets. Freeze until solid. Store frozen meatballs in freezer bags until ready to cook. Makes approximately 80 meatballs. These are good for something rather quick. Takes approximately 1 hour baking time.

title: Cough Syrup
instructions: Boil all ingredients except honey for about 3 minutes. Strain through cloth to remove all seeds and lemon rind. Mix well with honey. Take one warm tablespoon at a time at 1/2 hour intervals.

title: Goulash
instructions: In a skillet brown beef in the vegetable oil. When browned add the flour and stir until flour starts to brown. Add water and stir. Add the hot sauce Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Stir well. Bring to a boil. Now add the carrots onions peppers and tomatoes if desired. If the sauce seems too thin at this point you can thicken it with a bit of rue which is flour that you have heated in just a slight bit of vegetable oil or you can add just a touch of cornstarch. Once the vegetables have been added bring to a boil once again then cover and simmer until vegetables are tender. The longer it simmers the better it will taste. It is great served over noodles or over rice.

title: Easy Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes with skins on until just firm. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs until lemon colored. Add bread sausage etc. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Uncle Joe Allen'S Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in large bowl. This is a great salad and easy to make.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Meatballs
instructions: Cook onion celery and pepper. Add ketchup sugar and vinegar. Warm then add to meatballs.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Add onion catsup and dressing into blender or food processor. Add softened cream cheese into mixture and blend until mixed. Refrigerate for a few hours.

title: Rosamarina Salad
instructions: In saucepan mix sugar and flour; whip eggs and add to juices. Cook until it thickens. Add the macaroni and all the fruit to 3/4 container Cool Whip. Cool 2 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender (45 minutes to 1 hour). Let cool peel and mash. Add 1/2 cup sugar eggs vanilla milk and 1/2 cup butter to potatoes. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until smooth. Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Banana Pudding
instructions: Beat cream cheese and milk together. Fix pudding by directions. Mix milk mixture to pudding. Make layer of bananas wafers and pudding mixture or put pudding mixture on the bottom of 9 x 10-inch pan. Put bananas and wafers in then to finish put a layer of Cool Whip on top. Cool for 1 hour before serving.

title: Chili Rice
instructions: Saute onion in oil in 2-quart boiler. Add rice salt and chili powder. Pour in broth plus enough water to make 16 ounces liquid. Bring to boil and then cover and simmer until rice is done.

title: Aunt Janet'S Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and celery in skillet; drain fat. Pour hamburger into baking dish 2 1/2-quart dish. Add 3 cups boiling water rice and dry vegetable soup. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Roll into balls. Put into 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over meatballs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until juice is cooked up.

title: Happy Life Recipe
instructions: Take Love and Loyalty mix it thoroughly with Faith. Blend it with Tenderness Kindness and Understanding. Add Friendship and Hope sprinkle abundantly with Laughter. Bake it with sunshine.

title: Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
instructions: Blend cheese with margarine. Stir flour with salt and paprika and mix well. Wrap 1 tablespoon of mix around each olive. Completely cover the olive. Freeze in a plastic bag. To serve place frozen puffs on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes until golden. Olives will be quite hot. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients together. Add the strawberries. Bake in 3 round cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done. Cool before frosting.

title: Mixed Fruit Pies
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice; add other ingredients. Pour in crusts. Chill for 4 hours.

title: Chicken And Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and celery in oil over low heat. Add garlic and parsley. Remove from pot. Brown chicken slowly in remaining oil. Add bouillon vegetables rice salt cayenne pepper Worcestershire and water. Cook over low heat 1 hour. Add sausage. Add more water if necessary and correct salt.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Cream the cream cheese with the sugar. Add milk and mix well. Combine with the thawed topping. Remove the brown crumbs from angel food cake. Break or cut the cake into small pieces. Mix cake with the creamed mixture. Combine cherry pie filling with almond flavoring. Swirl into cake mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish or serve from a pretty crystal bowl.

title: Brownies #2
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time. Add chocolate syrup nuts and flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: Mix together cake mix oleo egg and vanilla. Put into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch metal pan. Cream together cream cheese powdered sugar eggs pecans and vanilla.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Polk Salad
instructions: Gather polk greens in spring of year. Look and wash well. Parboil greens; rinse. Boil again. Put 2 tablespoons of soda in water rinse well. Squeeze out all the water you can. Put greens and cut up onion in skillet with fair amount of Crisco. Cook until onion is translucent. I like to scramble 3 or 4 eggs then mix with cooked greens.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sprinkle cheese in pie crust. Whisk eggs until frothy. Add other ingredients and mix. Pour over cheese. Bake at 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until center is set.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix. Spread over mix. Top with remainder of Cool Whip before serving. Refrigerate.

title: Onion Mushroom Rice
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan over high heat bring to boiling soup mix rice and water. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 25 minutes until tender stirring occasionally. Stir in green onions if used. Yields 4 servings.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed on box; add poppy seed to cake mix. Stir and bake as directed. Poke holes in cake and add in holes caramel syrup. Top with Cool Whip and crushed up candy bars.

title: Baneberry Tarts
instructions: Combine butter and sugar. Mix in egg yolks flour and vanilla. Roll balls the size of marbles. Indent with your thumb and fill with a dab of jelly. Bake at 350 for 10 - 12 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Doughnuts
instructions: Heat 3 to 4-inches of oil to 375\u00b0 in deep fryer. Measure 1 1/2 cups flour and the remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in remaining flour. Turn dough onto well floured surface. Roll around lightly to coat with flour. Gently roll dough 3/8-inch thick. Cut with floured doughnut cutter. With wide spatula slide doughnuts into hot fryer. Turn doughnuts as they rise to surface. Fry 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Carefully remove from oil. Drain. Serve plain sugared or frosted. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Zucchini Squares
instructions: Mix all together. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until brown. Let cool cut into squares.

title: Baked Creole Eggplant
instructions: Parboil eggplant; drain. Saute onion celery and shrimp in butter in skillet. Add tomato. Cook to desired consistency. Add salt pepper Tabasco sauce Worcestershire sauce and bay leaf. Add eggplant. Spoon into 4 x 7-inch baking dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Place chicken parts in large saucepan with water to cover. Cook over medium-high until tender. Remove from saucepan and dice meat reserving cooking liquid. Fry sausage. Dice or chop. In 2 teaspoons of sausage fat saute chopped onion pepper and celery until almost tender; then add scallion. Cook few minutes more. Add ham sausage chopped chicken butter and parsley to pan. Add the reserved liquid from cooking to chicken; season with salt and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes before blending into rice. Serves 4 to 5 people.

title: Ham And Cheese Quiche
instructions: Combine eggs half and half and cheese. Cook ham slice and cut into small cubes. Add to mixture. Add parsley and garlic powder. Mix well. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. When done middle should be raised and browned lightly. Cover pie crust edge with foil to keep from overbrowning.

title: Instant Spice Tea
instructions: Crush red hots to powder. Mix to all other ingredients. Keep in a closed container. Add 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Cream butter sugar and pumpkin until smooth. Add eggs. Blend well. Sift flour baking powder and spices together and add alternately with milk to egg batter. Do not overmix. Fold in nuts and raisins. Sprinkle a little cinnamon sugar on top before baking. Bake in greased muffin tins at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done. Do not open oven door while baking or muffins will have a tendency to fall. Equal amount of mashed sweet potatoes may be substituted for the pumpkin. May be frozen and reheated. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Fried Zucchini
instructions: Slice zucchini. Roll in flour then roll in milk/egg mixture. Roll in bread crumb/Bay seasoning mixture. Let set 1 hour before frying in canola oil.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients starting with lettuce and ending with bacon.

title: Mini Morsel Cookies
instructions: In a medium bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. In a large bowl combine 1 cup sugar and vegetable oil. Mix well. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in mini morsels (do not use whole bag it will be more than you need). Shape into balls. Roll in remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Beef Stew - Oven Baked
instructions: Put meat in roaster. Add onion soup mix; sprinkle on. Add potatoes onions and carrots. Mix together cream of celery soup water and catsup. Pour over stew. Bake covered for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients; serve with veggies. Especially good with raw cauliflower.

title: Strawberry Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Put in blender or food processor. Add cheese in 1-inch cubes. Blend until smooth. Stir in berries and nuts. Pour into mold. As jello begins to thicken stir to distribute fruit and nuts evenly.

title: Fried Catfish
instructions: Mix together flour salt pepper and other seasonings with corn meal. Fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Pralines
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and bring them to a boil. Brown the 1/3 cup sugar; add to first mixture while cooking to soft ball stage. Drop on oil paper.

title: Rolls
instructions: Add dry yeast to warm water. Add sugar and egg to yeast and water; add Crisco and flour. Mix until smooth. Turn into large bowl. Cover tightly. Refrigerate 12 hours. Take out and knead lightly. Pat out 1-inch thick and cut out. Place on buttered pan and butter top. Let rise at room temperature about 1 hour. Bake at 500\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until brown.

title: Apricot Bread
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1/3 cup sugar 1 tablespoon flour and 1 egg with orange flavoring and rind and set aside. Cover apricots in warm water and soak for 30 minutes. Drain apricots and cut them in small pieces. Cream sugar and butter. Add egg. Add water and juice.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
instructions: Slice the meat diagonally against the grain into 1/8-inch strips. Heat a large nonstick or regular skillet (use 1 tablespoon of oil) and brown the steak quickly over high heat. Push aside.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage; drain and crumble into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over sausage. Mix well the remaining ingredients; pour over sausage mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until set and browned on top. Cool 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl; chill. Cover bowl with plastic wrap.

title: Orange Sour Cream Cookie Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients beating well until spreading consistency. Place 1/4 teaspoon frosting on each warm cookie.

title: Hot Island Splash
instructions: Combine both ingredients; heat until boiling. Serve hot. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Austria Viennese Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salt water until done. Drain well. Saute onions green pepper and celery in 1/4 cup butter. Add to noodles with salt pepper and parsley flakes; stir well. Blend in sour cream and lemon juice. Place in buttered casserole; top with crumbs blended with remaining butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop by teaspoon into hot cooking oil. Cook until golden brown about 3 minutes. Makes 24.

title: Jello-Sour Cream Dessert
instructions: Make jello using boiling water add strawberries bananas and crushed pineapple. Put half mixture into a 9 inch square pan chill until firm. Spread with the sour cream and add the rest of the jello mixture. Chill till firm. Cut into square to serve.

title: Cream Puffs(With Cream Filling)
instructions: Combine butter or margarine salt and water. Heat to boiling. Sift flour and measure. Add to boiling mixture. Beat vigorously until mixture leaves sides of saucepan and does not cling to spoon.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Pie
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed. Meanwhile grate the cheese set aside. Combine milk eggs salt and pepper swish lightly until smooth.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Butter 10 x 15 pan. Fill with graham crackers broken apart. Bring to a boil butter and sugar and boil for 2 minutes. No more. Add pecans and pour over crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Separate with fork and put on foil at once. Keep in Tupperware container in refrigerator. Keeps up to 2 to 3 weeks. Do not freeze.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix as for drop cookies. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes or until done. Frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Fancy Franks
instructions: Slice each hot dog in half lengthwise. In small bowl crumble onion rings. Reserve 2 tablespoons for topping. Combine potatoes butter crumbled onions salt and pepper in shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and blend well. Combine soup and milk in small bowl. Pour 3/4 soup mixture over potato mixture and blend. Arrange hot dogs cut side down on top of potatoes. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Pour remaining soup mixture over onions. Bake 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Milk Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine butter evaporated milk sugar and salt in medium heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil for 4 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat.

title: Oriental Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Dice bacon and fry crisp. Remove bacon from pan and lightly brown almonds in the bacon fat. Drain on paper towels; blot excess fat away. Combine sugar vinegar lemon juice paprika celery seed honey onion mustard and salt in saucepan. Heat until sugar is dissolved stirring constantly. Cool slightly and pour into a jar with tight lid. Add oil and shake well. Combine lettuce oranges bacon and almonds in serving bowl. Pour warm dressing over salad just before serving.

title: Quick Trick Fudge
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a full boil. Boil 10 minutes stirring constantly. Add vanilla and beat until thick.

title: Sante Fe Style Chicken Breasts
instructions: Cut avocado into large dice. Combine with tomatoes onion and cilantro. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons lime juice. Add salt and pepper if desired. Toss gently. Refrigerate covered until ready to serve. Melt butter in a skillet and saute the garlic. Lightly brown chicken on each side then remove to a plate. To drippings in skillet add marmalade chili powder salt pepper and remaining lime juice. Return chicken to skillet and coat with glaze. Simmer until cooked through. Serve with guacamole.

title: Fresh Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter until golden. Separate into rings if desired. Add pepper rings and cook until tender. Combine ingredients in a 2-quart shallow casserole and toss lightly. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender stirring once.

title: Dump Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together chill and serve.

title: Potato Patties
instructions: Add chopped onion to mashed potatoes. Form into patties. Brush with butter. Fry in butter greased frying pan until golden on each side.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain and set aside. Mix soups Ro-Tel and chili powder together. Place Doritos in a casserole dish. Put meat and onion on top of that. Pour mixture on top of meat. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and serve.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk cocoa and butter 4 to 5 minutes. Add vanilla peanut butter and oatmeal. Drop off on waxed paper to cool.

title: Honey Butter Chicken
instructions: Toss chicken in your favorite coating. Melt 1/2 cup butter in roasting pan. Roll chicken in butter. Arrange in pan skin side down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Melt 1/4 cup butter with honey and lemon juice. Turn chicken skin side up and drizzle with honey mixture. Bake another 30 to 40 minutes basting occasionally. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Biscotti Di Prato
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place almonds in shallow pan and bake until golden brown (8 to 10 minutes). Let cool. Reduce oven to 300\u00b0. In small bowl whisk together the eggs vanilla and extract. In mixing bowl combine the flour sugar baking soda and salt. Add egg mixture and mix until blended about 1 minute. Cut almonds in half and mix in. Divide dough in half. On greased and floured baking sheet pat out dough into 2 logs about 1/2-inch high 1 1/2-inches wide and 12-inches long spacing them about 2 inches apart. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to wire rack. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Ground Beef Ragout(With Pate Grand-Pere - Dumplings)
instructions: Cook beef in margarine. Add onion salt and pepper. Brown stirring often. Add other ingredients mix cover and let simmer. Prepare dumplings (pate grand-pere).

title: Apple Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops on both sides in hot fat. Place apple slices in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with butter or margarine. Top with browned chops Cover. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Queso Napolitano(Cream Cheese Flan)
instructions: Heat sugar in skillet over medium-high heat until melted clear and light brown stirring occasionally. Spoon syrup over bottom and around sides of 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Set aside.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Brown ground beef; cook macaroni. Mix all but pizza sauce and mozzarella cheese together. Place in a 9 x 13 pan pour pizza sauce over the top then sprinkle the mozzarella cheese over the pizza sauce. Bake 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cover with foil until the last 10 minutes. A can of mushrooms can be added to the meat mixture if desired.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix margarine sugar and vanilla. Add flour gradually and mix well. Chill dough. Form into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until set not brown. Roll in confectioners sugar while warm.

title: Rosy Glow Punch
instructions: Combine cranberry juice cocktail and concentrate. Stir well; chill. Just before serving pour into a 4 quart punch bowl. Add scoops of sherbet. Slowly add ginger ale. Makes about 50 (1/2 cup or 4 ounce) servings.

title: Shells, Cheese And Tomato Macaroni
instructions: Cook shells for 14 minutes; drain. Mix everything else together and add to drained shells. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Eggnog
instructions: Simmer first 4 ingredients. Mix 1 cup into eggs. Mix back into pan. Stir over low heat 5 minutes to thicken. Strain and chill. Add nutmeg if desired.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add cubes garlic powder and pepper. Next add onion celery carrots and cabbage. Boil gently until vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes; boil gently until all is heated and serve.

title: Scalloped Potatoes Supreme
instructions: In greased baking dish or 2-quart casserole alternate layers of potatoes peppers and onion. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over. Cover; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 to 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Serves 8.

title: Cream Candy
instructions: Cook in open kettle or heavy pan. Put sugar salt and boiling water in pan; stir over low heat until dissolved. (Dont let boil at this time.) Add cream; stir only one time. When candy starts boiling cut butter in slices and drop into candy. Cook until it says crack on the thermometer (290 degrees). Pour on buttered marble or dish. Pour 2 tsp. vanilla on candy. Pull candy when cool.

title: Slow Cooker Barbecue Pot Roast
instructions: Brown meat in hot oil in skillet then transfer to slow cooker. Add sauce green pepper and onion. Cover and cook on high heat for 4 to 5 hours or until tender. Slice and serve with sauce.

title: Mixed Cut Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook cauliflower in salted water according to package. Drain. Arrange in a buttered 1-quart casserole. Drain beans reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Add drained beans to casserole. Melt butter in small saucepan. Stir in flour. Add reserved 1/2 cup liquid milk onion salt and hot sauce. Cook and stir over medium-low heat until sauce thickens. Pour over vegetables in casserole. Garnish with pimento. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hamburger
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet. Drain then add cream of mushroom soup tomato soup salt pepper and garlic salt. Simmer this for 20 minutes. Add cream cheese and sour cream; stir this together until cream cheese is melted and mix is well blended. Cook macaroni and drain. Layer macaroni and mixture in a casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs; beat. Add remaining ingredients except nutmeats. Beat thoroughly. Fold in nutmeats. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Great Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour oats baking soda cinnamon and salt; set aside. Cream butter; gradually add sugars beating until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Alternate additions of dry ingredients and pumpkin mixing well after each addition. Stir in morsels.

title: Fat Free T'S Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Add spaghetti sauce onions and green pepper. Add enough spaghetti sauce to make thinner than usual. Cook slowly until well blended. Combine grated Mozzarella cheese with cottage cheese and Egg Beaters. In a 9 x 13-inch pan spread a thin layer of the meat mixture then the uncooked lasagna noodles. Top with meat mixture and a layer of cheese mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Continue layering and end with Parmesan cheese topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wontons(Appetizers)
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain fat. Add rest of ingredients except wonton skins. Put mixture each skin. Fold in triangle. Wet edges with cold water to seal. Fry in 1-inch hot oil until golden brown 30 to 60 seconds. Drain on paper towel. Freeze if you wish.

title: Mel'S Beer Cheese Soup
instructions: In a large heavy Dutch oven melt the butter. Mix in flour until smooth. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly over medium heat. Blend in the hot chicken broth with wire whip. Add the cheese and stir until blended. Pour in whipping cream. Incorporate well. Add Worcestershire and beer. Cook over low heat stirring until thick and smooth 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with croutons bits of ham freeze dried chives or a sprinkling of parsley.

title: Cranberry Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spread cranberries over 10-inch greased pie plate. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and nuts over cranberries. In bowl beat eggs well. Add remaining 1 cup sugar; beat until thoroughly mixed. Add flour and melted butter. Beat well. Pour batter over cranberries. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and pour into pie crusts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
