instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain fat and run hot tap water over meat. Using a colander makes this easy. Combine meat mixture soups and corn; heat thoroughly. Add noodles and its ready to serve.

title: Spicy Eggplant Relish(Caponata)
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet heat 1/2 cup oil and add eggplant. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon to a plate. Place the rest of the oil into the skillet and add the celery and onion; cook about 7 minutes. Add eggplant and the remaining ingredients and simmer about 20 minutes until eggplant is tender but holds its shape. (Stir gently now and then.) Can be kept covered in refrigerator for two weeks or stored in the freezer for one month. Bring to room temperature to serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in the order given pour into an oiled 2 qt. casserole dish and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Top with the additional buttered crumbs and bake 20 minutes longer or until center is firm.

title: Friendship Salad
instructions: Blend in understanding and good measure. Mix faith and sportsmanship in all pleasure. Add for seasoning a pinch of humor and wit. A few grains of kindness wont hurt a bit. Use confidence and courage let none go to waste. Mix in a bowl with oil of love to taste. Serve as many as you can handle but remember to serve yourself as well.

title: Apple Cinnamon Rice
instructions: Combine juice and water in medium saucepan; bring to a boil. Add rice and cinnamon stick. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Yields 3 cups.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
instructions: In top of double boiler blend together sugar flour salt and milk. Beat eggs and vanilla. Place over boiling water and stir until thick. Set aside until cold. Cover crust with a layer of sliced strawberries. Top with filling and refrigerate to chill. Spoon whipped cream around edge of filling. In center put whole berries.

title: Spicy Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In small saucepan add water and 1 stick margarine; bring to boil. Add oatmeal; turn off with lid on. In large bowl add sugars and eggs; mix. Add oatmeal mixture. Mix. Add flour baking soda spices and salt; mix. Put in dripping pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tassies
instructions: Blend first four ingredients thoroughly. Divide into 24 equal parts and form into balls. Place a ball into each of 24 miniature muffin pans. Press thumb into each ball to make a shell. Beat with a fork the next 4 ingredients until blended. Place a few ground nuts in each shell and pour filling over each. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Party Spinach Dip(Low-Fat)
instructions: Process cottage cheese in a blender until smooth. Press spinach between paper towels until almost dry. Put cottage cheese spinach and remaining ingredients into a bowl. Blend well folding ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Yields 3 cups. Has 14 calories and a trace of fat per tablespoon.

title: Candy Store Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Blend in remaining ingredients. Pour batter into a buttered and floured angel food tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together and chill for about an hour and roll into balls. Leave on a plate or cookie sheet in refrigerator for easy snacking.

title: Daiquiri Pie
instructions: Place gelatine pudding and sugar in saucepan; stir in 1/2 cup water and the eggs. Blend well. Add remaining water; stir over medium heat until mixture comes to full boil. Remove from heat and stir in rum. Chill thoroughly. Fold Cool Whip into chilled mixture and spoon into graham cracker or chocolate crust.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and pour into baking dish. Cook for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 250\u00b0; continue baking for 2 to 3 hours. Remove from oven long enough to sprinkle top with 6 strips of bacon cut in strips. Allow to cook 1 hour or until bacon curls and is crisp.

title: Pineapple Layered Salad
instructions: Beat egg yolks; add 1 cup syrup from pineapple sugar and flour. Cook until thick. Arrange in layers in bowl with a layer of pineapple a layer of marshmallows grated cheese then sauce. Repeat. Serve at room temperature. Serves 6.

title: Pimento Loaf
instructions: Soak bread in milk; mix with other ingredients and cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
instructions: Mix cheese mayonnaise and mustard until melted. Pour over cooked cauliflower.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together and put tiny Tater Tots on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Bake cake as usual following directions. Let cake cool. Poke holes in cooled cake large enough for caramel to fill. After cake is cool pour evaporated milk then pour caramel into the holes. Cover cake with Cool Whip. Chop up Heath bars and sprinkle on top of cake. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix Bisquick milk and cheese. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Stir all ingredients together; pour in pan. When set cut into squares or use cookie cutters.

title: Cry Babies (Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Add molasses and egg. Beat until smooth. Stir together flour baking soda and ginger. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake until lightly browned about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Green Bean Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well in casserole dish. Put grated cheese on top or you can use canned onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake Delight
instructions: Roll the zwieback into fine crumbs and mix with the melted butter or margarine and 1/2 cup of the sugar. Pack all but 1/2 cup of this mixture on the bottom and sides of a well-greased 9-inch pan.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Slices
instructions: In medium saucepan over low heat melt chocolate chips and butter stirring constantly until blended. Remove from heat; cool 5 minutes. Stir in marshmallows and 1 cup nuts; do not melt marshmallows.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix and place in microwave. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes on High. Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Pour half popcorn in a brown paper bag and pour half the syrup over it. Add remaining popcorn and syrup.\tFold top of bag and shake well or gently stir with large long handled spoon. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High. Take out and shake well. Cook another 1 1/2 minutes on High. Remove and shake well. Spread on cookie sheets to cool.

title: German Pfannkuchen
instructions: Beat eggs. Add 1 cup milk and continue beating. Then add flour sifted with the salt sugar and then rest of the milk. This will be a thin batter. Heat iron frying pan fairly hot with a tablespoon of melted butter in the bottom. Pour 2 or 3 tablespoons of the batter into the pan and roll it from side to side until bottom is covered. When top is set dot with a teaspoon of butter and flip it over with a pancake turner to finish cooking. It is good served with butter and sugar rolled up and eaten with a fork. Applesauce thick is also good on these pancakes.

title: Lemon Chicken On Escarole
instructions: Wash escarole thoroughly and boil down. Saute minced garlic in olive oil in frypan. Cut up cooked escarole some before simmering with garlic. (This can be done ahead of time.) Salt while cooking.

title: Wesley'S Biscuits
instructions: Melt shortening in pan which biscuits will be baked. Leave enough melted shortening in the pan to turn the biscuits. Add remaining melted shortening with other ingredients and mix well.

title: Low-Fat Fusilli Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions omitting salt and fat. Drain; rinse with cold water and drain again. Drain pineapple reserving 2 tablespoons juice. Combine pasta pineapple chunks cantaloupe and grapes in a medium bowl. Cover and chill. Combine yogurt and reserved 2 tablespoons pineapple juice in a small bowl stirring well. Cover yogurt mixture and chill.

title: Ground Beef And Vegetable Soup
instructions: Slowly brown ground beef with chopped onion and smashed garlic clove. Drain and put in large pan with soups tomato paste herbs salt pepper and 2 to 3 cups of water. Add more chopped onion and garlic. Slice cabbage thinly and add along with carrots and green pepper. Simmer for about 1/2 hour. Leave skin on potatoes cut into quarters and add to soup along with macaroni; simmer for another 1/2 hour. You will need to add water once in awhile as the soup cooks.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
instructions: Mix thawed and drained broccoli onion green peppers and cheese in a greased 10 inch pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth about one minute with hand beater. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown about 35-40 minutes at 400\u00b0. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Layered Pudding Dessert
instructions: Spread half of the crushed wafers in the bottom of a greased 8 inch square pan. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions spoon hot pudding over the wafers. Slice one banana; place over pudding. Top with remaining crumbs. Chill for one hour. Meanwhile prepare gelatin according to package directions; chill for 30 minutes or until partially set. Pour over crumbs. Slice the remaining banana and place over gelatin. Spread whipped topping over all. Chill for at least 2 hours. Serves 9.

title: Crab Au Gratin Dip
instructions: Pick carefully through the crab for pieces of shell. Blend the cream cheese mustard Worcestershire sauce and mayo until smooth. Fold in the crab. Spread in a 9-inch Pyrex pie plate. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until browned and bubbly. Serve over crackers.

title: New Potatoes And Peas
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan place potatoes. Add water to cover potatoes. Over high heat heat to boiling. Reduce heat to medium. Cook 8 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender. Drain in colander.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crackers. Pour into baking dish. Crumble 1 roll of crackers and mix with 1/2 cup melted butter or margarine. Sprinkle generously on top of vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until brown.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Mix hash browns onion and margarine together then add 2 cans water. Cook 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Heat to simmer.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in oblong pan. Mix together soups and water. Heat. Pour over chicken. Top with cheese and stuffing mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Pat topping down into soup mixture. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes and dry. Pierce with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Cool to handle. Cut in half lengthwise; remove pulp to bowl carefully; keep skin whole. Mash pulp with cottage cheese salt and pepper. Scoop mixture back into skins. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley and bake 20 minutes more.

title: Fig Bars
instructions: Drain figs reserving syrup. Mash figs well adding in a little bit of the reserved syrup.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: In saucepan combine brown sugar corn syrup butter cream of tartar and salt. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Bring to hard ball stage 260\u00b0. Remove from heat; stir in baking soda stirring quickly. Pour over freshly popped corn in large pan. Bake 1 hour at 200\u00b0. Stir occasionally. Turn onto waxed paper and break apart.

title: Grammie'S Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix well by hand you dont have to be afraid of overmixing. Pour into loaf pan and let set 1 minute. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Ragu
instructions: Saute onion carrot and celery in olive oil for 15 to 20 minutes. Add meat cook and crumble. Add white wine to mixture and continue to cook (with lid on loosely) for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Add tomato sauce salt to taste and basil. Lightly cover and cook for several hours more. Serve with pasta.

title: Swiss Mocha
instructions: Stir ingredients together and place in blender until mixture is powdered. Place in an airtight container or a pretty jar. Yields 1 cup. Use 2 rounded teaspoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Cocktail Sauce For Shrimp
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with boiled shrimp.

title: Pronto Hominy
instructions: Make cream sauce with the first 8 ingredients; when thick add cheese. Mix in well-drained hominy and undrained chilies. Pour into buttered casserole. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
instructions: Let cream cheese stand to room temperature. Beat until fluffy and blend in sour cream salt and sugar. Fold in fruit nuts and marshmallows. Pour into loaf pan or jello mold. Freeze overnight or 6 hours.

title: Butterscotch Crispies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour baking soda and salt onto waxed paper. Cream margarine and brown sugar with electric mixer at medium speed in large bowl until fluffy. Beat in eggs 1 at a time until fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Add flour mixture 1/3 at a time until well blended. Stir in rolled oats rice cereal and walnuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls about 1-inch apart onto large cookie sheets lightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake 10 minutes or until cookies are firm and lightly golden. Remove to wire racks; cool.

title: Double Peanut Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In hot oven melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Remove from oven. Stir in crumbs; spread evenly in bottom of pan. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Sprinkle with a layer of peanut butter flavored pieces layer of chocolate pieces and then peanuts. Press peanuts gently into mixture. Bake 25 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Chill at least 1 hour before cutting bars. Makes 36 bars.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients blending well. Spoon into buttered casserole dish. Crush Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top to cover. Dot with butter bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Parmesan Vegetables
instructions: In large bowl break broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Combine with onion. In small bowl combine sugar cheese salt basil and mayonnaise. Mix well. Toss vegetables and dressing. Refrigerate overnight. Just before serving add remaining ingredients. Toss lightly.

title: Sweet Potato And Banana Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Peel potatoes; cut crosswise into 1-inch slices. Place in pot; cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat slightly; cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Peel bananas; cut in half once lengthwise and cut twice crosswise. Toss with lemon juice. Place cooked potatoes and bananas in a shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar nutmeg and salt. Drizzle with rum and melted butter. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and puree potatoes bananas and liquid in a food processor until fairly smooth leaving a bit of texture. Pour into an ovenproof casserole and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mom'S Peach Pie
instructions: Beat egg white until foamy; brush over bottom and side of pastry. In small bowl combine flour and sugars; cut butter into mixture until it resembles fine crumbs. Sprinkle 2/3 of mixture in bottom of crust; top with peaches. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except shrimp only using a sprinkle of cayenne pepper. Rinse shrimp in cold water and drain; fold into mixture of other ingredients.

title: Black Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift sugar cocoa flour and salt together. Add eggs vanilla and margarine. Boil 2 cups water; remove from heat. Add 2 teaspoons baking soda. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Giant Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking soda and salt and set aside. Cream butter until fluffy and beat in sugar egg and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Shape into 2-inch balls. Place 3 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Let cookies remain on sheet until they are firm. Makes 21 (4-inch) cookies. (For softer cookies add an additional 1/2 cup flour.)

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Cook margarine water peanut butter and vegetable oil until it comes to a boil then add flour sugar milk eggs vanilla and soda. Grease and flour pans. Bake on 18 x 13-inch cookie sheets. Makes 2. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Meatballs Mix hamburger milk soup mix and 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce together by hand. Form into meatballs and place on broiler pan. Broil 12 to 15 minutes (or until done).

title: Brownie Pudding Cake
instructions: Stir together flour 1/4 cup sugar 1 tablespoon cocoa powder and baking powder. Add milk oil and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Stir in nuts. Transfer batter to a 1-quart casserole. Combine the 1/3 cup sugar and remaining cocoa powder. Gradually stir in boiling water. Pour evenly over batter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean. Serve warm. Makes 4 servings.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in heavy saucepan. Add onions and garlic; cook 5 minutes over medium heat until soft. Add other ingredients. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours uncovered stirring occasionally.

title: Church Windows
instructions: Melt margarine and chocolate drops and cool the mixture. Add the nuts and marshmallows. Mix and form 4 to 6 logs from the mixture. Roll in coconut on waxed paper or foil and put in freezer until firm slice thin.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In skillet saute onions and butter. Set aside. Mix eggs and milk until well blended. Add corn and meal mix. Spread butter into prepared pan. Spoon sauteed onions over top. Spread sour cream over onions. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 35 minutes. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Turkey Casserole(Great For Turkey Leftovers)
instructions: Cube cooked turkey. Cook thin spaghetti according to directions. Make white sauce.

title: Low-Fat Cranberry-Apple Cobbler
instructions: Place chopped apple in an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray. Combine cranberry sauce and orange juice stirring well. Spoon cranberry sauce mixture evenly over apple. Combine oats flour and brown sugar; cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle oat mixture evenly over cranberry mixture. Coat oat mixture with cooking spray. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until apple is tender. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mile High Biscuits
instructions: Sift all ingredients together. Blend in shortening. Add milk and egg (one at a time). Stir to mix. Turn out on floured board and knead. Roll out and cut biscuits. Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Preserved Children
instructions: Mix the children and dogs together. Sprinkle the field with flowers. Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in sun. When brown set away to cool in the bathtub.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Bottom Mix together flour oleo and nuts. Pat firmly in bottom of pan and bake at 375\u00b0 until slightly brown.

title: Caramel Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Blend margarine and peanut butter. Stir in brown sugar. Sift together flour baking powder salt and granulated sugar into mixture. Add 3/4 cup milk and vanilla extract. Mix until flour is dampened. Then beat two minutes on electric mixer or 300 strokes by hand. Add eggs and remaining milk. Mix then beat one minute longer or 150 strokes by hand. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 25 to 30 minutes before removing.

title: Overnight Salad
instructions: In a shallow baking dish layer the lettuce celery peppers peas eggs and onion. Mix mayonnaise oil sugar and Parmesan; smooth over salad. Distribute cheese and bacon over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Vegetable Kabobs
instructions: Pour boiling water over mushrooms and let stand 2 minutes; drain. On 4 skewers alternately thread mushrooms and zucchini. Combine Italian dressing and Worcestershire sauce. Grill kabobs over medium coals about 12 minutes turning and brushing often with salad dressing mixture. Thread cherry tomatoes on end of skewers and grill 5 to 10 minutes more until heated through turning and brushing often with salad dressing mixture. Yield 4 servings.

title: Mexican Hominy Casserole
instructions: Drain hominy. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Heat soup (undiluted). Add Cheez Whiz and let melt. Pour over hominy. Sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered.

title: German-Style Red Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage into 6 wedges removing core; place in large saucepan. Add onion sugar salt bay leaf and water. Bring to boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add vinegar and apple; cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until apple is tender.

title: Canadian Doughnuts
instructions: In a large bowl cream butter or margarine and sugar together until light. Add egg and milk. Stir until well blended. Sift flour a second time with baking powder salt and nutmeg. Add enough of the flour mixture to the butter-sugar mixture to make a soft dough. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and roll into 1/3-inch thick and cut with doughnut cutter. In a deep skillet or deep fryer heat vegetable oil or Crisco to 365\u00b0. Fry doughnuts until golden brown on both sides do not crowd. Drain on absorbent paper and dust with powdered sugar or granulated sugar. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Texas Jambalaya
instructions: Use a heavy pan with cover heat oil and add uncooked rice. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until rice is browned. Add onion bell peppers garlic and ground beef. Cook and stir frequently until meat is brown. Add seasoning soup and water. Cover tightly and cook over low heat stirring occasionally for about 40 minutes or until rice and meat are tender and liquid is absorbed. If needed add more water during cooking.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese oranges and jello together in a large bowl. Stir until jello is completely mixed. Add Cool Whip and chill.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in bowl. Beat for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pans 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack.

title: Onion Puffs On French Rounds
instructions: Cut small French rolls into slices and mound mixture of remaining ingredients onto each slice. Place under broiler until puffy and slightly browned.

title: Pepperoni Puffs
instructions: Combine cheese mushrooms onions and mayonnaise. Spread about 2 teaspoons of the mixture on each toast round. Place pepperoni slice on top. Place on baking sheet. Broil 3 to 5 minutes until cheese melts. Serve immediately or keep warm in 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening brown sugar and eggs. Stir in milk. Sift together and stir in dry ingredients. Chill at least one hour. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until set. Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Mums Indian Relish
instructions: Grind all of vegetables after washing. Measure all of the vegetables putting them in a stainless steel large kettle. Sprinkle 1 cup of non-iodized salt over the vegetables. Let stand overnight. Drain off all the juice on the vegetables. Add 2 quarts vinegar and bring to a boil; cook until tender. Mix the sugar turmeric mustard and flour and make a thin paste with a small amount of water. Pour the paste over the ground vegetables. Mix well. Let stand 5 minutes and ladle into clean hot jars and seal. Makes 10-12 pints. Cover and let cool before storing in cool place.

title: Chicken Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and paprika. In skillet brown chicken in 4 tablespoons of the butter and transfer to a 2-quart casserole. Arrange artichoke hearts between chicken pieces.

title: Oven Spareribs
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Sprinkle ribs with lemon juice. Cook for 1/2 hour. While cooking combine rest of ingredients. Bring to boil then remove. Pour over ribs and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour (until tender).

title: Crab Meltaways
instructions: Mix together first 6 ingredients and spread on muffin halves. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until golden brown. Better if baked on wire cookie rack placed in a lipped pan to catch excess margarine. May be frozen up to 3 months before baking.

title: Frankfurter Puffs
instructions: Pour boiling water over 6 frankfurters. Cover; let stand 8 minutes. Slit each frank lengthwise. Spread with mustard. Combine 2 cups well-seasoned mashed potatoes minced onion chopped pimento and chopped parsley. Spread over split frank. Brown in broiler or oven. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: 1900 Great-Grandmother Sarah Bright'S Laundry Soap
instructions: Dissolve the lye well in 5 cups cold water. Melt the grease and strain through an old stocking into the lye stirring all the time. Mix the kerosene amonnia and Borax together and then add the oil of sassafras. Add the grease and mix well.

title: Favorite Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Sift flour salt and soda. Fold into creamed mixture along with the oats nuts and raisins. Roll into small balls and place on cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Yields approximately 10 dozen cookies.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix 1/3 cup with 1 cup hot water.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Combine beef beans oregano cumin and garlic powder. Place four of the uncooked lasagna noodles in the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread half the beef mixture over the noodles. Top with 4 more noodles. Combine water and salsa sauce. Pour over all. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until noodles are tender. Combine sour cream onions and olives. Spoon over casserole. Top with cheese. Bake uncovered until cheese melts about 5 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

title: Low Calorie Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Sprinkle orange jello over it and mix well. Mix pineapple with oranges and add 1/2 box of pudding. Mix with the mixture of Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
instructions: In a large bowl combine sour cream minced chives lemon juice salt pepper and hot sauce. Peel and thinly slice cucumbers. Add and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix in large mixing bowl; add to cooled thickened jello. Pour in molds and let set.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Layer the first 4 ingredients in order in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat remaining ingredients together and pour over bread in pan. Cover in refrigerator overnight. In the morning make a topping of 2 cups crushed cornflakes and 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cherokee Dinner
instructions: Brown meat and onion in olive oil. Stir in ingredients except olives and cheese. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon into baking dish; top with cheese. Broil until cheese is melted. Garnish with sliced olives. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hot Crab Spread
instructions: Beat together cheese and milk. Add onions and everything but almonds. Stir well. Put in 8 x 8-inch glass pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Top with toasted almonds. Serve with crackers. May be doubled.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Brown bacon add onion and simmer until tender. Drain 1 can of beans add to bacon and onion. Then add second can with most of the liquid. Add mushroom soup and simmer until hot.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl mix flour baking powder baking soda and salt. In a separate bowl whisk together shortening applesauce granulated sugar egg and vanilla until shortening breaks into pea-sized pieces. Add flour mixture to applesauce mixture. Mix well. Fold in oats and raisins. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto a cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven and cool on a cookie sheet for 5 minutes. Remove and put on cooling rack. Makes 36 cookies.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice together. Add pineapple Cool Whip and pecans. Pour into crust. Sprinkle coconut on top. Let chill.

title: Fruitcake
instructions: Line angel food tube pan with heavy brown paper (a grocery sack will do). Spray with vegetable cooking spray.

title: Veggie Bars
instructions: Unroll the crescent rolls and spread on a large greased cookie sheet. Pat them together into a single piece and bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 so they are brown on top.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in greased 9 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 until top browns and sides pull away from pan. Serve hot or cold with whipped cream or plain.

title: Potato Souffle
instructions: Brown onion in butter. Add flour and then milk. Add egg yolks and sauce to potatoes; mix well then fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in a greased dish in oven about 25 or 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Place apples in shallow casserole dish. Cream butter with sugar. Gradually work in cheese and flour. Spread over apples and bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes until top begins to brown.

title: Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate dried beef. Mix all ingredients together. Roll cheese ball in extra grated dried beef.

title: Mock Pound Cake
instructions: Blend margarine and cream cheese. Add sugar beat well until mixed. Add eggs 1 at a time blending until smooth; add vanilla. Sift flour salt and baking powder 3 times. Add flour alternately with milk. Mix smooth after each addition. Pour into greased and floured 10 x 4-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Big Mac Sauce
instructions: Mix well and keep refrigerated in a covered container. Makes about 2 cups sauce. Spoon over piping hot hamburgers.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Melt together cream cheese and soup. (Do not add water to soup. Put in as is and melt with cheese over medium heat until smooth.) Mix gelatine with 3 tablespoonfuls of water. Add to soup mixture. Add soup mixture with the rest of the ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate overnight (or at least a few hours).

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed. When done blend together cream of coconut and Eagle Brand milk. While cake is still hot poke holes in top and pour liquid over cake. Top with Cool Whip and coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken With Pasta And Broccoli
instructions: In a large skillet heat the oil over medium heat. Saute the garlic for about 1 minute until golden stirring constantly. Add the chicken strips and saute until white and almost completely cooked. Add the broccoli and saute until crisp-tender then add the sun-dried tomatoes red pepper flakes salt and pepper. Add the wine then the broth and butter and cook for about 3 to 5 minutes or until heated through stirring occasionally.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain artichoke hearts well. Chop artichokes in food processor until smooth. Add mayonnaise cheese and garlic; mix well. Pour into small casserole; bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with Triscuits or Melba thins.

title: Very Very Cake
instructions: Stir well and bake about 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add milk to beaten eggs and combine. Mix the liquids with the flour mixture and blend. Stir in melted butter. Pour into pan sprayed with Pam. Turn when it browns around edges

title: Excellent Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix baking mix milk and cheese together and drop by tablespoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Melt butter and add garlic powder. Brush over warm biscuits.

title: Sehr Gut Potato Salad
instructions: Fry bacon until almost crisp. Add celery and fry until bacon is crisp. Stir in flour sugar salt and dill. Gradually stir in water and vinegar. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Add potatoes and peas; heat through. Garnish with egg quarters. May make ahead and refrigerate. Then bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Dessert
instructions: Bake angel food cake as directed. When cool break cake in pieces and place in baking dish. Cream sugar cream cheese and condensed milk together. Fold in cool whip with electric mixer. Pour this mixture over cake pieces then add pie filling.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Combine the cake mix cocoa sugar oil and cake coloring. Add the eggs and buttermilk. Mix as any other cake mix in 3 thin layers. Cook the flour and milk to a thick pudding. Place in box to cool. Cream the oleo Crisco 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Beat in the pudding mixture and spread on cake. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: King'S Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove from bone and cut into bite size pieces. Grease 9 x 13-inch dish with margarine. Sprinkle crushed chips in dish. Add other ingredients in order listed. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more.

title: Cream Of Asparagus Soup
instructions: Cook asparagus in water until tender. Whip asparagus in blender until smooth. Saute onions in margarine. Stir in flour and cook until bubbly. Add milk gradually stirring until thickened. Stir in asparagus puree. Add chopped parsley and salt to taste. Do not boil.

title: Angel Rolls
instructions: Let rise for 30 minutes and knead; cut out with biscuit cutter. Dip in melted butter; let rise. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Cook first three ingredients for 5 minutes until sugar has dissolved. Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Mix well. Place in buttered platter to cool.

title: Steak Butter
instructions: Mix altogether and serve over cooked steak.

title: Sweet Dill Pickles
instructions: Put some dill and garlic bud or sliced onions in bottom of jar and fill with unpeeled sliced (not too thin) or make spears of cucumbers. Add rest of dill and more garlic or onion on top. Fill jars with liquid that has been heated to dissolve sugar. Seal and cold pack just until water begins to boil. Yields approximately 4 quarts.

title: Ham, Potato And Cheese Chowder
instructions: Put potatoes onion water and oleo in covered dish and microwave 10 to 12 minutes stir occasionally. In large bowl combine milk flour and pepper (shake flour and little milk to dissolve). Microwave 6 to 7 minutes stir often. Pour over potatoes. Add ham and cheese microwave 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour with soda and salt; cream butter. Gradually add sugar; mix well. Add eggs and bananas. Blend; add milk and lemon juice. Add flour mixture and nuts. Put in a bread pan and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Pudding
instructions: Drain pineapple and set juice side. Mix flour and sugar. Add reserved juice stirring well. Beat egg and add to mixture. Stir in pineapple. Pour into casserole dish. Top with bread cube. Pour melted oleo over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 9-inch pans.

title: Mom'S Baked Chicken And Prunes
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or day ahead Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In large open roasting pan arrange chicken pieces skin side up. Place carrots and prunes around chicken. In small bowl mix brown sugar lemon juice white wine vinegar salt flour oregano and pepper until blended. Pour over chicken. Bake 50 to 60 minutes basting chicken frequently with liquid in pan until chicken is fork-tender. Arrange chicken carrots and prunes on large platter or in bowl. Skim fat from juice in roasting pan; pour pan juices over chicken mixture. Serve warm or cover and refrigerate to reheat later. Makes 8 main dish servings about 335 calories per serving.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix all together and boil. Pour into hot canning jars already cleaned and prepared. Seal jars.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Let first 4 ingredients stand 3 hours. Drain. Add sugar and vinegar; refrigerate.

title: Moravian Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and shortening with sugar. Add molasses. Add soda to boiling water and add to creamed mixture. Sift flour with spices and salt. Add small amount at a time to creamed mixture and work in well. Work well with hands and knead dough well. Cover and store in a cold place overnight and longer if you dont want to bake all at one time. Roll to infinite thinness on board. (Board should be covered with cloth stretched tight and tacked on edges of board.) Flour board (cloth) evenly before rolling out cookies. Bake on a greased cookie sheet in 375\u00b0 oven for a few minutes or just until they begin to brown.

title: Animals
instructions: Place peanut butter cream cheese and honey in mixing bowl. Stir until well blended. Trim crust from bread. Cut into animal shapes using cookie cutters. Spread peanut butter on half the bread animals. Top with a matching bread animal. May be covered and refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Place flower tips from broccoli and cauliflower in large bowl. Add cheese bacon and onion. Stir up. In separate bowl mix Miracle Whip Green Goddess dressing sugar and vinegar. Mix until smooth. Pour over vegetables. Stir until fully mixed and coated.

title: Dilled Butter
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in vinegar and dill seed. Good on green beans and whole kernel corn. Yield 1/4 cup.

title: Instant Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all together and store in an airtight container. To make tea use 2 teaspoons to cup of boiling water.

title: Toasted Sloppy Joe
instructions: For the meat sauce (Sloppy Joe) saute garlic in the oil over medium heat in large skillet. As the garlic begins to brown add the onion and saute until soft. Stir in the beef with a fork; continue stirring constantly to keep it loose as it browns.

title: Strawberry Frozen Pie
instructions: Blend yogurt sour cream and strawberries together. Pour into pie crust; freeze until solid.

title: Camper Stew
instructions: Do not drain any of the ingredients. Just pour in crock-pot. Mix all of the ingredients together and cook on low for about 6 hours or let simmer on low on top of stove for 2 hours. Pepper salt and add hot sauce to taste.

title: Zucchini Loaf
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and set aside. In a large bowl combine eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Beat well in mixer. Stir in squash. Add dry ingredients stirring only until moistened. Optional nuts and/or raisins may be stirred in. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done. Test with toothpick. Let remain in pan 10 minutes then remove to cool.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet; add onion and rice. Brown stirring continuously. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water. Combine all in a baking dish; add mushrooms salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Three Fruit Punch
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in mixer; beat until smooth. Pour over crushed ice and add ginger ale. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind berries. Add sugar and let stand overnight. Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Mix all together. Put in dish; let set in refrigerator overnight. Add 1/2 envelope gelatin.

title: Apricot Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill. Serve on little pieces of bread.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix well and serve cold or with ice cubes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and taco sauce with mixer. Onto 2 plates spread lettuce tomatoes and onions. Add taco dip on top of lettuce tomatoes and onions. Spread 1 package of shredded Colby cheese over entire plate. Serve with taco chips or your choice of chip.

title: Cheese Crisps
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a large bowl with hand knead all ingredients until blended.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients and form into loaf. Combine Worcestershire sauce and catsup. Lightly score top and spread catsup over top. Roast in covered pan at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes.

title: Cucumber Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cucumber mixing until well blended. Stir in cucumber. Chill several hours or overnight. Serve with chips or as a vegetable dip. Yields 1 2/3 cups.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix meal flour egg buttermilk and sugar. Pour over butter in Bundt pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes (until crisp and brown on top).

title: Sweet And Sour Beans
instructions: Drain beans and bean sprouts; mix with onion and garlic. Mix salad oil sugar and vinegar together and pour over beans. Let marinate for 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Cream butter and powdered sugar. Work flour vanilla and nuts into creamed mixture. Form into small crescents or balls. Bake on ungreased sheet in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Roll tarts in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream together eggs and oil. Add dry ingredients. Blend in vanilla butter extract pineapple carrots and pecans. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Puree together carrots melted margarine and milk. Mix together sugar eggs flour cinnamon nutmeg and baking powder. Add pureed carrot mixture to rest of ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 to 1 hour until crispy.

title: Stew
instructions: Use a large covered casserole. Combine all ingredients into the casserole. Cover and bake 4 hours at 250 degrees. Do not brown meat beforehand. Optional - frozen peas. In crock pot may cook longer until potatoes and carrots are tender.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Squash
instructions: Cook whole squash in boiling water until tender; drain. Cut in half lengthwise; scoop out pulp. Reserve pulp and shell. Mash pulp. Melt butter over low heat and blend in flour 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Remove from heat. Stir in milk gradually. Return to heat. Cook stirring constantly until sauce is thick.

title: Bacon Tossed Brussel Sprouts
instructions: Fill 6 quart Dutch oven with water. Add 1 Tbsp. salt. Bring water to a boil; add Brussels sprouts. Reduce heat to medium. Cook 12 minutes until crisp and tender. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop cooking. In large non-stick pan over medium heat cook bacon for 5 minutes until slightly crisp. Pour off fat. Add onion to bacon in skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until tender. Add sprouts remaining salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly. Add vinegar and butter stirring to melt butter.

title: 20 Minute Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Using palm of hand flatten chicken to even thickness. Dip chicken into egg then into crumbs to coat. In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine brown chicken on both sides. Add sauce. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cheeses. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Parboil the eggplant whole. Let cool and cut in half lengthwise. Scoop inside out leaving about 1/2-inch around side and bottom. Chop the pulp. Saute onion butter parsley flakes and garlic powder until wilted. Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes more. Add eggplant pulp and 3/4 cup bread crumbs and shrimp and ingredients. Cook on low heat until done 5 to 10 minutes. Fill hull and sprinkle rest of bread crumbs on top. Add a strip of bacon on each one. Bake in oven until bacon is done and bread crumbs are toasted.

title: Pineapple Carrot Bread
instructions: Combine flour salt soda and cinnamon; set aside. Combine eggs sugar and oil in mixing bowl. Mix well. Stir in carrots and pineapple. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Yields 2 loaves or makes 5 miniature loaves.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Add meat and brown. Add flour salt pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through. Serve with noodles or macaroni.

title: Herbed Lentils And Rice
instructions: Combine broth and lentils onion uncooked rice wine and seasonings. Shred 1/2 ounce cheese and stir into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until lentils and rice are done stirring twice. Cut remaining cheese into strips and uncover casserole. Top with cheese strips. Bake an additional 2 to 3 minutes more until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sandy'S Spinach Salad
instructions: Trim spinach; tear in small pieces and refrigerate. Sprinkle strawberries with 1 teaspoon of sugar or artificial sweetener and refrigerate.

title: Mother'S Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Put soda in buttermilk and sift together flour cocoa and spices. Add alternately with buttermilk and soda beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Then add jam and preserves nuts and raisins. Pour into tube pan lined with greased brown paper. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Makes a large cake. I just grease and flour the pan. Top with Caramel Frosting.

title: Tomato Beef Stew
instructions: Shake meat with seasoned flour in plastic bag. Brown meat in shortening in Dutch oven or stew pot. Add soup and water; cover. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add remaining ingredients. Cover. Cook 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Stir occasionally to thicken. Uncover and cook to desired consistency. Serves 5.

title: Peachy-Cream Shake
instructions: Put 1/4 cup milk and sliced peaches in blender. Blend until smooth. Add ice cream. Blend. Add 3/4 cup milk. Blend until mixture is combined. Sweeten with sugar if desired. Pour into tall glasses. Garnish with peach slices if desired. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Sweet-Potato Puff
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into pieces. Cover with water. Bring to a boil and boil 20 minutes or until tender. Drain potatoes and mash. Beat egg cream salt sugar and spices together then beat into mashed potatoes. Whip until fluffy. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Pile whipped potatoes in baking dish. Press marshmallows lightly into potato mixture. Bake uncovered about 30 minutes or until marshmallows are melted and browned. Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Boil the beef starting on high heat until it comes to a boil. Lower the heat to medium and cook the beef approximately 30 minutes. Add vegetables stewed tomatoes and V-8 juice. Bring to a boil then lower heat to medium. Cook for approximately 30 minutes then simmer on low heat until beef is tender but not overcooked. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Breakfast Casserole(A Great Make-Ahead Dish)
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Mix sausage and eggs together. Put in a shallow baking dish. Pour soup over the top. top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. This can be made the night before and baked in the morning.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix flour sugar and butter until the size of small peas. Pat gently into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake crust in a 325\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Oven-Baked Spaghetti Pie
instructions: *I use my homemade spaghetti sauce with the spices.

title: Southern Fried Corn
instructions: Cut kernels of corn off cobs with sharp knife. Scrape each ear with knife to remove all of corn and milk from each ear. Melt butter in heavy saucepan or heavy skillet. Add corn and 1 tablespoon of milk per ear (about 1 cup for 12 ears). Simmer until tender. Season to taste with salt and pepper. (I use white pepper.)

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit. Add the marshmallows and coconut. Add sour cream and mix thoroughly. Chill.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown meats and drain. Melt cheese in microwave. Stir all ingredients together and heat in crock-pot. Serve with Fritos.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Place chicken pieces in greased casserole and pour taco sauce over chicken according to taste. Cover casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours uncovered. Sprinkle cheese over top of chicken and cover with broken tortilla chips. Bake uncovered until cheese is melted and chips are hot. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pork Chops New Orleans
instructions: Brown chops on both sides and place in buttered casserole. Arrange tomatoes onion and green pepper on top of chops. Heat broth and wine together in separate pan; add thyme sage salt and pepper to broth after heating. Sprinkle raw rice over casserole and pour hot broth over all; mix (might add a little extra rice and broth). Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour; be sure rice is thoroughly cooked. Liquid will be absorbed.

title: Meat Loaf And Potatoes
instructions: Arrange evenly in greased 2-quart baking dish the potatoes salt pepper and some of the onions. Mix ground beef milk crackers or oats catsup rest of onions and some more salt and pepper. Spread evenly over potatoes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: You will need a 14-inch pizza pan (lined with foil).

title: Gold Coast Pork Chops
instructions: In skillet brown chips (use shortening if necessary). Pour off fat. Stir in soup water carrots onion and sage. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes. Add green pepper and celery. Cook 15 minutes more until done. Stir occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef in saucepan with oil onion garlic and parsley. Add tomato paste 2 cups of water salt and pepper and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Bring 5 quarts water to boil; add salt and lasagna (cut in half) and cook 20 minutes or until tender stirring almost constantly to prevent sticking together. Drain. Arrange lasagna in casserole in layers alternating with layers of sauce Mozzarella and Ricotta until lasagna is all used and ending in like sequence Ricotta last. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) about 20 minutes or until Mozzarella is melted and serve. Makes 6 large or 8 medium servings.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Prepare ground beef with seasonings as on the package. Shred lettuce dice tomato. Mix all ingredients together. Add chips in last.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
instructions: Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar mixing well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Stir in vanilla. Place vanilla wafer in muffin paper and pan and fill with cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Chill overnight. Top with pie filling.

title: Squash-Potato-Onion Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in baking dish. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Stir about 3 times.

title: Chocolate Vinegar Cake
instructions: Mix in order. Grease and flour a 13 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch cake pan. Pour mixture in and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour until top springs back at touch.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cut nuts dates and orange candy into small pieces. Add coconut. Melt butter and pour over nut mixture. In another bowl mix eggs sugar flour soda and milk. Pour over the nut mixture and mix well in a large bowl. Bake in tube pan 2 hours at 300\u00b0. Let cool in pan.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburg with onion; drain. Salt and pepper. Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add pizza and spaghetti sauces 1/2 bag cheese and noodles. Mix together. Layer optional items on top. Cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream together Crisco sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Add flour and milk alternately. Add vanilla. Mix all ingredients well. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Bean And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown the meats onions and celery. Drain grease. Add soup paste mustard and brown sugar. Cook 15 minutes. Pour drained beans over mixture and stir well. Pour into a very large casserole dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ice Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add cream cheese and ice cream in small amounts and beat with mixer. Fold in pineapple. Garnish with coconut nuts etc.

title: Kelli'S Recipe For Dirt Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk; set aside. Blend Oreos until fine crumbs. Divide crumbs into two piles. Put on bottom dish or new flowerpot. Add cream cheese (softened) to pudding and Cool Whip. Mix. Pour over crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs. Top with fake flowers and worms.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Blend the flour baking powder and baking soda with the butter. Add raisins sugar and caraway seeds.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and wash carefully. Save stems for another dish. Combine drained crab meat and grated sharp cheese. Add mayonnaise and mix well with a fork. Stuff this mixture into each mushroom cap. Sprinkle each with crushed crackers. Bake for 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and run under the broiler until they bubble. Serves 8.

title: Never Fail Rolls
instructions: Mix shortening sugar salt and boiling water. Add yeast to lukewarm water. When dissolved add eggs and flour; combine all. Let rise 1 hour. Make into rolls and let rise bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Garlic Grits
instructions: Cook grits. Add shredded cheese margarine and Worcestershire sauce. Add beaten eggs; mix. Bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Judy'S Fudge Candy
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Cook and boil for 10 minutes. Combine next 5 ingredients with cooked ingredients. Add a pinch of salt and vanilla and mix. Pour into pan lined with wax paper and chill for 4 hours.

title: Mongolian Beef(Spicy)
instructions: Deep fry beef in oil. In wok stir-fry beef red peppers and onion in sesame oil. Add approximately 2 tablespoons each of soy sauce oyster sauce and wine sauce. (All can be found in any Asian grocery store.) Season with black pepper and pinch of sugar. Stir-fry quickly to blend flavors. Place crisp fried rice noodles on serving dish. Cover with beef mixture and serve.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
instructions: Saute onion celery and bell pepper in oleo. Add other ingredients adding shrimp last. Cook until shrimp are done. Serve over rice. Adjust thickness by adding more flour or chicken broth according to your taste. Use more shrimp if desired.

title: Strudel
instructions: Put fruit sugar and salt in greased baking dish; dot with butter. Mix flour sugar baking powder and egg. Spread over top of fruit; cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until fruit bubbles. Uncover; bake 25 minutes longer. Serve warm with topping custard or ice cream.

title: Biscuit Pizza'S
instructions: Leave biscuits out at room temperature while you are browning meat. Drain grease after browning hamburger meat. Add barbecue sauce or pizza sauce.

title: Hawaiian Sweet-Sour Ribs
instructions: Fry ribs until brown and add soy sauce sugar vinegar and pineapple juice. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes on low heat. Add pineapple chunks and continue to cook on low heat for another 30 minutes or until meat is tender. If desired thicken juice with cornstarch and serve.

title: Chicken Drummettes Teriyaki
instructions: Cut large drummette sections from chicken wings and reserve rest for another use. Combine remaining ingredients in a large glass dish or plastic bag. Add the drummettes and marinate. Refrigerate overnight.

title: My Mother'S Apricot-Cheese Salad
instructions: Drain and chill fruit. Reserve juices. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add 1 cup combined juices. Chill until slightly congealed. Fold in fruits and marshmallows. Pour in long baking dish and chill until firm. Spread with Cheese Topping.

title: Gingernut Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in a pan and remove from heat; add sugar syrup and beaten egg. Mix until well combined. Sift flour and ginger into bowl and pour in butter mixture. Mix until combined. Allow to cool a little. Roll teaspoons of mixture into balls. Place well apart on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake in moderate oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 45.

title: Wheat Rolls
instructions: Mix flours and salt with 2 tablespoons sugar. Mix yeast with water and remaining sugar. Stir in oil. Mix yeast mixture with flour. Cover and set for 1 hour at room temperature. Spray baking pan. Form rolls and place in pan. Rise 1/2 hour. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until done.

title: Gourmet Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish. Cover and bake at 250\u00b0 for about 3 to 4 hours. Serve with noodles rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Lemon Jello Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and Jell-O. Add oil and water. Blend well. Add eggs one at a time. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in 9 x 12-inch pan or tube pan.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool. Sift flour soda and salt. Add egg yolks one at a time beating after each. Blend in vanilla and melted chocolate. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk beating after each addition. Fold in egg whites. Pour into three 9-inch layer pans lined on bottom with waxed paper and greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed in center. Cool in pans for 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack. Spread coconut-pecan frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake.

title: Macadamia Nut Fudge
instructions: Line an 8-inch square pan with foil. In a large saucepan over medium heat combine sugar salt evaporated milk and butter stirring constantly until mixture comes to a firm rolling boil. Boil 6 minutes stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Stir in chips unsweetened chocolate marshmallows and vanilla. Blend until smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour into pan. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Remove from pan and peel off foil. Makes 2 pounds 10 1/2 ounces candy. Contains a total of 5950 calories; sorry!

title: Pudding Dessert(12 To 15 People)
instructions: Beat the ingredients together and spread over cream cheese. Refrigerate until firm. One-half hour before serving spread whipped cream over the top.

title: Breakfast Tacos(Eggs With Chile)
instructions: Scramble the eggs with 1/4 cup of milk. Saute onions in bacon grease. Pour mixture into bacon grease in skillet. Add chopped bacon. In blender mix jalapeno peppers with tomato sauce. Add 1 cup of water to this mixture; dump into scrambled eggs. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with tortillas. Serves at least 4 persons.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Top with Cheddar cheese if desired. Bake at 300\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Down Home Pound Cake
instructions: Separate eggs. Whip whites; add 6 level tablespoons of sugar and refrigerate until rest of cake is mixed. Cream butter and remaining sugar beating until very light (this is important). Add egg yolks 2 at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and cream alternately beating until mixture is light. Add vanilla. Fold in egg whites. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour and 25 minutes or until done.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well; add sugar beating well. Add butter beat well. Add raisins coconut and peanuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake for 1 hour in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Special Cheese Cake
instructions: Soften margarine and blend with graham cracker crumbs. Spread evenly on bottom and sides of 9-inch spring-form pan. Blend remaining ingredients one at a time and mix well. Pour into spring pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Leave oven door closed for 1 hour to let set and cool. Next open and cool 30 minutes more.

title: Cukes
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onions and cover with water; add salt. Let stand for 3 hours or more. Drain and rinse. Mix vinegar sugar water and celery. Pour over cukes and let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Can be frozen.

title: Punch For A Crowd
instructions: Put Tang and sugar in a small container with lid and some of the water. Shake until Tang and sugar are completely dissolved then combine with all other ingredients in a very large container. Slice orange very thin and float on top. Sugar can be omitted.

title: Light And Creamy Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine pumpkin milk pudding mix and pie spice in a small bowl. Beat at low speed until blended about 1 minute. Fold in 2 1/2 cups of Cool Whip. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate until firm about 4 hours. Use remaining Cool Whip on top if desired.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Combine meat rice egg parsley onion salt pepper and 1/4 cup soup; mix well. Shape into 20 small meatballs and place in large saucepan. Mix remaining soup water and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over meatballs. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 40 minutes stirring often.

title: Lemon Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Coconut Balls
instructions: Mix well all ingredients except paraffin and chocolate. Roll into balls and refrigerate overnight. Melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip balls and put on waxed paper until chocolate sets up.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts. Place chicken breasts in baking dish. Spread the soups over the chicken. Top with Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix. Bake about 30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Shoestring Potato Salad
instructions: Mix salad dressing and mustard well. Add to other ingredients (except potatoes) and mix well. Chill. Just before serving add potatoes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and sprinkle stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Deluxe Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: In large bowl sprinkle yeast over warm water. Stir in butter shortening sugar and potatoes. Add cold water and salt; stir in flour. Use immediately or store in refrigerator. Pat on table; cut into squares. Makes about 3 dozen. Place in pan not touching. Let rise 1 hour until double in size. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Velvet Custard Pie
instructions: Sprinkle cinnamon on top before you bake.

title: Easy Cake
instructions: Light oil 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread pineapple in pan. Pour in cherry pie filling. Sprinkle cake mix; slice oleo and place on top. Top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Casserole Burgers
instructions: Mix beef onion egg bread crumbs salt pepper and tomato sauce. Make into patties. Melt butter in pan. Add patties and green pepper strips. Brown slowly until done. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Fruit Favorite
instructions: Whip cream cheese in milk. Whip package of Dream Whip and add to cream cheese. Place in crust. Top with pie filling. Serve with whipped cream if desired.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix and top with sharp Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs and melted butter; spread half on bottom of pan and chill. Cream together cream cheese sugar and Dream Whip. Beat until very stiff. Spread half of this mixture on crust. Next spread cherry pie mix. Top with remaining cream cheese mixture and then sprinkle with remaining graham cracker crumbs.

title: Hot And Spicy Cranberry Dip
instructions: In a saucepan combine first 7 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 5 minutes. Serve warm with pineapple oranges and sausages.

title: Italian Slaw
instructions: Chop cabbage and leave in bowl. Dice green peppers and onions. Add to chopped cabbage. Stir in sugar salt oil and vinegar. Let stand 30 minutes. Refrigerate for crispness. May keep in closed glass container up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan cook bacon until crisp. Remove crumble and set aside. Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon drippings in saucepan; discard remainder. Add onion slices to saucepan and cook until lightly brown. Add potatoes and water and cook until potatoes are tender. Add corn milk salt and pepper. Cook until it starts to boil. Serve with crackers. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Old Fashioned Carrot Cake
instructions: *Mazola oil work best in recipe.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix together and heat in the oven for about 20 minutes. Sprinkle the chow mein noodles over the top and put back in the oven for an additional 10 minutes. Heat until noodles are crisp. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Crab Stuffed Manicotti
instructions: Cook manicotti shells according to package directions. Drain the shells and set aside. Combine crabmeat Ricotta cheese mushrooms onions wine and lemon juice in a bowl stirring until blended. Stuff the shells with the crabmeat mixture. Place the shells in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonfat spray.

title: Cheese Pudding
instructions: Remove crusts from bread. Butter each slice. Put together like sandwich. Cut into 1/2-inch cubes. Place half of cubes in a buttered baking dish. Cover with 1/2 pound grated Cheddar or Velveeta cheese. Then add remaining bread cubes milk beaten eggs salt dry mustard and onion. Pour over bread. Either store in refrigerator overnight or let stand for 2 hours before baking. If refrigerated let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before putting in the oven. Set casserole in a pan of hot water for baking. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Before baking test pudding. If too dry add a bit more milk (usually not necessary). Be sure the cheese will melt well. If in doubt use Velveeta.

title: Tequila Slush
instructions: Mix ingredients and freeze. Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving and stir until slushy with a spoon. Can be refrozen and kept indefinitely.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Toss drained pineapple and cheese together. Combine sugar and flour and mix with pineapple juice; pour over pineapple and cheese mixture. Take 4 or 5 slices of white bread cut in cubes and butter well with melted butter. Put bread mixture over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Simple Strawberry Cake
instructions: Combine butter or margarine and confectioners sugar; add strawberry juice until desired spreading consistency. Beat until creamy.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend softened cream cheese and 4 tablespoons margarine. Add chicken and spices; mix well. Separate crescent rolls into triangles. Place chicken filling on a triangle and top with another crescent triangle. Twist. Brush with margarine and top with crushed croutons. Bake on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray. Cook spaghetti noodles and drain. Brown hamburger and add to spaghetti sauce. Layer spaghetti noodles in bottom of pan. Next beat egg in milk and pour over noodles. Pour spaghetti sauce over noodles top with cheese then arrange pepperoni slices on top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Tomato Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil until soft in a large saucepan; stir in tomatoes tomato paste basil salt sugar and water. Heat to bubbling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered stirring frequently 45 minutes or until sauce has thickened. Yield 5 cups.

title: Pecan Buns
instructions: In a large bowl blend egg sugar and warm water. Stir in yeast until dissolved. Add roll mix gradually. Add extra flour and knead until dough is not sticky. Put in a warm place and let rise about one hour.

title: Tom'S Navy Bean Soup
instructions: Wash and look through beans. Combine beans and water in large dutch oven bring to boil cover and remove from heat. Let stand for one hour. Add ham hocks bring to boil reduce heat cover and simmer 3 hours. Remove meat from bone chop into pieces and add back to soup. Stir in salt and pepper. Saute onion in butter and add to soup stirring in well. Serve while hot with cornbread or crackers. Yields about 5 quarts.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour cake pan. Cream sugar shortening and eggs. Add mashed bananas and vanilla. Mix well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Stir in nuts. Bake 40 to 50 minutes. Cool and frost with Caramel Icing (page 90).

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook first 9 ingredients 2 hours or longer. Cook in crock-pot all day. Brown ground beef and onions. Cook spaghetti with oil. Do not mix ingredients. Serve with salad.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Line baking dish with a layer of chicken then add a can of cream of chicken soup. Add another layer of chicken and then add a can of cream of mushroom soup and another layer of chicken. Fix stuffing according to package then put on top of other ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Date Ball Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and cook over low heat stirring constantly until it boils hard. Cool slightly; add 1 teaspoon vanilla and Rice Krispies. You may substitute 1 cup nuts for 1 cup Rice Krispies. Cool. Form into balls (1 teaspoon each) and roll in coconut. (Good frozen.)

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order given. Mix well. Pour into loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0. Bread is done when top springs back when touched.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
instructions: Disjoint wings and wash. Deep fry in oil; drain. While wings are frying mix all remaining ingredients and warm until butter is melted. After draining wings toss them in the sauce until coated. Serve with carrot and celery strips and Blue cheese dip. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Beignets From Togo
instructions: Grind dry black-eyed peas into a flour. Mix this with chili pepper minced onion and salt. Add small amount of water to make small rolls. Fry in hot oil.

title: Red Macaroni Sauce
instructions: Put sauce in a crock-pot on low overnight or on top of stove for 4 to 5 hours. Stir often.

title: Amaretto Dip
instructions: Mix together well and sprinkle with almonds if desired. Serve with sliced apples pineapple and strawberries.

title: Biscuits
instructions: With fingers crumble butter and enough flour (mix flour and salt first) to make a coarse meal-like texture. Add enough milk to stick it all together. Turn onto floured surface roll and cut. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 biscuits.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Drain pineapple and fruit cocktail; save syrups (making a total of 1 cup). Combine cornstarch and sugar. Then blend in beaten egg yolks and syrup blend. Mix well. Cook over medium heat stir constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Remove from heat and cool at room temperature. Fold in whipped cream walnuts marshmallows pineapple and fruit cocktail. Chill.

title: Tuna-Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni drain and rinse with cold water. Combine macaroni cheese tuna onion and celery in a large bowl. Stir together (use ziti macaroni). Pour salad dressing salt and pepper over macaroni mixture and mix thoroughly. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Serves 5 to 8.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl. Cream butter with sugars. Add vanilla and eggs to creamed mixture. Then add dry ingredients and mix until well blended. Add M&Ms and mix again. Drop by the teaspoon on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 11 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix together first three ingredients. In 1-cup measure put the vinegar and egg; beat slightly. Fill cup with ice water. Pour over first mixture and blend to make a soft dough. Makes 4 double crusts.

title: Church Windows
instructions: Melt chips and butter in saucepan on low temperature. Put marshmallows in large bowl and pour melted chocolate over them. Stir with fingers until marshmallows are completely covered. Shape marshmallow mixture into 2 logs on aluminum foil. Wrap and place in refrigerator for 2 hours. Slice into 1/4 to 1/2-inch cookies. Great for holiday guests.

title: Rocky Road Candy
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan slowly melt chocolate over low heat stirring constantly to avoid scorching. Remove from heat; beat until smooth. Stir in marshmallows. Spread in a buttered pan. Chill. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Bean Pot
instructions: Cook ground beef onions and bell peppers until light brown. Add mustard sugar vinegar and salt and pepper to taste. Add lima beans kidney beans and pork and beans. Boil slowly for a few minutes. Simmer.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Add flour salt and soda or baking powder. Mix well. Add oatmeal and nuts or raisins or both. Roll in rolls about inches in diameter. Chill. Slice 1/4-inch tick. Bake on ungreased sheet 10 to 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Magic Potion(Halloween)
instructions: Prepare Creepy Crawler Ice Ring. Pour boiling water over gelatin in heatproof bowl. Stir until gelatin dissolves. Stir in cold water. Add lemon-lime beverage and sugar; stir well (mixture will foam for several minutes). Unmold ice ring by dipping bottom of mold briefly into hot water. Float ice ring in punch. Serve cups of punch garnished with gummy worms if desired.

title: Nan'S Hershey Chocolate Cake
instructions: Soften butter. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour syrup and vanilla. Bake in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Six-Layer Casserole
instructions: In a greased casserole make a layer of each ingredient in the order listed. Season each layer. Bake for 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Coconut Chews
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and cream in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved. Continue cooking without stirring to soft ball stage. Remove from heat; fold in corn flakes coconut and nuts. Press into buttered pan.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Put beaten eggs in medium size bowl. Add sour cream whole corn and creamed corn. Mix well. Add muffin mix. Add melted butter & swiss cheese. Pour into greased 10 X 6 pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Braised Cabbage
instructions: In a large pot saut onions and bacon until tender. Add cabbage water salt and pepper. Cover and simmer until done. Mix cornstarch with water and add to cabbage. Cook until liquid is slightly thick.

title: Loaf Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease and flour a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 or 12 minutes or until done.

title: Sourdough Culture
instructions: Allow milk to stand in a warm place for 24 hours. Using a wooden spoon stir in flour. Allow to stand in a warm place until it forms bubbles and becomes very sour. When ready place in a large loosely covered bowl and place in refrigerator. Never use metal bowls or utensils when working with sourdough.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Hand mix Melt butter and add sugar then eggs and mix well. Mix flour and all other dry ingredients. Alternately add flour mixture and applesauce to butter sugar and egg mixture. Add nuts raisins and water last. Pour batter into a well greased and floured lg. tube pan or 3 sm. loaf pans. (It only takes the small ones about an hour to bake at the same temp.) Bake at 350 on middle rack. Do not open oven door any more than necessary. Check the large one after an hour sticking a toothpick in to see if it is done. Cool in pan for 25 min. then remove to cake rack.

title: Ribbon Salad
instructions: Dissolve the lime gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. Add 1 1/2 cups water. Pour into a 14 x 10 x 2-inch pan. Chill until set. Dissolve the lemon gelatin in 1 cup boiling water in top of double boiler. Add marshmallows and cream cheese which has been cut into small pieces. Beat until well blended. Remove from heat and stir in pineapple and pineapple juice. Cool then fold in whipped cream. Spoon over top of chilled lime gelatin. Chill until firm. Dissolve raspberry gelatin in 2 cups boiling water and 1 1/2 cups cold water then pour over chilled lemon layer. Chill. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Mississippi Mud
instructions: Combine walnuts flour and butter until crumbly Sprinkle into the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool. Mix 2 instant chocolate puddings with 2 c. milk. Spread over cream cheese layer. Mix 2 instant vanilla puddings with 2 c. milk. Spread over chocolate layer. Top with 1-12 oz. Cool whip Sprinkle with chocolate jimmies.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy then add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour mixture slowly. Blend well. Makes 2 loaves. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Fry together onion garlic salt pepper hamburger and sausage. Combine meat mixture into rice. Put a large spoonful in each cabbage leaf that has been partly boiled. Fold leaf into square. Lay in pan. Pour tomato mixture over top and sprinkle caraway seed over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Drain cherries and pineapple. Mix cake per instructions on package. Add an extra egg. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan. Let cool. Cut the cool cake into thirds. Crumble first third into punch bowl. Spread pineapple over the cake. Crumble the second third on top of pineapple; spread pie filling over this. Crumble last third over pie filling.

title: Shrimply Delicious
instructions: Thaw shrimp rinse and drain. Let cream cheese stand at room temperature for 1 hour or until softened. Put all three packages into a bowl. Add 3 jars of Fresh. Mix together until well blended. The cream cheese will be pink in color. Fold in shrimp. Serve with vegetables and grain crackers. Great for all occasions.

title: Sausage Balls
