instructions: Using your hands mix ingredients well. Roll into 1-inch balls (or about the size of an English walnut). Place on cookie sheet and cook at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Dog Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine wheat flour powdered milk salt and garlic powder. Cut in shortening or meat drippings until mixture resembles corn meal. Mix in egg and add enough ice water until mixture forms a dough. Roll out 1/2-inch thick and cut. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until done.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine and onion and cook until clear. Add remaining ingredients. Cook in saucepan for 15 or 20 minutes. Pour on chicken (cut up) or wieners and bake in oven. Cook chicken in 300\u00b0 oven for one and one half (1 1/2) hours. Cover loosely with foil.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix flour meal salt and pepper in a dish. Melt shortening in an electric skillet. Roll chicken in batter and fry in electric skillet for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Layered Spinach Salad
instructions: In a greased 8x10 inch casserole layer each ingredient as listed. Add a Tbsp. or so of mayonnaise to peas to keep them together. Refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Vegetarian Lasagna(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water. Set them aside. Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until soft and transparent but not browned. Stir in the tomato oregano basil parsley and salt. Cook sauce about 1/2 hour simmering it and stirring often until it has thickened. Stir in the sauteed mushrooms and cooked beans.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Make pastry for a one-crust pie. Line pie pan. Place all ingredients into a bowl and beat together with a rotary beater. Pour into pastry-lined pie pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes just until a silver knife inserted 1-inch from the side of the filling comes out clean. The center may still look soft but will set later.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together adding nuts last. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Sprinkle 2/3 c. of coconut into bottom of crust set aside. Spread remaining 2/3 c. coconut in even layer in shallow pan toast at 350 degrees for 7 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned stirring frequently cool.

title: Cola Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Dust chicken with flour shaking off excess. In a 10-inch skillet heat oil over high heat. Add chicken and brown about 3 minutes on each side.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil and sugar. Mix dry ingredients together then add the egg mixture with milk. Apples and nuts go in last. Blend well with electric mixer. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Mediterranean Shrimp Linguine
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp but leave tails intact. Prepare linguini according to package directions. Drain. Keep warm. In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat heat 2 tablespoons oil; add shrimp. Cook 4 minutes stirring frequently until shrimp are tender and just pink. Using a slotted spoon transfer shrimp to a plate.

title: North Carolina Bishops Bread
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Stir in dates cherries chocolate pieces and nuts. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours. Let stand overnight before slicing.

title: Louise'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornmeal sugar and oil. Add 3/4 boiling water. Mix well. Beat egg yolk and add to mixture along with the buttermilk. Whip egg white and fold in. Pour into muffin tins sprayed with Pam. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes.

title: Never Fail Icing
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in top of double boiler. In bottom have water boiling. Beat with egg beater constantly for 7 minutes. Remove from heat and spread on cake.

title: Sesame Toffee Bars(Delicious)
instructions: Toast sesame seed under broiler until brown. Cream butter and brown sugar. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Sift flour with spices; add to creamed mixture and blend. Stir in nuts. Spread 1/4 inch thick in 13 x 15-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Spread melted chocolate over while still hot. Sprinkle with sesame seed and cut while warm.

title: Fried Alligator Fingers
instructions: Soak the fingers in buttermilk for several hours; drain and salt and pepper to taste. Heat about 1-inch of oil in frying pan. Shake the fingers in flour. Place in frypan in hot oil on medium heat for several minutes turning until all sides are brown.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil and sugar blend. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Combine flour soda salt cinnamon nutmeg and sift. Add to previous mixture. Fold in apples nuts and dates. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan for 15 minutes before you remove from pan.

title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat sugars margarine peanut butter vanilla and egg in bowl until creamy and well blended. Mix in flour oats baking soda and salt. Stir in chocolate chips.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: *Cheddar/Swiss/Monterey Jack (use alone or in combination).

title: Nut Muffins
instructions: In a medium bowl combine brown sugar pecans flour and salt. Stir in eggs and vanilla just until blended. Batter will be lumpy. Spray the muffin cups with cooking spray or line them with paper cups. Fill cups about 2/3 full. Place muffin cups in cold oven. Set oven on 300\u00b0 and bake for 25 minutes. Cool on a wire rack run a knife round the edge of each muffin cup to loosen muffins. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt butter add onions and saute until light golden. Blend in flour salt pepper and stir constantly about 2 minutes. Gradually add broth then broccoli and bring to boil. Stir frequently cover and simmer until broccoli is tender. Puree in batches. Return to saucepan add milk and bring to simmer. Ladle into bowl and sprinkle with grated cheese; run under preheated broiler until cheese is browned.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Salt and pepper pork chops. Flour and brown on both sides. Put rice in bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top of rice. Place pork chops on top of rice and onion mix. Pour water over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chicken  Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Add rice to boiling water; set aside. Melt butter and fry onion until soft. Add Cheez Whiz to onion and butter to soften. Add soup milk salt pepper rice and broccoli. Mix well. Add chicken; mix again. Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer. This freezes well. Mix ingredients and freeze. To use thaw and add bread crumbs. Bake according to directions.

title: Smoked Sausage And Apple-Kraut
instructions: Mix sauerkraut apples and thyme in a Dutch oven. Put the smoked sausage on top. Poke the sausage several times with a fork. Pour the apple juice in the Dutch oven. Simmer in covered pan for 1/2 hour. If there is too much liquid continue to simmer uncovered until the liquid is reduced.

title: Chicken Marinade
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Stir or mix well. Wash chicken pieces. Place chicken in large flat baking pan. Pour or spoon marinade over chicken and let it marinate several hours. Place in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Make gravy with juices. Serve with rice mixed vegetables and butternut squash baked.

title: Hard Cinnamon Candy
instructions: Mix sugar corn syrup and water in a large saucepan and stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves. Boil without stirring until the temperature reaches 310\u00b0 or until drops of mixture form brittle threads in cold water. Remove from heat and allow to stand until all bubbles have simmered down. Stir in flavoring and coloring. Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. When cool enough to touch break in pieces and coat with powdered sugar. Store in airtight container.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to directions on the package. Beat egg yolk lightly. Add cream. Melt margarine. Drain noodles. Add other ingredients and toss together.

title: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
instructions: In a small bowl combine soup pepper and paprika. In 2-quart oblong baking dish greased arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Pour soup mixture over potatoes. Cover with foil and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn over and bake 10 minutes longer until potatoes are tender. Serves 6.

title: Linguini In Clam Sauce
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in wok. Chop onions and garlic and saute. Add clam broth. Add wine and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Add the mushrooms oregano basil and pepper. Note Add seasonings according to your own personal preferance.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: 1. Combine sugar magarine and oil in large bowl and beat until fluffy. Add eggs beating after each one. 2. Add vanilla and buttermilk and beat until smooth. Mix dry ingredients. Gradually add to first mixture beating until smooth. 3. Fold in zucchini chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13 pan. 4. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour or till cake tests done.

title: Cookie Cake
instructions: Beat well. Bake in a cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift all the dry ingredients together into the pan you are going to bake the cake in. Make a well in dry ingredients and add wet ingredients. Add water slowly and mix thoroughly with a spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve from pan. Use any frosting.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Pinwheels
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towel. Sprinkle equal amounts of remaining ingredients on top of cream cheese. Roll tortillas tightly. Chill for at least 2 hours then cut the rolls into 1-inch pieces. Discard ends. Serve with spirals facing up. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Cranapple Crunch
instructions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish which has been buttered with the apples. Spread with cranberries. Mix oatmeal flour brown sugar and butter. Crumble over apples and cranberries. Bake at 300\u00b0 until done.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: In ungreased 8-inch square pan combine flour cocoa sugar baking soda baking powder and salt. Make 3 holes in mixture. Pour oil into one vanilla into another and vinegar into the third. Add water and mix with fork until well blended. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Navy Bean Soup(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight. Combine all ingredients in cooker. Add water to cover. Cook on low 10 to 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours. Remove ham or pork from soup; cut into pieces and return to pot. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat sugar oil and eggs together. Mix remaining ingredients into sugar mixture. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake(Serves 15 To 18)
instructions: Bring water and butter to boil (melted). All at once add flour and salt. Beat until mixture forms ball and leaves sides of saucepan. Cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time. Beat after each one (it will be like play dough). Spread into lightly greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Remove. Pierce bubbles with fork while hot. Cool completely.

title: Cherry Pie Delight
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese sugar and milk. Spread mixture over crust. Spread Cool Whip over top. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Tortilla Chips
instructions: Tear corn tortillas into small triangles. Spread them on cookie sheets and bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. If you rub each tortilla first with a tiny bit of butter 1/4 teaspoon to a side the flavor steps up; cut the baking time down to 20 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Croquettes
instructions: Saute onion until soft. Combine all other ingredients. Chill for 1 hour or overnight. Make croquettes. Place on oiled cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Serve with gravy.

title: Upper Crust Chicken
instructions: Trim crust from bread reserving crust. Cut bread slices diagonally into quarters. Cut reserved crust into cubes. Combine bread cubes chicken celery and 1 3/4 cups cheese; mix well. Spoon into 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Arrange bread quarters over chicken mixture. Combine mayonnaise egg and seasonings mix well. Gradually add milk mixing until blended. Pour over bread. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Garnish with celery leaves if desired. Yields 8 servings.

title: Pan-Fried Potatoes And Zucchini
instructions: Cut vegetables into chunks. Cook potatoes in oil over medium-high until some have browned. Add zucchini salt and pepper. Cover; cook over medium-low until zucchini is done.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together sugar oleo eggs sour milk and vanilla. Add flour soda baking powder and salt. Stir well. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Roll out on floured board. Cut into Christmas shapes. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato-Pecan Puffs
instructions: Whip sweet potatoes with margarine. Season to taste with spices. Form mixture into small balls. Cover each ball with pecans. Arrange on lightly greased baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve piping hot.

title: Fruit Cocktail Dessert Cake
instructions: Place the egg in a bowl and beat. Add the fruit cocktail then add dry ingredients (except brown sugar). Mix well. Put in ungreased pan. Sprinkle with the brown sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Broken pecans can be added on top of brown sugar before baking.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mash cream cheese with crabmeat. Mix in onion milk horseradish salt pepper and artichoke hearts. Spread in 9 inch ungreased pie plate. Sprinkle with almonds and bake in 375 degree oven for about 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve with crackers chips or raw vegetables. Makes 2 cups.

title: Mock Chopped Liver
instructions: Saute the onion until brown. Blend all ingredients in food processor. Serve chilled with crackers.

title: Rocky Road Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and salt. Add eggs and vanilla. Add walnuts. Fold in melted margarine. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with marshmallows.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Do not drain liquid off fruit. Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Muffins
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add milk and eggs; mix well. Add oil; mix thoroughly. Fill buttered muffin tins 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Frito Dressing
instructions: Mix together. Put into baking dish. Bake in oven 25 minutes at 325\u00b0 until brown.

title: Paella
instructions: Debone pork. Cut up chicken and pork into mouth-sized pieces. Preheat a large skillet or paella pan with 1/4-inch coating of olive oil (medium flame). Toss in chicken and pork; cook evenly. Chop onion into small pieces and add to meat. Cook with cover on for 20 to 30 minutes (low flame).

title: Krispy Cheese Crackers
instructions: Mix cheese and margarine; add flour salt and pepper mix well. Shape into small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Ham Potato Patties
instructions: Combine potatoes onion and ham. Chill 1 hour. Shape mixture into patties. Combine milk and eggs. Dip patties into this mixture and then in crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat. Add peppers soups and sauce. Let simmer. Put Doritoes on bottom of casserole dish. Put mixture on top of Doritos. Put cheese on top of that. Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Place hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt butter and pour over potatoes. Add salt pepper and onions. Mix soup and sour cream; pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with crushed Ritz crackers (about 32) and 1/4 cup melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Potato & Sausage Chowder
instructions: Melt butter and cook onion until soft. Stir in flour. Add potatoes milk salt & pepper. Cook 25-30 minutes. Add cheese and kielbasa and cook another 2-3 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or longer.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Sift flour 4 times. Pour boiling water over shortening sugar and salt. When cooled add 2 well beaten eggs and yeast. Last add the flour. Mix well; let rise until double. Knead and shape into rolls and let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Potato Stuff
instructions: Place potatoes in a 9 x 13 pan. Pour melted margarine over potatoes and onions (1 stick margarine). Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top to taste. Crush 1 stick of the Ritz crackers and mix with 1 stick of margarine. Spread mix over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken In Green Sauce-Guatemala(Jocon)
instructions: Cook chicken in the water with 1 tsp. of salt in a covered pot about 30 minutes or until chicken is soft. Remove chicken and set aside. Save broth and soak tortillas in in it. Toast sesame seeds and squash seeds in a skillet until they lightly brown. In a food processor grind the seeds. add the cilantro green onions hot chiles tomatillos and 1 cup of the broth. Add the tortillas and process into a smooth paste. Brown the chicken in a lightly oiled pan for 5 minutes over medium heat. Add the paste mixture and the remaining broth about 2 cups. Simmer over low heat for 15 minutes until the sauce is reduced to a thick rich green consistency. Serve over rice if desired. Makes 4-6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Whip all ingredients together until smooth. Grease casserole with butter. Pour mixture into dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and salt. Stir in lemon rind juice well beaten egg yolks and milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole or 6 custard cups. Set in pan of water (1-inch deep). Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm or cold. Good with whipped cream.

title: Kahlua Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed of electric mixer; gradually add sugar beat well. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each one. Add the Kahlua and chocolate; beat until blended. Combine flour cream of tartar soda and salt; add to the mixture in mixing bowl; alternate with the milk until all is used (begin and end with flour). Mix well after each addition. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 23 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool on wire racks for 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool. Stir 1/2 cup nuts into 1 cup of the frosting; spread between layers. Frost rest of cake. Sprinkle with reserved nuts.

title: Sweet Nut Braid
instructions: Soften yeast in water. Combine 1/3 cup butter sugar salt and milk. Stir to melt butter. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in eggs and yeast. Gradually add flour to form stiff dough. Knead 5 to 8 minutes. Cover; let rise about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Meat Roll
instructions: Combine beef egg crumbs onion 1/3 cup sauce salt oregano and pepper. Mix well and shape into flat rectangle about 10 x 12 inches on waxed paper. Sprinkle cheese over. Roll as for jelly roll; press ends to seal. Bake in shallow baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Drain off excess fat. Pour remaining sauce over roll; bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Husband'S Delight
instructions: In a large skillet brown beef with onion then drain grease. Stir in soup cream cheese and catsup. Transfer to a large casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top with biscuits and bake for an additional 10 to 20 minutes until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Italian Anise Slices
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. In a large mixing bowl cream butter sugar and anise flavoring; beat in eggs one at a time. Add flour mixture and almonds. Turn out on a floured pastry cloth and knead gently until smooth. Divide dough in half. Shape each half into a roll about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven until firm to the touch about 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. While still warm. Cut rolls into crosswise slices about 1/2-inch thick. Place cut side down on cookie sheet. Return to oven and bake until toasted and dried out about 10 to 20 minutes longer if necessary. Turn once to toast and brown both sides. Cool completely. Store in a tightly covered tin box. Makes 3 to 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chicken Fricasse
instructions: Fry chicken in butter (use heavy skillet) for 5 minutes; add onion garlic and tarragon sprigs. Sprinkle with flour stirring to distribute flour evenly. Add water and carrots. Cover and cook for 20 minutes. Remove chicken and keep warm. Let the sauce cook down stirring often for about 5 minutes. Remove tarragon; add cream salt and pepper. Simmer 3 minutes. Stir in chopped tarragon and serve with rice. Serves four.

title: Pat'S Hungarian Goulash
instructions: Brown meat; add onions. Combine first 4 ingredients and add. Combine next\t3 ingredients\tand add. Add 1 cup of the water. Cook 2 to\t2 1/2 hours (until tender). Mix flour with remaining water and add and let thicken.\tI add carrots or green beans for variety.\tServes 4.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion in oleo; stir in soups mixing well before adding other ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Strawberries On A Cloud
instructions: Mix sour cream evaporated milk and 10x sugar together. Add thawed whipped topping. Tear angel food cake into small pieces and put into a large bowl. Add first mixture stir together. Mix strawberries (sliced) and glaze. Put on top of cake mixture. Keep refrigerated.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Rub meat with a cut surface of garlic salt and pepper. Place in bowl. Heat vinegar water onion bay leaves peppercorns and sugar together but do not boil. Pour hot mixture over meat; cover bowl and let stand in cool compartment of refrigerator 4 to 8 days turning meat each day.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Veggie Sandwiches
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls and press on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes. Gently press if puffy. Cool completely.

title: Veg-All Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal. Slit top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins. Let cool. Peel and shred coarsely. Over low heat cook onion in butter. Add cheese and stir until almost melted. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream salt and pepper. Fold in potatoes. Put in greased 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter and bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Excellent Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: In wok fry chicken breasts in Wesson oil. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Remove excess oil when done with paper towels. In separate pan cook Knorr soup and bouillon cubes about 20 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch. Cut up vegetables and add with the soup to chicken in wok. Heat together while stirring. Enjoy.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Layer cake pan with pecans. Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Roll biscuit in mixture. Pour over pecans in cake pan. In saucepan mix butter ice cream granulated sugar and brown sugar. Mix until all is melted. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Flip out on wax paper while still hot.

title: Calico Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Remove from dressing with slotted spoon and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Macaroni And Cheese With Tomatoes
instructions: Cook macaroni. Peel and chop onion. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Open can of stewed tomatoes. In mixing bowl combine milk cheese stewed tomatoes and onion. Pour cooked macaroni into baking dish. Pour tomato cheese mixture over macaroni and stir. Bake in oven for 40 minutes.

title: Hearty Steak And Kidney Pie
instructions: Cover kidneys with cold water. Add 1 teaspoon salt; let stand for 1 hour. Prepare pie crust mix according to package directions. Refrigerate until ready to use. Roll (beef) chuck strips in 1/4 cup flour on waxed paper coating evenly; shake off excess flour. In large skillet melt butter. Add strips of chuck and brown well on all sides. Brown only enough at one time to cover bottom of skillet. Takes about 25 minutes. Arrange around sides of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Add sugar to lime Jell-O and mix by package directions. Add all to Jell-O. Let set until firm. Can be made several days ahead.

title: Helen'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Grate cheese in flat dish. Beat egg and pour over cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add milk to cover cheese. Pour cooked macaroni into dish; stir. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Beat sugar and oleo together. Add eggs; mix well. Add flour chocolate and vanilla. Blend well. Pour into greased Pyrex (9-inch) pie plate. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook crushed berries with the other 4 ingredients until thickened. Pour over the whole berries in a baked pie shell. Cool and serve with whipped cream.

title: Frosty Dessert
instructions: Mix cream cheese with powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip; stir until smooth. Spread on cooled crust. Mix pudding with milk. Spread on top of cream cheese. Spread Cool Whip on top of cream cheese. Sprinkle with whatever you have.

title: Cake Frosting
instructions: Cream shortening. Add confectioners sugar; add egg whites and beat well. Add vanilla or other desired flavoring. Beat until smooth; spread on cake.

title: Butterscotch Banana Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients; set aside. Combine bananas sugar eggs and butter; blend well. Alternately blend in flour and milk. Stir in pecans and butterscotch morsels. Pour in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Sprinkle 1/3 cup finely chopped pecan pieces on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Cool 30 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Garnish with a few red maraschino cherries.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix thoroughly all but nuts; then add them. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Red Cabbage(A Sweet And Sour Dish With Great Color)
instructions: In a small saucepan combine sugar vinegar and cloves. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 6 minutes. Remove cloves. Add onion and water; simmer 5 more minutes. Place shredded cabbage in a large saucepan and pour hot vinegar solution over cabbage. Cook until cabbage is hot and crisp-tender (5 to 6 minutes).

title: Old-Fashioned Apple Fritters
instructions: Combine egg and milk. Stir in sugar and salt. Sift and mix together the flour and baking powder.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Place sugar butter cocoa and milk in 2 1/2 quart bowl and microwave for 10 minutes on medium-high setting (70%) stirring every 3 minutes. After cooked add peanut butter and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer until smooth and partially set. Pour in a 9 x 9 buttered pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Dip For Raw Vegetables
instructions: Mix all ingredients and use with assorted raw vegetables.

title: Hash Browns
instructions: Mix everything except butter and corn flakes; place in baking dish. Top with corn flakes and butter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Corn To Can
instructions: Cut raw corn off of cob and measure. Add water sugar and salt. Stir well. Cook for 5 minutes. Cool. Put into freezer containers and freeze.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Country Fried Chicken
instructions: Blend milk and egg. Combine flour and seasoning in plastic bag. Shake chicken in seasoned flour. Dip chicken pieces in milk-egg mixture. Shake chicken a second time in seasoning mixture to coat thoroughly and evenly.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef. Add all other ingredients; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 40 or 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with tossed green salad and garlic bread. This is a big hit with men!

title: Ym Ym Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil and debone chicken breasts. Place in casserole dish. Undercook broccoli and layer on top of chicken. Melt together both soups mushrooms margarine and cheese. Pour over broccoli and chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Salmon Log
instructions: Remove skin and bones and flake salmon. Add other ingredients except pecans and parsley. Mix well and chill until easy to handle. On a sheet of waxed paper mix pecans and parsley. Turn salmon mixture onto this and shape into a log. Serve with crackers.

title: New Year'S Omelet
instructions: Scramble eggs in a bowl. Add ham and cheese. Mix. Add a dash of wine and spice to taste. Pour in a heated skillet. Flip when lightly golden brown.

title: Guey Cake
instructions: Mix. Pour mixture on top of cake in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Slush Cake
instructions: Mix together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Whole Wheat Rolls
instructions: Combine in a large bowl 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast. Heat buttermilk butter sugar and salt until warm and butter is almost melted (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to flour mixture along with eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes after blending with electric mixer. Stir in remaining flour with mixing spoon and as much flour as needed to form soft dough. Knead 6 to 8 minutes on floured surface. Let rise until double. Make into desired rolls. Makes 1 1/2 dozen cloverleaf rolls. Let dough again. Bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Fried Rabbit
instructions: Roll rabbit in mixture of flour salt and pepper. Heat fat or oil about 1/4 inch deep in heavy frypan large enough to hold the pieces without crowding. Use moderate temperature.

title: Roast Turkey With Wild Rice Stuffing
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Remove giblets from turkey; set aside for gravy. Wash and dry turkey inside and out. Wash and drain wild rice. Cook and stir celery and onions in butter in a large sauce pan until tender about 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and green pepper cook and stir 3 minutes. Stir in rice add 2 cans of chicken broth and remaining ingredients except egg. Heat to boiling reduce heat and cover. Simmer stirring occasionally until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed one hour or more. Remove from heat and let stand covered about 20 minutes stir in egg. Spoon stuffing into neck cavity bring skin of neck back over and fasten with a poultry pin. Spoon stuffing into body cavity do not pack. Most turkeys have a band of skin or metal to push legs through. Place turkey in roaster and roast according to package directions for pounds of turkey. Thermometer should register 195\u00b0 if used. When turkey is done remove from pan and use pan drippings to make gravy. Let stand 20 minutes before carving.

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: Mix sugar milk and butter and cook until it forms a firm ball in cold water. Fold in the dates and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla and nuts and stir. Pour onto a damp tea towel and roll lengthwise. Let harden. Cut in 1/4 inch slices. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Western Stew
instructions: Marinate meat in dressing for several hours or overnight in fridge. Remove from marinade and brown meat. Combine meat marinade and water in a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Add vegetables and continue baking for 45 minutes. Place biscuits around edge of casserole; brush with margarine. Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 475\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Fettuccine
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions; drain. Heat butter and garlic in skillet on medium heat until garlic is lightly browned. Add Crab Delights half and half and pepper. Heat about 3 minutes or until mixture just begins to bubble stirring occasionally. Add Parmesan cheese; stir for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Toss Crab Delight sauce with fettuccine. Serve immediately with additional Parmesan cheese if desired. Makes four 1-cup servings.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain all vegetables before adding to liquid. Cut onion and bell pepper. Dice small. Mix vinegar oil and sugar. Put in covered bowl and keep in refrigerator.

title: Italian Salad
instructions: Combine the dressing sugar onion and Parmesan cheese in a large Ziploc bag; refrigerate and let marinate for 8 to 12 hours. Mix remaining ingredients and toss just before serving.

title: Chess Cake Squares
instructions: Mix ingredients. Spread in well-greased 13 x 9 x 2 pan.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Bible Cake
instructions: Beat (third word in Proverbs 2314). Bake in loaf pans at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Yankee Doodle Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add all other ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with grated Parmesan cheese. Makes about 6 cups.

title: Pineapple Rhubarb Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine 1 tablespoon margarine 3 tablespoons flour the brown sugar and nutmeg. Stir in water. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until thickened. Add rhubarb and cook until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in pineapple and pour into ungreased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish (12 x 7 x 2-inch works well). Combine 1/2 cup sugar 3/4 cup flour and remaining margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle over fruit mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in 3 1/2 cups boiling water. When completely dissolved add\tstrawberries pineapple and nuts. Place 1/2 of mixture into a mold or 9 x 13 x 2 1/2-inch pan and let set in refrigerator. Keep the remaining half at room temperature. When first half is set spread 1 pint of sour cream. Carefully pour remaining mixture over sour cream. Let set until firm in refrigerator.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Dissolve soda in vinegar; set aside. Cream the shortening. Add sugar and beat well with electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Beat in soda mixture. Sift together flour cocoa and salt. Combine buttermilk vanilla and food coloring. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture beginning and ending with flour mixture. Bake 25 to 35 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on racks. Spread Custard Frosting between layers top and sides. Sprinkle with coconut flakes if desired.

title: Dean'S Squash Casserole
instructions: After cooking squash beat in bowl with Mixmaster. Add other ingredients including bread crumbs. Place in shallow casserole; cover with more bread crumbs. Dot with butter; bake for about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Arroz Con Pollo(Rice With Chicken)
instructions: Separate breasts wings drumsticks and liver. Place remaining parts of chicken in saucepan with 3 cups water peeled onion saffron and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Boil 30 minutes; strain to make 2 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Boil 2 to 3 quarts water. Add chicken. Turn flame off and let chicken sit in water. Steam broccoli. Make Stove Top according to package directions. In a bowl with a wire whisk mix soup broth and sour cream. Lay chicken in bottom of rectangular casserole dish and broccoli. Pour soup mixture over chicken and broccoli. Spoon stuffing to cover entire top of dish. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Roasted Pecan Clusters
instructions: Melt butter in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan. Spread pecans evenly in pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes Casserole
instructions: Heat until mixed and then pour over potatoes in baking dish.

title: Old Fashioned Christmas Cookies
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Mix well. Add shortening and cut into flour mixture with a pastry blender. Break eggs in a cup and fill with milk to make 1 cup; add vanilla. Add to flour mixture and mix well. Chill if desired for easier handling. Roll out on pastry cloth and cut out cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool and decorate as desired.

title: Fruit Ice Cream
instructions: Mix and pour into ice cream freezer. Freeze per instructions for freezer.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Beat the one egg; add sugar and beat until very light and white. Add the milk without stirring. Then sift 1 pint flour to which has been added the baking powder and salt and nutmeg. Beat this thoroughly; then add quickly enough flour to make a firm but soft dough. Roll out 1/2-inch thick; cut into rings.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry cake mix nuts and melted butter. (Mixture will be crumbly.) Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Serve with whipped cream or hot with coffee cream. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates and nuts. Let them stand until cool. Mix shortening and sugar. Add the eggs without heating. Sift salt with flour. Now add soda to dates and nuts. Add alternately to the sugar mixture with flour. Lastly stir in 2 to 3 cups cold water. Bake in two loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Naomi Currey'S Mincemeat Cake
instructions: Mix brown sugar white sugar Crisco and eggs in bowl. Add mincemeat and milk. Stir then add soda baking powder flour salt and spices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Test with toothpick.

title: Christmas Gelatin Layered Salad
instructions: Layer 1 Dissolve lime gelatin in hot water. Add pineapple and juice-water mixture to gelatin; stir well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and place in refrigerator to congeal.

title: Baked Stuffed Fish
instructions: You will need toothpicks or string.

title: Cream Caramel Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour baking soda and salt together. Alternating add flour and sour cream to butter mixture. Add vanilla.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: About 1 1/4 hours before serving On waxed paper mix potato flakes paprika\tsalt garlic powder pepper and 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese. In pie\tplate beat egg and 1 teaspoon water. Dip chicken pieces into egg mixture then coat with potato flake mixture.

title: Mexican Taco Salad
instructions: Prepare rice according to directions on bag. Saute onions and ground beef. Add chili mix canned tomatoes salt and pepper to beef mixture. Add rice. Mix milk and cheddar cheese soup together and beat until creamy. Pour over meat mixture. Top with cubed fresh tomatoes shredded lettuce shredded cheese and Fritos.

title: Tortellini Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except broccoli and tortellini. Bring to a boil and then turn to low and simmer for 30 minutes. At 15 minutes add the broccoli and tortellini and continue to simmer for 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Stroganoff Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain. Combine ground beef onion and seasonings. Shape into 16 meatballs. Brown the meatballs in oil turning to brown all sides. Stir in soup. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream macaroni and sweet peas. Put in greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Bunker Hills
instructions: Combine Spam\tcheese mayonnaise relish and mustard. Pile on open-face buns.\tBroil until cheese is bubbly.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Sauce
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan combine rhubarb sugar 2 tablespoons water and cardamon or cinnamon. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes or until fruit is tender. Stir together the 1 tablespoon water and cornstarch. Add to rhubarb mixture. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir for 2 minutes more. Stir in strawberries. Serve warm over ice cream. Makes 2 cups.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Add onions. Mix soup tomatoes and milk. Alternate meat and tortillas. Pour soup mixture over meat and tortillas. Poke with knife so soup runs through meat. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Top with cheese. Put back in oven for a few minutes for cheese to melt.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Bake
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish combine soup and sour cream. Stir in broccoli ham and rice. Mix well. In a cup combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over casserole. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve.

title: B J'S Baked Ham Omelette
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Sift flour with baking powder; beat eggs and season lightly. Add 5 to 6 drops Tabasco sauce. Stir in flour ham cheese cottage cheese and most of the melted margarine. Swirl rest of margarine around in dish to coat evenly. Pour in egg mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer until puffed and golden brown. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine milk and soup in a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole dish. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and microwave on High for 10 minutes. Stir. Microwave another 12 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 8.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare spinach according to package and drain well. Combine eggs cheese milk and onions. Add salt celery salt basil and garlic. Combine with spinach. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Top by overlapping sliced tomatoes and crumbled bacon strips. Cover edge of crust with tinfoil to prevent it from getting too brown. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Spicy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine beef and garlic in a Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat until browned stirring to crumble meat. Drain meat in colander pat with paper towel. Wipe pan drippings from skillet with paper towel. Return meat to Dutch oven add tomato juice and next 9 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat. Simmer 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in mixed vegetables. Cover and cook 25 minutes. Yields 10 cups 177 calories per cup.

title: Two-Flavor Fudge
instructions: In saucepan combine brown sugar granulated sugar evaporated milk and butter or margarine. Bring to full boil over moderate heat stirring frequently. Boil for 15 minutes over moderate heat stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Add marshmallow cream butterscotch chips and chocolate chips. Stir until chips are melted and mixture is smooth. Blend in nuts and vanilla. Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill until firm. Makes about 2 1/2 pounds. Freezes well.

title: Southwestern Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into 3 or 4 portions. Mix flour and salt; dredge meat in flour mixture. Set aside remaining flour. Brown meat in small amount of hot oil about 3 tablespoons. Place meat in shallow baking dish. Blend reserved flour mixture into drippings in skillet. Add tomatoes and green chilies celery carrot and onion. Cook stirring constantly until mixture boils. Pour over meat. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until meat is tender. Sprinkle cheese over meat.

title: French Oven Stew
instructions: Heat oven to\t300\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in a heavy 3 quart ovenproof saucepot. Cover and bake stirring 3 times for 3 hours or until meat is\ttender and sauce thickens. Discard bay leaves before serving or storing. Makes 8 servings. In you like add a cup of frozen green peas or cut green beans 20 minutes before stew is done.

title: Chutney Chicken Spread
instructions: Process chicken in food processor for 5 seconds using steel blade. Add cream cheese chutney curry onion mayonnaise and pepper. Process 5 to 10 seconds until well blended. Place in an au gratin dish; spread with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with large corn chips.

title: Dutch Apple Bread
instructions: Sift flour. Add baking powder salt and sugar. Sift again. Cut softened butter into dry ingredients as for pastry. Add beaten eggs and milk. Beat. Spread in 8 x 12 pan (greased). Press apple slices over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix oleo and graham crumbs. Put this in the bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat the eggs oleo and 10x sugar for not less than 15 minutes. Spread on the graham crust and then cover with sliced bananas and crushed pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and some cherries. Refrigerate for several hours before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: In a 6-quart saucepan put oil and heat. Brown roast on both sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in mushroom soup onion soup mix and 1 cup water. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 2 hours. Add vegetables. Cook 45 minutes. Remove roast and vegetables. Stir in flour and 1/2 cup water. Gradually stir into pot. Cook until it boils and thickens.

title: Mum'S Rice Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cook rice and raisins together. Beat egg yolks and add sugar pinch of salt milk nutmeg and cinnamon.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook ground beef. Put in 8 inch baking dish. Top with sauce and cheese. Combine milk bisquick and eggs. Beat until smooth. Pour over top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Caramel Coconut Pie
instructions: Brown coconut and pecans lightly in 1/4 cup margarine. Mix cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Put 1/4 cream cheese mixture in each pie crust. Drizzle 1/4 jar caramel and 1/4 coconut mixture. Repeat layers. Freeze (better results if frozen overnight). Thaw 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cran-Apple Bake
instructions: Combine fruit and sugar in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until brown and bubbly.

title: Caramel Apple Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar in mixing bowl until fluffy and well-blended. Spread on bottom of pie crust. In skillet over medium heat melt butter and add apples. Cook stirring until tender-crisp about 5 minutes. Drain well on paper towels.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes; 275\u00b0 may be better. Makes 100 cookies.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Place cranberries Quartered orange with peel apple and sugar in food processor. Chop until mixture reaches relish consistency. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Mix in walnuts and serve.

title: Maxine'S 2 Minute Microwave Fudge
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart bowl stir sugar cocoa milk and vanilla together until partially blended. Place butter over top in center of bowl. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir vigorously until smooth. (Dont worry if all the butter does not melt; it will as mixture is stirred.) Pour mixture into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour. Cut into squares. Makes about 36 squares.

title: Banana Shake(Yield: 3 Large Shakes)
instructions: 1. Unpeel bananas and put in a blender.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Blend together in blender. Delicious refreshing drink.

title: Baked Spareribs Aloha
instructions: Cut ribs into serving pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in shallow pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Pour off excess fat. Reduce oven heat to 350\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over ribs. Bake for 1 1/2 hours basting frequently. Makes 4 servings.

title: Linden Lea Banana Chip Muffins
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and eggs. Mix well. Stir in bananas buttermilk and vanilla. Stir in remaining dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Heat in crock-pot until cheese is melted. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Jo'S Quick Spanish Rice
instructions: In a large pot heat the vegetable oil until very hot. Stir in Sofrito and stir for 20 seconds. Add rice; stir until all ingredients are well mixed. Add black beans water salt garlic powder pepper and envelopes of Sazon; stir and bring to a boil. Add olives and/or Vienna sausages (optional). Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes (until all water is absorbed). Stir rice once with a large fork after 10 to 15 minutes. When rice is done turn off heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir rice once again after 5 minutes and enjoy!

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Boil until soft. Drain but do not throw water away. Mash potatoes and butter. Slowly add water (not too much) and heat stirring all the time. Mix leek soup mix with water and add to potatoes. Heat and stir all the time. Keep stirring and add 1/2 the cream.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Combine cranberries orange and apricots and put 1/2 the mixture in\tthe blender. Blend well. Add the other half of mixture blend well. Add sugar ginger almonds and raisins to mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar syrup water and peanuts. Measure into custard cup soda and salt. Cook together sugar corn syrup water and peanuts for 30 to 35 minutes after it begins to boil until it is amber a little deeper than straw color. Add soda and salt mixed. Remove from heat. Beat until blended and pour onto heavy buttered aluminum tray. Pull edges to thin sheets; cut off pieces with kitchen shears. Cool and store tightly covered.

title: Tangy Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Store in glass jars.

title: E-Z Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Use can from cream of mushroom soup to add the hot water and half and half to all ingredients. Stir together and put in casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Pepsi Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in pan. Put salt over chicken then put Pepsi up to the top of chicken. Then cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Then cover with barbecue sauce.

title: Easy Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken breasts in 1 quart water until tender. Remove cool and cut up. Add cream of chicken soup to broth and bring to rolling boil.

title: Vanilla Wafer Pudding
instructions: Pour half of the vanilla wafers into about a 1 1/2-quart bowl. Whip cream until stiff and fold in drained maraschino cherries (chopped) and drained crushed pineapple. Add chopped nuts. Layer the creamed mixture over the wafers; add the remaining vanilla wafers. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: *Broccoli cauliflower carrots green pepper celery etc.

title: Pineapple Glazed Apple Pie
instructions: In large saucepan combine 1 1/4 cups of pineapple juice and sugar. Bring to a boil. Add apple wedges. Simmer covered 3 to 4 minutes or until apples are tender but not soft. With slotted spoon lift apples from liquid. Set apples aside to drain. Blend the remaining 1/4 cup pineapple juice slowly into cornstarch. Add to hot pineapple liquid in saucepan. Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles. Cook 1 minute more. Remove from heat; stir in butter or margarine vanilla and salt. Cover and cool 30 minutes without stirring.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all of ingredients together and roll into 80 to 100 balls.

title: Chocolate Thing
instructions: Melt butter in a 6 x 9-inch glass baking dish. Mix in flour and pecans. Press into pan to form crust.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice. In a large frying pan heat oil; toss in broccoli and onion. Cook for 5 minutes. Add cream of chicken soup. Reduce heat. Stir in cheese milk and salt; cook until bubbly. Place rice in bottom of 2-quart casserole and add broccoli sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie (Or Lemon)
instructions: Fold together milk and juice. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into crust and cool for a few hours.

title: Angel Food Pie
instructions: Put water sugar and pineapple in top of double boiler and bring just to boiling point. Mix flour and cornstarch and add to pineapple mixture. Cook until it thickens. Remove from heat and add vanilla. When cool fold in egg whites. Pour into 2 baked pie shells. Top with 1/2 pint whipped topping for each pie. Sprinkle with coconut. Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Brown Sugar-Bourbon Glazed Ham
instructions: Place unwrapped ham on rack in large roasting pan. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours.

title: Gelatin Easter Baskets
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water. Pour into individual ring molds or 6 ounce custard cups. Chill until firm about 2 hours.

title: Red Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water (do not add cold water). Add ingredients except sour cream. Stir well or until raspberries separate. Pour 1/2 mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until firm enough to spread sour cream over top. Add remainder of jello mixture and chill until firm. This can be made with different flavors also. Example strawberry jello and fruit orange jello and mandarin orange slices etc. But raspberry is super!

title: Roux
instructions: Mix the flour and oil in a heavy pot; stir constantly over a medium fire. As you stir the roux browns slowly. Dont cook the roux fast because as it reaches the done point it will burn.\tWhen the roux is a rich dark brown turn fire off while continuing to stir until it cools. Makes enough roux for stew with one hen or 2 pounds shrimp.

title: Nine Layer Vegetable Salad
instructions: Layer vegetables in the order listed in a 10 x 10 x 2-inch casserole dish. Spread mayonnaise evenly over top. Sprinkle sugar then Parmesan cheese then Bac*Os bits over mayonnaise. Layer mushrooms evenly over top and then sliced eggs. Add croutons on top.

title: Midwestern Scalloped Corn And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain off all fat except about 2 tablespoons. Add flour and stir until blended then add milk and stir until mixture boils and thickens. Add corn salt and pepper to mixture. Place into shallow casserole. Arrange thick slices of tomato over the top of sausage and corn mixture. Top with grated cheese. Place under broiler for 4 to 5 minutes until tomatoes are cooked and cheese is melted. Yields 4 servings.

title: Lemon-Glazed Carrots
instructions: In 1-quart microproof casserole combine carrots and water. Cover. Cook on High (maximum power) 6 minutes. Stir in green peppers. Cover. Cook on High (maximum power) 12 to 15 minutes or until carrots are tender stirring once during cooking time. Drain.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and press firmly into 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese sugar and 2 tablespoons of milk until smooth. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Prepare pudding using 3 1/2 cups milk. Spread over layer of cream cheese. Chill 2 hours. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding layer. Garnish with graham cracker crumbs or semi-sweet mini chocolate chips.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Blend Crisco salt and sugars. Stir in eggs; add peanut butter and vanilla. Add dry ingredients to first mixture blending well. Roll into small balls the size of a walnut. Place on greased baking sheet and mark with fork to form \X\ on cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip blending well. Spoon onto crust. Chill until set at least 4 hours. Garnish with fresh strawberries if desired.

title: Easy Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs; add butter milk sugar and flour all together. Add corn. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm approximately 45 minutes or more. Sprinkle small jar chopped pimentos on top (option).

title: Apricot Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter with sugar. Mix in egg yolks then flour then nuts. Use hands. Grease an 8-inch square pan. Put half of the dough in pan. Top with 2 tablespoons of apricot preserves. Put the rest of the dough on top of the apricot preserves. Spread remaining preserves on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Lay chicken wings n large pan. Mix soup dressing and 3/4 jar preserves and spoon over chicken. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking for 1/2 hour or until browned at 350\u00b0.

title: Pork Chops With Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; cook and stir until mixture boils. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside. In a skillet brown chops in oil. Season more if desired. In a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish layer potatoes and onion. Pour broth mixture over. Place chops on top. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with parsley and paprika if desired.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain shredded zucchini and squash. Squeeze dry with paper towels. Set aside. Coat a medium skillet with vegetable spray. Place over medium-high heat until hot. Add onions and saute for 5 minutes or until tender. Combine squash onions shredded cheese and next four ingredients in large bowl. Stir well.

title: Party Potato Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix buttermilk mayonnaise horseradish sugar bouillon and dill. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill. Garnish. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: A-B-C Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add fruit juice or cold water. Add fruit cocktail. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch dish and let set.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix oleo and sugar; mix flour salt and baking powder. Add 2 mixtures together and add vanilla. Add enough milk to make stiff dough. Roll out on floured sheet and cut like biscuits. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Breakfast Ham Ring(Yields 8 Servings)
instructions: In a large bowl lightly beat 2 eggs. Add ham sausage bread crumbs milk parsley and horseradish and mix well. Press into a greased 6 cup ring mold. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Toward end of baking time prepare scrambled eggs with remaining eggs. Remove ring from oven and drain juices. Unmold onto serving platter. Fill center with scrambled eggs. Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Spinach Shells
instructions: Prepare shells and drain. Cool spinach and pour into large bowl. Add salt pepper and cheese (Ricotta or cottage cheese). Mix fried beef and spaghetti sauce. Stuff cheese mixture into shells. Pour spaghetti sauce over shells. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange And Cashew Chicken
instructions: Drain oranges reserving 2 tablespoons syrup. Blend syrup with stir-fry sauce. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or skillet (high heat). Add chicken cashews and garlic; stir-fry for 3 minutes. Remove from pan. Heat remaining oil in same pan. Add onion and snow peas. Stir-fry for 3 minutes and then add chicken cashews and stir-fry sauce mixture. Cook and stir to coat all ingredients. Remove from heat and stir in oranges. Serve on rice.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Pour into unbaked 8-inch pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Then 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind cranberries and apple. Add the sugar. Stir and let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Stir in nuts and orange peel. Mix egg orange juice and salad oil in a small bowl. Add liquid mixture to dry mix and blend well. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes before removing from pan. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Ham And Onion Quiche
instructions: Bake pie shells at 450\u00b0 for 6 minutes.\tAlways prick bottom and sides of crusts with a\tfork before baking. Remove shells from oven; reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Toss ham in 1 tablespoon flour then sprinkle ham over bottom of pie shells. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over ham. Beat remaining ingredients together and pour mixture into shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Easy Lemon Pie(No Bake)
instructions: In medium mixing bowl blend cream cheese lemonade and condensed milk until smooth. Add a few drops of food coloring. Blend well. Squeeze 1/2 lemon into mixture. Add Cool Whip and blend for a few minutes. Pour into pie crust. Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Shredded Carrot And Egg Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl combine carrot onion eggs and salt. Add salad dressing. Toss to combine. Refrigerate about 2 hours to allow flavors to blend. Yields 4 servings.

title: Cheese And Apple Spread
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and salad dressing mixing well. Add cheese and apples; mix well. Chill. Serve with apple wedges crackers and bread. Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Easy Rotini Salad
instructions: Mix vinegar and sugar; slowly add oil. Add cooked rotini and green pepper.

title: Edna'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix corn eggs and sour cream together. Add meal. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 16.

title: Potato Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Using a large bowl beat eggs well. Add flour salt baking powder and butter to eggs and beat well until all is dissolved. Add potatoes and onions and mix well. Dont be afraid to use your hands! Pour into brownie pan and bake for 1 hour. Enjoy!

title: Monster Chip Cookies
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream shortening butter and sugar until light and fluffy (about 5 minutes). Add eggs one at a time beating each well. Add vanilla and lemon juice. Combine flour oats baking soda salt and cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Stir in chips and nuts. Drop by 1/4 c. three inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 14-16 minutes or until lightly browned and set in center. Cool two minutes before removing to wire rack.

title: Recipe For A Happy Marriage
instructions: Take one child. Mix with generous pats of good humor and understanding. Blend in discipline as needed. Surround with music love of nature pets and friends. Bake in a warm pleasant atmosphere. Use large amounts of patience. Do not be discouraged if at times objects do not seem to be turning out to your perfection. Continue basting. Before you realize it your delight turns out even better than you had even hoped for. Release when properly aged.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo vegetable oil sugar powdered sugar vanilla and eggs. Add flour salt and soda. Roll a teaspoon of dough into a ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press lightly with floured fork. Works best if dough is chilled. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Cicoria Fina Agliata(Dandelion Sauteed With Garlic)
instructions: Clean and wash greens cut in half. Place in saucepan. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender. Remove and drain. Heat oil and garlic in frying pan. Place greens in pan. Stir with wooden spoon until slightly dry. Serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions until golden in margarine. Add water; bring to boil. Add bouillon cubes and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer 1/2 hour or until ready to eat. Add grated cheese just before putting in bowls. In individual bowls add croutons. Put Mozzarella cheese over top in each bowl. Melt cheese in microwave or oven.

title: Buttermilk Chicken
instructions: Melt 1 stick of butter in a flat casserole dish. Salt pepper and flour chicken pieces. Place in dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Turn over and bake for 15 minutes more. Mix cream of chicken soup with buttermilk and pour over chicken. Cover and bake for 15 minutes longer. Serve with rice.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Serve over sliced cucumbers.

title: Jello Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well; let come to boil. Add jello. Mix and let cool. Chill milk. Beat until stiff and add all together. Pour in crust.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Tenderize meat; brown steak quickly in 3 tablespoons oil. Add mushrooms onion soup and water. Bring to boil. Mix sour cream and flour. Add to meat and simmer until sauce is thick.

title: Devil'S Food Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients; bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Beat all ingredients together with a spoon. Cook quickly on a hot griddle. Yields 12 to 15 pancakes.

title: Creole Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Sort and wash peas. Place in Dutch oven. Cover with water. Soak overnight. Drain peas. Add pork. Cover with water. Cover and cook 45 minutes. Add all other ingredients except sausage. Cover and cook 1 1/2 hours. Stir occasionally. Add sausage. Cook uncovered over low heat 45 minutes. Serve over cooked rice. Serves 10.

title: Quick Vegetable Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter an 8 x 5-inch loaf pan. Chop the spinach. Grate the carrot. Chop the scallion. In a large bowl combine flour 2 tablespoons Parmesan sugar baking powder salt thyme and nutmeg. In a separate bowl combine the milk oil and egg. Stir the milk mixture chopped vegetables and pimento into the flour mixture until all ingredients are just moistened. Spoon batter into the prepared pan. Sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Bake until a toothpick stuck into the center comes out clean 55 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from the pan; cool completely.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage and onion until tender and drain water. Place cooked cabbage in casserole dish sprayed with Pam. In a bowl mix soup mayonnaise and salt and pepper. Pour over cabbage. In another bowl mix crushed Ritz crackers butter and cheese. Spread over cabbage and soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Do not overbake or cheese gets too brown.

title: Dried Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven from 45 to 60 minutes. Serve hot. (If you use a dish that can be taken out of the refrigerator and put right in the oven that will be the best.)

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust; brush with egg if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole Microwave
instructions: Place butter in 2 1/2-quart casserole. Heat full power 20 to 30 seconds or until melted. Stir in green pepper onion and celery. Cook full power 6 to 8 minutes until vegetables are tender. Stir halfway through. Sprinkle vegetables with flour and stir to blend. Mix in tomatoes. Cook full power until heated 4 to 6 minutes. Stir halfway through cooking time. Blend in remaining ingredients. Cook full power about 6 minutes or until shrimp are fully cooked. Stir twice during time. Remove bay leaf.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Prepare cookie mix as directed on box. Spread in pizza pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle with sugar before baking.

title: Chocolate Chunkies Cookies
instructions: Combine flour baking soda and salt. Beat butter and brown sugar in a large bowl at medium speed until creamy. Beat in egg until light and fluffy. Beat in melted chocolate and vanilla. At low speed beat in flour mixture. Fold in nuts chocolate and candies. Grease baking sheets. Drop dough by tablespoons 2 inches apart on prepared pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool cookies on rack. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Peel and dice zucchini. Mix zucchini Bisquick and oil in bowl. Mix well. Then add eggs one at a time. Add remaining ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together and shape into balls. Dip into melted chocolate.

title: Linguine With Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Add the juice from the clams seasonings condensed cream of mushroom soup and white wine. Simmer covered for 10 minutes.

title: S'More Cookie Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8-inch square baking pan. In large mixing bowl beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Stir together flour crumbs baking powder and salt. Add to the butter mixture and beat until well blended. Press 1/2 dough into pan. Arrange bars over dough breaking as needed to fit. Spread with Marshmallow Creme. Scatter bits of remaining dough over Marshmallow Creme; carefully press to form a layer. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool completely and cut.

title: Deep Dish Pie (Has No Bottom Crust)
instructions: You will need 1 greased casserole dish.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Cover pickles and onions with water and salt. Let soak for 3 hours. Drain. Mix together 10 cups water turmeric mustard seed celery seed vinegar and sugar and pour over pickles. Heat and put in jars and seal.

title: Chicken Enchiladas Casserole Style
instructions: Place first 7 ingredients in saucepan; heat to boil. Reduce heat. Add sour cream (do not boil after adding). Place a couple of spoonfuls in the bottom of 4-cup crock-pot. Layer tortillas soup mixture and cheese. Cook on low for the afternoon. Let stand 10 minutes if there is too much liquid or cook a bit longer. Dinner is ready when lessons are finished. Serve with tossed green salad.

title: Turkey Keema
instructions: Heat oil and fry onion until golden brown. Add ginger and garlic fry for a few more minutes. Add ground turkey tomatoes and all the spices; fry for a few more minutes. Add 2 to 3 cups water and cook until turkey is tender and gravy is thick.

title: Zucchini Bread(2 Loaves)
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy and slowly add remaining ingredients. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured loaf pans and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 60 minutes or until done. Invert and cool loaves on racks.

title: Play Clay
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Work the mixture with your hands until it feels well mixed. Shape the dough into decorations like stars or snowmen or cut with cookie cutters. Be sure to make small hole in the top or push a paper clip into the dough.

title: Easy 1 Hour Rolls
instructions: Heat milk to lukewarm. Add oil. Mix yeast and sugar into a small amount of warm water to dissolve yeast. Add to milk mixture and then dry ingredients. Roll out on floured board and knead well. Cut out biscuits and place in oiled pan. Let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until browned.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a covered pan and simmer until vegetables are tender about 10 minutes. Add cheese stirring over low heat until cheese is melted. Whisk in beer and stir until well blended.

title: Baked Bluefish Fillets With Creole Sauce
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together in a 2-quart pan and saute together for 10 minutes over medium heat. Add remaining ingredients all but bluefish fillets and mix well over medium-low heat until vegetables are fully cooked about 15 minutes. While this is cooking bake bluefish fillets in a 400\u00b0 oven until fully cooked approximately 30 minutes. When fish is cooked portion on plates and top with Creole sauce.

title: Pizza Bread
instructions: Thaw frozen bread dough. Roll dough into 2 (14 x 8-inch) rectangles. Beat together eggs Parmesan cheese and oregano. Spread egg mixture on dough reserving 3 tablespoons. Top with cheese and melt. Roll up from long edge and pinch seams to seal. Place seam side down in greased pan. Brush top of loaves with remaining egg mixture. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fortune Cookies
instructions: Write fortunes on strips of paper. Mix sugar into egg whites and blend until fluffy. Melt butter and let cool until warm. Add flour salt vanilla and butter to the sugar mixture. Beat until the batter is smooth. Pour batter from a spoon to form circles on a well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 8 minutes. Lay a message on each cookie; fold in thirds then bend it gently in the center. If cookies get too hard to bend return to oven for about 1 minute.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in refrigerator. Keeps well for several days.

title: Jiffy Spoon Bread
instructions: Scald milk. Beat eggs in a bowl until light and frothy. When milk is scalded add corn muffin mix and beat. Then add eggs. Pour into casserole dish margarine which has been melted. Bake in 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Leftovers are good with syrup for breakfast.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in a large bowl with a wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Spread on bottom of crust.

title: Escallop Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in a greased uncovered container 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Oh-So Easy Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour the bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve 1/4 cup of the M&Ms. Mix remaining ingredients together. Spread in pan. Sprinkle with reserved candies. Bake about 30 minutes until light golden brown; cool. Cut into bars. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Lemon Chiffon Cake
instructions: Separate eggs. In egg whites add 1/2 tsp. cream of tartar and beat well until very stiff. In yolks add flour sugar salt baking powder oil extract rind and water. Beat well until creamy. Fold into egg whites do not beat. Pour into 10 inch tube pan. Do not grease. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes and 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes more.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Combine sugar buttermilk soda oleo and Karo. Cook over low heat until candy makes hard ball in cold water about 45 to 55 minutes. Add pecans and vanilla. Start beating by hand until it gets thick and loses its sheen. Drop on wax paper and cool.

title: One Pan Dinner
instructions: In electric frypan brown pork chops and onion. Wash sweet potatoes and microwave 10 minutes on High.

title: Frankfurters And Sauerkraut
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and cook 1 to 1 1/2 hours the longer the better. Add frankfurters and cook 30 minutes longer.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Break up angel food cake into bite-size pieces. Place pieces in bottom of casserole dish. For ease in mixing allow cream cheese to soften out of refrigerator for a couple of hours. With wire whisk blend together cream cheese whipped topping and sugar until nearly smooth. Layer this mixture on top of cake pieces. Top dessert with one or both cans of pie filling depending on your liking. Because of layering a deep dish is best. However if using a shallow pan at least 9 x 13-inch is recommended.

title: Manicotti(Jean Stapleton'S Recipe)
instructions: Grease griddle lightly. Wipe away excess grease with paper towel. Put one teaspoonful batter on griddle. These do not need to brown. Do not turn. They are done when top appears dry.

title: Angel Food Cake And Strawberries
instructions: Mix jello according to directions minus 1 cup of cold water. Refrigerate until partly set. Mix in Cool Whip and strawberries. Mix well. Add angel food cake and stir just until mixed. Refrigerate until set. This is better is it is made a day ahead of time.

title: Before Breakfast
instructions: Fry sausage and drain off fat. Beat eggs. Add milk salt and mustard. Layer in 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan bread sausage and cheese. Pour egg mixture over all. Put in cold oven. Set temperature at 350\u00b0. Bake 45 minutes.

title: Spanish Cabbage
instructions: Fry bacon; break in pieces. Saute onion and green pepper. Chop cabbage. Add tomatoes salt and pepper and vinegar. Put all in one pot and boil until cabbage is done.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Drain pineapple measuring syrup. Add water to make 1/2 cup if necessary. Stir into gelatin with lemon juice. Blend in mayonnaise. Chill until very thick. Fold fruits nuts and Cool Whip into jello. Pour into 2 freezing trays or a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Freeze until firm or at least 3 to 4 hours. To serve cut in squares or slices. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Herbed Toast
instructions: Preheat broiler. In small mixing bowl combine margarine basil and parsley; mix thoroughly. Onto each slice of bread spread half of the margarine mixture; sprinkle half of the cheese on each slice of bread. On nonstick baking sheet arrange bread slices herb-side up and broil until cheese is golden about 1 minute.

title: 8 Layer Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer as follows 1/2 head shredded lettuce bacon eggs peas onion mixed dressing ham and Swiss cheese. Press down after each layer. The dressings will spread thickly over entire surface and top with ham and cheese. Cover with Glad Wrap and refrigerate at least 12 hours.

title: Cole Slaw Without Mayonnaise
instructions: Grate or shred cabbage and soak in water for an hour Drain and rinse well and pat off water. Mix sour cream sugar and cider vinegar well and pour over cabbage and mix well. If using caraway seeds spin then in the blender long enough to release the oils and mix in the slaw.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Blend 1/2 of the sugar with cornstarch. Add pineapple with juice. Cook stirring constantly until mixture is thick and clear. Cool. Blend cream cheese (softened at room temperature) with 1/2 cup sugar and salt. Add eggs one at a time stirring well after each egg is added. Blend in milk and vanilla. Spread the cooked pineapple mixture over the bottom of pastry shell. Pour in cream cheese mixture and sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes.
