Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 50 minutes. Cool before serving. Serves 7 or 8.

title: Chocolate Pie (No Cook)
instructions: Combine sugar and butter. Beat in electric mixer at medium speed five minutes. Add chocolate and one egg; beat five minutes. Add other egg vanilla and salt; beat five minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon in baked pie shell and chill.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. This will keep covered in refrigerator for a week a month or until all has been eaten.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Prepare your crust. Cook crushed strawberries. After cooked until clear add 1 Knox gelatine dissolved in 2 tablespoons cold water. Add berries into baked pie shell.

title: Smothered Deer Tips
instructions: Cut stew meat into small pieces and brown in cooking oil. Remove meat and saute onion and garlic in the oil. When onion is tender put the meat back into oil with onion and garlic. Add flour and toss until blended. Salt and pepper to taste. Lower heat and slowly add water until sauce is not too thick. Add Kitchen Bouquet to darken and simmer on low flame until meat is tender about 1 hour.

title: Banana Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: In a large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Stir in ReaLemon and vanilla. Slice 2 bananas; dip in lemon juice. Drain and line crust. Pour over bananas; cover. Chill 3 hours or until set. Before serving slice remaining bananas; dip in lemon juice drain and garnish top of pie. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Coconut Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
instructions: Mix eggs sugar flour oleo milk coconut and vanilla. Pour into 10-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Golden Chicken
instructions: Place chicken parts in a single layer in large baking pan. Cover with soup onion and Chablis wine. Cover dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with rice and vegetable.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate overnight. Serve cold!

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. When ready to eat add dressing and mix then add crushed Fritos.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Measure all ingredients into a large bowl. Mix 1/2 minute on low speed scraping bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes at high speed scraping bowl occasionally. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat margarine with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Add about half of the flour the 1 cup sugar the egg vanilla baking soda and cream of tartar. Beat until thoroughly combined. Beat in remaining flour. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Combine the 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon. Roll balls in sugar cinnamon. Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 11 minutes or until edges are golden. Makes about 36.

title: Penne Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. In a skillet combine all other ingredients and simmer. Drain pasta and combine with heated tomato mixture. Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: John'S Favorite Buffalo Wings
instructions: Melt butter and mix with red hot sauce. Cook wings in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. After hour is up pour sauce mixture over wings. Turn oven up to 425\u00b0 and cook for 1 more hour. Serve hot with Blue cheese salad dressing for dipping.

title: President Clinton'S Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: In a large bowl toss sugar flour and cornmeal with a fork. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes. Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

title: Crispy Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Roll chicken pieces in flour to evenly cover all sides. Dip chicken in egg white and roll in cornflake crumbs. Place on prepared cookie sheet. Bake 20 - 30 minutes for boneless breast halves or 45 - 55 minutes for chicken pieces.

title: Hamburger And Rice Casserole
instructions: Add garlic onion flakes basil flakes and mushrooms to olive oil; mix well. Add tomatoes and cook for 1/2 hour. Brown crumbled hamburger. Add eggs to cool rice. Add hamburger and rice mixture to the tomato mixture. Put in 2 or 3-quart casserole. Add salt to taste (optional). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Sausage Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package. Chop onion pepper and celery. Brown sausage and drain then add vegetables. Cook until vegetables are limp. Add rice and soup and pour into greased 3-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Alkali Bars
instructions: Bring to a boil the raisins and water. Turn off heat. Stir in salad oil; cool to lukewarm. Stir in sugar and egg. Sift together flour and spices. Beat dry ingredients into raisin mixture. Stir in the walnuts. Pour into a greased baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Baked Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix well first 6 ingredients and place in greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Combine 1 1/2 sticks melted margarine and crackers and spread on top of potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cover loosely with foil during latter part of baking to prevent drying out. Serves 12-15.

title: Quail Our Favorite Way
instructions: Shake salt over each quail covering all parts. Put quail in sack with flour and shake well. Oil should be hot enough that it bubbles when quail are placed in it. Put quail in oil with breast side down. Turn when browned with total cooking time not over 10 minutes. Remove quail to drain on paper towel. Pour off oil into container reserving enough oil and drippings to make gravy.

title: Oatmeal Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar cocoa butter and milk to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir in oatmeal. Drop by tablespoon onto well buttered wax paper. Cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients (in order listed) in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover; bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Peach Almond Cream Tart
instructions: Bake pie shell at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. In bowl combine condensed milk sour cream lemon and extract; mix well. Reserving 6 peach slices spread remaining filling on bottom of pie shell. Top with sour cream mixture. Top with reserved peach slices and almonds. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool. Refrigerate.

title: Hungry Jack'S Pancakes
instructions: Break eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork. Add buttermilk and mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix just long enough to blend well. Pour onto hot griddle and brown lightly on both sides.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: In large saucepan or kettle having a lid brown meat in oil. Add salt spices and onion soup mix. Stir in boiling water tomato sauce and soy sauce. Cook and simmer about 15 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Blend 3/4 cup sugar flour and salt in top of double boiler. Add milk slowly and cook until thick stirring constantly. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Beat egg yolks; combine with custard. Cook 2 minutes longer. Add vanilla.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix fried hamburger and seasoning. Put in bottom of baking dish. Heat refried beans and spread over top. Mix sour cream chili dip and cheese. Spread over beans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Heat Tostitos and serve.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Beat eggs and add milk. Add salt and mustard. Cube bread; stir into eggs. Add cheese and sausage. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Heat all ingredients in a double boiler. Serve warm with crackers.

title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Simmer raisins and water in saucepan over low heat until raisins are plump 20 to 30 minutes. Drain water into measuring cup. Add water to make 1/2 cup. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cream shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in raisin liquid. Blend flour baking powder soda salt and spices. Stir in. Add rolled oats nuts and raisins. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Punch For A Bunch
instructions: Mix and chill. Freeze some of the punch in a mold to keep cold. Do not add ice. The ice will melt and water down the punch.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix beaten eggs syrup sugar peanut butter and vanilla together. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until crust is brown.

title: Fat-Free Fudge Brownies
instructions: Combine flour cocoa sugar and salt. Stir to mix well. Stir in applesauce egg whites and vanilla. Fold in nuts if desired. Coat an 8-inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray. Spread batter evenly in pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 23 to 25 minutes or until the edges are firm and the center is almost set. Cool to room temperature. Cut into squares and serve. Yields 16 servings. Contains 80 calories and 4 grams fat.

title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
instructions: In large saucepan boil/steam broccoli in 1/2 cup water. Remove about 1/4 of the broccoli and set aside. Put remaining broccoli in blender and puree until smooth. In large saucepan over medium heat combine flour butter and 1 cup of water until creamy. Pour mixture from blender into flour mixture. Rinse blender with 1/2 water and cream or evaporated milk and pour in flour-broccoli. Stir and season with spices. Microwave Cheez Whiz and stir into soup. Chop broccoli that was set aside and add to soup. Heat thoroughly.

title: Chow Mein Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown beef onions and celery; add remaining ingredients and stir well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake for 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Super Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients; add onions salt pepper and sour cream. Place in casserole. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix broth and soup together. Heat until mixed well. Pour over chicken.

title: Steak House-Style Grilled Steak
instructions: Mix seasonings and brown sugar. Brush steaks with oil. Sprinkle seasoning mixture over both sides; press into steaks. Place steaks on medium-hot grill. Grill 6 to 8 minutes on each side or until cooked to desired doneness.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: In large bowl cream together oleo and sugar. Add eggs; beat until light and fluffy. Add almond extract. Stir in flour and baking powder. Mix until smooth. Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Pour batter in pan. Spoon pie filling with the cake mixture in different places. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden and cake tests done. Filling will sink into the cake while baking. Serve warm with sweetened whipping cream or Cool Whip.

title: Vietnamese Spring Rolls(Goi)
instructions: *Or 1 pound large cleaned and deveined shrimp or 8 ounces boiled breast of chicken minced.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans on serving dish. Then layer on green chiles. Mix taco seasoning mix with 1/2 of the jar of chunky salsa sauce. Layer this on serving dish. Add grated Cheddar cheese. Layer sour cream. Spread the chopped green scallions. Then sprinkle remainder of salsa sauce on top. Keep refrigerated. Can use corn chips or tostadas to scoop the dip up. Use 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish or round plate.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and oil together. Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients add alternately with water to pumpkin mixture. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove from pan to cool.

title: Pineapple Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender (approximately 30 minutes). Remove skins. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Lightly spray a 1-quart baking dish with vegetable spray. Mash potatoes. Add pineapple juice oil and whip until fluffy. Add pineapple cinnamon nutmeg and allspice. Mix well. Place in baking dish. Spread molasses over the top. Dot with margarine. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: Line bottom of dish with 1/2 crushed cookies. Then spread pudding. Then spread rest of crushed cookies. Spread Cool Whip and then nuts.

title: Chocolate Peppermint Pie
instructions: Combine cocoa and sugar. Add to pudding mix and prepare as directed on package. Cool; add vanilla. Whip cream and fold into chocolate mixture. Pour into peppermint stick ice cream shells. Freeze.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add oil and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar and blend together. Fold into batter. Add nuts and apples. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Brown pork sausage. Drain and crumble. Mix all other ingredients together. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until set and brown. Serve hot. Serves 6.

title: Crystal'S Crab Mold
instructions: In large bowl dissolve the gelatine in water. Heat soup and add to gelatine. Add rest of ingredients; mix and mold (i.e. Tupperware jello mold container). Chill 6 hours. Unmold. Serve with crackers.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: In a bowl whisk together buttermilk 1 tablespoon flour 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Immerse tomato slices in mixture. In a heavy skillet heat over moderate heat until candy thermometer registers 350\u00b0. While oil is heating whisk together the remaining flour salt and pepper. Dredge tomatoes (1 at a time) in seasoned flour shaking off excess and fry in batches of 6 (do not crowd in skillet) until golden brown on both sides. Transfer slices to paper towel to drain. Sprinkle with salt.

title: Peg'S Shrimp Yummies
instructions: Place cheese on dish. Pour 3/4 sauce over cheese. Place shrimp on top and add rest of sauce. Sprinkle with green onions. Place crackers around dish.

title: Zucchini-Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender drain mash lightly and drain again. Make stuffing according to directions. Layer 1/2 of stuffing on bottom of 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Mix rest of ingredients together layer and then top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion bell pepper and season to taste. Layer in dish with frozen vegetables and mushroom soup. Add a layer of Velveeta cheese. Top with a layer of Tater Tots and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Pineapple Salad
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk over low heat; pour jello in stirring until dissolved. Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise mixing until well blended. Gradually add jello mixture mixing until well blended. Stir in pineapple. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into 2-quart mold; chill until firm. Unmold if you like. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix brown sugar and cocoa in 13 x 9 pan. Stir in water until well blended. Snip marshmallows into quarters and scatter over mixture. Prepare cake batter and spoon over mixture. Top with nuts. Bake for 45-50 minutes at 350 degrees. Serve warm topped with whipped cream or ice cream. Delicious!

title: Chuckwagon Stew
instructions: Coat beef in mixture of flour paprika 1 teaspoon chili powder and salt. Brown in hot fat in large Dutch oven. Add onion and garlic; cooking until soft.

title: French Pastries
instructions: Press 1 can of crescent rolls into a 13 x 9-inch pan sealing perforations. Cream 1 cup sugar with cream cheese and vanilla. Spread this over dough. Top with remaining can of dough. Brush with egg yolk. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of sugar and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Best when served same day at room temperature.

title: Golden Ruhl Broccoli
instructions: Cut off tips of broccoli only and steam or boil until almost done. Meanwhile mix soup eggs onions mayonnaise and cheese and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese. Add strawberries and juice pineapple and bananas nuts Cool Whip and lemon juice. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan or 24 muffin paper cups. Freeze.

title: Spaghetti-N-Meat
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add bell pepper onion celery and ground chuck. Cook slow until done. Mix in spaghetti mix Ragu sauce and tomato sauce. Simmer 20 minutes. Boil spaghetti. Rinse with cold water. Add to the meat sauce. Cook for 10 more minutes. Cover with cheese. Put lid on pot. Turn off heat. Serve with salad or cold slaw and garlic bread.

title: Ham And Egg Pasta
instructions: Cook fettuccini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with hot water. Keep warm. In large skillet over medium-high heat heat oil. Saute onions for 1 to 2 minutes or until crisp-tender. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in sour cream milk parsley salt and pepper. Cook stirring constantly until hot. Do not boil. Stir in turkey ham egg wedges and fettuccini; toss gently. Makes 4 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Prepare apples. Put a little lemon juice over them; set aside and cover. Add sugar and eggs to oil; mix well at low speed until creamy and smooth. Sift flour and measure. Sift again with salt soda and baking powder. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture a little at a time. Fold in well after each addition; add vanilla. When batter is stiff remove beaters and finish mixing by hand. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Saucy Apple Swirl
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Put 1/2 batter in pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle most over batter. Also sprinkle most of nuts. Add rest of batter and sprinkle rest of nuts and sugar-cinnamon. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes sometimes longer.

title: Unbaked Fruit Cake
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers. Cut candied fruit into pieces. Leave nuts whole. Mix all ingredients except milk and marshmallows. Melt marshmallows in milk and mix with other ingredients. When mixed well pack in angel food pan or 3 small loaf pans. When cool remove from pan and wrap in wax paper at room temperature.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0 and grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Place applesauce in the bottom of the pan. Mix remaining ingredients in mixing bowl and sprinkle on top of the applesauce. Bake until golden brown 15 to 20 minutes and serve warm. Makes 6 servings.

title: Holiday Hermit Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening and sugars together until creamy. Beat in eggs. Sift dry ingredients. Add to cream mixture along with buttermilk beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pinto Bean Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix well; pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Prepare the cranberries and apples in a food processor or blender. Mix together the oranges sugar and dry Jell-O then combine all ingredients together. It is best to let the relish set a couple of days before you use it. The relish can also be frozen.

title: Seviche - Raw Fish, Mexican Style And Salsa(Actually The Lemon Juice Cooks The Fish, So It'S Not Really Raw.)
instructions: *Vary the number of chilies according to your \heat tolerance\ or just dont use them. I prefer at least 3.

title: Pumpkin Rolls
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour and yeast. In saucepan heat milk shortening sugar and salt until warm. Add to dry mixture. Add egg and pumpkin. Beat at low speed 1/2 minute. Beat 3 minutes on high. Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough.

title: Surprise Supper
instructions: You will also need 4 (18 x 12-inch) pieces heavy aluminum foil.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour; add cream egg vanilla and nutmeg. Mix well with eggbeater or wire whisk. Put rhubarb in pie shell; pour cream mixture over rhubarb. Push the rhubarb pieces down so they will be well coated with the cream mixture. Flute edge of pie crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Communion Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly sifting 3 times. Add cream and milk to make a medium dough ball. Divide into 4 equal parts and knead 25 to 30 minutes. When dough is smooth and free from bubbles roll out with rolling pin onto metal baking sheets. Measure with ruler 1-inch (prick with fork) the width of cooking sheet all the way across (1-inch prick 1-inch prick). Length is 1 1/2-inches prick (1 1/2 3 4 1/2 6 7 1/2 9 10 1/2 12 13 1/2). Bake in slow oven 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 until light brown. Cut apart lengthwise with sharp knife.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix both kinds of corn sour cream cheese corn meal and butter together. Then add eggs (slightly beaten) and salt and pepper. Mix well. Bake in 1 1/2-quart casserole at 325\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until center is set. If desired you may add a cup of cooked chicken.

title: Chocolate Fried Pies
instructions: In a saucepan combine granulated sugar flour and cocoa powder. Stir in the 1/2 cup milk and butter. Stir until blended thoroughly. Bring to a boil stirring constantly until it thickens. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Let cool.

title: Onion Shortcake
instructions: Saute onions in oleo until tender. Add sour cream 1/2 cup of Cheddar cheese dill weed and salt. In a separate bowl mix corn bread mix milk egg corn and hot sauce. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Top with onion mixture. Top this with 1 1/2 cups Cheddar cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (Very good leftover!)

title: Yummy Casserole
instructions: Fry mushrooms in butter pan about 10 minutes; do not brown. Fry medium onion in butter. Combine ham cheese and mushroom mixture. Place cooked noodles in greased oblong casserole. Place ham and cheese mixture over noodles. Pour half and half over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Egg Salad
instructions: Cut cooked eggs into pieces. Stir in other ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Oatmeal Molasses Cookies
instructions: Into a medium mixing bowl sift together flour soda cloves ginger and sugar. Add margarine egg and molasses. Beat until smooth and stir in oats. Drop by level tablespoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until lightly browned; let stand a minute before removing from pan.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
instructions: Mix all ingredients; chill overnight for best flavor.

title: Tropical Pork Chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Place chops in shallow baking dish. Top with pineapple and orange juice. Bake for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Spinach-Cheese Bake
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; stir until blended. Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with cheese and bake 5 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Saut celery onion and garlic in vegetable oil until tender; add the taco seasoning and 1 cup water. Stir until mixed well. Add tomatoes and all beans with juice except pinto beans (rinse and add). Bring to a boil and simmer on low for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool.

title: Ham & Cheese Omelet Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a bowl combine cream cheese and milk whisk until smooth. Add flour and salt mix well. In a separate bowl gently whisk eggs then add cream cheese mixture mix well. Pour in a long cookie sheet (parchment paper may be used). Bake for 30 to 33 minutes or until eggs are puffy and golden. Meanwhile finely chop ham. Remove omelet from oven immediately spread dijon mustard and sprinkle 1/2 of cheese ham and green onions. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese and roll up (like a jelly roll). Let stand 5 minutes allowing cheese to melt. Slice and serve.

title: Jessie'S Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except salt. Add salt last to taste. Store in sealed container in refrigerator for at least 1 hour prior to serving. Serves 10.

title: Applesauce-Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream the oil and sugar together. Add the egg and beat until light. Blend in the vanilla and applesauce. Stir the flours baking powder baking soda cinnamon cloves oats and raisins into the creamed mixture. Blend well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Makes 24 cookies.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add strawberries and stir until thawed. Add sliced bananas pecans and pineapple. Pour half of mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan and hold in refrigerator until firm. Jell remaining half only to thick pouring consistency. Spread sour cream on first mixture and pour remaining half on top. Place in refrigerator to jell entire mixture.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and eggs. Sift together all dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients and pumpkin to creamed mixture. Add pecans and vanilla. Mix well. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes in greased and floured 9 x 13 pan at 350 degrees.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain green beans; place in casserole dish. Warm soup and water in saucepan; pour over beans. Cook in oven 20 minutes. Top with onion rings. Cook 10 more minutes.

title: Germany Gurting Cucumber Salad
instructions: Chill cream. Wash and slice cucumbers. Sprinkle with salt and sugar; add vinegar. Allow to stand 10 minutes. Add sweet cream and mix. Chill 15 minutes before serving.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and beat until smooth. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake in greased 8 x 8-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Pour into bowl the cake mix and jello. Add oil nectar and well beaten eggs. Mix at low speed then beat for 2 minutes at number 4 speed. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in pan.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Mix together soup lemon juice and mayonnaise. Cook and drain broccoli. Place in bottom of casserole. Top broccoli with chicken then pour soup mixture over all. Sprinkle top with cheese and crumbs. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Watergate Salad(Pistachio)
instructions: Mix dry pudding and pineapple. Fold in Cool Whip nuts and marshmallows. Fill 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce and then onions in large bowl. Mix mayonnaise with sugar and stir in peas (drained). Add cheese and top with bacon bits.

title: Rib Ticklin' Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and let simmer for 20 minutes. Brush sauce on meat the last 20 minutes of grilling.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Pour stewed tomatoes water and spice in a large pot with garlic pepper and crushed red pepper. When mixture comes to a boil stir in onions zucchini and yellow squash. Stew (boil) for 2 hours stirring every 15 minutes. Serve in individual bowls; garnish with freshly grated cheese. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tuna Walnut Spread
instructions: Serve with crackers (Ritz are best).

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Hard-boil eggs and peel. Boil all ingredients except eggs in a saucepan. Simmer for several minutes. Cool until just warm and add shelled boiled eggs. Keep refrigerated a day or so to blend spices.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix milk and eggs. Add lemon juice. Pour into a prepared vanilla wafer pie crust. Chill.

title: Tacos In Pasta Shells
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain fat. On low heat add cream cheese salt and chili powder. Simmer 5 minutes. Cook pasta shells; drain. Toss in butter. Fill with beef mixture.

title: Chocolate Delight Dessert
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients in 9 x 13 baking dish; spread out for crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Cheese Ball
instructions: Press shredded carrots between paper towels to remove excess moisture; set aside. In large bowl combine cheeses and minced onion. Stir in shredded carrots and broccoli. Cover tightly. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Shape mixture into a ball; wrap with plastic wrap. Makes one cheese ball.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together and chill.

title: Shrimp And Rice
instructions: Cook shrimp in boiling water with a little salt about 10 minutes and peel. Cook the rice in shrimp water. Saute onions and bell pepper (chopped) in margarine. Add rice and stir. Add Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper to taste then shrimp. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Herb Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan; remove from heat. Stir in lemon peel flour dill weed and salt. Blend in half and half; cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Blend a small amount of hot mixture with egg yolk; blend back into hot mixture. Stir well; cook for 1 minute longer. Serve over cooked vegetables.

title: Peach Dump Cake
instructions: Pour sliced peaches into ungreased cake pan. Pour dry cake mix onto that. Cover with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cake does not jiggle when moved. To serve top with Cool Whip.

title: Light Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix all ingredients together; as you do for biscuit dough. Put wax paper and then a towel over bowl. Let stand and rise for 1 1/2 hours. Knead dough until stiff using 1/2 cup flour. Place in a greased loaf pan. Brush with melted butter and let rise for 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Old Time Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and salt in iron skillet. Add milk oleo and Karo. Cook on high until when dropped in cold water the candy wont separate makes a ball in bottom of cup of cold water. Take off heat; beat. Add vanilla and beat until it looks shiny. Pour in buttered platter. Can add pecans peanut butter or coconut.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine cauliflower broccoli onion and water chestnuts; toss well. Combine remaining ingredients mixing well. Pour over vegetables and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Put chocolate chips sugar vanilla egg and salt in blender. Heat milk to just boiling. Pour into blender. Blend 1 minute or until thoroughly blended. Pour into 6 individual serving cups. Chill and serve with whipped topping.

title: David'S Favorite Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container until ready to use. Then add 3 to 4 heaping teaspoonfuls to a cup of hot water or 2 to 3 tablespoons to a glass of ice water and enjoy.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Mix ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on high until melted then on low for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Frozen Fruit Dessert
instructions: Mix together well and freeze. Will keep 4 to 6 weeks.

title: Beef Enchiladas
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet and pour off excess fat. Add taco seasoning and water. Simmer until reduced. Place equal amounts of taco meat on each tortilla. Add some refried beans if desired. Put some salsa in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Roll up tortillas and place seam down in pan. Top with more salsa and the cheese. Put in oven at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes or microwave 6 to 8 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding mix pineapple with juice marshmallows and pecans. Add Cool Whip and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix the sugar cocoa vanilla peanut butter and nuts together. Melt the butter or margarine. Add to mixture. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan lightly buttered. Refrigerate and cut.

title: Fruity Mermaid Kabobs
instructions: For each kabob thread a watermelon wedge large at the bottom onto a 6-inch narrow cocktail straw to make the tail of the mermaid. Next thread a prune onto the straw push gently next to the watermelon to tighten and look like a waist. Next thread a cantaloupe ball for the face. Pull in a mound of alfalfa sprouts from the container and stretch the mound just enough to keep the sprouts bunched together. Shape the hair and insert onto straw letting hair drape around face.

title: Holiday Fruit Cookies
instructions: Mix well shortening brown sugar and eggs. Add buttermilk and stir in flour. It will be easier to work with if you chill dough overnight. Drop by teaspoon on baking sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until done. Yields 7 dozen.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in salt water until tender. Drain off all of water. Put cabbage in casserole dish.

title: Mushrooms With Garlic Butter
instructions: Mince the garlic. Wash the mushrooms quickly then trim and slice them. Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat. When the foam subsides add the mushrooms the minced garlic 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper. Cook stirring occasionally until mushrooms are browned and tender about 5 minutes. Taste for seasoning and add salt and pepper if needed. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

title: Apricot Nut Supreme Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small saucepan melt chocolate and margarine over low heat. Stir constantly until mixture becomes a curdling consistency; remove from heat. Add sugar eggs and extract; stir quickly to blend.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes and drain. Combine other ingredients except crackers to make sauce. Combine sauce with broccoli. Pour into casserole. Sprinkle top with cracker crumbs. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. This may be frozen or refrigerated before baking.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a microwave-safe glass bowl mix first 3 ingredients together and cook on High for 7 to 9 minutes until mixture bubbles and peanuts are brown. Quickly stir in margarine and vanilla. Cook on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Add baking soda stirring quickly until mixture is foamy. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet. Let cool for 15 minutes until firm. Break into pieces or cut. Makes 1 1/4 pounds.

title: Salad(Christmas Or Valentine'S Day)
instructions: Bring water to a boil; add jello. Stir until dissolved. Add frozen berries; continue to stir until berries are thawed apart. Add applesauce. Stir until well mixed. Set in refrigerator until set.

title: Lisa'S Famous Breakfast Eggs Florentine
instructions: Cover the bottom of shallow baking dish (10 x 6 x 2-inch) with spinach. Break eggs around outside edge of dish. Pierce egg yolks twice and egg whites several times with a toothpick. Mix soup pepper and onion flakes. Pour around eggs. Cover spinach completely. Cover and cook on High for 7 to 8 minutes or until eggs are almost set. Sprinkle cheese. Let stand covered 5 minutes. Serves 6 people.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients but ginger ale the day before. Fill ice trays with mixture and put 1 cherry per cube (optional). Freeze until ready to serve. Mix ginger ale and ice cubes in large punch bowl.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Lightly mix and form into loaf.

title: Chicken Broccoli Vegetable Saute!
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove chicken; keep warm. In same skillet in remaining margarine cook broccoli carrots and mushrooms 5 minutes stirring often. Stir in soup milk and pepper. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash and water. Cover and cook slowly 10 minutes; drain. In skillet saute onion and pepper in butter 3 minutes. Combine all ingredients. Spoon into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Taco Dip
instructions: Let cream cheese soften. Spread on bottom of dish. Spread 2 cans of green chilies then chopped onion then chili. Layer second set of green chilies. Cover with cheeses. Bake at 350 for approximately 30 minutes. Serve with chips.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Separate rolls into 8 triangles. Place triangles onto pizza pan. Press to form sides of crust. Seal perforations. Spoon sausage over dough. Sprinkle with hash browns and Cheddar cheese.

title: Meat Loaf(From Ann Landers)
instructions: Mix together thoroughly. Put into loaf pan and cover with two strips of bacon. Pour one can (8 ounce) tomato sauce and bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Mary Ann Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add beaten eggs cocoa soda and salt. Gradually sift\tin flour and sour milk. Add hot water and banana flavoring; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. This cake is best when mixed by hand instead of using a mixer.

title: Basil Chicken With Rice
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan over high heat heat broth tomatoes garlic and basil to boiling. Add chicken rice peas and hot pepper sauce. Return to boiling; remove from heat. Cover. Let stand 5 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed. Fluff rice with fork before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven-Barbecued Beef Brisket
instructions: Trim brisket well. Place in large deep roasting pan. Heat Worcestershire sauce liquid smoke and margarine. Pour over brisket. Cover tightly with heavy-duty aluminum foil. Cook in oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour per pound. (Or cook at 425\u00b0 for 1/2 hour then reduce heat and cook at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes per pound.) Meat is done when fork inserts easily. Cool for 30 minutes and cut with electric knife into thin slices.

title: Percolator Punch
instructions: Place sugar and spices in basket of percolator. Place juice and water in lower part of coffee pot and allow to perk just like coffee.

title: Wild West Corn
instructions: Melt cream cheese and milk stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Beat egg until smooth. Add milk and shortening. Mix thoroughly. Pour this in flour. Mix to a very smooth dough. Drop by spoonfuls into broth. Cover tightly and cook 10 to 14 minutes or until done depending on size of dumplings.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside. Saute celery and onions. Cook rice by directions adding water chestnuts celery and onions. Into a large buttered Corning casserole put layer of rice then layer of chicken mixture and then sprinkle with cheese. Alternate layers until all is used. A little Tabasco sauce can be added. Garnish with small pieces of chicken cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Mix sugar cream of tartar and cinnamon. Pour in boiling water. Boil until soft ball stage. Remove from fire. Add vanilla and pecans. Stir until mixture sugars. Turn out on waxed paper and separate pecans.

title: Delicious Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine oleo sugar and syrup. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved (do not boil). Let cool slightly. Add to beaten eggs vanilla salt and pecans. Pour in unbaked pie crust. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Graham Cracker Crumb Crust
instructions: Blend ingredients together; spread out in a 9-inch pan. If desired bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Chewy Brownies
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in bowl. Mix at low speed until smooth. Combine baking soda and flour in sifter. Sift in dry ingredients. Pour into 13 x 9 baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat melt butter; blend in flour and add milk all at once. Stir until thickened. Add grated cheese salt and pepper. Continue to cook and stir until cheese is melted. Remove from heat and spread 1/2 of the cheese sauce on the bottom of a shallow 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Place potatoes on top of cheese sauce sprinkle with onions and bacon. Add remaining sauce over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until potatoes are tender.

title: Cheeseburger Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Meanwhile press biscuits into 12-inch round greased baking sheet or 12-inch pizza pan pinching edges of biscuits together to seal. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Friendly Fungus-Marinated
instructions: Gently boil the mushrooms for 1 minute drain. The heat will help the marinade to absorb into the mushrooms. Serve hot or cold.

title: Beer Batter Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Add beer and beat 60 strokes with spoon. Fill a lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and drizzle top with melted butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or golden and tests clean. Remove from pan and cool on rack.

title: Pork Chops In Apple Juice
instructions: Brown chops in a 12-inch Dutch oven in margarine. Remove chops and saute apples and onion slices in drippings until tender. Set aside in a\tbowl. Return chops to Dutch oven. Add apple juice bouillon sage and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Add apples and onions to\tDutch oven and cook\tfor 5 minutes.\tRemove chops apples and onions. Stir\tin the half and half. Cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens. Pour over chops and serve.

title: Roman Holiday
instructions: Add to ground beef and salt and pepper celery onion green pepper and mushrooms. Simmer until soft. Cook spaghetti (broken in thirds) and add Cheddar cheese and tomato soup.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix and boil salt vinegar pepper sugar oil and water. Cool mixture and pour over remaining ingredients premixed in a large bowl. Set for several hours in refrigerator.

title: Batter Dip For Frying
instructions: \How many ways can you eat peanut butter. Let me count the ways.\

title: Truthahn Brust In Zwiebelrahm Sosse(Turkey Breast In Onion Sauce)
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Lay turkey slices in shallow baking dish (spray with nonstick coating). Mix together whipping cream and soup mix; pour over turkey. Sprinkle with parsley. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake another 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Snicker Salad
instructions: Put the Cool Whip in a bowl. Next core the apples but leave the peeling on the apples. Dice the apples and put into the Cool Whip. Cut up the Snicker bars and slice the bananas. Combine all with the Cool Whip and mix together. Serve.

title: German Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potatoes add salt and egg and mix well. Drop by tablespoons in well-greased frying pan spreading real thin. Fry slowly until browned on each side.

title: White Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together three times. Cream sugar and shortening; add milk stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and spoon into 9-inch pie plate or shallow ovenproof dish. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Sprinkle with sliced green onions and chopped tomatoes if desired. Serve with tortilla chips or crackers. Makes 2 cups. Preparation time 10 minutes. Cook time is 25 minutes.

title: Oriental Skewers
instructions: Wash and cut chicken into 1-inch chunks. Also cut sirloin into chunks. Marinate chicken in teriyaki sauce for 1 hour. Marinate steak in Worcestershire sauce for 1 hour. Cut and wash peppers and onion into large chunks. Put peppers and meat on skewer alternating. Cook on grill until done. Serve over rice with extra sauces sauteed mushrooms and pineapple chunks. Do not use the sauce that the meat marinated in. Use fresh sauces.

title: Christmas Crunch
instructions: Boil syrup butter sugar and salt together for 5 minutes at medium-high. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and soda; return to heat and cook 2 more minutes. Pour over Rice Chex almonds and coconut; mix well. Pour out onto greased cookie sheet (large). Cool cut and eat.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Blend together in blender then chill.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Add milk to fill line on container. Freeze in electric or manual freezer until solid. Makes 1/2 gallon.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large 3 gallon pan; cook until mixture comes to rolling boil. Turn heat down until sauce is barely boiling and cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Stir often but sauce must be stirred constantly almost all of the last hour to keep from sticking. Store in 12 (1/2 pint) Mason jars.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherry Cookies
instructions: In large bowl stir together flour cocoa salt baking powder and soda. In mixer bowl beat together butter and sugar on low speed of electric mixer until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Gradually add dry ingredients to cream mixture; beat until well blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down center of dough with thumb. Drain cherries and reserve juice. Place a cherry in center of each cookie. In saucepan combine chocolate chips and condensed milk. Heat until chocolate is melted. Stir in 4 teaspoons of cherry juice. Spoon about 1 teaspoon frosting over each cherry spreading to cover cherry. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes. Remove to wire rack and cool.

title: Broccoli And Walnut Stir-Fry
instructions: In a large skillet or wok heat the oil until quite hot. Add the walnuts and saute for 1 minute. Add the broccoli and cook over medium heat tossing frequently until tender and crisp about 4 minutes. Add the soy sauce and cook 1 minute more. Serve immediately garnished with red bell pepper.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and spices together in lg bowl. Add milk eggs butter and molasses. Stir well. Add pumpkin and mix until all blended together. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes and decrease heat to 375 for 1 hour or until a toothpick comes out clean when stuck into middle of the pie.

title: Classic Green Bean Bake(Yields 6 Servings)
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole combine soup milk soya sauce and pepper. Add beans and 1/2 of the onion rings. Stir. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes until hot and bubbly. Stir. Top with remaining onion rings. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Zelma'S Never Fail Dumplings
instructions: Beat eggs and shortening. Add dry ingredients and enough milk to make a stiff dough. Knead dough on floured surface. Roll out very thin cut in strips and drop into boiling broth with a teaspoon of Accent seasoning. When dumplings are almost done add a few drops yellow food coloring and 1 cup of cream.

title: Easy Grilled Chicken
instructions: Layer chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle salt pepper garlic and onion powder to your taste. Place in microwave oven and cook chicken until done (around 30 to 40 minutes depending on your oven). Remove chicken and place on heated outdoor grill. Baste barbecue sauce over it and put lid down. It only has to stay on the grill for a few minutes to get the smoked flavor without all of the time and trouble of regular grilled chicken.

title: Rhubarb Sauce For Ice Cream
instructions: Barely cover the ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over low heat until tender. Sauce will be kind of thick.

title: New England Baked Beans
instructions: Cook dry beans in water until softened (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Drain and put into crock-pot. Add all remaining ingredients; mix well. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or high 4 to 6 hours.

title: Grandma Cocking'S Cornish Pasties
instructions: Note Ingredients listed are for each pastie.

title: Buttermilk Fudge
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a buttered Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture reaches soft ball stage or candy thermometer registers 243\u00b0; remove from heat. Cool to 180\u00b0. Stir in vanilla. Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until mixture thickens and begins to lose its gloss. Stir in pecans. Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan or baking dish; cool. Yield 1 1/4 pounds.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk and beaten eggs. Stir until well blended add squash 1 c of the cracker crumbs and 1 c of cheese stir until blended. Pour into a buttered 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Mix together the remaining cheese and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve 8.

title: Sunshine Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water; add sour cream. Beat until smooth and frothy. Add pineapple and vegetables. Pour into bowl; let set. Also good with orange-pineapple jello.

title: Sandwich Or Cracker Spread
instructions: Blend until consistency wanted. Make sandwiches or serve on crackers.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Mix sausage beef pepper onion mushrooms and pepperoni in skillet and brown. Add sauce and sugar. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Goulash
instructions: Brown bacon in heavy 3-quart pot with a tight fitting lid. Remove bacon and brown onions in drippings until transparent. Remove pot from heat and add paprika beef salt caraway bacon and half green pepper and tomato. Return to heat and cover tightly. Simmer over low heat stirring occasionally and add small amounts of water as needed. Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is tender. Add garlic potatoes the rest of peppers and tomatoes. Add enough water to completely cover meat and vegetables. Bring to a boil; simmer 30 minutes. Serve with very small bow tie egg noodles.

title: Chicken A L'Orange
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Arrange quartered chicken pieces in a long shallow baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes turning pieces twice during cooking. In a small skillet melt butter; stir in salt pepper paprika and tarragon; pour evenly over chicken pieces. Continue to bake for about 15 minutes until chicken is tender and browned. While chicken bakes prepare sauce.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in sugar salt and warm water solution. Add melted shortening and enough flour to make a medium stiff dough. Grease dough and cover and let rise until double in size. Make rolls; let rise again and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Curry Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend well and chill before serving with cucumbers carrots cauliflower celery etc.

title: Turkish Delight
instructions: Bring orange juice to a boil.\tStir boiling juice into gelatin. Dissolve\tcompletely. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan lightly sprayed with oil. Chill 3 hours or more. Slice into squares and coat with confectioners sugar then serve.

title: Custard(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix Egg Beaters with sugar vanilla and salt. Gradually add scalded milk and pour into ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg and place dish in a warm-water bath. Bake in slow oven 1 hour or until set.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Boil lemon and orange rinds with cloves and cinnamon bark for 5 minutes. Strain; add juices sugar and the tea. Serve piping hot. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Whiskey Slush
instructions: Add the tea bags to the boiling water in a large glass bowl. Let cool. Stir in sugar and water. Add frozen orange juice and lemonade. Stir well. Finally stir in whiskey. Freeze in a container with a lid. Serve in a glass with Sprite.

title: Momma'S String Bean Dish
instructions: Drain green beans and chestnuts. Mix together the soup sherry oregano salt and pepper. Toss in green beans and chestnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Nice if topped with \canned\ onion rings or slivered almonds.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Cream sugar shortening eggs and milk. Add flour and spices; mix well. Stir in rhubarb. Pour into greased pan; add topping.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Peel carrots; cut in 1/4-inch thick diagonal slices. Cook in 1 1/2 cups water for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Melt butter or margarine; add brown sugar brandy or cognac. Stir well. Add to carrots in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook 2 to 3 minutes longer.

title: Easy Cobbler Pie Topping
instructions: Prepare fruit or berries and sugar to taste (can use fresh or canned). Mix flour and sugar. Add beaten egg and mix until mixture is like coarse cornmeal. (I do this with my fingers; if preferred you can use a fork.) Sprinkle mixture over fruit or berry cobbler filling in a pie plate or glass long dish.

title: Green Bean Sauce
instructions: Mix mayonnaise vegetable oil grated onion Worcestershire Tabasco sauce dry mustard and eggs and serve over green beans.

title: Great Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Layer bread sausage and cheese in a buttered baking dish. Combine eggs milk salt and dry mustard; pour over the ingredients in the baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake the next morning in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quickie Frozen Dessert
instructions: Layer large oblong Pyrex dish (10 x 14-inch) with ice cream sandwiches. Spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle candy bits on top. Cover and place in freezer. When ready to serve remove from freezer. Let sit for 5 minutes. Cut into squares. Makes 12 to 15 generous servings.

title: Sweet Pastry Pockets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cream brown sugar with cream cheese. Add 1/8 teaspoon salt and vanilla extract; beat well. Stir in coconut. Chill while preparing dough. Combine flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cream butter with confectioners sugar and egg yolk. Blend in orange rind and dry ingredients; mix well. Add orange juice; mix until a stiff dough forms. Roll out half at a time on well floured surface to 1/8-inch thickness. Cut with floured 2 1/2 or 3-inch cutter. Place 1/2 teaspoon filling in center of each; moisten edge with water. Fold in half; seal edges. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining dough. Make 1/2-inch cut in top of each for escape of steam. Brush with slightly beaten egg white. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until light golden brown. Makes 36 cookies.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Mold(Easy)
instructions: Peel and cook onions in salted boiling water until tender. Drain. Add butter and sprinkle with white sugar. Heat and toss onions over low heat until browned and glazed.

title: Corn And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Chicken Lasagna
instructions: You can add more chopped cooked chicken. Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and saute 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in soup and next five ingredients. Reserve 1 cup sauce. Drain spinach well pressing between layers of paper towels. Stir together spinach cottage cheese and next three ingredients. Place three lasagna noodles in a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Layer with half each of sauce spinach mixture and chicken. Sprinkle with 1 cup Cheddar cheese. Repeat procedure. Top with remaining 3 noodles and reserved 1 cup of sauce. Cover and chill up to one day ahead. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup cheese and bake 5 more minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10 people. Can use Contadina Light Alfredo Sauce found in the dairy section of the grocery.

title: Mom'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Put everything in bowl. Mix together. Place in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mission Artichoke And Spinach Frittata
instructions: Melt 1/4 cup or less margarine in 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Beat the eggs then gradually mix in the remaining ingredients one at a time in order. Pour in the 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes.

title: California Chicken Soup
instructions: In stock pot combine all ingredients except tortellini and broccoli. Bring to a boil; add tortellini. Reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes. Add broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove bay leaves.

title: Sauerkraut Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients; melt fat in skillet and brown meatballs. Mix sugar water and vinegar. Spoon over meat. Simmer for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Creamy Peanut Dessert
instructions: In a bowl combine cracker crumbs and peanuts. Stir in 1/4 cup butter and 2 tablespoons peanut butter; mix well. Set aside 1/2 cup for topping. Press the remaining crumb mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile in a mixing bowl beat cream cheese and 1/2 cup peanut butter until smooth. Beat in sugar and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip; spoon over crust. Drizzle with chocolate; sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cover and freeze for up to 3 months. Remove from the freezer 15 minutes before serving.

title: Pete'S Sauerkraut
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan. Cook on high heat for 2 minutes stirring\tconstantly. Cook on medium heat for 7 minutes stirring often to keep from burning. Delicious over hot dogs.

title: Applesauce Cake With Lemon Glaze
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt cinnamon and nutmeg; set aside. Cream shortening with sugar. Add eggs and applesauce. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 2 minutes. Fold in raisins. Spoon batter into a nonstick 12-cup fluted pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until wooden pick inserted into center of cake comes clean. Cool 10 minutes. Invert onto a wire rack for cooling. Drizzle sugar and lemon juice over cake. Makes 16 servings.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Heat milk 3 minutes on roast. Cut cheese in pieces then add to hot milk. Heat 5 minutes on 1/2 power until cheese is soft. Mix until smooth. Add beaten egg butter and seeds. Beat until well mixed. Put in small containers and freeze. Just super on any crackers.

title: Chambord Brownies
instructions: Mix together above ingredients and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Allow to cool.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning. Layer the following in a 9 x 13-inch pan salsa taco shells to cover pan hamburger salsa refried beans sour cream and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Six-Week Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: In large bowl add 2 cups bran Crisco oil and raisins. Pour boiling water over the mixture and let stand. Mix remaining bran sugar eggs and buttermilk. Sift flour soda and salt. Combine cover and store in refrigerator. May use as desired.

title: Corn And Sausage Bake
instructions: Brown breakfast sausage. Drain off grease. Mix all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until bubbling and brown.

title: Peanut Butter S'Mores(Microwave)
instructions: For each smore spread 1 graham cracker square with peanut butter. Top with semi-sweet chocolate pieces and marshmallows. Cover with another graham cracker square.

title: Namak Paaray
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and add small amounts of water enough to make a smooth binding dough. Divide dough into 3 parts. Set aside for 10-15 minutes.

title: Deviled Ham And Chive Balls
instructions: Blend ham pretzels Worcestershire and pepper thoroughly and form 25 balls using a rounded 1/2 teaspoon for each. Freeze on cookie sheet for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Burritos
instructions: In a large stock pot add 4 quarts of water and all of the ingredients except the tomatoes and bring to a boil for 40 minutes. Remove the chicken with a large spoon and remove the chicken bones and skin. Skim fat oils from the top of the broth put the chicken meat back into the pot add tomatoes and boil for 15 minutes. Serve on flour tortillas with salsa or hot sauce rice or beans optional. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Creme De Menthe Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar then add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool thoroughly.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour or until meat is no longer pink. Drain and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables; drain. Line bottom of casserole with vegetables. Mix onions cheese and mayonnaise and seal over vegetables. Mix melted oleo and crackers and put on top and bake until bubbly (not too fast).

title: Corn Dodgers(Hush Puppies)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together drop by rounded teaspoon into hot grease. Fry until golden turning once.

title: Italian Squares
instructions: Saute beef onions and garlic until meat loses red color. Add spinach rice and cheese; mix well. Mix milk and eggs salt and pepper and add to rice mixture. Place in shallow casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until set. Meanwhile blend sauce and seasonings and simmer 5 minutes. Cut spinach meat mixture into squares. Top with tomato sauce and grated Italian cheese.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and oil together. Add dry ingredients. Mix together. Add carrots and nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes in a greased 10 x 13-inch pan or 3 layers.

title: Continental Frosting
instructions: Cook milk and flour until thick; take off heat (cool). Cream sugar and butter with mixer until fluffy 4 to 5 minutes. Add flour and milk mixture. Beat another 4 to 5 minutes. Add vanilla. Keep cake cool after frosting (refrigerate). Add crushed pieces of pineapple and flavoring if you want it (just a little). Very good over chiffon cake angel cake or any other kind of cake.

title: Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Lay out cream cheese overnight. Mix all ingredients with mixer. Pour in pie crust. Let stand in refrigerator all day or night. Put some flavor of pie filling over pie if desired (blueberry or strawberry).

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add yeast to warm water and let dissolve. Mix milk yeast and shortening with dry ingredients until slightly sticky. Form into rolls and place on ungreased baking pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Bake immediately or cover and store in refrigerator up to one week.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: For whole wheat bread use 3 cups whole-wheat flour and 3 cups bread flour.

title: French Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Stir in chocolate. Add eggs one at a time beating at high speed for 5 minutes after each egg. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into cooled pie shell and chill until firm (about 2 hours) or freeze.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and butter; add sugar. Cream until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Add baking powder to flour. Add to mixture alternately with milk and flavoring. Bake in tube pan 1 hour and 15 minutes at 315\u00b0.

title: Ice Cream Cone Clowns
instructions: You will also need construction paper and glue paste or a stapler.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs water peanut butter and 1/2 of cake mix until light and fluffy. Stir in remaining cake mix and chocolate chips. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Beef-Barley Vegetable Soup
instructions: Place meat in kettle. Cover with cold water. Add seasoning. Heat slowly to boiling point. Cover and let simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender. Skim off fat. Remove meat and bone. Add barley and vegetables. Continue cooking for 45 minutes. Yields about 2 quarts.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Press 1/2 uncooked ground beef into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan. Layer top with potatoes then layer with ground beef then potatoes again. Mix water and soup well; pour over potatoes and meat. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Sparkling Catawba Punch
instructions: Mix pineapple juice and lemonade. Add ginger ale and sparkling grape juice just before serving. Makes 125 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Creamy Pimento Cheese Spread
instructions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl. Add first five ingredients. Process until smooth. Add pimento. Pulse 4 or 5 times.

title: Pineapple Scallopini
instructions: Melt butter and break toast into pieces. Pour butter over toast. Drain pineapple (partially). Mix remaining ingredients and pour over toast. Bake covered for 30 minutes. Great with ham.

title: Homemade Pop Sickles
instructions: Mix cool-aide and sugar together. Pour into cubed ice tray. Put wax paper over tray. Cut holes in the middle of the cube just big enough to fit a stick in. Put in freezer until well set. Take out of freezer; remove wax paper. Take as many out as you would like and enjoy. Put remainder in freezer.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Add cheese on top. Put corn flakes over all and 1/2 stick melted butter over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Swiss Potato Pancakes
instructions: Measure flour sugar and salt into large bowl. Mix well with fork. Add shortening mix with fork until crumbly. In small bowl beat together egg water and vinegar (using fork to blend well). Combine dry ingredients with liquid. Divide dough into 5 equal portions and shape into round flattened patties ready for rolling. Wrap each patty in plastic wrap chill 1/2 hour before using. When ready to roll lightly flour both sides of patty and roll out on lightly floured board. Makes 5 (9-inch) pie crusts or 20 tart shells. Can be frozen after shaping into round flattened patties.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar and baking powder together into a large bowl. Combine oil orange juice flavoring and eggs; add it to the dry ingredients a little at a time. Mix until smooth (dont overmix). Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Pour half the batter into the pan. Spread half the apples evenly over the batter and sprinkle with half the cinnamon-sugar. Repeat with other half. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 and 1/4 hours. Remove from oven place on a rack and let stand about 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Baked Beans With Hamburger
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger and onion. Mix all other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Mix salt with flour; cut in shortening. Separate egg; save the white. Add yolk to 2/3 cup water and beat. Add to flour mixture. Mix into soft ball stage. Divide dough in half.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook onion and zucchini in salt water for about 5 minutes then drain well. Pour into well-greased casserole. Add Italian seasonings. Pour tomatoes over top of zucchini and onion. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven and sprinkle well with Parmesan cheese and return to oven until the cheese melts.

title: Low-Fat Soft Ginger Cookies
instructions: Stir flour salt baking powder and spices together. Cream sugar margarine and egg until light. Add prunes buttermilk molasses and vinegar and beat to combine. Dissolve soda in boiling water. Stir in flour mixture and soda water. Drop onto greased baking sheet and bake for 15 to 17 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Vegetable Dip In Rye Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except bread). Cut top off bread (keep for lid). Dig out center of bread (keep bread for dipping). Fill bread with mixture. Replace top of bread. Triple wrap bread with foil and place in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours (or until cheese is melted and mixture is hot all through). Mix pieces of bread with 2 tablespoons of butter and place in oven for 10 minutes. Serve dip warm with raw vegetables crackers bread sticks etc.

title: Uncooked Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into a 9-inch graham cracker or vanilla wafer crust.

title: Slice And Bake Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugars. Beat in vanilla and eggs. Combine flour salt and soda. Gradually stir in dry ingredients. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Orange Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Drizzle melted margarine over chicken; sprinkle with paprika. In small bowl combine onion salt rosemary pepper orange juice orange peel and cornstarch; mix well. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered for 40 to 45 minutes or until tender. Baste occasionally.

title: Ranch-Style Baked Lentils
instructions: Rinse the lentils. In a heavy saucepan bring lentils salt and 4 cups water to a boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the lentils are tender. Meanwhile brown beef in a skillet. Drain excess fat. Stir in soup mix catsup mustard vinegar and remaining water. Gently stir in lentils. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Bake covered at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Chop apples and set aside. Measure oil into large bowl; add sugar egg and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Sift flour salt soda and baking powder together. Add small amounts at a time to creamed mixture. Fold in pecans and apples. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Parker'S Favorite Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs slightly just until whites and yolks are mixed. Stir in sugar then add corn syrup melted butter milk and vanilla. Stir the pecans into the egg/sugar mixture. Pour mixture into an unbaked pie crust.

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan melt oleo. Do not get too hot. Add cocoa and milk; mix well. Stir in powdered sugar; bring to a bubbling boil stirring constantly. Cook 2 or 3 minutes more. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and peanut butter. Stir until cooled slightly and begins to firm. Pour into greased (oleo) 8 x 8-inch dish. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer chopped lettuce onions and bell peppers. Into mayonnaise stir the 3 tablespoons sugar. Spread over lettuce onions and peppers. Spread cheese and bacon bits over top of mayonnaise. Chill and serve. Other veggies such as green peas broccoli or cauliflower may be layered in.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add egg well beaten and the mashed pulp of the bananas. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Mix well. Drop into greased tins and bake in a medium oven about 12 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Basic Stir-Fry
instructions: In glass bowl combine chicken soy sauce and garlic powder; stir well and set aside. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in skillet or wok. Stir in all vegetables and stir-fry 3 to 5 minutes until onions are translucent. Remove to bowl. Heat remaining 2 teaspoons oil. Add chicken and stir-fry until chicken is cooked about 5 minutes. Return vegetables to skillet or wok. Stir in cornstarch mixture and continue cooking until sauce thickens. Divide mixture evenly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Buttercream Mints
instructions: Blend all ingredients with spoon then hands. Line molds with fine sugar. Press in fondant. If no molds are available roll into 1 inch or 1/2 inch balls then flatten with fork or bottom of glass dipped in powdered sugar. May make ahead and freeze.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Mix in remaining ingredients. Place layer of hamburger mixture. Cover with grated colby of colby jack cheese and crushed tortilla chips. Pour remaining hamburger mixture over first layer. Top with more grated cheese and crushed tortilla chips.

title: Turnip Salad(Southern Style)
instructions: Pick a mess of salad from the garden about 3 pounds. Wash to remove bugs worms and dirt. Parboil in a pot of water after adding a pinch of soda. Drain. Put in pot and cover with water. Add olive oil and salt to taste. Cook on medium heat (2 hours) until tender. Drain and chop. Serve.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix jello and boiling water; let cool (not gel). Cream the cream cheese sugar and lemon juice. Whip the chilled evaporated milk. Beat until peaks form. Add jello and cream cheese mixture to whipped milk. Pour into graham cracker pie crusts. Chill.

title: Western Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain excess bacon grease. Cook drain and rinse ground beef. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a casserole dish prepared with Pam. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese with 1/4 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in 1/2 of the Cool Whip; spread over crust. Prepare pudding as directed on package using 3 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill several hours or overnight. Spread the remaining Cool Whip over the pudding. Top with Bakers coconut (as much as desired). Makes 15 to 18 servings.

title: Scotch Crunchies
instructions: On high heat place tomatoes and jalapenos directly on stovetop until slightly roasted. Remove from heat. Peel and slice. Combine with avocados garlic onions cilantro garlic salt and pepper into a food processor. On low speed blend ingredients until they appear blended into a lumpy texture not creamy. (I prefer to hand mix in a mocahete which adds just the right authentic flavor!) Serve with tortilla chips or as a topping on your favorite Mexican dish! Muy Bueno!

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Cream the cheese and margarine. Mix in flour. Stir in Rice Krispies. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with back of spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Raspberry Punch
instructions: Mix all juices. Blend and allow to stand several hours (overnight). At serving time pour into punch bowl and add sherbet cut into small pieces. Serves 40.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Add milk and flour. Blend well. Add coconut. Pour into 9-inch pie pan greased with butter. (This pie makes its own crust.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until it sets in the center. Let cool before cutting to serve.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Logs
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl then roll small logs and dip in the chocolate. (Melt the chocolate chips and wax in top of double boiler and keep stirring the chocolate while you are dipping the logs. Use toothpicks to dip with.)

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Mix cooked meat and spaghetti sauce together. Layer noodles at bottom of pan. Pour sauce over noodles thick enough to cover. Spread cottage cheese over noodles then layer the Mozzarella cheese. Repeat. Cook in oven for about 30 minutes or until cheese is done. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done (about 20 minutes).

title: Cucumbers And Sour Cream
instructions: Peel cucumbers; slice thin and chill. Mix other ingredients together. Toss all lightly. May be served on greens. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Combine butter flour and pecans. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Combine cream cheese confectioners sugar and 1 1/2 cups whipped topping. Spread over the cool crust and chill. Combine pudding mixes and milk. Beat 2 minutes with rotary mixer. Spread on top. Top with remaining whipped topping. Sprinkle with pecans and grated chocolate. Refrigerate.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix flour pecans and margarine. Pat in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and cool. Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Fold in Cool Whip and/or whipping cream as desired. Spread over cooled crust. Add one can cherry topping/filling. Top with whipping cream or Cool Whip as desired.

title: Low Calorie Instant Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together brown sugar sugar substitute margarine and wheat germ. Sift together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Stir into creamed mixture and add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Drop by level teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 68 small cookies 37 calories per cookie.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat margarine with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Add about half of the flour the 1 cup sugar the egg vanilla baking soda and cream of tartar. Beat till thoroughly combined. Beat in remaining flour. Cover and chill 1 hour.

title: Blender Bearnaise
instructions: Reduce vinegar together with tarragon until liquid is almost gone. In a blender beat eggs and lemon juice until lemon colored. In the same pan as the vinegar and tarragon melt the butter while hot. Slowly pour into the egg mixture while the blender is running. Add salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy.

title: On The Grill
instructions: Remove silk from corn but not the husks. Tie the husks closed. Wrap potatoes in foil. Some fresh herbs and margarine can be added to the foil package if desired. Dip summer squash and eggplant slices in olive oil. Soak husks of corn in cold water for 10 minutes. Drain and cook for 30 minutes turning. Cook potatoes 45 minutes and squash and eggplant for 20 minutes on coals that have burned 45 minutes.

title: Pina Colada Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Dutch Baby Pancakes
instructions: You will need casserole dish 2-quart size.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Make a paste with food coloring and cocoa and add mixture. Add salt and flour together. Add to creamed mixture adding buttermilk a little at a time alternately with soda and vinegar (do not beat hard) just blend. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 2 (8-inch) round pans greased and floured.

title: Apricot-Pineapple Molded Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and let set until slightly thickened. Add crushed pineapple. Beat together cream cheese and Cool Whip. Fold Cool Whip mixture into the Jell-O. Pour into a shallow baking dish (8 or 9-inch square pan). Let set in refrigerator until firm.

title: 15 Minute Linguine With Clam Sauce
instructions: While pasta cooks saute butter onions and garlic. Add juice from clams and milk. Bring to boil and add thickener and clams. Before removing from heat stir in parsley and remove; pour over pasta. Sprinkle with \Italian cheese\. Serve with a salad and bread.

title: Great Gerts
instructions: Cream margarine and cheese. Add seasonings flour and Rice Krispies. Pinch off small bits with your fingers and press flat with a fork dipped in cold water. The smaller these are the better they are. Bake on a cookie sheet for about 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Glorified (Heavenly) Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill very thoroughly before serving. Serves 6 to 8. If you choose to use Cool Whip add just before serving instead of whipping cream.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
