instructions: Put the sugar milk and butter in boiler; boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add the cocoa quick oats and nuts. Stir and mix in the vanilla and pinch of salt. Spoon out by drops on dish sprayed with Pam or greased with butter.

title: Squash Cookies
instructions: Combine squash sugar oil and egg. Sift together flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. Add to squash mixture. Add soda dissolved in milk. Add vanilla. Drop on greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a well-greased pan. Bake one hour or until brown at 400\u00b0.

title: Oven Stew
instructions: Cut stew meat into small pieces. Salt pepper and roll in flour. Brown in skillet. Put stew meat carrots tomato sauce and cabbage in a long pan or Dutch oven. Cover and bake 2 to 3 hours or until tender-done at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Combine spaghetti eggs and Parmesan cheese. Place half of mixture in greased 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Add half of Mozzarella cheese. Repeat with remaining spaghetti and Mozzarella. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut into squares and serve with spaghetti sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Diabetic Orange Cookies
instructions: Cream first three ingredients then add the rest of the ingredients and form into 1-inch balls. Chill. Press a pecan half in the center. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Frozen Coleslaw
instructions: Combine vegetables. Sprinkle with salt and let stand 1 hour. Drain if water accumulates. Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Cool. Pour over cabbage mixture. Stir well. Freeze in plastic bags or container. To serve thaw in refrigerator.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Prepare eggs and cream in blender. Put ham and Swiss cheese in pie shell. Pour egg mixture over it. Cook 45 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Frozen Strawberry Yummy
instructions: Cut first 3 ingredients as for a crust. Add nuts. Spread out crumbs onto cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Spread a little more than half of the crumbs into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Jack'S Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: *Read Jack and the Bean Stalk.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: In mixing bowl add meat rice garlic powder chopped onion and 1/2 can of tomato sauce. Mix all together. Set aside. Cut tops off green peppers and hollow. Boil all peppers for 5 minutes then fill each pepper with meat mixture in round deep dish. Pour over leftover tomato sauce. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Pour juice over if desired.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together first 5 ingredients. Cut in margarine. Add milk to make a soft dough. Knead lightly on floured board for 2 minutes. Shape into a round loaf. Place on greased cookie sheet cut an `X across the top. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Combine ingredients; form into balls. Brown. Add sauce. Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: *Or whatever vegetables you want.

title: Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix well. Shape into loaf and cover top of loaf generously with catsup. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be baked on broiler pan rack so grease will not be absorbed into loaf. Makes 10 servings.

title: German Chocolate Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients. Blend well. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until set. Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets. Makes 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Will keep for days.

title: Fried Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Slice sweet potatoes. Cover an iron frying pan with just enough oil to cover bottom. Fry 1 layer of sweet potatoes at a time turning to brown both sides lightly. Lift onto platter and if desired sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar or eat plain.

title: 4 To 6 Pound Brisket(Freezes Well)
instructions: Trim all fat from brisket. Generously cover both sides of brisket with garlic salt celery salt and onion salt. Pour all of hickory liquid smoke; place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Peppered Steak
instructions: Flour salt and pepper steak. Brown in frying pan in oil. Place bell pepper and onion over steak. Pour bouillon over steak and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Lasagne(Lite Cooking)
instructions: Cook and stir onions and garlic in Crisco until tender. Add ground beef and drain if necessary. Add tomatoes and tomato paste basil oregano sugar and pepper. Stir until well blended. Simmer 30 minutes. Combine cottage cheese 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley; set aside. Cook noodles 7 minutes in unsalted boiling water. Drain. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Layer all ingredients in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Bake 45 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

title: Lipton Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips 2-inches long. In a large skillet heat shortening and brown meat trimmings. Stir in onion soup mix and *2 cups water. Cover and simmer 30 minutes (until meat is tender). Stir in peppers and simmer covered 10 minutes. Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup water. Stir into skillet mixture. Cook until thickened.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Butter & flour a 10-inch tube pan. Sift flour baking powder & salt. In a cup stir milk & vanilla. In a large bowl mix butter and sugar until yellow and fluffy. Add 2 eggs and beat well. Repeat and add last 2 eggs. Beat well. With a wooden spoon stir in flour mixture. Add milk mixture. Spoon into pan. Bake 1 hour. Cool cake in pan 10 minutes. Turn onto cake plate and dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Goop
instructions: Mix and shake. Put in covered container.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix well. Drop by spoonful into hot skillet. Fry until crisp.

title: Stuffed Cabbages
instructions: Core and steam cabbage until leaves can be peeled off in whole pieces. In a large bowl mix together meats rice onion salt and pepper. Add water to meat/rice mixture until \sloppy\ to the touch; more is better than not enough. Line bottom of roast pan with outer torn cabbage leaves (reserve enough to cover casserole also). Pour 1/2 can of sauerkraut over leaves. Roll small amount of meat/rice mixture in individual cabbage leaves starting from stem side and tucking in edges. Place rolls in layers on top of sauerkruat. Add remaining sauerkraut with juice tomatoes with juice and 1/2 can water. Top with remaining torn leaves which will burn while cooking and will be discarded. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with mashed potatoes and crusty bread.

title: Cranberry Grape Ice Cream Soda
instructions: In a blender container process grape cranberry drink and 1 scoop ice cream until smooth. Pour into glass with remaining ice cream. Top with soda. Makes 1 serving.

title: Vegetable Soup(Heart Smart)
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium-high heat in hot oil cook onion and garlic about 3 minutes or until soft stirring frequently. Add tomatoes in juice chicken broth carrots celery parsley basil salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover. Simmer about 20 minutes. Add lima beans and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer about 20 minutes or until beans are tender. Makes 6 servings about 3/4 cup each.

title: Turtle Cookies
instructions: Melt first two ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and mix together. Drop by teaspoonful on waffle iron and cook 1 minute. Frosting is enough for a double recipe of cookies.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; batter will be thick. Spread into lightly greased 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife comes out clean.

title: Healthy Banana-Nut Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0 (200\u00b0C). Mix both flours with sugar and walnuts. Stir in baking powder cinnamon and salt. Place mashed bananas in separate bowl. Add eggs milk and oil and mix well. Add wet ingredients to dry mixing just until moistened. Spoon into lightly greased muffin tins and bake 15 to 20 minutes depending on size. Cool on wire racks. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cherry Pound Cake
instructions: Grease tube pan and dust with flour. Combine margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour vanilla and salt; mix well. Fold in walnuts and halved maraschino cherries. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from pan after 10 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Holiday Punch
instructions: Mix together jello and sugar. Add hot water. Mix together thoroughly until jello and sugar are totally dissolved. Add ReaLemon juice and pineapple juice; mix well.

title: Twice-Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Pierce potatoes with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes or until tender. Allow potatoes to cool to the touch. Cut them in half lengthwise; carefully scoop out pulp leaving a 1/4-inch shell. Place pulp in a large bowl. Add orange juice. Melt 3 tablespoons butter; add to pulp and beat until smooth. Stuff the potato shells; place in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.

title: Chicken Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole or 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 until macaroni is tender 55 to 60 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine and let set a couple of days before serving.

title: Strawberry Square Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and water together. Add pineapple juice. Place in the refrigerator until partially congealed. Fold in fruit and marshmallows. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in refrigerator overnight to congeal. Serves 24.

title: Loaf Pound Cake
instructions: In one bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Blend in butter vanilla egg yolks and milk. Beat vigorously for 3 minutes. Pour batter into a greased 9-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes. Yields one 9-inch cake.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together flour soda cinnamon sugar cloves salt and nuts and set aside.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Thaw and squeeze out spinach. Mix with other ingredients. Put in greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (for a 7 x 11-inch dish). I use a 9 x 13-inch dish and bake a little less time.

title: Candied Or Stewed Apples
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water in large saucepan. Prepare apples by cutting in half and removing cores. Place in saucepan and sprinkle with spices and butter. Cover and cook slowly and turn apples when about half done. Cook until juice begins to get syrupy.

title: Salisbury Meatballs
instructions: Combine the ingredients. Cover with sauce. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fresh Salsa
instructions: In a large frying pan cook all the chiles until black on each side then cut chiles down the middle and remove all the seeds. Dice chiles real small. Put into a large saucepan. Chop onions and tomatoes real small. Put into pan with chiles. Add the Pace salsa to other ingredients in pan. Also add tomato sauce stewed tomatoes and 1 cup of water. Let simmer for about 1 hour. Make sure to add about 1 tablespoon of garlic salt. Make sure to mix all ingredients well before simmering. Makes about 6 pounds of salsa.

title: Easy Crust Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook and debone fryer. Cut up chicken and place in a large baking dish. Mix soup and broth; heat until creamy. Add salt and pepper; pour over chicken. Mix flour milk and melted margarine. Spoon over chicken. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown and bubbly about 30 minutes.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Cut lettuce into bite size pieces and place in bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish. Mix celery onion pepper carrots and water chestnuts together; spread evenly over lettuce. Spread Hellmanns mayonnaise over top of mixture. Make sure you use sufficient mayonnaise because this will become your dressing when served. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons sugar over mayonnaise. Cover with plastic wrap; let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Curried Baked Fruit(Prepare The Day Before)
instructions: Drain all fruit. Add sugar and curry to melted butter. Arrange fruit and nuts in layers in casserole; pour butter mixture over all and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Refrigerate overnight. Reheat at 350\u00b0 before serving. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla. Put 1 vanilla wafer in each cupcake liner. Put 2 tablespoons of cream cheese mixture on top of vanilla wafer. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool. Put 1 tablespoon of pie filling on top of each one.

title: Possum Stew
instructions: Paw n the chillun allus worked so hard a catchin little fish outta the creek that they just had to be cooked! ... but they iz sweet n gud eatin. Scales take insides outn the haid off ... clean in cold watah ... salt n roll in 1/2 meal n 1/2 flour ... drop in hot fat n brown on both sides. To eat small bream ... furst pull fins off ... then start at the tail n ease meat up with a fork along backbone all the way up to whair the haid wuz ... hitll cum off in one piece widout bones iffn youre careful.

title: Broccoli-Chicken-Stuffing Hot Dish
instructions: Brown chicken in margarine. Salt and pepper to taste. Put veggies in 2-quart casserole dish. Microwave about 8 minutes covered turning once and stirring. Put about 1/2 package of stuffing mix on top of veggies. Mix soups and milk and pour 3/4 over stuffing. Add chicken and pour rest of soup over chicken. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Imperial Crab
instructions: Combine ingredients. Toss lightly. Put in crab shells. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Put pineapple and juice in a large bowl; add pudding and mix well. Stir in marshmallows and fold in Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated. Makes 10 servings with 1 gram of fat per serving.

title: Sour Cream Lasagne
instructions: Lightly brown beef and remove excess fat. Add tomato sauce onions salts and sugar. Simmer 10 minutes. Cream together sour cream and cream cheese. Line lightly oiled 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish with layer of cooked noodles. Add 1/2 of tomato mixture. Put cream cheese mixture on top and spread evenly into layer. Put another layer of noodles and top these with other half of tomato mixture. Put grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Coffee-Toffee Torte
instructions: Freeze then crush Heath bars. Prepare angel food cake as directed on box. Bake in a 10-inch tube pan. Invert and cool. In saucepan mix pudding and instant coffee but using only 1 1/3 cups of milk for each package of pudding for a total of 2 2/3 cups of milk. Cook according to directions on box. Cool. When cool beat until mixture is smooth. Fold in half of the whipped cream. Split cake into 3 layers. Spread half of the pudding-cream mixture between layers. Fold remaining whipped cream into pudding mixture and frost tops and sides of cake. Sprinkle top and sides of cake with crushed Heath bars. Chill until ready to serve.

title: *Baklava(Pita Dulci)
instructions: Butter a 12 x 17 x 1-inch baking pan. Butter 8 to 10 sheets of phyllo for bottom crust. Sprinkle nuts (combined with sugar and cinnamon). Sprinkle nuts on every sheet or every two sheets. Top with 8 sheets. Refrigerate. Cut into diamonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. (After 40 minutes lower oven to 325\u00b0 for remaining 20 minutes.) Pour cooled syrup over hot Baklava.

title: Phillip'S Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Dump pineapple into pan; spread evenly. Dump cherry filling. Spread evenly. (Layer) dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer; spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts on top of dry cake mix. Put margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 48 to 53 minutes. Serve warm or cold. Makes 15 to 18 servings.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients with juice of pineapple Cool Whip and pudding. Blend in pineapple nuts and cherries. Refrigerate.

title: Hamburger Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Put chili and peppers in crock-pot. Add hamburger and onion then add 1/2 box of cheese. Cook 1/2 hour. Stir then add remaining cheese. Cook 1 to 2 hours in crock-pot. Enjoy!

title: Apple Pie Delight(Diabetic)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a mixing bowl combine Equal Measure flour nutmeg cinnamon and salt.\tAdd dry mixture to apples; toss gently to coat fruit.\tFill a pastry lined 9-inch pie plate with apple mixture. Dot with margarine. Cover with top crust that has slits in it. Seal and flute edge.\tBake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 and turn oven down to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Pecan Halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Spread pecans on large baking sheet. Melt butter and pour over pecan halves. Sprinkle with salt and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Orange Nut Glazed Raisin Bread
instructions: Scald milk pour over salt sugar and butter. Blend and cool to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast on warm water stir to dissolve. Add to milk mixture with 2 1/2 cups flour. Beat 2 minutes with electric mixer then beat in eggs orange peel ginger raisins and 1/2 cup flour. Then mix in enough remaining flour a little at a time with spoon. Then use hands knead until smooth into a ball. Grease and let rise in warm place until doubled. Punch down. Let rise 15 minutes. Make into 2 loaves. Make 3 slashes in top. Let raise not more than double. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cover with sheet of foil after 20 minutes if it browns too fast. Remove loaves from pan. Place on wire rack spread Orange Glaze over them then cool.

title: Fancy Green Beans
instructions: Chop bacon in pieces fry in skillet.\tSaute onion and pimiento in bacon grease; add the green beans juice and all to mixture. Add garlic salt\tand Natures Season to taste. Simmer.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix Cheez Whiz and hominy in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Stir well; then top with crumbled corn chips. Cook about 10 minutes. Serve while hot.

title: Mustard And Vinegar Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients; make sure cucumbers are covered. Use a large container. Let set for 3 to 4 weeks.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Soften cream cheese in microwave. Chop green onions and mix with cream cheese. Spread a layer over each slice of ham. Roll the ham up and slice into small sections. Place a toothpick in each one and refrigerate at least 2 hours until ready to eat.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Steam broccoli for 5 minutes (until bright green and still crisp). Cool and chop into 1/2-inch pieces. Add onions olives Miracle Whip and dill seed. Refrigerate overnight (or for at least 8 hours); just before serving add eggs or cheese and salt to taste. Stir well. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Never Fail Caramel Icing
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar. Boil over low heat stirring constantly. Stir in milk and bring to a boil again stirring constantly. Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm. Gradually add powdered sugar until thick enough to spread.

title: Wild Turkey Salsa And Rice
instructions: Cut up turkey in chunks and cook in a crock-pot with water on low for 4 hours or until tender. Saute oleo garlic onion and green peppers in a Dutch oven. Add all vegetables in a Dutch oven on top of stove and simmer for 30 minutes. Add cooked turkey and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in shortening; drain excess fat. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Combine ketchup and remaining ingredients; pour over chops. Cover; simmer 45 minutes basting occasionally or until meat is tender. Skim off any fat from sauce. Makes 6 servings (1 cup sauce).

title: Pink Flamingo
instructions: Soften cream cheese; beat until fluffy. Add milk lemon juice vanilla and red food coloring. Mix well. Pour into a vanilla wafer crust in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Slice bananas over the top. Spread whipped cream over the top. Chill and serve.

title: Curry-Glazed Chicken
instructions: Place margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and heat in a 375\u00b0 oven until melted. Stir in honey mustard and curry powder. Add chicken turning to coat. Bake turning chicken over after 20 minutes. Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Contains 255 calories per serving.

title: Cherry Flip
instructions: Mix together crackers and oleo and pat into a small oblong dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cream together cream cheese sugar and milk. Spread on top of cooled crust. Sprinkle nuts on cream cheese mixture. Spread Cool Whip atop nuts. Then spread pie filling atop the Cool Whip. Very good!

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Start cooking on high. Turn to low and simmer 24 hours. If too juicy uncover last two hours of cooking time. Your house will smell delightful! Yields 2 to 3 pints.

title: Orchard Pops
instructions: In blender combine all ingredients; blend until smooth. Pour about 1/3 cup into each of six 3-ounce paper cups. Cover with foil. Insert wooden stick through foil. Freeze for 5 hours or until firm. Before serving let pops stand 10 minutes at room temperature. Remove foil and peel off paper cups.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Peel cukes slice or grate also the onion. Sprinkle with salt and set aside for 1 hour. Squeeze a few at a time (discarding liquid). Pour the vinegar water sugar black pepper and green pepper and mix thoroughly. Add enough sour cream to make it a bit soupy. Sprinkle paprika on top before serving.

title: Old-Fashioned Raisin Bars
instructions: Combine raisins and water in saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in salad dressing. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in sugar and egg. Add dry ingredients and beat. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Pumpkin Pecan Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour soda salt and cinnamon and nutmeg. Add sugar and stir to mix thoroughly. Make a well in center of dry ingredients and add all at once the oil eggs and water and pumpkin. Mix well and add nuts. Pour batter into 3 (8 x 4-inch) loaf pans. Fill only half full. Bake for 1 hour or until wooden toothpick comes out clean. One loaf equals 16 slices; each slice contains 85 calories.

title: Beef And Noodle Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet brown beef. Remove beef and drain fat. In the same skillet melt butter over medium heat. Saute onion and pepper until tender. Add beef Worcestershire sauce noodles and soups; mix well. Spoon into a greased 3-quart casserole; top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. Let stand in ice water while making roux.

title: Lena'S 5 Pound Fudge
instructions: Cook together until a firm ball. Beat until you cant beat anymore.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Pour into a plastic bag; add 2 or 3 pieces of chicken at a time shaking until well coated. Melt 1 stick of margarine. Turn over to coat both sides.\tPlace in single layer. Bake at\t400\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Turn and bake until finished browning about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Campfire Bean Dinner
instructions: In large skillet brown meat well. Stir in soup mix beans chili sauce and water. Simmer uncovered stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook drain and mash potatoes. Add cheese sour cream salt pepper and butter. Beat until smooth and fluffy. Refrigerate or bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 8 cups.

title: Old Fashioned Light Bread
instructions: In a large mixer bowl combine 3 cups flour and yeast. In saucepan heat milk shortening sugar and salt just until warm and shortening is almost melted; stir constantly. Add to flour mixture. Beat at low speed 1/2 minute scraping sides of bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. Gradually stir in as much flour as you can mix with a spoon. Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic. Shape into a ball. Place in a lightly greased bowl at least twice as large as the ball of dough. Turn dough over once to grease surface. Cover with slightly damp cloth. Allow to rise in warm place until double in size (about 1 hour).

title: Merk'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Add eggs singly beating well after each addition. Sift flour baking powder and soda together. Add to creamed mixture alternating with sour cream blending after each addition. Spread half of batter in 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and lined on the bottom with waxed paper. Cream butter brown sugar and cinnamon together. Add nuts; mix well. Dot batter in pan evenly with half of nut mixture. Cover with remaining batter. Dot with remaining mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes. Cool cake for 10 minutes. Remove from pan.

title: Texas Meatballs And Rice
instructions: Mix ground beef egg chili powder salt and pepper; shape into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls. Place in 2-quart casserole. Microwave at High (100%) until meatballs are set and lose pink color 4 to 7 minutes rearranging meatballs after half the cooking time. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover. Microwave at High (100%) until mixture is bubbly and onion is tender 4 to 7 minutes. If using an oven without a carousel stir after half the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender 2 to 3 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Paul Newman Chicken
instructions: Clean chicken and marinate several hours in dressing. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Put bread crumbs in plastic bag and shake chicken generously in crumbs. Spray a 13 x 9 pan with Pam. Place chicken in pan. Cook for 1 hour uncovered turning once. If chicken appears to be cooking too fast turn oven down to 350\u00b0 for the last 15 or 20 minutes. This dish is great hot or cold.

title: Spicy Fruited Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in oil in skillet; pour off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until done stirring occasionally. Garnish with orange slices.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pickling spice. Pour pickling spice in a strainer and put in mixture. Cook on low heat for 3 hours. Remove strainer and discard spices. Refrigerate sauce.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Stir over low heat until blended. Bring to a boil over moderate heat. Be careful not to mistake air bubbles for boiling. Boil slowly stirring constantly for 5 minutes (soft ball stage). Remove from heat. Stir in chips and vanilla until chips have melted. Turn into a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Let cool.

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients; set aside. Beat butter or margarine and sugar until\tlight and fluffy; add eggs. Beat well. Stir in milk and vanilla. Add flour; mix well. Stir in nuts dates and chopped cherries. Shape tablespoon of dough into ball and roll in\tCorn Flakes. Place on greased cookie sheet and put a quartered cherry in the middle of each. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add pepper and ringed onions. Mix in chili powder tomatoes and rice. Bake in covered dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together; add peanut butter and milk and fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham crust. Freeze until firm. Take from freezer a few minutes before serving.

title: Skyline Dip
instructions: Microwave Skyline until completely defrosted. Spread cream cheese in the bottom of a medium size baking dish until covered. Pour defrosted Skyline over cream cheese. Sprinkle cheese and onions (optional) and serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
instructions: Cream together first 5 ingredients. Sift together flour salt and baking soda. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture. Add oatmeal and mix well. Add desired nuts raisins chocolate chips or dried fruit. Bake until brown in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with the buttermilk coconut flavoring and coconut. Bake in a greased and floured stem pan for 50 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sex In A Pan
instructions: Combine butter flour and chopped pecans; press in bottom of 13x9x2 inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let totally cool. Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese; layer on crust. Spread 1 c. of cool whip on cream cheese. Combine 1 1/2 c. of milk with each pudding and layer on top of cream cheese. Top with 12 oz. of cool whip. Serve chilled.

title: Newfie Corn Soup
instructions: In a 2-quart pot melt butter. Add onion and cook until soft but not brown. Add potatoes 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 cup water. Cook until potatoes are soft and water is evaporated. (Add more water if necessary.) Add creamed corn and evaporated milk to desired consistency. Simmer 5 minutes over low heat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with hot Italian bread or rolls and a salad.

title: Rhubarb And Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add 3/4 of mixture to fruits. Put remaining and sugar mixture in unbaked pie shell. Add fruit. Dot with butter. Add top crust. Bake in 420\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes more.

title: Haystack Cookies
instructions: Melt peanut butter and morsels and fold in potatoes and pecans. Spoon out on wax paper.

title: Green Bean Side Dish
instructions: Steam beans with oil and dill weed to warm. Add margarine to taste. Serve piping hot. This vegetable is especially good with Italian foods. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Indian Corn
instructions: Cut bacon into small pieces; fry until crisp drain reserving 2 tablespoons fat. In reserved fat saute green pepper and onion until tender. Add corn salt and pepper; heat thoroughly over medium heat. Add cream; cook 1 minute stirring. Stir in bacon. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar add egg yolks. Mix soda into sour cream. Add flour and sour cream alternately to butter/sugar mixture. Add vanilla and almond extract.

title: Mexican Meat Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion together; pour off grease. Mix in enchilada sauce and mushroom soup; mix well. In casserole dish layer Doritos sprinkle with grated cheese. Place layer of meat mixture and layer of Doritos and layer of meat mixture sprinkle with cheese. Cook in hot oven for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet. Add chicken and ham; cook and stir for 5 to 8 minutes until chicken is browned. Stir in soup water beans and mustard. Bring to boil. Stir in rice and cheese; cover. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Fluff with fork and serve. Serves 4.

title: Egg Noodles
instructions: If eggs are small use a little less flour; if eggs are large use a little more flour.

title: Harvest Apple Cake
instructions: Grease and lightly flour a 9-inch tube pan. Sift together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Chop and peel apples. Set them aside. Stir together eggs and vanilla then beat 2 minutes until light. Gradually add oil beating until thick. Gradually beat in sugar. Add dry ingredients apples and nuts a little at a time; beat well after each addition. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Use cream cheese frosting.

title: June'S Jiffy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in large pan. Mix batter of flour sugar and juice. Pour over butter. Lay peaches over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cut onion into thin slices; saute in margarine. Add flour and pepper; cook for 10 minutes. Add stock and Worcestershire sauce until onion is tender.

title: Waffle Cookie
instructions: Cream margarine. Add eggs sugar and vanilla. Add flour then chocolate chips. Heat up waffle iron. Put 2 to 4 small teaspoons of batter separately in waffle iron making 2 to 4 cookies. Close iron then take out with fork. \Great!\

title: Grandmother'S Gingerbread
instructions: Blend sugar shortening and eggs. Stir in molasses. Combine dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Beat well. Pour into greased and floured pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until done.

title: Chili Cheese Squares
instructions: Grate cheese and mix together. Beat eggs lightly. Add canned milk to eggs and blend with cheeses. In a 9 x 13 buttered pan cover bottom with chopped green chilies. Pour cheese mixture over chilies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove cool. Cut in 1 inch squares.

title: Spaghetti(With Homemade Pastas Of Course!)
instructions: In a large Dutch oven lightly brown the meat in oil and garlic at medium-low heat. Slowly mix in water and tomato paste. Add onions celery and bell peppers. Simmer covered 3 to 5 hours until meat is very tender. Check often and add water as needed making certain there is about a quart of thin sauce when ready to add the pasta. Add salt pepper and homemade pasta. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes to 1/2 hour stirring often until broth is absorbed. Stir in parsley. Serves 6.

title: Frozen Pea Salad - Layered
instructions: Put all ingredients in large bowl in layers as listed. Spread over this 2 cups mayonnaise mixed with 3 tablespoons sugar (seal edges as you spread). Cover with airtight seal (I use Tupperware).

title: Asparagus Roll-Ups
instructions: Cook asparagus; drain. Trim crusts from bread. Flatten each piece with rolling pin. Mix softened butter with cheeses. Spread mixture on each piece of bread and top with a piece of asparagus. Roll and dip in butter. Cut into fourths and freeze. When ready to serve bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 96.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Combine eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Beat together. Add sliced apples and walnuts. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dan'S Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time. Beat in the brandy. Melt the chocolate in dish over hot water. Stir the melted chocolate and sour cream into the creamed mixture. Sift together the flour cocoa baking soda baking powder and salt. Stir the dry ingredients gradually into the melted chocolate mixture to form a batter. Stir in the white chocolate chips and nuts. Drop the batter by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Pot Roast Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first 8 and shape into a loaf in center of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Peel and slice potatoes onions and carrots (sliced lengthwise). Mix parsley flakes salt and pepper. Place vegetables in layers around meat. Sprinkle each layer with part of salt mixture. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more to brown meat. Serves 4.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Combine milk ground beef cracker meal onion garlic salt and Parmesan cheese in a large bowl. Mix well. Split each bun and toast lightly. Divide meat mixture into 8 parts. Spread one part mixture evenly over top surface of each bun. Place on cookie sheet. Make a well in center of meat using the back of a spoon. Combine tomato sauce and oregano. Spoon 2 teaspoons of mixture into each well. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons cheese over each burger. Continue baking until cheese melts.

title: Pineapple And Coconut Pie
instructions: Pour into two 9-inch pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Anisette Sponges Cake
instructions: Mix together rum and water. Layer one package of Sponges in a 10-inch spring-form pan. Pour half the water and rum mixture over sponges. Cook pudding according to directions. While hot pour half over sponges.

title: Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together all ingredients; chill. Roll into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Debbie'S Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and hot water in large container; set aside. In food processor grind cranberries and orange. Chop celery; mix together. Add lemon juice and sugar. Add nuts. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Easy French Bread
instructions: Sift flour sugar salt and yeast in large mixing bowl. Add hot tap water and oil at one time. Stir until dough leaves sides of bowl. Turn out on floured surface and knead 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Put in greased bowl. Turn cover and let rise until doubled. Turn out. Divide in half. Roll each half to 12 x 15-inch. Roll tightly from long side. Place on greased cookie sheet. Slash top 3 to 4 times diagonally. Let rise.

title: Bean And Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables as directed; drain and cool. Add drained red beans. Add diced vegetables and mix. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and mix. Mix sugar vinegar flour and mustard in a small saucepan. Cook stirring until clear. Cool and pour over vegetables.

title: Zucchini Stew
instructions: Thaw sausage meat the night before. Brown in frying pan and drain any excess fat. Set meat aside. Peel zucchini and slice into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Peel and slice onions and garlic.

title: Teresa'S Cabbage Salad
instructions: Saute almonds in butter; add poppy seed. Cool. Mix cabbage and noodles and almond mixture. Add dressing of oil vinegar and sugar. Refrigerate an hour if possible.

title: Benedictine Spread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Add a drop of green food coloring; stir well. Spread mixture on bread slices. Serve as finger sandwiches.

title: Baked Grits
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease large baking dish with butter flavor Crisco. Melt butter flavor Crisco in large skillet. Add mushrooms. Saute until mushrooms give up their liquid about 5 minutes. Place grits in large bowl. Mash if they are leftovers. Add mushrooms eggs evaporated milk cheese paprika and cayenne. Stir gently to mix. Pour into casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato - Corn Chowder
instructions: Saute onion garlic and sweet potato in butter or margarine until onion is translucent. Add remaining ingredients except for corn and heavy cream. Cook over medium heat for 45 minutes. Add frozen corn and heavy cream. Cook 5 more minutes over medium heat. Adjust seasoning to taste.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order given. Mix until smooth. (Will be thick.) Put into Bundt pan that has been sprayed with oil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until center is done. Let cool before cutting. Very moist and rich.

title: Pork Chops And Rice Casserole
instructions: Flour pork chops and lightly brown in oil in a heavy skillet. Remove from skillet and drain. In a large casserole dish stir together chicken and rice soup water and instant rice. Add pork chops. Cook for 1 hour in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Mary Bradshaw'S Bourbon Hot Dogs
instructions: Cut hog dogs in bite size pieces. Put on cookie sheet in 350\u00b0 oven just until cuts are sealed. Mix catsup sugar rosemary oregano basil and bourbon and bring to a boil. Add hot dogs. Best to do day before so flavor can set in.

title: Brandy'S Chicken
instructions: Open Rice-A-Roni and sprinkle in baking dish. Put chicken breasts on top of rice. Mix seasoning packet in 3 cups of water in which you have dissolved the 2 chicken bouillon cubes. Add soup to water with seasoning and mix well. Pour over chicken and rice. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Cover when bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add milk. Cook and stir. Add vanilla and margarine. Heat in microwave. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Diet Apple Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch and apple juice and bring to a boil. Mix cinnamon nutmeg oleo and apples and add to juice. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Place top crust over and make several slits in top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Arabic Chicken Fajitas(Very Low-Fat)
instructions: Spray large wok with nonstick cooking spray; heat until very hot. Add chicken and cook it for 4 minutes. Remove from wok and keep it warm.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Cook broccoli cuts as per directions. Drain. Add cream of mushroom soup 1 can evaporated milk 2 cans regular milk and Cheez Whiz. Heat over medium-low flame stirring regularly.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat up cheese and mix all together (can be frozen).

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Shake flour in bag; place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Add spaghetti sauce to bag. Squeeze bag to blend ingredients. Add chicken and green peppers to bag. Turn bag to coat chicken with sauce. Arrange chicken in even layer. Close bag with provided tie; cut 6 half-inch slits in top of bag. Bake until tender 35 to 40 minutes. Serve over hot pasta.

title: Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Bring the chicken stock to boil. With a wire whisk mix together egg whites flour and water until smooth. Pour a thin stream into boiling chicken stock. Do not stir until egg mixture is cooked. Add the soy sauce and mix well. Ladle into consomme cups and top each serving with 1 teaspoon chopped chives or scallion tops. Makes 3 cups. Each 3/4 cup serving contains approximately 42 calories 0 mg cholesterol and 167 mg sodium.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Pour batter in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Wash and clean chicken. Salt and pepper chicken and soak in milk overnight in refrigerator.\tFlour and deep fry in Crisco until done.

title: Cream Cheese And Pineapple Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add crushed pineapple and mix well. Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour and nuts. Pat on bottom of pan and bake until brown in 350\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Soupe 'A Loignon(Onion Soup)
instructions: In heavy pot melt butter. Add onions and cook slowly stirring occasionally until golden. Sprinkle on the flour and stir for a few minutes seasoning with salt and pepper. Add broth and wine stirring constantly. Bring to a boil. Lower the heat and let the soup simmer for 30 minutes partly covered.

title: Hash Brown Cheese Bake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 pan for 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in mixer bowl. Beat until smooth. Pour half of the mixture into pie shell. Arrange pears in pie shell. Pour remaining sour cream mixture over pears. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and mix until crumbly. Sprinkle over pie. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings. Pan size is 9-inch.

title: Fruit  Dip
instructions: Gradually beat orange juice into Cool Whip until the mixture is creamy but not thin. Add sugar to taste. Serve with fresh or canned fruits.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients with enough mayonnaise to moisten.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix peaches and lemon filling together. Pour into buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Add cake mix on top then nuts and then butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until brown. (Insert knife to be sure it is done.)

title: *Mary E'S French Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Shake well before using.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Put cracker crumbs on top. Pour melted margarine over it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in margarine until onion is transparent. Add the rest of the ingredients. Pour into large casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Skillet Chicken And Rice
instructions: Saute celery onion and green pepper in small amount of oil or butter until tender. Add chicken salt and poultry seasoning. Continue stirring until chicken is heated. Cook rice according to package using chicken broth instead of water. Add to sauteed ingredients and cook until dry and beginning to stick to skillet.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and milk. Divide into 3 graham cracker pie crusts. Top each pie with 1 can cherry pie filling and Cool Whip. Chill thoroughly.

title: Fiesta Salad
instructions: Separate onion slices into rings. Place in salad bowl with green pepper and tomato. Fry bacon until crisp; remove and drain. Pour off bacon drippings. Reserve 2 tablespoons in skillet. Stir vinegar chili powder salt and red pepper sauce into drippings; heat to boiling. Pour over vegetables and toss lightly. Crumble bacon; sprinkle on top. Serve with a slotted spoon. Makes 6 servings.

title: Delicious Drumsticks
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix flour salt paprika and pepper in a bowl. Dip chicken into butter. Roll in flour mixture to coat. Arrange in an ungreased square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Bake uncovered until done about 50 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Unthaw spinach and mix all ingredients thoroughly. Take one round loaf of baked bread and hollow out the entire center leaving only shell. Pinch into bite size. Pour dip in bread shell and arrange bite size pieces around outer edge. (Dip pieces in dip mixture.)

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add beaten egg yolks then add milk gradually. Place over medium heat; stir constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat then add vanilla. Stir well. Place into baked pie shell.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and blend well. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done. Makes 3 layers.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Set oven for 425\u00b0. Combine beef and onion in baking dish. Brown in oven and drain. Cook macaroni then mix with spices beef and onions. Add 1 1/2 cans tomato sauce tomato paste and water. Mix in some of pepperoni. Top with cheese pepperoni and remaining tomato sauce. Bake 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Venison Roast In Gravy
instructions: Soak venison roast for 4 hours in mixture of baking soda vinegar salt and water. Rinse; soak in clear water 1 hour. Remove roast from water and pat dry. Remove as much fat as possible before cooking to eliminate any gamey flavor. Combine seasoned salt garlic powder and pepper. Sprinkle on both sides of roast. Sprinkle with soy sauce. Place onion slices on top of roast and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons flour. Place thin slices of oleo on onion. Wrap roast twice in heavy-duty aluminum foil. Place in roasting pan. Add 1 quart water. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours. Add water if necessary to roasting pan but do not open foil. Remove roast from pan. Carefully open foil and measure liquid. Combine 1 1/2 tablespoons flour and 2 tablespoons water to each cup of liquid. Stir well. Stir into roast broth. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Serve gravy with roast.

title: Louisiana Gumbo
instructions: Brown okra in bacon drippings until okra is no longer gooey stirring constantly (use 2 packages frozen okra and dont give up) Add onion and pepper chopped; saute. Add a lot of water and a little tomato sauce; let boil gently for at least 2 hours. Add seafood parsley green onion tips and seasonings; cook until seafood is completely done (about 30 minutes). Turn off fire and add file. I use shrimp and 1 can of crabmeat; when I feel rich I add oysters.

title: Date Nut Loaf
instructions: Combine nuts and dates. Add boiling water and stir in soda. Combine egg vanilla and cooking oil. Add date mixture. Combine sugar cocoa salt and flour. Add to date mixture and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Annie'S Old Fashioned Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar flour cocoa milk and syrup over low heat until mixture forms a soft ball. Stir only until sugar is thoroughly dissolved. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Let stand. Beat until thick and creamy.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Mix in tomato paste water salsa and taco seasoning. Add more water if sauce is too thick. Spread small amount over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Place a layer of tortillas over sauce tearing in half to cover sides and corners. Layer remaining as follows cheese tortillas sauce and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Greens With Hot Dressing
instructions: Wash drain and dry lettuce and greens. Add chopped green onions; set aside. Fry bacon in a large skillet until crisp; drain. Set aside skillet with the hot bacon fat still in it. Combine the vinegar water sugar salt and pepper in a bowl. From the reserved skillet pour off all but about 3 tablespoons of hot fat. Pour the vinegar mixture into the skillet. Place skillet over the hot coals; bring mixture to a boil. Remove from heat and pour over the lettuce and spinach greens.

title: Lemon Freeze Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Add lemonade and evaporated milk. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill in refrigerator until firm. This is for 1 pie only; double ingredients for 2 pies.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Add sour cream soup and half of the shredded Cheddar. Put mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with cooking spray. Sprinkle remaining cheese and equal amount of stuffing on top. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove foil and cook for 15 minutes more.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper. Add tomatoes macaroni ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer 15 minutes on low heat. Drain excess fat. Add mushroom soup little at a time. Pour ingredients into large baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top to melt as the last thing. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Put oil in pot add garlic onion mushrooms and red peppers. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add florets and stir-fry 5 to 8 minutes until tender. Add salt and lemon rind. Toss and serve. Serves 6.

title: Swedish Pancakes
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour on hot griddle spreading out thinly in a circle. Use thin spatula and loosen edges. Turn over when batter begins to bubble. Remove and serve. Spread with butter and sugar or jelly. They are like crepes.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer 1 layer of lettuce onion green pepper celery peas and another layer of lettuce on top. Mix mayonnaise salt pepper and cheese together. Spread on top of salad. Sprinkle Bac*Os on top of salad.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Chill all ingredients thoroughly. Mix juices together in punch bowl (or other serving container). Add ginger ale just before serving to preserve effervescence.

title: Blender Pear Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pears and boil 1 cup of juice to dissolve gelatin. Put remaining ingredients in blender including gelatin. Blend; add nuts. Pour into serving dish and garnish with shredded cheese chopped peanuts sliced canned pears etc. Chill.

title: Strawberry Pound Cake
instructions: Blend well the cake mix jello and flour. Add salad oil and eggs one at a time also well drained strawberries. Beat well. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Creamy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef drain off fat. Mix in a bowl canned milk and canned mushroom soup. Add to ground beef and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve on roll like Sloppy Joes.

title: Red Punch
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water. Then add cold water lemonade orange juice and pineapple juice. Mix all ingredients together. Just before serving add ginger ale. Makes 1 gallon. Float fresh strawberries or make an ice ring.

title: Mexican Layer Dip
instructions: Layer first four items. Decorate with green onions chopped tomato and black olives. Finish with teaspoon of sour cream and avocado. Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Saute onion in the butter. Mix with cooked and drained squash. Pour into an oiled baking dish. (May use Pam cooking spray.) Beat eggs well (may use Egg Beaters as a substitute). Add salt pepper sugar and then milk. Pour over squash and onion then mix gently. Top with bread crumbs and melted butter. Bake 20 minutes in a 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Break up beef and cook until no longer pink. Stir in onion and cook until tender. Add sauce mushrooms water olives herbs and salt. Simmer about 10 minutes. Spoon into prepared pan. (Grease a 9 x 15 x 2-inch baking pan.) Top with slices of cheese. Place in preheated oven. In a large bowl beat eggs milk and oil with electric mixer until foamy. Beat in flour and salt until batter is smooth. Spoon batter over hot beef mixture spreading to cover completely; sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 6.

title: Sal'S Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown beef onion and spices together. Add tomato sauce and mushrooms. Let cool. Put on hamburger bun halves. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes about 12 to 16 halves.

title: Easy Microwaved Baked Apple
instructions: Core a firm flavorful apple such as Jonagold Empire Cortland or Redfree but dont cut through the bottom of the apple. Peel a little of the skin from around the top of the apple. Put some butter and brown sugar in the hole and microwave on High for 2 minutes.

title: Eggnog Kringla
instructions: Sift powdered sugar and nutmeg. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. In another large bowl beat butter until softened. Add flour mixture and egg nog alternately; mix well. Chill 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 when ready. Roll golf ball-size balls of dough into long ropes on floured surface then shape in figure 8s on a cookie sheet pinching edges together. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown around edges. Cool on wire racks and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Oregano Rice
instructions: Saute rice in margarine until light brown (rice). Place in 3-quart casserole. Add remaining ingredients; cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or a little longer.

title: Butterscotch Dip For Apples
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in a very heavy boiler until smooth and well blended. This is a great dip and would be an excellent addition to any party.

title: Corn Dip
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients. Chill and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Caramel Chews(Unbaked)
instructions: Melt caramels in the water in double boiler. Remove from heat and stir in coconut oats and nuts. Let stand 5 minutes. Shape into 2 (12-inch) rolls. Frosted with melted chips. Refrigerate. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.

title: Slow-Cooked Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut beef into 3 x 1-inch strips; brown in oil in a skillet. Transfer to a slow cooker. Combine next 7 ingredients; pour over beef. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or until meat is tender. Add tomatoes and green peppers; cook on low for 1 hour longer. Combine water and cornstarch to make a paste. Stir into liquid in slow cooker and cook on high until thickened. Serve over noodles or rice. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix together and beat for 2 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. When it is done it is very moist. Pour confectioners sugar over entire cake.

title: Party Salad
instructions: Combine Cool Whip and milk. Refrigerate 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients and let set overnight.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill before serving.

title: Seafood Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Mix soup and chicken broth into a large pan. Add onion and green pepper. Mix and simmer until tender. Add butter shrimp crabmeat and all seasonings. Pour this mixture over crumbled cornbread and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Makes 2 average size casseroles or 1 large.

title: Strawberry Butter
instructions: Whip all ingredients together in blender. Place in a container. Refrigerate. Stays fresh for 3 to 4 weeks. Makes 2/3 cup. Excellent on toast or English muffins.

title: Hot Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix sausage and cheese well with biscuit mix. Shape into balls about the size of a quarter. Pat partially flat. Place on cookie sheet and bake for approximately 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes approximately 7 to 8 dozen.

title: Congealed Carrot Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Drain pineapple and reserve juice; add water to juice to make 2 cups. Stir into Jell-O mixture. Chill until the consistency of unbeaten egg whites is reached. Stir in pineapple carrots cheese and pecans. Pour into a lightly oiled 6 cup mold. Cover and chill until firm. Unmold onto lettuce leaves if desired. Yields 16 servings.

title: Apple Bean Bake
instructions: Melt butter. Add cubed apples and cook until tender. Add brown and white sugar. Stir until melted. Stir in cinnamon catsup and molasses. Add beans and mix well. Pour mixture into 2-quart casserole. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients in shallow baking dish.

title: Pear And Jello Salad
instructions: Use only half of juice from pears. Mix Jell-Os in hot water; use half of pear juice. Put all ingredients in the blender mix completely. Pour in mold and chill until it gels.

title: Cajun 15 Bean Soup
instructions: In a large pan or kettle cover beans with water and add 2 tablespoons salt. Soak overnight. In the morning bring to boil and then drain. Add 2-quarts water. Bring to boil. Simmer slowly 2 1/2 hours to 3 hours. May be cooked in crock-pot. In a skillet saute onion garlic and sausage until sausage is brown. Drain off excess grease; add contents to bean pot with stewed tomatoes lemon juice and flavor package. Simmer for 10 minutes. Serves 12 to 14. Great as a leftover next day. Also freezes very well.

title: Peanut Patty
instructions: Cook ingredients in a heavy skillet or pan over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes. Add red food coloring. Turn off heat and add oleo and powdered sugar. Pour on a greased cookie sheet. When set break into pieces.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: To make crust mix all ingredients to form dough. Spread in pizza pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Apple-Mint Whip
instructions: Blend to slush consistency.

title: Pico De Gallo (Fresh Salsa)
instructions: Do not peel tomatoes. Chop/dice all ingredients. Start with one serrano pepper and taste. If your desire for the fire is greater then add more peppers. Enjoy with chips vegetables etc.

title: Millionaire Candy
instructions: Boil sugar milk and butter (rolling boil). Take off heat and beat well. Add nuts marshmallow cream chips vanilla and broken Hershey bar. Fold for a few minutes. Spoon out onto wax paper or pour into buttered dish.

title: Quiche
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Saute onion and pepper in a small amount of fat. Mix meat sauteed vegetables cheese mushrooms flour and put into piecrust. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45-55 minutes or until firm. May be frozen. Serves 4.

title: Creamy Carrot Nut Mold(Salad)
instructions: Lightly oil a 2-quart mold with cooking oil. Pour boiling water over gelatin in bowl and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved. Gradually add gelatin mixture to sour cream stirring until well blended. Stir until mixture begins to jell. Stir in pineapple carrots and nuts. Turn into mold and chill until firm about 4 hours. Unmold onto salad greens.

title: Powdered Sugar Angel Food Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Fold in 1 tablespoon at a time the granulated sugar. Sift together the powdered sugar flour and salt. Fold into egg mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in tube pan at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Invert the cake while cooling.

title: Oven Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Boil sugar margarine syrup and salt for 5 minutes (stir). Remove from heat and add soda and vanilla. Stir well over popped corn (add nuts if desired). Spread on deep cookie sheet or shallow roaster. Place in 200\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring at 15 minute intervals. Remove from oven cool and store in tightly covered containers.

title: Oriental Salad
instructions: Cut cabbage lengthwise and crosswise (slice thin). Add onions and chill. Brown noodles in oleo. Add sunflower seeds and almonds. Saute until light brown; drain on paper towel. I do this ahead of time and store in plastic container.

title: Marshmallow Creme
instructions: Soften gelatine in water over top of double boiler. Place over boiling water and stir gelatine until dissolved. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Put corn syrup in large mixing bowl; pour hot gelatine mixture over the syrup and beat until thick (about 15 minutes). Stir in 2 teaspoons vanilla. Store in 1-quart wide-mouth jars in refrigerator. Spoon out as needed.

title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Combine cream cheese 1 egg and 1/4 cup sugar in a medium mixing bowl; beat on high with mixer until smooth. Gradually add 3 tablespoons milk 2 tablespoons margarine cornstarch and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla beating well. Set aside.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in skillet; add stuffing. Stir until stuffing is coated. Place 1/2 dressing in casserole. Blend together all other ingredients. Put in baking dish and cover with balance of herb dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Quebec Tourtiere
instructions: Mix meat onion and spices in a saucepan. Add boiling water. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Skim off any fat. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll out half of the pastry and line 9-inch pie plate. Place filling in pie plate and cover with the remaining pastry. Prick with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden. Serve piping hot topped with homemade ketchup or chili sauce. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Layered Potato Salad
instructions: Layer 1/2 potatoes in a large bowl. Sprinkle with 1/2 onion and 1/2 eggs. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon oil if desired. Blend cottage cheese and mayonnaise together and spread 1/2 over above layers; sprinkle with 1/2 the dry dressing mix and lemon pepper to taste. (Be generous with the lemon pepper.) Repeat layers. Let set overnight to develop flavors.

title: Catalina Beans
instructions: Wrap several beans in a strip of bacon; repeat until all beans are used. Place in baking dish and cover with Catalina dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine cream of mushroom soup and milk. Layer peas. Crumble potato chips and tuna. Repeat layers. Cover. Cook in microwave for 10 minutes.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening until soft and fluffy. Add eggs and beat until blended (mixture may become lumpy). Add cake mix and water and flavoring and mix well until blended and moist. Dough will be stiff. Add any desired additional ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls and flatten on greased cookie sheet (flattening is not required). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Cranberry Shakes
instructions: You will need chilled glasses..

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In large skillet brown sausage and drain reserving 1 tablespoon of fat in skillet. Chop mushrooms and stems; add to the skillet with the onion and saute 5 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Mound lightly into reserved mushroom caps. Bake 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes 6 appetizer servings.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple and sugar to a good boil. Remove from heat and add jello stirring until dissolved. Cool in refrigerator 45 minutes. Fold in cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and both sugars add eggs and vanilla. Mix together with flour oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. Add chips candy and nuts. Form into patties and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake for 6 minutes at 375\u00b0. The dough is very stiff and the cookies dont spread very much. They also seem to get darker as they cool so they are real easy to burn.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Brown and drain beef; stir in tomato paste onion and seasoning. Mixture will be thick. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Place biscuits in greased muffin tins; press to cover bottom and sides. Spoon 1/4 cup of mixture into each cup and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until golden brown. This will make 12 (I buy 2 cans of biscuits). Absolutely delicious and easy to make.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt together margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips over low heat stirring constantly. Add Chex to mixture and mix well.

title: Potato Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream the butter and sugar then add potatoes; beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Add melted chocolate and vanilla; beat well. Bake in 3 layers until sides of layers leave pan.

title: Infallible Rice
instructions: Saute onion in butter until transparent. Combine onion rice and hot broth; bring to a boil on top of the stove. Cover; place in a 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Sauteed Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in large baking pan. Add shrimp and lemon and herb seasoning sprinkled on top of shrimp. Bake at 450\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Saute 1 teaspoon margarine and chopped onions. Pour rice soups sauteed onions and margarine in casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Cook sausage until done; crumble then drain. Mix cheese and sausage; sprinkle in pie shell. Lightly beat eggs. Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture. Pour in shell and bake at 375\u00b0 about 40 to 45 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Baked Beans
instructions: Drain butter lima and kidney beans; add pork and beans and set aside. Fry bacon; reserve drippings and drain bacon. In small skillet add drippings brown sugar vinegar salt mustard and chopped onion. Cook until onion is transparent. Add to bean mixture; add crumbled bacon. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until done. Allow them to cool and debone them. Cut into small pieces. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth according to the time on the package. When done drain and add cheese. Stir it until it has melted completely. Saut chopped onions and bell peppers for about two minutes in 1/2 stick of margarine. Add this to spaghetti. Add chicken pimentos Ro-Tel tomatoes and English peas to spaghetti. Heat until hot but do not cook.

title: Fruit Salad(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Mix together. Drain and rinse mandarin oranges before putting in bowl.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Wash celery and cut into small pieces about 2-inch strips. Combine raisins olives cream cheese and mayonnaise and stir until ingredients are mixed well. Fill celery pieces and chill.

title: Chicken Cashew
instructions: Fresh mushrooms may be added.

title: Lemon-Poppy Seed Muffins
instructions: Grease bottoms of or use paper baking cups in regular muffin pan. Mix oil milk eggs and pudding mix with fork until blended. Stir in the poppy seeds. Divide evenly into 12 prepared muffin pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated oven at 375\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes and drizzle with glaze.

title: Monmouth County Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place chicken and ham in 2-quart casserole. Combine butter or margarine and flour; stir until smooth. Slowly stir in broth and cream. Cook (200\u00b0) stirring constantly until thickened. Add salt pepper onion mushrooms and sherry. Pour over chicken and ham. Drop sweet potato biscuit dough by tablespoons around edge of hot mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Pour into an 11 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over top. Slice butter over top of cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Chess Squares
instructions: Mix one egg margarine and dry cake mix. Mix together until crumbly. Press into the bottom of a 9x13 pan. Mix remaining eggs sugar cream cheese and vanilla until smooth. Pour on top of crumb crust. Bake at 325 degrees for 35 minutes or until you see a hint of light brown on top. Let sit until cool then cut into squares.

title: Ham And Swiss Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Bake biscuits until light browning starts. Split biscuits and place ham and Swiss cheese in the middle. Replace tops. Place biscuits in a 13 x 9-inch glass (greased) dish. Melt margarine in saucepan. Combine remaining ingredients with the margarine. Spoon mixture over the biscuits. Cover and place in refrigerator overnight. Uncover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Potatoes In Apple Cups
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Peel and mash. Add butter salt and sugar to potatoes and blend thoroughly. Scoop out inside of apples leaving a margin of about 1/4-inch all around. Fill apples with mashed sweet potatoes. Place in a baking dish and bake in a moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for about 15 minutes until apples are cooked. Place marshmallows on top of potato mixture and return to oven to allow marshmallows to brown. Serves 4.

title: Chicken In Tarragon Sauce
instructions: On hard surface with meat mallet flatten each chicken breast. In large frypan place butter over medium high temperature. Add chicken and saute about 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned and fork can easily be inserted. Remove chicken and keep warm. In same frypan add mushrooms and saute about 2 minutes. Add cognac and carefully ignite by touching edge of pan with match flame. (Always use caution when flaming!) Allow flame to completely die out after several minutes. Add cream and cook over high heat until mixture reduces and thickens coating back of spoon. Stir in cayenne tarragon dash of salt and lemon juice. Arrange chicken on a platter and pour sauce over to serve. Serves 4.

title: Italian Sausage Peppers
instructions: Cut sausage into 1-inch pieces; saute in oil in large skillet until lightly browned. Remove from heat. Saute cut up peppers and onions until tender. Add sausage and other ingredients. Stir; cook 15 to 20 minutes on low heat. Serve over noodles rice or rolls.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Roll into small balls. Flatten and deep fry in oil. Cook until brown.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Spread it in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix chicken soup mayonnaise mushrooms curry powder and 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese in medium bowl. Spread chicken mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese over top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cajun Chicken Casserole With Cornbread Crust
instructions: Combine chicken soup celery green pepper onion and pimentos in a large bowl. Stir well. Pour into a 9 x 14-inch pan or individual casserole dishes. Combine cornbread mix chicken stock and melted butter in a large bowl. Stir well. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until crust is golden and casserole is bubbly for about 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 10 servings.

title: Fresh Tofu Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add mushroom soup; beat and blend with milk and soy sauce. Mash tofu coarsely and combine all ingredients; mix well. Bake in oiled loaf pan set in a pan of hot water at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before unmolding.

title: Battle Bread
instructions: Mix all together and put in a covered bowl in icebox. Let set for 1 hour. Grease bread pan. Put dough in pan. Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Double Batch Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat and onion together. In crock-pot add all ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 2 hours (low setting on crock-pot). Can be baked in a large Corning Ware dish in oven.

title: Barb'S Pasta Salad
instructions: To the cooked pasta add the Italian dressing and salad season mix. Mix well and refrigerator overnight. Just before serving add the green peppers and tomato.

title: Slaw Dip
instructions: Mix with mustard or mayonnaise until smooth.

title: Rolled Round Steak, Jelly Roll
instructions: You will need a 3 to 4-quart pot (Dutch oven) and 1 empty Coke bottle.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour Crisco and salt. Cut shortening in flour until it is gravel size. Put vinegar egg and water in another bowl and beat then add to flour mixture. Flour your hands and form crust into a ball. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate for 2 hours before rolling into pie crust.

title: Cajun-Style Chicken Nuggets
instructions: In large bowl mix onion soup mix bread crumbs chili powder cumin thyme and pepper. Dip chicken in bread crumb mixture; coating well. In large skillet heat 1/2-inch oil and cook chicken over medium heat turning once until tender. Drain on paper towel. Serve warm and could be served with assorted mustards. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Lemon Things
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour margarine and powdered sugar in small bowl. Press evenly in bottom and about 5/8-inch up sides of square\tpan 8 x 8 x 2-inches. If dough is sticky flour fingers. Bake 20 minutes. Beat remaining ingredients in a medium bowl on medium speed until light and fluffy. Pour over hot crust. Bake\tabout 25 minutes. Let stand until cool and cut into small pieces.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Dilute the lemonade according to directions on the can and pour into punch bowl. Stir in thawed strawberries. Just before serving add ginger ale and ice. Makes 1 1/2 gallons of punch.

title: German Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 12-cup Bundt pan. Mix cake mix oil water and eggs together with mixer on low speed until blended about 1 minute. Scrape bowl and beat for 2 minutes still on low speed. Add the container of frosting and continue beating on low speed for about 2 minutes. Pour into pan and bake until a cake tester inserted in cake comes out clean 55 to 60 minutes. Cool cake in pan. Invert onto a plate and cool completely before slicing. No frosting is needed.

title: Ants On A Log
instructions: Wash celery and cut into small pieces. Fill celery with cream cheese and add raisins. Children can assist with this activity.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Peel core and chop apples. Cook apples slowly (do not add water). Cook in crock-pot on low temperature for 7 to 8 hours. Makes about 3 pints.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining Durkee onions. Broil until crisp and brown.

title: Hearty Sausage Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat brown sausage; drain. Add onions carrot and green pepper; cook until tender. Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk; cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and begins to boil. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and sage. In 3-quart baking dish combine beans and sausage mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve hot with crackers. Makes 10 servings.

title: Amish Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients thoroughly and make a well in center. To well in flour mix and add remaining ingredients. Mix until no lumps remain. Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan. Doesnt need to be greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Saturday Night Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole combine onion and ground meat. Microwave 4 minutes on High (100%). In a separate bowl combine the remaining ingredients mixing well. Add to meat and onion stirring to blend. Cover and microwave 8 minutes on High (100%) or simmer on stove. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Soak bread in milk. Combine with onion meat beaten egg salt and pepper.

title: Corn Custard With Tomatoes
instructions: Grate corn from cobs into a bowl and measure correct amount. Beat eggs vigorously and stir in onion salt and cayenne. Heat milk until a film forms; skim and stir into corn mixture. Pour into 6 buttered custard cups and place in a shallow pan containing about 1 inch of boiling water. Bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in center of custard comes out clean.

title: Cranberry Smoothie
instructions: Combine half of all the ingredients in electric blender; process until smooth. Repeat with all the remaining ingredients. Combine mixtures. Pour into individual glasses. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Homemade Butter
instructions: Mix thoroughly with mixer until it turns to butter.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter or oleo and eggs (one at a time). Add flour baking powder soda vanilla and sour cream or buttermilk. In small bowl mix cinnamon chopped nuts and sugar. Pour half of batter in cake pan; put half of topping onto cake then add remaining cake batter and top with remaining topping. Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan in 350\u00b0 oven for for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sprinkle nuts and coconut in bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix cake mix according to package directions; pour over coconut. Cream margarine and cream cheese. Add powdered sugar. Drizzle by spoonfuls over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease 3 loaf pans. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place all ingredients in bowl except for nuts and beat with electric beater until creamy. Add nuts and pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 3 loaves.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: Blend ingredients together and pour into baked pie shell. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Zucchini Dish
instructions: Spread rolls on 9 x 13-inch pan. Saute onion and zucchini in oleo until soft. Pour over rolls. Pour eggs over zucchini and onions. Sprinkle cheese over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Company Rice
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Bake in covered 2-quart casserole dish 1 hour or until done. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
