instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Blend until creamy. Blend in egg. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Christmas Gingersnaps
instructions: Sift flour measure 7 cups and sift with soda salt and spices. Sift 1/2 cup flour and set aside to use only if needed. Measure sugar butter and molasses. Turn molasses into small pan and warm slightly; add brown sugar and stir until melted. Add butter blending in well. Stir in eggs one at a time. Batter is smooth. Add orange peel. Stir in dry ingredients. Gradually add sufficient flour to make a soft dough that can be kneaded. Knead until smooth. Keep tightly covered and refrigerate overnight. Roll out and cut in desired shapes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Rice Puffs
instructions: Beat egg. Stir in poultry seasoning salt and cheese; mix with rice. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Shape by rounded teaspoonfuls into 1-inch balls. Roll in bread crumbs. Heat 2 to 3 inches of oil. Fry rice balls until golden brown; drain. Makes about 15 rice balls.

title: Veal Shank, Milanese-Style(Ossobuco Ala Milanese)
instructions: Melt 6 tablespoons of butter in a skillet large enough to hold the veal pieces without crowding. Roll the meat in the flour and put in the skillet over moderate heat to brown both sides. Add carrot onion celery half the garlic the marjoram and the piece of lemon peel then season with salt and pepper.

title: Apple-Nut Kuchen
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon. Mix one egg 1/2 cup milk and 3 tablespoons oil; stir into flour mixture. Turn into well-oiled 9-inch pan.

title: Pepperoni Quiche Appetizer
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in a greased pie plate (use a bigger pan and make thinner for an appetizer). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Brandied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: One and one-fourth hours before serving cook yams in boiling salted water for 25 minutes or until tender. Drain and cool. In a 1-quart saucepan mix cornstarch nutmeg or cinnamon salt and granulated sugar. Stir in water. Cook over low heat until sauce is clear. Stir in lemon juice and brandy. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Peel potatoes; slice crosswise 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Put into buttered shallow baking dish. Pour on sauce then bake 30 minutes or until glazed basting occasionally. When glazed sprinkle with miniature marshmallows and broil until golden if desired.

title: Salted Peanut Crisps
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix shortening brown sugar eggs and vanilla. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting. Blend together flour soda and salt; stir in. Mix in peanuts. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2-inches apart on lightly greased sheet. Flatten with tumbler dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen (2-inch) cookies.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. In a medium bowl stir flour baking soda and salt. Set aside.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Using large glass or plastic bowl that has flared top layer vegetables in order named; do not mix. Spread mayonnaise over top to seal. Sprinkle sugar then cheese over this. Seal with covering of plastic wrap or tight fitting lid. Refrigerate 8 to 12 hours. When ready to serve sprinkle top with crumbled fresh fried bacon or artificial bacon bits. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Crock-Pot Camp Stew
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain well. Add to other ingredients in crock-pot. Stir well cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours (high for 2 to 3 hours). Serve with tossed salad and crusty French bread for a quick and easy meal.

title: Bacon And Chive Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 14 minutes or until tender. Drain. Mix mayonnaise and mustard in a large bowl. Add potatoes bacon and chives. Mix lightly. Refrigerate until serving (at least 1 to 2 hours). Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick Cheeseburger Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Generously grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cook beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain. Stir in soup vegetables and milk. Stir baking mix and water in baking dish until moistened; spread evenly. Spread beef mixture over batter. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Mounds Cake
instructions: Blend filling together (cream cheese butter sugar 1 egg cornstarch milk and vanilla). Beat at high speed until smooth. Set aside.

title: Homemade Pimiento Cheese
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients with mayonnaise. Add pimiento salt and sugar.

title: Butterscotch Pudding Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix egg and 1/3 cup water in square pan 8 x 8-inch. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Mix remaining ingredients and gradually pour over brown sugar. Bake until cake springs back 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Spoon into dessert dishes. Serve warm; whipped cream optional.

title: Coconut Cake And Icing
instructions: Cream eggs sugar and Crisco. Add milk baking powder flour vanilla and coconut. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mocha Walnut Brownies
instructions: Heat the brown sugar and butter in a medium-size saucepan over medium-low heat until the butter has melted. Dissolve the coffee in the hot water and stir into the butter mixture. Let cool to room temperature. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter an 8 x 11-inch baking pan. When the butter mixture is cool beat in the eggs and vanilla. Sift the flour baking powder and salt together. Stir into the butter mixture with a wooden spoon. Stir in the walnuts and chocolate. Spread evenly in the pan with a rubber spatula. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until light brown. Cool and cut into bars. Frost and sprinkle with nuts if desired. Makes 20 brownies.

title: 100% Frosting
instructions: Boil the first 5 ingredients until clear. Pour over slightly beaten egg white; continue to beat until spreading consistency. Add vanilla.

title: Grits And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Grease a 2-quart souffle dish. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cook grits in milk and water according to package directions. Add salt. When grits are cooked add pepper nutmeg Tabasco and all but 1/2 cup of cheese. Mix well and then allow to cool slightly. Add egg yolks. Beat egg whites stiff and add half of them to the grit mixture; beat well. Fold in remaining egg whites with a rubber spatula. Spoon into the souffle dish and sprinkle remaining cheese over the top. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Ladyfinger Dessert
instructions: Melt chocolate in a double boiler pan. Stir in instant coffee. Cool. Beat egg yolks and fold in chocolate mixture. Beat egg whites fold in chocolate mixture. Beat whipping cream with salt and fold in mixture.

title: Carrot Cheese Log
instructions: Mix together carrots cream cheese Parmesan cheese and fines herbes. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Microwave Potatoes For 2
instructions: Peel and chunk potatoes. You can also add chopped onion to taste. Put in small casserole with tight fitting lid. Dont add any water. Cook on high for 3 minutes. Add small pat of oleo. Stir well to coat the potatoes. Then add any of the seasonings and cook covered for 1 more minute or until tender.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Cream together margarine brown and white sugar and peanut butter. Then add rest of the ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Put 1 cup chocolate chips over top and let melt. Frost with the following 1/2 cup 10x sugar 1/4 cup peanut butter and 2 to 4 tablespoons milk.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: Layer chicken onion slices and Velveeta cheese in order listed in 11 x 14-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 of chips. Pour mixture of tomatoes and soups over chips. Top with remaining chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Does best if covered with foil during baking. Uncover last 10 minutes to brown top.) Makes 12 servings.

title: Lemon Chiffon Jello
instructions: Pour the liquid from the pears into a saucepan with the 2 packages Jell-O. Heat just before it boils. Blend pears cream cheese and Cool Whip in blender. Fold in Jell-O. Pour mixture into 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish sprayed with Pam. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Fudge
instructions: Combine cocoa sugar milk and vanilla in 3-quart saucepan. Stir until smooth. Cook on medium heat until soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Cool and beat until loses its gloss. Add peanut butter and nuts. Pour onto buttered platter. Cool and cut.

title: Chicken Mushroom Pie
instructions: Combine chicken celery soup mushrooms and liquid celery green pepper and steak sauce in a large skillet. Heat slowly until bubbly hot about 10 minutes.

title: Family Reunion Rolls(Makes 2 Dozen)
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast into warm water; stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture. Add beaten eggs and 3 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Add and stir in remaining flour.

title: Green Chilli
instructions: Saute pork steak; salt and pepper to taste. Brown hamburger; salt and pepper to taste. Put Ro-Tel and tomatoes in blender and blend about 30 seconds. Cut jalapenos into small pieces. Put all ingredients into large soup pot add 1/2 jar of minced garlic and cook (simmer) for about 1 hour or so.

title: Baked Pork Chops(Makes 1 To 2 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash chops and season on both sides. Beat together egg and milk. Dip chops in mixture then coat on both sides with crushed cornflakes. Place in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and the juices run clear. It is not necessary to turn chops during cooking. Serve in sandwich or with baked potato or other vegetable.

title: Lemon Oat Lacies(Cookies)
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add remaining ingredients except powdered sugar; mix well. Cover. Chill 30 minutes.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and oil. Add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda and add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla. Add coconut and nuts. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture. Pour batter into three greased and floured 8-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Roast Beef Po Boy
instructions: Put roast in baking pan. Add onion garlic and soup. Add bouillon cubes to water; pour over. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0. May need to add more water. Slice roast; serve on French bread with gravy.

title: Waikiki Meatballs
instructions: Mix thoroughly beef crumbs onion egg salt ginger and milk. Shape mixture by tablespoon into balls. Melt shortening in large skillet; brown and cook meatballs. Remove meatballs. Pour fat from skillet. Mix cornstarch and sugar. Stir in reserved pineapple syrup vinegar and soy sauce until smooth. Pour in skillet; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens. Boil 1 minute. Add meatballs and pineapple tidbits; heat thoroughly. Serve over bed of rice.

title: Chocolate Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Mix sugar salt and\tcocoa.\tAdd eggs and mix well. Stir in vanilla and milk. Add melted oleo then coconut. One cup of nuts may be added if desired. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until firm. Cool and serve.

title: Mexican Fiesta
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add seasoning and water. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Prepare rice. Melt cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes; mix well. Combine meat rice and cheese dip. Top with chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: *Weight Watchers makes a fat-free Parmesan cheese.

title: Tex-Mex Salad
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in bowl. Using a fork gradually mix oil into lime juice in small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Add to salad with mint and mix well. Line plates (or serving bowl) with lettuce leaves. Mound salad on lettuce.

title: Microwave Applesauce
instructions: Place apples and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover and microwave on High until apples are tender. Stir in sugar and cinnamon. Cool.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Peel orange remove white membrane. Chop rind and pulp fine. Chop or grind cranberries. Combine apples oranges and cranberries and drain well reserving the juice. Pour juice in measuring cup and add enough water to make two cups. Heat one cup juice and sugar in a small saucepan stirring until sugar is dissolved. Pour over gelatin in bowl stir until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in remaining juice and cool thoroughly. Add drained fruits nuts and celery. Pour into mold and chill until firm. Unmold on lettuce greens with pink gelatin cubes and pink mayonnaise.

title: Jello Delight
instructions: Dilute Jell-O in hot water and let set slightly. Add crushed pineapple; let set until firm. Mix Dream Whip according to package; add cream cheese. Whip together and put over set Jell-O. Cook until thick the eggs sugar flour and juices. Cool then spread over Jell-O and cheese topping.

title: Spice Snakin' Cake(Microwave)
instructions: Mix as directed on box using only 3/4 cup water. Place in a 5 x 9-inch buttered glass dish or cut a piece of wax paper to fit bottom. Microwave on Medium for 6 minutes; rotate dish one time. Cook on High 3 minutes. Rotate dish one time. Makes 6 servings.

title: Christmas Plum Pudding
instructions: Combine raisins currants nutmeats and 1/2 cup flour. Combine eggs molasses buttermilk suet and fruit juice. Combine remaining flour bread crumbs soda spice and salt. Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold. Cover mold; set in deep kettle. Add water to 1-inch below cover of mold. Cover and steam 2 hours.

title: Stuffed Orange French Toast
instructions: Butter 1 side of each bread slice; lay 6 slices flat buttered side down in a lightly buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Brown Sugar Macaroons
instructions: Combine sugar nuts and egg and mix. Using 1 rounded teaspoonful per cookie shape into balls. Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet in a preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Breakfast Stuff(Stuff:  An Unspecified Material Substance Or Aggregate Of Matter.)
instructions: Brown sausage and drain well. Mix Bisquick milk and eggs. Spread mix in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine sour cream poppy seed salt and eggs. Spread this mix over the sausage. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Chicken Soup(The Kind That Cures The Flu)
instructions: Cook chicken in large stockpot; cool debone and cut up into small pieces. Return to pot in which broth from chicken was cooked. If more broth is needed you may use clear canned broth. Add clean cut up carrots and celery. Add onions which have been chopped and chopped fresh parsley tops and stems. Cook in broth until tender. You will need to salt and pepper to taste. May serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Pasta Nugget Salad
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions; drain. In large bowl combine pasta and remaining ingredients; toss to mix. Serve immediately or cover and chill. Stir gently before serving. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Congealed Waldorf Salad
instructions: Bring 1 cup cider to a boil; add gelatin and stir until dissolved. Stir in remaining cider. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Fold in apple celery and pecans. Pour into a 4-cup mold. Chill until set. Unmold on a lettuce lined plate and top with a dollop of mayonnaise.

title: Ground Meat & Rice
instructions: Brown meat in butter. Add soup rice and water. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes or until rice is done.

title: Coconut Candy
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into 1-inch balls; chill. Dip into chocolate and place on wax paper to set.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Stir well cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Serve with vegetables or Snackwell pepper crackers.

title: Red Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs until smooth. Then combine food coloring cocoa and salt to make a paste. Add this to shortening mixture. Then add flour milk and vanilla; beat until smooth. Remove from mixer and fold in vinegar and soda. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Cook broccoli according to package directions to tender-crisp. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large heavy skillet over moderate heat. Stir in garlic basil leaves onions and parsley. Cook 1 to 2 minutes. Turn off heat and gently mix in with cooked broccoli.

title: Irene'S Cake
instructions: In a casserole dish place crumbled angel food cake in bottom and cover with crushed pineapple with juice. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions and pour over pineapple. Place sliced bananas over pudding; cover with Cool Whip. Let chill before serving.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: In a large kettle cook potatoes carrots and celery in water with bouillon cubes until tender. Saute onions in butter until soft. Stir in flour and salt and pepper gradually add sour cream stirring constantly until desired consistency. If too thick add plain milk. Yield 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Homecoming Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding milk sour cream and half of Cool Whip. Layer crackers bananas and pudding. Top with other half of Cool Whip.

title: Kay Huddleston'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Mix soup and Cheez Whiz. Add cooked and well drained broccoli. Top with onion rings or cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Corn Noodle Soup
instructions: Cut up the chicken and cover with 3 quarts water. Add the salt and saffron and stew until tender. Remove chicken from stock and set aside the legs and breast for chicken salad. Take the rest of the meat from the bones and return meat to broth. Add the corn and noodles to soup. Season with pepper. Cook 15 minutes longer. Before serving add parsley and chopped eggs.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Beat eggs in a large bowl on high until foamy. Beat in flour sugar and brown sugar. Beat in butter. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into pie shell and bake for 55-60 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream or cool whip.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
instructions: Boil a whole chicken in a Dutch oven pot with water. (Cover chicken over half way with water) after chicken is done take out of broth to cool. Mix flour and shortening in together first. Then add all other ingredients. (I beat my egg in with the 5 tablespoons of chicken broth.) After mixing all ingredients mixture should be a soft dough. Roll out dough very thin and let stand for about 10 minutes. Then cut into strips and drop into boiling broth. Simmer about 15 minutes then add deboned chicken to dumplings.

title: Butterscotch Fudge Bar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter and chocolate in saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour baking powder and salt. Add morsels. Spread mixture in a 9-inch square pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Store in airtight container.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix chill and serve with apples grapes bananas and other fruit of your choice.

title: Crunch Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and shortening until light and creamy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add milk and flour alternately. Stir in flavorings. Start baking in cold oven at 275\u00b0 in tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti saute green pepper and onions in butter. When tender combine all other ingredients (except spaghetti) and bring to a simmer over low heat until well blended. Mix with spaghetti. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Spread with cheese and melt in oven. Garnish with parsley.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix well. Refrigerating overnight makes it better.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream butter sugar salt and flour together. Add beaten eggs buttermilk and nutmeg. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Nutmeg may be sprinkled on top of pie if desired.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: In a large pan brown ground beef; drain. Add tomato sauce mushrooms and onion; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Prepare noodles according to package directions.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake(Prepare 24 Hours Ahead.)
instructions: Prepare 24 hours ahead.

title: Copy Cat Cheese Biscuits(Similar To Those Served By A Popular Seafood Restaurant)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix baking mix cheese and water. Drop by large spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. After baking while hot brush with melted butter mixed with the parsley garlic and Italian seasoning. Serve hot. Makes about 12 biscuits.

title: J.D.'S Texas Cheese Dip
instructions: Heat soup to boiling. Reduce heat and melt in cheese. Add green chiles. Pour into bowl and let cool for one hour. Great for dipping fresh vegetables or tortilla chips. For hotter dip use Velveeta jalapeno cheese.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Place the flour baking powder baking soda and salt in a bowl. In another bowl cream the shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat the eggs and add to the creamed mixture. Mash the bananas (3/4 cup banana pulp) and mix with the sour milk and vanilla. Add the banana mixture alternately with the dry ingredients. Mix well. Pour the batter into 2 greased 9-inch round layer pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1/2 hour at 375\u00b0 for the round pans and 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 for the 9 x 13-inch oblong pan.

title: English Cheese Melts
instructions: Cut English muffins in half. Set aside. In large bowl mix together olives cheese onions mayonnaise and salt. Spread mixture evenly over 12 muffin halves. Place on baking sheet. Broil 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and melted. Cut in half before serving. Garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: You will need 1 (8 x 20 x 3-inch) pan with cover.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes & Apples
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes in half crosswise. Cook in boiling water to cover for 10 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Zucchini Brownies
instructions: Mix together flour sugar cocoa salt and baking soda. Combine shredded zucchini vanilla and oil. Mix with dry ingredients. Add nuts. Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. May frost or serve as is. Very good!

title: Carrot Ring With Peas
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Place in a greased 5 1/2 cup ring mold. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Unmold and serve on platter with cooked peas in the center. This makes a very pretty vegetable to serve with chicken fish or beef. You may make the ring and freeze. Reheat fill with peas and serve immediately.

title: Crispix Squares
instructions: Pack first four ingredients in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Add vanilla ice cream. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

title: Italian Fish Fillets
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut fish into serving size pieces. Arrange in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with parsley basil oregano and pepper. Top with spaghetti sauce then sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily at the thickest part.

title: Wyoming Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar together. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Drop onto cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 8 dozen.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream together eggs sugar and oil. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and cinnamon. Add alternately with baby food. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. For icing combine cream cheese powdered sugar vanilla and butter or oleo.

title: Vinegar For Sushi
instructions: Combine vinegar sugar and salt in saucepan stirring until sugar dissolves. Bring to a boil. (If you desire add ajinomoto when liquid becomes clear.) You can make a larger \batch\ at a time and keep it on hand making it handy to make sushi inari maze-gohan California roll etc. frequently. The \su\ is also very good to make \sunomono\ or for other salads.

title: Black Forest Pie
instructions: Spread 1 cup whipped topping on bottom of pie crust. Combine milk and pudding mix. Blend with wire whisk or mixer for 1 minute. Fold in 1 1/2 cups whipped topping. Spread over whipped topping in crust. Spread remaining whipped topping over top leaving a 1-inch border and forming a depression in center of the whipped topping. Spoon cherry pie filling in the center. Chill 3 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place dry beef in bottom of dish. Wrap bacon around chicken. Spread soup over top of all. Cover with foil. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours then 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour uncovered.

title: Twin Mountain Muffins
instructions: Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with baking powder and salt. Cream butter and shortening; blend in sugar gradually. Add beaten egg and beat until smooth and fluffy. Add flour mixture alternately with milk beating well after each addition. Spoon into buttered muffin pans filling about 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift together the flour soda and salt. In separate bowl cream together the butter shortening sugar and vanilla. Add egg to creamed mixture and beat until fluffy. Add dry ingredients plus milk to creamed mixture and stir until smooth. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass which has been dipped into sugar. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven for about 12 minutes. Cool. Yields 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: My Favorite Meat Ball Appetizer
instructions: Mix ingredients together; roll into walnut size balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 until done (approximately 30 to 45 minutes). Prepare the sauce while meat balls are baking.

title: Texas B.B.Q. Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Over medium heat add butter onion green pepper saute until tender about 5 minutes. Add beef and saute 2 minutes. Add lemon juice worcestershire sauce ketchup brown sugar mustard salt and hot pepper sauce to skillet mix well.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add cold milk to egg yolk. Add this mixture to scalded milk (total 2 1/2 cups milk includes all). Cook very slowly until thick and creamy. Add vanilla. Cool. Pour into unbaked cooled pie crust 8 or 9-inch. Add meringue by beating 3 egg whites (room temperature) with 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar until foamy. Gradually add 3 tablespoons sugar and beat until stands in peaks. Put on pie. Brown in 350\u00b0 oven 12 minutes. Cool out of draft.

title: Mock Scwarzwalder Kirsch
instructions: Mix cake mix cinnamon almond extract and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 and let cool.

title: Brennan Potatoes
instructions: Bake potato. Grill bacon until crisp. Drain leaving 3 tablespoons grease. Add onion and saute slowly. Remove from heat. Cut shallow lengthwise strip from potatoes and scoop out inside and add to skillet. Add cheese crumbled bacon sour cream and seasonings. Mix and mash with spoon to blend. Return to low heat and heat through. Stuff into potatoes. Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets. Cream the butter with sugars in a large bowl until blended. Add egg and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and baking soda in a small bowl. Stir into creamed mixture with oats chocolate chips raisins and nuts. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto prepared cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned around edges. Remove to wire racks to cool. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Let margarine get to room temperature. Add Crisco and sugar beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating 1 minute after each alternately with milk. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Simple Party Punch
instructions: In punch bowl place any flavor sherbet. \I prefer orange.\ Then slowly pour the ginger ale over and let soften. Stir and mix together until the sherbet is dissolved.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Combine dry Jell-O with defrosted Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Drain liquids from oranges and pineapple; stir into Jell-O mixture. Reserve a small amount of oranges to decorate the top. Refrigerate and serve cold.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook beans for 15 minutes. Layer on tray and let cool. Mix taco mix and add cream cheese. Layer on top of beans. Chop pepper tomato onion and lettuce and layer in order. Serve with chips.

title: Grilled Fajitas
instructions: Marinate the meat according to directions. Grill the vegetables until tender-crisp. Remove and keep warm. Grill meat until preferred doneness.

title: Broccoli 'N Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together soup broccoli rice process cheese spread half the onions and water. Spoon into 1 quart casserole dish. Bake 35 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Cabbage Casserole In A Rice Cooker
instructions: Brown ground meat and sausage together. Drain oil when cooked. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl; then transfer into rice cooker. When cooked leave in cooker for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dutch Baked Beans
instructions: Saute peppers and onions in small amount of oil. Blend all ingredients together. Pour into casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Mexicali Pie
instructions: In skillet brown frankfurters and cook onion in butter until tender. Add soup beans and water. Bring to boil. Pour into 2-quart shallow baking dish (12 x 8 x 2-inch). Combine corn muffin mix milk and egg. Spoon around edge of baking dish. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until done. Makes about 5 1/2 cups.

title: Strawberry-Banana Smoothy
instructions: In blender process strawberries yogurt banana and juice until smooth. Immediately pour into chilled insulated drink container or make into popsicles. Refrigerate any remaining drink in covered container and serve later. Instruct your child to give the container several vigorous shakes before opening it.

title: Cheese And Chilies Roll
instructions: Bring cheeses to room temperature. On a sheet of wax paper roll out Velveeta. Divide the cream cheese into small portions and put on top of Velveeta. Roll again. Spread the green chilies over cheeses. Roll up as for a jelly roll. Divide into 2 rolls. Serve with crackers.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients then bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter vanilla and oats. Stir well. Drop on wax paper.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well then chill overnight. Serve with chips or raw vegetables.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
instructions: Roll pork chops in flour and onion mixture. Brown pork chops in oiled skillet. Add whole tomatoes salt and pepper. Cover with tomato sauce and simmer until tender.

title: Sizzlers
instructions: Cook hamburger meat and onion until done; drain. Add chili powder garlic powder salt pepper and red pepper. Cook for a few minutes. Add Cheez Whiz and cook until melted. Spread meat on flat tostada shells. Shred cabbage on top of meat (may want to sprinkle red pepper on if you like hot stuff). Place another tostada shell on top of cabbage.

title: Caramel-Peach Crunch Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a bowl combine flour oats sugar cinnamon and salt. Add butter. Mix well.

title: Persimmon Date Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Dissolve soda in persimmon pulp. Mix into creamed ingredients. Combine flour baking powder salt cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Stir into creamed mixture.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine cream cheese and margarine. Add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs slowly until well mixed. Gradually add flour. Then add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Fruited Pistachio Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl combine pudding mix whipped topping and salad dressing; mix well. Fold in remaining ingredients. Leave in bowl. Serve immediately or chill.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook until soft ball stage the sugar Karo and water. After soft ball stage add peanuts. Cook until dark. Remove from burner. Add baking soda vinegar and salt. Mix together and pour onto a buttered cookie sheet. Cool then break apart.

title: One Bowl Banana Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl add all ingredients and beat until mixed well. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 40 minutes. Test with toothpick to see if done. Cool and frost with butter powdered sugar frosting.

title: Chewies
instructions: Melt oleo; add sugar. Add eggs one at a time; add flour and vanilla. Spread thinly on greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut while hot.

title: Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crumb with next 3 ingredients. Reserve 3/4 cup with spoon. Press the rest to bottom and sides of 9-inch spring-form. Beat eggs light slowly beat in 1 cup sugar. Add next 5 ingredients and beat with hand or beater until blended. Sieve. Stir in lemon rind. Pour into pan. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn off heat open oven door. Cool cake in oven for 1 hour. Dont fret it will settle. Chill. Remove pan sides. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fruit Pops
instructions: Put in all ingredients and blend until smooth. Put in Dixie cups or popsicle molds. Put plastic spoon or popsicle stick in middle and freeze until frozen.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put 1/3 cup mix in mug; add hot water to make 1 cup.

title: Egg Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cut bread; add a little butter. Beat eggs with milk salt and mustard. Layer bread sausage and cheese. Pour egg mixture on top and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions; drain. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and seasonings. Add the two cheeses. Let simmer while you cook and drain macaroni; add to other ingredients and let simmer 10 minutes. Pour into two oblong; greased baking dishes and cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. This can be frozen for use at a later date.

title: Chili Cheese Puff
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Kentucky Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked deep dish pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until solid.

title: Cream Of Corn Soup
instructions: To Cream Soup Base add corn milk onion chervil salt and bouillon cube. Heat to simmering cooking long enough to dissolve bouillon cube. Serve garnished with parsley and paprika.

title: Bean Relish Bowl
instructions: Combine all but lettuce and egg. Toss lightly cover. Chill at least 1 hour. Just before serving add lettuce and egg. Toss.

title: Divinity
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup water and salt. Cook to very hard ball stage (260\u00b0). Slowly pour syrup in a thin stream over beaten egg whites beating constantly. Beat until mixture holds shape (about 4 to 5 minutes). Stir in vanilla. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls on waxed paper lifting and twirling spoon to form a peak. If divinity becomes too stiff for twirling add a few drops hot water. Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Beef Casserole(From The Files Of Louella Scott Williams)
instructions: Lightly brown the ground beef onion and green pepper in oil then add the soups water garlic and cooked spaghetti. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and top with grated cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add oil sugar vanilla and zucchini. Mix well. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add raisins pineapple and nuts. Blend.

title: Fried Eggplant Or Summer Squash
instructions: Wash eggplant; pare and cut in 1/2-inch slices. Or wash squash and cut crosswise in slices. Dip slices in well seasoned flour. Saute slowly in butter for 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp and browned turning occasionally. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Whitney'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil potatoes in jacket until done. Peel and mash. Add butter sugar vanilla sprinkle of nutmeg & cinnamon. Combine the beaten eggs and milk. Mix with potatoes until well blended. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients for 2 minutes with electric mixer. Fold in nuts. Bake in greased tube pan 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool before serving.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Blend dry ingredients and 1/2 sour cream. Mix well all remaining sour cream. Beat well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Pumpkin Cake(This Cake Is So Tasty It Doesn'T Need Frosting)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together and beat well. Bake in tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour. May sprinkle with confectioners sugar if desired.

title: Pecan Pie Muffins
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together in large bowl. Make a well in center. In another bowl mix eggs until foamy. Mix butter into eggs. Put egg mixture into dry ingredients. Mix well. Pour into foil cupcake liners. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. You must use foil cupcake liners.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Ham, Egg And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Place ham cheese and croutons in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix remaining ingredients; pour this mixture over crouton mixture and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pot Pie
instructions: Cook until barely tender carrots potatoes and celery. Add dinner cuts onions and a dash of salt. Add mushroom soup. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with pie crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts Diane(Reduced Fat)
instructions: Cook chicken slowly in covered nonstick skillet on both sides. Add a little water if it wants to stick.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in large mixer bowl; beat for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pans for 15 minutes. Remove and cool on racks.

title: Miniature Cheese Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Line cupcake pans with paper liners. Place vanilla wafer in bottom of each liner. In small bowl beat next 5 items until light and fluffy. Fill liners 3/4 full with mixture. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until set. Top each with spoonful of filling and 1 teaspoon nuts. Chill. Serves 24.

title: Slaw
instructions: Cut up cabbage onion and carrot. Mix. Add sugar and salad dressing. Mix.

title: Christian Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Add tears of joy sorrow and sympathy for others. Flavor with little gifts of love and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of faith and prayer to lighten other ingredients and raise texture of great heights of Christian living. Bake well at a high degree of human kindness and serve with a warm smile.

title: The Zucchini Bread
instructions: This is so easy and so great to have on hand in the freezer. Toasts like a dream or serve with cream cheese.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick butter mix 1/2 cup powdered sugar and graham cracker crumbs. This makes first layer of cake. Press mixture into bottom of loaf pan.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in order listed in a microwave-safe pan. Microwave on High for 5 minutes or bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa. Add corn syrup and milk. Stir. Cook on medium heat stirring often until it reaches a soft ball stage (235\u00b0 on a candy thermometer). Add butter and vanilla. Let cool. Beat until it thickens and loses its shine. Pour into greased pan to harden. (Nuts may be added just before pouring into pan.)

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt in a bowl. Heat margarine Coke and cocoa in pan to boiling. Pour over mixture. Add eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla. Stir in marshmallows. Batter will be thin; marshmallows will float. Cook in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Frost cake while hot.

title: Beet Top Greens
instructions: Beet greens may be prepared in the same ways that you prepare spinach or Swiss chard but they must be young and small to be tasty. Try cooking the greens in boiling salted water for 5 to 8 minutes. Drain chop and add the butter or margarine. Toss with a fork until butter is melted. Add the horseradish and lemon juice; mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Serves 4.

title: Peaches-N-Cream Pie
instructions: Blend first seven ingredients for two minutes. Put into greased 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Arrange peach slices on top. Blend cream cheese juice and 1/2 cup sugar together. Beat until creamy and place in center of peaches; spread out to about 1 inch from edge of pie plate. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can be served warm or cold.

title: Red Wine Vinegar Salad Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and mix until smooth. Serve over various lettuce salads.

title: Waldorf Turkey Toss With Apple Dressing
instructions: Combine applesauce honey vinegar poppy seed paprika and lemon peel. Gradually add oil beating with electric mixer until slightly thickened.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cut carrots into round pieces and boil about 5 minutes. Combine carrots with rest of ingredients and refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

title: Glad'S Own Custard Pie(Ed'S Very Favorite)
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar. Scald milk and add to mixture. Add nutmeg; pour into unbaked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until filling is firm. Top with meringue. Brown slightly.

title: Orange-Nut Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Stir in orange rind and nuts. Beat eggs in small bowl. Add orange juice and oil. Mix well. Add to flour mixture. Mix until moistened. Fill greased tins 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Melt butter in oblong baking pan. Pour out and save for later. In\tpan put pie\tfilling on bottom and top with crushed pineapple\tand juice. Cover this with the dry cake mix. Top off with reserved melted butter. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
instructions: Prepare enough grits to serve 12. Mix all ingredients in grits while hot. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except milk and salad oil. Dip chicken in milk and coat with crumb mixture. Place in shallow roasting pan skin side up (do not grease pan). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Brush with salad oil; bake 30 more minutes or until nicely browned and tender.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown sausage meat; drain. Press one can crescent rolls in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish. Top with sausage and cheese. Beat eggs; add salt and pepper. Pour eggs over sausage and cheese. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Saute shrimp in oil until pink. Remove shrimp and saute onion celery and bell pepper. Add rice to shrimp and eggplant mixture. Pour into buttered 2 1/2 quart dish. Pour soup over top. Top with grated cheese and then buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: You will need one 8-inch clay flowerpot.

title: Caramel Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar and corn syrup and blend. Pour mixture into bottom of 8 x 8-inch or 10-inch round pan. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Peel and slice apple. Spread apple slices on top of nuts. Dip each refrigerated roll in sugar-cinnamon mixture (one side only). Place sugar side down in the pan. After placing all rolls in pan sprinkle remaining mixture over all. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven and turn out onto a large plate or tray. Let sit for 30 seconds then lift off and serve warm.

title: Ginger'S Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets. Combine first four ingredients and mix well with spoon. (Dough will be thick.) Add vanilla chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Let stand on cookie sheet 1 minute before removing to wire rack. Yields 2 dozen large or 4 dozen small cookies.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar milk cocoa and margarine for 1 1/2 minutes. Start timing when it has reached a full boil. Remove from heat; add oats nuts and vanilla. Then add peanut butter. Mix well then drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Chocolate Crunch Truffles
instructions: In a medium saucepan over very low heat melt chocolate stirring constantly; remove from heat. Add butter stirring until melted; stir in liqueur and orange peel if desired. Transfer to a medium bowl; cover and refrigerate until mixture is fudge-like about 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom Croustades
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut a 3-inch round from each slice of bread. Brush inside of 2 miniature muffin tins generously with butter. Gently fit bread rounds into each mold to form a cup. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Butterscotch Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt and cinnamon; set aside. Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs and beat. Add flour mixture and oats. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Soup
instructions: Simmer all ingredients and then add cheese. Stir until completely mixed. Serve with tortilla chips and quesadillas.

title: Cheesy Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. To cook chicken you can either boil for 20 to 25 minutes or place in a microwave-safe dish; cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes on High. Turn and cook another 2 to 3 minutes or until cooked through and no longer pink inside. Let cool. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish combine chicken salt pepper rice and soup. Mix well. Top with cheese then with bread cubes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the bread. Use some of the reserved clam fluid to thin it. Cut the top off the bread. Break out the insides and set aside.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix vanilla pudding 1 cup water 1/2 cup oil and the eggs together on medium speed until well blended. Fold in the poppy seed. Prepare Bundt or tube pan by greasing with butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool 15 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put 4 to 6 slices of bacon on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until juice cooks down.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in casserole dish. Mix soup and milk. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and is bubbly.

title: Peanut Butter And Oat Cookies
instructions: Bring first three ingredients to a boil. Take off heat and add peanut butter vanilla and oats. Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.

title: Green Apple Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and eggs. Beat. Mix all dry ingredients. Add to eggs and sugar mixture alternately with oil and coffee. Beat well. Add raisins apples and nuts. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool. Add Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Southern Peanut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar syrup butter salt and vanilla. Continue to beat until thoroughly blended. Stir in peanuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serve warm or cold. May be topped with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Jean'S Nine-Layer Casserole
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or pan. Line with bread slices. Sprinkle chicken over bread. In saucepan saute the mushrooms in 2 tablespoons of butter. Using a slotted spoon spoon mushrooms over chicken in baking dish. Combine water chestnuts and mayonnaise; spoon over mushrooms. Top with cheeses. Combine eggs and milk; pour over cheese layer. Cover and then chill for at least 3 hours or let stand overnight. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours. Combine melted butter and crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole and then bake 10 more minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Mix sugar milk and soda thoroughly and cook over medium heat until small amount tested in cold water forms small ball. Add butter and return to heat until butter has melted. Remove from heat; add vanilla and beat until mixture begins to thicken. Add pecans; mix thoroughly and drop in thin patties onto waxed paper or foil. Yields 20 to 24 pralines.

title: Corny Cornbread
instructions: Blend eggs margarine sour cream and corn. Add salt and muffin mix. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. This is best when served hot.

title: Chili
instructions: Simmer onion and drippings. Add beef and simmer until brown. Mix all other ingredients. Add beans last so they will not be mushy. Add all ingredients to meat and bring to a boil. Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal. Stir until well coated. Using buttered spatula or waxed paper press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cut into squares when cool. Yield 24 squares 2 x 2-inches.

title: Waikiki Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat crumbs onion egg salt ginger and milk. Shape mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls into balls. Melt shortening in a large skillet. Brown and cook meatballs. Remove meatballs; keep warm. Pour fat from skillet.

title: Mock Coconut Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order given. Beat well. Chill dough 1 hour. Shape into small balls. Put on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned. Do not overbake. Let cool on cookie sheet before removing.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a large bowl cut broccoli into bite-size pieces. Crumble bacon into broccoli and add chopped onion. In a small bowl mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Stir well. Stir into broccoli gently until broccoli and bacon are well coated. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Pour into pie plate and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. No crust is needed.

title: Congealed Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into container and chill until firm.

title: Never Know It'S Low-Fat Cake
instructions: Prepare German chocolate cake mix as directed on package substituting Egg Beaters and applesauce for eggs and oil. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with low-fat cooking spray as directed. Pour condensed milk over hot cake (in pan). Let cool. Spread caramel topping. Sprinkle Grape-Nuts. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Delicious and guilt-free!

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Use meat mixture to fill and roll about 12 to 15 flour tortillas. Place rolled tortillas in cooking dish.

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mealy. Add water a tablespoon at a time and toss with a fork to blend. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. Roll out as thin as possible. Cut into 2 or 3-inch squares and fry in hot oil 370\u00b0 until puffed and browned. Makes 20 to 30 depending on size. Serve warm with cinnamon sugar or syrup if desired.

title: Cabbage Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot. Add cabbage onion pepper garlic powder sugar salt and pepper. Stir-fry until cabbage is just tender and light green about 3 minutes. Add water and cover; remove from heat. Let stand 3 to 5 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Stir in pecans. Combine remaining ingredients and add to flour mixture stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes and remove and leave on wire racks.

title: Dutch Rusk
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients then add flour to thicken slightly. Add the next 3 ingredients and mix. Add flour until right for punching. Lard sides of pan. Knead a few minutes more. Let rise 2 times. Make into large 3-inch buns. Let raise. Bake at 350\u00b0 and let cool. Slice each bun in 2 or 3 slices. Dry in low oven until crisp.

title: Microwave Sweet Potato Chips
instructions: On a rack arrange the sweet potato slices in a circle. Sprinkle with either salt cinnamon-sugar mix or chili powder. Cook in microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes until dry. Rotate rack halfway through cooking. Let stand 1 minute. Contains 40 calories; no fat.

title: Garden Salad
instructions: Drain all canned vegetables. Mix oil vinegar sugar and pepper. Pour over vegetables and mix well. Best if refrigerated overnight.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Boil together margarine or butter and milk. Cream together eggs and sugar with a pinch of salt. Beat well. Add flavoring. Add flour. Beat in warm milk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Vanilla Pudding
instructions: Mix together sugar flour salt and milk; cook over medium heat to a boil. Separate eggs; beat yolks. Mix with small amount of pudding mix. Then add to entire mixture. Put back on fire and cook for one minute. Remove from heat. Add 1 stick of oleo and vanilla.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Chop cabbage and green onions. Add almonds sesame seed and cooked chicken breasts. Combine Top Ramen flavor packets salt pepper sugar vinegar and oil. Pour over salad and add crushed Top Ramen noodles.

title: Date Roll
instructions: Melt margarine and marshmallows in pan over low heat. Chop dates and nuts. Add to margarine-marshmallow mixture. Spread about 1 cup graham cracker crumbs on wax paper. Shape mixture into long roll. Lay on graham crackers and roll up. Chill; slice thin.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature for about 1 hour. Using plastic gloves mix cream cheese ham or turkey (use as much as desired) green onions red pepper and Worcestershire sauce; mix well and form into a ball. Roll in pecans until covered and store in refrigerator. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Frosty Orange Nog Without Ice Cream
instructions: Place ingredients in blender and blend until smooth.

title: Yummy Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Heat milk and sugar to rolling boil in 2-quart saucepan stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Add chocolate and salt. Stir until chocolate melts then beat with rotary beater until smooth. Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla. Keeps well in jar in refrigerator (if the family doesnt find it).

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water and stir in strawberries until thawed. Add a little water. Add bananas. Pour half of this mixture in a pan. Chill until firm. Spread evenly with the sour cream. Pour remaining jello on top. Chill until firm and cut in squares. Top with dollops of sour cream. Serves 6.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well and shape into loaf; cook in covered pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Last 10 minutes remove foil and let meat brown.

title: Spaghetti Fruit Salad
instructions: In a saucepan combine sugar eggs lemon juice and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until temperature reaches 160\u00b0 until mixture is thickened. Cool completely. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in a large bowl. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Pour juice over the spaghetti. Stir in apples. Toss gently. Drain. Stir in the egg mixture. Add pineapple. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Fold in whipped topping just before serving. Garnish with walnuts and cherries.

title: Rita'S Banana Crush(Punch)
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water. Add juice and bananas (mashed or put in blender). Put in 7-Up thats been chilled.

title: Baked Apple And Carrot Casserole(Low-Fat!)
instructions: Place half of the sliced apples in a buttered casserole dish. Cover with half of the carrot slices. Combine dry ingredients; sprinkle half of the mix over carrots. Repeat the layers; pour orange juice over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Bake pie crust 7 minutes. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0. In medium bowl combine milk light brown sugar cognac light corn syrup pumpkin pie spice and salt. Add canned pumpkin and beaten eggs. Blend well. Slowly pour pumpkin mixture into prepared pie shell. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven until filling is barely set in the center about 40 minutes. Cool. Garnish with whipped cream if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cauliflower Chowder
instructions: Wash cauliflower and separate into flowerets; set aside. In a large saucepan melt butter. Saute onion until soft and transparent. Stir in garlic. Saute briefly being careful not to burn. Stir in rice and coat with butter. Add pepper to broth; bring to a boil. Lower heat to simmer. Leave uncovered and cook 20 minutes. Add cauliflower; cover. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes until cauliflower is just tender. Sprinkle with cheese and parsley. Serve hot from the pot. Serve in wide rimmed soup bowls. Add extra cheese if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Favorite Christmas Candy
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Shape into 2 logs; wrap in foil. Store in refrigerator. Cut into slices. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat whites until stiff. Add salt sugar and vanilla. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts. Spoon onto cookie sheet covered with brown paper. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 minute. Turn oven off. Leave in oven 1 hour or overnight. Do not open oven until finished.

title: No Sugar Apricot Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Put cream cheese and butter in a bowl and blend. Add sifted ingredients; blend and cover. Chill. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Divide dough into small portions. Roll on floured board about 1/8 inch thick and 3 inches square. Place a scant tablespoonful of preserves in center of dough and fold 2 opposite corners to center. Pinch and seal. Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake 20 minutes until edges are lightly browned.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Save 1/3 for topping. Put in 9 x 12-inch pan and cook for 5 minutes at 350\u00b0. Chill.

title: Sarah Circle Christmas Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Put 1/2 crumbs in casserole. Add shrimp mushrooms and 1/2 cheese. Top with remainder of bread and cheese. Beat eggs slightly. Add seasonings and milk; mix. Pour over the casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 servings. (May be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated.)

title: Hawaiian-Style Chicken
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper; dredge chicken pieces. Heat oil in large skillet; add chicken and brown well on both sides. Turn chicken skin side up and add water. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Place chicken on platter and keep warm. Add vegetables to skillet. Bring to a full boil over medium heat separating vegetables with fork. Stir until sauce cubes are blended. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in catsup and serve over chicken. Makes 3 servings.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; let stand 5 minutes. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients; make a well in center of mixture. Add yeast mixture oil and buttermilk; stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter; place on ungreased baking sheets. Cover; let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) free from drafts 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Yields 24 (100 calories per biscuit).

title: Cowboy Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes. Let cool. Peel and cube. In large skillet fry bacon. Remove bacon and allow to cool then crumble. Saute onions and peppers in bacon drippings. Add potatoes and stir heating thoroughly. Add bacon last. Serve while hot.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix and pour into a tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peanut Velvet Frosting
instructions: Heat butter over low heat until golden brown. Remove from heat. Beat in sugar milk vanilla and salt. Blend in Jif. Frosts one 9 x 13-inch cake.

title: Scandinavian Cucumbers
instructions: Stir together sour cream sugar parsley vinegar onion and dill. Fold in cucumbers; cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Coconut Bananas
instructions: Cut bananas into 1-inch pieces. Place lemon juice sour cream and coconut in separate bowls. Dip bananas in lemon juice. Roll in sour cream and then in coconut making sure all sides are coated. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Makes about 24 pieces.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll out; cut. Cook gently in boiling broth.

title: Quick Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix oleo and other ingredients with a fork or fingers. Roll into balls about 1-inch. Place on cookie sheet and press with fork crisscross. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Sauce
instructions: Cut onion celery and carrots finely. Fry in oil until lightly brown. Add small amount of grated cheese garlic and parsley. Add clean shrimp tomatoes tomato paste and 1/2 cup water. Cook until done. Use more water if needed. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve over spaghetti.

title: A Popular Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add sugar oil zucchini and vanilla to eggs and mix lightly but well. Combine flour salt soda baking powder and cinnamon then add to the egg/zucchini mixture. Stir all until well blended then add nuts and pour into two 9 x 5 x 3-inch greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove pans from oven and cool on a rack.

title: Posh Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain well; beat eggs and add all ingredients to eggs. Pour into buttered baking dish and dot with butter or top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: New Version Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in bottom of a 11 x 7-inch baking dish or pan. Sprinkle cinnamon and nutmeg over apples. Cover with slices of white loaf bread with crust removed. Mix sugar margarine and egg. Pour over bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Sift together flour salt and baking soda. Cut in shortening until mixture looks like meal. Add buttermilk mixing with a knife until dough cleans bowl of all flour. Chill.

title: Banana Fluff Cake
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and shortening together. Add vanilla bananas buttermilk and baking soda. Mix well. Add baking powder flour salt and nuts. Beat until fluffy. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Mix 1 package of banana instant pudding according to box directions. Spread over cake. Spread Cool Whip over this. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Salad
instructions: Cook rhubarb in water for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and add Jell-O sugar and juice. Chill slightly. Fold in apple and nuts.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole; stir together peanuts sugar syrup and salt. Cook 8 minutes on High in microwave oven stirring well after 4 minutes. Stir margarine and vanilla. Microwave 2 minutes longer. Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and foamy. Immediately pour into lightly greased baking sheet. Spread out.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar eggs vanilla milk margarine and marshmallow cream with electric mixer until smooth. Spoon into a greased 2-quart shallow dish. Combine brown sugar flour 1/3 cup margarine and pecans. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar well. Beat in eggs. Add flour vanilla and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Pudding
instructions: Slice all but 4 berries. Mix cream cheese milk and confectioners sugar until smooth. In 4 goblets layer half of sliced berries then half of cheese mixture. Repeat. Garnish with whole berries. Shave the chocolate bar. Top each goblet with 1 ounce shaved chocolate.

title: Oreo Cookie Delight
instructions: Layer in a 9 x13 inch pan. 1st layer put crushed cookies in dish and pour melted butter on top. 2nd layer mix cream cheese and powdered sugar; spread on top of cookies. 3rd layer sliced strawberries. 4th layer pineapple. 5th layer sliced bananas. Top with Cool whip.

title: Christmas Morning Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Scramble eggs and set aside. Fry bacon and set aside. Fry hash browns and set aside.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir peanuts sugar syrup and salt together in a deep bowl. Cook on High 4 minutes. Stir candy so all sugar is mixed and continue cooking on High for 3 more minutes. Add butter and vanilla to syrup blending well. Cook on High 1 to 2 minutes. Add soda and stir well until light and foamy. Pour immediately onto lightly buttered surface. Spread cool and break into pieces. Store in an airtight container. Can use roasted salted peanuts. Omit salt and add peanuts after the first 4 minutes of cooking.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple thoroughly; reserve syrup. Add enough water to make 1 cup syrup. Combine with sugar and cranberries and bring to full boil. Remove from heat. Drain cranberries and reserve syrup. Combine drained cranberries pineapple banana pears and lemon juice and chill. Melt butter and blend in cornstarch. Add cranberry syrup and stir over medium heat until it boils and thickens. Reduce heat and stir a little hot mixture into egg. Return to hot mixture stirring constantly. Cook over low heat 3 minutes. Cool to lukewarm. Fold fruit marshmallows and whipped cream into cool mixture. Freeze. Can be frozen in muffin tins and used as needed. Will thaw quickly for eating.

title: Barbecue Buns
instructions: In a large bowl thoroughly mix 2 cups flour dry milk solids sugar salt and yeast. Add oleo. Gradually add tap water to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer scraping bowl occasionally. Add 3/4 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in enough additional flour to make a stiff dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes). Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm place free from draft until doubled in bulk about 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Drain spinach (squeeze dry) and combine with other ingredients. Put bowl in freezer until hard enough to roll. Roll out into 1-inch balls and put on cookie sheet in freezer. After frozen they can be stored in bags. Cook at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes (until golden brown).

title: Sherry'S Soft And Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift together flour baking soda and salt and set aside. Combine butter or shortening sugar brown sugar vanilla and water. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Add flour mixture; mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by well rounded teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Tasty Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredient together and pour into a greased and floured jelly roll pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Spread peanut butter immediately from the oven; cool in refrigerator. Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler. Spread over cooled cake. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Raspberry Jelly Without The Raspberries
instructions: Wash the tomatoes and cut out blemishes. Cut tomatoes into quarters (leave skins on) and place in a blender (or equivalent); liquify. Place the tomato liquid in a saucepan; add sugar and boil 5 minutes. Add 1 package berry jello and mix well. Place in hot jars. Jars may be sealed with paraffin or rings. It is recommended that the finished product be either frozen or kept in the refrigerator. I use paraffin and rings and leave it at room temperature if the rings seal.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Meatballs
instructions: Cook meatballs as directed (see recipe). Mix brown sugar and cornstarch in skillet. Add meatballs; stir in pineapple (with syrup) vinegar and soy sauce. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat. Add meatballs. Cover; simmer stirring occasionally for 10 minutes. Stir in green pepper. Cover; simmer until crisp-tender 5 minutes.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins and water for 2 minutes. Cool and add soda to raisin mixture. Add remaining ingredients to raisin mixture. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Smothered Hamburger
instructions: One egg and 1/2 cup bread crumbs can be added to stretch hamburger.

title: Cocoa Fudge
instructions: Combine cocoa sugar and salt in large saucepan. Add milk gradually. Mix thoroughly; bring to bubbly boil on high heat. Stir continuously. Reduce to medium heat; continue boiling without stirring until mixture reaches 232\u00b0 or until a small amount of mixture forms a soft ball stage when dropped into cold water. Be sure bulb of thermometer is not resting on bottom of saucepan. Remove saucepan from heat. Add margarine and vanilla to mixture. Do not stir. Allow fudge to cool at room temperature until it reaches 110\u00b0. Add peanut butter. Nuts are optional. Beat by hand or with electric mixer until fudge thickens and it loses some of its gloss. Quickly pour and spread fudge in lightly buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch glass dish. Cut into squares. Makes about 3 dozen squares.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix sugar mustard salt and vinegar. Add oil slowly; beat constantly until thick (or use blender). Add poppy seed and beat a few minutes longer. Delicious over fruit.

title: Seasoned Buttery Vegetables And Noodles
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain. Meanwhile in large saucepan melt butter. Add broccoli green pepper and mushrooms. Cook just until tender. Add hot pasta and remaining ingredients heat thoroughly stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese if desired. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli And Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain. Chop into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Melt 1 1/2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan. Add flour and salt; cook 1 minute. Add milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Place broccoli in a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole. Combine remaining ingredients except the bread crumbs. Pour over broccoli. Pour white sauce over all. Combine 2 tablespoons melted butter with bread crumbs. Put crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Green beans or asparagus may be substituted for broccoli.

title: Alsatian Pork With Sauerkraut
instructions: Cook bacon and onion in a skillet until bacon is crisp stir constantly. Stir in sauerkraut and brown sugar add potatoes and apples. In a cheese cloth bag tie peppercorns juniper berries cloves parsley and bay leaves; add to sauerkraut. Add pork chops and smoked kielbasa pieces pour chicken broth in stir well. Heat to boiling then reduce heat cover and simmer until meat is done potatoes are tender for about 45 minutes. When done remove spice bag. With a slotted spoon remove sauerkraut potatoes and apples to a large platter. Arrange meat and kielbasa in the center of the platter. Serve with fresh sourdough bread.

title: Methodist Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion;\tdrain good. Mix ground beef onion sugar and pork and beans.\tPut in a long Pyrex dish. Put bacon on top of beans and top with ketchup. Cook until bacon is cooked. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0.

title: Stir-Fry Lemon-Honey Pork
instructions: Cut pork into thin strips. Dredge in the flour. Cook quickly but thoroughly in the hot oil. Remove meat from skillet. Add remaining ingredients to drippings and cook 2 minutes until crisp but tender. Stir pork strips in and serve.

title: Salad
instructions: Cut ingredients and marinate overnight in Kraft Italian dressing.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Put ground beef rice and peppers in green peppers in 2 inches of water and cook covered for 1 hour.

title: Spoon Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine corn meal shortening and 2 cups of milk in a pan over medium heat. Bring mixture just to a boil stirring constantly. Blend beaten eggs salt and remaining milk. Add to corn meal mixture. Mix well. Stir in baking powder. Pour into greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot with butter.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Spread chips in casserole dish. Place boned chicken on top of chips. Saute onion and pepper in butter until tender. Add all other ingredients except for the cheese. Mix well. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Top with cheese the last few minutes.

title: Murlean'S Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill.

title: Summer Cake
instructions: Bake cake as per directed in a large oblong pan. While hot cover with crushed pineapple.

title: Beef Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground meat with chopped onions chili powder ground comino and salt. Drain. On the side pour about 1/2 can Wolfes chili into a bowl or Pyrex pie dish; add small amount of water (make it a little runny); stir and warm in a microwave. Dip flour or corn tortillas into warm chili; add a couple of spoons of meat onions and cheese then roll it up and place into an oblong pan. When all are rolled up pour any remaining chili on top; add cheese and onions. Cook at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Fruit Rolls
instructions: Crush wafers to fine crumbs. Add to nuts and chopped cherries. Mix well in milk. Pour coconut on waxed paper. Form rolls by rolling and shaping on coconut. Wrap in foil. Refrigerate.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Layer the sausage and cheese in order in the pie shell. Beat the eggs and milk together. Add to the pie shell. Sprinkle with sharp cheese. Bake for 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Cut into chunks. Add all ingredients; mix well. Chill at least 2 hours.

title: Easy Spareribs
instructions: Place all ingredients in a heavy pan and cook 45 minutes (high heat). Stir every 10 minutes until all sauce is gone. Turn to low heat; fat becomes oil.

title: Zucchini, Carrot And Tomato Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine carrots zucchini and tomatoes in rectangular dish. In saucepan stir cornstarch milk 1/2 cup cheese and butter until smooth and thick. Pour sauce over vegetables. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Beef Casserole(Chinese Style)
instructions: Cook beef until brown and crumbly. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Arrange thawed peas over meat then cover with celery. Mix together soup cream seasonings and onion. Pour over celery. Sprinkle with chips or flakes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon together; set aside. Cream the sugar shortening molasses and eggs together. Add flour mixture; mix well. Stir in oats nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Easy Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine apples and sugar in mixing bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Blend oil vanilla and egg with the apples then combine the dry ingredients and mix in well. Stir in the raisins. Pour into greased 8-inch square cake pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Yields 9 servings.

title: Wassail
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place cloves and cinnamon in small cloth and tie. Drop in cloth bag of spices; heat to boiling and boil 10 minutes. Simmer 20 minutes. Heat before serving.

title: Party Mix
instructions: In a small saucepan melt margarine; stir in Worcestershire sauce and seasoned nuts cereals and pretzels. Pour margarine sauce over mixture. Mix lightly about every 20 minutes. Spread out on absorbent paper or heavy brown paper to cool. Keep crisp by storing in airtight container.

title: Scorcher
instructions: In a large kettle fry meat in oil until dark brown. Then add 1-quart of water. Cover and simmer two hours. Add remaining ingredients except flour and cornmeal. Cook at gentle simmer for 30 minutes removing bay leaves after 15 minutes. Make a paste of flour cornmeal and water. Stir into mixture cooking another five minutes at simmer while stirring often. Serve immediately with a fire extinguisher at your right elbow.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar eggs apples nuts and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and add to oil mixture. Put in greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Chunk squash. Par-boil drain and mash. Leave skin on. Put in baking dish. Beat egg yolks lightly. Add all ingredients except egg whites. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into vegetable mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Makes 8 servings.

title: Coke Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple juice and cherry juice together. Mix Jell-O with juice. Cool thoroughly (this is very important). Add Cokes pineapple nuts and cherries. Pour in molds or Pyrex pan and chill until firm.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Mix in order given and our into unbaked pie crust. Bake in moderate oven 25 minutes. You may use an orange instead of lemon; its very good.

title: Chi Chi'S Mild Salsa
instructions: Cut up stewed tomatoes and combine in saucepan with onions fresh tomato salt and pepper. Bring just to a boil. Boil hard 1 minute and remove at once from heat.
