Put half of mixture through blender just to mince fine but not to puree. Return to remaining half of mixture. Cool and refrigerate in tightly covered container to use within a few weeks. Freezes well to use within 6 months.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and curry powder. Drain fruit well. Arrange in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add butter mixture. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Stuffed Clams
instructions: Mix together bread crumbs celery green pepper and onion. Add lemon juice and clam juice and mix well. Season with garlic salt oregano and pepper and mix. Add this mixture to the chopped clams. Spoon into cleaned clam shells and top with bacon pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bacon is crisp. Serve with lemon wedges. Serves 8.

title: Mary'S Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook grits. Add cheese butter and garlic. Stir until blended. Beat 3 eggs in measuring cup. Add half and half to eggs to measure 1 3/4 cups total. Add to grits. Put in casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Herbed Chicken Bake
instructions: Prepare rice mix using package directions. Season chicken with salt and pepper in skillet. Brown slowly in butter. Spoon rice into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with chicken skin side up. Add soup to skillet. Slowly add Sauterne stirring until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Muffins
instructions: Combine eggs oil vanilla and zucchini. Add and stir until moistened sugar flour cinnamon soda salt baking powder and chopped nuts. Grease muffin tins. Fill 2/3 full. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 18 minutes.

title: Homemade Custard
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook over medium heat until it comes to a full boil. Pour into a 9x13 pan lined with vanilla wafers or crackers.

title: Chinese Icicles(Cookies)
instructions: Using high speed of the electric mixer cream butter sugar and vanilla until soft and creamy. Sift together salt and flour; add gradually to butter mixture. Blend well on low speed. Add noodles stirring in by hand. Chill until firm. Pinch off small pieces of dough and shape into fingers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool; dust with powdered sugar. Yield 5 to 6 dozen icicles.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 1/4 cup fat from bacon. Cook onion in the fat until tender. Blend flour sugar salt and celery seed; add vinegar and 1 cup water and cook until thickened. Add bacon potatoes and eggs.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Empty can of pineapple with juice in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Spread pie filling over pineapple. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pie filling. Sprinkle chopped nuts over cake mix. Generously dot with margarine. Never stir mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until top is brown.

title: Zucchini Parmesan(Can Substitute Eggplant For Zucchini)
instructions: On wax paper combine bread crumbs with oregano. Cut zucchini lengthwise. Brush with mayo; coat with crumb mixture. In 2 1/2-quart casserole dish arrange zucchini crumb side up. Cook covered with wax paper on High for 12 to 15 minutes until tender rotating halfway through cooking time. In small bowl cook spaghetti sauce on High for 1 to 3 minutes until hot. Meanwhile sprinkle 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese over zucchini. Spoon sauce over cheese; top with remaining Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cook on High for 2 to 4 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Green Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream Cheese Mix above ingredients until smooth. Fold gently into whipped cream.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix 1 stick of margarine (melted) with the first 5 ingredients. Mix half of dressing with rest of ingredients. Leave half of dressing to top the mixture. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole
instructions: Season meat with salt brown in hot fat. Arrange alternate layers onions potatoes and meat in a 2-quart casserole. Pour soup over layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over casserole about 10 minutes before its done if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Two-In-One Bake
instructions: Cook cauliflower in 1-inch boiling salt water until tender-crisp; drain. Separate into flowerets. Start heating oven to 350\u00b0. Combine soup and milk in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Add cauliflowerets ham savory and 1/2 cup cheese. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Fresh Key Lime Pie
instructions: Pie Shell Mix cracker crumbs butter and sugar in bowl. Press into pie pan to form crust. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0; cool.

title: 3 Bean Salad
instructions: Fry together bacon and hamburger; drain. Add 3 cans of beans and juice. Mix with onion catsup brown sugar prepared mustard and vinegar. Mix together in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sensational Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips. In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon margarine cook 1/2 of beef and 1/2 of onion until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender. Set aside and repeat with remaining margarine beef and onion. Return meat mixture to skillet. Stir in soup and paprika. Heat through stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to very low. Stir in sour cream. Gently heat through. Serve on hot noodles.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Boil together the brown sugar and hot water for 10 minutes. Cool and add the butter flour milk salt and eggs. Cook all together in a double boiler until thick and smooth stirring constantly. Cool and add 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and 1/2 cup pecan meats chopped. Put 2 tablespoons of mixture in prepared (baked) tart shells. Garnish with 1/2 cup whipped cream sweetened with 1 tablespoon of powdered sugar and put a whole pecan on top. Fills about 1 dozen shells. Delicious!

title: Sara'S Brownies
instructions: Mix all together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Pizza Style
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix with egg and milk. Spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with spaghetti sauce grated cheese and pepperoni or other toppings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Combine soup milk water and cheese and heat to boiling stirring. Combine first 8 ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with bread crumbs Parmesan and parsley. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Microwave until butter melts; take out and stir fast! Put into pan. Let cool then cut.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Mix in order listed. Fill section of a greased muffin pan half full. Bake at 450\u00b0. Dough will keep in refrigerator for 5 days.

title: Tex-Mex Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken broth soups chili powder Ro-Tel onions and bell pepper. Place half of the chicken in casserole dish. Pour half of the soup mixture on top. Crumble half of the Doritos on top. Layer again in this order. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream and black olives. Makes 1 large or 2 small casseroles.

title: Cottage Cheese And Sausage Biscuits
instructions: Grease muffin pan and press biscuit half in pan cups up the side as far as you can. Divide sausage and place on dough. Mix cheese cottage cheese eggs and pepper; pour over sausage and dough. Bake 375\u00b0 15 to 20 minutes. Wipe muffin pan grease and make the rest of the muffins.

title: Cantaloupe Rings
instructions: Cut about 1 1/2 inches from tops of melons. Scoop out seeds. Wipe cavity with paper towels. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Add water to syrup to measure 1 1/4 cups. Heat syrup-water mixture to boiling. Pour over gelatin. Stir to dissolve. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in milk and pineapple. Chill to consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Spoon into cantaloupe cavities. (Depending on cavity size there may be enough gelatin mixture to fill a third cantaloupe.) Chill in upright position at least 3 hours or until firm. Slice into 1-inch rings to serve. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix the last 4 ingredients (except for 1/3 of the whipped topping). Layer wafers bananas and mixture. Top with remaining whipped topping. Keep refrigerated.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening with brown sugar cream. Add egg. Sift together soda salt flour milk rolled oats. Finally add raisins nuts vanilla. Bake at 375 till golden brown.

title: Corn And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook all ingredients together. On the farm we used fresh corn and tomatoes. This was one of Claudes favorites.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Slice onion about 1/8-inch thick then chop slices finely. In a pan add about 2 tablespoons of butter and the onions. Saute until transparent. Add the chicken broth. Dice the potatoes and add to the broth. (The potatoes should double the volume of liquid in the pan.) Cook until potatoes are tender. While still on the heat mash the potatoes. Cook a little longer and mash again. At this point you can add the sour cream and serve.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package instructions. Mix jello with 2 cups boiling water. Add frozen strawberries to jello and break up. Add 1/4 cup cold water and stir. Jello has to be jelled until a little thick.

title: Popover Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Stir in taco seasoning mix tomato sauce and water; mix well. Simmer for 10 minutes stirring frequently.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with salt pepper and onion. Drain. Add taco mix and 2 cups water. Cook on medium heat until mixture is hot. Let simmer on very low heat stirring occasionally until mixture is thick. Add drained corn and olives (if desired); heat. Grate each kind of cheese separately. Spray baking dish with vegetable spray. Fill each separated shell with small amount of pepper cheese and meat. Roll shells and lay in dish (side by side) and pour rest of meat sauce over rolled shells. Cover the tops of shells with grated cheese (Cracker Barrel). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Add sugar and water mixture. Freeze in quart containers. To serve add 1 quart of punch mix to 1 (2 liter) bottle of 7-Up. Do not use ginger ale.

title: Oriental Eggplant
instructions: *This will not work with the round American type eggplants.

title: New Potato Dish
instructions: Boil new potatoes until partly cooked. Remove from pan and cut potatoes into halves. Pour melted butter over potatoes in a baking dish and sprinkle with dry Italian dressing. Finish baking until done. Do not cover.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Step 1 Remove 1 cup cake mix and cut in 1/2 stick margarine with 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Set aside.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Blend peppers and vinegar. Add with sugar and boil over medium heat for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add pectin. Boil for 1 minute. Add food coloring; strain out pepper pieces if desired. Can in 4 pint canning jars. Serve over cream cheese with crackers.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Split Twinkies long wise and lay in cake pan filling up. Mix vanilla pudding and milk together and set aside. Mix cream cheese sour cream and Cool Whip. Add to pudding and spread over Twinkies. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Mill Road Acres Beer Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Best when just baked.

title: Pizza Sandwich
instructions: In a frypan with a small amount of melted margarine grill 2 slices of sandwich bread on one side only of each slice. Then remove one slice from pan and set aside.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and mix for 10 seconds at high speed. Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef Nachos
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef; drain. Put into mixing bowl. Add salsa chili powder Miracle Whip and corn. Layer 1/2 meat in dish. Add 1/2 chips and cheese on top. Layer rest of ingredients.

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Measure and sift dry ingredients. Beat until light and fluffy the sugar shortening eggs milk and vanilla. Blend in the dry ingredients. Add nuts dates and cherries. Blend well and chill. Shape into small balls. Roll in crushed corn flakes. Place on greased baking sheet. Press 1/4 maraschino cherry in each. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 10 minutes.

title: Pork Sausage Spread
instructions: Brown and drain the sausage. Add remaining ingredients. Spread on party rye bread. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 2 well-greased and floured cake pans. Frost with 7-Up frosting.

title: Daffodil Dip
instructions: Cut the white of the egg up into the cream cheese and salad dressing. Keep the egg yolk separate and mix all the rest together. After thats done smash the egg yolk and sprinkle on top. If you want a big dish use 8 ounces cream cheese and 2 hard-boiled eggs.

title: Oil Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour wheat germ and salt. Pour water and oil in all at once. Stir with a fork. Roll dough between sheets of waxed paper. Bake 15 minutes at 450\u00b0 (prick with fork before baking).

title: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford Cake
instructions: Mix together flour nuts and butter and put in 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broken Glass Cake
instructions: Dissolve each (cherry orange and lime) package jello in 1 1/2 cups hot water and place in long dishes. When jelled cut into small squares. Dissolve 1 package plain gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Add to 1 cup hot pineapple juice. Chill to a syrup. Whip 1 pint whipped cream; add 1/2 cup sugar. Mix well the whipped cream juice mixture and jello squares. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan lined with crust.

title: Sour-Creamed Potatoes
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot.

title: My Best Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all together and let stand overnight before baking. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 1/2 hours. Makes\t5 pounds. This was copied from an original recipe sheet of Mother Reeves.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease baking dish. Place beef in baking dish. Toss with gravy and flour. Set aside. Spray 12-inch skillet and cook mushrooms celery onion and garlic about 6 minutes or until tender but crisp. Transfer to baking dish along with carrots wine beef broth thyme marjoram salt and pepper. Bake covered about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Uncover to stir occasionally until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked through. Replace cover after each stirring. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tuna Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Fill buns; wrap in tinfoil. Heat in preheated oven for 15 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Let cream cheese set out until its room temperature. Mix crabmeat and cream cheese; shape into a ball. Pour cocktail sauce over it and refrigerate until youre ready to serve. Serve with crackers.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet add 1/2 cup Crisco to get it to the melting stage. Add 1 or 2 bags of corn with your 2 teaspoons salt and pepper frying to let the whole kernel corn get golden brown.

title: Creamy Raspberry Ring
instructions: Combine gelatin and water and cook over medium heat until dissolved. Beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. Add milk and softened gelatin; beat until mixed. Refrigerate until slightly thickened about 15 minutes. Stir in cream cheese mixture until smooth; fold in whipped cream. Pour into ungreased mold.

title: German Schnitzel
instructions: First flatten meat to tenderize and make larger. (This can be done by pounding meat with the flat side of meat cleaver or plate edge.) Season with salt pepper and garlic powder and spread with mustard. Dip meat in egg on both sides and then dip in bread crumbs. Melt margarine in skillet at medium-high heat. When margarine is hot add meat and fry until brown on both sides. If egg is left over scramble and place on top of meat.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon in casserole. Top with bacon slices and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crumbs cocoa sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour Eagle Brand evenly over crust. Top evenly with remaining ingredients in order listed. Press down firmly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool; chill thoroughly if desired. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Cheddar Cheese Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Combine egg milk and water and stir into dry ingredients until they are moistened. Spoon batter into a greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Buttermilk Jello
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in saucepan and heat until jello is dissolved. Set off and cool. Beat in Cool Whip and pour in dish.

title: Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine milk rice pudding mix raisins and egg in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Serve warm. Makes 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Grate American cheese and set aside. Chop onion and saute in butter. Cook frozen broccoli in water. Combine onion and broccoli using all liquid. Add bouillon cube and stir until dissolved. Add garlic powder dash of pepper half and half and grated American cheese. Heat until cheese is melted stirring constantly.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken Chimichangas
instructions: Grind or chop \chicken\; add cheese and green chilies set aside. Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave at High 15 seconds or until hot. Brush both sides of tortillas one at a time with vegetable oil (keep remaining tortillas warm). Place a scant 1/2 cup of \chicken\ mixture just below center of each tortilla. Fold in left and right sides of tortilla to partially enclose filling. Fold up bottom edge of tortilla; fold into a rectangle and secure with a wooden pick. Repeat with remaining tortillas and \chicken\ mixture. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned. Serve with shredded lettuce salsa and sour cream. Yields 4 servings.

title: Spinach Bites And Lemon Mayonnaise
instructions: Lightly grease baking sheets. In a small bowl mix spinach stuffing mix cheese eggs margarine onion and nutmeg. Shape into walnut size balls. Place on baking sheets. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or until ready to bake.

title: Spinach Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Add olive oil to moisten to taste. Use as filling for spinach turnovers (in roll mix dough) or excellent as pizza topping dip for raw vegetables to spread on French bread or crackers to stuff boneless chicken breasts or to toss with hot pasta.

title: Blackfoot Potato Soup With Sausage
instructions: Slice sausage into 1/4-inch thick; brown over medium heat in Dutch oven or heavy kettle. Remove sausage with slotted spoon and reserve. Drain away excess fat. Add celery onion thyme and salt. Cook until onion is tender. Stir in flour. Cook 1 minute.

title: Kool-Aid Modeling Dough
instructions: Mix flour salt cream of tartar Kool-Aid and water in medium saucepan. Stir in oil. Adult should stir the mixture over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes until mixture forms a ball in the center of the pan. Remove to a floured surface and knead for 1 minute. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

title: Corn Dogs(Makes 8)
instructions: Mix corn meal flour milk egg and oil. Beat with fork. Roll hot dogs in flour then roll in batter. Deep fry in oil until brown.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix together and bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes only.

title: Snow Flakes
instructions: Melt chips in microwave 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until melted. Pour into dry ingredients; mix together. Pour onto wax paper and let cool. Chocolate chips may be used also.

title: Wintertime Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into buttered casserole dish; sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad (Or Dessert)
instructions: Mix ingredients and pat into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish (bottom only). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes; cool. Whip together 8 ounces cream cheese and 3/4 cup sugar. Fold cheese and sugar into 8 ounces Cool Whip. Spread over pretzel crust. Top with fruit (peaches strawberries bananas nectarines cantaloupe works well placed close together). Cover fruit with a partially set 6 ounces of Jell-O. Refrigerate. Serves 12.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In 3-quart oblong baking dish mix soup milk thyme and pepper. Stir in vegetables. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble. Meanwhile cut each biscuit into quarters. Remove dish from oven. Stir. Arrange biscuits over hot chicken. Bake 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack Mix
instructions: Mix and blend first 4 ingredients and blend well. Pour over the two packages of oyster crackers. Mix well and place in air-tight container for storage.

title: Three Fruit Jam
instructions: Combine fruit and lemon juice in 4-quart saucepan. Cook stirring until it is almost tender. Stir in sugar powdered pectin butter and food coloring. Bring to a rolling boil stirring constantly. Boil for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from heat and skim off foam. Ladle into sterilized jars leaving 1/2-inch space at top. Seal with paraffin. Makes 8 (6 ounce) glasses.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs. Sift flour; measure and sift with salt baking powder and soda. Add to first mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 5 x 10 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Bacon Cheddar Grilled Sourdough Bread
instructions: Heat grill. Cut loaf into 1-inch slices. Lightly spread one side of each slice of bread with margarine. Place margarine side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Sprinkle cheese bacon and parsley evenly on bread slices. When ready to barbecue place slices margarine side down directly on gas grill over medium-high heat or on charcoal grill 4 to 6-inches from coals. Cook 4 to 6 minutes or until bottom of bread is toasted and cheese is melted. Makes 8 servings.

title: Party Cucumber Spread
instructions: Press shredded cucumber between paper towels to remove excess moisture. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Stir in cucumber and other ingredients. Spread between party rye or wheat bread or as a spread for open-faced sandwiches.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates soda salt and butter. Cool. Add eggs to sugar and then add other ingredients. Combine the 2 mixtures. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured loaf pan for 1 hour or until done.

title: Chocolate Town Special Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla beating well. Sift together salt flour soda and cocoa. Add to creamed mixture with buttermilk. Mix well. Add boiling water; mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Peach Alexander
instructions: Mix in blender and serve. This will make 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chess Pie Bars
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and mix well. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine the last ingredients and beat well. Pour over crust in pan. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool then cut into squares. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Fried Pie Crust
instructions: Mix well with pastry cutter; divide into balls large enough for 4-inch fried pie.

title: Veggie Surprise
instructions: Put eggs milk corn bread mix and onion soup (one package) into blender container. Mix until blended.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix above ingredients. Eat with your favorite fruit!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions then drain well. In saucepan melt margarine. Add a few onion flakes flour and water. Blend and let boil a bit. Add Cheez Whiz broccoli and eggs. Mix gently. Turn into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Dot with cracker crumbs and/or crumbled croutons and 2 tablespoons margarine. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine vegetables chicken and seasoning; mix well. Stir in mayo to moisten. Spread mixture in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Smashed Potatoes
instructions: first smash the potatoes. Mix the potatoes and the flower and the water. cook it for 40 menets. Put the potatoes on a plat and then put butter on it.

title: Almond Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate; set aside. Cream margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs and blend in chocolate vanilla and flour. Add 1/2 almonds and spread in 8-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining almonds and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch
instructions: *Ive used cornflakes Chex and Kix.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Do not drain pineapple. Stir into pudding mix. Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows. You may add more pecans if desired.

title: Chocolate Milk Shake
instructions: Place the chocolate sauce milk and ice cream in a blender. Blend until it turns a chocolate milk color. Pour in a cup. Top with whipped cream and sprinkles. Place the piece of chocolate on top of the whipped cream.

title: Baked Plum Tomatoes With Linguini
instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch glass Pyrex dish pour a layer of olive oil. Cut up about 10 plum ripe tomatoes in halves. Sprinkle on top lots of fresh garlic salt and pepper basil or spice and oregano (optional). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until the tomatoes get a little soft or to the consistency you like (approximately 35 minutes). It doesnt look like tomato sauce. Cook up linguini and add to the Pyrex dish that the tomatoes are in. Toss and serve.

title: Chicken In Sour Cream
instructions: Put chicken in a baking dish. Mix other three ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Pressure Cooker Swiss Steak
instructions: Have butcher run meat through tenderizer. Cut steak in eight pieces. Coat with flour. Brown in cooker (uncovered) with small amount of hot oil. When completely brown on both sides add a little salt and pepper. Add 1 1/4 cups water for 4-quart cooker (1 1/2 cups for 6 to 8-quart cooker). Set pressure control for 10 pounds (both sizes). After control starts to jiggle cook for 35 minutes. Adjust heat for control to jiggle 1 to 3 times a minute. Cool cooker normally 5 minutes and then place under cold running water to reduce pressure. Recipe makes its own gravy. Serve with mashed potatoes and vegetables.

title: Meatless Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon. Pour half of batter into a greased 9 x 13 inch glass dish. Crumble bacon and cheese on top of first layer. Cover with remaining half of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix with hands until crumbly. Form into small balls. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Can be frozen before ready to bake. Serves 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel and cut apples; arrange in an oblong baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients in bowl; sprinkle over apples. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Cool before serving. Serves 12.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix well and keep in refrigerator. Will keep up to a week.

title: Mushroom Veal
instructions: Arrange veal in 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Top with sliced mushrooms. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at 50% (Medium) 7 to 10 minutes or until veal is tender and no longer pink; rearrange once leaving mushrooms on top. Set aside. In small bowl blend remaining ingredients. Increase power to High. Microwave 2 to 4 minutes or until thickened stirring with wire whip once or twice. Pour sauce over veal; cover with wax paper. Reduce power to 50% (Medium). Microwave 2 to 4 minutes or until heated through.

title: Earthquake Dessert
instructions: Cover a 9 x 13 x 3-inch cake pan with coconut. Next sprinkle on nuts. Prepare cake mix according to box directions; spread over nuts and coconut but dont mix together. Blend until smooth the cream cheese oleo and powdered sugar. Carefully spread over cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Will rise and fall and have craters like an earthquake!

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Rinse the kidney beans and drain. Put in large bowl and pour dressing over all. Mix ingredients (last five) for dressing until sugar dissolves. Pour over beans mixture and let stand overnight in refrigerator stirring 3 or 4 times. Drain and serve.

title: Mickey Mouse Rice Pilaf
instructions: Melt margarine in a large skillet and saute garlic onion celery and mushrooms until tender not browned. Add rice and stir until each grain is coated. Add chicken broth bay leaf salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Transfer to buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until rice is tender and all liquid absorbed. Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place pineapple rings on top. Pour a little juice over top. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Blend soup into 1 package broccoli (do this 3 times). Mill all together; add lemon pepper. Refrigerate. To serve heat mixture with half and half until hot.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex with crushed saltine crackers. Place a layer of onions over crackers. Sprinkle with a layer of grated cheese. Repeat until onions and cheese are used.

title: Southwestern Salad
instructions: Wash and drain lettuce. Break into small pieces in a large salad bowl. Add tomatoes which have been cut into small pieces. Add Ranch Style beans. Just before serving add corn chips and Catalina dressing. Toss well and serve. For small servings this recipe can be halved.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: *Add 1 tablespoon vinegar to milk and let stand 1 minute.

title: San Antonio Skillet Supper
instructions: Cook sausage in half lengthwise. Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. In a 10-inch skillet combine rice sausage and remaining ingredients except optional toppings. Mix well breaking up tomatoes with large spoon. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat; let stand covered 5 minutes. Top as desired and serve with additional salsa or picante sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Bushel Of Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix well sugars oil and margarine. Add eggs vanilla salt and soda; mix well. Add flour; mix well. Add oatmeal or cereal and chocolate chips. Blend well. Bake at 350\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes until light brown.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix first 5 ingredients. Set aside. Mix buttermilk egg and vanilla together. Add to dry mix and mix well. Add nuts and broken Heath bars. Stir just enough to mix. Pour into 8 x 10-inch or 2 bread loaf pans (greased well or wax paper lined makes easier clean up). If greased also flour well. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Turn out while warm (after cooling about 1/2 hour).

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients well and put in baked cool pie shell or vanilla wafer crust. When ready to serve top with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

title: No-Fuss Bar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Set aside. Combine crumbs chips coconut and walnuts in medium bowl. Stir to blend. Add milk. Stir with spoon until blended. Spread batter evenly into prepared pan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Let pan stand on a wire rack until completely cooled. Cut into 2 1/4 x 2 1/4-inch bars. Store tightly covered at room temperature or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Amanda'S Punch
instructions: Chill all juices first. In punch bowl with ice ring add already mixed cranberry pineapple and sugar. To this add ginger ale and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Mix chicken soup mayonnaise and curry powder. Pour over broccoli in casserole dish. Mix cheese and bread crumbs; put over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot through and brown.

title: Homemade Ice Cream(1 Hour And 30 Minutes)
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan combine milk and whipping cream. Cook over low heat until warm (6 to 8 minutes). In large mixer bowl combine all remaining ingredients. Beat at medium speed scraping bowl often until smooth (2 to 3 minutes). Gradually stir into milk mixture. Cool to room temperature. Pour into ice cream canister. Freeze in ice cream maker according to manufacturers directions. Yield 3 quarts.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese pineapple bell pepper onion and seasoning salt (by hand) until well blended. Add 1 cup pecans and mix well. Shape into ball. Roll in 1/2 cup pecans and refrigerate.

title: Boursin Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until fluffy. Refrigerate at least 24 hours for flavors to blend. Soften at room temperature for 1 hour before serving.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage and drain well. Mix spaghetti sauce with meat. In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer with noodles sauce cheese and pepperoni. Repeat with remaining ingredients ending with cheese and pepperoni. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes until cheese is bubbly.

title: Dreamy Salad
instructions: Heat milk and marshmallows in a double boiler until marshmallows are melted. Add lemon jello; stir until dissolved. Mix crushed pineapple with cream cheese with mixer. Add to jello mix. Add nuts. Cool. Fold in Cool Whip. Form in flat shallow dish and let set in refrigerator. Make red jello using drained pineapple juice for part of liquid. When beginning to set pour over cold bottom layer.

title: Super Easy, Super Quick Supper
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon cooking oil (any variety) in large frying pan. Add onion and cook until clear. Add chicken and cook until thawed. Add broccoli and mushrooms and cook about 5 minutes until heated through. Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts. Mix stir-fry seasoning according to package directions and pour over stir-fry. Add soy sauce to taste. Be careful not to cook too long bean sprouts will become soggy. Serve immediately over hot cooked rice.

title: Orange Gelatin Salad
instructions: Mix together gelatin and hot water. Add orange juice concentrate; cool. Add orange slices and crushed pineapple. Let congeal.

title: Fiesta Chicken Bake
instructions: Place chips on the bottom of a glass casserole dish. Scatter the chicken pieces on top of chips. Mix soups and chiles together and pour over all. Top with tomatoes; sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Garnish with sour cream and guacamole before serving.

title: Pound Cake (5 Flavor)
instructions: Cream the Crisco and margarine adding gradually the sugar. Add eggs one at a time; beat well 1 1/2 minutes after each egg. Sift baking powder with flour; add alternately with milk and flavorings. Mix well. Bake in a large tube pan. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage into wedges. Cook in salted water until tender; drain. Mix soup and milk together and set aside. Grease casserole dish. Layer alternately the cabbage soup and cheese. Top with bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Candy Delight
instructions: Combine whipped topping and pineapple in 2-quart bowl. Mix apples candy bars and peanuts into whipped topping mixture. Spread mixture into serving dish and grate chocolate onto mixture. Yields approximately 7 cups.

title: Continental Veal
instructions: Measure soy sauce into large skillet and brown veal in oil with onions and garlic about 15 minutes. Add 1 cup water stock or tomato juice and the sugar pepper and rosemary or marjoram. Add salt. Cover and cook until veal is tender. Approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes before cooked add carrots green peppers and mushrooms. Just before serving stir in lemon rind. Add extra water stock or tomato juice as necessary during cooking. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mini-Reuben Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Layer bread slices on cookie sheet. Put a teaspoon of dressing then a piece of corned beef sauerkraut and top with a small piece of Swiss cheese. Put under broiler for 3 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Cheese Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients stirring well; spoon into a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes. Yield 12 to 15 servings.

title: Harvest Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix lightly with a fork. Shape into a loaf and bake in a greased 8-inch square pan for one hour.

title: Lemon Cake Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add lemon juice and beaten egg yolks; mix. Stir in flour and milk. Fold in egg whites that have been beaten stiff. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for first 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake until set as custard about 45 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all together. Roll into acorn-size balls. Roll in sugar. Press with glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: In shallow dish blend water and egg. Set aside. In another shallow dish or on a sheet of wax paper mix bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and paprika. Dip each chicken piece in egg then in bread crumb mixture to coat.

title: Red Hot Salad
instructions: Add red hots to water and bring to boil. Red hots should be dissolved. Pour over jello. Add applesauce and nuts. Let set in refrigerator.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in two 8-inch round cake pans. Place one layer in the bottom of a punch bowl. Add pineapple. Layer with bananas (sliced) 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and 1 layer Cool Whip. Add the other layer of cake. Layer with strawberries 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and Cool Whip. Cover with maraschino cherries and nuts.

title: Pecan Dreams
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add vanilla. Mix in flour and pecans then roll in small balls and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes then roll in powdered sugar twice.

title: Bacon Wraps
instructions: Cut strips of bacon into 3 parts. Wrap each part around the center of a cracker. Place on a rack over a baking pan so that grease will drain away from crackers. Bake at 250 to 300 degrees until crisp. Store in airtight container.

title: Biscuit And Beef Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown beef and drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles. Place cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Refrigerate leftovers. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Microwave Nachos Grande
instructions: On large microwavable platter start layering as follows tortilla chips Cheddar cheese refried beans hamburger sour cream tomatoes green onions and black olives. After completing first layer of everything begin with second layer in same order. When ingredients are gone top with guacamole and jalapeno peppers. Entire platter can be heated in microwave. Serve immediately. Great party snack (but a little messy)!

title: Spoon Hot Rolls
instructions: Mix warm water and yeast. Melt margarine. Add margarine sugar egg and flour to yeast. Mix well.

title: Secret Beef Stew(Serves 6)
instructions: Place grapefruit juice in saucepan. Place over medium heat. Add stew meat and mix well. Add Worcestershire sauce garlic onion bay leaves and seasonings; mix well. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours. Add vegetables. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove bay leaves.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Pour boiling water over bran. Stir well and let cool. Mix all ingredients. This will keep in refrigerator 6-8 weeks. Bake 20 min. at 400 degrees in greased muffin pan.

title: Sauteed Calf'S Liver With Onions
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy skillet. Add onions and cook stirring frequently for 7 to 8 minutes. Stir in sage and cook 2 to 3 minutes longer or until onions are limp and slightly colored. Set skillet off heat.

title: Frosting
instructions: Blend with mixer until smooth. Frost one layer. Can be used for Whoopie Pies.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue
instructions: Cook roast along with 2 diced onions and 2 cups water in crock-pot for 8 to 12 hours on low. Drain. Shred meat and add 1 diced onion and barbecue sauce. Cook 1 to 3 hours on medium.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage in medium skillet; cook over medium heat until brown stirring occasionally. Drain well. Line bottom of buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with crescent rolls firmly pressing perforations to seal. Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well and pour over sausage. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until set. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into squares and serve immediately. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fancy Chicken Puff Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium heat melt butter and saute shallots lightly. Stir in flour and cook for 3 minutes. Add broth and sherry. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Season to taste with salt pepper and nutmeg. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in ham chicken asparagus and cream. Pour chicken mixture into an ungreased 9-inch pie pan. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cut an 8-inch circle from crust. Cut hearts out of extra dough with a cookie cutter if desired. Place circle on a cookie sheet and moisten with cold water. Pierce with a fork and brush with egg. Decorate with hearts which are also brushed with egg. Bake crust and full pie plate for 10 minutes reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake another 10 to 15 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and filling is hot and set. With a spatula place pastry over hot filling and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tiramisu
instructions: In top of double boiler beat egg yolks and 1/4 cup sugar with mixer for 5 minutes. Set over simmering water; add Marsala and continue beating for 6 minutes. (Keep beater on high speed.) Remove set aside and cool. In separate bowls beat Mascarpone cheese (which is available in delis with imported cheeses) until smooth and whipping cream until it has soft peaks. Fold together Mascarpone whipping cream powdered sugar and vanilla. Mix together coffee and rum. Layer one package of ladyfingers in flat bottom casserole and brush with 1/3 of the coffee mixture. Spread 1/3 of the Mascarpone mixture on ladyfingers and top with 1/3 Marsala mixture. Repeat with remaining ladyfingers making 3 layers. Sift cocoa powder evenly on top. Cover lightly and refrigerate 3 hours. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Praline Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped pecans in pan. Set aside. Cream the butter or margarine and cream cheese. Add brown sugar and cream until light and fluffy (about 5 minutes). Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Fold in flour just until combined. Do not overmix. Stir in vanilla and remaining 1 cup chopped pecans. Spoon batter into prepared pan and place on baking sheet in oven. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until wooden toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove to rack to cool completely. Yields 16 servings.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in oleo. Cook rice and broccoli according to package directions. Combine celery onion soup and cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Stir in cooked rice. Add broccoli. Pour into a 3-quart dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Okra Gumbo
instructions: In a large skillet heat oil and brown okra until tender (about 10 minutes). Add onions and tomatoes to mix. Cook until onions are translucent. Put all remaining ingredients in large pot along with mixture in skillet. Bring to boil then simmer for about 45 minutes.

title: Zesty Squash
instructions: Mix cut squash Ro-Tel tomatoes (do not drain) and 1 1/2 to 2 cups water in a large pot. Stew on medium heat for about 20 minutes or until squash is tender. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a baking dish spoon in layer of squash mixture dob with butter sprinkle with handful of bread crumbs and layer of cheese. Continue layering until all mixture is used. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Dessert
instructions: Combine crackers sugar and oleo. Spread 3/4 mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix Eagle Brand milk and orange juice. Fold in Cool Whip and oranges. Fold in Cool Whip and oranges. Spread in crust. Top with remaining cracker mixture. Refrigerate.

title: The Original Berlin Fair Clam Chowder
instructions: Use a coarse grinder for all ingredients. Cook salt pork and onions just a little. Add about 2 or 3 cups or more water then the potatoes. Cook until nearly done. Add clams and the juice salt pepper and a little sugar (about 1 teaspoon). Simmer about 1 hour uncovered. This recipe can to me from my sister-in-law Marion France.

title: Chicken Chip Bake
instructions: Use 1/2 bag of chips mixed in with all the ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste. Put rest of chips over all. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. (Put in cake pan or casserole.) You can use canned chicken or cook a whole one and use it.

title: Golden Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour cream of tartar soda and salt together. Put aside. Cream butter and flavoring together until butter is soft and smooth. Add sugar gradually creaming until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time. Next add dry ingredients to creamed mixture beating until well-blended. Form dough into 1-inch balls and place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together to form batter. Roll or dip frankfurters in mixture and fry in deep fat.

title: Gouda Cheese
instructions: Wrap Gouda with crescent roll and bake about 20 minutes. Either serve with crackers pickles pepperoni or summer sausage or serve with fresh fruit (apple slices grapes etc.).

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients; will be stiff (better to mix with hand). Bake at 350\u00b0 on a well-greased cookie sheet about 8 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Saute celery and onion until tender. Mix all ingredients together. Place in a 1 1/2 qt. greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove and sprinkle chinese noodles over top. Bake for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Add boiling water to All-Bran; set aside. Mix sugar oil and beaten eggs. Add buttermilk and flour mixed with soda and salt. Mix in over All-Bran then fold in 40% Bran Flakes. Bake in greased muffin pan at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Mix keeps up to 6 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter margarine cream cheese and sugar until thoroughly creamed. Add vanilla and salt; alternate eggs and flour. Beat until well blended. Bake in a lightly greased and floured tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Meat Ball Stew
instructions: Chop onion fine. Combine ground meat chopped onion and rice in a large bowl. Form into medium size meat balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Kielbasa Casserole
instructions: Parboil kielbasa for a few minutes before slicing to remove some of the fat. Melt grape jelly in pan then add can of chili and slices of kielbasa. Simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: German Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and eggs. Sift together flour and spices. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk to which the soda has been added. Fold in gently the preserves vanilla and nuts. Pour into a greased and floured angel food cake pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done at 325\u00b0. Cool for 15 minutes after it is removed from oven.

title: Simple Salmon Cakes
instructions: Drain salmon and flake into bowl; stir in onion egg and bread crumbs. Mix. Form into 1/2 inch thick patties; fry in a little oil until crisp and golden on both sides. Turn only once while frying. Serve with lemon.

title: Zucchini Drop Cookies
instructions: Beat well the zucchini pulp soda sugar and shortening. Add egg and beat well. Sift flour and spices. Add dry ingredients with nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Walnut Pie
instructions: In a medium bowl beat together eggs corn syrup sugar butter vanilla and salt. Arrange walnuts on bottom of pie shell. Carefully pour egg mixture over walnuts. Bake on bottom rack of preheated 400\u00b0 oven until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean about 30 to 35 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cardinal Punch
instructions: Pour all juices into a large goblet half filled with ice cubes. Top with ginger ale. Decorate with slices or oranges and lemons.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers bread cubes or raw vegetables.

title: Jerky
instructions: Cut meat into strips 1/8-inch thick. Soak meat in mixture of ingredients for 6 hours. Dry in oven or on stovetop until crisp.

title: French Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine soup and margarine; stir well. Drain mushrooms and water chestnuts reserving liquid. Add enough water to reserved liquid to equal 1 1/3 cups. Add all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a lightly greased baking dish. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Crab Topping For Crackers
instructions: Mix all together. Let set for awhile to blend. Spread on crackers.

title: French Toast With Bananas 'N Brandy Coulis
instructions: Slice baguettes diagonally into 3/4-inch thick slices. Mix buttermilk milk eggs vanilla and cinnamon thoroughly. Soak slices in mixture for 10 minutes or so. Lightly spray griddle with nonstick vegetable coating. Over medium heat cook slices on griddle until golden brown. Keep in warming oven (covered with a sheet of aluminum foil) at 200\u00b0 until just ready to serve.

title: Easy Strawberry Jam
instructions: Combine berries and 2 cups sugar in pan. Boil 5 minutes. Add remaining sugar and lemon juice. Boil 12 to 15 minutes longer. Remove from heat and stir until foam disappears. Let set overnight. Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add taco sauce and simmer. Put lettuce tomatoes kidney beans onions and cheese in a bowl. Add meat and French dressing. Mix. Add chips just before serving.

title: Pecan Balls
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar. Mix well; add flour mixed with pecans and vanilla. Shape into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes or until light brown. Cool then roll in powdered sugar. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Shrimp Toast
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on bread. Cut diagonally. Put about 1 inch oil in frying pan and heat. Place bread with filled side down and fry 15 seconds. Turn and fry other side until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Southern Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar well. Break the eggs one at a time in a small bowl. Combine all ingredients and beat for about 5 minutes. Grease a large pound cake pan and bake for 2 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream together egg sugar shortening and molasses. Add rest of ingredients. Roll in small balls then roll in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Honey Coconut Divinity
instructions: Boil together sugar honey and water until syrup spins a thread. Slowly pour syrup over stiffly beaten egg whites beating continuously. Beat until mixture holds in shape. Blend in extract and coconut. Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper or spread in a buttered 9-inch square pan; cool and cut into squares.

title: Excellent French Dressing
instructions: Blend well in blender and keep in refrigerator.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add to pineapple. Stir in eggs and butter. Mix. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Toasted Cheese Rounds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well except bread. Spread over entire slice of bread. Broil on cookie sheet until bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Buttery Toasted Rye Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except bread; mix well. Slice loaf into 1/2-inch slices cutting but not through bottom of loaf. Spread one side of each slice with margarine mixture. Wrap in foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Nutty Pie
instructions: Beat the egg whites until stiff but not dry. Add the sugar gradually. Mix baking powder with graham cracker crumbs and fold into meringue mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake for 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven in a greased Pyrex pie pan. Dont overbake. Cool. Pour small carton of Cool Whip over pie; refrigerate overnight.

title: Yogurt Pies
instructions: Fold ingredients together and put in graham cracker crust. If your family doesnt like yogurt they will like these. (These are great for diabetics or heart patients.)

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Diet Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Shape into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheets 2-inches apart. Flatten with fork and sprinkle lightly with sugar. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Only 7 calories each! Makes 15 cookies.

title: Sauteed Corn With Bacon
instructions: Remove husks and silks from corn. Cut corn from cob scraping cob to remove pulp; set aside. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon reserving drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute corn in bacon drippings until golden brown. Add water to cover salt and pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat cover and simmer 30 to 45 minutes. Stir in crumbled bacon.

title: Lemon Snowball
instructions: Line a 12-cup bowl with 2 pieces of wax paper one on top of the other. Let each piece extend over opposite edges of bowl so all edges are covered; paper will be wrinkled. Set bowl aside. In a large bowl sprinkle gelatin over cold water. Let stand 5 minutes to soften. Add boiling water; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in granulated sugar salt orange juice concentrate lemon juice and peel. Refrigerate 45 minutes to 1 hour stirring occasionally until partially set and mixture mounds when dropped from a spoon. In a large bowl whip 1 pint cream until it forms soft peaks. Fold gelatin mixture into whipped cream. Spoon a small amount of lemon mixture into bottom of prepared bowl. Scatter several pieces of angel food cake over lemon mixture. Continue alternating cake and lemon mixture until all is used. Cover with plastic wrap and foil. Refrigerate 1 to 2 days before serving. May also be frozen.

title: Grilled Turkey Burgers
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Shape into 4 patties. Coat grill rack with cooking spray place on grill over medium-hot coals. Place patties on rack and cook 8 minutes on each side or until done. Serve on buns. Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Kabobs
instructions: In small bowl whisk oil garlic rind and juice vinegar oregano salt and pepper. Pour half into large storage bag; add beef. Seal; refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Divide steak peppers onion and mushrooms into 6 equal portions. Thread each portion onto large metal skewers. Heat broiler. Place skewers on large broiler-pan rack. Brush with some of remaining marinade. Broil 5 minutes. Turn over; brush with remaining marinade. Broil 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix mayo cream cheese and soup in small pan until warm. Add gelatin. Mold.

title: Bread Bowl
instructions: Turn a baking bowl upside down and grease well. Press dough evenly covering the outside of the baking bowl. Bake according to package directions. Cool and carefully remove and invert on to a serving tray. Fill with dips stews etc. Bread bowl is edible.

title: Vanilla Wafers
instructions: In a medium bowl beat all ingredients at low speed until well blended. Drop dough by 2 teaspoons about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until edges are brown. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
instructions: Chop and mix all ingredients together. Pack in pan with oil paper. Cover tightly. Store in cool place. Keeps good for several years in freezer. Store in cool place for 2 to 3 weeks before cutting.

title: Sweet Potato Balls(Unusually Delicious)
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Add sugar butter and flavoring. Mix and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Place sugar peanut butter and margarine in a glass bowl. Microwave 2 minutes on High. Stir a few times during the 2 minutes. Remove and stir in vanilla. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch buttered dish. Chill 30 minutes and cut in squares.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef in oil in a large skillet stirring to crumble. Drain off pan drippings. Stir tomatoes tomato paste and seasonings into meat. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Place half of noodles in lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish slightly overlapping lengthwise edges. Spoon 1/3 of meat mixture over noodles. Add 1/2 shredded Mozzarella cheese cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese. Repeat layers and spoon on remaining meat mixture. Arrange Mozzarella slices on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter then blend in salt and flour. Add sour cream until smooth. Bring to boil add corn and cook until heated through. Add 1/2 bacon. Pour in greased dish and top with parsley and bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Colo Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Night Before Cook spaghetti and rinse under cold water. Refrigerate. Peel deseed and chop cucumber. Chop green pepper and green onions. Deseed and chop tomatoes. Add spaghetti. Add salad dressing (all of it). Add salad dressing now or just before.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add taco seasoning cheese and Ro-tel tomatoes. Stir together in skillet over low heat until cheese is melted keep warm. In large bowl mix the salad mix tomatoes and Doritoes. When ready to serve mix everything together and serve immediately to keep chips from getting soggy.

title: Gerry'S Chicken With Lime Butter
instructions: Sprinkle chicken on both sides with salt and pepper. In a large frypan place oil and heat to medium temperature. Add chicken and saute about 4 minutes or until lightly browned. Turn chicken cover and reduce heat to low. Cook 10 minutes or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease. Remove chicken and keep warm; drain off oil and discard.

title: Quick-N-Easy Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Combine fruit and 3/4 cup sugar. Let stand for 20 minutes. Melt margarine to pour over cobbler at the end. Sift together flour and sugar. Add milk. Stir briskly (lumps will remain). Pour butter over top. Top with fruit. Bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Fresh Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Arrange in square or round pan the cut fruit. Sprinkle with mixture of flour sugar and cinnamon. Dot with butter or margarine. Sift together into bowl the flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add oil milk and egg. Stir with fork until blended. Drop by spoonful over fruit. If desired dough may be spread with spatula. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated oven at 350\u00b0. Cook until bubbly and light brown. Serve warm.

title: Fillet Of Flounder
instructions: Combine egg milk salt and pepper. Soak the fish in this mixture for 15 minutes. Dip each fillet in the bread crumbs. Melt butter in skillet. Add fillets and saute on both sides until brown.

title: Fettucini
instructions: Let butter or margarine eggs and cream stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours. Cook bacon in skillet until browned. Remove and drain on paper toweling. Beat together eggs and cream just until blended. Cook pasta until al dente (tender) about 15 minutes. Drain thoroughly; do not rinse. Toss pasta with butter. Pour egg mixture over and toss until pasta is well coated. Add bacon cheese pepper and parsley; toss to mix. Serves 6.

title: Romaine Strawberry Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce; cut strawberries in fourths (if large cut in sixths). Add cranberries; toss or layer in dish. Add nuts just before serving. Top with poppy seed dressing (page 37).

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix and bake 15 to 20 minutes. Remove cover. Top with 1 stick oleo melted and add Progresso bread crumbs Italian-style. Bake 15 to 20 minutes more and serve.

title: Salt Dough
instructions: Mix with your hands adding more flour if dough is sticky and more water if crumbly. Wet the surface to add bits of decorative dough to cut-outs. After shaping bake at 200\u00b0 until thoroughly dry (about 1 hour). You may glaze with egg yolk/water for brown color. Varnish cooled ornament.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Add tomatoes celery green pepper onion parsley and bouillon cubes to chicken broth. Simmer 24 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add chicken and okra; cook for 6 minutes longer. Add rice and corn. Heat and serve. Makes 6 servings 1 cup each; 155 calories per serving.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Press cookie dough onto a greased pizza pan. Cook as directed. Do not overcook. Let cool. Mix softened cream cheese with 3/4 of the container of Cool Whip. Spread onto dough. Cut up fruit onto pan. Spoon heated preserves onto pizza. Let chill in refrigerator 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Dilly Bread
instructions: You will need an 8-inch round 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole.

title: Country Chicken Soup(8 Servings)
instructions: Place all ingredients except rice in slow cooker in order listed. Cover; cook for 1 hour on high then on low for 8 to 9 hours. One hour before serving remove chicken and cook slightly. Remove meat from bones; return meat to slow cooker. Add rice; cover and cook for 1 hour on high.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: In a bowl combine cornmeal flour sugar baking powder salt and baking soda. Add egg milk and corn; stir just until mixed.

title: Mushroom Tomato Quiche
instructions: Beat eggs and egg white until creamy. Add milk and cream. Sprinkle in salt and pepper. Stir in meats and cheese. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Add mushrooms; layer tomatoes. Sprinkle with additional cheese if desired. Bake for 10 minutes at 425\u00b0 then for 10 additional minutes at 350\u00b0. (You can also add 1/4 cup sauteed onions for more flavor.) Serves 8.

title: Secret Kiss Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla in large bowl. Gradually add flour. Beat on low until well blended. Chill 1 hour.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
instructions: Mix oil and dry ingredients. Pour over oyster crackers; blend well. Dry on paper towels.

title: Mary Imus' Favorite Cake
instructions: Blend dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into large rectangular pan or two 8-inch round layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. May add chopped walnuts and/or raisins. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar after baking or frost with light chocolate frosting. Stores well.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Dissolve flour in the milk. Add salt sugar and eggs. Combine with corn and mix well. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. When done knife will come out clean.

title: Jessica'S Famous Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients all together. Form into a loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball Or Log
instructions: Have cream cheese at room temperature. Combine with all ingredients except nuts. Form into ball or log. Place in refrigerator and chill. Take out and roll ball or log in nuts. Wrap in waxed paper or foil and place in refrigerator until time to serve.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: In large bowl cream butter and 2 cups sugar until fluffy. Add vanilla then eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. In separate bowl combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Add sour cream to butter and egg mixture; mix well. Slowly stir in flour mixture until batter is smooth. Spoon 1/2 of batter into a greased 10-inch tube pan. Combine cinnamon nuts and remaining sugar; sprinkle 1/2 over batter in pan. Spoon in remaining batter and top with cinnamon/nuts mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes until tested done. Cool 15 minutes before removing from pan. Makes 16 to 20 servings.

title: Pastel Cookies
instructions: Mix together the shortening margarine and sugar. Add gelatin eggs and vanilla. Blend in dry ingredients. Roll into small balls; place on cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar. Make sure glass has a bottom design on it that goes on cookie when pressed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Cobbler Pie
instructions: Line an 8-inch square pan with cherry pie filling. Mix margarine 1/2 cup sugar baking powder flour salt and milk. Pour 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water over the batter. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Baked Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Beat eggs. Add flour and sugar. Mix well. Add pineapple. Pour into greased casserole and cover with white bread (cubed). Pour melted butter or margarine over all. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Delicious!

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat together with a fork and press into the bottom of greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fluff (Weight Watchers)
instructions: Mix together yogurt Cool Whip and puddings. Fold in pineapple and oranges. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crunch Top Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/2-inch crosswise slices. Cook in boiling water until almost tender. Melt butter in shallow 9 x 13-inch pan. Add single layer of potatoes turning once in butter. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake 1/2 hour or until done and tops are crisp. Serve hot.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix meats thoroughly with bread which has been soaked in the milk seasonings and beaten eggs. Put in a well-greased loaf pan. Spread with ketchup or chili sauce. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Creamy Grits
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil in a large sauce pan. Gradually stir in grits. Return to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer stirring occasionally for 5 to 7 minutes until thickened. Add cheeses and hot sauce or red pepper stirring until cheeses melt. Serve immediately.

title: Snickers Cheese Cake
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter; press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Can use ready made vanilla wafer crust.

title: Dr. Ziment'S Prescription Garlic Chicken Soup For Colds And
instructions: Peel garlic cloves and place with other ingredients in a medium-size saucepan. Heat to boiling then reduce to simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes breathing fumes during cooking. If desired strain soup discarding solid ingredients or puree it after removing bay leaf. Divide the soup into 4 portions each of which should be taken at the beginning of a meal one to three times a day.

title: Kentucky Pound Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites stiff. Combine all ingredients in large bowl (including egg whites and yolks). Mix thoroughly. Use round deep pan. Start in cold oven; bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Onion Shortbread
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Stir in sour cream dill weed salt and half the Cheddar cheese (1/2 cup). In a separate bowl combine corn milk dry muffin mix egg and hot pepper sauce. Put corn mixture in a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Spread onion mixture over top. Top with remaining Cheddar cheese. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Layer in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan or large casserole dish with potatoes and onions. Combine soup tomato sauce milk and spices. Pour over potatoes and hamburger. Cover with foil or cover casserole and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Remove cover. Place on top a few slices of Mozzarella cheese. Bake for 15 minutes until browned. Keeps well in refrigerator. Reheat in oven or microwave.

title: Porcupine Balls
instructions: Mix beef rice salt pepper and onion together. Form into 1-inch balls. In large skillet mix soup and water; bring to a boil. Add meatballs gently. Cover; simmer for 25 minutes turning once.

title: Texas Pie
instructions: Spread each ingredient in a large pan in the order that its written. Bake about one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Movie-Time Nachos
instructions: Empty chips into large serving bowl; set aside. Over low heat in small saucepan mix remaining ingredients. Add a little more milk or salsa to achieve desired consistency. Stir constantly until thoroughly heated. Allow to cool a few minutes before serving. Dip and enjoy! Serves 2 to 4.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli and drain. Put half of it into a casserole dish. Beat 1 egg until light add undiluted mushroom soup and mayonnaise; mix well. Pour 1/2 of this mixture over broccoli in the casserole and also half of the grated cheese. Repeat with layers of broccoli mixture and cheese. Melt 1/4 cup butter. Mix with crumbled crackers and sprinkle over entire casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Chicken Tortellini Soup
instructions: In large saucepan combine water broth soup chicken onion garlic basil and oregano. Bring to a boil; simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Add tortellini and vegetables. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with cheese.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Beat together the peanut butter sugar vanilla and butter. Roll into small balls and chill them for about an hour. In top of double boiler set over hot water melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip chilled balls into the mixture and place on wax paper to cool.

title: Stir-Fried Pork Tenderloin With Vegetables
instructions: Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces. With knife held in slanting position almost parallel to the cutting surface cut tenderloin crosswise into 1/8-inch thick slices. In medium bowl mix pork with next 5 ingredients.

title: Favorite Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl cream together milk shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Slowly add milk while stirring. Cook over medium heat until it comes to a boil. Boil 1 minute and add oleo and vanilla.

title: Cream Of Broccoli
instructions: In medium saucepan bring 3 cups milk and broccoli to the boiling point then simmer stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Stir in Lipton chicken noodle soup mix and flour blended with remaining milk. Bring to the boiling point then simmer 10 minutes or until soup is lightly thickened and broccoli is tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Make-Ahead Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill overnight.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Buffet Potatoes
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except butter and bread crumbs and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and drizzle the butter over crumbs. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese and 1/2 stick margarine. Set aside. Drain broccoli and place in a 2-quart casserole dish. Cover with cheese/margarine mixture. Melt remaining 1/2 stick margarine and add to cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Mexican Pinwheels
instructions: Blend together cream cheese green onions black olives pimentos and jalapenos. Spread on 10 flour tortillas. Roll jelly roll. Sash wrap and chill. Slice. Serve with salsa.

title: Italian Cheese Sticks
instructions: Bring butter and cheese to room temperature. Beat together the butter and cheese until well blended. Combine flour oregano salt and cayenne; add to cheese mixture gradually. Add water; mix until well blended. Form dough into a ball. Roll out on floured surface to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into 3 x 3/4-inch strips or cut into shapes with small cookie cutters. Bake on ungreased baking sheet in 400\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm or cold. Makes about 40.

title: Vichysquash
instructions: Saute onion in butter until clear. Add broth and cut up squash; cook until tender. Puree squash when cool; season and add cream when cold. Sprinkle top with chives. Can be served hot or cold.

title: Company Chicken Casserole
instructions: Line casserole dish with pieces of dried beef. Lay chicken breasts on top. Combine sour cream and undiluted soup. Spoon evenly over chicken. Bake covered for approximately 45 minutes. Check; if chicken is tender uncover and bake about 5 minutes more.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and debone. Cut in bite size pieces. Save 1 cup of broth. Cook noodles in remaining broth. Combine remaining ingredients and add chicken and noodles. Bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Horseradish Sauce Variation-2
instructions: Blend the ingredients and run through food processor. Once combined-refrigerate.

title: Low Cholesterol Pie Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Roll between wax paper. Makes enough for a double crust pie or two pie shells.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze in an 8 x 8-inch pan. To serve let stand about 15 minutes and cut into squares. Serve on a bed of lettuce. Serves 9 to 12.

title: Sour Green Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Saute onion in bacon fat until transparent. Drain beans reserving liquid. Combine vinegar sugar and bean liquid and pour over beans and onion in baking dish. Microwave or heat in medium oven covered. Sprinkle bacon over beans prior to serving.

title: Diabetic Pie
instructions: Mix; add ingredients and pour into crust. Top with Cool Whip (optional).

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and add salad dressing (amount desired). Refrigerate.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Press ground beef into 8-inch casserole and salt and pepper it. Spread soup and top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (This recipe can be doubled and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.)

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine 1 cup stuffing mix with the tomatoes ground chuck and egg mixing well with your hands. Prepare remaining stuffing mix as directed on package following directions as if you were using all the bread. Divide the meat mixture in half. Drop chunks of half of the meat into 8 x 8-inch pan. Top with the prepared stuffing and press down gently. Layer the rest of the meat mixture on top. Again in chunks. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour depending upon the amount of meat used. Makes 9 servings.

title: Candied Walnuts
instructions: Combine brown sugar sugar and sour cream in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat until it boils. Cook to the soft-ball stage (240\u00b0 on candy thermometer). Stir in salt and vanilla. Pour hot candy over walnuts in a mixing bowl. Mix until walnuts are evenly coated. Spoon out onto waxed paper. Separate nuts. Allow to cool and set.

title: Nevada Annie'S Chili
instructions: Saute onion green pepper celery garlic and jalapeno pepper. Add meat and cook until it loses its redness. Combine chili powder cumin garlic salt Tabasco salt and pepper with 8 ounces beer (the other 4 ounces is for the cook!). Let stand 2 minutes. Add to meat along with the remaining ingredients. Simmer covered on low heat for 3 hours.

title: Roseanne'S Shipboard Stroganoff
instructions: Heat the gravy. Add the canned roast beef. Just before serving add the yogurt and mix. Serve immediately over cooked egg noodles.

title: Watermelon Rind Preserves
instructions: Clean rind by removing red meat and green outer part of rind. Cut rind and lemon into small pieces. Mix fruit and sugar; let set overnight. Cook mixture for about 1 hour until thickened. Remove mixture from heat. Add 1/2 cup pectin and enough food coloring to give an attractive color. Seal preserves in jars.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cook pudding as per directions. Add to cake mix and mix well. Batter will be shiny. Pour mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate bits on top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. One-half cup of chopped nuts can also be sprinkled on top of bits before baking. This is a most cake that keeps fresh for days.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain. Chop into small pieces. Combine soup mayonnaise egg onion salt and pepper. Add to the broccoli. Pour into casserole dish and cover with cheese and cracker crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Teriyaki Beef Jerky
instructions: Mix sauce well and pour over thin sliced beef. Let marinate at least 4 hours. Place strips on wire rack over cookie sheet. Bake at 150\u00b0 for 11 to 12 hours. Blot excess grease. Store in container with a lid at room temperature.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix altogether in large bowl. Chill and serve.

title: Potato Cheese Fritters
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well. Shape into balls. Dip in well beaten egg; roll in crumbs. Fry in deep fat until crispy.

title: Stir-Fry Fajitas
instructions: In a large skillet fry meat in salad oil until tender. Add garlic onion and rest of ingredients. Cook until desired tenderness. Serve mixture on warm tortillas topped with salsa and sour cream to your taste.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package in three 9-inch layer cake pans. Boil sugar milk marshmallows and coconut until marshmallows melt. Cool. Put between layers. Use frosting on top and sides.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Make jello according to directions. Chill until slightly set. Chop cranberries apples and oranges in food processor. Add sugar according to taste. Add nuts and mix with jello. Chill.

title: New Waldorf Salad
