instructions: In a large bowl gently toss together pineapple apple celery grapes walnuts and kiwi. In a small bowl stir together the mayonnaise yogurt and honey. Fold gently into fruit mixture. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Makes 6 to 8 servings each containing 210 calories and 2 grams saturated fat.

title: Mud Pie
instructions: Mix crushed wafers and butter. Press into a 9-inch pie plate. Cover with softened ice cream. Top with hot fudge. Freeze for 10 minutes. Top with Cool Whip and almonds. Freeze any leftovers.

title: Good Lite Cake
instructions: Put pears in mixer. Add 1/4 cup Crisco oil and cake mix. Beat then add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice. Add chopped onion and pepper. Cook sausage until done. Add with remaining ingredients to rice mixture. Place in casserole and bake until bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: All-In-One Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash potatoes but do not peel them. Cut them into quarters. Wash the carrots and cut them into 2-inch chunks. Peel onions and cut into wedges.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in electric blender. Process until smooth. Store in refrigerator. This makes 1 1/2 cups. You may want to add a little more water as it makes a thick milk.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients; place in layer pans that have been greased and floured. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pie filling in bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan. Pour crushed pineapple over filling. Sprinkle cake mix over fruit mixture. Pour melted butter over all. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until top is brown about 1 hour. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Hot Crab Meat Spread
instructions: Blend well. Put in Pyrex casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve hot with crackers or French bread.

title: Easy Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar corn syrup and butter. Cook over low heat until butter melts. Remove from heat and add vanilla and pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oven French Fries
instructions: Wash peel and cut potatoes lengthwise into \French fries.\ Toss with oil in a large bowl. Spread in a single layer on baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes turning once. Salt before serving if desired.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: In a large bowl combine water cracker crumbs and salt. Add beef and mix well. Press into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan lined with waxed paper. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cut the meat into 12 squares. Coat each square lightly with flour. Brown in oil in skillet a few pieces at a time. Drain. Remove waxed paper from the baking pan. Spread the soup in bottom of pan. Place meat squares in a single layer over soup. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. To serve spoon some soup over each meat square. Yields 12 servings.

title: Chicken Pineapple Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery pineapple salt lemon juice and mayonnaise. Stir in salted almonds. Chill in refrigerator. Serve on lettuce or endive. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients as listed in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Combine flour brown sugar pecans and margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes stirring often. Let cool. Combine strawberries sugar lemon juice and egg whites; beat at high speed about 20 minutes or until fluffy. Fold whipped cream into strawberry mixture. Remove 1/3 of crumb mixture from pan. Pat remaining crumbs into smooth layer. Pour strawberry mixture over crumbs in pan and sprinkle reserved crumbs over top. Freeze. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel eggplant slice and boil in water until tender (5 to 10 minutes). Drain and mash. Saute meat and onion in skillet. Add meat mixture eggs bread crumbs cheese and seasoning to eggplant. Mix well; pour into a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve hot or cold. Contains 160 calories per serving.

title: Cinnamon-Frosted Zucchini Bars
instructions: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In a small bowl beat butter for 30 seconds.\tAdd sugars; beat until fluffy.\tAdd eggs and vanilla; beat well. Stir in flour. Stir in zucchini coconut and nuts.\tSpread\tin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.\tCool completely in pan.\tDrizzle with frosting; cut into bars.

title: Spinach Balls With Mustard Sauce
instructions: Combine spinach stuffing mix cheese butter scallions 3 eggs and nutmeg. Shape into 1-inch balls. Refrigerate or freeze until ready to use. Bake on greased baking sheet at 350\u00b0 until golden brown 10 to 15 minutes if thawed and 20 minutes if frozen. Makes 70 balls.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
instructions: Heat oil; add all seasonings except lemon pepper. Drizzle over crackers; shake in lemon pepper. Let stand overnight in airtight container. Occasionally turn upside-down.

title: Granny Eudell'S Chewy Brownies
instructions: Mix and pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Cut while still warm.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix catsup and mustard. Add sugar and spices. Mix remaining ingredients. Bring to boil for 15 minutes. Bottle up. Makes a little over 8 pints.

title: Dave'S Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in skins and cool. Peel potatoes and chop in large 1/2-inch chunks. Add 1/2 mayo and mix carefully or with clean hands if desired. Add veggies and salt and pepper to taste. Add remaining mayo and mix carefully. Chill and serve.

title: Bacon Wrapped Chestnuts
instructions: Cut bacon in half and wrap each chestnut. Secure with a toothpick. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chestnuts in an ovensafe dish (but the one you want to serve them in). Mix ketchup sugar and soy sauce and pour over chestnuts. Make sure theyre all coated. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Great crowd pleaser!

title: Chocolate Chip And Raisin Cookies
instructions: Combine flour and baking powder in medium bowl and set aside. Blend sugars in a large bowl using an electric mixer set at medium speed.

title: Strawberry Ice
instructions: Place strawberries in blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Microwave marshmallows and milk in large mixing bowl on High for 1 to 2 minutes or until smooth when stirred stirring after 1 minute. Gradually add strawberries to marshmallow mixture beating until well blended. Blend in juice and peels.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies. Mix pudding and milk and set aside. Mix cream cheese margarine and powdered sugar. Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture. Layer in an oblong dish alternating crumbs with pudding mixture.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and remove stems from mushrooms. Chop stems. Set aside. Cook sausage until done. Drain well on paper towel.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and milk then flour. Mix all remaining ingredients. Pour into 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. This makes filling and crust.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttercream Frosting
instructions: In small saucepan stir flour and milk smooth. Cook over low heat until thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat; let cool. In bowl cream butter Crisco sugar and vanilla. Add milk/flour mixture to butter mixture and beat with electric mixer until smooth.

title: Salted Nut Roll
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle 1/2 of the jar of peanuts on bottom. Melt\tmargarine and peanut butter chips. Add Eagle Brand milk and stir then add marshmallows and stir until coated. Pour marshmallow mixture over peanuts and press down. Sprinkle rest of nuts on top and press down. Cool and cut into small pieces.

title: Sweet Potato And Apple Scallop
instructions: Place in a buttered baking dish by layers half of the sweet potatoes cover with half of the apples sprinkle with half the sugar dot with half of the butter and sprinkle with half of the salt. Repeat the layers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes until apples are tender.

title: Almond Puffs
instructions: Mix margarine and peanut butter. Add vanilla. Gradually add sugar working in as much sugar as possible. Dough will be stiff. Make nickel size balls. Line up on wax paper placed on cookie sheet and place on level surface in freezer for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Skillet Casserole
instructions: Put oil in skillet. Add hamburger onions and green pepper. Brown. Pour off excess grease. Add tomatoes. Simmer 1 hour. Add macaroni and cook another 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine ham pork ground beef cracker crumbs pepper eggs and milk. Shape into 2 loaves and place in greased baking dish. Combine brown sugar mustard and vinegar; pour over loaves. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Grami Hurd'S Larded Grouse
instructions: Grouse are rather dry birds and need to be larded to be palatable. Clean and wash quickly under running water. Cover bird entirely with thin slices of bacon tying them in place with a crossing of soft string or toothpicks. Place the birds in a roasting pan and baste them with enough boiling water to use again and again. Roast in an oven (350\u00b0) for 45 minutes basting frequently.

title: Chocolate Chex Mix
instructions: Combine all cereals nuts and pretzels. Melt chocolate in microwave. Pour over mixture. Mix well. Dry on wax paper. Break into pieces and enjoy.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Roll up chicken cutlets with 1 slice ham and 1 piece Swiss cheese. Put in toothpicks to hold together. Flour and brown cutlets (optional). Put cutlets in casserole with 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken soup diluted with about 1/2 can any white wine. Cook in oven for about 1 hour.

title: Fiesta Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain the ground chuck. Add onions and green pepper. Spray a casserole dish with Pam. Spread the beans in the bottom of the dish. Add the meat mixture and black olives. Pour the soup over top and cover with a layer of grated mozzarella cheese.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook ground beef and onions together on low heat until done. Drain off fat. Add all the ingredients together and cook until thick stirring often. If too thick add more broth. Make about 5 quarts. This freezes well.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake(A Light Moist Cake With A Tangy Fruit Topping)
instructions: Lightly butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan or two 8-inch square pans. Prepare Brown Sugar Topping and set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Combine Quick Mix and sugar in a large bowl. Mix well. In a small bowl combine milk eggs and vanilla. Add half of milk mixture to dry ingredients. Beat 2 minutes until batter is smooth. Add remaining milk mixture and beat 2 to 3 more minutes. Pat Brown Sugar Topping evenly over bottom of pan. Spoon crushed pineapple smoothly over topping. Spread batter over pineapple. Bake 45 to 50 minutes until center springs back when lightly touched. Cool in pan 10 minutes then invert onto a serving plate. Serve warm with pineapple side up. Makes one large cake or two 8-inch cakes.

title: Danish Cucumbers
instructions: Peel and slice cucumbers thin. Sprinkle with the salt. Let stand at least an hour or overnight. A plate should be placed on top of cucumbers and weighted down. Drain and rinse well. While they are draining mix the vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Pour over the cucumbers and let them stand at least 2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Mix ground beef rice onion salt and pepper well. Form into good size balls and wrap in cabbage leaves. Fasten with toothpicks. Place in large pot; cover with canned tomato soup. Simmer for 45 minutes to an hour. Shredded cabbage may be placed between layers of rolls to give more flavor to the sauce. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake(Needs No Frosting)
instructions: Mix all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream on top.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli or peas according to package directions in salted water until tender. Drain. Arrange peas or broccoli in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer chicken on top. Combine next 3 ingredients and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes or until heated. Trim with pimento strips if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly(Fat-Free)
instructions: *Sweet or green peppers may also be used.

title: Sausage Brunch(Serves 8)
instructions: Put croutons in bottom of 8 x 12-inch Pyrex pan then put 2 cups cheese on top then loose sausage. Beat eggs mustard and milk. Pour over top and let sit overnight in refrigerator. In the morning pour over top 1 can cream of mushroom soup mixed with 1/2 cup milk. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of cheese over this. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes; cool. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add vanilla and cooled raisins. Sift together the flour baking powder soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to raisin mixture and blend well. Add chopped nuts. Chill. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Bear Claws
instructions: Melt candy wafers and Crisco together. Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl. Pour melted candy over cereal and cool well. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper. When firm store in airtight container.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Add sugar gradually to shortening. Beat in lemon flavoring vanilla eggs and bananas. Sift flour soda and salt. Beat in dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 in two 9-inch round pans or 9 x 12-inch pan. Test at 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into 2 rolls then wrap meat in foil. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Punch holes in the bottom of the rolls with a fork. Place the rolls on a rack in a baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours. Yum Yum!!!!

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Pour all ingredients into crock-pot and mix. (If you microwave Cheez Whiz as on label it pours nicely.) Cook 6 to 8 hours on slow.

title: Cherry-Pineapple Strudel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch cake pan with butter. Spread can of pineapple (do not drain) in greased cake pan. Spread cherry pie filling over pineapple. Sprinkle yellow cake mix over pineapple and cherries. Sprinkle pecans over cake mix. Cut butter in small pieces and put on top of cake mix and nuts. Bake for 1 hour. Be careful not to burn pecans. Serve hot or cool.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute exactly. Add chocolate chips. Stir and cool until right consistency to spread. Add chopped nuts if desired. Frost cake or cookies while warm.

title: Vegetable Stroganoff
instructions: Blend cream and yogurt until smooth; set aside. Microwave vegetables in a microwave-safe bowl on High for 5 or 6 minutes until cooked through. Cook noodles until tender; drain. Keep vegetables and noodles warm by placing in a 200\u00b0 oven in a covered dish. Saute onion and mushrooms in oil until onion turns translucent. Add garlic; cook for another 3 minutes. Stir in Worcestershire sauce. Add 1/4 teaspoon of salt and pepper or to taste if desired. Reduce heat to low. When ready to serve stir cream-yogurt mixture to make sauce; heat through. Toss vegetables with noodles. Place on serving platter. Spoon sauce over top. Garnish with mixture of garnish ingredients. Serves 6.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Slowly add cake flour. Pour into greased and floured tube pan or Bundt pan. Do not preheat oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chewy Turtle Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over chocolate and stir until melted. Cool. Beat sugar and margarine until fluffy. Beat in egg yolks. Beat in chocolate mixture and vanilla on low speed.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine the first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until blended. Add egg and beat until blended. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed. Drop by heaping teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until brown. Cool 2 minutes before removing from sheet.

title: Cheaters Jam Cake
instructions: Mix cake by directions on the box and add flour. Fold in jam raisins and nuts. Do not beat or mix with mixer. Flour and grease three 9-inch cake pans. Spoon batter equally into pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes depending on your oven.

title: Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Heat soup and cream cheese together. Layer all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Homemade Noodles
instructions: Place chicken (without skin) in large kettle of water along with celery and celery salt. Cook for approximately 1 hour. Remove chicken and strip meat from bone. Return meat to water and add noodles. Cook for half an hour.

title: Beefy Rice
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter. Mix rice soup salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Cook onion in margarine until tender. Add remaining ingredients; heat until boiling. Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Break up shrimp and blend with all ingredients. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain water from artichokes and chop. Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Shrimp And Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Butter an oblong baking dish. Melt 4 1/2 teaspoons of the butter; blend in flour. Add milk and cream; cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add salt and pepper to taste; set aside. In remaining 2 teaspoons of butter saute mushrooms gently for about 5 minutes. Arrange artichokes in a single layer on the bottom of prepared baking dish. Scatter shrimp over artichokes. Cover shrimp with a layer of mushrooms. Stir sherry and Worcestershire sauce into cream sauce; pour over contents of baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly (or refrigerate several hours and bake for 45 minutes). Serve with rice.

title: Chocolate Souffl
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a sauce pan. Gradually add milk stirring constantly and heat to boiling. Remove from heat. Gradually add the beaten egg yolks to this mixture and then stir in the melted butter. Set aside. Beat the next three ingredients with an electric mixer until foamy. Gradually beat in sugar until meringue forms stiff and glossy peaks. Gently combine the two mixtures and carefully pour into a well greased 6 cup souffl dish. Bake on lowest oven rack at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Serve immediately with fat free cool whip.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix 1 cup cornmeal 1 heaping tablespoonful of flour a little baking powder salt to taste and a little grease. Add enough hot water to make soft mix. Have griddle hot and pour batter onto hot griddle. Turn over with spatula when brown on bottom.

title: Best Ever Baked Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions until done and drain. Mix all ingredients and put into a casserole dish. Place in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Suncoast Ham
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; bring to boil. Brush sauce liberally on ham. Grill about 20 minutes on each side.

title: Nutty Bars
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with crackers. Press into 9x13 baking pan. Layer coconut chocolate and butterscotch chips and nuts in order. Spread milk evenly over mixture.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 12-cup fluted tube pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon in plastic food storage bag. Separate dough into 30 biscuits. Cut into quarters. Shake in bag to coat. Arrange in pan. Mix brown sugar and margarine. Pour over biscuit pieces. Bake 28 to 32 minutes or until golden brown and no longer doughy in center. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Turn upside down onto serving plate. Pull apart to serve. Serve warm.

title: Roast Lamb
instructions: Crush garlic with salt and pepper. Mix with oil; spread on lamb. Sprinkle with marjoram thyme rosemary and flour. Pour wine and 1 cup water into pan. Roast in a 325\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours basting frequently. Serves 6.

title: Strawberry Pie (Low-Fat)
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add cornstarch and sugar and boil until thick. Let gel for a few minutes in the refrigerator. Add strawberries and pour into crust. Chill in the refrigerator. Serve with whipped topping vanilla ice cream or yogurt.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: Soak the bread pieces in the wine; set aside. Combine the Italian sausage eggs mint and bread. Form into 24 meatballs. Brown the meatballs over high heat in a skillet lightly greased with olive oil. Finish cooking the meatballs in a marinara sauce. Serve over spaghetti or other pasta.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Simmer until sugar melts and sauce has thickened a little. Serve with chicken or pork.

title: Oatmeal Yeast Bread
instructions: Add oats molasses salt and oil to boiling water. Let cool. Dissolve yeast cakes in water. Add to first mixture. Mix in flour sifted. Let rise in greased bowl until double in size. Shape into loaves or rolls. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 2 loaves or 2 dozen rolls.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in a pan. Mix in flour and salt. Add milk slowly stirring until smooth. Cook and stir until sauce thickens. Add mustard and cheese. Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Makes 2 2/3 cups sauce.

title: Tacos
instructions: Brown chopped meat stirring often. Add salt and pepper to taste. Drain off fat. Put ground meat in a bowl. Everyone puts their favorite things on their own tacos. Eat and enjoy.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Clean crab meat. Combine ingredients except almonds. Mix well and put mixture into a small baking dish. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Susan'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine in large bowl all above ingredients. Pat into a loaf size pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Roast Cooked In Crock-Pot
instructions: Put roast in crock-pot. On top of roast put can of soup and the envelope soup mix. Cook on low. You will have gravy to serve on rice or noodles. You can cook on low overnight.

title: Chocolate Square Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Add sugars shortening egg and vanilla. Beat until smooth (about 2 minutes). Stir in oats and nuts. Shape dough into a roll; wrap and chill thoroughly. Slice and put on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately place small square of milk chocolate bar on each. Remove from sheets and press pecan or walnut half into chocolate square.

title: Frosted Molasses Creams
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and molasses. Mix well. Add coffee then sifted dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Pour into greased pan (12 x 18-inch). Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 25 minutes or until done. While still warm frost with confectioners sugar and butter or confectioners sugar with a little spoon of milk. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Thaw shells 10 minutes before baking 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Brown beef; drain. Add seasonings and fix as package directs. Mix refried beans and half of salsa. Layer crust with half beef bean mixture and cheese. Repeat layer. Bake 25 minutes. Put rest of salsa on top. After baking add lettuce and tomato. Serve. (We use sour cream on ours too.) Enjoy.

title: Summertime Salad
instructions: Break cauliflower and broccoli in small pieces; dice onion. Crumble bacon. Mix together rest of ingredients then add all together and stir well. Put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa oleo and milk. Stir until sugar dissolves over medium heat. When mixture comes to a rapid boil boil one minute. Remove form heat. Add vanilla. Cool and beat. Spread on thin cake layers.

title: A Love Cake For Mother
instructions: Mix well and bake in hearty warm oven and serve to mother everyday. She ought to have it in big slices.

title: Low-Fat Autumn Medley Stew
instructions: In a large soup kettle simmer chicken breasts in the broth. Add the onion as the chicken simmers. When chicken is fully cooked remove and set aside.

title: Chicken Pasta Stir-Fry
instructions: In large skillet heat oil. Add broccoli and carrots. Stir over medium heat until tender-crisp. Add next 5 ingredients; cook until chicken is done. Stir in pasta onions and cheese; heat thoroughly.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch glass dish pour pie filling on bottom. Spread evenly. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pie filling. Melt butter and pour over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pizza Muffins
instructions: Put pizza sauce on half of English muffin. Sprinkle with shredded Mozzarella and bake until cheese is melted. Serve.

title: Strawberry Milk Punch
instructions: Place strawberries and sugar in mixer bowl. Beat with electric mixer until well blended. Combine with milk and ice cream in punch bowl. Serves about 25.

title: Orange Pineapple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs oranges (with juice) and oil. Blend in cake mix. Grease 3 round cake pans. Divide cake mixture into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Blend Cool Whip pineapple and pudding together. Spread generous amount between layers and over cake. Refrigerate overnight before cutting. Keep refrigerated.

title: Honey Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order given. Blend in blender or mixer until oil disappears. Yield 2 cups.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Mix well. Drop by small spoonfuls into hot soup. Cook 12 minutes.

title: Filled Sugar Cookies
instructions: Prepare the filling using raisins sugar water and flour. Cook until thick. Set aside to cool.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham crackers and 1 stick melted butter. Beat for 5 minutes. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix powdered sugar eggs and 2 sticks melted butter. Spread on graham cracker crust.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Using a wire whisk combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Refrigerate until well chilled. Serve over tossed green salad. Yields 2 cups. One tablespoon serving contains 54 calories and no cholesterol.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Coarsely grate zucchini. There should be 2 cups lightly packed down. Beat egg. Add zucchini Bisquick salt and cheese; mix well. In a large skillet fry tablespoons of mixture in a little butter until lightly browned. Keep warm in oven while frying rest of batter.

title: Primavera
instructions: In a large skillet saut garlic in oil. Add vegetables and basil and saut until almost tender. Add chicken broth and mushrooms. Bring to a boil quickly reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 5 minutes. Mix well. Serve over pasta cooked al dente. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Serves 6.

title: Batter
instructions: Beat ingredients until smooth. Cover onion mushrooms fish etc. with batter and deep-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Cut pork in small pieces and place in small amount of oil on stove in large heavy pan with salt and pepper. Cook slow until juice is drawn out (do not brown). Cover and cook about 40 minutes. Add celery and soy sauce; cook 20 minutes. Add onions and cook 10 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook another 10 minutes. Add cornstarch and bring to boil; add beans sprouts and water chestnuts. Cook slowly until juice is clear. Good.

title: Russian Borscht
instructions: Make vegetable soup with first five ingredients including beets (if using raw ones). Add canned beets (if using canned) when soup is almost done. Add tomatoes and generous amount of dill weed (to your own taste of course). Serve with dollop of sour cream or cottage cheese.

title: English Scones
instructions: Rub the butter and flour until they resemble fine bread crumbs. Stir in the baking powder sugar and sultanas. Add the milk to make a sticky dough and turn onto a floured surface. Knead gently then roll flat (about 1-inch thick) and cut out circles. Place on floured baking tray. Brush with milk. Bake at 220\u00b0C for 10 to 20 minutes. Spread with butter and jam to taste.

title: Double Good Blueberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Add water and 2 cups of blueberries. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and clear (mixture will be quite thick). Remove from heat. Stir in butter and lemon juice. Cool. Place remaining 2 cups raw blueberries in pie shell. Top with cooked berry mixture. Chill. Serve garnished with whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar cinnamon baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Add oil and eggs; mix well. Stir in strawberries pineapple raisins and pecans. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from pans; cool. Wrap loaves in foil tightly overnight to mellow.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast
instructions: Cook sausage until brown or done; drain well. Spread bread cubes in 12 x 8 x 2-inch buttered baking dish. Top with sausage then cheese. Combine eggs milk salt and mustard; beat well. Pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until set.

title: Old Fashioned Vinegar Candy
instructions: Melt butter in heavy pan; add sugar and vinegar. Stir until sugar dissolves; wash down sides of pan with pastry brush dipped in cold water. Boil mixture to brittle stage (256\u00b0); pull and cut into small pieces with scissors or knife. Arrange on buttered plate to cool.

title: Hot Sandwich Supreme
instructions: In small saucepan blend soup flour and onions and 3/4 cup Milnot. Cook over low heat until mixture comes to a boil (stir constantly to prevent scorching). Remove from heat stir in chicken and pimento. Spread in 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill until thick. Cut in 4 squares and place on each of 4 slices of bread top with other bread. Cut in halves or quarters. Beat eggs and remaining Milnot together. Dip sandwiches in egg mixture then in potato chips. Sprinkle with almonds. Place on greased cookie sheet bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook diced potatoes and carrots until tender. Drain and add along with peas covering the chicken pieces. Pour soup over all. Mix melted oleo flour and milk together. Pour over soup and spread evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Sausage Bake
instructions: Cook sausage red pepper onion sage garlic powder salt and pepper until done. Spoon mixture into greased 9-inch round baking dish.

title: Bouillabaisse
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients in large stock pot and cook over moderate heat until vegetables are softened. Add clam juice and water and bring to brisk boil. Add shellfish monkfish and then squid. Cover and gently simmer until fish is cooked. Stir in Pernod and sprinkle with parsley just before serving.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant;\tmash. Mix soup onion egg salt and pepper; add to eggplant.\tAdd 1 cup of herb stuffing; toss. Pour into casserole dish.\tSprinkle remaining stuffing on top and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix soup sour cream onion Ro-Tel and 2 cups of cheese in large bowl. Dip tortillas in hot oil and drain on paper towels. Put 2 tablespoons of mixture on each tortilla and roll up. Place seam side down in a large baking dish. Cover enchiladas with the remaining mixture and top with remaining 2 cups of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Combine all; pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes. Serve with white egg sauce.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Melt margarine and add garlic salt pepper parsley scallions and lemons. Grease a large shallow pan and place shrimp in single layer on bottom of pan. Pour butter mixture over shrimp. Place under broiler for 5 minutes until pink. Remove. Serve on bed of rice. Can pour butter sauce over rice.

title: Pastor'S Delight
instructions: Liberally spread cheese on Spam; frost like cake. Decorate with whole cloves. Give to pastor with our delight.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut into large pieces. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in a bag. Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in bag coating pieces with cheese mixture. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Place potatoes in a layer in pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour turning once during baking. When golden brown sprinkle with parsley.

title: Carolyn'S Ice Cream
instructions: Add sugar to beaten eggs; beat until stiff. Add remaining ingredients. Use a Number 2 can crushed pineapple (drained). This was a recipe of Carolyn T. High. Freeze in ice cream churn.

title: Spaghetti Bake Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger butter onion and green pepper. Cook spaghetti as directed; drain. Mix hamburger mixture spaghetti tomato soup and corn. Put in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Cover liberally with cheese. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Make day before so it will sit in refrigerator several hours.

title: Toll House Kookie Brittle
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine butter vanilla and salt in bowl and blend well. Gradually beat in sugar. Add flour chocolate morsels and 3/4 cup walnuts. Mix well. Press evenly into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup walnuts over top and press in lightly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes until golden brown. Cool. Break into irregular pieces. Can cut into bars when warm if desired. Makes about 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Tiramisu
instructions: In medium mixing bowl beat cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer until well combined. Add milk and beat 2 to 3 minutes until light and fluffy.

title: Marinated Rabbit
instructions: Cut rabbit into serving size pieces. Cover with marinade containing the ingredients and marinate overnight at room temperature. Save the marinade and brown the meat in a baking pan at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Halve and clean out peppers. Mix all ingredients together well. Fill pepper shells with mixture. Put a little water in bottom of Pyrex dish. Cook on 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Double Lime Chiffon Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add reserved juice. Cool until slightly thickened; beat until frothy. Fold in pineapple cottage cheese mayonnaise and nuts. Place in 13 x 9-inch pan or mold. Refrigerate until firm. Yield 12 servings.

title: Deep-Fried Turkey
instructions: Fill the injector needle of a bulb baster with salad dressing and squirt under skin. Tie legs together with one end of a 30-inch string. Pour oil to depth of 5 to 6 inches into a deep pot of a propane cooker; heat to 325\u00b0. Carefully lower turkey into hot oil using string; fry 30 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted in turkey registers 185\u00b0. (Temperature of oil drops immediately after turkey is placed in it; oil may not reach 325\u00b0 again.) Remove turkey from oil and cool slightly before slicing.

title: Fresh Tomato-Basil Sauce
instructions: Prepare the first 2 ingredients; place together in bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Vidalia Onion Classic Casserole
instructions: Saut sweet onions in butter until transparent. Add chicken broth sherry and flour. Cook and stir. When slightly thickened transfer to medium casserole. Top with bread crumbs and both cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix together and freeze.

title: Cranberry Crunch
instructions: Grease 10-inch quiche or pie plate. Spread cranberries over bottom of dish. Sprinkle with 1 cup sugar and pecans. In small bowl at high speed beat eggs until frothy. Add 1 cup sugar; beat well at low speed. Add flour shortening and margarine. Pour batter over berries and nuts. Bake 1 hour or until golden at 325\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cocktail Bars
instructions: Mix together fruit cocktail vanilla eggs and sugar. Add flour soda salt and brown sugar. Mix and pour into greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: East India Chicken(Serves 6)
instructions: Combine flour curry powder salt and pepper in paper bag. Add chicken pieces and shake until lightly coated. Brown chicken in butter. Sprinkle onion raisins and rice over chicken. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water and add to chicken. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a large saucepan combine margarine milk and sugar over medium heat. Stirring constantly bring to a boil. Continue stirring until mixture reaches the soft ball temperature on a candy thermometer or until a drop of the mixture in the water forms a ball. After reaching soft ball stage remove mixture from heat and add vanilla peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme. Stir until smooth. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased glass dish. Let cool.

title: Macaroni Cheese Twist
instructions: Cut up green pepper and garlic; fry in pan with 4 tablespoons oil until tender. Stir in tomato sauce and water. Simmer 10 minutes.\tAdd cheese (cut in 1/2-inch cubes). Stir into mixture. Serve over hot macaroni.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time until you have all eggs beaten with sugar and butter. Add sour cream 1/3 at a time then 1 cup flour. Continue with the sour cream and flour. Add vanilla and lemon. Beat until smooth. Grease tube cake pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
instructions: Put eggs in pan. Drain pineapple and add to eggs. Beat together. Add sugar and flour to juice and cook until thick. Pour over pineapple marshmallows and cheese in a bowl. Stir and chill.

title: Pull Apart Cheese Loaf
instructions: Mix melted margarine/butter and garlic powder. Dip biscuits in this and put in a greased loaf pan so they are standing vertically (4 rows of 5 biscuits). Mix green onion and grated cheese. Put about 1 teaspoon of mixture between each biscuit until it is gone. Pour any leftover melted butter/garlic mixture over the top. Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until golden brown in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Angel Food Cherry Dessert
instructions: Crumble angel food cake into bite size pieces. Prepare pudding according to directions then mix whipped topping with pudding. Put cake pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan and top with the pudding mixture. Chill. Top with cherry pie filling and chill again.

title: Jim'S Favorite Zesty Bell Pepper Slaw(This Recipe Can Be Prepared In 45 Minutes Or Less.)
instructions: Coarsely chop cabbage bell peppers and scallions. In a bowl whisk together mayonnaise yogurt vinegar and cayenne. Add vegetables basil and salt and pepper to taste; toss well. Chill slaw covered 20 minutes.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk and butter at a hard boil for one minute. Put into a bowl and add cocoa peanut butter and vanilla. Last add your oats and mix well. Spoon onto foil or wax paper until firm.

title: Mystery Artichoke Appetizer
instructions: Blend all ingredients together thoroughly and pour into greased baking dish. Note Onion and artichoke may be chopped separately in food processor pulsing carefully. Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Pickled Onions
instructions: Drop onions in boiling water. Boil 3 minutes. Drain. Place in cold water. Cut root end; squeeze stem end to remove onion skin. Combine 2 cups water and pickling salt; pour over onions. Let stand 12 hours. Drain; rinse thoroughly. Combine vinegar sugar and pickling spices; bring to boiling. Pack onions into hot jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Cover with pickling liquid leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Adjust lids and process in boiling water bath (half-pints) for 10 minutes.

title: Honey Walnut Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend honey and mayonnaise until smooth. Toss remaining ingredients with lemon juice. Stir in honey mixture. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 7 cups.

title: Ann'S Salad
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Golden Puffs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoon into hot oil. Fry until golden brown on each side. Drain and shake in brown bag containing cinnamon and sugar or powdered sugar. Makes a great after school snack.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix sugar oleo eggs vanilla and cocoa until smooth. Add flour and salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanuts Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate chips on stove at low heat until completely melted. Add peanuts and Chinese noodles. Mix well. Drop by tablespoon into cupcake wrappers. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Let chill in refrigerator until youre ready to serve.

title: Creole Muffins
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt sugar and corn meal together. Combine eggs and milk and add to dry ingredients stirring only enough to moisten. Add oil butter peppers onion pimiento and cheese. Combine stirring only enough to moisten. Do not overstir. Place in greased muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 to 4 dozen.

title: Marbled Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine crumbs cocoa sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. In large mixer bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy; beat in condensed milk until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.

title: Dr. Bird Cake
instructions: Measure and mix dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add eggs oil pineapple with juice and bananas. Stir to blend; do not beat. Pour into 9-inch tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Put softened cheese and milk together and mix until smooth. Add lemon juice and vanilla and blend. Pour into 9 ounce pie shell. Chill for 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Add water gradually stirring until smooth. Bring to a boil stirring constantly until thick. Reduce heat; cook 2 or 3 minutes longer until clear and transparent. Remove from heat; add lemon juice and drop of red food coloring. Fold in sliced strawberries. Pour in baked and cooled pie shell. Top with Cool Whip; chill. Enjoy!

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown onions in oil and add paprika and stir well. Add meat. Cover and simmer a few minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Cover and simmer until done. Add more water or broth if needed during cooking. Add sour cream gradually. You may want to use less than the full 8 ounces. If mixture is too thin you may want to thicken it a little.

title: Onion Cheese Dip
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan combine soup mix tomatoes and cheese over medium heat. Heat to boiling stirring often. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables for dipping. Makes 2 1/2 cups. Preparation time 5 minutes.

title: Scotch Raisin Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar gradually while beating; stir in milk and molasses. Beat well. Sift dry ingredients (except oatmeal and nuts) together.

title: Ham Roll
instructions: Spread cream cheese on ham slices. Place pickles on cream cheese and roll up like a jelly roll. Cut into desired size.

title: Mint Surprise Cookies
instructions: Sift flour soda and salt; set aside. Cream butter and shortening. Add sugars gradually; mix well. Add eggs water and vanilla; beat well. Blend in dry ingredients; mix well. Dough may be chilled.

title: Cheese Wedges
instructions: In a bowl mix flour corn meal and chili powder. Add butter milk and egg. Stir until just moistened. Press mixture into nine-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until mixture is lightly browned and begins to pull away from sides of pan (about 25 minutes). Mix cheese chilies and green onions; spread over hot mixture. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts (about 15 to 20 minutes). Serve either hot or cold. Makes 12 pieces.

title: Hobo Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Drain. Drain juice from butter beans and kidney beans. Add the 4 beans and salt and pepper to taste. Add a pinch or two of chili powder and bring to boil. Then turn to low and let simmer.

title: Baked Round Steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0; place round steak in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread cream of chicken soup over steak. Shake Lipton onion soup mix over other soup. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Logs
instructions: Cream margarine and peanut butter in mixing bowl until light. Add confectioners sugar gradually beating until fluffy. Stir in cereal. Shape by level tablespoonfuls into logs. Roll in peanuts. Place on waxed paper. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax in double boiler over hot water stirring. Drizzle over logs. Chill until serving. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix Veg-All corn soup and sour cream together. Put mixture into a casserole dish. Sprinkle crushed crackers over casserole. Pour melted margarine over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish sprayed with Pam. Mix well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown ontop.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix orange juice as directed. Mix 1/2 of orange juice 1/2 of Ginger ale and 1/2 gal. pineapple sherbet. Add rest of ingredients as needed. Will serve approximately 50 to 60 people.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix butter or margarine with sugar; add flour crushed potato chips vanilla and chopped (finely) pecans. Drop by teaspoon on oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until light brown. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar while warm.

title: Shrimp Mousse(Appetizer For A Large Crowd.)
instructions: Rinse shrimp well. Set aside. Dissolve gelatine in boiling water. Set aside. Bring tomato soup to a boil. Add cream cheese. Let it melt into soup. Add mayonnaise. Mix well. Add celery onion chives parsley and shrimp. Stir well. Pour into prepared ring mold or fancy fish mold that has been sprayed with Pam vegetable oil. Place into refrigerator overnight. Unmold onto platter or tray that has been lined with lettuce leaves. Serve with crackers.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Saute onion and broccoli until tender (about 20 minutes). Combine rest of ingredients. Combine all ingredients. Pour into lightly greased loaf-baking dish. Bake about one hour at 350\u00b0. Serves about 20.

title: Mousse
instructions: Stir well but do not use electric mixer. For variety add desired amount of one or more of the following ingredients apples nuts raisins dates chocolate chips cocoa or drained fruit cocktail or up to 4 bananas (overripe). Bake in a floured and greased Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool on a rack for about an hour. Turn over onto serving plate.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: In a bowl mix together 1 cup sugar 2 tablespoons flour and diced rhubarb. Pour into an 8 or 9-inch baking dish and dot with butter.

title: Dilled Shrimp Dip
instructions: Blend milk gradually into cream cheese. Stir in lemon juice shrimp Worcestershire sauce garlic salt and dill. Cover; refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large punch bowl.

title: Raisin Molasses Gems
instructions: Beat shortening and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy. Add molasses and egg; beat well. Combine flour soda cinnamon cloves ginger and salt. Add to molasses mixture; mix well. Stir in raisins. Cover. Refrigerate until chilled. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll each in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on oiled cookie sheet. Bake in upper third of preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Emergency Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground chuck in a skillet; drain. Add spaghetti sauce and oregano; heat until warm. Put 8 ounces of sauce on bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2 or equal size pan. Layer uncooked lasagna sauce cottage cheese Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Repeat layers until ingredients run out; end with cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 15 minutes before serving. Good with garlic bread and tossed salad.

title: Flank Steak
instructions: Place steak flat in shallow baking dish. Mix all ingredients and pour over steak. Let stand all day turning occasionally or refrigerate overnight. Barbecue 5 minutes on each side or broil 2 minutes on each side. Cut diagonally into thin strips.

title: Pumpkin Tea Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Position rack in center of oven. Generously butter a 9 x 5-inch metal loaf pan and set aside. Sift flour baking soda salt cinnamon ginger and nutmeg into a medium bowl or onto a large sheet of waxed paper spread on work surface. Set aside.

title: Banana Quick Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat shortening until creamy and glossy. Gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy after each addition. Add eggs and beat until thick and pale lemon color. Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with bananas. Blend thoroughly after each addition.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Sprinkle apples with cinnamon salt and water. Rub together flour sugar and butter. Drop mixture over apples. Bake in buttered 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Stir again and serve. Serve with any vegetables.

title: Pizza Bake
instructions: Boil spaghetti for 9 minutes; drain. Add milk and beaten eggs; mix well. Put into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown ground beef until crumbly; drain and place on top of spaghetti. Pour pizza sauce on top of ground beef. Layer onion slices pepper slices mushrooms and pepperoni. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cereal Mix
instructions: Provide each child with covered margarine tub. Have available various measuring cups and spoons. Instruct children to make a snack mixture by using various measuring tools. Encourage them to compare amounts measured.

title: Crunchy Snack Mix
instructions: Combine pretzels cereals and nuts in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cook and stir brown sugar oleo and corn syrup in a medium saucepan over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Let the mixture boil without stirring for 4 minutes. Remove heat.

title: Hot Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions in skillet. Drain any grease and add tomatoes corn and tomato paste. Put in bottom of 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Chicken With Artichoke Hearts
instructions: Combine flour salt paprika and pepper. Roll chicken in flour mixture to coat very lightly shaking off excess. Spoon 2 tablespoons oil from top of artichokes into skillet and heat. Place chicken in pan and saute browning slowly over moderate heat. Turn to brown on all sides. Add onion when chicken is almost browned. Spoon off any excess fat. Add wine heat to boiling then cover. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Saute nuts in butter until lightly browned. Set aside. Add artichokes to chicken. Mix cornstarch with remaining marinade then gently stir liquid into skillet. Simmer 1 minute until slightly thickened. Remove chicken and artichokes to serving dish. Spoon liquid over chicken and sprinkle with toasted nuts.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Add pepper and cheeses to hot white sauce; stir until cheese melts. Combine sauce and potatoes and pour into 2-quart casserole. Toss crumbs with margarine and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Garnish with chopped olives.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil; let cool. Whip Pet milk; add sugar celery apple and nuts. Add Jell-O mixture and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let set a minute.

title: Japanese Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar with the butter. Add the remaining ingredients. Shape into two rolls; chill until firm. Cut 1/4-inch thick and bake 30 minutes at 300\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Lorraine Priest'S Peanut Butter Bonbon
instructions: Mix powdered sugar and cracker crumbs. Heat margarine and peanut butter over low heat until melted. Stir into crumb mixture. Press in ungreased baking pan 8 x 8 x 12-inch. Heat chocolate chips in small saucepan over low heat stirring frequently until melted. Spread over crumb mixture. Refrigerate until firm about 30 minutes. Cut into one inch squares (3 dozen candies) or shape into one inch balls and dip in mixture of chocolate chips and one tablespoon of shortening.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs two at a time; beat well after each. Add flour and sour cream alternately beginning and ending with flour. Add soda and extract last. Bake in greased and floured large tube pan for 1 1/4 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix syrup sugar salt butter and vanilla. Add eggs; pour into 9 inch unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 400 degrees until brown.

title: Corny Squares
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup in boiler; boil for 1 minute. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Stir without heat until smooth. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cornflakes and peanut butter mix in pan. Cut squares when cool.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Spray saucepan with nonstick cooking oil. Place onion over medium heat. Saute onion until clear. Add all ingredients except shrimp. Stir well. Add shrimp; cover and cook on very low heat for 35 minutes. Uncover and toss rice. Cover again and cook very slowly until rice is done. Yields 2 servings.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine bread and milk in a small bowl. Beat egg in large bowl; add oregano salt pepper and garlic. Add beef and cheese; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Cook 3 or 4 pieces of bacon until crisp. Crumble cool bread and crumble; add remaining ingredients. Toss lightly and moisten with Miracle Whip. Cheese is good in this. Mix all but bacon in with Miracle Whip then pour over bread and bacon. Toss. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook chicken debone and reserve broth. Cut chicken in approximately 1-inch pieces. Put in large pan the potatoes carrots onions peas and celery; cook until tender. Add 1 to 2 cups of broth and mix with cornstarch. Mix vegetables and 3 cups of cooked chicken. Pour broth etc. over all and put in large baking dish. With mixture hot and bubbling put biscuits on top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are done and browned.

title: Cornmeal Chicken Saute
instructions: Pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness. Place flour in plastic bag. Beat eggs in shallow bowl or pie plate. Combine cornmeal cumin salt and cayenne pepper in another pie plate. Place chicken 2 pieces at a time in bag with flour and shake to coat. Remove chicken and dip in egg. Roll in cornmeal mixture pressing to coat. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until brown and cooked through. Place on platter; top with sour cream and picante sauce.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Bring to boil the sugar orange juice lemon juice and juice from the can of cherries. Remove from heat and add jello. Dissolve jello and then add cherries and nuts.

title: Fresh And Frosty Lemonade
instructions: Combine lemon juice and sugar. Add water stirring. Serve over ice in glasses and garnish with lemon slices.

title: Layered Macaroni Shrimp Salad
instructions: In large salad bowl layer greens macaroni 1 1/2 cups cheese tomatoes shrimp peas and cabbage. Combine mayonnaise and Italian dressing. Pour over salad. Top with remaining cheese. Cover and refrigerate several hours.

title: Club Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the salad chicken tomatoes and bacon. Drizzle with dressing and toss to coat. Serve immediately. Yield 6 servings ready in 15 minutes or less.

title: Thanksgiving Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries fine. Add pineapple and sugar. Stir well. Let stand in refrigerator overnight (covered). Two hours before serving whip cream. Add nuts. Place in a serving bowl and chill.

title: Sausage Cornbread Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 10-inch skillet. Brown sausage and onion; drain well. Combine eggs cornmeal corn milk and oil. Pour half of mixture into skillet. Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese. Pour remaining batter over top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chew Bread
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Pour in light brown sugar. Mix together. Add eggs flour and flavoring. Add as many pecans as you like. Pour in a 9 x 13 pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. When middle of bread falls take out of oven. If you dont take out of oven when it falls it wont be as moist.

title: Hot Apple Cider
instructions: For a handy accent to the last coffee break of the day do this Make your coffee as you usually do but then add a quarter teaspoon of almond extract. Voila!

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine sweet potatoes sugar cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Add eggs; with a fork lightly beat eggs into sweet potato mixture. Add the evaporated milk; mix well. Place a pastry lined 9-inch pie plate on oven rack; pour in sweet potato mixture slowly. Cover edge of pie with foil. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Remove foil. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes more or until a knife inserted off-center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Cover and chill to store. Serves 8.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour 1 cup sugar and milk. Melt butter in a 2-quart baking dish. Pour batter over butter. Toss 2 cups of peaches with 1 cup sugar and pour over batter. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directions on box. After it cools cut each layer in half making 4 layers. Put sour cream in dish with lid. Add sugar and mix well. Cover with lid and chill for 3 hours. After 3 hours add thawed coconut to mixture and stir well. Spread on each layer of cake and place in sealed cake plate in refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Cook vegetables in broth and seasoning mix until tender. Remove from heat. Drop in cooked beef which you have removed all visible fat. Remove from heat and cover so meat will heat through.

title: Southern Gizzards
instructions: Heat oil in iron skillet on medium-high heat. Dip gizzards in whipped eggs and roll in flour or pancake mix. Put as many as you can get in the skillet. Turn every 5 minutes for about 20 minutes or dark brown.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put into greased casserole. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Kentucky Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat white syrup sugar salt butter and vanilla. Add eggs and pecans. Pour into unbake pie shell. Sprinkle pecans over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cream Sticks
instructions: Put yeast in warm water; scald milk then add your oleo in hot milk to melt. Put together when cool then add yeast well beaten eggs vanilla and sugar. Add flour. Put in warm place until double in bulk. Roll out and cut in pieces about 1/2 x 3 1/2-inches long. Let rise again. Fry in deep vegetable oil. Cut top of stick open and fill with filling. Ice with brown sugar frosting.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple in a Pyrex baking dish. Mix flour sugar pineapple juice (the 3 tablespoons) and margarine or butter. Pour over pineapple chunks. Top with cheese then cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Pie
instructions: Melt together chocolate chips evaporated milk and butter or margarine. Remove from heat and add flour salt sugar eggs (mixed well) and walnuts.

title: Winona'S Mocha Torte
instructions: Blend dry cake mix cinnamon and clove in large mixing bowl. Prepare cake according to package directions. Divide batter into three 8-inch glass baking dishes. One at a time microwave 4 minutes and 30 seconds to 5 minutes or until a wooden pick comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes then turn out immediately onto a cake rack.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water with 1 tablespoon sugar. Add shortening salt 1 tablespoon sugar and flour. Mix well. Pour out on floured board and knead a few times then cut out and place in a pan. Grease top and let rise in a warm place until double in size about 1/2 to 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Baked Chili Cheesy Dip
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Spoon into a 1-quart casserole dish. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Stir before serving. Serve hot with toasted bread slices or tortilla chips. Makes 4 cups.

title: Butterscotch-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add beaten eggs and hot water; mix well. Add flour and soda. Add vanilla and oats; mix well. Add chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: All-Season Salad
instructions: Combine cranberry sauce and lemon juice in bowl; mix well. Spoon in lightly oiled mold. Freeze until firm.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs; add rest of ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Martha Odom'S Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and Crisco. Add egg and beat well. Add vanilla with sifted flour to which soda and salt have been added. Pinch off pieces the size of walnuts and place one inch apart on cookie sheet; flatten with hand or glass which has been floured.

title: Polenta With Cheese
instructions: Bring water to boil add salt and sprinkle in cornmeal stirring constantly. Cook over low heat for 40 minutes. Polenta is cooked when it begins to leave the sides of the saucepan. Add cheese and cook stirring constantly for 5 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Wash peppers cut a thin slice from stem end and remove seeds. Cover with boiling salted water and simmer 5 minutes. Drain.

title: Pink Snowstorm
instructions: Combine punch milk and ice cream in an electric blender. Blend until smooth and frothy. Pour into tall glasses. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well. Pour into a greased baking dish. Sprinkle some crackers over top. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat in 3-quart saucepan; drain. Add sauce; simmer for 10 minutes. Cook lasagne according to package directions; drain. (Separate lasagne and lay out flat on wax paper or aluminum foil to keep pieces from sticking together as they cool.)

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Mix well and place heaping teaspoonful of mixture on cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Turn oven off and put in cookies for 2 hours or overnight. Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix chicken almonds pineapple and celery with enough Miracle Whip to make it hold together. Season to taste with salt pepper and Greek seasoning.

title: Tuna Ball
instructions: Mix with a fork all ingredients except parsley flakes. Roll into ball and roll in parsley flakes. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine corn sugar eggs milk pepper and 3/4 cup of cracker crumbs in casserole. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of crumbs on top and dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Kabobs
instructions: Remove stems from strawberries. Cut bananas pineapple apples cantaloupe and honeydew into chunks. Place fruits in a bowl. Add Fruit-Fresh and orange juice concentrate stirring gently. Let stand for 1 hour or longer. Arrange fruits and marshmallows on skewers. Sprinkle each kabob with a small amount of sugar.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Fry hamburger bacon and onion. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Javanese Pork Sate
instructions: Cut tenderloin(s) in half. Blend remaining ingredients together. Marinate pork in mixture for 10 minutes. Grill or broil for 10 to 12 minutes turning when needed. Serve with hot cooked rice if desired. Serves 4.

title: Oreo Spider Cookies
instructions: Scrape filling out of Oreo cookies. Cut red licorice into thin strips (to look like spider legs). Put frosting on an Oreo piece; drape red licorice over frosting so that the licorice hangs out both sides. (Use however many red strips you want for however many legs you want.) Put an Oreo piece on top to form cookie. Put little dots of frosting on top for eyes. Enjoy this fun treat!

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add seasoning mix and simmer 15 to 20 minutes; set aside.

title: Quick And Sassy Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground steak in large skillet. Add garlic and onion. When tender add all other seasonings. Continue to simmer for 1 minute; add tomato sauce spaghetti sauce and water. Stir until meat is completely mixed with sauce; simmer for 20 minutes. Stir to keep from sticking. Serve sauce over pasta with garlic bread. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hungarian Goulash
instructions: Cut beef cubes in pieces about one-inch square or smaller. Cut up onions medium fine. Fry onions in oil until brown. Add paprika and stir. Add water about 4 cups. Simmer until beef is nearly tender. Add potatoes (cubed pieces). Cook until potatoes are done. Eat as is or pour over noodles or rice.

title: Bar-B-Q Sauce
instructions: Pour water vinegar syrup and mustard into a large pan. Beat with a portable mixer until smooth. Add butter and bring to a boil stirring constantly until butter melts. Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes enough sauce for 5 - 3 1/2 to 4 lb. whole fryers split down the breast and cooked over a charcoal fire. Makes 1 gal. sauce.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown meat real well; add onions and brown. Add all ingredients except sugar and herbs. Cook for 1 1/2 hours; add herbs and cook another 1 1/2 hours. Add sugar at very end. Serve over spaghetti and sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Bacon And Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Combine chicken celery onion yogurt and pepper in small bowl. If desired place lettuce leaf on bottom of each bun; place pineapple ring on lettuce. Top each with one third of the chicken mixture and bacon. Makes 3 servings.

title: Barbecue Sparerib Sauce
instructions: Mix all sauce ingredients together and pour over ribs. Bake for 1 hour or until done.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Cook pudding with milk and stir until thick. Cover; cool to room temperature and whisk. Fold in Cool Whip Amaretto and brandy. Serve with any type of cut-up fresh fruit.

title: Cherry 'N Apple Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine pie filling apples and lemon juice. Pour into an 8 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch glass baking dish or a size larger. In medium bowl cut margarine into cake mix until crumbly. Add pecans and sprinkle evenly over pie filling. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with ice cream or plain anytime.

title: Sausage Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Crumble ground beef and sausage fry and drain well. Add spices and Worcestershire sauce. Melt cheese with meat over low heat. Serve on party rye. (Place on cookie sheets and freeze. Reheat 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.) Serves 24.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Combine. Stir with a spoon putting into 3 greased and floured pans. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Mix butter milk and pudding mix together. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute stirring continuously. Remove from heat and add confectioners sugar vanilla and nuts. Pour into a buttered pan. Chill before cutting.

title: Brownies
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Melt butter with cocoa. Put sugar eggs and vanilla into a large bowl; beat for 2 minutes. Add butter and cocoa mixture; then add flour mixture. Mix well.

title: Tangy Dill Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and cocoa. Add egg yolks and milk. Cook over medium heat until thick. Remove from heat and add margarine and vanilla. Pour into baked pie crust. Top with meringue and brown.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Spread popcorn out in a 17 x 12 x 2-inch baking pan; set aside. For caramel mixture in a heavy saucepan combine the brown sugar margarine corn syrup and the salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture starts to boil. Continue cooking for 5 minutes. Remove caramel mixture from heat; pour over popcorn. Toss quickly to coat. Bake the caramel-coated popcorn in a 300\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Stir popcorn. Return to oven; bake 5 to 10 minutes more or until well coated. Gently stir in the peanuts if desired. Turn caramel popcorn out onto foil. Cool; break up into 1-inch pieces. Store in the Tupperware cereal storer. Makes about 10 cups.

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well with a fork. Add shortening and mix with a fork until ingredients are crumbly. In a small bowl beat together with a fork the water vinegar and egg. Combine the two mixtures stirring with a fork until the ingredients are moistened. Divide the dough into 5 parts and with hands shape each portion into a flat round patty ready for rolling. Wrap each in plastic or waxed paper and chill at least 1/2 hour. Dough may be left in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or frozen until ready to use.

title: Holiday Ham Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Place about 2 inches apart in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown. Immediately remove from pan. Serve warm. Yields about 7 dozen appetizers.

title: Ginger Lemon Tea
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the water sugar ginger and lemon peel strips. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Remove ginger and lemon strips with a slotted spoon and discard. Place tea bags in a tea pot. Immediately add simmering water mixture. Cover and let stand 3 to 5 minutes. Remove tea bags and discard. Serve immediately in mugs. If desired garnish with lemon slices.

title: Cheese Rounds
instructions: Combine flour salt pepper and paprika; stir well. Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse meal. Add cheese; stir well. Roll dough to 1/3-inch thick on floured surface. Cut with a 1 3/4-inch biscuit cutter. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown ground beef and drain. Place browned meat in bottom of greased shallow 2-quart baking dish. Spread onion rings over top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Spread soup over onion rings. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Stir in milk. Add egg yolks and butter. Cook until thick. Pour into baked pie crust (add vanilla before you put in crust). Top with egg whites beaten until stiff.

title: Savory Turkey Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine contents of seasoning packet poultry seasoning and water; mix well. Add soup; blend well. Add potato slices turkey carrots celery and onion stirring until thoroughly combined. Spoon mixture into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Oyster Cracker Munchies
instructions: Mix and pour over crackers. Let sit several hours.

title: Cherry Torte
instructions: *Blueberry may be substituted for cherry.

title: Asparagus Spears With Garlic Mustard
instructions: In 10-inch skillet place asparagus spears; add enough water to cover. Bring to a full boil. Cook over medium heat until asparagus is crisply tender (5 to 7 minutes). Drain; return to skillet. Add remaining ingredients pushing asparagus to side just until butter is melted. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until heated through (5 to 7 minutes). Makes 4 servings.

title: Corn Flake Candy
instructions: Cook sugar and syrup until boils then remove from heat. Add peanut butter. Stir peanut butter in sugar and syrup. Pour mixture over corn flakes. Press corn flakes and mixture into a sugar pan. Let cool cut in squares and eat.

title: Deep Dish Brownies
instructions: Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Blend together butter sugar and vanilla. Ad eggs. Beat well with spoon. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture beating until well blended. Stir in chips. Spread into pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together. Spread it evenly over bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Velvety Homemade Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Cook 1/2 fresh pumpkin in oven. Remove seeds to use later in a snack. Cook until soft. Scoop out and mash. Mix sugar and seasonings with mashed pumpkin. Add eggs one at a time. Add evaporated milk. Place pumpkin pie mixture into unbaked homemade pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 and cook for 10 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for about another 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water; then add frozen strawberries and let thaw in Jell-O. Chill until partially set then fold in whipped cream. Tear half the cake into small chunks and spread in bottom of square pan 8 x 8-inch. Spread half the strawberry mixture over cake and repeat layer of cake crumbs ending with strawberry mixture. Chill at least 3 hours.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour with sugar soda and salt. Stir shortening to soften. Add flour mixture 1 cup milk and vanilla. Mix until flour is dampened. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer. Add eggs melted chocolate and remaining 1/3 cup milk. Beat 1 minute longer. Pour into two greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Coconut Bread Pudding
instructions: Line a well-buttered pan with white bread slices cut in quarters. Spread coconut on top of bread. Mix milk sugar eggs and vanilla with a spoon. Spoon enough to soak bread then layer bread and milk until done. Dot top with margarine. Sprinkle with sugar brown sugar cinnamon nuts raisins and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. This is a good way to use old biscuits rolls and bread.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
instructions: Sift flour 3 times before measuring. Add baking powder and salt and sift again. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add 1/3 flour and blend well. Add 1/2 milk and blend well. Add another 1/3 flour and blend then the other 1/2 milk and finally the last 1/3 flour and blend well. Pour 2/3 batter into 2 pans which have been lined with wax paper. To remaining 1/3 batter add 3/4 teaspoon each cinnamon and allspice 1/4 tsp. cloves and 1/4 pound of raisins chopped fine. Pour into cake pan which has been lined with wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken And Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breast until tender. Remove from pot. Remove skin and bones. Shred or dice chicken. Strain broth and put in a clean pot. Save 1 cup broth. Cook macaroni in broth until tender. Cook carrots and celery until tender. Cook cauliflower and broccoli together.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine flour salt baking powder and sugar. Add eggs milk and oil. Add cinnamon and blueberries. Pour into greased muffin pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix well. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Banana Ice Cream
instructions: This is for a 5-quart maker.

title: Grilled Lemon Dill Fish
instructions: Mix mayonnaise lemon juice dill and lemon peel. Place fish on greased grill over medium coals. Brush with 1/2 of the mayonnaise mixture. Grill 5 minutes turn. Brush with remaining mayonnaise mixture. Grill an additional 5 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Cool Whip Salad
instructions: Drain fruit and mix together.

title: Pam'S Stuffed Peppers(Serves 3)
instructions: Cut stem ends from peppers; remove seeds and cut peppers in half. Cook peppers in a small amount of water; cover. Cook in microwave oven on High power for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from microwave and water. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well. Stuff peppers with mixture. Place in baking dish. Pour tomato sauce over mixture in peppers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash and hull strawberries and pat dry. Place berries in medium size bowl. Add glaze and toss gently to coat. Arrange in baked pie shell. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled. Serve with whipped cream if desired.

title: Miracle Cake
instructions: Mix flour soda cocoa and sugar. Add Miracle Whip warm water and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour batter into greased and lightly floured 8-inch layer or 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Frost with icing when cool. Also makes 18 cupcakes. Buttercream frosting is very good on this cake or use your favorite icing also.

title: Pumpkin Bread
