instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add milk to beaten egg. Add egg mixture to dry ingredients. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or so.

title: Confetti Bites
instructions: Press crescent rolls into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking sheet to form crust. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Combine cream cheese mayonnaise basil and garlic powder. Spread thinly over cooled crust. Top with chopped vegetables. Cut into small squares.

title: Fajita Style Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine picante sauce cornstarch cumin and salt in small bowl; set aside. In large skillet or wok over high heat heat oil until hot but not smoking. Add meat. Cook until almost done. Add onion pepper and garlic. Stir-fry until vegetables are crisp tender. Stir picante sauce mixture to blend ingredients. Add at once to skillet. Cook and stir about 2 minutes until sauce thickens. Spoon 1/2 mixture into tortillas; top with cheese sour cream and salad trimmings. Add more salsa. Serves 4.

title: Pizza
instructions: Prepare hot roll mix as for pizza. Oil dough before filling. Brown meat. Heat together meat tomato paste tomato sauce 1/2 sharp cheese garlic hot pepper sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Place on dough. Add remaining half of cheese; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes(Quick And Easy Version)
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop dough about the size of a walnut onto ungreased cookie sheet. Press flat with the bottom of a glass that has been coated with sugar. (Dampen bottom of a glass so sugar will stick to it better. If you use a glass that has a design on the bottom your cookies will have a pretty design on them.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 11 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Fallbrooks Famous Bean Dip
instructions: Heat tamales in microwave 2 minutes. Stir. Add beans. Heat 2 more minutes. Stir. Add cheese and heat 2 more minutes. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice. Cover and simmer until water is gone. Add condensed milk regular milk and water. Cook 1 hour at low temperature. Add butter. Stir constantly. Taste with cinnamon or nutmeg. Keep stirring!

title: Spinach And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Blend flour seasoning and butter. Add milk. Stir until boiling. Add spinach. Add beaten yolks and cheese. Fold in egg whites beaten lightly. Turn into buttered dish. Sprinkle crumbs and bits of butter on top. Bake in pan of water in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve with or without cream sauce.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Dice and saute mushrooms onions and green peppers; set aside. Rub vegetable oil on both sides of bread dough and on the surface that you roll it out on. Roll it into an oblong shape. Spread sauteed ingredients evenly over the dough. Leave a 1/2-inch border around the dough. Layer meats and sprinkle generously with cheese. Roll up and place on cookie sheet. Let rise for about 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bread feels done.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Cut off tops of green peppers. Remove seeds. Pre-cook in boiling water salt added. Cook about 5 minutes. Drain. Sprinkle inside with salt. Brown meat and onion in hot fat. Add tomatoes rice Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper to taste. Cover and simmer until rice is almost tender. Add cheese. Stuff peppers. Stand upright in oblong baking dish. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until hot. For crisp pepper omit pre-cooking.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Form into walnut size balls and deep fry 4 minutes or until golden brown. Drain onto paper towels.

title: Cloverleaf Rolls
instructions: In large bowl combine sugar salt yeast and 2 cups flour. In 1-quart saucepan over low heat heat water milk and 3 tablespoons butter until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). With mixer on low speed gradually beat liquid into dry ingredients just until blended. Increase speed to medium; beat 2 minutes occasionally scraping sides. Beat in 1 cup flour to make a thick batter. Continue beating 2 minutes with a wooden spoon. Stir in 2 1/2 cups flour to make a soft dough. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic about 10 minutes. Work in about 1/2 cup of flour while kneading. Shape dough into a ball; place in greased large bowl then turn dough over so that the top is greased. Cover bowl with towel and let rise in warm place away from drafts about 1 hour until size is doubled.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve 1/2 cup of the juice. Dissolve lime gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in reserved pineapple juice and pineapple. Pour into a 6 cup mold or glass salad bowl. Chill until firm. When first layer is firm beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy. Fold in whipped topping. Spread evenly over first layer. Chill until firm. When second layer is firm dissolve strawberry gelatin in 1 1/3 cups boiling water. Add frozen fruit and stir until fruit thaws. Pour over second layer and chill until firm. Makes 12 servings.

title: No-Can Cucumbers
instructions: Slice cucumbers onion and peppers into a bowl. Add salt. Let stand for 3 hours or overnight. Rinse well. Make brine of vinegar and sugar; pour over pickles. Keep refrigerated. Store in any jar with rubber seal inside.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water 1 more cup water. Mix and let rise in double size then knead down and put in rolls. Let rise until double in size. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown. Brush with butter.

title: Sauteed Butternut Squash
instructions: In a heavy (preferably nonstick) skillet heat oil until sizzling. Add squash and garlic to coat well with oil. Saute slowly over low heat stirring frequently for about 30 minutes until squash is golden and tender. (Add a tablespoon or two of water to pan if squash begins to stick.) Add salt and pepper to taste then sprinkle sage and parsley over squash and mix to combine well. Serves 4.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Blend together sugar cornstarch and water. Cook over medium-high heat stirring occasionally. Add Jell-O and stir to dissolve. Cool mixture. Add strawberries and pour into baked pie crust. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving. Top with whipped cream before serving.

title: Potato Donuts
instructions: Work butter into potatoes. Add eggs and sugar and mix well. Add dry ingredients. Let rise about 10 minutes. Deep fry and roll in sugar.

title: Icebox Butterhorns
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in lukewarm water. After 5 minutes add salt eggs milk oil and 2 cups flour; beat thoroughly. Stir in remainder of flour. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk. Refrigerate overnight (can be used before if necessary). Remove from refrigerator; divide dough in half. Roll out in a circle; spread with melted butter and cut into 12 pie-shaped wedges. Start at large end and roll up. Place on greased baking sheet. Let rise about 3 hours or until doubled in bulk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes. Yield 24 rolls.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken With Pea Pods
instructions: Marinate skinned boned chicken breasts in egg white 1 1/2 teaspoons of cornstarch and wine for 20 minutes at room temperature or overnight in fridge.

title: Chicken-Cheese Lasagne
instructions: Melt margarine over low heat in 2-quart saucepan. Add garlic. Stir in flour and salt. Cook stirring constantly until bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in milk and broth. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in Mozzarella 1/2 cup Parmesan onion and spices. Cook and stir just until cheese melts. Spread 1/4 of the cheese sauce (about 1 1/2 cups) in ungreased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with 3 or 4 noodles overlapping if necessary. Spread 1/2 the cottage cheese over the noodles. Repeat with 1/4 of the sauce 3 to 4 noodles and remaining cottage cheese. Top with chicken spinach 1/4 sauce 3 to 4 noodles and remaining sauce. Sprinkle rest of Parmesan over all. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Viva Chicken Tortilla
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together. Bake in a casserole for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cut into finger size pieces. Can be served warm or cold.

title: Slovenian Cabbage And Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles in water; drain thoroughly and set aside. In large skillet melt 1/2 cup butter; add onions and cook until tender. Add cabbage; cook until tender and light golden brown. Add additional butter if onions and cabbage stick to skillet. Add ham and mix thoroughly. Stir in noodles and heat through. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Makes 6 servings.

title: Filled Drop Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Dissolve soda in warm water and add to creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Stir in flour and salt. Drop by dessert spoon on greased cookie sheet. Make a dent in the center of cookie and put in one teaspoon of filling. Top with small amount of dough. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Oklahoma Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and add onion and pepper. Cook until onion is clear. Stir in cumin and paprika. Cook 5 more minutes. In large pot combine rest of ingredients except brown sugar. Add beef mixture. Bring to boil; turn down to simmer 1 hour stirring occasionally. Add brown sugar and simmer 10 more minutes.

title: Cucumber Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Smokin Barbecue Riblers
instructions: Finely chop garlic and yellow onion together. Add all ingredients to the largest crock-pot available. Stir often. Cook on low for approximately 5 to 6 hours. Add crushed red pepper to ribs and sauce before serving. Your final product will be the most tender sweet and spicy treat for your summer activities guaranteed!!!

title: Oven Baked Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle rice in lightly buttered shallow pan (baking). Lay chicken pieces skin side up over rice. Spread soup evenly over all. Cover. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until tender. May remove cover after 1/2 hour for crispy chicken. Yields 4 to 5 servings.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine above ingredients and heat. Pour hot dressing over salad.

title: Weight Watchers Taco Soup
instructions: Mix ingredients. Cook until flavors blend. Serve with grated cheese! One cup equals 3 Weight Watchers points.

title: Herbed Sliced Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if skin is tough otherwise scrub and rinse them. Cut into thin slices most of the way through. Use a handle of a wooden spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way. Put potatoes in a baking dish and fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs.

title: Texas Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Place celery onion green pepper and hamburg in fry pan. Brown lightly. Drain off excess grease. Add seasonings; mix together. Add 2 quarts water. Bring to a low boil. Simmer 2 hours.

title: Sweet And Spice Pork Loin Roast
instructions: In a small bowl combine taco spices and seasonings orange marmalade and garlic powder. Blend well. Score pork roast with a sharp knife. Place pork roast in a large resealable plastic bag and cover with marmalade mixture. Marinate in refrigerator for 45 minutes. Remove pork; wrap in foil and place in a baking dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Open and fold back foil; bake 30 minutes longer or until roast is glazed. Cool 10 minutes before slicing. Slice pork thinly and serve drippings that remain in foil as a flavorful gravy.

title: Muffins That Taste Like Donuts
instructions: In a bowl combine flour baking powder salt nutmeg and cinnamon.

title: Oven Stew
instructions: Mix all together and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar until light and smooth. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Sift flour before measuring. Add flour 1 cup at a time alternately with juice. Mix in flavoring. Mix well. Bake\tin 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and floured for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: 15 Minute Pickles
instructions: Put spices in sack. Bring vinegar to a boil. Add cucumbers and onion. Boil 5 minutes and seal.

title: Chicken With Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Brown chicken in skillet with oil. Mix soup milk and mushrooms together. Pour over chicken. Cover and simmer until done.

title: Mom Leeper'S Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Savory Kraut
instructions: Saute onion in butter until golden; add other ingredients. Cover and simmer gently until most of liquid is gone. This is excellent with Hillshire Farm Polish sausage wieners or to use in Reuben sandwiches.

title: Peanut Butter Chewies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; stir then finish mixing by hand. Pat into wax paper-lined greased 8 x 8-inch pan or roll into a rope. Refrigerate. Slice and enjoy.

title: Flour Tortillas
instructions: Mix flour and shortening by hand. Then add water. Knead dough. Then pinch off size of biscuit and roll. Place on hot griddle that has been greased with shortening.

title: Popcorn Party Mix
instructions: In small saucepan combine margarine paprika Parmesan cheese and salt. In large bowl combine popped corn peanuts and raisins. Add margarine mixture. Toss to coat well. Serves 8.

title: Champagne Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch pan approximately 15 minutes. Cool. Spread drained pineapple over cake. Mix pudding milk and cream cheese together with mixer. Put on cake. Spread with Cool Whip and chopped nuts or maraschino cherries cut up on top.

title: Pistachio
instructions: Mix together in bowl cocktail pudding and pineapple. Chill 5 minutes in refrigerator. Add marshmallows and Cool Whip. Then add nuts.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring butter sugar milk and cocoa to a boil for only 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter; stir until this melts. Add oatmeal; stir. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Allow to cool.

title: Health Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Combine next 6 ingredients and cool to lukewarm. Add softened yeast and molasses. Stir in whole wheat flour; beat well. Gradually add enough flour to make a soft dough. Turn out on lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth. Place in a greased bowl and turn once. Cover with damp cloth. Let rise in warm spot until double in bulk 1 or more hours. Punch down. Let rest for 10 minutes. Shape into 2 loaves in greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch bread pans. Let rise until double approximately 45 minutes. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Great toasted.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Special Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Refrigerate for one hour. Then serve.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar together until smooth. Add peanut butter and milk beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping and fill graham cracker crust. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

title: Fruit Flavored Cream Pie
instructions: Make jello according to package. Measure out 2/3 cup into small bowl. Add 2/3 cup powdered skim milk. Stir. Set bowl in pan of ice water and whip until like whipped cream. Spoon into pie tin. You may add a compatible fruit. Do not refrigerate. Eat any time. This equals 1 jello and all the milk for day.

title: Salad Verte With Raspberries
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl and stir with wire whisk. Set aside. Combine salad greens in large bowl add vinegar mix and toss well. Add raspberries toss lightly.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cut up stalks of cauliflower and broccoli into little pieces and leave \flowers\ intact. Steam in 2 cups of water the cauliflower broccoli and carrots. When vegetables are tender drain them saving the liquid. Set vegetables aside. Add bouillon cubes to the hot liquid. In a kettle melt the margarine and butter. Add celery and onions; saute until clear. Using a wire whip add flour and milk a little at a time. Dont scorch. Add bouillon broth to cream mixture. Add vegetables salt pepper and Accent.

title: Spinach In Rye Rounds
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread until smooth. Scoop out center of rye bread forming a bowl. Put dip in center of bread and serve with bread cubes and crackers.

title: Strawberry Sorbet(Make Ahead)
instructions: Twirl lightly into strawberry mixture and re-freeze. Serve over watermelon chunks in champagne glasses. Garnish with fresh mint. Delicious light dessert.

title: Indian Fry Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar and salt. Allow to stand 5 minutes covered with towel. Add flour and oil; stir flour into liquid mixture. Turn out on floured board and knead until doughs texture is smooth. Put dough into greased bowl cover and let rise for 1 1/2 hours or until doubled in bulk. When doubled punch down and knead a few moments in 1/2 c. cornmeal. Separate into two balls. Work with one ball at a time. Cover resting ball with towel. Roll dough into 12 inch diameter circle 1/2 inch thick. Cut into 2 inch squares. Let pieces of dough rest while oil heats in iron skillet to boiling point. Fry 5 to 6 pieces at a time until golden brown just a few moments. If there are leftovers warm for breakfast and shake in confectioners sugar.

title: Old-Fashioned Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and milk together; cut margarine into mixture. Add flavoring. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Boil onions for 2 minutes drain place in bottom of casserole dish. Mix soup and water and margarine. Pour over onions. Top with crushed corn flakes and dot with margarine. Cook until bubbles at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In medium bowl beat egg yolks stir in sweetened condensed milk and ReaLemon. Turn into prepared shell. In small bowl beat egg whites with cream of tatar until soft peaks form gradually add sugar beating until stiff but not dry. Spread meringue on top of pie sealing carefully to edge of shell. Bake 15 minutes or until meringue is golden brown. Chill before serving.

title: Savory Meat Loaf And Vegetables
instructions: In large bowl mix 1/2 cup soup beef bread crumbs onion egg Worcestershire and pepper. In 3-quart oblong baking dish shape meat mixture into 8 x 4-inch loaf. Arrange potatoes and carrots around meat loaf. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Spoon off fat.

title: Potato Cheese Bake
instructions: Bake potatoes. Cube with skins on. Cook bacon halfway then combine with potatoes and continue cooking. Add cheese and mayonnaise; mix together. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan for about 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Dump-It Cake
instructions: Pour all of the ingredients into a casserole baking dish as they are listed by layers. Example First the pineapple then the cherries then the cake mix and so on until the walnuts top it all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Almond Joy Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch pan according to package directions.

title: Strawberry-Lemon Square
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs1/4 cup sugar and butter until blended press into bottom of 13x9-inch baking pan. Beat cream cheese1/4 cup sugar and 1/4 cup milk until blended spread over crust. Pour 2 3/4 cup milk into large bowl add pudding mixes blend well. Pour over cream cheese layer let stand 5 minutes or until thickened. Cover with whipped topping and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

title: Buns
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let rise till double in size work it down let rise again. Form balls and let double in size again. Bake 350\u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.

title: Savory Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage in a large skillet stirring until crumbly. Pour off drippings. Add onion flakes tomato paste and 2 tomato paste cans of water mixing well. Add seasonings and spices. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix walnuts and butter in a 9-inch pie plate until well blended. Press onto bottom and sides of plate. Refrigerate. Microwave chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the milk in a large microwavable bowl on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until chocolate is almost melted stirring halfway through. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Beat in cream cheese sugar and remaining milk until well blended. Refrigerate about 10 minutes to cool. Gently stir in whipped topping until smooth. Spoon into crust. Freeze 4 hours or until firm. Let stand at room temperature about 30 minutes until pie can be easily cut. Store leftover pie in freezer. Makes 8 servings.

title: Prune Cake With Buttermilk Sauce
instructions: Cake Sift dry ingredients. In a large bowl beat eggs oil buttermilk and vanilla. Add dry ingredients; stir in prunes. Pour in greased and floured tube pan and bake 50 to 55 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Super Baked Beans
instructions: Mix hamburger pan sausage and bell pepper. Cook until meat is brown. Drain. Pour cooked meat beans barbecue sauce and smoked sausage into a glass baking dish. Do not use cast-iron cookware. Cover with lid or aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dressing Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mix together and let set 2 hours. Use on cabbage salad. Let set for flavor.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: In blender combine dry milk and sugar. Pour in melted butter and with blender running add boiling water. Blend scraping sides of blender until mixture is smooth and thick. Store in covered container in refrigerator until used. Makes 14 ounces or equivalent of 1 can.

title: Apple Cranberry Crunch
instructions: Combine brown sugar 1/4 cup sugar 1/3 cup flour and cinnamon with apples and fresh cranberries. Put in an ungreased dish. Combine and crumble on top 1 1/2 sticks margarine 2/3 cup sugar 1 1/2 cups flour walnuts and enough oatmeal to crumble. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until apples are tender and top is browned. Use a 7 1/2 x 11-inch dish. Good served warm with ice cream.

title: Herbed Spinach Bake
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Mix with other ingredients. Pour mixture into a 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Easy Chicken
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Place chicken in pan; cover with soup. Top with stuffing made according to directions (mix in bowl; add a little extra water). Cook covered with foil at least 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Will not dry out if you need to leave in oven longer.

title: Jello Gelatin
instructions: Mix jello and let firm. Drain pineapple but save juice. After jello firms add bananas marshmallows and pineapple.

title: Southern Fried Deer Steak
instructions: Marinate deer steaks overnight in Worcestershire sauce Italian dressing and red wine vinegar. Cut steaks into small pieces (about the size of a glass top). Flour well. Melt grease in large cooking pan on top of stove. Add meat smother meat with onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover. Turn over when golden brown. Cook on low heat or meat will get tough. Add water when both sides are brown. Simmer about 10 more minutes. Takes approximately 30 minutes entire cooking time.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: In a large roasting pan in 425\u00b0 oven melt the margarine. Meanwhile in pie plate combine flour salt paprika and pepper. Coat the chicken quarters evenly with the mixture. In roasting pan place the chicken pieces skin side down in melted butter. Bake 30 minutes. Turn the chicken pieces and bake 15 minutes more until pieces are fork-tender.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Pie
instructions: Mix well together until crumbly and uniform in size; set aside.

title: Blackberry Jam
instructions: Wash berries and place in kettle with sugar. Boil rapidly stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat and skim the top. Stir and skim alternately for 5 minutes. Pour into hot jars and use hot lids. Hot water bath for 5 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 half pint jars.

title: Clauda'S Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a greased Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix together flour margarine and pecans. Put in a greased 9 x 13 pan and press it in pan to make crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes and let cool. Mix together Cool Whip sugar and cream cheese and layer it on crust. Top with the pie filling and chill for 6 hours.

title: Kal-Bi
instructions: Combine toasted sesame seed with oil shoyu sauce green onions garlic ginger sugar and ajinomoto. Mix well then marinate meat overnight in refrigerator. Broil over charcoal.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix and pat into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Blend and pour over the crust. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Passion
instructions: Pour sweetened condensed milk and soda pop into drum of ice cream maker and follow freezer operating instructions.

title: Pineapple-Orange Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Makes 4 servings. 4 points per serving.

title: Big Mama'S Un-Baked Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt marshmallows and milk over low heat. Mix crackers (rolled fine) in marshmallows and milk. Add all other ingredients. Put in loaf pan lined with wax paper and press firmly. Put nuts and fruit on top. Cover tightly and let set for a month.

title: Russian Tea Cakes(Christmas Balls)
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar. Add salt and flour (mixed). Use hands; work well. Blend in vanilla and nuts. Chill 1 hour. Form into balls (1-inch). Place 2 1/2 inches apart. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. (They do not brown or spread.) Roll in confectioners sugar. Cool; roll again. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix salt and water and pour over cucumber and onion; let stand 2 hours. Drain (dont rinse). Mix sugar and white vinegar. Stir until all the sugar is dissolved. Pour over cucumber and onion. Pack in containers and put in freezer.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash. Add sugar and butter. Pour in 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs. Melt cheese in white sauce. Pour over bread crumbs; dot with butter. Put in moderate oven until bubbly.

title: Louisiana Dirty Rice
instructions: Cook rice separate. Cook all other ingredients together. Mix with rice and green onions. Salt and pepper as desired. Serve very hot.

title: Bread Basket Dip
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients (except bread). Put into hollowed out loaf of bread. (When you hollow out the bread save the top of bread so that you can put it back on top of the filled loaf.) Wrap entire loaf of bread in aluminum foil and bake for 2 full hours at 300\u00b0. Serve with bread cubes crackers or raw veggies. This is worth the effort.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine and cook sugar milk margarine and salt. When it starts cooking cook for 5 minutes. Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Beat until glaze is gone. Pour onto a plate and let chill until you can cut it.

title: Butter Riches
instructions: Cream the butter. Gradually add brown sugar and white sugar. Cream well. Add egg yolk and vanilla. Beat well. Blend in flour to form a stiff dough. Shape into small balls. Put on greased cookie sheets. Flatten to size of a 50 cent piece with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes until golden brown. Cool and frost with Browned Butter Frosting.

title: Chocolate Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together very well. Chill 2 hours. Crush 3 graham crackers. Shape mixture into ball and roll in cracker crumbs.

title: Turkey With Cornbread Dressing
instructions: In a skillet saute celery and onion in butter until tender. Place in large bowl with cornbread crumbs sage and poultry seasoning. Combine eggs chicken broth and cornbread mixture stirring gently to mix.

title: Salmon Spread
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together except for the pecans or parsley. Shape and chill. Remove from the refrigerator and roll in pecans or parsley. Serve as desired.

title: Van Der Height'S
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup margarine and mix with crushed chocolate wafer. Consistency should be slightly tacky and moist. Press into pan. Can use pie pan cake pan or cupcake sized pan. Try to form a pie crust with the sides higher than the middle. Put in freezer to cool.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add sauce. Spread mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add sausage mushrooms green peppers and pepperoni. Top with Mozzarella cheese. In a bowl mix eggs milk cooking oil flour and salt. Beat well and pour evenly over cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix corn meal flour baking powder sugar and salt. Beat eggs; add milk and stir into corn meal mixture. Heat fat in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven until hot. Tilt pan to coat with fat then pour off and stir excess fat into batter. Pour batter into pan and bake for 25 minutes or until bread pulls away from sides of pan. Cut into squares and serve hot with butter. Makes 9 servings.

title: Death By Chocolate 2
instructions: Preheat oven according to brownie package directions. Bake brownies according to directions; let cool.

title: Healthy Vegetable Stew
instructions: Arrange onion potatoes kidney beans uncooked rice and celery in layers in order listed in a covered casserole sprayed with Pam. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix spices and tomato sauce well and pour over stew layers in casserole. Cover and simmer 1 1/4 hours or until potatoes are tender. Do not stir; but check occasionally to be sure it does not boil dry. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix the ingredients and pour into a casserole dish. Cover with a thin layer of crushed cornflakes; drizzle with butter or margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Brie
instructions: In a glass pie plate melt butter and saute nuts; add the brown sugar. Do this in a microwave. It should only take a minute or so. All microwaves are different so use your own judgment. Then place the wheel or wedge of Brie in the plate and return to the microwave just until the cheese melts. Serve with Wheat Thins. Delicious!

title: Chocolate Kahlua Mousse
instructions: Blend chips in blender until they are chopped fine. Add water for 10 seconds in blender. Add egg yolks Kahlua sugar and vanilla. Beat egg whites stiff then fold into mix. Chill 3 hours.

title: Warm Mexican Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a crock-pot until warm. Serve with chips.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In a saucepan mix the milk butter cocoa and sugar. Bring to a boil for 1 minute. (If you boil longer than 1 minute the cookies will be too hard.) Add the vanilla oats and peanut butter. Spoon drop onto waxed paper or leave in a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish and slice when cool.

title: Broccoli Chicken Soup
instructions: Mix together chicken broth chopped broccoli chopped celery chopped onion and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer together until vegetables are tender about 15 minutes. Then add rice Cheddar cheese soup and chicken meat. Fold in milk and Velveeta cheese. Simmer together on low heat about 30 minutes. Stir often.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread(Nutritional)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the corn bread mix. Add corn bread mix last and pour into greased pan or casserole; bake. Can be reheated.

title: Potato Topped Meat Loaf
instructions: Measure 1/4 cup gravy from jar and combine with beef and next 5 ingredients. Form into a loaf (8 x 14 x 1 1/2-inch) in shallow baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven and carefully drain fat.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes; boil in salt water until tender then drain. Blend potatoes margarine sugar eggs and milk; process until smooth. Add vanilla. Divide filling between the unbaked pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients 3 sticks margarine 1/3 cup cocoa and 1 teaspoon vanilla in large bowl mixing well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Spread marshmallow cream over hot cake; cool.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spread cookie dough on round pizza pan. Cook and cool as package directs. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Spread mix on cooled cookie dough. Decorate with mixture of fresh fruit. Slice like pizza and enjoy.

title: Lentil Loaf
instructions: Boil lentils until well done. Mix with other ingredients and bake in a shallow baking dish about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Aunt Irma'S Unbaked Cookies
instructions: In saucepan melt first 4 ingredients. Let come to boil remove from heat. Stir in oats nuts and vanilla. Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper. Cool.

title: Western Mac-N-Cheese
instructions: Prepare mac-n-cheese dinner as directed on box. Brown beef celery green pepper and onion; cook until tender. Stir in tomato paste corn water salt and pepper. Mix well. Add the mac-n-cheese dinner and mix again. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Pudding
instructions: Take the boiling water and stir in oats. Let stand for 20 minutes. Mix in the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in long pan.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Mix ingredients in a blender for 7 minutes on medium. Bake in an 8 x 8-inch pan at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Crispy Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine cornflakes salt pepper and cheese; set aside. Wash and pat dry chicken pieces. Combine beaten egg and milk. Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and roll in cornflakes mixture. Place in well-greased baking dish (can use Pam spray) skin side up. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Do not cover or turn chicken while baking.

title: Tea Cakes(Sugar Cookies)
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Stir together dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. If dough is sticky add flour to handle. Cut out with cookie cutters. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. These are called sugar cookies now but used to be called \Tea Cakes.\

title: English Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0 (150\u00b0C). Beat all the ingredients together. Then before putting it in the oven you can put some raisins and walnuts on the face (top). Bake for 45 minutes. After baking spread some icing sugar (powdered sugar) on top of the cake.

title: Quick Microwave Broccoli
instructions: Put broccoli and water into small microwave dish; sprinkle on salt and add margarine. Microwave on High for 4 1/2 minutes; turn dish 1/4 turn and microwave for additional 3 1/2 minutes. This serves two depending on size of broccoli used. Increase time and water for more servings. You can establish this based on experimenting if you undercook slightly then add more time to achieve your desired degree of doneness. This procedure cooks the vegetables to a good consistency and color without its becoming soggy.

title: Best Bean Dip Ever
instructions: Mix beans cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning. Put into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix cheeses together and sprinkle on top of bean mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese bubbles.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Set aside 2/3 cup of cake mix. Combine remaining cake mix butter and 1 egg. Mix with fork until crumbly. Press mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Green Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add pineapple juice and sugar. Stir in ginger ale. Freeze until icy. Stir occasionally to keep mushy. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Do not peel zucchini. Scrape out seeds. Grind zucchini and onions; add salt and leave overnight. Refrigerate. Rinse and drain. Add vinegar dry mustard turmeric cornstarch celery seed pepper and sugar. Mix ingredients well. Cook until clear about 30 minutes over medium heat stirring to keep from sticking. Put in jars and seal. Makes about 6 pints.

title: Spicy Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine all ingredients. Place in a large baking dish. Shape into a loaf. Bake 1 hour or until done. Makes 8 servings.

title: Potato Dumplings
instructions: Combine all ingredients; roll into balls. Drop into boiling salted water. Boil 3 minutes after dumplings come to surface of boiling water.

title: *Asparagus Vinaigrette
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; stir in oil and vinegar. Blend well. Add mustard chives relish and eggs. Chill and serve over asparagus on lettuce.

title: Chicken With Colorful Rice
instructions: In plastic bag mix together flour salt and spices. Add chicken shaking to coat. In large frying pan heat oil and margarine. Add chicken and cook turning for about 20 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. Combine broth and wine; add to frying pan. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until fork-tender. Remove chicken; keep warm. Pour off fat; return 1 tablespoon fat to pan. Stir hot rice into mushrooms and drippings. Add tomatoes and spinach to rice mixture; carefully toss until warm throughout (3 minutes). Transfer rice to platter and arrange chicken on rice.

title: Pizza Bread
instructions: Grate cheese and onion. Chop pepper very fine. Add all ingredients together. Spread on rounds of French bread. Broil until cheese melts. Serve with chips and dill pickle.

title: Crispy Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Baking Temperature 375\u00b0. Baking Time 1 hour.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Pour oil into skillet and heat. Cut okra into thin round slices. Crack an egg and mix into okra slices well. Sprinkle flour over okra and egg until well coated. Add to hot oil and fry until lightly browned. Drain on paper towels and salt to taste.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 9 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with additional bread crumbs. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Party Pin Wheels
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Sprinkle fixings on top. Roll up jelly roll style wrap tightly. Chill 2 hours or over night. Cut off ends slice accordingly 3/4 inch slices.

title: Hermits
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add syrup soda (dissolved in water) and eggs. Stir in sifted flour cloves allspice cinnamon raisins nuts and salt. Drop in small pieces (top) on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake slowly at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Place noodles in 2-quart baking dish cover with water and sprinkle with salt. Cook uncovered 15 minutes. Remove and let noodles stand in water while preparing meat sauce.

title: Quick Cinnamon Nut Coffee Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in small pan over low heat. Measure and mix sugar and cinnamon in small bowl. Remove margarine from heat. Dip biscuits one at a time in margarine. Then roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture. Place in tube pan overlapping biscuits in a circle. Sprinkle with nuts and remaining sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine chicken soup mayonnaise water chestnuts and any desired vegetables. Place in baking dish. Mix cornmeal Bisquick and milk; pour over chicken. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add cheese to top; cook 10 more minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef with green pepper and onions in shortening. Add mushroom soup tomato soup and soup can of water also garlic clove. Heat. Blend in 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese. Add spaghetti. Pour into 3-quart casserole dish. Top with 1/2 cup sharp cheese. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Fry bacon; crumble and set aside. In a glass bowl (large) layer first the lettuce (torn into bite-size pieces) then the celery green pepper uncooked peas and onion. Mix together mayonnaise oil sugar and Parmesan cheese. Gently spread over layered ingredients. Sprinkle Parmesan and Cheddar cheese. Also crumble bacon. Garnish with croutons.

title: American Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and drain; add garlic in hot oil. Add tomato paste tomatoes seasonings. Cover and simmer 20 min. heat oven to 350\u00b0. In 13x9 baking dish alternate layers of cooked noodles swiss cheese cottage cheese and meat sauce. Bake 20 to 30 min. Serve with grated parmesan cheese. 6 to 8 servings.

title: Scrumpdiliicious Ice Cream
instructions: Smash cookies and spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer nuts over cookies. Spread softened ice cream over cookies and nuts. Spread softened Cool Whip over ice cream. Dribble chocolate syrup over Cool Whip. Cover with aluminum foil and put in freezer until frozen hard. Eat and enjoy while your mouth salivates. This is one of those things you cannot put down with just one serving.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir together 1 slightly beaten egg pumpkin 1/3 cup sugar and pumpkin pie spice. Spread over bottom of pie shell. Combine 2 beaten eggs corn syrup 1/2 cup sugar butter and vanilla. Mix well and stir in pecans. Spoon over pumpkin mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until filling is set.

title: Sausage And Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Brush mushrooms with dressing and place on broiler pan for 5 minutes. Press sausage evenly into mushroom caps using about 1/2 teaspoon sausage in each cap. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Broil an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve hot. Makes 12 servings.

title: W-R Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Combine egg vinegar and water with a fork. Sprinkle over dry mixture and mix with a fork. Let stand 10 minutes. Roll out this recipe. Makes 2 (2-crust) pies.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Do not add liquid or oil to cake mix. Mix with spoon; put in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool; prepare frosting.

title: Quickie Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in 12-inch skillet. Drain. Add tomatoes tomato sauce 1 teaspoon salt and chili powder. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti. Add 1 teaspoon salt until tender. Drain. Place spaghetti in long casserole dish. Pour meat mixture over spaghetti. Cover with cheese.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook chicken; drain fat from broth. Remove chicken from bones. Cut meat into smaller pieces. In a large pot heat broth almost to boiling point. Drop in layer of thinly sliced raw potatoes then a layer of dough then a layer of chicken. Continue layers until used ending with dough. Add boiling water to broth if necessary to cover ingredients. Cook uncovered until dough is cooked.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and cream of chicken soup. Pour over other ingredients and combine well. Pour into greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes. Serve with toast or biscuits.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Combine butter brown sugar corn syrup and cream of tartar in saucepan. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in soda. Pour over popcorn and mix well. Put on cookie sheet and bake at 250\u00b0 for one hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Cool on wax paper.

title: Eggplant With Two Cheeses
instructions: Mix flour and garlic salt. Coat eggplant. Cook in oil over medium heat turning once until golden brown. Pour 1/2 of tomato sauce into ungreased oblong 13 1/2 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Add eggplant. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Add remaining tomato sauce. Sprinkle with oregano and Mozzarella cheese. Cook uncovered in 325\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbly about 25 minutes.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt butter. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top evenly with remaining ingredients; press down gently. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool thoroughly before cutting. Store loosely covered at room temperature. Makes 24 bars.

title: Beans Beverly
instructions: In a large saucepot or Dutch oven saute ground beef bacon onion and garlic. Add ketchup dry mustard all beans vinegar salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Pour mixture into a large beanpot or other type of casserole dish. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour or until thickened. Serves 10.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Simmer sauce about 2 hours after adding to drained hamburger.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: *Usually only one of each of the larger fruits is needed and the amount of the smaller fruits will vary.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Put sugar eggs and lard in bowl and beat together. Add cocoa and water; beat again. Add flour and soda and stir well. Add sour cream and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: No-Peek Chicken
instructions: Combine rice and soups. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Place cut-up chicken slices on top. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken. Seal with foil. Bake for 2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Garden Beef And Macaroni
instructions: In saucepan brown beef and cook onion until tender. Stir to separate meat; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 20 minutes or until done. Stir often. Makes 3 1/2 cups.

title: Carrot Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage and carrots. Finely chop onion and celery. Mix together in a large bowl. In a separate bowl mix remaining ingredients. Pour over shredded vegetables and refrigerate. Yields 10 servings. Serving Size 1/2 cup. Exchanges 1 vegetable.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan. Line bottom of pan with crackers. Mix pudding with milk; beat 2 minutes. Stir in Cool Whip. Put 1/2 mixture over crackers. Layer crackers and rest of pudding. Final layer of crackers. Chill in refrigerator while making frosting.

title: Vegie Pie
instructions: Spread out crescent rolls on large cookie sheet. Push dough up sides of pan slightly. Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 375\u00b0 until golden brown. Cool. Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and spices. Spread over rolls. Top with vegetables then sprouts. If made in advance add tomatoes just before serving.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain well. Add soups sauce chilies and taco seasoning. Simmer. Place tortillas in bottom of large casserole dish. Add meat mixture and a small amount of grated cheese. Add another layer of tortillas and meat mixture. Cook in microwave 10 minutes. Add the rest of the cheese and microwave until the cheese is melted.

title: Cookie Salad
instructions: Blend pudding and buttermilk together. Drain oranges and pineapple and add. Add Cool Whip and stir together. Crush 1/2 package of cookies and mix in. Save a few cookies for topping. Refrigerate.

title: Shrimp And Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute shrimp onion and parsley in butter until tender. Make instant potatoes according to directions on box. Mix all together; put in a casserole dish and top with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees until cheese melts.

title: Hot Asparagus Canapes
instructions: Trim crust from bread and flatten with rolling pin slightly. Blend cheeses and egg to workable consistency then spread on bread. Place an asparagus spear on each slice and roll each securing each with a toothpick. Dip in melted butter so as to coat thoroughly. Place on a cookie sheet and freeze. Remove and slice into 3 equal sections. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Coca Cola Cake
instructions: Place 1 stick butter oil 3 Tbsp. cocoa 1 c. Coke and 1 1/2 c. marshmallows in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Set aside to cool.

title: Chicken Veggie Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons salad dressing in large skillet. Add chicken and garlic powder. Add veggies. Stir-fry until chicken is cooked. Reduce heat; stir in remaining dressing and soy sauce. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Broccoli Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Prepare stuffing mix as directed on box. Layer as follows broccoli 1 can soup stuffing mix remaining can of soup. Top with cheddar cheese. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Combine flour sugar and 3 tablespoons of pineapple juice. Mix in pineapple and add cheese. Melt butter and pour over mixture. Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cherry Dream Whip Dessert
instructions: Crumble mixture. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool until it can be handled with fingers. Re-crumble and put back in pan; pat in hard.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Set temperature control of electric skillet at 325\u00b0. Fry bacon until crisp and remove from frypan. Dip off all but 1 tablespoon bacon grease. Reduce heat. Simmer. Combine potatoes with onion green pepper sugar salt pepper vinegar and water. Place in frypan. Cover and heat thoroughly. Sprinkle crumbled bacon and parsley over potatoes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan; remove from heat. Sprinkle brown sugar on bottom of pan. Arrange drained pineapple slices over sugar. Garnish with maraschino cherries and chopped nuts.

title: Meat-Za Pie
instructions: Mix beef garlic salt and milk in an 8-inch or 9-inch pie plate. Shape into a crust with a fork. Put ketchup into the center area of meat crust. Layer mushrooms or 1/4 cup chopped green pepper if you prefer on the ketchup. Break cheese into strips and crisscross over the mushrooms. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and oregano. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Serve with a salad and a green vegetable.\tQuick and delicious supper!!

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Soften gelatin with 2 tablespoons of cold water. Dissolve gelatin and jello with 1 1/2 cups of boiling water. Run raw cranberries and unpeeled but seeded apples through food chopper. Cut up nuts and orange. Mix sugar with pineapple and combine with ground cranberries nuts and orange. Add to jello mixture and turn into mold.

title: Apple Butter Milkshake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Yield 2 servings.

title: Chicken Ratatouille
instructions: *You may substitute 1/2 teaspoon dried basil and 1/2 teaspoon oregano for Italian spices.

title: Cheese Roasts
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper. Coat meat. Heat oil in skillet. Cook onion until tender. Add meat cubes. Cook until brown. Slowly add sour cream or milk and vinegar or lemon juice. Stir constantly.

title: Orange Rolls
instructions: In large mixing bowl add the first 3 ingredients. Mix for 2 minutes with dough head beater. Add next 4 ingredients and continue to blend. Slowly add remaining flour\tuntil mixture is blended well and not sticky to the touch. Cover and let double in size. Punch down and\troll dough out long and narrow to 1/4 inch in thickness. Spread thin layer of orange frosting over dough. Roll up and cut in 1 1/2 inch rolls. Place in greased pans. Let rise to top of pans and bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 20 rolls.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Boil and cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Mix soup and evaporated milk and set aside. Saute celery and onion in the butter and add stuffing. Spread half of stuffing mix in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Add all the chicken. Top that with half of the remaining stuffing. Pour all of soup mix over that. Top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mint Tea
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to boil. Add tea bags sugar and mint. Remove from heat. Cover and steep 10 minutes. Add lemonade orange juice concentrate and 4 cans water.

title: Broccoli And Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Pour Marzettis Wilde Raspberry dressing over the above mixture. (Dressing can be found in with packaged salads department.) Very good with pork or steak and healthy too!

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Line with graham crackers. Mix pudding and milk; beat for 2 minutes. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour 1/2 of mixture over graham crackers then lay another of graham crackers. Pour rest of mixture over graham crackers. Add another layer of crackers. Refrigerate for 2 hours; frost with chocolate icing.

title: Nancy Mccorkle'S Scotch Sausage Pie
instructions: Chop finely the green pepper and onion and mix with the chopped parsley. Combine with pork sausage.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion together (salted water) then drain. Cook rice in salted water for 15 minutes with lid on. Add soup and Cheez Whiz. Bake for 30 minutes covered at 350\u00b0.

title: Corned Beef Sandwich
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients. Put on bread bun or English muffin. Make sandwich and wrap in foil. Can be stored in refrigerator or frozen. Warm in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until warmed through. Can make open-face and add cheese. Put under broiler until cheese melts.

title: Stuffed Manicotti Pastas
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onion; drain and cool. Place in mixing bowl with bread crumbled milk egg drained mushrooms 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese garlic salt salt pepper and Italian seasoning to taste.

title: Quick And Easy Chicken Soup
instructions: In large saucepan bring chicken broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat. Stir in pasta. Simmer 8 to 12 minutes or until pasta is almost tender. Remove broccoli from pouch. Add to soup mixture. Cook 5 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender. Stir in chicken. Cook until thoroughly heated. Makes 4 (1 1/2-cup) servings.

title: Pudding Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and pudding. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir in baking powder and flour. Mix in nuts and goodies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes for drop cookies. Makes 4 to 5 dozen. \This also makes a great giant cookie.\

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Sift flour and sugar together into a bowl. Heat margarine cocoa and Coke to boiling point. Add buttermilk soda eggs vanilla salt and marshmallows. Batter will be thin and marshmallows will rise to top.

title: Broccoli In Cheese Custard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish put the chopped broccoli into it and sprinkle with the cheese. Beat the eggs lightly in a bowl and stir in the milk or cream salt and pepper. Stir into the broccoli-cheese mixture. Put the baking dish in a shallow pan with hot water halfway up its sides. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes or until the custard is set.

title: Hay Stacks
instructions: In a double boiler melt peanut butter and butterscotch chips. Mix in noodles and walnuts until coated well. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Put into refrigerator until set.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add milk. Mix together sugar flour nutmeg and cinnamon. Stir into egg mixture. Add chopped rhubarb. Dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Heath Bar Pie
instructions: Crush Heath bars into small pieces and put in bottom of pie crust. Mix the rest of the ingredients together and pour over Heath bars. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Ma'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook and cool pudding. Drain and chill pineapple. Remove seeds and chop cherries. Mix pineapple cherries marshmallows and nuts. Mix pudding mayonnaise and whipping cream. Pour over fruits and nuts and mix well. Garnish with paprika. Can be made the day before needed.

title: Indian Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Mix flour sugar and corn meal together. Add yeast and enough water to make a sticky dough. Drop by teaspoons into hot lard (deep fat fry). Fry until crispy brown on both sides. Remove to a paper towel covered pan. Serve with butter and maple syrup or peanut butter or jelly. Also good with ham and eggs or tomato gravy. Lots of ways to serve them.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Drain juice off pineapple; put cream cheese in a bowl. Beat until light and soft. Add Cool Whip and drained pineapple. Spread over cooled cake. Halved cherries may be put on top of topping or if preferred nuts or any other decoration.

title: Zesty Mozzarella Chicken
instructions: In a shallow bowl combine egg white and milk. In another bowl combine the bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and seasonings. Dip each chicken breast in the egg white mixture then in the crumb mixture.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Heat water peas and spices to boiling. Simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours until peas are soft. Add vegetables and simmer until tender (may need to add more water). Add bouillon and jarred meat. Heat and serve.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar margarine and milk; boil to soft ball stage then add chocolate chips Marshmallow Whip and peanut butter. Beat until everything is melted and smooth. Pour into buttered sheet cake pan and cool.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased loaf pan at 300\u00b0 for about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Brazos River Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Brown meat and onion with pepper and garlic. Add soups and mix well. Pour in baking dish and top with cheese. Bake 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together and drop with teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs margarine and sugar; divide and press into two pie plates. Bake at 350 degrees for 5 minutes. Mix cream cheese 3/4 cup sugar and eggs with beaters and pour into crusts. Bake 15 minutes at 350. Cool. Mix remaining ingredients and pour on cheesecakes. Sprinkle with cinnamon and almonds if desired. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes. Chill for 24 hours.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Pour in pie crust and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla and eggs. Sift together cocoa and flour. Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Add nuts. Spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Butter a Bundt pan heavily with soft butter. Separate each frozen roll into 3 pieces. Put into buttered pan. Pour melted butter over. Combine dry pudding mix brown sugar cinnamon and nuts. Sprinkle over dough. Leave pan out overnight uncovered.

title: Crock-Pot Pizza
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Cook and drain macaroni. Layer ingredients in crock-pot. Add your own choice of whatever extra ingredients you want (olives green peppers etc.). Cook 3 hours on low.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken remove from pan. Place in baking dish. Mix cream of mushroom soup and white wine together and pour over chicken. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove chicken. Add sour cream. Stir; heat for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Diabetic Fruit Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar replacement. Add eggs; beat until fluffy. Combine flour baking soda salt and nutmeg in sifter. Add alternately with hot apple juice to creamed mixture. Fold in raisins and currants. Allow to rest 15 minutes.

title: Homa L'S Caramel Pecan Pie
instructions: Put can of milk in pot with lid on and keep covered with water. Boil (barely bubbling) for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Remove; add hot coffee and beat until smooth. Add pecans; put in pie shell and top with whipped cream.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Cut shortening into mixture until it is fine crumbs. Stir in just enough milk so dough leaves side of bowl; round up into ball. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 10 times. Roll or pat dough 1/2-inch thick. Cut with floured 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 1-inch apart for crusty sides. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 16 biscuits.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut round steak into strips and brown in butter. Add garlic and beef broth. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add green onion and green peppers. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Blend cornstarch water and soy sauce. Stir into meat mix and cook until thick (2 minutes). Add tomatoes and stir gently. Serve over a bed of rice.

title: Tofu Fried Rice
instructions: Saute garlic and green onion in water until tender. Stir in celery and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in sprouts and red pepper and cook 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients and remove from heat. Serve hot with soy sauce.

title: Caramel Coffee Cake
instructions: Spray Pam in angel food pan. Mix dry pudding mix and sugar together. Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts (optional) to the mix. Sprinkle in bottom of pan. Place frozen rolls on top of mix so entire bottom of pan is covered. Pour melted butter over all. Cover with a towel and allow to rise all night (not in the refrigerator). Next morning bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Allow to set for 10 minutes then invert on plate. Delicious plain or with butter.

title: Oatmeal Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream sugars and butter or margarine together until light and fluffy. Beat eggs one at a time. Sift together flour salt baking soda and spices. Mix nuts and raisins into sifted flour mixture and add to creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Stir in oats. Mixture will be rather stiff. Make 2 rolls on waxed paper and roll up. Refrigerate overnight. Slice into thin slices and place on baking sheet. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mom'S Jelly Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Add ingredients according to order of recipe. Spoon into greased muffin tins or paper liners. Place 1/2 teaspoon to 1 teaspoon of any kind of jelly or jam on top of each muffin pressing into batter. Try to bring batter over the top of jelly to cover it up. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until brown.

title: Cranberry Sauce For Pork
instructions: Saute chopped onion and butter. Add catsup cranberries (check for sweetness before adding sugar) sugar Worcestershire sauce and yellow mustard. Simmer and serve over pork.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix nuts cinnamon and sugar together and set aside. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs; cream together. Add vanilla sour cream and dry ingredients; mix. Pour 1/4 of batter into greased tube pan or loaf pan. Sprinkle 1/2 nut mixture over. Add the rest of the batter then sprinkle the rest of the nut mixture over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and corn meal. Add eggs and butter. Mix well. Add buttermilk and lemon juice. Mix well. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes. When begins to brown cover with foil to prevent burning.

title: Leslie'S Salad
instructions: Toss lettuce celery green onions and Mandarin oranges together. Melt 1/4 cup sugar toss in 1/2 cup almonds and lay out on greased cutting board to cool. Chop and add to greens.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Combine egg sugar and dates. Cook on low heat until dates are melted. Remove; add vanilla. Pour over Rice Krispies and pecans; mix well. Form in small balls and roll in coconut. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Fluffy Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine pie filling mix 1 cup of sugar and 1/4 cup of water in saucepan. Blend in egg yolks; add remaining water. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Remove from heat; stir in lime juice and rind. Beat egg white until foamy throughout. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and continue beating until mixture will form stiff shiny peaks. Blend in pie filling mixture. Add enough food coloring to tint light green. pour onto crust. Chill until firm. Garnish with prepared whipped topping lime slices or twists.

title: Chocolate Berry Chill
instructions: Spread softened ice cream onto bottom of crust. Freeze until firm. Spread fudge sauce evenly over ice cream. Cover with Cool Whip. Freeze 4 hours or until firm. Let stand approximately 30 minutes before serving. Garnish with strawberries and fudge sauce. Preparation time 15 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Artichoke Squares
instructions: Drain artichokes reserving marinade from one jar. Saute onion in marinade. Cut up artichokes. Beat eggs and add crumbs and seasonings. Stir in cheese sauteed onion and artichokes. Turn into a greased 11 x 7-inch baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool slightly before cutting into squares. Makes 40 servings (I dont believe it!).

title: Pull Apart Cake Or Bubble Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into quarters. Mix together 3/4 cup sugar and 3 teaspoons cinnamon. Roll biscuit pieces to coat. Layer in ungreased tube pan with nuts. Combine 3/4 cup oleo 1 cup brown sugar and rum or milk. Bring to a boil. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 40 minutes. Cake will not slice just pull apart. May also use frozen bread dough instead of biscuits.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Sift flour salt and spices together. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately to the creamed mixture beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Fold in the jam and pour into three 9-inch round pans that have been greased and lined with wax paper. Bake for 40 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven. Ice with caramel icing.

title: Cold Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage in large bowl. Chop onion and pepper and put on top of cabbage; set aside. Heat to boiling the oil mixture vinegar sugar and salt. Pour over cabbage mixture. Let set overnight before stirring. Stir up and refrigerate. Will keep indefinitely.

title: Heavenly Delight Congealed Dessert
instructions: Prepare jello. Allow it to partially congeal in refrigerator. Dice cherries except for a few for garnish. Mix cherries pecans and pineapple in separate bowl. Mix cream cheese (room temperature) with water and then with fruit. Mix in jello and marshmallows.

title: Pineapple Chutney
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and cook until the mixture is thick. Add salt to taste. Cook pineapple in juice until the juice has reduced to very little then add all the other ingredients. Cook until the mixture thickens. Keep chutney in a jar and use as needed.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion (salt to taste); drain. Mix together meal buttermilk oil eggs corn soda and salt. Use a large glass baking dish or a large and medium-size iron skillet. Grease with shortening. Pour 1/2 of meal mixture into dish. Pour in ground beef. Chop peppers then grate cheese. Sprinkle over meat. Add rest of meal mixture. Bake uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Best when served with pinto beans and cole slaw.

title: Lemon Mustard Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place chicken in shallow baking pan. Melt margarine in saucepan. Stir in mustard lemon juice and tarragon. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake 45 minutes or until cooked through. Spoon sauce from pan over chicken as needed.

title: Fish Cakes Oven Baked Or Fried
instructions: Separate fish into small flakes. Cook onion in fat or oil until limp. Combine eggs mashed potatoes catsup and salt with fish and onion in a bowl. Portion mixture into cakes and roll in bread crumbs. Space in single layer on well oiled shallow pan and bake 8 to 10 minutes. If frying use bacon fat until brown on both sides.

title: Cajun Shrimp
instructions: Divide shrimp equally among 4 small au gratin dishes; set aside. In saucepan heat butter or margarine with olive oil. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Cook 5 minutes over medium heat.

title: Lori'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together sour cream cream of chicken soup cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour mixture over chicken. Mix cracker crumbs with butter and spread over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until crackers are brown.

title: Snack Meat Balls
instructions: Combine milk 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce and soup mix; blend well. Let stand for 5 minutes. Add beef; mix well. Mixture will be moist. Shape into balls using 1 tablespoon for each. Place on rack in broiler pan. Broil 5 to 6 inches from heat for 10\tto 12\tminutes. (Do not turn meat balls.) Combine remaining ingredients and Worcestershire sauce in saucepan. Cook stirring until heated. Add meat balls.

title: Grandma Minnie'S Banana Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Mix together melted butter beaten eggs milk and mashed bananas. Add to dry ingredients and mix just enough to combine. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour sugar soda and cocoa. Add the remaining ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done when toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool and frost with your favorite chocolate fudge frosting.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Bring margarine sugar salt and corn syrup to a boil stirring constantly. Then boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add soda and vanilla and pour over popcorn. Mix and turn into 2 large buttered baking pans. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. (Optional\tpeanuts can be added and stirred in the last 30 minutes of baking.)

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Heat lima beans or peas. Mix hamburger meat and lima beans or peas with one can of tomato soup. Add Worcestershire or A.1. steak sauce dash of salt and pepper. Put mixed ingredients into pie shell; cover with a layer of Cheddar cheese (optional). Cover with top pie crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 35 minutes or until turns brown.

title: Icebox Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add salt sugar eggs margarine then flour. Stir. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Roll out on lightly floured board 1/4-inch thick and cut like pieces of pie. Roll from wide end to point. Set on greased cookie sheet and let stand about 3 hours before baking at 425\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Add more flour if dough is too thin. Unused dough keeps well until needed.

title: Nesselrood Pudding
instructions: Whip enough whipping cream to make 1 cup. Sweeten with powdered sugar to suit your taste. Add vanilla. Beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar gradually and beat until stiff. Toast almonds. Put almonds Grape-Nuts and 1 tablespoon cherry juice in large mixing bowl. Add whipped cream. Blend together. Fold in egg whites last. Pour all into desired serving bowl or flat pan and freeze.

title: Easy Home Baked Bread
instructions: In large bowl combine water yeast sugar and salt.* Gradually add flour to form a stiff dough. Place in a greased bowl and cover. Let rise until double in size 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Toss on floured board divide in half shape into 2 loaves. Grease pans and sprinkle with cornmeal. Place in the dough and let rise 45 to 60 minutes. Brush with beaten egg white all over the top and sprinkle with sesame or poppy seed.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Heat beans and water to boiling in Dutch oven. Boil uncovered 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 1 hour.

title: Chipped Beef Balls
instructions: Finely chop beef and mix together with cream cheese horseradish and parsley. Form into bite size balls and roll in Parmesan cheese. Chill. Just before serving spear each ball with a pretzel stick. Serves 8.

title: Ravioli And Sausage
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat cook sausage until browned and no longer pink stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Heat to boiling. Add ravioli. Heat through stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese. Garnish with oregano if desired.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
instructions: Mix sour cream and onions. Spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread sauerkraut over top. Layer with corned beef; add Swiss cheese. Top with bread crumbs. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature before beginning. This is very important!

title: English Muffins
instructions: In large bowl combine 1 1/4 cups flour salt sugar and yeast; mix well. Add the warm water and shortening. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed on mixer. By hand gradually add remaining flour to make a firm dough. Knead on floured board until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl; cover and let rise until double. Punch down dough and roll out on lightly sprinkled cornmeal board. Cut into 3 or 4-inch circles. Cover; let rise until dough about\t30 minutes. Bake on lightly oiled griddle or frypan at 325\u00b0 for about 8 minutes on each side until golden brown. Makes 12 to 14.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Baked Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes in the skins then peel. Mash the potatoes with cream and seasonings. Place in the baking dish and brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles. Brown beef then add sauce onion and mushrooms. Mix eggs and cottage cheese together then layer in 10 x 13-inch pan noodles beef mixture eggs cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese and repeat for three layers. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Rosemary Abbott'S Syrian Shadai
instructions: Combine ingredients and cook in large stewing pan until noodles are done. If desired white breast of chicken can be substituted for stewing chicken. Correct the seasoning with salt and pepper.

title: Wilted Coleslaw
instructions: In a small bowl combine the cabbage onion celery seed and salt; set aside. In a skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserving 1 tablespoon drippings. Crumble bacon over cabbage mixture. To the drippings add sugar vinegar and paprika; heat until sugar is dissolved. Pour over cabbage mixture and toss to coat. Serve immediately. Yield 1 serving.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: In large bowl mix milk (Eagle Brand) lime peel juice and salt. Add yolks. Use mixer at high speed. Beat 1 or 2 minutes or until thick. Pour into crust. Chill at least 2 hours or until set.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool. Mix ingredients except strawberries. Slice strawberries in 1/4s and place in pie crust. Cook other ingredients until thick. Pour over strawberries; place pie in refrigerator to cool then put Cool Whip on top of pie. Ready to serve.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
instructions: Combine and serve with sliced apples. Or combine one 8 ounce cream cheese 1/2 cup brown sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1/2 teaspoon Watkins caramel flavoring.

title: Chocolate Nut Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in small saucepan; stir in brown sugar. Heat until bubbly. Stir in corn syrup and cream. Heat stirring constantly just to boiling. Add nuts. Pour into generously buttered 10-inch (12-cup) Bundt pan. Put aside.

title: Spinach Or Broccoli Bake
instructions: Thaw spinach. Add cheese soup butter onion and egg; mix well. Toss in stuffing (reserve 3/4 cup). Place in greased 1-quart casserole. Top with remaining stuffing. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Steam vegetables and onion together; drain. Put cheese in and mix well. Put in baking dish. Mix butter and crackers together; spread on top. Bake until it starts to turn brown around edges at 350\u00b0.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Fry beef and drain. Add remaining ingredients. Place in crock-pot and keep on low. Serve with chips.

title: Mashed Potato Candy
instructions: Stir powdered sugar into potato vanilla and salt mixture until dough resembles pie crust. Place between sheets of waxed paper and flatten until 1-inch thick. Spread with peanut butter. Cut into bite size candy. Store in covered container.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Sift together the flour cream of tartar soda and salt. Cream the shortening. Gradually beat in sugar and eggs. Stir in dry ingredients. Chill dough about 1 hour. Form balls the size of small walnuts. Roll in a mixture of 2 tablespoons of sugar and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) until lightly browned but still soft about 8 to 10 minutes. These cookies will puff at first then flatten out with crinkled tops. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Melt margarine. Add chicken chunks to the margarine and coat well. In separate bowl combine all dry ingredients. Add chicken to dry ingredients and coat well. Bake on greased/sprayed cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: Add all ingredients together in a microwavable bowl and heat in two minute increments until cheese is melted. Stir well and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Banana Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Chili Relleno Squares
instructions: In a lightly greased 8-inch square pan alternate layers of cheeses and chilies starting and ending with cheese. Beat eggs milk and flour until smooth. Pour egg mixture over cheese and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into small squares. Serve warm.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In saucepan bring butter sugar milk and vanilla to a boil for 2 minutes stirring frequently. In large mixing bowl put oats and cocoa powder together. Pour butter sugar milk and vanilla over oats and stir until mixed well. Drop tablespoon size cookie dough onto wax paper let cool. Enjoy!

title: Creamy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and chop chicken breasts. Reserve 1/2 cup of broth. Crush crackers and mix with butter. Put 1/2 cracker mixture in bottom of casserole dish. Mix all liquid ingredients with chicken and layer over crackers. Top with remaining crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish.

title: Country-Style Barbecued Ribs
instructions: In large pot cover ribs with water and bring to boil. Cover and simmer for 45-60 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cook onion in hot oil until tender and stir in garlic. Stir in remaining ingredients except ribs and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes stirring once or twice. Grill ribs over low coals about 45 minutes or until done turning every 15 minutes and brushing with sauce. Serves 6.

title: Grandmother'S Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Soften yeast; combine next 5 ingredients. Cool. Stir in 2 cups flour beat. Add eggs and yeast flour to make soft. Rest for 10 minutes; knead. Let rise until double in bulk. Divide in 1/2 or make into rolls. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 35 minutes. I let it rise twice before I put it into pans kneading it again.
