title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix cooked macaroni chicken onion bell pepper and olives together. Combine Italian dressing mayonnaise salt and pepper in separate bowl. Pour over salad and mix well. Put in refrigerator to cool.

title: French Toast
instructions: Beat egg until frothy. Add milk; beat well. Melt butter in skillet on low heat. Dip bread slices one at a time into egg mixture. Lift them into skillet with pancake turner. Brown on each side. Serve with confectioners sugar maple syrup or cinnamon and sugar if desired.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain and place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Chop onion and put over beef. Spread 1 can cream of chicken soup on top of beef and onions. Top with Tater Tots. Mix cream of celery soup with 1/2 can water; mix well and pour over Tater Tots.

title: Lasagne To Die For!!!!
instructions: Brown sausage and hamburger; drain. Add undrained tomatoes tomato paste water basil garlic and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Simmer covered 15 minutes; stir occasionally.

title: Southwest Appetizer Cheesecake
instructions: Place tortilla chips in large plastic bag; seal. Finely crush chips with mallet or rolling pin to measure 1 cup. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine crushed chips and butter; press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Set aside 2/3 of cake mix. In mixing bowl combine remaining cake mix butter and 1 egg. Mix until crumbly. Press mixture into a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tuna-Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni as directed on box. Strain. Mix in tuna shrimp crabmeat onion mayonnaise and seasonings. Mix mushroom soup with juice from tuna. Mix soup and place in greased casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 1/2 hour or until bread crumbs have browned.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Mix popped corn gumdrops and nuts in large pan. Melt oil and oleo and marshmallows. Pour over the first 3 ingredients mix well by hand. Pack tightly in greased tube pan. Let set for 2 hours. Take out of pan.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Boil beets until tender. Dip in cool water and pull off skins.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift flour baking powder and soda together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream blending after each addition. Spread half the batter in a 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured). Cream butter brown sugar and cinnamon; add nuts. Mix well. Sprinkle 1/2 nut mixture evenly over the batter in pan. Cover with remaining batter. Sprinkle remaining nut mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Strawberry Surprise
instructions: Prepare 1 box strawberry jello and refrigerate to jell. After it has jelled spread 1/2 of the strawberries over the jello. Over strawberries spread the sour cream. Spread the remaining strawberries over the sour cream. Prepare the second box of jello and pour over the already prepared mixture. Sprinkle the pecans over the jello and refrigerate until firm.

title: Cream Cheese Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and pecans. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Baby Pearl Tapioca
instructions: Combine and heat to boiling stirring all the while. Boil for 5 minutes. Pour in cans and cold pack 20 minutes. Can add fruit cocktail and Cool Whip after opening.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix together and add 1/2 cup lemon juice before pouring into graham cracker crust.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown bacon and onion but dont cook until crisp. Add other ingredients mixing well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Chunk up the cream cheese. Drain the crab. Dump it all in the crock-pot on high. Stir frequently until the cheese melts. Cover; turn to low and cook 4 to 5 hours.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Arrange broccoli in greased baking dish. Place chicken on top. Combine next 4 ingredients. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Egg Strata
instructions: In a large baking dish spray Pam all over. Put 6 slices of bread on the bottom. Cover bread with cooked sausage (drain off grease). Next layer is Velveeta slices. In a large bowl mix eggs dry mustard milk salt and pepper. Pour over layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Harvest Loaf
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and mix well. Cream margarine; add sugar gradually. Blend eggs in creamed mixture and mix well. Add dry ingredients and pumpkin. Stir in morsels and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes. Grease and flour loaf pan.

title: Nutty Tuna-Noodle Bake
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain well. Meanwhile in saucepan melt the butter or margarine; stir in flour. Add the milk and soup all at once. Cook until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Remove the soup mixture from heat; stir in American cheese until melted. Stir in tuna peas and carrots and pimiento into soup mixture. Fold in noodles. Turn the soup-tuna mixture into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle the chopped peanuts atop. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until mixture is heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Macaroni 'N Cheese
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan over low heat. Add flour. Slowly add milk and cook until thickened. Add salt pepper and cheeses. Continue cooking over low heat until cheeses melt. Add to 1 pound cooked drained elbow macaroni. Place in buttered casserole dish. Mix plain bread crumbs with melted margarine and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot.

title: Vegetable Party Sandwich Spread
instructions: Drain vegetables well. Beat cream cheese and lemon juice until smooth. Stir in vegetables. Yields about 2 1/2 cups. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate-Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding oil eggs vanilla sour cream and butter. Divide batter in half. Add chocolate chips to one bowl and chocolate syrup swirled in the other. Pour bowl with chocolate syrup in bottom of greased and floured pound or bundt cake pan. Then pour bowl with chocolate chip batter on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hillbilly Ice Cream
instructions: Fold all ingredients together and freeze. Any flavor of fruit pie filling may be used.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a baking sheet. Mix the ingredients together with a fork. Drop by teaspoon lumps of mixture onto baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes or until edges turn light brown. Remove from baking sheet with a spatula. Cool. Yield 24. You may place a pecan half in the center of each macaroon before baking if desired.

title: Apricot Sherbet
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Heat until gelatin is completely dissolved. Place in bowl and freeze until partially frozen. Whip apricot mixture with electric mixer. Return to freezer until set.

title: Chicken Scaloppini
instructions: Slice chicken thin and flour. Saute in olive oil until golden brown. Season with garlic salt. Layer chicken and top with eggplant and mushrooms in a baking dish. In a pan melt butter and add flour and onions. Stir in broth Sauterne and parsley. Mix to a nice gravy. Pour over chicken and eggplant. Bake covered 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Quiche
instructions: Mix eggs milk dressing and seasonings. Toss flour with cheese and add to liquid mix. Pour over any of the following ingredients in the pie pan Broccoli - crab - ham - chicken - shrimp - mushrooms - spinach.

title: Mama'S Creamy Mac-N-Cheese
instructions: Bring 1 quart of water to a boil in a saucepan. When it begins boiling add 1 tbsp of butter. Add noodles and cook until tender. Drain most of water but leave some in the bottom of the pan. Add milk cheese and the other tbsp of butter salt and pepper. Stir until cheese is thoroughly melted of low heat. Makes approx. 4 servings.

title: Lo-Cal, Fat-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy. Add cream of tartar and vanilla. Add sugar gradually and beat until stiff and glossy. Fold in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon on foil lined cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in a 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Bean And Eggplant Curry
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet heat olive oil. When hot add onion and carrots; stir-fry for 5 minutes. Add turkey and stir-fry breaking up turkey until there is no more pink. Add tomato sauce oregano beans and season to taste with pepper. Stir-fry for another minute or so or until all ingredients are very hot. Stir in parsley and serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream And Chili Bake
instructions: In skillet brown the ground beef. Stir in beans enchilada sauce tomato sauce and 1 cup shredded cheese. Set aside 1 cup corn chips. Coarsely crush remaining chips. Stir them into meat mixture. Turn in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spoon sour cream on casserole. Sprinkle 1/2 cup shredded cheese. Sprinkle reserved corn chips around edge of casserole. Bake uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients in order given. \Ice\ with 1 cup Miracle Whip mixed with 1 cup mayonnaise. Top with shredded Swiss cheese. Toss together before serving.

title: Easy Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Blend the ice cream and milk. Add the pudding. Beat 1 minute. Pour in a baked pie shell. Let stand in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

title: Sausage Zucchini Boats
instructions: Cook whole zucchini in salted boiling water until tender 7 to 10 minutes. Cut in 1/2 lengthwise segments. Scoop squash from shells and mash. Cook sausage with onion. Drain off excess fat. Stir in mashed zucchini reserving 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Add remaining ingredients. Mix with a spoon into shells. Place shells in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with remainder of Parmesan cheese and dash of paprika. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Zucchini
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Bake in a greased loaf pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Bake and peel potatoes (or boil with skins on) at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and peel potatoes. Mash pulp and stir in raisins sugar cinnamon and pineapple. Pour into baking pan and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake covered at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients and serve with fresh veggies.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: *Note May not need all of flour; watch for consistency of cake batter.

title: Corn Bread Dressing(100 Years Old)
instructions: Mix bread and biscuits in a large pan or bowl. Melt butter and lightly saute onion and celery. Add to crumb mixture. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake in well-greased shallow pans in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Cherry Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt butter in 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix sugar flour baking powder and milk into batter. Pour batter over melted butter in pan. Do not stir! Spoon pie cherries juice and all over batter. Do not stir! Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar over top. Bake for 60 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Scald milk. Add bread and set aside. Beat eggs lightly and add seasonings sugar and butter. Mix then add vanilla and raisins. Mix with bread and milk mixture and pour in 2-quart buttered dish and bake in a pan of water at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa;\tadd just enough milk to moisten. Add egg\tyolks.\tIn double boiler or Teflon skillet place milk and bring to a boil. Gradually stir in chocolate mixture. Cook until it thickens.\tJust before taking up add margarine and vanilla. Pour in cool baked pie shell. Chill. Top with Cool Whip before serving.

title: Chalupah
instructions: Cover all ingredients with water. Cook 6 hours covered. Stir and add water as needed. Remove lid; cook 1 more hour. Meat will fall apart. Serve over tortilla chips. Add grated cheese lettuce tomato onion and avocado. Looks like a giant tostada. Freezes well.

title: Mandarin Glazed Beets
instructions: In large saucepan combine sugar cornstarch lemon juice and butter. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in beets and oranges. Cook until hot. Serve. Also good cold.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
instructions: In double boiler melt morsels and Crisco. Add Rice Krispies and raisins. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper on cookie sheet. Refrigerate 1/2 hour. Can use small peanuts cut pecans or walnuts or coconut in place of raisins.

title: Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan with fork scraping corners until moist. Stir batter vigorously with fork for 1 minute. Scrape sides and smooth out. Bake 40 to 50 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar or a frosting of your choice.

title: Celery Seed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into bite size pieces. Cook in salted water. When boiling add onion and garlic powder along with celery seed. Cook to desired doneness and then drain. Place into bowl and add 1/2 stick butter pepper and parsley. Mix until coated.

title: Quick And Easy Vanilla Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar Crisco and egg together. Add vanilla then add dry ingredients. Roll into balls (small). Flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 50 cookies.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Heat butter garlic and olive oil in a large skillet. Add shrimp and saute on both sides until done (about 5 minutes). Pour off pan drippings into a small saucepan. Add the remaining ingredients. Cook over high heat 1 minute. Pour sauce over shrimp and serve with rice to absorb the juices.

title: Cheese And Sausage Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape into small marble-sized balls. Place on cookie sheet and bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot. Keep on hand in the freezer. Can be frozen cooked or uncooked. Makes about 100 balls.

title: Corn Custard
instructions: Saute onions including tops and bell pepper in butter. Add remaining ingredients and bake in a deep baking dish (10 x 7 1/2 x 3-inch) for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until center has cooked and knife comes out clean when inserted.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: In large casserole dish spread even 1/2 Pepperidge Farm mix. Melt oleo in water. Pour over this then mix chicken onion celery mayonnaise salt pepper and spread over mix evenly. Beat eggs well in milk. Pour over chicken mixture. Cover casserole with foil and refrigerate overnight. Before cooking remove casserole and let sit until room temperature. Pour 1 can mushroom soup over top spreading even then top with balance of Pepperidge Farm. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Beans 'N Cheese
instructions: Bring beans to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Drain well and mash slightly. Pour into shallow baking dish. Add soup blending well. Top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts being careful not to scorch cheese.

title: Chicken Elegant
instructions: Spread chipped beef on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Wrap each chicken cutlet with one piece of bacon and place on top of beef. Mix sour cream and mushroom soup together then spread over chicken and beef. Refrigerate 24 hours. Bake uncovered at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Olive Spread
instructions: Mash cheese with a fork. Add mayonnaise and stir until smooth. Add other ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate at least 12 hours. Mix will become firm as it cools.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Stir beef garlic flour salt pepper paprika and mushrooms. Saute 5 minutes. Add soup. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Mix all together the day before serving. Put in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Fluff
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in a glass bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Plain Pound Cake
instructions: Beat sugar crisco and margarine together; until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Add flavoring any time. Add half milk half flour beat until smooth the add rest of milk and flour. Beat on low speed then turn on high. Beat until creamy. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hour. Dont forget to grease pan and flour pan.

title: Orange-Honey Cake
instructions: Combine concentrate honey and coffee. Beat eggs until light; add oil and sugar gradually. Beat. Sift dry ingredients together. Add egg mixture alternately with orange mixture. Mix until smooth. Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done. Cool remove from pans. Makes 2 loaf cakes. Best if let set for 2 days before serving.

title: Cabbage Burger Bake
instructions: Quarter and shred cabbage. Spread half in buttered 12-cup baking dish. Saute bacon just until fat starts to cook out in frying pan. Stir onions and rice in drippings in frying pan and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until onion is soft and rice is lightly browned. Spoon over cabbage in baking dish. Cook ground beef and crumble over rice mixture. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with remaining cabbage. Heat Ragu and water to boiling. Pour slowly over cabbage. Top with bacon. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chris' Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until very stiff; add sugar gradually and baking powder. Beat until stiff. Fold in crackers nuts and vanilla. Put in buttered pie pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 23 minutes. May be served with whipped cream.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream margarine sugar molasses and egg together. Stir flour salt baking soda cloves and ginger together. Add to creamed mixture. Mixture will be soft. Roll in little balls and roll in sugar. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole I
instructions: Cook celery and onion with broccoli in 1/2 cup water for 7 or 8 minutes (or until tender). Add rest of ingredients; mix and put in casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
instructions: Blend mayo sugar mustard salt and lemon juice. Add remaining ingredients. Toss gently to coat. Serve on bed of lettuce or serve as is.

title: Unkneaded Brown Bread
instructions: Combine yeast 1/2 cup warm water and sugar. Set in warm place for 10 minutes to dissolve yeast.

title: Baked Hostess Ham
instructions: Lay ham on heavy foil and pour mixture over it. Stick 6 to 8 whole cloves in ham. Fold foil to seal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes per pound. When done punch holes in bottom of foil to let liquid drain out.

title: Fruit Salad(Good For Diabetics)
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add crushed pineapple and buttermilk. Chill overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Mashed Potato Patties
instructions: Mix mashed potatoes and grated cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Form the mixture into patties and brown in butter on both sides. Leftover mashed potatoes work just fine.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese and 1/4 cup onion rings on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together chili powder and paprika. Allow cheese to soften. Mix well the cheeses nuts and garlic powder. Roll into balls or rolls. Roll and completely cover in chili powder/paprika mix.

title: Crabmeat Spread
instructions: Combine in small baking dish; bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers. Can sprinkle with paprika before baking. Can top with almond slivers.

title: Samoa Milkshake
instructions: Mix ice cream and milk in a blender to make a milkshake. Place crushed Samoas on top of the milkshake. Makes one milkshake.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple. Heat juice butter sugar and lemon juice to boil. Remove from heat and let cool. Add cornstarch and water. Stir until thick. Add Cool Whip and stir over pineapple chunks apples grapes and marshmallows.

title: Helen'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Beat butter and sugar then add eggs then oil and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Drop by teaspoons and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix Jell-O in boiling water. add sugar and mix thoroughly. Add cold water lemonade pineapple juice and extract. Freeze in plastic container. Thaw but not completely and add ginger ale.

title: Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into crust. Chill until set (about 4 hours). Arrange fruit on top before serving.

title: Lentil Casserole
instructions: Combine first 11 ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole coated with vegetable cooking spray; stir well. Add broth; stir well. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until lentils are tender. Yields 11 servings about 134 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

title: Ful Medames(Lebanese; International)
instructions: Toss together watermelon onion cilantro jalapeno chiles salt garlic and lime juice in glass or pottery bowl. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes then serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Put eggs in small bowl and beat well. Set aside. Put milk in mixing cup or bowl. Add vinegar (to make sour milk). Set aside.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
instructions: Mix cornstarch and sugar with cold water. Add boiling water and cook until thickens stirring constantly. Add butter. Serve over cupcakes angel food cake bread pudding or plain cake.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Mix crumbs with 1/2 cup melted margarine; spread in bottom of brownie pan to make crust. Cream 1 cup margarine; gradually add sugar. Add eggs beating well. Spread over crust; cover with bananas. Sprinkle pineapple; spread with whipped cream. Garnish top with nuts and cherries. Chill thoroughly. Better if made 1 day prior to serving.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Sprinkle half of the cake mix on the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour cherry pie filling over the cake mix. Combine the rest of the cake mix with the pecans. Melt the butter and pour over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top should be a golden brown.

title: Date Buns
instructions: Sift together flour salt sugar soda and cream of tartar. In separate bowl beat eggs. Add melted butter and milk. Combine the liquid and dry ingredients with a few strokes. Add dates.

title: Fish
instructions: Marinate fish overnight in beer and mustard. Mix salt and black pepper in corn meal then bread fish in corn meal and fry. This recipe will serve 4 people.

title: Pork And Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops. Combine rice salt and broth. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Arrange pork chops on top of rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Mama'S Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: In small bowl combine 1/4 cup water 1 teaspoon sugar and yeast. In large mixing bowl mix together melted margarine hot water 1/2 cup sugar salt and eggs. Mix together with whisk. Add yeast mixture. Stir in 4 cups flour and mix well. Stir in remaining flour and mix thoroughly but do not knead. Put in large oiled container and refrigerate. When ready to bake roll out dough 1/2-inch thick. Spread with melted margarine. Cut out with biscuit cutter. Let rise in warm place 1 hour. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400\u00b0. Dough will keep in refrigerator for several days.

title: Anise Biscuits
instructions: Blend sugar and oil. Add eggs flavoring anise seed flour and baking powder. Shape dough into four loaves. Bake on slightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Slice each loaf and bake to toast about 7 minutes on each side.

title: Microwave Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish stir together sugar and syrup. Microwave at High for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts. Microwave at High for 3 to 5 minutes until light brown. Add butter and vanilla to syrup blending well. Microwave at High for 1 to 2 minutes more. Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot! Add soda and stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Let cool. Break into small pieces and store in an airtight container. Makes about 1 pound.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except cheese and chips). Put them on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Katie Mae'S Cold-Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco; then gradually add sugar creaming mixture well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Mix dry ingredients together and add these alternately with the milk to creamed mixture. Add flavorings. Place in a well greased tube pan which has also been floured. Put in a cold oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Do not open oven the first hour. Serves 21 or more.

title: Mississippi Pecan Pie
instructions: Boil syrup and sugar together about 2 minutes. Pour slowly over eggs. Add butter vanilla and nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. In heavy saucepan over low heat melt peanut butter chips; stir into cheese mixture. Add nuts. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Shape into 1-inch balls.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dump in in order the cherries undrained pineapple dry cake mix and nuts. Smooth after each layer; do not mix. Place the butter pieces on top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with ice cream.

title: Music Teacher Casserole
instructions: Combine tuna or chicken soups vegetables and 2 cans of water. Mix and add noodles and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: In a large skillet dissolve gelatin brown sugar and salt in boiling water. Add butter and bring to boil stirring constantly. Add potatoes; simmer about 15 minutes basting frequently until syrup thickens and potatoes are glazed. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
instructions: Alternate layers of ham and potatoes onions and cheese in crock-pot. Salt and pepper to taste. Top with can of mushroom soup. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon in baking dish. Put bacon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix in large bowl roaster or dishpan in order given. Drop by large spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Flatten dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Let cool several minutes before removing from pan.

title: Chicken Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a small saucepan over medium-low heat melt butter in water. Add flour and salt stirring until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Add eggs and beat vigorously until smooth. Stir in cheese. Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove puffs from oven; cool and split. Combine remaining ingredients adding more mayonnaise if needed to moisten. Fill each puff with a heaping teaspoonful of chicken mixture. Yield approximately 2 dozen puffs.

title: Crispy Fried Chicken
instructions: Beat eggs and milk together. Dip chicken in this. Mix all dry ingredients together in plastic bag then put a few pieces at a time in bag and shake. Fry in hot grease until golden brown. Let drain on paper towels.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Pour peaches into large cake pan. Add sugar if needed. Mix Bisquick sugar milk vanilla and egg until well blended. Pour over peaches. Dot with margarine and bake in 375\u00b0 oven until browned on top.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Put salt in water enough to cover vegetables. Let stand 2 hours; drain well. Mix vinegar sugar and celery seed together and pour over drained cucumber mixture. Mix well. Place in freezer bags and freeze. Real good; easy to make.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Peel and dice onion. Cook potatoes and onion in a large pot with enough water to cover potatoes well. Boil until potatoes are tender or until they begin to fall apart. Add bouillon cubes pepper and oil. Stir in potato flakes until well mixed. Add chicken soup. Continue to stir until well mixed and smooth. Serve hot.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup in 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High 5 minutes. Stir in peanuts. Microwave 3 to 5 minutes stirring occasionally until peanuts and syrup are lightly browned. Stir in butter vanilla and soda until foamy. Spread 1/4-inch thick on buttered cookie sheet. Makes 1 pound.

title: Vegetable Relish
instructions: Add salt to the vegetable mixture and mix well. Let stand for 3 or 4 hours. Drain well. Add sugar vinegar water and spices to vegetables. Boil for 3 minutes. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Cole Slaw Dressing
instructions: Put vinegar and butter in top of double boiler until butter is melted then add other ingredients after they have been mixed together. Cook until thick or to your liking.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour spices salt and lemon juice. Add apples; toss to mix. Roll out pastry dough for crust and top. Cut vents in top piece. Line pie pan with pastry and cut off overhang. Fill with half the apples and dot with butter. Add remaining apples. Moisten rim with water. Adjust top crust. Leave about 1/2-inch pastry beyond edge. Fold in under lower pastry. Seal rim by pressing together and flute it. Brush with milk. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until apples test done with fork. For a single crust use a 425\u00b0 oven.

title: Cayenned Corn
instructions: Melt the butter in a pan large enough to accommodate the corn; add the corn the garlic the cayenne and salt to taste. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes over medium heat and add cream. Cook additional 8 minutes or until heated through. Serves 4.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute green onions in butter until limp. Add broccoli. Saute another 5 minutes stirring frequently. Then add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg add milk and flour. Then mix with grated potatoes. Add onions and salt. Cook on griddle until well browned.

title: Corn Flake Candies
instructions: Melt sugar and syrup on low heat until dissolved. Mix in peanut butter. Gently fold in corn flakes. Spoon onto waxed paper to cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and water. Cook sugar cornstarch and water over medium heat in saucepan until clear. Remove from heat. Pour jello into mixture. Put in whole strawberry chopped into quarters; place in baked pie shell. Chill until firm. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Potato Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in water. Add mashed potatoes shortening sugar and salt. Cool; let stand in warm place until bubbly or about 2 hours. Add flour; beat well. Cover; chill. Shape dough (cold) into rolls. Let rise at room temperature about 3 hours. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in 425\u00b0 oven. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Beat soup and milk together. Place a layer of potatoes in large casserole; sprinkle with onion green pepper salt and pepper. Repeat until all are used then pour over this mixture the milk and soup. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until potatoes are tender all through. Serves 8.

title: Mile-High Lime Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine the milk sour cream lime juice and food coloring if desired. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into the crust. Refrigerate for at least 12 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingersnaps
instructions: Beat the butter in large bowl until light. Slowly add sugar. Beat in molasses ginger cinnamon cloves baking soda and salt. Add flour 1/4 cup at a time. Mix thoroughly. Chill 4 hours. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Divide cookie dough in half. Shape each half into 1 1/2-inch thick rolls. Cut dough crosswise with sharp knife into 1/2-inch thick slices. Place on lightly buttered baking sheet. Bake cookies until golden about 8 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cook crumbled sausage and drain. Spread bread with butter. Place in greased casserole butter side up. Sprinkle sausage over then top with cheese. Combine remaining ingredients beating well. Pour over bread and sausage. Chill 8 hours or overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Combine chocolate and coffee until smooth. Add egg yolks and beat on high speed for 30 seconds. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar. Fold in chocolate mixture and blend until smooth. Chill 1 hour.

title: Fruit Cookie Pie
instructions: In a medium bowl beat together butter and sugars until light and creamy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well.

title: Strawberry Parfait
instructions: Mix water with Jell-O. Stir in frozen strawberries until thawed. Cut cake in small pieces; spread in large pan. Fold whipped cream marshmallows and strawberry mixture together. Pour over cake. Sit in refrigerator for two hours.

title: Spaghetti Stew
instructions: Place beef in crock-pot and brown on high for 1 hour. Break up meat. Add Italian sauce water chopped celery chopped onions tomatoes soup and V-8. Cook spaghetti; drain and add. Cook on high for 1 hour then on low for 2+ hours. To serve top with grated Cheddar cheese.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Wash and dry. Stuff with cream cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Cabbage Stew
instructions: Brown ground round. Add onion celery and green pepper. Cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until cabbage is tender.

title: Beef, Potato Soup(Lucy'S Original)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a Dutch oven kettle. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes and carrots are tender then simmer some more. Delicious served with corn bread.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Precook potatoes and onions. Mix all ingredients and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Chop onions and garlic. Combine all ingredients in a heavy kettle and simmer with meat slowly about 3 hours. Remove meat; strain gravy and thicken with flour. Serve over noodles.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter until tender. Mix remaining ingredients and bake in casserole dish at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Moma Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef in large skillet add green beans tomato soup and season with chili powder to your taste. Cook until thicken. Pour into 11 x 7 in baking dish. Arrange biscuits in a single layer over top. Bake at 350 degrees until biscuits are golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: White Cake With Raspberry Sauce
instructions: Prepare and bake cake according to package directions using a 13 x 9 inch baking pan. In a small bowl beat cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth. Fold in whipped cream. Spread over cooled cake. Refrigerate until serving. Just before serving combine strawberry glaze and water in a bowl; gently fold in raspberries. Serve over cake.

title: No Sugar Apple Pie(But Sweet As Pie)
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Sprinkle with flour and spices. Blend in thawed undiluted juice. Put into bottom crust and dot with butter or for a deep dish pie put apple mixture in a loaf pan and dot with butter. Put on top crust and cut air vents. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix cream cheese until smooth with electric mixer. Add grated cheese and dressing mix. Stir together until well blended. Shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients then the liquid. Mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan (flour lightly) and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanutty Ice Cream Balls
instructions: Combine cereal and peanut butter. Scoop ice cream into balls using No. 16 ice cream scoop or shape into 2 1/4-inch balls. Roll in cereal mixture. Place on wax paper and freeze until firm. Drizzle with hot fudge. Makes 8.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Let sausage come to room temperature. Grate cheese and let come to room temperature. Mix sausage cheese and Bisquick together. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Place on cookie sheet and refrigerate or freeze. After frozen put in a plastic bag. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Keeps for 2 months. Yields approximately 53 balls.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice in water until tender. Heat milk with soup. In a large bowl add soup milk Mozzarella cheese rice and chicken. Cover with shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake until mixture bubbles. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. May be cooked in microwave until bubbly.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter. Mix sugar milk and flour. Pour mixture over butter. Add fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour brown sugar baking powder and baking soda. In another bowl combine oil eggs oatmeal raisins and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened (the batter will be thin). Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes or until the muffins test done. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Sherry Pie
instructions: Line two pie pans with ladyfingers. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Beat egg yolks sugar salt and sherry. Put in double boiler and cook until thick. Add to gelatin. Beat egg whites and the other 1/2 cup sugar until glossy. Fold into mixture. Pour into pie pans. Let cool. Top with whipped cream. Sprinkle chocolate shavings on top!

title: Stromboli
instructions: Brown sausage and hamburger. Drain then add salt pepper green pepper garlic salt and onion. Cook for 30 minutes. Roll out bread. Spread some sauce. Add a layer of ham sausage and hamburger mixture layer of olives layer of both cheeses layer of salami and layer of pepperoni. Add another layer of sauce then add a layer of ham. Close to make a loaf. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Dian'S Casserole
instructions: Fix macaroni and cheese as directed on the box except for the milk leave it out. Fry the hamburger; drain the grease. Mix the can of tomato soup with the hamburger.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Stir together peaches allspice cinnamon butter and sugar in a deep pan on stove top. Bring to a boil.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together well. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well. Cook on hot griddle or skillet greased at 325\u00b0. Top with your favorite fruit syrup or whipped cream.

title: London Broil Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place meat in a Ziploc bag and marinate overnight turning over to be sure both sides have been done. This is not only excellent for beef but also turkey London broil.

title: Fruit Smoothie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Cream together shortening sugars and peanut butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in vanilla. Sift together flour baking powder and salt (if desired). Add to creamed mixture mixing thoroughly. Stir in coconut. Spread batter in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Cool in pan on rack. If desired spread with confectioners sugar frosting. Sprinkle with peanuts. Cut into 3 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Arrange in greased dish with stalks facing each other. Top with the chicken. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and butter and pour over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package instructions. Cook rice according to directions on package. Heat soups. Place broccoli rice and eggs in casserole. Pour heated soup mixture over casserole. Sprinkle 1 cup grated Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and hot and cheese has melted. Serves 3 to 6.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mash the sweet potatoes; add beaten eggs sugar cream cinnamon salt vanilla and melted butter. Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Cook about 35 minutes or until a knife will come out clean.

title: Famous Apple Cheese
instructions: Simmer apples in boiling water until tender. Remove from water; drain and place a layer in a buttered casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over apples. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Stone Jar Cookies
instructions: Heat molasses. Remove from heat and add margarine and soda. Add flour baking powder salt and ginger gradually. Chill. Roll very thin on floured board. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 8 to 10 minutes. Dont overbake. Store in stone jar and they will become very soft.

title: Mom'S Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in large bowl. Mash bananas on large plate with fork; put in bowl. Add shortening eggs vanilla and nuts; mix well. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Grease and flour loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Fresh Blackberry Pie
instructions: Prepare crust. Combine sugar flour and salt. Add to berries. Toss to coat fruit. Fill 9-inch pie plate. Adjust top crust seal and flute edges. Cover edge with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove foil. Bake 25 to 30 minutes more until golden. Cool.

title: Shredded Chicken Or Pork Sandwich
instructions: Shred the chicken or pork into small pieces. Put chicken or pork in saucepan. Add barbecue sauce until meat is well coated. Simmer on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Pile it on your favorite sandwich roll or hamburger bun.

title: Honey Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Season chicken to taste with seasoning salt black pepper and cumin. In a deep pan saute garlic in oil. Add chicken to pan. Brown lightly.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: In a large bowl mix together with hands (let margarine soften) until smooth. Pinch off about 1 tablespoon size of dough; roll in the palm of hands to form a round ball. Place balls on a cookie sheet. When it is filled put in refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening together. Add vanilla. Add flour and eggs. (I mix in eggs with mixer and flour by hand.) Knead dough. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter or something smaller. (Use lots of flour on counter hands rolling pin and dough itself.) Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Dried Apple Stack Cake(60 Years Old)
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and molasses; then add egg and buttermilk. Mix well. Stir in dry ingredients together with vinegar-soda mixture.

title: Smash Cake
instructions: Mix 1st three ingredients by hand and \smash\ into greased pan. Mix last 3 ingredients until smooth and pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Vanilla Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla and butter in saucepan and cook until thickened. Add vanilla and butter. Pour into serving dishes. Top with plastic wrap to prevent skin forming on top.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
instructions: Layer potatoes onion and ham (do not cut up) in a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Blend together oleo flour salt and pepper. Cook for about 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add milk stirring until smooth. Pour over potato mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix stuffing cheese salt and spice in a bowl. Melt butter in a pan. Dip chicken breast in butter cover well then roll in crumb mix. Do one chicken breast at a time. Place on greased baking pan uncovered. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes until crisp.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Cool and break into bite-sized pieces. Place broccoli in baking dish. Cook in microwave about 5 minutes. Arrange chicken on top. Pour on melted oleo then half of the grated cheese. Mix together sour cream and soup (will be thick). Spoon over chicken and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Bourbon Cookies
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Add rest of ingredients stirring after each one is added. Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake about 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Suzannne'S Juicy Chicken
instructions: For each serving of chicken breast salt and pepper as desired and oil with bit of margarine. Place piece on an individual sheet of heavy duty aluminum foil. Pour a little lemon juice dash of Tabasco dash of Worcestershire sauce slice of onion and a small pat of margarine on each breast. Fold and seal each package tightly. Cook on a cookie sheet in a 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Can be cooked ahead.

title: Baked Lima Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight and rinse. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Boil 5 to 7 minutes. Use large casserole or bean pot. Place 1/2 onion in bottom. Put in beans bacon (rolled and placed in the beans) then mix remaining ingredients to cover beans (add water if needed). Place strips of bacon on top; cover with catsup and bake at least 2 hours at 300\u00b0. Add water if beans become dry. Can be baked longer.

title: Sour Cream Salmon Loaf
instructions: Crush corn flakes. Drain off half liquid from salmon. Combine all ingredients. Place in a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0. If firmer texture is desired use less butter and add 1 more egg.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in 200 degree oven for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Coconut Almond Carrot Ring
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Beat sugar and oil at medium speed of electric mixer until well mixed. Stir in flour mixture. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in carrots nuts raisins and 2/3 cup of the coconut.

title: Broccoli Noodle Bake
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan; saute onion green pepper and celery. Put broccoli on top; cover and simmer until broccoli is thawed cook spaghetti according to directions. In a bowl combine soup and milk. In a buttered 3-quart casserole dish layer spaghetti vegetables mushrooms soup and 1 1/2 cups cheese. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until hot and bubbling. Serves 10.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan in the order listed.

title: Minty Lamb Burgers
instructions: These are wonderful. If possible grill over hot coals but are delicious pan-fried also.

title: Meatballs Romanoff
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large skillet. Remove from heat. Blend in flour and sauce mix. Gradually stir in milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Add frozen meatballs; heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 10 minutes. While meatballs simmer cook noodles. Stir parsley flakes and 2 tablespoons butter into noodles. Serve meatballs with sauce over noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: In a large bowl place milk sugar coconut eggs flour butter and vanilla. Stir until combined. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool at room temperature. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Place in refrigerator until it starts to jell. Meanwhile mix sugar and cream cheese. Whip chilled milk in a chilled bowl. Have Cool Whip ready. Beat jello; add everything to jello and mix well. Pour into pie shells. Chill before serving.

title: Easy Rice Pudding(Microwave)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish. Microwave 7 minutes or until boiling. Let stand 5 minutes. Add cinnamon if desired.

title: Dilled Carrots
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add all ingredients. Cover; simmer 12 to 15 minutes until carrots are tender.

title: German Spice Bars(Lebkuchen)
instructions: Heat honey and sugar slightly in a pan. Add butter. Add 2 cups flour and baking powder; beat well. Add nuts citron peels and spices. Add 1 1/2 to 2 more cups flour until you have a thick pliable dough. Pat it 1/4 inch thick into pans (three 8 x 8-inch cake pans and one 9 x 9-inch cake pan). Bake about 25 minutes. When cool cut in squares and ice with Lemon Glaze. Make this ahead for Christmas. Keeps 6 months when in an airtight container!

title: Chicken Pizza Mexicana
instructions: Gas grill. Sprinkle cheese evenly over bread shell. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and grill pizza 4 to 6-inches from medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until crust is crisp and cheese is melted (if crust browns too quickly place a piece of aluminum foil between crust and grill). Makes 4 servings.

title: Cucumber Surprise
instructions: Prepare favorite chicken salad recipe for about 6 people. Place 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken salad (depending on size of cucumber slices) on the cucumber slice and top with a toasted pecan half. Makes 48.

title: Cherry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix together and pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill.

title: Cliff'S Healthy Waffles
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mix all dry ingredients together. In a separate bowl mix buttermilk oil and egg yolks and beat well. Slowly stir buttermilk mixture into dry ingredients until thoroughly mixed. Beat egg whites and fold into batter. Spoon dip batter into preheated waffle iron.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix lemonade with Eagle Brand and Cool Whip. Pour mixture into a graham cracker crust. Chill for at least 1 hour. (Makes enough for two small pies.)

title: Brownies 'N Cream
instructions: Mix together cream cheese vanilla and egg until creamy; set aside. Mix the brownie mix according to package directions except using slightly less water and oil. Spread 3/4 cup of brownie mix in bottom of sprayed 9 x 13 pan. Spoon in filling and spread remaining brownie mix over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle top with additional chips if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Step 1 - Strawberry Glaze Cook water sugar and cornstarch until thick. Remove from heat and add lemon juice food coloring and strawberries. Set aside.

title: Easy Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop on lightly greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake 7 to 9 minutes at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Cactus Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill in refrigerator.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat the eggs then add sugar vanilla oleo and milk. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until center is firm.

title: Crab Delight Fettuccine
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Drain. Heat butter and garlic in skillet on medium until garlic is lightly brown. Add half and half Crab Delight and pepper. Heat about 3 minutes or until mixture just begins to bubble stirring occasionally. Add Parmesan cheese. Stir 1 minute longer. Remove from heat. Toss Crab Delight; save with fettuccine. Serve immediately with Parmesan cheese if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chism Special
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy dutch oven; brown meat with onion garlic and bell pepper until meat is well done. Add soup catsup chili powder and Worcestershire sauce. Stir in corn and olives. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour. Add water as needed to keep sauce liquid or to desired level of thickness. Served over cooked pasta; sprinkle with cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fig Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Cook mashed figs and sugar for 10 to 15 minutes. Add gelatin and boil until it dissolves. Pour into hot sterilized pint jars and seal.

title: Christmas Jello With Eggnog
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1/4 cup cold water. Measure 3/4 cup of lemon jello and save. Add eggnog to rest of lemon jello and pour into mold. Drain juice from pears and add water to make 3/4 cup. Dissolve cherry jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add measured fruit juice and leftover lemon jello to cherry jello. Chill until thickened. When lemon jello is firm enough arrange sliced pears over top. Then gently spoon thickened cherry jello and chill. Can border with whipping cream.

title: Barbecue Beef Brisket
instructions: Marinate overnight the brisket in liquid smoke garlic powder and onion salt. Sprinkle generously. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mint Layer Treat
instructions: Mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Do not grease! Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Test for doneness with toothpick.

title: Toffee Crunch Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Chocolate or vanilla wafers or Oreos (crumbled) may be substituted for coconut macaroons.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine and Crisco with electric mixer. Add sugar and eggs. Now add rest of ingredients and finish mixing. Drop by teaspoonful on baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for about 8-10 minutes. Makes a large batch.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
instructions: Bake pound cake mixture in thin round cake layers (3 to 6 layers). After cool soak layers slightly with sugar and water mixture. Beat whipped cream and put on layers. Grate fresh coconut and place on cake layers.

title: Fluffy Potato Casserole
instructions: Put potatoes into large bowl of electric mixer. Add cream cheese onion eggs and flour. Beat at medium until light and fluffy. Salt and pepper as needed. Spoon into a 9-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle canned onions over top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Heat 2/3 cup cream in a large microwave safe bowl until steaming. Add chips; whisk until smooth. Slowly whisk in remaining cream. Chill in refrigerator for 15 minutes. Beat with mixer just until soft peak forms. Arrange 3 crackers side by side long edges touching on serving plate. Spread evenly with 1/2 cup cream mixture. Repeat 4 more layers. Add one more layer of crackers and chill one hour. Chill remaining cream. Spread top and sides of cake with cream mixture. Chill 4 hours. Garnish with peanut butter chips.

title: Turtles
instructions: Melt over boiling water. Add 2 to 16 ounces coarsely chopped nuts (English walnuts pecans peanuts). Mix well. Drop onto buttered wax paper. Cool. Dip into melted chocolate.

title: Potatoes With Cream Cheese
instructions: Cut slightly thawed hash browns into cubes and put in 2-quart casserole dish. Mix softened cream cheese and half and half in saucepan and place over low heat until well blended. Add spices and pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Rum Slush
instructions: Heat water and sugar until sugar dissolves. Add lemonade orange juice and rum. Stir until juices are dissolved. Freeze in 9 x 13-inch Tupperware container. Spoon in glass and add 7-Up.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat first 7 ingredients together. Add the remainder in order one at a time. Grease 3 loaf pans. Fill 2/3 full and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Soppa
instructions: Boil the fryer; remove meat from bones and save broth. Blend the soup milk and broth. Dip tortillas in hot Crisco oil. Put a layer of tortillas in bottom of casserole dish. Sprinkle onion grated cheese chopped green chilies and chicken pieces over tortillas. Pour sauce over and repeat layers until all tortillas are gone. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hot Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Cook sauerkraut and brown sugar with a little water for 30 minutes; drain. Cut bread in half horizontally.\tSpread bottom half with corned beef (can be softened in microwave for 15 seconds to make easier spreading). Place sauerkraut over corned beef; cover with\tslices\tof cheese. Place on cookie sheet in a 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Cover with top half of bread; return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes.\tCut in wedges.

title: Ambrosia Salad(Kids Love It!)
instructions: Mix well together. Save some coconut and oranges for top. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Jubilee Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in pattie shells or on shallow casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Rich Caramel Sauce
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in a Dutch oven over medium heat stirring occasionally until butter melts; remove mixture from heat. Bring sugar 1/2 cup water and lemon juice to a boil in a Dutch oven over high heat stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium-high and boil stirring occasionally 8 minutes or until mixture begins to brown. Reduce heat to medium and cook stirring 5 minutes or until mixture is caramel colored. Pour sugar mixture gradually into whipping cream mixture. Remove from heat; let stand 1 minute. Whisk until smooth. Cook over medium-low heat stirring occasionally until a candy thermometer registers 230\u00b0 (thread stage); cool. Makes 2 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Cream milk and lemon juice with mixer. Add coconut pineapple and pecans. Fold in Cool Whip. Put in crust and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Cream butter; add flour and sugar. Cream together then add nuts and vanilla. Roll into small balls approximately 1-inch in diameter. Bake in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet. Sift additional confectioners sugar on cookies after baking. Makes about 40 cookies.

title: Fettuccine With Tomato Basil Sauce
instructions: Combine salt pepper garlic and extra virgin olive oil. Then add tomatoes and basil and mix well. Serve over hot fettuccine. Pass Parmesan cheese.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix pesto vinegar and dressing. Add to mixture of vegetables and pasta and toss. Chill before serving.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add nuts and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Melt shortening and add to mixture. Stir in chocolate bits. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ann'S Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle chops with salt pepper and paprika and brown in oil; drain. Blend sauerkraut and onion. In baking dish layer chops sauerkraut then sour cream on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Holiday Fruit Drops
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and eggs well. Stir in soured milk. Measure flour; sift. Blend dry ingredients; stir in. Stir in nuts fruit and dates. Chill at least 1 hour. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until almost no imprint remains when touched.

title: Quick Chicken Paprika
instructions: In hot skillet saute minced onion chopped peppers salt and paprika until onion is golden approximately 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in chicken soup; bring to boiling stirring constantly. Stir in chicken; remove from heat. Stir in sour cream. Delicious served over rice in pastry cups on noodles or toast points.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix sour cream sugar vanilla and coconut. Reserve enough coconut to put on top of cake if desired and refrigerate overnight. Mix and bake cake mix according to directions on box making 2 layers. Slice the layers to make 4 and spread the filling between them.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar in bowl until well blended. Add undrained pineapple; mix well. Add flour. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla; mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup nuts. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.

title: Easy Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Place cooked meat and onions into Pam-sprayed 2-quart baking dish. Add catsup Worcestershire sauce mushrooms (if desired) and 2 tablespoons Bisquick. Stir well and set aside. Combine remaining Bisquick with enough water to form a soft dough. With fingertips dipped in Bisquick press dough into bottom and up sides of casserole. Fill with meat mixture. Sprinkle on cheese. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Spray 12 muffin cups with cooking spray. Combine first 4 ingredients. In small bowl blend egg orange peel juice and oil. Stir in flour mixture until moistened. Stir in cranberries and nuts. Spread in muffin cups. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake 18 to 22 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Hot Dog Bean Casserole
instructions: Stir together in a 2-quart baking dish all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 5 (3/4 cup) servings. Top with cheese if desired.

title: Jeff Davis Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour and cream with butter. Beat until light and frothy. Add eggs. Pour into unbaked pastry-lined pan. Bake as for custard pie about 40 minutes starting with hot oven to set pastry then reduce heat for remainder of baking time. Top with meringue when cool.

title: Gravy
instructions: Add the flour to the drippings. Stir. Slowly add the water and stir until the gravy thickens. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix vinegar oil and sugar. Bring to a boil and pour over top of tossed ingredients listed.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with a layer of frozen Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot Garlic Pickles
instructions: Drain all pickle juice from jar. Add remaining ingredients to jar and reseal. Place jar upright on kitchen counter the first day. Place upside-down the second day. Continue this for 5 days.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in salt water till nearly done. Drain water from noodles. Mix all but cracker crumbs and grated cheese in casserole dish. Top with crackers and cheese. Bake at 350 till lightly brown on top. Serve hot.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix drained tuna and green onions with mayonnaise. Add salt to taste. Add macaroni and sliced hard-boiled eggs and mix together. Pour into serving bowl. Save 1 sliced egg to decorate top of salad. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Put layer of macaroni in bottom of casserole. Mix rest with tuna and vegetables. Put in dish and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Mix butter thyme and cayenne pepper. Spread evenly over tenderloin. Place tenderloin in shallow roasting pan and pour 3/4 cup orange juice over meat. Roast in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes to 155\u00b0 to 160\u00b0 on meat thermometer basting occasionally. Remove meat to serving platter. Keep warm. Measure basting liquid into small saucepan adding additional orange juice if necessary to make 3/4 cup. Quickly whisk in flour sugar and butter. Cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens. Cut tenderloin in 1-inch slices and serve with sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Prepare vegetables and cut in cubes. Cook celery and onions slowly in oil for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and boil until vegetables are soft about 1 hour. Add more water if needed.

title: Pork Roast
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut in large cubes. Peel carrots; cut into 2-inch lengths and quarter lengthwise. Cut onion to form rings. Cut apple into wedges and remove core. Cook roast for 30 minutes on grill (medium heat) turning occasionally to brown on all sides. Place roast in roasting pan and place the rest of ingredients around roast. Cover and cook for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0; season to taste.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Combine cornmeal and sugar in bowl; mix well. Stir in butter. Add water gradually beating constantly until smooth. Stir in buttermilk and eggs; mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 12 servings.

title: Gismos
instructions: Cut the tortillas into quarters. Press small chunks of beef on each of the tortillas. Cut small slices of pepper and press into the beef. Cut domino-shaped pieces of Swiss cheese to lay on top of each tortilla but first shake salt on each. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Slide in each pan after 20 minutes. Keep an eye on them to get them cooked just right.

title: Orange Pork Chops
instructions: Dust chops with flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Brown chops in hot butter about 5 minutes on each side. Combine brown sugar orange rind and juice; pour over chops. Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes. Arrange orange slices on meat; simmer another 5 minutes. Transfer chops and slices to a heated platter. Add 2 tablespoons water to sauce in skillet; stir and heat well. Pour over meat.

title: Quick Skillet Dinner
instructions: Cook sausage in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes. Add onions and cook stirring occasionally about 3 minutes. Add rice and mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients except pepper. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in green pepper. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs milk and butter. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pickled Mushrooms
instructions: Cut the stems off the mushrooms. Wash and place in a saucepan and cover them with water. Bring water to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Drain immediately. Put mushrooms in a quart jar and add all the remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for several hours or longer but remove garlic after 48 hours. Can be stored in refrigerator for weeks. Makes 36 or 5 cups.

title: Lemon Coconut Bars
instructions: In a medium bowl combine flour and confectioners sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Press onto bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cottage Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine beef catsup tomato juice salt pepper red pepper eggs crumbs onions and 2 teaspoons mustard in a large bowl. Mix well. Line a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with foil. Press in the mixture.

title: Underwood Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Crust Put Crisco in bowl; add 2 1/4 cups flour and mix well. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and enough water to make ingredients cling together. Roll dough until very thin.

title: Chicken And Filling
instructions: Mix chicken with remaining ingredients. Put in roasting pan or baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Save rest of broth for gravy to serve on top. Very simple and good for company or home use.

title: Creole Red Bean Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. Mix all ingredients. Great with barbecue!

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients; blend well. Shape into small balls about 1 inch in diameter. Place on cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. These can be frozen and kept on hand for breakfast or snacks. If frozen bake for 20 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Date Nut Pudding
instructions: Mix dates soda and boiling water and let set until cold. Meanwhile mix white sugar egg flour walnuts margarine and vanilla together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Let yeast dissolve. Then add shortening sugar and egg beaten to this water and flour to stiffen rolls after they raise. Spread butter sugar cinnamon and nuts. Put into the pan. Let raise then bake. Ice with powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Cornflake Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water. Add cornflakes and nuts; mix well. Drop by tablespoon on waxed paper. Let set overnight until firm. Do not set in refrigerator.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Place cabbage in a bowl. Mix all other ingredients in a separate bowl and then pour over cabbage and toss. Garnish with sliced olives.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook onions in butter until tender in Dutch oven; drain. Return onions to Dutch oven with potato salt marjoram pepper and water. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer just until potato is tender about 15 minutes. Add cream-style corn whole kernel corn and evaporated milk. Heat through. Makes 6 servings. I usually double the water and milk so its a little more soupy.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Put Oreo cookies in blender to make them look like dirt. Set them aside. Cream the cream cheese and butter. Add pudding sugar and milk then fold in the Cool Whip. In a large container put a line of the dirt then the pudding until you reach the top with the dirt on top.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; mix. Then add dry ingredients and mix. Then add apples and nuts. This makes a very stiff batter. Pour into Bundt pan. Spray with Pam or Crisco. I sprinkle with sugar so the cake will not stick. Bake about 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Cheese Fondue
instructions: Combine onion soup mix tomato juice and lemon juice in pan and heat. As the juice simmers add small portions of cheese until melted. Place in fondue pot. Dip small sausage balls small hamburger balls diced hot dogs or diced French bread.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to directions. Drain (yields about 3 1/4 cups). Stir margarine or butter into hot spaghetti. Stir in well-beaten eggs and Parmesan cheese. Press spaghetti mixture into a buttered 10-inch plate forming a crust.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt butter; add Bisquick. Stir until bubbly on medium heat add milk. Stir until thick. Add cheese and cooked broccoli. Stir until blended.

title: Beef Roast And Gravy
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Place roast in baking pan with 2-inch sides. Season with pepper. Bake in oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until center is slightly pink. Meanwhile saute onion in butter. Slice roast with electric knife into thin slices. Remove from pan. Add water to drippings. Stir in cornstarch or flour to thicken. Add salt and onion. Return meat to pan and continue cooking until gravy is hot and thickened slightly.

title: Rhubarb And Strawberry Jam
instructions: Combine rhubarb (cut up) and sugar. Mix and let set overnight. In the morning bring to a boil and boil 8 minutes then add the package of Jell-O. Mix well and put in sterile jars and seal.

title: Springerle(German Christmas Cookies)
instructions: With electric mixer beat eggs until light. Gradually add sugar and continue beating on high speed for 15 minutes or until like soft meringue. Add anise oil. Sift together flour and soda; blend into egg mixture on low speed. Cover bowl tightly with waxed paper or foil and let stand about 15 minutes (for easier handling).

title: Betty'S Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together. (Will be pink.) Wonderful also as a dressing on fruit salad plates.

title: Lemon Danish
instructions: Open crescent rolls and cut diagonally to form triangle shapes. Mix together all other ingredients and add the mixture to the middle of each triangle. Bring the three corners to the middle and pinch together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Mix together confectioners sugar lemon extract and milk to make a glaze.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain squash and mash with a fork. Use 1/2 as much bread crumbs as squash. Add remaining ingredients along with margarine last (melted). Mix well and cook 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: In a heavy medium saucepan melt confectioners coating and chocolate pieces over low heat stirring constantly. Stir in peanuts or cashews.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix flour with sugar. Add eggs and beat until well mixed (by hand). Add butter (melted) and mix well. Add coconut. Add milk and mix well (warm milk for faster cooking). Cook at 350\u00b0 about 30 to 40 minutes. Test corner of pie with knife to check degree of doneness.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach and drain. Melt oleo saute onion and all spices then add cheese to melt. Add milk. Mix in drained spinach. Put in casserole dish and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and brown.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham crackers and 1 stick margarine and press in pan. Combine 1 stick margarine sugar and egg. Slice bananas over crust. Add pineapple. Then pour mixture evenly over all. Lastly Cool Whip. Decorate with cherries on top. Refrigerate until cold. Cut into squares.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Place whole breast on cutting board rib side down. Cut in half. With a boning knife trim the meat away from the breast bone following contour of rib cage and pulling meat away as you cut. Repeat with the remaining breasts.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs. Bake in casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes t 375\u00b0.

title: Meat Loaf Meal
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add other ingredients and mix. Place in casserole and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Crunch
instructions: Mix well and spread in Pam sprayed 12 x 9-inch pan.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove from broth and set aside to cool. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. When tender partially drain leaving enough broth to be slightly soupy. Add cheese soup and Ro-Tel. Cook over very low heat stirring constantly until cheese is melted. Remove skin and bones from chicken. Break into bite size pieces. Stir into spaghetti. Add black pepper to taste.

title: Baked Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli in small amount of water and drain then cut up. Mix the soup with milk and heat until it boils. Stir in the pimiento and water chestnuts. Arrange broccoli in buttered shallow baking dish and pour soup mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Manicotti
instructions: Mix together the ground beef beans onion oregano 1 1/2 tablespoons of seasoning mix and 1 cup of cheese. With a small spoon or using fingers press meat mixture into shells. Arrange in a 12 x 8-inch microwave-safe baking dish.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in bowl. In large bowl cover the crackers with this mix. Add oil and toss. Bake 30 minutes at 225\u00b0. (If making 1/2 batch use 1/3 cup oil.)

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all together and pour into an 8 x 10-inch baking dish (sprayed with Pam). Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes until firm.

title: Cocoa Peanut Butter Chip Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle chips on bottom of crust. In medium saucepan over low heat melt butter. Add cocoa stir until smooth. Add sweetened condensed milk and water. Stir with whisk until well blended. Stir in egg and vanilla. Remove from heat. Pour into crust. Bake for 30 minutes or until edges are set (center will firm while cooling). Cool slightly. Garnish with whipped topping (if desired). Serve warm or at room temperature. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lemon Bisque
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water. Add sugar salt lemon juice and rind. Put milk in freezer until ice crystals form. Beat milk until stiff and whip slightly congealed Jell-O into it. Spread crumbs in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Pour mixture over crumbs saving some crumbs to put on top. Chill 3 hours or longer. Serves 12 to 15 people.

title: Refrigerated Cabbage
instructions: Shred cabbage pepper and onion; chop celery. Mix all together. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Boil separately sugar water and cocoa until cocoa is dissolved. Mix together milk egg yolks and flour. Combine all and cook until mixture thickens.

title: Boy Scout Brownsie Taters
instructions: Chill salad dressing. Shake well and cover bottom of large iron skillet with 1/8-inch of salad dressing. Heat. Add onions fries peppers and seasonings. Cover while cooking stirring occasionally. When taters are done remove from heat. Sprinkle cheese over and let melt.

title: Sunday Rolls
instructions: In a large bowl mix ingredients thoroughly. Cover and let stand 8 hours or overnight on counter. Next morning turn out on floured board and knead lightly. Roll 1/2-inch thick and cut into rolls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Let rise 4 to 6 hours. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Muffins
instructions: Combine flour egg oil and ice cream in bowl. Beat until smooth. Stir in berries. Fill well-greased muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheese Bars
instructions: Press 1 tube of rolls into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Mix cheese sugar egg and vanilla until smooth. Spread over rolls in pan and cover with 2nd tube of rolls. Top with 1/4 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Mix together and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer pinched up lettuce on bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Add layer of green peas. Slice onion and pepper into thin rings. Place layer of these on top of peas. Add layer of bacon bits and cheese. Just before serving pour dressing on top in crisscross pattern.

title: Excellent Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Melt butter. Blend in flour. Add milk. Cook and stir until thick. Add salt pepper onion and cheese. Stir until cheese is melted. Mix sauce with macaroni. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with crushed crackers if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly and browned.

title: Perfect Apple Dumplings
instructions: To make sauce combine sugar water cinnamon and nutmeg. Boil 5 minutes add butter.

title: Zucchini Bake
instructions: Combine zucchini tomatoes onion cheese seasoning and Bisquick. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. In blender process eggs and oil. Pour over casserole. Top with extra cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients; sprinkle paprika or salad seasoning on top. Serves approximately 20.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except peas with enough mayonnaise to mix well. Fold in peas gently. Chill and serve.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: In plastic bag combine lemon juice oil garlic and bouillon; add chicken. Marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight. Remove chicken from marinade. Grill of broil as desired basting frequently with marinade. Slice chicken into strips. Place on tortillas. Top with garnishes and cheese. Fold tortillas. Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
instructions: Combine oil and sugar; beat until smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add hot water then dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Stir in potatoes nuts and vanilla; beat well.
