Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in mixture. Bake in 3 greased 8-inch layer pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Roux
instructions: Combine oil and flour in heavy pot preferably cast-iron. Cook mixture over low heat; stir constantly until a rich caramel color is reached. When desired color is obtained add chopped seasoning (onion bell pepper and celery) in order to lower temperature and keep roux from burning. Continue to stir. Always add hot water or liquid to roux. Cold water will cause roux to curdle and flour and oil to separate.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: For cake preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine cake mix pudding mix eggs water peanut butter and oil. Using low speed of an electric mixer beat until moistened. Increase speed of mixer to medium and beat 2 minutes longer. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan and springs back when lightly pressed. Cool in pans 10 minutes; invert onto a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Punch
instructions: Put softened sherbets in bowl and add rest of the ingredients. Stir.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Mix all together; let simmer. Serve with grated cheese and corn chips.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese until it is very smooth. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Pour in with cheese. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill. Mold or use regular dessert dish and cut in squares.

title: Scrambled Eggs(Microwave)
instructions: Melt butter in microproof bowl on High for 30 to 45 seconds. Add eggs milk salt and pepper; stir. Microwave on High 1 1/4 to 1 3/4 minutes or until eggs start to set. Stir eggs after 1/2 time. Remove eggs while they are still soft and moist. Let stand 2 minutes. Eggs will firm up during standing time. If desired add cheese.

title: Easy Apple Cake
instructions: Beat the eggs with a spoon or fork. Add the sugar and oil. Sift the flour baking powder salt and cinnamon together. Add flour mixture to first mixture with vanilla. Fold in the apples and chopped walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 to 55 minutes in a 13-inch pan or two 8-inch square pans for 40 to 45 minutes. Use half the recipe in an 8-inch square pan.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix and let set overnight the first 5 ingredients. Use processor.

title: Tomato Soup Salad
instructions: Heat undiluted soup until hot but not boiling. Stir in lemon jello until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potatoes and put immediately in milk. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix and drop from tablespoon onto a greased frying pan. Cook until well browned and crisp on both sides. Serve hot.

title: Cranberry Fruit Pops
instructions: In a blender container process crushed pineapple until smooth; add cranberry apple drink and yogurt. Process until completely blended. Pour into 2 ice cube trays. Freeze about 1 hour until partially firm. Place wooden stick in center of each cube. Freeze until hard. Makes 28 pops.

title: Seafood Appetizers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Thaw shrimp as directed on package. Drain well pressing between paper towels to remove excess water. Cut shrimp into small pieces. Unroll dough onto ungreased cookie sheet. Press dough to form a 12 x 8 inch rectangle firmly pressing any perforations in dough to seal. Top dough with the remaining ingredients in this order shrimp imitation crab meat seafood seasoning garlic powder cheese and parsley flakes. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Cut into squares. Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Creamy Reception Punch
instructions: Spoon orange sherbet by tablespoons into a large punch bowl. Stir in orange juice and lemon juice. Slowly pour in chilled lemon-lime carbonated beverage; stir gently to mix. Makes 36 ounces.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown meat in oil in skillet. Add other ingredients in Dutch oven. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. (Can put in crock-pot for 4 to 5 hours.)

title: Grandbuddy'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into a meat loaf pan or bread loaf pan. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 1 hour or until done. Serve hot with a tomato sauce. Serves 8.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook enough potatoes that when mashed makes about 2 1/2 quarts. Add margarine and enough milk to thin. Add mayonnaise mustard pickles onion and eggs. Mix well. Top with egg slices. Serve hot or cold.

title: Cream Cheese Cherry Dessert
instructions: To the crushed crackers add the melted oleo sugar and gelatine. Mix all together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pat down and chill.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Cook margarine sugar and dates over low heat stirring constantly until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring. Add 2 cups Rice Krispies and 1 cup chopped nuts. Let cool. Roll into small balls in confectioners sugar. Makes approximately 3 dozen.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0. Bake in 3 layers or an oblong pan. Cool. Spread icing over cake.

title: Shrimp-Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cut large shrimp in half combine shrimp macaroni cauliflower celery parsley and pickle. Combine mayonnaise French dressing lemon juice and seasonings; mix thoroughly. Add mayonnaise mixture to shrimp mixture and toss lightly. Chill; serve on salad greens and garnish with egg slices.

title: Russian Teacakes
instructions: Take 2 big rolls frozen cookie dough. Slice it thin. Put on cookie sheets by loving hands of all the G.A.s touching the cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 4 to 7 minutes. Cool and put in Baggies to give to a lonely person.

title: Creamy Corn
instructions: Combine corn cream cheese and mushroom pieces in saucepan. Heat over low heat until creamy. Stir continually will scorch easily.

title: Texas Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter egg yolks and lemon extract. Add flour and baking soda mixture. Mix well. Fold in fruit and nuts that have been dredged in flour. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Heat oven to 200\u00b0. Grease 2 cookie sheets. 15 1/2 x 12 inches with butter; keep warm in oven (keeping the cookie sheets warm allows the candy to be spread 1/4 inch thick without it setting up). Grease long metal spatula with butter; set aside.

title: Seafood Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and drain mushrooms. Hollow out and chop enough of the pieces to make 3 tablespoons. Cook pieces with onion garlic and 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil. Stir in crab shrimp Prosciutto and cheese along with catsup. Stuff into mushroom crowns; sprinkle with fine soft bread crumbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Fettucini With Blue Cheese Sauce
instructions: Cook fettucini in boiling salted water. While cooking pasta prepare sauce. Melt butter and cheese over low heat. Gradually stir in cream walnuts and wine. Bring to boil then whisk a bit of the sauce into the egg yolk. Return the mixture to the sauce and stir continuously over gentle heat until thickened do not allow it to boil. Stir in the parsley and pour mixture over cooked and drained pasta. Serve immediately with crusty bread. Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Swedish Pan-Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar. Beat together until well mixed. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or more.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for one hour. Stir after 1/2 hour and take the lid off for the last half hour.

title: Laundry Spray
instructions: Mix well and pour into used spray bottles. This will remove most stains and grease stains.

title: Chocolate Bourbon Balls
instructions: Cream 1/4 cup softened butter. Gradually add the sugar alternately with the bourbon beating until thick and smooth. Shape measuring 1/2 teaspoons of mixture in small balls using sugar on hands if necessary. Press a pecan half on each side of ball and chill. Melt chocolate with 1 1/2 teaspoon of butter in top of double boiler. Dip one end of each candy in the chocolate and put on cookie sheet covered with wax paper. Chill. Makes about 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni and set aside. Mix cottage cheese and sour cream with a little under half the bag of cheese. Then combine mixture with macaroni. Spray a 13 x 9 pan with cooking spray and pour macaroni mixture into pan. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese bubbles or turns golden brown whichever is preferred. Enjoy!

title: One Bowl Brownies
instructions: Microwave chocolate and butter in a large bowl on High 2 minutes or until melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir sugar into chocolate. Mix in eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Potato-Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook green pepper and onion in a saucepan coated with vegetable spray over medium heat stirring constantly 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in broth chopped potato and pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Combine cornstarch and milk stirring until smooth. Gradually add to potato mixture stirring constantly. Stir in corn. Boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Serve immediately.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a small bowl combine flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. In a large bowl cream margarine granulated sugar brown sugar eggs and vanilla. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats and butterscotch morsels and drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 7 to 8 minutes for chewy cookies 9 to 10 minutes for crispy cookie. Cool for 2 minutes and remove from baking sheets.

title: Slow Cooked Pork Chops
instructions: Fry pork chops. Put in slow cooker or drain oil and leave in skillet. Add soup water green pepper and onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook until pork chops are tender.

title: Caramel Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine the margarine sugar egg yolk eggs buttermilk baking soda flour and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into three greased layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Twice - Baked Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake potatoes for 1 hour or until tender. Cut shallow lengthwise slice from 1 side of potatoes and scoop out pulp reserving shells. Combine pulp with butter milk chives seasonings and half the cheese. Beat until light and fluffy. Spoon pulp into reserved shells. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Cook meat with seasonings except salt and pepper in Dutch oven. Bring to a boil then cook on low heat 3 to 4 hours until done. Add salt and pepper to taste during the last 30 minutes of cooking. Place sliced green peppers on top of beef and steam until tender. Remove meat from broth and cool. Slice beef thin and return to broth. Serve on Italian bread.

title: Tomato Aspic
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Combine and gradually heat other liquids. Pour in gelatin and stir. Let liquid cool. Oil mold. Sprinkle onions celery and olives on bottom (chopped very fine). Works great to chop vegetables in blender with some water added then strain pressing out water. Pour cooled mixture in mold. Chill until firm. (I mix vegetables right into liquid and pour in a bowl; works fine.) Excellent for the holidays or anytime. Serve a little dab of mayo on top. A real tradition in the Roseberry family!

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: In heavy skillet cook onions in heated butter until slightly browned. Sprinkle with flour and cook over low flame until golden never allowing them to become dark brown. Add consomme and water. Bring to boil stirring constantly with a wooden spoon then simmer gently for 20 minutes. Spoon into casserole or individual bowls. Place slices of bread on top. Sprinkle generously with cheese. Add pepper. Sprinkle with melted butter. Brown quickly under broiler flame. Serves 4 to 6.

title: No Cheese Cheese Cake
instructions: Press into pan (reserve 1/2 cup for top).

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs. Pour into square well-buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Cook for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease bottom of Bundt pan. Sprinkle half of nuts on bottom; arrange rolls on top of nuts. Combine margarine sugar cinnamon pudding and nuts; pour over top. Let set in a cool oven overnight. The next morning tuck rolls back inside pan and remove from oven. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 20 to 25 minutes then turn upside-down on plate.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Put in casserole dish mix squash cheese crackers eggs tomatoes with beef and onion. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 min.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Pack okra tightly in jars. Add a few hot peppers and a button of garlic to each pint. Bring to a boil the water vinegar salt and sugar. Pour over okra in jars and seal. Let age about 3 weeks.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes or until liquid decreases to 1/2 cup. Cool. Cream shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Add other ingredients alternately to cream mixture. Drop by 2 heaping teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 40 large cookies.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Salt eggplant and leave for 30 minutes to drain. Pat dry. Heat 6 tablespoons olive oil in a large heavy pan. Add eggplant. Brown on all sides. Remove. Drain on paper. Add more oil. Cook zucchini until moisture has evaporated. Remove. Drain. Cook peppers. Remove. Drain. Add onions. Cook until soft not brown. Stir in tomatoes garlic sugar parsley and thyme. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add the rest of the vegetables. After 5 minutes remove from heat. Mix in basil. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cheddar Cheese Popovers
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; beat with an electric mixer just until smooth. Place a well-greased muffin pan in oven at 450\u00b0 for 3 minutes or until a drop of water sizzles when dropped in pan. Remove pan from oven; pour 1 tablespoon of batter into each cup. Sprinkle each with 1 teaspoon cheese; fill each cup 3/4 full with remaining batter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Pour in bowl. Mix in soup and tuna. Add cheese on top. Cook in oven until cheese is melted and warmed up.

title: Tabooley - Wheat Garden Salad
instructions: Soak wheat in cold water for 45 minutes. Change water several times. Use sieve; press to squeeze dry. Chop parsley mint leaves and tomatoes very fine. Add wheat lemon juice oil salt and pepper. Mix well. Serve with fresh lettuce leaves or serve in pita bread. Serves 6.

title: Brandon'S Brownie Dessert
instructions: Mix and bake brownies according to directions on box. Let cool. Mix up chocolate according to directions on box.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Mix together cake mix pudding poppy seed oil and water. Add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Pour into prepared Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Banana Clay
instructions: Peel bananas and freeze them in an airtight container. Remove from freezer when frozen solid and blend in blender with a little water or orange juice.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine cookie crumbs and butter. Press firmly into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. In a large mixer bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. In a small bowl toss 1/2 cup chips with flour to coat; stir into cheese mixture. Pour into crust. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup chips evenly over top. Bake for 1 hour or until it springs back when lightly touched.

title: Green Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix cheeses garlic and green chilies together. Stir in nuts. This is really good on Club crackers. You may roll it into a ball and roll in nuts if you wish.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix milk and pudding until smooth. Beat. Fold in half container of Cool Whip. Line dish with wafers. Pour a layer of pudding bananas and wafers ending with pudding on top. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle with wafer crumbs if desired.

title: Heavenly Delight
instructions: For crust mix together flour 1/2 cup chopped pecans and margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Mix cream cheese confectioners sugar half of the Cool Whip and 1/4 cup pecans. Pour over cooled crust. Mix instant pudding and milk. Pour over cream cheese mixture then add rest of Cool Whip.

title: German Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover tightly and keep in the refrigerator.

title: Passover Tsimmes Kugel *
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Uncover and continue baking an additional 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12 easily.

title: Fluffy Biscuits
instructions: In a bowl combine the flour baking powder sugar and salt. Cut in shortening until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. In a small bowl beat egg and milk; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Turn onto a well floured surface; knead 20 times. Roll to 3/4-inch thickness; cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm; great with apple butter.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine first four ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape into balls about the size of a quarter. Brown on all sides in a dry skillet; drain on paper towels. Drain fat from skillet then add remaining ingredients. Stir well. Return meatballs to sauce. Refrigerate until time to use. When ready to use reheat simmering for 20 minutes. Serve in a chafing dish with cocktail picks. Yields 36 balls. For a party of 50 triple recipe.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix all together in micro-safe dish and heat until cheese melts. Stir and serve with tortilla chips. Decorate top with chopped olives. Teens love it!

title: Calico Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions in large pan. Then add catsup brown sugar vinegar salt and mustard; mix well. Then add beans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes large casserole or several small ones. Freezes well. Thaw and reheat.

title: Marshmallow Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in 5-quart saucepan. Add marshmallows and cook over low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted. Mixture should be syrupy. Remove from heat and add Rice Krispies. Stir until well coated. Press mixture firmly into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cut into squares when cool. Enjoy.

title: Rolled Chicken Breast
instructions: Sprinkle chicken breast with tenderizer garlic salt and seasoning salt. Fold chicken breast in half around slice of cheese and wrap with slice of bacon. Top with soup and bread crumbs. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Pickled Beets
instructions: Boil the beets until tender about 2 hours. Remove them from heat and peel. Slice 1/4-inch slices. Put the vinegar sugar and spice bag in a kettle and boil for a few minutes or until sugar is well dissolved. Add the beets to the syrup and bring it back to the boiling point. Remove from heat. Pack while hot in sterilized jars and seal. Makes about 8 or 9 pints.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Pour lemon juice over crushed bananas and mix all. Pour into cups and put in freezer for 1 hour. Top with maraschino cherries. Freeze overnight. Makes 25 (5 ounce) cups or 35 (3 ounce) cups.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar cooking oil and vinegar. Sift flour and soda together. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake in a tube pan for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Test with a toothpick.

title: Cranberry-Apple Jello Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and apples and mix with sugar. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water or juice. Add cold water and refrigerate until Jell-O thickens then add fruit mix.

title: Peanut Butter Chews
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: My Grandmother'S Easter Soup(Traditional Sicilian)
instructions: Put broth and water into a 10-cup saucepan over medium heat. Mix next 8 ingredients together and form into small meat balls (1-inch size) and drop into boiling liquid. Let simmer 3/4 hour.

title: Dump-It Dessert Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In lightly greased 9 x 12 inch baking pan spread pineapple and top with pie filling. Sprinkle dry cake mix over this. Slice margarine into 12 slices and dot over top. Cover all with coconut. bake for 1 hour or until golden. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Pecan Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: In mixing beat cream cheese until smooth. Add 1/2 c sugar salt 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Beat just to combine. Spread mixture on bottom of pastry. Sprinkle pecans over cream cheese mixture. Lightly beat 3 eggs. Add 3 tbsp sugar syrup melted butter and 1 tsp vanilla. Place pie on a baking sheet on oven rack. Slowly and carefully pour syrup mixture over pecans. Cover edge of pie crust with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 min. Remove foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 min. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 min. more till knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool before serving. Refrigerate leftovers. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pecan Crispies
instructions: Cream shortening butter sugar and eggs. Beat well dry ingredients add to creamed mixture and add nuts. Drop by tsp. about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Season and brown chops. Place over rice in casserole dish. Place onion and pepper on top of each chop. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour consomme over all. Bake for one hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Indian Punch
instructions: Boil the sugar lemon rinds and 1 quart water for 5 minutes. Cool then add remaining ingredients except ginger ale. Chill. When ready to serve add ginger ale.

title: C.C.'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package; drain. Pour in casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Fettucini Alfredo(Lo-Fat)
instructions: Melt margarine. Saute whole cloves until brown. Remove garlic. Mix sour cream yogurt and Parmesan cheese and put in skillet with butter.

title: Gram Ingraham'S Dumplings(Ora B. Plumlee Ingraham)
instructions: Roll out 1/4 inch thick; cut in squares. Drop squares in boiling broth; cover and cook. Take chicken out of broth and serve apart from dumplings.

title: Quick Cheeseburger Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Generously grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cook beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown. Drain. Stir in soup vegetables and milk. Stir baking mix and water in baking dish until moistened. Spread evenly. Spread beef mixture over batter. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain the vegetables. Combine with onion celery and pimentos. Pour dressing over vegetables.

title: Dutch Apple Cake
instructions: Beat egg in mixer bowl until foamy. Add sugar; beat well. Add apples pecans flour baking powder and vanilla; mix well. Pour into greased and floured 4 x 8-inch loaf pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool. Serve warm with whipped cream. Cake will rise to top of pan and fall leaving a crusty top. Yield 12 servings.

title: Hamburger And French Fries
instructions: First mix ground meat pepper salt and water. Cook the meat in a pan on the stove for one hour. Put the meat on the buns.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Set jello using water and 1 cup juice. Add drained fruit before jello sets. Let set. Cook 1 cup juice sugar flour egg and butter. Let cool. After it cools mix 1 envelope Dream Whip according to directions on package. Carefully fold into cooked mixture. Spread on top of jello and fruit. Refrigerate.

title: Date Nut Bread(Made In Soup Cans)
instructions: Put chopped dates in a saucepan and add cup of water. Bring to a boil. Set aside to cool. In another bowl beat eggs. Add sugar and vanilla or rum and mix well. Then sift together flour baking powder salt and soda.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine the ingredients and place into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes two pies.

title: Chicken Souffle
instructions: Line 9 x 13-inch buttered pan with bread; top with chicken. Add mushrooms then water chestnuts then cheese. Combine eggs milk and salt and pour over chicken etc. Mix soups melted butter mayonnaise and pimento and spread on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake 15 minutes longer at 325\u00b0.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Put hash browns in 9 x 13-inch baking dish and let thaw. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over hash browns. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar blend in flour and vanilla gently mix in chips. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Wrap dough by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix the flour sugar cocoa and soda. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Shrimp Enchiladas
instructions: Melt margarine and saute onion until tender. Add soup and heat. Add cream cheese and melt. Add half jar pimento. Fill tortillas with mixture and fold over. Pour rest of mixture and pimento over them. Top with other cheese. Heat in oven until hot and melted.

title: No-Bake Oaties
instructions: Melt butter or margarine and stir in sugar. Add juice and rind. Heat stirring until sugar dissolves. Stir in the oats and nuts. Chill mixture for an hour. Shape into balls. Roll balls in coconut flakes. Makes about 30.

title: Chocolate Pixies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Melt butter and chocolate squares. Cool slightly. Blend in sugar and one egg at a time and beat one minute. Add walnuts and dry ingredients. Mix well. Chill at least 30 minutes. Shape into balls using 1 teaspoon of dough for each. Roll in sugar. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Freeze It And Forget It Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine syrup egg sugar salt flour and vinegar in saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Cool. Add fruit to cooked mixture. Chill Carnation in refrigerator tray until soft ice crystals form around edges of tray (10 to 15 minutes.) Add lemon juice; whip very stiff (1 minute.) Fold into fruit mixture. Spoon into 6 cup mold. Freeze until firm about 5 to 6 hours.

title: Apricot Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 1 to 1 1/2 quart casserole. Arrange potatoes in casserole. Mix sugar cornstarch salt cinnamon and orange peel in heavy quart saucepan. Add apricot nectar and water. Cook on high until mixture comes to boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in apricots and margarine. Pour evenly over potatoes. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes (uncovered).

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes onion and bacon in casserole dish. Mix soup and milk; pour over potatoes. Cook in microwave for 10 minutes. Mix in Cheez Whiz. Cook 10 minutes longer or until potatoes are done.

title: Gooseberry Pudding
instructions: Cream margarine and 1/3 cup sugar well. Add baking powder and flour mix well. Add milk to creamed mixture. Spread in greased 8-inch pie pan. Top with berries. Sprinkle 1 cup sugar over berries dot with margarine and pour boiling water over all. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Chocolate Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until thick; pour into baked pie shells. Top with meringue. Bake until meringue is brown.

title: Toffee Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate together. Spread by hand into a greased 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Do not overbake. While cookies are still warm spread chocolate over them.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Prepare spaghetti sauce mix according to directions. Add oregano and parsley. Melt butter in frying pan and add bread dressing. Toss until brown. Put zucchini in bottom of casserole. Spoon part of sauce over it. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Top with Mozzarella and tomato slices. Add remainder of sauce and rest of bread; top with cheese. Bake 30 to 45 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: This recipe makes 3 or 4 pie crusts. Dough may be frozen in a freezer bag for future use.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except tomato sauce and syrup. Bake in loaf pan for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Pour mixture of tomato sauce and syrup over meat loaf. Baste 2 to 3 times while cooking next 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Onion Soup
instructions: In large saucepan saute onion in butter until soft. Stir in flour; cook over low heat stirring for 3 minutes. Remove pan from heat; add chicken broth stirring and add cauliflower and bring to boil. Simmer for 30 minutes. Puree in blender in 2 batches and return to saucepan. Add milk cream cayenne pepper white pepper and salt to taste. Cook until hot and serve sprinkled with minced parsley. Serves four.

title: Biscuit Tortoni(An Italian Dessert)
instructions: Soak crumbs in milk with powdered sugar and salt for 1/2 hour. Fold whipped cream and vanilla into softened macaroons. Fill paper baking cups in cupcake tins. Decorate with maraschino cherry bits. Freeze without stirring.

title: U. P. Skinny Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Pasta Con Broccoli
instructions: Cook shells and drain. Cook broccoli and drain. Saut mushrooms in butter. Mix all ingredients together and simmer over low heat. Add salt pepper and garlic powder to taste.

title: Dry Mixture For Barbecue
instructions: Mix and store in a glass jar. Keep lid on tight. This will keep for years.

title: Tuna Tempties
instructions: Mix all ingredients; spread on buns. Wrap in foil and place in a shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until heated through and the cheese melts.

title: Banana Stars Cookies
instructions: Mix the ingredients well in large bowl. Roll out and cut into star shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes. Makes 2 to 3 dozen.

title: Microwave Fat-Free Risotto
instructions: Place onions in an 11 x 8 1/2 x 2-inch (28 x 21.5 x 5-cm) dish. Cook uncovered at 100% for 2 minutes in a 650 to 700 watt oven. Stir in rice and cook uncovered for 1 minute or until rice is milky-white but not browned.

title: Tomato Delight
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Add 2 to 3 slices of tomatoes. Chill at least 4 hours and better if overnight.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to instructions on box. Bake in 12 x 18-inch or 11 x 15-inch pan. When done let cool completely before adding the rest of the topping.

title: One-Step Salmon Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Meanwhile chop celery. Drain salmon. Break into large chunks. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole combine celery condensed soup milk frozen broccoli lemon peel and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Add salmon and uncooked noodles then toss lightly until well mixed. Bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven about 50 minutes or until noodles are tender stirring once after 25 minutes of cooking. Sprinkle salmon-noodle mixture with cheese. Bake uncovered about 5 minutes more until cheese is melted. Makes 4 servings. Contains 244 calories.

title: Louise'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix the flour sugar baking powder and salt together then work in the shortening. Take out 1 cup for topping. Add the cinnamon brown sugar vanilla buttermilk and soda. Stir all together. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle on the topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Southern Deep Dish Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar and salt. Add Karo butter and vanilla. Add pecan pieces. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Best Hot Fudge
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in large glass measuring cup. Microwave on High until it comes to a boil stirring every minute. Stir in vanilla and butter. Serve over vanilla ice cream.

title: Beef Roast Sunday Dinner
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put roast on heavy-duty foil in baking dish. Sprinkle soup mix over roast. Pour mushrooms and liquid over roast. Seal foil over roast in pan. Put in preheated oven just before leaving for church. It can bake as long as 2 1/2 hours and be perfect. If you desire gravy drain juices into a saucepan. Put 3 tablespoons flour in a small jar. Add 1 cup water and shake vigorously. Pour into heated juices. Cook until desired thickness. Add more water if needed.

title: Tomato Catsup
instructions: Select good firm ripe tomatoes; scald and strain through a coarse sieve to remove seed and skin. When cold add to each gallon tomatoes the other ingredients; let simmer slowly for 3 hours. Seal in bottles or jars.

title: Tossed Artichoke Salad
instructions: In a saucepan combine oil vinegar 2 tablespoons of water onion sugar garlic 1/2 teaspoon salt celery seed and dash of pepper. Bring to boiling. Add artichoke hearts. Cook until tender 3 to 5 minutes. Cool. Stir in pimento. Chill.

title: Party Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll into golf size balls. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Pour 3/4 cup hot water over soda in small bowl. Stir to dissolve. Beat in molasses and egg yolk combining well. In medium bowl combine flour sugar salt and spices mixing well. Add butter. Using fingers rub into flour mixture to make crumbs. Sprinkle 1/4 crumb mixture in bottom of pie shell. Top with 1/3 molasses mixture. Continue layering ending with crumb mixture on top. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake pie for 35 minutes or until filling is firm to the touch when lightly pressed with fingertip. Serve pie warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and Crisco. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Sift together dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients with milk into mixture; add vanilla. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In medium saucepan melt butter; stir in brown sugar and milk. Bring to a boil; boil and stir 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla. Mix in 10x sugar; beat until smooth. Spread into buttered 9-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Uncle Bill'S Drop Cocoa Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar and vanilla. Blend flour and cocoa together and add to this mixture. Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours. Mold a scant tablespoon of dough around each chocolate drop. Shape into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until set. Cool. Roll in 10x sugar. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Irene'S Corn Bread
instructions: Put water and margarine in a large pot; bring to boil. Beat eggs and sugar; stir in salt milk and corn meal. Add to boiling water; stir and cook until thick. Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking dish or pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Mix dry jello with cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Add all fruit which has been well drained. Mix well and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Variety Torte
instructions: Cream butter and oil with sugar until creamy. Add egg yolks and flavoring; mix well. Gradually add dry ingredients alternating with milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites; blend lightly. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Split layers for 6 pieces.

title: Raised Doughnuts
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup lukewarm water. Scald milk and when cool add dissolved yeast and rest of ingredients. Let rise until double in bulk. Place on board; roll out and cut. Let doughnuts rise about 3/4 hour and fry in hot fat.

title: Easy Pecan Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool.

title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve chilled. Serves about 8 people.

title: Dill Pickle Appetizer
instructions: Spread cheese on ham. Roll up on pickle. Chill about 1 hour. Slice.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cut carrots and zucchini julienne style and then cook them until they are tender. In a saucepan add the first eight ingredients and cook over medium heat until smooth and thick. Do not boil. Then mix vegetables and sauce in a casserole dish. Stir bread crumbs cheese and margarine together and spread over the top. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 to warm and brown crumbs.

title: Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Cook 3 to 4 hours on low in a crock-pot.

title: Steak Roll-Ups
instructions: Place prepared stuffing on cubed steak and roll up. Place in pan and pour mushroom soup over steaks. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Blend oil and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Stir together dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Stir in apples pecans and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from pan when slightly cooled in tube pan at least 1 1/2 hours.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage and fry; drain well. Spread bread with butter. Cut into cubes and cover bottom of 9 x 14-inch pan (sprayed with Pam). (Frozen bread slices are easier to work with.) Sprinkle drained sausage over bread. Beat eggs well then add evaporated milk and salt. (I use garlic salt.) Beat until fluffy then pour egg mixture over sausage and bread. Cover with grated cheese. (I also put some of cheese into egg mixture before pouring onto bread and sausage.) Refrigerate overnight (covered with foil). Bake next morning for 35 to 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Spinach Noodles Italiano
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan cook the noodles according to package. Drain well. In same saucepan melt butter. Stir in herbs and noodles. Cook over low heat until heated through 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in Parmesan cheese.

title: Recipe For Friendship
instructions: Mix ingredients together; toss in a little flair. Serve to everyone you know and topped with a tiny prayer.

title: Taco Bake
instructions: Brown beef and onions about 10 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce kidney beans chili powder salt and pepper. Break taco shells in 1/2 at fold. Arrange on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spoon meat mix over tacos and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot. If desired top with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Put butter Rice Krispies pecans and coconut in bowl; mix well and put in oven for 10 minutes or until butter melts. Remove from oven; add sugar and mix well. Place layer of sugar mixture in bottom of dish then place layer of soft ice cream over that then another layer of sugar mixture etc. with layer of sugar mixture being on top. Cover with foil and re-freeze ice cream. Take out of freezer 30 to 45 minutes before serving.

title: Ezio Pork Chops
instructions: In a large frypan put olive oil to cover pan. Heat pan first. Put fresh rosemary in first and then pork chops. Cook hot and then sprinkle wine to cool pan down. Move chops around so they dont stick. Repeat many times. Heat up. Cool down with wine. Turn over. Should be caramel color on chops. Cook until white inside. Serves 4 to 6. Temperature Medium-high. Cooking Time 35 minutes.

title: Helen'S Tortilla Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil. Add broths tomato sauce cumin chili powder jalapenos and Worcestershire. Bring to a boil cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add chicken and tomatoes. Cook 15 minutes. Cut corn tortillas in narrow strips. Fry crisp. Place a few tortilla strips in the bottom of each bowl. Fill with hot soup. Top with more chips and shredded cheese. (Optional - squeeze fresh lime juice on top.) Avocado slices may be served with this soup.

title: Festive Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In a skillet saute the red pepper and onion in butter until tender. Add the soup milk worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce; stir until smooth. Stir in the green beans and water chestnuts. Transfer to an ungreased 1 1/2 qt. baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Quick Shrimp Curry
instructions: Cook onion garlic and curry powder in butter until onion is tender. Stir in soup milk shrimp and peas. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes; stir frequently. Serve over rice. Serve with fruit salad.

title: Sue'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Soften bread crumbs in milk. Combine remaining ingredients. Shape into a loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese And Potted Meat Spread
instructions: Place minced onion in a small amount of water for 5 minutes. Drain. Mix with cream cheese and potted meat. Chill. When ready to serve spread on party rye or crackers.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Combine milk and flavoring. Add flour alternately with milk beginning and ending with flour. Fold in coconut.

title: Brandied Roast Pork
instructions: Place all ingredients except pork loin in a saucepan and bring to a low boil stirring until sugar is melted and ingredients are blended. Use caution since this boils over easily. Let cool. Reserve 1/3 cup of the marinade and refrigerate. Marinate pork for no less than 4 hours; overnight works best.

title: Homemade Eagle Brand Milk
instructions: Mix syrup oleo and boiling water. Slowly add sugar and milk. Mix until well blended. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Strawberry Banana Sodas
instructions: Blend or process the bananas strawberries and mineral water on medium speed until smooth. Pour into 2 chilled glasses.

title: Crazy Aunt Moo'S I Married A Greek Orzo Salad(Yield:  10-12 Servings)
instructions: 1. Cook box of orzo set aside.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Whip together lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk. Whip cream and sugar. Add flavorings. Mix well with milk mixture. Pour into baked pie crust. Refrigerate. Very very good.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Cake
instructions: Put ingredients in bowl in order given. Mix well. Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Brown sausage; drain off fat. Separate crescent rolls and place into ungreased 12-inch dish. Press together making bottom crust and sides. Spoon sausage over the crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with cheese. Beat together eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients in a large skillet. Stir over medium-high heat until ingredients form a soft ball. Remove from skillet and knead the dough until pliable and has an even consistency. Store in an airtight container. Gallon size Ziploc bags work well; will keep for months.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Heat water to boiling. Melt margarine in hot water. Add flour and salt all at once and stir until mixture leaves sides of pan. Remove from heat; add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Drop by spoonfuls on a greased cooking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Place tea bags in water; brew 5 to 10 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add all other ingredients. Bring to a boil and let simmer for at least 15 minutes.

title: Butterfinger Bars
instructions: Cream butter sugar and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl. Add quick-cooking oats. Mix well; press into a 2-quart utility dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until slightly firm to touch. Place chocolate morsels and peanut butter in a double boiler over boiling water. Stir until melted. Spread melted chocolate mixture over warm oat mixture. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: The Best Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Pour all ingredients into an electric ice cream freezer. Add milk to fill line; freeze as usual. Fresh fruit may be pureed and added.

title: Old-Time Beef Stew
instructions: In Dutch oven thoroughly brown meat in 2 tablespoons hot shortening turning often. Add 2 cups hot water and next 9 ingredients. Cover; simmer for 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally to keep from sticking. Remove bay leaves. Add vegetables. Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Garden Medley Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain. In medium skillet heat margarine with garlic. Add carrots zucchini and onions. Cook and stir until vegetables are tender.

title: Hot Sausage Cheese Puffs
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain. Pour sausage in a large bowl. Cool completely. Add cheese Bisquick and water. Mix well until blended. Roll into 1-inch balls or patties. Bake at 400\u00b0 until puffed and golden brown. Bake about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Taco Stacko
instructions: Blend refried beans with taco mix. Spread in 9-inch pie plate. Mash avocados and combine with sour cream and lemon juice. Spread mixture over beans. Sprinkle with cheese tomatoes chilies olives and green onions.

title: Best Icing
instructions: Cream sugar oleo crisco. Add salt vanilla milk and flour. Beat high speed 12 minutes.

title: Fish Stew For 25
instructions: Peel and cut up the potatoes. Add water to cover and boil until tender. When cooked mash potatoes with a potato masher. Cook bacon until brown then add onions. When the onions are brown place bacon onions and potatoes in large pot (12 quart) and combine the mixture. Add tomato juice tomatoes and ketchup and bring to a boil. Add Worcestershire sauce hot sauce salt and pepper. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add fish and bring to a rolling boil. Turn down the heat and let simmer.

title: Chocolate Nut Caramels
instructions: Put sugar corn syrup 1 cup cream and butter together. Stir and cook to a vigorous boil. Gradually add the other cup of cream. Do not allow the mixture to stop boiling while cream is being added. Cook until thermometer reads 250\u00b0 stirring gently. Without a thermometer cook to hard ball stage. Remove from fire; add chocolate nuts and vanilla. Beat until chocolate is melted.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease round layer pan 9 x 1 1/2-inches or square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Prepare topping. Mix baking mix sugar egg and water. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Stir in apples. Spread batter in pan. Sprinkle with topping. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean 20 to 25 minutes. Refrigerate any remaining coffee cake.

title: Dried Beef Spread
instructions: May substitute dried venison for beef.

title: Snow Frosting
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in top of double boiler. Beat 1 minute then place over boiling water and beat constantly for 4 minutes. Remove from boiling water beat 1 minute more while you add vanilla. Spread on cake.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli stems for 10 minutes then put in bottom of casserole. Fry sausage very little and pour off grease. Alternate broccoli tops sausage onion and cheese in casserole with soup. Put croutons on top and pour on butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix together. Put into a greased and floured Bundt or angel food pan and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour and powder together in a bowl set aside. Cream butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar while beating. Beat until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Beat until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and lemon mix well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Mix well. Spoon batter into a greased tube pan. Place in cold oven. Turn on oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar and oil. Add flour cinnamon baking soda baking powder and vanilla. Mix. Stir in pineapple zucchini and walnuts. Pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 3 small or 1 large and 1 small loaf.

title: Baked Beans With Meat
instructions: *May substitute all ground beef.

title: Yogurt Pie
instructions: Mix yogurt and Cool Whip. Place in pie crust and chill until firm.

title: Zucchini Patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil and cheese and mix well. Divide batter into 4 patties.

title: Almond Bars
instructions: Mix ingredients (except egg white and almonds) together well. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat egg white. Pour over top. Place sliced almonds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Kisses
instructions: First beat egg whites until thick. Next add salt sugar cream of tartar and vanilla then spoon out on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes or until they start turning a little brown.

title: American Spaghetti
instructions: Saute bacon green pepper onion and mushrooms 5 minutes. Add ground beef and cook until brown. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add tomatoes (break up). Combine with spaghetti. Pour into large baking dish and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with cheese if desired.

title: Brown Sugar Cake With Maple Flavor
instructions: Cream butter and sugar then add egg yolks one at a time and beat. Mix milk and buttermilk together. Take 1/3 cup out. Add soda to 1/3 cup of milk. Add flour and milk to mixture. Add flavorings. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cheese; add onions and Worcestershire sauce. Work 1 package of beef into mixture. Roll into ball then in other beef. Cool 4 hours. Serve with Wheat Thins or Triscuits crackers.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Dessert
instructions: Mix 2 tablespoons milk into peanut butter in a large bowl. Gently stir in whipped topping. Pour 2 cups milk into a large bowl. Add the pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk 1 to 2 minutes or until well blended. Spoon whipped topping mixture and pudding alternately into glasses. Refrigerate 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine Raisin Bran and milk. Let stand until mixture is moistened. Add egg and shortening. Beat well then add flour baking powder salt and sugar stirring only until combined. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt margarine; add\tsugar\tsyrup and salt. Stir constantly until sugar is dissolved. Let boil over low heat 5 minutes; do not stir. Remove from heat; add soda and flavoring. Stir real good; this will be foamy. Pour over corn and mix real good. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Let cool and break apart.

title: Lime Spring Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Mix cheese and pineapple together; then add all ingredients to gelatin mixture and congeal. Yields 10 servings.

title: Gelatin Pizza
instructions: Pour gelatin into a bowl. Add water and stir until dissolved. Spray pizza pan and pour in gelatin mixture. Refrigerate about 3 hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Heat sugar water and cornstarch until clear stirring all the time. Add jello. Cool. Clean and halve strawberries. Fold into cooled jello mixture. Spoon into pie crust and refrigerate until set. Serve topped with Cool Whip.

title: Potato Supreme
instructions: Combine all ingredients except butter and stuffing mix. In a large bowl mix thoroughly and then spoon into a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish lightly buttered. Combine stuffing mix and butter and sprinkle on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly and brown. May be made ahead and stored covered in refrigerator.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Fold together the sour cream cream cheese chilies olives onions and garlic powder. Smear on flour tortillas and roll into a log. Cover individually with foil and refrigerate overnight to set. Cut into pinwheels or 2-inch sections. For variation layer tortillas and cut into wedges.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Blend with 1/2 cup sugar until creamy. Add vanilla and eggs; blend well. Place vanilla cookie into paper muffin cup. Place into muffin pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture into cups. Bake for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Top with cherries peaches or strawberries.

title: Brisket
instructions: Brush liquid smoke on brisket and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Soak overnight in cold coffee and wine. Add onion and bay leaves. Bake in a covered roaster or roasting bag for 5 to 6 hours at 300\u00b0 fat side up. Remove fat after 4 hours and drizzle with barbecue sauce. Slice across grain and add more sauce if desired. Keep in low oven (200\u00b0 to 250\u00b0) until ready to serve.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Add milk to onion mix to make 1/2 cup milk; mix. Heap onto tablespoon forming into a ball. Drop into deep hot fat and fry until golden brown.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: In a small mixing bowl cream butter; add 1/3 of the sugar and beat well. Add egg vanilla salt and cream; beat until smooth. Gradually add remaining sugar beating until smooth. If frosting is too thick additional cream may be added.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour with seasonings. Layer macaroni cheese and flour mixture in alternate layers in a baking dish until all are used. Pour milk over all and top with crushed cracker crumbs if desired. Bake about 45 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Fresh Peach Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in order listed. Pour into lightly floured Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour. Remove from oven to rack. Cool completely.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: In bottom of dish put the lime jello 1 cup hot water and 1 cup crushed pineapple. Let this set.

title: Oven Baked Potato Chip Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken; remove skin and dip chicken in beaten egg. Place chicken in crushed potato chips and press both sides so chicken is evenly covered. Place chicken in pan after putting a little oil in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 5 servings. Good with Easy Potato Bake.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease and sprinkle cornmeal in an 8-inch baking pan or skillet. Combine all ingredients in bowl mixing well. Pour into pan or skillet and bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and place in a large roaster or foil turkey pan. Pour oleo and taco mix over mixture and bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes. Stir every 15 minutes. Cool and store in airtight containers.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
instructions: Serve with apple slices.

title: Powerhouse Stew
instructions: Use a heavy saucepan large enough to hold all ingredients. Brown beef in the pan. Drain. Add package of beefy-onion soup to one cup of hot water in a small saucepan then add this to the beef. Add the tomato soup. Peel and dice potatoes and onions to suit. Add all vegetables salt and pepper to suit. Cook until done.

title: Granola Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients (sugar honey egg flour soda cinnamon salt oats coconut and nuts). This mixture will be thick. Press in prepared pan. Bake 20 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut into 32 bars.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute ground meat onion salt and pepper. Simmer with cover on. Cook until meat turns white. Add water and bring to boil. Add garlic powder red pepper paprika Italian spice mix chili blend tomato sauce cream of mushroom soup and cheese soup. Simmer for at least 30 minutes to 1 hour. Makes large amount. Can be divided and frozen.

title: Tuna Buns
instructions: Combine all ingredients except buns. Spread mixture between buns. Wrap each in foil. Place on baking sheet. Heat at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 10 servings.

title: Flour Tortillas
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with shortening until it looks a coarse meal. Add warm water and knead dough well. Divide into 12 small balls. Roll into very thin circles. Cook on hot griddle until done on both sides.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and cube cooked potatoes. Add chopped onion pickles and egg whites. In a coffee mug add egg yolks pickles and juice (about 1/8 cup) and finish filling mug with mayonnaise (about 3/4 cup). Pour to consistency over other ingredients.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat with salt pepper and onion; add tomato paste water and spaghetti sauce mix and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan alternate layers of meat sauce Cheddar cheese noodles and Mozzarella cheese until all ingredients have been used. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed Yogurt Dressing
instructions: Crush garlic and salt in a mortar and pestle or small bowl until a paste forms. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Lucille'S Rice Dressing (Dirty Rice)
instructions: Have cooked rice ready. Have onion parsley bell pepper celery green onions and garlic chopped and ready.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Using a rolling pin crush pretzels between waxed paper. Mix together pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons of sugar. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Let cool completely.

title: Corn Bread Taco Bake
instructions: Brown and strain meat. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Pour into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Prepare corn muffin mix according to package directions except add 1/2 can onions. Spoon around outer edges of casserole. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top corn bread with Cheddar cheese and remaining onions. Bake for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Velvety Chicken Pate
instructions: In medium skillet saute butter and chicken livers for 2 minutes. Add onion and apple and stir for 5 minutes until apple softens. Stir in brandy and cream. Transfer mixture to blender and blend 2 to 3 minutes or until smooth. Refrigerate this mixture for 1 hour.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Boil the rice in the water for about 25 minutes until soft. Gradually add the cream and flavor with salt. This method makes a lighter pudding and it is less likely to burn on to the saucepan. Serve with a lump of butter cinnamon and sugar.

title: Mexican Hamburgers
instructions: In skillet mix hamburger onion green pepper salt pepper chili powder and sugar. Let hamburger brown with all these ingredients. Add tomato ketchup and let simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans on serving dish mix sour cream and taco mix. Spread on top of beans. Top with lettuce tomatoes cheese and peppers.

title: Peaches And Cream Cheesecake
instructions: Beat flour baking powder soda pudding butter and egg for 2 minutes at medium speed then pour into 8-inch deep dish or 10 pie pan. Drain the can of peaches saving juice. Put peaches on top of mixture in pan. Beat cream cheese sugar and peach juice. Spoon onto the top of peaches within 1 of edge. Mix 1 Tbsp. sugar and cinnamon sprinkle over cheese mixture. Bake 350\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes until crust is golden brown - filling appears soft. Keep refrigerated.

title: Cucumber Snacks
instructions: Combine cream cheese mayonnaise and package of Good Seasons. Mix well and spread mixture on bread and top with a cucumber. Refrigerate a couple of hours before serving. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef mix in seasoning package. Drain very well. Break up chips and toss all ingredients together. Pour dressing over salad and mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Pie Filling Jello
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water. Add 1 cup cold water and pie filling. Mix well and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until set. Spread Dream Whip over top of set Jell-O.

title: Frozen Cookie
instructions: Sift together flour soda cream of tartar and salt. Cream brown sugar and butter; add eggs and vanilla. Add to flour mixture. Make an oblong loaf of this mixture; wrap it in wax paper and freeze. Then cut it thin and bake 10-12 minutes until brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Zucchini Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers any size. If they are solid 2 gallons. Make a brine of 2 cups salt to 1 gallon water; boil and pour over cucumbers in a stone jar. Weigh down; let stand 7 days. Drain; wash and cut into chunks. For next 3 days make a solution daily of 1 tablespoon powdered alum. Pour over cucumbers which have been drained and old liquid discarded. On 4th morning heat 6 cups white vinegar 5 cups sugar 1/3 cup pickling spices and 1 tablespoon celery seed (may tie spices in a cloth). Heat to boiling and pour over pickles. On 5th morning drain liquid into a pan. Add 1 cup sugar. Reheat. Pour over pickles. On 6th morning drain in pan. Add 1 cup sugar. Pack pickles into sterilized jars and fill to within 1/2-inch of top of jar with boiling liquid. Seal at once.

title: Mango Pickles
instructions: Boil all ingredients except mangoes. Add mangoes when mixture is cool. Store in jars and refrigerate.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Drain vegetables; mix with celery and onions add salt and pepper. Heat vinegar and sugar; pour over vegetables. Refrigerate until well chilled before eating.

title: Mom'S Chicken Dumplings
instructions: Mix eggs oil salt and pepper together. Add flour and about 3/4 cup water. Work dough until you can roll it easily. Do not have it stiff. Roll as thin as possible. Cover with dishcloth and let sit overnight. Put chicken broth in a large pot. Let come to hard boil and begin to put in dough cut in small pieces keeping dough covered. Boil until pastry is done. If broth gets too low add water so pastry doesnt become dry. With a big spoon occasionally lift pastry from bottom to top.

title: Rice And Deviled Eggs With Tuna
instructions: Cook green pepper and onion in butter until glossy. Combine soup and milk. To 3/4 of the soup mixture add rice and tuna. Place in a casserole. Top with deviled eggs and refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir peanut butter sugar eggs and vanilla in a bowl until blended. It will be sticky. Roll into 1 1/4-inch balls. Then roll in sugar and place on cookie sheets about 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake 12 to 14 minutes until cookies look dry and tops are cracked. Remove from oven and immediately press chocolate kiss in center of each. Cool on cookie sheets.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; beat eggs and oil together. Beat in dry ingredients. Stir in carrots. Can bake in a Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Drain corn. Put in casserole dish. Add rest of ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set. If you want a little more custard add 2 extra eggs slightly beaten and 1 more cup of milk.

title: Pronto Dip
instructions: Whiz the cheese in a Waring-type blender. After several seconds add picante sauce enough to both taste and color. Serve with corn chips or on lettuce (tomato optional) as a salad.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Mix flour cornmeal baking soda pepper garlic salt and egg. Slowly add milk to make a thick smooth batter. Try not to make it too runny. Use less milk if you need to. Cut onions into rings. Prepare oil by heating to frying temperature. Dip onions into batter and put immediately into oil. If oil is hot the rings will start frying immediately. Let the rings fry until golden brown. Remove and place on paper towel to drain. Serve with catsup or barbecue sauce. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Combine yeast 1/2 cup warm water and sugar. Combine 2 cups warm water and flour. Stir all together and put in quart jar. Let stand 8 hours then refrigerate 3 to 8 days before using.

title: Crustless Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat egg in a medium-size bowl. Add beef catsup onion Worcestershire bread crumbs pepper sauce 1/2 teaspoon oregano 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Mix thoroughly with a fork. Pat meat evenly in a 12-inch pizza pan. Bake 7 minutes or longer until no longer pink. Spread marinara sauce over meat. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon oregano 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Top with Mozzarella and Parmesan. Arrange green pepper mushrooms and pepperoni on top of cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Broil 3 minutes until cheese is bubbly. Serve in wedges. Makes 4 servings.

title: Quicky Chicken(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Variation Eliminate tomato sauce use a little more oil to coat potatoes and add oregano and green pepper rings.

title: Date Nut Candy
instructions: Mix sugar margarine milk and dates in saucepan; cook until thick or makes a ball in cold water. Beat until it begins to get thicker. Add pecans and beat some more. When it gets so thick you cannot beat it put in a damp cloth and roll it up. Let set for at least 2 hours then slice into pieces.

title: *Southern Sweet Potato Pie*
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs and stir. Add sweet potatoes and mix well. Stir in milk vanilla and salt making sure all ingredients are thoroughly mixed. Pour into pie shell and bake 40 minutes. (If using a commercial frozen pie shell use a 9-inch deep dish.)

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Beat together margarine sugars and eggs until creamy. Then add salt and flour coconut chocolate chips and pecans. Pour in two 9-inch cake pans greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Let cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar or leave plain.

title: Cranberry Baked Apples
instructions: Cut each apple lengthwise in half and remove core. Arrange apple halves cut side up in 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Mix together sugar flour cocoa salt and soda. Add vinegar vanilla salad oil and cold water. Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Top Of Stove Cookies
instructions: Boil the sugar butter milk and peanut butter for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add cocoa vanilla and oats. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Toss cheese in flour. Combine 3/4 cup cheese 1/2 c. almonds and remaining ingredients except pastry. Mix well. Roll pastry into 15-inch square. Fit pastry into 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Trim 1-inch beyond edge. Fill with turkey mixture. Top with remaining cheese and almonds. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Diabetic Yam Pie
instructions: Combine gelatin sweetener salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir in milk egg yolks and yams. Mix well. Cook 10 minutes. Chill. Beat egg whites until stiff. Stir in Sweet N Low. Fold into gelatin mixture. Pour into pie shell. Chill.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut top from peppers; remove seeds. Brown meat in skillet; stir in garlic salt and salt. Add 1/2 cup of tomatoes and the cereal. Fill each pepper with 1/2 cup meat mixture. Place in a greased shallow baking dish. Pour on remaining tomatoes. Top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Nachos
instructions: Spread 1 teaspoon of refried beans on each tortilla chip. Top with 1 teaspoon of cheese and one olive slice. Place 8 in circle on paper plate. Heat on full power for 30 to 60 seconds or until cheese is melted. Serve warm. Repeat with remaining chips.

title: Old Fashioned Potato Salad
instructions: Place potatoes in a Dutch oven; cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook 8 minutes or until tender. Drain; place in large bowl. Add onion and next 4 ingredients; toss gently. Combine sour cream and next 5 ingredients; stir well. Pour over potato mixture; toss gently to coat. Cover and chill.

title: Kraut Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Potato And Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients at last minute before serving.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients in order listed lettuce celery pepper onion and peas. Mix sugar and Miracle Whip together and spread over top layer. Then sprinkle cheese and bacon bits on top. Let salad marinate for 24 hours if desired or serve when prepared.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Mix all except cheese and tortillas. Fill tortillas. Put remainder of mixture on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Grease medium iron skillet and warm in oven as it preheats. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into hot pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. If you run out of eggs you may substitute a heaping tablespoon of mayonnaise.

title: S'Mores Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir ice cream with a spoon until smooth. Spoon into crust pressing to compact and molding slightly in center. Wrap in plastic and freeze for at least 3 hours. When ready to serve remove plastic wrap and smooth marshmallow cream over top of ice cream. Drizzle with fudge sauce and top with mini marshmallows.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix and store. Use 3 teaspoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix all together. Add 1/4 cup mix to cup of hot water. May need to add more according to taste.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together 1/2 cup margarine salt pepper onion soup sour cream and cheese. Add thawed potatoes and blend. Pour into buttered 3-quart casserole. Mix 1/4 cup melted butter and corn flakes. Put on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir together flour 1/2 cup sugar cocoa baking powder and salt. Add milk oil and vanilla; stir until smooth. Stir in nuts. Turn into a ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Combine the 3/4 cup sugar and the 1/4 cup cocoa; gradually stir in boiling water. Pour liquid mixture evenly over batter in pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean. Serve warm or chilled. Sprinkle with sifted powdered sugar. Serves 8.

title: No-Fuss Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook ground beef in preheated large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink. Pour off drippings. Add spaghetti sauce and tomatoes with liquid to skillet. Stir and set aside. Meanwhile combine Ricotta egg Parmesan and basil. Spread 2 cups beef sauce over bottom of 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Arrange 3 lasagna noodles in single layer pressing into sauce. Spoon cheese mixture on top of noodles. Sprinkle with 1 cup Mozzarella and top with 2 cups sauce. Arrange remaining noodles in a single layer pressing lightly into sauce. Top with remaining sauce. Spread evenly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until noodles are fork-tender. Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella; tent lightly with foil. Let stand at least 15 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Romano Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Cook chicken. Roll in bread crumbs. Place in casserole and add cooked noodles. Dice cream cheese. Mix in sauces and seasonings. Pour over noodles. Bake 35 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Garlic Cheese Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine first seven ingredients. Beat until well blended. Slice bread in one inch pieces. Spread on one side of each slice of bread and place on ungreased baking sheet. Broil 4 inches from heat for 3 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Pista Kulfi
instructions: In a large capacity food processor or blender combine all the ingredients except whipped topping. Blend thoroughly 1-2 minutes. Remove blades and pour into a large bowl. Gently fold in the whipped topping.

title: Dilly Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; let stand 10 minutes. Combine cottage cheese oleo salt sugar and baking soda. Stir. Add onion dill egg and softened yeast. Beat well. Add flour gradually. Cover with wet cloth. Let raise in warm place until double in bulk. Stir dough down knead and pinch into loaf pan proportions. Let rise 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Green Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and put cheese on top. Bake in greased covered casserole for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix and melt cheese into rice and can of soup in microwave. Serve.

title: Eden Isle Breast Of Chicken
instructions: Pepper but do not salt chicken breasts. Wrap slice of bacon around each. Place a layer of dried beef in bottom of baking dish. Place bacon wrapped breasts in dish. Cover with mixture of chicken soup sour cream and cream cheese. Cover with foil. Place in 325\u00b0 oven for 2 hours. When tender remove foil and let brown slightly. Serve on bed of rice.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Blend all ingredients in big pot. Add chicken and cook on medium heat until chicken is fully cooked; stir often. It takes about 45 minutes. Serve with rice and tossed salad.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce in bite-size pieces into a large bowl. Add browned drained and cooled hamburger. Add beans cheese and crumbled chips. Combine mayonnaise and taco sauce; add to salad. Mix well.

title: Grandma Gregory'S Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef and diced onions. When beef and onions are brown add spaghetti sauce tomato paste and diced whole tomatoes. Drain all juice from tomato can. Prepare noodles per package instructions and drain noodles. Combine with sauce and enjoy!

title: Cold Cucumber Soup
instructions: Peel cucumbers and cut in small pieces. Mix together yogurt and water until smooth. Add cucumbers garlic salt and mint. Place some ice cubes in a bowl and refrigerate a few hours. Stir well just before serving.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat together eggs oil and sugar. Add grated zucchini. In a large bowl mix together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add zucchini mixture and blend. Add nuts raisins and spices. Mix well. Pour into two greased loaf pans and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Rinse peas and boil with water and ham hocks. Reduce heat to a slow boil; cover and cook 45 minutes. Add to pot cut up vegetables and seasonings. Simmer for 2 hours. After 2 hours remove ham hocks and set them aside. Place smoked sausage in soup and cook for 1/2 hour longer over low heat.

title: Lo-Fat Triple Layer Chocolate Silk Pie
instructions: In large bowl mix cream cheese sugar and 1 tablespoon milk with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip; spread in bottom of crust. In 2nd bowl stir pudding mix into remaining milk and mix well. Immediately stir in whipped topping. Spread this over cream cheese mixture.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Place chops in baking dish. Combine bread crumbs onion 1/2 water margarine and poultry seasoning. Spoon onto each chop. Cover chops with gravy made with mushroom soup and 1/3 cup water. Bake 1 hour uncovered at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Company Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook skinned chicken in water until tender. Remove from broth and cut into chunks. Strain broth and measure. Add water to equal amount called for to cook rice. Cook rice according to directions. While rice is cooking saute celery in small amount oleo until partially tender. When rice is done combine rice chicken celery water chestnuts soups mayonnaise and onion soup mix. Pour into large flat casserole (approximately 4 quarts). Cover with stuffing mix. Drizzle with melted oleo. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove cover and bake 20 to 25 minutes longer until golden brown and heated through. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Chocolate Quick Cake
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients into 8 or 9-inch cake tin or dish. Make three indentations in dry ingredients. In first indentation put vanilla. In second indentation put vinegar. In third indentation put cooking oil. Pour cold water over whole thing and mix with a fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes. Makes 1 small cake.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat all ingredients. Dip in and enjoy!

title: Breanna'S Favorite Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2 qt. glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of the wafers bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice ending with pudding. Chill. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Dissolve and pour over cucumbers (gallon glass jar); let stand for 2 weeks. Wash off brine water and cover with cold water. Add 2 tablespoons alum powder and let stand for 24 hours. Drain off alum water. Pour vinegar to cover and add 2 teaspoons pickling spices (tied in a bag) and leave for 24 hours. Drain off vinegar and throw away. Add 3 cups sugar for 3 mornings straight. These pickles do not have to be sealed. The whole process is done in the gallon glass jar.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Combine egg whites sugar salt water and corn syrup in top of double boiler. Place over rapidly boiling water beating constantly\tat high speed of electric mixer. Beat for 7 minutes or until frosting will stand in peaks. Remove from boiling water; add vanilla and beat at high speed until thick enough to spread.

title: Apple Cinnamon Burritos
instructions: In heavy skillet melt butter; add sliced apples. Fry until tender. Add sugar and cinnamon to taste. Fry until caramelized but still juicy. Spoon onto warmed flour tortillas.

title: Sweet And Sour Stew
instructions: Coat meat with flour salt and pepper. Brown in bacon drippings. Combine water sauces brown sugar vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt. Stir into browned meat. Add onion. Cover and cook over low heat about 45 minutes. Add carrots and cook 45 minutes longer or until tender. Can be cooked in Dutch oven in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Michelle'S Favorite Punch
instructions: Mix together Kool-Aid sugar and water. Stir until sugar dissolves. Add pineapple juice. Chill. When ready to serve add ginger ale. Pour in punch bowl over an ice ring.

title: Kidney Bean Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pack into loaf pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Torte
