instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Cut in oleo. Spread 2/3 of mixture in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Spread 1 can of pie filling on top. Sprinkle remaining ingredients on top of pie filling. Bake 30 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven. Top with vanilla ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Add vanilla. Combine dry ingredients (flour soda salt and cinnamon). Add to first mixture. Fold in chopped pecans and apples. Bake in greased tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Pink Fluff Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix pie filling drained pineapple and Eagle Brand. Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Chill.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Thaw frozen juices. Pour in orange juice lemonade and apple juice. Stir while pouring in ginger ale. Scoop on sherbet. Serve immediately. Add more sherbet later as first scoops melt.

title: Cornbread Taco Bake
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add taco seasoning water corn pepper and sauce. Pour in casserole dish. Mix package of muffin mix and pour over mixture. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Add cheese and bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Mexican Maze-In Bread
instructions: Mix together the corn meal salt and soda and blend. Stir in shortening sour cream corn and eggs and mix well. Add chiles and cheese; stir. Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Thoroughly mix together the cream cheese bacon celery salt and onion salt. Cut off tops of cherry tomatoes and remove pulp. Stuff with cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle tops with parsley. Chill.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Sprinkle sugar over berries. Pour cake mix over pineapple blueberries and sugar. Melt and pour margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle chopped pecans over top. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish or pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Buy a circle cake. Put holes in cake with a knife. Pour jello over cake and put strawberries on cake.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with raw vegetables. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Chruscik(Polish Pastry)
instructions: Add salt to eggs and beat until thick and lemon colored. Add sugar butter and rum; continue to beat. Fold in flour and knead until the dough blisters. Transfer to a well floured board and knead. Cut in half and roll very thin. Cut into strips about 4-inches long. Slit each piece in center and pull one end through the slit. Fry in hot fat (Crisco) until lightly browned. Drain on absorbent paper and sprinkle with powdered sugar. With leftover egg whites I recommend the following recipe

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut into thin slices but not all the way through. Use handle of spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way. Put potatoes in baking dish and fan slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside. Check with fork.

title: Shish Kabobs(Method:  Stick)
instructions: Marinate beef and vegetables for at least 2 hours. (Use a plastic Ziploc bag or plastic bowl with lid. Keep cold in cooler.) Alternate items on toasting stick. Cook over the coals until done.

title: Cake Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cake mix eggs and oil; stir until well blended. Mix in chocolate chips. Spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake for 9 to 12 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Saucy Succotash
instructions: Combine corn beans cheese and onion. Combine mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce. Fold into corn mixture. Turn into 1-quart casserole. Melt butter; toss with crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Preheat oven 350\u00b0. Grease large shallow baking dish. Combine water and milk and heat to simmer. Add Cornmeal salt sugar and butter. Stir over medium heat until the mixture is thickened (about 5 minutes). Remove from heat.

title: Delicious Dove Casserole
instructions: Cook whole doves in chicken consomme until tender. Remove breasts and dice meat. Measure 4 cups and set aside. Blend 3 tablespoons butter with flour and cream. Saute bread crumbs green pepper onion parsley and sage in remaining 3 tablespoons butter. Mix the sauteed ingredients flour mixture and dove meat. Place in skillet. Add salt pepper and sherry. Let cook gently for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Melt butter over medium-high heat. Brown hamburger onion and green pepper. Add remaining ingredients and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix and serve with Triscuits.

title: Venison Backstrap
instructions: Shell a quart and one-half of chestnuts. Put them in hot water and boil until the skins are soft then drain the water and remove the skins. Replace the chestnuts in water and boil until soft. Take out a few at a time and press through a colander while hot. Season the mashed chestnuts with two tablespoonfuls of butter two teaspoonfuls of salt and one-quarter of a teaspoon of pepper.

title: Mother'S Lifetime Recipe
instructions: A heaping cup of happiness

title: New Fruit Salad Ambrosia
instructions: Mix the gelatin with the cottage cheese. Add the pineapple marshmallows and shredded coconut. Add the whipped topping and mix well. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Sombreros
instructions: Mash drained sweet potatoes. Mix with beaten egg margarine salt brown sugar and nutmeg. Arrange slices of pineapple in a lightly greased shallow baking pan. Mound the sweet potato mixture on each slice. Brush with additional margarine if desired. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Roast Beef In Crock-Pot
instructions: Trim fat from roast. Place into crock-pot. Add dry soup mix mushroom soup tomato soup and water. (I find it easier to mix the ingredients before pouring over roast.) Turn crock-pot on high until cooking well. Turn to low and let cook 10 to 12 hours or until desired doneness.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut all vegetables into chunks. In a deep frying pan or wok add oil chicken and vegetables. Cook on medium high for 5 minutes. Stir occasionally. Add oregano salt pepper and garlic powder and simmer for 10 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Serve over white rice and enjoy! Serves 5.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for margarine and nuts. Add nuts and margarine; mix all together. Put in pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 or 35 minutes on bottom rack. Cut heat off and leave for a little while.

title: Indoor S'Mores
instructions: Measure cereal into large bowl. Butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Melt only 5 cups of marshmallows corn syrup magarine and chocolate chips in medium saucepan over low heat stirring constantly; remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal. Mix quickly until completely coated with chocolate. Stir in 1 cup of marshmallows. Make squares by pressing mixture down into buttered rectangular pan with buttered back of spoon. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Then cut into 2-inch squares. Yields 24 squares.

title: Stuffed Bread
instructions: Slice top off of the French bread; scoop out and crumble the inside bread leaving about 1/2 to 3/4-inch shell. Brown ground beef onion and pepper. Add all of the remaining ingredients to the crumbled bread; stuff the shell. Top with sliced American cheese; replace top of loaf. Heat in oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Sweetheart Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Combine strawberries and 1 tablespoon sugar substitute; let stand 20 minutes. Stir in strawberry spread. Cover and chill. Combine 1/2 cup flour 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar substitute baking powder and salt; cut in margarine with a pastry blender until crumbly. Add milk; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Sprinkle remaining flour over work surface.

title: Party Dip
instructions: Beat all ingredients with mixer until well blended. Put in refrigerator. Best if made the day before needed.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients; shape into loaf in 9 x 5 x 3-inch long pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Eloise'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all above ingredients (except pie shells of course). Melt the butter; mix well. Pour into pie shells. Bake approximately 45 minutes and you have two delicious chocolate pies. You may serve with Cool Whip if desired.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine beans and corn. Mix rest of ingredients (except oleo and crackers) in with vegetables. Pour into greased casserole dish. Dot with oleo. Crumble crackers on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Watercress Salad
instructions: Trim off the tough ends of the watercress and discard. Rinse the leaves and tender stems. Drain well. Put mustard vinegar salt and pepper in salad bowl. Blend with wire whisk. Add oil beating with whisk. Add watercress chopped egg and onion. Toss and serve.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Store in airtight container. Enjoy!

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Remove kernels (unpopped corn) and place corn in 2 large baking pans.

title: Quick Cherry Cheese Pie Or Fruit Dip
instructions: With an electric mixer mix lemon juice cream cheese and marshmallow cream together until smooth. Pour into already prepared graham cracker crust and top with chilled cherry pie filling. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Gnocchi Pi Ricotta(Cheese Dumplings)
instructions: Mix flour and Ricotta cheese. Add egg. On a lightly floured board roll out with palm of hand a small amount to form a rope. Cut into bite size pieces. (Add more flour as needed.) Cook in salted boiling water until gnocchi rise to the top. Drain well and serve with favorite sauce.

title: Polish Kielbasa
instructions: Boil kielbasa approximately 45 minutes. Remove and let cool. Slice into approximately 1/4 inch slices. Arrange on plate and refrigerate 2 hours. Serve right off plate. Great with ketchup mustard or your choice of topping. Also great for sandwiches on Polish bread.

title: Easy Baked Chicken Kiev
instructions: Place chicken breasts one at a time between 2 sheets of waxed paper. With flat side of mallet gently pound breasts until each is about 1/4 inch thick; set aside. In a rimmed plate or pie pan combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon of oregano garlic salt and pepper; set aside.

title: Snickers
instructions: Peel and dice apples. Cut Snickers in small pieces. Mix all together with Cool Whip.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Clean shrimp. May leave tail on. Melt butter/margarine in frying pan. Saute garlic and shallots until clear. Add everything except parsley and shrimp. Bubble one minute. Place shrimp on broiler pan. Pour half sauce over shrimp. Broil 5 inches from heat for 3 minutes. Turn over and pour remaining sauce on shrimp and broil additional 3 minutes. Turn out onto serving dish; garnish with parsley. Serve with white rice. Instead of broiling may also just add shrimp to frying pan with sauce and cook until shrimp are done.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare macaroni by package directions in medium saucepan. Melt butter; stir in flour dry mustard and salt. Gradually stir in milk; cook and stir until mixture thickens slightly and bubbles. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup of shredded cheese and stir until melted. Add macaroni.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Arrange pecans on top of filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool and refrigerate.

title: Pita Chips(Great With Chili Or Stews Or Dips)
instructions: Cut each pocket bread into sixths. Split each triangle and place rough side up on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes until crisp but not brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix together chicken soups stock and vegetables. Add a little pepper and poultry seasoning to taste. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons melted butter; stir together. Pour in greased 9 x 13 baking dish.

title: Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Place apples sugar and cranberries in baking dish. Mix melted oleo sugar oatmeal and flour together and pour over apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Venison Parmesana For Two
instructions: Saute onion in margarine in skillet until tender. Dip steaks in milk; coat with a mixture of crumbs salt and pepper. Brown quickly in the hot skillet from which the onions have been removed. Place in a baking dish. Add tomato sauce to skillet; heat for several minutes stirring occasionally. Add mushrooms now and pour sauce over steaks. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese. Let stand covered for a few minutes to melt the cheese. Great served with rice pilaf.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
instructions: Combine all ingredients; blend well. Chill for 15 minutes. Form into 1-inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cereal 'N Honey Snack Mix
instructions: Melt honey butter and brown sugar in pan. Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl. Pour honey mixture over dry ingredients and stir to coat. Bake in jelly roll pans for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Lay out on aluminum foil to cool. Store in closed container.

title: Pumpkin Crunch
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix over top then nuts. Melt oleo and drizzle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cheesy Carrots
instructions: Melt 1 stick butter and cheese (separately) in microwave; drain carrots and add to cheese in 1-quart casserole. Crumble bread into the melted butter. Sprinkle bread over carrots. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies(Aka:  Mississippi Mud Cookies)
instructions: Put sugar cocoa milk and margarine in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir well and boil 1 minute. Turn off heat and add vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Allow to set. Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Fruit Tray
instructions: Arrange lettuce on large tray. Arrange fruit so that no two colors are next to each other.

title: Three Cheese Roulade
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Line with wax paper grease again; set aside. Lightly grease a piece of foil 15 inches long; set aside.

title: Tangy Lemon Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Put all ingredients in bowl and mix well for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour into pan; bake for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chili Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Brown meat. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and chili sauce mix. Simmer 5 minutes. Stir in corn and olives. Cut tortillas in half or quarters according to bowl size. Layer tortillas and meat in casserole bowl ending with tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Garnish after baking with lettuce and avocados.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into a 1-quart casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Old-Fashioned Wassail
instructions: Tie cloves and cinnamon in a cheesecloth bag. Place spice bag and remaining ingredients in a large kettle; stir well. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Remove the spice bag. Yield 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Butter Baked Chicken And Gravy
instructions: Dip chicken pieces into 1/2 cup Pet milk. Roll pieces in flour salt and pepper. Melt 1/4 cup butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Put chicken skin side down. Bake uncovered near center of 425\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Turn chicken over. Pour mixture of 1 can cream of chicken soup 3/4 cup Pet milk and 1/4 cup water over chicken. Bake 30 minutes longer or until drumstick is tender when pierced. Place chicken on serving dish. Stir gravy well and serve with chicken over mashed potatoes. Serves 6.

title: Unbelievable Cookies
instructions: Drop on cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Carefree Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken soup mushrooms and Cheddar cheese in a 2-quart casserole dish. Add rice mixing well. Sprinkle with potato chips and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Broken Glass Cake
instructions: Dissolve each of the jello flavors in 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water. Pour into 3 (8-inch) square pans and chill until firm. Blend pineapple juice water and sugar; bring to a boil. Add lemon jello and stir until dissolved. Chill mixture until its consistency of unbeaten egg white. Whip this mixture then whip the cream then whip together. Cut the 3 jello flavors in 1/2-inch cubes and fold through the lemon mixture. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together. Stir in apples and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. This is a very moist cake; should be refrigerated if there are leftovers.

title: Daiquiri Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve jellos in boiling water and add thawed lemonade and limeade. Chill until partially set. Whip until foamy. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Stir in pineapple and pour into an 8 cup mold. Refrigerate.

title: English Walnut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except whipped cream and pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes until top is crackly brown and filling just quivers when you nudge the pie plate. Cool and garnish with whipped cream and nuts.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix margarine and graham crackers and pat into 13 x 9-inch pan. Make pudding according to package directions; cool slightly. When cool spread over graham cracker crust. Add layer of banana slices then layer of pineapple. Cover this with Cool Whip. Sprinkle chopped pecans and cut up maraschino cherries over the top. Refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Baked Creamed Potatoes
instructions: Peel dice and boil potatoes until tender. Mash potatoes then add margarine cream cheese sour cream salt and pepper. Mix until smooth and well blended. Pour into a buttered 2-quart casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 until lightly brown. Serve.

title: Crusty Top Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Beat for 10 minutes. Add vanilla and lemon flavoring. Beat 2 minutes longer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Texas Brownies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour and sugar. In a microsafe dish combine butter shortening coffee or water and cocoa. Microwave at High power for 2 minutes or until just boiling. Pour boiling mixture over flour mixture. Stir to blend. Add buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix well. Pour mixture into a microsafe 9 x 11- inch baking dish. Microwave at Medium-high power for 18 minutes turning dish every 4 to 5 minutes until brownies test done. They may still appear soft on the surface.

title: Christmas Almond Bark Drops
instructions: Melt almond bark in double boiler on low heat. Do not let water boil hard while melting. Have cereals peanuts and marshmallows in big bowl. Pour melted chocolate either white or dark over cereals. Mix. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Set cool and store.

title: Quick Dish
instructions: Place ground beef in skillet. Season with garlic powder salt black pepper (use quite a bit of black pepper) and chopped onion. Cook until done. Drain and add soup. Simmer until heated thoroughly. Serve on noodles.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter; mixing well. Line muffin pans with paper liners. Spoon graham cracker mixture into each liner. Press into bottom. Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar. Mix well. Add egg and vanilla beating well. Spoon into liners. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: Fill crescent rolls with chicken and cheese. Mix soup and milk. Pour over rolls and bake at 375\u00b0 until brown. You can use canned ham or turkey instead of chicken.

title: Sole Neptune
instructions: Butter casserole dish. Place sole on bottom. Top with crab and shrimp. Then with tomato and garlic butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken And Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together; use only enough broth to make moist. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Melt butter and saute onions. Add cheese and soup. After cheese has melted add crabmeat salt pepper and Tabasco sauce. Serve in chafing dish.

title: Quiche
instructions: Prick pie shell with fork and bake 5 minutes at 450\u00b0. After filling bake 45 minutes or until brown and puffy at 350\u00b0.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate. Beat all ingredients except nuts until smooth for 2 minutes in blender on high stopping blender occasionally to stir or 2 minutes with hand beater. Pour into pie plate. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Serve with ice cream if desired.

title: Mackenzie'S Mexican Surprise
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish pour Doritos first then layer beef and onion and beans. Pour Ro-Tel over mixture. Top with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Red Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Cream butter; slowly add sugar. Cream thoroughly. Add well beaten eggs and soda dissolved in a little hot water and cocoa mixed with a little hot water. Alternately add sour milk and flour. Mix to smooth batter. Add vanilla. Bake in moderate oven 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Pecan Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch cake pan with margarine.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins until tender. Drain and peel. Cut potatoes into bite size pieces in a large bowl. While potatoes are still warm sprinkle with vinegar. Add celery eggs pepper onion pickle salt and pepper. Blend mayonnaise and mustard together. With 2 forks gently toss all ingredients. Add more mayonnaise if needed. Avoid mashing potatoes. Cover and chill.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and eggs. In separate bowl combine flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Add flour mixture gradually to butter mixture. Mix well. Add vanilla and almond extracts.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Simmer chickens with salt until tender. Bone and chop fine. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill. Serve on a lettuce leaf with green stuffed olives and small whole dill pickles.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar milk and cocoa. Stir together. Bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Mix in oatmeal and any optional ingredient.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Heat beans then drain. Combine milk soup and pepper; pour over beans. Add 1/2 can onion rings. Pour into a large flat casserole; bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Garnish with remaining onion rings; bake 10 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Strawberry Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt 1/4 cup butter in 9-inch square pan. Mix 1/2 cup butter; add 1/2 cup sugar and beat until light. Add egg and beat well. Sift flour baking powder and salt and add to first mixture with milk beating until smooth. Carefully spread on berries. Bake in oven (375\u00b0) about 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes; turn out on serving dish. Serve at once with cream if desired.

title: Mock Steak With Gravy
instructions: Mix ground beef crackers salt and water. Form into balls and refrigerate overnight. Next day slice meat and brown in a skillet. Place slices in covered baking dish. Mix cream of mushroom soup flour steak sauce and second cup of water and pour over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Very good.

title: Kosher Dills
instructions: Pack cucumbers in jars with 2 pods of hot pepper 1 teaspoon garlic flakes and fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dill seed. Pour hot vinegar mixture over and seal jars.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs and vanilla; add diced apples. Sift together the dry ingredients and add. This makes a stiff batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Dreamy Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix milk and pudding until smooth. Add spice and pumpkin. Mix until blended. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into baked pie shells. Refrigerate until served.

title: Chicken Kabobs
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Cut chicken into 1/2-inch chunks and place in marmalade for approximately 6 to 8 hours. Wrap each chicken chunk with 1/2 slice of bacon. Thread chicken mushrooms and onions on shish-kabob skewers alternating chicken mushrooms and onions. Cook 30 to 35 minutes baste while cooking with leftover marmalade.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Chop cabbage in bite size pieces. Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Saute beef and onions. Put over cabbage. Mix tomato sauce water and rice. Pour over contents. Top with kraut. Bake 20 minutes uncovered. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine milk and lemon juice in a large bowl. Stir in cranberry sauce pineapple and nuts; fold in whipped topping. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Freeze until firm. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before cutting. Return leftovers to freezer.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingerbread And Sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour square pan 9 x 9 x 2-inch. Measure all ingredients into large mixing bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed scraping bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally. Pour into pan. Bake for 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Fruit Jam
instructions: Put everything except the gelatin into a pan and cook over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes stirring every so often. Now sample a little to see if it needs more sweetener. Sprinkle the gelatin ever the mixture and stir until completely dissolved.

title: Hillbilly Goulash
instructions: Brown beef and onions in skillet; drain. Add Worcestershire sauce. Stir in flour and mix beef well. In large pot cook egg noodles and drain. Add to noodles ground beef mixed vegetables (drained) and 1 1/2 cups tomato juice.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours. Stir occasionally. Broil shrimp and marinate 4 to 5 inches from heat in preheated oven for 7 minutes. Then shrimp and broil another 10 minutes. Serve shrimp with the marinade. Serves 4.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar water salt flour butter and vanilla and cook until thick. Add 1 tablespoon vinegar. Cool. Add to apples (sliced thin). Place in pie shell and bake at 425\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dip chicken breasts in egg batter; add salt and pepper. Roll in bread crumbs. Fry lightly in oil. Place in a greased baking dish. Cover with spaghetti sauce and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Put Mozzarella cheese on chicken 5 minutes before its done.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Slice peaches into a greased 8-inch baking dish. Add lemon juice. Mix sugar flour and egg and crumble over top of peaches. Pour margarine over top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until browned and bubbling.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix well all ingredients except butter and pie shells and Cool Whip in a saucepan. Add the butter last and cook over medium heat until thick stirring constantly.

title: Turkey Escallopes With Plums
instructions: Pound turkey if necessary between two sheets of waxed paper to uniform thickness. Place in a large bowl. Pour the apple juice soy sauce sherry garlic and thyme over the turkey and mix gently. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for 3 to 4 hours. Remove turkey and reserve the marinade. Heat butter and oil in large skillet. Quickly brown turkey on both sides. (Be careful not to overcook.) Add the plums and reserved marinade. Cover and simmer gently 10 to 15 minutes. Garnish with fresh thyme and dusting of pepper and serve.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Place thawed potatoes in large bowl. Mix soup cheese sour cream onion salt and pepper. Pour mix over potatoes. Toss until coated.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat well in a large skillet. Drain. Add green pepper onion salt and pepper. Brown a few more minutes. Add tomatoes. Place in a large bowl in this order lettuce tomatoes corn chips hot meat mixture and hot cheese mixture.

title: Lucille'S Jello
instructions: Mix about ingredients and chill until set. Top with lite Cool Whip.

title: Uncle Hollie'S Sponge Candy
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and vinegar in 2-quart bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High 3 minutes. Stir well. Microwave uncovered on High 4 to 10 minutes until thickened (300\u00b0). Test by dropping in cold water. Remove the threads; if they bend cook more. It is done if it is very brittle. Quickly stir in soda and mix well.

title: Country-Fried Steak And Cream Gravy
instructions: Pound steak to 1/4-inch; cut into serving-size pieces. Sprinkle with seasonings. Dredge in flour; dip in milk. Dredge in flour again. Brown coated steaks in hot oil. Remove and drain. Reserve 3 tablespoons pan drippings. Add 1/4 cup flour to drippings. Cook over medium heat until bubbly stirring constantly. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Add 2 cups milk slowly cook until thick stirring constantly. Add steak to gravy; cover reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove cover and cook an additional 5 minutes.

title: Cowboy Cookies(Great Family Recipe, Many Cookies To A Batch)
instructions: Sift flour soda salt and baking powder; set aside. Blend together margarine and sugars. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add oatmeal vanilla and chips. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gale Cirocco'S Broccoli And Spaghetti Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter. Pour in chicken broth and broccoli. Heat over medium burner. Add milk and Cheez Whiz. Heat on low so the milk does not curdle. Cook spaghetti separately according to box directions. Drain and add to the soup.

title: Oatmeal Nut Bread(Makes 3 Loaves)
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour salt and undissolved yeast. Heat water milk molasses and margarine over low heat until liquids are 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0. Add to dry ingredients; beat 2 minutes at medium speed scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs oatmeal and 1 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes. Stir enough flour to make a stiff dough. Turn into floured board knead 8 to 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl; grease top. Cover and let rise until doubled about 1 hour. Punch down; knead in pecans. Divide into 3 equal pieces; shape into loaves. Place in 3 greased 8 1/4 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans. Cover and let rise until doubled about 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from pans; cool on wire racks.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken celery and nuts. Add soup mayonnaise and eggs mixing well. Add most of potato chips salt and pepper. Put in greased casserole. Sprinkle with remainder of chips. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes covered.

title: Super Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix all seasonings. Add cabbage and chill thoroughly. Garnish with sliced olives. Serves 4.

title: V-8 Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine meat vegetable juice and 1 well beaten egg. Add oatmeal and mix until really moist. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Noodle Casserole #1
instructions: Combine noodles soup and milk. Add chicken broken into small pieces. Put in casserole dish cover and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Sprinkle with cheese during last 5 minutes of baking.

title: Lady Sarah'S Doughnuts(My Sweet Mother)
instructions: Sift together flour nutmeg cinnamon baking powder salt and baking soda. Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored; gradually beat in sugar. Add melted shortening milk and vinegar then add flour mixture. Mix well. Chill for a time then turn out on floured cloth.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix in dishpan. Drop on greased cookie sheet and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes (do not overbake). Makes 300 to 400 cookies.

title: Ratatouille Supreme(Healthy, No Fat)
instructions: In nonstick skillet saute eggplant and zucchini for 8 minutes. (Putting the lid on the skillet and stirring often will prevent sticking.) Add peppers and onion and simmer uncovered for another 6 minutes. Add garlic and simmer 2 minutes. Add wine tomatoes herbs salt pepper and black olives. Cook covered for 30 minutes over low heat until eggplant is tender. Sprinkle with parsley and serve. (Also good served over pasta or rice.)

title: Pineapple Bake
instructions: Slice 5 slices of bread. Melt the butter and cook the bread in the butter. Mix the rest of the ingredients and place in a casserole. Place the bread on top. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Ginger Bread Boys And Girls
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream shortening and sugar until light fluffy. Beat in egg and molasses. Add flour soda salt and spices. Stir until a stiff dough is formed. Wrap dough and refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Chewy Cake
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix with sugar. Add eggs and flour; mix well. Add vanilla and nuts; mix. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Honey-Mustard-Lime Chicken
instructions: Slice chicken breasts. Combine honey lime juice and mustard. (I use a combination of Kosciusko and a stone-ground mustard.) Place chicken in a baking dish. Pour marinade over chicken turning to coat. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes turning once.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Drain pineapple well. Squeeze to remove all liquid. Blend softened cream cheese with pineapple. Add other ingredients and shape into ball. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Reshape and roll in additional cup of finely chopped pecans.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl well. Pour into a large Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie(Makes 9-Inch Pie)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare crust (if needed) and press into pan. Soften cream cheese in large bowl. Beat in 3/4 cup sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating until smooth after each one. Beat in lemon peel and juice. Pour into crust. Bake 30 minutes or until center is firm. (Do not turn oven off.) Remove from oven. Allow to stand 5 minutes. During this time combine sour cream 1 tablespoon sugar and vanilla. Spread over top of pie. Sprinkle with nuts. Return to oven. Bake 2 minutes or until sour cream is set. Cool. Chill about 4 hours before serving.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients then add nuts. Grease Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix cake mix brown sugar pecans margarine and eggs. Spread evenly on pizza pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool. Mix container of whipped cream and softened cream cheese and spread over crust. Arrange fruit on top of filling in alternating rows of fruit. May use \Fruit Fresh\ to keep fruit from turning. Chill to serve; slice like pizza.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Mix vegetables water chestnuts and mayo. Pour into casserole. Top with cheese. Spread butter and crackers (mixed together) on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Oven-Baked Pork Stew
instructions: In a large skillet brown meat in hot oil. Remove meat from skillet reserving drippings. Stir flour into drippings. Stir in undrained tomatoes garlic bay leaf sugar bouillon granules thyme oregano pepper sauce 1/4 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and 3/4 cup of water on medium heat until dissolved. Put in blender. Add cottage cheese until very smooth. Add cream cheese yogurt and lemonade. Mix well for 2 minutes. Put in refrigerator for 3 hours. Eat with lots of fruit.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown beef in large heavy kettle; drain and add onions. Cook until onions are tender. Add remaining ingredients except cheese; simmer for 15 minutes. Ladle into bowls; top with the grated cheese. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix the finely crushed graham cracker crumbs with the powdered sugar. Add the peanut butter and melted margarine. Work with hands until smooth and soft. (If too crumbly add a bit more margarine but not much). Press into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler. Pour over mixture in pan. Refrigerate until set about 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Cabbage Pie
instructions: Roll out pastry and line a 9 inch pie plate and refrigerate. Stir fry cabbage and sliced onion in butter until barely tender. Whiz cottage cheese and scallions in blender or food processor. stir into cabbage mixture along with tarragon. Salt and pepper to taste. Distribute half of cabbage in pie shell. Arrange sliced eggs on top cover with rest of cabbage. Cover with top pastry crimp edges. Cut 2 or 3 slashes in top and bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees and bake 20 to 25 more minutes. Crust should be lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream margarine shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla. Pour into tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Blueberry Pie
instructions: Bring berries (1 cup) 3/4 cup sugar and lemon rind to boil in saucepan. Combine remaining sugar (1/4 cup) and 1/4 cup water with cornstarch. Stir into boiling berries. Cook about 1 minute until thickened. Cool to room temperature. Pour in other 4 cups berries stir to coat. Pour in baked pie shell. Chill until completely set. Decorate with whipped cream or Cool Whip and a few berries.

title: Brisket
instructions: Rub salt pepper and celery salt into brisket. Lay brisket on heavy-duty foil fat side up. Pour liquid smoke Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice over brisket. Seal in foil and let marinate overnight. Bake for 10 hours at 225\u00b0.

title: Jarilyn'S Spiced Tea
instructions: Bring 1 quart of water to a boil. Steep with 1 family size tea bag. While still hot add sugar cinnamon orange juice and lemonade. Add an additional quart of either hot or cold water (more or less to taste).

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Transfer chicken to plate; set aside. Add to skillet the oil onion salt oregano and pepper. Brown until golden. Add chicken tomatoes and wine or water. Bring to boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Remove meat; keep warm. Boil sauce over high heat 3 minutes to thicken slightly. Spoon on top of chicken. Serve over rice.

title: Honey Glazed Ham
instructions: Combine apple juice allspice cloves ginger and cinnamon sticks. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Drizzle ham with 1/2 honey. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Drizzle with other 1/2 honey. Baste with apple juice mixture every 20 minutes until done.

title: Taters
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Wash and wedge potatoes. Soak wedges in cold water for 1/2 hour. Mix together dry ingredients. Coat wedges with mixture. Place in pan on top of melted butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes turning once after 20 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine the first ingredient in a large bowl. Combine corn meal and all other ingredients; pour into cream-style corn. Place in an 11 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until a knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Blue Owl Restaurants Chicken Salad Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the cheese. Place in pie crust. Bake at 375 degrees for about 30 minutes. Top with cheddar cheese and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Navajo Fry Bread(For Navajo Tacos)
instructions: Mix ingredients and let set for 1 hour. Take small amount of dough and knead into a ball. Roll out on a floured surface. Fry in hot oil. Top with chili cheese lettuce tomato onion etc. Use leftover bread for dessert. Its great with honey on top.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In large bowl combine butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla. Beat at medium speed until creamy. Add egg beat well. Turn mixer to low gradually add flour mixture. Stir in morsels. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes. Remove and cool completely. Makes 6 dozen 2 inch cookies.

title: Chocolate Mint Pie
instructions: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons milk in saucepan over low heat. Beat sugar in cream cheese; add remaining milk the chocolate mixture and peppermint and beat until smooth. Fold chocolate mixture into whipped topping. Spoon into crust and freeze.

title: Shrimp Scampi For Two
instructions: Soak fish in buttermilk overnight or for 4 to 6 hours. Wash well removing buttermilk. Drain on paper towels. Squeeze lemon juice over fish. Roll in mixture of cracker meal flour and small amount of cornmeal if desired. Fry in heavy skillet (cast-iron) in enough Crisco plus 1 tablespoon butter to cover bottom of pan well.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Pour boiling water over tomatoes red peppers green peppers and onion; let stand 5 minutes. Drain and add sugar vinegar and canning salt. Mix and cook 15 minutes. Mix salad mustard with cornstarch and cook 15 minutes longer. Stir to keep from sticking. Remove from stove and add salad dressing. Stir thoroughly and put in pint jars; seal.

title: Sugar-Free Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix well and drop by level teaspoon on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown about 10 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix. Roll in a ball and put on pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes. Put a chocolate star on top.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Add water to juice to make 2 cups and heat to boiling point. Add Jell-O pineapple and cranberry sauce; stir until cranberry sauce is completely melted. Stir in nuts and refrigerate until set.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O as directed on box. After set add pineapple and bananas. (Icing recipe follows.)

title: Mexican Fahitas
instructions: Marinate steak in oil and vinegar overnight. Place a little oil in pan and saute over very high heat so meat sears. Add 2 tablespoons green peppers salt pepper and garlic. Cook until meat is done.

title: Blender Breakfast
instructions: Put orange juice sugar dry milk ice cubes and banana or strawberries in blender. Blend on high speed for 1 minute or until ice is chopped and mixture is smooth. Pour into individual glasses. Garnish with orange slices.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer for a few minutes. Add cheese to taste. Easy! Good!

title: Mama'S Goo-Ood Chili
instructions: Cook ground chuck until brown; drain through strainer until all fat is gone. Finely crumble meat with hands then put in 6-quart slow cooker. Add all remaining ingredients then stir to mix thoroughly. Cook on high 2 hours then simmer for 2 hours then enjoy the best chili in world.

title: Open House Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large serving bowl adding the 7-Up last. Add ice cubes or frozen ice ring. Serve and enjoy.

title: Candy Pizza
instructions: Heat chocolate chips and condensed milk in microwave until melted. Pour over 1 cup Rice Krispies and stir to coat. Press on buttered pizza pan. Press into top the candied cherries and nuts. Drizzle melted almond bark across top or can use part of white frosting mixed with Eagle Brand.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Mix soup milk onion and parsley. Dip chicken in soup mixture and then roll in stuffing. Place in shallow baking dish. Pour butter over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Chicken Tamale Pie
instructions: Mix soup beans chilies chili powder onions and chicken in a saucepan and heat. Mix muffin mix as directed. Add 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese. Pour into casserole dish and pull up onto sides. Pour heated mixture within 1/4 inch of edge. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Garnish with cheese onions and cherry tomatoes.

title: Russian Tea Mix
instructions: Mix. Store in sealed jar and mix 1 to 2 tablespoons with hot water to make 1 cup.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix together Kool Aid water sugar frozen limeade and lemonade. Last just before serving add 7 up ginger ale and orange sherbet.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oil pudding and eggs. Beat well after each egg is added. Add milk and grated chocolate and fold in chocolate chips. Bake in tube pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients in oblong pan laying chicken on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn heat to 200\u00b0 until done about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Green Chili Stew
instructions: Ingredients may be increased or decreased according to taste. Go ahead! Have it your way.

title: Chicken In Tomato Cream Sauce
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and nutmeg. Brown lightly in heated butter in large pan. As you turn chicken to brown second side add onion and mushrooms around edges. Sprinkle chicken with parsley and basil. Pour in sherry. Bring to a boil and cover. Reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked (about 20 minutes). Transfer chicken to warm serving dish. Stir mustard into liquid in pan. Add tomatoes and cream. Bring to a boil cook and stir until liquid is shiny reduced and slightly thickened. Pour sauce over chicken and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl until smooth. Pour batter into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cream Puffs(Diabetic)
instructions: Combine water shortening and salt. Bring to boil. Reduce to low and add flour; beat until smooth and ball clings. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs one at a time. Beat until smooth. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or golden brown and almost dry. Makes 6 to 8.

title: Hot Ham Buns
instructions: Mix butter mustard poppy seed and onion and spread on the surface of buns. Tuck a slice of ham and cheese in each bun. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes until hot.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Cream margarine vanilla and peanut butter together adding powdered sugar until desired consistency is reached. Roll into 1-inch balls and place on wax paper lined cookie sheet. Melt chocolate chips and Crisco in top of double boiler; keep mixture in boiler over low heat and dip balls in chocolate. Place on wax paper to cool.

title: Baked Corn Custard
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together and place in a shallow baking dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Molasses Popcorn Balls
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan combine molasses corn syrup and vinegar. Cook stirring occasionally till a little mixture dropped into cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat add 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine. Stir only long enough to mix. Pour over popcorn. Toss until coated. Quickly shape into 2 1/2-inch balls. Makes 10.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and salad dressing mix until smooth. Slice a thin slice off tops of tomatoes and carefully remove insides; invert on paper towel to drain. Fill with cream cheese mixture.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix together and let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Cut asparagus spears in pieces about 3/4 inch long and place in bottom of a casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese and hard-boiled eggs. Cover with white sauce. Add another layer of asparagus cheese egg and pimento; cover with white sauce. Top with buttered bread crumbs or crumbled Ritz crackers. Bake in a moderate oven and cook until crumbs are crisp and brown approximately 30 minutes.

title: Banana-Nut Bread
instructions: Mash bananas (hands work best). Add all other ingredients. Either grease and flour pans or spray with cooking spray. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 until done (45 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Potato Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain and set aside. Combine soup milk onion salt and pepper. In a greased 2-quart casserole dish layer half of the potatoes half of the soup mixture and half of the sausage. Repeat ending with sausage. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven uncovered for 2 minutes.

title: Four Layer Salad
instructions: Make a bed of lettuce in the bowl. Place a layer of English peas on the lettuce then a layer of chopped onion. Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over onions. Top with package of shredded Cheddar cheese.

title: Mock Angel Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour 5 times then add sugar and salt. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until about half stiff then add baking powder. Beat until it stands in peaks. Now pour boiling water over flour and sugar and stir until well mixed. Add vanilla. Fold in egg whites until well blended. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan in slow oven at 320\u00b0.

title: Minted Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine cucumber onion vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Toss well. Add yogurt and fresh mint. Stir well to combine. Refrigerate.

title: Peach Pear Jam
instructions: Wash peel pit and grind or finely chop peaches pears and cherries. Prepare jam according to directions on package of MCP Pectin for Peach Pear Jam.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In medium skillet melt butter and add sugar cocoa and milk. Bring to boil over medium heat. Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Return to boil. Remove from heat add oatmeal uncooked. Stir until mixed well. Spoon onto wax paper and let cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Top with herb stuffing Pepperidge Farm. Add grated cheese on top.

title: Steamed Spinach
instructions: Squeeze and dry spinach thoroughly. Melt butter and chop onion fine. Mix egg yolks with spinach and add all ingredients except egg whites. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into spinach.

title: Foiled Hobo Stew(Method:  Foil)
instructions: Put meat for one serving on a large foil square. Add remaining ingredients. Seal foil with a double foil. Cook on hot coals for 45 to 60 minutes turning occasionally.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add extracts. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 (do not preheat oven) for 1 1/2 hours +.

title: Jello Cheese Cake
instructions: Remove cream cheese from fridge. Put evaporated milk in freezer. Add 1 cup hot water to Jell-O. Place in fridge until syrupy. Whip. Add sugar and vanilla to cheese and beat. Whip evaporated milk until it peaks. Mix with cheese mixture. Add crushed pineapple if desired. Press 1/2 of cracker mixture into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and let stand while preparing other ingredients. Sprinkle balance of crackers over top.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: In large bowl mix together\tmeal flour buttermilk eggs onion sugar garlic and paprika.\tBring 4 cups oil to a boil in large pot. Drop\tby teaspoonfuls in hot oil until brown. Yield 50 hush puppies.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef until browned stirring to crumble. Drain. Spoon beef into an 8-inch baking dish. Top with pizza sauce and cheese. Combine biscuit mix milk and eggs; beat until smooth. Pour mixture over casserole covering evenly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Melted Cheese Spread
instructions: Cut up cheese. Add milk; put on medium heat until cheese is melted. Add egg and cornstarch; cook until thick. Cool. Makes a good sandwich on rye with slice of shave ham.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Add coconut chocolate chips and nuts in layers. Pour milk over nuts. Do not stir. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Rice And Beef Supper
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 2 1/2-quart greased covered oven dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed. Serves 4.

title: Rhubarb Crisp
instructions: In an 8 x 8-inch pan mix the first 5 ingredients. In bowl combine the next 4 ingredients. Sprinkle on top of rhubarb. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Easy Vegetable Linguine
instructions: Cook linguine as directed. Cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons fat. Saute onion and broccoli in fat. Crumble bacon. Combine all ingredients. Mix lightly. Serve with additional cheese. Can be served warm or cold. Makes 2 servings.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Rinse the dry green split peas. Pick out any stems or stones. Put peas ham hock onion pepper and water in a pot. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours until ham hock is tender. Remove ham hock and cut meat from bone. Cut meat into small pieces. Return meat into soup. Heat to serving temperature.

title: Quiche Parmesana
instructions: Place all ingredients (minus pie shell) in blender. Cover; blend at high speed at least 1 minute. Pour mixture into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Easy Vegetable-Beef Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer over low heat for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dream Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as per recipe on box. While still hot poke small holes with toothpick. Heat Jell-O up and pour over cake slowly to drain in cake. Chill completely in refrigerator until cold. Frost with whipped cream. Chill and serve.

title: Rice And Gravy
instructions: Cook the rice then meat and seasoning then put gravy. Put the rice and gravy in the to 72 minits and it is radey.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 in tube pan (Bundt pan is nice to cook this in).

title: Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease baking pan (9 x 13-inch). Melt chocolate and shortening in large saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat. Mix in sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread into pan. Bake 30 minutes or until brownies pull away from pan. Do not overbake. Cool. Cut into bars. If desired before cutting spread with chocolate frosting.

title: Artichoke Pie
instructions: Mix basil garlic and oil. Add tofu; blend. Mix in pine nuts. Pour into crust and top with artichoke hearts and bread crumbs. Drizzle oil on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine sugar and flour. Add the corn syrup coconut pineapple eggs and vanilla; mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Cover loosely with foil if the top browns too quickly. Cool on a wire rack. Chill before cutting. Store in the refrigerator. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Egg-Cheese Dish(Breakfast - Brunch)
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan generously. Spread the bread cubes over bottom of pan. Sprinkle cheese cubes over bread. In bowl beat eggs. Add milk and seasonings. Mix well. Pour over cheese-bread in pan carefully. Cover with plastic or foil and place in fridge overnight. Next morning sprinkle bacon bits over mixture and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In blender grind cookies up fine. Add melted butter and mix. Press into 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Melt chocolate in microwave stirring every 30 seconds. Pour half into pan over crust. Smooth and spread over entire crust. Keep remaining chocolate warm. Blend peanut butter and butter together. Slowly beat in confectioners sugar; add vanilla. Beat. Spread over chocolate layer. Pour remaining chocolate over peanut butter layer. Chill for 1 hour. Cut into bars and serve. Very rich!

title: Granny'S Rolls
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Slowly add 9 to 10 cups flour until sticky dough forms. Turn out onto greased bowl and turn to cover top with grease. Let rise until doubled. Punch down and form rolls. Place in greased pan and let rise until double. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Brush margarine over tops of hot rolls.

title: Crab Meat Dip
instructions: Mix chill and serve.

title: Hot Chili Sauce
instructions: Wash tomatoes and dip into boiling water long enough to loosen skins then remove skins and core. Cut up and place in colander to drain. Save drained juice and put in 8 quart kettle and boil about 30 minutes. Add other ingredients and cook moderately fast stirring often until sauce thickens to desired consistency (about 2 1/2 hours). Store in pint or 1/2 pint jars. This sauce may also be served as a cocktail sauce on shrimp or oysters.

title: Jalapeno Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine all filling ingredients in mixing bowl. Mix well. On each tortilla spread about 1/2 cup mixture. Roll up tightly (jelly roll fashion). Wrap in Saran Wrap. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Cut each tortilla into 12 slices. Makes 48.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix well together and put into a greased loaf pan; bake at 300\u00b0 until brown.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Thaw spinach. Mix with ingredients; pour into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Gingerbread Cookies(50 To 60 Cookies)
instructions: Combine the sugar ginger nutmeg cinnamon salt and baking soda. Mix well. Add the melted margarine evaporated milk and molasses. Add the extracts if desired. Mix well. Add the flour 1 cup at a time stirring constantly. The dough should be stiff enough to handle without sticking to fingers. Knead the dough for a smoother texture. Add up to 1/2 cup additional flour if necessary to prevent sticking.

title: Crunchy Jungle Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugars thoroughly. Add the eggs and vanilla; blend. Add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture. Form into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Low-Fat Green Chili Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Open cans of green chilies and rinse in colander with water; set aside. Take egg whites and evaporated milk; whisk until just frothy. Spray ungreased 8 x 9-inch pan with Pam or other low saturated fat oil. Put a layer of chilies then sprinkle mixture of 2 cheeses (I use quite a bit). Then pour 1/3 of milk and egg white mixture. This mixture does not need to cover the layer. Repeat this layering (chilies cheese and milk mixture) until you are at the top. Pour tomato sauce on top to cover. Bake until bubbly throughout anywhere from 20 to 30 minutes. Take out. Serve with salad and bread.

title: Indian Salmon Croquettes
instructions: In large bowl drain and pulverize salmon. Add all ingredients; mixing thoroughly. Mixture should be moist and not too chunky. Pour top olive oil into heavy iron skillet and heat over medium heat. Shape croquettes to desired size dust with flour on both sides and cook turning them once until golden brown on both sides about 4 to 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Microwave Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in 2-quart glass casserole dish with salt and pepper. Cover with water and microwave covered on High for 40 minutes. Saute onion peppers mushrooms and garlic until onion is translucent. Drain chicken reserving liquid.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Combine oil vinegar and seasonings; mix thoroughly. Cut up lettuce tomatoes cucumbers onions and pour dressing over all. Garnish with black olives and Feta cheese.

title: Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cover bottom of pot with oil and brown 3 to 4 minced garlic cloves. Add tomato sauce and the remaining spices according to taste. Brown the meat and drain fat. Add the meat and let simmer 1 hour. Serves 3 to 4. Cook until desired thickness the longer you cook it the thicker it gets.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with 2 cups hot water until dissolved. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Add blueberry pie filling and crushed pineapple. Place in refrigerator until firm. Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together. Spread on top of congealed salad.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Saute chopped onions and peppers until tender in shortening. Add ground meat and brown. Add tomatoes rice and seasoning. Put in covered dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Serve.

title: Sinful Potatoes
instructions: Thaw hash browns. Put soup cheese onion and sour cream in large mixing bowl; stir together. Add potatoes and salt and pepper to taste and mix again. Pour into 10 x 13-inch pan.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in a roasting pan. Bake at a low heat (200\u00b0 to 300\u00b0) for several hours until done.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
instructions: Mix margarine and brown sugar in cast iron deep fry pan on the stove. Spread evenly in bottom of pan. Remove from stove and place pineapple rings on top of mixture placing a cherry in the center of each pineapple ring. In a large bowl place cake mix eggs and pineapple juice. Mix well mixture will thick heavy and fluffy. Spread on top of pineapple in cast iron pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake is golden brown and a toothpick stuck in the center comes out clean. Cool cake in pan for 5 minutes then turn over onto cake plate. Best served warm.

title: Striped Pudding Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directed baking in 9 x 13-inch pan. Remove from oven. Poke holes at once down through the cake to the pan with round handle of wooden spoon. Holes should be about 1-inch apart.

title: Bob Hope'S Favorite Chicken Hash
instructions: Cut chicken in fine strips crumble bacon and combine with the onion butter lemon juice and seasonings. Saute until thoroughly heated in the butter and shortly before serving add the sherry and sour cream. Do not allow to cook after adding the last two ingredients. Just heat through.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Grate large chunk of Mozzarella and Romano cheese; set aside. Brown in skillet celery onion and ground beef. Mix in saucepan tomatoes tomato paste sugar vinegar garlic powder salt and pepper. Add meat mixture to sauce and simmer 3 hours. Cook lasagna noodles. Spread 1/3 sauce in large baking dish. Put layer of noodles over sauce. Sprinkle cheese over noodles. Repeat and top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Beat shortening sugars eggs and vanilla until fluffy. Stir in flour mixture oats and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain. Spread in ungreased baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Layer ham and cheese over broccoli. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour over cheese. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lula'S Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake in greased\ttube pan for 4 hours at 250\u00b0. Put a pan of water over cake and one of water under cake.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together. Chill 24 hours for thick or 3 hours for creamy smooth.

title: Broccoli Chowder
instructions: Wash broccoli and remove any leaves on coarse stems. Put broccoli in kettle and add half the stock or broth. Bring to boil reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 7 minutes or until tender. Remove broccoli from stock with slotted spoon and chop coarsely. Add remaining stock milk ham salt and pepper to the stock in kettle and stir well. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring occasionally. Stir in cream cheese butter and broccoli and heat until cheese is melted. Do not boil. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Mix flour butter and powdered sugar. Press evenly in bottom of ungreased square pan (8x8x2). Bake for 20 minutes. Beat remaining ingredients about 3 minutes on medium speed or until light and fluffy. Pour over hot crust. Bake about 25 minutes longer or just until no imprint remains when touched lightly in the center. Cool. Cut into 2 inch squares.

title: Hickory Smoked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken on baking sheet. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with seasoning. Bake in oven for 30 minutes. While chicken is baking melt butter in saucepan with garlic over low heat. Cook for a minute. Add tomato sauce and hickory seasoning. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove chicken from oven; brush generously with sauce. Cook 15 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine onions green chiles soup sour cream olives and 1/4 of each cheese. Set aside 1 1/2 cups of the combine mixture. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay each tortilla flat and put in mixture. Roll up and put rolls in pan. Cover tortillas with the remaining mixture. Sprinkle remaining cheese over the tortillas. Refrigerate overnight. Bake in oven uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Beat egg slightly with fork; stir in milk pumpkin and margarine. Blend dry ingredients and stir in until flour mixture is moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Fold in raisins. Fill greased muffin cups or paper baking cups 2/3 full. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon sugar over each muffin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Better Than Sin Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box. When cake is done poke holes in first layer and spread 1/2 of the condensed milk on top and then 1/2 of the caramel heat the hot fudge and put 1/2 of it on the first layer repeat process on second layer. Add cool whip on top and cherries to garnish.

title: Monteray Carrot Cake
instructions: Measure into sifter the flour salt cinnamon baking soda and sugar. Sift into mixing bowl and add salad oil eggs (one at a time) and vanilla. Beat until light. Stir in carrots. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini With Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray an 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole dish with a nonfat cooking spray. With a stiff brush scrub zucchini well. Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. In a medium bowl combine flour and 1/2 teaspoon lite salt 1/2 teaspoon oregano and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Toss zucchini slices in seasoned flour to coat them well. Slowly heat liquid Butter Buds in a nonstick skillet. Saute zucchini slices until golden brown about 4 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towels. Cover bottom of baking dish with zucchini. Top with tomato slices.

title: My Mom'S Strawberry Bread
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the first 3 ingredients. In a large bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Grease and flour 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans. Set aside. Add strawberry mixture to dry ingredients and stir until blended. Pour into pans. Bake one hour or more at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean. Contains 195 calories per 1/2-inch slice.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and reserve 2/3 cup for topping (add nuts; optional). Add oil water and eggs to remaining batter and beat. Sprinkle topping over batter and top with chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: No Egg Ice Cream
instructions: Add 1/2 cup sugar to fresh peaches. Blend. Add 2 cups sugar Pet milk and apricot nectar to peaches. Mix and pour in freezer. Fill 1 gallon ice cream freezer with milk and freeze.

title: Hamburger 'N Hot Dogs
instructions: In a pot cook hamburger with garlic; drain oil. Add soup mix onions and celery to hamburger mixture. Simmer on low heat. Chop hot dogs into bite size. Add hot dogs and Ragu sauce to hamburger mixture; set on low heat to simmer. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Roll out biscuits; fill with apples. Pinch together. Bring to a boil the butter sugar cinnamon and 7-Up. Pour over Apple Dumplings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Taco Salad
instructions: In large skillet brown ground beef and onion; drain. Remove from skillet; set aside. In same skillet prepare Rice-A-Roni as package directs. Stir in meat mixture salsa and chili powder; continue cooking over low heat 3 to 4 minutes or until heated through. Arrange lettuce on serving platter or bowl. Top with beef/rice mixture tomato and cheese. Garnish or serve with tortilla chips.

title: Piroshki
instructions: Remove pastry shells from package and let stand at room temperature to thaw 30 minutes.

title: Coke Roast
instructions: Sprinkle roast with seasoned salt and sear in oil on all sides. Remove and blot off fat from roast. Place roast in a foil lined pan. Pour Coke and chili sauce over roast then Worcestershire sauce. Cover loosely with foil and bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0. It will have a barbecued flavor and tastes good the next day too.

title: Cheater'S Cheese Souffle
instructions: Sprinkle the sliced chicken with 2 tablespoons flour (or put both into a bag and shake). Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the chicken and flour and saute until lightly browned (about 4 to 5 minutes). Remove chicken from pan and keep warm. Combine garlic ginger vinegar chicken stock honey and soy sauce. Add to the same pan and bring to a boil; stir until thickened fragrant and reduced by about half (about 5 minutes). Add chicken to the pan stirring well. Sprinkle with scallions and heat through. Serve over steamed rice. Serves 4.

title: Rye Log
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients well add corned beef. Let sit overnight in refrigerator covered.

title: Dorothy'S New England Apple-Raisin Bread
instructions: Blend flour sugar cocoa soda salt and spices in a large bowl. Stir together buttermilk applesauce and butter. Combine above stirring until just moistened. Fold in raisins and nuts and turn into greased and floured 6 1/2 C ring mold.

title: Lazy Man'S Chile
instructions: Brown the meat with the diced onion and seasonings. Add tomato soup (do not dilute). Add kidney beans (do not dilute). Let simmer 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Lemonade Pie
instructions: Fold sweetened condensed milk and lemonade concentrate into whipped topping; spoon into crusts. Freeze until firm. Garnish if desired.

title: Smooth Chocolate Dip
instructions: Whisk ingredients in a small bowl. Makes about 3/4 cup of dip.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mixing well. Spread 1/2 of mixture in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cover with 1 can (4 or 5 oz.) green chilies drained and 6 ounces shredded Cheddar cheese. Spread remaining batter over top. Bake in hot oven 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until browned. Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Potato Soup
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut them into small cubes with some large cubes. Put them and the soup water and milk in a pan. Bring to a boil until potatoes are done. Season with celery seed and garlic while cooking.

title: Old-Fashion Herb Stuffing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place bread cubes on baking sheet; bake 10 minutes or until dry. Melt margarine in large saucepan over medium heat. Add onions celery and carrot; cover and cook 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add broth thyme sage paprika and pepper; bring to a simmer. Stir in bread pieces; mix well. Remove pan from heat; set aside. Coat a 1-1/2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spoon stuffing into dish. Cover and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Serves 4.

title: Escalloped Pineapple
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Blend in milk oleo pineapple and bread crumbs. Pour into a well-greased casserole and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Especially good served with baked ham instead of sweet potatoes.

title: Baked Custard
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar (exact amount depends upon sweetness desired) and salt and stir until well mixed. Add scalded milk gradually while stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Add nutmeg or cinnamon if desired. Bake in 6 or 8 custard cups or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Place cups in a shallow pan containing warm water and bake in a moderate 325\u00b0 oven 45 minutes for the cups and 50 to 60 minutes for casserole. Test by inserting a silver knife into center of the custard. If knife comes out clean the custard is done.

title: Swiss Cheese Bread
instructions: Trim crust from bread leaving bottom crust intact. Make diagonal cuts 1-inch apart in bread. Do not cut completely through bread into slices but leave bottom crust intact.

title: Vegetable Potato Soup
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in covered saucepan until tender. Mash until fluffy. Add milk; mix well. Cook remaining vegetables and salt in beef broth in covered saucepan until tender about 15 minutes. Blend with potato mixture. Stir in black pepper and butter. Serve hot.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in bowl and mix well. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in nutmeg salt milk and flavoring. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes or until pies are done.

title: Rice-A-Roni Salad
instructions: Cook and cool Rice-A-Roni according to package directions. Drain liquid from marinated artichoke hearts and mix with mayonnaise. Add all ingredients and marinade to Rice-A-Roni. Garnish with artichoke hearts.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water and cool. Mix all ingredients and chill in bowl. (A jello salad bowl is best.) Unmold salad and serve with crackers.

title: Brisket Marinate
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients and put on brisket. Wrap with foil and put in refrigerator overnight. Mix Worcestershire sauce and season salt together. Pour over brisket. Rewrap and bake at 300\u00b0 for 5 to 7 hours or until tender.

title: Old Fashioned Ground Beef Soup
instructions: Brown the ground chuck with onions celery and bell pepper. Add remaining ingredients and cover with water until all vegetables are covered. Add stew mix and cook until vegetables are tender. Makes a large pot of soup that may be frozen indefinitely.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In casserole dish add layers of broccoli onions eggs and celery soup. Make a cream sauce of melted butter flour and salt. Stir well. Add milk and cheese; blend until melted. Pour over other ingredients. Sprinkle with grated cheese or Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Brown onion lightly in butter. Add chili sauce water and sugar; simmer for 20 minutes. Add mustard lemon juice vinegar Worcestershire salt and garlic. Simmer until mixture is thick.

title: Rechele'S Red Beans And Rice
instructions: In a large pan cook onions green peppers and garlic in butter for about 3 minutes. Add beans sausage tomato sauce and worcestershire sauce hot pepper sauce. Tabasco sauce and red pepper. Reduce heat to a simmer cover and cook for 15 minutes. Boil rice. Serve mixture over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix butter sugar peanut butter and vanilla together. Roll into 1/2 inch balls; chill. Melt chocolate chips and dip peanut butter balls. Place on wax paper.

title: Blueberry-Oat Muffins
instructions: Combine oats and sour milk in small bowl. In another bowl combine flour baking powder soda salt and brown sugar; stir well to blend. Add egg and melted margarine to oat mixture; stir well. Add oat mixture all at once to dry ingredients. Stir just until all ingredients are moistened. Gently fold in blueberries. Fill well-greased muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Date Skillet Cookies
instructions: Cook first four ingredients for 15 minutes (medium heat) in an electric skillet. When cooked stir in nuts vanilla and Rice Krispies. Mix well. Let cool about 10 minutes. Roll in hand to make small balls and then roll in coconut. Put on waxed paper on cookie sheet.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Fry steak in oil until brown. Place in roasting pan or crock-pot. Cover with remaining ingredients. Simmer at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until tender.

title: Mango Chutney
instructions: Peel and slice mangos. Salt and cover with water overnight. Strain and wash. Boil all ingredients (except sugar) until tender. Add sugar and simmer another 2 hours. Bottle and seal.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Add salt to water in large cooking pan. Bring water to a boil. Add macaroni. When water returns to boil cook macaroni for 7 to 9 minutes. DO NOT OVERCOOK. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Drain in colander. Run hot water through macaroni to rinse well. Combine eggs melted butter milk salt and pepper. Mix in cooked macaroni. Arrange macaroni mixture and grated cheese alternately in buttered casserole with top layer being cheese. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until surface is golden brown and cheese is crusted. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sinful Pie
instructions: Mix crumbs sugar and margarine in pie plate. Press evenly in bottom of pan. Arrange banana slices on crust. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add milk and pudding mix. Beat until thickened. Spread over banana slices; put pineapple over this. Spread Cool Whip over pineapple. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Fried Squash
instructions: Slice the squash into thin rounds. Dip in beaten egg then coat with the cornmeal. Fry in oil on medium heat on both sides. Drain on paper towel and salt lightly before serving.

title: Momma'S Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into buttered casserole dish. Top with several pats of butter and sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: You will need 1 new 8 x 10-inch flowerpot silk flowers and candy gummy worms.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix and make into soft balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients except peas beans and pasta in large pot. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Add peas beans and pasta and cook an additional 1/2 hour or until all vegetables are tender. Add extra water during cooking if soup starts to get too thick.

title: Pepper Relish(Makes About 6 To 8 Pints)
