instructions: Grind and soak peppers and onions in boiling water for 15 minutes. Drain and add sugar vinegar and salt. Bring to a boil and let simmer for 30 to 35 minutes. Seal at once. Delicious on sandwiches!

title: Goochies
instructions: Line cookie sheet with tinfoil. Break crackers and place on foil. Sprinkle nuts over crackers. Boil margarine butter and sugar for 3 minutes. Spoon over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Golden Beef Quiche
instructions: Lightly brown beef and onions. Drain off any grease. Put meat in crust. Mix undiluted soup and rest of ingredients. Pour over meat. Bake 35 to 45 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Melt chips and peanut butter together until smooth. Add corn flakes and mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let harden.

title: Pixie Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients until well blended.

title: Swedish Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice according to pkg. directions.

title: Pecan Praline Ice Cream
instructions: Place pecans in butter in a skillet and toast. In a separate bowl mix all other ingredients. Mix in pecans. Pour mix into freezer add milk to fill line. Follow ice cream manufacturers directions.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine corn milk onions egg salt and pepper; mix well. Pour into pan top with pimientos and green peppers. Stir just enough to mix. Dot top with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cheesy Lasagne
instructions: Melt margarine and stir in flour and salt. Cook stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in milk. Boil stirring constantly for 1 minute. Add Swiss cheese Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cook and stir over low heat until cheeses are melted and mix remaining ingredients along with Parmesan cheese. Spread 1/4 of the cheese sauce mixture in ungreased dish. Top with 4 uncooked noodles. Spread 1 cup cottage cheese mixture over noodles. Repeat with 4 noodles the remaining noodles and remaining cheese mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Flora'S Pepper-Rice Rings And Pork Chops
instructions: Heat fat. Brown chops on both sides. Place onion and pepper ring slices on each chop. Fill rings with rice. Pour (spoon) tomato juice over rice to moisten. Add seasoning. Reduce temperature (to about 240\u00b0). Cook approximately 1 hour.

title: Southern Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until brown.

title: String Bean Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon crisp; crumble. Saute onion in bacon drippings. Drain beans; put in casserole. Dilute soup with 1/2 can hot water. Add onion to soup and simmer 2 minutes. Pour soup and onion mixture over beans in casserole. Sprinkle bacon bits on top. Cover and bake for about 25 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Corn Cheese Custard Pie
instructions: Thaw pie shell for 1 minute. Mix ingredients until well blended. Pour into pie shell and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 until puffed and browned.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Blend soup milk and pepper. In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish arrange alternately with potatoes onion and sauce. Dot top with 1 tablespoon butter; sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more or until potatoes are done.

title: 1-2-3 Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Put beans in greased casserole dish. Add soup over top and then put the onion rings on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Heavenly Lime Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. In a large mixing bowl mash cream cheese. Add hot gelatin mixture; stir until dissolved. Melt marshmallows in 1/4 cup boiling water. Add cold water and whipped cream. Beat mixture until smooth. Add pineapple and nuts. Pour into greased mold large baking dish or individual molds.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Mix together all ingredients put into a buttered casserole cover and bake at 350\u00b0f. 180\u00b0c. gas mark 4 for 35-45 minutes.

title: Saucy Apple Swirl
instructions: Blend sugar and cinnamon. Grease 10-inch Bundt or tube pan and dust with about 1 tablespoon of sugar-cinnamon mixture; save remainder for cake. Blend cake mix applesauce and eggs until moistened. Beat as directed on package. Reserve 1 1/2 cups batter. Pour remaining batter into pan. Sprinkle with remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture; then top with reserved batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until done. Cool cake in pan top side up for 15 minutes. Then invert on serving plate.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugars. Blend in egg and vanilla; mix well. Add combination of dry ingredients; mix well then stir in chocolate morsels.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake chocolate cake as directed on the box and cool. Mix pudding as directions say on the box. Crush candy bars. Thaw Cool Whip.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook pork and chicken until very tender. Cut in small pieces. Mix all ingredients together and simmer 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in loaf pans coated with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Makes 2 to 3 loaves depending on size of pan.

title: Applesauce Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well; sift dry ingredients and add alternately with applesauce mixing well. Add nuts and raisins which have been rolled in flour. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. I use a tube cake pan.

title: Barbecue Hash
instructions: Cook all meat separately; only brown hamburger. Remove all fat and keep liquid. (Liquid will be used to thin hash as other ingredients may make it too thick.) Grind meat tomatoes potatoes and onions. Mix all ingredients. Bring to a boil then cook very slowly until done stirring constantly (wooden paddle good to use for stirring). Mixture easy to stick and burn. Add liquid from cooked meats to thin as desired. Used over rice. Will freeze.

title: Banana-Chocolate Tea Bread
instructions: Cream butter gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour cocoa soda salt and cinnamon; sift together. Stir flour mixture into egg mixture blending well. Add vanilla. Stir in banana sour cream nuts and chocolate chips.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Set 1 cup Oreos grounded aside; mix melted butter and Oreos together. In 13 x 9-inch glass dish press Oreos down. Slice ice cream long ways 3/4-inch thick. Set in pan on top of Oreos 1 can of fudge on top of ice cream. Spread Cool Whip on top of fudge; sprinkle 1 cup Oreos on top Cool Whip. Cover with Saran Wrap. Put in freezer.

title: Batter White Bread
instructions: In large mixing bowl sprinkle yeast into water; let stand a few minutes then stir until dissolved. Add 3 1/4 cups flour sugar salt and shortening. Blend at low speed then beat 2 minutes at medium speed or beat by hand. Beat remaining flour in by hand. Cover and let rise until doubled about 45 minutes. Stir batter beating hard 1/2 minute. Spread in 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Let rise until doubled about 20 minutes. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Melissa'S Best Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs 5 minutes. Shell eggs and wash with water. Cut eggs in half. Put egg yolks in dish and egg whites on plate. Mix egg yolks and Miracle Whip together. Spoon egg mixture into egg whites.

title: Marinated Chicken Breasts
instructions: Soak chicken in mixture of remaining ingredients for several hours or overnight. Cook or grill.

title: Eggplant And Shrimp
instructions: May use fresh peeled shrimp in place of canned shrimp.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and refrigerate. Then mix next 3 ingredients. Toss these two parts together; at the last minute add chips and Russian dressing.

title: Rice Dressing
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage. Saute vegetables in butter until soft; do not brown. Mix veggies rice meat and all soups together. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Corn
instructions: Boil corn until tender. Drain. In small saucepan melt butter milk and cream cheese together. Blend until creamy. Add seasoned salt. Pour over corn and mix well.

title: Grandmother'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugars. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour cocoa salt baking powder and soda. Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Stir in water mix until smooth. (Batter will be thin.) Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind rind of 1 orange. Grind oranges apples and cranberries; mix. Add sugar. Prepare Jell-O according to directions using 1/4 less water. Add Jell-O and nuts to the cranberry mixture; refrigerate until set. This freezes well and will keep almost indefinitely in the freezer. Serves 12.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs vanilla and zucchini together. Add all other ingredients to wet mixture. Grease and flour loaf pans. Pour into loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Spiced Round
instructions: When the hog heads have been cleaned and soaked in salt water for some days put in a dinner pot and cook in plenty of water until very tender. Take out in another pot and with a fork break up fine; put in some of the juices and one pint of sifted meal to a head or more if you like; return to the stove and boil a few minutes. Can use the whole head and jowl which makes it very nice. In this case you take off all the grease that you can. Mold and fry in a hot skillet.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Mix all together (except kisses). Shape dough in balls; roll in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. When cooked top each cookie with a candy kiss and press so cookie cracks around edges.

title: Pastichio(Baked Macaroni)
instructions: Brown meat and onions slowly (will make its own grease). When meat is browned add garlic powder and tomato sauce blending well. Cook macaroni just until tender. Drain and set aside. Mix eggs margarine and milk together and set aside. Lightly butter 9 x 13-inch pan and put down a layer of macaroni packing well. Add layer of cheese and a layer of meat. Repeat the three layers ending with the rest of the pasta meat and cheese. Pour egg mixture over top and using a knife make wide cuts in the pastichio so the egg mixture will run through pasta. Oh so good! Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare stuffing mix according to directions; set aside. Place chicken breasts in casserole. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place a slice of cheese on each chicken breast. Pour the undiluted chicken soup over the chicken. Place the prepared Stove Top stuffing on top. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove the lid reduce the heat to 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes more. Serves 4.

title: Fresh Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and add salt and pepper to desired taste. If you desire a hot taste leave all seeds in peppers. If you desire a milder taste cut peppers in half and take out all seeds.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Grease and flour regular tube pan or fluted tube pan. Combine cake mix sugar oil eggs and sour cream. Blend with electric mixer at low speed until ingredients are moistened. Beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Stir in pecans. Pour half of batter into prepared pan. Combine cinnamon and brown sugar. Sprinkle over batter. Pour remaining batter into pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until a toothpick comes out clean. Allow cake to cool 10 minutes. Meanwhile prepare Rum Sauce then pour over cake. Cool at least 1 1/2 hours before turning out of pan.

title: Yellow Cake With Cherries
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add prepared Dream Whip. Spread on top of prepared cake. Top cake with cherry pie filling. Enjoy!

title: Pasta With Sausage And Cream Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in skillet; stir in sausage and fry until brown. Drain grease. Stir in cream wine 1 tablespoon parsley nutmeg and 1/2 cup Parmesan. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Handy Casserole
instructions: Saute for 3 minutes the onion margarine and green pepper. Brown beef breaking up the meat as it cooks. Add salt pepper and sugar. Stir in tomatoes tomato sauce and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 15 minutes.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool slightly; set aside. Beat the cream cheese until smooth. Gradually add gelatin beating well. Stir in pineapple and baby food. Fold in whipped topping. Pour mixture into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Cover; chill until firm. To serve cut into squares and serve on lettuce. Serves 12.

title: Fabulous Ham And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Spread half the bread cubes evenly in dish. Add the ham and both cheeses then cover with remaining bread cubes. Mix eggs milk onion salt and mustard. Pour evenly over bread cubes and refrigerate overnight. Combine cornflakes and butter for topping. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 10 servings.

title: Beignets(New Orleans Style Square Donuts)
instructions: In large bowl stir together 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast. In saucepan heat milk sugar shortening and salt to 115\u00b0 to 120\u00b0. Stir constantly. Add heated mixture to flour mixture; add egg. Beat with electric mixer on low 1/2 minute. Beat 3 minutes on high. Use spoon and stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Place dough in greased bowl turn once to grease surface. Cover and refrigerate dough until chilled. (Chill overnight and fry for breakfast.)

title: Tex-Mex Dip
instructions: Mash the avocados with the lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste. On a flat 12-inch plate layer and spread refried beans. Spread avocado mixture over beans. Mix the sour cream mayonnaise and taco mix together; spread over avocado layer. Sprinkle with cheese then olives onions and tomato. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump pineapple in pan. Then dump in pie filling. Then add cake mix and oleo. Dont grease pan. Use a long cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: New Year'S Eve Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix all together and put chips on top. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Richie'S Irish Grandmother'S Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients until moistened. Turn pancakes when bubbles appear. Tis helpful to sift dry ingredients together. Tis better not to beat the egg. Tis best not to overstir the batter. Double the ingredients and youll have batter good for 2 days!!

title: Poppy'S Favorite Cookies
instructions: Mix cream cheese and butter until blended. Blend in yolk and vanilla. Add cake mix (dry) 1/3 at a time mixing well after each addition. If mixer is used add last 1/3 by hand. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown. Cool slightly before removing from sheet.

title: Venison Soup For Crock-Pot
instructions: Put everything into a 6-quart crock-pot. Fill with water to 1/2-inch of top. Cover. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours or until done. Adjust salt. Serve with hearty bread and a salad.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sugar stir until dissolved. Add cold water. Prepare orange juice and lemonade according to package directions. Add pineapple juice. Add jello mixture. Pour into jars cover and chill for 24 hours. Part of jello mixture may be poured into jello mold. Freeze for 24 hours. Place ice ring in punch bowl add rest of punch.

title: South Of The Border Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese; beat it with a fork. Add salsa to taste. Use with taco chips or regular chips.

title: Polish Pork Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Boil noodles. Drain and rinse with cold water. Set aside. Brown pork and onion in pan over medium-high heat. Add 1 cup water. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Place cooked meat onion and noodles into a casserole dish. Add drained kraut and stir in both cans of cream of chicken soup. Mix in bay leaves parsley red pepper brown sugar pepper and salt and top with paprika. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Mostaccioli
instructions: Bring a 3-quart saucepan full of water to a boil. Add mostaccioli noodles and simmer until tender. Drain and set aside. Brown ground chuck in a skillet and drain off any grease. In a large saucepan add tomato paste water sugar salt pepper oregano and basil. Heat and simmer. Add browned meat mixture. Simmer the tomato-meat mixture for at least 1/2 hour. Next add noodles and serve with Parmesan cheese and buttered garlic bread.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop green onions using half of green tops. Cut beef fine or chop fine. Soften cream cheese and add onions beef and accent. Put small amount of pecans in and keep the rest to roll cheese ball in. Mix thoroughly; then roll ball in remaining nuts. Refrigerate. Will make 2 small balls or 1 large ball.

title: Yummy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Stir together flour sugar soda and salt. In saucepan combine butter water and cocoa. Cook stirring constantly until it comes to a rolling boil. Add boiling mixture to dry ingredients and blend with electric mixer. Stir in buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 17 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Leave in pan and while cake is very warm pour warm icing over cake. Serve from pan.

title: Bird'S Nest(A Recipe From Belgium)
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Divide into 6 portions. Flatten and shape meat mixture around boiled eggs. Dip meat coated eggs into egg whites and bread crumbs. Deep-fry in hot oil until brown and crusty about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from oil and drain. Cut crosswise for 2 round nests. Spoon tomato sauce around nests. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Combine and dip by spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Dip glass bottom in water then sugar and flatten cookies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Smashing Mystery Dessert
instructions: Mix and bake in a 13 x 12-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes; do not overcook.

title: Grandma'S Cutout Cookies
instructions: Mix and put in refrigerator. Next day roll and cut out. Bake at 350\u00b0 for around 8 minutes.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Delight
instructions: Add black-eyed peas to onion. Cover and cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes. Put bacon on top.

title: Light Cajun Chili
instructions: Saute turkey sausage until lightly browned; spoon out the fat. Add kidney beans and tomatoes. Simmer covered for 1 hour. Can be served as is or over rice or pasta. Delicious!

title: Seafood Scampi
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet on medium-high heat. Saute onion green pepper and garlic 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Stir 3 minutes. Add cooked fettucini; toss and heat through. Serves 4.

title: Pork Chops And Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Brown chops. Blend soup sour cream water and parsley. In casserole dish put layers of potatoes sauce mixture salt and pepper. Top with chops. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Steak Marinade For Barbecue
instructions: Marinate meat all day or overnight especially with a thicker cut of meat.

title: Orange Candy Cake
instructions: Cream oleo sugar and eggs one at a time. Add flour alternately with milk. Add candy dates nuts and coconut. Mix well. Mixture will be thick. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 250\u00b0. While cake is still warm add glaze while still in pan.

title: Peach Puff Pie
instructions: Sift the flour baking powder and salt together. Cream the butter and 1/2 cup of the sugar; add beaten eggs gradually and then the grated lemon rind. Add flour and milk alternately. Put peaches into the pastry shell; sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of sugar. Spread batter over the peaches and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: In a colander rinse cooked macaroni with cold water; drain well. In a large bowl combine the pasta and salad dressing. Toss to coat. Add the cucumber green pepper onion and snipped parsley to the pasta mixture. Toss gently. Cover and chill for 4 to 24 hours. Before serving stir in the cherry tomatoes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into large bowl. Mix water vinegar and vanilla. Make a \well\ in dry ingredients. Add water mixture and applesauce all at once. Mix well. Grease 10 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Batter will be very thin.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Wash peas. Put in water to boil. Simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Add ham bone vegetables bay leaf and thyme. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until peas are soft. Remove bone. Cut off meat and dice. Return meat to soup. Season to taste with pepper. Makes about 2 quarts.

title: Grandmother'S Large Raisin Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until lemon colored. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Add to egg butter mixture. To the raisins add the cup flour and be sure each one is coated. Put in large cake pan and cook about 3 hours between 250\u00b0 and 275\u00b0.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spray 6-inch deep oven safe pot or dish with Pam or spread margarine around dish. Layer cherry pie filling coconut pineapple cake mix pecan halves and cut up margarine over top. Bake on 350\u00b0 approximately 1 hour.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients; let sit overnight in the refrigerator to blend flavors.

title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli and onion. Fry bacon and drain mix mayonnaise sugar vinegar and raisins. Combine all ingredients together and let set overnight.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into 2 nine-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: 7 Layered Salad
instructions: Tear the cleaned crispy lettuce into bite-size pieces; place in glass bowl. Layer rest of the ingredients in order given. Add sugar to the mayonnaise and spread over the top as you would frosting. Top with grated cheese. Cover and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours. At serving time garnish with parsley and croutons. Diced ham may also be added if desired.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Mix all ingredients and dip boiled wieners into it. Drop into hot fat (deep) and fry until brown.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage. Drain off fat. Mix onion bell pepper and celery. Saute with sausage. Mix rice soup mix and water. Bring to a boil. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Add sausage onion bell pepper and celery to rice and soup mix. Cover with plain toasted croutons. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 2 casseroles. May use beef.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine graham cracker crumbs margarine and 2 tablespoons of sugar. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Combine gravy and next 6 ingredients. Add spaghetti and mix well. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/4 cup cheese and paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Banana-Pineapple Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 round 9-inch pans or 1 (13 x 9-inch) pan. Beat all ingredients in a large bowl on medium speed for 2 minutes. Scrape bowl occasionally. Pour into pans and bake 35 to 40 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans. Cool completely. Frost cake.

title: Yoo Hoo'S
instructions: Mix all of the contents in a blender for about 30 seconds. Refrigerate until cool. Makes 2 drinks.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes evaporated milk sugar eggs and margarine with electric mixer until smooth. Pour into oblong dish sprayed with Pam. Heat in 400\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes or until heated thoroughly.

title: Venison Roast With Wine Gravy
instructions: Remove any white membrane surrounding roast. Place roast in a shallow dish. Combine wine onion and seasonings; pour over roast. Cover and marinate 8 hours in refrigerator turning meat occasionally.

title: Linguine Salad
instructions: Cook linguine. Finely chop vegetables. Put 1/4 shaker of Salad Supreme into drained linguine. Add rest of shaker to Italian dressing and stir. Pour over linguine. Add vegetables and toss lightly. This is better if prepared the night before. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil onion. Cook chicken and cut into bite size pieces. Mix everything together in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Make biscuits and place on top of mixture (make biscuits very thin). Bake at 475\u00b0 until biscuits are done.

title: Special Rum Cake
instructions: Before you start check the rum to make sure the quality is good. Select a large measuring bowl measuring cup etc. and check the rum again. With an electric mixer beat 1 cup butter in the fuffy bowl. Add 1 teaspoon sugar and beat. Meanwhile check the rum again. Add 3 large eggs 2 cups fried druit and beat unitl very high. If druit sticks in beaters pry out with a screwdriver. Taste the rum again. Add 3 cups baking powder one pint of rum one seaspoon of tada and one cup of pepper. Stir in 1/2 pint lemon juice and fold in the chopped buttermilk and strained nuts. Add one bablespoon of scrown sugar or whatever color you have. Check the rum again. Turn pan to 350 degrees grease oven and pour the whole mess in. Sample rum while waiting.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Let first 5 ingredients stand in the refrigerator for several hours. Then add 1 package of Dream Whip without vanilla 1 cup chopped nuts and 3 cubed bananas. Fold all this together and put into paper cups placed in muffin tins. Place into freezer until firm then you can place in Ziploc bags.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix together chili and Cheez Whiz in crock-pot (small one works nice). Stir occasionally. Serve with chips.

title: Chinese Spareribs
instructions: Sprinkle ribs with garlic salt (optional). Mix ingredients coat ribs on both sides and put in glass pan to marinate overnight. Fill the bottom of a broiler pan with water cover pan rack with aluminum foil and put ribs on rack. Cover loosely with foil bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour per pound. Baste with sauce frequently. Towards end of cooking remove covering foil.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and mix together with other ingredients. Reserve 1 cup cheese. Pour in\tgreased casserole dish. Spread remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt in microwave peanut butter chocolate chips and one stick of margarine in a large bowl. Stir in the Rice Chex. Put into a paper bag and add little amounts of powdered sugar and shake until the Rice Chex are fully coated.

title: Instant Delite
instructions: Mix flour and oleo until crumbly; press into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Hot 'N Spicy Mustard
instructions: In a medium saucepan slowly combine the vinegar and mustard whisking to make a smooth mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Add sugar and eggs; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Cook for about 30 seconds or a little more until mixture coats a spoon. Remove from heat; pour into hot sterilized jars. Cool. Cover and refrigerate. If this is stored for a long time it may need stirring before using.

title: Pineapple Orange Congealed Salad
instructions: Place pineapple in a saucepan; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add gelatin stirring until completely dissolved. Stir in buttermilk coconut and pecans. Cool. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or dish. Chill until firm. Yields 15 servings.

title: Baked Lima Beans
instructions: Cover limas with water and bring to a rapid boil. Stir in baking soda; water will turn green. Pour off; add fresh water. Parboil 3 times or until water boils clear. Add chopped onion meat and pepper to taste. Do not salt until beans have cooked long enough to taste saltiness of meat. Cook until beans are tender about 1 hour. Pour off excess stock and save for adding to leftover beans or soup. Lift tomatoes from juice in can chop and add to beans. To about 2 quarts of cooked beans add 2 tablespoons vinegar and 2 heaping tablespoonfuls brown sugar. Salt and season to taste. Pour into baking dish cover with sliced ham or bacon sprinkle with brown sugar and dot with butter. Bake 1 hour in moderate oven. Add tomato juice to excess bean stock for soup.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans; put in a large pot with the water or stock and 1 tablespoon oil. Cover tightly and bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until beans are tender.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Pour into 20 x 14-inch oven cooking bag. Add rice carrots celery and onion. Place bag in baking pan. Evenly spread out rice mixture. Sprinkle chicken with marjoram salt and pepper. Place on top of rice close bag and make slit in top of bag. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Mora'S Good Caramel Candy
instructions: Cook over low heat to 238\u00b0 or soft ball stage. Pour in greased 8 x 8-inch pan; cut into squares when hard. A nicer alternative is to get the small brown candy cases from Sees and plunk a spoonful into each one. This makes the candy easier to serve or to package for mailing.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Soften cheese; mix all together. Serve with thinly sliced apples.

title: No Cook Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat together milk and pumpkin. When smooth add vanilla pudding pumpkin spice and cinnamon. Beat well. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker pie shell or regular pie shell that has already been baked and cooled.

title: Burnt Sugar Cake
instructions: Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans or 13 x 9-inch oblong pan (large tube pan works well also and is my choice).

title: Solid Chocolate Easter Eggs
instructions: For each egg prick hole in each end of egg making it larger on the broader end. Bow out the egg. Carefully rinse out the inside of each egg. Place on wax papered cookie sheet and allow to dry in 200\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour. Melt chocolate chips (6 ounces will fill one large egg) over low heat. Place each egg in egg cup or tray. Fill with chocolate using a baby spoon and tiny funnel. It may look full and need to be gently tapped to settle chocolate down. Add more chocolate until it is genuinely full. Whip chocolate off shell and chill overnight. Decorate with paint glitter or whatever you like. Covered with sequins is spectacular. These are a little bit of work but are a huge hit with the little ones.

title: Sweet Potato Bake
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes to just tender about 30 minutes. Drain cool and peel. In large bowl mash potatoes. Stir in oleo sugar and raisins.

title: Steak(Crisp And Crusty)
instructions: Put broiler pan 8 to 10-inches from heat and preheat broiler. In a shallow bowl combine oil and mustard. Dip steaks into mixture then into the onions coating completely. Place steaks on a rimmed baking sheet and broil for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to boil. Add flour and cocoa to mixture. Mix eggs soda sour cream and vanilla together and add to mixture. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Candy
instructions: Put nuts in bottom of crock pot. Layer other ingredients. Cook on low 1 hour without stirring. After 1 hour stir well. Cook on low another hour. Add 2 tsp. vanilla. Drop on wax paper.

title: Watergate Salad(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Fold dry pudding mix into the whipped topping. Use medium-size salad bowl. Add the drained pineapple. Add the miniature marshmallows. Mix well. Chill for 2 to 3 hours or overnight if possible. Serve right away.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Break bread into pieces as if for stuffing unless you are using cubed plain stuffing pieces. Add soup 1/2 stick melted margarine and eggs and blend well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased. Sprinkle crushed potato chips and 1/2 stick margarine (or butter) over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 10-inch pie plate. Beat all ingredients until smooth. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean (50 to 55 minutes). Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Gravy-Baked Pork Steaks
instructions: Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper. Brown in shortening in large iron skillet; drain. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour around chops. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 45 minutes or until tender. Stir gravy. Makes 4 servings.

title: Crawfish Or Shrimp Fettuccine
instructions: Saute onions bell pepper and celery in margarine until tender. Add shrimp or crawfish. Cook 7 minutes. Add 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil. Add noodles; cook 7 minutes. Add seasoning to taste. Melt Velveeta and add the half and half to noodles.

title: Chicken Chow Mein Casserole
instructions: Simmer celery onions and chicken broth 15 to 20 minutes. Mix with chicken soup and butter. Top with noodles and nuts. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Festive Date Balls
instructions: Boil and stir margarine sugar and dates for 3 minutes. Add Rice Krispies and pecans. Form into small balls and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Tuna Miniatures
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine 1 cup of corn flake crumbs with milk. Mix in remaining ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls. Roll in remaining corn flake crumbs. Place on greased pan and bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Raisin Carrots
instructions: Heat skillet and add butter or oil. Saute carrots for 10 minutes. Add juice spices and raisins. Cover and simmer until carrots are tender and most of the juice is absorbed.

title: Peanut Brittle(Easy Microwave Recipe)
instructions: In a 2-quart glass dish combine peanuts sugar syrup and salt. Cover and microwave on High 4 minutes. Remove; stir. Replace cover and microwave again for 4 minutes. Add vanilla and margarine; cover and microwave for 2 minutes. Add sifted baking soda; stir swiftly and pour onto greased cookie sheet. Spread thinly; allow to cool. Break up and store in an airtight container.

title: Toffee
instructions: Heat over medium heat the first 4 ingredients stirring constantly. Cook until mixture turns amber colored and begins to emit a light smoke. (This usually takes between 10 or 15 minutes.)

title: Creamed Cabbage
instructions: Cube or shred cabbage; add cubed ham cream flour and seasonings. Cook just until tender. You may add a little milk if more liquid is needed. Slow heat is the secret.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and shortening over low-heat. Remove from heat add sugar and blend. Add eggs and blend; add flour and salt and blend. Mix in nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes in lightly greased pan.

title: Golden Harvest Soup
instructions: In a large heavy pan cook onion and garlic with basil in butter until tender. Stir in golden mushroom soup and water. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook ten minutes or until noodles are done.

title: Mock Baklava
instructions: Line 2 cookie sheets with foil place crackers on cookie sheet in single layer. Cover with layer of almonds. Heat oven to 300\u00b0. On stove melt butter and sugar bring to a boil. On low heat cook for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Use spoon to drizzle all over crackers. Bake in oven for 15 minutes. Be sure rack is set on on above center in oven. Cool on counter and cut one at a time carefully.

title: Mock Champagne
instructions: Boil sugar and water for 3 minutes and cool. Add rest of the juices and chill. Just before serving add chilled ginger ale. Makes 50 servings.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs 3 cups flour salt and baking powder. Mix 1 cup flour with nuts and fruit. Mix with other ingredients. Bake 3 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Pour Miracle Whip sugar and vinegar over ingredients. Mix well. You may add additional Miracle Whip to suit your taste.

title: Vermont Country Dill Pickles
instructions: Mix the ingredients and bring to a boil. Add fresh dill and 2 cloves garlic to each 1 quart pickle jar. Wash and drain pickling cucumbers and pack into jars. Pour boiling salt and vinegar solution over cukes and seal jars.

title: Cracker Dessert
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff adding sugar gradually. Beat in baking powder. Fold in crackers nuts and vanilla. Spread in greased 9 inch pie plate. Bake 40 minutes at 300\u00b0. When cool top with peach slices and whipped cream.

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Mix together. Let rise. Spread on pizza pan then put on your favorite toppings and bake.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash strawberries and drain. Place in crust. Pour prepared jello over strawberries. Chill in fridge. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix well and pour into shallow casserole. Top with cheese and mixture of crumbs and butter. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Blend in the milk and vanilla. Stir in the flour cherries and pecans. Form dough into two 8-inch rolls. Roll in flaked coconut coating outside. Wrap in wax paper or plastic. Chill 2 hours. Cut into 1/4-inch thick slices. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes on ungreased sheet pan.

title: Hawaiian Coconut Pie
instructions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil in a small saucepan. Slowly pour over beaten eggs beating constantly to blend. Add butter; stir until melted. Stir in salt vanilla lemon juice cereal coconut and milk. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until top is set and lightly browned. Serve warm or cooled with or without whipped topping.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
instructions: Spray Bundt pan well with Pam. Take rolls (thawed) and spread in pan. In layers pour brown sugar nuts dry butterscotch pudding and melted butter over rolls. Cover with cloth and let sit out overnight. Bake the next morning for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: King Cake
instructions: Put in large bowl; make a stiff mix of ingredients. Put a little oil on top. Cover; let rise overnight or until double in size. Punch down. Knead 50 times. Divide in half. Roll 1/2 as flat as you can. Spread softened cream cheese. Spread over entire area. Spread pie mix of your choice over cream mix. Fold over the sides of dough to cover pie mix. Let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Mix powdered sugar and small amount of milk. Spread over cake. Sprinkle toasted almonds over cake. Take remaining dough and make into rolls; let them touch each other. Rise until double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Pizza Salad
instructions: Spread crescent dough on a greased cookie sheet. Press to form crust. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Diabetic Apple Pie
instructions: Pare apples and slice thin. Combine Sugar Twin flour spices and salt. Mix with apples. Line pie plate with pastry. Fill with apple mixture and dot with butter. Adjust top crust. Sprinkle with Sugar Twin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Hildy'S P-Nut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar and Karo together; bring to boil over medium heat. Add peanuts when mixture reaches 270\u00b0. Continue to cook until 290\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add baking soda. Beat with wooden spoon until you reach a nice warm brown color. Turn out onto well-buttered cookie sheet. Let cool and break into pieces.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Bake
instructions: Roll pork chops into flour; brown until golden. Cook potatoes until almost done. Put in bottom of baking dish. Mix sour cream and mushroom soup; thin with milk. Pour over potatoes.

title: Pancakes
instructions: In medium bowl mix dry ingredients. In small bowl mix eggs oil and milk. Add to dry mixture and mix. (Batter should be lumpy.) For standard size pancakes use a 1/4 c measuring cup to pour out batter.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Combine eggplant Worcestershire sauce salt pepper and water. Cook on medium-high until cooked down and most of the water has evaporated. Mix butter with cracker crumbs. Spray casserole pan with Pam or lightly grease. Place 1/2-inch of cracker crumbs in baking dish. Add eggplant and crackers leaving enough crackers for a top covering. Mix egg and milk and pour over top of casserole. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix milk sugar cocoa and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil for two minutes. Remove from heat add peanut butter and stir until mixed. Add vanilla and then oats. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool.

title: Biscotti(Hard Almond Cookies)
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix until blended. Fold in almonds. Shape into a roll the same length as your cookie sheet. Flatten to 1/2 inch thick and 3 inches wide. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned. Cut into cookies at 1/2 inch intervals. Turn over and place back in oven to brown the other side.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar with shortening. Add eggs and beat well. Add pecans soda and milk. Add flour salt vanilla and bananas. Mix well. Bake in loaf or layer pan at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix instant pudding with 3 cups milk; add Cool Whip. Layer pan with graham crackers. Spread 1/2 pudding mix over graham crackers. Layer graham crackers on top of mix. Spread remaining half of pudding on top of graham crackers. Layer graham crackers on top. Spread fudge frosting over top layer of graham crackers generously. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Chop up 3 to 4 cups lettuce. Place in large bowl or oblong pan. Sprinkle with salt pepper and approximately 1 teaspoon sugar. Layer with sliced hard-boiled eggs salt and pepper. Sprinkle peas (I never use whole box). Layer remaining lettuce. Top with bacon bits and then Cheddar cheese. Seal top of salad with mayonnaise. Decorate with scallions.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Cook green string beans until still firm. Pack in jars. To each pint jar add 1/4 scant teaspoon red pepper 1 clove garlic and 1 head dill or 1/4 teaspoon dill seed. Heat vinegar water and salt. Bring to a boil. Pour into jars. Seal.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan; set aside. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine chocolate chips and butter in a large saucepan. Melt over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Combine eggs salt and sugar; blend well. Add to chocolate mixture. Stir in flour baking powder and vanilla until well blended. Stir in nuts if desired. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 25 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edge of pan. Let stand until cool. Cut into bars.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in an airtight container. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Combine fruits; sprinkle with lemon juice. Chill. Fold whipped cream into mayonnaise. Fold into fruit mixture. Serve on greens. Top with coconut.

title: Concentrated Tea Lemonade Base
instructions: Combine lemon juice peel and sugar stirring until dissolved. Set aside. Pour boiling water over tea bags. Steep 15 minutes in a covered container; strain. Combine lemon juice and tea mixture. Cover tightly and refrigerate.

title: Noodle And Ham Dish
instructions: Cook ham and potatoes until potatoes are almost done. Add noodles and cook for 12 to 15 minutes. Then add tomato juice and sauce and simmer until done.

title: Chili
instructions: Heat 2 teaspoons olive oil in large skillet. Add meat bell peppers and onion. Cook over medium-high heat 5 minutes or until meat has browned. Add chili powder cumin and tomatoes. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in beans and heat through.

title: Surprise Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together very well until you can handle with your hands. Roll into little balls; press with fork dipped in flour. Bake about 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. These brown very fast on bottom so watch them closely. Yes these are all the ingredients.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add sherbet and stir until blended. Add other ingredients. Fold in whipped cream last. Add 1 cup chopped nuts if desired.

title: Simply Delicious Easy Brownies
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. In a large bowl combine ingredients in order given. Mix well and add 1 cup chopped nuts if desired. Put in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Check at 25 minutes if you like brownies chewy. Frost if desired.

title: Vegetable Souffle
instructions: According to what vegetables you decide to use blanch mixed vegetables for 3 minutes and cook squash in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain well. In saucepan over heat melt butter then add flour and stir in milk. Cook until thickened. Remove from heat and set aside. Beat egg yolks until fairly stiff and add to sauce. Add seasonings and mix well. Add vegetables of choice. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.

title: Barbecued Beef Ribs
instructions: For 600 p.m. serving time

title: Quick Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Drop Biscuits
instructions: Mix and drop by teaspoon into cupcake pans prepared with oil. Bake at 425\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Chili - Wanda'S Way
instructions: Soak and cook pinto beans until done 3 to 4 hours. Brown chili grind or chuck (chili grind is better or buy a roast and have them run it through the coarse grinder). Brown until the red is gone. Drain fat. Saute onion and bell pepper and cook 5 minutes. Drain.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: *If you dont like your spaghetti hot use a can of diced tomatoes instead of the Ro-Tel.

title: Crabmeat Appetizers
instructions: Spread muffins with mixture. Set on cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen wrap until ready to serve. Broil until bubbly. Cut into four pieces.

title: White Bean Chili
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; heat over medium heat until hot. Add chicken; cook and stir until browned breaking into pieces with fork. Remove chicken; drain fat from skillet. Add celery onions and garlic to skillet; cook and stir over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes or until tender. Sprinkle with chili powder cumin allspice cinnamon and pepper; cook and stir 1 minute. Return chicken to skillet. Stir in tomatoes with juice beans and chicken broth; heat to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered 15 minutes.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Marinate chicken wings anywhere from 6 to 24 hours. Remove from marinade and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 60 minutes. You can also use marinade for pork or beef. Delicious! Yield 24 wings.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cook and clean shrimp. Saute veggies in butter and some water. Add tomatoes tomato sauce flour sugar and spices. Add peas. Cook this all together for a few minutes until it is well mixed then simmer about 1/2 hour. If it seems to be getting too thin add more flour. If it is getting too thick add hot water. Add shrimp to mixture about 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Skillet Beans
instructions: Brown diced bacon in large skillet. Remove bits from drippings and reserve for garnish. Saute onion in bacon grease until tender. Add remaining ingredients and stir until mixture begins to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Garnish with bacon before serving.

title: Barbie'S Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix together in a medium bowl all the ingredients except the cocktail sauce. Shape into a ball. Place in middle of a serving dish and cover with clear wrap. Refrigerate. To serve pour the cocktail sauce over the ball and decorate dish with crackers.

title: Cocoa Kiss Cookies
instructions: Beat butter sugar and vanilla in large bowl until creamy. Stir together flour and cocoa; gradually add to butter mixture beating until blended. Add pecans; beat until well blended. Refrigerate dough about 1 hour or until firm enough to handle.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Bake
instructions: Trim ends of zucchini. Cook covered in boiling salted water for 5 to 8 minutes. Drain and cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out centers; chop.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
instructions: In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch Pyrex layer bread cubes cheese bread cubes and cheese. Top with sausage that has been fried crumbled and drained.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown stew beef in oil about 5 minutes. Add water salt pepper potatoes turnip carrots celery onion bouquet sauce bouillon cube and bay leaf. Cook over medium heat for about 1 1/2 hours or in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Mix flour and 1/2 cup water (cold). Add to stew beef to thicken for gravy.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cover and cook onion in margarine in 3-quart saucepan over low heat stirring occasionally until tender 20 to 30 minutes. Add beef broth water bay leaf pepper and thyme. Heat to boiling and reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Set oven on broil and/or 550\u00b0. Place bread slices on cookie sheet. Broil with tops about 5 inches from heat until golden brown about 1 minute. Turn; broil until golden brown. Place bread in 4 ovenproof bowls or individual casseroles. Add broth; top with Swiss cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place bowls on cookie sheet. Broil with cheese about 5 inches from heat just until cheese is melted and golden brown 1 to 2 minutes. Serve with additional French bread if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Warm Broccoli And Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine soup mix sour cream broccoli and 3/4 cup cheese. Pour into a 1 quart casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Mix sugar water and cream of tartar let come to boil. Drop in crackers; let boil 2 minutes. Put in pie shell. Put margarine and cinnamon on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven and let brown.

title: Black Bean Dip
instructions: Combine beans and garlic in food processor using on-off motion until smooth (do not puree). Transfer to bowl and stir in salsa. Serve with vegetable crudites or toasted tortilla pieces. Makes 4 servings about 1/2 cup each.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain and place in baking dish. Combine soups; pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese and stuffing. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Henriette'S Easy French Bread
instructions: Put 1 cup warm water in a large bowl. Sprinkle in 2 packages of yeast and 2 tablespoons of sugar. Let stand until yeast rises. Put remaining 1 1/2 cups of water in small pot and then add 3 tablespoons of butter 1 level tablespoons salt and 4 tablespoons of sugar. Simmer until all ingredients are melted. Cool until lukewarm.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with banana. Blend well. Stir in nuts. Pour into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until done. Remove from pan. Cool on rack.

title: Prime Rib And Au Jus
instructions: Place whole ribeye on baking pan. Rub both sides heavily with chopped garlic. Cover both sides with black pepper then lightly salt both sides. Bake with fat side up at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes then lower temperature to 175\u00b0 and cook for 4 hours for medium-rare 6 hours for medium-medium well.

title: New Mexico Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.

title: Toffee Squares
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add beaten egg yolk vanilla and sifted flour. Spread on 12 x 17 1/2-inch cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Polynesian Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients; shape into very small balls (scant teaspoonfuls). Brown in shortening.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
instructions: In mixing bowl cream butter sugar and eggs. Stir in cocoa flour vanilla and salt. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brownies test done. Cool. Spread marshmallow cream over top of cooled brownies. In small saucepan melt peanut butter and chocolate chips over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in the cocoa. Spread over marshmallow layer. Chill before cutting. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Asparagus Cheese-Rice
instructions: Combine rice and cheese. Drain asparagus and reserve liquid. Add asparagus to rice and cheese. Blend together egg mayonnaise 3 tablespoons asparagus liquid and seasoned salt. Stir into rice mixture. Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle paprika over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef With Dumplings
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast. In Dutch oven or large skillet slowly brown meat on all sides in hot shortening. Add next 7 ingredients. Cover. Cook slowly 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Place biscuits on meat. Sprinkle with parsley. Cover tightly and steam 15 minutes or until \dumplings\ are done. Remove meat (pot roast) and \dumplings\ to warm platter. Make pot roast gravy if you want to. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fisherman'S Delight
instructions: Thaw frozen fish. Clean and dry fish. Brush inside of fish with lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Wrap each fish with bacon slices. Place fish in a hinged wire grill. Cook about 5 inches from moderate hot coals for 10 minutes. Turn and cook for 10 to 15 minutes longer or until bacon is crisp and fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Cool and cut into bite-size pieces. Take fat off the cooled broth blend fat with flour 1 teaspoon salt and pepper. Slowly add 2 cups broth and heavy cream stirring constantly. Cook over low heat until thick. Combine cornbread crumbs celery 1 teaspoon salt pepper to taste and butter. Arrange cut up chicken and dressing alternately in large casserole. Cover with sauce and bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together the cheese at room temperature. Roll in chopped parsley or paprika.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Put chicken in large pot and add about 1/2 gallon water; cook until tender. Remove chicken from broth and let cool; remove from bone. Reserve broth. Mix milk Crisco and flour. If not thick enough add a little more flour. Put broth on stove and add cans of chicken broth; bring to boil. Add chicken into broth. Drop dough a teaspoon at a time into broth and cook 10 minutes covered.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into a ball. Serve with ritz crackers.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix oil dill garlic salt and Ranch salad dressing. Pour over crackers. Mix well. Let stand for at least one hour. Store in plastic container.

title: Pink Ice
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Stir in the strawberries crushed pineapple and thawed topping; gently fold in bananas and walnuts. Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Let stand at room temperature for 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Bake at 375\u00b0 in a loaf pan about 40 minutes or until done.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup(Makes 7 Cups; Low In Cholesterol)
instructions: Heat broth in large saucepan to boiling. Add broccoli onion and garlic. Cover. Simmer for 7 to 10 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Remove from heat. Cool for 5 to 7 minutes. Puree vegetables and broth in blender or food processor until desired consistency. (Process in two or three batches if necessary.) Return to pan.

title: Cheery Cherry Vanilla Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: In 2-quart glass measuring cup with handle combine sugar sour cream corn syrup butter and salt. Microwave at High for 5 minutes. Stir well until sugar dissolves. Microwave at High for 6 minutes or just until mixture reaches 236\u00b0. Let stand 15 minutes; do not stir. Add vanilla; beat until mixture starts to lose its gloss (about 6 minutes). Stir in cherries and walnuts. Quickly pour into buttered 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Cool and cut into squares. Makes about 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Black Magic Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar cocoa soda baking powder and salt in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs coffee buttermilk oil and vanilla. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. (Batter will be thin.) Pour in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Boil potato in quarters. Smash 1 or 2 quarters on clean surface. Add sugar a little at a time mixing in with potato until you have a sugar/dough ball. Press ball out flat. Spread peanut butter. Roll into a roll. Refrigerate. (Use sugar like flour.) Enjoy.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in salted water and drain. Add bread crumbs and cheese and put mixture in a baking dish. Add rest of the ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 until top starts to brown.

title: Easy Rolls
instructions: Mix well and spoon into greased muffin tins. Bak at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry And Cream Squares
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream in a large bowl. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan until firm (overnight). Spoon sour cream over top. Yields 12 servings.

title: Date Nut Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Flour dates with 1 cup flour. Beat sugar and eggs together. Add the 2 cups flour then rest of ingredients. If you dont use enough nuts use 2 tablespoons shortening. Cook at 275\u00b0 about 1 hour and 10 minutes if using 3 small pans. Cook longer if using large pan.

title: Steak And Oatmeal
instructions: In a large skillet in a little oil brown steak on one side. Remove steak. Mix oatmeal in oil that the steak was browned in. Add a little water if needed. Spread oatmeal mixture on one side of steak. Put sliced onion on top of oatmeal. Fold over steak. Add more onions Worcestershire salt and pepper to taste on top. Put a small amount of water in pan. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Calico Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain. Add remaining ingredients to ground chuck and place in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly usually about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Chewies
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine eggs and sugar. Add chips and pecans. Drop with teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Cool before removing from cookie sheet. Makes 2 dozen chewies.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together until smooth. In an oblong glass pan (13 x 9-inch) cut margarine in chunks in bottom of pan. Pour in batter. Pour sliced peaches and juice evenly over batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool 20 to 30 minutes before serving.

title: Lo-Cal Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugar and eggs. Add pineapple. Add all dry ingredients. Stir well. Add vanilla. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and celery in oleo. Cook rice. Put in a large bowl. Add Cheez Whiz and soup. Mix well. Add broccoli. Pour in well-greased casserole and bake until broccoli is done 30 to 45 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Grease baking sheet. Combine sugar corn syrup and salt in 3-quart casserole. Stir in peanuts. Microwave on High until light brown for 8 to 10 minutes stirring once. Stir in remaining ingredients until light and foamy. Spread on greased cookie sheet as thin as possible. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Laura'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour together. Stir until smooth. Add cocoa; blend well. Add all other ingredients and cook over low heat until thick. Pour into a baked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Clara'S Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs vanilla and oatmeal. Mix dry ingredients (flour salt and soda) then add to creamed mixture. Add nuts raisins and chocolate chips. (These can be worked in by hand.) Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes. Makes approximately 7 dozen.

title: Mother Baker'S Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar well adding well beaten eggs flour and baking powder. Add fruit that has been mixed with a cup of the flour. Let pressure come to 5 open pet cock and cook one hour. Close and raise to 15.

title: Beef-Filled Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise; remove seeds. Bake cut side down in shallow pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tender. Fry diced bacon. Add beef onion 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Cook until beef is browned. Pour off excess fat. Remove squash from shells (reserve shells). In small mixing bowl whip squash with 1/2 teaspoon salt; add milk as needed to make mixture fluffy. Combine with beef mixture. Return to squash shells. Top with crushed potato chips. Continue baking at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cold Slaw
instructions: Dip apples in 1/2 cup lemon juice to prevent browning. Mix dressing ingredients in separate bowl until blended and pour over veggies. Chill for several hours.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add the rest of the ingredients.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix 2 eggs and melted oleo together and press into 9 x 13 pan. Mix the cream cheese 2 eggs powdered sugar and vanilla together. Spread on top of cake mixture and bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and reserved powdered sugar.

title: Easy Shrimp Creole
instructions: In medium skillet heat dressing and saute green pepper and onion. Stir in tomatoes with liquid and simmer covered 15 minutes. Add shrimp red pepper and sugar. Simmer covered an additional 15 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Serve over hot rice.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Combine margarine and sugars together. Add Egg Beaters and vanilla. Mix well.

title: Crock-Pot Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown beef in skillet and drain off fat. Put all ingredients in crock-pot (3 1/2 or 4-quart model). Stir thoroughly. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours (high 3 hours).

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage and drain. Stir in pizza sauce. Set aside. Line greased muffin pan with biscuits. Spoon sausage mixture into biscuits. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Add cheese on top and let it melt.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix together. Cover and chill. Before serving add 1 quart carbonated water or ginger ale. Makes 10 servings.

title: Crescent 'N Sausage
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles. Press perforations to seal. Brush each with margarine. Combine cheese and oregano; sprinkle over dough. Cut each rectangle crosswise to form 2 squares. Place a sausage link on each square; roll up. Cut each roll into 3 or 4 pieces. Secure each with a toothpick. Place cut side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pineapple Cream Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with spoon. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef in skillet; drain fat. Add Ragu. Heat to boiling. Mix Ricotta eggs parsley salt pepper and some Parmesan cheese (save some to sprinkle on top). Put meat sauce in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Put layer of noodles 1 cup cheese mixture meat sauce noodles then cheese sauce. Spread remaining meat sauce on top and sprinkle the rest of Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Eggplant
instructions: Peel eggplant and dice in small cubes. Saute pepper and onion until tender. Add tomatoes eggplant salt and pepper; cook 15 minutes. Place in a casserole dish. Melt oleo in a skillet. Add bread crumbs and stir. Sprinkle bread crumbs over eggplant. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until eggplant is tender and crumbs are brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; remove bone when done. Put into casserole dish with sour cream chicken soup and 1/2 stick butter. Stir together. Crumble the Ritz crackers on top. Add remaining butter. Bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop cranberries; add sugar. Chill for 2 hours. Add marshmallows pineapple and nuts. Whip cream and fold into cranberry mixture. Refrigerate or freeze. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Grind the first 4 ingredients all together. Drain off juice. Add the salt; let set overnight. Add the water and cook 10 minutes on simmer. Drain well and rinse with water to remove salt. Mix the sugar vinegar and mustard. Stir in vegetables and cook 12 minutes. Then mix the cornstarch with cold water. Add to vegetables and cook 3 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and let cool 10 minutes. Add the salad dressing. Stir well. Put in pint jars and seal. Hot water bath for 5 minutes.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef in 10-inch skillet until brown. Drain. Stir in beans tomato sauce taco sauce chili powder and garlic salt. Heat to boiling. Coarsely break chips and place in ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Top with beef mixture spread sour cream. Sprinkle onions tomatoes and cheese. Cook uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbly 20 to 30 minutes. Arrange additional tortilla chips around edge of casserole. Serve with shredded lettuce chili peppers and taco sauce. Yields 6 servings.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Use 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup.

title: Shrimp Soup(Sopa De Camaron)
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp; chop. Place shrimp 1 cup of chicken broth and the Casera sauce in blender. Cover and blend on high speed until smooth. Heat shrimp mixture the remaining broth salt saffron and pepper to boiling. Mix cornstarch and water; stir into shrimp mixture to thicken. Heat to boiling; cook and stir for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in half and half. Garnish with parsley. Yields 5 cups.

title: Tortilla Appetizer Wedges
instructions: In medium bowl combine cream cheese and sour cream; mix well. Stir in chilies onions and jalapenos. Season with salt and pepper. Spread tortilla with about 1/4 cup cream cheese mixture; top with another tortilla. Continue spreading and stacking tortillas until stack is 4 tortillas high. Top with another tortilla that has not been spread with cream cheese mixture. Make another stack with remaining 5 tortillas. Wrap tortilla stacks in plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Cut each stack into 18 wedges. Arrange pinwheel fashion around cup of salsa picante sauce or salsa verde. Makes 36 appetizer servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken. Cut in bite-size pieces. Put in buttered dish. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Crush crackers and spread over chicken. Melt butter and spread over crackers. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dinner Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spoon into small muffin tin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Yogurt Fluff
instructions: Pour boiling water into blender container. Add gelatin; blend at low speed until dissolved about 1 minute. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 cup. Add to gelatin; stir until ice is almost melted then blend in yogurt and vanilla. Chill in dessert glasses for 1 hour or until set. Makes 5 servings. Each serving contains 35 calories.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar butter and milk; bring to a boil. Stir constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat. Stir constantly. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate pieces until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme nuts and vanilla. Heat until well blended. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan; cool and cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Fudge Candy
instructions: (Optional Add 2 c. walnuts or pecans.)

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook beans for 1 hour over medium heat with salt pepper and drippings. Add garlic onion and pepper. Cook 1 hour and add sausage in 1/2-inch slices. Cook another hour. Serve over rice.

title: Crazy Beans
instructions: Brown sausage. In crock-pot put sausage beans onion and green pepper. Mix together tomato soup tomato paste and brown sugar. Pour into crock-pot and mix with beans. Use crock-pot on high for 1 hour then low for 2 hours.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion together in salted water until tender. While squash is cooking saute crushed crackers in 1/2 cup margarine until brown and crisp. Set aside. Make white sauce with 1/4 cup margarine half and half and cornstarch. When white sauce is smooth add Velveeta cheese cubes and heat until melted. Drain squash and place in an oblong casserole dish; pour cheese sauce over squash and top with the crackers. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cover with foil for the first half of baking time to keep crackers from browning too much.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all the ingredients with enough Miracle Whip to hold together. Shape into a ball.

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Cook zucchini 10 minutes until clear using some of pineapple juice in the cooking. Then add 2 cups pineapple lemon juice sugar and box of Sure-Jell. Bring to rolling boil. Boil for 5 minutes; remove from heat then add orange jello. Stir well; put into jars and seal.

title: Large Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix milk and pudding together. Fold in sour cream and 1/2 of Cool Whip. Place layer of vanilla wafers in large dish. Then a layer of bananas and a layer of pudding. Repeat. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate. Will serve a lot.

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add milk. Knead the dough until it has a rubbery texture. Roll it out on a lightly floured surface until it is 1/2-inch thick. Cut into squares. Fry in oil until brown. They will puff up and cook quickly. Drain on paper towels. Dust with powdered sugar and serve with honey if desired.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Set aside walnuts. Using your hands blend ingredients together. Shape into ball. Roll in chopped walnuts.

title: Hershey Bar Pie
instructions: In double boiler melt Hershey bars and marshmallows in the milk. Allow to cool. Add the whipped cream. Pour into crust and top with additional whipped cream. Chill about 4 hours.

title: Broiled Tomato With Cheese
instructions: Mix the other ingredients in a small container and pour over the tomatoes. Broil the tomatoes 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese is slightly brown. Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs pumpkin and vanilla together. Set aside. Combine all dry ingredients and add to mix alternately with water. Add nuts. Grease and flour 3 loaf pans. Makes 3 loaves. Bake in electric oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1-1/2 hours or gas oven at 375\u00b0 test for doneness.

title: Maple Walnut Walkaways
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Add flour and salt. Cut in butter and mix until blended. Roll 1/2 at a time into rectangle. Beat cream cheese sugar lemon and orange rind. Beat until fluffy. Spread 1/2 on each rectangle. Sprinkle walnuts. Roll as jelly roll. Place seam side down on greased cookie sheet. Slit lengthwise 3/4 of the way through. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Slice at an angle. Makes 24 cookies.

title: Italian Avocado Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients well and serve with veggies!

title: Hamburger And Tater Tots
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Salt to taste. Add soup and 1/2 can water. Mix. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Place Tater Tots on top of mixture. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 8 servings.

title: Clam Pie
instructions: Cut clams up with sharp knife and fork. Peel and dice potatoes; combine with onions pepper Texas Pete Worcestershire oregano parsley flakes salt and black pepper in large saucepan. Cover with clam juice and water. Add mixed vegetables and boil slowly 1 hour. Dice salt pork and fry crisp. Add meat and grease to clam mixture. Continue cooking. Mix pie crust and roll out. Using 13 x 9-inch pan line sides with crust. Add clam mixture. Cover with strips of crust. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until crust is browned.

title: Panned Steak
instructions: Pound round steak that has been well rolled in flour. Fry in oil until good and brown. Season to\ttaste while frying. Pour some\thot water over the steak; cover and let simmer for 2 hours. Pour on a milk and flour gravy; cook 15 minutes longer. Serve.

title: Fruit Medley
instructions: Mix well. Mix 1 package vanilla reduced calorie pudding \dry\ with fruit (family size). Stir well. Weight Watchers count as 1/2 cup equals 1 fruit and 5 optional calories.

title: 30 Minute Chili
instructions: Brown the hamburger meat with diced onions and green pepper until meat is brown. Add can of mushroom soup and can of tomato soup (undiluted). Add catsup water salt pepper and chili powder. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add the whole can of drained kidney beans. Add juice from can as needed. Stir well. Serve with raw chopped onion. Add more chili powder to make hotter.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Dumplings For Stew
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add liquid. Put on simmering stew. Cook 10 minutes uncovered. Cook 10 minutes tightly covered.

title: Luscious Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Add butter lemon rind lemon juice and egg yolks. Stir in milk and cook over medium heat stirring until thick. Cool then fold in sour cream. Spoon into baked shell. Cool at least 2 hours. Serve topped with whipped cream and chopped walnuts or pecans.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and add the rhubarb. Bake between 2 crusts until done.

title: No-Mix Cherry Pineapple Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13 baking pan. Spread pineapple with syrup in the pan. Spoon pie filling evenly over pineapple. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over mixture then the chopped nuts over all. Slice the chilled margarine in thin slices and put evenly over the other ingredients. Bake 50 minutes or until golden. Serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix peanut butter powdered sugar margarine and graham crackers together. Roll into balls. Refrigerate. Melt together paraffin wax and chocolate chips. Dip balls with toothpicks in chocolate. Drop on wax paper to cool.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Mix sugar with stiff egg whites. Add this mixture to crackers pecans and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes and cool. Mix Nestle Quik to Cool Whip and spread over cooled pie crust. Makes 1 pie.

title: Escarole And Beans
instructions: Remove core from escarole and wash under cold water until completely cleaned. Discard discolored and tough outer leaves. Place in a large pot with salt. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Lower heat and boil gently 8 - 10 minutes. Drain. In same pot heat oil and saute garlic 3 minutes. Add cannellini beans. Simmer 5 minutes. Add escarole and toss to mix. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook another 2 minutes and serve.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend well. Allow to stand covered in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving. Makes about 2 1/4 cups. Great as a party dip with fresh veggies.

title: Eight Minute Cake
instructions: Put everything in bowl at one time and cut the oleo into little pieces. Beat for 8 minutes. Grease and flour two (9-inch) pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Saucy Shrimp
instructions: Put all but the shrimp into a saucepan. Hold out the sherry until later. Over medium heat bring to a boil then simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Just before serving add shrimp and sherry. Serve over rice.

title: Favorite Chocolate Cake With Sour Milk
instructions: *May substitute milk with 1 teaspoon baking soda dissolved in it.

title: Pecan - Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese 1 1/3 cups sugar 1 egg vanilla and salt until thick and creamy. Beat 3 eggs. Add 1/4 cup sugar Karo syrup and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Spread cream cheese mixture in bottom of unbaked pie shell. Then sprinkle nuts on top of pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Veal Scallopini
instructions: Cut veal into serving pieces. Make sauce by combining salt paprika oil lemon juice garlic mustard nutmeg and sugar. Beat or shake in bottle to combine thoroughly. Lay veal flat in baking pan. Pour sauce over meat. Turn pieces to coat with sauce. Let stand 15 minutes. Remove garlic. Lift meat from sauce and dip in flour. Brown well in heated shortening in skillet. Add onion and green pepper. Combine chicken bouillon with remaining sauce and pour over meat. Cover and cook until tender about 40 minutes. Add browned mushrooms and olives to meat and cook about 5 more minutes.

title: Baked Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on package and drain. Blend soup mix sour cream and salt. Add to drained spinach. Place entire mixture into a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Sausage Squash Casserole
instructions: Spray baking dish with Pam. Layer ingredients as listed except for cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Place cheese on top as soon as removed from oven.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushroom Strudels
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease baking sheet. In bowl mix crabmeat onion egg celery and bread crumbs. Remove stems from mushrooms and finely chop. Add to crabmeat mixture. Fill each mushroom and place on baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes to remove water from mushrooms.

title: Hamburger Pie
