instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake 30 minutes. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms (beat vigorously 20 strokes). Gently smooth dough into ball on floured board; knead 5 times. Roll dough 2 inches larger than pie plate.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzel crumbs butter and 3 tablespoons of sugar. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Mix in enough Italian dressing to hold the mixture together. Very good served with Club crackers.

title: Easy Pound Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directed on box. Mix pudding into cake batter. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown. Let cake cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove cake carefully from pan and enjoy.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until done drain. Add sour cream or yogurt and cream of celery soup. Add meat and onion mix. Place in 3-quart casserole dish. Cover with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0. Yields 4 servings.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Add sugar salt and milk to beaten eggs; mix. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle nutmeg over the mixture and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn oven temperature down to 325\u00b0 and bake until done.

title: Baked Chopped Broccoli
instructions: In a buttered casserole dish layer the first 4 ingredients top with a little stuffing. Add the water and dot with butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover the last 10 minutes to brown topping.

title: Gooey Cheesecake
instructions: Mix well. Spread dough in bottom and 1/2-inch up sides of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fried Apple Pies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Moisten dough with enough water to give it the right consistency for rolling. Roll dough out on lightly floured surface. Cut into 6-inch saucer size circles.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix together cooked macaroni ham Cheddar cheese cooked frozen peas and salad dressing. Add salt and pepper to your taste. I also add a little prepared mustard. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Marinated Tomato Slices
instructions: Place tomato slices in a shallow dish. Mix remaining ingredients and marinate tomatoes.

title: Mexican Corn Pudding
instructions: Just mix and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Summer Squash Soup
instructions: Saute the onions in the margarine until tender. Add the squash chicken broth white pepper celery salt and tarragon and cook over low heat until tender. Remove from heat and stir in the milk. Process in blender until smooth. Serve hot or cold. Can be frozen.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line bottom and sides of a 9 x 11-inch pan with waxed paper. Mix pumpkin milk sugar cinnamon and eggs; pour into pan. Pour dry cake mix over mixture. Top with nuts and cooled margarine. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes. Invert on tray.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar oil salt and pepper. Mix with remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Chicken Stir-Fry(Dinner In Ten Minutes Or Less)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in large skillet or wok. Add chicken cut into thin strips. Stir in Hidden Valley original Ranch salad dressing. Mix to coat chicken. Add thawed vegetable medley and 2 tablespoons water. Stir-fry about 2 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Jill'S Favorite Chicken Skillet
instructions: Combine flour salt paprika sage and pepper in a paper bag. Add chicken a few pieces at a time and shake to coat. Reserve excess flour mixture. In skillet brown chicken on all sides in hot Crisco. Remove chicken. Stir reserved flour mixture and sugar into pan drippings. Add chicken broth. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Stir in lemon juice carrots onion and parsley. Return chicken to skillet. Cover and cook until vegetables and chicken are tender 40 to 50 minutes. Stir occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

title: Graham Cracker Pudding Cake
instructions: Roll crackers. Add melted butter. Mix well and line the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Place in refrigerator using 1/2 graham cracker mixture. Prepare vanilla pudding as directed and put in pan. Let set until cool. Cover with remaining crumbs. Prepare chocolate pudding the same and put in dish. Set overnight. Add whipped cream just before serving. Cut in wedges.

title: Stolen Wine Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Pour pecans in bottom of tube pan. Pour batter over nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Baked Limas
instructions: Combine all ingredients except beans and bacon mixing well until sugar is dissolved. Gently stir in beans (with juice) and place in oblong baking dish. Layer bacon across top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from oven; turn bacon slices and spoon off grease. Return to oven and bake 45 minutes longer.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Bake in Bundt cake pan for approximately 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gina Lloyd'S Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions. (Bread and Circus sells bulk wild rice Roach Bros. carries 6 ounce packages in the specialty food section rather than with other rices.) I cook the rice in a 6-quart pot.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Add 1 cup oats to 1 1/4 cups boiling water stir cover remove from heat and let set.

title: Mexican Chocolate
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender and puree. May substitute mint chocolate chips for plain chocolate chips.

title: Easy Stir-Fry
instructions: Marinate meat in marinade and/or vinegar for about 1 hour. Preheat vegetable oil in wok or large pan on stove. Add meat and marinade to pan and quickly brown outside of meat stirring so all sides brown. Cover and steam for about 3 minutes. Add vegetables; stir until coated with liquid. Cover and steam for 5 minutes or until vegetables are desired tenderness. Add brown sugar and soy sauce to taste. Serve over rice.

title: Jellied Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook together (water sugar and cornstarch) until the mixture thickens. Add the dry gelatin powder and let the mixture cool. Pour over the strawberries in the pie shells and chill until firm. Top the pies with whipped cream or your favorite topping.

title: Oven Omelet
instructions: Blend together eggs sour cream and salt. Stir in cheese. Add ham if desired. Pour egg mixture into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Drizzle butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until set.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all together and pack firmly in a loaf pan lined with foil. Let set in refrigerator three days before cutting.

title: Poppy Seed Sweet Bread
instructions: Put all ingredients in large bowl and mix well with electric mixer. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Divide batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except wings) then add chicken and let marinate 4 hours or more. Remove chicken from marinade and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: #1 Grated Apple Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter\tthen add sugar eggs (beaten) buttermilk blackberry\tjam and grated apple. Mix well together then add all remaining ingredients. This may be baked in a stem pan or long pan.

title: Rotini Salad
instructions: In a bowl blend together the oil vinegar and Italian dressing. In a large bowl combine other ingredients. Stir. Pour dressing over and stir. Chill. Keeps good in refrigerator. May add other vegetables such as onions carrot slices cauliflower etc.

title: Cookie Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cookies. Chill. When ready to serve add the cookies.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions in 4 layers. Add bananas and 3 tablespoons of Cool Whip with about 1/4 cup sugar. Frost between 3 layers with bananas. Frost top and sides with rest of Cool Whip.

title: B-B-Q Sauce
instructions: Place the meat of your choice in the bottom of a pan. Mix dry ingredients and pour over meat. Then mix liquids and pour over meat and dry seasonings. Marinate at least two hours. This is better if you marinate your meat overnight or at least for several hours. Turn once when marinating. Now grill!

title: Divinity(Divinity Is Not Really Hard To Make.)
instructions: In a large saucepan cook sugar water and glucose until it threads (usually 20 minutes). We use a candy thermometer. Add butter and peanuts and continue cooking stirring constantly so peanuts wont stick to the pan. When the thermometer shows soft crack immediately have someone bring in the cold marble and lay it on a large countertop. Use butter or cooking spray such as Pam and grease marble countertop and forks.

title: Chicken Breast With Sage And Nutmeg
instructions: Trim any fat from chicken. Combine next 5 ingredients. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and set aside. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add chicken and cook 7 to 8 minutes on each side until browned. Add vermouth and bell pepper; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is tender. Transfer chicken to serving platter; spoon sauce over chicken and garnish with fresh sage leaves.

title: Diabetic Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potatoes onion water and salt in saucepan. Cover and boil until potatoes are done about 20 minutes. Then add milk and margarine and pepper. Heat for 5 minutes until hot. Then while this is heating make Rupples.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Mix well. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Banana-Nut Loaf
instructions: Lightly grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan; set aside. Stir flour baking powder salt and baking soda in a mixing bowl. Stir thoroughly. Cream sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add eggs and orange peel; beat well. Mash banana in a bowl with a fork; stir in milk. Add flour mixture and banana mixture alternately to cream mixture. Beat until smooth after each addition. Fold in nuts. Pour batter in prepared pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Turn out and cool on a wire rack.

title: Whole Cranberries In The Microwave
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in 8-inch square microwave dish covered with plastic film vented on one corner. Microwave on 50% power for 6 minutes. Stir. Microwave for additional 6 minutes. May be served warm or cold.

title: Onion-Beef Soup(Microwave)
instructions: Combine onions and butter in 3-quart microproof casserole. Cover. Cook on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until onions are transparent stirring once during cooking time. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese. Cook on High for 10 to 11 minutes or until hot. Serve in bowls with cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Susan'S Vegetable Toss
instructions: Stir-fry zucchini and garlic in oil for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Reduce to low heat. Add parsley margarine and half and half. Cook until butter melts. Add cheeses linguine and oregano. Serve.

title: Mock Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan combine all ingredients. Cook and stir over low heat until hot. Serve with vegetables poultry fish or eggs. Makes 1/2 cup or 8 (1/2-tablespoon) servings.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients including cranberries. Mix all wet ingredients. Combine all ingredients. Spray pan with Pam (meat loaf size pan). Bake at 350\u00b0. Cool and then turn out.

title: Kraut Burgers
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Put on grill. Serve with lettuce tomato and onion. Great for summer or anytime cookout.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix eggs potatoes sugar butter and spices in large bowl. Gradually beat in milk. Mix thoroughly. Stir in flour until well blended. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 20 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until set and knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cheerwine Punch
instructions: Combine and serve very cold. Make ice ring or ice cubes with mixture to add to punch to keep it cold. Makes 30 small servings.

title: Jason'S Creation
instructions: Brown meat and onion together. Stir in peas corn and stewed tomatoes. Add a dash of lemon pepper black pepper or cayenne to taste. When macaroni and cheese mix is ready mix all together in a large skillet until heated through. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix cheese and Bisquick then add sausage. Roll into small balls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 300\u00b0 or until done.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: In large pot combine all except cheese and chips. Bring to a boil using medium heat. (Can mash tomatoes if desired.)

title: Easy Good Lasagna
instructions: Rinse noodles under warm water until soft. Do not cook.

title: Blarney Stones
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In mixing bowl whip cream until soft and peaks form; gradually fold in sugar. Combine water and extract; add alternately with flour mixture gently folding ingredients together after each addition just until combined. Fold in egg whites. Spread into greased and wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done and is lightly browned. Cool on a rack for 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool completely. With fork break cake into 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 inch pieces; set aside.

title: Chow Mein Chunkies
instructions: Melt butterscotch coating. Add peanut butter; stir and melt. Stir in noodles and peanuts. Drop into large candy cups and let set at room temperature.

title: Best Banana Bread
instructions: To make sour milk mix about 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar to the 1 tablespoon of milk and let stand until curdles. Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten egg and salt. Add flour and bananas alternately. Dissolve soda in little tepid water and mix with the sour milk. Add to batter. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in greased loaf pan very slowly at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes. Brown 10 minutes more if needed. Toothpick test and let stand overnight before use having turned out to cool.

title: Dessert Brownies
instructions: Melt cocoa and oleo in 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: No Cook Frosting
instructions: Mix together; put on cake and place under broiler a few minutes until brown. Do not have to put under broiler can just leave as is.

title: Red Chicken Stew
instructions: Cook chicken and shred into small pieces. Put all ingredients in crock-pot or large pot and cook for approximately 2 1/2 hours on low to medium heat. Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Cake
instructions: In a saucepan combine first 5 ingredients. Stir constantly over a low heat until mixture bubbles. Stir in sugar flour and baking soda while mixture is hot. Beat until smooth then stir in vanilla. Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 until center is firm to the touch. Cool.

title: Spanish Cream(Serves 6)
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over milk. Let stand 5 minutes then heat until dissolved. Separate eggs. Beat egg whites to peaks. Beat yolks in large bowl. Pour gelatin mixture into egg yolks (slowly) then pour back into pan and add sugar. Cook until custard coats spoon (8 to 12 minutes). Add vanilla. Pour custard over egg whites and cool.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Gradually add other ingredients adding pecans last. Lightly grease and flour 9x13 pan. Spread mixture evenly. Bake 30-35 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out dry.

title: Brownies (Low Calorie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place all ingredients in bowl; stir to blend well. Bake for 30 minutes in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Yield 16 two inch squares 1 square = 95 calories.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix salad dressing whipped topping and sugar. Pour over apple mixture and toss gently.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients; stir well. Cover and chill 3 hours. Serve with fresh vegetables. Makes 2 cups.

title: Midnight Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add cocoa eggs and sour milk. Mix well. Add flour. Mix. Add boiling water with baking soda and vanilla. Beat. Go heavy on wet ingredients. Light on dry ingredients. Bake 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0 in long pan or 8-inch.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: In serving bowl layer the crushed Oreos. Mix pudding with milk until thick for second layer. Mix cheese powdered sugar oleo and Cool Whip for the third layer.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients. Place mixture in loaf pan to chill thoroughly and cut into slices. Roll in flour and brown quickly in frying pan. Place fried slices in casserole. Mix mushroom soup and 1 can of water; pour over meat. Cover to bake. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Lemon Daffodil Dessert
instructions: Combine juice sugar and condensed milk; add whipped cream. Tear cake into small pieces and place in casserole dish or individual compotes. Pour mixture over cake and blend together slightly. Chill 24 hours before serving. Pound cake can be used. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli in bite-size pieces. Chop green onions. Cut tomatoes in half. Mix all ingredients in medium-size bowl. Salt and pepper to taste. Coat with mayonnaise. Toss until well coated.

title: Cottage Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients in blender. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Party Cones
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake batter according to package directions; set aside. In saucepan over low heat melt peanut butter chips with milk stirring constantly until blended. Add peanut butter mixture while warm to cake batter. Beat on medium speed of electric mixer until blended about 2 minutes. Fill ice cream cone cup 2/3 to 3/4 full with batter. Place upright in regular muffin cups or 2 inches apart on a cookie sheet. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted comes out clean. Cool completely. Frost as desired. Decorate with chocolate or colored sprinkles. Makes 24 cones.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Cook noodles following box directions. While noodles are cooking add pepper onion and tomato soup to ground beef. Simmer about 15 minutes. When noodles are done layer half of the noodles and half the ground beef. Mix 1/2 tomato wedges and 1/2 cheese. Repeat with the remaining ending with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Lima-Corn Bake
instructions: Place 1/2 the lima beans in bottom of nonstick baking pan. Top with a layer of corn then top the corn with 1/2 of the tomato slices the onion and garlic. Top with another layer of lima beans and corn; end with tomato slices. Pour tomato juice over all. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown beef and onion then add all the other ingredients. Simmer for 1 hour.\tServe with a salad.

title: Vegetable Pie
instructions: Brown bottom of pie shell slightly. Cook broccoli according to package directions. Saute mushrooms and onion in butter. Beat egg slightly and mix with broccoli mushrooms and onion. Place mixture in cooked shell. Place cheese slices on broccoli mix. Mash yams or sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon butter and water in can and place on top of cheese and broccoli. Cut top of pie crust in strips lattice top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top crust is brown.

title: Crab Meat Dip Pizza
instructions: Beat cheese until light and fluffy. Blend in remaining ingredients. Then chill.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Mix oil vinegar and seasonings. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes. (If you increase dont add more salt or poultry seasonings but simmer longer.) Marinade chicken overnight. Grill over low heat until done.

title: Unfried French Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Slice each potato length into 1/4-inch ovals then slice each oval lengthwise into matchsticks. Coat a baking sheet with 3 sprays of vegetable oil. Combine egg whites and Cajun spice in a bowl. Add the matchstick potatoes and mix to coat. Pour the coated potatoes onto the prepared baking sheet and spread them out into single layer leaving a little space between. Place the baking sheet on the bottom shelf of the oven. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the fries are crispy turning them every 6 to 8 minutes with a spatula so that they brown evenly. Serve immediately.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and chop onion; drain. Put in 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Add green beans and green pepper if desired. Mix water and mushroom soup. Pour over mixture. Add a layer of cheese slices. Place tatoes on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until tatoes are done and cheese is melted.

title: Jello Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening with sugar and Jello. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir together flour baking powder and salt add to Jello mixture. Add food coloring. The food coloring should match the flavor of the cookie lime = green lemon = yellow cherry = red. Mix until well combined. The flavor of the Jello you use is the flavor of your cookies. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Press with the bottom of a glass that has been buttered and dipped in sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Do not brown.

title: Barbecue Franks
instructions: Cut franks in bite-size pieces (approximately 5 pieces for each frank).

title: Crunchy Sundae Topping
instructions: Melt oleo in heavy saucepan. Stir in brown sugar. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add cornflakes nuts and coconut. Toss until well mixed. Pour out on cookie sheet and cool thoroughly. Crumble and serve over ice cream.

title: Crisp Pickle Slices
instructions: Bring the syrup of vinegar sugar salt celery mustard seed and turmeric to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Pour over cucumber slices and seal. Cook 5 minutes in hot water bath.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni (salt water that you cook macaroni in); drain well and cool. Combine vegetables and macaroni. In a small bowl mix remaining ingredients well. Then add to macaroni and vegetable mixture. Stir until mixed well.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Combine milk and lemon juice; stir well. Fold in pineapple and topping. Spoon into pie shell and chill.

title: Aunt Betty'S Nephew'S Famous Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown onion and garlic (cut up in 1/4-inch pieces). Add ground meat and brown. Add sauce and paste with 1 to 1 1/2 cans water; add sugar salt and pepper. Cook well and let simmer for two hours.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add frozen berries and break apart. Break up angel food cake in jello mixture. Mix slightly. (Cake will absorb juice and jello.) Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan and refrigerate. Serve in squares topped with whipped cream.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: Cut loaf of Velveeta into slices and put in a large bowl. Saute vegetables in 1/4 cup of oleo until tender. Add to cheese. Add 3/4 to 1 cup picante. Place bowl in microwave and heat stirring occasionally until melted to a medium consistency. Serve with your favorite nacho chips.

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: Heat all ingredients in a Teflon skillet uncovered. Stir gently until well heated. Makes dinner for one with a 4-ounce portion of limited vegetables (pea pods or bamboo shoots).

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Blend sugar flour nutmeg and butter. Add beaten eggs; beat smooth. Pour over rhubarb in a 9-inch pastry-lined pie pan. Top with pastry cut in fancy shapes. Bake in hot oven (450\u00b0) for 10 minutes then in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water then add pie filling and crushed pineapple with juice. Cool Whip may be added when set if desired.

title: Apple Dump Cake
instructions: In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan layer pineapple and top with apple pie filling. Sprinkle cake mix over apple filling. Slice margarine over dry cake mix. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Tasty Baked Fish
instructions: Combine onion mustard and water. Let stand 10 minutes. Wipe fish with damp cloth and arrange in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice onion and mustard mixture and black pepper. Pour mixture over fish. Bake in preheated oven at 500\u00b0 for 12 to 17 minutes or until done and lightly brown. Garnish with paprika. Serves 6.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Place ingredients in order given in a large mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer; start on low speed then move to medium and finish with about 10 minutes on high speed. Batter should be smooth and liquid. Grease and lightly flour a round baking pan 10 inches in diameter and 3 inches high. Pour batter into pan; bake for 1 hour in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Leave cake in oven with door closed for an additional hour after heat is turned off then cool on rack. Refrigerate for storage. Makes 20 servings.

title: Creamy Split Pea Soup
instructions: Lightly boil first 4 ingredients until peas are soft (45 minutes). Cool a little and remove bay leaf. Blend with remaining ingredients. Return to pan and simmer until thick. Stir occasionally. Makes 1 quart.

title: Spanish Shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook and drain pasta shells. Brown and drain ground beef. Combine picante sauce water tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Chop chilies and grate cheese. Stir 1/2 cup sauce into ground beef along with chilies 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can fried onions. Pour remaining sauce into bottom of 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Stuff cooked shells with ground mixture. Arrange shells in dish. Pour remaining sauce over shells. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and fried onions. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes.

title: Wallace'S Tortilla Dogs
instructions: Place Velveeta cheese spread and wiener on flour tortilla; roll up. Microwave on paper towel on High for 45 seconds or until cheese is melted and wiener is hot. Serve with salsa. Makes 1 serving.

title: Bacon Wraps
instructions: Cut off ends of bread and cut in half. Spread with soup directly out of can. Roll bread up like crescents. Cut bacon in half. Wrap a slice of bacon around each slice of bread. Secure with toothpick. Bake on foil lined cookie sheet at about 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pizza Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together and simmer until blended about 2 hours.

title: Sugarless Punch
instructions: Thaw shrimp if frozen.

title: Parmesan Potato Rounds
instructions: Pour melted butter into jelly roll pan. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in plastic bag. Drop in potato slices; shake to coat with flour mixture. Place in a single layer over the butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Turn slices; sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Bake 30 minutes more or until tender.

title: Eye Of Round Roast
instructions: Line pan with foil. Put onion halved and 2 cloves of garlic in pan on each side of roast with 1 inch of water. Pile salt on top.

title: Pierre'S Noodles With Vegetables
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan and cook noodles. While noodles are cooking melt the butter in a skillet. Add the mushrooms and zucchini. (It may be more convenient to use separate skillets for the mushrooms and zucchini.)

title: Squash Rolls
instructions: If possible check temperature of warm water with thermometer. Sprinkle yeast over water in a large bowl; stir until dissolved. Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved. Add eggs squash 1/2 cup softened butter and 3 cups flour.

title: Italian Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger onion garlic beef bouillon salt and pepper to taste; drain. Add remaining ingredients; heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally 1 hour. Serve over hot cooked spaghetti.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Mix together first nine ingredients and set aside. Mix together vinegar sugar salad oil Italian dressing and pour over dry ingredients and stir. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Broccoli And Sausage Quiche
instructions: Separate 1 egg and beat until frothy. Brush pie shells with white but do not saturate. Bake pie shells. Brown sausage and drain. Cook broccoli according to package and drain. Combine whipping cream Velveeta and Cheddar cheese and microwave 3 to 4 minutes. Beat eggs and combine with cheese mixture.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 1-quart casserole dish. Cover. Microwave 10 to 12 minutes on High or until water is absorbed. Fluff with fork.

title: Mexican Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix eggs cornmeal milk oil soda salt and corn. Place half of mixture in skillet or pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Top with ground beef onions grated cheese and jalapeno peppers. Put remaining cornbread mixture on top. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti according directions; drain. Should have approximately 3 cups of spaghetti. Add the Parmesan cheese and eggs. Pat spaghetti mixture into a buttered 10-inch pie plate to make crust.

title: Broccoli And Corn Scallop
instructions: Saute onion in 1 tablespoon of butter. Blend in flour. Gradually add milk. Stir constantly until thickened. Add cheese. Stir until melted. Stir in corn and 1/4 cup bread crumbs. Arrange broccoli in an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch dish. Pour cheese sauce over broccoli. Toss remaining crumbs and butter over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Balls
instructions: Let cheese set to reach room temperature. Beat cheese until creamy add remaining ingredients. Roll into small balls. Serve with toothpick.

title: Hamburger And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add hamburger salt and pepper heating through but not browning. Spread half the shredded cabbage in a 2-quart baking dish. Cover with meat mixture. Top with remaining cabbage. Pour undiluted tomato soup over top; stir. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute cabbage peppers and onion together until transparent. Add oleo and zucchini. Saute until transparent.

title: Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: In 4-quart pot add chunked potatoes and onion. Cover with water and cook. Stir all other ingredients together in pot warming slightly to blend well. Add to potatoes and onions and water. Heat slowly stirring often. Add milk if its too thick. Refrigerate leftovers (5 to 7 days).

title: Joe Ann'S Cup-A-Salad
instructions: Bring to a boil sugar water and pineapple. Remove from heat. Dissolve Jell-O into mixture. Chill until slightly thickened. Add cheese milk and pecans. Stir well. Chill until set.

title: Coconut Caramel Pies
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet. Add coconut and chopped pecans. Cook until golden brown stirring frequently. Set aside. Combine cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer 1/4 of the cream cheese mixture in each shell. Drizzle 1/4 topping on each pie. Sprinkle 1/4 of the coconut mixture over each. Repeat layers. Freeze. Remove from freezer about 30 minutes before serving. Additional caramel sauce may be served with the pie. If making individual serving pies will make approximately 36.

title: Kool Popsicles
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid jello sugar and hot water until dissolved. Add the cold water and stir. Pour into ice cube trays and let freeze. Enjoy!

title: Strawberry Jello Punch
instructions: Pour the boiling water over the Jell-O and sugar. When cool add the pineapple juice. Let stand at least 24 hours in refrigerator. Add the ginger ale before serving.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: *I put mine in the blender but make sure to drain well.

title: Orange Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl; stir in remaining ingredients except pastry shell. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake 35 to 45 minutes longer. Filling will be moist in center. Cool. This kitchen-tested recipe makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix together. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Beat sugar butter and eggs in a large bowl until smooth. Stir in bananas and lemon juice. Mix flour baking powder baking soda and salt into bowl. Stir dry ingredients into creamed mixture. Fold berries and nuts. Pour into pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes until toothpick is clean.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients and shape into a ball. Roll cheese ball into the reserved chopped beef. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Stuffed French Toast
instructions: Beat together cream cheese and 1 teaspoon vanilla until soft and fluffy. Stir in nuts; set aside. Cut bread into 10 to 12 (1 1/2-inch) slices. Cut pocket in top of each. Fill with 1 1/2 tablespoons cheese mixture. Beat together eggs whipped cream 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and nutmeg. Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Cook until golden. Heat together orange juice and preserves; drizzle over toast when done.

title: Joanne'S Lo-Cal Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Boil 1 1/2 cups water. Dissolve with jello. Add 1 1/4 cups cold water. Mix with lite ice cream until dissolved. Refrigerate until jelled. Serve with lite Cool Whip and sliced banana. (Make your own treat; try a different flavor jello and fruit topping.)

title: Corn Hush Puppies
instructions: I measure with regular tablespoon not measuring spoon.

title: Father'S Day Delight
instructions: Combine Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and let cool. Whip cream cheese. Add to Cool Whip; add sugar then blend with Jell-O mixture. Pour into large pan. Add marshmallows and nuts. Let chill thoroughly.

title: Ranch Style Beans
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 35 to 40 minutes uncovered at 400\u00b0. Stir once during baking. This freezes well.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Use 3 small or 2 large pans. Cream together margarine eggs sugar and red food coloring. Sift together cocoa flour salt and cinnamon. Have buttermilk and vanilla ready. Mix all ingredients alternating 3 mixtures until all are used and mixture is smooth and velvety. Stir in vinegar and soda. Pour into prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes and test for doneness. Cake is bright red. Serves 24.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Set aside a small amount of dried beef to roll the ball in then mix all the remaining ingredients together. Form into a ball and roll in saved dried beef.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix together flour soda salt and spices. Beat shortening and sugar until creamy. Add molasses and egg. Add buttermilk raisins and nut meats. Slowly add flour mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Aunt Sally'S Olive Shells
instructions: Blend together the cheese butter paprika and salt. Stir in flour. Chill dough for easier handling. Wrap a small piece of dough around each olive sealing well. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm. Makes 24.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
instructions: Melt ingredients together mixing well. Stir in a large jar of dry roasted peanuts. Stir well and drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Bake in low oven for 2 hours. One-half hour before taking from oven dissolve 1 tablespoon sugar in boiling water and pour over the pudding. Serves 8.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Seal jars. Process 5 minutes in boiling water. Remove from water immediately after 5 minutes.

title: Easy Cheese Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In 10-inch skillet brown ground beef onion and garlic and drain. Return beef mixture to skillet and stir in Ragu and water. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish layer 1/3 sauce mixture 1/2 of uncooked lasagna noodles 1/2 of combined Ricotta or cottage cheese and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley. Repeat these steps in layers ending with sauce on top. (Everything will be 1/2 except sauce and it will be thirds in order to end up with enough to cover the top lightly.) (I add Monterey Jack cheese to mine optional.) Cook for 1 hour tightly covered with aluminum foil. Let set 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Continental
instructions: Cook broccoli and set aside. Saute onion and celery in butter. Add soup and heat. Then add Cheez Whiz. Add cooked rice and salt and pepper to taste (and dash of Tabasco if desired). Layer chicken broccoli and rice mixture in casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Pour Marzetti caramel apple dip into chocolate or graham cracker crust. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and miniature chocolate chips per taste or eye appeal. Freeze. Thaw about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease and flour 2 round pans. Drain peaches reserving sauce. Add enough water to reserved sauce to measure 1 1/4 cups. Prepare cake mix as directed on package except substitute sauce mixture for water. Pour batter into pans. Bake and cool as directed on package.

title: Ham And Swiss Cheese Finger Sandwiches
instructions: *Deli ham and cheese work best for this recipe but are not required. The ham should be sliced \sandwich thick.\

title: Fudge Sauce
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in a double boiler. Cook over hot water until thick. Then add 1/2 to 1 cup of hot water to the cooked milk and chocolate. Add the butter and the vanilla. Serve hot or cold over ice cream or use as fillings for cakes. Makes 2 cups.

title: Yum-A-Setta(Amish)
instructions: Brown hamburger with salt pepper brown sugar and onion. Add tomato soup. Cook egg noodles and drain. Add chicken soup. Layer hamburger mixture and noodle mixture in casserole dish with processed cheese between layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Summer Blt Spread
instructions: Combine bacon sour cream mayonnaises and tomatoes in med. bowl. Stir until blended. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour to blend favors. Can be prepared up to 3 hours in advance. To serve spoon in small bowl or a hollowed out tomato. Place on lettuce leaves or serving plate surrounded by Keebler Town House crackers. Serve with bacon and parsley over spread.

title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy saucepan and brown the beef cubes until deeply colored. Remove from pan and brown sliced onions until golden brown. Return beef cubes to pan and add beef bouillon and dry red wine. Simmer until beef cubes are almost tender. Add small onions and cook until tender. Add mushrooms and heat through; adjust seasonings. Mix cornstarch and water add to beef stock and boil for one minute or until sauce is thickened and clear. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Six Layered Dinner
instructions: Place potatoes in bottom of greased casserole. Add celery beef onions and peppers. Salt and pepper each layer. Pour tomatoes over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water. Add 1 cup cold water. Add strawberries pineapple and bananas. Mix well. Pour half into container and chill until firm. Spread sour cream over Jell-O and add remaining Jell-O and chill.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook Boston butt in crock-pot for about 4 1/2 hours on high until tender. After it cooks trim off fat. Cut in chunks and put in food grinder. Use 1 cup of stock and cut up potatoes chopped onion and a little more water to cover potatoes. Cook until tender but not mushy. To this add meat tomatoes corn hot sauce salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for a while.

title: Cup Custard
instructions: Beat eggs; mix all together. Put in custard cups. Set cups in a 9 x 9-inch pan with 1 1/2-inches hot water in it. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about an hour.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and 1 stick melted butter. Press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream eggs 2 sticks butter powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat with mixer approximately 15 minutes. Spread over crumbs. Slice bananas over mixture. Cover with large container of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Decorate with cherry halves. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Summer Tomato Salad
instructions: Slice tomato in thin wedges. Slice onion also in thin wedges using as much or as little as you want. Add salt and pepper and toss lightly. Set in refrigerator for at least 1/2 hour. Pour dressing to taste just before serving.

title: Okra Fingers
instructions: Wash okra trim and drain. Place in shallow dish. Pour buttermilk over okra set aside. Combine next 5 ingredients mixing well. Remove okra from buttermilk and carefully roll in cornmeal mixture. Drop into hot oil (375\u00b0). Fry 3 to 5 minutes turning and browning on all sides. Drain on paper towels.

title: Homemade Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown hamburger then drain grease off. Place back on heat and add other ingredients continually stirring. May add ketchup and brown sugar to taste. Add chili powder to taste also. Cook on low to medium heat for 30 minutes then serve hot.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Add dry gelatin to cream cheese and combine. Add boiling water celery and pineapple. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into square baking dish and refrigerate until cold and firm.

title: Quick Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Put flour salt and cut up chicken in brown sack. Close tightly and shake chicken pieces good. Fry in hot shortening or oil of your choice. When browned remove to paper towel on platter. Mix remaining ingredients. Dip each piece of chicken into sauce while hot. Then place in roasting pan. Leave open. Bake for 20 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and drain. Melt 1/2 stick margarine in dish. Reserve 1/2 cup crumbs with the rest of margarine to sprinkle over the top of casserole. Mix all other ingredients in dish with margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Noodle Pudding
instructions: Boil noodles in salt water until tender. Drain very dry. Put in large bowl. Melt butter in hot noodles. Add 9 beaten eggs. Add both cans of fruit with juice. Add vanilla sugar raisins and orange juice. Put 3 tablespoons butter in 2 (9 x 12-inch) baking pans. When butter is melted in a 350\u00b0 oven divide the mixture between the 2 pans and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 or until slightly brown. Can divide recipe in half.

title: Apple Snack Cake
instructions: Cover diced apples with sugar. Let stand until liquid rises stirring occasionally until sugar dissolves. Blend together eggs and corn oil. Add to apple-sugar mixture. Sift together flour allspice cinnamon nutmeg salt and soda. Add raisins and pecans. Add flour mixture to apple mixture. Beat by hand as too much mixing makes it crumble. Pour into greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. After it comes out of the oven poke holes in cake and pour the following sauce over top.

title: Wheat Germ Bread
instructions: In large mixer bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour yeast wheat germ and salt mix well. Add water molasses shortening and egg. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. By hand gradually stir in remaining flour to make a stiff batter. Cover. Let rise in warm place until light about 45 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until deep brown. Remove from pan cool.

title: Myrtle'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Line 10 x 13-inch pan with crust mixture pressing firmly to bottom and sides.

title: White Merry Christmas Fudge
instructions: Put sugar milk and corn syrup into saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture begins to boil. Clip a candy thermometer to side of pan. Cook for about 12 minutes or until mixture reaches 234\u00b0 soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add butter and almond extract. Beat until fudge begins to thicken. Quickly stir in walnuts and cherries. Beat until fudge is no longer glossy. Score into squares while warm.

title: Cabbage Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger; add other ingredients. Season to taste. Cook until cabbage is done.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/3 cup catsup. Pack into loaf pan; spread catsup over loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chile Cheese Squares
instructions: Spread the chiles in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with cheese. Combine eggs cream and pepper and mix well. Pour over cheese.

title: Ranch Style Baked Beans
instructions: In large skillet put oil and brown ground beef. Stir in soup mix beans catsup water mustard and vinegar. Simmer until ready to eat.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) pans. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time. Cream thoroughly. Add vanilla. Alternately add flour in 3 portions with milk in 2 portions; pour in pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Allow to cool 10 minutes before removing from pans.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt butter in an 8-inch square pan. Mix together remaining ingredients in pan with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Coconut Pecan Frosting
instructions: Combine milk sugar yolks butter and vanilla. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add nuts and coconut. Beat until cool.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt 1 stick margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar flour baking powder salt and milk. Pour into pan with butter or margarine. Pour fruit over top of batter. Do not stir! Bake at 350` for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Elly'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine shortening and sugar until creamy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and salt alternately with milk and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Do not preheat oven; start in cold oven.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Cut cake into sections/slices small enough to fit shape of bowl. Slices should be normal size thickness.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening and peanut butter and sugar together then add eggs one at a time. Add flour and vanilla. Roll into walnut size balls and flatten in crisscross pattern with floured fork. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown 10 to 12 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet; cool. Yields about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Tapae
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt. Brown in butter in skillet. Remove chicken and butter into large baking dish. Mix apples with chicken. Sprinkle with sugar and nuts. Add cider; cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with mound of steamed rice.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli until almost tender. Put well drained broccoli in greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandma'S Apple Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour salt baking powder and shortening; mix in milk. Roll out dough in rectangle. Spread with apples and sprinkle with a little cinnamon and sugar. Roll up like jelly roll and slice about 1 1/4 inch thick. Place in 9 X 13 pan. Boil sugar water cinnamon and butter. Pour over dumplings. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream granulated sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add the mixture alternately with buttermilk or sour milk. Add coconut extract and flaked coconut. Place in a greased and floured tube pan (a 2 piece pan works best). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from oven. While still hot punch holes in cake and slowly pour the glaze over cake allowing it to seep into holes and down sides and middle. Cool thoroughly before removing from pan. Cake will cut better if allowed to firm up overnight.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer until done. More water can be added if too thick.

title: Baked Onions
instructions: In buttered casserole dish place thinly sliced onions potato chips and grated cheese. Do this in layers. Pour over mushroom soup and milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients except zucchini and eggs together. Mix well. Then add zucchini and eggs. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch dish. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix together and put into 9-inch square pan.\tBake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Candied Yams
instructions: Slice potatoes; put in ovenware dish. Mix sugar flour and salt; sprinkle over potatoes. Mix lemon juice and water; pour over top. Dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered.

title: Cheese Beef Dip
instructions: Brown the beef onion and garlic. Drain the grease. Add cream cheese and melt into the meat mixture. Add the other ingredients. Serve warm in a crock-pot or fondue pot with corn chips.

title: Butter Pecan Pound Cake
instructions: Grease pan. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Sprinkle chopped pecans in bottom of pan. Combine cake mix eggs oil and water. Mix for 2 minutes until smooth. Add icing to batter; mix well and pour into pan on top of pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken Pizzioli
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chicken and cheese. Pour over top of chicken. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Remove from oven; sprinkle cheese on top. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine corn onion cheese soups and sour cream. Place in a greased 8 1/4 x 4 1/4-inch or 9 x 5-inch casserole dish. Mix together crackers almonds and melted margarine. Spread topping over vegetable mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. May be made ahead and refrigerated.

title: Chicken And Tater Tots Casserole
instructions: Broil skinless breast of chicken until done. When cooled cube chicken into bite sizes. Layer Tater Tots in the bottom of a greased casserole dish and add cubed chicken. Mix soups and milk and pour oven chicken and Tater Tots. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Kentucky Jam Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients (except pecans). When batter is smooth and sugar is dissolved add pecans. Bake in two 9x9 pans for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. (I line the bottom of pans with wax paper and grease and flour sides.)

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain well; squeeze out excess moisture. Chop into smaller pieces; set aside. Unroll dough. Press into greased 10-inch glass pie plate covering bottom and sides. Sprinkle cheese and onion over crust. Beat eggs. Add milk seasonings and reserved spinach. Pour into crust. Sprinkle with bacon parsley and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hot Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Heat last 6 ingredients and pour over cabbage and onions. Keeps for days.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in peanut butter graham crackers and powdered sugar. Pat in cookie sheet.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order given. Reserve cheese. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Blend together pudding and milk. Mix Cool Whip with pudding. Pour on top of graham cookies. Add another layer of cookies. Last add Pillsbury chocolate fudge icing on top. Let chill until you can keep the kids out of it.

title: Birds Nest
instructions: Use round deep casserole and fill it half full with tart peeled and sliced apples; sprinkle with brown sugar and nutmeg or cinnamon or both. Dot with butter.

title: Mamie'S Lima Beans
instructions: Pick beans and cover with cold water. Soak 1 to 2 hours. Pour off water and rinse beans. Add all ingredients. Cover beans with cold water and simmer until tender. Pour into baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 until crusty on top. Enjoy!

title: The Unnamed Recipe
instructions: In microwave melt chocolate 1 1/2 minutes; then continue to melt in microwave 15 seconds at a time until completely melted. Stir between meltings. Mix peanuts and cereal together. Pour into melted chocolate. Drop by spoon on waxed paper to cool.

title: Chris' Dump Cake
instructions: Spray oblong pan with\tnonstick spray. Put cherry and pineapple in pan and mix with each other. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over this mixture. Cut up margarine all over the top of this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until brown on top.

title: Egg Roll
instructions: Place ingredients in springroll shells according to package diagram. Deep fry with temperature of 140\u00b0 to 150\u00b0. Turn on both sides ready when golden brown in color. Blot excess oil before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat all but cookie mix until fluffy with mixer. Grease and flour a 9 x 15-inch pan. Cut 1 roll cookie mix and spread on bottom of pan. Pour cream cheese mix on cookie crust. Slice other roll cookie mix and place on top of mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Beef Or Deer Jerky
instructions: Mix all ingredients and marinate overnight. Remove meat from juice and dehydrate. If you do not have a dehydrator place in oven on 140\u00b0 with oven door cracked open so meat will dry out without being cooked. If meat is thin enough it should dry out overnight.

title: Chicken A La King(Low-Fat)
instructions: Melt margarine in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chicken and onion; cook stirring constantly 3 to 5 minutes or until chicken is browned. Add mushrooms; cook 1 minute. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk and next 4 ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Cut each slice of toasted bread into 4 triangles. Serve chicken mixture with 4 toast triangles; sprinkle with paprika.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Crush graham crackers 1 stick butter and sugar. Mix. Put in a square dish. Beat powdered sugar egg and butter at medium speed for 15 minutes. Put on top of crumb mix. Slice bananas. Put on top. Put drained pineapple between bananas. Put Cool Whip onto that. Put nuts and cherries. Set overnight.

title: The Rattlesnake
instructions: In pitcher combine pineapple juice tomato juice sugar and hot pepper sauce; blend well. Pour over ice cubes in glass. Squeeze lime juice into each drink if desired. Garnish with dried red pepper ripe olive and lime peel. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Mozzarella
instructions: Marinate chicken in egg at least 1 hour. Roll in bread crumbs and brown in butter. Place in baking dish. Top with mushrooms then cover with cheese; add chicken broth. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake 30 to 40 minutes more.

title: Lemon Bundt Cake
instructions: Make cake mix according to directions only at the part for water add 3/4 cup lemon juice and the rest water (this is what makes your cake moist). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Place on round cake plate cool.

title: Creamy Broccoli (Or Cauliflower) Bake
instructions: Heat 1-inch salted water to boiling. Add broccoli (or cauliflower). Cover and heat to boiling. Cook until stems are almost tender (10 to 12 minutes). Drain. Place broccoli (or cauliflower) in ungreased 1 1/2-quart round casserole dish.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix oleo powdered sugar flour and salt together. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 oven. Beat eggs; add sugar 6 tablespoons flour and lemon juice. Pour on baked crust. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into squares.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In Dutch oven cook hamburger with garlic and seasoned salt until brown; drain. Add onion celery and dill weed. Add water (just enough to cover ingredients). Cover and simmer for at least 2 hours. Add water if needed. Add potatoes along with more water to cover ingredients. Cook until potatoes are tender (not mushy). Add milk; stir and skim off fat. Great with French bread and butter.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream oil and sugar together. Add eggs and mix well. Add flour soda cinnamon apples and pecans. Mix well. (Batter will be stiff apples will add moisture when cooked.) Bake in preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 in a tube pan.

title: Top Secret Chili
instructions: Brown beef in skillet; drain off fat. In a large pot combine beef and other ingredients and bring to a simmer over very low heat. Cook stirring often to prevent sticking. Cook 2 to 3 hours. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for one hour. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes but not browned. Roll immediately in powdered sugar.

title: Raspberry Dessert
instructions: Melt oleo and mix with crumbs and brown sugar. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan to make bottom layer; let set.

title: Pasta And Ricotta Stuffed Red Peppers
instructions: Chop the onion. Mince the garlic. Grate the Mozzarella and Parmesan. Cut tops off peppers. Remove the seeds and ribs. Cook peppers in a pot of boiling salted water just until soft about 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Light Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add 2 1/2 cups flour (save 1/2 cup to flour fruit) vanilla flavoring milk raisins 1 pound pineapple cherries mixed fruit coconut and pecans. Add crushed pineapple last. Bake at 250\u00b0 for approximately 3 to 3 1/2 hours.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding (dry) and pineapple together until well blended. Add Cool Whip to pudding mixture until well blended. Chill for 2 to 3 hours. Extra nuts or coconut can be added if desired.

title: Golden Pound Cake
instructions: Note Allow butter eggs and milk to get room temperature.

title: Leftover Corn-Off-The-Cob
instructions: Cut corn from cob and scrape cob; set aside. Melt butter in large skillet. Add chopped onion and cover. Stir once or twice until onion is translucent. Add corn and milk if corn is dry. Cover and heat through. Season to taste. Sprinkle with cheese if desired.

title: Piping Hot Venison Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown meat and remove from heat. Add taco mix enchilada sauce and taco sauce. Mix well and pour over beans. Spread cheese on top. Heat in 400\u00b0 oven 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly. Spread sour cream over cheese and return to oven for 5 minutes. Use spoon to dip and serve with nacho chips.

title: Tamale Dip
instructions: Cut up Velveeta cheese in small pieces Add Chili Con Carne salsa and canned chilies. Unwrap and cut up the tamales in bite size. Mix all ingredients well and place in a deep dish and bake for 30 -35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Fried Noodles
instructions: Heat skillet; add oil. Mix all the rest of ingredients and dump into skillet. Pack down in skillet. Lower heat. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Turn when golden brown and cook other side. Invert onto plate. Garnish with parsley. Serve with broiled meat.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix eggs and fruit pie filling. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with mixture of butter flour and brown sugar. It should be crumbly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sweeten blueberries to taste and place in melted butter. Cover with crushed pineapple (do not drain). Pour cake mix on top of this mixture (do not stir). Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Steak N' Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Flour meat and season with salt and pepper. Brown in butter. Place meat in casserole dish. Cook onions until tender but not brown; add soup milk and mushrooms. Heat to boiling. Pour over steak. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Seafood Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese and crabmeat thoroughly. Shape into ball or log in serving dish. Chill until ready to serve. At serving time pour cocktail sauce over seafood ball and sprinkle top with parsley flakes. Serve with Triscuits or crackers.

title: Polynesian Beef
instructions: Brown beef in shortening on top of stove. Add remainder of ingredients. Simmer 1 hour until tender. Serve over or with cooked white rice.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Cool. Add evaporated milk. Chill until slightly set. Blend mayonnaise and softened cream cheese. Add to thickened Jell-O mixture. Drain pineapple and fruit cocktail. Add fruits to Jell-O mixture. Pour into mold. Does well in Tupperware mold.

title: Chicken Pillows
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in one-inch pieces. Marinate in lemon juice oil oregano salt and garlic. Unwrap phyllo dough; place on wax paper and keep covered to keep moist. Cut dough in half lengthwise forming 2 strips each 6-inches wide. Fold in half crosswise; brush with melted butter. Put two pieces of chicken at short end and roll; form a package. Brush with melted butter and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Roasted Smoked Goose
instructions: Cut snapping turtle meat into steaks (thick as possible) and batter down with hands. Saute in butter and season to taste. Serve with jelly or appropriate sauce.

title: Seafood File Gumbo
instructions: In a medium sized pot make a roux with flour and oil. Saute onions and celery on high for 3 minutes. Stir in water and seasoning and chicken. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Add shrimp and crabs; reduce heat. Cook 25 minutes; add oysters juice and sausage. Cook 10 minutes. Sprinkle with file.

title: Apple Cinnamon Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cake mix pie filling and eggs in a large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Spread half cake mixture in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 sugar mixture. Repeat with remaining batter and sugar mixture. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: 100 Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo oil and sugars. Add beaten egg and vanilla. Add dry ingredients oatmeal Rice Krispies and coconut; mix well. Roll into balls from tablespoon. Flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes on a greased cookie sheet.

title: Potato Filling
instructions: Melt 1/4 pound butter in each of 2 skillets. In one brown the bread cubes until crisp. In the other stir-fry onions and celery until soft and translucent. Mash the potatoes adding the milk eggs salt and parsley. Fold in the celery and onion mixture and the bread cubes carefully so the cubes remain whole. Pour into a large baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Simmer until thick about 1/2 hour.

title: Honey Nut Spread
instructions: Combine cream cheese and honey mixing until well blended. Stir in nuts. Chill. Great for topping pumpkin muffins!

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Mix in order given and bring to boil. Simmer 15 minutes. Pack into sterilized jars and seal at once.

title: Ruben Casserole
instructions: Combine kraut onion parsley and seed in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with 2 cups cheese and 2/3 cup dressing. Layer beef slices. Add rest of cheese and dressing. Toss bread cubes with margarine and spread on top. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Kluskis
instructions: In large bowl tear bread into dime size pieces. Mix both turkey and hamburger with bread. Add all remaining ingredients except 1/2 cup Worcestershire and 1 stick margarine or butter. Make into patties. Melt butter or margarine in large frying pan; add 1/2 cup Worcestershire on medium to medium-low heat; fry slowly covered approximately 10 to 15 minutes each side or until no longer red in middle.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Let sausage and cheese stand at room temperature before making. Mix together with Bisquick and sauce. Form into small balls and place on ungreased pans and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and freeze. Reheat before serving.

title: Stollen
instructions: Combine fruits and nuts in bowl and dredge with 1/4 cup flour. Heat milk in small saucepan (or in microwave bowl in microwave oven) until very warm not hot. Pour into large bowl. Sprinkle yeast and the 1/2 teaspoon sugar into milk. Stir to dissolve; let stand until bubbly about 10 minutes. Stir in remaining sugar softened shortening eggs salt cardamon lemon rind almond and rum flavorings and 3 cups of the flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic about 15 minutes using only as much additional flour as needed to keep dough from sticking.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Cook butter and sugar over low heat until bubbly. Cool and add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly. Add vanilla and cream then sifted dry ingredients and coconut. Mix thoroughly. Nuts may be added. Spread in shallow pan (greased) and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. While warm cut in squares.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat butter sugars vanilla water and eggs until light and fluffy. Mix flour with soda and salt; blend into butter mixture. Stir in nuts and chips. Drop 2 inches apart from teaspoon onto greased baking sheets or pour onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Italian Shrimp
instructions: In large shallow baking dish add shrimp to all other ingredients. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Turn to broil for additional 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain well. Mix sour cream soup carrots garlic and Tabasco sauce; set aside. Combine stuffing and melted margarine. Put half of this crumb mixture in 8 x 11-inch or 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add the zucchini to the sour cream and soup mixture; pour over crumbs. Cover with remaining crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine milk sugar margarine and salt. Heat until margarine melts. Cool to 115\u00b0. Stir in yeast mix and flour. Cover and let rise. Roll out and cut into squares. Dip in margarine. Put in Bundt pan and let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pasta Primavera With Shrimp
instructions: Cook fettucine in salted water to desired doneness. Drain and rinse with hot water. In large skillet melt margarine; saute onion and garlic until tender. Add shrimp and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Remove shrimp from skillet; keep warm. Add 2 tablespoons margarine and whipping cream to skillet; heat until margarine melts. Stir in cheese salt and pepper. In large saucepan combine fettucine broccoli and cream mixture; cook until thoroughly heated. Place on warm serving platter; spoon shrimp over top. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Black Bean Casserole
instructions: Soak beans 4 to 8 hours then cook by bringing to a boil. Simmer until done. Cook rice by instructions on bag. Cook beans with coriander cumin and garlic. Place beans in a large casserole dish. Add rice then chopped tomatoes with juice. Add cheese and olives. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix unprepared pudding with pineapple. Then add Cool Whip and nuts. Fold in marshmallows.

title: Chinese Stir-Fry Lamb With Vegetables
instructions: Marinate lamb in soy sauce brandy garlic and cornstarch for one hour or more. Heat a wok or large skillet. Add oil to thinly coat bottom of pan. Add salt and ginger. Cook until ginger begins to brown and dry up. Add lamb with marinade all at once and saute until lightly browned. Add onions and bouillon. Cover and cook until meat is as done as you like it (about 1 minute for rare). Remove cover and add bean sprouts snow peas water chestnuts and cashews. Cook about one minute more stirring constantly. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Texas Casserole
instructions: Brown the meat onions and garlic. Drain off excess fat. Add the 2 cans of soup and a small amount of water bring to boil and let simmer while cooking the macaroni shells.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
instructions: Mix peanut butter sugar and eggs. Roll dough into balls and place on cookie sheets. Bake at 375 for 8-12 minutes or until lightly brown. As soon as they come out of the oven firmly place a kiss in the center of each of the cookies. Cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Wayne'S Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour liquid from asparagus and cream of asparagus soup; heat until creamy. Combine milk and cornstarch; add this to mixture and cook until thickened. In casserole dish layer with 1/2 of the English peas and 1/2 the asparagus then covered with half of thickened sauce and repeat with remaining peas asparagus and sauce. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until heated throughout and cheese is melted about 15 to 20 minutes. Watch closely.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon No-Bake Pie
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool to lukewarm. Whip cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add gelatin mixture. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with peanuts until firm. Refrigerate and leave 1 to 2 hours. I always do overnight as the longer the better the flavor. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Blend these ingredients and pour over vegetables. Refrigerate and marinate 48 hours. (Shake or stir occasionally.) Keeps for several days.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Blend well. Spoon into crust. Chill until set at least 4 hours. Garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Meat Loaf Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine all ingredients. Mix well. In a large shallow baking dish shape into a loaf. Bake 1 hour.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Separate biscuits; cut each into thirds. Wrap dough around cheese cubes; seal well. Fry in hot fat 2 to 3 minutes until brown.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook tortillas in oil. Fill with chicken onions and cheese.

title: Salad(Cranberry)
instructions: For syrup bring to boil the sugar and water; add cranberries and cook until they pop. Dissolve Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Add to Jell-O the cooked berries pineapple and nuts. Put in refrigerator to jell.

title: Out Of This World Pie
instructions: Cook first four ingredients until thickened. Then add last four items. Mix together gently. Pour into pie crust. Top with whipped cream. Makes 2 pies.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O in water. Let it dissolve then add all other ingredients. Mix well. Put in refrigerator and let it jell.

title: Onion Squares
instructions: In a skillet saute the onion in the butter. In a bowl combine the muffin mix egg milk corn and Tabasco to taste. Pour into a greased 8 x 8 inch pan. Add the sour cream salt dill weed and 1/2 c. cheese to the sauteed onions and spread all over the batter. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake at 425\u00b0 for 25-30 minutes. Cut into squares and serve warm.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except coconut) well with mixer. Add coconut and mix with spoon. Pour into oven baking dish. Top with topping.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain canned beans. Combine beans mushroom soup milk bacon bits salt and pepper. Turn mixture into a 1-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Sprinkle with French fried onions. Continue baking about 5 minutes.

title: World'S Best Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking soda cream of tartar and salt together and set aside. Mix together sugars margarine and almond extract. Stir in oil and eggs. Mix with electric mixer until well mixed. Add flour mixture one cup at a time. Use electric mixer until mixture becomes very thick finish mixing with a wooden spoon. Chill dough. Roll chilled dough into walnut-sized balls. Place on cookie sheet. Press with fork or a tumbler dipped in sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Snapper With Honey Mustard Sauce
instructions: Rinse fish and pat dry. Place in a baking dish. Combine first 7 ingredients. Stir with a wire whisk until well blended. Pour mixture over fish cover and marinate 30 minutes to an hour in refrigerator. Remove fish from marinade. Coat grill with vegetable spray and grill fish over hot coals or broil 6 minutes on each side or until fish flakes. Baste with extra marinade.

title: Sweet Rolls
instructions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Sprinkle a few nuts in bottom of pan. Stand up biscuits in circle of pan. Mix Jell-O pudding mix brown sugar and nuts. Sprinkle mix over and between biscuits. Pour the melted butter or oleo over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 35 minutes. Turn out onto plate and serve while warm.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Blend until smooth. Serves 4-6. Note Can use small pkg. of frozen strawberries and 1 banana instead of orange juice.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Mash avocados. Add lemon juice salt and pepper. In separate bowl mix sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning. Refrigerate both mixtures.

title: Seasoned Pecans
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Melt butter salt and hot sauce. Add pecans. Stir to coat. Bake 20 minutes stirring every 2 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the Worcestershire sauce.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Stir shortening to soften. Gradually add 2 cups sugar and cream together until light and fluffy. Add extract. Sift 3 cups flour baking powder and salt together 3 times; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and water a small amount each time. Beat after each addition until smooth. Fold in egg whites. Bake in 2 paper-lined 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch pans in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Put layers together with the following filling.

title: Sausage Rolls Canadian
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese or margarine mixing until well blended. Add flour; mix well. Shape into ball; chill. Cut sausage links in half crosswise. Simmer in water 2 minutes; drain. Cool. Divide dough in half. On lightly floured surface roll out each half to 12-inch square. Cut each square into 16 (3 x 3-inch) pieces. Spread each piece with mustard to within 1/2 inch of edge. Roll around sausage half; seal ends. Dip each roll in seed. Place seam-side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Zucchini Raisin Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add oil and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients. Mix all together. Add squash. Bake in 3 loaf pans. Cook 55 minutes at 325\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: Mock Apple Dumplings
instructions: Blend flour baking powder salt sugar and shortening like pie crust. Add milk and mix thoroughly until forms a soft dough. On a floured surface pat dough then roll out to a rectangular shape with 1/4-inch to 1/2-inch thickness. Spread softened margarine over the dough. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar apples and more cinnamon and sugar. Roll up like a jelly roll. Cut in 2-inch slices and place in 9 x 13-inch pan (sprayed). Pour Syrup (recipe follows) over slices. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes or tops are golden brown and center is firm. Serve warm or cold.

title: Stir Crazy Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Then add the liquids. Stir well. Pour into 9 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon uncooked oatmeal over top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes for chewy brownies. Yields 16 pieces. Has 68 calories. Exchange 1 starch.

title: Apple Torte
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Grease a 9-inch glass pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or more. Check for doneness. You can double this recipe.

title: Fruit Salad With Sauce
instructions: Cook until mixture has some thickness; cool. Add all kinds of fruit (canned or fresh). Also you can add nuts or coconut.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs. Sift dry ingredients 3 times. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla and food coloring. Beat well. Fold in soda dissolved in vinegar. Bake in 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and frost with White Frosting for Red Velvet Cake.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Hold out 1 cup pecans. Mold ingredients into a ball and roll in the remaining cup of pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Turkey And Mushroom Croquettes
instructions: Make thick sauce. Melt 4 tablespoons butter. Add 4 tablespoons flour. Add stock and milk. Bring to a boil. Cook until thick and smooth. Add seasonings and parsley. Let cool.

title: Monterey Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. In a medium bowl beat egg. Add sour cream Parmesan cheese and garlic powder. Drain spaghetti. Add to egg mixture with cheese spinach and half of onions. Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Hamburg Pie
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft then drain. In the meantime brown beef and onion. Mix in beans and soup and add salt and pepper to taste. Spread meat mix in a Dutch oven. Mash potatoes and mix in milk eggs salt and pepper to taste. Spread mashed potatoes on top of meat mix leaving edges open for bubbling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes until top browns.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: In a skillet brown the ground beef and drain. Stir in 1/2 cup salsa. Spread 1/4 cup salsa in a glass baking dish. Top with 3 or 4 taco shells. Top with half of each beans meat mixture sour cream and cheese. Repeat layers; cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with lettuce and remaining salsa. This dish will serve 6 to 8 people.

title: Whipped Yellow Turnips
instructions: Cook potatoes and turnips in boiling salt water to cover in 3-quart covered saucepan over medium heat about 20 minutes. Drain. Return to pan. Shake pan over low heat a few seconds to dry. Mash vegetables. Add remaining ingredients. Beat with fork until fluffy.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix thoroughly and fry on a hot griddle.

title: Greek Salad
