instructions: Break lettuce in small pieces. Place in salad bowl with celery onions cucumbers green pepper and tomato. Pour only enough dressing over vegetables to lightly coat each piece. Garnish with cubes of Feta cheese anchovy fillets Calamata olives and boiled shrimp (optional).

title: Mocha Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Stir 3 tablespoons powdered instant coffee into devils food cake (dry mix) or use strong cold coffee in place of water. Mix and bake as directed. Cool. Frost with Mocha Butter Icing.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all together. Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook hamburger onion celery and green pepper in bacon grease until brown. Drain hamburger (if needed). Add other ingredients and cook 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggfree Spice Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and margarine well. Mix together dry ingredients and add. Mix until well blended. Put in a bread tin and bake in a preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Cook beef and green peppers in electric skillet until done. Add both cans of soup water and soy sauce. Stir until celery soup is thinned out. Simmer. Pour over rice.

title: Nut And Raisin Bread
instructions: Heat skillet until almost smoking. Turn burner down to low. Mix 1 to 1 1/2 cups corn meal mix milk and egg. May also add chopped onion and/or sour cream. Add water if needed to make batter thin like cake batter. Pour into hot skillet and place lid on. Then turn batter and let cook. Crack lid to let the steam out so cornbread will not be soggy. One bag of self-rising corn meal is used.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening sugars eggs and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter. Sift dry ingredients and stir into creamed mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with back of floured fork to make crisscross. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Crab Meat Casserole
instructions: Blend butter with flour. Add tomato soup and sour cream. Cook spinach with onion according to package directions. Line baking dish with this mixture. Cover with raw rice then crab meat and add sauce. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until thoroughly hot and cheese melts about 30 to 40 minutes. Season to taste. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Smothered Round Steak
instructions: Clean and trim excess fat from steak. Cut into 3-inch wide by 5-inch long pieces. Salt and pepper the steak and dredge in the flour. In a frypan place the cooking oil and heat. Place steak in frypan and cook turning occasionally until done. Remove from the frypan and add remaining flour to the cooking oil; stir until brown. Add water to make gravy a smooth texture. Add onions. Return the steak. Cover and cook for an additional 10 to 15 minutes over a low fire. Serves 6 to 7.

title: Creamed Green Beans And Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter. Fry onions in butter then add flour. Stir and add milk. In separate pan boil water and add bouillon cube. Add to first mixture. Cube potatoes and mix with green beans. Pour cream sauce over both.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Bring to a boil the sugar oil vinegar and salt. Add remaining ingredients and let stand 12 to 24 hours in refrigerator. Will keep for days.

title: Bride'S Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Chill until slightly thickened. Add remaining ingredients. Chill for several hours or until firm.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar well then add cocoa and flour. Put in microwave until thoroughly heated. Bake pie crust with pie weights until brown. Pour filling into baked crust filling will be very thick. For meringue beat 1/2 cup sugar and 3 egg whites until stiff peaks form. Bake pie with meringue on top until browned.

title: Hamburg Casserole
instructions: Cooking Time 40 minutes. Servings 4 to 6.

title: Squash Pickle Relish
instructions: Cook all together until tender. Process for 5 minutes in water bath cooker.

title: Golden Top Stroganoff
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 2-quart casserole. Cook noodles according to package directions. Brown meat and drain. Put into casserole and mix in 1/2 can of onions. Prepare gravy mix according to package directions except increase water to 1 1/4 cups. When thickened add 1/2 cup sour cream mixing well. Drain noodles. Return to pan. Pour and stir in the gravy mixture. Spread this over the meat/onions in casserole. To remaining sour cream add egg and seasoned salt mixing well with a fork. Pour over noodles making sure all are covered. Bake for 25 minutes uncovered. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes more. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Roast On The Grill
instructions: Pierce chuck roast; cover with meat tenderizer and pepper well. Mix marinade of vegetable oil ketchup vinegar with garlic and a few shakes of Worcestershire sauce. Cover roast and marinate at least 12 hours. Grill and baste with marinade. Roast has better texture when room temperature before grilling.

title: German Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm water. Add the table salt and sugar. Blend in the flour. Put on bread board and knead for 5 minutes or until smooth. Divide into 4 equal parts. Roll each part separately. Cut into 5 equal pieces. This will yield 20 small pieces each of which will be rolled (like a rope) and formed into a pretzel. Place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Flip over; brush each pretzel with beaten egg and sprinkle with coarse salt. Let rise 20 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and place in airtight container and freeze. Thaw at room temperature and warm in oven. Serve plain or dip in cheese or mustard.

title: Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Melt lard in heavy pot. Add hamburger salt pepper and chili powder. Chop onion fine and add. Stir in tomato juice. Let cook 1 hour or until thick as desired.

title: Grandmother'S Old Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter then sift sugar. Add to butter a little at time until all is used. Then add egg yolks beaten until light. Add flour gradually and last add beaten egg whites. Fold whites in lightly. Pour into a greased loaf pan or tube cake pan and bake 45 minutes in a moderate oven. Do not open oven door until cake has been in oven 40 minutes. A pan of water in bottom of stove helps.

title: Honey Baked Sweet Potatoes(Over 50 Years Old)
instructions: Place potatoes in a baking dish. Combine butter and honey and pour over potatoes in a hot (400\u00b0) oven 15 to 20 minutes basting frequently.

title: Barbecued Baby Beef Ribs
instructions: Wipe ribs with wet towel or with damp cloth. Place ribs in a single layer in a shallow roasting pan. Roast ribs at 450\u00b0 for about 20 minutes turning once.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Bake crusts with pecans on top; cool. Cream the cream cheese with 2 cups powdered sugar. Put a layer in each crust. Beat Dream Whip (2 envelopes) with cold milk. Put a layer in each crust. Divide pie filling on each pie. Garnish with remaining Dream Whip.

title: English Muffin Pizza
instructions: On English muffin spread chili sauce add a slice of cheese a slice of bacon and season with poultry seasoning. Broil in oven approximately 7 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken and cut in bite size pieces. Chop onion and saute in butter in large skillet. Add green chilies soup and water. Mix and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oleo and 1 egg together and press into pan (9 x 13-inch). Cream together cream cheese 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour over cake mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Ranch Pretzels
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Break pretzels into pieces. Place in oven on cookie sheet for 20 minutes. While pretzels are baking mix dressing oil and dill weed. Remove pretzels and place into plastic bowl with lid; pour (well mixed) oil over pretzels mix and shake. Place pretzels back on cookie sheet and bake 20 more minutes. Keep stored in plastic bowl.

title: Easy-As-Pie Pie
instructions: In medium sized bowl beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Gradually add sweetened condensed milk and stir until well blended. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Turn into crust. Refrigerate (not freeze) 2 to 3 hours. Garnish with chilled cherry pie filling before serving.

title: One Egg Cake(From 1975 Edition)
instructions: Stir ingredients until smooth. Bake at 375\u00b0. Good for strawberry shortcake.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bring water cornstarch sugar and food coloring to a boil. Cook until thick and clear. Remove from stove and add Jell-O. Cool 10 minutes in freezer. Add strawberries and mix. Pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator then top with Cool Whip.

title: Calico Salad
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients. Make a dressing with the remaining ingredients. Pour over salad. Needs to set in refrigerator at least overnight. Will keep up to 6 weeks.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and Miracle Whip. Add other ingredients. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Hot Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mash cheese and crisco; cream well. Add flour and salt; Mix well. Roll into small balls; chill 1 hour. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Balls will flatten as they cook.

title: Fudge
instructions: Cook until thick when dropped in cold water. Beat all the time. Add the Marshmallow Fluff after removing from fire. Beat until thick. Pour over nuts.

title: Cherry Angel Food Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed on package. Cool. Beat whipping cream and powdered sugar in a chilled bowl until stiff. Fold in cherries juice and nuts. Frost cake. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Blend cream cheese into hot potatoes. Beat and add eggs and chopped onion. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Beef Jerky
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4-inch strips. Works better if meat is a little frozen. Mix ingredients. Marinate strips of meat overnight mixing once or twice. Turn oven on to slowest temperature. Dry on oven rack for 3 or more hours or until meat is dark and cracks when it is bent. Remove and cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Peppercorns
instructions: Cut tenderloin lengthwise to within 1/2 inch of opposite edge leaving edge intact. Open tenderloin out flat. Place heavy-duty plastic wrap on tenderloin; pound meat to flatten. Remove wrap. Spread mustard; sprinkle sage green peppercorns and 1/2 tablespoon each of black and white ground peppercorns. Fold tenderloin back over and tie with string at 3-inch intervals. Spread butter on top of tenderloin; sprinkle rest of peppercorns. Place on rack. Can bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted at thickest part of meat reads 140\u00b0 for rare 150\u00b0 for medium or 160\u00b0 for well done. Can also cook on gas grill. Serves 8.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco with sugars. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour soda and powder. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. (Its okay if they are light in color.) Grease cookie sheets first time only and drop in small/medium sized clusters.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Cook the chicken until done. Pick the chicken off in pieces and layer in the bottom of a 9 x 11-inch pan. Prepare the stuffing by the directions on the box then spread the stuffing over the chicken. Next you will pour the soup over the stuffing (no water added). Then bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mary Raper'S Lemonade Cookies
instructions: Cream together the butter and sugar. Add eggs. Beat until light and fluffy. Sift together the flour and soda. Add alternately to creamed mixture with 1/2 cup of lemonade. Drop from teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from baking sheet.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Beat cream cheese margarine milk and vanilla in medium bowl with electric mixer on low speed until smooth. Gradually beat in powdered sugar on low speed one cup at a time until smooth. Frosts 1 (13 x 9-inch) cake generously or fills and frosts one 8 or 9-inch (2-layer) cake.

title: Pastry
instructions: Add boiling water to Crisco. Beat until water is absorbed. Add flour and salt in two cup then one cup intervals. Blend well after each addition. The final cup should be added slowly depending on the humidity. You may not need a full cup. If you dont use it all immediately wrap in wax paper to refrigerate. Allow to come to room temperature after refrigeration.

title: Bananas Royale
instructions: Stir topping rum and cinnamon in 12-inch skillet. Quarter bananas by cutting in half lengthwise and crosswise. Cut again in half lengthwise to form 8 pieces per banana. Add bananas to topping mixture; heat thoroughly.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together and stir well. Pour into ovenproof dish. Sprinkle generously with Mexican style Velveeta on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Banana Punch Concentrate
instructions: Mix well. Freeze in quarts. Use 1 quart slush with 2 quarts 7-Up.

title: Mama'S Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook lasagna noodles and cool. Brown ground beef with garlic salt and pepper. Add mushrooms onion and green pepper.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Can use a blender.

title: Pumpkin Bread (Dave'S Favorite)
instructions: Mix all together by hand or electric mixer (mixer is faster and more thorough). Bake in loaf pans (greased) one pound coffee cans or other cans. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Springs back to touch when done.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Sprinkle cinnamon and nutmeg in batter. Melt butter and mix together the flour sugar baking pwd. salt and milk; stir by hand until smooth. Pour batter over butter and dribble the fruit over the batter; do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 min. or until done.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
instructions: Combine flour and salt. Add milk eggs and oil. Whisk with a wire whip. Let sit for about 2 hours while roast is cooking. Pour some of meat drippings into a 9 x 8-inch baking dish. Add batter and cook in hot oven at 425\u00b0 until batter rises in peaks about 30 minutes. Serve with roast beef.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and salt. Stir in the eggs. Mix altogether. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Scallop
instructions: Brown pork chops in skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Blend soup sour cream water and parsley.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Fry sausage until done. Drain. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Shape into loaf and put in loaf pan or on baking sheet. Keep drained. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Ham Hocks And Turnip Greens
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly breaking off the tough stems. Place in pot with all other ingredients. Cover with boiling water and cook gently for 3 hours. When done season to taste with salt and pepper. Drain.

title: Potluck Potatoes
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Combine corn flakes (or Chex) with melted 1/4 cup butter; top casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and drain. Cut bacon in small strips; brown and drain. Mix together and place in baking dish. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 4 quarts. Does well in crock-pot.

title: Hawaiian Delight Cake
instructions: Poke holes in cake. Pour crushed pineapple with juice over cake and spread evenly. Make pudding and spread over pineapple. Slice bananas and place over pudding mixture. Spread Cool Whip over bananas and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Mother'S Cheese Loaf
instructions: Shred cheese. Add crackers and pimento. Mix dry mustard sugar and eggs. Add milk. Add vinegar very slowly. Cook over medium heat until thick. Add cheese mixture; stir well. Bake in cheese ring or baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Turkey 'N' Stuffing Pie(Microwave)
instructions: In 9-inch round or fluted microwavable dish place water and butter. Cook covered on High 3 minutes or until butter melts. Stir in stuffing crumbs and 1/2 can onions. Press stuffing mixture into dish as above. Reduce milk to 1/2 cup. In large microwave bowl combine soup milk turkey and peas. Cook covered 8 minutes. Stir turkey mixture halfway through cooking time. Pour turkey mixture into stuffing shell. Cook uncovered 4 to 6 minutes. Rotate dish halfway through cooking time. Top with remaining onions; cook uncovered 1 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Mix milk potatoes and butter. Mix together flour sugar baking powder salt and soda. Mix all together. Turn onto a floured board; knead 30 seconds. Roll 1/2-inch thick and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Mix cinnamon and 5 tablespoons sugar. Sprinkle apples with cinnamon/sugar mix. Set aside.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Jam
instructions: In a large kettle combine strawberries rhubarb sugar and pineapple. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat; stir in gelatin until dissolved. Pour into jars or frozen containers leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Top with lids; refrigerate or freeze.

title: Peanut Butter Play Dough(Play Dough You Can Eat.)
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Let kids make critters of their choice out of the mixture. Decorate with peanuts raisins chocolate chips or coconut and eat.

title: Tears On Your Pillow Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat together oleo brown sugar eggs flour and milk. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Turn off oven and leave pie in for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake pastry shell 5 minutes. Mix ingredients; pour into pastry shell. Bake 45 minutes. Let stand 10 to 12 minutes until firm before cutting into wedges. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Taverns
instructions: Mix all ingredients except meat in pan and bring to boil. Add the hamburger meat. Crumble until well mixed with other ingredients. Boil 10 minutes then simmer 20 minutes. Serve on hot toasted buns.

title: Ham Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together and form into a loaf. Place in a pan (loaf) and pour on can of Campbells tomato soup over it. Bake 1 hour in oven at 375\u00b0.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place into a baking dish with cover. Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake 20 minutes at moderate heat. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Melts
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cream butter and gradually add dry ingredients. Mix and chill 1 hour. Roll into balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with finger. Bake 12 to 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix soup 1/4 c. milk pepper vegetables and chicken in 9 inch pie plate. Mix remaining milk egg and baking mix. Pour over chicken mixture. Bake until golden brown.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine. Set aside. In large bowl with mixer beat 4 eggs and 2 cups sugar. Add chocolate to margarine mixture and mix well. Gradually add flour. Add vanilla and 1 cup chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Sicilian Cheese Ball
instructions: Allow cheese to soften at room temperature. Blend all ingredients together until smooth (except nuts). Chill for 2 hours. Shape into a ball and roll in chopped nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Bread(Appetizer)
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain. Reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: For syrup mix water sugar and cinnamon. Cook for 5 minutes (simmer) then add butter. While syrup is cooking in a bowl put flour and shortening. Cut shortening into flour until it resembles coarse bread crumbs. Add milk all at once. Stir until moistened.

title: Peanut Butter Cornflake Candy
instructions: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil. Turn off heat. Add peanut butter and beat until melted or smooth. Pour into cornflakes. Put in square pan. The cornflakes are not to be crushed. Use nonstick pan to mix in.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: In an 8 x 8-inch pan put your spinach or green beans on bottom then pour the can of cream of mushroom soup over the top of the spinach or green beans. Sprinkle the top with the dried onions. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vanilla Cream Fraiche(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: In a small chilled bowl whip cream until almost stiff. Gently fold in the yogurt and vanilla. Chill in a covered container at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend. Use as a topping for berries other fruits and desserts.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Cool this and add the onion pimientos green pepper and cucumber.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries marshmallows and sugar together. Chill overnight. Add apples grapes walnuts and salt. Add cream to mixture when ready to serve.

title: Party Nuts
instructions: Melt margarine in jelly roll pan at 325\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar and salt; beat into meringue. Fold in nuts and spread over melted butter in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes turning with a spatula occasionally until all butter is absorbed. Cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Bill'S Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Pour coconut into frozen pie shell. Melt butter and pour over coconut. Mix eggs sugar flour buttermilk and vanilla; beat well. Pour over coconut in pie shell. Bake until brown.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juice from fruit and measure 4 cups juice. Pour juice into pan. Add the dry jello dry pudding mix and tapioca. Cook until thick. Let cool completely. Pour over fruit in large bowl. Will keep in refrigerator up to 3 weeks.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix together in casserole dish. Keep enough cheese to top. Sprinkle with parsley and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until it bubbles up in the middle. If potatoes start to look dry cover to finish baking.

title: Linguini With Fresh Clam Sauce
instructions: Chop garlic and brown in skillet with olive oil. Shuck clams reserving the juice. Chop clams and add to garlic and oil. Cook for 3 minutes. Add parsley and pepper; simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over freshly cooked linguini.

title: Happiness Cake
instructions: Mix together thoroughly. Add tears of joy sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kindly service. Fold into daily life. Bake well with the warmth of human kindness and serve with a \smile\ anytime.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown rice in oil until golden brown. Add onion and garlic. Saute. Next add tomato sauce water salt and pepper. Bring to a boil then lower to the lowest heat possible for 20 minutes. Turn off heat and keep covered for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk until it starts to thicken then add the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Layer in dish wafers bananas and filling. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Danish Kringle
instructions: Mix butter and flour then add cream. Roll out and cut in strips. Shape in figures of an 8. Brush with egg white and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes checking often.

title: Key Lime Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butter/margarine confectioners sugar 2 cups flour and salt. Mix with a pastry blender or two knives until mixture is well blended. Pat evenly into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan and bake 20 minutes. Beat eggs lightly. Stir in granulated sugar 6 tablespoons flour lime juice and rind. Mix well and spread over baked crust. Bake 25 minutes longer. Remove from oven and sift confectioners sugar over the top. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Crock-Pot Baked Potatoes
instructions: Like foil baked but no oven heat! Fill your crock-pot with washed and well-greased potatoes. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. This recipe is great when you are having a busy day!

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple well. Melt butter in pan (9-inch round or 8 or 9-inch square). Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar. Arrange pineapple and cherries in sugar mixture. Prepare crumb cake and pour over all in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until tests done.

title: Ham And Pineapple Skewers
instructions: Fit the steel knife into the work bowl of a food processor. Combine flour orange juice mustard baking powder salt and pepper in a bowl. Process 10 seconds until well mixed. Pour batter into a deep bowl. Cut bread and ham into 1/2 inch cubes. Place a cube of bread a cube of pineapple and a cube of ham on wooden pick. Repeat to make 30 appetizers. Pour oil into a large deep skillet to the depth of 2 inches. Heat oil to 325\u00b0. Dip each appetizer into batter to coat completely. Carefully lower wooden picks into hot oil. Deep fry for about 5 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm. Yield 30 appetizers. Carbohydrate 15 g protein 3 g fat 2 g calories 82 g.

title: Chicken Diablo(Honey)
instructions: Line baking pan with silver foil. Melt butter honey and mustard. Stir in salt and curry powder. Brush on chicken before and during baking. Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar until creamy. Add egg cloves and apple butter. Sift in flour with baking powder soda and cinnamon. Add raisins. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Combine sugar and graham cracker crumbs. Melt margarine and peanut butter in microwave. Mix both together. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips (2 minutes in microwave); stir for 90 seconds. Spread on crumb mixture. Refrigerate. Cut when cool. Easy and always a big hit!

title: Chicken Dijon(Low-Fat)
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and garlic powder. Mix mustard yogurt and sour cream in a bowl. Dip chicken in mixture and cover with mixture. Place dipped chicken breasts in baking pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Chop cabbage fine. Add chopped green pepper onion and shredded carrots.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Whip cream until stiff. Add sugar pineapple vanilla and marshmallows (gently). Add food coloring last. Chill very thoroughly before serving. Amount 6 to 8 servings.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Stir Jell-o and gelatin together. Add boiling water. Pour into 9 x 13 pan and chill.

title: Cheesy Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Mash cheese and blend in sour cream onion and pepper to taste. Cut a slice from top of tomatoes and scoop out centers. Fill tomato shells with cheese mixture. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift sugar flour salt cocoa and baking soda into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Make a well in middle of ingredients and add combined vanilla oil cold water and vinegar. Stir until smooth with wire whisk. Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool frost as desired.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients in a large bowl in the order given adding water last. Stir only until moistened. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Bake for 30 minutes. Cool on rack. Serve with chilled peaches and whipped topping or ice cream.

title: Easy Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes; cool and peel. Melt the margarine and quarter the potatoes. Put into shallow baking dish and pour the margarine over them. Turn each section of potato to coat with margarine well. Sprinkle with minced onion and seasoned salt. Top generously with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Kathy'S Strawberry Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Grease 13 x 9 pan. Mix first 3 ingredients and set aside. Combine cake mixture and rhubarb mixture; pour into cake pan. Pour marshmallows on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat; add salt pepper to taste and kidney beans. Simmer 15 minutes. Cool. Add rest of ingredients. Doritos and lettuce when serving.

title: Asparagus Soup
instructions: Cut off top 1-inch of frozen asparagus and reserve. Chop up remaining asparagus stalks and place in blender. Add pint of half and half and blend on high for 1 minute. Put in saucepan add tips of asparagus and bring to scald. Do not boil. Serve immediately with sprig of parsley and pinch of paprika.

title: Old Witch'S Magic Nut Cake
instructions: In a large bowl beat together eggs pumpkin oil and water. Add flour sugar baking soda salt nutmeg cinnamon raisins and walnuts. Pour the batter into 3 buttered (1 pound) coffee cans. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until straw inserted in the cake comes out clean.

title: Spicy Oven Fries
instructions: Wash potatoes; cut into wedges or 3/4-inch chunk slices. Drain. Place in a bowl; sprinkle with oil and toss lightly. Combine spices and cheese. In a separate bowl put half of the potatoes in. Sprinkle half of the spice mixture over and toss lightly. After placing these potatoes in a single layer on a lightly oiled 10 x 15-inch pan sprinkle spices over the remaining potatoes. Bake at 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Betsy'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Blend well in blender. Serve over fresh vegetable salad.

title: Large Shell Macaroni And Sausage
instructions: In large skillet brown sausage; drain off excess fat. Add bell pepper and onion; cook until tender. Stir in tomatoes and tomato sauce (cut up the tomatoes with fork). Add sugar salt and chili powder. Mix. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Cook large shell macaroni according to directions on package; drain thoroughly. Add cooked shell macaroni to sauce. Stir in sour cream; heat thoroughly. Pass the grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Kids Finger Paints
instructions: Press a block of styrofoam into a small flowerpot. Poke a peppermint stick into the middle of the block. Pour enough uncooked rice or beans into the pot to completely cover the styrofoam. Theyll keep the pot from tipping.

title: Two Bean Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand for 1 hour or longer.

title: Crusty Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Add milk to soup. Heat to boiling. Add onion cheese salt and pepper. Arrange alternate layers of soup mixture and cooked potatoes in buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle corn flakes on top. Melted brown butter may be added to the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix chicken sour cream enchilada sauce green chiles and chicken broth in pan and heat. Fry tortillas until softened. Layer in shallow pan the sauce tortillas and onion and top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Pecans (Sweet)
instructions: Put nuts in mixture and coat. Spread nuts on baking sheet and bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Turn nuts every 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Simmer broccoli onion and butter until soft. Add soup and cheese. Mix well. Add rice. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until real hot and brown.

title: Holiday Wreaths
instructions: Line two large cookie sheets with wax paper. In top of double boiler combine marshmallows butter or margarine vanilla and food coloring. Heat over boiling water stirring frequently until marshmallows are melted. Gradually stir in cornflakes. Drop by rounded greased teaspoonfuls onto lined cookie sheets. Shape into 2-inch wreaths. Decorate with red candies. Store between layers of wax paper in refrigerator. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen about 60 calories each.

title: Tandy Kake
instructions: Cream eggs vanilla sugar oil and salt. Add flour alternating with milk. Beat. Pour into greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Check by pressing center or when edges separate from sides of pan. While hot spread with peanut butter. (In a large cookie sheet you may need more than 3/4 cup of peanut butter to cover.) Allow to cool at room temperature until peanut butter is set. Melt the Hershey bars in the microwave. Caution against burning. Pour onto peanut butter topping and spread to cover.

title: Kip'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar; add whipped topping and strawberries and mix well by hand. Put in crust and garnish with strawberries. Chill.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Mix well. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Spread bean dip in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix lemon juice avocado garlic salt sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning together. Spread on top of bean dip. Layer tomatoes onions and cheese dip. Top with black olives.

title: Lick-It Glue
instructions: Mix gelatine and fruit juice in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil until gelatine is completely dissolved. Using a paintbrush brush warm solution on one side of a sheet of paper. Dry overnight. Children may then color the uncoated side of the paper and cut it apart. Lick and stick instant stamps!

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix well the oil sugar vanilla and eggs. Then add flour soda and apple pie spice. Mix well. Last add apples and nuts. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: California Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle onion soup mix over bottom of 17 x 13-inch buttered pan. Sprinkle rice evenly over soup mix. Place chicken on top of rice. Dilute mushroom soup with water and pour over chicken. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Cheese Ball 2
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly until smooth. Form into 2 balls and roll in chopped nuts. Chill 2 hours.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix water oil and pudding mix. Beat in eggs one at a time. Blend with cake mix and poppy seed. Place in a Bundt pan greased and floured or sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Allow to cool in pan for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and water. Add cake mix instant chocolate pudding eggs and sour cream. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan a few minutes and then turn out onto serving plate. Either sprinkle with powdered sugar or ice immediately while still hot with Chocolate Frosting.

title: Jiffy Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix soups milk sour cream seasonings and hash browns. Pour into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Boil water sugar cloves and cinnamon for 5 minutes in 4 to 6 quart pot. Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil and let simmer for 30 minutes. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Pour melted butter onto the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over melted butter. Sprinkle nuts evenly over crumbs. Scatter chocolate pieces over nuts. Sprinkle coconut evenly over chocolate pieces. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Cut into bars. Makes about 2 dozen 1 1/2 x 3-inch bars.

title: Philly Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices. Arrange cookie slices slightly overlapping on foil covered 14-inch pizza pan. Press edges to seal. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and remove from foil onto serving plate. Combine cheese sugar and vanilla mixing well. Spread over crust; arrange fruit on cream cheese mixture. Glaze with marmalade and water; mix. Chill.

title: Kugel
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish melt margarine. Boil noodles 5 minutes until still slightly firm. Mix remaining ingredients together and beat well. Mix together with noodles. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0 until bubbling. Cool until warm to touch. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top. Serve warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers. Great served warm with cream!

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese soup and tomatoes (Ro-Tel). In oblong pan layer tortillas beef onion and beans. Pour melted cheese mixture over entire casserole. Crumble Fritos on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and brown on top 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in large jelly roll pan. Pour into mixing bowl. Add cake mix and 1 egg. Mix and put in greased pan. Press out evenly in bottom of pan.

title: Golden Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together in bowl the flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in corn meal. In a small bowl beat eggs milk and shortening. Add all at once to corn meal mixture. Stir with fork until flour is just moistened. Even if batter is lumpy do not stir anymore. Pour into well-greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until done.

title: Artie'S Homemade Pasta Sauce
instructions: Chop the onions bell peppers parsley mushrooms and garlic. In a large pot over medium heat heat the olive oil and saute onions and peppers until onions are clear. Add mushrooms then garlic and parsley. Add ground beef and brown it off. Add tomato sauce oregano and salt. Then add ketchup and lemon juice. Bring to slow boil and add wine. Bring to boil again then reduce heat to simmer and cover and cook 2 or 3 hours. For pasta sauce add meatballs and sausage during last hour of cooking.

title: World'S Easiest Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Melt butter in a 2-quart casserole dish. Add uncooked macaroni and stir until macaroni is coated. Mix in Cheddar cheese and pour milk over the mixture so that all macaroni is covered. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Linguine With Shrimp
instructions: Peel and clean shrimp. Smash and dice garlic. Brown garlic in unsalted butter. Chop parsley. Slice mushrooms and stir in the warm unsalted butter. Add coarsely chopped shrimp. After shrimp turns pink stir in parsley. Pour over hot linguine. Add Romano cheese salt and pepper to taste.

title: Grandma'S Best Cookies
instructions: In small bowl combine dry ingredients. In large bowl cream margarine and peanut butter; blend in both sugars add egg and vanilla. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven quickly press candy star into top of each cookie. Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Chicken Tacos(Low-Fat)
instructions: Add sugar picante sauce and cumin to chicken breast pieces. Cook on low temperature for 3 minutes stirring. Toast taco shells in oven until lightly browned. Fill shells with meat. Garnish each taco with lettuce tomatoes and onions.

title: Frog Eye Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in 1 1/2 quarts water with oil and salt added. When tender drain and cool. Cook until thick\tthe sugar flour pineapple juice eggs and salt. Remove from stove and add lemon juice. Cool. Drain the cans of pineapple and save. Use juice for custard. Drain mandarin oranges. Add 1 large and 1 small container Cool Whip plus 1 cup small marshmallows to cool custard. Add fruit; stir and refrigerate.\tAdd macaroni too. Makes about 20 servings. Keeps in fridge about 1 week.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil for 3 minutes. Let cool. Cut up strawberries. Put in baked pie shell. Pour mixture over strawberries. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Fire Ant Poison
instructions: Mix above ingredients well. Use a 2-gallon plastic bucket. Add 5 pounds white corn meal and mix thoroughly. Use 1/3 to 1/2 cup of this bait formula to each fire ant mound. This does not keep long. Try to use it all. Fire ant bait recipe was developed by Texas A & M.

title: Spicy Rabbit
instructions: Combine first six ingredients in non-metal casserole. Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours. Remove rabbit and dry with paper towels. Coat the rabbit with seasoned flour. Heat oil in large frypan over medium heat. Brown to taste then return marinade to frypan. Simmer to tender. Add enough flour to thicken marinade. Serve.

title: Cream Cheese Cupcakes
instructions: In large bowl sift together flour sugar cocoa baking soda and salt. Add oil water vinegar and vanilla; beat well. Fill cupcake liners half full. Make topping. Soften cream cheese. Cream in small bowl. Add egg sugar and salt. Beat well. Stir in chocolate chips. Put about 1 tablespoon of topping on each cupcake. Use all of topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Makes 18 cupcakes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together the flour baking powder and salt. Cream together the butter and sugar then beat in eggs vanilla extract and milk. Stir in the flour mixture then gradually add enough of the remaining flour to make the dough stiff enough to roll. Form the dough into balls. Chill at least 1 hour. Place the dough on floured surface; roll out 1/8 inch thick. Cut with cookie cutters and place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan bean dip avocados mixed with garlic and Tabasco sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning (mixed) then top with remaining ingredients. Serve with chips.

title: Crispy Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Do not peel cucumbers. Slice thin. Add onions peppers garlic and salt. Cover with ice. Mix thoroughly. Let stand 3 hours. Drain.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Let butter and grated cheese stand at room temperature for about an hour before mixing with remainder of ingredients into a stiff dough. You may use a cookie press or make small balls and flatten to form wafers. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Happiness Recipe
instructions: Sprinkle generously with kindness. Add plenty faith and mix well. Spread over a lifetime. Serve to everyone you meet.

title: Peanut Pretzel Bars
instructions: Mix cereal and pretzel sticks. Spread in 10 x 15-inch pan that has been buttered. Put sugar Karo syrup and peanut butter in pan. Bring to a full boil stirring constantly. Stir in peanuts and vanilla. Pour over cereal; spread evenly and press down firmly. Melt chips together and frost. Chill and then cut into squares.

title: Strawberry Salad Cake
instructions: Make both packages of vanilla pudding according to package directions. Let cool slightly. Wash and hull strawberries. Slice and allow to sit in a sugar mixture. Let Cool Whip thaw.

title: Berry Cobbler
instructions: Toss together berries and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside. In another bowl combine 1 cup sugar flour baking powder and salt. Add milk. Mix just until batter is smooth. Melt butter; pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Spoon berries over melted butter. Pour batter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with cream.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook a 4 1/2 pound chicken in 3 cups hot salted water. After chicken is cooked cut it off the bones. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in saucepan. Add flour. Stir in 2 1/2 cups reserved broth and cook sauce stirring until slightly thickened. Add cream and pour over prepared chicken. Refrigerate overnight or all day.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix 2 packages of beef with the onion cream cheese Worcestershire sauce and Accent. Form into a ball. Roll in the remaining beef and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Mushroom Turnovers
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter with the onion until limp. Add salt pepper nutmeg and lemon juice. Blend in flour until smooth and slightly thickened. Stir in sour cream and dill weed. Cool filling. Place small amount of filling (scant teaspoon) on one side of 2-inch pastry round. Fold over and crimp edges with fork tines. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. These freeze well before baking.

title: Blender Hot Sauce
instructions: Blend tomatoes garlic peppers and salt. Add the onion and chop but not fine. Add vinegar. Best to start with smaller amount of peppers and add to taste. Pour all in saucepan and simmer 15 minutes. Pour in sterile jars and seal. Give boiling water bath for 5 minutes. Refrigerate after opening.

title: Eggplant And Feta Salad
instructions: Set the oven at 350\u00b0. Pile the eggplant squash zucchini pepper and onion in a large roasting pan and sprinkle them with oil. Turn the vegetables in the oil so they are coated. Bake the vegetables tossing them a couple of times during the cooking for 40 minutes or until tender.

title: Chicken Saute With Cranberry Vinegar
instructions: In oven proof skillet heat oil and lightly brown all the chicken. Cover and bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Place chicken on platter. Keep warm. Saute shallots in same pan. Deglaze pan with vinegar whisk in cranberry jelly and butter. Serve over chicken.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and freeze.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Mix lightly but well. Sift together flour baking powder soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to egg mixture. Stir in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes two 9 x 5 x 2-inch loaves.

title: B. L. T. Surprise Salad
instructions: Combine potatoes bacon tomatoes sandwich spread celery and green onion. Mix lightly. Season to taste. Chill. Serve in lettuce lined bowl. Garnish with bacon.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening sugars vanilla water and eggs until light and fluffy. Mix flour with soda and salt; blend into shortening mixture. Stir in nuts and chips. Drop 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl at medium speed cream the butter with 1/4 cup sugar. Beat in flour to form a soft dough. Press dough evenly on bottom of casserole and 1/2 inch up sides. Bake until brown about 15 minutes; let cool. Spread pineapple over crust. Add remaining 1/2 cup sugar to egg. Add melted butter vanilla and coconut. Spread mixture over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown. When cool cut into squares.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand several hours in refrigerator.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake(Bars)
instructions: With mixer beat sugar. Add the margarine. Beat in one egg at a time. Add milk. Crumble and add wafers. Chop nuts and add to mixture. Add coconut. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0. Should brown lightly on top.

title: Pork And Pepper Goulash
instructions: Cut pork into 3/4 to 1-inch cubes. Heat bacon in heavy skillet. Cook until crisp. Add onion. Saute for 2 minutes until onion is wilted. Add pork cubes to pan along with green and red peppers tomato paprika garlic caraway seed and salt. Cook stirring over high heat for 5 minutes. Turn heat down to low; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile stir cornstarch and broth together until smooth. Pour mixture into pan with meat and peppers. Heat to boiling; stir and cook until juices are thickened.

title: Broccoli And Cheese
instructions: Boil broccoli in water until tender and crisp. Drain and put in greased casserole dish. Add 1/3 stick butter. Mix. Add 1/2 pound Velveeta and mix. Toss Ritz crackers with 1/3 stick melted butter. Sprinkle on broccoli. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spicy Plantation Chicken
instructions: Combine egg buttermilk and 1 tablespoon of oil. Sift together the flour curry powder salt and pepper. Blend flour mixture into the buttermilk mixture; beat until smooth. Dip chicken pieces into batter; drain. Cook batter chicken in deep 350\u00b0 oil for about 12 minutes or until chicken is done. Fried chicken recipe serves 4 to 6.

title: Kaga
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix all except butter. Melt butter in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan while oven is preheating. Mix ingredients; pour over melted butter. Do not stir! Bake 20 minutes. Dont look; let set 5 minutes to set.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Scald 1 1/2 cups milk in top of double boiler. Combine sugar flour salt and cornstarch. Stir in remaining milk and egg yolks. Stir this flour mixture into hot milk. Cook until thick. Remove from heat; add butter vanilla and 3/4 cup coconut. Allow mixture to cool. Pour into pie shell; cover with remaining coconut and meringue. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until meringue browns lightly.

title: Sunday Hot Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the warm water. Then add the other ingredients beating as you add. Gradually add flour until dough is soft and not too stiff. Let stand 6 hours or overnight. Knead for 5 minutes and divide in 4 parts. Roll out like pie crust; cut in 8 pieces. Roll big end to small end. Put in greased pan and let rise in warm place until after church on Sunday morning or 4 to 5 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Before baking add a dot of butter to each roll.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
instructions: Combine cooking oil and sugar. Add egg yolks; beat well. Add hot water then dry ingredients. Stir in potatoes and nuts. Then fold in beaten egg whites. Put in 3 layers and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli celery onion bacon raisins and mandarin oranges in salad bowl. Blend mayonnaise vinegar and sugar in small bowl. Add to broccoli mixture; mix until coated. Top with almonds. Chill until serving time.

title: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Put in blender. Process until smooth. Keeps sometime in fridge.

title: Baked Beef Roast
instructions: Place roast in pan. Spread the celery soup over roast. Sprinkle onion soup over the roast. Spoon the water over the top and sides. Bake 3 to 4 hours at 350\u00b0. During the last hour of baking time put potatoes and carrots around roast to bake.

title: Cucumber And Onion Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill. This makes a lot. You can half the recipe if you like.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Bring squash pepper onion and water to a boil in medium saucepan. Cook until slightly tender; drain. Add drained pimentos. Melt the butter in double boiler. Add flour and stir until well blended. Slowly add with squash mixture. Spread cracker crumbs and grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boll sugar cocoa butter and vanilla for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in oats and peanut butter. Drop into waxed paper.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Pack the beans into 4 pint jars. Add the salt dill seed garlic and red pepper to the beans in the jars. Bring the vinegar and water to a boil. Pour into jars and seal. Process 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Cube Steak Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Brown cube steak on both sides then put into a crock-pot. Then add the mushroom soup. Cook on high for 1 hour then on low until meat is done. Great with biscuits rice or cream potatoes.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium heat cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Over low heat shake pan to dry potatoes. With a table knife chop potatoes until almost mashed. Place potatoes in a heavily buttered 8-inch skillet. Pat down top evenly; dot with butter or margarine and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover; cook over low heat until bottom is browned. (Lift gently with spatula to check.) To serve invert onto plate so browned side is up.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil pasta. Drain. Do not rinse. Add oil lemon juice and seasonings. Mix well. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Add mayonnaise bell pepper onion celery olives and pimientos. Mix well. Serves 12. Can do ahead.

title: Sausage Dressing
instructions: Cook sausage. When done remove sausage and add onions and celery in drippings and cook until done.

title: Hamburger Pie(Grandma Hazel)
instructions: In a skillet fry ground chuck and onion. Drain fat. Add tomato sauce and corn. Heat on low just until heated thoroughly. Place in a 10-inch pie plate. Add mashed potatoes then top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Add French fried onions and return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar oil and eggs. Gradually add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over berries. Chop margarine up over berries. Mix flour sugar milk and vanilla well. Pour over berries. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes.

title: Great Grandmother'S Hoe-Downs(Sugar Cookies)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs sour milk and lemon extract; beat after each addition. Sift soda baking powder nutmeg and flour together. Chill dough 30 minutes. Flour hands. Roll a portion of dough (small egg size). Dip or roll in a bowl of sugar. Flatten with two fingers. Place 2 or 3 raisins in center. Bake until light brown.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream 1 stick butter and shortening; add sugar and beat well. Add egg one at a time alternating with flour soda and buttermilk. Add vanilla coconut and 1 cup of pecans. Bake in 3 prepared 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Easy Monkey Bread
instructions: Separate biscuits and cut each into quarters. In a small bowl mix 1/2 cup sugar with cinnamon and nuts. Drop in cut biscuits and roll to cover.

title: Red Fruit Punch(Usa)
instructions: Mix together sugar and juices. Cover and chill until flavors are well blended. Just before serving add the carbonated beverage or ginger ale. Serves 10.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix and cook about 20 to 25 minutes in well-greased iron skillet (9-inch or larger).

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine and mix well. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Makes 2 large or 3 small loaves.

title: Molded Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve lime gelatin in hot water. Add pineapple juice and marshmallows. Whip until marshmallows are dissolved. Let cool until partially set. Then add pineapple celery nuts cream cheese and whipped cream. Pour into mold and let set.

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: In a quart Ziploc bag pour the half and half milk sugar and vanilla. Seal bag. In a gallon Ziploc bag add 2 tablespoons rock salt or ice cream salt. Fill bag full of ice. Place quart bag in gallon bag. Turn end over end until the ice cream sets; takes about 15 minutes. It will look like snow cream when ready.

title: Broccoli And Cheddar Soup
instructions: In large saucepan cook broccoli until soft; drain. In small pan saute onion in margarine. Add cornstarch and slowly add broth and cream. Stir and cook until thickens. Add salt nutmeg and broccoli. Just before serving stir in cheese.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots until done. Drain. Add the other ingredients and top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Rice Krispies Delite(Fast And Easy)
instructions: Bring Karo and sugar to a boil and remove from heat. Add peanut butter and stir. Pour mixture over Rice Krispies and mix thoroughly. Place in greased 11 x 14-inch pan. Pat down flat with wax paper. Melt chips together. Microwave 3 minutes. Stir and spread over Rice Krispies. Cool for 1 hour. Cut into squares.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix instant pudding according to box. Add Cool Whip and cream cheese. Crush Oreos. Place layers of Oreos pudding Oreos and pudding mixture. Finish with cookies on top.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip. Put in 8 x 12-inch Pyrex dish. Put nuts on top. Refrigerate overnight or longer. Cut in squares to serve. Do not cover in refrigerator. (I usually put this in a bowl.)

title: Creamy Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in Pam-sprayed pan. Put small pieces of chipped beef over chicken. Mix sour cream and mushroom soup and pour over chicken. Crumble bacon and sprinkle on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours uncovered.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together and bake for 35 minutes. As an option top with cornflakes and drizzle with butter.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat together well the first 5 ingredients. Sift together the dry ingredients. Add them to the liquid mixture. Stir in raisins nuts and water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes.

title: Party Beans
instructions: In a large Dutch oven brown beef over medium heat. Drain fat. Add onion and celery; cook until tender. Stir in soup ketchup and tomato. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Spoon into a large kettle or roaster. Add all remaining ingredients; stir well. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 25.

title: Hot Peppers In Tomato Sauce
instructions: Boil all ingredients except peppers for 10 minutes. Cut peppers in rings and put in sauce. Bring to a boil again. Pack in hot jars. Seal.

title: Poor Man'S Ambrosia
instructions: Peel and grate apples. Add pineapple orange juice 1 can of water and flavoring to apples. Mix well. Let stand for several hours before serving. Keeps well in refrigerator several days. (May add a little sugar or Sweet N Low.)

title: Pumpkin Delight
instructions: Take out 1 cup dry cake mix. Put aside. Combine remaining mix with 1 egg and the melted margarine. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together the pumpkin eggs white and brown sugar evaporated milk and cinnamon. Spread on cake dough.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Boil the chicken for about 20 minutes. Remove and cook the rice in 2 to 3 cups of chicken broth. Place the rice soups and chicken into Pyrex dish; bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Whippersnaps Cookies
instructions: Grease cookie sheet. Combine cake mix Cool Whip and egg. Stir well. Drop by teaspoon into sugar. Coat. Place about 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 or 15 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Cinnamon Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Mix cake mix 3/4 oil 4 eggs sugar sour cream and flavoring. In separate bowl mix 2 Tbsp. cake mix brown sugar and ground cinnamon. After mixing well add pecans. In greased cake pan begin layering batter and cinnamon and mix beginning with cinnamon mix and ending with it also. Bake for 50 minutes at 350 or until cake is done. Mix powdered sugar and milk to make creamy topping. Drizzle over cake while it is still warm.

title: Philly 3-Step Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar vanilla and 2 eggs; pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Spread with one 21 ounce can of cherry pie filling. Makes 8 servings.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown lean hamburger and sausage in large skillet. Drain off fat. Add Velveeta cheese cut in cubes. Stir until cheese melts. Add soup and salsa sauce. Serve warm with your choice of corn chips.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan using scissors cut bacon into small pieces. Cook until crisp. Remove bacon from pan; drain all but 3 tablespoons grease from pan. Add onion and saute in bacon grease until tender and brown. Add remaining ingredients. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender. Serve with bacon sprinkled over soup.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and place in baking dish. Crumble Ritz crackers on top and bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Mexican Fruitcake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add pineapple and eggs. Mix with mixer about 2 minutes. Add pecans. Bake in 9 x 13-inch loaf pan greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Susan'S Easy Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Microwave chicken covered with 1/2 bottle of sauce for 20 minutes. Add rest of sauce and bake in regular oven at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cheesy Potatoes(Microwave)
instructions: If potatoes are nice no need to peel. Slice potatoes and onions and layer in casserole. Sprinkle with a little salt if desired. Dot top with butter. Mix hot water with bouillon and pour over top. Cover and microwave on High for 17 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender stirring occasionally. Uncover sprinkle with cheese and parsley. Recover microwave 1 to 2 minutes longer.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press crescent rolls on cookie sheet and bake according to directions. Mix next 5 ingredients and spread over cooled crust. Top with veggies.

title: Appetizer Dip
instructions: Cook chickpeas approximately 6 minutes in pan of water. Drain. Blend in blender the chickpeas tahini garlic lemon juice and olive oil until smooth. Little water may be added to thin slightly.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Defrost spinach and squeeze dry. Chop. Place room temperature cheeses in a mixing bowl. Add spinach and stir until blended.

title: Sponge Gingerbread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add molasses and egg. Sift together ginger cinnamon and flour. Blend into molasses mixture. Dissolve soda in boiling water. Add to mixture; batter will be runny. Bake in greased pan at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve cherry gelatin in boiling water. Mix in plain gelatin which has been softened in a little cold water. Stir in sugar lemon juice ground cranberries and orange. Then stir in pineapple celery and pecans. Let congeal in refrigerator overnight.\tMakes 12 servings.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add the rest of the ingredients and chill.

title: The Preacher'S Coming
instructions: Make a graham cracker crust for a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate with oleo over low heat; add sugar and mix well. Beat egg yolks and add to chocolate mixture. Stir well. Add vanilla and stir. Beat egg whites until very stiff; fold them into chocolate mixture. Add nuts if desired. Pour chocolate mixture into crust; chill in freezer until firm to touch.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients. Mix mayonnaise to desired taste. Chill before serving. (May serve on top of orange).

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients 2 to 3 hours. Add the oil oregano salt basil and sugar. Cook 1 hour then add the tomato paste. Bring to a hard boil. Remove from heat. Can or freeze. Makes 11 quarts.

title: Cut Glass Jello
instructions: Prepare orange grape and lime jello and let set. Combine 1 cup pineapple juice --finish the cup with water and add another 1/2 cup cold water and sugar. Heat until sugar is dissolved then dissolve the strawberry jello. Let set until it is thick like syrup. Then add Cool Whip crushed pineapple. Cut the 3 flavors of jello into cubes. Mix all together and put on a graham cracker crust. To make crust mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter and put in large rectangular pan. Can use sugar free jello and lite cool whip for less calories.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
instructions: Mix Bisquick and sour cream. Add melted margarine and mix well. Fill miniature greased muffin tins. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion a few minutes in oil. Combine with remaining ingredients. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients; pat firmly in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Dissolve gelatin in hot water and cool. Mix cream cheese and sugar; cream well. Add gelatin mixture. Whip Dream Whip; fold into cream cheese mixture. Pour into cooled crust. Chill 1 or 2 hours. Pour the blueberry pie filling (chilled) over top. Set approximately 1 hour before serving.

title: Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: Saute celery and onions in butter until tender. Add to cornbread and bread crumbs. Add chopped eggs; mix. Add seasonings and broth. Dressing should be extra moist. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until lightly browned on top.

title: Chewy Cake Squares
instructions: Mix batter. Grease pan. Bake exactly 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Cover with wax paper for approximately 30 minutes before cutting.

title: French Fried Cauliflower
instructions: Parboil the cauliflower 10 minutes. Cool and separate into flowerets. Dip each piece into eggs and crumbs then in eggs and crumbs again. Fry until golden brown.

title: Lemon Jello Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease tube pan generously and flour. Blend 3/4 cup water with lemon Jell-O. Empty cake mix into bowl and blend in prepared Jell-O. Afterward add oil; mix thoroughly adding eggs separately and blending well each time. Add flavorings; blend well. Remove cake from oven and invert on foil. Top with icing. Cover cake on foil until icing settles.

title: Hacienda Dip(Microwave)
instructions: Mix cream cheese salsa and salt until well blended. Put cheese mixture in microwave-safe bowl and microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes or until heated stirring every 2 minutes. Makes 2 cups. This is also good cold.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Remove seeds and membrane from peppers and rinse. Cook peppers in boiling water to cover about 5 minutes; drain. Cook ground beef and onions in 10-inch skillet; stir occasionally until beef is brown. Stir in rice salt garlic salt and 1 cup tomato sauce. Heat until hot. Stuff peppers with beef mixture and stand upright in baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Before covering pour remaining tomato sauce over stuffed peppers.) Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Sauerkraut Rice Spuds
instructions: Cover potatoes with water. Add other ingredients. Cook until potatoes and rice are soft about 50 minutes. Stir and mix well. Serve with gravy or margarine or bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hungarian Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Cook cauliflower in salted water until tender. Drain and place in a buttered baking dish. Cover with bread crumbs; season and pour sour cream over it. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crumbs are slightly brown.

title: Fretta-Like Cornbread With Broccoli
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cornbread mix; add that gradually. Place in greased 9 x 12-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Easy and good and healthful!

title: Beefy Mushroom Party Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Chop olives mushrooms and green onions (not the tops). Mix all together. Spread on crackers or party rye bread.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrot Salad(Serves 12)
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling water until crisp-tender about 5 minutes. Drain and cool. Combine carrots onion and green pepper in large serving bowl. Combine soup sugar oil vinegar Worcestershire and salt. Pour over vegetables. Stir gently to combine. Cover. Refrigerate at least 24 hours to blend flavors.

title: Turkey-Carcass Soup
instructions: Remove turkey from carcass and place in large Dutch oven; add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours or until all vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf. Very good!!

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Spread chicken in bottom of casserole dish. Mix water and chicken soup then pour over chicken. Mix milk flour and melted margarine. Pour over other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Ranch-Style Frijoles
instructions: Soak beans in cold water overnight. Drain wash and cover with about 2 inches of water. Add salt and boil over moderate heat for about 1 hour adding water if needed. Add diced onion diced garlic pepper cumin seed chopped chilies taco sauce and tomatoes. Cook over medium heat for an hour or longer until beans are tender. For spicier beans add 1 or 2 teaspoons of red chili powder.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Combine Ricotta cheese 12 ounces of Mozzarella cheese egg and garlic powder. Mix well. Combine sauce and water in a separate bowl. Spread 1/3 of sauce in bottom of a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Place 3 uncooked lasagna noodles on top. Cover with 1/2 of the cheese mixture 1/2 of the hamburger and 1/2 of the mushrooms and pepperoni.

title: Fruited Carrot Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart bowl tossing gently. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Bailey'S Irish Cream
instructions: Mix all in blender. Pour into dark bottle and refrigerate.

title: Lobster-Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes rub skins with shortening and prick with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 till done 70 to 80 minutes. Cut slice from top of each. Scoop out insides; reserve shells. Mash potatoes. Add butter salt pepper and enough milk or cream to moisten. Beat till fluffy. Stir in lobster 3/4 cup cheese and onion. Pile filling into potato shells. Bake 20 to 25 minutes longer. Sprinkle remaining cheese over tops of potatoes; bake 3 minutes more.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box.

title: Woody'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: Put ground beef pork and chicken into a large pot. Pour enough broth over the meat to cover. Put catsup and tomatoes; stir. Add Worcestershire salt and pepper to taste. Add mashed potatoes and creamed corn. Heat stir constantly so it will not stick.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Melt butter; pour into baking pan sprayed with Pam. Dump the remaining ingredients in the baking pan. Mix together. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered. This makes a large casserole.

title: Hawaiian Marshmallow Pie
instructions: Microwave marshmallows and the reserved 1/2 cup pineapple liquid in large bowl on High 2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until smooth when stirred. Refrigerate 30 minutes or until slightly thickened. Mix until well blended. Fold in pineapple and whipped topping. Pour into crust. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Garnish with pineapple chunks and cherries.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Beat eggs into creamed mixture; add flour. Fold in nuts and chocolate bits. Bake in well-greased pan at 325\u00b0 about 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with electric mixer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Beat for 10 minutes. Grease and flour Bundt cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: In 4-quart casserole dish layer in order the potatoes onion corn green beans and carrots. Mix soup with hamburger. Pour over top. Place in 350\u00b0 oven covered with lid. Bake for 1 hour. Top with grated Cheddar cheese the last few minutes so it will melt.

title: Mamma'S Cooked Salad Dressing
instructions: Cook first 7 ingredients and add margarine. Shake in some pepper and celery seed. This makes 1 quart and will keep a long time.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and gradually add sugar until all sugar is dissolved. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Mash bananas and add to the batter. Sift dry ingredients together and fold in (do not beat). Fold in finely chopped pecans. Bake in greased loaf pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Aspic
instructions: Cool and mold. Finely chopped onions pepper and celery may be added to mixture before molding.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: In a small bowl mix flour cinnamon baking soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl beat eggs well then beat in oil sugar and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture until well blended then add apples and walnuts. Spoon into 2 1/2-inch muffin tins lined with paper muffin cups. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: American Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter and add to potatoes which have been boiled and drained. Mash together. Butter large casserole dish and add 1/2 of the noodles. Spread mashed potato mixture over noodles and top with slices of cheese. Add rest of noodles and again top with cheese slices. Dot with butter; cover. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Mix all together. Chill 1 hour before serving with sliced apples.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken. Poke holes in the lemon with a fork. Insert it into the chicken. Sprinkle with paprika. Put in a roasting pan and cover with foil. Bake in oven for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove foil and bake until just brown.

title: Crunchy Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add next 5 ingredients. Chill one hour. Form into a ball and roll in nuts.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix jello according to directions on the box. Allow to partially gel. Add strawberries and Cool Whip to broken up angel food cake. Return to refrigerator for 3 hours.

title: Oven Roasted Skinny Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Halve the potatoes lengthwise. Cut halves lengthwise into long wedges about 1/3-inch wide. Spray potatoes with cooking spray. Place on cookie sheet cut side down. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons cheese and dust with paprika. Bake 15 minutes. Turn potato wedges. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and dust with additional paprika. Bake 15 minutes longer or until crisp and golden brown. Per serving 170 calories 4 grams protein 38 grams carbohydrates 1 gram fat 3% calories from fat 1 mg. cholesterol 41 mg. sodium.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken in egg whites and cornstarch. Saute chicken. Add vegetables sherry soy sauce hoisin garlic and ginger. Add snow peas cherry tomatoes bok choy and cashews. Total cooking time is about 10 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Coat 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place uncooked rice in bottom of dish and top with chicken. Combine water mushroom soup and onion soup mix stirring to blend. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken and rice are done.

title: Mock-Sou-Berag
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water until tender. Drain and rinse with cold water. Divide cheese into 2 equal portions. Mix parsley into 1 portion of cheese. Place half of noodles in buttered baking dish. Add cheese with parsley. Top with remaining noodles. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and top is browned. Cut into squares. Baking time is 55 minutes from cold oven start.

title: Salisbury Steak With Onion Gravy
instructions: In a bowl combine 1/3 cup soup with beef crumbs egg salt and pepper. Shape into 6 oval patties. Brown patties in skillet. Gradually blend remaining soup into flour until smooth. Add remaining ingredients to skillet. Stir.\tCover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Stir often.

title: Peach Cooler
instructions: Put all ingredients except ice cream into blender container. Cover and process at liquefy until smooth. Stop blender add ice cream cover and process 1 cycle at blend.

title: Luscious Lemonade
instructions: Combine sugar lemon juice and water. Stir to dissolve sugar. Serve over ice. Garnish with lemon slices. Serves 6.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix next 4 ingredients and spread over crust. Put a layer of bananas over that then a layer of pineapple. Top with Cool Whip cherries and nuts. Serve well chilled.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Grease pan and bake at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Light Fruitcake
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup brandy thawed orange juice concentrate and cranberries in a large bowl; cover and let stand 1 hour. Combine dates pecans orange rind vanilla eggs and pineapple. Add to cranberry mixture; stir well. Combine flour baking soda salt cinnamon allspice and nutmeg. Add to fruit mixture; stir well. Spoon batter into a 6-cup Bundt pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until a wooden pick comes out clean. Cool cake 20 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Melt chocolate chips over hot water. Add milk; heat until mixture is just warm. Serve over ice cream. Can be refrigerated and warmed again.

title: Oktoberfest Sauerkraut(Liz Cooked 60 Pounds For The '93 Oktoberfest)
instructions: Combine all ingredients and add a little water. Simmer for 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Quick Bread
instructions: Combine eggs sugar oil and strawberries. Beat well. Add flour soda salt and cinnamon. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until bread tests done. Cool only slightly and remove from pans.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together sugars and flour. Beat thoroughly by hand eggs milk vanilla and butter.\tFold in nuts. Pour into pastry-lined pan. Bake 37 minutes or until done.

title: Delicious Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and butter over low heat; gently stir in Rice Krispies. Press into 9-inch pie dish. Beat together pudding and cold milk then add Cool Whip and marshmallows. Pour into the pie shell and cool at least 2 hours.

title: Fried Shrimp
instructions: Combine milk egg and beer beating well. Roll shrimp in flour then in milk mixture then in flour again. Fry in hot oil until brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles until tender; drain. Pan-fry ground beef until brown and pieces separate; drain. Add Ragu sauce and mushrooms to browned ground beef. Heat until bubbling. Using 10 x 13-inch baking dish place a single layer of noodles on bottom of dish. Cover noodles with layer of beef and sauce. Place cheese slices over beef and sauce then sprinkle heavy with Parmesan cheese. Repeat each step again. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 15 minutes.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Peel and shred cool potatoes coarsely. Melt butter over low heat. Add cheese and stir until melted slightly. Fold into potatoes with remaining ingredients. Turn into casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake for about 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Veal Parmigiana
instructions: Dip veal cutlets in beaten eggs and dredge in Italian bread crumbs. Bake coated cutlets in a well greased baking dish for 35 minutes at 350 degrees. Pour spaghetti sauce over cutlets then sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for an additional 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Croutons
instructions: Toss bread cubes with butter and seasonings. Spread in a single layer in shallow pan. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven stirring occasionally until crisp and light brown about 30 to 45 minutes. After cooling store in airtight container for use in soups and on green salads. Store in refrigerator or freezer for extended storage.

title: One Pot Supper
instructions: In a large pot place cabbage on bottom and then potatoes. Add enough water to cook. Cook only until about half tender. Add sausage pieces. Cover and cook until tender. Add butter and salt and pepper to taste. Serve with cornbread.

title: Nutrition Bombs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Mixture will be stiff. Shape into balls. Roll in sesame seed coconut chopped nuts etc.

title: Dirt Cake
