instructions: Crush Oreos with filling and set aside. Cream together butter cream cheese and powdered sugar. Set aside. Blend pudding and milk. Mix cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture together then fold in Cool Whip. Layer crushed Oreos and filling. Very attractive in a trifle dish. Keep refrigerated.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Clean the spinach and tear it into bite size pieces. Put in a salad bowl. Toss with onion celery and eggs. Chill. Toss with dressing.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Chop onion and saute in butter. Cook rice and broccoli. Mix all together. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and cook for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Tortellini Soup
instructions: Bring broth to a boil. Add tortellini and cook to package directions (about 4 minutes). Add spinach and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Serve immediately in heated bowls sprinkled with Parmesan cheese. Serve with crusty bread and butter. Serves 2 or 3 as a main course or 6 as an appetizer.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Brown pepper and onions in the oleo. In large boiler first cook spaghetti in broth until about tender. Add all other ingredients. After all is cooked about 10 minutes it can be baked in a casserole dish about 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. If desired freeze to use later.

title: Exotic Fruit Compote
instructions: Drain all fruit. Arrange in alternate layers in large baking dish/casserole.

title: Fruit Fluff
instructions: Mix Cool Whip sour cream and gelatin with mixer. Fold in other ingredients. Pour into serving bowl. Chill until time to serve.

title: Peanut Butter Drops
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Roll in balls and place on waxed paper to chill. Dip in chocolate chips and wax which have been melted together.

title: Apple Cheese Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine lettuce apple cheese and sunflower seeds; toss gently. In small saucepan over medium heat heat jelly and vinegar until melted stirring frequently. Cook slightly. Pour over salad; toss to coat. Yields four 1-cup servings.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Saute onion celery and green pepper in a small amount of oil or butter. Mash squash and mix in saute vegetables. Add crumbled cornbread can of cream of chicken soup and egg. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm and brown about 35 minutes.

title: Tofu Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare crust by crushing granola in blender to make 1 1/4 cups of crumbs. Press into a 9-inch pie plate.

title: Cornflake Cookies
instructions: Cook syrup and sugar until it begins to boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter then cornflakes. Drop on wax paper from spoon.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat in cast-iron pot; drain well and return to stove. Add tomato sauce and 1 1/2 cups water; simmer. Add chili powder and all herbs. Mix well and allow to cook for about 10 minutes. Add salt and cayenne pepper to taste; allow to simmer until thick. Add sugar and cook for few minutes longer. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Add all ingredients to beaten eggs. Bake in greased quiche pan or baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool and serve in small squares or serve warm as main dish.

title: Olive Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Mix the margarine flour and Mozzarella cheese as you would a pie crust. With your fingers roll the dough around the stuffed olives. Bake at 400\u00b0 on a cookie sheet for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add sugar. Beat until stiff. Add salt and vanilla. Mix well. Add pecans and nuts. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drop by spoonfuls onto foil covered cookie sheet. Put in oven and immediately turn oven off. Leave cookies in closed oven overnight.

title: Our Lord'S Scripture Cake
instructions: Note Look up the references in the Old Testament.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Peas
instructions: Set oven to 400\u00b0. Scrub potatoes and remove eyes or bad spots. Slice paper thin (a food processor does job quickly). Oil-rub a 1-quart baking dish or 2 (1/2-quart) dishes. Layer half the potatoes onions flour and salt in the dish. Cover with all the peas and top with layers of remaining onions potatoes flour and salt (in that order).

title: Tuna Fish Pie
instructions: Melt butter add pepper and onions cook until soft. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add milk slowly stirring constantly until thick and smooth. Boil 2 minutes add remaining ingredients pour into large baking dish cover with rolls. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gobble Gobble Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix all ingredients well. Spoon mixture into loaf pan. Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sand Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar for 5 minutes. Dissolve soda in vinegar and add to margarine mixture. Add vanilla; beat in flour. Add chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Turtles
instructions: Arrange pecans in clusters of 3 or 4 halves 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Top each cluster with 1 caramel slightly flattened. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 7 minutes or until caramels soften. Remove to waxed paper.

title: Brownie Mix
instructions: In a large bowl combine first five ingredients. With a pastry blender cut in shortening until evenly distributed. Store in a large airtight container in cupboard. Keeps 10 to 12 weeks. Yield About 17 cups of mix.

title: Fruit Slush
instructions: Dissolve sugar in hot water. Cool completely. Combine remaining ingredients; pour in sugar and water mixture. Place in freezer. Stir once an hour for the first 3 hours. Freeze 24 hours. Thaw at room temperature until slushy before serving.

title: Chili Mac And Beef
instructions: Brown meat onions and pepper salt. Stir in remaining ingredients. Taste and if necessary add chili powder. Simmer about 20 minutes until macaroni is tender. Add more water if not saucy. Cook 5 minutes longer.

title: So... Easy Crock-Pot Roast Beef
instructions: Put roast in crock-pot. Sprinkle onion soup mix over roast (no water required). Cook 8 to 10 hours on medium heat. Add potatoes and veggies as you wish.

title: Sweetheart Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple with sugar. Add gelatine which has been softened in the 1/4 cup cold water. Stir until dissolved. Add lemon juice and cherry juice and set aside to cool.

title: Favorite Soft White Frosting
instructions: Mix flour and milk; heat slowly until it makes a thick paste. Cool in refrigerator. Combine remaining ingredients; beat until fluffy. Add flour paste and beat well.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil together\tingredients until mixture forms soft ball. Drop a little dab of mixture in cold water. Remove from fire and add 3 tablespoons peanut butter. Mix until it begins to thicken. Pour into butter-greased pan 9 x 13-inches. Let set until mixture is solid.

title: Upside Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread coconut evenly in bottom of pan. Sprinkle with pecans. Prepare cake mix following package directions for original recipe. Pour over coconut and pecans. Combine cream cheese and melted butter beat until creamy. Add sugar; beat until smooth. Drop by spoonfuls evenly over cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted 1/2 to bottom comes out clean. Cool completely. To serve cut into pieces and turn upside-down on plates.

title: Plantation Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter and gradually add sugar. Add syrup and evaporated milk. In a separate bowl add salt to eggs and beat until light. Stir well into first mixture. Add vanilla and pecans. Use 1 cup nuts for halves 1 1/2 cups if using broken pieces. Pour into pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Six Layer Cookies
instructions: In a 9 x 12-inch baking dish melt margarine. Add remaining ingredients in order sprinkling evenly. Do not press down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut in small bars when cooled. Do not overbake.

title: Orange Sour Cream Dip
instructions: Combine orange juice and milk in blender. Add pudding and blend on low speed 2 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Chill 2 hours. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Cheese Potato Casserole
instructions: In a large casserole dish mix potatoes sour cream onion soup mix and cheese. Also add salt and pepper in a saucepan; melt butter. After it melts crumble your Toasties in with your butter. When the Post Toasties are pretty well soaked in the butter spread over the contents already in the dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until cheese is brown.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix in crock-pot the 3 cans of soup. Add rice. Place the chicken on top of mixture. Add the diced celery. Cook for 3 hours on high or 4 hours on low.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy; beat in flour and both sugars. Blend in butter. Stir in chips and nuts; pour in pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve warm with cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Mix beans and chopped chilies. Layer in small (4 x 8-inch) dish. Mix together and layer on top of beans sour cream mayonnaise and taco mix. Mix together and add next layer of tomatoes black olives and green onions. Top with grated cheese. Serve cold or heated.

title: Chinese Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Cook oil flour salt and mushrooms in skillet. Add drained liquid plus enough water to make 1/2 cup liquid. Cook until thickened. Add lemon juice soy sauce chicken or turkey celery and green pepper; cook for 15 minutes. Spoon onto split hamburger buns. Serve hot.

title: Chile Rellenos Dip
instructions: Peel and chop tomatoes; add remaining ingredients. Add salt pepper Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces to taste. Chill and serve with Doritos.

title: Chicken Over Stuffing
instructions: Cook chicken cutlets in chicken broth for about 20 to 30 minutes or less. Put them in a butter coated casserole dish. Put Stove Top stuffing on top of chicken. Mix cream of chicken soup with milk and pour over stuffing. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake until bubbly at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes.

title: Raisin Drop Cookies
instructions: In a small pan boil the raisins in the water. Boil for 5 minutes. Cool. Stir in 1 teaspoon baking soda. Let stand.

title: Custard Sauce
instructions: In a heavy 2-quart saucepan over low heat or double boiler over hot (not boiling) water beat egg yolks sugar and salt with wire whisk. Gradually stir in milk and cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon about 25 minutes. Stir in vanilla. Serve sauce warm or cold over apple pie fruitcake cut up fruit or ice cream. Serves 12.

title: Broccoli-Onion Deluxe
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain. Cook onions in boiling salted water until tender. If frozen onions are used drain. In saucepan melt 2 tablespoons butter. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook stirring until thick and bubbly. Reduce heat and blend in cream cheese until smooth. Stir in vegetables. Place mixture in a 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt remaining butter. Toss with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese and sprinkle over casserole. Bake 20 minutes more.

title: Lady Baltimore Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar thoroughly. Add sifted dry ingredients alternatively with milk and water; beat smooth after each addition. Add extracts. Fold in egg whites. Bake in 2 waxed paper lined pans 9 inch square layer pans in moderate over (350 degrees) for 30 minutes. Put layers together with 2/3 of the recipe for Seven Minute Frosting tinted a delicate pink.

title: Johnnycake(Northern Corn Bread)
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix (be careful not to overbeat) until well blended. When batter is smooth pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Can be served warm.

title: Lemon Gooey Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 1 egg in a well greased and floured 9 inch x 13 inch pan. Combine cream cheese 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Spread over cake mixture and bake 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: One Pot Dinner
instructions: Brown beef and onion together. Drain off fat and put into crock-pot. Brown bacon; drain off fat. Add bacon and remaining ingredients to crock-pot. Stir together well. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 9 hours.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine all ingredients. Mix until smooth. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Party Fruit Punch
instructions: Be careful to keep in a moderately warm atmosphere. Do not refrigerate. Do not overbake boil or broil. Neither should you keep her in a stew. Women are tender and bruise easily so do not pinch or whip too hard. When she appears to wilt take her out to dinner. Sprinkle with equal amounts of strength and kindness. Baste often with love and affection. Garnish occasionally with flowers as this improves the flavor over the years.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan melt 1 stick of butter. Add graham cracker crumbs coconut chocolate chips butterscotch chips and condensed milk. Sprinkle with walnuts (chopped). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Mix until creamy and serve with sliced apples.

title: Crawfish Fettucini
instructions: Saute onions celery bell pepper and garlic in butter. Cover pot; stir occasionally. Add flour. Cook 10 minutes and stir. Add parsley green onions and crawfish. Cook 10 minutes. Stir. Add milk slowly then add Velveeta cheese. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Season to taste. Serve over noodles and add Parmesan.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a gallon jar; then fill to top with Worcestershire sauce. Shake well.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix salt flour baking powder and spices (such as cinnamon nutmeg and allspice). Mix honey with water and add alternately to first mixture with combined dry ingredients. Add raisins figs and nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan or angel cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Quail Pie
instructions: Cook quail until tender in enough water to cover them. Salt water to taste. Save liquid. Remove all meat from bones; place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 4 tablespoons flour in 1/2 cup cold water. Add flour paste gradually to cool quail broth stirring constantly. Cook mixture until thickened; pour over quail meat in pan. Add the drained peas. Roll out pie crust to cover top of pan. Dot with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 until crust is golden brown.

title: Frozen Worm Cups
instructions: Prepare pudding mixes according to package directions; let stand 5 minutes. Layer puddings in cups sticking 1 or 2 gummy worms in each pudding so that they look like they are coming out of the dirt. Insert wooden stick in each pop and freeze about 4 hours. To serve remove from cups and enjoy.

title: Poached Salmon
instructions: Thaw salmon if frozen. In large skillet combine water lemon juice and pepper. Bring to a boil. Add salmon. Simmer covered for 7 to 10 minutes until fish flakes easily. Remove salmon from liquid and serve. Serves 4.

title: Carrot Kugel
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat the egg yolks with sugar until light. Add the grated carrot shredded apple wine lemon juice lemon peel and potato flour. Blend well. Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form and fold them into the carrot mixture. Spoon into a well-greased 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Baked French Toast
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Diagonally cut bread into 1-inch slices and place in baking dish. Set aside. In bowl beat eggs sugar and vanilla. Stir in milk until blended. Pour mixture over bread in baking dish turning slices to coat well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In bowl combine flour brown sugar and cinnamon. Cut in butter until mixture resembles small crumbs. Turn bread slices over in baking dish. Scatter blueberries over bread and sprinkle evenly with crumb mixture. Bake 40 minutes or until golden brown. Cut into squares. Top with strawberries. Makes 8 servings.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Wash and drain blueberries. Melt butter or margarine. Add flour sugar and baking soda. Mix well. Pat 3/4 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch glass dish well-greased. Sprinkle with berries and top with rest of mixture crumbled up. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 425\u00b0 or until edges are brown.

title: Fried Cornmeal
instructions: Put hot cornmeal mush in a loaf pan; cut into slices. Put slices of mush in heated greased frying pan and fry both sides.

title: M&M Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add butter and stir. Add well beaten eggs and stir. Add M&Ms coconut pecans and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti noodles and drain. Stir butter into hot spaghetti. Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs. Form into a \crust\ in a 10-inch pie plate. Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti crust. In skillet cook hamburger onion and green pepper until vegies are tender and meat is browned. Drain. Stir undrained tomatoes tomato paste sugar oregano and garlic salt. Heat through. Turn meat into \crust.\ Bake uncovered 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake until melted.

title: Batter Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt and margarine. Add cold to lukewarm. Measure warm water into large bowl. Add yeast and stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture egg and 2 cups of flour; beat until smooth. Stir in remaining flour to make a soft dough. Cover and let rise in a warm place free from drafts until doubled in bulk (about 15 to 20 minutes). Punch down and shape into rolls.

title: Thick Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the fruit and use the juice instead of milk to cook the pudding using 4 1/2 cups of juice. Add orange juice if you dont have enough from the fruit. Cook until thick. Cool completely. Add all of the fruit except the bananas which you will add when you serve. Keep in refrigerator. This is enough for a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: My Vegetable Sandwich(Ideal For Picnic)
instructions: Use 1 cup of stir-fry vegetables. Heat until soft then add flour cornstarch or leftover cream potatoes (your choice). Add chopped onion to vegetables. Salt and pepper. Serve as open-faced sandwich or closed sandwich using 2 slices of your favorite bread.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Whisk together 1 cup sugar flour salt and baking powder. Add milk. Whisk. Melt 1 stick of butter in bottom of cake pan. Pour batter over butter. Pour fruit over batter. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over fruit. Bake for 1 hour or until golden at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine well and refrigerate. Serve with raw vegetables or bread chunks.

title: Asparagus Almond Casserole
instructions: Combine asparagus with soup eggs and almonds. Season with a little red pepper and paprika. Mix well. Place in buttered casserole. Spread cheese over top. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineanna Nut Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 3 round cake pans 9 x 1 1/2-inches. Mix flour sugar baking soda salt and cinnamon in large bowl. Add oil and eggs. Stir until all dry ingredients are moistened; do not beat. Stir in bananas 1 cup pecans the vanilla and pineapple. Divide batter evenly among pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely on wire racks. Fill layer and frost side and top of cake with cream cheese frosting. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of pecans on top of cake. Cut cake using sharp knife. Refrigerate any remaining cake.

title: Applesauce Cupcakes
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs applesauce flour and floured fruit. Bake in paper baking cups.

title: Lime Pickles
instructions: Wash and cut cucumbers in 1/4-inch sliess. Soak in water and lime 8 to 10 hours. Wash several times to get lime out. Put cucumbers in solution made with rest of ingredients. Let stand 3 hours. Boil in same solution for 30 minutes. Put in clean hot jars and seal. Makes 7 or 8 quarts.

title: Sweet Potato Rolls
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes and 3 tablespoons melted butter. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water then add to potato mixture. Add egg salt and sugar; blend together. Sift flour and measure; add 4 cups alternately with 3/4 cup warm water to potato mixture. Turn onto well floured (using the other cup of flour) board and knead. Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; let rise for 2 hours or double in bulk. Place on board; roll to desired thickness and cut in shapes desired. Place on greased cookie sheet; brush tops with butter and allow to rise for 1 hour. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar cornstarch and 7-Up cola until thick. Add coloring; cool. Fold in strawberries and pour in pie shell. Refrigerate and garnish with whipped topping.

title: Favorite Cheesy Grill
instructions: Top 1 bread slice with processed cheese and second slice of bread. Spread sandwich with margarine. Cook in skillet on medium heat until lightly browned on both sides. Makes 1 sandwich.

title: Harvest Potatoes With Herbs
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. In small bowl combine seasonings. Place 2 tablespoons melted oleo in 10-inch nonstick skillet. Arrange a third of the potato slices in a circular pattern in skillet. Sprinkle with about 1/4 teaspoon seasonings 4 teaspoons melted oleo and 2 tablespoons onion. Repeat layers twice. Cover tightly with foil; press layers down. Bake 20 minutes. Uncover; bake 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove from oven; press layers down with a spatula. Let stand 10 minutes. Invert onto serving platter to unmold potatoes.

title: Apple Surprise
instructions: Place pie filling in a 9 x 13 inch cake pan. Sprinkle lemon juice over the pie filling with. Add one part of the cinnamon over the mixture. Cover filling with dry cake mix do not stir. Sprinkle with the remaining cinnamon. Drizzle melted butter over the cake mix. Spread nuts over top of cake. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes until topping is bubbly.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Bring 8 cups of water to boil. Add pasta. Reduce heat. Cook in gently boiling water for 8-10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Return to pot. Cut pepperoni in half and add to pasta. Stir in pizza sauce and 3/4 cups mozzarella cheese. Transfer to a baking dish. Top with remaining mozzarella cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pound Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Add add oil vanilla and sweet potatoes and mix well. Add eggs one at a time mixing well each time. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put half in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Put half of the can of pie filling on batter then add more batter then rest of filling layering it. Take a knife and cut through and swirl around. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can drizzle frosting on it but is delicious as it is.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Mix the first six ingredients. Place cut up vegetables in 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Pour sauce over vegetables and mix. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients in airtight container. Shake contents of container before mixing 3 heaping teaspoonfuls with boiling water in a mug. Stir thoroughly.

title: Frozen Dessert
instructions: Divide cake into 3 sections. Break into pieces about large marshmallow size. Place in tube pan 1/3 of cake with dry orange jello. Place oranges on top then spread 1/3 of ice cream over all. Mix 1/3 of cake pieces with dry lime jello then add to pan. Cover with blueberries followed by 1/3 of ice cream. Mix last 1/3 of cake with dry strawberry jello and add to pan followed by strawberries and last of ice cream. Freeze at least 3 days.

title: Pickled Mixed Vegetables
instructions: Heat vinegar mixture to boiling point. Remove from heat and let cool. Prepare any combination of vegetables suggested above. Slice thin peppers carrots garlic half onions and cut in 1/4-inch strips. Separate cauliflower into small flowerets. Rinse beets. Drain mushrooms (4 quarts in a gallon jar). Pour vinegar mixture over vegetables and keep refrigerated. Will keep several months.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Prepare the meatballs by combining the beef egg bread crumbs and onion; mix well. Form into balls about 1 1/2-inches in diameter rolling them around in your hands to make them round. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and brown the meatballs on all sides. Pour in the red wine and cook over low heat for about 10 minutes. Add the tomatoes (including juice) and basil; simmer for about 25 minutes.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Drop by spoonfuls onto mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sweet Potato Oven Fries
instructions: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges lengthwise. Spray them lightly with the cooking oil spray. Add the salt and pepper. Bake them at 450\u00b0 until crispy on the outside and tender on the inside about 25 minutes. Turn them halfway through the cooking time.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes and onions thin and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix mushroom soup with milk. Pour over potatoes and onion. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix 3 1/2 cups milk with vanilla and banana instant pudding. Add box of sour cream and 3/4 of Cool Whip. Mix well. Layer in dish with vanilla wafers and bananas. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese 1 to 2 minutes with electric mixer until creamy. Blend in remaining ingredients. Spread mixture in 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle top with paprika. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Then spread or dip any of your favorites.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream margarine. Add sugar slowly; add eggs one at a time. Sift spices salt and flour. Add coffee and applesauce. Stir in raisins nuts and coconut. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish combine soups; lay chicken on top of soup. Mix stuffing mixes with chicken broth until moist. Pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sunday Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix rice soups and vegetables together. Season to taste. Pour into a 9 x 13 casserole. Wash chicken dry and season. Melt margarine in skillet. Coat chicken on both sides. Put chicken on top of the rice. Pour a small amount of chicken broth or water around the edges of the casserole about 1/4 cup. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours uncovered. Freezes well.

title: Chili Rellenos Bake
instructions: Combine cheeses; spread half on bottom of 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Split open chiles. Place over cheese; top with remaining cheese. Gradually add milk to flour. Blend well; add eggs. Pour over casserole; cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool 10 minutes; cut into squares.

title: Swiss Steak(Serving 200)
instructions: Mix flour 2 tablespoons salt 1 tablespoon pepper and 2 tablespoons seasoned salt until well blended. Coat steaks with flour mixture. Brown lightly in hot oil. Transfer to steam table pans.

title: Spaghetti Bolog'Nase
instructions: Saut mushrooms carrot onions and green pepper in oil. Add sausage and cook until sausage is done. Drain well. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 40 minutes (or longer).

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased 6 x 10-inch baking dish. Mix flour sugar baking powder salt and egg with fork until well mixed and crumbly. Place this mixture over top of sliced apples. Pour over all the melted butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon. The secret to this recipe is the egg in the crumb mixture. Be sure its well mixed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: 7 Minute Microwave Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and microwave on High for 7 minutes. Put in refrigerator to crisp and store.

title: Ground Beef Grand Style
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions in skillet stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Combine cream cheese soup milk catsup and salt in bowl; mix well. Add to ground beef; mix well. Spoon into 2-quart baking dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Arrange biscuits around edge of casserole. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until biscuits are golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Asparagus Lasagne Bianco
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain and cut in half crosswise. In saucepan cook garlic and thyme in butter. Blend in flour. Cook stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Stir in milk; cook until thickened. Season sauce with salt and pepper. In buttered 2-quart baking dish layer 1/3 of noodles sauce cheese ham and asparagus. Repeat layers twice. Cover and cook on high for 9 to 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat cake flour cocoa oil buttermilk and 1 teaspoon vanilla in one bowl. Set aside then beat 2 eggs until foamy. Gradually add sugar. Put both mixtures together. Pour in cake pans that have wax paper on bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or 40 minutes. Cool then take cake out. Peel wax paper off. Use no-bake white icing on this cake.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Skin and bone chicken breasts. Mix next 3 ingredients. Lay chicken in greased baking tray. Pour mixture over and bake covered tray for 1 hour. Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Hamburger Subs
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add cheese 1/2 stick of margarine and 1/2 package of dressing mix. Split the sub rolls across and scoop out the inside of the cut rolls. Cut the pieces of bread that were scooped out into small pieces and add this to the hamburger mixture. Stuff the rolls with the mixture and put on a baking pan. Melt the other 1/2 stick of margarine and add to the rest of the Ranch dressing mix. Pour this over the rolls and bake until light brown.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix in a large bowl; serve with dressing of your choice.

title: Carrot Salad(Serves 45 People)
instructions: Put all together in glass bowl. Mix well; chill and serve. This will serve 45 people.

title: Drop Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. Add flour and nutmeg together. Mash potatoes until smooth. Add milk and flour alternately. Add margarine; beat until smooth. Drop by tablespoonfuls on a greased cookie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: In a large skillet cook sausage on medium to medium low. Add ground chuck. Add salt pepper onion powder garlic powder fennel seeds sugar basil and 1/8 c. parsley flakes. Keep turning the meat continuously. Turn range to low heat. Add cans of tomatoes and tomato paste. Let it come to a low boil (bubbles). Turn to simmer and cover with a lid. Let it cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Check every 15 minutes.

title: Orange Pineapple Punch(Make 1 Day In Advance)
instructions: In a 6-quart container combine first 7 ingredients. Place punch in covered container and freeze. Remove to partially thaw. Break into chunks; add ginger ale and cherries. Stir until slushy. Makes 27 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl.

title: Mason Jar Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in quart jar and shake well. A clove of garlic kept in the jar adds to the flavor. Refrigerate.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix 2 packages (regular size) vanilla instant pudding with 3 1/2 cups milk (set aside). Cream the cream cheese powdered sugar and butter together. Mix all mixtures together in \large\ bowl with Cool Whip. Crush Oreos. Layer Oreos and mixture in a flowerpot starting with Oreos and ending with Oreos on top for \dirt.\ Stick artificial flowers in pot and serve with small dirt spade.

title: Pickled Garden Relish
instructions: Combine the vinegar oil and seasonings in a large saucepan stirring to dissolve sugar. Add all other ingredients; toss to coat. Bring to a boil on high heat; reduce to low and simmer covered for 10 to 20 minutes or until cauliflower is crunchy but cooked. Cool then refrigerate a day before serving stirring several times to marinate all ingredients equally. Drain just before serving. (Serve cold.)

title: Sherry Pound Cake
instructions: Mix and beat together until smooth and creamy. Bake in Bundt pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Flour Tortillas
instructions: Place filling in tortillas. Roll up and place in baking dish seam side down. Bring to boil the sugar butter water and flavoring. Pour boiling mixture over tortillas and soak for 40 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ghost Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars peanut butter margarine shortening and egg in a large bowl. Stir in flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Cover and refrigerate about 3 hours or until chilled.

title: Great Pork Chops
instructions: Trim off any excess fat from chops. Beat eggs with a little milk and place in pie tin. Grind crumbs or crush fine. In 9 x 13-inch pan sprinkle a light layer of garlic salt or powder. Dip chops in egg (both sides) and dip in crumbs (both sides); layer evenly over bottom of the pan. Top each chop with a tablespoon of undiluted soup. Add 1 cup milk around edges of pan. Cover with foil to seal. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Night Before Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil and drain potatoes. Whip hot potatoes adding cream cheese and sour cream. Whip until fluffy and smooth. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place into a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Dot generously with butter and sprinkle with seasoned salt. Cover with foil and refrigerate. Potatoes could be frozen at this stage and thawed before baking. Bake covered with foil 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Uncover and continue baking for 20 minutes more.

title: Sweet Onion Corn Bread
instructions: Cook onion in butter until tender and clear. Prepare mix according to package directions. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with cooked onion. Mix sour cream and cheese; spoon over the top. Bake in hot (400\u00b0) oven for 25 minutes or until done. Let stand a few minutes before cutting.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion over medium heat until browned. Drain on paper towels. Discard pan drippings. Add tomatoes water bouillon cubes salt pepper bay leaf celery and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add mixed vegetables noodles and thyme. Bring to a boil. Simmer uncovered about 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grandma Dyer'S Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes. Mash potatoes with milk and mayonnaise to taste. Add sweet pickles and chopped onion. Slice boiled eggs and put on top of potato salad. Salt pepper and paprika to taste. Serve warm.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix together and roll out between 2 pieces of wax paper. Yield 2 crusts.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into small balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Italian Fried Cheese
instructions: Dip cheese in eggs and coat with bread crumbs. Deep fry in 350\u00b0 vegetable oil for 1 to 2 minutes or until brown.

title: Baked Fudge Pudding
instructions: Put margarine and cocoa in saucepan and melt over low heat. Cool slightly. Add sugar flour eggs and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer until creamy. Add nuts; stir thoroughly. Pour mixture into a greased 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Torte
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and press into an 8 x 10-inch pan.

title: Hawaiian Yum Yum
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients. Prepare 1 box of wild rice according to directions and add to mixture. Mix well. Put in a 12 x 12-inch Corning Ware dish. Sprinkle with paprika and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Happy Apples
instructions: Slice the apples. Spread peanut butter over. Make happy faces with raisins.

title: Chicken Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well. Roll into ball. Roll in chopped nuts. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Potluck Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain whole kernel corn cooked cauliflower cooked broccoli and mushrooms. Cut up large pieces of cauliflower. Combine cream-style corn cheese and soup. Fold in drained vegetables. Turn into a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Melt butter. Toss with crumbs. Sprinkle atop mixture. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven 30 to 35 minutes or until hot. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Quick Chicken Lunch
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in a 6 x 11-inch Pyrex. Layer mixture with Doritos on top. Cover with grated cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: West Virginia Cookies
instructions: Combine eggs sugar pitted dates and margarine in skillet over low heat. Stir constantly until mixture forms thick paste. Remove from heat. Add vanilla Rice Krispies and nuts. Roll into balls and then into coconut. Makes 50 to 60 pieces.

title: Langostinos And Pear Salad(Yield: 4 Servings)
instructions: 1. Shred 1 small head lettuce to make a good layer in bottom of a 9 x 11-inch dish.

title: Puppy Chow(Snack Food)
instructions: Mix together cereal nuts and raisins. Melt together chocolate chips margarine and peanut butter. Add vanilla. Pour mixture over cereal and nuts. Mix well. Pour powdered sugar into large clean plastic garbage bag; pour mixture into bag and shake. Serves 2 to 3 teenagers!

title: Iowa Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix together thoroughly all ingredients; chill overnight. Flour hands and shape mixture into roll; wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Refrigerate or can be frozen.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
instructions: Cut meat into bite-size pieces. Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Mix cream of chicken soup and sour cream together spread on top of meat. Mix crackers melted butter and poppy seed together and put on top of sour cream/soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Apple French Toast
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with vegetable oil spray. Slice bread into 1 1/2-inch slices. Place bread tightly together in one layer in pan.

title: Rice With Beans And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix rice beans garlic onion and chilies. Layer this mixture alternately in a greased casserole with Jack and Ricotta cheese ending with rice mixture. Bake for 30 minutes. During last few minutes of baking sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese over top. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cranberry Freeze
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend at low speed. Add more cranberry juice if necessary

title: Chicken Mandarin
instructions: Wash and dry chicken pieces. Shake in a paper bag with flour to coat. In a skillet heat oil and margarine. Add chicken and brown each piece. Drain mandarin oranges and set aside. Mix juice from the can with the lemon juice orange juice honey soy sauce and ginger. Pour sauce over the chicken in skillet. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until tender. Add mandarin orange sections for 5 to 10 minutes before chicken is done. Serve with rice. Serves 4.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. To serve stir in 2 teaspoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Crispy Chocolate Bars
instructions: Combine chocolate and butterscotch morsels and peanut butter in\ta large pan. Stir over low heat until smooth. Add Rice Krispies or corn flakes. Stir until well coated. Spread mixture into a long baking dish. Chill until firm. Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes before cutting into bars.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
instructions: Grease 9 x 13 pan. Use 1 can of rolls on bottom. Dont separate or press into pan. Mix cheese vanilla sugar and egg yolk. Spread on rolls. Place second can of rolls on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Boil medium potato peel and mash. Put in with powdered sugar and cornstarch. Add vanilla. Mix well. Add enough milk to make it like dough. Put a little cornstarch on table and roll and spread lightly with peanut butter. Cut into pieces.

title: Crock-Pot Camp-Out Chili Dogs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and rolls in a crock-pot. Stir well. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 10 hours (on high for 2 to 3 hours). Add cheese just before serving and allow to melt slightly. Serve each frankfurter in a roll and spoon sauce over top. Makes 6 to 8 servings (about 2 quarts).

title: Oriental Roast Pork
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pork. Place meat in plastic bag big enough to hold it and place in bowl. Pour marinade in bag. Refrigerate at least 4 hours overnight is fine. Occasionally move the bag around so marinade reaches all portions of the meat.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cut slice from top of bread loaf remove center leaving 1-inch shell. Cut removed bread into bite size pieces.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Mix water and sugar in blender; set aside. Add butter and milk. Blend at high speed until mixed well. Store in Tupperware.

title: Million Dollar Relish
instructions: Ingredients are put through a food chopper and measured when chopped.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Mix mustard and jelly in saucepan over low heat. Add cocktail wieners to sauce and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Dagwood Sandwiches
instructions: Spread out bread on table. Spread mustard or Miracle Whip. Layer 1 slice of each on bread putting lettuce pickles and tomatoes in between the slices. Put top slice of bread on. Slice in half. Makes 6 sandwiches.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Add soda to molasses and let stand for a few minutes. Add milk egg and butter. Add sifted dry ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 8-inch square greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve with cheese slices or whipped cream.

title: Halushki
instructions: Mix all together making a slightly thickened paste. Place mix on a dish and scrape off in about nickel-sized amounts into boiling water. Stir occasionally.

title: Fresh Apple Or Pear Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil vanilla eggs lemon juice and salt in a mixing bowl. Beat well. Mix flour and soda; add to first mixture and beat well again. Add apples and pecans. Mix well. Grease and dust Bundt pan with flour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sour Milk Biscuits
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add Crisco. Mix until crumbly. Add milk. Mix. Place on a lightly floured board and knead lightly. Cut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cranberry Almond Biscotti
instructions: In a small bowl plump cranberries in apple juice. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cover baking sheet with parchment or buttered wax paper; set aside. In food processor grind 3/4 cup of the almonds to a fine powder. Scrape ground nuts into a large bowl. Add flour sugar cinnamon baking powder soda remaining 3/4 cup whole almonds and cranberries. Mix to blend. Pour in honey and water. Mix until ingredients form a stiff dough. Divide dough into 2 parts. Roll each piece into a 12-inch log. Place dough logs on prepared sheet.

title: 3 Layer Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ground beef with bread crumbs. Roll into meatballs and brown in skillet. Brown sausage too. Slice meatballs and sausage. Boil noodles about 15 to 20 minutes. Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with sauce. Layer noodles on top of sauce. Spread Ricotta cheese over noodles. Spread meatballs and sausage over cheese. Pour more sauce over meats. Put sliced Mozzarella cheese over sauce. Repeat process until pan is full. Top with noodles Mozzarella cheese then sauce. Bake 45 minutes. Let cool for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Nut Caramels
instructions: Blend sugar corn syrup and salt with wooden spoon. Boil for at least 10 minutes stirring well. Add butter. Slowly stir in evaporated milk and continue stirring. Do this at medium heat (it may bubble and pop you may have to remove it from heat until you finish adding all the milk). Stir constantly and cook until a firm ball forms in cold water 245\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Use electric mixer to beat for a couple of minutes. Add nuts and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool completely. Cut into squares. Wrap individually. Yield 120 to 140 caramels about 3 pounds.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; heat to boiling. Add one tablespoon butter; salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Sourdough Bread Or Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Take 1 cup of starter from a friend. Add 1/2 cup sugar potato flakes and 1 cup hot water. Leave out 8 to 12 hours. Take 1 cup of starter that has been out (put other back in refrigerator for 3 to 5 days). Add 1/2 cup of sugar vegetable oil salt and 1 1/2 cups hot water. Mix and gradually add bread flour. Make dough; let rise 8 to 12 hours. Make into loaves or rolls. (Press flat and sprinkle with sugar cinnamon and chips of butter. Roll up and cut.) Let rise 8 to 12 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix crumbs and margarine together and form into crust in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar margarine and eggs together for at least 15 minutes. Smooth mixture over crust. Cut bananas lengthwise and place on mixture. Drain pineapple and pour over bananas. Top with Cool Whip nuts and cherries. Chill. When firm cut into squares and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil and drain broccoli; place in greased casserole dish. Blend soup with mayonnaise; add lemon juice and mix. Pour over broccoli. Top with grated cheese then bread crumbs (or crushed potato chips). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Chewy Fudge Brownies
instructions: Blend ingredients well; batter will be stiff. Add pecan pieces. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 in glass oblong dish greased on bottom with nonstick cooking spray or vegetable shortening. Do not overbake. Cool completely in pan on wire rack. Cut into squares. Cover tightly after cooling to keep.

title: Sunday Treat
instructions: Mix vinegar honey cloves and cinnamon in saucepan. Heat to a simmer. Add peach halves; cool. Chill several hours or overnight; drain. Serve fruit with some of the liquid over it.

title: Ham And Broccoli
instructions: Cook rice; drain. Cook broccoli. Pour rice in 9 x 13-inch dish. Layer broccoli on top of rice. Mix rest of ingredients except Parmesan cheese. Cover broccoli with mayonnaise mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare crumb topping by combining flour brown sugar and shortening in bowl until mixture resembles course meal. In another bowl dissolve soda in boiling water. Add molasses and corn syrup; blend well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle crumbs evenly over the top. Bake in the middle of the oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat and continue to bake for 35 minutes or until filling is set. Do not overbake!

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Drain sauerkraut and rinse in cold water. Drain again and add 1 cup sugar. Let set overnight. Add celery pimiento onion wine vinegar oil and green pepper. Mix and marinate 24 hours. Delicious salad; no sauerkraut taste just good!

title: Creamy Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni as per box; drain. Combine with next 4 ingredients. Spoon into greased pan. Top with crushed crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and taco seasoning together; set aside. Layer in order bean dip guacamole sour cream mixture picante sauce chopped tomatoes and sliced black olives. Cover with cheddar cheese and top with jalapenos to taste. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together potatoes onion soup sour cream and butter. Top with corn flake crumbs and if desired pieces of butter here and there on top of corn flake crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer bean dip in bottom of a pie plate. Spread sour cream on top. Spread taco sauce on top. Sprinkle with cheese tomato and onion. Serve with taco chips.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Shred cabbage and place in bottom of dish. Peel and slice potatoes and put on top of cabbage. Slice onion and place a layer on top of potatoes. Crumble corned beef on top and pour soup over casserole. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover with foil. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Five Minute Fudge
instructions: Combine Carnation with sugar in heavy saucepan. Heat to boiling. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Stir until marshmallows are melted. Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan.

title: Veggie Casserole
instructions: *Such as broccoli cauliflower whole carrots and water chestnuts (a must).

title: Quick Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Put cherry pie filling in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Put margarine slices on top of cake mix. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Melt sherbet in jello. Add drained fruit and nuts. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; chill until set. Garnish with whipped cream cheese.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and save broth for stuffing. Debone chicken. Cook chopped onion and celery in butter until tender. Mix 1/2 cup water with can chicken soup. Add onion and celery to soup mixture and heat. Mix stuffing according to recipe on package. Spread chicken on bottom of casserole or pan. Spread soup mixture over chicken. Cover chicken and soup with prepared stuffing. Bake about 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Pierce pie shell. Beat egg yolk with water and brush shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Saute sausage and onion then stir in flour. Beat eggs with milk. Set aside. Sprinkle half the cheese on shell. Top with sausage then rest of cheese. Pour in egg mixture. Sprinkle with parsley. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until set.

title: Hummus
instructions: Put all ingredients except salt and paprika in a blender or food processor and puree. Season with salt. Garnish with paprika. Serve with pita bread. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients. Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar together. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Add flour soda baking powder and salt. Gradually add oatmeal. Mix in Wheaties or Total with your hands. (The batter becomes very dry.) Add coconut if you wish.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt and cocoa in double boiler. Pour enough milk to mix. Add egg yolks. Stir in rest of milk and cook until mixture is thick. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour in pie shell. Top with meringue if desired.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook rinse and drain pasta according to directions. Cook mushrooms and pepper in a small amount of boiling water in a large covered saucepan about 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Drain well. Stir together flour and 1/2 cup cold water in a small bowl. Stir into vegetable mixture in saucepan. Stir in milk and bouillon. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Stir in the pasta turkey or chicken and sherry or water. Spray a 2-quart square baking dish with nonstick spray coating. Pour the pasta mixture into the dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes or until heated through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pizza Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Crumble sausage and brown with onion bell pepper and celery. Add cheese. Spread on small slices of wheat bread. Bake until bubbly.

title: The World'S Best French Onion Soup
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. On stove top heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onions and stir often until softened and golden brown about 35 minutes. Increase heat to high and pour in 1/2 broth stirring until most of the broth has evaporated and onions are browning again. Continue until you have used up 2 cups of the broth. Wrap bay leaf parsley and thyme in cheesecloth. Add to soup; reduce heat to low and simmer covered 15 minutes. Season with Madeira and salt and pepper to taste. Toast bread in oven on a cookie sheet 5 minutes. Divide the soup among 8 ovenproof bowls. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of cheese over each then top with bread and 2 tablespoons more cheese. Place bowls on cookie sheet and bake until the cheese bubbles 10 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Country Or Cured Ham
instructions: Use a 15 gallon pot.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Cok on medium heat for 10 minutes.

title: Vienna Bread
instructions: Combine lukewarm water sugar and yeast in bowl. Let stand 15 minutes. Add salt and oil; mix. Gradually add flour. Mix well. Knead until smooth on floured board. Place in greased bowl and let rise until doubled. Punch down and let rise again. Cut into 3 pieces. Let rise again (15 minutes). Shape into long loaves and place on greased cookie sheets sprinkled with cornmeal. Cover with towel and let rise in warm place until doubled. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken-Corn Soup
instructions: Cover chicken with water and cook until tender. Remove from water; cool. Cut into bite-size pieces. Set aside.

title: Rice Salad From France
instructions: Mix well in a large bowl. For the dressing make an oil and vinegar dressing and add salt pepper about a teaspoon Dijon mustard parsley and basil. Mix to taste and pour over salad. Serve chilled. This is authentic straight from Paris!

title: Sour Cream Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let set for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Apple Crumb Cake
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. In large bowl cream butter and 2 cups of sugar. When fluffy add eggs. Stir dry ingredients in separate bowl. Beat flour mixture in cream mixture. Alternate with sour cream. Beat in vanilla. Stir apples and remaining sugar; fold in batter. Spoon 1/2 batter into pan.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix together then add bananas. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Candy Bar Pie(Serves 15 To 20; 9-Inch Pie)
instructions: In microwave heat candy bars marshmallows and milk on High 3 to 4 minutes. Stir after 2 minutes. Chill 30 minutes until thickened. Stir occasionally. Whip whipping cream. Fold whipped cream into cooled chocolate mixture. Lightly pour into prepared crumb pie shell. Freeze until firm. Cut with wet knife.

title: Sugar-Free Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix jello cornstarch Sugar Twin water and salt in saucepan. Bring to boil stirring at all times. Cook until clear. Cool for about 5 minutes and pour over strawberries that have been arranged in baked pie crust. Refrigerate for about 3 hours. Serve with Cool Whip Lite.

title: Baptist Pie (Makes 2-9-Inch Pies)
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crusts. Pour into 2 pie crusts and chill. Top with additional Cool Whip.

title: Best Cake Ever
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chocolate chips and German chocolate; beat 2 minutes. Grate chocolate; mix into cake batter. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms; chop stems. Combine in 1-quart casserole stems onion and margarine. Microwave on High 2 minutes. Stir in bread crumbs cheese and seasonings; mound in caps. Microwave 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Rotate 2 times while cooking. Heat thoroughly.

title: German Delight
instructions: Heat all but 3 squares chocolate with 1/4 cup milk over low heat. Beat in cream cheese and remaining milk. Gently stir in whipped topping until smooth. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm. Remove from freezer. Let stand 30 minutes. Melt remaining chocolate drizzle over pie.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake in greased loaf pan at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Angel Amanda Biscuits
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cut in shortening. Stir in yeast and buttermilk. Roll and cut. Bake at 450\u00b0. Will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs; add bananas milk flour and nuts. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice-A-Roni
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni as per box instructions. Place in a 9 x 12 or 9 x 13 baking dish. Lay chicken breasts on top of Rice-A-Roni. Season with salt pepper and paprika. Cover and bake for 1 hour or until chicken is done in 350\u00b0 oven. You may remove cover last 20 minutes or so.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Make your noodle dough. Roll it out. Make stuffing out of chopped meat onions salt pepper eggs parsley and spinach. Cover half of noodle layer with stuffing then put second half on it. Take wooden board and press quarters by using edge of board but do softly so stuffing moves and forms pillows (each about 6 x 6 cm) and the two noodles layers meet and glue. Then separate pillows from one another with a knife and cook in a broth for 15 minutes. Serve it in broth or with potato salad and green salad.

title: Orange Coconut Balls
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers to fine crumbs. Add sugar margarine orange juice and nuts. Mix well. Form into balls and roll each ball in flaked coconut. Yield 6 dozen.

title: Aunt Fanny'S Cabin Baked Squash
instructions: Wash and cut up squash. Boil until tender. Drain thoroughly. Then mash. Add all ingredients except 1/2 of the margarine. Melt remaining margarine. Pour mixture in baking dish then spread melted margarine over top and sprinkle with cracker meal or bread crumbs. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven approximately 1 hour or until brown on top and set.

title: Angel Food Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add egg. Mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and add. Stir in flavoring and coconut. Shape into small balls; roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on a greased sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Rookie Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix cake mix eggs water and shortening. Mix in pecans. Shape dough into balls the size of small walnuts. Roll balls in powdered sugar. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Vegetable Casserole(Feeds 10 To 12 People)
instructions: Cook vegetables. Heat soups. Layer vegetables in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Pour soup over vegetables. Add chestnuts then onion rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Stir-Fry Vegetables
instructions: Heat oil about 1 minute. Add vegetables with wooden spoon. Stir constantly until food is only wilted but still crunchy. The secret of good stir-fry is not to overcook.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing mustard celery seed salt and pepper. Mix well. Add potatoes eggs onion celery and pickles. Mix lightly. Chill. Makes 6 servings.

title: Rosemary Pork Chops
instructions: Trim fat from chops. Add oil to skillet. Add chops and brown well on both sides. Sprinkle with pepper. Add shallots vermouth and rosemary. Over high heat heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with brown rice and carrots.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Bring to boil chocolate Crisco and milk. When cool add sugar eggs flour baking soda and vanilla. Do not overmix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix together well adding eggs one at a time. Pour into three 8-inch cake pans (grease bottoms only). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool on rack for at least 5 minutes.

title: Big Mac Special Sauce
instructions: Blend all the ingredients with a fork. Keep tightly covered and refrigerated. Use within a month. Makes 2 cups.

title: Mom'S Italian Cinnamon Cookies(Pinwheels)
instructions: Make a well in the flour and baking powder. Add eggs liquid vanilla and lemon extract. Beat with fork bringing in the dry ingredients. Add more flour to obtain soft firm consistency. Rest dough 10 minutes and roll out using flour to prevent sticking. After rolling to about 1/4-inch spread butter. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon lavishly. Roll up. Cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Lay flat on cookie pan and bake only until lightly golden.

title: Coffee-Caramel Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Spread melted chocolate over bottom of crust. Freeze until set about 5 minutes. Spoon ice cream into crust; smooth top. Freeze until very firm about 4 hours. Can be prepared up to 4 days ahead.

title: Health Nut Spread
instructions: Mix all and adjust to taste. Can add more or less of any item. Serve on crackers bagels or English muffins.

title: Stuffed Burger Bundles
instructions: Prepare stuffing according to package directions. Combine evaporated milk and meat; divide into 5 patties. On wax paper pat each to 6-inch circle. Put 1/4 cup stuffing in center of each; draw meat over stuffing and seal. Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine remaining ingredients pour over meat. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 5 servings.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine cooked rice and cooked broccoli with onion which has been sauteed in margarine. Add soup water and Cheez Whiz. Cook in shallow baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle grated Colby cheese on top and bake approximately 5 more minutes until cheese is bubbly.

title: Clear Lemon Filling(Used Between Layers Of Cake.  Terrific!)
instructions: Add gradually stirring. Spread over or between layers.

title: Cream Of Squash Soup(A Wonderful Way To Use Up Yellow Squash. Serves 12.)
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in butter until translucent. Add carrots potatoes squash and chicken stock and cook until vegetables are tender about 45 minutes. Remove from heat. When cool enough to handle puree in blender about 1 cup at a time. Return to pot. Add cream and heat thoroughly. Add salt and cayenne if desired. At serving time sprinkle a bowl with paprika. Can be served hot or cold. Can be doubled.

title: Pepper Dish
instructions: Use electric fryer or frying pan. Fry cut-up green peppers until soft. Add onions; fry until soft. Add hamburger; cook until browned. Open tomato soup cans; do not add water. Add soup to pan mix and you have an easy one-dish meal.

title: Tex-Mex Chops
instructions: In large skillet over medium-high heat brown chops in oil on one side about 2 minutes; turn chops and add salsa and chiles to skillet. Lower heat; cover and simmer gently for 8 to 10 minutes. Uncover; top each chop with one tablespoon of cheese. Cover and simmer just until cheese melts. Serves four.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and cranberries well! Set 4 hours; drain. Mix all ingredients. Serve!

title: Pineapple Dump
instructions: Open both cans of pineapple and pour juice and pineapple in cake pan (9 x 13-inch). Put dry cake mix on top of pineapple (do not combine). Melt stick of margarine in saucepan and pour as mix as possible. Preheat oven at 450\u00b0. Bake until cake mix on top is brown (golden brown). Approximate cost $5.00.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with whipped cream or ice cream and serve. Double recipe for a 10 x 13 x 3-inch cake.

title: Hamburger Delight
instructions: Brown beef with onion. Add garlic salt salt sugar pepper and tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes. Cook noodles. Drain and put in Pyrex dish. Add meat sauce with cream cheese and sour cream. Add grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Sausage And Potato Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray 13 x 9 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Combine potatoes onions carrots oil and soup mix in large bowl. Stir until evenly coated.

title: Cinnamon Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar eggs. Then add vanilla cinnamon and baking powder. Divide dough in half. Chill for 3 hours. Roll out and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Robert E. Lee Cookies
instructions: Melt the butter; add molasses sugar and eggs. Beat well. Sift together and add to the mixture the flour soda cinnamon ginger and cloves. Freeze dough for several hours. Break off pieces of dough (heaping teaspoon-size) and roll into small balls. Roll balls in sugar. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet about 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake in a preheated 385\u00b0 oven until firm and brown about 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 10 dozen.

title: Lipton Soup Canapes
instructions: Cut bread into thirds; remove crust. Melt oleo with soup. Dip bread on both sides in mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Watch carefully.

title: Kristy'S Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion until done. Line pan with chips (15 x 11-inch pan). Add layer of meat mixture cover with tomatoes and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Cookie Cutter Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and extract. Beat in dry ingredients. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Frost with orange flavored frosting. Better the second day.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate squares over low heat until melted. Remove from heat. Beat flour sugar salt vanilla and eggs with mixer. Stir in nuts and chocolate mix. Use 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Heat chocolate chips and milk until smooth. Remove baking pan from oven and arrange marshmallows on top. Bake 5 minutes. Remove and flatten. Drizzle melted chips over marshmallows. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Cut when cold. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Six-Can Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in a 2-quart casserole for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Add all ingredients together except the milk and heat to boil (low heat) until thick. After mixture is cooled add canned milk to mixture and stir until your liking of thickness.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Crush enough of the strawberries to get 1 cup. Add sugar and tapioca. Cook over medium heat until clear and thickened. Add butter cool stirring occasionally. Arrange remaining strawberries in pie shell. Pour berry mixture over strawberry halves. Let cool. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Cheese Appetizer
instructions: Heat all the ingredients and mix well. Spread on crackers or party rye bread.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Butter sides of heavy 2-quart saucepan. Combine sugar and milk in pan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils. Cook to soft ball stage (234\u00b0). Remove from heat. Quickly add Creme peanut butter chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir just until blended. Pour into buttered 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Score 1 inch squares while warm. Cut when firm.

title: Roast Leg Of Lamb
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Wipe leg of lamb with all natural paper towels. Place fat side up in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Roast uncovered until lamb reaches desired doneness about 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove roast to serving platter. Slowly drizzle 1/4 cup of the Madeira over the lamb. Let stand 15 minutes before carving the roast.

title: Quick And Easy Skillet Supper
instructions: Slice smoked sausage and brown in large skillet. Meanwhile cut cabbage in chunks and steam. Boil noodles and melt margarine. Combine everything in skillet and cook over medium heat stirring occasionally for a few minutes. Salt and pepper as desired.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Break bread into small pieces. Melt butter and add all ingredients; stir well. Put into greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 30 to 35 minutes. Placing pan in a large pan of water.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook cool peel and grate (or chop) potatoes. Melt 1/4 cup butter and stir in onions; cook onions until tender. Add cream soup and 1 cup of Cheddar cheese to butter and onions. Heat until warm. Mix potatoes and cream mixture. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Jiffy S'Mores
instructions: Spread peanut butter on one cracker. Top with chocolate. Spread marshmallow cream on remaining cracker. Place crackers together.

title: Chicken Bake
instructions: Combine all 3 soups with onion mushrooms parsley and raw rice until well blended. Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam. Place rice mixture in pan; top with chicken breasts. (Be sure to remove all fat from chicken.) Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Fresh Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Use wire whisk. Blend in cold water then lemon juice until smooth. Add beaten egg yolks. Blend thoroughly. Add butter and boiling water stirring constantly. Bring to a boil until thickened. Pour into pie crust. Add meringue. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Beef Stew In The Oven
instructions: In a 5-quart Dutch oven layer stew beef and alternate vegetables 1/3 stew 1/3 celery 1/3 peas salt and pepper. (Easy on the salt the soup has a lot.) Repeat for 3 layers. Cover top with mushroom soup and 1/2 can of water. Cover and bake for 5 hours in oven at 225\u00b0.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt. Beat egg until thick. Add sugar (a tablespoon at a time). Blend in vanilla. Mix to dry mixture. Spread batter in 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan greased and lined with wax paper. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn warm cake on towel. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Trim edges off. Spread with jelly; roll up.

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together then pour into pie shell. Top with Cool Whip and chill for 2 hours then serve.

title: Refrigerator Cake
instructions: Place over heat and stir until marshmallows melt. Let cool and add orange juice and whipping cream. Pour this mixture over sliced angel food cake. (This will cover two medium-size cakes.) Place in refrigerator until firm (about an hour). Put the evaporated milk in the freezer about 2 hours before you whip it. Shake it occasionally or until it is a frozen mush and it will whip beautifully.

title: One-Skillet Breakfast
instructions: Chop bacon into small pieces and fry in skillet until almost crisp; drain excess grease. Add hash browns; reduce heat to medium-low. Continue cooking until browned turning frequently with spatula.

title: Hot Chicken Or Turkey Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in 9 x 9-inch pan or casserole dish. Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Let potatoes thaw. Mix all ingredients together. Pour in large baking dish. Top with parsley. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Layer broccoli soup mushrooms and onion rings twice. Top with cheese and bread cubes. Bake for 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Wintry Day Bean Soup
instructions: Rinse beans. Place in large kettle. Cover with water. Add salt and soak overnight. Drain. Add 2-quarts water and ham or sausage. Simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Add onion garlic chili powder tomatoes and lemon juice. Simmer 45 minutes. Add salt and pepper if desired. Makes 2-quarts.

title: Cookie Sheet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift together sugar and flour. In saucepan bring to a boil shortening water and cocoa. Pour over flour mixture while hot. Add buttermilk eggs soda and vanilla. Bake in large cookie sheet with sides (greased and floured). Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. While cake is baking make frosting.

title: Martin'S Catfish
instructions: Split whole catfish. Mix corn meal black pepper seasoning salt garlic powder and paprika. Fill saucepan with corn meal mixture (1/2-inch thickness). Butter catfish in mixture and cook in preheated oil at 375\u00b0 (medium).

title: Bambinoes(Party Snack)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place Ritz crackers in orderly fashion on cookie sheet. Put one slice pepperoni on top of each cracker and cover with Mozzarella cheese (about 6 to 7 shreds per cracker). Bake for 7 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted on top. Enjoy!

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in their jackets with bay leaf in boiling salt water until barely tender. Cool peel and grate. Add butter to soup; stir until smooth. Blend in sour cream salt pepper green onions and cheese. Pour over potatoes. Stir gently until blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Saute ground chuck bacon and onion; drain. Mix with remaining ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Wash the potatoes; pat dry. Prick each potato with a fork in a few places. Bake potatoes on a rack at 400\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until potatoes are done. Cut a thin slice from top of each potato. Scoop out the pulp into a bowl. Mash the potato pulp with the hot milk or half and half until fluffy. Beat in the butter and the green onion. Add seasonings. Fry the bacon until crisp; crumble and add to potato mixture. Spoon potato mixture into shells. Sprinkle with both cheeses. Place potatoes on baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until potatoes are piping hot and cheese is melted about 15 minutes. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

title: Herb Mayonnaise Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream. Mix well and fold in sour cream. Chill 3 to 4 hours.

title: 9-Day Old Slaw
instructions: Mix together cabbage green pepper onion and 1 to 1 1/2 cups sugar. Set aside. Blend remaining ingredients and bring to a full boil over high heat stirring constantly. Pour over cabbage mixture immediately. Let cool. Cover and store in the refrigerator. Keeps 9 days.

title: Easy Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add sugar and stir in marshmallows while still hot. Add lemon juice. Let cool some. Add pineapple cottage cheese salt and nuts. Stir until well mixed. Add softened Cool Whip. Blend thoroughly. Pour into mold or bowl. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: For sauce in a saucepan melt butter. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Add milk 1 cup water and chicken bouillon granules all at once. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir in chicken mushroom stems and pieces (drained) and pimiento. Heat through. Serve spooned over toast toasted English muffins or baked patty shells. Serves 4.

title: Carbonnades 'A La Flamande
instructions: Cook bacon until brown. Put bacon in 3-quart casserole dish. In bacon grease cook onions until tender and lightly brown. Place with bacon in dish. In grease cook beef chunks until browned on all sides. Add salad oil if necessary. Put in dish.

title: Toffee Crunch
instructions: Line cookie sheet with foil. Put a layer of saltines (1/4 pound) on sheet. Boil 2 sticks of butter with 1 cup of sugar for 3 minutes. Pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown. Sprinkle a large package of milk chocolate chips on top. Spread when melted. Cut long way into strips. Chill. Finish cutting crossways.

title: One Step Brownies
instructions: Put all of the ingredients into bowl and mix all together. Mix about 4 minutes or until smooth. Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes (greased pan).

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in a single layer in a shallow baking pan. Add the sauce mixture. Cover and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Uncover and bake 45 minutes. Baste occasionally.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Blend soup and milk. Combine all ingredients using only half of cheese. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Turkey Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Add enough broth to be moist. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 40 minutes or until golden brown. More broth can be added while baking. Spoon over the top.

title: Walnut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Sift first 3 ingredients into a bowl. Add butter and mix well. Stir in walnuts. Drop on baking sheet and bake until light golden brown about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put in greased and floured pan in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Piccata(May Use Green Rice As Side Dish)
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet; heat to medium high. Roll chicken breasts in flour. Cut each breast in half or smaller pieces. Brown chicken in butter for 5 minutes; turn chicken then pour in lemon juice cooking wine and garlic. Cover; let cook on medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove chicken and garnish with fresh parsley. Remaining butter makes a good sauce for chicken or rice.

title: Philly Apricot Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar margarine and cream cheese well. Add eggs juice and peel. Add flour and baking powder. Chill several hours.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: Cream butter; add gradually sugar; mix well. Blend in chocolate; add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating 5 minutes after each addition. Turn into cooled baked pie shell. Chill 1 to 2 hours before serving with whipped cream and walnuts.

title: Never Failing Biscuits
instructions: Mix the water yeast and sugar. Stir to dissolve; add the oil buttermilk soda and salt. Mix well. Add the flour one cup at a time mixing well after each cup. Cover mixing bowl with a plate or foil and refrigerate overnight or a few hours. Each time you wish to use some stir dough lightly; cut off the amount you want. Knead on floured board or wax paper. Cut off rolls and bake at 450\u00b0 until brown about 15 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine condensed milk limeade concentrate and whipped topping in a bowl; mix well. Spoon into pie shell. Chill for 10 minutes or until serving time. May substitute lemonade concentrate for limeade concentrate if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Cake With Black Walnut Cream Filling
