instructions: Place sugar milk egg yolks flour and butter in double boiler. Cook until custard forms. After custard cools add nuts and vanilla. Spread between layers. Cover with chocolate frosting.

title: Easy Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Pour into a well-greased 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with coconut as desired. Bake for 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Meal-In-One
instructions: Cook macaroni by package directions. Saute onions in butter. Cook ground beef. Combine all ingredients together except the Cheddar cheese in large greased dish. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: In saucepan over low heat melt caramels with butter and milk. Mix cake according to directions. Pour half of batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven; top with chocolate chips and pecans. Pour caramel mixture over the first layer after baking it. Pour second half of cake batter over top. Bake 20 minutes more. May frost if desired. May be prepared a couple of days in advance.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cream cheese and 2 tablespoons melted butter until smooth. Add chicken milk salt pepper and pimento. Mix well. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles. Firmly press perforations to seal. Spoon 1/2 cup meat mixture into center of each rectangle. Pull 4 corners of dough to top center of filling; twist slightly and seal edges. (May be frozen at this point.) Brush tops with 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle crouton crumbs. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 to 25 minutes until brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Toffee Squares
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg yolk and vanilla; blend together. Add flour mix together again. Spread this mixture onto a cookie sheet by pinching pieces of dough and pressing dough to cover the cookie sheet working with your fingers. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Crispy Critters
instructions: Melt the chips peanut butter and butter in the top of a double boiler. Remove from heat and stir in the Rice Krispies. You can either drop the mixture by teaspoons on waxed paper or spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cut into bars when cool.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Wash blueberries and sprinkle with sugar. Place blueberries and crushed pineapple in a large baking dish. Sprinkle cake mix over top of berries. Melt margarine and pour over cake mix. Top with chopped pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into marble size balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Broccoli Cheese Cornbread
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Should be golden brown.

title: Hamburger Chili Dip
instructions: Mix into crock-pot set on low. Cook about 1 hour until hot. Serve with chips. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook all except cheese and milk for 3 minutes. Add heated milk and cheese cut in chunks. Stir until cheese melts (4 minutes). Can be frozen. When reheating thin with canned chicken broth.

title: Blue Cheese Dip
instructions: Empty all of the ingredients into a mixing bowl. Mix it all together with an electric mixer. Chill in the refrigerator. You can put it on crackers or stuff celery with it.

title: Gooey Butter Coffee Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix 2 eggs and butter. Place in a large ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix cheese vanilla 2 eggs and powdered sugar (save 2 tablespoons). Pour mixture on top of the first layer. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Then sprinkle nuts and remaining powdered sugar. Bake an additional 25 minutes.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a 4-quart soup pot. Saute onions slowly for about 40 minutes or until brown. Add flour and mix well. Cover and steam about 5 minutes.

title: Jamay'S Biscuit Peach Cobbler
instructions: Bake biscuits as directed on can. In a 3-quart pot add peaches sugar butter nutmeg cloves cinnamon vanilla and lemon flavor. Cook until it starts to get thick. Break open your cooked biscuits and place the bottom part on a greased square pan. Pour your peach mixture over the biscuit bottom then place the top part of the biscuit over the mixture. Let bake in hot oven for 15 minutes. Serve with ice cream or cheese if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Hazelnut Truffle Log(Makes One Log)
instructions: Melt over hot not boiling water chocolate morsels; stir until smooth. Remove from heat but keep over hot water. Add butter egg yolks and heavy cream; beat with a wire whisk or fork until smooth. Stir in hazelnut flavored liqueur. Transfer to a small bowl. Set bowl over larger bowl filled with ice cubes. Chill stirring occasionally until fudgelike in consistency yet smooth and creamy about 30 minutes. Shape into 8-inch log. Roll in hazelnuts. Wrap in waxed paper. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan combine soup water and cheese. Over low heat heat until cheese is melted stirring occasionally. Add spaghetti chicken pepper and parsley. Heat through stirring occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Aunt Millie'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Grease and flour spring-form pan. All ingredients must be at room temperature. Mix all ingredients in one large bowl. Mix well.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars and Crisco together well. Add eggs. Beat thoroughly. Stir in nuts. Add flour soda salt and spices which have been sifted together. Blend well. Mixture will be very stiff; shape into about 2 1/2-inch rolls and place in refrigerator. When ready to bake slice and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 8 minutes. Bake on greased cookie sheets. Remove while warm. Makes at least 5 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place the cut up chicken dipped in melted butter in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour remaining ingredients over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup over the top. Cover with foil and bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cornstarch and water; mix. Bring to boil; simmer 15 minutes then add cornstarch and water. Mix and simmer until desired thickness.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo and saute celery and onion. Mix with cooked rice; add chicken mushroom soup Cheez Whiz and drained broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 in casserole dish for 30 minutes.

title: Mayme'S Cheese Dreams
instructions: Toast lightly the 8 slices of bread. Precook bacon lightly. Place cheese tomatoes and onion on bread. Broil approximately 2 minutes. Place cooked bacon on top of mixture and broil until cheese is melted. Serve with your favorite salad.

title: Sunny Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil noodles as directed on package. Drain water. Slice peppers onion (or chop) olives and pepperoni. Mix in with noodles. Pour whole bottle of dressing over mixture. Toss well. Chill and serve.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil over high heat. Add dash of garlic salt. Cut chicken in strips; add to oil. Cook for 3 minutes. Add vegetables; stir-fry 3 more minutes. Reduce heat; stir in the remaining ingredients. Cook 1 to 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: California Granola
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients except raisins and mix well. Spread onto ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown stirring occasionally. Stir in raisins. Spread onto ungreased cookie sheet or aluminum foil; cool. Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator. Serves as a snack or as cereal with milk. Makes about 8 cups.

title: Pudding Surprise Cake
instructions: Leave baked cake in deep large 9 x 13 or size larger pan. Add mixed banana cream pudding. Layer with Cool Whip. Top with cherry or strawberry pie filling.

title: Pear Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with brown sugar until smooth. Beat in remaining ingredients except sugar until combined. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Garbanzo Bean Soup
instructions: Heat beans and tomatoes together in large cooker. Cook onion and hamburger together. Pour in with beans and tomatoes. Simmer for 4 hours.

title: Zucchini Relish(Canning)
instructions: Combine zucchini onion green and red peppers. Sprinkle with salt and cover with cold water. Let stand 2 hours. Drain vegetables; press out liquid. Combine remaining ingredients bring to a boil. Add vegetables simmer 10 minutes. Pour hot into hot jars leaving 1/4 inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 4 1/2 pints.

title: Cinnamon French Toast(Kindergarten Recipe)
instructions: You break the eggs and mix in cinnamon with a fork real good. Add milk. Put a piece of bread in and then put it into a buttered pan. (Do all 4 pieces.) Flip it over take it out. Put it on a plate and put syrup on top. Then you eat it.

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Fill each greased cupcake cup 2/3 full. Cream together the cheese salt sugar and egg until light and fluffy. Stir in chocolate bits. Drop a tablespoon of this mixture on top of each cupcake. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Cream mixture will be in the center of each cake. These may be frosted with chocolate icing if desired.

title: Bake-A-Rice
instructions: Cook sausage then drain. Boil soup mix and rice for 7 minutes in water. Add vegetables; put in baking dish. Cover with water chestnuts then bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy Rocky Road
instructions: Butter 8-inch square pan. In large microwave-safe bowl place chocolate chips butter and shortening. Microwave at High (100%) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes just until chocolate chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred. Add marshmallows and nuts. Blend well. Spread even in prepared pan. Cover and refrigerate until firm. Cut into 2-inch squares. Makes 16 squares.

title: Meatballs In Sauce
instructions: Mix. Form into small balls (walnut size). Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Turn as needed. Prepare sauce.

title: Potato Deluxe(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into oblong pan. Sprinkle with corn flakes crumbled. Bake 1 hour or more at 375\u00b0 until brown on top. Serve for breakfast lunch or dinner with entree and salad.

title: Busy Day Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion in skillet. Drain grease. Add salt pepper and chili powder. Simmer over low heat and add cream of mushroom and tomato soups. Simmer about 5 minutes and pour meat mixture over cooked macaroni. Sprinkle crushed cracker crumbs over the top and sprinkle heavily with grated Parmesan cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until ingredients are heated through and sauce bubbles. Serves 5.

title: Bul-Kogi(Korean Barbecue)
instructions: Place in broiler pan cover and let marinate at least 15 minutes or until ready to cook. Uncover and broil about 10 minutes. Serve over white rice.

title: Streusel Topped Fruit Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Pour pie filling into pie shell. In bowl combine flour and brown sugar. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly; stir in nuts. Crumble this mixture over pie filling. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden brown and filling is bubbly. Remove from oven and let cool.

title: Oriental Beef
instructions: Fry ground beef onions and mushrooms together and drain. Return the meat mixture to the skillet. Put green beans in a strainer and run water over them to separate. Stir the beans and rice into the beef mixture. Push the skillet mixture to the sides of the skillet. Break the egg into the center and scramble. Mix the meat mixture and scrambled egg together. Add soy sauce and stir-fry until the mixture is heated. Serve from the skillet.

title: Easy Skillet Chicken
instructions: Beat egg and milk together. Mix flour salt and pepper. Dip chicken into egg mixture; roll in flour mixture. Brown chicken well in a mixture of oil and butter in a heavy skillet. Pour off skillet drippings. Return chicken to skillet. Add 1/2 cup boiling water. Cover. Cook over low heat for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into serving pieces. Soak pieces in buttermilk overnight in refrigerator. Drain. The next day dip in flour salt and pepper. Fry as usual.

title: Barbecue Wieners
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Let simmer as long as possible before serving.

title: Spicy Shrimp With Noodles
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions while cleaning the shrimp; drain. Melt butter in a medium skillet over low heat. Stir in olive oil and red pepper flakes and raise heat to medium-high. Add shrimp and saute until almost pink. Add Cajun seasoning and garlic powder; saute for 1 minute until fragrant. Add Italian seasoning and sherry; heat until simmering. Dissolve cornstarch in water; add to skillet. Continue to cook stirring constantly until thickened. If necessary add small amounts of additional sherry until desired consistency is reached. Top with Parmesan cheese. Serve hot over linguine.

title: Orange Yogurt Salad
instructions: Pour water over gelatin; stir until dissolved. Stir in yogurt and orange segments. Pour into 4-cup mold. Chill until firm at least 4 hours; unmold. Makes 8 servings about 1/2 cup each.

title: Today'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix together; beat until smooth. Bake at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Spice Cookies
instructions: Combine cake mix shortening eggs and water in a large bowl; blend thoroughly. Stir in oats and raisins. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Frozen Dessert
instructions: Mix Cool Whip sour cream and sugar; add all other ingredients. Freeze. Take out 1 hour before serving.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Put rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place chicken on top of it. Mix together the water and cream of mushroom soup. Pour over the chicken. Sprinkle with onion soup mix; cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

title: Texas Chili
instructions: Mix the ingredients and soak the ribs in this mixture for 2 hours. Then bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 2 or 3 hours. Baste every now and then with the sauce. If the ribs are fatty drop them in boiling water for about 5 minutes before marinating then proceed as directed. Serves 6.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Butter bottom of 9 X 13 pan. Spread pie filling evenly over bottom of pan. Sprinkle cake mix evenly over top of filling. Sprinkle nuts and butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. When completely cooled spread with cool whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: White Christmas Cake
instructions: In a large saucepan bring margarine or butter and 3/4 cup water to boiling stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add baking bar; stir until melted. Stir in buttermilk eggs and rum extract; set aside. Sir together 1/2 cup of the flour and the pecans; set aside. In an extra bowl stir together remaining 3 cups flour sugar coconut soda and powder. Stir in margarine mixture. Fold in coconut mixture. Stir in margarine mixture. Fold in pecan mixture.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken until tender; debone and cut into pieces. Mix chicken soup green chilies and sour cream together.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients with enough mayonnaise to hold together (not too much). Spread evenly over bread or buns. Place under broiler until melted.

title: Pecan Cheese Bars
instructions: Combine butter sugar and corn syrup. Cook over low heat until sugar dissolves. Cool slightly. Add beaten eggs gradually. Add vanilla and salt. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Top with pecans. Bake at 325 degrees for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole #2
instructions: Place drained peas on bottom of 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Spread chicken over this. Make sauce of soup mayonnaise and water. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle on almonds. Tear bread into small pieces and place on top. Drizzle melted margarine over bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Beat yolks and whites separately. Add 1/2 cup sugar to yolks while beating. Add 1/4 cup sugar to whites after beaten stiff. Mix yolks and whites add milk whipped cream whiskey and rum. Let set for at least 2 hours. Stir before serving.

title: Three-Cheese Potato Souffle
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first nine ingredients. Beat egg yolks; stir into potato mixture. In a small mixing bowl beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; gently fold into potato mixture. Transfer to a 2-qt. souffle dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden. Serve immediately.

title: Eggplant Appetizer
instructions: Wash eggplant; cut into 1/2-inch cubes. In 1/2 cup hot oil in large skillet saute eggplant until tender and golden brown. Remove eggplant and set aside. In 2 tablespoons hot oil in same skillet saute onion and celery until tender about 5 minutes. Return eggplant to skillet. Stir in tomato sauce; bring to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Add vinegar sugar capers salt pepper and olives. Simmer covered and stirring occasionally 20 minutes longer. Refrigerate eggplant mixture covered overnight.

title: Ranch Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix in saucepan 1 cup brown sugar water and butter. Boil 5 minutes. Pour into 9-inch square pan. Mix in bowl 1 cup brown sugar milk Bisquick raisins nuts and vanilla. Spoon batter on top of mixture. It will sink into liquid and spread as it bakes. Bake 45 minutes. Serve warm plain or with whipped cream. This recipe serves 9.

title: Jalapeno Fudge
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Put chilies evenly in greased 8-inch square pan. Sprinkle cheese over chilies. Pour eggs over cheese and bake until firm in center about 30 to 40 minutes. Place on wire rack and cool 5 minutes. Cut into bite size pieces. Delicious served on crackers.

title: Cap'N Crunch Cookies
instructions: Melt almond bark. Add all other ingredients. Drop on wax paper.

title: Chapatis
instructions: This is a flat bread. Sift flour and salt adding 2 tablespoons oil and 2/3 cup water. Stir to form a ball. Knead until smooth and elastic about 3 minutes. Divide into 12 equal pieces and form into balls. Roll into circles 6 to 7-inches; keep covered. Heat a cast-iron skillet and cook in ungreased skillet 1 minute on each side. Stack and cover with towel. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except cornflakes. Pour into baking dish and top with crushed cornflakes. Melt 1/2 stick oleo and pour over slivered almonds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Delicious with cooked rice.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
instructions: Mix until crumbly. Press into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fudgemallow Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate with peanut butter in saucepan over low heat stirring until smooth. Fold in marshmallows. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Chill until firm. Cut into squares. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Fast And Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken and eggs together; put in bottom of casserole dish. Mix broth and soup together; pour over chicken. Mix flour milk and melted margarine; pour over casserole. Do not mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix eggs milk salt and mustard. Blend well. Pour in an 8 x 12-inch greased casserole. Add bread crumbs sausage and cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hobo Bread
instructions: Combine raisins water and baking soda. Let stand overnight (10 to 14 hours). Add remaining ingredients. Mix by hand with spoon. Grease cans (not too large) and fill each can 1/2 full. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cool in cans when cool remove from cans. Wrap in plastic wrap or freeze. You may use soup cans or any other size you wish.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Raisin Cinnamon Bars(I Use Dates Instead Of Raisins.)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Sift dry ingredients together and stir into creamed mixture; add oats and 1 tablespoon water. Mix until crumbly. Firmly pat 1/2 mixture in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread with date filling. Mix remaining crumbs and 1 tablespoon water. Spoon over filling. Pat smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes. Cool; drizzle with Cinnamon Icing. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pimento And Cheese
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix in other ingredients. (Black pepper garlic and mayonnaise are used to your taste.)

title: Wilted Lettuce Dressing
instructions: Mix all together. Pour over cut up leaf lettuce. Mix enough to coat lettuce.

title: Swedish Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugar. Add eggs beating well after each. Mix together the remaining ingredients and stir in. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Chicken Ala Can
instructions: Make in large frying pan. Put soup water and rice in pan. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add all ingredients except onion rings and simmer 10 minutes. Heat onion rings in oven. Dish up chicken hot dish into serving bowl and put onion rings on top.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute onions with margarine in large skillet for 15 to 20 minutes on medium heat. Place half of onions in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with half of crackers and half of Parmesan cheese. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Bake uncovered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Beef And Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Brown onions in 2 tablespoons oil. Add meat and seasoning. Heat until meat loses color. Put in casserole dish over green beans. Add tomato soup. Top with mashed potatoes. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. More spices can be added to taste. Pans should not be over 1/2 full.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Melt butter and beat eggs. Drain the whole kernel corn. Combine all ingredients together adding the muffin mix last. Pour mixture into a greased 7 X 11-inch baking dish. Bake ate 375 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Pasta-Bean Salad
instructions: Cook the pasta (macaroni twists or shells) and drain. In large bowl stir together mayonnaise parsley cheese and lemon juice until blended. Add pasta beans peas and carrots; toss to coat well. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled.

title: Molded Spring Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Beat in salad dressing with mixer. Stir in cottage cheese and add salt. Chill until thick and syrupy. Fold in peas radishes green peppers and onion. Pour into lightly oiled mold. Chill until set.

title: Light Trifle
instructions: Prepare instant pudding according to package directions. Fold in half the whipped topping while pudding is still soft.

title: Casserole Of Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Spread 1/2 of bread cubes in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix chicken celery onion and mayonnaise and spread over cubes. Cover with remaining cubes. Combine eggs and milk and pour over top. Let stand overnight refrigerated. Mix soup and 1/2 can of milk and pour over top before baking. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle cheese over top for last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook noodles per package directions. Rinse under cold water. Add remaining ingredients and toss gently.

title: Chicken Deluxe Casserole
instructions: Mix stuffing and butter together. Press half of mixture in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baker. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over stuffing. Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Mix and sift flour baking powder and sugar. Add milk and well beaten egg. Mix well. Pare and core apples cut in sections and dip each piece of apple in the butter. Fry in deep fat until brown. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in water over double boiler until chocolate melts; cool. Sift flour soda and salt; set aside. Beat egg yolks with sour cream adding sugar gradually and beat vigorously until thick. Add chocolate mixture and vanilla mixing well. Add flour soda and salt to sour cream mixture. Beat until smooth. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in paper lined 13 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Frost with chocolate butter cream frosting.

title: 1-2-3 Beer Bread
instructions: Mix in beer 4 ounces at a time. Pour the batter into 3 well-greased 3 x 6-inch pans. Drizzle melted butter over the top. Bake for about 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Good at barbecues.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Mix together and let congeal.

title: Jan Hagel Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease jelly roll pan. Mix oleo sugar and egg yolk. Blend in flour and cinnamon. Pat into pan. Beat egg white and water; brush over dough. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Cut immediately into strips.

title: Peggy'S Carrot-Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil; add eggs and crushed pineapple. Beat well. Mix dry ingredients together and add to other mixture. Add carrots and pecans and beat well. Bake in three 9-inch greased and floured pans about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Wash and cut rhubarb into small 1-inch pieces. Beat egg; add lemon juice sugar and flour. Mix together and pour over chopped rhubarb. Stir until well coated. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust. Dot with oleo. Cover with top crust. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar and prick holes with fork. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes and then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cabbage Supreme
instructions: Boil shredded cabbage for 7 minutes. Grate the cheese. Make white sauce with the margarine flour milk and salt. Line buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish with finely crushed potato chips. Add 1/2 of the cooked cabbage 1/2 of the white sauce mix and sliced hard-boiled eggs. Spread 1/3 cup grated cheese over mixture. Repeat steps ending with the remaining chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Christmas Ornaments(Do Not Eat!)
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Knead in bowl until thoroughly blended. Lightly spray dough board and rolling pin and roll mixture to 1/2 inch thick. If dough sticks spray a sheet of waxed paper and place over mixture. Cut out with cookie cutters. Using a straw punch a hole in each ornament where you will put the ribbon later. Lay out to dry for at least 2 days. Tie ribbon through holes and hang on tree.

title: Raspberry Nut Bread(Mmmmmm-Good)
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together the berries sour cream and nuts. Add alternately the dry ingredients to the liquid ingredients. Grease and flour loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Holiday Garlic Olives
instructions: Drain olives; save liquid. In small saucepan combine 1 cup olive liquid chili powder garlic bay leaves olive oil pepper and onion. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes uncovered. Stir in pimientos. Place olives in a large jar; pour seasoning mixture over. Cover. Refrigerate. Make at least 3 to 4 days prior to serving. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Glazed Meat Loaf
instructions: In a large bowl combine ground beef bread crumbs milk egg onion 2 tablespoons tomato sauce horseradish salt and pepper. Mix well. Put in loaf pan. Combine remaining ingredients and spread over meat loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Pie
instructions: Mix wafers and butter and spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange sliced bananas over crust. Beat together milk and lemon juice until thick. Add sour cream. Pour over bananas. Mix together pineapple and Cool Whip and spread over sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with pecans coconut and cherries. Refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Sweet And Sour Baked Beans
instructions: Place onions in skillet; add sugar mustard garlic salt salt and vinegar. Cook 20 minutes covered. Add onion mixture to beans. Add bacon. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 12. This fills a 3-quart casserole.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: If you have difficulty finding yellow rice use white rice.

title: Cupid Cream Puffs
instructions: In a medium saucepan heat butter with water over high heat stirring occasionally until butter is melted and mixture is boiling. Add salt and flour all at once. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture leaves sides of pan in a smooth compact ball. Remove from heat. Quickly add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition until smooth and shiny. Drop mixture by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet 3-inches apart shaping each into a mound. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven 50 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Hearty Stir-Fry
instructions: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions; drain. In medium skillet cook sausage until no longer pink. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Add cabbage onion apple and garlic. Stir-fry just until tender. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Add spaghetti. Cook and stir until hot. Remove from heat. Add cheeses; toss to mix. Arrange on warm serving platter. Garnish as desired. Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Meatballs And Sauerkraut
instructions: Mix together meat egg bread crumbs salt and pepper. Shape into 1-inch balls. Simmer catsup water and cookie crumbs for 5 minutes. Add brown sugar salt and sauerkraut. Heat to boiling. Add meatballs; lower heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt butter sugar and salt gradually and add milk until it starts to thicken. Beat eggs and then stir them in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Chop tomatoes peppers and onions fine. Boil all together slowly then add spices and sugar and boil 3 to 4 hours. Bottle and seal while hot.

title: Cucumber Casserole
instructions: *You can use half ground beef and half sausage.

title: Summer Vegetable Tian(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Blanch the broccoli in salted boiling water for 3 minutes or until it is bright green. Refresh under cold water and allow to drain. Trim the tough stalks from the spinach and wash well without draining the spinach. Put the spinach in a large pot and cook over low heat covered until wilted about 4 to 5 minutes. Squeeze out the water and chop roughly. Set aside.

title: Brownies From Heaven
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Beat in vanilla. Combine flour and cocoa; add to creamed mixture just until combined. Stir in walnuts. Spread into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 23-28 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Cherry Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish. Line with graham crackers (not crushed). Mix together pudding and milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour half of this mixture over graham crackers. Place another layer of graham crackers over this and pour rest of the pudding mixture over crackers. Lay a third layer of graham crackers on top. Frost top layer with Fudge Frosting and let set all day or night in refrigerator.

title: Hoppin John Soup
instructions: Fry sausage and drain. Drain 3 cans of peas; use juice and all of the other 3 cans. In a 6-quart pot stir in peas onions salt pepper water and sausage. Bring to a boil and cook on medium for 45 minutes. Add cooked rice and simmer 20 minutes more. The soup will be thick so stir frequently to keep from sticking.

title: Asparagus-Almond Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Toast bread; crumble and mix with butter. Combine cheese and soup. Heat slightly to melt cheese. Add almonds. Place half the asparagus in prepared dish. Cover with slices of 1 egg and half of the soup mixture. Repeat layer. Sprinkle buttered bread crumbs over all. Bake until bubbly and browned about 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water just enough to separate. In bowl combine soup mayonnaise beaten eggs onion and salt and pepper to taste. Pour this into broccoli mixing well. Sprinkle cheese on top. Melt margarine and mix into stuffing; sprinkle on top of broccoli mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
instructions: Combine softened cheese strawberries and sugar. Process until smooth. Fold in whipped cream and freeze in pie shell. Top with additional frozen or fresh strawberries to decorate.

title: Maw, Maw Rene'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk beating on low speed until well blended. Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Beat on low speed 1 minute. Layer wafers bananas and pudding mix until all used ending with top layer of pudding. Cover with a layer of Dream Whip. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Panamanian Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in shallow pan and pour other ingredients over chicken. Cook covered in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Aunt Wanda Chicken
instructions: Heat enough oil in a skillet to cover the bottom. Salt tenderloins. Dredge in flour. Lightly brown both sides in oil. Pour off some of the oil before next step. Generously sprinkle tenderloins with lemon pepper seasoning. Mix soup and 1/2 can of hot water and pour over tenderloins. Sprinkle with a little more lemon pepper seasoning. Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Crunchy Romaine Toss
instructions: Brown in skillet walnuts Ramen noodles butter and almond slices. Set aside and cool. In a large salad bowl combine broccoli romaine lettuce chopped green onions. Mix together oil sugar or Splenda vinegar soy sauce and salt and pepper to make dressing. To romaine mixture add nut mixture and toss. Pour dressing over salad mixture and toss.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash strawberries and sprinkle with salt and let drain. Bake pie shell and let cool. Cook 7-Up sugar cornstarch and food coloring until thick and clear. Cool. Add strawberries and pour into pie shell.

title: Chocolate Syrup Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with the syrup. Add vanilla. Mix well. Bake in a sheet cake pan which has been floured and greased at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Angel Food Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare cake as directed on box. Combine water orange juice and food coloring. Add grated orange peel; mix. Bake and cool as directed on box.

title: Lana'S Peasant Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine water yeast sugar and salt. Stir until dissolved. Add flour (dough will be wet). Place dough onto floured platter.

title: Light And Easy Lemon Chicken
instructions: Place each chicken breast in the center of a 12-inch square piece of aluminum foil. Fold sides of foil up so the lemon juice wont run out. Halve the lemons and squeeze the juice of 1/2 lemon over each chicken breast then sprinkle each with 1/4 teaspoon tarragon and black pepper. (I also add 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of wine poured over each piece of chicken.) Fold foil together and seal well. Bake wrapped chicken in shallow baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Peasant Potatoes
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat melt butter. Add onion and garlic. Cook and stir 5 minutes or until onion is transparent. Stir in oregano and sausage and cook about 5 minutes more. Stir in potatoes salt and pepper until potatoes are well coated with butter. Place mixture in slow cooker. Cover and cook on High 3 to 4 hours or on low for 6 to 8 hours stirring every hour if possible. During last 30 minutes of cooking add cabbage and peppers. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving. Makes 6 side dish servings or 4 main dish servings.

title: Coconut One Step Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Pour into greased pie tin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Texas Stew
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet. Drain. Mix in can of\ttomato\tsauce\tcorn green beans new potatoes and spices. Let simmer on stove for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve with corn bread.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Mix the crumbs butter and seasonings. Sprinkle a layer of crumb mixture 1/2 inch thick in the bottom of a buttered baking dish. Cover with oysters. Add a little milk then a layer of crumb mixture. Repeat until all the mixture has been used. Be sure a layer of crumbs is on top. Bake 35 minutes in a moderate oven.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Mix all and shape into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 11 minutes on ungreased baking sheets. \Do not overcook.\ Cool on wire rack. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Pineapple Cocktail Barbecue
instructions: Drain pineapple and save syrup. Combine the syrup with the jelly or preserves ketchup cloves cinnamon and salt. Heat to boiling.

title: Fruit Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Place in ice cream churn to freeze.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift the dry ingredients and add to the cream mixture mixing well. Fold in the mashed bananas vanilla and walnuts. Pour into the prepared pan. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until a tester inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool in the pan for 2 minutes then invert on a rack.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Spread pineapple in a lightly buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with cake mix blueberries and sugar. Drizzle with butter and top with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Microwave Curried Rice With Almonds
instructions: Put onions and oil into 3-quart casserole. Cover tightly and microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Wash rice briefly in a sieve under cold running water; drain well. Add to onions in a casserole along with rest of ingredients except almonds. Cover tightly and microwave on High for 7 minutes; stir. Cover and microwave until liquid is almost absorbed 8 to 10 minutes longer. Stir. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir again and top with almonds.

title: Ice Cream Sandwich Dessert
instructions: Unwrap ice cream sandwiches and place side by side in a 13 x 9 pan. Top with caramel topping nuts and Cool Whip. Freeze until ready to serve. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Stuffed French Toast
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl; spread on 1 slice of bread. Top with remaining bread to form a sandwich. In small bowl beat egg with water. Transfer to small shallow pan and soak sandwich turning occasionally for 10 minutes or until all egg is absorbed. Melt margarine in small skillet; add sandwich. Cook until bottom is golden brown; turn and brown other side. Top with strawberry spread and serve. Serves 1.

title: Uncooked Chili Sauce
instructions: Bring vegetables spices sugar and vinegar to a boil and fill 10 pint jars. Seal. The liquid that you drain off can be put in tomato juice if making it the next day.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: In a bowl combine the first seven ingredients. Add beef and mix well. Shape into 1-1/2 inch balls. In a large skillet brown meatballs in oil; drain. Combine tomato sauce water brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce; pour over meatballs. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Frosty Lemon Supreme(Healthful Eating)
instructions: Line a 9-inch pie plate with 1/4 cup of the graham cracker crumbs. Beat egg whites water and milk to stiff peaks. Add egg yolks lemon zest and lemon juice; beat 1 minute gradually adding sugar. Spoon into pie plate. Sprinkle remaining crumbs over top. Freeze at least 2 hours.

title: Doughboys
instructions: Wrap cubes of ham and cheese in biscuits. Toast on grill. Serve with pickle relish.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Leave cream cheese at room temperature. Mix with onions that are chopped real fine. Cut up corn beef with scissors and mix in. Add Accent and Worcestershire sauce. Roll ball in chopped pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Crescent Lasagna Rolls
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage stirring until crumbly. Add onions spices tomato paste and garlic. Mix well. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes and cool. Combine egg cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in bowl and mix well. Press crescent rolls into two 3 x 10-inch rectangles. Layer ground beef mixture egg and cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese on rectangles. Roll each to enclose filling. Place on baking sheet. Brush with milk. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Corn Pudding(Serve As A Vegetable.)
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Gradually add milk stirring until smooth. Add eggs corn butter and salt. Mix well. Pour into greased 1-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Place in pan of hot water. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 3/4 hours.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Chinese Sauteed Fresh Vegetables
instructions: *Choose any 1 vegetable or combine several. Vegetables should total 1 pound before cooking.

title: Herb-Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Cut the vegetables into chunks. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in shallow baking pan in a single layer. Bake for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown stirring occasionally. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a large saucepan. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer covered for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Yield 4 servings.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Cook hamburger bell peppers and onion. Add cheese. Add to meal corn oil milk and salt. Mix all together and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Griffin'S Grape Jelly Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef crumbs onion milk egg and next four seasonings; Gently shape into 1-inch balls melt shortening in large skillet. Brown meatballs. Remove meatballs from skillet drain fat. Heat chili sauce & jelly in skillet until jelly is melted stirring constantly Add meatballs & stir until coated. Simmer 30 mins. Serve hot in chafing dish. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Taco Bake
instructions: Cook ground beef with onions until browned and drain well. Spoon into a 13 x 9-inch ungreased baking dish. Into this stir taco seasoning drained corn and tomato sauce. Spread evenly in dish. Sprinkle 1 cup shredded cheese on top. Mix Bisquick milk and eggs until well blended. Pour over beef mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with lettuce tomato salsa and sour cream.

title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Heat butter until bubbly. Place egg yolks lemon juice and salt in blender. Blend at low speed. Uncover. Pour hot butter in. Continue to blend. Makes 1/3 cup.

title: Spanish Stew
instructions: *The more celery peppers and onions the better.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter mix. Add cornflakes and stir until all are coated with syrup mixture. Drop by teaspoon into wax paper. Cool and serve.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Dissolve soda in milk; add flour alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Roll nuts candy and dates in extra flour then add coconut. Add to cake batter. Bake in tube pan at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Mix 2 cups white sugar and 1 cup orange juice; pour on cake while hot. Store cake in pan overnight. Can also bake in loaf pans.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
instructions: Mix 1 egg with box of cake mix and 1/4 cup butter (melted). Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Press mixture into the bottom. Mix 2 eggs powdered sugar and cream cheese. Pour on top of other mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain squash and combine all other ingredients. Set aside enough stuffing or topping. Bake in casserole dish 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter two large cookie sheets. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating constantly until stiff and glossy. Fold in vanilla nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto a buttered cookie sheet. Put in preheated oven then turn oven off. Leave in oven for several hours or overnight until crisp.

title: Richs Celery Chicken Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle tenderloins with salt and pepper. Brown in skillet in butter about 5 minutes per side. Remove. Cook onion and celery in same skillet until tender; add more butter if needed. Remove. Add flour and 1 Tbsp. butter to skillet. Stir over medium heat until paste forms. Add chicken broth to skillet. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Stir in celery and onion. Layer rice in casserole. Layer chicken pieces over rice. Pour thickened celery broth over meat. Cover and bake for 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pineapple in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread blueberry mix over pineapple. Spread dry cake mix over blueberries. Cut margarine into pats and lay on cake mix. Sprinkle nuts on top of margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. May top with whipping cream.

title: Orange Candy Cake
instructions: Use some extra flour to coat candy and nuts.

title: Hot Slaw
instructions: Put cabbage and onions in large bowl. Heat remaining ingredients in saucepan bringing to a boil. Pour over cabbage and onions; toss. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and have noodles cooked and drained. Melt butter. Blend in flour and seasonings. Add broth. Cook stirring until thickened. Stir in mushroom soup chicken and stuffing mix. Add cooked noodles and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until bubbles.

title: Easy Brown Sugar Pie
instructions: Spread brown sugar in pie crust; sprinkle with flour. Pour milk over it. Dot with margarine. Do not stir. Sprinkle pie with cinnamon or allspice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until set.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
instructions: Press 1 package rolls in 9 x 13 greased pan. Beat cream cheese 1 cup powdered sugar and flavoring until smooth. Smooth cream cheese mixture over rolls. Cover with the other package of rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sandwich For A Crowd
instructions: Combine cream cheese Cheddar onion mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce. Spread on bread that has been cut lengthwise. Add ham and roast beef slices.

title: Beef Vegetable Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large stockpot. Cook at high temperature for half an hour; then simmer for an additional hour.

title: Pork Chops With Tomato Sauce
instructions: Brown chops in little portion of bacon drippings. On top of each chop place 1 small onion (sliced) and 1 lemon (sliced) and salt and pepper. Mix and pour over chops tomato soup and water. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. Combine flour baking powder baking soda and cinnamon and set aside. In a larger bowl whisk together applesauce sugar egg whites banana and vanilla. Add flour mixture all at once and stir gently to blend. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean. Cool bread completely.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand for 20 minutes in greased loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: In bowl beat eggs oil and vanilla. Set aside. In another bowl mix flour sugar salt and cinnamon. Stir in carrots raisins nuts coconut and apple. Combine well then add wet ingredients from other bowl. Stir just until combined. Spoon into well-greased muffin tins filling to top for large breakfast muffins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Orange Butter
instructions: In small bowl beat butter orange peel and orange juice until well blended. Refrigerate to chill.

title: Chocolate Chip Date Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates and 1 teaspoon baking soda; let cool. Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten eggs then add cooled mixture. Sift together the flour and 1/4 teaspoon soda; add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan that has been greased and floured. Mix the last 3 ingredients; spread on top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta until tender. Drain. Shake together vinegar olive oil salt pepper and Parmesan cheese. Mix together remaining ingredients; add pasta and pour dressing over tossing to coat. Chill.

title: Blueberry Delight(Microwave)
instructions: Mix together pie filling and almond flavoring in microwave-safe dish. Cook on High 3 to 4 minutes until bubbly. Sprinkle on top of sauce the cake mix then slice butter or margarine on top. Combine pecans cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle over sliced butter. Cook on High 12 to 13 minutes or until cake is firm.

title: Hamburger Baked Beans
instructions: Brown together onions pepper and celery. Pour off grease. Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until thick.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Thaw bread dough or mix box dough for pizza crust. Spread on greased cookie sheet (like for a pizza). Mix next 7 ingredients and spread on dough. Cover with toppings you want; roll like a jelly roll. Place seam side down and brush with egg white. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars in a large mixing bowl. Add flour and crumble together. Set aside 1 cup of this mixture. Mix eggs salt soda and yogurt together in small mixing bowl. Add this to the sugar mixture and combine (seems better if not completely smooth) and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Cinnamon Cake
instructions: Sift in large mixing bowl the flour and sugar. In a saucepan put cocoa cold water oleo and shortening. Bring to a boil. Pour over flour and sugar; add eggs buttermilk soda cinnamon and vanilla. Bake in large 11 x 17-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or less.

title: Marinated Orange And Onion Salad
instructions: Combine orange and onion in a large shallow dish. Pour vinegar over mixture and toss. Sprinkle with parsley. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours; stir occasionally. Toss gently. Serve over mixed greens using slotted spoon. Makes 3 servings.

title: Polish Sausage And Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles per directions and set aside. Melt butter and saute onion and sausage 8 to 10 minutes. Add cabbage and saute 5 minutes. Stir in caraway seed salt and pepper. Stir in noodles and sour cream. Heat through 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Steak
instructions: Brown steak on both sides in oil in frying pan. Combine salt pepper dry mustard minced onion water and vinegar and pour over steak. Cover tightly and cook about 1 1/2 hours over low heat. Drain orange sections and pineapple chunks reserving 3 tablespoons liquid and blend in brown sugar and cornstarch. Put steak on platter to keep warm. Put fruit and sugar mixture in pan with drippings and cook 2 or 3 minutes. Pour over meat and serve.

title: Apricot Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a loaf pan. Soak apricots in warm water for 30 minutes. Cream butter sugar and eggs well. Stir in orange juice. Combine dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Drain apricots well. Add with nuts to batter. Bake approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Marinara Sauce
instructions: Tips Use more carrots (makes sweeter) or garlic or oregano if you like more herbs; whatever you desire its always good.

title: Ham And Rice Chantilly
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use a 2-quart casserole dish greased. Combine ham rice peas 1/2 cup cheese salt pepper and cayenne. Spoon into casserole dish. Add remaining cheese to the whipped cream. Spread over top of rice mixture. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Gradually add powdered sugar; beat until light and fluffy. Stir in vanilla and 1/2 c. pecans or sprinkle pecans on top of cake. Yield enough for one 3 layer cake.

title: Easy Tomato Soup(Yields 3 Servings)
instructions: Heat tomato juice. Add spices. Do not bring to a boil but simmer gently. Serve with thin slice of lemon to garnish each serving.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into a ball and roll on floured board. Cut with cutter dipped into flour. Bake on greased cookie sheet in a moderate oven until brown.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix first four ingredients with electric mixer. Shape into ball and then roll in pecans.

title: Mustard Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add vinegar and mustard. Cook in double boiler until thick. Add butter.

title: Apple Cranberry Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine the cranberries sugar tapioca water and orange peel. Bring to boil stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in apples. Cool. Pour into unbaked pastry shell that has been coated with 1/4 cup flour and 1/4 cup sugar mixed together. Top with uncooked pastry or lattice strips of pastry. If using a full top crust cut a few slits in top crust. Slice a few slices of margarine and place on top and sprinkle sugar over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Cranberry Apple Salad
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 cups water to boiling. Add cranberries and simmer for 10 minutes. Add sugar gelatin soaked in the other 1/2 cup of water nuts and apples. Pour into mold. Place in circle on bed of crisp lettuce and fill\tcenter\twith cottage cheese seasoned with salt and paprika. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Saute garlic and onion in oil; add shrimp. Sprinkle with lemon juice; add mushrooms wine and salt. Cook until shrimp turn pink (about 4 minutes). Serve over rice or pasta. Add green salad and crusty French bread for a flavorful menu.

title: Eggplant And Mozzarella
instructions: Saute the eggplant (cubed) with minced garlic in olive oil. Stir in the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Toss with basil cubed Mozzarella and rigatoni.

title: Orange Fluff
instructions: Combine Jell-O orange juice water and pineapple; let congeal. Beat lemon pudding and milk until smooth; whip cream until firm. Fold in pudding and whipped cream. Spread over congealed Jell-O mixture.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Dice hot peppers and onion. Add milk until right consistency. Mix in blender.

title: Old Fashioned Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine and mix ingredients. Pour in a pie shell and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Karo Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Swiss Baked Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in lightly oiled 13 x 9 x 1-inch baking dish. Top with cheese slices. Combine soup and water; stir well. Spoon sauce evenly over chicken; sprinkle crumbs on top. Dot with butter or margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Saute onions and celery in oleo. Mix all ingredients. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls in hot cooking oil. Will float when done. Put on paper towels to drain.

title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook onion until tender. Add remaining ingredients except parsley. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Garnish with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt margarine and cocoa together. Stir together. Let it cool for a few minutes. Add sugar. Add eggs all at one time. Beat with a mixer. Add milk and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 1 to 2 tablespoons fat. Add onion celery and carrots to fat in kettle. Saute until onion is soft and transparent. Stir in flour and cook 1 minute. Stir in clam juice. Add bacon potatoes and bay leaf. Cover and simmer 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add half and half and clams and salt and pepper to taste. Cook until heated through.

title: Cauliflower Lettuce Salad
instructions: Mix dressing cheese sugar and onion in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Refrigerate. Makes 8 servings.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Put rice in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all liquids together. Pour 1/2 of liquids over rice and mix well. Place chicken uncovered on top of rice. Cover with remaining liquids. Sprinkle cheese and almonds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour sugar and milk. Spray pan. Pour in pan. Pour the peaches over dough. Pour juice over the whole thing. Sprinkle a little cinnamon if you want to. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Meatballs In Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Pour water over bread crumbs then mix all ingredients together. Form into 1 1/2-inch meatballs. Heat a little oil in a skillet; brown meatballs a dozen or so at a time. Place them in spaghetti sauce after draining off grease.

title: Pineapple Kielbasa
instructions: Cut kielbasa into bite size pieces. Combine chili sauce brown sugar pineapple and juice. Pour into a casserole dish. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix pie filling pineapple condensed milk banana and lemon juice well. Fold in container of Cool Whip. Pour into oblong pan and cover. Put in freezer. Take out about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Melt butter in top of double boiler. Add dry ingredients; stir until smooth. Add liquids slowly; cook until thick and smooth. Add cooked beets; let set over low heat for at least 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking soda. Set aside. Mix fat and peanut butter. Add both kinds of sugar. Mix well. Add eggs and beat well. Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mixture. Drop dough from a teaspoon on baking pan. Flatten with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 (moderate oven) for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Boil noodles until firm but done. Drain. In casserole dish combine soups and tuna. Add drained noodles. Top with grated cheese. Bake for 20 minutes or until done.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Mix sour cream dry onion soup mix mushroom soup lemon juice and mustard. Heat sauerkraut in drippings from cooked sausage. In baking dish alternate layers of potatoes cream mixture and sauerkraut. Put bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0F. for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and light brown on top.

title: Garden Vegetable Quiche
instructions: Combine flour 1/2 cup butter and softened cream cheese in a medium bowl stirring until blended. Shape into a ball. Cover and chill 30 minutes. Saute mushrooms pepper zucchini onion carrot and garlic in 2 tablespoons margarine until vegetables are crisp-tender. Remove from heat; stir in paprika salt and pepper. Set aside. Pass chilled pastry evenly on bottom and sides of 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle cheese over bottom of shell. Spoon sauteed vegetables evenly over cheese. Combine eggs and milk in a medium bowl; beat with a wire whisk. Pour egg mixture over vegetables. Saute chopped onion in 1 tablespoon margarine until tender; drain and sprinkle over quiche. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until set and lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Corn Bread Pudding
instructions: Butter 1 1/2-quart casserole. Mix all ingredients one at a time. Bake uncovered for approximately 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 until set brown and crusty.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies reserving 1 cup. Mix with margarine and put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream the cream cheese with confectioners sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread cream cheese mixture on crumbs. Spread cooled pudding on top. Sprinkle cookie crumbs over all.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Measure dry ingredients in mixing bowl. Add oil water and coloring. Mix well knead until smooth. Stores well in airtight bowls or bags.

title: Corn Dodgers
instructions: Fry in patties dropped by spoonfuls into a small amount of cooking oil. Serve hot.

title: Noreen'S Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar marshmallows salt milk and butter over medium heat. Boil for 8 minutes. Take off heat. Add chocolate chips vanilla and nuts. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix the above ingredients in a large bowl add enough mayonnaise to hold ingredients together. Chill at least one hour and can be chilled overnight. Sprinkle with paprika and sliced hard boiled eggs before serving.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients except sugar. Combine eggs vegetable oil sugar zucchini and extracts in a separate bowl and beat well. Stir flour mixture into wet ingredients; mix until smooth. Add raisins nuts and chopped dates last and stir. Pour into 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes for loaves and 20 minutes for muffins.

title: Stuffed Cabbage(Total Cooking Time:  36 Minutes)
instructions: Remove core and blemished leaves of cabbage. Place cabbage in 3-quart microproof casserole. Add water. Cover with plastic wrap and cook on High (Maximum power) 6 minutes. Cool cabbage slightly and separate leaves. Combine ground beef pork rice egg thyme parsley garlic salt and pepper; stir thoroughly. Divide mixture among 6 to 8 large cabbage leaves. Wrap leaves tightly around mixture. Line bottom of 3-quart microproof casserole with some leftover cabbage leaves. Place cabbage rolls on top of loose leaves. Cover with remaining cabbage leaves. Dot with butter and pour tomato sauce over top. Cook covered on 80 (Reheat) about 30 minutes. Baste after 15 minutes and cook until rolls are fork-tender. Remove and let stand covered 5 minutes. Discard top loose cabbage leaves before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix together margarine cake mix and 1 egg. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 smaller pans greased and floured. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese and 2 eggs; pour over the top of cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle some powdered sugar on top if desired.

title: Oriental Chicken(By Pam Gabriel)
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces in a frying pan cook chicken with the lemon juice and water. When the chicken is done add the 2 packages of dressing mix and simmer for at least 5 minutes. Cook rice as directed. Serve the chicken mixture over rice.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix thoroughly sauerkraut bean sprouts celery diced pepper chopped onion and celery seed. Blend together sugar salad oil and vinegar. It is best when this mixture is heated and then left to cool. When cool pour mixture over vegetables. Its better after it stands a few days. Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in a little oil. Put in casserole dish. Blend soup with milk and add pepper. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with paprika (optional) on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Check after 45 minutes for doneness. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Liver Sausage Appetizer Ball
instructions: Mash liverwurst to make smooth. Blend in all of rest of ingredients except add only 1/3 of the cream cheese. Pack into a 2-cup mixing bowl lined with foil or plastic wrap. Chill several hours until firm. Turn out and frost with remaining cheese. Chill well. Serve with crackers.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Put crackers in brown paper bag. Sprinkle all dry ingredients onto crackers. Shake well. Pour oil onto crackers and shake again. Let bag set in sink 1 hour before storing in Tupperware. Sack will absorb excess oil.

title: Sherry Wine Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix with electric beater about 5 minutes at medium speed. Pour the batter into a greased bundt pan or angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until done. Cool about 25 minutes before turning onto a rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar and milk stirring until mixture makes soft ball in cold water. Add marshmallows and peanut butter stirring until all is dissolved and begins to thicken. Pour in buttered dish or pan. Slice when cold.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar; beat well. Add pumpkin and lemon juice; mix until blended. In a separate bowl combine flour baking powder spices and salt. Add to egg mixture. Mix well.

title: Poor Man'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and heat until dissolved. Add rest of ingredients and mix together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sugar Coated Pecans
instructions: Cook as a syrup the sugar orange juice rind and salt to soft ball stage. Stir well then add nuts. Stir until creamy. Lift out pecans one at a time placing them on wax paper until dry.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook onions slowly with butter and oil in heavy covered 4-quart saucepan for 15 minutes. Stir in salt and sugar. Cook uncovered over moderate heat 35 to 40 minutes stirring often until onions are a deep golden brown. Sprinkle with flour; stir 3 minutes. Remove from heat; add boiling bouillon and water to onion mixture. Blend well. Add wine and seasonings. Simmer partially covered 35 minutes. While soup is simmering place 1 layer of French bread slices on cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until they are dried and golden brown.

title: Out Of This World Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand 10 minutes. Combine dissolved yeast eggs 2 1/2 cups flour shortening sugar and salt in a large mixer bowl. Beat until smooth at medium speed scraping sides of bowl for 2 minutes. With wooden spoon stir in remaining flour to make soft dough. Cover. Let rise until double in bulk about 1 hour. Punch down. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt the oleo butterscotch chips and peanut butter together in microwave for 4 minutes. Pour over the Rice Chex; mix well. Put Chex mix in paper grocery bag with the powdered sugar. Fold top over and shake. Coat all well. Pour out and let dry on cookie sheet.

title: Butter Rolls
instructions: Roll dough very thin. Spread butter and sugar over dough. Roll up into a roll. Cut into small rolls. Place in pan. Mix milk sugar and vanilla; pour over rolls. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until done.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream Pie
instructions: In a bowl whisk melted ice cream and pudding mix for 2 minutes. Pour into crusts. Freeze until firm. Pies may be frozen up to 2 months. Remove from the freezer 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with whipped topping if desired. Yields 2 pies 6 to 8 servings each.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water; rinse and drain. Add macaroni to a bowl containing salad oil and vinegar. Mix together then add remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: Lace Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Pour over melted butter. Add egg and vanilla. Drop by 1/4 teaspoon onto cookie sheet covered with aluminum foil dull side up. Place fairly far apart as mixture will run. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 8 minutes or until well browned on edges. Cool; remove with fingers from foil.

title: Sausage Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Bring water to boil; add rice and Lipton onion soup mix. Boil 7 minutes. Add celery green pepper sliced water chestnuts and browned sausage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: South Of The Border Casserole
instructions: Mix milk soup salsa and onions. Chop tortilla into pieces. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer ingredients and top with cheese. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrots And Cheese
instructions: Cook carrots and drain. Melt the butter and cheese together then mix with the carrots. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt butter and mix with the crackers. Sprinkle over the carrots and cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes (until cracker mixture is brown).

title: Chile Con Queso Dip
instructions: Saute the onion (chopped fine). Add the tomatoes and green chilies. Cook until most of the liquid is gone. Add and heat the milk. Add the Velveeta (cubed) and heat until melted. Mix well and serve.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie(Makes One 9-Inch Pie)
instructions: In a saucepan mix the sugar and cornstarch very well. Gradually stir in water. Cook over medium heat and stir constantly until mixture gets thick. Boil 1 minute. Stir a little of this hot mixture very slowly into the egg yolks. Then blend this mix into the hot mix in saucepan. Return to heat and boil about 1 minute more stirring constantly until smooth and thick. Blend in butter. Stir to melt and then add lemon juice and stir well. Pour into baked shell. Cover with meringue. Be sure to seal meringue to crust so it doesnt shrink. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Wasetti
instructions: Cook noodles as directed then drain. Brown ground beef; add soups and Velveeta. Mix well. Add noodles. Put into casserole dish. Sprinkle Cheddar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot through 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 12-inch pan for 35 minutes.

title: New Potatoes
instructions: Scrape the peel off of the potatoes. Wash well. Cover with cold water; cover and bring to a boil. Cook until fork tender approximately 15 minutes after they come to a boil. Add bacon drippings and butter and stir. Mix cornstarch with 1 cup of half and half and add to the potatoes stirring well. Add the rest of the half and half salt and pepper. Stir frequently to keep from sticking and scorching. Cook until smooth and it thickens. Garnish with chopped green onions and crispy fried bacon.

title: Raisin Sauce For Ham
instructions: In a saucepan combine brown sugar cornstarch and mustard. Stir in water raisins vinegar lemon juice and peel until blended. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Stir in butter until melted. Serve warm over sliced ham. Yield 2 cups.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Cut ends of eggplant; peel skin with potato peeler. Slice into 1/4 or 1/8-inch slices. Scramble 3 eggs in a bowl. Pour bread crumbs in another bowl. Dip eggplant in egg then in bread crumbs. Fry in olive oil to lightly brown on both sides. Cover bottom of baking pan with tomato sauce. Place a layer of eggplant overlapping edges in pan. Cover lightly with sauce; spread evenly. Cut or break American cheese into squares 1 for each serving and place over eggplant. Put an even coating of Kraft Parmesan over it. Do another overlapping layer of eggplant sauce American cheese and Parmesan. Put sauce on each piece of American cheese so it wont burn. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: 3 Bean Salad
instructions: Drain kidney beans thoroughly. Pour off liquid from wax and green beans. Empty beans into a large bowl. Add onions. Dissolve sugar in vinegar and add salt pepper and Crisco oil to beans. Stir gently to blend. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Serve beans thoroughly drained on lettuce.

title: Sausage Soup
instructions: Brown sausage. Add remaining ingredients except kidney beans and simmer until vegetables are tender. Add kidney beans and simmer 5 minutes more. Then enjoy!

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda together. Add lemon juice to apples. Mix oil sugar and eggs together; add dry ingredients alternately with apples. Add nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Leave in pan and cover with glaze.

title: Low Carb Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Steam or microwave the cauliflower until soft. Puree in food processor adding the butter and half & half to taste. Season with salt and pepper. This has 5 grams carbohydrates.

title: Old Time Cinnamon Jumbles
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and egg thoroughly. Stir in buttermilk and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and stir. Chill dough.

title: Chafing Dish Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat and next 8 ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls. Melt shortening in skillet. Brown meatballs. Remove from skillet and drain. Heat chili sauce and jelly in skillet until jelly is melted stirring constantly. Add meatballs and stir until coated. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve hot in chafing dish.

title: Home Baked Communion Bread
instructions: Mix as for pie crust. Divide into 3 parts. Roll out and score into small squares. Bake on thin cookie sheet for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serves 200.

title: Impossible Tamale Pie
instructions: Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Cook and stir ground beef in skillet until brown; drain. Stir in onion and seasoning mix. Spread in plate. Sprinkle with tomatoes and corn. Beat eggs milk baking mix and cornmeal until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Farmer'S Doughnuts
instructions: Grease and flour 12 muffin tins. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening sugar and egg. Sift flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce or milk. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 30 minutes or until done.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
instructions: In one bowl mix together flour baking powder salt cinnamon and baking soda. In another bowl mix together oil eggs sugar vanilla and chocolate chips. Add flour mixture to bowl and mix all ingredients well. Divide batter in well greased and floured loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 60 minutes. Pick test; cool in pan 10 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Oven Baked Or Crock Pot Stew
instructions: Cut vegetables in large pieces. Combine all ingredients in large pot or crock pot. Cover and bake for five to six hours at 275\u00b0 in pot; or low in crock pot.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix all but biscuits and place in baking dish. Top with flaky biscuits and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and cheese. Add flour nuts and flavoring. Make into 2 rolls. Chill overnight. Cut into 1/4-inch slices or make into small balls and press down on cookie sheet with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly brown.

title: No Brown Meatballs
instructions: Bring to a boil ginger ale and catsup. Pack and roll meat mixture into firm balls. Add to boiling mixture. Cook about 3 hours. Chill and remove fat from top; reheat. This makes a good dish to freeze or prepare ahead. Serve with noodles or pasta.

title: Healthful Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first six ingredients. In medium bowl combine next four ingredients. Combine the two mixtures. Spray pan with non-stick spray. Spread batter in pan. Bake 25 minutes. Cool and cut into 16 bars. Calories per serving 68.

title: Sea Reef Salad
instructions: Drain and flake salmon. Mix salmon eggs olives and almonds. Soak gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes. Dissolve over hot water. Add mayonnaise sour cream onion salt and lemon juice. Mix and combine with salmon mixture. Mold and place in refrigerator until congealed. Remove from mold. Garnish with parsley. Serve.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Heat soup to lukewarm. Stir in water. Slowly sprinkle gelatine into mixture. Add onion mayonnaise and shrimp. Fold in soft cream cheese. Pour into mold. Chill overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Simple Cheese Tarts
instructions: Use cupcake liners as needed.

title: Southwest Green Beans
instructions: Drain green beans leaving a little water in each can. Saute onion in bacon drippings. Add chili sauce beans and bacon. Chill overnight. Heat to serve about 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apricot Cookies
instructions: Mix half the recipe at a time. Mix together well all the ingredients. Roll into 4-inch balls then refrigerate 2 to 3 hours or put in freezer for 1/2 or 1 hour then take out of refrigerator or freezer. Take 1 ball out of refrigerator at a time then roll out ball on board with flour or powdered sugar and cut with diamond cookie cutter and fill with 1 teaspoon apricot mixture with ground walnuts in center then bring two corners together and seal. Put 1/2 toothpick in cookie to hold together. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly golden brown. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Deluxe
instructions: Cook macaroni as package described; rinse and set aside. Mix well cottage cheese sour cream eggs and sharp cheese (save 2 cups for topping). Add macaroni and stir well. Pour into lightly greased (Pam) 2-quart casserole. Top with shredded cheese and a dash of paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Spinach Lasagne
instructions: Saute onions green peppers and garlic in oil until golden stirring often. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste parsley oregano and bay leaf. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. Combine spinach Ricotta egg 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese salt and pepper.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Sprinkle coconut and nuts in 3 pie shells. Mix other ingredients with melted margarine. Do not boil. Pour into shells and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. I cover edges of pie shells with foil.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Makes 2 standard size layers. Mix all dry ingredients. Add mayonnaise water and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Steam the squash zucchini and lemon. Cook them but still firm. In a saucepan heat just to boiling the cream of mushroom soup bouillon cube and sour cream. Add the grated carrot.
