Drain the vegetables well and add them to the sauce. Prepare the stuffing. Cover bottom of a casserole dish with 1/2 of the stuffing. Add vegetable/sauce mixture then top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Shred cheese and combine with sausage and Bisquick. Shape into small balls and place on cookie sheet or shape into balls. Freeze. Then bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Make balls small since they get larger when cooked. Yields 100 balls.

title: Summer Garden Medley
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet saut the zucchini corn green pepper leek and seasoned salt in oil until vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes; heat through. Yield 4 servings.

title: Sauerkraut
instructions: Place shredded cabbage in sterile jars. Use 1 teaspoon salt per quart and 1/2 teaspoon salt per pint. Cover with hot water and place lids on tight. Store in a cool dark place for one month before tasting.

title: Company Cabbage
instructions: In large saucepan heat bouillon in 1/4 cup water until dissolved. Add cabbage carrots onion 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper; toss to mix. Cook covered 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Combine butter mustard and pecans and pour over vegetables; toss to mix. Sprinkle with paprika. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Saucepan Scratchies
instructions: Mix everything in kettle you melt the butter or margarine in. Add oil to melted butter. Add sugar then eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla flour baking powder and nuts coconut or chocolate chips. Put in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Do not overbake. Watch very closely.

title: Just Like Grandma'S Bread Pudding
instructions: About 2 hours before serving preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a medium saucepan over medium heat heat milk until tiny bubbles form around the edges.

title: Coconut Prize Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a large bowl then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly. Cool for 15 minutes right side up. Remove from pan.

title: Deviled Ham Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve with snack crackers. Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Vermicelli With Spinach And Pasta Sauce
instructions: Cook spinach in olive oil over medium heat about 10 minutes stirring constantly. Add salt pepper Ricotta and skim milk. Cook over low heat until mixture is heated through. Do not allow to boil. Simmer pasta in sauce in a small pan; heat through. Cook vermicelli according to package; drain.

title: Scalloped Ham And Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter and stir in milk and flour. Layer 1/2 the ham then potatoes and onion. Season with pepper. Top with the remaining ham. Pour on the flour sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Panhandle Egg Pie
instructions: Variations Ham onions green peppers and/or Cheddar cheese may be added.

title: Creamy Tuna Twist
instructions: In large bowl stir together first three ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; toss to coat well. Chill.

title: Easy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together in saucepan and bring to boil. Use sauce on ribs chicken etc.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Creamed Tuna On Biscuits
instructions: Saute onions in margarine until limp but not brown. Add tuna green beans and mushroom soup. Stir until well blended and simmer for a few minutes. If too thick add a little milk or water. Bake biscuits according to printed directions. Serve creamed tuna over biscuits. Toast may also be used instead of biscuits. This makes a good evening meal as it is light.

title: No-Egg Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat sugar sour cream condensed milk and vanilla well. Add 2% milk and fruit. Pour in freezer and freeze.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix softened butter sugar flour and beaten eggs well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Best when served room temperature.

title: Hot Water Sponge Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar well. Add flour and baking powder. Beat. Add hot water. Put in two 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Mix in other ingredients. Pour into a greased pan. Place in cold oven. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until there is a little crust on top. Great used as brownies.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift flour brown sugar salt and soda. Bring to a boil the butter cocoa and water. While still hot add to flour mixture. Add eggs vanilla and milk. Pour into sheet pan that has been lined with tinfoil and that has been greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes no longer. Frost with Texas Sheet Cake Frosting.

title: Stuffed Baked Tomatoes
instructions: Cut thin slice from top of tomatoes and scoop pulp out with large spoon. Mix pulp with remaining ingredients and let stand. Place tomatoes carefully in 8-inch greased baking dish. Fill carefully with mixture. Top with bread crumbs and butter or grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: One Pan Meal
instructions: Brown meat; add soup potatoes and onion. Simmer until potatoes are tender. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Cook until it turns white and seal relish up in a jar. This does not take long to prepare.

title: Apple Nut Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 4 1/2 dozen using small muffin tins.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix sugar margarine and peanut butter with hand. Roll mixture into balls on waxed paper. Melt chocolate and paraffin in top of double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate mixture with toothpick. Place on wax paper.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix tea pineapple juice lemon juice and orange juice. Boil cinnamon sticks in cup of water for 10 minutes. Add to tea mixture. Heat and serve.

title: Pear Bread
instructions: Combine flour cinnamon and pecans in a large bowl. In a separate dish combine oil eggs sugar pears and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Spoon mixture into two greased loaf pans. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

title: Chinese Egg-Drop Soup
instructions: Put chicken broth in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Immediately reduce heat to simmer. Dissolve cornstarch in water; add to chicken broth stirring until slightly thickened. Add onion and stir. Add egg very slowly stirring to break it up. Serve immediately.

title: Snow Cream
instructions: Mix egg sugar vanilla and milk. Pour mixture over snow. Stir quickly before snow melts. Add more sugar and vanilla if needed.

title: Pork Chops And Brown Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large dish except pork chops. Lightly brown the chops and place on rice mixture. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Paella(Low-Fat)
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven over medium-high heat until hot. Add chicken and stir until browned. Add rice onion and garlic. Cook stirring until onion is tender and rice is lightly browned. Add broth tomatoes tomato liquid paprika ground red pepper and saffron. Bring to a boil over high heat; stir. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add shrimp pepper strips and peas. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until rice is tender liquid is absorbed and shrimp are opaque.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and blenderize. If you have an ice crusher you can do the ice in it and then scoop out the ice and pour orange mixture over it in your glass.

title: Bunuelos De Planto(Banana Fritters)
instructions: To prepare the batter sift 1/2 cup of the flour and the salt into a deep mixing bowl. Stir in the beaten egg and butter and then the milk and continue to stir until the batter is smooth. Do not beat or overstir. For the best results set the batter aside at room temperature and let it rest for an hour or so although it may be used at once if it must. In either case the egg white should be beaten with a whisk or rotary beater until stiff and then folded into the batter just before using it.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake in slow oven at 320\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lime Jell-O Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello as directed on package add sugar while jello is hot. Add pineapple juice and frozen lemonade diluted to make 1 quart. Add limeade diluted as directed. Add ginger ale immediately before serving.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Drain peas well. In medium mixing bowl mix all listed ingredients. Season to taste. Cover and set in refrigerator to chill. Serves 4 persons.

title: Corn-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Put in casserole and pour 1/4 cup melted butter over this. Bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serve.

title: Spice Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add coffee and egg. Stir in dry ingredients and raisins. Chill 1 hour. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan until done in center. Cut into bars and glaze with powdered sugar glaze.

title: Peach Macaroon Ice Cream
instructions: Whip whipping cream. In a large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk crumbs peaches and extract. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Cover. Freeze 6 hours or until firm.

title: The World'S Greatest Mushroom Soup
instructions: Slice mushroom caps thinly. Chop mushroom stalks finely. Soften chopped onions in butter with the chopped mushroom stalks. Add flour and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Gradually add the chicken stock and bring to a boil. Then add the sliced mushroom caps bay leaf tarragon and Worcestershire sauce. Add salt and pepper to taste and simmer from 15 to 20 minutes. Remove bay leaf and adjust seasonings. Serve garnished with a few slices of mushrooms and chopped parsley.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Place crackers in a large bowl. Pour oil over crackers and mix. Add dressing mix and stir. Place mixture on a large cookie sheet and heat in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind the cranberries. Add the sugar and pineapple. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. When ready to serve mix in the marshmallows nuts and Cool Whip.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mash cheese until creamy. Blend remaining ingredients except celery and onion. Fold in vegetables and combine with cheese. Mix well. Refrigerate. Use with crackers or raw vegetables.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Bring to boil pour over beets and boil 10 minutes. Pack into sterilized jars and seal. No salt. Makes 12 pints.

title: Rich Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Melt butter and peanut butter in a bowl over hot water. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Yields about 2 dozen squares.

title: Endive-Watercress Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a jar; cover tightly and shake vigorously. Rinse endive lightly; pat dry and trim ends. Arrange on salad plates; top with watercress. Drizzle dressing over top and sprinkle with toasted walnuts.

title: Savory Short Ribs
instructions: For Crock-Pot Arrange ribs in shallow microwave dish. Salt pepper and rosemary each rib. Cook on High for 5 minutes. Drain fat. Add ribs carrots celery and wine to crock-pot. Stir together butter flour chicken broth beef broth and bouillon until smooth. Add to the ribs in crock-pot and cook on high for 6 hours.

title: Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water; add melted butter egg and sugar with mixture. Add flour. Store in airtight container and refrigerate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Tuna Fish Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and stir in 1/2 of the crackers. Add the other ingredients. Mix. Pour into a Pyrex or other glass dish; top with remaining 1/2 cup crackers. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Escalloped Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into medium size casserole dish. Dot top with cracker crumbs and butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Whole Wheat Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and onion in large saucepan; drain grease. Salt and pepper to taste and add all spices (sugar garlic powder and Italian seasoning). Add tomato wedges tomato paste and 1 can water. Simmer 30 minutes. Boil noodles according to box; dont over boil. Drain. Make layers starting with 1 thin layer of sauce 4 noodles laid lengthwise layer of sauce layer of cottage cheese layer of Mozzarella cheese noodles sauce cottage cheese Mozzarella sauce noodles sauce cottage cheese Mozzarella and last 2 or 3 tablespoons Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese really bubbles about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve with tossed salad and garlic bread!

title: Christmas Corn Bread
instructions: Sift everything together except meal. Stir in meal. Then add remaining ingredients. Beat 1 minute. Bake in greased pan 20 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Steak And Rice
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips. In a large skillet (ovenproof if desired) brown meat in oil using high heat. Add onions; saute until tender-crisp. Blend soup water and garlic salt; pour over steak. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour or until steak is tender. Or cover and bake at 350\u00b0. Serve over beds of fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix together and make into meatballs. Fry.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt in a bowl. Add raisins and walnuts. Combine egg vanilla and melted shortening. Dissolve soda in pineapple and add. Stir just enough to mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake 1 hour or until done at 350\u00b0. Wrap in foil for freezing.

title: Kiwi Mousse
instructions: Briefly puree 8 ounces kiwi and pour into bowl. Whip cream into soft peaks. Whisk egg whites until stiff; sprinkle with sugar toward end and beat to incorporate sugar. Stir melted gelatin into puree. Fold in whipped cream then egg whites. Pour half the mousse into a round 8 x 3-inch mold. Refrigerate 15 minutes. Pour tea over cake and let absorb. Put cake in mold in 1 piece. Add remaining mousse. Freeze 4 hours. Garnish mousse with kiwi.

title: Double Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs shortening and half of the cake mix (dry) until smooth. Stir in remaining cake mix oats and chocolate pieces. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Squaw Corn
instructions: Dice the bacon and fry. Drain bacon and cook onion in grease. Beat egg; add salt onion bacon and corn. Pour into a greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Peel eggs slice lengthwise remove cooked yolks. Put other ingredients in bowl with yolks and mix with mixer until well blended not lumpy. Put filling mixture into egg whites and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients and add to wet. Blend well and chill. Roll out 1/4-inch cut out and bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes. Makes 8 dozen small cookies.

title: Batter Bread
instructions: Measure water into a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved. Add margarine sugar salt and 2 cups flour. Beat for 2 minutes with electric mixer (medium speed). Blend in remaining flour. Cover; let rise until double. Stir down and spread in greased loaf pan. Let rise until double. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until loaf sounds hollow. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Carolina Beans
instructions: Cook ground chuck with onion and pepper and drain. Mix all other ingredients. Bake in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tropical Chicken Salad
instructions: Place chicken and celery in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise and curry powder. Add to chicken mixture and mix well. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Before serving add the pineapple bananas oranges and coconut. Toss gently. Serve on salad greens if desired. Sprinkle with nuts. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut tips off wings and section pieces. Combine margarine soy sauce and other ingredients until melted. Sprinkle wings lightly with garlic salt. Pour mixture over wings and marinate 4 hours or overnight. Remove from marinating sauce and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Easy Bake Chicken
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Place boneless chicken in baking dish. Spread cream of chicken soup over chicken. Spread prepared Stove Top stuffing over soup. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Wild Rice And Mushroom Frittata
instructions: In small bowl rinse rice in several changes of cold water; drain in strainer; set aside. In 1 quart saucepan combine rice water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Heat to boiling over high heat; cover and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until tender about 40 minutes. Drain well. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In 9-inch skillet with heat proof handle heat oil over medium heat. Add onion garlic and mushrooms. Cook stirring until vegetables brown and most of the liquid evaporates about 5 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Layer in 9 x 13-inch casserole thin layer of sauce 3 raw noodles all of raw ground beef 1/2 Jack cheese 1/3 sauce 3 noodles spread all Ricotta cheese rest of Jack cheese 1/2 remaining sauce 3 noodles and rest of sauce. Cover loosely. Cook on 1/2 power (5) 10 minutes turn 1/4. Cook 1/2 power 10 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Turn 1/4 cook on High (10) 7 minutes. Add cheese (Mozzarella and Parmesan). Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Calico Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute garlic and onion in margarine over low heat until tender. Add chicken broth carrots and celery; cook until just tender-crisp. Blend flour into milk; add to chicken broth and cook stirring until slightly thickened. Stir in cheese. Add salt and Tabasco to taste. Serves 4.

title: Crock-Pot Corn
instructions: Cook 4 hours on low.

title: Cranberry Jello Salad
instructions: Make 2 packages Jell-O using only 3 cups of water instead of the usual four (I use the pineapple juice which was drained from the crushed pineapple and the rest water making up the 3 cups water 1 boiling and 2 cold.) Allow Jell-O to begin to jell; add the other ingredients. Chill until Jell-O is completely firm and set.

title: Barkley'S Garlic Butter
instructions: Moosh together at room temperature.

title: Indian Chicken Curry
instructions: Melt butter; add onion and garlic and cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients (except cooked chicken). Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add chicken; cover and heat. Serve over hot rice.

title: Dreamsicle Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions on box. Bake in two 9-inch round cake pans. When layers are cool cut each in half making a total of four layers.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple pecans and bananas. Spoon batter into greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool pans for 10 minutes. Remove and cool completely. Spread frosting between layers on top and sides. Sprinkle pecans on top.

title: Pizza Sauce
instructions: Cook garlic peppers and onions in vegetable oil until soft then add tomato paste oregano basil sugar and salt. Simmer all together until it comes to a boil. Bottle and seal.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Combine. Add 1/3 to 1/2 cup per mug of boiling water.

title: Lemon Or Lime Shimmer
instructions: In small bowl sprinkle gelatin over cold water; let stand 1 minute to soften. Add boiling water and stir to dissolve. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into 2-cup mold or individual dishes. Chill until set. Makes 4 servings.

title: Bubble Bread
instructions: Crumble yeast into water. Place milk sugar salt and egg in mixing bowl. Blend. Add 2 cups flour and beat until bubbles form on surface. Add melted shortening and about half remaining flour. Mix in additional flour to form soft dough. Turn dough out onto a floured board and knead dough until it is smooth so it is elastic and can be easily handled. Press dough into a lightly greased bowl; turn dough over so greased side is up. Cover and allow to rise to double in bulk. Knead down and divide into 18 portions. Shape into balls; lightly butter and coat with sugar-cinnamon mixture (1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon).

title: No Peeky Chicken
instructions: Put rice milk soups and Kitchen Bouquet in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir. Place chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle with dry onion mix. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 2 hours. \Dont peek.\

title: Not Just Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes. Cut lengthwise wedge across top of potatoes 1-inch wide and 1-inch deep. Remove wedge. Place bacon and green onions in corner of wedge. Add butter. Replace wedge and wrap in foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potato is done.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix soups onions and green chilies with a dash of salt. Layer the pan with tortillas dipped in oil. Layer that with chicken. Pour 1/2 soup mixture then top with cheese. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Baba Ghanouj(Eggplant Puree)
instructions: Place eggplant in a baking pan and bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Remove eggplant and let cool; split open and scoop out pulp; set aside.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger onion green pepper salt and pepper oregano and mushrooms. Cook noodles as directed on package. Combine hamburger mixture and drained egg noodles with remainder of ingredients. Put Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes and uncovered 13 minutes more. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Then add corn syrup sugar margarine and vanilla and mix well. Add pecans. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour into pie crust. Bake on cookie sheet for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Jamie'S Onion Ring Batter
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Beat in egg then add buttermilk until batter is proper consistency. Slice onions thick and dip in batter. Fry in peanut oil until light brown.

title: Blueberry Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Add vanilla. Sift 2 cups flour salt and baking powder together. Add sifted ingredients to creamed mixture stirring thoroughly. Dredge berries in remaining flour. Fold berry mixture gently into creamed mixture. Pour mixture in tube pan that has been greased and coated with sugar. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Mix all ingredients. Cover with 2 cups potato chips or 1/2 package sliced almonds. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut beef into strips. Heat 2 tablespoons of margarine in skillet. Add mushrooms onions and garlic. Cover and simmer until onions are tender. Remove from skillet.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces; cook until crisp. Drain on absorbent paper. Spread on bottom of pie shell. Beat eggs cream and seasonings just enough to blend. Stir in cheese; pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until pie shell is golden brown and filling is firm. Serves 4 as an entree 8 to 12 as an appetizer.

title: No Bake Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and 1 cup canned milk in heavy saucepan stirring constantly. Remove from heat. In another bowl mix wafer crumbs marshmallows pecans powdered sugar and salt. Reserve 1/2 cup chocolate mixture for glaze. Stir remaining chocolate mixture into crumb mixture and mix well. Press into greased pan (9-inches). Stir remaining canned milk into the reserved chocolate mixture until smooth and spread over mixture in pan. Chill until glaze is set then cut into 36 squares.

title: Molasses Crinkles
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Sift together and stir in the remaining ingredients. Chill dough. (You can make the day before or longer and freeze dough.) Take out of refrigerator; cut in thin slices. Cut each slice into 4 sections. Roll each section into balls the size of marbles or walnuts. Dip tops of balls in sugar. Place balls sugared side up 3 inches apart on greased baking sheet. Touch each cookie with your finger dipped in water to dampen sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven; add zucchini onion green pepper carrot celery and garlic. Saute 15 minutes over medium heat. Stir in next 9 ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Uncover and simmer another 45 minutes until sauce is thickened stirring occasionally. Combine water and salt; bring to a boil. Add lasagna noodles and boil uncovered for 12 to 15 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Spread 1/4 of the sauce in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with three noodles and one-quarter of cheeses. Repeat until remaining ingredients are used. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand five minutes before serving. Serves 8.

title: Coconut Bread
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In large bowl combine sugar oil eggs and extract. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk; stir just until moistened. Fold in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 by 4 1/2 inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until bread tests done. Cool 10 minutes in pans before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Crab Meat Spread
instructions: Combine soup cheese and onion in pan. Heat until cheese melts stirring. Blend in mayonnaise. Remove from heat. In small saucepan sprinkle gelatin over water. Over low heat stir until dissolved. Stir into soup mixture. Add crab meat and celery. Pour mixture into a 6-cup mold that has been greased with mayonnaise. Refrigerate until firm. Serve as spread with crackers.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat cake mix vanilla pudding oil sour cream eggs and vanilla with mixer for 2 minutes. Combine nuts sugar and cinnamon together. Grease and flour tube pan. Layer cake mix and nuts three times. Top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Biscuit Pudding
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except biscuits and cinnamon in saucepan. Warm then add crumbled biscuits; stir well. Pour into baking dish; sprinkle top with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until it checks done when toothpick is inserted.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In saucepan blend sugar and cornstarch. Combine egg yolks and water; stir gradually into sugar mixture. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat; stir in butter lemon peel and juice and food coloring. Immediately pour into baked pie shell. Heap meringue on hot pie filling; spread over filling carefully sealing the meringue onto edge of crust to prevent shrinking or weeping. Bake about 10 minutes or until delicately browned. Cool pie away from draft.

title: Easy Beef Pie
instructions: Mix and put into 9-inch deep dish pie crust.

title: Mustard Beets
instructions: Bring to a boil all ingredients except beets until sugar is dissolved (use wire whisk to mix in mustard). Add beets. (I sometimes put in slices of sweet onion too.) Simmer uncovered 5 minutes. Cool and put in jars and refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo and peanut butter. Add both brown and white sugars. Cream until light and creamy. Add unbeaten egg and beat well. Add flour which has been sifted with soda. Add vanilla and 1 cup chopped nuts if desired. Roll 1/2 teaspoon in hand to form small ball. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Press flat with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Merry Berry Heaven
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cranberry sauce and rind. Add juice. Chill until thickened. Fold in Cool Whip topping. Chill again until mixture will mound. Pour in pie shell. Chill until firm (about 3 hours). Garnish with cranberries if desired.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. In a different bowl blend the oil (or shortening) and sugar until creamy. Add the egg and bananas to the sugar mixture; mix well. Add the flour to the sugar mixture slowly in three parts. Pour mixture into a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake for 45 minutes or until you can insert a toothpick in the bread and it comes out dry. Cool before slicing.

title: Skillet Beef And Corn
instructions: In skillet brown meat onion and thyme in oil. Season with pepper if desired. Stir in wine; bring to boil. Simmer uncovered over medium heat about 7 minutes or until liquid is gone. Add tomatoes; reduce heat. Cover and cook 15 minutes or until meat is tender. Uncover and cook 5 minutes more. Add corn and rice; heat through. Garnish with sliced green onions if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread
instructions: Spray pan with Pam!!! Mix all ingredients until well blended. Pour into pan bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Raisin Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Add the milk eggs and raisins. Pour into 3 greased bread pans and let stand 15 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hospitality Punch
instructions: Mix all in punch bowl except 7-Up. Add this just before serving. Add ice float and slice citrus slices.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal. Remove 1 cup of mixture and combine with cinnamon and nuts; set aside. To remaining crumb mixture add milk and baking powder. Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle the reserved crumbs over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into squares. Garnish with whipped topping and a pecan half if desired.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs. Add 3/4 cup sugar. Add milk salt 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 tablespoon butter. Pour over bread. Mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheeseburger Turnovers
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Add salt and pepper (about 1/2 teaspoon salt and 2 shakes of pepper). Roll each biscuit very thin and sprinkle a generous tablespoon of meat on biscuits. Add a half slice of cheese. Fold biscuit over meat and press around edges with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 on cookie sheet until brown.

title: Delicious Fruit Cake
instructions: Pour 1/4 cup brandy over raisins and currants; let soak while you chop and slice other fruits and nuts. Mix all fruit and dredge with 3 cups flour. Sift rest of flour with soda baking powder and spices. Cream butter; add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add well beaten egg yolks molasses figs and strawberries and blend. Add fruits and nuts. Fold in dry ingredients. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add to batter. Turn into pans (lined with wax paper). Fill pans 3/4 full. Bake at 250\u00b0 for about 3 hours for 2 pound cake and 4 hours for 5 pound cake. Brush tops and sides with Brown Sugar Glaze.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add milk flour sugar melted margarine and dash of salt and pour into baking dish. Sprinkle nutmeg over top and bake at 300\u00b0 until done. Will turn golden brown.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: In food processor chop fine the onion peppers and chiles. Melt butter and saute the chopped vegetables. Add Velveeta and the Monterey Jack cheese shredded. Add milk to thin. Cook on stove or in microwave.

title: Crab Melt Aways
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and spread on muffin halves. Cut in quarters and freeze. When ready to serve place under broiler until browned.

title: Mexican Chip Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and ground beef; drain. Combine all ingredients and put in crock-pot to keep warm. Use as a hearty appetizer or party snack with corn chips or tortilla chips.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Put flour in a mixing bowl; cut butter in with a pastry cutter until crumbly. Add buttermilk and stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead a few times. Pat or roll dough out to 1/2 or 3/4-inch thickness. Cut out with a 2 1/2-inch round cutter. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet; bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 12 to 14 minutes. Brush tops with a little melted butter.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Will also need 1 punch bowl.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Bake about 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix well. Pour into butter-greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Set dish in a shallow pan holding 1-inch of hot water. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Yam Sticks
instructions: On baking sheet bake yam at 400\u00b0 until just tender 35 to 40 minutes (do not overbake); let yam cool then peel and discard skin. Cut potato into 2 x 1/4-inch sticks.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Bring to a boil sour cherries and sugar. While hot add jello pineapple orange juice and pecans. Pour into large mold. Refrigerate until set and unmold.

title: Quick Cottage Cheese Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix jello powder with cottage cheese. Stir in Cool Whip. Add drained fruit and chill for 1 hour. Serve.

title: Golden Angel Food Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy add cream of tartar beat until stiff but not dry. Add sugar a little at a time and beat. Fold in flour. Beat egg yolks until very light and fluffy. Fold in egg white mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into angel food pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Prepare lime Jell-O. Fold in crushed pineapple. Chill in an 8-inch pan. Add mayonnaise and chopped nuts to cream cheese mixture. Spread over Jell-O and chill. Prepare red Jell-O. When it begins to set pour over cheese layer. Let salad completely set before turning out on plate.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: In blender mix first 7 ingredients in order listed. Pour into lightly greased 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 40 to 45 minutes or until knife test done. The finished result will be pie crust coconut custard filling and shredded coconut topping.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Cook 8 potatoes with skins on. When done let cool completely. Peel potatoes and cube. Put in crock-pot. Add the rest of ingredients. Cook on high for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Turn to low. Serve.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in large mixing bowl. Beat 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool 15 minutes then fill and top with Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen beans according to directions. Drain mushrooms chestnuts and bean sprouts thoroughly. Mix beans with remaining ingredients except cheese. Turn into casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Pour pineapple over marshmallows. Add mandarin oranges and coconut. Add nuts and sour cream; mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Hash Brown Quiche
instructions: Press potatoes into greased quiche dish to form crust. Pour butter over potatoes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Fill crust with cheese and meat. Combine milk and eggs. Beat well and pour over cheese and meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until knife tip inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Creamy Tuna Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Take other ingredients and mix together with cream cheese. Serve with crackers or tortilla chips.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix together the margarine cocoa milk and sugar. Let come to a boil. Boil for 1 minute then add peanut butter oatmeal and vanilla. Mix well and drop on wax paper.

title: Oatmeal Spice Cookies
instructions: Pour cake mix and oats into bowl; mix. Add eggs oil and nuts; stir until dry mixture is completely moist. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a cookie sheet treated with oil or cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Do not overcook. For moist cookies place warm cookies in a sealed container. For crisp cookies cool first and then place in container. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Pull Candy
instructions: Put ingredients in cooker. Boil to 240\u00b0. Add butter. Boil to 260\u00b0. Pour on buttered marble slab. Pull.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine cream cheese 1 cup pecans and remaining ingredients until thoroughly blended. Shape in a ball and roll remaining pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Place asparagus in casserole dish. Pour on soup. Sprinkle with crackers add cheese on top.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time beating after each one. Add wafer crumbs nuts and coconut. Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Baked Chinese Dish
instructions: Brown onion celery ground beef and soy sauce together. Add soups water Worcestershire sauce and stir until smooth over medium heat. Add rice; mix well. Pour in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Put chow mein noodles on top; bake 10 minutes longer with cover off.

title: Louisiana Cornbread Salad
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole or larger layer the ingredients twice in this order cornbread beans vegetables and bacon. Top with cheese. Mix sour cream and salsa together and spread over entire top of dish so no air holes are showing. Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Tropical Ambrosia
instructions: Dump Cool Whip in a large mixing bowl with a lid. Drain pineapple and oranges. Mix into Cool Whip. Add nuts and mix. Add marshmallows and coconut if desired and mix. Chill.

title: Layered Vegetable Vinaigrette(Serves 8. Preparation :20.  Stand 1:00.  Total 1:20.)
instructions: Mix dressing (first 4 ingredients) in a jar. Shake well. Scrub or peel carrots and slice into rounds. Steam green beans for 5 minutes; drain. Slice tomatoes cucumbers and mushrooms into slices. Layer vegetables in a serving dish and top with dressing. Refrigerate 1 hour or more before serving.

title: Easy New Potatoes
instructions: Cube well washed and unpeeled potatoes (about size of a quarter); enough potatoes to cover a cookie sheet in a single layer. Coat quartered potatoes with oil then coat them with the onion soup mix. Spray cookie sheet with Pam and spread potatoes on it. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Green Gook
instructions: Break up cake into small pieces in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix together pudding and milk until thickened and thoroughly blended. Add Cool Whip. Mix well. Pour over cake. Stir lightly. Refrigerate.

title: Kids Stuff
instructions: Brown ground beef. Cook elbow noodles until slightly tender; drain. Add tomato soup cream-style corn and beef to noodles. Pour into greased baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Grate enough carrots to fill the next to large mixing bowl. Mix with onion raisins drained pineapple and mayonnaise. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook over medium heat for 2 hours.

title: No-Bake Peanut Oat Cookies
instructions: In a medium saucepan mix sugar and cocoa. Add milk and butter. Put over medium heat and bring to a boil; boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and oats.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Pour into 3 greased cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until done. Spread filling on first 2 layers and Caramel Frosting on top of third layer and sides. Top with pecan halves.

title: Mei Ling'S Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Combine sauce juice sugar oil flour and salt; mix well. Pour into skillet. Cook stirring until mixture comes to a boil and thickens slightly. Add chicken pineapple water chestnuts and ginger. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes. Serve over rice. Sprinkle with nuts. Serves 6 to 8.

title: New Orleans Pralines
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Press firmly into well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan. Bake in preheated very hot oven (450\u00b0) for about 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. (Mixture will be golden brown and bubbly.) Cool thoroughly. Cut into bars. Makes 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan of bars.

title: Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Place each chicken breast on a sheet of waxed paper. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Combine eggs salt and pepper. Dip chicken breasts into egg mixture and roll each in bread crumbs. Brown chicken in hot oil in a large skillet. Drain on paper towels. Place chicken in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Drain oil from skillet. Combine tomato sauce basil and garlic powder in skillet. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes or until thickened. Stir in butter. Pour mixture over chicken. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and arrange Mozzarella cheese slices on top. Bake 10 additional minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Layer the bottom of a large bowl with the pieces of angel cake. Mix sour cream Cool Whip and powdered sugar to form cream mixture and pour on top of cake pieces.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in casserole. Dot with margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Green Beans, New Potatoes And Bacon
instructions: Put everything in a pan with water and cook for several hours until done.

title: Golden Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine crumbs cheese parsley and seasonings. Melt oleo with garlic in shallow dish. Dip chicken in butter and then in crumbs. Place in baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Dont turn. Baste with pan drippings.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease the bottom of a loaf pan (about 9 x 5 x 3-inch) with oil or shortening. Place egg and milk in a medium size bowl and beat until blended. Add the other ingredients. Stir to blend and beat vigorously for 1 minute. Pour batter into prepared baking pan. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until top of loaf springs back when touched with your fingers. Place on a rack to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before removing from pan. Slice and serve warm. Leftover bread is extra good sliced and toasted.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch squares; marinate chicken in 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed. Quickly stir-fry chicken in hot vegetable oil. Drain and remove chicken from heat. Mix in a separate bowl 2 tablespoons soy sauce cooking wine sugar Chinese brown vinegar 1 teaspoon cornstarch sesame oil salt and hot pepper sauce; set aside. Stir-fry minced ginger in remaining oil. Add chicken and the sauce; set aside until thickened and thoroughly heated. Remove from heat; mix in peanuts.

title: Candied Pecans
instructions: Melt butter in cookie sheet. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes stirring every 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Punch
instructions: Combine sugar 1 cup water salt and spices in large pan. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer. Combine cranberry sauce and 3 1/2 cups water in blender. Gradually add cranberry mixture and cider to sugar syrup. Heat to just below simmering and serve.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Bake in large roaster at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours. Stir well every 1/2 hour.

title: Tomatoes With Honey And Black Pepper
instructions: To make this salad peel a large tomato cut it into slices and spread each slice with honey. Sprinkle the slices with salt and pepper then reassemble the tomato. Brush with more honey and give a sprinkle with salt and pepper. Refrigerate for 20 minutes. Serve cool.

title: Creamy Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.

title: Creamy Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except fruit; mix until well blended. Refrigerate covered 1 to 2 hours to allow flavors to blend. Serve with fresh fruit \dippers.\ Will keep covered in refrigerator up to 5 days. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish. Put several pats of butter on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Tree Bark
instructions: Line large cookie sheet with tinfoil. Arrange saltines to cover tray. Combine butter and brown sugar. Pour over crackers and bake at 400\u00b0 for seven minutes. Remove and pour one cup chocolate chips over. Spread until melted. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Lift and break into pieces.

title: Cinnamon French Toast
instructions: Mix eggs salt milk and cinnamon. Dip bread in egg mixture. Brown both sides on lightly greased griddle.

title: Venison Pot Roast
instructions: The day before cooking season venison thoroughly with salt and pepper. Stuff meat with garlic and refrigerate overnight. Brown venison in hot oil. Remove roast. Add flour and water stirring constantly to make a light brown roux. Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Add onion and return to Dutch oven. Cover; cook slowly for 5 hours or until tender.

title: My Favorite Apple Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add apples mix well. Line a 10 or 12-inch baking dish with pastry add apple mixture. Pour apple juice around edge (not on apples). Cover with top pastry sealing edges. Cut slits in top. Brush with margarine sprinkle with white sugar. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until juice bubbles through slits. This is a deep-dish pie. Pan must be at least two inches deep.

title: Zucchini Fruit Loaves
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients together until thick and foamy. Add zucchini and fruit and stir. Sift together next 6 dry ingredients; combine with last two (nuts and raisins) and add to first mixture.

title: Pineapple Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare lemon jello as per directions on box. Refrigerate until partially gelled. With electric mixer mix in cream cheese until smooth. Stir in pineapple and pecans. Refrigerate until gelled.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Put all ingredients in mixer and beat until fluffy. Pour in a greased casserole.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: 1st Layer Add melted butter to pretzels and sugar; mix well and bake for 6 minutes. Let cool while preparing 2nd layer.

title: Beefed-Up Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place dried beef slices evenly around chicken breasts. Tuck edges of beef under chicken. Place in 8-inch square baking dish. Combine soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes. Remove cover and sprinkle with almonds. Continue baking at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Meringue Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 200\u00b0. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine egg whites and salt in a large bowl. Beat with an electric mixer on a medium-high speed until soft peaks form 1 to 2 minutes. Increase speed to high. Add sugar gradually in a slow steady stream beating until stiff shiny peaks form 2 to 4 minutes. Add strawberry flavoring and food coloring; mix until just combined. Spoon meringue mixture into pastry bag fitted with star tip. Pipe meringue into 2-inch mounds on prepared baking sheets. Bake until cookies are dry and crisp about 1 hour and 35 minutes. Turn off oven; let cookies stand in oven with door closed for 5 minutes. Remove from oven; cool 3 minutes. Remove from parchment paper; place on wire rack to cool completely.

title: Sweet Roll Dough
instructions: In mixing bowl dissolve yeast in water. Stir in milk sugar and salt. Add eggs shortening and half the flour. Stir with spoon. Add the rest of flour. Turn unto floured board. Knead until smooth about 5 minutes. Round-up in greased bowl. Cover with damp cloth. Let rise until double about 1 1/2 hours in warm place. Punch down. Shape into rolls or coffee cake. Let rise until double about 30 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Bread
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients with an electric mixer then add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Put mixture into greased and powdered sugared pans. Bake for 60 to 90 minutes at 350\u00b0. Fill loaf pans half full.

title: Salad Dressing For Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oil then add oil slowly until mixed well.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Pat graham cracker crumbs melted margarine and 1 tablespoon sugar in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat 1 egg soft margarine salt and confectioners sugar for 10 minutes until very creamy; pour over graham cracker crumbs. Slice 4 to 5 bananas over mixture. Drain crushed pineapple; spread over bananas. Add cut up strawberries over bananas and pineapple. Spread Cool Whip over fruit. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Chill overnight.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and roll in 1/2 cup nuts. Chill. Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Vegetables Mexicali
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add zucchini onion and green pepper and saute for 5 minutes. Add eggs and stir until barely set. Remove skillet from heat; stir in chilies salt black pepper and cumin. In a small bowl blend flour and sour cream. Arrange 1/2 of tortilla wedges in a shallow 2-quart casserole or 8-inch square baking dish. Add 1/2 of vegetable mixture then 1/2 of sour cream mixture. Top with 1/2 of the cheese. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dean'S Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Peel and chop onions. In large pot cover onions with water and boil until onions are soft and mushy. Mix in ground beef stirring to separate. Add more water if necessary. Heat until meat is gray. Add tomatoes mashing with spoon; then add salt pepper and chili powder. Cook over low heat until thick stirring often. Skim off excess fat.

title: Cocktail Bread With Cucumber
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Spread on slices of rye cocktail bread. Top with a slice of cucumber. Sprinkle with dill weed.

title: Misericordia Crabcakes
instructions: Melt butter and shortening in top of double boiler. Add onion; let simmer over direct heat about 15 minutes or until onion is very tender but do not brown or burn it. Take pan from heat; let cool a moment then stir in flour. Be careful the butter mixture is not too hot or the flour will get lumpy. Stir milk in gradually making smooth. Add and stir seasonings. Place over boiling water and stir constantly until sauce is thickened and well blended. Pour this thick sauce over the picked over crab meat. Mix well and refrigerate overnight. Shape the chilled mixture into patties about 1 inch thick. Roll them in the fine breadcrumbs to coat all over and lower them carefully into hot fat deep enough to cover them completely and fry to a deep golden brown. Lift out with slotted pancake lifter and let them drain a moment on absorbent paper. Serve piping hot.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Place rack in middle of oven and preheat to 350\u00b0.

title: Jumbo Oat Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar butter or margarine and corn syrup until fluffy. Add egg whites and extract; mix well. Gradually add combined remaining ingredients; mix well. Drop 1/4 cup measure about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Press into 3-inch circles. Bake 14 to 16 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool 1 minute; remove to aluminum foil. Store lightly covered. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Salsa Verde
instructions: Peel core and chop tomatoes. Chop peppers. Mix all together. Add salt and black pepper to taste. Bring just to a boil. Ladle into hot pint jars. Add 1 teaspoon lemon juice and/or vinegar to each jar. Adjust lids.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar; add eggs food coloring vanilla and lemon flavoring. Sift together flour soda and cocoa. Add the vinegar to the buttermilk. Alternating add the flour mixture and the buttermilk to the creamed mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean (15 to 20 minutes). Use 3 greased and floured 8-inch round cake pans or one 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Chinese Chews Cookie
instructions: Mix together butter brown sugar eggs nuts and dates.

title: Tomato-Topped Chicken And Stuffing
instructions: Crush 1/2 cup stuffing. In small bowl combine crushed stuffing and margarine. Set aside. In a 3-quart saucepan over high heat heat water to boiling. Remove from heat; add remaining stuffing. Toss to mix well.

title: Chicken Enchilada
instructions: Saute onion and garlic. Add tomatoes chicken and bouillon simmer 15 minutes. Add Cheddar cheese. Spoon into tortillas roll up and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with Swiss cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Curried Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise curry powder soy sauce and lemon juice. Add to chicken mixture. Chill and serve.

title: Cowboy Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Mix with all other ingredients in large pot and cook 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix together. Put in punch bowl. Add the sherbet at that time.

title: Potato Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Add mashed potatoes sour cream and yeast mixture. Add flour and salt; knead well. Brush with melted butter. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Shape in desired form and place on greased pan. Let rise for 1 hour or more. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven about 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Blend all ingredients except crackers. Mix well. Pour over crackers to coat them. Put crackers on a cookie sheet. Place in warm oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter until tender. Cook noodles and chicken. Chop the chicken. Combine onion celery water soup noodles and chicken. Mix well. Add 1/2 cup cheese. Mix well. Pour into greased dish and top with remaining cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cinnamon And Raisin Bread(Bread Machine)
instructions: Add ingredients to the bread pan in the order that they are listed except the raisins. Select setting to Basic. Change crust color or leave it at medium. Press Start/Stop to begin. Add the raisins when beeping sounds during kneading. Display will read 220. When display read 000 press Start/Stop for 3 seconds to cancel. Use oven mitts to handle hot bread pan.

title: One-Step Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Combine beef and spaghetti sauce. Spread 1/3 of mixture in lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on sauce. Layer 1 cup cottage cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese over noodles. Spoon 1/2 of remaining sauce over cheese. Top with 4 noodles 1 cup cottage cheese 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and remaining sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Circuit Preacher Scripture Cake
instructions: Follow the directions of Solomon for bringing up a child (Proverbs 2314). Bake in a tube pan at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour or longer if necessary. Cool on a rack. Slices best after a few hours.

title: Cheeseburger Pie(Weight Watchers Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown turkey onion and green pepper in skillet. Add tomato sauce chili powder and garlic powder. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes. Add cooked macaroni and 3 ounces of cheese. Stir until cheese melts. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish that has been sprayed with a nonstick spray. Sprinkle remaining 1 ounce of cheese on top. Bake 30 minutes. Remove and let set 10 to 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook first 8 ingredients until tender. Add milk mixed with flour. Add chicken bouillon cube. Last add cubed Velveeta cheese. Stir until cheese is melted.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix cloves ginger and cinnamon together in small container. Mix all ingredients including spices together. Chill one hour. Shape into balls and roll in sugar. Cookies will flatten in baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Stir sugar milk butter and cocoa together. Bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from stove add oats peanut butter nuts and vanilla. Stir well. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.

title: Cobbler Dough
instructions: Stir with a fork until blended. Drop by spoonfuls over fruit. Bake in an 8-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs(Easter Candy)
instructions: Mix well the powdered sugar peanut butter margarine and vanilla. Form into balls or patties or form mixture into egg shapes; dip in chocolate for Easter.

title: Eggplant And Yogurt
instructions: Fry eggplant until they are golden brown. Add salt pepper and water to yogurt. Take eggplant out of the oil and put cumin seed in the oil until brown. Put half of the cumin in yogurt.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Put the hot water and soda over the dates and let stand while you mix up the rest then put all together. Cook 1 cup brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups boiling water until sugar dissolves. Pour over pudding batter before baking. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Crisp Bars
instructions: Combine sugar Karo and salt. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Blend in peanut butter. Stir in cereal. Pat evenly in a foil lined pan. In small pan melt oleo and brown sugar. Remove from fire. Add milk and vanilla. Beat in powdered sugar until smooth. Remove cookie mixture from pan. Peel off foil and spread top with icing. Chill and cut in small bars.

title: Zucchini Jelly
instructions: Boil grated zucchini and sugar for 6 minutes; add lemon juice pineapple and Pen-Jell. Boil 6 minutes more. Put in sterilized jelly jars. Melt paraffin and pour on top to seal.

title: Orange Delight
instructions: Mix dry Jell-O with pineapple and add cottage cheese Cool Whip and marshmallows. Mix well.

title: Frozen Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix well with mixer until soft and creamy. Pour half of mixture into each pie crust. Sprinkle coconut mixture over Cool Whip mixture. Drizzle half caramel topping over coconut mixture. Layer; repeat each mixture again. Finish with caramel topping. Wrap well and put in freezer overnight. Keeps well for 3 months in freezer.

title: Wieners In A Pot
instructions: Place dogs in pot cover with water. Place on stove and bring to boil. When wieners are hot take out of pot and put into buns.

title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix flour salt and soda. Set aside. Mix fat and peanut butter. Add both kinds sugar. Mix well. Add eggs and mix well. Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mix. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Melt the margarine in a 10-cup refrigerator container using the microwave oven. Takes about 1 minute on High. Add everything else but the flour. Beat. Add the flour and mix well. Refrigerate until you are ready to bake muffins. May bake immediately or wait 2 to 3 days.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Mix remaining ingredients with broccoli and put into a well greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: No Bake French Cream Cake
instructions: Place 1 cup crumbs in ungreased 8 inch square pan. Thoroughly cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Spread carefully over crumbs. Combine cream nuts and pineapple. Spread over creamed mixture then sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Let stand 18 to 24 hours in refrigerator. Cut into squares and serve. May top with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Serves 12 - 16.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken.\tDo not salt.\tPick off bones and put aside. Save broth. Melt margarine and stir into dressing. In\ta greased dish (9 x 13-inch) put a layer of dressing crumbs a layer of chicken then a layer of mushroom or celery soup (diluted with 1 can of broth). Again layer the crumbs chicken and can of cream of chicken soup (diluted with 1 can of broth). Top with crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour (or until brown). Use no salt at all.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix sauce Accent cheese and 1 package beef. Cover and set 24 hours. Wrap ball with remaining beef and serve.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Put popped popcorn and peanuts in a big roaster or pan. Put brown sugar white syrup and oleo in saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Add soda and immediately pour over popcorn and peanuts. Put in oven and toss every 15 minutes for 1 hour. Spread on wax paper to cool.

title: Fruited Chicken And Rice Skillet
instructions: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken. Cook and stir 3 minutes. Drain; reduce heat to medium. Stir in combined dressing juice and sugar. Add rice and green pepper. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add oranges and pineapple. Let stand covered 5 minutes. I also add pea pods. Preparation time 10 minutes. Cooking time 10 minutes plus standing. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mickey Mouse Salad
instructions: Wash off the lettuce and place on plate. Lay a pear half on the lettuce. Cut cherries in half then place on the end of the pear for a mouth. Use two raisins for eyes and two pecans for his ears to make a Mickey Mouse face.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Place roast in large crockpot. Add all other ingredients. Cook on low 8 hours.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Roll into balls and bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: French Apple Cream Pie
instructions: Put crust in pie pan and fill with apples. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Mix egg sugar lemon juice cream cheese and sour cream. Mix until smooth. Pour over sugar and cinnamon apples. Put crust on top and bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cook 40-45 minutes at 400 degrees.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
instructions: Cook 1st four ingredients; stir over medium heat until mixture boils and is bubbling over top. Stir 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla flavoring and chocolate bits. Stir until melted. Stir in nuts. Spread in buttered pan. Cool thoroughly.

title: Potato Dumplings
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Put bread in the middle of a ball formed around the piece of bread. Place in boiling water. Simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with roast beef roast pork etc.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Melt first three ingredients for 2 to 4 minutes on High. Stir. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until soft.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Add onions and cook slowly until soft. Add sugar and salt. Stir and cook one minute. Boil water and melt bouillon cubes. Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Add brandy or cooking sherry. Cook and cover on low 4 to 6 hours. Spoon into soup crocks. Top each crock with toasted French bread. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 servings. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Best Yet Pineapple Cake
instructions: Blend together butter cream cheese sour cream and sugar. Add undrained pineapple and coconut; blend. Sprinkle with dry pudding mix as it comes in the package. Fold in whipped topping. Use to fill and frost layers of yellow cake.

title: Diabetic Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients and add to applesauce mixture. Dough will be thick. Pour into well-greased loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook vermicelli al dente. Combine all ingredients. Mix well so that everything is coated. Chill before serving.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs and milk together. Combine dry mustard salt and pepper. Add to egg and milk mixture. Line bottom of a 13 x 9-inch dish with bread. Cover with sausage. Pour egg mixture over sausage. Top with grated cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can freeze up to 6 weeks.

title: Sweet And Sour Venison Stew
instructions: Brown the venison cubes in the oil in a heavy skillet. Add the rest of the ingredients (except parsley) and cover. Simmer for 2 1/2 hours. Add water during simmering if needed. Thicken with instant flour and serve over hot buttered noodles.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in greased baking dish for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm (leftovers are also good cold).

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Slice Twinkies in half and place cream side up in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice bananas on top of Twinkies. Prepare pudding as per directions and combine with well drained pineapple. Pour this over bananas. Next smooth Cool Whip over top and sprinkle on nuts. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Line spring pan with Lady Fingers. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler; beat in egg yolks one at a time. Beat whites until frothy; add sugar to beaten whites. In bowl blend 1/4 of white with chocolate mixture. Fold in remaining whites. Fold in Cool Whip and vanilla. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts Oriental
instructions: Combine all ingredients and set aside for 15 minutes. Heat grill charcoal grill or broiler. Place breasts on hot grill cooking on each side until done about 5 to 10 minutes on each side depending on size of breasts.

title: Pecan Fingers
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening and confectioners sugar. Blend in flour. Press evenly in bottom of ungreased pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread over hot baked layer and bake 20 minutes longer. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Lemon Angel Food Cake
instructions: Use the whole egg and prepare pudding as directed on box. Tear angel food cakes in 1-inch pieces. Alternate with pudding (layer cakes then layer pudding) in cake pan. Put in refrigerator for several hours. Invert cake in plate after chilling and ice with Cool Whip.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Place beans in a Dutch oven with water. Bring to a boil; simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Drain and rinse beans. Return to Dutch oven with broth garlic and bay leaves; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 1 1/4 hours. Stir in all remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until beans and vegetables are tender and gravy is thick. Remove bay leaves. Serve over rice. Makes 12 servings.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: First Layer Crush pretzels add sugar and margarine. Mix. Spread in 11 x 14-inch Pyrex. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake(16 Servings)
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Grease and lightly flour three 9-inch cake pans. In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar using an electric mixer if possible. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. The mixture should be smooth and creamy. Using a spoon add one-third of the milk. Repeat until flour and milk are incorporated. It is important that ingredients be folded in; batter should not be beaten after flour has been introduced. Stir in vanilla. Distribute batter evenly among three cake pans and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until layers are golden brown and spring back when gently pressed in the middle. Cool for about 5 minutes and turn layers out of pans.

title: 7-Up Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening together and beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add flour alternately with lemon extract and 7-Up. Pour batter into well-greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. When thoroughly cool sift powdered sugar over cake. This cake freezes well and stays moist. Serves 16.

title: Vegetable Pie
instructions: Line a 10-inch pie plate with crusts. Defrost vegetables but do not cook. Mix milk with soup. Stir vegetables into soup. Pour mixture into crust. Cover with sliced cheese. Cover with top crust. Vent. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix last 3 ingredients in bowl and set aside. Beat remaining ingredients together until smooth. Grease tube pan. Put layer of batter layer of apples several times ending up with apples on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Serves 15 people.

title: Pan Toasted Fish
instructions: Place fish in shallow baking dish and cover with milk. Refrigerate 1 hour. Drain and pat dry. Combine egg white and lemon juice in a separate shallow dish and set aside. Combine oat bran paprika and black pepper. Dip fillets in egg mixture then oat mixture. Saut in oil in nonstick skillet 3 minutes on each side or until evenly browned. Serves 4.

title: Ginger-Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Arrange wings evenly in the bottom of a shallow dish. Combine soy sauce honey arrowroot vinegar ginger and garlic in a bowl. Pour marinade evenly over top. Cover and chill up to 4 hours. Remove wings from marinade. Arrange on broiler pan. Cook turning and basting with the marinade several times for 15 to 20 minutes or until done to your liking.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Line a 9-inch pan with pastry 1/8 inch thick. Combine ingredients adding pecans last. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 35 minutes longer or until a silver knife inserted in center of filling comes out clear.

title: Cold Chicken Curry
instructions: Cook rice; refrigerate until cool. Toss rice cauliflower and French dressing; cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. In a large bowl combine the mayonnaise curry powder salt and pepper. Stir in milk. Add chicken and toss. Refrigerate for 2 hours. In a large bowl mix the rice and chicken. Add green pepper celery and onion. Turn on platter lined with romaine leaves. Top with almonds.

title: Sausage Soup
instructions: Brown and drain sausage and onions. Combine all ingredients in large pot and simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. May be thinned with more broth or water. May be frozen.

title: Shepards Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add onions. Cook until onion softens. Add tomato soup and beans. In a bowl put mashed potatoes plus eggs (beaten with a fork) and grated cheese.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar until light and well blended. Beat in oil. Sift dry ingredients together; beat into egg mixture. Add pumpkin and mix well. Pour into well-greased and floured 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until cake tests done. Let stand in pan 10 minutes. Turn onto rack to cool. Serve with whipped cream or ice with cream cheese icing.

title: Easy Spicy-Sweet Chicken
instructions: Pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness; sprinkle with salt to taste. Cook chicken in oil in 10-inch skillet over medium heat cooked through about 5 minutes on each side. Remove from skillet and reserve. Increase heat to medium-high. Add picante sauce marmalade and peas to skillet; mix well. Cook and stir 3 minutes or until sauce has thickened. Return chicken to skillet; spoon sauce over chicken and heat through about 1 minute. Serve with additional picante sauce if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Sticky Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Thaw bread dough at room temperature (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Tear off bread dough in two-inch balls. Place in greased pan. Melt butter and add remaining ingredients. Pour over balls. Let rise 2 hours at room temperature. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Dorothy'S Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of muffin tins or use paper liners. Beat egg melted margarine and milk. Combine dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Stir until flour is moistened. Stir in marmalade mixing well. Divide equally into 12 prepared muffin tin cups. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onions until tender. Drain well. Add butter and mix well. Fold in remaining ingredients. Place in buttered casserole and top with layer of cracker crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Easy Lasagna Ii
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine meat and spaghetti sauce. Mix eggs into cottage cheese. Spread a thin layer of sauce in pan. Add a layer of the uncooked lasagne noodles a layer of the cottage cheese mixture a layer of cut up Mozzarella and a generous layer of sauce. Repeat layers ending with the sauce. Cover tightly with heavy-duty foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand covered outside of oven for 12 to 20 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breast
instructions: Arrange chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9 1/2-inch baking dish. Top with cheese. Combine soup and wine; stir well. Spoon evenly over chicken. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Rocky Road Candy
instructions: In heavy saucepan over low heat melt morsels with Eagle Brand milk and margarine. Remove from heat. In a large bowl combine nuts and marshmallows; stir in chocolate mixture. Spread in wax paper lined 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill for 2 hours or until firm. Remove from pan; peel off paper and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Four Fruit Compote
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 3/4 cup juice. In a saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch. Add pineapple juice orange juice and lemon juice. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute longer. Remove from the heat and set aside. In a bowl combine fruit. Pour warm sauce over the fruit. Stir gently to coat. Cover and refrigerate. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Chili Dip (A Hit)(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Use microwave or conventional oven. Put Hormel chili in bowl. Cut Velveeta in small chunks. Place in chili. Drain chilies and mix with chili and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or microwave until cheese is melted. Stir frequently. Dip with nacho chips.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Then add buttermilk raisins dates and nuts. Cream the rest of ingredients together. Mix together all ingredients in large bowl. Makes about a gallon. Cook in a 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a large heavy pan place sugar oleo and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until ingredients melt. Continue cooking to soft ball stage 235\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Quickly stir in marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Pour into two 8 x 8 x 2-inch pans (buttered). Cut into squares when cold. You may add nuts or use crunchy peanut butter.

title: Microwavable Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Put butter into glass microwavable tray. Microwave for 30 seconds. Add marshmallows into tray; microwave 2 to 3 minutes. Add Rice Krispies cereal evenly. Mix evenly. Set to cool for 10 minutes. Cut into squares and enjoy.

title: Magic Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except potatoes in large bowl. Shape into a loaf. Place in crock-pot. Place potatoes at the sides of loaf. (If potatoes are peeled wrap in foil to keep from darkening.) Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours on high for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Mix together shortening brown sugar and egg. Stir in applesauce. Sift flour baking soda salt and spices and mix well together. Add nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake until golden brown in a 375\u00b0 oven for about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Fresh And Creamy Potato Salad
instructions: Combine potatoes celery green peppers onion and salt; mix lightly. Combine cream cheese sour cream and milk mixing until well blended. Add to potato mixture; mix lightly. Chill. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Fried Round Steak
instructions: Pound steak thoroughly. Cut in serving pieces. Blend egg and milk. Dip meat in egg mixture then in crumbs. Slowly brown meat in hot oil (iron skillet works well) turning once. Season with salt and pepper; cover. Cook over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes or until tender. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
instructions: Mix flour pineapple 1 1/2 cups sugar and soda. Pour in ungreased pan. Cut butter into pats and place on top. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix together 3/4 cup sugar butter cream and nuts. Cook slow until thickened. Pour over cake when cake is done.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cranberries then add pineapple sugar nuts and oranges. Jellied cranberry sauce also can be used instead of whole cranberries. Put into glass dish or mold.

title: Chicken And Ham Party Salads
instructions: Put chicken through meat grinder (hand operated). Mix with other ingredients in a bowl.

title: Pizza Omelet(Serves 2)
instructions: Allow 3 eggs for 2 servings. For each egg add 1 tablespoon evaporated milk 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper. Beat eggs slightly; beat in milk and seasonings. Heat 1 tablespoon butter in heavy skillet and add eggs and cook slowly.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Blend all together except 1 teaspoon soda. Cook until thick in double boiler; add soda. Pour puffed up filling in pie shell. Cover with meringue made from the 3 egg whites. Put in oven to brown.

title: New Moon Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar well. Add egg yolks and beat well about 5 minutes. Sift flour salt and baking powder together and add in 3 parts to creamed mixture blending it well. Add vanilla. Clean beaters and beat egg whites in another bowl until stiff but not dry. Pour on top of the batter and with spatula or rubber scraper fold in gently. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dust with flour. Pour in batter and spread to corners. Sprinkle with walnuts and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Lightly dust with powdered sugar while warm.
