Cool and cut with a serrated round cookie cutter so you will have half moon shaped little cakes.

title: Chicken Breasts In Sour Cream
instructions: Mix flour and sour cream. Add cream of mushroom soup and white wine. Mix in pepper and garlic salt. Place chicken breasts into baking dish. Add mixture onto top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 90 minutes. If desired you can then turn onto broil until top is slightly brown. Served with brown rice is good.

title: Cinnamon Toast
instructions: Heat the oven. Butter 2 pieces of bread. Place cinnamon on bread. Butter the bread. Cook for about 5 minutes.

title: Coconut Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/4 cup water. Cook next nine ingredients in double boiler or in a microwave until slightly thick (12 to 15 minutes). Remove from heat and stir in the gelatine; cool.

title: Oriental Steak Broil
instructions: In a 1-quart saucepan combine the lemon juice oil garlic soy sauce salt pepper and aniseed. Bring to a boil over high heat and stir about 30 seconds or until the salt dissolves. Put the steak into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch non-aluminum baking dish and pierce all over with a fork. Pour the hot marinade over the steak turn the steak over in the marinade to coat it well and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes (or longer if you have time) turning once. Preheat the broiler. Place the steak on the rack of the broiler pan about 2 or 3 inches from the heat. Broil for 5 to 7 minutes per side for medium. Cut the steak on the diagonal into 1/2-inch slices. Makes 4 servings 340 calories per serving.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix margarine and flour together and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool.

title: Berry Banana Smoothie
instructions: Combine ingredients in a blender; cover and blend until smooth. Makes 2 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Skillet Candied Sweet Potatoes(Serves 6)
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet. Stir in brown sugar water and salt. Add sliced potatoes. Cook uncovered over medium heat 10 to 15 minutes or until glazed basting and turning gently 2 or 3 times.

title: Cherry-Chocolate Cups
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir together flour baking powder and salt. Stir into creamed mixture; mix well. Divide dough in half. To one half add nuts and chocolate. Press a rounded teaspoonful of chocolate mixture into the bottom and up sides of ungreased 1 3/4-inch muffin cups. Place a cherry half in the center of each cup. Top with a rounded teaspoonful of the remaining white dough and another cherry half. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 32.

title: Walnut Cheese Patties
instructions: Mix together and form into patties. Fry in small amount of oil (not too hot of pan) until golden brown. Cover with mushroom or onion gravy. Also can be used with tomato sauce. These patties can be made up ahead and frozen until ready to use.

title: Wall Cleaner
instructions: Mix together. Good to wash walls. This does a good job for pennies.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Spray pan with Pam. Sprinkle coconut and chopped nuts in bottom of pan. Mix together cake mix. Spread over coconut and nuts. Mix together confectioners sugar melted butter and softened cream cheese. Spread over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef onion egg parsley and crumbs. Form into balls and brown. Pour off drippings. Stir in soup water and pickles. Cover; cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Delicious with any meal.

title: Scrumptious Minted Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine brownie mix egg water and oil in a large bowl. Stir with spoon until well blended about 50 strokes. Spread in prepared pan. Bake for 25 minutes or until set. Place 30 wafers evenly over hot brownies. Let stand for 1 minute to melt. Spread candy wafers to frost brownies. Score frosting into 36 bars by running tip of knife through melted candy. Do not cut through brownies. Cut remaining 18 candy wafers in half lengthwise; place halves on each scored bar. Cool completely. Cut into bars.

title: Tuna Vegetable Souffle
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Prepare 4 servings of potatoes omitting butter. Fold in mayonnaise. Add egg yolks one at a time; beat until fluffy. Stir into vegetable mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in. Pour into greased 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Mushroom Caps
instructions: Cut the bacon strips in half and wrap each strip around the perimeter of each mushroom cap to create a small cuff. Fasten the back with a toothpick. Broil mushrooms 5 minutes or until the back becomes slightly crisp drain. Mix the cheese with onion and bread crumbs. Place a small mound of mixture inside each mushroom cap within the bacon cuff. Broil 3 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Eye Of Round Roast
instructions: Marinate night before. Bring to room temperature. Preheat oven to 500\u00b0 and cook 6 minutes per pound. Turn oven off and leave for 2 hours without opening door.

title: Large Cheesecake
instructions: Crush graham crackers and mix well with melted butter. Mix eggs sugar vanilla and cream cheese. Beat well. Put crackers in spring-form pan and pour in cheese mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 10 minutes. Increase oven to 475\u00b0.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Put fruit in large bowl with fruit cocktail juice. Pour pudding over fruit and mix.

title: Deep Fried Pickles
instructions: In a large bowl combine 2 eggs 1/4 c. of the flour buttermilk Worcestershire sauce hot sauce cayenne pepper seasoning salt and garlic powder. In a separate mixing bowl combine cornmeal 2 c. flour salt and 3/4 tsp. black pepper. Preheat oil in a deep fryer or pot to 365\u00b0. Dip drained pickles into milk mixture and then dredge them in the flour mixture. Deep fry until golden brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Bring cranberries and water to a boil. Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes. Allow to cool. add sugar and jello. Mix well. Add the apple pineapple and nuts mix well. Pour into mold and refrigerate until set or overnight.

title: Spicy Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small pan and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Cool. Pour the cooled mixture over the prepared vegetables and toss lightly. Cover and chill several hours or overnight to blend flavors. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour salt soda and sugar together. Cut in shortening. Add sweet potatoes. Stir in buttermilk. May need more to make stiff dough. Turn onto floured board and knead lightly. Roll out and cut into biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Twister Pie
instructions: Combine Tropicana Twister Cool Whip and condensed milk. Beat thoroughly. Pour into pie crust and chill. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
instructions: Mix together press and roll into small balls. Then flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown. Let cool slightly. Cover in sugar and cinnamon.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Add enough flour to the ingredients to make a moderately stiff dough. Make into a long roll. Wrap in waxed paper and chill overnight in refrigerator. Cut off small portions and roll thin. After cutting brush each cookie with unbeaten egg white. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Trim with candy or nuts. For other holidays trim with colored sugar sprinkles etc. They keep well.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Finely grate cheese. Mix with oleo flour and pepper. Place small balls (about size of a quarter) on ungreased cookie sheet. Pat flat with back of fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from pan while still hot.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Butter 10-inch pie plate. In a saucepan melt 3 tablespoons of butter; add onion and green pepper. Saute until tender. Stir in meat; brown. Drain excess fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Add 2 tablespoons butter to cooked spaghetti.

title: Coconut Shortbread
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter together then stir in remaining ingredients. Wrap in waxed paper and chill. to bake slice in 1/4 inch slices and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15-20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream butters sugars egg and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Crisscross with fork tines. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly.

title: Applesauce Jello
instructions: Melt red hots and sugar into the water. Add jello and applesauce. Pour into mold. Chill several hours.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Season to taste with lemon juice. Simmer until shrimp are tender.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: In a double boiler mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Add lemon juice orange juice and pineapple juice. Cook over warm water for 20 minutes stirring constantly. Beat eggs and slowly add to cooked mixture. (It is best to add a little cooked mixture to the eggs and blend well then return to double boiler.) Cook stirring 5 minutes more. Cool and blend with cream cheese.

title: Dad'S Favorite Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften the cream cheese. Mix in Worcestershire sauce garlic powder and Accent to taste. Chop green tops of onions and dried beef. Reserve about 1/3 of the chopped dried beef. Add remaining beef and about an equal portion of green onion tops to cream cheese mixture. Shape mixture into a ball then roll in reserved beef. Serve with crackers (Sociables Dads favorite) or vegetables.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Heat chocolate chips condensed milk and margarine until melted then add flour vanilla and salt. Mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Flake salmon; add beaten eggs. Add remaining ingredients; mix and put into greased loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Surprise Cake
instructions: Coarsely chop the peanut butter cups into random pieces; spread in a metal pan and freeze solid. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Overnight Tuna Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Whisk soup and milk in a 2-quart microwave-safe bowl until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients except 1/4 cup cheese. Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours or overnight. Cover with lid or vented plastic wrap. Microwave on High 15 to 17 minutes until bubbly. Sprinkle with reserved cheese. Let stand uncovered 5 to 7 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Orange Roughy De Jonghe
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place fillets in a shallow buttered baking dish (about 7 x 10-inch). Pour sherry over fillets. Combine mayonnaise garlic parsley and bread crumbs. Spread evenly over fillets. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until fork-tender.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown\thamburger and\tonions\tin frying pan. Drain grease. Salt and pepper hamburger. Place Tater Tots over the bottom of the casserole dish. Put hamburger over top of Tater Tots. Place remaining Tater Tots over top. Spoon soups over the top of the Tater Tots. Bake in oven for 30 to 45 minutes on 325\u00b0.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Mix pudding and milk then add to first mixture. Crush package of Oreos centers included; half goes on bottom half goes on top. Chill at least 24 hours before serving.

title: Gumbo Style Okra
instructions: Saut chopped onion in melted butter until onions are clear. Stir in remaining ingredients and cook over low heat until okra is tender. Season with salt and pepper to suit your taste.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and condensed milk in mixing bowl. Mix thoroughly. Add lemon juice and vanilla; mix. Pour into pie crust. Chill for 1 hour. Pour on pie filling and chill before serving.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed 13 x 9-inch pan. Pierce cake with fork while hot and pour Eagle Brand over cake. Set. Pour Coco Lopez and let set again. Cool. Put on Cool Whip; sprinkle with coconut. Serve cold.

title: Veggie Mix
instructions: Mix sugar oil vinegar salt pepper and water together and boil until sugar has melted; let cool to warm stage.

title: Frozen Lemon Squares
instructions: Combine margarine crumbs and sugar; press onto 8-inch square pan. In bowl beat egg yolks. Stir in condensed milk and lemon juice. Add yellow food coloring if desired. Pour into crust. Top with whipped cream or topping and freeze. Keep cool.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a small bowl. Let stand so tomatoes release their juices. Brush both sides of bread with olive oil. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat source on both sides until lightly browned. Place bread on serving plates and spoon topping over slices. Serve immediately.

title: Small Party Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients. When thoroughly mixed shape into small balls. I use a teaspoon to get uniform size. Place in baking dish and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve in barbecue sauce or sweet and sour sauce.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Heat oil. Saute next 4 ingredients until tender. Add tomatoes and brown. Stir in paprika cayenne salt and water. Add a bay leaf and simmer for 15 minutes. Add shrimp and continue simmering for 10 to 12 minutes. Thicken sauce with cornstarch mixed with a little cold water. Serve with rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Yummy Breakfast Roll
instructions: Place 1 can of rolls in bottom of a 9 x 13 pan. Mix 1 cup sugar cream cheese and vanilla together. Spread over rolls. Spread 2nd can of rolls over cream cheese. Melt butter; mix with 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Pour over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Tortillas (Flour)
instructions: Sift flour and salt together and work shortening into it with hands and fingertips then add water until dough forms into firm ball. Knead well and form into small balls the size of golf balls. Let stand for about 15 minutes and then roll into thin pancake size of 7 to 8 inches. Cook on moderately hot griddle or skillet (ungreased) for 2 minutes on one side; turn over and cook 1 minute on the other side. Serve while hot. (These can be placed in foil and reheated in oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes.) Serve with butter spread on them or fill with cooked refried beans cheese etc.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach; drain squeezing out liquid. Add remaining liquids; mix well. Chill 2 hours or more in refrigerator then roll into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet (can line sheet with heavy Reynolds Wrap for easy cleaning). Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes shaking the pan for even cooking.

title: Sugar 'N Spice Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg. Mix in molasses. Mix in spices. Add flour and mix well. Form into balls and roll in granulated sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Corn-Crisped Pork Chops
instructions: Combine corn flake crumbs Accent salt and pepper. Dip chops in evaporated milk then roll them in crumb mixture. Place in shallow baking pan greased and lined with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork.

title: Bread Dressing
instructions: Saute onion celery and seasonings in margarine. Add broth. Add broth to bread crumbs until moistened. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Add 1 stick of the butter melted to the crushed graham crackers to form a thin layer crust.

title: Mock Lasagna
instructions: In a baking pan spread 1 can ravioli. In small bowl combine egg cottage cheese Parmesan cheese and parsley. Spoon over ravioli. Top with half the cheese slices. Spoon remaining ravioli over cheese layer. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Top with remaining cheese slices. Bake until cheese melts. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Tuna Puffs
instructions: Early in the day Combine eggs crumbs salt mustard onions milk and tuna. Pour into 6 individual casseroles or 8 custard cups. Refrigerate.

title: Beet Pickles
instructions: Cut tops off beets; cook until tender. Peel and cut beets in size wanted. Boil vinegar and sugar together. Add cooked beets; bring to boil. Pack in hot jars; finish filling jar with syrup. Seal; put jars in a 250\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Starlight Mint Surprise Cookies
instructions: Cream together the margarine sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs water and vanilla. Beat well and add flour salt and baking soda. Chill dough. To 1 tablespoon of dough enclose a chocolate star and roll into a ball. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yield 4 1/2 dozen.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Use equal amounts. Combine and mix well.

title: Jello Ice Cream
instructions: Combine and mix jello sugar and hot water; add gelatin and ice cream. Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan and refrigerate. It layers by itself. Cut into desired pieces and serve.

title: Civil War Pound Cake
instructions: Dissolve soda (the size of a pea) in 1 tablespoon of cold water. Beat eggs separately and very well. Mix whites last. Fold in carefully. Bake about one hour or until tested with a straw that comes out clean.

title: German Red Cabbage
instructions: Remove cabbage core; shred cabbage. Add onion sugar salt bay leaf and water. Bring to a boil then simmer 20 minutes. Add vinegar and apple. Cook additional 3 or 4 minutes. Sprinkle with bacon bits.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into lightly greased baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly usually about 20 minutes.

title: Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onion in butter; drain mushrooms reserving 3/4 cup of liquid. Combine eggs cream mushrooms and liquid spices and saltines; add onion and cheese and mix well. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake covered for 30 minutes. Remove cover and continue baking for 30 minutes more.

title: Ugly Dip
instructions: Fry sausage then drain well. Put both packages of cream cheese and 1 jar of salsa in microwave for about 7 to 10 minutes or until cream cheese begins to melt.\tMix sausage with cream cheese mixture. Can be served warm or cold with salsa chips or toast.

title: Whole Wheat Sandwiches With Olive Filling
instructions: Chop almonds until fine; combine with other ingredients. Trim crust from bread. Spread one slice with filling. Top with another slice of bread; cut into finger sandwiches. Yields 32 sandwiches.

title: Instant Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine rice 2 cups milk salt cinnamon sugar nutmeg and raisins. Bring to a rolling boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat; boil slowly for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Mix eggs with remaining milk. Slowly add to hot mixture stirring constantly. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Add vanilla. Let cool. Makes 6 servings.

title: Classic Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in green beans and half the onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot. Stir. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 more minutes. Makes 10 servings.

title: German Style Pork Chops
instructions: Mix flour salt pepper and bread pork chops then saute in skillet with butter to slightly brown both sides (1 to 2 minutes). In large pot add water soup mix onion and beer. Bring to simmer. Then add breaded pork chops. Simmer on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Thicken with flour or cornstarch and serve over rice or noodles.

title: Grannie'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Melt butter. Beat together with sugars vanilla peanut butter and eggs. In a separate bowl combine the flour bran oats and baking soda. Stir mixture into butter mixture. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Cool.

title: Diabetic Snow Pudding
instructions: Soak gelatin in cold water. Combine lemon juice rind and boiling water. Bring to boiling point and remove from heat. Add softened gelatin and artificial sweetener. Mix until well dissolved. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Add unbeaten egg whites and extracts. Beat until fluffy and holds shape. Chill until firm

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Sift together flour brown sugar baking powder and salt. Add chocolate chips and nuts; toss to coat. Mix egg and oil mixture into dry mix stirring lightly and quickly just to mix. Grease bottoms only of muffin tin or use paper baking cups. Fill each cup 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes until light brown.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine. With knife spread sour cream on chicken pieces and roll in crumbs; gently roll chicken in melted margarine (I melt it in a 13 x 9-inch pan) and place in same. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Tinola(Chicken Papaya)
instructions: In saucepan cook chicken with salt bagoong or patis and ginger for 20 minutes or until fat collects at bottom of pan. Stir occasionally. Add water cover and cook for about 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender. Add papaya cubes and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Tostada Salad
instructions: In small jar mix vinegar honey cumin salt and pepper. Shake well. Slice chicken into 1/2-inch strips and toss with garlic salt. Cook and drain corn. Add to chicken. Stir cover and chill 1/2 hour. Add tomatoes beans onions and lettuce. Toss. Pour dressing over salad and toss. At serving time add cheese and Tostitos and toss gently. Garnish with salsa and sour cream.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add taco seasoning mix according to instructions. Let cool. In a large bowl mix meat cheese onion and tomatoes. Right before you serve it add lettuce and crunched Doritos. Pour dressing over and mix.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients. Stir in chicken and vegetables. Spread into casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix cornflakes butter and parsley together then spread it over casserole mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Sensational Fish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place fish in nonstick baking pan; divide remaining ingredients equally on top of each fillet. Bake until fish flakes easily when tested with fork about 15 minutes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Put pineapple in flat dish. Mix flour sugar and cheese and spread over pineapple. Sprinkle crackers over this then pour melted margarine over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chops And Stuffing
instructions: Brown chops in oil. Place in 12 x 8 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Lightly mix bread cubes onion butter 1/4 cup water and poultry seasoning. Place a mound of stuffing on each chop. Blend soup and 1/3 cup water. Pour over stuffing and chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Yields 4 servings.

title: Preacher'S Coming
instructions: Put crushed wafers in ungreased 9 x 13 pan. Melt chocolate in 2/3 cup oleo. Stir in yogurt and 2 beaten egg yolks. Add nuts and vanilla. Fold in egg whites that have been stiffly beaten. Pour over crumbs and chill until firm. Top with 1/2 gallon vanilla ice cream that has been softened. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup nuts. Drizzle with Chocolate Fudge Sauce (follows). Cover and freeze. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Chocolate Brownie Pies
instructions: Melt chips with butter then add other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix jello vanilla water oil and eggs well. Pour mixture into a 10-inch tube pan that has been lined with wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool 15 minutes in the pan. Mix together the powdered sugar and lemon juice. Drizzle over the cake while it is still warm.

title: None Such Prize Cookies(Makes 48 Cookies, 3-Inches In Diameter)
instructions: Sift together flour salt and baking soda. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually. Cream smooth. Add mincemeat broken into small pieces. Add flour and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Orange Mushroom Salad
instructions: Toss lettuce orange slices mushrooms and onions with dressing until well coated. Serve on lettuce leaves. Top with raisins if desired.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
instructions: Cook pudding as directed. After coming to a boil pour cake mix in pudding pan and stir. Batter will be a little lumpy. Pour in greased pan. Sprinkle chips and nuts on top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly and add sugar salt and spices. Add butter to pulp and add pulp to liquid. Add milk and beat. Pour into pastry-lined pie plate and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 40 minutes until filling is firm.

title: Tomato Bisque And Macaroni
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Add large can of tomatoes. Heat until real hot (not boiling). Add 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda. Stir well. Add milk until desired amount about 1 quart. Salt to taste.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together; shape into ball or log. Roll in chopped walnuts.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in granulated sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Stir dry ingredients together and fold into pumpkin mixture. Spread on greased and floured 10 x 15 x 1-inch cookie sheet. Top with chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done when tested. Turn out on dish towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll towel and cake together. Cool. Unroll.

title: Cottage Cheese Dessert(Or Salad)
instructions: Mix together well. Refrigerate. Will be ready to serve within an hour.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine jello water pineapple and berries. When it begins to thicken add bananas. When it begins to get firm combine the cream cheese Cool Whip or sour cream and sugar. Pour into large container half of jello mixture. Add the cream cheese mixture then the rest of the jello. Spread the cream cheese with a spatula.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Sprinkle flour in eggs and beat thoroughly. Beat milk in with flour mixture. Beat everything together and pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Corn pudding should be kind of firm; test with knife. Should be like a custard.

title: Italian Hot Bath
instructions: Heat oil and butter in microwave on Full power for 3 minutes. Mix garlic and anchovy into a paste. Add to oil and butter mixture and microwave on Full power for 3 minutes.

title: Ronald Reagan'S Favorite Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni in water until tender and drain thoroughly. Stir in beaten egg. Mix mustard and salt with 1 tablespoon hot water and add to milk. Add cheese leaving enough to sprinkle on top. Pour into buttered casserole. Add milk; sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until custard is set and top is crusty.

title: Crustless Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar flour milk coconut butter and vanilla. Pour into large greased dish. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0 (glass dish 350\u00b0).

title: Lite Crab Dip
instructions: Combine yogurt mayonnaise cream cheese and seasonings. Mix well. Then stir in cheese and crab. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Kahlua Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix sour cream eggs oil and Kahlua. Mix until well blended. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into well greased Bundt or other pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: English Teaballs
instructions: Cream butter and confectioners sugar. Add dry ingredients. Work with hands to mix. Add nuts. Chill. form into balls. Place on lightly greased pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. While warm roll in confectioners sugar. When cold roll again in confectioners sugar. Yields 50 cookies.

title: Season'S Greeting Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients chill and serve.

title: Baked Ratatouille
instructions: Layer all ingredients in 6-quart casserole pressing down to make firm. Drizzle olive oil over top layer. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 3 hours with some of the liquids. Uncover during last hour if soupy. Mix gently and salt to taste. Garnish with parsley and tomato slices.

title: Ham And Swiss Pinwheels
instructions: Sprinkle flour over work surface. Turn dough out onto floured surface and roll into a 12-inch square. Combine mustard and honey in small bowl and brush over dough. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Top with ham slices. Roll up jelly roll fashion pinching seam to seal (dont seal ends). Cut roll into 16 slices. Place slices cut side down on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) for 45 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden. Serve immediately. Yields 16.

title: Sparkling Pink Punch
instructions: Mix together lemonade orange juice and water; chill. Add ginger ale just before serving. Garnish with orange slices. Serves 25 to 30.

title: Catfish Creole
instructions: Melt butter in wide frying pan over medium heat. Add onion celery green pepper and garlic. Cook until soft about 7 minutes. Add tomatoes and their liquid (break up tomatoes with a spoon) lemon slices Worcestershire sauce paprika bay leaf salt thyme and liquid hot sauce. Cook stirring occasionally for about 15 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened. Press fish pieces down into sauce. Cover pan and simmer until fish flakes. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers thoroughly; cut in half lengthwise. Combine salt vinegar and water. Heat to boiling. Pack cucumbers into clean hot jars. Add 2 tablespoons dill seed and 3 peppercorns to each jar. Fill with boiling pickling syrup to within 1/2-inch from top of jar. Immediately seal and process in boiling water 10 minutes.

title: Swinging Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cream cheese and beat until cheese melts. Fold in prepared Dream Whip nuts marshmallows and salad dressing. Pour in large mold and chill until firm.

title: Raisin Squares
instructions: Cook raisins in 1 cup of water. Set aside. Mix dry ingredients and add egg and margarine. Fold in raisins and water into this mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until done. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Seafoam Frosting
instructions: Mix well with spoon then put in double boiler and beat until it holds peaks.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix rice soups and water in bottom of 2-quart casserole. Dip chicken breasts in melted margarine then lay on top of the rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour covered. Uncover and bake 15 more minutes or until chicken is brown. Sprinkle with paprika before baking to help chicken brown.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order. Bake 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: In a punch bowl combine pineapple and apple juices. Puree undrained strawberries in blender; stir pureed strawberries into pineapple juice mix. Pour in ginger ale. Garnish with strawberry slices lime slices and fresh mint.

title: Frozen Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in top of double boiler; bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cook until chocolate and marshmallows are melted. Remove and set aside to cool. Combine butter and coconut in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook stirring often until coconut is lightly browned. Remove from heat and stir in graham cracker crumbs. Press 3/4 of crumb mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cut ice cream crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices. Arrange half of slices over crust. Pour 1/2 of chocolate mixture over ice cream; then repeat layers. Combine remaining mixture and pecans over top. Cover and freeze until firm. Yields 15 servings.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Cream together margarine and brown sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Sift together and add flour baking powder and salt. Add chocolate chips vanilla and nuts. Spread on greased cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Spaghetti With Zucchini Sauce*
instructions: Wash but do not peel zucchini. Trim ends and slice lengthwise into quarters and then into 1/2-inch slices. Heat oil and 2 tablespoons margarine. Add garlic and zucchini. Cook until zucchini is golden brown; drain on paper towels. Discard garlic. Season zucchini with salt and pepper. Boil spaghetti and drain. Place in warmed serving bowl with remaining 2 tablespoons margarine Ricotta cheese and generous amount of grated cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Toss well and serve with zucchini slices on top.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant in bite size pieces. This should take about 2 months. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Cook at 475\u00b0 for 4 weeks. This will serve 3800 people. If more are expected add the two rabbits. Only do this if needed as most people dont like hare in their stew.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Thaw frozen bread dough in refrigerator overnight. Roll or pat thawed bread into a rectangle. Slightly beat egg; spread some on dough layer. Add pepperoni on top of egg. Sprinkle with cheese. Roll up like jelly roll style. Connect ends or seal ends. Brush with remaining egg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Good served warm or cold. Snack or meal.

title: Creamy Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl beat egg yolks; stir in sweetened condensed milk lemon juice and pulp. Pour into crust.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Cook ground beef and onions together browning the meat a little. Add vegetables and water. Bring to a boil and sprinkle the rice over and bring to rolling boil; cover and let simmer for 1 hour. Should be cooked in a 6-quart kettle. Will serve 6 to 8 people. Can be served with shredded cheese on top. This is a good-for-you low-fat meal.

title: Carameled Nuts
instructions: Combine sugar salt cinnamon and milk. Cook stirring constantly until a soft ball forms when in cold water. Remove from heat and add vanilla and 2 to 3 cups English walnuts or pecans. Spread out and cool.

title: Sharon'S Toffee
instructions: Soft boil until golden brown. (Can add nuts and pecans.) Use heavy pan.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and pat into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 5 to 7 minutes. Cool 1 hour.

title: Seven Up Salad
instructions: Combine jello with hot water. Add cream cheese and beat with beater until fairly smooth. Add rest of ingredients and beat. Chill until solid.

title: George Washington'S Cherry Tree Cake(Make This In Honor Of His Birthday Or Someone Else'S!)
instructions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and vanilla. Sift flour baking soda and cinnamon and add to first mixture. Stir in pie filling and chocolate chips. Pour in two greased and floured cake pans or a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. You can frost if you like. A rich and moist cake.

title: Three Cheese And Chicken Bake
instructions: Saute the green pepper and onion in butter. Stir in soup milk mushrooms pimento and basil. Place half the noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover with 1/2 each mushroom sauce cottage cheese chicken and cheeses. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough into 1 1/4-inch balls. Place about 3-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in flour. Bake 9 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 2 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 3 dozen. Contains 80 calories per cookie.

title: Spiced Pecan Halves
instructions: Beat egg white and cold water until frothy. Add pecan halves and stir to coat evenly. Mix sugar salt and cinnamon in a large bowl. Add coated nuts and stir to coat thoroughly with sugar mixture. Place on buttered cookie sheet and bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Beef Cabbage Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in 1 tablespoon oil. Add cabbage celery and onion in skillet. Transfer to 5-quart stock pot. Add remaining ingredients plus 1 cup water if needed. Stir and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Soup
instructions: Soak the dried fruits in the fruit juice for 2 hours or longer; add 2 teaspoons honey. Bring mixture to a boil; add cornstarch and stir until mixture begins to thicken. Add cinnamon; chill or serve warm.

title: Hot Rib Sauce
instructions: If you use pork or have much grease from cooked meat use a tablespoon of lemon juice also.

title: Mottogany Wings
instructions: Bake wings at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Drain any liquid from pan. Combine soy sauce and brown sugar. Pour over drained wings. Continue baking for 35 to 40 minutes until wings are glazed. Serve hot by keeping in a crock-pot or warmer.

title: Scallop Casserole
instructions: Melt 1 stick of butter in a skillet. Add scallops and spices; cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes. Blend in the flour; add warmed cream. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until it comes to a boil. Remove and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Melt remaining butter in small saucepan; add crumbled crackers and stir. Sprinkle cracker mixture over the top of casserole. Bake covered at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Uncover; bake an additional 5 minutes. Let cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Honey Lemon Chicken
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in shallow baking dish. Stir until well blended. Place chicken in marinade. Turn to coat. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Turn once. Heat broiler or prepare grill 3 to 5 minutes per side. Makes 6 servings.

title: Baptist Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until tender (leave skin on). Debone and set aside. Butter baking dish. Prepare Stove Top as directed on package. Layer in bottom of pan. Put chicken on top of stuffing. Mix cream of chicken soup with chicken broth. Pour over layers. Bake covered for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot.

title: Floreeta'S Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup lukewarm water. Mix dry ingredients. Cut into shortening. Add buttermilk and yeast to dry ingredients (batter will not be stiff). Let stand at room temperature about 20 minutes. At this point batter may be refrigerated for several days.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter. Add sugars and cream. Add eggs and vinegar; mix well. In separate bowl combine flour oats salt baking powder and baking soda. Add a little at a time to creamed mixture until well blended. Add chocolate chips candy bar and nuts. Roll into balls.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Use large flat serving dish. Spread bean dip on dish. Mash together avocados with lemon juice and spread on beans. Mix together sour cream mayonnaise and seasoning. Spread on avocado layer. Top with chopped vegetables and cover with cheese. Serve with corn chips.

title: Baked Shoestring Potatoes
instructions: Cut a 24-inch length of heavy-duty aluminum foil. Cut potatoes in thin lengthwise strips as for French fries and place just off center on foil. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with salt pepper cheese and parsley. Pull edges of foil upward then pour cream over the potatoes. Fold foil. Place on shallow pan and bake in very hot oven at 450\u00b0 about 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done. Fold back edges of foil and sprinkle potatoes with extra chopped parsley if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa butter and milk in a pan on stove. Let come to a boil and let boil for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes then put in vanilla flavoring. Add peanut butter and then you add your oatmeal a little at a time. Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Cool and enjoy!!

title: Lemon Tarts
instructions: Mix all the ingredients (except pie shells and coconut) adding lemon juice last. Bake pie shells; cool. Put in cooled pie shells and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Heat butter until hot; add onion and mushrooms. Saute until light brown. Sprinkle flour over onions and mushrooms; stir quickly. Add milk gradually; stir constantly and bring to boil. Reduce heat; let simmer until mixture thickens. Stir in remaining ingredients and cook until thoroughly heated. Serve on toast.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Place vegetables and broth in saucepan. Bring to boil reduce heat cover and cook until vegetables are tender about 8 minutes. Mix milk cornstarch salt pepper and thyme; add to cooked vegetables. Cook stirring constantly until soup is slightly thick and mixture just begins to boil. Remove from heat. Add cheese and stir until melted. Makes 4 servings 1 cup each.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt Milky Ways and add one stick margarine. Set aside. Cream one stick margarine with sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and buttermilk to which soda and vanilla have been added and chopped nuts. Bake in tube or oblong pan 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Honey Wheat Bread
instructions: Heat milk butter cottage cheese and honey until butter melts. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix whole wheat flour sugar and salt. Beat the eggs and add to liquid ingredients. Add this to dry ingredients and mix well. Add enough white flour to form a ball (2 to 3 cups). Knead 10 minutes. Let rise in a greased bowl. Punch down and divide in 2 or 3 parts. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes. Form into loaves and let rise. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Bean Dip
instructions: Mix taco seasoning into refried beans. Spread into small casserole dish. Spoon sour cream on top of and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or microwave on High for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream margarine eggs sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add sour milk flour and cocoa. Beat. Add hot water and soda. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco. Add sugar and cream together. Add eggs one at a time and beat. In a separate bowl sift together whole wheat flour all-purpose flour and salt; add to sugar mixture. Add vanilla and milk. Mix well and pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Skin chicken. Slash chicken flesh. Combine ingredients in bowl. Add chicken turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight turning occasionally. Let chicken stand 1 hour at room temperature before cooking. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Arrange in shallow baking pan. Bake 15 minutes; turn and coat with marinade. Bake until chicken is fork-tender.

title: Tasty Tidbits
instructions: Melt margarine. Add seasoning. Mix well. Add cereal nuts and pretzels. Toss to mix. Bake 250\u00b0 1 hour. Stir often cool and store in airtight jars.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in pan. Mix 1 cup sugar flour baking powder and milk. Pour into pan on top of melted oleo. Add peaches on top of this. Add remaining sugar over this. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Chill overnight. Serve with fresh chilled vegetables.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Prepare macaroni as directed on the box. Drain and rinse with cold water. Mix remaining ingredients and toss together until the macaroni is well coated.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Use 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup hot water. Makes 125 cups. Stores very well in a tight container.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Add all ingredients in 8 x 8-inch square pan. Mix with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Raspberry Punch
instructions: Pour pineapple juice and ginger ale over vanilla ice cream and raspberry sherbet until melted and blended. Makes 24 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Baked Apricot Casserole
instructions: Butter a shallow casserole. Melt butter in saucepan. Add juice of 1 to 1 1/2 cans of apricot juice flour and brown sugar. Stir until thickened. Arrange apricots in dish. Pour sauce over fruit. Crumble crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly (approximately 25 to 30 minutes).

title: Fettucine With Ham And Peas
instructions: Saute the garlic in 1 tablespoon oleo. Stir in ham and peas. Saute 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat cover and keep warm. Cook the fettucine omitting the salt. Drain well and place in a large serving bowl. Add 1/2 cup oleo. Stir until melted. Add cheese and sour cream. Stir gently. Fold in ham mixture and pepper. Toss gently. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Fluffy Coconut Pudding
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Add boiling water and stir until dissolved. Cool to room temperature. Beat egg whites with salt until frothy. Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time and beat well after each addition. Continue beating until mixture holds a peak when beater is lifted. Slowly beat gelatin. Add vanilla to whipped cream. Mix and fold into egg whites. Fold in coconut. Cover and chill at least 4 hours. Garnish with Mandarin oranges and serve.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In a pot add potatoes and onion to boiling water. Cover; cook 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Blend in milks butter and seasonings. Cook until heated.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream the 2 sugars shortening eggs and vanilla. Add flour and baking soda salt and water. Mix well. Add chocolate chips. One cup of chopped nuts may be added if desired. Drop by 1 round teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serves 36.

title: Traveling Taco Dip
instructions: Spread beans over bottom of 10-inch glass pie plate. Layer remaining ingredients in the order listed. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 8 servings. Preparation time 10 minutes.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Sift flour. Measure and add sugar soda salt and cinnamon. Sift again. Work the shortening into this mixture as for pastry. Stir in chopped nuts and raisins that have been dusted with flour. Add ground apples and stir only enough to blend ingredients together. Pour into a greased 4 x 8 x 3 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield one loaf.

title: Sausage Pie
instructions: Set oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all together and fill pie shell. Bake 1 1/4 hour.

title: Cream Puff Pastry
instructions: Combine water and butter in saucepan. Bring to boil. Add flour and salt to butter mixture. Stir vigorously until mixture leaves sides of pan and forms a ball. Let cool 4 to 5 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating with wooden spoon after each addition. Spoon dough into mound on baking sheet and bake as directed. Cut tops off and pull out soft dough inside. Fill with cream filling.

title: Indulgence Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Heat the milk and chocolate over low heat. Stir until melted. Remove from heat. Beat yolks and vanilla together then add the chocolate mixture. Return to heat and stir until thick. Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold gently into the chocolate mixture. Divide into cups and refrigerate until firm. This is only 129 calories per serving.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Rolled Buttermilk Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder soda and salt. Add buttermilk and mix lightly with a fork. Turn out on a floured board or pastry cloth. Knead lightly 4 or 5 times. Roll or pat out to 1/4-inch thick; cut into rectangles 1 x 3-inch with a floured knife. Drop into boiling stew. Cover and boil gently 10 to 12 minutes. Do not uncover while cooking.

title: Coolest Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk in a large bowl. Stir in whipped topping sour cream and mayonnaise. Layer 1/3 each of the wafers pudding mixture bananas and berries in serving bowl. Repeat layers twice. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Makes 12 servings.

title: Homemade Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Melt butter and pour into ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Form into small balls and place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve in brown gravy.

title: Best Ever Fudge
instructions: Melt butter with the cheese. Sift together cocoa and powdered sugar and add to cheese mixture then add vanilla and nuts to taste. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and slice. Very creamy.

title: Vegetable Bars
instructions: Spread rolls out and blend seams together in a large rectangle cake pan. Bake 10 minutes or less. (Check at 8 minutes according to package directions.) Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and salad dressing together and spread on top of baked crust. Garnish with chopped fresh broccoli cauliflower tomato peppers onion (whatever you like or is in season). Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over this. Cut into bars. Will keep several days in refrigerator.

title: Ole Fashioned Beet Pickles
instructions: Wash fresh beets and leave an inch of the top stems so the juice will not cook out so much. I sort the beets according to size and this eliminates overcooking of small beets. Save a few cups of the red water the beets were cooked in. Beets are tender when tested with a fork. Drain off the hot water and cover with cold water until cool enough to handle. Peel beets and cut off the stems. Leave small ones whole but large beets still need to be quartered.

title: Candy Cane Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly the first 6 ingredients. Blend in flour and salt. Divide dough in half; blend food coloring into 1/2. Shape 1 teaspoon dough from each 1/2 into 4-inch rope. Roll back and forth on lightly floured board. Place ropes side by side. Press together lightly and twist. Place on ungreased baking sheet; curve top of cookie to form a cane. Bake about 9 minutes until set and very light brown. Makes about 2 to 4 dozen cookies depending on size of canes.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine. Add sugars eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and soda together; set aside. Cream butter and sugar in separate bowl. Add eggs to creamed mixture one at a time. Add milk and flour mixture. Mix well. Fold in nuts dates and cherries.

title: Caramel Pull-A-Parts
instructions: In Bundt pan or angel food cake pan sprinkle nuts on bottom. Place frozen dough balls side\tby side in single layer. Melt margarine or butter; mix in pudding and brown sugar. Cook until sugar\tdissolves. Remove from heat; pour over dough\tballs evenly.\tCover with waxed paper and a towel overnight.\tNext morning\tbake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.\tTo keep rolls\tfrom burning on top or becoming too crusty place foil on top for the first 25 minutes then remove and bake 10 minutes more. Turn out on platter while still hot and serve.

title: Gloria'S Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Confirmation Auction Cavatini
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet. Cook noodles separately until tender. Drain noodles. Mix sausage noodles and spaghetti sauce in a casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake until melted.

title: White Christmas Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate over medium-low heat stirring until smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in peppermint crunch. Spread on parchment paper lined cookie sheets. Chill in refrigerator 8 to 10 minutes. Break into small pieces. Store in airtight containers. Makes 2 1/2 pounds of candy.

title: Onion Butter
instructions: Blend Lipton onion soup mix thoroughly with softened butter. Makes about 1 1/4 cups. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add enough cold water to reserved liquid to make 1 3/4 cups. Add to jello; chill until slightly thickened. Add oranges. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart ring mold. Chill until firm.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Mix sugar water and instant coffee well. Simmer for one hour. Cool slightly. Add vodka and vanilla. Stir well. Pour into dark bottles and cap. Keep in cool dark place. Delicious. May use the same day made. Best when allowed to mellow for few weeks. Need 2 to 3 bottles.

title: Honey 'N Spice Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Combine Heinz 57 sauce and honey. Place chicken pieces on broiler or grill; brush with melted butter. Broil or grill until chicken is tender turning and basting frequently with sauce. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Coconut Crunch
instructions: Spray 13 x 9-inch baking sheet with Pam; set aside. Pour entire contents of Eagle Brand milk into a shallow dish. Cut slices of loaf bread in half and dip into Eagle Brand milk. Place on the baking sheet and sprinkle each slice with coconut. Place on lower rack and broil until coconut is lightly toasted. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Place in mixing bowl the water oats and margarine. Cover and let stand 20 minutes. Add other ingredients. Mix well and bake in a pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Sweet Onion Corn Bake
instructions: In a large skillet saute onions in butter until tender. In a small bowl combine the sour cream milk dill and salt until blended. Stir in 1 cup of cheese. Stir into the onion mixture; remove from the heat and set aside.

title: Salmon Steaks With Herbed Lemon Butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients but salmon oil and lemon. On wax paper shape mixture into 1 x 7-inch roll. Wrap and chill. Brush salmon with oil. Barbecue grill or broil 4-inches from heat 4 to 6 minutes on each side or until fish flakes when tested with a fork. To serve top salmon with 1 teaspoon each of the margarine and garnish with lemon wedges and parsley. Makes 4 to 6 servings. Equals 4 protein exchanges 1/2 fat exchange plus herbed margarine (1 teaspoon = 1/2 fat).

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: 1. Rub each beet with olive oil for added flavor.

title: Wanna'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk; boil until soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter vanilla and oleo. Beat until mixture begins to thicken. Pour into a buttered dish; cut when cooled. This is my secret recipe. Its yummy!

title: Corned Beef Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients well and refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Football Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 250\u00b0 for about 6 hours. Yields 4 servings.

title: Quick Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients until smooth and thickened. Fold in Cool Whip thoroughly. Layer wafers bananas and pudding.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Beat well to blend.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan cook onion in butter until onion is tender. Stir in salt flour and pepper. Add milk all at once; stir until thick and bubbly. Stir in broccoli and cheese; cook until cheese is melted. Cook broccoli until tender before adding to mixture.

title: Favas
instructions: Saute onion in oil. Add water and 1/4 cup ketchup. Stir and simmer then add more water if needed. Add pepper parsley nutmeg and cinnamon. Cook for 5 minutes. Add another 1/4 cup ketchup and favas with juice. Simmer about 5 more minutes. Enjoy!

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into baking dish. Set aside.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and spoon into tortillas; roll up. Place in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan (use about half of mixture). Spread remaining mixture over all tortillas. Sprinkle cheeses over top and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and cheeses melt.

title: Bachelor'S Roast
instructions: Rub roast with salt pepper and garlic salt. Sear roast on all sides in oil. Remove from pan; drain off excess fat and place in foil lined pan. Pour Coke and catsup over roast. Cover loosely with foil and bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0. This is good chopped up and mixed with sauce for barbecue sandwiches.

title: Baked Beans With Hamburger
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in a little oil on low heat. Increase heat and add hamburger. Mix vinegar catsup and Worcestershire sauce. After hamburger is browned add this mixture and onion to it and boil. Add beans. Put in a casserole dish and bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Pizza(Lo-Fat)
instructions: Several hours ahead Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise in a medium-size bowl; stir until smooth. Add the dressing mix; blend well. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

title: Hearty Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix with hand forming a ball. If it comes too soft refrigerate 1 hour. Roll lightly in walnut mixture. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Serve with Wheat Thins.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: In a deep bowl stir together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Mix eggs and milk together and pour into dry ingredients. Stir with a whisk until batter is smooth. Pour shortening into a heavy skillet to the depth of 1/2 to 2 inches. Heat until hot but not smoking. Hold a funnel with a 1/2-inch opening in your hand and keep one finger over funnel end. Hold funnel over hot oil; remove finger from spout. Using a slow swirling motion dribble batter into center of pan. Let brown on both sides. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Food For Fido(For The Dog Lover)
instructions: Mix well and watch tails wag.

title: Freezer Chips
instructions: Slice all vegetables thinly. Leave skin on cukes. Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate and stir each day for 5 days. Freeze with liquid for storing.

title: Rice Consomme
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add rice and mushrooms; simmer for 20 minutes. Add consomme water and oregano; stir until well blended. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (covered).

title: Easy Summer Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemonade. Fold in Cool Whip until smooth and well blended. (Makes two 8-inch pies.) Freeze for about 1 hour before serving. Store in freezer well covered.

title: Creepy Jigglers
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatins in large bowl 3 minutes or until completely dissolved. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until firm. Dip bottom of pan in warm water about 15 seconds. Cut into Halloween shapes with cookie cutters all the way through gelatin. Lift from pan. Makes 24 pieces.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies finely. Mix cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Mix milk and instant pudding. Combine cheese mix and pudding. Layer flowerpot alternately ending with cookies on top. Place worms around on top and stick down in the mix. Add a silk flower in the middle giving the effect of a pot plant.

title: Pear Salad
instructions: Heat 1 cup pear juice to boiling; mix with Jell-O. Refrigerate and let set until jelled around edges. Blend cream cheese salad dressing and mashed pears. Prepare Dream Whip as directed. Fold into cream cheese mixture then fold in Jell-O. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Banana Split(Sugar-Free Torte)
instructions: Crush graham crackers. Add melted margarine and mix. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice bananas on top. Cook pudding according to directions. Stir in pineapple. Pour over bananas. Spread 2 cups Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate. Top with strawberries.

title: Rabbit Baked In Mustard, Garlic And Cream
instructions: Coat rabbit pieces with mustard. Mix minced garlic pastry and tarragon with a little salt and sprinkle half over the rabbit. Combine the vinegar and broth and pour into a large baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining garlic minced parsley and tarragon over then put the rabbit pieces on top.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix the potatoes granulated sugar milk eggs and 1/2 cup butter together and place in a greased casserole. Combine the remaining ingredients together and pour on top of potato mixture. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Yummy Stuff
instructions: Cook pasta in water seasoned with bouillon; drain. Return to pan; add cheese slice. Cover let cheese melt. Mix in meat and vegetables. Serve with catsup.

title: Melt-Away Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg yolks well; combine with sour cream. Sift dry ingredients together; stir into egg yolk mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in. Drop by large spoonfuls onto hot griddle until tops are bubbly; turn and brown on other side. Makes 10 pancakes.

title: Daddy'S Grilled Chicken
instructions: The night before prepare chicken as follows Spray chicken with Pam. Then coat chicken with seasoning salt completely. Do not add salt or pepper. Place chicken in a large bowl or platter and cover tightly with foil. Chill overnight.

title: Chinese Torture
instructions: Combine candied ginger walnuts syrup crumbs and melted chocolate. Form 1-inch balls. Mix cocoa and sugar. Coat each ball completely with this mixture. Wrap and store in refrigerator.

title: Meringue Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites to soft peaks. Gradually beat in 1 cup sugar. Beat until stiff. Fold in 1 teaspoon vanilla. Set aside.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Break spaghetti into 3-inch lengths. Cook in a large amount of boiling water; drain. In Dutch oven or kettle cook meat onion and green pepper until meat is browned. Sprinkle with salt. Gradually stir in soups milk and 2 cups of the cheese. Divide spaghetti evenly between two 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dishes. Into each pan stir half the soup-meat mixture. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese atop each dish or use 1 large baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until hot through.

title: Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread lightly. Arrange corned beef on 4 slices of bread. Add sauerkraut. One tablespoon salad dressing. One slice swiss cheese. Brown on grill on one side. Butter other slice of bread and flip and brown on other side. When cheese is melted. Serve.

title: Southwestern Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Spread 1 side of half the bread slices to taste with chipotles if using. Arrange half the cheese slices evenly on top of chipotles. Scatter green chilies on top then add remaining cheese and bread.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and salt. Add milk vanilla and nutmeg. Dot with butter. Pour in pan place in oven and bake 30 minutes or until set.

title: Rich Cocoa Fudge
instructions: Butter an 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil; set aside. In heavy 4-quart saucepan stir together the sugar cocoa and salt. Stir in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to full rolling boil. Boil without stirring to 234\u00b0 or until syrup forms soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Do not stir. Cool at room temperature to 110\u00b0 (lukewarm). Beat with wooden spoon until fudge loses its gloss. Spread in pan. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Slowly add and stir in beet juice and vinegar. Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens and clears. Add drained beets. Stir to mix. Let stand 2 minutes to heat the beets through.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream the eggs sugar oil and pumpkin together. Sift the other ingredients together and add alternately with water to creamed mixture. Pour into 3 well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Soft Shapes
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients. Mix in sugar and knead until blended. Divide mixture in half and color one red and green. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and press nut half into center of each. Store in airtight container.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Saute the sausage and mushroom stems garlic and parsley. Drain well. Add cheese. Stuff the mushroom caps. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Peel and slice eggplant very thin. Dip in egg and Italian bread crumbs. Fry in olive oil and drain. Make a sauce with tomato sauce Romano cheese salt and pepper basil oregano onion garlic Parmesan cheese and mushrooms. In casserole dish alternate sauce eggplant and Mozzarella cheese (like a lasagna). Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shera Jello Mold
instructions: Mix gelatin with water until dissolved. Chill until thick but not completely set. Whip until frosty and light. Add sour cream and mix well. Chill.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Potato Salad For 100
instructions: Cover potatoes with water; bring to a boil. Add 1/4 cup salt. Cover and cook until tender. Drain well; cool slightly. Combine onions oil salt and pepper. Add to potatoes. Combine celery eggs relish pimientos salad dressing and mustard to potato mixture. Mix lightly but thoroughly to coat potatoes.

title: Window Washing Solution
instructions: *BLKLIN sweatshirt. Cut off the hood with the strings still attached and tie it onto a mop. Use it to dust ceilings and walls. The hood can be washed and used over and over again.

title: Hunter'S Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into bite size pieces. Add the brown gravy and bake at 465\u00b0 for about 4 weeks. Salt and pepper to taste. This will serve 3800 people. If more are expected the rabbits may be added but do this only if necessary as most people do not like to find \hare\ in their stew.

title: Mom'S Dumplings For Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Cut in Crisco shortening. Stir in just enough milk to make a real thick sticky dough. Roll out pretty thin on a floured surface. Cut into squares. Drop into boiling broth. (Scatter your droppings so they dont all goo up. You can judge this by dropping according to where the boiling bubbles are.) Cook about 20 minutes. DO NOT STIR TOO MUCH (just enough to keep the dumplings from sticking to the bottom otherwise you will break up the dumplings). Thicken broth with a mixture of flour and milk to desired consistency.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Combine vanilla wafer crumbs sugar cocoa and pecans. Mix well. Combine Karo syrup and rum and pour over crumb mixture. Mix well. Shape into balls and roll in coconut. Store in covered container in refrigerator.

title: Dirt Cups(Great For Kids)
instructions: You will need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) plastic cups. Suggested decorations gummy worms and frogs candy flowers chopped nuts.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Pour undiluted soup in pan. Combine other ingredients. Cover; heat and serve piping hot on toast.

title: Crunchy Graham Crackers
instructions: Place crackers on foil covered cookie sheet. Melt butter margarine and sugar. Bring to boil. Boil 3 minutes. Pour mixture over crackers and sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Break apart.

title: Jim'S Favorite Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour cocoa egg yolks milk margarine and vanilla. Cook in double boiler until thick. Pour into pie shell. Top with stiffly beaten egg whites sweetened to taste. Add cream of tartar to thicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Cook on High for 2 minutes. Stir in nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased pan. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix together by hand the cake mix 2 eggs and melted butter. Pat into a well-greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Set aside then mix 2 eggs 1 box powdered sugar and cream cheese until well blended. Pour over cake mixture. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven let cool and sprinkle with 1/4 cup powdered sugar.

title: Nadine'S Favorite Icebox Salad
instructions: Combine the sugar and pineapple; bring to a boil. Dissolve gelatin in water. Add sugar and pineapple mixture. Put in\trefrigerator until it begins to set then add cheese pecans and whipped cream.\tReturn to refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth. Stir in lemon and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill 3 hours. Top with your desired amount of pie filling.

title: Dieter'S Swiss Mocha
instructions: Blend in blender. Use heaping teaspoonfuls per cup boiling water.

title: Special Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Dry bread crumbs in oven at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cut a lid in pumpkin. Remove seeds and fibrous insides; discard. Rub inside of pumpkin with mixture of 1 tablespoon butter and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook onions in 6 tablespoons butter for 10 minutes. Stir in bread crumbs; continue stirring and cook for 10 minutes longer. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon salt other seasonings and cheese. Put crumbs and cheese in pumpkin. Fill pumpkin with enough chicken broth to fill within 1/2-inch of top. Put pumpkin lid on.

title: Chicken Stew With Parsley Dumplings
instructions: Heat chicken 4 cups of water onion bouillon and pepper to boiling in Dutch oven and reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Add carrots and simmer 10 minutes. Mix flour and 1/2 cup water. Stir flour mixture and celery into chicken. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Combine Bisquick milk and parsley. Drop by spoonfuls onto boiling stew. Cook uncovered over low heat 10 minutes. Cover and cook an additional 10 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bacon Appetizers
instructions: Cut bacon in 4ths and wrap each piece around a water chestnut. Fasten with toothpick. Bake on rack at 400\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until bacon is crisp. Pour off grease; put roll-ups into baking dish. Mix catsup and sugar; pour over rolls and return to oven for about 10 more minutes. Makes about 50 and may be served hot or cold.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Divide dough and roll out on floured table until 1/4 inch in depth. Spread with melted butter Land of Lakes is best and sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon to cover. Roll dough up and cut into 3/4 inch slices or larger if desired. Place on a buttered pan butter tops and let rise until doubled. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes or golden brown. Take out immediately and invert on another pan.

title: Creamed Tomatoes
instructions: Mash tomatoes in a pan. Add flour milk and sugar. Salt and pepper to taste. Heat until thick and creamy. Serve over biscuits.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients; pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sweet Cinnamon Bread
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Grease and flour the bottom only of a 9 x 3-inch loaf pan. Pour batter into pan.

title: Eclair Dessert
instructions: Mix pudding and milk. Stir in Cool Whip. In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer graham crackers 1/2 pudding mixture layer of graham crackers other 1/2 of pudding mixture and graham crackers. Spread the chocolate fudge icing over top layer of graham crackers. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Turkey Scalloppine
instructions: Skin turkey slice meat across grain as thin as possible. Salt and pepper slices coat with flour. Heat oil and butter in large skillet. Lightly brown slices a few at a time pour off fat return meat to skillet. Add Marsala thyme and oregano; cook until almost dry turning slices gently as they cook (about 10 minutes). Saute mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter add to turkey. Add beef broth. Cook turkey over gentle heat until almost dry. Beat egg yolk with cream remove skillet from heat. Pour cream mixture over turkey slices turn gently to glaze. Makes 6 servings.

title: Scallop Kabobs
instructions: Set oven control at broil and/or 550\u00b0. Broil kabobs 3 inches from heat 5 to 8 minutes turning once and basting with butter.

title: Candle Stick Salad(For Holiday Dinner Party)
instructions: *Note The number 8 is variable depending on how many youre having for dinner.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix the jello and the hot water together. Add the remaining ingredients. Let stand until well congealed in refrigerator. This is very good and it is very filling.

title: Corned Beef Hash
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased casserole dish. Mixture will be sloppy. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until firm and crusty. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat together sugar oil and eggs. Add pumpkin and mix well. Sift together flour baking powder cloves salt baking soda nutmeg allspice and cinnamon; mix with first 4 ingredients. Then add walnuts and raisins. Bake in 4 loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (metal pans 50 minutes).

title: Bill'S Quiche
instructions: Pour into crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let set 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet; drain. Cut into small pieces. Add onion to skillet and cook until soft. Combine onion with sausage and sprinkle over bottom of pastry shell. Sprinkle on cheese. Combine egg salt light cream and milk. Beat slightly. Pour over ingredients in pastry shell. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown steak salt and pepper then add onions and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add broth and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes or until tender. Blend sour cream and 2 tablespoons flour together. Stir in broth. Cook and stir constantly until thickened and serve over rice or noodles.

title: Mother'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Turn oven on to 400\u00b0. Put pie into oven then turn down to 350\u00b0. Place a sheet of foil on top then bake until center is firm.

title: Dandy Candy
instructions: Combine peanut butter milk powder honey and vanilla in mixing bowl. Next mix ingredients with spoon.

title: Easy Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water stir in sugar salt shortening and egg. Mix flour in until dough is easy to handle. No kneading necessary. Grease top of dough and put in refrigerator before using. Shape about 2 hours before serving. Bake at 400 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
instructions: For brine bring first 3 ingredients to boil. In cold water wash about 30 (4-inch) pickling cucumbers. Pack in quart jars. Add spices to each quart jar. Pour hot brine over cucumbers to within 1/2-inch of top. Immediately adjust covers. Process 20 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes about 6 quarts.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Place peach slices in an 8 x 8-inch square pan. Cream the butter and 3/4 cup sugar. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Spoon mixture over fruit. Sift together 1 cup sugar cornstarch and nutmeg. Sprinkle over batter. Pour water over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Peter Pan Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine salt and peanut butter; mix well. Add sugars gradually and cream. Add eggs and milk; mix well. Add flour and soda. Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Press top lightly with fork to flatten slightly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Frosting Filling For Layers
instructions: Mix sugar sour cream and coconut. Let stand while making layers. Put between cake layers and refrigerate or mix together overnight. Put between layers next day.

title: Batter Rolls
instructions: Scald milk; stir in sugar salt and oleo.\tCool to lukewarm. Measure warm water into large bowl. Crumble yeast; stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture egg (beaten) and 2 cups flour. Beat until smooth; stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in bulk about 30 minutes.\tPunch down and shape into 2 dozen rolls. Place on greased baking cake pans or muffin cups. Cover. Let\trise in warm place until doubled in bulk about 30 minutes. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 about 15 minutes or so.

title: Cranberry Salad Squares
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Stir in whole cranberry sauce and ginger ale. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into squares. Place on lettuce leaf; garnish with sour cream mixed with a dash of cinnamon.

title: Sugar And Spice Pecans
instructions: Boil all ingredients\t(except pecans) to a soft ball stage (230\u00b0). Let cool\ta few minutes and stir until mixture begins to look creamy then add pecan halves. Mix well with wooden spoon. When hard turn\tout on an oiled sheet or wax paper and break apart.

title: Irish Potatoes
instructions: In medium size mixing bowl mash the hot pulp of baked potato with a fork. Add the sugar and blend well. (If the pulp is not hot enough to melt sugar place bowl in larger bowl with hot water.) Add vanilla and coconut; work into mixture thoroughly. Form dough into small rounds and roll each one in cinnamon lightly.

title: Southwest Beans
instructions: Brown beef and onion in oil. Stir in flour and add seasonings. Add tomato sauce and 2 cups of the liquid the beans were cooked in. Simmer about 45 minutes. Add beans and simmer until flavors blend.

title: One-Step Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Crumble beef into a microwave safe colander; place colander in a 9-inch pie plate. Cover with wax paper; microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes or until meat is no longer pink stirring after 3 minutes. Combine beef sauce water and wine. Spread 1/3 of mixture in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on sauce. Layer 1 cup cottage cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese over noodles. Spoon 1/2 of remaining sauce over cheese. Repeat process again. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Cover with plastic wrap folding back one corner for steam to escape. Microwave at Medium 32 to 35 minutes give dish half-turn after 15 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese and microwave for 2 minutes. Yields 6 large servings.

title: Saucy Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef crumbs egg and salt; shape into 50 meatballs. Place in a shallow baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Bake until browned; turn once. Spoon off fat.

title: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs 1 at a time. Add Wesson oil then gradually add flour and buttermilk alternating flour with milk.

title: Homemade Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Melt oleo in milk and cool. Beat eggs and add to yeast then add milk and oleo. Add dry ingredients gradually and place in greased bowl. Cover tightly and refrigerate. When ready to cook pinch off in biscuit size pieces. Pat out and put on greased pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Will keep in icebox for 4 to 5 days. Do not wait for them to raise.

title: Quick Cobbler Crust
