instructions: Combine flour sugar and milk. Add butter and egg. Mix well! Pour over top of desired fruit that has been placed in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain fat. Add Prego and simmer. Cook noodles as directed. Layer noodles sauce and cheese. Finish with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chilled Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Serves 6.

title: Greek Cabbage Soup
instructions: Saute the onion in the oil 5 minutes. Add the water; bring to a boil. Mix in the tomatoes cabbage salt and pepper. Bring to a boil again and cook over low heat 1 1/4 hours or until cabbage is tender. Taste for seasoning. Stir in the parsley. Serve with sauteed bread. Beef bone or ham bone or chunks may be added for richer taste. Also soup is very good if served with melted Gruyere or Mozzarella cheese on top with toasted croutons.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Add almond extract. Stir in flour and baking powder. Mix until smooth. Turn mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon pie filling onto batter in 16 spots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden and cake tests done. Filling will sink into cake while baking. Blueberry filling may be used.

title: Cheesy Squash Custard Casserole
instructions: Heat oil and butter in large skillet. Add squash onion and garlic and saute until vegetables are crisp-tender. Combine beaten eggs cheeses dill salt and pepper. Transfer vegetables to buttered 8-inch square baking dish. Pour egg mixture over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until set. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cereal Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine or shortening and sugars. Add eggs. Mix in dry ingredients then cereals and chocolate chips or raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Casserole Of Chicken
instructions: Blend mayonnaise and water. Add remaining ingredients except noodles and eggs. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Garnish with sliced eggs and Chinese noodles.

title: Wild Rice And Prawn Salad(Serves 8)
instructions: Make rice according to directions; set aside.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Season okra with salt and cayenne pepper to taste. Combine flour and cornmeal and season with more salt and cayenne pepper. Dip okra into egg batter and then into flour and cornmeal mixture.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind the cranberries and let stand overnight. Add sugar. Before serving add celery marshmallows and pecans and mix. Fold in the whipping cream and serve.

title: Ice Cream Sundae Dessert
instructions: Crush cookies between 2 layers of wax paper to about 1/4 inch size. Mix with melted margarine. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill. Slice ice cream and spread over the cookie crust. Freeze hard.

title: Sausage Cornbread Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Brown sausage with onion and drain. Combine meal eggs corn milk and oil. Pour half of mixture into large iron skillet or greased oblong pan. Sprinkle sausage mixture and cheese over batter. Pour remaining batter on top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Holiday Orange-Blueberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Beat eggs. Add butter orange juice milk and orange rind. Mix well. Pour liquid mixture into dry ingredients and stir only until well moistened. Carefully fold in nuts and blueberries. Pour into 5 x 9-inch buttered and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 60 minutes or until toothpick stuck in center comes out clean. Let set 10 minutes before removing from pan. Cool on rack. Wrap and refrigerate overnight before slicing.

title: Chicken-Fried Round Steak
instructions: Pound the steak thoroughly and cut into serving pieces. Mix eggs and milk. Dip meat into egg mixture then into cracker crumbs. Handle carefully so all the coating stays on the meat. Heat the fat in a large skillet. Brown meat on both sides in the hot fat. Cover tightly and cook over very low heat for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Beef Macaroni Skillet
instructions: Brown beef and onion in 12-inch skillet. Add tomato juice Worcestershire sauce vinegar salt pepper mustard and macaroni. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Stir occasionally during cooking.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Butter sides and bottom of glass baking dish. Combine all ingredients in baking dish. Bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Minestrone Soup With Ground Beef
instructions: In a 5-quart Dutch oven or saucepot over high heat cook ground beef onion celery and cabbage stirring carefully so that meat stays in chunks until all pan juices evaporate and meat and vegetables are lightly browned (about 10 minutes). Add tomatoes garbanzo beans and corn with all their liquid zucchini macaroni bouillon basil leaves and water. Over high heat heat to boiling stirring to break up tomatoes. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes until macaroni and vegetables are tender.

title: Sauteed Zucchini With Raisins
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and cut into slices about 1/2-inch thick. In a large frying pan heat 1 tablespoon of the oil and 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat. Add half the zucchini and brown on both sides. Add the remaining oil and butter; saute the rest of the zucchini. Remove with slotted spoon.

title: Meal-In-One Soup
instructions: Cut meat into small pieces. Add onion celery salt pepper and a little water. Cook until tender. Take meat out of liquid and let cool. Remove any bones. To the liquid add vegetables barley tomato paste and tomato sauce. Put meat back into liquid and cook on simmer until vegetables and barley are tender. Add water as needed. Cook and drain macaroni noodles and add to soup while simmering.

title: Bev'S Lemon Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together with mixer until fluffy. Pour into graham cracker pie crust and freeze.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Put water and gelatin in saucepan. Place over direct heat and stir until dissolved or mixture is clear. In medium size bowl combine condensed milk and lemon juice. Stir in gelatin mixture. Fold in sour cream. Mix in 1 1/4 cups of the pie filling. Turn into crust. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Garnish pie top with remaining chilled pie filling.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix soup milk soy sauce and pepper in casserole dish. Stir in green beans and 1/2 can of French fried onions. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Stir and add the rest of onions on top. Cook 5 more minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa in large bowl. Add milk and margarine. Do not stir. Microwave for 2 minutes. Stir just until creamy. Add vanilla and chopped nuts. Stir until blended. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Cut into squares.

title: Super Dooper Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine oil both sugars egg and vanilla together. Add all dry ingredients to oil/sugar mixture. Mix well. Drop from teaspoon 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake! Remove immediately from cookie sheet.

title: Basic Chicken Bog
instructions: Discard liver gizzard and innards if desired. Boil chicken in a large covered pot until done about 1 1/2 hours with a sprinkling of celery salt and/or garlic powder if you like. Pour off chicken liquid (broth) and measure. Cool chicken slightly; strip of bones and skin. Measure 1 part rice for 2 parts broth i.e. if you have 4 cups of broth measure 2 cups rice. Cut up sausage into 1/2-inch chunks. Replace chicken rice broth and sausage into pot and cover. Bring everything to a boil then reduce heat to low. Dont lift lid for 30 minutes at least then check to see if rice is done. If not continue simmering until rice is done. Ask anyone for other variations!

title: Punch - No Ice Needed
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in 1/2 gallon of boiling water. Cool. Add lemon juice pineapple juice and 2 gallons of water. Freeze overnight. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Christmas Wreath
instructions: Melt oleo and marshmallows together; when hot add green food coloring. Pour over corn flakes. Mix well. Spoon into a plate in a wreath design and decorate with red hots. (Can put a candle in center.)

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Combine or mix tortilla flour with warm water. Slowly swift until it becomes a dough (not too sticky). Make round balls then roll out into any shape no bigger than the size of an interior coffee cup. Preheat pan with vegetable oil low to medium heat. Lay dough inside pan. Cook until one side is brown then flip over and cook the other side until brown. Combine sugar and cinnamon on another plate; mix with fork. When tortilla is cooked place on top of sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle both sides of tortilla well; remove. Ready to eat.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Melt oleo. Cook celery onions and bell pepper slowly for 40 minutes or until done. Add seasoned crawfish tails and cook slowly for 40 minutes. Add parsley with crawfish tails. Add green onions during the last 10 minutes. Add cornstarch to thicken just before adding green onions. Add lemon juice. Let set for a few minutes. Serve over cooked rice. May use shrimp.

title: Peanut Butter Delight
instructions: Place margarine sugar milk and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a hard boil. Remove from heat and add oatmeal peanut butter vanilla salt and flour. Stir until well blended. Press in pan smoothly. Let cool. Cut into squares. You may add chopped peanuts if desired.

title: Beer Cheese Soup
instructions: Sweat the onion in butter until tender. Add the garlic and sweat briefly. Add the flour making a roux stirring constantly for 5 minutes until its golden. Add the beer and let simmer for 1/2 hour. Add the cheese and let it melt in. Add the cream and let the soup continue to warm just to a simmer. Do not let it boil. Add the julienne peppers. Add the dry mustard Tabasco and Worcestershire sauce to taste. Add salt and white pepper to taste. Makes 8 servings.

title: Apple Honey Refresher
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into ice filled glasses. Serves 6.

title: Creole Grillades
instructions: Cut meat in bite-size pieces. Brown in butter. Season with salt pepper and Accent. Remove.

title: Homemade Italian Spaghetti(Special Seasoning)
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in food processor. Freeze fatback prior to grinding. After all ingredients are ground up add a dash of allspice and basil leaves. Makes about 6 quarts.

title: Oven Pancake
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0 for metal 9 x 13 x 2 baking pan (reduce heat 25\u00b0 for glass pan). Melt butter in pan in oven until butter is bubbling. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour into hot butter. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately with syrup jam powdered sugar etc. for breakfast.

title: Butterscotch Fingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch square pan on sides and bottom. Melt margarine. Mix with other ingredients. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats sugar and salt. Let stand until lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water and add to oats mixture. Beat in flour; knead until smooth. Let double in bulk. Shape in 2 loaves and place in greased pans. Let double again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Brush tops with butter or margarine.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together shortening sugar eggs water and vanilla until creamy. Combine flour salt and soda. Add to mixture. Add raisins and oats. Mix well. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen. 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli and onion. Place in large bowl. Add shredded cheese bacon bits salad dressing sugar and vinegar. Stir together. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers onions and green pepper. Pour salt on top; let sit 1 hour. Rinse well. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over cucumbers. Place in jars or large bowl; store in refrigerator.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening with mixer. Add egg. Cream again. Mash bananas and add. Cream. Mix slowly while adding oatmeal. Combine flour salt soda cinnamon and nutmeg. Fold into creamed ingredients. Add pecans. Spoon onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Store in tight container to keep moist.

title: Yellow Bread
instructions: Beat all ingredients except 1/2 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon for 8 minutes at high speed. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon. Layer batter and sugar-cinnamon mixture in 2 greased loaf pans. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Mix together refried beans green chilies and taco seasoning mix. Spread on a 12 inch round platter. Blend avocados lemon juice and 1/2 c. taco sauce until smooth. Spread on top of bean mixture. Spread sour cream on top of avocado mixture. Top with shredded lettuce cheese taco sauce and olive slices. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Homemade Play Dough
instructions: Cook flour salt cream of tartar and oil over medium heat until it thickens. Add food coloring and knead when cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown the ground beef with diced onion. Drain off fat. Put all ingredients in pot. Bring to a boil and then simmer 1 hour.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Place ingredients in a large bowl in the order listed. Mix mayonnaise and sugar thoroughly and place on top of pea layer. Spread it on like frosting. Sprinkle the cheese on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Buttermilk Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix buttermilk and pudding mix until smooth. Add fruit and fold in Cool Whip. Makes a huge salad. Half of recipe is enough for a family.

title: Marinated Fish Kabobs
instructions: Thaw fish if frozen. Cut fish into 1-inch pieces. To make marinade combine oil soy sauce scallions garlic brown sugar dried mustard and black pepper. Place fish pieces in marinade. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.

title: Big Soft Ginger Cookies
instructions: Combine flour soda salt and spices. Set aside. In large mixing bowl beat margarine with electric mixer on low speed to soften. Gradually add 1 cup sugar beating until fluffy. Add egg and molasses beating well. Stir in dry ingredients.

title: Grilled Chicken Breast
instructions: Marinate chicken in other ingredients in Ziploc bag for several hours. Grill 7 minutes on each side over medium heat.

title: Beer Batter Chicken
instructions: In bowl with fork mix first 3 ingredients. In another bowl beat together beer egg and 2 teaspoons salad oil; stir liquid into flour mixture. Coat half of chicken pieces with batter.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Cook chicken in water with celery onion and salt until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from bone and line 13 x 9-inch pan with chunks of chicken. Mix together both soups and milk and pour over chicken. Next mix the stuffing with enough chicken broth to moisten then spread over top of soup and chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. I use the ones in the boxes and bake as directed (let cool). Mix together cocoa flour sugar and eggs. Add 1 cup milk slowly until mixture is smooth.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Stir together first 3 ingredients. In mixer combine 1/2 cup butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Mix until fluffy. Add egg and beat until smooth. Combine milk and vanilla; add alternately with dry ingredients to mixture at low speed. Pour batter into greased and floured 1 1/2-quart oval baking dish. Spoon berries over batter. Combine 1/4 cup sugar 1/4 cup flour and cinnamon; cut in butter. Sprinkle over berries. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Add sugar to eggs; mix well. Add butter stirring until blended. Add flour mixture alternately with milk mixing until blended after each addition. Stir in oats nuts and raisins. Let batter stand for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Fold all ingredients together and place in baking dish. Cover with 2 cups crushed potato chips. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes until hot.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: In 1 quart casserole heat bacon until crisp. Remove bacon; crumble; set aside. Add onion to bacon drippings; heat until onions are transparent. Stir in flour sugar salt and celery and heat;\tstir in water and vinegar.\tCook until mixture boils. Add potatoes and\tbacon stirring gently to coat with sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Stouthearted Bean Salad
instructions: Drain Trappeys beans; coarsely chop onion and jalapeno peppers. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate. Add salt and pepper to taste. Alter olive oil and vinegar to taste.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Cut up dates in a bowl; sprinkle soda over them. Pour boiling water over all and let cool. Mix sugar eggs and butter together and drain dates liquid into batter. Add flour and then dates and nuts last. Makes 2 loaves. Put into greased pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Add oil pumpkin and eggs. Beat 1 minute at medium speed in mixer. Put batter in a 15 x 10 x 2-inch pan or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool completely.

title: Vic'S Cheese Potato Soup
instructions: Cook chopped celery onion and carrot in broth and water for 20 minutes. Add potatoes and cook another 15 to 20 minutes (medium heat). Stir in cream of chicken soup and add Velveeta last. Stir to dissolve. Soup is ready to serve when all of the cheese has dissolved. Salt and pepper to taste and garnish soup with crumbled bacon.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown chops in oil. Then place in a baking dish or oblong pan. Cover with potato slices and onion. Spoon soups over the top and spread to cover potatoes. Put foil or lid on. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and chill overnight.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Divide popped corn between two 4-quart glass bowls. Combine brown sugar butter syrup and salt in a 2-quart bowl. Microwave on High for 3 to 3 1/2 minutes or until mixture boils stirring once. Microwave at 30% power for 4 minutes. Stir in soda. Pour half of the syrup evenly over each bowl. Sprinkle 1 cup of peanuts over each bowl. Stir until it lightly coats corn. Microwave at 50% power one bowl at a time for 6 to 7 minutes stirring twice.

title: French Carrots
instructions: Steam or microwave carrots until tender. In a small pan heat butter honey Cointreau orange zest and parsley. Heat until blended. Add salt and pepper to taste. Arrange carrots on serving dish. Pour warm sauce over carrots. Serve at once.

title: Creamy Hash Browns
instructions: Mix sour cream and soups together. Put frozen hash browns in a 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Mix in soups and sprinkle with cheese. Sprinkle with crushed cornflakes (if desired). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Pull lettuce apart rinse and drain beans. Add grated cheese and sliced onion and toss well. Add crushed Doritos tomatoes and salad dressing at the last minute to avoid a soggy salad.

title: Pineapple On Ice
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender.

title: Corn Pudding(Vegetables)
instructions: Melt margarine and cream cheese together. Stir in corn. Simmer on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Stir frequently to avoid sticking.

title: Fruit Salad #3
instructions: Toss all ingredients together and serve in lettuce cups.

title: Black Forest Pie
instructions: In saucepan over medium-low heat melt chocolate with sweetened condensed milk. Remove from heat. Stir in extract.

title: Simple Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients; mix well. Cover. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Place all ingredients into a pot. Bring to a rapid boil. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Refrigerate.

title: Baked Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Pour vegetable oil into baking dish. Add minced garlic and paprika. Dip chicken breasts into mixture and coat evenly on both sides. Place chicken in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove and drain excess oil. Put cheese over top of chicken and return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes or until cheeses are melted. Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken breasts and bake 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Dice artichokes very fine. Mix mayonnaise and cheese with artichokes thoroughly. Put in small casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and bubbly. Serve with Ritz or Town House crackers.

title: Everyday Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can also be baked in microwave oven.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients in large bowl. Add oil and blend. Add eggs and beat well. Add grated carrots; stir and beat well. Bake in two 9-inch round cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Drain. Add butter. Combine all other ingredients. Bake in greased casserole pan at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and beat with mixer. Pour into a casserole dish.

title: Cracker Candy
instructions: Crush crackers; boil sugar and mix exactly 4 minutes. Remove from heat immediately and quickly stir in crackers and peanut butter. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Allow to cool and enjoy.

title: Herbed Yogurt Cheese
instructions: Line 6-inch strainer with coffee filter or double thickness of cheesecloth. Place strainer over bowl.

title: Blueberry Cheese Pie
instructions: Add Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice to softened cream cheese. Pour 1/2 blueberry pie filling in a graham cracker crust. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour over pie mix. Add Cool Whip milk and lemon juice. Then put the rest of the pie filling on top. Let cool several hours.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a saucepan and cook until heated through approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Add sour cream and blend.

title: Best Ever Fried Eggplant
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut in 1/2-inch slices. Combine first 3 ingredients. Separately combine next 3 ingredients. Coat each slice eggplant in mayonnaise mixture then in crumb mixture. Place in single layers on cookie sheet and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes or until brown. Serve hot. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Sift together flour baking soda ginger allspice and cinnamon. Set aside. In a large bowl cream butter or margarine. Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add egg and pumpkin. Beat well. Add dry ingredients. Mix until blended. Add nuts. Mix well. Spread batter evenly in well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift flour with salt baking powder soda cloves cinnamon and nutmeg and set aside. In a large bowl beat sugar with butter until blended. Add eggs one at a time beating. Mix well after each egg. Continue to beat mix until light and fluffy. Beat in pumpkin with mixer at low speed; gradually add flour mixture until well blended. Divide batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes. Turn onto wire rack to cool completely. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar water and cornstarch until thick. Add Jell-O and pour over strawberries in baked pie shell. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add sugar slowly and continue beating until mixture is very stiff. Gently add nuts and chips with spoon. Drop by tablespoon on a cookie sheet covered in foil (greased with a little Crisco). Place in oven and turn heat off. Leave cookies in oven overnight or several hours. This recipe doubles well.

title: Broccoli Onion Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli and water in casserole dish. Microwave on High for 10 minutes; drain. Stir to break up. Stir in onions and soup. Top with cracker crumbs; microwave on High for 7 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave for 1 minute on High until cheese is melted.

title: Caramel Cinnamon Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar cinnamon and nuts in a bowl. In a saucepan mix oleo oil and water and bring to a boil. Pour over the dry ingredients. Add sour milk soda eggs vanilla and salt and beat well. Pour into greased and floured cookie sheet pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Ten minutes before cake is done make frosting.

title: Polske Paczki(Polish Donuts)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk; add 2 cups flour. Let stand in warm place about 1/2 hour. Then beat eggs sugar vanilla grated rind and scant teaspoon salt. Beat until light. Add this to sponge. Melt butter and add this to sponge. Add 5 cups of flour. Cover and allow to rise for about 1 hour or until double in bulk. When light turn on board and pat with hands until dough is 1/2-inch thick. Cut and let rise again until light. Cook in deep oil.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Cook 1st. 8 ingredients in large kettle. While they are cooking brown ground beef and onion. After browning add to rest of ingredients. Cook till done about 20 minutes. Could also be put in slow cooker and cook for 6 - 8 hours. Optional Add cabbage.

title: Tangy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain and save liquid of fruit cocktail and pineapple. Add 1 cup of this liquid to the pudding and Tang. Mix all ingredients together. Apples or maraschino cherries may be added for color.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender and blend on mix for 1 minute.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Bring to a boil; add 2 cups powdered sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip(Microwave)
instructions: Remove outer wrap of frozen broccoli and microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes. Microwave onions and celery in butter until tender. Add soup and cheese. Microwave 4 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Stir twice during cooking. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and microwave until heated through. Serve hot with corn chips or fresh vegetables.

title: Roast Chicken And Potatoes
instructions: Mix tomato sauce in small amount of water in a bowl. Coat potatoes with sauce and place in roaster. Sprinkle garlic bouillon and dabs of butter on top of potatoes. Do the same with chicken. Cover chicken with remaining sauce. Bake 1 1/2 hours covered at 350\u00b0.

title: Chess Bars
instructions: Mix together cake mix egg and margarine. Put in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese eggs powdered sugar and vanilla. Pour over first mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Sally'S Blubber Burner
instructions: One glass before each meal. Good for dieting!

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and beans. Sprinkle onion rings on top. Heat thoroughly in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute 1 onion and green pepper in margarine. Slightly beat eggs and mix with Jiffy corn mix and corn; add onion and pepper. Pour into casserole dish. Mix sour cream and cheese; pour over top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Gram'S Nutmeg Sauce(To Serve Over Fig Or Plum Pudding)
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Add boiling water gradually. Cook 3 to 4 minutes until thick. Remove from burner and add butter and nutmeg. Serve over fig or plum pudding.

title: Michael'S Marvelous Chicken
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil. Add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes. Drain well; rinse with cold water. Peel and devein shrimp. Combine whipped butter and next 3 ingredients; add shrimp. Add salt basil poultry seasoning garlic and lemon juice; mix well.

title: Beef Stroganoff - Quick And Easy
instructions: Cut beef in 1-inch strips. Brown in hot shortening. Add chopped onion and garlic. Lightly season beef. Stir in soup and mushroom pieces. Add ketchup Worcestershire sauce and sour cream. Heat but do not boil. Serve over noodles.

title: Best Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Gently stir salt into thinly sliced cucumbers. Cover with ice cubes; let stand 2 to 3 hours. Add more ice if it melts. Drain. Add onions. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes. Pack at once in hot sterilized jars. Process in boiling water bath for 30 minutes. Remove jars from canner. Makes 8 pints.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Put onion green pepper and butter in 3-quart microwave casserole. Cover and cook on High (max power) for 6 to 8 minutes until onion is translucent. Add juice from stewed tomatoes and flour; stir until smooth. Stir in rest of the stewed tomatoes. Cover and cook on High for 5 minutes. Add chicken covering with sauce. Cover and cook on Simmer (or 50%) for 25 to 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Stir halfway through cooking time. Allow to stand covered 5 minutes before serving with hot rice or pasta.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and drain. In large pot combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil covered for 40 minutes. Uncover for the last 10 minutes. Skim off grease.

title: Sunny Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium bowl. Add fruit and toss gently. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Step 1 Mix together flour pecans and butter like a pie crust. Press in bottom of a 7 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Margaritas
instructions: Blend in blender and serve in salted glasses.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt candy with 1 stick of butter in top of double boiler. Set aside to cool. Cream 1 stick butter with sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour nuts and buttermilk to which soda has been added. Add vanilla. Fold in Milky Way mixture. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 300\u00b0.

title: Gorp(Trail Mix)
instructions: Mix together. Place in sealed plastic bag or other airtight container.

title: S'Mores Pudding Dessert
instructions: Oil or butter a 1 1/2 quart glass baking dish; then line bottom of dish with 1/3 of the whole size graham crackers. Cook pudding mix with\tthe milk using a little extra milk if needed as directed on package. Pudding should not be too thick. Cool pudding not more than 5 minutes.

title: Roast With Pepperoncini
instructions: Pour pepper juice into roaster. Cut tops off peppers. Add water or wine to jar and add. Cook at 350\u00b0 all day. Will fall apart with fork.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes and place in greased casserole. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine chicken soup and evaporated milk. Dot with margarine. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Heat clams with liquid. Dice potato onion and green pepper. Drain clams but keep liquid. Put clam liquid potato onion and pepper into a saucepan and cook on low heat until tender. Add milk if necessary.

title: Chicken Oriental
instructions: Combine chicken soup mayonnaise celery rice onion salt and water chestnuts. Place in a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Melt margarine; add sliced almonds and corn flakes. Sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg then flour (sifted) then the nut meats (cut fine). Drop onto greased cookie sheet with teaspoon. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0); cook quickly. Yields 50 cookies.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Dissolve strawberry jello with 1/2 cup hot water. Then mix cake mix oil eggs jello and strawberries in order with an electric mixer. Bake in 3 medium cake pans (put wax paper in bottom of pans) at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. If possible make cake few days before using and refrigerate.

title: Oven-Baked Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Add garlic ketchup soy sauce and honey to chicken bouillon. Stir until well blended. Pour into shallow baking dish. Lay spareribs in the marinade sauce and let sit in refrigerator turning occasionally overnight or 8 hours at least in sauce. Bake at 375\u00b0 in oven for 1 1/2 hours turning for even browning in the pan with the sauce. Serves 4. Delicious and easy.

title: Get Together Punch
instructions: Day before serving pour 1 can punch into a 1 1/2-quart ring mold. Freeze. Mix remaining punch pineapple juice lemonade and club soda into a punch bowl.

title: Overnight Tossed Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce and spinach into bite size pieces in very large bowl. Add onion tomatoes peas and bacon; toss gently. Combine mayonnaise sour cream lemon juice oregano basil salt and pepper. Mix well. Spread dressing over greens; be sure to \frost\ entire surface. Do not mix in! Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. To serve Toss dressing with greens. Serves 8.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; spread pineapple evenly. Cover with cherries. Sprinkle cake mix over fruit. Sprinkle melted butter over cake mix. Add nuts if wanted. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer first 7 ingredients and place in refrigerator 6 hours or overnight. Just before serving toss and sprinkle bacon and cheese on top.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in greased and floured pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Walnut Graham Cracker Cookie Bars
instructions: Line a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet with whole graham crackers; set aside. On top of stove in a pan combine brown sugar margarine and walnuts. Heat until all melted together. Pour over all graham crackers and spread evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool slightly and cut into squares.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Layer salad with the first 4 ingredients. For top of salad mix the next 3 ingredients. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons dried salad seasoning (McCormick Salad Supreme).

title: Tom'S Tea
instructions: Place tea bags in a small saucepan with water. Bring to a boil. Boil 3 minutes. Remove from stove and set aside to cool.

title: Homemade White Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water with 1 teaspoon of sugar for 5 minutes in one bowl. Put scalded milk sugar and salt in another bowl and cool; add 4 cups flour. Mix until smooth. Add yeast mixture to this. Add more flour to form dough. Cover with towel; let rise. When it doubles punch down. Let rise again. Separate into pans; let rise again. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchilada
instructions: Cook chicken; shred it and keep broth. Fry tortilla shells in a dash of oil until lightly browned. Add cheese mushrooms chicken and onion to shell and roll up. Mix chicken soup and chicken broth and pour on top of tortillas. Top with cheese and bake in warm oven until melted.

title: Surprise Casserole
instructions: Layer in order given. After baking 1 hour in a covered casserole uncover and add 7 or 8 slices of American cheese and return to heat just to melt cheese.

title: Soup
instructions: Cook all the ingredients on low heat until vegetables are tender.

title: Skipper'S Ceiling Pancakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and grill on lightly oiled hot skillet or griddle. If the pancakes are flipped too high they will stick to the ceiling.

title: Mustard 'N Herb Sauce
instructions: Use blender to mix egg and champagne mustard with blender on high speed. Add oil in a thin stream until mixture thickens. Turn off blender and add parsley and lemon dill. Blend again until sauce is pale green. Makes about 1 1/2 cups of sauce.

title: Busy Women'S Dream
instructions: Cook ground chuck; crumble in bottom of a 10 x 10-inch dish. Add can of soup. Place the Tater Tots on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers and butter. Pour in baking dish. Crush one roll of Ritz; sprinkle over mixture. Pour one stick melted margarine over it. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Fruity Spring Trifle
instructions: Break cookies coarsely into 2 1/2-quart clear glass serving bowl. Sprinkle with orange juice. Top with layers of sliced fruit. Prepare pudding with 3 cups of milk. Refrigerate until pudding begins to thicken. Add chocolate; stir with wire whisk. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spoon over fruit; top with remaining whipped topping. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or overnight.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Boil vegetables in 1/2 cup water until tender. Drain and add beef and gravy. Pour into casserole dish. Beat egg whites with salt until stiff. Beat flakes sour cream and milk. Fold in egg whites. Spread over beef mixture. Sprinkle cheese and paprika over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix a tablespoon of cornstarch with 1 cup sugar. Mix with 1/4 cup cold water and stir gradually into 3/4 cup hot water. Bring to a boil and cook until clear and thick. Stir 3 tablespoons of strawberry Jell-O into hot filling. Stir until dissolved. Let cool. Gently fold fresh whole strawberries into cooled mixture. Pat into baked pie shell. Place into refrigerator to set. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Combine orange and pineapple juices with enough water to make 1 1/4 cups. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add orange rind and other juices. Crush cranberry sauce with a fork. Add to juices and pineapple. Chill until slightly thickened. Add orange sections and nuts. Pour into mold and chill.

title: Oven Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into 4 portions. Mix flour and salt. Pound into meat. Set aside remaining flour. Brown meat in small amount of hot shortening and place in shallow baking dish. Blend remaining flour with drippings in skillet. Add remaining ingredients except cheese.

title: Lemon Cake Squares
instructions: Mix the cake mix 1 egg pecans and butter together. Beat by hand until well blended. Spread this mixture in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Use your hands to spread this mixture evenly over the bottom of pan.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Separate crescent dough and place in ungreased 12-inch pizza pan. Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese.

title: Libby'S Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine the soup water and green beans in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle top with cheese and dressing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Microwave the sugar and karo 4 minutes on high in covered microwave-safe dish. Add nuts. 4 minutes more on high. Add butter and vanilla. Microwave 2 minutes on high. Add 1 tsp soda and stir briskly. Pour and spread onto cookie sheet.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Roll stew meat in flour and brown in small amount of shortening. Combine all ingredients in large covered pot. Make sure there is enough liquid to cover all ingredients. Add water or more V-8 if necessary. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours. Do not peek.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Slowly add flour mixture then vanilla. Add sour cream last. Cook at 325\u00b0 in tube pan about 1 1/4 hours.

title: Flavor-Favorite Bar Cookies
instructions: Combine oleo and sugar. Blend in egg and vanilla. Add flour; mix well. Spread into ungreased 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts; press lightly into batter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until edges are lightly brown. Cool; cut into squares or bars.

title: Pecan Sandies
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. Mix well. Add flour and pecans. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Shape into balls or fingers. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool slightly then roll into powdered sugar.

title: Whoopie Pies(Homemade Moon Pies)
instructions: Add all ingredients together. Beat well and drop by teaspoonful on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes in oven at 375\u00b0.

title: Orange Creme Salad
instructions: Combine cream cheese and sugar beating until light and fluffy. Gradually add milk beating until blended. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; let cool 5 minutes. Gradually add to cream cheese mixture beating until blended. Stir in rind and juice. Pour into a lightly oiled 4-cup mold. Chill until firm.

title: Ruth'S Cookies
instructions: Combine water eggs margarine peanut butter and half of cake mix until smooth. Mix in rest of cake mix and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cut up vegetables and cover with Equal vinegar and water mixture. You may add other vegetables.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring first four ingredients to full boil and cook for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add next 3 ingredients. Mix well. Drop by teaspoons on wax paper and let cool.

title: Holiday Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Steam yams until almost done; cool and peel. Cut lengthwise and place in flat pan. Put remaining ingredients in saucepan; cook for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Pour sauce over yams. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine onion milk cheese soup crackers butter salt and pepper to taste. Alternate layers of the cooked squash and sauce mixture in a buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Combine cranberries marshmallows and sugar. Let set overnight. Add apples grapes pecans and salt. Fold together with whipped cream. Chill.

title: Chicken And Rice(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cut up tomatoes into large chunks. Cut up pepper into strips. Cut up onions into rings. Dissolve chicken bouillon with 1 cup water. Combine ingredients and simmer until tomatoes dissolve. Add salt pepper and garlic powder. Cut up chicken in strips and add. Simmer another 1/2 hour. Cook rice and add (or) serve it over the rice.

title: Mom'S Goulash
instructions: In a frying pan saute in butter or oleo the onions pepper and celery. Add meat; cook until done and drain off fat. Add beans tomato juice macaroni salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot as is or over corn bread.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cinnamon sticks in pan. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes. Pour into six mugs. Add cinnamon stick to each mug for stirring.

title: Rye Bread Dip(Appetizer)
instructions: Take an oval rye bread loaf and hollow out center after cutting off a top portion. Break up center pieces into bite-sized pieces of bread. May break up top portion also. Bread now looks like a \bowl.\ Mix dip ingredients and fill rye \bowl\ just before serving. Use broken rye bread pieces as dippers.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: *Immerse in boiling water to peel then squeeze out seeds and chop.

title: Yummy Brisket
instructions: Trim fat on brisket. Line cake pan with aluminum foil 6 inches extra on each side. Put brisket on foil. Rub Worcestershire sauce on brisket generously so there is some on the pan. Rub with garlic powder and pepper. Top with soup mix. Top with another sheet of foil and seal well with bottom sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Slice into thin pieces.

title: Meat Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream softened cheese and mayonnaise. Add onion horseradish and hot sauce. Take 3/4 cup of pecans and all of meat. Add to mixture. Sprinkle remainder of nuts and parsley over ball. Let set in refrigerator for several hours.

title: Deviled Ham Spread
instructions: Mix all together; spread on Triscuits or any cracker of your choice.

title: Lemon Salad
instructions: Dissolve the jello in the hot water and cold water. Add the remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13 dish and chill until set.

title: Chicken A La Can
instructions: Combine soups water and chicken. Add rice; quickly boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 7 minutes. Top with French fried onions.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Cook and stir until it bubbles. Serve hot or cold.

title: Benny'S Pasta E Fagioli
instructions: Add bouillon granules to 1 cup water and set aside to dissolve. Heat oil in large soup pot over medium-high heat. Saute beef stirring to break up slightly until beef loses pink color. Add 2 cups of water onion carrots and celery and simmer 10 minutes. Stir bouillon mixture oregano black pepper parsley Tabasco and Ragu into pot. Simmer 10 minutes. Add 2 cups of water (or enough to reach desired consistency) stir and simmer about 40 minutes (until carrots and celery are done). Cook drain and rinse pasta while soup simmers. Stir in beans and pasta just before serving. Makes about 12 large servings. Change flavor by changing type of spaghetti sauce used.

title: Grandma'S Gingersnaps
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream shortening and sugar. Beat in egg and molasses. Combine flour soda spices and salt. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Roll teaspoonfuls of dough into balls. Dip one side of each ball in sugar; place with sugar side up on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown and crinkly. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Add all ingredients including broccoli into blender and blend. Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients and cook until thickened. Add 2 tablespoons butter and vanilla and stir.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; beat eggs in one at a time. Sift flour salt and baking powder (I sift mine 3 times). Add flour and milk alternately. Pour into tube pan. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chocolate Banana Cake
instructions: Prepare ingredients in order given beating 3 minutes. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes until done.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients. Add the rest; beat 1 minute. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Key Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Mix good. Do not beat; milk may look curdled. Just mix a little more. Pour into an 8-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pig Pickin' Cake
instructions: Combine and divide into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool.

title: Corn Fritters(From 1975 Edition)
instructions: Beat egg yolks; add to corn then add salt sugar and flour. Add butter. Beat egg whites until stiff and add last. Fry on hot griddle. When golden brown turn over on other side.

title: Honey Butter
instructions: Mix until creamy. Refrigerate in covered jar.

title: Quick Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in foil lined pan. Season chicken and place onion slices over chicken. Mix catsup and Coca-Cola together; pour over chicken. Bake until tender at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Yields 4 servings.

title: Trifle Cake
instructions: Bake a devils food cake. Completely cool and cut into strips. Mix up chocolate pudding. Using a large bowl put layer of cake strips in bottom of bowl. Cover cake strips with chocolate syrup. Next put a layer of chocolate pudding then a layer of nuts and a layer of Cool Whip. Start completely over ending with Cool Whip. Swirl top with chocolate syrup chopped nuts and top with cherries.

title: Cavatina
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage. Drain. Add mushrooms and spaghetti sauce. Cook pasta and drain. In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan layer 1/2 of pasta 1/2 of pepperoni 1/2 of cheese and 1/2 of meat mixture. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
instructions: Strain pineapple (save juice). Take juice from pineapple add the butter and heat until butter is melted. In bottom of long baking dish spread blueberries and pineapple. Then sprinkle cake mix on top. Pour juice and butter and last sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Use a cookie sheet. Thoroughly combine all ingredients. Put through cookie press with star tip onto cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Store cooled straws in airtight container. Makes about 90.

title: Texas Chili Beef
instructions: Heat the oil in a large heavy bottomed skillet add the onions red pepper and garlic if using and cook gently for 5 minutes until the onion and pepper are soft. Add the beef turn the heat to high and cook until the meat is evenly browned stirring with a wooden spoon to remove lumps. Remove from the heat and stir in the flour chili powder cumin and oregano. Add the tomato paste the tomatoes with their juice and the beef broth. Return to the heat and bring to a boil stirring. Season with salt if desired but not with pepper (chili powder flavors the dish). Cover the pan and simmer for approximately 40 minutes. Stir in the cannellini beans and simmer for a further 5 minutes to heat through. Turn into a warmed serving dish and serve at once. Serves 4.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together well the sugar and cream cheese. Stir in Cool Whip and add the bananas strawberries and pineapple. Freeze. Will keep in freezer for 3 months.

title: Fresh Cabbage Relish
instructions: Shred cabbage and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons salt in glass bowl. Let\tset several hours or overnight. Drain well. Coarsely grate carrot. Cut\tonion into thin slices. Add to cabbage. Add celery seed and mustard seed to cabbage. Bring to a boil the vinegar water and sugar. Boil 1 minute. Cool and pour over vegetables\tand spices. Cover and chill 24 hours. Will keep several weeks in refrigerator.

title: Pecan Wonder Coffee Cake
instructions: *Sour cream or sour milk may be used instead.

title: Macaroons(Diabetic)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites stiff but not dry; fold in sweetener. Add cornflakes coconut nuts and almond extract. Drop from teaspoon onto greased baking sheet; bake about 12 minutes. Remove at once from baking sheet.

title: Sweet Potato Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Blend in sweet potatoes. Sift together dry ingredients; add nuts. Stir into creamed mixture alternately with cold coffee. Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans and 8 greased muffin pan cups. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 1 hour for loaves and 25 minutes for muffins or until they test done in center. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely. Makes 2 loaves plus 8 muffins.

title: Oatmeal Bake
instructions: Cream well butter white sugar and brown sugar. Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling water over 1 cup oatmeal. Add 1 whole egg 2 egg whites (save yolks) and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Sift together 1 1/2 cups flour 1 teaspoon soda 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Combine creamed mixture and oatmeal; gradually add dry mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. When taken from oven cover with following topping.

title: Dream Pie
instructions: Beat whipped topping mix 1 cup milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Add remaining 1 3/4 cups milk and pudding mixes. Blend on low speed. Beat on high speed 2 minutes. Spoon into pie shell. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Store leftovers in refrigerator.

title: Classic Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs slightly in bowl. Add sugar margarine and vanilla. Mix in pecans. Set pie shell on heavy-duty baking sheet. Pour filling into pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 45 to 50 minutes until knife inserted midway between center and rim tests clean. Cool on rack to room temperature.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except last 3. In a separate pan melt butter. Add corn flakes and almonds. Spoon over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Tired Mama Cake
instructions: Put cherries and pineapple (juice and all) in cake pan (9 x 13-inch) and mix together. Sprinkle cake mix over fruit. Sprinkle chopped nuts over cake mix. Cut up margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Excellent Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheets. In a large bowl cream together the shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well with each addition then stir in the vanilla and sour cream. Combine the flour baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon. Gradually stir into the creamed mix. Finally stir in the rolled oats and your choice of additions. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Then let cool for 5 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fruit Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Mash cranberry sauce and add to jello. Stir until smooth and add 1 cup cold water. Chill until thickened. Fold in apples and oranges. Pour into a 6 cup mold and chill until set.

title: Grandma'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Melt Crisco shortening in 4-quart saucepan over low heat. Remove and let cool. Add sugar molasses and egg to cooled shortening; beat well. Sift together flour soda ginger cloves cinnamon and salt. Add to first mixture. Mix well. Chill 2 hours. Form into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. Place on a greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barbecued Franks
instructions: In skillet brown ground beef and hot dogs in margarine. Add green pepper and onion. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover; cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Stir. Serve in hot dog buns and spoon sauce over.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients like pie crust. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Gradually add fettuccine and salt to rapidly boiling water so water continues to boil. Cook uncovered stirring occasionally until tender. Drain. Pour back into heated pan. Gradually but quickly stir in butter half and half and cheese tossing quickly so butter will melt. Sprinkle with pepper and serve at once. Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine with mixer and chill until ready to serve. Great with any fruit.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Cream together Jell-O and cream cheese. Add boiling water and mash with fork. Add pineapple Cool Whip and nuts. Put in 9 x 12-inch pan. Chill and serve.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Mix sugar milk flour nutmeg cinnamon and baking powder together then melt butter in a deep baking dish. Pour the first mixture over butter. Add fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust rises and browns about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Mix ingredients together; shake well. Baste chicken. Place over rack on bottom position. Broil chicken pieces. Baste with sauce. Cook about 1 hour turn after 1/2 hour.

title: Gooey Cake(Serve As A Brownie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix butter and egg. Batter will be stiff. Take spatula and pat into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Set aside. Mix powdered sugar eggs and cream cheese with mixer for 5 minutes until good. Pour over top of cake mix. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Take remaining powdered sugar and sprinkle over the top when cake is done. Let cool and serve. Caution Overeating this stuff will cause severe stomach ache its very rich! I know!

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix first 10 ingredients together. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Bake. Yields 6 dozen.

title: Chili Burger(Quick And Easy)
instructions: With the ground beef prepare as many patties as needed. Place on baking sheet. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce to taste and broil in oven until done. Heat chili mixed with chopped onions. Remove cooked patties and place on bun. Pour chili and onion mixture on top of patties. Add cheese and onions. Top with top of the bun.

title: Lemon Torte
instructions: In medium saucepan combine egg yolks lemon peel lemon juice salt and 1/4 cup sugar. Mix thoroughly and cook over medium heat until mixture just bubbles. Stir constantly or it will scorch. Cool. Beat egg whites until frothy. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and beat until mixture forms stiff peaks. Whip whipping cream. Fold in lemon mixture and egg whites; mix well. Cover the bottom of 8-inch square Pyrex dish with crushed graham cracker crumbs. Pour lemon mixture over crumbs. Sprinkle some crumbs on top and freeze at least 4 hours.

title: Seashore Shells
instructions: Bake patty shells as directed on package. Meanwhile combine and heat soups (undiluted). Add fish and peas. Warm until just heated through. Spoon into shells. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend pudding peanut butter milk and Cool Whip together and pour in graham cracker shell. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Pecan Date (Cracker) Pie
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients; add chopped pecans and dates. Beat 3 egg whites and blend gently with mixture. Add almond flavoring. Bake in greased pie dish at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Life Recipe
instructions: Mix these thoughts and tears of joy and sorrow. Add sympathy for others. Fold in four cups of prayer and faith to lighten other ingredients and raise texture to great heights of Christian living. After pouring all this into your daily life bake well with the heat of human kindness and serve with a smile.

title: Taco Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and garlic; drain off fat and add tomato sauce water olives flour vinegar and chili powder. Simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Wings Buffalo Style
instructions: Place wings on a cookie sheet. Melt butter with sauce. Pour over wings. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Green Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach; drain well. Mix all ingredients together and pour into large greased casserole. (Add milk after hot ingredients are melted.) Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hot Water Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream sugar cocoa and shortening. Add hot water and stir until melted. Add sifted dry ingredients and blend; then add milk and vanilla. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool and then frost and serve.

title: 14-Day Sweet Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers. Cut a 1/16-inch slice off blossom end and discard. Leave 1/4-inch of the stem attached. Place whole cucumbers in suitable 1-gallon container. Combine 1/4 cup salt with 2 quarts water; bring to a boil. Pour over cucumbers. Add suitable cover and weight. Place a clean towel over container. Store at about 70\u00b0. On the third day drain salt water and discard. Rinse cucumbers and re-scald container; cover and weight. Return cucumbers to container. Add 1/4 cup salt to 2 quarts fresh water and boil. Pour over cucumbers. Replace cover and weight; recover with a clean towel. On the fifth day drain salt water and discard. Rinse. Makes 5 to 9 pints.

title: Chicken Dorito
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Cool and debone. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Saute onion until tender. Combine chicken soup tomatoes and onion. Layer Doritos chicken mixture and cheese. Bake in moderate oven until cheese is melted and the dish is thoroughly heated.

title: Kugali
instructions: Fry bacon until it starts to brown. Add chopped onion. Fry until onion browns; set aside. Do not drain grease. Add this to potato mixture. Grate potatoes into cold water. Stir well. Drain. Add eggs milk salt pepper and Accent. Stir well. Add bacon and onion. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Low Sodium Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers. Pack into sterilized jars. Place 1/2 clove garlic and 1 head dill in each jar. Heat vinegar water and salt substitute in saucepan until boiling. Cover cucumbers with hot liquid leaving 1/2 inch head space. Adjust lids. Process 15 minutes in boiling water bath. Allow 5 days to ripen.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl except for stuffing. Sprinkle stuffing in bottom of a greased 2 quart casserole dish. Pour mixture over stuffing. Sprinkle one cup of stuffing on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Shepherd'S Pie(A Meal In One Dish)
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add onion and cook until tender. Stir in tomato sauce and heat until bubbly. Put in bottom of a casserole dish. Put green beans (or corn) on top of meat. Put prepared instant potatoes on top of green beans (or corn). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Fettuccine
instructions: Cook fettuccine as directed; set aside. In a large pot melt butter and saute onion and bell peppers for 15 minutes. Add garlic crab and shrimp and cook for 10 minutes. Stir in cream and then cheese stirring gently until cheese is melted. Stir in fettuccine. When thoroughly mixed pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Old-Fashioned Apple Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Mix lightly through apples (sliced 1/4 inch thick). Heap in pastry-lined 9-inch pie pan. Dot with butter. Adjust top crust and flute edges; cut vents. bake in hot oven (425 degrees) 50 to 60 minutes or until crust is browned and apples are tender.

title: Carrot Cookies
instructions: Pour boiling water over raisins and soak 5 minutes; drain. Combine sugar shortening egg and lemon extract in mixing bowl; beat well. Stir in carrots and drained raisins. Sift together flour baking powder and salt; add to first mixture and blend well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortenings; gradually add sugar and cream well. Beat eggs in one at a time. Add flavoring. Mix in milk and flour (with salt) at 3 different times. Mix well. Put in greased and floured tube pan and place in cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well and chill until wobbley. Add marshmallows pineapple and bananas. Mix with slightly chilled jello and let chill until firm. Mix together pineapple juice sugar egg and flour. Cook and stir until thick. Cool. Mix cream cheese and Dream Whip. Put into cooked and cooled mixture with coconut or nuts. Makes enough for two 8-inch or 9-inch pans.

title: Apple-Orange Marmalade
instructions: Peel oranges remove white membrane; boil rinds until tender in water to cover. Let cool then grind and chop fine. Divide peeled oranges in sections combine with apples; add water to barely cover. Cook over low heat one-half hour. Add sugar and orange rind. Boil until thick. Pour into sterilized jelly glasses. When cool seal with paraffin. Makes 10 or more glasses.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Mix eggs milk and salt together. Add baking powder to flour and mix into first ingredients. If not stiff enough to make a stiff dough add more flour gradually. Roll very thin. It may creep. Cover rolled pieces with flour and roll up. Cut into thin strips. May be cooked immediately or dried and stored. Noodles will be done when edges are not sharp.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs. Add dry ingredients. Add chopped fruits and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 on greased and floured cookie sheet. (Drop dough with a tablespoon.) Remove from oven when desired brownness is reached about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Rosemary Honey
instructions: Bruise fresh leaves slightly and place in layers on the bottom of a small saucepan. Pour room temperature honey into the pan and cook over low heat. Stir the mixture just until the honey is warm about 2 minutes. High heat will damage the honey.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Combine and bake at 350\u00b0 till done. Cool.

title: Lemon Luscious
instructions: Soften butter and mix with flour and spread in square baking pan. Then sprinkle pecans over the top of that. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes then cool. Then mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on cooled crust. Chill in refrigerator. Mix pudding and milk and spread over the top of the cheese mixture. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle pecans on top if desired.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Pour into 2 baked 9-inch pie shells. Top with nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar. Mix well. Mix in can milk and vanilla. Fill freezer with milk to 3/4 full. Freeze.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add and mix remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Place casserole in pan of water and bake of 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: In a bowl mix together the flours sugar salt milk powder and baking powder. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until well mixed. Mix water and egg whites to blend but do not beat. Add to dry mixture stirring just to blend. Mixture will be lumpy. Fold in blueberries. Spoon into paper-lined muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes until nicely browned. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Add sugar to beaten eggs. Continue beating until thick. Set aside.

title: Broccoli-And-Chicken Soup
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add broccoli. Cover reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Stir in soup and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thoroughly heated. Stir in pepper. Pour into serving bowls. Top each serving with 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Yields 1 quart.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Chop onion; brown in butter. Add beef. Let brown well and add tomatoes (put through sieve) peppers and garlic. Add beans which have been cooked for 1 hour. Simmer about 6 hours.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Heat through until thick. Add pepper and garlic salt to taste. Cool completely before wrapping mixture in egg roll skins and seal rolls with egg yolk. Deep-fry in wok.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Add 1 large onion thinly sliced. Cook carrots not too soft; drain. Marinate overnight. Can be served cold but best when hot.

title: Molded Vegetable Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water; add cold water vinegar onion and pepper. Chill until slightly thickened. Combine vegetables and fold into gelatin mixture. Chill until firm. To fill a 9 x 13 dish double this recipe.

title: Orange Pineapple Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all together. Freeze in ice cream freezer.

title: Green Bean Casserole(Prep Time:  10 Minutes; Cook Time:  30 Minutes)
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in beans and 1/2 can of onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbling; stir. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Serves 6.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown the onion beef salt and pepper chili powder and tomatoes; set aside. Cook the water 1 teaspoon salt and corn meal on the stove stirring constantly until thickens. Pour the corn meal mush into baking dish; pour meat mixture over that. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar salt and cornstarch in the top of a double boiler. In another bowl beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup of the milk. When well mixed add remaining 1 1/2 cups of milk and mix well. Add milk and egg mixture to sugar mixture. Before starting to cook the pudding layer your wafers and sliced bananas in a 2-quart casserole.

title: Souper Burgers
instructions: Brown beef and saute onion in oil until tender. Stir to separate beef. Pour off grease. Add soup and seasonings and cook 5 minutes. Serve on buns.

title: Gourmet Hominy Bake
instructions: Drain and rinse the hominy. Generously butter a 3-quart casserole. Layer the ingredients in this order hominy green chilies salt pepper sour cream butter. Repeat the layers ending with a layer of hominy. Dot the top with butter and pour cream over all. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Swiss Chocolate Squares
instructions: Combine water butter and chocolate in saucepan; bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in combined flour and sugar. Add eggs sour cream soda and salt; mix well. Pour into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Frost while warm with milk chocolate frosting.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Beat in flour sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Blend in melted butter. Stir in Nestle Toll House semi-sweet chocolate morsels and walnuts. Pour into pie shell. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Pasta Alfredo
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package; drain. In same saucepan heat Alfredo sauce over medium heat stirring frequently. Stir in cooked pasta chicken and peas. Cook 5 minutes more. Makes 4 servings.

title: Never Fail Pastry
instructions: In large bowl with fork beat butter and sugar until creamy then blend this mixture with soft shortening. Combine flour and salt with fork; blend with butter mixture. Gradually stir in water until mixture cleans sides of bowl. On lightly floured surface knead dough until just well mixed. Chill. Divide into thirds and roll out crusts. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Popcorn Balls
instructions: Combine corn syrup and sugar and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in powdered jello until dissolved. Pour over popped corn one quart at a time. Shape into balls and place on Saran Wrap to cool and dry then wrap individually.

title: Crustless Crab Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium skillet saute mushrooms in butter. Remove and drain well. In blender or food processor (metal blade) blend eggs sour cream cottage cheese Parmesan cheese flour onion powder salt and Tabasco sauce. Pour mixture in large bowl. Stir in sauteed mushrooms Jack cheese and crab meat. Pour into 9 or 10-inch quiche pan. Bake 45 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean. Quiche should be brown (golden) and puffed. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Cut in wedges. Serves 8.

title: Apple And Cinnamon Crescent Rolls
instructions: Peel core and cut apples into eight or ten pieces each. (Use one apple per crescent roll.) Put the eight or ten pieces of cut apple on the crescent roll and roll it up. Place them in a deep baking dish. Mix 1 cup water and 1 cup sugar. Pour the mixture over the crescent rolls. Put a little butter on each one and sprinkle cinnamon over the rolls. Bake in preheated oven (350\u00b0) for 20 or 25 minutes.

title: Broiled Squash
instructions: Place squash in a saucepan; add water to cover and bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 6 minutes or until tender but still firm. Drain. Cut squash in half lengthwise leaving stems intact. Remove pulp leaving 1/4-inch thick shells. Mash pulp; add chilies and next 5 ingredients. Stir well. Spoon mixture into shells. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Arrange squash on a rack in a roasting pan coated with vegetable cooking spray. Broil 5 1/2-inches from heat for 8 minutes or until browned. Serves 4.

title: Bread Pie
instructions: Fill pie crust with crumbled bread. Cover bread with sugar. Fill with milk. Dot with little chunks of butter and cover with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder sugar salt and shortening. Mix thoroughly with fork. Add milk to beaten egg and add slowly to make soft dough. Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet for individual shortcakes or put in a 9-inch round cake pan. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0) for 10 to 12 minutes for individual longer for cake pan. Serve with fresh sweetened strawberries.

title: Ellie'S Divinity
instructions: Cook water sugar and syrup until it reaches soft boil stage. Add 1/2 of the syrup mixture to stiffly beaten egg whites. Cook other half of syrup to crack stage when dropped into cold water. Add this to egg whites beating all the time. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir with a large spoon until it loses its gloss. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Chop dates cherries pineapple and pecans. Dredge in a mixture of the next 5 ingredients. Cream sugar and shortening or butter. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Add baking soda with warm water. Add this to the mixture with fruit and flour mixture. Stir well. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Wheat Germ Cookies(Sugarless)
instructions: Heat water and dates together until mushy. Cream oil and dates. Add other ingredients in order given. Beat thoroughly. Add nuts or raisins. Bake on lightly oiled cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain syrup from fruit cocktail; add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid. Heat to boiling; add gelatin. Dissolve and let cool. Stir in fruit. Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and lemon juice and add nuts. Pour half of the gelatin mixture into fruit mold and let set. Spread cream cheese mixture over first layer and pour in remainder of gelatin. Return to refrigerator until firm. Serve on lettuce.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cornflakes and margarine. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Top with crumbled cornflakes and margarine. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Maw-Maw'S Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream together cheese and sugar. Add fruit and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Put in large rectangular pan and freeze.

title: Ella Eld'S....Finnish Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast and salt in warm water using a large mixing bowl. Add whole wheat flour; stir and add the 6 cups white flour. Knead thoroughly right in the bowl. Cover and let rise for 2 hours. Make dough into 3 round flat loaves about 1-inch thick (use a rolling pin). Lay on a cloth to rise for 35 to 40 minutes. Cover with a cloth. Test dough by pressing lightly with finger. If the impression stays it is ready to bake. If not let dough rise a little longer.

title: Microwave Crunchy Caramel Corn
instructions: In large microwave bowl combine popcorn cereal and nuts. In 4-cup microwave bowl combine brown sugar margarine syrup and salt; microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir microwave on High for 45 seconds to 2 minutes or until mixture comes to rolling boil. Stir in vanilla and baking soda (mixture will become foamy). Pour over popcorn mixture and toss to coat. Spread 1/2 of mixture in ungreased 12 x 8-inch pan. Microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until popcorn is evenly coated stirring every minute. Spread on foil to cool. Using same dish repeat with remaining popcorn mixture. Allow to dry for 2 hours. Store tightly in covered container.

title: Peaches & Cream
instructions: In bowl combine flour milk 1/2 c. sugar baking powder vanilla egg and cook and serve pudding together. Mix well and pour into a 10-inch deep dish pie pan or 8x8-inch square sprayed with non-stick spray. Place peaches over the batter. In a small bowl beat well cream cheese peach juice and 1/2 c. sugar. Drop by large spoonfuls over the peaches as evenly as possible. Spread out over the peaches as evenly as possible keeping at least 1 inch from the sides. In small bowl mix together 1 Tbsp. sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35-40 minutes.

title: Polka Dots
instructions: Combine first three ingredients stirring well. Stir in morsels. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheets.

title: Beef And Rice Espagnole
instructions: In skillet cook meat and onions until meat is browned. Drain off fat. Stir in tomato sauce uncooked rice water olives chili peppers garlic salt pepper and hot pepper. Bring to boil. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until rice is tender. Add cheese cubes stirring just until cheese is distributed. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix and place ingredients in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Beat eggs lightly; add with sugar oil and vanilla and add to dry ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Knock Your Socks Off Carrot Soup
instructions: Saute the chopped carrots and onion over medium heat in butter for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Add the stock or bouillon and rice and bring to a boil. Cover the pot and simmer for 25 minutes or until the carrots and rice are tender. Put soup into blender jar and puree on low speed for a minute. Then turn to high speed until the soup is really smooth. (If the soup is too thick for pureeing add a little extra stock.)

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in a large glass bowl in order given. Cover and refrigerate overnight or several hours.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Beat egg. Add sugar and then Wesson oil and vinegar. Sift flour and soda together. Add to mixture. Add buttermilk slowly. Add vanilla and cake coloring. Bake in 3 greased and floured 9 inch pans for 30 minutes at 350.

title: Sunday Dinner Roast
instructions: You will also need heavy-duty aluminum foil.

title: Peach Glazed Carrots
instructions: Arrange carrots in casserole dish. Combine preserves and butter; spoon over carrots. Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until hot. Serves 10.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt the chocolate and oil together. Beat in the sugar and eggs. Stir in the flour baking powder salt and nuts. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin according to directions on box. Add sugar while hot. Add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Cheesy Chowder
instructions: Cook veggies in butter or margarine until tender. Add chicken broth soup and pepper. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Blend milk and flour; stir into chowder. Add cheese and parsley. Heat through until cheese melts and chowder thickens.

title: Chicken Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in bottom of casserole dish. Place one slice of cheese on top of each breast or sprinkle with shredded cheese. Pour soup and wine over top of chicken. Combine stuffing mix and margarine. Sprinkle on top. Bake 350 degrees for 55 - 60 minutes.
