title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix these ingredients together and pour dressing on just before you serve.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Evening Place starter in a large bowl and add these ingredients. Make into stiff batter. Rub with oil. Cover with plastic wrap and leave on counter overnight to rise until doubled.

title: Seafood Cocktail
instructions: Divide seafood among 8 cocktail glasses saving 8 shrimp for garnish. Serve Guacamole Sauce over seafood. Garnish with shrimp.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in pan. Crumble up and drain off fat. Chop or tear bread into small pieces. Grate cheese. Beat eggs; add milk and salt. Spray 9 x 12-inch pan with Pam. Combine meat bread cheese and egg mixture in large bowl. Pour into pan. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 12 servings.

title: Black Cake(This Cake Will Keep Up To A Year.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Take 1/2 cup of flour and dredge raisins and currants in it; set aside. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Beat eggs until light. Sift remaining flour with mace cloves and nutmeg. Add flour alternately to batter with beaten eggs. Stir in brandy and fruit. Pour into baking pan. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 2 or more hours. Makes 36 servings. Preparation time 250.

title: Sausage Dip
instructions: Brown meat adding onion chili powder and garlic salt to taste. Drain off grease. Add meat and soup to crock-pot to heat through. Add milk using 1 soup can. When heated serve with white tortilla chips.

title: Fruitcake
instructions: Combine eggs mincemeat condensed milk fruit and nuts. Fold in dry ingredients. Bake slowly in a tube pan (250\u00b0 or 300\u00b0) for 2 hours.

title: Deep Apple Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Stir together sugar flour nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Mix with apples. Put in ungreased baking dish. Dot with butter. Put pie crust over fruit. Put slits in crust. Bake 1 hour.

title: Elephant Stew, Texas Style
instructions: Skin and dress elephant; cut in bite size cubes. Peel vegetables and cut into cubes. Put rabbits in; cut in half. Put in large pot; simmer gently for 24 hours.

title: Cajun String Beans
instructions: Place neck bones in bottom of soup pot. Add potatoes salt onions parsley garlic and Worcestershire sauce. Place string beans on top. Add water to cover ingredients. Cover and cook slowly until done.

title: Eggplant-Oyster Casserole
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1-inch cubes. Boil in salted water 10 minutes or until soft. Drain and mash. Mix with eggs salt pepper milk melted oleo and 3/4 cup cracker crumbs. Add oysters and pour into greased baking casserole. Cover with remaining cracker crumbs. Dot with oleo and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Pineapple-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix sugar flour and pineapple juice drained from can. In greased medium glass casserole put half of cheese layer of pineapple and top with rest of cheese. Pour juice mixture over all. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour until brown on top.

title: Aunt Patsy'S Bell Peppers(Microwave)
instructions: Cut bell pepper in half seed & clean. Mix all ingredients together and stuff bell peppers. Place in microwave glass dish 2-inches deep. Cover with wax paper and cook 19-20 minutes. Uncover spread ketchup on top of peppers return to microwave and cook uncovered for 2-5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Country Butter Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time alternating with flour. Add vanilla. Bake in a tube pan that has been greased and floured at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sugar English Walnuts
instructions: Combine and cook first 4 ingredients until it has a sugary look or makes a small soft ball when dropped in cold water. Add vanilla flavoring; stir in nuts to coat. Spread on wax paper to cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Baked Celery Casserole
instructions: Cook celery 8 minutes in salted water. Drain. Mix celery chestnuts pimento and soup. Place in a buttered 2-quart casserole. Melt butter. Pour over bread crumbs. Add almonds. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Beat egg in a butter casserole dish. Heat corn and milk then gradually stir into beaten egg. Add salt bread crumbs and cheese. Mix thoroughly. Place directly on the rack of a moderately low (325\u00b0) oven and bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until custard test done.

title: Dry Sugar Pickles
instructions: First Day Let cucumbers and salt set in 1 gallon boiling water for 24 hours.

title: Rice For Weenies
instructions: Start with your hot rice (with that onion already cooked in it remember?). Then add your cheese to the rice so it melts and coats the rice. Does it look like a golden field? Well then youre ready to add the cauliflower and the weenies and serve this nice and hot. If you have a bear sitting at the table while you eat this the calorie count is cut in half. But dont expect to have no calories just because you invited two bears. And you cant subtract calories just because you have three bears there. Get the drift of this yet?

title: Stuffed Flounder
instructions: Simmer peppers onions celery and garlic in butter. Let cool a little and mix together with bread crumbs eggs pepper and parsley. Add crabmeat and mix in. Put 2 to 3 tablespoons stuffing in center of each fillet. Place a pat of butter on stuffing and sprinkle over with lemon juice. Lap ends of fillet over stuffing and secure with toothpick; sprinkle with paprika. Put in greased baking dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix corn margarine eggs and cornbread mix together. Add sour cream. Stir. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. (May need to cover last 10 minutes of baking if top is getting too brown.)

title: Broccoli With Rigatoni Pasta
instructions: Gently brown garlic in oil and butter. Be careful not to burn garlic or it will taste bitter. Add broccoli and stir as you heat pan. Add chicken broth; cover and simmer until broccoli is just al dente (still a little firm). Cook rigatoni pasta until al dente; drain. Add half the fresh basil and mix together with the broccoli. Top with parsley pepper cheese and basil.

title: Needhams(Candy)
instructions: Prepare and cook potatoes to make 3/4 cup. Drain. Add salt and mash. Melt oleo; add potatoes coconut and sugar and mix well. Turn into a buttered jelly roll pan. Spread evenly. Refrigerate and allow to harden. Cut into squares and dip in coating.

title: Instant Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together 24 hours ahead. About 1 hour before serving add 5 bananas quartered. Wonderful.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix and cook for 45 minutes. Can like tomatoes using hot bath.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs
instructions: Mix butter and milk; add peanut butter flour and powdered sugar. Shape into small eggs. Lay on wax paper overnight.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Put roast in roasting pan. Cover with water. Add brown gravy mix; stir until dissolved. Add whole onion. Bake in oven for 3 hours at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Add vegetables; bake 45 minutes to 1 hour more.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: In a 3-quart pan make scalloped potatoes. Leave out butter (hamburger takes place). Fry hamburger and strain. Add to potatoes. Strain peas and add to potato and hamburger. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Make into balls. Melt paraffin wax and chocolate bits. Dip balls in this and lay out on wax paper to dry.

title: Salmon Pickle Loaf(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pack into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 10 minutes before unmolding. Servings 8. Calories 1 serving 221. Exchange per serving 1 bread 2 1/2 low-fat meat.

title: Spaghetti Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken and take off bone. Cook spaghetti in broth. Salt and pepper to taste. Brown green pepper and onion in oleo. Add cream of celery soup and mushroom soup. Mix well. Pour in casserole dish. Cover with cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0. Wash and scrub potatoes good. Dice potatoes in cubes with skins on. Put potatoes in large pot of water. Boil potatoes 10 to 12 minutes. Drain potatoes. Heat butter in a shallow pan that will allow them to be in one layer. When butter is hot roll potatoes in butter until they are covered completely. Add salt and pepper. Place them in a 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven. Cook for about 1 1/2 hours turning occasionally so they will brown evenly. (You may use a little vegetable oil when butter cooks out of potatoes.)

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: Use just enough canned milk to be able to form graham crackers into dough. Add dates nuts and Marshmallow Creme. Mold into 1 large roll or several small ones.

title: Mozzarella Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut Italian bread crosswise into 1-inch slices. Do not cut through bottom crust. Cut Mozzarella cheese into 1/4-inch slices. Place cheese slices and olives between bread slices. Then place the bread on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and the bread is hot. Sprinkle loaf with oregano. With a knife divide loaf into slices. Serve hot.

title: Turnip Casserole
instructions: Cook turnips and onion in saucepan in a little water until tender. Drain and mash. Add next four ingredients to turnips and mix well. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Place chuck roast in a crock-pot. Cover with water. Add soup mix and tomato juice. Let cook all day or night. Remove meat from broth and cool. Remove any fat from top of broth. Place broth in roaster or large soup pot. Add barley carrots celery and beef broth. Simmer slowly until carrots are slightly tender. Add lima beans corn and green beans. Let cook a while and add cabbage cut fine. When that is tender add peas. Then add the meat that has been trimmed of any fat and cut into small pieces. Simmer.

title: 7 Pounds Wings
instructions: *Use if you want them a little spicy.

title: Cajun (15) Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans and rinse. Simmer beans in 2-quarts water about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Saute onion. Add onion tomatoes lemon juice and flavor packet to beans. Simmer another 30 minutes. Add sliced sausage the last 10 minutes of simmering. Serve with crusty pumpernickel bread.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Gradually add flour mixture to creamed butter. Add vanilla and nuts. Drop in 1-inch balls on a greased cookie sheet and then mash slightly flat. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown. If desired roll in powdered sugar. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In skillet saute beef and onions until meat is fully cooked. Drain fat. Stir in tomato sauce and other seasonings. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Spread mashed potatoes on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes uncovered or until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Wash and cook apples until tender then run in blender until smooth. Put in saucepan; cook with cider vinegar sugar and spices on low heat about 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Pour at once into jars and seal. Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath at simmering temperature.

title: Rocky Road Squares
instructions: In top of double boiler over boiling water melt morsels with sweetened condensed milk and butter. Remove from heat. In large bowl combine nuts and marshmallows; fold in chocolate mixture. Spread on wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill 2 hours until firm. Remove from pan; peel off wax paper and cut into squares. Cover and store at room temperature.

title: Unusual Meatballs
instructions: Mix all together except soups. Make into 12 large balls or more small ones if preferred. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan or any baking dish. Mix soups together and pour over. Cover with foil or glass top of baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. This can be made the night before and put in the refrigerator. Can be served with rice or potatoes.

title: Easy Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cook crumble and drain sausage. Layer ingredients in order listed in 9 x 13 glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until firm. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Chocolate Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Combine cocoa and sugar in a bowl. Cream butter with 1/2 cup cocoa mixture in small bowl. Add remaining mixture alternately with milk beating to spreading consistency. Blend in vanilla.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse. Add chopped vegetables. Pour Italian dressing and Salad Supreme over vegetable-spaghetti mixture. Toss before serving.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Melt Crisco in boiling water. Add sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add eggs yeast mixture and flour. Batter will not be stiff. Cover with greased waxed paper and refrigerate.

title: Jalapeno Cocktail
instructions: In covered blender combine ingredients and blend until smooth. Pour over ice into four 10-ounce glasses. Garnish with sour cream. Yields 4 cups or 6 servings.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Chill 1/2 hour then roll out and bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Party Meatballs
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine ground beef eggs bread crumbs water and garlic salt. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Shape beef mixture into 1-inch balls.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and cheese together. Layer all ingredients after cooking and draining the broccoli in a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sister Ann'S Braised Venison
instructions: Salt each steak; dredge in flour and beat with a mallet or edge of saucer. Saute onions in the fat then remove onions and reserve. Brown steaks well in fat on each side over medium heat. Be careful not to overcook it. Serve with onions on top. Make gravy with the drippings and 3 tablespoons flour. Serve in a separate bowl or return steaks and onions to gravy pan and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with rice or hot biscuits or mashed potatoes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Shake chicken in bag with flour salt and pepper. Melt butter and dip floured chicken pieces into butter. Roll chicken in potato chips. Place in foil-lined pan; cover with foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. Just before removing from oven remove foil and brown.

title: Broccoli Continental
instructions: Arrange broccoli in a shallow baking dish. Arrange mushroom slices over this then arrange olives then pimento strips. Sprinkle lightly with oregano and garlic powder or garlic salt.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir together peanuts sugar syrup and salt in a large microwavable mixing bowl. Cook 4 minutes on High power. Stir and cook 4 more minutes on High. Stir in butter and vanilla. Cook 2 more minutes on High. Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and foamy. Immediately pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet and spread very thin. When cool break into smaller pieces. Store in an airtight container. Makes 1 pound.

title: Praline Grahams
instructions: Separate each graham cracker into 4 sections. Arrange in a jelly roll pan with edges touching. Melt margarine in a saucepan; stir in sugar and pecans. Bring to a boil cooking 3 minutes stirring frequently. Spread mixture over graham crackers. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Let cool and break apart. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Old Style Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease bottom of loaf pan and lightly flour. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Beat in eggs one at a time. Gradually add sugar beating all the time. Add to flour mixture then add lemon juice. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Marla'S Butter Pecan Carrots
instructions: Peel carrots and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Boil until tender (20 minutes). Remove from heat drain and add butter. Stir to coat all carrots. Add maple syrup and put mixture in a baking dish. Add pecans and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir to coat. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: *Minute-Boil Fudge Frosting
instructions: Place chocolate sugar milk Spry butter corn syrup and salt in a saucepan. Bring slowly to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. Boil briskly for 1 minute. (On a rainy day or very humid day boil mixture for 30 seconds more.) Cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread.

title: Quick Lunch
instructions: Split top of wieners lengthwise fill with grated cheese sprinkle crushed peanuts on top. Stick under broiler until sizzles.

title: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix jelly and chili sauce in a large pan. Roll meat into small bite size balls. Brown in skillet. Add meat to sauce and cook about an hour. (Crock pot works well.) Use toothpicks to serve for a party or serve over rice as a meal.

title: Butterfinger Dessert
instructions: Combine all crackers and margarine; mix and put 2/3 of the mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Shrimp And Crab Casserole
instructions: Saute vegetables until tender. Add soup cheese pimento salt and pepper. Stir in crab meat and shrimp. Add Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 20 to 25 minutes. Dot with butter before baking.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown hamburg onions and bacon. Mix in sauce and beans. Cook in crock-pot.

title: Peanut Butter Roll Candy
instructions: Boil sugar and water until it spins a thread. Do not stir. Add egg whites and vanilla to thick syrup. Beat by hand until stiff. Roll out on powdered sugar board and spread with peanut butter about 1/2-inch thick all over. Roll like jelly roll. Slice and eat.

title: Crunchy Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Combine the sour cream milk chives salt and pepper. Add potatoes; mix. Spread in a 15 x 10-inch baking pan. Combine cheese and corn flakes; sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Sprinkle with chives if desired.

title: Festive Freezer Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 9-inch metal pan. Prepare topping Mix brown sugar walnuts cinnamon and 2 tablespoons butter or margarine; set aside.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and melted butter until smooth. Place broccoli in casserole dish. Add chicken and pour sauce on top. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken 'N Biscuits
instructions: In greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish combine chicken broccoli and 1 cup cheese. Blend soup and 3/4 cup milk; pour over casserole. Bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Gems(Christmas Springerla)
instructions: Stir eggs and sugar; add sifted flour till stiff. Roll out about 1/8 or 1/4 inch thick. Cut with roller cutter. Let stand overnight. Sprinkle anise on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 until light yellow.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until dry. Combine with cottage cheese. Add eggs. Add flour. Add margarine. Stir well after each ingredient. Place in glass casserole. Spread cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time. Combine flour soda and salt. Add alternately with the buttermilk. Add flavoring. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Mike'S Brownies
instructions: Measure all ingredients into one bowl. Mix with mixer on low speed about 5 minutes. Batter will be thick. Spread in a well-greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the last 3. Shape into 1-inch balls. Melt shortening in skillet; brown. Remove from skillet and drain. Heat chili sauce and jelly in a skillet. Stir until jelly is melted. Add meat balls. Stir until thoroughly coated and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Hot Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let set overnight. Will keep for up to 10 days. Also the longer it sits the hotter it will be. Excellent with pinto beans and cornbread.

title: Italian Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar margarine and shortening. Add egg yolks one at a time beating after each one. Mix together soda and buttermilk; add alternately with flour to first mixture. Add nuts coconut and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Boil and let cool the sugar and vinegar. Pour over mixture and let set 24 hours. This will keep for several days when refrigerated.

title: Creamy Wafers
instructions: Blend shortening and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs beating until smooth. Sift flour with salt; add to mixture beating vigorously. Add flavoring. Drop from spoon onto lightly greased cookie sheet about 3 to 4 inches apart. Place nut in center of each cookie. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Lina'S Frosted Braunschweiger
instructions: Mix together thoroughly braunschweiger ketchup and mayonnaise. Form into loaf with damp hands as it will stick. Chill for 1 hour. Frost with softened cream cheese (Philadelphia). Cream cheese should be frosting consistency; thin with mayonnaise. Serve with any type cracker. Makes 20 (1 ounce) servings. Very good to serve for weddings. Enjoy!

title: Grandmother Skupin'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add molasses and eggs. Beat well. Sift all dry ingredients together (flour soda salt cinnamon and ginger). Add dry ingredients to mixture and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls about 1-inch apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Quickie Trifle
instructions: Cut each jelly roll in 3 pieces. Line sides and bottom of casserole with jelly roll. Pour half vanilla pudding over. Put rest of jelly rolls on top. Cover with remaining vanilla pudding. Top with Cool Whip. At Christmastime its god to substitute egg nog for milk.

title: Corn And Dumplings
instructions: Mix well in glass baking dish all the ingredients. Dot with 1/2 stick butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set or it barely shakes in middle.

title: Fruitful Muffins
instructions: Combine oats flour baking powder and cinnamon. Combine remaining ingredients and add to dry mixture. Stir until moistened. Fill paper-lined cups 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gazpacho(Cold Vegetable Soup)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor. Puree thoroughly. Cover. Chill overnight. Serve with croutons. Serves 6.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Cream jello and cream cheese and set aside. Bring pineapple and sugar to a boil then add cream cheese and jello. Mix until dissolved. Add cold water and put in refrigerator until thickened around edges. Add Cool Whip and celery and refrigerate until solid.

title: Peppermint Delight
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan that has been lined with crushed vanilla wafers. Sprinkle vanilla wafers on top. Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Mrs. C'S Wine Bread(Fruitcake)
instructions: Cream shortening and eggs; add grape juice. Beat 3 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Divide into 3 greased pans and bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Pour Mogan David grape wine over breads when removed from pans. Cool and wrap in wax paper and then in foil. Store them in a tightly sealed can. If they get dry coat with more wine.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into greased pan and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown!

title: Santa Fe Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into thin strips. Sprinkle with paprika salt and pepper. Heat olive oil or butter in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken to oil and cook for 2 minutes. Add chopped onion green pepper and garlic to skillet. Cook until tender about 4 minutes stirring frequently.

title: Ham And Red-Eye Gravy
instructions: Fry ham slowly being careful not to overcook. Remove from pan. Make gravy in the pan ham was fried in. Pour a small amount of coffee or cream right from the pot. Add a little water and bring to a boil.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Toss all ingredients lightly except crumbs. Place in buttered casserole; sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Freezes well.)

title: Cranberry Scones
instructions: Combine flours sugar baking powder salt and spices. Add butter cut in with pastry blender until coarsely mixed. Make a well. Add cream milk and lemon zest. Stir. Add cranberries; stir until dough coheres. Shape into ball. Place in center of greased baking sheet. Pat into a 9-inch disk. Score deeply into 8 wedges. Brush top with 1 tablespoon of cream and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut apart at score marks and serve hot.

title: Raisin Pudding
instructions: Stir together bread pieces white sugar egg 1 tablespoon flour and milk. Bake in oven until dry.

title: Orange Brunch Pancakes
instructions: Stir together biscuit mix oats sugars and peel. Beat together eggs milk juice and vanilla with rotary beater; add to flour mixture. Stir until blended; let stand 5 minutes. For each pancake pour about 1/4 cup batter onto hot lightly greased griddle. Cook over medium-low heat for about 3 minutes until golden brown turning once.

title: Vegetable Pie(Quiche)
instructions: Grease pie plate. Cook vegetables until tender. Drain thoroughly. Mix them together with cheese and pour in plate. Mix rest of the ingredients and pour over the vegetables. Serve hot or cold.

title: Apple Pie Cake
instructions: Cream margarine; add sugar and egg. Combine dry ingredients and add to margarine mixture. Stir in water vanilla and chopped apples. Spoon into greased pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash water and salt and cook until just barely tender. Drain and set aside. Saute onions and peppers in margarine until crisp-tender (about 3 minutes). Combine vegetables egg and next 5 ingredients. Spoon into greased casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Mincemeat For Pie Filling(Low Calorie!)
instructions: Chop tomatoes fine. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon salt over them and let stand 1/2 hour. Drain. Add chopped apples and raisins. Cook until done. (Tomatoes apples and raisins may be ground in a meat grinder or chopped in a blender.) Add vinegar cinnamon cloves and sugar before cooking.

title: Perfect Pound Cake
instructions: Add sugar to butter gradually and cream together. Add eggs one at a time then add cream. Add flour gradually then add vanilla. Pour into a well-greased and floured tube pan. Drop pan to remove any bubbles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until brown and springy. Freezes well.

title: Lyndon B. Johnson'S Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Drain potatoes very well and mash. Add sugar eggs milk 1/2 cup butter coconut vanilla and nutmeg. Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch casserole. Combine brown sugar flour remaining 1/2 cup butter and nuts. Sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add onion and saute. Add broccoli with 1/3 cup water. Cover and slowly bring to a simmer. Continue simmering until broccoli is thawed. Add soup and Cheez Whiz and simmer again. Add rice; stir and pour into buttered baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 approximately 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Carrots
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in greased casserole at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and add bread crumbs and slivered pecans. Return to oven for 15 minutes more to brown crumbs. Serve at once from the oven.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut up cabbage and boil until tender. Fry ground pork until brown; add seasonings Ro-Tel tomatoes and cabbage. Cook for about 45 minutes. Add salt and black pepper to taste. Add 1/2 cup bread crumbs to mixture. Cook about 2 to 3 minutes. Pour into baking dish and sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bread crumbs are brown.

title: Mary'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Spoon dough onto cookie sheet and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Five Minute Fudge
instructions: Place chocolate chips condensed milk and butter in a large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave at Medium (50%) until chocolate chips are melted about 5 minutes stirring twice during cooking. Remove from microwave. Stir in flavoring and nuts. Pour into a \Pam\ sprayed 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Refrigerate until set. (If you dont eat it all the first day refrigerate any leftovers.)

title: Vidalia Onion Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients; put in a shallow dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with crackers. Delicious! Serves 10 to 12.

title: Artichoke Salad
instructions: Cook artichoke hearts as directed on package. Rinse with cold water and cut each heart in half. Chill. Prepare remaining ingredients keeping each separate. Lightly toss together lettuce half of the cauliflower half the tomato and all the chives in a large salad bowl. Arrange remaining ingredients in vertical rows over top of salad.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Dice vegetables. Cover with chicken stock. Add seasonings. Simmer until vegetables are soft. Spoon vegetables into a blender and puree. Return to chicken broth; add 1 can Cheddar cheese soup undiluted. Stir until smooth. Adjust seasonings to taste; bring to boil. Sprinkle each serving with a little shredded Cheddar cheese and paprika. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Liverwurst Pinwheels
instructions: Combine liver spread chopped pickle mustard and margarine. Trim crust from bread. Cut into 9 long slices; spread with oleo and 2 tablespoons mixture. Place gherkin strip across narrow end of each slice and roll up like jelly roll. Wrap tightly in damp linen towel. Chill 2 hours. Slice each strip into 8 pieces.

title: Gazpacho(Cold Spanish Soup)
instructions: Combine onion soup and juice. Mix seasonings well and add to juice. Mix all liquids and add. Add vegetables or serve on the side. Chill soup at least 4 to 8 hours.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with water. Add 7-Up. Soften cream cheese. Beat in pineapple vanilla and sugar. Mix Jell-O with cheese mixture and nuts. Add desired amount of food coloring to give light green color. Pour in 8 oiled Jell-O molds or in an 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Summer Corn Salad
instructions: Remove kernels with paring knife and place in large bowl. Add tomato onion and green pepper. Toss to combine. Add lime juice and olive oil. Snip cilantro and add to mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Yum Yum Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Mix well. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Salisbury Skillet Supreme
instructions: In a large bowl mix together the beef rice onion egg salt and pepper. Shape into 6 patties. Brown patties on both sides in oil. Drain vegetables reserving liquid. Combine 1/2 cup of liquid and gravy. Stir in gravy and drained vegetables and thyme. Pour over browned patties. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Six Layer Dinner
instructions: In order given layer ingredients in greased 2-quart baking dish. Season each layer with salt and pepper. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage. Add other ingredients and mix.

title: Deb'S Dump Cake
instructions: Layer pineapple nuts cherry filling and coconut. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top. Drizzle melted margarine over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix and bake at 475\u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes until brown.

title: Fruited Pot Roast
instructions: In Dutch oven brown meat on both sides in hot oil. Remove from heat; add onion carrots wine garlic salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 1 3/4 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Meanwhile pour 1 1/2 cups hot water over prunes and apricots. Let stand while roast is cooking. Drain reserving liquid. Place fruit atop meat. Cover and cook 30 to 40 minutes more or until meat is tender. Remove meat and fruit to warm platter. Pour pan juices into measuring cup; skim off fat. Add reserved fruit liquid to pan juices to make 1 1/2 cups. Return to Dutch oven; blend together flour and 1/2 cup cold water. Stir into juices. Cook and stir until gravy is thickened and bubbly. Spoon some gravy over roast; pass remaining gravy around.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in roaster. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chops. Cover. Bake at 300\u00b0 or until meat is tender and gravy thick.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Combine meat green pepper onion chili powder and oregano; cook until meat is browned. Drain off excess fat. Remove from heat and add soup water enchilada sauce and garlic salt combining well. In a greased 9 x 12 x 3-inch casserole dish place a layer of tortillas then meat mixture and the cheese. Layer any remaining ingredients ending with the meat mixture on top. Refrigerate casserole for 24 hours or if desired freeze. To serve bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (longer if frozen). Serves 10.

title: 20 Minute Apple Butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and cook until candy is dissolved and mix is thick about 20 to 25 minutes. Pour into hot jars and seal.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish as listed. Use the mayonnaise to seal in the vegetables. Cover and chill 8 hours. Add the bacon bits after chilling.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Crush Ritz crackers and spread in bottom of casserole dish. Melt butter and drizzle over crackers mixing well. Mix chicken broth sour cream and cream of chicken soup together; boil stirring until smooth. Add cut up chicken to sour cream mixture and pour over Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until sides are bubbly.

title: Chicken Dijon In Pastry Shells
instructions: Prepare pastry shells as directed on package. In a skillet over medium-high heat melt margarine and cook half of chicken until browned; stir often. Remove and cook remaining chicken. Reduce heat to medium-low add 1 tablespoon margarine cook broccoli and mushrooms until tender and liquid has evaporated stir often. Stir in soup milk and mustard. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Heat through stirring occasionally. Spoon over pastry shells. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until done. Tear into small pieces and line the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix chicken soup with milk. Pour over chicken. Put stuffing on top of soup mixture. Melt 1/2 stick of margarine and mix with 2/3 cup chicken broth. Pour over stuffing. Bake for approximately 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lo-Fat Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil boneless skinless chicken breast in water. Cook until tender. Chop into bite size pieces and mix together with the other ingredients. Add salad dressing as you desire. Serves 12.

title: Alphabet Cupcakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift all but C F and K together in a mixing bowl. Add F and K; stir thoroughly with spoon. Add C and mix. Place heaping tablespoon in well-greased muffin pans. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Mix chicken soups and bread crumbs to consistency for sandwiches. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box. Cool. Crumble 1 cake layer in large serving bowl. Make pudding using the 3 cups milk. Pour 1/2 pudding mixture over cake.\tSpread 1/2 of pie filling over pudding. Next spread 1/2 of pineapple 1/2 of Cool Whip and 1 package of coconut. Repeat all layers.

title: Zucchini Stick Salad
instructions: Slice zucchini and peppers into thin strips. Heat oil in frying pan; stir in zucchini and peppers to coat evenly. Cover and cook about 10 minutes stirring occasionally until tender-crisp when pierced. Do not overcook. Remove from heat and stir in olives and green onions 1 teaspoon garlic salt and pepper. Turn into bowl.

title: Chocolate Philly Fudge
instructions: Gradually add sugar to cream cheese mixing well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread into greased 8-inch square pan. Chill overnight. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
instructions: Place margarine in baking dish; melt in oven. Heat peaches 1/2 cup sugar and water in saucepan until sugar is dissolved then bring to a boil. Combine flour baking powder salt remaining 1/2 cup sugar and milk in mixing bowl; stir until smooth. Remove baking dish from oven; add batter then peach mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Crust will rise to top and brown.

title: Souper Rice Supper
instructions: In a large saucepan mix contents of soup can with equal amount of water. Bring to a boil. Fill can with Minute rice and add to boiling soup. Stir in 1 1/2 cups cooked vegetables (broccoli peas or green beans) 4 slices American cheese and 1 1/2 cup cooked meat or fish. Stir cover and remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes for rice to cook.

title: Oriole Nectar
instructions: Microwave 2 to 3 minutes to melt sugar. Fill with water to 1 quart. Add 4 to 5 drops red food coloring. Cool store in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar and milk for 3 minutes; remove from heat. Add peanut butter vanilla and cracker crumbs. Beat until smooth.

title: Chinese Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Beat the egg with a fork. Bring the broth to a simmering point. Remove from heat and slowly drizzle in the beaten egg stirring slowly. The egg should become stringy-looking rather than making the soup appear milky. Garnish with parsley. Serve hot.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except peaches. Mix at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into well-greased deep dish pie plate. Pour drained peaches over mixture.

title: Condensed Milk Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Beat together oil and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating until well mixed. Add vanilla. Add flour and milk alternately mixing well after each addition. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan.

title: White Sauce
instructions: Blend in blender until smooth. Mix thoroughly all ingredients and serve. May be used to make mock turkey stuffing etc.

title: Apple Strudel
instructions: Thaw puff pastry for 20 minutes. Combine apples raisins cinnamon sugar nuts and crumbs. Unfold and roll out each pastry square to 13 x 10-inch rectangle. Place half the apple mixture along center line of pastry (lengthwise). Brush edges with beaten egg yolks. Fold dough over filling pressing edges together to seal. Place seam-side down on greased rimmed baking sheet. Repeat with remaining pastry. Brush tops with egg yolks.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Mix corn meal with cold water in bowl. Add to boiling water in saucepan. Cook for 15 minutes stirring frequently. Add salt and margarine; mix well. Remove from heat. Cool. Press into baking dish.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Brown beef or sausage. Stir in seasoning blend. Cook for 5 minutes. Add broth soup and potatoes. Simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Asopado Puertorrigueno(Soup)
instructions: Put everything together in a pot except the rice. After it has boiled abut 45 minutes add rice. Boil until it gets thick. Add some water if needed. Also taste for salt. Serves 2 or 3 people.

title: Blond Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and melt in oven. Put brown sugar in large mixing bowl and pour the melted butter over it. Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs. Mix in flour baking powder vanilla pecans and chocolate chips. Pour batter into already buttered pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownies just begin to pull away from sides of pan. When cool cut in squares.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter until slightly brown and clear. Add rice and 1 package of broccoli prepared according to package directions. Add cream of chicken soup and a small jar of Cheez Whiz. Mix well. Sprinkle bread crumbles on top. Cook at low heat for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Mix together cream of mushroom soup cream of chicken soup and milk until hot then add seasonings and butter. Mix together with macaroni and chicken. Place in greased casserole. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Turtle Cookies
instructions: Mix brown sugar margarine water and vanilla. Stir in flour and salt until dough holds together (if dough is dry stir in 1 to 2 teaspoons of water). Cut caramels into fourths. Shape dough by teaspoonfuls around caramel pieces. Press dough into center of each pecan half. Bake until done 12 to 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Chocolate, Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Chop 2 squares of the chocolate into cake mix. Bake cake in 4 layers.

title: Pig In Blanket
instructions: Cut biscuits in half. Wrap around sausage; bake at 450\u00b0 about 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine Cool Whip milk lemon juice and strawberries. Mix thoroughly. Put in pie shells and freeze. Remove from freezer 1 hour before serving. Garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Quick Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine soup and milk in casserole dish. Add tuna 1 cup potato chips and peas; blend. Sprinkle remaining chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Vanilla Custard
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan whisk milk and cornstarch until blended. Whisk in eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Cook over medium low heat whisking constantly until mixture thickens and you can see the bottom when whisking. Cool. Makes enough to fill a 9 inch pan.

title: Oven Dried Jerky
instructions: Trim semi-frozen meat and slice 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick strips. In bowl combine all ingredients except meat. Stir until dissolved. Add meat; coat thoroughly. Let stand 1 hour or refrigerate overnight. Meat will absorb liquid. Remove excess liquid. Arrange strips close together on oven or cake racks in shallow pans. Dry meat on lowest temperature (150\u00b0 to 200\u00b0) until it turns brown and feels hard (4 to 7 hours). Pat off beads of oil. Cool and store in airtight bags or jars. Keeps indefinitely. Makes 1/2 pound. Can also be dried on top of wood stove on racks and pans. Turn strips often though. Very economical.

title: Apple-Peachie Sauce
instructions: Prepare apples core and chop up. Cut up peaches. Add dates. Blend slow in blender until smooth. Very good!

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper and pound into steak. In large skillet brown steak in hot oil on both sides. Add chopped vegetables tomatoes or soup mixture. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Serve over mashed potatoes or rice or egg noodles.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Saute the onion in the oil in a medium size saucepan until tender. Add the tomato paste tomato sauce water oregano basil salt and pepper. Simmer covered for 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Coat the inside of a 1 1/2-quart casserole with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the Ricotta and half of the Mozzarella in a large bowl. Add the cooked ziti and half of the tomato sauce. Stir gently to mix. Turn into the prepared casserole. Add the remaining tomato sauce. Sprinkle with the remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and browned.

title: Eggplant Stuffed Artichokes
instructions: Wash eggplant and saute in oil with onions tomato and garlic. Steam artichokes until done. Stuff with eggplant mixture and serve hot.

title: E-Z Micro Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar and flour in large microwave bowl; gradually add milk (evaporated milk can be used). Stir in eggs real well. Microwave 3 minutes. Stir. Cook in microwave 2 additional minutes. Stir. Cook until creamy or until desired thickness. Crumble vanilla wafers into pudding and add sliced bananas. Top with whole vanilla wafers. (One bowl only to wash.) Enough for two and company too.

title: San Francisco French Toast
instructions: Combine eggs vanilla extract sugar and orange juice Mix well. Heat oil in skillet. Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Fry in oil until lightly browned on each side. Serve with syrup powdered sugar and apple butter.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Beat Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip together then add crushed pineapple nuts and pie filling. Pour into serving dish refrigerate to season.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Let bread thaw and rise as per the package instructions. Roll as flat as possible. Top with butter cheese and pepperoni. Roll up like a jelly roll. Spread egg over top and seal. Bake on foiled cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken And Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Cook chicken in oil in a Dutch oven until chicken is golden brown; remove chicken. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in Dutch oven. Saute onion and next 3 ingredients in drippings. Add water rice salt peppers chicken and sausage; bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and let simmer until chicken is done and rice is tender and water is absorbed. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hamburger Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Lightly brown hamburger and onion; stir in noodles. Pour into casserole. Mix 1 cup bread crumbs with 3 tablespoons butter. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Pound Cake(Diabetic)
instructions: Coat bottom of 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with vegetable cooking spray. Dust pan with 1 teaspoon flour. Set aside.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in a shallow Pyrex dish in order. Put in microwave for 5 minutes (longer for some microwaves). Serve with chips.

title: Fork-Tender Swiss Steak
instructions: Season the steak and place it on a well floured cutting board. Cover the\tsteak with flour and pound it with a meat hammer. Continue to turn flour and pound the meat until all the flour is taken up by the steak.

title: Oreo Cheesecake
instructions: In food processor or blender whirl 1/2 package of cookies including fillings until fine crumbs form. (Or place cookies in paper or plastic bag and crush by rolling with rolling pin.) Mix in butter.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Peel core and chop apples into bite size pieces (sprinkle with lemon juice so they wont turn brown). Add celery raisins cherries and 3/4 cup pecans. Mix well. Add 1 tablespoon sugar to mayonnaise and beat until smooth. Pour over mixture and toss. (You might have to use more or less mayonnaise.) Place mixture in serving dish and sprinkle the top with celery seed and the remainder of the pecans.

title: Party Spritzer
instructions: Pour juice and mineral water over ice in a glass. Garnish with fruit as desired. Makes 1 serving.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except cheese. Make 1/2 loaf. Lay cheese on top of meat. Top with remainder of meat and cheese. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in airtight container. Add 2 teaspoons of spiced tea mix to 1 cup hot water for a delicious hot drink.

title: Glazed Ham Steaks
instructions: Combine honey mustard and lemon juice in mixing bowl; beat thoroughly. Grill ham steaks slowly over charcoal or cook under broiler. Brush frequently with honey sauce until brown and glazed on both sides.

title: Mexican Stuffed Shells
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Combine picante sauce water and tomato sauce. Stir 1/2 cup ground beef along with chilies 1/2 cheese 1/2 cup French fried onions and mix well. Pour 1/2 of remaining sauce mixture in bottom of a 10-inch round or 8 x 12-inch baking dish.

title: French-Style Green Beans
instructions: Rinse beans well trim stem ends and cut beans lengthwise (French-style). Melt butter or margarine in medium-size skillet over medium heat; stir in chicken broth. Add beans; bring liquid to boil. Reduce heat and cook (covered) about 18 minutes. Add bell pepper parsley salt and pepper. Cook uncovered an additional 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Sweet Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Lightly grease 9-inch round cake pan. Prepare basic biscuits rolling dough into a rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Brush with butter. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over dough. Roll up jelly roll fashion beginning with long side. Slice into 1/2-inch slices. Bake 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 16 to 18 rolls.

title: Pan-Fried Squash
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Add sliced squash and water. Cook covered on low until done. Scorching slightly adds to taste! Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Linda'S Cheese Straws
instructions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Add water and mix as for pie crust. Place dough into cookie press and form dough in long lines on cookie sheet. Cut into desired lengths with sharp knife; separate slightly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes (until lightly browned). Cool and serve.

title: Chicken Mandalay
instructions: Shake first 3 ingredients in bag with chicken until coated. Saute in oil until golden brown. Mix remaining ingredients in bowl and add to chicken. Simmer until chicken is cooked. Serve with rice.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Cube 3 to 4 bananas\tsprinkle with lemon juice. Add Eagle Brand milk Cool Whip cherry pie filling and nuts. Mix and freeze.

title: Cherry Batter Pie
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread hot cherries on bottom. Pour batter over cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with nonstick coating. Spread chilies in bottom of dish. Cover chilies with cheese. Mix remaining ingredients in blender until well blended. Pour mixture over chilies and cheese. Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 6 to 8. Also good cold cut into 1-inch squares for hors doeuvres.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad Or Dessert
instructions: Cream the cream cheese with sugar and mayonnaise. Add pineapple (drained) and cranberry sauce. Use mixer to mix well. Add Cool Whip. Put into cupcake liners and freeze. Or can be frozen in any dish desired. Thaw slightly before serving. A good way to store in freezer is to let mixture freeze and put into Ziploc bags.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies I
instructions: Beat Crisco and sugars in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and vanilla mixing well. Add flour salt and soda. Mix well. Fold in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mega-Fudge Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter and flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Place sugar butter and water in a heavy saucepan and bring just to a boil; remove from heat. Add chocolate chips and stir until smooth; blend in vanilla. Transfer to a large mixing bowl and beat in the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake 350 degrees till done. When cool top with frosting

title: Shrimp With Feta Cheese
instructions: Simmer tomatoes in a large skillet for 10 to 15 minutes or until tomato liquid is reduced by about half. Add shrimp; simmer just until they begin to turn pink; sprinkle with cheese. Cover skillet; simmer about 5 minutes longer or until shrimp are cooked and cheese is hot. Spoon rice onto a large serving platter; top with shrimp mixture. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Grilled Lemon Chicken
instructions: In a small saucepan combine butter lemon juice water soy sauce paprika honey mustard garlic salt and cayenne pepper. Heat until butter melts stirring well. Grill chicken over medium coals about 15 minutes per side or until chicken is done brushing frequently with sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Blueberry Pudding Cake
instructions: Put blueberries in bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan. Mix flour baking powder salt melted shortening 1/2 cup sugar and milk. Spread over berries. Mix 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch and water. Pour over mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm or cold with whipped topping.

title: Yam Patties
instructions: Place patties in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat the water white sugar and brown sugar. Heat until sugar is melted good; pour over patties. Dot with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 until syrup is thick and they are bubbly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in greased and floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Sherry And Cream Gravy
instructions: Tie 2 pieces of tenderloin together in 3 or 4 places. Season with Worcestershire sauce poultry seasoning and garlic powder. Place in baking pan (use meat thermometer). Cook at 350\u00b0 until thermometer reads 180\u00b0. (Well done pork reading on thermometer.) Remove from pan when done. Let rest 10 minutes. Slice and put on serving platter.

title: Raisin And Nut Bran Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease a 2 inch muffin tin. Combine bran and milk in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes. Then mash with the back of spoon. Sift together the flour and sugar and add to bran. Add the beaten egg and the melted butter and stir until well blended Do not beat. Stir in the nuts and raisins. Divide batter amount the muffin cups. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Sweet Cherry Mold(A Christmas Special)
instructions: Put jello in bowl; add hot water and stir until jello is dissolved. Add cold water. Drain cherries and pineapple and add juice of both to jello.

title: Self-Rising Flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in tightly covered can or jar and use soon. Use in any recipe calling for self-rising flour. Yields approximately 1 pound.

title: Hot Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple (save juice). Combine flour sugar and juice; mix. Add cheese and pineapple. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Combine margarine and cracker crumbs and sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Piquant
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Meanwhile cook bacon and garlic until bacon is crisp. Add vinegar; heat. Brown bread crumbs in butter. Pour sauce over hot broccoli and sprinkle with crumbs. Makes 3 servings.

title: Macaroni 'N Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water; drain and rinse. Combine the mushroom soup milk onion and seasoning. Alternate layers of macaroni soup and cheese in greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad With Creamy Orange Dressing
instructions: Sprinkle apple chunks with the lemon juice to keep them from discoloring. Place all the fruit in a large bowl. Spinach bowl works well.

title: Monday Night Roast Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Refried Bean Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with Fritos corn chips or tortilla chips.

title: Deviled Hamburgers
instructions: Mix all together and\tspread\twith fork on\thalf of hamburger bun. Broil about 4-inches from flame about 12 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Wrap chicken breast individually in foil and bake for 1 hour in a 400\u00b0 oven. When removed from oven save broth which has cooked out of chicken. Bone and cut up chicken meat; set aside. In a mixing bowl combine soups milk onion salsa and half of the chicken stock; blend well. Pour rest of chicken stock into a well-greased large shallow baking dish. Begin with a layer of the tortilla pieces. Sprinkle some of the chopped chicken meat. Pour some of the soup mix on top of chicken and then sprinkle with half of the grated cheese. Repeat layering process ending with soup mix. Top with cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrot-Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Note Very good to serve with baked ham. All measurements are approximate.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and lard together. Set aside. Mix salt vinegar egg and cold water together. Add to flour mixture. Roll out the way you like it thick or thin and put in pie pan.

title: Quickie Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except potato chips. Put in a casserole dish. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9-inch pie plate. Mix all ingredients until smooth 1 minute in blender or 2 minutes with a mixer. Pour into pie plate. Bake for 30 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Fruit Delight
instructions: Cut pears into bite size pieces. Mix dry pudding mix into juice. Pour juice mix over pears into large bowl with cover. Stir and place in the fridge.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Crush cookies until fine. Mix together margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix pudding with milk and vanilla in a separate bowl. To the cream cheese mixture add 12 ounce bowl of Cool Whip then mix pudding into cream cheese and Cool Whip mixture. Layer cookies then pudding cream cheese mixture ending with crushed cookies. Arrange in a 9 x 13-inch pan or you can also use individual flowerpots.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve with chips and crackers.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in pineapple. Fold in bread cubes. Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Great with ham or chicken.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad 1
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Carrot-Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Stir together flour baking powder soda salt and spices. Set aside. Combine grated orange peel and carrots. In large bowl cream butter. Gradually beat in brown sugar until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Alternately stir in flour mixture and carrot mixture until well blended. Stir in walnuts. Turn into greased loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until pick inserted comes out clean. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Turn out to cool completely.

title: Salmon Mousse
instructions: Bone and flake salmon draining off liquid and adding water to make 1/2 cup. Soften gelatin in liquid and warm until thoroughly dissolved. Add to mayonnaise chili sauce lemon juice Worcestershire sauce dill and pepper. Mix well. Add lox cooked eggs onions and olives; pour into a 6-cup mold. Chill until firm. Garnish with olives parsley and pimentos. May halve recipe.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Layer in dish hamburger cheese pepperoni cheese and so forth ending with biscuit mix on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients except margarine and crackers. Place the vegetable mixture in a 9 X 13 casserole dish. Melt margarine and mix with crushed crackers. Spread evenly over the vegetable mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Chili(D'Alessandro'S)
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add beef and brown lightly; drain off fat. Add the rest of ingredients except kidney beans tomato juice and chili powder. Simmer 30 minutes. Cool slightly. Add remaining 3 ingredients and simmer 1 hour. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mildred'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first seven ingredients well. Shape into a loaf. Mix the remaining ingredients and pour over meat loaf. Bake covered for 1 1/2 hours and uncovered for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pasta E Fagioli
instructions: Brown meat in skillet with salt sense and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Simmer covered with 1 cup water until tender. Salt and pepper from amounts given. In a large pot heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onions garlic celery and carrots. Cook stirring frequently until onions are transparent. Add ground meat and remaining ingredients except macaroni. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Add macaroni; simmer 2 minutes. If mixture is too thick add more chicken stock or water. Serve with bread sticks. Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Fern'S Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast and 1 heaping teaspoon to dissolve in 1/2 cup warm water; set aside. Mix together hot water salt sugar and shortening then add eggs; stir. Add 4 cups flour; stir together then add yeast mixture. Mix. Add 4 cups flour and stir thoroughly. Let rise and then shape into rolls. Drop into greased and floured pans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 2 dozen rolls.

title: Chilled Cucumber Soup
instructions: Blend on high speed in blender chopped cucumber and chicken broth 2 minutes. Add sour cream. Continue to blend 2 more minutes at high speed. Chill before serving.

title: Deep Dish Chocolate-Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix eggs milk and vanilla and add to dry mixture. Stir in pecans. Pour into prepared pie crust; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix; put into large casserole. Top with crushed potato chips. Microwave 9 minutes on High uncovered.

title: Healthy Lasagne
instructions: In saucepan cook turkey. Add garlic powder oregano and basil. When cooked add Italian sauce. In bowl mix the cottage cheese egg whites pepper and parsley flakes. Layer 3 noodles (uncooked) in bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish then the meat sauce cottage cheese mixture and evenly sprinkle Mozzarella. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 35 to 40 minutes. Add some water (1/4 to 1/2 cup) during baking if too dry. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Serve.

title: White Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute the minced garlic in the olive oil on low heat for 1 to 2 minutes. Do not let garlic brown. Add clam juice (which you get from draining the chopped clams) and the white wine. Bring to a boil; add parsley and chopped clams. Cook for 2 minutes then add to well-drained linguini which you cook according to package.

title: Hawaiian Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Divide into two or more greased baking dishes. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and continue baking 20 to 30 minutes more. Yields 80 to 100 servings.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Rinse chilies; slit open and remove all seeds. In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish alternate chilies with cheeses to make 2 or 3 layers. In separate bowl beat egg whites until stiff. In another bowl beat yolks until foamy. Beat in evaporated milk flour sugar and salt. Fold egg whites into yolk mixture. Pour over chilies and cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Arrange tomato chunks on top. Return to oven and bake 25 minutes longer. Serve warm.

title: Donna'S Goulash
instructions: Brown meat and onions together with garlic. When all browned add beans and catsup. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Nut Loaf
instructions: In a mixing bowl stir together flour cinnamon baking soda salt nutmeg and baking powder; set aside.

title: Low Fat Chocolate Cake
instructions: Spray a 9-inch cake pan with cooking spray and set aside. Stir first 5 ingredients together. Stir in remaining ingredients until thoroughly blended. Pour into pan and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oyster Dressing
instructions: Break stuffing bread into small pieces and let stand. Simmer vegetables in margarine until tender. Add oysters and simmer 5 more minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks and sugar together. Add oleo flour buttermilk and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Old-Fashioned Cocoa Cake
instructions: Cream butter or margarine sugar and eggs until fluffy. Beat on high speed of mixer 3 minutes. Reduce speed to low. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk to creamed mixture. Blend in crushed candy. Pour into 2 greased and cocoa dusted 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Frost with frosting of your choice.

title: Paneton
instructions: Place the yeast in 3/4 cup warm milk; let rest 3 to 4 hours. Beat the egg whites with the sugar until it forms peaks. Add the pisco and the orange extract; set aside. Add the yeast into a big bowl. Add the rest of the warm milk the melted butter the egg yolks the grated rind and the anise. Slowly add 3/4 of the flour and the egg white mixture. Beat until smooth. Set aside in a warm space until the next day.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt then add shortening 1/3 cup buttermilk and bananas. Beat vigorously for 2 minutes. Add 1/3 cup buttermilk and nuts; beat 2 more minutes and then fold in nuts. Pour batter into prepared pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar. Add onion celery pickles seasoning and mayonnaise. Toss to blend. Fold in egg slices. Chill; add egg slices on top.

title: Vegetable And Ham Casserole
instructions: Layer half of potatoes onion carrots and ham in a 2-quart baking dish. Combine soup milk and pepper to make sauce. Pour half of sauce over vegetables and ham. Add remaining ingredients (vegetables and ham). Top with remaining sauce. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Remove cover and sprinkle with cheese. Bake another 10 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Simple Salsa
instructions: Chop all ingredients. Mix together well and refrigerate for one hour before serving. Serve with white corn tortilla chips. Hot and delicious!

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
instructions: Cook Stove Top stuffing as directed on the box. Take hamburg; roll out on a flat surface about 1-inch thick. Take cooked ham; put slices to cover all hamburg. Take stuffing; put into a line towards the center. Even it all out. Roll into a meat loaf; cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 2 hours. Enjoy! Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine butter sugar eggs and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at high speed for 3 minutes. Blend dry ingredients in separate bowl. Add with water to the creamed mixture. Pour into two greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake tester is clean and dry. Cool for 10 minutes then frost with a buttercream frosting. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Brown ham slices in hot oil. In a deep casserole dish or pan place half the potatoes carrots onions seasonings cheese and margarine. Place ham slices on top of vegetables. Pour 1/2 the soup and milk mixture over this. Add the rest of the vegetables margarine and spices. Sprinkle on cheese and add ham slices on top. Pour remaining soup mixture over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender.

title: Dream Balls
instructions: Cook sugar egg yolks butter dates nuts and marshmallow cream 10 to 15 minutes on low heat until mixed. Add crisped rice cereal and vanilla. Form into balls. Roll in coconut.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Scald milk and cool. Beat eggs until frothy. Add sugar spices and milk. Mix. Add cooked rice. If to be served with fruit cook it plain otherwise may add raisins dates or a small can of drained fruit.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs then sift dry ingredients and add other liquids. Bake in cold oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 2 layers.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Invite all friends and family that you know. Fish slow for 50. Mix up hush puppies from Martha White Hush Puppy mix. Get Mutt and Chris to fry 3 or 4 gallons of crappie fillet. Have everyone bring a dish of anything.

title: Ai'S Huli Huli Chicken
instructions: Salt chicken several hours prior to cooking. Add all ingredients (except oil) and let stand 15 minutes. Add oil. Mix well and baste chicken as it cooks over coals.

title: Hungarian Mushroom Soup
instructions: Saute onions in 2 Tbsp butter. Salt lightly. A few minutes later add mushrooms 1 tsp dill 1/2 c stock or water tamari and paprika. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Melt remaining butter in a large saucepan. Whisk in flour and cook whisking a few minutes. Add milk. Cook stirring frequently over low heat about 10 minutes - until thick. Stir in mushroom mixture and remaining stock. Cover and simmer about 10 - 15 minutes. Just before serving add salt to taste freshly ground black pepper 2 teaspoons lemon juice 1/2 c sour cream and if desired extra dill. Serve garnished with 1/4 c fresh parsley. Takes approximately 1 hour to prepare and makes 4 rich servings.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and shred. Mix chicken sour cream and cream of chicken soup. Mix together and add poppy seeds. Mix. Crush crackers and pour over chicken mixture in a casserole dish. Melt butter and pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add tomato sauce water tomatoes kidney beans green chilies corn beans and taco seasoning.

title: Mrs. Fields Cookies
instructions: *Put a small amount of oatmeal into blender until it turns to powder. Measure first.

title: Easy Candy
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in microwave-safe bowl. Microwave 45 to 60 seconds or until melted (shiny). Stir until well blended. Stir in nuts. (You can use any nuts.) Drop by teaspoons onto a wax paper-lined cookie sheet. Place cookie sheet in refrigerator for about an hour. Remove candy and place in Tupperware or tin with wax paper between layers. Keep in refrigerator. Delicious!

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Layer crushed chips in 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread diced chicken over chips. Sprinkle onion and pepper. Mix soup undiluted and spread. Pour Ro-Tel over top. Bake 25 minutes. Last 10 minutes cover with Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese.

title: Rotel Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and save at least 1 1/2-quarts broth. If not enough broth use 1 can of chicken broth with water to make 1 1/2-quarts. Saute onion bell pepper and celery in butter.

title: Bims Candy
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and peanut butter. Add cereal and shape mixture into balls. Roll in confectioners sugar or coconut.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place peeled sliced apples in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour water over the apples. Mix sugars flour and margarine as for pie crust. Spread on\ttop of apples. Bake until apples are done. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together and press in bottom of a greased pan. Next mix cream cheese and sugar. Cream together. Stir in Cool Whip (sometimes you use more).

title: Italian Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 10-inch pie pan or 9-inch square pan. Cook spaghetti to desired tenderness; drain and set aside. Brown the beef with celery; drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce and mushrooms; simmer 15 minutes. Combine spaghetti eggs Parmesan cheese and garlic salt; toss. Place mixture in the prepared pan. Press evenly over bottom and up sides forming a crust. Pour meat mixture over spaghetti. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan cheese.

title: Stuffed Burger Bundles
instructions: Prepare stuffing according to package. Combine milk and meat. Make patties and pat to 6-inch circle. Top with stuffing. Draw meat up and over to cover stuffing. Place in casserole and pour remaining ingredients (combined) over all. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: New Potatoes With Black Peppercorn Butter
instructions: Combine broth and peppercorns in a small sauce pan. Cover and simmer until reduced to 1/4 cup. Add Brandy and simmer until reduced to about 3 Tbsp. Cool. Blend peppercorns butter lemon juice shallots and Thyme in processor until peppercorns are finely chopped. Cook potatoes until tender and quarter. Place in a large bowl. Add green onions and 1/4 c. peppercorn butter. Reserve remaining butter for another use. Toss gently. Season with salt.

title: Cherry Cobbler Ice Cream
instructions: Prepare Cobbler Topping. In large mixer bowl beat together eggs and sugar. Add cream pudding mix vanilla and salt; beat well. Mix in pie filling. Pour into 4 to 5-quart ice cream freezer. Add milk. Freeze according to manufacturers directions. Remove dasher. Add Cobbler Topping and stir until well mixed. Ripen ice cream. Makes 4 quarts.

title: Hens In A Basket
instructions: Make stuffing on stove according to directions. Set aside.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Combine pumpkin sugar oil and egg. In another bowl stir together flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. To dry ingredients add pumpkin mixture along with 1 teaspoon soda dissolved in 1 teaspoon milk. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and vanilla. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemonade; fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Top with additional Cool Whip. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Crab Swiss Bites(Appetizers)
instructions: Separate crescent rolls into three layers. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Mix crab mixture together and spoon onto layer of crescent rolls. Bake 10 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Makes 36 appetizers.

title: Easy Baking Powder Substitute
instructions: Sift ingredients and store in airtight container. Use the same as purchased baking powder.

title: Chicken Turnovers
instructions: Cook onion and celery in butter until tender. Stir in flour gravy or cream salt and chicken. Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness. Cut dough into 4-inch squares. Spoon chicken mixture onto 1/2 of each square and fold over to make triangles. Press edges of dough together to seal. Stick top with fork to let steam escape. Bake in greased pan at 425\u00b0 about 30 minutes until browned.

title: Fudge Sauce Supreme
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate; blend in cocoa and sugar. Stir in cream. Bring to a rolling boil for 10 seconds. Makes 12 ounces.

title: Poppy Seed Muffins
instructions: Combine flours sugar poppy seed and baking soda; stir. Add yogurt egg white vanilla and nuts. Pour in muffin cups sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 16 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Hot Dish
instructions: Fry sausage with onion. Put into casserole dish. Drain sauerkraut and put on top of sausage. Make mashed potatoes and while whipping potatoes add grated Cheddar cheese. Put on top of sauerkraut; sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake for about 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Enjoy.

title: Hamburger Gravy
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Mix soup mix in water and pour over meat. Mix well and let simmer for about 30 minutes. Serve over noodles rice or creamed potatoes.

title: Coconut Cream Pie #2
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients first. Add liquid ingredients. Cook on top of stove until mixture becomes firm. Pour into pie shells already browned. Save egg whites for icing to go on top of pies. This recipe makes 2 pies.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Whip soup and milk in a 2-quart bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients except 1/4 cup cheese. Cover with lid or vented plastic wrap and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight. Microwave on High for 15 to 17 minutes. Sprinkle reserved cheese on top. Let stand 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves 4.

title: Microwave Party Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes and water in 3-quart casserole. Cook covered on power 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir halfway through cooking. Drain. Beat together cream cheese onion dip salt pepper and garlic salt in large mixing bowl until well blended. Add hot potatoes one at a time beating until light and fluffy. Spoon potatoes in 2-quart casserole. Dot with margarine as desired. Heat covered on full power 4 to 6 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with paprika as desired before serving.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with onions; pour off drippings. Add tomato sauce; rinse can with water (1/2 cup more or less). Use this water. Add chili powder butter vinegar and sugar. Simmer 15 minutes then add beans and simmer 10 to 15 minutes more. Salt to your taste.

title: Crunchy Chicken Cheese Bake
instructions: Place chicken in an oblong dish. Top with cheese. Stir soup according to directions. Spread over cheese. Combine butter and stuffing. Sprinkle on top of soup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until chicken is done. Serve over rice. Garnish with oregano.

title: Nana B'S Ham Sauce
instructions: Beat egg in a saucepan. Add vinegar salt pepper and mustard. Cook slowly over low heat stirring constantly (dont curdle). Add currant jelly and catsup. Heat. Serve on ham. (This is a tangy delicious sauce.)

title: Seven-Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 12 x 2-inch brownie pan. Spread crumbs over it. Sprinkle coconut over that. Sprinkle chocolate morsels over that. Sprinkle peanut butter morsels over that. Pour canned sweetened condensed milk over that. Top with nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares while still warm.

title: Cherry Delight Salad
instructions: Thaw Cool Whip. Put in large bowl add all other ingredients and mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish and freeze. Remove from freezer and partially thaw before serving. Can be used as a salad with meal or as a light dessert.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Use large mushrooms. Wipe clean with paper towel. Never wash or peel. Break stems off and cut them up. Saute chopped onion and celery until tender in butter. Add chopped mushroom stems when onion and celery mix is partially done. Saute until golden. Use plenty of butter. Add Italian seasoned bread crumbs and mix. Stuff raw mushroom caps and cook or freeze. Dont cook before freezing.

title: Barbecue
instructions: In Dutch oven saute onions and garlic until golden. Add brown sugar and cook until caramelized. Add other ingredients and simmer 15 minutes. Add meat. Bake covered for 5 or 6 hours at 325\u00b0. Uncover last half hour. Remove from oven and shred meat with 2 forks and return to sauce. Can be frozen.

title: Sourdough Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread. Slice off top 1/4 of bread and hollow out carefully. Make sure there are no weak points. Fill shell with mixture. Put bread top back on. Wrap in foil and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Bread from the top and inside are used as dippers. (You will need additional bread.)

title: Burnt Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Mr. Z'S Hot Shrimp
instructions: Shell and if necessary devein shrimp. Slice garlic and ginger into thin\tslices; add to butter in frying pan. Cook on medium heat. Add peppers and lastly the shrimp. Cook only until shrimp turns red; do not overcook.
