title: Grandma Hebel'S Stacked Salad
instructions: Break large head of lettuce into bite size pieces. Put in a large bowl. Add celery onion green pepper and peas. Salt lightly. Spread with one pint Thousand Island dressing. Be sure to cover all ingredients well. Sprinkle with sugar. Add cheese. Add bacon. Cover with aluminum foil and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.

title: Cornbread Squares
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine flour cornmeal sugar baking powder and salt. Add eggs milk and oil. Blend just until moistened. Spoon into a greased baking pan (8 or 9-inch square). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: White Trash
instructions: In a large pot on very low heat melt margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour in cereal and with a large spoon blend until cereal is coated. In a plastic bag dump powdered sugar then add coated cereal and shake until coated. Enjoy.

title: Cherry Pie
instructions: Melt the margarine in the baking dish. Mix flour sugar milk and eggs. Pour mixed mixture in the baking dish. Do not stir. Pour can of cherries in the middle of mixture. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool before serving.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry cake mix nuts and melted butter. Mixture should be crumbly. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Serve with ice cream whipped cream or serve warm with coffee cream.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Coat meat with the flour salt and pepper. Melt shortening in a Dutch oven or large pot. Brown meat thoroughly in the hot shortening. Add envelope of soup mix and the water. Heat to boiling then reduce heat cover and simmer 2 hours. Stir in carrots green pepper onion celery bouillon cubes (2) and bay leaf. Simmer 15 more minutes. Add potatoes and simmer another 20 to 30 minutes. Add frozen vegetables. Stir well and simmer about 5 more minutes or turn off heat and let set about 10 minutes until vegetables are tender. If you prefer thicker stew combine 1 cup cold water with 3 tablespoons flour; stir in stew and heat to boiling. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove bay leaf.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo; pour over the bread. Beat eggs; add sugar and pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Good with ham.

title: Shoepeg Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain beans and corn. Mix all ingredients together except crackers and margarine. Pour into greased casserole. Crush crackers and toss with melted margarine. Top casserole with crackers and margarine mix. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Dip Or Baked Potato Topping
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate for at least one hour. Great dip for raw vegetable plate or topping for baked potatoes.

title: Garlic Toast For Pasta Dishes
instructions: Spread English muffins with butter or margarine. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Top generously with Parmesan cheese and sprinkle on some dried oregano. Place under broiler flame until browned. These can also be cut into fours before being put under broiler and served as party tidbits.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all together and fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into graham cracker crusts. Chill until firm. Makes 2 pies.

title: Turtle Cake #1
instructions: Mix cake mix as on package; pour 1/2 of batter in 13 x 9-inch greased and floured pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Saucy Sirloin Surprise
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cut into 1-inch cubes. In skillet brown meat in shortening. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients except beans. Cover; cook over low heat 1 hour. Stir now and then. Remove bay leaf. Chill overnight.

title: Fudge Squares
instructions: Melt together chocolate and butter. Add eggs and sugar; beat well. Add milk flour nuts and salt. Pour into well-greased and floured pan and bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Turn out on waxed paper and do not disturb until cold. Cut and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Prick and bake pastry 5 minutes. Use quiche pan or standard pie plate. Cook bacon crisp. Remove from skillet. Pour off all but 1 teaspoon of fat. Cook onion in fat. Crumble bacon over crust with onion and cheese.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups milk mushrooms and pimento. Fold in cooked chicken; let stand about 12 hours. Add noodles; place in buttered casserole and sprinkle with almonds. No salt is needed. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 12 servings.

title: Our Best Brownies(A Delightful, Chewy Treat)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan. In a medium bowl combine eggs vanilla and Brownie Mix. Beat until smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until edges separate from pan. Cool. Cut into 2-inch bars. Sprinkle or frost with Brownie Topper of your choice. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and flour; blend in margarine (melted). Add egg yolks milk and water and cook until nice and thick. Pour into pie shell.

title: Zucchini Cheesy Onion Corn Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Mix in the corn meal and sugar. Add mixing only until dry ingredients are moistened the oil eggs milk zucchini cheese and onion.

title: Small Fruit Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. In small baking paper cups drop heaping teaspoonful in cups. Place cups on baking sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mimi'S Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in dish while mixing flour sugar and milk. Pour into hot butter. Add fruit. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peas And Cheese
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise sugar and pickle juice. Toss all together and serve.

title: Venetian Pasta Rolls
instructions: Crumble sausage in skillet. Brown and drain. Add onion; cook until tender. Stir in 1/2 cup sauce and 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover each half of noodle with approximately 1/3 cup sausage mixture; roll up starting at narrow end. Place seam side down in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Spoon remaining sauce over noodles; top with Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with additional Parmesan cheese if desired. Serves 8.

title: Boiled Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar water syrup and salt in saucepan. Stir. Boil slowly without stirring until mixture will spin a long thread when a little is dropped from spoon; hold spoon high above saucepan (238\u00b0 to 242\u00b0). In mixing bowl beat whites until stiff about 2 1/2 minutes. Pour hot syrup slowly over egg whites while beating. Continue beating until mixture is fluffy and will hold its shape. Add vanilla. Blend. Spread on cake.

title: Candied Carrots And Grapes
instructions: Melt butter; blend in cornstarch. Add honey lemon juice and cinnamon. Cook stirring constantly until mixture boils. Add glaze to sliced carrots and grapes. Stir to mix.

title: Frozen Sherry Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl or pot. Transfer to five 1-quart freezer containers; freeze for at least 24 hours. The mixture will be slushy. To serve spoon into wine glasses. Yields 1 1/4 gallons.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown onion and green pepper in 1 tablespoon cooking oil. Add ground beef. Cook until beef is done. Drain well. Put back on heat; add Ragu mushrooms and sauce mix. Simmer at least 1 hour or longer. Layer cottage cheese and lasagna (cooked until soft) in casserole dish until 1/2 inch from top. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Cook for 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease and flour bundt pan. Melt 2 Tbsp. butter and pour into bottom of bundt pan.

title: Grandma Fay'S Cake Donuts(1898-1974)
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Sift flour and add baking soda and baking powder. Mix into other ingredients and add vanilla and nutmeg. Refrigerate dough overnight.

title: Tangle Britches(An Old York County, Pa Recipe)
instructions: Cream together the butter and sugar. Add eggs beating well. Sift in the cinnamon and enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll out the dough very thin on a floured board to about 1/8 inch thick. Cut into rectangular pieces (3 x 5-inch). Make 5 cups lengthwise in the dough 1/2 inch apart and 4 1/2 inches long so that the rectangle remains on one piece. Fry in hot deep fat (360\u00b0) for 2 minutes or until they bob up to the top of the hot grease. When dropping them into the fryer pick up the first third and fifth strips and pull them upward. Let the second fourth and sixth sag downward so that in frying they get all tangled or as the Dutch say \all through each other.\ Dust with powdered sugar or dribble molasses over them and eat hot.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine ground beef onion garlic and pepper; cook until meat loses its redness. Stir in soup mushrooms and salt; stir well and cook until bubbling. Stir in sour cream and heat. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Stove Top Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel sweet potatoes or yams. Cut into thick slices. Rinse in cold water. Cover sweet potatoes or yams with water (use small amount of water as potatoes already have water in them). Bring to a boil (30 minutes). Add all the ingredients except for the marshmallows and butter. When potatoes are done sprinkle with marshmallows and butter and heat until marshmallows and butter are melted slightly.

title: Drop Doughnuts
instructions: Mix together and drop by spoonful into hot grease. Remove when done.

title: Quickie Fudge
instructions: Blend powdered sugar and cocoa. Put in sifter then into mixing bowl suitable for microwave oven. Add milk and butter; do not stir. Cook 2 minutes on High in microwave. Stir ingredients to blend. Add vanilla and nuts. Mix well. Pour into buttered dish. Freeze 20 minutes or chill in refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Polish Angel Wings Chrust
instructions: Whip all ingredients except for vegetable oil flour and powdered sugar. Slowly add flour until the batter is satiny. Roll out on a well floured board (the thinner the better). Cut into long strips then cut strips into 4 to 5-inch strips. Slit these strips in the center and pull one end through to make a bow tie. Deep fry these about 6 to 8 at a time. When golden remove from hot oil. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Enjoy!!

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Put a layer of cake squares into bowl. Put a layer of cherries layer of French vanilla pudding and a layer of pineapple. Keep alternating the layers until all ingredients are used. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Mincemeat Mini Loaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 4 to 6 mini loaf pans. In large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. With pastry blender or two knives scissor fashion cut in shortening until mixture resembles fine crumbs.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Let hash browns thaw completely. Mix in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together the sugar and margarine until well blended. Add the eggs and beat well. Add the remaining ingredients and mix until blended. Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Place all ingredients in mixer; beat 4 minutes. Pour into 3 pans (8 or 9-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Crab Au Gratin
instructions: Pick through crab to remove shell. Put it in a 2-quart casserole dish and set aside. Saute onion in butter. Remove from heat and add flour. Set back on heat and add milk immediately. Stir constantly until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Add shredded cheese and stir quickly until it melts. Remove from heat. Salt and pepper to taste. Gently mix it with crabmeat in the casserole dish. (Top with buttered bread crumbs.) Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Can sprinkle with paprika before baking.

title: Zippy Beef Olive Spread
instructions: Soften onion in sherry or water. Add to cream cheese and mayonnaise. Mix well. Chop finely the smoked beef and olives. Add to cream cheese mixture. Mix well. Form into ball or log. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Mix sugar soy sauce lemon juice garlic and ginger until smooth. Pour over chicken and marinate several hours or overnight.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into lightly greased casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Mary Ann'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat and chopped onion; drain. Place meat mixture and the rest of ingredients in a large kettle or Dutch oven. Simmer for 1 hour. Stir occasionally.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix milk and egg together; pour ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tuna, Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight. Sprinkle 1 cup buttered bread crumbs on top before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Wednesday'S Frosty Look-Alike
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender. Whip it up and there you have an imitation of the brand name prepared item.

title: Nannie'S Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Saute chopped onion and garlic in vegetable oil. Add chopped tomatoes and tomato sauce. Add salt basil oregano and sugar. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pea Pod Salad Oriental
instructions: In a large bowl combine first 5 ingredients. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients except lettuce. Pour over chicken mixture; mix well. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Line serving bowl with lettuce leaves; spoon salad over lettuce. Makes 4 servings. Each serving provides 1 bread exchange 4 vegetable exchange 2 fat exchange 3 calories optional exchange and 3 protein exchanges.

title: Quick And Easy Potato Soup
instructions: Saute garlic and onions in olive oil in a 4-quart kettle. Add hot water potatoes and salt to desired flavor. Cook for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. You may reduce the water to 6 cups and add 2 cups of milk after potatoes are done if you use dairy products. Serve hot with crackers and/or bread and butter.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil well. Add eggs one at a time; add vanilla then chopped apples. Sift together flour baking powder soda cinnamon and salt. Last add chopped nuts. Bake in angel food pan 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mock Margarita
instructions: Use a 4-quart nonmetal container. Mix lemonade and lime concentrate powdered sugar and egg whites with a whip. Add crushed ice and club soda. Serve in salt rimmed glasses.

title: Hot Bologna Sandwich
instructions: Skillet fry the bologna in butter on one side. Turn over and as second side fries place a slice of cheese on it. Serve on bread with some mayonnaise.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Add to the eggs the salt and melted butter then add the milk and flour sifted with baking powder. Stir in the well beaten corn. Fry in small spoonfuls in plenty of hot lard.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Add well beaten egg yolks and beat well. Add honey; mix. Sift in dry ingredients. Add alternately with milk to the butter mixture. Beat until smooth. Add chopped nuts and fruit. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into a greased paper lined 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Poly Whipped Topping(Low-Fat)
instructions: Chill a small mixing bowl. Soften gelatin with 2 teaspoons cold water then add the boiling water stirring until gelatin is completely dissolved. Cool until tepid. Place ice water and nonfat dry milk in the chilled mixing bowl. Beat at high speed until the mixture forms stiff peaks. Add the sugar still beating then the oil and the gelatin. Place in freezer for about 15 minutes then transfer to the refrigerator until ready for use. Stir before using to retain a creamy mixture. Yield 2 cups.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook ingredients until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Use egg whites for meringue; put on pie.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Fruit Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. To prepare crust In a medium saucepan place 1/4 cup sugar and butter. Heat until butter is melted stirring occasionally. Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Press mixture evenly over the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In a large bowl with an electric mixer beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in remaining 3/4 cup sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Blend well. Spoon blueberry filling evenly over crust. Carefully pour cream cheese mixture over blueberries. Bake just until set 45 to 50 minutes. Cool. Chill until cold about 2 hours or longer. Cut into squares.

title: Cheesy Potato Bake
instructions: May substitute regular hash browns for hash browns OBrien with onions and peppers. This would eliminate the oleo and onion. May also use Fiesta Cheddar cheese soup with peppers instead of the regular Cheddar cheese soup.

title: Pineapple Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan combine pineapple and cornstarch. Stir. Add honey soy sauce and cider vinegar. Heat ingredients for 5 minutes until thickened. This sauce is poured over sliced ham when it is served. Do not pour over ham when it is baking.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Mocha Bundt Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt cake pan shaking out excess. Combine first 7 ingredients in large bowl and beat thoroughly. Pour into pan. Bake until tester inserted in center comes out clean about 50 to 60 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes in pan then invert onto rack.

title: Rice With Black Beans(20 Minutes)
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Add onion and garlic cook and stir until tender but not browned. Stir in beans tomatoes water and oregano. Bring to boil. Stir in rice. Return to boil. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Baked Bananas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small saucepan combine sugar butter water salt and lemon juice. Bring to a boil; cook briefly until syrupy. Add zest. Lightly smear a Pyrex (not aluminum) baking dish with butter (its best to choose a dish you plan to serve it in because transferring baked bananas is a tricky job). Split bananas in half lengthwise and place in dish so that they are cut side down and not overlapping. Immediately cover bananas with syrup and pop in oven. Bake for a total of 30 minutes. After 10 minutes baste them with syrup. Repeat 10 minutes later.

title: 1 - 2 - 3 Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Mix and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Let it boil 1 minute then add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well for 1 minute. Serve warm.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chili sauce and grape jelly. Roll into small balls and brown in a skillet. In a large pot (or crock pot) combine chili sauce and grape jelly. Add meatballs and simmer until ready to serve. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Goofy Bars
instructions: Mix for 5 minutes with mixer. Pour in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when done. Cut into squares.

title: Baked Rice
instructions: Put all ingredients into a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Pie(Shepherd'S Pie)
instructions: Run cold water over vegetables to separate. Cook meat and onions until meat is brown; drain. Stir vegetables and 1/4 cup water into meat. Cook covered 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in soup and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Put mixture in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Prepare potatoes according to package directions. Put over top of meat mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over top the last 5 minutes of baking. Serves 4.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar butter cocoa and milk together. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter vanilla and oatmeal. Drop by spoonfuls on tin foil or wax paper. Leave until cooled.

title: Country Cornbread
instructions: Heat oil in a seasoned cast-iron skillet at 350\u00b0. Mix the remaining ingredients together. Remove the hot oil from the oven and add oil to the mix. Pour mixture into hot skillet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Medley
instructions: Cut cauliflower and broccoli into bite size pieces. Mix in large bowl. Mix dressing well. Pour over vegetables; toss gently. Chill before serving. Place onion rings on top.

title: Herb Bread Sticks
instructions: Melt oleo. Add garlic salt basil and parsley. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cut buns into quarters then half the quarters. Brush with oleo mixture on cut side. Place on cookie sheet and bake until crisp and lightly browned about 30 minutes. Store in tightly closed container. Enjoy!

title: Fresh Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Place garlic basil tomatoes olive oil and Parmesan cheese together in large bowl. Cook pasta according to directions and drain well. While still hot toss pasta with other ingredients. Cover and cool. Best when eaten warm.

title: Cracker Tarts
instructions: Mix the crumbs and baking powder; set aside. Beat the egg whites until stiff then gradually add the sugar. Fold in the cracker crumbs. Add the vanilla and nuts. Place in paper muffin cups and bake until very light brown at 325\u00b0. Be very careful not to overbake. Top with whipped cream and cherries.

title: Fondue
instructions: Melt cream cheese in double boiler. Add milk; stir until smooth. Add garlic salt and Parmesan cheese. Stir again. Serve with dry French bread. Cut into squares or strips.

title: Potato-Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion in small amount of oleo. Add chicken broth and potatoes. When potatoes are done add Velveeta salt pepper and sugar (1 teaspoon). Thin with milk if desired.

title: Velvet Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Blend in butter and boiling water. Add chocolate. Cook stirring constantly until chocolate melts and mixture becomes thick and smooth. Remove from heat. Blend in 1/2 tsp. vanilla. Cool to lukewarm. Frosts 1 eight or nine inch layer cake.

title: Old-Fashioned Lemonade
instructions: Combine sugar and 1 cup water in a pan. Heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved. Bring to a full boil. Remove from heat and cool.\tAdd lemon juice and 4 cups water. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Melt 1/2 margarine; add to 1/2 pound cheese and mix with broccoli. Put into buttered casserole. Crush crackers; mix with remaining margarine and sprinkle over broccoli. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and pineapple; add remaining ingredients. Chill before serving.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add vanilla and beaten eggs. Sift together dry ingredients. Add alternately with milk. Mix well adding bananas and nuts. Bake in 2 loaf pans in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Shake flour in oven bag and place in large baking pan. Add barbecue sauce and chili powder and squeeze bag to blend. Add onion and beef; turn bag to coat. Tie off bag and bake for 45 minutes. Divide mixture evenly onto rolls.

title: Cocktail Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix together ingredients and cover with barbecue sauce. Cook in crock-pot for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Pudding Poke Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake cake mix as directed on package for 13 x 9-inch cake. Remove from oven. Poke holes at once down through cake to pan with round handle of wooden spoon. Holes should be at 1 inch spaces. After holes are made combine pudding mix with sugar in large bowl. Gradually stir in milk. Beat with electric mixer at low speed for not more than 1 minute. Quickly pour half of thin pudding over warm cake and into holes. Let rest of pudding sit for 1 minute then spoon and swirl over cake. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for cheese. Pour half of mixture in hot skillet. Sprinkle half of cheese on top. Pour rest of mixture on top of cheese. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Tarts
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Roll out thin. Cut in 2 or 3-inch squares. Put 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon of raspberry strawberry or apricot jam on each. Fold over to make triangles. Seal edges. Or use a donut cutter and cut circles for bases and circles with holes to go on top. Seal edges and put jam in centers. This method makes very attractive cookies. Be sure to seal the two layers together and use only 1/2 teaspoon of jam on each cookie or the jam will \boil over.\ Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove and put on brown paper to absorb oil. Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Flat Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the warm water. Stir in 5 cups of flour then stir in the rest little by little adding only enough to make a dough. Turn out on floured board and knead until dough is smooth and elastic and doesnt stick to your hands. Pat into a ball. Pour 1/2 teaspoon of oil into palm of your hand and roll dough ball around until it is coated. Put in bowl; cover with towel and let rise until doubled 30 to 40 minutes. Punch down and divide into two portions. With your hands flatten out each portion to a plate-size round. Brush rest of oil on top of rounds. Sprinkle one with sesame seed and the other with Italian seasoning. Put on baking sheets; cover with bowls and let rise until doubled about 30 minutes. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes until golden on top.

title: Popovers
instructions: Grease 6 Pyrex muffin cups; place them on a cookie sheet and preheat them for 10 to 15 minutes in 425\u00b0 oven. Combine all ingredients. Pour the batter in the heated cups. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Do not open oven during baking as it causes shrinkage.

title: Sausage Brunch Braid
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat cook sausage onion celery green pepper and garlic until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender; drain. Add cream cheese green onion and parsley. Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Set aside.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Chill all ingredients. Combine each one finishing with ginger ale. Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Creamy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place cooked broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Melt the cream cheese soup and margarine in microwave. Stir to blend. Pour mixture over cooked broccoli. Top with cheese slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: European Style Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in bowl. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour in loaf pan covered with foil. Uncover and bake for 10 more minutes to brown top.

title: Cereal Muffins
instructions: Pour milk over cereal. Set 3 minutes to soak. Stir and add egg and oil. Mix in rest of dry mixture. Bake in muffin pans. I like to add frozen blueberries. Real good.

title: Cranberry-Apple Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O. Add cranberries apples sugar and nuts. Add celery and crushed pineapple if desired. Pour into individual cups decorative mold or 9 x 9-inch pan. Let set.

title: Low Cholesterol Chicken
instructions: Place crushed Rice Krispies cereal and seasonings in large plastic food bag. Shake to blend well. Brush chicken on all sides with mayonnaise. Place one piece at a time in bag; shake to coat well. Place on rack in broiler pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Eskimo Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar vanilla wafers and cocoa. Mix well. Add oats and mix. Put in refrigerator overnight. Roll in 36 balls and roll them in powdered sugar. Store in fridge.

title: Shrimp Linguine
instructions: In large skillet combine shrimp wine lemon juice and lime juice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer covered 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except linguine. Cook stirring constantly just until snow peas are tender and shrimp is opaque about 5 minutes. Prepare linguine as package directs. Remove bay leaf from shrimp mixture. Combine shrimp mixture and hot cooked linguine; toss to coat. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Twin Layered Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add tomato paste and sugar. Mix eggs Parmesan cheese parsley flakes and pepper. In 13 x 9-inch pan layer beef mixture noodles cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers. Cook for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach And Orange Salad
instructions: Toss the oranges and spinach. Add desired rice vinegar and olive oil. Sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Put the first 4 ingredients into a container and cover with 1/4 cup salt. Let stand overnight. Thoroughly drain next day.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Whip egg whites while gradually adding sugar until stiff peaks form. Fold in vanilla. Stir in chips and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto parchment lined baking sheets. Put into oven and IMMEDIATELY TURN OFF OVEN. Leave overnight or at least 8 hours in turned off oven. Do not open oven door during this time.

title: Oreo Delight
instructions: Crush cookies; add melted margarine. Mix well. Grease a 9 x 13 pan and line with cookie mixture. Soften ice cream at room temperature and spread on top of cookies. Melt 1/4 cup margarine and unsweetened chocolate. Add sugar and evaporated milk. Cook and stir for 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Drizzle over ice cream. Freeze overnight. Serves 12.

title: Sour Cream Apple Squares
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine flour brown sugar and butter. Blend at low speed until crumbly. Stir in nuts. Press about 2 3/4 cups into the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease baking sheets with butter flavor Crisco. Place sheets of foil on countertop for cooling cookies. Combine butter flavor Crisco brown sugar egg milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Combine oats flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Mix into creamed mixture at low speed just until blended. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2-inches apart onto baking sheet. Bake 1 baking sheet at a time at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Remove cookies to foil to cool completely. MAKES ABOUT 2 1/2 DOZEN COOKIES.

title: Spanish Style Rice
instructions: Combine tomato sauce water onion green pepper butter salt sugar mustard and pepper in saucepan. Cover and bring to a full boil. Stir in rice. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 5 minutes. Stir with a fork. Makes 3 1/2 cups or 4 servings.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add milk and flour alternately. Add soda; mix well. Add eggs (one at a time). Add flavoring. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven (in a cold oven).

title: Lamb Meatballs
instructions: Mix form into small meatballs and place in casserole dish.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into bite size pieces. In salad bowl mix broccoli onion cheeses and bacon. Mix mayo sugar and vinegar and add to broccoli mixture. Toss well.

title: Pasta And Veggie Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except tomato and avocado. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Just before serving stir in tomato and avocado. Has 120 calories.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together then stir in eggs oil and strawberries. Grease 2 loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Cream Cheese Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta as directed by package. Cook vegetables as directed by package. Drain pasta and vegetables; mix all ingredients while pasta and vegetables are still warm. Serve immediately or chill.

title: Low-Fat Banana Shake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Makes a great healthful treat with virtually no fat. Add any fruits to make different combinations.

title: Spinach And Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the spinach and strawberries. Toss with the spinach and strawberries just before serving.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Enchiladas
instructions: Brown and crumble meat. In a large mixing bowl combine 2 cans of enchilada sauce tomato soup and 1 tomato soup can of water; mix well. Lay one side of tortilla in sauce and then drop meat and cheese on that side. Roll it up and put seam side down in a rectangular 13 x 9-inch pan that has been greased. When pan is full pour remaining sauce over enchiladas. For more sauce use other can. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover pan with foil; cook at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add oil eggs water apples and nuts. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 in greased and floured pan.

title: Garlic-Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Blend together butter garlic powder minced onion and set aside.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine pumpkin sugar oil and egg in a large mixing bowl. Beat well. Combine remaining ingredients except walnuts. Add to pumpkin mixture mixing well. Stir in walnuts. Spoon into a 9 1/4 x 5 1/4 x 2 3/4-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins. Cool peel and shred coarsely. In saucepan melt butter over low heat. Add cheese and stir until almost melted. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream salt and pepper. Mix with shredded potatoes. Bake in a 2-quart casserole and sprinkle with paprika for color. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Best if made day before and stored in refrigerator until ready to bake.

title: Easy Personal Pizzas
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Using a rolling pin roll each biscuit to 1/4-inch thickness. Place on cookie sheet. Put a tablespoon of sauce on each biscuit. Add desired toppings and sprinkle cheese over all. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Press crescent rolls into 15x10x1 inch baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 - 15 min. Cool before adding topping. Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients spread over cooled crust top with chopped veggies. Sprinkle top with salad supreme (Mrs. Dash).

title: Spinish
instructions: Combine spinach cream Ricotta and salt and pepper to taste. Heat over medium heat in saucepan. Pour over cooked pasta and sprinkle with pine nuts.

title: Tuna Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add just enough soup to make moist. Form patties and roll in bread crumbs. Spray Pam on both sides. Bake until brown. You may also brown these in a skillet on top of the stove. Just spray Pam in skillet as directed.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Blend soup with milk until smooth. Add into mixture red pepper Worcestershire sauce seafood seasoning black pepper salt and parsley. Stir mixture well. Fold in shrimp and crab meat. Keep lumps as whole as possible. Pour into a greased casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine. (I use \Shedds Country Crock.\) Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: In mixer put sugar shortening 2 eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add alternately milk and flour along with salt and baking powder. Add chips and nuts. Put in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool; top with powdered sugar.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir well; do not use mixer. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool and ice with buttercream frosting.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. With use of a blender hand beater or electric mixer blend ingredients. Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Pour ingredients in pie plate. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Meal In A Dish
instructions: Brown beef in hot shortening in skillet. Stir in onions beans salt pepper tomatoes and mustard. Boil for 3 minutes. Stir often.

title: Meat Loaf And Gravy
instructions: Place heavy-duty aluminum foil in baking pan 9 x 9 x 2-inches. Mix meat and onion soup mix; turn onto foil and shape into loaf. Spread mushroom soup on loaf. Fold foil loosely over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cool Orange Drink
instructions: Combine and blend for 30 seconds.

title: Chicken Delish
instructions: In electric skillet brown chicken in oil. Add remaining ingredients cover and simmer 1 hour. Serve over rice noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Chicken Livers With Mushrooms
instructions: Fry bacon in pressure cooker; remove. Saute liver. Pour off excess drippings. Add remaining ingredients. Close cover securely. Place regulator on vent pipe. Cook 5 minutes and cool pressure cooker at once. Crumble bacon and sprinkle over liver. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mom'S Apple Pie Bars
instructions: Mix 2 1/2 cups flour shortening and salt like pie crust. Put egg yolk into measuring cup and fill with milk to measure 2/3 cup. (Save whites for later.) Mix with flour mixture. Slice apples. Blend sugar cinnamon tapioca and 2 tablespoons flour. Mix all together. Divide dough in half. Pat 1/2 of mixture in bottom of cookie sheet. Arrange apples on crust. Sprinkle sugar mixture over apples. Put on other half of dough for top crust.

title: Microwaved Peanut Patties
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and water in 2-quart microwave-safe dish. Microwave on Full power 3 1/2 minutes. Stir in peanuts and continue to microwave on Full power for 9 minutes stirring after 5 minutes. Stir in butter vanilla and food coloring. Beat hard with wooden spoon 2 minutes until creamy. Pour into greased miniature muffin pans. Makes about 24 to 30 patties.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain ground meat onion and pepper. Then add soups tomatoes and milk. Sprinkle with garlic powder salt and chili powder. Cut the corn tortillas into bite size pieces. Add to mixture and mix well. Pour into 2 or more baking dishes; top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cornmeal Cookies
instructions: In bowl mix all ingredients one at a time. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake on greased cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes or until bottoms of cookies are brown.

title: Mediterranean Steak
instructions: Pressure cook round steak with water approximately 15 minutes; set aside.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients; mix well. By 1/4 cupfuls shape into balls or patties. Heat soup milk and garlic salt. Pour over patties. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. During last 10 minutes add mushrooms.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Heat strawberries sugar and jello and cool. Mix milk vanilla pudding sour cream and Cool Whip (reserve half for top). Line your bowl with vanilla wafers then alternate strawberry mixture and wafers. Then top with jello mixture while still runny. Chill. Top with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Marinade For Beef Roast
instructions: Go to a pizza store. Buy 3 large pizzas. Bring home cut and serve.

title: Apple, Cinnamon, Raisin Mini-Muffins
instructions: In small bowl stir together flour oats sugar baking powder and cinnamon. In another bowl beat to blend egg juice oil apple and raisins. Add dry ingredients; stir just until moistened. Spoon batter equally into 24 greased tiny muffin pans (1 1/2-inch diameter). Bake at 400\u00b0 until well browned 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from pans; serve warm or cool. If made ahead package cool muffins in an airtight container and hold at room temperature up until next day. Freeze to store longer.

title: Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook grits according to directions on container. Add butter eggs and cheese. Pour into oblong 8 x 10-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until lightly browned. Serves about six. Can be made day ahead before baking.

title: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce
instructions: Bring water to rapid boil. Add salt and spaghetti. Cook uncovered about 15 minutes or until done. Drain. Saute onion in oil or butter until brown. Add ground beef and cook until brown. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook the bacon and onion in skillet until done. Set aside. Cook the macaroni until done; drain. Add bacon and onion to macaroni. Add water and tomatoes. Cook for 30 minutes. May add more water. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix together the cake mix sugar oil and water. Then beat in the eggs one at a time. Add the sour cream last and then fold in the poppy seed. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Glaze while warm with a powdered sugar icing.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Butter casserole and line with tortillas. Make sauce. Saute one medium chopped onion and 1 can green chilies (seeds removed). Add soup broth Carnation milk and chicken. Top with grated cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Marge'S Apple Puffed Pancake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In blender or large bowl mix eggs milk flour granulated sugar vanilla salt and cinnamon until blended. If using a mixer batter will be lumpy. Melt oleo in a 12-inch fluted quiche pan or 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Add apple slices. Return to oven until oleo is melted and sizzles. Do not brown. Remove from oven and immediately pour batter over apples. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake 20 minutes until puffed and brown. Serve with maple syrup. This is a nice brunch recipe. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and put into a large baking dish. Make sure it is tall enough so the juice will not overflow. Spread 1/2 cup tomato soup over top of loaf. Cover with foil and cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cook last 15 minutes uncovered to brown.

title: Holiday Punch
instructions: Several hours ahead mix together the fruit juices salt and water. Place in covered container in refrigerator to chill. At serving time combine mixture with ginger ale. Stir in food coloring if desired. Serve over a block of ice in punch bowl. Makes 25 generous servings.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Grease bottom only of 2 loaf pans. Cream margarine and brown sugar. Add eggs zucchini water and vanilla. Sift together flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and cloves. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Stir in nuts/raisins. Pour into greased pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 60 minutes (until toothpick comes out clean). Cool slightly before removing from pans.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl until smooth. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Then spread on bottom of pie crust. Pour 1 cup milk into bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. (Mixture will be thick.) Stir in pumpkin and spices. Mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Garnish with additional Cool Whip topping and nuts if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Simmer chicken 40 to 45 minutes or until tender. Cool; remove chicken from bones and dice. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate until well chilled. Makes 8 servings.

title: Double Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Blend cake mix oil and eggs. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop from a teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Bring water sugar and apples to a boil. Cook several minutes until apples are soft but not mushy. Dissolve cornstarch in 1 cup water. Stir into apple mixture. Cook until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in allspice lemon juice cinnamon vanilla and margarine. Pour mixture into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until browned. Put tinfoil on edges to keep from browning.

title: Pot-Roasted Pork
instructions: Rub pork with salt and pepper. Make tiny slits in meat. Insert garlic. Put in broiler 15 minutes. Place onions in bottom of crock-pot. Add pork and remaining ingredients. Cook on low for 10 hours.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar and flour. Add egg yolks milk and butter or margarine. Let cook until mixture thickens. Pour into cooked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Fuzzy Navel Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Chop peaches. Combine peaches Schnapps sugar and orange juice in a covered glass container and let set for 24 hours. Mix cake mix pudding mix eggs and oil with 1 cup of chopped peaches from preceding mixture. Add 1/2 cup liquid from preceding mixture. Mix. Add chopped pecans. Mix. Pour mixture in greased Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Date Cake Squares
instructions: Combine dates prunes raisins and water; heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until tender and water is absorbed about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add margarine and cool. Mix eggs until stiff. Spread in a greased 11 x 7 x 2 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake springs back when touched lightly about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Spread hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat the remaining ingredients and pour over the potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach and drain completely. Dice water chestnuts and green onions. Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Chill approximately 1 hour before serving.

title: Grilled Tuna
instructions: Combine oil teriyaki sauce lime juice ginger garlic powder and pepper. Place tuna in a shallow dish. Add marinade. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours to 1 day. Grill tuna over medium hot coals about 5 minutes on each side. Serve on a bed of leaf lettuce. Garnish with lime slices and cherry tomatoes. Serves 8.

title: Fried Chicken Livers
instructions: Clean liver and roll in flour salt pepper and garlic mixture. In a frypan place the cooking oil and heat hot. Fry livers until crisp and brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Quick And Easy Ham Rolls
instructions: Cut off green part of the onion. Spread softened cream cheese on ham slice. Place green onion longways on ham slice at one edge. Roll and place toothpicks along edge. Repeat. Refrigerate until cream cheese hardens. Slice about 1-inch thick leaving a toothpick in each slice. Enjoy.

title: Pepper Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in water and set aside. Mix in 2 tablespoons coarse black pepper and 2 tablespoons dried chopped onion. Beat together eggs cottage cheese and butter and microwave 1 to 2 minutes until warm. Combine yeast mixture with the cheese mixture. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Dough will be stiff! Knead to form ball on table. Cover with a large bowl and let rise until doubled. Beat down and let rise again. Form loaves on cornmeal dusted cookie sheets; let rise again. Just before putting bread in oven mix 1 egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush on loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Christmas Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken in cold water. Pat dry. Combine garlic (minced) sour cream lemon juice salts paprika and pepper sauce. Coat chicken with mixture place in a covered bowl overnight in refrigerator.

title: Mashed 3 Potatoes With Scallions(Excellent For Holidays)
instructions: Place potatoes half the scallions 1 tablespoon salt and enough water to cover the potatoes. Boil until soft. Drain reserving 1/2 cup cooking liquid. Mash the potatoes; stir in reserved cooking liquid cream butter all but 2 teaspoons of the remaining scallions 1/2 teaspoon salt pepper and nutmeg. Transfer to warmed serving dish. Sprinkle with remaining scallions and serve hot.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
instructions: Put apple slices in unbaked pie shell. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over apple slices. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife inserted comes out clean from center.

title: Egg And Bacon Spread
instructions: Fry bacon. Hard boil eggs. Let grease drain from bacon while peeling shells from eggs. Crush eggs up in medium mixing bowl. Crumble bacon in with eggs. Add 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise. Mix together well. Spread on wheat bread topped with sliced tomato and enjoy.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Put apple in casserole dish. Put bread strips on top of apples. Mix sugar egg self-rising flour and softened margarine together. Pour mixture on top of bread strips. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown. Let it cool before serving. May top cobbler with ice cream before serving.

title: Crunchy Baked Chicken
instructions: Place butter in a 2-quart glass baking dish. Microwave at 70% power 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until melted. Combine salt and pepper with cornflake crumbs. Roll chicken in the melted butter then in the seasoned crumbs. Place the chicken pieces skin side up with the thick edges toward the outside of the dish. Microwave uncovered 6 to 7 minutes per pound. Turn the dish halfway through the cooking time. Let stand 3 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Put quarter of apple in each roll. Gently pull dough over apple quarter. Crimp edges so there are no holes. Place in Corning Ware dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bring sugar water and margarine to boil. Pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken pieces in 9 x 12-inch dish. Mix soups and milk together and pour over chicken. Spread dressing over chicken mixture. Gradually pour broth over dressing until moistened. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Foam Green Salad
instructions: Use standard recipe for mixing Jell-O. Put in refrigerator until it begins to jell. Mix nuts cheese pineapple and whipped cream together. Add Jell-O mixture. Pour in mold and serve when firm.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Apple Pecan Dessert
instructions: Mix pie filling water and nutmeg. Pour into greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with pecans. Top with biscuits. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Eggplant Au Gratin
instructions: Trim ends from eggplant and slice in 1/2-inch rounds. Sprinkle slices with salt and pepper and roll in flour. Heat oil (1/2-inch deep) in large skillet and fry eggplant slices until golden brown on both sides. Line bottom and sides of a 1 1/2 quart casserole with eggplant slices.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together all ingredients saving 1/2 of the pecans. Set pecans aside. Shape mixture into ball. Roll ball in remaining pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Muesli
instructions: Combine oatmeal wheat germ orange rind raisins and nuts. Shred 1 apple and chop 1 apple. Slice banana. Drizzle with honey and apple juice. Mix altogether. Serve with milk. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Roasted Ribs
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add all other ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Can be refrigerated up to 2 weeks. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Salt and pepper ribs; place on rack and pour 3 cups water in pan. Bake 30 minutes. Pour out water; reduce heat to 300\u00b0. Brush ribs with Veras Barbecue Sauce. Bake 25 minutes. Turn; baste with sauce and bake 20 minutes. Broil a few minutes on each side before serving.

title: Seven In One Casserole
instructions: Arrange layers in order. Pour tomato soup over layer of ground chuck and top with Pepperidge Farm herbal dressing mix and press down into soup. (You can substitute bread crumbs for the Pepperidge Farm dressing.) The last 5 minutes of cooking you can top with grated cheese. This may be made to serve as many as you want. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: After Dinner Mints
instructions: Combine egg white cream vanilla oil flavoring and coloring. Stir well. Add sugar all at once mixing thoroughly. Add more cream if needed. Add butter and more sugar if necessary to make mixture the consistency needed to roll into firm small balls. Arrange balls on waxed paper. Press each ball with tines of fork dipped into additional powdered sugar. Let stand overnight to form crust. Put mints into tins with waxed paper between each layer. Mints may be frozen and kept for several months.

title: Simon And Garfunkel Chicken
instructions: Turn the chicken breasts smooth side down and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Dot each breast with 1 teaspoon margarine. Lay a slice of Mozzarella cheese on top of each chicken piece. Roll up jelly roll fashion long edge to long edge. Secure well with wooden toothpicks. Melt the remaining margarine; add parsley sage rosemary and thyme. Roll the chicken rolls in the flour then in egg then in crumbs. Place in baking dish. Pour melted margarine and spices over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Lasagna
instructions: In large skillet saute ground beef. Drain excess fat. Add spaghetti sauce onion salt and garlic. Simmer 20 minutes. Cook lasagna according to package.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in small diced pieces for about an hour. Drain while hot. Put in mayonnaise and salt. Let cool then mix other ingredients. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Recipe For Raising Our Children
instructions: Mix all ingredients; add a pound of persistency and one cup of love and whip until right consistency. These recipes are given by our Creator.

title: Fresh Creamed Corn
instructions: Cut corn off cob. Then with the knife blade scrape juice from each cob. Place in a saucepan and cook for about an hour or until corn is tender. Add a little more water or Carnation milk if necessary. When tender add enough water to make it fairly juicy. Mix in a cup 2 tablespoons flour and water to make a thin flour paste. Add this to corn to thicken mixture. Continue simmering until done.

title: Texas Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Simmer 3 hours then add 3/4 stick of oleo and simmer another 1/2 hour.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Drain English peas and Shoe Peg corn. Put both in a covered bowl overnight. Add onion radishes celery and pecans. Stir the mixture gently until combined. Add mayonnaise. Stir until well coated. Chill.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and Wesson oil. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each. Add 7-Up. Bake in four layers at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli And Cheese
instructions: Mix 1 stick of butter Velveeta cheese and broccoli together. Mix the other stick of butter and crushed crackers. Put broccoli mixture in casserole pan. Crumble cracker mix on top of broccoli casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Chow-Chow Relish
instructions: Combine chopped vegetables; sprinkles with salt. Let stand 4 to 6 hours in a cool place. Drain well.

title: Quick Lasagne
instructions: Mix together eggs cottage cheese Mozzarella spinach and spices. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread sauce thickly over bottom of pan. Add layer of uncooked noodles (dont overlap) then top with cheese mixture. Continue layering noodles cheese mix and sauce. Finish with sauce. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Combine lettuce onion and tomatoes. Brown beef in pan drain and let cool slightly. Add beef cheese and nacho chips to veggies. Pour on dressing. Toss and serve.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in 9-inch greased pan.

title: Texas Hot Cocoa Cake
instructions: Bring to a boil first 3 ingredients. Sift in large bowl sugar flour and cocoa. Pour liquid mixture over flour mixture and beat until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in large oblong pan and bake 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except tortilla chips. Put in pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until melted. (You can melt it in the microwave on Medium heat.) Use it as a dip for the tortilla chips.

title: Mocha Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in vanilla. Add beaten eggs in thirds beating well after each addition. Blend chocolate and instant coffee powder together. Add to creamed mixture. Add sifted dry ingredients in thirds mixing well after each addition. Stir in walnuts. Turn batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Cut into squares.

title: Spice Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Gloria'S Sopaipillas(Fried Indian Bread)
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a medium size mixing bowl and cut in shortening. Make a well in center of dry ingredients. Add water to dry ingredients and work into a dough. Knead dough until smooth; cover and set aside for 20 minutes. Heat 2 inches of shortening in a heavy pan at medium-high heat (425\u00b0). Roll dough to a 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured board. Cut dough into 4-inch squares and fry until golden on both sides turning once. Drain Sopaipillas on absorbent towels.

title: Jamie'S P.B.J. Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine shortening and sugar until very fluffy. Add eggs one at a time still creaming then vanilla and peanut butter. Stir in salt baking powder and soda. Add enough flour stirring to make a soft dough.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Carefully stir in drained pineapple 1 cup pecans green pepper onion and salt. Chill well. Form into a ball and roll in remaining cup of pecans. Wrap in aluminum foil and let set overnight. (This is so that the onion and bell pepper taste will not be too strong.)

title: Broccoli-Corn Bake
instructions: Combine corn broccoli egg 1/2 cup cracker crumbs onion 2 tablespoons melted butter or margarine salt and pepper. Turn into 1-quart casserole. Combine 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and remaining butter; sprinkle over vegetable mixture. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Italian Spinach
instructions: Saute garlic and onion in olive oil until onion is clear. Mix in spinach. Cook on medium heat until tender. Spinach will cook down a considerable amount. Add drained tomato and drained mushrooms. Simmer until heated through. Serves 2 - 4.

title: Applesauce Cupcakes
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy in large mixing bowl. Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture alternately with applesauce. Add vanilla and mix well.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a very large bowl. I have never added the cloves to the mix but I love the cinnamon in it.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine rice soup mix chicken soup and water. Pour into a 9 x 13 baking dish. Place chicken on top of rice mixture. Melt butter and drizzle over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. If using glass pan bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Paula'S Chili And Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Monkey-Faced Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix brown sugar shortening molasses milk and vinegar. Stir in flour ginger and cinnamon. Drop by rounded teaspoonful about 2 inches apart onto a cookie sheet. Press 3 raisins in each cookie for eyes and mouth. Bake until set 11 to 12 minutes.

title: Green Grape Salad
instructions: Slice bananas. Mix green grapes. Add salty peanuts and mix with salad dressing. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Butter dish and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: French Garlic-Herb Cheese Spread
instructions: Blend the first 3 ingredients. Mix in seasonings. Chill for 3 hours or overnight. Serve with bite-size raw vegetables or crackers.

title: Microwave Cherry Crunch
instructions: Pour pie filling in oblong Pyrex baking dish. Sprinkle cake mix over pie filling. Pat mix into cherries. Sprinkle brown sugar and a little cinnamon over that. Dot with margarine and sprinkle nuts on top. Cover with wax paper and microwave on High for 14 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread bean dip over large plate. Combine mayonnaise sour cream and taco mix. Spread over bean dip. Layer next 4 ingredients as listed. Let chill for at least 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Smoked Turkey
instructions: Working from the front lift the skin from the turkey breast and slide 2 strips of bacon beneath it on each side. Secure the loosened skin with toothpicks. Place the onion and apple inside the body cavity. Cook about 4 hours in a smoker using damp hickory apple pecan or cherry wood to provide smoke and flavor. Check for doneness every 30 minutes beginning at 2 1/2 hours by pricking deeply with a cooking fork. When juice running from the hole is clear not pink the bird should be done. (Depending on the birds size and the smokers temperature cooking time will vary considerably.) Keep the fire low and smoky so the turkey cooks and throughout without drying too much on the outside. A small pan of water placed inside the smoker helps keep the bird moist.

title: Vegetable Sauce
instructions: Put first 8 ingredients in a large pot and stir. Let sit on stove 3 minutes. Add celery (sliced) then add last ingredients. (You need not add anchovies.)

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes in jackets. Skin sweet potatoes. Mash the potatoes. Add butter and sugar. Mix well. Add eggs one at a time. Mix. Add spices flavoring and milk. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm about 1 hour.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: In a large bowl combine potatoes sour cream cream cheese chives and garlic powder. Turn into greased 2-quart casserole. Combine bread crumbs with butter; sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Top with cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Honey Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and honey. Add egg; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add raisins and nuts. Mix well and add to first mixture along with water to form soft dough. Drop from spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Easy Cheesecake
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients and beat until fine then pour into 3 pie crusts. Add fruit topping to each pie. Chill for 3 hours.

title: Ripe Tomato Jam
instructions: Boil tomatoes with sugar for 10 minutes. Add lemon and gelatin. Boil 10 minutes longer. Seal in sterilized jars.

title: Beef Enchiladas
instructions: Cook beef and drain well soften tortillas fill with beef cheese and onion. Roll and place in baking dish. After all are placed in dish pour over the enchilada sauce. Sprinkle remaining onion and lots of cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes or until are very hot and cheese is melted.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening eggs and sugar until well blended. Add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk. Blend in the blueberries. Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Can'T Believe It Dessert
instructions: Pour pie mix in ungreased 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Sift dry cake mix over top of pie mix. Sprinkle 1/2 cup melted butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Carob-Date Syrup
instructions: Blend until smooth. Pour into container and add 1 cup of water. (Use this to rinse out the blender.) Stir well. Use 5 tablespoons syrup to one cup water to make a delicious hot or cold drink. Mix 1/2 cup rice milk with 1/2 cup water and add 4 tablespoons carob syrup. Blend until smooth. Also may use as a hot syrup. Delicious on bananas with chopped nuts sprinkled on top.

title: Hot Sausage Appetizers
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Skillet Cooker (Date)
instructions: Cook in iron skillet.

title: Meat And Rice
instructions: Cook meat and onion until almost done. Add soups rice and salt to taste. Put in baking dish and cook 20 minutes uncovered. Put lid on and cook 20 minutes longer in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Arrange in greased casserole. Place chicken on broccoli. Combine mayonnaise soup lemon juice and curry. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Microwave Peanut Patties
instructions: Combine sugar water salt and syrup in a 2-quart glass measuring bowl. Bring to a boil in microwave (approximately 5 minutes). Stir and add peanuts. Return to microwave and cook approximately 7 to 8 minutes or to soft ball stage (234\u00b0) is reached. Remove; add butter vanilla and food coloring. Cool and beat until creamy.\tDrop in buttered muffin cups.

title: No Crust Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 or 25 minutes. Makes 1 large or 2 small pies.

title: English Toffee
instructions: Melt butter over low heat. Add sugar. Turn burner up to medium-high. Stir constantly. Will go through several (3 to 4) consistency changes until light brown and smooth. Pour onto cookie sheet and spread out. Rub and place squares of chocolate to melt. Sprinkle with nuts. Let stand in cool room until chocolate settles. Break into pieces and serve. Great holiday candy!

title: Boot Scootin' Spinach
instructions: Precook spinach as directed on package. Drain; then add butter. Add half and half and salsa. Cook until bubbling hot in a large frying pan. Add half and half as needed for consistency. Add crumbled Feta cheese. Let cook down to desired consistency (not too soupy). You may add a touch of garlic if desired.

title: No Bake Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and 1 1/2 sticks margarine; press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat 20 minutes by hand (or 10 minutes with mixer) the confectioners sugar 2 sticks margarine eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Spread over graham cracker crust. Add crushed pineapple and sliced bananas over pineapple. Top with whipped topping; decorate with nuts cherries or strawberries.

title: Chicken Almond Casserole
instructions: Broil the breasts until almost done and remove skin (about 10 minutes). Put in a casserole dish. Mix soup lemon juice mayonnaise and onions; pour over breasts. Garnish with crushed potato chips and almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly. Serve over rice.

title: Oriental Chicken And Noodles
instructions: In small bowl dissolve reserved seasoning packets from noodles in the warm water. Add soy sauce and cornstarch; stir until smooth. Set aside. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain off most of the liquid; set aside. In 10 inch skillet or wok over medium-high heat in 1 T. hot oil stir fry chicken until browned. Add vegetables and garlic and cool until vegetables are tender-crisp. Add reserved cornstarch mixture. Cook until mixture boils and thickens stirring constantly. Add desired amount of cashews just before removing from heat. Serve over noodles. May use additional soy sauce over top if desired.

title: Ladyfingers
instructions: Cream the butter with mixer. Add other ingredients and blend well. Pinch out narrow strips of dough about 3 inches long for each and place on ungreased baking sheet 1/4 inch apart. Bake 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. May not appear brown when ready. While warm roll in extra confectioners sugar to coat entirely.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown meat. Add celery onion bean sprouts mushrooms soy sauce and water. Bring to a boil then simmer about 3 hours. Before serving thicken with cornstarch and water. Serve over Minute rice or noodles.

title: Granny Dean'S Famous Fudge
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan. Mix well. Gradually add milk while stirring being sure to keep mixture smooth. Bring to a bubbly boil on medium heat stirring constantly. Stir bottom of pot as well to avoid sticking. Bring to a full rolling boil for several minutes until mixture reaches \soft ball\ stage. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Dont stir. Cool at room temperature until it loses its gloss. Beat with rotary beaters for about 5 minutes until thickening begins. Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch flat pan. Cool in fridge (or on the porch in the winter). Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Oranges In Liqueur
instructions: Boil the zest from one orange (zest is the peel without the bitter white portion) for 5 minutes. Drain and dry. Melt butter. Add sugar and liqueur. When sugar is dissolved add the orange zest and the juice. Simmer until medium thickness. Peel and slice remaining oranges 1/3-inch thick. Place overlapped oranges on a serving platter. Sprinkle walnuts over top. Pour sauce over the orange slices and serve.

title: Island Style Chicken
instructions: Drain pineapple chunks reserving syrup. In skillet brown chicken in shortening. Pour off fat. Add reserved syrup broth vinegar sugar soy sauce and garlic. Cover. Cook over low heat 40 minutes. Add green pepper and pineapple chunks. Cook 5 minutes more or until done. Stir occasionally. Combine cornstarch and water. Gradually stir into sauce. Cook stirring until thickened. Serve over cooked parsleyed rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Red Cabbage And Kidney Beans
instructions: In a large skillet cook onion in butter 3 or 4 minutes. Add shredded cabbage. Sprinkle with brown sugar salt and pepper. Add wine and vinegar. Add beans; cover and cook slowly 30 or 40 minutes. Add more wine or water if needed. Serve with pork chops.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Marinate meat in mixture. Saute green peppers (3 to 5 minutes). Stir in meat and cook over medium high heat for approximately 5 minutes. Stir in tomatoes. Simmer for approximately 3 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese in evaporated milk and soup. Brown ground beef. Add onion garlic salt and green chilies. Cook until onion is tender. Fry tortillas until soft. Layer ingredients in a greased 2-quart casserole dish starting with tortillas then meat mixture. Repeat. Pour cheese sauce over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lite Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Combine the first 8 ingredients. Boil for 1 minute stirring. Add broccoli and next 3 ingredients. Cook until cheese melts and well heated. Garnish bowls of soup with 1/2 teaspoon shredded cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake layer cake according to directions making 2 layers. Let cool. Prepare vanilla instant pudding mix according to directions using cold milk. Crumble one layer of the cake in the bottom of a large punch bowl or trifle bowl. Spread with 1/2 can pineapple evenly over cake. Next spread 1/2 pudding evenly over pineapple. Next spread 1/2 strawberries over pudding. Next sprinkle 1/2 chopped nuts over the strawberries. Next spread 1/2 coconut over the nuts. Add one container of Cool Whip.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Measure and sift together flour soda and salt. Cream margarine/butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Stir in mashed bananas. Fold in dry ingredients and nuts. Place in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or 8-inch square cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Tess' Salad
instructions: At least one hour ahead peel and section the oranges. Using a serrated knife cut off the polar ends of the peel then slice the peel off the sides. If the orange is a \ready to eat\ naval type it will section easily by hand. If not use that same serrated knife to cut sections by going in one side of the membrane and out the other releasing each orange section and leaving behind its lining. Squeeze all excess juice from the remaining membrane into the bowl of orange tidbits. Discard the membrane. Pick out seeds if necessary. Drizzle honey and sprinkle cinnamon over the oranges-au-jus. When you are done drizzling and sprinkling cover the bowl and let it stand at room temperature at least one hour.

title: Coffee Sponge Cake
instructions: Dissolve coffee in 1 cup boiling water. Separate the eggs. Beat yolks. Add 1 1/2 cups sugar. To this add alternately the dry ingredients and coffee. Beat whites until stiff. Add cream of tartar. Fold into batter the vanilla. Bake in ungreased pan (angel food is best) at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Family Favorite Chip Dip
instructions: Have cheeses at room temperature.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Roll in balls and dip in sugar. Flatten slightly with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Old-Fashion Chocolate Pie
instructions: Put sugar in boiler. Separate egg whites and yolks. Put yolks in sugar. Put in 1/4 cup of water and mix. Add flour cocoa and milk. Cook until thick. Take off heat and add butter and vanilla. Pour in baked pie shell.

title: Italian Green Beans
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon olive oil and diced tomatoes. Bring to boil. Add beans salt pepper and oregano. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Remove cover and continue to cook over low heat until excess moisture has evaporated and beans are tender.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook onions and peppers until brown in skillet. Add meat and brown (drain grease). Add salt and black pepper to taste. In long baking dish chop cabbage. When meat mixture is brown add rice. Stir well. Pour meat mixture evenly over cabbage. Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Top with cheese and let melt before serving.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Thaw frozen okra and season with salt and pepper. Coat okra with meal. Drop into hot oil. Cook until tender and brown.

title: Apple-Noodle Bake
instructions: Mix apples sugar cinnamon and nutmeg together in a large bowl. In a second bowl mix the cheese eggs sugar honey and vanilla. Fold the noodles into the cheese mixture and put half of it in a buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Spread the apple mixture on top and cover with the rest of the cheese mixture. Dot with a tablespoon of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: 1930 Yeast Doughnuts
instructions: Heat milk slightly and dissolve yeast. Add 1 1/4 cups flour and beat until smooth. Cover and let rise in warm place until it doubles about 2 hours. Cream Crisco salt and sugar together. Add egg and blend. Stir this mixture into yeast sponge. Add remaining flour and mix thoroughly. Rub top with Crisco and let rise again until almost double. Roll 1/4-inch thick and cut with floured doughnut cutter. Allow to rise about 45 minutes. Then fry in deep kettle with Crisco heated until an inch cube of bread browns (about 60 seconds). Fry doughnuts 2 to 3 minutes until brown. Drain and glaze with confectioners sugar and hot water combined until it becomes a thin frosting. When you make these wonderful doughnuts you will have a smile on your lips and a smile in your stomach.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 1 hour covered at 350\u00b0. Check to see if rice is cooked.

title: Chocolate Covered Pecan Caramels
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy saucepan. Add brown sugar condensed milk and corn syrup then blend well. Cook over medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes or to 248\u00b0 on candy thermometer (firm ball stage) while stirring with wooden spoon. Remove from heat. Add pecans and vanilla. Stir and pour into buttered foil lined 8 x 8-inch pan. Let stand until firm. Lift foil from pan; cut into 3/4-inch squares with buttered knife. In double boiler melt chocolate chips and paraffin over boiling water. Dip squares one at a time into chocolate mixture and place on waxed paper. Let stand until cool then wrap in plastic wrap. Store in refrigerator or freezer. Yields 100 pieces.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Marinade chicken overnight. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Can be used on a whole cut up chicken.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs until creamy. Sift dry ingredients together. Add small amounts of dry mixture to creamy mixture. Beat until smooth. Add vanilla. Fold in apples and pecans. (Do not use mixer.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour in greased and floured pan.

title: Front Porch Lemonade
instructions: Combine sugar and boiling water stirring until sugar dissolves. Add lemon juice and cold water. Mix well. Chill and serve over ice. Garnish if desired. Yields 7 1/4 cup.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Boil the raisins in the water for 5 minutes. Drain good. Mix together the sugar cornstarch and cinnamon. Add the half and half egg yolks and raisins. Boil until thick. Keep stirring. Put in baked pie shell.

title: Pumpkin Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a 3-quart container melt margarine and saute onion. Add chicken broth and heat to boiling. Add potatoes beans corn carrots celery and peas; cover and cook until tender. Mix together pumpkin salt nutmeg and white pepper. Heat until boiling; reduce to low heat and cook 15 minutes. (Mix this pumpkin mixture with the vegetable mixture then heat as directed.) Stir in cream.

title: Barbecue Turkey
instructions: Use pressure cooker for ingredients and cook 20 to 25 minutes. Cut turkey in half and brown each side on grill for 30 to 45 minutes. Place turkey in broiler pan and pour sauce over turkey. Cover and cook on grill for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion and drain. Cook macaroni in water and drain. Prepare spaghetti sauce mix according to instructions on back with hamburger and onion. Mix in Cheddar cheese and macaroni. Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and baked at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Homemade Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Cover hamburger in cold water with onion. Cook until done. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until thick.

title: Pa'S Chicken Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole. Place chicken in margarine. Spread Veg-All over chicken. Mix chicken broth and cream of chicken soup and pour over mixture then mix milk and Bisquick together (batter will be thin). Pour on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Ooey Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix margarine and 4 eggs. Turn into very large (10 x 16 1/2 x 2-inch) greased pan. Mix together sugar cream cheese and 2 eggs; beat well. Pour over cake batter. Sprinkle with black walnuts. Bake 45 to 55 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Looks ugly but tastes great!
