title: Mam-Maw'S Old Fashioned Sauerkraut
instructions: You will need churn or large glass jar.

title: Mexican Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half length wise. Remove yolk-place in bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Fill eggs and enjoy.

title: Spicy Sausage Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown and drain sausage and hamburger. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on high until cheese melts. Stir frequently. Reduce heat and serve from crock-pot with corn chips or tortilla chips.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well. Bake in ungreased loaf pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Slice baked cake through middle and break into small pieces. Put one half in large bowl or pan. Spread 1/2 chocolate pudding over cake. Add 1/2 chocolate bar pieces and 1/2 Cool Whip. Repeat layers. An additional candy bar may be used to decorate top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Fruit Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sifted sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla milk and preserves. Sift flour and soda together and add to butter mixture. Have all fruits and nuts cut up into small pieces. Roll in extra flour; shake off as much flour as possible. Add to batter. Mix with hands until all fruits are well covered. Drop on greased pan. Bake in slow 350\u00b0 oven for about 18 minutes.

title: Tuna Pasta Bake
instructions: In small saucepan over medium-high heat heat oil. Add onion and garlic and cook stirring occasionally about 3 minutes. Add tomato sauce and oregano; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer stirring occasionally about 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Bread
instructions: Heat and melt shortening. Add sugar salt and milk. Cool. Add yeast that has been dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water to cooled mixture. Add flour and beaten eggs alternately beating well after each addition. Place dough in greased bowl to rise until doubled. Cover with cloth. When rising is complete punch down and put dough in 4 greased loaf pans. Let rise then bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Takes about 35-40 minutes. Butter crust when done.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Place water sugar and yeast in small bowl and set aside. Add all the rest in a large bowl then add items in small bowl. Mix all together and set in fridge for 15 to 20 minutes. Bake what you want now and leave rest in fridge; will stay good for a week. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine and mix well all ingredients. Press firmly into ungreased loaf pan (2 if needed). Bake at 375\u00b0 about 1 hour. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Core and quarter unpeeled apples; cook in large heavy saucepan until soft about 30 minutes. Press through food mill.

title: Wild Rice Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Heat milk to lukewarm; add honey. Stir to dissolve. Add to ingredients. Stir in dry milk and oil. Stir in flour and cooked rice. Pour dough onto floured surface; knead in flour (dough is slightly sticky because of rice). Place in greased bowl. Cover. Let rise in warm place until double. Turn out on lightly floured surface. Knead well. Place in 2 loaf pans. Let rise until double. Turn out on lightly floured surface. Knead well. Place in 2 loaf pans. Let rise until double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until lightly brown. Brush with butter while still warm. This dough does not raise very fast.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In large pot combine onion garlic and olive oil. Saute but dont brown. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 3 hours. Add meatballs the last hour. Serve with freshly grated Italian cheese.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix broccoli mushroom soup Miracle Whip or mayo egg onion and sharp or Cheddar cheese together and put in buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Melt oleo and toss in Pepperidge Farm stuffing. Place stuffing on casserole. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Spareribs
instructions: Place ribs on a rack in large shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile combine sugars and cornstarch in medium saucepan. Stir in catsup vinegar and water; bring to boil. Cook and stir until thickened and clear. Remove ribs and rack from pan; discard fat. Place ribs back in roasting pan. Pour about 1 1/2 cups of the sauce over ribs. Bake 30 minutes longer. Cut ribs into serving size pieces. Brush with remaining sauce. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Italian Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes eggs and onion. Fry bacon and crumble. Mix altogether using equal amounts of sour cream and creamy Italian dressing. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Peanut Butter Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together margarine sugars and peanut butter. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour baking powder salt and soda. Add to mixture; beat well. Add milk and vanilla. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool. Frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Chuck Wagon Chili Soup
instructions: Saute beef in a 5-quart pot over medium heat 4 minutes or until brown. Discard fat. Saute onions and garlic in pot 4 minutes or until soft. Stir in chili powder and cumin then squash broth and 1 extra cup water. Cover and gently boil 15 minutes until squash is almost tender. Add tomatoes and beans; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes to develop flavors. Serve with shredded Cheddar cheese and sliced scallions.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: First Layer Crush cookies; save out about 3/4 cup to sprinkle on top layer. Melt margarine; add to cookies then press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Creole Green Beans
instructions: Cook green beans in salted water until tender. Reserve liquid.

title: Shirley Cumming'S Cabbage Soup
instructions: Saute garlic bacon and cut up cabbage strips in olive oil for 2 minutes in frying pan. Then add chicken broth and pepper; simmer for 15 minutes. Add noodles and simmer for 15 more minutes. Serve with corn bread or muffins.

title: Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: In mixer cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg yolks flour salt milk and lemon juice. In bowl beat egg whites until fluffy then add to mixture. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 then 45 minutes at 300\u00b0 until lightly golden.

title: Pressed Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix Pet milk and marshmallows together and melt stirring constantly. Add nuts fruit and crumbs. Mix well and press in pan or dish and store in refrigerator.

title: Never Fail Meringue
instructions: Combine 2 teaspoons sugar and 1 tablespoon cornstarch in saucepan. Add 1/2 cup water. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and clear. Cool. Beat egg whites with salt and vanilla until soft peaks form. Add 4 tablespoons sugar after adding cornstarch mixture. Beat until it stands in stiff peaks. Spread on pie. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Uncooked Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate and then add butter milk and vanilla. Add confectioners sugar and nuts or coconut. Mix well and pour into a buttered square pan.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Boil and debone chicken to bite-size pieces. Set aside. Prepare rice as directed. Set aside. Saute onion in butter or margarine until soft; blend in flour soup and milk and add mushrooms.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Combine chips butter and peanut butter. Melt in large saucepan stirring until all ingredients are melted. Take pan off stove and add cereal. Mix until all cereal is coated with chocolate mixture. Put 1 cup of powdered sugar in brown paper bag. Add cereal and shake until mixture is powdered with the sugar.

title: Microwave Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape into loaf or ring mold. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at Medium for 15 to 16 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Blend eggs milk onion and peppers in a blender. Add to dry ingredients. Fry in deep fat. They will turn over by themselves when 1 side is done.

title: Tuna Hot Snack
instructions: Flake tuna and add salad dressing mustard Worcestershire sauce and horseradish. Fill croustades or shells; top with grated Parmesan cheese. Bake in moderate oven until brown. Serves 6.

title: Turkey Cabbage Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together make into 6 patties and fry until done. Can also be microwaved power High for 5 minutes. Rearrange patties and cook 5 more minutes at power 7 or until done.

title: Cherry Pie Supreme
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Gradually add cherry juice stirring until thick and clear. Add butter and extract. Cool. Line 9 inch pie plate with pastry. Add cherries to cool cornstarch mixture. Pour into pastry lined pie plate. Top with crust. Crimp edges high. Fold strip of aluminum foil around edge of pie. Bake in oven (425\u00b0) about 40 minutes. Remove foil 10 minutes before end of baking. I roll the crust between 2 sheets of wax paper. I fold it and put it in the pan on the top crust I spread canned milk on top crust then cut holes and put bits of oleo in the holes. Then sprinkle sugar on top of crust.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar for 20 minutes. Put in 1 egg at a time beating after each egg. Add 7-Up. Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan and bake 1 1/4 hours at 325\u00b0. God bless!

title: J.D.'S Party Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Melt butter in a large oven pan. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
instructions: Combine in double boiler the oil chocolate and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and flour. Chill. Drop into sugar and shape. Bake on wax paper in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Honey Bars
instructions: Mix honey and eggs together. Add baking powder and flour sifted together then add chopped nuts dates and flavoring. Bake at 350\u00b0 on cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes. Mixture should be 1/4 inch deep. Cut in strips (1/2 x 3-inch). Roll in powdered sugar before serving. Yields 60 to 72.

title: 5 Cup Salad(Very Good)
instructions: Mix together and serve. Drain fruit. This is very good. I used a whole can (large) or crushed drained pineapple and small can of mandarin oranges. My grandchildren loved it.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Brush top with melted butter.

title: 3 Soup Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Place mixture in a casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Cook at 375 until cheese in melted well.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms(First Course For Two)
instructions: *Use light variety bread.

title: Taffy Apple Pizza
instructions: Spread and flatten 1 package of refrigerated peanut butter cookie dough in a pizza pan. Bake according to directions. If it bakes over the edge of the pan trim some away. Cook completely.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add Miracle Whip and mix. Add milk all at once and stir. Turn out on floured board and knead 5 or 6 times. Roll to 1/2 or 3/4-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Saute beef and onions in margarine in large saucepan until meat is browned. Add tomatoes water celery bouillon cubes bay leaf Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add mixed vegetables noodles and thyme. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Jellied Pineapple Salad
instructions: Marinate marshmallows in pineapple with juice. Add whipped cream and cheese. Moisten gelatine in cold water and dissolve in 1/4 cup hot water. Add to mixture then add pecans. Pour into mold. Sprinkle some grated cheese on top and chill overnight.

title: Old Fashioned Spice Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Soften butter in a bowl. Add spices and salt. Mix well. Add sugar. Mix well. Beat 5 of the eggs one at a time. Stir in flour and the last remaining egg. Grease only the bottom of a 9-inch tube cake pan and flour lightly. Place in a cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until well done. Cool at least 20 minutes before turning out.

title: Smoked Sausage Oriental
instructions: Saute green pepper onion and sausage in butter for 5 minutes. Combine cornstarch ginger vinegar soy sauce and preserves. Stir into sausage mixture. Cook over low heat until sauce thickens. Mix in pineapple chunks and heat. Serve over chow mein noodles or rice.

title: Papa Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder cocoa and salt. Beat Crisco and sugar good. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add milk and dry ingredients alternately and beat well after each addition. Add vanilla. Bake in tube cake pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 or 1 1/2 hours.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Let stand 5 minutes. Add the rest; mix until flour is dampened. Fill oiled cans a little more than half full. Place in cold oven. Bake at 325\u00b0. Bake about 40 minutes. Let set a little before you loosen them. Run a serrated knife around the sides and they will slowly slide out. Makes 7 cans. Tastes better the longer it sets. Can use more nuts prunes and raisins.

title: Chinese Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large casserole dish; mix well. Bake uncovered for 40 to 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet And Sassy Sauce
instructions: In a medium-size saucepan melt butter or margarine and saute onions. Combine all the other ingredients and let it simmer until your ribs are ready.

title: Potato Wedges
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges; cook until tender. Drain. Layer baking dish with potato wedges slice butter and place on top of potatoes. Add salt pepper and garlic salt (may use seasoned salt as well). Place in oven on broil until golden brown.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Mix onion Ro-Tel tomatoes green chilies and soup in blender. Brown ground beef and drain. Break 6 tortillas in pieces and spread in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Put half of the ground beef half of the sauce and half of the cheese over the tortillas. Place other 6 tortillas on top of the cheese (do not break up these tortillas). Put rest of meat sauce and cheese over the tortillas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Golden Glow Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add pineapple juice lemon juice crushed pineapple grated carrots and celery. Pour into molds and chill until firm.

title: Bleu Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Make into 1-inch meat balls. Cut bacon slices in half and wrap each slice around meat ball. Hold together with toothpick. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bacon is crisp. Remove toothpick and serve hot.

title: Woodchuck Patties
instructions: Remove all fat from the meat and grind with a meat grinder. Mix the ground meat with bread crumbs egg parsley green onions green pepper garlic powder and basil. Salt and pepper to taste and shape into patties.

title: Seven Seas Casserole
instructions: Mix water with soup onion salt lemon juice and dash of pepper in saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring occasionally. Pour about 1/2 of soup mixture into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole then in layers add rice (right from box) partially thawed frozen peas and tuna. Add rest of soup. Sprinkle with cheese and dash of paprika. Cover and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. After 10 minutes cut through with knife.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Soften oleo and gradually add powdered sugar then the frozen thawed strawberries. Be careful not to add too much berries; it may not take the full 1/2 cup. Blend and spread between layers sides and top of cake.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Mix sugar water and cherry juice together. Bring to a boil. Add Jell-O and mashed cherries. Let stand 5 minutes; add pineapple and nuts then Coke last. Chill and serve.

title: German Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes slice or cut into 1/2-inch pieces and boil in salted water just until tender. (Be careful not to overcook or the potatoes will become mush.) Meanwhile cut bacon into small pieces. Cut onion into small pieces or green onions into thin slices. Mix together vinegar water sugar pepper and salt. Fry bacon in skillet until crisp then scoop bacon out of skillet into vinegar mixture leaving drippings in skillet. Saute onion in drippings. Add flour to onion in skillet and stir until smooth and thickened. Drain potatoes (when tender) and pour into skillet. Add bacon/vinegar mixture and stir gently to mix evenly.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In heavy saucepan mix all ingredients except pecans. Stir thoroughly and cook to 238\u00b0. Stir often. Cool to 170\u00b0 and add pecans. Stir until thick. Pour onto a buttered platter and cut into squares.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; mix in celery and onion. Arrange fish fillets on top. Cover and simmer until fish is done about 20 minutes for frozen fish 10 minutes for fresh. Break up the fish with a spoon into bite size chunks. Add remaining ingredients and simmer gently for 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Red Potatoes
instructions: Slice garlic cloves. Mix with olive oil. Set aside for at least 4 hours. Wash potatoes. Cut into quarters. Place into microwavesafe covered dish. Add water. Cook 10 to 15 minutes on High in microwave or until tender. Drain water. Place on grill; brush with olive oil mix. Turn occasionally until slightly crisp. Serve immediately.

title: Skillet Herbed Chicken
instructions: Loosen skin of chicken with fingers working from breast side. Cut off wing tips. Blend butter with lemon peels salt and herbs. Spread on the meat under the skin and skewer wing to breast. Heat a 9-inch skillet over moderate heat and place chicken skin side down in the dry pan. Cover and cook over medium heat 25 minutes or until chicken is nicely browned and tender.

title: Carrot Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine bran flakes milk and carrots; let stand 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients stirring until particles are moistened. Line each muffin tin with two paper liners; fill half full. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Put cranberries and oranges including rind through grinder. Add celery nuts and sugar. Make Jell-O using only 1 1/2 cups water. Add other ingredients. Place in refrigerator until thick. Serve with whip cream.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Crush Oreos in food processor. Beat together cream cheese and margarine. Mix pudding and milk. Blend the two mixtures. Add Cool Whip. Layer cookies and pudding mixture in a bowl. (For childrens parties fill clear plastic cups and garnish with gummy worms.) Refrigerate for one hour.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Slowly cook meat onion celery and bell pepper until celery and onion are tender. Add uncooked rice and tomatoes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Heat until thickened. Add to beaten egg yolks. Bring to a boil. Thicken and remove from heat and add vanilla flavoring. Pour this over banana and vanilla wafers which have been layered. Top with meringue and brown lightly.

title: Beef Brisket Pot Roast
instructions: Heat large heavy pot. Add meat. Brown on all sides without oil. Pour off any fat. Sprinkle onion around meat. Cover tightly. Cook over low heat for 1 hour. Remove from heat. Keep covered and let meat cool to lukewarm. When cool slice across grain for serving. Return meat to pot. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 1 to 2 hours longer or until tender turning slices once.

title: Sweet Pickle Recipe
instructions: Put cucumbers in stone\tjar or glass. Pour over them 1 gallon boiling water with\t1 teacup salt dissolved. Let stand 8 days. On the 8th\tday drain off water and wash good. Then pour\tover gallon boiling water and let stand 24 hours. Ninth day pour over a gallon boiling water with 1 tablespoon powdered alum; let stand 24 hours. Tenth day drain and pour over 1 gallon boiling water and let stand 24 hours. Eleventh day drain and pour over boiling syrup.

title: Cranberry Bars
instructions: Combine flour oats brown sugar lemon rind and soda in mixer bowl; mix well. Stir in margarine. Reserve 1 cup flour mixture. Press remaining flour mixture into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Spread cranberry sauce over baked layer. Sprinkle with mixture of reserved flour mixture and pecans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes longer or until golden brown. Cool. Cut into bars. May be frozen up to 12 months.

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into 1/4-inch strips cutting across the grain. Heat oil and add chicken until they go white (about 3 minutes). Add green pepper onion celery water chestnuts broth salt and ginger. Cover and cook about 6 minutes. Mix soy sauce with cornstarch. Add to skillet with bean sprouts. Turn heat down and simmer few minutes. Serve over hot rice. Serves 4.

title: Mandarin Dessert
instructions: Drain oranges; save juice. Add enough water to make 1 cup. Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add sherbet and stir until melted. Chill until thickened. Then add orange sections and chill until you are ready to serve about 2 hours.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Wash and drain beans; cover with water. Add salt; soak overnight. In morning drain beans and add 2 quarts water and ham hock with ham shreds. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 3 hours. Cut ham off bone; return meat to pot. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes more. Enjoy!!

title: Pig Eat'In Cake
instructions: Put cake mix\teggs oil and oranges in bowl and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chocolate Town Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugars and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour to mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Mix together and drop by rounded spoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Sausage-Bean Stuffing Supreme
instructions: Combine 4 cups water beans and chicken bouillon cubes. Bring to boiling and boil gently for 2 minutes. Remove from heat; cover and let stand for 1 hour. Add sausage tomato onion celery parsley garlic thyme bay leaf and salt. Return to boiling. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Stir in wine. Boil gently uncovered for 30 minutes more or until liquid is absorbed. Makes 4 cups stuffing enough for a 5 to 6 pound duckling.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine oil and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and sour milk; beat well. Stir in zucchini. Add dry ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured pan 9 x 13-inch size. Sprinkle with chocolate chips on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Rolls
instructions: Add sugar and shortening to boiling water. Cool in mixing bowl. Add yeast that has been mixed with lukewarm water. Add cold water eggs and salt. Add flour 2 cups at a time. Place dough in bowl and rub with vegetable oil. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cheese Cut Outs
instructions: Mix butter and cheese then add soup mix and flour. Blend and shape into ball and chill. Roll out on floured board. Cut into desired shapes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen. (If difficult to roll out add more flour.)

title: Cheer-Up Chicken Soup
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan combine water and broth; bring to a boil. Meanwhile cut chicken into 1/2-inch chunks. Add to liquid with carrots celery and potatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add mushrooms onions and thyme. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Add salt and pepper. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cucumber Mousse
instructions: Peel and coarsely grate cucumbers. Wrap in a paper towel and squeeze gently to completely remove juice. Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Add cold water and vinegar. Fold in sour cream and chill mixture until thickened. Fold in cucumbers onion and pepper. Pour into greased mold and chill until firm. Serves 6.

title: One Pan Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease loaf pans. Stir ingredients in pan until moist. Beat 1 minute. Bake 55 to 65 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before cutting. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Black Forest Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Bake batter in 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Remove cake layers from pans and cool on rack. Place 1 cooled layer on serving plate. Spread half can of cherries on first layer. Top with second layer. Combine sugar vanilla orange rind and cream. Whip cream mixture until cream holds its shape. Spread on second layer and sides. Spread half of cherries on top of whipped cream. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together in order listed. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until center is firm.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt butter peanut butter and chocolate chips in large pan over low heat. After completely melted pour box of cereal into pan and coat each piece. Be careful not to break up cereal. After coated pour box of powdered sugar into trash bag then pour cereal over it and shake bag until cereal is coated.

title: Molded Shrimp Loaf
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Bring tomato soup to a boil in saucepan. Add gelatin and allow to cool. When cool add cream cheese. Stir in all other ingredients. Pour into an oiled 9 x 5-inch loaf pan; cover and chill for 2 to 4 hours or until set. To serve unmold on large platter. Garnish with lettuce and lemon and lime slices.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix the lemonade and Eagle Brand milk. Fold in the whipped cream. Put in graham cracker crust. Cool in refrigerator for 3 hours.

title: Apple Crisp Pie
instructions: Place apples in pie shell then sprinkle with the sugar. Mix together the flour oleo nutmeg and brown sugar and sprinkle over the top of the apples. Bake at about 375\u00b0 until apples are tender.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve 1 package lime jello with 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Blend cream cheese to jello. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Pour milk over crackers. When soft add to mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 2 layers at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Put together with whipped cream or topping.

title: Chocolate Snack Cake(Without Eggs)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix first 5 ingredients (dry) in bowl with fork; stir in rest. Pour into ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Cake can be mixed in pan. Recipe can be doubled and made in 13 x 9-inch pan but should be mixed with mixer.

title: Wine Cake
instructions: Mix and beat ingredients 5 minutes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes in well-greased Bundt pan. Can be made 2 days in advance. Frost or glaze as preferred.

title: Honey Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar then eggs. Add honey sour milk and vanilla. Beat well and add dry ingredients. Chill and form into balls. Roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Mushrooms A La Grecque
instructions: Place tomatoes in a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole and add wine. Cook over low heat 20 to 25 minutes. Strain and discard liquid. Add the mushrooms (wash them first!) pepper bay leaf and olive oil to tomato pulp. Cook 30 minutes over low heat. Correct seasoning with salt and pepper. Serve cold. Serves 4.

title: Pronto Pups
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add egg and milk and beat until smooth. Dip franks in batter and fry until brown. Drain on paper towels. If batter is too thick add some more milk.

title: Cranberry Cooler
instructions: Dissolve raspberry sherbet in cranberry juice until slushy. Add the 7-Up. Serves about 30.

title: Creative Noodle Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook entire package of noodles. Let sit in water for 1 hour or overnight. Separate eggs. Beat egg yolks sugar and vanilla until thick and lemon colored. Beat egg whites until stiff. Mix yolk mixture with drained noodles. Add any optional ingredients.

title: Sherrie Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 30 minutes. Drain water. Mix together cheese egg soup mayonnaise and mushrooms. Pour over cooked broccoli and stir well. Cover with cracker crumbs and drizzle butter on top.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Mix all ingredients except mushrooms and sour cream. Bake at 350\u00b0 until meat is tender. Add mushrooms and juice before serving. Add sour cream. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Chocolate Fudge Deluxe
instructions: In a 3 1/2-quart saucepan mix sugar with dry gelatin. Add milk corn syrup chocolate and butter. Cook over medium heat stirring frequently to 238\u00b0 on thermometer. Remove from heat; pour into a large mixing bowl. Stir in vanilla. Cool about 25 minutes or to 110\u00b0. Beat with wooden spoon until candy thickens. Stir in walnuts. Spread into prepared pan. Let cool. Cut in squares. Makes about 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak and discard. Press peppercorns into both sides of steak with heel of hand. Melt butter in pan large enough to hold steak. When butter is sizzling brown steak on one side turn and brown second side. Reduce heat and finish cooking steak. (To test make a small slash with a sharp knife to see if steak is as done as you want it to be.) Season with salt to taste. Obviously makes one serving.

title: Chocolate Carmelita Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine first seven ingredients; mix well. Reserve one cup; press remaining on bottom of prepared pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown; cool 10 minutes. Top with nuts and chocolate pieces.

title: Angel Food Delight
instructions: Mix chocolate pudding mix according to instructions on the box. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish tear up the angel food cake into\tsmall (bite size) pieces. Spoon on pudding mixture and top with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Taco Rice
instructions: Cook and stir chicken in hot oil until lightly browned. Add broth tomato sauce and seasoning mix. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add corn and red pepper. Bring to a full boil. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Serve with cheese sprinkled over it tortilla chips and sour cream if desired.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar soda and salt. Add oil and mix. Add flour and vanilla. Mix all together. Add apples and pecans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake slowly for 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a baking pan. In a bowl beat butter until creamy. Beat in 1/2 cup confectioners sugar and then work in 2 cups flour to make a smooth dough. Press dough in an even layer in the prepared pan. Bake 15 minutes until slightly puffed. Next beat eggs in a bowl with a wire whisk. Beat in granulated sugar lemon peel and juice. Sift remaining 1/4 cup flour over egg mixture and stir in. Prick top of crust with a fork about an inch away from each other all over. Pour egg mixture over crust and bake 30 minutes until egg mixture is set. Remove from oven. Cool and sprinkle top with 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners sugar.

title: Tomato Aspic
instructions: Heat juice and dissolve jello. Add water and cool until slightly thickened. Stir in celery onion and horseradish. Add sliced stuffed olives and shrimp if you like variation. Pour into ring mold or individual molds.

title: Chocolate Drink
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a container with a lid. Shake until dry milk is dissolved. Drink immediately or chill in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring the first 5 ingredients to a boil and add the peanuts. Stir constantly until peanuts are golden brown. Remove from stove and add the soda. Stir until foaming almost stops. Pour on greased sheet pan. Use heavy pan use wooden spoon and make on a clear cool day.

title: Merry Cherry Salad
instructions: Drain fruits and reserve juice. Dissolve gelatin in hot water and add fruit juice. Chill until partially congealed. Blend cream cheese with lemon juice salt and mayonnaise. Fold in whipped cream. Beat chilled gelatin until light and fluffy. Fold into cream cheese mixture and fruits. Pour into chilled buttered pan. Freeze until firm. Remove from freezer. Let warm enough to cut into squares. Serve on lettuce leaf. Garnish with maraschino cherries or coconut.

title: Rice Balls
instructions: Drain rice on cloth. Add eggs salt pepper and parsley. Chill. Fry in deep oil until light brown.

title: Western Style Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add beef; cook until no longer pink. Add remaining ingredients; stir to combine. Cover; reduce heat. Simmer 6 to 8 minutes or until veggies are crisp-tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spicy Oven Fries
instructions: Cut potatoes in quarters lengthwise. Mix with olive oil. Sprinkle with pepper salt garlic powder and cayenne pepper. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Martha Washington Chocolates
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into 1-inch balls. Chill for 30 minutes. Melt chocolate chips with paraffin. Using toothpicks dip chilled balls into chocolate.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Scrub fresh crisp cucumbers. Wash but dont peel. Slice cucumbers crosswise and mix with onions and green peppers. Mix the salt with the vegetables and bury 1-quart cracked ice in mixture. Cover with a heavy lid. Let stand 3 hours. Drain and prepare the following Blend sugar turmeric and cloves together. Add mustard and celery seed and vinegar. If the vinegar is too strong substitute 1 cup of water for 1 cup vinegar. Pour this mixture over the vegetables in a large pan; heat to scalding stirring occasionally but do not boil. Seal in hot sterilized jars. Let stand about 3 to 4 weeks before using.

title: Garden Vegetables With Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions adding broccoli to water last 2 minutes of cooking time; drain well. Add process cheese spread and milk to pasta mixture in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring until process cheese melts. Stir in remaining ingredients. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix the above ingredients except flour; sift in enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll out and cut with a cookie cutter. Bake in a moderate oven until golden brown.

title: Sugar Free Dream Sicle Fluff
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add ice (to make 2 cups). Stir until melted. Let set 5 minutes. Add pudding and oranges and mix with mixer. Add cool whip and mix with mixer. Refrigerate. Tastes great and its quick!

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix all together in a sauce pan. Cook on medium high until it thickens stirring often.

title: Ham 'N' Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Form a ball and chill. Serve on crackers.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Put drained beans and ham hock in large soup kettle. Add water and salt; bring to boil. Cook slowly for 45 minutes; add other ingredients. Cook 2 hours or until beans are tender and liquid thick. Serve over steamed rice. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain off fat. Add the rest of the ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Sift together flour and sugar and add beer. Mix well. Pour into buttered 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Melt 1/2 stick oleo. Pour over top and return to oven for 15 minutes.

title: Molasses Yeast Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over rolled oats molasses shortening and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add yeast eggs and 3 cups flour to oat mixture. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to form a soft dough. Knead until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl and cover. Let rise until double in size about 1 hour. Punch down. Shape into rolls and place in shallow pan. Cover loosely. Rise until doubled in size 30 to 40 minutes. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Brush with melted butter. Makes 3 dozen rolls. Enjoy!

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Cook squash and onion in enough water for simmering (about 1 1/2 cups) until tender. Drain reserving 1 cup liquid. Return 1 cup liquid to squash. Mix all ingredients. Place in 2-quart buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until light golden brown. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Prepare potatoes onions and celery. Place in saucepan add water salt and pepper. Cover and turn to high heat. Bring to rolling boil switch to simmer and cook for 20 minutes. Then add milk and bring almost to a boil again using high heat. While this is heating measure flour into bowl and add egg. Stir with a fork until thoroughly mixed. Stir in egg flour mixture and butter. Switch to simmer for at least 15 minutes.

title: Wagon Wheel Vegetable Platter
instructions: Begin your platter with a bed of lettuce on a round platter. Add thick slices of tomatoes and thin slices of onion around edge of platter. Place pieces of avocado on tomatoes. Make spokes with raw cucumber sticks or celery sticks. Fill center of dish with radish roses and carrot curls.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar real good. Add eggs and flour alternately adding flour first and last. Cut fruit and nuts fine and mix with a little flour. (This keeps all the fruit from going to the bottom of cake.) Add vanilla. Mix nuts and fruit with batter.

title: Strawberry Sherbet
instructions: Rinse drain and hull berries. Add sugar and mash. Stir in buttermilk. Pour into refrigerator trays; freeze 2 to 3 hours. Remove from trays; break into chunks. Beat with electric beater until smooth. Refreeze until firm.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Texas Pie
instructions: Beat the first 7 ingredients together until blended. Stir in coconut and pineapple. Pour into pie crust. Bake for 5 minutes at 425\u00b0. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0; bake for about 1 hour longer.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken With Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Dip chicken breasts in bread crumbs. Place the fillets on microwavable dish and cover with a domed microwavable cover. Cook fillet on High for 4 minutes. Rotate dish 1/4 turn and continue cooking on High for 4 additional minutes. Add 1/8 cup of water to the frozen broccoli in microwavable dish and cover. Microwave broccoli for 3 minutes on High. Separate the broccoli and microwave for 3 additional minutes on High. Divide broccoli and place each portion with a chicken breast. Pour Hollandaise Sauce equally over both portions and serve.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
instructions: Boil potatoes in skins just until tender. Chill in refrigerator. When chilled grate potatoes. Mix sour cream cream cheese milk margarine 3/4 cup grated cheese salt pepper onion and grated potatoes. Put in 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Add flour then cheese (cut up cheese into chunks so it will melt quickly). Then add mushrooms and soup. Cook broccoli according to directions on package. Drain. Add to mixture. Heat the dip well then pour into chafing dish and keep hot. Serve with Fritos.

title: Speedy Little Devils
instructions: Mix melted butter with dry cake mix; set aside 1 1/2 cups. Press rest into 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread mixed Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter on top. Crumble rest of cake mix on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool and cut.

title: Jimmy Dean'S Calico Beans
instructions: Brown sausage hamburger onion and celery. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Cook in crock-pot on high for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Clara'S Nesselrode Pie
instructions: In a small bowl soak the gelatin in the cold water for about 5 minutes. In a separate bowl beat the egg yolks. Add 1/4 cup of sugar and cream.

title: Flying Saucer Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients then add the next 2. Mix and add the next 4 ingredients and stir in the last 4 ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Mix soup mayo milk and lemon juice. Heat and stir. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan broccoli on bottom some sauce cut up chicken remainder of sauce grated cheese bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Andy'S Country Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add chips and melt. Add remaining ingredients. Mix. Pour into two unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Stir well. Bake in greased muffin pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Cut up vegetables; grind in food chopper using coarse blade. Add salt. Cover; refrigerate overnight. Rinse in cold water. Drain well.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut shortening into flour baking powder and salt with pastry blender until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in just enough milk so dough leaves side of bowl and rounds up into a ball. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 10 times. Roll 1/2-inch thick. Cut with floured 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 1 inch apart for crusty sides touching for soft sides. Bake until golden brown 10 to 12 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 1 dozen biscuits.

title: Strawberry-Banana Freeze
instructions: Reserve 4 berries for garnish. Puree other berries and banana in blender. Add jam and milk. Blend. Freeze.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter gradually adding sugar. Beat eggs in creamed mixture one at a time. Combine flour cocoa soda and salt. Add alternately the dry ingredients and sour cream to creamed mixture mixing well after each addition. Add boiling water and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Check after 70 minutes with toothpick ovens may vary. Do not overbake. Cool for 15 minutes.

title: Pink Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix lemonade and ice water. Add pineapple juice and Hawaiian Punch. Stir thoroughly. Add 7-Up. Scoop sherbet into punch bowl. Pour punch over sherbet very slowly. Punch will be very frothy. Serves 100 four ounce servings.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs oil and water. Blend in cake mix and peanut butter. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Mash down with spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour baking powder and salt. Add egg and water and mix. Shape into balls and freeze or roll out and use. Makes about 7 crusts. You may re-roll or re-shape; dough doesnt get tough!

title: Cream Of Carrot Soup With Homemade Croutons
instructions: Melt butter in a pan and saute the onions potatoes and carrots for ten minutes on med low heat. Add stock and sugar and bring slowly to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes. In a food processor puree soup. Return to pan and add half and half. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: *Ground chicken or turkey may be used or 4 chicken breasts which have been boiled deboned and cut up may be used.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook all ingredients thicken to consistency you desire. Top with biscuits.

title: Pimento Cheese Salad Ball
instructions: Mix all until well blended. Roll in nuts and chill.

title: Muddy Buddies
instructions: Melt butter chips and peanut butter in microwave for about 2 minutes. Stir in vanilla until smooth. Pour mixture over cereal. Put powdered sugar in a bag. Shake Chex and sugar until well coated. Spread onto wax paper to dry.

title: Cabbage Rolls Or Pigs In The Blanket
instructions: Cook cabbage 25 to 30 minutes. Peel leaves. Combine hamburger rice onion soup mix onion egg and 1/2 can tomato soup. Roll meat mixture up in cabbage leaves. Secure with toothpicks. Place cabbage rolls in a large pan and cover with remainder of tomato sauce and soup. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni # 1
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on box. Drain and put into crock-pot. Add other ingredients in this order oil milk butter eggs and pepper. Top with the grated cheese and cook for 4 hours on low. Turn off after 4 hours.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. Drain; rinse with cold water. Chop onion cucumbers and tomatoes. Combine ingredients for dressing. Pour over pasta onion and cucumbers. Add tomatoes last. Refrigerate for several hours overnight if possible. Will serve at least 12.

title: Cabbage-Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions. Drain off grease. In mixing bowl combine cabbage carrots salt and pepper. Add ground beef mixture to this and toss to mix well. Pour uncooked rice into a 3-quart casserole. Pour cabbage and ground beef mixture over rice. Pour beef broth and water over mixture. Cover casserole and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cucumber Delight Pickles
instructions: Combine vinegar water sugar and salt. Bring to a boil and set aside to cool. Wash peel and slice cucumbers rather thick. Place onion and garlic in jars. Add cucumbers filling jar to top. Fill jar with vinegar mixture; seal. Refrigerate for 3 days before serving. (Liquid makes about 3 quarts.)

title: Meowser'S Pickled Brussels
instructions: Wash and trim sprouts. Thoroughly wash four 1-pint canning jars and lids. In each jar place 1 garlic clove 1 teaspoon dill seed 1 teaspoon peppercorns and then fill with Brussels sprouts.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Microwave chocolate squares and 2 tablespoons of milk until almost melted stirring 1/2 way through. Stir until completely melted. Beat in cream cheese milk and sugar until well mixed. Refrigerate 10 minutes. Stir in whipped topping until smooth. Put mix in pie crust. Freeze until firm (3 to 4 hours). Garnish with chocolate curls or shavings.

title: Fruit Kabobs
instructions: You will need wooden skewers. Choose five of the fruits (grapes are a must) and cut into bite-sized pieces. Put a piece of each fruit on a wooden skewer alternating with grapes. A strawberry on top always adds color. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Yummy Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Butter 9-inch square pan. Mix all ingredients together combining them well. Spread mixture in pan and bake 35 to 40 minutes or until dry on top and almost firm to touch. Cool for 10 to 15 minutes. Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Working Man'S Breakfast
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and set aside. Brown onion in the bacon drippings. Add bread cheese and potato. Crumble bacon and add to mixture. Beat eggs; pour into mixture. Season to taste and cook until set stirring occasionally.

title: Caramel Oatmeal Chewies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine oats flour brown sugar soda and salt; mix well. Stir in margarine. Reserve 1 cup and press remaining onto bottom of pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown; cool 10 minutes. Top with chocolate pieces.

title: Deanna'S Apple Crisp
instructions: Wash peel core and slice apples. Sprinkle lightly with hot water and a few drops lemon juice. Also a few tablespoons of sugar salt and cinnamon. Arrange apple mixture in bottom of large greased baking pan. In mixing bowl add melted butter; keep adding remaining sugar and flour to form crumbly mixture working with a fork. Sprinkle butter-flour mixture evenly over sliced apples. A few chopped walnuts pecans or wheat germ give an added crunch to topping. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until apples are tender and crumb topping is golden brown. Serve warm with whipped cream or softened vanilla ice cream.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Cook shrimp according to package directions. Thaw crab meat. Cook rice according to package directions using seasoning in package. Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Holiday Cranberry Muffins(Heartwarming Christmas 1991)
instructions: Let cranberries stand overnight in 1/2 cup sugar. Combine dry ingredients. Add liquid ingredients all at once. Stir until moistened. Add cranberries and stir. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Yields 18.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Assemble 3 lasagna strips into a buttered 9x12 inch baking dish. Mix cheese into hot mashed potatoes. Add 1/2 potato-cheese mixture. Layer 3 more lasagna noodles and repeat with potato and cheese mixture. Saute oleo and onions until golden. Pour over casserole. Bake 20 minutes a 350 degrees uncovered.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Fresh Apple Pie(Large Recipe)
instructions: Arrange apples in 8 deep pie pans that have been lined with pastry. Mix the following and sprinkle over the apples sugar flour nutmeg and butter. Cover with pastry. Brush top with milk. Bake approximately 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until apples are done. Yield 8 (8-inch) pies.

title: Taco Snack Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients except margarine in a large bowl tossing to coat well with seasoning. Drizzle with melted margarine and toss to coat well. Store in an airtight container. Makes an excellent anytime snack.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown beef and onions in a large skillet. Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes or until slightly thickened. Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: Place rice in bottom of flat baking pan. Lay washed chicken breasts on top of rice; sprinkle lemon pepper and salt on chicken and rice mixture. Place onion slices on top of mixture and pour the water over rice. Bake uncovered at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Noodles Alfredo
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain well and return to the pan. Add remaining ingredients tossing lightly to coat the noodles. Good with veal and poultry. Serves 4.

title: San Francisco Chops
instructions: Trim pork chops. In a microsafe dish combine the oil and garlic. Spread evenly in dish. Microwave at High power for 1 minute. Combine sherry soy sauce brown sugar and pepper in bowl. Add pork chops to dish turning to coat. Pour sauce over chops. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High power for 4 minutes turning chops and dish once after 2 minutes. Keep covered. Microwave at Medium power for 12 to 15 minutes until no pink remains. Remove chops to serving dish. Dissolve cornstarch in water. Stir into pan juices. Microwave at High power for 1 to 2 minutes until thick. Pour sauce over chops and serve.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine first three ingredients and heat until sugar is dissolved. Do not boil. Remove and add the remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Bottle to store.

title: Black Bean Tortilla Pinwheels
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sour cream in bowl until blended. Stir in Monterey Jack cheese olives onion salt and garlic powder. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Place beans in food processor or blender; process until smooth. Spread each tortilla with a thin layer of beans. Spread thin layer of cream cheese mixture over beans. Roll up tortillas lightly. Wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate until chilled. Cut 3/4-inch slices and serve with salsa.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together cream cheese sugar and butter; add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Add flour last and one package of Dream Whip. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Veal Parmigiana
instructions: Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan. Blend salt pepper crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Dip meat in eggs and then in crumbs twice. Place meat in buttered pan. Cook 20 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven; turn and bake 20 minutes on the other side.

title: Strawberry Supreme Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients then add strawberries. Bake in greased and floured pan per directions on box.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
instructions: Spray a 1-quart casserole dish with nonstick coating. Mix all ingredients in a mixing bowl except potatoes. Gently stir in potatoes. Spoon onto prepared baking dish. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake casserole 45 minutes or until slightly puffed and top is lightly browned.

title: California Tamale Pie
instructions: In skillet or slow cooking pot with browning unit cook meat until crumbly. Drain. In large bowl mix cornmeal milk and egg. Add meat dry chili seasoning mix seasoned salt tomatoes corn and olives. Put in slow cooker or crock-pot and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook for another 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Meal In A Bowl Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven cook ground beef or ground pork and onion until meat is browned or onion is tender. Drain off fat. Stir in beef broth water peas potatoes mushrooms carrots sage basil salt and pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 6.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine and cream with sugars. Add eggs and vanilla which have been beaten together. Then beat in the dry ingredients with the mixture. Add rest of the ingredients by hand. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use an ice cream scoop or tablespoon to drop dough onto the cookie sheet.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Beat Egg Beaters and add remaining ingredients. Pour into a large cast-iron skillet already sprayed with cooking spray. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add egg molasses ginger and cinnamon. Sift the flour baking soda and salt. Add sifted dry ingredients to the creamed mixture alternately with the cold water. Drop by spoonful (large) onto greased baking sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes in moderate hot 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in a casserole dish. Pour in peaches and sprinkle cinnamon on peaches. Mix all other ingredients and pour on top of peaches. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Calico Bean Casserole #2
instructions: Cook bacon hamburger and onions in frypan. Add vinegar brown sugar and mustard. Simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the beans. Put meat mixture in bean pot or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or slow cooker on low for 4 hours.

title: Graham Cracker Dream Bars
instructions: Mix sugar margarine milk and egg. Cook until it comes to boil. Remove from heat. Add coconut nuts and graham cracker crumbs. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers. On top of graham crackers spread filling on graham crackers. Put another layer of graham crackers on top of filling.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute vegetables in butter. Add other ingredients except shrimp and lemon; simmer 2 hours. Add shrimp during the last 30 minutes and put in whole lemon the last 10 minutes. Serve with rice and lemon juice. Serves 6.

title: Sue'S Rosh Hashana Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in large Ziploc bag(s) with lemon juice. Marinate overnight turning bags occasionally. Next day pat dry chicken with paper towels. Dredge in seasoned flour. Fry in oil until golden. Drain on paper towel.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Put sugar and milk in sauce pan and stir until not grainy. Then boil until it forms a soft ball when dropped into ice water. Let cool 15 to 20 minutes. Then add vanilla and peanut butter. Beat well. Spread into 9 x 9 inch pan.

title: Potato Wedges
instructions: Place potatoes in large bowl. Add cold water. Let stand 30 minutes. Dry potatoes. Spray pan with nonstick spray. Place potatoes in pan. Spray potatoes with nonstick spray. Sprinkle with pepper and salt. Bake for 20 minutes at 425\u00b0. Using spatula turn potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic. Bake until golden potatoes.

title: Great Caesar'S Roast
instructions: Partially crush one cup Caesar Croutons. Add one Tbsp. each chopped chives and parmesan cheese and two Tbsp. melted butter. Cut three medium tomatoes in half (cross-wise). Season with salt and pepper. Top with croutons mixture. Broil until brown. Serve with roast.

title: Breakfast Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside. Combine Bisquick and onions. Combine 2 beaten eggs and milk then add to Bisquick mixture. Stir only until the mixture is moistened.

title: Rice Pudding(Rizogalo)
instructions: Heat milk and water in saucepan. Add rice; stir. Add sugar salt and butter and stir then let simmer for 50 minutes. Beat 2 eggs in separate bowl and slowly add hot mixture. Beat constantly. Add vanilla and stir gently. Ladle into dessert dishes and sprinkle with cinnamon. Refrigerate. Serves 8.

title: Szechuan Steak
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except steak in a 10 x 13-inch dish. Score steak on both sides. Marinate for several hours. Grill.

title: Chicken Parmesan(Aunt Sue'S Recipe)
instructions: Dip chicken in eggs. Roll in bread crumbs. Brown in olive oil and garlic (both sides). Grease casserole. On bottom layer spaghetti sauce chicken Mozzarella cheese garlic oregano and Parmesan. Layer more spaghetti sauce and top with more Parmesan.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Centered Cookies
instructions: Mix first six ingredients together until fluffy. Separately mix the flour soda baking powder and salt. Then add these to the first six ingredients. Mix well. Roll into 1 inch balls and roll each ball in sugar. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 - 11 minutes remove quickly from oven. Place one chocolate candy kiss into the center of each cookie pointed side down. Bake for exactly one minute longer. Remove from oven and immediately spread chocolate over each cookie. You may want to leave the cookie as is or you may place a butterscotch chip in each one. Freezes well. Makes 6 - 7 dozen cookies.

title: Rum Sauce
instructions: Cream the butter. Add sugar gradually then rum flavoring very slowly. Add well beaten egg yolks and milk or cream. Cook over hot water until it thickens as a custard. Pour onto beaten egg whites. It is delicious on bread pudding.

title: Fresh Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put into a casserole dish. Put casserole dish in a pan of water and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Mozzarella Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion and garlic. Drain off any excess grease. Combine with remaining ingredients (except Mozzarella) and place in 3-quart casserole dish. Top with Mozzarella and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Add garlic and cook until done but still firm. Drain. Add chopped onion. Cool to warm. Add mayonnaise sour cream vinegar salt and pepper to taste and mix well.

title: Blender Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put first 6 ingredients in blender and mix well. Pour into pie shells and bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven while center is still shaky.

title: Oven French Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Scrub potatoes cut into long strips about 1/2-inch wide. Dry strips thoroughly on paper towels. Toss in a bowl with oil as if making a salad. Toss with optional spices. Spread potatoes in a single layer on a cookie sheet and place in preheated oven for 35 minutes. Turn strips periodically to brown on all sides. If a crispier browner potato is desired run under broiler for a minute or two. Sprinkle with salt. Yield 6 servings 80 calories per serving. This is a low cholesterol reduced fat recipe.

title: Aloha Sandwich Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese with milk. Drain pineapple and mix with cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve on rounds of nut bread or Ritz crackers. Makes 12 servings.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a jar to store. To make hot chocolate mix 4 tablespoons with 1 cup of boiling water.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Bake 20 minutes longer at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut in squares.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix sugar oil vinegar water and flavor packets. Set aside. Crush dry noodles. Mix noodles with almonds sunflower seeds onions and slaw. Drizzle with dressing and toss.

title: Pita Points
instructions: Cut pita bread into 8 pie-shaped pieces (like pizza). Split sections open and pull apart. Drizzle olive oil on \rough\ side of bread. Sprinkle with seasonings as desired. Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for approximately 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Combine sugar butter syrup and vanilla. Bring to boil over medium heat. Remove and stir for 10 minutes. (Turns to light caramel color.) Mix together.

title: Six Week Bran Muffins
instructions: In large bowl mix cereal sugar flour soda salt and cinnamon. Add eggs oil and buttermilk. Mix well. Store in jars in refrigerator. Grease tins and fill 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Monte Cristo
instructions: Cut 3 slices of Italian bread. Place 3 ounces of ham and 1 slice of Swiss cheese on first piece. Top with another slice of bread 3 ounces turkey and 1 slice American cheese. Top with remaining slice of bread. Dip sandwich into egg wash and grill like French toast. Microwave or bake until hot through.

title: Pigs In A Blanket
instructions: Wrap each roll or biscuit around a sausage link. Follow baking instructions on can to brown. Makes 10 servings.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 1/2-quart baking dish. Spread the apples in it and sprinkle 1/3 cup water on top. Combine the flour sugar cinnamon and salt in a bowl and rub in the butter with your fingers until it resembles coarse crumbs. Spread evenly over the apples. Bake for about 30 minutes or until the crust is browned. Serve with heavy cream or whipped cream.

title: Milk Chocolate Rice Krispies
instructions: Heat milk chocolate chips oleo and syrup. Add vanilla and powdered sugar and mix. Add Rice Krispies. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Set in refrigerator. Cut into small squares to serve. (May melt chocolate chips in microwave or double boiler.)

title: Chicken Livers
instructions: Wrap rinsed chicken livers with strips of uncooked bacon. Place on cookie sheet. Baste with butter and Worcestershire sauce mixture. Broil in oven turning once.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Put eggs in pot and cover with water; heat just until the water boils. Remove pot from heat and cover. Let stand 15 to 18 minutes; remove shells from eggs. Cut eggs in half and remove yolks. Put the yolks in a small bowl and mash with fork. Add rest of ingredients and mix. Fill the egg whites with mixture heaping it up slightly. Hint Set pot in sink and run cold water over them to cool eggs down quickly. This makes them easier to peel.

title: Scalloped Corn Supreme
instructions: Heat milk and corn gradually. Stir in egg. Add next four ingredients and dash of pepper. Mix well. Pour into greased 8-inch round baking dish. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Oil Pie Pastry
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl. Mix oil and milk together with a fork. Add to flour and mix with hands until just mixed. Add a little cold water if more liquid is needed. Split dough into two balls. Chill 10 minutes. On a dry floured counter press dough into a flat circle with hands.

title: Hermits
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix brown sugar shortening margarine coffee egg baking soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until almost no indentation remains when touched. Cool. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Strawberry Cream Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except sour cream. Put half in a bowl and let it begin to jell. Then cover with sour cream. Pour on the other half which you have not chilled. Put in refrigerator to congeal.

title: Minestrone Soup Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Then dump together and season to taste a little Tabasco chile powder and garlic. Great on a cold day. Serve with corn bread.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine Eagle Brand milk and water. Add pudding mix; beat until well mixed. Chill for 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart round glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of vanilla wafers bananas and pudding mixture. Chill thoroughly. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix sugar frozen coconut and sour cream until blended. Place in a covered container and refrigerate overnight. The next day prepare cake mix as directed on box. Bake in layers. When cool split layers into 4 layers. There should be enough topping to cover all four layers. Cover entire cake and refrigerate for another day or two. The longer this cake is refrigerated the better it becomes.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Chop celery carrots and onion. In large saucepan break eggs in peanut oil. In separate corners of pan place celery carrots and onion. With spatula chop egg up and flip as it cooks and stir other vegetables. Add rice and soy sauce and mix all together stirring and flipping until rice is brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Fudge Ribbon Cake
instructions: Make cake according to directions. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. In bowl mix cream cheese sour cream and sugar. Add eggs one at a time then add vanilla and flour. Mix until smooth and pour over chocolate batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Good Baked Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger or sausage whichever you choose. Drain. Add pork and beans and onion; simmer 10 minutes. Good over cooked rice or mashed potatoes or biscuits.

title: Oatmeal Banana Bread
instructions: Combine bananas oats and milk in bowl; set aside. Cream butter or oleo and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine dry ingredients adding alternately with banana mixture to creamed mixture. Spoon into two greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove from pans; cool on wire rack. Yields 2 loaves. Can be frozen up to 3 months.

title: Louisiana Yam Corn Bread
instructions: Sift flour with cornmeal baking powder salt and sugar; set aside. Combine eggs milk and oil in a large bowl. Beat until smooth. Add yams and beat until blended. Add flour mixture stirring only until flour mixture is moistened. Spoon into 2 greased 8-inch square pans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until breads test done. Cut into squares. Serve warm with butter.

title: Punch Recipe(Club Member: John Waters)
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. The ginger ale is to be added just before serving. Sherbet can be added if desired.

title: Tortellini In Garlic Basil Sauce
instructions: Saute garlic in olive oil. Add basil and oregano; stir frequently and do not overcook. Add butter; let melt. Continue to stir. Meanwhile water should be brought to a boil. Add tortellini. Cool and toss.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Heat oil in skillet; brown meat; set aside. Drain pineapple and combine the juice with the water vinegar brown sugar cornstarch and soy sauce. Mix well. Cook sauce in the skillet until clear and slightly thickened. Add meat and cook over low heat for about 55 minutes. Add green pepper onion slices and pineapple chunks and simmer about 5 more minutes. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Skillet Fried Corn
instructions: Place bacon slices in skillet and cook until crisp; remove from skillet to cool. For fresh corn cut off cob (it is better cut off cream style). Mix corn salt and sugar; pour into bacon drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon strips into corn. Add 1/2 cup water. Cook 15 to 20 minutes over low heat. Stir often.

title: So-O Good Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Combine brown sugar and flour. Add egg yolks and water and beat with electric mixer until creamy and smooth. Heat the can of milk until hot and add the creamy mixture. Cook until thickened; stir constantly. When thickened remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into an 8-inch pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Cook the chicken in enough water to cover until tender. Pick off bone return chicken to broth. Bring to a boil. Thicken with flour mixture. This amount depends on the thickness you want. Cook and stir well. A few drops of yellow food coloring adds color. Serve over biscuits or mashed potatoes.

title: Fruity Cereal Squares
instructions: Butter baking pan or dish (9 x 9 x 2-inches). In large saucepan heat gelatin (dry) corn syrup and butter to boiling over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in cereal until evenly coated. Pat mixture evenly in pan with buttered back of spoon. Cover chill until set about 30 minutes. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Stores at room temperature. Makes 3 dozen squares.

title: Barbecues
instructions: Mix all together and heat thoroughly.

title: Blueberry Dump Cake
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan spread the can of blueberry pie filling followed by the can of crushed pineapple. Sprinkle the box of yellow cake mix over top (dont mix). Pour the butter over the cake mix and sprinkle with chopped pecans if desired. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Butterfinger Bars
instructions: Mix brown sugar sugar oats and butter. Pat in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Melt chocolate chips. Add peanut butter. Spread over cooled bars. Refrigerate.

title: Rigatoni With Meat Sauce
instructions: In large saucepan heat oil. Saute onion garlic carrot and celery until golden brown. Add parsley oregano basil and meat. Stir and cook until meat is brown. Add wine and let evaporate quickly. Add tomatoes salt and pepper; simmer about 1/2 hour. Prepare rigatoni as package directs. Drain. Pour in warm bowl. Add sauce and parmesan cheese. Toss to mix.

title: French Toast With Brandied Lemon Butter
instructions: In a shallow dish beat eggs sugar salt milk and vanilla. Soak bread in mixture. Heat butter over medium-high heat and cook each slice until lightly browned on each side. Serve with maple syrup or Brandied Lemon Butter and lemon slices. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Serves 6.

title: Okra Corn Tomato Medley
instructions: Saute onion in bacon drippings until tender. Add okra and cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add remaining ingredients stirring well. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until corn is tender. Yields 6 servings.

title: Carrot Souffle
instructions: Peel fresh carrots and cut into chunks or use frozen carrots. Boil carrots until extra soft. Drain very well. While carrots are warm add sugar baking powder and vanilla. Whip with mixer until smooth. Add flour and butter. Mix well. Whip eggs and add to carrot mixture. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch buttered baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until top is lightly brown. Add powdered sugar to top and serve.

title: No-Knead-No-Fault Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Place the whole wheat flour in a large mixing bowl and set in the oven at the lowest temperature for 20 minutes. While the flour is warming dissolve the yeast in 1 cup warm water. Add the honey to the mixture and set it aside. Then dissolve the molasses in 1 cup water. Set aside while the flour is being warmed. This short time period will give the yeast mixture time to work before you combine it with flour.

title: Chicken Vegetable Fettucini
instructions: Put vegetables in 9 x 12-inch casserole dish in microwave with 1 tablespoon water. Cook until tender then set aside to drain. Debone chicken breasts; cube and season to taste. Brown in oleo. Remove chicken when brown leaving remaining oleo. Saute onions. When ready add cheese. When melted slowly add milk and stir. Then add vegetables. Stir until well coated with cheese. Add noodles and chicken; stir gently again. Put in same 9 x 12-inch dish and top with bread crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Feather Cake(From Cookbook Given To Flora A. P. Engle, Christmas 1902.)
instructions: (No directions were given; follow cake procedures.)

title: Cheesy Artichoke Heart Appetizers
instructions: Unroll dough into rectangles; press onto bottom and sides of 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan to form crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread over crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with thin red pepper strips.

title: Layered Enchilada Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onion add seasonings and tomato sauce. This may be made ahead and used when ready. In casserole (round) alternate layers of tortillas sauce olives and cheese. Add water cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. May be frozen before adding water for later use. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Saute onion in butter. Add broccoli cheese mushroom soup and mushrooms. Heat thoroughly. (Good in crock-pot.) Serve with plain Doritos.

title: Cauliflower Au Gratin With Almonds And Cheese
instructions: Boil cauliflower in salted water until tender (about 20 minutes). Drain. Make cream sauce. If desired add part of cheese to sauce. Reserve other and sprinkle over top of cauliflower. Place whole cauliflower (or broken into flowerets) into casserole. Pour sauce over cauliflower. Just before serving sprinkle with grated cheese and almonds. Brown in moderate oven for about 10 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Use a tube pan. Cream margarine sugar and eggs together. Sprinkle flour over nuts and fruit covering good. Add to batter and add vanilla. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Party Meatballs
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and add ground beef. Make meatballs the size of a silver dollar and place in casserole dish. Mix the next 3 ingredients and pour over meatballs.

title: English Muffins In A Loaf
instructions: Combine 3 cups flour yeast sugar salt and baking soda. Heat liquids until very warm. Add to dry mixture and beat well. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into two 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal. Sprinkle top of batter with cornmeal. Cover let rise in warm place for 45 to 60 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Turn out of pans while bread is still warm.

title: Barbara'S Pineapple Cream Pudding Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in 13 x 9-inch pan. Meanwhile combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan. Cook over medium heat 20 minutes. Poke fork into done cake. Pour on pineapple mix; spread evenly. Cool completely.

title: Quick Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Work in shortening. Add buttermilk and stir until well mixed. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet leaving a little space between biscuits. Bake at 425 degrees until nicely browned about 10-12 minutes.

title: Country Chicken Pie
instructions: Melt margarine over low heat in saucepan. Blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually add buttermilk; cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add chicken and vegetables. Continue cooking ten minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine dry ingredients. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in chives. Reserve 2 tablespoons egg and combine remaining egg and buttermilk to flour mixture mixing just until moistened. On lightly floured surface knead dough ten times. Roll out dough to 10-inch circle. Place over chicken mixture. Brush with reserved egg. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Punch
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Add enough water to make 1 1/2 gallons. Add large bottle ginger ale or more if you need to make more.

title: Jennie'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Beat egg with fork. Add mayonnaise and chicken soup; blend well. Stir in broccoli onion and cheese. Pour into 1 1/2-quart oblong dish. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Add flour and vanilla beating well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Place in cold oven. Set oven at 350\u00b0 and bake one hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat butter eggs sugars and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add dry ingredients; blend well. Stir in chips and nuts. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet 2 inches apart. Bake in a moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 7 to 9 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Chicken Dip
instructions: Mix together first 6 ingredients. Place in casserole dish; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain. Add salt pepper garlic soup chilies and enchilada sauce. Mix well. Line bottom of 13 x 9 casserole dish with tortillas. Cover with half of the meat mixture. Add another layer of tortillas then meat sauce. Cover with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving the syrup. In a saucepan combine rice water pineapple syrup and salt. Mix just to moisten the rice. Bring quickly to boiling reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Add marshmallows pineapple banana and lemon juice. Stir and then allow to cool completely. Fold in cream. Chill before serving.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Combine broth broccoli and butter. Simmer 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and let simmer 20 minutes.

title: Austrian Apple Torte
instructions: Beat eggs until thick. Add sugar to eggs slowly 1/2 cup at a time. Stir in vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Stir in flour mixture 1/2 at a time. Fold in apples. Stir in walnuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
