instructions: Cook meat onions pepper and seasoning in skillet until meat is brown. Put about 1/2 cup of cheese in the bottom of an unbaked pie shell. Pour drained cooked meat mixture over cheese in shell. Mix mayonnaise milk and eggs and pour over meat mixture. Sprinkle rest of cheese on top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes then cool for 10 minutes.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Place dough on a large cookie sheet on foil. Pat out with hand then sprinkle cheese. Spread pepperoni on dough and sprinkle with olive oil and oregano. Fold into thirds seam faced down on cookie sheet. Pinch ends closed. Bake around 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in preheated oven until golden brown. Can brush crust with egg white. Slice and serve.

title: Mammas Quick Dinner Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water add dry ingredients; cover and let rise in warm place until double. Turn out onto floured surface; knead just to coat with flour; flatten to even thickness. With a round cutter cut rolls and place onto a lightly greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Put into mixing bowl the yellow cake mix vanilla pudding sour cream eggs and oil. Beat as directed on package. Put half of batter into greased pan.

title: Irish Cream
instructions: Mix first three ingredients in blender. Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Keep refrigerated.

title: Potato Smoked Sausage Casserole
instructions: Pare and slice enough potatoes to equal 2 cups; set aside. Cook onion in 1/4 cup margarine until tender. Blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually add milk stirring until smooth. Cook stirring constantly until mixture is slightly thickened. Place half of sausage in bottom of 2-quart ovenproof casserole. Add half of potatoes half of peas and half of sauce. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients ending with sauce. Combine crumbs and margarine; sprinkle over sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until crumbs are lightly browned. Makes 4 servings.

title: Shrimp, Crab And Crawfish Boil
instructions: Add shrimp crab crawfish corn and potatoes to pot of boiling water with shrimp boil. Wait a few minutes (not too long) and take out. Throw all ingredients on a table and enjoy! A little messy but fun!

title: Overnight Crab Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in deep casserole dish (1 quart size). Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. May sprinkle little paprika on top.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: In skillet over medium heat brown meat and onions. Cook until done; drain. Stir in corn tomato sauce rice steak sauce and pepper. Set aside.

title: Turkey Corn Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan combine all ingredients except salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring occasionally until thoroughly heated. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Chill milk in freezer several hours. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add lemon juice and undrained pineapple. Chill until slightly thickens. Whip margarine cheese and sugar until fluffy. Fold into jello. Whip milk until it peaks. Fold into mixture. Butter dish and sprinkle with 1/2 of crumbs. Pour cheese mixture. Put remainder of crumbs on top. Chill several hours.

title: Orange Spiced Tea
instructions: Peel oranges (no white) cut into thin strips spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Toss all ingredients. Cover. Store one week before use.

title: Mom'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Mix sauces spices and pork together and simmer.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Into a 9 x 13-inch pan pour the can of pineapple. Over it spread the cherry pie filling. Spread the coconut over this then sprinkle the dry cake mix over all these layers. Top with nuts. Put thinly sliced oleo over top. Bake for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Spice Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix flour cinnamon cloves and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Add the raisins juice and nuts; mix. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes. This is a nice moist cookie.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer the ingredients as stated in an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with Tostitos or a heavier chip.

title: Easy Salad
instructions: Stir gelatin into boiling water until dissolved. Let stand until cool. Add carrot celery and pineapple. Also add cheese if used. Refrigerate until gelatin is firm. Serves 6.

title: Lamb Shanks
instructions: Put shanks in covered ovenproof casserole. Mix all other ingredients and cut large onion and put slices on top of shanks. Pour all over shanks and cover your dish. Potatoes and carrots may be added to dish. Bake 3 hours in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Diet Chicken
instructions: Line baking pan with foil. Arrange chicken pieces in pan. Cover with foil. Mix together other ingredients and sprinkle over chicken. Place onion rings on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tender.

title: Mrs. Lowell'S Thanksgiving Cornbread
instructions: Beat eggs in bowl. Add corn muffin mix sour cream corn melted butter and sugar. Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Almond Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl combine sugar corn syrup and salt; mix well. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir in almonds; microwave on High again 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla; microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in baking soda. As soon as the mixture foams quickly pour onto a greased metal baking sheet. Cool completely. Break into 2-inch pieces. Melt chocolate in microwave. Drizzle over top. Yield About 1 pound.

title: Hot Water Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together well. Pour enough boiling water just to mix well. Add shortening. Form into palm size pones. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Spiced Roast With Dijon Sauce
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle crush the fennel seed mustard seed and pepper. Set aside.

title: Barley Sausage(Vedaras)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Fill large clean sausage casings with mixture. Boil in salt water or place in baking dish; bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Soup Enchiladas
instructions: Beat 6 eggs add salt and pepper. Fry as pancakes.

title: Diabetic Sugarless Cake
instructions: Chop raisins and boil water and raisins for 5 minutes in a 2-quart pan. Remove from heat and add apples chocolate and margarine. When mixture is cool stir in flour baking powder and soda. Add egg liquid sweetener (Sweet 10) and vanilla. Beat 1 minute by hand and stir in nuts. Bake in 9 x 9-inch pan for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut into pieces wrap and store in freezer. Contains 175 calories per piece.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Cake
instructions: Do not drain the pineapple. Mix flour pineapple sugar eggs nuts and baking soda well. Pour into a prepared 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes. Mix the powdered sugar butter cream cheese and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Spread immediately over hot cake and let cool.

title: Chicken Crescents
instructions: Cook and chop chicken.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Combine above ingredients. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until a knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Crab Dip Spectacular
instructions: Combine and chill. A must for Christmas.

title: Punch With A Punch
instructions: Mix juices lemonade and sugar. Let stand until ready to serve. Then add ginger ale strawberries sherbet ice cubes and rum. Enjoy!

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Dredge peaches in flour. Add next 5 ingredients and mix well. Set aside. Roll 3/4 of pastry to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Fit into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon in peach mixture. Roll remaining pastry out to 1/4-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Cut into 1/2-inch strips. Arrange in lattice fashion over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Easy Rolls
instructions: Mix well and drop by spoonfuls into muffin tin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cream Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender 30 to 40 minutes. Cool and remove bones. Cook eggs approximately 10 minutes and slice. Combine milk and flour together and pour into chicken broth. Add chicken and eggs for a delicious dinner. Salt and pepper to your taste; serve over hot biscuits. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar and well beaten egg. Mix flour salt and baking powder. Add alternately with milk (start and end with flour). Beat altogether until batter is creamy. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Godmother'S Flag Cake(4Th Of July Tradition)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 (15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch) jelly roll pans. Prepare 1 package of cake mix substituting orange juice for water. Spread batter evenly in cake pan. Bake 20 minutes. Cool cake for 15 minutes in pan. Invert on rack. Repeat steps for second cake mix. Slice 1 pint of strawberries. Cut remaining strawberries in half. Beat the whipped cream powdered sugar vanilla and salt until stiff peaks form. Put one cake layer on a flat serving board. Spread with about 2 cups whipped cream and top with sliced strawberries. Put the second cake layer on top. Put remaining whipped cream over top and sides of cake.

title: Baked Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Wash eggplant and cut in half lengthwise. Carefully remove pulp leaving 1/2-inch of the outer shell. Dice pulp.

title: Chicken Breasts De Duxe
instructions: Dust chicken with flour. Melt oleo in heavy skillet and add chicken. Cook over moderate heat about 15 minutes on each side. Pour mushrooms with broth into saucepan. Add bouillon cube and heat. Blend wine and cornstarch (to mushrooms) until thickened. Allow sour cream to come to room temperature. Place in bowl stir until smooth. Add to sauce. Remove chicken to warm place. Pour sauce into skillet. Heat and serve over chicken and rice on platter.

title: Eagle Brand Milk
instructions: Stir ingredients until dissolved. Beat until smooth (will be thin but will thicken later on). Keep in refrigerator.

title: Betty'S Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Layer first 3 ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together milk eggs salt mustard pepper and onions. Pour over dry ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Creamy Chicken-Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter until tender. Add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add half and half and broth. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Yields 4 cups. To store refrigerate up to 2 days; freeze up to 1 month.

title: Family Special
instructions: In large pot brown hamburger. Open macaroni and cheese box reserve cheese package until later. Add 2 cups water spinach and macaroni (only not cheese) to hamburger and bring to boil. Reduce heat simmer 10 minutes. Add cheese package Cheddar partially drained kidney beans and garlic salt to taste. Stir well. Let \sit\ 10 minutes before serving. Serves 4. May be doubled.

title: Pecan Balls
instructions: Mix butter sugar salt and vanilla. Work in flour. The last bit of flour may be worked in with hands. Add nuts. Chill dough. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until set but not browned. Roll in sifted confectioners sugar while warm. Cool.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix together and freeze until a mush. To 1 gallon of punch add 1 quart of ginger ale. Serves 25 to 30.

title: Hot Or Cold Tuna Salad
instructions: Cook shells according to package. Mix lemon juice mayo mustard sugar basil and salt.

title: Marinated Potato, Ham And Green Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix well. Let stand overnight before serving. You may make this and keep in refrigerator for a long time as it is used. The longer it stands the better the flavor.

title: Collard Greens
instructions: Steam ham hocks in a small amount of water for about 1 hour. Cut and wash collard greens very well. Add the greens chopped green pepper scallions sugar and seasoning to the pot. Simmer for approximately 1 hour or until tender.

title: Saladmaster Meat Loaf
instructions: Use #1 blade on Saladmaster machine to grate potato carrot celery and crackers to a fine mesh. Cut onion on #2 blade. Add 2 eggs and 1/2 the bottle of soy sauce. Mix to a consistent color. Add meat and knead thoroughly to a consistent color throughout. (Check for dry spots or lumps of unmixed meat; knead some more.)

title: Sausage Strata
instructions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with bread (may take more than six slices). Spread cooked drained sausage over bread; sprinkle with cheese. Combine remaining ingredients. Beat well. Pour over sausage and cheese. You can make the night before and refrigerate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let sit a few minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Tear chicken apart and place in casserole dish. Pour soup celery and chicken in bowl. Mix in one can of milk and mix good. Pour this mixture over chicken. Melt 1 stick of butter with 1 can broth. Mix with stuffing mix. Spoon this mixture on top of 2nd layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie(Dry Bottom)
instructions: Pour into 2 crusts and sprinkle flour mixture on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange And Cashew Chicken
instructions: Reserve 2 tablespoons syrup from oranges. Blend reserved syrup with stir-fry sauce. Set aside.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add sweet potatoes brown sugar margarine spices salt and sweetened condensed milk in a large mixing bowl; beat until fluffy. Add evaporated milk and lemon flavoring; beat just until blended. Stir in coconut. Beat egg whites with electric mixer until foamy; gradually add white sugar one tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form.

title: Roll Biscuits
instructions: Mix warm water and yeast together. Mix flour sugar soda and buttermilk. Add yeast and water. Mix and put in icebox. Pinch off a small piece roll and cut out. Bake in greased baking pan.

title: Fred'S Pound Cake
instructions: Combine buttermilk and baking soda; set aside. (Baking soda will react with buttermilk and volume will increase.) Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream together butter (at room temperature) and sugar. Alternately add eggs one at a time with flour and buttermilk mixture. Bake for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cinnamon Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange apple slices in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour water over top. Combine cake mix brown sugar melted butter and cinnamon. Stir until thoroughly blended. Mixture will be crumbly. Sprinkle crumb mixture over apple slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly. Serve warm or cooled completely with whipped topping or ice cream if desired.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Add sugar to melted Milky Ways and butter. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour salt and baking soda. Add milk alternately. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0 (two 8 or 9-inch round pans).

title: Raw Potato Dumplings
instructions: Grate potatoes fine and drain off brown liquid. Add the beaten eggs salt crumbs and flour to make a stiff dough. Drop into boiling salted water from a wet spoon. Dumplings should be about 1 1/2-inches long and 1/2-inch in diameter when cooked. They are done as soon as they float to the top.

title: Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually. Beat real good (several minutes) then add eggs one at a time beating each time. Add vanilla. Add soda to milk. Add flour and milk alternately to other ingredients. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. This cake is good plain frosted or frozen. Do not open oven door.

title: Apricot-Coconut Balls
instructions: Blend apricots coconut and pecans together in a large mixing bowl. Stir in condensed milk. Shape into small balls and roll colored coconut. Let stand in air until firm.

title: Applesauce Jello Salad
instructions: Heat applesauce and mix with dry Jell-O. Measure juice of one orange. Add enough 7-Up to make one cup. Mix with Jell-O and applesauce. Add grated orange rind. Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Cheesy Ham Nuggets
instructions: Combine with first 6 ingredients; mix well with fork. Cut ham into 20 (1-inch) cubes. Shape a thin layer of cheese mixture around each ham cube. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Yields 20 appetizers.

title: Jumbo Cookies
instructions: Sift first four ingredients together. Mix second four ingredients in another bowl until well blended. Add mixtures together and blend well. Add nuts and chocolate drops. Do all blending by hand with a spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in a 13 x 11 x 1 1/2-inch pan until looks flaky. Cool about 20 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large kettle; add next 6 ingredients. Reduce heat and simmer covered until all vegetables are tender about 30 minutes. Stir in soup and cheese. Cook until soup is heated through and cheese is melted. Yields 10 to 12 servings (3 quarts).

title: Butterscotch Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat dry cake mix margarine and egg in large bowl on low speed until blended. Press on bottom of ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown; cool.

title: Chicken Fricassee
instructions: In heavy pan combine chicken roux onion salt pepper and water. Cook covered on low heat for about 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Add green onions and parsley. Cook another 10 minutes. Serve with cooked white rice.

title: Tea Dainties
instructions: Mix together butter dates and sugar. Cook over low flame stirring constantly until mixture boils. Mix together egg (beaten) milk and salt. Add to date mixture. Cook 2 minutes and cool. Add nuts and Rice Krispies. Form into 1-inch balls and roll in chopped nuts or coconut. Store in refrigerator.

title: Whipping Cream Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour and whipping cream together then place dough on a floured pastry board. Roll out dough. Cut out biscuits and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Tacoed Eggs
instructions: In a bowl combine eggs cheese onion green pepper and hot pepper sauce. Cook and stir in a nonstick skillet until eggs begin to set. Add taco meat. Cook until eggs are completely set. Spoon onto a warmed tortilla and roll. Top with salsa.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: In skillet cook sausage until browned drain meat. In 2 qt. shallow baking dish spread sausage. Top with bread cubes and cheese. Mix picante sauce eggs and milk and pour over bread and cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Uncover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes only 6 servings so I double this and put in 9 x 13 baking dish for our Sunday School class.

title: Barbecued Franks
instructions: Split hot dogs lengthwise and layer in slightly greased casserole dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over franks. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Turtles
instructions: Arrange pecans in clusters of 3 or 4 halves 2 inches apart on a greased baking pan. Top each cluster with 1 caramel flattened slightly. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 7 minutes or until caramel softens. Remove to wax paper. Flatten caramels with spatula; top each candy with 1 milk chocolate square while still warm. Spread chocolate when melted. Refrigerate a few minutes until chocolate hardens.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs oil sugar and vanilla until thick. Stir in remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into two greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about one hour or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Add all ingredients into glass baking dish and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Top with favorite cheese about 10 minutes before done.

title: Chicken Casserole No. 2
instructions: Microwave chicken (cover with Saran Wrap) for 10 minutes or more depending on microwave. Layer bottom with 1 package of crackers (crumbled). Add cut-up chicken. Mix together soups and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Top with crumbled crackers and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except bread. Hollow out inside of 1 loaf of rye bread. Put dip in bread. Use excess bread and the other loaf of bread for dipping.

title: Corny Biscuits
instructions: Mix together and drop teaspoonfuls onto a baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Sift flour salt soda baking powder ginger cloves cinnamon and nutmeg together. Beat shortening sugar and molasses until creamy. Beat in egg yolk. Blend in flour mixture. Chill dough for 1 hour. Roll dough 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut into shapes. Place 1/2-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cookies may be decorated before or after baking as desired.

title: Beaten Biscuits
instructions: Beat forty-five minutes on a block with an axe.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Put 1/2 of cheese in cooled pie crust. Sprinkle drained sausage on cheese. Pour eggs and milk on cheese. Top with remainder of cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 30-45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cheese Filled Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix yeast water and 1 teaspoon sugar. Let stand for 10 minutes. Add egg. Cut margarine into flour and salt. Mix well. Add yeast mixture. Divide into 2 balls. Roll each into an 8 x 10-inch rectangle.

title: Water Chestnuts Wrapped In Bacon
instructions: Wrap bacon around water chestnuts. Secure with a toothpick. Blend remaining ingredients set aside. Broil bacon wrapped water chestnuts until bacon is crisp. Drain and place in oblong dish. Pour sauce over cooked chestnuts and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Bert'S Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
instructions: Put sugar and syrup in a microwaveable bowl and cook on High for 4 minutes. Add peanuts and cook for 4 more minutes. Add butter and vanilla and cook for 1 more minute. Take out of microwave and add baking soda. Stir and pour into a buttered pizza pan. Cool.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
instructions: In a small skillet heat a small amount of oil and brown the onions. Add the ground beef and brown. Drain off the fat. Cook the macaroni according to the package and drain. Add the beef to the mixture along with the soup. Heat through. Transfer to a casserole dish to serve.

title: Butter Nut Chewies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 x 2 pan with Pam. Beat eggs until foamy in large bowl of electric mixer. Beat in sugar vanilla and Crisco (butter) until creamy. Combine flour with baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Mix at low speed until blended. Stir in nuts at low speed (mixture will be stiff). Spread evenly in prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25-30 minutes or until top is light brown. Cool 10-15 minutes and cut into bars. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Bundt Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chips for 2 minutes. Add chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes in Bundt pan.

title: Summer Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs (one at a time) and soda in buttermilk. Add flour. Chop and flour dates nuts and orange slices cut up. Add to mixture. Cook at 250\u00b0 for 2 3/4 hours. Mix orange juice and sugar. Pour over cake and let stand overnight.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
instructions: Slice cucumbers very thin into bowl. Chop onion and add to bowl. Mix salad dressing sugar fresh ground pepper and parsley until creamy in separate bowl. Add to cucumber and marinate for at least two hours in refrigerator.

title: Cauliflower Morocco
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter with juice of 1 lemon. Saute cauliflowerets in butter with garlic basil salt and pepper to taste. Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Butter Crunch
instructions: Melt butter over low heat; add sugar stirring constantly until dissolved. Add water and syrup. Cook on low until brittle (290\u00b0). Remove from heat; stir in walnuts. Spread in greased jellyroll pan; cool until hard. Melt chocolate and pour over crunch; sprinkle with finely chopped nuts. Elevate pan to cool so it doesnt continue to cook.

title: Zucchini Squash Relish
instructions: Sprinkle salt over squash onions and peppers. Let stand overnight. Rinse and drain well. Bring remaining ingredients to a full boil. Pack in sterile jars. Seal.

title: Chicken Bake
instructions: Melt butter; blend in flour. Add milk chicken broth or half and half. Cook until thick. Add the chicken mixture (chicken peas pimientos and mushrooms); season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour into a large shallow baking dish. Cover top with 1 1/2 inch baking powder biscuits press a slice of stuffed olive in center of each and bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes or until biscuits are done.

title: Cold Peach Soup
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender until frothy. Pour into soup bowls. Garnish with nutmeg and mint sprigs. Serve as a side dish to any spicy entree.

title: Seven-Up Cake And Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in greased and floured pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix bread crumbs egg whites and skim milk together. Mix in cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour in dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. High in nutrition.

title: Custard Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice in 1 quart slightly salted water for 20 minutes. Drain and place in a 2-quart casserole. Add other ingredients. Beat with eggbeater only until blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until knife comes out clean.

title: Jalapinto Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Add ground beef and brown. Stir in pinto beans rice and tomatoes. Mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Mix pudding in pineapple juice until dissolved. Add all other ingredients and mix. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Scald milk (do not boil). Stir in margarine cornmeal and salt. Cook stirring constantly until cornmeal comes away from sides of pan and thickens. Set aside. Cool to lukewarm. Add beaten egg yolks and mix well. Fold in beaten egg white. Mix gently but thoroughly. Pour into a greased floured baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: 24 Hour Layered Salad
instructions: Layer each in order.

title: Meat Loaf Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in shortening until red disappears. Add chopped onion green pepper parsley catsup steak sauce tomatoes and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes onions sour cream soup margarine and cheese together. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with cooking spray. Mix cornflakes and 1/4 cup melted margarine. Sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Ham With Gingered Pineapple
instructions: Bake ham on rack in roasting pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until thermometer registers 140\u00b0. Blend juice from pineapple with sugar soy sauce ginger and cornstarch in saucepan. Cook stirring until thickened. Twist pineapple slices and arrange on ham. Brush sauce over pineapple and ham. Bake 30 minutes longer brushing with remaining sauce after 15 minutes.

title: Mexitalian Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine chili drained salsa mushrooms Parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning. In small bowl stir cottage cheese and parsley flakes. Layer noodles cottage cheese chili mixture and Mozzarella cheese in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish coated with vegetable cooking spray; repeat to make three layers. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lasagna is thoroughly heated. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Cook meat and drain well. Spread on bottom of greased casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Mix milk eggs Bisquick salt and pepper in bowl with wire whip. Add onion and pepper; pour over top of meat and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm in middle.

title: Hermits
instructions: Set oven at 400\u00b0. Cream butter and add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Mix other ingredients and add to butter and eggs in 2 or 3 portions mixing until smooth. Drop 2 inches apart on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam by teaspoonfuls. Bake 10 minutes or until nicely browned. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine all of the ingredients. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls 1-inch apart on greased foil lined baking sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from baking sheets immediately or they will stick if allowed to cool on pan. Store covered at room temperature. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Apple Dump Cake
instructions: Dump fruit filling in cake pan. Sprinkle some cinnamon over evenly. Add dry yellow cake mix. Place pats of butter evenly on top. Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Mix peas asparagus and soup and put in casserole bowl. Slice margarine in small pieces and put on top. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Catalina Shell Salad
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Add dressing and marinate in refrigerator with dill weed preferably overnight. Add onions tomatoes and cucumber. Salt and pepper to taste; mix together well. Serve chilled.

title: Old Time Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar milk cocoa salt and syrup to soft ball. Set aside and cool to lukewarm. Add to fudge the butter and vanilla; beat until creamy. Pour on buttered platter.

title: Fruit Filled Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream margarine sugar and extracts; add eggs one at a time. Mix flour and baking powder; add to dough. Mixture will be very thick and stiff. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Place 1/2 of batter in pan; spread with spatula. Spread can of pie filling on batter. Drop rest of batter by spoonfuls leaving space between; batter will spread during baking. Bake 35 minutes until top is browned and tests done. Cool in pan on rack and cut in squares or bars.

title: Coconut Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add remaining ingredients in order given mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Add meat and cook breaking up. Stir in tomatoes tomato sauce sauce mix and V-8 juice. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Frosted Toffee Bars
instructions: In a medium bowl combine oats sugar and margarine; mix well. Spread in a greased 9-inch square pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 13 minutes or until light golden brown; cool. In a small heavy saucepan over low heat (or in microwave) melt chips. Spread over oat mixture; sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate until chocolate is set. Cut into 2 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator. Makes about 2 dozen bars.

title: Apple Cream Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt. Add cream egg and vanilla and beat until smooth. Add apples and pour into unbaked pie shell. Combine flour sugar and cinnamon and cut in butter. Sprinkle this topping on pie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Pour water over 100% Bran and mix in order given. Mixture may be stored in airtight container and baked when needed. Bake in greased muffin pans. Grease lightly even if they are teflon lined. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Use a 3-quart saucepan. Fill 3/4 full of water. Add chicken broth or bouillon cubes. Finely chop carrot onion and celery; add to water and cook until tender. Add cheese. When cheese melts stir in cornstarch mixed with small amount of water. Serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Cool. Remove meat from bone in small chunks. Place in greased casserole dish. Mix 1/2 cup milk with 1 can of chicken soup. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle water chestnuts over chicken. Pour 1/2 cup chicken broth over cornbread stuffing mix and stir. Put on top of casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Christmas Braid
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a little warm water. Mix shortening salt sugar egg vanilla and milk. Add yeast mixture then flour. Mix well. Add raisins candied fruit and nuts. Let rise. Divide into 3 parts. Roll each portion into a long roll. Form into a braid. Let rise until light. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat. Add the next 2 ingredients and refried beans. Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with tortilla chips. Spread meat mixture. Layer chilies and cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve with taco fixings such as chopped lettuce tomato black olives sour cream etc. I top it with crumbled tortilla chips. Enjoy.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Combine shortening and sugar in a bowl and mix. Add eggs. Measure and sift flour baking powder cinnamon and allspice together. Add to shortening sugar and eggs then add milk and jam. Pour into two greased and floured cake pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Put apples in bowl and add next 5 ingredients. Mix. Add dry ingredients and mix. Add nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for minutes.

title: Dinner In A Dish
instructions: In a 2 quart casserole dish place in layers

title: Matilda'S Divinity
instructions: Boil sugar water and salt to 250\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Put Marshmallow Creme in large bowl. Pour sugar syrup slowly over Creme while stirring. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour in a buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat together sugar pumpkin oil and eggs. Sift together flour soda salt and spices; mix well with egg mixture. Add raisins nuts and water. Pour into well-greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes. Turn out on rack to cool completely before cutting.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix the ingredients together and then put into graham cracker crust shell. You may sprinkle a few graham cracker crumbs on top. Do not freeze. Chill in the refrigerator for a few hours. Serves 1 to 4.

title: Rice Stroganoff
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan melt margarine. Add mushrooms scallions and garlic and\tsaute over medium heat until mushrooms are just tender 1 to 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except rice and sour cream and bring mixture to a boil. Add rice and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low cover and cook until\tliquid is absorbed and rice is tender 10 to 15 minutes. Stir\tin sour cream and serve immediately. Healthy. Makes 4 servings with 160 calories per serving.

title: Versatile French Dressing
instructions: For pizza sauce add oregano and basil.

title: Mamma Mia Basic Pizza Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water and add oil. Sift flour and salt into bowl. Add yeast mixture and knead until smooth (approximately 10 minutes). Cover. Let rise in warm place approximately 2 hours (until double in size).

title: Mustard Greens
instructions: Prepare mustards for cooking by stripping the stalk out. Wash leaves thoroughly and cut them up. Add to pot. Fry out your salt pork in pot you are going to cook the mustards. Add water and sugar; cook until tender.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 dry ingredients together. Mix oil and sugar separately. Add the eggs and vanilla; stir. Add dry ingredients to oil sugar and egg mixture then add apples and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes in Bundt pan.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat; add dry ingredients. Mix well. Add cereals and coconut. Mix. Roll into small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet 3 inches apart. Press with fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove quickly; cool on rack. Do not overcook.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix in bowl on high the shortening butter sugar brown sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix until it tastes more like butter than sugar about 5 minutes. Then add rest of the ingredients by hand. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Apricot Nectar Pound Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Mix together and put in Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until springs back when touched.

title: Chinese Lemon Chicken
instructions: Combine dry jello garlic salt and mustard. Add melted margarine. Mix well. Place mixture in oblong baking dish. Arrange chicken in single layer turning to coat both sides. Sprinkle with almond slices; cover. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes basting once. Remove cover; baste again and bake 15 more minutes or until done.

title: Mushroom Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate crescent roll dough into triangles. Place on cookie sheet; pinch seams together. Toss sliced mushrooms in melted butter to coat. Arrange mushrooms on top of dough. Sprinkle with cheese and Italian seasoning. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut into wedges or squares. Serve warm. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: In small pieces tear apart dried beef. Mix together both cheeses dried beef and onions. After mixed together form into a small ball and roll in nuts. Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake slowly in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Golden Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients and add a large can of water. May use a juice can. Stir. Add ginger ale before serving.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Add jello to fruit then add cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Blend well and chill about 2 hours.

title: Beer Batter
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add beer to desired consistency. Excellent for fish or vegetable batter. Deep fry at 350\u00b0.

title: Taco Party Tray
instructions: Blend avocado cream cheese sour cream milk lemon juice and salt. Spread evenly on dinner plate. Layer the rest of the ingredients on top. Serve with chips.

title: Jordan Marsh Blueberry
instructions: Cream sugar and butter until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Add berries. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in greased muffin pans.

title: Easy Making Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter peanut butter and sugars. Beat in syrup and vanilla. Sift and beat in flour and baking powder. Stir in oatmeal and coconut. Use greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Kraut Slaw
instructions: Mix kraut onion bell pepper celery and pimentos. Pour sugar over vegetables and stir. Cover and refrigerate overnight (24 hours). Next day drain real good stir to help with the draining. When drained good add the oil and vinegar. Keep covered will keep several weeks in refrigerator.

title: Hot Deviled Potatoes
instructions: Prepare 2 servings potatoes to package directions. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into 2 foil baking shells. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until heated thoroughly. Makes 2 servings.

title: Divinitygreely, Colorado
instructions: Boil syrup water and sugar until it spins a thread. Pour over beaten egg white and continue beating until gloss is gone. Add vanilla and walnuts. Pour onto greased platter to cool.

title: Chicken Wing Appetizers
instructions: Place chicken wings in single layer in shallow roasting pan. Mix remaining ingredients together. Heat on top of stove until sugar is dissolved. Pour sauce over chicken wings. Place uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven and bake for approximately 2 hours. Turn wings occasionally. After first hour check frequently to prevent burning. Wings are done when sauce is thick and bubbly.

title: Nacho Bisque Potatoes
instructions: Place Tater Tots in a 9 x 12-inch dish or pan. Pour the cheese soup that has been mixed with the milk over the potatoes. Next pour the tomato bisque soup that has been mixed with the water over the nacho cheese soup. Mix soups with spoon gently (do not disturb potatoes). Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour or so until Tater Tots test soft and are lightly browned and soups are thickened. Serve hot. Stir slightly when removed from the oven and ready to serve.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour and set aside. In large mixing bowl beat egg whites until foaming. Add cream of tartar and vanilla extract. Beat until very stiff but not dry. Add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time and continue to beat. Using spatula fold in flour. Pour batter into 10-inch ungreased tube pan. Using a knife pop bubbles. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: In a microwave or in a double boiler on the stovetop melt peanut butter chocolate chips and margarine together. Stir until smooth. Pour over cereal and stir until all is coated. Put confectioners sugar in a clean bag and pour in cereal. Close bag and shake until all cereal is covered.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage over medium heat. Drain fat. Place sausage in a greased 2 quart casserole dish.

title: Chicken Pasta Skillet
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet combine soup milk and mustard. Over medium heat heat to boiling. Stir in broccoli. Return to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook for 5 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Stir in pasta and chicken. Heat through stirring occasionally. Garnish with red pepper slices.

title: Apple Pandowdy(Sugar Free)
instructions: Peel core and slice apples; place in bottom of 9-inch square baking dish. Combine flour salt vinegar and water in saucepan and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla butter and brown sugar replacement; pour mixture over apple slices.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed; split to make 3 layers. Dissolve Jell-O in two cups boiling water. Add 2 cups strawberries juice and strawberry glaze. Place in refrigerator until mixture thickens. Mix pudding as directed. Place 1 layer of cake in bowl layer of Jell-O mixture and a layer of pudding. Repeat until all is used. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Molasses Oatmeal Pancake Or Waffle
instructions: Heat milk and molasses in saucepan to 110\u00b0. Pour over oatmeal in large mixing bowl. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake as directed in waffler or as pancake until bubbly; toss and bake until golden.

title: Aunt Emma'S Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Debone cooked chicken and place in large casserole dish. Mix together soups onions celery and pour over chicken. Then mix sage dry corn bread mix milk and eggs. Pour over chicken mixture. Then add 3 cups chicken broth over this.\t(Looks like too much.)\tBake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Heavenly Delight
instructions: Mix together ingredients and refrigerate. Let set until chilled.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Cut cake in half when cool. Crumble half in bottom of punch bowl. Mix one box instant pudding mix with milk as directed and pour over cake. Drain 1 can crushed pineapple and pour over pudding. Spread 1 can cherry pie filling over pineapple. Spread 1 tub Cool Whip over cherry pie filling. Repeat entire process and top with nuts and maraschino cherries.

title: Shrimp Santa Fe
instructions: Mix all ingredients except shrimp or fish and picante sauce. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Stir in shrimp or fish. Continue to bake for another 30 minutes. Add picante sauce. Bake for 30 more minutes. Serve with rice and toasted French bread.

title: Brown Sugar Franks
instructions: Wrap each frank with a slice of bacon. Marinate in mixture of butter and brown sugar overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut into bite sizes and secure with toothpick.

title: Turkey Crunch Casserole
instructions: Mix together turkey eggs mushrooms celery almonds and onion. In another bowl mix together the soup and Miracle Whip. Toss with the turkey mixture and turn into a two-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with chow mein noodles.

title: Cranberry Pear Crisp
instructions: In lightly greased 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish thoroughly mix cranberries pears granulated sugar cinnamon and 1 tablespoon of flour; set aside. In a medium bowl mix remaining 3 tablespoons flour with the brown sugar. With a pastry blender cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in oats and nuts; sprinkle evenly over fruit mixture. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Let stand at least 10 minutes before serving. Serve plain or with milk. Serves eight. Per serving without milk 331 calories 4 g protein 52 g carbohydrates 14 g fat 74 mg sodium.

title: Honey Cake
instructions: Sift flour. Measure and sift with baking powder baking soda spices and salt. Beat eggs until thick and light about 5 minutes. Add sugar gradually beating well. Add honey coffee and shortening. Blend well. Add dry ingredients. Beat until well blended. Sprinkle nuts on bottom of greased and waxed paper lined 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 35 to 40 minutes or until done. Let stand in pan 5 minutes then turn out on rack. Cut into squares. Yield 24 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Add together sugar eggs and oil; stir. Add cinnamon salt and baking soda; stir. Add flour and mix well. Add apples and nuts. Pour into baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Warmed Oysters
instructions: Have oysters opened at market. Place oysters in deeper half shell in aluminum foil pan. Cut lemon juice to each oyster. Add small amount of water to bottom of pan. Cover with aluminum foil. Barbecue over low direct heat for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Stir first 5 ingredients well. Stir in pecan pieces. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes depending on oven or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Penuche Candy
instructions: Combine and cook to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and beat in 1 cup chopped nuts and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Pour into buttered pan. Cool.

title: Bean Hamburger Dish
instructions: Brown bacon and hamburger. Add onions. Mix other ingredients except beans. Drain kidney beans and rinse. Drain butter beans. Add them and the pork and beans to rest of mixture. Can be cooked in crock-pot or roaster.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs
instructions: Mix together. Refrigerate overnight. Shape into eggs; dip in chocolate.

title: Green Bean Bundles
instructions: Gather approximately 10 beans into a bundle and wrap with 1/2 bacon strip. Lay seam side down in glass 9 x 13 inch pan. Continue making bundles until pan is full. Top with marinade cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in oleo until soft. Set aside. Heat soups and Cheez Whiz. Add rice and broccoli to vegetables. Add soup to mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Quick Tamale Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onion in fat. Add ground beef and brown. Place uncooked noodles over beef. Combine juice and seasonings. Pour over noodles. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add green pepper. Cover and cook 10 minutes more. Stir in sour cream before serving. Heat but do not boil.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Very good with chili.

title: Impossible Lasagne Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie pan (10 x 1 1/2-inches). Cook and stir beef until brown; drain. Stir in oregano basil tomato paste and 1/2 cup of Mozzarella cheese. Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in pan.\tSpoon beef mixture over top. Beat milk Bisquick mix eggs salt and pepper until smooth 1 minute with mixer.\tPour into pan.\tBake until knife comes out clean 30\tto 35\tminutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cool 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Anne'S Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
instructions: Place sugar brown sugar butter eggs and vanilla in bowl; mix thoroughly. Sift flour salt and baking soda together. Gradually add flour mixture to sugar mixture. Mix until well blended. Add chocolate chips and blend into mix with a spoon. Spread onto a 12 x 14-inch baking pan (greased). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until edges are lightly browned. Cool and then cut into squares. Keep in airtight container.

title: Orange Congealed Salad
instructions: Put pineapple in a pan and bring to a boil. Add jello and mix well. Let cool. Add buttermilk nuts and Cool Whip. Mix well. Pour into a large dish. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together hash browns onions cheese sour cream soup one stick margarine (melted) and pepper to taste. Cover top with bread crumbs and pour other stick of margarine melted over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Mix the persimmon pulp with the soda. Mix all ingredients together and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Caribbean Fudge Pie
instructions: Beat oleo and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add chocolate and instant coffee. Mix well. Stir in flour and walnuts. Bake in lower third of oven for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Top with ice cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry. Place the flour salt pepper cinnamon nutmeg and garlic powder in a shallow baking dish; stir to distribute all the ingredients evenly.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and spread into an 8 x 8-inch square cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for around 40 minutes. Recipe may be doubled for a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Green Pepper Pickles
instructions: Wash peppers. Stem and cut into lengthwise strips discarding seeds. Mix 4 cups vinegar and 1 cup water. Pack pepper strips into jars cover with vinegar mixture add 1 tablespoon salt to each jar and put on lid tightly. Invert for 1 hour; then store. Ready for use in 3 months. Keeps unopened and unrefrigerated for more than 2 years.

title: Patio Potato Salad
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine milk sugar vinegar 1 egg butter cornstarch salt celery seed and dry mustard. Cook and stir over low heat until thickened. Remove from heat; blend in onion and mayonnaise. Cool. Combine potatoes and hard-cooked eggs; carefully fold in dressing. Chill. Just before serving sprinkle with paprika. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt into a bowl. Cut shortening in until fine. Stir in milk to a soft dough. Knead slightly on a floured board. Roll out and cut or pat into shape. Bake in a preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cocoa Cola Cake
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in a 2 1/2-quart bowl; set aside. Combine butter cocoa and cola in a 2-cup glass measuring cup. Microwave at High 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Stir cola mixture into flour and sugar. Add buttermilk egg soda vanilla and marshmallows; beat well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spread marshmallows evenly in batter. Microwave at High 10 to 12 minutes; rotate dish 1/4 turn at 2-minute intervals. Frost cake while hot with Chocolate Cola Frosting.

title: Pinch Coffeecake
instructions: Put rolls in Bundt pan. Sprinkle with sugar and pudding. Dribble butter over all. Let rise overnight. Cook for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Raspberry Jam
instructions: Boil tomatoes and sugar 20 minutes. Add Jell-O. Boil 1 minute. Put into jars/containers and refrigerate.

title: Small Chocolate Pie
instructions: Heat milk in double boiler. Beat eggs; add dry ingredients a small amount at a time and mix thoroughly. Add to heated milk; cook until thickened. Take off heat; add chips butter and vanilla. Have ready small baked pie crust. Beat remaining egg whites (1 additional egg white will make more meringue); add 1 tablespoon sugar for each egg white. Pour chocolate mixture in pie crust; top with meringue and bake until brown in 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix flour baking powder soda salt and pecans and set aside. Melt butter; add sugar and eggs. Beat well. Add vanilla then add dry ingredients and mix. Pour into pan and place chocolate chips on top of batter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Molasses Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt and spices. Cream the shortening. Beat in sugar. Blend in egg and molasses. Beat well. Stir in sifted ingredients. Fold in raisins and rolled oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on lightly greased or Pam sprayed cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Let stand 1 minute. Remove to cooling rack.

title: Harvest Loaf Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Combine flour with soda salt and spices. Cream butter and sugar; cream well. Blend in eggs; beat well. At low speed add dry ingredients alternately with pumpkin beginning and ending with dry. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes. Let stand at least 6 hours before slicing.

title: Kahlua Cheesecake
instructions: For crust blend cookie crumbs with 1/3 cup sugar and melted butter. Press firmly over bottom and halfway up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Crab Ball
instructions: Mix and shape into ball. Refrigerate. When ready to serve spread cocktail sauce on ball. Serve with crackers. This appetizer is so easy and great for entertaining.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding according to directions on box. Add the sour cream and mix well. Add 1/2 container Cool Whip and mix well. Layer pudding bananas cookies and continue layering in this manner until all pudding is gone. Top the entire pudding with Cool Whip. Refrigerate. (The colder the better.)

title: Texas Pecan Pie
instructions: This recipe will make 1 deep pecan pie or 2 small pecan pies.

title: Honey Butter
instructions: Whip together butter and yolks. Gradually add honey and vanilla; beat until quite stiff. Store in refrigerator. Use on fruit bread French toast waffles and pancakes.

title: Potato Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine cheese salt and potatoes. Form into balls. Roll in bread crumbs. Dip in egg blended with milk. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and shred. Put on inside of crescent roll and roll up. Mix soup and milk together. Put crescent rolls in baking dish and pour soup mixture over. Put cheddar or american cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with season salt. If using mushrooms lay a slice on the tenderloin and roll up. Wrap a slice of bacon around the bundle and secure with a toothpick.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Prepare vegetables according to package. Saute onion and celery in 2 tablespoons butter. Pour into baking dish. Using same pan make a sauce with 2 tablespoons butter milk and soup. Add shredded cheese until melted. Add sauce to vegetables. Toss and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Can be made ahead. Refrigerate and bake when ready.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook cut up onions in oil until soft. Add all other ingredients. Simmer about 1/2 hour.

title: Good Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Cajun Chicken Strips
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bag; add chicken and shake. Cook in butter 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Copper Carrots
instructions: Boil carrots briefly in salted water until barely tender. Drain. Slice onion and pepper and layer with carrots. Mix all remaining ingredients and heat until sugar dissolves. Pour over vegetables and store in refrigerator. Serve cold. Keeps several weeks.

title: Reese Imposters
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar butter and peanut butter. Mix until smooth. Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips in double boiler or microwave. Spread over dough. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares.

title: The Magic Muffin
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Butter 8 muffin cups. Mix oat bran baking powder cinnamon and salt (optional) in a bowl. Stir in almonds. In separate bowl combine milk egg honey and chopped apple. Make a well in dry ingredients and add milk mixture. Stir just until moistened. Spoon into prepared muffin cups. Bake for 15 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Place ground beef in casserole dish with onion. Place potatoes on top. Mix cream of chicken soup with 1/2 can of water; pour over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Chowder
instructions: Cook chicken in water with tomatoes for about 45 minutes. Remove bones and skin from chicken and cut into small pieces. Put chicken back into the broth and add all ingredients except milk. Cook over medium-low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Stir occasionally to avoid sticking. Add milk when done. Yields 5 quarts.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except milk. Add enough milk to form balls. Drop from teaspoon into hot fat. Cook until well browned and cooked through. Serve hot.

title: Cran-Ale Punch
instructions: Mix cranberry juice and lemonade in large punch bowl. Just before serving pour in ginger ale. Serves 25.

title: Homestyle Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni. Mix other ingredients with macaroni. Sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Moma'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Add crushed pecans to top of mixture and dot with butter. Bake for 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Grated Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix syrup and milk in a large bowl; add potatoes. Beat eggs and butter. Combine 2 mixtures. Add other ingredients and mix. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done. Serves 12.

title: Glazed Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form into baseball size balls. Place in shallow baking dishes sprayed with Pam. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Glaze with Brown Sugar Glaze below and bake 20 minutes. Makes 12 meatballs. Leftovers can be frozen and are great microwaved.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 3325 degrees. In large mixing bowl beat eggs until foamy. Beat in flour sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Beat in softened butter. Stir in chocolate morsels. Pour into pie shell and bake 55 to 60 mins.

title: Corny Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except margarine and crackers. Mix the melted margarine and the crushed Ritz crackers. Put this mixture on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Swiss Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except walnuts. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle with walnuts. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Put in icebox to set.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix butter sugar and syrup. Bring to a boil over low heat. Beat eggs gradually. Add syrup mixture. Mix in nuts salt and vanilla. Pour into crust and bake about 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Waldorf Salad
instructions: Toss ingredients together. Serve on a bed of lettuce with dressing.

title: Chippy Blond Brownies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream margarine and brown sugar. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Beat in vanilla. Combine the flour baking powder and salt; gradually add to the creamed mixture. Stir in the chocolate chips and pecans. Spread into a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Pickled Shrimp
instructions: Place shrimp in boiling salted water. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender. Drain and rinse with cold water then chill. Make alternate layers of shrimp and onion rings in a sealable container. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp and onions. Seal and place in refrigerator for 6 hours or more shaking or inverting occasionally. Drain and serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: One Dish Meal
instructions: Grease a 2-quart casserole. Spread rice on bottom. Mix flour chili powder salt and pepper. Spread over rice. Dot with 1/2 tablespoon butter. Mix beef and onions and put over rice. Repeat. Pour over the layers the tomatoes with liquid. Spread corn on top and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate. Better if stands for awhile.

title: Mexican Squash
instructions: Melt margarine in a large skillet. Add onion and cubed pork. Cook until pork is tender. Add other ingredients. Season with garlic salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into a large baking pan. Cover with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Delicious Muffins
instructions: Add dry ingredients to egg and milk. Just before blended add melted shortening. Fold in cereal. Bake 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in bread pans.

title: Silky Meringue
instructions: Beat with an electric mixer on high speed for 1 minute or until soft peaks form (tips curl) when beaters are lifted out. A hand mixer works fine but beating time may be slightly longer. At soft peak stage add sugar slowly while beating egg whites so that sugar dissolves. Beat 7 minutes or until stiff peaks form (tips stand straight). Spread the meringue over hot pie filling to avoid leakage between filling and meringue. Also seal the crust well to prevent leakage and shrinking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Everyday Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in milk. Add meat eggs onion and seasonings; mix well. Form in single loaf in 4 3/4 x 8 3/4-inch loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. In 30 minutes spread some ketchup on top and continue baking. Or the recipe calls for a Piquant sauce that can be spread on meat loaf before you bake it.

title: Crab On Deck
instructions: Put margarine and cheese in bowl; microwave until soft. Drain crab. Mix all ingredients together. Spread onto English muffins; partially freeze them. Cut into pieces and freeze for appetizers. When ready to eat broil until golden and eat.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix sugar butter corn syrup and salt in pan. Boil and cook 5 minutes (candy thermometer 250\u00b0) and add vanilla. Pour over popcorn and mix well. Bake in a 225\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring at 15 minute intervals.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes; peel and slice when cool enough. Chop onions fine; add to warm potatoes. Dice bacon and fry crisp. Remove from grease and put on the warm potatoes. To the grease add the flour and brown slightly. Add the rest of the ingredients and boil until thick. Pour over potatoes and stir well. Best if served warm. This will serve 15 to 20 people.

title: Individual Ham Loaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form it in small loaves in shallow pan. Mix brown sugar water mustard and vinegar to make a sauce. Pour sauce over; cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove foil. Baste a couple times with sauce.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put all of the ingredients into a blender and mix well until ice cubes are crushed.

title: Cinnamon Ring Cucumbers
instructions: Soak cucumbers for 24 hours in lime and enough water to cover. Drain and soak for 3 hours in clean clear water. Drain. Simmer for 2 hours in 1 cup white vinegar red food coloring and enough water to cover. Drain.

title: Broken Glass Torte
instructions: Dissolve each box of jello in 1 cup of hot water and 3/4 cup of cold water and pour into square cake pans; let set. Cut in 1/2 inch cubes. Soften gelatin in cold water and dissolve in hot pineapple juice; let thicken slightly. Whip cream add sugar and vanilla combine with gelatin and pineapple juice and fold in jello cubes.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown beef; add all ingredients and warm. Serve on hamburger buns. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Cook chuck with onion and pepper until done; drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a crock-pot; turn on high until well heated then turn on low and cook 4 to 5 hours.

title: Mushroom Sandwiches
instructions: Saute mushrooms with butter or margarine. Add the cream and salt to taste. Thicken with flour (mix flour with water). While cooking add the Worcestershire sauce to hot mixture and then refrigerate overnight to thicken. Use to make tea sandwiches.

title: Sweet Dill Pickles
instructions: Drain pickle slices and return pickles to jar. Boil sugar vinegar and celery seed. Pour over dill slices. Refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving.

title: American Flag Cake
instructions: Line bottom of 9 by 13-inch baking dish with pound cake slices. Top with 1 c. of the strawberries and 1 c. of the blueberries. Then spread cool whip on top evenly. Use the remaining strawberries to make the strips of the flag and the remaining blueberries to make the stars of the flag. Chill and enjoy OLD GLORY!-

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in soup in top of double boiler or crock-pot. Add remaining ingredients. Serve warm with tortilla chips. Yields approximately 3 pints.

title: Barbecued Lima Beans
instructions: Using a large skillet fry bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towel. Use 1 tablespoon grease to saute onion. Add Worcestershire sauce horseradish and catsup and stir. Add lima beans tomato soup and bacon bits. Stir well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered. Serves 6 to 8. Very tasty.

title: Baked Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Butter shallow 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix together sugar flour and 3 tablespoons of the drained pineapple juice (it makes a paste). Pour in casserole and spread. Place pineapple chunks on top of paste. Cover pineapple with cheese. Mix cracker crumbs with melted margarine and sprinkle on top of cheese. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Raw Onions
instructions: Cover onions with cold water. Let stand 1 hour changing water every 15 minutes (this takes the bite away from raw onion). Drain. Mix rest of ingredients. Put into 2-quart covered dish or jar. Chill at least 24 hours stirring occasionally to mix well. Makes 2 quarts. Good with steak and good in sandwiches.

title: Hot And Spicy Shrimp
instructions: Mix butter and oil in flame-proof baking dish. Add all spices and lemon juice. Bring to a boil then decrease heat and simmer 10 minutes stirring frequently. Remove from heat and let the flavors marry for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Combine all together. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0. Later cover with egg whites.

title: Honeybun Cake
instructions: Mix together brown sugar cinnamon and pecans. Set aside. Mix together cake mix eggs oil sugar and sour cream. Pour half of mixture into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Pour half of brown sugar/cinnamon mixture over cake batter. Add remaining cake batter and then remaining brown sugar mixture. With fork swirl brown sugar/cinnamon mixture into batter several times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Mix powdered sugar milk and vanilla; pour on top to glaze.

title: Blanche'S Pickle Ginny
instructions: Let green tomatoes stand overnight; drain then peel tomatoes; grind peppers celery cabbage and onions. Add brown sugar horseradish pepper mustard seed and vinegar. Boil 15 minutes and seal in hot jars.

title: Vegetables Confetti
instructions: Cover bottom of an 11 x 17-inch ungreased pan with rolls spread out flat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes until lightly browned. Cool. Mix the cream cheese sour cream mayonnaise and salad dressing mix; spread over baked rolls. Mix diced vegetables together; sprinkle over the cream cheese mixture. Cover with plastic wrap; press vegetables down into cream cheese. Keep covered. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Cut into small bars.

title: Pig Pickin' Cake
instructions: Mix together oil cake mix eggs and mandarin oranges. Pour batter into greased and floured cake pans (2 or 3). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes (about 20 minutes if using 3 layers) or until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Cool on wire racks.

title: White Bread And Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; add 1 tablespoon of sugar. Let stand in a warm place for 45 minutes. Beat in the remaining ingredients adding flour gradually. Place in a well-greased bowl. Let stand until doubled in size; knead well. Shape into loaves or rolls. Let rise again approximately 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Makes 3 - 8 inch layers 2 - 9 inch layers or 1 - 9 x 13 2 cake. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done. Cool cake well before icing. Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake your choice of yellow cake. While cake is baking put evaporated milk flavoring and sugar in a measuring cup. Add enough water to make 2 cups. Whip by hand.

title: Double Batch Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening sugars vanilla water and egg until light and fluffy. Add flour soda and salt. Stir in nuts and chips. Drop from a teaspoon on greased baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 100.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage in frying pan. Drain off fat. In saucepan melt the Velveeta. Once melted add soup and Ro-Tel. Pour ingredients from saucepan to a crock-pot. Stir in meat mixture and chopped onion. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Anne'S Italian Biscuits
instructions: Make a well in flour and mix in remaining ingredients. Divide dough in half. Make 2 long loaves and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove and cut in diagonal slices. Return to a cookie sheet laying slices on cut side. Return to oven to toast approximately 5 minutes.

title: Apple Caramel Salad
instructions: Mix pudding pineapple and juice. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well and chill.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump above ingredients in order into a ungreased 11x13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Drain pineapple and add to cream cheese. Use 7-Up to mix Jell-O in place of cold water. Mix cream mixture in Jell-O. When Jell-O begins to harden (or congeal) sprinkle nuts on top or in cream mixture. Place in refrigerator until firm and ready to serve. Orange Jell-O is also good with this.

title: Crazy Pie
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar. Blend in shortening and water. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed with electric blender. Pour batter into a 9-inch pie pan. Do not spread. Pour favorite pie filling in center of batter. Do not stir. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 425\u00b0 preheated oven.

title: Chocolate Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour sugar and cocoa in ungreased 2 quart pan (9 x 9). In a small bowl mix milk butter and vanilla; add to flour mixture and stir with a fork until mixed and smooth. Stir in nuts and spread the dough evenly in the pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa. Pour hot water over batter. Do not stir. Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Scrod Putanesca
instructions: In saucepan or large skillet add oil and garlic; simmer for 5 minutes. Add all other ingredients except scrod and angel hair; simmer for 25 to 30 minutes. Wash scrod in cold water and towel dry. Add to tomato mixture.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into small greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Cover bottom of dish with slices of beef. Wrap 1 strip of bacon around rolled half of chicken breast. Put 8 pieces of breast in casserole or pan which has been lined with 1 layer of beef. Mix sauce of sour cream and soup and pour over chicken. Cook uncovered for 3 hours at 300\u00b0. The bacon and beef will be almost absorbed and chicken crisp brown outside and succulent inside.

title: Hermits
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix brown sugar shortening coffee egg soda salt and spices. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about ten minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed; drain. Beat eggs and mix with broccoli soup cheese mayonnaise and onion. Add melted margarine with ground crackers and place on top of casserole. Bake 25 minutes at 400\u00b0 in 2 1/2-quart casserole. Serves 8.

title: Baby Pearl Tapioca
instructions: Bring to a boil the water and salt. Add tapioca. Bring back to good boil again cover and turn off heat. Let set covered an hour or longer until balls are clear. Add Jell-O and sugar. Stir until dissolved. Chill. When ready to serve add whipped cream and any fruit desired. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan stir together 1 cup sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in water until smooth. Stir in egg yolks stirring constantly. Bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in next two ingredients. Pour into pastry shell and top with egg whites beaten stiff.

title: Company Vegetable Casserole
instructions: In a bowl combine beans corn soup sour cream cheese and onions. Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.

title: Pepper Biscuits
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup warm water with yeast and let stand about 1/2 minute before mixing in the flour. Then add all ingredients mix well and knead for about 10 minutes. Make small rolls and let rise in warm place for about 4 hours. Roll out small pieces of dough by hand into size of a cigarette and about 16 to 18 inches long twist and make round circles and brush with beaten egg. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Party Munchies
instructions: Mix together oil dill weed lemon pepper and dressing. Add crackers. Put in large bowl; stir occasionally. Store in airtight container.

title: Bacon Roll-Ups
instructions: Cut bread slices in half; cover bread with soup. Roll up and take one piece of bacon and wrap around bread and stick together with toothpick. Put on broiler pan and bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 until bacon is cooked.

title: Del'S Crab Dip
instructions: Very easy! Just combine ingredients and serve surrounded by crackers. Japanese rice crackers are the best. I love this dip!

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Spread each tortilla with cheese; heat until melted. In a bowl toss chicken with salsa peppers and onions. Spoon 1/2 cup mixture into each tortilla. Roll up tightly. Makes 24.

title: Mandarin Duck Salad
instructions: In small skillet melt margarine over medium-low heat. Add almonds. Cook until light golden brown stirring constantly. Remove from heat; cool.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes then at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Cook lasagne noodles until tender. Drain on paper towel. Brown meat; drain off excess grease. Add spaghetti sauce and oregano. Blend eggs and cottage cheese together. Spread thin layer of meat mixture in 8 x 11-inch pan. Layer of noodles all of egg mixture noodles then rest of meat mixture. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Funnel Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine eggs and milk. Sift in flour powder and salt. Beat until smooth. Pour mixture through funnel into hot oil in skillet. Cook until golden brown turn carefully with tongs and/or spatula and cook one more minute. Drain excess fat. Dust with powdered sugar. Serve hot with honey or syrup for dipping.

title: Hash Browns
instructions: Layer 3/4 stick of margarine hash browns onion sour cream and chicken soup (mixed together) and cheese. Toss the corn flakes with 1 stick of margarine and use for top layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Bonbons
instructions: Empty boxes of sugar into large bowl. Mash out the lumps then add milk and melted butter; mix well. Add coconut. (May be easier to mix with hands.) Place in freezer for 1 hour then roll into small balls. Put back in freezer for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Square Dance Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients together for 5 minutes. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan greased and floured. Pour 1/2 of batter in pan then add 1/2 of topping then remaining batter then remaining topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: In covered 5-quart Dutch oven over medium heat simmer potatoes onions celery cloves garlic salt bay leaf dill seed and 1 cup water for about 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Discard cloves. Add fish 1 cup water and remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling; reduce heat to low. Cover simmer 5 to 10 minutes until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Garnish with parsley.

title: Buffalo Swingers Wings
instructions: Fry unbreaded Wingflingers according to directions. Melt margarine and stir in remaining ingredients. Coat cooked Wingflingers with sauce and bake 10 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0. Serve with Blue cheese dressing celery sticks and carrot sticks.

title: Tracey'S Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine broth potato and carrots in soup pot; bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes. Add rest of ingredients; cook on low for 15 minutes or until all ingredients are soft.

title: Patsy'S Christmas Cherry Salad
instructions: Beat cream cheese at room temperature until fluffy. Add reserved juice from cherries. Add remaining ingredients and fold together. Chill in refrigerator 6 to 8 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
