instructions: Boil broccoli in another pot. Drain. Put Cheez Whiz and melt. Add soup and broccoli. Put in dish and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown. Serves 10.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook diced Chicken until tender let cool for 1 hour. Combine Chicken Celery Eggs Onion Relish Mayonnaise Salt and Pepper. Toss together. Cut the tops off the Tomatoes scoop out a portion of the pulp and discard; fill each tomato with a portion of the Chicken Salad and put each Tomato on a portion of the shredded Lettuce. Chill for 1/2 hour in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop on cookie sheet with teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake until firm and brown.

title: Dad'S Meat Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Layer in microwavable pie pan; soft shell beans Cheddar cheese Mozzarella cheese and picante sauce. Layer again and cover with shell. Microwave for 10 minutes or bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with more picante sauce; serve.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken; remove from broth and cool. Save broth. Debone chicken. Cook 12 to 16 ounces spaghetti in chicken broth until tender. Do not drain. When spaghetti is tender add onion and green pepper which have been sauteed in butter. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and Velveeta cheese which have been cubed. Add chicken. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Spicy Pecans
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in deep 3-quart casserole. Cover with wax paper. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir well. Microwave again for 2 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes or until soft ball stage. Add pecans and stir to coat. Spread on wax paper and cool.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
instructions: Put brown sugar butter half and half and salt into a 1-quart glass measuring pitcher. Cook uncovered in a microwave oven 2 minutes at High or until sugar dissolves and butter melts. Stir until blended. Cook uncovered for 45 seconds at High or until sauce comes to boiling.

title: Mrs. Logan'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine butter and sugar until light and smooth. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Fill sugar box with flour (to rim). Add to above mixture and beat well. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Grease tube pan. Add batter; shake down. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Mix together and pour into 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Spaghetti With Marinara Sauce
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan cook onion carrots and garlic in hot oil until tender but not brown. Add undrained tomatoes sugar salt oregano pepper and red pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 45 to 60 minutes or to desired consistency. Cook pasta in large amount of boiling salted water until tender; drain well. Serve with tomato mixture. Serves 8.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Dry frankfurters and dip into combined ingredients. Fry until golden brown. Serves 10.

title: St. Louis Style Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream together peanut butter sugar and cream\tcheese. Blend in 2/3 carton Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Drizzle chocolate syrup over top. Refrigerate for 2 hours until firm. Top with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in a little salted water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup and milk; stir in carrots. Fold in drained squash and onion. Combine stuffing and butter. Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mix on top. Sprinkle remaining stuffing mix over vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes or until heated.

title: Hot Crawfish Dip
instructions: Saute green onions in butter. Stir in flour. Add crawfish tails and fat; continue to saute. Stir in mushrooms and seasoning. Fold in sour cream just before serving. Keep hot in chafing dish. To freeze omit sour cream and add when ready to serve.

title: Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill until ready to serve. Makes 1 cup of sauce.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Add egg buttermilk and onion. Mix well. Drop batter by rounded teaspoons into deep hot grease (375\u00b0). Cook turning frequently about 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Nell And Maxine Cheese Spread
instructions: Beat with mixer. Very good on rye bread. Can be made ahead of time and refrigerated.

title: Crab Souffle
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan place 1/2 of cubed bread. Mix crab onion mayonnaise almonds celery and green pepper. Put over bread. Put rest of bread on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and dash of salt. Cook until clear. Add jello. Stir until dissolved. Cool. Add strawberries. Pour into baked pie shell. Refrigerate. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease cookie sheets. Work butter in a bowl until creamy. Add sugars and beat well. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Blend in water and peanut butter. Gradually add dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Crisscross with fork. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients well and stir in chocolate chips; leave in bowl. Sift together flour sugar cocoa baking soda and salt. Beat water oil vinegar and vanilla. Combine with flour mixture. Pour into greased and floured square or tube pan. Spoon cheese mixture lightly on top spreading with knife as you go. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Sift confectioners sugar on top of cake.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy; add condensed milk. Mix. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla; pour into crust. Chill 2 hours. Top with cherry pie filling just before serving.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour butter and cheese. Add salt pepper sauce and Rice Krispies. Roll into small balls and flatten with a fork dipped in cold water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes. Bake on ungreased pan. Makes a great snack.

title: White Bread
instructions: Put sugar shortening and salt in a bowl. Pour boiling water on top. Stir to dissolve. Cool to lukewarm and add yeast which has been dissolved in 1/4 cup lukewarm water. Add 4 cups flour and beat thoroughly. Add remaining flour gradually and mix to a dough that wont stick. Knead lightly on floured surface 8 to 10 minutes. Place in a greased bowl; cover closely and let rise in a warm place until doubled 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Punch down or knead 2 minutes to reduce to original size. Let rise again until doubled about 1 hour. Knead down; divide in 4 portions and let rest 10 to 15 minutes. Mold in loaves; place in greased pans. Cover loosely and set in warm place to double (about 1 hour). Bake in a hot 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar. Add well beaten eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Chill thoroughly. Roll out on well floured board and cut with your favorite cookie cutter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes on well-greased cookie sheet. Yields 4 or 5 dozen.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Break up saltines. Mix all other ingredients except cracker meal. Let stand until crackers are moist. Add crabmeat; roll in cracker meal. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen medium crab cakes. Let stand in refrigerator at least an hour before frying.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix margarine and cheese with a mixer. Add remaining ingredients. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet flattened with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pannukakka(Finnish Pancake)
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch glass dish or 2 pie dishes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix soup and cream cheese. Heat and stir until cheese is melted. Add mayonnaise and mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Trim off thick part of each cabbage leaf. Cover leaf with water; soak 2 minutes. Mix beef onion rice tomato juice and pepper. Place about 3 tablespoons meat mixture on each cabbage leaf. Tuck in sides and roll up.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix the buttermilk and soda and let stand. Beat egg whites until stiff. Cream sugar oleo and shortening. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each. Add buttermilk alternately with flour to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla. Fold in beaten egg whites. Gently stir in nuts and coconut. Bake in 3 or 4 layer pans at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mint Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate; cool. Beat eggs salt and sugar. Add chocolate. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes. Cool.

title: Mint Candy
instructions: Beat egg white until bubbly. Blend in butter sugar flavoring and coloring. This should be like cookie dough. Knead well then roll into balls. Let sit on wax paper; press down with a fork.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Cook clams and bay leaf for 5 minutes with just enough water to cover. Remove bay leaf. Saute onion celery and green pepper in butter and add to clams and clam juice. Add the thickened milk potatoes and bacon bits; cook gently until potatoes are done. Season with salt pepper and garlic.

title: Sugarless Coffee Cake
instructions: Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Then when cool top with whipped topping.

title: Yum Yum Pie
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs oleo and 1/2 cup sugar. Press 2/3 of this mix in large buttered casserole dish.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: Stew chicken and cook pasta in broth. Mix dressing mayonnaise cheese and olives. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces and mix all together. Store in tightly covered bowl. Will keep up to two weeks.

title: Chili
instructions: Into a 2-quart pot first add sauteed onion. Brown and drain the meat; add to pot. Then add tomato soup and chili powder. Simmer 10 minutes. Add kidney beans stewed tomatoes catsup and sugar. Mix together and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Hunter-Style Chicken(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: In large skillet heat together butter and oil. Cook chicken pieces over medium heat for about 25 minutes turning to brown. Remove chicken to a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Keep warm. In same skillet combine onion mushrooms and garlic. Cook and stir until onions are tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper; mix well. Add wine chicken broth and tomatoes; mix well. Cook and stir over medium high heat until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Pour vegetable sauce over chicken. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in bowl until light and fluffy. Add egg. Beat until smooth. Add milk soda and vanilla. Mix well. Add enough flour to make stiff easily handled dough. Roll very thin on floured surface. Cut as desired. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or lightly brown.

title: Grilled Sausage And Scallops With Peppers, Lemon, Basil And Garlic
instructions: Blanch the scallops in boiling salted water for 1 minute. Drain and allow to cool. Cook the sausage in boiling water until completely cooked about 5 minutes. Drain and allow to cool. Thread the scallops sausages and vegetables on skewers and season with salt and pepper. Cook the skewers over a medium fire until all the ingredients have attained some brown crusting about 3 to 4 minutes. Slide the ingredients off skewers into a large bowl. Add basil garlic oil lemon juice and balsamic vinegar. Shake the bowl until everything is well mixed.

title: Raspberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add sugar and then cold water and all juices. Yields 60 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind in food grinder or blender the cranberries apple and orange. Dissolve jello in hot liquid. Combine all ingredients and store in refrigerator. Keeps well for days.

title: Cold Bean Dip
instructions: Start with beans and layer each item in a glass dish. Serve cold.

title: Fresh Garden Salad
instructions: Chop cauliflower broccoli onion and tomatoes. Mix mayonnaise sugar vinegar sauce and lemon juice; stir over vegetables. Allow to set in refrigerator overnight before serving.

title: Power Cookies
instructions: Cream together brown sugar sugar butter and shortening. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Combine flour salt and soda and beat into 1st mixture. Add remaining ingredients and knead into first mixture. Drop by heaping teaspoons 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until brown. Makes 7 dozen cookies.

title: Lemon Cream Pudding
instructions: Thoroughly mix sugar salt and cornstarch in top of double boiler. Add cold water and milk; blend until smooth. Stir constantly over direct heat until mixture boils and becomes transparent-looking. Place over boiling water cover and cook 15 minutes.

title: Cheezy Cheese And Macaroni
instructions: Cook macaroni for 2 minutes less than the box calls for. Drain. Put under cold running water until macaroni is completely cool; drain. In saucepan place cut up chunks of Velveeta butter milk and flour. Heat slowly dissolving cheese and flour. Add all grated Cheddar cheese except for 1/2 cup. Pour over macaroni in a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with 1/2 cup cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lentil Stew
instructions: In large kettle combine ham onion soup bay leaf lentils pepper allspice cloves parsley flakes and salt. Bring to boil; reduce heat cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Add carrots potatoes and celery. Return to boiling point reduce heat cover and simmer one hour or longer until ham and vegetables are fork-tender.

title: Egg Surprise Pie
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Combine eggs milk salt and pepper. Mix well. Layer pie shell with cheese and sausage. Pour egg mixture over this and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Saute onion and celery in oil. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Put on top crust. Moisten bottom crust around edges to seal. Prick with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Summer Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Other vegetables such as green peppers or onions may be used or included.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Mix all together except sour cream and croutons. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Serve with sour cream and croutons on top. If you prefer you can use tomato juice instead of the picante if you dont like it as spicy.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together well. Roll into ball or log shape. Roll in chopped nuts. Refrigerate overnight to blend all flavors. Serve with crackers. Stays well in refrigerator several weeks.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs cool and peel. Place eggs in jar fill with remaining ingredients. Top with onions and fill jar with vinegar seal leave untouched for 24 hours.

title: Cajun Corn
instructions: Cook onions in melted butter until tender. Add Ro-Tel. Simmer for 7 minutes. Add corn. Cook on low for 12 minutes. Add salt to taste.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: In skillet cook sausage fully then add onion until transparent. Drain well. Add to sausage mixture the next 7 ingredients; mix well. Chill for at least 2 hours. May do ahead and chill overnight. Then shape into small meatballs and roll in flour. Beat together milk and eggs. Dip meatballs into mixture then roll in bread crumbs. Fry in oil until golden brown. Change oil when needed. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Grandma Hillesland'S Romme Grod(Cream Porridge)
instructions: Bring cream to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Continue to boil while sifting flour into cream slowly beating vigorously until mixture becomes heavy and butter starts to form. Remove butterfat as it appears. Add about 1 quart hot milk gradually and beat until smooth and the consistency of cooked cereal. Add salt to taste. Serve hot with butterfat sugar and cinnamon.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Sift together all the dry ingredients and set aside. Cream the shortening and gradually add the sugar. Continue to cream until light and fluffy. Add and beat well the eggs. Add alternately to the mixture the bananas and the flour mix. Beat all until smooth. Turn into a well-greased bread pan and bake for one hour at 350\u00b0 or until bread is done. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Tie spices loosely in bag and boil in water. Add tea tied loosely in bag and steep 5 minutes; remove bags. Heat frui juices and sugar; add to tea and serve. Serves 25.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine the mayonnaise mustard Worcestershire sauce and 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice. Layer 1 cup beans 1/2 cup peas 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice 1/2 of the onion and 1/2 of the water chestnuts. Spread 1/2 of the mayonnaise mixture and repeat. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 8 or more.

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
instructions: Layer first 5 ingredients. Mix Miracle Whip and sugar together and spread on top. Cover all with cheese and chill several hours or overnight. Serves 20.

title: Glenda'S 16 Bean Soup Recipe
instructions: Place beans in large kettle and cover with water. Add salt to beans and water; soak overnight. Next morning drain and add 2 quarts water. Add some ham or chicken pieces. Boil slowly for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Add the rest of ingredients. Simmer another 30 minutes and serve with cornbread or crackers.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Poach chicken breast in water seasoned with black peppercorns a little salt celery tops and sprinkle of garlic salt. Cook 5 minutes and turn off stove. Allow chicken to sit in broth until completely cooled. When the chicken is completely cooled remove from broth and cut into small dices. Combine sour cream and mayonnaise. Mix chicken celery apples walnuts and sour cream/mayonnaise mixture well. Refrigerate at least 2 hours (or overnight). Serve on butter croissants with leaf lettuce or serve alone with slices of fresh fruit in the summer for a cool evening meal.

title: Party Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Blend all in an electric blender for about 1 minute. Spread thin sandwiches with this and freeze or else freeze. Spread in small amounts.

title: Potato Stuffing Casserole
instructions: In a medium skillet saute celery and onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Add bread cubes and stir until lightly browned. Stir in potatoes parsley salt pepper milk and egg. Mix well. Spoon into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Dot with remaining butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned. Garnish with additional parsley. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Trappers
instructions: Bottom Layer Blend together cake mix margarine 1 egg and pecans. Pat in bottom of 10 x 13-inch pan. Set aside.

title: Beets - Spiced
instructions: Heat water 1 tablespoon vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt to boiling. Add beets. Cover and heat to boiling; cook 30 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cut beets into slices. Mix olive oil 1/4 cup vinegar sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt cloves and onions. Pour over beets and marinate overnight.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes in 9 x 13 baking pan. Mix with other ingredients. Top with 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes and 1/4 cup melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pickled Peaches
instructions: Wash and peel peaches. Drop peeled peaches into cold salt and vinegar solution (2 tablespoons salt and 2 tablespoons vinegar 1 gallon water) immediately to prevent discoloration. Mix sugar and vinegar and hot water; add spices (tied loosely in cloth bag). Boil and skim. Wash peaches in cold water and drain. Drop drained peaches into boiling syrup and cook 5 to 6 minutes. Pack in preheated jars. Cover with boiling spiced vinegar or let stand overnight in syrup then pack in jars. Cover with boiling vinegar. Seal and process 30 minutes in hot water bath at simmering temperature.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Press crescent rolls in a cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes (as on package). Let cool. Mix the next four ingredients and spread on crust. Chop all the vegetables fine and press on cream cheese mixture. Next press 1 cup shredded cheese on top of the vegetables. Refrigerate.

title: Cherry Bread Pudding(With Almond Cream Sauce)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine the bread with the 4 cups of liquid. Mix well. Beat together the eggs sugar and almond flavoring. Combine with bread mixture and then stir in the cherries. Melt the butter in a 9x13x2 inch baking pan. Pour bread pudding mixture into pan and bake for about an hour. Serve with Almond Cream Sauce.

title: Cream Candy
instructions: Combine sugar syrup milk and salt. Cook until it forms a soft ball. Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla; set aside until lukewarm. Beat until it thickens and is creamy.

title: Chicken With Eggplant
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Set aside. Trim off eggplant ends cut in 1/2 lengthwise and each 1/2 in thirds lengthwise. Then cut across in 1-inch sections (total 5 cups). Cut onion in 1/2. Slice thin (total 1 cup). Core tomatoes and cut into small cubes (total 1 1/2 cups).

title: Cheddar Chowder
instructions: Combine water and bouillon cubes in a heavy Dutch oven. Bring to a boil. Add vegetables; cover and simmer 12 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Melt margarine in heavy pan; blend in flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually add milk and mix with a whisk. Cook over medium heat until thickened stirring constantly. Add cheese stirring over low heat until melted. Add all ingredients to Dutch oven stirring over low heat. Do not boil. Serves 8.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O water and pineapple and boil gently together for 10 minutes. Add cream cheese as soon as you remove boiling mixture from heat. When cooled and beginning to thicken add celery and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour mixture into ring or mold and chill thoroughly.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Toss; stir in dressing and chill.

title: Swiss Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Beat until smooth and of a spreading consistency. Chill. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Mixed Lobster And Haddock
instructions: Mix together all ingredients while fish is warm. Place in refrigerator in a covered jar for at least 3 hours. The haddock will absorb the juice and taste from the lobster. Serve as a salad or lobster roll.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Grease a deep-dish pie pan and place a pie shell in bottom. Dump in all ingredients and mix. Use the other pie shell as the cover pressing the edges closed and trimming the excess. Cut slits in top and bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Bubble Pizza
instructions: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Quarter biscuits and place in bottom of pan to cover. Mix hamburger and sauce and then pour on top of biscuits. Bake for 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Top with cheese and bake an extra 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. In large mixing bowl combine salt sugar and\tshortening. Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over this. Add egg then lukewarm water and yeast. Add 3 cups flour and let rise until double in bulk (about 1 hour). Knead down on floured board. Make into desired shape and allow to rise again about an hour.

title: Preacher'S Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add rest of ingredients and pour into 9-inch unbaked deep dish pie shell or 2 small shallow pie shells. Bake slowly in 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until slightly set.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Stir on low flame sugar water butter and bananas (mashed) until butter melts. Set aside to cool. Beat eggs and vanilla; add to bananas. Sift flour salt baking powder and soda. Add to batter and stir until blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased loaf tin.

title: Stuffy Noses
instructions: Mix water and salt. Place 1 or 2 drops in each nostril then gently suction with bulb syringe.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Cream well the sugar and butter. Add egg and pulp. Sift dry ingredients. Mix all together. Add in raisins and nuts. Mix. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Top with fried crispy bacon. Mix sugar and mayonnaise and spread over bacon. Let set in refrigerator covered 2 hours or longer before serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: In large bowl mix sugar flour and salt. Add and mix by hand the shortening (oil) unbeaten eggs vanilla and baking soda dissolved in buttermilk. Add pecans and bananas. Pour into 2 loaf pans or a large ring mold. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Garlic Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Roll into Italian bread crumbs until completely coated. Place in baking pan.

title: Cheerleaders Cream Cheese Snack
instructions: *The hot and spicy is particularly good.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Very good.)

title: Lanette'S Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together and place in a casserole dish.

title: Hot Pretzels
instructions: Heat oven to 475\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. In a large bowl mix the hot water and yeast. Add water (warm) and sugar slowly. Add 5 cups flour. Stir until smooth (not sticking to sides); knead it. Form dough into golf ball size balls and shape each into pretzels. Fill a frying pan with water. For each cup of water used add 1 tablespoon baking soda. Place pretzels in gently boiling water for 30 seconds. Take out of the water and place on cookie sheet. Salt pretzels. Bake for 8 minutes until golden brown. Can be frozen before baking.

title: Crab Critter Fritters
instructions: Remove\tbone from crab. In mixing bowl beat egg beer and stir in Bisquick.\tAdd remaining ingredients and gently stir in crab. In heavy skillet heat 2 or 3 inches oil. Drop batter into hot oil (about 2 tablespoons for each fritter); fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Serve with cocktail sauce.

title: Salmon With Linguini
instructions: In a large bowl mix the linguini and Parmesan cheese. In large skillet heat oil over high heat. Cook onion and garlic 1 minute. Add peas cooking an additional 2 minutes. Reduce heat to medium and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and mix with linguini. Toss in salmon. Makes 6 servings less than 300 calories each.

title: Cabbage Beef Casserole
instructions: In a 5-quart Dutch oven or saucepan over high heat. Cook ground beef and onions until pan juices evaporate and meat is well browned. Stirring occasionally remove Dutch oven from heat. Add cabbage carrots pepper and 2 1/2 teaspoons salt; toss to mix well.

title: Quick Pound Cake
instructions: Add all ingredients in bowl. Beat for 3 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Spread on a cookie sheet 1/2-inch thick. Chill several hours. (Do not freeze.) Cut into squares and roll in flour. Brown on both sides. Put in a roasting pan. Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup mixed with 1/2 cup water. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Crisp Or Paradise
instructions: Slice the apples into a 7 x 7-inch pan. Dot with butter; sprinkle with lemon juice. With pastry blender blend the remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crisp as desired.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill thoroughly.

title: Fruit Pudding
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding as directed on package. Mix Dream Whip as directed on package. Fold pudding and Dream Whip together. Drain fruit cocktail and oranges. Add to pudding mixture. Mix in marshmallows. Refrigerate. Can add bananas at time of serving.

title: Mazell'S Caramel Icing
instructions: Add 1 cup milk and 2 3/4 cups sugar in a large boiler. Bring this to a rolling boil. In a small skillet caramelize 1/4 cup sugar. Pour into milk and sugar mix. Boil stirring constantly until thick. Pour into mixing bowl with margarine. Beat well. (If too thick to spread easily add milk 1 teaspoon at a time until right consistency.) Spread evenly over cake layers.

title: Black Forest Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Bake in three 9-inch layer pans. Cool and remove. Spread cherry pie filling between layers. Layer plentifully on top layer. Ice sides with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Copper Pennies(Marinated Carrots)
instructions: Boil carrots in salted water. Cool. Saute pepper and onion in small amount of oil. Alternate carrots pepper and onion in bowl. Make a sauce of remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

title: Streusel-Filled Spice Cake
instructions: Stir together streusel ingredients until crumbly. Cool. Prepare cake.

title: Cola Salad
instructions: Drain juice from cherries and pineapple. Heat. Dissolve gelatins and cool. Mix pineapple cheese nuts and cherries with gelatin. Add cola last and blend. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan until firm.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mash potatoes. Measure and add other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and cook until firm.

title: Blarney Stones
instructions: Heat sugar and eggs until like marshmallow consistency. Add dry ingredients and boiling water alternately to sugar and egg mixture. Pour into a greased and floured 11 x 17 x 1-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. After baking let stand 10 minutes and turn out to cool.

title: Casserole Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar gradually beating until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients. Turn into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and while still hot stir well with wooden spoon. Cool. Form into small balls. Roll in granulated sugar.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix all together and put following dressing over all.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a buttered baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top browns.

title: Old Fashion Rice Pudding
instructions: Grease 2-quart casserole dish. Combine eggs sugar and milk. Beat well. Fold in rice lemon juice vanilla butter nutmeg and raisins. Pour into casserole dish and put in pan of boiling water. Bake for 45 minutes or until custard is set. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil and water. Beat in eggs; add pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients twice. Add 1/2 to batter then add rest with nuts and the vanilla. Grease four Number 303 cans with shortening; sprinkle with flour. Fill cans 1/2 full; bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0 or until done. Remove from cans in 10 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Deviled Eggs
instructions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise. Put yolks in small bowl. Add other ingredients and mix. Fill the egg white halves with yolk mixture and top with sliced olives.

title: Swiss Fudge Toffee
instructions: Combine. Boil for 20 minutes stirring all the time. Take off stove and add nuts if desired then beat well until it thickens. Pour into a greased dish and cut in squares.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake care as directed. While cake is in the oven make the pudding as directed. When the cake is done poke holes all over it. Then pour hot pudding over the hot cake. Cool ten to fifteen minutes. Then pour caramel topping over all this. Refrigerate. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube cake pan. Place ingredients in mixing bowl in order listed. Mix slowly for 2 minutes. Mix fast for 4 to 5 minutes. Do not preheat oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak A La Cheddar Noodles
instructions: Melt butter. Add beef and sprinkle with garlic powder. Saute until browned. Remove meat from skillet. Add onion and green pepper; saute 2 minutes. Return to skillet with tomatoes and bouillon cube. Simmer 30 minutes. Blend together cornstarch water soy sauce sugar and salt. Add to meat mixture and cook until thickened. Reduce heat and cook 2 minutes longer. Prepare noodles and toss with grated cheese. Serve meat over noodles.

title: Baked Salmon
instructions: Combine margarine bread crumbs and milk. Bring to a boil. Stir in salmon egg and salt. Pour into casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Raspberry Or Strawberry Pretzel Delight
instructions: Mix pretzels margarine and sugar. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool completely.

title: Cinnamon Almond Cookies
instructions: Beat at low speed 8 of the egg whites and granulated sugar for 4 minutes or until the sugar is dissolved. Stir in ground almonds cinnamon flour chocolate bits lemon juice and cocoa. Chill for 2 hours. Put rounded teaspoonful of dough 1 inch apart on greased baking sheets.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix cherries sugar and jello. Cook in saucepan until comes to a boil. Let it cool and then add pineapple and nuts. Stir well and refrigerate. (May wish to use potato masher and mash cherries after cooking for better consistency.)

title: Sacromonte Omelette
instructions: Cut up onions and pepper and fry until soft. Add the pimentos. Mix well. Add a pinch of salt to the eggs and beat well then add 1/3 of the egg mixture to the pan lifting the sides with a spatula so that the liquid covers the vegetables. Add the remaining eggs. Wait until the egg mixture has set that is until the bottom is slightly toasted and the surface is still moist (not runny). Put the spatula under the omelette and detach it gently from the pan. Add more butter (or oil) if necessary. Slip the omelette back into the pan this time undone side down. Cook until this side has set.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart glass bowl melt chocolate chips in microwave. Combine with milk and sugar. Cook for 4 minutes stirring often. Mix in margarine vanilla and salt. Beat with rotary beaters until smooth. Serve over ice cream. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Creamy Potato Bake
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender. Drain and mash. Spread potatoes evenly in a lightly greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with sour cream. Sprinkle with bacon and green onions. Top with cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Scotch Clusters
instructions: Melt morsels in top of double boiler stirring constantly. Break up noodles and pour into melted butterscotch. Add chopped nuts. Using two spoons spoon out clusters on waxed paper. Do not have heat too high or morsels will harden.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Use large cast iron skillet. Put small amount of oil in bottom of pan. Place in oven while you mix ingredients. Mix cornbread according to package directions; add 1 can creamed corn. When iron skillet is hot remove from oven. Pour 1/2 mixture in bottom of pan. Layer meat onion chilies and cheese. Pour remaining batter on top to cover. Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until brown and firm. Cool slightly before cutting in pie wedges. Great as a meal with a salad.

title: My Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and butter. Mix in the rest as listed. Stir well. Drop on greased cookie sheet one teaspoon at a time. Bake for about 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Do not half or double recipe.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
instructions: Grease and flour a loaf pan. In a large bowl sift together the flour and baking soda. In a separate bowl cream together the butter and sugar then beat in the egg and salt. Alternately add the flour and orange juice to the creamed mixture. Mix well after each addition. Fold in the cranberries and pecans. Turn into loaf pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Orange Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water in large bowl. Stir in cranberry sauce cold water lemon juice cinnamon and cloves. Refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened. Stir in orange. Spoon into 5 cup mold. Refrigerate about 4 hours or until firm. Unmold; garnish as desired. Makes about 10 servings.

title: Seafood Fancies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets. Separate dough into 12 pieces then separate each piece into 3 equal layers. Place on prepared cookie sheets.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Grease large iron skillet and heat. Lightly sprinkle with meat and let brown slightly. Pour half of batter in hot skillet. Sprinkle layer of cheese then onion and then peppers. Pour remaining batter over contents. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Csorege (Hungarian Cookies)
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and salt. Make a well in dry ingredients and pour in mixture of egg yolks sour cream and vanilla. Blend well. Let dough rest for 1 to 2 minutes. Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to 1/8-inch thick. Cut dough into diamond-shaped pieces 2-inches wide at center and 6-inches long. Make a 1-inch slice in center of each diamond; pull end through center twisting slightly. Heat oil to 365\u00b0 and fry diamonds for about 3 minutes or until lightly brown. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Mix together water sugar and salt. Add yeast to water. Stir in egg and shortening. Then add flour until you have soft dough. I add a little sugar to yeast water. They are real good.

title: Trifle Pineapple Dessert
instructions: *To cut cake cut into slices and then cube.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Make cornbread using yellow cornmeal and chilies. Cool. Crumble cornbread and bacon then add the other ingredients. Add enough mayonnaise to moisten. (May need additional mayonnaise.) Yield 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Sun Wheels
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes; peel and mash. Beat potatoes until smooth. Add egg butter sugar and vanilla. Slice each pineapple ring to make 2 thin rings. (Rings may break but merely put together in a circle. Also it helps to freeze the pineapple before slicing.) Place 8 thin rings of pineapple in a baking pan and place a mound of the potato mixture on each slice of pineapple. Cover with the remaining 8 rings. Bake at 325\u00b0 until heated (about 30 minutes). Remove and sprinkle with coconut. Place in oven to brown coconut or in broiler watching carefully to avoid burning coconut. Serves 8.

title: Fat-Free Banana Muffins
instructions: Spray 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups with cooking spray. In a large bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. In medium bowl using a wire whisk or fork thoroughly mix sugar and orange juice. Whisk in egg whites corn syrup and orange peel until blended. Gradually add to flour mixture stirring until smooth. Stir in cranberries. Spoon into prepared muffin cups. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 25 minutes or until lightly browned and firm to touch. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Serve warm or cool completely on wire rack. Store in airtight container.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Mix sour cream mayonnaise sugar mustard seasoned salt and pepper. Toss with cabbage carrot and onion. Sprinkle with paprika or dill weed if desired. Makes 8 servings 95 calories per serving.

title: Drop Nut Cookies
instructions: Sift together the flour and salt. Beat the egg yolk and whites until thick. Gradually beat in the brown sugar. Mix in the nuts oil vanilla and flour until well blended. Drop by teaspoon onto lightly oiled cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes or until delicately browned. Makes about 36 cookies. Contains 40 calories per cookie.

title: Diabetic Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients then add egg milk and butter. Mix well and measure 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Pour into a warm nonstick skillet until brown turning once. Makes 10 pancakes.

title: Bananas Foster(Serves 4 People)
instructions: You need a gas stove or stove top heated with gas or propane. Melt butter with brown sugar and place bananas around the sauce. Heat for about 2 minutes. Pour creme de banana into the pan. Bring back to flame. Repeat with brandy. Pour sauce and bananas over ice cream. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix thoroughly the oleo shortening 3 cups sugar and eggs. Blend in flour cream of tartar soda and salt. May need to chill dough for a little while then shape rounded teaspoonfuls into balls (whatever size you want your cookies). Then roll the balls of dough in the sugar and cinnamon mixture. Flatten a little and place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until set. Move immediately from baking sheet.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Beat white of egg until light and fluffy meringue forms. Set aside. Beat yolk of egg; add buttermilk then dry ingredients and cooking oil. Fold mixture into beaten egg white. Pour batter onto hot griddle to form pancakes 4-inches in diameter. Serve with butter syrup or jelly.

title: Cabbage Patch Stew
instructions: Cook ground beef and onions until meat is browned. Drain off fat return to heat and add beans and tomatoes. Cook for fifteen minutes. Add cabbage water salt pepper and chili powder. Cook for an additional 15 minutes. Serve with cornbread. This stew is better served the next day.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix boiling water oats and butter; let stand for 20 minutes. Add sugar brown sugar vanilla eggs flour soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Mix all ingredients together and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan greased and floured 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Fried Oysters
instructions: Drain oysters. Mix remaining ingredients together. Coat oysters with mixture. Fry in deep fat until golden brown.

title: Cracker Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites sugar and cream of tartar until stiff. Fold in cracker crumbs nuts and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Mix cake mix with 1/3 cup evaporated milk and oleo. The dough will be stiff. Melt unwrapped caramels with other 1/3 cup milk until smooth. Spread half of batter in rectangle baking pan with fingers in a greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Remove from oven sprinkle chocolate chips over baked batter and pour melted caramel over that layer. Add nuts. Drop remaining batter on this. It will look strange. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes. No longer! Dough may not look done but thats due to the melted caramels. Let it cool for a few minutes and then loosen around pan edges. Wait about an hour before cutting into squares.

title: Beef Casserole Italiano
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain off fat. Stir in the tomato sauce parsley oregano basil 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Meanwhile combine spinach Ricotta cheese and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Spoon spinach mixture around edges of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour beef mixture into center. Cut each Mozzarella slice into 3 strips and arrange in a lattice pattern over meat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Melt margarine and add flour salt and paprika. Stir until smooth. Add milk slowly. Cook over medium heat and stir until sauce thickens and boils. Put 1/2 of potatoes in greased casserole and add 1/2 of sauce. Place slices of cheese on top. Repeat layers ending with cheese on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Uncover and bake additional 30 minutes or until potatoes are soft.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool before slicing.

title: Baked Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: In medium saucepan melt margarine. Stir in ketchup lemon juice honey soy sauce and ginger; stir until smooth. Marinate chicken with above for at least 1 hour better if overnight.

title: Creamy Peas And Potatoes
instructions: Prick potatoes and microwave on High (100% power) for 10 minutes or until fork-tender; set aside. In a 2-quart microwave-safe bowl combine the peas and water. Microwave on High for 6 minutes or until peas are tender; set aside.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix with mixer all but shrimp. Then add shrimp and stir in with spoon so shrimp stays whole. Serve on crackers chips or bread sticks.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown beef. Pour off any accumulated grease. Add celery peppers and onion; saute. Add tomatoes and their juice. Add remaining ingredients except for Cheddar cheese. Simmer 20 minutes. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole. Spread Cheddar cheese on top. Bake 20 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Campfire Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes thin. Place on heavy-duty aluminum foil. Peel and dice onion; mix with potatoes. Cut margarine into pieces and drop on top. Add salt and pepper. Fold over aluminum foil; roll edges to close. Place over campfire or on grill for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Turn over every 15 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Gradually beat in sugar. Add other ingredients. Beat together. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Combine sugar eggs and flour. Add butter milk and 1/2 cup coconut. Put 1/2 cup coconut on top of pies. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done. Yields two 9-inch pies.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add rest of ingredients except bread and mix well. Spray 11 x 13-inch baking dish (or pan) with Pam. Line with bread. Sprinkle raisins on top. Pour milk mixture over bread. Let set 30 minutes. Bake for 35 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until done. Should shake like Jell-O when pan is gently shaken back and forth.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Steam the broccoli until tender. Chop coarsely and set aside. Saute the onion in butter or margarine until soft but not brown. Add flour and stir until paste-like. Blend in milk and cream. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thickened and smooth. Add cheese by the handful stirring until smooth. Add broccoli and salt and pepper. Serves 12.

title: Easter Cake
instructions: Melt margarine; add sugar and evaporated milk. Bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes more stirring continuously. Add 1 capful vanilla. Pour over cake. Sprinkle fresh coconut and place a few jelly beans on each piece of cake.

title: Lemon Cake Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar with flour and stir in beaten egg yolks and lemon juice/rind while gradually adding milk. Stir in butter. Set aside. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into first mixture. Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish. Place in a pan of hot water and bake at 350\u00b0 until tests done. The top will have appearance of a cake with custard on the bottom.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In large kettle cook potatoes carrots and celery in water until tender (about 20 minutes). Drain reserving liquid and setting vegetables aside. In same kettle saute onion until soft in margarine. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Gradually add milk stirring constantly until thickened. Gently stir in cooked vegetables. Add 1 cup or more of reserved liquid from vegetables until soup is of desired consistency.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Cut cheese into squares and put in crock pot. Brown ground beef and add all ingredients and simmer on low until cheese is melted.

title: Quick Skillet Stew
instructions: Drain potatoes reserving 1/3 cup liquid; slice. In skillet combine potatoes and reserved liquid with remaining ingredients. Heat; gently stir occasionally. Makes about 5 cups.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Discard tough parts and chop broccoli. Add chopped onions raisins and sunflower seeds. Mix sugar vinegar and mayonnaise and pour over broccoli mixing well. Add bacon crumbled just before serving.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream together until fluffy shortening sugars and vanilla. Whisk in egg. Stir in cocoa and milk. Fold in flour and soda mixed and chocolate bits. Drop batter by rounded teaspoonfuls onto nonstick (or greased) baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes. Cool about 5 minutes before removing cookies from sheets. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Overnight Potatoes
instructions: Boil and mash 8 potatoes. Mix cream cheese sour cream milk egg and onion. Dot 1/2 stick oleo on top. Bake until brown at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Can make 1 day ahead. Refrigerate and then bake.

title: Meatball Hoagies
instructions: Mix hamburg bread crumbs and egg. Add garlic salt oregano salt and pepper to taste. Roll meatballs and add to own spaghetti sauce. Cook on medium heat about 45 minutes. When meatballs are done add to buns. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese to top and bake in oven until cheese is melted. Serve with a side of spaghetti.

title: Ham Croissant Appetizers
instructions: Unroll dinner rolls. Cut each one in half to form a small triangle. Spread a little mustard on each triangle. Place 1/2 teaspoon deviled ham and a small amount of cheese near the longest side of each triangle. Roll up.

title: Oatmeal Cookies With Dried Cranberries And Apricots
instructions: Put rack in center of oven. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease baking sheet. Cream butter or margarine and sugar with an electric mixer or food processor fitted with a metal blade. Add egg and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Add flour baking soda salt and oats. Mix until just combined. Stir in cranberries and apricots. Drop batter by tablespoon onto a prepared baking sheet spacing cookies 2 1/2-inches apart. (They spread considerably.) Bake until cookies are a medium brown about 11 minutes. Let cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Use metal spatula to transfer to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Zucchini Bars
instructions: Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients together and add to egg mixture. Fold in zucchini coconut and oatmeal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes in greased and floured sheet pan.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Mix eggs soup cheese and mayonnaise and add to broccoli. Place in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Place 1/2 cup crushed soda crackers on top and bake 15 more minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mash bananas on plate with a fork. Combine all ingredients adding bananas last. Mix well using a wooden spoon. Place batter in greased loaf pan 9 x 5 x 4-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cake
instructions: Mix cake and pour in cake pan. Drain peaches and place on top of cake. Mix cream cheese sugar and peach juice and spread over top of peaches to approximately 1 inch from edge of pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onion; add salt. Let this soak for 2 hours. Place cucumbers and onions in containers for freezing. Dissolve sugar with vinegar. Pour over cucumbers and onions just enough to cover. Put in freezer. When ready to use remove and let thaw.

title: Chicken-Rice Bake
instructions: In a 2-quart baking dish (shallow) mix soup water rice paprika and pepper. Place chicken on rice mixture. Sprinkle with additional paprika and pepper. Cover chicken and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Makes 4 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onions for 5 minutes. Drain. Mix soup and sour cream together. Mix soup mixture with squash. Melt margarine and mix with stuffing mix. In a 7 x 12 x 2-inch pan layer 1/2 stuffing mix then vegetable mix top with stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spread 2/3 of cornbread stuffing in bottom of 1 large baking dish ungreased. Sprinkle chopped chicken over mixture. Mix soup chicken broth chopped celery chopped onions and oleo together. Cook this mixture in large boiler until onions and celery are tender. Pour this over cornbread mix and chopped chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until light brown.

title: Mahogany Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar; add 1 egg at a time. Beat well. Add flour and baking soda and alternate with 1/2 cup milk. Heat other 1/2 cup milk and chocolate. Add while warm; beat well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Use 10 x 10-inch pan.

title: Cherry Goodies
instructions: *If using apple add a little cinnamon.

title: Crab Cake Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except breadcrumbs and cheese in 1 1/2-quart baking dish; sprinkle with breadcrumbs and grated cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until lightly browned and cheese has melted.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a hot greased skillet or pan at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together margarine sugar flour eggs vanilla and baking powder. After mixing all ingredients together pour half of batter in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread 1 can of pie filling over batter. Carefully spread remaining batter over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Scalloped Carrots
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat cook and stir butter and flour until smooth and bubbly about 2 minutes. Gradually add milk and lemon juice. Cook and stir until thickened. Add celery salt salt and pepper; mix well. Remove from heat.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Put cookies in milk. Take them out almost immediately and layer in bowl with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Hearty Fiesta Burgers
instructions: In mixing bowl combine egg crumbs taco sauce onion and salt. Add ground beef and mix well. Shape mixture into 6 patties. Brown on both sides. Mix soup chili beans and peppers (if desired) and pour on top of patties. Cook covered over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes. Top with shredded cheese. Melt cheese and serve.

title: Strawberry-Nut Dessert
instructions: Bring 1 cup water to boil. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add juice from frozen strawberries and pineapple. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in remaining ingredients. Chill until firm.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Cream oleo Crisco white and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Mix well then add peanut butter. Drop by tablespoonful on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into tube pan sprayed with Pam and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Tea Cookies
instructions: Mix together to make a dough not too thin and not too thick. Roll out on floured surface and cut out with cookie cutter. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Milky Way Ice Cream
instructions: Melt candy bars over\tlow heat with 2 cups evaporated milk. Mix eggs and sugar in large bowl and beat well. Mix in melted candy bars and milk mixture. Pour into freezer can and finish filling with milk to within 2 inches of top of can. Freeze until ready.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Put flour Crisco and salt in mixing bowl until it resembles corn meal. Add milk and egg. Roll out on floured board and cut into strips.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast Bake
instructions: Crumble sausage in medium skillet; cook over medium heat until brown stirring occasionally. Drain well. Spread bread cubes in a buttered 12x8x2 in. dish. Top with sausage and cheese. In a separate bowl combine eggs milk and seasonings. Beat well and pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next morning bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Banana Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Cream together butter and brown sugar. Mix in egg and buttermilk. Mix together oats flour baking powder salt and allspice. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in bananas. Spoon into greased muffin pan filling 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Delicious Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed on box. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook pineapple and sugar together for 5 minutes. When cake is done poke holes all over it and pour pineapple mixture over top while both are still hot. Let cool. Make pudding and pour over cooled cake. Put in refrigerator to cool set. Then spread whipped cream over top. Sprinkle with nuts and coconut. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine flour baking soda sugar cinnamon and salt. Add eggs and oil (do not beat). Stir in vanilla pineapple 1 cup pecans and the banana. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove and cool completely.

title: Cream Of Rice Pudding
instructions: The CoCo Lope and Harina de Arroz can be bought at Foodtown by the Goya products.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix and pour into 2 greased loaf pans (9 x 5-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes. Remove from pans. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients together.

title: Pronto Potato Soup
instructions: In small frying pan brown bacon until crisp. Remove and drain on paper towel. Add onion to drippings in pan and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Drain fat off. Meanwhile in 3-quart saucepan mix cold potatoes and soup until smooth. Add milk gradually stirring constantly to desired consistency over medium heat. Add bacon and onions. Season with salt pepper and parsley.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Lightly grease bottom of pan.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix in order given. Put in greased loaf pan or 2 small loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add vanilla and mix well. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Sift flour soda and salt together. Set aside. Mash bananas and combine with water. Add bananas and sifted ingredients alternately to creamed mixture beating well after each addition. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add Milnot to which egg has been added. Mix well and chill overnight. Roll out thin on lightly floured board and cut circles. Place between wax paper. These can be made ahead of time. If they are wrapped they will not dry out.

title: Rhubarb Pie For 1
instructions: Wash clean and cut rhubarb into bite size pieces (enough to fill 9-inch pie pan).

title: Plum Nutty Cake
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and beat until well mixed. Pour into a greased tube or Bundt pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool and drizzle with glaze.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a bowl stirring until moistened. Knead dough 20 times on floured surface. Pat dough to 1/2-inch thickness and cut with round biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet and bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Bread
instructions: Mix lukewarm water and yeast; set aside. Mix together oil salt sugar and 1 cup water; then add yeast. Add flour. Make into a dough ball; coat bowl and top of dough ball with oil. Cover with a tea towel and put in a warm place or in sink with warm water. Let rise about 1 or 1 1/2 hours. Punch down. Let rise again about 1 1/2 hours or until doubled in size. Make rolls. Let them rise about 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. If you like a soft crust coat baked rolls with butter and cover with tea towel for 5 minutes. To make sweet rolls add more sugar.

title: Apricot Delight
instructions: Heat apricot nectar just under boiling point. Add jello and sugar; let cool. Add frozen orange juice crushed pineapple nuts banana and marshmallows. Stir in salt and lemon juice. Congeal in refrigerator. Optional Serve with thin layer of Cool Whip.

title: Apple Bean Bake
instructions: Cook apples in melted butter until tender. Add sugars. Cook until sugars melt. Add last four ingredients; stir together well. Combine with beans. Mix well! Pour all into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mandarin Orange-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Sprinkle gelatin over mixture; stir well. Spoon mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Combine pecans and coconut. Sprinkle over salad. Chill 6 hours or overnight. Makes 15 servings.

title: Blueberry Pecan Delight
instructions: Mix all together and congeal.

title: French Rolls
instructions: Cream butter sugar and salt. Add beaten eggs. Liquefy yeast in 1 teaspoon sugar. Add to mixture. Add milk and enough flour to make stiff smooth dough. Let rise 5 hours. Take off large chunk off dough; roll thin on floured surface. Cut into wedges spread with soft butter. Roll from broad end to narrow end. Place rolls on ungreased cookie sheet. Let rise 3 to 4 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields approximately 60 rolls.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Mix the ingredients all together except vanilla. Cook over medium heat for 1/2 hour stirring constantly or until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Add the vanilla and beat by hand for 1 minute. Then pour into a buttered pan. Cut into inch squares.

title: Parmesan Dip
instructions: Melt cream cheese and milk in a double boiler. Add Parmesan cheese salt and pepper. Sprinkle on top green onions and paprika. Serve with sliced French bread.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Onion odor will cling to many containers especially plastic but is easy to remove.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Heat iron skillet or heavy baking pan with a little oil. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon meal and brown lightly. Then add batter and bake at 400\u00b0 until browned on top usually 20 minutes or so.

title: No Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix graham crackers raisins nuts and candied fruit. Heat milk; add marshmallows and heat until melted. Add butter and water; mix thoroughly. Pour over graham cracker mixture and mix. Line pan with waxed paper. Press mixture into pan. Cover with waxed paper. Refrigerate for 3 days before cutting.

title: Country Steak
instructions: Pound steak. Cut into serving size pieces. In skillet brown steak in oil. Pour off fat. Stir in soup and water. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until done. Stir often. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Gourmet Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins. Peel and shred. In saucepan combine butter and cheese. Stir until melted. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients except paprika. Fold into potatoes. Pour into a greased baking dish and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut the squash and onion. Boil until tender. Drain and mash. Add salt\tpepper eggs soup butter and 1/2 cracker crumbs; mix well.\tLayer 1/2 of the squash mixture in a dish. Sprinkle this with 1 cup of cheese. Spread remaining squash on top of cheese and sprinkle\tthe remaining\tcracker crumbs on squash. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top of the crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Dish
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes with 1/2 cup pineapple salt butter and honey or brown sugar. Turn into 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle top with nutmeg and garnish with remaining crushed pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pickle Relish
instructions: Combine cucumbers peppers and onion. Sprinkle with turmeric. Dissolve salt in 2 quarts cold water and pour over vegetables. Let stand 3 to 4 hours. Drain. Cover vegetables with cold water and let stand 1 hour. Drain thoroughly. Tie spices in a cheesecloth bag. Add to sugar and vinegar. Heat to boiling and pour over vegetables. Cover and let stand 12 to 18 hours in a cool place. Simmer until vegetables are hot. Bring to boiling. Pack boiling hot into hot jars leaving 1/8-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process 10 to 15 minutes. Yield 6 pints.

title: Blueberry Cake Or Muffins
instructions: At low speed cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs (1 at a time). Mix until blended. Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with milk and vanilla. Mash 1/2 cup blueberries; stir in by hand. Fold in rest of blueberries. Pour in greased tube pan or muffin tins. Sprinkle with sugar on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Granny'S Italian Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar and Crisco until very creamy. Add eggs and beat very well. Add vanilla. Put flour baking powder and salt through sifter and mix thoroughly into batter; should not be sticky. Grease cookie sheets. Drop by teaspoon onto sheets and form with fingers. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cookies are light brown. Ice with powdered sugar and milk frosting.

title: Shepherd'S-Cheese Pie
instructions: Brown your meat; drain your meat. Saute onions and bell peppers with butter. Add to the meat. Add season and sauce to meat. In your oblong casserole dish spread meat evenly on bottom of dish. Spread creamed potatoes evenly over meat topped with shredded cheese. Place in oven at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Strata
instructions: Line a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan with 10 slices of bread then ham cheese bread (10 slices) ham and cheese. Mix eggs milk salt onion salt and mustard; pour on top of bread ham and cheese. Cover; let stand overnight. Take out 10 minutes. Uncover; bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 375\u00b0. Take out of oven; let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean thoroughly and boil for 5 minutes 10 large mushrooms. Remove stems and boil as well. Saute onion. Add mushroom stems. When these are cooked add Parmesan parsley and garlic. Fill mushrooms. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Salad
instructions: Drain orange segments and set aside. Combine gelatin and water stir until dissolved. Cool. Add sherbet and mix well. Add orange segments and stir until well blended. Pour into lightly oiled mold and refrigerate.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until brown. Add onions and saute for a few minutes. Add brown sugar and vinegar then chopped potatoes. Turn down heat and allow to season through. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Makes 1 large loaf or 2 medium loaves.

title: Appetizer Meat Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cranberry sauce and tomato sauce. Shape into balls about 1-inch in diameter. Brown on all sides. Remove from pan into a deeper pot draining off extra fat. Combine cranberry sauce with tomato sauce. Pour over meat balls. Cover and simmer over low heat about 45 minutes. Serve in chafing dish. Provide toothpicks.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add onion and cook until tender. Stir in Cheez Whiz until melted. Spoon into oblong casserole dish. Prepare cornbread mix as directed. Add remaining ingredients mixing just until moistened. Spoon over meat and cheese mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes.

title: Pizza Snack
instructions: Put 1 tablespoon sauce on each tortilla slice. Sprinkle about 1 teaspoon of cheese onto each slice. Put slices on a tray and put in toaster oven or oven for 3 to 5 minutes on 350\u00b0. In microwave only cook 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.

title: Classic Spinach Dip
instructions: Drain spinach until dry. Stir together all ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve with bread crackers vegetables or chips.

title: Alpine Goulash With Buttered Noodles
instructions: Brown meat well on all sides in hot drippings or shortening. Turn cubes to brown equally. Add balance of ingredients cover and cook slowly until beef cubes are tender about 2 1/2 hours.

title: Hominy Grits Casserole
instructions: Bring water to boil. Add hominy and cook 3 minutes. Beat eggs in a cup and finish filling with milk. Stir in egg mixture butter and garlic cheese. Pour into buttered casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: Use a large bowl. Pour 2 cups boiling water over the shredded wheat and let stand. Cream sugar shortening and eggs well beaten. Add shredded wheat mixture and other ingredients. Let stand 36 hours before using. Fill muffin tins slightly over half and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Batter keeps indefinitely in refrigerator.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Beat together cream cheese powdered sugar and milk. Spread on crust. Spread pie filling over filling and top with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar salt and baking soda. Then add 1 egg beaten with juice of the fruit cocktail. Add medium can of Fruit Cocktail.

title: Easy Cheesy Rice And Broccoli
instructions: Bring broccoli and water to boil in medium saucepan separating broccoli with fork. Stir in Velveeta cheese. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in Minute rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Perfect Corn Bread
instructions: Sift flour with sugar baking powder and salt; stir in cornmeal. Add eggs milk and Wesson oil. Beat with rotary or electric beater until just smooth. (Do not overbeat). Pour into greased iron skillet or 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fred'S Favorite Raisin Custard Pie
instructions: Cook raisins sugar 1 1/2 cups water and vinegar about 10 minutes. Mix egg yolks remaining water cornstarch and butter. Add to raisins and cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Low-Sugar - Low-Fat Delight
instructions: Make jello with 1 3/4 cups boiling water. When cool add yogurt. Whisk to mix. Refrigerate.

title: Drop Donuts
instructions: Stir with fork and drop by teaspoon into hot grease for about 3 minutes.

title: Ranch Crackers
instructions: Mix together oil dressing and dill weed. Pour over crackers in a Ziploc bag. Shake.

title: Bev'S Super Squash
instructions: Wash zucchini and cut in 1-inch slices. Put in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and let boil for 5 minutes only. Drain squash very well. Cut scallions into very small pieces (use the green and white part). Put the squash into a long baking dish sprinkle scallions on top of squash. Salt and pepper to taste. Slice cheese and place on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted about 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Favorite Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar margarine eggs and vanilla. Add the flour baking powder salt and cocoa. Gradually add the 1/2 cup sour milk and 1 cup boiling water. Batter will be thin. Grease and flour pans lightly. Frost with your desired frosting. Bake at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 layers bake 25 minutes. With one 9 x 13-inch pan bake 45 minutes; 30 cupcakes bake 25 minutes.

title: Crab And Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Serve with crackers.

title: Apple 'N' Honey Scones
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly spray large cookie sheet or grease lightly. Combine first 7 ingredients; cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add apple milk and honey mixing until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface; knead gently 5 to 6 times. Pat dough into a 9-inch circle.

title: Christmas Snack Mix
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients all together in large pan. Over this pour the remaining ingredients. Cook 2 or 3 hours in oven at 250\u00b0 stirring very 15 or 20 minutes until crisp. Spread on paper towels to cool.

title: Cherry Mountain Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Spoon ice cream into the crust. Freeze for 2 hours. Crumble pecan cookies over ice cream to form second layer. Place cherries over cookie layer.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Combine spaghetti chicken olives onion seasoning and broth. Bake until hot. Add sour cream and stir. Place almonds on top and heat through. Serve with French bread and a salad. A great way to use leftover chicken or turkey.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour pan. Beat butter and cream cheese together in bowl until well blended. Add sugar to mixture and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each addition. Add vanilla and lemon flavor. Sift flour and blend into creamed mixture. Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Bacon Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine bacon Parmesan cheese and onion; set aside. Cut biscuits into fourths; dip each piece in butter. Layer one third in a 10-inch lightly greased Bundt pan. Sprinkle half of bacon mixture over biscuits. Repeat procedure ending with biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Invert onto a serving platter. Serve immediately.

title: Grandmom'S Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Cook the first 7 ingredients slowly for approximately 15 minutes or until raisins are puffy. Set aside to cool then add soda. Set aside until cold. Add flour and water last. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 in Bundt pan. Do it right and its yummy!

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Put rice and water in dish and mix. Layer remaining ingredients and bake 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased casserole dish. Cover top with crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Jerusalem Artichokes With Cream Sauce
instructions: Wash and peel the artichokes slice in covered pan. Cook in small amount of water (salted). Boil for 10 to 15 minutes until tender. Drain well. Melt butter in a saucepan. Blend in flour salt and white pepper; add cream or milk all at once. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in parsley. Serve sauce over cooked artichokes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Frozen Cranberry Cups
instructions: In food processor or blender combine berries sugar and pineapple until finely chopped.

title: Macaroni Goulash
instructions: Cook macaroni firm as directed. Brown turkey and onion together in 4-quart pot. Drain. Add stewed tomatoes oregano garlic ketchup and salt. Simmer 20 minutes. Add macaroni and simmer 10 minutes more. Serve with salad.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts. Add nuts and stir. Bake in small

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash and drain vegetables. Slice cucumbers and onions. Soak in salt solution (2 quarts water and 1/2 cup canning salt) for 3 hours. Mix vinegar sugar and spices; bring to a boil. Add cucumbers and onions just to heat thoroughly (until cucumbers change colors). Pack hot cucumbers into jars leaving 1/3 inch space. Cover with boiling hot liquid. Adjust lids and seal.

title: Peachy Fruit Salad
instructions: Puree first 4 ingredients until smooth. Refrigerate 1 hour. Place remaining ingredients in large bowl. Pour peach sauce over fruit. Toss until covered. Chill. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cranberry sauce. Chill until syrupy. Add nuts and celery. Stir in sour cream. Chill at least 4 hours in a mold.

title: Vegetable Burgers(Serves 4)
instructions: Will need aluminum foil squares.

title: London Broil Marinade(Serves 6)
instructions: Mix ingredients together to blend. Pour over 2 pound cut of London broil. Marinate 3 hours or overnight. Broil over grill or in the oven. For medium rare broil about 15 minutes on each side in the oven. If you are cooking on the outdoor grill adjust the time according to the distance your rack is from the coals 15 minutes on the first side and 10 minutes on the other side might produce the desired doneness. Slice diagonally very thin. Serves 6. (The amount of marinade is enough for a large cut of steak.)

title: Belgian Waffles
instructions: In medium bowl combine first four ingredients. In separate bowl sift dry ingredients. Add the liquid into the dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in Belgian waffle maker.

title: Spicy Shrimp Etouffee(Ay-Too-Fay)
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter; add garlic powder and celery seed. In a bowl combine cornstarch red and black pepper 1/4 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Stir into cooked vegetables. Add tomato sauce. Stir in shrimp. Bring to a boil; then reduce heat and simmer briefly just until heated through. Serve over hot cooked rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Rolls
instructions: Toss chicken with olive oil oregano and salt. Cook in skillet over medium heat until done. Add onions and heat through. Heat pita bread in microwave. Spread pita with sour cream and chicken mixture. Top with lettuce tomatoes and cucumber. Fold and enjoy.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape into 2-inch balls and arrange in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Shape or cut a hole in center. Cook in hot oil (skillet). Shake in a brown paper bag filled with sugar. Eat while warm.

title: Kid'S Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Place mixture of half cornmeal/half flour with salt/pepper to season in paper bag. Dip chicken pieces in milk then drop in paper bag; shake. Pan-fry until golden brown and done through.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: In a large skillet cook beef and onion until beef is lightly brown and onion is tender; drain off fat. Stir in salsa taco seasoning and water; cook over low heat 5 to 6 minutes or until mixture thickens. Stir in corn and olives. Spoon into 8-inch square baking dish.

title: Easy Apple Pie
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Layer in 10-inch pie plate. Mix 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Mix melted butter flour 1 cup sugar egg and chopped pecans. Pour over apples. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Swedish Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix well and pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Peel apples and slice. Add remaining ingredients. Mix with apples and let stand while making crust.

title: California Pie
instructions: Fold in crumbs and nuts to first 3 ingredients. Butter pie pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool; top with Cool Whip ice cream or whipped cream. I like it served without topping.

title: Lemon Chess Bars
instructions: Mix and bake in 9 x 12 glass pan 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool slightly.
