title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs with electric mixer. Add sugar while beating. Other ingredients should be added in the order listed beating well after each addition. Pour into ice cream freezer. Add enough milk to fill container. Freeze in ice cream freezer according to directions.

title: Red Pepper Round Steak
instructions: Partially freeze steak; slice diagonally across grain into 1/4-inch wide strips. Cut strips into 2-inch pieces. Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut cauliflower and broccoli into small pieces and pour mixture of ingredients over pieces.

title: Mexican Chili Bake
instructions: In large skillet cook onions green peppers and garlic in butter until tender but not brown. Stir in rice tomatoes and seasoning. Heat thoroughly. Saute beef; stir beef into rice mixture. Spoon half of beef-rice mixture into buttered shallow 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup corn chips. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until heated thoroughly.

title: Freezer Cole Slaw
instructions: Let cabbage green pepper and carrots set 1 hour. In saucepan add vinegar salt mustard seed celery seed and sugar. Bring to a boil. Pour this over cabbage green pepper and carrots. Let set 2 hours. Drain well and place in freezer containers and put into freezer. When ready to use thaw and mix in mayonnaise to taste.

title: Taco Crescent Pie
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain. Add taco mix water and olives. Simmer 5 minutes. Separate rolls and put in ungreased 9 x 10-inch pie plate to make crust. Sprinkle 1 cup crushed chips over bottom crust. Spoon on meat mixture the sour cream cheese and top with remaining corn chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Slice and serve. Top individual servings with as much lettuce tomato and taco sauce as desired. Freezes well.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; chill.

title: Lotsa Layers Salad
instructions: Twenty-four hours prior to eating make in order by layering lettuce celery green pepper water chestnuts onions and peas in a bowl. Mix mayonnaise and sugar and spread with spatula over top. Layer remaining ingredients. Cover and keep in refrigerator.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs. Add all other ingredients. Pour into greased casserole and bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until golden brown on top. Place casserole in pan of water to prevent burning. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook until it\tthickens stirring to prevent lumping.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt butter and set aside to cool. Mix flour and sugar together. Add milk and eggs. Beat well. Stir in vinegar and vanilla. Add butter and nuts. Pour into pie crust and place in cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sis Haack'S Black-Eyed Peas(Beans)
instructions: Fry until cooked the oleo and hamburger. Add the other ingredients and let simmer 30 to 40 minutes. Add a little water if dry.

title: Eggplant Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl and blend. Then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured fluted tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until cake tests done. Do not underbake. Cool in pan. Remove from pan and finish cooling on rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. For mellowing of flavors cover and store overnight. Do not use cake mix that has pudding added.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef in microwave for 10 minutes. Drain. Stir in tomato sauce tomato paste salt pepper and garlic. Microwave for 10 minutes.

title: Melt Aways Cookies
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients and add flour nuts and coconut. Form balls using a teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Roll or sift with powdered sugar.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar flour and baking powder. Add milk; mix well. Add oleo vanilla and coconut. Mix well. Pour into an 8-inch glass pie pan which has been lightly greased. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes its own crust.

title: Hungarian Pastry
instructions: Mix well by hand until no more yellow or white shows. Flatten out wrap in waxed paper and store in refrigerator overnight.

title: Cabbage Vinegar Salad
instructions: Chop and blend together all vegetables and 1/2 cup sugar. Mix and boil remaining ingredients together for 3 minutes. Pour over vegetable mixture. Chill before serving.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Soften leaves in boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes. Mix together all remaining ingredients then shape into small roll and roll up in cabbage leaves. Fasten with toothpicks. Place in greased baking dish and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle rice in pan. Place chicken breasts on rice. Mix canned soup with water; pour over chicken and rice (lift chicken enough to allow liquid to reach rice underneath). Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken and rice. Cover pan with foil. Bake about 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is done (juices run clear when poked with fork).

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Saute onion in margarine. Mix all ingredients adding salt and pepper to taste. Bake in oblong dish 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Nan'S Lime Delight Salad
instructions: Mix jello according to directions and let chill until it begins to thicken. When thickened take out of refrigerator. Add the cabbage carrots and pineapple. Return to refrigerator to jell until served.

title: Tater Crisp Chicken
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Rinse fryer in cold water and cut into serving pieces. Pat dry. Dip pieces in melted margarine and roll in potato flakes. Place skin side up in prepared dish and season to taste. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until done.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks slightly. Blend with milk sugar lime juice and cornstarch. Whip over hot water until slightly thick. Put into baked pie shell. Top with favorite meringue recipe.

title: Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl. In separate bowl add chopped onion soup mayonnaise and beaten eggs. Mix thoroughly. Add cooked drained cauliflower to the first mixture; mix thoroughly. Mix melted butter and bread crumbs together; sprinkle over cauliflower mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peppered Rib Eye Steaks(Dry Marinade)
instructions: Brush steaks with olive oil. In a small bowl combine all seasonings. Sprinkle seasoning over steaks and press into both sides. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Grill steaks. We have used this on every cut of steak even deer steaks and it is very good.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large Dutch oven and bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cook uncovered 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Discard hot pepper. Pack into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/4 inch headspace. Cover with metal lids. Screw bans tight. Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes. Yield 11 half pints.

title: Southern Italy Meat Balls
instructions: Add all ingredients; make 6 meat balls. Saute in olive oil until brown; drain and place meat balls in gravy.

title: Spanish Pie, Potato
instructions: Cube the potatoes in very small cubes. Put them in frying pan with 2 tablespoons butter (melted). Let them fry while stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Cut slivers of green onions in very little pieces. Get a casserole bowl and preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter bottom and edges of bowl; take the slightly cooked potatoes and cover bottom of casserole dish then mix green onions grated cheese 1/2 pound grated ham and put a layer of this mixture on first layer of potatoes. Repeat with putting final layer of potatoes on top. Beat 2 eggs and pour over top of whole mix and let eggs run through whole mixture. Bake in oven for 45 minutes approximately. This is sooo good youll want to slap the cook but dont because he or she has feelings too. I picked this recipe up in Spain.

title: Ginger Pickles
instructions: Peel and cut cucumbers in small strips. Soak 24 hours (2 gallons water and 3 cups lime). Rinse well. Soak 2 hours in alum and water to cover them. Wash 3 times. Soak 6 hours in ginger and water to cover. Rinse well. Drain.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Peel onion and slice thinly. Melt butter slowly in pan. Add onion and cook slowly over low heat stirring often until onion is golden brown. Add 6 cups water and the bouillon cubes. Cook at least 1 hour. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese when served.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: Mix Sure-Jell with strawberries in a saucepan. Bring to a boil while stirring. Add sugar and boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Seal in jars and let cool.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Blend the ingredients into a ball and serve with a variety of crackers.

title: Meal-In-A-Dish
instructions: Brown beef in oil. Place in casserole dish. Layer remaining ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours. Cover with grated cheese return to oven until cheese is melted. Serve.

title: Barbecued Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a heavy skillet. Cover; cook over low heat for about 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apple Crumb Cake
instructions: Work first four ingredients like a pie crust (leave crumbly). Put 2/3 into a 9 x 13-inch pan and press down lightly. Slice apples on top. (If keeping apples very close you will need 7 or 8 to fill pan evenly.) Mix the last 3 ingredients in a dish; add this mixture and cover the entire apple pan. Add the remaining pie crust on top to cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Check on apple softness; different apples take a longer period of time for baking.)

title: Cherry Nut Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening and lemon extract add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add egg yolks and beat well after each addition. Sift together dry ingredients 2 times. Add liquids and dry ingredients alternately to creamed mixture beating only until smooth after each addition. Stir in nuts and cherries. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Thaw spinach and squeeze as dry as possible. Mix with yogurt cheese egg whites onion 4 ounces Mozzarella cheese and spices. Cook pasta according to package directions. Stuff shells or manicotti with spinach mixture. Put in 11 x 14-inch casserole dish sprayed with nonstick baking spray. Cover with sauce which has been diluted with water.

title: Chocolate Brownie Deluxe
instructions: (Perry County Fair 2nd Place Hersheys Greatest Cocoa Cookie Brownie Bar Contest.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cut 12 doughnuts and holes from bread. Remove crust from scraps fitting scraps in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place cheese slices in layer over bread followed by a layer of broccoli then a layer of ham. Arrange bread doughnuts and holes on top. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over all. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Bake uncovered in slow 325\u00b0 oven for 55 minutes. Sprinkle some grated cheese over top 5 minutes before end of baking. Serves 12.

title: Garry'S Rum Cream Pie
instructions: Beat the egg yolks until light in color then gradually beat in the sugar. Soak the gelatin in the cold water and put on low heat stirring until gelatin is dissolved. In a slow stream pour the gelatin mixture into the egg mixture beating constantly. Cool mixture. Stir in the rum.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch dish. Cook and stir beef until brown; drain. Put in taco seasoning. Mix sour cream mayonnaise cheese and onion and put aside. Mix Bisquick and water until soft dough forms. Pat into greased pan; press to 1/2 inch on sides of pan. Layer beef tomatoes and then green peppers in pan over dough. Spoon sour cream mixture over top. Bake until edges of dough are light brown about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef Wellington
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0 Place meat in lightly greased roasting pan. Sprinkle with pepper if desired. Roast at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thermometer reads 130\u00b0. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Mix ingredients in a large bowl. Chill first if possible. Pour in 4-quart freezer then add sweet milk if not full to freezer line.

title: Tomatoes Provencale
instructions: Halve tomatoes and place on cookie sheet. Crumb toast. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the crumbs. Pile mixture on tomatoes and broil 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Grilled Steak And Vegetable Salad
instructions: Grill steak over medium-hot coals to desired degree of doneness about 20 minutes for medium turning halfway through cooking time. Slice steak diagonally across grain into scant 1/4-inch slices. Combine sliced meat and vegetables in shallow serving bowl. Pour dressing over and toss. Serve immediately or refrigerate several hours. Serve chilled. Makes 6 servings.

title: Marinated Sweet And Sour Salad
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling salted water to cover in a large saucepan until crisp-tender about 5 minutes. Drain; cool. Combine carrots onion and green pepper in a serving bowl.

title: Crisp Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In saucepan mix brown sugar shortening and butter. Cook and stir over low heat until butter and shortening melt. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients mixing well. Drop from teaspoon 3 inches apart on well-greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 about 7 minutes. Cool slightly and remove from pan. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Crab Imperial
instructions: Mix thoroughly first 7 ingredients. Turn over lightly with hands. Put in cleaned crab shells. Top with cracker crumbs. Next spoon melted butter over cracker crumbs and sprinkle with paprika. Bake until browned.

title: Chicken Cheese Soup
instructions: Cover vegetables with water and simmer until tender. Bring the bouillon cubes and 2 quarts of water to boil being sure that the bouillon cubes are dissolved. Melt butter in another pan; add flour to butter slowly. Stir constantly. In just a few seconds it will be thick. Then add to this mixture stirring quickly 1 cup of the boiling water with bouillon cubes then add a little more then add all of this mixture to the water mixture. Stir thoroughly. Add this mixture to the vegetable mixture. Do not drain vegetables. Add Cheez Whiz to soup and stir until dissolved. Add peas to soup. Add chicken cubes. Add bacon crumbles. Simmer for 10 minutes. Youre done.

title: Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Pound each chicken breast into long thin pieces. Place 1 piece of ham and cheese on each chicken breast. Fold chicken breast in half. Garlic salt each side of chicken. Place chicken in hot pan with a small amount of oil. Cook chicken until done turning often (medium high heat; 20 minutes).

title: Applesauce Doughnuts
instructions: Blend butter and sugar. Add eggs. Mix applesauce and soda and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Roll out and cut. Fry in deep fat (350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0). Drain. May coat with granulated sugar or powdered sugar.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix well and pour into a greased skillet or pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar syrup vanilla and salt in large bowl and mix well. Combine butter and cocoa; stir into egg mixture. Add pecans and coconut mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes or until set. Yields 1 pie.

title: Romaine Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Cook sausage until done. Crumble then drain. Mix cheese and sausage. Sprinkle into unbaked pie shell. Lightly beat eggs and combine with remaining ingredients. Pour into pie shell containing sausage mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool 10 minutes on rack.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: Use 2 1/2-quart dish brown ground beef slightly. Layer potatoes ground beef onions kidney beans chili powder salt and pepper to taste and pour tomato soup over top. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Bread Pudding(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: Scald milk with butter. Stir in all other ingredients except the eggs. Mix well then add eggs last stirring gently. Pour into greased pan. Place pan in hot water and bake about 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve about 1 ounce butter sauce with each serving.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Using a shortening cutter cut margarine into flour until it is in coarse cornmeal sized granules. Add water 1 to 2 tablespoons at a time. Just enough to bind the dough together. Overlap 2 sheets of plastic wrap (14-inches long with 2-inch overlap). Very lightly sprinkle them with flour. Put half dough on wrap. Sprinkle dough ball with flour and put 1 more sheet of plastic wrap on top of ball. Roll thin. Remove half of plastic wrap and lay crust in pan. Do not remove top sheet until dough is shaped in pan. This way the dough doesnt stick and there isnt a mess. Makes 2 crusts.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Melt butter. Add green onions and cook until tender about 5 minutes. Mix eggs cream milk and salt. Stir in green onion mixture and remaining ingredients. Divide between 2 pie crusts and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 45 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole dish line the bottom with the tortillas then layer the chicken pieces onion and the remaining liquid mixture combined with the seasoning. Cover with cheese and bake in a moderate oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Cut butter into flour. Blend in 1/4 cup light brown sugar until smooth. Place in shallow dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Quickie Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together with a mixer until smooth. Serve with your choice of fruit.

title: Sweet-Sour Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken wings in a single layer in shortening in electric skillet set at 300\u00b0. Remove as they brown; drain drippings. Add vinegar sugar pineapple juice catsup soy sauce mustard and salt. Bring to a boil at 250\u00b0 for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add chicken wings. Simmer covered for 5 minutes. Turn wings over and cook uncovered for 15 minutes more.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Cook onion and bacon together in the microwave for about 2 minutes in a microwaveable dish. Add pork and beans and brown sugar. Mix together well. Place back in microwave. Cook for 10 minutes. Stir beans and cook for another 10 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over Chex in large bowl. Put powdered sugar in large grocery bag. Pour in mix and shake well.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Line a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan with wax paper. Grease and flour. Set aside. Beat eggs in a large bowl at high speed until thick. Gradually add sugar and beat 5 additional minutes. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Combine flour and next 5 ingredients. Gradually stir into pumpkin mixture. Spread batter evenly in prepared pan. Sprinkle with 1 cup pecans gently pressing into batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Sift flour and combine with next 4 ingredients. Combine egg buttermilk and margarine; add to dry mixture. Stir until smooth. Stir in banana. Use 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Pour onto hot griddle coated with cooking spray. Turn only once when edges look done. Serve with maple syrup and strawberry preserves.

title: Crown Jewel Patties
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Add bread crumbs. Shape into patties and coat with corn flakes. Place on greased baking sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Summer Relish For Cold Meats
instructions: Mix well all ingredients and chill.

title: Heavenly Turtle Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan combine sweetened condensed milk nuts and vanilla. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and begins to pull away from sides of pan about 10 to 12 minutes. Spread nut mixture in bottom of baked pie shell.

title: Cheesy Baked Fish
instructions: Bake fish until almost done. In the last 5 to 10 minutes of baking lay cheese across fish then cover with picante sauce. Return to oven. It is ready as soon as cheese melts. This is good with any mild flavored fish.

title: Strawberry Stuff
instructions: This is a layer dessert. Tear cake into small pieces (about 1-inch cubes). You want to smash up strawberries and have plenty of juice. I usually add a good cup of sugar to the strawberries while they are thawing. Spoon strawberries and juice over cake. This juice will soak into the cake then spoon some Cool Whip over the top of the strawberries. First layer is cake second is strawberries and third is Cool Whip. Repeat layers. Cool Whip should be on top. I usually make 6 layers. It is usually colorful in a glass dish. This is easy and tastes really good.

title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
instructions: They seem not to firm until chilled. No extra flour. Mix oil melted chocolate and sugar in a bowl. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and dry ingredients and chocolate chips. Chill several hours. Roll into balls and top with powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8-10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in casserole dish. Top with buttered stuffing mix or Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Vegetable Soup
instructions: Add ingredients to a crock-pot and cook all day.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Place 1/2 teaspoon dill seed in bottom of pint jar approximately 4 pints. Wash okra and pack as tightly as possible in jars being careful not to bruise. Add 1/2 teaspoon dill seed 1 pod red and green peppers and 1 clove garlic to each jar. Bring vinegar water and salt to a boil. Pour hot mixture over okra; seal and allow to stand 2 weeks. Serve icy cold.

title: Barbecue Hamburger
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in a roaster and smooth it out. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies(Makes 112.  Can Be Halved.)
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. Mix together with other ingredients. Add chocolate chips and chocolate bar. Add chopped nuts. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In a large bowl stir together first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool. Serves 8.

title: Deluxe Potato Bake
instructions: In a large bowl combine eggs bread crumbs onion milk seasoned pepper and seasoned salt. Drain potatoes and stir in egg mixture. Add 1/2 of Cheddar cheese and 1/2 bacon. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bacon. Bake 5 minutes longer. Garnish with additional cooked bacon and parsley.

title: Hamburger Barbecue Sandwiches
instructions: In a large skillet cook beef green pepper and onion stirring to break up meat into small pieces. When meat is brown and vegetables are tender pour off excess drippings. Mix vinegar mustard ketchup sugar Worcestershire and pepper; add to beef mixture. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon onto hamburger buns. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pecan Fingers
instructions: Mix. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Shape into balls or crescent shapes about 1/2 tablespoon in size. Bake 15 minutes. Cool. Roll in powdered sugar. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Pear Mincemeat
instructions: Grind fruit including peels of lemon and oranges. Cook in a large roaster pan in a 300\u00b0 oven for 2 hours. (Cook uncovered.) Stir every 20 minutes.

title: Miracle Whip Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add salad dressing; mix well. Add vanilla and water; mix well. Pour into 8 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lorie'S Pumpkin Whoopie Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut into small cakes.

title: Zucchini Brownies
instructions: Spread on greased and floured cookie sheet. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1 cup chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Black And White Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. In large bowl combine brownie mix water oil and egg. Beat 50 strokes by hand. Add 1 1/2 cups pecans chocolate chips and coarsely chopped baking bar; mix well. Spread in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 33 to 39 minutes or until center is set. Remove from oven; immediately sprinkle with finely chopped baking bar. Let stand 2 minutes to soften; spread evenly over brownies.

title: Crab Meat Salad
instructions: Mix in order. Mix well and chill for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Chop squash and onion and boil together until tender. Remove from heat and drain then stir in salt pepper milk butter and egg; mix well. Crush crackers. Grate cheese then pour into 2 layers. Start with squash then cheese and crackers. Repeat again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cream margarine and Crisco. Add sugar gradually. Add eggs separately. Beat well. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately. Add vanilla. Beat well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Molasses Surprise Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and molasses. Add eggs; mix well. Sift together flour salt soda ginger nutmeg and cinnamon. Add small amount of dry ingredients and mix until blended. Stir in sour milk nuts and chocolate chips. Mix in remaining dry ingredients. Drop from tablespoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Walnut Bread
instructions: Combine ingredients in order listed. Bake in a greased loaf pan for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix sugar crumbs peanut butter and butter until well blended. Scrape into a 9x13 inch ungreased pan; press into an even layer. Spread melted chocolate over top. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting bars.

title: Pineapple Snow
instructions: Mix all together and pour into an 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Casserole Supreme
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain well. Add onion chili powder Heinz 57 tomato juice and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 20 minutes. Combine pork and beans ketchup sugar and mustard; add to meat mixture. Grease a 2-quart casserole; alternate layers of meat mixture and spaghetti. Cover with enough additional tomato juice to completely cover top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni until done. Shred cheese. Crumble crackers until fine in a blender or use rolling pin. Layer macaroni cheese and about 5 slices of margarine twice. Add milk about halfway up in bowl. Sprinkle on cracker crumbs and pepper (optional). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown or 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix first five ingredients together and form into bite size balls and chill. Melt the chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler. Dip each piece with a toothpick and place on waxed paper to dry.

title: Potatoes Hamburger
instructions: Brown hamburger then add onion and peppers. Cook for 10 minutes then add potatoes sliced with skin left on. Cook until potatoes are tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Orange And Pineapple Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken. Cook and stir 3 minutes. Drain. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in combined dressing juice and sugar. Add rice and green pepper. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add oranges and pineapple chunks. Let stand covered 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Pour peach pie filling in large bowl with lid. Drain all other fruit and add pineapple last. Stir and let stand overnight. Stir before serving. Good with any meal.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes. Bake in hot oven 45 to 60 minutes. When done cut crisscross on top and scoop out potato; mash. Add milk margarine and seasoning. Refill potato shells and sprinkle with grated cheese. Return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Lane Cake
instructions: Bake mix as directed on box. Let cool split the layers once and set aside. Cook together the yolks butter and sugar until thick; add the rest of ingredients and cook until it thickens again. Lay the first split layer on serving plate and spread the cooked ingredients over each layer. Do not put it on sides until you are finished and you know there is enough left over to do them. This cake is pretty if it doesnt have it on the sides. Also you can place cherry halves on top of cake.

title: Cavitini
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding cooked and drained noodles and bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix and shape into balls the size of a quarter. Bake on a foil-lined cookie sheet at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream together the butter and sugar. Add the eggs. Beat until light and fluffy. Add the almond extract. Stir in the flour and baking powder. Mix until smooth. Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Turn the mixture into the pan. Spoon the pie filling into the cake in 16 spots spacing 4 spoonfuls evenly in each directions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden. Filling will sink into the cake while baking.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Sift the flour with baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add water and milk all at once and mix just until dough follows fork around bowl. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Turn out on lightly floured surface; knead gently 1/2 minute. Roll out 1/2 inch thick and cut with biscuit cutter glass or cup. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes just until golden brown on top. Yields 16 medium biscuits.

title: Farmers Meal
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion. Cook peel and shred potatoes. Place hamburger potatoes and soup in layers and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Put cheese on top when nearly done.

title: Cabbage Lasagna
instructions: Saute ground turkey onion and green pepper until meat is browned. Boil cabbage until tender. Save 2 cups liquid and drain off excess. Combine 2 cups liquid oregano pepper salt and tomato paste and simmer on low heat for 4 minutes. Add meat onion and pepper to mixture. In a 9x13 pan pour half of meat mixture then add cabbage Pour remaining meat mixture and then top with shredded mozzarella. Bake at 400 until cheese is browned about 30-45 minutes.

title: Grecian Shrimp
instructions: Saute onion lemon juice oregano butter in oil. Add shrimp and cook until pink. Before serving add feta cheese in large chunks into hot mixture. Serve hot over pasta or rice or serve cold on romaine lettuce.

title: B.B.  King'S Beale Street Blues Sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan combine ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour. Remove bay leaves. Serve warm. Refrigerate unused sauce for up to several weeks.

title: Cool Carrots
instructions: Peel carrots. Cook until tender. Slice into pennies. Saute onion and pepper in small amount of oil until just tender. Add salt to cooking water. Mix oil sugar and vinegar. Heat to dissolve sugar. Add other ingredients and pour over carrots. Cover and refrigerate at least overnight.

title: Shrimp Curry
instructions: In microwave oven simmer butter onion and celery until soft in a 2-quart glass casserole dish. Add all other ingredients. Cook on simmer until shrimp are pink approximately 15 minutes. Some microwaves vary.

title: Slaw
instructions: Shred the cabbage onion and pepper. Pour 1/2 cup sugar over the top. Do not stir. In a saucepan combine the oil vinegar salt celery seed and dry mustard. Bring to a boil and then pour over the cabbage onion and green pepper. Do not stir. Refrigerate overnight. Stir before serving.

title: Vegetable Soup (Italian Style)(Very Unusual Soup)
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and garlic in olive oil. Add broth tomatoes and rice. Simmer longer if using wild rice. Add zucchini potato and beans. Add water as desired. Serve with grated Mozzarella or Parmesan cheese.

title: Turkey Salad Burritos(Serves 4)
instructions: In medium mixing bowl combine turkey celery black olives and cheese. In another bowl whisk together salad dressing picante sauce and salt. Pour sauce over turkey mixture. Blend well.

title: Chinese Spareribs
instructions: Pour spices over meat and marinate for 15 minutes. Broil over a low flame for 10 minutes on each side. Serve hot. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Slice cake in thin pieces. Arrange 1/2 of cake pieces in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Beat the cream cheese and sugar. Beat in Cool Whip. Spread half of the cream cheese mixture over the cake. Layer more cake slices on top. Spread remaining cheese mixture over cake layer. Top with cherry topping. Chill.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms; finely chop stems. Melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Add mushroom stems and onion. Cook stirring until onion is limp. Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice crab bread crumbs egg dill and 1/4 cup cheese. Blend well.

title: Rhubarb Pudding
instructions: Mix rhubarb and sugar together well and put into greased 13 x 9-inch pan or dish. Beat eggs and milk and pour over rhubarb. Finally mix last three items together. Crumble and add on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
instructions: Reserve 1 egg for garnish. Chop other 2 eggs; lightly toss together chopped eggs beans celery relish onions and salt to taste. Gently blend in sour cream. Cover and chill to blend flavors. Serve garnished with egg; 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese may be added before the sour cream.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut up the chicken as you would for frying. Brown slightly in small amount of oil and set aside. In a 2-quart casserole dish place a layer of sliced potatoes and then cover with a layer of peas. Arrange pieces of chicken over this. Add salt and pepper to cream and pour over the chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove cover and return to oven until chicken is brown. Add biscuits for topping if desired and bake 15 minutes or until chicken and/or biscuits are brown.

title: Red-Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix all together in a gallon container. Finish filling with water and place in freezer. Take out morning of the day of serving.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Stir eggs. Add flour and all the other ingredients; mix well. Cook uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts Diane
instructions: Place chicken breast halves between sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Pound slightly with mallet. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon each of oil and butter in large skillet. Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side. Do not cook longer or they will be overcooked and dry. Transfer to warm serving platter.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream butter/oleo with the sugar. Add eggs vanilla and vinegar. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top is nice and brown approximately 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Easy Pork Chops
instructions: Brown onion in melted oleo. Place pork chops in bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle browned onion over. Cover with mushroom soup. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until pork chops are done.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients and cook to a rolling boil. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and add the peanut butter vanilla and oatmeal. Mix well and drop on wax paper.

title: Millionaire Salad
instructions: Add lemon juice sugar butter and marshmallows to slightly beaten eggs. Cook until dissolved then cool to room temperature. Add fruit and nuts. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze overnight. Remove from freezer 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Grease and flour pans 5 mini or 2 large loaf pans. Toast coconut in shallow baking pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 7 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned stirring frequently. Set aside. Mix together cake mix pudding water eggs and oil. Mix for 1 minute. Add poppy seed and coconut. Pour into pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven. Five mini loaf pans bake about 30 minutes. Two large loaf pans bake about 45 to 60 minutes. Done when knife comes out clean.

title: Baked Ham
instructions: Stud ham with cloves. In a blender combine the next four ingredients and pour over ham. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake for 2 hours. As the pan juice cooks down add ginger ale. Baste ham every 15 minutes adding ginger ale as needed.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Make paste of flour sugar salt and juice. Add butter. Cook until thick. Add egg. Cool. Add juice of 1/2 lemon. Chop pineapple oranges marshmallows cherries and nuts. Add cooked dressing and whipping cream. Fold all together. Freeze.

title: Seven Can Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tuna Pie
instructions: Cook onion and celery in butter for 10 minutes. Add flour; stir until smooth. Add soup salt and pepper; cook until thick stirring constantly. Take off heat; stir in drained tuna. Chop eggs; stir in. Pour into small greased casserole; top with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Texas Straw Hats
instructions: Brown ground beef in one skillet and drain. Meanwhile saute onions pepper and celery in 3 tablespoons cooking oil just until onions are clear and celery is still crisp. Combine browned beef with sauteed veggies in a large pot. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes. Serve over Fritos and top with grated cheese. Serves 6 + as main dish or many more when used as a \Dip\ for holiday parties! Learned this one when I was a girl scout.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine 1 cup oleo powdered sugar and eggs. Beat with electric mixer for 15 minutes. While this is mixing combine 1/2 cup oleo and the graham cracker crumbs. Pat this mixture real firm into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread the filling on top. Slice the bananas over the top of this. Sprinkle the pineapple over this. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate 3 hours. Cut in squares and serve.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in deep dish. Add all the other ingredients over chicken. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. Remove cover and bake 1/2 hour or until brown and chicken is done.

title: New Potato Salad
instructions: Wash potatoes; leave the peeling on. Slice potatoes in about 1/8-inch pieces. Cook in boiling water until done. Drain water and pour potatoes into bowl. Chop bacon and onion and put in bowl with potatoes. Pour Ranch dressing over mixture and toss. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tuna Cheese Souffle Sandwich
instructions: Place 4 slices bread in greased 8-inch pan. Combine all ingredients except soup and eggs. Spread evenly over bread in pan. Blend together soup and eggs pour over sandwiches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until set and lightly browned.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Stir together sugar and oil. Beat in eggs and pumpkin. Add and mix in dry ingredients. Pour into a greased bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Healthy Oven-Fry Chicken (Tenders Or Breast)
instructions: Coat chicken lightly with melted margarine and dredge in seasoned dry bread crumbs. Place in an ungreased shallow baking pan. Oven fry at 425\u00b0 for 5 to 9 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through. For crisper chicken coat pan with 1 tablespoon melted margarine or vegetable oil and preheat oven for 5 minutes before adding chicken.

title: Cookies
instructions: You first put some sugar in then flour and beat em. Then you put in a last thing is to cook it. Then you eat it.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Whip up cream cheese with fork until creamy. Put in all ingredients except 1 cup pecans. Mix and form in ball and roll in remaining pecans. Wrap in aluminum foil and let set overnight (so flavors will not be so strong). Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in bottom of casserole dish. Slice eggs over. Dilute soup with 1/2 can chicken broth. Pour over above. Spread dressing mix over this. Pour 1 1/2 cups broth over dressing mix. Put pats of butter on top and sprinkle with black pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cold Taco Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese with sour cream (with electric mixer). Add taco seasoning and mix. Pour in dish. Drain salsa sauce well and sprinkle over mixture. Place shredded lettuce on top then fresh tomato and then shredded cheese. Serve cold with taco chips. Serves 10.

title: Weight Watchers Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spoon into muffin pan sprayed with Pam. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 6 muffins.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in butter. Roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture. Arrange in loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter together. Add eggs and zucchini. Add flour soda baking powder and cinnamon sifted together. Add zucchini mixture blending well. Add nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ground beef. Mix well. Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Place in loaf pan and bake 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice. Boil in salted water until tender. Drain potatoes. Mash thoroughly and add eggs. Mix well. Add sugar and butter and milk and flavoring. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie crust and bake on 350\u00b0 until done. This mixture will be soupy.

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: For crust mix cake mix coconut butter and 1 egg until crumbly. Press into ungreased 9x13 inch pan.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape into patties. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Open Face Tuna Sandwiches
instructions: Layer first 4 ingredients in order (tuna on toast with the onion over tuna and the eggs over onion). Mix the soup milk parsley and lemon juice together. Pour over sandwiches and broil 5 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Eggplant Casserole(Wonderful!)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cover peeled and diced eggplant with water; add 1 teaspoon salt and simmer over low heat until tender 10 to 15 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Combine eggplant with remaining ingredients and mix. Pour into square or round baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Recipe makes 6 servings. Ultra low-fat.

title: Barbecue Kielbasa
instructions: In large skillet saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 3 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened stirring occasionally. Yields 4 servings.

title: Browned Rice No. 2
instructions: Cut up onion and celery. Brown in butter. Add rice and brown. Place in casserole; add salt pepper consomme and water. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Lobster Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients to a soft dough. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Melt the last 3 ingredients. Brush mixture over biscuits immediately out of the oven!

title: Chicken-Fried Steak
instructions: Pound steak 1/4-inch thick; cut into serving pieces. Blend egg and milk. Dip meat in egg mixture then in crumbs. Slowly brown meat in hot oil turning once. Cover; cook on low heat for 45 to 60 minutes until tender. Season to taste. Serves 6.

title: Whipped Cream Icing
instructions: Beat margarine and Crisco until creamy. Add sugar gradually; beat well. Add milk slowly beating until light and fluffy.

title: Rhubarb Preserves With Jello
instructions: Cook rhubarb until done. Add sugar and Sweet*10. Boil for 5 minutes. Pour this mixture over jello. Stir until jello is dissolved. Cool. Put in jars. Enjoy the preserves!

title: Three Layer Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix and spread in 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 7 minutes; cool.

title: Moo-Moo Good
instructions: Brown meat with onions. Add tomatoes beans and rice. Pour into casserole dish. Top with crushed Fritos and grated cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Put milk onion lemon juice Tabasco celery salt garlic salt salt pepper and egg in a bowl. Add salmon that has been boned and dark skin removed. Flake with a fork. Add oleo and crumbs. If dry add salmon juice. Pour into a buttered casserole dish and bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serves 4-6.

title: Velvet Salad
instructions: Mix dry Jell-o pineapple and sour cream. Mix cool whip nuts and marshmallows. Combine Jell-o mixture with cool whip mixture. Chill in mold or bowl for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken
instructions: Stir-fry chicken in oil for 4 minutes. Combine chicken and vegetables; stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup mayonnaise and soy sauce to taste.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together rice chicken broccoli cream of chicken soup water salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Top this with dabs of butter.\tSprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Drizzle melted butter over the\tcrumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top is brown.

title: Mexican Hero
instructions: Toast Chex crumbs in a 300\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes; set aside. Combine egg seasoned salt and taco sauce. Stir in ground beef and Chex. Shape into 4 oval patties to fit bread loaf. Broil or grill for 10 to 12 minutes or until done. Turn midway. Place end to end on split French bread. Spoon on additional taco sauce. Top with tomato lettuce and cheese. To serve place top on loaf and slice crosswise.

title: Sweet And Sour Mustard
instructions: Mix mustard and peppers with enough water to make a smooth paste. Add sugars and vinegar. Bring to a boil stirring continuously. Add butter and stir until melted. Add a little of the hot mixture to the eggs; mix well. Pour this into hot mixture in pan. Continue to stir. Bring to a boil again over medium heat. Pour into jar. Cool and refrigerate. This is guaranteed to open your sinuses!!!

title: Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Brush one side of one slice bread with melted butter. Spread Russian dressing on other side of bread slice. Place corned beef on dressing put sauerkraut on top of corned beef and then the cheese on top of that. Cover with other bread slice. In a skillet melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter; place sandwich in skillet and cook until browned and cheese is melted. Serves 1.

title: Uncooked Relish
instructions: Put each vegetable through food chopper using coarse blade. If vegetables are covered with liquid drain off and discard liquid. Measure each vegetable after chopping.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into a loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat eggs gently with sugar. Add oil water and pumpkin. Add flour soda salt cinnamon dates and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in 2 loaf pans.

title: Slaw Salad
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Set aside. Mix the rest of the ingredients together in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Pour over cabbage immediately; mix well. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Acorn Squash
instructions: Bake squash in oven or microwave until nearly tender. Saute apple and celery in butter for 5 minutes. Stir in crumbs and salt and pepper. Fill squash with mixture and top with cheese. Bake 15 minutes longer until tender. Serves 2.

title: Philadelphia Relish
instructions: Let stand at least an hour before serving. Yield 2 1/2 cups.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix soup butter and Cheez Whiz in saucepan until melted and smooth. Add hominy and onion. Put crushed Fritos on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: No Ball Sugar Cookies
instructions: With mixer mix sugars oleo and oil then beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift together the flour baking soda and cream of tartar. Add them to mixture. Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Form into small balls and roll in sugar. Flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in hot pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Reese'S Cup Candy
instructions: Melt oleo. Add powdered sugar and creamy peanut butter; mix well. To this mixture add graham cracker crumbs. Mix well and press into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread over top.

title: Snicker Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill overnight. Roll into balls the size of a quarter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Place sausage in iron skillet and bake at 500\u00b0 until done.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Bake
instructions: Cook box of macaroni. Combine soup and milk in a saucepan. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Grease bottom and sides of a deep Corningware dish. Layer with cooked macaroni. Cut tomatoes in small pieces and layer; then add a layer of soup mixture and finally a layer of grated cheese. Continue layers ending with a layer of grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly around edges. This is great reheated in the microwave!

title: Banana Split Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 1/2 cup of juice. Set aside.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Wild Plum Jelly
instructions: In a large kettle simmer plums and water until tender about 30 minutes. Pour through a damp jelly bag allowing juice to drip into a bowl. Measure 5 1/2 cups of juice; return to the kettle. Add pectin; stir and bring to a boil. Add sugar; bring to a full rolling boil. Boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Skim off any foam. Pour hot into hot jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process for 5 minutes in a boiling water bath. Yield about 8 half pints.

title: Maque Choux
instructions: Saute onion for a few minutes in olive oil and butter then add bell pepper. A couple of minutes later add corn stirring all the while. This mixture should just be about done then add diced tomatoes. Cook about 2 more minutes then season with salt pepper and sugar. Makes 6 servings.

title: Wiener And Potato Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and mix in next 4 ingredients. Add both milks. Bring to boil and boil for 1 minute or until thick. Stir in Parmesan cheese and parsley flakes. Boil potatoes and cut in cubes; place in casserole dish. Cut up wieners and add to potatoes; mix in sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Cream together oleo Crisco sugar and eggs. Sift together and add flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Add apples and nuts. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle top with a little sugar and cinnamon.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Melt shortening in skillet; add beef onion salt pepper and flour. Cook until meat loses its red color stirring occasionally. Drain off excess fat. Stir in water Worcestershire sauce and ketchup; simmer stirring occasionally for 15 to 20 minutes or until of desired consistency. Serve in buns. Makes 8 sandwiches.

title: Cheese Cookies
instructions: Blend softened margarine and grated cheese. Add flour salt and cayenne pepper. Knead dough finally adding Rice Krispies. Roll in small balls then flatten with hand on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done approximately 10 to 12 minutes depending on the oven.

title: Rob'S Fried Zucchini
instructions: Combine egg milk flour salt and garlic salt in bowl; mix well to form batter. Dip each zucchini round into batter; fry in deep fat. Batter zucchini when ready to fry so each piece is coated. Fry until crisp and golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: No Bake Peanut Cookies
instructions: Cook hard the sugar milk and margarine for 1 1/2 minutes. Add the oats and peanut butter. Stir thoroughly and drop by teaspoons onto wax paper.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Mix cabbage peppers carrots and salt. Let stand 1 hour. Boil sugar vinegar and celery seed for 3 minutes. Let cool. Pour over cabbage mixture. Pur into containers and freeze. To serve simply thaw.

title: Fruit Cocktail Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and Cool Whip then add fruit cocktail and jello. Let set for 2 hours before serving. Keeps in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender except for oil and poppy seed. Process for 15 seconds in blender. Then add oil and seed. Mix well. Serve with salad of spinach mushrooms bean sprouts mandarin orange small red onion fresh strawberries and sunflower seeds.

title: Aloha Cake
instructions: Follow directions on mixing from the back of cake box. Use the pineapple juice in place of water. If pineapple juice is not enough just add water for the right amount required. Cook cake by using directions from cake box. Mix cream cheese vanilla pudding and milk (thats required on pudding box). Add sugar to taste. Next spread whip topping. Then place cherries for the finishing touch. Add pecans if desired. Keep refrigerated until served.

title: Mostaccioli And Sausage Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage; drain. In 2-quart baking dish combine sausage sauce noodles and 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese. Mix well. Top with remaining cheese. Bake 25 minutes or until heated through. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and line cake pan with mixture. Beat egg whites butter and powdered sugar for 10 minutes and spread over cracker mixture. Add pineapple slice bananas long ways and place over pineapple. Top with whipped cream nuts and maraschino cherries.

title: Erin'S Heavenly Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit. Stir in sour cream thoroughly. Add marshmallows. Garnish with maraschino cherries.

title: White Chocolate Candy
instructions: Melt the chocolate and peanut butter. Add all ingredients and mix well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let cool and place in a tin. Keeps well.

title: Coconut-Cranberry Chews
instructions: Beat the butter sugar orange peel and vanilla until smooth. Beat in the egg. Mix in the flour baking powder and salt. Mix until dough comes together. Mix in the cranberries and coconut. Shape into balls and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes. Let cookies cool... and then enjoy!

title: Lo-Cal Summer Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours. Serve with assorted fresh vegetables. Yield 2 1/4 cups.

title: Easy Chicken Breasts
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken. Stir well. Pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Good with rice or mashed potatoes. Makes lots of gravy.

title: Cranberry Cherry Pie
instructions: Let pie crust stand out of refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add egg and blend. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 1 inch apart on cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until very light brown at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Our Lord'S Old Scripture Cake
instructions: Beat on low speed until pecky and fluffy.

title: Whiskey Balls
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers in blender also nuts and coconut. Mix all together form in balls and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Venison Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles in salted water. Brown meat and onion in oil. Drain. Add oregano and sauce to meat. Simmer for 15 minutes. Layer noodles cottage cheese meat sauce and Mozzarella cheese in pan. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Slaw
instructions: Mix vegetables. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer until well blended then cool. Pour over vegetables. It will stay crisp for several days.

title: Super Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain and cool. Mix all ingredients and chill at least 4 hours. (Can use yellow or red bell peppers. Some of each looks pretty.)

title: Champagne Strawberries
instructions: Combine strawberries and sugar in bowl. Stir in white wine. Chill several hours. Spoon sauce and strawberries into four 6 ounce goblets. Pour champagne over each.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order given. Mix thoroughly until moist. Pour into two greased bread pans. Combine 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon of butter. Mix until crumbly and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Overnight Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine fruit. Add marshmallows and mix well. Chill slightly and mix again. Fold in whipped topping and chill overnight.

title: Caramel Apple Slices(Microwave)
instructions: Melt caramels with water in microwave bowl stirring occasionally. When ready spoon over apple slices.

title: Chess Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix with 1 egg and butter. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Combine remaining eggs sugar and cream cheese together mixing well. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Cheesy Chicken Soup
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Use water from chicken for soup. Shred the chicken add other ingredients and enough water to cover everything good. Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Flan
instructions: Blend eggs and milk for 2 minutes. Heat sugar in pan over very low heat until caramelized. Immediately put caramel into large container add remaining ingredients on top of caramel. Cover container and place into a larger pan filled with water. Heat over medium-low heat until ready.

title: French Onion Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in the warm water. In a large bowl combine shortening and hot water. Add the sugar salt and soup mix and stir well. Add yeast mixture. Gradually add the flour to make a stiff dough. Knead on a floured board until smooth and elastic. Let rise in a warm place until double in bulk. Punch down and let rise again 1/2 hour. Shape in 2 loaves; it makes nice round ones in 8-inch cake pans. Let rise until light and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch dish. In layers on top of hamburger put cheese chopped chilies and onion. Pour on cream of mushroom soup and put on Tater Tots in rows. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together and store in an airtight container for up to 6 months.

title: Tuna Goulash
instructions: Mix in baking dish and pour 1 can mushroom soup over top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mrs. Ruth'S Cake
instructions: Dissolve cocoa in 1 cup hot water. Mix well. Bake in greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain. Fry hamburger and drain. Mix together hamburger sauce chilies onion salt and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes. Combine spaghetti and sauce; mix well. Layer two 9 x 13-inch baking dishes with half the spaghetti; top with half of the cheese and cover with remaining spaghetti and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. (Half recipe fills one 9 x 13-inch pan.)

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Add all dry ingredients into sifter. Sift right into ungreased 9 x 9-inch pan. Make 2 small \holes\ in pan. In one hole add oil the second hole vinegar then pour cold water over everything. Mix with fork until flour is wet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Speedy Chili
instructions: Melt fat; add hamburg onion and pepper. Cook until meat is lightly browned. Add tomato sauce; simmer for 5 minutes. Add kidney beans chili and salt. Simmer.

title: Peppermint Kisses
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff enough to hold in points. Add 8 tablespoons of sugar gradually and beat until fluffy. Fold in remaining sugar salt candy and chocolate bits. Cover cookie sheet with unglazed paper and drop mixture by spoonfuls onto sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until delicately browned firm and dry. Remove from paper immediatley. Kisses should be used within one week after baking unless frozen. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and cranberries together and let stand overnight or several hours. Add gelatin to boiling water. Stir until dissolved. Add other ingredients and chill. Use the pineapple juice and less water if desired.

title: Beef N' Bean Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ground beef half of the dry bread crumbs 1/4 cup cream of mushroom soup egg thyme leaves salt and pepper. Press mixture evenly against bottom and sides of an ungreased 9-inch pie pan. Cover meat mixture with the French-style green beans. Spread remaining cream of mushroom soup over the green beans. Bake uncovered for approximately 35 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Kentucky Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder baking soda salt and sugar in mixing bowl. Cut in butter or margarine with pastry blender until mixture resemble coarse crumbs. Add buttermilk. Mix quickly to make a soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead a few times to make a soft dough; dont overknead or the biscuits will turn hard and dry. Roll out to a 6 x 6-inch square. Place on ungreased baking sheet. With knife cut dough into 12 even portions; do not separate. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Dust with flour and melted butter.

title: One Rise Monkey Bread
instructions: Grease a 12-cup fluted tube pan or 10-inch tube pan. In a large bowl blend 1 1/2 cup flour sugar salt yeast water margarine and egg at low speed until moistened. Beat for 3 minutes at medium speed. Stir in remaining flour by hand. Knead dough on floured surface until smooth about 1 minute. Press and roll dough to 15 x 2-inch rectangle. Using sharp knife cut dough into diamond shaped pieces by cutting into 2-inch strips diagonally across dough. In shallow pan melt the 1/3 cup margarine dip each piece of dough in melted butter and place in prepared pan making layers. Sprinkle each with poppy seed. Cover. Let raise in a warm place until light and double in size (45 to 60 minutes). Heat oven at 375\u00b0. Bake 20 to 25 minutes deep brown. Butter top while still warm.

title: Jello Plum Pudding
instructions: Dissolve gelatin dessert mix in boiling water. Stir in cold water and spices. Chill until very thick. Fold in the remaining ingredients and chill until firm. Good with hard sauce or whipped cream.

title: Butter Fingers
instructions: Sift about 1/2 box confectioners sugar; measure out 4 tablespoons sugar. Cream butter and sugar; add flour and pecans. Make out in finger size rolls. Cook in slow oven about 250\u00b0 or 300\u00b0 until brown. Roll on remainder of sugar.

title: Hero Hamburgers
instructions: Combine beef and 1/4 of barbecue sauce eggs and salt. Mix lightly and divide into 16 portions. Gently shape into thin round patties. Place 1 teaspoon each barbecue sauce cheese relish and onions on 8 of the patties. Top them with remaining 8 patties. Press edges together; broil or fry 4 minutes on one side turn baste with remaining barbecue sauce and cook 4 minutes longer or until meat is done. Serve on buns. Makes 8 servings.

title: Dad'S Own Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in oil on medium high in a medium saucepan until soft (about 5 minutes). Add the garlic and saute for a minute more. Transfer the onions and garlic to a medium bowl. Add the ketchup mustard honey Worcestershire sauce vinegar molasses cinnamon salt and cayenne pepper and mix well. Pour over or brush on meat during last 3 or 4 minutes of barbecuing. The sauce is best for chicken ribs or pork chops. If you dont like this you dont like barbecue.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks\twith milk. Mix cornstarch with brown sugar and add egg and\tmilk mixture gradually. Add salt. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add butter and vanilla. Beat egg whites until they form soft peaks. Add 1/2 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks. Pour filling in baked pie shell. Top with meringue and bake at 400\u00b0 until browned on top.\tCool and chill.

title: Frozen Berry-Melon Pops
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Press fruit mixture through a fine mesh strainer over a bowl to extract juices. Discard solids. Pour mixture into 3-ounce paper or plastic drink cups or pop molds. Cover with foil. Cut a slit in the foil and insert wooden sticks. Freeze several hours until pops are firm.

title: Spicy Chicken With Olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F. Crush garlic under flat blade of chefs knife; remove and discard peels. Set aside.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until thick. Cool completely. Do not work with it if it is warm. Add oleo and shortening. Beat until creamy and frost.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Slice each tray of rolls through the middle. Spread sauce on both halves of each tray. Place ham on bottom halves. Top with remaining halves. Cover trays with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Best served hot.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: In a medium bowl combine flour white sugar 2 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and salt. Stir in the milk oil and vanilla until smooth. Spread in an ungreased 9 x 9 square baking pan. Combine brown sugar and remaining cocoa. Sprinkle over batter. Pour hot water over all. DO NOT STIR. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm. Top with whipped cream or ice cream if desired.

title: Osceola Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all but garnish and then top around edges or center of spread with them. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 30 minutes but check off and on. Serve with favorite cracker.

title: Holiday Ham And Chili Cheese Ball
instructions: In a small bowl combine cheeses deviled ham scallions and chilies; mix well. Shape mixture into a ball. Roll in chopped nuts. Wrap in plastic wrap; chill. Remove from refrigerator to soften slightly before serving. Serve with your favorite crackers. Makes 1 (2-cup) cheese ball.

title: Snow Caps
instructions: Split hot dogs lengthwise. Place in shallow pan. Combine onions and potatoes. Put on top of hot dogs. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Serves four.

title: Pizza Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix in 9 x 13-inch greased pan with egg 1 cup cheese milk and garlic salt. Pour spaghetti sauce over spaghetti. Add 3 cups cheese and arrange pepperoni on top. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes before serving.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir until mixed well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Mushroom Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine soup 1/2 cup cheese pepper salt mushrooms and onion in a bowl. Gradually add milk. Stir in potatoes. Place in a greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Cinnamon Bars
instructions: Cream butter in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg yolk flour and cinnamon; mix until well blended. Press mixture into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Pour egg white over surface; drain off excess. Sprinkle chopped pecans over top. Press lightly into dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into 3 x 1-inch bars; cool on wire racks. Yield about 4 dozen.

title: Vanilla Sauce
instructions: *Brandy rum or sherry to taste may be used in place of vanilla.

title: Tomato Gravy
instructions: Heat tomato juice and sugar almost to a boil. Dissolve flour in milk; mix to a thin paste and add to tomato juice. Stir until smooth and thick cooking thoroughly.

title: Sugar Cream Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Add water. Stir until shiny. Add milk. Mix well. Pour in deep pie shell. Dot with butter cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10-inch pie plate and set aside.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crab meat with mixer then add crab meat and mix with a spoon. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes in Pam sprayed pan. Sprinkle extra cheese on top and return to oven to melt.

title: Cherry Something
instructions: Prepare pudding mix according to package directions. Mix with Cool Whip and nuts. You can use a serving dish or individual dishes. Place angel food cake on the bottom of dish. Put pudding mixture on top of cake. Pour cherry pie filling over this and refrigerate.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well in blender. Serve as a fresh dip for vegetables.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Use 8 x 8-inch greased pan.

title: Rhubarb Pudding Cake
instructions: Slice rhubarb into 1-inch lengths. Arrange in a greased 8-inch square pan. Cream the shortening and 3/4 cup of sugar. Blend in bran flakes. Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add alternately with milk to shortening and sugar mixture. Spread batter over rhubarb.

title: Spaetzels(Chewy European Dumplings)
instructions: Mix to a stiff smooth dough. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon into boiling water dipping the spoon into water between each dumpling to keep dough from sticking. Boil about 5 minutes; drain. Serve with goulash and stew.

title: Hot Or Mulled Cider
instructions: Heat well but do not boil. Serve warm.

title: Smoky Salmon Dip
instructions: Drain salmon; reserve 2 tablespoons salmon liquid. Flake salmon and set aside. Combine and blend cream cheese salmon liquid lemon juice horseradish and liquid smoke. Fold in salmon and green onions. Refrigerate until chilled to allow flavors to meld. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Orange And Cherry Cobbler
instructions: In saucepan combine pie filling water and lemon juice. Heat to boiling. Pour into a round cake dish. Top hot cherries with rolls cut side up. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until rolls are done. Spread tops with the icing that comes in the orange roll package. Serve warm. (Also try peach filling.)

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed drain and rinse with cold water. Combine macaroni and other ingredients. Mix salad dressing and pour over salad.

title: Sad Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add brown sugar and Bisquick mix; mix well. Add vanilla nuts and coconut; mix well. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Cake is real chewy.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in the oleo. In a separate bowl mix the eggs and corn. Mix the sauteed onion and pepper with sour cream and corn bread mix. Add eggs and corn to the mixture and spread in a greased 7 x 12 inch baking dish. Cover mixture with shredded cheese and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

title: Nuts Over Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter and shortening at medium speed with an electric mixer about 2 minutes or until soft and creamy. Gradually add sugar beating at medium speed for 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating just until yellow disappears.

title: Fabulous Ham And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Spread half the bread cubes evenly in dish. Add the ham and both cheeses then cover with remaining bread cubes. Mix eggs milk onion salt and mustard. Pour evenly over bread cubes and refrigerate overnight. Combine corn flakes and butter for a topping. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Pinwheel Hash Ring
instructions: Combine last 4 ingredients. Unroll each crescent roll. Place triangles of dough on greased cookie sheet with large ends of each triangle in the middle overlapping slightly with small ends pointing outward to edges of cookie sheet. Effect will be of a large sunburst with open circle in center. Place hash mixture in ring over base of triangles. Fold points over filling and tuck under the base of the center with filling showing between slits of the ring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be served with scrambled eggs stewed tomatoes or celery soup if desired.

title: No Guilt Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a 9 inch pie plate mix chicken vegetables and soup. Mix milk egg and baking mix. Pour over chicken mixture. Bake 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Doughy White Bread
instructions: Melt butter and allow to cool. Follow package directions to activate yeast. Sift flour sugar and salt. Combine with egg. Add butter and milk. Add yeast last. Beat well. Return to bowl and let rise covered for one hour or until doubled. Shape into two loaves and let rise in pans. Brush with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown approximately 30 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf With Piquant Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix lightly. Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes. Drain. Let set for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sugar-Free Vegetable Gelatin Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Add cold water. Let set until partially thickened. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until firm. Serves 4.

title: Quick Pepper Steak
instructions: Remove fat from meat and brown. Cut steak into bite-size pieces. Add mushrooms and gravy. Cook noodles and drain. Serve steak and gravy over noodles. Excellent with rolls and tossed salad.

title: Graham Cracker Candy
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar and Pet milk. Cook on medium heat for 3 minutes. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Remove from heat and add crumbs coconut and nuts. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Deviled Clams
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and let stand for bread crumbs to absorb liquid. Mixture should be moist. Fill the half clam shells. Sprinkle each with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Cut rhubarb into 1-inch pieces and put into saucepan with sugar and 1/4 cup water. Cover and cook about 15 minutes.

title: Baked Alaska
instructions: Make cake as directed on box. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Remove from pan; let completely cool. Slice cake into 4 pieces. Slice ice cream lengthwise about the thickness of the cake layers. On one layer place ice cream. Place another layer of cake on top. This will make two cakes. Wrap one; freeze it for use later. Beat egg whites until very stiff. Add sugar and flavoring. Spread on one cake. Bake for 3 minutes or until brown. Have oven preheated to 500\u00b0.

title: Nutty Canadian Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend cheeses with 2 tablespoons maple syrup. Shape into a ball. Brush on the remaining syrup and coat with pecans. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Low-Fat Chicken And Rice
instructions: Season chicken with garlic salt and paprika and broil. Stir 1/2 bouillon into cooked rice and place in casserole. Place chicken on top of rice and pour remaining bouillon over all. Bake for 1/2 hour in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening until well mixed. Add buttermilk and yeast. Work into flour with large spoon. Grease a large bowl. Put in dough. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Roll about 1/2-inch thick on a floured surface. Let rise about 1 1/2 hours. Brush with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal-Chocolate Morsel Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients; stir well. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yield 6 dozen.

title: Custard Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and blend 4 to 5 minutes. You could add raisins or nuts or coconut if you like. Pour into a greased pie plate and bake for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Sprinkle nutmeg on top of pie. Enjoy!

title: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in water; mix all ingredients well. Add 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour. Mix into a soft dough. Let rise until doubled in bulk. Work one half at a time. Roll out on a floured surface. Sprinkle with a mixture of the cinnamon and sugar. Roll up from the small end. Cut into half-inch pieces and put into a greased pan. Let rise until doubled in bulk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. May be frosted with a drizzle of powdered sugar and milk.

title: B-B-Q
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to boil. Add meat and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Banana Bread
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes in greased loaf pan.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer the lettuce celery peppers eggs onion and peas.

title: Octopus Sauce(Salsa Di Pulpo)
instructions: Wash octopus in salted water pounding against sink to remove any sand that may be in suction cups on tentacles. Rinse and wash again. Remove head and discard using only the tentacles. Rinse again and drain. In medium saucepan saute onion in oil until tender but not brown. Add octopus and saute until octopus curls and turns pinkish-red. To octopus add the rest of the ingredients. Cook on medium-low heat for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Serve with spaghetti or metazanne cooked according to package directions. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Icing For Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on cake.

title: Man Sized Steak Salad
instructions: Boil meat at 550\u00b0 for 13 minutes per side; cool. Cut into 3/8-inch strips. Arrange in baking dish (13 1/2 x 9 x 2-inch). Place mushrooms on meat. Top with pepper rings.

title: One Bowl Buttercream Frosting
