instructions: In a small mixer bowl cream the butter. Add cocoa and sugar alternately with milk. Beat to spreading consistency (additional milk may be needed). Blend in vanilla. Makes about 2 cups of frosting.

title: Fruited Macaroni Salad
instructions: In a saucepan combine the sugar flour and salt. Drain juice from oranges and pineapple into a 1-cup measuring cup; cover and refrigerate fruit. Add enough water to the juice if needed to measure 1 cup; stir into the sugar mixture until smooth. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until thickened and bubbly. Reduce heat; cook and stir 1 minute longer. Remove from heat. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into egg; return all to pan stirring constantly. Bring to a gentle boil; cook and stir 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. In a bowl combine the macaroni and cooked dressing. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Pork
instructions: Thinly slice pork into bite-size strips; set aside. Preheat wok or large skillet to high heat. Make sauce in a bowl by stirring together teriyaki sauce cornstarch and seasoning package from frozen vegetables. Set aside sauce. Add oil to skillet. Stir-fry pork over heat for about 3 minutes or until it is no longer pink then remove from skillet. Add frozen vegetables undrained pineapple and water to skillet. Add sauce. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until thick and bubbly. Cook 2 minutes; stir in meat and cook 30 seconds. Serve over chow mein noodles.

title: Artichoke And Basil Hero
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine basil oil Parmesan cheese capers vinegar mustard and garlic. Cover; blend until nearly smooth. Set aside. Cut bread in half lengthwise. Hollow out each half leaving a 1-inch shell. Spread basil mixture over each half of bread. On bottom half layer artichoke hearts Provolone cheese tomato and spinach. Cover with top bread. Cut sandwich crosswise into 6 to 8 pieces.

title: Broccoli-Onion Deluxe
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion until tender. Put in the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. In saucepan melt half of the butter. Blend in flour salt and a dash of pepper. Add milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Reduce heat; blend in cream cheese until smooth. Pour over broccoli and onion. Place cheese on top and then use other half of butter; melt and toss bread crumbs in and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat the cream cheese and sugar until fluffy. Add peanut butter and beat well. Gradually beat in milk. Fold in the cool whip. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with peanuts. Freeze until firm. Wrap in moisture proof wrap.

title: Baked Clams
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan; add clams crabmeat and bread crumbs. Refrigerate mix then prepare in shells (real or aluminum) and bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown. Add bacon if desired.

title: Graham Cracker Pie Crust
instructions: In a small mixing bowl combine crumbs sugar and butter. Mix together well and press mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Add filling.

title: Oatmeal Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Make in rolls or pat down in ice cube trays lined with waxed paper. Keep in refrigerator overnight. Slice thin and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Melt cocoa in water and bring to a boil. Pour over dry ingredients. Beat eggs add buttermilk and vanilla. Add to mixture and beat. Pour on large cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: California Blend Casserole
instructions: In large glass casserole (cake pan is too big) melt margarine. Add celery and onion. Saute on low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add rice. Stir well. Add bag of vegetables and mix together.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Serve as side dish.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Cut margarine into flour. Add buttermilk. Grease pan. Pour in batter. Butter tops of biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Place cod in pan and pour enough water and chicken broth to cover. Remove fish and bring liquid to boil. Add cod; reduce heat to low and simmer about 5 minutes or until cod is opaque and separates easily into large flakes. Remove fish from liquid and cool. Flake fish removing skin and bones.

title: Cream Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Cut crusts on bread. Put light coat of butter on outside. Combine softened cream cheese sugar and softened stick of butter. Spread this mixture on each sliced then roll up. Make a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle this on outside; freeze. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 7 minutes.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Simmer together tomatoes mushroom soup onion soup and water. Put rice in baking dish. Set chops on top of rice. Pour mixture over rice and chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes and then uncover and bake for additional 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix oats water and butter. Let stand for 10 minutes. Mix sugars eggs salt soda cinnamon and vanilla. Add to oats mixture. Add flour and mix well. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. (Mash ripe bananas first.) Grease a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a mixing bowl mix thoroughly the margarine shortening sugar and eggs. Blend in flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar-cinnamon mixture. Place 2-inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet (vegetable spray works well). Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until set. Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies.

title: Francis B'S Salad
instructions: Marinate overnight in Wish-Bone Italian dressing. Add raw cauliflower and cherry tomatoes. Shake (toss) and serve.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in the 2 cups boiling water; stir gradually into the beaten cream cheese until melted. Drain oranges reserving their liquid. Measure and add enough cold water to equal 1 1/2 cups liquid. Mix into Jell-O mixture. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat chilled topping mix (Dream Whip) according to directions on package. Fold into Jell-O mixture along with oranges nuts and cottage cheese. Turn into lightly oiled 9 x 13 x 2-inch salad dish or pan.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Cook brown sugar butter syrup and salt for 5 minutes at slow heat. Do not boil hard. Remove from heat. Add soda pour over popcorn and stir well. Cook in oven for 1 hour at 200\u00b0. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Banana Smoothie
instructions: *With plain yogurt add 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Debbie'S Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Roll out and pat into a 13 x 15-inch cookie sheet the crescent rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let cool. Mix mayonnaise cream cheese garlic salt and dill weed. Dice a few green onions and add to mayonnaise mixture. Spread over cooled crust. Chop fine green onions cauliflower broccoli mushrooms green peppers tomatoes and black olives. Sprinkle over crust. Refrigerate.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; mix well. Add milk; stir. Pour mixture into a lightly greased shallow 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter. Combine 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; add to peaches. Spoon mixture over batter; do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until browned.

title: Broiled Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spread on top of 9 x 13-inch white or yellow cake while it is still warm. Place very low under broiler; broil until icing bubbles all over surface and becomes brown. Take care that it does not burn.

title: Lemony Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Measure first 7 ingredients into a plastic bag; close tightly and shake to blend. Moisten chicken with lemon juice. Let stand for 30 minutes. Place chicken chunks a few at a time into plastic bag. Shake to coat thoroughly. Pour oil into heavy saucepan filling no more than 1/3 full. Heat to 375\u00b0. Carefully add chicken a few pieces at a time. Fry turning once about 2 minutes or until tender. Drain on paper towels.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Mix everything together and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Chipped Beef Spread(Microwave)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in shallow baking dish. Microwave 4 to 5 minutes. Turn 1/4 turn during cooking. Serve hot as spread for crackers.

title: Fillet Of Flounder Florentine
instructions: Dip fish in seasoned flour then in beaten egg to which cheese parsley salt and pepper have been added. Saute in oil or butter until brown. While fish is sauteing mix garlic wine lemon juice and butter together and bring to boil to evaporate wine approximately 1/2 minute. Add cooked spinach to serving dish. (Have spinach warm.) Lay fish over spinach. Pour hot mix (garlic wine lemon juice butter) over fish and spinach. Garnish with lemon slices. Please no substitutes.

title: Greek Tomato Salad
instructions: Cut tomatoes to bite size. Cut olives in half. Rub bowl with garlic; add tomatoes olives and cheese. Sprinkle with vinegar and olive oil. Add seasonings and toss. Marinate for at least 4 hours on counter. If longer store in refrigerate until 1 to 2 hours before serving. Taste improves the longer it stands at room temperature.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Fry hamburger drain. Rinse with boiling water to remove all grease. Add to lettuce tomatoes onion and Cheddar cheese which have been mixed together well. Add kidney beans drained and rinsed.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook the egg noodles until tender; mix in the tuna. While stirring add chopped onion and mayonnaise and add salt then add the sweet peas and mix thoroughly. Let stand for 5 minutes and restir. Its ready to eat. This can be served hot or cold!

title: Chowder(Winning Recipe)
instructions: Saute bacon until crisp; drain (saving fat). Crumble bacon and set aside. Slowly saute onions green pepper celery carrots and garlic in bacon fat until tender. Boil potatoes in salted water until cooked. Combine vegetables; add seasonings and beat in a mixer until creamy. Do not beat longer or it will become too smooth and thick.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Add pumpkin; mix well. Blend in flour salt baking powder and spices; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Raisins and/or nuts can be added. Freezes well. One can pumpkin will make 2 batches.

title: How To Make Pickles
instructions: Heat beans do not boil. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour off juice. While hot add ingredients. Marinate 24 hours. Serve cold.

title: Maxine'S Chicken
instructions: Place chicken flat in baking dish salt and\tpepper chop onion over top. Mix soups and sherry; pour over chicken. Grate cheese and spread over top. Bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0.\tCook rice according to directions. Brown small onion in part of bacon grease. Blend bouillon soup and Worcestershire sauce; add in rice. Add onion and bacon. Cook the last 30 minutes that the chicken cooks.

title: Bourbon Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat together eggs sugar and butter. Beat corn syrup and bourbon well in a separate bowl. Add bourbon mixture to egg mixture; beat well. Stir in pecans. Pour mixture into a 9-inch pie shell and bake 40 to 50 minutes until set.

title: Candied Dills
instructions: Let 25 pickles (4 inch size) stand 2 weeks in salt brine (9 pt. water 1 pt. salt). Drain & wash. Cut in chuncks or chips & put in water with Alum - size of walnut (1 heaping Tbsp.). Next morning wash & drain & pour dressing over pickles.

title: Tortellini Soup
instructions: Slice sausage and brown in oil. Add onion carrots and spices. Cook 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except for tortellini. Simmer covered for 1 hour. Add tortellini and cook until done.

title: Reuben Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and place in 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese bubbles. Serve with rye rounds or cocktail rye bread.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
instructions: To make marinade combine all ingredients except shrimp. Marinate the shrimp for 1/2 to 3 hours. Broil or barbecue for 3 minutes each side. Garnish with parsley and lemon.

title: Nana'S Turkey Stuffing(Mrs. Catherine Wissman)
instructions: Chop cleaned celery into small diced pieces; also dice the onion. Cut bacon into pieces small enough to crumble when cooked. Combine celery onion and bacon in large frying pan. Cook over medium heat until bacon is all crisp. Drain any fat off and pat with paper towel.

title: Bread Stuffing
instructions: Night before Dice wheat and white bread. Cook celery and onion in margarine until translucent. Add to cubed bread. Mix broth seasoning egg salt pepper together. Add to cubed bread. Add water as needed so mixture is moist. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Blend soup flour sour cream carrots onions salt and pepper. Then stir in broccoli (2-quart casserole). Moisten stuffing mix with butter/margarine then sprinkle on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Put everything in a big pot and cook slowly for about 3 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Delights
instructions: Mix and roll in wax paper and place in refrigerator overnight. Slice thin and place on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Oriental Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayo yogurt and lemon juice. Stir with remaining ingredients. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix peaches and 1/2 cup of sugar and set aside. Set oven to 350\u00b0. Put margarine in deep baking dish and set in oven to melt. Make batter of other ingredients and pour over melted margarine; do not stir. Put sugared peaches on top of batter; do not stir. Bake until crust is light brown. Peaches will sink to bottom. Can serve ice cream on top.

title: Mull Cider
instructions: Bring to boil; simmer 20 minutes. Remove spices and serve hot.

title: Bishop Bread
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Blend in dry ingredients then fold in nuts dates chips and cherries. Put in greased loaf pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Be sure to bake long enough.

title: Easy Oven Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 5-quart Dutch oven. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours stirring once each hour. Makes 8 servings.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter eggs cinnamon cloves and nutmeg. Stir together the flour baking soda and salt. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Add soup; mix well. Blend in raisins and nuts. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Soup
instructions: Boil chicken stock onions and celery together for 45 to 60 minutes. Strain out onion and celery and discard. Stir in peanut butter until dissolved. Mix flour with half and half add together with remaining ingredients simmer all together 15 minutes. Add dash of egg shade for coloring. Garnish with 1/2 teaspoon bacon crumbs or minced country ham. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Swedish Pecan Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except powdered sugar and mix well. Shape dough into balls the size of walnuts. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 275\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until light brown. Roll in powdered sugar after theyre cooled.

title: Almond Crescent Cookies(A Christmastime Favorite)
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar; beat well. Add almonds and extract. Mix in flour and salt. Chill dough for 2 hours. Roll into pencil-thin strips 2 1/2 inches long. Place 1 inch apart on baking sheets. Curl into crescents. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool on pan. Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Baked Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix the pineapple with the cheese. Put in buttered baking dish. Mix together the bread crumbs sugar flour and melted butter. Spread on the pineapple mixture. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Mess
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet while potatoes are cooking. Pour hamburger and onion into saucepan. Add mushroom soup. Fill can with milk and add to mixture. Add potatoes and peas. Let simmer 20 minutes.

title: Quick Cornbread Mix
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Cut in shortening with pastry blender or two knives to mix thoroughly. Place mix in a jar or canister and store in a dry place until ready to use. This mix will keep in a cool place for about a month.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar in mixing bowl. Beat in eggs syrup and vanilla. Stir in pecans. Pour filling into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool to room temperature before cutting. Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Orange Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add butter and egg yolks mixing well. Add milk juice and rind. Bake in crust until set at 350\u00b0. Use the egg white for meringue. Makes 2 small pies or 1 large.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Beat together sugar milk flour and margarine. Pour into pudding pan. Spoon fruit over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: White Cookies - Pink Icing
instructions: Cream together sugar and Crisco. Add salt and vanilla. Mix and add to buttermilk soda baking powder and flour (add gradually). Cool dough in refrigerator before rolling and cutting with cookie cutter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 8 minutes.

title: Cherry Crunch(Serves 8)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8-inch square baking pan. Mix oats flour and sugar. Cut in butter with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Spoon half of mixture into prepared pan. Top with pie filling. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Spoon into dessert dishes. Serve warm with sweetened whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Three Bean Casserole
instructions: Cut up bacon into 1/2-inch square pieces; dice onion. Combine with ground beef and brown and then drain. Combine all ingredients except cheese in a medium size roaster. Do not drain the beans. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven. (Fifteen minutes before removing from the oven sprinkle grated cheese over the top.) Good served warm or cold.

title: Spinach Salad And Dressing
instructions: Beat the first 7 ingredients with mixer or in blender. This dressing tastes better if refrigerated for several hours or overnight.

title: Cocoa-Lace Cookies
instructions: Spray baking sheets with no-stick cooking spray; set aside. In medium saucepan melt margarine stir in brown sugar and corn syrup. Bring to a boil stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat; stir in remaining ingredients until blended. Drop mixture by teaspoons 3 inches apart on prepared baking sheets. Bake 9 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cookies spread thin and are deep brown (cookies will still be soft). Cool 2 minutes on sheets. Working quickly with spatula remove cookies to wire rack; cool completely. Sprinkle if desired with confectioners sugar. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Mom'S Stuffed Olives
instructions: Large green olives with pits are used for this recipe. With a small paring knife remove the olive from the pit (pare as you would an apple in corkscrew fashion so you have one continuous piece). Wrap olive around small ball of meat stuffing. Roll olive in flour beaten egg and then bread crumbs (Italian seasoned or plain dry bread crumbs may be used). Fry slowly turning to brown all sides evenly. Its work but they are always a hit!

title: Hot Curried Fruit
instructions: Drain all the fruit. In 3-quart baking dish place peaches and pears with hollow side up. Place apricots on top. Sprinkle this with pineapple and cherries. Combine butter sugar and curry powder. Sprinkle over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Baste 3 or 4 times. Cool and refrigerate at least one day. Heat before serving.

title: Ginger Syllabub
instructions: Mix Advocaat and preserves well together. Fold into the cream. Gently transfer into a serving dish. Put in refrigerator for a few hours. When set decorate with a few ginger pieces. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix it all together. Makes 5 quarts of dry mix. Use 4 teaspoons (heaping) per cup hot water.

title: Frost Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks and the sifted dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Mix well and spread the beaten butter into a baking sheet as thin as possible.

title: Chicken-In-A-Crock
instructions: Dissolve bouillon in hot water. Season chicken with pepper and onion salt. Place in crock-pot. Mix soup and bouillon together. Pour over chicken. Cook on low heat covered for approximately 5 hours.

title: Gail'S Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Make a crust with rolls by unfolding and laying them in the bottom of a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes. Watch carefully! Cool. Mix cream cheese dressing and mayonnaise; spread on crust. Put vegetables over this layer. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Spiced Raisin Scones
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray cookie sheet. In microwave-safe bowl combine raisins and orange juice. Cover and microwave on High power for 2 minutes. Set aside.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Must start in cold oven. Cream the margarine shortening and sugar. Add 1 egg at a time beating well. Add flour and milk alternately. Add flavoring. Add baking powder last. Bake in a large greased tube pan. Place in a cold oven. Turn oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool in pan. Excellent.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Grind raisins and orange peel together and add to flour. Mix cake by the conventional method for butter cake. Bake in moderate oven. Cover with orange juice and sugar after baking. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Ham Sandwich Spread
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate. Yields 2 cups.

title: Danish Fudge
instructions: Melt butter in a 3-quart saucepan. Add brown sugar and Pet milk. Stir to blend. Bring to a boil. Boil exactly 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool 2 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger pepper and onion; drain. Mix remaining ingredients and add to hamburger mixture. Grate cheese on top. Serves well with corn bread.

title: Marinated Shrimp
instructions: Marinate shrimp in Italian dressing several hours. Saute shrimp in the dressing with garlic and onion powders and dash of oregano (only long enough to cook the shrimp). Cook pasta according to package directions. Serve shrimp over noodles. Serves 4.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in an airtight container. To use pour 3 heaping teaspoonfuls in cup; add hot water. Let stand a few minutes for spices to settle after stirring.

title: Creamy Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large kettle saute onion in butter until transparent not browned. Add the sweet potatoes zucchini and broccoli. Saute lightly for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in broth. Simmer for a few minutes. Add potatoes and seasonings. Cook another 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in cream (milk) and heat. Makes about 4 quarts.

title: Rosie'S Taco
instructions: Cook taco mix according to package directions. Place taco shell into a preheated skillet of oil enough to cover the shell. Cook for 60 seconds. Prepare tacos by using the following place meat into the taco shell a dab of hot or mild sauce and sprinkle a little shredded cheese. Top with shredded lettuce shredded tomatoes and shredded cheese.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken in bite size pieces. Mix celery almonds mayonnaise onions lemon juice and soup. Put in a two-quart casserole. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Diet Punch
instructions: In pitcher dissolve Crystal Light in 1 cup water. Add pineapple juice. Pour mixture into punch bowl with a little ice. When ready to serve add Diet 7-Up.

title: Italian Ziti Medley
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan brown sausage. Remove from pan and drain. Melt butter and cook mushrooms onion and pepper strips until tender but not brown. Blend flour into vegetable mixture. Gradually stir in milk. Cook stirring constantly over medium-low heat until boil. Boil 1 minute. Blend in 1 1/2-cup Cheddar Parmesan and pepper until cheeses are melted and mixture is smooth. Combine ziti sausage and vegetable/cheese mixture. Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup Cheddar on top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or bubbly.

title: Sausage Biscuits
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Knead for 10 minutes. Shape into 36 small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cheese-Potato Bake
instructions: Place sliced potatoes in shallow greased baking dish. Combine milk Tabasco and salt. Pour over potatoes. Dot with 1 tablespoon butter. Bake uncovered 40 minutes at 400\u00b0 until tender. Top with cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple. Save juice. Mix all fruits and pecans except bananas and strawberries.

title: Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients stirring until dissolved.\tCook 15 minutes at 450\u00b0 then 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: In large saucepan slowly cook onions peeled and thin in butter until soft and golden. Sprinkle onions with flour. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in condensed beef broth water and Worcestershire sauce. Add salt and pepper. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Toast slices of French bread 1-inch thick. When soup is done stir in Parmesan cheese. Ladle soup into individual ovenproof bowls. Float bread on top of soup. Place cheese on bread. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut-Caramel Pie
instructions: Bake pie shells to a golden brown and set aside to cool while mixing ingredients. Melt butter in large skillet. Add coconut and pecans; cook until golden brown stirring frequently. Set aside.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Melt butter. Add peanut butter crackers pecans sugar and salt. Form into small balls. Melt together the paraffin and semi-sweet chocolate in double boiler. Dip cookies in chocolate-paraffin mixture and lay on waxed paper to dry.

title: Double Chocolate Mocha Trifle
instructions: Prepare and bake brownie mix according to directions for a cake-like brownie. Cool completely and cut into cubes. In a mixing bowl whisk pudding mix into the milk until mixture begins to thicken. Dissolve coffee granules into warm water add to pudding mixture; mixing well. Fold in 2 cups whipped topping. Chop toffee bars. Layer 1/3 of brownie cubes in bottom of glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 of the pudding mixture pressing lightly and 1/3 of chopped toffee. Repeat layers 2 more times. Decorate with remaining whipped topping and remaining toffee bar. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Rinse well with cold water. Chill thoroughly. Mix remaining ingredients add dressing to chilled macaroni and toss until coated.

title: Sweet Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease muffin tins. Beat egg slightly; stir in milk and oil. Sift together the flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add flour mixture to liquids stirring just until moistened. Carefully blend in blueberries and spoon into muffin tins until 2/3 full. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until toasty brown.

title: Heavenly Salad
instructions: Split grapes in half lengthwise to remove seeds. Add chopped pineapple and marshmallows.

title: Egg And Cheese Rarebit
instructions: In top of double boiler over hot water melt cheese and butter until smooth. Add chicken broth onion parsley nutmeg salt and paprika. Beat eggs well then stir in and cook and stir over boiling water until smooth and thickened. Serve on toasted English muffins or toast. Yield 4 servings.

title: Apple-Cabbage Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water according to package directions. Chill until slightly thickened. Combine cabbage vinegar and salt; let stand 20 minutes. Fold cabbage apples and nuts into gelatin and turn into oiled mold. Chill until set. Unmold on crisp lettuce.

title: Cornish Game Hens
instructions: For 2 hours refrigerate game hens in a marinade of soy sauce ginger and pineapple juice covered. Preheat broiler. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0; remove hens from marinade. Put marinade aside. Place hens in skillet; boil 5 minutes on each side. Bake hens uncovered 30 minutes until done.

title: Easy Pudding Frosting
instructions: Cream margarine Crisco sugar and pudding. Add milk and vanilla. Beat on high about 5 minutes. So good youll want to eat it with a spoon!

title: Beefy Rice
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch dish. Add rice. Mix soups and pour over rice. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Tamale Bites
instructions: Combine corn bread crumbs 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce and the salt. Add ground beef; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place in shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Deluxe Macaroni
instructions: Make sauce; melt oleo and add flour. Blend. Add hot milk; stir until thickened. Add remaining ingredients. Add cheese to sauce; let melt.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown steak; add onion peppers tomatoes mushrooms and seasonings. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Dumb Bread
instructions: Mix together and bake in a greased loaf pan in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Anadama Bread
instructions: Stir cornmeal slowly into boiling water. Boil 5 minutes. Add oil molasses and salt; cool. When lukewarm add yeast which has been dissolved in the warm water. Add flour to make stiff dough. Knead well. Let rise until doubled. Shape into 2 loaves. Place in greased pans. Let rise. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0. Bake 30 minutes more.

title: Overnight Spinach Dip
instructions: Blend soup mix sour cream cream cheese and mayonnaise in bowl. Stir in spinach. Chill overnight. Hollow out bread; reserve bread pieces. Spoon mixture into bread shell. Serve with reserved bread.

title: Saucy Steak Skillet
instructions: Coat steak pieces with flour. Pound into beef. Brown beef in oil in 10-inch skillet. Push beef to side. Cook and stir onion in oil until tender. Drain. Add enough water to potato liquid to make 1 cup. Mix liquid catsup Worcestershire sauce pepper flakes instant bouillon salt marjoram and pepper. Pour on beef and onion. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer until beef is tender about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Rinse frozen beans under running cold water to separate. Add potatoes beans and pimiento to skillet. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and simmer until beans are tender 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar in mixing bowl. Beat at speed 6 for 1 minute. Stop and scrape bowl. Beat 1 minute more at speed 6 then turn to speed 4 and add eggs. Beat 30 seconds. Stop and scrape bowl then turn to speed 6 for 1 1/2 minutes. Stop.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Saute margarine onion and green pepper. Put in greased casserole dish. Add 2 cans of corn corn muffin mix and eggs. Mix all together in casserole. On top spread sour cream and on top of that Cheddar cheese. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Deep-Dish Peach Pie
instructions: Place peaches in unbaked pie shell. Mix in separate bowl the sugar salt flour nutmeg and cinnamon. When thoroughly mixed add evaporated milk and mix. Pour mixture over peaches. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Kathy'S Sauce
instructions: Melt the margarine in a saucepan. Mix together with the margarine the soy sauce Worcestershire and lemon juice. Mix cornstarch and cold water then add to other ingredients. Stir frequently until the mixture thickens. More cornstarch may be added if needed for thickening. Great on fajitas!

title: Hot Breakfast Tea
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and put in a cheesecloth bag. Bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add the tea bags. Remove from the heat and cover. Let steep for 5 minutes. Remove the tea bags and squeeze gently. Add the spice mixture sugar and juices. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat and let simmer 5 minutes. Remove the spice bag and serve hot. Garnish with orange slices. Yields 7 1/2 cups.

title: Caramel Topping
instructions: Combine butter and cream in small mixing bowl. Microwave at Medium 1 1/4 to 3 minutes or until butter is melted. Stir in brown sugar nuts and/or coconut. Spread carefully on warm cake. Microwave on High 2 to 3 minutes or until topping bubbles in a few spots. Use as frosting on Oatmeal Cake.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Drain browned hamburger and hot sausage add celery onion and bell peppers. Mix. Simmer awhile. Drain meat mixture and add contents of soup mix packets and raw rice. Place in a large casserole and pour in hot water. Stir and bake covered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with almonds and bake 15 minutes more uncovered.

title: Old Atlanta Oatmeal Drop
instructions: Combine and cook sugar margarine cocoa and milk for 1 1/2 minutes. Start timing when mixture has reached a full rolling boil. Remove from heat add oats vanilla peanut butter and chopped nuts. Beat until blended. When it begins to set spoon quickly on wax paper. Yields about 50 cookies.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Drain and flake salmon reserving liquid. Combine salmon with bread crumbs and green onions. Stir in beaten eggs lemon juice and reserved salmon liquid. Form into 6 patties. Fry patties in oil over medium heat until lightly browned on both sides. Serve hot with Dilled Cream Pea Sauce. Yield 6 patties.

title: Cheesy Ham Casserole
instructions: Preparation Time 15 minutes. Cooking Time 30 minutes. Microwave Cooking Time 10 minutes.

title: Pasta With Chicken, Steak And Shrimp
instructions: Marinate chicken steak and shrimp in 1 cup Italian dressing overnight. Grill steak and chicken; add shrimp last and cook until pink. (Dont overcook shrimp.) Cut chicken and steak into small pieces; leave shrimp whole. Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and rinse. Prepare seasoning mix according to package directions. Combine pasta chicken steak shrimp mushrooms onions and pasta seasoning; toss to mix. Place in baking dish and cover with swiss cheese slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Big Dave'S Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in large enough bowl. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water/flour mixture and wait until fully involved.

title: Buttermint Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg and extract. Gradually add flour; stir in peppermint. Dough will be soft. Divide dough into three parts. Shape into plastic wrap into 1 1/4-inch diameter logs. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Slice into 1/4-inch rounds. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Chili
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large pot and cook 1 to 2 hours until green pepper is tender.

title: Pecan Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese on medium speed until smooth. Add 1/2 cup sugar 1 of the eggs1 teaspoon of the vanilla and the salt. Beat just until combined. Spread the cream cheese mixture onto bottom of the pastry. Spread pecans over the cream cheese mixture.

title: Maple-Glazed Ham
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place ham slices on broiler pan. Combine syrup and mustard in small bowl. Brush each slice with about 1 1/2 tsp. of syrup mixture. Broil 4 inches below heat about 4 minutes or until ham starts to brown. Turn and brush with remaining syrup mixture. Broil until browned. Makes 4 servings.

title: Apple-Blueberry Squares
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar thoroughly; add eggs. Beat until smooth. Add flour baking powder and salt; mix well. Add vanilla; blend well. Spread 1/2 dough in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been greased. Place apples and blueberries with a little juice over dough. Drop remaining dough over fruit. Sprinkle top with cinnamon sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Gran'S Easter-Egg Cake
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over water and let soften. Blend yolks and 3/4 cup sugar in top of double boiler. Add lemon juice and rind and cook over simmering water stirring constantly (do not let water touch bottom of pan). When thick as medium white sauce remove from heat. Add softened gelatin and stir until dissolved. Chill until mixture thickens and mounds.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
instructions: Add pudding mix to cake mix. Add water and eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add oil and beat with electric beater at high for 10 minutes. Use angel cake pan. The secret is beating the mixture at high for 10 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Snack Cake
instructions: Mix flour cocoa soda and salt in a 9-inch square microwave-safe pan. Mix remaining ingredients in 4-cup measure. Stir into flour mixture until well blended. Microwave on High for 6 to 7 minutes rotating dish 1/4 turn twice until pick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes on flat surface. Moist spots will dry. Then place on wire rack. Serve warm.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Yield 2 cups. Carbohydrate 0 g protein 0 g fat 7 g calories per serving 63. One tablespoon = 1 fat exchange.

title: Quick And Easy Jambalaya
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased heavy pot or casserole dish that covers tightly. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Do not open until finished.

title: Chilaquilas(American Name: Enchilada Casserole)
instructions: Very large bowl. Plug in crockpot; oil the bottom with the canola oil.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Mix apples eggs sugar and cinnamon. Sift flour baking soda and salt. Add to apple mixture. Add nuts. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Aunt Abbie'S Ginger Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar; add egg molasses and spices. Alternate milk and soda with flour to make stiff enough to roll. Roll out; cut. Sprinkle with white sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Parma Breaded Steak
instructions: Trim steaks. Dip steaks in eggs and then in a mixture of the cheese and crumbs. Let stand while preparing the sauce.

title: Cheese And Bacon Potato Bake
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium-high heat heat broth to a boil; reduce heat. Add potatoes and onion; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Drain reserving 1 1/2 cups broth. In skillet over medium-high heat cook bacon until crisp. Remove and crumble bacon; pour off all but 3 tablespoons drippings. Blend flour into reserved drippings. Gradually add reserved broth; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in cheese until melted.

title: French Icing
instructions: Cook milk and flour until thick. Beat until lumps are gone. Cool and add sugar Crisco vanilla and salt. Beat until it looks like whipped cream.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll crescent dough. Do not separate. Press seams together to fill the bottom of a 15 x 10-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool.

title: Easy Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Add pudding to sour cream. Stir until smooth. If too thick add a little bit of milk. Serve with sliced fresh fruit.

title: Oatmeal-Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In large bowl mix all ingredients together one at a time. Shape into cookies and bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown. Dont overcook.

title: Huckleberry Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Candy Apples
instructions: *Insert a wooden ice cream bar or lollipop stick part way through stem end of each apple.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or microwave on High for 4 minutes. Add beans (I like B & W baked beans) and partially fry bacon and add. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or microwave on High for 12 minutes.

title: Pork Chops In The Corn
instructions: Note To serve 4 double the recipe except use 3/4 teaspoon of salt.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half and filet. Then cut the filets in several pieces. Heat butter and oil mixture in skillet. Dredge chicken in flour and dip in egg. Brown lightly in skillet about 3 minutes a side. Remove to warm baking dish. Continue until all chicken is browned. Add wine capers and parsley to skillet and deglaze. Pour over chicken. Squeeze juice of 1 lemon over chicken. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Garay'S Santa Maria Beans
instructions: Pick over and wash beans draining well. Place in 6 to 8-quart kettle. Cover with water. Bury ham hock in beans. Add sliced onion minced garlic cilantro and 2 teaspoons salt. Cut top off tea bag and add tea leaves to mixture. Add Chipotle chile(s) one for medium heat and two for hotter. Bring beans to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Add boiling water as needed to keep beans just slightly covered with water. Simmer for at least two hours.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Melt butter and mix with graham cracker crumbs. Mix sugar milk cheese and Dream Whip. Whip until stiff. Put half of this mixture over half of the graham crumbs. Put the cherries over the cream mixture and add another layer of the cream mixture and then add the remaining crumbs. Cover and put in refrigerator to chill.

title: Russian Pancakes Or Blini
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup milk or enough to make a sponge. Let rise in a warm place about 3 hours. Cream egg yolks butter and salt. Add yeast sponge remaining flour and remaining milk. Beat until smooth. Cover. Let stand for 30 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter. Butter a skillet lightly. Proceed like for pancakes about 3 inches in diameter.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Add 1 tablespoon sugar and yeast to 1/4 cup warm water; dissolve. To 1 cup water add 2 cups flour dry milk salt 2 tablespoons sugar and melted butter. Add this mixture to yeast mixture and beat thoroughly. Add 1 cup flour to mixture; stir.

title: Potato Strips
instructions: Scrub potatoes. Slice lengthwise in 3 to 4 slices. Spread with butter and soup mix. Reassemble and wrap in foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Pour melted butter in unbaked pie shells. Spread coconut over butter. Mix other ingredients and pour over coconut. Bake at 375\u00b0 until middle is set about 35 minutes.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Drain. Add 2 tablespoons sour cream (heaping) 2 tablespoons mayonnaise (heaping) and a sprinkle of parsley. Mix well.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Put the chicken in a pot. Cover with the water; add the sliced carrots. Bring to a boil; cook until wing falls off. Remove chicken from pan; let cool before removing meat from bone.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in a well buttered casserole. Sprinkle 1/2 cup grated sharp Cheddar cheese on top then sprinkle with Italian herbed bread crumbs. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Brenda'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream (room temperature) cream cheese. Add chopped beef green onions (chopped) and desired amount of olives chopped. Shape into ball and roll into nuts. Place on serving dish with crackers.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Chop the tomato and slice the scallions. Mince the garlic and jalapeno pepper. (You may use only 1/2 or 1/4 of the jalapeno or leave it out if you dont want it to be hot.) Halve and peel the avocados and cut the flesh into 1/2-inch cubes. Squeeze 1 teaspoon lime juice over the avocado and toss. Taste for seasoning and stir in additional juice salt or jalapeno if desired.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and cook on medium heat. When it comes to a boil boil for about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and quickly add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Stir thoroughly and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let harden.

title: Wendy'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine peanut butter Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Combine flour salt and baking soda and add to creamed mixture on low speed. Mix until blended. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Flatten slightly in crisscross pattern. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes until light brown. Cool 2 minutes on sheets before putting on rack. (Dont sugar coat.)

title: Hoogie Poogie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. While meat is cooking combine rest of ingredients in slow cooker. When meat is done add to slow cooker and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Pare apples and place center up in baking dish sprayed with Pam. Mix brown sugar white sugar and cinnamon; cover the apples. Dissolve cornstarch in cold water. Place over apples. Put dabs of oleo on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until apples are soft but not mushy.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine 1 3/4 cups cheese with remaining ingredients. Mix and shape into a loaf in 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 70 minutes. Brush with extra sauce and top with remaining cheese. Let stand for a few minutes until cheese has melted.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: On stove melt margarine and water. Bring to boil. Quickly add flour and stir with wooden spoon over low heat until it forms a ball. Take off heat and add 4 eggs. Mix with electric beater. Drop teaspoonful on ungreased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes (place 2-inches apart). Let cool. Make pudding. Slice puffs and fill.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops. While these are browning peel and slice potatoes and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over raw potatoes. I usually melt this in the microwave before pouring over potatoes. Place browned pork chops on top of potatoes. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Uncover and bake for about 10 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed on box. Melt butter in pan. Sprinkle pecans and coconut in pan. Pour cake mix on top.

title: White Chocolate Cream Puff
instructions: Melt butter in water. When it starts to boil stir in flour. Stir until dough forms a ball. Let this mixture cool at least 2 minutes. Beat in eggs one at a time until well mixed or use the equivalent of 4 egg beaters.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: In blender mix onion and vinegar. Add sugar poppy seed and salt. Add oil slowly or it will separate. Store in glass jar in refrigerator. Keeps up to 6 months.

title: Mexican Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chilies and cheese in order given (wet ingredients first then dry ingredients).

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Butter a 2-quart baking dish. Put peaches on bottom and sprinkle with lemon juice and extract. In a large mixing bowl mix flour sugar salt and egg until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches; drizzle with margarine. Bake 35 to 45 minutes until topping begins to brown. Great with ice cream or milk.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: In a medium pan heat rice water and salt to boiling over medium heat. Reduce heat to low; cover. Simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until rice is tender and all liquid is absorbed. Add milk half and half and sugar. Mix; heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Place first 5 ingredients in a very large bowl. Mix oil and dressing mix. Pour over dry ingredients. Mix well. Stir occasionally to blend all ingredients. Let stand overnight. Serve next day.

title: Delicious Custard
instructions: Melt butter. Blend in cornstarch sugar and salt. Gradually add milk. Heat to boiling over direct heat. Stir into slightly beaten egg yolks. Return to heat and cook 2 minutes stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Cool thoroughly. Makes 2 cups. Serve plain or with cream. (Excellent for banana cream pie.)

title: Traditional Wassail
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan or Dutch oven. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Remove cloves and cinnamon sticks. Serve wassail hot from Dutch oven or in a heatproof punch bowl. Yield 32 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Raisin-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Stir in the oats. Combine egg whites brown sugar oil milk vanilla and raisins and add to flour mixture. Mix well.

title: Frozen Slaw
instructions: Bring sugar vinegar and salt to boil. Boil one minute. Pour over cabbage mixture. Stir. Cool. Freeze in small containers.

title: Cookies And Cream Pie
instructions: Pour half and half into large bowl. Add pie filling mix. Beat with wire whisk until blended (approximately 1 minute). Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip and cookies. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm (6 hours or overnight). Remove from freezer and let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving. Garnish top with additional cookie bits. Store leftovers in freezer.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
instructions: Combine vegetables soup 1/2 cup cheese sour cream salt pepper and 1/2 can onions. Put in 1-quart casserole. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Trim meat of all external fat. Use a deep heavy pot with lid. Brown meat on all sides. Add onion and garlic; cook until the onion is soft about 3 to 4 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in coriander cumin tomato paste 3/4 cup water chilies and black pepper. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Yield 8 servings. Carbohydrate 10 g protein 24 g fat 15 g calories 273.

title: Butterscotch Candy
instructions: Boil the sugar corn syrup and water to the firm ball stage. Add butter salt and vanilla. Cook to soft crack stage. Pour into oiled pan. When partly cooled mark into squares.

title: Toasted Pecans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the pecans in a saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat and boil for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Stir in pecans quickly. Spread on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Let cool and break apart. Store in an airtight container.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
instructions: Mix the salt and sweet potatoes well. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and remaining ingredients. Pour into greased tube pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or longer if needed. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Pour juices into punch bowl. Add desired amount of sherbet. Use 1 quart of ginger ale for each gallon of punch.

title: Dressing For Slaw
instructions: Cut up onion; blend all ingredients in blender for just a minute. Makes 2 pints of dressing. Pour over grated cabbage; chill.

title: Dill Weed Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Use for fresh vegetables. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw and drain broccoli; set aside. Melt oleo. Beat 3 eggs. Mix melted oleo eggs water minced onion flour and Cheez Whiz. Add in broccoli and top with bread crumbs. Pour in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes; serve.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wipe mushrooms with a damp cloth and remove the stems. Chop the stems very finely. Beat cheese with milk and Worcestershire sauce until light and fluffy. Add chopped mushroom stems water chestnuts bell pepper onion and bacon. Blend well but gently. Fill the mushroom caps with the mixture and place on a baking sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook and debone the chicken breasts. Add the macaroni which has been rinsed in cold water and drained. Add remaining ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Pineapple Dream Cake
instructions: Bake the cake as directed on box in square pan. When done prick cake with a fork while cake is still hot pour crushed pineapple over the cake spreading over entire cake. While cake is cooling mix pudding with only 1 cup of milk; set aside. Mix whipped topping and combine with pudding. Spread over cake.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix eggs milk and margarine then add dry ingredients. Mix only a little then fold in blueberries as much or little as you want. Put in muffin tin about 2/3 full. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Buster Bar Torte
instructions: Mix crumbs and\tCool Whip and spread in a 9 x 13-inch freezeable pan. Cover with softened vanilla ice cream (1/2 to 3/4 gallon). Put in freezer for several hours until solid.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix cream of mushroom soup with sweet milk. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole arrange the thinly sliced potatoes and chopped onion in layers adding soup mixture. Dot with butter. Cover and cook one hour at 375\u00b0. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Classic French Silk Pie
instructions: Beat sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Stir in vanilla cream of tartar and chocolate. Beat in eggs until light and fluffy about 3 minutes. Pour into pie shell. Refrigerate to set 3 to 4 hours or cover with plastic wrap and freeze at least 8 hours. If pie is frozen remove from freezer 15 minutes prior to serving. Beat whipping cream and powdered sugar in a chilled 1 1/2-quart bowl until stiff. Top pie with cream and garnish with chopped nuts or chocolate curls.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Cut acorn squash in half lengthwise. Remove seeds. Bake cut side up; season with all other ingredients. Continue baking 20 minutes longer.

title: Eggs In A Basket
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Trim crusts off bread; spread both sides of bread with butter. Fit bread slices into cups of muffin tin. Place in oven until lightly toasted; remove from oven. Break an egg into bread and top with cheese. Return to oven and heat 12 to 15 minutes. Slip baskets carefully from the tins. Cool a bit.

title: Curry Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in pot and generously season with curry powder. Let sit several hours or overnight. When ready to cook add some water to the pot (enough to cover the chicken). Toss in some chopped onion and celery to suit your taste and add seasoned salt and pepper. Boil until chicken falls off the bones. When chicken is done scoop out all meat bones and pieces and pick out the good meat from the bones and \oocky\ parts. While you are picking through the chicken boil some chopped potatoes in the pot and when the potatoes are tender add the chicken meat back into the pot. Stir all this together for a few minutes then serve over rice.

title: Ginger Snaps
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening add egg and then the remaining ingredients. When mixed roll into small balls the size of a marble (about 1 teaspoonful) in palm of hand. Dip in mixture of sugar and cinnamon (additional to that in recipe). Bake at 350 about 15 minutes leaving space on cooking sheet for them to spread. Do not mash the round balls down on cookie sheet.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in oven for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and butter until fluffy; add eggs and bananas. Mix in flour and milk; add nuts and vanilla. Add oil last. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 2 regular or 3 small loaves.

title: Frozen Mocha Torte
instructions: Combine 1 cup wafer crumbs sugar and butter. Press onto the bottom and 1-inch up the sides of a greased 9-inch spring-form pan. Set aside.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients lightly. Put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve 1 cup of mix for topping.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar oil vanilla salt and soda then add flour chopped apples and nuts. Mixture will be stiff. Spoon into Bundt cake pan sprayed with Pam. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Christmas Treat Cracker
instructions: Mix Hidden Valley mix and oil in spices and mix well. Put on cookie sheet in slow oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix altogether and refrigerate.

title: Special Mac And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in 4 to 5 cups water until tender. Drain if needed. Add butter 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Add 2 cups of the milk and the Velveeta (sliced). Stir on low heat until cheese is melted. Pour into greased casserole.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Crush graham crackers. Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and melted butter. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook mushrooms and onion in butter for 3 minutes. Remove and add floured 1 1/2-inch strips or chunks of beef. Add more butter or shortening if necessary. Brown quickly. Add 2 cups stock or bouillon cubes and water. Add mushrooms onion and gravy flavoring. Cover tightly and cook 1 hour or until meat is tender. Ten minutes before serving stir in sour cream. Serve with noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Combine peaches and sugar. Melt margarine in an 8 x 8-inch dish. Mix other ingredients by hand. Pour over margarine (dont mix). Spoon peaches over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Praline Cookies
instructions: Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Line bottom of\tpan with whole graham crackers. Place brown sugar and butter in\tsaucepan. Bring to a rolling boil and cook for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. When mixture has stopped bubbling stir in nuts. Spoon and spread over graham crackers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Cool and cut into 48 (1 x 2-inch) bars.

title: Banana-Date-Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Add soda to sour milk. Add bananas. Mix in nuts dates and flour. Mix well. Grease 1 loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Muffins
instructions: Combine beaten eggs and brown sugar. Mix well and add melted margarine. Then add flour vanilla and pecans. Bake in cupcake size muffin tins for approximately 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour salt and shortening. Add water and egg making soft dough. Divide into two parts. Roll out into very thin sheets and let dry for 15 minutes. Cut into small strips and drop in boiling broth. Cook until tender.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Fry bacon. Drain and chop. Put in pie shell. Sprinkle with cheese mushrooms and broccoli. Blend eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over meat and vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Shells
instructions: Coarsely chop cabbage and onion. In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot oil cook cabbage onion pepper and salt until cabbage and onion are very tender (about 20 minutes) stirring occasionally.

title: Crescent Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except dough and press mixture into a loaf pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan for 5 minutes. Drain off fat and invert meat loaf onto a cookie sheet. Separate roll of dough into 4 rectangles. Overlap slightly on a pastry cloth or floured board to form a large rectangle. Roll out to 10 x 5 inches. Drape over meat. Trim excess. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Take 5 graham crackers mash fine and put in bottom of dish. Drain pineapple (save juice and mix lemon juice with the pineapple juice then pour back into the pineapple). Add the Jell-O Borden sweetened condensed milk marshmallows and Cool Whip. Mix well and pour over the cracker crumbs and refrigerate.

title: Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. If too sour add sugar. If too sweet add vinegar and salt. Add to potatoes which have been diced and basted overnight in French dressing. Also add diced celery and 1 dozen boiled eggs.

title: Marie'S Easy Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients until thick pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and freeze for 1 hour.

title: Heavenly Orange Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix wafer crumbs and oleo. Press in spring-form pan. Bake 10 minutes and cool.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Cook rice; wash and drain. Mix rice shredded cheese parsley and onions. Beat eggs and add to rice mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until firm.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. Best if made a day ahead.

title: Pear Jam
instructions: Note You will need canning jars rings and new lids.

title: Skillet Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients then add the rest. Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Garden Toss Spaghetti
instructions: Saute veggies in oil until zucchini is tender. Prepare spaghetti; toss with half and half cheese salt and pepper. Add hot cooked veggies to spaghetti and toss well. Serve on warm platter.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients and beat well. Pour in bottle and add salt and piece of garlic.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Prepare cake mix as directed. Pour 2 Cups of batter into greased 13 X 9 inch pan. Bake 15 minutes. In heavy saucepan over low heat melt caramels and butter. remove from heat. Add sweetened condensed milk. Mix well. Spread caramel over cake. Spread remaining batter over caramel. top with nuts. Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole dish. Add all ingredients except peas cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for one hour. Add peas if desire leave in oven for another five minutes; then serve.

title: Puppy Chow Snack
instructions: Melt together the first 3 ingredients. Add and stir in the cereal. Shake the mixture with the powdered sugar in a large container with a tight lid until cereal mixture is well coated.

title: Peach Butter
instructions: Mix peaches sugar and salt. Stir until well blended. Let stand. Put in a large heavy pan. Boil rapidly stirring constantly to prevent scorching. As mixture becomes thick reduce heat to reduce splattering. Add spices and continue to cook until butter is thick to flake off spoon or approximately 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Honey Wheat Bread
instructions: In saucepan heat milk just until bubbles form around edge of pan. Remove from heat. Add shortening honey and salt stirring until shortening is melting. Let cool to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast over water in mixing bowl. Stir to dissolve yeast. Stir in milk mixture and eggs. Combine flours add 2/3 of flour. Mix at low speed. Mix rest of flour by hand. Cover bowl with wax paper and towel. Place in warm draft-free area one hour. Grease bread pans. Knead dough by hand and divide in equal parts about 4. Place in pans and let stand 40 to 50 minutes. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Let cool.

title: Banana Coconut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Into a large bowl sift together flour baking soda and salt; set aside. Put eggs butter lemon extract sour cream and sugar in blender and mix or mix by hand. Pour egg mixture into flour mixture stirring thoroughly. Fold in nuts bananas and coconut. Pour batter into 2 lightly buttered 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Gems (Haystack)
instructions: Mix sugar cream and margarine and cook until mixture forms a soft ball. Add crumbs coconut and nuts; beat well. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; make into loaf. Put into shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. During the last 30 minutes spoon on tangy mustard glaze. Save some for serving the Ham Loaf.

title: Chicken Breast Monterey
instructions: Sprinkle chicken filets with seasoning. Coat with flour. Brown for 5 minutes on each side in butter over medium heat. Reduce heat to low. Add next 4 ingredients. Simmer covered for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Top each filet with one piece of cheese. Let stand covered for 5 minutes or until cheese begins to melt.

title: Beef And Biscuit Casserole
instructions: Cook ground chuck and onion until tender; drain. Combine the tomato sauce garlic salt and chili powder in a bowl. Add the egg and 1 cup of the cheese chunks. Combine this with ground chuck and onion. Divide each biscuit into 2 pieces. Place 10 pieces in the bottom of a casserole dish. Spread the ground chuck mixture on top of the biscuits. Place the remaining biscuit pieces on top of the meat mixture. Bake for 25 minutes at 300\u00b0. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top of the browned biscuits and return to the oven long enough to melt the cheese.

title: Mrs. Hooper'S Fried Corn
instructions: Melt bacon drippings and margarine in an iron skillet until hot. Reduce heat slightly and add corn. Stir constantly until done about 10 to 15 minutes. Salt to taste.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Mix everything together. Shape into patties. Coat with cracker crumbs and fry. Makes about 8 to 10.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Cook beans and drain. Add red onion sliced in rings. Then put into jar and shake all the ingredients together. Pour over beans. Refrigerate several hours. Serve sprinkled with crumbled bacon. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crispy Potato Quiche(Serves 6)
instructions: Press thawed hash browns between paper towels to remove moisture. Fit hash browns into greased 10-inch pie plate forming a solid crust. Brush crust with melted butter making certain to brush tip edges. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle cheeses and ham evenly over bottom of crust. Beat half and half with eggs and seasoned salt. Pour over cheeses and ham. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Frozen hash browns cut the preparation time for this spicy quiche.

title: Lemon-Vanilla Angel Food Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spray vegetable coating spray lightly onto a tube pan.

title: Mexican Pinwheels*
instructions: Add onion olives and peppers to cream cheese. Mix well. Spread over tortillas and roll up (jelly roll style). Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate about 4 hours. Slice into 3/4-inch sections (save the ends for yourself as this is all that will be left!). Serve with salsa if desired. Watch them disappear!

title: Baked Lasagne
instructions: Cook the lasagne and drain. Brown the meat. Mix the Ricotta parsley nutmeg cinnamon and eggs. Alternate in baking dish. Sprinkle some cheese and sauce until dish is filled. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Rye Bread
instructions: Pour the milk over the salt molasses and oil. Add water when cool; add yeast and unbleached flour and beat until smooth. Stir in caraway seed. Gradually\tadd the rye flour and mix to make a medium stiff dough. Dough will be sticky. Turn it out onto a floured board and knead 10 minutes.\tCover let rise until double 2 hours. Punch down let rise again. Shape into 2 long rolls on cookie sheets with cornmeal. Let rise until double. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Mix as usual when making cookies. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan brown bacon and cook onion and celery with garlic and basil until tender. Stir in soups water tomatoes macaroni and salt. Bring to boil; cover. Reduce heat; simmer 15 minutes. Add zucchini cook 10 minutes more or until done. Makes 8 cups.

title: Applesauce-Graham Cracker Dessert(Low-Calorie)
instructions: Combine apple sauce with dry Jello. Lay 6 graham crackers in bottom of 9x13 dish and cover with jello-applesauce mixture. Repeat crackers and mixture until all 36 graham crackers are used (6 layers). End with applesauce on top and sides.\tUse Cool Whip to cover the layers completely. Refrigerate for 24 hours.\tServes 12-15.

title: Cheddar Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in flour and simmer. Briskly stir in warm milk. Blend well. Heat until boiling. Stir in cheese. Blend well.

title: Punch Bowl Cake(Small Size)
instructions: In a small punch bowl assemble 10 layers in the following order thin layer of crumbled cake all of vanilla pudding thin layer of Cool Whip thin layer of cake (crumbled) all cherry pie filling thin layer of Cool Whip thin layer of crumbled cake all crushed pineapple thin layer of Cool Whip and sliced bananas. Decorate top with Cool Whip coconut and cherries.

title: Baked Potato Skins
instructions: Scrub potatoes thoroughly and prick several times with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until done. Allow to cool to touch. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise; carefully scoop out pulp leaving about 1/4-inch thick shells. Cut each shell into 1 inch wide strips and place on ungreased baking sheets. Brush tops of strips with butter; sprinkle with seasoning and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp. Serve warm with sour cream.

title: Bread Dumplings(Semmelknodel)
instructions: Finely slice bread rolls and soak in milk for 15 minutes. Fry onion and parsley in butter; add to soaked bread. Mix in eggs flour salt and nutmeg. Bring water to a boil with salt. Form a test dumpling and cook in slowly simmering water 10 to 15 minutes. If it breaks apart add bread crumbs to mixture to make it drier. If it is too firm add a little more milk to mixture. Serve with goulash or roast beef.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 450\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: No Peek Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients (except peas) in large casserole dish (2-quarts) or large rectangle cake pan with tight fitting* top. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 5 hours. When done add frozen peas.

title: Peanut Crisp Bars
instructions: In a large saucepan combine granulated sugar corn syrup and salt. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Blend in peanut butter; stir in cereal. Pat evenly into a square pan. In a small saucepan melt oleo and brown sugar. Remove from heat; add milk and vanilla. Stir in powdered sugar. Beat until smooth. Spread over cereal mixture. Cut into squares and enjoy. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Microwave Cream Pie Filling
instructions: Mix egg yolks and milk with a whisk. Fluff up good. Mix dry ingredients together then add to egg mixture. Cook in microwave on Full power for 6 to 8 minutes. Stir at 2 minute intervals until thickened. When finished add margarine and vanilla. Makes 1 (9-inch) or 2 (8-inch) pies.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine sugar 1/3 cup water and cranberries; let boil for 5 minutes. Take off and let cool. Mix jello and water and let it start to jell a little; add cranberries pecans pineapple and celery. Mix and refrigerate.

title: Coconut Bars
instructions: Cream together the margarine and 1/2 cup brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add 1 cup flour; mix well. In a 9 x 13-inch pan bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. In another bowl mix together the remaining 1 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup flour. Blend eggs vanilla and salt. Fold in pecans and coconut. Spread mixture evenly over baked layer. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in large casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Summer Delight
instructions: For a low-fat quick cool summer treat spread chocolate Cool Whip between 2 chocolate graham crackers.

title: Zesty Carrots
instructions: Cut carrots julienne style. Cook until tender (about 6 to 8 minutes). Drain carrots reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Turn carrots into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. In small bowl combine onion horseradish mayonnaise reserved liquid from carrots and salt and pepper to taste. Pour over carrots spreading evenly. Toss bread crumbs with butter; sprinkle over top. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 6 servings.

title: Raspberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels sugar and butter well. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes. Cool this crust.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine corn and eggs lightly beaten. Add mixture of next 5 ingredients. Stir in milk and melted butter. Pour into greased 3-quart casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring once.

title: Dominosaurus Pound Cake
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt in medium bowl; set aside. In separate bowl cream butter and sugar; add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Alternately add flour mixture and milk. Line outside of spring-form pan with foil. Grease and flour pan. Pour in batter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Remove cake from pan. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fluffy Flapjacks
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder soda sugar and salt. Combine buttermilk melted butter and beaten egg. Add to dry ingredients stirring only until flour is moistened. Batter will be lumpy and thick. Bake on hot ungreased griddle. Makes 6 to 8 pancakes.

title: Coconut Bars
instructions: Beat eggs until lemon color. Add brown sugar oil vanilla flour salt and soda. Mix well. Add coconut and nuts. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook on simmer until warm.

title: Pickle Relish
instructions: Heat to boiling vinegar sugar turmeric ground mustard celery seed and salt. Add cucumber mixture; let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Put in cans and seal.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: What'S Cooking?(Beef Stew For One)
instructions: Brown beef in butter. Add soup vegetables and horseradish. Let simmer until vegetables are soft. Add water for desired thickness. For more servings add more vegetables horseradish and another can of soup.

title: Crustless Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and mix with other ingredients. Pour into lightly greased or buttered 9-inch dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sugar-Cured Hams
instructions: Mix together. Pat on fresh hams; wrap in brown paper. Tie string around ham to secure paper. Place in a cotton \sack.\ Hang in a cool dry place for ham to cure.

title: Crunchy Jumble Cookies
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda. Set aside. Mix margarine and sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Add flour mixture. Stir in Rice Krispies and butterscotch or chocolate bits. Drop by teaspoon on lightly-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Festive Cup
instructions: Add to water all spices sugar and rind. Bring to a boil. Add the bottle of wine. Simmer for 1/2 hour. Strain before serving.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
instructions: Prepare broccoli by boiling only 5 minutes then drain. Combine eggs mayo soup and cheese. Stir in broccoli. Cover with crushed crackers. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Jenny'S Cornbread Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix sour cream and mayonnaise; set aside. Place half of the crumbled cornbread in the bottom of a large serving bowl. Top with half of the beans. In a medium bowl combine tomatoes green pepper and onion; layer half of the cheese bacon corn and reserved salad dressing. Repeat layers using remaining ingredients. Garnish as desired. Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours before serving. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Easy Oven Stew
instructions: Mix beef cubes and flour in large ovensafe pot. Do not brown meat. Add other ingredients and stir. Bake covered at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours or until meat is tender. Makes 12 (1 cup) servings.

title: Beef With Cabbage And Potatoes
instructions: Place large skillet on high heat. Add water beef potatoes onion garlic salt and pepper. Cook until 1/2 liquid is reduced. Add cabbage and carrots. Cook 35 minutes or until cabbage and carrots are tender. Serves 6.

title: 24 Hour Salad For The Holidays
instructions: Combine eggs vinegar and sugar in top of double boiler. Cook over low heat beating constantly until smooth and thickened. Remove from heat and add butter. Cool. Fold in fruit marshmallows and whipped cream. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Mix all except blueberries and 2nd cup sugar. Spread over bottom of well buttered pan. Add blueberries and a 2nd cup of sugar. Pour boiling water over blueberries and sugar layer. Dot with extra butter. Bake at 315\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Delight
instructions: Melt butter in casserole. Cut up and blend all ingredients. Bake for 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Stir after 30 minutes. This makes a big casserole.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger until brown. Drain. Add onion to meat. Spread beans in a 8 x 11-inch pan. Crumble chips and spread on beans. Add hamburger with onions to chips and beans. Pour diluted sauce on top of meat. Top with grated cheese and olives. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and heated about 20 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in casserole dish. Mix sour cream and soup. Pour over chicken. Pour melted butter over crackers. Add poppy seed (optional) and mix well. Put cracker mix on top of chicken. Bake until bubbly about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve over rice or alone as a casserole.

title: Seven Layer Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over margarine. Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients in order listed and press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Chill if desired. Cut into squares.

title: Garden Zucchini Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine 1 egg onion and Parmesan cheese. Stir in potatoes. Put potato mixture in a 9-inch pie pan or 10-inch quiche dish. Pat the mixture over the bottom and up the sides of the pan. Bake uncovered in a 400\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly on a wire rack. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Casserole
