instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can top with crushed cornflakes combined with melted margarine before baking.

title: Cube Steak
instructions: Brown cube steaks. Place in casserole dish. Can add a little dry onion soup mix. Add the cream of chicken soup and a little water. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until tender. Gravy can be used to put over potatoes. Can also cook on top of stove. Simmer for 1/2 to 1 hour or until tender.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix covering with crackers. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Drain potatoes. Mash up. Add butter brown sugar nuts and coconut. Mix well. Form into balls around large marshmallows then roll in crushed corn flakes. Place on greased cookie sheet. Warm for about 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Turtles
instructions: Melt first two ingredients in top of double boiler. Add 3 cups chopped or broken pecans. Spoon out on greased cookie sheet. Put in freezer until hard or overnight. Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler. Dip candy in mixture using tongs. Place on wax paper to set up. Do not use foil because the candy will stick to it. When taking from freezer to dip in chocolate wait only until you can stick a toothpick in it and then dip in chocolate.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes\tand onion in small amount of water and cook until soft. Add milk salt and pepper then reheat. Brown flour in butter and blend it slowly into the potato mixture. Add a little water to the beaten egg and stir into the soup. Let cook for a few minutes very slowly and serve hot with a little chopped parsley sprinkled on top. Yummy on a cold winter night.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 18 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until light brown. Makes 3 or 4 dozen.

title: Moist Crispy Chicken
instructions: Combine cereal paprika salt and pepper. Brush chicken breasts with mayo. Place crumb mixture in plastic bag and add chicken. Shake to coat well. Place chicken in a greased baking dish and bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In a saucepan combine milk sugar shortening and peanut butter. Bring to a boil; let boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add cocoa vanilla and oats. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Let cool completely until firm.

title: Corn And Chicken Chowder
instructions: Melt butter and add onion. Cook and stir until onion is light yellow. Add chicken potatoes celery and chicken stock; simmer until vegetables are tender. Add corn milk and seasonings; heat thoroughly. Add more salt and pepper if desired.

title: Port Wine Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine cheese food softened cream cheese and 2 tablespoons margarine; mix until well blended. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Mold into ball. Roll in chopped pecans. Refrigerate. Makes 1 ball.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of a large pan. Mix first 4 ingredients well. Pour batter in pan on melted margarine. Pour peaches (2 cups) over batter. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and brown.

title: Orange Sangria
instructions: Cut orange in half. Slice one half. With a vegetable peeler cut off the thin outer peel of the other half of the orange. In a bowl using a wooden spoon mash peel into the sugar so sugar absorbs the oils; then add remaining ingredients. Cover and chill. Remove peels after 15 minutes. Serve over ice. Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Alabama Camp Stew
instructions: Boil all meat together in enough water to cover meats. Cook until tender. Remove bones and grind meat. Cook potatoes tomatoes and onions in meat broth until potatoes crumble to touch. Stir well while cooking. When vegetables are done add ground meat and stir well over low heat. Add all remaining ingredients except corn and butter. Mix well and season to taste. Let simmer for about 1 hour stirring frequently. Add corn and simmer stirring constantly for about 15 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Blender Corn Pudding
instructions: Put corn eggs flour salt and sugar in blender; turn on and off twice at low speed. Add milk and stir until blended. Grease baking dish and cut up rest of margarine in dish. Pour mixture in center. Stir twice during first 15 minutes of baking to distribute the margarine. Continue baking at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon Pie
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool to lukewarm. Whip cream cheese until soft and beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add gelatin mix blending thoroughly. Fold in whipped topping. Pour in graham cracker crust. Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Grind chipped ham and american cheese together in food processor. Cook sauce. Cook ground beef salt oregano and parsley. Place sauce and beef mixture in a crockpot. Then add ham and cheese mixture. Warm on low.

title: Pineapple Sherbet Punch
instructions: Mix juices and water. Add sherbet and ice cream. Makes 7 1/4 quarts. Serves 60 or more punch cups.

title: Cherry Delight Salad
instructions: Mix all together and chill before serving.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients with a pastry blender until it reaches consistency of coarse corn meal. Blend remaining ingredients into flour mixture.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Put potatoes into well buttered baking dish alternating layers with white sauce made from other ingredients. Cover top with bread crumbs and chopped onions.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Cook beans until done. Drain. Add tomato juice and tomatoes. Cook ground beef onion and pepper until done. Drain. Add to the bean mixture. Add chili hot beans and chili powder salt and pepper to taste. Add cooked macaroni (optional).

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugar and butter. Add shortening. Add eggs one at a time. Sift the dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Mix in vanilla. Bake in greased tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Drain Veg-All and water chestnuts. Mix ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cover while baking.

title: Super Seaside Sandwiches
instructions: Combine salad dressing cucumber and milk. Mix well. Combine tuna bread crumbs 1 cup salad dressing eggs and onions. Mix lightly. Shape into 6 patties. Brown on both sides in margarine. Cover each bread slice with lettuce tomato and patty. Top with cucumber mixture.

title: Mrs. Beck'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook the first 4 ingredients together on warm overnight. Remove chicken bones and skin. Cut up and add the other ingredients. Cook until corn is tender. Thicken with mashed potatoes.

title: Crabmeat Supreme
instructions: Melt cheese and margarine in double boiler. (I prefer crock-pot.) Add other ingredients and let simmer. (Seafood flavor increases as it simmers.) Add olives at serving time. Serve in patty shells over toast points rice or noodles. Serves 12.

title: Romanian Chicken Breasts
instructions: Fry chicken breasts in oil until brown. Season well with salt and pepper to taste. Remove from pan. To oil add ham onion celery and basil simmer for 5 minutes stirring. Add paste to broth. Return chicken back to skillet and simmer 1 hour or until done. Turn chicken breasts occasionally. Cook spaghetti in boiling water drain well. Sprinkle chicken with parsley and serve over spaghetti. Makes 6 servings.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello and boiling water and let cool. Add remaining ingredients. Mix. Pour into jello mold sprayed with Pam. Congeal several hours. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pork Chop Dinner
instructions: Slice potatoes thin and put in bottom of casserole dish. Add sliced onions pork chops and mushroom soup. Cover and cook at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Combine drained vegetables onion cheese mayonnaise and soup; mix well. Pour mixture into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle crushed crackers over top of casserole. Return to oven and bake until crumbs are lightly browned. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Mix sour cream cream cheese and onion; let stand several hours. Brown beef salt and sugar together. Add garlic and tomato

title: Chicken Or Turkey Salad
instructions: Wash lettuce; dry thoroughly with paper towel. Toss with salad oil until well covered. Arrange on 4 salad plates. Put diced meat and celery into bowl. Moisten with a little salad oil and add mayonnaise salt and pepper. Toss until well mixed. Spoon onto salad plates. Garnish with hard-cooked eggs and tomato slices. Makes 4 servings.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage; drain and let it get cold. Mix all ingredients together in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and set casserole out on counter for about 30 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. This is great for company!

title: Alison'S Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain. Set aside. Simmer mild enchilada sauce with 1 can mashed stewed tomatoes and chili powder. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Hot Swiss And Almond Spread
instructions: Combine cream cheese and salad dressing. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread mixture into 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes stirring after 8 minutes. Serve with crackers. Makes 2 1/3 cups.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Bring water sugar and cream of tartar to a boil. Drop in your crackers but\tdo not stir.\tPour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Dot with butter. Bake until shell is browned.

title: Easy Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Pour melted butter onto the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over butter. Sprinkle nuts over crumbs then sprinkle chocolate or butterscotch then sprinkle coconut then over all pour the milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool in pan and cut into bars.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Combine sugar salt eggs and spices. Blend in cream and vinegar; add raisins. Mix well. Place in pie pan and bake 1 hour or until set in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs then add flour 7-Up and lemon extract. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes.

title: Lanice'S Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and grate potatoes in large pot. Dice onion and green pepper. Add water (enough to cover potatoes). Bring to a boil; reduce to simmer and cover for 20 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add cheese and milk; cook 10 minutes longer to melt cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Scotch Shortbread
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the first 3 ingredients. Sift in the flour; mix thoroughly with hands. Roll out to 1/3 to 1/2-inch thick. Chill; cut into finger size pieces. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Prick with a fork; press edges with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Watch closely as they brown quickly.

title: Tomato Dumplings
instructions: Heat the first five ingredients in saucepan with tight fitting cover.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice per directions on box. After rice is cooked combine all ingredients except margarine in 2-quart casserole. Melt margarine and mix in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Parisienne(Crock-Pot Recipe)
instructions: Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt pepper and paprika. Place in crock-pot. Mix wine soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken and sprinkle with more paprika. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Kahlua(Coffee Liqueur)
instructions: Dissolve sugar and instant coffee in hot water. Add alcohol and vanilla; stir. Store for 30 days (or 30 minutes) depending on urgency. Everclear is available at drug or liquor stores.

title: Layered Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine cheese and bacon; mix well. In 2 1/2-quart bowl layer spinach cheese mixture mushrooms onions and peas. Combine mayonnaise sour cream and sugar; mix well. Spread over salad to seal. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons cheese over top; cover. Refrigerate overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in bowl mixing well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon in bowl. Sprinkle over batter. Swirl batter with knife. Bake using cake mix directions. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl. Drizzle over warm cake.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 3 (9-inch) round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Boil macaroni and eggs. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Garnish with paprika. Chill and serve.

title: Cranberry Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix sugars and margarine. Stir in milk orange juice and egg. Stir in remaining ingredients except Browned Butter Glaze. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet. Bake until light brown 10 to 15 minutes. Cool; spread with glaze. Makes about 5 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together except marshmallow cream. Spread into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take from oven and spread immediately with marshmallow cream. Let cool then ice.

title: Christmas Mints
instructions: Cream all ingredients well. Form into small balls. Place on wax paper. Press flat with fork or bottom of glass. Let stand until firm.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix it all together and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Top with a small can of tomato sauce for the last few minutes of cooking if you like.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Brown onion in 1 teaspoon butter. Add broccoli soup milk and cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Add rice. Bring to boil and then remove from heat. Pour all contents into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Turkey And Black Bean Chili
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium-low heat cook onion pepper carrots and garlic in hot oil until golden brown and tender. Sprinkle with chili powder and ground cumin. Cook stirring frequently 7 to 8 minutes until spices are fragrant. Add ground turkey breast and cook stirring with wooden spoon to break up meat about 5 minutes or until cooked through and slightly brown. Add beans broth salsa and tomato paste. Bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium. Cook stirring occasionally 45 minutes or until thickened. Makes 8 servings.

title: Savory Vegetable Dip
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients except vegetables; mix well. Chill 1 hour to blend flavors. Refrigerate. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients in saucepan until sugar is melted and mixture is hot. Stir in the confectioners sugar.

title: Rich Frosted Brownies
instructions: Combine sugar flour eggs butter cocoa and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until center is firm. Cool. Frost. Will yield 48 squares.

title: Schnitzel Beans
instructions: Fry chopped bacon until brown. Add sugar and vinegar to bacon and fat. Add beans and sliced onion. Cook 1/2 hour.

title: Breakfast Bars
instructions: Butter a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In a large saucepan melt butter and marshmallows over low heat stirring constantly. Stir in peanut butter until melted. Stir in dry milk and drink mix. Remove from heat; fold in raisins and Cheerios. Butter hands and pat into pan. Cool and cut into bars. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Brownies(Club Member: Clint Hudson)
instructions: Melt shortening and cocoa with sugar and eggs. Beat in flour. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Polish Chop Suey Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix by hand until creamy. Put into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except onion rings and a little cheese saved for the top. Rinse out mushroom can with a little liquid drained from the peas and add to peas. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese then with onion rings. Bake 4 to 5 minutes longer.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Blend together butter cream cheese and powdered sugar. Set aside. Mix milk and pudding together. Blend both mixes. Add Cool Whip.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brenda'S Quick Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Wash and scrub corn to remove silks. Place corn into boiling water. Cook until done about 20 minutes. Remove corn and place it on clean cloth towels to cool. It looks shriveled when cool. Make sure it is dry and doesnt steam Ziploc bags. Put into Ziploc bags seal and place in freezer. It is ready to eat by removing and heating in boiling water. Amount frozen is optional. Corn can be kept up to 1 year this way.

title: Caramel Delights
instructions: Combine oats sugar soda salt and margarine. Reserve 3/4 cup and pat remainder in an ungreased 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Combine caramel sauce with 3 tablespoons flour and drizzle over top. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup oat mixture. Bake another 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Granny'S Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and cook at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Not-So-Sinful Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. With nonstick cooking spray coat bottom only of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Set aside. In large saucepan over low heat combine oil and chocolate. Heat stirring frequently about 2 minutes until chocolate is melted. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Add sugar and applesauce to chocolate mixture; mix well. Stir in egg whites and vanilla; blend well. In medium bowl combine oats flour baking powder and salt; add to chocolate mixture stirring until just combined. Scrape batter into prepared pan. Bake 22 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out almost clean (do not overbake). Cool completely in pan on wire rack. Remove from pan and cut into bars. Store in tightly covered container for up to 1 week. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar just before serving.

title: Quick, Delicious Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Mix and let stand in refrigerator overnight the first 2 ingredients. Bring to rolling boil for 15 minutes. Add strawberry jello. Cool and serve on toast or as desired.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Mix ingredients together well. May need more flour to stick together. Knead until smooth. Dough should not be sticky. Roll out on well-floured surface. Let set at least 1 hour. Cut in desired width.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Stir together sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Blend milk and egg yolks. Gradually stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat. Blend in butter and vanilla. Press plastic wrap onto filling in saucepan and cool to room temperature.

title: Parker House Rolls
instructions: Put shortening sugar and salt into milk; cool to lukewarm. Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Add sugar; stir into milk mixture when lukewarm. Add eggs then stir in 4 cups of flour. Beat thoroughly. Add 3 cups of flour and mix dough thoroughly. Cover with cloth and put in a warm place to rise for 45 minutes. Knead and let rise another 25 minutes. Roll out dough on lightly floured board to 1/2-inch thick. Cut with a 3-inch cutter. Make a crease slightly to one side of center of each biscuit nearly through the dough using the dull side of a knife. Then brush edge of each biscuit with melted butter and fold wider side over shorter side pressing edges firmly together. Arrange 2-inches apart on baking sheet; cover with cloth and allow to rise for 1 1/2 hours. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and brush with melted butter.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crumble cookies in food processor; set aside. Combine cream cheese Cool Whip confectioners sugar and margarine together. Mix in another bowl the pudding milk and vanilla then mix both mixtures together and blend well. Layer Oreo cookie crumbs pudding filling and cookie crumbs on top. Freeze. Can be served frozen or slightly thawed. Layer in a clean plastic flowerpot. Insert stem flowers for appearance.

title: Strawberries In The Snow
instructions: Whip milk softened cream cheese and 4x powdered sugar. Put layer of whipped cream in dish and layer of cake slices; put remainder of whipped cream and spread canned strawberry pie filling over top and chill.

title: White Chocolate Mousse
instructions: In a bowl beat cream until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff peaks form; set aside. In another bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add chocolate and beat until fluffy. Add chocolate and beat until smooth. Fold in whipping cream and alternate layers of mousse and berries in parfait glasses ending in mousse. Garnish with additional berries if desired. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 hours.

title: Best Sweet Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornbread mix as directed in small baking bowl. Mix yellow cake mix as directed in large mixing bowl.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Tear up bread and place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Brown and drain meat. Spoon sausage over bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat together eggs milk mustard salt and pepper. Pour over meat mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Frizlie Annie Hot Dish
instructions: Dice onions and brown in oil; add meat and brown. Drain fat. Cook noodles; add to meat mixture. Add soup corn olives and cheese. Mix and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in a covered pan or casserole dish.

title: Green Beans With Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Wash beans; trim ends and remove strings. Cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Combine beans and water in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes. Drain. Melt butter in a skillet. Stir in sugar garlic salt salt pepper and basil. Add tomatoes; stir gently cooking just until soft. Pour tomatoes and sauce over beans; toss gently. Transfer vegetable mixture to serving bowl; garnish with fresh basil. Yields 6 servings.

title: Creamed Corn(From Gulliver'S Restaurant)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flour and butter in a pot; bring to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes. Blend butter with flour; add to corn and mix well. Remove from heat.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Add 1 1/2 cups milk and bring to boiling point. Combine sugar salt and cornstarch. Add remaining milk to make a smooth paste. Add paste to milk and cook until thickened. Beat egg yolks. Pour a small amount of hot mixture over yolks before adding them to milk. Cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Cook until lukewarm and pour into baked pie shell. Cover with meringue of egg whites cream of tartar and 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until meringue is browned.

title: Crumb-Topped Celery Bake
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 375\u00b0. Position disc in bowl with slicing side up; slice celery and water chestnuts. When sliced vegetables reach fill level empty bowl into ungreased shallow 1 1/2 qt casserole dish. Slice remaining vegetables. Add soup to casserole; stir to mix. Sprinkle bread crumbs over celery mixture. Bake for 45 minutes. Makes 6 (1/2 c.) servings.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Whisk together first 5 ingredients. Pour over crackers stirring to coat. Place on baking sheets and bake at 275\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 11 to 12 cups.

title: Butternut Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs flour vanilla and nuts; mix. Use a teaspoon of dough for each cookie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Flaky Meat Pies
instructions: Fry meat in butter just enough to take the red out. Add onions and cinnamon until onion is limp. Salt and pepper to taste then add vinegar and mix well. Cook a few minutes longer. Remove from heat.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzel 1/4 cup sugar and butter. Press into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool. Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling pineapple juice. Add strawberries. Cook until mushy. Chill. Pour over cream cheese. Refrigerate.

title: Pumpkin Supreme
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs sugar and margarine. Mix well and press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Set aside.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine mix and chill. Serve with fresh fruits.

title: A Happy Marriage
instructions: Flour with frequent portions of recreation and a dash of happy memories. Stir well and remove jealousy temper and criticism. Sweeten well with generous portions of love. Keep warm with a steady flame of devotion. Never serve with cold shoulder or sharp tongue.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on package and drain. Cook 1 cup rice in 3 cups lightly salted water. Combine with broccoli and add 1 pound Velveeta (or 1 jar Cheez Whiz) and cream of mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until slightly brown on top.

title: Green Tomato Chow Chow
instructions: Peel and chop tomatoes. Place in a large pot. Add all other ingredients. Bring to boil. Cook about 10 minutes or until tomatoes and onions are tender. Stir frequently so mixture does not scorch. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal. Makes 12 pints.

title: Raisin Drop Cookies
instructions: Combine raisins and water; boil 5 minutes. There should be 1/2 cup liquid left. Cool then add soda. Blend shortening with salt and spices; gradually add sugar creaming thoroughly. Add eggs vanilla and cooled raisin-soda mixture. Add flour sifted with baking powder mixing well. Stir in nuts. Chill dough until stiff. Drop by rounded teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Praline Strips
instructions: Arrange crackers on ungreased cookie sheet all going in same direction. Put sugar and butter in saucepan and boil for 2 minutes. Stir in pecans and spread on crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Break into strips.

title: Spicy Broiled Redfish
instructions: Mix all seasonings together. Dip fish into melted margarine or butter. Coat both sides of fish with seasoning mix. Place on a lightly greased broiler pan. Broil for 4 minutes. Turn and broil an additional 3 minutes.

title: Lemon And Rosemary Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with black pepper and garlic salt place in dish and marinade in lemon juice and rosemary. Marinade for 1-2 hours. Remove chicken from juice and sprinkle with parmesan cheese grill until done. You may spray chicken with olive oil to keep from drying out while grilling.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Beat until fluffy. Gradually add powdered sugar and beat. Spread on carrot cake.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Mix together peach brandy champagne and add club soda; add ice ring and serve.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Work in 1/3 cup margarine. Press over sliced apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 until apples are done and topping is golden brown.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Roll into a ball and refrigerate for 24 hours. Shape into a ball or into individual logs. Sprinkle pecans onto the ball. Serve with crackers.

title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix mayonnaise cheese onions and garlic; spread on bread halves. If desired spread with parsley. Wrap each half in foil. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or freeze. Unwrap and place on baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes (20 to 25 minutes if frozen) or until puffed but not brown. Cut into slices. Serves 12 to 15.

title: No Bean Chili Dip
instructions: Cut cream cheese to line serving dish suggest a 9 x 9-inch size. Cover with Hormel chili sauce. Garnish with Mozzarella cheese and microwave until cheese is melted. Great with Ritz crackers.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a 10-inch skillet combine oil and chili powder. Cook 1 minute over medium heat. Increase heat to medium-high. Add half of the chicken pieces and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cook 4 minutes stirring frequently. With slotted spoon remove chicken to a large bowl. Repeat with remaining chicken and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.

title: Vanilla Brownies
instructions: Mix together and place in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and garlic in small amount of fat. Drain. Add tomato paste and sauce salt pepper and oregano. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cook noodles as directed.

title: Chicken Baked In Sour Cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Dredge chicken in flour. In a large skillet heat butter and brown chicken. Transfer to a casserole. Add mushrooms and sour cream diluted with water. Sprinkle with thyme and cover tightly. Bake until chicken is tender about 1 hour. Serve with fluffy rice.

title: Pizza Cutlets
instructions: Dip cutlets in egg then crumbs and fry in oil. Pour oil off and place cutlets back in layers. Pour over tomato sauce and 1/2 can of water. Cover between layers. Salt to taste and sprinkle with oregano garlic salt and cheese. Add mushrooms if desired. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Nachos Ole
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart saucepan combine soup and salsa. Over low heat heat through stirring often. Serve over tortilla chips. Top with tomato green onions olives and peppers.

title: Citrus Punch(Serves 40)
instructions: Mix pineapple juice lemonade orange juice and sugar ahead of time and chill. Right before serving add chilled ginger ale.

title: Egg Pastry
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Cut in shortening. Beat egg slightly. Add water and vinegar. Add gradually to dry ingredients just enough to hold dough together. Makes 3 to 4 pie crusts or a big pot of dumplings. Good in freezer or can freeze and have ready to cook.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat; add other ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Cook lasagna noodles as directed on package.

title: Virginia'S Beans
instructions: For each can of beans add 2 Tbsp. mustard 2 Tbsp. vinegar 3/4 c. brown sugar.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute first six ingredients in olive oil. Add tomato sauce brown sugar miso and mushrooms. Simmer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Jalapeno Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Hard-boil eggs. Halve the eggs and mash the egg yolks with enough mayonnaise to make a smooth paste. Add salt to taste then the chopped jalapenos. Stuff the egg whites and sprinkle top with chopped parsley.

title: Mary Jane'S Naughty No-No'S
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar together. Let cool completely! Add eggs flour pecans and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in 9 x 13 pan. Cool in pan for 30 minutes before cutting into small squares. If you melt your margarine in baking pan you dont have to grease it.

title: Mocha Cream Frosting
instructions: Combine confectioners sugar and cocoa. Cream butter with 1/2 cup cocoa mixture in small bowl. Combine instant coffee and hot water until dissolved. Add remaining cocoa mixture alternately with coffee and milk; beat until spreading consistency. Blend in vanilla. Makes about 2 1/4 cups frosting.

title: Fruit Kabobs With Hawaiian Dip
instructions: Set aside 1/4 cup coconut. Mix the remaining ingredients except for fruit. Place in a serving dish and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup coconut. Arrange fruit on skewers and serve with dip.

title: Hamburger Chop Suey
instructions: Mix altogether. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle Chinese noodles on top; bake 10 more minutes.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Shred cabbage into bowl. Open shrimp and drain juice.

title: Strawberry Butter(To Serve With Strawberry Bread)
instructions: Combine strawberries and softened margarine in an electric blender or a mixer until smooth and creamy. Make sure both ingredients are at room temperature.

title: Macaroni Cheese Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a loaf pan. Heat to boiling the first 3 ingredients. After cheese melts mix in next 5 ingredients. Fold in eggs and the cooked macaroni. Put in greased pan and bake until firm about 1 1/4 hours. Slice to serve.

title: Super Meringue
instructions: For each egg white use 1 heaping tablespoonful marshmallow cream. Beat egg whites until almost stiff and add marshmallow cream. Beat until mixture stands in peaks. Pile on pie and bake until light brown. Produces super meringue that will not weep or fall.

title: Fudgie Scotch Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Press into a very well buttered 9 x 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 45 minutes and cut into squares.

title: No Shortening Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Mix well. Pour in prepared 8-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pimento Cheese Spread
instructions: Wrap 1/2 slice bacon around Waverly crackers. Put on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Scotch Raisin Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar gradually beating until fluffy. Add molasses and buttermilk; mix well. Sift together flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Add to egg mixture and mix well. Add oatmeal nuts and raisins. Stir only until blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Store 1 day before slicing.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
instructions: Stir over heat until sugar is dissolved and butter is melted. Increase heat to medium and bring mixture to boiling stirring occasionally. Boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat and beat sauce 1 minute. Serve warm. Makes 1 1/4 cups sauce. Use heavy saucepan.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients as listed. One bag taco chips for dipping.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into Bundt pan and bake approximately 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Little Lasagna
instructions: Fry ground beef and onions until light brown. Cook noodles; drain. Spoon into shallow dish. Spread cottage cheese over noodles. Add beef. Place half each of the cheese strips and Ragu on top; repeat with remaining strips and sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is brown.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick butter in pan; put in sugar. Add peanut butter a little at a time. Pour in milk. Keep stirring so it doesnt burn; turn down heat. Cook about 20 minutes. To test if its done put water in cup and put a little drop of candy in cup of water. When it forms a little ball its done. Then add rest of butter and vanilla. Grease plates with butter to pour candy out on.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in half the whipped topping. Spread over crust. Prepare pudding as directed using 3 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill for several hours or overnight. Spread remaining whipped topping over pudding. Makes 15 servings.

title: Puffy French Toast
instructions: Sift together\tdry ingredients. Blend milk and egg. Add to flour mixture and beat until smooth. Dip bread slices into batter turning to coat slices evenly. Fry in greased skillet until golden brown on both sides.

title: Zucchini Squash
instructions: Cut squash lengthwise about 1/8-inch thick. Place squash in low Corning dish alternating squash slivered butter grated Italian cheese salt and pepper. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven; remove lid. Cover the top of mixture completely with sliced Velveeta cheese. Return to oven; bake until tender and cheese is melted.

title: Chuck Wagon Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp drain and set aside. Cook ground beef onion and celery until meat is brown and onions are tender; drain off fat. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Mix all ingredients in large Dutch oven or crock pot. Crumble bacon over beans.

title: Crispix Mix
instructions: Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in oven at 250\u00b0. Stir in garlic salt onion salt lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. Add Crispix cereal nuts and pretzels. Mix until well coated. Bake in oven at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on absorbent paper to cool. Yields 8 cups.

title: Christmas Scent
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer in pot on stove or put in electric pot. May add water as needed. May be stored in refrigerator.

title: Every Day Broccoli Cheese Chicken
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook chicken for 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and broccoli is done stirring occasionally. Makes 4 servings. Prep time 5 minutes. Cook time 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar salt and egg. Blend in syrup. Add shortening vanilla lemon juice and lemon peel. Mix until smooth and creamy.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Fry bacon and remove from frying pan. Lightly flour beef and brown in bacon grease. In a stockpot combine bacon (crumbled) beef onion garlic tomato sauce wine broth bay leaves thyme and basil. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Add vegetables (chopped into 1-inch pieces) and boil until tender. Thicken with 2 to 4 teaspoons flour with 1/2 c. water if desired. Serve with French bread.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Mix boiling water sugar and coffee. Let cool. Add brandy and vanilla. Use 1/2 gallon dark bottle to store. Better if aged up to six weeks especially if you use a vanilla bean.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix lightly all ingredients. Put in buttered casserole. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Pickles
instructions: Cut cucumbers into spears. Place them in a quart jar. Add mustard and celery seeds and onion. Bring water to a boil in a small pan. Add sugar and vinegar and pour into the jar. Let stand 4 to 6 hours before refrigerating. Cover. Serve cold.

title: Connie'S Creamy Frosting
instructions: Cream butter cocoa corn syrup and vanilla in mixing bowl. Add powdered sugar and milk. Beat until even consistency. Makes approximately 1 cup frosting.

title: Fudge Sunday Pie
instructions: Put milk chocolate marshmallows and salt in a 1-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until chocolate and marshmallows melt completely and mixture thickens. Cool to room temperature. Line bottoms and sides of two 9-inch pie pans with vanilla wafers. Spoon vanilla ice cream over vanilla wafers. Cover with chocolate sauce and sprinkle with nuts. Freeze until ready to serve.

title: Basic Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Grease skillet or pan. Place in oven to heat. Beat egg in mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Blend well. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 1 (9-inch) skillet or 9-inch square pan. Batter should be creamy and pourable.

title: Honey Acorn Squash
instructions: Pierce skin of squash several times. Put on microwave tray cook on High 4 to 5 minutes. Turn over after 2 minutes. Let stand 3 minutes then cut in half. Scoop out seeds. Arrange in dish with cut side up. Top with honey butter and lemon; cover with plastic wrap. Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until squash is tender. Let stand covered 2 minutes before serving.

title: Glazed Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut chicken wings at joint. Mix ingredients in shallow baking dish; add chicken and marinate for 1 hour. Remove chicken from marinade and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Turn chicken; coat on other side and cook for additional 30 minutes.

title: Eggrolls
instructions: Drain everything well. Add everything together except oil water and eggroll skins. Add a large spoonful of mixture to skin and roll (rolling directions on package). Adding a touch of water will make eggroll skin stay closed. To fry (and boil) spread 2 tablespoons oil in a 10-inch nonstick frypan. Arrange enough dumplings to cover the bottom without overlapping. Add 2/3 cup cold water; cover pan bringing it to a boil. Turn to medium heat until water has evaporated. Add 1 tablespoon oil if needed. Fry until both sides are brown.

title: Lettuce Pea Salad
instructions: Add 1/2 of all ingredients listed in order given then add other 1/2 except Sweet N Low. Use Sweet N Low over top of last layer. Let set at least 2 hours.

title: Bird Nest Cupcakes
instructions: Bake your cupcakes. Cool. Frost with white or chocolate frosting- really any kind of colored frosting looks great (lemon pastel). Decorate with coconut around outside circle of cupcake. You can cook the coconut or add food coloring to make pretty. Place jelly beans in center. Eat Eat.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pour into shallow pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Favorite Beef Loaf
instructions: Mix meat. Add onion and seasonings. Soak crumbled bread in milk. Add eggs. Combine meat and egg mixture. Bake uncovered for 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot or cold.

title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
instructions: Cook pasta shells as directed on package. Mix cheeses eggs and spices in bowl. Spoon cheese mixture into shells. Pour thin layer of sauce in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place stuffed shells open side down side by side in pan. Pour remaining sauce over shells. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
instructions: Use small cucumbers. Wash and let stand overnight in cold water or ice. I put mine in the refrigerator. Next day drain and pack into hot sterilized jars. To each quart add 1 garlic clove 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper 1/8 teaspoon alum and 1 grape leaf. Make brine of vinegar salt and water. Bring to a boil and pour over the cucumbers in the jars. Seal. Makes 6 to 8 quarts.

title: Beef Bologna
instructions: Mix and shape into three 6-inch rolls. Wrap and refrigerate 24 hours. Bake at 300\u00b0 on broiler rack for 1 hour. Freezes well. (Dont overbake.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on package. Beat eggs and mix other ingredients with broccoli.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a baking dish (medium size). Heat peaches and juice in a saucepan. Mix flour sugar and milk in a bowl. Pour flour mixture into butter. Spoon peaches on top of batter; use all juice. Bake about 30 minutes or until golden brown. (The browner the better.) Serve with ice cream.

title: One-Minute Cookies
instructions: In heavy saucepan melt butter. Stir in sugar cocoa and milk. Bring to boiling. Cook 1 minute stirring slowly. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter vanilla and oats. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper covered surface starting at outer sides of pan.

title: Fruit Cup
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Mix the instant pudding mix with 2 tablespoons Tang and the juice from the fruit. Garnish with cherries.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice medium thin. Make a white sauce of butter flour salt and milk. When thickened remove from range add grated cheese. Stir cheese into sauce. Place sliced potatoes in 3-quart casserole cover with hot white sauce and bake in 375\u00b0 preheated or cold oven uncovered for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Put sugar on ground up cranberries; let set at least 1 hour. Mix with jello and other ingredients.

title: Tuck'S Cow Pies
instructions: In a double boiler over simmering water melt the chocolate chips and shortening stirring until smooth. Remove from the heat; stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto waxed paper. Chill until ready to serve. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Wassail
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well and store in jars. Serve with hot cider.

title: Perfect Pasta And Seafood Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients together add more seasonings and mayonnaise if needed refrigerate. Enjoy!!!

title: Butterscotch Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 12-cup Bundt pan. Microwave 1 cup of the morsels in a small microwave-safe bowl on Medium-high (70%) power for 1 minute; stir. Microwave at additional 10 to 20 second intervals stirring until smooth. Cool to room temperature. Combine flour granulated sugar baking powder cinnamon salt and nutmeg in medium bowl. Stir together melted morsels pumpkin vegetable oil egg and vanilla extract in large bowl with wire whisk. Spoon batter into prepared pan. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until cake comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack for 30 minutes; remove to wire rack to cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Serve with Butterscotch Sauce.

title: Squash Puffs
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop by tablespoon into hot oil.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: In a 4-quart Dutch oven cook onion celery and garlic in hot margarine or butter until tender. Add water undrained tomatoes lentils barley bouillon cubes rosemary oregano and pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Add carrots and simmer for 15 minutes more or just until carrots are tender. Ladle into soup bowls and top with cheese. Makes 5 servings.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple and add jello; stir until dissolved. Let cool and add buttermilk Cool Whip nuts and bananas. Mix well and pour into salad mold and chill. May use 13 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Lemon Yum Yum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 13 x 9 x 2 pan melt butter on top of stove. Add flour brown sugar and pecans. Spread in pan. Bake 15 minutes or until brown. While crust is cooling in large bowl put softened cream cheese sugar and 1/2 large Cool Whip and vanilla. Mix with mixer. When crust is cool add cream cheese mixture. Then top cream cheese with lemon pie filling. Then add other half of large Cool Whip. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Butterscotch Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium pan melt morsels and margarine. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press 1/2 mixture on bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch dish. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add milk egg and vanilla. Mix well. Pour over graham cracker mixture. Put other 1/2 mixture on top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Strawberry Angel
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and strawberries. Break up angel food cake in bite size pieces and gently stir into Cool Whip and berries. Chill.

title: Millionaires Pie
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice. Add Cool Whip pineapple and nuts. Pour into graham cracker crust.

title: Potato Fritters
instructions: Cook potatoes until done. Drain and mash. Let stand for about an hour or until cooled then add the remaining ingredients. Pat into small patties; put vegetable oil in hot frying pan then add potato fritters. Fry until golden brown. Top with your favorite cheese while hot and enjoy.

title: Banana Crush Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water in large saucepan; boil until sugar melts. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients except ginger ale. Pour into empty milk cartons and freeze. When ready to use thaw to mushy stage (a few hours in refrigerator) then place one or two cartons at a time in punch bowl and pour cold ginger ale over it. (The mixtures in cartons will keep in freezer for several months.)

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugars until well blended. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour. Add rest of dry ingredients and sift again. Stir in gumdrops omitting black ones. Add oatmeal and coconut. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 until brown. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Line 10 inch plate with pastry. Drain crisp bacon. Cut cheese and bacon in half. Overlap layers of cheese and bacon on pastry. Best eggs and add remaining ingredients. Pour over cheese. Bake 50 minute or until knife inserted in center comes out clean and top is lightly browned. Serve warm. Makes 6-8 servings.

title: Layer Salad
instructions: Mix lettuce frozen peas water chestnuts and onions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice boiled eggs to cover. Cover eggs with mayonnaise. Sprinkle cheese on mayonnaise. Top with bacon bits.

title: Mystery Dip
instructions: Chop ingredients and mix with mayonnaise or blend all together in blender. Serve as a dip or spread for crackers.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add bananas and juice; combine well. Add combined dry ingredients mixing until just moistened. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for 1/2 can onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle the remaining onions on top and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Presto Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in an 8 x 15-inch baking dish. Put the pork chops on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except chips. Pour mixture into 9 x 13-inch dish. Cover and chill overnight. When ready to serve sprinkle top with chips and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with soda. Combine butter sugars pudding mix and vanilla. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour. Mix then stir in chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients together mixing well pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Before serving garnish with Cool Whip and nuts if desired.

title: Holiday Delight
instructions: Grind cranberries in blender or food chopper. Add drained pineapple and sugar. Let stand for 2 hours or overnight. Whip the cream; add Marshmallow Creme and fold in cranberry mixture. Add nuts. Chill.

title: Peanut-Butter Drops
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift flour with soda salt ginger and cloves. Set aside. In a large bowl with wooden spoon or portable electric mixer at medium speed beat shortening peanut butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and milk. Beat until smooth. Stir in flour mixture and peanuts until thoroughly combined. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 1 minute before removing from cookie sheets. Remove to wire rack. Cool.

title: Red Cinnamon Cucumber Pickle
instructions: Drain liquor from oysters and reserve. Pick over oysters for any bits of shell and grit. Melt butter in a heavy 3 to 4-quart saucepan. Add onions and saute until soft about 3 minutes. Add flour stirring constantly until blended. Gradually add milk and cream stirring over low heat until mixture comes to a boil. Stir in salt and cayenne pepper. Add oysters and liquor and simmer over low heat until the oysters just begin to curl at the edges about 4 to 5 minutes. Ladle hot stew into bowls and garnish with chopped parsley. Serves 4.

title: Beer Cheese Soup
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour and blend well. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add hot chicken broth and milk. Mix well until smooth and thick. Add cheese. Mix until all cheese melts and soup is smooth. Add beer. Simmer 15 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Popcorn Trash
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Cook last 4 ingredients to 234\u00b0 or soft ball stage. Pour over popcorn mixture and mix well. As soon as mixture cools enough to work with spread onto 2 to 3 buttered cookie sheets and press out. Bake 1 hour at 200\u00b0. Cool. Break into pieces and store in airtight container.

title: Butterscotch Or Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Crust Mix flour butter and nuts together. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Blossom Tarts
instructions: Mix cream cheese eggs sugar and vanilla and beat for 5 minutes. Use 18 medium size muffin liners. Place vanilla wafer in\tbottom\tof each muffin liner. Fill muffin liner 3/4 full (on top of vanilla wafer). Bake 12 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.\tLet cool and fill with pie filling. Refrigerate.

title: Shrimp And Crabmeat Au Gratin
instructions: Saute celery and onions in butter until wilted. Blend in flour mixing well. Gradually add milk stirring constantly. Add egg yolk salt and black pepper. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Put crabmeat and shrimp in a mixing bowl; pour the cooked sauce over the crab and shrimp and mix well. Transfer half of mixture to lightly-greased 2-quart casserole dish. Top with half the cheese; repeat layers. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Praline Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar oleo and cream; bring to a boil. Boil gently for 3 minutes. Take off heat and add marshmallows. Stir until melted. Add a pinch of salt vanilla pecans and graham crackers. Blend well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Store in a container or Ziploc bag.

title: Durkee Chicken
instructions: Wrap each breast with 1 slice ham and 1 slice Swiss cheese. Combine sour cream mushroom soup and Durkees spread. Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Spread sour cream mixture over chicken. Cover and bake for 2 1/2 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and margarine with beater. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add milk. Crush wafers in a food processor and add to moist mixture. Add coconut and pecans. Grease Bundt pan and spoon mixture into pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Layer pineapple in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Place pear halves over pineapple rings. Melt butter. Add curry powder. Spoon over fruit. Sprinkle brown sugar over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Skillet Cabbage
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tomatoes in large skillet. Cover. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and heat through. Serves 6. Good cold as salad.

title: Christmas Cocktail
instructions: In a juice extractor put in first a few pieces of apple then grapes lemon and then rest of apple. Serve in tumbler. Makes one serving.

title: Pork And Bean Casserole
instructions: Trim the fat from the chops. Season with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in frypan. Add the chops and cook over a low heat until browned on both sides. Remove the chops. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons fat. In remaining fat saute the onions and garlic for five minutes. Stir in mustard chili sauce and beans. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Arrange the chops on top. Cover and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and flour bottoms of 2 (9-inch) layer cake pans. Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside. In large bowl with mixer at high speed beat next 3 ingredients for 3 minutes or until light and fluffy. At low speed beat in real mayonnaise. Add flour mixture in 4 additions alternately with water beginning and ending with flour. Pour into pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove; cool on racks. Frost. Makes 2 (9-inch) layers.

title: Eggplant Delicious
instructions: Peel and boil eggplant until done. Drain and mash with potato masher. Stir in oleo while hot. Season. Stir in eggs milk crackers and onions. Pour into casserole and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Cake(Upside-Down)
instructions: Flour and grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake mix according to directions. Put coconut and nuts in bottom of pan. Pour cake batter over coconut and nuts. Mix cream cheese and butter in saucepan over low heat until blended. Take off heat and add confectioners sugar. Mix until blended. Pour over cake and bake. Makes own icing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mud Squares
instructions: In a large bowl pour boiling water over oats and margarine. Let stand for 10 minutes. Stir in both sugars and add eggs. Combine dry ingredients and add to oat mixture. Stir in 1/2 of the chocolate chips. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining chocolate chips and nuts over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Makes 24 squares. Squares are very moist. Its especially good served with ice cream.

title: Pineapple Cream Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Beat soft cream cheese; add milk and pudding slowly. Spread on cake. Add drained pineapple; top with Cool Whip. Top with nuts (optional). Refrigerate.

title: Scotch Scones
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add other ingredients. Form into balls and pat flat about 1/2-inch thick. Bake slowly at 300\u00b0 about 1 hour until pale tan in color. While warm sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Store in tins. They are better when aged.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce and put in bottom of dish. Layer next 5 items on top of it. Mix sour cream mayonnaise and dressing mix. Pour over top of layers and seal good. Refrigerate at least 8 hours.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Blend all ingredients then stir constantly over low to medium heat until thick. Place in blender with banana sweetener and flavorings. Blend for 1 minute. Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve. Makes 1 serving. One serving equals 1 protein 1 milk and 1 fruit.

title: Cafe Brulot(Spiced Coffee With Brandy)
instructions: In a heat proof punch bowl combine the orange rind lemon rind and sugar. Mash the mixture gently with the back of a spoon. Add cinnamon sticks and cloves; toss into mixture. In a small saucepan combine the brandy and liqueur; heat over low heat until warm. Pour 3/4 of the liquor over the orange lemon sugar mixture; ignite remaining liquor and pour it flaming into the bowl. While still flaming add the coffee gradually. When the flames go out stir the mixture until the sugar is completely dissolved. Ladle into cafe brulot or demitasse cups. Makes about 26 3-ounce servings.

title: Sweet Potato Oven Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Coat baking sheet with vegetable oil spray.

title: Marilyn'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Mash squash. Mix with other ingredients except crumbs and margarine. Put in casserole dish a layer of crumbs a layer of squash mixture. Top with crumbs and dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can be frozen.

title: Cream Pie
instructions: Heat butter or oleo 2 cups milk and sugar. Add cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup milk. Cook do not boil until thick. Pour into baked pie shell and add nutmeg on top. Bake 15 minutes at 370\u00b0.

title: Delicious Broccoli
instructions: Microwave broccoli on High for 5 to 6 minutes stirring once. Drain. Place broccoli in a dish. Sprinkle cheese over broccoli. Dilute soup with milk. Pour over broccoli. Microwave 6 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle onion rings over casserole. Return to oven and microwave for 2 1/2 minutes.

title: Pie Crust Recipe(Makes Top And Bottom Crusts For A 9-Inch Pie)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with a pastry blender in a shallow bowl. Work quickly; dont mix too much! Dough should still be crumbly. Divide into 2 dough balls. Roll out for top and bottom crusts. For best results roll on pastry canvas sprinkled moderately with flour. A cloth sleeve on the rolling pin helps too. Roll outward from the center of the dough ball; roll lightly in all directions. Overworking crust will make it tough instead of flaky.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Pound Cake
instructions: Place cherries in large flutes of greased Bundt pan. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Combine 1/2 cup drained pineapple brown sugar melted butter and 3 tablespoons of pineapple syrup. Spoon into Bundt pan on top of cherries. Prepare pound cake mix according to package directions using pineapple syrup for liquid. Stir in lemon peel vanilla and remaining crushed pineapple. Spoon into pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes. Cool in pan for 5 minutes. Turn out on wire rack or serving plate to complete cooling.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in baking dish (2 1/2 to 3-quart size). Mix dry ingredients. Add beaten egg and milk. Mix gradually. Place fruit in dish in melted oleo or butter. Pour batter over fruit. Bake in 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Cocoa Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Spread on cookies when cool. Top each cookie with a nut.

title: Fruited Eggnog Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder salt and mace. Stir in egg nog butter egg and rum. Stir just until flour is moist. Fold in pecans and mixed candied fruit. Pour into 9 x 5-inch pan or two smaller loaf pans. Spray pans with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Hot Caramel Sauce
instructions: To caramelize sugar place a heavy skillet over low heat. Stir constantly until melted and brown. Place granulated sugar and cream in a double boiler and heat to boiling point. Add caramelized sugar and stir until well blended. Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla. Beat thoroughly. May be reheated over hot water. Store in jar in refrigerator.

title: Chili Bean Casserole
instructions: Spread butter in a 3-quart baking dish. Line the dish with corn chips. In a saucepan combine chili and beans. Heat. Alternate layers of chili beans onions peppers corn chips and cheese. Put layer of cheese last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields approximately 7 to 8 servings.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish the first 5 ingredients. Mix together the mayonnaise and sugar and spread over vegetables. Top with shredded cheese and Bac*Os and refrigerate overnight.

title: Spinach Dip Appetizer
instructions: Drain spinach. Combine all ingredients (except bread) in bowl and mix well. Chill 2 hours. Cut bread into bite size pieces and use for dipping.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Put 60 Ritz crushed crackers mixed with melted butter in 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Mix vanilla instant pudding with milk until thick. Add softened butter pecan ice cream. Add Cool Whip on top. Top with toasted coconut.

title: Creamy Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Rinse well. In medium-size pan boil potatoes until tender; drain. In mixing bowl combine potatoes butter and milk. Blend with mixer until creamy. Add sour cream and cream cheese. Pour ingredients in a Pam-sprayed baking dish. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Barley  Soup
instructions: Brown beef. Add water salt pepper barley and bouillon cubes. Simmer for 30 minutes covered. Add carrots celery onion and tomato sauce. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add frozen lima beans and simmer for another 15 minutes.

title: Frito Surprise
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Add bean dip stirring occasionally. May add a little water if it gets too dry. Let simmer about 15 to 20 minutes. When ready to eat put Fritos on a dinner plate. Pour meat mixture over them then add lettuce tomato and onion on top of meat mixture. Quickie meal. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Antipasto Pasta Salad
instructions: In 4-quart bowl combine artichoke hearts salami olives and Parmesan cheese. Add olive oil lemon juice oregano salt and pepper. Toss well to coat ingredients evenly with dressing. Add Fontina cheese; toss again.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In bowl put 2 eggs beat slightly. Add sugar and mix well. Add syrup and mix well. Add melted margarine and pecans; mix well. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes then turn oven temperature down to 325\u00b0 and bake 30 additional minutes.

title: Squash
instructions: Cook squash until tender; drain. Mash squash and add remaining ingredients. Put mixture in ungreased 1-quart casserole. Bake uncovered 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Lime Salad
instructions: Boil 1 cup water; stir in jello. Add 1/2 cup cold water and lemon juice. Add jello to cream cheese and mix. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in pineapple marshmallows and nuts. Pour into ring mold and chill until firm.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Add boiling water to jello. Stir well. Add cranberries and mix well. Add drained crushed pineapple and pecans. Let set 6 to 8 hours.

title: Mrs. Nancy'S Secret Cheesecake
instructions: Whip cream cheese. Mix in confectioners sugar. Blend in Cool Whip. Spread in pie shells. Top with pie filling.

title: Pastry Shell(9-Inch)
instructions: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl. Cut in shortening and butter until mixture is very coarse. Sprinkle water one tablespoon at a time over flour tossing with fork until mixture cleans sides of bowl. Make a ball. Wrap airtight and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Roll out on floured board. Place in 9-inch pan. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Pickle Roll-Em-Ups
instructions: Spread 1 side of each ham slice with 1 tablespoon cream cheese. Place 1 pickle on edge of each ham slice. Roll ham slice around pickle; press edges to seal. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. To serve cut each pickle into 6 slices. Makes 48 appetizers.

title: Strawberry And Banana Dessert
instructions: Add sugar to sweeten fresh berries. Slice bananas; pour lemon juice over to keep from darkening. Then add all together. Refrigerate for later. Use strawberry glaze if desired.

title: California Gazpacho
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl stirring well. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight. Ladle into soup bowls. Yields 6 cups (53 calories per 1-cup serving).

title: Paris Breakfast
instructions: Melt butter in 10-inch glass pie pan in 400\u00b0 oven. Mix next 6 ingredients and pour into pie plate. Bake for 15 minutes. Dust with confectioners sugar. Serve with syrup or jam.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; saute onions over medium heat until clear. Reserve 3 tablespoons of cracker crumbs for topping and place remaining crumbs in bottom of lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish. Remove onions from pan with slotted spoon. Add soup and onions alternating layers. Combine eggs and milk; pour over onions. Top with cheese and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Ammonia Cookies(German Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together until well blended. Combine flour baking powder soda and powdered ammonia; mix in the egg mixture. Chill at least 2 hours or overnight. Roll out and cut with cookie cutter. Place on cookie sheets and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown. Makes 7 to 8 dozen.

title: Crab Soup Supreme
instructions: Mix the crab and gumbo soup and cream together. Heat thoroughly; do not boil. Sprinkle with chopped chives and serve. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Cake And Frosting
instructions: Cream Crisco and 1 1/2 cups sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Add flour and milk. Mix well. Pour into 3 well-greased and floured pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown. Melt 1 1/3 cups butter. Add sugar and cocoa. Mix well. Add dash of salt and milk. Mix. Cook in saucepan 5 minutes after it comes to rapid boil. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Ice cake.

title: Salsa Chicken
instructions: Combine salsa currants water honey cinnamon and cumin and mix. Heat oil in skillet. Cook almonds for 1 to 2 minutes. Set aside. Add garlic. Cook for a minute or less and then add chicken cooking until browned on both sides. Add the salsa mixture to the chicken. Reduce heat and put on cover. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until chicken is done. Add almonds and stir. Serve with rice or couscous. Serves 4.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Saute meat and onion until tender. Drain excess fat. In a small saucepan boil cut up celery until tender. Drain well. In large skillet add all ingredients. Stir well. Add Open Pit sauce to your liking. Simmer until done.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: About 3 1/2 hours before coat meat with flour. Pound with saucer. In hot salad oil brown meat on both sides in 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions etc. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 3 hours turning once. Serve over hot noodles rice or potatoes.

title: Parmesan Pork Chops With Apples
instructions: Combine egg and milk; set aside. Combine flour and Parmesan cheese; set aside. Dip pork chops into egg mixture and sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper; dredge in flour mixture. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat; add pork chops and brown on both sides. Transfer to a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; top with cooked apples. Cover with aluminum foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Buttermilk Fudge
instructions: Place in large boiler and mix well. Cook to soft ball stage and add vanilla and nuts. Beat until thick and pour in greased pan.

title: Green Beans Creole
instructions: Steam green beans over water for 5 minutes until just tender or cook frozen beans as package directs. Combine the cooked beans with remaining ingredients in a large saucepan. Heat over medium heat for about 15 minutes or until all vegetables are tender.

title: Maggie'S Strawberry Jello Cake
instructions: Dissolve Jello in 1/2 cup of water. Mix with cake mix and Wesson oil. Add eggs one at a time.

title: Apple Matzo Farfel Kugel *
instructions: Soak matzo in water. Drain. Beat eggs with salt sugar butter and cinnamon. Add to matzo. Stir in nuts apples and raisins. Put in greased Pyrex pan.* Dot with butter. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 until golden. Yield 6 servings.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Blend all ingredients and put in a 13 x 8-inch dish; freeze for later use. Or prepare in a large bowl and refrigerate for a few hours before serving.

title: Deep Sea Chowder
instructions: Combine and heat slowly until soup is thawed. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally.

title: Rib And Brisket Rub
instructions: This is a general base and tastes great. Feel free to add garlic and/or onion salt and any other spices you prefer.

title: Hot And Spicy Dip
instructions: Brown beef and sausage with onion. Melt cheese. Add mushrooms and soup. After cheese has melted pour cheese mixture over browned meat. Add garlic powder. Serve hot.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix together well. Bake at 400\u00b0 in muffin tins. Unbaked batter will keep in refrigerator for about 3 weeks.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Scrub potatoes; boil in skins until done. Then peel and cut into slices or cubes. Add onion apple peas and pickles; mix oil vinegar water salt pepper sugar and parsley well. Pour over warm potatoes. Serve warm or chill for 1 hour and serve cold. Substitute with bacon fat from 4 slices of bacon. Crumble bacon and add to salad. Serves 4.

title: Salmon Burgers
instructions: Flake salmon with a fork; combine with the next 5 ingredients. Add 1 to 2 tablespoons reserved liquid stirring until mixture sticks together. Shape into 6 patties and cook over medium heat in a sprayed skillet approximately 4 minutes on each side.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Prepare lasagna according to package directions; drain. In saucepan heat oil. Saute onion garlic and mushrooms. Stir in spaghetti sauce; simmer 15 minutes. In bowl combine Ricotta spinach 1/2 cup Mozzarella Parmesan and\tegg; mix well. In 12 x 12-inch baking dish layer 1 cup sauce half the lasagna noodles half the remaining sauce\tall of the spinach mixture half of the remaining Mozzarella\tand the remaining noodles and sauce. Cover. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Uncover; top with remaining Mozzarella and parsley. Bake 15 minutes longer. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Bran And Molasses Muffins
instructions: Combine all-bran milk and molasses. Let stand until most of the moisture is taken up. Add egg and shortening; beat well. Stir in raisins. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add to all-bran mixture stirring only until combined. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes. (Yield 12 muffins 2 1/2-inches in diameter.)

title: Quick Cream Of Wheat Cornbread
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Quiche(One Dish Breakfast)
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in blender few seconds. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle bacon and sausage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until knife comes out clean. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Dill Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend together\tall ingredients. Chill several hours. Serve with raw vegetables. Yields 4 1/2 cups.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top. Sprinkle bacon bits on top of cheese. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 2 hours at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Cabbage Baked With Cheese
instructions: Boil salt and cabbage for 10 minutes; drain well. Mix milk oleo cheese and flour; cook until butter and cheese is melted stirring often. Pour over cabbage and bake 15 to 30 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Fix soup according to directions. In a casserole dish layer ground beef frozen Tater Tots cheese and soup. Keep layering until you end up with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and cheese is melted.

title: West Indies Salad
instructions: Spread half of the onion over bottom of large bowl. Cover with separated crab lumps and then remaining onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour oil vinegar and ice water over all. Sprinkle sugar on top. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours. Toss lightly before serving.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add strawberries and stir to thaw. Add pineapple and bananas. Pour half the mixture into 6 cup mold. When set blend sour cream into remaining room temperature Jell-O mixture and pour into mold. Refrigerate overnight or until firmly set.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together well; form into ball and chill 1/2 hour. Roll in chopped nuts.

title: Basic Bread Pudding
instructions: Spread bread cubes evenly in 8-inch round dish. Sprinkle evenly with brown sugar nutmeg salt then raisins. Measure milk into 1-quart measuring cup. Add butter. Microwave at High for 4 minutes until butter is melted and milk is warm. Rapidly stir in eggs with a fork and mix well. Pour over bread cubes in dish. Microwave a Medium-high for 9 to 12 minutes. When cooked center may still be slightly soft but it will set up as pudding cools. Serve warm or chilled. Makes 6 servings.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Follow directions for cake mix making 2 cake layers from each box; let cakes cool. In a large deep pan or plate you start by taking the first cake layer and set it on pan or plate. Pour 1/4 cup Kahlua over cake then cover with 1/2 of the first container of Cool Whip. Sprinkle some of the crushed Skor bars over top. Repeat this until all 4 layers are completed. Chill and serve.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients in large mixer bowl. Beat for 4 minutes at medium speed. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add 1 cup boiling water. While this mixture is cooling add together yeast and lukewarm water. Beat eggs slightly and add. Add yeast to cooled creamed mixture then add flour and salt. (Add only 2 cups of flour at a time). Mix well. Spray large bowl with Pam. Pour dough into bowl and cover. (This mixture will be very sticky.) Put in refrigerator overnight. Let raise 2 hours before baking in muffin tins. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Brush with butter when done.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Combine hamburger and soups. Heat together in skillet. Then put in casserole dish and completely cover with American cheese slices. Then completely cover with a layer of Tater Tots. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until Tater Tots are done.

title: Ranch Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand in refrigerator 12 to 24 hours.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Crush crackers real fine. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with crackers. Add baking powder and nuts. Add 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla to egg whites. Mix together. Pour into a well buttered pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Put a small carton of whipped cream on top then chill.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until done. Mash with fork and cool. Take large marshmallows and around each press the mashed potatoes. Use just enough to cover the marshmallow completely. Dip in melted butter and roll in graham cracker crumbs. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. The balls will crack slightly when done.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Make School Roll Dough or use any yeast bread dough. Roll out in rectangular shape (approximately 8 x 11 inches). Put 1/2 of ham slices and 1/2 of cheese slices along middle of dough leaving an inch on each end uncovered. Sprinkle with seasoning; fold one side of dough over ham and cheese. Repeat ham and cheese layer on top of fold using remainder of ham and cheese. Sprinkle this layer with the Italian seasoning. Leave 1 inch on each end to seal. Fold dough over; seal all edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Grandpa Dick'S Peanut Butter Popcorn
instructions: Melt the butter over low heat and mix in peanut butter. Then use a big spoon to drizzle it over the popcorn.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Cream together oil and sugar; add beaten eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients of flour and spices to mixture alternating with buttermilk. Fold in prunes and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in tube pan. Ice with Buttermilk Frosting. Good when stored for a few days wrapped or sealed in cake taker.

title: Pecan Bars
instructions: In a large bowl combine oats flour 1 cup dark brown sugar. Cut 1/2 cup butter into mixture till coarse and crumbly. Press into a 13x9-inch baking pan. Place pecans evenly over crumb mixture.

title: Barbecue Sauce(Makes 1 Quart)
instructions: Mix until blended well. Good on pork chicken and beef. Also if you like onions chop 1/4 cup fine and add to sauce. If you add onions cook until onions are tender.

title: Quick Leathers
