instructions: In blender or processor blend until smooth. Pour into bowl and microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes until reduced by half. Lay a piece of micro-wrap on a plate. Evenly spread 1/4 cup fruit mixture to a 6 1/2 inch circle. Make sure edges arent too thin. Elevate plate on top of inverted saucer. Microwave 5 minutes until no longer sticky in center. Carefully place plastic wrap with leather on wire rack. Let cool and repeat with remaining mixture.

title: Red Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans well. Mix all ingredients well scraping bowl thoroughly. Chill for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Mexican Pecan Candy
instructions: Combine sugar milk and soda in large heavy saucepan; cook until a few drops form a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Stir as little as possible. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in pecan halves. Sprinkle salt onto waxed paper. Quickly drop pecan mixture by spoonfuls onto paper to form patties. Cool. Store in covered container.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies(No Bake)
instructions: Place sugar cocoa butter and milk in saucepan and boil for 2 minutes. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla. Then pour into oatmeal which has been placed in a large bowl. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Avocado And Cucumber Salad
instructions: Prepare jello with cream cheese. Let jello mixture cool and beat together until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Put in a ring mold and serve with mayonnaise in center of ring or use individual molds and top with mayonnaise.

title: Sugar Pie
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add well beaten egg and flour; beat well. Add milk and vanilla. Pour into 6-inch unbaked shell. Bake in slow oven until knife comes out clean.

title: Extra Easy Lasagna
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. In 10-inch skillet over medium heat cook beef until brown stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Add spaghetti sauce; heat through stirring occasionally.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg milk dry ingredients and vanilla. Work so you can handle by adding 3 or 4 cups flour. Roll on a board 1/4 inch thick. Cut and bake on greased baking sheet for about 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Pound chicken breasts until 1/4 inch thick. Mix bread crumbs and parmesan cheese together in a shallow pan or bowl. Melt butter in fry pay over medium heat. Dip chicken pieces in egg then in bread crumbs mixture and fry in butter about 5 minutes per side or until done. Remove from pan. Serves 4.

title: Pineapple Cheese Cake
instructions: Whip the first 4 ingredients until smooth then add 1 small can crushed pineapple. Bake in graham cracker crust 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool until glaze forms on top.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare stuffing according to directions only using 1 tablespoon margarine. Set aside. Saute chicken cubes in pan sprayed with Pam until no longer pink. Add soups and milk. Pour into a sprayed 9 x 13 pan and sprinkle with poultry seasoning. Top with prepared stuffing and bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small saucepan. Cook over low heat 5 minutes. Stir in carrots and chill.

title: Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into buttered baking dish. Cover and let set in refrigerator overnight (until it is a mush). Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Thaw a loaf of frozen bread and roll out on floured surface into a large triangle. Spread with mustard and put the baked ham Provolone cheese salami and Mozzarella cheese down the center of the dough. Fold sides and pinch. Brush top with melted butter and sprinkle with oregano.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Add other ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. Freeze.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add other ingredients. Mix well.

title: Hot Crab Dip(Tasty . . . Fast!)
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients until well blended. Turn into 1 1/2-pint baking dish. Bake uncovered in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Stir often. Serve warm with crackers. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Garden Citrus Salad
instructions: Prepare salad dressing mix with vinegar water and oil as directed on envelope. Mix greens oranges onion and pecans in large salad bowl. Add dressing; toss well.

title: Apple Bars
instructions: Cream oil sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Blend well. Add apples and nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Place zucchini slices in bottom of 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole. Combine all other ingredients except cheese; mix and pour over zucchini. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and sugar in large mixing bowl. Add vegetable oil and next 4 ingredients. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 6 minutes. Stir in poppy seed. Pour batter into a 10 count Bundt pan sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan and drizzle with lemon glaze.

title: No Sugar Strawberry Pie
instructions: Slice strawberries. Sprinkle with NutraSweet. Mix cornstarch and water in saucepan. Bring to boil and cook until thickened. Add gelatin. Combine mixture and strawberries. Pour into pie crust. Chill at least 3 hours with whipped cream.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together; put in loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Put catsup on top.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix fruit with 2 cups water and freeze overnight; Bundt pan works best.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Mix ground beef onion pepper and milk together. Cook rice and mix with ground beef. Take cooked cabbage leaf by leaf and roll with ground beef inside. Place into baking pan and pour tomato soup over. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ice Cream Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Prepare muffin pan or use liners. Fill 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Serve hot with butter jelly or honey.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Layer Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Let cool then split both layers (can make 3 layers). Combine sugar sour cream (reserve 1 cup sour cream for frosting) and coconut. Blend well. Chill. Spread between layers. Combine reserved sour cream with whipped topping. Blend until smooth. Spread on top and sides of cake. Seal cake in airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days before serving.

title: Corned Beef Dip
instructions: Slice corned beef into tiny pieces. Mix all ingredients together. Chill overnight. Best served with squares of rye bread.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
instructions: Place corn in a 1 1/2-quart glass jar. Remove seed portions of tomato; dice and add to corn. Cover with Italian dressing and marinate 12 to 24 hours in refrigerator turning jar occasionally to be sure all vegetables are covered. Drain before serving. Diced bell pepper and/or chopped green onions may be added for color and/or flavor. Whole kernel yellow corn may also be added for color.

title: Sue'S Biscuits
instructions: Pour in milk oil salt baking powder and sugar; mix well. Add flour. Add more flour if needed. Flour hands take 1 tablespoon dough and knead in hand until not sticky; place in pan. Pour 1 tablespoon plus oil in baking dish. Turn biscuits in oil in pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes approximately 10 biscuits. Delicious.

title: Coconut Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan top with chili cover chili with cheese. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted (and hot).

title: Corn Loaf
instructions: In large bowl mix together corn tomatoes onions green peppers salt pepper corn meal and cheese. Let mixture set 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Hot Mustard
instructions: Mix dry mustard and vinegar in glass bowl and let stand overnight. Next day beat eggs with sugar. Blend all. Cook in a double boiler 10 to 12 minutes. Seal in sterilized jars.

title: Lo-Cal Apple Pie
instructions: Place egg yolks Sucaryl and next 4 ingredients in blender and blend 2 seconds. Add apples. Blend until fine. Pour into buttered pie plate. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Add remaining ingredients and process along with 1 teaspoon Sucaryl. Put meringue on pie spreading to edges. Brown at 350\u00b0 until golden brown about 10 minutes. Serves 6 155 calories per serving.

title: Marinated Slaw
instructions: Bring all ingredients except cabbage and onions to a rolling boil. Mix 1 cup salad oil into this. Pour over cabbage and onions and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cube Steak With Gravy In Crock-Pot
instructions: Dip steak in flour; fry until brown. Place in crock-pot. Add water soup and gravy mix. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. Serve hot over rice.

title: Potato Topped Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef onions and bell pepper. Drain. Add soup salt and pepper. Pour into casserole dish. Top with potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When making creamed potatoes add a teaspoon of mayonnaise.

title: Pecan Pie Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans with mixer. Fold in pecans. Pour on greased and floured sheet cake pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Baked Beans For A Crowd(Recipe Can Be Halved Easily!)
instructions: Combine brown sugar and dry mustard. In large enamel roaster put half of the pork and beans. Sprinkle half of the sugar-mustard mixture and 1 tablespoon of the onion on the beans. Repeat steps. Place bacon pieces over second layer. Pour ketchup over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Stir gently before serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Add baking soda to buttermilk. Mix eggs bananas sugar milk an shortening. Add dry ingredients. Mix together and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Grease and flour pan.

title: Oven-Baked Curry Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine curry powder cinnamon cayenne salt and flour in a plastic bag. Add chicken and shake well to coat. Put chicken on baking sheet and spray with cooking oil. Bake 20 minutes. Turn the chicken over and continue baking until golden brown about 15 minutes longer.

title: Sour Cream Apple Squares
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar and butter or oleo as crumbs. Measure 2 3/4 cups into 10 x 15-inch pan (ungreased). To rest of crumbs add the rest of ingredients. Stir in apples. Spread over crumb base. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Serve with ice cream whipped cream or sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Use casserole dish large enough for amount desired. Put margarine in dish then layer potatoes onion and pork chops on top so that they will brown. Salt and pepper ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chunky Chewy Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl combine all ingredients. Beat 50 strokes by hand. Spread in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool completely; cut into bars. Makes 24 bars.

title: Slow Cooked Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut beef into 3 inch x 1 inch strips; brown in oil in a skillet. Transfer to a slow cooker. Combine the next seven ingredients pouf over beef. Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hr or until meat is tender. Add tomatoes and green peppers; cook on low 1 hr longer. Combine the cold water and cornstarch to make a paste; cook on high until thickened. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Chestnut Chicken Casserole
instructions: Line a 3-quart casserole dish with 3 cups of cooked broccoli. Mix remaining ingredients and spread on top of broccoli. Top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes and drizzle with 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes in preheated oven.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening sugar and salt. Beat in egg until very light. Add baking soda to sour milk and stir into egg mixture alternating with flour. Fold in rhubarb and candy sprinkles. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with topping. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Ice Cream Float
instructions: First get a tall glass. Take scoops of ice cream and put in the glass. Pour beverage over ice cream until glass is full.

title: Violet'S Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients but meat. Mix well. Pour half in an 8-inch iron skillet that has been heated in the oven with oil. Then put on layer of meat layer of cheese and then remaining mix. Bake 30 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions. Rinse in cold water and chill. Mix all other ingredients and thin with 1 tablespoon pickle juice if necessary. Chill until served.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix flour and soda. Combine eggs mincemeat condensed milk fruit and nuts. Fold in dry ingredients. Bake in tube pan (greased and lined with wax paper) at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. (I have baked this in 2 loaf pans.) Decorate top with cherries and nuts. Freezes well.

title: Banana Squares
instructions: In large bowl of an electric mixer beat butter and sugar until creamy; beat in egg vanilla and banana. In another bowl stir together flour baking powder and salt; gradually add to butter mixture blending thoroughly. Stir in butterscotch chips. Spread batter evenly in a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool in pan on a rack then cut into 16 squares. Store in refrigerator.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Place in covered container. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Venison Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in milk then add eggs. Mix then add venison onion tomato juice and salt and pepper. Shape into loaf. Place in baking dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Tacoritas
instructions: Brown beef and add taco seasoning according to directions on package. Place flour tortillas in baking dish and fill with 2 heaping tablespoons ground beef mixture. Add lettuce tomato and onions. Fold over and close with toothpicks.\tHeat enchilada sauce and Velveeta cheese. Pour over the tortillas and top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with picante.

title: Easy Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Put ingredients into blender and blend for 3 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown approximately 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Place Velveeta cheese in between 2 sheets of Saran Wrap. Roll Velveeta with a rolling pin into a circle or oval 1/4-inch thick. Remove top piece of Saran Wrap. Spread cream cheese on top of Velveeta. Sprinkle pecans pimentos green onions and green pepper on top of cheeses. Roll into a log and place seam down on platter. May be prepared with light cream cheese and Velveeta for less fat.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water (save 1/4 cup of dissolved jello). Add frozen strawberries pineapple and bananas. Put in refrigerator to congeal. When congealed mix cream cheese confectioners sugar vanilla and reserved jello. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread this mixture over congealed jello. Sprinkle with nuts if desired.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine beans milk soup pepper and half of onions. Pour in casserole and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Cream of chicken soup may also be used.

title: Apples And Carrot Dish
instructions: Drain 1/2 juice from carrots. Mix apple filling and carrots. Put in a baking dish sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake about an hour in 350 degree oven.

title: Microwave Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions and drain. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish and set aside.

title: Amy Weaver'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly; add milk and beaten egg yolks (reserve egg whites for meringue); mix well. Cook in a double boiler to the desired thickness. Add vanilla. Pour into a ready baked crust. Cover with meringue and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Eggs For A Crowd
instructions: Blend milk eggs and spices. Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer 7 to 8 slices of bread. Cover with half of cheese and half the egg mixture. Repeat using balance of ingredients. Refrigerate overnight or all day. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let set a few minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Manhattan Clam Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan cook and stir bacon and onion until bacon is crisp and onion is tender. Stir in reserved clam liquor the potatoes water and celery. Cook uncovered until potatoes are tender about 10 minutes. Add clams tomatoes and seasonings. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Place cheeses in small mixing bowl; let stand at room temperature until softened. Add onion and Worcestershire sauce; blend on low speed. Beat on medium speed until fluffy scraping sides and bottom. Cover and chill for 8 hours.

title: Twice-Baked Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes with jackets. Cool peel and grate. Mix everything but 1 cup cheese in a cake pan. Sprinkle remaining cup of cheese over casserole and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 min. to an hour or until cheese on top is bubbly and casserole is hot completely through. Serves 6.

title: California Rice And Chilies
instructions: Cook rice. Brown onion in butter until transparent. Add cooked rice sour cream green chilies salt and pepper. Grease a large 2 1/2-quart casserole or baking dish and layer one-half of rice mixture 1/2 cottage cheese 1/2 Cheddar cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can be made ahead and frozen.

title: Zucchini Hot Dish
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion in water for 5 to 10 minutes. Drain. Place 1/2 package herb stuffing in bottom of greased 12 x 9-inch baking pan. Cover with zucchini and onion mixture. Combine grated carrots soup mixes and melted butter. Spread over top. Cover with sour cream. Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Fabulous Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Serve with fresh fruit. Yield 2 cups.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Separate white of eggs in small bowl. Mix egg yolk butter and sugar together. Add dry ingredients; beat. Then add milk and coconut. Beat white of eggs until stiff; fold into cake mix. Pour in two 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Burger Bundles
instructions: Prepare stuffing mix according to instructions. Combine beef and milk. Salt and pepper to taste. Make patties and hollow out center. Fill with stuffing. Be sure stuffing is covered with beef to make bundle. Place in greased cake pans etc. Heat soup catsup and Worcestershire sauce until bubbly. Pour over bundles. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Rolls
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Add sugar and continue beating for several minutes. Add lemon juice. Stir in flour mixture warm milk and vanilla. Mix until batter is smooth. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold carefully. Pour onto greased 11 x 15-inch pan lined with waxed paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Quickly turn upside-down on dishtowel sprinkled with confectioners sugar. Pull off paper. Roll up folding in long side using towel to keep rolled. Let cool. Unroll and spread with lemon pie filling or your favorite jelly. Reroll and sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

title: Mexican Burrito Pie
instructions: Combine beans Bisquick and water in bowl; mix well. Spoon mixture into greased 9-inch pie plate; form shell. Cook beef until brown. Drain; spoon over bean mixture and top with sauce. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 minutes. Cut into wedges. Top with sour cream and serve. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Macaroni 'N Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni; toss with oil. Add all other ingredients. Pour into lightly greased crock-pot; stir. Cover and cook for 3 to 4 hours on low.

title: Microwave Garden Corn Soup
instructions: Combine onion green pepper garlic and oil in a 3-quart casserole. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and vent. Microwave at High 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp and tender. Drain vegetables and pat dry with paper towel. Wipe drippings from casserole with paper towel. Return onion mixture to casserole. Add corn water tomatoes bouillon marjoram thyme mustard and pepper.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Saute onion chilies garlic carrots celery and chicken in butter till vegetables are tender.\tAdd cumin chili powder salt lemon pepper and flour. Then add chicken broth tomatoes and tabasco to taste. Bring to a boil and simmer for one hour. Serve with Tortilla Chips. Serves 8.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat sugar and eggs together. Add syrup margarine and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in nuts. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix together. Top with 1 package slivered almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with corn chips.

title: White Potato Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into 8-inch pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tai Pork
instructions: In large heavy skillet pour 1/2 cup oil. While oil is heating season pork chops. Coat on both sides with crushed garlic. Brown pork chops on both sides; drain. Serve with rice and favorite stir-fry vegetables.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each individual biscuit into four pieces. Shake sugar and 2 teaspoons of the cinnamon in bag. Bring margarine brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon to boil.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Grease baking dish. Put in first 3 ingredients. Sprinkle oatmeal on top. Mix sugar flour and oleo together. Sprinkle over top and bake until apples are tender.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: In a greased 13 x 9 baking pan arrange rhubarb. In a mixing bowl combine sugar and gelatin; sprinkle over rhubarb. Then sprinkle the dry cake mix over the gelatin mixture. Pour hot water over cake mix but do not stir. Top with coconut and almonds; drizzle with butter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Spoon small amounts on pan. Press with fork. Bake at 350 degrees. Cook 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Beat eggs add oil then cake mix and Jello. Beat well then add strawberries and beat well. Bake at 325 degrees until done. Bake in 3 layers.

title: Zucchini Bread(Makes Two Loaves)
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Add zucchini then add flour sifted with salt baking powder and cinnamon. Add 1 cup nuts (more or less). Bake in two greased and floured loaf pans for 1 hour or until done at 350 degrees. If using glass pans reduce oven temperature to 325 degrees.

title: Croquettes
instructions: Saute onion in the olive oil on medium heat until onion is transparent. Add flour to the saute and gradually add milk stirring constantly. When the ingredients are blended together to a smooth and creamy consistency add the diced meat salt and pepper. Continue to stir constantly until the mixture begins to boil. Cook for about 3 or 4 minutes more. The mixture should separate easily from the skillet. Then pour into a shallow pan or platter and allow to cool for several hours. You can refrigerate the mixture since the cooler it is the easier it is to handle. When the mixture has cooled spoon small amounts and roll into bite size croquettes. Then bread the croquettes using bread crumbs eggs and bread crumbs again and fry to a golden brown.

title: Hamburger-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown and loosely drain hamburger. Add soup and Cheez Whiz; blend with water. Add dry uncooked noodles and diced onion rings. Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Pillows
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and melt over hot water and remove from stove. Place shedded wheat on fork and dip in chocolate mixture and place on waxed paper. Cool 1/2 hour.

title: Ambrosia Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in large bowl; beat 2 minutes. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. After cake has cooled cover with topping.

title: Canadian Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs milk sugar and vanilla together and pour over bread (broken into pieces). Soak about even not too much. Spread with nutmeg. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Wash broccoli thoroughly and cut tops into bite sized florets (save stems for another use). Combine with Swiss cheese and green onions. Stir together mayonnaise sugar and vinegar and add to broccoli mixture. Let marinate overnight or up to several days in refrigerator. Just before serving toss with bacon. Sprinkle some on top. Serves 6.

title: Swiss Chicken Pie
instructions: In bowl stir together soup and milk. Fold in remaining ingredients (except pastry). Spoon into ungreased 2-quart rectangular baking dish. Roll out pastry to 1/8-inch in thickness. Cut into 3/4-inch strips. Twist strips about 4 times each and arrange in a crisscross pattern over ingredients in dish. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until pie is bubbly and pastry is golden brown.

title: Cheese Knots(Tastes Like Soft Pretzels)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix together Chex crushed cheese and butter. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits. Cut each in half. Press each half in crumb mixture to coat both sides. With hands roll each piece to form an 8-inch stick (crumbs will work into dough). Gently tie to form a knot. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until light brown. Serve immediately. Makes 20 servings.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat onion and bell pepper. Add tomato sauce Ro-Tel tomatoes Mexicorn salt and noodles. Cover with cheese and bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Party Chicken Salad
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice and salt and chill for several hours. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries and sugar; mix thoroughly to dissolve sugar. Sprinkle gelatin over pineapple juice to soften. Place over medium heat; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add to cranberry mixture; mix well. Stir in fruits; fold in sour cream and Cool Whip.

title: Crab Chowder
instructions: In a large pot about a 3-quart size combine potatoes onion water and salt. Bring to a boil. Keep covered about 10 minutes. Add milk crabmeat corn parsley and other seasonings. Cook over low heat until piping hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Strawberry & Banana Stuffed French Toast
instructions: Cut french bread into eight 1 1/2-inch slices. Make a pocket in each slice by cutting a slit from top of bread to bottom. Combine jam cream cheese strawberries and banana in a small bowl to make filling. Place heaping Tbsp. of filling into each pocket. Press back together.

title: Potato-Beef Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Brown beef and add salt and pepper to taste. Chop onion and add to beef 1/2 way through browning. Slice potatoes. Dissolve bouillon cubes in one cup water in microwave (approximately 1 minute or until dissolved). Layer in a 2-quart casserole a layer of potatoes half of beef another layer of potatoes half of beef and another layer of potatoes. Pour bouillon mix over meat and potatoes. Cover and microwave on High for 15 minutes or until potatoes are soft.

title: Love Cake
instructions: Make topping first so it can cool

title: Sawdust Cake
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers; mix with melted margarine. Hold out one cup of crumbs. Press the rest of the crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix partially melted ice cream with the Cool Whip and pour over crust; drizzle topping over top and cover with remaining crumbs. Freeze overnight.

title: Meringue Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites with salt and cream of tartar until frothy. Gradually add sugar while beating and continue beating until mixture gets very stiff and holds shape. Add vanilla. Fold in chocolate and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on foil covered cookie pan. Turn oven on for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Turn off oven after 30 minutes and place cookies in oven. Leave in cooling oven for 5 hours or overnight. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach; squeeze dry. Cook onion and margarine. Stir in spinach; cover and cook 5 minutes. Add salt milk and margarine. Slowly add eggs while stirring. Blend in bread crumbs and cheese. Place spinach mixture in mold which has been lined with waxed paper. Top with a few crumbs. Bake about 60 minutes at 325\u00b0. If desired serve topped with tiny cocktail tomatoes.

title: Gala'S Goulash
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic powder. Drain well. Add soup and cheese. Continue cooking over low heat on stove stirring until cheese melts. Add cinnamon and beans. Coat warm macaroni with margarine. Serve meat sauce over macaroni. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Old-Fashioned Chicken Main Soup Dish
instructions: In large pan combine ingredients. Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until done. Stir often. Makes 7 cups.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except for melted chocolate) well. Press out on large cookie sheet or in large pan. Let set until hard. Ice with melted chocolate and let stand about 15 more minutes before cutting.

title: Beef Ragout In Squash
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Cut squash in half and remove seeds. Place cut side down in shallow baking pan. Pour in 1-inch water. Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Wilderness Ice Cream
instructions: You will also need 8 small clean baby food jars with lids 8 (1 pound) coffee cans with the plastic lids paper towels chipped ice and ice cream salt. (You may use regular table salt.)

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Work together and make into small balls rolling between palms of hands. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: 24 Hour Cole Slaw
instructions: Boil vinegar salt mustard celery and oil for 3 minutes. Pour over shredded cabbage onion and bell pepper. Sprinkle sugar over all and mix. Put in an airtight container in fridge for 24 hours.

title: Dip In Hawaiian Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Hollow out bread and place mixture in bread loaf. Use bread pieces for dipping.

title: Eliza'S Fried Apple Pies
instructions: In a medium bowl mix all ingredients as for biscuits. Turn out on a floured surface mixing in additional flour to rolling consistency. Pinch off enough dough about walnut size; roll dough very thin. Spread half the surface with 2 tablespoons dried apple filling; fold over and seal edges by pressing with fork. Fry in small amount of solid shortening until golden brown on both sides.

title: Cinnamon Cream Cheese Roll Up
instructions: Mix cream cheese egg yolk and 1/4 cup of sugar until creamy. Trim crust from bread and roll each slice with a rolling pin to flatten. Spread each slice with cream cheese mixture and roll like a jelly roll. Melt butter. Mix together remaining sugar and all the cinnamon. Dip each bread roll in melted butter and then roll in cinnamon/sugar mixture. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes.

title: Trout With Lemon Stuffing
instructions: Place trout in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. In small bowl combine crumbs onion pepper mushrooms salt and pepper. Spread over fish; top with lemon slices. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High 5 to 7 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Let stand 3 to 5 minutes. Contains 133 calories per serving.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
instructions: Peel put and mash avocados in a medium bowl with lemon juice salt and\tpepper. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco mix in\tbowl.

title: Ruby'S Cooking Oil Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Add oil and mix with a fork. Sprinkle water over mixture and mix one tablespoon at a time. Shape into a ball and place between two sheets of wax paper and roll out.

title: Pizza Rolls
instructions: Roll out crescent rolls. Put pepperoni on each triangle. On top of pepperoni put the cheese. Roll up starting at bottom. Seal the sides together. Slice. Put on greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Mayonnaise Cupcakes
instructions: Combine raisins nuts and baking soda in boiling water. Allow to cool. Add flour sugar mayonnaise and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into cupcake pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Betty'S Glazed Ham
instructions: Bake ham in 3 cups water for 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Take ham out of water.

title: Meat And Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute in skillet beef onion and celery until tender; drain. Add water tomato paste salt and paprika. Reserve 1 cup for biscuits. Add beans to largest portion of meat mixture and simmer while you prepare biscuit dough.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown onions with garlic salt in oil. Add rest of ingredients (except hamburger). Simmer sauce for 2 hours. Brown hamburger; drain and add to sauce and simmer 1 more hour.

title: Jello Jigglers
instructions: Microwave water 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in Jell-O and 1 1/2 cups mini marshmallows. Microwave 30 to 45 seconds. Stir until melted. Spray an 8 x 8 or 9 x 9-inch pan with Pam lightly. Pour into pan. Refrigerate 45 minutes. Roll into log and cut.

title: Spaghetti And Ground Beef
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup of water into skillet; add onion and cook until tender. Add ground beef. Stir until ground beef is browned. Drain excess grease from skillet. Add margarine and stir until melted. Add tomato paste or sauce and salt and pepper. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook spaghetti per box instructions. Rinse spaghetti under cold water to separate spaghetti and put in large bowl. Pour ground beef mixture onto spaghetti and mix well. Serves 4 to 6. Serve with green beans buttered potatoes and barbecue bread.

title: Asparagus-English Pea Casserole
instructions: Place asparagus and peas in an 8 x 8-inch buttered dish. Add soup; layer almonds on top. Sprinkle cheese then cracker crumbs. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix Sugar Cinnamon Nutmeg Flour and Lemon Juice in mixing bowl. Mix in sliced Apples then place in bottom Pie crust. Place top crust over mix making sure to seal the edges. Poke holes in crust with fork. Sprinkle water on top of crust and top with dabble of sugar. Bake in oven at 400 degrees or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Jewish Apple Cake(From 1975 Edition)
instructions: Grease and flour a 9-inch tube pan. Slice apples and in separate bowl mix 4 teaspoons sugar and the cinnamon.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Mix orange Jell-O and boiling water; chill. Add remaining ingredients. Save some of the coconut to sprinkle on top. Pour in a large flat container. Chill overnight.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar; add flour salt and vanilla. Stir in eggs and buttermilk until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie crust and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Parmesan Chicken With Mozzarella
instructions: Mix bread crumbs Parmesan cheese oregano salt and pepper and set aside. In a hot skillet add some butter and saute garlic. Next melt remaining butter. Now roll each piece chicken in butter then roll in mixture. Put in 13 x 9 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Just at done place 2 slices Mozzarella cheese on each chicken breast; put back in oven until it melts.

title: Dilled Pot Roast
instructions: In a large skillet brown roast in hot oil. Place roast in a 3 1/2 to 4 qt. electric crockery cooker cutting if necessary to fit. Add the water to cooker. Sprinkle roast with 2 tsp. of the fresh dill weed or 3/4 tsp. dried dill weed salt and pepper. Cover and cook on high heat setting for 5 to 6 hours or on low heat setting for 10 to 12 hours until meat is tender. Remove roast from cooker reserving liquid; cover roast and keep warm. Measure liquid from cooker; skim fat. Reserve 1 c. of the juices. Meanwhile in a small saucepan stir together yogurt and flour until well combined. Stir in the 1 c. reserved cooking liquid and remaining dill weed. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minutes more. Serve meat with sauce and noodles. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed on box in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Jello Cheesecake
instructions: Cream first three ingredients together well. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Refrigerate until cold not thick. Pour into cheese and sugar mixture. Add juice of lemon. Stir in Cool Whip and mix lightly. Pour lemon mixture into a graham cracker crust. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Sinful Chocolate Pie
instructions: In blender combine chocolate bits egg yolks and Kahlua at medium speed. In saucepan heat cream until it comes to a boil. With blender on low speed pour hot cream into top of blender. Blend on high for 1 minute (the hot cream will melt the chocolate bits and cook the yolks). Pour mixture into pie shell and chill for 3 hours. Do not freeze. Very rich; will serve 12 easily.

title: Chicken Rotel
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove from broth. Cook spaghetti in broth. Cut up cheese. Remove spaghetti from heat; if soupy drain a little. Mix cheese and spaghetti slightly. Add Ro-Tel peas and cream of mushroom soup. Put in casserole and bake in oven until bubbly. (If more liquid is needed add broth you drained from chicken.) Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Cut in shortening; add milk and mix lightly. Roll and cut. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Italian Meat Balls
instructions: Soak toast in cold water for 7 or 8 minutes and then press dry. Combine with all the other ingredients. In a bowl work together until thoroughly blended. Form in 12 medium sized balls and fry slowly in about 2 tablespoons hot shortening until brown on all sides. Do not turn meat balls until absolutely done.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Top with bread or cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain. Add taco seasoning and follow directions on package. Mix in corn. Layer 1/2 of tortillas in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Then spread 1/2 meat mixture and 1/2 cheese. Repeat. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Casseroleroswell, New Mexico
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 X 13 pan. Stir in both cans of corn and cornbread mix. Add eggs and stir with fork. Drop sour cream and cheese by spoonfuls on top then fold in gently. (Optional may add 1 can of chopped green chilies)

title: Oven Dills
instructions: Pack pickles in jars. Boil ingredients listed and pour over pickles 1 clove garlic and 2 dill sprigs. Tighten lids. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 hour. Set jars on jelly roll pan in oven in case of breakage.

title: Minced Clam Dip
instructions: Saute clams for 10 minutes and leave juice. Saute pepper and onion with margarine adding lemon to taste for 10 minutes. Combine above ingredients and add 1 cup bread crumbs. Season with parsley and oregano. Mix well; top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cake Icing
instructions: Boil fast for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Beat until creamy.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix and stir with fork. Just before serving add celery. Can be prepared day before but do not add celery.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut vegetables into bite size pieces. Mix together vinegar water and dressing mix and pour over vegetables. Marinate in refrigerator overnight stirring occasionally. Serve cold.

title: Ranch Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bowl and mix well.

title: Party Meatballs
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients mixing well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Cook meatballs in hot oil in a large skillet until lightly browned; drain meatballs on a paper towel and discard drippings. Combine chili sauce and jelly in skillet; cook over medium heat until jelly is melted. Add meatballs; simmer 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Transfer to chafing dish; keep warm. Sprinkle with chopped green onion if desired. Yields about 5 dozen.

title: Linda Poor'S Ground Beef And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Mix in onion salt pepper and rice; cook 2 to 3 minutes more. Add soup and water; mix thoroughly. Remove from heat. Place cabbage in casserole (2-quart size). Pour meat mixture over cabbage. Do not stir. Cover and bake in a slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Ball Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the last 2 and form into small balls. Melt chocolate with paraffin in double boiler; dip each ball into chocolate. Remove and place on wax paper.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand so onion can go through mixture. Drop by small spoonful into deep hot grease. They will float. When done drain on paper. Serves 8.

title: Italian Spices Citrus Cake
instructions: Grease and line the base of 7-inch round deep cake pan. Blend the egg yolks with the sugar until mixture is thick and creamy. Whisk half of the orange peel and all of the lemon peel into the egg yolks. Mix the juice from both oranges and the lemon with the ground almonds and stir into the egg yolks. The mixture will become quite runny at this point. Fold in flour. Whisk the egg whites until stiff and gently fold into yolk mixture. Pour mixture into pan and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until golden and springs to the touch. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes and then turn out. It will sink slightly at this stage. Whip cream to form soft peaks. Stir in remaining orange peel cinnamon and sugar. Once cake is cold cover with the toasted almonds and dust with confectioners sugar and serve with cream. Serves 8.

title: Lemon Surprise
instructions: Combine flour butter and chopped nuts. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased pan (glass). Bake mixture at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes; cool. Combine powdered sugar and cream cheese. Spread on top of cooled nut mixture. Layer lemon pie filling on top. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes onion celery salt pepper and water about 20 minutes. With hand masher mash potatoes. Add milk and butter.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients. Fold in blueberries by hand. Pour into greased muffin tin and sprinkle top with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. With mixer beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add egg and vanilla and mix well. Toss chips with flour. Stir into cheese mixture. Pour into pie crust. Bake 35 minutes or until center springs back when lightly touched. Cool and top with glaze. Serves 8.

title: Breakfast Brunch Casserole
instructions: Line bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with rolls pressing firmly to seal perforations. Sprinkle on sausage and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients. Heat well and pour over sausage. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into squares for serving.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Mix soup and broth. Remove chicken from bone. Melt margarine in casserole dish. Add layer of chicken layer of soup and broth mixture and layer of stuffing mix. Repeat layers ending with stuffing. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Angel Cream Cake
instructions: Cut cake into 1/4 inch slices; arrange half the slices on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. In large mixer bowl combine sweetened condensed milk water and extract; mix well. Add pudding mix; beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spread half the cream mixture over cake slices; top evenly with 1 can cherry filling. Top with remaining cake slices cream mixture and cherry filling. Chill 4 hours or until set. Cut into squares to serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pink Pie
instructions: Mix together pineapple nuts pie filling and milk. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into pie crust and chill. Makes 2 pies. This is great to freeze.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss together until everything is coated with dressing and Salad Supreme. Refrigerate overnight if possible. Eat and enjoy. Theres enough for a party!

title: Saucy Cheesy Bake Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook noodles according to the package directions. Brown beef and drain. Layer 1/2 noodles 1/2 meat 1/2 sauce and cheese. Repeat for top layer. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Microwave Praline Bites
instructions: Mix morsels and syrup. Cook on low in the microwave stirring constantly until melted. Gently stir in pecans and drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper and serve when cool.

title: Hamburger Goulash
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add rice tomatoes and other ingredients. Stir to blend. Cover and simmer until rice is tender. Stir occasionally. Cook about 45 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Olivia'S Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add strawberries pineapple with juice and salt. Pour half gelatin mixture into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill until set.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Pour over beets and boil for 10 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Cheese Potato Fries
instructions: Place potato wedges in a plastic bag; add cooking oil cheese garlic powder and pepper. Close bag and shake to coat. Arrange wedges in single layer on a nonstick baking sheet. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake 30 to 35 minutes turning once or twice.

title: Frozen Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Place vegetables in a large bowl and pour boiling water over them. Drain the veggies and put them into a greased 9 x 13 inch casserole dish. Melt 1 cube of butter and drizzle it over the vegetables. Add the cheese distributing it evenly through the dish. Melt the over cube of butter and mix it with the crushed crackers. Cover the vegetables with the cracker mixture right to the edges of the dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35-40 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: With 3-inch biscuit or doughnut cutter cut one round from each slice of bread. Set rounds aside. Tear remaining bread scraps into 1-inch pieces; spread evenly in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle the Cheddar cheese evenly over the bread. Then layer the asparagus over the cheese. Combine the cooked ham and chopped onions and layer this mixture over the asparagus. Arrange the bread rounds on the top.

title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli and cauliflower into small flowerets. Add celery radishes onion salt and pepper into a bowl.

title: John Wayne Cheese Casserole
instructions: Grate cheeses and add chilies in a bowl. Beat egg whites until stiff. Mix together remaining ingredients and fold into egg whites. Pour over cheese mixture; mix with a fork. Pour into a greased round casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Crock-Pot Lasagna
instructions: Mix 2 cups Mozzarella (reserve 1 cup for topping) cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl; set aside. Add 1/2 to 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce to meat mixture in bottom of crock-pot. Add a layer of noodles broken to fit without overlapping. Continue layering 1/3 of sauce 1/3 pepperoni and 1/3 of the cheese mixture. Repeat with noodles sauce pepperoni and cheese mixture until you use it all. Pour water around edges of crock-pot. Top with cheese. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in punch bowl and serve.

title: Sausage 'N Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and onion. Mix all ingredients together. Put in casserole. Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix oil and vinegar sugar pepper and soup seasoning packet (from Ramen noodles) and refrigerate.

title: Creamy Beef And Rice Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan combine water wild rice mix and salt. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir in frozen mixed vegetables during the last 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Crabmeat Pie
instructions: Combine and mix first 4 ingredients until well blended. Add the last 3 ingredients; mix well then place in the pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes and then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crunchy Onion Casserole
instructions: Cook onions in salted water in saucepan until partially tender; drain. Place in casserole. Top with soup cornflakes and margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Crunchy Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salt and pineapple. Chill several hours. Serve salad on a bed of lettuce. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Top with pineapple tidbits.

title: Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Sift flour and salt into a bowl. Add milk oil and egg. Beat until smooth. Separate onion into rings. Dip each ring into batter. Fry 2 to 3 minutes in heated oil (375\u00b0). Drain; sprinkle with salt. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Ma'S Goulash
instructions: In a large skillet cook ground beef onion and bell pepper. Drain and discard grease. Combine cooked macaroni tomatoes and 1/2 of the grated cheese with the ground beef mixture. Transfer to baking dish. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and cook 10 minutes. Cool completely. Cool hard-boiled eggs completely or eggs will be tough. Place all in gallon glass jar. Refrigerate overnight before using.

title: Garlic Shrimp
instructions: In large skillet heat butter and oil. Fry the garlic red pepper and paprika about 1 minute stirring constantly. Add the shrimp and cook over medium heat until they turn pink. Stir constantly about 3 minutes. Stir in parsley lemon juice and salt. Serve immediately. Serve with bread for dipping.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in a 13 x 9-inch glass pan. Mix flour sugar baking powder salt and milk. Pour batter over melted margarine. Pour sweetened fruit and juice on top. Bake 30 to 45 minutes until brown and crisp on top. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Put Kool Aid in container and mix as directions. Add pineapple juice and and sugar. Chill until ready to use. 4 Makes 2 gallons.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Separate eggs and beat egg yolks. Add sugar to yolks and beat until smooth. Combine flour cornstarch and cocoa. Stir a little of the milk into flour cornstarch and cocoa mixture to make a smooth paste. Scald remaining milk and stir a little of it into each of the mixtures. Slowly combine egg mixture and cocoa mixture together with scalded milk. Cook and stir until thickened. Add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell and cover with meringue. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Clean cabbage and wilt in warm water. Mix all ingredients except some of the sauce. Roll mixture into cabbage leaf tightly. Put in a pan. Pour remaining tomato sauce. Cover with foil. Bake for about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Boil cabbage until tender and drain. Meanwhile saute onion in butter and mix with cabbage. Add cheese bread crumbs celery seed milk salt and pepper. Bake in 1 1/2-quart dish at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes until cheese is melted. Serves 6.

title: Scampi(Easy)
instructions: Melt butter in a medium skillet over low heat. Add onion garlic and parsley. Saute until golden about 10 minutes. Add shrimp and stir until pink. Remove shrimp and place in ovenproof dish. Cover and keep warm. Add wine and lemon juice to skillet. Simmer about 2 to 3 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour over shrimp. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Mother'S Chicken Almondette
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except bread crumbs and margarine. Put into Mothers \Yeast-Riz\ Crust (recipe follows). Blend bread crumbs and margarine. Sprinkle over the chicken mixture in crust.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix together in pan on stove or in crock-pot. Stir until cheese has melted. Keep warm and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Hamburger Delight
instructions: Brown ground chuck onion and green pepper. Add mushrooms. When browned well drain. Add Spanish rice barbecue sauce Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder. Stir and when heated serve. Makes 4 portions.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine broccoli and onion; cook according to package directions. Drain and add remaining ingredients stirring well. Pour into greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Wings
instructions: Disjoint wings; save tips for broth. (Cover with water and boil for 1 hour.) Roll rest of wing pieces in cornstarch then in 2 beaten eggs. Brown in oil. Place in single layer in baking pan. Pour sauce over and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour; turn and cover the last 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Blend in onion Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder. Beat on medium speed until fluffy. Add celery bell pepper and pimentos and mix well. Cover and chill 3 to 4 hours. Shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans. Wrap and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Beat well. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture alternately with bananas. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Frost with powdered sugar frosting while warm. Cut when cool.

title: Broccoli With Cheese
instructions: Recipe can be prepared a day ahead for better taste. Spray baking dish with nonstick spray or lightly grease with fat.

title: Muffins
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and put in nonstick muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Very Best Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Soak bread in milk. Crumble into ground beef and mix well with egg salt pepper and onion. Form small balls. Roll balls in flour and then simmer in broth and bouillon for an hour or longer. You might use an electric frypan at 200\u00b0. These freeze well.

title: Old Settlers Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with meat and onion. Bake in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add peas. Put in greased casserole pan. Spread mushroom soup on top then cream of Cheddar cheese soup over top. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Catfish Barbecue
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a small bowl. Arrange fillets on sheet pan or sizzle platter that has been coated with cooking spray. Pour catsup mixture over fillets; cover and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes turning once. Remove fillets from marinade reserving the marinade. Bring marinade to a boil in a small saucepan for 2 minutes. Place fillets on rack of broiler pan that has been coated with cooking spray. Broil 6 inches from heat 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork basting occasionally with marinade. Transfer to a serving platter. Contains 156 calories. Yields 6 servings.

title: Beets With Pineapple
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Stir in pineapple and juice. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Add butter lemon juice and beets. Cook over medium heat about 5 minutes.

title: Friendship Cake
instructions: Beat cake mix eggs pudding and oil together. Then add fruit and nuts. Bake in a greased Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 from 40 to 60 minutes.

title: Yogurt Fruit Pie
instructions: Select the flavored yogurt that would go best with your fruit combination. Strawberry and banana use strawberry yogurt pineapple (crushed) and coconut use pina colada mandarin orange slices with lemon yogurt. Mix ingredients together; pour into pie shells and refrigerate 2 hours. Serve.

title: Cheesy Meat Snacks
instructions: Mix ingredients together and form into balls. Place on a jelly roll pan about 1/2-inch apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 36 meatballs.

title: Delicious Yogurt Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine yogurt and Cool Whip until well blended. Pour into center of pie and smooth out to edges. Cover with plastic wrap well. Refrigerate overnight. Defrost frozen strawberries and put on top just before serving.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Bake sesame seed and almonds for 10 minutes. Boil chicken breasts with ginger and enough water to cover until done. Take out of water and let cool completely. String chicken. Chop lettuce and onions; mix well. Add chicken chow mein noodles sesame seed and almonds.

title: Veggie Bites
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls and place in bottom of an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan pinching edges together to seal. Brush dough with beaten egg. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 11 to 13 minutes and cool completely.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all and bake for 45 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Smothered Cabbage
instructions: In heavy pot cut cabbage. Add ham and all ingredients. Cook until done.

title: Easy Raw Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cut or break the cauliflower and broccoli into bite sizes. Mix dressing until smooth then mix with the vegetables. Refrigerate. Make at least 24 hours before serving.

title: Five Layer Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread bean dip in a 9x13 inch dish. Mash avocados with lemon juice in bowl. Stir taco seasoning into sour cream in a small bowl. Layer avocado mixture and sour cream mixture over bean dip. Top with cheese and tomatoes. Sprinkle with green onions and olives. Chill for several hours before serving.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil. Put the jello in the mixture. Chill the milk then whip it stiff. Mix all the ingredients and pour into the graham cracker crust. Ready to eat after slightly chilled.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Stir with fork. Drop by spoonfuls into stew etc. Cook covered for about 20 minutes.

title: Hushpuppies
instructions: Combine corn meal milk egg and onion. Mix well. Drop by rounded teaspoonful into deep hot oil (375\u00b0) frying only a few at a time until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes about 2 dozen hushpuppies.

title: Michigan Bean Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix gently but well. Bake at 300\u00b0 uncovered for 5 to 6 hours covering the last hour. Or cook in crock-pot on low overnight.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and cream cheese together. Break eggs and put 2 each in separated cups. Mix the flour and sugar together and measure 2 cups of this mixture. Add 2 cups at a time to cream cheese mixture plus 2 eggs until all ingredients are mixed well. Beat one minute after each addition. Add vanilla. Spray pan with Pam. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and pepper. Mix all together and place in greased casserole. Add cheese cubes to the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexicali Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in wok. Add beef and onion. Stir-fry over high heat until beef is done. Drain excess fat. Add chili powder corn tomatoes sugar oregano and dash of salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in cheese until melted. Spoon over shredded lettuce and top with corn chips.

title: Easy Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all together thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until done.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Boil small potato with peeling. Cool and peel. Mash with a fork. Add vanilla. Add powdered sugar until you can knead it like bread. Roll with rolling pin. Spread peanut butter chill and slice 1/2-inch thick. Spread with cinnamon English walnuts or candied cherries. These are variations you can use.

title: Fudge(Elaine'S)
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and milk together in double boiler. When completely melted and blended add vanilla and nuts. Spread in an 8 x 8-inch pan and refrigerate.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine milk peanut butter egg and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Add biscuit mix and mix well. Chill 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly brown. You can make Peanut Blossoms from this recipe. Follow directions as directed except do not flatten. Bake as directed. Press a solid milk chocolate candy drop in center immediately after baking.

title: Crisco Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together Crisco and sugar. Add eggs and beat very well. Add cake flour then vanilla flavoring. Beat very Well! Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Crab Casserole
instructions: Thaw crabmeat if frozen; combine crabmeat celery mayonnaise onion green pepper Worcestershire sauce and salt. Place in a well-greased 2-quart casserole or individual shells. Combine bread crumbs and cheese; sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated and lightly browned.

title: Deer Steak
instructions: Beat your deer meat then mix flour Greek seasoning garlic salt pepper and salt. Shake deer meat in the mixture. Have grease real hot. Cook until brown like you want. Drain on paper towel.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add other ingredients except water and beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in water. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Add shrimp onion pepper and ham. Cook and stir until shrimp are pink. Stir in tomatoes tomato sauce and hot pepper sauce. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Drain potatoes and place in 13 x 9 casserole dish. In saucepan over low heat combine chicken soup milk and cheese stirring until cheese melts. Remove from heat and fold in sour cream chives and parsley. Pour mixture over potatoes. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients then add pecans (halves or chopped). Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool before serving.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in olive oil and add finely chopped onions celery garlic and green peppers. Cook until onions are soft. Add eggplant tomatoes and tomato sauce. Add seasonings. Cover and simmer until eggplant is tender. Add bread crumbs to thicken and pour into a shallow baking pan. Top with Swiss cheese slices and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in salt water. In microwave melt butter or margarine. Add flour; stir well until smooth. Add pinch of salt. Add 1/2 cup of milk; microwave a few seconds. Add 2 more cups of milk and sharp Cheddar cheese. Microwave until cheese is melted. Pour over macaroni; sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat sugar and Crisco together. Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour salt soda baking powder and cinnamon together. Add to egg mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Beat in bananas and soak until plump. Drain well. Add nuts and raisins to batter. Mix all ingredients with a wooden spoon. Pour into a greased bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Fry onion and margarine. Boil pepperoni 10 minutes and remove excess fat and drain. Add all other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Eleganti
instructions: Cook in buttered casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and divide into two loaf pans. Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Easy Cheese Cake
instructions: Make graham crust in large oblong pan. Mix Jell-O with 1 cup hot water. Chill to egg white thickness. Mix cream cheese with sugar. Whip Carnation milk until thick. Mix all together and pour over graham cracker crumb crust. Spread cherry or blueberry pie filling on top (optional).

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine or butter and sugar in a large bowl until smooth and creamy. Stir in beaten eggs and peanut butter. Mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients and mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Flatten by pressing crisscross with tines of fork. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on baking sheet 2 to 3 minutes before removing with spatula. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Beef Nacho Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Stir in salsa corn dressing and chili powder. Layer 1/2 each of the meat mixture chips and cheese in 2-quart casserole. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Top with shredded lettuce and chopped tomato if desired.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Crush crackers; add margarine. Place 1/2 of mixture into casserole. Spread chicken pieces on top. Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken. Spread other half of crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Bake it rather thin; use 9 x 13-inch casserole.

title: Barbecued Pork
instructions: Put one slice onion in bottom of slow cooker. Top with roast and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange remaining onions on roast and add water. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours or until tender. Discard most of juices. Break pork into pieces removing fat. Pour barbecue sauce over pork and stir. Let heat through then serve over buns.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a square baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Cook and stir ground beef and onion in a 10-inch skillet until beef browns. Drain. Stir in seasoning mix; spoon into plate. Beat Bisquick milk and eggs with wire whisk or hand beater until almost smooth about 1 minute. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean about 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese; bake 2 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Garnish with lettuce tomato olives and sour cream. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and pack in jars. Put one spray of dill on top and 2 cloves of garlic in each jar. Mix vinegar water and salt. Bring to a boil and pour in jars with cucumbers. Seal and put in hot water bath for 7 minutes. Makes about 8 to 10 quarts. Very good and crisp.

title: Tater Tots Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger with finely diced onion if desired until all red has disappeared. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add can of mixed vegetables (do not drain) and 1 can of mushroom soup (do not dilute). Cover top with Tater Tots and bake at 350\u00b0 until nicely browned.

title: Stuffed Artichokes
instructions: Clean and cut artichokes. Snip pinchers off. Soak in salt water. Rinse and drain. Chop garlic. Place clove in each around leaves. Mix bread crumbs and cheese. Spread artichoke leaves and spoon mixture into each leaf. Tuck parsley in. Place in Dutch oven standing up. Pour small amount of olive oil over each. Fill pan with water up to middle 3/4 of bottom row of leaves. Boil slowly 2 to 3 hours. Enjoy!

title: New Orleans Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight. When ready to cook combine all ingredients except rice and fill pot with water. Bring to a boil then simmer a few hours until soft enough to puree. Puree 1 cup of beans in blender. Stir into pot and mix so beans are slightly soupy. Salt and pepper to taste (never cook beans in salted water!). Serve over fluffy white rice as a main course with French bread and green salad.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Bake covered for 15 minutes in a 425\u00b0 oven. Drain. Combine tomatoes cornstarch and basil. Cook stirring constantly until sauce thickens. Pour heated sauce over chicken; top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes uncovered. Serve with noodles or spaghetti. Serves 4.

title: Tasty Pecans
instructions: Beat egg with one teaspoon water. Mix pecans to coat with egg and water mixture. Mix sugar cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Add pecans to mixture. Stir thoroughly. Spread on large cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 60 minutes stirring once.

title: Broccoli And Chicken
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and top with Pepperidge Farm dry stuffing mix. Top with butter and heat in a microwave to serve.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Combine butter flour and pecans; mix well. Press in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Thoroughly blend all ingredients and pour into two unbaked pie shells. Bake 20 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake 40 minutes longer or until knife inserted comes out clean. Cool completely on rack. Enjoy!

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk and margarine in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook to soft ball stage (about 15 minutes) stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Quickly pour into a buttered 9-inch square dish. Let cool.

title: Broccoli Puff
instructions: Combine soup and cheese add milk mayo and egg. Pour over broccoli. Melt butter and pour over bread crumbs.\tSprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Raspberry Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1/2 cup water. Put in frozen raspberries (break up with fork). Add 1 cup cranberry-orange relish. Chill about 5 to 10 minutes. Add 1 cup lemon-lime soda.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown onion and hamburger. Add other ingredients and simmer.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cut up fruit and nuts. Mix flour and sugar fruit and nuts. Beat egg whites until they stand in peaks. Add to mixture with vanilla and salt. Mix and chill in refrigerator. Drop by teaspoon or form into small balls on greased cookie sheet. Flatten each cookie. Bake 12 or 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spicy Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Grease a 15 x 10-inch jellyroll pan; line with waxed paper. Grease and flour waxed paper; set aside. Beat eggs in a large bowl at high speed until thick; gradually add 1 cup sugar and beat 5 additional minutes. Stir in pumpkin and vanilla. Combine flour pumpkin pie spice baking powder and salt. Gradually stir into pumpkin mixture. Spread batter into prepared pan; sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Persimmon Squares
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Cook seed prunes and\tmash. Mix all ingredients and bake in greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Krisp Sweet Dills
instructions: Drain Kosher dills; cut into strips and rinse well in clear water; drain. Put back into jars. Mix the rest of ingredients in kettle; boil one minute. Let cool. Pour over dills. Let stand overnight in refrigerator before using. Will get crisper with age.

title: Chex Party Mix
instructions: Mix melted butter Worcestershire sauce and salt in large bowl. Mix in Chex and nuts. Mix well until pieces are coated. Place in shallow pan and place in oven. Stir every 15 minutes. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Artichoke Spread
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients stirring well. Spoon into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole or souffle dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Garnish with parsley if desired. Serve with toast points or Melba rounds. Yields 3 cups.

title: Onion Cheese Soup
instructions: Melt butter in 4-quart saucepan over low heat. Add onions and saute until lightly browned. Add flour and cook an additional 5 minutes until butter and flour are well blended. Slowly add milk and chicken stock stirring constantly to prevent lumps. Season with salt and pepper continuing to stir until soup thickens. Whisk in egg yolk slowly and add cheese. Simmer for another 5 to 10 minutes stirring to prevent burning. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Roast Corn
instructions: Pull husks away from ear leaving attached at stalk end. Remove silk. Let corn stand in cold water about 15 minutes.

title: Mom'S Date Loaf Candy
instructions: Bring to boil sugar milk syrup butter and salt. Add dates. Stir until forms firm ball in cool water. Place pan in cold water and beat until thickened. Add nuts and pour out on wet cloth (brown domestic works best). Roll up and let set until firm. Unroll and cut into slices.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Shred meat from chicken breasts into strips. Place 5 tortillas on ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle each with half of cheese mixture. Top with chicken strips peppers and onions. Use jalapenos for desired spiciness. Top with additional cheese and top with another tortilla. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-18 minutes or until crisp and heated through. Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa. Serves 6-8 as appetizer.

title: Chicken Yum-Yum
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Lay strip of Sizzlalene on each breast and roll up. In bottom of 9 x 13 Pyrex dish lay chopped beef down. Mix sour cream and soup and pour over. Cover with foil. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Lime Pickles
instructions: In a large plastic pan cover with cold water and let set overnight the cucumbers and lime. Then wash several times with cold water. Next combine sugar salt pickling spices and white vinegar. Pour over washed cucumber slices and let set for 3 hours. Then bring to a boil for 30 minutes. Put in jars and seal. Makes 9 pints.

title: Reese'S Balls
instructions: Melt margarine in large container. Stir in graham crackers and all other ingredients except chips and paraffin. Mix well. Roll into balls put on waxed paper on cookie sheet and freeze for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix together and store or take camping. When you wish to use this mix take a coffee cup and fill a little over 1/2 full with dry ingredients then just add hot water and stir.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Dice eggs and add with onion salt and pimento to chilled green beans. Pour over whipped sour cream to which sugar has been added. Serve at once.

title: Quick Pasta Delicious
instructions: Heat olive oil in a medium size pan. Saute zucchini and yellow squash. Add green pepper red onion and mushrooms. Saute until tender and add minced garlic salt pepper and frozen peas. Steam for 5 minutes. Pour in a little bottled marinara sauce and toss with favorite pasta. Amount of ingredients depends on size of family.

title: Apple Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Let stand. Mix remaining ingredients. Then mix both batches together. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Six Layer Dinner
instructions: Layer ingredients as they are listed. Place in a greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Cook the brown sugar and heavy cream on medium low heat in saucepan. Cook to soft ball stage on candy thermometer. Remove from heat and add vanilla and butter. Let set until cool enough to stick your finger in. Beat until thick.

title: Eastern North Carolina Barbecue Sauce
instructions: *Add pepper to taste I like it hot.

title: Cheddar Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter or margarine over low heat. Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually add milk; cook and stir over medium heat until the mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Add salt Cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese; stir until the cheeses melt. Add potatoes; stir gently to mix. Place in a greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Macaroons
instructions: Combine ingredients. Drop from a teaspoon on a well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes about 30 cookies.

title: Banana Split Pie(Not For The Calorie Counters!)
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Press in pie pan. Bake crust until golden brown.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl. Serve and enjoy.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Salt and pepper chops. Brown in small amount of oil in hot skillet. Place in shallow greased baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Break potatoes into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix next 5 ingredients. Pour over potatoes. Mix 3 cups corn flakes and 1/4 cup margarine; spread over mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Wacky Cupcakes(No Eggs)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Make hole in the center and add rest of ingredients. Mix and pour into cupcake holders. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Congealed Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook and chop up chicken. Chop finely almonds celery and eggs. Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water and add to hot chicken stock. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add mayonnaise and mix well. Add all remaining ingredients. Season to taste. Place in molds or pans and chill. Serve on lettuce leaves topped with stuffed olives. Serves 16 to 18.

title: Spicy Beef Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients except buns. Shape beef mixture into 4 patties about 1/2-inch thick. Cook in 10-inch skillet over medium heat turning once about 10 minutes for medium or until desired doneness. Serve on hamburger buns with chili and cheese spread.

title: Chinese Roast Pork Or Chicken
