Freeze until firm. Cut into squares about 20 minutes before serving. Top with whipped cream and pecans. Makes 9 (3-inch) squares.

title: Mom'S One-Bowl White Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt into bowl. Drop in Crisco. Add about 2/3 cup milk then vanilla and beat until smooth. Add egg whites; mix thoroughly. Add remaining milk and beat until well blended. Pour batter into 2 (8 or 9-inch) pans which have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Use desired frosting.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Chill and serve.

title: Barbecue Muffins
instructions: Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Flatten into 5-inch circles. Press each into the bottom and up sides of a greased muffin pan; set aside.

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Add yeast to warm water and dissolve. Mix in the flour and salt. Knead for about 5 minutes adding more flour only if necessary. Cover and let rise for 1/2 hour. Roll or pull by hand. Place on greased pizza pan. Makes 2 to 3 crusts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: California Flank Steak
instructions: Rub liberal amounts brown sugar into both sides of the flank steak. Dont be stingy! Lay the steak into an oblong container and cover with soy sauce. Remember to lift the steak so the sauce gets underneath. Cover and marinate for 1 hour. Turn the steak over re-cover and marinate for 1 hour more.

title: Mushroom Rice
instructions: Mix liquid ingredients with melted butter and bouillon. Add olives mushrooms and (last) the rice. Cook covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cream Of Chicken Soup
instructions: Place the chicken pieces in a large saucepan and cover them with the water. Add the celery bay leaf onion salt and peppercorns. Place the pan over high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low cover the pan and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Combine flour salt baking powder and spices. Fold in flour mixture. Pour into a greased and floured (or Pam sprayed) jelly roll pan. Spread evenly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle powdered sugar on a soft towel loosen cake and invert onto towel. Roll up cake in towel. Cool cake completely. Unroll and spread with filling.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Pour into a pastry shell and bake on lower shelf in a moderate oven (375\u00b0) 40 to 45 minutes. This makes one large pie.

title: Joyce'S Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Combine lettuce broccoli cauliflower onion and cucumber with mayonnaise. Blend well making sure everything is covered with mayonnaise. Pour bottle of Italian dressing over mixture and garnish with tomatoes and shredded cheese.

title: Chocolate Chip Nut Cake
instructions: Mix together except chocolate chips and nuts and beat 5 to 10 minutes. In another bowl mix chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Remove paper from caramels. Follow instructions on cake mix box to mix. Pour half of batter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake this half for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Penne With Tomato Cream Sauce
instructions: Brown sausage meat; put aside. In a heavy saucepan combine the tomatoes with juice cream garlic and tarragon; bring the liquid to a boil breaking up the tomatoes. Add sausage; simmer mixture for 25 to 30 minutes or until sauce is thickened. Cook penne 12 to 15 minutes in boiling water; drain well. Toss with tomato sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve.

title: Pineapple Filling
instructions: Drain pineapple (keep juice). Beat sugar eggs and butter until light and fluffy. Pour over bread cubes and drained pineapple. Add enough juice to moisten well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 35 to 40 minutes. Serve from oven.

title: Aunt Bea'S Potatoes
instructions: In skillet saute onions in oil or margarine. Combine with hash browns soup sour cream and cheese. Spread in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine cornflakes and melted butter. Sprinkle over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Pie Crust Biscuits
instructions: Using medium size mixing bowl mix together pie crust mix baking powder and baking soda. Make a well in the center and add buttermilk all at once. Stir only until dough clings together.

title: Good Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0 and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
instructions: In heavy saucepan stir grits slowly into boiling water. Cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Allow grits to cool. Mix well with beaten eggs. In greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish alternate layers of grits and cheese. Pour milk over top. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and paprika. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Ralph'S Cream-Style Corn
instructions: Open can; empty into pot. Heat on medium-high to desired warmth. Serves 1 to 2 people per can.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken until it falls off bone. Reserve 4 cups broth. Take chicken off bone. Combine broth chicken and all other ingredients in large pan. Cook over low heat until spaghetti absorbs most of liquid. (If you want more spaghetti cook it first then add remaining ingredients.)

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients and set aside. Mash bananas. Beat eggs until light. Mix bananas and eggs together. Add dry mixture and mix. Add nuts and stir well. Put in a 9 x 5-inch buttered loaf pan. Some like to add 2 tablespoons melted butter to the batter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites salt vanilla and water until foamy. Add cream of tartar. Beat until slightly stiff. Add 1 cup sugar gradually then fold in flour and sugar mixture gradually. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Amanda'S Picante Salsa
instructions: Dip tomatoes in boiling water to remove skins. Chop all vegetables and put in large pot or dishpan. (I use food processor for peppers.) Cook on medium heat for 20 to 30 minutes or until starts to thicken. Dissolve 3 tablespoons cornstarch with 1/2 cup water. Add to salsa; cook a few minutes longer to thicken. Put in hot jars to seal. Makes about 14 pints.

title: Mom'S Cobbler
instructions: Place fruit in pie dish. Mix sugar and Bisquick. Pour over fruit. Slice margarine over sugar mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until well browned.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Wash beans in cold water and drain. Mix beans bell pepper and onions. Mix vinegar oil sugar pepper and salt. Pour over beans and toss lightly until well mixed. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Ham Appetillas
instructions: Remove tortillas from refrigerator. Combine cream cheese mayonnaise onions and olives. Spread thin layer of mixture on tortilla. Arrange four slices of ham over cheese. Tightly roll up tortilla. Wrap individually in plastic wrap. Place in refrigerator at least 3 hours or overnight. To serve cut into 3/4-inch slices. Makes about 64 appetillas.

title: Crock-Pot Roast Beef
instructions: Place vegetables in bottom of crock-pot. Salt and pepper meat. Place into pot. Add liquid and cover. Cook on low for 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours). Remove meat and vegetables with spoon. Thicken remaining liquid for gravy if desired.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Pie(Lite Choices)
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Press crust ingredients into a 9-inch pie plate; chill.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown meat; drain off excess fat. Add onion green pepper and garlic. Cook 1 minute. Add tomato sauce tomato paste water Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Serve with spaghetti noodles.

title: Marshmallow Puffs
instructions: Line a 9-inch pan with foil; butter the foil. Arrange marshmallows in pan. In a double boiler or microwave-safe bowl melt chocolate chips peanut butter and butter. Pour over marshmallows. Chill completely. Cut between marshmallows. Yields 3 dozen. White chocolate chips can be substituted.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Stir in lemonade. Add cold water and cranberry juice. Pour over ice in punch bowl; slowly pour in 28 ounce bottle of ginger ale. Chill. Yield 12 cups.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese sour cream and taco mix. Spread on 8 inch pie plate. Layer refried beans then salsa. Top with cheese lettuce and olives. Refrigerate up to 1 hour then serve with crackers or tortilla chips.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together and let set overnight or several hours in refrigerator. Serve with vegetables or chips.

title: Curried Chicken Breasts
instructions: Conventional Oven Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together gravy mix curry powder and water. Place in large size brown-in-bag. Place in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Season chicken with salt pepper and paprika. Place in single layer in the bag. Cut slits in the bag and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Cut in shortening with pastry blender. Add enough water to hold ingredients together sprinkling evenly and mixing with fork to form ball. Makes enough for 8-inch or 9-inch pie either 2-crust or bottom crust and crisscross strips on top.

title: Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small serving bowl and set aside for the flavors to meld about 3 hours or overnight is best. Keeps about 1 week. Good on almost everything. Makes about 2 cups of salsa.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Alternate adding flour and cream (divide into thirds). Cook at 300\u00b0 at least 2 hours or until brown. Start in a cold oven! \Makes a crusty delicious cake.\

title: Indian Fry Bread
instructions: In a bowl mix dry ingredients. Slowly add cold water a little at a time until dough forms. Divide into balls about the size of a softball. On a floured surface roll balls out into an even circle about 1/4-inch thick. In a large frying pan heat lard or oil on medium heat. Oil should be about 1-inch deep. Place fry bread in pan. Flip with tongs. When lightly brown on both sides remove and place on paper towels. Serve as a meal with beans cheese or add lettuce tomatoes to make a Navajo taco. Serve as dessert with sprinkled powdered sugar.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
instructions: Place chicken in buttered baking pan; place sauerkraut over chicken. Top with cheese. Pour dressing evenly over cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 1 hour. Serve sprinkled with chopped parsley. Serve over white rice.

title: Soup For A Winter Evening
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in crock-pot. Cook on low for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Easy Festive Fudge(Chocolate Or Peanut Butter Or Butterscotch)
instructions: Mix in a heavy 2-quart pan the sugar milk marshmallows margarine and salt. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat to a boil (bubbling all over the top). Boil and stir 5 minutes more. Take off heat.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender; mix 3 minutes. Meanwhile butter a 10-inch pan and dust with flour. Pour mixture in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix vinegar sugar and mayonnaise and pour over broccoli and cauliflower. Chill before serving.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring water to boil; add rice. Boil for 14 minutes. Drain rice (optional). Mix remaining ingredients while boiling. Cook until thick; stir constantly. Serve warm or cold with cinnamon sugar. Can be rewarmed in microwave. Use 2-quart kettle or larger.

title: Baklava
instructions: Grind nuts and combine with cinnamon and sugar in a large bowl. Melt butter. Brush bottom of a 14 x 20-inch pan with butter. Place one pastry sheet and brush with butter repeating process until 6 pastry sheets line pan. Add nut mixture. Add another sheet. Brush with butter and sprinkle with nut mixture. Repeat process until all ingredients are used ending with 4 layers of buttered filo on top. Cut into diamond shapes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Delight
instructions: Combine cucumbers and onions in a bowl. In a separate bowl mix sour cream vinegar and seasonings. Pour over cucumbers and onions. Mix lightly. Let stand one hour before serving. Serves 6.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let set overnight. Serve with king size chips.

title: Wild Duck
instructions: Brown dressed ducks in butter. Remove duck and make water flour salt and pepper gravy from butter. Add wine to gravy. Place ducks in roaster breast down. Cover with gravy. Cover roaster and cook in very slow oven at 200\u00b0 for at least 4 hours. Check often and add more water wine and seasonings if necessary. Serve with wild rice.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole dish. Add rice; lay chicken in rice. Sprinkle soup mix over all. Pour 2 cups water. Spread can of soup over chicken; add can of water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tahini Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend well. Use as sauce for fish or make beef/lamb/onion and parsley patties and use as sauce for them.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Butter a tube pan. Cut each biscuit in half and roll into a ball. Place 1/2 of them in pan. Bring rest of ingredients (except nuts) to a boil. Add nuts. Pour 1/2 of mixture over biscuits that are in the tube pan. Put remaining biscuits on top of first layer. Top with remaining mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sugared Peanuts
instructions: Put in heavy skillet over heat until water evaporates and sugar crystallizes. Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let it cool. Enjoy!

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and cook about 1 minute. Add the remaining ingredients and stir 1 minute. Drop by spoon onto wax paper.

title: Mandarin Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. (Drain mandarins and discard juice.) Refrigerate.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Use apple pulp left from preparing apple juice for jelly. Press through food mill. Measure pulp. Add sugar and spices; cook until the flavors are blended well about 15 minutes. To prevent sticking stir frequently as mixture thickens. (If too thick add a small amount of water for desired consistency.) Makes 5 pints.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Sift together flour salt and baking powder; set aside. Melt margarine and add to brown sugar. Mix well and let cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips. Bake in large 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 3/4-inch greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except stuffing mix and butter. Place in 2-quart baking dish. Toss stuffing mix with butter and spoon over vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes about 6 cups.

title: Primavera Vegetables With Linguine
instructions: In large skillet heat oil. Saute onion and garlic for 1 minute. Add zucchini yellow squash and bell pepper. Saute 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in reserved tomato juice tomato paste water salt and pepper. Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in tomatoes and basil and simmer 1 minute.

title: Beat 'N Eat Frosting
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in small deep bowl. Add boiling water. Beat to stiff peaks with eggbeater or electric beater. Spread between layers and on top and sides of 8-inch cake. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate and peanut butter in microwave. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonful onto wax paper. Yields approximately 7 dozen. This is a holiday requirement at my house.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Simmer butter onion pepper and red pepper; mix together soup corn and Ro-Tel. Put ham potatoes and spaghetti in casserole dish. Then pour over soup. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Then put Velveeta cheese on top. Put in oven for 5 minutes.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves
instructions: Drain liquid off grape leaves. Put leaves in 3-quart pan of cold water. Heat to boiling; drain.

title: Hawaiian Dessert(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Bring juice to a boil; add gelatin stirring until gelatin dissolves. Combine pineapple and milk in blender; blend well. Add gelatin mixture almond extract and ice. Mix thoroughly in blender. Pour into dessert dishes. Chill until set about 1 hour.

title: D.P. Whitmer'S Blueberry Muffins(This Recipe Won Third Place In Connecticut Post Contest.)
instructions: Lightly spray the inside of muffin tins with nonstick spray. With a paper towel or tissue gently wipe the spray inside each muffin cup. Spread soft butter around inside of each muffin cup liberally. Set aside tins in cool place. Into a bowl put 1/3 cup flour 1/3 cup confectioners sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon; mix well then add the fresh or hard frozen berries and mix well. Reserve at room temperature.

title: Red Salt
instructions: Excellent on all meats.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Prepare strawberry Jell-O as on package omitting 2 cups of cold water. Mix in strawberries. Place torn angel food cake in 9 x 13-inch pan and pour strawberries over cake. Let sit until firm and spread Cool Whip over strawberries. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together by hand. Roll in chopped pecans.

title: Dry Mustard Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a crock except cucumbers. Wash cucumbers and add as they are available. Put plate over cucumbers in crock. Put large rock on plate to hold cucumbers under mixture until cucumbers lighten up. They are then ready to eat.

title: Low-Fat Oven Fried Catfish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 or adjust oven if it cooks fast. Dip fish in egg whites then coat in meal. Arrange in pan lined with aluminum foil and sprayed with Pam. Place in oven; turn once. Place under broiler if you want fish crunchy and browned. Bake 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes with sugar milk salt and orange rind. Scoop up about 1/4 cup potato mixture and shape into a ball around a marshmallow using more if needed to cover. Roll in corn flakes (or pecans). Place on baking dish sprayed with Pam and freeze covered.

title: Champagne Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix club soda pudding mix eggs and oil. Beat with mixer. Stir in (by spoon) the cherries nuts and pineapple. Make three layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Fun Castle
instructions: Wash pieces of brick\tand rocks in plain water until they are thoroughly wet. Wet sponge and wring it out.\tPlace rocks bricks and/or sponge in a shallow glass bowl (do not use metal of\tany kind). Arrange to suit your fancy placing on top of each other to get the desired shape you want. The good thing about the sponge is that you can cut it to desired shapes. Mix water bluing (you can still get this at the grocery store I just called to see) and ammonia in a glass jar.\tPour over the rocks being sure to dampen all of them with the mixture. Put a drop or two of food color and a few drops of bluing on one or two of the rocks. Sprinkle with 4 tablespoons salt and watch it grow. Add 2 tablespoons each water and ammonia\tafter two days to edge of bowl. This is straight from Heloise!

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Layer carrots onion and bell pepper. Boil remaining ingredients and pour over layered carrots onion and bell pepper. Refrigerate until chilled or overnight. Lasts several days in refrigerator.

title: World'S Easiest Fudge
instructions: Spray an 8 x 8 or 9 x 9 microwavable dish with nonstick spray. Place chocolate chips and Eagle Brand milk in dish. Stir. Microwave approximately 1 to 2 minutes. Stir. If using nuts add those in. Microwave at 30 second intervals until chocolate chips are completely melted. Refrigerate. Takes approximately 4 to 6 hours to set up.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat saute onion celery and broccoli in butter for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in cheese soup and milk until smooth. Place rice in a greased 8-inch square baking dish. Pour cheese mixture over; do not stir. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Coney Sauce
instructions: Fry together. Drain hamburger and onions. Mix together in a large kettle sugar vinegar juice tomato puree chili powder pepper catsup sauce Worcestershire sauce and garlic salt. Add hamburger and onion to this mix. Salt to taste. Simmer over low heat for 1 hour. Cool; run it through a meat grinder. One pint makes 8 or 9 Coneys.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl and mix well. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix soup milk sour cream chilies jalapeno and 1/4 teaspoon cumin in blender. Mix cream cheese onion chicken and 1/4 teaspoon cumin in large bowl. Roll mixture in flour tortillas. Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan and pour liquid mixture over top. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes then uncovered for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tPut all 3 cans of soup in large deep baking dish; pour in cup of rice and stir together. Lay chicken pieces on top; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Boo'S Spicy Salsa
instructions: Blend the first 3 ingredients in blender. Add the bell pepper. Mix all ingredients and cook for 1 1/2 hours or desired thickness. Then can.

title: Banana Drop Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly grease to large baking sheets with butter or vegetable shortening. Sift together flour sugar baking soda salt cinnamon ginger and nutmeg. Using a pastry blender or two forks work the margarine into flour mixture until thoroughly mixed. Mix the chopped walnuts with the oatmeal. Stir into flour mixture. Beat in egg and bananas. Mix well. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of batter onto baking sheets about 2 inches apart. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until the cookies have browned around the edges. Remove from oven. Cool cookies for 2 - 3 minutes and transfer to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Walnut Roast
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the last 3 and bake in an oiled meat loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Prepare whipped topping mix as directed. Prepare pie filling reducing milk to 2 cups. Blend in half whipped topping. Arrange banana in shell and put pudding mixture in shell. Garnish with remaining whipped topping. Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Candied Walnuts
instructions: Bake walnuts for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Combine sugar water cinnamon and salt in saucepan; cook over medium heat to soft ball stage. Do not stir. Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts. Stir until mixture becomes creamy and sticks to the nuts. Dump on cookie sheet and spread as it cools.

title: Pretzel Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix and spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish; bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 to 7 minutes. Let cool.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl blend all ingredients on low setting then beat 2 to 3 minutes on medium. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Georgia Special
instructions: Mix well and cook at 350\u00b0 until done. Cool.

title: Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook over low to medium heat until mixture reaches 240 degrees on a candy thermometer. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Beat until fudge starts to thicken and turns dull. Pour into buttered pie pan.

title: Punch For 25
instructions: Make gelatin as directed on package. Add rest of ingredients except ginger ale and mix thoroughly. Add ginger ale just before serving. Sherbet may also be added when ready to serve.

title: Stackups Grande
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add onion and green pepper; cook until tender. Stir in Cheez Whiz and chili powder. Layer tortillas and meat mixture in two stacks in 13 1/2 x 8 3/4-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with tomato; cut into wedges to serve. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sugar in a small bowl until smooth. Set aside. Drain pineapple and mix in large bowl with banana pieces strawberries nuts and whipped cream. This should be well mixed. Add cream cheese/sugar mixture and mix well. Spread in a 9 x 11-inch pan and freeze for 3 hours before serving. This can be stored in the freezer for at least 3 weeks and can be used as either a salad or dessert.

title: Grumbire Soup(Hearty And Filling On Cold Winter Days.)
instructions: First Cover potatoes and onion with water and cook until soft. Add milk and heat through stirring gently. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pork And Pea Pods
instructions: Mix soy sauce cooking sherry garlic and ginger for a marinade. Add meat tossing to coat evenly. Cover tightly. Refrigerate at least four hours or longer.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Combine sugar water and instant coffee granules. Simmer slowly for 40 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Add vanilla. Add vodka. Pour into clean empty bottles. Let set at least 3 weeks.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Mix sour cream and brown sugar together and let set overnight in refrigerator. In the morning add other ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes one regular bread pan loaf.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown meats garlic and salt add next 5 ingred. Then add 1 tsp each of chili powder thyme tarragon basil marjorum oregano celery salt 1-2 bay leaves sugar to taste seasoning salt romano or parmesan. Simmer for 2-3 hrs.

title: Whole-Wheat Apple Cinnamon Muffins
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the first 6 ingredients. Peel the apple and grate it into another bowl. Stir in the yogurt and the sugar until the sugar dissolves. Stir in the egg molasses oil and 1/4 cup water. Stir the flour mixture into the yogurt mixture until just combined. The muffin batter will be lumpy. Spoon into prepared muffin pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 until edges start to brown about 15 to 20 minutes. Make ahead and freeze. Great for breakfast.

title: Arroz Con Pollo(Chicken And Rice)
instructions: Mix salt garlic and oregano; rub chicken inside and out. Saute tomatoes peppers and onion; add chicken and simmer 1/2 hour. Add achote coloring rice olives and capers; mix well. Add liquid; stir and cover. Cook until the rice is done and all water has been absorbed about 25 minutes. Serve hot. Garnish with strips of pimentos and peas.

title: Carolyn Craig'S Mayonnaise Muffins
instructions: Mix well and drop in greased muffin tins. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Cinnamon Sticks
instructions: Mix and spread real thin on buttered cookie sheet (press and spread with palms of hands). Brush top with slightly beaten egg white. Sprinkle with finely chopped pecans. Cook in 300\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut in sticks 1 x 3-inches while hot and cool in pan.

title: Whipped Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Using electric mixer mix sugar margarine Crisco and eggs; mix very well. Be sure to use whipped margarine; its the secret to the cake because no baking powder or soda is used. Add flour and milk then flavoring. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Butternut Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar shortening and salt. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk alternately ending with flour. Fold in flavoring by hand.

title: Chicken Enchiladas(Low-Fat)
instructions: Wrap tortillas in foil. Heat in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts With Vegetables
instructions: Tear off 2 (12 x 18-inch) sheets of aluminum foil and rub them lightly with oil. Place onion slices on each sheet. Flatten breasts to 1/4-inch thick and place over onions. Combine mayonnaise and mustard. Spread over each chicken breast. Top with carrots zucchini and mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with basil garlic powder and paprika. Seal edges tightly to make package. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix eggs and cream. Stir in cheese and sausage. Pour in greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Puree chilies in blender. Saute in 2 tablespoons oil (use a 2-quart Dutch oven) onion pureed chilies and garlic. Puree stewed tomatoes in blender and add to the sauteed mixture along with beef broth cream of chicken soup chicken broth salt sugar lemon pepper Worcestershire sauce chili powder cumin and Tabasco. Simmer 1 hour.

title: Hamburger And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 until rice is tender.

title: Chicken & Dumplings
instructions: Mix dough. Roll out to about the same thickness as pie crust prick dough with fork & cut into 2 inch wide strips then break into pieces about 2 inches long. Add enough water to broth to make about 2 qts. Bring broth to boil add chicken & dumplings & salt & pepper to taste. This makes enough to serve 8-10 people.

title: Seasoned Pork Roast
instructions: Combine garlic salt and pepper. Rub over roast. Place roast on rack in roasting pan and roast in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes per pound.

title: Fruity Banana Milk
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender or jar. Cover and blend or shake until mixed well. Makes 3 servings.

title: Preacher Cookies
instructions: Combine butter sugar and milk in a medium sauce pan; boil 3 minutes. Stir in cocoa oatmeal vanilla and nuts. Beat well; working quickly drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool 5 minutes. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Mix coconut and nuts. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake mix as directed. Pour over nuts and coconut. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and margarine. Drop by teaspoonfuls on top of cake mix (will almost completely cover top). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening and cool. Add sugar molasses and egg. Beat well. Sift together flour salt baking soda and spices. Add to first mixture. Chill good. Form into balls; roll in granulated sugar. Put onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Cook in crock-pot on low for 18 hours. Remove peppers. Use a fork and shred roast. Place in deep plate or bowl and pour juice over. Serve.

title: Herb Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms. Remove stems. Chop stems finely. Melt 1/4 cup butter in skillet. Saute mushroom caps briefly on both sides. Remove to shallow baking dish. Melt remaining butter and saute stems and onions. Remove from heat. Add bread crumbs and remaining ingredients. Toss to mix. Spoon into caps. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cantaloupe Sorbet
instructions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add cantaloupe and process until smooth. Mix cantaloupe sugar and lemon juice; stir well. Cover and freeze until almost firm stirring occasionally.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Heat soup and milk; dip tortillas in this mixture. Place small amount of onions chicken green chilies and cheese on each tortilla. Roll up and place in casserole dish. Pour soup mixture over tortilla. Sprinkle any remaining ingredients over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly hot.

title: Edee'S Crab Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Cinnamon Cream Pie
instructions: Mix 1 cup sugar flour and cornstarch. Stir in scalded milk; then very gradually blend in beaten egg yolks. Add the half stick of margarine cut in several pieces. Cook in double boiler until thick. Stir in vanilla. Cool.

title: Chinese Whatsit(Or You Name It Casserole)
instructions: Saute beef; add salt and pepper to taste and a dash of sugar. Place cooked beef in a 9 1/2 x 13-inch baking casserole. Combine celery and onion and layer evenly over beef. Break up frozen peas and make another layer. (Celery onion and peas may be combined to make 1 layer together.) Spread crushed potato chips over vegetables. Dilute soup with water and pour over all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Cookies
instructions: Lightly brown sausage in frying pan breaking into pieces. Remove sausage to absorbent paper and reserve 1/4 cup drippings.

title: Easy Pot Roast
instructions: Place roast in Dutch oven; add soup mix and mushroom soup. Add water to cover roast. Cover. Cook at 325\u00b0 for about 2 hours. Add carrots and potatoes during last 45 minutes of cooking if desired.

title: Farmers Casserole
instructions: Brown steak or boil chicken. Saute onions and pepper. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cook covered.

title: Jello Balls
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Roll into balls and roll in small box of Jell-O. (Use red for Christmas; orange for Thanksgiving.)

title: Mexican Mess
instructions: Brown meat with onion and spices; drain well. Add corn picante beans and tomatoes; simmer for 30 minutes. Crush tortilla chips in a serving dish; spoon mixture over chips. Top with lettuce tomatoes cheese taco sauce (if taco sauce used I leave out other seasonings) and black olives. Quick easy and great!

title: A Crock Of Beans And Meatless Sausage
instructions: Add ingredients to crock-pot. Let cook on high until thickened; about 4 to 6 hours. Serve over brown rice barley or bulgur wheat.

title: Onions And Rice
instructions: Saute green onions in hot oil in a large skillet until tender. Add rice and next 5 ingredients. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Garnish with a green onion fan. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add milk egg and margarine. Beat well and bake in an 8-inch greased pan in a hot oven 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into shell and bake at 300\u00b0 until knife comes out clean when inserted in center. Pie should be brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well adding sugar slowly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes a 1 pound loaf.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together 3/4 pkg. of chipped beef (chopped) with cream cheese onion garlic powder and accent. Make into a ball and roll in reserved 1/4 pkg. chipped beef. Refrigerate until about 1/2 hour before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift flour and mix with salt and soda. Add to egg mixture. Add the remaining ingredients and beat until well blended. Bake in 3 greased layer pans at 350\u00b0 until tested done. Let cool and frost.

title: New Orleans Pecan Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine egg yolks sour cream granulated sugar flour vanilla and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened (about 5 to 10 minutes). Pour into baked pie shell. Set aside.

title: Sweet Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in with pastry blender the shortening egg and milk. Add blueberries. Drop batter into cupcake pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook down until thick. Then can. Let set for 30 days before use.

title: Country Sausage And Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Cook and stir sausage and onion in oil in 10-inch or 12-inch skillet until onion is tender about 5 minutes. Stir in potatoes sauce mix water and pepper. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally 10 minutes. Stir in carrot strips; cover and simmer until carrots are crisp-tender and potatoes are tender about 10 minutes. Stir in broccoli and cheese. Cover and cook until broccoli is heated through and cheese is melted 5 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
instructions: Toss all ingredients and place in crock-pot.\tCook on low-medium for 8 hours. Mixture will thicken and be ready to eat!

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix eggs sugar shortening butter and vanilla until smooth. Add flour and beat on high for 10 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pear Cake
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together. Add oil eggs and vanilla. Mix well and add pears. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. No icing needed for this moist cake. Great way to use up pears during pear season.

title: Bro. Don'S Corn Dish
instructions: Fry bacon crisp. Set aside keep drippings in pan. Cut corn off with sharp knife cutting first a thin layer off tops of kernels. Repeat twice getting all kernels off cob.

title: Mexican Potato Topper
instructions: Microwave on High for 5 minutes; stir and return if needed to melt cheese thoroughly. Can also be used as topping for broccoli cauliflower etc.

title: Ribbon Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar 6 tablespoons margarine and 1/3 cup milk in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. Continue boiling for 4 minutes over medium heat stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate pieces until melted. Add 1 cup (1/2 jar) Marshmallow Creme and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Beat until well blended.

title: Chicken And Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Season chicken to taste. Place in ovensafe pan. Mix soup milk and mushrooms. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Grapefruit And Crab Meat Cocktail
instructions: Chill grapefruit and crab meat in cans. Drain grapefruit. Flake crab meat removing bony tissue. Alternate grapefruit and crab meat in cocktail glasses. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over grapefruit and crab meat. Serves 8.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Make a paste of red coloring and cocoa; add to creamed ingredients. Then add vanilla. Mix buttermilk in same cup where red coloring was mixed. Use all clinging coloring. Sift flour salt and soda together and add to mixture. Beat well; then fold in vinegar. Pour into 2 cake pans lined with greased waxed paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Corn 'N' Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dee'S Kitchen Soup
instructions: Brown meat in large pan; drain grease. Celery and onion may be cooked at this time. Add water seasoning and tomatoes. If using any fresh vegetables or rice add at this time. Cook until tender. Add more water as needed. More seasoning may be needed depending on taste. Cook for about 30 minutes. Serve with cornbread or biscuits.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour salt cold water and shortening like for pie crust. Cut up apples and place in center. Add butter sugar and cinnamon. Shape the dough around apple. Jag around sides and top with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Could possibly even take 1 hour. Keep checking.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt butter in mixing bowl; add each of the following one at a time and stir until well mixed between each Sugar eggs syrup vanilla salt pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55-60 minutes or until pie appears set.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a lightly greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill for several hours before serving.

title: Green Enchiladas(Get Raves!!!)
instructions: Combine soup milk and Velveeta in top of double boiler. Heat until cheese melts. Add chilies and pimientos. Set aside. Brown meat; season with a little cumin powder and pepper if desired. Layer torn tortillas meat onion Velveeta sauce and grated cheese. Repeat layers. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Pavlova
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil. Draw six (3-inch) circles on the foil. Set aside. In a small mixer bowl combine egg whites vinegar and salt. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form (tips curl). Gradually add the 1/2 cup sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating on high speed until very stiff peaks form (tips stand straight) and sugar is almost dissolved (about 4 minutes). Use the back of a spoon to spread the meringue over the circles on the foil building the sides up. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Turn off oven. Let meringue shells dry in oven with door closed for at least 1 hour. Remove from foil. To serve spoon fruit into meringue shells. Top with whipped topping. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broiled Chicken(Or Maybe Oiled-Foil-Broiled Chicken)
instructions: Marinate the chicken breasts in lemon juice and herbs de Provence for 8 to 24 hours. Cover the broiler pan with aluminum foil then oil the foil. Heat the broiler. Arrange the chicken on the oiled foiled pan; broil it on one side then turn it over and broil it on the other side.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen broccoli according to package directions. Drain well and set aside. Cook rice (not instant) and set aside. Saute chopped celery and onion in melted margarine over low heat. Stir frequently until wilted. Add cream of chicken soup and milk. Simmer until well mixed. Add Cheez Whiz and stir well until melted into mixture. Add rice broccoli and salt and pepper to taste with 3 good dashes of Tabasco sauce. Stir until mixed. Pour into large casserole. Top with breadcrumbs and grated mild Cheddar cheese (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly and hot. Uncover last 15 minutes.

title: Roast Stuffed Turkey
instructions: Rinse turkey thoroughly inside and out. Using your hands rub turkey completely with vegetable oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place bread in bottom of roasting pan. Put turkey breast side down on the bread. Cook in 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove turkey from oven and place on large platter (we use oven mitts to turn the turkey onto its back). Make the stuffing (recipe following) using the bread in the bottom of the roasting pan.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add eggs cheese mushrooms onion and dash of salt and pepper. Mix well; set aside. Cook manicotti according to directions (dont cook too long it makes the noodles hard to stuff). Stuff with hamburger mixture and layer in bottom of baking dish. Cover with sauce and a little grated cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Boil chicken breast until tender. Remove from broth. Cook pack of noodles in broth. Saute mushrooms onions and green peppers in butter and garlic. Stir into noodles and broth. Add stewed tomatoes and cheese. Stir until melted. Add 1 tablespoon cornstarch with enough water to make a smooth paste. Add to other ingredients. Serve with salad and rolls. Enjoy!!

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Cook cheese and soup together until smooth. Combine all ingredients in greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix baking mix milk brown sugar oleo and nutmeg. Spread in ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Drain peaches reserving 1 cup syrup. Arrange peaches on mixture in pan. Pour reserved syrup over peaches. Bake until golden brown about 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream. You can use fruit cocktail (30 ounces) for the peaches.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour in an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Use big zucchini but still tender enough so you can pierce the skin easily with your thumbnail. Peel cut into quarters lengthwise remove the seeds and slice crosswise. Add zucchini to remaining ingredients after they are tossed together. Mix well. (It may be runny.) Dump into a 9-inch pie crust and bake 40 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until golden brown. (Youll think you are eating apple pie but its more delicious.)

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix ingredients all together. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be served warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Drain pineapple and cherries very well. Mold into a ball and refrigerate overnight. Roll in chopped pecans before serving. This is always a favorite at parties.

title: Jeff'S Potato Salad With Beer Dressing
instructions: Boil potatoes until just tender. Peel and slice.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix Cheez Whiz and soup together. Add chicken then Veg-All. Pour into casserole dish. Crush 1 tube Ritz crackers and melt 1/4 stick margarine. Toss together and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Dice potatoes and onion; cook in grease from bacon slices until tender. Add celery soup and milk. Heat through. Crumble bacon on top.

title: Cherry Cream Puff Ring
instructions: Puff Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Heat water and butter to boiling in a 1-quart saucepan. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously about 1 minute until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat; add eggs one at a time. Beat until smooth. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet to form an 8-inch ring.* Smooth top with spatula. Bake until puffed and golden 50 to 60 minutes. Cut off top with sharp knife. Pull out any soft dough.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Combine squash onion flour pepper sugar and salt. Beat eggs and add to squash. Add margarine. Drop by tablespoons on oiled griddle. Cook on both sides until golden brown. Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

title: Roquefort Dressing
instructions: Break up cheese and mix in remaining ingredients until smooth. (Or place all in a blender and process until smooth.) If the dressing is too thick add a little milk to make it pour better.

title: Almond Tea
instructions: Mix well. Before serving add 1 quart ginger ale.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter or softened margarine. Add eggs; mix well. Add 1/2 of the flour salt and baking powder to the creamed sugar mixture. Then add water vanilla and remainder of flour mixture. Form into small balls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Sprinkle with sugar.

title: Cheesy Ham And Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix together potatoes oleo salt pepper soup ham onion and sour cream. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Crumble with Topping.

title: Banana Snack Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix flour butter and walnuts. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Beat cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip together. Spread over cool crust. Mix lemon pudding and cold milk together to make third layer. Top with thin layer of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Lemon-Orange Salad
instructions: Mix jello and 2 cups hot water. Stir in frozen orange juice. Cool. Then add mandarin oranges and pineapple. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Spice Cake
instructions: Mix all well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Works well in tube pan or layers.

title: Gratin Potatoes(Serves 3 To 4)
instructions: Rub the inside of 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish with the cut garlic clove; let it dry. Then smear the inside of the dish with butter or margarine. Cut potatoes into slices no thicker than 1/8-inch. Arrange slices in dish in rows slightly overlapping both slices and rows. Lightly salt each layer. Do not fill dish more than 2/3 full. Pour milk into dish until potatoes are about half covered; then just barely cover the whole mixture with the half and half. Finally sprinkle all liberally with the bread crumbs and some butter shavings. (Note I use plain skim milk; relying on the seasoned crouton crumbs for flavor; it works fine!)

title: Mexican Soup
instructions: Cook meat; drain. In a large pot add additional ingredients for 30 minutes. Serve with cornbread.

title: Grease And Flour Pan
instructions: Mix together. Store in refrigerator and use on pans when recipes read \grease and flour pans.\ Works great on special occasion cake pans.

title: Whole Note Chicken
instructions: Put celery pepper and onion in melted oleo in a skillet. Cook until almost done. Cook 2 cups rice which will make 4 cups cooked rice. Mix chicken rice soup and cooked items together. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. The last 10 minutes put cheese on top; bake until melted and a little brown on top.

title: Orange Fluff
instructions: Combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan (dont drain). Boil and remove from burner. Add jello and stir to dissolve. Add the cold water and slightly congeal. Fold in ground cheese. Add the Cool Whip and nuts folding. Put in casserole dish and chill.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown beef bacon and onion; drain off fat. Add beans brown sugar white sugar vinegar mustard catsup salt and pepper. Place in baking dish and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Tex Mex Dip
instructions: In the bottom of a serving dish spread the bean dip set aside. Mix together the avocado dip lemon juice and picante sauce and spread over the bean dip. Mix together the mayonnaise and sour cream spread this over the avocado mixture. Then sprinkle with the seasoning. Top with tomatoes onions and cheese.

title: Choco Peanut Butter Dreams
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together sugar peanut butter and margarine until light and fluffy. Blend in water egg and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients. Mix well. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Remove to wire rack and cool completely.

title: Baked Turkey
instructions: Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Baste turkey with magarine. Stuff if desired. Put water onion and apple in roaster. Put turkey breast side down in water (this keeps the breast basted and moist). Cover roaster. Bake at 475\u00b0 for one hour. Turn oven off. Do not open oven door at all all night.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Squares
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate in double boiler or microwave oven. Spread over peanut butter mixture. Cool in refrigerator about 30 minutes until edges harden. Chill again until completely hardened.

title: Tante Herta'S Green Tomato Relish(This Is A Double Recipe)
instructions: Put tomatoes onions and peppers through coarse grinder; add salt and let drain real dry. Put tomatoes vinegar sugar and spices in pot. Add red pepper and bring to a good boil. Simmer for 10 minutes stirring well. Pour into jars and process in the recommended manner. Makes 4 1/2 quarts.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Slightly beat the eggs in a blender. Add pumpkin sugars salt and spices. Add milk last and beat until mixed. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in hot (425\u00b0) oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 375\u00b0 and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Put in 5-quart stockpot venison meat that is cut into chunks (as big as you like) onion salt and pepper. Add water to cover meat; add bouillon cubes. Cover; let cook until meat is done. Put in potatoes and carrots (chopped); cook until done. Add canned vegetables as stated. Simmer. Add flour and water in separate bowl make it pasty. Add salt and pepper. Add to stew stirring constantly until thickened. Let simmer; serve.

title: Baked Shrimp A La Jessica
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine first 9 ingredients in shallow 2-quart baking dish and mix well. Remove 1/4 cup of this mixture and set aside. Add shrimp to baking dish and mix thoroughly. Combine bread crumbs with reserved butter sauce and sprinkle over shrimp. Bake 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Best Ever Cornbread
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Saute beef and onion lightly. Do not brown; drain fat. Remove from heat. Add rice and water and mix. Place 1/2 of cabbage into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover with meat mixture. Put rest of cabbage over meat. Pour soup over all. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix together. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Dice all fruit. Cut up nuts. Add grated coconut. Dredge with 3 cups flour. Cream the butter sugar eggs and flavoring. Add remaining cup of flour. Pour this batter over dredged fruit and nuts. Mix thoroughly. Bake in oven about 275\u00b0 for about 2 hours.

title: Reuben Sandwiches
instructions: In small bowl combine mayo pepper and chili sauce. Spread about 1 tablespoon of this mixture on each bread slice. On each of 4 bread slices place a cheese slice 1/4 of the corned beef 1/4 of the sauerkraut a cheese slice and another bread slice mayo side down.

title: K'S Brownies
instructions: Mix cocoa and sugar. Add flour melted margarine eggs and vanilla. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Add nuts if desired.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Combine cucumbers salt and onion; let stand 2 hours. Drain well. Pack in freezer containers leaving 1-inch headspace.

title: Norma'S Creamy Apricot Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve 1/2 cup juice and set aside. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add marshmallows stirring until slightly melted. Stir in the pineapple and apricot baby food. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Combine cream cheese and the reserved pineapple juice blending well. Stir in whipped topping. Fold in gleatin mixture. Arrange banana slices in bottom of a lightly greased 12 x 18 x 2-inch Pyrex dish. Spoon gelatin mixture over bananas. Sprinkle with chopped nuts (pecans). Chill until firm. Yields 12 servings. A pretty orange color and delicious.

title: Bug Sandwich
instructions: Take 2 pieces of plain bread put dead spiders and flies and their guts on top. Put fur on it and roast it for 16000 days. Roast it in a 36 oven. Turn it up to 70 or 80\u00b0. Then eat it.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Drain and serve.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender and drain. Add corned beef cheese soup milk and onion. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mud Pie
instructions: Make crust with cookies and oleo and refrigerate. Soften ice cream and add to chilled crust. Add sauce before serving.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Finely chop green onions and chipped beef. Mix all ingredients together and shape into a ball. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple and set juice aside. In a 9 x 13-inch pan pour pie filling in to cover bottom. Put drained or crushed pineapple on top of that. Pour dry cake mix on top of pineapple and spread evenly. Pour melted butter and pineapple juice on top of dry cake mix. Mix coconut and brown sugar together and spread over top of juice. Cover top of cake sufficiently. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until coconut is golden brown. Cherry juice should be coming through top.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix sugar and butter together. Add flour and eggs alternately beginning and ending with flour (example flour 2 eggs flour 2 eggs flour and etc.).

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash. Drain and season with salt and pepper. Mix with 1/2 stuffing. Add sour cream pimentos onion and soup. Mix other half stuffing with half cup melted butter. Line casserole with half stuffing; pour squash mixture into casserole. Top with rest of stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Pol'S Apple Cake
instructions: Mix in saucepan for 3 minutes; pour over warm cake.

title: Mexican Fri Chik
instructions: Saute onion and green chilies until onion is soft. Add to remaining ingredients except tortillas and Cheddar cheese. Grease a 3-quart casserole dish. Place a layer of tortillas in the bottom of the pan. Spoon some chicken mixture on tortillas and continue layering tortillas and chicken mixture. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top servings with your favorite picante sauce. Serves 8.

title: Lazy Man Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Add milk and vanilla. Blend. Melt margarine in pan. Add milk mixture. Stir in canned peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Potatoes With Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine seasonings. Place 2 tablespoons oleo in nonstick skillet and melt. Arrange 1/3 of potatoes in a circular pattern with about 1/4 of seasoning 1/3 onion and 2 tablespoons soft oleo. Repeat layers 2 times. Cover tightly with foil and press down. Bake 20 minutes uncovered. Bake 20 minutes. Uncover; bake 20 minutes more or until potatoes are tender. Remove from oven; press down with spatula. Let stand 10 minutes; remove to a platter. Serve hot. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Crunch Salad
instructions: Mix and spread in greased Pyrex 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Cool.

title: Crunchy Chicken Cheese Bake
instructions: In a 3-quart oblong baking dish place chicken. Top with cheese. Stir soup and spread over cheese; top with tomato. Combine margarine and stuffing; sprinkle over tomato. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Serve over rice. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar milk salt and oleo in saucepan; cook until it comes to a boil. Boil only 1 minute and remove from heat then mix in oatmeal and other ingredients. Place in buttered pan or drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Makes 3 to 5 dozen.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Saute sausage and drain. Add cheese Bisquick and water. Roll into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown. Can also be frozen and cooked when needed.

title: Benedictine Spread
instructions: In a large bowl using an electric mixer beat cheese until smooth and creamy. Slice cucumber in half lengthwise. Scrape pulp and seeds into a small sieve. Place sieve over a cup and with the back of a spoon push juice from pulp (if more juice is needed rub peeled cucumber over sieve to extract juice). Add cucumber juice onion mayonnaise Tabasco Worcestershire and only enough green coloring to give a faint green tint. Beat until thoroughly blended. Correct seasoning if necessary. Refrigerate.

title: Individual Cheese Cake
instructions: Place piece of graham cracker in bottom of muffin paper. Beat well the cream cheese eggs and sugar. Pour over grahams and top with pie filling. Bake 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 12 to 15.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in a preheated oven at 475\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Beef With Noodles
instructions: Place a clean towel over wire cooling rack. Spread cooked noodles evenly over towel and let dry 3 hours. Combine water 2 teaspoons soy sauce salt and bouillon granules in a small bowl. Cut beef across the grain into thin slices about 2 inches long.

title: Kraut Relish
instructions: Combine sauerkraut carrot green pepper and green onion. Mix together Italian salad dressing and poppy seed. Add to vegetables and toss well to coat. Chill thoroughly. Makes 6 servings 39 calories per serving.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Drop batter by tablespoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 about 8 minutes.

title: Potato Stuffing Or Dressing
instructions: Cook potatoes. Add salt. Drain. Add oleo and mash. Fry onions and celery until tender. Add to potatoes. Add bread egg and poultry seasoning. Mix can be used to stuff a small chicken or put in greased bowl cover with foil and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Take foil off to brown top. Good as a side dish with fried chicken.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and add milk gradually stirring until smooth. Melt butter in iron skillet and add mixture; cook until thick.

title: Homos Bi Tahini
instructions: Bring to a boil the contents of the can of garbanzo beans and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Save the juice from the beans to be used later if the mixture is too thick and needs thinning. Using a food processor place all the ingredients (with the exception of the olive oil paprika and parsley twigs) and blend until mixture is smooth. Taste to see if you want to add more lemon juice or salt to mixture. Pour into a nice serving dish; drizzle olive oil on top. Sprinkle with paprika and add a couple of parsley twigs for added decoration. Pita bread can be cut into triangles and used to dip into Homos. I usually double this recipe which serves 6 to 8 people. Import stores have the tahini.

title: Aunt Winnie'S Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs for 1 minute. Separately combine flour salt cinnamon baking soda and salt. Add the 2 mixtures together. Fold in the carrots and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Blend by hand and roll into 1-inch balls. Should make about 1 dozen. Freeze on cookie sheet and put in Ziploc bags. Bake when needed at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until firm and slightly browned.

title: Dreamy Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries (medium grind). Pour sugar over cranberries and let set. Wash grapes cut in half. Put marshmallows in same bowl with grapes. Mix chopped pecans grapes marshmallows and cranberries all together. Whip the cream and mix thoroughly. It is better for cranberries grapes nuts and marshmallows to sit in refrigerator overnight then mix with whipped cream about 2 to 4 hours before serving but this is not necessary. Serves 12.

title: Rumbledethumps
instructions: Cook cabbage a few minutes. Remove with slotted spoon. In the same water cook potatoes until done. Mash potatoes and butter with masher. In casserole stir all 4 ingredients together and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 30 minutes.

title: Barbecued Beef
instructions: Brown beef in shortening. Add water and simmer in covered skillet for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Add remaining ingredients and cook until tender. Add more water if needed. Serve on buns.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cocktail sauce together. Form ball. Refrigerate several hours. Before serving pour sauce on top.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Saute meat with chopped onion; mix with eggplant which has been cooked and drained. Crumble crackers and add to meat mixture along with eggplant. Put in greased casserole and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cube Steak Casserole
instructions: Roll cube steak in flour; salt and pepper to taste; brown in greased skillet on both sides. Place meat in casserole dish or crock-pot. Mix soup gravy and water. Pour over meat. Cover and cook 2 hours at 350\u00b0 in casserole dish or start on high for 1/2 hour in crock-pot then cook on low until tender.

title: Lung Fever Salve - Draw Salve
instructions: First put the lard and wax together and melt; then melt camphor in it. Then put in all the other ingredients except for turpentine and cook until they are all melted. Remove from stove and then add turpentine (turpentine is inflammable).

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Drain pineapple well. Mix together; form into a ball. Roll in chopped nuts. Top with a cherry.

title: Weight Watchers Casserole
instructions: Mix all together in a large baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Louella'S Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Chicken Skanavis
instructions: Put chicken in a casserole and cover with Swiss cheese. Pour over the breast the can of soup which has been diluted with sherry. Top with stuffing and drizzle the melted butter over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Grease and flour 9-inch baking dish. Cream 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup butter. Add eggs. Sift together flour soda cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture. Mix in apples. Bake in shallow pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Clam Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients. Add sage to taste and bake in greased baking dish at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease (not oil) and flour bottoms only of two 9 x 5-inch or 8 x 4-inch loaf pans.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Stir-fry cabbage carrots and onions in 2 tablespoons oil and soy sauce for one minute. Remove from wok and set aside. Add meat and salt and pepper to vegetables. Heat 2 cups oil in a skillet. Spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons of mixture on each egg roll wrapper fold sides and roll diagonally. Brush with water to seal. Fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain on paper towel.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes with onion until tender. Drain. Mix in salt milk and cup of cheese (about 4 slices) until cheese melts. Pour a layer of potato-milk mixture in a casserole dish. Top with cheese slices. Continue layering potato mixture and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar margarine and vanilla; add coconut raisins and pecans. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Sausage With Fried Apples
instructions: Shape sausage into 12 patties. Fry in a large skillet over low heat until well done but not crisp. Remove to heated platter; keep warm. Pour off all but 4 tablespoons drippings. Core apples but do not pare. Cut into rings about 1/2-inch thick. Arrange apple slices in skillet. Top with grape jelly and cinnamon. Cook over low heat. Cover for several minutes to soften apples. Uncover; cook until apples are tender and well glazed; turn often being careful to keep shape of apples. Arrange on platter with sausage. Garnish with grape glaze. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in mixer until smooth. Refrigerate. This dip is great with fresh vegetables.

title: Beef Paprika
instructions: Cube beef. Heat drippings in a large skillet or flame-proof casserole.\tAdd beef and fry until brown on all sides. Peel and chop onions and garlic. Add to pan and cook until transparent. Sprinkle in flour and stir into mixture. Add broth marjoram caraway seed a pinch of sugar paprika and seasonings. Cover tightly and cook gently for 1 3/4 hours.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and saute onion; add potatoes soup cheese sour cream and seasonings. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Mix melted margarine with crumbs. Pat into a crust covering potatoes during the last 10 minutes of baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Custard
instructions: Boil macaroni in generous amount of water. Drain and mix with grated cheese salt\tand butter. Lastly stir in eggs. Pour in greased baking dish and bake to light brown.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into baking dish. Reserve 1/4 of potato chips to crumble on top. Bake 20 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix Cool Whip pudding and pineapple. Then add mandarin oranges and marshmallows. Pour into mold or bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Babuska Peanut Butter Triangle Cookies
instructions: Mix peanut butter and butter with powdered sugar until well blended. Stir in Rice Krispies and options. Roll into 4-inch triangles or your size you like. Roll in finely chopped nuts and chill. Slice as needed.

title: Toasted Pita Triangles
instructions: Cut pita bread into quarters; separate into 2 pieces. Cream together softened butter with herbs and seasonings. Spread each pita piece with herb butter. Place pita pieces on baking sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 until butter is melted and pita is crispy about 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Lime Melon Balls
instructions: Boil together the water and sugar. Cool to room temperature and add lime juice. Pour over melon balls in sherbet glasses. Garnish with pomegranate seeds a sprig of mint or thin slices of lime.

title: Quick Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with whisk until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in whipped topping. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Blueberry-Almond Blintzes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except butter in a food processor or blender until smooth. Heat an 8-inch crepe pan or skillet over medium heat. Coat pan with about 1/2 teaspoon of butter. Add 3 to 4 tablespoons of batter to the butter tilting pan to make an even layer of batter. Cook on one side only. When bottom begins to brown turn out to cool on a plate. Repeat process with remaining batter. Makes 18.

title: Banana Cream Cake
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix well sugar oil eggs and salt. Mix flour spices soda and pecans (optional). Alternate flour mixture and bananas into the sugar mixture. Bake in two 9-inch pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan; grease well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. After cooled ice with cream cheese mix. It makes for smiles.

title: No Peek Casserole
instructions: Mix soups water rice and parsley in bottom of flat baking dish. Place chicken pieces on top of mixture and sprinkle with onion soup mix. Cover with foil; bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter; add quartered zucchini. Cook until tender. Add diced tomato and/or 1 can chili with or without beans. Cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Add cheese and cover to let cheese melt and serve.

title: Pink Christmas Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix in all ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip. Place in paper liners in muffin tins and freeze. Serve on lettuce leaf. Serves 12.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in flour egg yolks lemon peel and juice and milk. Beat egg whites until stiff fold into first mixture. Pour into pie shell and bake in preheated oven. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake 45 minutes until golden or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine both the cream cheese and American cheese in a bowl. Add the garlic powder. Roll into a ball. Put the chili powder (as much as needed) on a plate. Roll the cheese ball around until it is covered with chili powder. Serve with crackers.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour and sugar.

title: Ground Beef With Cornbread(Serves 4)
instructions: Brown beef pepper onions and\tsalt. Add chili powder and tomato sauce. (If there is any grease drain well.) Pour beef and tomato mixture into oiled 9 x\t13-inch baking dish. Pour beans over meat mixture. Spread cheese over beans; set aside.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill well before serving.

title: Broiled Red Snapper
instructions: Place snapper on broiler pan. Brush with butter and squeeze a slice of lemon over each piece of fish. Sprinkle with a small amount of oregano and just a hint of paprika. Broil on top rack of oven for approximately 5 to 6 minutes. Crack door to keep fish warm until serving.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add slightly beaten eggs sweet milk vanilla and nutmeg and stir well. Mix buttermilk and soda and then add to the mixture. Mix in enough flour to make a soft dough. Roll thin cut into strips lengthwise and then across to make squares and rectangles. Place in greased pans and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 dozen tea cakes.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle lemon juice over. Combine cake mix nuts and melted butter. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Icebox Pickles
instructions: Bring ingredients except cucumbers and onions to boil. Alternate cucumbers and onions in jar. Pour hot liquid over cucumbers and onions. Let cool. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

title: Cooked Icing
instructions: Combine flour and milk in a saucepan adding milk slowly and stirring until smooth. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Set aside to chill completely.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind together first 5 ingredients. Add pineapple and sugar. Dissolve jello and hot water. Cool. Add fruit mixture and refrigerate 4 hours.

title: Just For Kids Dough And Salt Art
instructions: Knead flour and salt together adding water gradually. Arrange art shapes on cookie sheet and brush with egg whites before baking. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Art will be 1/2-inch thick.

title: Braised Cabbage
instructions: In skillet heat butter until foamy. Add chives and sauce until tender. Add green cabbage and carrots.

title: Christmas Rum Balls
instructions: Combine wafers and next three ingredients. Mix in pecans syrup and rum. Blend well. Dust hands with sugar and shape dough into 1-inch balls. Press pecans in top of each ball. Let stand for 1 hour then roll in sugar. Store in tightly closed jar for 3 days. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Cook lima beans until done. Mix 6 cups flour 1 pint salt eggs and water; roll dough and let dry 2 to 3 hours. Melt Crisco in little frying pan; let it get real hot and add 4 tablespoons flour one at a time so it doesnt get lumpy. Let brown and add 2 tablespoons garlic salt and 1 tablespoon paprika. Add to lima beans and water they were cooked in. Tear up dough and put in last. Dig in.

title: Indian Fry Bread
instructions: Mix preceding ingredients with just enough water until dough forms. Roll out on floured surface. Cut into pieces and deep fry until golden. Top with honey or powdered sugar.

title: Amish Cream Pie
instructions: Heat milk sugar and cornstarch in pan until thick stirring constantly. Add butter and vanilla. Stir and pour into baked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Blueberry Muffins
instructions: In large bowl stir together flour oats sugar baking powder soda and salt; set aside. In a small bowl mix egg water and oil; add all at once to oat mixture stirring just until moistened. Stir in blueberries. Spoon into greased or lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Blend 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over the batter in each muffin cup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen. Muffins freeze well. Microwave for a quick breakfast.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Combine 1 c. water and 1/4 c. butter and bring to a boil. Add 1 c. flour and 1/2 tsp baking powder to above mixture. Let cool. Beat in 3 eggs 1 at a time. Drop by Tbsp in soup and cover. Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad (With Fruit)
instructions: Boil pasta 10 minutes; drain and cool. Drain fruits saving juice. Add to juice the eggs and flour and cook until thick. Add to pasta. Fold in fruit. Before serving add about 10 ounces Cool Whip.

title: Coconut Supreme Dessert
instructions: Mix butter and flour until creamy. Add pecans and press mixture onto bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake crust at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes (or until slightly golden). Toast coconut in same oven. Watch carefully for it browns quickly. Next mix 1 cup powdered sugar and the cream cheese. Add 1 carton Cool Whip to this mixture and spread mixture over the baked crust. Prepare instant pudding according to directions. Allow pudding to set before spreading over cheese layer. Cover pudding with 2nd carton of Cool Whip. Sprinkle coconut on top.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain grease. Add the rest of the ingredients. Dont drain the vegetables. Bring to a boil and simmer.

title: Barbecued Duck Breasts
instructions: Dissolve soda and salt in bowl of water. Soak duck breasts in this water 3 hours. Remove pat dry and place in shallow pan. Combine next 5 ingredients in plastic bag. Add duck breasts close bag and marinate at least 1 1/2 hours (or overnight in refrigerator). Remove breasts form marinade. Wrap each in bacon and secure with toothpicks. Cook on grill for about 5 minutes on each side basting with marinade. Serves 4.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar. Cook 2 minutes. Stir constantly. Add milk. Cook until mixture boils. Remove from heat and cool 10 minutes. Beat in confectioners sugar.

title: Secret Message Cookies
instructions: Melt chips in a small saucepan over low heat and stir constantly. Place on graham cracker on top of another and dip 3 sides in melted chocolate to seal allowing excess to drip off. Place on wax paper until set.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Bring first 2 ingredients to a rolling boil (do not overcook). Remove from stove. Add peanut butter; mix well. Add cornflakes; mix well. Shape by rolling small balls in wet hands. Let set on waxed paper 1/2 hour. Do not double recipe.

title: Classic Karo Pecan Pie
instructions: In a large bowl stir eggs corn syrup sugar butter and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50-55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool. Makes 8 servings.

title: Hungarian Cheese Logs
instructions: Mix with mixer. Roll into 6 rolls on wax paper. Sprinkle chili powder on wax paper and roll log in it. Keep refrigerated.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. Without draining them mash until size of pea. Meanwhile cook onion in margarine for 3 minutes. Sprinkle with flour. Cook and stir 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk and cook stirring often 5 to 7 minutes until simmering and thickened. Stir in potato mixture and remaining ingredients. Yields 4 servings 234 calories.

title: Apples And Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil first six ingredients until thick. Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Layer sweet potatoes and apples (apples need to be sliced thin). Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Cook for 30 minutes in moderate (350\u00b0) oven.

title: Macaroni And Tomato Soup
instructions: Cook the macaroni. Cook the ground beef with the onion and drain. Add the milk to the tomato soup and heat. Add the cooked macaroni and meat.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
