instructions: Soften cream cheese. Cut dried beef in small pieces. Chop onions fine and mix with cream cheese and 2/3 of the dried beef together with other ingredients. Roll into a ball or log with hands. Roll ball in remaining dried beef. Refrigerate and set out 30 minutes before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together and applesauce. Mix raisins with 1/2 cup flour. Sift remaining flour with spices soda and salt. Add dry ingredients to liquid mixture. Beat well. Pour into oiled pan. Bake in very moderate oven 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: I double this and bake at 350\u00b0 for an hour.

title: Pepper Steak And Rice
instructions: Sprinkle steak with paprika and set aside while preparing other ingredients. Brown garlic in margarine and add steak onions and green peppers. Continue cooking until vegetables are wilted. Add tomatoes and broth. Cover and simmer on low heat about 15 minutes. Blend water with cornstarch and soy sauce. Stir into steak. Cook until thickened. Serve over fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fried Squash Sticks
instructions: Slice squash in sticks. Mix flour salt and pepper. Roll squash sticks and fry until golden brown.

title: Delicious Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli flowerets chopped dates bacon onion and nuts or seeds in a large bowl. In separate bowl combine mayonnaise sugar vinegar and milk. Pour over salad mix well and serve!

title: Ice Cream(No Cooking)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and beat with a mixer until well blended. Stir in any flavoring that you want to choose such as strawberries bananas chocolate etc. Pour into freezer. This does not have a canned milk taste.\tMakes about 5 quarts depending on how much fruit is added.

title: Cheese And Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix and dissolve cream cheese in sugar and a little cream. Cook sugar syrup and cold water until dissolved. Soften gelatin in cold water; add to juice. Chill until partially set. Add pineapple cheese and whipped cream. Add English walnuts if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour in a buttered casserole dish.

title: Holiday Cut Outs
instructions: Cream the butter. Add sugar and beat until light. Beat in eggs. Add vanilla and sifted dry ingredients. Add cream; mix very well. Chill several hours. Roll to 1/8-inch thickness. Decorate after cutting out with tree angel bell etc. cutters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen. Dough can be made and frozen.

title: Karen'S Banana Bread
instructions: Mix flour soda and salt; set aside. Mix Crisco oil and sugar. Add eggs. Add flour mixture until well blended. Add bananas and nuts alternating with buttermilk. Add vanilla. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown or approximately 45 minutes (use average loaf pan).

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil fryer; take the meat off the bone. Mix stuffing according to package directions. Mix each can of soup separately with a can of milk until creamy. Layer in casserole dish in this order half stuffing mix chicken meat cream of celery soup half stuffing mix and cream of chicken soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Homemade Pimento And Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and use on bread crackers or as a dip for raw vegetables.

title: Graham Cracker Squares
instructions: Place a layer of graham crackers on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine oleo sugar milk and egg and boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add crumbs pecans and vanilla. Spread this mixture on top of graham crackers. Put another layer of graham crackers. Combine oleo milk and powdered sugar and spread over top of graham crackers.

title: Cheese Snacks
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into balls. Flatten on cookie sheets and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake in 11 x 13-inch pan or casserole. Dilute soup with 1/2 can water in a bowl; stir and set aside. Combine Ro-Tel tomatoes with salsa and set aside. Layer all ingredients in pan starting with chips and ending with cheese and chips. You may make 2 or 3 layers of each ingredient. Bake about 15 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0; grease and flour a tube pan. Blend all ingredients in a large bowl. Beat 3 minutes on high speed. Scrape bowl often. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in tube pan. Frost with cream cheese icing.

title: Melting Moments Cookies
instructions: Sift cornstarch with flour. Cream butter and sugar; add flour mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in water if desired. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Depression Days Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix salt vinegar and water and pour over vegetables and let marinate a couple of hours or overnight. More salt and vinegar can be added to suit taste.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: Fry ground beef and drain; add spaghetti sauce let sit. In large bowl mix cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese eggs parsley salt and pepper. Pour 1 cup of sauce in 9 x 13-inch pan and add layer of uncooked lasagne. Cover with 1 1/4 cups of sauce and 1/3 of cheese mix. Continue with layer of lasagne sauce and cheese mix. Cover with aluminum foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Chicken Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Set aside. Mix chicken soup chilies and sour cream. Place a layer of tortillas (whole or strips) in bottom of a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Spoon on soup mixture then chicken pieces. Sprinkle with cheese. Repeat all layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Italian Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and cool. Drain artichokes reserving 1/4 cup liquid; set aside. Cut artichokes into fourths. Set aside. Combine pasta artichokes reserved artichoke liquid and remaining ingredients in a large bowl; toss gently. Cover and chill. Yield 6 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and cut raw potatoes into quarters and then into 1/2-inch slices. Put in pot and barely cover with water. Add onion parsley salt caraway marjoram and bay leaf. Cook until potatoes are soft. Make a roux from the butter and flour and add a little water from the cooked potatoes to thin. Add this back to the potato mixture to thicken. Stir in vinegar as desired for taste.

title: Marshmallow Creme
instructions: Cook sugar corn syrup and water to 242\u00b0 or medium ball stage. While this mixture is cooking place the Karo syrup and egg whites into a bowl. Beat slowly until mixed then beat hard until light and fluffy. Pour the first mixture into this in a fine stream. When the mixture is completely combined beat hard for 3 minutes. Add vanilla and store in jars or cans. Do not cover until mixture is cold.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Combine in a large bowl. Mix well. Spoon in jars and seal. To serve add 2 teaspoons to a cup of boiling water.

title: Sugar And Spice Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and molasses. Sift together the flour baking soda salt cinnamon cloves and ginger. Add to first mixture. Put in refrigerator to cool (easier to handle). Shape in small balls (flour hands to make easy). Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Dust with powdered sugar while warm. Makes 4 1/2 to 6 dozen.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saut celery in butter until tender. Combine soup and cheese in large bowl. Mix in broccoli and rice; pour in dish. Bake 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Miami Vise
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of electric blender; cover and process until smooth. Serve immediately. Yield 4 cups.

title: Easy Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in blazer pan or chafing dish. Add garlic and cool slightly. Add shrimp; cook stirring frequently until shrimp are tender. Stir in wine and parsley. Heat to boiling. Serve with rice.

title: Ranch-Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients. Chill for at least 1 hour. Serve in hollowed out round bread loaf.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease or spray bottom of 9x13 inch pan. Sprinkle pecans and coconut over bottom of pan. Mix cake according to directions on the box and pour over pecans and coconut mixture. Mix cream cheese butter and sugar together. Pour over cake mixture leaving 1/2 to 1 inch on each side. Bake for 50 minutes. This was always a favorite of Muggsys when he came to the house. Without nuts of course.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Mix together soups chicken and cooked spaghetti. Top with cheddar cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lasagne Roll-Ups
instructions: Cook pasta just enough so it is soft enough to roll. Dont overcook. Drain and lay flat on foil to cool. Combine Ricotta cheese 1/2 cup of Mozzarella cheese egg Parmesan cheese salt and pepper in bowl. Spread cheese filling on each noodle. Top with a little sauce then roll them up. Place in baking dish seam side down. Top with more sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Continue to bake until cheese melts.

title: Eggplant Parmegiana
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Place in shallow dish. Dip eggplant slices in egg and then in flour mixture. Brown slices until golden in hot oil. Drain well on brown paper. Place one layer of eggplant in glass 8 x 8-inch baking dish; top with half of Parmesan cheese Italian sauce and Mozzarella. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is completely melted.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Dip okra in egg mixture then in flour mixture. Fry in hot deep fat.

title: Cranberry Crunch
instructions: Mix margarine flour brown sugar and oats. In separate bowl mix cranberry sauce and sugar. Grease cake pan with a little melted butter. Spread 1/2 of oats mixture in cake pan. Spread cranberry sauce mixture over oats mixture then cover cranberry mixture with remaining oats mixture. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Set aside. In a large bowl beat oil sugar eggs and vanilla at medium speed for 3 or 4 minutes. Gradually add flour mixture; beat until smooth. Fold in pecans and apples. Pour batter into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool on a wire rack for 20 minutes. Dribble with brown sugar topping while warm.

title: Healthful Date Bread
instructions: In a medium bowl combine dates and raisins. Pour boiling water over mixture. Set aside to cool slightly. Stir together flour baking soda baking powder and salt.

title: Louise'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins in water; drain raisins saving 1/3 cup juice. Cream shortening; add sugar and cream again. Add beaten eggs. Stir in oats. Sift flour with spices baking soda baking powder and salt. Add alternately with 1/3 cup raisin water. Add nuts and raisins. Spoon onto cookie sheet with tablespoon or roll into balls by hand. Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly brown at 350\u00b0. Do not overbake or the cookies will be hard.

title: Fresh Apple Or Pear Cake
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients. Combine apples eggs and oil. Stir into dry ingredients. Add pecans and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in tube pan.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls in a 17 x 11 x 1-inch pan and pat together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown 10 to 11 minutes. Cool.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed in oblong pan. Put crushed pineapple on baked cake. then add vanilla pudding. Add sliced bananas then add Cool Whip (spread across bananas) cherries (drain juice and crush) pecans (crushed) and coconut on top (optional). Keep refrigerated.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
instructions: Butter bread placing buttered side on bottom of pan. Layer the Cheddar cheese Velveeta cheese and ham sausage or bacon on top of bread. If bacon or sausage is used brown and fry. Mix the rest of ingredients together and pour on top. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake 1/2 hour covered then 1 hour uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Onion-Raisin Sauce
instructions: Brown tenderloin. Place in 275\u00b0 oven until done slightly pink in middle. In separate pan heat 1 tablespoon butter or oil. Saute onion until caramelized. Add raisins. Mix wine and cornstarch. Add to onion and raisins. Cook until thick. Slice tenderloin; place on sauce. Serve with vegetable and potato or rice.

title: Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar cocoa baking powder and salt then add milk shortening and vanilla. Beat well until fluffy. Mix in nuts and pour into well-greased and floured pan (about 7 x 10-inch pan).

title: Fettucini With Tomatoes, Basil And Feta Cheese
instructions: Mix tomatoes Prosciutto basil olive oil vinegar and garlic in large bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste. Set aside for 1/2 hour. Cook pasta in boiling water until tender. Drain. Add pasta to tomato mixture. Top with Feta cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Chicken Slaw
instructions: Whisk dressing and soy sauce together and set aside. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients (except chow mein noodles). Pour dressing over salad and toss well. Chill until ready to serve. Serve topped with Chinese noodles. (This is really good over hot white rice too.)

title: Creamy Chicken Paprikash
instructions: This is a lean and light dish that is ready to eat in 30 minutes.

title: Layered Salad Deluxe
instructions: Layer spinach lettuce eggs bacon and peas in order listed in a large salad bowl.

title: Yummy Salad
instructions: Combine lettuce carrot and onion in large salad bowl. Cook bacon slices and save bacon grease for later. Crumble bacon into small bits. Mix ramen noodles and almonds on a cookie sheet. Lightly coat the noodle/almond mixture with the bacon grease. Brown the mixture in toaster (or conventional) oven. Make dressing by combining vegetable oil vinegar sugar and soy sauce in a sauce pan. Simmer sauce until sugar is dissolved. Set aside to cool. Add bacon bits and the toasted ramen noodles and almonds to salad in bowl. Mix and serve. Keep dressing separate from salad until salad is served. (Salad will not keep very long once dressing is added.)

title: Quick Berry Punch
instructions: Combine Kool-Aid and cranberry juice cocktail. Just before serving add 7-Up.

title: Hamburger-Stuffed Bread Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Slice top off of loaf and set aside. Remove bread from interior of loaf leaving enough on the sides to form a shell. Tear the bread you removed into small pieces in a mixing bowl. Brown the ground beef and drain well. Return to pan and add onion; cook until onion starts to get soft. Add green pepper (and celery if using) and mix well. Add Worcestershire sauce and seasonings. Add meat mixture to bread pieces in bowl. Mix well; mix in the undiluted soup. Taste test and adjust seasoning. Stuff bread loaf shell with mixture. Top with cheese. If desired spread butter or margarine on the top slice you removed. (You can also sprinkle it with garlic powder or more of the cheese.) Heat stuffed loaf (and top) on a cookie sheet in preheated oven approximately 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Slice and serve.

title: Fun Donuts
instructions: You will also need a paper bag for shaking donuts.

title: Holiday Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large pot and chill well. (I add the cold ginger ale right before serving. This can be frozen if you make it ahead of time.) Makes approximate 128 ounces; twenty (6 ounce) servings.

title: Angel Chocolate And Raspberry Dream(Fat-Free)
instructions: Use an 8-inch square glass baking dish or similar size. Cut half of the cake and cut it in half. Using 1/4 of the cake break into bite size pieces and make a layer of cake pieces in the bottom of the dish. Sprinkle 1 cup of raspberries over the pieces of cake.

title: Never Fail Dinner Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add the biscuit mix and mix well. Knead about 1 minute on a board dusted with flour. Shape into rolls and put on lightly greased baking sheet or muffin tins. Cover with damp cloth and let rise in a warm place about 1 hour. Cook in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Potato And Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops and drain. Peel potatoes and onion; slice thinly. Layer pork chops alternately with onion and potato slices in casserole. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix flour with milk and pour over layers. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Mix all together. Add tiny marshmallows and refrigerate. When serving add 3 to 4 bananas.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Have pastry shell ready; heat oven to 425\u00b0.

title: Coconut Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar beating well at medium speed. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour baking powder and salt and add to creamed mixture gradually adding milk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Add flour and mix. Pour into 3 greased 9-inch pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 23 to 30 minutes.

title: Truffles
instructions: Melt chocolate in a bowl over hot water. Remove bowl from hot water and whisk in butter. Next whisk in egg yolks. Add rum cognac or liqueur. Place bowl over cold water and beat vigorously until chocolate is thick and smooth. Chill until workable. Form into balls with 2 teaspoons; roll in unsweetened cocoa. Place on a chilled plate until firm. Roll in cocoa again and keep chilled in a covered container until served.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Add coconut (not to edge of pan). Next add pecans on top of coconut. Mix boxed cake according to directions; pour over coconut and pecans. Mix the butter cream cheese and powdered sugar; spoon over cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tangy Fruit Punch
instructions: Place 1/2 c. water with bananas & strawberries in blender and process till smooth. Stir in rest of ingredients except ginger ale. Refrigerate and serve with ginger ale.

title: Creme-De-Menthe Dessert
instructions: Melt marshmallows with 1/4 cup milk in double boiler. Let cool. Add creme-de-menthe and heavy cream.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Add milk butter sugar and cocoa. Boil for 2 minutes. Take off stove and add oats vanilla and salt.

title: Farm-Style Beef Sausage
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well and stuff into casing. Great baked broiled or fried.

title: Gourmet Sirloin Tips
instructions: Saute garlic in hot oil. Add meat and brown on all sides over medium heat. Mix remaining ingredients and add to meat. Cover and simmer over low heat on top of range or bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until meat is tender. Serve over hot fluffy rice. Serves 4.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix together and sprinkle additional Parmesan on top. Bake for 1/2 hour or until hot and brown on top at 350\u00b0. Serve with French bread.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Spray an 8 x 8 casserole dish with cooking spray. Combine the first 6 ingredients with 1 cup of Swiss cheese. Place slices of French bread over mixture and sprinkle with parsley. Bake uncovered 30 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together the butter sugar eggs oil and vanilla. Add the flour salt baking soda and cream of tartar. Roll into small balls. Press with a fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Brown chicken in hot oil on all sides. Set aside and continue cooking until all pieces are done. As last of chicken browns add remaining ingredients. Cook slowly for 40 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Add sherry if desired. Serve with pasta and a salad.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Serves 4 people. Coat a medium saucepan with cooking spray. Melt butter over medium heat. Add noodles constantly stirring over low heat until noodles become golden brown. Add rice. Coat with butter. Meanwhile bring water or broth to a full boil. Add at once to rice. Salt and pepper to taste. Put on a tight fitting lid and simmer until water is absorbed. If brown rice is used add more water and cook longer.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix meat rice 1/2 cup water onion celery salt and garlic powder. Shape into balls and pour remaining ingredients. Bake 45 minutes covered. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Spinach And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and spinach in water until completely thawed (but not cooked). Stir in remaining ingredients except bread crumbs. Place in large casserole dish and cover with seasoned bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 12 servings of 1/2 cup at approximately 85 calories per serving.

title: Tomato-Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Rinse in cold water and drain. Stir in tomatoes onions garlic parsley oil salt basil and pepper. Cover and refrigerate about 2 hours or until chilled. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sausage Pitas
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet; add vegetables. Cook until just tender. Lightly toast pita bread. Use spoon to open while warm. Fill with sausage and vegetables.

title: Cranberry-Pear Relish
instructions: Heat all ingredients except liqueur in a large saucepan to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered stirring frequently until mixture thickens about 45 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in liqueur. Refrigerate covered 4 hours or overnight. Serve slightly chilled. Yields 8 cups.

title: Pecan Pie Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and melted butter well. Reserve 2/3 cup of this batter. Spread the rest into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Put corn in large bowl. Mix sugar water syrup salt and butter in saucepan. Cook to 250\u00b0 or until a few drops form a hard ball when dropped into cold water. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and pour in thin stream over corn stirring constantly to mix well. With buttered hands shape into balls. Add food coloring to syrup if desired. Makes 12 to 15 large balls.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate overnight. Serve next day chilled.

title: Chocolate Temptation
instructions: Bake brownie mix according to directions on box adding the pecans. After they are baked remove from oven and crumble into crumbs. Mix chocolate pudding according to directions on box. Place a layer of brownie crumbs in bottom of trifle bowl then a layer of Cool Whip. Continue until you have used all ingredients. It is best when it sits for several hours.

title: Chinese Vermicelli
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together sesame oil soy sauce sugar chili oil and vinegar. Cook vermicelli in boiling water until barely tender (probably less than a minute). Drain rinse with cold water and drain again.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients and place in saucepan and place on heat. Bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. This is very hot so use pepper as you desire.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Saute 1/2 cup chopped onion and 1/2 cup celery until limp. Add Velveeta cheese. Parboil frozen spinach and drain thoroughly. Add spinach cream of mushroom soup and half the bread crumbs to the pan; blend thoroughly. Put this in a baking dish. Sprinkle remaining bread crumbs on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger-Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Spread hamburger in bottom of a square baking dish. Cover with chopped onions; top with Tater Tots. Spread Cheddar cheese soup on top. (If you mix a little milk with the soup it spreads much easier.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Triple Tasty Fudge Bars
instructions: Prepare frosting mix. Combine dry cake mix and 1/2 of prepared frosting water and egg; stir by hand (stiff). Put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan greased on bottom only. Combine sour cream and remaining frosting mix and spread over mixture in pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Chop eggs; add to other ingredients. Mix well.

title: Broccoli With Sesame Dressing
instructions: Cook spinach and broccoli as directed. Drain well. Mix rest of ingredients except onion rings with vegetables. Bake 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Add 1/2 can of onion rings. Mix well and add rest of can on top of casserole. Bake an additional 10 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pat out like a hamburger and fry in butter and oil until brown. Good with pintos or green beans.

title: Sunday Morning Beef Stew
instructions: Lightly spray casserole dish with Pam. Do not brown or salt meat. Put meat in dish. Pepper to taste. Cover with chopped onion. Mix both soups and mushrooms with juice in bowl. Spread soup mixture over meat and onions. Bake covered at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours or at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve over rice noodles or mashed potatoes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Turkey Breast With Sherry
instructions: Remove turkey breast from package. Blot dry using paper towels. Combine flour salt and pepper; dust turkey slices with seasoned flour. Add 2 tablespoons butter in heavy skillet over medium-high heat; brown flour dusted turkey slices about 2 minutes on each side. Remove to warm platter. Add remaining butter and almonds if used to the pan. Brown almonds over medium-high heat and turn almonds out onto platter with turkey breasts. Add sherry to pan. Bring to a boil and scrape pan to bring up brownings. Add cream; boil for 2 minutes. Pour sherry-cream over turkey breasts. Serve immediately.

title: Foolproof White Candy
instructions: In heavy saucepan melt white chocolate with milk. Remove from heat; stir in salt vanilla cherries for color and walnuts. Spread evenly onto wax paper-lined 8-inch square pan. Chill 2 or 3 hours. Turn fudge onto cutting board. Pull off wax paper and cut into squares. (Store at room temperature.)

title: Hearty Tuna Soup
instructions: Combine water or broth with contents of potato mix including seasoning packet. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in tuna milk broccoli and salt. Heat 5 to 10 minutes more until mixture is heated through. Makes 5 servings each with 196 calories 4 grams fat and 15 milligrams cholesterol.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce celery green pepper onion peas and water chestnuts in that order. Cover with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with sugar Parmesan cheese and bacon bits. Add tomato wedges. Cover and store overnight.

title: Caramel-Apple Dessert
instructions: Microwave Directions Toss apples with 1/4 cup wheat germ and flour. Layer apple mixture ice cream topping and raisins in 8-inch square glass baking dish. Microwave at High 6 to 7 minutes stirring after 3 minutes. Separate crescent rolls into 2 rectangles. Stretch dough over apples to edge of dish. Drizzle with margarine; sprinkle with combined remaining 1/4 cup wheat germ and cinnamon. Microwave at High 6 to 7 minutes or until apples are tender. Let stand on countertop for 3 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream if desired.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix well and place in graham cracker crust. Chill thoroughly.

title: Tabooly (Suff-Soof)
instructions: Clean and wash vegetables and chop fine. Wash and soak wheat 10 minutes. Squeeze water from wheat and add vegetables. Add lemon juice oil salt and pepper and mix well. Serve with lettuce grape leaves or cooked cabbage leaves.

title: Crab Chowder
instructions: In 3 to 4 quart saucepan combine all ingredients. Heat to boiling; remove from heat.

title: Chicken And Crab Meat Dressing
instructions: Combine 1/2 stick of melted margarine and catsup; split chicken breasts just enough to fold. Salt and pepper. Brush each piece with the mixture. Place the pieces of chicken in a shallow baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 turning and basting occasionally with the mixture.

title: Birthday And Special Occasion Cake Frosting
instructions: Beat until smooth. Use for frosting and decorating. Half will do a sheet cake.

title: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine 1 1/4 cups sugar cocoa cornstarch and salt in heavy saucepan. Whisk to remove lumps. Gradually whisk in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and comes to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Beat the egg yolks until thick. Stir 1/4 of the hot mixture into the yolks. Add remaining yolks to hot mixture. Cook over medium heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the butter and vanilla.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine celery onion eggs chicken broth and mushroom soup. Add chicken and mix. Place in buttered casserole. Top with cracker crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stromboli
instructions: In a Dutch oven brown beef and drain well. In same Dutch oven saute onion and musheroms with garlic and pepper. Stir in meat and spaghetti sauce. Heat until bubbly. Spread meat mixture over both halves of Italian bread and top with cheese. Broil 6 inches under low flame for 10 minutes.

title: Classic Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter until light. Mix in powdered sugar then vanilla. Work in the flour. Knead dough on unfloured surface until smooth. Use a shortbread pan or jelly roll pan. Spray lightly with nonstick spray. Put ball of dough in the middle of pan and spread to sides. Prick entire surface with a fork then bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until very lightly browned. Be sure middle of shortbread is completely cooked. Cool 10 minutes then loosen with a knife and flip onto a cutting board. Cut while still warm into desired shapes. Top with Lemon Curd jelly or jam or dip in chocolate.

title: Spicy Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs until frothy. Add oil sugar and vanilla. Beat well. Stir in zucchini and pineapple.

title: Potato Puffs
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat eggs. Add potatoes. Combine flour baking powder and salt; stir into potato mixture. In large saucepan or kettle heat about 1-inch of oil to 375\u00b0. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 4 or 5 at a time into hot oil. Fry 2 to 3 minutes turning once or until golden brown. Watch closely since they brown quickly. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately. Yield 1 1/2 to 2 dozen.

title: Chicken-Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook wild rice in 4 cups of water for about 45 minutes; drain. Saute onion and celery in 2 tablespoons butter. Mix all soups together. Blend all ingredients. Season to taste (lemon pepper parsley flakes garlic powder salt and pepper are what I use). Put in buttered casserole dish. Top with crushed potato chips or cornflakes. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Rhubarb Delight
instructions: In an 8 x 12-inch baking dish layer the rhubarb sugar dry gelatin and dry cake mix in that order. Pour water over all and scatter the pieces of oleo over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until cake is lightly browned.

title: Roasted Turnips, Onions And Carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine turnips carrots onions and 8 whole garlic cloves in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Drizzle vegetables with 3 tablespoons of olive oil. Sprinkle with savory. Season with salt and pepper and toss well. Bake until vegetables are almost tender about 45 minutes.

title: Roast Turkey And Cornbread Stuffing
instructions: Rinse turkey and wipe dry; rub with oil then salt and pepper. In a large bowl combine stuffing mix with oil and vegetables; stir in broth. Mix lightly. Stuff loosely into neck and body cavities. Skewer neck skin to back; tuck legs under skin band. Twist wings under turkey. Place turkey breast-side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Place a tent of foil over turkey. Roast at 325\u00b0 for 3 1/2 to 4 hours (180\u00b0 to 185\u00b0 on meat thermometer). Remove foil last 1/2 hour. Cornbread stuffing can be cooked separately the last 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and oil until fluffy. Add pumpkin and mix. Add dry ingredients and mix . Add water and mix. Line bottom of pan with wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 4 loaves.

title: Dad'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Blend all ingredients together using 10 oz. of A-1 steak sauce. Pack into a loaf pan and top with remaining A-1 sauce. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken, Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease bottom of casserole dish with butter. Mix soups and rice together. Pour in dish. Salt and pepper chicken. Place on top of soup mixture. Put pat of butter on each piece. Cook at 250\u00b0 for two and one half hours. Make sure all rice is covered to prevent drying. I cover mine with tinfoil.

title: Caramel Nut Crunch
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter jelly roll pan (15 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch). Heat brown sugar corn syrup margarine and salt in 3-quart saucepan over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in cereal and nuts until well coated. Spread in pan and bake 15 minutes. Cool until slightly firm 5 to 7 minutes. Loosen with metal spatula. Let stand until firm about 1 hour. Makes 8 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Holiday Creams
instructions: A candy thermometer is necessary for this recipe.

title: Gilge Christmas Candy
instructions: Thoroughly mix margarine sweetened condensed milk powdered sugar and vanilla. Divide and add desired flavorings and colorings. Roll into little balls. If balls are too soft to handle freeze them. Then coat with melted chocolate.

title: Spicy Peanut Dip
instructions: In a large bowl mix together all ingredients until smooth. Chill for 1 hour. For dipping serve with assorted fresh or blanched vegetables and pickled baby corn. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Slaw
instructions: Combine ingredients in bowl. Let set a couple hours before serving.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch; gradually add milk until smooth. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick. Reduce heat; cook and stir 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Stir small amount of hot liquid into egg yolks. Return all back to pan. Bring to gentle boil stirring constantly. Cook 20 minutes longer. (Mixture will be very thick.) Add butter and lemon peel. Gently stir in lemon juice. Cover and cool completely. Fold in sour cream; pour into pie shell. Refrigerate 2 hours. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Grease square baking dish. Spread mustard on one side of each slice of rye bread. Cut bread in 1/2-inch cubes. Scatter over bottom of dish. Crumble corned beef over bread. In large bowl mix sauerkraut soup water and relish until blended. Spoon over corned beef. Cover with microwave paper. Microwave on High about 8 minutes (turning twice). Place cheese on top and warm until cheese melts. Let stand 5 minutes then serve.

title: Zucchini Patties
instructions: Mix together all but the cheese. Form into patties. Fry in oil until nicely browned. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese when done.

title: Classic German Chocolate Cake
instructions: In small saucepan over low heat melt chocolate in water; stir. In large bowl beat sugar and shortening until fluffy. Beat in egg yolks and vanilla. Stir in chocolate mixture. In medium bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; add to batter alternately with buttermilk until blended.

title: Chicken Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli. Arrange in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice curry powder and soup. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and margarine. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbly. Makes 8 servings.

title: Banana Nut Loaf
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 55 minutes. Cool on rack before slicing. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: In double boiler over boiling water dissolve cornstarch in water; stir in sweetened condensed milk and egg yolks. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat; add margarine and vanilla. Cool slightly. Arrange 2 bananas on bottom of prepared pastry shell. Pour filling over bananas; cover. Chill 4 hours or until set. Spread top with whipping cream that you have whipped and add sugar and vanilla; garnish with remaining banana slices. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender. Let cool peel and cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick slices. Combine next 6 ingredients in a small saucepan; stir in pineapple juice syrup orange juice and margarine. Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: African Chop Suey
instructions: Brown meat; add onions celery soups water mushrooms molasses rice salt and pepper. Bake 2 hours uncovered at 325\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: In a casserole dish melt stick of margarine in a 375\u00b0 oven; in same dish add the remaining ingredients and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Top with ice cream. Fast and easy dessert!

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and jello. Add pineapple; mix then add marshmallows. Let set for a few hours before eating.

title: 24 Hour Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage and onion and green pepper (optional). Combine oil vinegar sugar and salt. Pour over cabbage mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Will keep 2 weeks or more.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple and sugar; bring to a boil. Add orange jello. Stir until dissolved. Add cold water and let stand until almost congealed. Fold in Cool Whip. Add Cheddar cheese and nuts.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Measure flour; add baking powder salt baking soda sugar and spices. Combine eggs and oil. Pour into flour mixture stirring just enough to moisten the dry ingredients. Add pumpkin and vanilla mixing well. Stir in raisins. Spoon batter into greased or paper-lined medium-sized muffin pans filling each cup 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Makes about 18 muffins.

title: Funnel Cake
instructions: Mix together and pour into funnel. Release and make circles of batter into hot grease. Cook 10 to 15 seconds on each side. Dust with powdered sugar while still hot when placed on plate. Makes 10 (5-inch) cakes.

title: Spinach Puffs
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill in covered dish for 2 or more hours. Roll or shape into balls about the size of walnuts. Freeze or refrigerate until ready to use. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 60.

title: Fresh-As-Spring Salad
instructions: Cut 6 asparagus spears into 4 inch lengths and marinate with cherry tomato halves in 2 tablespoons Italian dressing; cover and refrigerate. Cut remaining asparagus into 1/2 inch pieces; reserve.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Grease tube pan. Cut roll dough pieces in half (while still mostly frozen) and place in pan. Sprinkle brown sugar over dough pieces and sprinkle nuts and cinnamon over brown sugar. Pour melted margarine over all. Cover with a tea towel and leave on countertop overnight. In morning heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until browned and done. Invert on a plate and remove pan.

title: Hot Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Soften cheese and margarine. Mix with the other ingredients. Spread cheese mixture on bread. Layer into 3 layers. Cut into thirds finger size. Seal each slice with cheese mixture (like icing on a cake). This is messy! Place on a cookie sheet and quick freeze. After they harden place in plastic bags in the freezer.

title: Wild Grape Dumplings
instructions: Stir listed items together to form stiff dough. Add 1 or 2 tablespoons more juice if needed.

title: Ginger Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix well and pour over wings. Refrigerate and marinate for 3 to 5 hours. Broil and add a little sauce at a time. Cook 15 to 20 minutes or until crisp.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix stuffing and melted oleo. Use about 2/3 of it to line the bottom of a casserole. Mix soup sour cream grated onion and carrots. Stir in remaining vegetables and place over stuffing layer. Sprinkle remaining stuffing mixture on top. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Hawaiian Pork Chops
instructions: In large skillet quickly brown chops in oil; drain fat. Combine pineapple chunks and juice with ketchup. Add onion salt and pepper and pour over chops. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes. Turn chops. Add green pepper cut into chunks. Cover; cook another 15 minutes. Thicken sauce with cornstarch and water.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Pour into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with cheese if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix well and pour into baking dish.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar and milk to a boil and boil 3 minutes. Turn off heat and add dash of salt vanilla marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Mix and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cut when cool.

title: Coconut Orange Balls
instructions: Mix well crushed vanilla wafers sugar and nuts. Add orange juice and melted margarine. Mix well. Form into small balls and roll in coconut. Store in a cool place. Yields 100.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and garlic. Add tomato paste stirring constantly. When mixed well pour into very large pot and add crushed tomatoes oregano basil parsley and bay leaves. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 2 hours and 45 minutes. Add sugar and Parmesan cheese. Continue to simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool and store extra sauce in freezer. Makes a lot!

title: Tailgate Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Press crescent rolls out on a jelly roll pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Combine cream cheese mayonnaise and dip mix. Spread over cooled rolls. Top with finely chopped vegetables then top with grated cheese. Cut in squares and serve as an appetizer.

title: Hot Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef. Drain. Add Manwich to meat mixture. Mix up cornbread in bowl. Spread 1/2 in bottom of casserole dish. Pour meat mixture on top. Pour remaining batter on top. Bake until brown.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Divide batter. Place in two 9 x 13-inch pans. Bake at 450\u00b0. Yields two 9 x 13-inch pans.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Put oil and flour in pot. Slowly brown flour stirring constantly (flour should be very dark but not burned). Add onions celery parsley and garlic lightly saute. Add tomato paste 5 cups water and other seasonings. Cook for 3 hours on very low temperature. Add raw shrimp. Cook 30 minutes before serving. Just before serving add eggs. Serve over hot rice.

title: Frozen Daiquiris Drink
instructions: Mix all together; put in freezer. If you wish to put in fresh strawberries put strawberries into blender; strain and add juice to the mixture.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together and form into balls. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Turkey A La King
instructions: Mix dressing according to directions. Add raisins and celery. Press in bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix chicken mushrooms and three soups and put on top of dressing. Crush crackers. Mix cheese and butter into crackers. Sprinkle cracker mixture over hot dish. Cover with foil. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Take off foil for last 15 minutes.

title: Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Brown ground beef; add salt pepper and any other spices to taste. Drain. Blend together next 5 ingredients. Place beef in pie shell. Pour milk and mayonnaise mixture over meat. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chile Rellenos
instructions: Layer cheese and chiles. Heat remaining ingredients and pour over layers. Cover and let stand one hour. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Grated Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until slightly firm. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: S'More Supreme(For Kids)
instructions: Place 4 graham cracker halves on your work surface. Spread the first cracker with 1/4 of the softened ice cream. Top with 2 tablespoons of Marshmallow Fluff. Drizzle with 1 1/2 teaspoons of the chocolate syrup and place a cracker over the top. Freeze first Smore while you work on others. Repeat until finished. Serve soon or graham cracker will crumble.

title: Corn Souffle Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs in a large bowl; add both kinds corn cornbread mix sour cream and butter. Mix well. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Party Hors D'Oeuvres(Also Diabetic)
instructions: Cream all ingredients; roll in chopped nuts or celery. Shape into a ball. Chill.

title: Pretzels
instructions: Mix yeast water sugar and salt in a bowl. Add flour; mix well. Put dough on wax paper; knead until smooth. Cut pieces and make into shapes not too thick not too thin. Put on cookie sheet. Brush with beaten egg; sprinkle them with coarse salt. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Good Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: In large skillet brown pork. Add water; cover and simmer until tender (1 hour). Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Mix pineapple syrup brown sugar cornstarch vinegar soy sauce and salt. Cook over medium heat until thickens. Cook pineapple bell pepper and onion in small amount of oil or butter until tender; add to pork mixture. Serve over hot rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add remaining ingredients in order. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hazel'S Christmas Pickles
instructions: Fill a one gallon glass jar with small to medium cucumbers which have been thoroughly washed. Add all the preceding ingredients and finish filling the jar with water. Put lid on and shake well let stand in cool place till December (standing longer will not affect quality). Open jar; drain and wash pickles. Cut into bite size chunks and put back into jar. Dissolve 7 cups of sugar in a quart of water and pour over cucumbers. If necessary add more water to cover pickles; let stand for 2 weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Courtney'S Easy-Cheesy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken bone it and cube meat. Boil broth in saucepan stir in flour to thicken add cheese and let melt. Add noodles and chicken. Pour into casserole. Put buttered bread crumbs on top. Pour evaporated milk over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30- minutes. (May be made ahead and baked when ready.)

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook peeled Irish potatoes in pan of water until just tender. While potatoes are cooking chop onion bell pepper boiled eggs and sweet pickle in bowl. Drain potatoes and pour into onion mix. Add salad dressing and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Peggy'S Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Cut skinned potatoes into thin slices. Pour soup and milk over layered potatoes in a deep baking dish. Place dabs of butter and bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes. (Cover pan with foil.)

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: In a separate large pan add chopped dates orange slices nuts salt and flour. Melt margarine and cream in sugar; add eggs and 1 cup of buttermilk. Add soda to remaining 1/2 cup of buttermilk and add to mixture of oranges dates flour nuts and salt. Mix well with hands. Bake in tube cake pan for 3 or 4 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until done; debone and shred. Cook spaghetti in remaining broth. Saute pepper and onion in butter. Mix spaghetti and soup with cheese. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Creamy Coleslaw
instructions: Fill blender container to top-cup marking with vegetables. Add cold water just to cover vegetables. Cover container; follow manufacturers instructions or run just long enough to chop vegetables about 3 to 4 seconds. Pour mixture into strainer; drain thoroughly. Repeat with remaining vegetables.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
instructions: Brown the meat; add onions and cook a few minutes. Add soup sauerkraut and rice. Bake covered 1 hour at 300\u00b0 then 1 1/2 hours uncovered. Serve with rye bread.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix squash carrots onion sour cream and cheese. Add stuffing mix to butter. Grease dish with butter. Spread small amount of stuffing mixture on bottom of dish. Pour squash into dish and top with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover for 30 minutes or until tender. Drain and let cool to touch. Peel and cut into 1/4-inch strips. Set aside. Combine 1/4 cup butter and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Gently stir in potatoes and cheese.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken and then shred. Add chicken and 1/2 of each of the ingredients and roll into tortillas.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Bring cranberries sugar and water to a rolling boil. Add jello; stir until dissolved. (To make sweeter you may substitute strawberry jello instead of cherry.) When mixture is cool add celery nuts and apples. Mix well and pour into a 9 x 12 baking pan. Let set. Serve by cutting into squares. Enjoy!

title: Meat And Vegetable Stew
instructions: In a nonstick pot put enough oil to coat bottom of pot. Dredge meat in flour with salt and pepper. Heat oil and add meat. Cook until brown. Add any leftover flour to pot. Stir in onion celery bell pepper and garlic. Cover and lower heat to simmer. Cook 1/2 hour. Add water carrots potatoes salt and pepper. Cook slowly 1 hour. Adjust seasoning. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown and crumble sausage (hot or mild; we prefer the hot); drain and cool. Set aside. Beat eggs and milk together with beater a couple of minutes. Add salt and mustard and beat again. Trim crust off white bread and break into small pieces. Add bread to egg mixture and stir until softened. Stir in cheese mushrooms and sausage. Pour into a greased (with butter) 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand a few minutes before cutting. Great luncheon dish as well!

title: Carrot Cake Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Line 12 medium muffin tins with paper baking cups or spray bottoms with nonstick cooking spray. Combine dry ingredients and raisins. Add combined remaining ingredients mixed just until moistened. Fill muffin cups almost full; lightly sprinkle with additional wheat germ if desired. Bake 20 to 22 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 low-fat muffins.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine and bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Scallop Puffs
instructions: Slice French bread in thin slices. Set aside. Saute scallops lemon zest and garlic in butter then add dill. Let cool. Add Swiss cheese and mayo. Place on slices of French bread. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden brown.

title: Chili Cheese Rounds
instructions: Cream softened oleo and cheese. Blend in flour and chili powder. Work it with hands and shape into small balls; press on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Chicken 'N Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put half of the mixture in the bottom of a 9 x\t13-inch pan. Place chicken pieces on rice. Add balance of rice mixture. Parmesan cheese and/or Mozzarella cheese may\tbe added. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 250\u00b0 uncovered. May be baked 1 hour at 375\u00b0. (I prefer the slower cooking.)

title: Chocolate Shot Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and add sugar gradually; cream until fluffy. Add vanilla and flour with soda mixed in; add oatmeal. Chill 30 minutes and then roll dough in log shape. Then roll log in chocolate decors or shots. Cut into 1/4-inch slices. Bake on foil covered cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Florida Pies
instructions: Mix the fruit and nuts together and drain. Mix Cool Whip Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice together. Stir fruit into milk mixture and pour in pie shells. Refrigerate overnight or 4 to 6 hours. Makes 2 large pies.

title: Slushy Fruit Punch
instructions: Process sugar water sherbet bananas pineapple juice orange juice Hawaiian punch and lemon juice about 1/3 at a time in blender. Pour into 1 large or several small freezer containers. Freeze until firm. Let large container stand at room temperature for 1 hour or smaller containers for 30 minutes or until slushy; do not thaw completely. Pour into punch bowl. Add lemon-lime soda to slush mixture just before serving. Garnish with fresh fruit of choice.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Break taco shells or Doritos in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Brown beef and onion in skillet. Add taco mix as directed. Add beans and simmer. Pour over chips. Top with grated cheese. Put in a 325\u00b0 oven just until cheese is melted. Serve with layered salad.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Put in greased casserole. Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing and bake 20 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until brown on top. Good with Ritz crackers.

title: Rib-Ticklin' Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In saucepan stir together all ingredients. Stirring frequently bring to a boil; reduce heat and boil gently 15 minutes to thicken. Brush on meat turning frequently during last 20 minutes of cooking. Makes 2 cups.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl the hash browns soup sour cream 3/4 of the melted margarine cheese onion salt and pepper. Pour into a 9 x 11-inch glass Pyrex dish. Mix the remaining margarine with the corn flakes and top the hash brown mixture. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fresh Cranberry Orange Relish
instructions: Slice unpeeled orange into eighths. Remove seeds. Place half the cranberries and half the orange slices in food processor container. Process until mixture is evenly chopped. Transfer to a bowl. Repeat with remaining cranberries and orange slices. Stir in sugar to desired sweetness. Store in refrigerator or freezer. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

title: Carolina Christmas Cake
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually. Add well beaten egg and applesauce (Use a little of the flour to dredge fruit and nuts). Sift remaining flour mixture alternately with the water to the creamed mixture. Add flour raisins and nuts.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Cook manicotti according to package directions. Mix next 10 ingredients together. Stuff into cooked manicotti. Place into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan into which 1/2 of the sauce has been poured. Pour remaining sauce over the manicotti. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Can be made ahead freezes well before or after baking.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Sift together flour cream of tartar baking soda & salt. Set aside.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix margarine 3 cups flour vanilla water sugar eggs and lemon extract to make batter. Dredge fruit nuts raisins and coconut in 1 cup flour. Add to batter mix. Put into Bundt pan. Put pan of water in oven on shelf under cake. Cook 1 hour at 325\u00b0 then remove water from oven. Continue to cook cake until knife comes out clean.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in flour and slowly add chicken broth. Cook and stir until thick. Stir in milk sherry salt and pepper. Gradually add cheese. Stir in cooked chicken cubes and peas. Serve over rice. Makes 2 1/4 cups gravy.

title: Cocktail Franks
instructions: In a saucepan combine equal portions of mustard and jelly. Heat slowly on low heat until jelly melts and sauce becomes smooth and well blended. Remove strings from franks and place in sauce. Heat 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Let the cream cheese soften. Mix the soften cheese together with the pineapple onions and ham. Form into a ball. Roll in the nuts to coat the cheese ball. Place on an attractive serving dish place in the refrigerator until it is well chilled and serve with party crackers.

title: Salmon Bits
instructions: Drain salmon; reserve 1/4 cup liquid. Break meat apart. Add flour and slightly beaten egg. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add baking powder to liquid; beat until foamy. Pour into salmon mixture. Drop by teaspoon in deep fryer half full of oil. Remove from oil as soon as brown. These are very crisp and light.

title: Blackberry Jam Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in jam and preserves. Stir together all dry ingredients. Add alternately with buttermilk to jam mixture. Bake for 40 minutes in 3 well-greased cake pans or Bundt pan. Cool for 5 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Bourbon Slush
instructions: Mix together and freeze and keep frozen. Use ice cream scoop and fill glass 3/4 full. Add 7-Up and stir. Add cherry. This will keep frozen for a long time.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Put tomato soup in 2 quart saucepan and bring to a boil. Lower heat and add gelatine and stir for 4 minutes. Add cream cheese and stir until smooth. Take off heat. Fold in mayonnaise celery onion and shrimp. Put into a 4 cup mold and chill overnight.

title: Beef, Bean And Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Cook beef onion and garlic in a large saucepan coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat until browned stirring frequently to crumble the beef. Drain the beef mixture in a colander.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour eggs and butter. Add pecans chocolate chips and vanilla. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes one pie.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar salt and flour. Beat until creamy. Add corn syrup butter and extract. Stir in pecans. Pour in pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Confetti Brownies
instructions: In a large bowl combine crumbs marshmallows nuts and sugar. In a saucepan melt chocolate chips and milk over low heat stirring often until blended smooth. Remove from heat. Add extract if desired. Set aside 1/2 cup. Pour remaining chocolate mix over crumb mix; mix until well blended. Pour batter onto greased 8-inch square baking pan. Press down evenly. Frost with reserved chocolate mixture. Chill for an hour.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Sift flour and other dry ingredients. Combine egg milk and oil. Mix together and fry on pancake griddle.

title: Chicken Corn Soup
instructions: Cover chicken with water salt and pepper and cook until done. Take chicken out of broth to cool. Chop potatoes onion and celery. Add to the chicken broth along with the corn. Add crushed pepper flakes. Cook until done. Pick chicken off bones and add to soup. This can be used as is or thicken with rice noodles or rivels. If you use any of these cook again until done.

title: Vegetable Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Chill overnight or until you can roll into ball. Roll in crushed nuts or parsley.

title: Cranberry Ice
instructions: Boil cranberries in cold water until mushy. Put through sieve. Add sugar and cook on low heat until sugar dissolves. Add orange juice and rind. Put in freezer until hard. Remove and beat until frothy. Refreeze. Serve with a turkey dinner. A holiday tradition.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix pulp eggs and milk. Sift dry ingredients together and add to pulp mixture. Pour into greased pan to depth of 2-inches. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Rocky Road
instructions: Place chocolate morsels milk and butter in top of a double boiler; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cook until chocolate and butter melts stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in pecans and marshmallows. Spread mixture into a waxed paper lined 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Chill at least 2 hours. Cut into 1 1/2 inch squares store in refrigerator. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients together and chill.

title: Vegetable Chili
instructions: Chop green peppers and onions. Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/4s; cut each 1/4 crosswise into 1/2-inch slices.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and milk. Spread on top of cool pie crust. Slice half of the strawberries on top of the cream cheese mixture. Cook the other half of the strawberries cornstarch and lemon juice until it thickens. When cool spread on top.

title: Australian Sultana Loaf
instructions: In bowl beat potatoes with the sugar. Sift the flour baking powder and salt. Combine with potato mixture. Stir in the raisins then add milk and spices. Beat well. Pour into a greased loaf tin. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Allow to cool.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour a 9 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan.

title: Low Calorie Beef And Potato Casserole
instructions: Grease a 2-quart casserole. Arrange diced potatoes in bottom and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon crumbled oregano 1/4 teaspoon salt and some freshly ground pepper. Crumble ground chuck over potatoes in an even layer. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon more oregano 1/4 teaspoon salt and some more pepper.

title: Grandma Honey'S Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Roll into balls the size of quarters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly browned. Cool. Roll in confectioners sugar. Yields 36 cookies.

title: Apple Ring Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Slice peel and cut centers out of cucumbers. Soak overnight in lime water. Drain and soak overnight in ice water; leave in icebox the next day for 4 hours. Next mix sugar vinegar alum salt red hots food coloring and cinnamon sticks; bring to boil. Reduce heat and boil gently for 30 minutes. Can in jars.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Mix 1/2 of margarine and cream cheese with hot spinach. Add egg; mix well. Pour into 9 x 9-inch dish. Mix rest of margarine (melted) with bread crumbs. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Simmer sauce and grape jelly while meatballs are baking. Use crock-pot.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients and marinate chicken breasts overnight. Roll chicken breasts in bread crumbs and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes in foil covered pan at 325\u00b0. Open foil for last few minutes of baking time.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Blend in remaining ingredients adding more milk if mixture is too thick. Sprinkle additional cornmeal on bottom of hot greased iron skillet. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Stir And Bake Bars
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients. Add the water and eggs and mix until well blended. Spread in a 15 x 10-inch pan. Sprinkle with chopped nuts combined with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool before cutting in squares.

title: Impossible Coconut Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 until set. Makes 2 pies.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place drained pineapple in casserole dish. Mix sugar and flour and sprinkle on top of pineapple. Add grated cheese followed by crushed crackers. Pour melted margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes uncovered. Serve warm.

title: Olga'S Pound Cake
instructions: In measuring cup break in eggs plus enough milk to make 1 cup. In mixing bowl cream shortening with sugar. Beat eggs with milk slightly and add to shortening and sugar. Sift flour and salt together. Add baking powder. Add to creamed mixture and mix until all is well mixed at a low speed. Then add 3/4 cup milk some lemon rind or vanilla. Mix for 2 minutes at medium speed. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash onion and water in saucepan. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until squash is tender. Drain and mash. Combine squash cheese pecans green peppers mayonnaise egg salt sugar and pepper stirring well. Spoon into greased 2-quart casserole. Combine cracker crumbs and butter stirring well. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Goofy Bars
instructions: Place dry cake mix in a bowl. Put eggs in measuring cup and add enough water to make 2/3 cup. Add to brown sugar and beat until well blended. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chips and marshmallows on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Ashton'S Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except walnuts in greased casserole. Sprinkle nuts around outside edges. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator to warm. Bake uncovered 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vidalia Onion Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cracker crumbs and 4 tablespoons butter; press into 8-inch pie plate. Melt 2 tablespoons butter. Saute onions until tender. Beat other ingredients except cheese together. Pour onions over cracker crust. Pour other mixture over onions. Sprinkle with grated cheese and dot with paprika or parsley flakes. Bake 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add sugar mayonnaise and vanilla. Mix cocoa and water together. Put into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Chili Bake
instructions: Combine rice and chicken broth in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 50 minutes or until rice is tender and moisture is absorbed. Combine chicken and remaining ingredients in a large bowl; stir in rice. Spoon mixture into a 2-quart casserole coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Yield 5 servings.

title: Eggplant Genovese
instructions: Mix the tomato paste with an equal amount of water. Add herbs salt and sugar; simmer on low heat to a boil. Cut the eggplant in one-inch slices lengthwise. Pour oil in casserole and alternate layers of eggplant slices with cheese finishing with the cheese. Pour the tomato sauce over it and bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll out dough on well floured towel to about 1/4-inch deep. Cut with doughnut cutter or in strips if desired. Fry in deep fryer until golden brown. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Wash cut up and partially cook broccoli. Drain. Add garlic cheese almonds margarine onion soup mushrooms parsley oregano salt and pepper.

title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook onion until tender. Stir in soup milk and pepper. Heat to boiling. Add potatoes. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until hot and bubbling stirring occasionally. Garnish with sage if desired. Cooking time is about 10 minutes.

title: Clam Cakes
instructions: Mix in order given and fry in deep fat. It is extremely important that you mix the ingredients in the order given or the results will not be as good.

title: Rice And Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook beef until brown. Drain and add remaining ingredients. Bake for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Heavenly Biscuits
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Let set until completely dissolved stirring occasionally. Add to Bisquick. Stir vigorously 2 minutes. Pour onto a floured sheet of wax or plastic wrap. Knead until smooth. Cover with mixing bowl and let rest 10 to 15 minutes. Press down and cut out biscuits with a 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place in a greased baking dish and let rise for at least 30 minutes. If using a glass baking dish bake for 18 minutes at 425\u00b0. Yields 15 biscuits. Brush with butter after baked.

title: Zucchini Souffle
instructions: Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex pan. Grate zucchini and chop onion. Beat eggs. Add oil and Bisquick; blend thoroughly. To this mixture add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix milk and soup. Microwave on high 2 minutes. Stir. Add green beans. Microwave on high 2-3 minutes. Add onions and almonds. Microwave on high another 2-3 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and dust with flour a 17 1/4 x 11 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan. In a medium mixing bowl beat eggs for 5 minutes on medium speed. Add all other ingredients one at a time in any order mixing well after each addition until entire mixture is creamy smooth.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Blend cheese butter and margarine well in mixer. Add sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs and flour alternately (mix as follows one egg 1/2 cup flour continue). Blend well. Add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Start cake in cold oven. Turn oven to 300\u00b0 and bake for approximately 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown. Remove from pan immediately. Cake stays fresh over a week and freezes well.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Gently wash mushrooms; remove stems. Finely dice stems; set aside. Place mushroom caps open end up in a large flat casserole. Melt approximately 1/2 of the stick of the butter. Add the onion and mushroom caps. Lightly saute until golden. Remove from heat; add the diced pepperoni and bread crumbs mixing well. (I usually use 1 cup of crumbs first to see how well the mixture holds together. If I need more I use more.) Stir in the shredded cheese. Stuff the mushroom caps; drizzle with the remaining melted butter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 12 to 15 minutes or until cheese melts in topping and mushrooms are light golden brown. You can also broil these appetizers at 425\u00b0 for about 5 to 8 minutes. Serves 16 to 25.

title: New Zealand Salad
instructions: Mix well. Delicious poured over grapefruit sections and sliced avocado on lettuce.

title: Quick Cheese Fondue
instructions: In a 4-cup glass measure blend soup and milk; cook 3 to 4 minutes stirring halfway through cooking time. Add garlic powder and nutmeg; stir to blend. Blend in cheese. Cook 2 to 3 minutes stirring every minute until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Caesar Salad With Sourdough Croutons
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients in processor or blender. With machine running gradually add oil in thin steady stream. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Prepare 1 day ahead. Cover and chill. Bring to room temperature before serving. Combine lettuce onion and croutons in a large bowl. Toss with enough dressing to season to taste. Sprinkle with cheese and serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Eyes Of Texas Salad
instructions: Combine cooled black-eyed peas rice and chicken. Add remaining ingredients; blend well and pack into an oiled 5 1/2 cup mold. Refrigerate until set. Unmold and spread with Avocado Topping. (Dont like molds? Just use a casserole dish.)

title: Orange Apricot Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Let set. Once congealed top with cool whip and marshmallows. Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over marshmallows.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Squeeze water from spinach. Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl. Mix thoroughly and chill for 1 hour. Nice when served with sliced pumpernickel!

title: Brownies
instructions: Blend oil sugar and vanilla. Add eggs. Separately combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add egg mixture. Bake in greased and floured 12 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Viva La Chicken
instructions: Wrap each chicken breast in foil. Bake for 1 hour in 400\u00b0 oven. Cook and save juice. Bone and cut in large pieces. Cut the tortillas in 1-inch strips. Grease bottom and sides of oblong Pyrex casserole dish. Put the round sides of tortillas around the edge of the dish. Put half of the strips on the bottom. Mix together soups milk onion and salsa. Pour juice from chicken in bottom of dish. Put half of chicken pieces over the bottom then half of the sauce. Repeat the layers starting with tortilla strips. Put cheese on top. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Pork Chop Delight
instructions: To large casserole dish add cooked potatoes cooked carrots and frozen broccoli. Cover with margarine parsley and onions. Top this with pork chops. Pour onion soup mix and water over pork chops. Cover with foil and bake for 2 hours at 400\u00b0.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix well; chill and serve. You can substitute peach pie filling for apricot pie filling and can of apricots for can of peaches. You can top with Cool Whip if desired. Salad will last longer without bananas in it.

title: Wiener-Bean Pot
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In an 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish combine undrained tomatoes (chopped) mushrooms (optional) and 4 tablespoons Village Saucerie. Place chicken over sauce mixture. Sprinkle remaining 2 tablespoons Village Saucerie over chicken; spread evenly. Cover dish with foil. Bake 30 minutes. Uncover; sprinkle chicken with Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together and bring to a boil. Simmer 1/2 hour. Cool. Baste meat.

title: Low Calorie Pineapple Cheesecake
instructions: Blend together first two ingredients in a blender. Then add the next four ingredients and blend until smooth. Then fold in last 2 ingredients and pour into large baking dish. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into slices and serve.

title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup of the cheese and croutons. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with reserved 1/2 cup cheese and croutons. Bake for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet; add garlic onion green pepper and zucchini. Cook about 3 minutes or until onion is tender stirring frequently. Add eggplant and spices; cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes; cover and cook 5 minutes longer or until tomatoes are heated.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Roll out biscuits until you have one huge round. Spread sausage over it and roll up like a jelly roll. Cut\tinto 1/2-inch rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Grandma'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening together. Add the molasses mixture and beaten egg. Sift the flour with the other spices and baking powder add to the creamed mixture alternately with cold water and soda mixture. Roll out and cut the cookies into round shapes or place by teaspoonfuls onto a cookie sheet and press down with the base of a glass covered with flour (quicker). Sprinkle with sugar and top with a walnut or pecan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes (keep watch).

title: Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and shortening in mixer. Add eggs. Beat well. Add oats flour coconut soda and vanilla. Blend until mixture is moistened. Drop onto greased baking sheet using #40 dipper. Bake in a 18 x 26-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned around edges. Do not overbake. Yield 200 cookies.

title: Rice Krispie Chicken Supreme
instructions: Place crushed cereal in a shallow dish; stir in paprika. In another dish beat egg and milk slightly. Add flour salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Mix until smooth.

title: Sarah'S Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Stir in the sour cream sugar and vanilla. Fold in the whipped topping. Spoon the mixture into the prepared crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Creole Burgers
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add onions and saute. Add ground beef and brown. Drain well if needed. Add remaining ingredients. Stir well. Turn heat to low and simmer covered for 30 minutes. Serve over toasted bread or hamburger buns. Great served with a green salad.

title: Marshmallow Puffs
instructions: Mix sugar oleo and egg and cream well. Add pineapple flour baking soda and nuts. Mix well. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. When cookie is baked put 1/2 marshmallow on each sticky side down while resting on oven door. Put back in oven 1 second. Remove and cool on cloth. Frost cookie; dip in coconut and put cherry on top.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Use first 3 ingredients for each pint jar. Place 1/2 teaspoon dill weed in bottom of jar. Wash okra; place in jar. Add other 1/2 teaspoon dill. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil. Pour over okra in jar. Seal and allow to stand for 2 weeks before eating.

title: Apricot Jam
instructions: Heat the applesauce until its hot and bubbly. Then turn the heat to a low setting and add the Jell-O and sugar. Stir this mixture until the sugar and Jell-O dissolves. Cool and place in containers. This jam must be stored in the refrigerator. Enjoy this jam on homemade bread or biscuits.

title: Brazilian Salad
instructions: Combine fruit and vegetables mix with mayonnaise and lemon juice and season. Serve on lettuce.

title: Kielbasa Appetizers
instructions: Combine all ingredients except kielbasa in medium saucepan; stir well. Cook over low heat 2 to 3 minutes stirring constantly. Add kielbasa and cook until thoroughly heated. Serve warm.

title: Mrs. Thelma'S Jam Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening. Add sugar gradually; cream until light and fluffy. Beat egg yolks; add to creamed mixture. Sift together the soda nutmeg cloves cinnamon and flour. Combine jam and sour milk. Add dry sifted ingredients and jam mixture to the creamed mixture. Add raisins. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into batter. Divide the batter equally into 2 (8-inch) cake pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Nut Bread
instructions: Combine all wet ingredients and sugar; mix all dry ingredients together. Add wet ingredients to dry and mix. Add nuts and chips. Bake in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Make 1 large or 2 small loaves.
