title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Cook chicken and cut in pieces. Mix soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Put broccoli on the bottom of a 9 x 9-inch pan. Place chicken on top of broccoli. Put soup mixture over that. Spread shredded cheese on top of dressing. Sprinkle lemon juice on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mother'S Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain veggies and mix with onion green pepper and celery. Mix sugar wine vinegar and oil together and pour over veggies. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Saute hamburger until brown. Drain fat. Add tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes. Add water and bring to a boil. Add Veg-All soup mix and orzo. Sprinkle with parsley flakes oregano and garlic salt. Lower heat and simmer 1 hour. Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Paintbrush Cookies
instructions: Mix well in bowl the sugar shortening honey egg and vanilla. Sift together in another bowl the sifted flour soda and salt.

title: Chive Muffins
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large bowl and make a well in center of mixture. Combine rest of ingredients and add to dry ingredients stirring just to moisten. Spoon batter into greased muffin pans filling about 2/3 full. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until muffins are lightly browned. Remove muffins from pan immediately.

title: Parsnip Pie
instructions: Saute parsnips leeks onions and garlic in olive oil over medium heat; do not allow this mixture to brown. You can mix a little butter with your olive oil if you like. Layer mixture alternately with Parmesan cheese into crust. Some times we mix in some sauteed spinach as well. Season to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with sliced tomatoes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pizza(Makes Two Dough Crusts)
instructions: Mix yeast and water together. Pour into flour and salt. Add 2 more cups flour. Grease bowl and let sit 1 1/2 to 2 hours until dough doubles in size; punch down and refrigerate for 2 hours. Mix tomato sauce garlic oregano basil sugar and salt and let simmer for 5 minutes. Roll out dough and top with favorite toppings. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Schnitzel
instructions: Beat egg milk and oil together. Dip turkey slices in egg mixture then in crumbs. Place in a single layer in greased baking pan. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 turning once. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream butter brown and white sugar. Add eggs salt and chocolate (melted in boiling water). Alternately add buttermilk and dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in layers or 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Scoop egg yolks from egg. Mix all ingredients except paprika. Fill egg whites with yolk mixture. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Combine all ingredients except candy kisses in large mixing bowl. Mix on lowest speed of mixer until dough forms. Shape dough into balls using 1 rounded teaspoon for each. Roll balls in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Top each cookie immediately with kiss. Press down firmly so cookie cracks around edge.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Combine flour and baking powder. Add grated cheese and chopped nuts; mix well. Add eggs milk and oil. Batter will be lumpy. Pour batter into pan and bake for 1 hour. Turn out on rack to cool.

title: Truly Different Cupcakes
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine in a heavy pan. Add butter flavoring and pecans and stir to coat pecans. Remove from heat. Combine sugar flour eggs and vanilla; mix only until blended. Do not beat. Add chocolate-nut mixture and again mix carefully without beating. Pour into 18 baking cups in muffin pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Angel Food Quickie
instructions: Slice angel food cake in bottom of 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Layer fruit next. Cover with one box instant vanilla pudding mixed with 2 cups milk and 8 ounces sour cream. Cover with carton of Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and melted butter. Add beaten eggs and pecans to syrup mixture. Add flavoring and pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Slaw
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate.

title: Loretta'S Red Rice
instructions: Saute green pepper celery and onion with sausage in a tablespoon of butter. Add tomato sauce tomato paste 2 cans water sugar and spices. Bring to a boil and add rice. Reduce heat. Cover and let simmer for 20 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed.

title: Mushroom Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Unroll crescent roll dough onto baking sheet and pinch together seams. Toss sliced mushrooms in melted butter to coat. Arrange mushrooms on top of dough. Sprinkle with cheese and Italian seasoning. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut into wedges or squares with a pizza cutter and serve warm. Makes 8 to 10 appetizer servings.

title: Easy And Fast Pecan Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar and Cool Whip and put into 9 x 13-inch spray coated baking dish. Sprinkle chopped pecans over mixture. Cut each biscuit into quarters and place tightly together over mixture and nuts. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool for a few minutes before turning baking dish over onto a flat dish or cookie sheet. Pecan rolls will drop easily onto dish or cookie sheet.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Drop noodles into 6 cups rapidly boiling water; heat to rapid boil. Cook stirring constantly 3 minutes; cover and remove from heat.\tLet stand for 10 minutes; drain. Heat oven to\t350\u00b0. Stir margarine and onion into noodles. Stir eggs into sour cream. Stir egg mixture ham salt pepper and caraway seed if desired into noodles. Sprinkle bread crumbs evenly in a greased 2-quart casserole.\tPour noodle mixture into casserole. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered until mixture is set 40 to 45 minutes. Serve from casserole or\tunmold\tonto heated platter. To unmold loosen edge of noodles around inside rim with knife. Place inverted platter over casserole; invert noodles onto platter. Garnish with parsley if desired. Serves 4.

title: Steak And Gravy
instructions: Cover bottom of skillet to 1/4 to 1/2-inch of oil. Heat. Lightly salt and pepper steak pieces. Roll steak in flour until covered. Fry breaded steak in oil until browned on both sides. Drain well. Put meat in gravy.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix and put in baking dish. Mix crust up and pour on top.

title: Piccadillo(Pic-A-De-O)
instructions: Combine all seasonings; stir with fork. Saute onions and peppers in 2 tablespoons olive oil; set aside. Saute meat in 2 tablespoons olive oil; stir in seasonings. Add Worcestershire sauce and tomato sauce; stir well.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar and margarine for 20 minutes. Then add lemon extract and flour. Beat for 5 more minutes. Then add 7-Up and beat for 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate 24 hours. Will keep in refrigerator 2 weeks.

title: Chocolate Icebox Dessert
instructions: Cut oleo into flour with pastry cutter. Add nuts and cut again. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 and chill. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Mix in Cool Whip and spread on pie crust. Chill.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Precook chicken and broccoli separately. Spread broccoli in a casserole and place chicken on top. In separate bowl combine soup mayonnaise and lemon juice. Pour over chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle cheese and bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Thoroughly cream oil butter and both sugars. Add vanilla and eggs. Sift dry ingredients. Stir in and blend. Roll teaspoon of dough into a ball; roll ball into granulated sugar. Press down on a lightly greased cookie sheet with a glass tumbler dipped in sugar. Bake about 12 minutes. Makes 8 dozen cookies.

title: Savory Sirloin Steak
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Combine rosemary and pepper; sprinkle over steak. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add margarine and place over medium heat until margarine melts. Add steak and cook 6 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness. Remove steak from skillet; transfer to a serving platter and keep warm. Combine yogurt mustard and Worcestershire sauce in a small saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thoroughly heated (do not boil). Spoon sauce over warm steak. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Bisquick Caramel Rolls
instructions: Mix Bisquick and water. Roll out and spread with 2 tablespoons margarine. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Roll up and cut into slices. Melt 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons margarine and add brown sugar. Place spoonfuls of mixture in bottom of muffin cups. Place a slice of dough in each cup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Salsa
instructions: Simmer all ingredients in large pot uncovered for 1 hour. Make paste of 6 tablespoons cornstarch and 2/3 cup water. Add to sauce and simmer to thicken.

title: Basic Muffins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425\u00b0. In a large bowl combine the oat bran cereal nuts raisins and baking powder. Stir the brown sugar or liquid sweetening. Mix the milk egg whites and oil together and blend in with the oat bran mixture. Line muffin pans with paper baking cups and fill with batter. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes. Test for doneness with a toothpick; it should come out moist but not wet. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Forever Amber Candy
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bake in a 10 x 15-inch pan for 45 minutes at 300\u00b0. Take from oven and spoon into bowl of powdered sugar and roll. When taken from oven dip with 1 teaspoon and use another to roll. Makes about 60 cookies.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Makes 2 loaves. Put sauce on top of loaves before baking.

title: Cheddar Bay Biscuits
instructions: Preheat heat oven to 450.

title: Seafoam Salad
instructions: Heat to dissolve pineapple juice and lime Jell-O. Cool until slightly thickened. Cream the cream cheese and Miracle Whip. Add this to whipped cream and crushed pineapple. Mix all together and put in a mold; chill. Green food coloring may be added for a little more color.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Grease well and flour a stem cake pan. Into bowl put butter and sugar and cream thoroughly. Add flour and eggs alternately beginning and ending with flour. Mix thoroughly after each addition. Add vanilla last of all. Pour batter into pan and start in a cold oven. Cook 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Do not open oven door during that hour. If not quite golden brown at end of time increase heat to 350\u00b0 and allow another 5 minutes or so.

title: Grandmas Peach Pie
instructions: In a large bowl stir the above ingredients together and transfer to nutmeg pie crust. Dot with butter and top with nutmeg pastry. Cut 12 slits in top of pastry to allow steam to escape. Cover pastry edge with foil. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake 20 to 25 minutes longer until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly in the center.

title: Cool Whip Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice thoroughly. Add pineapple Cool Whip and nuts. Pour into 3 prepared graham cracker shells. Chill 3 or 4 hours. May be frozen. May garnish with red or green cherries. Makes 3 pies.

title: Old Fashioned Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl; beat until smooth using a wire whisk. Layer half of cooked macaroni in bottom of a greased 9-inch square baking dish sprinkle with 1 2/3 cups cheese and layer remaining macaroni on top. Pour milk mixture over macaroni; sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Bake uncovered for 50 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and continue baking 5 minutes longer or until set. Serves 6 to 10.

title: Microwave Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Pop corn. Combine corn syrup margarine and sugar. Heat and bring to boiling. Boil 3 minutes stirring often. Remove from heat and add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Stir well it will be foamy. Pour over popcorn in a large bowl and toss or stir well. Coat a large grocery bag with Pam or any baking spray put corn in bag. Turn down top of bag until closed. Microwave on power 7 for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove bag open up and shake well. Microwave again on power level 7 for 1 1/2 minutes. Take out and shake again. Put in and microwave for 30 seconds longer (if it is not brown enough place in large bowl or on wax paper. Separate it. Cool and store. All microwaves may vary so dont over cook it.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix and add raisins. Add 2 eggs beaten. Cook for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water. Mix well then add 1 cup juice. When partly congealed add pineapple celery nut meats and cream cheese that has been creamed well. Then fold in whipping cream. Chill.

title: Potato Soup(Yia Yias)
instructions: In 6-quart pot boil potatoes until tender not mushy. Drain. Saute celery and onion in a little oil and butter; set aside. Put potatoes into pot; mash coarsely. Add onion and celery. Add hot milk salt and pepper. Add chicken broth. Stir well. If\ttoo thick add more\tmilk to thickness you desire.\tWe like it thick.

title: Seafoam Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water with lemon juice. Add remaining ingredients mixing well. Chill.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Beat the butter at medium speed with electric mixer about 2 minutes until creamy. Gradually add sugar beating at medium speed 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating just until yellow disappears. Combine flour and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix at lowest speed just until blended after each addition. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 to 15 minutes; remove from pan and let cool completely on wire rack.

title: Fitas
instructions: Saute meat onions and peppers until done. Fill shells; add tomatoes and cheese. Wrap and pour picante sauce over them or some people like to put picante sauce inside shell.

title: Mesquite Grilled Cajun Turkey
instructions: Prepare grill for indirect method. Brush turkey with oil. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over turkey. Place turkey on grill. Cover grill and cook according to package directions. Wrap in foil and let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Remove netting from turkey and slice turkey.

title: White Chocolate Mousse With Frangelico
instructions: Melt the white chocolate and butter in a small saucepan stirring constantly. Set aside. Beat egg yolks sugar and liqueur until the mixture forms a slowly dissolving ribbon when the beaters are lifted. Pour the mixture into the top of a double boiler and cook whisking constantly over simmering water until very thick about 3 minutes. Remover to a large mixing bowl. Whisk in the white chocolate mixture and stir until smooth and cool. Beat the cream until the peaks are stiff.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Honey Sauce For Fruit
instructions: Combine honey and sour cream. Just before serving drizzle over individual fruit cups. Makes 1 to 1 1/4 cups.

title: Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Brown sausage and pour off grease. Add onion garlic celery and green pepper to sausage; simmer until tender. Wash rice and add to mixture along with soups. Bake in oblong 9 x 13-inch dish for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Grape Conserve
instructions: Wash the fruit; remove grapes from stems. Remove skins from pulp. Cook pulp until soft; strain to remove seeds. Place the skins and strained pulp into a preserving kettle. Extract the juice from oranges and lemons; add juices and rind to the grape mixture and cook about 1 hour. Measure the sugar and grape mixture to equal amounts. Add nuts and salt. Continue to cook until thick. Pour into sterilized jars. Cool and pour melted wax on top.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mixer. Grease and flour 3 layer cake pans. Pour batter into pans and bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Place everything into a roaster or large crock-pot. Cover with the V-8 juice and cook 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 in the oven or 6 hours in the crock-pot.

title: Easy Clam Chowder
instructions: In a 3-quart pan combine potato mix amounts of water and milk called for on potato package clam juice onion and pepper. Cover and cook until potatoes are cooked. Add clams milk and butter. Bring to boil and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes. Serve hot. Season to taste.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Put everything except marshmallows in saucepan. Place over medium heat and stir constantly until it comes to a boil. Continue cooking 1 to 1 1/2 minutes until bubbly. Drop in 10 marshmallows. Take off heat and beat with beater until smooth and ready to spread.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients thoroughly. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the butterscotch chips on top. You can also sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Chop the tomatoes into 1/4 inch pieces. Toss with 2 Tbsp. garlic in a bowl. Add the basil vinegar 1/3 c. olive oil salt and pepper and mix well. Let stand at room temperature for at least 15 minutes. Rub bread with the cut side of the garlic halves and brush bread with 1/4 c. olive oil. Place on grill rack. Grill for 5 to 8 minutes or until toasted. Arrange the bread on a serving plate and top with the tomato mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Pork And Corn Stuffing Bake
instructions: Combine soup stuffing celery onion and paprika. In 9-inch greased pie plate spoon stuffing. Arrange chops on stuffing pressing lightly into stuffing. Combine sugar and mustard. Spread mixture evenly over chops. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until chops are no longer pink. Garnish with celery leaves if desired. Serves 4.

title: Pasta And Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Combine water salt carrot and beans in a 6-quart pot. Simmer until beans are tender.

title: Foundation Cake
instructions: *If self-rising flour is used omit salt and baking powder.

title: Chili-Cheese Pie
instructions: In 8 ounce nonstick skillet heat 1 teaspoon margarine over medium heat until bubbly and hot. Add onion and garlic; saute about 3 minutes. Add beef chilies tomato paste chili powder 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground pepper. Cook stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes. Transfer mixture to a 9-inch pie plate and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Sage Cornbread
instructions: Saute onions in iron skillet in margarine until tender. Combine corn meal sugar and sage in mixing bowl. Mix onions into corn meal mixture.

title: Rice Dressing
instructions: Saute a little minced onion and garlic in a little oil then add drained green beans. Season with salt and pepper. Cook slowly for about 5 to 10 minutes then add a small amount of water saved from can and a little grated cheese.

title: California Strawberries With Cream
instructions: Mix strawberries and sugar; chill. Mix sour cream and almond flavoring. Put strawberries in parfait glasses or serving dishes. Top with sour cream mixture. Garnish with mint. Yields 4 servings.

title: Beau Monde Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve with a mixture of fresh vegetables.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and Crisco together; take out 1 cup. Add egg milk soda and molasses; pour into 9 x 9 pan. Sprinkle 1 cup flour mixture on top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Erica'S Easy Applesauce
instructions: Wash apples. Cut apples in quarters. Cores may be removed if desired. Place in large pot. Add water. Cover and cook about 30 minutes or until apples are soft. Place a large colander over a bowl and press mashed apples through with a large spoon. The peels and seeds will remain in the colander.

title: Marion'S Mandarin Green Salad
instructions: Place lettuce in salad bowl and top with Mandarin oranges pecans and onion rings. Combine the next seven ingredients and pour over salad just before serving.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash onion and salt until tender. Drain and mash. Add margarine soup and most of the crumbs. Pour into buttered casserole. Sprinkle remaining crumbs. Dot with additional butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Gooey Cake
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Spread into a well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cream and mix together last 3 ingredients. Pour on top of cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool thoroughly for 1 hour before cutting into squares.

title: Frozen Cabbage Salad
instructions: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of salt over cabbage and let stand 1 hour. Squeeze out fluid. Mix cabbage celery and green pepper.

title: Lazy Man'S Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Put cabbage in boiling water; cook until slightly soft. Drain. Brown ground beef and onions until onions are clear and beef loses its pink. Drain. Add tomato soup tomato sauce and water to meat. Prepare Minute rice as directed on package. Add meat and tomato mixture. In an 11 x 15-inch baking pan layer cabbage and meat-tomato mixture; repeat once more. Cover with aluminum foil; bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Garlic Chicken
instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons butter and the oil in a large skillet. A few at a time brown the chicken pieces well in the hot fat; remove them to a side dish as they are browned and season with salt and pepper. Pour out the fat from the skillet; let the pan cool for 5 minutes.

title: Fried Cheese
instructions: Cut 1 ounce Sorrento string cheese in half (or keep whole optional). Dredge each piece of string cheese in flour dip in egg and then coat with bread crumbs. Place on a plate in a single layer. Refrigerate uncovered for one hour.

title: Marshmallow Cream Fudge
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine marshmallow cream sugar evaporated milk butter and salt; cook over medium heat. Bring mixture to a boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. After boiling for 5 minutes add chocolate morsels and remove from heat. Stir well until smooth. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into 8-inch square pan. Refrigerate about 2 hours. Makes 2 1/4 pounds. Enjoy!

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook mixed vegetables according to box. Drain and cool. Combine with remaining vegetables. Prepare dressing.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Sift flour salt baking powder and cocoa. Add butter eggs and nuts. Bake in two greased oblong pans 8 x 12-inch or smaller ones. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Melt in top of double boiler marshmallows and milk. Pour hot over lime jello and stir until dissolved. Add cream cheese and stir to dissolve. Add crushed pineapple. Cool. Blend in whipped cream.

title: Cherry Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Mix flour salt and baking powder. Add to creamed butter and sugar; mix well. To this add the eggs one at a time slightly beaten. To this add candied pineapple first dates cherries and pecans. Bake in moderate oven at 250\u00b0 for 2 or 2 1/2 hours. Let cool in pan overnight. Cook in square pan lined with wax paper. Spray with Pam. Cook this several days before using.

title: Barbecue Wieners
instructions: Slice wieners approximately 1/2-inch thick. In skillet mix all ingredients. Cover and simmer slowly 10 minutes.

title: Mock Clotted Cream(Dried Milk Method)
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar together. By degrees add dried milk. Flavour with vanilla and beat until very smooth. (GE)

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce and fill bowl half way full. Mix together celery and onions. Sprinkle over lettuce. Add peas. Spread mayonnaise 1/4-inch deep. Sprinkle cheese and top with bacon bits.

title: Chocolate Scotcheroos
instructions: Cook sugar and light corn syrup in a 3 qt. saucepan over medium heat until mixture boils. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Mix in Rice Krispies. Press into buttered 13 x 9 inch pan. Let harden. Melt over hot water (double boiler) semi-sweet chocolate morsels and butterscotch morsels. Stir to blend. Spread over Krispies mixture. Chill until firm in refrigerator. Cut into bars. Yield 48 2 x 1 inch bars.

title: Savory Ribs
instructions: Mix all ingredients and saute. Pour over ribs and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Bring to a boil stirring.

title: Squash Puppies
instructions: Mix meal and flour. Add onions and squash. Stir in eggs and milk to make stiff batter. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil.

title: Banana Walnut Muffins
instructions: Mix flour sugar walnuts soda and salt together. Combine bananas butter egg and milk and vanilla in separate bowl. Add banana mixture to dry ingredients mixing until just combined. Bake until toothpick comes out clean about 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Old Time Sweet Tater Puddin
instructions: Mash butter and sugar together. Beat in eggs. Add sweet potatoes spices and milk. Pour in greased pan and sprinkle top with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Unstuffed Cabbage
instructions: Crumble beef into a 4 to 5 quart Dutch oven. Add onion and cook over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes stirring often until beef is lightly browned. Quarter and core cabbage. Cut crosswise in one-inch wide strips. You should have about 8 cups. Add to meat mixture. Cover and cook over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes stirring occasionally until cabbage wilts. Stir in tomatoes sugar vinegar and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally for 10 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Serves 4.

title: Mexican Coffee
instructions: Place coffee and cinnamon in filter basket of coffee maker. Add water and brew. In a saucepan blend milk chocolate syrup and sugar stir over low heat until sugar dissolves. Combine milk mixture and brewed coffee. Stir in vanilla. Pour into cups to serve. Top each serving with whipped cream with ground cinnamon sprinkled on top.

title: Cocoa Pebbles S'Mores Bars
instructions: Line 13 x 9-inch pan with foil. Grease bottom and sides of foil-lined pan. Place graham crackers on bottom of pan cutting crackers to fit. Microwave chocolate and 2 tablespoons butter in microwavable bowl on High 2 minutes. Stir until melted. Spread 1/2 of the melted chocolate over graham crackers. Microwave remaining 4 tablespoons butter in 4 quart microwavable bowl on High 45 seconds or until melted. Add marshmallows. Mix to coat. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes or until melted stirring after 45 seconds. Add cereal. Mix to coat well. Press firmly over chocolate-coated graham crackers in pan. Drizzle with remaining melted chocolate. Cool. Cut into squares. Makes 24.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Cook meat and onions; drain. Add taco seasoning according to package. Add corn beans tomatoes and water. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with grated cheese and chips.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Lay crescent rolls flat on large cookie sheet. Bake until done (watch carefully). Cool.

title: Second Time Around Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Add 1/4 cup water and donuts. Stir well and pour into 12 x 18-inch shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Mexican Quiche
instructions: Bake unpicked pastry with 2 layers of foil for 5 minutes at 450\u00b0. Remove foil; bake 5 to 7 minutes more (keep warm). Cook sausage onions and garlic until meat is done. Drain. Stir in chili peppers. In another saucepan combine cheese and flour; add cream. Cook and stir until cheese is melted. Add hot sauce. Blend hot cream mixture into beaten eggs slowly. Add meat mixture. Pour into pastry. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until a knife comes out clean. Let stand. Serve with picante sauce sour cream and guacamole.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients; store in an airtight container. To make 1 cup place a heaping teaspoonful in cup and fill with hot water.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pecans and pie crust. Mix well. Pour into pie crust. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Ice Cream Surprise
instructions: In a 9 X 13 pan place as many of the ice cream sandwiches to line bottom of pan. Squeeze all of the caramel magic shell sauce onto ice cream sandwiches. Crumble 1 Butterfinger candy bar on top. Top with cool whip then sprinkle 2nd butterfinger candy bar crushed on top of dessert. Refrigerate until time to serve.

title: Pears With Spicy Lime, Chile And Peanut Chutney
instructions: Cut each pear lengthwise into quarters. Using a melon baller create a well in the center of each quarter. In a small bowl prepare chutney by mixing together the next seven ingredients. Spoon chutney into hollowed out section of pear quarters. Add a sprig of mint for garnish. Place on serving tray.

title: Jello Cream Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple to boiling point. Add Jell-O and stir until dissolved. Refrigerate until it begins to set. Stir in cream cheese. Fold in whipping cream and nuts. Add cherries if desired. Mold. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cucumber Mousse
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Put over heat and add vinegar onion salt and paprika. Chill until about to set. Beat the gelatin mixture into the stiffly whipped cream. Fold in the cucumbers. Rinse individual molds fill them with mousse. When they are thoroughly chilled invert them onto a garnished plate. Serves 4.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix hash browns with sour cream and margarine. Add 1 cup of the grated cheese onion salt and pepper. Slowly mix in the can of soup. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix remaining 1 cup cheese with corn flake crumbs. Sprinkle on top of potato mixture in dish. Bake 40 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar syrup and butter. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until butter melts and mixture is steaming. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and pecans. Mix well. Pour into pie crust and bake at 325\u00b0 until set.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole *
instructions: Saute celery and onion in margarine. Add all three soups undiluted to make a sauce. Mix all ingredients together and pour in casserole dish. Place drained broccoli on top and sprinkle with paprika and grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable Rice Bake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Put cheese on top and dot with butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In large bowl beat 1 1/2 cups sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs; blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. Stir in flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt; mix well. In small bowl combine the 2 tablespoons each of sugar and cinnamon. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until set immediately. Remove from cookie sheets. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Super Rotel Dip
instructions: Cook ground beef and sausage until brown and crumbly. Add Ro-Tel and cheese and melt on low heat. Serve with corn chips.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat margarine until melted. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole or 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Cook uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Mock Filet Mignon
instructions: Combine ground chuck onion soy sauce mushrooms pepper and mix lightly. Shape into patties 1 1/2-inch thick. Wrap each patty with one slice bacon. Secure with pick. Grill 3 to 6 minutes or to desired doneness.

title: Pink Divinity
instructions: Mix sugar corn syrup water and salt in saucepan. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cover and bring to a boil. Cook for a minute or two to wash down sugar crystals. Remove cover. Cook without stirring until syrup reaches hard ball stage 260\u00b0 or until syrup is slightly brittle when dropped in cold water. Beat egg whites until frothy. Continue beating adding Jell-O slowly. Beat until candy is creamy. Stir in nuts. Candy sets quickly. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Mix together cream cheese egg 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt; beat well. Stir in chocolate tidbits; set aside. Sift flour 1/2 cup sugar cocoa soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt into mixing bowl. Add water oil vinegar and vanilla; beat well. Fill baking cups 1/3 full of chocolate batter. Top each with a heaping teaspoonful of cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with granulated sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: 5-Hour Stew
instructions: Toss everything into a roaster pan and let cook at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours. Can also use slow-cooker for 7 to 8 hours. Remove bay leaves before serving.

title: Boston Butt Pork Roast
instructions: Preheat oven and roasting pan to 350\u00b0. Salt and pepper 1 side of the roast. Place seasoned side of roast down on preheated pan. Bake for 20 minutes. Season top side of roast. Turn roast over and decrease oven heat to 325\u00b0. Roast for about 2 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 (longer time will be needed if larger roast). Turn roast over and add vegetables around base of roast in pan with potatoes on bottom covered by the carrots and at least 2 pieces of the apples on top of the roast. Cover the roasting pan after adding the vegetables. Add hot water to depth of about 1-inch. Bake for an additional hour or hour and 15 minutes or until vegetables are done and meat shreds easily. Remember to check water level occasionally. You dont want it to go dry.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Prepare pudding as directed omitting 1 cup of the milk and adding sour cream and Cool Whip. In large bowl layer with vanilla wafers the sliced bananas and pudding. Layer until all is used ending with pudding on top. Add Cool Whip on top and keep chilled until ready to use.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 inch pan. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup level off. In large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder salt and lemon peel. Using pastry blender or fork cut in margarine until mixture is the consistency of coarse meal. Add milk eggs and vanilla; stir until well blended. Pour 3/4 of batter into prepared pan. Top with blueberries. Spoon remaining batter over blueberries. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool 30 minutes.

title: Fudge
instructions: Break chocolate into heavy (large) mixing bowl. Add whipped marshmallow chopped walnuts and vanilla. In a large pan heat to melt butter and margarine. Then bring to a rolling boil once boiling starts. Let boil for exactly 6 minutes. Remove from heat. Add to mixture in bowl. Mix well. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill overnight and enjoy.

title: Cinnamon Biscuits
instructions: Roll biscuits in butter then roll in brown sugar. Sprinkle on cinnamon.

title: London Broil
instructions: Blend all ingredients in shallow pan. Marinate steak turning occasionally several hours or overnight. Broil 5 to 6 minutes on each side. Slice on diagonal.

title: Grandma'S Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in sugar salt oleo eggs and flour to make stiff dough. Grease top; cover and let rise until double in bulk. Punch down. Form into balls and cover. Let rise until double in size again about 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until done.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan or 12 cup Bundt pan. Beat butter and cream cheese together in mixing bowl until well blended. Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beat well. Blend in vanilla. Sift flour and salt together and blend into cream mixture. Spoon batter into prepared pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Glazed Fruit And Franks
instructions: In saucepan combine preserves lemon juice cornstarch and cinnamon. Cook and stir until well blended and slightly thickened. Stir in franks and pineapple. Heat through. Just before serving stir in apples and oranges. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Breast With Honey Chutney And Pears
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine pears and lemon juice. Melt margarine in skillet. Add chicken; saute. Transfer to shallow glass baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken. Place pears and lemon juice combination on top. Bake 30 minutes or until done.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Place nuts in the bottom of Bundt pan. Cut biscuits into quarters. Roll each piece in sugar and cinnamon mixed together. Put in greased Bundt pan. Melt butter; add brown sugar water and remaining cinnamon and sugar. Boil 2 minutes. Pour over biscuits. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Turn out on plate; serve warm.

title: Hot Cheese Yummies
instructions: Add mayonnaise to grated cheese. Add chopped ripe olives and green onions. Mix and spread on English muffins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cut into fourths to serve. Freezes well.

title: Chinese Pickled Beets
instructions: Mix everything in saucepan and cook until mixture thickens. Cool and store in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Mix flour salt paprika and pepper in a bag. Shake 3 or 4 pieces of chicken in bag to coat. Melt butter in large skillet; add chicken to brown. Add onions pepper and mushrooms; cook 5 minutes longer. Add tomatoes tomato paste garlic red pepper and oregano. Cook covered until tender about 30 minutes. Add sherry wine; mix well and bring to boiling point. Serve with spaghetti. Yields 4 servings.

title: Mushroom Appetizer
instructions: Mix cream cheese bacon and mushroom caps. Broil about 10 minutes or until clear liquid seeps from mushrooms. Serve hot.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Melt oleo; saute onion and celery. Add undiluted soup squash cornbread soaked in milk and sage. Pour in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain and crumble. Stir-fry onion in bacon drippings for 2 minutes. Add rice and stir-fry for 7 to 8 minutes. Add soy sauce water and crumbled bacon. Reduce heat to medium-low. Pur eggs on top of rice mixture. Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes or until eggs are cooked.

title: Banana Bread 2
instructions: Beat flour baking soda salt sugar margarine and eggs 2 1/2 minutes on high. Add sour cream and beat on low. Add bananas and vanilla and beat on low. Optional Add walnuts and beat on low. Add raisins; cover raisins with sugar and drop in batter that has been poured into loaf pan. Push raisins into batter individually with knife. Butter and flour bottom of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed drain. Rinse with cold water drain. Mix mayonnaise with lemon juice salt and sugar. Combine with macaroni celery seed tomato celery pimiento and green pepper. Serve on salad greens garnish with radish roses. Serves 6.

title: Sauerbraten Steaks
instructions: Combine 2 1/2 cups water vinegar sugar salt cloves peppercorns and bay leaves in saucepan; bring to boil. Pour over sliced onions; cool. Stir in oil. Pour marinade over steak; refrigerate 8 to 10 hours turning at least once. Remove steaks from marinade to absorbent paper; pat dry. Heat drippings to 350\u00b0.

title: Meat In Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in covered 2-quart dish and bake at 300\u00b0 for four hours. Delicious!

title: Mama Crow'S Raisin Nut Jam Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs well then add jam. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with dry ingredients and beat well after each addition. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake 40 minutes at 300\u00b0 (or until toothpick inserted in center of layer comes out clean). Cool completely on racks.

title: Bar-B-Que'D Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in a large skillet and cover with water. Brown the chops. Remove from skillet and brown the onions. Put chops back in the skillet with the onions and add vinegar brown sugar and ketchup. Add water to cover. Cook over high heat until it starts to boil. Reduce heat to low let simmer until gravy thickens about 2 hours.

title: Shrimp Bake
instructions: Mix well and place in casserole dish. Sprinkle top with 3/4 cup grated Swiss cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mama Fisackerly Tea Cakes
instructions: Combine margarine sugar vanilla and egg. Mix well. Add flour slowly. Form into balls on a greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on edge (15 to 20 minutes).

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Cups
instructions: In microwave melt chocolate butter and shortening. Stir until smooth. Place in miniature foil baking cups in miniature muffin pan. Put 1 teaspoon chocolate mixture in each cup. Microwave peanut butter until melted. Spoon into cups and cover with chocolate mixture. Refrigerate. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in a 13 x 9-inch or 2 1/2-quart greased casserole. Corn flakes can be crushed and mixed with melted butter for a topping if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Garnish with lemon twist and parsley if desired.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine. Add onion broccoli and celery. Cook over low heat a few minutes then add soup cheese and rice. Pour in baking dish and bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. (This may be cooked in microwave.)

title: Marbled Double Chocolate Cheesecake Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 8 or 9-inch square baking pan with foil extending edges over sides of pan. In a small mixing bowl beat butter 1/2 cup sugar and salt until smooth. Stir together flour and cocoa; gradually add to butter mixture beating until soft dough is formed. Press dough onto bottom of prepared pan. Beat cream cheese and remaining 1/2 cup sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; blend well.

title: Robert Redford Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake cake in 13 x 9-inch pan according to package directions. While cake is still warm poke holes (about a dozen) across top of cake with the end of a wooden spoon. Let cool slightly. Pour sweetened condensed milk and topping into holes and over cake. Let stand a few minutes then spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle crushed candy bars over top. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Pumpkin Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine sugar cream cheese and margarine. Mix at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Blend in pumpkin. Add combined dry ingredients mixing until just moistened. Fold in nuts.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. You can use either a 13 x 9-inch rectangle pan or a Bundt pan.

title: Chocolate Bottom Bites
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; make a well in the center of mixture. Combine water oil vinegar and vanilla; add to dry ingredients stirring well. Spoon batter into paper-lined miniature muffin pans filling 2/3 full.

title: Cream Cheese Cherry Pie
instructions: To cherries add 1 cup sugar and the flour. Cook in saucepan until thick; refrigerate to cool. Cream the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add the vanilla and a little cream to make it smooth. Whip the cream and fold into cream cheese mixture. Fill the cooled pie crust with cheese filling. Pour cherry mixture on top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Cook cornbread as directed on package. Crumble and let cool. Chop pepper tomato and onions. Add to cornbread then add about 3 cups of Miracle Whip. Chill.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain off grease. Add taco seasoning. Spoon half of hamburger into 2-quart casserole then beans then cheese then chips. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy White Chili
instructions: In a large saucepan saut chicken onion peppers and garlic powder in oil until chicken is no longer pink. Add beans broth and seasonings. Bring to a boil then simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour and measure. Sift twice with soda. Set aside. Cream butter and add sugar slowly beating constantly to cream well. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Stir in sour cream. Add flour mixture one-half cup at a time. Beat well. Stir in vanilla. turn into well-greased and floured pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Side Dish
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Combine pineapple sugar bread and eggs. Pour into baking dish over melted butter. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Logs
instructions: Form into logs. about 2 inches long and about 1/2 inch in diameter. Put them into freezer till frozen. Oh about an hour or so. Melt 1 package of chocolate chips. 1/2 bar of wax. Dip logs into chips and wax. Put logs onto wax paper. Its a lot easier to store.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Mix German chocolate cake mix as directed on box; set aside. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Sprinkle with nuts. Sprinkle coconut on top of nuts. Pour cake mixture over coconut.

title: Crust (Never Fail)
instructions: Mix first four ingredients in a large pan until it is crumbly. Place 1 egg 1 teaspoon of vinegar in 1 cup and mix. Fill remainder of cup with milk to make 1 cup. Mix with flour until it will come off of your hands.

title: Ragu No-Boiling Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In bowl combine Ricotta cheese 1 cup Mozzarella cheese 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and eggs. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish spread 1/2 of one jar of pasta sauce. Layer 4 uncooked noodles then 1/2 jar of pasta sauce and 1/2 of the Ricotta cheese mixture; repeat. Top with remaining 4 uncooked noodles and rest of pasta sauce. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour. Remove foil and sprinkle remaining cheeses. Bake uncovered an additional 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Fruited Green Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine salad greens and fruit; toss. Add dressing and poppy seed; toss to coat. Makes 5 (1 cup) servings.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine apples and sugar and let stand for 30 minutes. Beat egg. Add oil and vanilla and add to apple mixture. Mix all other ingredients together and add to apple mixture. Grease and flour an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 40 minutes to 45 minutes in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Beef And Biscuits Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in onion; stir in tomato sauce chili powder and garlic powder. Simmer. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with biscuits combine half of the cheese sour cream and egg; then mix with meat. Spoon the meat mixture over the biscuits. Sprinkle the rest of cheese on top of the meat mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley (Microwave)
instructions: Combine veggies soup 1/2 c. cheese sour cream pepper and 1/2 can Durkee fried onions. Pour into the 1 qt. casserole dish. Microwave on high 10-12 minutes or until bubbly. Remove and sprinkle remaining onions over top. Microwave until cheese is melted.

title: Sesame Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Wash chicken and cut into cubes (approximately 1 to 2-inch in size). Set aside to drain on paper towels. Mix beaten egg milk salt and sesame seed in medium size bowl. Add chicken to egg mixture. Coat each piece of chicken with flour. After all chicken is coated with flour heat shortening on medium until ready to fry. Add nuggets a few at a time to keep them from sticking together turning them 2 or 3 times until they are tender and golden brown. Serve with sauces such as barbecue honey mustard or sweet-n-sour.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: In a bowl blend together cream cheese sour cream and taco mix. Spread over dinner plate. Layer the remaining ingredients on top. Chill until ready to serve. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Easy Chicken Hawaiian
instructions: Place chicken in crock-pot or casserole dish. Mix other ingredients and pur over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or in crock-pot all day. Serve with rice.

title: Homemade Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour celery salt baking powder salt and sugar. Mix in butter until even particles are formed. Add milk and blend. Cook until tender in chicken broth.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: Soak gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes. In top of double boiler beat egg yolks; add 1/2 cup sugar lemon juice and salt. Cook over hot water stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Add softened gelatin and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat add lemon rind and cool. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating until stiff. Fold in cooled lemon mixture and then pour into the pie shell. Refrigerate until set. Spread with whipped cream just before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar together thoroughly. Add eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Bake in a well-greased and floured tube cake pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Salsa
instructions: Combine the scallions fresh tomatoes and peppers in a large mixing bowl. Stir in the pureed tomatoes water and lime juice. Stir in the oil and parsley; season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate covered until ready to serve. Serve with your favorite corn tortilla chips. A great summer dip! Yields 8 cups.

title: Wild Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar water jello and cornstarch. Cook at a slow rolling boil for 5 minutes. Put berries in baked pie shells. Pour mixture over berries. Refrigerate. Top with whipped cream or sour cream when served. Makes 2 pies.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Salt pepper and sugar to taste. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Stir when half done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in 11 x 13-inch greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corned Beef And Noodles
instructions: Alternate in layers in greased baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup crumbs. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all together well; put in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. Stir every 20 minutes.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Heat 2-inches deep of oil in skillet. Heat oil until hot but not smoking. Take batter pour it through funnel into hot oil moving in a circular motion then crisscross until youve made a cake the size of a plate or smaller. When lightly browned remove and drain on paper towels. Dredge or sprinkle in powdered sugar and sprinkle with cinnamon powder. Best when eaten warm.

title: Chicken Mini-Drumsticks
instructions: Remove tips from chicken wings. Combine pineapple juice beer soy sauce brown sugar onion ginger and garlic. Stir together until sugar is dissolved. Add chicken stirring to coat well. Cover and marinate at room temperature for about 1 hour. Drain chicken; reserve marinade. Melt margarine in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add chicken and cook browning on all sides. add 1/2 cup reserved marinade to chicken. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally over low heat for about 15 minutes or until fork can be inserted into chicken with ease. Keep chicken moist by using additional marinade as needed.

title: Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add beaten eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk to butter mixture. Fold in pecans. Bake in a well-greased lightly floured tube pan (9-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until straw inserted comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes before removing. This can be baked and stored for a couple of days. Keep cool.

title: Pineapple Parfait Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello and water. Add pineapple. Chill until slightly thickened. Soften and blend cream cheese and sour cream. Stir in jello mixture. Add nuts and chill.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
instructions: In large pan heat chili. Cut cheese into small squares and add to chili. When cheese is melted add sour cream and sauteed onion. Mix well and serve hot with chips.

title: Bill Salveson'S Mozzarella Marinara
instructions: Cut Mozzarella cheese into slices approximately 1/2-inch thick.

title: Crusty Coated Eggplant
instructions: Cut stems off eggplant and slice 1/2 to 5/8-inch thickness. In a bowl beat in egg. In second bowl mix cracker crumbs seasonings and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Spread butter in a 10 x 15-inch baking dish. Dip each slice of eggplant in egg. Drain briefly then coat with cracker crumbs. Arrange slices in single layer in pan. Bake for 20 minutes turning once in a 425\u00b0 oven.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop onto cookie sheet or put in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Cracker Pie
instructions: Whip the cream and add sugar and preserves. Put mixture into pie crust; sprinkle top with coconut and refrigerate.

title: Best Ever Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; save 1/4 for the top. Put the remainder into the bottom of a glass baking dish (8 1/2 x 11-inch). Grease the baking dish first.

title: Sausage Cheese Casserole
instructions: Crumble and brown sausage; drain. Beat eggs; add milk salt and mustard and mix. Stir in bread cubes cheese and sausage and mix. Put in 8 x 12-inch glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let it set for 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Sausage-Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown sausages and beef chuck cubes in electric skillet. Add onion garlic green peppers potatoes kidney beans basil salt and pepper. Add bouillon and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Check from time to time. Add more bouillon if needed. Juices may be thickened for gravy.

title: Lipton Onion Burger
instructions: In large bowl combine beaten egg Lipton onion soup mix water bread crumbs and ground meat. Shape into patties. Grill or broil until done. Makes 8 servings.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream the butter; gradually add the sugar and beat 10 to 15 minutes at medium speed. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.

title: Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Strain green beans and artichoke hearts. Cut or mash green beans into small pieces. Cut artichoke into small pieces. Mix all ingredients together and place in casserole dish. Sprinkle top with additional bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Cut dates in quarters and pour boiling water over them. Add shortening sugar and salt. When cool add beaten egg flour sifted with soda and cream of tartar nuts and vanilla. Beat well. Pour into greased and floured bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Watch oven; do not get too hot.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine corn eggs and milk. Add crushed rusks and mix well. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Mix well pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes; cool completely. Cream the cheese and blend in 1 cup sugar. Add Cool Whip; mix well. Spread over cooled pretzels. Dissolve jello in boiling water; add frozen strawberries slightly thickened. Pour over Cool Whip layer. Chill until firm.

title: Pizza Dipping Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients in small saucepan; cook over medium heat until hot. Serve with warm bread sticks and chips. Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Beat together the eggs and milk. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Mix both mixtures together and beat with a whip until smooth. Pour in hot oil.

title: Hoppin' John
instructions: Wash peas and place in large pan with cold water. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat cover and let sit for 1 hour. Fry bacon slowly until brown drain. Add Tabasco sauce bacon and salt to peas. Bring to a boil lower heat and simmer stirring frequently for 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Should be moist but not wet. Makes 6 servings.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Beat after each addition is made. Add bananas. Next add dry ingredients and nuts (walnuts or pecans). Bake in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

title: Parmesan Potato Sticks
instructions: Scrub and peel potatoes; cut lengthwise into quarters. Cut each quarter into 3 strips. Roll in melted butter; then roll in combined remaining ingredients. Place potato sticks in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Drizzle melted butter over potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Yield 6 servings.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: After popping corn sift through to remove unpopped kernels. Melt caramels water and butter together over medium-low heat stirring constantly so it doesnt burn. When melted pour over corn. Stir so it is well coated. Shape into balls and store in airtight containers.

title: Little Reubens
instructions: Cook the drained sauerkraut for 5 minutes with the diced onions and 2 tablespoons butter. Mix corned beef with relish and mustard. Spread on slice of party bread. Top with heaping tablespoonful of sauerkraut mixture and slice of Swiss cheese. Broil until cheese melts. Serve as an appetizer.

title: Chocolate Pudding Stacks
instructions: In microwave sprinkle gelatin over 1/4 cup cold water. Let stand 1 minute to soften. Microwave on high 20 seconds stir; rotate cup 1/4 turn; microwave high 20 seconds. Prepare pudding with skim milk following package directions. Add unflavored gelatin and vanilla to pudding stir until blended. Place 8 graham crackers in bottom of 11 X 7 inch dish. Spread with 1/2 the pudding. Place 1/2 the banana slices on pudding. Repeat layers ending with bananas. Refrigerate 4 hours. To serve cut into 8 squares. Top with 1 tub whipped topping.

title: Coconut Balls
instructions: Roll in balls then dip in chocolate with 1/2 block to pack.

title: Angel Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites and vanilla to soft peaks; gradually add sugar. Beat until stiff peaks form. Mix crumbs nuts and baking powder; fold into beaten egg whites. Spread evenly in greased and floured 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely. Whip the cream or use Cool Whip. Cut pie. Serve topped with cream. Serves 6.

title: Pizza Sauce To Can
instructions: Wash and core tomatoes. Cut them up and put them through a juicer (should be about 6 quarts of juice). Put juice in a large heavy kettle and add remaining ingredients. Cook until thick and volume is reduced to about 1/2 the original measure. Ladle into hot pint jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Cover with lids and bands and process in a boiling water bath canner for 35 minutes. Makes 6 pints.

title: Twenty-Four Hour Salad
instructions: In a 10 x 13-inch pan layer chopped lettuce onion celery peas and chestnuts. Spread on mayonnaise covering all ingredients. Sprinkle salt pepper and sugar over top of mayonnaise. Sprinkle Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses over mayonnaise (Parmesan first). Cover tightly with Saran Wrap or pan lid and refrigerate 24 hours. When ready to serve top with bacon and tomatoes. Serves twelve.

title: Shrimp And Scallop Casserole
instructions: Marinate seafood in soy sauce 15 minutes. While seafood is marinating melt butter in saucepan. Add parsley and crushed garlic. Remove seafood from sauce. Place in a shallow casserole or baking dish. Top with mushrooms water chestnuts and bean sprouts. Pour butter mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. (Test shrimp for doneness.)

title: Picture Perfect Petal Cake
instructions: In a small bowl toss coconut and food coloring until evenly coated; set aside. Place angel food cake on a large serving platter. Frost top and sides with whipped topping; sprinkle on coconut. Cut cake into 8 or 10 slices then very carefully pull out each slice just a bit to resemble flower petals. Spoon strawberry halves in center. Any leftovers should be refrigerated.

title: Corn Lovers Special
instructions: In 13 X 9 baking dish place both cans of corn. Mix 2 eggs with corn bread mix. Set aside. Saute onions. Layer on top of corn. Place corn bread mixture on top. Drizzle melted butter over top and bake for 40 minutes at 400.

title: Baked Onion Rings
instructions: Mix egg substitute salt and pepper. Dip onion rings into egg mixture and coat with bread crumbs. Place in single layer on greased baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Makes 4 servings.

title: Breaded Tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Cook until all is mixed well. Butter 2 1/2-quart casserole dish and pour in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cherry Bundt Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed on package. Pour half into greased and floured Bundt pan. Put about 1/2 can of cherry pie filling into center of cake. Do not touch sides of pan with cherry filling. Pour the rest of cake mix over the top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream.

title: Zucchini And Cream Cheese
instructions: Cut unpeeled zucchini into thin slices and boil until tender but still crunchy. Drain thoroughly. Melt cheese and butter and mix with garlic powder and zucchini. Put in a baking dish and crumble crackers on top. Bake for 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown. Serves 6.

title: Taco Ring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Brown beef drain and add taco seasoning mix along with the water and cheese. Place crescent rolls in a ring around a large round stone with the pointed end facing right overlapping each other then place meat mixture in the center of the crescent rolls. Take the end of each crescent roll and wrap around the other end until circle so complete. Bake in the oven until the rolls become golden brown about 10 minutes. Use the rest of the ingredients to garnish with.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda salt and sugar; add 3/4 cup shortening brown sugar and buttermilk. Add bananas eggs and vanilla; beat for 1 minute. Fold in 3/4 cup chopped pecans dusted with flour. Bake in a tube pan. Make a thick paste of confectioners sugar and enough sour cream to dribble over cake for frosting.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Bake chicken breasts topped with margarine at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes turning every 15 minutes. Pour off margarine and chicken fat. Cover chicken with half the barbecue sauce and bake 30 minutes. Turn and cover other side and bake 30 minutes.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake in three layers. Place 1 in bottom of bowl. Mix pudding mix and place 1/3 on cake layer. Top with blueberry filling. Mix pecans with Cool Whip. Put 1/3 on top. Place second layer cake. Add drained pineapple 1/3 of pudding mix and 1/3 of Cool Whip. Put third layer with rest of pudding mix strawberry mix and Cool Whip.

title: Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Mix cranberries apples and sugar. Melt margarine. Add Rice Krispies brown sugar and flour. Fold into cranberry mixture. Sprinkle with nuts over the top. Bake in a large buttered casserole (9 x 13-inch) uncovered for 45 minutes or until thickened and bubbly at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Gourmets Delight Pecan Cheese Dip
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar and vinegar. Cook over boiling water until thick. Cool slightly. Beat in cheese. Grate in green pepper and onion. Add pecans. Let season 2 hours. Good for potato chips or Fritos.

title: Italian-Style Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix potatoes sauce mix and water in ungreased 2-quart round casserole; stir in milk. Bake uncovered 30 to 35 minutes or until top is golden brown and potatoes are tender.

title: Kourabiedes(Crescent Cookies)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Measure butter shortening 2 cups sugar egg liqueur almond extract and 2 cups flour into a large mixer bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed scraping bowl constantly. Beat 1 minute on medium speed scraping the bowl occasionally. Stir in remaining flour. Knead until smooth. Shape 1-inch pieces of dough into crescent shapes. Place 1-inch apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake until cookies are light brown on bottoms 15 to 20 minutes. Sprinkle powdered sugar on cookies while hot. Cool on wire racks. Flavor mellows after 2 or 3 days. Store cookies in airtight containers at room temperature no longer than 9 days or in freezer no longer than 2 months. Makes about 11 dozen.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Beat eggs one at a time into mixture. Add additional ingredients.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli onions cheese sunflower seeds and bacon. Mix mayo sugar and vinegar. Stir in broccoli mix. Makes 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all with electric mixer well. Chill and enjoy.

title: Okra Gumbo
instructions: In large skillet saute onion and pepper in oil until tender. Add remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat 15 minutes. Stir frequently. Serve immediately. Yields 8 servings.

title: Lime And Pineapple Holiday Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple and add enough water to make 2 cups of liquid. Heat this and add jello. Dissolve. While still hot add marshmallows; cool. Add cottage cheese pineapple nuts and cherries. Whip cream and fold other ingredients into this. Chill until firm.

title: Baked Ham
instructions: Cut rind off ham. Combine dry ingredients and add enough juice to make a dough that can be rolled over fat. Cover part of ham with dough. Put in cold oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes per pound 4 or 5 hours for a 15 pound ham basting every 30 minutes. Take dough off and finish with brown sugar or any favorite way of browning ham.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini in boiling water until just tender. Drain. In large bowl beat eggs. Stir in mayonnaise onions green pepper cheese salt and pepper. Add zucchini; toss. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Dot with butter and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add all ingredients. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or 5 minutes in microwave.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: In large bowl combine cake mix eggs orange juice oil and pudding mix. Blend at low speed of electric mixer 1 minute then high speed 3 minutes. Pour 2/3 of batter in nonstick (Pam sprayed) pan or greased and floured Bundt pan. To remaining 1/3 of batter add chocolate and blend. Pour over top of batter in pan. Marbelize with knife. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cake tests done. Cool in pan 10 minutes then turn out onto plate to cool completely. Glaze if desired.

title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Beat well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Butter pie plate (10-inch Pyrex).

title: Non-Edible Christmas Tree Ornaments
instructions: Mix ingredients; knead and shape ornaments by using cookie cutters or other kitchen tools to cut them out. Push in metal buttons or other decorations that wont melt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Make color with food color or decorate after baking with colored glue glitter glue etc. Easy and fun!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and set aside. Melt butter in skillet add onion and broccoli. Simmer until onion is transparent and broccoli is tender. Add soup Cheez Whiz and milk. Mix well and remove from heat. Add rice. Bake in buttered pan covered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill until ready to serve. Serve with crackers.

title: Easy Corn Pudding
instructions: Put all in blender and mix. Put corn in last. Blend it very little. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until knife comes out clean.

title: Carrot Crunch Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixing bowl beat butter oil and sugar until fluffy. Beat in eggs water and vanilla. Sift together all-purpose flour baking soda nutmeg and salt. Add to bowl along with whole-wheat flour. Mix just until blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Make large drop cookies well spaced on greased baking sheet using about 1/3 cup batter for each. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Cool on racks.

title: Chicken And Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in heavy covered skillet. Brown chicken on both sides. Remove chicken and drain excess fat. Stir in soup and loose pan drippings. Add sour cream stirring until well mixed. Add chicken. Cover and simmer over very low heat until tender about 50 to 60 minutes. Stir in mushrooms last couple of minutes. Serve over pasta or rice.

title: Church Windows
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and butter. Let cool a little. Add marshmallows and nuts. Mix well. Put coconut on wax paper and put mixture onto coconut. Shape into roll. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate for 48 hours. Slice and serve.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with chopped onion; drain grease. Tear tortillas and place in 13 x 9-inch dish. Heat soup and tomatoes. Layer tortillas meat beans and soup mixture. Continue layering until all is used up. Top with grated cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly.

title: Lemonade Punch
instructions: Prepare lemonade concentrate with water according to the directions on the can. Add chilled cranberry juice cocktail and ginger ale. Add ice and mix well. Float scoops of sherbet on top. Serve as is or over ice cubes if desired. Yields 25 (6 ounce) cups.

title: Fruit Cocktail Squares
instructions: Cream sugar and eggs together. Sift and add flour soda and salt. Add fruit cocktail and vanilla. Use 15 X 10 X 1 inch pan. Grease and flour cookie sheet. Pour batter in cookie sheet sprinkle with coconut and nuts (optional). Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown. While cookie dough is still warm drizzle with the following glaze over dough.

title: Cherry Pineapple Cake
instructions: Beat until smooth. Pour into 3 cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: 20-Minute Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Using palm of hand flatten chicken to even thickness. Dip chicken into egg then into crumbs to coat. In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine brown chicken on both sides. Add spaghetti sauce. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cheeses and parsley. Cover. Simmer 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Spitsade
instructions: Fry chicken (which has been skinned) coated with salt pepper garlic powder and paprika. Put fried chicken in large pan with 1/2 cup of frying oil. Add olives mushrooms and peppers to chicken. Add 1/2 cup wine for flavor. Cook for at least 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve with rice.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Dip
instructions: Drain tomatoes reserving 1 tablespoon oil. In food processor place oil tomatoes cheese and garlic. Process until well blended stopping once to scrape down sides. Serve with pita chips or bagel chips. Also good with raw vegetables.

title: Hash Brown Potato Pie
instructions: Beat together eggs and milk. Stir in hash browns onion salt and hot pepper sauce. Stir in 1 cup of the cheese and half of the bacon. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie plate or quiche dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until center is set. Sprinkle remaining cheese and bacon over the top. Continue to bake 3 to 4 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Egg Foo Yong
instructions: Beat eggs slightly in mixing bowl. Add other ingredients. Cover bottom of a 6-inch skillet with peanut oil and heat skillet. Pour 1/4 of the mixture in this and cook over low heat until brown on one side. Turn carefully and cook until brown on other side. Serve with Brown Sauce.

title: Salad
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple. Combine filling and oranges and pineapple. Add sliced bananas just before serving.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Cut zucchini in half length-wise. Scoop out pulp leaving 1/4 inch shell. Combine onion mushrooms celery margarine and tomato in a microwavable dish. Cover with plastic wrap and cook 4 - 6 minutes. Drain. Add crackers egg grated cheese parmesan cheese salt and pepper. Mound this stuffing in each zucchini shell. Cover and microwave 5 to 7 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In large saucepan melt peanut butter 1 cup of sweetened condensed milk and 2 tablespoons butter; stir occasionally. Remove from heat; stir in peanuts. Spread mixture into wax paper-lined 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Roast Goose
instructions: If necessary singe and clean the goose. Pat dry. Rub the cavity with salt. Combine the other ingredients and stuff into the goose. Secure the opening with skewers and truss. Prick the skin thoroughly with a fork so that fat will run out. Put goose on rack in a roasting pan breast side up. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roast in 350\u00b0 oven for 3 1/2 hours. At the end of one hour add a cup of water to the pan and baste every half hour with the drippings. Serves 8.

title: Baked Beans(Impressive And Easy)
instructions: Season the ground beef according to your family preference. I use black pepper seasoning salt garlic powder and onion powder. Put all ingredients into a skillet stir and heat.

title: Pam'S Sweet Trash(Low-Fat)
instructions: Combine popcorn pretzels and cereals in a large pan or Dutch oven that has been sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Combine sugar Butter Buds syrup and lite salt in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Quickly stir in baking soda. Pour over popcorn mixture and stir together quickly. Mix until well coated. Spread on 4 cookie sheets that have been lined with foil and sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool until hardened. When cool and hardened break apart and store in an airtight container.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion (and sausage if used). Cook until done. Add tomatoes salt chili powder corn and olives. Cook until heated. Place into an 11 x 7-inch oblong pan. Mix cornmeal milk and eggs; spread on top. Cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cheese browns.

title: Creamy Tarragon Dip
instructions: In a blender or food processor with knife blade attached blend the first 8 ingredients until smooth. Pour mixture into small bowl. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Slow Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Combine meat onions celery carrots tomato juice tapioca sugar salt pepper and basil in 2 1/2-quart casserole. Cover tightly and cook in a slow oven (300\u00b0) for 2 1/2 hours. Stir potatoes and green beans (undrained) into stew and continue cooking covered for 1 hour or until meat and vegetables are done. Stir occasionally. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Marshmallow Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in 3-quart saucepan. Add marshmallows and cook over very low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted and mixture is syrupy. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies and stir until well coated. Press warm mixture evenly and firmly into buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Cut into squares when cool. Yield 24 squares when cool (2 x 2-inches).

title: Classic Chocolate Cake
instructions: Stir together cocoa and boiling water in small bowl until smooth; set aside. Cream butter sugar and vanilla in large mixer bowl. Blend in eggs. Combine flour soda and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Blend in reserved cocoa mixture.

title: Frozen Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and cream cheese and gently fold in pineapple. Add Cool Whip then add nuts. Fold in strawberries. Freeze. Serves 10.

title: Malakoff(Cool, Summer Dessert)
instructions: Mix 2 whole eggs with milk sugar and cornstarch. Mix cold and cook until thick (like a pudding). Stir constantly to avoid lumps. Cool.

title: Pattie'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff. Add sugar vanilla and nuts. Pour into an 8-inch greased pie pan. Mold sides up to form a pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Melt chocolate in water and cool. Beat whipping cream until thick. Mix vanilla into cooled chocolate and fold together with whipped cream. Pour into cooled meringue pie shell. Chill.

title: Potato 'N Cheese Bake
instructions: Melt cheeses and oleo. Add half and half. Add salt; put frozen potatoes in a large casserole. Pour cheese mixture over the potatoes. Let set 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel potatoes; boil until soft. Mash with butter and sour cream. Add green onions and salt; blend until potatoes are fluffy. Put into a casserole dish; sprinkle with more of the salt to taste if desired. Add slices of Velveeta cheese to cover top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers and cheese and put in a casserole dish. Sprinkle combined crackers and cheese on top. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Creamed Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick oleo in casserole dish. Mix well all ingredients. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Date Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs with a fork. Add vanilla sugar and flour beating with a fork. Add the date mixture mixing just to blend. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Peanut Butter Crunchies(Diabetic)
instructions: Thoroughly blend peanut butter and honey. Stir in 1/2 c. Corn Flake crumbs. Form into 24 small balls and roll in remaining Corn Flake crumbs. Chill.

title: Apple Brownie
instructions: Cream butter sugar egg and dry ingredients. Mix. Mixture will be dry. Add apples and nuts. Spread in 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ham Loaf
