instructions: Combine smoked ham fresh pork eggs and bread or cracker crumbs and form into loaf. Place in roasting pan. Make sauce of remaining ingredients and pour over loaf. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about an hour or until done.

title: Upper Peninsula Pastie
instructions: Place all ingredients on crust then fold and seal. Dot with butter and make three slits in crust to allow the steam to escape. Bake in center rack at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with brown gravy or catsup.

title: Watermelon Punch
instructions: In a blender puree the watermelon pieces and strain the puree through a very fine sieve set over a pitcher discarding the solids. (There should be about 2 1/2 cups juice.) Stir in the vodka the Triple Sec and the lime juice; pour the cooler into long-stemmed glasses filled with ice and garnish each drink with a watermelon slice. Makes 4 to 6 drinks.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups(Makes Approximately 6 Dozen)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortillas. Spread tortillas with mixture almost to end and roll up. Slice into 2-inch lengths.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut the broccoli into small bite-sized pieces. Cut cauliflower into bite-sized pieces. Add onion and cheese. Add dressing (*) then bacon bits last and toss.

title: Lentil Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Place in an oiled 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with lemon wedge or tomato sauce. Yield 6 servings. Approximate calories/serving 225.

title: Shrimp Skillet
instructions: Add rice to butter onion celery in skillet and saute until rice is golden brown. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and then simmer uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Veal Pennsylvania
instructions: Coat veal with flour. In a large skillet melt butter over medium heat. Add veal; cook about 2 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Add apples and pecans. Cook and stir until apples are tender-crisp. Add honey and brown sugar. Cook and stir until warm. Can serve on large croutons by cutting out white bread with large cookie cutter sprinkle with salt and pepper and bake on cookie sheet 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Becky'S Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast. Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Stir in yeast mixture and buttermilk. Blend thoroughly and refrigerate or roll into biscuits. Let rise slightly; bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Dough will keep up to 3 days in fridge. Makes 8 fat biscuits.

title: Strawberry Soup
instructions: Put all the ingredients except the sour cream in electric mixer container. Mix on low speed 5 to 7 minutes until sugar has dissolved completely and emulsifed. Add sour cream and mix 1 more minute. Chill. Serve with whole berries for garnish. Makes 6 servings.

title: Horseradish Ring
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups hot water. Stir well. Add cold water salt and vinegar. Stir. Cool to jellied stage. Stir in horseradish and whipped cream. Pour into an oiled mold. When thoroughly set unmold. Garnish with parsley leaflets. Excellent with ham.

title: Cheese Breaded Fish
instructions: Beat eggs in separate bowl. Take first 4 ingredients and place onto counter top lined with wax paper. Take a rolling pin and roll ingredients into a crumblike mixture. Cover all pieces of fish in egg mixture and then cover fish with crumb mixture to create batter taste. Cook fish in skillet of oil for 6 minutes. Serves 3 to 4 people. Very tasty!

title: Scalloped Chicken
instructions: Mix all except chips. Let the mixture soak together for 10 minutes then press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with crushed potato chips then bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pasta With Tomato And Basil
instructions: Chop basil leaves. Mince garlic. Shred cheese. Drop tomatoes in boiling water for about 10 seconds. Peel and chop tomatoes. Mix tomatoes basil garlic and cheese with oil; let stand in covered bowl at room temperature for at least 3 hours. Cook pasta and drain. Add tomatoes to hot pasta and mix well. Serve warm.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Beat the eggs milk sugar cinnamon and vanilla together. Place the bread pieces in a buttered baking dish (approximately 8 x 1 1/2-inches round). Pour milk mixture over the bread. Sprinkle on the raisins. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Wrap ribs in foil bone side down. Place on a cookie sheet; bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Open foil; baste with barbecue sauce. Cook uncovered an additional 30 minutes. Absolutely delicious! And no clean up!

title: Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In a large bowl cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one a a time beating well after each. At low speed gradually beat in yogurt milk and vanilla. Gradually add dry ingredients; beating until fluffy. Scrape bowl as needed. Stir in chopped walnuts.

title: Cheese Fondue Bake
instructions: Mix butter and mustard; then spread on one side of each slice of bread. Cut bread into cubes. Beat remaining ingredients with wire whisk until uniform. Stir in bread cubes. Pour into a well greased baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: My Man'S Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Bake\tuntil light and brown 10 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in water until cooked. Melt butter to liquid. Beat eggs. Add all the ingredients together stir it thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 in any baking pan until top is browned and casserole is lightly moist.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Combine all ingredients with the bananas being last. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Paradise Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar and vanilla mixing well. Blend in egg. Spread into bottom of crust. Combine rest of ingredients; mix well. Pour over cream cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes. Cool.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together the sugar salt cornstarch and flour. Stir in milk and beaten egg yolks. Cook in saucepan on medium heat stirring continually. Add butter and vanilla. Fold in coconut. Pour in baked pie shell.

title: Steak And Rice Casserole
instructions: Trim bone and fat from steak and cut into 1-inch strips. Brown steak in oil in skillet on top of stove. Mix steak and all other ingredients in a covered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Appetizer Cheese Bake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Stir in cheese and onion. Spoon into a 1-quart souffle dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until puffed and golden. Serve immediately with crackers. Makes 3 cups.

title: Turkey Chili
instructions: In a large pan or Dutch oven place oil ground turkey chili powder salt and pepper. On medium heat stirring often cook until meat has changed color. Add tomato juice picante sauce and pork and beans. Simmer for 2 hours.

title: Shelva'S Sherbet Punch
instructions: Put ice cream and sherbet in punch bowl. Pour juice and ginger ale over it and mix. Serves 24.

title: Zesty Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Core cabbage and put in plastic bag; cook in microwave for approximately 25 minutes (if not fully cooked put in for approximately 5 minutes more). Let cool. In microwave dish prepare rice according to instructions on package; let cool. Take sauce and put about 1 inch on bottom of lasagna dish. Separate cabbage leaves pulling off one at a time. Take 1 loaf of cabbage. Spread out and put on 1 large spoon of rice and 1 teaspoon of sour cream. Flop in sides and roll. Do this until all leaves are rolled and place them in the dish with sauce. Cover them with the rest of the sauce. Sprinkle cheeses on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Hot Fruit Juice
instructions: Mix ingredients in large pot. Heat on medium heat until mixture is hot (do not boil). Serve hot. Leftover juice can be refrigerated and reheated.

title: Five Flavor Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening; add sugar. Cream until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each. Sift flour and baking powder; add a little at a time with milk. Stir in flavoring. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in pan. Mix soup and sour cream and then mix in with chicken. Crumble crackers over this and pour butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Welch Fried Cakes
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add milk to eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add currants. Mix and chill.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Fill a 9-inch pie plate 2/3 full of peeled and sliced apples. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of sugar mixed with cinnamon. In a small bowl mix 1 cup of sugar butter flour beaten egg and nuts. Pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until golden brown. Bake over a cookie sheet; might drip over the side.

title: Blueberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix jello and boiling water. Add pineapple. Let congeal a little then add pie filling and pecans.

title: Italian Sausage Zucchini Milano
instructions: Crumble and saute sausage. Remove sausage from skillet. Keep tablespoon of drippings. Add squash and onion saute. Add all other ingredients and 1/2 cup water. Put sausage on top. Cover. Cook for 15 minutes.

title: Cool Cherry Romanov
instructions: Stir liqueur into pie filling. Alternately spoon ice cream whipped topping and cherry pie filling into dessert dishes or parfait glasses ending with whipped topping. Garnish with a spoonful of cherry pie filling. Any remaining whipped topping can be refrozen. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sugarless Applesauce Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine raisins fruit and water in saucepan. Cook uncovered until water is evaporated and fruit is soft. Set aside to cool. In a large mixing bowl combine flour baking soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. In a separate bowl combine eggs applesauce sweetener oil and vanilla. Add nuts to fruit mixture. Stir into dry ingredients and blend thoroughly. Pour into greased fluted tube pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Trifle
instructions: Layer in clear glass bowl.

title: Sandy'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat drain grease. Add onion and cook till onion almost done. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer on medium to low heat until done.

title: Pumpkin Cake With Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Mix eggs oil sugar flour pumpkin cinnamon baking powder salt and baking soda together. Pour into a greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 25 minutes.

title: Surprise Cupcakes
instructions: Fill cupcakes 3/4 full of batter. Mix egg cream cheese sugar and chocolate chips in middle of batter. Sprinkle with nuts and sugar over top. Bake as directed on cake box.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni rinse in cold water and drain in colander. Dice olives pimiento and onion. Toss in salad bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add mayonnaise to moisten.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut up cooked chicken. Mix all ingredients together except Miracle Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Spice Bars
instructions: Spread in pan.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Pow - Wows
instructions: Mix bacon with chipped ham chili sauce and relish. Put a tablespoon of ham mixture on a sliced burger bun. Top with a slice of cheese. Close bun and wrap in foil. Heat 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Mix together and bake in 2 loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Mix 3/4 cup powdered sugar with a little lemon juice and drizzle over bread.

title: Bread Pudding With Apples And Raisins
instructions: Beat together eggs milk sugar cinnamon vanilla and salt. In a round baking dish add bread apples and raisins. Pour egg mixture over all. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 40 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. For a change add the melted butter and sugar on bottom of dish. Make bread pudding with apples and raisins as directed. Cool. Turn dish upside down over another dish. The pudding will have a caramel type topping. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Enjoy.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Make pudding as directed on back of box; mix in pineapple. Fold in marshmallows and Cool Whip. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serves 10.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter sugar and well beaten egg. Mash bananas with fork and add to butter sugar and egg mixture. Sift together dry ingredients and add to mixture. Pour into buttered loaf pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in 8 x 4 x 4-inch pan.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes until done. Add celery onions and eggs. Mix mayonnaise sour cream vinegar and sugar. Toss over potatoes. Garnish with paprika.

title: Seven Layer Salad(Taco Flavored)
instructions: Stir into drained meat the beans and taco sauce. Heat. Layer meat mixture sharp grated Cheddar cheese 1 cup sour cream chopped onion olives tomatoes and green peppers.

title: Luscious Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch. Add lemon rind and juice. Stir. Add egg yolks and milk. Add butter. Cook over medium heat until thick. Cool. Fold in sour cream. Pour in baked pie crust. Top with meringue and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 or 12 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix in saucepan milk cocoa sugar and butter. Bring to boil and cook 1 minute. Have ready and stir in immediately peanut butter quick cooking oats and vanilla. Nuts are optional. Drop on wax paper by spoonfuls and cool.

title: Easy Popsicles
instructions: Mix juice together. Cut hole in center of cover of 10 (1 ounce) cups with tops. Fill cup with juice. Place cover on top then place craft stick or straw in hole securely. Put into freezer until frozen.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix together and press on a cookie sheet. Chill overnight or put into freezer until firm. Cut into 4-inch squares. Roll in flour and brown on both sides in hot oil. Place pieces in a baking dish. Cover with 1 can mushroom soup and 1 can water mixed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Plain Pastry
instructions: Mix well and form into a ball. Let rest in refrigerator for about 20 minutes. Cut ball in half and roll half just thin enough to be able to handle into a pie plate. Place filling into pie plate with bottom crust in place. Roll out top crust to same thickness as bottom and place on the pie. Bake the pie according to the directions given with the filling. Most 2-crust pies cook best when baked in a hot oven (450\u00b0) for about 10 minutes and the rest of the time in a moderate oven (350\u00b0).

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Chop up chicken breasts. Combine chicken with all ingredients except ham and rice. Bring to boil. Add ham and rice. Cover and simmer until rice is done.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Manicotti Shells
instructions: Mix ingredients and stuff in manicotti shells which have been boiled for 10 minutes. Pour spaghetti sauce over and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad #2
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Combine first 6 ingredients with 1 cup mayonnaise sour cream and 1/2 cup milk. Blend well. Add macaroni and toss. Refrigerate covered several hours. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir into salad.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix with the dried beef and horseradish. This is great on pumpernickel bread.

title: Opera Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle half of stuffing over bottom of 10 x 13-inch casserole. Layer rest in order given. Blend soup and milk pour over top. Moisten remaining stuffing with melted butter and water put on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until hot.

title: Chewy Cake
instructions: Melt margarine then add sugar and eggs. Cook together over low heat 10 minutes stirring constantly. Add flour nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Bake 35 minutes at 345\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in a blender on low speed for 3 minutes. Pour in 9-inch greased pie plate. Let stand for 5 minutes then sprinkle with coconut. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm or cold.

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
instructions: Cut cucumbers into sticks. Pour boiling water over and let stand overnight. Next day drain. Pack solidly into jars.

title: Caribbean Fudge Pie(Kraft General Foods, Inc.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter and sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add chocolate (melt in microwave or in double boiler) instant coffee and rum extract. Mix well. Stir in flour and 1 cup chopped walnuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Decorate top with 1/2 cup walnut halves. Bake in lower third of oven for 25 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Top with whipped cream or ice cream. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Mix all dressing ingredients and pour over lettuce. Add croutons and stir once more. Use Parmesan cheese before serving if desired.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Grease and flour one loaf pan. Mix ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini Lo-Cal Soup
instructions: Saute the onion and zucchini in margarine until tender. Add broth and simmer 15 minutes. Pour into blender 1/3 at a time and whip until smooth. Add milk dill salt and pepper.

title: Pickled Green Beans
instructions: Clean and cook whole green beans. Place them in a sterile pint jar. Boil the water vinegar sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Pour over beans and seal jar. You may double recipe.

title: Raspberry-Rhubarb Salad
instructions: Heat rhubarb with sugar until soft. Add Jell-O and stir. Add pineapple juice and lemon juice. Refrigerate until partially set. Add the rest of the ingredients and refrigerate again until completely set.

title: Magic Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour cracker crumbs over margarine and spread. Pour coconut on top and spread. Pour chips on top and spread. Pour nuts on top and spread. Pour Eagle Brand milk over top and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Let cool before cutting in squares.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except stuffing. Sprinkle stuffing over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until it begins to bubble.

title: Microwave Vegetable Soup
instructions: Preparation time 1 hour. Use a 4-quart microwave pot with cover. Cook ingredients on High for 20 minutes stirring at 10 minutes. Cook at 50% power for 25 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Taste softness of celery for doneness.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Break up biscuits in a lightly greased or buttered dish. Beat eggs. Add other ingredients. Pour in dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 or 40 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Brown flour and onions in butter. Add about 2 cups broth and simmer. Use layer of chicken then a layer of vegetables. Pour 1/2 of the gravy over the chicken and vegetables. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Pull biscuits apart and place on top of cheese. Pour remainder gravy over the biscuits. Bake until biscuits are browned about 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Easy Meatballs For A Group
instructions: Fill slow cooker with meatballs. Combine sauce and jam. Pour over meatballs. Cover. Cook on low 4 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in jar and shake well. Store and keep indefinitely. Good on chicken beef and pork.

title: Turkey And Stuffing Bake
instructions: Combine butter and water; stir until butter melts. Pour over seasoned stuffing crumbs; toss lightly. Stir in 1/2 can French fried onions. Spoon stuffing mixture into a 9-inch shallow baking dish (1 1/2-quart) or pie plate. Press stuffing across bottom and up sides of dish to form a shell. Mix condensed celery soup milk turkey and peas together then spoon into prepared baking dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake uncovered for 5 more minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Herbed Seasoning Blend
instructions: Mix well and spoon into shaker. Makes 1/3 cup. Recipe from Hills and Pines Garden Club Raleigh North Carolina.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine in a Dutch oven until tender. Add flour and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk stirring until mixture boils. Stir in corn and next 3 ingredients. Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon into bowls; sprinkle with paprika. Yield 3 servings.

title: Pumpkin-Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually. Cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well. Sift flour baking powder salt and spices. Stir in dry ingredients. Mix well. Add raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Mix together in bowl. Spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until desired color (approximately 10 to 15 minutes).

title: Easy Bread
instructions: Combine shortening and boiling water in bowl stirring until shortening is melted. Stir in salt and sugar. Let stand and cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in very warm water and add to shortening mixture. Add eggs. Mix well. Gradually add flour to make soft dough.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Simmer chicken until cooked. Season if desired. Reserve water that chicken simmered in for sauce. Remove bones and cut into small strips or cubes. Allow 1 ounce of chicken per enchilada. Grate cheese. Allow 1/2 ounce cheese per enchilada. Cut whole chilies into very thin strips and chop a little for garnish on top. Combine soup broth (2 soup can measures) and seasonings in a saucepan. Thicken with the cornstarch. Soften tortillas in the sauce. Remove tortillas from the sauce and fill each with 1 ounce of chicken 1/2 ounce of cheese and 1 to 2 strips of green chilies. If desired add 1 tablespoon of sauce and then roll. Make sure the tortilla is soft enough or it will crack when rolling. When pan is full garnish with chopped chilies and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until cheese is melted and toasty on top. Serves 8.

title: Rev.  Vriesen'S Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix ingredients drop on hot greased griddle and fry until golden brown.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix and cook stirring constantly over medium heat until thick. Put in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell with lattice top. Bake for 40 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until done.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Fry tortillas until lightly fried not crisp in oil and dry using paper towels. In a separate container put cheese. Set aside. Mix together remaining ingredients in another large mixing bowl. Separately fill each tortilla with a small amount of \mix\ and a small amount of grated cheese. Place \bed-fellow\ style in a large baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain and set aside. Saute meat onion and pepper; drain. Add tomatoes paste sugar oregano and garlic; set aside. Combine spaghetti margarine Parmesan and eggs. Press in 10-inch pie plate. Spread with cottage cheese. Top with meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese and peanut butter in a large mixing bowl; beat at medium speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add whipped topping and powdered sugar and continue beating until smooth. Spoon filling into prepared crusts. Freeze at least 8 hours or overnight. Garnish with chocolate shavings if desired. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Potato Festival Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Mash potatoes while hot then cool. Add potato water scalded and cooled milk salt sugar and melted shortening to potatoes. Add softened yeast then stir in flour. Mix thoroughly using only enough flour to make a stiff kneadable dough. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in lightly greased bowl. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk. Punch down and let rise again for about 1 hour. Shape into 2 loaves. Let rise in greased bread pans. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for about 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Turn bread out onto racks to cool. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream if desired. Makes approximately 40 (3-inch) balls.

title: Roman Apple Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter and add sifted dry ingredients. Add milk eggs and apples. Pour in a bottom oil and floured 9x12 pan.

title: Crackerjack Cookies
instructions: Cream butter well and blend in sugars. Beat in egg and vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and soda together and mix in. Stir in oatmeal Rice Krispies and coconut by hand. Drop by teaspoons onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Omit coconut if desired.

title: Sponge Candy
instructions: Mix sugar corn syrup and vinegar in saucepan. Cover tightly; bring to a boil. Uncover; place a candy thermometer in the pan. Without stirring cook over medium heat to 300\u00b0. Gradually lower heat as mixture thickens to prevent scorching. Remove from heat; quickly stir in the baking soda and vanilla. Turn into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Do not spread; candy will spread itself. Cool; break into pieces.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs 1 cup flour with baking powder and salt. Add vanilla; beat well. Cut fruit and nuts. Sprinkle the other cup flour over fruit and nuts. Pour batter over fruit and nuts. Mix with hands. Line pan with heavy brown paper (grocery bag works fine). Put in cold oven and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and bake for 2 1/2 hours. Place pan of water under cake while cooking.

title: Oven Porcupines
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix meat rice water onion salts garlic powder and pepper. Shape mixture by rounded tablespoons into balls. Place meatballs in ungreased baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Stir together remaining ingredients; pour over meatballs. Cover with aluminum foil; bake 45 minutes. Uncover bake 15 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Frosting Grate peel and squeeze juice from lemon; mix confectioners sugar and add juice.

title: Never Fail Peanut Brittle
instructions: Boil sugar syrup and water until it spins a thread. Then add peanuts and stir continually. After peanuts are added cook until it turns a light yellow. Remove from heat. Add soda salt and butter. Spread thin on buttered cookie sheet. Break into pieces.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken
instructions: Cut four thin lemon slices; squeeze 2 teaspoons juice from remaining lemon. Set aside. In skillet in hot oil cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned. Remove; set aside. Spoon off fat. In skillet combine soup milk reserved lemon juice and pepper. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet; top with lemon slices. Cover; cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink stirring often. Garnish with fresh thyme if desired.

title: Cripple Creek Chicken
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in margarine in small skillet; add paprika. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Roll in onion mixture. Arrange in 11 x 15-inch casserole. Spoon remaining onion mixture over chicken. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Stir in all ingredients except milk until moist and smooth then add milk. On medium heat cook until thick and boiling. In large bowl put in alternating layers of vanilla wafers and bananas and pudding.

title: Six-Layer, One-Dish Dinner
instructions: Layer potatoes celery ground hamburg steak green pepper onions and tomatoes. Sprinkle on each layer separately 2 teaspoons of salt and 1 teaspoon pepper. Dot with butter. Cover. Bake for 2 hours in moderate oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Torte
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake crust at 350\u00b0 until brown about 20 minutes. Let cool and crumble into 9 inch x 13 inch dish. Save some to sprinkle on top.

title: Corn Dog Mix
instructions: Mix well; dip hot dogs in batter and deep fry. This is enough for 2 pounds of hot dogs.

title: Huntington Chicken
instructions: Cook celery and pepper in chicken broth. Put noodles and all other ingredients in pan. Add some grated cheese on top. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Icing Bring sugar and water to a boil. Continue boiling until mixture spins a thread and remove from heat. Beat egg whites while sugar mixture cooks. Egg whites will form a peak. Add vanilla and heated sugar mixture to egg whites. Mix well.

title: Drop Fast Cookies
instructions: Add sugar chocolate and milk together and bring to a boil. Add peanut butter and stir until melted. Remove from heat and add oatmeal. If mixture seems too dry add a little more milk. Drop by spoonful on wax paper and refrigerate until cookies have hardened.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Blend cream cheese and 1/2 cup butter. Stir in flour and chill 1 hour. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Roll dough into 24 (1-inch) balls and press into 1 1/2-inch muffin tins. Beat egg brown sugar 1 tablespoon butter vanilla and salt together. Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans on dough in tins. Add egg mixture and sprinkle with remaining nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 25 minutes or until set. Cool in pans. Makes 24 tarts.

title: Cousin Mary Dee'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening together then add the eggs and vanilla. Sift flour and add gradually. Can make drop cookies or roll out but cool the batter first if you are going to roll them out. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Six Week Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Pour 2 cups hot water over bran and let it stand while mixing muffins.\t Mix wet ingredients\ttogether. Add\twet ingredients to dry ingredients. Add soaked bran and mix well. Store in refrigerator. Will keep 6 weeks. Bake at 350\u00b0 in oiled muffin tins or cup\tcases\t15 to 20 minutes. Do not overcook. Yields 6 dozen.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Cook ground beef until all pink is gone; drain any grease. Add chopped onion. Cook until it is clear. Add remaining ingredients and simmer. In a large saucepan put 4 cups cold water cornmeal and salt. Bring to a boil; cook until the mixture is slightly thick. Add butter; stir it in until melted. Put meat mixture in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spoon cornmeal mixture over meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and sprinkle with lemon juice salt and pepper. Mix all ingredients together with 1/2 cup salad dressing.

title: Cucumber And Raisin Salad
instructions: Add all ingredients in serving bowl and mix well.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients adding blueberries last. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Beef Goulash
instructions: In Dutch oven or heavy saucepan heat shortening and brown meat well. Stir in Lipton onion soup mix tomato paste and water. Simmer covered 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender adding more water if needed. Serve over noodles.

title: Vegetable Bars
instructions: Cover the bottom of a cookie sheet with the crescent rolls; flatten out and pat to make a solid crust. Bake according to the directions on the package until they are a light golden brown. Cool.

title: Chicken Livers And Bacon
instructions: Cut chicken livers in 1-inch squares. Cut bacon strips in half. Wrap livers in bacon securing with a toothpick. Place in a shallow pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until bacon is crisp. Drain fat. Serve hot. Makes 24 bite-size hors doeuvres.

title: Dandelion Jelly
instructions: Boil blossoms in 1 quart of water for about 3 minutes only. Drain off. Add 3 cups juice to Sure-Jell and lemon or orange extract. Bring to a boil. Add sugar. Boil about 3 minutes. Can seal and process 5 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 5 (1/2 pints).

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Crush graham crackers in a medium size bowl. Add sugar and margarine;\tmix well. Spread in bottom of large cake pan evenly. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Spinach Salad Parmesan
instructions: Toss together all ingredients. Serve with your favorite no or low-fat dressing. Makes 6 cups.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger and Italian sausage. Squeeze sausages out of skins. Add seasonings. Add tomato sauce paste and water; stir. Simmer uncovered for 3/4 hour. Make enough pasta to serve 6 to 8.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Make crust with first two ingredients. Crush crackers fine; add to softened stick of margarine. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate. With electric mixer beat next 4 ingredients for 20 minutes. Must be 20 minutes! Pour over crust. Prepare Dream Whip according to package directions. Fold in well drained crushed pineapple and sliced bananas. Spread evenly over top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together using broth from boiled chicken. Cook until light brown on top. Serve with cranberry sauce or giblet gravy.

title: Linda Kay'S Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: (I suggest you double this recipe. I make 2 or more at a time. They dont last long.)

title: Baked Green Peppers And Onions
instructions: Put all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover; bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together except corn flakes and 1/2 cup melted butter. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. May be prepared the night before and refrigerated.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Arrange potatoes in pan. Mix eggs milk 1/3 stick butter white sugar vanilla and orange juice; pour over potatoes. Combine brown sugar flour 1/3 stick butter and pecans. Sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Spanish Squash
instructions: Cook onion in a little oil until tender but not brown. Add tomatoes zucchini and salt and pepper to taste. Cook slowly adding small amount of water if needed. Add bay leaf if desired.

title: Poppy'S Tomato Sauce
instructions: Put a little olive oil in bottom of pan. Brown onion and garlic. Add both cans of tomatoes and sugar. Top with oregano black pepper and salt to taste. Simmer 1 to 2 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Use a 3-quart baking dish. Stew chicken cool and debone. Reserve 2 cups of broth. Combine soups with 1 cup of broth. Pour over chicken. Mix melted butter with second cup of broth and mix in stuffing. Spoon over chicken. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Grease pie pan with butter and dust with flour. Combine ingredients and pour into pie pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown onion in cooking oil and add ground beef chili powder tomato sauce corn and olives. Place in mixing bowl and add 1 1/2 cups milk and 1 cup corn meal. Place in a greased baking dish and top with 1/2 pound grated Cheddar cheese. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans or 3 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf pans. In large bowl cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Stir in eggs pumpkin and water. Blend in flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and cloves. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into pans and bake about 70 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
instructions: Heat first 6 ingredients until milk is scalding. Stir in potatoes. Cook until smooth stirring constantly.

title: Apple Chip Cake
instructions: Beat together eggs and sugar. Add vegetable oil. In large bowl mix together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Slowly mix dry ingredients into egg mixture. Blend well. Fold in apples and nuts. Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Avocado Dip
instructions: Mash avocados. Peel tomato and dice to fine pieces. Chop onion into fine pieces. Mix these together and add salt and very finely chopped jalapeno peppers to taste. Sprinkle lemon juice over top of mixture. This helps it from turning brown. Chill and serve.

title: Fruit Cup With Lemon Creme
instructions: In large bowl combine undrained pineapple chunks undrained mandarin orange sections and undrained fruit cocktail with the flaked coconut and lemon juice. Sprinkle the instant lemon pudding mix over the fruits and toss lightly to combine. Chill. Just before serving peel and slice bananas; fold into fruit mixture. Serve in dessert dishes; top with approximately 2 1/2 tablespoons Cool Whip. If desired garnish with tiny bit of grated lemon or grated orange peel. Serves 9.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Cream butter sugar salt and flour. Add egg yolks and lemon juice; beat until fluffy. Stir in milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites with a wire whisk gently until well blended.

title: Carob Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter honey and molasses; add egg. Sift dry ingredients. Mix together. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Dirt
instructions: Scrape filling off 1 roll Oreos; crush and save. Mix pudding milk and cream cheese in mixer. Stir in Cool Whip. Crush 2 rolls Oreos and stir into mixture along with filling from first roll. Spoon into plant pot. Sprinkle crumbs from first roll on top. Cover and refrigerate. Place flower in pot when ready to serve.

title: Sweet Yams
instructions: Mix and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil eggs sugar and vanilla together. Sift together flour soda cinnamon and salt. Mix well into egg mixture. Blend in apples and nuts. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Roast Bacon
instructions: If necessary remove casing from bacon. Place bacon fat side up in ungreased baking dish. Stir together pineapple (with syrup) honey ginger and water. Pour over bacon. Roast uncovered for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Baste occasionally.

title: Roasted Peppers Siciliano
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Wash peppers and drain well. Place peppers on cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes or until the skin of the peppers become blistered and charred. Turn the peppers every 5 minutes with tongs. Place hot peppers in a large kettle; cover kettle and let them stand 15 minutes. Peel off charred skin with sharp knife. Cut each pepper into quarters. Remove the ribs and seeds and cut out any dark spots. In large bowl combine oil lemon juice salt and garlic. Put the pepper mixture with or without anchovy fillets into a 1-quart dish or jar covered. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve as an appetizer a side dish or use in a tossed salad. Makes 1 quart. Excellent with lasagne or other Italian meals.

title: Miniature Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Combine flour salt and baking soda and set aside. Combine brown sugar and granulated sugar butter and vanilla extract; beat until creamy. Add eggs; beat well. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Stir in semi-sweet chocolate mini chips and chopped nuts. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes approximately 6 dozen cookies.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Beat eggs; add oil sugar and vanilla. Mix well then add zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients. Pour into loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Crab Meat Canapes
instructions: Combine cheese spread seasonings butter mayonnaise and crab meat in bowl; mix well. Spread on muffin halves. Freeze just until firm. Cut into quarters. Store wrapped in freezer. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place on baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Sunshine Salad Dessert
instructions: Strain all fruit and cut up in small pieces. In a large bowl place all strained and cut fruit. Add sour cream and mix thoroughly. Add miniature marshmallows and mix.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 2 loaf pans lightly greased at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Watermelon Rind Pickles
instructions: Select a melon that has a thick rind. Remove outer green skin and pink flesh; use only the greenish white part of the rind. Cut rind into 1 inch cubes. combine rind and cold water; soak overnight in refrigerator. Drain; cover with water and boil 30 minutes. Drain.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips together. Pour over Crispix mixture. Put mixture and powdered sugar in paper grocery bag. Shake until coated. Allow to cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in a deep-dish pie pan. In one bowl mix 1 cup of sugar flour and milk. In another bowl mix 1/2 cup sugar and fruit. Pour batter into pie pan with melted butter. Add fruit. Do not mix. Bake for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Southern Pork Loin
instructions: For basting sauce saut onions and celery in the butter until soft. Add tomato puree vinegar and molasses. Blend well. Place meat on a roasting rack in pan. Brush with part of the sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours or until pork is tender and juices run clear when pierced with a fork. Do brush the pork from time to time during cooking for best flavor. Cooking time depends on thickness of meat. Makes 4 servings.

title: Skippy Quick Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In medium bowl combine ingredients; stir making a dough. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Put on ungreased cookie sheet. Place 2-inches apart and with a fork gently flatten each cookie making crisscross pattern on each cookie. Bake 8 minutes or until lightly brown and slightly puffed. May be topped immediately with sprinkles chocolate chips or Hershey Kisses if desired. Cool on rack completely.

title: Apple Caramel Dip
instructions: Unwrap caramels. Place in bowl with a little milk. Microwave until partially melted. Add cream cheese and stir. Microwave until melted and smooth (add more milk if needed). Slice apples and dip.

title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs lightly in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar oil and vanilla. Beat until creamy. In another bowl combine flour baking soda salt baking powder cinnamon and nuts; set aside. Add zucchini and pineapple to egg and sugar mixture. Add dry ingredients stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon batter into 2 well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Nutty Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Combine margarine with brown sugar. Add cornflakes and pecans. Sprinkle over the cooked mixture. Place maraschino cherries over top and return to oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Banana Loaf Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs well beaten. Add flour with baking powder. Sift in. Add milk and soda mixture. Add 4 mashed bananas and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0. Do not grease pan.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: In a shallow baking dish combine all ingredients except for shrimp. Cook uncovered in microwave at High for 4 to 5 minutes stirring twice. Stir shrimp into butter sauce. Cover. Microwave at High for 5 to 7 1/2 minutes or until shrimp are opaque. Let stand covered for 3 to 5 minutes before serving.

title: Apple-Nut Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat cheese and apple juice in small mixing bowl until smooth. Cover and chill at serving time. Sprinkle with pecans. Serve with fruit dippers. Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients and apples by hand in large bowl until apples are well coated. Combine with wet ingredients. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean at 350\u00b0 (may be less than 1 hour). Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Good with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Homemade Bread And Buns
instructions: Mix lard sugar and salt. Beat in eggs with spoon into granite dish pan. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add to mixture. Then add flour to warm water mix. Only then add flour to stiffen and not sticky; pat into ball. Leave in dishpan. Cover with tea towel. Let rise 2 hours. Pull off about 2-inch. Roll into ball. Put in greased pans or into loaf bread. Let rise 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Brush with butter after out of oven and pan. Let cool and serve warm.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: In a medium sized saucepan mix the 1 cup sugar salt cinnamon nutmeg cloves and cornstarch. Beat in the egg yolks and then the sour cream and raisins. Cook over low heat about 10 minutes stirring constantly until well thickened. (Mix will thin on heating and then thicken again.) Remove from heat and cool 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening sugar and brown sugar. Add egg and crushed pineapple (drained). Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Add to pineapple. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Superfast Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Combine flour 1/4 cup sugar and milk in mixing bowl; stir to blend. Pour batter evenly over melted butter. Stir together berries remaining 1/2 cup sugar and water; spoon evenly over batter. Do not stir. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: In a large crock-pot add the ingredients. Cook on low 2 hours before serving. Serve with chips.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix hamburger onions bell\tpepper eggs\tcracker crumbs potatoes salt and pepper. Mix\t2/3 can of tomato sauce. Bake for approximately 1 1/2 or 2 hours at 350\u00b0. When done take out of skillet. Add 1 1/2 cups of water and 1/3 can of tomato sauce. Thicken with flour for gravy.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: In a bowl cream sugar and butter. Add the eggs and banana and mix together. Sift together the flour salt and soda. Combine with the creamed mixture; add walnuts and mix again. Pour into 2 greased and papered loaf pans. Bake 1 hour in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers. Mix 2 packages jello pudding mix with 3 1/2 cups milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread 1/2 jello mixture over graham crackers. Top with another layer graham crackers and spread other half of jello pudding mixture over that. Cool in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Do not cover pan with Saran Wrap or waxed paper. Spread frosting over top and refrigerate. Should be made at least 24 hours ahead of time.

title: Sparkling Harvest Cider
instructions: In punch bowl combine cider ReaLemon and sugar. Stir until sugar dissolves. Chill.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. When mixed well enough to work with add cheese. Knead this and put on floured board. Roll out and cut biscuits. I melt some margarine in my pan and see that top and bottom of biscuits have margarine on them. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine sugar and oil. Mix in eggs and zucchini. Add salt flour soda spices and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in raisins and nuts. Bake in 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 75 minutes.

title: Hot Dogs Roll-Ups
instructions: Wrap bacon around hot dogs; secure with toothpicks. Place in crock-pot. Pour the brown sugar over the hot dogs. Simmer on high for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onions in margarine. In a separate pan cook broccoli according to directions; set aside. Cook rice. Combine soup water chestnuts Cheez Whiz rice celery and onions until the cheese melts. Add broccoli and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Set cheese out until soft; add garlic powder red pepper and pecans. Mix well with hands. Roll into two rolls. Sprinkle with chili powder. Refrigerate; slice when cool.

title: Lemon-Lime Mold
instructions: Make jello and mix but substitute 1 pint of sour cream for 1 cup of water. (Beat some cream with some jello to avoid curdling) and then add 1 can crushed pineapple drained. Let set and unmold. May garnish with avocado slices.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Mix salt and cabbage; let stand 1 hour. Squeeze excess moisture from cabbage. Add carrot and green pepper. Mix together in saucepan the vinegar water mustard seed celery seed and sugar. Boil 1 minute. Cool to lukewarm; pour over cabbage mix and serve. This slaw freezes very well. Make a double amount and freeze half for a future meal and picnic.

title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Spread on cake platter in order given. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Lemon Or Orange Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth and creamy. Pour into pie crust. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Kraut With Dumplings
instructions: Empty kraut in a deep pan. Add water and boil.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package while browning one pound of hamburger. Drain hamburger. Drain lasagna noodles and run cold water over noodles. Then spread 3 of noodles in a cake pan making a layer. Spoon Ragu sauce over the noodles. Sprinkle the hamburger over the sauce. Then sprinkle the Mozzarella cheese over the hamburger.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Trim off large leaves of broccoli. Remove tough ends and wash thoroughly. Cut flowerets and stems into bite size pieces. Add bacon onions and raisins. Combine remaining ingredients in separate bowl; stir well. Add dressing to broccoli mixture; toss gently. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

title: Quick Nut Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts in top of double boiler. Place over simmering water and stir until smooth. Add nuts and mix.

title: Holiday Coconut Rum Balls
instructions: In a large bowl combine crushed cookies nuts and coconut. Add sweetened condensed milk and rum; mix well. Chill 4 hours. Dip palms of hands in powdered sugar and shape batter into 1-inch balls. Roll in powdered sugar; cover and store in fridge. If desired reroll in powdered sugar before serving. May be made ahead and stored in fridge for several weeks.

title: Meat And Veggie Bake
instructions: Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with strips of bacon. Crumble raw ground beef over bacon. Slice potatoes and place over ground beef. Peel and slice carrots and put on top of potatoes. Slice onion and put on top of carrots. Pour 1 cup water over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Cook all ingredients except onions on top of stove for 3 to 4 hours in covered pan. During last 1/2 hour remove meat; slice thinly with electric knife. Return sliced meat to broth. Add sliced onion and cook another 1/2 hour or until onions are soft. Serve as roast or make sandwiches when served on kaiser rolls.

title: Orange Tea
instructions: Pour 4 cups boiling water over the tea leaves and orange rind in a heat-proof bowl and let the mixture steep for 10 minutes. Strain the tea into a pitcher; add the orange juice the lemon juice and the sugar stirring until the sugar is dissolved and chill the mixture. Add the ginger ale; pour the mixture into tall glasses filled with ice cubes and garnish each drink with one of the orange slices. Makes 8 drinks.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add rest of ingredients. Bake in lightly greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake 4 to 5 hours at 250\u00b0. (Can be made in a crock-pot 4 to 5 hours.)

title: Millie'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Make meatballs from the hamburger and set aside. (You can brown the meatballs if you wish but they cook very well if added to the sauce raw.) Combine all ingredients except meatballs and pasta and cook at least 8 hours. Add the meatballs to the sauce and cook until they are done. Serve over prepared pasta.

title: Custard Pie (Fruit)
instructions: Place in unbaked pie shell. One cup of fresh fruit may be placed on top (such as rhubarb strawberries blueberries cherries etc.). Bake at 350\u00b0 until set (knife when inserted will come out clean).

title: Pioneer Skillet Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare a fire so you will have hot coals on the hearth. Put dry ingredients unsifted in bowl. Mix in buttermilk and egg. Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and mix thoroughly. Put remaining oil in 9-inch cast-iron skillet. (If baking in fireplace use cast-iron skillet with legs called spider pan.) Heat skillet in oven or over coals for 5 to 10 minutes. In oven pour batter into skillet and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brown. Cut into wedges and serve with butter.

title: Hobo Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes pepper and onion in strips. Layer 1/2 the potatoes onions and pepper on a sheet of foil. Add 1/2 the butter and garlic powder. Layer the rest of the vegetables add the rest of the butter and garlic. Wrap in aluminum foil. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour or until tender. Also great cooked on the grill.

title: Roast Turkey Breast With Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place turkey in shallow roasting pan. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over turkey. Cover and bake until done (165\u00b0 to 170\u00b0 on meat thermometer) about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Cut turkey into slices. Serve gravy with turkey and if desired with boiled or mashed potatoes. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Walnut Balls
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Sift flour and salt together; add to creamed mixture. Mix well to make soft dough. Stir in walnuts (pecans). Break off pieces of dough size of walnut; shape into balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet with spatula. Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar. Makes 4 dozen balls.

title: Baked Ahead Potatoes
instructions: Scrub pierce and bake potatoes at 425\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Cool slightly. Break in half lengthwise and scoop potatoes into a large bowl. Beat in butter salt pepper and sour cream. Refill shells. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes. Freeze or refrigerate as desired. Serves 6.

title: German-Style Red Cabbage
instructions: Remove outer leaves quarter core and shred cabbage. Core and slice unpeeled apples. Combine cabbage apples bacon fat salt and pepper in heavy saucepan. Add enough boiling water to cover. Cover pan and simmer until cabbage is tender but still somewhat crisp (20 minutes). Drain off liquid reserve and keep hot.

title: Crab Delight Spread
instructions: Dissolve Knox gelatine in water. Warm cream of mushroom soup and mix with the dissolved gelatin. Add the remaining ingredients and stir. Pour into 1 quart mold.

title: Whole Wheat Bread Pudding
instructions: Remove crust. Cut in cubes. Soak in water and squeeze out. Place in 2-quart baking dish; mix and add milk. Put in hot oven. When it starts to bake well then turn down heat. Stir often for 2 hours. Serve hot or cold with whipped cream.

title: Hot Pizza Dip
instructions: In a bowl combine cream cheese Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Spread on the bottom of a greased 9-inch pie plate. Combine cheeses; sprinkle half over the cream cheese layer. Top with the pizza sauce and peppers. Sprinkle with the remaining cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve warm with tortilla chips or breadsticks.

title: Chicken Salad With Pecans
instructions: Boil chicken until done let cool and cut into small chunks. Fry bacon until very crisp crumble into bacon bits. Chop celery medium fine. Crumble pecans under each half is in about 6 pieces. Open canned mushrooms and drain. Put in large bowl chicken bacon bits celery pecans and mushrooms. Add sour cream mayonnaise and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly and serve.

title: Ambrosia Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round cake pans in 325\u00b0 oven. Stir in brown sugar. Spread mixture evenly in pans.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening salt and peanut butter in mixer. Add sugars; add eggs milk and flour sifted with soda. Drop small spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Mash with fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done. May also be used as icebox cookies. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Congealed Peach Salad
instructions: Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise. Bring 1 cup of juice to a boil; add to Jell-O stirring until dissolved. Add 4 tablespoons hot liquid to cheese mix and blend. Add to Jell-O mix and blend well.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: First Layer Spread 2 cans of bean dip.

title: Meatball Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes. Add to meatballs. Cook in crock-pot on low for 6 to 8 hours. (Italian meatballs can be gotten from Sams.)

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add all ingredients. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with tostado chips or corn bread.

title: Reuben Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until hot. Serve with cocktail rye and horseradish sauce if desired.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli until done. Drain. Saute onion and pepper in butter. Mix broccoli rice onion pepper and mushroom soup together. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 long enough to heat through and melt cheese.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage until done. Drain and set aside. Beat eggs. Add milk salt and mustard. In a greased baking dish layer bread sausage and cheese. Pour eggs over this. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Potato-Peanut Candy
instructions: Boil potato in\tslightly salted water until\tcooked. Mash hot potato adding as much powdered sugar as it will hold to make dough that can be rolled out. Add vanilla during this process. Roll out on powdered sugar to 1/4-inch thickness. Spread with peanut butter generously. Roll up and\tslice. This candy keeps very well.

title: Hamburger And Macaroni
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet. Cook macaroni until done in large pot. Put macaroni and hamburger in square 9 x 9-inch pan or larger if serving large crowd. Add spaghetti sauce. Sprinkle shredded cheese over top. Place in microwave or in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Mix other ingredients together. Set aside. Put broccoli in 9 x 11 baking pan. Pour mixture over it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes uncovered.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix together. Put in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch greased pan.

title: Gingery Pea And Noodle Salad
instructions: Stir mayonnaise ginger garlic salt mustard and soy sauce. Chill. Dice green onions and celery. Combine with peas and water chestnuts. Cover and chill.

title: Macadamia Butterfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 275\u00b0. Lightly grease a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. In a large mixing bowl beat butter brown sugar granulated sugar egg yolk and nutmeg until light and fluffy. Add flour; stir to combine. Pat dough over bottom of prepared pan.

title: Grandma'S Swiss Steak
instructions: Get the round steak cut a little thicker than the regular round steak. Cut meat into pieces. Pour some flour on it and pound flour into meat. Have oil hot in pan; brown meat. Add green pepper celery and tomato juice to meat. Salt to taste. Let simmer until well done. Add a little water if meat isnt done and the tomato juice is used up.

title: Miniature Cheesecakes
instructions: Mix together. Place in paper lined cupcake tins using about 1 1/2 tablespoons per cup. Reserve 1/2 cup for topping.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Combine all and serve over ice.

title: Fried Ice Cream
instructions: Roll a scoop of ice cream (any flavor) in crushed corn flakes. Freeze. Roll out a canned biscuit or pie pastry and wrap ice cream being careful to seal all edges. This may be returned to freezer until ready to fry. Heat oil to 400\u00b0 and drop ice cream in for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Drain. Top with maple syrup and nuts. Most any kind of ice cream topping will do fine. Serve at once.

title: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Memmie'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust according to directions on package. Heat milk in double boiler. While it is heating mix sugar salt cornstarch and cocoa well; set aside. Beat egg yellows slightly adding 1/3 cup of the warmed milk. Pour egg mixture back into milk in double boiler. Add sugar mixture. Stir constantly over medium heat until thick. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Allow to cool slightly. Pour into cool baked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Patti'S Chicken
instructions: Beat eggs; add garlic pepper and diced onions. Dip chicken breasts in mixture. Fry chicken until brown then bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add vegetables to chicken and bake an additional 15 minutes. Take chicken out of the oven and sprinkle the avocado over it before serving. Serves 4.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients and shape into small meatballs. Roll meatballs in paprika. Lightly brown in 1/4 cup margarine. Drain grease and cover meatballs with cream of mushroom soup mixed with 1/2 can water. Bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Tear bread into pieces and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook sausage and drain. Put over bread. Put cheese over sausage.

title: Low-Fat Jello Salad
instructions: Cook Jell-O and pineapple juice for 5 minutes after it comes to a full boil. Cool. Mix Cool Whip cottage cheese and pineapple together. Add Jell-O mixture. Blend well. Pour in mold and chill.

title: Orange Raisin Carrots
instructions: Combine carrots water and salt in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat. Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes until carrots are crisp-tender; drain. Combine orange juice and cornstarch and stir into carrots. Stir in raisins and sugar. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients until creamy. Beat in water egg and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients. Mix well. Cover; chill about 2 hours. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; flatten with tines of fork dipped in granulated sugar to form crisscross pattern. Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack. Cool completely.

title: Frozen Chocolate Sundae
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and marshmallows in evaporated milk on medium heat. Layer crushed cookies in a flat 9 x 13-inch dish with softened ice cream on top of that. Spread the chocolate mixture over the top of ice cream; sprinkle more cookie bits on top of chocolate mixture and freeze. When set cut and serve.

title: Rich Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and beat with mixture until well blended. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with boiled shrimp.

title: Potatoes For Mr. And Mrs. Party
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick oleo in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together onion and potatoes and put in pan. Heat mushroom soup and cheese. Pour over potatoes and onion. Top with corn flakes and drizzle with melted butter.

title: Heath Toffee Cake
instructions: Cook German chocolate cake as directed on package. When cake is done while hot pour milk over cake. Next pour caramel topping over cake. Next put chopped nuts then add chopped Heath bar. Punch holes in cake before adding topping ingredients.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs buttermilk and coconut. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until browned.

title: Million Dollar Pies
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into prepared pie shells. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Coq Au Vin
instructions: Wash and dry chicken. Combine salt pepper and flour; rub into chicken. Brown chicken in butter in a Dutch oven or electric skillet. Add whole onions garlic and mushrooms. Cook over low heat until onions brown lightly. Add wine thyme and bay leaf. Cook covered over low heat 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Gladys' Baked Dessert
instructions: Beat eggs; add dry ingredients. Mix well. Stir in melted butter. Add pecans and vanilla. Pour into an 11 x 7-inch pan. Set that pan in another pan of boiling water. Bake at 325\u00b0. Bake for 45 minutes or until set like a custard. Do not overbake. Cool. Cut into 2-inch squares. Can be served plain or topped with whipped cream and a cherry.

title: Pizza Potatoes
instructions: Put potato slices and packet of seasoning mix into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Heat tomatoes water and oregano to boiling; stir into potatoes. Mix in cheese and pepperoni (use as much or as little as you like). Arrange more cheese and pepperoni on top. Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cream Squares
instructions: Melt butter and pour into cake mix. Add egg. Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish. Take cream cheese powdered sugar vanilla and eggs and pour over cake mix. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Cranberry Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple. Combine flour sugar soda and salt. Stir in dates and almonds. Combine pineapple with eggs cranberry sauce oil and orange peel; stir into dry mixture.

title: Uncooked Finger Paints
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Add water. Mixture will be grainy.

title: Easy Cherry Cake
instructions: Melt the margarine in an 8 or 9-inch square pan. Combine flour sugar baking powder and milk. Pour over margarine. Pour cherry pie filling over dough. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Wash and peel eggplant. Slice into 3/8-inch slices. Dip into beaten eggs until coated well then place into seasoned bread crumbs until well coated. Cook in electric pan at 300\u00b0 for 3 to 4 minutes on each side. You may use olive oil Pam or vegetable oil. Make 2 rows in a 13 x 9-inch dish. Pour sauce over fried eggplant. Sprinkle with cheese and sliced mushrooms. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until slightly golden. Allow cheese to set for 10 minutes before serving. Serves 4.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Bring to a boil all ingredients except clams. Cook for 20 minutes. Take off burner. Now dump in clams and let set while you get another saucepan and melt 4 tablespoons of margarine. Stir in 2 tablespoons of flour and 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Add salt and pepper to taste. (It will appear lumpy.) Take off burner. Put soup back on burner and pour in the sauce. Stir frequently and cook for 10 more minutes.

title: Valentine Party Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl combine dry gelatin and cottage cheese. Fold in pineapple marshmallows pecans and cherries. Add Cool Whip lite. Mix gently to combine. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Indoor S'Mores
instructions: Butter baking pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Heat corn syrup butter and chocolate morsels to boiling in 3-quart saucepan stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal in large mixing bowl; toss quickly until completely coated with chocolate. Fold in marshmallows 1 cup at a time. Press mixture evenly in pan with buttered back of spoon. Let stand until firm at least 1 hour. Cut into about 1 1/2-inch squares. Makes 48 squares.

title: Barbecue Slaw
instructions: Mix with 1/2 large head of cabbage chopped.

title: Quick And Easy Jello Salad
instructions: Sprinkle dry gelatin into cottage cheese and mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients. Store salad in refrigerator at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Herb Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in advance. Chill and store and use as desired over salads. Use 2 tablespoons per serving.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine oats and oleo in boiling water and let stand 20 minutes. Cream together sugars and eggs and add to oat mixture then add flour salt cinnamon soda and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bad Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. In pot add beans onions bell peppers and remaining ingredients. Heat on low 15 minutes. Crumble bacon and add most of it to heating mixture. Put mixture in baking dish and top with remaining bacon. Cook at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Thanksgiving Potatoes
instructions: Place the diced potatoes in a large saucepan and add water to cover. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer over medium heat until tender. Drain. Place the potatoes in a mixer bowl. Cut the butter and cream cheese into small pieces and add to the potatoes. Beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Beat in the sour cream. Season with nutmeg salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately or reheat in a buttered casserole at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes if you want to prepare them in advance. Yields 8 servings.

title: Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Brown meat in skillet over medium heat. Drain fat and set aside. Blend next four ingredients until smooth. Stir in meat cheese onion and pepper.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine sugar flour cocoa baking soda and salt in a large mixing bowl; mix well. Heat margarine and water in saucepan until boiling. Pour over dry ingredients; mix well. Beat in buttermilk eggs and vanilla.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel and dice eggplant. Cook for 10 minutes in boiling water. Drain in a colander. Place in a greased baking dish. Melt 3 tablespoons butter; stir in 3 tablespoons flour. Add tomatoes then chopped onion and pepper. Add 1 tablespoon sugar bay leaf and cloves; cook 5 minutes. Pour over eggplant. Cover with bread crumbs; add grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Harvest Cake
instructions: Dice apples. Mix well with sugar; let stand for 1 hour. Add flour soda salt vanilla oil eggs walnuts and fruit. Mix well. Pour into baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Barbecued Pot Roast
instructions: Rub roast surface with salt and pepper. Brown in butter on all sides. Add water tomato juice onion and garlic. Simmer meat 1 1\\2 hours. Mix remaining ingredients and add to meat. Cook for 2 hours more. Add potatoes and carrots the last 2 hours.

title: Cranberry Conserve
instructions: In a large saucepan combine cranberries orange peel oranges raisins and water. Cover and simmer over medium heat until cranberries are soft. Add pecans and sugar; stir well. Simmer uncovered 10 to 15 minutes stirring often. Cool. Spoon into covered containers. Refrigerate. Serve as a relish with poultry or pork or spread on biscuits.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Mix the mustard flour oil and turmeric together with 1 pint cold vinegar. Stir into 6 pints of vinegar and boil. Add vegetables and cook until tender. Put in jars and seal well.

title: Cheese Blitz
instructions: Mix well the cream cheese egg and 1/2 cup sugar. Spread mixture on bread. Roll up; dip in margarine and sugar. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with cinnamon. Melt margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Bundt Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients together thoroughly in a large bowl. Pour into a \well\ greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Turn out on a plate. A light powdered sugar glaze goes well with this cake.

title: Jello Pudding Pecan Pie
instructions: Blend pie filling with corn syrup. Gradually stir in evaporated milk and egg. Add nuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 until top is firm and just begins to crack (about 40 minutes). Cool at least 3 hours. Garnish if desired.

title: Pink Fluff
instructions: Take pineapple Jell-O and sugar and heat on stove. Cool. Beat cold milk and softened cream cheese. Fold into jello mixture.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add meat. Brown and drain. Add tomatoes corn soup and ketchup. Top with Tots. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until Tots brown.

title: Pineapple Icebox Pudding
instructions: Combine butter and sugar. Beat until light. Add beaten egg yolks and pineapple. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture. Roll wafers to crumbs and add crushed pecans. Place a layer of crumbs then a layer of fruit alternating with crumbs on top. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: In ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan crumble raw ground beef and season with salt pepper onion and garlic powder. Cover evenly with Tater Tots. Add the undiluted cream of mushroom soup. Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes until bubbly. Bake at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Tex-Mex Soup
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan brown onion and hamburger. Add remaining ingredients. Heat for 10 minutes. Serve with crushed corn or tortilla chips cheese sour cream and shredded lettuce.

title: Herbed Beef-Vegetable Stew
instructions: In a Dutch oven brown meat on all sides in hot oil. Drain off any excess fat. Stir in gravy tomatoes Heinz 57 sauce garlic bay leaves thyme and pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover; simmer for 1 hour. Add carrots and onions; simmer 20 minutes more. Stir in mushrooms and if desired the olives. Simmer 15 minutes more or until meat and vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf; discard. Season to taste. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Beef Summer Sausage
instructions: Crumble ground beef in a large bowl. Mix the next 6 ingredients together and sprinkle over ground beef. Mix water and liquid smoke together and pour over ground beef. Add peppercorns and mix thoroughly best method is to use your hands. Divide into 3 equal portions and shape into rolls. Wrap in foil. Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Chicken Sauce
instructions: Mix together and heat until thick. Put chicken in oven for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Take out and pour sauce over chicken. Bake in oven for one hour.

title: Cranberry Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve over a bar of cream cheese.

title: Surprise Pie
instructions: Place eggs oleo sugar and flour into blender at high speed for 1 minute. Whether using chocolate chips or coconut add and blend a few seconds. Pour into greased pie plate. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from center comes out clean. Pie forms its own crust.

title: Dilly Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in refrigerator overnight before serving.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Blend soup and milk and add all ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese. Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with reserved cheese. Bake for 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Heat sugar and syrup slowly to boiling until sugar melts completely. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies. Roll into balls with hands and place on waxed paper or spread on buttered cookie sheet and cut into 1-inch squares. Store in fridge.

title: Zucchini Casserole Imperial
instructions: Cook zucchini until tender (not mushy); drain. In large bowl beat eggs; stir in mayonnaise onion green pepper celery salt and pepper. Add zucchini. Turn into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Dot with butter and sprinkle with buttered breadcrumbs.

title: New Corn Bread
instructions: Blend gently to mix then bake in greased pan at 425\u00b0 until brown and crusty.

title: Chalupa
instructions: Combine in large kettle. Cover with water; bring to boil. Cover and simmer about 6 hours. Break up meat and cook uncovered until thick about 45 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
instructions: Place graham crackers in bowl and add butter and sugar. Press crumbs on bottom of baking dish. Mix sour cream milk and pudding mix together. Add whipped topping mixing until blended. Spread 1/2 over crumb crust. Slice bananas over filling. Spread the remaining filling over that. Grate pecans over top. Garnish with raspberries and mint.

title: Fireplace Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes onions parsley and pimiento. Add seasonings. Brown in hot fat until golden brown and crisp. Makes 6 servings.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt together chocolate chips peanut butter and margarine and pour over Crispix cereal (use a large bowl). Stir well. Get a grocery sack. Shake out the dust. Take the powdered sugar and pour in the sack. Dump the cereal mixture in. Close the top of the sack. Shake it. Shake it some more baby shake shake shake shake. Look in the bag. Is your chow well coated? If not add more sugar and shake it baby shake it some more. Pour out onto wax paper or foil. Eat some. Eat some more. Put it in a bowl with a lid and put it in a cabinet. Say you wont eat anymore. Swear you wont eat more! Eat some more . . . get really fat!

title: Orange Raspberry Soup(Serve As An Appetizer Or As A Dessert.)
instructions: Let orange concentrate and red raspberries thaw overnight in fridge. Combine all ingredients in blender. Turn on high for 1 minute. (Can be made ahead of time and kept in fridge until needed.)

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers and butter. Pour into well-greased baking dish. Sprinkle top with buttered cracker crumbs and bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt margarine (reserve 1/4 cup). Mix other 1/4 cup margarine salt onion sour cream soup and cheese in pan until cheese melts. Put hash browns in pan. Pour cheese mixture over hash browns. Cover with crushed corn flakes and pour remaining margarine over all. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Special K Bars
instructions: Combine sugar and Karo syrup in pot and bring to boil. Be very careful not to burn helps to keep stirring. Take off stove; stir in peanut butter then add Special K. Mix well and spread evenly in greased pan or dish (14 x 9-inch works real good). Sprinkle both types of chips on top and top broil in oven just to slightly melt chips. Remove and let cool. Cut and serve.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Mix brown sugar oleo 2 tablespoons flour and walnuts. Set aside. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Beat eggs. Gradually add sugar beating after each addition. Stir in melted oleo. Add flour mixture alternately with milk. Beat until smooth. Spread 1/2 of batter in greased 9-inch pan. Spoon pie filling over batter. Cover with remaining batter.
