Sprinkle brown sugar mixture over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Seafood Chowder
instructions: Saute onion and carrots in butter until onion is tender. Sprinkle with flour and stir. Add water salt and pepper and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and simmer approximately 30 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Butterfinger Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine flour soda and salt in a small bowl. Beat sugar and butter in large mixing bowl until creamy. Beat in egg; gradually add flour mixture. Stir in Butterfinger pieces. Drop by slightly rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cook on baking sheet for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream the margarine; add sugar. Mix in eggs; add vanilla. Stir in flour. Add chocolate and nuts. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: In a medium bowl combine stems cheese parsley and dressing. Fill mushroom caps. Bake 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Contains 15 calories each.

title: Borscht
instructions: Chop beets carrots and onion. Cover with water in a saucepan and bring to a simmer. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Add cabbage miso and apple cider vinegar. Cook for 10 more minutes. Add tamari or salt to taste. Serve hot in bowls with a dollop of sour cream on top.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook ground beef. Mix the spaghetti sauce and onion together. In a 9 x 18-inch pan layer the noodles meat and cheeses until pan is full. Cook for 20 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Mother'S Flaky Pie Crust
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Blend in Crisco. Mix together vinegar egg and water and stir into flour mixture. Roll out and fit into pie pans. Fill with favorite fillings.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix in order. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Coconut Delight
instructions: Cut butter into flour until it looks like coarse meal. Add pecans and press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Cool.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add all other ingredients. Place dough in greased bowl. No need to let rise before baking. Keep covered in icebox and cook as you want them.

title: Peaches And Cream Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Mix in dry pudding mix. Pour into 8 1/2 x 13-inch greased cake pan. Place sliced peaches on top of batter. Blend cream cheese sugar and peach juice together and pour over top of peaches. Bake for 1 hour on 350\u00b0. Best when served warm!

title: Hominy
instructions: Dissolve the lye in the cold water. Stir in the shelled corn and let stand for 15 hours. Drain off the lye water and put the corn in a sack. Rub and wash it in the sack through running water. After the hulls are off the corn take it out of the sack and cook for 3 or 4 hours or until tender. Change the water 2 or 3 times while it is cooking.

title: Fudge Sauce
instructions: Place ingredients into saucepan. Heat on high to a boil. Continue to boil stirring constantly.

title: Raspberry Ribbon Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in raspberries pineapple and pecans; blend well. Spoon 1 1/2 cups gelatin mixture into a lightly oiled 8-cup mold. Chill until set. Spread 1 cup sour cream over raspberry layer. Spread remaining raspberry mixture over sour cream. Chill until set. Spread 1 cup sour cream over raspberry layer. Top with remaining raspberry mixture. Chill until firm.

title: Dorito Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Drain off fat. Add mushroom soup milk Cheddar cheese soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Mix well. Place layer of Doritos chips in the bottom of baking dish followed by layer of mixture then chips and more mixture. Place layer of grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: In separate skillets brown the meats drain and spoon into large stew pot. Then in no particular order add everything else. Cover and simmer on medium heat until vegetables are tender.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Drain Veg-All. Mix with chicken soup and broth.

title: Papaya Jam
instructions: Measure fruit into 6 or 8-quart pot. Measure sugar into separate bowl; mix 1/4 cup of the sugar with 1 box of Sure-Jell. Stir sugar with Sure-Jell into fruit. Bring mixture to full rolling boil stirring constantly. Quickly add remaining sugar to fruit. Bring to full rolling boil. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Fill jars. Quickly cover and seal. Invert for 5 minutes.

title: Ambrosia Dip
instructions: Drain and rinse cherries. Drain pineapple. Place all ingredients in food processor. Process until well blended or mix well until blended. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Serve with assortment of fresh fruit or fat free cinnamon star cookies or angel food cake. Yields 8 servings (1/4 cup each). Has 85 calories 1 g. fat. Heavenly!

title: Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs cocoa molasses cinnamon cloves and salt. Add buttermilk. Add flour and mix well. Makes a 2 layer round cake or a loaf cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes for layer a little longer for loaf.

title: Hamburg Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown hamburg; drain. Bring to boil the vegetables. Add the seasoning cabbage and water. Bring to a boil again. Add the rice. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Boil wieners as you would for hot dogs. Wipe dry. Insert stick in wieners if you have them. If not serve on plate and eat with forks. Mix flour sugar baking powder salt corn meal butter milk and eggs together. Coat wieners with batter. Fry in deep fat heated to 365\u00b0 until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Good served with mustard.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Chop apples fine. Add sugar; mix and set aside. Mix oil or oleo vanilla and eggs. Add to apple mixture. Sift together flour cinnamon nutmeg salt and soda. Add pecans. Mix and add to apple mixture. Pour into Bundt or tube pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Tuna And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine rice albacore celery onion lemon juice diced eggs sliced mushrooms and sliced chestnuts. Mix curry powder pepper mushroom soup and mayonnaise. Add to rice and tuna mix. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Add crumbled potato chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until it bubbles. If made ahead add potato chips last and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Mock Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute onion and chopped celery in butter. Add cream of potato soup with evaporated milk water parsley chives and white fish. Simmer 1/2 hour.

title: Oyster Casserole
instructions: Crush saltines to coarse meal. Spread a 1/2-inch layer of saltines in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Layer oysters and dots of butter with layers of crackers. Add salt and pepper to each layer to your taste. Fill to within 1-inch of top of casserole dish. Add milk to just cover cracker layer on top. Finish with a couple dots of butter. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown and crusty.

title: Easy Pot Pie
instructions: Cut up enough meat to line the bottom of crusts. Pour a thin layer of mashed potatoes a layer of peas another layer of potatoes a layer of carrots and another layer of potatoes. Put a pie crust on top and put butter on top of crust. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 2 pot pies.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese; gradually add pineapple green pepper onion and seasoned salt. Mix well. Roll into ball and roll ball in chopped pecans. Chill. Serve with your favorite crackers. Will keep a week if kept refrigerated.

title: Fresh Fruit Butter
instructions: Cream butter stir in fruit or peel and lemon juice. Refrigerate or freeze. These will keep up to 3 months in the freezer. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix well. Make into balls. Roll in flour and brown in oil. Put in casserole dish. Add can of mushroom soup and can almost full of water. Cook about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale. Wait until time to serve to add ginger ale.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak raisins and dates in wine or brandy for at least 15 minutes. Add milk and bread. Bring to a boil. Add beaten eggs mixed with sugar and vanilla. Let mixture come to boiling point. Pour into 8 x 12-inch pan that has been sprayed with nonstick spray. Put this pan into a larger pan with hot water 1 1/2-inches deep. Pour melted butter over top and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: Combine strawberries and 2 c. sugar and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Add remaining sugar and lemon juice. Boil 12 - 15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir until foam disappears. Let cool put in jars and seal.

title: Squash Bread
instructions: Beat together the first 3 ingredients. Mix in remaining ingredients. Grease and flour two loaf pans. Pour in batter. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for one hour or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pan for 5 minutes and turn out.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Cook noodles 10 hours before baking time. Saute onion celery and mushrooms. Add tomatoes tomato sauce dry spaghetti sauce mix cottage cheese mushroom soup and eggs. Simmer.

title: Greek Chicken Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine chicken cucumbers Feta cheese olives and parsley; set aside. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise yogurt and oregano. Add to chicken mixture. Toss lightly until coated. Cover and chill. Serve on Boston lettuce or whole wheat pita. Makes 8 servings.

title: Angel Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until frothy. Add sugar gradually with vanilla. Beat until mixture forms soft peaks. Add cracker crumbs and pecans together. Fold into egg white mixture. Bake in 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool thoroughly. Top with 1 1/2 boxes Cool Whip mixed according to directions on box. Sprinkle with nuts and coconut if desired.

title: Tex-Mex Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into a loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar milk oleo and cocoa; bring to a boil. Boil 1 1/2 minutes; take off heat and add peanut butter and vanilla then add oats. Mix well; drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper.

title: Chicken Casserole Deluxe
instructions: Wash chicken and place in pan with 2 quarts of boiling water and salt. Simmer covered until tender. Drain; reserve broth. Cool. Remove meat from bones. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange beans over bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange half of chicken over beans. Top with 16 of the saltines then half of the cheese. Combine soup broth onion flakes and remaining cheese and pour over chicken. Crumble remaining saltines. Sprinkle over casserole. Top with mushrooms. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Sugar Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Blend sugar flour butter and salt with a pastry blender until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Add whipping cream and stir \gently\ with a finger in a wavy motion. Do not tear bottom of pie shell. Mix vanilla and milk together and pour over cream mixture. DO NOT STIR. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. This will thicken as it cools.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar salt flour and cocoa. Add milk. Separate eggs. Beat yolks and mix well with other ingredients. Cook on medium heat until it thickens. Remove from heat. Add vanilla flavoring and butter. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue from the egg whites. Bake at 375\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Brown meat; drain and set aside. Blend next 4 ingredients until smooth. Stir in meat cheese onion pepper and salt. Turn into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes until brown on top and knife in center comes out clean. Serves 4.

title: Turkey Barley Soup
instructions: Combine stock onions and barley in Dutch oven. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add potato and carrot and simmer 20 minutes more. Stir in turkey and peas and simmer 5 minutes more. Serves 8. Can be served hot over brown rice as a side dish.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Bring to a boil. Add squash mixture. Boil 2 minutes and can.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Put cooked macaroni in large buttered casserole dish. Add butter milk and most of cheese. Stir until smooth. Add salt and pepper. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grilled Lemon Chicken
instructions: Mix lemon juice and dressing mix. Set aside to thicken. With kitchen mallet pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness. Arrange chicken into single layer in pan and cover with lemon mixture. Marinate for 1 hour in refrigerator turning after 30 minutes. Grill over hot coals 15 to 20 minutes turning only once.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine oil sugar and eggs. Beat well. Sift flour and gradually fold into creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Gently fold in apples and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Or Sausage Quiche
instructions: Brown meat; add salt and pepper to taste. Blend together mayonnaise milk eggs and cornstarch until smooth. Stir in meat cheese and onion. Pour into pie crust. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Rolls
instructions: Roll out rolls; press sausage on top and roll up and slice. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Nutritional Information Serving 1 cookie; calories 70; total fat 2 grams; saturated fat 0 grams; cholesterol 10 milligrams; sodium 60 milligrams.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Soften cream cheese slightly; blend in peanut butter milk and sugar. Fold in softened Cool Whip; scoop mixture into pie shell. Freeze several hours. Thaw slightly before serving.

title: Homemade Pimento Cheese
instructions: Grate cheese. Chop up pimentos small and add in with 1/2 of juice with cheese. Add vinegar salt pepper and mayonnaise. Beat with a mixer until smooth. If not smooth add mayonnaise.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in a skillet until meat is browned stirring to crumble meat. Drain. Add taco seasoning mix and water stirring well. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Combine refried beans and 1/3 cup taco sauce. Spoon half of bean mixture in bottom of pastry shell. Top with half of meat mixture half of cheese and all of corn chips. Repeat layer with remaining bean mixture meat mixture and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broiled Hamburger Spread
instructions: Note May substitute as desired including finely chopped cheese.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: In greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole place the sausage on bottom with the rest of the ingredients on top. Cover with Handi-Wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake for about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill and serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Mini Reubens
instructions: On a cookie sheet place cocktail rye. Spread with Thousand Island dressing. Add the sauerkraut then the meat placing Swiss cheese on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven until cheese is melted.

title: Sugar Free Apple Pie
instructions: Stir all ingredients together; let stand 10 minutes. Place in 9 inch pie crust; cover and make two slits in top crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Lettie'S French Bread
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in large pan. Knead until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes. Let rise for 1 1/2 hours in warm place covered; then punch and work down every 15 minutes six times.\tDivide dough into 3 portions and shape into loaves. Put in greased pans or cookie sheet. Cover and let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage in skillet with pepper and celery until tender. Drain well. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Add all remaining ingredients and pour in a 3-quart casserole dish. Bake for 1 1/2 hours covered.

title: The World'S Easiest Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook the macaroni and cheese according to directions on the package. Add soup milk and tuna and heat through. You can also add a cup of frozen peas that have been slightly cooked in the microwave. This is an easy one for kids to do!

title: Dill Pickle Pick-Ups
instructions: Mix cream cheese onion and mayonnaise. Spread on bread (with crust removed) thickly. Lay bread on damp paper towels. (Drain pickles.) Roll pickle up in bread. Chill overnight. Slice to serve.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well let chill 4 hours. Serve with vegetables crackers or chips.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Chill cucumber until just before serving. Combine yogurt chives onions salt and pepper and chill well to blend flavors. Place cucumber on a serving dish and top with dollops of the chilled dressing. Sprinkle with dill. For variety add to the dressing mushrooms (sliced).

title: Rice Meat Balls
instructions: Combine Minute rice with beef egg onion salt margarine pepper and 1/2 cup tomato juice. Mix lightly. Shape mixture into 18 balls and place in skillet. Add sugar to remaining 2 cups tomato juice. Pour juice over meat balls in skillet. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 15 minutes basting occasionally.

title: Old West Bean Pot
instructions: Combine baked beans kidney beans navy beans green pepper tomatoes and seasoning mix in 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes until hot and bubbling. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: W.W. Tuna And Bean Special
instructions: Drain beans. Put in small baking dish. Mix tuna with beans. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Put in oven for a few minutes to melt cheese and warm beans and tuna through (350\u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes).

title: Glazed Carrots(France)
instructions: Cut carrots into 2-inch pieces. Heat carrots and remaining ingredients except parsley to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until tender about 25 minutes. Remove carrots and boil rapidly to reduce liquid to glaze consistency. Add carrots; turn to coat evenly with glaze. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Yummy Bars
instructions: Combine candy bar peanut butter and marshmallows in saucepan. Heat until melted stirring to mix well. Fold in cereal. Press into greased 9 x 9-inch dish. Let stand until cool. Cut into bars. Yields 30 servings.

title: Frosted Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients and drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Saute diced onion celery and carrot in the butter until tender. Add chicken stock ginger pepper and cauliflower. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until cauliflower is tender. Puree soup in blender.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix all together; pour into 2 (8-inch) or 1 (9 x 13-inch) greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together pretzels margarine and the 3 tablespoons sugar. Press in 13 x 10-inch pan. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Set aside. Mix Jell-O boiling water and berries; stir until dissolved. Cool in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Mix softened cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over pretzel mixture and pour cooled Jell-O over. Refrigerate; let set 4 to 6 hours. You may top it with more Cool Whip if desired. Serves 8 people.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Drain crab meat and remove shells; set aside. In a large bowl mix together all ingredients fold in crab meat. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly and golden. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Savory Spaghetti  Sauce
instructions: In Dutch oven cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender; drain. Add next eight ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf. Yields 4 to 6 servings about 1 quart.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients well. Pour into pie crust. Chill well.

title: Lemon Icebox Pudding
instructions: 1. Beat together and freeze in refrigerator tray for 1 hour or more the 3 egg yolks sugar and juice of 1 1/2 lemons.

title: Gobs
instructions: Cream the sugar Crisco and eggs together. Add buttermilk water and vanilla. Sift together the remaining ingredients and add. Drop from spoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Jello Pudding Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as on box and bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Remove and poke holes quickly down through cake with round handle of wooden spoon.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Mix in a small bowl. In another bowl beat slightly 1 egg white. Add a few at a time 1 cup pecans. Rub the pecans in the egg white with your fingers to coat them thoroughly. Drop into the bowl of sugar and spices and coat each nut completely. Place on a buttered cookie sheet. Bake 30 minutes at 300\u00b0. Check last few minutes to avoid scorching.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: Mix berries and sugar; mix Sure-Jell and water. Bring water and Sure-Jell to boil and cook for 1 minute. Pour cooked mixture over sweetened berries stirring for 3 minutes. Pour into freezer containers and let stand 24 hours then place in freezer.

title: Ladies Delight
instructions: Combine tuna and mayonnaise in bowl and mix well. Place bread on cookie sheet and toast in broiler on one side. Remove from broiler and turn toasted side down. Spread bread with tuna mixture; place tomato slices on \open face\ sandwiches. Top with slices of Cheddar cheese. Return to broiler and watch closely until cheese starts to melt and seems a bit bubbly. Serve.

title: Hollywood Chicken
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet. Add chicken noodle soup and remaining ingredients except potato chips. Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens. Crush the potato chips and spread them in a 9 x 11-inch baking pan. Reserve a few chips for garnish. Pour hot mixture over chips; sprinkle remaining chips over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Broiled Salmon Steaks
instructions: Buy two salmon steaks from the fresh seafood section of the supermarket. Rinse with cold water and pat dry. Preheat broiler (if using Jenn-Air spray grill with Pam). Lightly sprinkle both sides with garlic salt and fresh lime 15 minutes before cooking. Use more lime during cooking to prevent drying. Turn twice at least. Broil for a total of 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Louisburg Chicken Pie
instructions: In large saucepan or Dutch oven combine chicken or turkey with onions celery peppercorns and water. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until poultry is tender. Remove from stock. Strain stock and set aside to cool (about 3 cups). Discard onion celery and peppercorns. Skin and debone poultry cut into bite-sized pieces; set aside.

title: 3-Point Nacho Spread
instructions: Blend beans and 1/4 cup salsa in blender or food processor. Spoon into a 1-quart serving bowl. In small bowl stir together 1/4 cup salsa and sour cream. Drop by spoonfuls over beans. Spread to cover. Spoon remaining salsa over sour cream. Sprinkle with cheese and cilantro. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours. Serve with reduced-fat crackers or baked Tostitos.

title: Agua De Melon
instructions: In the blender put melon sugar and water; blend until it is pureed. Ready to serve.

title: Coconut Pound Cake(The Nashville Cookbook)
instructions: Butter a 10-inch tube pan. Line bottom with waxed paper. In mixing bowl beat butter shortening and 3 cups of the sugar until creamy about 4 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating 2 minutes after each. Sift flour with salt; stir in flour in thirds alternating with milk. Add almond extract and 1/2 teaspoon coconut flavor then fold in coconut. Place in cold oven; set oven to 350\u00b0 and bake until cake tester comes out clean about an hour and 15 minutes. Place cake on wire rack. In small pan bring remaining 1 cup sugar 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon flavor to a boil about 1 minute. Pour syrup over hot cake. Cool 30 to 40 minutes. Remove cake from pan to a rack or plate after sugar syrup has soaked into cake. Eat and enjoy. Makes 1 (10-inch) cake.

title: Ribbon Cake
instructions: Put 1/2 applesauce in 2 separate bowls. Mix red Jell-O in one and green in the other. Layer crackers in a dish (will be 4 crackers). Then spread the red Jell-O on top crackers then green Jell-O until all is used up. Put Cool Whip on top if desired. Cool. Cut into thin slices. Good for the holidays!

title: Tropical Fruit Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Line bottom with toasted pecans. Slice bananas on top of this. Boil together pineapple sugar and cornstarch until thickens. Cool. Pour on top of bananas. Top with Dream Whip.

title: Honolulu Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine preserves barbecue sauce onions and soy sauce. Pour over the chicken breasts. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Add water chestnuts and green pepper for final 10 minutes.

title: Blueberry Boy Bait
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients together until it resembles coarse meal. Remove a cup for topping and set aside. Add baking powder eggs milk salt and vanilla; mix until smooth. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add blueberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: *Low-Cholesterol Pound Cake*
instructions: Cream the margarine shortening and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add egg white; beat well. Add egg substitute; beat well. Add flour alternately with milk beating well after each addition. Add flavorings. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine broth and veggies in big pot. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Blend milk and flour together and stir into veggie mixture cooking until slightly thickened. Add seasonings and cheese. Simmer until cheese melts. Serves 4.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix together in order.

title: Chicken A La King Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Put in greased casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs.

title: Creole Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan; blend in flour and cook over low heat stirring constantly until dark brown. Add liquid okra tomatoes onion pepper Tabasco sauce (optional) thyme and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Then cover and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Add seafood and cook 10 to 15 minutes longer. Remove bay leaf. Serve in soup bowls with mound of hot rice in center. Serves 6.

title: Cherry Pudding
instructions: Mix in order given except the Cool Whip and pour in an ungreased pan. This can\tbe baked in same pan or casserole dish that\tits mixed in.\tBake at 325\u00b0 until juice thickens. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Easy Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or cookie sheet. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes. Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth-covered board. Knead 20 times. Pat dough in bottom and up sides of pan with floured hands. Or roll into 13 x 10-inch rectangle and place on cookie sheet; pinch edges of rectangle forming 3/4-inch rim.

title: Chocolate Pies(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well then add egg yolks margarine 1 teaspoon vanilla and Pet milk. Put milk in quart jar and finish filling jar up with water plus about half more can of water. Mix all together and cook on medium heat stirring all the time until it becomes thick and begins to boil. Pour in two cooked pie shells. Beat egg whites. Add a little vanilla and about 3 or 4 tablespoons sugar. Put on top of chocolate pies and put in oven; cook at about 300\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Crush crackers. Add melted oleo and sugar; press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Save some for garnish. Blend orange juice and milk; stir in Cool Whip and oranges. Fold in; do not beat. Pour over crumb crust. Top with reserved crumbs. Refrigerate or freeze.

title: Apricot Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Make into 1-inch balls. Can be frozen.

title: Rejoice Cake
instructions: Mix flour soda cinnamon and salt. Beat oil sugar and eggs thoroughly. Add flour mixture. Beat until smooth. Add pineapple carrots 1/3 cup coconut and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan. Cool on rack.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Leaves
instructions: Combine meats and saut with onion in butter until lightly browned. Add rice dill thyme salt and pepper and mix well. Place cabbage leaves in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and pat dry. Spoon meat mixture on center of leaves; fold over envelope fashion and secure with toothpicks. Place in greased shallow baking dish; pour tomato sauce over cover and bake in a slow oven (325\u00b0) for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Oriental Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fettucine Primavera
instructions: Cook broccoli carrots zucchini green pepper onion and seasoning in oleo in skillet until vegetables are tender. Stir in mushrooms. Toss vegetables with hot noodles. Stir in Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Form into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in the blender and blend until smooth. Serve over fresh fruit. Yields 2 1/2 cups (10 to 12 servings).

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain in ovenware dish. Put 1/2 of the can of mixed vegetables in bottom of dish. Top with half of ground beef and onion mixture. Add other half mixed vegetables. Add other 1/2 ground beef and onion mixture. Top with mashed potatoes. Heat before serving. Ready to eat with salad and rolls.

title: Szechuan Noodle Toss
instructions: In a 5-quart saucepan over high heat bring 3-quarts water the salt and 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil to a rolling boil. Add pasta stirring to separate strands. Cover pan until water returns to boiling. Uncover and cook pasta 7 to 9 minutes or until pasta is al dente; that is cooked but firm to the bite. Pour hot pasta and water into a colander that has been set in the sink. Drain pasta thoroughly. Rinse with cold running water and drain pasta again. Transfer cooled pasta to a large bowl and set aside.

title: Yogurt Fluff
instructions: Pour boiling water into blender add Jell-O. Blend on low speed until dissolved (about 1 minute). Combine cold water and ice to make 1 cup cold water. Add to Jell-O and stir until almost melted. Then blend in yogurt and vanilla. Chill in dessert glasses or bowl until set (about 1 hour). Makes 5 servings; 35 calories per serving.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Combine butter evaporated milk egg yolks and brown sugar. Cook in double boiler over boiling water stirring constantly until thick. Add vanilla and nuts. Remove from heat; add chocolate pieces until melted. Set aside. Beat egg whites and salt until stiff. Fold into cooled chocolate mixture and pour into pie shell. Freeze until firm.

title: Frozen Cherry Cream Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Fold in pie filling and cool whip until blended. Spoon into crust cover and freeze. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix eggs sugar oil and vanilla then add all other ingredients leaving the raisins and nuts until last. Pour into two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans and bake in preheated oven for 50 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Blend milks and pudding. Add Cool Whip and sour cream. Layer wafers bananas chocolate syrup and pineapple. Chill.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off. Cut shortening into flour with fork until consistency of coarse meal. Add milk all at once; stir with fork just until a soft dough forms. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface; sprinkle dough lightly with flour. Knead gently 10 times or until no longer sticky. Roll out dough to 1/2 inch thickness; cut with 2-inch floured biscuit cutter. Place biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8-12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 biscuits.

title: Shanghi Casserole
instructions: Brown meat onions and garlic in oil. Add celery and soup. Cook mixed vegetables in 1/2 cup water 5 minutes. Add vegetables and liquid to meat mixture. Stir in rice and seasonings. Turn into a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Remove cover. Top with noodles. Return to the oven for 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Freezes very well.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Reserve one cup dry mix for filling. Mix 1 egg oil and cake mix. Mixture will be crumbly. Press into bottom and sides of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. I find Pyrex best. Set aside.

title: Party Chicken With Shrimp
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp and bone chicken; set aside. In large skillet cook onion in butter until tender. Remove onion to bowl with slotted spoon. In drippings cook chicken until browned on both sides. Into chicken skillet measure 3 tablespoons parsley. Add onion tomato sauce water wine salt pepper and basil. Bring quickly to a boil. Add shrimp; reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until chicken and shrimp are tender. Serve with rice. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Add Velveeta cheese and 1/2 stick butter or margarine. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Prepare Crumb Mixture.

title: Miracle Whip Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add water and vanilla. Blend well. Blend in Miracle Whip. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Simmer pineapple and sugar in small saucepan until sugar is dissolved. Poke holes in cake with long tined fork. Cover with warm pineapple mixture. Chill until completely cooled at least 1 hour. Prepare pudding as directed on package. Stir in coconut. Spread over pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans. Refrigerate until served. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add other ingredients (except pie shells). Pour into pie shells. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Beef Ball
instructions: Mix beef and onions together in food processor. Add cream cheese and mix. Take out and form ball. Wrap a slice of pressed beef around ball.

title: Calico Bean Bake
instructions: Brown ground chuck bacon and onions. Drain only the butter beans; mix all together in large dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. You can use a crock-pot and cook for a couple of hours on medium. Keeps very well and tastes better the second day.

title: No Crust Apple Pie
instructions: Fill pie plate 2/3 full with sliced apples. Sprinkle with first 3 spices. In a bowl mix remainder of ingredients and pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef And Corn Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef then add the celery and chopped onions. Cook until soft. Reduce heat and stir in 1 can of tomato soup cream-style corn drained kidney beans and seasonings. Place in large casserole and bake uncovered 20 minutes. Top with 2 to 3 cups of crushed corn chips. Return to oven and bake 10 to 15 minutes until toasted.

title: Gobs
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed on box. Spoon onto cookie sheet by tablespoon. Bake as directed.

title: Baked Spareribs Aloha
instructions: Cut after every third rib about halfway through the strip. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in shallow roasting pan. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1 hour. Carefully drain off all excess fat. While ribs are roasting mix remaining ingredients and let stand to blend flavors. Pour over ribs after 1 hour baking. Bake 45 to 50 minutes longer basting frequently to coat ribs with the flavorful sauce.

title: Spiced Beets
instructions: Add all ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil about 10 minutes.

title: Jane'S Several Layer Dip(Low-Fat)
instructions: Layer ingredients as listed in the recipe. Use with baked tostadas. Serves 2. Has 250 calories and 5 fat grams.

title: Ding Dong Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Cook in a Bundt pan. When cool slice in the middle to make 2 layers. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip and spread on top of the bottom layer. Place the other layer back on. Place the can of icing in the microwave for about 20 seconds; drizzle over the cake.

title: Refrigerator Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Cream butter and sugar at medium speed until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; beat for 5 minutes. Sift milk powder baking powder and salt together. Add to mixture and beat 5 minutes. Add flour alternately with water beating until smooth. Fold in blueberries by hand. Grease muffin tins lightly and flour. Fill about 2/3 full and bake at 350\u00b0 until done about 20 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingersnaps
instructions: Sift flour cinnamon and salt; set aside. Cream shortening and sugar until light. Add eggs and molasses. Dissolve soda in hot water and add to creamed mixture. Stir in dry ingredients and chill for easier handling. Roll into balls (tablespoon). Place on a greased sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole(Yields 6 Servings)
instructions: Combine beef and onion in skillet; cook until beef is lightly browned. Drain; add salt and pepper. Stir in catsup and tomato sauce; heat thoroughly. Turn into 8-inch square pan or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cheese over beef mixture. Top with biscuits. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook rice and broccoli separately. Chop broccoli and stir into rice. Heat soup butter and cheese until melted. Place rice and broccoli in pan. Pour cheese over broccoli and rice. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Pour onion rings over and serve.

title: Allen'S Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix in flour 1 cup sugar and milk; pour over oleo. Put fruit over batter; sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over fruit. Add 1/2 cup water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Million Calorie Bars
instructions: Melt caramels with milk in microwave. Mix flour oats sugar soda salt and butter. Press 3/4 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake\tat 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and top with chocolate chips and nuts. Drizzle caramel over top. Crumble remaining crumb mixture and bake 12 more minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sheath Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix the flour and sugar in a large bowl. Bring to a boil the cocoa water and Crisco. Add to flour and sugar mixture. Add the buttermilk eggs soda and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 11 x 16-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Just as cake comes from oven pour filling over it while still in pan.

title: Margarita Pie
instructions: Mix condensed milk lime juice tequila and Triple Sec together. Fold in whipped cream. Fill pie shell. Refrigerate overnight (the longer you refrigerate the better it is). Top with more whipped cream and lime slices. Serves 8 comfortably. Great as a leftover.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and eggs one at a time. Beat to mix well. Add salt vanilla and syrup. Mix well. Put pecans in crust and pour mixture in crust. Bake until done about 1 1/4 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Roasted Rosemary Chicken
instructions: Rinse the chicken pieces removing any excess fat and the wing tips. Pat dry. Place the olive oil in a Dutch oven over low heat and saute the onion stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook stirring 5 minutes longer. Add the minced rosemary leaves. Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Quick 'N Easy Cheese 'N Onion Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease and flour two loaf pans. Grate Cheddar cheese.

title: Scott'S I Don'T Feel Like Cooking But The Kids Are Hungry
instructions: 1. Brown turkey or beef. Spice to taste (garlic pepper basil whatever). Add diced sausage. Add diced vegetables and corn. Simmer for 10-15 minutes (next commercial). 2. Add can of soup thin to taste. Boil noodles and drain. Add to simmered ingredients (or visa versa depending on pot size). Mix well.

title: Kiwi-Berry Pizza
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour into a greased and floured 12-inch pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool in pan 10 minutes; remove to wire rack and cool completely. Combine preserves and water in a small saucepan; heat until preserves melt. Cool. Set aside. Prepare whipped topping mix according to package directions. Spread over cake. Top with preserves. Arrange fruit over preserves. Yield one 12-inch pie.

title: Quick Lunch Box Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 13 x 8-inch cake pan. Combine all ingredients except\tchocolate and nuts in a large mixer bowl. Blend well\tat low speed; pour batter into pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Real good.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in water with onion salt and pepper for 45 minutes. Cool and bone. Break chicken in large chunks and put in buttered casserole mixed well with soup and sour cream

title: Tamale Pie (Scratch)
instructions: Use cookie cutter to cut the cornmeal mixture into fun shapes also fried onions in butter. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole combine water cornmeal butter salt cumin and pepper. Cook uncovered 100% power (High) for 4 to 6 minutes or until very thick stirring every minute. Spread mixture on wax paper into an 8-inch square about 1/4 inch thick. Chill. Cut into 18 small shapes. Place shapes on a baking sheet in a single layer. Cover chill or freeze until firm. Store frozen shapes in a sealed freezer bag.

title: Nutmeg (Donut) Muffins
instructions: Beat egg with fork. Add oil and milk. Sift together flour baking powder salt sugar and nutmeg. Add to egg oil and milk. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full. Put bit of butter on top. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 9 large muffins.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth and fluffy. Add beaten egg yolks and applesauce. Sift the coarse husks out of flour 2 or 3 times then sift the flour with soda and spices. Mix raisins through it. Add the dry ingredients to the first mixture. Last of all fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. Turn into two 8-inch square cake pans (greased and floured). Bake for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Frost with mocha frosting.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Trim eggplant then cut into 1-inch cubes (no need to pare). Saute onions garlic and zucchini in olive oil in large frying pan for 5 minutes; stir in eggplant. Cover. Simmer 15 minutes. Stir in tomatoes olives parsley chili sauce basil and salt; cover. Simmer 15 minutes; uncover. Cook 10 minutes longer or until almost all liquid has evaporated.

title: Graham And Peanut Butter Bon Bon
instructions: Set almond bark aside; mix remaining ingredients together in a bowl. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Melt almond bark. Form crumb mixture into balls and dip in melted almond bark place on wax paper. Allow the almond bark to cool and set up. Preparation time 25 minutes. Makes 44 to 48 Bon Bons.

title: Cherry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix pie filling sugar and water in saucepan; bring to boil. Add jello; mix well. Remove from heat. Add Coke; mix well. Add pineapple; mix well. Pour into container. Chill until set.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
instructions: Mix together and place in pie shell the sugar cinnamon salt and apple slices. Blend brown sugar flour and butter in small bowl. Mix until crumbly; sprinkle over apple mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients well; add last 3. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 until firm about 40 to 50 minutes.

title: 7-Layer Salad
instructions: Break lettuce in large salad bowl. Lay ingredients as listed. Cover with Saran Wrap to seal. Refrigerate and serve after 8 hours.

title: Ham And Lima Bean Soup
instructions: Combine and cook on top of stove for 15 to 20 minutes. Quick and easy.

title: Arkansas Dirt
instructions: Cream together in a big bowl cream cheese and oleo then add powdered sugar and carton of Cool Whip. Next mix pudding mix with milk then add to other mixture. Layer in a pot with crushed Oreo cookies.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Note Canned beets may be drained and marinated in the mixture.

title: Uncooked Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix margarine and peanut butter well. Add confectioners sugar and mix well. Add almond flavoring. Pour into a 6 x 8-inch pan and smooth with hand. Let sit until firm.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Chop onion. Add onion and rice to butter and brown. Pour in Pyrex dish. Add beef consomme. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: One Dish Dinner
instructions: Place bacon in bottom of pan. Add hamburger crumbled up. Add vegetables salt and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes. Add 1 cup water and finish cooking with cover on until vegetables are done.

title: Lumberjacks
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add molasses and eggs. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients and stir in. Drop on greased sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Yields 4 dozen cookies.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Cranberry Glaze For Pork
instructions: Combine cornstarch cinnamon and salt in small saucepan. Stir in orange juice and cranberries. Heat over medium heat stirring occasionally until thick. I use this glaze to baste my pork roast. The kids love the sweet but tangy taste.

title: Old Fashion Spice Cookies(Grandma Chamberlins)
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and molasses. Add egg allspice cloves ginger and coffee. Mix. Add enough flour to make stiff dough. Chill. Roll out 1/4-inch thick. Cut with cookie cutters. May decorate with sugar toppings. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Lo-Fat Broccoli Skillet Quiche
instructions: In Teflon-lined 9-inch skillet melt margarine over medium heat. Add onion and cook until tender. Add broccoli tomato cheese salt and pepper. Pour imitation eggs over vegetable-cheese mixture; do not stir. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until quiche is set. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Cut in wedges to serve. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Blend together until they are crumbs.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello thoroughly in hot water; add sugar pineapple juice and strawberries. Freeze in 1 gallon size Ziploc bag. Remove from freezer; place in refrigerator a few hours prior to serving time. While slushy add ginger ale; serve. Great for showers!

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll out the same as any pie crust.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid sugar and water. Then add pineapple juice. Chill. Pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale. Serve at once. Yields 50 servings.

title: Self-Iced Cake
instructions: Combine dates water and soda; let stand until cool. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Slowly add flour salt and cream of tartar. Stir until well blended. Add date mixture; mix well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Shrimp De Tonghe
instructions: Cream together butter salt and garlic. Mix in bread crumbs parsley sherry pepper and paprika. Peel and devein shrimp. Toss into simmering water and cook just a few minutes only until they turn pink. Rinse with cool water and drain.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Toss together with oil and water until dough forms a ball. Chill 10 to 15 minutes then roll out on lightly floured surface. Place in a 9-inch pie pan. Prick sides and bottom and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Slice eggs in half; remove yolks and place in medium size bowl. Mash with a fork. Mix in remaining ingredients. Add mayonnaise 1 tablespoon at a time until mixture is creamy. Refill whites with mixture. Sprinkle with paprika for color.

title: Vanilla Glazed Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat sugar and eggs until fluffy; add pumpkin and mix well. In another bowl combine flour salt cinnamon baking powder baking soda and nutmeg. Stir dry ingredients into sugar mixture alternating with oil and water. Add vanilla and mix well. Beat for 3 minutes; fold in nuts. Divide and pour into greased 5 inch x 3 inch loaf pans (makes 3 to 4). Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour; brush hot glaze over tops of warm loaves.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine beef crumbs onion egg salt pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Form into a loaf and put into shallow pan 7 x 10-inches. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes basting occasionally. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Macaroni Fiesta Salad
instructions: Combine macaroni cheese celery salad dressing pimiento green pepper and onion; toss lightly. Season to taste. Serve in lettuce lined bowls. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Party Franks
instructions: In saucepan saute onion in oil until tender. Stir in the next 11 ingredients. Add lemon slices. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes or until slightly thickened stirring occasionally.

title: Navajo Fry Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and add water(enough a little at a time till you have a stiff dough) mix well. Knead dough on a floured board till it becomes elastic. Let dough rise 10 minutes covered. Roll out dough till it is 1/2 inches thick. Cut into squares or circles. Deep fry at 370\u00b0 till golden brown. Drain on paper towels and drizzle with honey.

title: Grasshopper Pie
instructions: Combine milk and marshmallows in top of double boiler. Heat and stir over hot not boiling water until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat. Cool stirring every 5 minutes.

title: Doubly Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat butter sugar eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Stir together flour cocoa baking soda and salt. Add to butter mixture. Stir in chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or just until set. Cool slightly. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack. Cool completely. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Egg Foo Young
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Drop by 1/2 cup into heated oil in skillet. Do not crowd omelets. Turn once when lightly browned. Transfer drained patties to warm platter. Serve omelets over rice topped with gravy made from last 6 ingredients (cook until thickens) or leftover roast gravy or canned gravy to which soy sauce and Chinese brown sauce has been added. Chinese noodles green onions celery etc. make nice additions to meal.

title: Potato And Cabbage Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large stock pot and saute onion garlic and caraway seeds until onion is tender. Add broth cabbage potatoes salt and pepper bring to boil and then simmer for 1 hour. This soup may be pureed with a hand-held blender if you prefer.

title: Aunt Maud'S Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Soak poppy seed in 3/4 cup milk overnight. Sift dry ingredients. Add shortening and 2/3 of milk; beat well. Add poppy seed last. Pour into medium sized tube pan and bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Ice with fudge frosting. Serves 12.

title: Calico Rice Bake
instructions: Tear off a 36 x 18-inch piece of heavy-duty foil. Fold in half to make an 18-inch square. Fold up sides using your fist to form a pouch. In a bowl thoroughly combine vegetables rice water cheese salt onion salt rosemary and pepper. Place mixture in pouch. Dot with butter. Fold edges of foil to seal pouch securely. Grill over medium-hot coals about 30 minutes or until done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown the hamburger drain and add taco mix. Layer the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Right before serving add cheese broken taco chips and French dressing. Mix all together. Makes a large Tupperware bowl.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Sift corn meal into boiling milk. Stir constantly over low heat until milk and meal are just blended and thickened. Beat in mayonnaise and salt. Cool; dont chill. Add beaten egg yolks and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Grease medium casserole in the bottom and part way up the sides. Pour in mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sweet Potato Custard
instructions: Mix the flour and sugar well. Add all other ingredients. Beat with electric mixer until creamy. Pour into pie shell. Bake in preheated oven 10 minutes at 450\u00b0 then 30 minutes or until brown at 350\u00b0. Very important to bake correctly.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Fold sugar pumpkin and lemon juice into egg mixture. Mix remaining ingredients together then fold into egg mixture. Line a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan (no larger) with wax paper or aluminum foil. Pour pumpkin mixture in. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Flip out onto towel with powdered sugar sprinkled. Peel off wax paper or aluminum foil and roll widthwise. Cool then unroll and add cream cheese mixture or ice cream. Re-roll and freeze.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a large bowl with an electric mixer combine cream cheese peanut butter sugar and milk. Beat until smooth. Gently fold in whipped topping. Freeze 4 to 6 hours. Thaw 10 minutes before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake Or Cupcakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients into large bowl. Blend then beat 3 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Weight Watchers Muffins
instructions: Stir dry ingredients together. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir well. Add fruit. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes in greased (spray with Pam) tins or line with cupcake liners.

title: Marie'S Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except cheese). Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 covered. Top with cheese re-cover and bake 1/2 hour longer.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and oil. Beat until blended. Mix all dry ingredients together and add to egg mixture. Mix well and then add apples vanilla and walnuts. Stir until completely blended. Pour into Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Valerie'S Chicken Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients; heat slowly until margarine is melted (do not boil). Mop sauce onto chicken during last 15 minutes of cooking time.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix according to directions. Let cool. Combine pudding and cream cheese (pudding according to directions). Put on top of cool cake. Combine Cool Whip and pineapple put on top of pudding. Cover with coconut.

title: Tijuana Pie
instructions: Brown ground meat and season to taste. Mix together soups beans tomatoes and tomato sauce. Heat to mix well. Grease casserole dish and using a third of each ingredient layer chips meat soup mixture and cheese. Continue to layer until all ingredients are used. Be sure cheese is on top. Heat until cheese is melted. Serves 8.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Drain fruits reserving 1 cup juice. Bring juice to boil and mix with gelatin until dissolved. Cool. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and congeal. Serves 8.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare jello chill. Add prunes and pineapple.

title: Potluck Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Brown ground beef; drain. Mix all ingredients except cheese. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Take thawed orange juice and pineapple juice. Add enough water to equal 4 cups liquid. Heat liquid and dissolve jello. Let cook. Add oranges pineapple and pecans. Let set.

title: Cranapple Delight
instructions: Mix and bring to a boil.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple to make 1 cup liquid. (If not a cup finish with water.) Boil and pour liquid over Jell-O; stir until dissolved. Add bottle of 7-Up. After it quits foaming add oranges pineapple and 1 cup nuts (optional). Chill. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chewy Walnut Squares
instructions: Mix in order and spread in pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes in a greased 8-inch square pan. Cookies will be soft in center. Leave in pan. Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: First cook broccoli and chicken (separate) then pour off liquid. In a saucepan combine soup cream and cheese until melted and hot. Layer broccoli chicken and sauce in a baking dish then repeat this process. Top with fried onion rings. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Melt butter in 2-quart saucepan. Sprinkle in flour; gradually add milk and bring to boiling point. Add corn salt pepper and sugar. Heat thoroughly; remove from heat and add beaten eggs. Pour into 2 1/2-quart buttered baking dish. Bake at 375 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender. Drain. Add butter (melted). Mix all ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 in 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch pan 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sausage Snacks
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds. Place sausages on shortest side of each triangle. Roll up starting at shortest side and rolling to opposite point. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with ketchup or mustard.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients and bake on hot grill or frying pan. Makes 6 medium. I triple it for us! Nice and light!

title: Golden Pineapple Layer Cake
instructions: Combine undrained pineapple whipped topping and pudding mix. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut cake lengthwise in thirds. Drizzle with liqueur. Spread one-third pudding mixture over bottom layer of cake. Top with second layer. Repeat. End with topping. Chill 30 minutes. Sprinkle with toasted sliced almonds. Garnish with pineapple slices and/or raspberries or strawberries.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and some of milk. Pour into freezer. Finish milk up to line. If adding fruit use about 2 cups. If using fresh peaches can change vanilla to almond.

title: Ground Beef Shepherds Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat; add onion and saute for 5 minutes. Add ground beef and basil and saute 5 more minutes. Add garlic green beans and tomatoes; stir well. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour mixture into a 2-quart casserole dish. In separate bowl combine potatoes with egg and water. Mix well and spread over meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes start to brown on top. Sprinkle with cheese 5 minutes before done.

title: Molasses Crinkles
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly then add remaining ingredients. Chill dough. Roll into small balls and dip in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Oyster Dressing
instructions: Drain oysters saving likker and chop. Cook celery and onions in margarine until tender. Combine oysters cooked vegetables bread cubes and seasonings; mix thoroughly. If dressing seems dry moisten with oyster likker. Bake in casserole at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Recipe will make dressing for a 4-pound turkey. For 10 to 15-pound bird make 3 times recipe; 16 to 20 pounds 4 times and 21 to 25-pound bird 5 times.

title: Macaroni And Cheese(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a quart pan combine water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and bring to a boil. Add macaroni slowly so that water continues to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 8 to 9 minutes. Drain macaroni in colander. Place macaroni in a 1-quart casserole dish. Stir in butter egg salt dry mustard and 2 1/2 cups of the grated cheese. Stir until evenly mixed. Pour milk over macaroni mixture. Top casserole with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Cover with foil. Cook for 20 minutes. Uncover casserole and cook another 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Marinated Green Beans
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar oil and water in a medium saucepan. Boil for 2 minutes. Combine beans and onion rings; add hot marinade. Set aside to cool. Refrigerate and marinate at least overnight. Yield 6 to 8 servings. Excellent for low-fat diets.

title: Sausage Potato Soup
instructions: Brown crumbled sausage and drain well. Combine potatoes onions water salt and celery seed in large pot. Cover. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Mash potatoes slightly leaving small lumps. Add drained sausage and milk. Heat well. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Herbed Stuffed Eggplant(Low Calorie, Low Cholesterol And Low-Fat)
instructions: Wash eggplant under cold water; dry with paper toweling. Cut each eggplant in half lengthwise. Add 1 inch of water to a large skillet; bring to boiling over high heat. Add 2 eggplant halves skin side down. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer 5 minutes or until flesh is soft. Remove to wooden cutting board. Repeat with remaining eggplant. When eggplant are cool enough to handle scoop out flesh with a large spoon leaving 1/4 inch thick shell. Be careful not to break through the skins. Place shells in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Coarsely chop eggplant flesh; set aside.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix rice chicken beans cheese and mayonnaise. Melt butter and mix with crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle buttered cracker crumbs over rice and chicken mixture. Bake in a shallow baking dish at 350\u00b0 until hot approximately 30 minutes.

title: French Fries
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes lengthwise into stick 1/4-inch thick. Place in a bowl cover with water and refrigerate 16 hours. Drain potato sticks and lay out on dish towels to dry. Be sure they are completely dry before frying. In a deep-fryer with a candy thermometer clipped to the side heat 2-inches of peanut oil to 300\u00b0. Add just enough potatoes to cover the base of the frying basket and cook until slightly limp 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Do not brown. Lift basket and drain fries. Transfer potatoes to a baking rack and separate sticks. Repeat with remaining potatoes. Increase heat to 375\u00b0. Again add potatoes in batches to the oil. Fry until chestnut brown on edges and crisp. Drain and transfer to a bowl lined with paper towels. Immediately season with salt tossing to coat. Serve. Yields 4 servings.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together. Sprinkle with grated egg yolk. Serve with fresh vegetables as a dip.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain salmon; remove skin and bones. Combine salmon with all other ingredients. Blend together well. Shape into a loaf and place into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Quick Lemon Cake
instructions: Blend dry mix with water oil and eggs in a large bowl at low speed until moist. Add jello and beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 38 to 43 minutes.

title: Turtle Candy
instructions: Melt caramels and milk together. Add nuts and drop on waxed paper. Refrigerate until firm. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip turtles and return to wax paper. Makes 50.

title: Old-Fashioned Butter Crunch
instructions: Toast almonds at 350\u00b0 until golden 5 to 10 minutes. Cool. Reserve 1 cup and blend to almost dust (1/2 to 1 cup). Melt butter in a large heavy saucepan on medium heat (3-quart pan). Cook the sugar corn syrup and water to hard crack stage (300\u00b0). Stir often. When done mixture will pull from side of pan. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup slivered almonds. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch buttered Teflon type pan. When almost cool run scraper around sides of pan; use heat resistant scraper. Cool completely and turn out on waxed paper.

title: Punch
instructions: Squeeze lemons. Combine juices water and sugar. Mix well. Use food coloring for desired color. Makes 2 gallons. Very good.

title: Catfish Court Bouillon
instructions: Cut onion and bell pepper into strips. Mix with tomato sauce and cook for 20 minutes. Pepper and salt to taste. Add Ro-Tel. Cut catfish into chunks. Add to mixture. Add juice of lemon. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and oleo. Cool. Beat eggs sugar flour and baking powder into chocolate mixture. Add nuts and almond extract.

title: Dill Pickles With Garlic
instructions: Soak cucumbers overnight in cold water. Put one dill in bottom of quart jars then pack jars with cucumbers. Add garlic and second sprig of dill on top. Combine vinegar salt and water. Bring to boil. Fill jars and seal. Store in dark cool place.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Cook in oven until it bubbles. Put buttered bread crumbs on top and bake until brown.

title: Mama Weber'S Lasagne Twisties
instructions: Cook meat and onion; drain. Add seasonings and tomato sauce and simmer 30 minutes. Add buttered noodles and spinach. Put half of mixture in pan then add half of Parmesan cheese. Repeat. Top with sour cream Jack cheese and green onions. Cook 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water. Stir over low heat until dissolved. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Add tea and cool. Add juices and canned pineapple. Refrigerate. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Cook bacon ground beef and onion. Add all other ingredients and mix together. Place in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: For a less cheesier recipe use Velveeta Lite cheese or use less Velveeta cheese.

title: Brunch Egg Bake
instructions: Place cubed bread into greased 9X13 pan. Top with Cheddar. Beat eggs milk mustard and onion powder; slowly pour over bread and cheese. Bake at 325 degrees for 30-35 minutes. Cover with bacon and bake another 10 minutes or until knife in center comes out clean.

title: Napple-O-Tata
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel sweet potatoes. Slice into rounds 1 to 1 1/2-inches thick. Melt 2 of the tablespoons of margarine over low heat. In small bowl mix cinnamon nutmeg and ginger.

title: Mrs. Rose'S Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: Cook all but vinegar until thickens then add vinegar slowly. Let cool and then add 1 pint of Miracle Whip. Makes a generous portion; keeps well.

title: Garden Vegetable Pie
instructions: Grease quiche pan or 10-inch pie plate. Add broccoli onion pepper and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients and stir until smooth; pour over all. Bake until golden brown 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes a delicious lunch with a salad or as hors doeuvres.

title: Cheese Rice Krispies
instructions: Mix cheese and margarine. Add flour mixed with pepper. Add Rice Krispies. Shape into balls (small). Place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes; do not brown. They taste like they have nuts in them.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Pour into greased cast-iron skillet cornstick pan or muffin pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Potato Soup
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in soups and milk; heat thoroughly. Garnish if desired with shredded Cheddar cheese diced cooked ham or bacon.

title: Pineapple Sherbet
instructions: Slice pineapple in half lengthwise. Remove pulp and place in saucepan with the remaining ingredients. Cook 5 minutes.

title: Nana'S Vegetable Soup(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Brown ground beef; pour off fat. Put in crock-pot along with other ingredients. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Cook meat and drain. Add cheese; stir well until melted. Add spices; spread on bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Fiesta Taco Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook radiatore according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile in 10-inch skillet cook ground beef and onion stirring occasionally until browned 5 to 7 minutes; drain off fat. Stir in corn taco sauce tomato sauce chilies cumin and salt. Stir in radiatore. Spoon into greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cheeses over mixture in alternating rows to form 3 Cheddar and 2 Mozzarella strips. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Garnish with tomato wedges and avocado slices. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually add sugar in small amounts. Beat until thick. Fold in pumpkin and dry ingredients. Mix well. Grease a 15 x 10-inch pan and line with waxed paper. Pour batter into pan. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Turn out on a clean towel which is sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll as a jelly roll and let cool. Unroll and spread with filling. Then re-roll chill and keep refrigerated.

title: Miracle Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Form into balls and press down with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Combine 2 cups brown sugar 1/2 cup syrup and 2 sticks margarine. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Add salt soda and vanilla. Pour over popcorn. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. Combine flour salt and pepper. Lay meat on board; sprinkle with half of flour mixture. Pound into meat on both sides of meat until all flour is used. Meat may be cut in strips or left whole and cut later.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add all other ingredients but sour cream. Pour half of mixture into dish. Chill until almost set. Spread sour cream on top. Pour remaining gelatin mixture over sour cream. Chill until firm.

title: Peixie A Lumbo (Shrimp And Fish Stew)
instructions: Sprinkle fish with salt. Heat oil in large skillet. Saute onion and green pepper over medium heat until tender. Add tomatoes and cook until most liquid is gone. Stir often. Remove from heat and add coriander and red pepper. Arrange layer of half the fish layer of shrimp layer of vegetable mixture. Repeat layers in Dutch oven. Pour coconut milk over mixture and simmer for 5 minutes over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and partly cover. Simmer for 15 minutes or until seafood is done. Serve over rice.

title: Perfection Pie(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Melt chips in boiling water; set aside to cool. Beat eggs. Blend in cornstarch and sugar replacement. Continue beating and add the shortening and gradually the chocolate mixture. Pour into the pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until custard is set.

title: Molded Raspberry Jello
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in hot water. Add frozen raspberries and the juice. Pour into 8-inch cake pan. Chill until firm. Whip together the whipping cream marshmallows and cream cheese until stiff. Spread over gelatin. Chill and serve. Serves 8.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread and refrigerate overnight for soup mix to absorb completely. Cut top of Hawaiian bread and hollow out; fill with dip. Tear bread left into pieces for dipping.

title: Creamy Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add cheese and cook over low heat until melted. Add other ingredients and serve over corn chips or Doritos.

title: Todd'S Taters
instructions: Wash potatoes and slice; boil until tender. Spread in glass 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Put in margarine. Coat well with lemon-pepper seasoning. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend all ingredients except nuts together. Refrigerate until workable. Shape into ball roll in nuts.

title: Hot Pineapple Bake
instructions: Break bread in a bowl (tear in small pieces). Add beaten eggs and sugar. Add pineapple. Cut butter into chunks or slices and mix in. Butter casserole (2-quart size) and spoon mixture into casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until bubbly. (Excellent side dish with baked ham.)

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Add salt and soda. Fold into creamed mixture along with oats and nuts. Roll in small balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Refrigerator Cole Slaw
instructions: Let mixture cool and pour over vegetables. Refrigerate 12 hours before serving. Will keep for weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Almost Heaven Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. Punch holes in cake while hot. Spread pineapple over cake. Cool. Mix pudding in milk; spread over pineapple. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip together. Spread on top of cake. Let chill in refrigerator before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake for approximately 35 to 40 minutes in another large cake pan with 1-inch of water in the bottom. Works like a double boiler only in the oven.

title: Hannah'S Seafoam Candy
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside. Boil water and brown sugar until it forms a soft ball; do not stir! Pour a small stream of mixture to the egg whites slowly. Cool and then drop onto wax paper.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: Mix pudding as directed on box. Cream powdered sugar and cream cheese together. Add pudding to cream cheese. Gently fold in Cool Whip. Crumble Oreo cookies into mixture and gently stir. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Mix yellow cake mix according to directions and bake. When cake is done punch holes in cake with end of wooden spoon. Spoon cream of coconut on cake and let cool. (You can use can of Eagle Brand milk to make cake richer along with cream of coconut.) Mix Cool Whip and coconut together and put on cake (leave some coconut for topping). You may also use crushed pineapple. Keep refrigerated.

title: Cheesy Beans
instructions: Boil beans and drain. Add bacon pieces and onions in a casserole. Add Mozzarella and almond slivers just before removing from oven. Bake 30 minutes (350\u00b0). Also can be heated easily in microwave.

title: English Goulash
instructions: In skillet fry cabbage and onion until browned; add tomatoes. In a skillet brown hamburger sugar and vinegar. Add to first ingredients and simmer 45 minutes. This may be put over mashed potatoes.

title: Cottage Cheese Dill Bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on warm water and stir until blended. Stir in 2 teaspoons sugar and set aside. Combine cottage cheese onion dill weed baking powder salt 2 tablespoons sugar and eggs. Mix thoroughly. Add yeast mixture and mix well. Add flour to make a stiff dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic. Place dough in greased bowl; turn to bring greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size (1 to 1 1/2 hours). Punch down. Turn onto lightly floured surface knead a few times. Divide into two equal portions. Shape each portion into loaf in well-greased loaf pan 8 x 5 x 3-inches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from pans to rack and brush tops with melted butter. Makes two loaves.

title: Chicken Pie With Sweet Potato Crust
instructions: Layer first 4 ingredients into a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole. Combine flour and a small amount of milk in saucepan blending until smooth. Gradually stir in remaining milk and chicken broth. Place over low heat. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add salt and pepper. Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables in the casserole. Cover mixture with sweet potato crust and bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: South Of The Border Chicken And Rice
instructions: Combine soups broth and Ro-Tel in large saucepan. Heat until well-blended. Spread chicken in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Combine mashed potatoes hot milk (mixed with rum) butter nutmeg salt lemon rind and egg yolks. The fold in egg whites. Put in a buttered casserole and bake in a hot 400\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chile Cheese Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese in oblong dish. Spread chili over cream cheese. Layer Cheddar cheese over chili. Heat until cheese is melted (can bake or microwave). Serve with nacho chips.

title: Peanut Butter-Honey Dip
instructions: Combine peanut butter honey and milk in a medium-sized mixing bowl; stir until smooth. Stir in raisins and cinnamon; sprinkle with toasted almonds. Serve with apple and banana slices. Yields 3 cups.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixer. Serve with carrot sticks cucumber sticks celery sticks green pepper sticks or cauliflower. Children love it with potato chips.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Beat sweet potatoes with mixer until free of lumps. Add remainder of ingredients and beat well. Pour into one 9-inch unbaked crust and bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0 plus 10 minutes. Lower baking temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue cooking for 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind cranberries and apples; add drained pineapple. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water then add cold water. Put all ingredients together and mix well. Pour into containers or Jell-O molds. Makes 4 to 5 pints. May be frozen or stored in refrigerator for a couple weeks.

title: Kourabiedes 2
instructions: Melt butter and let stand until cool. Beat at high speed until light and fluffy (1/2 hour).\tAdd 1/4 cup powdered sugar egg yolk and whiskey; beat thoroughly. Add baking powder to flour and\tsift together. Use low speed and add flour to butter mixture. Add a little at a time until you have a soft dough.
