Shape and\tplace on cookie sheet; bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Do not brown. Place on waxed paper and sift powdered sugar over cookies.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually and cream well. Add eggs one at a time. Add mashed bananas nuts and sifted dry ingredients. Pour into greased bread pan. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Elk Or Venison Steak & Gravy
instructions: Slice onions and peppers in rings. Brown lightly in oil. Remove from heat and remove them from oil. Remove all fat from steaks. Pound steaks to tenderize. Mix flour salt and pepper. Cover steaks in flour shake off excess and brown both sides in oil used for peppers and onions. Pour off oil. Place onion and pepper rings on top of steak then spread soup over all. Add water to almost cover meat. Simmer for 2 hours adding water as needed to keep meat nearly submerged. (Can be done in slow cooker.)

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Bring ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Cook rice as directed on box. Cook hamburger. Mix together. Stir in cans of tomatoes. Cook for about 5 minutes. Then put cheese on top and let melt. Let stand 5 minutes. Then eat.

title: Green String Beans
instructions: Crumble bacon and add to remaining ingredients. Simmer all ingredients 1/2 to 1 hour.

title: French Class Spinach Cheese Dip
instructions: Defrost spinach and drain. Soften cream cheese. Stir in spinach Parmesan cheese mayonnaise dill and garlic powder. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Warm to serve.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: In a large skillet cook sausage onion pepper and celery until halfway done. Do not drain. In another skillet add 3 tablespoons of oil and cook rice slowly until browned. Add other cooked ingredients in a large pot and add tomatoes and chicken broth; cook for 30 minutes. Add to mixture to thicken. Season to taste with ground red pepper garlic powder seasoned salt and pepper.

title: Cajun Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a mixing bowl. Mix in the eggs and pineapple. Grease a 9 x 13 cake pan with oil or spray with Pam. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Frozen Lemonade Pie
instructions: Fold sweetened condensed milk and lemonade concentrate into whipped topping. Spoon into crusts. Freeze until firm. Garnish pies if desired. Yield Two 9-inch pies. Freeze for 8 hours.

title: French Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in jar. Cap and shake well. Makes 2 servings. Contains 18 calories a serving.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel and parboil 2 to 3 pounds sweet potatoes. Mash and add salt pepper and brown sugar to taste. Put in casserole; add 1 small can crushed pineapple. Cover with marshmallows. Bake in a moderate oven until the marshmallows are toasted.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots until tender but still crisp and drain. Bring sugar vinegar oil tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce mustard pepper and Italian seasoning to a boil. Pour over carrots; add chopped vegetables. Marinate overnight. This keeps a long time.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Cook ground beef. Drain. Fry bacon crisp and crumble. Combine the rest of the ingredients in crock-pot and cook all day.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
instructions: Using electric mixer beat eggs on high for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Sift flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Fold into pumpkin. Spread in well-greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1 1/2 pan (cake roll pan). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Starting at narrow end roll towel and cake together; cool. Unroll and spread with filling.

title: Eggplant
instructions: Cook diced eggplant until mushy in salted water. Mash eggplant and combine with other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Place chicken breasts one at a time between 2 sheets of wax paper and gently pound with mallet until 1/4-inch thick. In a rimmed plate combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon of oregano garlic salt and pepper; set aside. In a small bowl stir together softened butter parsley and remaining oregano. Spread about 1/2 tablespoon of the herb-butter mixture across each breast about an inch from lower edge; lay a strip of Jack cheese over butter mixture. Fold lower edge of breast over filling. Fold insides and roll up to enclose mixture. Dip each bundle into melted butter and drain briefly; roll in bread crumb mixture until evenly coated. Place bundles seam side down in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours. Bake uncovered in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink when lightly slashed. Makes 4 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Feathers Voo-Doo Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except noodles. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle chow mein Chinese noodles over top and cook for about 5 minutes more.

title: Yankee Doodle Macaroni
instructions: Heat shortening in pan. Add onion garlic and mushrooms; saute until onion becomes pale yellow. Add meat; stir until brown. Add tomatoes parsley and seasonings. Cover. Simmer about 45 minutes. While meat is cooking cook macaroni in boiling water 7 to 10 minutes. Drain well. Toss in margarine. Turn macaroni onto hot platter. Pour sauce over; sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast; set aside. Grate cheese into water with sugar and salt. Heat just until warm. Add to flour mixture with egg. Stir well. Add 2 to 2 1/2 cups flour; knead to moderately stiff dough. Shape into ball and let rise until double. Divide in half and let rest 10 minutes. Shape into two loaf pans; let rise until double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cover with foil the last 20 minutes. Cut while warm and spread with garlic seasoned butter and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.

title: Chicken Fried Deer Steak
instructions: Trim deer steak of all fat etc. Soak in combination of milk and Worcestershire sauce for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and make into patties. Fry in margarine.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook egg noodles and drain. Mix mushroom soup with egg noodles and put in a casserole dish. Brown hamburger and drain. Mix together hamburger and Pizza Quick. Place this mixture in casserole dish on top of noodles. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Zucchini And Eggplant
instructions: Combine the vegetables in a pot. In a bowl stir the tomato sauce and broth together until smooth. Stir in oregano or basil then add to mixture in pot and simmer covered for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Strudel
instructions: Mix melted oleo egg yolks and milk very well. Add flour; work in well. Divide dough into 6 parts. Cool dough in refrigerator overnight or at least for an hour. Roll out on a floured cloth. This should be about as thin as you would roll out noodles. Sprinkle well with cracker crumbs sliced apples (very thin) sugar and cinnamon. Dribble melted oleo over all this about 3/4 of a stick. Roll up. Grease well with melted oleo. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour until golden brown. Again grease well with oleo and sprinkle with sugar. Different things one can put with apples include raisins coconut and pecans. Use 1/2 cup sugar.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Spray a tube pan with cooking spray and drop in frozen rolls. Mix pudding mix and brown sugar. Dump over rolls. Mix white sugar and cinnamon; dump over rolls. Add nuts. Pour on butter and let stand uncovered overnight. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Invert onto pie plate.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Place asparagus in casserole. Mix sour cream and dried soup mix together. Spread over asparagus. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes until casserole is thoroughly heated.

title: Old-Style Pineapple Pudding
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar and salt and dilute with cold water pineapple juice and boiling water. Cook in double boiler stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Cool slightly; add lemon juice pineapple and beaten egg whites and pour in molds to chill and set. Serve with custard or whipped cream.

title: Crumb Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat a 13 x 9-inch pan with vegetable cooking spray. Put milk in a shallow dish. Mix remaining ingredients except chicken in a medium size bowl. Dip each piece of chicken in milk then in crumbs pressing so crumbs adhere to form a thick even coating. Arrange meaty sides up in a single layer in prepared pan. Bake 1 hour or until browned and juices run clear. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes sour cream soup onions cheese and 1 stick butter. Pour into a large casserole dish. Mix 1/2 stick butter with crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is brown.

title: Easy Angel Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour and measure 1 cup. Add 1/2 cup sugar and sift 4 times. Separate eggs; measure egg whites. Place in large bowl and add 1/4 teaspoon salt. Beat until foamy. Add cream of tartar and beat until stiff peaks. Gradually add 1 cup sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating after each addition. Fold in vanilla. Fold in flour mixture 1/4 cup at a time. Place in 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chewy Mincemeat Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine muffin mix butter and sugar; blend until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup mixture loosely packed. Press remaining crust mixture into bottom of ungreased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven; cool 5 minutes. Carefully spread with mincemeat; sprinkle remaining crumb mixture over mincemeat. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wire rack. Makes 32 (1 x 2-inch) bars.

title: Chicken With Sage Cornbread Crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle chicken with the salt and pepper and arrange on a rack in a baking pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the juices run clear when the chicken is pierced with fork. Meanwhile in a small bowl combine the mustard and oil. In another small bowl combine the crumbs and sage. Preheat the broiler setting the rack 6 inches from the heat. Brush chicken with half of the mustard mixture and sprinkle with half of the crumbs. Place under broiler for 1 minute or until golden brown. Turn the chicken the chicken coat it with the remaining mustard and crumbs and broil for 1 minute or until golden brown. Serve with corn-on-the-cob and steamed green beans or broiled tomatoes. Serves 4.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Roll sugar cookie dough onto 2 pizza pans. Bake each for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool completely. Mix together cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Spread onto cooled sugar cookie crust. Top with sliced fruit.

title: Okra Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Boil crabs until they turn red (about 20 minutes). Set aside and reserve water. Wash okra and cut into 1/4-inch rounds. Put 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in an iron skillet and fry okra stirring often to prevent burning until it is browned and dried out with all trace of sliminess gone.

title: Curry Rice
instructions: In large pan simmer pork chop cubes in salted water (enough to cover) 45 to 60 minutes. Add more hot water; enough to make as much curry as you want; then put in onions carrots and potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Bring to boil lower heat and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally covered. Add the green pepper and simmer another 15 minutes. Add flour to water to make sauce for thickening. Stir into vegetables. Add curry powder. Serve over regular cooked rice not instant. Leftovers freeze nicely.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake one hour at 325\u00b0 or until done.

title: Kiddy Punch
instructions: Mix orange juice according to directions. Then mix all together. Serve chilled.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Divide dough in half and chill. Roll out 1/2 at a time about 1/4-inch thick. Cut with small round cutter. Place 1/2 teaspoon jam on each cookie. Bake on ungreased sheet in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Beat persimmon pulp soda sugar and margarine until creamy. Beat in egg then add flour cinnamon nutmeg cloves and salt. Fold in walnuts and raisins. Drop by spoonfuls on greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Deluxe Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni per package directions; rinse and set aside. Combine the next 6 ingredients. Add macaroni; stir well. Spoon into lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt the butter in a large pan. Spread brown sugar evenly in skillet and arrange pineapple slices on sugar filling in spaces with nuts. Sift the flour baking powder and salt together. Beat egg yolks until light adding sugar gradually. Add pineapple juice and sifted flour. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour batter over pineapple. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 30 to 35 minutes. Turn upside down on cake plate. Serve with whipped cream if desired.

title: Marinated Slaw
instructions: Bring this mixture just to a boil. Let cool and pour over cabbage mixture. Place in airtight container and let stand for 24 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Cheesy Chicken
instructions: In a bowl combine crumbs and cheese. Add seasonings and mix well to blend. Melt butter. Dip chicken into butter then into crumbs. Arrange chicken in lightly oiled ovenproof baking dish. Bake chicken at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until brown and done. Chicken should be tender.

title: Indiana Picnic Cake
instructions: In a bowl sift first 2 ingredients add butter and nuts and mix all together. Take out 1 cup set aside. Add to bowl the rest of the ingredients. Beat well and put in greased square pan 9 x 9-inch then sprinkle the cup of crumb mixture on top. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Crunch Top Broccoli Bake
instructions: Heat oleo in small saucepan until melted. Stir in flour salt pepper sugar and onion. Add sour cream. Stir until smooth. Cook stirring constantly until mixture comes just to boiling point. Fold in broccoli. Pour into 1 1/2-quart greased baking dish. Toss together Chex cereal and cheese and sprinkle over broccoli mixture. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix until smooth. Place dip in center of serving tray and surround with vegetables of your choice.

title: Saccharine Pickles
instructions: Boil together and cool. Pour over cucumbers packed in jars and seal. Makes about 8 quarts of pickles.

title: Baked Beans And Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion. Mix meat and onion with ketchup. Add other ingredients. Place in casserole dish and bake covered for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Glazed Chef'S Prime
instructions: Combine cornstarch cinnamon and salt in small saucepan. Stir in orange juice and cranberry sauce. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened. Set aside.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients; set aside. Cream butter oil and sugar until light. On medium speed beat eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Beat well after each addition. Stir in zucchini. Pour in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool and ice. Put brown sugar icing on top.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Pinwheels
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl blend first 4 ingredients. Separate crescent dough into 8 rectangles. Firmly press perforations to seal. Spread about 1/4 cup pepperoni mix on each rectangle. Start at shorter side and roll up; seal. Cut into 6 pieces. Place cut side down onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: English Apple Pie
instructions: Arrange apples in a greased oblong baking dish. Sprinkle granulated sugar over apples. Mix brown sugar flour pecans and margarine; pour over apples patting to cover entire surface. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes a sweet gooey apple pie. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mashed Potatoesdallas, Texas
instructions: Boil potatoes until you are able to pierce with fork.

title: Quiche Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Rinse mushrooms pat dry and remove stems. Chop stems (makes about 1 1/2 cups) and set aside. In large skillet saute bacon until crisp; drain on paper towel crumble and set aside. Pour bacon drippings from skillet. In the same skillet melt butter. Use about 4 tablespoons of melted butter to brush the outsides of the mushroom caps and place in large shallow 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. To the butter remaining add onion and saute then add mushroom stems and saute 2 minutes longer. Remove from the heat. In bowl combine eggs cream cheese and salt. Stir in bacon and mushroom mixture. Fill caps. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dee Dee'S Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together and roll into balls. Chill.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Drain fat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage and small carrot. Add celery seed salt and pepper to taste. Combine vinegar and mayonnaise; add to cabbage. Use more or less vinegar depending on how sour you like it.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Combine the yeast flour sugar and potato buds in a bowl. Gradually add the warm water until smooth. Place in a large glass or crock. Keep covered with plastic wrap in a warm place for 2 days then refrigerate.

title: Peach Sunrise Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions baking in two 8 or 9-inch pans. Once layers are cooled slice in half making 4 layers.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine the frozen hash browns cheese and onion in a large bowl.\tCombine the milk beef stock half of the melted butter garlic powder salt and black pepper in another bowl and mix until well blended. Pour over hash browns and mix well. Heat the remaining butter in a large ovenproof skillet over high heat.\tWhen the skillet is hot spoon in the hash brown mixture. Cook the hash browns stirring occasionally until hot and all of the cheese is melted (about 7 minutes).\tPut the skillet into the oven and bake for 45-60 minutes or until the surface for the hash browns are dark brown.

title: Refrigerated Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Heat vinegar sugar and seasonings to boiling.\tArrange sliced cucumbers onions and green pepper in jars. Pour hot liquid over and cool. Store in refrigerator.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue Beef
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock-pot and cook on high until mixture boils. Then turn to low and simmer for 6 to 8 hours. Chop cooked meat and serve on sandwich rolls.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Put bacon in a 2-quart casserole. Cover with paper towel. Microwave 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until crisp. Remove paper towel and bacon; leave drippings in casserole. Crumble bacon and set aside. Add clams liquid potato onions and water. Cover and microwave 8 minutes on High stirring every 3 minutes. Add milk bacon seasonings and butter. Cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes until it comes to a boil. Let stand 2 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs beating into mixture one a a time. Add soda baking powder graham cracker crumbs milk coconut and nuts. Grease and flour 3 (9-inch) cake pans. Pour into 3 layers. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Slices
instructions: Melt butter add condensed milk and cocoa and heat gently until combined. Remove from heat and add chopped fruit coconut and crushed/crumbled cereal. Stir well and press into a Swiss roll tin. When cool ice with lemon icing.

title: Banana Layer Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add mashed bananas and vanilla. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cherry Berry Pie
instructions: Drain cherries and raspberries; reserve 1 1/4 cups juice and set fruit aside. In a saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch; gradually stir in juice. Cook and stir over medium heat until the mixture begins to boil. Cook and stir 2 minutes longer. Remove from the heat; stir in butter extract and food coloring. Gently fold in the fruit. Cool slightly. Pour into pie crust and top with a lattice crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly. Cool and serve plain or with ice cream.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Serve or chill and serve.

title: Beet Jam
instructions: Grind beets in a food chopper. Measure 3 2/3 cups pulp and juice and add lemon juice. Add Sure-Jell and bring to a boil. Add sugar. Stir and bring to a full boil again. Boil for one minute. Put in glasses and cover with paraffin.

title: French Fried Cauliflower
instructions: Roll flowerets in flour dip in egg to which water has been added. Roll in bread crumbs and fry in deep fat. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Confetti Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain well. Cool; rinse with cold water to cool quickly. Combine Italian dressing mayonnaise salt and pepper in a large bowl. Blend well. Add cooled macaroni cauliflower celery green pepper radishes carrots tomatoes and parsley to the mayonnaise mixture. Toss lightly until pasta and vegetables are evenly coated. Chill for 8 to 10 hours to enjoy.

title: Green Chile Soup
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the cilantro in a 2-quart casserole. Cover tightly and cook on High for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through. To serve Spoon the soup into 4 cups and sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Fresh Peach Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust as directed on package. Prepare Dream Whip also as directed. Mix together sugar and cornstarch. Add water. Cook over medium heat until thick and clear. Color with yellow food coloring. Add almond extract. Pour over peaches and stir lightly. Pour into pie crust; top with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat onion and garlic in a large skillet; drain off fat. Add tomatoes taco sauce olives green chiles salt and pepper stirring to blend mixture. Simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all together except chocolate chips. Beat 4 to 5 minutes. Mix (by hand) the chocolate chips into the batter. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool. Ice with chocolate frosting.

title: Art'S Aroma
instructions: In large deep skillet fry Spam until brown. Add vegetables tomato sauce and spices. Simmer until potatoes are tender to fork. Serve with French bread or sourdough bread.

title: Salmon Caesar
instructions: In medium bowl beat together eggs milk and soup. Stir in croutons flaked salmon green pepper and onion. Pour into buttered 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set in center.

title: Cheese And Mayo Potatoes
instructions: Dice cooked potatoes. Add bacon and onion. Stir in mayo. Put in casserole and top with shredded Velveeta. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix mashed sweet potatoes sugar melted margarine and vanilla together. Mix with mixer until fluffy. Pour into casserole dish.

title: Oven Baked Beef Stew
instructions: Clean and cut potatoes. Cut all vegetables up into pieces. Combine ingredients in baking pan. Pour in 2 cans of broth. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Grilled Corn On The Cob
instructions: Butter each ear of corn and sprinkle with curry powder. Wrap each ear of corn in a sheet of aluminum foil. Place on grill for approximately 10 minutes or until cooked.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Heat oil and saut the onion. Add the chicken tomatoes and taco seasoning. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Layer 4 corn tortillas on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Layer 1/3 chicken mixture olives and cheese. Repeat layers 2 times ending with cheese. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Broiled Quail
instructions: Combine any commercial barbecue sauce or your own with oil bay leaf garlic and lemon and pepper seasoning. Pour over cleaned quail and marinate at room temperature for about 1 hour before cooking. Broil over charcoal turning once or twice until done about 20 minutes. Do not overcook as this will dry out the tender white meat of the quail. Serve barbecue sauce separately. The legs make delicious hors doeuvres.

title: Prune Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream sugar with Wesson oil. Add eggs 1 at a time beating after each. Mix flour with spices. Beat in flour and milk alternately. Add nuts prunes and raisins. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Party Wieners
instructions: Saute onions in oil until tender. Stir in catsup water vinegar mustard pepper sugar and wieners. Bring to boil stirring occasionally. Turn down heat simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Salad(Pink Delight Salad)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for several hours.

title: Cabbage And Chicken
instructions: In a paper or plastic bag mix flour seasoned salt and celery seed. Coat chicken legs a few pieces at a time and coat. Heat oil in a large frying pan; add chicken and cook turning until brown about 10 minutes. Transfer to a large baking dish. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In the same pan cook onion until tender. Add tomatoes tomato sauce apples caraway seed salt and sugar. Bring to a boil. Add cabbage and mix well. Spoon mixture over chicken. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour until chicken is tender. Remove foil; sprinkle cheese over chicken. Return to oven for about 5 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Hot Taco Rice
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add salsa tomato sauce and bouillon cube. Bring to a full boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Meanwhile prepare rice as directed on package. Put rice on the bottom of serving dish or casserole dish. Top with meat mixture.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Put raisins in large saucepan. Cover with water plus that amount of water also. Simmer until raisins are plump. While raisins are cooking mix together the sugar egg flour and cornstarch. Pour small amount of hot liquid into the sugar-egg mixture then gently pour all this into raisins. Stir constantly; it will thicken quickly. Remove from heat. Let cool while fitting crust in pie pan.

title: Pumpkin-Raisin Muffins
instructions: Place sugar vegetable oil eggs pumpkin and water in a bowl and mix. Sift flour baking soda and salt in raisins and spices. Add to first mixture and mix. Stir in raisins and walnuts. Place in paper liners in cupcake tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 approximately 15 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Blend shortening with sugar until creamy. Sift dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mix blending well. Add mashed bananas lemon juice and nuts. Bake in 3 well-greased No. 2 cans (average size can in the home). Fill cans only 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Fried Peach Pies
instructions: Cover dried peaches with water. Cook in boiling water for 30 minutes until tender. Drain and cool.

title: Corny Corn Muffins(Lo-Fat)
instructions: *No cream style corn? Substitute 1/4 cup milk buttermilk or yogurt a pinch of baking soda and corn kernels to make 1 cup.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt together. Add all remaining ingredients except coconut. Mix well. Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens stirring with wire whip to prevent sticking. Add coconut and pour into pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Pecan Sandies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add water and vanilla. Mix well. Blend in flour salt and nuts. Chill for 4 hours. Shape into crescents or fingers using about 1 tablespoon of dough per cookie. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool slightly. Dust with powdered sugar. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Caramel Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt caramels with water and margarine in covered double boiler or in a saucepan over low heat. Stir occasionally until smooth. Combine sugar salt vanilla and eggs. Gradually add caramel sauce; mix well. Stir in pecan halves. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Pie filling will appear to be soft but it becomes firm as it cools.

title: Yam Souffle
instructions: Mix together the above and pour into greased 8-inch round baking dish.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients to make crumbs. Reserve about 3/4 cup for topping. Add milk and eggs to remaining crumbs and mix until smooth. Put batter in prepared 13 x 9-inch pan. Add cinnamon to reserved crumbs and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Applesauce Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix together thoroughly shortening sugar and eggs; stir in applesauce. Sift together flour soda baking powder salt and spices; stir into sugar mixture. Mix in raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Place 1/4 maraschino cherry on top for decoration. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Wasateh Mountain Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add both sugars beating well. Add eggs; mix well. Stir in flour baking powder soda salt and vanilla. Fold in oats cereal nuts morsels coconut and raisins.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Heat all ingredients in a medium saucepan except nuts and cook until smooth. Add nuts and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate until set. Cut into squares.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole dish. Pour pineapple (drained) in dish. Sprinkle sugar and flour mixture over pineapple. Sprinkle cheese over sugar and flour mixture. Mix cracker crumbs and melted margarine. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Mushroom Rice
instructions: Make rice according to package directions. Saute onions and mushrooms in margarine until tender. In large casserole combine cooked rice mushrooms and onions and soy sauce. (Add more soy sauce to taste.) Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken grapes and almonds. Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients. Add to chicken mixture and mix well.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Cook bacon; drain and crumble. Combine half the Swiss cheese and the other ingredients. Mix completely. Pour into deep dish pie shell. Cover with the rest of the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm in center. This is very good even if you are not a lover of spinach.

title: Weight Watchers Raspberry Mousse With Strawberries
instructions: Drain raspberries reserving juice. Combine gelatins in small saucepan; stir in half the orange juice and raspberry juice. Let stand 3 minutes. Stir over medium heat until gelatin is dissolved.

title: Bacon Wrap Ups
instructions: Wrap bacon around the water chestnuts and spear with toothpick. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes (can be frozen until needed). Mix together the ketchup sugar and soy sauce; dip the bacon wrap ups in this sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Eggless, Butterless, Milkless Cake
instructions: Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased and floured). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine. Press into a 13 x 9-inch dish. Bake for 10 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Cool.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef with chopped onion; drain. Add catsup and mustard; simmer for 5 minutes. In 2-quart casserole layer beef mixture and slices of cheese. Top last layer of cheese with biscuits. Follow baking directions on can. Serve with salad or fries.

title: Turtles
instructions: To make each turtle use 1 whole (head) and 2 halves (4 legs) pecans. Place pecans in form and place softened caramel over pecans to make body. Pour a tablespoon of chocolate chip mixture over that and chill until firm.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Mix in flour and spice. Pour brandy over chopped up fruit and nuts. Add to cake mix. Refrigerate for 1/2 day before cooking. Grease cookie sheet. Cook for 15 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Philly Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine cheese food softened cream cheese and margarine; mix until well blended. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Mold into bell shapes using the Cracker Barrel container coated with margarine. Chill until firm. Remove. Yields 2 bells.

title: Hot Roll Recipe
instructions: Warm milk sugar and Crisco. Dissolve dry yeast in the warm water. When dissolved add to milk mixture. Add flour and beat with electric mixer. Set aside until double in size. Sift together baking powder salt and baking soda. Add to mixture and enough flour to make a stiff dough (enough to handle; I use my hands.) Make out your rolls (use greased muffin tins or whatever kind of roll you are making) and let rise. (I make two balls in muffin pan.) Bake at 425\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes. The dough can be placed covered in the refrigerator for several days. You can make a dozen at a time.

title: Graham Cookies
instructions: Cover bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan with graham crackers. Mix margarine egg sugar and milk in saucepan and boil 2 minutes. Cover crackers with mixture. Remove from heat and add vanilla coconut cracker crumbs and nuts. Pour over crackers in pan and add another layer of crackers and press down gently. Cover with Icing.

title: Frosted Pineapple Squares
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until thick and smooth; set aside to cool. Scald milk and add sugar. Set aside to cool. Mix yeast and warm water; let it sit for a few minutes. Cut butter into flour and add eggs. Combine flour yeast and milk mixtures. Dough will be moist. Divide in half. Roll each half out on a floured surface to fit the bottom of a jelly roll pan. Spread cooled pineapple filling and cover with second half. Seal edges; snip surface of dough to let steam escape. Cover with clean towel and let rise in a warm place for about one hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Frost with confectioners sugar frosting. May want to use 2 cans of canned pie filling or substitute other canned fruit or fresh fruit or pineapple.

title: Fat-Free Pumpkin Bran Muffins(Tasty Muffins Without The Fat.)
instructions: Spray 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups with cooking spray. In medium bowl combine pumpkin cereal milk corn syrup and egg whites. In large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Add pumpkin mixture; stir until well blended. Stir in raisins. Spoon into prepared muffin cups. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Remove; cool on wire rack.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Combine in blender and blend until smooth.

title: Energy Saver Bars
instructions: Toast oats in shallow baking pan in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes or until golden brown. Line a 9-inch square baking pan with aluminum foil and butter. Melt marshmallows peanut butter honey and butter in medium saucepan over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in toasted oats and raisins. Place in prepared pan spreading evenly. Chill until firm. Remove from foil and cut into small squares. Refrigerate in sealed container.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
instructions: In saucepan combine beans and oil. Bring to boil. Let cool and drain off liquid. Add eggs onions pickles and salad dressing. Cover and refrigerate.

title: President Harding'S Pudding Pie
instructions: Cream together butter and sugars. Add eggs half and half and vanilla. Pour into pie shells that have been baked 4 to 5 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle lightly with nutmeg and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix remaining ingredients in order given. Chill and use as spread for crackers or party bread.

title: Heloise Peking Roast
instructions: Wash meat. Cut slits in meat and put in slivers of onion. Drizzle vinegar over meat. Cover tight and place in refrigerator overnight. Next day drain off vinegar and wipe dry. Put meat in heavy pan and brown both sides in oil. Pour coffee and water over meat. Add salt and pepper. Cover and bake 5 to 6 hours in low degree oven until meat is fork-tender. Make drippings into gravy.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; chill but add 7-Up just before serving.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Heat but do not boil. Serve hot. Serves 16 to 18.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil to softball. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Stir until creamy syrup then add peanut butter. Put in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in ungreased shallow casserole. Chill until set. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Apple Strudel
instructions: Toss apple slices in lemon juice. Add nuts raisins salt Sugar Twin and cinnamon; mix well. Lay out 1 sheet of fillo dough on waxed paper and brush carefully with 1 teaspoon melted margarine. Sprinkle with 1/2 tablespoon bread crumbs. Place second sheet on top of first and repeat the process. Now you are ready to fill and roll the strudel. Spoon 1/2 of the apple mixture in one strip along the edge of the fillo sheets that are nearest you. Using the waxed paper to help you get started roll the dough like a jelly roll. Lay on greased baking sheet seam side down and brush top with remaining tablespoon margarine. Score at 1-inch intervals. Repeat process with other two fillo sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown; be careful not to let it burn. Cut into slices when cool.

title: Persimmon Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating well. Add egg and beat well. Combine flour spices and salt; add to creamed mixture mixing well. Combine persimmon pulp and soda; stir well and add to creamed mixture. Stir in raisins and pecans. Drop dough by level teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until done. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Marinated Italian Beans
instructions: Wash beans trim ends and string. Place beans in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Add water. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and microwave at High for 12 to 14 minutes or until crisp-tender stirring after 6 minutes. Let stand covered 2 minutes. Drain. Combine dressing and remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Stir well. Pour mixture over beans cover and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours. Serves 6.

title: Hot Apple Cider Punch
instructions: Heat cider cloves allspice cinnamon and sugar to boiling; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Strain punch and pour into punch bowl. Float oranges in bowl. Makes 32 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

title: Fruity Pebble Bars
instructions: Put cereal in a large bowl. Melt marshmallows and butter in pan on stove. Add marshmallow mixture to cereal; mix well. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Chill for 1 hour to harden. Cut into squares.

title: Tender Breaded Chicken Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dip chicken in oil then in flavored bread crumbs flavored with garlic powder. Place 1 slice of cheese on cutlet then roll. Put in pan sprayed with Pam. Cover with foil. Bake 50 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: South Of The Border Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Add taco seasoning mix; stir. Add refried beans and water; stir. Layer beef and bean mixture into a large oblong casserole dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Spread sour cream over mixture. Top with Cheddar cheese. Add taco sauce and jalapenos if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix together lemon juice oil salt pepper sugar and basil. Add sliced onion and mushrooms. Marinate overnight in refrigerator.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Form ingredients into a loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Mix tomato paste and water and put on top of loaf. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes more.

title: Potatoes Deluxe
instructions: Thaw potatoes for 30 minutes. Mix with remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Cook 2 minutes remove and cool. Place remaining ingredients in bowl and add cooled mixture and blend. Chill. Keeps for days in refrigerator. Great for 2 people.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender; saute onions and bell pepper in small amount of margarine. Mix all ingredients reserving 1/2 of cheese for top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Canning Fish
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Cut fish into pieces to fit in jar. Fill about 1/2 full then add 3 tablespoons of mixture. Finish filling jar with fish. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to each pint. Do not add water. Pressure cook for 90 minutes. Yields 4 pints of fish.

title: Shipwreck(Turkey Casserole)
instructions: In 10-inch baking dish layer each ingredient; potatoes on bottom onions ground turkey uncooked rice and kidney beans. Spread tomato soup on top. Pour water over all and cover tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given until well blended. Place in 2 greased and floured bread pans. Place crumbs on top and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Hamburger
instructions: Saute onion with garlic for 1 minute; set aside. In a separate bowl mash beans. Add cracker meal (enough to make a ball). Add cider vinegar egg white onion and garlic. Grill or bake for 2 1/2 minutes on each side.

title: Hotel Peabody Vanilla Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Liberally grease muffin tins (not with the nonstick spray) and heat muffin pans until almost smoking. Spoon muffin mixture into hot muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix flour margarine and confectioners sugar well. Press into ungreased 8-inch square pan. Build up edges about 1/2-inch. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients. Pour over hot crust and bake until no indentation remains when center is lightly touched about 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix flour soda powder and salt. Melt butter in saucepan. Add sugar. Blend in flour mixture gradually mixing well. Spread in 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle with chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool in pan cut into bars.

title: Chocolate Pudding(Yields 2 Cups)
instructions: Scald the milk in the top of a double boiler over direct heat. Mix the cocoa sugar and add the 1/4 cup cold milk slowly stirring all the time to make a smooth paste. Combine the scalded milk with the other ingredients and cook over hot water stirring constantly until the pudding thickens. Remove from the fire and chill before serving. If you use milk for each half cup of pudding that you eat subtract a half a cup of milk from your daily allowance of milk.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in water. Beat eggs until fluffy. Fold eggs and cornstarch into pineapple. Add salt and sugar. Put in baking dish. Cover mixture with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until golden brown all over. Serve with ham like a vegetable.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a bowl mix the cream cheese sugar and peanut butter with electric mixer. Fold in cool whip. Pour the mixture into pie shells and chill several hours before serving. Garnish with reserved cup of cool whip.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 dish with vegetable spray. Layer ham slices on bottom then add potato slices. Mix cream of mushroom soup with milk and pour over potatoes. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can add Vidalia onion if desired.

title: Peasant'S Purse
instructions: In medium skillet saute (with 1 tablespoon butter) mushrooms leeks (cut into pieces) and garlic. Add wine. Boil gently until wine evaporates. Stir in chives and rice. Set aside.

title: Quesadillas(Appetizers)
instructions: Fry each tortilla in 1/4 inch of hot oil until crisp and golden turning once. Drain and place tortillas on paper towels. Sprinkle each tortilla with combined cheese then tomato pieces and sprinkle of dried cilantro. Microwave each tortilla approximately 1 minute until cheese is melted.* Using scissors cut tortillas into quarters. Serve warm.

title: Fantastic Chicken
instructions: Combine soup and cream and put half in bottom of baking dish. Lay chicken pieces over the mixture. Put other half on top of chicken. Salt and pepper chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Combine ingredients in large casserole or a roaster. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: 7 Stacked Layer Lettuce Salad
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in large dish in layers with lettuce on the bottom. Mix mayonnaise and sugar and put on top. Mix. Add shredded cheese and Bac*Os or bacon. Can substitute boiled eggs onions and cauliflower.

title: Beer Batter Bread
instructions: Combine flour and sugar; add beer and egg. Stir mixture with fork until blended. Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch bread pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes or until done. Remove from pan and cool on rack.

title: Turkey Or Crab Tetrazzini
instructions: Saute the onion green pepper celery mushrooms and pimento. Add wine and turkey or crab. Put pasta on bottom of casserole and Parmesan cheese on top then sauteed mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes. May use 2 cans favorite pie filling in place of pineapple.

title: Wild Rice Chicken Supreme
instructions: Cook contents of rice and seasoning packet according to package directions. While rice is cooking melt butter in a large saucepan. Add onion and cook over low heat until tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Gradually stir in half and half and chicken broth. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in chicken pimiento parsley almonds and cooked rice. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Melt margarine. Add corn sour cream and Jiffy corn muffin mix. Mix good and bake in a greased casserole. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top is lightly brown.

title: Better Than Almost Anything Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions. Add water oil and eggs.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and butter; cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour alternately with milk beating well after each addition. Add flavorings. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Orange Glazed Cranberry Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In large bowl mix flour sugar baking soda pumpkin pie spice salt and baking powder. In second bowl stir together remaining ingredients until well mixed. Add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture and stir until all ingredients are well moistened. Pour batter into 2 (9 1/4 x 5 1/4-inch) greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 minutes. Cool 10 minutes then remove. Cool then drizzle with glaze.

title: Julia Child'S Sweet Onion Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Heat olive oil in a large saute pan. Saute sliced onions until soft but not browned. In a separate pan heat butter and saute shallots briefly. Add to onions and continue cooking until the mixture is tender. Season with salt pepper and nutmeg; let cool.

title: Sun-Drop Punch
instructions: Pour into punch bowl over crushed ice.

title: Cherry Dream Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl combine cake mix 6 tablespoons butter and 1 cup rolled oats. Mix until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs add 1 egg and mix until well blended. Press into prepared pan. Pour cherry pie filling over crust. Spread to cover. To reserved crumbs in large bowl add remaining 1/4 cup rolled oats 2 tablespoons margarine nuts and brown sugar. Beat until thoroughly mixed. Sprinkle over cherry mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Add whipped topping if desired.

title: Nachos
instructions: Cook meat and onion until browned. Drain and stir in beans. Arrange half of chips on each of two 12-inch plates. Layer half the meat-bean mixture olives and cheese on top of chips for each plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Mikey'S Tuna Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients. Chill and serve.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan; let cool. Puncture the cake full of holes. Combine cream of coconut and condensed milk; pour mixture over the cake. Top with whipped topping then the coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Pudding(Mmmmmmmmmm Good)
instructions: Cream the pudding milk Cool Whip and sour cream together in a large bowl. Layer the pudding mixture bananas and cookies in a big dish. Put pudding mixture on bottom and layer finishing with cookies on top. Enjoy!!

title: Easter Basket Cake
instructions: Make cake according to package directions. Bake in two 9 inch round pans. Cool. Put first layer on plate. Frost with icing; cut hole about 2 inches round in the middle of the second layer and put on top of first layer. (Save the middle part you cut out for another time.) Frost with icing. Put 1 c. tinted green coconut in the middle of hole. Put robbins eggs and/or jelly beans on top of coconut. Sprinkle rest of coconut around the bottom of cake to resemble green grass. Roll foil to resemble a handle and decorate with ribbon. Put on cake to make a handle of a basket. Enjoy!

title: World'S Best Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg is added. Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Place in large tube pan which has been greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Beat in eggs 1 at a time beating thoroughly after each. Add flour reserving 2 tablespoons. Add sour cream. Mix 1/4 teaspoon soda mixed with 2 tablespoons flour. Add to mixture with flavorings. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Remove from pan when comfortable to handle.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook and debone chicken (reserve broth). Saute onion until soft. Cook spaghetti and drain. Add milk broth and 1/2 of the Velveeta cheese to spaghetti. Heat until cheese melts. Add bite size pieces of chicken and sauteed onion to mixture. Put into casserole dish and cook covered until it bubbles in the middle. Grate remaining Velveeta over top. Melt and serve.

title: Spinach Cornbread
instructions: Melt margarine in pie plate. Mix all ingredients well and pour into pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli-Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes until tender; drain. In saucepan over medium heat cook soup and cream cheese stirring constantly. Alternate broccoli and soup/cream cheese mixture in casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Bite Size Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly and drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at\t325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. This does better if let set for a couple hours in refrigerator before cooking.

title: Potato Leek Soup
instructions: Melt butter in soup pot. Cut off tough green tops of leeks and wash thoroughly to remove sand. Slice leeks thinly. Simmer slowly in butter until transparent. Dice potatoes and add to leek with broth. Simmer 1/2 hour. Puree in blender. Return to heat. Season and stir in milk. Heat through. Do not boil. Serve sprinkled with fresh parsley.

title: Hot Curried Fruit
instructions: Arrange all fruit except cherries in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine brown sugar butter and curry powder; sprinkle over fruit. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Garnish with maraschino cherries. Serve immediately. Fruit can also be served from chafing dish. Serve with ham. Makes 12 servings.

title: Oven Baked Spuds
instructions: Cut potatoes in wedges and put in ice water for 30 minutes. Combine oil garlic powder paprika and salt and pepper. Coat potato wedges with mixture and lay in shallow baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Carrot Sticks
instructions: Place carrots in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with salt sugar or Equal. Use either pepper or cinnamon. Stir to mix. Dot with butter. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Stir once half way through. Kids love these; especially with cinnamon!

title: Easy Five Can Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing lightly. Turn into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 to 360\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
instructions: In small saucepan mix milk gradually into flour with wire whisk. Cook over medium heat whisking constantly until mixture thickened. Remove from heat; cover with plastic wrap and set aside to cool.

title: Easy Oven Stew
instructions: Mix together flour salt pepper and paprika; sprinkle over beef. Toss floured beef in oil that has been put in 3-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the next five ingredients in the order given in layers on top of the melted margarine. Pour the sweetened condensed milk over the layered mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Homemade Pizza Crust
instructions: Sprinkle yeast into the water and stir until dissolved. Stir in sugar salt and oil. Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth then gradually stir in the additional 1 1/2 cups flour. Dough should be as soft as biscuit dough. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl and brush top with soft shortening. Cover and let rise in warm place (85\u00b0) free from draft until doubled in bulk. Punch down and divide in half. Form each half into a ball and place on greased baking sheet. Press out with palms of hands into circles about 12-inches in diameter making edges slightly thick.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and beat 2 minutes. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour in greased and floured Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. A frosting is not necessary but I usually put a chocolate frosting or glaze on top.

title: Christmas Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and hot water; let stand about 10 minutes. Add pie filling and pineapple; stir until blended. Pour 1/2 of mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish and chill until firm. (Let other half of mixture stand at room temperature until needed.)

title: Baked Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook onion celery and pepper in water until tender. Drain. Mix all ingredients with squash and bake at 400\u00b0 until firm and slightly brown. Put cheese evenly across top of squash and cover casserole with lid to melt cheese. (Do not return to oven.)

title: Shrimp And Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp. Mix well and place in covered dish in refrigerator to chill.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Put cinnamon stick and whole cloves in a cheesecloth bag. Place in saucepan with sugar and water. Bring to a boil and boil for 15 minutes. Remove spices and add all remaining ingredients. Heat and serve. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Ham And Cheese Strata
instructions: Remove crusts from bread; cube bread slices. Layer bread broccoli ham and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Beat eggs milk onion salt and mustard. Pour over bread etc. in pan. Sprinkle paprika and parsley flakes on top. Bake 50 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes. Cut and serve; great for brunch.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Mash cranberry sauce until fine. Add pineapple jello orange juice and nuts. Put in long size Pyrex dish and let gel overnight. Good anytime with meats or as a salad with crackers.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: In a large skillet or\twok stir-fry chicken and white onions in oil until chicken is completely cooked and onions are clear. Then mix cooked rice green onions and mushrooms in skillet with chicken and onions. If rice\tis too dry add 1/4 cup water in skillet or chicken broth. Sprinkle soy sauce over rice mixture to taste.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add the beaten eggs then the soda with milk mixture and vanilla. Roll out thin on flour surface. Cut with cookie cutter. Sprinkle with sugar and bake on greased cookie sheet in a 350\u00b0 oven until light brown.

title: Pork Chop 'N Potato Bake
instructions: Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside. Combine soup milk sour cream pepper and 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt. Stir in potatoes 1/2 cup of the cheese and 1/2 cup of the French fried onions. Spoon mixture into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange pork chops over potatoes. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Eggplant Fritters
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt; stir in eggs. Add to mashed eggplant mixing well. Drop batter by tablespoons in deep hot oil and fry until golden brown turning once.

title: Happy Marriage Recipe
instructions: Combine love and warmth. Mix thoroughly with tenderness. Add forgiveness. Blend with friends and hope. Sprinkle all remaining tenderness. Stir in faith and laughter. Bake with sunshine. Serve daily in generous helpings.

title: Hamburg Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion and put in casserole dish. Put soups on top and cover with French fries laid in rows. Bake at 350-375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. You can put the hamburger in the casserole raw and then cook for 1 hour or until done.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: In large bowl of electric mixer combine sugars and butter. Beat until well mixed. Add eggs one at a time. Continue beating until mixture is creamy. Next add flour soda baking powder salt vanilla crushed pineapple and nuts and mix on medium speed for a minute or two. Do not overbeat. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet and bake for about 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Do not overbake. Bake at 375\u00b0. Place on cookie rack to cool.

title: 3 Bean Dish
instructions: Brown the bacon hamburger and onion. Add drained cans of beans in a crock-pot. Add the rest of the ingredients. Cook on low for 4 hours.

title: French Fried Onion Rings
instructions: For thicker batter Increase salt to 1 teaspoon; add another egg. Reduce milk to 1/2 cup and reduce oil to 1 teaspoon.

title: Chicken Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix in bowl and beat with egg beater. Makes enough for about 6 halves of chicken.

title: Herb Shake Instead Of Salt
instructions: Take one large field a half dozen children two or three small dogs a pinch of brook and some pebbles. Mix the children and dogs together and put them on the field with flowers. Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun. When brown set away to cool in the bathtub. Yield Many years of memories.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Use cheaper cut of meat; cut in small chunks. Mix with Gebhardts chili powder garlic and flour. Melt fat and suet in deep pot; fry onion until tender; add meat mixture. Cook 15 minutes add salt; gradually pour in hot water. Simmer 45 minutes or until tender. If chili with beans is desired add Gebhardts Mexican-style beans heat thoroughly; serve.

title: German Chocolate Filling And Topping
instructions: In medium saucepan combine milk egg yolks and butter. Cook stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Cool until thick enough to hold shape stirring occasionally. Frosts two 9-inch round layer cakes.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Mash cream cheese with a fork and add mayonnaise. Blend well. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped pecans and 1 cup chopped olives. Add 2 tablespoons olive juice and a dash of pepper (no salt). Stir well. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Hershey Candy Bar Cookies
instructions: Beat until light and fluffy then add flour until all flour is in. Spread on greased 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Melt 7 or 8 Hershey bars (without almonds); can do this in the microwave oven (only takes a few seconds). Stir and immediately spread on top as soon as cookies comes out of oven. Sprinkle crushed nuts over chocolate. Let set for 15 to 20 minutes and cut into 1 1/2-inch squares.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 1 hour at 450\u00b0.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix poppy seed with hot water and let stand. Combine all other ingredients and mix with electric mixer on low. Add poppy seed and water; continue mixing on low for 1 minute. Then mix on high for 3 or 4 minutes. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes (or in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes).

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Take sausage out of refrigerator and bring to room temperature about an hour. Mix all three items together and roll into tiny balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Put flour in a brown paper bag. Add about three pieces of chicken at a time and shake until chicken pieces are well coated with the flour. Dip chicken in melted butter and place on a cookie sheet; salt and pepper to taste. Cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for one hour or until golden brown.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Melt margarine and add other ingredients. Mix well. Bake in an unbaked pie shell at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low heat for 3 minutes. Stir constantly. When firm transfer to waxed paper and knead dough. Store in airtight container and keep in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Corn Chowder
instructions: In saucepan blend cream of chicken soup and milk. Add remaining ingredients. Heat. Stir occasionally. Makes about 7 cups. Serve with crispy bread.

title: Apple And Lemon Punch(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Make a simple syrup by dissolving sugar in hot water. Add lemon juice; let cool. Dilute syrup with water to taste. Just before serving add apples. Serve over ice.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Sift or stir together dry ingredients. Add onions. Mix egg and milk. Mix all together. Drop with a small spoon into hot cooking oil. Cook only until light brown.

title: Hot Mushroom Dip
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain saving 2 tablespoons of drippings in pan. Crumble bacon and set aside. Add mushrooms onion and garlic to drippings. Cook over medium heat until tender and most of the mushroom liquid has evaporated about 6 to 8 minutes. Mix in flour salt and pepper. Add cream cheese Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce. Reduce heat to low and stir until cheese melts. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream and bacon. Serve with crackers.

title: Indian Pickle(Splendid Way To Salvage Green Tomatoes)
instructions: Chop coarsely all the vegetables. Sprinkle with salt and let stand 12 hours or overnight.

title: Orange Crush Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening 1/4 cup margarine and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Sift flour and salt together. Add to batter alternately with orange soda mixing well after each addition. Stir in extracts. Spoon into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool in pan and remove to wire rack to cool completely. Combine cream cheese 1/4 cup margarine and confectioners sugar in mixing bowl. Mix until smooth. Spread over cake.

title: Chicken Stroganoff Casserole
instructions: Blend soup and sour cream. Stir in milk. Add chicken or tuna parsley pimento seasonings and noodles. Pour into 1 1/2 quart shallow baking dish. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 servings. All you need to complete the meal is tossed salad rolls and dessert.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar kool-aid and concentrates in water. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Easy 10 Cup Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix well. Cook on High 2 1/2 minutes. Remove from microwave. Add vanilla. Beat 50 strokes. Pour in buttered platter. Cool and enjoy.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter. Pour mix over corn flakes. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let cool.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Bake cake according to directions in 9 x 9-inch pan. Cool. Cut crosswise in half. Arrange 1 layer of cake in 2-quart serving bowl. Pour 1/2 strawberries over cake then 1 cup pudding. Repeat. Cover and chill 4 hours. When ready to serve top with Cool Whip. Garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: Place ground beef in the bottom of a casserole. Top with a layer of sliced raw potatoes then a layer of onions. Pour can of beans over this. Cover with tomato soup. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour 15 minutes. Uncover and brown for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken cheese almonds celery and pineapple in bowl. Mix mayonnaise salt and soy sauce in bowl. Add to chicken mixture; mix well.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese spread onto slice of ham. Roll and secure with party picks. Continue until sufficient amount of ham slices and cheese is used for your particular party. Refrigerate. Before serving slice in small jelly roll type slices and secure each with a pick. (I use Alouette herb and garlic cream cheese spread.)

title: Szechuan Pork And Peanut Stir-Fry
instructions: In a bowl mix sherry cornstarch soy and garlic; stir in pork strips. Refrigerate 1 hour. Heat oil in wok or skillet over medium heat. Stir in onion and and carrots; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from pan. Stir-fry marinated pork until browned. Return onion and carrots to pan; stir in red pepper broth and brown sugar. Scrape bottom of pan to loosen browned particles and stir into liquid. Reduce heat to low; cover. Cook 5 to 6 minutes until pork is thoroughly cooked. Increase heat to medium; add green pepper. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes until pepper is crisp-tender. Stir in peanuts. Serve over hot rice.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Mix bananas soda and water; set aside. Mix shortening sugar eggs and milk. Add flour and baking powder mixture alternately with banana mixture. Add nuts; mix well. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Crumble together the 1 cup flour 1/2 cup butter and 1/4 cup powdered sugar. Press into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cold Avocado Soup
instructions: Peel and slice avocado and put in blender. Add heavy cream lemon juice and salt. Blend until smooth. Place in soup bowls and sprinkle with oregano. Serves 2.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Pt in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with remaining stuffing mix. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Grease an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Sift dry ingredients. Beat eggs sugar cooking oil and molasses. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture and mix until smooth. Blend in boiling water. Stir lightly and quickly. Batter will be thin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube or Bundt pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cake mix sugar oil eggs and sour cream. Blend with electric mixer at low speed until ingredients are moistened. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Stir in pecans. Pour half of batter into prepared pan. Combine cinnamon and brown sugar. Sprinkle over batter. Pour remaining batter into pan. Bake 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Remove cake from oven and allow to cool in pan 10 minutes. While cake is still in pan pour Rum Sauce over cake and allow to cool 1 1/2 hours before turning out on cake plate. Serves 12.

title: Pork Chops Creole
instructions: Brown the chops in a small amount of fat. Sprinkle rice between the chops and over the top. In bowl dilute soup and add seasonings then pour over the chops. Bake covered in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until the rice has absorbed moisture.

title: Quick Cheese Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Stir in water. Add biscuit mix and beat. Add mustard and 1 cup cheese. Mix thoroughly. Turn batter into pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and dot with butter. Bake 45 minutes. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack before slicing. Serve sliced buttered and toasted with a green salad soup or chili. Also makes delicious croutons. This bread will freeze well.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Gradually beat in sugar then oil. Combine dry ingredients; add to first mixture alternately with zucchini. Stir in raisins nuts and vanilla.

title: Cream Puff Cake
instructions: Boil water and oleo (margarine); stir in flour while on the stove until it pulls away from the side of the pan and forms a ball. Remove from heat; add eggs one at a time. Put in a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 10 minutes. Let cool.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
instructions: Combine strawberries and sugar stirring well. Let mixture stand 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Combine pectin and water in a saucepan stirring well. Bring mixture to a boil and let it boil for 1 minute stirring as it boils. Remove from the stove and stir well again. Pour the pectin mixture over the fruit. Stir for 3 minutes. Pour into sterilized jelly glasses or frozen food containers. Cover with lids and let stand at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours or until jelled. Store in freezer up to 1 year or in refrigerator up to 3 weeks. To serve remove and allow to come to room temperature. Yields 5 cups.

title: Creamy Lemon Cheesecake(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello in the boiling water. Put cottage cheese cream cheese and jello in blender; blend until smooth. Gently fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into the pie shell and chill at least 4 hours.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dry ingredients together. Then add liquid ingredients. Beat with electric mixer 3 minutes on high. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch or 2 rounds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Test with toothpick. Usually cracks open.

title: Crunchy Ham Salad
instructions: Blend the cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add the ham parsley onion mustard and hot pepper sauce. Blend until mixed good. Chill. Serve on bread or crackers.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs until hard-boiled. Cook; peel and slice in half. Take yolk and mix other ingredients with yolk. Add salt and pepper to taste. Put yolk mixture into egg halves.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Low-Fat Quick And Easy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook meat and onion in a Dutch oven over medium heat until beef is browned stirring until it crumbles. Drain beef mixture and pat dry with paper towels. Wipe drippings from Dutch oven with a paper towel. Return beef mixture to Dutch oven. Stir in vegetable juice and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Simmer all ingredients over low flame. Stir frequently to prevent sticking. When thick pour into bowl. Sprinkle top of pudding with cinnamon. Chill. (Remove cinnamon stick and rind prior to chilling.)

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Add egg vanilla salt and cream of tartar. Sift and add flour soda and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 8 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Crumble graham crackers over butter. Layer remaining ingredients exactly as listed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Ginger Lemon Marinade
instructions: In a small bowl combine lemon juice water vegetable oil vinegar sugar sesame oil ginger coriander and fennel seed (optional); mix well. Use to marinate chicken fish or veal. Remove meat and boil marinade for 3 to 5 minutes until thickened. Brush over meat before cooking. Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Warm green beans. Add soup. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cover with potato chips or deep fried onions.

title: Baked Red Snapper
instructions: Melt oleo and saute bell pepper onions celery and green onions until tender. Add tomatoes wine and seasoning. Cook slowly on medium heat for 20 minutes. Place fish in baking dish. Pour sauce over fish. Add sliced lemons over fish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Baste fish with sauce. Fish should be tender when stuck with a fork.

title: Ting-A-Lings
instructions: In large bowl combine butterscotch chips and peanut butter. Microwave at 7 for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until melted stirring every 30 seconds. Add cornflakes and peanuts. Stir until coated. Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto wax paper. Chill until set.

title: Summer Stir-Fry
instructions: Batter with flour and fry in oil. Serve with tossed salad.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together; pour in greased casserole dish. Cook 30 minutes in regular oven.

title: Calico Quiche
instructions: Beat eggs with half and half. Stir in corn asparagus 1 cup cheese flaked ham and onion. Add salt and pepper. Carefully pour filling into 10-inch pastry shell. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift together sugar and flour. Set aside. Put butter cocoa and water and bring to boil. Pour over sugar and flour mixture. Add baking soda vanilla eggs and buttermilk. Mix well. Add cinnamon and bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0 in 13 x 9 x 2 dish.

title: Veggie Biscuit Bites
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix all ingredients until soft dough forms. Turn dough onto surface generously dusted with baking mix; gently roll in baking mix to coat. Shape into ball; knead 3 or 4 times. Roll dough 1/2-inch thick. Cut with 1-inch round cutter dipped in baking mix. Place with edges touching on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen 1-inch biscuits. For mini drops use teaspoon and drop dough on cookie sheet.

title: Sweet And Fruity Dip
instructions: Cream the cheese. Add heavy cream then the pineapple and cherries.

title: Cheese Corn Bread
instructions: Prepare corn bread mix as directed; add cheese and bake.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; drain grease. Mix spaghetti sauce and water in with this mixture. Mix the egg into the container of cottage cheese. In large oven pan layer sauce mix and lasagna noodles. Spread cottage cheese on the noodles then the Mozzarella and Cheddar. Make 2 to 3 layers and top with Parmesan cheese. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Be sure to put aluminum foil over the pan.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise or remain whole. Remove seeds and parboil for five minutes. Remove casing from sausage; crumble and brown with onions in butter until both are lightly browned. Add dissolved tomato paste; salt to taste.

title: Zucchini-Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling water for 5 minutes then drain. Combine soup sour cream and carrot. Fold into drained zucchini. Combine stuffing mix with butter. Put half on bottom of a 12 x 7 1/2-inch casserole dish. Spoon vegetable mix over crumbs and top with remaining stuffing mix. The whole package of stuffing mix may be used but is a lot of crumbs (your preference). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cold Vegetable Salad
instructions: Clean fresh vegetables then cut up in bite size pieces. Put in a bowl (a glass bowl looks nice). Then pour Italian dressing over this (I prefer Good Seasons packets). Then you just marinate overnight turning occasionally.

title: Candied Dill Pickles
instructions: Tie spices in cheesecloth bag. Combine all ingredients; stir to mix. Let stand until sugar dissolves. Return 1/2 of the pickles to jar. Add spice bag. Add rest of pickles and syrup. Refrigerate 3 to 4 days before serving. You may remove the spice bag after a week.

title: Praline Pie
instructions: Mix margarine brown sugar and pecans together; pat into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 until pie crust is brown and praline mixture is bubbly. Cool. Next add butterscotch pie filling to 2 cups cold milk. Mix until thick. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into cooled pie crust. Refrigerate. Serve with a scoop of ice cream.

title: Peanut Butter Tandy Cake
instructions: Beat the eggs; add sugar. Then add flour and vanilla. Scald the milk and melt margarine in the milk and add to the other ingredients. Pour into greased jelly roll pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Spread peanut butter on cake while its hot. Cool.

title: Wine Merchant Soup
instructions: Heat beef broth in large kettle. Saut onions celery and carrots in butter and oil until just tender. Transfer with slotted spoon to broth and simmer. Use same oil and butter to saut mushrooms. When done pour mushrooms and liquid into soup. Add wine and bring to a boil. Combine cornstarch and cold water then add to soup.
