Heat until slightly thickened and serve. Serves 6.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Place layer of crumbs in bottom of greased casserole dish. Layer with cheese. Layer 1 can of asparagus and 1/2 of soup and liquid mixture on top. Repeat layers. Reserve some cheese and cracker crumbs for topping. Pour melted butter over topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Leona'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat and season with next 7 ingredients. Add tomatoes. Simmer 3 hours or until thick. Add beans with liquid. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Philly 3 Step Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs; mix well. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Yields 8 servings. Can be served with fruit sauce on top.

title: Salmon Party Ball
instructions: Flake salmon. Combine salmon cheese lemon juice onion horseradish and liquid smoke. Chill 6 to 8 hours. Shape salmon mixture into a ball. Combine pecans and parsley; roll the salmon ball into the mixture. Chill at least 4 hours. Serve with crackers. Makes 3-inch salmon party ball.

title: Baked Pineapple Salad
instructions: Place 1/2 of drained pineapple in buttered 10x6 pyrex dish. Mix flour sugar and salt sprinkle half of this over pineapple. Dot with butter. Spread 1/2 of mixed cheese over this. Repeat in same order. Bake at 325\u00b0-350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove and sprinkle with pecans. Bake 5 more minutes.

title: S'Mores Candy
instructions: Pour cereal into very large bowl; set aside. Slowly bring to a boil stirring constantly chocolate chips margarine and Karo syrup. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and stir. Pour chocolate over cereal. Toss until well coated. Fold in marshmallows. Spread mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan or shallow baking dish. Chill one hour and cut into squares.

title: Cobbler Pie
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Mix sugar flour and milk. Pour in berries or fruit. Pour mixture in a baking dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes until tested done with a fork.

title: Tomato Sauce
instructions: Brown onion in hot oil. Stir in tomatoes breaking them up with a spoon. Add other ingredients. Cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes.

title: One Step Cream Sauce
instructions: Measure cold milk into saucepan. Thoroughly blend in flour salt and pepper. Add butter and bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Makes 1 cup cream sauce.

title: Celery Seed Salad Dressing
instructions: Shake well and serve over fruit or lettuce salad.

title: Mom Bekkering'S Stuffing
instructions: In large pan over low heat saute onion in 1/2 cup butter until soft but not brown. Add cubed bread. Sprinkle salt pepper sage thyme and parsley over bread and then stir well. Simmer uncovered until bread becomes slightly browned and crispy stirring every few minutes. Add 1/4 cup butter melted and mixed into 1/2 cup water; mix well. Remove from heat and serve or refrigerate to reheat in the microwave before serving. (Can be made the day before.)

title: Cranberry Cream Mold
instructions: Heat orange juice to boiling; add gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Break up cranberry sauce with a fork. Add to jello. Add water and lemon juice. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in the whipped topping and pour into a 5-cup mold. Chill until firm. Enjoy!

title: Meltaways
instructions: Combine butter and 10 tablespoons powdered sugar. Beat 30 minutes with mixer. Add flour vanilla and pecans. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 about 20 minutes. Roll gently in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: Cook sausage and onions. Mix with cheeses and eggs salt and pepper. Spread one pizza dough in the bottom of 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Top with sausage mix. Spread second tube of pizza dough on top of sausage mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Pear Pie
instructions: Peel core and slice pears (approximately 5 cups). In mixing bowl combine sugar flour orange peel and cinnamon. Add pears and cranberries; toss to coat. Set aside.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients and chill overnight. Roll into small balls. Press middle of cookie and put cherry or walnut in hole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Remove bone and fat and mash. Serve on buns.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Break or cut cauliflower into small bite size florets. Fry bacon to a crisp and crumble. Slice green peppers and cut into small pieces. Chop onions fine. Mix all ingredients except Miracle Whip.

title: Britt Pruitt'S Hot Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order. Pour into prepared pans and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Thins
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder. Cream sugar. Add jello and sugar. Cream well. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Add flour to butter mixture. Mix until smooth. Cook on ungreased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Boil eggplant; drain and mash well. Add eggs to canned milk; beat well. Add butter grated cheese and onion. Turn into greased casserole.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Prepare pudding with 3 cups of milk; fold in 1/2 of whipped cream. Reserve vanilla wafers and 1 banana. Arrange in layers of wafers and bananas. Spread 1/4 of pudding over wafers; top with banana slices. Place wafers around sides of dish. Cover and chill 3 hours. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Corn Supreme Casserole
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together. Pour into greased 8 x 12-inch pan. Spread sour cream over the top. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Southern Moon Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. To make cookie crust In a large mixing bowl cream together 1/2 cup butter or margarine and white sugar. Add egg evaporated milk and vanilla. Mix well. In a separate bowl mix together flour salt cocoa powder baking soda and baking powder. Add flour mixture slowly to sugar mixture while stirring. Mix just until all ingredients are combined. Drop the dough into greased cookie sheet by rounded tablespoonfuls. Leave at least 3 inches in between each one; dough will spread as it bakes. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes until firm when pressed with finger. Allow to cool at least 1 hour before filling.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine; add flour. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Put in large baking dish and cook in slow oven until thick. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
instructions: Heat 2 cups water to boiling. Add broccoli celery and onion. Cook until tender. Do not drain. Heat margarine until melted. Stir in flour until smooth. Add 1 1/2 cups water until boiling. Add cooked vegies broth bouillon salt and pepper. Heat until just boiling. Stir in cream. Heat but do not boil.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Remove meat from bones used in making stock and add to stock. Saute in 2 Tbsp. oil onion garlic clove celery stalks carrot raw potato and zucchini. Stir until veggies glisten. Add stock along with kidney beans can of tomatoes and tomato sauce. Simmer 30 minutes stirring often. Add 1/2 cup uncooked spaghetti broken into 1 inch pieces. Add salt pepper chili powder oregano and parsley. Simmer 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Kelly
instructions: Marinate cubed cutlets in egg in refrigerator overnight (at least 4 hours). Then mix in breadcrumbs; brown in skillet in margarine.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and set overnight.

title: French Peas
instructions: In a saucepan cook green onions and lettuce in oil over low heat for 5 minutes. Combine flour with broth. Add to lettuce mixture and stir until thickened. Put in the cooked peas sliced water chestnuts and seasoning. Heat through and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach Rolls
instructions: Mix first five ingredients and spread on tortillas; roll up. Chill in refrigerator then slice.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all together. Place in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon (optional).

title: Teriyaki Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Cut into strips. Combine next 5 ingredients in an 8-inch square pan. Add steak to marinade; turn to coat. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix ingredients together except the chocolate chips and pack into a 9 x 13 inch pan. Pack down the mix hard so they dont crumble. Either put chocolate chips on top and put it in warm oven to melt and spread or melt the chips and pour over the peanut butter mix. Let stand 6 hours to cool and cut.

title: Chocolate Banana Fizz
instructions: Peel banana and cut into large pieces. In blender combine all ingredients. Cover and blend until smooth. Makes 1 serving.

title: Cheese Strada(Breakfast-Brunch Meal)
instructions: Trim crusts if desired. Layer bread cheese and butter. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over layers. Cover and put in refrigerator for overnight or 8 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm. Let stand for 15 minutes. Serve for breakfast or brunch.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine eggs oil buttermilk sugar and vanilla; mix well. Combine flour cinnamon baking soda and salt; stir into egg mixture. Stir in pineapple carrots raisins nuts and coconut. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tests done. Do not overbake. Remove to a wire rack to cool.

title: Chicken-Potato Soup
instructions: Melt oleo in deep saucepan. Add onion; cook until tender but not brown. Stir in chicken broth; add chicken and potatoes. Cover. Cook for 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add milk; mash 1 or 2 pieces of potato with spoon. Stir well.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add pecans coconut and vanilla wafers. Mix well. Bake in well-greased and floured 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan or a tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Microwave Dog Biscuits
instructions: Place flour into bowl. Add egg and enough broth to moisten flour. Add remaining ingredients. Roll dough into a ball. Working on a floured surface break off pieces of dough to form rings and rolls. Place on microwaveable dish. Bake on High for 10 minutes until firm. Let them cool and harden before giving them to the dog. Yields 20 biscuits.

title: Sauerbraten (Sour Beef Pot Roast)
instructions: Place meat vinegar spices and onion in bowl and refrigerate overnight longer if need be. Place in iron pot and brown meat on all side. Meanwhile strain vinegar and water and pour over brown roast and proceed to cook the same as pot roast (2 to 3 hours). Take meat out and keep warm. Add raisins and gingersnaps in 8 pot liquid. Gingersnaps will thicken the gravy. Add more crackers if you like a thicker gravy. Slice meat and serve with the gravy. Potato Rolls or noodles and red cabbage.

title: Turtles
instructions: Melt caramels with 3 tablespoons water in a double boiler. Add pecans and stir. Drop this on buttered cookie sheet and put a toothpick in each one. Place in freezer. Melt Hershey bar and paraffin in double boiler. Dip candy in chocolate. Place on wax paper and remove toothpick. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Pecan Chiffon Pie(A Light Airy Take-Off Of The Real Thing.)
instructions: Put to soak the gelatin and water. Meantime combine in saucepan or double boiler the slightly beaten egg yolks salt milk and 1 cup of the brown sugar and cook slowly stirring constantly until thickened. When done remove and stir in soaked gelatin and vanilla. Set aside to thicken only slightly while toasting until lightly browned in skillet the pecans and oleo. Make meringue using stiffly beaten egg whites and 1/4 cup brown sugar beaten into whites. Now gently fold together the custard meringue and 1/4 cup toasted pecans (cooled). Pour into 9-inch pie shell and top with remaining 1/2 cup toasted pecans. Chill until set. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Seafood Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Blend in remaining ingredients except almonds paprika and crackers. Spread mix into 9-inch pie plate. Top with almonds and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Sour Cream Banana Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; blend thoroughly. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream ending with dry ingredients. Add bananas and nuts mixing until just blended. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Cornflake Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt and baking powder and set aside. Cream shortening and add sugar together and gradually beat until light. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture. Add coconut and cornflakes. Drop by small teaspoon on greased sheet 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until delicately brown.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix together Miracle Whip cheese and oregano. Spoon mixture over chicken breasts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered or until tender.

title: Coconut Pie(Make In Blender)
instructions: Blend in blender for 3 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Cook potato and mash. In a large mixing bowl blend potato and sugar together. Roll out on waxed paper. Spread peanut butter on this mixture and roll up in jelly roll fashion. Cut in pieces.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in 1/2 cup of boiling water (cool). Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating after each. Add vanilla and melted chocolate and mix until blended. Sift flour with salt and soda. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with buttermilk beating after each addition until batter is smooth. Fold stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour batter into an 8 or 9-inch round cake pan lined on bottom with paper. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 35 to 40 minutes or until it springs back when lightly touched.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt soda and sugar. Cut in vegetable shortening. Add yeast cake dissolved in lukewarm water and buttermilk. Mix with large spoon until flour mix is moist. Keep covered bowl in refrigerator until ready to use. Take out amount needed. Roll on floured board to 1/2-inch thick. Cut and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Makes about 5 dozen. Keeps a few weeks in refrigerator.

title: Potato Dumplings
instructions: Grate potatoes; add eggs salt and pepper. Add flour and bread crumbs. Make into dumplings using 2 teaspoons. Drop into salted boiling water and cover. Cook until they float. Drain carefully and transfer to soup or serve with gravy and meat.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 if using glass pan). Fill baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inches) with stick of butter already melted. Sprinkle in brown sugar until 1/4-inch high. Place pineapple in an arrangement with cherries. Set to one side.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Put half in bottom rest on top.

title: Creamy Pralines
instructions: Stir and mix well. Pour into saucepan. When mixture begins to boil add pecans. Let cook until it reaches soft ball stage. Beat until it begins to thicken. Drop by spoon on waxed paper. Delicious!

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan combine soup milk cheese garlic powder and pepper. Add broccoli and carrot. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring occasionally. Add spaghetti. Heat through stirring occasionally. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables mixing lightly. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Taste to see if its sweet enough. Pour over vegetables. Put in covered dish. Put in refrigerator. Let stand overnight.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In large frying pan add ingredients in order given. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Ice Cream Soda
instructions: In the bottom of a tall soda glass stir the half and half together with the chocolate syrup. Add about 4 ounces of club soda. Drop in the scoop of ice cream and fill the glass to the top with additional club soda. Serve with a long straw and a long handled spoon. Makes 1 soda.

title: Seafood Party Spread
instructions: Blend together ingredients then gently add 1 package \crab\ or \lobster\. Add shredded cheese. Serve with \fancy\ crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine crust ingredients; press into a 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Quick Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Cook and mash potatoes with butter and milk or prepared potato mix with butter and milk. Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain and pour meat into baking dish. Cover the beef with mashed potato mixture then coat mashed potatoes with creamed corn. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 covered with foil. Remove foil and serve.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes slice thin and place 1/3 of slices in bottom of 2-quart casserole dish. Dot with 1/3 of butter. Season with salt and pepper. Place thin onion slices on top. Sprinkle flour over onions and cover with 4 slices of cheese. Add the second layer the same as the first. Do the third layer the same. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve hot. Serves 8.

title: Cinnamon Swirl Raisin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix 3 cups flour 1/2 cup sugar salt and yeast in large bowl. Heat water and oil until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0); stir into flour mixture. Stir in eggs. Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Gently roll in flour to coat. Knead 8 to 10 times until smooth. Place in greased bowl; turn greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place 1 hour or doubled in size. Grease 2 loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3). Punch dough down; divide in half. Knead 1/2 cup raisins into each half. Roll out 18 x 9-inches; brush 1 tablespoon oil over rectangles.\tMix 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon. Sprinkle each rectangle with 1/2 of mixture. Roll up each rectangle beginning at 9-inch side. Pinch edge of dough into roll to seal. Press ends with edge of hand to seal. Fold ends under loaf. Place loaves seam side down in pans. Brush oil over loaves. Cover let rise in warm place about 1 hour or until double. Move oven rack to lowest position. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until loaves are deep golden brown or sounds hollow when tapped.\tRemove from pans to wire rack to cool. Brush butter over loaves.

title: Apple Pecan Cake
instructions: Beat the sugar oil and eggs until well blended. Add the remaining ingredients. Cook for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0 in an aluminum foil lined pan.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: In a stew pan add water salt bay leaf and lemon. Bring to boil then add shrimp. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Drain and reserve liquid.

title: Apple Dessert Cake
instructions: In a bowl combine the apples and sugar; let this sit until the sugar is dissolved into the apples. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 8-inch pan 30 minutes at 400\u00b0 oven. Let cool slightly then put topping on cake.

title: Corn-Sausage Chowder
instructions: Cook sausage and onion in large kettle; brown and drain. Add potato salt marjoram and water. Simmer until potatoes are cooked about 15 minutes. Add corn and milk. Heat through and serve. Add pepper to taste.

title: Brownies
instructions: Beat eggs in medium bowl. Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Beat well and then blend in butter. Combine flour and cocoa; gradually add to egg mixture until well blended. Spread into a well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in pan.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until almost done; remove them and add pepper onion and celery. Mix together mayonnaise mustard and pickle relish. Add to potatoes; salt to taste and sprinkle top with paprika.

title: Rumaki
instructions: Cut chicken livers in half. Pour teriyaki sauce over chicken livers and water chestnuts in large bowl; refrigerate about 4 hours. Drain. Cut bacon slices in half. Wrap a piece of liver and a piece of water chestnut in each slice of bacon. Secure with toothpick. Roll in brown sugar. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Turn oven to broil for about 10 minutes turning occasionally. Serve with hot sauce.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Cream sugar eggs and oil. Add sifted flour (save 1/2 cup to coat nuts). Add spices and prunes. Mix. Add nuts. Bake in greased floured tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix butter eggs flour and sugar. Add milk coconut and vanilla. Pour in ungreased pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Candied Apples
instructions: Combine sugar water and cinnamon Imperials in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer until Imperials dissolve. Add the apples a quart at a time and cook until firm but done. Pour remaining syrup over cooked apples.

title: Buttered Rum Sauce
instructions: Beat together the first 3 ingredients and freeze.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In large bowl coat potatoes with oil then add soup mix and mix well. Empty potatoes into shallow baking or roasting pan. Bake stirring occasionally 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Press out cookie dough into a well-greased round or square cookie sheet. Bake for approximately 8 minutes at temperature indicated on cookie dough package. Cool. Mix cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on cooled dough. Top with fruit.

title: Baked Beans And Ground Beef
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Mix baked beans ketchup onion mustard brown sugar garlic powder and Worcestershire. Top with bacon. Place in greased 3 quart casserole. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Serves 8.

title: Hardtack Candy(Important:  Use A Wooden Spoon And Do Not Scrape Side Of Pan.)
instructions: Mix sugar Karo syrup and water well; boil to hard crack stage (300\u00b0). Do not stir while boiling. Remove from heat; add flavoring oil and coloring. Stir until mixed. Pour into well buttered 8-inch square pan. Cool for a few minutes and score with a metal spatula. After it hardens enough remove from pan when cooled enough to touch. Crack with a knife handle. After cracked and cooled completely shake small amount of powdered sugar on candy and toss around. Makes 1 pound.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
instructions: Drain green beans. Rinse well. Pour into saucepan. Add sugar and vinegar. In separate pan fry bacon and onion. Add to green bean mixture and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour in uncooked pie shell. Cook 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Peach And Melon Salad
instructions: Toss fruit with juices almonds and sugar. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Serves 6.

title: Spinach Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix spinach beaten eggs soup cheese and dressing. Spoon spinach mixture into 8-inch square baking dish. Top with combined bread crumbs and margarine. Bake 45 to 55 minutes. Makes 6 servings. Delicious!

title: Beet And Carrot Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into greased and floured bread pans (1 pan for large loaf or 2 medium loaves). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 1-quart casserole. Set aside. In 1-quart saucepan melt 2 tablespoons butter. Add onion and celery. Cook and stir over medium heat until tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Blend in evaporated milk. Cook and stir until mixture just thickens. Stir in corn and egg. Pour into prepared casserole. Set aside.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: *Blended Oatmeal Measure and blend in a blender to a fine powder.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: Cream butter and add sugar gradually creaming well. Blend in melted and cooled chocolate then vanilla. Add 1 egg at a time beating for 5 minutes after each addition. Turn into pie shell. Chill 1 to 2 hours. May be topped with whipped cream and nuts if desired.

title: Toasted Coconut Pie
instructions: Thoroughly combine eggs sugar margarine lemon juice and vanilla. Stir in coconut and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Cook spinach; drain well. Mix soup and sour cream; let set. Add crumbs soaked in melted butter to sour cream mixture. Mix in spinach and place in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie Dessert
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs 1 cup sugar and melted margarine; mix well. Press into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Set aside. Combine eggs 3/4 cup sugar and cream cheese; beat with electric mixer until light and fluffy. Pour over crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: In heavy pan\tput in light\tbrown sugar and oleo or butter. Heat until mixed and melted. Stir often. Set aside to cool then add vanilla and eggs. Add flour and salt. Mix; add nuts.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt stick of butter in a casserole. Mix dry ingredients. Add milk to dry ingredients and pour over butter in casserole dish. Empty can of fruit on top and press in with a spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until golden on top and done in center.

title: Meringue Snowmen
instructions: Cover cookie sheet with heavy brown paper. Place egg whites in bowl. Add cream of tartar and beat at high speed until foamy. Gradually beat in sugar a tablespoonful at a time. Turn off mixer occasionally and scrape sides of bowl. Continue beating at high speed until stiff and glossy about 6 or 7 minutes. For each snowman drop two rounded tablespoonfuls of meringue just touching each other on brown paper; then add rounded teaspoonful of meringue at top for head. Place pretzel stick arms and cinnamon candy eyes mouth and buttons on each snowman. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn off heat and leave snowmen in oven for one hour.

title: Scalded Corn Cakes
instructions: Bring water to a boil; gradually mix meal with water. Set in refrigerator for 20 minutes. Deep fry at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes in skillet with 1-inch of fat.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Beat eggs lightly. Melt butter and mix together with the dry ingredients. Add eggs. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Check with a toothpick.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash chicken and leave wet. (Chicken may be skinned if desired.) Combine biscuit mix paprika salt and pepper in a large plastic bag. Place chicken in bag and shake until chicken pieces are evenly coated. Set aside.

title: Three Cheese Chicken Bake
instructions: Cook noodles. Drain well. In saucepan cook onions and pepper in small amount of water until tender. Drain. Add soup and mushrooms pimiento milk and basil to vegetables. Layer 1/2 of noodles 1/2 mix chicken and cheeses. Repeat. Bake in covered casserole in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Oriental Pork
instructions: Trim excess fat from pork. Combine egg 1/4 cup cornstarch flour 1/4 cup chicken broth and 1/2 teaspoon salt (salt optional). Beat until smooth. Pour salad oil 1-inch deep in electric skillet. Heat to 375\u00b0. Dip pork in batter and fry 5 to 6 minutes or until golden.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown rice in oil. Add onions and bell pepper. Cook 1 minute longer being careful not to brown rice too much. Add chicken and broth; bring to a boil and cook until most of liquid is absorbed. Lower heat; cover and cook until rice is tender. Arrange cheese on top of rice. Cover and allow cheese to melt. Serves 4.

title: Chicken And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake until cheese melts at 350\u00b0.

title: Ultimate Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Cream sugar and eggs. Add vanilla and salt. Add chocolate. Add flour. Add rest of ingredients and bake in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Buttery Sherry Bundt Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and pudding mix with oil sherry wine eggs and flavoring. Beat 8 minutes. Pour half of batter in well-greased Bundt pan which has been sprinkled with cinnamon sugar and nut mixture. Then put rest of mixture on batter then rest of batter. Bake at 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. When done cool in pan on wire rack; cool before removing from pan.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Mix thoroughly with remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can also be microwaved on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Fudge Marble Bundt Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0; grease and flour Bundt pan. Combine yellow part of cake mix and rest of ingredients. Mix on low until moistened. Mix at high power for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan reserving 1/4 of batter. Mix reserved batter with chocolate mix and drop by tablespoonfuls on top of yellow batter. Swirl chocolate batter through yellow with butter knife not touching bottom of pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until cake springs back when touched on top or toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool in pan for 20 minutes then invert onto serving platter and cool completely.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and sour cream until smooth. Add all the rest of the ingredients and mix. Put in casserole and cover with topping.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
instructions: Mix together flour oleo and pecans. Press into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let cool. Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Mix chocolate with 2 cups milk. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Mix vanilla pudding with 2 cups milk. Spread over chocolate pudding. Top with large Cool Whip. Grate Hershey bar on top. Chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Gnocchi (Potato Dumpling)
instructions: Cook potatoes; drain and mash. Let the potatoes cool. Add the egg and mix well. Add all flour until stiff enough to handle without sticking.

title: Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in frig to cool.

title: Hot Mexican Dip
instructions: Cook and drain ground beef. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until cheese is melted. Serve with Tostitos chips.

title: Stir-Fried Beef
instructions: Fry beef in oil with onion; add vegetables and saute. Stir in cornstarch tomato sauce sugar ginger mushrooms and soy sauce. Cook until thick. Serve over rice.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Dump everything on top. Stir until moist. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Jessica And Mom'S Cornbread
instructions: Stir all dry ingredients together then add egg and stir into mixture. Add oil and stir again until well mixed. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Add milk to mixture slowly while stirring until batter is slightly thick and not too thin. Pour into well-greased cast-iron skillet and bake at 425\u00b0 until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean.

title: Chess Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and butter and work into a dry batter. Press mixture into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix the remaining eggs cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla together. Pour over pressed mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Center will stay soft. Do not overcook. Cut into squares of desired size.

title: Frosted Strawberry Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and chill to set. Place cream cheese in bowl; cream. Add whipped cream marshmallows and powdered sugar. Spread on jello.

title: Tuna Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve with small knife and crackers. Serves 8.

title: Ribbon Jello Salad
instructions: 1st Layer Mix 1 package Jell-O 1 cup boiling water and add 1/2 cup cold water. Chill until firm.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder salt and nutmeg. Mix sweet potatoes milk and oil. Stir into flour mixture just to moisten. Turn onto floured surface with floured hands. Knead gently about 6 strokes. Roll out about 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot with butter and honey.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate butter and margarine; cool thoroughly. Then add sugar eggs and vanilla; stir lightly but dont beat. Add flour and nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes only. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix pineapple chunks sugar and Cheddar cheese and place in a baking dish. Then mix pineapple juice flour and margarine. Pour this mixture over pineapple. Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 10-inch spring-form pan (or can use an 8-inch square casserole dish). Combine cake mix and oil in large bowl; mix well. Press mixture into bottom of pan. Bake 22 to 25 minutes or until set. Remove from oven. Increase oven temperature to 400\u00b0.

title: Campfire Pineapple Upside Down Cakes(A Girl Scout Camp Favorite)
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Prepare tuna can by removing paper label and washing thoroughly. Place 1 pat of butter in bottom of can. Add 1 Tbsp. brown sugar 1 pineapple ring and a little of the juice. Place 2 Tbsp. of the cake batter on top of pineapple ring. Cover can tightly with aluminum foil. Bake in campfire coals for about 15 minutes. Each can serves one person.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Combine and simmer the chili sauce 1/4 cup finely grated onion and the cranberry sauce. Combine ground beef and onion and make into 1-inch meatballs. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over the meatballs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together holding out 1 cup pecans. Roll into ball and refrigerate until cool and roll in remaining pecans.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind cranberries. Remove pulp and juice of oranges. Combine all ingredients. Makes about 1-quart. Keeps 1 to 2 weeks refrigerated.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Melt oleo and all spices. Pour over dry mix; spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Will fill 2 cookie sheets.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pat in an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Mix all together. When dissolved pour into a 9 x 13 pan. When set cut in squares.

title: Mayonnaise Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a mixing bowl mix all the ingredients together. Put them in a well-greased muffin pan and bake until golden brown. Makes about 1 dozen.

title: Polish Sausage Dinner
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes; core cabbage and slice in 1/2-inch pieces. Peel and slice onions; slice Polish sausage. Layer potatoes onions cabbage then Polish sausage. Add another layer of everything but end with cabbage this time. Salt and pepper as you later. Cook on High in microwave 20 minutes. Let set 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix well. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven in well-greased and floured pans.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Salad
instructions: Clean spinach; chop coarsely and chill. Crumble bacon. Combine spinach lettuce and onion in salad bowl. Sprinkle with egg and bacon bits. Toss with dressing and serve.

title: Dreamy Creamy Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar in a large bowl until smooth and creamy. Add peanut butter and milk. Mix well. Add whipped topping. Mix well. Pour over pie crust. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Chicken Waldorf
instructions: In large bowl stir together mayonnaise mustard and brown sugar. Fold in cubed chicken apples celery walnuts and raisins; mix well. Apply lid and refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours.

title: Easy Tortilla Soup
instructions: In saucepot bring 3 cups water dry vegetable soup mix and mixed vegetables to boil. Reduce heat and simmer partially covered for 8 minutes more. Add diced tomatoes. Cook 2 minutes more. Stir in minced cilantro. Garnish with crushed tortilla chips sliced scallions and dollop of sour cream.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine oleo butter cream cheese and sugar. Beat well; add salt and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and mix well. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Place in a cold oven and set at 325\u00b0. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Cool in pan.

title: Divinity
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar corn syrup salt and 1.2 c. of water. Cook to hard boil stage (260 degrees) boiling about 20 minutes stirring until sugar dissolves. Meanwhile beat the egg whites until they form stiff peaks. Pour syrup over stiff egg whites beating at high speed with an electric mixer. Add vanilla and beat until the candy hold its shape. Spoon onto waxed paper. Makes 40 pieces.

title: Strawberry Truffle
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and chill. Add 12 ounce Cool Whip to pudding mixture after chilling. Layer starting with pudding mix angel food cake strawberries (frozen and fresh) and end with pudding mix. If not enough pudding mix top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and place on greased baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Sausage Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use enough chicken broth to make mixture juicy. Pour into baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Pecan Roll
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; mix with hands. Shape mixture into 5 (4 x 1-inch) rolls (mixture will be dry). Combine caramels and water; melt in microwave or double boiler. Dip rolls in melted caramels; roll each in pecans. Chill for at least 1 hour before cutting in slices.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Kabobs
instructions: In a saucepan cook carrots covered in a small amount of boiling water for 8 minutes; drain well. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Cut pineapple slices into quarters; set aside.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix crumbs with 2 tablespoons of butter. Whisk egg mayonnaise and soup. Then mix in broccoli onion and cheese. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cottage Lasagna(Scaled For 8 Servings)
instructions: Brown beef in skillet over medium heat tossing lightly with fork; drain off fat. Stir in spaghetti\tsauce tomato sauce tomato paste and Parmesan cheese.\tCover and simmer 10 minutes. Cook noodles; drain and rinse in cold water. In a 7 x 11 x 2-inch baking dish spread 1/3 of the sauce then 1/2 of the noodles 1/2 of the cottage cheese and 1/2 of the parsley. Repeat the last step. Cover with the remainder of the sauce. Cut the Mozzarella cheese into strips and arrange them on the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30\tminutes or until cheese melts and the sauce is bubbly.

title: Dr.  Pepper Glaze
instructions: Mix Dr. Pepper and brown sugar. Place ham in baking pan basting frequently with sauce. You can still use your cloves or cherries for decor.

title: Harvest Loaf Cake
instructions: Cream the butter with sugar. Mix in eggs and pumpkin. Sift flour with spices and salt. Add to first mixture. Stir in 1/2 cup of nuts and the chocolate chips. Pour into buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes.

title: Brown'S Corn Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon in pan until almost done. Add onions and celery and saute until lightly browned. Transfer to a cooking pot. Add cream-style corn kernel corn butter and broth. Add carrots and potatoes. Cook for about 15 minutes. Mix together flour and a little water to form a paste. Add milk and flour paste. You might want to add more flour paste depending on how thick you like your chowder. Simmer for 30 minutes or until you are ready to eat. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crab Chowder
instructions: Heat clam juice sherry brandy shallots garlic parsley stems and bay leaves in large saucepan over high heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; simmer uncovered 15 minutes skimming surface as necessary. Strain through sieve lined with double thickness of dampened cheesecloth; keep warm. Boil potatoes in lightly salted water until tender 5 to 8 minutes. Drain. Cook bacon in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat until fat is rendered and bacon is crisp. Add onions and celery; saute stirring frequently until tender. Add thyme saute 1 minute. Stir in flour; cook stirring constantly over low heat 5 minutes. Do not brown flour. Gradually stir clam broth into roux over low heat. Heat to boiling over high heat. Reduce heat to low; simmer uncovered 20 minutes skimming surface as needed. Stir in cream and potatoes; heat to boiling. Season to taste with salt if necessary and enough white pepper and red pepper sauce to give chowder a good peppery taste. Just before serving stir in crabmeat. Heat until crab is hot. Ladle chowder into warmed individual soup bowls and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind all vegetables together; add 1/2 cup salt. Let stand at least 4 hours then drain. Allow sugar and vinegar to come to a boil. Add spices and then the relish mixture. Boil on low heat 10 minutes. Jar and seal.

title: Pork Chops And Potatoes
instructions: Brown chops well on both sides. In 2-quart Pyrex layer potato rounds onion rings mushrooms and mushroom soup. Repeat another layer of each ingredient. Add about 1/4 of a soup can of water to mixture. Place chops on top of potato mixture and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until chops are completely cooked. Season to taste.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix ingredients. Fill cup almost half full with mix and add very hot or boiling water.

title: Chicken Chianti
instructions: Remove and discard visible fat from chicken. Cut meat into 1 1/2-inch cubes and reserve. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and saute until lightly browned. Remove with slotted spoon and set aside.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Combine the graham cracker crumbs\t1 stick melted margarine and 4 tablespoons confectioners sugar. Shape in bottom of a large flat dish. Combine the 2 cups confectioners sugar eggs and 2 sticks margarine and cream together. Spread over graham cracker mixture. Cut bananas and put over cream mixture. Put crushed pineapple over bananas. Top with Cool Whip and decorate with nuts and cherries.

title: Chocolate Cheese Cake
instructions: In large bowl combine cream cheese and sugar; beat well. Blend in cocoa. Add eggs and vanilla; blend well. Blend in whipped cream. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes; cool to room temperature. Cover and chill for several hours. Top with cherry pie filling before serving.

title: Classic Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Prepare and cook dry fettuccine in large pot of boiling salted water 6 to 8 minutes just until al dente (tender yet firm to taste); remove from heat. Drain well; return to dry pot. Place butter and cream in large heavy skillet over medium-low heat. Cook and stir until butter melts and mixture bubbles. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Stir in salt pepper and nutmeg. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in cheese until thoroughly blended and smooth. Return briefly to heat to completely blend cheese if necessary. (Do not let sauce bubble or cheese will become lumpy and tough.)

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix pineapple cheese sugar and flour; pour into casserole dish. Spread crushed crackers on mixture; pour melted butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Chocolate Pie
instructions: Prepare instant pudding as directed on package using only 1 cup milk. Blend in 1 1/2 cups thawed Cool Whip and 1/4 cup chopped nuts. Spoon into a cooled baked pie shell. Garnish with 1/2 cup Cool Whip. Sprinkle with additional nuts if desired. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Cook pork and beef in water until fork-tender; shred. Add catsup pickle relish Worcestershire and paprika to meat. Add just enough broth to desired consistency. Makes 24 servings.

title: Treasured Macadamia Wreath Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Fill cookie press using smallest star plate. Shape into wreaths on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 10 minutes watching closely so cookie will not be too brown. When cool you may wish to ice them with Confectioners Sugar Icing and decorate with red hots for holly berries. Makes about 180 wreaths.

title: Golden Capped Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half. Place cut side up in a shallow baking dish. Add salt and pepper. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread a portion on top of each tomato. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix and sift together first 5 ingredients. Add milk egg and shortening. Bake in shallow buttered 8 x 8-inch pan at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Can bake in muffin pan if desired.

title: Turkey Sopa
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and celery in oil. Stir in soup tomatoes and milk. Mix well. Stir in turkey. Layer turkey mixture tortillas and cheese in a greased casserole dish. Begin with the turkey mixture and end with it. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into an unbaked crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Cheese
instructions: In a shallow 1-pint casserole combine Brussels sprouts bouillon nutmeg and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Cook franks until fully cooked. In deep fryer add mixture of remaining ingredients and fry until golden brown. If mixture is too thick to dip add water.

title: Simple Breakfast
instructions: Line pan with English muffins. Mix eggs and sour cream; pour over muffins. Put cooked sausage on top of eggs. Put Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Fig Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and whip until light and fluffy. Add oil. Stir baking soda into buttermilk. Alternately add flour and buttermilk mixture into batter. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until tests done.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar milk salt syrup and water. Cook in iron skillet for best results until mixture forms soft ball in cold water. Remove from fire and add peanut butter. Stir until creamy and loses glazed look. Pour into lightly greased square cake tin. When almost cold cut in squares of 1 inch.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. In bowl beat cream cheese; stir in vanilla oranges pineapple soda and nuts. Let it set. Then stir in Cool Whip. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. To serve Cut in squares and place whipped cream on top.

title: Cream Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell in moderately slow oven (325\u00b0) for 20 minutes or until firm and delicately browned.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Add water to raisins. Boil for 5 minutes. Cool. Cream shortening with sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add vanilla and cooled raisin mixture. Add nuts. Sift together flour baking powder soda salt cinnamon nutmeg and allspice. Add to raisin mixture and blend. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 60.

title: Easy Pickled Beets
instructions: Drain beets then put them in a glass jar. Bring to boil sugar and vinegar stir and add this mixture to jar. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple-Almond Coffeecakes
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 tsp. sugar in warm water in large bowl. Let stand 5 minutes or until mixture is bubbly. (If yeast does not bubble it is no longer active and dough will not rise.)

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Clean broccoli; cut in 1/2-inch pieces. Steam broccoli in 1/2 cup water until tender. Do not drain; set aside.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach in microwave and drain. Add eggs.

title: Egg Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Separate dough into 4 rectangles. Place 2 rectangles in ungreased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Press over bottom and 1/2-inch up sides to form crust. Place cheese and bacon in bottom of pan. Beat eggs and milk. Pour over bacon and cheese. Separate remaining dough and arrange in triangles over egg mixture. Do not seal. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and filling is set.

title: Marbled Haupia
instructions: Cook haupia as directed on the back of the coconut milk can (uses cornstarch salt sugar and water). Add vanilla after haupia is cooked. Take out 1 cup of cooked haupia and stir chocolate into it (more for extra dark chocolate). Pour remaining haupia in a pan. Drizzle chocolate mixture over poured pan of white haupia. Pull a knife zigzag through the haupia to marbleize the chocolate. Refrigerate to set.

title: Mile High Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder cream of tartar and salt in bowl. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Stir in egg and milk mixing to form soft dough. Knead lightly on floured surface. Roll to 3/4 inch thickness. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Yields 12 biscuits.

title: Himmel Torte
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar mixing well. Add flour and baking powder. Add dates and nuts. Mix gently. Pour into greased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. When cool break into pieces. Mix in drained pineapple. Add whipped cream atop. Serve in sherbet glasses.

title: Mississippi Mud
instructions: Cream oleo eggs and sugar. Add flour cocoa vanilla and nuts or coconut. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and spread 1 jar marshmallow cream over top. Cool and frost.

title: 7-Minute Frosting
instructions: Put all ingredients except flavoring in top of double boiler and cook for 7 minutes. Add flavoring.

title: Pumpkin Crumble Cake
instructions: Mix all together and\tspread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: An herb-seasoned spread in the pan crust filled with a hearty chicken and vegetable mixture.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Mix and form into fingers or balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Roll in 4x sugar.

title: Stuffed Quail Breast
instructions: Marinate quail breast overnight in Italian dressing. Split breast on both sides of bone; stuff with the jalapeno pepper slices. Drizzle mixture of melted butter and picante sauce over each breast. Wrap 1 slice bacon around each quail; secure with toothpick. Wrap in heavy foil. Bake for approximately 2 hours at 300\u00b0. Best results when put on smoker or pit for 2 hours.

title: Vegetable Roll-Ups
instructions: In a small bowl combine cream cheese dill and garlic powder. Blend well. Spread about 1 tablespoon mixture on each tortilla. Top each with carrot broccoli and onions. Roll up each tortilla and cut in half.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add corn meal and softened margarine. Beat together. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Add salt and pepper. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs flour and add milk and vanilla.\tDivide batter into equal parts. Cook 2 plain layers. Into the\tother half put raisins nuts and spices. Stir well.\tBake 2 more layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Put together with Filling.

title: Baked Eggs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan or dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Can be made ahead put in a pan covered with heavy foil and refrigerated up to 24 hours then reheated to serve. Makes 12 servings.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Combine butter flour and sugar together. Beat egg; add milk. Add to creamed mixture. Cook in top of double boiler until thickened stirring constantly. Cool; add vanilla. Pour into baked pastry shell and chill. Makes one (9-inch) pie; spread with whipped topping.

title: Very Rocky Road Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: A grandmother is a lady who has no children of her own so she likes other peoples girls and boys. A grandfather is a man grandmother. He goes for walks with the boys and they talk about fishing and tractors and like that. Grandmothers dont have anything to do but be there.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan melt 1/4 cup butter. Stir in flour; cook until smooth 1 minute. Stir in milk cream cheese salt pepper and mustard; cook until thick 3 to 4 minutes. Add Cheddar cheese and mix. Add elbow macaroni. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Mix bread crumbs and melted butter; sprinkle over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Italian Cheese Pie(Pastera)
instructions: Mix well into Ricotta all ingredients. Turn into pie crust. Top with lattice effect. Sprinkle with nonpareils. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3/4 to 1 hour.

title: Sourdough Basic Starter With Yeast
instructions: After feeding wait 3 to 4 days before using.

title: Lite Fruit Salad
instructions: Stir preserves first for easier mixing. Drain all canned fruits. Add pineapple apple diced peaches halved cherries marshmallows and pecans to apricot preserves then fold in gently the mandarin orange slices. Oranges will break up easily. Refrigerate. Make up early in the day for softer marshmallows.

title: Spinach-Orange Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the oil marjoram pepper and nutmeg. Add the orange sections radishes and green onion; toss well. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours tossing occasionally. Wash the spinach. Pat it dry with paper towels and tear it into bite size pieces. Just before serving add the spinach and vinegar to the chilled ingredients. Toss well.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Brown sausage. Wash zucchini; cut off ends. Do not peel. Cook in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Halve lengthwise and remove pulp with spoon. Combine pulp bread crumbs sausage cheese onion parsley salt pepper and eggs. Fill zucchini shells and top with sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Winter Squash Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease muffin tins with a small amount of oil or use paper liners. Measure and sift flours baking powder salt sugar and spices into a large bowl. Stir in corn meal or wheat germ.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Drain. Layer half of Tater Tots in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Put meat mixture on top of the Tater Tots. Mix soups together and spoon on top of the meat. Top with the rest of the meat. Top with the rest of the Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake for 5 more minutes or until cheese has melted. A great dish to bring to a dish supper. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Save 1 cup of broth. Cut up chicken in bite size pieces; set aside. Crumble up cornbread fine; pour melted margarine over cornbread. Set aside. To meat add 1 cup of broth soups and sage; mix well. Mix all with cornbread. Put in baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Bud'S Rum Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Preheat oven to setting as directed on the cake mix box. In a mixing bowl blend together cake mix nuts raisins and vanilla. Substitute one-half the liquid required in the cake mix with rum. Bake the cake according to package directions. Set aside to cool. When cool remove cake from Bundt pan and place on a plate. At this time additional rum can be sprinkled on the cake for more flavor. Prepare a glaze in a pot atop the stove consisting of the butter sugar and 1/2 cup rum. Heat and stir until smooth. Be careful as the rum may catch fire! Spoon the glaze mixture over the cake. The cake is best served chilled.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and Crisco well. Add eggs one at a time beat after each egg. Add sugar beat well. Add flour and flavorings. Pour into tube pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees then turn oven to 325 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Meltaway Monkey Rolls
instructions: Thaw bread dough. Pull apart loaf of bread into walnut size chunks. Place in generously buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar cinnamon and dry pudding. Pour butter and milk over top. Pull apart second loaf of bread and arrange evenly on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Toss together and set aside the sugar blueberries and flour. Mix all ingredients together except egg whites and blueberries. Add egg whites and mix again. Then stir in blueberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine milk sugar biscuit mix eggs butter and vanilla in electric blender. Cover and blend for 3 minutes.

title: Pecan Rolls
instructions: Place pecans in greased pan. Place rolls on top of pecans; let rise overnight. Next morning cook butterscotch pudding. Add butter brown sugar and cinnamon. Bring to boil over low heat. Pour mixture over rolls. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dark Fudge Cookies(Godiva Chocolates Developed This Recipe)
instructions: In a double boiler or microwave melt chocolate over low heat; cool for 10 minutes. In large bowl cream sugar butter and eggs until smooth. Beat in the cooled chocolate until well blended. Gradually add the flour and salt; mix until smooth. Stir in nuts. Cover and chill until firm about 1 hour.

title: Frozen Suckers
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid Jell-O sugar and hot water. Then add cold water; stir until all is dissolved. Pour into molds or ice trays. Chill until frozen.

title: Homemade Canned Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Boil for 2 hours. Add 3 cups of sugar and cook 15 minutes more. Put in hot jars.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Brown sausage; drain and crumble. Set aside. Place crescent rolls in bottom of pan. Place sausage on dough and cover with hash browns. Pour blended eggs with salt and pepper to taste over potatoes. Top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Frosting
instructions: Mix well. Bring to a boil and cook for only 2 1/2 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and beat until thick.

title: Chili Chicken
instructions: Heat tomatoes and chilies soups and Velveeta cheese until cheese is melted. Add cubed chicken to cheese mixture. In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer chicken and cheese mixture layer of onion and layer of crushed Doritos. Repeat layers ending with a layer of chicken and cheese mixture. Heat at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbly. Can be put together the day before and heated the next day.

title: Italian Chicken And Potatoes
instructions: Place chicken and potatoes on cookie sheet. Add oil on top. Sprinkle garlic powder or garlic on top. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until potatoes are golden brown about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Sprinkle with Romano cheese and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Val'S Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in large deep bowl in the order listed. Stir before serving.

title: Black Forest Trifle
instructions: In a large saucepan slowly heat 4 cups milk with the chocolate just until bubbles form around edge of pan. In a small bowl combine cornstarch sugar salt and remaining milk; mix well. Gradually stir cornstarch mixture into hot milk; bring to boiling stirring. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Spoon one-third of the chocolate pudding into a 2-quart bowl or souffle dish. Top with one-third of the crumbs. Set aside 1/2 cup cherry filling. Gently spoon half of remaining cherry filling onto crumbs.

title: 80 Calorie Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce onion and peas. Spread mayonnaise. Layer cheese; sprinkle Bac*Os. Refrigerate overnight to marinate. Keeps several days.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Boil 2 bouillon cubes in 2 cups water. Add broccoli and cook 15 minutes. Saute onions and/or mushrooms in margarine. Mix flour into cold milk and evaporated milk. Cook with sauteed mix until thick. Add sliced Velveeta cheese. Stir until melts. Add broccoli. Stir on low heat until thick (about 20 minutes).

title: Sour Cream Pecan Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan. Cream margarine and 2 1/4 cups sugar until light; add egg yolks one at a time beating well. Add vanilla lemon and almond extracts. Stir together flour and baking soda then add to batter mixture alternately with sour cream. Mix well; stir in pecans. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; add 1/2 cup sugar and fold egg whites into batter. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cool Whip And Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and soft cream cheese; add sugar and blend thoroughly to dissolve sugar. Add chocolate syrup. Shred candy bar with paring knife over the pie.

title: Pineapple Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Separate dough into two long rectangles. Place these rectangles with long sides together and press the edges and perforations to seal. Roll to a rectangle about 10x15 inch. Combine the pineapple spread with the spices. Mix well. Spread on the dough and roll up jelly-roll fashion starting with the 15 inch side. Cut into 1 inch thick slices. Place cut side down on baking sheet. Flatten slightly with the fingertips. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until the rolls are lightly browned. Remove the rolls from the baking sheet and place on a rack to cool slightly. Place rolls in a large shallow serving dish. Pour the pineapple butter sauce over the rolls.

title: Chocolate Sunday Cake
instructions: Combine brown sugar cocoa and water. Mix well. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Place marshmallows evenly on top. Make cake batter following package directions. Pour into pan. Top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Cut into bars or squares to serve.

title: Williamsburg Tea Bread
instructions: Set oven at 300\u00b0. Beat eggs and sugar together until creamy. Add flour salt and baking powder. Stir in dates nuts and vanilla by hand. Spoon into greased 9 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/4-inch loaf pan. Cover with foil and bake on middle shelf for 1 1/2 hours. Increase heat to 325\u00b0 remove foil and bake another 15 to 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into middle of the cake. Turn out and cool completely before slicing.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Boil frozen chopped spinach and drain water. Squeeze excess water out of spinach after cooled. Combine leek soup mix sour cream mayonnaise and green onion tops. Add cooled spinach to mixture and refrigerate. Cut top of round loaf of bread and hollow out making a bread bowl. Cut up pieces of bread for dipping. When ready to serve place dip mixture in bread bowl and serve.

title: Cinnamon Munch
instructions: Combine sugar and cinnamon; set aside. Melt margarine in a large skillet. Add Chex. Heat and stir gently until all pieces are coated. Continue to heat and stir 5 to 6 minutes. Sprinkle half the cinnamon/sugar mixture evenly over Chex; stir well. Sprinkle remaining mixture. Heat and stir 1 minute longer. Spread on absorbent paper towel to cool.

title: German Bread
instructions: Set aside yeast 1 teaspoon sugar and warm water. Heat milk salt and sugar. Add milk mixture eggs and yeast mixture to 3 cups flour. Mix well. Add anise seed and the rest of the flour slowly mixing by hand to form a stiff dough.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to package directions. Bake in tube pan. Mix together coconut sour cream and sugar. When cake is baked punch at least 100 holes in the hot cake. Pour coconut mixture immediately over hot cake. Let stand about 8 hours then remove from pan.

title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and cook until comes to a boil. Let boil until a piece comes to a small ball in a cup of water. Mix in oats and peanut butter. Drop on greased waxed paper or foil.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese with egg yolks until smooth. Add milk. Mix well. Add lemon juice and rinds. Stir until thickened. Pour into crust.

title: Mud Puddles
instructions: Prepare or buy your favorite chocolate chip cookie dough.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening sugar eggs milk and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Drop onto greased cookie sheet and press with glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix ingredients. Pour into pie shell and bake for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and continue baking until golden brown about 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: In a small saucepan heat 2 tablespoons butter. Add flour. Cook 1 minute. Stir in milk. Cook until mixture boils and thickens. Cool slightly. Heat oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Apple Pear Honey
instructions: Cook approximately 30 minutes until it changes color. Place in clean jars and seal.

title: My Chili
instructions: Cut or chop stew beef into 1/4-inch cubes. Mix with chopped onion and green pepper. Add garlic and olive oil; brown in skillet. Add balance of ingredients except kidney beans in slow cooker along with meat and simmer for 4 hours. Add kidney beans and simmer additional 2 hours. Serve.

title: Peanut Butter Toast
instructions: Toast bread in toaster. As soon as it pops up spread peanut butter on one side of each slice. The peanut butter will melt slightly on the warm toast. Cut it diagonally. Great as a breakfast food or a snack.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil pasta according to package directions. Rinse and chill.

title: Picnic Pasta
instructions: Cook drain and cool pasta. Add remaining ingredients; toss and chill. At serving time toss again.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Dip chicken pieces in melted margarine. Arrange on top of mixture of rice\twater and soups in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or longer. Cover dish.

title: Taco Pinwheels
instructions: Mix ingredients together (except tortillas). Spread mixture onto tortillas. Refrigerate individual rolls in saran wrap. Slice and serve.

title: Hot And Hearty Ham Cheesers
instructions: Grind ham and then cheese. Mix together in a bowl. In another bowl mix margarine chives parsley dry mustard and garlic. Spread butter mixture on soft rolls (either side). Place one scoop of ham and cheese mixture on the bun and wrap in foil. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Yellow Peppers
instructions: Pack jars full with peppers. Boil water. Fill jars to brim cap and turn over for 24 hours then store for eating.

title: Pineapple Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Beat eggs oil buttermilk and vanilla; add to dry ingredients. Blend well. Add the rest of ingredients. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from oven. With fork poke holes in top to cover surface. Immediately spread with hot Buttermilk Glaze or Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute cubes of meat in butter along with the onions then add soup. Simmer for 1 hour then add mushrooms and garlic salt. Simmer 30 minutes longer. Take off heat and stir in sour cream. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix cream sugar and butter. Bring to a boil and let boil 10 minutes. After boiling point is reached add Karo. Boil until it forms soft ball in water. Add vanilla; stir until creamy. Add nuts and cherries. Pour into greased pan.

title: Cookie Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour melted butter in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over melted butter. Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Sprinkle chocolate chips coconut and nuts evenly over mixture; press down firmly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown. Allow to cool before cutting into squares. Makes 30 squares.

title: Dixon'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix commercial sauce with tomato catsup in a 1 to 1 ratio. Add brown sugar. Add the sweet pickle juice to thin (replaces vinegar the pickle juice is the secret ingredient). Heat the sauce preparation to boil. Excellent for pork ribs chicken chops or beef.

title: Sloppy Joe
instructions: Brown the ground beef celery onion and green pepper. Add remaining ingredients and bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Speedy Beef Casserole For One
instructions: In skillet cook meat onion and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender; drain. Stir in Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. In saucepan combine meat mixture tomato sauce rice and chili powder. Cook over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly stirring occasionally. Stir in half of the cheese until melted. Spoon onto a plate. Top with remaining shredded cheese.

title: Yayi'S Chicken
instructions: Blend butter and flour; add broth and milk. Cook stirring constantly over low heat & sauce is thick. Saute onion in a little butter add rest of ingredients to sauce. Add sherry (optional). Serve in pasta shells.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: In bowl combine flour sugar baking soda baking powder and cinnamon. Add carrot oil and eggs. Beat with an electric mixer until combined.

title: Sweet Pickles Recipe(1960)
instructions: Soak cucumbers in brine that will float an egg for 5 days. 2 cups of salt to 1 gallon of water. Then drain and put into a clean churn or earthenware large jars and sprinkle over the top one tablespoonful of powdered alum to each gallon of cucumbers; cover with boiling water. Let stand for 24 hours then drain and reheat the solution and pour back on them for 24 hours. Split the cucumbers as desired and cover with syrup.

title: Fabulous Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar milk marshmallow cream margarine and salt in a heavy 2-quart saucepan. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat to a boil (when mixture is bubbling all over top). Boil and stir 5 minutes more. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate pieces until completely dissolved. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan. Makes 30 pieces.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender in water; cool. Then puree broccoli and cooking water in blender. Melt margarine. Saute onion in it until transparent. Blend flour into margarine and onion mixture; cook until foamy. Stir in milk. Gradually bring to a boil stirring constantly.

title: Butterscotch Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed about 2 minutes or until soft. Slowly add sugar and beat about 7 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating until yellow disappears. Gradually add flour until blended. Add flavorings pecans and morsels. Spoon batter into a greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool a little. Pour the topping over cake while warm.

title: Dirt Cups
instructions: Crush cookies in food processor or plastic bag with rolling pin. Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in whipped topping and half of crushed cookies. Place 1 tablespoon crushed cookies in each cup. Fill cups about 3/4 full with pudding mixture. Top with remaining crushed cookies. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Decorate with gummy worms frogs or your favorites.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: White wine may be substituted for milk.

title: Mississippi Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Bake in a 9-inch square baking pan or a 12-inch cast-iron skillet. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 35 minutes.

title: Raisin Spice Cake
instructions: Put in a pan sugar shortening water raisins and spices; boil for 5 minutes. Cool\tthen add flour salt soda and baking powder. Bake in loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs several minutes. Beat in sugar one cup at a time. Add vanilla and evaporated milk and pour in 4-quart freezer container. Either add fresh milk to full line in freezer container or add sweetened fresh fruit reducing sugar in ice cream mixture by 1/2 to 1 cup depending on taste desired. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cherry Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Combine rhubarb sugar and pie filling. Boil for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter and gelatin; mix good. Put in jars and seal.

title: Cappucino
instructions: Combine and heat first 7 ingredients. Serve with a cinnamon stick in each cup and top with Cool Whip. Makes 8 cups.

title: Stroganoff Sandwich
instructions: Cut loaf of bread lengthwise; wrap in foil and heat at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. In a skillet cook beef with onion until brown. Drain stir in sour cream milk Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder. Add 3/4 teaspoon salt. Heat but do not boil. Remove bread from oven. Scoop out some of the middle pour meat mixture into bread. Top with shredded cheese then heat until cheese is melted. Once out of oven add tomato and green pepper rings. Slice and serve while still warm.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour cream of tartar soda and salt. Set aside. In a large bowl with electric mixer beat shortening until fluffy. Gradually beat in 1 1/2 cups sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually beat in flour mixture.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients. Beat eggs sugar and oil. Add other ingredients and mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 large loaves or 3 small loaves.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix cornmeal and boiling water. Cool to lukewarm. Add yolks of eggs well beaten with milk salt and baking powder. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in greased 2-quart baking dish at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Puree
instructions: Wash and hull fresh berries. In a blender or food processor puree the berries; add almond extract and vanilla. Sweeten with sugar.

title: Onion Rice
instructions: Cook onion in margarine until soft. Add broth and bring to boil. Add rice. Reduce heat to low. Cook covered for about 25 minutes or until rice is soft and relatively dry. Add freshly ground black pepper to taste.

title: Bread Bowl With Dip
instructions: Hollow out bread; save bread.

title: Kentucky Spoon Bread
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Bake in 9 x 9-inch casserole at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden.

title: Chili Pizza
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in seasoning mix and tomatoes. Cook 5 to 10 minutes. Arrange tortillas in a circle on a 12-inch pizza pan; overlap edges where needed. Spoon ground beef mixture onto tortillas. Top with cheese and olives. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes one 12-inch pizza.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Cream together first 6 ingredients. Mix together the flour soda and cream of tartar. Add to cream mixture with the vanilla. Roll into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0F. for a minute or two until lightly browned. They will be chewy.

title: Party Potato Skins
instructions: Scrub potatoes and rub skins with oil. Prick each potato several times with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until done. Allow to cool to touch. Cut top third off each potato. Discard tops. Carefully scoop out pulp leaving about 1/8-inch thick shells. (Pulp can be used for mashed potatoes.) Fry potato skins in 375\u00b0 oil for 3 to 4 minutes or until brown. Drain on paper towels. Place skins cut side up on ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with garlic salt and cheese. Broil 6 inches from heat for 30 seconds or until cheese melts. Top skins with bacon and 1 tablespoon of chives. Press green chiles between paper towels to remove excess moisture. Combine chiles sour cream and red pepper in a small bowl. Stir well. Top with remaining tablespoon of chives. Serve with potato skins. Yields 8 servings.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving size pieces; coat in flour. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. In a skillet or Dutch oven brown meat on both sides in oil. Top with the onions and celery. Combine tomatoes Worcestershire sauce and oregano; spoon over vegetables. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Serve over noodles if desired. Or even rice. Can also use venison for beef.

title: Almond Arfa
instructions: Melt almond bark and mix in peanut butter. When smooth stir in Rice Krispies peanuts and marshmallows. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and let set up.

title: Steak Diane
instructions: Trim fat from steak and cut into moderate size pieces. Melt the butter over low heat and saute the garlic. Coat the steak pieces with Worcestershire sauce and place in the frying pan. Add the lemon juice and pepper. Turn when brown then simmer until done.

title: Honey-Pecan Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender; drain. Peel and cut into quarters. Place quartered potatoes in a greased shallow casserole dish. In a small saucepan combine honey brown sugar salt and butter. Bring mixture to a boil stirring constantly. Pour syrup over sweet potatoes. Sprinkle chopped pecans on top. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake sweet potatoes for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Stir-fry chicken for 2 minutes. Add peppers onions and cilantro; stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until chicken is done. Remove from heat and stir in beans. In medium bowl combine enchilada and tomato sauce blend well. Spoon 2 tablespoons of sauce into bottom of baking dish; reserve remaining sauce. Spoon 1/2 cup chicken filling down center of each tortilla roll up. Place seam side down in baking dish. Pour remaining sauce on enchiladas. Cover. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve with yogurt.

title: Dressing Bread
instructions: Bake about 20 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Banana Bread
