instructions: Cream all ingredients together. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 or longer if not done when checked.

title: Favorite Apple Crisp
instructions: Butter a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Peel apples and slice. Sprinkle with cinnamon salt and water. Put flour sugar and butter together; mash with a fork. Drop over the apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix all ingredients to make dough. Save 1 cup for top of cobbler. Pat dough into ungreased cookie sheet. Pour 1 large can pie filling on top of dough. Use 1 cup of dough to drop here and there on top of filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients and cook over low heat until thick. Put in baked pie shell. Cover with meringue and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Do not mix cake mix according to directions. Mix ingredients all together and bake. Cool then spread whipped cream on cake. On top of that spread 1 can cherry pie filling. Looks good and is good. Easy to make.

title: Cheese-Corn Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inches. Measure all ingredients in order listed into a bowl; stir just until flour is moistened. Batter will be lumpy. Spread evenly in pan. Bake 8-inch pan 45 minutes; 9-inch pan 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hot Cross Buns
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine milk shortening 1/3 cup sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Mix the 1 teaspoon sugar with the yeast that has been softened in lukewarm water and add to lukewarm milk mixture. Add egg raisins cinnamon allspice and as much sifted flour as can be stirred into the dough. Place in a greased bowl cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Knead and shape into 2-inch balls and arrange on a greased pan. Brush each bun with egg white cover and let rise until double in bulk. Snip in deep cross in the top of each with scissors. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from pan immediately. Cool on wire rack. When cool fill cross with powdered sugar frosting. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Zesty Chicken Cutlets With Apricot Sauce
instructions: In food processor or blender process apricots until smooth. Place in small saucepan. Simmer covered over low heat 8 to 10 minutes until reduced in volume by half. Stir occasionally.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix milk lemonade lemon juice food coloring and not quite half of Cool Whip. Put into a cooked crust. Put rest of Cool Whip on top of pie.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Drain. Add soup and milk together then combine with broccoli and stuffing. Put in casserole and bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes or until liquid has decreased to 1/2 cup. Cool. Cream shortening; add sugar and blend well. Add eggs one at a time to creamed mixture beating well after each addition. Add vanilla nuts and cooled raisin mixture. Add sifted dry ingredients and blend well. Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Party Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Mix together and place in buttered casserole dish. (I use a 9 x 13-inch pan.) Refrigerate until ready to bake. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Quick Meatballs
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix ground meat bread crumbs milk egg and seasonings thoroughly. Shape by tablespoon in 1 1/2-inch balls. Place on ungreased pan. Bake until done about 10 minutes. Now add the meatballs to your favorite recipe.

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oil and rub into steaks. Splash on olive oil. Coat all sides. Cover and refrigerate turning occasionally 6 to 8 hours or overnight. Grill as desired.

title: Easy Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook until 260\u00b0 for soft-crack stage. Pour over 2 quarts salted popcorn. Mix thoroughly and mold into balls.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter. Add eggs and beat. Add flour vanilla and melted chocolate and pour in a greased Pyrex plate. Bake 25 minutes at 300\u00b0. Serve topped with vanilla ice cream.

title: Low-Fat Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Saute onion garlic and oil until tender; stir in flour pepper and Tabasco sauce. Blend and add milk slowly and cook on medium heat until boiling. Add cheese and stir until smooth and add to macaroni and pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt. Beat eggs until lemon colored. Blend in dry ingredients. Add melted butter and milk; mix well. Pour into a pastry shell. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Allow to set before serving.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Unroll can of crescent rolls and place flat in a 9x13-inch Pyrex dish. Spread sausage over rolls and then pour eggs over sausage. Spread cheese evenly over top of eggs. Bake at 350 degrees until eggs are set 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add sugar and shortening to hot sweet potatoes. Combine potatoes with flour mixture. Roll or pat 3/4-inch thick. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Soda Cracker Chocolate Candy
instructions: Line a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with foil and coat with nonstick cooking spray. Place crackers in rows on foil.

title: Peanut Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate. Add peanut butter and mix well. Stir in Rice Crispies and marshmallows. Add peanuts. Mix well. Spoon by heaping spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Toffee Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package directions in a 9 x 13 pan. Cool on wire rack for 5 minutes. Make slits across the top of the cake making sure not to go through to the bottom.

title: Peanut Butter (Fudge) Critters
instructions: Mix all ingredients until it feels like dough. Press into pan. Cut into squares. Can make critters by breaking off pieces of dough and make dogs clowns bears hearts etc.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In a medium to large skillet heat butter and add onions red pepper and green pepper. Cook until slightly tender. Add rice; mix together. Lower heat and add water. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes. When done add chili powder mix and serve. Serves 4.

title: Fish Fillets Au Gratin(Niel'S And Oj'S Favorite Fish)
instructions: *Suggested Fish Pike trout halibut haddock cod red snapper sok or flounder.

title: Salmon Pie
instructions: Flake the salmon. Combine with crackers beaten eggs white sauce and seasonings. Turn into a baking dish. Top with the mashed potatoes. Bake in the oven (375\u00b0) about 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in dish. Mix rest of ingredients except fruit and pour over melted margarine. Pour fruit on top and sprinkle with brown sugar then place pats of margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Tuna Pate Pyramids
instructions: In large round bowl place layers of

title: Lasagna(World Famous!)
instructions: Brown hamburger slowly. Add next 5 ingredients. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Cook the noodles (according to package directions). Combine remaining ingredients together except Mozzarella cheese. Place half the noodles in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread half cottage cheese filling half Mozzarella cheese and half meat sauce. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Rice Krispies Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix cheese and oleo at room temperature. Mix thoroughly with flour and pepper. Add Rice Krispies. With hands easily roll into small balls and put onto cookie sheet. Press with a fork to make pattern on top of each cookie. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 275\u00b0. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Ballgame Mix
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Coat cereal in oil. Toss dry mix with cereal. Microwave on High for 5 minutes stirring once.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into a baking dish. Cover with bacon slices and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sherried Shrimp With Garlic
instructions: Thaw shrimp if frozen. Peel and devein leaving tails intact; set aside. In large skillet combine sherry orange juice red pepper strips olives parsley garlic capers tomato paste and black pepper. Bring to boiling. Add shrimp. Cook and stir for 1 to 3 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Remove from heat. Stir in olive oil. Serve with bread.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Heat oil in dutch oven. Add beef and brown on all sides starting on medium high and reducing to medium as it cooks. Add onion and garlic. Add water salt lemon juice sugar worcestershire sauce bay leaf and allspice. Simmer for 1 to 2 hours stirring occasionally. When almost done remove bay leaf and add veggies. Thicken with flour or cornstarch mixed with cold water.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple. Remove from heat and stir in dry jello mix. Let chill 10 to 15 minutes (dont let it congeal). Add buttermilk and Cool Whip. Stir and pour in 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cuts easily in lovely squares. Easy 10 calories and yummy!

title: Homemade Hamburger Helper(Beef Noodle)
instructions: In a large skillet cook ground hamburger meat with chopped onion. If a lot of grease is left over drain. Add cream of mushroom soup and stir while adding milk. Add brown gravy mix. Stir in cooked noodles. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Fresh Creamed Corn
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy skillet or pan. Add other ingredients and cook very low stirring constantly. May need to add more water as corn thickens. Cook and stir for about 30 to 40 minutes. Place in oven until brown.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Melt the chocolate and water together in a small pan. Stir in the vanilla flavoring and butter then the egg yolks 1 at a time. Beat the egg whites until stiff. Fold the chocolate mixture into the egg whites using a rubber spatula or a metal spoon. When thoroughly mixed pour into a glass bowl. Cover and chill overnight. Serve with whipped cream on top.

title: Easy Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O with boiling water as directed on Jell-O package. Add cold water. When Jell-O becomes slightly thickened add pineapple and carrots. Stir and refrigerate for 2 hours. This is easy healthy and it tastes good too!

title: Chile-Cheese Quesadillas With Salsa Cruda
instructions: To make 1 quesadilla spread 2 teaspoons Ricotta over tortilla. Sprinkle with heaping tablespoonful Monterey Jack cheese and 2 teaspoons diced chilies. Top with 1 tortilla. Repeat to make 2 more quesadillas.

title: Spring Tonic
instructions: Mix above and drink one glass each morning to improve energy.

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
instructions: Have sausage and cheese at room temperature. Combine and mix well. Add paprika and biscuit mix and mix well. Roll into small balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 100 sausage-cheese balls. May be baked and frozen for unexpected company.

title: Bacon-Potato Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon; saute onion and drain. Add potatoes and water; cook until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly. Do not boil. Add more milk if chowder becomes too thick. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crawfish Fettucini
instructions: Saute onion bell pepper and green onions in butter. Add half and half and cheese and melt on slow/low heat. Once melted add crawfish. Continue cooking for about 5 minutes. Place cooked fettucini in 3-quart casserole dish. Add crawfish mixture. Stir well. Bake in covered dish at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Savory Turkey Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In large bowl blend contents of sauce mix envelope and poultry seasoning. Stir in boiling water. Using wire whisk stir in soup. Add potato slices turkey carrots celery and onion; mix well. Spoon mixture into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 6.

title: Microwave Parched Peanuts
instructions: Put a thin to medium layer of peanuts in a microwaveable dish. Set heat on highest setting and run for about 2 minutes. Take out of microwave (use an oven mitt or small towel to keep from getting burned). Stir peanuts very good and put back and run for 1 more minute. Remove and stir again. Then run for 1 more minute. You can sample peanuts at various times and get the stage of parched peanuts you like best. You may want to run for extra time if desired. Peanuts will continue to cook some after removing from the microwave. Cooking time 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Morsels
instructions: Melt butterscotch in double boiler. Then stir in peanut and noodles. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper and let harden (about 45 minutes).

title: Spinach-Phyllo Triangleshouston, Texas
instructions: Drained thawed spinach well pressing between paper towels until barely moist. The drier the better. Saute onion in 2 Tbsp. butter in a skillet until tender. Add spinach Parmesan cheese and the 7 ingredients on the right hand list. Stir well.

title: Nanaimo Bars(Makes 16 Bars.)
instructions: Measure crumbs coconut and nuts into a bowl. Blend and reserve. Heat butter and 1/4 cup granulated sugar in small saucepan until butter is melted. Stir in cocoa. Mixture should be smooth and sugar dissolved. Blend in egg and vanilla mixing well. Combine mixture with crumb mixture. Turn into a lightly oiled 8-inch cake pan. Press firmly to make a smooth surface. Place in freezer while preparing next layer.

title: Minnie'S Baked Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Cook in water until they crack. Drain water and add onions sugar bacon and tomato juice in a large roaster. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 4 hours. If they become dry and beans are not tender add water and bake a little longer. Can be frozen. Makes a large roaster full.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream eggs and sugar. Add oil zucchini and vanilla. Then add sifted flour salt baking powder baking soda and spices. Mix all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in two loaf pans.

title: Quick And Easy Cobbler
instructions: Place stick of butter in a Pyrex bowl; melt in a 350\u00b0 oven. Mix sugar flour and milk in a mixing bowl. Pour into melted butter canned peaches. Pour other 3 ingredients over peaches and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until dough is done.

title: Gran'S Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Melt butter and set aside. Grate lemon rind lightly on tiny side of grater. Squeeze juice from lemon. Beat eggs until light. Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned and doesnt shake.

title: Pink Stuff(Or Whatever Color You Like)
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail. Mix all ingredients together and chill until it sets.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar water and cream of tartar in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add crackers and boil for 2 minutes; stir constantly. Cool. Pour cooled mixture into unbaked pie crust and sprinkle top with cinnamon and butter pats. Bake at 350\u00b0 until pie crust browns.

title: Date Loaf Candy
instructions: Stir sugar salt cream syrup and butter. When it first boils put in dates. When nearly done put in pecans. When done take from stove. Let cook then beat until stiff. Roll in wet cloth.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Let pickles stand 1 hour or longer. Then drain.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix cold water and cornstarch to a thin paste. Combine hot water with sugar until sugar is dissolved. Add cornstarch mixture and bring to boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Stir a small amount into slightly beaten egg yolks. Combine with remaining mixture and cook for while longer. Add lemon rind and juice and butter; blend well (until butter has melted). Pour into baked pie shells. Top with meringue. Place in 325\u00b0 oven until meringue is browned.

title: Meat Loaf Dinner
instructions: Preheat oven 375\u00b0. Mix up all ingredients and cook about 45 minutes. Cut the middle and if it is grey it is done.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Put pineapple juice in 2-cup measuring cup. Fill up to top with orange juice. Add 2 tablespoons sugar. Mix a small amount of juice with 2 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch. Bring the rest of the juice to a boil and slowly add cornstarch mix. Cook until thick. Remove from heat and add 1 tablespoon butter. Cool then add to apples and nuts. Mix.

title: Sour Cream Yeast Dough
instructions: Heat sour cream over low heat until lukewarm. In large bowl dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sour cream butter sugar eggs and 2 cups flour; beat until smooth and stir in remaining flour until cleaves to the bowl. Knead on well-floured board until smooth (about 10 minutes). Place in greased bowl turn once to bring greased side up cover and let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) until double about 1 hour.

title: 2 - 2 Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Marinade
instructions: Mix together. Place in bowl or Ziploc bag with chicken for 40 to 45 minutes. Grill or broil.

title: Scalloped Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling salted water until crisp-tender. Saute onion in margarine. Combine with carrots soup salt pepper and cheese. Put in baking dish. Top with croutons tossed with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Cover and blend until smooth about 30 to 45 seconds. Serve immediately.

title: Kathleen'S Strawberry Angel Jello
instructions: Make angel food cake according to directions and tear into small pieces. Make jello according to package directions; chill until firm. Whip jello and blend in Cool Whip. Add strawberries and fold in angel food cake pieces. Chill until set.

title: Buttermilk Jello Salad
instructions: Mix in saucepan jello sugar and pineapple. Boil 2 minutes. Cool and add buttermilk and Cool Whip. Mix well and let set in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Can be made with other flavors of jello. Garnish top with few chopped pecans or chopped maraschino cherries if desired.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 about 2 hours. After first hour cover with glaze.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in pan. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over margarine. Pour condensed milk over this. Add chocolate morsels pecans and coconut. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until light brown.

title: Tn Pudding Cake With Orange Topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flour soda and buttermilk to creamed mixture. Blend pecans dates and coconut. Pour in tube pan and bake 1 1/2 hours. As soon as cake is done make slits in top with knife to bottom of cake. Pour Orange Topping over cake.

title: Taco Chip Dip
instructions: Beat together cream cheese and dip. Spread into the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Fry ground beef and drain. Add taco seasoning and prepare according to directions on package. Put meat mixture on top of cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with Tostitos chips.

title: Beef Garden Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Place butter in casserole dish and melt. Add all ingredients except biscuits and mix well. Top with biscuits and place in a 400\u00b0 heated oven. Bake until mixture bubbles and biscuits are browned.

title: Wonderful Pie Crust(No Big Deal...)
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour and salt. Sprinkle in cold orange juice and \stir\ only until dough leaves sides of bowl. The secret is do not handle the dough very much. Divide dough into two equal parts and roll out one at a time on well floured area. Place in pie plate and flute poke holes in it and bake for your one crust pies. Bake at 425\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Aunt Judy'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt butter and mix in flour. Add remaining ingredients except vanilla and pecans and mix well. When all mixed add vanilla and pecans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes one 8-inch pie.

title: Microwaved Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients with milk being added last. Microwave on High for 8 minutes.

title: Delightful Ham Rolls
instructions: *May use finely minced onions instead of garlic.

title: Shrimp In The Pink
instructions: In large skillet heat oil margarine and garlic powder and cook shrimp over medium-high heat stirring constantly until shrimp turns pink. Remove and set aside. Add water and milk; bring to boiling. Stir in noodles and sauce; reduce heat and simmer stirring occasionally 8 minutes or until noodles are tender. Stir in shrimp and green onions. Heat through. Makes about 2 servings.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Put eggs in a large saucepan with enough water to cover 1/4 to 1/2 inch above eggs. Bring to a boil. Set timer for 10 minutes drain. Run cold water over eggs to cool. Peel and slice eggs lengthwise. Separate yolks. Mix yolks mustard and mayonnaise. Stuff into whites with spoon and fork. Garnish with paprika.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and paprika. Place in buttered casserole dish. Top with grated cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Heat crushed pineapple just to boil. Stir in 6 ounce box of apricot jello. Add sugar. Blend well. Let cool until partially set. Add softened cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate.

title: Noodle Salad
instructions: Cook and cool noodles. Mix vegetable oil vinegar sugar Accent salt and pepper. Pour mixture over slaw noodles almonds onions green pepper and sunflower kernels. Let stand in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Serve cold.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Blend the first 4 ingredients with wire whisk. Tear or cube bread into 8-inch round baking dish. Add sweets. Pour custard over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until near set in center. Serve warm or cold.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Top with 1 can Comstock blueberry pie filling. Refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares.

title: Frozen Pops
instructions: Dissolve jello Kool-Aid and sugar in boiling water. Add cold water. Pour into ice cube trays small paper cups or popsicle molds. Freeze until firm 2 to 3 hours. Makes 20 to 24.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Spread over salad and top with chopped nuts.

title: Teriyaki Steak
instructions: Freeze steak for 1 hour. Slice thin cross grain. Combine remaining ingredients in shallow dish. Add steak slices. Marinate for 1/2 hour. Place on broiler rack. Broil 4-inches from heat. Cook for 7 to 9 minutes or until brown turning to other side. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in dry sealed container. Use 3 heaping teaspoons to each cup of hot water.

title: Cheese Fondue
instructions: Divide bread into thirds. Butter baking dish. Layer 1/3 bread 1/2 cheese repeat with bread on top. Add eggs to milk and salt. Pour over bread and cheese mixture. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Before baking pour melted butter over top. Set casserole in pan of hot water. Bake at 325\u00b0 uncovered. When brown and crusty put on cover and continue to bake for 45 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all but last ingredient. I put it in a plastic Ziploc bag (make sure it is locked) and freeze. Take out of freezer a couple of hours before serving put into your punch bowl and add the ginger ale.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onions until tender. Drain. Mix in rest of ingredients except for bread crumbs. Place in greased baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Inside Outside Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Add 1 box pistachio pudding and mix. Pour into Bundt pan. Bake cool and cut cake into 3 layers.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except almonds and corn flakes. Turn into buttered casserole dish. Top with flakes and almonds and bake in 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: In a skillet brown meat. Drain off fat. Stir in pizza sauce mushrooms and olives. Simmer ingredients while you cook macaroni. Drain macaroni and add 2/3 cup milk.

title: Oatmeal Banana Bread
instructions: Combine first three ingredients and set aside. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in bananas and milk. Add dry ingredients all at once stirring just until all are moistened. Turn into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until done. Remove from pan and cool.

title: Crock-Pot Soup
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Place in crock-pot. Add in layers the Ranch Style beans minestrone soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Add water and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer in crock-pot.

title: Abby'S Favorite Caramel Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Cut 1 loaf of bread into small pieces (about 1/2-inch squares); place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix pudding mix brown sugar melted margarine milk and cinnamon with spoon. Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture on bread cubes in pan. Cut second loaf of frozen dough into 1/2-inch squares and layer in pan. Pour remaining pudding mixture on dough. Let rise overnight in refrigerator (10 to 12 hours). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Immediately invert onto cookie sheet.

title: Pinkie'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan place tomatoes chopped and liquid from the can. Add 1 cup of water and 1 cup chicken broth. Deskin as much chicken as you want meat in the stew. Add onion salt and pepper to taste and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer about 1 hour. During the last 30 minutes add the diced potatoes. Remove the chicken; cook and take meat off the bones. Chop the meat and return it to the pan. Add the corn and butter beans and continue cooking until the beans are done.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Slice tomatoes; do not peel. Put slices between paper towels to absorb liquid. Mix batter of eggs corn meal chives water salt and pepper. Fry in an iron skillet after battering each slice. Dont over heat oil. Turn to brown each side.

title: Fresh Prune Or Apple Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt sugar and baking powder together twice. Put in large mixing bowl. Add eggs beating well. Add just enough milk to make a firm batter. Put batter in a 12 x 18-inch greased pan. Split prunes and place halved prunes in rows on dough pressing in lightly. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for about 10 more minutes until done.

title: Tomato Aspic
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water and then add remaining ingredients. Pour into individual molds or in 9 x 9-inch square pan. Refrigerate until set.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix together sugar milk butter and cocoa. Boil for 2 minutes. Mix together oats and peanut butter. Put both mixtures together. Drop on wax paper.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown meat; add onions seasoning tomatoes corn and bouillon. Bring to a boil. Stir in green peppers. Boil again. Stir in rice and remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Ganache
instructions: Gently warm the cream in a small saucepan over medium heat until small bubbles begin to appear at the edges. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate until mixture is smooth and the chocolate has melted completely. Do not stir so vigorously that bubbles form. If there are any visible lumps strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. When cake is done poke several holes in top of cake. Pour condensed milk over cake. Pour caramel topping over milk. Let cake cool completely. Top with Cool Whip. Break candy bars into small pieces and scatter on top of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Rice Delight
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter. Add soup milk and 1/3 jar Cheez Whiz. Make layers of rice asparagus chestnuts and soup mixture in a buttered casserole dish. Add remaining Cheez Whiz on top of last layer in teaspoonfuls. Bake covered with foil 25 to 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet And Sour Dressing For Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Beat egg. Put all ingredients in double boiler and cook stirring constantly until thick enough for dressing. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Looks messy. Beat beat and beat until mixture is smooth and creamy! Put on cooled cake.

title: Cousin Sue'S Great Beans
instructions: Place onions vinegar sugar mustard garlic powder and salt in a skillet. Cover and cook over low/medium heat for 20 minutes (onions should become transparent). Combine all beans (do not drain the baked beans). Combine both mixtures in a casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven covered 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Dry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; chill and serve.

title: Gloria'S Pinch-Me Cake
instructions: Cut biscuits in quarters and roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Place in buttered tubular pan. Melt butter and brown sugar together and pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Invert on platter and sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Quick Beef Pie
instructions: Heat beef stew and put in casserole while hot. Mix buttermilk biscuits with the water. Drop on hot stew. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until biscuits are done.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
instructions: Boil water and add jello and gelatin. Stir until melted. Add cream cheese to hot mixture and dissolve well. Chill until partially congealed. Add rest of ingredients. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill before serving.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients together in large mixing bowl. With a fork mix in shortening well. Stir in enough milk to form a soft dough. Knead gently for 30 seconds. If dough is too moist add flour. Form dough into 10 balls; flatten and place on baking sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot with butter. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add sugar flour and milk then add rhubarb. Pour into unbaked pie shell that has been sprinkled with 1 tablespoon flour. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 3/4 hour or until custard is set.

title: Egg Souffle(Breakfast Casserole)
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch buttered baking dish.

title: Caramels
instructions: In a 3-quart pan cook sugar corn syrup nulomoline cream and lecithin. Stir often at beginning to dissolve sugar. Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes. Add broken pieces of butter and cook to 230\u00b0. Continue to cook and stir until mixture reaches 246\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add salt and vanilla. Gently stir with wooden spoon. Pour into buttered pan. Add nuts if desired.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix eggs sugar zucchini and add flour cinnamon vanilla salt baking powder soda and nuts. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Herb Dressing
instructions: In blender container combine sour cream milk and mayonnaise. Process until thoroughly combined scraping down sides of container as necessary. Stir in remaining ingredients. Transfer to a bowl or jar with tight fitting cover. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Just before serving stir well. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cherry Crumb Pie Topping
instructions: Mix and take out 1/2 for on the top then mix egg in rest. The rest put on the pie. Sprinkle the 1/2 on the top.

title: Broiled Shrimp Parmigiana
instructions: Add lemon juice to a bowl of cold water. Clean shrimp and devein under cold running water. Remove tail shell as well. Split shrimp along vein cavity but do not separate. Place in bowl of lemon water and let set.

title: Jan'S Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Soften margarine and mix with flour and pecans. Spread into a 9 x 13 baking dish. Brown in a 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Easy Apple Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients into pie shell. Cover and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: In blender or food processor combine first 3 ingredients; mix until blended. Remove cap and pour melted butter in slow steady stream until mixture is thoroughly mixed. Keep warm over hot boiling water.

title: Brunch Egg Bake
instructions: In a large bowl lightly toss cheeses together. Sprinkle half of cheese mixture in ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In medium skillet cook mushrooms green onion and red pepper in margarine until onions and pepper are tender. Arrange vegetables over cheese. Arrange ham strips over vegetables. Sprinkle remaining cheese over ham.* Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off. In a large bowl using wire whisk blend flour milk parsley and eggs. Pour over layers in baking dish. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until mixture is set and top is lightly browned. Let stand about 10 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Low-Fat Maple-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cut the sweet potatoes and apples into 1/4-inch slices. Layer in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a saucepan bring syrup cider butter and salt to a boil. Pour over potatoes and apples. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes more or until tender. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Custard Filling
instructions: Combine dry ingredients thoroughly. Add milk and eggs. Cook over boiling water until thick like pudding. Add vanilla and butter. Mix well. Cool.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Put all ingredients into food processor; chill to serve. Will keep well.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix together and let set several hours in refrigerator before serving.

title: Cranberry Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Save juice. In saucepan mix juice 1/2 cup water and lemon juice. Heat to boiling; remove from heat and add gelatin. Stir well. Break up cranberry sauce with fork. Stir into gelatin mixture. Refrigerate until mixture begins to gel. Stir in pineapple celery and apple. Pour into 4 cup mold. Chill until firm.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well and serve with assorted vegetables.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken until tender; remove from bone and cut into small pieces. Reserve liquid for stock. If necessary add enough water to stock to make 2 quarts. Add soup butter salt and pepper. Make dumplings according to directions; cut into strips. Drop dumplings into boiling chicken stock. Boil 2 to 3 minutes stirring gently. Fold in chicken and eggs. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients with mayonnaise. Season to taste (use Natures Seasons blend and Accent flavor enhancer).

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and drain grease. Add all other ingredients in a large soup pot with lid. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix well peanut butter soft butter corn syrup vanilla and salt. Stir in powdered sugar and nuts. Knead well. Spread into buttered cookie sheet. Press smooth. Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Sprinkle cucumbers and onion with salt. Let stand 1 1/2 hours. Drain and rinse. Mix but do not heat dressing. Pour over cucumbers and onions in jars. Let stand in refrigerator the longer the better. More cukes and onions can be added to the same solution several times.

title: Pita Snacks
instructions: Preheat broiler. Split pita breads. Combine butter and dill weed; blend well. Spread dill butter on pita; cut each half into 4 wedges. Broil until crisp.

title: Pet-Ritz Easy Caramel Apple Pie
instructions: Combine caramel candies each cut into 4 pieces and 1/3 cup flour. Add apples ice cream topping and lemon juice. Mix well. Pour mixture into a frozen regular 9-inch Pet-Ritz pie crust and sprinkle with 1/2 cup pecan pieces. Bake at 375\u00b0 on a preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes. Store at room temperature. When using a Pet-Ritz deep dish crust please substitute 15 caramel candies 1/2 cup flour 5 cups apples 1 cup caramel ice cream topping and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.

title: Crustless Vegetable Quiche
instructions: Light grease 10-inch pie plate. Mix together first 4 ingredients. Put into pie plate. Put remaining ingredients into blender and blend until mixed well. Pour liquid mixture over ingredients already in pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Christmas Sugar Cookies
instructions: Lightly grease a 15 x 12 x 1-inch cookie sheet. In a large bowl cream the 1 cup of butter. Gradually add the sugar beating until fluffy.

title: Meatball Stew
instructions: Broil ground beef until rare and crumbled. Combine with egg white and dill weed. Shape into 24 equal sized meatballs. In a large nonstick skillet saute meatballs until browned on all sides. Add green pepper and onion to skillet. Cover and steam 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes and salt. Then stir in beans and macaroni. Cover and cook over medium heat about 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Serves 4.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels 2 teaspoons sugar and margarine; press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 7 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool. Mix cream cheese confectioners sugar and whipped topping; spread on pretzel mixture. Dissolve strawberry and lemon jello in boiling water. Add pineapple and strawberries. Allow mixture to cool. Spread jello and fruit on cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate. Cut into squares. Serves 16.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all. Pour into a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Meat Cholent
instructions: Soak the beans overnight in water. Drain. Use a heavy saucepan or Dutch oven and brown meat and onions in the fat (or margarine). Sprinkle with salt pepper and ginger. Add beans barley and small potatoes (peeled) and sprinkle with flour and paprika. Place uncooked eggs in shells on top. Add enough boiling water to cover one-inch above the mixture. Cover tightly. Cholent may be baked for 24 hours at 250\u00b0 (125\u00b0C) or for quicker cooking bake at 350\u00b0 (180\u00b0C) for 4 to 5 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Mexican Dip(This Dip Can Also Be Made Into Roll-Ups.)
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except for tortillas) together. To make roll-ups spread dip mixture over tortillas. Roll up and slice into 1 inch pieces. Place on tray and garnish with cilantro.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Cook dates sugar butter and egg together until soft. Cool slightly and add vanilla Rice Krispies and nuts.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix all of above. Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Nutty Buns
instructions: Separate biscuits; cut each in half. Brush biscuits with mayonnaise. Combine sugar cinnamon and pecans; roll biscuits in mixture. Place 2 pieces in each greased muffin cup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: In food processor crush cookies until they resemble dirt. Set aside. Cream together cream cheese margarine and powdered sugar. Mix pudding and milk until well blended. Fold pudding into cream cheese mix. Fold in whipped topping. In an 8 - 10 inch plastic flowerpot alternate layers of cookie dirt and pudding mixture. End with dirt. Top with worms. Chill several hours. Serve with sand shovel.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Blend cheese and butter until soft. Add flour; blend well and chill well. Roll into small balls. Bake at 500\u00b0 for 7 minutes or until brown. Makes 40. May be frozen. You may stuff olive in the cheese ball before baking.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except water or milk with fingertips. Add enough water or milk to make dough stiff enough to be rolled out. Roll out dough fairly thin. Sprinkle surface of dough with additional sugar. Cut dough into rounds. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Famous Smorgasbord Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together. Line bottom of 9 x 3-inch baking dish with this mixture (consistency of wet sand). Pour batter over crust slowly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan and preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Place bread on the bottom of pan. Sprinkle on cheese (1/2 amount). Add 1/2 of ham or sausage. Layer cheese and remainder of meat. In a bowl beat eggs; add milk salt and dry mustard. Pour mixture over cheese. Dot with butter. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake for 50 minutes to 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Christmas Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk syrup and salt in saucepan; mix well. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture boils and sugar dissolves. Cook to 238\u00b0 stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Cool to 110\u00b0 without stirring. Beat until mixture loses its gloss and a small amount dropped from a spoon will hold its shape. Quickly stir in pecans coconut and cherries. Pour into slightly greased pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Rolled Chipped Beef
instructions: Let cream cheese stand until it is room temperature. Add seasonings and mix. Spread on slice of beef. Roll and put in foil and freeze. When ready to serve cut into bite-sized pieces and serve with toothpicks.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Drain cooked broccoli and spread in a casserole dish. Place chicken on top and pour sauce over both. Can be made ahead. Before serving crush 2 cups of Pepperidge Farm dressing and add about 2 sticks margarine. Cover casserole with dressing crumbs and cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook for 15 minutes more. This may be frozen to heat and use later.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Gather ingredients in a large bowl and mix in the order they are listed.

title: Frizzled Steak
instructions: Cook steak in small amount of oil until slightly browned. Add onions cook until transparent. Add soy sauce sugar and 2 cups water. Cook until meat is tender 1 1/2 to 2 hours adding water as necessary. Add mushrooms and celery. Cook for 15 minutes longer and thicken with desired amount of cornstarch mixed with water. Serve on rice.

title: Pearl Huffman'S Wilted Lettuce Salad
instructions: Mix the drippings flour sugar salt water vinegar and egg thoroughly and boil 2 to 3 minutes. Pour over bowlful of mixed lettuce and onions. Stir in bacon bits and serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan cook slowly constantly stirring until cheese is melted and smooth. Cook until thick and then cool use with cauliflower broccoli celery carrots and radishes.

title: Southwest Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large skillet over medium-high heat cook ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender about 5 minutes. Meanwhile prepare potatoes according to package directions but use 2 cups water and 3/4 cup skim milk and omit butter or margarine and salt. Place cooked meat mixture in a colander and rinse under hot water. Drain well. Wipe skillet with a paper towel. Return meat mixture to skillet over medium heat. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese and heat through about 7 minutes. Transfer meat mixture to a 2-quart casserole. Drop potato mixture in mounds on meat mixture or spread it over meat mixture. Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes or until hot. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Blondies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In large bowl stir flour baking powder and salt. In another bowl cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat eggs 1 at a time. Mix vanilla. Stir in flour mixture. Fold in walnuts and chocolate chips. Spread batter in pan.

title: Chocolate Cake With Cherries
instructions: Beat eggs into cake; mix powder. Add almond extract. Add 20 ounce can cherry pie filling and mix well. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour mixture into pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broiled Peaches(Dresses Up Plain Meats)
instructions: Place peach halves cut side up in baking dish. Combine allspice orange rind brown sugar and chopped nuts. Sprinkle mixture over peaches. Broil in preheated oven about 5 minutes or until sugar mixture is bubbling. Makes nice accompaniment for meats.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook noodles in boiling water until al dente (still a little firm); drain and place in a large bowl. In a medium-sized bowl combine the Ricotta cheese and half the Mozzarella cheese; add to the noodles and mix. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover bottom of dish with half the spaghetti sauce. Spoon the noodle mixture over the sauce. Cover with the remaining sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and the remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for 20 minutes for easier serving. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Delightful Dill Bread Boat
instructions: Soak in water the chipped beef to remove salt. Drain and chop. Mix mayonnaise sour cream and all spices. Remove center of loaf of rye leaving a bread \bowl\. Cube bread removed plus second loaf. Fill center of bread bowl with mayonnaise mixture. Arrange bread cubes around bread bowl for dipping.

title: No Cook Fudge
instructions: Melt cheese and oleo. Pour over mixed sugar cocoa vanilla and nuts. Mix and pour into pan. Cut in squares after it hardens.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits in 1/4 pieces. Dip in margarine roll in sugar. Put in Bundt pan in layers. Sprinkle nuts and raisins on each layer. Repeat process until 1-inch from top of pan. Drizzle remaining margarine (mixed with cinnamon and sugar) over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until top is brown.

title: Almond-Turkey Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Toss 3/4 cup cheese with flour. Mix cheese mixture turkey celery 1/3 cup almonds mayonnaise juice and seasonings. Roll pastry to 15-inch square on lightly floured surface. Place in 12 x 8-inch baking dish; trim 1-inch beyond edge. Turn under edge; flute. Fill with turkey mixture. Top with remaining cheese and almonds. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crawfish Dressing
instructions: Saute first 4 ingredients. Add next 5 ingredients. Mix in cheese and bread crumbs. Shape into patties and dredge lightly with flour. Saute in small amount of oil until crisp or put in flat shell dishes and heat in oven. Drizzle with lemon juice or serve with lemon slices. Very good stuffing for flounder.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage with enough water to cover cabbage and onion until tender. Drain and add soups. Gently fold together. Crumble sausage in pan and fry out grease. Drain thoroughly and chop or break up larger chunks real fine. Put on top of cabbage and serve. May need to reheat before serving.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar; mix with dry ingredients then add vanilla and water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Claudine'S Chili Con Carne
instructions: Brown beef garlic and onion in small amount of olive oil. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Just cook until everything is hot. Recipe can be doubled for larger crowd.

title: Pecan Tassies
instructions: Let cream cheese and margarine soften at room temperature. Blend together the cheese and margarine. Stir in flour. Chill 1 hour. Shape in 1-inch balls and press in mini muffin pan bottom and sides.

title: Split Pea Chowder
instructions: In 5-quart Dutch oven combine all ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer approximately 2 hours or until chowder has thickened stirring occasionally. Makes 8 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

title: Pink Cloud Salad
instructions: Mix and chill. Best to set overnight.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Soften cream cheese at room temperature. Mix cream cheese canned milk lemon juice and vanilla all together. Pour into a graham cracker pie shell. Chill 1 hour. Pour 1 can cherry pie filling over chilled pie. Spread evenly and serve.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Boil pineapple in saucepan. Add Jell-O and bring to a boil again. Remove from heat. Set in water until cool but not set. Add other ingredients. Place in molds and refrigerate until set. Eat and enjoy.

title: Polish Steak Rolls
instructions: Cut meat in approximately 3 x 3-inch pieces. Pound with meat tenderizer. Chop onion and fry with chopped bacon until almost done. Put spoonful of drained bacon and onion in each steak piece. Roll up and put toothpick through. After you have done all meat dip in flour and salt and pepper. Brown in skillet. Remove and make a gravy out of drippings adding mushroom soup with some milk. Put meat in pot pour gravy over cover and bake in oven for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 or until tender.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend eggs oil and sugar until creamy. Add flour salt and baking soda a little at a time; blend well (batter will be stiff). Fold in apples vanilla and nuts. Pour into tube pan. Bake for 1 hour. Remove from pan after about 30 minutes.

title: Applesauce Banana Bread
instructions: Place bananas in large bowl and mash with electric mixer. Stir in the sugar and let stand 15 minutes. Add the applesauce and eggs and beat well. Beat in the baking soda baking powder salt and vanilla then gradually beat in the flour mixing thoroughly. Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan that has been coated with nonstick spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the loaf comes out clean. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before removing from the pan. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook rigati 12 minutes; drain. Cut up tomatoes keeping juice; add seasonings. Slice cheese in uniform slices. Put a layer of noodles then tomatoes then cheese; continue until you end up with sauce and cheese. Place cubed buttered bread over entire top of dish. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 9 x 9-inch pan. Cream together sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs and blend well. Stir in the rest of the ingredients except the blueberries. Spread half the dough in the pan. Spoon the pie filling on the top; spread the other half of dough over the pie filling. Bake about 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve all ingredients in hot water; add to 1 large unsweetened pineapple juice in a gallon container; finish with water. Freeze to slush and serve with vanilla ice milk.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken
instructions: In skillet in hot oil cook chicken for 10 minutes or until browned. Combine soup and milk; stir in lemon juice and pepper. Pour over chicken; top with lemon slices. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes until tender.

title: Kahlua Kreme Torte
instructions: Bake cake according to directions adding 1 tablespoon Kahlua to batter. Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans and cool. Split layers into 4. Melt chocolate bits over water. In large bowl combine cream milk and 2 tablespoons Kahlua. Slowly add instant pudding until thickened. Lay cake cut side up. Spread 1/2 raspberry preserves. Cover 1/4 pudding. Next add 2nd layer of cake and 1/2 chocolate. Next 1/4 pudding mix. Repeat layers ending with chocolate layer on top. Decorate with fresh raspberries and chocolate curls.

title: Leona'S Caramels
instructions: Melt butter in heavy 3-quart saucepan. Add sugar and salt. Stir in syrup. Mix well. Gradually add milk stirring constantly. Cook on medium heat until firm ball stage (245\u00b0) or for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and pour into well buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Cool for 4 to 5 hours. Flip on board and cut with sharp knife and wrap each piece in wax paper.

title: Whole Wheat Italian Bread
instructions: In a large bowl sprinkle yeast over warm water and let stand for 5 minutes to soften. Stir in sugar oil and salt. Add whole wheat flour and 1 1/2 cups all-purpose. Mix to blend. With a heavy-duty mixer or wooden spoon beat until dough is elastic. Stir in wheat germ and 1 cup all-purpose flour. Turn out onto floured area with remaining flour. Knead until smooth. Place in greased bowl. Cover and let rise. Punch dough down; turn out onto floured surface and divide in half. Shape into loaf shape. Place on greased baking sheets; cover lightly and let rise. Bring cornstarch mixture to a boil. Brush loaves while mix is warm. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned. Cool on wire rack.

title: Salmon Casserole(Low-Fat)
instructions: Coat a 2-quart shallow casserole with nonstick spray; set aside. In a large bowl toss together the onion crumbled salmon celery bell pepper mustard parsley and bread crumbs. Place milk in a 2-cup measure. Blend in mayonnaise. Pour over the salmon mixture and thoroughly combine. Spoon mixture into the prepared casserole. Bake in the preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes.

title: Delicious Prune Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and oil and beat well. Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk. Add nuts prunes and vanilla and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and poke cake full of holes with a fork and pour the topping over the cake hot and spread.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Have ready a tube pan. Stir flour and first amount of sugar together to blend. Measure egg whites cream of tartar and salt into large mixing bowl. Beat until foamy. Gradually add second amount of sugar 2 tablespoons at a time. Continue beating until meringue holds stiff peaks. Add flavoring. Sprinkle sugar-flour mixture over meringue. Fold in gently until mixed. Bake in ungreased tube pan for 30 to 35 minutes. Invert on a funnel to cool.

title: Funnel Cake
instructions: Beat egg. Add milk. Sift salt sugar flour and baking powder. Add egg and milk. Beat until smooth. Pour batter into funnel. Allow batter to run into deep fat at 375\u00b0. Make swirl in fat from center out. Drain on paper. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Hot Polish Sausage
instructions: Cook Polish sausage in skillet to brown a bit. Drain off fat. Cut into 1/4-inch slices. Mix with other ingredients and cook in microwave for 5 minutes. Then cook 15 minutes more at Medium power. Stir occasionally. Serve warm with toothpicks or on small plates.

title: Microwave Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except ketchup. Shape into a loaf in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf dish. Spread ketchup over top. Cover; microwave on medium-high for 22 to 24 minutes or until no longer pink. Allow to stand covered for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Championship Choco-Chip Bars
instructions: In medium bowl combine flour and sugar. Cut in oleo until crumbly. Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Press firmly into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. In same bowl combine sweetened condensed milk egg and vanilla. Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts. Spread on prepared crust. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Turkey
instructions: Thaw turkey 2-3 days. Put turkey in clean sink and remove gibblet and neck. Wash godd and dry with paper towels. Butter inside and outside of turkey. Put salt pepper and seasoning salt on turkey. Add 1/2 cup butter inside. In roasting bag put 1 tsp. flour; shake bag and pour out. Poke holes in bag; put turkey in bag and bake at 250 degrees for 7 hours checking every hour until golden brown.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Pour cold water in cup and sprinkle Knox on top. Set aside. Crush graham crackers and place them in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. In a double boiler cook next 6 ingredients until very smooth stirring occasionally. Add Knox mixture and stir until dissolved. Pour over cooled crust. Refrigerate to set. You can add a small can of drained crushed pineapple.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Easy quick and delicious!

title: Sherry Trifle
instructions: Arrange layer of ladyfingers in attractive dish or serving bowl 1-quart size. Sprinkle ladyfingers with sherry. Make up Jell-O according to package directions; pour Jell-O over ladyfingers. Chill until set.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and flavoring. Add 1 egg at a time. Sift flour soda and salt together. Add alternately with milk. Add bananas and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 in greased and floured cake pans until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Plantation Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add bell pepper and pimentos. Mix lightly. Combine milk and salt and pour over potato mixture. Cover with foil. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are fork-tender. Remove foil. Cover with mixture of bread crumbs and cheese. Drizzle 1/3 cup butter over top. Continue baking for 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: One Of A Kind Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Mold into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 4 hungry people.

title: Zesty Mexican Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until cooked thoroughly cool and separate. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a large casserole dish combine all ingredients and mix well. Sprinkle top with 1/2 cup of both cheeses and bake for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine sugar Bisquick butter and vanilla. Add eggs and beat well. Add milk mixing well. Pour into 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Melt the butter in a small skillet. Add the onion and cook until transparent.\tPut into a casserole dish and add the soup and rice. Stir and bake for one hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Tropical Banana-Nut Cake
instructions: Sift together in large bowl the flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Add shortening bananas and 1/3 cup buttermilk; stir to dampen flour. Beat at medium speed 2 minutes with mixer or 300 hand strokes. Add eggs vanilla and remaining buttermilk. Beat 2 minutes longer (or 300 more strokes). Fold in chopped nuts. Pour into 2 paper lined 9 x 1 1/2-inch round pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and frost as desired.

title: Uncooked Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa butter and milk; heat to boiling point in large pan stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute and 30 seconds. Remove from heat; add oats and beat well. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Beat well. Drop on wax paper and let cool.

title: Diabetic Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix and stir all ingredients in order given flour baking soda baking powder and salt. These can be sifted once if you prefer. Add beaten egg and mix well with vegetable shortening peanut butter and Sweet N Low. Add dry ingredients. Drop by large teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Snap Peas And Peppers
instructions: About 30 minutes before serving or early in day cut yellow peppers into 2 x 3/4-inch pieces. Cut celery diagonally into 1/4-inch thick slices. Remove stem and strings along both edges of each pea pod. In nonstick 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in 1 tablespoon hot olive or salad oil cook yellow peppers celery 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper stirring frequently until vegetables are tender and lightly browned about 10 minutes. Remove vegetables to bowl. In same skillet in 2 teaspoons hot olive or salad oil cook snap peas 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper stirring frequently until peas are tender-crisp about 4 minutes. Stir pepper mixture into snap peas in skillet. Spoon vegetables onto platter. If not serving right away cover and refrigerate to serve cold later. Garnish with basil sprig if you like. Makes 6 accompaniment servings.

title: Cheese Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix and bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Hot Crab, Artichoke And Jalapeno Dip With Pita Triangles
instructions: In a small heavy skillet cook the bell pepper in the oil over moderate heat stirring until it is softened and let it cool. In a large bowl combine the bell pepper artichokes mayonnaise scallions pimiento Parmesan lemon juice Worcestershire sauce jalapeno peppers and celery salt. Blend the mixture until it is combined well and stir in the crab meat gently.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in greased and floured 8 or 9-inch pans for 35 minutes. Bake and remove from pans. Frost cake with 7-Up Cake Custard.

title: French Fried Hot Dogs
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in bowl. Add onion and water. Beat with rotary beater for 2 minutes. Dip hot dogs in batter holding with kitchen fork or tongs. Drain off excess batter over the bowl. Fry in hot deep fat (375\u00b0) for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain on paper towel. Insert wooden skewers. Serve with mustard.

title: Greek Spinach Pie(Spanakopetes)
instructions: Thaw frozen spinach at room temperature for 2 hours. Drain and chop into small pieces. Heat oil and saute scallions until soft and wilted. Add spinach and simmer until moisture evaporates. Rinse feta in cold water drain and crumble it into bowl. Blend in pot cheese parsley pepper and dill. Add beaten eggs and mix well. Add spinach and scallions and mix well. Butter 11 x 14 x 2-inch pan and line it with about 12 to 15 sheets of phyllo each sheet individually brushed with warm melted butter. Spread spinach and cheese mixture on top. Cover with about 12 to 15 more individually buttered phyllo sheets on top of one another. Roll or push edges of phyllo down all around the pan to hold in mixture. Brush entire top and edges with warm melted butter.

title: Microwave Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut refrigerated biscuits into quarters. Place butter in round microwave cake dish and microwave for 1 minute 30 seconds or until butter milts. Stir brown sugar and ground cinnamon into butter. Add biscuits and stir to coat with mixture. Arrange biscuits evenly in dish. Microwave on high for 4 or 5 minutes. remove from oven and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Best when served hot.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Combine oil dry Ranch dressing mix and dill weed; stir well. Pour over crackers. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours stirring occasionally. Store in airtight container.

title: Three-Minute Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine cooled margarine sugar eggs buttermilk and vanilla in a bowl; mix well. Stir in coconut. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until set. Yields 8 servings.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Open crescent rolls and flatten on cookie sheet pinching seams together. Bake until brown. Mix Miracle Whip cream cheese and salad mix together; spread on baked rolls. Chill overnight. In blender chop vegetables. Put vegetables and cream cheese over baked rolls about 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Easy Hot Rice
instructions: Mix in frying pan. Add water. Cook until rice is tender.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; drop by teaspoon and press with fork on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 30 to 36 cookies.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Puree all ingredients in blender. Chill. Serve in well chilled soup bowls. Pass as a garnish croutons finely diced cucumbers onion and green pepper.

title: Broiled Coconut Topping
instructions: In small bowl combine all ingredients. Spread evenly over top of hot 8-inch or 9-inch square cake. Run under broiler 4 inches from heat 2 to 3 minutes or until topping is bubbly and golden. Cool cake in pan on wire rack; serve slightly warm.

title: Chili
instructions: After sauteing meat and onion together add other ingredients. Cook over medium heat or in a crock-pot for approximately 1 hour.

title: Lemon Tea Bread
instructions: Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Heat the milk with the herbs and let steep until cool.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and peas. Add onion pepper and pimento. In a saucepan combine sugar vinegar salt and chili powder. Mix and bring to a boil. Simmer. Mix vegetables and sauce together and refrigerate.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice eggplants; boil with onion and bell pepper until done. Drain and mash. Add oleo beaten egg and milk; mix then add soup and stuffing mix. Put into casserole. Cover; bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes. Top with cheese; bake until cheese is melted.

title: Easy Quiche
instructions: Mix in blender. Put in anything else such as ham bacon cheese green peppers or mushrooms. Pour into greased pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mrs. Truman'S Ozark Pudding
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Pour over apples and nuts. Bake in buttered pie dish at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Frozen Daiquiris
instructions: Mix rum 7-Up sugar lemonade and limeade concentrates and water together. Place in a large plastic container; cover and freeze. When ready to serve spoon some of mixture into glass and add the same amount of extra 7-Up.

title: Snow Ice Cream
instructions: Mix condensed milk in medium size bowl of snow. Add vanilla and taste; add snow until it is as you like it.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour boiling water over shortening. Add sugar molasses and egg then beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour in ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order given combining baking powder with the flour. Use just enough hot water to dissolve the soda. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Crumble 1/2 of cake in punch bowl. Add chocolate pudding and cherries. Crumble remaining cake and add vanilla pudding. Spread blueberries over vanilla pudding. Spread Cool Whip on top. Garnish with pecans.

title: Amish Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and sugar together until very crumbly. Put layer of Jif and sugar mixture in bottom of baked pie shell. Add pie filling then layer of Jif and sugar mixture. Top with Cool Whip or whipped cream. Add rest of Jif and sugar mixture on top of pie. Keep refrigerated.

title: Wonderful Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Blend in flour and vanilla; mix well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Place in cold oven. Turn oven to 325\u00b0. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Do not open oven door during baking time. If desired add 1 teaspoon lemon or butter flavoring instead of vanilla flavoring.

title: No Cook Cookies
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients 1 minute. Mix together and then spoon onto cookie sheet or plate and allow to firm and cool.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Break head of lettuce in small pieces. Place in bottom of dish. Dice onion. Layer on top of head of lettuce. Dice bell pepper. Layer on top of onion. Grate carrots. Layer on top of bell pepper. Dice celery. Layer on top of carrots. Layer peas on top of celery. Grate the eggs and layer on top of peas. Mix sugar with Hellmanns mayonnaise. Cover salad with mayonnaise. Sprinkle fancy shredded cheese over the mayonnaise.

title: Cheese Sticks
instructions: Finely grate cheese. Blend with butter and flour. Roll in small balls and put on cookie sheet. Flatten with spatula. Refrigerate for 4 hours. Bake 7 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes about 24. Place pan under broiler for a minute to brown them.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Add milk and Minute rice. Add cream of chicken soup. Stir in grated cheese. Place in greased casserole dish and bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and oleo; add eggs one at a time. Mix flour and soda. Add to sugar and egg mixture. Add bananas milk and vanilla. Mix well; pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Souper Sausage Cornbread
instructions: In bowl combine soup eggs and milk. Stir in muffin mix just until blended. Fold in sausage. Spoon mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Garden Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl stir together all ingredients except mushrooms. Stuff each mushroom cap with 1 tablespoon filling. Place in buttered 13 x 9 baking pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Blend milk and egg yolks. Gradually stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat and blend in butter and vanilla. Place plastic wrap onto filling in saucepan and cool to room temperature.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Combine pineapple and juice salad dressing and onions in baking dish. Place chicken in mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir once. Other pieces of chicken can be used.

title: Zucchini And Squash Provincial
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place the zucchini in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Top with onion. Sprinkle uncooked rice over the onion. Cut 1 tablespoon margarine into pieces and dot over casserole; top with yellow squash. Add tomatoes spices and juice. Dot with 2 tablespoons margarine. Cover tightly with foil and bake 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Remove foil and top with cheese. Bake an additional 5 to 10 minutes until the cheese is melted.

title: Company Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook the spaghetti; drain rinse and set aside. Saute onions lightly in butter or margarine in pan; stir in flour. Stir in broth milk and half and half. Cook stirring until thickened. Take off heat.

title: Chocolate No-Bakes
instructions: Mix together milk sugar cocoa margarine and salt in a pan. Bring to a boil. Let boil 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and add last 3 ingredients. Mix and drop by spoonful on wax paper. Let harden.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water. Add cranberry sauce. Dissolve. Add drained pineapple. With the pineapple liquid you have saved make 1 1/2 cups adding water if necessary. Mix. Pour into mold and refrigerate until ready.

title: Mini Micro Meat Loaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into oblong mini loaf pans (about 8). Bake on High or full power in your microwave for 8 minutes. Remove and drain grease. Turn loaves over and cook another 5 minutes. Remove and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sharon'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Add sugar shortening molasses and egg together in mixing bowl. Blend well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill. Form into 1 inch balls and roll in sugar. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Olive Balls
instructions: Grate cheese and let soften. Blend in butter and paprika. Work in flour until smooth and deep yellow color. Let stand for 15 minutes. Pinch 1 teaspoonful off; roll in palm and flatten. Place around a well drained olive. Chill for 10 minutes or freeze. Heat at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes 30 if frozen.

title: Spanish Beef In A Bun
instructions: Chop stuffed olives in blender. Place beef olives and tomatoes in a Dutch oven. Simmer until beef falls off the bones. Skim off any fat and remove bones. No additional seasoning is needed. Heap on buns or French rolls. Serve with a salad and beans if desired.

title: Coconut Cake(Portuguese)
instructions: Mix everything until it bubbles. Put in the oven in a round mold. Sprinkle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Wait until it is cold to put it on a plate. Preparation time 10 minutes.

title: Pink Champagne Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and cheese. Add other ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Melt margarine or butter. While butter is melting hand beat 6 eggs. Add the eggs to sugar then margarine. Mix buttermilk well then coconut and vanilla flavoring. Makes 2 pies. Put in unbaked pie crusts and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Cover squash with enough water to cover. Boil until tender and add salt and pepper. When tender drain and add 2 eggs and butter. Mix ingredients with enough crushed crackers to make the mixture into patties; then roll in crushed cracker crumbs and youre ready to deep-fry in hot oil. Cook until golden brown and serve.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients. Beat 2 minutes. Fold in nuts. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and egg. Pat in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix rest of ingredients together and pour on top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cut in 1 1/2-inch squares.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all in covered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Serves 4. Good with corn bread.

title: Sausage Cooked In Wine
instructions: Cut sausage any length desired. Pour wine and water over it. Cook in a 450\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Mama'S Biscuits - Uuuuuuum Good!
instructions: Add buttermilk until they are moist and sticky to the touch. Put on floured pastry cloth or I use some waxed paper with flour on it. Just wet the countertop a little and place the waxed paper on it and it will not move. Disposable after youre through and easy clean up. I just take the dough and put it on the flour and press it with my hands and then use a cutter and make the biscuits. I do not use a rolling pin. Do not work the dough or they will be dough. Try it; youll love it! Easy and delicious!

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape into loaf. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Delicious Rye Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water to which you have added the sugar. Let stand till yeast is thoroughly dissolved. Add syrup honey brown sugar molasses rye flour shortening and salt together in large mixing bowl. Add warm water and stir till well mixed. Add enough white flour to make a soft dough. Pour onto pastry sheet and knead till dough is still sticky when touched by hands. Dough should not be to stiff. Place in large mixing bowl and cover. Let rise in warm place till double. Place on pastry sheet and pinch of enough to make a round ball. There should be enough for 5 or 6 balls. Let stand for 10 minutes shape into loaves. Place in a well greased pans and set in warm place to rise till doubled in bulk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from pans and cool on cake racks. This should make 5 or 6 loaves depending on size of pans. 9 1/2 x 5 1/2 is about right. This bread freezes well and makes delicious toast.

title: English Muffin Bread
instructions: Combine 3 cups flour yeast sugar salt and baking soda. Heat liquids until very warm (120-130 degrees F). Add to dry mixture beat well. Stir in enough flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2) pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal. Sprinkle tops with cornmeal. Cover and let rise in warm place for 45 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes. Remove from pans immediately and cool on racks.

title: Sour Cream Lemon Pie
instructions: Cook sugar flour milk salt and egg yolks in a double boiler until it starts to thicken. Then add lemon juice; cook until it thickens. Cool. Fold in sour cream and place in a pie crust. Add topping of Cool Whip and chopped pecans.

title: Crepes Suzette(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix all ingredients until very smooth. Heat skillet; spray with Pam. Pour 2 tablespoons of mixture in skillet and spread over bottom of skillet. Brown crepe on both sides. Spread crepe with butter jelly syrup or fresh fruit. Can be rolled up like jelly roll and sprinkled with nuts and powdered sugar.

title: Twinkies Delight
instructions: Put Twinkies in bottom of pan. Place fruit with juice over Twinkies. Put Cool Whip over fruit and chill for 1 hour. Great afternoon snack.

title: Lemon Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients with 1 3/4 cups boiling water. When partly set add the remaining ingredients. Mix everything together and refrigerate until set.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Cook asparagus as directed until barely tender; drain. Melt butter in a small pan; stir in flour salt and pepper blending until smooth. Add milk and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Turn half of the asparagus into a 1-quart casserole. Top with half the eggs. Pour half the sauce over the asparagus. Repeat with remaining asparagus eggs and sauce. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. One pound fresh or one pound drained canned asparagus can be used.

title: Macadamia Yokan
instructions: Tear kanten into pieces; soak in water for 30 minutes. Cook until dissolved. Add sugar and salt; stir until sugar dissolves.\tAdd koshian; cook over medium flame until mixture comes to a boil. Add nuts. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cool.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Stir flour sugar cocoa baking powder baking soda and salt; mix thoroughly. Add mayonnaise water and vanilla and beat well for 3 minutes. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour mixture into pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. When cake cools frost or use whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars together. Add in eggs and vanilla. Mix well together. Add baking soda and salt (if desired) in. Gradually mix in flour. After everything is mixed together and batter is smooth add in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop in spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes. Edges should just be browning.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Remove seed from peppers and wash. Combine salt pepper rice browned ground beef milk and onion.\tStuff peppers lightly and place in pan. Add tomato soup and water then cover. Cook for 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Unbaked Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt margarine and marshmallows in a saucepan over low heat. When melted add crumbs. Mix.

title: You Got Chocolate On My Peanut Butter Candy
