instructions: Combine in mixing bowl. Mix well. May need more flour. Drop batter by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pizza Dip
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well. Heat in microwave 30 seconds to 1 minute. Dip tortilla chips lightly. Enjoy!

title: Imperial Chicken
instructions: Mix bread crumbs with cheese parsley garlic salt and pepper. Dip each piece of chicken into melted butter then into the crumb mixture. Be sure each piece is well covered. Arrange in shallow pan. Pour remaining butter over all the chicken and bake for 1 hour or until tender. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Mountain Muffins
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar in bowl. Add egg milk and oil. Also add raisins or cinnamon if you like. Pour into 6 greased muffin cups and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Deli-Style Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Rinse with cold water and drain again.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil. Mix in a large bowl. Pour in Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Apple Raisin Loaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs oil apples sugar and vanilla on low speed of electric mixer for 1 minute. Add flour soda baking powder salt and spices. Mix for 45 seconds. Stir in nuts and raisins. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes; then remove loaf from pan.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt together. Cut in Crisco. Blend egg vinegar and water. Add to dry mixture. Makes 2 large 2 crust pies or 5 single crusts. Any crusts not needed may be frozen and used later.

title: Frugal Gourmet Italian String Beans *
instructions: Cook all ingredients except lemon juice in covered pan over medium heat for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with lemon juice and serve.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
instructions: Clean and slice carrots longways. Then cut in half to desired thickness. Boil until tender. Drain water; add butter until melted then add brown sugar to sweetness desired. Stir until carrots are glazed.

title: Midwest Baked Beans
instructions: Brown bacon; drain. Brown ground beef; drain. Drain off all grease. Mix up all ingredients. Bake for 1 1/2 or 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve hot. A little goes a long way.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Cook carrots; cool and slice. In a large bowl add vinegar to tomato soup also oil. Add rest of ingredients. Add carrots; cover and marinate overnight. Can be stored in quart jars kept in refrigerator for weeks.

title: Poppy Seed Bread(Makes 1 Loaf)
instructions: Sift together first 3 ingredients; set aside. In a large bowl beat eggs; add sugar and oil or applesauce and mix well. Add vanilla and poppy seed. To this mixture alternately add flour mixture and evaporated milk. Bake 60 to 90 minutes at 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 in granite pan). Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Apple Butter-Jelly
instructions: Cut apples in quarters and cook until soft. Squeeze through colander. Put 5 cups of apples into pot. Bring to a boil. Add 7 cups of sugar and three shakes of allspice. Bring to a boil again. Add 1 box of Sure-Jell. Bring to a boil again for one minute. Pour into jars and seal. Makes approximately 80 pints.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Bring ingredients to a boil. Cook beets and slip the skins off. Cut up and put into jars. Pour hot liquid over beets and seal. Process jars in boiling water bath for 10 minutes. Makes approximately 10 pints.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Combine flour salt and baking powder. Beat eggs with milk and add shortening and corn. Combine mixtures lightly. Fry like pancakes until center is done.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add other ingredients. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Chocolate Cookies(Soft)
instructions: Blend margarine sugar and egg. Add chocolate. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together alternately with milk to mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop from teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes on greased pan. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Jiffy Clam Chowder
instructions: Combine all ingredients including clam juice in saucepan and simmer for about 10 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Tetrazzini
instructions: Mix water and milk with mushroom soup. Combine with remaining ingredients. Place in the casserole dish provided in the church office. There is no need to bake it as it is baked before serving at the soup kitchen. You can easily prepare this ahead and freeze it!

title: Rhubarb Cobbler With Oat Dumplings
instructions: In a small saucepan stir together the 3/4 cup sugar and the cornstarch. Stir in water and orange juice. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until the mixture is thickened and bubbly. Add the fresh or frozen rhubarb pieces; cook and stir until the mixture returns to boiling. Remove from the heat. Cover the mixture to keep warm.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and add three soups and water. Remove 1 cup of the mixture and reserve for topping. To the remaining soup mixture add 1 cup uncooked brown rice. Spread rice mixture on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken pieces on top of mixture and top with the 1 cup reserved mixture Parmesan cheese and almonds. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Easy Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Cube the rhubarb and spread on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle dry Jell-O over rhubarb then scatter marshmallows on top. Prepare yellow cake according to box directions; pour over top. Bake according to box directions. Serve warm plain or with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as usual and lay broccoli on bottom of greased casserole. Combine 1/2 pint sour cream and mayonnaise. Break fried bacon into small pieces over broccoli. Pour sour cream mix over broccoli. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle paprika. Cook 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Slow Cooker Kalua Pork
instructions: Place pork fat side up in slow cooker (crock-pot). Combine water and liquid smoke; pour over meat and sprinkle with salt. Cover and cook on medium 8 to 12 hours; remove pork butt from cooker and shred then add the juices from the cooker (at least 1 cup; the flavor is in the juice). Ready to eat.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and put in well-buttered casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl combine butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture. Mix well. Stir in morsels and nuts. Spread into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes. Cool; cut into 35 (2-inch) squares.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in a bit of oil. Combine all of the listed ingredients except cheese crackers. Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Combine 2 cups crushed cheese crackers and 1/4 cup melted margarine. Stir in 1/2 cup grated Cheddar cheese. Spread over vegetable mixture in casserole. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Nanamo Squares
instructions: Blend. Spread this icing over mixture in pan and let it set. Place in cool (not cold) place until set and cut into squares and serve.

title: Amazing Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken breasts for about 30 minutes. Put eggs in same pot with boiling chicken and boil for an additional 15 minutes. Drain water from chicken and eggs. Spray cool water on chicken and eggs to help cool faster. Spray rectangular casserole dish with Pam. Tear chicken breasts into small pieces and layer the bottom of rectangular casserole dish. Take hard-boiled eggs and remove shells. Press eggs with fork to make smaller pieces. Layer egg pieces on top of chicken and then season the top of chicken and eggs with salt and pepper. (You may also add a pinch of garlic.) Put cream of chicken soup (or chicken broth) on top of the layer of chicken and eggs and smooth with spoon. Mix flour butter and milk together. Pour onto the top of chicken and eggs. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

title: Hot Curried Fruit
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar and curry powder. Drain fruits. Arrange fruit in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and pour sauce over fruits. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix eggs and vanilla pudding. Stir in poppy seed with a spoon. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Smashing Squash
instructions: Add melted margarine to 1/2 of stuffing. Add to cooked squash. Add carrot onion sour cream and soup. Mix all together. Put into a large greased casserole dish. Sprinkle rest of stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cabbage Wedges With Cheese Sauce
instructions: Remove outside leaves from cabbage cut into wedges. Place in pan with one inch of salted water cover and heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer for 12-15 minutes. Fry bacon until crisp remove from pan and crumble. Discard all but 2 tablespoons of bacon drippings. Add flour salt pepper and cayenne stir until well blended then add milk and water. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add cheese stir until melted. Drain cabbage place on platter and spoon sauce over wedges sprinkle with crumbled bacon.

title: Mama'S Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add onions and pepper and cook until tender. Add next 6 ingredients and simmer 20 minutes. Gently stir in cheese. In heavy saucepan stir in corn meal into cold water. Add salt and butter stirring to boil. Cook until thick and bubbly. Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Pour mixture over this and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with more shredded cheese.

title: Oreo Pie
instructions: Soften ice cream until you can mix in broken cookies and top with crushed cookies. Put in the freezer to harden. Heat sauce and serve on pie.

title: Chayote Pickles
instructions: Peel chayotes. Chop first seven vegetables and put in large kettle. Put 1/2 cup salt on these. Mix well and let stand for 3 hours. Mix once or twice.

title: Linguini With Scallops
instructions: Cook linguini. Drain and cover to keep hot. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in skillet. Add mushrooms scallions and garlic. Saute until tender. Add scallops broth dash of salt thyme and pepper. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until scallops are tender. Add parsley.

title: Regal Peach Cake
instructions: Soften butter or margarine in large bowl. Sift together flour sugar and baking powder. Add butter and milk. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes more. Turn into a greased and floured 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool; split into 2 layers. Drain peaches. Whip the cream. Spread half of cream and peaches between layers. Spread other half of cream over top; arrange remaining peaches sunburst-fashion over cream. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand the longer the better.

title: Fried Cheese
instructions: Coat cheese with flour. Dip in beaten egg then in crumbs. Add salt to hot oil. Fry in oil 20 to 30 seconds. For variation herbs and seasonings can be added to crumbs.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Cover chicken with water and add the celery salt and onion salt. Boil chicken until tender. Remove chicken and debone. Add chicken soup to broth.

title: Barbecued Cocktail Franks
instructions: Cut each hot dog into 4 pieces. Combine barbecue sauce relish and hot dogs in saucepan. Cook on medium heat stirring occasionally just until heated through. Serve hot with cocktail picks. Makes about 48 appetizers.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Green Chili Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat in 2 tablespoons fat. Grease casserole dish. Place tortillas in bottom of dish. Add small amount of onion hamburger meat cheese and chilies. Repeat layers. Dilute soup with milk and pour over stacked tortillas. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding with pineapple in order to dissolve the pudding mix. Mix all other ingredients into pudding mix. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

title: Oven Bake Stew
instructions: Brown beef in skillet. Cut all vegetables in chunks. Mix all ingredients in large roasting pan. Cover tightly with foil; bake for 3 hours at 325\u00b0 or for 4 hours at 250\u00b0. Dont peek until after 2 hours; re-cover and finish baking.

title: Calico Pickles
instructions: Combine vegetables in a large bowl. Dissolve salt in water and pour over vegetables. Soak 15 to 18 hours in cool place; drain. In a large kettle mix sugar spices and vinegar. Bring to boil and boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Add vegetables and simmer 5 to 7 minutes. Pack hot into 8 hot pint jars. Remove air bubbles; adjust caps. Process 15 minutes in boiling water. Yields 8 pints. These pickles are colorful and an eye-catcher.

title: Salmon Stew
instructions: Cook bacon; drain crumble and set aside. Slice onion and saute in bacon drippings. Add potatoes; cover with water and cook until tender. Add crumbled salmon and milk; scald until hot. Salt and pepper to taste. Garnish individual servings with bacon and cheese.

title: Pepper Chicken(International:  Africa)
instructions: In a large skillet brown chicken pieces on both sides in hot oil about 15 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside reserving the drippings. Add tomatoes and onion slices to pan drippings. Stir in red pepper thyme and salt. Bring to a boil. Return chicken legs to skillet. Spoon tomato mixture over chicken. Return mixture to boiling reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 35 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Skim off fat. Serves 12.

title: Cheddar Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile in a bowl combine chicken 1 cup cheese soup milk pimentos salt and pepper. Drain spaghetti; add to chicken mixture and toss to coat. Transfer to greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.

title: Phillip'S Greek Vinaigrette
instructions: Add a touch of Greek home cooking love put ingredients in a small jar and shake thoroughly. Chill before serving. Always shake before serving.

title: Potato Logs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 2 tablespoons of margarine cheese and crumbs. Use 1/2 to 2/3 cup of potato mixture for each log to be formed. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of margarine; stir in crumbs and cheese. Roll potato logs in crumb mixture. Place in shallow greased baking dish. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole With Crunchy Topping
instructions: Combine potatoes sugar salt margarine milk flavoring and eggs. Turn into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with topping made by blending topping ingredients.

title: Lo-Cal Dessert
instructions: Make Jell-O according to directions. Place in refrigerator. Sets well in 20 minutes. Make instant pudding using 1 1/2 cups milk. Place in refrigerator. When Jell-O is almost set beat it with hand mixer for 1 minute. Stir in pudding. Place in refrigerator for 1/2 hour.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Mix in large bowl; beat cheese ReaLemon Worcestershire and garlic powder until fluffy; stir in onion. On serving plate spread cheese in a 6-inch circle. To with chili sauce and crab meat. Cover and chill. Serve with crackers. Makes 12.

title: Honey Glazed Chicken
instructions: Put enough oil in skillet to cover bottom about 1/8 inch. Have good and hot. Take garlic and crush with side of knife blade. Add to oil. Cut 1 lemon in half. Squeeze juice of half into skillet. Add chicken breast and quickly brown on both sides. Slice second lemon into slices and lay in bottom of 7 x 9-inch baking dish after spraying. Place chicken breasts on lemon slices. To skillet add juice of half lemon honey and seasonings. Bring to boil and pour over chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 until chicken is done.

title: 4 Layer Cake(Unbelievable Dessert)
instructions: First Layer Mix flour margarine and 1/2 cup nuts for first layer. Cream together and press into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Jackpot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in hot fat. Add onion. Cook until golden. Add tomato soup water and noodles. Cook until noodles are tender stirring frequently to taste. Add corn and 1/2 cup grated cheese. Pour into greased casserole. Sprinkle remaining cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Icing
instructions: Cook first 5 ingredients until forms a small ball in cold water. Add peanut butter and heat until smooth and spreadable.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Marinate chicken in 4 ounces of lite Caesar dressing for about 1 hour. Then place chicken and dressing in skillet and cook over medium heat until chicken is fork-tender. Add 2 ounces of dressing to California Blend and microwave until tender but still crisp. Mix chicken and California Blend together and serve on top of rice. Yield 5 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake
instructions: Layer big chocolate chip cookies in baking pan. Pour Cappuccino over. Set in fridge 2 1/2 hours. Cut into squares when cold. On top of each piece drop spoonful of whipped cream and dot each mound with bite size cookies.

title: Miss Clem'S Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut up elephant into 1-inch cubes. Be accurate. Use ruler. Place cubes in kettle containing 2315 gallons of water. Simmer 3 days. Add assorted vegetables. Do not use rutabagas. Rutabagas hate people; thats why they taste the way they do. Simmer 6 more days over low heat.

title: Turkey-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onions peppers and celery in butter until tender. Cook broccoli and drain. Arrange broccoli in bottom of a 2-quart casserole dish. Combine sauteed vegetables and other ingredients. Spoon over broccoli. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Three Layer Rainbow Salad
instructions: Mix and chill until thickened and set.

title: Egg Pie - No Crust
instructions: Grease pie plate. Mix all ingredients. Add filling and bake slowly at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for one hour or until done.

title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs with mixer. Add oil sugar and maple flavor. Continue beating until mixture is thick and foamy. Stir in zucchini. Combine flour and remaining ingredients except sesame seed. Stir gently into mixture just until blended.

title: Heidi'S Apple Barrel Pie
instructions: Mix oleo flour and sugar together. Pat into 9 x 13 pan. Mix together apples with sugar and cinnamon. Pour into pie crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Prepare French Vanilla instant pudding. While the apples are still hot pour pudding over apples. Cool and refrigerate overnight before serving. Top with cool whip.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0.\tGrease\ta 9-inch baking pan. Beat egg in mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir until blended. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 servings.

title: Shredded Beets With Horseradish And Sour Cream
instructions: Brown onion lightly in butter in large saucepan 2 to 3 minutes. Mix in beets horseradish salt dill weed and pepper. Cover; lower heat and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Smooth in sour cream and bring just to serving temperature do not boil.

title: Pineapple Pies
instructions: Beat together eggs and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into 2 (8-inch) pie shells or 1 (10-inch) and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Basic Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve dry yeast in lukewarm water according to directions on package. Add milk which has been cooled to lukewarm sugar and salt. Allow to stand 5 minutes. Add butter or margarine and egg; mix well. Stir in flour and beat with spoon until dough forms a ball and follows spoon around the bowl. Brush top of dough with melted butter. Cover with wax paper or towel. Let rise to double in bulk. Turn out on floured board and knead. Shape or cut; let rise in biscuit pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.

title: Hamburger On French Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Slice a loaf of French bread in half. Spread mixture on both halves. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Add cheese on top the last 5 minutes.

title: Pralines
instructions: Cook all together except pecans in 4-quart pan. Cook to 236\u00b0 (soft ball). Stir frequently with wooden spoon. Remove from heat. Add chopped pecans. Cool and beat until creamy. (After it cools it sets up pretty fast.) Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Tom Kha Kaichicken Coconut Soup
instructions: Cut up the chicken meat either diced or in strips chop lemon grass and kaffir leaves in food processor or hand chop finely. Cut the shallots to 1/4 inch strips cut scallions to 1 inch pieces chop cilantro with stems no roots. Peel and slice the galangal root in thin strips 1/2 inch long. Heat pan on medium add the kaffir lemon grass shallots whole dried chilis and galangal stir until light brown. Add the chicken broth and increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Add chicken coconut and milk fish sauce and 1/2 teaspoon chili paste. Add the chili paste in increments and taste before adding the second half. Heat almost to boiling remove from the heat add lime juice cilantro and scallions. Serves 4.

title: Pickles - Dill Into Sweet
instructions: Drain pickles. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for a week turning upside down 2 or 3 times a day.

title: Green Rice And Broccoli
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fat-Free Banana Crunch Muffins
instructions: Spray mini muffin pan cups with Pam. Mix the first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl with a wire whisk. Mix bananas yogurt egg substitute and vanilla well. Stir the flour mixture into the banana mixture until well moistened.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Add marshmallows and milk together over heat. Remove and add all other ingredients. Mix well and pack into dish. Refrigerate.

title: Hotel Sunlight Icebox Rolls
instructions: Pour hot water over butter and let cool. Add sugar and salt then half of the flour. Add beaten eggs then the remaining flour and yeast (which has been dissolved in 1 cup cold water). Beat thoroughly and let stand 3 to 4 hours in refrigerator or overnight. Before needed take out of the refrigerator and put in pans; let rise until double in size. Bake in moderate oven about 20 minutes.

title: Three Bean Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook lima beans as directed on package; drain. Turn into ungreased 4 1/2-quart bean pot or casserole. Add baked beans and kidney beans. In covered skillet simmer sausages in small amount of water for 5 minutes. Drain liquid and fry until brown on all sides. (Do not prick sausages.) Cut each sausage into 2 or 3 pieces. Add sausage pieces and ham to beans. Stir together remaining ingredients; pour over beans and gently mix. Bake uncovered 1 hour. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Brown sausage and onions. Add remaining ingredients except bread crumbs. Mix all and make into small balls; roll in flour and dip in milk/egg mixture. Roll in bread crumbs and deep fry. Can freeze.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mayonnaise except cheese. Sprinkle cheese over top and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Panettone(Italian Holiday Bread)
instructions: Scald milk; cool to lukewarm. Cream butter with sugar and salt. Measure warm water into a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle yeast in water. Stir in lukewarm milk and cream mixture. Add beaten eggs and about half the flour. Beat until smooth. Blend in fruits almonds and lemon peel. Add enough flour to make soft dough. Knead until smooth and elastic.

title: Country Sausage Au Gratin
instructions: Cook and stir onions in oil for 5 minutes. Stir in the potatoes sauce and water. Reduce heat and cook 10 minutes. Cook the carrots and broccoli; add to potatoes. Slice the sausage and add heating everything together until good and warm. Add the cheese on top before serving.

title: Shredded Potato Pancakes
instructions: Spread shredded potatoes on a towel and squeeze dry. Place in a large bowl; stir in eggs onions flour and salt. In a large skillet heat oil over medium heat. Drop potato mixture by scant 1/2 cup into skillet. Flatten each to about 4-inches round. Cook until golden brown about 4 minutes. Turn and cook other side. Remove to paper towel to drain. Serves 4.

title: Corned Beefies
instructions: Mix together and place into buns. Wrap individually in foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown ground chuck in medium skillet. Add mushrooms and onion; saute for 3 to 4 minutes. Drain off any excess fat. Stir in water sauce bouillon and salt. Bring to a boil. In a small bowl stir together the sour cream and flour; stir into meat mixture. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly; cook and stir for 1 minute more. Serve over noodles. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour cocoa and salt. Add eggs and mix well. Add milk butter and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes. Makes two (9-inch) pies.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Put in 2 greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda together and set aside. Mix in order given and bake in greased pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Layered Raspberry Dessert
instructions: Bake and cool cake as directed on package. Cut vertically in half. Freeze one half for later use. Tear the other half into 3/4-inch pieces.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet and drain. Stir in picante sauce until heated. Put on serving dish. Drizzle melted cheese on top then sprinkle lettuce and tomato on top. Garnish with sour cream. Serve along side of white corn chips.

title: Chili
instructions: Mix chili powder and flour; brown meat in large skillet. Add powder and flour while browning. When brown add water garlic oregano and salt. Simmer slowly for 2 hours.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into graham cracker pie shell. Top with favorite fruit if desired! Chill. Serves 8.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream with sugar; mix well. Add salt and lemon juice. Add pecans cherries pineapple and bananas. Stir until evenly blended. Turn into rectangular or square pan or muffin tins lined with fluted paper. Place in freezer about 4 hours or until firm. Remove about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Ham Sandwiches
instructions: Combine butter and mustard. Spread on hamburger buns. Make up sandwiches with ham and cheese. Wrap individually in foil. Bake in foil at 375\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes. (These also freeze well!)

title: Sunshine Muffins
instructions: Combine flours sugar baking powder and salt. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until moistened (batter may be lumpy). Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 15 to 18 muffins.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Crush the graham crackers in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour the melted oleo over and mix with the crumbs and sugar. Press into the bottom of the pan. Soften the cream cheese and whip. Mix in the powdered sugar and whipped cream or whipped topping. Spread over crumb crust. Pour the pie filling over the cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle a few cracker crumbs on the top and chill overnight.

title: Meatsea Pie
instructions: Mix meat milk bread crumbs and garlic salt with a fork. Pat mixture evenly in bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate or 8 x 8-inch pan firmly. Spread tomato paste over meat mixture. Drain mushrooms. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over paste then mushrooms then oregano and grated cheese. Lay Mozzarella cheese over top of pie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 5. Nice with a salad.

title: Toasted Seasoned Pecans(Microwave)
instructions: Place pecans in a 1 1/2-quart microproof casserole. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Cut butter into 8 pieces and space evenly on top of pecans. Cook uncovered on High (maximum power) for 5 to 6 minutes stirring once or twice during cooking to distribute butter.

title: Beef Wellington
instructions: Spread beef with 2 tablespoons of softened butter. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until filet is brown all over. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Reserve pan juices. Chop onion and mushrooms into fine pieces. Saute in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Cook the liquid down and cool. (Both of these may be done the night before.)

title: Pizza Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Put in a casserole dish a layer of meat cheese and meat. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Melt margarine in medium saucepan. Chop celery and onion finely and saute in margarine. Peel and dice potatoes into 1/2 to 1-inch cubes; add to pan. Add spices and just barely cover with water. Cover and boil for 15 to 20 minutes. Add canned milk reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally to prevent scorching.

title: Kentucky Cream Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and margarine with sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat well. Add flour and baking soda alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla coconut and nuts; fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in two or three 8 x 8 x 2-inch layers at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Russian Crab Salad
instructions: Chop eggs crab meat onion cabbage and greens. Mix everything together. Add mayonnaise.

title: Banana Split Salad
instructions: Mix the graham crackers and 6 tablespoons melted oleo into pan.

title: Killer Brownies
instructions: In bowl mix cake mix with margarine and half or evaporated milk. Using electric mixer blend at low speed. Batter will be stiff. In saucepan over medium heat or in 1 to 2-quart container in microwave melt caramels with remaining 1/3 cup evaporated milk stirring frequently on stove or twice during microwave melting. Keep warm. Place half of cake batter into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Let cool 2 minutes. Dribble melted caramel over top carefully. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts evenly over caramels. Drop remaining cake mixture by spoonfuls all over surface spreading together carefully with spatula. Return to oven and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Let cool in pan at least 15 minutes before cutting into bars. Makes about 24 (2 1/4 inch square) brownies.

title: Betty'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender; peel skins off and mash. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Heat tomato soup. Add lemon jello. Beat cottage cheese until smaller consistency. Add vinegar and mayonnaise to cottage cheese. Chop onion and celery into small pieces. Add the cottage cheese vegetable and shrimp to soup. Pour into serving dish.

title: Eggs Fantastic
instructions: Saute crumbled sausage mushrooms onions salt and pepper. Drain well on paper towels. Combine eggs and sour cream in blender for 1 minute. Pour eggs in greased 7 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until set in middle. Spoon hot sauce over eggs and add sausage mixture. Layer the 3 cheeses beginning with the Velveeta. Casserole may be refrigerated or frozen at this point and baked later. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and let set for 5 to 10 minutes before cutting and serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Crust Mix
instructions: Mix well and put in pan to cook.

title: Rita'S Maple Corn Souffle
instructions: Beat eggs; add melted butter syrup corn and seasoning. Pour into buttered baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Eat while hot (it falls).

title: Mexicali Rice
instructions: In large skillet cook beef until lightly browned. Add onion and green pepper cook until tender. Drain fat add remaining ingredients. Mix well bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 35 minutes stirring once until rice is done.

title: Cupcake Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients; then add 1 teaspoon lemon and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well. Put vanilla wafers in bottom of cupcake papers. Fill 3/4 full; bake and then cool. Top with whipped cream after cooled.

title: Oreo Freeze Cake
instructions: Mix crushed Oreos and butter. Reserve 1/3 of the Oreo mixture. Spread remaining mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice ice cream and place on top of crumbs. Pour Hersheys syrup over the ice cream. Spread Cool Whip over syrup. Sprinkle with reserved Oreo mixture. Freeze.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pack firmly into an ungreased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2 loaf pan. Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 1 hour 15 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing and serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Italian Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef in large heavy kettle; drain. Add all the ingredients except cabbage green beans and macaroni. Bring to boil. Lower heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add cabbage green beans and macaroni; bring to boil and simmer until vegetables are tender. If you prefer a thinner soup add additional water or broth. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving. Yield 12 servings.

title: Rick'S Barbecue Stew
instructions: Cook all vegetables until done. Brown meat in skillet. Add meat and stew mix. Simmer 15 minutes then add barbecue sauce. Add as much water as desired. Sliced okra can be added if desired. Fresh vegetables may be substituted.

title: Glazed Onion Rings
instructions: Peel onions and cut into even thin slices. Heat butter in a large skillet. Add onions and toss for a few minutes until coated with butter. Do not brown. Add vinegar brown sugar and curry powder. Stir to blend well. Add parsley. Cook onions for about 5 minutes covered until almost tender-crisp. Remove cover. Cook onions for 2 to 3 more minutes until glazed. Season with salt pepper and paprika. Add chiles if used. Serve onions hot as a side dish or cool as an appetizer. Or use onions as a topping for green or potato salads.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Saute bacon and diced onion into large saucepan. Add milk red pepper potato and corn. Let cook on medium heat until it thickens. Let it simmer until ready to eat.

title: Whoopee Pies
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Add egg milk oil vanilla cocoa and sugar. Drop by teaspoonfuls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Cook celery onion and pepper in small amount of oil until tender. Add tomato sauce seasonings and mushrooms. Pour over chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 until chicken is done about 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream the softened cream cheese and sugar. Add peanut butter; mix well. Add Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell; chill. Keep refrigerated.

title: Lemonade Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until edges turn brown.

title: Country Cottage Bake
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed on package except use only 1/2 cup milk. Add cottage cheese and celery mix lightly. Spoon into 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Arrange sausage links on top of dinner mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Combine peas and water. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let set for 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boiling point. Reduce heat and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until peas look creamed and ham hock is tender. Remove ham hock. Trim meat from bone and dice. Return meat to soup. Heat thoroughly and serve. Additional water or milk may be added to soup for a thinner consistency.

title: Pink Cranberry Freeze Salad
instructions: In small bowl combine cream cheese and sugar together; stir in mayonnaise. Fold in cranberries pineapple and pecans. Fold in whipped cream. Freeze in loaf pan. When ready to serve let sit 15 minutes. Cut into slices or scoop out into fancy dishes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 until top is browned.

title: Family Favorite Pancakes
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and\tsugar.\tCombine egg milk and oil; add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened.\tBatter will be lumpy. Cook on hot griddle. Makes about eight 4-inch pancakes.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Peel slice and cook carrots. Add salt if desired. Peel onion and chop. Chop bell pepper. Mix soup oil vinegar and sugar together. Drain carrots and cool. Put all ingredients together and stir. Place in refrigerator; let stand overnight. Will keep in airtight container for 2 weeks.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Combine taco mix with refried beans. Spread out in a circle on a glass plate. Layer remaining ingredients in order given. Garnish with taco chips (make a circle).

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Beat all together and mix well. Pour into a pie crust. Bake at 425 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and sour cream and place in bottom of dish. Place salsa on top. Shred lettuce and put on salsa. Place on top of lettuce cheese olives and tomatoes. (Leave tomatoes whole or cut in half.) Serve with corn chips.

title: Glue Paint
instructions: Color white glue with food coloring. Paint on waxed paper (solid paint coverage can be peeled off the wax paper when dry to be used as a sun catcher).

title: Sun Tea
instructions: Buy a \Sun Tea\ pitcher at the General Dollar Store.

title: Easy Golden Layer Cake
instructions: Combine undrained pineapple thawed whipped topping and pudding mix. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut cake lengthwise in thirds. Drizzle with liqueur. Spread 1/3 of pudding mixture over bottom layer of cake. Top with second layer. Repeat layering with pudding. Chill 30 minutes. Sprinkle with toasted sliced almonds. Serves 12.

title: Saturday Night Special
instructions: Brown meat in hot skillet and drain. Add pork and beans tomatoes and salt. Pour half the mixture in a baking dish add layer of sliced onion and cover with remaining beef mixture. Top with strips of bacon and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chip Oatmeal Brownies
instructions: Beat butter until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in sugars. Mix in eggs and vanilla. Stir flour baking powder cinnamon salt and nutmeg. Stir in oats and half the chips. Spread in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle the remaining chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Cut in bars about 3 dozen.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix pudding crushed pineapples. Add cool whip and marchmallows. Mix well and chill before serving. Keep refrigerated. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Devil Crabs
instructions: Simmer the chopped onion celery and parsley in 1 tablespoon butter. Do not let it brown. Then mix the crab meat bread crumbs and chopped eggs together. Add to the mixture 1/2 tablespoon red pepper and 1/4 tablespoon salt.

title: Hearty Hodgepodge
instructions: Cook beef and onion in large pan until beef is browned and onion is tender. Stir in 3 cans condensed soup beans water celery Worcestershire sauce and oregano. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. This makes a large amount and is very good warmed over and freezes well.

title: Dennis' Famous Chili
instructions: In 1/2-inch oil saute until soft the onions peppers and garlic. In another pan brown the beef. Drain fat from beef and add beef to onions and peppers. Add the tomatoes tomato paste and chili powder. Add the sugar salt pepper paprika bay leaves cumin basil and cayenne or hot chili sauce. Simmer all for at least 1 1/2 hours then add the kidney beans. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crunchy Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Brown beef and drain. Combine all ingredients except onions. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
instructions: In skillet brown slowly in salad oil one fryer cut up. Place in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. To skillet add onion and celery; cook until tender. Add catsup water lemon juice brown sugar vinegar Worcestershire sauce and prepared mustard. Simmer 15 minutes and skim off excess fat. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until done basting 3 or 4 times. Serves 4.

title: Slice And Bake Cookies
instructions: In large bowl beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg. In another bowl combine flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. In two batches beat flour mixture into butter mixture just until blended.

title: Creamy Corn Chowder
instructions: Brown bacon in Dutch oven and drain reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings. Saute onion and green pepper in drippings until soft. Add chicken broth and diced potatoes. Bring to a boil and simmer until potatoes are cooked. Add creamed corn seasonings bacon and milk. Heat through.

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except chicken). Take 2 pounds chicken pieces and make slits on the sides. Pour marinade over chicken and mix well. Marinate at least 2 hours.

title: Cinnamon Bites
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tTrim crust from the bread and roll very thin.\tCream together the egg yolk cream cheese and sugar. Spread the\tmixture on bread and roll up.\tIn a separate bowl mix the brown sugar\tand cinnamon.\tDip rolls in butter then in sugar and\tcinnamon mixture. Place rolls on well-greased cookie sheet. Freeze for 5 to 10 minutes. Cut into thirds. Refreeze in\tplastic bags until ready to use. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables as directed. Make stuffing. Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: South Carolina Scotties
instructions: Combine in top of double boiler the brown sugar white sugar and oleo. After this is heated and mixed well take off and cool. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake in greased and floured 8-inch square pan for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool before cutting.

title: Southwest Taco Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 400\u00b0. Partially bake pie crust for 10 minutes; cool. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Brown ground chuck and onion in a skillet; drain fat. Stir in taco seasoning mix and a little bit of water. Combine refried beans and 1/2 cup taco sauce in a mixing bowl. Layer 1/2 meat mixture in bottom of pie shell then half of bean mixture. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 25 minutes. Remove from oven; cool then top with lettuce tomatoes and sauce. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve cold. Makes a very large portion. Could cut recipe in half.

title: Vegetable Bar
instructions: Separate rolls; roll thin and seal seams. Place on a cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Cool. Mix cream mixture and spread on crust.

title: Baked Fish And Rice
instructions: To prepare the rice follow instructions on the rice box. Saute onions in melted butter. Season fish to taste with McCormick Season-All salt Goya adobo all-purpose seasoning and Sazon Goya. Bake until tender at 400\u00b0. Mix fried onion and cooked rice together. Place in pan or dish. Place baked fish on top.

title: Short Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for about 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Surprise Meat Balls
instructions: Combine beef bread crumbs milk and seasonings. Place 1 tablespoon of mixture onto palm of hand. Flatten. Place an olive in center of meat. Mold meat around olive. Place 1 dozen on shallow baking dish. Cook in microwave oven 3 minutes. Insert a wooden toothpick into each meat ball before or after cooking time 3 minutes (for 1 dozen).

title: Chicken Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for the pecans stirring well. Make into a ball and chill in the refrigerator. When cold roll in pecans. Serve with your choice of crackers or bagels.

title: Chili-Cheese Deviled Eggs
instructions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise and remove yolks. Position knife blade in food processor bowl. Add yolks cream cheese and remaining ingredients. Process until smooth stopping once to scrape down sides. Spoon or pipe into egg whites.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Blend together butter peanut butter and sugar and form into small balls or patties. In double boiler melt wax and chocolate bars. Dip balls or patties in chocolate mixture. Lay on sheet to cool.

title: Carrots By Coffelt
instructions: Heat all ingredients except carrots in a saucepan until all ingredients are dissolved. Cool. Pour over carrots and refrigerate. Keeps at least two weeks.

title: Oven Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes. Dry. Do not peel. Cut into wedges. Pour mixture over potatoes and toss until potatoes are covered with mixture. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chili-Cheese Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese along bottom of glass baking dish (8-inch); spread out chili; sprinkle cheese. Microwave/bake at High speed for 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve with taco chips.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Mix sugar potatoes oil eggs and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Put equal amounts into 4 greased 1 pound coffee cans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Eclair Pie
instructions: Mix pudding following package directions using 1/4 cup less milk. Stir in Cool Whip. In a large oblong dish place a layer of graham crackers close together on bottom. Alternate layers of crackers and pudding until you have 3 layers of crackers and 2 of pudding. Using fudge chocolate canned icing spread over top of crackers. Refrigerate to set.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Combine cranberries apple and sugar. Dissolve jello in hot water; add syrup. Chill until partially set. Add cranberry/apple mixture grape halves and nuts. Chill until firm. Serve on sliced pineapple and lettuce leaf.

title: Mustard
instructions: Soak mustard and vinegar 12 hours covered. Add remaining ingredients. Cook in double boiler for 10 to 25 minutes. Beat until custard consistency. Makes 2 cups.

title: Secret Recipe Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cover 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Jean'S Brownies
instructions: Grease a 9 x 10-inch pan. Mix soft butter and sugar until crumbly (electric beater). Add melted chocolate; beat until well blended. Add 3 eggs; beat until almost smooth. With wooden spoon beat in vanilla. Add sifted flour and salt and remaining egg; beat well. Add nuts. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Do not overbake! Bon appetit!

title: Holiday Squash
instructions: Mash squash. Add onion soup sour cream carrot salt and pepper. Butter casserole; sprinkle layer of crumbs in bottom. Add squash mixture. Cover with crumbs and generous dots of butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Crumble bread into large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir. If mixture is dry add mayonnaise. Place in refrigerator 2 to 3 hours to chill.

title: Peanut Patties
instructions: Bring sugar water and syrup to a boil. Add peanuts and food coloring. Cook until hard ball stage. Remove from heat; add butter and salt. Beat until mixture turns cloudy. Spoon out on waxed paper.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Prepare carrots and cut into small slices. Boil in water with salt and white sugar until tender; drain. Melt butter in saucepan with brown sugar and orange juice. Bring to a boil; add carrots. Do not overcook.

title: Jr.'S Club Sandwich Fixin'S
instructions: On one slice of bread put mustard bologna American cheese onion and pickles. On the other piece of bread put mayonnaise ham Swiss cheese lettuce and tomatoes. Cut in half. Serve with corn chips and dip.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: In medium saucepan combine sugar and syrup. Bring to a full boil. Remove from heat stir in cereal and peanut butter. Shape or drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Banana-Nut Bread
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients in electric blender or with mixer. Sift dry ingredients into large bowl. Add banana mixture; mix well. Stir in nuts milk and vanilla. Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool before cutting.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Beat egg yolks lightly. Add sugar vinegar and melted butter. Then add the spices. Beat egg whites to a stiff froth and add to the mixture. Finally add nuts and raisins. Bake at 300\u00b0 in a pie crust for 30 minutes.

title: Butter Cake
instructions: Cream Parkay and sugar; add eggs 1 at a time then vanilla and blend in flour. Bake in tube pan at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done. Excellent with fruit and whipped topping.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased dish; sprinkle with lemon juice. Blend dry ingredients; combine with butter. Sprinkle crumb mixture over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until apples are tender. Yield 6 servings.

title: Grandmama Alsie'S Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour in bowl. With spoon mix in Crisco and milk. Just before kneading add cheese and mix until thoroughly kneaded using extra flour as needed. Roll out to about 1/2 inch and cut out or make small biscuits by hand. Place on greased baking sheet and bake at 500\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Coconut Lemon Sours
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; press into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients; add to crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: 22 Minute Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Do not use mixer. In a saucepan put margarine water shortening and cocoa. Bring to boil and pour over flour mixture. Combine remaining ingredients. Add to batter and blend thoroughly. Cook 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Use a 9-inch pie pan. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie pan. Bake for 20 to 40 minutes until brown.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Boil first 2 ingredients 1 minute. Add the peanut butter (I prefer crunchy) and butter or margarine; stir well. Pour over 3 1/2 cups corn flakes stir well and add another 3 to 3 1/2 cups corn flakes. Put in buttered pan press lightly and cut in squares.

title: Browned Butter Frosting
instructions: Heat butter in pan over medium heat. Mix in sugar vanilla and milk; beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Barbecue Wieners
instructions: Wash turkey thoroughly; pat dry. Season with salt pepper and/or garlic salt. Place turkey in oven cooking bag in pan breast side up add 1 cup of hot melted butter and water in cavity and 1 cup of water to the inside of cooking bag. (Following directions for cooking bag.) Cook in 325\u00b0 oven until meat begins to loosen from leg. (22 pounds approximately 6 hours and 12 pounds approximately 2 to 3 hours)

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain and rinse. Combine diced cucumber pepper and chopped onion. Add 3/4 jar salad seasoning 2 diced tomatoes and 16 ounce bottle Italian dressing; mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Combine eggs sausage and milk. Then add remaining ingredients and mix well. Rest mixture in bowl about 12 hours or overnight. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Spicy Pickled Okra
instructions: Boil first 5 ingredients 1 minute. Stuff jars with remaining ingredients. Pour liquid over okra in jars. Seal.

title: Holiday Squares
instructions: Mix and blend well sugar and soft butter. Add eggs one at a time. Add lemon juice and flour a little at a time. Pour into greased 15 x 10-inch pan and mark into 32 squares. Place 1/2 teaspoon pie filling on center of each square. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Sift with confectioners sugar and cool.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix leek soup and cream cheese. Rinse spinach and drain. Add spinach to cream cheese mixture. Cut circle in top of loaf and hollow out center. Spoon dip into loaf and serve with bread torn in dip size pieces. Also you can serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix until thick. Chill and serve. Yields 6 to 8 servings. Preparation time 10 minutes.

title: Jello Cookies
instructions: Add sugar vanilla baking powder egg butter flour and jello (in this order). Mix together and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Joyce'S Homemade Stew
instructions: Crunch up Ramen noodles into slaw mix. Cut up green onions and pea pods; add to slaw mixture. Mix in almonds and sunflower seeds. In a small container with a lid mix Ramen noodle seasoning mix with oil sugar and vinegar. Pour over slaw. Refrigerate until chilled then serve.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add milk and flavoring; mix. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together; mix well. Fold in coconut. Put batter in large tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Sprinkle dry jello over cottage cheese and mix well. Add drained pineapple oranges and Cool Whip. Chill for at least 1 hour then serve.

title: Tuna Paprika
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet and cook garlic onions and peppers. Drain tuna and shred into skillet with vegetables. Mix the paprika and cream together and stir into skillet. Stir in the sherry and heat thoroughly. Serve with spinach noodles or over rice.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Wash beans soak in water with soda and 1 teaspoon salt overnight. Drain. Cover with fresh water. Add 1 tablespoon salt pepper and bacon; boil until beans are tender. Add brown sugar and dry mustard; pour into buttered pan and bake slowly at 300\u00b0 until brown.

title: Baker'S Chocolate One Bowl Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine and stir in sugar. Mix eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut when warm.

title: Chief'S Waffles
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff and set aside. Mix dry ingredients well. Combine milk and oil; stir into dry mixture. (Stir quickly and only until dry ingredients are moistened; the batter will be lumpy.) Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake on high in preheated waffle iron. For even baking close lid quickly; dont open. Wait for signal light or until steam stops.

title: Easy Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak bread in Pet milk. Beat egg yolks and 1/2 cup sugar. Add milk and margarine. Mix everything and cook until it starts to boil and gets thick. Pour into buttered dish. Beat egg whites and add 1/4 cup sugar. Pour over bread mixture and brown in oven.

title: Easy Lemon Cookies
instructions: Blend well and drop from a teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Mama'S Cabbage(Eline Leblanc Marchand)
instructions: In a large pan with a lid melt butter and add water. Add slivered cabbage apple caraway seed salt pepper and sugar. Place lid on tightly and steam for 15 minutes.

title: Barbecued Brisket
instructions: Pour 3 ounce commercial liquid smoke over beef in baking pan. Sprinkle with onion celery and garlic salt. Place in refrigerator overnight. Sprinkle both sides of meat with salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and bake in preheated oven at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours. Uncover meat and pour barbecue sauce over meat. Bake 1 hour longer.

title: Raspberry Tang Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water and chill until thickened. Whip until light. Mix cream cheese with mayonnaise. Mash banana. Fold both together with pineapple coconut and nuts. Then mix all together with gelatin.

title: Meal-In-A-Skillet
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with Cooking Spray; place over medium-high heat until hot. Add Ground Round and next 3 ingredients; cook until meat is browned stirring until it crumbles. Drain if necessary. Return meat mixture to skillet; add Tomato Salt and Pepper. Cook uncovered over medium heat 20 minutes. To serve stir cooked Rice into meat mixture. Yield 4 (1-3/4-cup) servings.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add sugar frothy mixed eggs oil and vanilla. Beat for 3 minutes then add squash and other ingredients. Makes 2 loaf pans. Cook for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Low Calorie Dressing
instructions: Add milk to cottage cheese and Ranch dressing in blender. Blend to right consistency.

title: 2-Minute Fudge
instructions: *If not using nuts use a little less butter.

title: Banana Butterscotch Nut Pie(Microwave)
instructions: Place milk in\tdeep bowl (I\tuse 1 1/2 quart Corning Ware.) Heat on High for 3 minutes. (You will have to watch to make sure it\tdoesnt boil over.) Beat with wire whisk. Heat at 50%\tat 2 minute 2 minute 1 minute intervals beating at each interval. Using your judgement when right consistency heat at 40% for 2 minutes then 1 minute or at 1 minute intervals continuing to beat at the intervals. (Remember you have to watch it!) Fold in bananas and nuts. Place in crust. Top with whipped cream or topping.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in large loaf pan or tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Place chocolate in top of a double boiler; bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cook until chocolate melts. Set aside to cool slightly. Cream butter with electric mixer. Add chocolate and remaining ingredients beating until smooth.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken and cut in small pieces. Cut grapes in half. Cut water chestnuts in small pieces. Add lemon juice to taste. Mix all ingredients together. Leave the noodles until ready to serve then add to mixture.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Layer with cheeses. Microwave until cheese melts.

title: Corn And Oysters
instructions: Crush crackers. Alternate layers corn oysters and crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lumpia Shanghai(Philippine Fried Egg Rolls, Shanghai Style)
instructions: Combine pork shrimp water chestnuts green onions egg and soy sauce; season with salt and pepper. Place a level tablespoonful of filling on each egg roll wrapper and seal with a few drops of water. Deep fry in hot oil and drain on paper towel. Serve with sweet-and-sour sauce. Serves 4.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Pat crescent rolls in large cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and Hidden Valley Dressing. Spread on crust. Top with vegetables then add cheese.

title: Perfect Boiled Custard
instructions: Mix filling as directed on box add sugar and stir in vanilla. Add enough milk to make 2 quarts. Chill in refrigerator and you have delicious boiled custard.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and Crisco gradually adding flavoring extracts. This will help to cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating on low for 1 minute after adding each egg. Flour should be sifted with salt and baking powder at least 3 times. Add flour and sour cream alternately to batter beginning and ending with flour. Pour into greased tube pan. Place in cold oven; turn oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Blend cheese egg whites yogurt vanilla and lemon juice in a food processor or blender. Add orange juice bananas and flour. Blend until creamy. Bake in a large pie pan on graham cracker crust for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: No Knead Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixer bowl. Set aside. In saucepan over low heat combine oil milk and water. Heat until temperature reaches 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients with the liquids add egg. Blend at low mixer speed until moistened. Beat three minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in another 2 or 2 1/2 cups of flour to form a stiff batter. (Batter will follow spoon.) Cover batter with damp cloth; let rise in warm place (80\u00b0 to 85\u00b0) until light and doubled about 50 minutes. Stir down batter spoon into greased two 8 x 4-inch loaf pans batter does not rise a second time before baking. Immediately place in oven. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool on rack. Brush with melted butter.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all together except crabmeat. This mixture can be made several days in advance and kept in the refrigerator. Add the crabmeat last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with Melba toast rounds or matzos etc. A party hit!

title: Texas-Style Potatoes
instructions: Mix together and pour into pan. Top with 2 cups crushed corn flakes add 1 stick oleo melted and drizzled over corn flakes. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Tiger Bites
instructions: Melt marshmallows margarine and peanut butter. Add in flakes and shape in pan. Let stand about 15 minutes or until marshmallows have cooled.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Saute zucchini onion and garlic. Add seasonings chicken broth and cream; simmer for 10 minutes. Put in blender for a few seconds to puree. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Dredge with flour. Fry (saute) in pork fat. Remove chicken. Fry onion in fat remaining in pan; add okra parsley or pimiento and red pepper. Cook slowly 15 minutes. Add to chicken with tomatoes water and 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt. Cook slowly until chicken is tender and add rice.

title: Macaroons
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Add sugar gradually. Fold in coconut cornflakes vanilla and salt. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet immediately.

title: Yogurt Baked Fish
instructions: Pat fish dry. Dip lemon in salt. Rub over fish. Let fish stand 15 minutes. Mix onion chilies garlic coriander and ginger in bowl. Heat oil in heavy medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion mixture and stir until golden about 10 minutes. Blend yogurt sugar and 1 teaspoon salt. Add to skillet and cook until thick enough to coat fish stirring frequently about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Line jelly roll pan with foil. Set fish on prepared pan. Spread yogurt mixture over fish. Sprinkle with raisins and almonds. Bake 9 minutes for every 1-inch thickness of fish. Serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender. Drain; put into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Heat soups and Cheese Whip. Pour over vegetables. Top with buttered cracker crumbs; bake 25 to 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 12.

title: Pumpkin Swirl Squares
instructions: Combine pumpkin 1 1/2 cups sugar oil and 2 eggs mixing until well blended. Add combined dry ingredients; mix well. Combine cream cheese and remaining sugar and egg mixing until well blended. Spoon pumpkin mixture into greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture over pumpkin batter. Cut through batter with knife several times for a marble effect. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Grate cheese and mix with the oleo. Add flour salt and pepper. Mix well. I mix with hands as this is a stiff mixture. Form in 1-inch balls. Bake about 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool. Store in airtight container. Keeps well.

title: Toffee Bars
instructions: Blend brown sugar flour and oleo until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Remove 1 cup and set aside. To remaining crumbs add baking powder salt vanilla milk and egg. Mix until smooth. Spread batter evenly in 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Sprinkle on chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sweet Rice Cake(An Oriental Dessert)
instructions: You will also need sterilized cotton gauze cloth (approximately 20 inches square).

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar butter and syrup. Heat and let come to a boil. Add eggs nuts and syrup mixture.\tPour into pie crust and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Angel Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Make small balls. Dip top in water then in sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Curry Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate. Serve with vegetables.

title: Cheesy Sausage Biscuits
instructions: Crumble sausage into large skillet. Add onion. Cover and cook over medium heat until sausage is browned. Drain well on paper towels. Combine sausage mixture soup water and biscuit mix until dry ingredients are moistened. Drop batter by heaping tablespoons about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Lo-Cal Italian Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix boiling water with gelatin. Add all other ingredients blending with whisk. Chill.

title: Herbed Mushroom Salad
instructions: Place mushrooms in small bowl. Combine all ingredients except shredded lettuce and pour over mushrooms. Marinate a few hours or overnight. Arrange shredded lettuce in salad bowls; top with mushrooms.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Microwave on High for 4 1/2 minutes or bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cook the uncooked rice as directed on the package. Steam broccoli and set aside. Cook and chop chicken. Mix the chicken soup sour cream cheese and pepper. Put the rice in the bottom of a lightly greased casserole dish. Layer the broccoli and chicken. Pour the chicken soup mixture over the top. Top the casserole with bread cubes and melted butter.

title: Spinach Bars
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan melt the butter. Mix remaining ingredients together and spoon into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool slightly before cutting into squares. Can be served hot or at room temperature.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat cream cheese until soft. Add Cheddar cheese onion Worcestershire sauce lemon juice mustard parsley flakes paprika salt ham and pimento. Mix well. Chill until nearly firm. Shape into a ball or log. Roll in chopped nuts. Wrap in foil and refrigerate overnight. Garnish with additional paprika and olives. Serve with crackers.

title: Escalloped Pineapple
instructions: To 4 cups fresh bread\tcubes\tadd 1 cup milk 1/4 cup sugar 1 stick margarine (chopped) 3 beaten eggs and 1 (No. 2 1/2) can chunk pineapple (well drained).\tDump into greased casserole.\tBake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8. Use as added item to main course.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Simmer chicken in water until done. Cook and thoroughly drain broccoli. Mix soup sour cream mayonnaise sharp cheese and seasonings. Arrange broccoli in bottom of greased 3-quart flat casserole dish. Remove skin from chicken. Take chicken from bone pulling into small pieces. Arrange on top of broccoli. Sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese. Pour sauce over all. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika. Dot with butter. Cook 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook and stir onions and garlic in Crisco oil in large skillet over medium heat until soft. Push to one side of skillet. Add ground beef. Cook stirring well to crumble beef. Drain if necessary. Add tomatoes with juice. Break tomatoes into smaller pieces. Add tomato paste basil oregano sugar and pepper. Stir until well blended. Simmer 30 minutes. Combine cottage cheese 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley. Set aside. Cook lasagna noodles 7 minutes in unsalted boiling water. Drain well. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place thin layer of meat sauce in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Add in layers 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese 1/3 cup Mozzarella and thin layer of sauce. Repeat noodle and cheese layers. Top with remaining sauce and remaining 1/3 cup Mozzarella. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Cut into 12 rectangles.

title: Flaky Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour shortening and salt thoroughly. Then mix egg well and add water and vinegar. Add this to the flour mixture. This is very flaky and tasty.

title: Crunchy Jumble Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl combine butter and sugar; beat until creamy. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Blend in flour mixture. Stir in Rice Krispies chocolate chips and raisins. Drop by level tablespoon onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. In a saucepan or microwave melt butter cocoa and water. Stir. Pour and mix with flour mixture. Mix remaining ingredients and then add. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes in a 15 x 12 x 1-inch pan or at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 13 1/2 x 9-inch pan.

title: Overnight Rolls
instructions: About 5 p.m. dissolve yeast in warm water. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and knead every hour until 930 p.m. Shape in desired rolls and allow to raise overnight (covered). Bake next morning at 350\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients well; refrigerate overnight. Serve in round hollowed out pumpernickel loaf unsliced.

title: Grandpa Chico'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients in bowl. Add milk and egg to the dry ingredients and mix the batter. Then add melted shortening. Stir gently to mix. Bake immediately in a piping hot heavy skillet (about 10-inches) and bake in hot oven at 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve at once. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Basic Cream Pie
instructions: Scald 1 1/2 cups milk in top of double boiler. Combine sugar flour cornstarch and salt. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup milk and egg yolks. Stir flour mixture into hot milk and cook until thickened. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Let cool a little and pour into baked pie shell. Cover with meringue.

title: Cherry Crunch Cake
instructions: Pour pie filling in pan. Spread about 2/3 of dry cake mix on top of filling. Drizzle melted butter on top. Sprinkle chopped pecans over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Olive Filled Cheese Balls
instructions: Cream together the cheese and butter. Blend in flour and cayenne. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Wrap each teaspoon of dough around an olive covering completely. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Bake covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover; add catsup to cover loaf and cook 1/2 hour longer.

title: Turkey Mexican Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onions in oil. Add turkey; drain. Add taco seasoning tomato sauce soup and water. In greased pan put dry macaroni and pour sauce on top. Lay cheese slices on top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Simple Meat Loaf
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine all ingredients listed. Mix thoroughly. Shape into a loaf in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. (Optional Top with ketchup and green pepper for garnish.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes. Do not cover.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Cook rice. Mix rice and broccoli with other ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Stella'S Caramel Corn
instructions: In a 2 1/2-quart saucepan combine brown sugar corn syrup butter cream of tartar and salt. Heat to boiling stirring over medium-high heat. Stirring constantly boil rapidly to hard ball stage (260\u00b0) about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda quickly but thoroughly and pour at once over popcorn in large roasting or baking pan. Stir gently until all kernels are coated. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour stirring 2 to 3 times during baking. Turn out at once on waxed paper; spread apart and allow to cool completely. Break apart and store in tightly covered container. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Frank Burgers
instructions: Mix 1/3 cup soup ground beef salt and 1 teaspoon chili powder and spread evenly on buns making sure to cover the edges. Then firmly press hot dogs into meat; place on broiler pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 450\u00b0. Cook onion and remaining chili powder in butter and add rest of soup and other ingredients; heat and serve over burgers.

title: Chocolate-Amaretto Cheesecake
instructions: Sprinkle chocolate wafer crumbs in bottom of a 7-inch spring-form pan. Set aside. Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add cream cheese and next 7 ingredients processing until smooth. Add egg and process just until blended. Fold in chocolate morsels. Slowly pour mixture over crumbs in pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes or until cheesecake is set. Let cool in pan on wire-rack. Cover and chill at least 8 hours. Remove sides of pan and transfer cheesecake to a serving platter. Garnish with chocolate curls if desired.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Roll steak strips in flour using all of the flour. Brown in butter. Add mushrooms and onion and cook until tender. Add garlic salt and pepper. Add beef broth. Simmer until meat is tender (30 to 45 minutes). Five minutes before serving add sour cream and mix well. Simmer a few minutes. Serve over egg noodles or rice.

title: Raised Doughnuts
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm milk. Add 1 1/2 cups flour and beat until smooth. Cover and let stand until double in bulk (2 hours).

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions and drain well. Cut cream cheese in chunks and add to spinach. Stir until cream cheese is melted. Add mushroom soup to spinach mixture. Fold in 3/4 can of onion rings. Place mixture in casserole dish and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Top casserole with remaining onion rings and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Terrie'S Favorite Ice Cream
instructions: Mix thoroughly and freeze in ice cream freezer (electric or hand crank).

title: Cashew Toffee
instructions: Lay saltine crackers in the bottom of an 11 x 17 cookie sheet. Heat butter and brown sugar together and cook until it reaches 250-268 with a candy thermometer. Remove from heat and stir in cashews. Pour over crackers and spread well. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and place in oven at 400 for 5 minutes. Remove and spread chocolate with a knife. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes or until hard. Break into pieces.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: In a medium saucepan heat oil over medium-high heat. Add onion. Saute 3 to 4 minutes until translucent. Add garlic and kielbasa. Saute stirring 5 minutes until kielbasa is lightly browned.

title: Black Cherry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O sugar and salt in boiling water. Drain cherries measuring syrup. Add water to make 3/4 cup. Add syrup and lemon juice to Jell-O. Chill until thick. Fold half the cherries into 1 cup Jell-O. Pour into large mold. Chill until set but not firm.

title: Just For Kids: Play Dough
instructions: Mix together in a saucepan and cook until ball forms (stir constantly). Knead until cool. Store in covered containers.

title: Easy Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Make a layer of tomato sauce then 4 uncooked lasagna noodles half the cooked vegetables sprinkle with 1/3 of the cheese sauce noodles then a layer made of the cottage cheese Parmesan cheese egg salt pepper and parsley sauce noodles remaining vegetables sauce and remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly around edges.

title: Better Than Sex Cake(I Didn'T Name It!  Recipe Came From Umc In Bonnie, Il!)
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions and divide between 9 x 13-inch and 8 x 8-inch greased and floured pans. While cakes are baking boil pineapple its juice and sugar on stove. Pour pineapple mixture over hot cakes then let cool. Mix pudding according to directions. Spread over cool cakes. Frost with whipped topping (thawed) and sprinkle with chopped pecans (or toasted coconut if you prefer). Refrigerate cakes. Makes 1 (9 x 13-inch) and 1 (8 x 8-inch).

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Take a tablespoon and dip out the amount for the size you want to make. Deep fry in fresh hot Crisco grease. Take out when golden brown and drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

title: Favorite Nana Fairy'S Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together shortening sugars egg water and vanilla until creamy. Add remaining ingredients combined; mix well. Roll into balls. Bake on greased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Squash Balls
instructions: Mix and roll into small balls. Roll in crushed cornflakes. Fry in deep fat until brown.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Slice cheese and arrange over top of potatoes.

title: Banana Nut Loaf
instructions: Cook at about 300\u00b0.

title: Grandmother Gunn'S Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Blend in sugar flour salt and eggs. Add buttermilk and vanilla. Stir until well blended.\tAdd 2 melted sticks of oleo and 1 teaspoon butter extract. Stir quickly and pour into 2 deep-dish unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes or until center is set.\tAllow to cool before cutting. Makes 2 pies.

title: Tarter Sauce
instructions: Blend and put in jar. Refrigerate.

title: Carrots And Apples
instructions: Stir everything and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Meemaw'S Quick Pie
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix with powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and pour cherry pie filling on top. Chill at least two hours before serving. Apple blueberry peach or other pie filling can be used.

title: Potato Strips With Cheese
instructions: Put strips into greased baking dish and pour the milk over them. Dot with butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with cheese and parsley; bake covered 5 minutes more.

title: Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add egg yolks one at a time and mix well. Dissolve soda in small amount of warm water then add 1/2 of buttermilk. Add to mixture and mix well. Add rest of buttermilk. Add vanilla then add flour. Beat 150 strokes. Beat egg whites and add last. Bake about 1 hour in 300\u00b0 oven using angel food cake or Bundt pan. Cake may be eaten as is or may drizzle outside with powdered sugar icing.

title: Cheese Ball
