instructions: Let cream cheese soften. Mix in deviled ham. Form into ball. Roll in nuts. Wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: This recipe is so easy because its made entirely in the pan in which it is baked. Preheat to 350\u00b0. Melt butter or margarine in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. (I do this on the top of the stove at a low heat.) Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over the butter or margarine. Pour condensed milk over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients and press down. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and add taco mix according to directions on package. Mix picante mix and cream cheese together. Make layers of hamburger refried beans picante mix and cheese. Repeat for 1 more layer.

title: Holiday Recipe
instructions: Take love and loyalty; mix it thoroughly with faith. Blend in with tenderness forgiveness and friendship. Whip it with hope. Always spice it with kindness and understanding. Sprinkle abundantly with laughter. Bake it with sunshine and serve it daily with generous helpings and seconds.

title: 1 Crust Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour Crisco and salt until like small peas. Gradually add cold water. Work together but not too much. Roll out on a floured surface.

title: Old Fashioned Chicken Dumplings
instructions: Cut shortening into flour salt and baking powder. Add milk to make a stiff dough. Roll very thin and cut in strips and drop into hot broth. Cook about 10 to 15 minutes slowly. Do not stir or remove top from boiler until ready to serve.

title: Cheese Strata
instructions: Trim crusts from bread. Place 4 slices in bottom of a well-greased baking dish. Cover bread with cheese then the remaining bread. Beat eggs. Add milk and seasonings. Pour over the bread and allow to stand for 1 hour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with or without tomato sauce.

title: Sour Cream Twists
instructions: Sift flour and salt in a large bowl. Cut in shortening and butter as for pie crust. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Beat eggs together. Combine with sour cream yeast and vanilla. Add to the flour mixture and mix well. Let rise in refrigerator for 2 hours. Sprinkle sugar lightly on breadboard. Place dough on sugar; sprinkle sugar lightly on dough and roll to 10 to 12-inch square folding dough into center from either side. Roll out and repeat the folding job until you have used the entire 3/4 cup sugar. Cut into strips 1/2-inch wide and 4 inches long. Twist the strips 3 or 4 times and lay them on an ungreased cookie sheet several inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Deviled Crab Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs and cut lengthwise. Remove yolks and put yolks into a bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Fill holes of eggs with mixture.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except eggs cheese and chips. Put chopped chicken celery onion pimento soup mayonnaise salt and juice together in casserole. Cover with sliced eggs and cheese. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Dry Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix together the dry milk sugar cocoa and salt. Store in a dry container. Put 4 to 5 tablespoons mix to 1 cup boiling water. Top with marshmallows. Makes 32 cups.

title: Chocolate Sin Cake
instructions: Toss chocolate chips and pecans in 1 tablespoon cake mix. Beat together remaining ingredients except topping for 3 minutes then fold in chocolate chips/pecan mixture. Pour into greased floured Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool on wire rack 10 to 15 minutes. Place cake on cake plate. Heat topping until warm (not hot) and fluid. Pour over cake. Serve warm.

title: Pizza Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine remaining tomato sauce sprinkle of garlic powder sprinkle of onion flakes and rest of black olives. Spoon over loaves after baked 25 to 30 minutes. Drain. Put cheese on top. Makes 4 large loaves or 16 to 20 small meat balls.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Spread over graham cracker crust. Cover with 3 or 4 slices of banana. Add large size can of crushed pineapple (well drained). Cover with Cool Whip (large size container). Sprinkle with 3/4 cup chopped nuts and 1/2 cup halved maraschino cherries. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken Noodle Parmesan(Preparation Time: 20 Minutes.  Cook Time: 10 Minutes.)
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan combine soup milk cheese and pepper. Add noodles and chicken. Over low heat heat through stirring occasionally. Garnish with parsley if desired. Serves 4.

title: Super Colossal Cinnamon-Pecan Ring
instructions: Grease a 12-inch pizza pan; set aside. On a lightly floured surface flatten thawed dough slightly. Cut each loaf into 4 pieces (8 pieces total). Form each piece into a rope about 18 inches long. Brush each rope on all sides with melted margarine or butter.

title: Never-Fail Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Spray pan with Pam. Roll mixture out and cut as you usually do. Place about 1-inch apart on pan. Bake for about 8 to 10 minutes until brown.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Place cooked beets in a pan. Combine remaining ingredients and cover beets with mixture. If you have a large quantity of beets continue adding mixture until beets are covered. Bring to boil boil 10 minutes. If you preserve them you can pack them into prepared jars. If not beets are ready to serve.

title: Easy Cheese Danish
instructions: Spread 1 can of rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Pinch together so there are no spaces. Cream sugar vanilla lemon juice cream cheese and egg yolk together. Pour into pan and spread evenly. Spread remaining can of rolls on top of mixture pinching together. Beat egg white and brush on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown. Chill and cut into squares.

title: California Dip
instructions: In saucepan saute the onion and garlic in the butter. Add the tomatoes and simmer for at least 1 hour. Add the chiles and simmer for another hour. Add the cheese. Blend while still on low fire. Serve Hot!

title: Strawberry-Banana Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add next 4 ingredients. Pour half of mixture into 9 x 13-inch dish and chill for 15 minutes. Spread Cool Whip on top of 1st layer. Add remaining jello mixture and chill until set.

title: Strawberry Fluff
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pat onto bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Take out of oven. Stir pat down and bake for 5 more minutes. Repeat. Stir pat and bake 2 more times. Take out 1/3 cup; reserve for topping.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients for 4 minutes. Put in a tube pan that has been greased and floured. Bake in oven for 50 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Toast bread; break up in a greased pan. Stir in raisins. Break eggs over sugar in a pan and beat. Add milk and vanilla. Pour over bread mixture. Sprinkle brown sugar over mixture. Also sprinkle cinnamon and dash of nutmeg.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Simmer celery and onion in 1 cup water for 5 to 10 minutes. Fry sausage and drain. Drain vegetables. Mix all ingredients in casserole. Stir until mixed. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Meat And Cheese Loaf
instructions: Combine ingredients in order given. Press into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Quick New England Baked Beans
instructions: Saute in skillet the bacon and onion until onion is almost tender. Remove from heat. Stir in honey mustard salt and cayenne. Layer half of beans in a 2-quart covered baking dish. Spoon half of honey mixture over beans. Repeat layers. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until honey mixture is absorbed. Makes 8 servings.

title: Black-Tie Red Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except sour cream and chives and place in 1-quart crock or casserole. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour (if too juicy uncover and cook 1/2 hour longer). Serve with side dishes of sour cream and chives for topping.

title: Matzoh Balls
instructions: Cream fat and add egg water and matzoh meal; beat well. Add seasonings and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Sugarless Spice Cake
instructions: In saucepan cook raisins in water until water evaporates. Add applesauce eggs sweetener and oil; mix well. Blend in baking soda and flour. Stir in cinnamon nutmeg and vanilla. Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cake tests done. Serve with whipped cream if desired.

title: Grandmama'S Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix butter eggs sugar juices buttermilk (with the soda in it) and jelly then add 4 cups flour and put the other 2 cups over the fruit; coat it real well. Then add all the spices and the butter and egg mixture to the fruit then add the pecans. Mix well and bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 1/2 hours if using a steeple pan or less time for loaf pans. Line bottom of the pans with paper from grocery bags (cut to fit) grease this real good and dust with flour. Test cakes to be sure if they have cooked long enough.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix cocoa and oleo together. Add sugar and eggs and beat. Add flour baking powder salt nuts and vanilla. Pour batter into greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes. Cool in pan and cut into squares. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Hot Rod Dog
instructions: Heat hot dog as directed on package or grill until thoroughly heated. Place hot dog in bun to form \body\. Place little wiener upright at one end of hot dog to form \driver\ using Cheez Whiz to secure pieces. Attach cherry tomato to top of little wiener with pretzel stick to form \drivers head\. Place tomato slice cut in half upright in hot dog attaching with a dab of Cheez Whiz in front of driver to form \windshield\. Place singles over hot dog in front of windshield to form \hood\. Decorate with a squiggle of ketchup. Attach whole pimento stuffed olives in front of hood to form \headlights\. Attach pickle slices with pretzel sticks; insert both sides of hot dog bun front and back to form \wheels\. Use cracker to form \steering wheel\. Attach green onion slices (white part) to drivers head using dab of Cheez Whiz to form \goggles\. Attach ripe olive slice cut in half to drivers head using dab of Cheez Whiz to form \smile\. Cut olive slice in quarters to form \eyebrows\. Attach pretzel stick to each side of little wiener to form \arms\.

title: Cherry Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix sugar flour baking powder and salt. Cut in the butter then egg to make crumbs. Put half the crumb mixture in bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour cherry pie filling evenly over. Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: In saucepan melt chocolate and butter; add water and unbeaten eggs (one at a time) beating all the time. Add other ingredients; mix until thickened. Pour in greased pie pan or square cooking dish. Let set in oven then turn oven on 350\u00b0. Cook about 30 minutes. Cut in slices when cooled and serve with scoop of ice cream.

title: Spicy Barbecue Beans
instructions: Chop onion. Combine all ingredients and place in baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Avocado And Shrimp Fettucine
instructions: In large skillet heat 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat; add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add parsley shrimp and vermouth and cook for 2 minutes stirring constantly until shrimp turns pink. Do not overcook. Transfer to small bowl.

title: Cottage Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: In a bowl combine the first eight ingredients. Add beef and mix well. Press into an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until meat is no longer pink. Drain. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Yield 4 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Roll in 3/4-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Immediately put Kisses in center of cookies. Remove cookies and place on wire rack to cool.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Fry sausage until well browned. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry-Sour Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add fruit. Pour 1/2 of mixture in a 11 x 7-inch or 9-inch square pan. Refrigerate until jelled. Spread sour cream on top. Pour remaining Jell-O mixture over cream and refrigerate. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Mama'S T Cakes
instructions: Mix sugar and Crisco. Blend well. Add soda baking powder and vanilla. Slowly sift flour into mixture until a soft dough is formed.\tDivide\tdough onto a pile of flour. Knead until it can be rolled out and cut cookies with a jar lid. Put on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Trudie'S Wilted Mustard Greens
instructions: Fry middling meat and remove from skillet. Pour most of grease into bowl and reheat skillet until hot. Add water and this will make a redeye gravy. Add to bowl of grease. Pour immediately over chopped vegetables. Eat with homemade hot biscuits.

title: Quick Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine margarine and sugar; beat until creamy. Fold in egg and vanilla. Combine flour baking soda salt and spices; add to mixture and mix well. Stir in oats. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 9 minutes for chewy cookies or 10 to 11 minutes for crispy cookies. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet then place on wire rack. Yield Approximately 8 dozen.

title: King Ranch Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken broth and both soups. Divide all ingredients in half. In greased casserole dish put in chicken sprinkle lightly with chili powder garlic powder salt and pepper. Follow with soup-broth mix. Then onion and green pepper on top. Make layer of tortillas and sprinkle with cheese. Repeat second layer as first. Top with crushed tortilla chips. Bake covered 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Brown chicken in olive oil. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Serve over rice.

title: Louisiana Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Brown flour in hot shortening in a Dutch oven stirring until smooth. Combine all ingredients and let simmer. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Perfect Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pie crust. Beat eggs slightly then beat in remaining ingredients. Pour into pie crust. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake 45 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. If using fresh pumpkin it is juicier than canned pumpkin so reduce milk to approximately 1 cup.

title: Old Fashion Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg. Combine soda and flavoring to milk. Add this to butter sugar and egg mixture. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll as thin as possible. Cut cookies with round cookie cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Fry beef and onion until done. Add all other ingredients except catsup and mustard; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add the rest.

title: Creamy Chicken And Rice Soup
instructions: Remove skin and bone from chicken. Cut in 1/2-inch cubes. Melt butter in a 4-quart saucepan and stir in chicken pieces. Cook until tender turning occasionally. Add 1 cup water flavor package from rice bouillon cubes parsley and onion. Bring to a boil and stir until bouillon is melted. Add rice mushrooms remaining water and milk. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 30 minutes. Gently fluff rice. Remove from heat. Blend in sour cream and garnish with chopped parsley. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: In Dutch oven heat 2 tablespoons oil to medium heat. Add tortilla strips; cook 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon; drain on paper towels.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix eggs oil sugar zucchini and vanilla in bowl. Then add flour soda salt baking powder and cinnamon. Blend well. Add nuts and raisins. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Cream the cream cheese; add Marshmallow Creme. When well blended add Cool Whip. Serve with chunks of mixed fresh fruit.

title: Yam Oat Bake
instructions: Put drained yams in buttered casserole. Mix rest of ingredients together and place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: In a large bowl combine the gelatins; add boiling water. Stir until all gelatin has dissolved. Pour into a shallow pan. Chill to firm. Cut into squares or using cookie cutters cut out into different shapes. This is great for picnics and parties because it can be left out for a long time and will not melt like regular jello.

title: Homestyle Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup gravy with beef and next 5 ingredients. Shape into 8 x 4-inch loaf in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile heat remaining gravy. Serve over meat loaf. Makes 6 servings.

title: Golden Harvest Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 4 quart bowl combine flour sugar baking soda cinnamon salt and cloves. Add apples carrots coconut raisins and walnuts. Mix well. Add oil milk vanilla and eggs. Stir till moistened. Fill cups 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes.

title: My Favorite Recipe
instructions: Blend love and kindness. Alternately add in small portions appreciation and pleasant companionship sifted with deserving praise. Flavor with carefully chosen advice. Lightly fold in cheerfulness and sorrow. Pour with tender care into clean hearts. Let bake until well matured; turn out on the surface of society. Humbly ask Gods blessings and it will serve all mankind.

title: Pork Chop Potato Bake
instructions: Sprinkle chops with garlic salt and pepper; let stand 1 hour then brown chops. In baking dish layer potatoes and onions. Salt to taste. Place browned chops on top. Mix soup and milk. Pour over chops and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Cook with chopped onion garlic salt and salt and pepper to taste. Heat mushroom soup chicken soup Ro-Tel and taco sauce in pan. Mix soup mixture with meat. Place layer of Fritos in casserole dish. Alternate layer of meat mixture grated cheese and Fritos. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes uncovered.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Bake in loaf pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Can also be baked in muffin tins (12) at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Be sure and grease pan or tins.

title: Haystacks
instructions: In top of double boiler over hot (not boiling) water melt butterscotch morsels. Stir in salad oil. In a large bowl mix chow mein noodles and peanuts. Pour on butterscotch and mix thoroughly with a fork. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper on greased cookie sheet.

title: Congealed Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water. Add rest of ingredients and chill until set.

title: Olmstead Manor'S Peanut Butter Spread
instructions: Blend all together very well. Needs to be refrigerated but tastes better at room temperature. Can be used on bread crackers or carrot sticks.

title: White Clam Sauce
instructions: In a large skillet or Dutch oven saute onion garlic and parsley in melted butter until onion is almost tender; add clams clam broth salt basil and pepper. Boil one minute. Cook pasta and serve with clam sauce.

title: Italian Style Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix in large bowl hamburg onions bread crumbs and cheese and knead by hand to semi-dry mix. Add egg. Add Ragu sauce. Place in large loaf tin. Cover with Ragu sauce and grated cheese (lightly). Cook at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Pumpkin, Oatmeal And Peanut Cake
instructions: Mix by hand and add more powdered sugar if needed.

title: Snow Cake With Topping
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Pour into greased and floured pan. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pears In White Wine
instructions: Wash pears. Pare and core from blossom end but leave steam intact. Brush with lemon juice. Combine wine and sugar in large saucepan. Bring to boiling stirring. Bring until sugar dissolves. Lower heat; add pears. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes or until tender but still firm. Let pears cool in syrup. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Drain pears.

title: Taffy Apple Dip
instructions: Blend 2/3 of sauce with cream cheese. Pat down in pie pan. Top with remaining fudge sauce and nuts. Cut apples in wedges for dipping.

title: Parson'S Punch
instructions: Simmer all ingredients (except orange juice) for 20 minutes in a large Dutch oven. Add orange juice. Strain and discard spices. Serve hot in punch cups or mugs. Makes 4 quarts or 32 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Asparagus-Pea Casserole
instructions: Layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly.

title: Sausage Soup
instructions: Add the first 5 items; simmer until potatoes are tender. Add beans; simmer until soup and beans are hot. Good cooked all day in a slow cooker.

title: Peppered Rib-Eye Steaks
instructions: Brush steaks lightly with olive oil. In a small bowl combine all seasonings. Sprinkle seasonings over steaks and press into both sides. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Grill steaks turning once over medium-hot coals 14 to 18 minutes for rare; 18 to 22 minutes for medium; 24 to 28 minutes for well done. Place on a warm serving platter; cut across the grain into thick slices. Garnish with orange slices and parsley if desired. Yields 8 servings.

title: Texas Barbecued Cheeseburgers
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Shape ground beef into 4 patties. Brush both sides of patties with soy sauce mixture. Grill to desired doneness. Top each burger with Cheddar cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Serve on buns and top as desired. Recipe may be doubled or tripled.

title: Lasagna By Ruff
instructions: First cover bottom of pan with tomato sauce completely. Then add ground meat and cheese. Cover with lasagna noodles (about 4). To start the second layer cover the noodles with tomato sauce meat and cheese. Repeat this process until you have run out of meat cheese and noodles. All seasonings and vegetables are to be cooked with meat. Your top layer should be covered with meat cheese and plenty of sauce so the noodles wont get hard. Cover and bake at 450\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cheese is melted thoroughly. Feeds 6 to 8 people.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Peel carrots; cut in fourths lengthwise. Place in heavy skillet and add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat turning often until tender and glazed.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook 2 chickens; cool. Cut up. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth leaving broth even with spaghetti. Mix ingredients together except Parmesan cheese and add to spaghetti. Mix thoroughly. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish and top with desired amount of Parmesan cheese. Bake for 30 minutes or until casserole is bubbly.

title: Baked Minute Steak
instructions: Place minute steaks in glass baking dish. Mix together soup water and flour. Pour over meat. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 40 minutes.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Peel boil and then drain potatoes. Mash with Carnation milk margarine salt and pepper. Put in a large baking dish. Brown hamburger and onion and drain. Add ketchup salt and pepper. Put hamburger in \well\ you have made in middle of mashed potatoes. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Finnish Pancakes(Pannukakku)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until smoothly mixed. In a 9 x 13-inch cake pan melt 1/2 cup margarine. When melted pour in the egg mixture. Bake in oven at 450\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with syrup cinnamon sugar or powdered sugar.

title: Grandma'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar butter and milk to boil in a heavy saucepan. Bring to full rolling boil over moderate heat stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and chips. Stir until bits melt and mixture is smooth. Add marshmallow cream and vanilla. Beat until smooth and blended. Pour into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Let set until firm then cut in squares.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Line oven dish with potatoes. Spread cheese and bacon on potatoes. Dot butter evenly over. Pour milk salt and pepper. Repeat layers until potatoes are used. End with bacon-cheese layer. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: In oblong casserole dish spread cornbread. Mix melted margarine and chicken broth. Pour over cornbread. Mix chicken chopped celery and onions. Mix with mayonnaise (enough mayonnaise to make like chicken salad) and spread over dressing. Beat eggs and 1 1/2 cups milk. Pour over chicken mixture. Poke holes so milk and egg mixture will penetrate to dressing layer too. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Partially freeze steak then slice across grain into 2 x 1/4-inch strips. Dredge steak in flour. Melt butter in a large skillet. Add meat and onion; cook until meat is browned. Stir in consomme soup mushrooms salt and pepper. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes or until meat is tender. Stir in sour cream; cook just until thoroughly heated. Serve over noodles. Yields 8 servings.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: With mixer blend cream cheese confectioners sugar and butter. In another large mixing bowl blend milk pudding and Cool Whip. Blend the two mixtures together. Crush the bag of Oreos. In desired serving dish layer cookies and pudding mixture.

title: Topaco
instructions: *Your choice of variety ham salami bologna spiced luncheon meat.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Mix butter sugar and syrup together. Beat eggs separate. Add eggs to sugar mixture. Stir then add coconut. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk oil and eggs. Bake in well-greased pans in moderate oven (350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0). Makes 2 pans.

title: Haluski
instructions: In a large pot melt butter. Add onions and simmer until onions are soft. Add shredded cabbage. Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer covered stirring occasionally about 45 minutes or until cabbage is very tender. Add brown sugar. Mix thoroughly. Add prepared noodles. (Depending on your taste as little or as much noodles can be added to cooked cabbage.)

title: Alan And Nancy'S Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms; break out stems (set aside). Place caps on cookie sheet. In large bowl place stick of butter and melt in microwave for approximately 1 minute. Add finely chopped mushroom stems fresh peppers onion and black pepper; mix. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Remove; add crushed Ritz cracker crumbs. Mix well and stuff caps. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion place in bottom of casserole dish. Place cooked potatoes on top of meat. Place cheese on top of potatoes. Pour mushroom soup over mixture. Separate biscuits and place biscuits on top. Cook until biscuits are brown and casserole is hot and bubbly. (Amount of each ingredient depends on number of servings needed.)

title: Caramels
instructions: In an iron skillet over medium-low heat cook all the ingredients 15 minutes stirring constantly. Pour in a greased pan.

title: Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Let cream cheese stand for about 10 minutes; cream the butter cream cheese and vanilla until smooth. Add your sugar a little at a time and mix until smooth. If sugar is lumpy you may want to sift before adding to creamed mixture.

title: Never-Fail Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Butter an 8x8x2 pan or a 10 3/4x7x1 1/2 pan. In a medium saucepan stir together sugar milk and salt. Boil until it forms a soft ball when tested in cold water. Remove from heat; add vanilla and peanut butter. Beat and pour into buttered pan.

title: Basic Marinara Sauce
instructions: Heat olive oil in deep 12-inch skillet and saute garlic until tender but do not burn. Cut tomatoes into small chunks and add to skillet. Add basil oregano parsley salt and pepper and bring to a low boil for 3 minutes. Add wine and cook on moderate heat for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for 15 minutes. Serve over 1 pound of pasta.

title: Fried Turkey
instructions: Mix all together then baste turkey. Set 2 days in refrigerator. Deep fry in peanut oil 3 1/2 minutes/lb. at 375\u00b0.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Pie
instructions: In a saucepan bring rhubarb and water to a boil. Remove from the heat. Add gelatin and stir until dissolved; cool. Stir in sliced strawberries; chill until it begins to thicken. Prepare whipped topping according to package directions; fold half into rhubarb mixture. Pour into crust. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Top with remaining whipped topping and whole strawberries. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Set oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs slightly in 2-quart bowl. Stir in sugar corn syrup melted butter and pecans. Pour into unbaked shell. Bake near center of oven 35 to 40 minutes or until filling is slightly firm. Center of pie may look soft when pie is gently shaken but will become firm when cool.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder into bowl. Cut in butter cheese and red pepper as for pie crust using a pastry blender or 2 knives. Add water and mix well. Fill cookie press using star plate. Form straw on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for approximately 8 to 10 minutes in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven. Remove from cookie sheet immediately to cooling rack.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Chop fine the onions pepper and garlic. In saucepan saute veggies in small amount of oil; add sausage. Cook mashing finely to separate. Cook until done drain off grease good and add Pizza Quick. Mix well and cook 10 minutes. Set aside. Take rolls from package and slice into 4 or 5 slices each. Place on cookie tin and put about 1/2 teaspoon pizza mixture on each slice. Smooth to edge of bread. Sprinkle with grated cheese. After cookie tin is filled with pizzas place in hot oven at 400\u00b0 or broiler to melt cheese. Remove from oven and serve hot or cold.

title: Boiled Raisin Cake(My Mother'S Recipe, Mrs.  Granville Carey)
instructions: Combine the shortening salt water raisins and sugar. Add the nutmeg cinnamon cloves and allspice. Boil mixture for 5 minutes; cool. Add together then mix with the raisin mixture the vinegar and baking soda. Add the flour. Bake for about 1 hour.

title: Rheba'S Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cook raisins and water together for 5 minutes drain and cool. While raisins are cooling mix remaining ingredients together add cooled raisins. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet at 325 degrees for 10 minutes or until light brown. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs; mix until blended. Stir melted chocolate into 1 cup of the batter.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and add seasonings; set aside. In separate pan cook onion in small amount of margarine (or spray). Add tomatoes soups milk and chilies to onion. Line a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole pan with tortilla pieces (enough to cover bottom) then add a layer of soup mixture a layer of cheese and a layer of meat. Add another layer of tortillas and continue layering ingredients until all are used. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Ham
instructions: Mix catsup sugar vinegar and onions. Pour over ham. Bake 1 hour in oven until hot. Could be heated on top of stove also. Serve on buns.

title: Arugula, Egg And Tomato Salad
instructions: Pick over the arugula and discard any tough stems. Rinse well and shake off excess moisture. Core tomatoes and cut into 1-inch cubes. Put all the ingredients into a salad bowl. Toss well and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water until tender. Drain. Arrange stalks in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 11 1/2 baking dish. Place chicken on top. Combine soup mayonnaise and lemon juice; add curry powder. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Pistachio Dessert
instructions: First Layer Mix the flour oleo sugar and nuts. Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Opal(Greek Fried Cheese)
instructions: *Kasseri cheese may be purchased at R. Hirts Eastern Market in Detroit. Or ask your butcher to order it.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough; otherwise just scrub and rinse. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Use a handle to prevent cutting through the potatoes. Put potatoes in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned and cheeses are melted.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops in oil. Combine catsup water honey and steak seasoning. Pour over chops. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes turning chops once. This sauce is also good for outdoor cooking. Makes 4 servings.

title: Country Fried Chicken
instructions: For extra spicy increase poultry seasoning to 1/2 teaspoon and black pepper to 2 teaspoons.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Cut butter into flour until resembles coarse meal. Stir 1/2 cup nuts into flour mixture. Press pecan mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar; beat until fluffy. Fold 1 cup whipped topping into cream cheese mixture. Spread over crust. Chill. Combine pudding mix and milk at low speed. Spread over cream cheese. Spread remaining whipped topping on pudding. Sprinkle with pecans or walnuts. Yields 15 servings.

title: Pizza Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together well. Shape into balls placing 1 cube of Mozzarella cheese in the center of each. Coat meatballs with flour. Brown in frying pan. Spoon off grease. Add pizza sauce. Reduce heat to a simmer and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cool cooked spaghetti by running cold water over it. Add all remaining ingredients and mix. Serve chilled.

title: Blueberry Banana Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell according to directions. Place bananas in bottom of crust. Mix Dream Whip and cream cheese until smooth. Pour over bananas. Let chill until firm then pour pie filling on top. Keep chilled.

title: Green Apple Dip
instructions: Mix cheese sugars and peanuts well to form dip. Slice apples thin and arrange around the dip.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Chicken
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Put chicken in a casserole dish. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Lazy (Snoozing) Sandwiches
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add to a casserole dish; bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Spoon onto bread buns or favorite crackers.

title: Fritos Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Layer chili corn and cheese. Put crushed chips on top.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Bring 6 cups water and sugar to a boil in saucepan. Boil for 5 minutes cool completely. Add frozen orange juice 4 1/2 cups water and pineapple juice to sugar mixture. Puree bananas in blender. Add lemon juice. Add to juice mixture. Pour into 3 large plastic zip-loc bags and freeze at least 12 hours or up to 3 weeks. Thaw 4 to 6 hours before serving. Add one bottle ginger ale to each bag of punch.

title: Cool Whip Pie
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and milk together. Fold in lemon juice. Drain oranges; cut oranges in small pieces and fold into mixture. Pour into pie shell.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Cook lasagne noodles according to package directions. Mash the potatoes. Add cheese to the potatoes and beat with mixer. Saute onion in margarine until soft. Add 1/3 of the onion and margarine to the potato mixture and salt to taste. Generously butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place a layer of lasagne noodles in dish then a layer of potato mixture. Repeat ending with noodles. Pour butter and onion over all. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until heated through.

title: Chili
instructions: Saute first three ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Ranch Beans
instructions: Brown onion and hamburger together. Add other ingredients and stir. Pour into casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: French Dip Sandwiches
instructions: Remove all fat from roast and put roast in slow cooker. Combine all remaining ingredients except bread and pour over roast. Add water to almost cover roast. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or until tender. Remove meat from broth; reserve broth. Shred meat with a fork. Cut rolls in halves spread with butter and grill until brown. Place meat on rolls; dip in reserved broth while eating.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Note I use 1 teaspoon baking powder.

title: Filet Mignon With Horseradish Gravy
instructions: Prepare gravy according to package directions; stir in horseradish and mushrooms. Set aside. Heat a heavy nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add steaks and cook 1 minute on each side. Steaks will be rare. Place in a lightly greased 1 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour gravy over steaks; bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 15 minutes or until desired degree of doneness. Garnish if desired.

title: Poptart Supreme
instructions: Heat Poptart(s) in toaster. Put pudding in a bowl. Put the Poptart(s) in the bowl. Mash together. Eat!!!

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter and sugar. Add eggs and cream for 5 minutes. Add vanilla. Mix dry ingredients together. Add buttermilk alternating with dry ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Cut crust off 3 slices of bread. Spread cheese between each slice and top. Cut in quarters. Spread on side of each. Put toothpicks in each one and put on cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen put in plastic bag and keep until needed. Cook frozen for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes until nearly done; cool. Peel and slice in half the long way. Place in baking dish. Cook syrup from water butter brown sugar and salt; pour over potatoes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Add 1/2 stick margarine and the cheese. Melt 1/2 stick margarine and add to crushed crackers. Put broccoli in casserole dish and top with crackers. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix flour and 1/2 cup sugar until smooth and there are no lumps in flour. Add milk margarine and egg yolks; cook over medium heat until it begins to thicken. Add chocolate syrup and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Pour in baked pie shell. Beat the 3 egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Put on top of filling and bake at 300\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Torte
instructions: Mix together and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in crock-pot on low heat. While cheese is melting brown meat and drain. When cheese is melted add picante sauce and meat to crock-pot. Cook on low heat for about 30 minutes. Mixture can be kept warm in crock-pot for as long as needed. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix potatoes soup salt pepper and onion. Pour in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until potatoes are tender. Add grated cheese and bake until cheese is melted.

title: Spicy Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Combine flour soda and salt and set aside. Beat butter and shortening with electric mixer for 30 seconds. Add sugars and beat until fluffy. Add milk egg and vanilla and beat well. Add dry ingredients to mixture and beat well. Add oats raisins and nuts and mix well. Drop teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove; cool on a wire rack. Makes 30 to 36.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and cut center out of mushrooms. Fry bacon crisp and crumble into cream cheese. Fill mushrooms with cream cheese and bacon mixture. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425\u00b0 or until mushrooms are slightly brown and bubbly.

title: Blt Egg Bake
instructions: Spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice of toast and cut into small pieces. Arrange toast mayonnaise side up in a greased 8-inch square baking dish. Top with cheese slices and bacon. In a skillet fry eggs over medium heat until completely set. Place over bacon. Top with tomato slices; set aside.

title: Party Cookies (M&M'S)
instructions: Blend shortening and sugars. Beat in vanilla and eggs. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to the sugar and egg mixture. Mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup M&Ms (reserve remaining candies for decorating). Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet and decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&Ms. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine butter and sugar; cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs and sour cream mixing well. Combine next 5 ingredients and add to batter; mix well. Pour batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Put beans in large bowl. Brown in skillet the hamburger seasoned with salt pepper garlic and chopped peppers and chopped onions; drain grease off. Add to beans. Pour in tomato soup and mustard. Stir and put in big baking dish. You can use whatever amount of beans you need. Bake at 350\u00b0 until desired doneness.

title: Aunt Perk'S Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Add ingredients together and put into baking dish.

title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
instructions: Add broccoli onion raisins and bacon to a bowl. Mix mayo sugar vinegar and lemon juice. Pour over mixture in bowl.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add tomato sauce and remaining ingredients except noodles and cheeses. Simmer 15 minutes. Cook noodles until tender. Layer 3 noodles and half of the hamburger mixture. Sprinkle with half of each cheese. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into balls. Roll in sesame seed. Eat!!

title: Shortbread Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add rest of the ingredients and mix well. Form into small balls. Bake on ungreased sheet at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool until barely warm. Shake in a bag of confectioners sugar.

title: Salmon Pate
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a food processor and mix until smooth. Refrigerate for several hours. Serve on crackers pita bread or raw vegetables.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread rolls over pizza pan making crust. Brown sausage and spread over crust. Add hash browns and Cheddar cheese. Mix eggs milk salt and pepper and pour over pizza.

title: Canned Grape Juice
instructions: Fill with hot water to neck of jar. Cold pack for 35 minutes. This is a mild juice.

title: Quick Microwave Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients (except margarine) in a glass bowl. Place the margarine on top of the mixture. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir until smooth. Press into a small baking dish. Refrigerate until cold and firm.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter add sugar slowly. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add dry ingredients. Fold in sour cream. Grease angel food cake pan. Place 1/3 of Streusel on bottom of pan then 1/2 of dough 1/3 of Streusel and rest of dough. Sprinkle remaining Streusel on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Prepare cornbread mix (with eggs and milk); add celery and onion. Bake 15 minutes at 450\u00b0. Crumble cooked cornbread mix in large bowl. Add reserved broth salt pepper bread and seasoning. Stir in chopped egg. Spoon half of mix into greased shallow dish spreading evenly. Arrange chicken pieces on top. Spread on remaining dressing. Top with soup and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cucumber Gel
instructions: Use sugar-free gelatin lite cottage cheese and low-fat mayonnaise to reduce calorie count. In a shallow 10-inch baking dish combine gelatin with water stirring until completely dissolved. Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended. Chill until firm and serve on lettuce leaves. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Squash And Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute squash and onion in butter until tender. Stir in corn salt pepper garlic and paprika; mix well. Spoon mixture into casserole dish. Top with croutons or bread crumbs and grated cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Elizabeth'S Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine peanut butter and sugars until creamy. Add water vanilla eggs soft flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture. Mix in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before removing from pan. Cool further on wire rack.

title: Gram'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and\tsugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour cinnamon ginger and cloves. Mix well. Add oatmeal and mix. Add nuts and chips. Mix well. Bake 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chinese Pickled Beets
instructions: Put sugar and cornstarch in large shallow pan. Stir mixing well. Add vinegar cloves ketchup oil salt and vanilla. Stir again well. Add beet juice from can. Cut beets into bite size and put into pan. Cook over medium fire 3 minutes stirring constantly until it thickens. Serve over rice.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in oven in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish or in microwave if using a microsafe baking dish. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter and lightly blend into butter. Arrange pineapple halves cherries and pecans over sugar mixture.

title: Hot Pepperoni Cheese Dip
instructions: In small saucepan combine all ingredients except Cheddar cheese. Cook over low heat stirring until cream cheese is melted. Add Cheddar cheese and stir until melted. Serve warm with vegetables and/or bread sticks. Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Janice'S Peach Cream Cake
instructions: Cut cake into 1/4-inch thick slices. Arrange half the slices on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. In large mixer bowl combine sweetened condensed milk and water; mix well. Add pudding mix and beat until blended. Chill 5 minutes. Stir in extract; fold in whipped cream. Pour half the cream mixture over cake slices; arrange half the peach slices on top. Repeat layers ending with some peach slices for garnish. Chill 4 hours or until set. Cut into squares to serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Strawberry Yogurt Cool Whip Pie(Yields 8 Servings)
instructions: Dice up desired amount of strawberries into bite-size pieces. Leave some strawberries; cut in half for garnish. Mix yogurt and Cool Whip on low speed with electric beater until light and fluffy. Stir in diced strawberries. Pour mixture into prepared graham cracker crust. Chill for several hours. Garnish with remaining strawberries when ready to serve. A great summer dessert!!

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Pour 7-Up in pan and boil. Pour over jello and cheese. Stir until dissolved. Cool until jello begins to thicken. Fold in pineapple Dream Whip and nuts. Pour into mold and refrigerate until firm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Bread (And Cookie) Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs gently (dont overbeat). Add sugar salt nutmeg and vanilla; blend. Add cubed bread cookies or cake; stir. Place saucer on pudding for few minutes so dry ingredients dont float and soak up liquid. Cook in top of double boiler with water barely simmering; cook until table knife stuck in center comes out clean. Serve with scoop of ice cream for each serving.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine peanut butter sugars egg and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients. Combine all and form small balls. Crisscross tops with fork on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Baked Breakfast
instructions: Preheat to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage (or fry bacon and crumble). Drain. Cool. In large mixing bowl beat eggs. Add milk salt mustard and cubed bread. Stir. Fold in cheese and meat. Pour in greased 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Refrigerate overnight before baking. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Upside Down Cake
instructions: Combine and place in a greased 9x13-inch pan. Over the top sprinkle 1 box of yellow cake mix. Drizzle over that one cube of melted butter and the chopped pecans. Gently press the pecans into the mixture.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Place thawed potatoes in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix together next 6 ingredients and spoon over potatoes. Top with crushed corn flakes and drizzle with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate; set aside to cool. Cream margarine. Gradually add 2 cups sugar beating well. Add 3 eggs beating well after each. Stir melted chocolate into margarine mixture. Add flour salt pecans and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Pour batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Set aside.

title: Hamburger Surprise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Make 3 hamburger patties. Peel and thinly slice potatoes carrots and onions. Tear off 3 big pieces of foil. In the center of each piece put a hamburger patty potatoes carrots onions salt and pepper. Bring 4 corners of foil up and fold edges. Will resemble a Hersheys Kiss. Put on cookie sheet and bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Serves 3.

title: Mexicali Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gramma'S Molded Salad
instructions: Bring Jell-O water and soup to a boil and set aside to cool. Stir rest of ingredients into Jell-O mixture. Pour into mold or in flat cake pan. Chill. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add rice and slightly brown. Mix the soup. Cook in buttered baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix oleo nuts and flour together. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread on cooked cooled crust. Mix 2 packages of pudding and 4 cups cold milk. Spread this layer. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Freeze until served.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 8 minutes. Make sauce using cheese butter milk salt and pepper. In baking dish place a layer of crackers a layer of broccoli and then pour some sauce. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Orange Frosty
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ice in electric blender. Process until smooth. Add ice; process until frothy. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Sprinkle pecans and coconut in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix as per package directions. Spoon over nuts and coconut. Combine remaining ingredients in mixer bowl until smooth. Spoon evenly over cake leaving 1-inch edge. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cream cheese mixture will sink to bottom to form frosting. Cool in pan. Cut into squares. Makes 16 servings.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Mix in flavorings. Add flour and baking powder. Beat until blended. Fold in pecans and fruits. Turn into a 10-inch tube pan lined with greased waxed paper. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours. Cool. Keep refrigerated or can be frozen.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Divide in 4 balls roll each into roll and wrap in foil. Refrigerate 24 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Puncture foil so fat can drip out. Slice thin and serve on crackers or sandwiches.

title: Tom'S Favorite Italian Salad
instructions: Marinate first 4 ingredients at least 2 hours. Add to desired amounts of lettuce and fresh spinach just before serving.

title: Tender Tri-Tip
instructions: Follow directions on package of meat marinade except replace water with 4 ounces wine; increase oil amount to 4 ounces. Add wine vinegar and minced garlic.

title: Green Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Scrub potatoes and make shallow slits around the middle as if you were cutting them in half lengthwise. Bake until done 45 to 60 minutes depending on size.

title: Easy Baked Ginger Grouper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put fish in flat casserole dish. Saute onion and green pepper; add tomatoes ginger and spices; boil. Spoon over fish. Bake 30 minutes or until just done. Dont overcook. Serve with rice.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0 F (220\u00b0 C). Combine all ingredients except chicken in a small bowl. Blend well. Dip chicken pieces in batter and place on a baking sheet. Bake uncovered 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown and tender. Or if desired dip chicken pieces in batter then fry in hot oil.

title: Strawberry Supreme
instructions: Dissolve 1 package jello in 1 cup boiling water; add frozen strawberries and stir until berries separate and gelatin is slightly thickened. Pour into a 5-cup mold; chill until set but not firm. Meanwhile dissolve 1 strawberry jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add vanilla ice cream by spoonfuls; stir until ice cream melts. Spoon into mold. Chill until firm about 4 hours.

title: Ham And Cheese Spread
instructions: Allow cheese to soften. Mix cheese onions and ham thoroughly. Enjoy.

title: Alda'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour together. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Add butter and mix well. Pour into pie crust and top with pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes or until set.

title: Stir And Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour baking powder and salt. Stir in sugar. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Oven Baked Kalua Pork
instructions: Completely thaw pork\tbutt. Preheat\toven to 375\u00b0. Slice pork butt in four sections about halfway through then rub down with salt\tand liquid smoke. Wrap with a piece of banana leaf then in ti-leaves.\tWrap tightly with foil; place in a baking pan. Bake for 2 hours then lower heat to 350\u00b0 and bake another 2\thours.\tDelicious by itself or with cabbage!

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars then add eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Stir in oatmeal chocolate chips nuts and coconut. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool for 2 minutes before transferring to wire rack.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Beef And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook noodles according to package; drain. In large skillet brown meat and stir in tomatoes and salt. Heat through. Combine with noodles; put into a 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Pour peaches and juice in baking dish. Cover with bread. Mix sugar butter and eggs and pour over peaches and bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Pull-Apart Bacon Bread
instructions: In a skillet cook bacon over medium heat for 5 minutes or until partially cooked; drain on paper towels. Roll out dough to 1/2 inch thickness; brush with 1 Tbsp. oil. cut into 1 inch pieces; place in a large bowl. Add the bacon cheese dressing mix and remaining oil; toss to coat. Arrange pieces in a 9 X 5 inch oval on a greased baking sheet layering as needed. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes. Cover with foil; bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until golden brown.

title: Quick Fruit Crumb
instructions: Place peaches with juice in baking dish. Mix sugar flour salt and baking powder with fork. Add beaten egg. Spread over fruit. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Carrots In Onion Sauce
instructions: To hot drained spinach add Tabasco salt butter and cream cheese that has been softened with milk. Stir until butter has melted and ingredients are blended.

title: Super Salad Seasoning Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Mix until evenly distributed. Put in a 1-quart airtight container. Label and store in a cool dry place. Use within 3 to 4 months. Makes about 3 cups Super Salad Seasoning Mix.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Add eggs and oil until moist. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple 2 cups bananas and walnuts. Spoon batter into three 9-inch greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pans to cooling rack to finish cooling. Frost when completely cool.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and jello. Add pineapple and Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Pour melted butter into bowl with all other ingredients and mix. Pour back into casserole dish; bake at 400\u00b0 until lightly browned about 40 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Blend together Miracle Whip sugar and oil together well. Pour over slaw mixture and mix until well blended. Refrigerate 1 hour and then stir again before serving.

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions: Broil drumettes 20-25 minutes. Combine margarine hot sauce & vinegar in saucepan. Heat until melted and blended. Add chicken. Toss to coat evenly.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put 1/2 the noodles on bottom of casserole. Layer chicken mushrooms onions celery and water chestnuts. Mix chicken soup mushroom soup and milk. Pour over mixture. Top with remaining noodles. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Cook onion in hot fat; add meat and seasonings until brown. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole drained beans and soup. Mash the potatoes; add milk egg and seasonings. Layer beans layer soup then layer mashed potatoes. Meat goes on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: This cake keeps well and is very moist.

title: Prospector'S Sourdough Starter
instructions: Dissolve dry yeast in warm water. Add sugar and salt. Stir until dissolved. Add flour and stir until smooth. Cover and allow to stand at room temperature for 36 to 48 hours.

title: Ruth Bruce'S Apricot Ribs
instructions: Place ribs in a large heavy pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and simmer gently until tender. Place in pan and baste with sauce. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes basting frequently.

title: Peanut Butter-Chocolate Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix sugars peanut butter margarine and vanilla. Beat in water and egg. Mix in flour soda and salt. Stir in peanuts and candies. Spread dough in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake until light brown 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spread cookie dough on round pizza pan. Bake until done slightly brown. Let cool. Cream together cream cheese and sugar then blend in Cool Whip. Put fruit in a ring around on top until you get to center. Chill one hour.

title: Chicken Paprika
instructions: Saute onion in shortening; add seasonings and chicken and saute about 10 minutes. Add water cover and simmer slowly until chicken is tender.* Add sour cream to pan and mix well. Heat through and serve with mashed potatoes or dumplings. Serves 4.

title: Too Good Noodles And Eggs
instructions: Do not overcook noodles. Use bacon drippings; fry noodles and saute onions. Add tomato pieces. Scramble eggs. Add to noodle and onion mixture. You may add frozen peas.

title: Coconut Chinese Chews
instructions: Mix ingredients in order named. Spread it thin on a greased and floured pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done not allowing the edges to become hard. Cut into 1-inch squares and roll between your palms into ball shapes. When cool ice each and roll thickly in shredded coconut.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain and wash all the beans and the corn. Finely chop the peppers onion and celery. Mix all ingredients together. Add the sugar vinegar and dressing. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crazy Caramel Rolls
instructions: Combine water butter and sugar. Cook until butter melts and mixes with other ingredients. Stir in pecans. Cut biscuits into quarters. Stir and coat each quarter in mixture. Bake in tube pan at 400\u00b0 until biscuits are done.

title: Italian Spaghetti
instructions: Cook and stir meat onion and pepper until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except spaghetti. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream together eggs and sugar; add zucchini oil and vanilla. Sift flour baking powder cinnamon baking soda and salt into wet ingredients. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine chiles sour cream and salt. Spread 1 cup cooked rice in a 2-quart casserole. Top with a layer of 1/3 of the sour cream mixture then 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat layers. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Pour over sugar flour and marshmallows in bowl; stir until marshmallows melt. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan. Spread Coca-Cola Frosting over top of cake.

title: Pizzaburgers
instructions: Combine milk chuck crackers onion salt and cheese in a mixing bowl; mix well. Cut hamburger buns in half. Toast lightly. Spread meat mixture evenly over top of each bun.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients in a large bowl and pour into a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage; crumble and set aside. Separate dinner rolls and arrange in oblong pan; press sides together to form crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Crust will be puffy. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Spoon sausage over dough; sprinkle with cheese.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix pie mix eggs sugar and milk; pour into cake pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over the pumpkin mixture. Pour melted butter over cake mix; top with pecans. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Cake Sift together the sugar and flour. In a saucepan bring to a boil the shortening oleo water and cocoa. Pour over flour and sugar mixture while hot. Add buttermilk beaten eggs soda and vanilla. Bake in sheet pan in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. While cake is baking make icing.

title: Walnut Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients mixing well. Stir in walnuts. Shape dough into rolls. Place on waxed paper. Roll up. Place in refrigerator and chill completely. Cut dough in rounds. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Slice the tomatoes 1/2-inch thick. Do not peel or core. Drain well between paper toweling until most of the moisture of the tomatoes is absorbed. Beat the eggs until light. Mix in cornmeal water chives salt and pepper.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 c. hot water. When cool add strawberries which have been thawed and lemon juice. Whip cream and add to mixture. Put a layer of mixture in bottom of pan. Break cake into small chunks. Alternate layers of cake and mixture until all is used. Chill. Slice and serve with whipped cream.

title: Refrigerator Dessert
instructions: Prepare puddings according to package directions. Line graham crackers on bottom and sides of square pan. Pour vanilla pudding on graham crackers and smooth out put another layer of graham crackers and top this with the chocolate pudding then top with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated. Enjoy!

title: Eva'S Tomato Aspic
instructions: Season tomato juice to\tyour liking with seasonings. Melt gelatin in small amount of tomato juice over medium heat. Mix with remainder of juices and grated onion. When this mixture begins to congeal add sliced or\tchopped olives and celery. Slice in squares when congealed. I add more gelatin (about 2 teaspoons). It slices or\tunmolds better. Yield 2 Pyrex dishes 10 x 6-inches.

title: Butter Crescents
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl. Add 1 cup melted butter sugar eggs and salt; stir well. Gradually add flour mixing well. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) free from drafts 4 hours.

title: Rhubarb Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Place rhubarb in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with the gelatin sugar and marshmallows. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour batter over marshmallows. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes. Invert cake onto a serving platter. Serve with whipped topping if desired. Yield 12 to 16 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Place sweet potatoes in large mixer bowl and beat until smooth. Add remaining ingredients except egg whites; blend until smooth. Beat egg whites in small mixer bowl with clean beaters at medium speed until stiff but not dry. Fold into potato mixture. Pour into 8-inch nonstick baking pan and bake uncovered 50 to 60 minutes until golden and set. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broiled Lamb
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for lamb. Mix well and pour over lamb in glass dish. Turn lamb to coat well. Refrigerate overnight turning occasionally.

title: Spicy Taco Dip
instructions: Combine Ranch dressing mayo milk and sour cream. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer cheeses peppers black olives and tomatoes. Refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Cook dates sugar egg butter and vanilla in skillet. Add Rice Krispies and nuts. Roll in coconut. Makes about 56 balls.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Soak strips of steak in soy sauce at least 30 minutes. Cut up medium onion and large bell pepper in chunks. Heat margarine until it sizzles then cook onions and peppers until they are tender. Drain steak; add to vegetables and cook for about 10 to 15 minutes. Add small amount of soy sauce to taste along with salt and pepper.

title: Everlasting Rolls
instructions: Put milk shortening and sugar in saucepan over low heat; let scald not boil. Take off heat and when lukewarm add yeast which has been dissolved in small amount of water. Place mixture in a large bowl and add enough flour to make dough the consistency of waffle batter. Let rise for two hours until doubled in bulk. Add salt baking powder and soda and enough flour to make dough. Take half of mixture and place in another bowl. Cover each bowl with foil and place in refrigerator and let rise overnight. Dough will keep for a week to 10 days in refrigerator and full recipe does not have to baked at one time. Take amount of desired dough from bowl. Place on floured board and make rolls into desired shape. Place on greased pan and let rise for 2 hours at room temperature. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown. Yields approximately 75 rolls.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Beat sugar and shortening together until creamy. Add beaten eggs. Mix baking powder soda salt and flour together. Add these alternately with buttermilk and bananas into sugar mixture. Add vanilla and pecans. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar oil and egg and beat. Add flour and salt. Mix well and let stand for 2 hours. Then work down well and make into small balls. Let rise for 2 hours and then bake until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Cowboy Potatoes
instructions: Fry bacon and remove from pan. Fry potatoes in bacon grease along with onions and peppers. Dice bacon and add to mixture. Season.

title: Marshmallow Squares
instructions: You will need a measuring cup 30 cm (12-inch) deep rectangular dish wooden spoon and kitchen knife.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all except for cheese. Put into casserole dish; top with shredded cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: In large bowl beat shortening until fluffy. Gradually add sugars. Beat well. Add eggs; beat well. Combine oats flour salt and soda; stir well. Stir in vanilla; add chocolate chunks and pecans. This will be very stiff. Drop by tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Let cool then transfer to wire rack. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Combine first five ingredients and boil one minute. Cool and pour over the remainder of ingredients. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix flour soda spices and sugar together in a large bowl. Add applesauce melted butter raisins and nuts. Pour into loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Best to bake the day before it is served.

title: Cheese Cake Squares
instructions: Beat cake mix butter and 1 egg together. Press into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Mix cream cheese 3 eggs and sugar together. Pour over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Add soup and milk. Stir well. Add American cheese spread; heat and stir until mixture is smooth. Add broccoli and rice. Mix well. Place in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Mix ground beef onion and garlic in 2-quart casserole. Microwave at High 5 to 9 minutes. Break up beef and drain. Stir in sauce water chili powder salt and pepper. Microwave on High 6 minutes stirring after 1/2 time. Alternately layer tortillas meat sauce and cheese in 1 1/2-quart round casserole ending with cheese. Microwave at High 1 to 3 minutes until cheese is melted. Let stand 2 to 3 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: My Best Meat Loaf
instructions: Melt Spry in skillet. Add onion and green pepper. Fry about 10 minutes. Combine all remaining ingredients except catsup. Add onion and mix thoroughly. Pack in 5 x 10-inch Spry coated loaf pan. Spread catsup on top. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve hot or cold. Makes 8 servings.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan; cook until thick.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops in a small amount of grease in frying pan. Set aside. Spray baking dish with Pam. Layer potatoes in bottom of pan. Arrange pork chops on top of potatoes. Pour cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup on top of pork chops. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini-Sausage Squares
instructions: Brown sausage. Break up very small. Stir together all ingredients except zucchini. Add that last. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm. They warm up in oven covered very nicely.

title: Coconut Chew'S
instructions: Cream butter and confectioners sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in flour. Press evenly in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients; spread over hot baked layer. Bake for 20 minutes longer.

title: Lima And Ham Salad
instructions: Combine dressing beans potatoes ham celery green onion parsley and chives in a large salad bowl. Cover; refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Before serving stir in snow peas or sugar snap peas. To serve if desired place halved tomato slices on a platter. Top the salad mixture or mound portions of salad on individual lettuce lined plates. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Cherry Bars
instructions: Beat eggs then add cake mix cherry pie mix and almond flavoring mixing by hand. Spread in greased jelly roll pan (11 x 16-inch) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. When cool frost.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in plastic baggie. Mix egg and milk. Dip chicken in egg and milk then place in baggie; shake well. Place in pan. Pour 1/2 stick melted butter over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Sunrise Pound Cake
instructions: Beat eggs seven minutes. Continue slowly beating and slowly pour in cup of cooking oil. Slowly pour in two cups of sugar. When this is well blended slowly add the two cups of sifted flour. Beat seven more minutes. Bake in a tube pan at 325\u00b0 for at least an hour. This makes a large cake.

title: Potato Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Butter baking dish. Slice potatoes to cover bottom of dish. Slice onion and lay across potatoes. Cook Minute rice and spread on top of onion. Cook hamburger; drain and put on top. Sprinkle with salt. Cover hamburger with vegetable soup right out of can. Pour 1 to 1 1/2 cans water (use soup can) over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: German Meatball And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine beef egg onion milk bread crumbs salt and pepper; mix well. Shape into 1-inch meatballs. In a medium skillet (medium-low heat) in hot salad oil brown meatballs; add undiluted beef broth and simmer covered 30 minutes. In a large saucepan cook noodles and drain. Toss caraway seed and noodles. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix the peanut butter powdered sugar butter vanilla and mayonnaise. Chill for 1 hour. Shape mix into balls. Stick toothpick in and dip into melted chocolate and paraffin 3/4 of way. (Melt the chocolate in double boiler.) Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
instructions: Mix well the butter confectioners sugar and vanilla. Sift together and stir in flour and salt. Stir in nuts. Chill dough. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Form into 1-inch balls. Place about 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until set but not brown. While still warm roll in confectioners sugar. Let cool then roll again in sugar.

title: Holiday Snowflakes
instructions: Melt candy according to package instructions. In a large mixing bowl add Chinese noodles and peanuts to candy mixture and stir well until all covered with chocolate mixture. Place onto wax paper with a teaspoon to form mounds. Sprinkle mounds with green and red crystals and let cool.

title: Porcupine Beef Balls
instructions: Lightly grease a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Set aside sauce. Add 1/2 cup water if sauce is thick. Combine beef rice onion salt and pepper. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls and put in casserole. Pour tomato sauce over meatballs. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. Add dry ingredients alternately with eggs and flavorings. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tomato Stuff
instructions: Cut up tomatoes onion and peppers; cook until tender. Salt and pepper to taste. Blend the flour and water together; add to cooked mixture. This will slightly thicken the mixture.

title: Fruit Salad Or Dessert
instructions: Drain liquid from fruit cocktail and save. Add crushed pineapple drained mandarin oranges and marshmallows. Rinse maraschino cherries and add. These can also be cut in half. Add Cool Whip to make it soft. Refrigerate. Add remaining fruit juice as mixture thickens.

title: Milk Chocolate And Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine peanut butter and butter; beat until smooth. Add sugar eggs and vanilla; beat until creamy. Blend in flour and salt. Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips. Spread evenly over top. Makes 48 bars.

title: Jean'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Bring water onion and margarine to a boil. Add broccoli; stir until thawed. Remove from heat; add rice. Cover and let stand five minutes. Add Cheez Whiz and soup. Put in a 2-quart casserole; top with onion rings. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Steak And Rice Special
instructions: Flour and brown steak in oil turning to brown all sides. Add onion and stir constantly until transparent. Add water and remaining ingredients mixing well. Cover and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over hot rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Thaw out strawberries. Mix in pie filling. Add bananas; stir. Chill well and serve.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix 1 stick margarine potatoes sour cream undiluted chicken soup onion cheese salt and pepper. Divide into 2 greased 9-inch pans. Cover each with topping of crushed corn flakes and other stick of melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. You may freeze one for later use if desired. Very good piping hot!!

title: Rhubarb Dream Dessert
instructions: Blend together and press mixture into ungreased 7 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and 1 stick margarine add sugar and beat until smooth. Add egg yolks beat well. Add combined flour and soda alternately with buttermilk. Stir in 1 tsp. vanilla and 1 c. pecans. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into three greased and floured 8-inch cake pans. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Felix'S Chicken Breasts
instructions: Line baking dish with dried beef. Wrap chicken breasts with bacon strips and place in the baking dish. Mix mushroom soup and mushrooms with sour cream; spread over the chicken. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Cinnamon Loaf(Breakfast)
instructions: You will need two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice according to instructions. Add oleo. Mix well. Add corn and soup. Add cheese; combine with mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven.
