Add the coconut then remaining flour. Drop with teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Pour hot vinegar solution over okra etc. in the jar. Seal; do not crowd okra in the jar. It takes at least three weeks to pickle and get crisp.

title: Cottage Cheese Muffins
instructions: Sift the first 5 ingredients into bowl and mix in oats and cornflakes. Beat egg yolk; add fat cheese and milk. Pour liquid mixture into a \well\ in the dry ingredients and beat. Fold in the beaten egg whites. Bake in muffin tins in a slow oven at 300\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Mother'S Cookies
instructions: Mix all together in bowl. Turn out on floured cloth or board and roll thin; cut with cookie cutter. Bake in moderately hot oven until brown.

title: Grilled Potatoes
instructions: Drain potatoes. Pour into aluminum pan. Chop onions and peppers (green and red) and place in pan. Add salt to taste. Add 1/2 stick of margarine. Add 2 teaspoons of bacon bits. Cover with foil and place on hot grill. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Strata
instructions: Place 6 slices bread on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with 1 cup Cheddar cheese broccoli ham and remaining bread slices cut in half diagonally. Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Blend in milk and mustard; pour over bread. Top with remaining Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Add sugar and flour; mix well. Beat eggs. Add to sugar mixture; mix until smooth. Add vanilla and milk. Cook on medium flame stirring constantly until quite thick. Remove from burner. Layer the following in a large bowl one layer of wafers one layer of sliced bananas and one layer of pudding mixture. Repeat until all pudding is used. Top with layer of vanilla wafers. Scrumptious!

title: Crockpot Chicken Breast
instructions: Combine soup sour cream wine and mushrooms. Place chicken breast in crockpot. Sprinkle with salt pepper and paprika. Cut onion into 1/4 inch slices and break apart into rings. Spread over chicken. Pour soup mixture over all and spread evenly. Sprinkle some more paprika over top. Cook on low setting 6-8 hours. Serve over rice. Yield 4-6 servings.

title: Italian Marble Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour pan. Prepare marble cake mix as directed and pour into pan. In a mixing bowl mix Ricotta sugar 4 eggs and vanilla. Layer over marble cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Allow cake to cool. Serve.

title: Potato Pie With Brandy Hard Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl beat at high speed the egg whites into soft peak. With mixer at low speed beat egg yolks potatoes milk sugar cinnamon ginger nutmeg cloves and salt until well blended. Fold in egg whites. Pour mixture in crust and bake until set.

title: Sylvia'S Stuffed Acorn Squash
instructions: Cut acorn squash in half (1/2); scoop out seed with spoon. In greased pan bake face down at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cook bacon; remove and crumble. Retain grease. In retained grease saute onions bell peppers hot peppers and tomatoes until tender. Add milk cheese butter sugar and crumbled bacon. Take squash and scoop out the squash; save shell. Mix squash with ingredients. Spoon mixture into shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: Mix preserves soup and dressing. Pour over chicken. Marinate for several hours or overnight. Put chicken in casserole. Cover with marinade. Cover with foil and bake at 300\u00b0 until done. Uncover and brown.

title: Italio Spaghetti
instructions: In skillet brown beef and onions; drain grease off. Return to skillet. Reduce temperature. Add thyme oregano salt pepper and dry mustard. Mix in browned beef. Pour tomato juice over mixture. Add broken spaghetti. Press spaghetti into mixture until it is covered with juice. Cover skillet and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Sesame Twist Quick Bread(Three Star)
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Form dough into smooth ball and knead 30 seconds of floured board. Roll into rope 2 inches thick and cut into 16 pieces. Roll each piece 8 inches long lapping ends. Fold in half twist once and pinch ends together. Place on buttered baking sheet; brush with slightly beaten whole egg. Sprinkle with lots of sesame seed. Bake in upper third of preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Don'S Rotisserie Chicken
instructions: Put green pepper salt pepper margarine and onion inside chicken. Lay bacon over breast area and tie chicken well. Put on spit and rub a little margarine over chicken. Put on rotisserie and cook on medium or low until well done.

title: Quick And Easy Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put pie crust into pie pan as directed on package. Combine all other ingredients (except vegetables etc.) in mixing bowl and mix lightly. Add vegetables bacon meats etc. if desired. Pour into crust. Mixture will look lumpy due to Cheddar cheese. Put in oven and bake 55 to 60 minutes. Quiche should have a slight brown coating when cooked completely.

title: Vegetable Stew
instructions: Saute in oil the onions garlic and pepper. Flour the eggplant and brown on all sides in the oil. Add the vegetables. Cover and steam 6 to 8 minutes until just barely tender. Add grated cheese. Serve over cooked egg noodles. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: A B C Sweet Treats
instructions: You will need waxed paper.

title: Orange Pork Chops
instructions: Place chops in a roasting pan; mix other ingredients and pour over chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place by heaping spoonfuls into greased skillet. Flatten into patties. Makes 8 patties.

title: Koinonia Granola
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt in a large roasting pan the oil margarine molasses vanilla brown sugar honey and salt. When mixed let cool slightly and add the oats sesame seed chopped nuts garage nuts wheat germ coconut and sunflower seeds. Stir thoroughly. Bake in shallow pans for 20 to 25 minutes. Stir every 5 to 7 minutes. After granola has cooled add the raisins. Very good as a snack.

title: Waist Watchin' Popcorn Snack
instructions: In a large bowl combine hot popped corn nuts pretzels and bran squares. In a small saucepan melt margarine with mustard. Pour over popcorn mixture tossing gently to coat. Sprinkle herb and spice mix over coated corn and toss again. Spread coated corn on baking sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately or store in airtight container. Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Drain all canned ingredients. Put in bowl. Add bell pepper onion and Italian dressing. Cover and let sit overnight. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well the first 6 ingredients. Roll in chopped pecans. Refrigerate and serve with crackers.

title: Cool Cucumber Rice Salad
instructions: Combine rice cucumber green pepper and radishes. Blend remaining ingredients (dressing mustard and pepper). Toss dressing mixture lightly with rice mixture and chill. Makes 6 servings.

title: Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine and sugars. Add eggs; mix well. Add flour soda and salt. Stir in oatmeal pecans and coconut. Chill dough. Make into rolls 1 1/2 inches. Refrigerate overnight or freeze rolls. Slice thin and bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Leave plenty of space between cookies on cookie sheet; they spread a lot.

title: Betty'S Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream together eggs margarine and sugar. Add bananas. Into another bowl sift together flour salt and soda. Add flour mixture a little at a time to sugar-butter mixture mixing well after each addition. Add nuts. Pour batter into a well greased and floured angel cake pan and bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Can be frozen.

title: Rolls
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in fat. Mix with warm water. Let rise 1 hour or until it doubles its size. Add 1 or 2 tablespoons flour and knock down. Put in refrigerator with cover and use as needed.

title: Velvet Angel Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate with the coffee in saucepan over low heat until blended; cool. Stir in vanilla then fold into whipped cream. Fill meringue shell. Refrigerate overnight or approximately 12 hours. Garnish with additional whipped cream shaved chocolate and pecan halves.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; place in iron skillet and bake in oven at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Dip
instructions: Combine tomatoes water garlic and herbs in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass or ceramic dish and cover tightly with microwave plastic wrap. Cook at 100% in a high-wattage microwave oven for 8 minutes. Prick plastic to release steam. Remove from oven and uncover; stir well. Re-cover and cook for 8 minutes longer. Prick plastic to release steam. Remove from oven and uncover; stir well and allow to stand stirring occasionally until cool and most of liquid is absorbed. Transfer to 1 1/2-quart dish; pour both oils over tomato mixture. Cover tightly with plastic wrap; cook for 5 minutes more. Prick plastic; remove from oven and uncover. Stir and leave until cool. Transfer to food processor and puree until smooth scraping down sides of bowl. Serve at room temperature with thinly sliced Italian bread crackers or cut up vegetables. Will keep in refrigerator (tightly covered) for up to one month. Makes approximately 3 cups.

title: Sour Cream Softies
instructions: Measure flour salt baking powder and soda into a sifter. Cream the butter or margarine with sugar until well blended in a large bowl. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift in flour mixture adding alternately with sour cream and blend well to make a thick batter. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 4 inches apart on greased cookie sheets. Spread into 2-inch rounds. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar if desired. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) for about 12 minutes or until light golden around edges. Remove from cookie sheets and cool completely on wire racks.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into graham cracker crust and top with meringue; brown.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: This makes a thin batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 or 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
instructions: In a small bowl combine soup paprika and pepper. In a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish arrange potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Spoon mixture over cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered. Uncover and bake 10 more minutes or until tender.

title: Chocolate Gem Pie
instructions: For crust combine flour pecans and brown sugar. In a heavy saucepan melt shortening and 1 square of chocolate over low heat stirring constantly. Stir into flour mixture until combined. Mix vanilla and water and sprinkle over mixture while tossing. Form into a ball. Roll out to make a 12-inch circle between 2 sheets of wax paper. Remove waxed paper. Place crust into a 9-inch pie plate; flute edge. Prick well. Bake until surface appears dry. Cool.

title: Coconut Custard
instructions: Add all ingredients together. Blend well. Bake in oblong Pyrex dish lightly sprayed with Pam. Cook in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Microwave Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Melt margarine in baking dish. Add potatoes onion and garlic. Cover loosely with Saran Wrap and cook on Full power for 5 minutes in microwave. Add green pepper salt and pepper and toss. Add cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Cook for 6 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: You will need 1 large bowl.

title: Cream Cheese Pie Crust
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese slowly add flour then add vanilla. Good for any type pie may also be used for tart shells.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Cook the bottom crust. Cook butter water sugar and cornstarch until it boils. Pour 1/2 over bottom crust; pour fresh berries on next leveling down; next add pie filling and then top crust. Pour the rest of syrup on top and brown in oven.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix oil and sugar; add eggs one at a time and continue mixing. Add pumpkin and mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and add to wet mixture. Add water and mix by hand well until smooth. Pour into greased loaf pans and bake for 50 to 60 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Watch at the end of baking and cover top with foil if getting too brown. Makes 2 large loaves.

title: No Peek Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients in a 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Do not peek until it is done. Serve over noodles or rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Mexican Cheese Soup
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Boil potatoes and garlic in salt water until tender. Drain. Turn heat to simmer; add butter milk tomatoes chilies Tabasco and green onions. Do not allow milk to boil. When warm drop in cheese. As cheese just starts to melt the soup is ready to serve. Feeds one Mexican Army.

title: Diet Butternut Squash
instructions: Pour into a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese Log
instructions: Mix together shape into log. Roll in chopped nuts. Chill until firm. Serve with crackers and vegetables.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta. Rinse with cold water and drain. Drain and chop tomatoes. Save liquid. Melt cheese with 2 Tbsp. tomato liquid in microwave or on stove top. Add 1/3 cup liquid to cheese. Mix everything together in large bowl. Serve cold or at room temperature. Stir when ready to serve. Makes a lot.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil sugar water and Jell-O for 1 minute. Cool. Have baked pie shell. Place strawberries in shell. Pour the mixture over the strawberries. Refrigerate to set. Before serving cover with whipped cream.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix and bake in unbaked pie shell until firm.

title: Lumpiaphillipines
instructions: Brown the beef and drain. Mix together all remaining ingredients except lumpia wrappers. Cook for 20-30 minutes drain away excess liquid. Sit for 10 minutes before wrapping. Put some of the mixture onto a wrapper fold over each side then roll up. Making a little package. Fry in the oil until golden brown.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Blanch all ingredients until al dente.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Beat together or mix in blender; refrigerate.

title: Cinnamon Munch
instructions: Combine sugar and cinnamon set aside. Melt butter over low heat in skillet. Add Chex and stir to coat. Heat for 5 minutes more sprinkle with half of sugar/cinnamon mixture and stir to coat cereal pieces. Add remaining sugar/cinnamon and stir. Spread on paper towels to cool.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Salad(Servings:  6)
instructions: Cook chicken breast. Add Japanese cucumbers and bean sprouts. Mix these ingredients.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Chop chicken in food processor. If you are going to use your chicken salad for sandwiches chop medium fine. To serve on lettuce chop and leave it in medium-small chunks. Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine cake mix nuts and melted butter. Crumble mixture over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Southern Cannon Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Roll into walnut-size balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve hot!

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and place in prepared 9 x 3 cake pan. Top with 1 cup crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Sharon'S Gourmet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes (cook whole in skin). Cool thoroughly. Shred potatoes coarsely. Combine mild and sharp cheeses 1/4 cup butter and 1/2 cup sweet milk; cook over low heat until cheeses melt. Add sour cream onion salt and pepper. Put shredded potatoes in 9 x 13-inch glass pan pour mixture over potatoes and dot with remaining butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes until golden brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Khyar Bil-Laban (Lebanese)(Cucumber-Yogurt Salad)
instructions: Mash garlic with salt and fresh mint in bowl. Add yogurt blending well. Peel and cut cucumbers in half lengthwise then slice in thin half rounds. Add cucumbers to yogurt mixture. Fold together gently. This is especially refreshing in summer. Serves 4. Garnish with fresh mint.

title: Honey Mustard Baked Beans
instructions: In small saucepan combine first 6 ingredients and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add beans and simmer for 2 minutes. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Italian Zucchini Crescent Pie
instructions: Cook and stir sliced zucchini and chopped onion in margarine for 10 minutes. Stir in parsley salt pepper garlic powder basil and oregano leaves. Combine eggs and cheese; stir into zucchini mixture.

title: Blueberry Cream Cheese Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Fill muffin tin with cupcake liners. In processor whip cream cheese lemon juice and vanilla until smooth. Beat in eggs. Add milk and butter and blend. Combine next 5 ingredients and beat into cream cheese mixture until well blended. Fold in blueberries. Pour into muffin tins. Fill 3/4 full. Sprinkle tops with sugar and cinnamon mixture. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Dressing
instructions: Combine cornbread and biscuits in large baking dish and pour 4 cups chicken broth over cornbread and biscuits. Let soak. Chop onions and celery. Cook onion and celery in margarine over low heat until tender. Mix together remaining ingredients. Add celery onion eggs salt pepper sage and broth to first mix. Stir as little as possible. (Overstirring will cause dressing to be soggy.) Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks add other ingredients and cook over hot water until the mixture is of a jelly-like consistency. Pour into pastry shell; cover with meringue and bake in a slow oven about 15 minutes.

title: Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs and butter. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Push down firmly. Melt marshmallows in milk in double boiler. Cool. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread on crumb mixture. Spread pie mix. Chill 4 or more hours.

title: Fried Cabbage
instructions: Cut the cabbage very fine. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Stir well and let stand for 5 minutes. Drop lard onto a hot iron kettle; then the cabbage stirring briskly until cabbage is quite tender. Add cream and remove kettle from the fire. Then stir in cider vinegar.

title: Chicken And Broccoli With Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Mix margarine and flour together in saucepan. Cook briefly over medium heat. Blend in chicken broth stirring constantly until thickened and smooth. Stir in mushrooms and their liquid. Season to taste. Place broccoli pieces in a shallow baking pan. Cover with sliced chicken and pour mushroom sauce over all. Top with parsley and bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 uncovered for 15 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and brown on top.

title: Facelift Casserole(Breakfast Casserole)
instructions: Brown and drain sausage and set aside. Beat eggs and milk salt and mustard. Gently stir in bread cheese and sausage. Put in 8 x 12-inch buttered pan and refrigerate overnight. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving. Yields 6 servings.

title: Pecan Tart
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat first 2 ingredients until fluffy. Stir in combined flour and 3/4 cup oats. Press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch tart pan or pie plate. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Beat eggs corn syrup brown sugar 1/4 cup margarine and bourbon until blended. Stir in 1 cup pecans and remaining 2/3 cup oats. Pour into crust. Decorate top with pecan halves. Bake an additional 25 to 30 minutes or until filling is set. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Covered Grapes
instructions: Wash grapes and drain thoroughly on paper towels. Do this several hours before ready to dip. If one drop of water gets into melted mixture it will cause the chocolate to harden up and become unusable. Line a cookie sheet with waxed paper; set aside. In a small saucepan combine chocolate pieces and shortening. Heat and stir over low heat until chocolate is melted. Holding grape bunch by stem dip grapes partially into melted chocolate. If necessary spoon over grapes to coat. Let excess drip off; place on prepared cookie sheet. Chill until chocolate is firm about 30 minutes or up to 6 hours. Makes 1 bunch (about twenty 3-5 grape servings).

title: Grandmother'S Old-Time Egg Custard
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Place in unbaked pie shell. Cook at 300\u00b0 until golden brown. Dust top of custard with cinnamon.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
instructions: Pour peaches into a 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle the cake mix over the top of the peaches (do not stir; this is the crust!) covering well. You may not need the entire box. Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar over the top and then follow with the melted butter. Cook at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until the top browns.

title: Mother'S Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix all well. Brown slightly in fat. Add 1/2 cup or more water. Cover tightly and simmer about 1 hour until tender. Or bake in oven for 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Makes 15 meatballs.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
instructions: In large skillet brown chops in hot oil. Remove chops. Add celery and onion and cook lightly about 3 minutes. Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients; add chops. Bring to a boil. Lower heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Short Ribs Of Beef
instructions: Saute onion in butter and add the mushroom soup mushrooms and 1 can of water. Add chicken or turkey salt pepper and curry powder. Mix well and heat. Serve this on Minute rice. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Ham-Aghetti Casserole
instructions: Place 1-inch pieces of bacon into a 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes. Remove half the fat. Add ham tomatoes spaghetti onions green pepper salt and pepper. Stir well. Cover. Microwave on High 18 to 20 minutes until spaghetti is tender stirring after 8 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes uncovered until cheese is melted. Makes 6 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ingredients. Mix well. Form in a meat loaf. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Pour favorite tomato sauce or gravy over and serve. Enjoy.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage
instructions: Cut sausage into pieces. Slice onion and pepper. Fry in covered pan until browned. Place noodles in 6 quarts boiling water. Return to second boil stirring occasionally until tender. Add sausage mixture and spaghetti sauce and pour over drained noodles. Makes approximately 8 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill. Makes about 1 3/4 cups.

title: Baked Meat Balls
instructions: Combine beef with onion green pepper egg seasonings and rice cereal. Form into 10 balls. Roll balls in flour and brown in hot shortening. Place balls in a large casserole and pour tomato soup which has been diluted with 1 can of hot water. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Key Lime Pie
instructions: Break eggs lightly then add condensed milk to the yolk and beat again. Add lime juice and beat until smooth. Pour mixture into a 9-inch baked pastry shell. Top with meringue and bake in a slow oven until meringue is brown.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar; boil over low heat for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Add milk stirring until milk comes to a boil. Cool. Add sugar beating after each addition until spreadable.

title: Pineapple Nut Squares
instructions: Melt butter and cream with sugar. Add eggs one at a time; mix well. Sift flour soda and salt together. Drain pineapple well. Add butter sugar and eggs mixing alternately with flour mixture. Add nuts and pineapple. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Cheese Crunchies
instructions: Blend ingredients. Roll into balls and mash with fork. Chill for 15 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. (These freeze well.)

title: Icebox Cake No. 1
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Drop one egg yolk at a time in the sugar and butter. Beat whites and add to the above.

title: Come For Coffee Cake(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place brown sugar in a pot on the stove top at medium heat. Add eggs and stir. Sugar should start to dissolve. Stir in the flour one cup at a time. Add vanilla to taste and stir. Add pecans and stir. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased with oleo. Bake in oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cool cut and serve.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Layer one-third of graham crackers in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Combine pudding mix and 3 cups of milk in a large bowl. Beat at low speed with an electric mixer until blended about 2 minutes. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon half of mixture on graham crackers. Repeat layers ending with graham crackers.

title: Pudding Delight
instructions: Mix together cracker crumbs margarine or butter and sugar. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Homemade Pancake Syrup
instructions: Mix brown sugar water butter and salt in saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in maple flavoring. Serve warm.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles corn meal. Add buttermilk. Turn onto floured surface and knead very briefly. Pinch off and roll biscuits. Place in greased pie plate with sides touching. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Do not overbake.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop lean beef and green onion tops. Mix all ingredients. Shape into ball. Refrigerate until chilled.

title: Mushroom Potatoes
instructions: Peel slice and cook potatoes. Arrange in glass pan; add salt. Cook soup milk margarine and cheese until cheese melts. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs. Bake until mixture bubbles.

title: Rice Side Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 275\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tina'S Tasty Tater Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl adding potatoes last. Chill and serve. Recipe can be halved.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Add sugar to cream cheese. Mix well after each. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Put in greased 8-inch pan. Chill several hours. Cut into squares. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: 1, 2, 3 Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. (Can be mixed in same pan as baked in.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 1 (9 x 13-inch) or 2 (8-inch round) pans.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and pineapple juice and all in small pan. Heat until Jell-O is dissolved. Do not boil. Let cool until slightly thick. Add buttermilk and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill until firm. (You may use diet Jell-O if you so desire.)

title: Pumpkin Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix crumbs with 1 tablespoon sugar and melted butter. Press into bottom of 10-inch spring-form pan. Chill.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Chop cauliflower into bite size pieces in large bowl. Add black olives and diced onion. Add salt and pepper. Mix mayonnaise mustard sugar and vinegar. Stir well. Cover bowl and refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt oleo and mix with graham cracker crumbs; pat in pan. Mix powdered sugar eggs and butter; beat 15 minutes and pour on crust. Slice bananas on this and pour pineapple on top. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with pecans and cherries. Put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Melt oleo. Add sugar and vinegar; bring to boil. Add this mixture to beaten eggs salt and vanilla. Beat good; pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Turkey Drumsticks
instructions: Put all the soups in a big bowl. For each can of soup add 1/2 can of water. Mix well and pour over the drumsticks. Bake for about 2 hours in a covered pan at 350\u00b0. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Spinach Dip Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook spinach until just done. Drain well. Mix spinach with cream cheese butter and salt. Put in casserole dish and cover with parmesan cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Spring Egg Rolls Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour salt eggs and water until smooth. Lightly oil 6-inch skillet and heat. Pour as little of the batter as necessary to cover the bottom into the skillet. Bake over very low heat until set then turn over for a few seconds.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup mushroom soup with remaining ingredients. Shape into loaf. Place in shallow baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Blend remaining soup 1/4 cup water and 2 tablespoons drippings. Heat and stir often. Serve with loaf. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hershey Pie
instructions: Melt the two Hershey bars in a double boiler. Fold in Cool Whip and put in the baked crust overnight with a few almonds on top if desired. Put in the freezer.

title: Sour Cream And Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook together squash carrot and onion then drain. Place squash mixture and alternate with mixture of cream of chicken soup and sour cream. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 30 minutes. During last few minutes place grated cheese on top. Secret is slowing cooking.

title: Frozen Strawberry Jam
instructions: The rest is the same as for jam.

title: Macaroni Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and vegetables according to directions. Cool. Mix in small bowl the Ranch dressing mustard salt and pepper. Set aside. Mix radishes and onions with macaroni and vegetables. Cover with dressing and mix well. Top with Parmesan cheese and bacon bits. Cover; let marinate in refrigerator 3 to 4 hours or overnight.

title: Two-Corn Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Saute pepper and onion in butter until soft. Mix all ingredients together and pour into casserole dish. Bake until set.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients mixing well. Shape into 1-inch meat balls. Brown for 15 to 20 minutes in hot oven (450\u00b0). Combine sauce and juice of pineapple in skillet. Heat and add meatballs. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes. Add pineapple chunks and olives. Simmer at least 15 minutes. The longer they simmer the better they become. Cook about 2 hours with pineapple. Add olives the last 45 minutes. Yield about 6 dozen meatballs. Crock-pot is the best to cook them in.

title: Mayor Sal Mancini'S Summer Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice and drain well. Follow directions on the Good Seasons packets. Combine all ingredients while rice is warm. Chill. Serves 10.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: In mixing bowl beat eggs. Add flour and white and brown sugar to eggs beating until well blended. Add melted butter chocolate chips and nuts. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Fills one pie shell.

title: Butter Dumplings
instructions: Mix together egg butter salt spices parsley and chives; then stir in flour. Let batter stand at room temperature for about an hour. Bring broth soup or salted water to gentle boil then using a teaspoon drop batter into liquid. When dumplings rise to surface they are cooked. Makes approximately 20.

title: Almond Curried Fruit
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle the fruit with almonds. Combine butter brown sugar and curry powder. Top fruit with brown sugar mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Last-Minute Rolls
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before dinner Into scalded milk in large bowl stir sugar salt and shortening. Cool until lukewarm. In small bowl sprinkle or crumble yeast into warm water. Stir until dissolved. Stir into lukewarm milk mixture. Add flour; stir until well blended about 1 minute. Cover with towel and let rise until doubled. Stir batter well then beat vigorously about 1/2 minute. Fill greased muffin pan cups or pinch off and put in pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonful 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly before removing. Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

title: Nutty Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread almonds in a single layer in baking pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until lightly toasted. Remove from oven and cool completely about 30 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300\u00b0. Generously grease 2 baking pans.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms in oil. Season with salt pepper and garlic powder. Add broccoli. Cook until tender in skillet. Place in casserole dish and cover with cream of mushroom soup undiluted. Cover with shredded cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Popsicles(Kids Recipe)
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Store in closed containers.

title: Bean And Rib Soup
instructions: Sort and wash beans; place in a large Dutch oven. (Cast-iron if you have one.) Fill with water 2 inches above beans and bring to a boil; cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let soak 1 hour; drain and remove.

title: Carrot Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots until tender. Add onions green peppers salt and pepper. Heat just to boiling the remaining ingredients and pour over carrot mixture. Chill well.

title: Guacamole Taco Dip
instructions: Put a layer of bean dip followed by layer of guacamole onions cheese olives peppers and tomato. End with a layer of cheese. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Mexican Plate Bean Dip
instructions: Spread bean dip over plate. Mix taco mix and salad dressing together. Spread over bean dip. Put shredded lettuce on top then put tomatoes. Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top. Serve the dip with chips.

title: Lanita'S Red Rice
instructions: Fry bacon; set aside. Saute onion and pepper in bacon grease. Stir in cold rice then tomato sauce and crumbled bacon. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Lemonade
instructions: Cut lemon into about 6 slices. Put lemon lemon juice sugar and water into a food processor or blender. Blend until lemon is in very small pieces. Strain the mixture into a pitcher and discard the pulp. Serve well chilled.

title: Broccoli-Carrot Stir-Fry
instructions: For sauce in a bowl stir together orange juice dry sherry and cornstarch; set aside. Preheat a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add cooking oil (add more cooking oil as necessary during cooking). Stir-fry ginger root in hot oil for 15 seconds. Add carrots and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add broccoli and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp-tender. Push vegetables from the center of the wok or skillet. Stir sauce; add to center of wok. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir for 1 minute more. Stir in vegetables and walnuts to coat. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: If using self-rising flour do not use soda. Mix all ingredients together. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Pumpkin Dessert Bread
instructions: Place dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Make a well in the center then add all of the other ingredients. Put into 2 loaf pans which have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
instructions: Combine water spices and sugar in large saucepan; boil uncovered for 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except lemon slices; heat until warm but do not boil. Strain. Serve in mugs with fresh lemon slices.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Preheat broiler; in a shallow 2-quart casserole dish arrange shrimp on bottom. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over shrimp and stir. Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat until shrimp are golden brown. Usually 2 to 4 minutes.

title: Mushroom Caps
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and save for other use. Clean caps and brush outsides with melted butter. Mix rest of ingredients and mound into caps. Place onto broiling pan and broil 6 inches from heat approximately 3 to 5 minutes until bubbling and brown.

title: Simmered Franks
instructions: Heat jelly and mustard over low heat. Cut wieners up. Pour mixture over wieners. Cook in slow cooker 2 or 3 hours. Serve hot.

title: Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast cake in water. Add egg salt sugar and flour. Work until smooth. Let rise. Work again. Let rise and make out into rolls. Let rise and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until light brown or to your desire.

title: Smoked Salmon Spread
instructions: Remove skin and debone salmon. Blend all the ingredients. Mold or shape as you like. Roll in parsley and pecans attractive and delicious on crackers.

title: Party Dip Or Breakfast Bread Treat
instructions: Brown sausage and ground beef together. Add spices. Add cheese and let melt over medium heat. Place on loaves and freeze. Use as a party dip.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients real good then add enough milk to fill freezer.

title: Cracker Candy
instructions: Mix margarine and brown sugar and boil for 2-3 min. Line 13x9 in pan with saltine crackers. Pour sugar mixture. Bake for 5 min. at 375\u00b0. Let cool a few minutes. Melt almond bark and pour over brickle. Top with chopped pecans. Let cool completely then break apart.

title: Chicken With Eggplant In Garlic Sauce
instructions: Heat oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and stir-fry. Transfer chicken to plate. To same skillet add eggplant garlic and ginger; stir in beef broth and boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 15 minutes. Combine cornstarch soy sauce vinegar sugar and sesame oil. Add mixture and radishes. Cook until sauce thickens and comes to a boil. Add chicken; heat through. Sprinkle with crushed red pepper. Makes 6 servings; per serving 425 calories.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in ungreased casserole dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Bars
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour cinnamon and egg yolk to butter and sugar; mix well. Put into ungreased 11 x 16-inch pan. Pour unbeaten egg white over top and spread with back of spoon. Pour off excess. Press nuts over top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from oven. Cut after 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Fried Rice (Japanese)
instructions: Mix eggs 1 tsp. DASHI sauce sugar and pepper until well blended. Heat skillet add sesame oil and egg mixture. Scramble and remove from skillet. Add vegetable oil to the hot skillet. Stir in green onion ginger and egg mixture. Add cooked rice and ham until crisp and hot. Mix with 2 Tbsp. DASHI sauce and a little pepper to taste. If you prefer you can use any kind of meat instead of ham.

title: Coriander And Mint Chutney
instructions: Clean and wash coriander mint chili tomato and onion. Put small amounts of each in blender and blend. Add yogurt and salt a little at a time. Blend until smooth. Store in a container with a tight lid. Will last approximately 2 to 3 weeks just stir each time you use it.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream sugar with shortening until creamy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift cake flour before measuring then sift with baking powder 3 times. Dissolve soda in hot water and add to buttermilk then add alternately with flour mixture to creamed sugar and shortening. Mix in finely mashed bananas. Pour in greased floured pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites. Add 1/4 cup sugar. Cream shortening and add salt and vanilla. Add rest of sugar then egg yolks. Beat. Sift flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture and 1/3 cup milk. Fold in egg whites and blueberries (dusted with flour). Sprinkle sugar over batter in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Put into a large kettle and bring to boil. Fill jars with okra as desired. Hot peppers may be added also as taste desires. Pour boiling liquid over okra. Fill jars to neck and seal.

title: Potato Dumplings
instructions: Boil potatoes and let stand for a few hours or overnight still in their jackets. Peel potatoes and mash them or put through a ricer then add the eggs and flour. Roll the mixture into little balls. Chill in refrigerator for about an hour before cooking. Cook in lightly salted water that is just under the boiling point. When dumplings are done will rise to top. Serve hot with melted brown butter and crumbs.

title: Queen Of Hearts Tarts
instructions: Cream together thoroughly the butter and sugar. Stir in the egg yolk and vanilla. Sift together the flour and salt and add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Shape into 3 dozen small balls and dip each into unbeaten egg white. Roll in chopped nuts (pecans or peanuts) and place 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Do not flatten balls. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. After baking 10 minutes remove pan from oven and with a thimble make a dent into each cookie. Return pan to oven. Work as quickly as possible and if the thimble sticks dip into cold water. When cookies are done remove to cooling rack and fill each dent while warm with jam or marmalade. A tart jam is best (plum apricot or pineapple).

title: Mexican Bean Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender; mix until blended. Taste to determine amount of hot sauce you wish to add. If its too thick for dipping add a little water. Make ahead so flavors mingle. Serve with low calorie tortilla chips. Contains 62 calories in 1/4 cup.

title: Azar'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Stir and cook water corn syrup and cornstarch until clear and thick. Add jello and some red food coloring. Cool and pour over berries in pie shell.

title: Old Lady Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add egg and beat thoroughly. Sift flour baking powder soda nutmeg allspice cloves cinnamon and salt together 3 times. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately to creamed mixture. Bake in a greased tube pan in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 45 to 60 minutes. Makes one (9-inch) cake.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Prepare pie crust as directed stirring in cheese with cold water. Roll each half into 13 x 10-inch rectangle; place on ungreased baking sheets.

title: The Very Best Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large 8-quart saucepan; pour off fat. Add onion and continue to saut until onion is golden. Add wine and deglaze pan. Add tomato using just enough water to rinse out each can. Add other seasonings and simmer 5 to 6 hours or until sauce is desired thickness. If it gets too thick thin with tomato sauce. Thick sauce is best for pasta and meat dishes. Thinner sauce is better for lasagna or stuffed pastas. Can even be used as a pizza sauce. Will freeze well. Yields 6 quarts.

title: Sour Cream Candy
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil stirring slowly until sugar melts. Then boil without stirring over medium heat to soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Let stand 15 minutes. (Do not stir.) Add vanilla; beat until it starts to lose its gloss about 8 minutes. Add cherries and nuts. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Dressing For Vegetables
instructions: Mix well with hand mixer the first 4 ingredients. Pour over the raw veggies about 2 hours before serving.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 until done; cool.

title: Layered Salad(Vegetable)
instructions: Layer vegetables in order given. Seal with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Let set overnight. Toss to serve.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Melt the chocolate in double boiler. Sift the flour salt baking powder and soda. Beat the eggs and gradually add sugar; beat well. Add oil and chocolate; beat until well blended. Add sifted dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Stir in zucchini and nuts. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
instructions: Place apples in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine sugar and cinnamon; set aside 1 teaspoon of mixture. Stir cornstarch and salt into sugar mixture. Sprinkle over apples. Stir together flour and nutmeg. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of water over part of mixture. Toss with fork. Repeat until all moistened. Form into a ball and roll dough into a 12 x 8-inch rectangle. Place pastry atop apples. Cut vents in pastry and flute edges. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Brush pastry with milk and sprinkle with reserved sugar mixture.

title: Creamy Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Be careful in your selection. Do not choose too young. When once selected give your entire thoughts to preparation for domestic use. Some insist upon keeping them in a pickle others are constantly getting them into hot water. This may make them sour hard and sometimes bitter; even poor varieties may be made sweet tender and good.

title: Sausage Snack Wraps
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds. Place sausages on shortest end of each triangle. Roll up starting at shortest end and rolling to opposite point. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with ketchup and mustard if desired. Yields 48 snacks.

title: Holiday Cranberry Salad
instructions: Wash cranberries. In a medium saucepan add cranberries and 1 cup water. Cook berries until they pop open. Take off heat. Add sugar and jello. Stir well until dissolved. Add crushed pineapple (juice and all) apples and nuts. Mix well. Pour into glass bowl and refrigerate until jelled. May be topped with Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat the margarine and sugars until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. In separate bowl stir flour cocoa baking soda and salt. Gradually add to butter mixture mixing well. Stir in oats and nuts. Drop by tablespoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 11 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cookies will be slightly moist in centers. Do not overbake. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Saute hamburger chopped green pepper and chopped onion together. Cook until well done. Add spaghetti and other ingredients. Put in a casserole and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake at 370\u00b0 until well warmed.

title: Chocolate Chip Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add wet ingredients. Add dry ingredients and chips and/or nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12-14 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and water; cook to form a soft ball. Add oleo and nuts; continue cooking until it turns brown. Remove from heat; add vanilla and soda stir until it foams. Pour quickly into a greased pan and break into pieces.

title: Butterscotch Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine Marshmallow Creme evaporated milk butter sugar and salt in a saucepan. Stir over moderate heat until mixture comes to a full rolling boil. Boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add butterscotch chips peanut butter and vanilla stirring until smooth. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Chill until fudge is firm. Cut into squares. Makes 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Lazy Day Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Lightly brown meat and onion. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour into a casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 60 minutes. Serves six.

title: Welch Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients like pie crust then add currants eggs and milk. Roll to 1/2-inch thick. Cut with cutter or water glass. Spray with Pam. Fry on griddle until golden in color. Turn to do other side. Cool on rack.

title: Tuna Stuffed Zucchini Boats
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise and remove seeds. Parboil zucchini in a large pan of salted water until slightly tender. Test for doneness with skewer. Combine and mix thoroughly tuna egg cheese parsley salt and pepper in bowl. Stuff zucchini with tuna mixture. Add tomato sauce and top with bread crumbs. Place in greased ovenproof dish or on cookie sheet on top of aluminum foil. Bake at 300\u00b0 until heated about 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger with chopped onion. Spread 1 can crescent roll dough in 9 x 13-inch baker. Place pepperoni in next then sprinkle Cheddar then Mozzarella and pour sauce over all. Layer second rolls on top and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding mix with milk in a large bowl until thick. Add sour cream and 1 carton Cool Whip. Mix until blended. Layer bananas cookies and half the pudding. Repeat layers. Top with second carton of Cool Whip and sprinkle with cookie crumbs.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package. Mix all ingredients in large mixer bowl; set aside. Mix salad dressing mustard and salt and pepper together. Pour over other ingredients and mix well.

title: Reuben Sauerkraut Spread
instructions: Drain sauerkraut. Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or in microwave for 3 to 4 minutes until cheese is melted. Serve on crackers or party rye bread. Can also be mixed and put in crock-pot.

title: Strawberry Glace Pie(Serves 6)
instructions: Bake and cook pie crust shell. Wash and hull fresh strawberries. Cut up 1 cup of berries. Mix 1 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cornstarch in 2-quart saucepan. Stir in 1 cup water gradually until smooth. Add cut up strawberries. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and clear. Stir in remaining berries saving 1/4 cup for garnish. Pour in pie crust. Chill until firm about 3 hours. Garnish with whipped topping and berries.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender. Mix well.

title: Seafood Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with milk. Mixture will be thick. Add onion and egg; beat. Refrigerate until chilled. Drop batter from spoon into hot deep fat. Cook 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Grandma'S Cake And Pudding
instructions: Mix cake according to instructions on box. Save out 1 cup of batter. Pour the rest of the batter in cake pan and bake until done.

title: Hot Tea Toddy
instructions: Combine water sugar cloves and cinnamon stick in medium saucepan. Bring to boil. Pour mixture over tea bags in tea pot. Brew 4 minutes. Remove tea bag. Stir in juice. Heat and serve in mugs with clove studded orange slices. Makes 6 servings.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Soak the yeast in warm water. Scald milk and cool. Beat the eggs until light. Measure salt sugar and shortening; stir into eggs. Add scalded milk. (Milk should be body temperature when dropped on wrist.) Stir in yeast. Add 1/2 flour then continue to add flour until dough is stiff. Knead about 5 minutes.

title: Quick Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9-inch round or heart-shaped pans. In a large bowl combine all cake ingredients at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at high speed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched in center. Cool 15 minutes; remove from pans. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Calico Salad
instructions: Mix vegetables together (do not use frozen mixed vegetables that contain potatoes).

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken until tender stewed. Remove from bone and put in deep dish or long casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Melt margarine and pour over chicken. Make a batter of flour and milk. Pour batter over chicken. Add mixed vegetables to chicken. Mix chicken or celery soup with broth from cooked chicken. Pour over chicken vegetables and batter. Season with salt and pepper to taste and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. While simmering make crust.

title: Skyline Chili(Ala Clark)
instructions: Chop onions. Put hamburger and water in a large pot first then all the other ingredients at one time. Simmer for 3 hours. Makes 2 quarts. Serve over spaghetti. Top with Cheddar cheese and oyster crackers.

title: Easy Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Grease and flour (real thick) 9-inch deep pie pan. Beat eggs add to flour and sugar. Gradually add evaporated milk and vanilla. Pour into pie pan and top with nutmeg. Bake 40 minutes or until knife comes out clean at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
instructions: Cook all the preceding together except for carrots until tender then drain carrots and add to this mixture. Bring everything back to a boil and pour in dish for serving.

title: Orange Roughy Pasta Florentine
instructions: Coat a 2-quart casserole with cooking spray. Add garlic. Microwave on High 30 seconds; add cornstarch and next 3 ingredients. Gradually add milk stirring with a wire whisk until blended. Microwave on High 3 to 4 1/2 minutes or until slightly blended stirring every 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in spinach and fish. Cover with lid; microwave on High 4 minutes or until fish flakes. Let stand one minute. Stir in cheese and serve over pasta.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine 1 cup bran with boiling water; cool and add oil. Sift together dry ingredients. Combine eggs and buttermilk. Add the dry ingredients. Add 2 cups bran. Bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Stir in flour cocoa vanilla and salt. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until a toothpick near the center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack. Spread Marshmallow Crme over cooled brownies.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Separate eggs and beat yellows real well. Add can of Eagle Brand milk. Mix well and beat in lemon juice until thick. Pour into vanilla wafer pie crust. Add meringue and brown lightly.

title: Pickled Squash Relish
instructions: Combine squash peppers onions and salt. Cover with ice and water; soak 3 hours. Pour off water and rinse. Mix together vinegar mustard seed sugar and celery seed; heat until sugar dissolves. Add squash pepper and onions; boil 3 to 5 minutes. Seal in hot jars. Great over beans and cornbread!

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown beef onions and green peppers in oil. Pour off excess grease. Add remaining ingredients and bake covered in casserole at least 1 hour at 350\u00b0. May add sliced or grated cheese on top when done.

title: Chocolate Snowballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour and salt. Set aside. Blend margarine sugar and vanilla; beat in egg. Stir in flour mixture nuts and chocolate chips. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool slightly then roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray 13 X 9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain; rinse with cool water. Let pasta dry on paper towels. For filling in medium bowl stir together 3 c. mozzarella with the ricotta and fresh basil. Using a teaspoon carefully stuff pasta shells with prepared cheese mixture. Spoon 2 c. spaghetti sauce into prepared baking dish. Arrange stuffed pasta over sauce. Pour remaining spaghetti sauce over top of pasta. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella. Bake manicotti for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with the Parmesan; bake for 10 minutes longer. Serve immediately.

title: Noodle Pudding
instructions: Boil noodles 4 minutes. Leave cream cheese and margarine out of the refrigerator for 2 hours. After they are softened put the cream cheese and margarine in the microwave to further soften. Whisk them together. Beat the 4 eggs with milk. Mix all the ingredients together including the noodles. Put all into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pico De Gallo
instructions: Mix first four ingredients in a bowl. Mix last three ingredients in a separate bowl. Combine and chill 2 to 4 hours. Drain and serve with chips.

title: Penuche
instructions: Blend together sugar milk butter corn syrup and salt in a 3-quart casserole dish. Microwave on High for 5 minutes or until sugar is dissolved. Stir well. Microwave 12 to 15 minutes on High or until small amount dropped in very cold water forms a soft ball. Cool to lukewarm. Using wooden spoon beat vigorously until mixture begins to thicken. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Continue beating until candy is thick and difficult to work. Spread evenly in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Cool until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Glorified Brownies
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and flour.\tMix margarine and cocoa and add to mixture. Add nuts and vanilla.\tSpread\tin 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spread small marshmallows over top. Return to shut-off oven to puff up\tand spread marshmallows. Cool slightly and frost.

title: Cherry Breeze
instructions: Mix corn flake crumbs and margarine thoroughly in 9-inch pan. Press firmly and evenly over bottom and sides of pan. Chill. Beat the cream cheese until light and fluffy. Add condensed milk and blend thoroughly. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Turn into crust. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or until firm. Top with chilled cherry pie filling before serving.

title: Reuben Meat Loaf(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Rinse drain and coarsely chop sauerkraut. Crumble ground beef. In a large bowl place sauerkraut ground beef bread crumbs corned beef egg parsley and garlic; mix until well blended. Pat one-half of the mixture into a shallow 1 1/2-quart round baking dish forming a slight rim along outer edge of dish.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray large cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Rinse chicken in cold water. Dip in yogurt then in bread crumbs. Bake for about 1 hour turning once. When turning spray chicken with butter flavor Pam.

title: Marshmallows(And You Thought They'D Always Come In Plastic Bags!)
instructions: Soak gelatine in 10 tablespoons water. Heat sugar in another 10 tablespoons water until dissolved add gelatine and let cool. Beat until almost stiff. Pour into pans thickly dusted with powdered sugar. When stiff cut in cubes and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients together and add next 3 ingredients. Fold in nuts and apples. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Homemade Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and shortening until mixture is like coarse cornmeal. Beat egg slightly and add to wet ingredients. Mix wet ingredients with dry and mix with a fork until blended. It will be sticky. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours then sprinkle pastry cloth with flour and roll out.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Peel peaches cut up and discard seed. Combine flour and sugar. Add milk and mix well. Place fruit in 9-inch baking dish. Cover with sugar and flour mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Prepare Chili-O mix. Add flour shortening tomato paste and water. Mix well. After browning tortilla shell dip the whole shell into sauce then fill as desired. Roll like jelly roll. Leave seam on the bottom of pan.

title: Skillet Cabbage
instructions: Chop vegetables coarsely. Heat large skillet or wok to medium-high setting using bacon drippings or two teaspoons of vegetable oil. Pour all vegetables into skillet or wok and cover. Cook 8 to 10 minutes only to heat vegetables and remove from heat while slightly crisp. May top with crisp crumbled bacon.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet; drain grease and set aside. Place a layer of potatoes in baking dish. Sprinkle some cooked sausage diced onion and shredded American cheese over potatoes; repeat layers until all ingredients have been used. Mix soup with 1/2 cup of water in bowl. Pour this over casserole. Slice 1/2 stick butter into pats and place on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender.

title: Campbell'S Golden Divan
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare stuffing as directed. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle turkey or chicken over stuffing. Sprinkle onions mushrooms and broccoli over chicken. Sprinkle cheese on top. Spoon soup (undiluted) over all. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6. Enjoy.

title: Pizza
instructions: Toast English muffins (each muffin will make 2 pizzas). Spread spaghetti or pizza sauce on top of toasted muffin (and/or meat). Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Place in oven until bubbly.

title: Classic Lasagne
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in saucepan in 2 tablespoons of oil until lightly browned. Add tomatoes tomato paste 1/2 cup water 1/2 teaspoon salt herbs and red pepper. Simmer covered for 1 hour. Combine beef pork parsley eggs bread crumbs 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese pepper and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Shape into 1/2-inch meatballs. Saute in remaining oil until browned; add to sauce. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Light Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 9-inch square baking pan with Pam or Bakers Joy. In a small mixing bowl soak raisins in Port and set aside. In a mixing bowl sift together oat bran flour baking powder and cinnamon. Place in another bowl the brown sugar oil milk corn syrup vanilla and egg substitute; mix with an electric beater for a minute or two. Add carrots to the liquid mixture then stir in the flour mixture then the raisins and Port. Pour mixture into prepared baking pan; bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick when inserted in center of cake comes out dry. Let cool to room temperature then cut into squares.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: In saucepan combine butter brown sugar and syrup. Stir well and bring to boil. Stir in condensed milk. Simmer stirring constantly until it reaches 234\u00b0 to 238\u00b0 or soft ball. Stir in vanilla. Pour over popped corn. Stir well. Butter hands lightly and shape into balls.

title: Joyce Yawn'S French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions and margarine until tender but not brown. Add flour broth and water. Simmer for 45 minutes covered. Pour servings in soup bowls. Top with sliced cheese (2 slices make it better). Put a few croutons on top of cheese and place under broiler until cheese melts.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla to eggs. Mix together dry ingredients and nuts; add to egg mixture. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Helen'S Golden Wedding Punches
instructions: Serves 1 cup punch to 50 persons.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix meat rice oregano and parsley together. Layer cabbage meat mixture sauerkraut and tomato juice. Pour remaining ingredients over. Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and let bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Mom'S Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger onion pepper and celery. Put all ingredients in Dutch oven and simmer about 1 hour.

title: Yam Casserole
instructions: Cook yams drain. Add canned yams (pour off some of the juices). Mash all yams. Add pineapple orange juice and rum. Blend. Pour into greased Pyrex pan. Sprinkle with marshmallows. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly (20 to 25 minutes).

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
instructions: Scald milk; stir in sugar salt and margarine. Cool to lukewarm. Measure warm water into large warm bowl. Sprinkle yeast; stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture eggs and 2 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic about 8 to 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm place free from draft until doubled in bulk about 30 minutes. Punch down. Turn out on lightly floured board. Shape into rolls.

title: Cheesecake Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with brown sugar in a small bowl. Add flour and nuts; mix to make a crumb mixture. Reserve 3/4 cup for toppings. Press remainder into bottom of an 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Asparagus And Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt butter; add flour. Add milk to make sauce. Add cheese pimentos and asparagus. Salt and pepper to taste. Server on toast.

title: Soy-Marinated Flank Steaks
instructions: Poke the steak all over with the tines of a fork; cut in half against the grain to make 2 steaks. In a non-reactive bowl or large resealable plastic bag combine the soy sauce Worcestershire sauce vinegar oil garlic sugar and pepper to taste. Add the steak and turn to coat. Cover to reseal the bag and marinate at room temperature for about 1 hour or refrigerate for up to 6 hours. Remove the steak from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Position the rack in the top position in the oven and preheat the broiler. Remove the steaks from the marinade and pat dry. Cook the steaks for 5 to 8 minutes on each side for rare to medium rare. Set aside on a cutting board for 5 minutes. Cut the steak against the grain on an angle into very thin slices. Arrange the slices on a warmed platter.

title: Mothers Roast Beef And Dumplings
instructions: Place the beef roast in a large cooking vessel with salt pepper and other seasonings; cover roast with cold water about two inches over top. Cook on medium high heat until roast is tender. Remove roast from boiling stock and let cool for several minutes. Slice or tear roast into strips. Place back into stock; bring to a boil and add prepared dumplings. Cook for about 15 minutes.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Add all ingredients together and mix well. Drop by spoonful in hot grease or butter. Use Teflon coated skillet when frying in butter.

title: Homemade Cocoa
instructions: Mix ingredients together slowly a little at a time. Use lemonade scoop for 1 cup cocoa. Add hot water. Keep in airtight container. Makes a large amount of cocoa.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook chicken breasts and take off bones (save broth). In a large bowl put chicken (chopped) onion and bell pepper. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Layered Chicken And Broccoli(Microwave Needed)
instructions: Stir broccoli onion garlic salt and pepper in a round baking dish 8 x 1/2-inch. Cover tightly and microwave on High (100%) until vegetables are crisp-tender 3 to 4 minutes. Stir. Arrange chicken and water chestnuts evenly on broccoli. Cover with waxed paper and microwave on High (100%) for 3 minutes.

title: Lemonade
instructions: Combine in saucepan the sugar 1 cup water and lemon rinds. Stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved. Boil about 7 minutes. Cool. Add lemon juice and ice water. Pour over ice in pitcher or tall glasses.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: You will also need a plastic flowerpot.

title: Shrimp Curry
instructions: Blend curry powder into Kraft mayonnaise. Gradually blend in the evaporated milk. Add the rest of the ingredients. Heat stirring occasionally. Serve over hot cooked rice. Serves 4.

title: Apple Pie In A Jar
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Fill hot jars with apples leaving 1 inch headspace.

title: Crisp
instructions: Place fruit in bottom of glass dish. Mix sugar and flour then add egg. Pour over fruit. Pour margarine over everything. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix mayo sour cream water chestnuts soup mix and spinach together. Hollow out the bread and use it as a serving dish for the dip. Use pieces of bread for dippers.

title: Redi-Cheese Burger
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Make burgers. Bake in oven or fry. Serve on roll with alfalfa sprouts and a slice of red onion.

title: Baked Chicken Supreme
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first 8 ingredients. Place chicken in mixture and turn to coat. Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Remove chicken from the marinade and coat each piece with crumbs. Arrange on a shallow baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is tender.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Place egg in 1 1/2-quart greased casserole; beat well with fork. Stir in milk sugar corn crackers and butter. Cover; microwave at Medium-high for 10 minutes. Stir well. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover; microwave at Medium-high 5 to 6 minutes. When done center will be just barely set. Makes 4 servings.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large crock-pot. When this is completely combined add 1 pound Velveeta cheese and let this completely melt. Stir constantly.

title: Lois' Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Blend oats in blender to a fine powder. In bowl with mixer cream butter and both sugars until fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla. In another bowl combine oatmeal powder flour salt baking powder and soda. Add oat mixture to butter mixture; beat until just blended. Stir in chocolate pieces grated chocolate and nuts.

title: Quick And Easy Rolls
instructions: Mix all together about 2 minutes. Pour into a well-greased muffin tin. Bake 10 minutes or until golden brown at 450\u00b0. Makes 12.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onions bell pepper jalapeno pepper and pimento in butter. Mix cooked rice and corn to the sauteed mix. Add sugar salt and pepper. Place in a buttered dish. Cook for 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Grate cheese on top the last 5 minutes or until melted. (Can be frozen. Leave cheese off until ready to cook.)

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook sorghum sugar butter and water until it forms crystal ball when dropped in cold water then add 1/4 teaspoon soda. Pour over popcorn. Make balls or leave loose.

title: Barbecued Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 1-1/2 qt casserole dish. Cover. Microwave 10-12 minutes on high. Let stand covered for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Fudge Ribbon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Pour batter into a well greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. In small mixing bowl beat cheese margarine and cornstarch until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk then egg and vanilla until smooth. Pour evenly over cake batter. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until wooden pick near center comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes; remove from pan and cool. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar or drizzle with chocolate glaze.

title: Plain Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour. Cream together sugar margarine and Crisco. Mix in flour and flavoring then beat in eggs one at a time until blended. Pour into well-greased tube pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Soda Cracker Delight
instructions: Beat egg whites until frothy; add cream of tartar. Beat until stiff gradually adding sugar. Beat well; add vanilla. Fold in soda crackers and chopped nuts. Bake in 12 x 8-inch glass pan well greased and floured at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let cool.

title: Dried Fruit And Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheet. Coarsely chop the dried fruit. In a medium bowl combine coconut sugar flour and salt. Stir in the egg whites and vanilla. Stir in the chopped fruit and walnuts. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough 1-inch apart onto the cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until edges of the macaroons are golden. Remove macaroons to cool. Repeat with remaining dough.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all the juices together. Add ginger ale and sherbet last.

title: Sausage-Cornbread Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a 10-inch skillet or 2-quart baking dish; set aside. Brown sausage and onion in medium skillet; drain well. Combine eggs corn meal corn milk and oil. Pour half of corn meal mixture into prepared dish. Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese. Pour remaining batter over top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Spoon Burgers
instructions: Brown meat and drain well. Add soups and a dash of Worcestershire sauce. Cook over medium heat and then turn heat down and let flavors blend. Serve on buns.

title: Spicy Hot Refresher
instructions: In covered blender or food processor combine V-8 juice cucumber lime juice and chili powder. Blend until smooth. Add ice cubes one at a time blending until ice is finely crushed. Serve immediately.

title: Delicious Pork Roast
instructions: Wash pork roast and pat dry. Sprinkle pepper and paprika liberally over roast. Place in 250\u00b0 oven and cook until well done.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Discard stems and break into small bite sizes (can be shredded). Combine with remaining ingredients. Marinate 24 hours for extra good flavor or eat it immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Turkey Apple Salad
instructions: In medium bowl gently stir together turkey apple celery and raisins. In cup stir together dressing and brown sugar. Pour over turkey mixture. Toss gently to coat. Serve on lettuce leaves. Makes 2 servings.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Stir all ingredients (except apples) together with large spoon. Add apples. Grease and flour pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Rye Boat
instructions: Mix together the mayonnaise parsley dill weed sour cream and onion. Make sure they are mixed well. Dice corned beef and combine with the previous mixture making sure that the slices separate. Chill mixture overnight.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil; stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Don not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple nuts and bananas. Spoon into 3 greased and floured 9- inch cake pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes. Cool. Frost with cream cheese icing. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top.

title: Dry Orange Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Do not mix Jell-O with water; use dry. Chill overnight.

title: Rice Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. In medium skillet brown beef and onion; drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce; mix well. In small bowl combine Ricotta cheese Mozzarella cheese and egg whites; mix well. In the prepared pan spread 1/3 of meat sauce 1/2 of rice and 1/2 of Ricotta cheese mixture; repeat layers. Spread remaining sauce on top; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Quick And Delish Chicken Soup
instructions: Heat oil in large pot. Add mushrooms and onions and cook 5 minutes. Add broth chicken and garlic. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in pasta tomatoes parsley and thyme. Cook 5 minutes. Yield 9 cups.

title: Easy Cookies
instructions: Mix well with mixer; roll into balls and mash with a fork onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 9 X 13 baking pan. In large bowl mix first 5 dry ingredients. In a medium bowl beat cheese corn and chilies with their liquid. Stir in onion eggs milk and margarine until blended. Stir into flour mixture just until flour is moist. Spread batter in pan. Bake 30 minutes until golden brown and toothpick in center comes out clean. Makes 15 servings.

title: Salisbury Steak And Onion Gravy
instructions: In a bowl combine 1/3 cup of the soup with the beef bread crumbs egg salt and pepper. Shape into 6 patties and brown; pour off fat. Gradually blend in remaining ingredients stirring to loosen browned meat bits. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes or until done. Stir occasionally.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage; drain. Break into pieces. Beat eggs and add milk salt and mustard. In greased baking dish layer bread sausage and cheese. Pour egg mixture over these layers. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Brisket With Rub
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl. Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Apply rub to both sides of brisket (fatty side last). Place in pan fatty side up and cover with heavy-duty foil or use roasting pan with lid. Bake for 10 to 12 hours. Can be cooked on grill.

title: Tater Tot Hot Dish
instructions: Mix hamburger and dry soup mix. Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Drain vegetables and spread on top of hamburger mixture. Mix together soups (do not add water). Spoon or spread on top of vegetables then place Tater Tots neatly atop of soup mixture. Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together and heat thoroughly. Good for large crowds. Leftovers are even better.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together until very smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Beat just until yellow is all through the mixture. Add flour one cup at a time beating only until mixed after each cup. Add vanilla. Stir until stirred in. Spoon into tube pan and cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute chopped onions and celery in butter. Cook chopped broccoli in water. Melt together cream of mushroom soup and Cheez Whiz. Combine. Add uncooked Minute rice. Bake in greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 to 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Chili Corn Taco
instructions: Saute celery and onion in oil until tender. Brown meat and drain. Add celery and onion. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Serve as chili or spoon into taco shells or over chips.

title: Crisp Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine ingredients. Dip chicken or fish in water then in crumbs. Put on nonstick sheet sprayed with Pam. If any crumbs remain sprinkle on. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Makes 2 servings.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Mix; spread in a 13 x 11-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut while warm.

title: Chili
instructions: Slice sausage. Brown sausage ground beef and onion. Lower the heat to simmer. Drain the oil from meats. Add remaining ingredients to meats. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours. Season to taste. Makes a big pot . . . enough to feed 12 hungry basketball players.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook meats and cut in small pieces. Cool stock and remove grease. Cook bacon and brown onions in fat. Cook 2 stalks celery with chicken or add 1 can cream of celery soup.
