Cook corn in bacon drippings and let stand with creamed potatoes (add to stew last to prevent sticking). Cook very slowly several hours. Season with salt pepper 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce.

title: Fried Potatoes
instructions: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces. Lightly brown. Add all other items and fry. Salt and pepper to taste. Cabbage may be added halfway through cooking potatoes. Add 1/2 stick butter. Cover and complete cooking.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Beat brown sugar and oleo until fluffy. Stir in baking mix and nuts. Mix until crumbly (reserve 1 cup). Press mixture in pan and bake 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Beat in remaining ingredients. Pour over mixture in pan. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Candy'S Chicken In Wine Sauce
instructions: Flour and brown chicken. Place in shallow baking dish. Stir and heat in saucepan cooking wine soy sauce and sugar. Pour over chicken. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours or until sauce of barbecue consistency. Turn chicken over at least once.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix together hamburger cracker crumbs and water. Pat into a jelly roll pan (about 1-inch thick) and put into the refrigerator overnight to chill well.

title: Turkey, Swiss And Mushroom Crepes
instructions: Lay turkey breast skin up on some sprigs of rosemary and oregano and bake in a covered dish with 1/2 cup water. Salt and pepper. Cut turkey into 1/2-inch cubes. Put approximately 3 tablespoons of turkey and 1 tablespoon grated Swiss cheese in the center of each crepe. Add 2 tablespoons of hot Mushroom Sauce. Roll up the crepe. Add 1 tablespoon Mushroom Sauce over the top of the crepe. Garnish with rosemary sprigs.

title: Quick Apple Dessert
instructions: Mix flour sugar and oleo until crumbly. Pour apples in buttered baking dish 8 x 8-inch. Sprinkle jello over apples and pour water over apples and jello. Next sprinkle flour mixture over apples. Bake 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown. Can be served with ice cream.

title: Praline Sweet Potatoes And Apples
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sweet potatoes; cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until golden brown. Turn potato slices over. Reduce heat; cover and cook 5 more minutes. Remove potatoes from skillet. Add apples; cook 5 minutes on each side or until tender and golden brown. Return potatoes to skillet. Add sugars pecans cinnamon and salt tossing to coat. Add 2 tablespoons water stirring to mix. Cook 5 minutes until potatoes and apples are glazed and tender.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion. Add soups enchilada sauce green chilies and picante sauce. Cook until hot. Stir in cheese until melted. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Lemon-Pepper Potatoes
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan combine Butter Buds onion tops and lemon-pepper seasoning. Stir in water. Add the potatoes. Toss to coat well. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes until potatoes are tender and beginning to brown stirring twice. Goes great with Tangy Baked Chicken and has no fat. Makes 4 side dish servings.

title: Rich Shortcake Biscuits
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients (flour through salt). Cut in margarine. Combine egg and milk; add to dry ingredients. Stir until moist. Knead gently on floured surface a few times. Pat out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut and bake on ungreased sheet 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Add pecans and raisins (English style).

title: Kalua Pig(Hawaiian-Style Luau Pork)
instructions: Pierce pork all over with a carving fork. Rub salt then liquid smoke over meat. Place roast in a crock-pot slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 16 to 20 hours turning once during cooking time. Remove meat from slow cooker and shred adding drippings as needed to moisten.

title: Cooked Finger Paint
instructions: Mix salt and flour; add cold water gradually and beat mixture with egg beater until smooth. Add hot water and boil until mixture loses chalky appearance. Beat until smooth. Color with food coloring.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: In large bowl beat softened cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually add condensed milk and beat until fluffy. Add lime juice and green food coloring. Mix until creamy and smooth. Fold in Cool Whip; mix well.

title: Mini Kisses
instructions: Heat oven to 275\u00b0. Grease and flour two cookie sheets. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Slowly add the 2/3 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Beat until smooth and shiny. Stir in with a spoon 1 cup of chocolate chips and 1 cup of nuts. Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 275\u00b0 (or can turn off oven and leave kisses in oven overnight). Makes about 4 dozen.

title: 24-Hour Cole Slaw
instructions: Place the cabbage and onion in a large bowl; set aside. Combine the vinegar sugar salt celery seed and mustard and bring to a boil. Set off heat and add 1 cup oil. Bring to a second boil and pour over cabbage and onion. Let set for 24 hours. Stir before serving.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Stir in oil and remaining ingredients. Batter will be stiff. Add apples last. Pour into a 9 x 13 cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Fig Preserves
instructions: Wash the figs by filling a bowl large enough to submerge them in water. Dissolve the salt and baking soda in the water. Using your hands toss gently so as not to bruise the figs. Drain the water rinse in clear water and drain again. Put the figs and sugar in a large pot over medium-low heat. Stir gently as they begin to cook. Raise the heat to medium when syrup forms and let it come to a gentle boil. Simmer uncovered for about 3 hours or until a foam appears around the edges of the pot. Stir occasionally. Spoon the hot mixture into 5 hot sterilized pint-sized preserving jars filling to within 1/2-inch of the top. With a clean damp towel wipe the rim and fit with a hot lid. Tightly screw on a metal ring. Process in a hot-water bath for 15 minutes. Using tongs remove the jars. Place on a towel and let cool. Test the seals. Tighten the rings. Store in a cool dark place. Let age for at least 2 weeks before using. Yield 5 pints.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken in water salted to taste until tender. Cool; remove from bone and chop fine. Combine chicken celery eggs pickle relish and broth. Moisten with mayonnaise. Chill. Can be served on lettuce. Makes good sandwiches.

title: Fresh Apple Cake #3
instructions: Blend sugar and eggs; add vanilla. Sift flour soda cinnamon and salt. Gradually add flour mixture and oil. Mix well. Stir in apples and nuts. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch or tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Layered Fiesta Spread
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet cook onion and beef until onion is tender and beef is no longer pink. Drain off fat. Stir in chili powder then refried beans. Cook covered until heated through. Stir. Spread avocado dip over mixture. Top with shredded cheese. Heat until cheese is soft. Before serving dollop sour cream over cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Hot Johnny Tomato Catsup
instructions: *If you like it mild leave out cayenne pepper.

title: Baked Chicken Sandwich
instructions: Mix the chicken mushroom soup gravy pimento onion and water chestnuts together. Cut crusts from bread. Spread mixture on 10 slices of bread and cover with the other 10 slices. Wrap individual sandwiches in plastic wrap or wax paper and freeze. At serving time dip the sandwiches still frozen in a mixture of beaten eggs and milk. Coat with crushed potato chips and place on a buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 10 sandwiches.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Layer broccoli in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Layer chicken on top of broccoli. Mix lemon juice mayonnaise bouillon cubes skim milk flour and curry powder in a saucepan. Cook over medium-high heat until it thickens. Pour this sauce over the broccoli and chicken. Next add a layer of cheese. Melt the butter and pour it over the bread crumbs. Put this on top as the last layer. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Marinated Steak
instructions: Combine dressing garlic onion and a dash of salt and pepper in a shallow glass dish. Add steak turn to coat with marinade. Refrigerate for several hours turning steak occasionally. Just before serving preheat broiler or grill. Drain steak broil or grill.

title: Apple Enchiladas
instructions: Mix cinnamon with apple pie filling after mashing pie filling with a potato masher. Spoon pie filling evenly down centers of tortillas. Roll up and place seam down in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bring butter sugar and water to a boil and boil 3 minutes stirring constantly. Pour over enchiladas and let stand for 30 minutes. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.

title: Honey Wings
instructions: Wash chicken wings. Season with salt pepper and Cajun seasoning. Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Place chicken wings in a roasting pan with 1/2 cup water 1/2 stick of butter and 1/2 onion. Let chicken wings bake about 30 minutes. In a bowl mix honey red pepper and hot sauce. Take chicken wings out and brush on honey mix and let cook for another 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple and save 2 cups pineapple juice. Cook package of vanilla pudding using 2 cups pineapple juice and 1 cup water. Cook until thick. Pour over fruit. Chill. When ready to serve slice 2 to 3 bananas. Mix and serve.

title: Bran Refrigerator Muffins
instructions: *If Raisin Bran is not used.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender approximately 5 minutes. In a mixing bowl combine all ingredients placing the bread crumbs on top. Place in a casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Excellent casserole!

title: Rice With Green Peas(Servings:  8)
instructions: Knead and rinse the rice. Place the rice and water in a heavy medium size saucepan and leave it for half an hour. Add salt and sake. Place the saucepan with a tight fitting lid on low heat for 1 to 2 minutes. Keep it covered until done. Heat over high heat for 9 to 10 minutes. Then for 5 to 6 minutes over medium heat. Continue cooking over low heat for another 5 to 6 minutes. Finally increase heat to high and cook only for 20 seconds. Stop the fire and mix the prepared peas very quickly. Cover rice with a paper towel replacing the lid immediately. Let stand for 10 minutes. Do not lift lid while rice is cooking.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend cream cheese and butter. Add sugar and eggs; mix well. There may be small lumps of cream cheese thats okay. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Chocolate Coffee Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Kolacky
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese; add milk sugar and egg yolk. Add sifted flour and baking powder. Chill dough. Knead and roll out to 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick. Using a small cookie cutter cut out shapes and fill with fruit filling. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chili Powder Substitute
instructions: Blend in blender. Use as you would chili powder. Also excellent in baked beans.

title: Mexican Melt
instructions: Melt cheeses (with salsa) with ground beef. Serve with Doritos.

title: Hershey Kiss Cookies
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients until creamy. Beating water egg and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Cover and chill for about 2 hours. Heat oven to 350. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 - 9 minutes. Place Hershey kiss in center of cookie while still warm.

title: Maui-Maui Punch
instructions: This was served at Chattanooga Louawa at So. E. Conference. Serves 75 to 100. Very good.

title: Sweet And Sour Ribs
instructions: On top of stove cover ribs with cold water. Bring to boil; simmer 10 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in roasting pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes until lightly browned. Pour off fat. Add pineapple chunks and peppers. Bake for 10 minutes.

title: Octopus Bubbles
instructions: Stir pineapple juice into club soda. Drink!

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients in order and pour into a 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix all ingredients. Use desired cookie press. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Simple Strawberry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 (8-inch) round cake pans. Combine flour salt and soda; set aside. Beat eggs in large mixing bowl. Add oil sugar gelatin and buttermilk; mix until well blended. Add flour mixture and blend well. Fold berries into batter. Pour batter into prepared pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven. Cool 5 minutes turn out of pans onto rack and cool completely. Frost with Buttercream Icing.

title: Homemade Cream Soup Mix(Lo-Fat)
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Store in jar in cool dry place. To make \legal\ cream soup to equal 1 can condensed soup combine 1/2 cup mix with 1 1/4 cups water or defatted broth. Cook until thick.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms and remove stems. Flake crabmeat and mix it into the cream cheese. Fill mushroom caps with the crab mixture and bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Great appetizers for parties.

title: Southern Plantation Salad
instructions: Sprinkle shrimp with the lemon juice and set aside. Combine other ingredients and stir in shrimp. Chill. Makes 8 servings.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Pour into a 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Saute onions celery and parsley in butter.\tPut raw rice and vegetables in a large casserole. Mix together. Add chicken broth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours covered.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Blend salad dressing and sugar until sugar is dissolved. Sift and measure flour and sift with cocoa and soda. Stir into salad dressing mixture. Add boiling water and stir until smooth. Add vanilla pour into well greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Ice while hot.

title: Oven Roasted Fries
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes as if making fried potatoes.

title: Chicken Fajita Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken into strips and cook in olive oil. Add peppers and onions to chicken. Add taco seasoning. Cook until chicken is done. Place chicken in casserole dish and add peppers and onions on top. Pour salsa over this and add cheese. Place under broiler until cheese is bubbly. Serve with sour cream.

title: Boy Scout Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix together first 3 ingredients. Combine shortening and milk and stir slowly a little at a time into flour mixture. Shape biscuits and place in a greased 8 x 11-inch pan. Bake for 12 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients (except pie crust and cheese ) together and put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Then add layer of cheese slices over hamburger mixture. Cover with your favorite pie crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add vinegar and salt. Let start to gel and all 1 cup sour cream and onion and cucumber. Mix well and gel until solid.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream(Custard)
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Beat eggs into milk. Slowly add to flour mixture. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thickened. When cooled add half and half and vanilla. Pour into freezer container and finish filling with milk. (I usually cook the custard the day before and refrigerate overnight.) Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: You will need a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Curried Rice
instructions: Saute onion in butter in a saucepan until tender. Add water and bouillon cube; bring to a boil. Stir in remaining ingredients. Allow mixture to return to a boil; cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Yield 4 servings.

title: Spicy Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Pour dressing over chicken. Place chicken in oven. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Wedding Crab Dip
instructions: Blend all together. Fold in crab. Pour into greased casserole. Top with 1/4 cup Gruyere and heat until bubbly in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Yields 1 quart. Serve with Melba toast.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp in a large pot or kettle. Remove. Saute onions celery and potatoes. Add water and seasonings. Simmer until potatoes are tender. Combine flour with milk. Add to kettle and cook until thickened. Add corn cream cheese and bacon. Stir very frequently. Serve when cheese is melted and soup is hot!

title: Chicken Cheese Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In 3-quart baking dish place chicken. Top with cheese. Stir soup and spread over cheese. Top with tomato slices. Mix margarine and stuffing. Sprinkle over tomato slices. Bake for 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Serve over rice. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Melt butter. Mix soup and rice. Pour into baking dish. Add breasts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Pecan Filling And Frosting
instructions: Combine milk sugar egg yolks butter and vanilla in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens almost 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add coconut and pecans. Beat until cool and spread between layers top and sides of cake.

title: Refried Beans
instructions: In iron skillet heat bacon grease and add pinto beans. Mash with potato masher. Add chili powder garlic salt and onion salt and stir over medium heat until beans are smooth. Top with grated cheese.

title: Third Graders' Favorite Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually and beat until light. Add egg. Combine dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Refrigerate for approximately 15 minutes. Roll thin on board sprinkled with confectioners sugar (or flour). Cut with your favorite cookie cutters. Place on greased cookie sheet. Decorate with colored sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yield about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until tender; skin bone and cut in cubes. Mix chicken with other ingredients except stuffing mix. Pour into casserole and sprinkle stuffing mix and dot with margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour. Will serve 8 to 10 people.

title: Tuna Mold
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water; set aside. Combine tomato soup and cream cheese in medium saucepan. Heat over medium heat stirring until well blended. Cool; add remaining ingredients. Pour into mold. Chill several hours until firm. Serve with crackers or on greens as a salad.

title: Walnut Frosties And Topping
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream 1 cup sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Blend in vanilla and egg. Gradually add flour soda and salt to creamed mixture. Mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. With thumb make imprint in center of each cookie. Combine topping ingredients and fill each cookie with 1 teaspoonful. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Balls In Celery Sauce
instructions: Flake corned beef with fork. Add bread onion egg and potato; mix. Shape into 12 balls and brown on all sides in hot butter in frypan. Place in casserole dish. Add hot water to celery soup and mix. Pour over balls. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 4 to 6. Can be prepared the day before adding soup when ready to cook.

title: Turkey Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat soups and Cheez Whiz in heavy saucepan. Add broccoli and turkey. Place cooked rice in 9 x 13-inch pan or dish. Cover with broccoli mixture. Pour melted margarine over Ritz crumbs and toss to coat. Spread on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. You could use ham or chicken instead of turkey.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add soup green chilies sauce and chopped onions. Heat thoroughly. Crumble 5 to 6 tortillas in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with half of meat mixture. Crumble an additional 5 tortillas on meat mixture. Top with remaining meat and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Pan Sugar Biscuits
instructions: Pull biscuits in halves or fourths. Get grease or Crisco or oil hot place in skillet. Turn when golden brown on every side. Remove carefully. Place on paper towel then roll in sugar or powdered sugar until coated. A great sweet and chewy snack.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Combine sugar cinnamon and pecans. Pour 1/2 batter into greased and floured pan. Top with 1/2 sugar mixture. Repeat. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pina Colada Pie
instructions: To prepare crust mix crushed vanilla wafers sugar nutmeg and 1/2 cup coconut. Add melted butter and mix well. Press firmly into a 9-inch pie pan and bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Sherbet Punch
instructions: Mix in order given adding ginger ale and sherbet when ready to serve.

title: Cream Cheese Peanut Bars(1993 National Peanut Festival Grand Prize Winning Recipe)
instructions: Combine cake mix margarine and 1 egg. Mix well. Press into a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine confectioners sugar cream cheese 2 eggs 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well. Pour over cake and top with peanuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until layer is done. Cool for approximately 1 hour and cut into bars. Yield 15 bars.

title: Dilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery pickles dill and apples. Moisten with mayonnaise or salad dressing. Serve on lettuce; garnish with almonds olives and cranberry cubes (if used). Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Honey-Fruit Syrup
instructions: In a small saucepan stir together pineapple juice honey cornstarch and ground ginger. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly cook and stir for 2 minutes more. Stir in fruit. Serve over pancakes waffles or French toast.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a large casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Gradually stir milk and egg into pudding mix in saucepan. Add rice and raisins. Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Serve warm.

title: Purple Cloud
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender container. Blend briefly. Pour into serving glasses. Serves 2.

title: Green Tomato Mincemeat
instructions: Cut tomatoes in small pieces or grind (I put them through food chopper). Bring to a boil in cold water 3 times draining off water each time. Add all other ingredients except pineapple. Cook slowly about 3 hours or until done. Add pineapple last 5 minutes. Put into hot sterile jars and seal. May process in hot water bath for 20 minutes.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Layer first 7 ingredients in order given in a 12 x 9-inch casserole dish. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice mustard and sugar; spread evenly over top of salad completely sealing to edges. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours. Garnish with parsley.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg then add lemon extract and pineapple. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Chili Con Carne Or Chili(For Weight Watchers)
instructions: In large saucepan or Dutch oven cook beef in boiling salted water to cover until it loses its red color. Drain; discard liquid. Break up any large pieces of beef; set aside. In same pot combine the onion celery green pepper and garlic. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes adding 3 to 4 tablespoons water if necessary to prevent vegetables from sticking. Stir in chili powder 3/4 teaspoon salt oregano and bay leaves. Cook 3 minutes. Add beef beans tomatoes and juice. Simmer uncovered stirring often. Divide evenly among 12 bowls. Serve each portion topped with extra onion if desired.

title: Butter Pecan Torte
instructions: Crust Combine graham crackers soda crackers and butter. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Panned Oysters
instructions: Heat butter in heavy skillet. Add oysters. Saute until done. Serve over toast. Pour remaining drawn butter over bread. Great for New Years breakfast.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients with wet hands. Form 16 balls. Brown slowly in hot oil shaking pan frequently to keep balls round. Blend paste with other ingredients. Pour over meatballs. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Serve over cooked noodles or spaghetti.

title: Chicken Livers Wrapped In Bacon(For Parties)
instructions: Cut chicken livers in about 3 or 4 pieces each. Stir in other ingredients except bacon. Cover and put in refrigerator for about 1 hour. Cut bacon slices in half. Wrap each piece of chicken liver with a piece of bacon; fasten with a toothpick. Place in a broiler pan or any bread pan that is deep enough to catch the grease while cooking. Bake in oven at about 350\u00b0. Bake until bacon is done.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks. Combine flour and soda. Alternate with buttermilk. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in egg whites coconut nuts and vanilla. Bake in 3 greased and floured cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Wash rice. Combine meat rice salt pepper and onion. Shape into balls. Place in pressure cooker on rack and pour tomato soup and water over meatballs. Cook for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream with hands. Roll into balls and flatten. Brush with egg white. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 until brown. Sprinkle with salt.

title: Victorian Pink Punch
instructions: Mix the Bacardi mix and 7-Up in a large glass punch bowl. Place rounded spoonfuls of pink sherbet on top. Serve chilled.

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
instructions: In shakeable container place all ingredients; shake. Chill 1 hour. Bring back to room temperature before serving.

title: Cottage Cheese Patties
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients and drop by spoonfuls into oiled frypan. When golden brown place in casserole and cover with gravy made from remainder of ingredients. Simmer in oven for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Use a 9 x 13-inch dish.

title: Baked Beans With Hamburger
instructions: Soak beans overnight and cook in salt water until well done. Prepare hamburger by browning in skillet with salt and onions added. Combine beans and hamburger in small roaster. Add tomato juice catsup chili powder and a small handful of brown sugar to suit taste. Bake 1/2 hour in 350-375\u00b0 oven.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: In large bowl cream butter and sugar. Add egg. Mix well. In separate bowl combine flour and baking powder. Gradually add to butter mixture. Add coconut nuts and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Press 2/3 of dough into greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan. Spread with preserves; crumble remaining dough over preserves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown. Cool in pan on wire rack. Cut into squares. Yield 36 bars.

title: Baked Pork Chop Moana
instructions: Place chops in single layer in a shallow baking pan. Mix wine and soy sauce; pour over chops. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour or so turning 3 or 4 times. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour turning and basting occasionally.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Then put in oven and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Lemon Sponge Custard Pie
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar egg yolks lemon juice flour and salt. Mix well. Stir in milk. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold egg whites into 1st mixture. Pour into crust-lined pie plate. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 35 more minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: My Favorite Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix the sugar cocoa and flour together in a bowl. Boil the water and pour over the cocoa mixture. Add the margarine salt and vanilla. Stir. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir then microwave 1 minute longer.

title: Pecan Bars
instructions: Line cookie sheet with crackers leaving whole. Sprinkle chopped pecans on top. Mix sugar margarine and butter together; bring to a boil. Boil 2 to 3 minutes. Drizzle over crackers and pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until light brown. Wait 2 minutes and cut into bars. Place on paper towel to drain some of butter. Store in container.

title: Homemade Egg Substitute(Cholesterol Free)
instructions: Beat egg whites lightly with a fork. Add remaining ingredients and beat until blended. Makes 6 tablespoons equivalent to 2 whole eggs or 1/2 egg substitute.

title: Campfire Cobbler
instructions: Put peaches in Dutch oven. Mix in red hots. Spread cake mix on top but do not stir in. Cover and bake right on hot coals 30 minutes. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar and cornstarch. Add milk 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and eggs. Cook on low heat until thick. Add coconut and mix well. Pour into baked pie shells. Cool.

title: Scampi Style Shrimp
instructions: In large skillet stir the green onions and garlic with margarine and oil for 1 minute. Add shrimp; cook and stir until shrimp are pink. Add ReaLemon and salt and heat thoroughly. Garnish as desired.

title: Mamma'S Pound Cake
instructions: Separate eggs; hold back whites. Cream the sugar butter and eggs; mix well. Sift flour soda and baking powder together. Add alternately flour and buttermilk. Add flavorings. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into mixture. Pour in greased tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheesy Meat Roll
instructions: Combine hamburger egg green pepper and onion. Generously add salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Spread mixture onto long piece of waxed paper. Pat meat mixture into a thin long rectangle. Spread tomato sauce over entire meat mixture. Sprinkle with helpings of cheese of your taste. Neatly take wax paper and begin to roll rectangle into a rolled tube. Place into a long dish.

title: Peanut Puffs
instructions: Cream shortening with peanut butter and salt until light and fluffy. Gradually add powdered sugar. Blend in vanilla then flour. Stir in peanuts; mix well. Shape into small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until golden brown. Roll in sifted powdered sugar immediately after removing from oven. When cool roll again in powdered sugar. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Merilee'S Chicken And Rice Salad
instructions: Marinate chicken for at least 1 hour in salad oil orange juice vinegar and salt. Mix together in bowl grapes celery pineapple mandarin oranges almonds rice and mayonnaise; add marinated chicken mixture and mix together well. Chill for several hours.

title: Lazarus Cheesecake
instructions: Prepare graham cracker crust and press into spring-form pan. Spray with Pam. Mix cream cheese and sugar for 3 to 5 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat for 30 minutes. Bake in spring-form pan at 300\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 20 minutes. In bowl mix together sour cream sugar and vanilla. Pour on top of cooled cake and return to oven for 10 minutes. You can omit topping and top with fruit.

title: Ann'S Steak Sauce Romaine Salad
instructions: Mix in blender alternating egg and oil. Serve over romaine lettuce with black olives and artichoke hearts.

title: Beau'S Chicken(Great; Low Calorie, Fat-Free)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake chicken breasts for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and spoon salsa over chicken and then put 1 slice cheese on each piece of chicken. Return to oven and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Hard Candy
instructions: You will need Wilton hard candy molds.

title: Parkay Orange Holiday Cookies
instructions: Mix flour cornstarch baking powder baking soda and salt in small bowl. Beat margarine sour cream sugar vanilla orange extract and peel in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy. Blend in egg. Gradually add flour mixture beating well after each addition.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Bring water and sugar to boil or until sugar is dissolved. Add cranberries and simmer approximately 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add the 2 packages Jell-O. Cool then add the remaining ingredients.

title: Spiced Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix sugar water and spices in saucepan. Boil 5 minutes. Remove spices; cool. Add fruit juices. Refrigerate until needed. Just before serving add ginger ale to juices in punch bowl. Garnish with slices of orange and lemon studded with whole cloves. May be doubled or tripled as needed.

title: Refrigerator Salad
instructions: Put marshmallows in bowl and add milk. Put in microwave for a few seconds until melted. Put cream cheese and sour cream in mixer. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour in marshmallow mix and fruit cocktail (drained). Mix together. Add 1/2 cups nuts if desired. Make the day before and let chill overnight.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Put potatoes on to boil. Brown and drain beef; add soup. When potatoes are tender drain all water. Add milk and butter; mash together. Layer hamburger soup potatoes then cheese. Brown in oven. Let cool 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spanish Chicken Casserole(Lower Fat)
instructions: Saute chopped onion in 3 tablespoons chicken broth over low heat. Add 14 ounces chicken broth and sour cream; continue to simmer. Add flour and cornstarch; mix with a wire beater to blend. Stir in water chestnuts green chiles and mushrooms. Cut tortillas into fourths. Line a large casserole dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray with part of the tortilla pieces. Fold chicken into sauce. Spoon chicken sauce over tortillas and sprinkle 1/2 of grated cheese on top. Repeat layers and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: 1. Prepare macaroni according to directions on the package.

title: *Coconut Pie*
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shells. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fiesta Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill several hours before serving. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chili Casserole
instructions: Place 2 cups broken chips in a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish; spread half of soup over chips. Spread chili and beans over soup and top with remaining soup. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining chips and bake 5 minutes longer. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Coconut-Nut Topping
instructions: Melt butter. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Aunt Chris' Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in a heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan. Bring to a rolling boil stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme and nuts. Mix until well blended. Pour into 8 x 8 foil pans lined with wax paper and let set to cool. Will take 2 pans. After cooled cut into squares.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes cut in half. Put into baking dish. Spread with sugar and margarine mixed together. Add 1/4 cup water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix hash browns sour cream soup cheese onions and milk together. Mix well. Melt butter in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Save half of butter to mix with cornflakes or crackers for topping. Pour into baking dish and top with crackers. Spread over top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Built-In Relish Burgers
instructions: Brown meat and onion in salad oil until meat is crumbly. Pour off excess oil. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve on buttered toasted buns. Serves 10.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts on top of stove or in microwave until cooked through. Put in bottom of 9 x 12 baking dish.

title: Blueberry Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water; allow to cool. Stir in pie filling and lemon juice. Chill until partly set. Spoon half of Jell-O mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine sour cream and sugar; spread over Jell-O mixture. Top with remaining Jell-O mixture. Chill before serving.

title: Super Southern Gal Biscuits
instructions: Sift together the first 5 ingredients. Cut in the margarine or shortening until crumbly. Add the milk; beat in the egg. Knead 5 to 10 times. Roll 1-inch thick; cut for biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Bayou Gumbo
instructions: Dredge chicken in flour (1/3 cup). Brown in oil. Remove. Add onion zucchini and garlic and saute until tender. Add tomatoes okra broth and water along with seasonings. Allow to simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Add rice corn and chicken; simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes. When ready to serve add olives and heat through.

title: Chocolate Lush
instructions: Melt butter in a pan. Crush Oreo cookies. Spread cookies in a 9 x 9-inch cake pan. Pour butter over cookies. Put in refrigerator until cool. Mix vanilla and chocolate pudding together with 3 cups milk until thick. Set aside. Mix together the powdered sugar 1 cup Cool Whip and cream cheese. Spread over cookies. Pour pudding mixture over cookies and cream cheese. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle crushed walnuts on top if wanted. Chill until firm.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Slightly brown ground beef and onion. Drain well. Spread three cups of cabbage in bottom of an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Spread meat on top of cabbage. Top with remaining cabbage. Combine soup and water spoon over casserole. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Onion Butter
instructions: Mix soup mix and margarine.

title: Hay Stacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch. Remove from heat. Stir in noodles and peanuts. Drop on wax paper to cool.

title: Molasses Cookies(Chewy German Cookie)
instructions: In a saucepan mix together the molasses sugar spices and water. Bring to a boil and sustain for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cool. Add nuts and the flour mixed with baking powder. Mix well. Let stand until cold. Divide dough and roll out on board or cloth with a rolling pin or pat by hand. Cut into diamond shapes and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes. Makes 12 to 14 dozen.

title: Potato Gnocchi
instructions: Boil potatoes until fork soft; cool. Mash down very well. Place on floured board and mix with flour. May require additional flour; add gradually. Knead until smooth. Roll into thin rolls and cut 1 to 1 1/2-inches long. Press lightly with a fork. Freeze on waxed paper in layers. When ready to heat boil in salted boiling water a handful at a time. Gnocchi are done when they float to top. Dont overcook.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers in thin slices. Cut peppers in fine strips. Dissolve salt in ice water and pour over sliced rings. Let stand for 3 hours then drain. Combine sugar vinegar mustard seed turmeric and whole cloves. Bring to boil and then add drained rings. Heat to boiling but do not boil. Put in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Lobster Newburg
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet. Blend in flour until smooth. Add cream all at once. Cook stirring constantly until thickened.

title: Almond Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ham stirring until blended. Spread 1 tablespoon mixture on each ham slice. Roll up jellyroll fashion starting at short end. Wrap in plastic wrap and freeze up to 1 month. Thaw at room temperature 1 hour before serving. Cut each roll into 3/4-inch slices. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Scotch Pancakes(Breakfast)
instructions: Beat ingredients together until smooth. Use one rounded tablespoonful per cake. Makes 40 (2-inch) cakes.

title: Popcorn Cracker Jacks
instructions: Blend butter honey and peanuts together in pan. Heat until well blended. Pour mixture over popcorn. Spread out on cookie sheet in a thin layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Foolproof Beef And Broccoli
instructions: Slice beef across grain into very thin strips. In skillet over medium heat cook beef and garlic until beef is brown. Add onion and cook 5 minutes. Stir in soup water and soy sauce. Heat to a boil. Add broccoli. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corned beef. Place in baking dish and bake until vegetables are tender. (Add 1/2 cup water if cooking in conventional oven.) Cover with corned beef and return to oven until piping hot. May be topped with shredded cheese if desired.

title: Crock Pot Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cook in crock pot on high for 3 hours.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and butter. Beat in eggs.\tAdd vanilla and vinegar. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 one hour.

title: Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine teriyaki sauce and 1/4 cup water in shallow baking dish; add chicken pieces coating well. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Drain marinade from chicken. Heat oil in large skillet or wok; stir-fry chicken and onion until chicken is slightly browned. Stir in vegetables ginger and wine. Cover and simmer 4 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp. Combine cornstarch and water in small bowl until smooth. Gradually add to skillet stirring constantly until thickened. Serve over rice. Yields 6 servings. Low fat!

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients for 3 or 4 minutes. Fold in package of frozen coconut and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare box cake mix as directed on box in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool 5 minutes. Punch holes in top of cake with fork. Pour 1 can Eagle Brand milk over cake.

title: Mexi-Corn Pudding(No Fat)
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a medium bowl; stir well. Combine egg substitute and milk; add to corn mixture stirring to combine. Pour mixture into a 1-quart baking dish coated with cooking spray. Place dish in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour hot water into pan to a depth of 1 inch. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Yields 6 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Down East Casserole(Serves 8)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook noodles; drain. Saute scallops in 4 tablespoons butter. When almost cooked add shrimp and cook until seafood is opaque. Drain. Save liquid. Melt 6 tablespoons butter blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook until smooth. Slowly add milk (some of seafood liquid could be substituted). Cook until sauce thickens stirring constantly. Add sherry. Add scallops shrimp and sauce to noodles.

title: Corn Pudding (Large)
instructions: Mix flour with sugar. Add all other ingredients. Spray dish with Pam so it will come out easy. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Brittany'S Pizza
instructions: Split each piece of bread into 2 pieces. Spread tomato sauce on 1 side of all slice. Put the cheese on top. Place on a microwave-safe plate. Microwave for 20 to 40 seconds or until cheese melts.

title: Cameo Ranch Soup
instructions: Briefly saut onion and celery on medium heat (do not overcook). Add Ro-Tel chicken broth and Ranch mix. Slowly bring to a medium boil. Add the diced chicken and Velveeta. Stir until Velveeta is melted. Serves 16.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour oatmeal salt baking powder and soda. Mix all ingredients together then add Hershey bar chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Dont overbake. Use ungreased cookie sheet. Make golf ball size cookies placed 2-inches apart. Should yield 112 cookies.

title: Salted Nut Roll Bars
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour about 1/2 of the nuts on the bottom. Melt together in microwave the peanut butter chips and margarine. Add condensed milk and stir to smooth consistency. Fold in marshmallows and press mixture on top of nuts. Press mixture down. (It helps to wet hands under faucet) and top with rest of nuts. Press nuts down firmly. Let set and cut into bars of desired size. The taste is similar to Salted Nut Roll candy bars.

title: Appetizer Quiche
instructions: Mix Bisquick 1/2 of the Cheddar cheese and onions. Mix milk and beaten egg together and then mix all together. Pour into greased 12 x 8-inch or 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread remaining Cheddar cheese on top. Crumble the bacon over the cheese. Make sure that the meat is generous. Pour the melted margarine over top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut while warm. Serves 15 to 18.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Cut shortening into flour sugar baking powder salt and soda with pastry blender. Stir in buttermilk and yeast mixture until dough leaves sides of bowl. Dough will be soft and sticky. Pour dough onto floured surface; roll into ball. Knead lightly 25 to 30 times. Sprinkle with flour if dough is too sticky. Roll it 1/2-inch thick. Cut with round cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 on a greased cookie sheet for about 14 minutes. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen biscuits.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Prepare chicken with salt and pepper. Mix saltine crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Dip chicken into melted butter and roll in crumb mixture. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Enjoy!

title: Peppy
instructions: Cook drain and rinse pasta. Drain and reserve all juices. Mix juice sugar eggs salt and flour. Heat until thick. Cool. Refrigerate overnight. Separate juice and pasta prior to refrigeration.

title: Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs; one at a time with flour salt soda and vanilla. Add apples nuts and coconut. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes in greased tube pan.

title: 30 Minute Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a saucepan combine water cocoa and margarine. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and pour over flour and sugar. Add eggs buttermilk and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into a greased sheet pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Terry'S Kale Soup
instructions: Cut beef into bite size pieces and brown in olive oil. Skin and slice sausages into bite size pieces and add to beef to brown. Then cover meat with water and add washed (peeled if necessary) and chopped vegetables and cook until everything is tender. Then add drained kidney beans and cook for another 1/2 hour.

title: Montana Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes and onion with margarine. Salt and pepper in enough water to cover until tender. Add flour to milk and add to potato mixture along with ham. Cook until thick. Serves 2.

title: Greek Beef Stew(Serves 6)
instructions: Blanch onions in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and peel. In a kettle melt the 1/2 stick of butter over moderate heat. Add the beef and toss to coat it with the butter. Do not let it brown.

title: Turkey And Mashed Potatoes
instructions: To Prepare Remove neck and giblets from cavities rinse turkey and wipe dry. Rub body cavity lightly with salt if roasting unstuffed. Cook neck and giblets for broth for flavoring dressing and for giblet gravy.

title: Deep Fried Squid Rings
instructions: Dry rings thoroughly with paper towels. Coat with flour to which salt and pepper has been added. Heat oil to 350\u00b0 or until drop of water sizzles immediately when dropped in oil. Plunge basket laden with 1 layer of squid into oil which should bubble vigorously on contact. If you dont have basket for deep frying use large spoon or tongs to immerse squid in oil and to remove. Fry until coating turns brown about 3 to 4 minutes. Serve hot with lemon-garlic butter or cocktail sauce.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Drain water from tuna.\tMix everything together. Place in blender or food processor on high speed until all is well mixed and smooth. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Old Southern Date Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix well. Add nut meats and vanilla last. Bake in slow oven (275\u00b0) for 1 hour. Use loaf pan.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Place rice and milk in heavy saucepan. Bring to a slight boil. Cover over low heat. After 1 hour add sugar and vanilla. Raisins may be added if desired last 15 minutes of cooking. Stir often; cook until thick. Careful may scorch easily!

title: Spicy Grilled Corn
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter. Stir in mustard horseradish Worcestershire sauce and lemon pepper. Place each ear of corn on a 12 x 9-inch piece of heavy-duty foil. Drizzle butter mixture over corn. Fold edges of foil to seal pouch securely leaving space for steam expansion. Grill over medium hot coals turning occasionally for 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: *One bottle is probably enough but some people might like more; mix in.

title: Tami'S Best Cheesecake
instructions: Beat softened cream cheese and add other ingredients in order listed one at a time. Pour into crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 at 1 1/2 hours or until set. Chill and garnish with fruit.

title: Tuna Waldorf Salad
instructions: Sprinkle apple with lemon juice. Combine with remaining ingredients. Chill. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Seafoam Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff. Gradually add sugar and beat for 1 minute. Fold in chips and nuts. Drop from teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until browned. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl beat eggs until creamy and pale yellow in color about 5 minutes. Beat in sugar salt corn syrup butter and vanilla. Stir in coconut oats and chocolate. Pour into pie shell. Bake 40 to 50 minutes until nutty brown. Cool on rack; refrigerate to chill before serving.

title: Homemade Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook in double boiler until thick and smooth. Pour in container and store in refrigerator. Serve on fresh salad greens.

title: Swedish Heirlooms
instructions: Cream the ingredients and add nuts. Roll into balls and flatten. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Roll in 10x sugar while warm.

title: Garlic Grits
instructions: Beat eggs; add milk to total one cup. Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Stir Fry Rice For 4
instructions: Begin cooking rice. Follow directions on package for 2 servings. While rice is cooking chop onion into 1/2 inch cubes or small strips. Chop garlic. Place oil onion and garlic into skillet on medium low heat. Let warm gently until onion begins to become translucent. Meanwhile chop carrot into 1/4 inch cubes (slice 1/4 inch long ways lay flat then long ways again then into cubes) and set aside. Take one cup frozen green peas out of bag cover with hot water and let set. Check rice and set aside when done. Turn heat up on skillet to medium high. When temp. is reached add rice to oil onion and garlic and spread in skillet. Pour in soy sauce wine and pepper. Let temp. rise back to medium high while turning with flat spatula. In center of skillet separate a hole in rice. Put eggs in center (yellows still whole). As eggs are cooking chop with spatula cutting yellows and whites stirring only slightly (the eggs will be chunky). Gently mix eggs with rice maintaining egg chunks. Rice and egg mixture should be semi-moist and begin sticking a little to skillet. Turn mixture with spatula (eggs should be cooking quickly). Turn heat off and let eggs complete cooking turning as needed. Drain water from peas and pour peas in skillet. Add carrots and turn with spatula to mix all ingredients.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Roll the biscuits in a mixture of the 3/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon and place in Bundt or loaf pan. Sprinkle with chopped nuts if desired. Mix the 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 cup sugar and margarine together over heat until margarine melts and pour over biscuits. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Turn over onto platter. Allow to cool before cutting.

title: Gourmet Cheese Balls
instructions: Cut the cheese into bite size pieces. Spread the flour on a square of waxed paper. Beat the egg with a fork and mix well with the milk in a shallow bowl. Spread the breadcrumbs on another square of waxed paper. Heat oil in a deep fat fryer or wok to 325\u00b0. Dip the pieces of cheese in flour shaking off excess. Dip in the egg and milk mixture and roll in breadcrumbs. Deep fry for 10 to 15 seconds or until golden brown. Serve immediately. Makes approximately 30 pieces.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese and sour cream until most of the lumps are gone. Add spices and mix in well. Now top mixture with grated Cheddar cheese chopped tomatoes and sliced black olives. Chill for about 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Low-Fat Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage in skillet. When its partially done add onion green chili and bell pepper. Continue cooking until sausage is nicely browned. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place bread in pan. Pour sausage mixture over bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat milk eggs and mustard together and pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Casserole may be made ahead of time and refrigerated. If so set out at room temperature 15 minutes before baking.

title: Rice Krispies Dessert
instructions: Mix Rice Krispies and peanut butter. Just bring to boil syrup sugar and vanilla. In microwave melt chocolate and butterscotch chips. In 13 x 9-inch buttered dish pound down Rice Krispies mixture. Spread chocolate mix on top. Kids \love\ this one.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken; debone and put in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all the soups and chicken broth together. Drain the Veg-All and mix with the soup. Pour this mixture over the chicken. Mix the milk with 1 package of Bisquick and pour over the other ingredients. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Put pineapple and juice into a bowl. Stir in pudding and fold in Cool Whip cherries nuts and marshmallows. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Place one crust in a pie plate as directed on package for a 2 crust pie. Spoon in mixture. Cover with top crust. Crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust and brush with egg if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Marshmallow Creme Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar Milnot and oleo together and cook until mixture comes to a boil stirring frequently. Boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips and Marshmallow Creme. Stir ingredients until mixture is creamy and smooth. Pour into a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Allow to cool and cut as desired. Makes 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Separate eggs. Beat egg whites until stiff. Cream butter sugar vanilla and egg yolks. Sift together in another bowl all dry ingredients. To main mixture add alternately the sour cream and dry ingredients. Mix very well. Loosely fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Done when toothpick in center is clean.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients except milk with soup. Make small patties and roll in flour.\tBrown patties in skillet and place in baking pan. Pour\tsoup and milk mixture over\ttop of patties. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: In large bowl cream first 3 ingredients. Add the rest of ingredients to first 3 and hand mix well. Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 40 minutes. Recipe may be doubled and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Gravy For Chicken Or Liver
instructions: Heat fat from chicken or butter. Add onions and celery and cook just a little. Add flour pepper and sage. Cut up boiled egg and add. Add meat of chicken or you can use liver. Cook until thickens.

title: Beef And Onion Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in refrigerator to firm up. Make into a ball and roll in pecans.

title: White Chocolate Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Then add 3 cups crushed potato chips to chocolate. Add pecans. Drop on wax paper to cool.

title: Coconut-Butterscotch Torte
instructions: Crust Mix butter flour and nuts. Pat firmly in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken breasts; cut up in medium pieces. Set aside. Reserve broth from chicken. Put dry rice into a large covered heavy baking pan. Add the soup to the broth and mix well. Put cut up chicken on top of the dry rice. Add all other ingredients and pour broth and soup mixture over the rice. Bake for 1 hour or until rice and chicken is tender.

title: Cole Slaw Dressing
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in blender; then slowly add vinegar. Blend thoroughly until creamy. Last add celery seed. Makes approximately 1 pint.

title: Simple Supper Beef And Broccoli
instructions: In a skillet over medium-high heat cook beef or chicken and garlic until browned. Add onion; cook 5 minutes stirring often. Stir in soup water and soy sauce. Heat to boiling. Add broccoli. Reduce heat cover and simmer until desired doneness of broccoli. Serve over noodles.

title: Cheese And Bacon Potato Bake
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium-high heat heat broth to a boil; reduce heat. Add potatoes and onion; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Drain reserving 1 1/2 cups broth. In skillet over medium-high heat cook bacon until crisp. Remove and crumble bacon; pour off all but 3 tablespoons drippings. Blend flour into reserved drippings. Gradually add reserved broth; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in cheese until melted. In greased 2-quart baking dish layer 1/2 each potato-onion mixture sauce and bacon. Repeat layers twice. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger drain grease. Combine all ingredients. Cook on low for 1 hour stirring occasionally.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place monkey pot or 2-quart rind mold or Bundt pan on a pie pan to catch any excess drips. Melt butter in a saucepan. Brush the inside of mold well with the butter or spray with vegetable spray.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix the first 2 ingredients for 2 minutes on medium speed or until thick. Add the Cool Whip. Mix until well blended. Add the marshmallows. Layer in bowl as follows layer of pudding mix layer of vanilla wafers layer of bananas. Repeat until all pudding mixture is gone. Its good to start with pudding mix and end with it on top. Sprinkle top with vanilla wafer crumbs.

title: White Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute garlic and oil pour clam juice in with garlic and oil put cubed potatoes in and when almost cooked put clams in and then parsley and milk. Cook a few minutes longer.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients into well beaten eggs. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until comes done in middle.

title: Double Decker Fudge
instructions: 1. Line a 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan with foil. Place 1 cup peanut butter ships in medium bowl. Set aside. in second medium bowl blend 1/4 c butter cocoa and vanilla until smooth. Add 1 c peanut butter chips.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion with margarine for 10 minutes stirring. Stir in parsley salt and pepper basil and oregano. Beat eggs with Muenster cheese. Add zucchini mixture with eggs. Mix well and place in pie shell. Bake 18 to 20 minutes in 370\u00b0 oven. Cool 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Coconut Delight
instructions: Spray a large pan. Place 1/2 gallon of vanilla ice cream in a bowl to soften. Crush 2 sleeves of crackers. Add sugar and stick of melted oleo. Mix together and press in bottom of pan. Mix softened ice cream with 1 cup milk and 3 boxes coconut cream instant pudding. Spread over the crust - Freeze for 4 hours. Top with Cool Whip and toasted coconut (optional). May be refrozen.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs. Add sour cream. Stir in sugar 1 tablespoon of flour vanilla and salt; mix well. Stir in apples. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Malone Supreme
instructions: Barbecue chicken on grill; dont cook completely. Chop chicken up into bite size pieces. Cook noodles; combine chicken celery onion and soup. Place in greased casserole dish. Top with cheese followed by cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 just to heat through (approximately 30 minutes). Serves 4 to 6.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish. Line bottom of dish with white bread. Brown sausage; drain. Spoon sausage over bread; sprinkle with a lot of grated sharp cheese. Beat eggs and milk together; pour into baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil; refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Soften cream cheese until smooth. Add pineapple pepper onion nuts and salt. Roll in nuts and parsley. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate.

title: Pineapple Custard Pie
instructions: Beat 1st three ingredients well. Blend others. Place in unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in 9-inch deep pie shell.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well. Use 1/3 cup (3 heaping teaspoonfuls) and add 1 cup hot water.

title: Lobster Newburg
instructions: Season the lobster pieces with salt white pepper and paprika. Melt 2 ounces of the butter in a saucepan. Fry the lobster pieces gently about 2 minutes. Add the brandy and the sherry. Let simmer until liquid is reduced by half. Add cream. Let simmer again until creamy. Add remaining butter ( do not allow the lobster to boil while adding butter). Rectify seasoning. Serve over freshly made toast. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cooked Play Dough
instructions: Cook on medium heat 1 cup flour 1/2 cup salt and 2 tablespoons cream of tartar adding 1 cup water 1 tablespoon vegetable oil and food coloring. Heat 3 to 5 minutes until mixture globs together and leaves sides of pan. Stir constantly.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in 9 x 13-inch pan; cool cake. Crumble 1/2 of cake in punch bowl. Mix pudding with milk as directed on box. Spread 1/2 pudding on crumbled cake in bowl. Drain pineapple and put 1/2 pineapple over mixture in bowl. Spread 1 bag glaze on pineapple begin with outside edge (needs to be touching sides of bowl to look pretty from outside). Next layer spread 1 cup Cool Whip. Repeat layers beginning with cake. Last layer use rest of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and maraschino cherries as desired.

title: Curried Celery Soup
instructions: In a medium saucepan place celery onion carrot potato garlic salt curry powder and 1 cup of the chicken broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered until vegetables are tender about 15 minutes. Pour half of the vegetable mixture into blender and blend until smooth. Remove and repeat with remaining vegetable mixture. Return all the pureed vegetable mixture to the saucepan. Add condensed skim milk and chicken broth to make desired consistency. Heat only until hot. Do not boil.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Do not drain fruit. Mix fruit and instant pudding. Fold in the Cool Whip and add the miniature marshmallows. Chill before serving.

title: Pumpkin Cake Bars
instructions: Mix eggs (or Egg Mates) pumpkin salt sugar ginger cinnamon and cloves together. Pour into pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top. Drizzle melted butter substitute over mix. Top with chopped nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cut into squares desired number of squares while still warm.

title: Blueberry Pudding Cake
instructions: Thinly slice angel food cake. Place on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place blueberry pie filling over cake. Beat instant pudding with 3/4 cup milk. Add and fold in sour cream and Cool Whip. Mix until smooth. Place cream mixture over blueberries and refrigerate. Always a hit!

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken pieces in lightly buttered baking dish. Top with sliced cheese. Combine soup and wine. Spoon sauce over chicken. Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Fill an 8 or 9-inch pan 3/4 full of sliced apples. In a bowl combine sugar flour and baking powder. Add the beaten egg and stir to form crumbs. Melt oleo and pour over top. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Mixed Vegetables Casserole
instructions: Make a sauce by adding butter flour and salt. Add cheese and cook over slow heat until melted. Pour off liquid from can of vegetables and place in casserole dish. Pour sauce over vegetables and bake 40 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour round pans (8-inch or 9-inch). Drain peaches saving juice. Add enough water to juice to make 1 1/4 cups. Prepare cake mix using the juice water mixture. Bake and cool as directed. Cut peaches into small pieces. Mix yogurt topping and peaches together. Use as icing between layers of cake on on top.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put water in pot to boil. Add dry mixture and stir until thick. Place fresh strawberries in baked pie shell and pour in cooled mixture. Chill and top with whipped cream.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Combine all but last three ingredients for marinade. Add meat. Cover and refrigerate for about 36 hours. Turn meat two times daily.

title: Sausage And Cheese Delights
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain and remove from pan. Brown hamburger and drain. Put meats back in pan and add cubed Velveeta cheese. Stir over low heat until cheese melts; add spices and stir again. Spread on party rye. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl combine oil eggs vanilla and sugar. Combine dry ingredients stir in vegetables and fruits. Add to first mixture and mix well. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full and bake for 15 to 18 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheesy Chicken Crescent Supper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl combine chicken and 2 tablespoons cheese. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place about 3 tablespoons chicken mixture on wide end of each. Roll up start at shortest side; roll to opposite side. In medium saucepan combine soup milk and 1/4 cup cheese. Heat until cheese melts. Pour half of soup mixture into ungreased 8 or 9-inch pan (reserve remaining soup mixture for sauce). Arrange filled crescents over hot soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Sprinkle with remaining tablespoon of cheese. Return to oven for 5 to 10 minutes until cheese is melted. Serve with remaining sauce. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain squash. Add salt and pepper to taste. Mix sour cream soup and onion in a small bowl. In another bowl pour melted butter over dressing; mix well. Alternate layers (2) of squash soup and dressing in casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Deluxe German Potato Salad
instructions: In a skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain crumble and set aside. In the drippings saute celery and onions until tender. Combine sugar and flour. Add to skillet with vinegar water salt and mustard. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens. In a large bowl combine potatoes carrots parsley and bacon. Pour the sauce over the potato mixture and stir gently to coat.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook noodles uncovered in boiling water for 20 minutes. Drain. Combine soup milk water and Cheddar cheese in 3-quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat until cheese melts and sauce is hot; stir constantly. Stir in cooked noodles turkey peas carrots and pimento. Spoon mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Hot Corn Bread(Or Mexican Bread)
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except peppers). Chop peppers (with rubber gloves on) and add to mix. Stir well and bake in well-greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or so.

title: Broiled Spareribs
instructions: Broil spareribs in broiler oven until golden brown on both sides. Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients in large pan and boil for 10 minutes uncovered. Place ribs in uncovered roaster pan and pour some of the sauce over them. Bake in a hot 450\u00b0 oven for 1 hour basting every 10 minutes with rest of sauce which should be kept boiling. Serves 5.

title: Apple Torte
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs. Beat in 1 cup of the apples. Add dry ingredients. Fold in remaining 3 cups apples and nuts. Place in large greased pan such as broiler pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Blend onion celery and bell pepper. Saute in butter until clear. Add crab meat cream cheese red pepper and salt. Serve hot.

title: Blackberry Or Peach Wine Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour shortening soda and salt until crumbly. Mix water eggs and vinegar together then add to flour mixture.

title: Corn Ole
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Add remaining ingredients; cover. Cook 10 to 15 minutes or until squash is tender stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Creamy Hash Browns
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in a greased 13x9 pan at 350 for 40-45 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and broccoli according to package directions. Cube the cheese. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in 2-quart casserole.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: In a large clear bowl layer the first 7 ingredients in order listed. Cover entire top of salad with mayo (amount used will depend on size of bowl). Sprinkle remaining ingredients in order listed over mayo. Cover salad and let set overnight in fridge.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Cook and stir bacon in Dutch oven. Pour off all fat but 1 tablespoon. Cook and stir onion and garlic in the fat until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except Parmesan. Heat to boiling and simmer 15 minutes. Place small amount of soup at a time in blender and puree. Reheat. Serve with grated Parmesan on top.

title: Double Boiler Frosting
instructions: Combine egg whites sugar cream of tartar and water in top of double boiler. Beat at high speed 1 minute. Place over boiling water; beat on high speed 7 minutes. Remove pan from boiling water; add vanilla. Beat 2 minutes longer on high speed. Fills and frosts two 8 or 9-inch layers or frosts a 9 x 13-inch cake.

title: Mary'S Nut Muffins
instructions: Mix all together in bowl. Do not beat. Put in small muffin tins with liners. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Saute onions in margarine until soft and transparent. In a baking dish arrange in layers the sliced potatoes and onions. Sprinkle with garlic seasonings in between layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Add whipping cream all over top. Sprinkle with paprika. Increase temperature to 400\u00b0. Bake another 10 to 20 minutes until potatoes are soft and brown on top. Serve with broiled meat.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cut and mix fruit add nuts and 2 cups flour; mix well. Separate eggs and beat whites and yolks well. Mix butter sugar and\tboth parts of egg together. Mix 2 cups of flour into this. Add cake mixture and fruit mixture together and mix well. Pour in greased pan and bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt and nutmeg. Add fruit mixing well. Let stand for 20 minutes. Spoon into pie crust and dot with butter. Put on top crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine. Add sugar brown sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients then peanut butter. Mix and roll into balls to place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add onion catsup water brown sugar celery vinegar dry mustard Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper. Mix together. Serve on warm hamburger buns.

title: Chocolate Delights
instructions: Line an 11 x\t13-inch cookie sheet with aluminum foil and spray with vegetable oil spray. Place 36 saltines side by side. Boil 2 sticks butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes (watch clock). Pour mixture over saltines and bake 7 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven\timmediately and while hot pour chocolate morsels over and spread with a knife. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Cut or break into pieces.

title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil egg noodles until tender. Put 3/4 of noodles on the bottom of a casserole dish. Layer chicken peas and soup on top of noodles. Lay cheese slices on top of last layer. Put remaining noodles on top of cheese. Cover.

title: Green Beans Oregano
instructions: Drain beans. Save 2 or 3 slices bacon for garnish and crumble remaining 4 or 5 slices. In a large bowl mix beans with crumbled bacon condensed soup mushrooms soup mix and oregano.

title: Sour Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Pack washed cucumbers in jars. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Fill jar with vinegar until you can touch it with your finger. Finish filling jar with water. Seal jars. Boil 10 minutes in cold pack canner. Remove jars and cover with a cloth until cool.

title: Strawberry-Nut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients as usual. Combine jello and water first. Use 12 x 8 x 2-inch Pyrex pan. Put half of strawberry mixture in pan. Refrigerate until set. Spread top with sour cream. Spread remainder of jello mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Easy Key Lime Pie
instructions: Soften cream cheese and blend with milk juice and 2 tablespoons Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Top with 8 ounce container of Cool Whip and chill.

title: Chicken-Cheese Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut each baked potato lengthwise into halves; scoop out centers leaving 1/2-inch border. Reserve pulp for another use. Brush halves with 2 tablespoons of the butter. Arrange potatoes on cookie sheet and place in preheated oven. Bake until shells are hot 5 to 7 minutes. While potatoes are baking cut chicken breasts in halves. Flatten each half by pounding between 2 pieces of waxed paper. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat; add chicken herbs salt and pepper. Cook until chicken is golden 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Cut chicken into 1/2-inch strips. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the cheese into each potato half; top each with 1/4 of the chicken and 1 tablespoon cheese. Bake until cheese melts about 5 minutes longer. Serve hot.

title: Scrabble Mix(You'Ll Never Want To Eat Store Bought Chex Mix Again!!)
instructions: Combine dry cereals pretzels and nuts in large roasting pan. In small saucepan slowly heat butter and bacon drippings until melted. Add Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces and blend. Pour over cereal mixture. With a rubber spatula gently stir ingredients to distribute the butter mixture. In small dish combine the seasonings and sprinkle over cereal mixture. Again stir gently to distribute all ingredients. Toast in slow over 250 degrees for 1 hour. During the hour remove from oven every 15 minutes and stir. Cool. Store in tin canisters.

title: Banana Nut Ice Cream
instructions: Combine ingredients and add enough milk to make 1 gallon. Freeze in ice cream freezer.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix form into loaf in baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for about an hour.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Add sugar soda butter dates and nuts. Pour boiling water over ingredients and let stand 5 minutes. When cool add remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Sweet Potato Buried Treasure Puff
instructions: Whip together sweet potatoes pineapple egg butter salt and cinnamon. Swirl in cranberry sauce. Spoon into greased 8 x 8-inch dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Blueberry Nut Bread(My All Time Favorite)
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Stir to mix. Set aside. In another larger bowl beat together eggs and oil. Stir in blueberries. Stir in dry ingredients only until moistened (do not overmix). Pour batter into 2 or 3 well-greased bread pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven approximately 50 minutes or until tests done with knife inserted in center that comes out clean. Let cool.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes(Quick And Easy Version)
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop dough about the size of a walnut onto ungreased cookie sheet. Press flat with the bottom of a glass that has been coated with sugar. (Dampen bottom of a glass so sugar will stick to it better.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 11 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Chicken Broccoli Divan
instructions: In a 9-inch pie plate or shallow casserole arrange broccoli. Top with chicken. Combine soup and milk together; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Sweet Potato Pone
instructions: Immediately upon shredding raw potatoes put in salted ice water; let stand 15 minutes. Drain thoroughly and add sugar and milk. Turn into a long baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with bits of margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and Carnation milk in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy reaches 234\u00b0. Stir constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate chips. Stir until melted. Add marshmallow cream nuts and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Top with walnuts. Press into fudge. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
instructions: Cream the shortening and peanut butter together gradually beating in the sugar egg vanilla and milk. Add the dry ingredients that have been mixed together. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a cookie sheet. Indent the center of each cookie with your thumb. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. When cookies come out of the oven place a Kiss in the center of each cookie.

title: Original Johnny'S Dock Seasoning Salt
