Store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar eggs 1/2 cup butter vanilla cinnamon brown sugar pecans and milk in large bowl; mix well. Spoon into a 2-quart greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly. Cover with marshmallows. Bake until marshmallows are brown.

title: Hershey Pie
instructions: Melt the bar and then mix in the Cool Whip. Pour into crust and cool in refrigerator for an hour.

title: Hot Dog Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables coarse. Sprinkle with salt. Let stand overnight. Rinse and drain. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over vegetable mixture. Heat to just boiling and simmer 3 minutes. Seal in sterilized jars. Makes 8 pints.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Peel and slice onions. Heat large soup pot. Melt butter and onion and cook over very low heat until light brown in color (15 to 20 minutes). Add stock; cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour into oven safe soup bowls. Sprinkle with croutons and cheese. Broil to melt cheese.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
instructions: Combine flour salt soda cinnamon and sugar. Make a \well\ in dry ingredients. Add oil and eggs stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in strawberries and nuts. Spoon batter into loaf pan and bake 1 hour or until done at 350\u00b0. Let stand overnight before slicing. I usually double the recipe and make 2 loaves or 3 mini loaves.

title: Cheese-Topped Zucchini
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise. In a large skillet cook onion in hot oil until tender but not browned. Add zucchini halves cut side up. Sprinkle with salt pepper and oregano. Pour tomato sauce over. Cover. Cook just until tender about 10 minutes. Top zucchini with Mozzarella cheese slices. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Beef-Noodle-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion in butter; stir in tomato sauce. Remove from heat. Cook noodles in boiling salted water until almost tender; drain. Blend milk cream cheese sour cream cottage cheese and green pepper into noodles. Alternate layers of noodle mixture with meat sauce in a 2-quart casserole ending with meat sauce. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit reserving liquid. Add water to syrup to make 1/2 cup total. Combine gelatin and boiling water in a blender. Cover and blend at low speed until it is dissolved approximately 1 minute. Add measured liquid syrup cream cheese and mayonnaise. Cover and blend on high speed about 15 seconds. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in fruit cocktail. Spoon into a jello mold and chill about 2 hours. Unmold and garnish.

title: Chicken And Water Chestnut Casserole
instructions: Set oven to 325\u00b0. Arrange chicken in single layer in greased baking dish. Mix soup milk mayonnaise and water chestnuts. Pour over chicken. Top with stuffing. Cover. Bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook until thick sugar cornstarch and Sprite. Add the strawberry Jell-O. Cool. Fold in the sliced strawberries. Line baked pie shell with softened cream cheese. Pour strawberry mixture into pie shell. Chill about 4 hours. Garnish with cream. Serves 8.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring water and margarine to boil; heat until margarine is melted. Add salt then dump in flour all at once. Over medium heat stir constantly as mixture cooks. It will be done when the mass forms around the spoon (about 1 minute). Remove to mixing bowl. With beater at medium speed beat in eggs one at a time. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 15 minutes longer. Turn off oven. Prick each puff with cake wire and leave in oven heat off for 30 minutes. Cool thoroughly before filling. Makes 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

title: Edible Play Dough
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Knead a little then refrigerate until chilled. Place portions on wax paper. Roll or shape into objects desired.

title: Brenda'S Beefy Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and pepper. Add rest of ingredients. Let simmer until hot all the way through. Optional Can bake in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Dustin'S Cheese Straws
instructions: Cream cheese and butter until very light in color. Sift dry ingredients together and add to cheese-butter mixture. Mix well. Put through a cookie/pastry press making each piece about 5/8-inch wide in long strips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on racks and then break into about 50 (2-inch) pieces. Store in airtight container.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Sift flour and spices together. Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time to sugar-oil mixture. Add vanilla. Alternately add sifted dry ingredients and juice of cherries. Fold in cherries apples and nuts. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Swedish Nuts
instructions: Bake walnuts in oven at 325\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until light brown. Take out and cool. Beat egg whites with sugar. Beat very well. Mix the nuts into the egg whites.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Wash and dry chicken. Put in shallow baking dish skin up. Simmer remaining ingredients for 5 minutes. Pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Guinea Garbage
instructions: Slice peppers and onions then saute them in a large skillet with a little oil. Transfer when tender to a large pot. Add one can of tomato sauce and the spices listed. Let simmer after mixing well. Cook the sausages and drain the fat. Place whole sausages in the sauce and cover them well with the sauce. Taste sauce and spice accordingly. Serve on sub rolls.

title: Cheese And Eggplant Bake(Serves 4)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease shallow pan. Cut eggplant 1/4-inch thick. Heat the oil in pan; put a layer of eggplant slices in skillet and saute 3 to 4 minutes on each side turning once until golden brown and drain on paper towels. Place layers of eggplant and cheese alternately in casserole dish with layer of cheese on top. Blend egg canned tomatoes onion tomato paste and water until smooth. Season with salt and pepper; pour over eggplant and cheese. End with tomato slices on top. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. Serve with French bread and salad.

title: Janice'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine brown sugar flour and sugar. Add the eggs butter (do not use oleo) milk and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Spread the pecans on top. Use more than one cup if desired. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until lightly set. It will set more as it cools. This pie is really different.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs raisins flour and soda and salt sifted together. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients and heat over medium-low heat stirring constantly.

title: Swiss Chicken Casserole
instructions: Arrange chicken in a greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Top with cheese. Combine soup and milk stirring well. Pour over chicken. Next layer dressing and drizzle butter over top. Cover; bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Quick And Zesty Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large pot brown meat and onion; drain. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 15 minutes until noodles are done.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Slice onions paper thin. Fill large pot to the top with onions. Add 1/4 cup of butter and simmer on low until onions are translucent. Mix in 1 teaspoon of dry mustard salt and pepper. Add equal amounts of beef and chicken stock and 1/4 cup of sherry. Cook on low (without boiling) for 6 to 8 hours a day for two days. Add sherry to replace fluid as it evaporates. Cut French bread into thin slices and place on a baking sheet. Bake in oven on low temperature for 3 to 4 hours until hard. Grate Gruyere cheese on bread and continue baking for 1 hour.

title: Smoke Fish Spread
instructions: Cream all ingredients. Refrigerate and serve with crackers.

title: Chicken Dijon
instructions: In a skillet in 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook chicken for 10 minutes or until browned. Remove. In an additional 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook celery until tender. Stir often. Add soup milk mustard and parsley. Heat to boiling; return chicken to skillet. Cover; cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Stir often. Serve with noodles or rice; garnish with parsley if desired. Serves 4.

title: Pineapple Cake-Buda
instructions: Make cake according to package directions and bake in spring-form pan. Mix pudding milk and cream cheese. Beat well and put on cooled cake. Spread pineapple on top of pudding and then whipped topping. Sprinkle with nutmeats.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese together until well blended. Add sugar and cream well. Add egg and flour alternately mixing well after each addition. Add vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in greased and floured tube pan.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple in baking dish. Mix flour and sugar and place on top of pineapple. Sprinkle cheese on top of this. Crumble Ritz crackers and place on top. Drizzle butter on this. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Make graham cracker crust with 1 stick of margarine (melted) and graham cracker crumbs. Line a 13 x 9-inch (3-quart) casserole.

title: Caramel Corn(Microwave)
instructions: Put popped corn into sprayed (Pam) large brown bag. Mix brown sugar butter syrup and salt in a 2-quart batter bowl. Microwave uncovered on High for 2 1/4 minutes. Stir. Microwave to boiling (takes about 1 minute) and boil for 3 minutes. Stir in soda and vanilla. Pour syrup over popped corn in bag. Mix and shake well to coat corn with caramel. Microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes shaking bag well after each minute. Cool. Stir occasionally. Leave corn in bag to cool. Squeeze bag occasionally as caramel cools to separate kernels.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients with mixer and press firmly in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown. Cool completely.

title: All-Bran Rolls
instructions: Mix Crisco sugar all-bran and salt. Add 1 cup boiling water to mixture. Let stand until lukewarm. Add 2 well beaten eggs. Put dry yeast in 1 cup lukewarm water. Add to mixture. Add 5 cups plain flour; gradually knead. Shape into rolls. Place in greased pan and let rise until double in bulk about 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. This can be kept in refrigerator and used as needed. Freezes real well. Makes about 3 dozen rolls.

title: Spat-Alls
instructions: Combine ingredients and drop by teaspoon into boiling salted water. Cook 20 minutes. Drain and add butter.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sift flour with baking soda spices and salt. Set aside. In large bowl of electric mixer at high speed beat butter sugar and eggs until smooth. About 5 minutes on low speed beat in molasses and water. Add flour mixture beating just until smooth. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add and blend in flour sugar salt cinnamon and cloves. Then add the sour cream and raisins and blend. Pour into pastry shell and bake until knife inserted 1-inch from side comes out clean about 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Avocado Dip
instructions: Peel and cut up avocado. Blend in blender with cream cheese sour cream and season to taste. Put in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan. Layer on top cut up lettuce chopped tomatoes sprinkle with Cheddar cheese then ripe olives. Chill until serving. Serve with Doritos.

title: Scalloped Asparagus(Microwave Oven Recipe)
instructions: Place asparagus in shallow dish with water. Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Cook on High 8 minutes or until tender; drain.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Stuffed Potato
instructions: Wrap potato in paper towel. Microwave on High 5 minutes. Open and stuff with cheese. Press sides together to melt cheese. Top with broccoli and sour cream. Serves 1.

title: Radio Overnight Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and shortening. Add eggs then rest of ingredients. Make into 2 rolls. Let set in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Salsa Cruda
instructions: Combine cover refrigerate over night or at least 3 hours.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into quarters; shake into mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place in Bundt pan evenly.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and cut chicken breasts in bite-size pieces. Layer cooked asparagus and chicken in casserole. Saute onion and mushrooms in margarine. Add other ingredients. Cook until cheese is bubbly. Pour over chicken and asparagus in casserole. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Soften ice cream; blend all ingredients together. Put in pie shell. Decorate if desired with extra crumbs. Freeze or refrigerate until set.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour cream of tartar soda and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts. Dip top in colored sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 about 8 to 10 minutes. Yields about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Crispy Peanut Butter Drops
instructions: Bring Karo and sugar to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter mixing until smooth. Add cornflakes (or cereal of your choice). Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. If desired dip in melted chocolate.

title: Okra Salad
instructions: Mix cornmeal flour and salt together; set aside. Wash and slice okra; dredge in meal and flour mixture. Fry in skillet until done.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Stir until it thickens and pour into an 8-inch pie crust. Let chill for 3 hours and serve. May serve with whipped cream.

title: Moosehead Gingerbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease and flour 8-inch square pan. Combine flour baking soda salt cinnamon ginger cloves mustard and pepper. Set aside.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine hot water and Jell-O; add all remaining ingredients except sour cream. Pour half in dish and congeal. Spread sour cream and add remaining mixture; congeal.

title: Cheesy Beef Pie
instructions: Saute beef green pepper and onion in a skillet until meat is done. Drain well on paper towels. Return to skillet. Add tomato sauce and seasonings. Combine 1/2 cup cheese sour cream and egg; mix well and stir into meat mixture. Spoon into an 8-inch baking dish. Split biscuits and place on top of meat mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle pie with remaining cheese during the last 10 minutes of baking. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Place sliced peaches in baking dish. Cut bread into cubes and cover the peaches with bread cubes. Mix butter sugar flour and egg. Pour mixture over bread cubes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown. (This recipe can be used for any kind of fruit cobbler.)

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Melt margarine. Add 1/3 cup sugar and pretzels (dont add fine crumb and salt mixture that you get after rolling just pieces); mix well. Put in oblong baking dish and bake at 300\u00b0 for 5 minutes or in microwave.

title: Sweet-Sour Bean Salad
instructions: Put vegetables in large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables and mix gently. Chill several hours or overnight. Serve on Boston lettuce. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: In slow cooking pot combine chicken with onions carrot garlic oregano basil salt pepper and tomatoes. Cover and cook on low 4 to 5 hours. Turn control to high. Add shrimp and rice. Cover and cook on high for 30 to 40 minutes or until shrimp is done.

title: Mayonnaise Rolls
instructions: Mix batter well. Pour into a greased muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Serves 12.

title: Bean Pot Chicken
instructions: Place chicken onion butter and lemon juice in crock-pot and cover. Cook on low heat for several hours or until tender. Strain liquid. Combine with mushroom soup. Pour over chicken. Heat in pot and serve.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender; drain and cool. Mix carrots onion and bell pepper. Mix other ingredients and pour over carrot mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Christmas Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve strawberry jello in the 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Add frozen strawberries and stir until thawed. Pour into a 5 to 6-cup mold and put in refrigerator to gel. When the mixture is gelled dissolved lime jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add pineapple juice and cool. Blend in softened cream cheese and crushed pineapple. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour this lime mixture over gelled strawberry mixture in mold. Chill until firm.

title: Quick Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut steak into serving size pieces. Heat oil in heavy skillet. Salt and pepper pieces of steak and coat in cornstarch. Brown in hot oil. Leave in skillet add 1/2 cup water onion and tomato sauce. Cook on medium heat 20 to 30 minutes. Add extra water if needed.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Stir in crushed bananas and nuts. Sift flour soda and salt. Add to other ingredients. Pour into 2 small oiled loaf tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Prepare strawberries ahead by pouring 1 cup of sugar over the strawberries and let stand stirring occasionally until sugar is dissolved.\tBlend in blender until smooth when ready to use.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Mix Crisco sugar beaten egg vanilla and milk; add dry ingredients to mixture then add cut up and floured gumdrops and nuts. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Great Scotts Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour salt soda and cinnamon and set aside. Combine in bowl sugar butter and eggs and beat until creamy. Gradually add flour mixture alternating with milk. Stir in oats butterscotch chips raisins and nuts. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine first 4 ingredients. Beat with electric mixer for 3 minutes or until smooth. Spoon into crust. Let chill until set.

title: Pizza
instructions: Make dough as directed. Spread thick into pizza pans or small cookie sheets. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Take out. Put pizza sauce on. Then sprinkle rest of ingredients. Bake another 15 minutes or until real hot and crust is brown.

title: Stove Top Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Prepare Stove Top stuffing for 8 servings and place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine cubed chicken soup and milk and pour over the stuffing. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Philly Pretzels
instructions: In a large bowl mix together yeast water sugar and salt. Stir in flour. Knead on floured table until dough is smooth. Shape into animal or other desired shapes. Brush with beaten egg. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain all four cans and pimento in a colander. While they drain slice celery. Place the sugar and vinegar in a large bowl; stir thoroughly. Add drained ingredients and celery; stir again.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Peel and cut up all fruit into small bite size pieces. Sprinkle sugar a little at a time as you put your fruit pieces in large bowl (to keep fruit from turning brown). When all fruit has been cut up add frozen strawberries Tropicana juice and Port wine. Mix well. Chill for 2 to 3 hours. Best when served the next day.

title: Coconut Macaroon Pie
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and salt until lemon colored. Add butter and flour; blend well. Fold in one cup coconut. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Put remaining coconut on top. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Boil syrup until sugar is dissolved then pour over popcorn. Mix well; press firmly into balls.

title: Pepper Shrimp
instructions: In a bowl whisk together the wine tomato sauce chervil lemon juice mustard oregano salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a skillet. Cook the minced garlic over medium heat for 1 minute. Add the tomato sauce mixture and bring to a boil then lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Stir in chopped parsley. Place shrimp in a single layer in a nonmetal baking dish. Pour the sauce over the shrimp and marinate covered for 3 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator. Preheat broiler. Broil shrimp about 6 inches from the heat for 10 minutes or until cooked through. Turn once.

title: Granny'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Slice bananas and alternate layers of wafers in oblong casserole dish.

title: Rainbow Jello
instructions: Grease 9 x 3 x 12-inch pan with butter. Dissolve lime Jell-O in 1 cup hot water. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Pour in pan and let set. Bring milk to boil. Add sugar and mix until dissolved. In another dish dissolve plain gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water. Add milk and sugar mixture sour cream and vanilla. Beat until blended. Cool. Pour 1 1/2 cups into lime Jell-O. Alternate Jell-O and cream cheese mixture in layers.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl saving 1 1/2 cups stuffing. Pour in baking dish and top with stuffing. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Blend cream cheese honey and vanilla together in mixer. Pour whipping cream into separate bowl and beat until stiff. Slowly blend whipped cream into cream cheese mixture. The cream cheese mix can be used without whipping cream.

title: Barbecups
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add barbecue sauce onion and brown sugar. Press each biscuit into ungreased muffin cup. Spoon meat mixture into cups and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix and chill overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Yummy Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and boil in a large pan until done. Drain potatoes well. Add sour cream butter salt pepper and onions. Mix with electric mixer until you cant stand it any longer and you must stick your finger in and taste. Add cheese and mix until blended. Serve with your favorite gravy. Mashed potatoes were not meant to be eaten without gravy.

title: Diabetic Pie
instructions: Mix jello into boiling water. Put 5 or 6 ice cubes into mixture. When it begins to thicken remove remaining ice cubes. Mix Cool Whip into this mixture. Mix well and pour into graham cracker crust and refrigerate.

title: Spicy Red Sauce
instructions: Preparation Time 10 minutes. Cooking Time 20 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Or Yogurt Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in Bundt or stem pan at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Grandma Neuenfeldt'S Cocoa Fudge Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add Crisco buttermilk and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes with mixer. Add eggs; beat 2 more minutes. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Cook beans with a dash of salt in boiling water cook 2 minutes. Add snow peas and cook for 30 seconds more. Drain and rinse under cool water. Add vinegar oil and pepper. Toss and mix well with red onion slices. Cool. Can be made ahead 24 hours.

title: Irish Stew
instructions: Trim the meat and cut into chunks. Peel and slice potatoes and onions. Cut cabbage into strips. In a large pot layer meat and vegetables. Add all seasonings. Add broth to barely cover meat and vegetables. Bring to a boil. Cover. Cook over medium-low heat for about 1 hour until the meat is tender and potatoes are cooked. Add more seasonings if desired. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve steaming hot.

title: Grannie'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Melt butter; beat together with the sugars vanilla peanut butter and eggs. In a separate bowl combine the flour oats and baking soda. Stir mixture into butter mixture. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Remove to a rack to cool.

title: Burritos
instructions: Mix beef beans and taco seasoning. Warm on stove. Roll mix in tortillas. Top with cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix together vanilla wafers and 1 stick margarine. Press in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cream together sugar 1 1/2 sticks margarine and cream cheese. Spread over vanilla wafer crust. Slice bananas on top of cream cheese mixture and cover with drained pineapple. Top with Cool Whip. Place nuts and cherries on top. Refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Frosty In A Freezer
instructions: Mix well and pour into ice cream bucket; place in ice cream freezer. Layer ice and rock salt around bucket and freeze. This tastes like a Wendys Frosty.

title: Feather-Light Yeast Rolls
instructions: Place yeast in 2 1/2 lukewarm cups water; set aside. Mix 4 cups flour salt baking powder and sugar together. Put in melted shortening and yeast water. Mix well. Take the 2 cups of flour and mix it into the dough mixture. Put about 2 handfuls of flour on countertop. Put dough on floured countertop. Grease fingers and knead dough. Put dough in greased bowl cover and let rise. After it has doubled punch it down. Make into rolls or bread putting it into greased muffin tins or bread pans. Let it rise. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tally Ho Dressing
instructions: Beat with mixer for 15 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crust. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
instructions: Peel carrots slice and cook in water; drain well. Set aside. Heat soup vinegar Worcestershire sauce and sugar. When sugar is dissolved add oil. Layer vegetables. Pour sauce over and let stand for a few hours in refrigerator. Keep adding vegetables as you use them.

title: Best Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Roll into small balls; press with glass dipped in sugar. Sprinkle sugar generously on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Basil-Dill Vinaigrette Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a cruet. Shake vigorously before using.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until light. Add the rest of the ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Do not overbake. Remove from oven when center of pie shakes a little. It will thicken as it cools.

title: Orange Bishop Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Add orange juice and vanilla then flour. Pour in pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour 15 minutes. While cake is hot make holes in top of cake and pour a mixture of 1/2 cup sugar and 3/4 cup orange juice over the top.

title: Easy Egg Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar and eggs. Heat milk and butter until milk is very hot (do not boil). Add egg mixture and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Speedy Spam Dip
instructions: Blend Spam onion and peppers in food processor until smooth. Stir in mayonnaise. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Elegant Beef Stew
instructions: Mix onion soup mushroom soup and wine together. Add meat; mix well. Cook for 3 hours at 325\u00b0. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Great for all kinds of fruits.

title: Fluffy Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scrub the 4 potatoes dry and coat with oil or fat. Wrap in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Halve lengthwise. Scoop out insides; salt and pepper shells. Mash boiled potatoes with pulp of baked potatoes. Beat sour cream and butter with potatoes until fluffy; season. Stir in onions and parsley; stuff shells. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven until hot.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Put chicken in Dutch oven; cover with water. Add salt pepper halved celery halved carrots onion and garlic. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat; simmer 1 1/2 hours. Remove and discard celery and carrots. Remove chicken; bone skin and cut in bite size pieces. Return meat to stock. Add carrot coins and simmer for 30 minutes. Add noodles and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Prairie Graham Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order listed until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch bread pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Double Crust Pizza
instructions: Shape each loaf of bread dough into a ball; cover and let rise until nearly double. Punch down cover and let rest 10 minutes.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted water until tender. Drain off water and mix all ingredients except mayonnaise. Let stand for about 5 minutes for ingredients to blend. Add just enough mayonnaise to bind ingredients together. Let stand for 2 hours before refrigerating.

title: Chicken-Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in deep kettle. Add water sherry salt curry powder onion and celery. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat strain broth (reserve). Cool chicken debone and cut into bite-sized pieces. Wash mushrooms pat dry. Slice and saute mushrooms in butter until brown.

title: Best Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Then place the flour sugar salt and baking powder in medium size bowl and blend thoroughly. Next pour the milk vegetable oil and eggs or egg substitute into 2-cup measure and blend thoroughly. Now pour liquid ingredients into the dry and do not blend thoroughly. With a wire whisk or fork blend for 20 seconds and stop. Last fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until muffins are lightly browned. (Can add blueberries 1 cup.)

title: Billy'S Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape in loaf pan or 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Beat well margarine 1 1/2 cups sugar 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon salt vanilla and egg. Add alternately and beat well flour soda and buttermilk. Fold in rhubarb. Spread in 9 x 12-inch well-greased pan. Top with 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Mix together and sprinkle on cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: 7-Up Strawberry Creme Cake
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Generously grease and lightly flour pans. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Blend at low speed for 4 minutes. Pour into prepared cake pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Line 9 x 13-inch pan with bread. Cover with bacon and shredded cheese. Beat milk eggs salt and pepper together. Add onion and green pepper and fold in mushrooms. Pour over bread bacon and cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Place chops in electric skillet with a little water; add brown sugar ketchup and lemon juice. Let juice cook off then brown both sides.

title: Kallaloo
instructions: Boil salt meat until tender in 3 quarts of water. Boil fish; remove bones and add to stock. Add crabs or conch. Put spinach okra (from which stems and tips have been removed) onion and garlic through grinder. Add to stock and boil rapidly about 30 minutes. The addition of vinegar prevents the appearance of slime. Do not skim while boiling. Serve hot with fungi.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Cream the oleo and peanut butter. Add sugars. Add egg and vanilla. Sift the flour baking soda and salt. Blend dry ingredients into the creamed mixture. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and place a chocolate kiss on top pressing down slightly. Return to oven and bake 2 to 5 minutes until kiss is melted slightly.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking soda salt and cinnamon together. Then take 1/2 cup of flour mixture and roll fruit and nuts into flour mixture. Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add flour mixture dates nuts and fruit; mix well.

title: Macaroni And Beef
instructions: Cook beef and drain off fat. Stir in all ingredients. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes and serve.

title: Kentucky Pound Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar oil egg yolks drained pineapple water or juice and cinnamon. Mix well. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add nuts and raisins. Fold into batter. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Date And Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter sugar and beaten egg. Add all other ingredients. Put in two bread tins or in 5 mini loaf pans (6 x 3 1/4 x 2-inch). Grease pans and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Slice bread in half lengthwise and place on cookie sheet. Melt butter. Add Cheddar cheese Parmesan cheese and paprika. Stir only enough to blend. Dont let the cheese melt. Cover the cut surfaces of the bread with the Mozzarella slices then spread on the butter/cheese mixture. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix the meat milk egg and bread crumbs together and refrigerate. Bake at 325\u00b0 and baste with the following mixture.

title: Hundred Dollar Frosting(Chocolate)
instructions: Combine butter and chocolate in a double boiler; heat stirring until melted. Remove and cool well. Add egg; stir vigorously. Stir in sugar vanilla and lemon juice. Beat until smooth. Add the chopped nuts. Mix well. Goes well on cakes or brownies. Preparation time 030.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Spray pan with Pam spray. Then layer of chicken and layer of sliced eggs. Heat chicken broth and celery soup. Pour over chicken. Melt butter and add flour and milk. Pour over chicken; will have lumps. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes until brown.

title: Tasty Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine last 4 ingredients and allow to stand 10 minutes. Fold in macaroni eggs chopped onions sliced radishes and chopped green peppers. Mix well. Chill 1 hour or longer and serve.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch dish or trifle bowl break lettuce into bite size pieces. Put grated carrots on top. Pour drained peas next then onion slices. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise and sugar and spread on top of onions. Sprinkle cheese on then add bacon pieces. Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate. Remove from stove. Add sugar corn syrup and cream. Mix well. Put back on stove. Stir while cooking. Drop chocolate into a cup of cold water until chocolate forms ball. Remove from stove. Add butter and vanilla using an electric mixer. Beat until thick. Pour into greased pan. Let cool.

title: Cranberry Tea
instructions: Tie cloves allspice and cinnamon sticks in a gauze bag. Combine all the ingredients. Bring to a boil then simmer for at least an hour. Remove bag of spices and serve hot. Will keep in refrigerator for a week or two.

title: Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Alternate with 1/2 pint sour cream. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Hot Pizza Dip
instructions: Microwave pepperoni for 30 seconds. Drain and blot on paper towels. In a small bowl mix together cream cheese oregano parsley and basil. Spread mixture in the bottom of a 9 inch pie plate. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of mozzarella cheese and 1/2 cup of parmesan cheese on top of the cream cheese mixture. Spread the pizza sauce over all. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Top with green pepper pepperoni and olive slices. Cover and microwave for 5 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes with skins on until tender. Cut bacon into small pieces; fry until crisp and drain off grease. Use 3/4 cup bacon fat. Add vinegar sugar and water; bring to a boil. Peel potatoes and slice thin. Put in greased bowl. Add bacon onion and seasonings. Pour hot liquid over potatoes; toss until mixed. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 35 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley and serve warm.

title: Orange Glazed Chicken
instructions: Cook and stir chicken in hot oil in large skillet until lightly browned. Stir broth orange juice soy sauce cornstarch sugar ginger and garlic powder in medium bowl. Add to skillet and bring to boil. Stir in vegetables and rice. Return to boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork.

title: B. L. & T. Dip
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and sour cream. Crumble bacon and mix with ingredients. Dice tomatoes and add to mixture. Let sit in refrigerator overnight. Serve on toast cut in mini triangles.

title: Spanish Bean Soup(Florida Cracker Style)
instructions: In a large heavy pot put in bone and cover with water. Add 2 onions and garlic. Bring to a low boil and cook for 30 minutes. Now add pepper herb seasoning chorizos and garbanzo beans. Simmer for 45 minutes. Add potatoes and the last onions. Taste add more garlic if needed. Simmer for 1 hour. Serve with warm Cuban bread.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Trim fat and tenderize meat. Cut steak into portions. Salt pepper and flour each piece. Fry in skillet with 2 tablespoons Crisco until golden brown. Set aside each piece on plate. In a casserole dish add tomatoes 1 cup water steaks onions green peppers and carrots. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Bohemian Dumplings
instructions: Make a nest with the flour in a large round bowl. Add milk eggs and salt to center of flour nest.\tMix mixture adding flour as you go with hands or large spoon until blended together. Break bread slices into 1-inch pieces and drop them one at a time into blended mixture until a ball can be made from it. Do not overwork mixture. Make balls about size of a baseball. Drop balls into boiling water in a 4-quart or larger pan. Boil for 1/2 hour. Water must continue to boil. Keep a lid on pan.

title: Dinner-In-A-Dish
instructions: Brown hamburg and drain. Peel onion and potatoes. In a casserole layer as follows hamburg onion slices and potato slices. Pour tomato sauce over. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Scotch Crunchies
instructions: Melt butterscotch pieces in top of double boiler. Remove and stir in noodles and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Let stand 20 minutes. Makes 25 to 30.

title: Baked Beans (1)
instructions: Stir the ingredients together. If not sweet enough add more brown sugar. If too sweet add more ketchup. Place in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour or until thick.

title: Cookies And Cream
instructions: Dunk each cookie in milk. Make a layer of cookies on the bottom of a large serving bowl. Spoon on a layer of Cool Whip. Keep layering dunked cookies and Cool Whip until you run out of Cool Whip. If any cookies remain crumble them on top of Cool Whip. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Antipasto Salad
instructions: Arrange cleaned lettuce on large tray. Arrange all other ingredients on top of lettuce. Put anchovies in center in small cup. Add dressing when served.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Mix together all but pecans. Put in wax paper and roll in pecans.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Line little plastic flowerpots with Saran Wrap. Fill to the top with chocolate ice cream. Sprinkle shaved chocolate on top. Serve with a fresh flower stuck in the middle.

title: Macaroni And Meat Sauce
instructions: Cook ground beef onions and green pepper together until brown; drain off fat. Add all other ingredients to cooked macaroni. Add beef mixture; cook for 15 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven. Top with cheese and brown.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Mix together. Spread thin on large cookie sheet. Sprinkle lots of chocolate chips on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Comes out like brownies. The kids get their veggies and dont know it.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add hot mixture. Cook until thick. Pour in 8-inch baked crust.

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour over steak and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Very good on steak tips.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine cheese 1 cup pecans mayonnaise onion garlic and Tabasco. Shape into ball. Pat remaining pecans into ball. Refrigerate.

title: Linguini Salad
instructions: Cook linguini. Add bottled dressing to Salad Supreme. Let sit overnight. Then add eggs and vegetables and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.

title: Eggs And Vegetables In Aspic
instructions: Blend. Pour gelatin into mold to depth of 1/4-inch. Arrange asparagus spears in mold. Chill until almost firm. Chill remaining gelatin until it has the consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Fold in eggs and peas; put on top of stiffened gelatin and asparagus. Chill until firm. Unmold and garnish with greens; serve with mayonnaise or French dressing. Serves 6.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with graham cracker crumbs. Press half the crumbs in 9-inch square Pyrex dish. Mix cream cheese with sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread half of cream cheese mixture over graham cracker crumbs.

title: Three Cheese Chicken Bake
instructions: In a skillet saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender. Remove from the heat. Stir in the soup mushrooms pimientos and basil; set aside. In a large bowl combine noodles chicken and cheeses; add mushroom sauce and mix well. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Chops And Beans
instructions: In skillet brown pork chops; pour off fat. Season with salt and pepper. Cover; cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Add beans catsup sugar and mustard. Top each chop with green pepper and onion slices. Cover; cook for 15 minutes more or until chops are done; stir occasionally.

title: 30 Minute Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large mixing bowl. Add sugar salt and unbeaten egg. Add flour gradually. Beat well with electric mixer on low or medium speed or by hand with large wooden spoon. Add shortening beating until thoroughly mixed. Spoon dough into well-greased muffin pans filling about 1/3 full. Let rise in warm place (90\u00b0 to 95\u00b0) until dough has risen level with top of muffin pans about 25 to 30 minutes. Bake in moderately hot oven (375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0) for 20 minutes. Remove from pans and serve warm. Yield 24 rolls.

title: Tomato Dumplings
instructions: Use skillet and fry bacon crisp; add tomatoes sugar salt and pepper. Bring to boil and add dumplings. Cook slowly for 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Boiled Dressing
instructions: Put first 7 ingredients in double boiler and cook until mixture thickens. Then add vinegar and continue cooking 3 minutes longer. Chill and when ready to serve thin with plain or whipped cream to suit taste.

title: Pasole
instructions: Brown pork in skillet then add all remaining ingredients and cook like a stew.

title: Kay'S Sweet And Spicy Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 275\u00b0. Line a sided baking sheet with parchment paper.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; crumble and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zaziki Dip
instructions: Beat whipping cream and then mix with the yogurt and cucumber. Season with garlic salt and pepper.

title: Joan'S Crunchie-Unchie Bars
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan well. Line pan with whole graham crackers. Cook together 1 cup sugar 1 stick butter and 4 sticks oleo. Cook 3 minutes. Pour over crackers and sprinkle slivered almonds on top. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix milk and bread crumbs. Gently stir in crabmeat and diced egg whites. Blend in remaining ingredients except Wheaties. Place into buttered 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with Wheaties or bread crumbs. Bake 15 minutes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Strawberry Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup of boiling water. Add 1/2 of fruit and nuts. Chill 1/2 hour. Spread with sour cream and add rest of fruit. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole stir together sugar and syrup. Microwave on High 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts. Microwave on High 4 minutes until light brown. Add butter and vanilla; blend well. Microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes. (Syrup will be very hot.) Add baking soda. Stir until light and foamy. Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Let cool 1/2 to 1 hour. When cool break into pieces and store in airtight container. Makes 4 to 6 servings (about 1 pound).

title: Italian Bean Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours to blend. Serve cold.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill well before serving.

title: Apple Pudding Pie
instructions: Pour apple pie mix into graham crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool well. Mix jello pudding as directed on package. Spread over cooked apple pie and top with whipped topping. Chill.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Mix together first 2 ingredients. Add eggs; beat after each one. Add flavoring and jam. Mix well. In another bowl mix dry ingredients. Add dry ingredient mixture to creamy mixture alternating with buttermilk until all ingredients are mixed well. Bake in tube pan greased and floured for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Apricot-Pineapple Jam
instructions: Grind dried apricots and soak in 3 cups boiling water. Let stand a couple of hours or overnight. Bring all ingredients to a boil and boil for 1 full minute. Remove from fire and add Certo; keep stirring for 5 minutes so fruit wont float. Put in jars and cover with wax. Boil jars before adding jam.

title: Basic Muffin Batter
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 12 regular or 24 mini muffin cups. In a large bowl beat together butter sugar baking powder and salt until fluffy. Beat in eggs. Stir in flour alternating with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour until blended.

title: Amish Tapioca
instructions: Add to the syrup from fruit enough water to make 6 cups of liquid. Bring to a boil. Add tapioca and boil 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Let stand 10 minutes stirring several times. Add jello from the box sugar and salt. When completely cool add pineapple and oranges. Whip the whipping cream and sweeten to taste then add to tapioca mixture.

title: Praline Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Combine flour oats and brown sugar. Cut in one stick margarine until it crumbles (coarse crumbs). Stir in chopped nuts. Pat mixture into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Stir while still warm to crumble. Let cool.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crumble all cookies and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients together until smooth. In large deep dish alternate layer of cookie crumbs and pudding mixture ending with cookie crumbs on top.

title: Velvet Pudding
instructions: Preheat the oven to between 300\u00b0 and 350\u00b0. Combine 1/2 cup sugar salt and cake flour. Heat the milk to almost boiling point and slowly pour the hot milk over the dry mixture. Stir continuously. Cook the mixture slowly stirring constantly until it thickens. Beat the egg yolks and add the hot mixture. Mix well. Add the butter and vanilla. Pour the mixture into a greased baking dish and bake for 40 minutes until light brown on top. Remove from the oven keeping the temperature at 300\u00b0. Spread a thin layer of jam on top. Beat the egg whites with 2/5 cup sugar until stiff. Spread the meringue over the pudding. Return the pudding to the oven and bake until the meringue is pale brown.

title: Pound Cake - Chocolate
instructions: Cream shortening eggs and sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each one. Sift flour salt baking powder and cocoa. Add to cake mixture alternately with milk and vanilla. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain. Chill. Combine vegetables. Mix rest of ingredients and toss with vegetables until coated. Will keep a week in refrigerator.

title: Rumaki(Makes 25)
instructions: Mix soy sauce brown sugar and ginger in square baking dish 8 x 8-inch. Cut bacon slices and chicken livers into halves. Wrap a piece of chicken liver and a water chestnut in each bacon piece. Secure with toothpick. Place in marinade. Refrigerate covered 2 hours and drain. Place rumaki on double layer of paper towels. Microwave at High 5 minutes. Reduce power to Medium. Microwave until bacon is brown 12 to 18 minutes. Rotate every 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Add pineapple nuts and carrots last.

title: George Washington Salad
instructions: Mix well 2 packages cherry Jell-O following directions on package of Jell-O. Add pie filling and crushed pineapple. Congeal and top with remaining ingredients. Add 1/2 cup nuts on top.

title: Chris'S Corn Flakes
instructions: Pour desired amount of Corn Flakes into bowl then pour desired amount of milk. Use spoon to stir to desired consistency Add sugar. ENJOY.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs alternately with flour. Add vanilla. Mix well and pour into well-greased tube pan. Place in a cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix and bake in an 8-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Fudge Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar cocoa milk and butter to full rolling boil. Remove from heat and quickly blend in peanut butter vanilla and rolled oats. Drop at once by tablespoon on waxed paper. Cookies will be sticky but will harden quickly. Cookies can be frozen easily in an airtight container with wax paper between layers. Yields 100 cookies.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and celery. Add soups (dilute with some water and simmer for a few minutes). Add cooked drained noodles and place in casserole. Cover with cheese and bake until bubbly at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Combine beef cracker crumbs milk and onion soup mix and press onto a cookie sheet. Put in refrigerator overnight. Cut into squares. Roll in flour and fry until brown. Mix soup with water and pour over meat. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel sweet potatoes and slice about 1/2-inch thick. Place in well-greased baking dish. Peel and slice apples; spread over potatoes. Scatter marshmallows over apples. Sprinkle with sugar salt and cinnamon; dot generously with oleo. Mix cornstarch and water until smooth; pour evenly over all ingredients. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Meaty Breakfast Crunchy Ranch Eggs
instructions: In a greased 7 x 11-inch deep dish combine tomatoes 1/2 can onions green peppers and pepper sauce. Break eggs over sauce. Top with cheese and olives. Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until eggs are poached. Bake a minute or so longer until onions are golden. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Quick Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and milk in boiler and cook 1 minute after it comes to a boil stirring constantly. Add soda crackers peanut butter and vanilla to syrup. Pour in greased pan. Cut in squares when cool.

title: Cheese Souffle
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.\tBlend in flour. Add milk and cook stirring\tconstantly until mixture is thick. Blend in seasonings and cheese.\tStir until cheese melts. Stir a little hot mixture into beaten egg yolks. Add to cheese sauce. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Carefully fold into cheese sauce. Pour into ungreased 1 1/2 quart casserole or souffle dish. Set in pan containing at least 1-inch hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Serve hot. For a stronger cheese flavor increase to 2 cups cheese.

title: Western Salad
instructions: Remove egg yolk and mash with garlic. Blend in salt paprika pepper and mustard. Add olive oil and vinegar; beat well. Chop egg white and parsley and stir in. Combine lettuce spinach and onion in salad bowl. Add dressing. Toss lightly.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Mix shortening and sugars then stir in molasses and egg. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Form dough into 1 1/4-inch diameter balls. Roll balls in sugar and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 12 minutes depending on whether you like the cookies crunchy or chewy.

title: Silk Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar together then add whipped cream. Chill in pie shell. Later add fruit on top. Recipe makes 2 pies and takes 2 cans of fruit topping.

title: Cardamon Butter
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in cardamon seed vinegar and sugar. Strain the sauce if desired. Good on beets whole kernel corn and carrots. Yield 1/4 cup.

title: Beef 'N Potato Bake
instructions: In shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish combine potatoes oil and pepper. Firmly press mixture across bottom and up sides of dish to form a shell. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: In a shallow bowl slice and layer cucumbers green peppers onions and tomatoes. Mix sugar oil vinegar and oregano together and pour over layered vegetables. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Apricot Sparkle
instructions: Pour 2 cups hot water over jello. When dissolved put in 1 1/2 cups cold water. Refrigerate and start to congeal. Mix flour sugar and egg. Add pineapple juice and butter. Cook over low heat until thickens. While still warm add cream cheese. Whip instant whip and fold into custard after it has cooled. Set aside. Add nuts pineapple marshmallows and diced bananas to the jello mixture. Put in flat dish and spread custard over; put in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; add fruit cocktail and eggs. Beat 2 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan until done.

title: Old Fashioned Beef Stew
instructions: In large heavy 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat in hot oil cook 1/2 of the meat until browned on all sides. Repeat with remaining meat. When all is browned place all the meat again in Dutch oven. Add onions celery tomato sauce and water. Cover and simmer for 2 hours stirring occasionally. (If this cooks down too much just add additional tomato sauce water or tomato juice as you would like.) Remove from heat and stir in carrots potatoes and fresh parsley (or 2 teaspoons dried). Cover; simmer 30 minutes more or until meat and vegetables are fork tender.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Spray Pam on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread chicken pieces over bottom. Combine soups peas carrots potatoes mushrooms Worcestershire sauce onion and garlic powder in bowl; pour over chicken. Mix oleo flour and milk; pour on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until top is golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pineapple-Cherry Cake
instructions: Spread pineapple in 9 x 13 greased pan. Pour pie filling over that. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Dot with butter. Bake 350 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Heat butter in 2-quart saucepan until melted. Stir in flour and salt. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth. Heat to boil stirring constantly. Continue 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in nutmeg.

title: Hot Bacon Dressing
instructions: In small saucepan combine all ingredients and stir thoroughly. Cook several minutes over low heat until very hot. Pour over salad and toss to distribute evenly.

title: Frozen Strawberry Whip
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Stir and freeze. Serve partially frozen. Defrost about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Homemade Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour egg yolks and vanilla. Cook slowly and stir constantly until mixture becomes thick. Add coconut to mixture. Pour into browned pie shells.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake 350\u00b0 25-30 minutes.

title: Creamy Cheese Soup
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan combine water pepper salt and vegetables. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and cook covered 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Cut cream cheese into smaller chunks and stir in both cheeses until melted. Add milk. Blend together butter and flour; add to saucepan. Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles. Yields about 6 servings.

title: Baked Apricots
instructions: Spread apricots out in single layer in baking dish. Sprinkle brown sugar over them evenly. Sprinkle crushed crackers over then drizzle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Crumble beef into 1 1/2 quart glass casserole. Add onion and garlic and microwave on High uncovered 3 to 5 minutes stirring once or twice until onion is tender. Add mushrooms cover and microwave 4 minutes longer stirring after 2 minutes.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Place butter in 2-quart casserole for microwave. Microwave at High (100%) until melted 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in parsley garlic salt lemon juice and pepper. Add shrimp. Toss to coat and cover.

title: Pumpkin-Pecan Cheesecake
instructions: In medium bowl combine graham cracker crumbs 1 tablespoon sugar butter and chopped pecans. Press over bottom and about 1 1/2-inches up side of an ungreased 9-inch spring-form pan; refrigerate. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl beat cream cheese and 3/4 cup sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and whipping cream. Stir in pumpkin maple syrup and spices. Pour into chilled crust. Bake in preheated oven for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Pour oil and buttermilk in a large bowl; stir in flour. Mix well. May sometimes have to add a little extra flour if too sticky. Roll dough on floured flat surface. Cut circles with glass or cookie cutter. Put biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet. Put a little butter or margarine on top of each biscuit. Bake approximately 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned on top.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix until salt and sugar are dissolved. Pour over cucumbers; refrigerate. Will keep a long time. Tastes like bread and butter pickles.

title: Skillet Twin Loaves
instructions: Mix ground beef bread crumbs chopped onion parsley eggs 1/2 can tomato sauce salt and pepper. Form into 2 oval loaves about 3 x 5-inches. Brown on all sides in oil by turning loaves with large spoon and spatula or 2 spatulas. When loaves are browned add remaining ingredients cover and simmer 1 hour basting occasionally. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Easy Barbecued Chicken(Yields 4 To 6 Servings)
instructions: Arrange chicken in 2-quart utility dish with larger pieces such as thighs and breasts at corners skin side down. Place small pieces such as legs and wings at center. Mix sauce liquid smoke and onion together. Pour over chicken. Cover with waxed paper or plastic wrap. Cook on High 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Turn chicken pieces over halfway through cooking time.

title: Potato Supreme
instructions: Thaw frozen hash browns for 30 minutes. Then mix all ingredients. Cover with Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornbread mix and oleo together and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients. Mix together cornbread mix with all ingredients and bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes(Microwave Cooking)
instructions: Melt butter or oleo in 4-cup glass measure uncovered on High (maximum power) for 1 minute. Stir in flour. Heat milk in 2-cup glass measure uncovered on 70 power for 2 minutes. Stir milk into flour mixture until smooth. Add salt and pepper. Cook uncovered on 70 power for 5 to 6 minutes or until mixture boils and thickens. Stir twice during cooking time. In 2-quart microproof casserole combine peeled and sliced potatoes onions and white sauce. Cover with waxed paper and cook on 90 power for 9 minutes. Stir. Cover and cook on 90 power for 9 to 10 more minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with paprika. Makes 4 servings.

title: Blue Cheese Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix garlic mix with sour cream. Add crumbled Blue cheese and wine vinegar. Chill in fridge overnight. Serve with carrot sticks bell pepper cucumber radishes cauliflower celery or anything you wish.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple over bottom of pan (9 x 13 x 2-inch). Sprinkle dry cake mix over cherries and pineapple. Drizzle melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or more until crispy and brown.

title: Slightly Sweet Muffins
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine egg milk and oil. Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Spoon into greased muffin pans filling 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove muffins from pan immediately. Makes 10.

title: Scalloped Microwave Potato
instructions: Arrange the potatoes in a 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle with salt flour and chopped onions. Pour milk over all; dot with butter. Cover and cook on 100% power for 16 to 18 minutes. Turn and stir potatoes 1/2 way through. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix all ingredients except 1/4 cup cheese. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with 1/4 cup cheese; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: * Salad Or Dessert *
instructions: Mix all together and let stand for a few hours however it can be used right away if necessary. (Use jello dry.)

title: Basic Stir And Drop Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; add sugar salt and egg. Add oil and half the flour; beat until smooth. Add remaining flour. Let dough rise in warm place for 30 minutes. Fill muffin pans to half full. Let rise until almost double. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 24 rolls.

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: *Liquid from vegetables and mushrooms can be used.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Chop artichoke hearts. Mix all ingredients. Spoon into shallow baking dish. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly brown on top. Serve with Wheat Thins or crackers.

title: Turkey Barbecue
instructions: Mix all together. Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Meatball Glaze
instructions: Mix and heat. Place meatballs into mixture.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until center is firm.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Simmer chicken in water with salt celery top and onion studded with cloves. Remove the skin and cut chicken into small pieces. Saute chopped onion in 3 tablespoons oil until soft. Add garlic chili sugar tomato puree pepper and the chicken. Simmer 10 minutes. Fry the corn tortillas in 1/4 cup salad oil until soft. Drain on paper towel. Fill each tortilla with the chicken mixture; roll and place in shallow pan made for oven-use. Heat half and half and bouillon cubes. Pour this mixture over the enchiladas; sprinkle with Jack cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until hot. Serves 12.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except onion rings. Put in casserole baking dish. Top with onion rings. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Cheesecake Surprise
instructions: Stir together first 2 ingredients and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cut in butter until crumbly; stir in egg yolk. Press evenly onto bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes; cool. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0.

title: Tin Can Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 3 (1-pound) coffee cans. Mix in saucepan apricot nectar apricots raisins and orange peel. Simmer for 5 minutes; set aside to cool.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and pineapple refrigerate. Mix jello according to directions on box. Chill until soft jell stage. Combine 1 carton Cool Whip with jello. Add strawberries 1/2 nuts pineapple and sugar. Tear angel food cake apart. Layer cake and mixture starting with cake. Cover with Cool Whip and coconut and nuts. This is great for summer when its too hot for chocolate.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: 24 Hour Vegetable Salad
instructions: Layer in order given. Refrigerate 12 hours or overnight.

title: Cornflake Crispies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Blend remaining ingredients in thoroughly. Drop from teaspoon; flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Place each piece of chicken between two pieces of waxed paper. Pound with wooden mallet to form cutlets not quite 1/4-inch thick. Peel off paper and sprinkle with salt. Place a piece of butter at each end of cutlet. Sprinkle with parsley and onion. Roll meat as for jelly roll tucking in sides and ends. Dust each roll with flour and dip in beaten egg then roll in bread crumbs. Chill thoroughly at least 1 hour. Fry in hot fat about 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with mushroom sauce if desired.

title: Creamy Fruit Pie
instructions: Pour milk into bowl. Add pudding mix. Slowly beat at low speed with mixer until well blended. Blend in 1/2 cup Cool Whip. Fold in quartered (or cut up fruit) berries. Pour in shell. Chill. Top with remaining Cool Whip and garnish with whole berries. (Fresh or canned fruit may be substituted.)

title: Quiche
instructions: Mix together cut up meat broccoli onion and cheese. Pour into baked pie shell. Mix together milk egg and mayonnaise and pour over top of last layer. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Shrimp Aspic
instructions: Boil water blend in gelatin. Cream the cheese and tomato soup. Add all spices and condiments. Mix all together and add shrimp. Pour in mold and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Set in hot water for 30 seconds to unmold. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat (season with salt pepper onion and garlic salt). Drain grease off. Crush chips into a 13 x 9-inch dish. Pour hamburger meat on top. Pour 1 can Ranch Style beans. Add 2 cans tomato sauce then taco sauce. Add cheese slices or grated cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar salt pepper and canned milk. Add to drained corn and put into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fun In The Bun
instructions: Combine pancake mix sugar cornmeal milk and egg in bowl; mix well. Insert 1 popsicle stick into each hot dog. Dip into batter coating well. Deep fry until golden brown. Serve with mustard dip. Yield 10 servings.

title: Fresh String Beans
instructions: Cook string beans in a steamer or (if no steamer available) in a pot with 1/2 cup water. When almost done add all ingredients. Toss and let them finish cooking slowly.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed on box. Butter a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Put pecans and coconut in bottom. Pour cake batter on top of nuts and coconut. Mix powdered sugar margarine and cream cheese. Pour on top of batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn cake out upside down. Leave pan over cake a few minutes to allow topping to loosen from pan.

title: (No Meat) Baked Ziti
instructions: Cook ziti until al dente (still a little firm) drain and place in a large bowl. Mix together the Ricotta cheese and half the Mozzarella cheese with the ziti. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and cover the bottom of the pan with half of spaghetti sauce. Spoon the ziti mixture into the pan. Cover with the remaining sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and the remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Ice Cream Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Drop batter from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 6 minutes or until cookies are brown around the edges. Remove from sheet while still warm. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onions line pan with tortillas meat beans and cheese. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and cream of chicken soup on top. Cover with foil and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Use a very large pan or two smaller pans.

title: Chopstick Tuna
instructions: Combine undiluted soup and water. Add 1 cup of the noodles tuna celery onions cashews and mushrooms. Toss lightly and spread\tin ungreased 6 x 10 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining noodles and bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Syrup Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and Crisco. Add chocolate syrup and sugar. Beat until smooth. Add eggs one at a time and continue to beat. Combine sifted flour and baking powder alternately with milk. Stir in vanilla. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Start in a cold oven. Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cover with Chocolate Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Shrimp Stuffed In Bell Peppers
instructions: Cut off tops; remove seeds from peppers. Cook pepper shells in boiling water for 5 minutes then put at once into cold water. Cut shrimp slightly. Combine with eggs crumbs and milk. Saute chopped ingredients in butter for 3 minutes; add to shrimp mixture. Add seasonings; stuff into pepper shells putting a few bread crumbs and a drop of butter on top of each. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in moderate oven (375\u00b0). Serves 6.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: My Mom had entered this in the previous Thyme in the Kitchen cookbook. Originally received from Sea Captains Restaurant in Myrtle Beach South Carolina. So good I thought it would be a shame not to add it to this one.

title: Laura'S Biscuits(Hand Rolled)
instructions: In a large bowl or wooden tray spread out about 4 cups flour and make a hole in center patting it down so flour will not be loose. Pour milk into the hole then add Crisco. Start with hands working flour into the milk and Crisco gradually. Do not make the dough too stiff. If you do biscuits will be tough and hard. When you get dough medium thick then knead 6 to 12 times adding more flour if needed.

title: Oatmeal Marble Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl combine butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla extract. Beat until creamy. Beat in egg. Blend in flour mixtures. Stir in oats and nuts. Spread into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Place in 375\u00b0 oven for 3 minutes. Run knife through to marbleize.

title: Finger Paints
instructions: Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Set aside. Combine laundry starch with 3/4 cup cold water in medium saucepan. Add hot water and cook over medium heat stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until mixture comes to a full boil and has become completely thickened. Remove from heat and stir in softened gelatin. Add soap and stir until completely dissolved. Add color or paint to all or part of mixture. Store in covered containers. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Bun-Steads
instructions: Combine ingredients except buns. Mix all ingredients split buns and fill. Wrap each filled bun in aluminum foil. Place in oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until filling is heated and cheese melts. Fills 6 to 8 large buns generously. Can be served hot or cold. Can be refrigerated and reheated to serve at a later time.

title: Buffalo Beans
instructions: Brown hamburg and drain. Cook bacon and onions in separate pans. Add remaining ingredients and warm through. You may freeze.

title: Whole Peanut Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and peanut butter thoroughly. Add egg and beat well. Sift together flour soda and baking powder. Fold into the creamed mixture. Add cornflakes oatmeal and salted peanuts.

title: Sara'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Stir it and put in a pan. Bake in oven at 7\u00b0.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Mix all ingredients together. Turn out on floured board and knead lightly until it makes a smooth ball. Store in covered bowl in refrigerator. May be kept several days.

title: New Yorker Pasta
instructions: Prepare spaghetti per package directions; drain. Cut broccoli into florets and steam 8 minutes in microwave on High. Microwave bacon until brown in special dish or on a platter prepared with several layers of paper towels. Place hot spaghetti in serving bowl. Add broccoli; toss gently. Add bacon (crumbled) and grated cheese; toss again. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and pepper. Serve hot. Serves 4.

title: Jean'S Pecan Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and roll into 1-inch balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Lime Party Salad(Serves 20)
instructions: Melt marshmallows in top of double boiler with one cup of milk. Pour hot mixture over lime jello and stir until dissolved. Stir cream cheese in hot mixture until cheese dissolves. Add pineapple. Cool mixture. Keep stirring until cool to touch.

title: Buddy Bons
instructions: Combine sugar and cracker crumbs. Melt butter and peanut butter in saucepan. Mix peanut butter mix with graham cracker mixture until crumbly. Roll dough into balls. Melt chocolate chips and shortening in the microwave. Use toothpick to dip balls halfway into the chocolate. Set on wax paper. Take out toothpick and cool in the refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix and form into balls and stick a toothpick in them. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip balls into chocolate and remove picks.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Simmer for a couple hours. If not thick enough mix cornstarch in cold water 1/4 cup and add to sauce.

title: Granny'S Pudding Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar salt and baking powder. Make a well in dry ingredients and add shortening and liquid. Beat slowly until mixed then beat faster for 2 minutes then add eggs and vanilla. Beat 2 more minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in a tube pan.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: In a large bowl layer cabbage onion bell pepper and carrots. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of sugar over the vegetables; set aside. In a saucepan combine vinegar remaining 1/2 cup sugar oil and Natures Seasons. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Let cool. Pour mixture over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours. Stir well before serving. (For a juicier salad double the amounts of ingredients used in vinegar mixture.) Makes 24 servings.

title: Marie'S Meatballs
instructions: In bowl combine all ingredients. Shape into balls. Put in a 10 x 10-inch baking dish. Top with the following sauce.

title: Best Ever Apple Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell. Make lattice cover of pie crust. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Salmon With Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in butter until golden not brown. Stir in flour to make a roux. Slowly add milk. Stir until thickened.

title: Orange Apricot Ring
instructions: Drain apricots; reserve syrup. Puree apricots in blender. Add water to reserved syrup to make 1 1/2 cups. Combine syrup gelatin and dash of salt; heat to boiling. Stir to dissolve gelatin. Remove from heat; stir in frozen orange juice concentrate until melted. Add apricot puree and 1 cup cold water. Pour into 5-cup mold and chill until firm.

title: Spiced Hot Apple Cider
instructions: Put juices into 30-cup coffee maker. Place remaining ingredients in coffee ground basket. Remove basket and contents when done percolating.

title: No Calorie Dip
instructions: Place in a blender. Mix thoroughly. (If desired add 2 tablespoons mayonnaise.)

title: Italian Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan combine broth potatoes onion carrot celery peas bay leaf Italian seasoning and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the pasta and tomatoes. Heat through. Discard bay leaf before serving. Yields 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs for 5 minutes on high. Gradually add sugar; stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Set this aside. Mix flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Pour into liquid mixture. Pour into 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Line pan with wax paper first and sprinkle with 1 cup of nuts (optional). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Gooey Butter Bars
instructions: Mix yellow cake mix until crumbly with 1 egg and 1 stick margarine. Press mixture into 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix softened cream cheese 2 eggs and box of powdered sugar. Spread this mixture over first layer and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cut into bars when cool.

title: Jambalaya Salad
instructions: Combine rice celery green pepper onion thyme pepper garlic salt turkey ham shrimp and tomato. Fold in salad dressing until all ingredients are well moistened. Cover and chill. Add crumbled bacon and toss just before serving. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Boil macaroni until done drain. Rinse with cold water. Add onion pepper and bacon to macaroni; stir in mayonnaise.

title: Italian Sausage And Beans
instructions: In 10-inch skillet brown sausage green peppers onion and garlic; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes or until zucchini is tender and mixture is slightly thickened. Serves 4.

title: Caramel Dumplings
instructions: Melt butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Brown. Keep stirring so it wont burn. Add 1 cup sugar and 2 cups hot water.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch cocoa and salt. Gradually add beaten egg yolks milk and cream. Cook in double boiler stirring until thick. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Pour into cooked pie shell (cool pie shell).

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dill Dip Duet
instructions: Cut out center of bread loaf to form bowl. Reserve cut pieces for dipping. Stir sour cream and other ingredients together. Pour into bread bowl and serve.

title: Pear Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix in medium bowl the first 5 ingredients. Mix well in a large bowl just until combined the remaining ingredients adding pecans last. Pour into 2 (8 x 4 x 2-inch) loaf pans sprayed with nonstick spray. Bake 55 to 60 minutes (clean toothpick test). Cool for 10 minutes on wire rack. Remove bread from pans and cool thoroughly on rack.
