Wrap in plastic wrap and store overnight before slicing. Makes 2 loaves 16 slices each.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Refrigerate at least one hour before serving.

title: Martha'S Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and blend with flour. Stir in whipping cream. Drain corn. Put in greased casserole. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour mixture over corn. Bake covered for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 and uncovered for 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cherry Oatmeal Dream Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together; mix with oats and set aside.

title: Mushroom-Potatoes
instructions: Mix together in a 2-quart bowl mushroom soup and cheese. Stir in milk pimento mushroom stems and pieces and potatoes. Put mixture in a greased baking dish and top with grated cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Nacho Skillet Casserole
instructions: In large skillet brown beef and onion; drain. Stir in sugar oregano chili powder beans tomato sauce and corn. Simmer 10 to 20 minutes. Lay tortilla chips on top with cheese sprinkled on them. Cover. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve immediately. Can be topped with diced tomatoes lettuce and sour cream.

title: Magnolia Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; beat at medium speed with a mixer until blended. Add eggs buttermilk and flavorings. Beat at low speed until blended. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Garnish if desired.

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions: Cut wings in half; discard tips.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients. Place in casserole; top with the last ingredient. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cream the cream cheese with 1/2 cup sugar and mix in Cool Whip. Spread on cooled crust. Dissolve jello with hot water. Add strawberries and let set until cool. Pour over cream mixture. May use raspberries in place of strawberries.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut up squash; boil or steam until tender. Drain then mash and add all ingredients except half of butter to squash. Melt remaining butter. Put squash mixture in a baking dish; spread melted butter on top then sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until top is brown.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and top with the grated cheese. Cover with foil and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Cut meat into small chunks and add all ingredients and cook all day. Meat will cook up until you cant tell it was chunks.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Saute onion in stock until tender; add to beans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. (May add additional apple juice and 2 teaspoons ketchup.)

title: Chili Soup
instructions: Brown bacon and onions and cook well. Combine all ingredients.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter. Add onions; cook about 10 minutes or until light brown in color. Stir occasionally. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water; add to onions. Simmer. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Turtle Brownies
instructions: Unwrap caramels and add 1/3 cup of evaporated milk in a double boiler. Stir mixture until melted. Combine cake mix remaining milk and softened margarine. Blend until mixture holds together. Stir in nuts. Press 1/2 of the cake mix into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove pan from oven. Sprinkle chocolate pieces on top. Pour melted caramels over top evenly. Crumble remaining mixture over caramel mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool completely and cut into bars. Garnish top with a few chocolate bits and nuts.

title: Peanut Butter Eggs
instructions: Beat butter marshmallow cream peanut butter and confectioners sugar. Chill in refrigerator. Shape into eggs.

title: Tuna Bake With Cheese Swirls
instructions: Brown onion and green pepper in oil; add salt and flour. Blend. Add soup and milk. Cook until sauce is smooth and thick. Add flaked tuna and lemon juice. Pour into greased baking dish and cover with Cheese Swirls. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn oven temperature down to 400\u00b0 and bake 15 more minutes.

title: Williamsburg Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture in thirds alternating with thirds of sour cream. Beat well after each addition of sour cream and dry ingredients.

title: Mom'S Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Soak mushrooms in warm water until soft about 30 minutes. Drain. Rinse in warm water; drain. Remove and discard stems; cut caps into thin strips. Mix pork salt cornstarch soy sauce and white pepper. Cover and refrigerate about 20 minutes. Heat water to boiling in 4-quart pot. Add cabbage and heat to boiling; cover and cook 1 minute. Drain. Rinse with cold water until cabbage is cold. Drain thoroughly. Remove excess water by squeezing cabbage.

title: Open Faced French Apple Pie
instructions: Coat sliced and peeled apples with sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Arrange in pie crust.

title: Mommys Dumplings
instructions: Sift the flour baking powder and salt; work in butter. Add one beaten egg and milk. Put on top of chicken broth and vegetables.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix Cool Whip with strawberries and juice. Spread on cool cake. Keep refrigerated. Cake tastes better the next day.

title: Turkey Hash
instructions: Cook the onion in margarine until transparent but not brown. Add turkey soup potatoes pickle relish and peas. Heat slowly. Season to taste. Turn into a 1-quart casserole. Cover with cheese. Sprinkle top with paprika. Cook for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cucumber Beef Rolls
instructions: Combine the cream cheese cucumber radishes and salt to taste; blend well. Spread on beef slices. Roll and secure with a toothpick. Chill. Yields about 10 rolls.

title: Crazy Custard Pie
instructions: Beat all liquid ingredients together. Break up bread and add to liquid mixture. Place in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Orange Coconut Pie
instructions: Dice orange sections reserving several for garnish. Prepare topping mix with 1 cup of the milk as directed on package using large mixing bowl. Add remaining 1 3/4 cups milk and pudding mix. Blend then beat at high speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl often. Fold in oranges. Spoon into pie shell. Chill at least 4 hours. Garnish with rest of oranges. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups (2 1/2 x 1 1/4-inch) or line\twith paper baking cups. Beat egg slightly in medium bowl; stir in remaining ingredients except blueberries just until moistened. Fold blueberries into batter. Divide batter evenly among cups. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Blueberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello and 1 cup of boiling water until dissolved. Add pineapple and blueberries. Chill.

title: Butternut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs 1 at a time mixing after each addition. Alternate flour and whipping cream then add flavorings. Put cake in cold oven then turn oven to 325\u00b0. Cook for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Ship 'N' Shore Skillet Supper
instructions: Combine vegetables and butter in 10-inch skillet. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in flour. Add combined soup sour cream and ham. Heat over low heat stirring constantly. Top with cheese. Heat until cheese begins to melt.

title: Tostado Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add Ro-Tel tomato sauce water and picante sauce. Let simmer. Serve over chips. Top with cheese and sour cream.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Fry sausage drain. In crock-pot put cut up Velveeta cheese and refried beans. Stir. Add drained sausage. Stir occasionally until cheese is melted. Serve warm with chips as a dip.

title: Spanish Omelet
instructions: In medium skillet cook and stir green pepper and onion in butter over low heat until onion is tender. Stir in tomato sauce sugar and seasoning. Simmer 10 minutes until sauce is thickened. Fills approximately 2; 3 egg omelets.

title: Turkey Rice Salad
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on package omitting margarine and salt. Mix rice turkey celery peppers and parsley in a large bowl. Add dressing; mix lightly. Serve warm or refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 6 cups or 6 servings.

title: Leonard'S Pot Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper pot roast. Wrap with heavy-duty aluminum foil. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour. Remove; slice onion. Slice potatoes like you would for potato chips. Salt and pepper. Add to roast in aluminum foil and cook for 1 hour more.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Make pudding; use 3 cups milk. In a serving bowl crumble half of cake in bottom of bowl. Sprinkle half of Kahlua. Spread half of pudding. Spread 1/2 of Cool Whip. Sprinkle half of Heath bars. Repeat all layers ending with Heath bars as top layer. Store in fridge.

title: Royal Pudding Fudge
instructions: Beat egg white slightly. Add pudding mix and stir well. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Pat into square buttered pan. Cut into squares.

title: Pickled Peppers And Wieners
instructions: Cut off ends of peppers; remove seeds. Place wiener inside of pepper. Place inside of canning jars (wide-mouth jars work best). Pour boiling mixture over peppers and seal. Process in hot water bath for 20 minutes or place in pressure cooker at 5 pounds pressure for 10 minutes. This should make 3 quarts.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and Jell-O powder. Add boiling water and mix well. Chill until thickened. Add the pineapple and pecans. You may add celery if you wish. Refrigerate.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Grease tube pan. Place raisins (or nuts) on bottom of pan. Place frozen dough balls on top of raisins.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: In a shallow pan combine bread crumbs cheese paprika garlic salt and pepper. Dip chicken pieces in butter then roll in bread crumb mixture. Arrange skin side up without touching in a lightly greased baking pan. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until meat near bone is no longer pink. Serves 4.

title: White Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Stand on right foot and rub fat from cooked chicken on your knees and toes of left foot. Saute onion in butter until tender or 527 p.m. Stir in first 10 ingredients and mix well. Spoon approximately 1/2 cup of this mixture into center of tortillas; gently roll into extra large shaped cigar (do not attempt to light) and place seam side down in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Slice and pat cookie dough to cover pizza pan. Bake according to directions. Mix together cream cheese vanilla and sugar and spread on cooled cookie dough. Cut fruit up into bite size pieces. Arrange fruit on top of mixture. Top with Cool Whip and enjoy.

title: Rosamarina Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut chicken into 1/2-inch cubes. Cut peppers into strips. Cook pasta according to package; drain. Meanwhile add cooking oil and preheat wok over high heat. Stir-fry chicken 3 minutes or until lightly browned. Add green peppers onion cumin and red pepper. Stir-fry 3 minutes (adding more oil if needed). Stir in drained pasta corn chili peppers and salt. Cover and cook 2 minutes or until hot. Stir in tomatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook 2 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Meringue Pie
instructions: Prepare Meringue Shell and cool completely. In a mixing bowl combine the egg whites vanilla and cream of tartar; beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar beating at high speed until stiff peaks form and sugar is almost dissolved. Spread onto the bottom of a well-greased 9-inch pie plate. Build up the sides to form a shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Turn off oven. Let dry with the oven door closed for at least an hour. Cool completely on a wire rack before filling.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Mix flour dry oatmeal brown sugar butter cheese and cinnamon until crumbly. Press 1/2 into 9-inch greased pan. Cover with rhubarb. Combine sugar water cornstarch and vanilla; cook until thick and clear. Pour over rhubarb. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients except pecans. Beat. Add pecans. Pour mixture into the tart shells. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in pot or roaster pan. Put in oven at 275\u00b0 covered. Cook for 5 hours. Stir every hour.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time while beating. Fold in cake flour. Add vanilla. Pour batter into a buttered and floured Bundt pan or two loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: In a bowl combine the first 10 ingredients. Transfer to a greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Combine the cracker crumbs and butter; sprinkle over the top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Truffles
instructions: Combine frosting and confectioners sugar in large bowl. Stir with wooden spoon until thoroughly blended. Cover each of 36 pecan halves with 1 tablespoon candy mixture. Roll into 1-inch balls; set aside. Chop remaining pecans; set aside.

title: Dairy Queen(No Eggs Ice Cream)
instructions: Soak gelatin in cold water (it will look like applesauce). Heat evaporated milk in pan until almost boiling; remove from heat and add gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Add sugar salt and vanilla. Pour into ice cream freezer; add milk to fill line and stir. Freeze as usual.

title: Stir And Dump Chicken
instructions: Place chicken parts in baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tasty Salad
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail\tbut save juice. To juice add water to\tmake 3/4 cup of liquid. Put juice on stove to heat. Add jello to hot juice. Stir until jello dissolves.\tRemove. Cool. Add cocktail cottage\tcheese apple\tand evaporated milk. Add nuts if desired.

title: New York Specials
instructions: In double boiler stir until smooth butter sugar and cocoa. Add egg and vanilla. Then remove from heat and add coconut graham cracker crumbs chopped nuts; spread mixture in 9 x 9-inch square pan. Mix butter confectioners sugar pudding powder and cream. Spread on first mixture. Melt chocolate and butter spread on cake. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into small pieces.

title: Honey Bunnies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly with wet fingers. Roll into balls.

title: Pineapple Cake Dessert
instructions: Bake 1 white cake (following mix directions) in 9 x 13-inch pan and cool. Mix cream cheese milk and pudding mix with mixer and spread on cake. Refrigerate. Drain pineapple and spread over pudding mixture. Spread Cool Whip over pineapple. Sprinkle with nuts. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serves 16.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook hamburger meat. Add sauce. Mix the Italian seasoning cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Layer starting with sauce and make sure noodles are covered. Pour 1/4 cup water over mixture. Cook at 350\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes then uncover and cook for another 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with crackers.

title: Lazy Wife Pie
instructions: *One can fruit pie filling can be used in place of fresh fruit.

title: Apple Pie(1994 2Nd Place Perry County Fair Apple Pie Contest)
instructions: Mix sugar flour cinnamon nutmeg and salt in large bowl. Stir in apples. Add lemon juice. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie crust. Place top crust over filling. Overlap crust one-inch beyond pie plate and fold and roll top edge under lower crust edge pressing on rim to seal. Cut slits in top crust for steam to escape. Roll reserved pastry about 1/16-inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut into desired shapes. Brush one side of pastry shapes with water. Place shapes moist side down on edge and top of pie. Mix egg yolk and one teaspoon water; brush over pie. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat and bake for approximately 30 minutes more until crust is golden and apples are tender when tested with toothpick or cake tester. Remove from oven and cool. Serves 8.

title: Peanut Butter Sticks
instructions: Trim 4 slices of bread at a time with electric knife. Toast trimmings in 200\u00b0 oven until dry and crumble into fine crumbs about like coarse meal. Cut bread into sticks and toast in oven at 200\u00b0 until dry and brittle. Add Crisco oil to peanut butter until it has a consistency of a thick syrup. Dip dry bread sticks in peanut butter. Roll into crumbs and lay on paper towels to dry. Store in airtight container.

title: Sausage Scramble
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Ranch Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in order given. Whisk until well blended. Refrigerate at least 12 hours before serving to let flavors blend. Dressing is thin. Add more mayonnaise if you want a thicker dressing. Yield About one quart.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and top with buttered crackers. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Herb Grilled Vegetables
instructions: *Italian Roma tomatoes also work well; split in half lengthwise.

title: Ice Cream Dessert(Lemon-Lime Delight)
instructions: Mix crackers margarine and sugar and press into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan. Set aside. Let Sherbet and ice cream soften and mix together. Spread over the crust and freeze. Mix sugar lemon juice and butter together and cook on low heat until dissolved. Add a little of the hot mixture to 2 egg yolks. Mix well and pour back into saucepan with other hot mixture. Bring to a boil and cook one minute. Cool thoroughly and spread over ice cream. Serve with dollop of whipped cream and lime slice.

title: Pepper 'N Beef Stir-Fry(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: In medium bowl toss sliced steak and cornstarch; set aside. In small bowl blend water steak sauce soy sauce and garlic powder. Set aside.

title: Best Carrot Cake
instructions: Cake Combine eggs sugar and oil. Mix well. Combine dry ingredients. Mix well. Beat dry ingredients into egg mixture. Stir in carrots. Pour into two 9-inch round baking pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes (or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean). Cool for 10 minutes and remove to wire rack.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Soak chicken overnight or 2 hours with Italian dressing. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over chicken turning chicken to coat well. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until done. Turn and baste chicken once during baking. (This can also be cooked on the grill.)

title: Burnt Caramel  Ice Cream
instructions: In an old skillet burn the brown sugar. It will be bubbly and black looking on the top. When it gets burnt pretty good add 1 1/2 cups hot water to the sugar. Be careful and remove the skillet from the heat before adding the water. It will still bubble over - so be careful. Cool.

title: Green Beans Milano
instructions: Cok onions and garlic in oil until tender. Remove from heat. Add tomatoes and cornstarch. Stir to dissolve. Cook stirring constantly until thickened and translucent. Add beans and basil. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Earth Cake
instructions: Melt oleo and while hot mix cream cheese and sugar.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Thaw and squeeze spinach dry. Add rest of ingredients.

title: Turkey Balls
instructions: In a bowl mix turkey egg thyme milk and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix well. Fold in instant potatoes. Take a heaping spoonful of mixture and roll in the palms of your hands to make balls. Add enough olive oil to the bottom of a frying pan to coat it. Arrange meatballs in pan and brown on all sides turning frequently. Add turkey balls to your favorite sauce.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Cook for 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; simmer about 10 minutes. Serve with cheese straws while hot. Delicious.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; gradually beat in sugar and oil. Combine dry ingredients. Alternate zucchini and dry ingredients into egg mixture. Mix. Stir in nuts and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Makes 2 loaves. Grease and flour pans.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in frying pan and season. Mix catsup and dry mustard together and spread on chops. Combine vinegar water and sugar; pour over chops. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Gourmet Finger Food
instructions: Wash the broccoli and cauliflower in cold water. Cut into bite sized pieces. Toss in olive oil. Sprinkle with garlic salt and lemon juice. Add in the olives.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Top with corn flake crumbs or crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine sugar and oil. Mix well. Add all remaining ingredients. Chill several hours or overnight. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Corn And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed. Add margarine and mushroom soup. Mix well adding corn. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan in preheated oven for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Cut in squares.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini for 10 minutes in salted water and drain. Place in greased baking dish. Melt butter. Add flour and blend in tomatoes green pepper onion brown sugar bay leaf and cloves. Cook 5 minutes. Pour over zucchini. Top with crumbs and dot with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix and beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping. Layer pudding mixture vanilla wafers and bananas until you have used up all the pudding and bananas. Top with whipped topping.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix together and store in refrigerator at least overnight.

title: Creamed Asparagus And Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Wipe caps and slice. Saute mushrooms in butter with onion until golden. Prepare asparagus (cooked) as usual; cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Heat 1 tablespoon butter and blend in flour. When lightly browned add cream. Heat slowly stirring occasionally until thickened. Season with salt pepper and nutmeg. Add sauteed mushrooms and onion; keep warm. Drain asparagus; place in dish. Top with mushroom sauce. Add a sprinkle of paprika if desired. Serves 8.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook noodles according to package. Drain. Cool in a single layer on wax paper. Brown ground beef and drain. Combine meat eggs bread crumbs Mozzarella cheese onions oregano salt and pepper. Mix well. Fill each shell with 2 tablespoons meat. Spread a thin layer of sauce in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Put shells with the open side down in a single layer. Cover with sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 36 shells.

title: Green Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Beat in softened cream cheese and Sprite. Chill until just beginning to set. Add Cool Whip salad dressing sugar and vanilla. Drain pineapple and add nuts and pineapple to jello mixture. Chill until firm.

title: Barbecue Wienies
instructions: Remove wieners from package and cut into 1 to 2-inch lengths. Put into cooking pot and add barbecue sauce. Cook with medium heat and stir occasionally. Serves 2 to 4 people.

title: Shrimp Bayer
instructions: Lightly mash shrimp. Add mayonnaise catsup horseradish salt and m.s.g. Blend well. Stuff celery stalks. Chill 1 hour. Cut in bite-size pieces.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Blend in melted chocolate and vanilla; stir in flour and chopped nuts. Pour batter into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Test with toothpick.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Combine thawed lemonade Cool Whip and Eagle Brand milk. Whisk well. Pour into the pie crust and freeze at least 1 hour.

title: Red Cabbage Salad
instructions: Chop cabbage and onions. Break up noodles (reserve flavor packets for dressing). Toast noodles seeds and nuts in a dry teflon pan until lightly browned. Cool. Mix ingredients together just prior to serving and tossing with dressing.

title: Taco Salad Dressing
instructions: In cruet or bottle combine all ingredients. Mix well then chill. Serve on taco salad or Indian tacos. May add dry taco seasoning or Tabasco for extra zip.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion in large fry pan. Boil egg noodles for 10 minutes. Drain. Add soup and water to hamburger. Add green beans and juice. Mix in noodles salt and pepper. Pour in casserole dish cover top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Chopped Pickle Relish
instructions: Slice cucumbers and peppers lengthwise and remove seeds. Grind cucumbers peppers and onions with a coarse grinder. Add salt; let stand overnight. Drain. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Heat to a boil; simmer for 20 minutes. Seal in hot sterilized jars. Yields 8 pints.

title: Spiced Peaches
instructions: Cook sugar vinegar and spices for 20 minutes. Drop in fruit a few at a time and cook until easily pricked with fork. Pack in hot sterilized jars. Add syrup to within 1/2 inch of top. Seal. Makes 6 pints.

title: Bagels
instructions: Mix together first 8 ingredients and allow to rise. Then cut dough into 12 pieces. Roll each piece into a ball. Make a 1-inch hole in the center of each ball using a floured finger to form a ring shape. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 20 minutes.

title: Hartzog Noodle Soup
instructions: Take eggs and add flour until its a thick dough. Meanwhile boil the chicken and all remaining ingredients. Roll out dough as thin as possible. Cover with flour then roll into a tight roll and put in the refrigerator. Take out chicken debone and put back into pot. Take out roll of dough and slice into 1/4-inch sections. Drop each noodle in pot one by one after unrolling them so they dont stick together. When noodles turn white they are done. Simmer for half an hour.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: *You can mix this with the corn meal. It gives the okra a different taste from plain fried okra.

title: Snicker Bars
instructions: Melt and spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Let cool.

title: Gram'S Butternut Cookies(Note:  These Are The Cookies We All Remember.)
instructions: Mix all together except egg white and nuts. Spread into two buttered pans about 1/3-inch thick. Brush with egg white and cover with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly golden at edges. Cut before it cools completely.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Make day before. Place in 9 x 11-inch pan in order listed. No substitutions (no Miracle Whip or imitation bacon). Refrigerate.

title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Mix together oleo brown sugar and eggs. Add rest of ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add the eggs. Sift flour soda baking powder salt and spices. Mix the coffee and molasses. Alternately add coffee mixture and flour mixture to the creamed mixture. Roll to 1/2-inch thickness and cut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs; slice in half. Beat egg yolks mayonnaise mustard and cheese until well blended. Fold in finely chopped olives. Stuff eggs. Refrigerate until party time. Makes 24 stuffed eggs.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening. Stir in milk. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead about 20 times. May cut with floured 2-inch cutter (or pat into a seven-inch circle and cut into 9 pieces). Bake on ungreased sheet at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until browned. Makes 9 to 12 biscuits.

title: Easy Pizza
instructions: Spread biscuits on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread sour cream over biscuits. Brown hamburger with onion Italian seasoning to taste salt and pepper to taste. Drain and pour over sour cream. Add tomato sauce and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix pie filling pineapple and strawberries with juice and let chill. Just before serving add bananas and mix together.

title: Honey Glorified Rice
instructions: Whip the cream; beat in honey gradually. Stir in vanilla. Fold in remaining ingredients. Chill. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Pour cabbage in bottom of dish. Mix soup and milk together and pour on top of cabbage. Sprinkle cracker crumbs and then butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Company Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in large bowl; toss lightly. Add Worcestershire sauce and enough mayonnaise to moisten. Spoon into buttered 8 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange mushrooms and eggs over top. Combine bread crumbs butter and cheese in small bowl. Sprinkle over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breaded Pork Chops
instructions: Pound chops; salt and pepper both sides. Beat egg(s). Dip pork chops into flour then egg then bread crumbs covering both sides. Fry in hot oil until brown and crispy on both sides. Put chops in roasting pan with water and a pat of butter on top of each pork chop. Cover and bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Then uncover and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Mrs. Clark'S Lemon Cheese Cake Filling
instructions: Mix all together in saucepan. When mixture begins to boil add the dissolved cornstarch and let cook until thick. Let cool a few minutes before putting on any white cake layers. Wonderful!

title: Brownie Peanut Butter Bites
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine brownie mix water oil and egg. Beat well with spoon. Fill mini Muffin cups about 1/2 full. Press one peanut buttercup into batter in each cup. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until brownie is set. Cool completely.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: Mix egg meat and bread crumbs. Shape into 4 dozen balls. Brown meatballs on broiler pan under oven broiler turning once. Place in large saucepan or Dutch oven. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over meatballs.\tCover and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally to coat evenly.

title: Midnight Punch
instructions: Chill fruit fruit juice grenadine and 7-Up. At serving time combine crushed pineapple and strawberries in a punch bowl. Add pineapple juice and grenadine. Slowly pour in chilled 7-Up. Add ice cubes. Garnish punch bowl with curls of orange rind. Makes about 30 servings.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Beat with mixer until well blended. Pour into ice cream freezer container. Add milk to fill the container. Freeze according to manufacturers directions.

title: Cheeseburger Rice
instructions: Brown meat and onion in large skillet; drain. Stir in water catsup mustard salt and pepper. Bring to boil. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Top with cheese. Cover; let stand for 3 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook until thickens and alternate layers of bananas pudding and nuts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Not So Sweet Strawberry Freezer Jam
instructions: Mix berries and sugar and let stand 10 minutes. Mix water and Sure-Jell and bring to a full boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. At once stir into fruit. Continue stirring 3 minutes. Immediately ladle into containers. Leave 1/2-inch space at top. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 24 hours; then freeze.

title: Green Bean Saute
instructions: In large skillet melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms onions garlic salt and pepper. Cook until mushrooms are tender. Add green beans. Cook 5 to 7 minutes or until heated through. Stir in cheese. Serve hot. Yields about 10 servings.

title: Ham Pot Pie
instructions: Cook ham as desired and set aside. Save ham broth.

title: Fresh Razzle-Berry Pie(Heritage Recipe)
instructions: In small strainer rinse raspberries drain well. Place berries in large mixing bowl. In small mixing bowl combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Add sugar mixture to berries. Stir gently to coat berries.

title: Delicious Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and drain well. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Stir occasionally.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken in salted water; debone. Pour chicken broth over Doritos to wet. Layer Doritos in casserole. Place chicken except 1 cup over Doritos. Saute onion in margarine until tender. Add soups and cup of chicken. Pour on top of chicken. Add cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Sliced boiled potatoes may be used for Doritos.

title: Chili
instructions: Heat shortening in a saucepan. Add onion beef and salt. Cook slowly for 5 minutes occasionally. Stir in chili powder flour tomatoes and water. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 hours. Stir occasionally. Add more water if needed.

title: Spiced Apple Wedges
instructions: Peel and core apples. Cut into wedges and set aside. In a large skillet combine sugar margarine and cinnamon. Add water. Cook and stir over medium heat until water boils and sugar dissolves. Add apple wedges to syrup. Return to boiling. Reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 10 to 15 minutes or until just tender.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Mix water with pineapple and heat to boiling point. Add Jell-O and dissolve. Refrigerate until it starts to thicken. Add celery and nuts. Mix Cool Whip and softened cream cheese and fold into Jell-O mixture. Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Refrigerate at least 2 hours preferable overnight.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Stir once half way through baking. Bake 1 hour at 375 degrees.

title: Hominy
instructions: Pack meat in either pints or quarts and fill up with cold water. Put 1 teaspoon salt to the quart jar. Place on rubbers and tops and cold pack for 3 hours.

title: Joe'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Fry onions and garlic in small amount of butter or margarine until they become clear. Add meat that has been previously browned. Add tomatoes and other ingredients. Mash the whole tomatoes. Simmer slowly for 4 to 6 hours. Skim grease that comes to the top. Makes 12 servings; time to prepare is 300 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix diced rhubarb with the 1/2 cup sugar and let stand until batter is mixed. Cream shortening and 1 1/2 cups sugar. Add egg. Then add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla. When cake is mixed add rhubarb mixture to batter. Blend. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped topping. If serving cold sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top before baking.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a large baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Meanwhile drain the pineapple; reserve 2 tablespoons liquid.

title: Cream Cheese Banana Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in bananas and eggs. Stir in baking mix and nuts. Do not beat. Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until done. Cover with foil the last 15 minutes.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Defrost spinach and squeeze out extra moisture. Mix eggs and cottage cheese. Add spinach to egg mixture. This is the filling.

title: Dayna'S Mexican Fudge(Chili Squares)
instructions: Spray small casserole dish with Pam. Place jalapeno peppers on bottom and side of dish. Beat eggs (like preparing for scrambled eggs). Pour over peppers and top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until set. Serve warm.

title: Velvet Fudge
instructions: Melt cheese and butter; blend together. Add vanilla; mix cocoa with 2 boxes confectioners sugar and add this to cheese mixture. Work in other 2 boxes of sugar (use hands; mixture is stiff). Roll out flat on wax paper. Sprinkle with nuts and roll up like a jelly roll and slice. Makes 3 or 5 rolls. Store in refrigerator or freezer. Best if let set at room temperature for 1 hour before serving.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix mandarin oranges eggs and oil. Beat 2 minutes at high speed of electric mixer; reduce speed to low and beat 1 minute. Bake in 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove and cool completely.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put prepared stuffing in an 8-inch square pan. Shred chicken and put on top of stuffing. Layer on chopped broccoli. Mix the mayonnaise soup and cheese; pour on top of broccoli. Crush Ritz crackers and put on top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lentil Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients; bake covered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Combine and let set overnight in refrigerator. Keeps well.

title: Hearty Manicotti
instructions: Cook the sausage and beef.\tAdd the onion tomato puree tomato paste sugar pepper basil and salt to the meat mixture. Cook the manicotti shells; drain and set aside. Mix together the Ricotta cheese Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese and parsley; stuff in the cooked manicotti shells. Spoon meat sauce into baking pan. Put stuffed shells on meat sauce. Pour leftover meat sauce over shells; sprinkle with Parmesan. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Canned Old Fashioned Mincemeat
instructions: Cook meat and grind. Fruit must be cooked canned fruit may be used more or less as desired. Mix all ingredients. Put in jars. Cold pack 30 minutes or pressure to 10 pounds and turn off.

title: Sweet And Spicy Baked Beans
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium saucepot cook pork chop onion and peppers in olive oil over medium-high heat 7 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Transfer mixture to an 11 x 7-inch baking or casserole dish. Bake 30 minutes or until beans are tender. Makes 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: Place frozen strawberries in a 2-quart glass microwave-proof bowl. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir in pectin and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir in sugar and lemon juice. Microwave on High for 6 minutes stirring midway through cooking. Pour into glass jars; seal. Will last longer if stored in refrigerator after cooling. Yields 2 cups.

title: Sourdough Bread Mix
instructions: Let set out all night. Cover with paper towel and rubber band. Mix once or twice; let ferment all night. Take out 1 cup the next day after stirring. Put the rest back in the refrigerator. Let set 5 to 8 hours. Make bread rolls or pizza dough. Makes 3 loaves of bread. When jar is full give 1 cup to a friend. Always keep refrigerated.

title: Steamed Blueberry Pudding
instructions: Mix and sift flour and baking powder. Beat egg yolks then add sugar and beat until thick. Add water lemon rind and lemon juice. Stir in flour and then blueberries. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Turn into greased pudding mold and steam 1 hour over rapidly boiling salted water. Serve with nutmeg or lemon sauce. Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or an 8-inch square baking pan. In a large bowl mix together cornmeal flour sugar baking powder and salt. In a medium bowl mix together the eggs milk and oil until smooth. Add milk mixture stirring until the dry ingredients are just moistened. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake until golden and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean 25 minutes. Transfer pan to wire rack to cool for 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix sour cream cream cheese and sugar. Add balance of ingredients. Mix well with mixer at medium speed. Pour into graham cracker shell and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Allow to cool then top with cherry or strawberry pie filling if desired.

title: Zucchini Marmalade
instructions: Peel squash and slice. Place in kettle with lemon juice peel and pineapple. Bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Add pectin and peach jello and bring to boil. Stir in sugar and ginger at full rolling boil stirring constantly. Sustain boil until the mixture jells. Remove from heat; skim off foam. Allow mixture to cool for 5 minutes. Skim and ladle into hot sterilized jars. Wipe jar rims; cover quickly with flat rings; screw bands tightly. Invert jars 5 minutes then turn upright. After jars cool check seals to make sure they are sealed.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together and cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Top with cooked bacon strips.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion celery and green pepper in oleo. Cook broccoli as directed. Drain. Add mushroom soup garlic powder and grated cheese. Mix together with cooked rice and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in buttered casserole.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Sift together the sugar flour and baking powder. Add milk and egg. Beat until smooth. Add apples. Drop heaping teaspoons full into hot fat (1 1/2-inch deep). Leave in fat 4 minutes or until brown. Drain and roll in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon.

title: Sauerkraut Cake
instructions: Cream the 2/3 cup butter and sugar. Beat in the eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with the water. Rinse drain and chop the sauerkraut. Stir in the sauerkraut. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven in 2 (8-inch) cake pans until center springs back when touched. Combine the remaining ingredients well and frost the cooled cake.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Set cream cheese out so that it will reach the soft stage. Take green onions and chop them up very fine (I use a chopper). Set them aside. Take ham out and chop it up very fine also. (I use a chopper on this also.) Set aside in 2 parts. When cream cheese is soft put in large bowl. Add Accent salt and mix together. Add green onions and part of ham and mix this together. Separate this in 2 equal parts then make a large ball out of each part. Set this aside and get the remaining part of ham spread this out on wax paper or foil. Take one of the balls and roll until covered with ham then do the other one. Wrap each ball in plastic wrap and refrigerate. Best if left overnight. You can also roll balls in pecans instead.

title: Creamy Fruit Parfaits
instructions: In bowl with mixer blend cream cheese and 1/4 cup milk until smooth. Add remaining milk and pudding mix and beat at low speed for 2 minutes. Alternately layer pudding mixture and fruit into 4 parfait glasses. Chill until served. Quick and easy.

title: No-Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Mix well and spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Mom'S Biscuits And Fluffy Dumplings
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Cut in oleo until fine. Add milk. Mix to form soft dough. Knead about 10 times on a floured board. Roll and cut out biscuits. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. May also drop by spoonfuls into boiling chicken broth. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes for chicken and dumplings.

title: Soft Ice Cream
instructions: Whip the cream and set aside. Beat the egg whites. Slowly add 1/4 cup brown sugar white sugar and salt to the eggs. Beat until stiff. Fold cream egg mixture vanilla and liquor together. Freeze covered in 4 to 6 goblets.

title: Never Fail Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil first 5 ingredients for 4 minutes. Add peanut butter Marshmallow Fluff and vanilla. Beat well; put in greased pan.

title: Old-Fashioned Chicken Soup
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Toss well. Fold in mayonnaise. Cover and chill at least 2 hours. Garnish with parsley and cherry tomatoes if you like. Sometimes I boil an extra egg and slice it thin and long over salad in bowl. Chill until ready to serve in lettuce lined salad bowl.

title: Salami Shell Salad
instructions: Cook shells drain. Rinse with cold water drain well put in medium bowl. Put oil and garlic in container of blender or food processor process until garlic is pureed. Add parsley oregano basil salt and pepper. Process until parsley is finely chopped. Pour dressing over shells and toss to coat. Add salami cheese and scallions toss again. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Hot Salsa
instructions: Cook for approximately 1 hour or until thickness desired in pot without lid. Makes 7 pints.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Combine corn egg yolks flour salt and baking powder. Fold in beaten egg whites. Heat oil. Drop batter into oil by spoonfuls and deep fry until slightly browned. Drain and serve hot.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until very stiff. Gradually add sugar to stiff egg whites then add baking powder and vanilla. Continue beating mixture at least 3 minutes; set aside. Crush crackers and walnuts thoroughly (a food processor with plastic blade works well); combine. Fold the cracker mixture into the egg white mixture. Spread into an 8-inch pie pan greased with butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese and milk in blender until creamy. Add sour cream green pepper and onion. Blend. Fold in dried beef and heat in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until bubbly. Serve hot with chips for dipping. Can be prepared ahead and frozen.

title: Irish Bread
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Melt butter and mix with eggs and milk. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour into two greased and floured 8-inch pans. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes depending on oven.

title: Apple Cinnamon Cream Liqueur
instructions: In blender container combine ingredients; blend until smooth. Serve over ice. Garnish as desired. Store tightly covered in refrigerator. Stir before serving.

title: Shrimp Scampi(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Shell and devein raw shrimp. \Butterfly\ the shrimp by making a cut and splitting the thickest part. Wash the shrimp and place it in a shallow baking dish.

title: Fudge Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Put all ingredients into heavy saucepan; cook stirring on medium heat until mixture begins to boil; boil 5 minutes then remove from heat. Cool. Beat until thick enough to spread on cake layers. Add vanilla. Use one recipe for each cake layer to be iced.

title: Chicken Teriyaki Chunks
instructions: Mix together soy sauce honey ginger and garlic. Simmer in saucepan. Cut chicken into 1-inch chunks. Dip chicken in beaten egg then dip chicken into flour. Fry the coated chicken nuggets in oil until browned. Dip chicken nuggets into soy sauce mixture then bake them in 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle chicken with sesame seed if desired. Serve with rice and whatever sauce remains.

title: Palagrina
instructions: Cook noodles in salted\twater slowly\tfor 15 minutes. Mix meat noodles and sauce together; add corn mushrooms cheese and other ingredients. Bake in extra large casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be frozen and served 2 to 3 weeks later.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring to a rolling boil the first 4 ingredients. Add all at one time the flour. Beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until mixture leaves the sides of pan and forms a smooth ball. Remove from heat. Quickly beat in one at a time beating until smooth after each addition the eggs. Continue beating until thick and smooth. Drop by tablespoons 2 inches apart on a greased baking sheet. Bake puffs at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 5 minutes longer or until golden brown in color. Remove to racks and cool completely. Fill shells with creamy vanilla filling sweetened whipped cream chicken salad or other desired filling.

title: Sausage Vegetable Grill
instructions: Prepare outdoor grill for barbecuing. Meanwhile peel carrots; cut each carrot lengthwise in half. Cut each unpeeled potato lengthwise into 6 wedges. Cut each onion lengthwise in half. In 12-inch skillet over high heat in 3/4-inch boiling water heat carrots potatoes and onions to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp; drain. Add olive oil salt pepper and marjoram to vegetables in skillet and toss to coat well.

title: Marinated Pork Steaks
instructions: Salt lightly on both sides of meat with the garlic seasoned salt and Cajun seasoning. Sprinkle both sides with onion flakes. Coat thoroughly both sides with teriyaki sauce. Coat thoroughly just one side with the soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Put steaks side by side in airtight container and shake. Turn over every hour for four hours. Pour marinade over steaks on grill; cook slowly until tender and serve.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Stir together first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Gently stir in blackberries until sugar mixture is crumbly. Spoon fruit mixture into a lightly greased 11-inch by 17-inch baking dish. Cut 1 piecrust into 1/2-inch wide strips and arrange strips diagonally over blackberry mixture. Sprinkle top with 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown and center is bubbly. Serve with ice cream if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Apricots
instructions: Grease casserole. Layer apricots sugar and crackers. Repeat layers so that crackers are on top. Dot with butter (be generous). Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in boiling water until tender. Save stock. Debone chicken and cut into small pieces. Mix onion soups sour cream broth and green chiles in a bowl. Grease a 2-quart casserole and place a layer of torn tortilla pieces on the bottom. Add a layer of soup mixture then chicken pieces then grated cheese. Repeat this process one more time ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 45 minutes.

title: Walnut Banana Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Beat in bananas and milk. Combine the flour baking soda and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture and mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack. Yield 1 loaf.

title: Smothered Chicken
instructions: Broil chicken until brown. Turn and brown other side. Place broiled chicken in Pyrex dish. Sprinkle with onion (if desired). Mix soup and milk together and pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Canned Apples
instructions: Peel core and slice apples; pack in jars. Add 1 or 2 aspirins and fill jars with cold tap water; seal. This is a good way to can apples for pies.

title: Oven Fried Pork Chops
instructions: Set oven to 425\u00b0. Place margarine or butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Place pan in the oven about 3 minutes or until margarine melts. Stir together egg and milk. Dip pork chops in egg mixture. Coat with stuffing mix. Place chops on top of melted margarine in pan. Bake 20 minutes. Turn. Bake 10 to 15 minutes more or until pork is no longer pink.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix; let set overnight. (Drain all fruit.)

title: Connie'S Frozen Citrus Pie
instructions: Beat concentrate for 30 seconds. Blend in ice cream and whipped topping. Whip until smooth. Pour into crust. Freeze at least 4 hours. top with additional whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to boil margarine water shortening and cocoa. Set aside. Mix together flour sugar and salt. Pour liquid ingredients over dry ingredients and add buttermilk soda eggs and vanilla. Bake in 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan that has been buttered. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Poodles
instructions: Put the oats in bowl; set aside. Put oleo sugar chocolate and milk in pan; boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Add peanut butter; stir until dissolved. Add vanilla. Pour all over oatmeal; stir until oatmeal is all covered. Put waxed paper on cookie sheets; drop by spoonful. Set in cool place to harden.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring salt butter and water to a boil. Turn burner off and sift flour in. Beat vigorously until it rolls. Cool slightly and add unbeaten eggs one at a time and beat thoroughly until creamy and smooth. Drop by teaspoons onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 10 more minutes. Do not open door while baking. Cool slit sides and fill with prepared coconut pudding or your favorite pudding.

title: Dum-Dum Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pint jar. Mix well and let set at least 6 hours before using. Great on lettuce leaf salad or spinach.

title: Glorified Grahams
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar and boil 1 minute and 45 seconds. Stir constantly. Line jelly roll pan with foil and place crackers side-by-side. Pour liquid over crackers and smooth to cover all crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Lightly coat a 5 x 9-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl mix oil and sugar. Add the buttermilk and beaten eggs stirring until smooth. In another bowl combine the remaining ingredients and add to the liquid mixture stirring just until the batter is moistened. Dont overmix it. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 18 1/2 slices.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: In skillet heat olive oil and half of minced garlic for 2 minutes over medium-high heat. Add broccoli and seasoning. Saut until broccoli turns limp; cool. Slice bread and add butter with remaining garlic to each inner side. Spoon broccoli mixture on bottom half of bread followed by half of cheese. Repeat. Put top half of bread onto the mixture and loosely wrap in foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. Set aside 10 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Sugarless Jam(For Diabetics)
instructions: In blender mix all ingredients thoroughly; keep refrigerated. Yields 1 3/4 cups or 28 servings 1 tablespoon each.

title: Lemonade Cake
instructions: Beat ingredients 4 minutes. Pour into well greased and floured tube pan. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spiced Black Beans
instructions: In a 4 to 5-quart pan over medium heat cook onions in oil until limp and lightly browned stirring often. Add chicken broth beans tomato paste spices and herbs. Cover bring to boil over high heat; reduce to simmer until beans mash easily about 3 1/2 hours. (Soaking beans overnight can reduce cooking time to 2 1/2 hours.) Uncover and boil beans on high until reduced to about 5 1/2 cups about 30 minutes stirring to prevent scorching.

title: Pecan Or Walnut Tartlets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix softened butter and cream cheese until smooth. Gradually add the flour to form a pastry dough. Line tart tins with tart size paper tartlet cups. Mix the remaining ingredients for filling.

title: Baked Summer Squash
instructions: Place squash strips into a greased baking dish. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with salt and paprika. Pour milk over all of this. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 until squash is tender.

title: Easy Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Place graham crackers in a 9-inch square Pyrex dish bottom and sides (dont crush). Put 1 1/2 cups milk and cream cheese in blender; blend well then add instant pie filling. Blend until it begins to thicken. Pour in crust and spread evenly then pour cherry pie filling over that. Chill until set or cold.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients to the onion celery pepper and mushrooms. Mix the vinegar oil sugar salt and pepper and add to bean mixture. Cover and refrigerate. Keeps well.

title: Dog Peanut Butter Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease two baking sheets. In mixing bowl combine flours baking powder and salt. In blender combine peanut butter and milk. Blend until smooth. Pour into dry mixture and blend well. The dough will be soft. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly. Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut into 2-inch squares. Place on baking sheet about 1-inch apart.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Cool and dice. Add eggs onion pickles and celery. Mix together with salad dressing salt pepper and mustard. Refrigerate; garnish with paprika and egg slices.

title: Pavlova
instructions: Step 1 Beat egg whites until soft peaks form; add 1/3 cup of the sugar and beat until dissolved. Gradually add remaining sugar beating well after each addition. When sugar is dissolved add vanilla and vinegar; beat 1 minute only to combine mixture. Mixture will be thick.

title: Grandma Arbuckle'S Ice Cream
instructions: Mix ingredients; pour into freezer container.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring sugar and corn syrup to a boil. Add peanuts; stir constantly and cook until light brown. Remove from heat. Add baking soda and salt. Pour mixture onto waxed paper. Break into pieces when cooled.

title: Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Italian Bread
instructions: Bread Maker Instructions Recipe is for 1 1/2 pound loaf. Ingredients (except warm water) should be at room temperature. Add ingredients in the order listed. Water should be warm (105\u00b0 to 125\u00b0). Select white bread and push \start.\

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Cut peeled eggplant into 1/4-inch slices. Dip each slice in eggs and crumbs. Saute in oil until browned. Place layer of eggplant in buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese oregano and Mozzarella cheese. Cover well with some sauce. Repeat until ingredients are gone. Top last layer of sauce with Mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. \Enjoy.\

title: Skillet Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Mix salt pepper and flour together then sprinkle lightly over chicken. In a skillet with butter brown the chicken on all sides. Pour barbecue sauce (your favorite brand) over chicken; lower heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes. Remove cover and cook for 15 minutes.

title: Hawaiian-Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix hot water and margarine in bowl. Stir in stuffing mix pepper half the pineapple and syrup. Spoon stuffing evenly on chicken; roll tightly. Secure with toothpicks. Place in 9-inch square pan with any remaining stuffing in center.

title: Vegetable Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook frozen vegetables as package directs. Drain and cut up any large pieces. Combine creamed corn cheese corn and soup. Fold in the cooked vegetables and mushrooms. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch dish. Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
instructions: In a bowl combine soup paprika and pepper. In a greased 2-quart oblong dish (2 x 4 x 5-inch) arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Sprinkle with the cheese. Spoon on soup mix over the cheese. Cover with tinfoil; bake 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix last 3 ingredients and pour over first 4 ingredients and allow to marinate at least one hour.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight before serving with fresh vegetables.

title: Sausage Rice Dish
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Saute cut up celery and onion with meat until glazy. Add cooked rice soup and peppers. Cook about 4 minutes. Put in a casserole dish and top with sliced olives. Cut up nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 6.

title: No Boil Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground turkey; add onion and garlic. Cook until onion is transparent. Reduce heat. Add spaghetti sauce and water. In a medium bowl combine cottage cheese eggs salt parsley and Parmesan cheese. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Chicken Rolls
instructions: Stir stuffing mix into boiling water. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Pound chicken breasts quite thin. Divide stuffing spooning into one end of each breast. Roll up and secure with toothpicks. Roll in flour. Brown in margarine in skillet. add wine and water. Cover; simmer 15 to 20 minutes turning twice.

title: Vodka Slush
instructions: Boil water and sugar together. Mix together frozen juices Vodka and water; add boiled mixture. Mix and freeze. Serve plain or with 50/50 or white soda.

title: American Persimmon Pie
instructions: Mix persimmon pulp egg and milk. Mix sugar salt and cornstarch; add to first mixture. Line a pie pan with pastry; fill with mixture. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Will'S Huevos Rancheros
instructions: Heat chili. Cook eggs sunny side up. Place eggs over chili and serve with warmed tortillas.

title: Olive-Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend cheeses and oleo. Stir in olives and chives. Chill for easier shaping. Form in ball. Chill thoroughly. Before serving sprinkle nuts over ball. Serve with crackers.

title: Yankee Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Spread ribs meaty side up in roasting pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange lemon slices on ribs and brown uncovered in 450\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Brownie Drops
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter over hot water. Stir to blend; cool. Beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating until thickened about 5 minutes with mixer. Blend in chocolate mixture. Add flour baking powder salt and cinnamon; blend. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) until cookies feel set when lightly touched 8 to 10 minutes. Store in tightly covered container. Makes about 36 cookies.

title: Italian-Style Broccoli
instructions: Trim off large leaves of broccoli. Remove tough ends to lower stalks; cut up and mix with other ingredients. Put in baking dish and bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until tender. Garnish with lemon slices if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes 1/2 cup margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla and put in a buttered casserole dish. Top with brown sugar nuts flour and 1/4 cup margarine all mixed together.

title: Cold Drink
instructions: Grate lightly the peel of both fruits. Squeeze fruit; put peel and juice in large pan. Add citric acid water and sugar. Bring to a full boil. Let stand for 24 hours. Strain into jars. When ready to use dilute this \syrup\ with three parts water.

title: Turkey Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. In large bowl mix all ingredients well. Shape into loaf and put in pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or unti loaf pulls away from sides of pan. Remove to platter. Cool 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 6 servings with 210 calories and 10 g fat.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a covered jar and shake vigorously until well blended. Makes 1 cup. Use with either greens or fruit salad.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and form into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Wash your squash; cook and drain then mash squash. Mix in grated cheese seasoning milk and pepper. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is bubbling on top.

title: Hallelujah Pie
instructions: Pour apple pie filling into a 13 1/2 X 8 3/4 x 1 3/4 baking dish. Pour dry yellow cake mix on top and sprinkle with cinnamon. Blend slightly and pour pecans over this. Place pats of margarine over entire top of mixture and bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Mix and bake brownie mix as directed on package in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Prepare 2 packages of Jell-O mousse as directed and spread over brownies. Spread Cool Whip on top of mousse. Mix Heath tidbits with pecans. Sprinkle over Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: Apple Crumb Cake
instructions: In saucepan combine white sugar and cornstarch. Cook until thick. Add vanilla and salt. Pare apples slice and add to cooked mixture. In another bowl combine crumbs mixture flour oatmeal brown sugar and melted butter. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan put in 1/2 of the crumb mixture then add cooked mixture and top with other half crumb mixture spreading evenly. Add 1 cup water throughout. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Texas Corn Bread
instructions: Sift corn meal flour baking powder salt and sugar together. Combine egg oil and milk; add to dry ingredients. Mix until smooth. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan 10-inch iron skillet or 12-muffin tin. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar oil cinnamon eggs and carrots then add flour soda and salt. Mix until well blended. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake about 45 minutes or when toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool completely then frost it.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Salmon Log
instructions: Drain salmon; remove skin and bones. Flake salmon with a fork; add cream cheese lemon juice onion salt and liquid smoke. Stir well. Chill mixture several hours or overnight. Shape salmon mixture into a log. Combine pecans and parsley; stir well. Roll salmon log in pecan mixture and chill several hours. Yields one 10-inch log.

title: Holiday Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine egg yolk sugar vinegar and butter in a small saucepan; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Remove from heat; add marshmallows stirring until melted. Cool. Stir in whipped topping. Pour dressing over fruit; toss gently until well coated. Yield 8 servings.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Muffins
instructions: Combine oats and buttermilk. Let the mixture stand for 1 hour. Stir in the eggs sugar and butter. Add the flour mixture and stir until it is just combined (will be lumpy). Fold in the raisins. Spoon batter into greased and floured muffin tins. Bake in preheated hot (400\u00b0) oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 18 medium or 12 large muffins.

title: Enchilada Casserole Con Crockpot
instructions: In a skillet saute 1/2 onion in about a tablespoon of oil. Cook for 2 minutes and add garlic.\tCook 2 minutes more and add chicken taco mix and cumin. Mix well set aside. In a blender add the rest of the onion and the can of enchilada sauce. Blend until fully mix. In Crock Pot-insert pour about 1/2 cup sauce on the bottom of the pan and begin building casserole. Start with sauce then put on tortilla then a layer of chicken mixture then a layer cheese. Repeat this pattern until finished. Pour the rest of the sauce evenly over the top and sprinkle a little cheese on the top just before serving. A Great dish if you are busy all day. If you dont have a Crock Pot you can cook this in a dish. Follow the same procedure except cook in the oven at 350\u00b0 until bubbling and casserole is completely hot. Hope you enjoy we have!

title: Hot Bean Salad
instructions: Brown salt pork in a large fry pan. Chop onion green pepper and celery; put in the pan. Add rest of ingredients. Heat slowly until hot stirring as needed to keep from sticking. Makes 6 servings.

title: Aunt Myrtles Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar chocolate milk and corn syrup. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring once in a while. Cover with lid and turn heat down for 3 minutes. Uncover and cook until it forms a soft ball in a cup of cold water about 10 minutes. When candy forms soft ball remove from heat and stir in 1/2 stick of butter or margarine. Stir just enough to melt butter. Let cool until able to touch bottom of pan. Add vanilla; beat well. Add nuts.

title: Curried Carrots And Pineapple
instructions: Drain pineapple syrup into measuring cup reserving pineapple chunks. Add enough water to syrup to make 1 cup liquid. Pour into medium skillet. Add carrot strips curry salt and pepper. Cover and cook over medium heat 10 minutes or until tender. Stir in pineapple chunks and cook covered a few minutes to heat through.

title: Almond Cream Chinese Dessert
instructions: Measure cold water into small bowl. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water. Let stand 1 minute. Add sugar to the mixture. Stir until gelatin dissolves. Pour boiling water into medium bowl. Stir in gelatin mixture. Combine milk vanilla and almond extract. Stir milk mixture into gelatin mixture. Divide mixture between four serving dishes. Refrigerate until set about 3 hours. Pare and slice kiwis. Arrange slices and strawberries over each dessert. Makes 4 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs. Place in a greased casserole dish and top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Yields 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in large bowl. Mix remaining ingredients and pour into center of dry ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Piquant Rutabaga
instructions: Steam rutabaga until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients and serve. Makes 4 servings. Makes 60 calories per serving.

title: Berry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine berries and cornstarch in medium bowl; toss lightly to coat. Add pourable fruit; mix well. Spoon into 1-1/2-quart or 8-inch square baking dish. In a medium bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Add milk butter and concentrate; mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Drop six heaping tablespoons of batter evenly over berries; sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake 25 minutes or until topping is golden brown and fruit is bubbly. Cool on wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature. Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Berry Pie
instructions: Just before serving fill crust with berries. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and top with whipped cream. Serve.

title: Oriental Turkey Bake
instructions: In 2-quart casserole mix soup water soy sauce green onions vegetables turkey and rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot. Stir and sprinkle French fried onions over turkey mixture. Bake for 5 minutes or until onions are golden.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Bake Jiffy cake as per directions in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Place drained pineapple on cake. Slice banana onto pineapple layer. Mix cream cheese with 1/2 cup milk. Using 2 1/2 cups milk add instant pudding and to that stir in cream cheese mixture. Spread pudding and cream cheese over banana layer. Top with Cool Whip and nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Perfect Corn Bread
instructions: Sift flour with sugar baking powder and salt; stir in corn meal. Add\teggs milk and shortening. Beat with rotary or electric beater until just smooth.\t(Do not overbeat.) Pour into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Raisin Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl and mix thoroughly. Beat eggs and whip oil and milk and applesauce. Add dry ingredients to liquid ingredients until moistened then add raisins and blend. Fill muffin tins greased or with papers 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from muffin tin immediately. You can freeze muffins for later use.

title: Fish Stroganoff
instructions: Cut fish in bite-size pieces. Mix flour salt and pepper. Coat each piece. In large frying pan cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon from pan and reserve. Cook onion and fish in bacon fat over medium heat until lightly browned. Reduce heat and mix in tomato juice mustard parsley and garlic powder. Simmer until sauce thickens slightly 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream. Serve over hot cooked rice or toast points. Crumble bacon and put on top of each serving. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts for 1 1/2 hours with 2 tablespoons of butter and salt. Let cool; debone and skin breasts. Save 1 1/2 cups of broth. Mix all 3 cans of soup with broth; mix well. Melt stick of margarine; add to stuffing until moist. Layer stuffing chicken then soup. Repeat until all is used. Top with stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix chicken 1 cup cheese 1 can soup 1/4 cup onion and sour cream. Spread on tortillas and roll up. Arrange in two layers in baking dish. Mix 1 can soup milk and 1 cup cheese. Pour over rolled tortillas covering thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Camper'S Stew
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. While warm add the French dressing and refrigerate until cool. Add remaining ingredients. Stir to mix. Cover and refrigerate several hours. More dressing may be needed.

title: Easy Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add milk. Spread in bottom of a baking pan. Spread 2 cups of unsweetened fresh cherries. Cover with 2 cups of sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until dough is done.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Precook broccoli until about done. Arrange in flat baking dish. Place cooked chicken cut into chunks on broccoli. Mix other ingredients (except potato chips) and spread over chicken and broccoli. Top with crumbs if you want. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. If this has been chilled it takes about 45 minutes to 1 hour to heat. Serve over rice.

title: Spaghetti, Ham And Eggs
instructions: Cook 8 ounces spaghetti in 4 quarts boiling salted water for 10 minutes until tender.

title: Candy Crunch
instructions: Melt chocolate. Mix in the pretzels and peanuts. Drop on waxed paper by teaspoon. Sets quickly. Make as large or small as you want.

title: Crescent Wrapped Apricot Gouda
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut Gouda round in half horizontally to form two circles; remove wax. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles. Firmly press perforations to seal. Press each into a 7 x 5-inch rectangle. Place the two rectangles 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Place Gouda circle in center of each rectangle. Spread 2 teaspoons of apricot preserves over each cheese round. Place remaining rectangles on top of each cheese round. Press dough around cheese to seal. Curl bottom edges over top edges gently stretching dough to form a ring of dough around cheese sealing it completely. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 10 minutes before serving. Makes 8 servings.

title: Salmon Salad
instructions: Drain salmon; remove skin and bones. Flake fish. Dice 2 of the eggs and add to fish. Add celery mayonnaise pickle and lemon juice. Mix.

title: Pat In Pan Pie Crust
instructions: In an 8-inch pie pan mix oil and milk. Add flour salt and sugar. Mix with fork then pat into pan to form an even crust layer.

title: Cinnamon Baked Apples
instructions: Remove thin circle of peel from top half of apple. Core. Place apples in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add water lemon juice and vanilla. Sprinkle apples with cinnamon and sugar substitute. Cook on High in microwave for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Black Bean Chili
instructions: Saute the onion red pepper chili oil and cumin over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the jalapenos and garlic and cook another minute. Add the tomatoes oregano and salt and cook over medium-low heat for about 20 minutes. Add the black beans and cook for another 20 to 30 minutes stirring occasionally. (Add a little water if necessary.) Add the cilantro and cook 5 minutes longer. Season to taste with lime juice and salt. Serve hot.

title: Mincemeat Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cream shortening with sugar then add egg and beat well. Add mincemeat vanilla and flour mixture and mix until well blended. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderately hot oven (375\u00b0) for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Baked Ham Slice With Apple Rings
instructions: Gash fat in ham slice to prevent curling. Mix brown sugar and spices; rub 1/4 of mixture into 1 side of ham. Put slice sugar side down in shallow baking dish. Peel and core apples; cut in 1/2-inch slices. Arrange around ham. Sprinkle apples and ham with remaining sugar mixture. Heat juice to boiling and pour over all.

title: Tyler Joe'S Ice Cream
instructions: Put ice cream in bowl. Cover top with lots of chocolate syrup. Let set until nearly melts. Take spoon and stir well. Take the straw and drink it up.

title: No-Fat Applesauce Bran Muffins
instructions: Stir together flour sugar and baking powder. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl combine cereal and milk. Let stand about 5 minutes. Add egg and applesauce. Beat well. Add flour mixture stirring only until combined. Put batter into muffin pans that have been coated with cooking spray. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yield 12 muffins.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add preserves and vanilla. Add dry and wet ingredients alternately beginning and ending with flour. Mix just enough to wet all of flour. Do not overbeat. Pour in well greased and well floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 1 1/2 hours. Cool on rack 15 minutes. Remove from pan and wrap in foil to keep moist.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together and put in a greased casserole (shallow). Cover top with layer of Swiss cheese (not the holey kind). Mix 1/2 cup Ritz cracker crumbs in slightly less than 1/2 cup melted butter and sprinkle over top. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chili
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Serves 10.

title: Party Mix
