instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in large roasting pan. Combine oil brown sugar Worcestershire and garlic salt. Pour over first 6 ingredients and toss to coat. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours stirring frequently.

title: Rice And Noodle Pilaf
instructions: Brown noodles in hot fat (Spry) stirring constantly. Add rice and remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes until all liquid is absorbed. Great with pork chops or chicken.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; cover and put in refrigerator until chilled. Remove from refrigerator and roll into 1 inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down each ball with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Yaki Soba
instructions: Chop shrimp and scallions. Cut pork chicken and beef into small strips. Heat wok with 2 tablespoons oil. Add shrimp pork chicken and beef. Stir-fry. Remove. To wok add water. Add noodles. Cook until soft (3 to 4 minutes). Add seasoning (from noodle package) the meat shrimp spinach and scallions. Cook 1 minute. Remove from heat. Serve hot. Serves 2 to 4. Amount of noodles in recipe may be doubled or tripled. If so add an additional 3/4 cup water for each package of noodles.

title: Apple Coconut Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to package directions for two crust pie using 9-inch pie pan.

title: Sandies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add water and vanilla. Mix well. Blend in flour and nuts. Chill for 4 hours. Shape in balls or fingers. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 about 20 minutes. Remove from pan; cool slightly. Roll in confectioners sugar. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Pour enough oil in a large pot to cover bottom. Brown pork and remove from pot. Add flour and brown. Add all ingredients. Stir well. Cover and simmer 1 hour.

title: Spinach Casserole(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Combine egg sour cream milk 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese onion salt and pepper; mix together. Add spinach and spaghetti and mix well. Put in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes more.

title: Baked Sauerkraut And Pork Chops
instructions: Mix everything but chops. Put in 9 x 12-inch pan. Lay chops on top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Cover with foil. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with mashed potatoes. Serves 4.

title: Easy Pineapple Cake
instructions: Beat egg well; add sugar and beat well again. Add crushed pineapple flour vanilla and baking soda. Bake at 350\u00b0 in jelly roll pan (10 x 13-inch).

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Blend in enough vegetable oil to get potatoes moist. Let stand. Add onion celery pickle juice and vinegar. Salt and pepper to taste. Keep and serve warm.

title: Baked Steak
instructions: Dredge meat in flour salt and pepper mixture. Brown slowly. Add remaining ingredients; simmer 5 minutes. Add onions. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 75 minutes.

title: Pinto Bean Casserole
instructions: Place oil onions and green pepper in frying pan to saute. Salt and pepper to taste. Take out of pan and place in a large bowl. Put ground beef in frying pan and brown; drain. Put this into the bowl. Add Lucks pinto beans (throw away the fat) and the tomato sauce to the bowl. Add hot sauce if desired. Let stand for 30 minutes. Place in casserole dish. Mix the Jiffy mix according to directions and pour on top of casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown about 20 minutes.

title: Savory Stuffed Peppers
instructions: In skillet over medium heat brown meat and onion; cook until done. Pour off drippings. Stir in corn tomato sauce rice steak sauce and pepper. Cut tops off green peppers and stuff; arrange in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice according to directions. Cook and drain broccoli. Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart casserole or baking pan. Top with onion rings. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion; drain well and mash. Add other ingredients. Put in 2-quart casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lo-Cal Fruited Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place chicken in 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix orange peel juice onion and bouillon granules. Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and paprika. Pour orange juice mixture over chicken. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Ladyfingers
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a large cookie sheet. Beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form. Add sugar gradually beating well after each addition. Beat until stiff and glossy. Beat egg yolks and vanilla until thick and lemon colored. Add to egg whites and fold in gently but quickly. Fold in flour. Press through a pastry tube or cookie press with large plain tip into strips 2 1/2 inches long onto prepared cookie sheet. (If you dont have a pastry tube or cookie press shape rounded teaspoonfuls of batter into strips.) Bake 8-10 minutes or until set and very lightly browned on the bottom. remove from sheets and cool on racks. Store in tightly closed tin box. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Mix thoroughly and boil 5 minutes stirring constantly.

title: Chewy Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan or microwave. In mixing bowl add margarine and brown sugar; mix well. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add flour and nuts; mix well. Add vanilla; mix well. Put in greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tomato Catsup
instructions: Boil tomatoes until soft; strain through a sieve. Add vinegar sugar cayenne pepper black pepper cloves mustard and salt. Boil down until it is 1/4 of its bulk and add cinnamon. Bottle seal and process. Makes 4 to 5 pints.

title: Health Food Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar cocoa milk and butter together over medium heat for one minute. Add cereal peanut butter and vanilla. Stir fast. Drop on waxed paper to harden.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in blender. Blend on high until well mixed. Add sugar and blend again. Add ice cubes three at a time and blend on high until completely crushed. Pour into cups and serve immediately. Makes 6 cups.

title: Perfect Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter oil sugar and powdered sugar together; add vanilla baking soda cream of tartar eggs and salt. Mix well. Add flour 1 cup at a time. Chill for 4 hours. Shape into balls roll in sugar then flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes or until light brown on bottom.

title: Broccoli For Brunch(Microwave)
instructions: Cook broccoli in microwave as directed on package or on High setting (for fresh) until tender. Add margarine salt and orange juice and heat in microwave until margarine is melted. Top with toasted slivered almonds.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: In small bowl beat together egg white and water. Stir in pecans stirring until all surfaces are moistened. Mix together sugar and remaining ingredients sprinkle over pecans and mix well to coat all sides. Spread on lightly greased or foil-lined cookie sheet and bake in preheated oven at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir about halfway through baking time to assure crispness and even drying.

title: No-Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar milk and margarine. Bring to a boil while stirring. Remove from heat; mix in the chips. Stir and melt. Add the oatmeal and mix well. Drop dough from spoon onto a waxed paper lined tray. When cooled they are ready to enjoy.

title: Dreamy Fruit Dip
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Beat in marshmallow cream. Fold in whipped topping. Serve with fruit. Store in refrigerator. Yield about 4 cups.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in casserole bowl. Top with 1 roll of Hi Ho or Ritz cracker crumbs (35 crackers) 1/2 cup slivered almonds and 1/2 cup margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Grandmother'S Pineapple Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and pale yellow. Beat or fold in Mascarpone until thoroughly incorporated. Mixture should be completely smooth. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into Mascarpone mixture. Combine Espresso and brandy. Dip ladyfingers very quickly into coffee-brandy mixture one at a time and line the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch rectangular dish. Spread half of the Mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers and sprinkle with powdered cocoa. Dip more ladyfingers into the Espresso-brandy and make another layer. Cover with Mascarpone and sprinkle with cocoa. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Just before serving peel some chocolate into curls with a carrot peeler and sprinkle over the cake.

title: Good Meatballs
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Let stand 1/2 hour. Shape into medium-size meatballs. Fry gently in oil until slightly browned or place on foil-covered cookie sheet for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Gently place in your own hot spaghetti sauce and cook on medium-low heat for 1 hour.

title: Stay Soft Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Blend together cocoa cornstarch and sugar. Add milk a little at a time. Cook slowly until thickened. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and butter. Stir gently until cool and thick enough to spread. This will frost 2 layers.

title: Turkey Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and rinse. Place in a 2 1/2-quart salad bowl. Add turkey celery onion and green pepper. Toss to mix. Combine dressing mix sour cream salad dressing and garlic salt. Add to pasta mixture and mix well. Sprinkle with almonds and paprika. Garnish with pepper ring and tomato slice if desired. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Grandma Mary'S Barbecue Beef
instructions: Brown meat. Add onion salt pepper and water. Cover and simmer approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Banana Fudge Walnut Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of an 8-inch square pan. Melt in 2-quart saucepan over low heat stirring constantly the butter and chocolate chips. Beat in thoroughly with spoon the rest of the ingredients. Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake about 30 minutes or until center is set. Cool completely. Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Alfredo
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Add broccoli for last 4 min. of cooking time. Drain.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding with pineapple. Save about 2 tablespoons for dissolving gelatin. Add nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Dissolve gelatin in pineapple juice. Mix into salad. Chill.

title: Amaretto Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup. Level with a knife. Combine flour and sugar in bowl; cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture is crumbly. Add almonds; toss well. Combine apple and Amaretto in a bowl. TOSS WELL. Spoon apple mixture into an 8-inch square baking dish or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with crumb mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Last-Time-Ever-I-Saw-My-Waist Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare and bake mix using package directions for a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Mix cream cheese and whipped topping in a bowl. Spread over cooled cake. Combine pudding mix and milk in a bowl. Mix well. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining 8 ounces whipped topping. Chill until serving time. Yields 18 to 20 servings.

title: Memoo'S Tomato Aspic
instructions: Boil water. Add to gelatin. Stir until dissolves. Add tomato sauce and vinegar; stir. Chill slightly. Add vegetables. Pour into individual serving dishes or 8 x 9-inch pan. Chill until set. Serve over bed of lettuce.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Cook ground beef and drain. Add sauce. Cook noodles. Blend eggs Ricotta and 1 cup Parmesan. Alternate layers starting with meat sauce noodles Ricotta mixture and meat mixture. Repeat. End with noodle layer. Top with Mozzarella cheese and remaining Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 bread loaf pans.

title: Pizza Margherita
instructions: Brush the dough or crust with a little olive oil to the edge. Spread tomato sauce over the dough to within 1/2-inch of the edge. Distribute Mozzarella slices over the tomato sauce and season with pepper. Arrange basil leaves over the Mozzarella reserving a few garnish if you wish. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Drizzle with the remaining olive oil. Carefully slide the pizza in the oven and bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until the bottom if crisp and browned and the top is bubbling. Garnish with the reserved basil leaves if desired. Yield one 12-inch pizza.

title: Best Ever Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars butter oil and egg together. When well blended add sifted flour soda salt and cream of tartar. Blend well then add oatmeal nuts coconut and Rice Krispies stirring just enough with a wooden spoon to mix. Drop by small spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Carrot Pecan Cake
instructions: Combine oil and sugar. Mix well. Sift together dry ingredients. Sift 1/2 dry ingredients into sugar-oil mixture. Blend well. Sift in remaining dry ingredients alternately with eggs one at a time. Mix well after each addition. Add carrots and mix well. Add nuts last. Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. After cool at least 10 minutes in pan. Remove from pan and finish cooling. Can sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Brown the meat with the onion. Mix together all ingredients except the noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Add noodles. Mix 3/4 into the casserole and spread the rest evenly over the top. Bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Chicken Picante
instructions: In large bowl combine taco sauce mustard and lime juice; mix well. Add chicken turning to coat; marinate for 30 minutes. In large heavy skillet melt butter until foamy. Remove chicken from marinade; fry until browned on all sides turning frequently. Add remaining marinade; cook about 5 minutes longer until chicken is fork-tender. Remove chicken boil marinade 1 minute and spoon over chicken. Place 1 tablespoon sour cream on top of each piece; top with lime segment.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: In a large soup kettle melt the butter. Stir in flour; heat and stir until smooth. Gradually add milk stirring constantly until thickened. Add potatoes and onions. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat; simmer for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; stir until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Chunky Chocolate Chip Brownie-Type Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream shortening sugars eggs and vanilla together. Blend in chocolate chips. Gradually add in flour on medium speed of mixer. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool for 25 minutes then cut into squares.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In large bowl mix first seven ingredients. Add eggs water and pumpkin. Beat thoroughly. Pour into 1 pound coffee cans filling cans about halfway. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle 2
instructions: Vegetables butter beans peas squash corn any vegetable you would freeze.

title: Corn Bread(Egg-Free And Milk-Free)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and beat well. Bake in a greased and floured 8-inch cake pan for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Beat egg in medium bowl. Mix in bread crumbs chili sauce salt onion garlic powder ground beef and celery. Shape into 30 small balls about 1-inch in diameter. Melt Crisco in large skillet on medium heat. Add meatballs and brown on all sides. Continue cooking until done about 12 minutes including browning. Warm barbecue sauce while meatballs cook. Serve meatballs on wooden picks to be dipped in warm sauce.

title: Cake, Jello And Pudding Dessert
instructions: Slice cake and place on bottom of 9x13 pan. Prepare Jello and pour over cake. Chill until set. Slice bananas over cake and Jello. Prepare pudding. Spread over bananas. Let set 5-10 minutes in refrigerator. Spread Cool Whip over pudding. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Soup Hash
instructions: In a large soup pot cook roast. When done remove roast and add diced onion celery and cubed potatoes to broth. When potatoes are almost done add soups. In the meantime shred up roast and add to pot. Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well (until all cream cheese is worked in). Place on plate form ball and refrigerate. Can be rolled in chopped nuts or parsley before serving.

title: Four Minute Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and beat to stiff peaks 4 minutes over boiling water. Sprinkle chopped nuts over top if you like.

title: Emily'S Mussels In Wine
instructions: With a stiff brush scrub mussels with running cold water to remove sand or beards. In a 5-quart Dutch oven or saucepot over medium heat in hot oil cook onion and garlic until tender. Stir in tomatoes with their liquid wine and basil. Then heat to a boil over high heat. Add mussels and once again heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer stirring occasionally until mussels open about 5 minutes. Serve with bread and salad.

title: Mud Pie Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar cocoa powder salt and baking soda. Add water oil egg vinegar and vanilla and pour in a large 8 x 14-inch cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Black Bottom Cake
instructions: Combine cream cheese unbeaten egg 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Blend well then add chocolate chips. Set aside. Sift together flour 1 cup sugar cocoa soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Then add water oil vinegar and vanilla. Beat well. Put chocolate mixture in greased pan and then spread cheese mix evenly over the top. Sprinkle with nuts and brown sugar. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together mixing well. Pour into greased (only) muffin pan. Mix 1 tsp. of cinnamon and sugar. Sprinkle on top of muffins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 min.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix well. Bake in a large skillet or muffin pan sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Never-Fail Meringue
instructions: Blend cornstarch and cold water; add boiling water and stir until thick and clear. Beat egg whites until foamy add sugar then beat until stiff but not dry. Add salt vanilla and cornstarch mixture\tand beat well.\tSpread on pie and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Bake pie crusts for 10 to 12 minutes. Mix dry ingredients. Mix into the pumpkin. Add eggs and milk. Mix with spoon. Pour 1/2 into each crust. Be careful not to overfill or to get mix on edges of pie crust. Bake 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Check after 30 minutes. Can freeze 1/2 of mixture and bake it later.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine first three ingredients and then add milk. Fold in the Cool Whip and nuts. Pour into a prepared graham cracker crust and freeze overnight. Just before serving remove from the freezer and let stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes.

title: Classic Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine soup milk and pepper in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Mix well. Stir in beans and half of the onions. Bake 10 minutes; stir. Sprinkle casserole with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes or until hot and onions are golden.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Pour spaghetti sauce into hamburger. Mix well. Pour in baking dish. Mix cream potatoes as directed on box and layer on top of hamburger mixture. You can sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Work first 6 ingredients together real good. Make a hole in flour then add buttermilk (enough to take up all the flour but enough to knead a little bit). Then put out on pastry sheet. Knead just enough to flatten with hand. Dont overwork. Then cut and bake at 425\u00b0 until light brown. When taken from oven put butter on top and cover for 6 minutes. Serve.

title: Cream Cheese Party Mints
instructions: Mix ingredients well by hand. Add desired color. Take a small piece dip in sugar and press in plastic mold. Drop out of mold onto waxed paper. Let dry for a while before putting in covered container. Can be frozen in airtight container for later use.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Mix bouillon cubes water onion celery and potatoes together. Cover and cook 20 to 30 minutes. Add remaining vegetables and cook until tender. Add cream of chicken soup and 1 cup water. Add Velveeta cheese and cook slowly until all cheese is melted. Sprinkle in bacon crumbs.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar blend in eggs. Add milk and vanilla. Mix real good add dry ingredients. Mix in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon full on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Chocolate Nut Pie
instructions: Layer the bottom of the unbaked pie shells with the nuts. Then mix all the ingredients and pour onto the pecans in the pie shell. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. The edges will become firm and the middle will look soft but it will thicken when it cools.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Use a 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Quarter cabbage and cut off core. Boil over medium heat in salted water until tender. (Do not overcook.) Pour into colander and cool. Mix all dry ingredients. Place cabbage leaves on chopping board and cut out middle stem. Make layers of cabbage leaves dry mixture and drizzle 1/4 cup olive oil. Continue making layers ending with dry ingredients and olive oil. (Make 4 layers.) Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be made the day before placed in refrigerator and when cold cut into squares. When ready to serve warm in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Can be eaten cold.

title: Spanish Rice With Turkey
instructions: Cook turkey onions and pepper until done stirring constantly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 4. Counts as 3 proteins vegetable and 1 bread.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat 1 minute after each egg. Add dry ingredients along with milk and flavoring. Cook in tube pan 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Put asparagus in casserole. Spread mushrooms on top of asparagus. Sprinkle cheese over soup. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake until cheese melts.

title: Becky'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil to small ball stage in 3-quart pan. Beat with mixer until mixture cools a little. (Starts to cool to side of pan somewhat.) Add nuts (optional). Pour into an 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan if recipe is doubled.

title: Holiday Eggnog Punch
instructions: Mix ice cream eggnog and Seven-Up in large container or punch bowl. Ice cream need not be completely blended in. Serve with a candy cane for stirring. Yields 24 servings.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place Canadian bacon in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Place a chicken breast on each piece of Canadian bacon and top with a 1/2 slice of bacon. Bake for 1/2 hour uncovered at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and cover with mushroom soup and sour cream mixed together. Bake for 30 minutes more at 350\u00b0. Serve with chopped green onions.

title: Frittata
instructions: Heat oil in large frying pan or Dutch oven. Add vegetables mushrooms garlic and bell pepper. Stir cover and cook for 3 minutes. In a bowl combine meat eggs salt and pepper and cheese. Stir into the vegetable mixture. Pour into a 3-quart casserole dish and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with Parmesan cheese and bake for 5 minutes longer. Yield 4 to 5 servings.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry cake mix nuts and melted butter. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Serve with ice cream whipped cream or serve with warm coffee cream.

title: Vegetarian Vegetable Soup(Stone Soup)
instructions: Wash and cut vegetables. Heat butter in skillet. Add onions and celery and simmer until soft. Remove from heat; slowly add 3 quarts of boiling water. Add seasonings and vegetables macaroni and rice; boil until vegetables are tender (about 20 or 30 minutes). Add tomato soup; heat. Add more water if needed.

title: Crock-Pot Brunswick Stew
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add remaining ingredients with beef and put in crock-pot. Cook 4 to 6 hours.

title: Grandma'S Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into a prepared unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Have oven preheated to 450\u00b0. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake another 25 minutes or until custard is mostly set and crust is browned.

title: Pasta And Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Break the cauliflower into its flowerets cutting the bigger ones in halves or quarters so that all the pieces are about 1/2-inch in size. Put the oil in a soup pot along with the garlic salt pepper and the cut-up cauliflower. Stirring gently cook over medium heat until the vegetable bits are well oiled and flavored. Add the tomato paste hot water the potato slices and 2 teaspoons salt and bring to a boil. Break the pasta into 1 or 2-inch lengths as you put it in the pot. Continue boiling until the pasta is well cooked has absorbed some of the water and the cauliflower garlic and tomato have lent their flavors to the pasta. Before serving discard the garlic clove. Serve with a sprinkling of Parmesan cheese.

title: Asparagus Ham Dinner
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile in a non-stick skillet; saute asparagus yellow and red bell peppers in oil until tender. Add tomatoes and ham; heat thoroughly. Drain pasta add to vegetable mixture. Stir in seasonings. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

title: Ground Beef-Noodle Casserole
instructions: In one bowl mix cream cheese cottage cheese and sour cream. Cook noodles. Alternate noodles and cheese mixture in a 13 x 9-inch casserole.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cook sugar and syrup until mixture thickens (cook just a little more than soft ball stage on a candy thermometer). Beat eggs without separating and slowly add eggs to hot syrup beating constantly. Add butter vanilla and nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell; bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In 4 cup glass measuring cup combine sugar and corn syrup. Cook on High for 4 minutes. Add peanuts and cook 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla; cook 1 minute. Quickly fold in baking soda. Spread on greased cookie sheet to cool. Break into pieces.

title: Citrus Sunshine Punch
instructions: Dissolve orange juice lemonade limeade and water together; add ginger ale and serve.

title: Chicken Adobo
instructions: Combine chicken water vinegar bay leaf garlic pepper and soy sauce in a medium to large saucepan. Bring to a boil; cover and lower heat. Cook until chicken is done and a small amount of broth is left. Add the oil and brown the contents of the pan if desired. (Cooking time is 45 to 60 minutes average.) Serve over rice.

title: Easy Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together in a large bowl (large enough to hold all ingredients). Mix dry jello into Cool Whip in Cool Whip container. Then fold into 1st mixture.

title: Sensational Spud Soup
instructions: Add soup milk and seasonings to potatoes and water. Serve with bacon sprinkled on top. Heat but do not boil.

title: Instant Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in sealed jar. To serve add 2 teaspoons to a cup of boiling water.

title: Potato Doughnuts
instructions: Add melted butter to sugar. Add eggs and mashed potatoes. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk. I refrigerate these for several hours (even overnight). Roll 1/2-inch thick; cut and deep fry.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Heat sugar vinegar and oil until sugar is dissolved and pour over kraut mixture. Refrigerate. The longer it sets the better it tastes.

title: Chocolate Turtle Pie
instructions: Spread caramel topping on bottom of crust. Sprinkle with pecans. Refrigerate. Stir pudding mixes into milk in medium saucepan. Stirring constantly cook on medium heat until mixture comes to full boil. Remove from heat. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Pour into crust. Place plastic wrap on surface of filling. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set. Garnish with Cool Whip. Store leftover pie in refrigerator. Makes 8 servings.

title: Easy Cheesecake
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers; add butter. Press into a 13 x 9 inch pan. Melt in microwave for 1-1/2 minutes; marshmallows and orange juice. Add cream cheese and cool whip. Pour into crust. You may top with cherries.

title: Vegetarian Lasagna
instructions: Place noodles in a pot of boiling salt water and cook 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Prepare spinach from package. Saute onion in oil until soft. Add carrots and mushrooms. Cook until crisp and tender. Stir in tomato sauce tomato paste olives and oregano. Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole. Layer in one-half each of noodles cottage cheese spinach sauce mixture and 1/3 of the cheese slices. Repeat. Place remaining third of Monterey Jack on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine the boiling water and Jell-O. When congealed add the salad dressing immediately. Beat until double. Blend into the Jell-O mixture the cottage cheese onion celery and salt and pepper. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Cranberry Nut Salad
instructions: Mix gelatins in large bowl; add hot water stirring until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into lightly greased 6-cup mold. Chill until firm. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Nut Roll
instructions: Cut shortening and flour as you do for pie dough. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add eggs sugar salt and sour cream. Mix and add with flour and shortening. Refrigerate overnight.

title: No-Rise Yeast Rolls
instructions: Place yeast in warm water. Cream sugar with melted butter in large bowl. Add beaten egg. Add dissolved yeast to creamed mixture then add flour and stir until mixed. Bake by dropping spoonfuls into well-greased muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. The batter does not need to rise to bake or to refrigerate. Place in airtight bowl and keep refrigerated. Will last several days. Use as needed.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo in heavy skillet; add rest of ingredients except Rice Krispies and coconut. Stir constantly over medium heat until thick. Remove from heat and cool. Add Rice Krispies; make into small balls and roll in coconut. \A favorite holiday treat of ours!\

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Grate coon cheese. Mix uncooked sausage cheese and Bisquick well. Add red pepper if you wish.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Pour vanilla pudding powder over fruit. Let sit overnight. Add cut up bananas before serving.

title: Bacon-Pineapple Appetizer
instructions: Soak ingredients for 2 to 3 hours. Wrap pineapple in 1/2 slice bacon. Microwave 1 minute turning as needed until done. Use lean bacon for best results.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Stir to separate meat; add taco season. Layer beans peppers chips and meat mix ending with cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fritter Batter
instructions: Beat eggs and milk in medium bowl until well blended. Stir in flour baking powder and salt. Add oil and mix. Cut up fruit or vegetables. Add to or dip into batter. Drop into hot deep fat (375\u00b0) and fry until brown. Do not crowd. Drain on paper towels.

title: Microwave Divinity
instructions: Mix together sugar corn syrup water and salt in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cook in microwave on Full power for 20 to 22 minutes. Stir once or twice during cooking. While syrup is cooking beat egg whites until stiff peaks form in large mixing bowl. Gradually pour hot syrup over egg whites while beating at high speed. Continue beating until mixture thickens and candy starts to lose its gloss. Beating may require about 12 minutes. Add vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper. Makes about 6 to 7 dozen pieces.

title: Layered Sandwich
instructions: Slice 3/4-inch layer off top (the lid) of bread. Hollow out loaf leaving 1/2-inch thick bread shell. Brush inside of loaf and underside of lid with salad dressing. Layer half the lettuce meat Mozzarella meat tomatoes meat Cheddar cheese and remaining lettuce. Firmly pack down and replace the lid. Cut sandwich in wedges to serve. Wrap unsliced loaf well and refrigerate. Try adding onions mushrooms and peppers.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Combine mayonnaise flour eggs and milk until blended. Stir in crabmeat Swiss and onions. Pour mixture into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: In casserole bottom melt margarine. Pour in some favorite stuffing mix. Save some for top. Add zucchini chunks and carrots. Mix sour cream cream of celery soup and chopped onion. Pour over zucchini and carrots. Top with remaining stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Buffet Cheese-Scalloped Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in small amount of water for 10 minutes and drain. Cook onion in butter for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Southern Chili
instructions: Saute chuck sausage onions green pepper and garlic; drain. Add all other ingredients and cook at least 3 hours. Never allow it to boil. Serve with sour cream and Southern corn bread.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Put Wesson oil and crackers in Ziploc bag and shake to coat. Mix dressing with dill weed and add to bag. Shake to coat. Pour out on paper towel to drain. Store in plastic container.

title: Chocolate Town Special Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9-inch layer cake pans. Cream the sugar and shortening together until creamy and light. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add vanilla; sift together with baking soda and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk. Make a heavy smooth paste of the cocoa and boiling water. Cool slightly. Add and blend well. Pour into pans and bake for about 35 minutes or until done.

title: Canned Okra
instructions: Put ingredients in a large pan and boil 10 minutes. Put in jars and seal. For fried okra rinse thoroughly. Roll in meal and fry as you would any fried okra.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a cookie sheet with margarine. Let dough thaw and rise until double in size. Roll dough out flat. Beat eggs; add oregano and Parmesan cheese. Spread 3/4 egg mixture all over flattened dough. Top with shredded cheese and pepperoni slices. Roll up like a jelly roll; seal edges and ends (be sure they are sealed). Place on greased pan and spread rest of egg mixture over top. Bake 30 minutes or until brown. While hot brush with margarine on top and sides. Serve hot.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Peel core and slice apples and place in a baking dish. Mix flour oats and sugar. Melt oleo and mix with dry. Spread mixture over apples. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Leah'S Pound Cake
instructions: Beat until creamy oleo and sugar. Add flour and eggs alternately. Add salt mace lemon juice and grated lemon rind. Mix. Pour in greased and floured angel food cake pan. Bake two hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Turkey Carcass Soup
instructions: Combine the turkey carcass water poultry seasoning and thyme in large pot. Bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes.

title: Glazed Chicken And Grapes
instructions: Wash chicken and pat dry. Spray a cold large skillet with nonstick spray coating. Heat skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken to skillet. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until no longer pink turning once during cooking. Transfer chicken to serving plates. Cover to keep warm.

title: Easy Caramel Icing
instructions: Melt oleo in saucepan. Add sugar and milk stirring well. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly. Cook until it spins a thread. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread on cake.

title: Oatmeal Hurry-Ups
instructions: In a saucepan combine cocoa and sugar. Add milk and margarine; cook over low to moderate heat stirring constantly until margarine is melted and mixture comes to a boil. Continue boiling two minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in oatmeal and peanut butter. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto wax paper. Allow cookies to set; store in covered container. Makes about 45 cookies each with 93 calories 4.25 g fat and .88 mg cholesterol.

title: Maple Hot Chocolate
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar cocoa and salt. Stir in hot water and butter bring to a boil. Add the milk maple flavoring vanilla and 8 marshmallows. Heat through stirring occasionally until marshmallows are melted. Ladle into mugs and top each with a marshmallow. Yields 4 servings.

title: Brad'S Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil pasta and drain. Add pepperoni olives green peppers and onion. Add dressings and mix well. Let chill for about one hour before serving. I prefer to let set overnight.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix milk lemon juice and pineapple. Fold in pecans and Cool Whip. Pour into crusts. Chill overnight.

title: Texas Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in oil until clear. Add remaining ingredients and simmer over low heat 20 to 30 minutes until desired thickness. Keeps up to 1 month in refrigerator.

title: Bagna Cauda(Garlic, Oil And Anchovy Sauce)
instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan and add the garlic. Cook briefly stirring without browning. Add the wine and cook until reduced by half. Add the butter a little at a time beating rapidly with a wire whisk. Stir in the anchovy season with pepper and serve hot. Yield about 3/4 cup.

title: Babe Ruth Bars
instructions: Mix brown sugar white sugar and corn syrup in a large pan; bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Immediately add peanut butter. Stir until peanut butter is dissolved. Add corn flakes and peanuts. Stir until well coated.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken 1 1/4 hours with 1-inch water covering them. Cool; debone chicken. Place chicken in large buttered casserole dish. Mix 3 soups and pour over chicken. Place finely chopped onion over this. Add stuffing. Slowly drip batter over this; add broth from chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. This is a meal in itself.

title: Chili Con Queso Dip
instructions: Saute bacon until crisp drain well. Saute garlic and onions until wilted and add tomatoes. Stir and cook until liquid is reduced by 1/2 approximately 1 hour. Pour into chafing dish add bacon and cheese. Serve when the cheese has melted. Keep warm for dipping with Fritos or Doritos.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Heat together 6 cups water and 4 cups sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all together. Freeze. When ready to serve remove and break up with fork until mixture is like mush. Add 3 quarts ginger ale. Serves 40 to 50.

title: Townsend Ice Cream
instructions: You will need a 1 gallon freezer.

title: Old Family Recipe Cake
instructions: Slice angel food cake crossways into three parts. Spread layers with apricot jam and stack. Cover entire cake with Cool Whip. Garnish top of cake with peach slices. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Taco Frijoles Para Los Ninos(Bean Taco For The Little Ones)
instructions: Place chips on bottom of individual serving bowls. Place beans in individual bowls. Top with lettuce cheese and onion. Sprinkle with salsa pequin if desired. Serve hot. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs onion milk egg parsley salt Worcestershire sauce and pepper; gently shape into 1-inch balls (a meatball scoop can be used). Cook meatballs in shortening in 12-inch skillet until brown. Remove meatballs from skillet; drain fat. Heat chili sauce and jelly in skillet stirring constantly until jelly is melted. Add meatballs and stir until coated. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Serve hot in chafing dish.

title: Crispy Fried Okra
instructions: Wash okra and drain well. Remove tip and stem. Cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Add egg to okra and toss to coat. Combine cornmeal salt and pepper. Dredge okra. Deep fry in hot oil at 375\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Deviled Clam Dip
instructions: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature. Add juice from minced clams until mixture is the right consistency. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Blackberry Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and bring to a boil in a deep dish pie pan. Work Crisco into the flour as if making biscuits. Then work in the iced water making a dough for dumplings and crust. Flour the board and roll the dough out with rolling pin. Roll thin then cut in 1-inch strips all across the board. Have the berries boiling and drop dumplings all across the pan dipping the juice over the dumplings and making sure to cover good. Then roll a top crust while berries are still boiling. Place cover on pie. Cover the top with butter and then sugar. Place in oven and brown the top being careful to not let burn.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: 1st Layer Mix and press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until very light brown. Cool.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cheeses to room temperature; blend well. Mix with paprika. Cover and refrigerate until firm enough to mold into a ball. Roll in finely chopped nuts. Cover and refrigerate until needed.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Mix barbecue sauce and jelly; dissolve over medium heat. Once sauce is dissolved cut wieners into small pieces and add to the sauce. Cook slow until wieners are done. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Pea Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the cubed potatoes peas and onions and Italian dressing. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 15 minutes until vegetables are tender. Stir in sour cream; blend well. Serve warm garnished with fresh mint.

title: Plum Cake
instructions: Beat eggs then add remaining ingredients. Beat until well blended. Pour into a tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Braised Beef Tips
instructions: Melt shortening in large skillet; brown meat on all sides. Stir in consomme wine soy sauce garlic and onion salt. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 1 hour or until meat is tender. Blend cornstarch and water; stir gradually into meat mixture. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Stollen
instructions: Heat milk to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast. Mix together first 6 ingredients. Let rise until double in bulk. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead in remaining 5 ingredients. Set aside 1/3 of the dough. Divide remaining dough in three equal parts and roll each in a strip about 12 inches long. Braid. Put on greased baking sheet.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix all together until blended; pour in greased baking dish. Crumble 1 sleeve Ritz crackers for top. Melt 1 stick butter and drizzle over mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut buttered bread into crouton size pieces. Stir eggs and milk together in a large bowl. Mix all the remaining ingredients in with milk and egg mixture. Pour into a buttered (or spray with Pam) 9 1/2 x 11-inch baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Grate cheese; add margarine at room temperature. Cream in mixer to consistency of shortening for cake. Gradually add flour salt and pepper. Use star plate or cookie press to shape. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add 7-Up. Chill until thickens. Drain pineapple juice (save). Fold pineapple marshmallows and bananas in jello. Put in pan. Chill until firm.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix by hand! Line 13-inch greased pan with wax paper (a must). Pour in cake batter and bake for 1 hour in 350\u00b0 preheated oven. Turn out on board and pull wax paper away from cake.

title: Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Place all ingredients (except Bisquick oil and milk) in crock-pot for 5 to 6 hours on low. Drain thoroughly in colander. Save and cool liquid. Debone chicken and cut into small pieces. Thicken liquid with flour and water paste. Add chicken and vegetables. Pour into oblong baking dish. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Make biscuits with Bisquick oil and milk. (Knead 2 minutes then cut.) Place on top of chicken and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Honey Fruit Compote
instructions: In large bowl combine pineapple chunks mandarin oranges grapes and kiwi slices. Set fruit aside. Add water to reserved pineapple juice to make 1 cup liquid and combine with orange juice honey and lemon juice. Pour over fruit mixture. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Mix the wine butter and garlic together and pour over the shrimp. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley flakes. Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 6 to 7 minutes. Be careful not to overcook the shrimp. The shrimp is done when it turns pink.

title: Irish Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets; cool. Peel potatoes and grate. Mix with other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: French Stew
instructions: Mix all together. Put in a large roaster. Cover and bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Wash and bake sweet potatoes until almost fork-tender (about 45 to 50 minutes). Cool. Scoop potatoes out of skins and mash there should be about 2 cups. Mix potatoes and remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife inserted in center comes out clean (50 minutes). Garnish with whipped cream. Makes 1 (9-inch) pie; preparation time 45 minutes; cooking time 1 1/2 hours.

title: Triple Good Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. In medium saucepan combine the first 4 ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Set aside.

title: Anise Toast
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add anise flavoring. Sift together flour and baking powder gradually. Add to butter-egg mixture. Flour board and knead dough. Shape into large loaf divided into thirds. Roll each in small amount of flour. Form into loaves pat and shape. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Slice. Put on cookie sheet. Bake an additional 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Christmas Treats
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate. Add sugar and milk. Keep heating and stirring until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat. Stir in oats nuts and vanilla. Allow mixture to cool to medium warm. Roll teaspoonfuls into balls. Place on waxed paper lined cookie sheets. Chill until firm. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Hamburger Goulash
instructions: Mix hamburger salt and onion in pan. Saute until brown. Add cubed potatoes mixed vegetables and tomato sauce. Cook for 45 minutes. Stir often.

title: Chicken Croquettes
instructions: In a medium to large saucepan melt 1/4 stick butter or margarine and stir in 1/4 cup flour until smooth. Add 1 cup milk and stir at a low boil until thickened and leaves sides of pan (about 2 minutes). Remove pan from burner. Add to this white sauce the chicken onion 1 egg 1/2 cup fine bread crumbs parsley poultry seasoning salt and pepper. Blend well. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Chopstick Tuna
instructions: Combine soup and 1/4 cup water. Add 1 cup noodles tuna celery cashews and onion; toss lightly. Place in ungreased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle remaining noodles over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Pineapple Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix the first 2 items and let stand overnight.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients (except marshmallow cream) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread marshmallow cream on cake as soon as you take from oven. Drizzle frosting over marshmallow cream. Cool and cut into small pieces. Very rich.

title: White Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar oleo salt and milk. Bring to a full boil (rolling) and boil over low heat for a full five minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add melted chocolate and Marshmallow Creme. Add nuts and vanilla; stir until well mixed. Pour in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Cool for several hours. (Melt chocolate slowly; it burns easily. Use heavy pan.)

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain vegetables. Mix all ingredients and put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with mixture of 1/2 cup melted butter or margarine and crushed Ritz crackers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Fold package of dry jello into cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Add crushed pineapple or fruit cocktail and mandarin oranges. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown meat and spices; drain. Add tomato sauce paste and sugar. Simmer about 1 hour on low.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Chop chicken into small pieces. Crush chips. Add all other ingredients except cheese. Mix together; pour into baking dish. Top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted good. (Can use Velveeta cheese.)

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar butter baking soda and salt in large bowl. Make a well in the center and add egg and buttermilk. Mix well. Blend in caraway seed and currants. Knead until smooth 2 to 3 minutes. Form into 2 round balls and place on buttered cookie sheet. Brush with beaten egg. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until well browned. Cool before cutting.

title: Sweet Party Mix
instructions: Mix sugar oleo and syrup in heavy saucepan and bring to a boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add baking soda and vanilla. Stir. Pour over cereal in a large bowl. Mix well to coat cereal.

title: Oyster Cracker Do
instructions: Pour oil over crackers and mix well. Blend dry ingredients and mix with crackers. Put in airtight container and refrigerate overnight.

title: Grandma Ella'S Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bottom of unbaked pie shell sprinkle 2 tablespoons flour and then sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar. On top of this arrange the finely sliced apples. Pour on top 3/4 cup sugar. Then sprinkle with cinnamon. Over this pour sweet cream. Then dot with butter. Bake for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Blend condensed milk milk and water. Add peach pulp and lemon juice. Freeze. This makes 2 quarts.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients into large bowl. Stir in mayonnaise. Gradually stir in water and vanilla until smooth and blended. (Batter will be thin.) Pour into prepared pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; salt to taste. Let cool. Skin and bone it and cut it into chunks.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Saute onion. In oblong baking dish mix tuna onion and pepper. Pour in soup and water. Cook noodles until tender. Drain and add to tuna mixture. Top with crumbled bread and shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Onion Dish Salad
instructions: Place sliced onions in bowl. Boil next 4 ingredients and pour over onions. Soak overnight. Drain well and add 1 1/2 cups salad dressing and 2 teaspoons celery seed. Chill several hours.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix(100 Cups)
instructions: Mix ingredients in large container. Store in dry place. For each cup of hot chocolate mix 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup hot water.

title: Jubilee Jumbles
instructions: Mix well shortening sugars and eggs. Stir in milk and vanilla. Sift flour soda and salt together. Combine with sugar mixture. Blend in nuts. Chill 1 hour. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Frost with browned butter frosting.

title: Orange Jello Delight
instructions: Add 3 cups boiling water to Jell-O. Mix well. Add orange juice concentrate. Add pineapple and oranges. Mix. Put in refrigerator and let set up. Mix pudding (dry) with Cool Whip. Spread on top of set up Jell-O. (Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese if desired.)

title: Nacho Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cook over low to medium heat until cheese is melted. This is hot and delicious.

title: Copper Penny Carrots
instructions: Mix all together and let set overnight in the fridge. This will stay good for a week if it lasts that long.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Microwave chicken breasts on High 2 minutes. Microwave broccoli until about half done. Layer broccoli in 9 x 9-inch casserole dish. Top with chicken breasts and pour soup mixture over chicken and broccoli. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Five Minute Chili (Meatless)(Quick And Tasty With Very Little Fat.)
instructions: Put all together and heat 4 or 5 minutes. Serve with corn bread.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
instructions: Fix Dream Whip as directed. Blend cream cheese with 1/2 cup of powdered sugar. Mix cream cheese mixture with Dream Whip and spread over graham cracker crust. Then dissolve jello in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Stir until thick. Pour over cream cheese and Dream Whip mixture and chill.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix margarine and buttermilk together then in separate bowl mix food coloring and cocoa. Fold into cake mixture with spoon. Put soda and vinegar in cup; mix then add to cake mixture with spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.; cut both layers in two making 4 layers.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt candy and margarine on low heat. Mix sugar eggs and vanilla. Sift flour and baking soda together. Add to egg mixture alternating with the buttermilk beginning and ending with flour. Pour in candy and mix well. Add nuts. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Shell and devein the shrimp leaving fantail on. Combine all remaining ingredients. Mix well. Dip shrimp in mixture; place in shallow pan in single layer. Pour remaining sauce over shrimp. Broil 6 to 8 minutes 3 inches from heat. Makes 4 servings.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions until done. Drain away all grease. Place into a casserole dish that is very deep. Add all the remaining ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 until it bubbles. Turn oven down to 375\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Put 1/2 lettuce into bowl. Add layer of celery onion bell pepper peas and eggs. Top with remaining lettuce. Cover with mayonnaise spreading to sides of bowl. Sprinkle with cheese and crumbled bacon on top.

title: Savory Grilled Potatoes
instructions: Mix salad dressing and seasonings in a large bowl until well blended. Stir in potatoes and onion to coat. Divide potato mixture evenly among six 12-inch square pieces of foil. Seal each to form packet. Place on grill and grill covered for 40 minutes or until done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Delicious Dairy Dip(Great For Fresh Fruit!)
instructions: In a small mixing bowl combine cream cheese sour cream sugars and syrup; beat until smooth. Chill. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Chill for several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Imitation Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute diced medium onion and mushrooms. Brown hamburger and drain. Combine hamburger soup sour cream onion and mushrooms. Cook egg noodles as directed on package. Drain and combine with hamburger mixture. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: No Fail Homemade Bread
instructions: Scald together milk sugar and shortening. Remove from heat. Add 2 cups water and salt. Let cool slightly. Mix 1 package yeast with 2/3 cup warm milk mixture and yeast mixture. Stir together and add remaining flour 2 cups at a time. Knead dough to a smooth consistency. Let rise to double size. Punch down and rise again. Work into rolls or loaves and place in greased pan. Bake 1/2 hour at 400\u00b0 and 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes one 9 x 13-inch pan plus 1 loaf.

title: Spicy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until meat is browned stirring to crumble. Drain and return meat to Dutch oven. Add spaghetti sauce and next 6 ingredients. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in tomatoes and vegetables. Return to boil. Cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Yields 12 cups.

title: Honey-Cinnamon Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots with 2 tablespoons of cinnamon and drain. Add honey and lemon juice; toss with 1 teaspoon of cinnamon more.

title: Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: Mix in saucepan the pudding sugar milk and butter. Cook to soft ball stage. Take off and stir in peanuts. Beat until starts to thicken. Drop from teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Sweet-Sour Cabbage
instructions: Cut medium head of cabbage in strips. Place in large skillet; cover with water and simmer until tender. Do not overcook. Fry bacon cubes in another large skillet. Remove all but 3 tablespoons of drippings. Add approximately 2 tablespoons of flour and enough water from cabbage to make a gravy. Add sugar and vinegar to make a sweet sour taste that pleases you. Add salt and pepper. Drain cabbage and add to gravy mixture. Simmer for a few minutes.

title: Norwegian Pie
instructions: Beat egg vanilla and sugar. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Beat into first mixture. Add apples and nuts. Bake in 9-inch square pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Beat heavy cream; add pineapple. Top pie just before serving.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix and cook sugar milk flour and cocoa. Then add egg yolks. Cook until thick. Turn off and add vanilla and margarine. Put in baked pie shell.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Dissolve soda with hot water. Mix other ingredients in order. Drop by teaspoons on baking pan about 3-inches apart. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Lime Sugar Cookies
instructions: In a medium bowl with electric beater cream butter and sugar; beat in salt and lime juice. Add flour and stir until blended. Chill covered tightly until firm enough to handle. Shape into two 4-inch long rolls. Wrap in Saran. Chill until firm. Remove 1 roll at a time. Cut crosswise into 1/8-inch slices. Use a wide metal spatula to place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Sprinkle with sugar/lime rind mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 approximately 6 to 8 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Spanish Rice(Serves 6)
instructions: Brown hamburg; add onion and celery. Cook until tender not brown. Put in casserole. Add rice bean sprouts mushrooms and juice on both. Add tomatoes and seasoning. Bake at least 1 hour or longer at 325\u00b0.

title: Venus De Milo Style Soup
instructions: Fry hamburg and onion in a large pan. Add water onion soup mix tomatoes and vegetables. Bring to a boil. Add orzo and cook until pasta is done.

title: Tomato Vegetable Soup
instructions: Add all ingredients except zucchini and corn to a 3 quart saucepan. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add zucchini; simmer another 20 minutes then add corn and cook 5 minutes more. Serve hot.

title: Kathy'S Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add garlic parsley basil salt tomatoes and tomato paste. Simmer uncovered until thickened. Cook noodles and drain. Rinse in cold water. Combine egg cottage cheese salt and pepper parsley and the Parmesan cheese. Alternate layers of noodles cottage cheese mixture beef mixture and Mozzarella cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Skillet Supper
instructions: Saute pepper and onion in oil until brown. Add hamburger; cook 5 minutes or until brown. Add tomatoes (not drained but chopped) water rice and seasonings. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Serves 5.

title: Herbed Chicken
instructions: In Dutch oven brown chicken in oil; drain. Add carrots mushrooms onions wine water parsley salt bouillon and spices. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer with cover for 50 minutes. Spoon off fat.

title: Reuben Pie
instructions: In medium bowl combine nondairy creamer egg onion mustard salt and pepper; set aside. In large bowl mix corned beef sauerkraut ground beef and bread crumbs. Add reserved egg-onion mixture and mix with hands until thoroughly combined. Pat 1/2 of mixture into prepared pie shell. Sprinkle cheese evenly over top; cover with remaining mixture and sprinkle with chopped parsley if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve at once or bring to room temperature; cover with plastic wrap and freeze up to three months. If frozen to serve partially thaw in refrigerator and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until heated throughout and bubbly. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Koch Kase
instructions: Have everything at room temperature and mix all together except caraway seed. Cover and let set in a warm place for one hour. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 15 minutes. (Takes a while but its worth it.) Pour into a buttered dish and top with caraway seed if desired. Refrigerate with cover on spread and enjoy.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in crock-pot (only fill 2/3 full). In saucepan melt butter; add onion. Steam until clear then add flour stirring constantly on medium heat. Add milk and simmer until sauce begins to thicken; remove from heat. Add 1 1/2 cups of cheese. Cook on low 14 to 16 hours. Best when done the night before. Place remainder of cheese on top. Serve when melted.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Sprinkle paprika over meat cut in strips and let stand 10 minutes. Cook meat and garlic in oleo until browned. Add onions and peppers. Cook until wilted. Add beef broth and simmer 15 minutes. Blend cornstarch water and soy sauce. Add to meat mixture. Cook until thickened. Serve over rice.

title: Rice Broccoli Dish
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a shallow casserole dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Then uncover and cook for another 10 minutes.

title: Party Pickin Chicken
instructions: Cut tips off chicken wings. Halve remaining chicken wings. Combine Lipton soup mix bread crumbs and caraway seed. Beat egg with beer or water. Dip chicken in egg mixture then soup mixture coating well. Place in shallow baking pan and drizzle with butter. Bake uncovered 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Cherry Chiffon Dessert
instructions: Combine ingredients in large bowl folding together until blended.

title: Teresa'S Hush Puppy Recipe
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together then add buttermilk. Put water in the empty buttermilk container. Add to mixture a little at a time. (How much you will need depends on the weather.) This makes enough to feed 100 to 120 people.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Cook at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. Stir sprinkle on cheese and bake for 20 more minutes.

title: 5 Minute Fudge
instructions: In a heavy saucepan place milk butter sugar salt and cocoa (if you want chocolate fudge). Bring to a bubbly boil. Cook for 4 minutes and 45 seconds stirring constantly. Take off heat and stir in peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until fudge starts to thicken. Pour in square pan. Cut as desired.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order of listing. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Mix soy sauce garlic and salad oil together. Pour over steak; let stand 1 hour. Pour into frypan. Allow meat to brown thoroughly on all sides. Add pepper onion and celery; cover. Cook 5 to 10 minutes over low heat. Stir in cornstarch dissolved in water; stir until thickened. Add tomatoes; cover. Cook 5 to 10 minutes longer or until meat is tender. Serve over boiled rice.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as package directs. Cook broccoli. Put in a large casserole dish. Add soup broccoli chicken and cheese. Mix well. Sprinkle grated cheese on top and bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Serve with tossed salad.

title: Very Good And Easy Pickles
instructions: Use a soft white cloth to tie your spices in. Put spice bag and garlic to taste in bottom of quart jar. Begin with a layer of pickle in jar then a layer of sugar; continue in this manner until jar is completely filled and firmly packed. Add tarragon vinegar put a top on jar and begin shaking and turning the jar often until all sugar has dissolves. Wait at least 24 hours before putting in refrigerator. Usually takes 2 to 3 days for pickles to become crisp-firm.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Cook garlic and onions in oil until tender. Add vegetables and bay leaf. Add salt pepper and a little oregano. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Mexican-Layer Dip
instructions: In a medium size baking dish spread refried beans. Combine sour cream and taco seasoning mix for next layer. Mash ripened avocados with guacamole mix and spread. The other ingredients may be added for the remaining layers. Dip is better if allowed to chill for a few hours. Serve with taco chips.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Dissolve yeast in water. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Knead roll and cut with biscuit cutter. Coat well with butter. Let stand in a warm place for 45 minutes. Bake at 475\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Ho-Ho Cake
instructions: Mix chocolate cake mix according to directions. Pour into greased 7 x 11-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Taco Burger
instructions: Brown meat. Add taco seasoning according to directions. Spoon on roll. Add sliced tomato lettuce and cheese. Serve with corn chips.

title: Ground Beef And Vegetable Stew
instructions: In Dutch oven brown beef breaking up pieces with spoon. Add onions garlic water basil salt pepper and potatoes. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are almost tender. Add peppers and tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes or until all is tender.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in bottom of pan. Sprinkle sugar over partially drained fruit. Measure flour sugar baking powder salt and add with milk. Pour onto butter. Pour fruit on top and bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Lazy Cobbler
instructions: In 13 x 9-inch pan melt oleo and brown sugar. Combine 1 cup sugar flour baking powder and milk. Pour over melted ingredients. Spoon on fruit. Cook at 325\u00b0 until browned. Cinnamon or sugar may be added to fruit if desired.

title: Mayfair Salad
instructions: Combine assorted greens pineapple and green pepper toss lightly. Place in lettuce-lined bowl. Arrange fruit salad on top. Serve with dressing. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chili Sausage Bake
instructions: Cut margarine or butter into baking mix; refrigerate 30 minutes. Mix sausage and green chili; let stand to room temperature. Divide dough in 1/2; roll each piece to a large rectangle 1/4-inch thick. Spread meat chili mixture over dough; roll up as a jelly roll. Wrap in plastic wrap and freeze for 1 hour. Remove from freezer and slice to 1/3 inch thickness. Freeze until ready to use. Remove from freezer and place on baking sheet. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Banana And Cheese Topping
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl. Mix until smooth. Makes 1 serving as part of midday meal. Supplement as required.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: In skillet over medium heat brown meat and cook onion until done. Pour off drippings. Stir in corn tomato sauce rice steak sauce and ground pepper. Set aside. Cut tops off peppers; remove seeds. Spoon meat mixture into peppers. Arrange in 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until peppers are done.

title: Peach Crumble
instructions: Arrange peaches in a shallow greased baking dish. Blend remaining ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle over the peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Play Dough
instructions: Combine flour salt and alum. Mix with boiling water. Add oil and mix well. Add food coloring as desired. Knead with flour to stiffness desired. Keep covered when not in use.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Beat eggs; add milk salt pepper and mustard. Place bread crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Crumble sausage over bread. Add cheese and mushrooms. Pour egg mixture over top. Refrigerate 8 to 10 hours. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix graham crackers and melted margarine; line 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Dissolve together jello boiling water and lemon juice; cool. Add jello mixture to cream cheese mixture then fold in 1 large can Milnot evaporated milk (whipped). Pour over graham cracker crust. Sprinkle a few graham cracker crumbs on top.

title: Congealed Lime Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese (room temperature). After adding water to Jell-O work in cream cheese until blended. Add other ingredients and chill. Use Bundt pan or mold.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Make a graham cracker crust by combining the graham cracker crumbs sugar and melted butter and pat into a 9 inch pie plate. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 12 - 15 minutes. Cool. Partially thaw the lemonade and combine with the sweetened condensed milk. Fold in Kool Whip and pour into a graham cracker crust. Chill for at least one hour. Can be garnished with a lemon cartwheel.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: In a medium bowl mix the cornmeal flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Then stir in the onion.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Mix melted butter and sugar; add eggs and mix by hand. Add other ingredients and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese-Olive Dip Or Spread(Heloise'S Recipe)
instructions: Mix cream cheese with mayonnaise. Stir in pecans olives olive liquid and pepper. It will be a little mushy but will thicken in the refrigerator. The spread will keep for weeks. It makes a great spread for crackers or finger sandwiches. (Also low calorie cream cheese and mayonnaise can be used with good results.)

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt stick of oleo; add crushed Ritz crackers. Place crackers in bottom of oblong baking dish. Layer drained beans and corn. Mix soup sour cream Cheddar cheese onion and salt. Spread over beans and corn. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Tomato Ham Soup
instructions: Boil ham for 1 to 2 hours. Separately cook macaroni until tender and drain. Remove ham from broth and cut up in small pieces put back into broth. Add the macaroni tomato juice and pepper to taste. Serves 6. Can freeze.

title: Emma'S Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Mix sugar shortening and egg and stir in milk. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Blend in blueberries. Put in greased pan.

title: Hot Chili Dip
instructions: In medium skillet brown ground beef; drain. Blend in soup mix and sour cream. Add chili powder to Ro-Tel that has been beaten until smooth. Heat through but do not boil. Add salt to taste.

title: Leona'S Sugar Free Apple Pie
instructions: Combine apple juice flour cinnamon and salt. Stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly about 3 to 5 minutes. Stir sliced apples into mixture and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Three Layer Delight
instructions: Melt margarine and mix in flour and nuts. Spread evenly on bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake Bites
instructions: Break the graham cracker in half crosswise. Spread 1 tablespoon of the cream cheese spread onto each graham cracker. Top each with a strawberry slice.

title: Shepherd'S Bread
instructions: Slice off top of bread. Hollow out center leaving 1 to 2-inch shell. Combine remaining ingredients in microwave-safe dish. Mix well. Microwave just until heated. Fill center with cheese mixture. Wrap in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 24 servings.

title: Half And Half Deli Pickles
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large pot; add washed cukes. Cover top with foil. Let stand 2 days (stir). Will keep fresh in refrigerator in jars or plastic containers for about 2 weeks.

title: Ginger-Fruit Punch(Non-Alcoholic)
instructions: Combine all ingredients into punch bowl. Serve with a frozen fruit ring.

title: Whole Wheat Muffins*
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients including raisins. Make a well in center and add egg oil and yogurt or buttermilk. Mix until dry ingredients are moistened adding fruit juice as needed. Fill muffin tins 1/2 full. It is not necessary to grease tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

title: Sour Cream Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt in large bowl. Cut in margarine. Mix sour cream and skim milk together; add to flour mixture. Knead and cut. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Contains 130 calories.

title: Golden Cliff Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in vanilla and egg yolks. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add dry ingredients to egg yolk mixture alternately with milk. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes in 13 x 9 x 2-inch loaf pan.

title: Perdue'S Delmarvalous Chicken Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix dry ingredients first. Then add vinegar and stir well. Next add beaten egg. Stir well. Add cooking and oil and stir.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry items together. Add oil and buttermilk; mix well. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Mix together with all other items. Cover; must be refrigerated. Use as needed; this will keep 10 days to 2 weeks.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water and add to the buttermilk. Mix in other dry ingredients. Make biscuits by rolling dough and cutting them out. Let rise about 10 minutes or longer before baking. Refrigerate any leftover for the next day. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Lemon Bundt Cake
instructions: Blend all at medium speed 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Cool 1/2 hour before removing.

title: Fresh Spinach Salad
instructions: Fry bacon; saute onion and mushrooms in bacon grease. Add vinegar sugar and 1 tablespoon water; heat to slight boil. Pour over fresh spinach. Add boiled eggs salt pepper and Tabasco and toss well. Stir in bacon chips. Serve immediately.

title: Sugarless Drop Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredient except raisins and nuts in large bowl and mix well. Add raisins and nuts and mix gently. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Scotch Friendly Bread
instructions: Whip and beat until fluffy putting vanilla in before the flour. Mix flour in a little at a time. Place in two ungreased square pans. Dampen palms of hands and spread batter out. Prick it clear through with hot wet fork. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cut in diamond shape.

title: Fake Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Mash figs. Mix all ingredients; heat on low. Boil on low with lids on jars for 20 minutes. Should seal. Serve with English muffins toast or peanut butter sandwiches.

title: Cheese Rolls
instructions: Mix softened cheeses and all other ingredients together. Form 2 rolls and roll in chopped nuts.

title: Quick Artichoke Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water (drain again). In a large bowl add pasta artichokes and marinade mushrooms tomatoes olives parsley and basil. Toss gently. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Before serving season to taste with salt and pepper. Serves 6.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add tomato sauce and seasonings. Simmer slowly for 20 minutes. Boil noodles. Drain. Mix all together. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Black Forest Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to manufacturers directions in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Mix pie filling and almond flavoring.

title: Billy Goat Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar eggs and water. Beat well. Add flour soda and spices. Mix well. Add ground raisins and nuts. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Chicken 'N Rice
instructions: Mix all but chicken and place in greased casserole. Place chicken breasts on rice. Salt pepper and paprika to taste. Bake for 2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Alternate layers of potatoes and onion in greased 2-quart baking dish. Season each layer with salt and pepper. Mix mushroom soup and milk; pour over potatoes. Cover and bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 8 servings.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in large dishpan in order given. Drop by large spoon and flatten on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Dont overbake these cookies. They freeze well. This recipe may be divided in half.

title: Super Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced squash and onion in salted water. Drain. Add sour cream and soup. Melt butter; add dressing. Grease casserole dish and spread half of dressing mix over bottom. Pour in squash and cover with rest of dressing. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Add soup cheese and sauces to sauteed onions. Stir and add pimentos. Place beans in casserole and pour sauce over them. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until bubbles.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Put celery onions and ground meat into casserole; bake in oven 20 minutes at 425\u00b0. Remove loosen meat; add ketchup water salt garlic salt and beans. Place in oven for additional 25 minutes.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Add rest of ingredients and mix. Pour into greased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
