instructions: Melt margarine in a baking dish; layer with wafer crumbs chocolate pieces nuts and coconut. Drizzle condensed milk over all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Roll out crescent rolls to cover a cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool completely. While pizza crust (crescent rolls) is cooling mix together softened cream cheese dry package of Ranch dressing and mayonnaise. Mixture will be of medium texture easy to spread. Chop finely about 1/2 cup of your choice of 2 vegetables. Spread mixture over cooled pizza dough. Sprinkle diced vegetables over mixture. Cover with layer of shredded cheese. Refrigerate for several hours. Cut into small squares.

title: Tomato Jelly
instructions: Heat tomato juice to boiling. Add Sure-Jell. Boil 2 minutes. Add sugar and boil 4 minutes. Quickly add Jell-O.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Prepare gelatin as directed on package using 1 1/2 cups of water. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Spoon into a 10-inch mold ring and refrigerate until firm. Unmold on a cold platter. Yields 10 servings.

title: Plain Waffles
instructions: *Hint For the very lightest pancakes or waffles replace the milk with club soda. Close windows before cooking or waffles or pancakes will float out!

title: Biscuits With Chicken
instructions: Bake biscuits until light brown. Mix chicken and soup together and pour over browned biscuits. Return to oven and heat until soup is bubbly. Serve with favorite vegetables.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cooking Time 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese with a mixer; add powdered sugar beating until smooth then add peanut butter and milk again beating until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into pie shells. Refrigerate or can be put in freezer for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Hot Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Blend milk cream cheese and sour cream in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Put in casserole and cover with pecans which have been sauteed in the butter. (Skip the sauteing and toss them on top to save the calories.) Need not be exact on amounts. Bake in small casserole for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Eliminate baking to serve cold.

title: Apple Pie Supreme
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs and melted butter. Press in bottom of 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Core. Peel apples. Cut in pieces. Simmer apples 1/4 cup sugar cinnamon and nutmeg until apples are just tender 1 or 2 minutes. Add cornstarch which has been dissolved in cold water. Simmer approximately 5 minutes. Cool. Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Blend in flour until crumbly to make topping. Pour cooled apple filling over graham cracker crust. Sprinkle topping over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions; drain. Rinse with cold water; drain well. In a large mixing bowl combine cooked tortellini sweet pepper broccoli carrot and olives.

title: Marinated Turkey
instructions: Buy whole turkey breast; remove all skin and bone. Cut into pieces about the size of your hand. Refrigerate turkey in marinade at least 8 hours or up to 48 hours; the longer it marinates the less cooking time it takes.

title: Easy Bundt Cake
instructions: Blend ingredients and beat for 2 minutes. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl and serve with crackers etc.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes onions and salt in just enough water to cover. Cook until tender; mash potatoes lightly with potato masher. Add butter and melt. Add milk and celery seed or powder if desired. Cook until hot and serve. We like to add homemade egg noodles for a change.

title: Pumpkin Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat baking sheets lightly with nonstick cooking spray. Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add egg vanilla and pumpkin. Mix well. Combine flour baking powder baking soda salt nutmeg cinnamon and chocolate chips. Stir into creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls on baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven 13 to 15 minutes or until done. Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Chipped Beef Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill 2 hours. Serve with crackers or cocktail rye bread.

title: Jellied Tuna With Mayonnaise
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in warm water. Add vinegar and salt. Chill. When slightly thickened fold in remaining ingredients. Blend. Turn into individual molds or 1 large one. Chill until firm. Unmold on lettuce. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion together; drain. Mix all ingredients together in pan where noodles are cooked. Pour in large deep round or square baking dish that has been greased. Put grated cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 (or microwave) until cheese is melted and all ingredients are hot. (This will make 2 dishes full.)

title: Peanut Butter Delights
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa butter milk and salt in saucepan and bring to a rolling boil. Boil one minute then remove from heat and add oats peanut butter and vanilla. Blend well. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Let stand until cool and firm; remove from paper. Ready to eat.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into well-greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot-Sweet Mustard
instructions: Combine mustard and vinegar. Refrigerate overnight. Next day combine that with the sugar and eggs in a double boiler. Cook until thickened.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts in water about 45 minutes. Debone and cut into bite sized pieces. Layer chicken and thawed broccoli cuts in a Pyrex 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole mixing gently. In medium bowl mix soup mayonnaise and lemon juice. Spread on top of chicken and broccoli. Top with bread cubes and cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. May be frozen. Bake thawed.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole(From Barbara Deskins)
instructions: Heat potatoes and pour off liquid. Add margarine sugars and salt. Adjust amount of sugar to individual taste. Mash potatoes with mixer. Beat eggs and mix in potatoes. Add milk until consistency is similar to regular mashed potatoes. Add vanilla.

title: Pasta Salad Surprise
instructions: Chill Veg-All thoroughly. Prepare macaroni according to package directions. Drain; combine macaroni Veg-All bacon and 1/2 can of onion rings. Add mayonnaise 1/2 of the parsley and seasoned salt. Toss gently. Serve immediately or chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Candied Walnuts
instructions: Combine sugar water and orange juice in saucepan and stir until blended. Cook slowly until small amount forms a ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add rest of ingredients. Make sure nuts are coated. Pour out on waxed paper or cookie sheet and separate with fork. Cool and store refrigerated in tightly covered containers.

title: Sunday'S Deer Steak
instructions: Season flour and dip in melted shortening or oleo. Lay on bread pan or cookie sheet. Place in 200\u00b0 oven while at Sunday school or church (2 hours total). Turn oven to 350\u00b0 to brown or place under broiler for a few minutes.

title: B'S New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Wash and open the clams reserving the liquid. In a large pot saute the bacon over low heat. When bacon is cooked through remove the slices and reserve. Mince the clams and the onion. Saute the clams and the onion in the bacon fat in the pot. Add the thyme. Sprinkle flour into the mixture. Add clam juice bay leaves pepper (if you like) and the diced potatoes. Crumble and add the reserved bacon strips. Cook until potatoes are tender. Add milk cream and butter. Do not let mixture boil at this point. Correct seasoning. Enjoy! (Makes about 4 to 6 servings.)

title: Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Let cheese and butter soften to room temperature. Add vanilla. Sift sugar in mixture while beating with mixer. Sprinkle with chopped pecans and coconut.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and shape in ball. Chill in refrigerator 2 hours then roll in the 1 1/2 cups chopped nuts.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed in order. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Bolt And Nuts
instructions: Melt butter and add sauces. Pour over mixed cereals and nuts in shallow pan (9 x 13 x 2-inch) or larger. Sprinkle with seasoned salts. Bake in a slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir carefully every 10 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage. Tear up 4 slices of bread and place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon sausage over bread. Sprinkle cheese over sausage. Beat eggs milk salt and pepper together. Pour over mixture in the dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. The cheese will rise to the top. This can be made the night before refrigerated and baked the next morning. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Scalloped Chicken
instructions: Mix all but cheese and chips. Put in casserole. Sprinkle cheese then chips on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Dough For Fried Pies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in butter with knife or blender until it resembles coarse crumbs. Mix egg yolk and milk; stir in flour adding only enough to hold the dough together. Shape into a ball. Wrap in wax paper and chill 1 hour. Roll out to 1/16-inch thick. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons filling in center and fold over. Moisten edges with cold water. Press with fork. Fry at 315\u00b0 for 2 or 3 minutes on each side in hot oil.

title: Pork Jambalaya
instructions: Season chops with salt and pepper. In a small lightly greased ovenproof skillet brown chops on both sides. Remove chops; set aside. Pour off all but 2 teaspoons drippings. Add celery scallions and green pepper. Saute until tender. Stir in rice broth and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Return chops to pan. Cover; bake in 375\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until chops are tender. Fluff rice with fork. Makes 2 servings.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies into fine crumbs; set aside. Mix cream cheese butter and sugar in separate bowl. Mix pudding and milk well. Combine the cheese mixture and pudding in large bowl. Add Cool Whip. In large pan or bowl alternate layers of cookies and pudding starting and ending with cookies. Refrigerate until served. Can be decorated with gummi worms or flowers and served with a trowel.

title: Tuna Fish With Rice
instructions: Cook rice in double boiler. Add butter and salt. Mix lightly. Line well-oiled with rice. Pour tuna fish into rice mold. Cover with white sauce which has been combined with the egg. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. (If desired minced beef chicken or salmon may be used instead of tuna.)

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and pour 1 1/2 cups batter per pan and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage and celery in water for 8 minutes and drain. Add chopped onion.

title: Escalloped Potatoes
instructions: Thaw potatoes preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all except corn flakes and 1/4 c. melted oleo. Place in 3 qt. casserole or large baking dish. Sprinkle buttered flakes over top and bake 45 minutes. Serves 10-12.

title: Hillbilly Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Time depends on the variety of apples used. Some are juicier so test cake with cake tester or toothpick until it tests done.

title: Crispy Nut Shortbread
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Grease 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy; blend in egg and vanilla. Add meal flour and nuts; mix well. Spread onto bottom of prepared pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until edges are golden brown.

title: Tostada Dip
instructions: Add or take away portions according to taste.

title: Old Settler Baked Beans
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger bacon and onion. Drain and mix other ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Whoppers Candy Milkshake
instructions: Mix in blender and serve.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add flour soda and sour cream alternately. Add vanilla. Bake in tube pan which has been greased and floured for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Start checking baking time at 1 1/4 hours.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Brown meats in hot fat; add soy sauce and 1 cup water. Simmer 2 minutes. Add celery and onion; simmer 1 1/2 hours. Blend cornstarch and water; stir into meat mixture. Add chestnuts bean sprouts and mushrooms; heat through. Season. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Shrimp Cocktail Rolls
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Add yeast. Let stand 5 minutes; mix well. Blend in flour a little at a time mixing thoroughly after each addition. Cover and let stand 10 minutes.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill at least 4 hours or overnight before serving. (On rubens this dressing is great.)

title: Anise Cookies
instructions: Cream eggs sugar and oleo. Add soda cream of tartar oil and vanilla then add flour. Make into big balls; chill 1 or 2 hours. Flour and cut out. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Chicken Elegante
instructions: Combine stuffing mix water and 2 tablespoons butter. Let stand 5 minutes. Mix gravy mushrooms and wine; set aside. In skillet/oven lightly brown chicken in 2 tablespoons butter in skillet. Place in baking pan; top each piece with stuffing broccoli and gravy mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: E-Z Dinner Muffins
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a bowl. Grease muffin pans well. Spoon into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Marvel Pie
instructions: Melt and blend the chocolate chips sugar and milk. Cool. Separate the eggs. Beat the egg whites. Beat in one at a time the egg yolks then the vanilla or rum flavoring. Fold in the beaten egg whites. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Italian Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and mushroom pieces. Drain excess oil. Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Add all ingredients except cheese and mix well. Put thin layer in casserole dish 9 x 13-inch. Sprinkle with half of both cheeses. Add remaining mixture and sprinkle again with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes if using immediately. If for future use cover tightly with foil wrap before baking and freeze.

title: Italian Scallops
instructions: Combine olive oil butter and garlic. Coat scallops with mixture and let marinate 1 to 4 hours at room temperature. In a large skillet heat 1 inch of oil to 350\u00b0. Bread scallops and fry in oil about 2 minutes on each side. Place on paper towels. Serve with lemon wedges and cocktail sauce for dipping. Use as main course or an appetizer.

title: C.Y.M.  Brownies
instructions: Hey kids this is so easy to make and Mom usually has all the ingredients in the kitchen except the cocoa so buy some cocoa and enjoy brownies for a long time.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and toss. Pour Ranch dressing over and toss again. Pour warm bacon drippings over and toss. Refrigerate for 1 hour and serve.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate with margarine over low heat. Remove. Gradually blend in milk. Mix sugar cornstarch and salt together; add beaten eggs and vanilla to dry mixture. Blend into chocolate mixture. Pour into unbaked 10-inch pie shell. Mix the coconut and pecans; sprinkle over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is puffed. Filling will be soft but will set while cooling. Cool 4 hours before serving.

title: Easy Oven Meatballs
instructions: Place in greased or Pammed 13 x 9-inch metal baking pan. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In large bowl combine bread crumbs onion turkey spinach salt pepper and egg. Shape into 16 meatballs. Place in greased or Pammed 13 x 9-inch metal baking pan. Bake about 25 minutes until meatballs are lightly browned and cooked thoroughly. Heat pasta sauce. Add cooked meatballs and simmer 10 minutes to blend flavor. Serve over rice or spaghetti.

title: Swedish Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Slash potatoes into thick slices but do not cut all the way through. Add seasoning to hot water and pour over potatoes. Baste while cooking. About 15 minutes before removing from the oven drain off most of the broth and thicken slighlty with flour. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Ricotta Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients with a mixer on low for 2 minutes. Add eggs milk and extracts and mix 1 more minute. Pour into pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: You will need 1 large iron skillet.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal stir well until coated.

title: Honey Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan melt the butter. Add honey mustard and curry powder and mix well. Coat both sides of chicken pieces with the honey mixture as you place them in the pan skin side down. Bake for 1/2 hour on each side basting occasionally. Serve with rice.

title: 3 Cheese Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and set aside. Boil lasagna noodles and set aside. Layer ingredients one by one into buttered cake pan until all ingredients are used. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Measure soda and buttermilk into quart size bowl. Beat together \until it sounds thick.\ Stir in blackberry jam and molasses. Set aside. Cream butter adding sugar and beating until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each. Have ready the 1 cup of flour sifted with spices. Add this cup of flour and spices. Add blackberry jam mixture. Mix well. Add 2 cups of flour gradually. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Blend well. Last of all fold in raisins cherries and nuts floured in remaining 1/2 cup of flour. Stir just to mix evenly. Pour into 10-inch tube pan lined with wax paper and lightly greased. Spread evenly on the top. Bake in low oven (300\u00b0) for 1 hour. Reduce heat to 275\u00b0 and continue baking (without peeking!) another hour. Turn on cake rack to cool. Test for doneness before turning.

title: Kentucky Fried Chicken
instructions: *Combine pancake mix with paprika sage and black pepper.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: *You must use one of these to get the true flavor of this casserole.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: In a large bowl cream the butter with the sugar. Beat in the eggs. Add the melted chocolate vanilla grated orange rind and the milk. Stir in the grated zucchini.

title: Skillet Beef Stew
instructions: In saucepan cook noodles and drain. In medium bowl combine soy sauce catsup cornstarch and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Add flank steak to mix and stir until covered. In skillet over medium-high heat add 2 teaspoons of oil and cook carrots and onions until crisp and lightly browned. Remove to another bowl. In same skillet over high heat add 2 more teaspoons of oil. Cook mushrooms until tender and liquid evaporates. Remove to bowl with carrots and onions. Add steak to oil with mixture. Cook about 5 minutes. Stir in veggies and 1/2 cup of water; heat through. Stir occasionally. Serve over noodles.

title: Veal Parmigiana
instructions: Cut veal into serving pieces. Cook onion and garlic in 3 tablespoons olive oil for 5 minutes. Add tomatoes salt and pepper; simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Add tomato sauce and oregano. Simmer 20 minutes longer. Combine crumbs and 1/4 cup of grated cheese. Dip veal into egg then into crumbs. Brown in 3 tablespoons olive oil in skillet.

title: Strawberries And Cream
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Stir occasionally until thawed. Add crushed pineapple and bananas which have been diced. Pour 1/2 of mixture into a large glass bowl. Chill until firm. Decorate with cream if desired.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Fill blender with water juice malt and sugar; blend together. Serves 4.

title: Baked Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Bake Homestead Yellow Cornbread (see recipe in this cookbook) crumble when cool in a 2-quart bowl. Lightly brown onions and celery in margarine or butter. Add eggs pepper and poultry seasoning to the crumbled cornbread. Add the onions and celery. Add chicken or turkey stock. Stir and pour into a well-greased pan (6 or 8-inch square). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or browned to your liking.

title: Chili Beans
instructions: In skillet cook meat stirring until brown. Discard excess fat. Add 1/2 cup onion. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Beat eggs one at a time and pour into ingredients. Add milk vanilla melted margarine and corn; mix well. Pour into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Poppy Seed Bundt Pound Cake
instructions: Bake in greased (not floured) pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool 10 to 15 minutes. Turn out of pan and glaze with 1 cup 10x sugar and 3 tablespoons lemon juice. Do this while cake is still warm.

title: Picante Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt; set aside. Cook onion and garlic in oil in 10-inch skillet 2 minutes. Add chicken broth and salsa. Bring to boil. Stir in rice. Arrange chicken breasts over rice. Cover tightly and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand covered until all liquid is absorbed about 5 minutes. Garnish with tomato avocado and cheese. Serve with tortilla chips or soft flour tortillas.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Put 1 teaspoon soda in 1/4 cup hot water. Add cinnamon allspice and vanilla. Mix well. Nuts or raisins may be added. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Walnut Waffles
instructions: Combine eggs milk and vanilla. In separate bowl combine dry ingredients. Add wet ingredients to dry. Add melted butter. Whisk until batter is smooth but do not overmix. Nuts can be added at this point or sprinkled on waffle prior to cooking. Cook waffles until golden brown. Top with whipped cream and grated walnuts if desired.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve the jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add 2 1/2 cups cold water. Add blueberries and pineapple. Let jello set.

title: Almond Chicken
instructions: Remove bones and skin from chicken. Pound flat with heavy pan; cut in half. Arrange slice of cheese and ham on each piece of chicken. Fold short sides over filling; roll up lengthwise. Secure with wooden toothpicks. Dust with flour; dip into beaten egg. Coat with crumbs. Arrange rolls on microwave tray or baking dish; dot with butter. Cover lightly with waxed paper. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Uncover; microwave 2 minutes more or until chicken is tender. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serves 4.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
instructions: Peel shrimp. Mix together shrimp tomato onion garlic and jalapeno. Stir in olive oil and parsley; season to taste with salt and pepper. Top with sliced avocado. Serves 4.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan brown beef and onion; drain. Add corn tomatoes kidney beans tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve with corn chips cheese and/or sour cream if desired. Yield 4 to 6 servings (1 1/2 quarts).

title: Veal Chops Parmesan
instructions: Season the chops to taste with salt pepper and garlic. Put bread crumbs and cheese in one bowl. In another bowl put eggs milk and salt.

title: Onion Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top (approximately 20 to 25 minutes). Serve with Club crackers.

title: Chocolate Bar
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread on waxed paper. Freeze. Can be divided into small servings. A good snack.

title: Oriental Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a pot combine vegetables garlic and ginger. Saute 10 minutes in 1/2 cup broth. Add all the rest of the ingredients. Simmer 1 minute.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Spread buttered tortillas in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Spread all of chicken over tortillas. Sprinkle half of cheese over chicken. In a saucepan put onions chilies oleo soup and milk. Simmer 10 minutes. Pour over chicken layers. Add another layer of tortillas and rest of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or cover and freeze for later.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Melt cheese in top of double boiler. Mix all ingredients thoroughly; roll into small balls. May be frozen at this point or baked at 375\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Grease 2 (15 1/2 x 12-inch) baking sheets. Keep warm. Put sugar syrup and water in a 3-quart casserole. Cook in microwave oven on Full Power for 8 to 10 minutes or until soft ball stage. Stir occasionally while cooking. Stir in peanuts. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until hard ball stage. Stir in butter and soda. Pour half of candy on each sheet spreading to 1/4-inch thick. Cool. Break into pieces. Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: In large roasting pan with lid mix onion soup mix mushroom soup milk and hot water together. Add rice mix well. Lay chicken pieces on top of liquid mixture. Cut butter over top. Cover pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 -2 hours. Rice should be soft some liquid. Dont cook too long or rice will be dry. Start checking for doneness after 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Streusel Pie
instructions: Place apples in pie shell and sprinkle with cinnamon. Cream 4 tablespoons of butter sugar and eggs; add salt vanilla flavor and cream cheese until just smooth. Pour over apples. Combine brown sugar flour 4 tablespoons butter and pecans. Crumble this mixture on top of pie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake for 15 minutes.

title: Apple Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spoon apple filling into 8 to 10 custard cups.

title: Lemon-Frosted Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: Combine flour baking soda ginger cinnamon cloves and salt. In another bowl mix margarine egg molasses vinegar and milk until smooth. Add dry ingredients to this mixture beating well. Cover. Chill 1 1/2 hours.

title: Crunchy Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash and break cauliflower into flowerets. Combine with next 3 ingredients in medium mixing bowl. Toss gently. Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Stir well. Spoon into serving bowl. Cover and chill.

title: Pacific Salmon With Roasted Garlic
instructions: Separate garlic into cloves and peel. Place in small ramekin and cover with olive oil. Wrap with foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Place garlic and 1 tablespoon of oil from baked garlic in food processor. Add butter and puree; season with salt and fresh ground pepper.

title: Fagioli
instructions: Rinse and pick over beans. Place beans and water in a stock pot; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Cover and let sit one hour. Return to heat and simmer 1 hour longer. Drain reserving 2 cups liquid. Set aside. Brown meat onions garlic carrots and green pepper in the pot. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and seasonings. Return beans and reserved liquid to the pot. Cook 1 hour. Add cooked macaroni and a splash of wine. Serves a crowd and freezes well.

title: Savory Green Beans
instructions: Combine vinegar salt pepper and dill weed. Combine bacon onion and remaining combined ingredients and pour over beans in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or microwave until done.

title: Italian Zucchini Soup
instructions: In a Dutch oven brown sausage with onion; drain excess fat. Add the celery green pepper sugar salt basil oregano pepper and tomatoes. Cover and simmer 1/2 hour. Add zucchini; simmer 1/2 hour or more. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired. Yield 2 quarts.

title: Party Salad
instructions: Prepare cherry Jell-O according to package directions and let congeal. Combine Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Refrigerate 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients along with Jell-O (cut into small pieces). Toss to mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Strawberry Cheese Cake Squares(Great For Christmas Or Valentine'S Day)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 13 x 9-inch pan combine graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Press into bottom and up sides of pan. Bake 10 minutes. Set aside. In medium bowl with electric mixer on medium speed beat pudding mix cheese dry milk sugar vanilla and 1 1/2 cups water until blended. Pour over crust.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine fruit cocktail bananas apples grapes cherries and marshmallows. Fold in whipped cream; refrigerate. Just before serving garnish with strawberries.

title: Congealed Applesauce Salad
instructions: Heat applesauce; add cherry jello and cool. Add ginger ale and orange juice. Congeal.

title: Old Fashioned Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Brown ribs in iron skillet. Mix ketchup water brown sugar vinegar and onion. Pour over ribs in baking dish. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add catsup chili powder and beans. Cover with grated cheese and onions last. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Delicious with taco chips!

title: Natural Room Freshener
instructions: Place cinnamon in a large pot with water and orange rind. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and let simmer. The combination of cinnamon and orange will fragrance every room in your home. It will smell clean fresh and delicious.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy skillet; saute celery and onion until tender. Pour into greased casserole. Dribble soup over. Add cheese and rice; stir in salt and cooked broccoli. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for about an hour.

title: I Can'T Believe It'S A Cookie
instructions: Roll tablespoon of dough in a ball. Dip fork in sugar and press to flatten cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Eggplant Chutney
instructions: Peel and chop eggplant. Core and chop apples. Finely chop onions. Put the pickling spice in cheesecloth. Put all ingredients in pan except sugar and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Add sugar and simmer until thick and lustrous.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients. Put in Pam sprayed casserole and top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles. Remove from oven and spread French fried onions on top. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Beef Stick
instructions: Mix well and form into 2 rolls. Chill overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and pineapple and bring to a boil. Add marshmallows stir and cool for a few minutes. Add sour cream and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Add sugar if needed. Pour into Jell-O mold and chill.

title: German Slaw
instructions: Alternate a layer of cabbage with a layer of onions. Put 7/8 cup sugar on top. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour over cabbage and cool completely. Refrigerate. Next day stir and repeat for 3 days. Can also be eaten immediately.

title: Hanky Pankys
instructions: Brown meat in large skillet; season with garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce. Make sure meat is in a crumbly texture. After meat is cooked place chunks of cheese on top and cover pan with lid. Simmer on low until the cheese melts and stir mixture thoroughly. Spoon meat mixture on party rye slices and serve warm.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Add all ingredients together except onions using only 1/2 of these now. Bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour then add remaining 1/2 of onions on top. Dont stir. Bake until onions are crunchy about another 5 minutes.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff. Add pinch of salt and vanilla. Add red or green food coloring if you like. Fold in pecans cereal and coconut. You may use corn flakes or miniature chocolate chips if desired.

title: Chicken Pot Pie Casserole
instructions: Mix together margarine flour and milk. Set aside. Combine all other ingredients. Pour into 3-quart casserole dish. Pour first mixture on top for crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until crust is brown.

title: Toasted And Seasoned Pecans
instructions: Heap pecans in middle of cookie sheet. Pour melted butter or margarine over pecans and sprinkle onion salt or powdered on pecans. Mix this mixture around with a fork or spoon and spread to all corners. May want to add regular salt to taste. Bake at 200\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour. Turn with spatula every 15 minutes. Bake until lightly toasted. Delicious!

title: Hot Dog Stew
instructions: In stew pot filled 1/2 with water put in peeled whole potatoes carrots and whole peeled onions. Add salt and pepper to water and taste. When potatoes and other vegetables are almost cooked add frankfurters and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with French or Italian bread. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat one large chopped onion with frozen broccoli and oleo until onion is tender and broccoli is thawed (you can put in 1/2 cup of celery with onion if desired). Add milk Cheez Whiz and cream of chicken soup. Bring to a boil. Measure 1 cup of regular rice before it is cooked and cook as directed. Mix cooked rice and broccoli mixture together. Put in a casserole pan and bake at 375\u00b0 until bubbly hot.

title: Chicken Biscuit Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Stir soup; add water. Slowly blend in chicken peas and pimento. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Hobo Vegetables
instructions: Cut 4 pieces of foil. To each piece add 1 carrot 1 onion 1 potato and 1 tbsp. butter; salt & pepper to taste. Wrap snugly and seal. Bake on a cookie dish at 350 degrees for 45 60 minutes or until done.

title: Kool-Aid Frosty Winter Fizz
instructions: Mix soft drink mix with water. Add ice cream. Stir until melted. Just before serving pour in carbonated beverage. Makes 32 servings 1/2 cup each.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes in serving size. Put in pan and almost cover with water. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until tender but not soft. Place in a baking pan. Slice 1 medium size orange thin; add to syrup. Cook until syrup drops heavy off spoon. Pour over potatoes. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Agnes Party Rolls
instructions: Melt first 5 ingredients together. Split dinner rolls and spread on both sides. Place a slice of ham and cheese in each roll. Heat until cheese melts.

title: Curried Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix in blender or food processor and add more mayonnaise if necessary.

title: Easy Ice Cream
instructions: In a pint-sized Ziploc bag put milk sugar and vanilla in bag. Mix well.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients. Pour into 9-inch pie plate. Drain peaches and arrange on top of crust mixture leaving 1/2-inch between the sides. Combine cream cheese peach juice sugar and vanilla and spread on top of peaches. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Cool and enjoy.

title: Meat Loaf(For 50 People)
instructions: Mix well and pack firmly into greased loaf pans 3/4 full. You will need 3 loaf pans about 12 x 4-inch. Bake in moderate oven for 1 hour.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake(No Fat)
instructions: Combine 3/4 cup sugar flour 3 tablespoons cocoa and baking powder. Blend in milk applesauce and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. In small bowl combine remaining sugar brown sugar and 4 tablespoons cocoa. Sprinkle evenly over batter. Pour hot water over top. Do not stir. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Fried Steak And Milk Gravy
instructions: Season meat with salt and pepper in shallow dish with flour and 1 teaspoon pepper. Dredge steak in flour. Dip in eggs and then back in flour again.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onions in butter. Cook broccoli and rice as directed on package. Combine remainder of ingredients. Stir in broccoli. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Coconut Pecan Topping
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine sugar evaporated milk beaten egg yolks and shortening. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans. Cool 15 minutes. Spread only between layers and on top of cake.

title: Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Remove skin from chicken and cut chicken into 1-inch strips. Mix flour salt and pepper. Lightly coat chicken strips with flour mixture. Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Add chicken and cook on both sides until browned about 8 to 10 minutes. Serve with mild salsa meatless spaghetti sauce or plain yogurt mixed with green onions.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Dust well-greased Bundt pan with first 2 ingredients. Mix together cake mix pudding and poppy seed. Beat in remaining ingredients. Pour into prepared Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Shrimp De Jonghe
instructions: To melted butter add garlic parsley paprika cayenne and cooking sherry; mix well. Add bread crumbs. Place shrimp in a 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Spoon butter mixture over. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Pear And Gorgonzola Salad
instructions: Puree berries in blender. Strain through a sieve to remove seeds. Whisk the puree together with syrup vinegar mustard tarragon sugar and sour cream. Chill.

title: Layered Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck then add seasonings and finish cooking. Put small amount picante sauce in bottom of 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Line with flour shells. Cover with refried beans and thin layer of picante sauce. Layer shells then ground chuck then shells then cheese (save shredded cheese for top) and picante sauce then shells. Cover with picante sauce and shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until melted and sauce is bubbling.

title: Creamy Salmon Spread
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients; blend well. Spoon into crock or small bowl. Cover; refrigerate until firm. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken. Debone and cut or tear into small pieces. Add soup and broth salt and pepper (pre-mixed) to chicken and add eggs. Toss until chicken is coated. Pour into buttered casserole.

title: Fingerpaint
instructions: Thoroughly dissolve cornstarch in water. Stir constantly while cooking over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil loses whiteness and starts to thicken. Lower heat and continue stirring about 2 minutes until mixture is very thick and smooth. Let cool slightly. Color by stirring in powdered or liquid tempera or food coloring. Leftover can be stored in a covered jar in the refrigerator.

title: Savory Mushrooms
instructions: Bring bouillon to a boil. Add washed wild rice; cover and simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat. Saute mushroom caps in butter. Mix rice almonds herbs and spices and fill mushroom caps. Drizzle with fresh lemon juice. Bake on cookie sheet at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. May easily be prepared a day prior to re-heating.

title: Lemon Broccoli
instructions: Trim off large leaves of broccoli and remove tough ends of lower stalks. Wash broccoli thoroughly and cut into spears. Arrange spears in a vegetable steamer over boiling water. Cook and stem for about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain. Transfer to a serving platter. Sprinkle with grated lemon rind salt and pepper. Garnish with lemon rind curls if desired.

title: Jewish Gradnies(Chicken Soup)
instructions: Pull skin off necks remove backs.

title: Sourdough Bread #3
instructions: For best results use unbleached flour. Scald milk and stir in butter; cool to lukewarm. Add yeast and stir until dissolved. Add this to the basic batter from Sourdough Bread #2. Add 2 cups flour; mix well. Blend sugar salt and soda; sprinkle over top of dough and stir in gently. Cover bowl and set in warm spot. Let rise for 30 minutes. Stir down; add remaining flour until too stiff to stir with spoon. Turn out on floured board and knead adding flour as required until dough is smooth and satiny. Better too wet then dry. Divide in half; place in greased bread pans and butter tops. Bake for 20 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Apple Puff Pancakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet. Add brown sugar and apples; stir to coat. Cook over medium-low heat for about 1 minute stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; set aside. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a 10-inch ovenproof skillet tilting pan to coat the sides. Whisk milk flour eggs and cinnamon in a medium bowl. Pour into skillet; cook for 1 minute. Place into oven; bake until puffed and golden 12 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar; serve immediately.

title: Barbecue Chicken Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low flame for about 10 minutes. Stir.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar brown sugar eggs cooking oil and vanilla. Add plain flour baking soda salt nuts dates or raisins cornflakes rolled oats and coconut. Mix well and drop on greased cookie sheet. Cook at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: California Seafood Brunch Bake
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter in skillet over low heat for 8 minutes remove from heat. Stir in crabmeat green onions and cheese. Layer bread cubes and seafood mixture half at a time in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish pressing down layers. Whisk eggs and remaining ingredients in bowl. Pour over layers. Chill covered for 4 hours or overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until set. Yield 12 servings.

title: Easy Cheese Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients in mixer except for crust. Beat eggs in one at a time. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Chill and serve with your favorite fruit topping.

title: Savory Snack Mix
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix popcorn cereal peanuts and pretzel sticks in an ungreased rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Heat margarine over low heat until melted. Remove from heat stir in remaining ingredients. Pour over cereal mixture and mix until well coated. Bake 15 minutes stirring twice. Turn into a bowl and cool. Store loosely covered. Makes about 9 cups of snack 300 calories per cup.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Crumble cake into 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish. Mix sugar cream cheese and 1 carton of whipped topping. Spoon over crumbled cake. Spread strawberries over mixture. Spread glaze over strawberries. Top with remaining carton of whipped topping. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Macaroni And Ham Salad
instructions: Cook rotini according to package directions; drain. Cool. Rinse with cold water to cool quickly; drain well. Combine cooled rotini with remaining ingredients and toss lightly. Chill.

title: Edna'S Punch
instructions: Mix tea base pineapple and orange juices together. Chill in freezer for several hours until ice crystals form. Stir every 2 - 3 hours. When ready to serve pour into punch bowl add ginger ale. May be chilled in refrigerator and served over ice. Makes 2 1/2 - 3 gallons.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Combine drained pineapple with other ingredients cutting margarine in small pieces and stirring in. Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers about 1/2-inch thick over mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 40 minutes.

title: Creole Sauce
instructions: Heat butter or oleo in saucepan. Toss in vegetables and cook stirring frequently until onions are limp. Add and stir in soup 1/2 cup of water and drained mushrooms pimento parsley and salt. Cook until heated through.

title: Sourdough Starter
instructions: Bread In a large bowl make a stiff batter of ingredients. Grease large bowl; put in dough grease or Pam spray top of dough. Cover with waxed paper. Let rise 12 hours. Punch dough down. Divide in 3 parts. Knead each part on floured pastry sheet a few times (8 to 10). Put into 3 loaf pans or into rolls. Grease pans and brush top of dough with oil. Let rise 4 to 5 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes; rolls for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order excluding the nuts and chocolate chips. Pour into well greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts and chips over top of the batter. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Combine eggs half and half onion salt and cayenne pepper. Blend until smooth. Drain crabmeat on paper towels until very dry. Sprinkle crab mushrooms and cheese over bottom of pie shell. Pour in egg mixture and top with chopped parsley. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in airtight container.

title: Onion Bake Fish
instructions: Mix sour cream mayo and dressing mix. Dip both sides of fish into this sauce. Crush onions and coat fish with crushed onions. Place in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until fish flakes with fork about 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken, Cheese And Rice Bake
instructions: Cook chicken and rice. In a large casserole dish layer chicken rice and cheese. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cheese melts.

title: Sweet Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a square baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir occasionally. Bake until moist but not dry. Makes 8 servings.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat celery and onion; drain. Add tomatoes and chillies sauce olives salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes; stir occasionally. Break up shells or chips; set aside. Mix cheeses and egg. Spread 1/3 of meat mixture on bottom of 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Top with 1/2 of cheese mixture then 1/2 of the chips. Repeat layers ending with meat. Top with chips either broken or whole. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 4 to 5 people.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornmeal corn and eggs. Pour half into 2-quart baking dish. Add uncooked sausage evenly on top. Put cheese evenly on top. Add rest of cornmeal to this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except raisins and pecans. Blend well. Then add pecans and raisins. Fill well-greased and floured 1 pound coffee cans to 1/2 full. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 cans.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Peel and mash well. Add sugar melted margarine coconuts pecans and spices. Mix well. Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam. Pour mixture in dish. Top with marshmallows. Bake 5 to 6 minutes at 250\u00b0 or until marshmallows are brown.

title: Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in pan to be cooked in approximately 12 x 8 x 2-inch. Add graham cracker crumbs coconut chocolate and butterscotch chips and nuts. Drizzle condensed milk over top of all. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Cut into squares. Makes approximately 24 squares.

title: Punch Bowl Dessert
instructions: In a punch bowl layer the following twice. Makes a good colorful dessert.

title: Baked Celery Casserole
instructions: Cook celery for 8 minutes in small amount of salted water; drain. Mix with all remaining above ingredients. Pour into a 1-quart rectangular baking dish buttered.

title: Confetti Rice
instructions: In a large skillet dry saute the onions and green pepper until tender. Add corn oregano paprika pimento and cook 1 to 2 minutes. Add rice peas and soy sauce and heat through. Serve hot or cold.

title: Mandarin Pork Chops
instructions: In a large skillet brown chops in oil on both sides. Remove from skillet. In the skillet add remaining ingredients except orange segments and green pepper. Cook and stir until slightly thickened. Add chops; cover and simmer for about 20 minutes or until tender. Add orange segments and green pepper. Simmer a few minutes until thoroughly heated. Serves 4.

title: Spicy Steamed Clams
instructions: In a heavy saucepan cook the garlic pepper flakes and oregano in the oil over moderately low heat stirring for 1 minute. Add the onion and fennel; cook the mixture over moderate heat stirring until the fennel is softened. Add the tomatoes with the reserved juice wine and salt and pepper to taste; simmer the mixture uncovered stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Add the clams; steam them covered for 5 to 7 minutes or until they have opened. Discard any unopened ones.

title: Gingerbread On The Coals
instructions: Cut tops from oranges. Remove fruit from shells. Save for fruit salad. Mix gingerbread mix and water. Place batter in orange cups and carefully set cups upright in hot coals. Cook about 12 minutes or until tops of cakes lose their sheen. Remove from coals and cool slightly. Top with small dab of oleo and eat with a spoon.

title: Lemon Cake Icing
instructions: Cook all ingredients except butter until thick in a pot on low heat. Add butter and beat. Makes enough icing to ice 5 thin layers of cake. Ice first layer and beat icing. Ice each additional layer and beat icing each time. Allow icing to air dry on cake before covering cake.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken. Saute onions in butter and add tomatoes and soup. Season with garlic salt and pepper. Cook noodles. Mix all in baking dish. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together. Shape into 2 loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Bars
instructions: Melt peanut butter and chips in double boiler. Add cereal and pour in square pan. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Mushroom-Bacon Stuffing
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain. Crumble into bowls. Pour off all but 1/4 cup bacon drippings. Add melted margarine mushrooms celery onion sage marjoram salt and pepper. Saute 10 minutes until veggies are tender. Remove from heat. Add bread crumbs broth and vegetable mixture. Toss well. Spread in a large greased baking dish. Bake 1/2 hour to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Icebox Pickles
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar spices and salt; let boil. Pour over cucumbers and onions. Cool; place in refrigerator. Ready to eat in 4 days.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
instructions: Cut cookie roll in 8 equal slices. Cut each slice in fourths. Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 375\u00b0. Immediately put a miniature peanut butter cup in middle.

title: Corn Soup
instructions: Blend corn milk salt and pepper on high 4 minutes. Add margarine and heat to desired temperature.

title: Ground Beef-Filled Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise; remove seeds. Place cut sides down in baking pan; add 1/4-inch boiling water to pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until almost tender. Saute ground beef until crumbly. Add stuffing mix parsley salt onion pepper and bouillon; toss lightly to combine. Turn squash cut sides up. Fill with beef mixture; return to oven and bake for 20 or 30 minutes longer. Saute mushrooms in butter; arrange over stuffed squash.

title: Lemonade
instructions: Pour over ice cubes in 12 ounce glass. Fill glass with water and serve.

title: Punch
instructions: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in water. Add fruit juice and chill. Just before serving add ginger ale. Serves 25.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Lightly butter bread slices and cut in fourths (square). Take squares and form buttered side in small tart pans. Fill with mixture of remaining ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Halloween Bread(A Spook Brings This To Us)
instructions: Combine and mix well the sugar brown sugar pumpkin salad oil and eggs. Sift together and add flour soda salt nutmeg cinnamon and ginger. Stir in water. Add pecans and raisins. Mix well and spoon into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. When done turn out on a rack to cool. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Scald milk; cool to lukewarm. Combine sugar and potatoes in a large mixing bowl; mix well. Add milk and shortening. Stir in yeast. Sift 6 cups flour salt baking powder and soda. Stir into yeast mixture. Cover dough; let rise for 2 hours.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. In a large bowl stir together last 6 ingredients until smooth. Add other ingredients and toss to coat well. Cover and chill.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine all vegetables in large bowl and toss lightly. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium saucepan bring to boil over low heat stirring gently to blend and dissolved sugar. Pour cooled vinegar mixture over vegetables cover and chill for 24 hours. Serve and enjoy. Serves 6-8 people.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain. Cook beans and hambone in water slowly for three hours. Add all ingredients except seasoned salt. Cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Add seasoned salt to taste. Serves 8. Serve over rice.

title: Homestead Garden'S Holiday Mulled Cider
instructions: Bring to a boil to dissolve sugar. Simmer 15 minutes or put in crock-pot on low.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook milk and sugar until it forms a soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Stir well then pour into buttered pan(s). When cool cut into 2-inch squares and serve.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix crushed vanilla wafers powdered sugar and pecans. Add melted butter and thawed orange juice. Mix well. Roll into small balls. Roll in finely grated coconut. Store in refrigerator overnight. These freeze well. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Texas Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks and flavoring. Roll nuts and fruit in 3/4 cup flour; mix remainder of flour in batter. Add fruit and mixture into batter. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into batter (mix with hands). Bake in greased Bundt pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Turn out of pan when completely cool.

title: Barbecue Wieners
instructions: Cut wieners in 1-inch pieces. Chop onion and brown in large skillet. Add tomatoes (broken into smaller pieces) and wiener pieces. Season with garlic powder salt and pepper to taste. Let simmer until wieners plump up (5 to 7 minutes).

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with liquid. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Combine as any other cake mixture. Bake in moderate (350\u00b0) oven for approximately 1 hour. Where different ingredients are mentioned in the same verse use common cooking sense. King James or Revised Standard contains the best terminology for translation of modern ingredients.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine broccoli soup eggs onion mayonnaise salt and pepper in casserole dish. Combine melted margarine with croutons. Cover broccoli mix. Spread cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add eggs oil and sour cream. Stir until blended. Stir in corn. Add chilies. Pour 1/2 of batter into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cover with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Repeat with remaining batter and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Stir yeast into warm water. Hold aside. Heat buttermilk margarine salt and sugar (works great in microwave!). Cool to lukewarm. Stir in 1 cup flour that has the soda and baking powder added. Beat well.

title: Sandy'S Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt 1 stick of margarine and mix with crushed cornflakes. Put mixture on top of casserole. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Will freeze thaw and cook.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Steam broccoli until you can pierce with fork cut into bite-size pieces and cover bottom of medium casserole dish. Parboil chicken about 8 minutes. Cut into cubes layer on top of broccoli. Combine mayonnaise soup and cheese spread over chicken. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Onion Dressing
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and dissolve with vinegar. Add onion juice or grated onion. Then add salad oil slowly and blend with rotary beater.

title: Chicken Corn Soup
instructions: Stew chicken; reserve broth. Remove meat from bones. Discard skin and chop into small pieces. Cook celery until tender. Add all ingredients to broth; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 5 servings.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
instructions: Let cream cheese get to room temperature. Whip together cream cheese and condensed milk. Add vanilla and lemon juice. Pour into pie shell and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Just before serving add pie filling to top of pie and serve.

title: Blueberry Torte
instructions: Mix the graham cracker crumbs sugar and butter. Use mixture to line a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix together. Bake until done at 350\u00b0.

title: 2-Step Vegetable Soup
instructions: Drain liquid from all vegetables except tomatoes. Combine all ingredients in large pot. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with crackers or warm bread.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Drain fruit; mix Eagle Brand milk Cool Whip and lemon juice. Fold fruit into mixture. Pour into 2 graham cracker pie crusts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Aunt Mickie'S Fruit Delight
instructions: Drain juice from all the fruit and mix sour cream and coconut together. Chill for a couple of hours before serving.

title: Delicious Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients with electric mixer. Pour into prepared 9 X 13 pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Arrange broccoli in baking dish; place chicken on top. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine butter and bread crumbs and sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Let cream cheese come to room temperature. Add sugar salad dressing and whipped cream. Blend all together. Mix together cranberry sauce well drained crushed pineapple marshmallows and pecans. Add to cream cheese mixture. Place in a Pyrex dish and freeze.

title: Easy Pudding Cake
instructions: In large bowl mix together pie filling flour salt baking soda sugar and chopped nuts. Beat together eggs oil and vanilla. Add to first mixture and beat well with a spoon. Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Melt butter and lightly saute onions and celery in pan. Add to bread crumb mixture which has been crumbled in bowl. Add other ingredients and mix well with hands or large spoon. Spoon into shallow pans and press. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 or 25 minutes. Serves 8. Serve with turkey hen or duck.

title: Nigerian African Stew
instructions: Cut meat into small cubes and place in pot of water 2 inches above meat. Next add all ingredients except tomatoes tomato paste tomato sauce tomato puree and spinach. When meat is almost cooked add tomatoes tomato paste puree and tomato sauce as well as spinach. (Cooking time is approximately 1 hour.) Serve over cooked white rice. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Cook and drain meat. Place in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Can use 1/2 package slaw mix instead of cabbage. Mix together and follow directions on wraps to rolls.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: In large bowl sift together flour sugar and salt. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until crumbly. In a small bowl beat water vinegar and egg. Add to flour. Cover bowl and chill at least 1/2 an hour before rolling. This can be kept in the refrigerator for a week.

title: Party Rye Pizzas(Great For Snacks Or A Party!!)
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage until done. Drain; add seasonings. Combine with melted Velveeta cheese and spread on party rye bread. Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake on cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Carmen'S Crab Spread
instructions: Chop onions tops and all finely. Add to soft cream cheese with remainder of ingredients. Use fork to flake crab and mix well. Can shape into a log roll in foil. Refrigerate until firm and flavors blend. Put in middle of platter and arrange favorite fancy crackers around when ready to serve.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Whip the cream. Crumble in Blue cheese. Fold cream and Blue cheese into mayonnaise. Add lemon juice. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Yields 2 cups. Thin with 1 to 2 tablespoons of milk to use the next day.

title: Whitney'S Delight
instructions: Make 1 envelope of Lipton soup over medium heat. When soup is ready turn off and add rice. Cook bacon and drain. Saute celery. Mix rice celery and bacon in casserole dish. Top rice with cheese. Bake until cheese melts. Enjoy!

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Punch holes in pie shell and bake before pouring mixture. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Fully cook sausage; add cheese onion and flour. Beat eggs milk and parsley flakes. Slowly pour over sausage mixture in pie shell. Bake on cookie sheet for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Holiday Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl. Serves 14.

title: Brunch For A Bunch
instructions: Cook sausage in skillet until brown stirring to crumble. Drain. Place hash browns in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Layer with sausage cheese and green peppers. Combine eggs and milk stirring well. Pour over green peppers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in 8 1/2 x 13-inch greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Mix baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt and 2 cups flour. Add shortening and ice water. May need to add a little flour. Roll on floured surface very thin. Cut into strips about 1 x 3-inches. Cut up chicken and add to 1 quart of water. Add salt and pepper and half an onion. Boil until done (if you like you may debone chicken but not necessary). Lay dumplings on top of broth very gently. Simmer slowly. Move them around with a fork in the juice. Heat milk and pour into pot slowly. Cook approximately 45 minutes or until dumplings are done.

title: Marinated Veggies
instructions: Add any type of vegetables that you like; let it set for 24 hours. You can continue to add veggies as they are eaten. Will keep about 2 weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken Perlo
instructions: Boil chicken and sausage. Add spices together until tender. Debone chicken. Cut sausage and chicken into small pieces. Mix rice with broth. Put ingredients together and bring to a boil. Cut on low heat cover tightly 20 minutes. Then cut burner off and wait until rice has softened about 15 minutes.

title: Snowball Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover tightly and freeze. Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving. Can be used as salad or dessert.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: In a small bowl mix together oil vinegar sugar salt pepper and chicken flavor packet from Ramen noodles and set aside. Chop head of cabbage and slice onions. Put in a large bowl. Crush Ramen noodles and add to cabbage.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Place 6 slices of toast in an oblong pan. Mix together tuna onion mayonnaise and noodles. Spread over toast in dish. Cover with slices of American cheese. Put rest of toast (6) on top. Mix soup milk and salt; pour onto center of toast within 2 inches of sides. Cook uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: The Scripture Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to create divine fruitcake. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes. Bake in 10 x 4-inch tube pan.

title: Anise Christmas Cookies
instructions: This eye-catching and mouth-watering treat uses a mix of several sliced fruits (except apples) such as plums kiwi bananas strawberries etc. and/or whole small berries or cherries grapes etc. The fruits are not cooked.

title: Appetizer Pastry(Tart Shell)
instructions: Cut chilled butter into 1/2-inch slices. In a medium bowl combine flour and salt. Use a pastry blender to cut in butter slices until mixture resembles oatmeal; set aside.

title: Parsley-Basil Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute garlic in butter and oil 3 minutes or until soft. Stir in clams and liquid clam juice parsley basil and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes. Spoon clam sauce over hot spaghetti or linguini. Makes 3 cups.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch. Add the water and lemon juice. Over high heat bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cook and stir until slightly thickened and clear (4 to 5 minutes). Add gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Cool to room temperature. Stir in strawberries. Pour into baked shell. Chill 4 to 6 hours. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Pam'S Bars
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in bowl. Cut in butter until crumbly. Add eggs. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove. Top with chips. Pour milk over; sprinkle with coconut. Bake for 20 minutes more. Melt 1/2 cup chocolate chips and shortening. Drizzle over top.

title: Prime Rib Roast
instructions: Pat optional ingredients into meat. Place roast fat side up in baking pan. Add water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Do not open oven door. You can do this in the morning. Then before serving cook at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes rare 45 minutes for medium or 1 hour for well done. Cook uncovered. Serves 6.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Combine cereal crackers pretzels dressing and dill weed; stir well. Sprinkle oil over it and stir well. Pour in paper bag and let sit for 2 hours shaking occasionally.

title: Crab Meat Appetizers
instructions: Spread cream cheese on 9-inch dinner plate. Add cocktail sauce on top and sprinkle crab meat on top. Chill. Spread on crackers.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and make balls.

title: Artichoke Squares
instructions: Drain 1 jar artichoke hearts and use juice to saute onion and garlic. Chop hearts and add to sauteed mixture. Beat eggs in bowl; add bread crumbs salt pepper oregano Tabasco sauce and parsley. Add sauteed mixture. Mix well and add cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish for 30 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until done.

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Cook zucchini 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in jello. After jello is dissolved pour into jars and seal or put in freezer.

title: Creamy Hash Browns(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Place potatoes in an ungreased 5-quart slow cooker. In a bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Pour over potatoes and mix well. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or until potatoes are tender and heated through. Yield 14 servings.

title: Tomato Aspic
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add the rest of the ingredients; mix well and pour into a lightly greased mold.

title: Tiramisu(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup of milk into blender container. Add cream cheese; cover. Blend until smooth. Blend in the remaining 1 cup milk. Dissolve coffee in water; add to blender with brandy. Add pudding mix; cover. Blend until smooth scraping down sides. Pour into large bowl. Gently stir in whipped topping. Cut ladyfingers in half crosswise. Cover bottom of 8-inch spring-form pan with ladyfingers halves. Place remaining halves cut ends down around sides of pan. Spoon pudding mixture into pan. Chill until firm about 3 hours. Remove side of pan. Sprinkle with grated chocolate. Serves 12.

title: Pretzels Dipped In Dark Or White Chocolate
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water in a double boiler. Dip pretzels until fully covered. Let excess chocolate drip back into pot. Cool on waxed paper. Store in refrigerator or freezer. Makes about 40.

title: Miniature Fruit Strawberries
instructions: In blender grind nuts and coconut. Mix all ingredients together. Place in refrigerator 3 to 4 hours to harden. Mold into strawberry. Shape by hand. Roll in fine red sugar. Dip ends in green sugar to form stems or small pieces of almonds dyed green can be stuck on end as stem. Use 2 per strawberry. Yields 50 or more. Store in airtight container in refrigerator or can be frozen.

title: Cherry Chip Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Beat for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Pour into tube pan lined with wax paper. Cook for approximately 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Leave in pan. Cool a little. Punch full of holes with fork.

title: Homemade Dinner Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Beat eggs in large mixing bowl. Add sugar yeast and oil. Mix well. Add 6 cups of flour salt and scalded milk alternately. Beat until satiny looking. Let rise until double in bulk. Turn onto bread board with 2 cups flour and knead. Roll and cut into biscuits. Brush with melted butter. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: New Zealand Panlova
instructions: Beat egg whites water and salt until stiff. Add 3/4 cup of sugar and beat again. Into remaining 1/4 cup of sugar add cornstarch. Add this to egg mixture and beat some more. Keep beating until mixture looks marshmallowy then add vanilla and beat into mixture. Spray Pam on baking sheet. Cut a piece of waxed paper to fit and place in baking sheet. Spray waxed paper with Pam. Pour egg white mixture on the waxed paper. Put in oven at ???\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to ???\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour. Do not open oven door. Turn off heat and allow to set for 1/2 hour.

title: Tropical Fruit Ice Cream
instructions: *Or can use fresh medium sized soursop (extract with 1 1/2 cups water; 3 or 4 large mangos (blend pulp); or 2 large coconuts (extract with 2 cups water in blender).

title: Zesty Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate cheese. Add olives and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cover bowl and chill thoroughly. Shape chilled mixture into ball. Roll in parsley or nuts.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Presweeten fruit with 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup flour. Put in baking dish. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Use an 8 x 12-inch glass baking dish.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Toss chill and serve.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Combine crumbs and 1/2 cup butter melted. Press in 9 x 13 pan. Chill. In small mixing bowl combine eggs 1/2 cup butter and powdered sugar. Beat on high speed about 5 minutes until thick and creamy. Spread on chilled crust. Arrange sliced bananas slightly overlapping to cover creamed mixture. Spread well drained pineapple over bananas. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries. Cover and refrigerate 10 to 12 hours.

title: Butter Pecan Dessert
instructions: Crush Ritz crackers. Melt butter and mix with crumbs in a 13 x 9 pan.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts thoroughly. Form into ball. Place in refrigerator to chill and become firm. Take out and roll in pecans. Keep refrigerated.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
instructions: Cut margarine into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add buttermilk and stir until dough clings together. Knead dough 10 to 12 strokes on lightly floured surface. Roll out to a 16 x 12-inch rectangle. Sprinkle sausage evenly atop dough. Roll up (jelly roll) style starting from long side. Slice into 1-inch slices. Place cut side down on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Drops(Soft Cookies)
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add milk alternately with dry ingredients to egg mixture. Add cocoa and mix well. Add vanilla maple flavoring and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cook 5 minutes and cool the first 3 ingredients. Mix shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients - add to sugar mixture. Mix well then add raisin mixture and stir. Drop on greased baking sheet and bake for 9-10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cook cake mix as directed but in 3 cake pans. Stir 3/4 cup sugar and crushed pineapple together. Set aside. In a large bowl mix sour cream and 1 3/4 cup sugar until blended. Add Cool Whip and set aside. When cake layers are cool spoon pineapple mixture over each layer letting juice soak into cake. Top with sour cream mixture. Continue with each layer.

title: Salami
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly with your hand. Shape into 3 (10-inch) logs. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerator for 24 hours. This step is mandatory.

title: Easy Italian Pasta Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Mix in casserole with chopped onion and spaghetti sauce. Top with Cashew Cheese and sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans. Add salt. Add water and soak overnight. Drain the beans. Add 2 quarts of water and ham hocks. Bring to a boil. Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Add onion tomatoes chili powder lemon juice salt pepper and garlic powder. Simmer another 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Vinaigrette
instructions: Puree lemon juice and garlic in food processor. With machine running gradually add olive oil and blend until smooth. Add Parmesan cheese blend until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Cover the bottom of 2-quart deep pie dish or casserole with pie crust. Cover sides also if you wish more crust. Place peaches in mixing bowl. Mix sugar and flour. Add water and mix well. Pour over peaches. Mix lightly and pour into pie dish. Sprinkle a bit of cinnamon and nutmeg over top of peaches and dot with butter. Make a lattice of pie crust across top of pan and bake 10 minutes. Now cool oven to 350\u00b0 and bake about 40 minutes longer.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except nuts. Spread nuts in unbaked pie shells and divide batter between pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hello Dollies
instructions: Crumble graham crackers. Mix with all ingredients. Spoon tablespoons of batter onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Butter Crust
instructions: Mix flour and salt in pie pan. Add milk and butter mixture. Work out to sides of pan with fingers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. This is good for cream pies.

title: Scuppernong Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar flour and butter to eggs and beat until well mixed. Stir in grapes and sugar in which they were canned. Pour into 9-inch pie shell. Cover with top crust also. Bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Reduce heat to 375\u00b0 and continue baking for 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple Fluff
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. Very good and low-fat!

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Snip dates figs and marshmallows with scissors. When scissors get sticky dip them in powdered sugar. Add nuts salt and cherries. Mix in 1 1/2 cups cracker crumbs. Add cream and mix well. Line a deep 9-inch round pan with waxed paper. Shape mixture into a round cake and coat with remaining crumbs. Press firmly into pan; cover with waxed paper. Chill overnight. Turn out and pull off waxed paper.

title: Seafoam Lime Mold
instructions: Dissolve lime jello in boiling water. Add cold water and lemon juice. Gradually add to cream cheese and blend. Chill until almost firm. Fold in marshmallows pineapple and nuts. Pour into one-quart mold. Chill until firm.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Place in casserole baking dish. Add mushroom soup. Crush enough Ritz crackers over top to cover. Pour over crackers the melted butter (may use less). Top with cheese slices or Cheez Whiz. Place in moderate oven until cheese melts.

title: Cappuccino Coffee Mix
instructions: Mix together. To serve use 2 teaspoons mix to a cup of boiling water. Excellent gift.

title: Un-Apple Pie
instructions: Peel and seed zucchini. Cut into lengthwise strips and slice like you would an apple. Cover with water and boil two minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Mix remaining ingredients together and stir gently through zucchini. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie crust and cover with top crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown. Tastes just like an apple pie!

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Combine flour baking soda and salt in separate bowl. Mix all ingredients and put in greased loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a 9x13x2 inch baking pan that has been greased and lightly floured on bottom only. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake. As soon as cake comes from oven add topping and broil as directed.

title: Glazed Acorn Squash
instructions: Place squash in shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over squash; cover. Bake in a 350! oven for 30 minutes until almost tender. Baste several times with pan juices during baking. Uncover; baste. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer until squash is tender.

title: Dirt Pie
instructions: Grind cookies fine. Mix all other ingredients. Beat with mixer until thick.

title: Golden Shrimp Rice
instructions: Saute vegetables in margarine until tender. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp turns pink. Add rice water salt and pepper to taste. When it comes to a boil turn to simmer. Cover and cook until rice is done about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Streusel Muffins
instructions: Prepare muffin mix according to package directions; fold in apple. Fill greased muffin cups 3/4 full. In a small bowl combine the walnuts flour brown sugar and butter; sprinkle over batter.

title: Oreo Trifle
instructions: Crumble Oreos until they are like potting soil. Cream margarine cream cheese confectioners sugar and vanilla. Mix pudding and milk. Mix pudding mixture with cream cheese mixture. When thick fold in Cool Whip. Layer in trifle bowl cookies first then filling until there are 4 layers of cookie and 3 layers of filling. Refrigerate 4 hours. Can be frozen.

title: Marinated Pork Party Sandwiches
