instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; cover and chill at least 8 hours.(Mayonnaise mixture) Trim fat from tenderloins. Place tenderloins in a large heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag. Combine oil and next 6 ingredients; pour over tenderloins. Seal bag; marinate in refrigerator 8 hours turning bag occasionally. Remove tenderloins from marinade reserving marinade. Place tenderloins on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer into thickest portion of 1 tenderloin. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 30 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 160\u00b0 basting occasionally with marinade. Let stand 10 minutes. Cut tenderloins into 1/4 inch slices and arrange on a serving platter lined with kale leaves if desired. Serve with mayonnaise mixture and cocktail rolls.

title: Chicken In Golden Sauce
instructions: Combine flour pepper and salt. Dust chicken with mixture and in a single layer skin side down lay in buttered dish 12 x 18 x 2-inch. Drizzle margarine over chicken. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn and bake 20 more minutes. Stir soup and pour over chicken. Bake 20 minutes longer. Delicious!

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; stir well. Make a well in the middle and add all other ingredients except pecans and vanilla. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Parisian Onion Soup
instructions: Simmer thinly sliced onions in water until tender. Dissolve bouillon. Add to onions. Simmer a few minutes. Place a few croutons and a slice of toast in each bowl. Add a slice of cheese. Pour soup over cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Let stand for a minute or two to melt cheese.

title: Bagels
instructions: Combine the yeast and 1 3/4 cups flour. Add water sugar and salt to yeast mixture. Beat at a low speed for 1/2 minute constantly scraping the sides of the bowl. Then beat at high speed for 3 minutes. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough. Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead until smooth. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes. Divide dough into 12 portions. Shape into balls and punch a hole in center of each with a floured finger. Pull gently to enlarge hole. Keep in uniform shape. Cover and let rise for 20 minutes.

title: Preacher Dan'S Mega Peanut Butter Chip Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour salt baking soda; set aside. In large bowl beat butter brown sugar white sugar vanilla and egg until creamy. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats pecans and peanut butter chips. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheets any size you prefer (the bigger the better).

title: Quickest Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in pan that you cook the cobbler. Mix together the cake mix and milk. Pour the batter in the middle of pan with the melted butter (dont spread the batter). Now pour 1 can peaches and juice on top of batter and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Cook in 325\u00b0 oven. Do not boil cobbler remove when top is gloden brown.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put into casserole dish. Add topping.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with orange juice. Combine sugar flour spices and salt. Cut in butter with 2 knives or a pastry blender to form crumbs. (Batter will be quite stiff makes nice large firm crumbs). Put crumbs over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 approximately 45 minutes.

title: Easy Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour milk and oil with fork until makes soft dough. Pat out on floured surface. Make into biscuits. (Makes about 4 large ones.) Bake at 450\u00b0 on greased cake pan about 20 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer each of the vegetables in a bowl. Mix Miracle Whip and sugar together and spread on top of vegetables. Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Refrigerate covered and add tomatoes before serving.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in 9 x 15-inch casserole. Top with cheese. Mix soup and water and spread over top. Top with bread crumbs. Pour melted butter over bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bacon And Egg Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon. Remove from skillet. Drain fat leaving enough to fry onions until soft. Add soup milk and sliced hard-boiled eggs. Mix all together. Stir in cheese and crumble bacon on top. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Road Runner Cake(This Makes Good Shortcake.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 (9-inch) layer pans. Sift together in a large bowl flour baking powder sugar and salt. Mix well. Add shortening and 1/2 of the milk. Beat for 2 minutes; add remaining milk vanilla and eggs. Beat 2 more minutes then pour batter into prepared pans. Bake for 25 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pans for 10 minutes and put on cooling rack.

title: Margaret'S Do-Nuts(Dee - Licious!)
instructions: Dissolve the baking soda in the sour cream and set aside. Beat together the eggs sugar and oil or melted shortening. Make sure it is well beaten. Add the sour cream with the soda in it the pinch of salt nutmeg and vanilla. Stir well and add 1/2 cup flour and the buttermilk. Stir well. Put the baking powder in 1 cup flour and stir into the mixture. Keep adding flour until dough feels ready to roll cut. Helps to chill in the refrigerator before rolling it out to cut.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Place all dry ingredients into 8 x 8-inch pan. Stir to mix up. Add wet ingredients and mix thoroughly.

title: Jean Tucker'S Peanut Butter Ice Cream
instructions: Blend well. Finish filling freezer with milk. Mix well and freeze. For chocolate peanut butter ice cream; use chocolate milk.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook hamburger meat; drain. Add taco seasoning and 3/4 cup water. Simmer 5 minutes. Let cool.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent roll dough in large back pan and bake as directed. Allow to cool. Mix cream cheese mayo and soup mix and spread evenly over cooled crust. Add diced vegetables.

title: Carolyn Koch'S Fudge
instructions: Mix all together. Cook until it comes to a boil. Boil 5 minutes longer. Take off heat. Then add

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat all ingredients for 7 minutes. Bake for 1 hour for large greased loaf pan. Less time for smaller pans.

title: Oatmeal Chip Bars
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar beating well with mixer at medium speed. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Combine flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Stir in oats chips and pecans. Spread mixture into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Two Flavor Fudge
instructions: Combine in pan the brown sugar white sugar milk and oleo and bring to a rolling boil stirring frequently. Boil for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and add marshmallow cream butterscotch and chocolate chips. Stir until melted and smooth. Blend in nuts and vanilla.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter; add sugar and cream together until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating to blend after each addition and again until light and fluffy. Sift together flour soda and salt. Gradually add flour mixture beating continuously. Blend in sour cream. Add flavoring one teaspoon at a time and blend well. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours (or longer).

title: Parmesan Cauliflower
instructions: Separate cauliflower into flowerets. Cook in small amount of boiling salted water until tender about 10 minutes. Drain.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Allow cream cheese and Blue cheese to soften at room temperature. Add garlic salt; mix well. Place in aluminum foil; shape into ball. Refrigerate until serving time. Serve on cheese board with assorted crackers.

title: Fried Plantains
instructions: Peel the plantains; cut them into thin round slices. Dip into salty seasoned cold water; place in strainer to drain off excess water. Fry in vegetable oil until golden brown; place on paper towel to absorb excessive oil. Sprinkle with a little all season. Place on a serving platter to cool.

title: Pizza Dip
instructions: Mix together with mixer cream cheese sour cream oregano red pepper and garlic powder and pour into 9-inch pie dish. Top with the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top with cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Hot Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop peppers. In large pan combine all ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring. Boil 8 to 10 minutes or until thickened stirring frequently. Immediately fill hot pint jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Place lids on jars. Process in boiling water canner for 15 minutes. Yields 3 pints.

title: Sweet Potato Crisp
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes; peel and slice crosswise about 3/8 inch thick. Spread in a buttered large but shallow baking-serving dish. Cut butter into flour and brown sugar. Add pepper cream and nuts; mix well. Sprinkle over potato slices.

title: Macaroni Salad(Club Member: Kristi Mayfield)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let set overnight.

title: Party Mix
instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch pan melt butter. Add Worcestershire sauce and stir until blended.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: In blender combine mayonnaise milk eggs and cornstarch. Process until smooth. Add crab meat cheese and onion and blend at low speed just to combine (3 to 4 seconds). Pour mixture into baked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until top is puffed up and golden brown. Remove from oven and allow to rest 10 minutes before serving to firm up the custard. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and bone chicken. Cook broccoli and drain. Arrange in a greased dish. Mix soup mayonnaise lemon juice and sour cream together. Add cheese bread crumbs and butter. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Mix well and bake in a 9 x 13 pan that has been greased well and wax paper added to bottom. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Easy Cranberry Salad(Yum-Yum)
instructions: Grind cranberries and apples; add marshmallows and 1 1/2 cups sugar. Mix well; let stand. Beat cream; add nuts to cream. Mix with the rest of ingredients. Freeze in serving size containers until ready to serve.

title: Sunday Brunch Casserole
instructions: Remove and discard crusts from bread if desired. Butter bread. Cube and place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese sausage red pepper and onions in order over the bread.

title: Spinach Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook shells. Fill with spinach souffle. Make a cheese sauce with the last 4 ingredients. Season with salt and pepper as it cooks. Stir constantly until cheese melts. Pour over shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Bake
instructions: Brown chops sprinkle with salt set aside. Combine soup milk sour cream potatoes 1/2 C cheese and 1/2 C chopped onion. Spoon mixture into 9x13 baking dish. Arrange chops over potatoes. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake uncovered for 5 minutes longer.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda. Add to cream mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour batter into 3 greased 9-inch pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Pour over corn mixture; mix well. Refrigerate overnight. Drain before serving.

title: Shrimp Luncheon Dish
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cover. When steaming turn to low and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Rosemary Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0F. Lightly oil baking pan. Cut a narrow wedge 2/3 through each potato. Insert a rosemary sprig and a sliver or two of garlic in each wedge. Drizzle a bit of olive oil in the opening too. Place potatoes in baking dish making sure none of them touch.

title: Green Bean Bake With Onion
instructions: Cook frozen beans according to package directions; drain (or drained canned beans). Combine the cooked frozen or the canned beans mushroom soup pimiento and lemon juice. Turn mixture into a 1-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle with French fried onions. Continue baking uncovered until onions are heated through about 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Collard Greens
instructions: Check leaves of collards carefully; remove pulpy stems and discolored spots on leaves. Wash leaves thoroughly; drain well and chop. Combine collards water and salt in a Dutch oven. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Saute salt pork in a skillet until golden brown; do not drain. Add collards stirring lightly. Cook over low heat 5 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix brown sugar sugar flour and eggs together. Pour melted margarine over mixture; add vanilla and mix well. Pour back into 13 x 9-inch pan and bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cut crust off bread. Spread butter on one side of bread. Place buttered side down in greased baking dish. Brown sausage; drain. Sprinkle sausage on top of bread. Sprinkle cheese on top of sausage. Mix eggs and half and half. Pour over bread and sausage. Cover; refrigerate overnight. Bake next morning 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 people.

title: Quick Caramel Icing
instructions: Cook stirring until sugar is dissolved then cool without stirring until mixture forms a soft ball. (Drop small amount in cold water to check.) Cool to lukewarm.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 3 (7 1/2 x 3 1/2 x 2 1/4-inch) loaf pans. In bowl beat sugar eggs and oil until blended and light and fluffy. Beat in pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients. At low speed beat dry mixture into pumpkin mixture.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cream margarine eggs and sweetener. Add soda spices flour and applesauce (or mashed bananas). Mix well. Fold in fruit and nuts.

title: Oooey Gooey Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and 1 stick margarine. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Blend cream cheese powdered sugar vanilla and 2 eggs. Spread on first mixture. Sprinkle with pecans that have been rolled in small amount of powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bring butter cocoa oil and water to a boil. Add to flour and sugar the salt soda and buttermilk. Add hot mixture to this mixture. Bake 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Have frosting made when cake comes out of the oven. Pour over hot cake.

title: Crock-Pot Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage; drain. Add onion bell pepper banana pepper red pepper salt pepper and garlic. Sprinkle with flour and mix until coated. Boil water then add chili powder to boiling water. Pour into meat mixture and cook on low for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Put into crock-pot and add Ro-Tel tomatoes tomato sauce soup and both beans. Cook on low for 1 hour then add halved jalapenos. Cook for 4 hours on low.

title: Broccoli Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 2 pie plates. Rinse broccoli under cold water to thaw. Drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli 2 cups of the cheese and onion; divide pour into pie plates. Beat milk eggs baking mix salt and pepper until smooth. Pour into plates. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake 1 to 2 minutes longer.

title: Chocolate Chunk Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In large mixing bowl cream butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg milk and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in nuts if desired and chocolate treasures or chunks. Spread into prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool completely; cut into bars.

title: Beef And Pepper Rice Skillet
instructions: Brown beef in oil. Stir in onion rice beef broth one soup can of water and soy sauce. Bring to boil reduce heat cover and cook over low heat until liquid is absorbed about 25 minutes. Stir in green pepper and pimientos. Heat.

title: Baked Apricots
instructions: In greased 1 1/2 quart casserole layer apricots sugar and crumbs until all ingredients are used. Pour melted butter over all. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Rinse dried beef in cold water. Place beef on the bottom of 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Wrap each piece of chicken in slice of bacon. Lay this over dried beef. Sprinkle small amount of rosemary over. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Bake 3 hours uncovered in 275\u00b0 oven.

title: Coke Salad
instructions: Bring water to a boil with sugar and juice from cherries. Add jello and cherries. Let stand 2 to 3 minutes and add pineapple Coke and nuts. Chill and serve.

title: *Chicken Mandalay
instructions: Cut chicken into chunks or slices. In a large skillet melt butter. Saute chicken until golden brown; set aside. Combine consomme curry powder onion salt and pepper. Pour over chicken. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Drain oranges reserving syrup. Combine syrup lemon juice and cornstarch. Cook stirring until thickened and clear. Add dates and green pepper; simmer for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in orange sections. Combine orange sauce with chicken mixture. Serve over rice. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce cauliflower bacon bits and onions. Make a dressing of mayonnaise Parmesan cheese and sugar. Cover the top with the mayonnaise dressing. When ready sprinkle with bacon bits and mix. Best if refrigerated 2 to 3 hours.

title: Noodle Soup
instructions: *Use 4 medium potatoes 1/4 head cabbage 4 medium carrots 1/2 red or yellow pepper (sweet) 1 large onion scored 1 whole tomato 1 celery heart 2 parsley roots 6 pieces of top parsley and 1/2 kohlrabi.

title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Place chicken breasts on a large micro-safe platter placing meatier parts toward outer edge of platter. Cover with plastic wrap and micro-cook 6 to 8 minutes per pound turning pieces over midway through cooking. If juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork chicken is cooked. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 5 minutes. When cool remove skin and chunk chicken saving broth. Place 1/4 cup reserved broth in a 9 x 13-inch micro-safe shallow casserole. Layer tortillas over broth and scatter chicken chunks over tortillas. Combine the soups half and half onion salsa drained olives and 1/2 cup of the grated Cheddar. Spread over chicken layer and micro-cook covered with plastic wrap on High power 12 to 14 minutes or until bubbly and hot. Sprinkle with remaining cheese; cover with plastic wrap and let stand 3 to 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles and drain; then set aside. While noodles are cooking stir together egg whites cottage cheese parsley and chili peppers in a medium bowl; set aside.

title: Milk Punch(Enough For Approximately 25 People)
instructions: Beat softened ice cream in large mixer bowl gradually adding fruit juices then milk. Beat until frothy. Pour into chilled bowl. Great for parties and showers.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: You may omit the butterscotch or caramel chips but use double of the other chip.

title: Cheerios Squares
instructions: Bring sugar syrup and butter to a boil. Remove; add peanut butter. Combine Cheerios corn flakes and peanuts in a bowl. Pour boiled mixture over cereals and mix well. Pour into buttered pan and cool. Cut into squares.

title: Tomato Creme Bisque
instructions: In saucepan blend soup and sour cream. Gradually stir in water. Heat and stir. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Tanya'S Treat(Low Calorie)
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and margarine until crumbly. Press in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill 15 minutes. Beat cream cheese. Add 1/4 cup sugar. Gradually add milk and beat. Fold in whipped topping. Spread over crust. Place peach slices on top. Dissolve jello in hot water. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 1/4 cups. Add to jello. Stir until slightly thickened. Remove unmelted ice. Gently smooth over peaches. Chill 3 hours. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Holiday Hot Nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl toss nuts with oil. In a small bowl combine all spices except salt. Add the spices to nuts tossing nuts to cover evenly with spices. Spread the nuts on a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake for 10 minutes. If desired sprinkle with salt. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat saute onion celery and broccoli in butter for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in cheese soup and milk until smooth. Place rice in a greased 8-inch square baking dish. Pour cheese mixture over do not stir. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to a boil in small saucepan the oleo water and cocoa. Mix the vinegar-milk mixture with remaining ingredients. Pour oleo mixture into bowl of flour and sugar. Add eggs milk mixture and vanilla. Pour onto greased cookie sheet (approximately 10 x 15-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Pecan Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. In a large bowl beat sugars and 1/2 cup margarine until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs. Blend well. Stir in flour baking powder and salt. Mix well. Stir in chopped pecans. Spread in pan and bake for 23 to 28 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. (I bake for only 13 minutes. They burn easily.) Cool completely. Frost. Arrange pecan halves over frosting if desired. Cut into 36 bars.

title: Doris Carson'S Cornbread Stuffing
instructions: Start with 2 packages of cornbread mix. Crumble together all ingredients except eggs and mushrooms. Add the eggs and mushrooms. Mix together; add chicken broth until runny. Grease a baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Almond Cream Filling
instructions: Combine flour sugar and cold milk. Add to hot milk in saucepan. Cook stirring constantly until thick about 5 minutes. Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm. Cream 1/2 cup butter confectioners sugar and vanilla. Add to cooled cooked mixture. Brown almonds in 1 tablespoon butter. Add to filling. Chill until firm enough to spread on cake or chiffon roll. Yields 12 servings.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix 3/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon together. Cut biscuits into fourths and roll in sugar mixture. Place in greased Bundt pan. Put butter 1 cup sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon in saucepan and bring to boil. After bringing to boil add nuts and pour over biscuits in Bundt pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Place Jell-O into large mixing bowl. Dissolve with only 1 cup of boiling water. Add all remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Chill. Serve with whipped cream. Be sure to leave the liquid in the strawberries and pineapple. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Casserole #1
instructions: Combine chicken soups sour cream and dumplings. Place chicken mixture in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix. Melt the margarine; pour over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Fudge
instructions: Microwave milk and white chocolate chips with condensed milk for 2 1/2 minutes. Stir. Microwave for another 2 1/2 minutes. Stir marshmallow cream into chocolate mixture. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Pour into buttered dish. Cut when cool.

title: Ham Finger Sandwiches
instructions: Melt margarine with chopped onion. Add poppy seed and mustard. Mix and pour on top of rolls. Spread evenly. Lay 3 slices of ham and cheese on top and put top rolls on. Cover with foil and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffing Balls
instructions: Saute celery onions and seasonings in the margarine in skillet about 5 minutes. Add to remaining ingredients and mix well. Shape into 12 balls. Place in well-greased muffin pan sections. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Simmer the above ingredients for 1 hour. Melt 1 (8 ounce) package Kraft Old English cheese. Boil 1 (8 ounce) package wide noodles and drain. Mix all together.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and enjoy with your favorite breads and crackers.

title: Twinkie Delight
instructions: Place Twinkies on bottom of large baking dish. Mix vanilla pudding mix with milk. Pour over Twinkies. Pour pineapple on and layer sliced bananas over pudding. Pour Cool Whip on top with crushed nuts on top of that.

title: Chicken Scallop
instructions: Combine ingredients and place in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Wink Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar; beat well. Add eggs and vanilla. Add rest of ingredients except corn flakes. Roll in corn flake crumbs formed into balls. Place on cookie sheet. Top each with 1/4 maraschino cherry. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Mmm Mmm Chicken
instructions: Clean and place chicken pieces in an aluminum foil-lined baking dish. Lightly butter top sides of chicken. Salt and pepper to taste. Spoon undiluted cream of mushroom soup over chicken covering chicken completely. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top of all. Seal aluminum foil tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Uncover and bake until coating is lightly browned and crispy.

title: Crock-Pot Roast Beef
instructions: Dissolve bouillon in boiling water. Pour over beef in crock-pot. Sprinkle with onion powder. Cook 15 minutes on high or 8 hours on low.

title: French Dip Burgers
instructions: In large pot prepare gravy mix using 2 cups water. Throw onion rings in; let cook on medium heat (rings will separate). While gravy mix is cooking make patties. Keep them relatively small not size hamburger you would make for the grill. Brown off all the patties. If gravy mix is boiling reduce heat. When all patties are browned and drained from excess grease put them all in the gravy mix stirring them around to get covered. Let them simmer covered about 1/2 hour. Great on bun; cover with some of the onion gravy and mustard.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: In a saucepan blend chili and cream cheese. After cream cheese is melted in chili pour into glass bowl. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Spicy Pickles
instructions: Peel and split garlic cloves. Empty juice out of pickle jar. Slice pickles into thin slices. Using the pickle jar layer ingredients as follows

title: Aunt Rachel'S Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Combine eggs sugar fruit cocktail and flour. Mix well and pour into a sheet cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. (Cooking time will vary with ovens and size and type of pan used.)

title: Crisp Cheese Wafers
instructions: In large mixing bowl toss together cheese flour cereal salt and cayenne pepper. Mix well. Melt butter. Add Worcestershire sauce. Pour over flour mixture and stir well. (Mixture will be coarse.) Shape into 3/4-inch firm balls. Place on lightly buttered baking sheet and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Cool 5 minutes before removing from sheet. Press with fork in crisscross pattern. Yields 126 wafers.

title: Lemon Butter Bars
instructions: Lightly coat a 9 inch baking pan with cooking spray. For the crust combine the flour and 1/4 c. sugar and blend together. Add 1/2 c. (1 stick) butter. Cut into flour-sugar mixture until it is finely mixed and the butter disappears. This will be like crumbs. Pour the crumbs into the prepared pan and smooth. Dont pat the crumbs too tightly. Bake on the middle rack of a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes until the edges are just beginning to brown.

title: Moist Banana Bread
instructions: Mix sugar bananas oil eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Mix well and pour into greased loaf pan. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for about 70 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine together. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Add vanilla vinegar and corn meal. Mix and pour into 2 (10-inch) unbaked pie shells. Bake at 275\u00b0 or 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until firm in center.

title: Broccoli Brunch Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pie plate 9 x 1 1/4-inches. Spread broccoli in plate. Beat sour cream cottage cheese baking mix butter and eggs until smooth. Pour into plate. Top with tomato and Parmesan cheese. Bake 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Macaroons
instructions: Beat egg whites vanilla and sugar until soft peaks form. Fold in coconut and peanut butter which has been melted and cooled. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt chips in saucepan over low heat stirring constantly. Stir in nuts and noodles. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper to set.

title: Hot Cheese Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Grind together cheese bacon onion and garlic. Combine mayonnaise and mustard. Mix well. Spread on bread. Broil for 6 to 7 minutes about 5 inches from broiler heat. These can be frozen. When ready to use take out of freezer about half hour before needed and broil 6 to 7 minutes or until done.

title: Twila'S No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring first 5 ingredients to a boil. Remove from heat. Add last 3 ingredients. Stir and drop on greased cookie sheet. Chill and enjoy.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Melt butter. Mix with flour and nuts. Pat into 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Blend Cool Whip sugar and cream cheese. Spread over crust. Top with blueberry filling. Chill until serving.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Beat with jam until smooth. Shape into a ball. Freeze for 30 minutes. Meanwhile toast almonds and coconut in oven set at 425\u00b0. Watch closely. Roll ball in the browned mixture. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Gypsy Stew
instructions: Add cheese mushroom soup olives pimentos salt pepper and chili powder to beef. Heat on low fire until cheese is melted; do not burn. Serve on slice of toast.

title: Scallop Chowder
instructions: Saute celery and onions slowly in melted butter until onions are transparent. Add potatoes salt pepper Sauterne wine and water. Bring to boil then add imitation seafood. Bring back to boil and then cut heat; simmer until potatoes are soft. Heat whipping cream to a rolling boil in a separate pan. Add to chowder and add parsley.

title: Sour Cream Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix fruit juices salt and sugar. Add cream stir until smooth. Makes about 3/4 cup.

title: Country Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving sizes. Brown meat in frying pan using 2 tablespoons shortening. Pour off fat. Stir in soup and water; cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Stir often.

title: Cheese And Onion Cornbread
instructions: In medium bowl combine 1 egg muffin mix cheese milk and onions. Stir until moistened. Turn into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan or 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Fudge Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix 3/4 cup sugar margarine milk flour salt baking powder and cocoa (1 1/2 tablespoons) together and put in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix together pecans 1/2 cup sugar brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa. Sprinkle over unbaked cake mixture. Boil 1 1/4 cups water. Pour over the whole thing. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cut cored pared apples in 1/2 inch rings or slices and cook until tender in syrup of 2 cups sugar 1 cup water 1/3 cup red cinnamon candies and a few drops of red food coloring. This is a good garnish for meat especially beef.

title: Grasshopper Pie
instructions: Stir together butter and cookie crumbs. Press into 9-inch pie plate. Set aside.

title: Tailgate Beans
instructions: In a skillet cook beef and bacon until lightly browned. Pour off excess fat. Combine meats with all ingredients. Turn into casserole dish. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Chocolate Rum Angel
instructions: Blend first four ingredients in top of double boiler and cook over simmering water stirring until mixture is of custard consistency and coats a spoon about 10 to 15 minutes. Soften gelatin in cold water and add to hot custard stirring to dissolve. Remove 1 cup of custard and add to chocolate chips. Still until chocolate is melted. Set aside. When remaining custard is cool add rum or flavoring and chill until mixture just begins to thicken. Whip cream and fold into chilled custard. Pour mixture into a 9-inch spring-form pan or 9 x 13-inch pan. Drizzle chocolate custard over top and sprinkle with almonds. Chill to set. If using spring-form pan unmold. Cut into servings and garnish each with sweetened whipped cream and a strawberry.

title: Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Boil 8 potatoes until tender. Cool peel and chop. Add one diced onion bacon crisps olive slices and Velveeta cheese. Add Miracle Whip and stir all ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar and cocoa. Add milk gradually. Stir in beaten egg yolks and butter. Cook until thickened. Add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Pecan Crunchies
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs flour soda and pecans. Stir until well blended. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cow Patties
instructions: Brown meats and spices; drain grease. Add Velveeta which has been chunked up. (You can use Mexican flavor Velveeta if you like it spicier.)

title: Cherry Cheese Tarts
instructions: Let cream cheese and 1/2 cup butter soften to room temperature. Mix 1/2 cream cheese flour and butter; chill. Press dough evenly against bottom and sides of small muffin tins.

title: Sugar-Free Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding skim milk lemonade and Cool Whip. Put in graham cracker pie shells. Makes 2 pies.

title: Simple Salsa
instructions: Simmer all ingredients for 1 1/2-2 hours until thick. Put into hot jars and seal with tops.

title: Helen'S Pancakes
instructions: Sift together flour sugar salt and baking powder and set aside. Gradually blend flour mixture with milk mixture. If batter is too thick add a little more milk. Fry in pan with canola oil.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in water with onions - or saute onions and add later. When potatoes are cooked add rest of ingredients and heat. For color you may add cooked diced carrots and also a chicken bouillon cube for more flavor.

title: Southern Spoon Bread
instructions: Heat milk salt and sugar to moderate temperature. Add corn meal to milk mixture and cook as mush. Beat together remaining ingredients while cooking mush. When good and thick add egg mixture beat well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot from the oven. A favorite of all our family!

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Cook corn on cob just enough to set milk (about 3 minutes). Cut from cob; put cabbage onions and peppers through food chopper using coarse blade. Combine all vegetables. Blend salt flour turmeric sugar and mustard. Add vinegar gradually. Bring to a boil and add to the vegetables. Simmer 25 to 30 minutes. Seal at once in hot sterilized jars.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs lengthwise in half. Slip out yolks and mash with fork. Mix in seasonings and salad dressing. Fill whites with egg yolk mixture heaping it up slightly.

title: Ceviche
instructions: Combine fish and lemon juice in a glass bowl. Marinate 2 hours. Drain and discard marinade.

title: Marshmallow Puffs
instructions: In large bowl pour milk over first five ingredients. Mix well and roll in balls and then in coconut. Chill 1/2 hour or more on cookie sheet in refrigerator.

title: Fish Courtbouillion
instructions: Cover fish and seasoning with water. Use cast-iron pot. Layer cooking oil fish onion bell pepper garlic and V-8. Pour Ro-Tel tomatoes and dissolved Tony Chachere instant roux over layers. Cover pot and cook over low flame. Every ten or so minutes remove cover and gently shake pot. Do not stir. Stirring breaks up the fish. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Oreo Frozen Dessert
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan. Crush Oreos. Add melted butter and press into pan. Freeze. Slice ice cream; arrange on top of Oreos and let soften to cover crust. Freeze.

title: Chicken Tikka
instructions: In a large mixing bowl blend spices together with yoghurt salt lemon juice coloring and tomato puree. Add chicken pieces and coat well. Leave overnight or for at least 3 hours.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: In a large kettle cook potatoes carrots and celery in water until tender. Drain reserving liquid and set aside.

title: Beef Porcupines
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Shape into large meatballs and brown in oil. Pour in tomato sauce mixture and cook for about 45 minutes on low until the rice is done.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat together egg sugar cream cheese vanilla and lemon extracts. Set aside. Press graham cracker crumb mixture into 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Pour cream cheese mixture into graham cracker crust and bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool and pour your favorite pie filling on top.

title: Chocolate Fruit Bars
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cream shortening; add sugar egg and vanilla. Stir in fruit. Add dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done approximately 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix together and place crushed saltines with butter on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lime Chiffon Squares
instructions: Combine margarine and crumbs. Press firmly into bottom of a 9-inch square or 12 x 7-inch baking dish. In a large mixing bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in Eagle Brand milk pineapple and lime juice. Fold in marshmallows and whipped cream. Pour into prepared dish. Chill 2 hours or until set. Garnish as desired.

title: Dutch Apple Cake
instructions: Mix sugar egg and butter together thoroughly. Stir in milk. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Spread batter in a greased and floured 9-inch square pan.

title: Pork Chops With Savory Apple Glaze
instructions: Serves 4; 136 calories 3 g fat and 20 mg cholesterol.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Blend shortening and sugar in large bowl. Beat in vanilla and eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture. Stir in 1/2 cup of candies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Oreo Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cheese until fluffy. Add milk. Beat until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Add 1/2 cup of chips and the flour and mix well. Pour over crust. Pour remainder of chips on top. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Chunk O' Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: Blend meat with chopped mushrooms onion parsley bread crumbs egg salt pepper and milk until blended. Dice cheese into 1/2-inch cubes. Blend into meat mixture (by hand) making sure to distribute the cheese chunks evenly. Pack into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Pour off liquid.

title: 20 Minute Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in oil and garlic. Add vegetables and stir-fry 1 minute or until crisp-tender. Combine bouillon soy sauce sherry vinegar brown sugar ginger and pineapple with juice. Bring to boil. Stir in Minute rice. Cover. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in chicken and vegetables and serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Basic Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour; add egg yolks and enough milk to blend well. When mixture is smooth add remainder of milk. Mix well and cook on medium heat stirring constantly until thick.\tRemove from heat and add butter vanilla and if desired 1 or 2 drops of yellow food coloring. Pour into cooked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Carolyn'S Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate with shortening. Take off heat; add sugar then eggs. Beat. Add flour baking powder salt and vanilla. Add nut and chocolate chips if desired.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Kill 1 moose (elk may be substituted). Dip moose in vat of chocolate. Let drip dry. Serves 3000.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes and mash. Add cheese. Cook lasagna and drain. Fry onions in butter. Grease an oblong pan with butter. Add a little milk to prevent sticking. Layer noodles and potatoes; top with onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pain Francais(French Bread)
instructions: Measure warm water into large mixing bowl; sprinkle in yeast to dissolve. Add salt shortening and flour stirring until well blended. Dough will be slightly sticky. Place in a greased bowl; turn to grease top. Cover and let rise 12 hours or until double in size. Form long loaf. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Brush with egg white mixed with water. Reduce temperature to 425\u00b0. Bake for 5 minutes longer on bottom shelf. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown steak in little oil until it gets tender. Add broth vegetables and soy sauce. Cover and simmer. Combine 1/4 cup water and cornstarch. Stir into the meat. Serve over rice.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Add brown sugar white sugar bacon and Velveeta cheese to remaining ingredients. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for about 2 hours.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions and bake. While hot poke holes in cake and pour sweetened condensed milk over cake.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cream together the Philly cream cheese and tomato soup. Add chopped onion green pepper shrimp mayonnaise gelatine garlic powder and salt. Serve with crackers.

title: Garden Spiral Primavera
instructions: Cook spirals according to package directions. In large skillet heat oil and butter. Add onion and garlic. Cook 2 to 3 minutes stirring frequently. Add the remaining vegetables. Cook 3 more minutes stirring frequently. Add wine and seasonings. Simmer 5 minutes or until tender. Toss spirals with vegetables. Add cheese. Serve immediately. Yield 6.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients and bake in uncovered casserole dish for 25 minutes.

title: Carrots Elegante
instructions: Cook carrots covered in 1/2-inch boiling water 8 minutes; drain. Turn carrots into a 1-quart baking dish. Stir in raisins butter honey lemon juice and ginger. Bake uncovered in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven 35 minutes; stir occasionally. Spoon into serving bowl. Sprinkle with almonds. Yields 4 servings.

title: Old Country Apple Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and pour over sliced apples. Mix together the sugar nuts raisins and cinnamon. Add apples. Add vanilla and vegetable oil to apples. Mix. Sift together every ingredient and mix. Mixture will be thick. Turn into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Deer Or Beef Jerky
instructions: Cut meat in strips 1/4 inch thick 3 inches long and 1/2 inch wide. Put meat in 2-inch deep pan. Mix other ingredients with 1 glass of water then add enough water to cover meat. Soak meat for 24 to 36 hours. Stir every 10 hours to coat well. After soaking place meat on paper towels to drain water. Sprinkle one side with red pepper. Move oven rack to top of oven. Place toothpick through end of meat and hang on rack. Put oven on lowest setting. Use spoon to crack door open. Cook 8 to 12 hours; if crunchy at 8 hours take out. After cooling store in jar in refrigerator.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients except grated cheese in small casserole dish. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes until bubbly. Serve hot with crackers. Makes about 15 servings.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and pat in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with grated cheese and crushed potato chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: 5 Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the first 3 ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in tube (or Bundt) pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Cool in pan about 15 minutes. Remove from pan perforate cake and pour glaze over it while still warm.

title: Italian Style Halibut On Grill
instructions: In bowl combine Italian salad dressing lemon juice salt pepper and Tabasco sauce. Place halibut steaks in sauce. Let stand 30 minutes turning once. Place fish on grill basting occasionally with dressing mixture. Cook fish for 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily when tested with fork. Before serving sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Easy Bake Meat Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ground beef onion egg and cracker crumbs and shape into meatballs. Pour cream of celery soup and half a can of water over top of meatballs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour add baked potatoes and have a quick delicious meal. Serves 4.

title: Pork Chop Supreme
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Season with salt if desired. Place chops in large baking dish. Top each chop with an onion slice and a lemon or orange slice. Place 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1 tablespoon catsup on each chop. Cover and bake 1 hour. Uncover and bake at 15 to 20 minutes or until browned.

title: Crock-Pot Hot Cocoa For A Group
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar cocoa and salt. Add hot water slowly mixing well. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Boil and stir 2 minutes.

title: Karen'S Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In skillet heat oil over moderate heat. Add beef onion and garlic and cook 7 to 8 minutes stirring occasionally until meat is no longer pink. Drain off any fat. Add tomatoes tomato liquid tomato paste 1 tablespoon of parsley oregano salt basil and pepper to skillet. Reduce heat to low and simmer about 1 hour stirring occasionally until thick. Meanwhile in a medium size bowl mix cottage cheese Parmesan cheese eggs and remaining 2 tablespoons parsley with a fork until well mixed.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: Cut corn from cobs and scrape cobs to remove all milk. Heat butter and bacon drippings in a medium saucepan until hot. Add corn water salt and pepper. Cook uncovered over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 10 to 12 minutes. Stir frequently. Serves 10.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes celery onion and salt in 2 cups water about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Lightly mash with a potato masher and cook stirring constantly until soup is hot and thickened.

title: Dutch Apple Bread
instructions: Mix all except apples real well. Will look like biscuit dough. Place in baking dish. Push apples into dough.

title: Cheese Quiche (Grape-Nut)
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain and crumble. Reserve 1 tablespoon drippings. Saute onion in reserved bacon drippings until tender and lightly browned. Combine eggs milk cheese salt pepper and cereal. Stir in onion and bacon. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serves 4.

title: Fudgsicles
instructions: Mix and pour into ice cups and freeze.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies fine and pour in bowl. Set aside. Then mix milk and vanilla pudding together in a large bowl. Add Cool Whip.

title: Pinto Bean Pie
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and butter (melt butter). Fold beans into mixture (mix well). Bake in 9-inch pie pan with unbaked pie crust (350\u00b0) for about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Cook chicken in approximately 3 quarts (12 cups) of water. When done remove meat from bones and place back in broth. Add chopped celery sliced carrots and chopped onion. Allow to simmer 20 to 30 minutes on low heat or until vegetables are done.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine and mix well the sugar flour salt and vanilla. Add rhubarb and strawberries; mix well and put into pie shell. Dot with butter. Add top crust and cut slits in crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Cranberry Freeze
instructions: Spoon into 13 x 9 baking dish. Freeze 4 hours or overnight. Cut into squares.

title: Gram'S Donuts
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Add hot to additional ingredients. Roll out dough. Cut. Drop into hot oil until golden brown. Place on paper towel. Drop donuts in cinnamon/sugar or powdered sugar for variation.

title: Stollen
instructions: Dissolve yeast in milk; add flour and remaining ingredients (except glaze). Knead dough well then let rise in warm oven until double in bulk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Glaze if desired.

title: Swiss Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage until browned. Mash with potato masher until fine. Drain well. Combine mustard with sausage and blend. Cut bread slices diagonally. Space half of bread in bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle sausage over bread. Top with cheese slices. Space remaining bread slices evenly over cheese. Combine remaining ingredients until well blended. Pour egg mixture over bread. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until egg sets. Great for a guest brunch!

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: In a medium bowl combine milk and juice. Let stand a few minutes. Stir in whipped topping. Add food coloring if desired. Spoon into crust. Chill until firm. Yields 6 servings.

title: Ham Nibbles
instructions: Combine ham drained canned corn mayonnaise eggs and 1 cup cracker crumbs in medium bowl. Shape mixture in small balls about 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Roll in remaining cracker crumbs. Fry in deep hot fat (365\u00b0 to 375\u00b0) 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Yield 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream together sugar oil and eggs; blend in flour salt baking soda baking powder cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well. Add zucchini and nuts. Blend by hand. Pour into 13 x 5 x 3 loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Easy Caramel Corn(Microwave)
instructions: Place popped corn in large brown paper sack. Combine brown sugar margarine corn syrup and salt in a 1 1/2-quart batter bowl. Cook on High for 2 minutes or until bubbly. Stir; cook for 2 minutes or until bubbly. Stir; cook for 2 minutes more on High. Add soda and stir until mixture is foamy. Pour mixture over popcorn. Fold bag and place into microwave. Cook 1 1/2 minutes on High. Take out and shake like crazy. Place in microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Shake again and pour onto waxed paper.

title: Turkey Buns(Quick!)
instructions: Melt margarine in frypan over medium-high heat. Add onions and green pepper; saute until limp. Add turkey mixing well. Cook until no longer pink about 4 to 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except buns. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Spoon onto buns. Yields 8 servings.

title: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie
instructions: Remove pumpkin from can; freeze 1 hour. In a blender combine partially frozen pumpkin frozen apple juice concentrate nutmeg and cinnamon. Blend together until smooth. Continue to blend while adding water to fill the blender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Texas Style Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in dish. Cut potatoes up and place in dish. Sprinkle garlic salt pepper and chili powder over potatoes. Place chopped onions and peppers over the top of the potatoes. Cover with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Molded Ambrosia
instructions: Mix crumbs and margarine; reserve 1/3 for topping. Press remaining crumb mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water; stir in reserved syrup. Chill until partially set. Add sour cream and vanilla. Whip until fluffy. Fold in pineapple oranges and coconut. Pour over crumbs in pan. Sprinkle reserved crumbs over top. Chill until firm. Cut in squares. Trim with maraschino cherries if desired. Serves 9.

title: Music Salad
instructions: Mix the jello with the boiling water and cool. Add the remaining ingredients. Put in mold to set.

title: Cocoa Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in container. Use approximately 1/2 cup mix to each cup of hot water.

title: Turketti(Low-Fat)
instructions: Break spaghetti in 2-inch lengths. Cook. Drain well. Mix chopped turkey pimento green pepper onion soup broth and pepper. Add Velveeta cheese and spaghetti. With two forks lightly toss until well mixed.

title: Frozen Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Crush cookies in blender or food processor. Reserve some cookie crumbs for garnish. Put remaining crumbs in 9 x 13 pan and drizzle with melted margarine. Let set in freezer. Cover with softened ice cream. Freeze.

title: Chicken With Walnuts
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; set aside. In small bowl stir soy sauce into cornstarch; stir in dry sherry ginger root sugar salt and red pepper. Set aside. Preheat a wok over high heat. Add oil; stir-fry green peppers and onions in hot oil for 2 minutes or until crisp-tender. Remove from wok. Add half of the chicken to hot oil (add more oil if necessary); stir-fry 2 minutes. Remove from wok. Stir-fry remaining chicken for 2 minutes. Return all chicken to wok. Stir in soy mixture. Cook until thickened and bubbly. Stir in vegetables and walnuts. Cover and cook 1 minute more. Serve chicken and vegetables at once. Serve with hot cooked rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Dirt
instructions: Cream together the first 3 ingredients.

title: Chocolate Pies
instructions: First lightly brown pie shells in oven. Set aside to cool. In a double boiler melt margarine. Add milk. Separate egg yolks. Save whites and store in refrigerator. Stir egg yolks with spoon and add to milk and butter mixture in a double boiler (before milk gets hot). In a bowl mix together sugar salt flour and cocoa. Add to mixture in double boiler. Stir continually until filling thickens. Add flavoring. Pour filling in pie shells. Beat egg whites until foamy; add 1/2 cup of sugar and beat until stiff. Spread over pies and lightly brown in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients for cake together and bake for 40 minutes in an oven preheated to 350\u00b0.

title: Ham Balls With Raisin Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In large bowl with hands lightly mix ham ball ingredients and 1/4 teaspoon pepper until combined. Shape into 12 balls divided evenly. Arrange in shallow baking dish. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook peppers onion and eggplant in the bacon grease for 4 minutes. Add tomatoes salt cheese and bread crumbs. Put in 2-quart baking dish greased and top with bread crumbs bacon and cheese. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine coconut and milk. Set aside. Blend margarine sugar eggs and vanilla. Add coconut mixture. Mix well and turn into pie shell. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Combine butter sugar and dates. Cook 5 minutes on medium heat stirring until well blended. Add coconut nuts Rice Krispies vanilla and salt. Mix well. Shape into balls and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Chicken El Paso
instructions: On waxed paper combine crumbs and chili powder. In shallow dish dip chicken into dressing. Coat with crumb mixture. On baking sheet arrange chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink turning once during baking. Serve with salsa. Makes 4 servings. Prep Time 5 minutes. Cook Time 20 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken In  Honey Sauce(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Add honey orange juice lemon juice mustard salt and curry powder. Mix well. Coat chicken pieces with honey mixture and place skin-side down in baking dish.

title: Traditional Chex Party Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Heat butter in a large shallow roasting pan in oven until melted. Remove. Stir in salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add Chex cereals and nuts. Mix until all pieces are coated. Heat in oven for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes until done. Spread on paper towel to absorb excess oil until cool then pour in bowl.

title: Confetti Refrigerator Dessert
instructions: Bake and cool cake as directed on package. Tear cake into about 1-inch pieces. Beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla in large bowl on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally until smooth and creamy. Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff. Gently fold whipped cream cherries and marshmallows into cream cheese mixture. Toss cake pieces and cream cheese mixture. Turn into 2-quart casserole. Refrigerate until set about 8 hours. Refrigerate any remaining dessert. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Chewy Rice Krispies
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat; add marshmallows stirring until completely melted. Add the rest of the ingredients until well mixed. Press mixture into evenly buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. When cool cut into squares.

title: Delightful Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes with jackets on with bay leaves; peel and cut. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread over\tpotatoes in casserole.\tBake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Candy Popcorn
instructions: Over medium heat melt oleo. Stir in sugar syrup and salt. Stir until mixture comes to a boil. Boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Put corn in large pan and pour syrup over it. Stir until well mixed.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix well with mixer at medium speed. Bake in 3 layers at 350\u00b0.

title: Fudge
instructions: Place sugar margarine and milk in medium size heavy pan. With heat set on medium stir constantly with wooden spoon until temperature reaches 234\u00b0 or to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add chips first; stir. Then add cream vanilla and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. \Enjoy.\

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and put in greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Foolproof Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil and eggs. Add sugar and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add to oil mixture. Add apples and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in tube pan.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook water sugar and cornstarch until thick. Remove from heat and add jello. Dissolve and cool. Pour over quart of strawberries in a baked pie shell. Chill.

title: Frosted Pecans
instructions: Beat the egg white until frothy. Add 1 tablespoon of water and mix in pecans. In another bowl mix 1 cup of sugar cinnamon mix and add to the other ingredients. Stir. Spread on cookie sheet and bake for 1 hour at 200\u00b0. Put in a paper bag and break it up.

title: Molasses Crinkles(Cookies)
instructions: Mix shortening sugar egg and molasses thoroughly with an electric mixer. Sift flour soda salt cloves cinnamon and ginger together. Mix dry ingredients into egg mixture. Chill. Roll into 1 1/4-inch balls. Dip tops of dough balls in sugar. Place balls sugared side up 3-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not hard.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
instructions: Combine ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup onions. Pour into casserole dish bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake for an additional 5 minutes uncovered or until onions are golden. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix cooked potatoes and ham and put in casserole dish. Saute onions in margarine. Add flour salt and pepper and make roux for sauce. Add milk stir until thickened. Add cheese until melted. Pour over potato mixture and mix. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Easy Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Line frozen ice cream bar sandwiches into the bottom of a 9x12-in pan (cut to fit). Cover with cool whip. Use half the container. Pour fudge topping over cool whip. Line another layer of ice cream bar sandwiches. Cover with the rest of the cool whip. Top with caramel ice cream topping. Sprinkle with peanuts. Refrigerate.

title: Mrs. Harry M. Schoppert'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together saving 1/2 of cheese to put on top. Place in a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Before putting in oven spread rest of cheese on top. You can add almonds on top too if you want. Can be prepared a day or 2 ahead.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots until tender. Drain and cool. Place layers of carrots onion and pepper in 2-quart casserole dish. Combine all other ingredients; mix well. Pour over carrots. Cover with plastic wrap or aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 until bubbly. Can be served hot or cold.

title: Chili Oil
instructions: The secret to a good mustard dipping sauce is to add 1/3 part white vinegar to 2/3 parts water when mixing with your powdered mustard for dipping your prawns won tons etc.

title: Baked Carrot Ring
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In mixer cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add carrots and mix. Sift together flour baking powder and baking soda. Add these ingredients to first mixture and mix only until well combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Soup
instructions: Place pork loin in a 4 to 6-quart covered stockpot and cover with water. Cook until meat is tender; cool slightly and slice or cube as desired. Place the meat and vegetables in the remaining broth and add the V-8 juice. Simmer until vegetables are tender. Serve with crackers and/or cornbread.

title: Marinated Tomatoes
instructions: Arrange tomatoes and cheese in bottom of shallow dish. In a small jar with tight fitting lid place corn oil vinegar parsley onion basil salt and pepper. Cover and shake well. Pour over tomatoes and cheese. Cover and refrigerate several hours spooning herb mixture over tomatoes occasionally.

title: Icebox Fruitcake
instructions: Roll out crackers to a fine meal. Mix all dry ingredients to crackers. Melt marshmallows in milk over a double boiler on low heat. Stir to keep from burning. Pour mixed fruit and meal. Mix well. Pack back into cracker box and store in icebox.

title: Million Dollar Salad
instructions: Drain juices from pineapple and grapes. Add pineapple cut up cherries grapes and bananas to marshmallows. Mix the cream cheese sugar mayonnaise and cherry juice together. Fold this mixture into marshmallows pineapple grapes and bananas. Whip the cream (if using sweet cream); fold into mixture. If using Cool Whip fold into other mixture. Chill and serve.

title: Vegetable Manicotti
instructions: Microwave shells to desired doneness. In small bowl combine zucchini broccoli mushrooms Parmesan cheese and green pepper. Mix well and fill each shell with 1/2 cup of mixture. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over shells. Cover with wax paper and microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes turning dish 1/4 turn halfway through cooking. Sprinkle with cheese and microwave uncovered on High 1 to 2 minutes until cheese is melted. Makes 2 servings.

title: Freezer Daiquiri
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in glass or plastic container in deep freezer for 8 to 12 hours before serving. About 30 minutes before serving remove from freezer. Mixture should be icy. Any portion not used may be frozen again. You may want to omit one can of pink lemonade and add one 10 ounce package of frozen strawberries. For a tart taste add juice of 2 lemons. This will never freeze solid. This recipe makes about 2 quarts or 20 to 25 cocktails.

title: Tropical Coconut Pineapple Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease 9 x 13 pan. Prepare cake mix using 1/2 cup yogurt and 1 egg. Spread batter onto the bottom of prepared pan. Bake 10 minutes. While baking in a bowl mix remaining yogurt egg pineapple brown sugar and coconut. Carefully spread yogurt mixture on top of partially baked batter. Bake bars 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely before cutting into bars. Mix confectioners sugar and 2 tablespoons reserved pineapple juice to create a glaze. Drizzle over cooked bars.

title: Mexican Pile-Upgroves, Texas
instructions: Brown meat slowly until browned then add taco sauce and water to cover. Simmer until water is cooked out.

title: Hazelnut Chocolate Candy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange 1 cup hazelnuts on jelly roll pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Wrap in kitchen towel and rub nuts to remove skins. Cool then coarsely chop. Microwave 12 squares chocolate chopped in bowl on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes stirring once halfway through until smooth. Stir in nuts.

title: Norwegian Coffee Bread(Norske Kaffe Brod)
instructions: Heat milk to lukewarm. Remove from heat and dissolve yeast in milk. Add 2 tablespoons sugar. Stir in flour until smooth. When smooth sprinkle flour on top; cover and set on stove. Let rise 1 hour or until double in size.

title: Sushi Su
instructions: Combine the ingredients; boil gently until dissolved.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa together. Add enough of the water to make a paste. Beat in egg yolks well. Heat remaining water with butter and salt until butter is melted. Add water mixture to first mixture and cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Cool and pour into baked 9-inch pie shell. Cover with meringue and brown.

title: Raisin Cream Pie
instructions: Cook raisins in small amount of water for 12 minutes. Drain water off raisins. Add the rest of ingredients; cook until thick then cool. Pour into the pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Peanut Butter Snowballs
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine sugar peanut butter and oleo; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and place on a waxed lined cookie sheet. Chill for 30 minutes or until firm.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Makes 3 gallons.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Dredge each chicken breast halve in flour; dip in egg and coat with bread crumbs. Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook chicken 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Place chicken in a 9-inch square baking dish; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients mixing well. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hello Dollies
instructions: Melt butter in bottom of dish. Make sure it covers the whole bottom of the dish. Sprinkle a layer of graham cracker crumbs covering the bottom. Pat down with a spoon. Next add a layer of chocolate chips then add a layer of coconut. Cover with Pet milk (evenly). Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden. Let cool for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Cheese-Herb Bread
instructions: Brush French bread halves with Italian dressing; top with American cheese slices or grated Cheddar cheese tomato slices sliced onion and chopped fresh basil. Broil until cheese begins to melt.

title: Golden Lemon Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken in egg then flour. In 12-inch skillet melt butter and brown chicken over medium heat 4 minutes turning once. Stir in soup mix blended with water. Arrange lemon slices on chicken. Bring to a boil then simmer covered 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened and chicken is done.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Red Beans With Tomato Sauce
instructions: Soak beans 2 or 3 hours; drain. Chop cooked bacon finely. Place in large saucepan with water; cover. Boil 10 minutes. Then add beans tomato sauce onion pepper pods garlic bay leaf cumin seeds salt and pepper. Cover and let simmer 3 hours or until beans are tender. Stir often. Add more water or tomato sauce as needed. Remove bay leaf before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Granola Bars
instructions: Blend 2nd bowl with 1st bowl and mix well. Spoon into paper lined muffin tins and bake at 325 for about 45 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Roast Beef And Gravy
instructions: Rub roast with salt and pepper. Mix soups and water. Put half of mixture into aluminum foil. Add meat and cover with other half of mixture. Close and cook at 325\u00b0 until tender. Take up roast with delicious gravy.

title: Quick Veggies And Pasta
instructions: Boil noodles and vegetables approximately 10 minutes. Drain. Add butter and salt to taste. Serve with Parmesan cheese and parsley.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Cook remaining ingredients in a baking dish uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Clam Fritters
instructions: Heat oil to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients until thick and stays on spoon. Pat batter into pan to form patty. Brown on each side. Serve hot. Good leftover and in sandwiches.

title: Pfeffernuesse
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate 1 day. Take 1 tsp. of batter and roll into ball (approximately size of walnut). Use powdered sugar on hands if it sticks. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes. Bake until no indentation remains when touched. Roll in powdered sugar. Will keep for months at room temperature in a glass container. They stay nice and soft.

title: Three Potato Salad
instructions: Place all potatoes in Dutch oven. Cover with water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cook 20 or 30 minutes. Drain and cool. Place potatoes in a large bowl. Add onion. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour over potato mixture and toss gently to coat. Cover and refrigerate. Makes 15 servings.

title: Sunday Sunday Chicken
instructions: In medium bowl combine soups butter and rice. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place chicken pieces over rice mixture. Brush with remainder of butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 275\u00b0 for about 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender. Very good.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Melt remaining margarine and add to beaten eggs milk bread sugar and other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Hard-Boiled Egg Casserole
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a saucepan over low heat. Add onion and cook until tender. Combine flour and milk with butter and onion stirring constantly until thickened. Add cheese until melted. Layer half of the eggs in a 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch dish. Pour half the onion and cheese mixture over the eggs. Sprinkle half of the potato chips and half of the bacon over the mixture. Repeat this process with the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cream together all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shells (not the deep-dish). Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Makes 3 or 4 pies.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: Combine cider and cinnamon sticks in pot and bring to a boil. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve hot in mugs; garnish with apple wedges.

title: Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef add sauce; simmer a few minutes. In a small saucepan mix soup and green chilies; warm for a few minutes. Pour beef mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with 2 layers of tortillas. Pour in soup mixture top with cheese. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Good Candy!
instructions: Combine chocolate and butterscotch chips in a double boiler until melted. Add nuts and noodles to chocolate mixture. Cover cookie sheet with waxed paper. Put by teaspoonful on cookie sheet and put in freezer. Store in freezer taking out shortly before serving.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese in soup. Add drained tomatoes and drained hominy. Cover with crushed Fritos and bake at 350\u00b0 until warm about 20 minutes.

title: Microwave Custard
instructions: Microwave milk in a 2-quart dish on High for 3 to 4 minutes until almost boiling. Mix together eggs sugar salt and vanilla and add to milk stirring to mix. Sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon. Cook on Medium-high rotating dish occasionally until knife comes out clean.

title: Vegetable Beef And Chicken Casserole
instructions: In skillet brown beef; spoon off fat. Stir in soups water mixed vegetables and Worcestershire sauce. Spoon into 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until hot. Meanwhile cut each biscuit into quarters. Remove dish from oven; stir. Arrange biscuits on hot mixture. Top with cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Blend butter and flour in saucepan until smooth. Add half and half and milk stirring constantly. Cook over low heat until thick. Add bouillon cubes and cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Add cooked broccoli.

title: Cherry Or Strawberry Winks
instructions: In a bowl mix all ingredients together adding just enough liquid to make a stiff dough. Drop from teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Optional Either place chopped cherries or cherry halves on small indentation in middle of cookie or mix all cherries (chopped) in dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove and cool on rack.

title: Zucchini Fritters
instructions: Grate zucchini. Add eggs salt pepper parsley and grated cheese. Add enough flour to hold shape when dropped by tablespoonfuls into hot shallow oil. Brown on both sides and drain on paper towels. Serve immediately. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar and cocoa in a medium saucepan. Add yolks of eggs and milk. Mix well. Add margarine. Mix and cook on medium heat stirring constantly with a rubber spatula. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Stir. Pour filling into crust and top with meringue.

title: Cheesy Chicken Over Rice
instructions: Put all in skillet; stir until well blended and bubbling hot. Serve over rice.

title: Queema (Ground Beef) Or Beef
instructions: Cut and fry onion in vegetable oil until red. Add meat and other ingredients. Let it cook on high heat for about 5 minutes then turn the heat down. Let it cook until the meat is tender.

title: Cherry Pudding
instructions: Mix as for a cake. Put in a buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle 2 cups cherries over this and 1 cup sugar over the cherries. Cover all with 2 cups of boiling water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. (Raspberries or other fruits may be substituted and adjust the sugar accordingly.)

title: Mona'S Tamale Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Brown hamburger and drain. Drain corn and pureed tomatoes. Add to the meat. Add taco mix. Pour mixture into greased casserole dish. Top with cheese and cornbread mix. Bake for 30 minutes or until cornbread is golden.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain egg noodles. Saute onion and pepper in 2 tablespoons margarine. Combine and mix well mushroom soup salad dressing mustard milk tuna fish and cooked egg noodles. Add onion and pepper to above mixture. Bake on 425\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Serve hot.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Melt butter in milk; heat to scalding point. Sift dry ingredients. Mix all ingredients except lemon pudding mix; pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned. Cut the cake into 2 layers. Prepare 1 package of lemon pudding mix; spoon onto bottom layer. Place top layer on top of the pudding. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into 4 small loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. You can pour into 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Avocado Taco Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans on large platter. Mix mayonnaise sour cream and taco mix; spread on beans. Spread with avocado mix. Spread with chopped olives. Spread with grated Cheddar cheese. Use any kind of chips or crackers to dip with. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Bishop Sheen'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Put meat in bowl. Add onions peppers bread garlic parsley egg salt pepper and applesauce; mix well. Form into loaf shape; flour well. Oil pan and place floured loaf in pan. Add catsup on top of loaf. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0\u00b0 for 2 hours. Uncover for last 15 minutes.

title: Diet Waffles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Heat waffle iron and use a cup measure to pour batter onto waffle iron. Cook until golden brown. Serve hot with fresh fruit slices.

title: Breakfast Apples
instructions: Combine all ingredients except apples; bring to a boil. Pare apples core cut in eights and add to syrup. Cook slowly until done 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and cool in syrup. Remove spices and lemon. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Chip Squares
instructions: Mix all together (chips last) and bake.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to a boil first 3 ingredients. Mix together the last 6 ingredients. Pour liquid mixture into dry mixture and beat until well mixed. Bake in a 15 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broiled Scallops
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Saute garlic. Place scallops in oiled baking dish; pour butter over them. Sprinkle salt pepper and cheese over scallops and broil 6 to 8 minutes. Serve with lemon slices.

title: Chokecherry Wine
instructions: Keep in warm place 21 days. Stir and let stand another 21 days; strain. Ready to bottle up.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix butter brown sugar and pretzels together. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Mix strawberry Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water and the strawberries. Cool until the mixture begins to set. Cream the cream cheese sugar and whipped topping; spread on top of cooled crust. Cover with strawberry mixture and refrigerate.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs. Drain immediately and run cold water over eggs. Peel eggs and place in narrow deep jar. In medium saucepan combine all other ingredients except sliced onions. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Place onion slices on top of eggs; pour hot vinegar on top of eggs making sure they are completely covered. Cover tightly; refrigerate for several days.

title: Apricot Cake
