instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts together. Stir well and beat for 5 minutes with mixer. Spray Bundt pan very good with Pam. Add nuts to mix and stir well. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour but remove the instant it is done. Let cool to lukewarm. Leave in pan.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix together and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spicy Mexican Brunch Eggs(Serves 8 To 12)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Over medium heat cook sausage mushrooms and onion. Drain well. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Combine eggs and sour cream in blender. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish (greased). Bake until eggs are softly set 5 to 10 minutes. Spoon salsa over eggs. Add sausage mixture. Top with Velveeta then Mozzarella and Cheddar.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together. Pour 1/3 batter into greased tube pan. Sprinkle with 1/3 chocolate chips. Mix 1/3 more batter with all of chocolate syrup. Pour on top of other batter. Sprinkle with 1/3 more chocolate chips. Pour rest of batter on top and sprinkle with rest of chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: My Own Beef Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potato. Add potato when stew is almost done. Bring stew to boil and then lower to simmer until done.

title: Eloise'S Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix well. Make patty cakes or put in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Creamed Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes with salt and margarine until tender. Drain well. Whip. Beat in cream cheese and sour cream. Pour into buttered baking dish. Sprinkle grated cheese on top if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Best if made up the night before. Store tightly covered in refrigerator overnight before baking.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
instructions: Sort and wash peas; place in a heavy saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil; cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let soak 1 hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Form in large ball. Roll in nuts. Wrap in foil and refrigerate.

title: Cheesy Macaroni Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Spray a 6-cup shallow baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut cheeses into cubes. Cook macaroni according to package directions. If using fresh broccoli put in with macaroni 3 minutes before pasta is done. Drain macaroni; leave in pot. Add Cheddar Mozzarella bacon bits mustard salt and red pepper. If using thawed frozen broccoli add it now. Spoon mixture into the prepared baking dish. Pour milk evenly over top. Bake until bubbly and golden 18 to 21 minutes. Makes 4 servings (1 1/4 cups).

title: Baby Potatoes With Garlic And Rosemary
instructions: Steam potatoes until tender about 20 minutes. Saute garlic in olive oil for a minute or two then add rosemary and saute another minute. Toss drained potatoes in garlic mixture. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Strawberries
instructions: Stir coconut pecans and 1 package jello. Add milk and extract. Mix well and refrigerate overnight covered.

title: Our Mary'S Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Fry bacon and break up into pieces. Fry hamburger. Fry onion. Put all ingredients into crock-pot and can cook all day.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip the cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add milk blending thoroughly. Fold topping in. Pour into crust; chill until firm. Top with chocolate syrup.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Spray 9 x 12-inch baking dish with Pam. Mix ingredients and put in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes to 1 hour or until brown.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Saute shallots in 4 Tbsp. of butter for 5 minutes. Add oysters with their liquor. Bring to a boil add milk and cream salt and pepper. Simmer 2 minutes. Add sherry and again bring to a boil. Serve at once with a tsp. of butter in each serving.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well. Pour into double boiler and cook until mixture coats spoon and is thick. Into a medium sized dish or bowl layer wafers and thin slices of banana. Add vanilla to pudding mixture after removing from stove. Mix well. Pour pudding into the bowl. Let cool.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Mix ingredients together with enough Bisquick to thicken. Drop by teaspoons into hot oil and fry until brown.

title: Candy
instructions: Melt almond bark and Crisco oil together. Add remaining ingredients. Place on foil on 2 cookie sheets.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Boil chicken until done; save broth. Fry onion in oil until clear. Add chicken pieces green mango curry and flour until browned. Add broth and tomatoes. Simmer 45 minutes. Serve over rice if desired.

title: Easy Chewy Pecan Squares
instructions: Blend ingredients until just moistened. Spread mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool; cut into squares and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Yields 24 (2-inch) squares.

title: Ham With Red-Eye Gravy
instructions: In large skillet over medium heat brown a thick slice of ham about 1/2-inch thick; turn and cook until browned and heated through. Remove ham to platter. Add 2 cups water to pan drippings over medium heat with spoon stir drippings to loosen from bottom of pan heat to boiling and boil 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve gravy over ham with grits. Delicious with biscuits.

title: Hot Ham And Cheese Rolls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Slice ham and cheese into long strips to fit each row of rolls. Halve rows a row at a time and place ham and cheese strips inside rolls. Pour mixture over rolls and bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 until cheese is thoroughly melted.

title: White Chili(Lighter Eating - 1.5 Points Per Cup)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low 8-10 hours or high for 4-5 hours.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together; add pecans apples eggs and margarine. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in sugar syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popcorn; mix well. Spread into large shallow baking pans or cookie sheets. Bake in oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mini Meat Loaves 'N Vegetables
instructions: Combine meat salt egg 1/2 can tomato sauce Italian seasoning and 1/2 can French fried onions. In 9 x 13-inch baking dish form 3 mini loaves. Place potatoes around loaves. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Place vegetables around loaves; stir to combine with the potatoes. Lightly season with salt and pepper if desired. Top meat loaves with remaining tomato sauce. Bake uncovered 15 minutes. Top loaves with remaining onions; bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Makes 3 to 6 servings.

title: Barbecued Brisket
instructions: Sprinkle brisket with pepper and paprika. Slice onions on top to cover. Mix remaining ingredients well and pour over meat. Marinate overnight. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for about 3 to 4 hours depending on oven and thickness of meat. When ready to serve slice very thinly against the grain and serve with sauce.

title: Curry Dip
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in blender and process for 30 seconds. Add last 3 ingredients and process about 15 seconds. Contents per tablespoon calories 9 sodium 44 mg.

title: Rose'S Cheese Balls
instructions: Let cream cheese get to room temperature. (Important to have cream cheese soft.) Add other ingredients. Mix well. Place in fridge until hard. Shape.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Coke and marshmallows in a large mixing bowl. Blend at low speed; beat 1 minute at medium speed. Add Coke; blend well. By hand stir in marshmallows. Pour batter into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Cool about 30 minutes. Spread with Cola Icing.

title: Black Cherry Yummmm
instructions: Drain liquid from cherries and pineapple into saucepan or measuring cup. Add enough Coke to make 1 cup. Heat to boil and add Jell-O. Let cool to room temperature. Add rest of Coke and other ingredients. Pour into an 8-inch square dish. Refrigerate until jelled. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Mix salad dressing and sugar together. Sift flour soda and cocoa together and combine with other mixture. Add water and vanilla. Bake in two layers at 350\u00b0 until done. Frost with 7 Minute Frosting.

title: Chicken With Dumplings
instructions: Cook chicken in boiling salted water until tender. Remove chicken saving 4 cups broth. Debone chicken; set aside. Skim broth saving 6 tablespoons chicken fat. Combine 6 tablespoons flour with fat in bowl; blend well. Add a small amount of reserved broth stirring until smooth. Stir flour into 4 cups of broth in saucepan. Cook over low heat until slightly thickened stirring constantly. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Soon To Be Your Favorite Party Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and blend until smooth. The consistency of the dip can be controlled by the amount of lemon juice used. Chill thoroughly and serve with potato chips.

title: Old Fashioned Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In sauce pan melt butter. Stir in flour garlic salt and pepper until well blended. Gradually stir in water milk and bouillon. Bring to a boil and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from heat stir in chicken and veggies set aside.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain juice from whole corn. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Salmon Cheese Casserole
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in scalded milk. Pour over bread crumbs and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Add cheese salmon and salmon liquid to bread crumbs and mix well. Add eggs mix lightly and pour into a buttered casserole dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Mornay
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onions in margarine. Add shrimp and wine; cook 2 to 3 minutes or until shrimp are pink. Remove vegetables and shrimp from pan with slotted spoon. Add cream cheese and milk to pan. Stir over low heat with wire whisk until smooth. Add Swiss cheese; stir until cheese is melted. Return shrimp and vegetables to pan; mix lightly. Serve with rice or pasta. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pinto Bean Soup
instructions: Cook onions slightly in butter. Put into a blender with the beans chicken stock and seasonings and blend. Transfer to a saucepan and simmer for 10 minutes. Add tomato juice. Heat and serve. Float 1 tablespoon of fresh cream on top of each cup.

title: Jello Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Dough will be soft. Place dough in a cookie press and place 1-inch apart on a cookie sheet. Put sprinkles on cookies and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Enjoy this great treat.

title: Kielbasa Delight
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 3-inch loaf pieces. Spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix pineapple chili sauce and brown sugar and pour over kielbasa. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Baste frequently.

title: French Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all together with a wire whip.

title: Candy Popcorn
instructions: Bring sugar water and cream of tartar to boil covered. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add margarine and baking soda. Pour over popcorn and stir thoroughly. Must be cane sugar or it will just crumble up and not stick to the popcorn.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Form beef rice parsley onion salt and garlic salt into walnut sized meatballs. Parboil 1 medium whole head of cabbage.

title: Honey Mustard Dressing
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix well. Add and mix next 4 ingredients. Slowly add the oil while beating with electric mixer.

title: Souper Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine soup eggs and milk; stir in muffin mix until blended. Gently fold in sausage. Into greased 9-inch square baking pan pour in muffin mixture. Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Pistachio Bundt Cake
instructions: Beat cake mix pudding mix oil water and orange juice. Add eggs one at a time beat on high for 2 minutes. Remove about 1/4 to 1/3 of batter to smaller bowl and set aside. Add 3/4 cup Hersheys syrup to large batter and beat until mixed. Pour into well-greased and floured Bundt pan. Take reserved batter and pour onto chocolate batter keeping away from sides and tube. Can substitute other pudding flavors such as banana or chocolate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Test for doneness.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease baking sheet with Crisco. Combine Crisco brown sugar egg milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat with mixer until well blended. Combine oats flour soda salt and cinnamon. Mix into creamed mixture until blended. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop rounded teaspoonful 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. In another large bowl put shortening and sugar. Cream together until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in mashed bananas. Add flour mixture about 1/4 at a time. Mix until smooth each time. Mix in nuts and pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes or until bread is browned and pulls slightly away from sides of pan. Let stand in pan 5 minutes. Cool before slicing.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes 1/2 cup margarine onion soup sour cream and cheese; stir well. Spoon into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Crush cereal and stir into remaining butter. Sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Fresh Peach Cobbler
instructions: Slice peaches and mix with 3/4 cup of sugar; let stand 2 hours. Sift together the flour salt and baking powder. Mix with 1 cup of sugar. Stir in milk and almond extract. Melt butter in baking dish. Pour batter over butter; do not stir. Pour the peaches over the top of the batter to form a layer. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes; with glass baking dish bake at 325\u00b0. Check as end of baking time approaches as you do not want the juices to caramelize. Serve with whipped cream if desired. Serves 6.

title: Smoked Kielbasi Appetizer
instructions: Slice smoked kielbasi in 1-inch slices. Place in microwave dish. Top kielbasi with 1 teaspoon of brown sugar. With toothpicks place a pineapple chunk on top. Microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until hot.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; drain. Add tomatoes and chili. Mix well. Simmer 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Bread Dressing And Pork Chops
instructions: Break bread into bowl; pour milk onion egg sage salt and pepper over bread and mix. Add more milk if needed to moisten bread. Brown pork chops. Place 2 chops in bottom of greased casserole; add dressing and put 2 chops on top. Add a small amount of water to grease from chops; pour over top of casserole. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Yields 4 servings.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray muffin tins with vegetable cooking spray. In large bowl combine first 5 ingredients. In separate bowl combine bananas applesauce egg and orange juice. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon batter into muffin tin and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Old Time Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add flour and eggs beat well. Stir buttermilk vanilla flavoring and nutmeg. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 to 50 min at 350\u00b0. Cool before serving. Serves 8.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Boil onion and chopped squash until tender and drain. Add butter mayonnaise egg salt and pepper. Mix well. Fold in cheese and pour into 8 x 8 greased casserole dish.\tTop with Ritz crackers crumbled and mixed with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl. Serve immediately. Yield 40 servings.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Dissolve in hot water. Add cold water juice and ginger ale. Makes approximately 30 cups. The colder the better!

title: Stuffed Turkey Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium skillet saute onion and celery in butter or margarine until translucent. In a medium bowl combine onion celery stuffing mix eggs and water; mix well. In a large bowl combine ground turkey plus half the stuffing mixture mixed well. Pat out half the turkey stuffing mixture in 4 1/2 x 8 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan. Spoon remaining stuffing over turkey mixture. Pour tomato juice on top. Bake for 1 1/2 hours until turkey is no longer pink. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Remarkable Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar milk and butter to soft ball stage (cook on medium heat). Stir often. Remove from heat; add chocolate chips marshmallow cream vanilla and nuts. Mix until chocolate is melted and blended. Pour into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; cool and cut in squares.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients mix well. Stir in flour drop by tablespoonfuls into 1/2 inch hot oil. Cook until browned turning once. Drain. Yield 6 servings.

title: Sorbet A La Fraise(Strawberry Ice)
instructions: Set aside 4 perfect strawberries with stems. Wash and cap remaining strawberries. Puree strawberries in blender food processor (with a steel blade) or food mill. Combine puree with confectioners sugar and lemon juice. Pour mixture into a 1-quart metal pan or ice cube tray. Freeze until mushy and frozen 1/2 inch around sides.

title: E-Z Cream Cheese Dips(Serves 5)
instructions: Mix 1 container cream cheese with marshmallow cream. Serve with fruit.

title: Bob'S Favorite Chocolate Chip-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; add both sugars and molasses and cream well. Add eggs (beat 1 minute). Add raisins chips and nuts to mixture. Blend remaining ingredients into mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake. Take out when tops of cookies look doughy. Makes a large batch.

title: Raspberry Bars
instructions: Cream butter and just 1/4 cup sugar. Beat in egg yolks. Blend in flour. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Meatball Mix
instructions: Combine the ingredients. Mix well. Store in refrigerator up 2 months.

title: Broccoli Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli and spinach according to directions on package. Mix all ingredients together except cheese and cracker crumbs. Add cheese and crumbs on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar. Cream well. Add eggs. Mix thoroughly. Add dry ingredients. Then add mashed bananas and sour milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes a large loaf.

title: Cold Tomato - Yogurt Soup
instructions: Puree tomatoes in processor or blender. Add remaining ingredients except garnish and mix until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning. Pour into bowl cover and chill well. Garnish each serving with yogurt and minced parsley.

title: Ricki'S Make-Ahead Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in a Dutch oven or large kettle; cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Drain and place in a bowl; mash. Add sour cream cream cheese 4 Tbsp. butter onion and salt; stir until smooth and the cream cheese and butter are melted. Spread in a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Melt remaining butter; drizzle over potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes; uncover and bake 20 minutes longer. If potatoes are made ahead and refrigerated let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before baking. Yield 12 servings.

title: Phyl'S Topari Tree
instructions: Insert endive on toothpicks all around a tree-shaped piece of Styrofoam. Then insert remaining ingredients with toothpicks all around tree. Curl carrots.

title: Salamio Roll
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and knead for 5 minutes. Pack tightly and cover. Put in refrigerator. Knead mixture for 5 minutes on the 2nd and 3rd day. On the 4th day knead again for 5 minutes. Form into 1 pound rolls. Bake on broiler pan. Set oven on 175\u00b0 to 200\u00b0. Bake for 4 hours. Turn rolls every hour. Meat will appear red when fully cooked.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs; beat well. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Gradually add flour mixture to creamed mixture. Beat well. Stir in chips and nuts if desired. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool slightly before removing from cookie sheet. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Baked Hominy
instructions: Beat egg well. Add hominy and mix well. Add rest of ingredients. Spoon into an 11 x 7 x 2-inch pan. Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until top begins to brown. Let set for a few minutes before serving. Garnish with parsley if desired. Serves 8.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate cheeses and mix all together. Add 5 drops of Worcestershire sauce and sprinkle some garlic salt on it to taste. Form the cheeses into a ball with your hands. Roll the cheese ball over the chopped pecans. Serve with vegetable crackers.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Heat first 2 ingredients together in saucepan on stove. Do not add water to Jell-O. Mix next 2 ingredients in bowl and beat until mixture thickens. Add sour cream and Cool Whip and mix well. Dip vanilla wafers in milk and layer in a large dish. Use half of the wafers for the first layer. For second layer layer half of the pudding mix. Layer half of strawberry mixture for third layer. Repeat layers. Top with wafers.

title: Cheesy French Bread
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and butter. Add cheese onions garlic and olives. Split French bread lengthwise. Spread half of mixture on each half of bread. Place each half with butter side up on baking sheet in oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 until topping is crusty or until cheese melts.

title: Fasnachts
instructions: Bring milk and lard to the boiling point but do not boil. Stir in sugar and salt; let cool to lukewarm. Beat eggs and add to the milk. Soak yeast cake in 2 tablespoons warm water and keep warm. Sift and measure the flour.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Can add onion green chilies Mexican tomatoes and chili beans.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in brown sugar lemon juice garlic and hot sauce. Remove from heat. In large skillet heat oil over medium heat. Fry wings turning occasionally for 10 minutes or until brown and very well done. Remove and drain on paper towels. Keep hot or bake wings in a single layer at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Creamy Spinach And Fettucini
instructions: In skillet melt 1/2 the butter add garlic and onion cook until golden. Add spinach cover pan cook until spinach is heated through. Meanwhile cook noodles. Drain and return to pot. Toss with remaining butter spinach mixture Parmesan and cream until all are blended and heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Aunt Hattie'S Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into medium-size greased casserole dish. Bake uncovered 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrot Bread
instructions: Cream eggs sugar and oil together. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake for 80 minutes at 325\u00b0 in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pan.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Mix together chicken broth refried beans and tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Shred chicken breasts and add to the soup. Cut flour tortillas in strips and bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly browned. Place soup in individual bowls top with cheese then place tortilla chips on top.

title: Instant Cocoa
instructions: Mix and store. One serving is 3 teaspoons of mixture to 1 cup of boiling water.

title: Broccoli Salad 2
instructions: Break florets into small pieces; add onion and cheese. Dice bacon and fry until crisp; drain well and add to broccoli mixture. Combine mayonnaise vinegar and sugar stirring until sugar is dissolved. Pour over vegetables. Chill.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Fill baked pie crust with sliced strawberries. Bring sugar cornstarch Jell-O and water to boil. Cook until mixture becomes clear looking. Cool slightly. Pour over sliced strawberries; refrigerate. Top with Cool Whip.

title: The Original Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine milk and lime juice. Add slightly beaten egg yolks. Pour into pie shell and bake 10 minutes. Make meringue by beating egg whites and cream of tartar and gradually adding sugar. Cover pie with meringue spreading to edges over crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 until lightly browned about 10 minutes.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Boil the squash and onion in water until tender; drain. Next add the cornmeal and egg. Continue stirring and add the milk and cheese if you prefer. Drop the patties into hot grease preferably in an iron skillet. Cook just the same as you would any other type of patty. Cook on low or medium. Brown and drain on a paper towel.

title: Chicken Fried Tacos
instructions: Boil chicken breasts and debone; cut into small pieces. Saute chopped onions in Wesson oil. Add chicken and heat until piping hot. Season with salt and pepper. Thaw tortillas. Fill with chicken and onions and roll up. Stick with a toothpick to hold together. Fry in hot grease. Serve with Roys Best of the Bayou picante sauce. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients; pour in casserole. On top put strips of Swiss cheese and almonds. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 more minutes.

title: Coffee Cake Dough
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt and margarine. Cool to lukewarm. Measure water into large warm bowl; sprinkle in yeast. Stir until dissolved. Stir in milk mixture egg and 1/2 the flour; beat until smooth. Add remaining flour to make a stiff batter. Cover loosely with aluminum foil; refrigerate for at least 2 hours. (Dough may be kept in refrigerator up to 3 days.) Finish as directed in individual recipes.

title: Sponge Cake
instructions: Sift together flour 1 cup sugar and baking powder into small mixer bowl. Measure egg whites salt and cream of tartar into large mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer at high speed until very soft mounds begin to form. Beat 1/2 cup additional sugar into egg whites a tablespoon at a time. Continue beating until very stiff straight peaks form when beater is raised. Do not underbeat.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Toss vegetables. Mix together mayonnaise lemon juice sugar and salt. Combine with vegetables. Best if refrigerated overnight.

title: Strawberry Cheese Delight
instructions: Make a coconut crust with coconut sugar and flour. Blend in margarine and press onto bottom of 9-inch spring pan or 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes; chill.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Mix well. Put small amount cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 60 minutes until bubbly.

title: Artichoke Spinach Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta; drain and rinse with cold water. Combine cooled pasta spinach tomatoes artichokes and cheese in a large bowl; toss gently.

title: Pea Soup
instructions: Wash peas well. Soak peas overnight in water to cover and then drain. Put peas in soup kettle with 2 1/2 quarts of water the cut up ham hocks and the sliced onion. Add freshly ground black pepper to taste. Bring to a boil then reduce heat so soup just simmers and cook for 2 hours. I serve this with dark rye bread and butter.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
instructions: In casserole dish place a layer of potatoes (cut into pieces). Then add chopped onion salt and pepper to taste. Then add melted butter. Chop the ham and add to this. Pour mushroom soup on top of ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix margarine powdered sugar and 1 cup flour together and pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. While baking mix rest of ingredients together on low speed. Pour on hot crust and continue baking for 20 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar while warm. Cut when cool.

title: Cookie Cookies
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients until dry buds form. Add egg. Roll into balls place on cookie sheet flatten. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 minutes.

title: Sorghum Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Combine remaining ingredients. Add sifted ingredients and mix thoroughly. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: 48-Hour Cole Slaw
instructions: Chop cabbage and carrots. Mix together and stir in vinegar sugar and mayonnaise. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and refrigerate up to 48 hours before serving. Stir every 12 hours if possible. Great with fish or chicken. Serves 6.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook chopped onion slightly. Add beef and brown until fairly done. Salt and pepper to taste. Add garlic salt. Blend in package of chili seasoning. Add tomato paste plus three cans water. Stir until blended. Fold in beans and cook over low heat for 20 to 25 minutes. Reduce heat to simmer and cook as long as desired. I usually let it simmer at least an hour and a half.

title: Lime Molded Salad(Nice On Buffet Table)
instructions: Mix jello boiling water and pineapple. Chill until firm. Fold in sour cream. Pour into mold. Chill 3 hours or more. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except bacon. Top with bacon slices. Bake for 3 hours uncovered at 300\u00b0.

title: Noodle Pudding
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package and drain well. Toss noodles cream cheese and butter together in pan. Beat together in blender eggs sugar milk and apricot nectar. Turn noodle mixture into a buttered baking dish and pour egg mixture over the top. Sprinkle with topping mix. Bake 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes. Can be done ahead and refrigerated all day.

title: Carrot-Pineapple Bundt Cake
instructions: Grease and lightly flour Bundt pan. Mix together cake flour sugar cinnamon baking soda baking powder and salt. Drain pineapple saving syrup. Add pineapple syrup to dry mixture; add eggs oil and vanilla. Beat for 3 minutes. Stir in pineapple carrots and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours. Cool 10 minutes in pan before unmolding. Frost with cream cheese glaze.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda together. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and bananas beating until light. Alternately add flour and milk. Beat after each addition until smooth. Add nuts. Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Remove from pan; cool on rack.

title: Marinade For Venison
instructions: Marinate meat overnight. If desired partially cook peppers of your choice and onions then bake or fry over meat.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except marshmallows in electric mixer. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add marshmallows on top and bake for another 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Take chicken off the bone. Mix soup and juice in a bowl and in a separate bowl mix melted margarine and stuffing mix. In casserole dish layer stuffing mix (reserve some to put on top) then chicken. Pour soup and juice mixture over chicken then top with stuffing mix. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Place frozen hash browns in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix melted butter salt onion soup sour cream and Cheddar cheese. Spread mixture over hash browns. Top with a mixture of melted butter and crushed cornflakes or bread crumbs if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Party Dip
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender container. Blend at high speed until creamy. Serve with chips crackers and fresh vegetables.

title: Teriyaki Sirloin Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients except steak. Soak meat in mixture for 2 hours or longer turning periodically. Remove from liquid and broil indoors or on barbecue.

title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
instructions: Use mixer on medium speed to mix Crisco and brown sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Continue to mix until well blended. Add drained pineapple to mixture; then add flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 400\u00b0 on lightly greased cookie sheets. While cookies are warm glaze with confectioners sugar and pineapple juice mixed together to make thin glaze. Makes approximately four dozen.

title: Lemon Condensed Pie
instructions: Mix lemonade (thawed) with condensed milk and vanilla flavoring. Fold in Cool Whip; stir until mixed well. Spoon mixture into crust. Makes 1 pie. Double for 2 pies. Keep chilled.

title: Cream Vegetables With Meat And Pasta
instructions: Boil chicken; break in strips. Set aside. Saute onion and bell pepper until tender. Cook rotini until tender. Drain well. Steam mixed vegetables and drain.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken using garlic salt if desired. Dip chicken in melted margarine and roll in bread crumbs. Place in baking dish. Break up bacon over chicken. Pour soups over chicken. Cover and cook in oven on medium heat (350\u00b0) for two hours or until tender. Squeeze a little lemon juice over chicken if desired.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Chop dates; pour water over dates. Cream butter sugar and egg and add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Cook carrots for 10 minutes. Blanch in cold water; cool then add celery green pepper and onion. Mix soup salad oil sugar vinegar salt mustard and pepper. Pour over vegetables and stir. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Creamed Corn Casserole
instructions: Fry four slices of bacon until crisp. Place on a paper towel to drain. In the bacon fat brown 1/2 cup chopped green pepper until soft. Mix together a can of cream-style corn the bacon (crumbled) green pepper 3 teaspoons chopped pimentos a slightly beaten egg and 1/2 can French fried onion rings. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use remaining onion rings as topping.

title: Edible Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in refrigerator. Eat and enjoy.

title: Tangy Vegetables
instructions: Combine dry salad dressing mix with oil in large casserole dish. Add vegetables and toss to coat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Mix ham pork milk egg and oatmeal or bread crumbs and make into balls. Arrange in baking dish. Combine brown sugar vinegar and water and pour over balls. Bake 1 hour in medium oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Mix ground chuck tomato juice and seasoning together. Add the cheese which has been cubed. Spread on bread slices and top with strips of cheese. Put on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Burger And Beans
instructions: Brown the hamburger and 1 onion. Add chili powder to taste; drain any grease after completely browned. Add the brown sugar ketchup and barbecue sauce. Add some more chili powder if needed. Mix and simmer. Add the pork and beans. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Add the last onion; simmer for a couple of minutes.

title: Peerless Rice-Paddy Pie(In Honor Of Stallion, Alex Miles)
instructions: Whip the whipping cream; set aside. Mix the cream cheese and the sugar until smooth. Add in the sweetened strawberries and mix by tossing lightly. Set aside.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the first five ingredients. Put this mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.\tSprinkle with dry cake mix and drizzle with melted margarine. Top with walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until knife comes out clean. Serve with ice cream or Cool Whip.

title: Quick Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Layer in order given.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed of mixer 5 minutes; gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Stir together flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Spread in greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Top with finely chopped walnuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Start at narrow end; roll towel and cake together. Cool. Unroll.

title: Cereal Crunchies
instructions: Arrange fruit on top of any ready-to-eat cereal to represent a funny face. (Use bananas for ears or eyes apple or pineapple for whole face strawberry for nose raisins for eyes or beard peach slice for mouth.) Serve with milk.

title: Chive-Onion-Potato Bake
instructions: Rehydrate potatoes according to package directions. Drain well. With a fork or wire whisk beat eggs soft cream cheese and milk in a large bowl until blended. Stir in potatoes Parmesan and pepper. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish or shallow 10-inch round casserole. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 35 to 40 minutes until set and lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Serve as a main dish or cut in small squares for party appetizers.

title: Cream Cheese Pecan Pound Cake
instructions: Reserve 1/3 cup flour to dredge pecans.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Beat the eggs then add the sugar. Then the milk. Sift together the dry ingredients then mix in along with your choice of vanilla or nutmeg. Drop the batter from a funnel into 375\u00b0 deep fat. Spiral into intricate endless patterns. Using your finger to stop the flow on the funnel when desired shape is formed. Serve warm with powdered sugar jelly or cinnamon and sugar.

title: Princess Loaf
instructions: Put in blender sesame seed milk onion and parsley. Blend slightly. Pour into bowl and mix remaining ingredients well. Place in shallow casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spiced Applesauce Raisin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Beat all ingredients except raisins in large bowl on medium speed for 1 minute scraping bowl constantly. Stir in raisins. Pour into pan. Bake until wooden pick comes out clean 55 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan; cool before slicing.\tMakes one 9-inch loaf.

title: Tuna Or Chicken Burgers
instructions: Mix filling ingredients. Fill buttered buns with mixture. Wrap in aluminum foil and refrigerate. Just before serving heat at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spinach Manicotti
instructions: In large bowl combine Ricotta spinach 1 cup Mozzarella 1/4 cup Parmesan egg parsley onion powder pepper and garlic powder. Combine spaghetti sauce and water.\tSpread 1 cup sauce in an ungreased 9 x 13 baking dish and stuff uncooked manicotti with spinach mixture. Arrange over sauce. Pour remaining sauce over manicotti and sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until heated through. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fig - Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Thoroughly mix figs Jell-O and sugar in large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Pour quickly into jars and seal.

title: Mom'S Butterscotch Squares
instructions: Can be done on stove top or with microwave.

title: Coconut Chess Pie
instructions: Melt oleo. Mix with sugar. Add eggs vinegar vanilla and coconut. Add milk mixing well. Stir in meal and mix well. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Sausage Crescent Rolls
instructions: Separate crescent roll dough into triangles. Place 1 sausage link at wide end of triangle; roll up. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 11 to 15 minutes or until crescent roll is brown.

title: Cheese Wafers *
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Form into two long rolls. Refrigerate overnight. Slice into thin rings and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 until lightly browned (5 to 7 minutes). Makes about 75 wafers.

title: Self Filled Cupcake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix according to package directions adding the instant coffee to the liquid called for on the cake box. Fill paper cupcake cups 2/3 full in muffin tins.

title: Mini Chips Brunch Crescents
instructions: Unroll crescent dough into 8 triangles. Sprinkle a heaping tablespoon of mini chips on each triangle and gently press into dough. Starting at short side of triangle roll dough to opposite point. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring to boil the first 4 ingredients. Boil about 20 minutes or until ball forms in cold water. Take off stove and add next 3 ingredients. Beat until creamy. Add nuts (pecans or walnuts) if you like for nutty fudge.

title: Icebox Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and score with tines of fork. (Press fork tines into cucumber flesh and peel length of cuke.) Do not peel. Slice about 1/8-inch or thickness of your choice. Slice onions into rings and separate. Slice or dice green pepper.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
instructions: Beat yolk and add with milk to pumpkin mixture. Beat egg white and fold carefully into mixture. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 a few minutes then bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Peach Glaze Pie
instructions: Mash 1 cup sliced peaches. Add water and cook 5 minutes. Mix sugar and cornstarch; add to fruit mixture. Cook until thick and clear. Add lemon juice butter and salt. Allow mixture to cool completely. Arrange remaining fruit in cooled pie shell. Pour cooled glaze over fruit. Chill thoroughly. Top with whipped cream.

title: Aunt Denise'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit. Slice bananas into large bowl. Add fruit marshmallows and mayonnaise. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Ham Ring
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Dissolve in boiling water. Blend in sour cream salad dressing vinegar salt and pepper. Chill until partially set; whip until fluffy. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into 5-cup ring mold; chill until firm. Garnish with tomatoes or cheese or pineapple or orange slices. Serves 6.

title: Fannie May Fudge
instructions: Melt oleo. Add sugar and stir. Add milk and heat until fairly warm (not hot). Add marshmallows. Bring to a slight boil. Remove from heat and add chocolate and nuts. Place in buttered jelly roll pan.

title: Heavenly Hash Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill for 4 hours. Drain fruits. Serves 8.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
instructions: Heat and serve with nachos.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil for 1 hour. Let set until room temperature. Add the vanilla and Everclear. Bottle. Let set 24 hours.

title: Split Levels
instructions: Melt chocolate chips cream cheese and evaporated milk over low heat or in microwave. Add walnuts.

title: Scotch-A-Roos
instructions: Microwave syrup and sugar until it comes to a boil. Add peanut butter; stir until dissolved. (I put in microwave for about 1 minute more.) Pour over Rice Krispies. Spread evenly into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chips for only 2 to 3 minutes in microwave. Spread over the warm Rice Krispie layer.

title: Cheesy Tortillas
instructions: Spread cream cheese on tortilla. Top with another tortilla (sandwich). Cut two tortillas in slices (like a pizza) and place on platter. Place cup of picante in middle of platter for dipping. This makes an excellent last minute dish especially when unexpected company arrives.

title: Squash Supreme
instructions: Saute pepper and onion in oleo. Drain the squash and while still hot add ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sausage Dip
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet. Drain. Melt Velveeta cheese in with sausage. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix butter peanut butter and enough confectioners sugar to make the dough thick enough to form into balls. Refrigerate. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax in double boiler. Then dip the balls into the chocolate with toothpicks.

title: Sicilian Spinach Pie
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Have a 13 x 9-inch baking dish on hand. Use 1 tablespoon of olive oil to grease the pan. In pan heat the remaining oil and saute onion over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. Add olives and saute an additional 5 minutes. Set aside. Cut dough in half and roll out a piece to fit the bottom and sides of the pan. Press into the pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Place uncooked spinach into Parmesan cheese. Scatter the onion/olive mixture over the spinach and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese. Roll out remaining dough and place on top. Make 6 to 8 holes in top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until the crust is brown. Serve at once.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Pare eggplant and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Cook in boiling water with 1/2 teaspoon salt until tender (about 15 minutes). Drain well. Mash the eggplant into small pieces. Add onion and bell pepper. Stir gently. Add eggs milk bread crumbs cheese salt and pepper. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart greased casserole dish. Combine margarine and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onion in a frying pan. Add Worcestershire sauce tomato sauce and barbecue sauce. Stir well. Sprinkle oregano over mixture. Heat thoroughly. Pour mixture into a casserole dish. Sprinkle grated cheese over mixture and top with quartered biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Caramels
instructions: Boil the first five ingredients 5 minutes. Gradually add milk. Boil and stir continually until firm ball forms in small bowl of water. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies in food processor or blender. Set aside. In medium bowl cream together butter cream cheese and powdered sugar beating with electric mixer until smooth about 2 minutes.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Combine soy sauce ginger and garlic. Add beef strips and toss. Set aside while preparing vegetables.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Set aside 3/4 cup of crackers. Press remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Set aside. Combine sweetened condensed milk orange juice concentrate and Mandarin oranges. Mix with mixer. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon mixture over crust and sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cover and freeze until firm.

title: Sand Pie
instructions: Crust Melt margarine mix with flour and add 3/4 cup pecans. Pat out in pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Take out of oven. Let cool completely.

title: Sweet Pepper Relish
instructions: Bring to a boil; simmer for 15 minutes. Can and seal. Have your jars and lids good and hot.

title: Frosted 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add 7-Up. Chill until syrupy. Fold in fruit and marshmallows. Let congeal.

title: Low-Fat Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together apple filling water and granulated sugar in a bowl. In another mixing bowl mix together all the dry ingredients. Fold the two together and spoon into a square baking dish that has been sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Bake about 30 to 40 minutes until set and golden brown on top.

title: Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix well all ingredients.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Spread
instructions: Place vegetables in a small colander or strainer; drain well. Beat together cream cheese and lemon juice until smooth. Stir in vegetables and pepper. Serve on crackers or mini bread sandwiches. Yield 2 cups.

title: Grandmother'S Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Let rhubarb stand in water for 10 to 15 minutes. Drain. Mix rest of ingredients together. Add rhubarb. Mix and bake in 2 single crusts for 30 to 35 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Fried Cabbage
instructions: This recipe is great for using up leftover cabbage rolls. Cabbage and meat mixture left over from cabbage rolls. Cook noodles (1/4 package) drain and add to mixture. Fry cabbage first and add beef mixture. Fry on low heat. You can add hot or sweet peppers. Add 1/2 jar of chicken gravy to mixture. Serve and Enjoy!

title: Calabaza Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 2 layers according to package directions. Simmer raspberries sugar and water on medium heat until thick and total volume is reduced by half. Whip cream with vanilla and powdered sugar and add 1/2 coconut. Layer the cake with raspberry sauce then 1/4 cup whipped cream mixture. Place next cake layer on top and repeat process. \Ice\ the cake with the remaining whipped cream and sprinkle the remaining whipped cream on top.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix instant pudding mix and milk. Add sour cream and 1/2 Cool Whip. Mix well. Pour mixture over layered bananas and vanilla wafers. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Line with whole graham crackers. Mix pudding and milk. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers. Alternate ending with crackers on top. Refrigerate 2 hours before frosting.

title: Thanksgiving Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and allow to cool. Mix rest of ingredients. Stir into cooled gelatin. Put in mold and chill.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water; add relish nuts and celery. Chill.

title: Salmon Yule Log
instructions: Drain and flake salmon. Add cheese lemon juice onion horseradish liquid smoke and salt; mix well. Chill 2 or 3 hours or overnight. Shape into log. Chill 2 or 3 hours. Sprinkle pecans on wax paper. Roll log in pecans. Chill until ready to serve with crackers.

title: Country Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into small portions. Boil for 30 minutes. Drain all water and pour into large mixing bowl then add butter and mix on low until butter has melted. Slowly add Pet milk and turn up speed to medium. Add salt and pepper. Beat until creamy and smooth.

title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
instructions: You will need a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with nonstick spray.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Mash and mix with 1/2 cheese and 1/2 cracker crumbs. Top with remaining cheese and crackers. Dot with margarine and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cubed Steak In Gravy
instructions: Salt pepper and flour steak. Place in iron skillet frying on medium heat. Drain well. After frying all meat drain off excess grease if any. Place small onion rings into pan and brown. Add 1/2 cup plain flour stirring as you add salt and pepper to taste. Add water or milk to desired consistency of gravy you like. Place all meat into deep baking dish. Pour gravy over meat. Cover and place in oven for 1 hour on 200\u00b0 to 250\u00b0. Serve over rice. Steak will be tender and tasty.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix and store in covered jar. Put 3 teaspoonfuls per cup. Fill with boiling water.

title: Delicious Orange Jello Mold
instructions: Pour boiling water into Jell-O. Add frozen orange juice. Add crushed pineapple with juice. Let stand in fridge until it starts to jell or coats a spoon. Mash bananas; mix in Jell-O and fold in Cool Whip or whipped cream. Pour into oiled mold or a 9 x 13 pan or pour into nice glass bowl. Chill firm. Best if made day before.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a large skillet cook sausage over moderate heat until it is broken into small pieces and is no longer pink. Drain and mix with parsley and 1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese scallions and lightly beaten eggs. Set aside. Melt butter in a large skillet and saute mushroom caps briefly rolling them around in the pan. Cool. Divide mixture among mushroom caps mounding it slightly. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a large lightly buttered pan at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Fettucini
instructions: Melt butter stir in flour. Gradually add half-and-half stir until thickened. Add Parmesan; cook and stir until smooth. Fold in crabmeat heat 3 minutes stir occasionally. Toss fettucini with sauce sprinkle with parsley. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Refreshing Cucumber Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cucumbers mixing until well blended. Stir in cucumbers. Chill several hours or overnight. Serve with chips or vegetable dippers.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion then drain. Add salt pepper egg chicken soup and dressing mix. Then mix all ingredients and add cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello and hot water. Add orange juice then add all the other ingredients. Refrigerate for a few hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In large bowl combine the flour cinnamon salt and baking soda. In another bowl beat the eggs sugar pumpkin and oil. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Fold in chocolate chips. Pour into 2 greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Broccoli Fettuccine
instructions: In skillet in hot margarine cook garlic for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Stir in soup milk and cheese. Heat to boiling. Add chicken. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes stirring often. Toss with fettuccine. Garnish with cherry tomatoes and fresh parsley if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Angel'S Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients then cut in shortening. Add buttermilk. Dissolve yeast in warm water and add to mixture. Knead lightly. Roll out; cut with biscuit cutter and bake on greased cookie sheet at 450\u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes. Dough may be stored in refrigerator pinching off as much as is needed each time or may be cut then frozen. Yields 5 dozen biscuits.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in boiling water. Cool. Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each one. Add melted chocolate and vanilla. Mix well. Sift together flour salt and baking soda. Add alternately with buttermilk to the chocolate mixture. Beat well each time. Beat until smooth. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 3 deep 8 or 9-inch cake pans lined on bottom with wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool. Frost tops only.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Melt cheese with milk. Add taco sauce. Brown ground beef and drain. Add ground beef to cheese mixture. Keep warm and serve with nacho chips.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa. Melt butter in iron skillet. (Be sure to use iron skillet.) Add sugar mixture to melted butter. Beat egg yolks. Add milk and beat together. Add this a little at a time to sugar mixture in skillet stirring constantly. Cook slowly. When thick enough add vanilla. Place in baked deep dish pie shell. Top with meringue. Place in slow oven at 325\u00b0 until meringue is brown.

title: Baked Vegetable Medley
instructions: Separate cauliflower and broccoli into florets. Cut carrots into 2 to 3-inch pieces. Into a casserole dish that has been sprayed with vegetable oil place vegetables evenly. Slice butter into several \pats\ and place on top of mixture. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Ham Loaf With Pineapple
instructions: Mix thoroughly the ham pork pepper cracker crumbs eggs pineapple juice and onion. Arrange 2 slices of pineapple along each side of a greased Pyrex loaf pan. Put ham mixture into loaf pan pressing against the pineapple slices to hold them in place. Cut remaining pineapple slices into fifths and place on top of ham loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Salad
instructions: Chop chicken up in bite size and fry until done after seasoning and flouring. Remove all grease from skillet. Open frozen vegetables and pour into bowl. Mix chicken and dressing and vegetables. Refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Monster Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In mixing bowl (using a wooden spoon) or in the large bowl of an electric mixer cream the butter and shortening together until well-blended and soft. Then beat in sugars in turn beating well after each until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well each time then beat in vanilla.

title: Idaho Potato Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar until creamy. Add eggs beating well. Blend in potatoes and vanilla. Combine flour cocoa and baking soda. Add alternately with milk blending well after each addition. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool. Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Cloud Biscuits
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Combine eggs and milk. Add to flour mixture. Mix just to blend. Turn onto lightly floured surface; knead gently for 20 turns. Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 3-inch biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet and bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 100 biscuits.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Brown sausage and ground beef. Add celery. Cook 10 minutes. Stir often. Add remaining ingredients except green peppers and cheeses. Simmer covered 20 minutes. Add green pepper; cover and cook 10 minutes. When serving add both cheeses on top of soup in bowl.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Make jello and cool. Drain pineapple mix with cottage cheese and nuts. Add to cooled jello then stir in the whipped topping and refrigerate.

title: Roast Opossum Supreme
instructions: Mix all ingredients and stuff opossum with it. Sew up opening with large needle and coarse thread. Roast in oven roaster on wire rack at 350\u00b0 until tender and richly brown.

title: Green Fried Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes in 1/2-inch thick slices. Mix flour salt and pepper. Dip tomatoes in mixture covering both sides. Fry slowly in small amount of hot fat until browned; turn and brown other side.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese. Beat sour cream into cream cheese. Beat lemon juice and Italian seasoning into mixture.

title: Meat Loaf Diabetic
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Festive Cranberry Salad
instructions: In bowl combine milk and lemon juice. Mix well. Stir in the pineapple cranberry sauce marshmallows pecans and food coloring if desired. Fold in the whipped topping. Spoon into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Freeze until firm 4 hours or overnight. Cut into squares. Yield 12-16 servings.

title: Cracklin' Corn Bread
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Add egg and buttermilk stirring mixture just until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in cracklings. Place in a well-greased 10-inch cast-iron skillet in a 450\u00b0 oven for 4 minutes or until hot. Remove from oven. Pour batter into skillet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix sugar and Jell-O in hot water. Add cold water lemonade and pineapple juice. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Christmas Candies
instructions: Butter sides of a heavy 2 quart saucepan. In it combine sugar and milk. Heat and stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to a boil. Then cook to soft-ball stage (234 degrees). Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients and stir until blended. Pour into buttered 9x9x2-inch pan. Score in squares when warm cut when firm.

title: Porky Pine Meatballs
instructions: 1st Layer 2 cans (drained and blended) Trappys jalapeno pinto beans.

title: Cajun Delight
instructions: In a large pan combine all ingredients. Bring mixture to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Remove lid and simmer an additional 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Lobster Dip
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter or margarine. Then add remaining ingredients.

title: Pineapple Cheese Dish
instructions: Stir together pineapple and grated cheese. Mix sugar and flour; sprinkle over pineapple and cheese. Sprinkle margarine and crushed Ritz crackers over pineapple dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Follow instructions on jello box then fold in whipped cream. Stir in remainder of ingredients; place in fridge for 2 1/2 hours. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Hilda'S Boiled Custard Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Beat all ingredients except peaches. Cook on low heat until its showing thickness stirring all the time. When custard is done add peaches. Put into ice cream freezer and freeze or you can put in the freezer.

title: Wild Rice And Duck
instructions: Boil chunks of duck breasts until tender; discard water. Cook rice as directed on package. Brown sausage and onion. Mix all ingredients; pour in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Cut up 1 chicken into small pieces and salt and pepper it. Place rice in bottom of Dutch oven. Add 1 can of mushroom soup 1 can of water and stir. Place chicken pieces on top of rice and soup. Cook on High for 15 minutes. Then cook on Medium-Low setting for 25 minutes. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Serves 4.

title: Garden Club Chicken
instructions: Combine chicken and all ingredients. Mix gently. Place in casserole dish.

title: Almost Snickers
instructions: Mix. Shape into bar. Wrap in foil. Freeze until firm. Makes 1 serving. Exchanges 1 milk 1 fruit 1 bread 1 protein and 1 fat.

title: Divinity Fudge
instructions: Put sugar syrup and water on stove to boil. Beat egg whites until very stiff. Let syrup cook until it forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water. Pour slowly into egg whites beating constantly with mixer. Add vanilla and beat as long as possible. Drop by spoon on wax paper. Set bowl in hot water if candy begins to harden. (May add nuts.)

title: Zucchini Saute
instructions: Combine zucchini and salt; let stand 15 minutes. Rinse in cold water and drain well. Saute onion in butter until tender. Add zucchini. Cook stirring constantly until all liquid is absorbed. Stir in sour cream and pepper.

title: Mae'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add egg beat until fluffy. Stir in milk. Add dry ingredients into creamed mixture and blend well. Divide dough in half. Chill 1 hour. On floured surface roll out dough 1/8-inch thick. Cut in shapes. Put on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Cool and decorate. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Stir together and cook over heat until mixture starts to come away from sides approximately 2 minutes. Knead. Add coloring before cooking. Store in covered container.

title: Squash Souffle
instructions: Cook squash and onion in slight amount of water until tender. Mash. Add other ingredients; sprinkle with crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the first 8 ingredients. Fold in apples nuts and raisins. Spoon into a well-greased cake pan or a 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until cake tests done. Serves 16 to 20.

title: Orange Shortcake
instructions: Section oranges removing seeds. Save extra juice and make up to 1 cup with concentrated orange juice. Mix flour and sugar; add 1 cup orange juice and cook until boils. Let boil a few minutes and add butter and stir in. Cool to room temperature. Stack rounds with sections between and over top with sweetened cream. Serve at room temperature.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Place pineapple and juice in pan. Bring to a boil; add lime Jell-O and dissolve. Fold in cheese. Cool slightly; fold in whipping cream. Chill and cut in squares.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar and cocoa in a 2-quart boiler. Stir in milk and butter. Cook until mixture comes to a rolling boil; stir well. Continue to cook on high for 1 minute. Remove mixture and stir in vanilla. Add oats; mix thoroughly. Add coconut and nuts (optional). Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Place in refrigerator to set.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Brown chicken\tthat has been sprinkled with Tonys seasoning.\tThe more you use the spicier the chicken. Remove chicken from skillet. Saute chopped onion and bell pepper in chicken grease (2 tablespoons). Place chicken back in skillet. Pour tomatoes over chicken. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally to avoid sticking. Serve over hot yellow rice.

title: Sultana Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine; add eggs and lemon extract. Mix. Add flour and baking powder. Mix together. Add nuts and raisins last; mix well. Put in a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Orange Glaze
instructions: Combine brown sugar orange juice and mustard. Mix well. Spoon over ham shoulder roast (pork) etc.

title: Sour Cream Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine sour cream and margarine. Fold in flour. Fill greased muffin tins three-fourths full. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 18 biscuits.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes salt and 1/2 cup boiling water in saucepan; simmer covered for 15 minutes or until tender. Pour off all but 1/4 cup stock; dot with butter. Combine orange juice corn syrup and brown sugar. Blend well. Pour over sweet potatoes. Simmer basting frequently for 15 minutes.

title: Delicious Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and butter in a saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly until butter is melted. Remove from heat and add hot syrup to beaten eggs stirring constantly. Add pecans and vanilla extract to mixture. Pour filling into pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dissolve yeast in warm water. In a separate bowl put flour baking powder baking soda and sugar. Cut in shortening; add yeast mixture and buttermilk. Knead slightly. Roll out to 1/2-inch; cut 15 biscuits. Place into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan and brush with butter. Let rise 30 minutes or in refrigerator overnight. Bake until golden brown.

title: T'S Dole Golden Layer Cake
instructions: Combine undrained pineapple whipped topping and pudding mix. Let stand for 5 minutes. Cut cake lengthwise into 3rds. Spread 1/3 pudding mixture over each layer of cake ending with pudding on top. Chill 30 minutes. Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Serves 12.

title: Souperburgers
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain excess fat. Add soup and seasonings simmer about 5 to 10 minutes to blend flavors stirring occasionally. Serve on buns.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Drain pimentos and chop parsley. Combine with dressing in a large Ziploc bag; add mushrooms and toss to coat. Chill.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased casserole. Top with 1/2 cup of grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. May serve with crackers.

title: Aunt Louise'S Banana Salad
instructions: Mix sugar salt milk and egg together. Cook until thick. Let cool. Add vinegar and peanut butter. Cut up bananas and pour dressing over them. Sprinkle with peanuts.

title: Refrigerator Crock Salad
instructions: Mix well and pour over all ingredients. Put in a crock or covered dish. Let stand in the refrigerator. \The longer it stands the better it is.\

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Put the bacon pieces in pan and fry until almost done. Then add all other ingredients except hamburger meat. I add that about 30 minutes before soup is done. You may also add carrots English peas corn or any other vegetable you would like but if you add extra vegetables you will also need to add extra liquid. Cook about 1 1/2 hours.

title: As Good As Fudge(Diabetic)
instructions: In small pan over low heat stir together honey and peanut butter until smooth. Remove from heat; add cocoa powder and blend well. Add remaining ingredients. Press into greased 9 x 9 x 2 inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 36 squares.

title: Marjorie Boyd'S Pea Salad
instructions: Cook peas; drain. Mix ingredients and chill.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken debone and retain broth (1 1/2 to 2 cups). Prepare rice with equal parts water in 2 to 3-quart pan. Melt margarine and mix in flour. Add broth slowly stirring constantly then melt cheese in the sauce. Defrost broccoli and cut into small pieces.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Bring water and salt to a boil; add rice. Cover and remove from heat. Let set for 5 minutes. Melt butter in skillet; saute onion and celery until tender. In a large mixing bowl combine rice celery and onion with remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Gingerbread People
instructions: In large bowl mix sugar and butter. Beat in egg and molasses. Stir in remaining ingredients. Roll dough on well-floured board. Cut into desired shapes. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Decorate as desired. Makes about 15 (6-inch) cookies.

title: Homemade Syrup
instructions: Mix in pan; turn to boil. Boil 1 minutes; turn off. Add Maple and vanilla.

title: Candy Cane Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly butter shortening confectioners sugar egg and flavorings. Blend in flour and salt. Divide dough in half; blend food coloring into one half.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Pick over and wash cranberries. Put through food chopper using fine blade; mix in half as much mashed ripe banana. Sweeten with honey and beat well. Let stand for an hour or so before serving.

title: Pretzels
instructions: Mix yeast warm water and sugar until dissolved. Stir in salt and flour gradually. Dump dough onto breadboard and knead until smooth. Shape into pretzels by rolling pieces of dough into long ropes and twist into pretzel shape. Place on oiled cookie sheets. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with kosher salt. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: No Peel Chicken
instructions: Stir rice and soups together in a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Lay chicken pieces on top of rice mixture. Sprinkle with salt and poultry seasoning or paprika. (Sesame seed may also be sprinkled on top.) Cover with foil and place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Dont peek!

title: Good Cherry Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple juice and pudding mix in bowl; mix well. Add banana pie filling and undrained pineapple; toss to mix. Pour into serving bowl. Chill until set. May substitute any fruit juice for pineapple juice. Yield 10 servings.

title: Pecan Slices
instructions: Mix these ingredients; spread about 1/8-inch thick on the 9-inch square pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Melt chocolate morsels over hot water. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar and syrup. Blend in bourbon. Combine nuts and wafers. Add to chocolate mix. Shape into balls. Roll in powdered or granulated sugar. Store in container several days to ripen.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix water sugar Karo and cornstarch together. Cook until thickened. Add Jell-O and mix well. Cool and pour part in bottom of baked pie shell. Leave strawberries whole and pour remainder of mixture over strawberries. Garnish with whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix flour cocoa baking powder soda and salt. Set aside. Beat butter and sugar in a large bowl until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add half the flour mixture and half the milk. Mix well. Mix in rest of flour mixture and milk until smooth. Fill a greased and floured baking pan or 2 layer pans no more than half full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes until cake springs up when lightly touched in center.

title: Hawaiian Bread Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Serve with Hawaiian bread.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 9-inch square pan. In medium bowl beat butter until creamy. Stir in sugar and brown sugar. Add flour salt and baking soda. Stir until mixture is crumbly. Set aside 1 cup of crumb mixture for top. Press remaining mixture into pan. Stir lemon juice into apricot preserves. Spread into pan leaving a 4-inch border around all edges. Sprinkle preserves with remaining 1 cup crumb mixture. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until browned.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Chocolate Boil Cookies
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients about 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonful on wax paper.

title: Applesauce Raisin Bread
instructions: Combine applesauce and soda in a small bowl. Cream butter with sugar in large bowl. Stir in egg cinnamon salt allspice and cloves. Blend in applesauce mixture. Mix in flour and raisins. Pour into greased 5 x 9 loaf pan or use smaller pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan on rack. Take out of pan and cool on rack completely.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt margarine over medium heat. Add flour. Slowly stir in 2 cups of milk. When slightly thickened slowly add rest of milk chicken granules broccoli and cheese. Stir until smooth and thick. Enjoy!

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix fruit cocktail juice and all with pudding until pudding is thick. Mix in Cool Whip. Add well drained pineapple and marshmallows. Mix and refrigerate.

title: Pecan Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll in wax paper and refrigerate. Cool and slice.

title: Barbecued Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients. In a medium saucepan simmer 5 minutes stirring frequently. Serves 5.

title: Grilled Pico Burgers
instructions: In bowl combine all ingredients. Divide meat mixture into 4 hamburger patties. Sear 5 inches from hot coals for 2 minutes. Turn and cook for 6 minutes for medium done. Serve hot topped with avocado onion lettuce and tomato.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Top with cheese cracker crumbs rolled in 1/2 stick melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in airtight jar. Place 2 to 3 teaspoons of tea mixture in 3/4 cup boiling water. May be made in larger quantities adding 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of boiling water.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Cut boneless venison into thin small steaks. Sprinkle with garlic and onion salt; pound well. Roll in flour and brown meat in skillet. Alternate layers of meat cream of mushroom soup and sliced onion in a casserole. Add 1 soup can of water over all. Cover and bake 2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix rice and soup together in a 2-quart baking dish. Add drained mushrooms; top with sliced margarine. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ziti With Broccoli
instructions: Boil broccoli 10 minutes until tender. Drain. Cook ziti 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Saute garlic in olive oil in large skillet until lightly browned. Add broccoli; cook 1 minute. Add ziti cream and Parmesan and cook 2 minutes tossing well. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan and top with Mozzarella. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Texas Brisket Of Beef
instructions: Spread the brisket generously with the Adolphs meat tenderizer; pierce with a fork. Place in a large rectangular Pyrex dish.

title: Lorna Doone Dessert
instructions: Mix crushed Lorna Doones and melted margarine. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fresh Peach Or Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel 5 to 6 peaches or apple slices into small slices and place in bottom of Pyrex dish. Melt margarine; add sugar and flour. (This will be dry and crumbly.) Sprinkle over fruit and pat down. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Crab Meat Casserole
instructions: Crumble 1 1/2 slices of toasted bread into crab meat and combine ingredients with milk blended with mayonnaise. With other 1 1/2 slices of toasted bread grate and sprinkle over top of casserole. Dot butter on top. Put in stove and cook until warm through. Serve.

title: Millionaire Candy
instructions: Heat slowly in double boiler. Dip balls in this mixture.

title: Lucky Lemon Ice Cream(Makes 1 Gallon.)
instructions: Combine the sugar milk half and half whipping cream and lemon rind. Add lemon juice and beat well. Fold in egg whites. Add food coloring if desired. Pour into freezer can of 1 gallon hand or electric freezer. Let ripen at least 2 hours.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add rest of ingredients; simmer 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Combine all ingredients (place sugar in mixture first then melted butter). Place mixture in greased baking dish. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Shrimp, Chicken And Vegetable Fettuccine
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente; drain and toss lightly with 1 tablespoon olive oil and keep warm. Cut zucchini bell pepper carrots and green onions into julienne strips. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in large skillet. Saute garlic lightly; add zucchini bell pepper carrots and green onions. Cook tossing until crisp-tender. Add chicken strips; cook stirring until opaque (about 3 minutes). Add shrimp; cook tossing until opaque (about 1 to 2 minutes). Stir in wine hot pepper flakes lime zest and cilantro. Bring to boil quickly; pour over cooked pasta in serving bowl. Toss to combine. Garnish with minced fresh parsley. Makes 4 to 5 servings. Also may be served over rice.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk. Stir in sugar salt and butter. Beat well and add flour. Let rise to almost double in bulk. Punch down and roll out on lightly floured board to 1/4 inch in thickness. Cut in about 2-inch pieces. Dip each piece in melted butter.

title: Ruth'S Chess Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine; add one egg at a time. Add milk corn meal vinegar lemon juice and salt. Pour into crust. Cook 10 minutes at 375\u00b0 then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and cook 40 minutes more.

title: Chicken Marinade
instructions: Pour mixed ingredients over chicken. Cover and refrigerate overnight. (Turn or shake chicken to make sure all chicken pieces are coated.) Place chicken in baking dish and bake at 300\u00b0 about an hour or can be grilled. (Discard marinade do not cook chicken in the mixture.)

title: Carrot Cake
