instructions: Mix oil and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Sift together flour soda baking powder cinnamon and salt. Add dry mixture in small amounts to egg mixture until all ingredients are well blended. Add vanilla. Blend in carrots pineapple and pecans. Bake in 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Check at 25 minutes. Ice with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: So Refreshing Punch
instructions: Mix all juices as directed on package. Next mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate until ready to use. Add 1 quart of ginger ale. Yields 2 gallons.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix juice and milk together. Add other ingredients. Put in a pie shell and chill. Makes 2 or 3 pies.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix together butter and shortening. Beat in 1 1/2 cups sugar eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Blend into creamed mixture. Shape rounded teaspoons of dough into small balls. Combine 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; roll balls in sugar/cinnamon mixture. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. (Be careful they burn easily!!) Remove from baking sheet; cool on racks. Makes approximately 6 dozen.

title: Ranch Style Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta; drain. Put in saucepan. Stir in olive oil on low-medium heat. Add package dressing. Stir in veggies. Heat until veggies are tender. Serve.

title: Vegetable Frittata
instructions: Thinly slice the onion and mince the garlic. Cut the squash and zucchini into 1/4-inch slices. Seed the bell peppers and cut into 1/4-inch strips. Slice the mushrooms. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the vegetables. Saut the vegetables for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender-crisp. Whisk the eggs and cream in a large bowl. Add the salt and pepper. Add the bread cubes cream cheese and Swiss cheese and mix well. Add the sauted vegetables and mix well. Pour into a greased 10-inch spring-form pan or a 9 x 13-inch baking pan packing the mixture firmly. Place the pan on a baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until firm to the touch puffed and golden brown. Cover the top with foil to prevent overbrowning if necessary. Place the spring-form pan on a serving plate. Loosen the frittata from the side and remove the side of the pan. Cut into small squares. Serve the frittata hot at room temperature or cold. May reheat cooked frittata at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until warmed through if desired. Yield 48 small appetizers.

title: Orange-Ginger Pork Roast
instructions: * Will leave some leftovers for sandwiches.

title: Arja'S Carrot Christmas Casserole
instructions: Mix everything together. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased casserole dish. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Bananas With Dressing
instructions: Combine brown sugar beaten egg water and vinegar in a saucepan. Bring to a boil; remove from heat and add vanilla. Let cool. When ready to serve (or just before) slice and cut up bananas into bite size pieces. Pour sauce over bananas and top with chopped peanuts.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in a 2-quart casserole. Sift together the flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in milk. Pour into butter; do not stir. Sprinkle fruit on top of butter; do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan. Add cleaned shrimp. Saute 5 minutes. Add Creole sauce and water or stock and simmer 5 minutes. Serve on hot platter in ring of boiled rice.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 13 x 9-inch pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; mix together and press into pan. Pour milk over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients. Press firmly. Bake 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Lithuanian Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef or turkey and drain. Add garlic onion celery cabbage water and potatoes; season with salt and pepper. Cook until tender. Add about 1 cup of sour cream. Serve with salad rye bread and butter.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar milk and butter to soft ball stage 236\u00b0 stirring frequently. Remove from heat; add chocolate pieces Marshmallow Creme vanilla and 1 cup nuts. Beat until chocolate is melted and blended. Pour into well buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Immediately score into squares. Cool and when set cut into squares.

title: Pizza Sticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Prepare Basic Biscuits rolling dough about 1/4-inch thick. Using a sharp knife or pizza cutter cut dough into narrow strips 1/2-inch wide. Cut strips into 3-inch sticks. Dip sticks into melted butter and roll in mixture of Parmesan cheese oregano and garlic salt. Place on lightly greased baking sheet about 3/4-inch apart. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 3 dozen sticks.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add tomato sauce and chili mix to ground beef. Spread cream cheese in bottom of 9 x 13-inch ovenproof dish. Spread chili mixture over cream cheese. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or in microwave until \bubbly\. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: In bottom of long ungreased cake pan mix the cocoa brown sugar and water. Sprinkle the marshmallows over this. Pour the cake batter over this (prepared according to package directions). Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream or Cool Whip.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients until pea like then add other mixture. Chill and form into balls. Wrap well and freeze. Take out and thaw as needed.

title: Apple-Caramel Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese in microwave. Add sugars and vanilla. Stir until mixed well. Dip apples in caramel sauce.

title: Mocha-Frosted Spice Cake
instructions: Bake cake in layers as directed. Prepare our creamy white frosting mix as directed except dissolve 2 teaspoons powdered instant coffee in the hot water before adding to the dry mix.

title: Marinated Sweet Potato Salad
instructions: In a large saucepan cook sweet potatoes in boiling salted water just until tender about 20 minutes. Cool completely. Meanwhile in a small bowl combine the next nine ingredients; set aside. Peel potatoes; cut in half lengthwise then into 1/4-inch slices. In a large bowl combine the sweet potatoes onion and green pepper. Add dressing and gently toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Discard bay leaves before serving. Yields 14 to 16 servings.

title: Healthy Snacks
instructions: In a large bowl combine 2 cups of Triscuits crumbs honey raisins peanut butter and dry milk. Shape into one-inch balls. Roll balls in Triscuits crumbs. Serve immediately or store in refrigerator. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Ham Cheese Ball
instructions: Form ingredients into a ball. Chill; roll in chopped pecans. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Apricot Buttons
instructions: Blend together the first 6 ingredients. Shape the dough into walnut size balls. Dip in reserved egg whites. Roll in chopped walnuts. Place on cookie tray; press thumb in center. Bake at 325\u00b0. When cool fill centers with apricot jam.

title: Green Bean And Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain green beans and corn. Put green beans in a long casserole dish and spread corn on top. Mix together sour cream soup and salt and spread on top of beans and corn.\tMix cheese butter and crackers. Put on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Petunia Bread Pudding
instructions: Put brown sugar in top of double boiler. Add cubed bread. Combine eggs vanilla salt milk and raisins. Pour mixture over bread. Dont stir. Cook for 1 hour in double boiler (undisturbed). When done turn upside down on serving dish.

title: Potato-Tomato Soup
instructions: In large saucepan combine first 6 ingredients. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Mix pineapple cheese sugar and flour in bowl. Put in baking dish. Place crackers over top. Pour melted butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut
instructions: Put salt and cabbage in pan and fill with boiling water. Seal. Keep in warm place a few days.

title: Boxman'S Chocolate Pies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and flour together. Add enough milk to this mixture to make a paste. Add salt and two beaten eggs then add the rest of the milk. Cook until thick. Take off stove and add butter and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into baked pie shells. Makes two 8-inch pies.

title: Savory Pot Roast
instructions: In 6-quart Dutch oven in 2 tablespoons oil brown roast. Spoon off fat. Stir in mushroom soup onion soup mix and 1 cup water. Cover; simmer 2 hours turning occasionally. Add vegetables. Cover; cook 40 minutes or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender. Remove roast and vegetables to platter.

title: Flaky Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt in a bowl. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Beat together egg and milk. Add to flour mixture all at once stirring just enough with fork to make a soft dough.

title: Magnificent Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Carefully scoop out the eggplant from the skin taking care not to puncture what should be a thin shell less than a quarter of an inch thick. Place the eggplant pieces in salted boiling water to cover and cook until very tender.

title: Oatmeal Cookies With Chocolate Covered Raisins
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add combined flour baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in oats and chocolate covered raisins. Drop by rounded tablespoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet then remove.

title: French Bread Dip
instructions: Cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with sliced toasted French bread.

title: Aunt Ethel'S Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: To potato add onion celery seed eggs sugar and flour. Mix together. Use pickle juice if you have it. Add vinegar and water. Cook. Add oleo and mustard last. Add 1/2 of this mixture with 1/2 of Hellmanns mayo.

title: Kosher Style Dill Pickles
instructions: Pack cucumbers in jar and pour over after boiling vinegar and water. Put in each jar dill grape leaves garlic pepper and alum. Cap and seal. (Green tomatoes bell pepper and sliced onions may be added too.)

title: Pork Chops And Apples
instructions: Brown chops on all sides in hot fat. Mix apples brown sugar and cinnamon. Place 3/4 of apple mixture in 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan. Dot with 3 tablespoons butter. Top with chops. Place remaining 1/4 apple mixture on top of chops and dot with remaining 1 tablespoon of butter. Cover and bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 6 servings.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Add dry ingredients to mixer bowl. Whisk to blend. Cut cold shortening and butter into small pieces and add to bowl. Mix on stir for 1 minute until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Continue on stir while adding the 3/4 cup of cold buttermilk. Mix just until moistened. Form dough into a ball and turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead 5 to 6 times and roll out to 1/2-inch thick. Cut into 2 inch rounds. Arrange biscuits on greased baking pan. Brush with 1 tablespoon buttermilk. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yield 16 biscuits.

title: Mom'S Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix eggs oil and baby food well then add remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Toothpick should come out clean.

title: Fruit Shake
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender except strawberries. Blend on high speed until well mixed about 30 seconds. Garnish each shake with 1 strawberry.

title: Tabooley
instructions: Soak wheat in water a few minutes. Squeeze dry between palms of hands. Chop onions parsley mint and tomatoes very fine. Add wheat lemon juice oil salt and pepper. Mix well. Serve on fresh lettuce. Serves 6.

title: Easy Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Combine cola and barbecue sauce. Pour into skillet. Add chicken and bring just to boiling. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and put in casserole and sprinkle top with bacon crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes covered. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Italian Tomato Soup(Preparation Time:  30 Minutes)
instructions: Peel and chop onion. In a large skillet or pan heat oil. Saute onion in oil for a few minutes until soft. Add pressed garlic. Sprinkle with whole wheat flour. Stir to combine. Add vegetable broth. Heat stirring constantly. Dip tomatoes in hot water; peel and chop. Add tomatoes to soup stirring. Add chili sauce bay leaves basil and herb salt. Bring to a boil. Cook covered over medium-low heat for about 15 minutes. Add cream to soup just before serving. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add minced onion taco sauce and stewed tomatoes. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Add meat mixture to shells and arrange lettuce cheese and tomatoes. Toss lightly. Serve at once. Yields 6 servings.

title: E-Z Fruity Barbecue
instructions: Salt and pepper ribs and brown in broiler or flour salt and pepper chicken; brown in skillet. Place in large flat pan or Pyrex with 2-inch sides. Lay in single layer. Pour sauce mixed with jam over the top. Cover with foil lightly. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Trifle
instructions: Bake cake; make pudding as directed. Cool them both. In large bowl break cake in small squares and layer it in bowl. Then pour 1/4 Schnapps over cake. Make 1 layer of pudding 1 layer of pie filling and layer of whipped cream. Sprinkle with coconut and pecans (crushed). Then repeat layers and refrigerate until served. Hope you enjoy.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and butter together; add remaining ingredients and mix together. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.

title: Buttermilk Chess Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; mix in eggs one at a time (do not beat). Add buttermilk flour and vanilla and mix well. Pour mixture into 2 pie shells (uncooked) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Spaghetti Supreme
instructions: Remove skin and bone from cooked chicken; cut into bite size pieces. Cook celery and bell pepper in bite size pieces. Cook spaghetti. Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs and transfer to a 10 x 15-inch baking pan sprayed or buttered. Top with bread crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cookies
instructions: I use milk chocolate chips baby M&Ms and toffee pieces.

title: Pineapple Banana Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients stir in nuts. Add rest of ingredients (oil bananas eggs and pineapple). Stir until moistened. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake for 1hour or until done. Cool 10 minutes in pan then put on rack to cool. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Do-Ahead And Chill Chocolate Angel Torte
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a medium saucepan; mix to blend. Stir in Carnation and water. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture begins to thicken. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into egg. Return egg mixture to saucepan. Continue cooking until mixture just comes to a boil and thickens. Stir in vanilla and chocolate. Cover surface of filling with wax paper; chill. Slice cake horizontally making three layers. Fill and frost cake layers. Sprinkle nuts over top of cake. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Stew For All Occasions
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix in a heavy 5 to 6-quart Dutch oven the first 9 ingredients. Stir in beef chuck. Add carrots celery and onions. Cover and bake about 3 hours stirring twice until the meat is tender and sauce thickened. Discard bay leaves before serving or refrigerating.

title: Eggs Lorraine
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Put 12 eggs in pan; break yolks. Put chopped onion and pepper on top of eggs and salt and pepper. Add mushrooms sausage and cheese. Pour over whipped cream. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Uncover and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Cut and serve.

title: Original Bourbon Cake
instructions: Combine cherries raisins and bourbon. Cover and let stand overnight. Drain fruit and reserve bourbon. Preheat oven to 275\u00b0. Cream butter and sugars until light. Add egg yolks a little at a time and mix well. Combine 1/2 cup flour with the nutmeg baking powder and chopped pecans. Set aside. Add remaining flour and bourbon alternately to the butter mixture beating well after each addition. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the batter. Then fold in soaked fruit and pecan flour. Turn into a greased 10-inch tube pan that has been lined with greased waxed paper. Bake for 3 1/2 hours. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Soften yeast in water. Add 1/2 teaspoon of the 1/4 cup sugar and set aside. Add fat or shortening rest of sugar and salt to hot milk. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cool then add egg; stir in softened yeast. Stir flour into liquid ingredients until well mixed. Turn dough out onto lightly floured board. Knead quickly until smooth and elastic. Form into smooth ball and place in a greased bowl. Turn over to grease the surface. Cover and let rise in warm place (about 85\u00b0) until double in bulk about 1 hour. Turn onto board and knead well. Roll out and cut with doughnut cutter. Place on waxed paper and let rise again until double in bulk. Cook in cooking oil until brown. While still hot roll in powdered sugar icing made by mixing 1 box powdered sugar and enough milk to make it thin enough to dip the doughnuts in.

title: Chicken Scarparella
instructions: Rinse arugula well; pat dry. Reserve half for garnish. Discard tough stems from remainder; slice thin. Set aside.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Combine ingredients in an electric blender or with the potato masher. Delicious with pita bread as a dip or as a sandwich on whole wheat bread.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Pound breasts thin. Salt and pepper chicken. First put chicken slice of ham and cheese. Roll up in jelly roll fashion. Secure with toothpicks. After all are rolled flour chicken. Melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Brown on all four sides about 4 minutes. Remove chicken; melt remaining butter. Add mushrooms and onion. Saute until tender. Then add water and bouillon parsley and chives. Bring to boil. Return chicken to sauce. Cook in oven 1 hour or until tender. Remove chicken. Add cream. Simmer several minutes until thickened.

title: Baked Roast Beef
instructions: Sprinkle onion soup mix on roost beef. Bake according to directions. Keep drippings for sauce. Make regular gravy with cornstarch. Stir into roast beef. Put in crock pot to keep hot. Put on buns.

title: Rice Krispies Treat
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows; add Rice Krispies and vanilla. Press mixture into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Melt chocolate chips and pour over the top. Let set in refrigerator for awhile.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Grind crackers to make crumbs and combine with melted margarine. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Cool and add icing.

title: No Cook Fondant
instructions: Mix cream cheese and flavoring. Add coloring.\tIf more than one color\tis desired separate batch at this time. Mix in sugar kneading with hands until consistency of stiff pie dough. You may need more sugar. Place one side in sugar and push sugar side into mold. Unmold at once.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Stuff in peppers and wrap in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Salmon Ball
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients; form into a ball. Roll in fine cut parsley. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with crackers.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp; remove to paper toweling to drain then crumble. Cook beef in fat remaining in skillet until no pink remains. Add onion; saute just until tender. Combine beef onion catsup salt brown sugar mustard and vinegar in a 3-quart baking dish. Partially drain all the beans add to baking dish stir gently to mix. Sprinkle bacon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 8 servings as a main dish.

title: Exquisite Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in unbaked 9 inch pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Creamed Chopped Spinach
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Add mushroom soup and mix well. Heat in microwave oven for approximately 3 minutes or until steaming hot.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream together the butter and sugar. Stir in the eggs molasses and vinegar. Sift and add dry ingredients. Mix until well blended. Form the dough into 3/4-inch balls by rolling dough in between your palms. Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 12 minutes.

title: Reuben Pie
instructions: In glass pie plate layer kraut and cheese. In separate bowl beat biscuit mix milk mayo eggs and chili sauce. Slowly pour over meat and cheese and allow to soak in. Makes own crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 until puffed and brown on top.

title: Barbecued Meat Balls
instructions: Mix hamburger rice milk onion pepper parsley and salt and pepper together and form into balls. Place in baking dish or crock-pot.

title: Strawberry Layer Gelatin
instructions: Prepare gelatin according to the recipe on the box. Divide in half. Place other half in serving bowl and refrigerate until set. Refrigerate other half until thick. I use the quick-set recipe on box being careful to remove all remaining ice cubes.

title: Almond Caramel Crunch
instructions: Place cereal in large bowl and set aside. In small saucepan over low heat melt caramels with water stirring until smooth. Add almond extract and stir. Pour over cereal stir until all pieces are coated. Spread on wax paper or lightly greased pan to cool. Separate pieces while cooling. Store in airtight container. Makes 4 cups.

title: Clam Chowder Soup
instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients and heat. Before serving top with remaining ingredients. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chicken Burritos
instructions: On each flour tortilla place sour cream down center chunks of chicken salsa onions cheeses peppers and more salsa (as desired). Roll side of tortilla up and secure with a toothpick. Place burritos on a baking sheet and broil in oven for a few minutes until burritos begin to brown and crisp. Serve. Good with Spanish rice.

title: Fluffy White Frosting
instructions: Blend all ingredients on low speed. Turn mixer to high speed and beat until fluffy and of proper consistency.

title: 5 Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Mix all ingredients together. Slice bananas. May add nuts or coconut for variation.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Mix and bake corn bread according to directions on package. Cool and crumble the corn bread. Meanwhile cook the sausage crumbling as it cooks. Drain. Chop pickles tomatoes onion and cucumber. Stir in sausage and all but 1/2 cup crumbled corn bread. Mix well. Use reserved corn bread to decorate the top. Also garnish with green pepper strips. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Devils
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly and add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately. Add melted chocolate vanilla and nuts. Mix well. Bake in a 7 1/2 x 11 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Cut in strips or squares while warm and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Noodle Pudding
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Melt butter in hot noodles in a large bowl. Once butter has melted add beaten eggs sugar and cottage cheese. Stir well. Add all other ingredients. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 or until noodles turn golden brown. Allow to cool somewhat before serving. Good either warm or cold as a side dish or dessert.

title: Whimpies
instructions: In a large frying pan or Dutch oven cook the meat and vegetables over medium heat until the meat is browned and the vegetables are tender about 30 minutes. Stir in the V-8 catsup sugar vinegar and Worcestershire and simmer uncovered over low heat for 2 hours. The mixture will resemble spaghetti sauce. (Remove lid during last 30 minutes of cooking if it seems too thin.) Sauce keeps well and freezes well. This dish can be used on cocktail rolls as an hors doeuvre or piled on hamburger buns for lunch.

title: Thumbprints(An Old Family Recipe)
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder. In medium bowl with mixer cream butter sugar egg yolks and vanilla until fluffy. Gradually mix in flour and baking powder until well blended. Cover bowl with wax paper and refrigerate until easy to handle about 1 hour.

title: Raspberry Vinegar
instructions: Drain raspberries carefully in fine strainer. Dont push pulp through strainer. Let stand 10 minutes. Place a disposable coffee filter in a strainer over a medium bowl. Pour raspberry juice into filter. Should have 1/2 cup clear juices.

title: Molasses Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Parboil ribs about 15 minutes. Put in baking pan. Pour sauce over and bake slowly in a 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Graham Streusel Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix crumbs nuts sugar cinnamon and butter. Set aside. Prepare cake mix according to directions. Pour half the batter in pan. Sprinkle half the crumbs over batter. Cover with remaining batter. Sprinkle the rest of crumbs over top. Bake 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Mudslide
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Makes 1 tall glass.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: In a bowl mash strawberries then stir in sugar. Ready for shortcake!

title: Crock-Pot Beef Stew
instructions: Place meat in crock-pot. Mix flour salt and pepper. Pour over meat. Stir to coat meat with flour. Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix well. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours (best way!) or high 4 to 6 hours. Stir stew thoroughly before serving.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixing bowl cream butter brown sugar egg and vanilla until light and fluffy. Mix in flour baking soda and salt. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Remove to cooling rack after 1 minute. Makes 4 to 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and add other ingredients. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Finger Lickin' Pork Ribs
instructions: Preheat gas grill on high for 15 minutes. Lightly garlic salt both sides of ribs. Put ribs on grill. Close lid. Rotate ribs frequently.

title: Red Cabbage
instructions: Saute bacon and chopped onion in bacon fat. Do not drain. Mix all ingredients and cook on very low heat (in heavy bottom pot or kettle) for about 1/2 hour. Very good with pork chops ham or fried chicken. Makes 5 servings.

title: Nanny'S Dump Cake
instructions: Do not preheat oven. Use an ungreased tube pan. Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix for 20 minutes. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Combine pretzels 3 tablespoons sugar and butter. Pat in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool crust.

title: Microwave Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart covered container. Microwave on High power for 5 minutes. Reduce setting to 50% power and microwave for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Mix egg sweet potato sugar and shortening in a bowl; beat until smooth. Stir in enough flour to make a dough stiff enough to turn onto a floured surface. Knead a few times; then roll out 1/2-inch thick. Cut with a biscuit cutter or jar lid and bake on an ungreased baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine the flour and sugar. Add potatoes eggs corn syrup nutmeg salt butter and evaporated milk. Beat well. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; add flavorings. Sift all dry ingredients together and add alternately with sour cream to first mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Pecan Cookie Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix (save 2/3 cup) margarine and 1 egg until moist. Press flat into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Mix sugar remaining eggs and vanilla together. Add corn syrup and 2/3 cup dry cake mix. Lightly stir in pecans. Pour this filling over browned crust. Return to oven. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool and cut into bars.

title: Heavenly Onions
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms in butter. Arrange onions and mushrooms in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Swiss cheese then the bread. Mix soup milk and Worcestershire. Pour over top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Overnight Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruits pineapple and oranges. Save 1 cup juice. Mix with pudding. Fold in fruits and cherries. Put in dish.

title: Primo Pesto!
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in food processor or blender. Puree until smooth. Stir in cheese. Yields 1 cup.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
instructions: Drain juice into saucepan and heat until boiling. Stir in both pkgs. of jello. Set aside to cool. Add water and coke. Chill until partly thickened. Fold in pecans cream cheese pineapple and cherries. Spray jello mold with non-sticking spray.

title: Holiday Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt (or use self-rising flour). Cream shortening; add sugar and eggs; beat until light and fluffy. Add buttermilk and flour alternately. Then fold in nuts cherries dates and candied fruit. Chill dough. Drop teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Top each with a cherry half. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Cut asparagus into 1-inch lengths. Cook until barely tender. Make a cream sauce of margarine flour milk and seasonings. Arrange alternate layers of asparagus sliced cooked eggs cream sauce and cheese in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with buttered crumbs. Bake in a moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Apple Pie Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. In a large bowl combine cake mix 1 cup of oats cheese and 6 tablespoons of margarine at low speed until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup of crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs blend 1 egg. Press into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package rinse and drain. In large bowl mix all ingredients; toss chill and serve.

title: Cold Garden Pizza
instructions: Mix 2 packages of softened cream cheese with mayonnaise dill weed and chopped onions. Bake crescent rolls at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Spread out on a cookie sheet or pizza pan; let cool.

title: Blackened Shrimp Stroganoff
instructions: Place shrimp shells in saucepan with 2 cups of water; bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Strain and discard shells (may substitute 1 cup chicken broth instead). In small bowl combine shrimp oil and blackened seasoning stirring to coat shrimp; set aside. Cook mushrooms and shallots in butter until tender. Remove from skillet. Cook shrimp over medium heat until pink. Remove from skillet and add vermouth to skillet. Boil uncovered about 2 to 3 minutes. Stir together the sour cream cornstarch and 1 cup of broth. Add to skillet; cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook 1 minute longer. Add shrimp red pepper mushroom mixture and capers. Heat through. Season with salt. Serve over noodles.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Drain well and put in bottom of casserole dish. Spot casserole with 1/2 stick of margarine or butter. Slice cheese and place all across top of broccoli. Crush 1 stick (37) Ritz crackers and place on top. Melt other 1/2 stick margarine or butter and pour over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put everything in blender and beat until mixed. Put in greased 10-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until firm.

title: Breast Of Chicken On Rice
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix mushroom soup with milk; reserve 1/2 cup of the mixture. Mix remaining soup mixture wit rice mushrooms (including liquid) and half of the onion soup mix. Pour into oblong baking dish 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch. Place chicken breasts on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken breasts; sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix. Cover and bake 1 hour; uncover and bake 15 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend in 8 ounces Cool Whip. Put into graham cracker crust and freeze.

title: Iced Tea
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Pour tea bags in a teapot or glass container. Pour the hot water over the tea bags and let sit for 5 minutes. Remove the tea bags. If you want to sweeten the tea now is the best time to add sugar. Add water until it is the strength you like. Let sit until cool and pour over ice to serve.

title: Easy Spice Cake
instructions: Mix and spread in jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool. Frost with Caramel Frosting.

title: Picnic Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise; remove yolks and set whites aside. In a small bowl mash yolks with a fork. Add the mayonnaise pickle relish mustard garlic salt Worcestershire sauce and pepper; mix well. Stuff or pipe into the egg whites. Refrigerate until serving. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Garden Salad
instructions: Mix together lettuce cauliflower broccoli and peas in a large bowl. Blend together salad dressing dressing mix and sugar; mix into vegetables. Top with bacon bits and shredded cheese. (Other vegetables may be used if desired such as green pepper cucumber carrots celery or tomato.)

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Fold in flour 1 cup at a time. Add baking powder with last cup. Blend well. Add pineapple and milk. Beat 3 minutes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Croquettes
instructions: Chicken Filling Cook chicken with salt savory garlic onion and 4 cups water. Take off broth remove chicken bones and break meat into 1-inch pieces. Cook a few minutes more. Strain broth and reserve 3 cups.

title: Blue Ribbon Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter brown sugar eggs and vanilla then add remaining ingredients except chocolate chips. Stir in chips. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Toast the English muffin. Place on a plate. In a skillet fry the bacon until crisp. Drain on a paper towel. Reduce the heat. Break the egg into the skillet; cook to desired firmness. Slide egg onto the muffin. Crumble the crisp bacon over the egg. Pour excess fat out of the skillet. Heat pizza sauce and pour over egg. Sprinkle cheese over all.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let set several hours.

title: Butterscotch Drops
instructions: Melt morsels in double boiler stirring constantly to smooth consistency. Add peanuts and chow mein noodles and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper until hardened. Store in airtight container. Does not need to be refrigerated.

title: 4-Layer Dessert
instructions: First Layer Mix flour margarine and nuts. Pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
instructions: Blend all in blender and pour over salad of fresh spinach mushrooms boiled eggs and bacon. Sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Lacey Cookies
instructions: 1. Fold in 1 c. chocolate chips. 2. Drop by teaspoons on a lightly greased cookie sheet. 3. Bake 12-15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Pour pie filling in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Add pineapple. Sprinkle cake mix over pineapple. Pour margarine over cake mix. Add coconut. Sprinkle pecans over. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 15 pieces.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Combine all ingredients except noodles and cook 1 hour. Add noodles and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Mix and decorate with grapes. Serves 20 people.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie (Pennsylvania Dutch Pie)
instructions: Cut butter into small bits; reserve 2 tablespoons for on top. Dissolve soda in hot water. Stir in molasses. Pour in unbaked shell. Mix dry ingredients flour sugar cinnamon nutmeg baking powder and soda. Spread mixture into shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until the center is firm. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons mix (reserved) on top. Bake 10 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Cottage Cheese Dill Bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on warm water; stir until blended. Stir in 2 teaspoons of sugar; set aside. Combine cottage cheese onion dill weed baking powder 2 tablespoons of sugar and eggs. Mix well. Add yeast mixture and mix well. Add flour to make a stiff dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic. Place dough in greased bowl; turn to bring greased side up. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled (1 to 1 1/2 hours). Punch down. Turn onto floured surface; knead a few times. Divide in half. Shape into bread pans and let rise until doubled. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from pans to rack. Brush tops with butter.

title: Easy Donuts
instructions: Place oil in skillet about 1-inch. Let it get hot. Cut small hole in center of biscuits with salt shaker lid. Drop into oil. Turn when brown. Brown other side. Drain on paper towel. Roll in sugar powdered sugar or cinnamon. Makes 20 donuts and 20 holes.

title: Ham Croquettes(Leftovers)
instructions: Melt butter; blend in flour. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute more. Remove from heat. Add ham onion and mustard. Chill well. Shape mixture into 8 to 10 balls. Roll in bread crumbs. Shape into cone handling lightly. Combine egg and water; dip cone in mixture and roll again in crumbs. Fry in deep hot fat (365\u00b0) for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Drain.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Brown ground beef and onion. Stir in American cheese. Mix all together then pour into oven baking dish. Sprinkle with Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Butter Pecan Cake
instructions: Empty both mixes into mixer bowl; add eggs oil and water. Mix on medium speed for two minutes. Add chopped nuts and coconut and mix until well blended. Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt cake pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and cool in pan for 10 minutes on wire rack if possible. Remove from pan and allow to cool completely. Good with powdered sugar or whipped topping.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add to first mixture. If using nuts and/or raisins add them now. Bake in oblong pan (9 x 13-inch) in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serve plain or with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Bean And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: In saucepan cook bacon until crisp. Remove and crumble. Set aside. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons drippings. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and stir now and then. Garnish with crumbled bacon. You can double this recipe many times for a crowd.

title: Chess Bars
instructions: Beat together the cake mix butter and 1 egg; press in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together the remaining 3 eggs cream cheese and confectioners sugar; pour over cake mix layer. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Leave in pan to cool 1 hour before slicing.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into small pieces. Place in 9 x 13 glass pan. Layer rest of ingredients in order given. Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over top. Top with grated cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours or overnight.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar cinnamon nutmeg ginger and salt. Set aside. In a separate bowl with a hand wire whip whip eggs for 10-15 seconds. Add in vegetable oil water and pumpkin. Add to sugar & spices and mix for 60 seconds. Gradually add to flour and baking soda. Fold in pecans.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In mixing bowl beat together zucchini sugar and eggs. Add cooking oil and mix well. Stir together the flour cinnamon baking soda nutmeg baking powder lemon and salt. Stir in zucchini mixture. Pour into oblong cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Hunter'S Stew(A Polish Recipe)
instructions: In large Dutch oven place cabbage sauerkraut and pork chops. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add bay leaf mushrooms and water; cook covered for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until chops are tender. Cool mixture then remove bones from chops. Cut chops into bite size pieces. Refrigerate all until 1 hour before serving then peel and slice kielbasi about 1/2-inch thick and add to cabbage with pork and tomato sauce. Cook covered about 1 hour or until pork is tender and stew is piping hot. Serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Fruit Roll
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients mixing well. Divide into 3 equal portions. Roll each into an 11-inch log. Roll in powdered sugar and wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate until firm. Cut in 1/2-inch slices. Can be frozen. Makes 5 dozen.

title: *Banana Cocktail
instructions: Mix together the ketchup lime juice scallions celery Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce. Fold in the bananas. Chill for 30 minutes. Serve in lettuce cups or sherbet cups. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Prepare and bake cornbread as directed on package. Crumble into a large bowl. Mix with other ingredients and chill. Keeps well.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Stir in beans sauce sugar salt and onion. Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in halves to form 20 halves. Place cut side down over meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: O' Henry Bars
instructions: Bring to a boil the Karo and sugar. Add peanut butter and Rice Krispies. Press into a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan (greased). Cover with melted chocolate chips.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Melt butter in boiling water. Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously. Cook stirring constantly until mixture forms a ball that doesnt separate. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating vigorously after each until smooth. Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake in very hot oven (450\u00b0) 15 minutes then in slow oven (325\u00b0) 25 minutes. Remove cream puffs from oven; split. Turn oven off and put cream puffs back in oven to dry out about 50 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Soften cream cheese and butter. Blend well. Combine flour and sugar. Add to butter mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press chocolate chips or pecans into each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Everlasting Pickles
instructions: Sprinkle salt over thinly sliced cucumbers and let set for 1 hour. Dissolve sugar in vinegar and add rest of ingredients to cucumbers slicing onion and pepper thinly. This makes a nice and crispy pickle and will keep indefinitely in the refrigerator.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Blend ingredients. Bring mixture to a boil and simmer for at least 1/2 hour.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil and stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla chopped nuts and bananas. Spoon batter into 3 well-greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy and sugar dissolves. Add egg yolks beating well. Combine buttermilk and soda.\tStir until soda dissolves. Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture beginning and ending with flour. Stir in vanilla. Add 1 1/2 cups walnuts and coconut stirring well. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) with cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Fold egg whites into batter.

title: Hawaiian Pie
instructions: Bake the pie shells. Cook the pineapple sugar and flour until it thickens. Cool then add the coconut and pecans. Divide the bananas into the pie shells. Pour pineapple mixture over the bananas. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Mama'S Colorvision Cake(Our Family'S Favorite)
instructions: To ice mix all remaining fruit gelatin in package with egg whites sugar cream of tartar and water. Place over boiling water and beat with electric mixer on high speed or rotary beater until icing holds stiff peaks. Remove from over boiling water and beat about 1 minute longer.

title: Strawberry Banana Ice Cream
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Stir in Eagle Brand milk half and half strawberries bananas and vanilla. Add milk and make by freezer directions. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water for 8 minutes. Stir add margarine and milk; cook for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Beat eggs sugar and extract. Remove rice from heat and slowly add egg mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix softened oleo sugar and onion with corn cornbread mix and 1 egg beaten. Put in casserole and cover with sour cream. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Sticks
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add beaten egg yolks. Sift flour and cinnamon together and add to mixture. Spread thin on a large cookie sheet that has been lightly greased. Press chopped pecans into dough. Spread beaten egg white over top. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Check after 45 minutes. Do not cook until brown as they will taste scorched. Cool and then slice in slender pieces.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in a large mixer bowl. Add eggs and vanilla; blend well. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; blend into creamed mixture. Stir in finely chopped nuts if desired. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes. (Do not overbake. Cookies will be soft. They will puff during baking and flatten upon cooling.) Cool on cookie sheet until set about 1 minute; remove to wire rack to cool completely. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Mix well (will be thin). Bake in muffin pans for 12 to 15 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Prepare potatoes as directed on package. Mix in other ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Uncover and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute celery green peppers mushrooms and onions in butter. Cook chicken and save broth. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Cook noodles in broth. Drain. Layer noodles chicken and other ingredients. Save 1/2 c. cheese for top. Bake 35 minutes at 350.

title: Air Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Beat until whites are very stiff then bake in moderate oven ten minutes.

title: Garlic-Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix milk Bisquick cheese and 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds.

title: Salt Free Diet Seasoning
instructions: Any seasoning can be added that you like. Keep in shaker and pass up the salt!

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion until tender. Remove from heat drain off any excess liquid. Then mash squash and onions; add salt pepper and butter. Add cracker crumbs half of the cheese milk and egg. Stir until well blended. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set about 45 minutes sprinkle rest of cheese on top and return to oven until melted and lightly browned.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Place cut up chicken in the bottom of a baking dish. Pour rice over chicken. Sprinkle package of Lipton soup over rice. Mix all soups with equal parts of water. Mix until smooth and pour over rice and chicken. Cover tightly with lid or foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 2 hours or until rice and chicken are done.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Brown ground meat drain and let cool. Put ground meat in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. In bowl mix taco seasoning mix and sour cream then put on top of ground meat. Place lettuce tomato and onion on then top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Enjoy with tortilla chips.

title: Mushroom Florentine
instructions: Saute whole mushrooms in butter. Set aside. Cook spinach and drain. Combine spinach butter onion salt garlic powder and pepper. Place in a 10-inch quiche or pie pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Arrange sauteed mushrooms over spinach. Cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Betty
instructions: Mound apples in buttered 9-inch pie plate; sprinkle with orange juice. Combine sugar flour spices and dash of salt. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly; sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until apples are tender and top is crisp.

title: Cornbread Stuffing
instructions: Mix crumbled cornbread and all other ingredients together put in casserole dish (2 1/2 qt.) and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown. Chicken parts and mushrooms may be added if desired. 10 to 12 servings.

title: Broccoli, Rice And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook rice. Saute onion in oleo and add rice and uncooked broccoli. Boil or bake chicken breasts; then debone and cut up into bite size pieces. Add to mixture. Add soup and Cheez Whiz. Mix well. Bake in a buttered casserole about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spiced Viennese Coffee
instructions: Put the orange extract and the sugar in coffee. Keep warm. Top with Cool Whip mixed with nutmeg and cinnamon.

title: Chicken And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; debone and chop. Cook sausage. Cook rice as directed on package using chicken broth. Combine all ingredients and top with cracker crumbs or bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (Use chicken broth as needed.)

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Butter or grease casserole dish. Drain asparagus. Make layers of asparagus eggs and cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Repeat. Add cream of mushroom soup. Top with crumbs. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Waffles
instructions: Soak the ingredients overnight. Next morning add 1/4 cup oil. Mix well. Add extra water a little at a time to make lighter waffles. Bake in waffle iron on high. This recipe is for a large crowd.

title: Sherry Zucchini Cake
instructions: Combine flour cinnamon soda salt and baking powder mixing well. Set aside. Beat together oil and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix dry ingredients with wet ones. Add vanilla sherry zucchini (leave peel on unless tough) and lemon peel. Mix in nuts and raisins. Turn into well-greased 10-inch tube pan or 9-inch Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a pick comes out clean when inserted in cake.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut beef into thin strips. Combine soy sauce garlic and ginger. Add beef. Toss and set aside. Heat oil in wok. Add beef and toss over high heat until browned. Add vegetables and cook 10 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and add to beef. Stir and cook until thickened. Add tomato wedges.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Put cheese on top of chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soup and milk and pour over the cheese. Top with dry stuffing. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 6 to 8 servings. This can be easily cut in half or doubled.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs lemon extract flour and 7-Up. Grease and flour Bundt pan very good. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Do not underbake. Make sure all ingredients are room temperature.

title: Peanut Butter Stew
instructions: Cook sausage until browned; drain all drippings except 2 tablespoons. Saute onion in drippings until tender. In a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish layer the ingredients. Begin with 1/2 of the bread then 1/2 sausage 1/2 onions and 1/2 cheese. Repeat layers. Beat together the eggs milk salt pepper and dry mustard then pour over the layers. Cover and refrigerate for at least overnight before cooking. When ready to bake remove dish from refrigerator 1 hour before baking to bring to room temperature then bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Steak A La Genevieve(This Is An Original)
instructions: Break up tomatoes placing about 1/2 the amount in baking dish. Place chicken steaks on top of tomatoes. Slice onions and peppers into strips about 1/2 inch wide. Place on top of meat. Pour remainder of broken-up tomatoes and juice on top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper as desired. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours tightly covered with foil.

title: Date Nut Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour with baking powder and salt. Add bread dates and nuts. Place in greased baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Ground Beef Stew
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add flour salt pepper and mushrooms. Simmer 5 minutes. Add soup; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream and noodles; sprinkle with parsley.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Put ingredients in layers. Lettuce in the bottom and peas on top. Spread 1 pint mayonnaise on top. Sprinkle with 1 or 2 tablespoons sugar. Cover with Romano or Parmesan cheese. Garnish with crumbled bacon or Bac*Os. Make 24 hours in advance.

title: Alex'S Favorite Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Beat eggs well. Gradually add in oil and sugar. Add vanilla. Combine with flour mixture. Add grated zucchini.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until browned; drain off excess fat. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place in an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward the center. Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese.

title: Chicken In A Blanket
instructions: Dice and brown the chicken in oil. Follow directions for cooking the soup. When the soup is done add 1/2 of the package of cheese. Cook until melted.

title: French Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl. Add salt and sugar. Stir in flour. Add enough flour to make dough thick enough to knead. Turn on floured board and knead 5 to 7 minutes. Place in greased bowl turning to grease. Cover; let rise in warm place until double (about 1 to 1 1/2 hours). Punch down. Divide into 2 balls. Let rest on lightly floured board covered 5 minutes. Grease hands and cookie sheets. Shape into 2 long French loaves. Make diagonal slits in top with razor blade or sharp knife. Cover; let rise until double (1 1/2 hours). Bake in moderate oven. When lightly browned remove from oven. Smooth over tops and sides of loaves 1 slightly beaten egg white. Return to oven for 2 minutes.

title: Curried Rice
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter until onion is tender. Stir in curry powder slightly beaten egg salt pepper and cayenne. Mix into hot rice; sprinkle with chopped olives if available.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar oleo and egg and mix thoroughly. Add flour and soda. Gradually add vanilla. Roll in logs about 2-inches in diameter. Make 4 to 5 rolls. Freeze and slice thin as needed. Cook in oven at about 350\u00b0.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple and cherries. Combine and add 1 package each of cherry and strawberry jello. Bring to a boil stirring lightly just to mix. Put in refrigerator; chill until it begins to thicken. Fold in pineapple nuts and cut up cherries. Add the 2 regular size bottles of chilled Cokes. Stir lightly to mix then chill for several hours until firm.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Mix Crisco and sugar; add egg yolks. Then add dry ingredients. Add orange juice and work as a pie crust. Roll dough out on floured board rectangle shape. Cut dough into 2-inch squares then spoon small amount of jam on each square. Fold two opposite corners overlapping each other. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 until light brown. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Orange Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Cut fat from pork chops if necessary. Place chops in large shallow baking dish. Combine the remaining ingredients; pour over chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Baste occasionally while baking.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix well the oleo oil sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet or roll dough out and cut with cutter. Makes large batch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into bite size pieces. Wash and cut cabbage into bite size pieces. Place in medium saucepan and cover with water. Add salt pepper and margarine. Cook until potatoes and cabbage are tender. Serve hot.

title: Layered Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Mix seasoning and salt and pepper to taste with hamburger or any seasoning you like. I also use Lipton onion soup mix or herb soup mix (1 package). Add raw egg to meat and seasonings and mix thoroughly.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix jello hot water cold water; let cool. Add sherbet pineapple and mandarin oranges. Use juice from pineapple and oranges. Let set till firm.

title: Aunt Jean'S Fruit Dessert
instructions: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix. Ready!

title: Bananas Foster
instructions: In chafing dish flambe pan or large skillet. Melt brown sugar and butter; add bananas. Roll bananas in melted sugar and butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon then saute until tender. Add banana liqueur and warm a few seconds and flambe. Baste bananas until flame is out. Serve banana slices and sauce over ice cream. Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Torte
instructions: Prepare the package of fudge brownies according to box directions. Add vanilla extract walnuts and cashews. Mix well. Spread in well-greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Cut crosswise into three equal parts. Put layers together with layer of raspberry jam and chocolate frosting. Spread remaining frosting on top and garnish with coconut.

title: Kathy Thompson'S Oh So Good Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Alternate cake mix and milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan or tube pan.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour into pie crusts. Cook in oven at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Chris' Tomato Beef Stew
instructions: Brown meat in a large pot then add garlic and saute. Add next 6 ingredients and add enough water to cover. Simmer until the meat is tender. Peel and cut the raw vegetables then add to stew with drained beans. Cook until vegetables are also tender. Remove the bay leaves before serving.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: In a large bowl beat the egg yolks until light yellow. Add the corn flour salt and pepper. In another large grease-free bowl use an hand-held electric mixer set at medium-high speed and beat the egg whites until they just start to form stiff peaks when the beaters are lifted. Using a rubber spatula fold 1/3 of the beaten egg whites into the corn mixture to lighten it. Fold in the remaining egg whites. Heat the oil to 375\u00b0 in a deep-fat fryer or a heavy saucepan. Drop the batter from a measuring tablespoon into the oil. Only cook 5 to 6 at a time turning occasionally so that they brown evenly. Using a slotted spoon remove the fritters to several layers of paper towels to drain. Keep warm in a 250\u00b0 oven until ready to serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Herb Marinated Chicken
instructions: Prick chicken parts on all sides with a fork. Marinate chicken turning occasionally for at least 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes uncovered.

title: Clam Mushroom Salad
instructions: Core rinse and drain lettuce. Chill in disposable plastic bag or plastic crisper. Clean mushrooms with damp paper towels; trim stems. Slice lengthwise. Combine clam juice oil vinegar salt tarragon and Tabasco in large jar or juice container; cover and shake well. Add mushrooms and onion. Shake to coat. Chill. Tear enough lettuce to make 5 cups. Chill remainder for use another time. Cut tomato into wedges. Combine with lettuce and mushroom mixture in large salad bowl; toss lightly. Add fresh clams to taste. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesecake Squares
instructions: With fork stir until crumbly the flour brown sugar nuts and butter. With spoon reserve enough to fill a cup and press the rest into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Beat together remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into crust. Sprinkle with saved topping. Return to oven for 25 minutes. Cool completely. Cut into bars. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chewy O'S
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter and pour in 9 x 13-inch pan or jelly roll pan. Cover bottom. Sprinkle cake mix over butter. Sprinkle marshmallows chocolate chips and Cheerios.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter until tender. Add to corn bread and squash and stir well. Stir in remaining ingredients mixing well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Country Style Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed; drain. In saucepan melt 1/4 cup butter; blend in flour. Add broth and cream stirring until thickened. Add cooking wine salt and pepper. In medium skillet melt remaining butter. Add mushrooms. Cook until tender. Add mushrooms and chicken to sauce. Pour in a greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until cheese is golden. Serves 6.

title: Cocoa
instructions: In a saucepan combine sugar cocoa water and salt. Cook over low heat. Stir in milk. Cook over medium heat (dont boil).

title: Mimosa Mold
instructions: Stir boiling water into Jell-O in large bowl at least 2 minutes until completely dissolved. Stir in Club soda. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours or until thick (spoon dragged through leaves definite impression). Stir in oranges and strawberries. Pour into 6 cups Jell-O mold sprayed with nonstick spray. Refrigerate 4 hours.

title: New Pumpkin Pound Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients room temperature. Beat margarine at medium speed 2 minutes. Gradually add sugar beating continuously over 7 minutes. After 7 minutes add eggs one at a time just until yellow disappears. Combine flour and next 6 ingredients. Combine pumpkin and next 2 ingredients. Begin with flour mixture and end with flour mixture. Alternate with pumpkin mixture. Mix at lowest speed just until blended. Grease well and flour a tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 to 30 minutes. Test for doneness. Cool on rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Ice with a cream cheese icing.

title: Miniature Reuben Sandwiches
instructions: Butter one side of party rye slice. Place buttered side down on a cookie sheet. Spread each slice with Thousand Island dressing. Cover bread with corned beef. Spread sauerkraut over corned beef. Place slice of Swiss cheese over sauerkraut. Cover with second slice of party rye Thousand Island side over Swiss cheese. Stick toothpick into sandwich. Bake 10 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Banana Mallow Pie
instructions: Combine 2 cups vanilla wafer crumbs and 1/3 cup Parkay margarine (melted). Press into 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Quiche
instructions: Press hash brown potatoes between paper towels to remove moisture. Press hash browns onto bottom and up sides of a 9-inch pie plate to form a crust. Drizzle melted margarine over crust. Bake crust in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Toss together the ham; cheeses and hot pepper sauce. Place in crust. Beat the eggs milk and seasoned salt together to form a smooth mixture. Pour over ham and cheese. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes until knife comes out clean. Let stand for 10 minutes.

title: Sugarless Applesauce Cake
instructions: Combine raisins fruit and water in a pan; cook uncovered until water is evaporated and fruit is soft. Set aside to cool.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Sift and mix dry ingredients together. Add mayonnaise coffee and vanilla. Mix with dry ingredients until moist. Grease and flour two 9-inch round pans or one 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Test center with a toothpick.

title: Salmon Cakes Deluxe
instructions: Drain juice from salmon into a bowl. Set salmon aside. Add bread crumbs to juice; let stand until thick. Stir next 6 ingredients and mix well. Add salmon and stir. Makes 6 or 7 cakes. Fry as you would crab cakes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in 4 cups boiling salted water. Stir often to prevent sticking. When tender add cheese and margarine to drained macaroni. Beat eggs well; add milk and flour using a wire whisk to dissolve lumps. Put macaroni mixture in a greased casserole dish. Pour milk and egg mixture over macaroni. Bake at 400\u00b0 until \set\ and slightly browned on top.

title: Almond Roca
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar water and syrup. Cook slowly until mixture reaches hard crack. Pour into buttered pan. When slightly cool cover with melted chocolate and almonds. When cold break into pieces.

title: Lauren'S Favorite Tuna Sandwich
instructions: Mix all together. Add whatever more mayo you want. Chill. Serve on wheat bread topped with sliced tomato and cucumbers.

title: Potato-Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. In the meantime cook celery and carrots in small saucepan with a little water. Fry bacon with onion and drain. When potatoes are tender (do not drain water) mix with electric mixer until potatoes are small. Add bacon onion carrots celery bouillon cube and frozen broccoli. Simmer and add cheese until melted. Salt and pepper to taste. If too thick add milk to thin.

title: Orange Mallow Frost
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add sherbet; stir until dissolved. Chill until almost set; fold in fruit and marshmallows. Fill 6 dessert dishes; chill until firm. Garnish with extra orange slices. Makes 6 servings.

title: Praline Coffee
instructions: In Dutch oven combine coffee milk and sugar; stir. Cook over medium heat until boiling; remove from heat. Stir in ice cream vodka vanilla and maple flavoring. Serve hot. Yield 20 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Creme Brulee With Fresh Fruit
instructions: Early in day or day ahead

title: Old Fashioned Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together sugars and flour. Add the rest of the ingredients. Stir together well and pour into two 9-inch pie shells. Sprinkle nutmeg over top of pies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes and 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until firm in the middle.

title: Crusty Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef onion and garlic in a skillet until meat is browned stirring to crumble. Drain off pan drippings. Stir in tomato sauce and chili powder. Pour into a lightly greased baking dish. Top with cheese. Spoon beans over cheese. Prepare cornbread. Pour over beans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Heat oleo oil and water to boiling. In mixing bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour boiling mixture over dry ingredients. Mix well. Add 1/2 cup buttermilk to which 1 teaspoon baking soda has been added. Stir and add 2 eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well. Mixture will be thin. Pour in a jelly roll pan (or 10 x 15-inch pan) greased with butter. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pork Barbecue
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake covered 3 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Take meat apart with fork. Bake 10 minutes longer uncovered.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and squeeze spinach. Add remaining ingredients in order; blend well. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Serve with fresh cut vegetables.

title: Rhubarb Jello Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and cut in butter. Add egg and milk. Mix well. Put into ungreased 6 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan. Push up on side of pan. Spread 3 cups cut up rhubarb on top. Sprinkle with 1 (3 ounce) package cherry jello.

title: Surprise Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in flour rum extract and nuts; blend well. Wrap a tablespoon of dough around each cherry. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 25 minutes cool slightly. Roll in additional powdered sugar and finely chopped nuts.

title: Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Small mixing bowl; mix together 1 1/3 cup crumbs and sugar. Stir in butter. Press into 9-inch pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar and flavoring. Beat until fluffy. Add egg; beat well. Add milk alternately with mixed and sifted dry ingredients; beat until smooth. Fold in floured blueberries. Turn into greased and paper-lined 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan and bake in moderate oven 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Ginger Ale Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water. Add ginger ale and chill until slightly thickened. Fold in peaches nut meats and diced celery. Turn into 1 quart mold or individual molds. Chill until firm. Unmold on crisp lettuce. Serve with whipped cream or mayonnaise. Makes 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Line 10 x 15-inch baking pan with roll dough pressing edges and perforations to seal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool to room temperature.

title: Humus Tahini
instructions: Partially drain chick peas. Place all ingredients in a blender; blend until smooth. Let it sit in refrigerator for at least 8 hours. Serve with crackers or fresh vegetables.

title: Turned-On Burgers
instructions: Combine pepperoni cheese and mustard. Shape ground beef into 12 thin patties. Top 6 patties with cheese mixture; cover with remaining 6 patties. Press edges together and seal. Broil or pan-fry. Serve on buns garnished with onion tomato pepper and radish. Makes 6 servings.

title: Basic Syrup Recipe
instructions: Boil for 3 minutes (stir and keep full boil). Pour into hot sterile jars with sterile lids and seals.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in brown sugar syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popped corn and peanuts. Mix well with greased hands. Turn into 2 large shallow pans. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool. Break apart and store in covered containers.

title: Hamburger Noodle Bake
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Toss in meat. Crush garlic and mix meat salt pepper and tomato sauce. Cover and cook slowly 15 to 20 minutes. Cook and drain noodles. Chop onions and mix with cream cheese and sour cream. In large casserole put 1/3 noodles in bottom. Spread 1/3 scallion mix over noodles with 1/2 meat sauce. Repeat layers twice. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Mix flour salt sugar shortening and yeast. Add water and mix by hand until mixture is not sticky (add more flour if needed). Let rise until pan is full then make into pizza crust or bread. Bake until golden brown at 375\u00b0.

title: Choplets And Pasta
instructions: In a large pot boil 10 cups of water. Make sure the water is very hot and boiling. Add 1 teaspoon oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt to boiling water. Add noodles stir and boil about 5 to 6 minutes. Test for doneness by cutting with fork and tasting. Drain in colander; do not rinse in cold water. Pour pasta into dish and put in margarine; let melt. Add Accent and stir to avoid noodles sticking.

title: Stoby'S Cheese Dip
instructions: Bring first 6 ingredients to a boil. Add Velveeta. In another bowl mix margarine and flour. Add to other mixture. Add picante sauce chili and lemon juice. Simmer.

title: Layered Shortbread Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 8-inch square pan. In large bowl cream sugar margarine and egg. Stir in flour one cup at a time. Stir in pecans. Divide dough into 2 balls; wrap 1/2 in plastic while preparing remainder. Press remaining dough into pan. Spread with preserves to within 1/2-inch from edge of pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and cinnamon. Pat out remaining dough between plastic wrap to shape of pan and cover over mixture. Press edges to seal. Bake until golden about 60 minutes. Score while hot; cut when cool.

title: Gelatin Layer Salad
instructions: Mix lime Jell-O pineapple 2 cups boiling water and 1 cup cold water. Let set. Whip cream and set aside.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add sugar and pineapple juice. Freeze. Remove from freezer in time for it to thaw just to slush stage. Add cold ginger ale before serving.

title: Beef Rolls Warsaw Style
instructions: Cut flank steak into wide strips or buy them in the store. Pound each strip well. Fry the bacon until golden. Remove from the drippings. Mix the bacon onion and bread crumbs. Add 2 tablespoons bacon drippings and as much water as needed to get a sour cream consistency. Season with salt and pepper to your taste. Spread stuffing on each strip of meat. Roll and fasten with toothpicks. Sprinkle with flour. Brown them in hot drippings then transfer beef rolls to a baking dish. Add 1/2 cup water. Cover and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with noodles or rice and a tossed salad. Serves four.

title: Venus De Milo Soup
instructions: Cook beef with butter and onion. Add water tomatoes and paste; cook for about 20 minutes. Add shells and let cook. Add Veg-All and mushrooms. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Gram Schrauder'S Custard With Peaches
instructions: Beat eggs then add sugar salt and cornstarch. Last add hot milk and vanilla. Cook slow stirring all the time until thick. Add sliced peaches when cool.

title: Peanut Butter Pie (No Bake)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a baked pie shell. Do not bake. Place in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken(Chinese)
instructions: In large skillet or wok stir-fry onion in garlic and ginger in hot oil for 1 minute. Add peppers and stir until crisp-tender. Remove from pan and add chicken. Stir-fry until cooked. Return vegetables to pan. Mix cornstarch with soy sauce pineapple juice vinegar and sugar. Pour into pan. Add pineapple chunks. Bring to a full boil. Serve with hot rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Frog Eye Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender drain. Cook fruit juices eggs sugar and flour until it thickens. Cool add fruit soup macaroni and Cool Whip. Add marshmallows and refrigerate. Makes large salad and can be frozen.

title: Easy Fudge (Fantasy Fudge)
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in heavy 2-1/2 quart saucepan. Bring to full rolling boil stirring constantly. Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat stir in chocolate pieces until melted. Add marshmallow creme nuts and vanilla beating until well blended. Pour into greased 13 x 9 pan. Cool to room temperature. Cut into squares. Makes 3 lbs.

title: Dry Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in tight container. The mix can be put in decorated jars or small tins and be given at Christmas. Use 1/3 cup of the powder to 1 cup of hot water.

title: Mom'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Combine macaroni in 2 cups warm water. Microwave for 4 minutes on High. Stir. Microwave 4 minutes more. Stir again. Mix cornstarch with milk. Heat milk and cornstarch mixture with butter until butter melts; stir to prevent lumping then add cheese and mustard. Stir well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Combine mixture with macaroni in casserole dish. Bake until cheese melts. Dot bread crumbs with butter. Brown in oven until butter melts.

title: Oma'S Crepes
instructions: Whisk together eggs milk and flour. Melt about a heaping teaspoonful of shortening in large frying pan (cast-iron or Teflon works best). When hot put large ladle of batter in pan moving pan side to side to thin out batter to size of bottom of pan. When lightly browned quickly turn with spatula and brown a minute on other side. Put on plate. Fill center with fruit jam or sprinkle with powdered sugar. Roll up and serve. Serves 4 about 8 crepes.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a tight container. Use 1/2 cup mix to 1 cup hot water for 1 cup hot chocolate.

title: Double Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients; beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir together the flour and soda; blend into batter. Stir in nuts. Form into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; flatten slightly with fingers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until slightly tan on edges. Cool slightly on cookie sheet; remove to wire rack to cool completely. Makes 6 dozen small cookies or 3 dozen large cookies.

title: Green Tomatoes
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper. Coat tomatoes. Fry in oil or butter. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Garnish with onion and pepper.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Beat egg add sugar and mix well. Add oil mix well. Add dates and walnuts. Sift dry ingredients and add mixing well. Bake in a greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into bars and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Sugarless Cookies(Yield: 32 To 34 Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet to make 32 to 34 cookies. Bake about 15 to 20 minutes. When done remove from pan and cool.

title: Chicken Kelly(For A Party, Serves 25)
instructions: Cut up chicken in bite size pieces. Beat eggs and pour over chicken. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Pour bread crumbs into bag with garlic and parsley. Shake.
