Put chicken into bag and shake until the chicken is coated. Heat 1 1/2 cups oil in frying pan and brown chicken. Place chicken in baking dish layering chicken and mushrooms alternately. Put sliced or grated cheese on top. Dissolve 4 bouillon cubes in 2 cups boiling water and pour over cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Popovers
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Beat eggs with rotary beater until light and thick. Add flour salt and 1/2 the milk. Continue to beat slowly until all flour is moistened (30 seconds). Gradually add remaining milk and melted butter. Beat until free from lumps (1 to 2 minutes). Fill greased pans a little less than 1/2 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole(Yield 4 To 6 Servings)
instructions: Cook beef and onion until meat is lightly browned; drain. Add salt in ketchup and tomato sauce and heat thoroughly; turn into 8 inch square or 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cut cheese into thin strips and lay over meat. Top with pizza crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Melissa'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sift 2 3/4 cups flour with baking powder and salt. In large mixing bowl with electric mixer at medium speed beat butter with brown sugar and eggs. Beat until mixture is light and fluffy. At low speed blend in milk then flour mixture; beat just to combine. Turn batter into prepared pan spreading evenly.

title: Twice-Filled Potatoes(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: Bake foil-wrapped potatoes in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour until they give when lightly squeezed; turn after 30 minutes. Remove foil. When cool enough to handle slice top quarter off. Scoop out inside without breaking skin; place flesh in a large bowl. Add cottage cheese yogurt celery red pepper chives mustard horseradish and thyme. Fill shells with filling. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake on cookie sheet in a 375\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mash half of strawberries and put in heavy pan with sugar combined with cornstarch butter and lemon juice. Cook until thick and clear. Mix cream cheese with milk and powdered sugar and spread over baked pie shell. Put rest of berries on cheese. Spread cooked mixture on this. Chill for 2 hours.

title: Ambrosia Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Combine pineapple oranges grapes marshmallows coconut nuts and cherries. Mix sour cream and sugar; stir into mixture. Chill. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cathedral Windows
instructions: When chocolate mixture is cool pour it over the marshmallows and pecans and stir carefully. Take wax paper and spread coconut on it. Divide the candy mixture making two rolls. Chill in refrigerator. Slice off slices.

title: Chocolate Rum Cake
instructions: Use greased and floured tube pan. Beat all ingredients together (except confectioners sugar) for 5 minutes. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Broiled Scallops
instructions: Dry scallops off with paper towel. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Dip scallops into mixture in beaten egg and tablespoon of water then dip into bread crumbs (use pie pan for crumbs). Place under broiler until brown possibly 7 to 8 minutes on one side. Turn them over on other side for approximately 5 to 6 minutes; check them with fork. Serves 2 people.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert Or Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and spread into a 10 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool.

title: Chicken Imperial
instructions: On waxed paper coat chicken breasts with 1/4 cup flour. In 12-inch skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook chicken a few pieces at a time until lightly browned on all sides. Set aside. In drippings in skillet over medium heat cook mushrooms and onion 5 minutes stirring frequently. Stir in cream salt and pepper; stir to blend well. Return chicken to skillet. Reduce heat to low; cover skillet and simmer 20 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender. Remove chicken. In cup blend 1 tablespoon flour with water. Gradually add to pan liquid stirring constantly. Stir until mixture thickens. Spoon over chicken.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Pinwheels
instructions: Mix together softened cream cheese and dry dressing mix. Spread on tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towels. Sprinkle on top of cream cheese. Roll tortillas tightly and wrap tightly. Chill at least 2 hours. Cut rolls into 1-inch slices. Discard ends. Serve with spirals facing up. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Sausage Balls #2
instructions: Add Bisquick and cheese to sausage. Sausage should be at room temperature. Roll into balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Red Cabbage
instructions: Shred cabbage medium fine. Saute onion in oil in large pot. Add cabbage and saute lightly. Add wine vinegar sugar and apple. Cook 35 minutes or until cabbage is wilted. Freezes well.

title: Broccoli-Onion Deluxe
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion in a small amount of water 3 to 4 minutes or until tender; drain well. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat; add cream cheese and stir until melted. Stir in salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables; stir gently. Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1/2 quart casserole; top with cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Combine remaining butter and bread crumbs; toss gently. Uncover casserole and sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake 5 additional minutes or until golden brown.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix and bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Bring ingredients to a boil; cook over medium heat for 4 minutes after it boils. Remove from heat and add powdered sugar. Beat until creamy.

title: Ninth Street House Iced Tea
instructions: Make 1-quart tea per directions on instant tea jar (do not use lemon flavored instant tea). Add sugar lemon juice and white grape juice. Mix well. Can be made in larger quantities and stored in refrigerator for future use.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Chop and combine vegetables salt and sugar. Cook until it begins to thicken; add vinegar and spices. Cook until it becomes a thick sauce and seal.

title: Cheese Puff Balls
instructions: Combine cheese flour paprika and pepper. Add beaten egg whites and shape into small balls. Roll in cracker crumbs. Fry in hot oil at 375\u00b0. Drain. Serve hot. Yield 8 servings.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; add milk and coconut alternately with flour vanilla and baking powder. Makes two layers. Add your favorite frosting; cover with coconut.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a saucepan; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Set aside. Saute onion in butter until tender. Stir onion soup milk and broccoli into rice. Spoon into a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish; sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually add sugar. Stir pumpkin and lemon juice together; set aside. Sift flour spices and salt together then fold into pumpkin mixture. Spread in a greased and floured jelly roll pan (batter looks like cake batter). Top with nuts. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. While baking spread powdered sugar on dish towel. When done place on towel and roll up. Cool.

title: Poppy Seed Cake Supreme
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl stirring to blend. Beat at medium speed for 5 minutes (700 strokes by hand) scraping sides of bowl frequently.

title: Fried Shad-Roe
instructions: Take the hard roe of shad; season with salt and pepper. Roll in flour. Immerse in beaten eggs. Roll again in bread crumbs or corn meal. Fry in enough fat to cover. Fry slowly. Shad roe has a tendency to pop. Drain on paper toweling. Serve with tomato sauce and lemon slices.

title: Caramel Morsel Bars
instructions: Melt caramels in water in saucepan over low heat stirring until smooth; set aside. In a large bowl mix cereal and nuts. Pour melted caramels over and mix well. Pat entire mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate and butterscotch chips over cereal mixture. Place in a 200\u00b0 oven until soft. Spread melted chips; cool and cut into bars.

title: Chicken Imperial
instructions: In 1-quart saucepan combine first 10 ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes. Arrange chicken in a large roasting pan. Pour liquid mixture over chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours basting frequently with juices.

title: Peanut Butter Delights(Cookies)
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa butter milk and salt in saucepan. Bring to hard boil (takes about 2 minutes). After it comes to a boil let it boil for 1 minute longer on high heat. Stir constantly from time you put it in the saucepan. Total cooking time is 3 minutes (no longer). Remove from heat and add peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until peanut butter melts into chocolate. Pour oats in and stir until it is so thick that you can hardly stir anymore but dont get it so thick that it falls apart. Spoon onto wax paper and let cool.

title: Lobster Casserole
instructions: Cut lobster into bite size pieces and cook slowly in butter to start color. Do not cook too long or too fast or it will be tough. Remove lobster meat. Add flour mixed with seasoning to fat in pan adding cream and top milk slowly. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add lobster and bread torn into small pieces. Pour into greased casserole. Top with a few buttered crumbs and bake until bubbly and delicately browned.

title: Preserved Children
instructions: They have a tale to tell;

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix together sugar flour and cinnamon. Add oil eggs vanilla and pumpkin. Pour into a greased tube pan and bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Let cool completely.

title: Rich Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Wash and drain strawberries. Cut the strawberries in half. Place the strawberries as tight as possible and mound them in the pie shell. Press confectioners sugar on until you cannot see the berries. Chill for 2 hours. Add whipped cream on the top and chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken breasts in the melted butter. Roll in bread crumbs mixed with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a shallow pan for 1 hour in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Party Potato Skins
instructions: Cut potatoes in half lengthwise. Scoop out pulp leaving 1/8 inch thick shells. (Save pulp for another use.) Brush with melted butter; broil 6 inches from heat until crisp. Place cut side up on ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with garlic salt and cheese. Broil 30 seconds or until cheese melts. Top with bacon and chives. Yield 8 servings.

title: Fudgsicles
instructions: Mix well and freeze.

title: Beef Rump Pot Roast-Herb Gravy
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Dredge pot roast in seasoned flour and brown in fat in Dutch oven. Pour off drippings. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water. Add bouillon bay leaves garlic salt marjoram and basil to meat. Cover tightly and cook slowly 3 to 3 1/2 hours until meat is tender. Remove meat to hot platter discard bay leaves and thicken cooking liquid with flour for gravy.

title: Fran'S Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix together grated cheese mayonnaise celery and onion. Mix together Ritz crackers and melted butter. Grease casserole. Place vegetables on the bottom cheese mixture next then spread crackers and butter mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Prepare the first four ingredients in salad bowl. In blender place the remaining ingredients and mix for 1 minute. Store left over dressing in refrigerator. Keeps well.

title: Icebox Treat
instructions: Put a layer of wafers in baking dish. Add a layer of fruit to which sugar has been added then add nuts to which margarine has been added. Make another layer of each. Chill 4 hours. Unmold on cold platter. Top with whipped topping and cherries.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Melt butter over low heat. Remove from heat and add evaporated milk sugar eggs and salt. Beat until well blended. Add flour and baking powder. Stir in egg mixture to blend. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in greased 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: English Muffin Canapes
instructions: Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add olives olive liquid and nuts. This should be soupy but thickens up after chilling. Excellent spread on small slices party rye bread toast or bagel rounds or crackers.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In pot melt margarine. Put flour and pepper in margarine and blend. Add milk and stir until margarine mixture is melted. Add cheese and stir until melted. Cook macaroni as directed. Put macaroni in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Put cheese mixture over macaroni. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix sugar and oil in blender. Add remainder of ingredients. Blend. Chill. Very good.

title: Broccoli Cheese Chicken
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and broccoli is done. Delicious!!

title: Lemon, Lime And Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix the Jell-O with the hot water; dissolve and let cool. Mix with the cool Jell-O the following cottage cheese crushed pineapple mayonnaise milk and pecans. Refrigerate this overnight and you will enjoy it the following night. Serves 6.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Cheesy Sausage Casserole
instructions: Crumble ground beef and sausage in a large skillet. Add onion green pepper salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat until meat is browned and onion is tender. Drain well. Stir in remaining ingredients mixing well. Spoon into a lightly greased 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly. Yield 12 servings.

title: Butter And Lecithin Mixture
instructions: *Lecithin granules are available at Bedford Medicine Shop West 16th Street.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together the mashed potatoes butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs. Then add vanilla and milk. Spray a casserole dish with Pam and put mixture in dish.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in oil. Add garlic green peppers and carrots. Saute briefly. Add bouillon soy sauce sherry vinegar sugar ginger and pineapple with juice. Bring to a full boil. Stir in rice (optional). Cover; remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Stir before serving. Cooked rice can be served on the side. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate 1 hour. Shape into small balls. Freeze. Bake frozen balls 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Streusel Topped Fruit Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spoon filling into pastry shell. In a bowl combine flour and brown sugar. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Stir in nuts. Crumble over pie filling. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden and filling is bubbly. Remove to wire rack to cool. Makes 8 servings.

title: Tater Tot Hot Dish
instructions: Fry ground beef onion and celery until celery is tender. Put in bottom of 2-quart casserole dish. Layer corn and soups then top with Tater Tots. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Parmesan Butter Pan Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In 9-inch square baking pan melt butter in oven (3 to 5 minutes). Meanwhile in medium bowl combine all ingredients except milk. Stir in milk just until moistened. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface; knead 10 times or until smooth. Roll dough in 12 x 4-inch rectangle. Cut into 12 (1-inch) strips. Dip each strip into melted butter. Place in same pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook beef garlic onion and green pepper in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat stirring frequently to break up meat. Cook until onion is soft and meat has a gray color. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer the chili for 45 minutes stirring frequently. Makes 7 servings.

title: Country Ham Steak With Glazed Apples
instructions: In 10-inch skillet melt butter until sizzling. Stir in brown sugar and mustard. Add apples. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until apples are crisply tender (5 to 7 minutes). Place ham steak in same skillet arranging apples on ham steak. Cover; continue cooking until ham steak is heated through (5 to 7 minutes). Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Place in greased 9-inch square pan.\tBake for 30 minutes. Cut into squares and serve.\tGood hot or cold. Makes 8 servings.

title: Two Pounds Of Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and water in a saucepan and cook to soft ball stage. Add peanuts and cook to hard crack stage. Remove from heat and add soda salt and vinegar. Stir well and pour into a buttered cookie pan. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Food For The Angels
instructions: Line pan with 1/2 crushed wafers. Cream powdered sugar and butter; add beaten eggs and beat. Repeat. Beat in vanilla and pour mixture over wafers. Whip cream; add sugar and pour over first mixture. Pour pineapple over that and sprinkle rest of wafers over top. Let stand in cool place 12 hours.

title: Spinach And Beans
instructions: In 6 to 8 quart pot brown garlic in olive oil. Steam spinach with cover on; add rest of ingredients. Cook elbow macaroni and add to mixture. Break to high simmer; add wine to boil off alcohol (1 to 2 minutes). Serve in bowl; sprinkle with parsley and Parmesan cheese. Enjoy with crusty bread.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown rice in oil. Add tomato sauce water and spices; bring to a boil. Let boil for 20 minutes then cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.

title: No Bake Fruitcake
instructions: Chop dates raisins and candied cherries. Crush graham crackers. Slightly toast pecans with a little butter then grind or chop. Melt marshmallows with butter in double boiler. Mix all ingredients together (you will have to mix with your hands). Line a box with wax paper; butter wax paper and pack cake into box. Refrigerate. (Will keep a long time in refrigerator.)

title: Five Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Marinate overnight. Stir often to be sure all vegetables are marinated.

title: Low-Fat Baked Chicken
instructions: Remove skin and fat from chicken. Season all sides with season salt. Lay pieces bone down in a baking dish. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until juices run clear when pricked with a fork. Be sure to retighten foil after checking.

title: Honey Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Wash and pat dry chicken with paper towels. Melt the margarine butter or vegetable oil in a shallow baking pan. Stir in remaining ingredients. Roll chicken pieces in the mixture then arrange in a single layer in same pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 basting occasionally for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Reserve 1/2 of chopped beef. Mix all ingredients and roll into a ball. Then roll in remaining half of beef. Chill for 1 hour. Serve with crackers.

title: Individual Cheesecakes
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients together. Put a vanilla wafer in the bottom of a small cupcake holder. Pour the cupcake holder about 1/2 full with batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Squash Puffs
instructions: Mix ingredients and spoon into hot grease for cooking.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the cream cheese butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla and almond extract. Add flour; blend well but do not overbeat.\tBake in a 10-inch tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Jello Dessert
instructions: Put pineapple and jello together. Boil for 3 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes. Add cottage cheese. Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Mold 30 to 45 minutes. May be made the day before. Yummy.

title: Bacon, Lettuce And Tomato Salad
instructions: Layer bacon lettuce tomato broccoli and onion in order listed in large glass salad bowl.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift flour. Make big hole in middle and put all ingredients in hole. Add buttermilk. Mix with hands to make a stiff dough. Roll out and cut with cutter; dont roll too thin. Bake at 425\u00b0 until done but not too hard. Brown lightly with oven on broil.

title: Breakfast Pizza Casserole
instructions: Press crescent rolls into a 13 x 10-inch casserole dish bringing up sides to hold liquid (like pizza). Sprinkle sausage over bottom on top of the crescent roll layer. Add hash browns and cheese. Combine eggs milk salt and pepper and mix well. Pour over top of all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 45 minutes when eggs are set and top is browned.

title: Holiday Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup water. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. (Optional 1 quart ginger ale when ready to serve.)

title: Harvest Spice Peach Crisp
instructions: Place fruit in 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Combine flour sugar oats and walnuts. Mix butter until crumbly; sprinkle evenly over fruit. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden. Serve with ice cream if desired. Prep time 5 minutes. Cook Time 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Scotcheroos
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup. Cook over moderate heat until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and Rice Krispies. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chips over hot water. Spread evenly over Rice Krispie mixture. Cut into bars when cool.

title: Herbed Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine Ranch mix and oil. Add dry ingredients. Pour over crackers. Bake for 15 minutes in a 200\u00b0 to 250\u00b0 oven. Stir while heating.

title: Spicy Shrimp
instructions: Coat shrimp lightly with flour. Melt margarine in large skillet on medium heat. Add shrimp; cook and stir 5 minutes or until lightly browned turning frequently. Mix chili sauce parsley lemon juice mustard and pepper. Pour over shrimp; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes.

title: Squash - Souffle
instructions: Cook squash in a small amount of water until tender; drain and mash. Combine margarine and stuffing mix; stir well. Place 1/2 of stuffing mixture in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine squash onions sour cream and soup. Mix well. Pour over stuffing layer. Top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart baking dish. Top with cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cowboy Hats
instructions: In a greased muffin pan place bologna slice in each cup until it forms a bowl. (It may be necessary to cut in the bologna so it will fit into the pan.) Fill each bologna cup with mashed potatoes. Place 1/4 slice cheese on top of each one. Bake at 325\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Fusilli With Fresh Tomato Sauce
instructions: Slice a large X on bottom of each tomato. Immerse into boiling water 15 seconds. When cool peel off skin. Slice tomatoes into 1-inch chunks letting seeds fall out.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Alternate layers of potatoes green pepper and onion in greased 2-quart baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over potatoes. Cover and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are done.

title: Egg Balls
instructions: With the back of a wooden spoon press eggs through a strainer into a small bowl; add the 1/4 cup butter and mix well. Stir salt Cayenne Worcestershire and celery seed into egg mixture. Shape egg mixture into 3/4-inch balls and chill in the refrigerator 1 hour. While egg mixture is chilling prepare bread crumbs. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place bread crumbs and the 2 tablespoons butter in a pie plate or shallow pan; place in oven and bake 15 minutes stirring occasionally until crumbs are lightly browned. Remove plate from oven and cool. Roll egg balls in the prepared bread crumbs to coat thoroughly. Makes 16 to 18 balls.

title: Mont-Diablo Dip
instructions: On large round cookie tray layer in order listed. Should be made a day ahead.

title: Cranberry And Orange Relish
instructions: Cut 1 small orange in quarters; take out seeds and white inner membrane. Grind in food chopper with 1/2 pound cranberries. Put in bowl or other container and mix in 3/4 cup sugar. Refrigerate for a few days to blend flavors.

title: Graham Cracker Fudge
instructions: Mix graham crackers and nuts. Cook bits over low heat until melted. Mix all other ingredients together with melted bits. Put in buttered pan then in refrigerator until hard enough to eat. You may add anything to recipe like coconut instead of nuts. Enjoy.

title: Manhattan Meatballs
instructions: Combine meat bread crumbs eggs onion and seasonings and mix lightly. Shape into medium meatballs. Brown in margarine. Put in casserole and combine preserves and barbecue sauce. Pour over meatballs. (Cover dish.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pepperoni Squares
instructions: Unroll 1 package of crescent rolls. Put layer of pepperoni on top. Put layer of cheese on top of pepperoni. Top with remaining package of crescent rolls. Cut into squares pinching edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fruit And Nut Salad
instructions: Remove the rind and the eyes from the pineapple and cut the flesh into small pieces rejecting the hard core. Blanch the nuts by pouring boiling water over them and allowing them to stand a few minutes when the skins can be easily removed. Chop finely and add to the pineapple. Pile in little heaps on lettuce leaves cover with the dressing and decorate with cherries.

title: Light Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and eggs until light. Sift together flour nutmeg cinnamon and baking soda. Add to egg mixture then add the rest of the ingredients. Add 1/4 cup of milk if necessary. Coat fruits with part of the flour. Drop by teaspoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Kim'S Fruited Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise lemon juice salt and pepper. Toss with chicken and celery. Add grapes; mix. Spoon into cooked and cooled pie shell. Tastes best if chicken mixture is chilled before serving in pie shell.

title: Abc Snack Mix
instructions: Other ingredients to use or for substitution; miniature marshmallows chocolate chips popcorn mixed nuts raisins dried fruit or M&Ms.

title: Jody'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Add rice and cheese. Saute onion in oleo and add to mixture. Pour into greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: My Favorite Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in deep 10-inch or 12-inch casserole dish at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven keep warm. Stir together in large bowl sugar flour baking powder and salt. Add milk beat until smooth. Set aside.

title: Garlic Lime Chicken
instructions: Mix together soy sauce lime juice Worcestershire sauce garlic and mustard. Place chicken in a bowl and pour sauce over all. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Remove chicken from marinade; discard marinade. Sprinkle chicken with pepper; grill until chicken is cooked through and tender about 6 to 8 minutes on each side. Makes 4 servings each with 130 calories (1.5 g fat and 76 mg cholesterol).

title: Polynesian Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend. Place chicken in glass baking dish. Add ingredients. Cover and chill overnight turning often. Place skin side down on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn and bake 30 minutes longer. Serve hot or cold.

title: Terry'S Haddock
instructions: Saute onions and celery until tender. Add tomatoes; sprinkle parsley flakes over top. Add fish on top. Simmer for 10 minutes turn over and simmer another 10 to 20 minutes until flaky.

title: Fresno Potato Casserole
instructions: Place unpeeled potatoes in 3-quart pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are just tender when pierced about 20 minutes. Drain well. When cool enough to handle peel and cut into 1/4-inch slices. In a greased shallow 2-quart casserole arrange half of the potato slices. Top with half of the bacon and onion. Stir milk into sour cream. Spread 1/2 of this over the bacon and onion then half of the cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Repeat layers. Sprinkle top with croutons and drizzle butter over all. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Banana Cake
instructions: Slice bananas into blender. Puree until smooth (1 1/2 cups). In saucepan combine 1/2 cup pureed bananas 1/3 cup sugar 1 egg and chocolate. Heat until chocolate melts. Cool. Cream remaining 1 cup sugar with shortening until light and fluffy. Add rum extract and remaining 2 eggs one at a time beating well after each. Combine dry ingredients. Beat with creamed mixture alternately with remaining bananas. Blend in chocolate mixture. Bake in 2 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes until done. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Invert on wire rack to cool. Cut slice in top of cake. Put cut side up and frost with Rum Fudge. Frost sides and top. Garnish cake with banana slices. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Uncooked Decorating Butter Cream
instructions: Mix all together and beat until smooth. Do not overbeat or it will have air bubbles. May use food processor which does not make air bubbles.

title: Orange Sorbet Freeze
instructions: In a blender mix all ingredients until thick and smooth. Makes one (10-ounce) serving.

title: Potato Cakes
instructions: Cook the onion in small amount of oil until tender. Combine potatoes onion and egg; mix well. Drop by spoonful in hot skillet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Brown on both sides. Serve hot.

title: Hot Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Pan can be lined with wax paper.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Mix in blender until smooth.

title: Spinach Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread dough in a large bowl. Roll dough flat about 1/4-inch thick. Spread spinach mixture on the dough and roll in a jellyroll style. Pinch edges together and make several fork pierces in the top. Place on oiled baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Clam Bake
instructions: Prepare meats ahead and put in large bowl together. Pour seafood sauce in another bowl. Add salt pepper and parsley flakes; mix. Pour over all the meat making sure all meat is coated. Add enough water if needed to barely cover all meats. Push meat under sauce. Let marinate in sauce at least several hours before putting bake together.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Party Sandwiches
instructions: Combine ingredients; spread on bread making desired sizes and shapes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Grease 9 x 9-inch pan. Place apples in pan. Mix all other ingredients together. Crumble on top of apples. Sprinkle with extra cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Arnie'S No Fat Refried Beans And Rice
instructions: In a 2-quart microwavable covered bowl add boiling water to rice. Let sit covered for 4 minutes then toss with fork to fluff rice. Add refried beans and stir until well mixed. Microwave mixture on High for 3 to 4 minutes. Let stand to cool for 5 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Aunt Georgia'S Tasty Cheese And Macaroni
instructions: Cook macaroni according to the directions given on the package. Rinse with hot water. Grate cheese and mix with macaroni and butter. Add milk and well beaten eggs. Mix well. Pour into a well-greased casserole dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Parmesan Fries
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. In a small bowl combine cheese and salt. Brush potato wedges with margarine and place on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle wedges with cheese to coat. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm with ketchup barbecue sauce or melted cheese.

title: Dump-It Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Dump applesauce into pan. Dump pineapple into pan. Spread dry cake mix over this. Melt margarine and pour on top of cake mix. Sprinkle nuts over butter. Do not stir. Bake for 1 hour. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups sour cream and chicken breasts together in casserole dish. Cover with cracker crumbs. Pour oleo over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Ham Steaks
instructions: Sear the ham on one side until brown. Turn and put 1 tablespoon of apricot or peach marmalade on the browned side. Heat thoroughly and serve.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Place in oven-safe casserole. Dot with 2 tablespoons of butter and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm on crackers.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Use ungreased 9 x 12-inch (approximately) pan. Layer ham bread and cheese. Beat 6 eggs with 2 cups milk and pour over ham mixture. Drizzle with melted butter. Refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Bishop Bread
instructions: Sift the flour baking powder and salt together. Cut chocolate into small pieces. Add chocolate nuts dates and cherries to flour mixture. Beat eggs with mixer until foamy. Add sugar gradually beating until eggs are thick and light. Add flour mixture; mix well. Turn mixture into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool and slice.

title: Brunswick Stew(Vegetarian)
instructions: Brown bacon remove from pan and reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.\tSaute onion and pepper until slightly tender pour into large skillet or Dutch oven.\tAdd corn tomatoes bacon and 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.\tAdd garlic pepper and salt. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes adding okra (if desired) for the last six minutes. Stir lightly twice during cooking.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Layer bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish with crushed tortilla chips. Put 2 cans tamales over chips. Follow with diced onion and black olives. Pour 2 cans chili with beans over mixture. Top with grated cheese. Serve with sour cream. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl and serve. For non-alcoholic punch substitute 1 liter of ginger ale for the champagne.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve with your favorite vegetables crackers or bread.

title: Rhode Island Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Combine milk with eggs and add to the dry ingredients. Add melted shortening or oil and stir until blended. Pour into greased muffin tins and bake for 20 minutes. Yield 12 muffins.

title: Smoked Sausage And Vegetable Dinner
instructions: Saute garlic in oil for just a few minutes. Fry potatoes carrots and onions in oil and garlic until vegetables are tender. Add sausage and broccoli. Steam for 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and serve.

title: Death By Chocolate 1
instructions: Cut up cake and put in bottom of large glass bowl (a flat bottom works best). Next layer half of the pudding then half of the Cool Whip and half of the crumbled candy bars. Repeat layers.

title: Pima Poshol Soup
instructions: Wash beans wheat and soup bone. Put in large pot and cover with boiling water. Cover and cook until beans are tender about 4 hours. Add salt the first hour. Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix in pimento celery bell pepper and onion chopped.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix and form small balls (about 1 1/2 inches). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli Surprise
instructions: Saute onion in butter until soft. Stir in flour and water. Cook over low heat until thickened. Blend in shredded Velveeta. Combine sauce and broccoli. Add eggs; mix gently until blended. Put in casserole and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Combine bacon and onion; cook until bacon is crisp and onion is tender. Stir in flour sugar salt celery seed and pepper. Add water vinegar and mustard. Cook and stir until bubbly 5 to 7 minutes. Slice potatoes and layer in a crock-pot alternating potatoes and sauce.

title: Green Salad
instructions: Open milk and put in large bowl into freezer. Dissolve jello in hot water. Add marshmallows and dissolve. Take off heat and add chopped cabbage walnuts and pineapple. Whip evaporated milk until thick then fold into jello mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together with a wooden spoon. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 to 15 minutes. Let cool 15 minutes. Makes 1 Bundt cake or 2 large loaves or 3 medium loaves or muffins.

title: Chicken Or Veal Piccata
instructions: Pound chicken or veal to about 1/4-inch thickness. Sprinkle with pepper and dust with flour. Heat oil and brown meat until golden. Remove from pan and add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; simmer until reduced to half. Add meat and heat through. Time will vary according to thickness of meat. Be sure juices run clear if using chicken. Very good served over linguine or fettucine. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fran'S Cheese Balls
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Place first five ingredients in a bowl and mash with a fork. Stir until well blended. Divide in half. Shape into 2 smooth balls. Roll one in parsley-chive mix and the other in chopped nuts. Roll in plastic wrap and chill 2 or 3 days for best flavor. Have at room temperature before serving with crackers or toast points.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine oil and seasonings. Pour over crackers on baking sheet or shallow pan. Stir. Bake at 250 degrees for 20 minutes. (Can bake longer.) Stir occasionally. Store in air tight container.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour butter and powdered sugar. Press into a 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 20 minutes. Beat eggs sugar baking powder and lemon juice for 3 minutes on high. Pour over cooked crust. Bake 20 more minutes. Cool thoroughly before cutting into squares.

title: Clam Roll-Up Appetizers
instructions: Melt margarine and saute the onions. Blend in flour. Add undrained clams and Worcestershire sauce; cook for 15 minutes on low heat. It will thicken. Remove from heat and cool.

title: Swiss Coffee
instructions: Place chocolate in empty coffeepot. Place coffee and orange peel in brew basket. Prepare coffee using 3 cups water. Serve hot with whipped topping. Makes 4 cups.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion or onion soup mix. Layer zucchini and then hamburger; add soup and repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix the ingredients and pour into churn. Fill to line with milk. Churn until frozen.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Saute onion and bacon until onion is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat until bubbly stirring well. Serve warm with corn chips. Yield about 3 1/2 cups.

title: Popover Doughnuts
instructions: In large bowl combine eggs sugar milk salt melted butter vanilla flour baking powder nutmeg and cinnamon. Heat vegetable oil until hot about 370\u00b0. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil; when brown on all sides remove from fat and sprinkle with sugar or glaze. (Doughnuts will turn themselves.)

title: Mom'S Favorite Pancakes
instructions: Mix well with electric mixer. If too thick add milk until desired consistency is reached. Cook on a 380\u00b0 grill or hot skillet (sprayed with Pam).

title: Beet Relish
instructions: Place beets onion and red pepper in saucepan. Add salt horseradish vinegar and sugar. Cook 20 to 25 minutes. Put at once into sterilized hot jars and seal immediately.

title: Lentils And Smok-Y-Links
instructions: In a large saucepan combine lentils parsley water salt and bay leaf. Simmer until tender (1 hour). Cut bacon into cubes and cook crisp. Remove; drain off all but 2 tablespoons of drippings or use 2 tablespoons of oil. Saute celery onion and garlic until tender. Stir in flour and tomatoes and heat to boiling. Drain lentils (if needed) and discard bay leaf. Cut sausages into bite size pieces and add to mixture with lentils and bacon. Simmer 15 minutes to blend flavors.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in bowl. Beat eggs. Add salt sugar and shortening. Mix well. Fold in flour. Mix and knead. Let rise until double in size. Shape into rolls. Place on greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown on top. Makes 12 to 15 rolls.

title: Easy Turkey Salad
instructions: In a large bowl stir together soup and mayo until smooth. Fold in turkey celery red pepper onions parsley and pepper. Cover and refrigerate. Makes 5 cups.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar Jell-O cornstarch and food coloring with 1 cup boiling water. Boil a few seconds until thickened; let cool. Place whole strawberries on baked pie shell. Pour cooked mixture over berries and place in refrigerator 3 to 4 hours.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: Combine broth onion potatoes and dill in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend mixture in blender or food processor until smooth. In a saucepan melt margarine. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Add the milk. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Stir in the blended potato mixture. Cook and stir until soup is heated through. Makes 3 or 4 servings.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Brown celery in butter. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp have turned pink. Add rice and soy sauce. Mix thoroughly (do not add salt) and cook for about 5 minutes stirring every few minutes. Serve.

title: Fudgy Bonbons
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium saucepan combine chocolate chips and butter; cook and stir over very low heat until chips are melted and smooth. Add sweetened condensed milk; mix well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In medium bowl combine flour nuts chocolate mixture and vanilla; mix well. Shape 1 tablespoonful (use measuring spoon) of dough around each candy kiss covering completely. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes. Cookies will be soft and appear shiny but become firm as they cool. Do not overbake. Remove from cookie sheets; cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Blend in flour. Add water. Stir in salt Cheez Whiz and broccoli. Add well beaten eggs. Bake 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Quick And Easy Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cream cheese soften. Mix in green onions olives and ham. Work mixture well and roll in bacon bits and you can put pecans on it if you want to. Chill and enjoy with crackers. This is good made the day before.

title: Chocolate Banana Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Cream the butter or shortening; gradually add brown sugar and beat well until light and fluffy. Add beaten egg and blend well. Add the dry ingredients alternately with the banana pulp a little at a time beating after each addition only until smooth. Pour half the batter into a greased or lined 8-inch square cake pan. Melt chocolate chips in a saucepan and spread over batter. Cover with remaining batter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan. Frost with Butter Frosting.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Beat eggs; add all other ingredients and mix. Bake in buttered dish in a slow to moderate oven at 350\u00b0 until firm about 35 minutes.

title: Graham Torte
instructions: Mix pudding with milk; stir until thickened and add Cool Whip. Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with graham crackers. Spread half of the pudding mixture on top. Then put another layer of graham crackers to cover pudding and put the other half of pudding mixture on top. Top that with another layer of graham crackers and spread softened chocolate frosting on top. Refrigerate.

title: Pineapple-Mint Supreme
instructions: Combine flour walnuts and brown sugar in bowl. Cut in butter or margarine until particles are fine. Press into bottom of greased 8 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown. Cool.

title: 7 Layer Bars
instructions: Melt oleo in pan. Add in layers all other ingredients in order. Do not mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Orange Biscuit Ring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a bundt pan. Place orange marmalade around pan (use more if youd like). Sprinkle with nuts. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon. Separate biscuits. Dip in melted butter then in sugar mixture. Stand biscuits on edge in pan spacing evenly. Sprinkle with remaining sugar and melted butter. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes until brown. Cool 5 minutes and then invert on serving plate. A tube pan may be used instead of a bundt pan.

title: Chocolate Pie(Club Member: Clint Hudson)
instructions: Mix flour cocoa and sugar well. Add milk gradually. Add beaten egg yolks. Cook in double boiler until thick. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake until pie shell is brown. Beat egg whites; spread on pie. Brown meringue.

title: Pineapple-Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and put in 9-inch baked pie crust cooled. Cover with whipped topping.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut round steak into narrow 2-inch strips. Slice onion and then cut slices in half. Brown round steak and onion with garlic. When browned add just enough water to cover meat (approximately 1 1/2 to 2 cups). Cover and simmer for 2 hours checking occasionally to make sure it has enough water. Add cream of mushroom soup and stir until smooth. Add sour cream and again stir until smooth. Serve over cooked egg noodles. If desired you may add a large can of sliced mushrooms to the stroganoff.

title: Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cook cauliflower in chicken broth. Add other ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes. Fast and scrumptious.

title: Oriental Oven Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine soup vinegar brown sugar soy sauce ginger and garlic powder. In 3-quart oblong baking dish arrange chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spoon off fat. Spoon soup mixture over chicken. Bake 30 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. Sift sauce; serve with rice if desired. (Skin can be removed from chicken before baking.) Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery green pepper pimento water chestnuts and rice in bowl; toss lightly to mix. Spoon into buttered 3-quart baking dish. Combine soup mayonnaise onion lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce in bowl; mix well. Add 1/3 of the soup mixture to chicken mixture; mix well. Spoon remaining soup mixture over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly. Yield 12 servings.

title: No Fry French Fries
instructions: Scrub potatoes well and cut into strips. Combine oil salt and pepper (may add optional ingredients) into a plastic bag. Add potatoes and shake to coat. Spread strips on 2 cookie sheets in a single layer. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until golden brown and tender. Stir once.

title: Quick Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops. Place rice in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Place pork chops on top of rice. Pour bouillon over chops. Bake at 320\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: White Castles
instructions: Mix and press on cookie sheet (one with the edging). Prick top of the ground chuck and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Continue for 5 to 10 minutes. Cut into squares and put on rolls.

title: Beef Paprika
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in large skillet. Add meat onion and garlic (minced). Cook and stir until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in catsup Worcestershire sauce sugar salt paprika mustard cayenne and 1 1/4 cups water. Cover and simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Forget 'Em Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) at high speed of an electric mixer until foamy; add salt. Gradually add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form. Fold in vanilla chocolate morsels and pecans into beaten egg whites. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto aluminum foil-lined cookie sheets. Place in oven and immediately turn off heat. Do not open oven door for at least 8 hours. Carefully remove from aluminum foil. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Stuffed Bacon Rolls
instructions: Partially cook bacon. Drain; reserve 2 tablespoons drippings. Set bacon aside. Cook onion and garlic in drippings until tender but not browned. In bowl combine egg and tomato sauce; stir in breadcrumbs mushrooms and onion. Mix parsley 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Add meat; mix well. Divide into 4 parts. Place 2 strips bacon side by side on waxed paper. Cut slice in half crosswise. Place 2 1/2 slices at one end of bacon slices overlapping slightly. Pat 1/4 of meat mixture evenly over bacon; roll up jellyroll style starting at narrow end. Place rolls seam side down on rack in 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Repeat with remaining bacon and meat. Bake in oven about 40 minutes for medium doneness.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cube bacon and fry crisp. Add vinegar and water. Thicken with flour and sugar mixed. Add potatoes and onions. Heat slowly. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix then dip in melted chocolate.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli put into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with chicken that has been removed from the bones. Mix the mayonnaise both soups evaporated milk lemon juice cheese and curry powder. Pour this over the chicken and broccoli. Mix stuffing mix with margarine (melted) and sprinkle this on top of the casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients. Stir in milk and bananas. Sift and add dry ingredients. Add nuts. Put in greased loaf pan; let stand 20 minutes before baking. Bake 1 hour.

title: Hot Clam Dip
instructions: Saute onions in butter until transparent. Add clams with juice and crushed crackers. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Fry ground beef and drain. Boil squash until tender. Dont overcook. Drain. Simmer bell pepper and onion until tender. Layer in order listed in large baking dish the ground beef soup squash onion pepper sour cream and shredded cheese. Mix butter and crackers and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbles.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add broccoli. Cover reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Saute onion in butter in a Dutch oven over low heat about 10 minutes or until tender. Add flour stirring until smooth; cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk and bouillon cubes. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is thickened. Add broccoli cooking water and pepper. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Yields 9 cups.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Prepare German chocolate cake mix according to directions on box. Put 1/2 batter in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. In small saucepan melt caramels oleo and evaporated milk. Heat until melted. Pour on cake. Sprinkle chocolate chip pieces and 1 cup pecans evenly over caramel mixture. Pour remaining batter on top. Sprinkle remaining pecans on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gooy Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs and butter; this will be very thick. Cream together cream cheese powdered sugar and eggs. Add to cake mixture; fold in pecan pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: In a double boiler melt the butter. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add milk and stir until smooth and slightly thick. Add Rotel and cubed Velveeta; stir until melted. Add spices or picante and heat through.

title: The Best Brownies
instructions: Blend oil sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Add eggs; beat well with spoon. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture until well blended. Stir in nuts. Spread in greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan. Cool in pan. Frost if desired. Cut into squares. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Mix together. Add sherbet by large spoonfuls.

title: Sherry'S Veggie Pizza
instructions: Press dough over a large cookie sheet sealing edges. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 minutes or until golden. Cool.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
instructions: Peel and grate pears. Beat oil eggs sugar and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients; mix well with creamed mixture. Add pears and pecans; stir by hand. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes. If using 2 loaf pans bake for 45 to 50 minutes. Bake a Bundt pan for 60 minutes and a tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serve warm or cold with whipped cream sprinkled with nutmeg or ice cream.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Put 2 cups of sugar in frying pan then add milk. Pan should be on medium heat. Add vanilla flavoring. Heat and stir until it comes to a low boil. Put a drip in a cup of cold water. If it forms a hard ball in the water then its ready to add peanut butter slowly. Could use from 3/4 to 1 cup. Then add margarine. On low heat stir until cloudy. Then put in an 8 x 10-inch container.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers onions and salt; let stand for 1 or 2 hours. Rinse and drain well. Let stand for 5 hours longer. Drain but do not rinse. Boil vinegar water sugar and spices for 3 minutes. Add cucumbers and onions and simmer 10 to 20 minutes (do not boil). Pack into jars and seal at once.

title: Cream Pull Candy
instructions: In large (8-quart) pan mix sugar syrup soda and water. Boil until mixture bubbles freely. Then place the thermometer in and dont let it touch the bottom of the pan. Next add the whipping cream slowly all around in the pan (dont pour it all in one place). Let this boil to the hard boil stage (260\u00b0). Do not stir. Pour out onto marble slab or heavily buttered cold platter. When cool enough to handle pull until creamy white and holds its shape (about 20 minutes). Cut with scissors and put in dish to cream. Be sure to butter your hands and remove all rings.

title: Cherry Glazed Chicken Breasts Stuffed With Wild Rice
instructions: Sprinkle chicken breasts lightly with salt paprika and garlic powder. Cook rice and after cooking add almonds. Place stuffing in the center of each chicken breast. Roll and secure with toothpicks or skewers. Roll stuffed breast lightly with flour. Melt butter in pan you will cook breasts in. Roll stuffed breasts in butter. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Baste with Cherry Glaze 2 or 3 times during last 45 minutes of baking.

title: Sausage And Rice Supreme
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Reserve. Slice and fry sausage in skillet. Coarsely crumble sausage. Remove sausage from drippings. In drippings add onion and celery and saute. Add mushrooms almonds water chestnuts soup water cooked rice and sausage. Mix and bake covered 45 minutes at 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: This recipe is enough for 16 to 20 chickens.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut up unpeeled squash. Cook until tender; drain and mash. Add margarine and mix well. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs; beat well. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Gradually beat into creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool slightly. Remove from cookie sheet. Makes 6 dozen (2 1/2-inch) cookies.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter for several minutes. Remove from heat blend in flour gradually. Add broth milk and pepper stirring until smooth. Add broccoli and Velveeta. Cook on medium heat 7-9 minutes or until soup is slightly thickened.

title: Ken'S 2Nd Grade Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except powdered sugar. Form into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Place in an airtight container.

title: Oreo Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Add 1 1/2 cups crushed Oreo cookies and bake as directed in 2 round pans. Let cakes cool then cut in half to make 4 layers. Whip the cream with 3 tablespoons sugar and fold in 1 1/2 cups Oreos and spread between layers. Keep refrigerated.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in bowl in order. Top with Miracle Whip (approximately 1 to 1 1/2-inches thick). Sprinkle about 1/2 cup sugar on top. Cover with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Take a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer cherry pie filling crushed pineapple and cake mix. Slice butter and layer on top of cake mix. Sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shake or stir to mix well. Store in airtight container.

title: Hamburg And Tomato Soup Casserole
instructions: Place 1/2 of the raw sliced potatoes in the bottom of a casserole dish. Next place sliced onions place hamburg evenly over these 2 ingredients. Put other half of potatoes on top. Pour tomato soup evenly over top. Place 2 or 3 pats of butter salt and pepper to taste over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Salsa
instructions: Cook tomatoes with salt for 30 minutes. Skim off sediments. Chop garlic onions and peppers in processor (not too fine). Add to tomatoes at the end of 30 minutes. Cook another 30 minutes. Ready to can.

title: Southern Peach Yam Bake
instructions: Combine sugar flour and nutmeg; cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add nuts. Arrange yams and peaches in a 1 1/2-quart casserole; sprinkle with sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle with marshmallows. Broil until lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Cook mixed vegetables until tender-crisp and then drain. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate. Better if made 1 day before using.

title: Scalloped Asparagus
instructions: Melt 4 tablespoons margarine and stir in flour salt and pepper to make smooth paste. Drain liquid from asparagus and add enough milk to make 2 cups. Stir liquid into flour paste and cook slowly stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in pimentos parsley and almonds. Cover bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole with half of asparagus (reserve 6 or 7 tips for garnish) eggs and cheese; repeat and cover with cracker crumbs. Garnish with asparagus tips. Melt remaining butter and pour over top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hot Cake And Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Chocolate Chip Melt Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix together all ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Can be served warm at room temperature or cold.

title: Chicken Bake
instructions: Mix the dressing preserves and soup mix together. Pour over cut up chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours uncovered. Sauce good over rice.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash until tender drain and season to taste. Pour into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Prepare cornbread according to box directions and mix in with squash. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Mix all but last ingredient and place in a casserole. Top with bacon. Bake for one hour in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Irish Bread
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (in lightly greased floured pan). Turn oven down to 300\u00b0 and bake 20 minutes more. When bread is taken from oven rub top with butter.

title: Tuna Spinach Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients folding in mayonnaise last. Place mixture in pie plate and sprinkle with a little extra cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. (We usually microwave for about 5 minutes.)

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all together and chill for several hours. Serve with fresh crisp raw vegetables.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips. Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole. Top with potato chips and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix together the sugar butter and water in saucepan; bring to a boil. Add chocolate chips and vanilla. Put mixture in a large bowl. Beat in eggs one at a time. In another bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; add to chocolate mixture. Blend in chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done in a greased pan.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs vanilla and oil together. Sift flour sugar soda and salt. Add to egg mixture. Add apples and nuts. Mix well. Bake in 3 layers at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Mix and bring to a boil. Drop in 25 Ritz crackers and boil 5 minutes. Pour in unbaked pie shell; add top crust. Dot with butter and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 1 egg. Press into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Blend cream cheese and 2 eggs until soupy; add powdered sugar. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until top is a golden brown. When cool dust top with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Rosemary(Recipe From The Club Meeting'S Herbal Luncheon)
instructions: Dust chicken pieces with flour and saute in butter until tender and light brown. Add chicken broth rosemary mushrooms and wine. Turn into casserole pan and bake about 30 minutes uncovered at 350\u00b0.

title: Tammy'S Cheese And Bacon Bagelettes
instructions: Mix together cheese mayonnaise and bacon bits. Spoon onto Lenders bagelettes (found in frozen food case) and bake until cheese is melted. Serve hot. These may be made ahead and frozen before baking.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder salt baking soda cinnamon ginger and nutmeg in a large bowl. Combine carrots oil pineapple eggs and water. Stir into dry ingredients and mix until smooth. Stir in walnuts and raisins.

title: Baked Stuffed Shells
instructions: Saute onion beef and all other ingredients except cottage cheese egg parsley Parmesan cheese and mushrooms. Simmer about 15 minutes. Cook shells as directed; cool. Fill shells with cheese mixture cottage cheese egg Parmesan cheese and parsley. Place sauce in 2-quart baking dish. Add stuffed shells. Bake for 30 minutes at 300\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Pineapple Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Drain sweet potatoes and slice into mixing bowl. Add pineapple without draining and salt. Stir to mix. Pour into buttered casserole. Cover top with bits of butter then with marshmallows. Bake at 300\u00b0 until marshmallows are browned.

title: Fast Breakfast
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Add potatoes and tomatoes; cook over medium heat 5 minutes. Top with cheese. Beat eggs and 2 tablespoons water. Pour over ingredients in skillet; cover and reduce heat to low. Cook 10 to 12 minutes or until egg mixture is set in center and cheese is melted. Uncover; let stand 5 minutes before cutting into wedges.

title: Drunken Dogs
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Add the franks or the hot dogs (cut into quarters) and simmer until heated. Keep warm in a chafing dish or crockette. Great appetizer!

title: Snickers Candy
instructions: Melt milk chocolate chips and shortening over hot water stirring until mixture is smooth. Pour 1/2 of melted chocolate into an 8-inch square pan. Spread evenly. Refrigerate until firm (about 15 minutes). Combine caramels butter and water and melt. Stir until mixture is smooth. Stir in peanuts. Pour into chocolate pan. Spread evenly. Refrigerate until tacky (about 15 minutes). Top with remaining melted chocolate and spread evenly. Return to refrigerator and chill until firm (about 1 hour). Cut into squares and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Miracle Whip Cake
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Add water and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Spread coconut on bottom and spread pecans on top of coconut. Mix cake mix in bowl according to directions on box. Pour over coconut and pecan mixture. Combine oleo cream cheese and powdered sugar. Spoon on top of batter. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool for 15 minutes and turn upside down on plate. Cake may crack in the middle.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Blend sugar flour eggs oleo and vanilla. Stir in chips pecans and coconut. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Two 9-Inch Pumpkin Pies
instructions: Thoroughly combine pumpkin sugar salt and spices. Add beaten eggs and milks. Blend. Pour into 9-inch pastry-lined pie pans. Bake in a very hot oven (450\u00b0) for 10 minutes and then in a slow oven (325\u00b0) for 55 minutes or until mixture doesnt adhere to knife.

title: Candied Baby Carrots
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter or margarine. Add brown sugar and water. Stirring constantly heat to boiling. Add drained cooked carrots and simmer 5 minutes or until carrots are tender. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Refrigerator Slaw
instructions: Mix together cabbage sugar onion green pepper salt and pepper and set aside. Mix vinegar oil celery seed and mustard together and boil for 5 minutes. Pour over cabbage mixture and do not stir! Let stand refrigerated overnight remove and stir well. Stays fresh for 8 to 10 days.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add milk and flour alternately. Put in greased and floured tube pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes without opening oven door. This makes a very large cake.

title: Gladys' Funnel Cake
instructions: Heat 3 cups cooking oil in frying pan to 350\u00b0. Mix milk and eggs. Blend dry ingredients together; add to milk-egg mixture. Using a funnel or measuring cup with a fine spout dribble batter into hot oil. Fry until a light golden color then turn over and brown other side. Do not overcook. Drain on paper towels. While warm sprinkle with powdered sugar or sugar and cinnamon mixture.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together in bowl. Add eggs and bananas mixing well. Sift flour and soda together into batter blending thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Cheese-Filled Jumbo Shells
instructions: Cook shells per package directions. Drain. Cool in single layer on waxed paper or aluminum foil. In a large bowl combine cheeses eggs parsley oregano salt and pepper. Fill each shell with about 2 tablespoons of cheese mixture. Spread a thin layer of sauce on bottom of rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Place filled shells open side down in single layer in pan. Cover with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese if desired. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Fills about 36 shells. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Grate squash and onion (I cut up the onion). Place in mixing bowl. Add to this the egg salt pepper and flour; mix well. In a thick boiler (I use Club aluminum) put in enough cooking oil to be about 3/4 to 7/8-inch deep. The oil should get hot. When it is hot use small spoon and drop small amounts of the ingredients in. Usually it takes about 6 or 7 fritters. When these are brown turn over to brown the other side. Take out of oil; place on paper toweling to get rid of excess oil. Begin the cooking process over until all the mixture is used. Serve hot.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and oranges (whole oranges with rinds) after the seeds have been removed. Mix ground oranges and cranberries sugar pineapple and pecans. Place in a closed container and let set overnight. Will keep for several days.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well and add sauce. Layer in buttered dish the noodles meat and sauce (heated) and cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Double Fudge-Cream Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 2-quart saucepan combine butter and chocolate squares. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until melted (4 to 6 minutes). Stir in remaining brownie ingredients except chocolate chips. Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half of batter into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Spread filling over brownie mixture. Spoon remaining batter over cream cheese layer (batter will not entirely cover cream cheese mixture). Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan.

title: Brownie Pudding
instructions: Mix together the flour white sugar baking powder 1 tablespoon cocoa and salt. Mix only until smooth. Add milk shortening vanilla and nuts. Spread into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix together brown sugar and 2 tablespoons cocoa and sprinkle over batter. Pour 1 cup boiling water over batter. This forms sauce in bottom of the pan as pudding is baked. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lemon Party Dessert
instructions: Mix until crumbly pat into 9 x 13 x 2-1/2 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown cool.

title: Gluten Steaks
instructions: Mix flour with enough water to make a stiff dough. Form dough into a ball and knead about 10 minutes. Place in bowl and cover with additional water. Let stand 30 minutes or overnight. Knead dough with hands under water to wash out the starch. Pour off the starchy water and cover with more water. Continue washing until water is almost clear. You now have concentrated protein to make the steaks!

title: Quick Cocoa Cake
instructions: Bring margarine Crisco water and cocoa to boil. Pour over flour and sugar. Beat by hand until smooth. Add eggs milk baking soda cinnamon vanilla and salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cake is done when toothpick comes out clean. Use 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Frost with chocolate icing.

title: 7 Layer Casserole
instructions: Mix rice and corn; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour over 1 can of tomato sauce 1/2 cup water onion green pepper and ground beef. Sprinkle again with salt and pepper. Add second can of tomato sauce and 1/4 cup water. Cover with strips of bacon. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake another 30 minutes longer until bacon is crisped. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Rhubarb Dream Dessert
instructions: Press mixture into 7 1/2 x 11 x 1 1/2-inch ungreased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Orange Pie
instructions: Mix orange juice and milk. Pour into pie shell. Spoon Cool Whip on top of pie. Do not spread. Chill in freezer for 3 to 4 hours. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Breast Parmesan
instructions: Mix bread crumbs cheese and spices; set aside. Beat eggs and oil set aside. Melt butter in pan; flour chicken dip in egg mixture then dip in bread crumb mixture. Fry gently on moderate heat browning on both sides. Cook about 15 minutes.

title: Split Pea And Ham Soup(Total Cooking Time:  75 To 85 Minutes)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 4-quart microwave casserole. Cover. Use Cook cycle and cook 70 to 80 minutes or until peas are tender. Remove ham hock from soup; cool until ham hock can be handled and meat cut from bone. Add meat to soup. Discard peppercorns and bay leaf. Stir. Use Cook cycle and cook 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Cabbage Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons oil in skillet over medium heat. Saute onion until translucent almost tender approximately 3 minutes. Add caraway and dill. Cook briefly. Remove from heat. Transfer to bowl. In food processor blend tofu salt lemon juice 1 tablespoon oil and tahini until smooth. Fold into sauteed vegetables. Pour into pie crust and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Mix salad dressing and sugar together. Add cocoa. Dissolve soda in water and other ingredients. Last add flour and vanilla. Bake in a loaf pan about 45 minutes at 375 degrees.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Whip potatoes with mixer until fluffy. Beat in other ingredients and pour into buttered dish.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar butter and Pet milk. Cook until thick. Add the marshmallows chocolate chips and pecans. Cook until thick.

title: Almond Pine Cones
instructions: Spread almonds in a single layer in shallow pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes stirring often until almonds just turn brown. Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise; mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Blend cover and chill overnight. Form cheese mix and shape into 2 pine cones on serving platter. Beginning at narrow end press almonds at a slight angle into cheese mixture in rows. Continue overlapping rows until all cheese is covered. Garnish with pine sprigs. Serve with crackers.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Chop beef finely. Place in bottom of glass dish. Wrap each chicken with half piece of bacon. Place chicken on top of chopped beef. Mix together undiluted soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 1/4 hours. Serve chicken on rice.

title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
instructions: Mix oil chocolate and granulated sugar. Blend eggs in one at a time until well mixed. Add vanilla. Stir flour baking powder and salt into oil mixture. Chill dough overnight. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Drop teaspoon of dough into confectioners sugar (1 box only) and coat well. Place 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Dont overbake. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pork And Potato Scallop
instructions: In a 2-quart baking dish arrange potatoes onions and green pepper. Top with pork chops. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper. Combine soup and milk. Pour over all. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook in microwave for 5 minutes or until soup starts bubbling. After soup starts boiling cook for another 15 minutes or until pork chops and vegetables are tender. Turn baking dish halfway around after 5 minutes of cooking. Let stand about 5 minutes.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Cut chicken into thin strips. Cook until done in a small amount water. Add onion. Cook until transparent. Add cut up broccoli and next 3 seasonings; cook about 5 minutes. Add 1 1/2 cups water with chicken bouillon cubes dissolved. Cook 1 minute. Stir cornstarch into cold water. Gradually add to chicken and broccoli. Cook 1 minute. Serve over steamed rice. Makes 2 big servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add flour and sugars. Melt margarine and let stand to room temperature. Add to sugar mixture and blend well. Add chopped nuts and chocolate chips. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: No-Peek Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix in crock pot. Cook on high 6-8 hours. Serve over rice or noodles. \Dont peek while cooking.\

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place sliced apples in greased baking dish. Combine cake mix sugar cinnamon and butter until clumpy. Pour over top of apples. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexi-Taco Sandwich
instructions: Cook ground chuck and onion. Add tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce salt and powders. Mix well; simmer for 10 minutes. Fold in crushed chips. Spoon onto bottom half of bun. Top with lettuce cheese tomatoes and top half of bun.

title: Tempura Batter
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in bowl. Gradually stir in water. Add fresh vegetables shrimp etc. The batter will be thin. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Kabobs
instructions: Place chicken cubes and green pepper pieces in shallow dish. Drain pineapple reserving 1/2 cup juice. Set pineapple aside. Combine reserved pineapple juice brown sugar soy sauce vinegar liquid smoke garlic powder and ginger. Pour over chicken and green pepper pieces. Stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

title: Derrick'S Spice German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets; cool and cut in cubes. Fry bacon until crisp. Remove and crumble over potatoes. Add onions to hot bacon drippings and fry until tender. Mix vinegar salt pepper sugar celery seed and water; bring to a boil. Stir in egg yolk quickly. Remove from heat; add potatoes and bacon. Put in casserole and keep warm to serve.

title: Pinto Bean Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown.

title: Cucumber Relish
instructions: Mix cucumbers peppers onions and salt and let stand 30 minutes; drain. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cucumber mixture. Bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 5 minutes. Fill jars and seal.

title: The Best - Abe'S Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift sugar soda flour and salt together into bowl; add eggs oil and vanilla. Mix well. Add apples and nuts; stir until mixed well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blue Pear Salad
instructions: Peel and split pears remove the core. Allow the Roquefort cheese and the butter to soften to room temperature. Add mix to creamy texture. Fill the pear; mix enough cream into the cream cheese with a light whisk until it will pour adding a pinch of salt. Place the pears on a bed of lettuce and pour mixture over them. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Chill 1/2 hour before serving. Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Thoroughly combine sugar and cocoa in a 4-quart saucepan; stir in milk. Bring to a bubbly boil on medium heat stirring constantly. Boil to 234\u00b0 (soft ball stage) on candy thermometer. Bulb of the candy thermometer boil until a small amount dropped in a half cup of cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat; add margarine and vanilla. Beat by hand until fudge thickens and loses some of its gloss.
