title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter honey flavoring and prunes. Gradually mix in graham cracker crumbs and other ingredients. Have molds (round or oblong) well-greased. Pack cake firm in mold. Decorate with red green and white candied pineapple slices. Let set in mold at least 24 hours in refrigerator.

title: Cake
instructions: Put in a bowl. Crack the eggs. Stir for 30 minutes. Put it in the oven and cook for a couple of hours. Set it in a cool spot. Gobble it up.

title: Butterscotch Pie(My Mama'S Best Ever)
instructions: Mix brown sugar flour and salt; gradually add milk mix well. Add beaten egg yolks. Cook over hot water stirring constantly until thick. Add butter. Pour into baked pie shell. Let cool. Use Cool Whip or your favorite meringue.

title: Cookies -- Quick And Easy
instructions: Mix cake mix flour oil and eggs together. Add 1 cup of any other ingredient you choose. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate before serving.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in a large bowl. Add eggs and vanilla blending well. Combine flour and cocoa and blend into creamed mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes. Do not overbake. Cookies will be soft. They will puff during baking and flatten upon cooling. Cool on sheet until set about 1 minute. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Follow Solomons recipe for making a good boy and you will have a good cake Proverbs 2314 (beat well). Turn into greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese powdered sugar Cool Whip and vanilla all together then add peanut butter. Put them in each pie shell and refrigerate for two hours before serving. Makes 2 pies.

title: Texas Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in blender until smooth. Pour into baked pie shell immediately. It will thicken soon. Refrigerate.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients; set aside. Melt butter mix with graham cracker crumbs and form into crust on the bottom and sides of cake pan. Pour cake mix into cracker crumbs crust. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Crush saltines in Ziploc bag with rolling pin. Line baking sheet with waxed paper foil or Saran Wrap. Sprinkle fine layer of crumbs. Very lightly combine all ingredients including unbeaten eggs. Using serving spoon put good sized dollops of mixture on top of crumbs. Crush additional crumbs if needed to add a top layer. Let set up under refrigeration until ready to serve. Saute in butter or margarine turning once.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Combine first three ingredients mixing well. Press flour mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool completely. Combine cream cheese and sugar beating until fluffy. Fold in two cups Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Combine pudding mix and milk; beat two minutes at medium speed. Spread over cream cheese layer. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding layer. Chill

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine soda and buttermilk. Put all ingredients in large bowl except Coca-Cola and marshmallows; blend well. Blend in Coke at low speed. Stir in marshmallows at low speed by hand. Pour in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Apple Walnut Cake
instructions: Beat butter on medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add flour mixture to butter mixture alternately with sour cream beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix at low speed after each addition just until blended. Pour half of the batter into a greased and floured 12 cup Bundt pan. Combine finely chopped apples and next 3 ingredients; spoon over batter in pan leaving a 1/2-inch border around center and outer edges. Add remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Pepper Cheese Pasta Sauce
instructions: Prepare Hollandaise according to directions. Drain and chop roasted peppers. Add along with Worcestershire sauce and cheese.

title: Fluffy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Reserve 1 cup juice. In saucepan add pineapple juice sugar flour eggs orange juice lemon juice and oil. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and let cool. In a salad bowl combine pineapple fruit cocktail oranges and bananas. Fold in whipped cream and the cooled sauce. Chill for several hours.

title: Blueberry Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and margarine; add eggs. Stir baking soda into milk and set aside. Blend in dry ingredients. Then add milk and vanilla. Stir blueberries in by hand. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Maple Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and brush on top of 3 pounds of beef pork or poultry. Baste frequently with sauce while baking.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix sour cream Miracle Whip seasoned salt and mustard. Toss in cabbage onion and carrot.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together well. Shape into balls the size of walnuts. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Ten Layer Salad
instructions: Layer the ingredients in order given in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover tightly and leave in refrigerator overnight or at least six hours. The lettuce doesnt limp and the natural juices and mayonnaise make a dressing. You may want to add radishes or cucumbers to your taste. This is a great dish to make a day ahead of time.

title: Stadium Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Chill and serve with vegetable dippers.

title: Best-Ever Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer 5 minutes. Use for basting chicken bologna beef or lamb. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Citrus Punch
instructions: In a pitcher combine first 3 ingredients. Chill until ready to serve. Pour citrus mixture into small punch bowl; add ice cubes (or ice ring) as desired. Add club soda or sparkling water. Just before serving garnish with orange slices and strawberries.

title: Cheeseburger Mac
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan combine all ingredients and heat over medium heat until macaroni is tender. Makes 4 servings or 6 cups. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juices from the fruits. Add marshmallows. Mix together sour cream milk sugar and salt. Add this creamy mixture to the fruits and marshmallows. Coarsely chop the pecans and add to the mixture. Place this in the refrigerator at least one hour before serving. Serves 10.

title: Sugar-Free Strawberry Salad
instructions: May add 8 packets of Equal to the strawberries.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tomato Jam
instructions: Cook tomato and sugar 12 minutes and add jello while warm. Store in refrigerator or freezer.

title: Red Beans And Rice(Preparation Time:  10 Minutes And Cooking Time:  20 Minutes)
instructions: Coat a Dutch oven with cooking spray over medium-high heat unti hot. Add sausage and next 3 ingredients. Saute until tender. Add beans and next 7 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Remove and discard bay leaf. Serve over rice. Garnish with thyme sprigs if desired. Yields 8 servings.

title: Butter Pecan Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease Bundt pan and dust with powdered sugar. Sprinkle pecans in bottom of pan.

title: Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients over low heat stirring often. Add butter. Cool slightly then add vanilla. Blend well.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix meal salt and shortening and scald with boiling water. Add well beaten eggs milk and baking powder. Bake in a greased deep pan or casserole in moderate oven. Serve from pan with spoon.

title: Whoppers Sauce
instructions: Place 1 maraschino cherry in each compartment of an ice cube tray. Add water and freeze.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juice off crushed pineapple and fruit cocktail. Peel apples and cut in bite size pieces. Mix everything. Let chill in refrigerator 4 to 5 hours or overnight.

title: Scones
instructions: Mix dry ingredients until well mixed. Add margarine. Mix until fine. Add milk and mix lightly into a dough. Roll out to half inch thick. Use 2-inch cutter. Brush with egg yolk. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for about ten minutes.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Place chicken pieces in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle dry stuffing mix and flavor packet over chicken. Heat broth soups and margarine until blended. Pour over chicken and stuffing mix. Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ting-A-Lings
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water in double boiler. Add other ingredients and stir to cover well. Drop in clusters onto waxed paper.

title: Marshmallow Cream Nog
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Cook over medium to low heat until marshmallow cream melts. Gradually stir 1/4 of hot mixture into egg substitute. Add remaining hot mixture stirring constantly until mixture thickens (1 or 2 minutes). Remove from heat. Stir in bourbon and 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg. Let cool. Chill for 3 hours. Remove vanilla bean and discard. Stir in ice milk just before serving. Sprinkle with nutmeg if desired. Makes 16 (1/2 cup) servings. Contains 113 calories fat 0.9 g saturated fat 0.5 g and cholesterol 4 mg.

title: Turnips Au Gratin Casserole
instructions: In medium saucepan bring 1-inch of water to boiling. Add turnips sugar and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and cook 12 minutes or until tender. Drain. Remove and set aside.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients and set aside. Mix the oleo sugar eggs soda mixed in buttermilk flour and salt. Mix and pour over fruit and mix together. Spoon into a 12-cup pan or Bundt pan greased well. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Take ice pick and punch full of holes while still in pan. Mix 1 cup orange juice and 2 cups powdered sugar. Pour over cake while warm. Leave in pan several hours then take out.

title: Pizza Bread
instructions: Put frozen loaves in refrigerator overnight. Cut each loaf in half and roll out. Brown sausage and drain. Chop green onions olives and pepperoni. On each 1/2 loaf rolled out layer sausage onions olives pepperoni and cheese. Sprinkle a few drops of Tabasco if desired. Roll up and seal edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until brown. At this point you may eat it or freeze it. If frozen remove from freezer (do not thaw) and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or until hot all the way through. Makes 6 loaves.

title: Herbed Tomato Soup
instructions: In a medium saucepan saute onion and garlic in butter until onion is soft. Add tomatoes basil broth and parsley. Simmer 10 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Place in blender container. Cover and blend thoroughly. Return to saucepan. Heat thoroughly. Garnish with additional parsley. Makes about 5 cups.

title: Fried Squash And Onions
instructions: Wash and dry squash. Cut into small rounds. Heat the oil in a big skillet. Put enough meal on squash to cover each piece. Fry for about 5 minutes and add the chopped onions. Add salt and pepper. Fry until brown and tender.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix well. Chill several hours. Let set at room temperature before spreading on crackers. Serve.

title: Italian-Style Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes; cut into approximately 1/4-inch thick slices. Mix seasonings and blend into olive oil. Add potatoes and mix well. Put potatoes into a greased baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.

title: Spam Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and put in a casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese or put cheese slices on top. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together and pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients like a pie crust. Take out one cup and set aside. Add to remaining ingredients the next 3 ingredients. Spread in square cake pan; spread cup of crumbs on top. Sprinkle cinnamon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Mix crushed wafers powdered sugar nuts and cocoa. Stir in bourbon and corn syrup. Shape mixture into one-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Cover tightly and refrigerate several days before serving. Makes about 5 dozen candies.

title: Baked Potatoes In Crock-Pot
instructions: Prick potatoes with a fork and wrap in foil. Place in crock-pot. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours. Do not add water.

title: Mustard Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix mustard garlic powder white wine (optional) and pepper in bowl. Rub chicken with mixture. Put on flat pan (I use a pizza pan) and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with rice and veggie or your favorite side dish.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss together chicken celery lemon juice and seasonings. Add fruit and mayonnaise. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fruit Delight Salad
instructions: Drain cherries mandarin oranges and pineapple thoroughly. Mix all ingredients together. Let chill 24 hours.

title: Hamburger Cheese Bake
instructions: In large skillet cook meat with onion until meat is lightly browned and onion is tender. Stir in tomato sauce sugar salt or garlic salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Meanwhile cook noodles according to package directions drain. Combine cottage cheese cream cheese sour cream green onion and green pepper.

title: Molded Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; place in a mold and chill.

title: Beef Goulash
instructions: Cook macaroni according to pkg. directions omitting salt. Drain and set aside. Brown beef with mushrooms onion and garlic. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer gently about 15 minutes. Add cooked drained macaroni. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Drain Veg-All\tand mix with\tsoup and chicken. Pour mixture into 1 of the crusts cover mixture with second crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (If mixture seems dry add a bit of broth.)

title: Sicilian Baked Sausage(Crock Pot)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large dish. Cover and bake for 75 minutes at 350 degrees stirring occasionally. This can also be done in a crock pot on low for 5 to 7 hours.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: Meat Loaf Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour over meat loaf before baking.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Add milk cracker crumbs coconut and nuts. Bake in 3 (9-inch) pans at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Rum Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients and freeze. Scoop into glass. Add ginger ale 7-Up or favorite mixer.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to 1/2 inch thickness between sheets of waxed paper. Place a slice of ham and portion of cheese on each chicken breast; roll up and secure with toothpicks.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased casserole. The casserole will be full. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Remove 1 hour before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0. Top casserole with 2 cans French fried onion rings when ready for baking.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium-high heat saute onion in butter for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in flour until completely blended. Add water bouillon granules garlic powder and pepper; stir. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to low. Add broccoli and milk. Simmer for 10 minutes or until broccoli is done. Stir in half and half and cheese until cheese melts. Serve hot. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar salt and flour in a bowl. Add butter eggs syrup and pecans. Pour in pie shell. Bake 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Sticks
instructions: Put bread into freezer let stay overnight. Take out next morning trim crust off. Slice into narrow strips. Put onto cooking sheet into 200\u00b0 oven; bake for 2 hours. Put peanut butter and oil into double boiler and mix well. Mash corn flakes fine. Put into bag or bowl. Take bread out of stove and put a few pieces at a time and dip into oil and peanut butter mixture. Coat well. It is best to use a spoon with holes in it. Then put the bread strips into the corn flakes; coat well. Store in air-tight container.

title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour half of the batter into greased tube pan. Sprinkle with 3 teaspoons brown sugar mixed with 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Add remaining batter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Foil-Baked Potato(Camper'S Fare)
instructions: You will need one 10-inch square of foil per potato.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Simmer browned chopped meat with kidney beans for 10 minutes and drain. Allow to cool. Mix remaining ingredients together. Add meat and beans. Add dressing.

title: Refrigerator Rolls(The Best Rolls You'Ve Ever Eaten!)
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and add 1/2 cup hot water. Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve dry yeast in 1/2 cup of lukewarm water. When first mixture is cool add beaten egg then yeast then the sifted flour. Mixture sometimes may need a bit more flour. Store in refrigerator at least 4 hours. When ready to cook knead. Roll out as for biscuits. Put in 8-inch pans. Let rise 2 hours at room temperature. Dough will keep well for 4 to 5 days. Will make approximately 30 rolls. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Rugelach
instructions: Combine all. Separate into 4 balls. Refrigerate until you want to make them. Dough can be frozen. Roll out into round (doesnt have to be perfect). Cut into 4 triangles then cut each into 3 (total of 12 triangles).

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together last 6 ingredients. Drain all beans except pork and beans. Cook bacon in skillet until crisp. Drain on paper towel and crumble. Cook hamburger in bacon fat in skillet until no pink remains. Add onion and saute. Place beans in casserole. Add hamburger and catsup mixture. Mix gently. Sprinkle with bacon bits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Corn Spoon Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except whole kernel corn. Fold in corn. Bake in a greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until knife tests clean. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Carrot Marshmallow Salad
instructions: Peel carrots. Shred with coarse shredder into mixing bowl. Add marshmallows pineapple raisins and coconut. Toss lightly to mix. Combine the mayonnaise with carrot mixture. Carefully fold in the whipped cream.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole break bread and cheese into bite-size pieces. Arrange shrimp bread and cheese in layers in casserole. Pour melted margarine over. Add mustard and salt to eggs; add milk. Pour over all. Cover with buttered corn flake crumbs; let stand overnight. Take out of refrigerator 1 hour before baking. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for an hour. Serves 6 generously.

title: Mama'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream sugar eggs and butter; add flour buttermilk and vanilla. Mix all together. For 18 layer cake put 2 tablespoons of batter in pans and bake at 500\u00b0 for 5 minutes. For 12 layer cake put 1/3 cup of batter in pans and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Make Believe Corn Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat egg. Add milk and oil; mix all together. Bake as you would corn bread. Grease skillet. Heat oven to 500\u00b0. Cook until brown.

title: Little Pizzas
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage. Drain. Add mango onion and pizza sauce. Simmer until pepper and onion are done. Add cheese chunks and let melt. Spread on choice of rye bread or crackers and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Can place on cookie sheet and freeze. Bake 15 minutes if frozen.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Store mixture in an airtight container. Be sure to stir well before using.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until done then pick meat off the bone in small pieces. Fix stuffing mix according to directions on box. Mix chicken soup with stuffing. In an 8 or 9-inch casserole dish layer dressing then chicken dressing and so forth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Serves 6.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs oil and 7-Up for 4 minutes. Fold in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Mexican Dish(Microwave)
instructions: Place tortilla shells between paper towels and microwave on Full power for 45 seconds. Combine chopped pepper onion and hamburger into 2 quart casserole dish. Microwave on Full power for 2 minutes. Mix taco seasoning sauce paste water and chili powder. Microwave on 80% power for 10 minutes or until thick.

title: Pumpkin Spice Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan. Combine oil and sugar then add eggs one at a time beating well; set aside. In separate bowl combine flour baking powder soda salt allspice cinnamon nutmeg; set aside. In another bowl combine pumpkin water vanilla butter flavor and orange extract. Mix flour and pumpkin mixture then add into sugar and egg mixture; mix at low speed. Beat an extra 3 to 4 minutes and pour into tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Recipe For A Happy Home
instructions: Blend together with a pinch of tenderness and 1 big dash of loyalty. Blend in faith hope and charity. Add a spoonful of compassion and one of ability to laugh at little things. Moisten with tears of joy sorrow and sympathy. Bake in a pan of good nature and serve repeatedly.

title: Dutch Meat Loaf
instructions: Lightly mix beef bread crumbs onion 1/2 can of the tomato sauce egg salt and pepper. Shape into loaf in shallow baking pan. Combine remaining sauce with water brown sugar mustard and vinegar; pour over loaf.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Prepare first 5 ingredients in salad bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the first combination. Serve.

title: Oven Fried Coconut Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix coconut and bread crumbs in a shallow dish. Beat eggs until foamy in a separate dish. Pour melted butter into a large baking dish. Dip chicken in eggs one piece at a time then roll in coconut mixture.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and hamburger meat then drain. Add to melted cheese. Blend tomatoes and all remaining ingredients. Serve warm.

title: Cappuccino Coffee
instructions: Blend all ingredients on high until blended. Place 1-2 Tbsp. in coffee cup; add 6 oz. boiling water. Yield 3 2/3 cups. For extra flavor serve with peppermint or cinnamon sticks. If desired add brandy or rum to taste.

title: Heart-Smart Gingersnaps
instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients together. Beat together sugar oil and eggs until well blended. With spoon stir in ginger then flour mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 8 to 10 minutes or until bottoms are browned. Cool 1 minute. Remove to rack and cool. Makes about 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook meat until done. At this point you may freeze meat for use later. Add vegetables to cooked meat and cook until done. For a crowd use a wash pot with a boat paddle to stir. Freezes well. I only made 1/6 of the recipe.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together and set aside. Cream butter shortening and sugar. Mix well with electric mixer and add eggs mixing well. Alternately add dry ingredients milk and vanilla. Mix very well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan.

title: Layered Taco Salad
instructions: Mash avocados well. Add lemon juice; set aside. Mix taco powder with sour cream; set aside. Alternate avocados beans and sour cream mix in layers until all is used up. Top with onions olives lettuce and tomatoes (put tomatoes on just before serving). Very good.

title: Trifle Alexandria
instructions: Line base of fairly small serving dish with cake. Moisten with 4 to 5 tablespoons of peach syrup. Arrange peach halves on top. Whip cream and milk together until thick. Stir in sugar then fold in egg white beaten to a stiff peak. Pile over peaches and chill. Just before serving crush strawberries finely sweeten to taste with powdered sugar and trickle gently over cream.

title: Chicken Adobo(Philipino Dish)
instructions: Cut up chicken and garlic and brown in oil. Add soy sauce vinegar water and potatoes stirring to keep from sticking. Cook until it has a very light gravy and chicken is done about 1 hour. Serve over rice.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix lemonade milk and Cool Whip together. Then place in graham cracker crusts. Then refrigerate until chilled.

title: Hot Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Add macaroni to the remaining ingredients. Spoon into a lightly greased baking dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Yummy Potatoes
instructions: Mix and toss. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Crab Enchiladas
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add milk soup and chilies. Butter casserole and layer sauce with crab and tortillas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove and top with Swiss cheese return to oven and melt cheese.

title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
instructions: Put the lemon juice over the vegetables. Use Ranch style dressing (enough to mix well). This can be made ahead of serving time. Serves 12.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Dip hot dog into batter coating evenly then drop in hot Crisco oil and fry until golden brown approximately 2 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Muffins
instructions: Mix cereal and milk in a large bowl; let stand until cereal is softened about 3 minutes. Beat in oil and egg. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened. Divide batter into 12 muffin cups. Bake until golden brown 16 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Something Else Cheesecake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions. Pour into floured and greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Shrimp Canapes
instructions: Cut each slice of bread into four 1 1/2-inch circles (make bread crumbs from leftover bread pieces and reserve for other uses). Place cutouts on baking sheet and broil 6 inches from heat for 1 minute or until lightly browned. Combine shrimp cheese mayonnaise thyme and salt; stir well and spread on bread cutouts. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Garnish each canape with dill weed pimento or olive slices if desired. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in the order listed. Let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Shake meat in soup mix salt and paprika. Put in baking dish. Set oven at 350\u00b0. Arrange vegetables around meat. Mix catsup and soup. Pour over all ingredients. Cover with foil and cook about 3 hours.

title: Chicken Cacciatore(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Cut up chicken and place in crock-pot. Add all other ingredients and stir together. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours (high 3 to 4 hours). Serve over spaghetti or vermicelli noodles.

title: Posh Squash
instructions: Steam squash until tender; drain thoroughly. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs and add remaining ingredients except buttered crumbs. Mix real well and pour into a buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 to 30 minutes. When it is almost done cover the mixture with buttered crumbs and let them brown lightly.

title: A B C Nibbles
instructions: Place cereal peanuts and raisins in a large bowl. In a cup combine oil sugar and cinnamon mixing well with a fork. Pour over cereal mixture stirring to coat completely. No cooking required. Makes 4 servings or 4 cups.

title: Millionaire Pie(Makes 2 Pies.)
instructions: Mix condensed milk and lemon juice until thickened. Add coconut pecans and fruit cocktail and mix. Add Cool Whip. Place in pie shells and chill.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Beat together oil egg and milk. Mix together flour baking powder sugar and salt. Add liquid to flour mixture. Makes 8 pancakes.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: Combine apricots sugar and water in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring occasionally until tender and most of liquid is absorbed (approximately 20 minutes). Sieve fruit and set aside. Cream margarine and brown sugar together until fluffy. Add vanilla and blend. Sift flour and salt together and slowly add to creamed mixture. Spread batter evenly on bottom of 9 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan. Spread sieved apricots over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into 1 x 2-inch pieces. Decorate with almonds and/or coconut. Makes 20 bars.

title: Cherry Or Blueberry Delight
instructions: Put 1/2 pie filling in shell and bake 15 minutes on 425\u00b0. Take out of oven and turn down to 350\u00b0. Mix cream cheese sugar eggs and vanilla. Pour over pie filling while hot. Bake for 25 minutes. Cool completely. Put whip topping on pie and rest of pie filling in center of pie.

title: Sauerkraut And Pork
instructions: Salt and pepper pork. Brown pork in pan. Put onion on top of meat. Put sauerkraut on top of meat; put brown sugar and vinegar in; add cut up potatoes. Bring to a boil. Cook about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Cook slowly on low.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Combine carrots onions and green pepper. Set aside. Combine soup oil vinegar and sugar in a pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Pour over carrots. Cool.

title: Special K Treats
instructions: Bring Karo syrup and sugar to a boil. Add the peanut butter until melted. Add the Special K cereal until mixed in well. Spread into a buttered dish to cool. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Pasta Vegetable Soup
instructions: Note Get fresh vegetables off salad bar.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger with onions and peppers; then drain. Then add chili; cook rice as directed. Add rice to hamburger mixture; then mix cornbread or corn muffin mix. Place hamburger mixture in bottom of long or round casserole pan. Put cornbread mixture on top and spread over top of meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Simply Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until done but still firm. Boil eggs. After cooled peel potatoes and eggs. In medium mixing bowl add all ingredients; mix well. Refrigerate and let cool until ready to serve. Makes approximately 4 servings.

title: Hamburger And Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Make a day ahead of time. Brown ground beef and onion. Cook macaroni until tender. Add tomatoes to ground beef. (Tomatoes should be chopped into smaller pieces.) Add tomato sauce and sugar. Simmer 5 minutes. Drain macaroni and add to meat/tomato mixture. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour or spoon into an 8-inch square casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Plain Doughnuts
instructions: Beat egg slightly. Add sugar and shortening. Sift dry ingredients together. Add alternately with milk to make a soft dough. Fry in hot fat at 350\u00b0. Cut and twist into figure eights. Great with maple syrup.

title: Lite N' Layered Summer Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9 x 13 pan with cooking spray. Mix graham cracker crumbs and yogurt together and spread over the bottom of the pan. Bake crust for 15 to 20 minutes until crisp.

title: Smacked Turkey Flat
instructions: You can substitute chicken breasts for turkey.

title: Five Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add well beaten eggs; combine flour and baking powder. Add alternately with milk. Stir in flavorings. Spoon mixture into greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Use glaze if desired.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Stuff shells with mixture of 3 cups shredded Mozzarella cheese 2 cups Ricotta or cottage cheese 1 tablespoon parsley flakes 2 eggs and 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt. Cover bottom of baking dish with thin layer of spaghetti sauce (2 1/2 pounds ground beef and 2 jars Prego sauce). Place stuffed shells in the dish and cover with remaining sauce. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese; bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Peach Alaska(Serves 6)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place bread slices on a cookie sheet; top each slice with a peach half cut side down. Beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar; beat until stiff peaks form. Cover each peach half with meringue covering peach and bread slice completely. Sprinkle top with toasted almonds. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix margarine with 1 1/2 cups flour and confectioners sugar. Press firmly into slightly greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Glenna'S Saucer Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar and add eggs and vanilla. Blend flour baking powder and salt and mix with creamed mixture. Blend in 3 tablespoons milk and chill overnight. Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Strawberry Mold
instructions: You will need an 8 cup (2-quart) mold.

title: Hershey Nut Pie
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk in double boiler or microwave. Add Hershey bars. Cool. Whip cream. Add to mallow mix. Pour into crust. Chill.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Core apples. Place sugar and butter in cavities. Set in custard cups; arrange in ring in baking dish with space between. Cover tightly. Microwave on High power.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Place chicken evenly in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Spread cream of chicken soup evenly over chicken. Toss lightly next 9 ingredients. Put evenly on top of chicken and soup. Pour hot chicken broth over all. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Okra Omelet
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the bacon drippings in a bowl. Pour the bacon drippings in a baking dish. Pour the mixture in a pan and pat down flat. Place pan in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn omelet and bake 5 to 10 minutes. Cut to serving sizes and serve warm. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mom'S Fast Chili
instructions: In a large saucepan cook beef and onion over medium high heat stirring often to break up meat until slightly browned 5 to 10 minutes. Drain excess fat. Stir in all remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered 10 to 15 minutes. Cooking time 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients. Top with a good layer of crushed chips. Bake in casserole at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Country Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper liners. In a large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add butter eggs and milk. Stir just until combined. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake 20 minutes or until muffins test done with toothpick. Serve hot with plenty of butter.

title: Copper Pennies Salad
instructions: Slice carrots and cook in salt water. Drain then add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

title: Hamburger One Dish Meal
instructions: Cook meat until gray and drain well. Place in square pyrex dish. Completely cover top of meet with 1/4 inch slices of velveeta cheese. Sprinkle onion on top of cheese and cover top with a layer of tater tots. Pour a can of celery soup on top (do not add water). Bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Cake Frosting
instructions: Prepare your favorite white or yellow cake layers.

title: Pork Chops With Apricot Glaze
instructions: In saucepan combine first five ingredients; cook over medium heat stirring frequently until smooth and thick (3 to 4 minutes). Remove from heat. Season pork chops with salt pepper and garlic powder; arrange on rack in broiling pan. Broil 6 minutes. Turn chops and brush with glaze; broil another 6 minutes.

title: Golden Sausage Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into an 8x8 greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 4 servings. To garnish with sausage reserve half of the links and arrange on top of the casserole the last 20 minutes of baking time.

title: Olive Pepper Pinwheels
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese and milk until smooth; stir in the peppers olives and dressing mix. Spread over tortillas. Roll up jelly-roll style; wrap tightly in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm. Just before serving cut into 1 in. pieces. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Danish Sugar Cookies(Makes About 7 Dozen)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a bowl. Cut in butter and shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in egg and vanilla; dough is fairly soft. Shape into tiny balls; roll in granulated sugar and place 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheets. Flatten to 1/2-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until delicately browned. Can be frosted with powdered sugar frosting and decorated with colored sugar. Or just roll in colored sugar instead of regular granulated sugar.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add other ingredients except nuts and oysters. Roll or pat out on foil and chill well. Drain oysters and spread on cheese. Roll up then roll the cheese roll in nuts. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornmeal mix eggs cottage cheese onion and grated cheese. Mix well. Add broccoli. Melt oleo in a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan. Add mixture and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown the hamburger and onion. Boil and drain the noodles. In casserole dish mix the soup Ragu sauce oregano salt and pepper. Add hamburger and noodles. Mix well. Cover top with cheese. Cover casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Tex-Mex Won Tons
instructions: For Filling In a large skillet cook ground beef onion and green pepper until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain off fat. Stir beans cheese catsup chili powder and cumin into meat mixture; mix well.

title: Peachy Chicken
instructions: Rub chicken with salt brush with butter. Place in shallow pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Drain peaches reserving 1/2 cup syrup. Combine syrup barbecue sauce and lemon juice. Pour over chicken. Bake 30 minutes. Arrange onions and peaches around chicken. Baste with sauce. Bake 30 minutes longer or until chicken is done. Good served over white rice.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Stir all ingredients into bowl. Grease pan generously. Pour in mixture. Bake at 375 degrees until brown.

title: Candied Grapefruit Peel
instructions: Cut the peeling into strips and cover with cold water. Parboil changing the water often until the peel is tender and not bitter. Drain. Place 1 1/2 cups water sugar and salt in a pan with the peel. Cook until the syrup is absorbed. Roll in granulated sugar and let dry before putting into a tin.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter or margarine. Add sugar and mix well. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Add to margarine/sugar mixture. Chill overnight or several hours. Shape into 1-inch balls and flatten slightly or cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes until edges begin to brown. Do not overbake.

title: Caesar Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a covered jar and shake thoroughly. Chill. Shake again before using. Makes 1 1/2 cups dressing. Pour over broken romaine lettuce leaves and add croutons and anchovies if you like.

title: Caramel Biscuit Ring-A-Round
instructions: In casserole combine sugar margarine and water. Cook uncovered 1 minute. Stir after margarine melts. Separate biscuits. Cut each into quarters and add to the sugar mixture. Push them away from the center. Cook uncovered for 2 1/2 minutes. Let stand 2 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix and store. To serve use 1/3 cup mix in 1 cup boiling water.

title: Old Time Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt first 2 ingredients in 3-quart heavy saucepan over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom and sides of two loaf pans. Mix all ingredients. Pour into pans. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool slightly and remove from pans. Allow to cool completely before wrapping in foil.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion together in water for about 5 minutes. Drain! Mix soup and sour cream; fold in carrots zucchini and onion.

title: Baked Ham
instructions: Cut the skin from the ham and score evenly. Rub with prepared mustard then pat in about 2 cups brown sugar for a whole ham. Stick all over with whole cloves. Place on rack and bake with pickled peach juice (or other juice) for basting. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven. Allow 16 minutes per pound for whole ham 19 minutes per pound for half ham or 8 minutes per pound for precooked ham.

title: Easy Orange Mallow Frost
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add sherbet and blend until dissolved. Chill until almost set. Fold in fruit and marshmallows. Chill until firm. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Special Rice Pilaf
instructions: Saute onion in butter until transparent. Add the rice and stir lightly until beige in color. Boil water with the bouillon cubes. Add to rice. Also stir in raisins and curry. Cover and simmer 20 minutes on medium heat.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in prepared loaf pans for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 until lightly brown and tested done. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat slowly for 1 minute all ingredients. Spoon at once into a baked 9-inch pie shell. Chill at least 2 hours. Top with whipped topping just before serving.

title: Jungle Jello
instructions: Put Jell-O in bowl. Add hot water and stir until clear. Pour juice from fruit cocktail in measuring cup. Add enough Southern Comfort to make 2 cups. Add to Jell-O mix and stir. Pour into glass dish and add fruit cocktail. Refrigerate. May take 2 days to set up. Great for parties.

title: *Mango Chutney*
instructions: Combine vinegar water salt and sugar in a large pot and bring to a boil. Add onions raisins garlic and ginger and bring to a boil again. Add mangos and chili peppers and bring to a boil. Cook for 20-30 minutes until mangos look clear or glassy. Gently stir mixture occasionally to avoid sticking to the bottom of the pot. Remove from heat place mixture in hot sterilized jars and seal immediately.

title: Vera'S Saucy Dish
instructions: Place green pepper and onion in a large skillet. Add enough water to cover vegetables. Cook over medium-high heat until tender 15 to 20 minutes. Add beef to skillet; add more water if necessary. Cook beef until done breaking into smaller pieces as you stir. Drain. Add tomato paste whole tomatoes (including liquid from can) and crushed tomatoes. Reduce heat stirring occasionally. Add Parmesan cheese and all seasonings. Simmer over low-medium heat for about 30 minutes. Pour sauce into hot cooked pasta. Stir to mix well. Serve with additional grated Parmesan cheese. Makes 16 to 18 cups.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole #1
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except cornflake crumbs. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle cornflake crumbs on top of mixture. Bake for approximately 45 minutes uncovered at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Lima Beans Over Rice
instructions: Boil ham hock until tender. Add the lima beans. Bring to a boil. Cut off and cool. Boil rice separately. When done place in dish. Cover with beans.

title: Coconut Sno-Ball Pie
instructions: Mix sno-balls with milk in double boiler. Mix sugar flour and salt; add to the slightly beaten egg yolks. Stir sno-ball mixture into egg yolk mixture. Add butter and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve with or without meringue.

title: Tiger Salad
instructions: Heat fruit cocktail. Dissolve Jell-O in heated fruit cocktail. Let cool. Add 2 cups buttermilk. Fold in Cool Whip. Place in refrigerator.

title: Excellent Potatoes
instructions: Place frozen potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat soup margarine cheese and sour cream just until melted. Place onions over the potatoes. Pour sauce over next. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Do not cover.

title: Yankee Enchiladas
instructions: On platter put chips around edge. Prepare salad with lettuce onion and Cheddar cheese. Heap salad in center of platter. Prepare sauce.

title: Gala Green Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove from skillet; crumble. Cook onion rings in remaining fat until tender. Toss onions and cheese with hot beans; sprinkle with bacon.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well. Sift flour soda and salt. Add gradually to creamed mixture and mix well. Shape into balls the size of walnuts and flatten with fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Eggplant Northern Italian Style(Serves 4)
instructions: Halve eggplants lengthwise. Crisscross meaty part with sharp knife. Place in large skillet. Add water to half depth bring to boil. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until tender enough to pierce with fork. Remove from pan and drain. Saute garlic until golden. Dice tomato and combine with garlic cheese parsley and oregano. Pour sauce in large baking dish. Sprinkle eggplant with salt and pepper and place skin side down in sauce. Top with cheese mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Salisbury Steak Deluxe
instructions: In a bowl combine soup mustard Worcestershire sauce and horseradish; blend well. Set aside. In another bowl lightly beat egg. Add bread crumbs onion salt pepper and 1/4 cup of the soup mixture. Add beef and mix well. Shape into six patties. In large skillet brown patties in oil. Drain. Combine remaining soup mixture with water; pour over patties. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until meat is done. Remove meat and place on platter. Spoon sauce over meat. Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 6.

title: Almond Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Stir in almonds and vanilla. Blend in flour with a pastry blender. Form into small balls. Place on an ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with a glass dipped in sugar. Bake for 9 to 10 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven until lightly browned. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Becky'S Beans
instructions: Brown onion and green pepper in oil. Add beef and brown. Pour this mixture into baking dish. Add rest of ingredients. Sprinkle another tablespoon of brown sugar on top before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sweetheart Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening and sugar until creamy. Blend in egg milk and vanilla. Blend flour baking powder and salt together. Add to creamed mixture; mix well. Stir in oats. Chill dough several hours or overnight. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes. Roll out on lightly floured board to 1/2-inch; cut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. When cool frost. Cookies can be cut into any shape easily handled. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Mom'S Doughnuts
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar. Combine dry ingredients add alternately with milk. Roll and cut out. Can be stirred up and refrigerated overnight.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Sprinkle salt on potatoes. Sift flour. Cut shortening and potatoes into flour. Add milk mix and roll out. Cut out biscuits. Place on greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Use a one-gallon wide mouth jar. Slice cucumbers and onions thinly and layer tightly in jar. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers. Shake daily. Store in refrigerator. Ready to eat in 5 days.

title: Cream Cheese-Fruit Tarts
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix baking mix 2 tablespoons sugar the margarine and 1 package cream cheese in small bowl until dough forms a ball. Divide dough into 6 equal pieces. Press each piece in ungreased tart pan 4 1/4 x 1-inch or ungreased 10 ounce custard cup (press on bottom and 3/4 up side). Place on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown; cool.

title: Crispy Fish Fillets
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Mix well. Add 1/4 cup of this mixture to crushed crackers. Mix well. Place fish in square baking pan. Pour lemonade mixture over fish. Sprinkle with cracker mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until fish flakes.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in this order in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan.

title: Creamy Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Heat first 5 ingredients in pan. Stir until smooth. Turn off heat.

title: Millionaire'S Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice and milk. Add remaining ingredients; pour into pie shells. Sprinkle extra pecans over the top. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs butter and syrup together. Add dry ingredients. Add nuts and flavoring. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Fudge Nut Squares
instructions: Cream margarine brown sugar eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking powder salt and oatmeal. Spread 1/2 of this in a greased jelly roll pan.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix prepared rice with chicken and soup. Simmer. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients. Shape into loaf and place in large shallow baking pan. Bake 1 hour or until done. Makes 8 servings.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook hamburger; crumble and drain. Add taco seasoning and beans. Stir well; turn into large bowl and add onion tomatoes avocados taco chips and cheese. Mix well; put into refrigerator. May make this part early in day. When ready to serve add lettuce and dressing. This makes a large salad and is very good. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening (butter) peanut butter sugars and egg thoroughly. Measure flour and blend all dry ingredients; stir into shortening mixture. Chill dough. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll dough in 1 1/4-inch balls. Place 3-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Flatten crisscross style with fork dipped in flour. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen (2 1/2-inch) cookies. These cookies are a favorite.

title: Easy Potato Rolls
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream sugar and shortening. Add potatoes salt and eggs. In a small bowl dissolve yeast in 2/3 cup of warm water; add to creamed mixture. Beat in 2 cups flour and remaining water. Add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Shape into a ball; do not knead. Place in a greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 hour.

title: Macaroni And Cottage Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed. Drain well. Saute butter and onion. Mix macaroni with butter and onion. Mix well. Add cottage cheese and stir. Makes about 16 servings.

title: Chicken And Mushrooms
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Place oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat and brown chicken on all sides. Do not crowd pan. Remove chicken as browned and set aside.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a bag. Put in dressing mix salt pepper parsley and paprika; mix well. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together then add liquids. Pour batter into muffin tin or foil cupcakes. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into small round balls. Put on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Crispy Potato Wedges
instructions: Place potato wedges in large bowl; add cold water to cover. Let set 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Spray nonstick spray on baking pan and set aside.

title: No Peel Apple Pie
instructions: Let pie crust stand at room temperature according to package directions. Meanwhile core and slice unpeeled apples (you should have 8 cups). In a large mixing bowl combine apples with water and lemon juice; toss to coat.

title: Quay'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Make real stiff with flour. Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet and mash with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Venison Dinner
instructions: Put the deer\tham and shoulder into a large dishpan. Cover with the chopped vegetables. Pour the vinegar water and oil over all. Sprinkle salt and pepper to taste. Cover the entire pan with aluminum foil; tightly seal the edges and cook at 250\u00b0 for about 6 to 8 hours. Or set entire pan on a grill or smoker overnight.\tYou will not even need a knife to serve.

title: Chili Rellenos
instructions: Combine milk eggs flour chilies. Blend. Mix in Cheddar cheese. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Blend flour salt and shortening. Mix water vinegar and egg; add to flour mixture. Mix well. Shape into two balls. Chill 15 minutes or may refrigerate up to 3 days. Roll out immediately or freeze until later use. Makes two crust pie.

title: Orange Gelatin Salad
instructions: Pour gelatin into serving dish add water dissolve. Put marshmallows reserved pineapple juice and cream cheese in pan. Heat until melted. Add pecans and pineapple. Mix with gelatin. Chill until set.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar eggs and oil. Add flour salt baking soda and fruit cocktail. Beat cocktail in blender with juice. Then put cocktail in with other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: German Pizza
instructions: In large skillet melt butter. Layer potatoes ham and onions. Cover and cook until potatoes are done. Whisk eggs and cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour over cooked mixture. Cover and cook until eggs are done. Amount of ingredients are to your personal taste.

title: Squash Au Gratin
instructions: Thinly slice the onion and slice the squash about 1/4 inch thick. Place in a 2-quart baking dish. Add salt and/or pepper to taste. Dot with margarine (this can be left out for a lo-fat dish if desired). Add water. Microwave for about 10 minutes or until done the way you prefer. Drain and sprinkle with the cheese. Microwave for 30 to 45 seconds or until the cheese melts.

title: Nutri-Bars
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add all liquids. Stir in chocolate chips. Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and slice.

title: Quick Cacciatore
instructions: Mix spaghetti sauce and tomatoes in pot adding spices to taste. Cut green pepper; add to sauce. Add mushrooms. Cook on stove until bubbly then reduce to simmer. While sauce is simmering cook chicken in frypan with only 1 to 2 tablespoons oil. Using a nonstick pan is best. Cook chicken until done browning on both sides. Add chicken to sauce. Spoon sauce over your favorite pasta. Place chicken on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Waikiki Balls(Lamb)
instructions: Mix meat crumbs onion egg salt ginger and milk. Shape mixture by tablespoon into balls. Melt shortening in large skillet. Brown and cook meatballs. Remove meatballs and keep warm. Pour fat from skillet. Mix cornstarch and sugar. Stir in reserved pineapple syrup vinegar and soy sauce until smooth. Pour into skillet and cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Add warmed meat pineapple and green pepper; heat again. Serve with rice. Makes enough for 6 persons.

title: English Toffee
instructions: You will need a candy thermometer medium saucepan spoon and buttered jelly roll pan.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until combined well. Bake in a pie shell at 350\u00b0 until a knife comes out clean.

title: Good And Moist Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornbread batter as usual and add 1 heaping tablespoonful mayonnaise. Makes cornbread very moist.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil chicken with bay leaves until tender. Remove chicken and chop into cubes. Place in a large mixing bowl. Add all remaining ingredients except cheese and bread crumbs. Mix well. Put mixture into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: All-Purpose Sauce
instructions: Bring sauce to a boil. Good for chicken and spareribs.

title: Hash Brown Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix sour cream soup butter salt onion and cheese. Spread on top of potatoes. Place cornflakes and butter on top.

title: Crock-Pot Dressing
instructions: Break up breads. Combine all ingredients except for margarine. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours or on high for 2 hours.

title: Glazed Chicken Drumsticks
instructions: Place chicken drumsticks in ungreased shallow glass dish. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Line broiler pan with aluminum foil. Place chicken on rack in broiler pan. Brush chicken with remaining sauce. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Orange Cake(Delicious!)
instructions: Cream together sugar and 1/3 cup shortening. Add eggs and milk. Dredge raisins and nuts. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Add rind and juice of 1 orange. Bake at 350\u00b0. While still warm drizzle over top the juice of 1 orange and sugar.

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: Melt margarine and pour over the other ingredients. Put in pan and bake for 2 hours at 200\u00b0 stirring every 20 minutes. Season with celery salt and garlic salt to taste.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Take half of cake and break into pieces and place into a punch bowl. Mix pudding and cake then add 1 can cherry pie filling then 1 can crushed pineapple then 1 (8 ounce) Cool Whip then half of the coconut. Repeat the steps and then add maraschino cherries on top.

title: Homemade Rolls
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in warm water; add the scalded cooled milk. Sift 2 1/2 cups flour in bowl; add sugar and salt (if using plain flour). Cut in shortening. Add the yeast mixture; beat vigorously until smooth and bubbly. Add rest of flour making a firm dough easily handled without sticking. Mold as desired. Let stand in a warm place until double in bulk which should be about 30 to 40 minutes. Bake in medium oven (400\u00b0) for 20 minutes or until brown. Um-Um-m-m-m-m- Good!

title: Broccoli With Linguine
instructions: Cook broccoli in a small amount of boiling salted water for 10 minutes. Drain and chop. Cook linguine according to package directions; drain. Combine linguine broccoli mushrooms half and half and butter. Simmer 5 minutes. Add cheese. Yield 6 servings.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain off excess fat. Simmer for 20 minutes the soups sauces and chilies. Place 6 1/2 ounce package tortilla chips in casserole. Pour meat mixture over chips. Cover with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: *Pastichio 3
instructions: Undercook the macaroni. Rinse with hot water to wash away starch. Add melted butter. Stir to mix. Add beaten eggs and cheese.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Grease crock-pot. Combine all the ingredients in large bowl and mix well. Pour into crock-pot. Put slices of cheese on top and sprinkle with paprika. Cook on low heat for 3 hours.

title: Simple Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Mix together sugar shortening and salt. Pour 1 cup boiling water over mixture. Stir and cool. Beat eggs slightly. Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water. Add flour. Mix all together and refrigerate (up to one week). Dough will be sticky. Roll out and cut into shape. Let rise 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
instructions: Crush cookies and set aside 1/2 cup crumbs. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour melted margarine over crushed cookies and refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and oil together. Add dry ingredients then apples and nuts. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with butterscotch morsels and bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Very tasty for Thanksgiving and Christmas.

title: Slow Cooker Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown beef in skillet and drain off fat. Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Stir thoroughly. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. May be cooked on higher temperature if you are home to stir (about 3 hours). Serves 6.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese in medium-sized bowl until fluffy. Gradually add sweetened condensed milk. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Before serving top with pie filling. Garnish each slice with a dollop of whipped topping.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Cream butter cheese and gradually add powdered sugar. Beat until mixture is light and fluffy add vanilla. Mixture makes about 3 cups.

title: Waffles
instructions: Stir milk and egg yolks into dry ingredients. Blend in melted shortening. Lastly add 2 beaten egg whites.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and shortening. Add salt and sugar. (I use pastry cutter to mix with.) Add enough milk to make soft dough. Roll out between wax paper. Bake according to filling directions. Makes 2 crusts.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies in food processor. Cream margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar. In large bowl mix pudding milk and Cool Whip. Blend the 2 mixtures together; layer cookies and mixture in sand bucket starting with cookies and finishing with cookies.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 (8-inch) round cake pans. In a large bowl combine all ingredients except cream cheese frosting. With mixer at low speed beat until well mixed constantly scraping bowl with rubber spatula. At high speed beat 4 minutes occasionally scraping bowl. Pour into prepared pans.

title: Spinach Squish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Allow frozen spinach to thaw. In a colander squish out as much water from the spinach as possible. Set aside.

title: Parmesan Peas
instructions: Cook peas as directed on package. Drain. Toss with remaining ingredients. Serve with additional grated Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Honey Oat Loaf(No Knead)
instructions: In large bowl mix together water and honey; sprinkle in yeast and let stand 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except for flour. With rubber spatula gradually work in flour. Mixture will be thick. Let rise for 30 minutes in warm place. Work with spatula again and let rise until double in bulk about 75 minutes. Turn onto floured board cut in half and pat each half into loaf shape. Dough will be very soft. Using 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) pans pour 1 tablespoon oil into each. Drop each loaf into a pan and turn to oil the top. Let rise until 1/2 inch from top of pan. Place in cold oven with shallow pan of water on bottom of oven. Set oven for 350\u00b0 and bake 45 minutes. Turn out gently as bread will be very soft.

title: Ethel'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk adding sour cream and half of the Cool Whip. Slice\tbananas over vanilla\twafers. Pour pudding mixture over bananas and ice with rest of Cool Whip. Store in refrigerator for 2 hours to set before slicing. The only place I could find French vanilla pudding was at Kroger. It is not the same with a substitute.

title: Cheese Onion Bread
instructions: Saute onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Combine eggs milk Bisquick and 2/3 cup cheese in bowl mixing well. Add onion stirring to blend. Pour into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Mix remaining 2 tablespoons butter 1/3 cup cheese and poppy seed. Sprinkle topping over batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until loaf tests done.

title: No Salt Seasoning Mix
instructions: Mix all spices together. Store in airtight jar. Use to spice up dishes without using salt.

title: Sad Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Soccer Squares
instructions: Cook sugar and corn syrup until bubbly; stir often. Remove from heat stir in peanut butter and cereal. Mix well. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and butterscotch chips together in a pot over medium heat stirring. Spread over cereal mixture and refrigerate one hour. Cut in squares. Makes 24.

title: Hobo Meal
instructions: Patty hamburger meat. Place in foil. Layer veggies on top. Top with butter and Worcestershire sauce. Seal tightly. Bake over open fire or in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until done. Over fire turn after 15 minutes and cook 15 minutes more.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients; mix well. Add 1/2 of the condensed milk and blend. Pour 1/2 batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Melt and blend caramels and remaining milk. Spread over baked cake. Sprinkle with pecans. Cover with remaining batter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Freezer Coleslaw
instructions: Bring sugar vinegar water and celery to a boil stirring occasionally. Boil 1 minute. Cool to room temperature. In a large bowl toss together cabbage and remaining ingredients. Set aside. Drain cabbage mixture. Stir cooled vinegar mixture into cabbage mixture until well mixed. Pack coleslaw in three one-pint freezer safe containers. Leave 1/2-inch space on top. Cover and freeze. Store in freezer up to 6 months. Thaw coleslaw about 3 hours at room temperature before serving. Makes 3 pints.

title: Spinach Soup
instructions: Brown onions in butter. Add 46 ounce can chicken broth. bring to boil add 2 cups Coffee-mate potatoes carrots and rice. Simmer 15 minutes. Add 10 ounce package chopped spinach 1 package asparagus or can asparagus and 1 tablespoon bouillon (instant). Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Mix melted margarine 1 cup flour and chopped pecans. Press in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Mix sugar water and vinegar; cook on medium heat. Add salt and beets; simmer for a few minutes then put in sterile jar. May increase for large canning.

title: Shrimp And Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix Ranch dressing lemon juice and dill. Stir until blended well. Add remaining ingredients. Serve.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Layer broccoli on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top. Mix together the next 3 ingredients and pour over broccoli and chicken. Add cheese and top with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes; do not cover. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mustard Fried Catfish
instructions: Brush fillets lightly with half of mustard. Place cornmeal salt red pepper and pepper in a zip-top plastic bag; drop in fillets one at a time and shake until completely coated. Brush fillets with remaining mustard; return to bag and shake again. Fry in deep hot oil (350\u00b0) 4 to 5 minutes or until catfish fillets float to the top and are golden brown; drain well. Transfer fillets to a serving platter; garnish with parsley and lemon wedges. Serve hot. Yields 6 servings.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Beat the pulp soda sugar shortening and egg thoroughly. Sift together the flour spices and salt. Add to the creamed mixture and beat well. Stir nuts and raisins into the mixture. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until slightly brown (about 15 minutes). Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Ranch Corn
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in an 8 to 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with cheese mixing a little in as you go. Turn oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Marinade For Beef Roast
instructions: Marinate roast overnight. Remove 1/2 the sauce and freeze. Cook roast at 325\u00b0 until done basting often.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Cook noodles. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Line with noodles. Beat egg with milk; pour over noodles. Mix hamburger soup and pizza sauce; spread over noodles. Add other spices and toppings; sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cream cheese and butter get to room temperature. Grate cheese and mix all ingredients together until well blended. Shape cheese into 1 large or 2 small balls. Roll in crushed nuts and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Icebox Slaw
instructions: In saucepan bring to a boil the last 5 ingredients and pour over the vegetables. Cover tightly and put in refrigerator. This keeps for several days.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: To make sour milk mix 1 cup milk with 2 tablespoons vinegar.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except for the topping. Pour into a casserole dish. Add crumbs and butter on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes until brown. Yield 5 servings.

title: Ham And Barley Soup
instructions: About 2 1/2 hours before serving cut celery into 1/4-inch slices. Cut carrots into 1 1/2 x 1/2-inch pieces. Dice onions. Peel and cut turnips into 1/2-inch chunks; thickly slice mushrooms.

title: Water Chestnut Appetizer
instructions: Mix together and heat first 3 ingredients. Leave heated in fondue pot. Wrap water chestnuts in bacon and secure with toothpick. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes or until bacon is done. Dip bacon pieces in sauce.

title: Cheese Crunchies
instructions: Mix cheese and margarine (room temperature); add remaining ingredients. Form into balls and flatten with fork on baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes at 350.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar and mix well. Add flour and butter and mix well. Add buttermilk and flavoring. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Rinse and chop finely the dried beef. Combine 1/4 cup dried beef with cream cheese sour cream grated Parmesan cheese and horseradish. Blend thoroughly. Refrigerate mixture for 15 minutes. Form into ball and roll into remaining beef; chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In medium mixing bowl beat eggs sugar peanut butter corn syrup and vanilla at medium speed until blended. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown and filling is puffy about 50 to 60 minutes. Cool on wire rack before cutting. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Gram'S Raisin Cake(100 Year Old Recipe)
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa; add water butter spices and salt. Boil 4 minutes; cool. Sift together the flour baking powder and soda.\tAdd to raisin mixture and mix until well blended. Stir in walnuts.\tPour into greased Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Can be stored in freezer up to 6 months.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix everything together. Pour into 2 pie crusts. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set up; about 40 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Bunny Nest
instructions: Melt margarine on low heat. Remove from heat; add sugar and coconut. Mix well. Add food coloring.

title: Grilled Salmon Steaks
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Pour into glass pan. Add 1 tablespoon of water. Add fish. Turn to coat with marinade. Cover and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes or in refrigerator for 2 hours turning steaks occasionally.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine chicken and vegetables in a greased shallow 2-quart baking dish. Set aside. Stir flour salt and pepper into butter. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until bubbly. Gradually add broth stirring constantly until thickened. Pour over chicken and vegetables. Top with corn meal pastry or pie crust.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until it falls off bone. Skin and debone it. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a saucepan mix both cans soup and picante. Mix well and add cheese until it is melted. Crunch up handful of chips and set aside. Now crunch 1/2 bag of chips and put in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan then layer 1/2 of chicken on top and then 1/2 of cheese sauce on top. Then repeat with other 1/2 in same order. Sprinkle top with chips and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: On waxed paper coat stew meat with flour; reserve leftover flour. In a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat in hot salad oil cook meat a few pieces at a time until well browned on all sides removing pieces as they brown. Reduce heat to medium. To drippings in Dutch oven add chopped onion and garlic. Cook until onion is almost tender about 3 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in reserved flour until blended. Gradually stir in 3 cups water bouillon salt Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Cook stirring constantly until mixture is slightly thickened. Add meat and heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer about 2 1/2 hours or until meat is almost tender stirring occasionally. Add potatoes and carrot chunks. Over medium heat heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in frozen peas. Cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes until all vegetables are tender. Serve with dumplings or noodles. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and drain fat. Add 1 tablepsoon parsley 1 1/2 teaspoons salt tomato paste 1 tablespoon basil tomatoes and chopped garlic clove. Simmer until thick (about 45 to 60 minutes). Cook noodles until tender drain and rinse in cold water. Combine cottage cheese eggs 2 tablespoon parsley pepper and Parmesan cheese; mix well. Place half of cooked noodles in 9 x 13-inch baking dish and spread half of cheese mixture over noodles. Add half of grated Mozzarella and half of meat sauce; repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand for 15 minutes and cut into squares. Enjoy!

title: Sun-Maid Raisin Nut Cake(Our Family Christmas Cake Since 1936)
instructions: Cream butter with brown sugar. Add molasses beaten eggs and buttermilk in which the soda has been dissolved. Mix and sift the flour baking powder cinnamon and cloves. Add to this dry mixture the Sun-Maid raisins (cut in pieces) and walnuts (coarsely chopped). Combine dry ingredients with the first mixture. Bake in 3 layers in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. When cool cover with your favorite icing. I use Caramel Icing.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and flour. Mix egg yolks sugar and baking powder. Beat egg whites stiff; save to last. Add to mixture fresh coconut (grated) red and green cherries red and green pineapple white raisins and nuts. Add juice of fresh orange; add egg whites. Bake in 275\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes per pound.

title: Spinach New Orleans
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain well. Add cream cheese and 1/2 stick butter. Mix well. Melt second 1/2 stick butter. Mix with bread crumbs. Sprinkle mixture on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown beef. Add onion garlic celery and bell peppers. Add rest of ingredients and cook for 2 hours. Add spaghetti sauce mix.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and hot water. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes. Add milk and heat almost to boiling. Serve.

title: Beef And Cheese Foldover(One Dish Meals)
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce; set aside. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Unroll crescent dough into 4 long rectangles on an ungreased cookie sheet. Overlap long sides; firmly press perforations and edges to seal. Pat to form 15 x 13-inch rectangle. Spread meat mixture lengthwise in a 4-inch wide strip down center of dough to within 1-inch of ends. Top meat with cheese slices. Fold shorter sides of dough 1-inch over filling. Bring long sides of dough rectangle over filling overlapping edges; pinch edge to seal. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 375 \u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Pizza Piena - Easter Meat Pie
instructions: *To cut down calories heavily grease pan and dust with flour. Works out well.

title: Cantaloupe Soup(The Blender At Its Best)
instructions: Remove seeds from cantaloupe and cube the pulp. Place pulp and cinnamon in electric blender and puree. Combine orange and lime juices and stir into the puree. Chill and serve in chilled soup bowls. Garnish with mint sprigs. Serves 5.

title: Angel Food Cake Dessert
instructions: Combine ginger ale orange juice and marshmallows and melt over low heat. Cool.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine juice egg yolk flour sugar and butter; cook until thick. After cool add Cool Whip.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over crackers. Put on cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Stir every 5 minutes.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Fry bacon crisp and crumble over shredded cabbage. Add chopped onion and combine dressing ingredients which can be thinned with milk if desired. Add to salad.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt the margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. In a bowl mix well the cottage cheese eggs onion broccoli and cornbread mix. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Place a layer of bread crumbs asparagus and soup in casserole dish. Top with layer of bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: 2-Minute Fudge
instructions: In 1 1/2 quart casserole stir together sugar cocoa salt milk and vanilla until partially blended. Put butter or margarine over top in center of dish. Microwave on High 2 minutes. Stir well until smooth. Pour into greased 8-inch square dish. Chill 1 hour.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken pieces soups pimentos and seasonings in saucepan. Heat until bubbling and hot. Line a large Pyrex casserole dish (that has been sprayed with Pam) with chow mein noodles. Pour hot chicken/soup mixture over noodles. Top with grated cheese. Place in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is golden brown.

title: Pork Tenderloin
