instructions: Cut tenderloin into 8 pieces; place each piece between 2 pieces of plastic wrap or waxed paper and flatten to 1/2-inch thickness. Sprinkle with lemon pepper. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook pork for 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until no longer pink and juices run clear. Remove to a serving platter and keep warm.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels butter and 1/4 cup sugar. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese and 1 cup sugar together. Spread over pretzel mixture. Next put a generous layer of Cool Whip. Dissolve Jell-O mix in heated pineapple juice. Remove from heat; let partially set. Add strawberries. Spread over mixture and refrigerate until Jell-O is firm. Top with Cool Whip and crushed pretzels.

title: Quick Southwestern Pizza
instructions: Move oven rack to lowest position. Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet or 12-inch pizza pan. Mix baking mix and water. Beat vigorously 20 strokes. Turn onto floured surface. Knead about 60 times or until no longer sticky. Press into 13-inch circle on cookie sheet; pinch edge forming 1/2-inch rim or press in pizza pan.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook about 1/2 hour until slightly thickened. Flavor should be \sweet and sour\.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Flatten the chicken breasts with wooden mallet and season with salt and pepper. Roll the strips of cheese in the ham slices and place in the center of the flattened breast. Fold the edges over one another and press tightly. Dredge them with flour and dip into beaten eggs. Coat well with bread crumbs. Chill until ready to fry. Cook at 325\u00b0 in deep fat for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Rainbow Sherbet Squares
instructions: Any desired combinations of sherbets can be used. Combine whipped cream sugar cookies and nuts. Spread about 1/3 of mixture into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Spoon sherbet over this layer. It is easier to do if the sherbet is fairly soft.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix first 4 ingredients well. Fold in sour cream and mix well. Pour into preheated greased iron skillet and bake until golden brown.

title: Doo Dads
instructions: In large bowl mix dry ingredients. Mix last 3 ingredients and pour over all dry ingredients. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours stirring every 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Put sugar and milk in pan and cook until small ball forms in cold water. Take off fire; add peanut butter vanilla and butter. Beat until thick and pour into two buttered plates.

title: Bible Cake(Behold There Was A Cake Baken. 1 Kings 19:6)
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 1/2-inch tube pan. Chop nuts and fruit fine; flour well with flour from the 2 cups. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; set aside. In mixing bowl blend butter sugar spices and salt. Beat egg yolks and add. Sift in baking powder and flour; add water and honey. Stir in floured nuts and fruits; beat. Fold into well beaten mixture the egg whites. Pour batter into pan. Bake 30 to 60 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Fettucini Alfredo
instructions: In saucepan on very low heat mix butter heavy cream parsley sherry and garlic powder until smooth. Add egg yolks. Remove from heat and pour over fettucini. Top with Parmesan.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan by package directions adding 1 teaspoon of flavoring and 1 package of frozen coconut. Mix together powdered sugar milk and water. Pour over cake immediately after taking from the oven. Allow cake to cool. Spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle other package of coconut. Sprinkle with pecans.

title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put in large airtight bowl. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Roll out to 1/8-inch thickness on floured surface. Use cookie cutters. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. May use icing and sprinkles when cooled.

title: Crock-Pot Deer Chili
instructions: Brown meat in small amount of oil in skillet. Add onions and stir in chili pepper. Transfer into crock-pot. Stir in tomatoes and beans. Cook on low all day. Yummy!

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar cocoa soda cream of tartar and salt into mixing bowl. Drop in shortening and add 2/3 of milk then vanilla and beat. Add eggs and beat. Add the remaining 1/3 of milk and beat. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Minnie'S Famous Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar butter and egg whites; slowly add flour and sour cream. Add beaten egg yolks. Mix and pour into stem cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Press cracker crumbs with 1 stick melted margarine into a 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Set aside.

title: Pizza Puff
instructions: In skillet cook meat on medium-high heat until browned adding oil as needed. Drain off all but 2 teaspoons fat. Add vegetables saute until limp. Add sauce and seasonings. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Spread meat mix in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish/pan. Sprinkle cheese evenly over meat. In blender add eggs milk flour 1 tablespoon oil and salt. Blend pour over cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 until browned and puffy about 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together (except eggs) and put 1/2 of mixture in bottom of casserole dish. Slice all the eggs. Use as the middle layer and then add the rest of mixture on top of this. Top with a cup of crushed cornflakes and 1 stick of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Ramen Noodle Salad
instructions: Cook noodles for 3 minutes and break into small pieces. Chop or grate cabbage. Mix drained noodles cabbage nuts chicken and peas in a large bowl. Mix flavor packages oil vinegar and sugar. Pour over cabbage mixture and blend together. Top with sunflower seeds and chill. Makes a lot.

title: Tabooley-Lebanese Parsley Salad
instructions: Rinse wheat in water until water is no longer cloudy. Soak for 5 minutes. Squeeze dry by cupping hands and pressing between palms of hands. Use food processor to pulsate parsley to save time or chop fine on cutting board. Chop onions mint leaves and tomatoes very fine. Place vegetables in a large bowl; add wheat lemon juice oil salt and pepper and mix well. Serve with fresh small grape leaves or place salad on romaine lettuce leaves used as scoops. Serves 6.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and butter. Stir in egg yolks. Gradually add 3 cups flour; mix well. Roll into small balls and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Dip finger in water and make shallow depression in each ball of dough. Put a bit of jelly (color of your choice) in each depression. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. (This is a good recipe to make when also making Forgotten Cookies as the remaining egg yolks are used.)

title: Ida Ceconi'S Vienna Cookies
instructions: Work flour and shortening together then work in sugar to a crumbly mixture. Add beaten egg yolks. Pinch off small amounts of this dough so that when it is rolled it is about the size of a small walnut. After it is rolled between the hands flatten slightly to about 3/4 of an inch thick. Make a small indentation in the center with finger large enough to hold a small amount of tart jelly. Brush each cookie with slightly beaten egg white and sprinkle with finely chopped nutmeats and sugar. Put in refrigerator for about 1 hour. Bake in slow oven (250\u00b0) for 20 minutes then gradually increase heat to 300\u00b0 and bake about 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix soups Ro-Tel and milk; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and pour into casserole dish. Add crumbled tortilla chips and diced chicken; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated thoroughly. Remove from oven and add grated cheese. Bake for 10 minutes more uncovered or until cheese melts. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mash cranberry sauce and add lemon juice and blend. Pour into a 1-quart refrigerator tray or 1 (9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pan. Soften cream cheese. Add sugar and mayonnaise. Mix well. Add pecans and whipped cream. Spoon cheese mixture over cranberries. Freeze until firm. To serve cut into slices and serve on lettuce. Makes 8 servings.

title: Apple Or Banana Pancakes
instructions: I use pancake mix the dry bought kind. Chop apples real fine and mix into mixture. You will not need to add the full amount of water. Cook as usual. If you add bananas mash real good and remember to put less water in mixture.

title: Grape Sparkle
instructions: Heat 1 cup of the grape juice just to boiling point. Add the gelatin; stir until dissolved. Remove from heat. Add other cup of grape juice (ice cubes may be added for quick cooling). Wash and let grapes dry. Place grapes in the bottom of a bowl or in individual dessert glasses. Pour thickened gelatin mixture over the grapes. Chill until firm. Yields 4 servings.

title: Pecan Caramel Candy
instructions: Melt 1 cup sugar and corn syrup. Add milk then add rest of sugar. Cook on low temperature until it forms firm ball (245\u00b0 on thermometer). Add vanilla butter and nuts. Pour on buttered wax paper or foil.

title: Chinese Spareribs (Barbecue)
instructions: Cut spareribs into 2-inch sections. Place in large bowl add remaining ingredients. Mix with spareribs and marinate for 6 hours. Cook in 300\u00b0 oven in the marinade sauce until tender. Add some water when needed. Brown under broiler flame. Garnish with sweet and sour sauce (Duck Sauce or Saucy Susan). Serves 4 to 6.

title: Stuffed Rolls
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together. Slice rolls and remove some of the center from the rolls to make room for the filling (save and freeze for later use when you need bread crumbs). Fill each roll with approximately 2 tablespoons filling (more or less depending on size of rolls). Wrap individually in foil and refrigerate or freeze until ready to use. Then place on cookie sheet and heat thoroughly in 300\u00b0 oven until hot through (about 20 to 30 minutes depending on whether or not they are frozen). Serve with salad and dessert for a light meal. Leftovers can be reheated.

title: Cranberry Gelatin Salad
instructions: Grind together the cranberries orange and apples. Add the pineapple juice to the gelatin and hot water. Mix other ingredients together and allow to set in refrigerator until solid.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Mix bean onion and pepper together in bowl. Mix the vinegar oil and sugar together and mix with beans. Let set overnight before serving.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until very stiff. Line a greased glass pie plate. (This is crust.)

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Stir in remainder of ingredients. Pour in shell. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until custard is set and knife inserted comes out clean. Serve hot. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add milk alternately with sifted dry ingredients. Add grated rind or lemon. Bake in loaf pan 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 5 to 10 minutes. Mix sugar and juice of 1 lemon and pour over bread. Let stand 1/2 hour then remove from pan. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Simmer all ingredients for 15 minutes on medium.

title: Zebra Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar oil and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Stir in flour cocoa cinnamon baking powder and salt. Cover. Refrigerate for 2 hours or longer. Lightly grease baking sheet; set aside. Place confectioners sugar in a small bowl. Shape dough in 1-inch balls. Roll in confectioners sugar. Place 2 inches apart on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 11 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Instant Miracle Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside. In a large bowl mix flour sugar and baking soda. Cut in shortening. Add buttermilk and yeast mixing well. Cover dough and chill 2 hours. Place dough on a floured cloth. Roll out and cut with a biscuit cutter. Place in pan and set aside until dough reaches room temperature. Brush with melted butter and bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 36 rolls.

title: Coconut Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in one 9-inch pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Asparagus - English Pea Casserole
instructions: Dilute soup with juice from peas to make 1 can. Layer in casserole dish. Cover with soup. Top with salt and pepper butter and cheese. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve over or with fruit.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except pie shell) together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add eggs butter and vanilla. Cook over medium heat until thick stirring often. Pour into pie shells. Top with whipped cream.

title: Stuffed French Toast
instructions: Place 9 bread slices in a single layer on bottom of slightly greased 13 x 9 pan. Top with cream cheese slices. Place remaining bread slices on top. Whisk together eggs milk syrup and cinnamon. Pour over bread. Cover and chill 8 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Lightly cover with foil after 20 minutes.

title: Jiffy Plum Cake
instructions: Mix all except nuts in large bowl. Beat well. Add pecans and stir. Bake 50 or 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Add all other ingredients and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Serve over fritos with sour cream and grated cheese.

title: German Christmas Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugar until creamy. Add one whole egg and 2 yolks and the juice of lemon. Sift flour and baking powder; add butter mix. Roll between two pieces of wax paper quite thin. Stamp out shapes. Mix a little cold water with egg whites and blend with fork. Brush on cookies. Decorate cookies with nuts colored sugar etc. Bake approximately 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Breaded Herbed Fish Fillets
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients. Coat fillets with cooking spray; dredge in breadcrumb mixture. Place fillets on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray; bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve immediately. Yields 4 servings.

title: Cheese And Bacon Puffs
instructions: Pat rounded teaspoonful of filling on crackers. Sprinkle with paprika. Broil under broiler until bubbly and lightly brown. Serve at once.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Grease a cookie sheet. Beat egg whites vanilla and salt until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff peaks form. Fold in coconut. Drop from a teaspoon 1 1/2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Makes about 20 to 24.

title: Ham Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling unsalted water until tender. Drain. In a large bowl stir together the soup milk and sour cream. Add celery mushrooms pimiento and parsley. Stir in cooked noodles and ham; turn into a 2 quart casserole. Combine cracker crumbs and melted butter and sprinkle over the casserole. Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Hot Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl.

title: Pork Chops And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops in shortening; remove from skillet and season. Pour off some of the drippings. Add rice green pepper onions chicken broth and thyme; stir. Place pork chops on top. Cover and cook in frypan at 275\u00b0 for 30 minutes or pour into a 3-quart casserole and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Vinegar Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar and flour in saucepan. Pour in water. Stir to thicken over medium heat. Should be like gravy consistency. Stir in vinegar or lemon juice to your own taste. Serve hot over your favorite white or yellow cake.

title: Slow Pokes
instructions: Remove package of chocolate from brownies; dont use. Add water and egg to mix. Arrange 3 pecan halves in Y shape on cookie sheet (ungreased). Drop 1 teaspoon dough on each Y. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook broiler water and salt until tender; cool. Remove skin and bones. Chop. Add rest of ingredients. Mix all together and store in refrigerator.

title: Pecan Cookies
instructions: With electric mixer cream butter and sugars. Beat in egg and extracts. Sift together the flour soda baking powder and salt. Gradually add to mixture. Stir in pecans. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes or until set. Cool for 3 minutes on cookie sheet before removing to rack. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Imperial Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together. Dip chicken pieces in butter then in crumb mixture. Place chicken in foil-lined roasting pan (use a rack if you have one). Dot chicken with extra butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fountain Hills, Arizona Potatoes
instructions: Cover potatoes and onion with water. Cook 5 minutes. Add pimento and cook 1 minute more. Drain and set aside. Melt margarine. Add flour cheese salt and milk. Stir until smooth. Add potatoes to this cheese sauce then pour into a casserole dish. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Mexican Style Chicken
instructions: Blend onion sauteed in margarine with soups and tomatoes as it heats. Add deboned chicken (cut into chunks) and Fritos. Stir until mixture is blended with chips. Pour in baking dish and top with cheese. Heat 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cheese bubbles. Freezes well omitting cheese.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole stir together sugar and syrup. Microwave on High 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts. Microwave on High 3 to 5 minutes until light brown. Add butter and vanilla blending well. Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes. Peanuts will be lightly brown and syrup very hot. Add baking soda and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet and let cool 1/2 to 1 hour. Break into small pieces and store.

title: Lois Ann Beason'S Chicken Breasts In Sour Cream
instructions: Arrange chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and coarse grind pepper. Cover with mushrooms. Combine undiluted soup sherry and sour cream. Stir until blended. Pour over chicken completely covering it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Chicken Cutlets With Spaghetti
instructions: Clean chicken cutlets the day before and season with salt pepper and garlic so that the chicken will soak up the seasonings. The following day crush the potato chips and place them in a bowl. Beat the eggs in another bowl. Dip the chicken cutlets in eggs and then in the potato chip crumbs until they are fully covered. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes then check with a fork to see if done inside. If not let cook a little longer. While chicken is baking cook spaghetti according to directions on package. Heat spaghetti sauce. Combine sauce and spaghetti and serve with chicken cutlets.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix until crumbly the powdered sugar and peanut butter. Put in bottom of baked pie shell saving 2/3 tablespoon of mixture for top of pie. Combine cornstarch sugar milk salt egg yolks butter and vanilla. Cook until thick. Cool some. Pour on top of crumbly mixture in pie shell. Beat egg whites with sugar for meringue. Cover top of pie. Sprinkle reserved crumbly mixture on meringue and brown in oven at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Extra Crispy Onion Rings
instructions: Combine pancake mix and salt; stir in club soda until smooth. Separate onions into rings. Dip a few rings into batter to coat. Drain off excess. Heat oil to 375\u00b0. Fry onion rings a few at a time 2 to 3 minutes turning once. Drain. Season with salt.

title: Basic Waffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook. Makes 6 round waffles. Can be frozen.

title: Baked Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute diced zucchini and chopped onion in butter or margarine for 5 minutes. Combine soup and sour cream; stir in carrots. Fold in zucchini and onion. Combine stuffing and melted butter (1/2 cup). Spread half of this mixture on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon on vegetables; mix lightly. Sprinkle on remaining stuffing mix. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine oil eggs sugar and vanilla. Combine all dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture. Add apples and chopped nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed; drain and put in baking dish. Dot with 1/2 stick butter. Slice Velveeta over broccoli. Top with buttered cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Oriental Cole Slaw
instructions: Dressing Make the night before. Combine oil sugar vinegar and beef packet from Ramen noodles.

title: Rocky Road Pudding
instructions: Combine pudding mix and milk. Beat until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. Chill for 5 minutes. Fold in remaining ingredients. Spoon into dessert cups. Chill. Serves 6.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: In a 30 cup percolator basket place sugars tea and sticks. In the bottom of percolator put juices and water. Perk and enjoy.

title: Scalloped Corn Casserole
instructions: In small bowl combine corn milk onion green pepper salt and pepper. Put 1/2 of corn mixture into quart casserole dish. Layer half the cheese and half the bread crumbs. Layer remaining corn and cheese. Mix remaining crumbs with melted butter and cover corn and cheese with crumb mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken pieces in sugar and soy sauce. Beat eggs with a little milk dip chicken in milk and roll in cornstarch. Fry in oil over low heat. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Place a little water in a pan and place first batch of fried chicken in it. Sprinkle cashews and chopped green onions over chicken. Place in oven to keep warm as chicken fries. Continue layering in this manner.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix lemon Jell-O crushed pineapple bananas and marshmallows. Let stand until firm. Cook sugar pineapple juice flour and egg until thick and cool. Spread over Jell-O mix. Mix Dream Whip and spread.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Spread nuts and coconut on bottom of pan. Mix cake according to directions; pour over nuts and coconut.

title: Cheese Eggs
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet over medium heat. Beat eggs. Add cheese torn in pieces. Add milk salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour into skillet and cook until soft done.

title: Peanut Butter Punch
instructions: Put 2 large spoonfuls of peanut butter in blender with sugar or honey and milk. Mix until all ingredients are blended and pour into cups.

title: Orange Drop Cookies
instructions: Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Frost with orange icing.

title: String Beans And Mushrooms
instructions: Place string beans in boiling salt water. Cook 7 to 8 minutes. Add drained mushrooms 3 minutes before the end of cooking time just long enough to heat them through. Drain beans and mushrooms. Season with additional salt and pepper and a lump of butter if desired.

title: Copper Carrot Pennies
instructions: Boil carrots in salted water until tender. Cool. Drain carrots. Alternate layers of carrots green pepper rings and onion in medium serving dish. Combine remaining ingredients in mixing bowl; beat until well blended. Pour over vegetables. Refrigerate until serving time. This can be made several days ahead. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Mexi Beef Casserole
instructions: Combine ground beef onion and celery in a 2 1/2-quart casserole stirring well. Cover with wax paper and microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until meat is no longer pink stirring every 2 minutes. Drain off drippings. Add beans and next 6 ingredients to meat mixture stirring well. Cover and microwave on High for 4 to 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated stirring after 2 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and chips. Reduce to Medium-high (70% power) and microwave uncovered for 2 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Thaw potatoes for 45 minutes. Combine melted butter with 2 cups crushed cornflakes; set aside half of them for topping. Combine all ingredients and pour into greased 3-quart baking dish. Top with buttered cornflakes. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Combine flour sugar salt and shortening. Add egg and Milnot. blend well. Roll into 6-inch circle crusts and fill with fruit. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in casserole dish and cover with grated cheese and potato chips. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins in the water for 5 minutes; let cool. Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Add dry ingredients to flour then add to creamed mixture. Add raisins nuts and vanilla. Put in refrigerator for 15 minutes. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pull Aparts
instructions: Spray 9-inch round pan with Pam. Open biscuit tube. Place biscuits in 9-inch round pan. Sprinkle grated cheese and bacon bits on biscuit dough. Place in oven and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Baked Beans Extraordinaire
instructions: Fry bacon and pour off fat. Add onion and brown. Add to mixture of beans. Mix syrup catsup and mustard together. Add to beans. Bake for 2 hours at 325\u00b0. Wonderful!

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
instructions: With a fork mix together first four ingredients. In separate cup mix next three ingredients. Combine the two mixtures stirring with fork until all ingredients are moistened then with hands shape into a ball. Chill at least 15 minutes before rolling into shape. Dough can be left in refrigerator up to 3 days or frozen until ready to use. Makes 2 double crusts and 1 shell. This dough is easy to handle.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add taco seasoning tomato paste one can of water (use tomato paste can) and corn. Put in casserole dish and cover with cheese. Prepare cornbread according to directions and pour on top. Bake according to box directions.

title: French Cabbage Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add the rest of ingredients and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Peel eggplant and slice into 1/4-inch slices. Soak in water and then dredge in flour. Let stand 10 minutes. Combine 2 eggs and milk; whip. Dip eggplant into egg and milk mixture and into crumbs. Place oil into skillet heat oil. Fry eggplant on both sides. Place in casserole.

title: Wagon Wheel Drumstick Dinner
instructions: Coat chicken legs with dressing and bread crumbs. Arrange chicken on round microwave-safe plate spoke fashion with meaty portion towards outer edge of plate.

title: Cobbler(Peach, Strawberry, Apple Or Blackberry)
instructions: Cut peaches place in pot with 1/2 cup sugar and bring to boil. Mix 1/2 cup sugar 3/4 cup flour salt and milk. Spray Pyrex with Pam. Dip peaches in bowl. Spoon flour mixture over peaches. Dot with butter sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over top of butter. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts and preserves. Mix well and chill. Mold into ring. Cover with chopped nuts. Fill center with strawberry preserves. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Put 1/2 of potatoes in greased baking dish. Combine salt pepper and flour; sprinkle part of this over potatoes. Dot with butter. Repeat this procedure. Measure soup and add enough milk to make 2 cups. Pour over potatoes. Cover; bake for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake until done. Cheese may be added the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Gingered Lamb Chops
instructions: Broil lamb chops 4 inches from coals about 8 minutes on each side basting with mixture of other ingredients.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and roll into walnut-size balls. Roll into smaller balls if used as cocktail meatballs. Bake on cookie sheet with sides at 450\u00b0. No need to turn balls.

title: Green Tomato Chow-Chow
instructions: Chop vegetables fine. Sprinkle with salt; let stand overnight. Drain. Mix turmeric flour and mustard with enough water to make smooth paste. Let vinegar come to a boil; add mixture. Add all other ingredients including vegetables. Boil for 10 minutes. Seal in jars while hot. Yields 12 pints.

title: Sweet Potato Rings
instructions: Boil and mash sweet potatoes. Blend in well beaten egg yolks melted butter salt and milk. Fold in well beaten egg whites. Butter a ring mold or Bundt pan. Place nut halves around in bottom of pan and sprinkle with brown sugar. Cover with sweet potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn upside-down in large plate. Let stand 5 minutes then remove pan. Fill ring with buttered green peas or green limas.

title: Tortilla Rolls
instructions: Mix cream cheese green chilies black olives and picante sauce. Smooth mixture on tortilla. Roll up tortilla and secure with toothpick. Refrigerate. Cut into 1-inch pieces. Serve with picante sauce. (Great for parties!)

title: No-Fry Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Peel eggplants; cut into 1/2 inch slices. Dip in egg and dredge in matzoh meal. Place in a single layer on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn eggplant slices and bake an additional 15 minutes. Layer 1/3 of eggplant slices in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with 1/3 each of Mozzarella cheese and spaghetti sauce; repeat layers twice. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yields 8 servings.

title: Aunt Rose'S Cherry Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix together flour baking powder sugar and butter with a fork to make coarse crumbs. Set aside 1 cup of crumbs. In a separate bowl mix well the eggs milk and vanilla. Mix in dry crumbs with a fork. Pour into a greased 12 x 18-inch pan. Top with cherries (pie filling) then the reserved cup of crumbs. Sprinkle with cinnamon brown sugar and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Pour on syrup and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Mother'S Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all together and bake in loaf pan for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Freezer Rolls (Little Straight Rolls)
instructions: I halve the amounts and make it in my bread machine on the dough setting.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven 375\u00b0. Butter baking dish. Peel and thinly slice apples. Place apples in baking dish. Pour orange juice over apples. Mix sugar flour cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour mixture over apples. Cut butter into small pieces and scatter over top of apples. Bake for 35 - 45 minutes (uncovered) at 375\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix beef onion bread crumbs egg salt pepper and 1/2 cup ketchup until well blended. Make into loaf; mix and pour remaining ingredients on top of loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (dry mix). Add hot water according to amount of tea needed. Three teaspoons of mix per 1 cup of hot water. Eight scoops of mix for 10-cup coffee pot.

title: Great Chicken
instructions: Mix together and pour over 8 to 10 boneless chicken breasts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve over rice. Sauce will make a nice gravy.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix meal and flour in bowl. Add buttermilk and mix thoroughly. Add beaten egg onion and yeast mixture. Mix good and drop by teaspoon into hot fat. Cook until golden brown. Serve hot with fish and French fries.

title: Three Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cheeses stand at room temperature until softened. Place in mixer bowl with Worcestershire sauce. Beat on medium until well mixed. Roll mixture into a ball; roll in chopped nuts and then chill.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Steam cabbage and saute in margarine. Melt cheese and milk; pour over cabbage. Place bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples sugar and raisins. Let stand 1 hour. Stir often. Sift flour nutmeg cinnamon salt and soda together. Add dry ingredients to apple mixture. Mix by hand. Then add vegetable oil vanilla and egg whites. Mix by hand. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. May be served plain with Cool Whip or frosted as desired. I never had a failure with this recipe. I have used many variations including chocolate chips. It stays moist and freezes well.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Mix sugar (brown) Crisco and butter. Cook until sugar is melted and dissolved. Add 1/4 cup milk and cook for 3 minutes. Take from stove and let cool. Then add enough powdered sugar to spread. Beat until smooth. Add vanilla last and blend into mixture.

title: Keebler Cracker Bars
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with Keebler Club crackers. Melt oleo in pan. Add sugars milk and graham crackers. Boil at least 5 minutes. Spread over Club crackers. Spread another layer of Club crackers over this.

title: Clear-The-Cupboard Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening at medium speed with electric mixer until fluffy. Add sugars beating well. Add eggs beat until blended. Combine flour and next four ingredients; gradually add to sugar mixture beat after each addition. Stir in coconut cereal vanilla and pecans. Drop by tablespoons onto baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 10 minutes or until golden. Yields 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Duncan Hines Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle top with sugar cinnamon and chopped nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for time recommended on cake mix instructions.

title: Chocolate Toffee Trifle
instructions: The night before serving bake cake in a 13 x 9 inch baking pan according to package directions. Cool; cut into 1 inch cubes. Pour pudding mix into a bowl add milk and Kahlua; mix well. Leave Heath bars in wrappers and pound with a hammer to crush. In a very large glass bowl or a trifle bowl layer in order half of cake cubes half of pudding mixture half of whipped topping and half of Heath bars. Repeat layers. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: First tear cake up in small pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread out.

title: Blended Potato Pancakes
instructions: Wash peel and cut up potatoes. Pat dry with paper towel. Put all ingredients into blender container. Cover. Press \chop\ button for 10 seconds. Use spatula to push potatoes down if necessary. Stop motor when using spatula. Spoon batter onto hot greased griddle using about 1/4 cup for each pancake. Brown on one side then turn once to brown other side. Yields 4 servings.

title: Stuffed Squash
instructions: Boil squash in salt water just until tender. Cut in half and dip out the inside. Mix with salt pepper chopped onion and bread crumbs. Might need to use a little Carnation milk or water from boil to mix easier. Stuff mix into squash shells and dab with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Sharp Cheese Sauce
instructions: Blend a little hot sauce with the mustard. Add the mustard mixture and cheese to the remaining hot sauce; stir over low heat until cheese melts. Add and stir in the tarragon. Good on cauliflower asparagus and green beans. Yield 1 1/2 cups.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixer bowl on low speed combine cake mix 1 egg margarine and 2 teaspoons spice until crumbly. Press onto bottom of 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. In large mixer bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in Eagle Brand 2 eggs pumpkin 2 teaspoons spice and salt; mix well. Pour over crust. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until set. Cool. Chill; cut into bars. Store in refrigerator. Makes 48 bars.

title: Quick And Easy Rolls
instructions: Stir until well mixed. Drop by spoonfuls into greased muffin tins filling each cup half full. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until golden brown.

title: Apricot Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Place sliced sweet potatoes in a greased baking dish. Combine the next 5 ingredients. Drain apricots saving 1 cup juice. Combine sugar mixture and juice; cook on medium heat for 3 minutes. Arrange apricot halves on the potatoes and pour sauce over all. Place a pecan half in the center of each apricot half. Drizzle the 2 tablespoons melted butter or oleo on top. Bake 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cocoa Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients in pan and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add oatmeal and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper. Let set until firm.

title: Mendy'S Tomato Pie
instructions: Mix together. Pour into pie shell. Bake 350\u00b0for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and sift dry ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients with dry mixture to sugar and eggs. Pour into a greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: White Cloud Cake
instructions: Cook cake according to directions on box. Cool cake completely. Punch holes (with knife etc.) in cake and pour Eagle Brand milk and creme de coconut over cake. Put Cool Whip and coconut on top of cake.

title: Dreamy Apricot Mold
instructions: Combine gelatin sugar and water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring to dissolve sugar and gelatin. Remove from heat and stir in strained apricots. Set aside to cool.

title: Oven Fried Okra
instructions: After washing cut okra in 1/2-inch pieces. Shake okra and meal together. Place oil in 10-inch skillet (iron) and heat in oven at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Add okra. Bake for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Serve hot. To freeze Cool place in freezer container. To heat place in skillet and bake in 350\u00b0 oven until brown. Stir occasionally.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add tomato paste garlic powder oregano and water. Mix until smooth. Then add eggs; mix well. Add cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese.

title: Artichoke Heart Appetizers
instructions: Unroll dough into rectangles and press into bottom and sides of jelly roll pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread on crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and put into 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake covered 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt margarine with Cheez-Its and spread on top. Bake uncovered 15 minutes more.

title: Macaroni, Ham And Cheese Casserole
instructions: In saucepan bring water and salt to a boil add macaroni and cook until tender. Drain and set aside. Melt butter over moderate heat in small saucepan. Add flour and cook stirring until the mixture froths and foams. Add the milk all at once and stir until thickened. Pour sauce into a large mixing bowl and stir in macaroni diced ham and 1 1/2 cups of the cheese. Pour into prepared casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs remaining cheese and melted butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese peppers pineapple onion and salt. Roll into a ball and roll in chopped pecans. Garnish with peppers or cherries. (If you wish to freeze cover with plastic wrap.) Uncover to thaw on rack so it will not get soggy. Serve on any kind of crackers.

title: Quick And Easy Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in skillet with salt pepper and onion powder. Be sure to remove excess fat. Put cooked beef in a casserole dish. Next layer sliced potatoes (peeled or not thin to medium slices) then layer with veggie of your choice. Top with cream of whatever soup and about 1/2 cup water. Bake in conventional oven until potatoes are soft (about 1 hour) or microwave until potatoes are done (15 minutes). Serve with dinner rolls.

title: No-Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Blend together in large cooking pan the sugar milk butter or margarine and the cocoa. Bring to boil. Take off heat and add vanilla and peanut butter then mix in oatmeal. Using a teaspoon drop spoon-size amounts onto wax paper. Let cool until dull in color and cookies have hardened.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Crush chips in bag. Toss together all ingredients except tortilla chips. Refrigerate. Before serving mix in chips and enough dressing to wet.

title: Cinnamon Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening sour cream sugar eggs and vanilla. Add flour soda baking powder and salt. Spoon cookies onto sheet. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake 8 minutes.

title: Easy Peach Jam
instructions: Mix peaches and sugar thoroughly. Set aside 10 minutes. Stir Sure-Jell with water in saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy about 3 minutes. Pour into plastic containers; cover. Let stand at room temperature 24 hours. Jam is now ready to use. Store in refrigerator or freeze extra containers. Thaw in refrigerator.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine carrot celery and onion; add chicken broth. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until vegetables are done.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Cook celery in chicken broth or a chicken flavored bouillon cube plus 3/4 cup water for 5 minutes. Combine cooked macaroni celery broth celery soup mushrooms chicken or turkey parsley and Worcestershire sauce. Add salt if needed. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread cubes; dot with butter. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Breakfast Dish
instructions: Mix hash browns with 1 beaten egg. Spread into cookie sheet and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Mix 7 eggs and 1/2 c. milk. Microwave for 3 minutes stir microwave 3 minutes more. Add to cooked hash browns. Add shredded cheese. Add ham mushrooms onions green peppers or any other favorite topping. Bake an additional 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar gradually; cream well. Add eggs; beat thoroughly. Add flour baking powder and salt alternately with milk. Add vanilla.

title: Baked Beef Stew
instructions: Brown stew meat in skillet. Combine meat and all other ingredients in a greased 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 3 1/2 hours until vegetables are tender and meat is done.

title: Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients with wire whip or in your blender. This is much cheaper than buying condensed milk. Store in refrigerator. Yields 1 1/3 cups or the same as one can of condensed milk.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
instructions: Place milk eggs flour salt and 2 tablespoons hot fat in blender and blend until smooth. Pour 1 tablespoon fat into a 9-inch pie plate. Pour in batter. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 and continue cooking for another 15 minutes until the pudding is puffed crisp and brown. Cut in wedges and serve immediately with roast beef. Makes 4 servings.

title: Herb Roasted Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In 13 x 9-inch baking pan arrange chicken. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Brush on chicken. Bake uncovered 45 minutes or until chicken is done. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Lamb Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in 3-quart saucepan. Add herbs and celery. Season. Simmer gently for five minutes. Add meat; stir well. Add gravy and stir. Cook for five minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Stew
instructions: Put in casserole. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours.

title: Chicken Noodle (Chicken And Rice) Soup
instructions: In large stockpot heat chicken stock (reference other recipe). Sweat onion celery and carrots. Cut into 1-inch cubes. Add sweated vegetables to chicken stock. Return cooked chicken pieces to the soup. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to simmer. Add noodles (or rice) and cook until tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Combine fruit and 1/2 cup sugar. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and flour. Add milk\tand stir. Add melted margarine to fruit. Add flour mixture. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: English Toffee
instructions: Put sugar and butter in a heavy pan and cook stirring until it turns the color of brown paper bag. Pour on buttered surface and melt chocolate bars on top. Sprinkle on chopped nuts.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a buttered baking dish. Cover with salad dressing; sprinkle with onion soup. Spoon on the preserves. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Breasts Florentine
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions; drain well. Place chicken in saucepan with celery onion salt and 1 cup water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender about 20 minutes. Remove chicken from broth. Strain broth reserving 1 cup. Discard vegetables.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: In large skillet cook potatoes carrots and celery in water with bouillon cubes until tender. Saut onions in butter until soft. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Gradually add milk stirring constantly until desired consistency.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix as usual. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Mix flour 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Coat chicken with flour mixture. Heat oil in 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven until hot. Cook chicken over medium heat until brown on all sides about 15 minutes. Drain fat from skillet. Mix tomatoes tomato sauce mushrooms water olives onions garlic 1 teaspoon salt oregano 1/4 teaspoon pepper and bay leaf. Break up tomatoes with fork. Pour over chicken. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until thickest pieces of chicken are done about 30 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with rotini. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Roll out on cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Potato And Ham Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes until almost done. Add ham and flour. Then add grated or chopped boiled eggs. Salt and pepper to taste. Add water so that it has a good consistency.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Stir in tomato paste onion and seasonings. Mixture will be thick. Cook over low heat 5 minutes stirring frequently. Place biscuits in a greased muffin tin pressing to cover bottom and sides. Spoon about 1/4 cup meat mixture into biscuit lined cups and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Mix apples 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon into bowl. Put into a 9-inch square baking pan. Combine flour 1 cup sugar oleo baking powder and egg into a bowl. Spread on top of apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together. Add to beaten eggs. Add other ingredients. Stir together do not mix with beater. Pour in pie shell and bake in 325\u00b0 oven or 45 minutes.

title: Hot Crab Spread
instructions: Combine cream cheese and milk. Add remaining ingredients. Blend well. Spoon into ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with toasted sliced almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve piping hot with crackers or rye bread.

title: Barbecue Fish
instructions: Mix all ingredients but the fish. Marinate fish for a couple of hours in this mixture. Place fish in grill basket 4 to 6 minutes per side basting once.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix well and put in a 9 or 10-inch pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine eggs milk and oil. Mix dry ingredients together and blend with liquid mixture until smooth. If batter thickens while standing add a little milk. Bake on lightly greased griddle. Bake until bubbles on top break and edges are cooked; turn and bake other side. May add fresh fruit or top with favorite topping.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix together 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup flour and 6 tablespoons margarine to a crumb texture. Set aside. Cream together 1/2 cup margarine and 1 1/2 cups light brown sugar. Add egg. Beat. Add buttermilk and vanilla. Beat. Add 2 cups flour and soda. Beat. Pour in greased and floured pan; top with the reserved crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until center springs back to touch.

title: Chocolate Gobs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order. Beat until smooth. Drop by teaspoon onto buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Cool.

title: Unbelievables
instructions: Mix ingredients and drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Buttercream Icing
instructions: Cream the shortening margarine and vanilla. Add milk and sugar alternately. Blend until smooth.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix baking soda and powder with flour. Add flour alternately with buttermilk then extract. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add all other ingredients except flour. Add 1 cup flour. Mix well. Add remaining flour. Put in warm place and allow to rise 1 hour. Stir down and place in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Let rise 40 minutes. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. While warm brush with melted butter and salt.

title: Grilled Chicken Steaks
instructions: Spread mustard on both sides of chicken; sprinkle with pepper. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours. Melt butter; stir in lemon juice garlic salt and tarragon. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Place chicken on grill. Baste with sauce. Grill 50 to 55 minutes until done turning and basting every 10 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Homemade Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and stir in Sloppy Joe mix. In large pot combine all ingredients. Simmer until done.

title: Chicken Corn Soup
instructions: Bring chicken to a boil and cook until done. Add chicken base (amount depends on how much you need to enrich the stock). Bring to a boil and taste. Add noodles and let them cook until almost done. Add corn and cook until done. Eggs can be large diced and added at the end for a garnish. Enjoy!

title: Oatmeal Applesauce Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine cake mix eggs and margarine. Spread in pan; bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Pour applesauce over cake. Combine oats and brown sugar until crumbly. Sprinkle over applesauce. Return to oven; bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour into a large pan or oblong 14 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish or 2 small ones.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti; while warm cut in cheese. Chop onion fine celery and pepper pimento and tomato; add to spaghetti then seasoning to taste.

title: Fresh Apple Bread
instructions: Cream together 1 cup sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Combine 2 cups flour soda and salt. Combine buttermilk and vanilla. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture. Combine pecans and 1 tablespoon flour. Stir pecans and apples into mixture. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Combine 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tomato And Cabbage Casserole(Serves 8)
instructions: Cook cabbage for 15 minutes; drain well. Combine flour and sugar and add to tomatoes with remainder of ingredients. Bring to boil and stir slightly. Place in casserole in alternate layers (tomatoes last). Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until bubbling about 30 minutes.

title: Bean Pot Applesauce
instructions: Set oven low 250\u00b0. Pare quarter and core the apples. Combine the sugar and cinnamon. Put a layer of apples in the bottom of a bean pot; sprinkle a little of sugar mixture over them. Continue layering apple quarters and sugar mixture. Pour enough cider over the apples to cover them completely. Cover bean pot. Place pot in oven and bake 2 to 3 hours or until apples are tender. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
instructions: Blend oleo brown sugar sugar and pudding. Add eggs and vanilla flavoring; mix well. Add flour and baking soda; blend well. Add chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie #1
instructions: Mix Dream Whip as per instructions on box. Add instant vanilla pudding and peanut butter. Place in pie shell and sprinkle with chopped nuts or chocolate chips. Refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Tiramisu
instructions: In blender puree berries granulated sugar and 2 tablespoons liqueur; reserve 3/4 cup. Pour remainder into pie plate.

title: Glazed Carrots And Apples
instructions: In a 1-quart microwave dish combine apple carrots brown sugar margarine and water. Cover tightly. Microwave on 100% power (High) 7 to 8 minutes or until carrots are tender stirring several times during cooking. Let stand 2 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fluffy White Frosting
instructions: Blend first 6 ingredients in top of double boiler. Cook over rapidly boiling water beating until mixture stands in peaks. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread.

title: Pineapple Cheese Mold
instructions: Mix Jell-O hot water and Pet milk until Jell-O is dissolved. Add other ingredients and put in bowl or pan. Let set. Mix after it has partially set.

title: Salmon Tetrazzini - Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on box. Set oven to 375\u00b0. In butter or margarine in a skillet saute mushrooms and onion until tender. Stir in paprika salt pepper and flour. Slowly mix in milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened and smooth. Remove from heat and stir in light cream. Drain remove skin and bones then flake salmon. In 2-quart casserole mix together noodles mushroom mixture salmon and all but 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese; sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter until tender. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add milk and seasonings. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Blend half of sauce with the chicken and the other half with the cooked spaghetti. Bank spaghetti on bottom and around edges of shallow greased baking dish. Pour chicken mixture into center. Sprinkle with cheese. Brown under broiler or in hot oven. Makes 4-6 servings.

title: Meat Ball Soup
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. Shape into 18 meat balls. In saucepan brown meat balls; cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Pour off fat. Stir in soup and water. Heat; stir now and then. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Peel and mash potatoes. While potatoes are still hot add other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until set and browned. Recipe can be doubled for 2 pies.

title: Aunt Rose'S Cookie Sheet Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients (except sugar). Work butter into flour mixture. Add sugar mix in. Put yolks into sour cream and beat well. Mix into flour mixture. Knead dough until smooth. Roll 2/3 dough on floured surface. Put into cookie sheet (one with 3/4 to 1 inch edge works best). Spread with pie filling. Roll rest for top crust. Cut for lattice top. Brush crust with egg whites. Bake in oven till golden.

title: Chile Verde(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Cut pork and beef into 1-inch cubes. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot; stir thoroughly. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours. Before serving taste for seasoning; add salt and cumin as needed. Makes 6 to 8 servings (about 3 quarts).

title: Pickle Relish
instructions: Chop cucumbers onions and pepper. Drain all the juice that you can then sprinkle turmeric over all this. Set aside 10 to 15 minutes. Mix vinegar sugar celery and mustard seed. Cook until boiling then pour over cucumber mixture. Cook 1 hour. Put in jars and seal. Cook on high until starts to boil then turn down to 3 stirring every now and then.

title: Savory Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Finely chop 1/4 cup stems. Cook and stir chopped stems onion and pepper in margarine in skillet over medium heat until tender. Remove from heat; stir in crumbs and basil. Spoon crumb mixture loosely into mushroom caps; place on baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Sour Cream Jumbles
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together until creamy. Add egg and beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with sour cream. Add nuts and flavoring. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 40 cookies.

title: Ham Cole Slaw
instructions: Place ham cabbage green pepper and pimento in a serving bowl. Combine seasonings salad oil and vinegar. Just before serving pour on dressing and toss lightly.

title: Corn Dogs Ii
instructions: Combine pancake mix corn meal and salt; mix well. Add milk and mix well. Dip each frankfurter in batter; coat well. Fry in fat heated to 365\u00b0 until golden brown. Turn to brown evenly. Serve immediately. If desired insert popsicle sticks. Makes 10.

title: Perfect Every Time Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and add next 5 ingredients (through paste). Simmer uncovered 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Fill a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with bread slices. Layer sausage and cheese over bread. Beat eggs and add milk. Pour over bread sausage and cheese. Let set in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Good for a ready breakfast for company or Christmas morning.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: In 1-quart casserole dish stir in all ingredients except chow mein noodles. To bake Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle chow mein noodles on top bake another 5 to 8 minutes and serve.

title: Six Weeks Muffins
instructions: Mix Raisin Bran sugar flour and soda in a large bowl. Add mixture of eggs buttermilk and oil; mix well. Store in covered container in refrigerator and use as desired. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full and bake for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Melt shortening over low heat (double boiler is good for this). Take from heat and blend in brown sugar and egg. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Blend with first mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while warm. Serves 16 to 24.

title: Muenster Cheese Batter Pudding
instructions: Beat egg lightly in bowl with a whisk. Add the flour half the milk salt and pepper. Stir in remaining milk. Let batter stand for an hour. Coarsely grate the cheese and stir half of it into the batter. Grease an 8-inch Pyrex pie plate; pour the batter into it and bake in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until puffed and brown. Scatter remaining cheese on top and bake just until it is melted. Cut into 24 narrow wedges.

title: Mississippi Mud Bars
instructions: Mix well oleo 1/3 cup cocoa eggs sugar and flour. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook 30 minutes or until done. While hot spread with marshmallow cream. Ice with the following immediately confectioners sugar margarine vanilla cocoa and Pet milk. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Oatmeal Zucchini Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease bottoms only of two 8 x 4-inch loaf pans. Beat together sugar eggs oil and vanilla. In separate bowl combine flour oats baking powder spices and salt slowly add combined ingredients to wet mixture. Mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in zucchini and nuts. Spoon batter into prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes on wire rack remove from pans. Cool thoroughly before slicing. Makes two 8 x 4-inch loaves.

title: Buttercake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar. Add all other ingredients. Pour into a greased Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Evergreen Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water. Add the Kool-Aid mix pineapple juice and ginger ale. Chill and serve over ice.

title: Hobo Potatoes(Pineliner'S Version)
instructions: Mix all together and bake in a covered dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or wrap in aluminum foil and place on outdoor grill under rack next to the charcoal for about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix dry cake mix softened butter and 3 eggs until moist. Pour into greased and floured cake pan.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Put all ingredients in saucepan. Cook until soft ball stage. Take off stove and add 1 cup crunchy peanut butter (optional smooth peanut butter). Beat until it loses its gloss. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Potato Filling For 12
instructions: Chop celery and onions fine; simmer in butter until soft. Beat eggs. Mix all ingredients together. Salt and pepper to suit taste. (Mash potatoes with milk.) Heat on stove top stirring constantly until desired consistency or bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Dilly Roast
instructions: Brown roast in small amount of oil over high heat. Place roast in Dutch oven over low heat. Mix remaining ingredients together. Pile sour cream mixture on top of roast. Simmer slowly 2 1/2 to 3 hours basting frequently with gravy.

title: Cream Cheese Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Mix until well blended. Add egg and mix well. Spread over bottom of pastry shell. Combine rest of ingredients and fill shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool. Brush with maple syrup and garnish with whipped cream and nuts (if desired).

title: Pecan-Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat sugar butter (must be very soft but not melted) eggs and almond extract on low just until mixed. Beat on high speed for 5 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. In a separate bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. On low speed add flour mixture alternately with milk mixing just until blended. Fold in chocolate chips. Sprinkle pecans in the bottom of a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Carefully pour batter over pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool 20 minutes in pan before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Artichokes And Mushrooms
instructions: Drain artichokes. Cut into halves and place in bowl. Saute mushrooms in butter for about 10 minutes. Drain and add to artichokes. Pour sour cream into skillet with butter and blend well. Add Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper to taste. Add parsley. Pour over artichokes and mushrooms. Top with bread crumbs and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour or until bubbly.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all together then chill. Roll into small balls and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Kid'S Kookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except flour and nuts. Add flour and nuts; mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes a soft cookie and very tasty!

title: Pick A-Peck-A-Cake
instructions: Beat well and bake in 3 well floured cake pans at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Italian Pizza Topping
instructions: In skillet cook sausage and onion until meat is browned. Drain off fat. Stir in tomato sauce basil oregano and salt. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes. Spread desired pizza crusts with meat mixture. Top with shredded cheese. Bake as directed in crust recipe. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup snipped parsley if desired.

title: Artichoke Pie
instructions: In a frying pan add oil and garlic and cook artichoke hearts until brown. Set aside. Beat eggs with Prosciutto Mozzarella and grated cheese. Add artichokes and pour into pie shell. Cover top with the other pie shell and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add dry ingredients and beaten eggs. Add mashed bananas and nuts. Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
instructions: Measure sifted flour and sift together with sugar. Set aside. Stir baking soda into buttermilk in cup and set aside. In a 2-quart saucepan melt the margarine and stir in cocoa and water. Stirring constantly bring to a boil and remove from stove. Add sugar/flour mixture gradually with spoon. (You will not need electric mixer.) Stir in buttermilk mixture and then add eggs and vanilla beating well. Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean. While cake is baking prepare frosting.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix these ingredients together. Then make a sauce.

title: Easy Cottage Cheese Loaf
instructions: Mix well and turn into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Herbed Green Beans
instructions: Cut beans into 1-inch pieces. Cook for 20 to 30 minutes on medium-high in salted water. In frying pan saute onion celery pepper and garlic in butter until tender. Drain beans. In large bowl add beans other vegetables and basil and stir. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Mix together soup flour milk and onion. Pour over potatoes and cabbage. Place browned pork chops on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Bring to boil the 4 cups water. Add sugar then cool. Bring to boil 5 cups water. Add coffee. Mix both together. Add vanilla. Add Everclear. Bottle. Makes about 1 gallon.

title: Marinated Beef Steak
instructions: Combine onions parsley vinegar oil mustard garlic and thyme. Place beef chuck shoulder steak in plastic bag. Add marinade spreading evenly over both sides. Close bag securely and marinate in refrigerator for 6 to 8 hours turning at least once. Pour off marinade. Discard. Place steak on rack in broiler pan so surface of meat is 3 to 4-inches from heat. Broil 18 minutes to desired doneness turning once. Carve into thin slices to serve. Yield 4 servings.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Generously grease and lightly flour two 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Beat eggs until frothy. Stir in sugar oil zucchini and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients until well mixed. Pour batter into loaf pans. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan; turn out onto wire rack to cool thoroughly before slicing. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Put cooked rice in baking dish. Add onion which has been fried in oil. Mix broccoli cheese soup and milk. Season to taste. Pour over rice. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Mushroom Appetizers
instructions: In a small skillet saute onion in butter until tender. Remove from heat and stir in shrimp 3 tablespoons each Parmesan and crumbs 2 tablespoons sherry the parsley and salt. Stuff mushroom caps with shrimp mixture.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate with margarine in small pan. Remove from heat and add milk. Separately combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually add to chocolate mixture. Stir in coconut and pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool for several hours.

title: Chicken Gravy
instructions: Strain broth in which chicken was stewed. Measure 1 quart broth into a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Combine flour and water; stir in some of the hot broth. Cook until thickened 15 to 20 minutes. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Corn Bread
instructions: Cook sausage and onion until brown. Drain and set aside. Combine cornmeal and other dry ingredients. Beat eggs buttermilk and oil together. Combine this with dry ingredients (batter will not be smooth). Add sausage onion pepper corn cheese and peas. Put in a loaf pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes until done. (If you use a cornmeal mix you can eliminate the salt and baking soda.)

title: Barbecued Hot Dogs
instructions: Put all ingredients except hot dogs in skillet; bring to a boil. Add hot dogs and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken With Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees. Place chicken breast in 9x13 inch pan sprayed with Pam. Slice potatoes 3/8 inch thick and place in pan. Place sliced onion rings on chicken. Sprinkle liberally with Tony Chacheres. Pour Italian dressing over all. Cover with foil and bake at 475 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add tomato soup water seasoning corn and green pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Date Pinwheel Cookies
instructions: Cut up dates. Add sugar and water. Cook over low heat until it boils. Add pecans. Cool.

title: Chess Cookies
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and eggs in pan. Spread over pan. Slightly beat the other 2 eggs. Beat cheese eggs and sugar until smooth. Pour over cake dough. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: In Pyrex dish (Pam spray) put rolls in bottom and push dough up the sides. Put sausage over dough then add cheese on top of sausage. Pour beaten eggs over top. Brown; do not overcook. Bake at 350\u00b0 20 to 30 minutes. Can be prepared day before you are going to serve. Dont cook until you are ready to serve.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes. Brown and drain seasoned ground beef. Cut baked potatoes in half lengthwise. Remove the potato from the skin leaving skin whole. Mix potato butter 3/4 cup of cheese salt and pepper. Mix well. Using a spoon put potato mixture back in skin leaving a hollow place in center. Fill with browned beef. Top with remaining cheese. Heat in oven or microwave just long enough to melt cheese on top.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with coconut milk and vanilla. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool cake completely and split cake layers. Spread Sour Cream Coconut Filling between layers and on top of cake.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Cook rice according to directions. Cook peas until heated through; stir together. Add handful of bacon bits and serve warm.

title: Candy Brittle
instructions: Cook corn syrup sugar and water until hard crackle stage. Remove from fire add salt and vanilla (if nuts are unsalted add 1 1/2 teaspoons salt). Stir ingredients and add nuts. Stir until all nuts are coated with candy nuts. Pour on greased cookie sheet and press thin as possible with 2 greased spoons. Cool and break into small pieces. Store in airtight container. Do not refrigerate.

title: Chicken Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together the chicken onion salt pepper milk cream cheese margarine and croutons. Flatten each triangle; fill with chicken mixture. Wrap crescent roll around filling. Bake on cookie sheet for 20 minutes.

title: Cream Of Crab Soup
instructions: Melt butter in heavy pan over low heat. Add onion and cook until tender stirring occasionally. Add flour and stir. Whisk in clam juice. Increase heat and bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Add half and half and return to a boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Add 3/4 pound of crab meat wine and seasoning. Simmer about 3 minutes.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt in a large mixing bowl. Combine oil and milk. Add to dry ingredients all at once stirring until the dough clings together. Knead lightly on a floured surface 8 times. Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut into rounds with floured 2-inch cutter. Place close together on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: American Lasagne
instructions: Brown beef and garlic in oil. Add then cover and simmer 20 minutes the tomato paste tomatoes salt pepper and oregano. Cook noodles according to directions on package. In an 11 x 7-inch dish alternate layers of noodles meat sauce 12 ounces cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. End with Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Spareribs
instructions: Blend all and pour over raw spareribs. Let sit for awhile. Cook on barbecue over medium heat.

title: Cheesy Pork Chops And Potatoes
instructions: One small head fresh broccoli (about 1/2 pound) may be substituted for frozen spears. Divide into spears and cook 3 to 4 minutes before using.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook and drain first 3 ingredients then add next 8 ingredients and simmer for 1 hour on low. Mix cottage cheese and 1 egg together. Then layer noodles sauce and cottage cheese. Layer again. Cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes. In a large saucepan combine water beef and chicken broth undrained tomatoes onion and green pepper. Bring to boiling. Add chicken; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add corn chili powder cumin and pepper. Simmer covered 10 minutes more. To serve place crushed chips in each bowl and ladle soup over the chips. Top with cheese.

title: Caramels
instructions: Put sugar salt and corn syrup into a large pan; bring to a boil and boil to firm ball stage 245\u00b0 stirring occasionally. Gradually add milk and butter slowly so that the mixture does not stop boiling at any time. Continue to cook rapidly stirring constantly to medium ball stage 242\u00b0. Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts. Stir well.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: First layer Mix flour pecans and margarine and put in a 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 350 degree oven until light brown.

title: Impossible Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pie plate 9 x 1 1/4-inches. Beat all ingredients until smooth 30 seconds in blender on high or one minute with hand beater. Pour into pie plate. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean about 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Serve with mixed fruit if desired.

title: Zucchini And Red Peppers
instructions: Scrub and trim zucchini. Grate them by hand or in a processor; toss in a bowl with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and let sit 20 minutes. Squeeze out moisture.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all together and chill. Serve with Fritos. Can be doubled tripled etc.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Beat egg whites in small mixer bowl on high speed until stiff. Beat egg yolks on high speed for 1 minute. Add corn salt pepper and flour. Beat on low speed until blended. Add beaten whites; fold in on lowest speed. Add oil in frypan. When hot drop the batter by spoonfuls. Fry both sides until brown. Serve hot with syrup.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour pan(s). Cream butter sugar and eggs using a mixer. Add remaining ingredients and mix on low until blended. Turn into pan(s) and bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean about 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes. Makes one 9 x 5-inch loaf or two 5 5/8 x 3 1/8-inch loaves.

title: Beefy Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Combine corn meal flour milk eggs salt soda corn and jalapeno peppers in a bowl; mix and set aside. Saute ground beef onion and bell pepper until lightly browned; drain thoroughly and set aside. Thoroughly grease a 10 1/2-inch iron skillet. Pour half of corn meal batter into skillet. Sprinkle evenly with beef mixture then cheese. Pour remaining batter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Frosty Fruit Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine sugar salt buttermilk and vanilla until well mixed. Gently stir in drained fruits. Pour into a 9-inch square pan. Freeze until firm. Cut into squares to serve. Store in freezer.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Mix all together. Cook in crock-pot for 8 hours with lid off.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: In a large bowl mix cottage cheese and eggs. Add spinach Cheddar cheese mushrooms salt and nutmeg. Cover and chill overnight. (If you wish you can bake and serve the same day.) Next day spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set about 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Beef Bake
instructions: Cook beef; stir in chili powder. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in taco sauce green chilies and salt. Combine corn and 1/2 of scallions. Layer 1/2 corn mixture 1/2 beef 1/2 olives and 1/2 cheese. Repeat layers. Bake covered in a 2-quart casserole for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Top with crushed tortillas sour cream and remaining scallions.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain off grease. Add oleo onion pepper mushroom and tomato soups. Simmer 45 minutes and stir often.

title: Cinnamon Chunk Pickles
instructions: Wash and chop 50 to 60 pickling cucumbers into 1/4 to 3/4 in slices and put into a 5 gallon stone jar. Mix 2 cups pickling salt to 1 gallon boiling water and pour over cucumbers. Cucumbers must be submerged. Make more mixture until cucumbers are covered. An upside down plate helps to keep them covered. Let stand for 7 complete days.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil bone and cut chicken into pieces. Saute onion and bell pepper in oleo. Heat soups chili seasoning Ro-Tel tomatoes and chicken broth. Add sauteed onion and bell pepper. Grease with oleo large pan small roaster or 9 x 13 1/2 x 2-inch Pyrex. Soak tortillas in small amount of broth. Tear into sixths or eighths. Put layer of tortillas layer of chicken soup mix grated cheese and repeat another time with cheese on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cover casserole with foil.

title: Asparagus Wrapped In Prosciutto
instructions: Wrap each spear of asparagus with a slice of Prosciutto from stem to just below the tip. Divide among four plates and set aside.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry. Sprinkle bacon cheese and onion in pastry-lined pan. Beat eggs slightly and beat in remaining ingredients. Pour in pie pan. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Broccoli-Rice Dish
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Cook and drain broccoli. Cook rice. Combine broccoli with soup cheese rice onion and celery. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Stuffed Rice Balls
