instructions: Add all ingredients to beaten eggs except pecans and mix well. Add pecans and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for about 40 more minutes.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Soak beans in 4 cups water overnight. Heat beans to boiling in same water; cover and simmer until tender 1 to 2 hours. Drain beans reserving liquid.

title: Sweet And Sour Red Cabbage
instructions: In medium saucepan combine all ingredients. Simmer covered about 1 hour stirring occasionally. Serves 5 to 6 persons.

title: Greek Spaghetti
instructions: Meat Sauce Thin tomato paste with water. Brown ground beef and onion in butter about 10 minutes. Add tomato paste cinnamon and garlic. Salt and pepper to taste. Add 1 cup of water and cook over low heat for 45 minutes until sauce is thick.

title: Garden Bean Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix beans celery green pepper pimientos and green onions; set aside. In saucepan put vinegar sugar water and salt; boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and immediately pour over vegetables. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Saute vegetables in butter until soft; adding Tony Chacheres seasoning. Add crawfish and cook over medium heat 2 to 4 minutes. Add 6 cans of soup and lower heat to low. Do not add water and dont bring to a boiling state. Serve over white rice.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients and chill. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese chopped tomatoes green pepper black olives and onions. Serve with taco chips.

title: Easy Strawberry Mousse
instructions: Pour boiling water into blender. Add gelatin and blend at low speed until dissolved (about 30 seconds). Add ice cubes and stir until ice is partially melted. Add the Cool Whip. Blend at high speed for 30 seconds or until smooth. Pour into individual glasses. Chill until set at least 30 minutes. Garnish with strawberries. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Mac Sausage And Broccoli Bake
instructions: Prepare Kraft dinner as on package. Cut broccoli into 1-inch pieces. Add ingredients to dinner and mix well. Spoon mixture into 2-quart casserole and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. (Make ahead as directed except for baking.)

title: Mother'S Fudge
instructions: Mix together cocoa and sugar. Add milk Karo and vinegar. Cook until candy reaches soft ball stage (234\u00b0 on candy thermometer). Add margarine and vanilla. After cooling beat with spoon until fudge loses its gloss. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Bierocks(German Dish)
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add all other ingredients except cheese and cook until cabbage is done. Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Press middle perforation together. Spoon 1/2 c. meat mixture onto one half of each rectangle. Add cheese (optional). Fold dough in half covering the filling and seal the side. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cut up cauliflower and cook until soft. Add rest of ingredients to the cauliflower and bring to a boil.

title: German Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Line bottom of pan with wax paper. Set aside. Place chocolate in top of a double boiler; bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cook until chocolate melts. Let cool. Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs and yolk one at a time beating well after each addition. Add chocolate mixing well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients; add flour mixture to chocolate mixture alternately with milk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Pour batter into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes; remove from pan and let cool on a wire rack. Pour Sweet Chocolate Glaze over top of cake.

title: Graham Bars
instructions: Spread in a well-greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Basil And Potato Soup
instructions: Cook onion and mushrooms in hot oil over medium-high heat until onion is tender and light brown. Add potatoes beef broth and chicken broth; bring to boil. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Peel and core apples. Cut each apple into 6 pieces. Microwave apples until tender about 3 minutes. Roll each apple slice in one crescent roll. Place in a 9 x 16 baking dish. Melt butter and mix in sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Spread the butter and sugar mixture over each roll. Gently pour Sprite over each roll careful not to remove sugar mixture. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Mushroom Salad
instructions: Mix mushrooms cheese and green onion together. Then mix the oil vinegar and Cavenders Greek seasoning for dressing. After mixing well pour over mushroom mixture. Serves 10.

title: Chocoholics' Cheesecake Muffins
instructions: In a small bowl beat cream cheese and 2 tablespoons of sugar until light and fluffy. Set aside.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix oatmeal oleo and boiling water; set aside for 20 minutes. Mix flour salt baking soda nutmeg and cinnamon. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Add mashed bananas alternately with flour soda and salt. Add nuts. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add to other ingredients and mix in a big casserole dish. Top with grated cheese.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Pie
instructions: Whip cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Prepare whipped topping as directed on package. Fold topping into peanut butter mixture. Pour into baked pie shell. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts. Chill until firm. Makes one 8-inch pie.

title: Cabbage Noodles
instructions: While cooking noodles in Dutch oven cut up cabbage and onion. When noodles are done and drained put butter bacon grease and/or bacon in bottom of pan. Add cabbage and onion. Cover and cook on low heat until cabbage is transparent. When cabbage is done mix in noodles and heat through.

title: Pinto Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion together. Add tomatoes beans and water. Cook for 20 minutes. Put in casserole dish. Mix muffin or cornbread following directions on box. Put on top of casserole. Cook in oven until cornbread is brown.

title: Raspberry Bars
instructions: Put first 5 ingredients into a mixing bowl and mix well. Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan. Take 4 cups of the mix and press into the pan. Spread the raspberry jam over the mix and then sprinkle the rest of the mix on top of the jam. Press lightly into jam.

title: Sara'S Great Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour in a Keebler graham cracker pie shell. Decorate with a blob of Cool Whip when being served.

title: Sweetheart Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Wendy'S Chili
instructions: Blend the French onion soup in blender on high for about 5 seconds. Pour over ground beef in skillet. Cook until done. Mix all ingredients including ground beef in a big pan. Cook on low for about 25 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Muffins
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mix flour brown sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon. Mix together egg ice cream and oil. Stir this into dry ingredients just until moistened. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven about 18 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Beef Patties
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup soup with remaining ingredients except water. Mix good; shape into 6 patties. Place in dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Drain off fat. Combine rest of soup and water. Pour over patties. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Seven-Up Salad(Serves 10 To 12)
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve 1 cup of juice. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add Seven-Up crushed pineapple marshmallows and banana slices. Refrigerate until firm. Make a custard by cooking the butter flour eggs sugar and 1 cup of pineapple juice until very thick. When cool fold in whipped cream and spread over salad. Sprinkle top with grated cheeses.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use 1/3 cup to 1 cup hot water.

title: Mud Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a round 8-inch pan or pie plate with shortening. Mix sugar margarine vanilla salt flour eggs and cocoa in a medium bowl with wooden spoon. Stir in nuts. Pour into pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted comes out clean about 25 minutes. Immediately prick holes in pie with pick; spread fudge sauce over top. Cool completely. Beat the whipping cream and powdered sugar in a small bowl until stiff. Drizzle fudge sauce on top. Store in refrigerator.

title: Annette'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Combine all ingredients. Simmer for a couple of hours.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix with mixer and pour into casserole dish.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Pasta
instructions: In a 10 inch skillet over medium heat in hot oil cook zucchini with garlic until tender-crisp.

title: Mrs. See'S Fudge
instructions: Into large mixing bowl add margarine nuts vanilla chocolate chips and marshmallow cream. Set aside. Make syrup of sugar and evaporated milk. Mix over medium heat and stir constantly. Bring to a boil. Boil exactly 12 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt butter in 2-quart saucepan. Stir in sugar syrup and salt. Bring to boil for 5 minutes; stir constantly. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and soda. Stir briskly so that soda can foam. Stir over popcorn in large container. Then spread out on 2 cookie sheets. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn every 15 minutes. Remove and cool. Break apart and place in airtight container.

title: Berry Red Punch
instructions: In punch bowl mix the lemonade diluted according to directions. Mix in partially thawed strawberries.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies (reserve one for top). Pack bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch with half of cookies; press firmly. Beat cheese and sugar until creamy. Add milk and vanilla. Add the 2 boxes of pudding; beat until thick. Pour over cookies then add other half of cookies on top. Spread Cool Whip on top. Grate cookies on top for dirt effect. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms and cut stems off; fill with cream cheese filling and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Pies
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding by directions on box and add 1/2 of the Cool Whip and milk. Mix well. Alternate mixture with bananas and wafers in glass bowl. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Chill well. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil on high stirring constantly until butter is melted. Remove from heat and gradually add hot syrup to beaten eggs stirring constantly. Add pecans and cool until lukewarm. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Sift flour baking powder and soda together. Cut in shortening. Stir in yeast mixture and buttermilk. Roll out on floured board. Cut into biscuits and allow to rise. Brush with melted butter. Bake for 10 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Yields 4 dozen biscuits.

title: Punch
instructions: Make Kool-Aid\taccording to color desired and chill. Mix other ingredients\tat time of use. For added flavor and beauty use 1/2 gallon pineapple sherbet softened slightly pouring the ginger ale over it last in the punch bowl.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Combine soda and salt and stir together with flour and cocoa. Add to butter mixture. Stir in chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or just until set. Leave a few (2 to 3) minutes to cool before removing from pan.

title: Glaze For Ham
instructions: Mix together and spoon over ham the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Cottage Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and eggs until fluffy. Sift flour and baking powder together and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Pour into greased square baking pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until done. Serve cake squares with warm sauce spooned on top.

title: Oatmeal Coconut Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars eggs and shortening. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Form into small balls (do not flatten). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. You may use butterscotch or chocolate chips to give a different flavor. Makes 5 dozen or more.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook drain and mash squash. Add soup sour cream and onion to squash. Melt butter in casserole. Add stuffing mix and blend well. Leave half of stuffing in bottom of the dish. Pour squash mixture on top and put rest of stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Watergate Pudding
instructions: First Layer Mix well the flour sugar oleo and pecans in9 x 13-inch pan. Pat flat. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Cool.

title: Tuna Or Chicken Casserole
instructions: Add egg to cooked rice when cool enough. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart round buttered baking dish on the bottom and up sides of 1/2-inch wide rim. Mix Cheddar cheese soup and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in green peas tuna sliced mushrooms and chopped pimiento. Pour into rice shell. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes until hot throughout.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie(Diabetic)
instructions: Mix gelatin with lemon juice and rind. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Beat egg yolks with water salt sweetener and flour until blended; add boiling water. Pour into saucepan; bring to a rapid boil. Stir vigorously as mixture thickens about 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add softened gelatin immediately; stir until blended. Fold beaten egg whites into lemon mixture. Fold in whipped cream and food coloring. Brush 9-inch pie plate with oil. Coat sides and bottom of plate with crumbs. Add lemon mixture. Chill.

title: Krebbles
instructions: Cook until thick about 10 minutes. Pour into loaf pan to shape. Slice and fry in butter. Its good.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Mix all together and pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Manicotti With Cheese Filling
instructions: Cook manicotti according to package directions. Drain. (Cool in single layer on wax paper or aluminum foil to prevent manicotti from sticking together.) Combine cheeses parsley salt and pepper for filling. Spoon into manicotti. Spread thin layer of sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Arrange manicotti in single layer over sauce. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Remove foil. Bake 15 minutes longer. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon and onion until tender not brown. Add water potatoes and corn. Cook slowly until potatoes are tender. Add salt and pepper. Just before serving add evaporated milk and butter.

title: Sara Lee Style Cheesecake
instructions: Mix and press into 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Blend the first 4 ingredients with pastry blender. Place apples in 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 2 hours.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Boil the fryer or breasts; debone and cut it to pieces. Soak tortillas a few seconds in chicken stock until wilty. Layer all ingredients in order listed. Bake in a 9 x 12-inch dish for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Yields 16 to 20 servings.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
instructions: Chop onions. Peel and dice potatoes. Cook onions and potatoes in chicken broth until tender. Puree broth potatoes and onions in blender or food processor until smooth.

title: Red Beef Curry(Low Sodium)
instructions: Brown beef in shortening. Add all seasoning and tomato paste. Stir to blend. Stir in enough water to cover meat (about 1 1/4 cups). Cover and simmer until meat is tender about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove cinnamon stick. Serve over brown rice.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix first five ingredients well. Spread mixture onto flour tortillas and roll them up. Chill. Cut into slices like cinnamon rolls. Great appetizers or party snacks.

title: Plum Dipping Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir just until jam is melted.

title: Christmas Fruit Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs and milk. Fold in soda flour and vanilla. Steam raisins for 15 minutes; add to batter. Mix nuts fruit and coconut with an extra cup of flour; mix in batter. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large soup pot. Simmer for 1 hour or until cabbage is tender. Add other vegetables to suit tastes or to recycle leftovers.

title: Sugared Nuts
instructions: Cook above to soft ball stage. Add 3 cups walnuts after removing from heat. Mix well. Spread quickly on wax paper to separate.

title: Valley Ranch Pinwheels(A Southwest Missouri Delicacy)
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and salad dressing mix. Spread evenly over the tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towels. Sprinkle equal amount of remaining ingredients on top of cream cheese mixture. Roll tortillas tightly (dampen edge to seal and secure it with toothpicks). Chill at least 2 hours. Cut rolls into one-inch pieces. Discard ends. Serve with spiral facing up. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs. Add sour cream; stir in sugar 2 tablespoons of flour vanilla and salt. Mix well. Stir in apples. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Meanwhile combine butter brown sugar and remaining flour. Sprinkle over top of pie. Return to oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until filling is set. Cool completely on a wire rack. Serve or cover and refrigerate. Yields 8 servings.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine egg buttermilk baking mix and cheese in a bowl. Mix well. Pour into 2 small or 1 large greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let cool for several minutes. Cut into slices to but not through bottom. Spread slices apart. Drizzle mixture of melted margarine and garlic salt over and between slices. May wrap in aluminum foil and reheat several times.

title: Herb Bread
instructions: Mix the butter onion parsley basil and lemon juice and spread on the bread slices. Heat on a cookie sheet at 250\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Separate slices before serving.

title: Squash Relish
instructions: Mix in a large container. Simmer for 20 minutes. Put in hot jars and seal. Makes approximately 10 pints.

title: Smothered Pork Chops
instructions: Place chops in baking dish. Do not need to brown them. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chops. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours depending on thickness of chops at 375\u00b0.

title: Artichoke Pickle
instructions: Mix all ingredients except onion in a large pot and bring to a boil. Pack jars with artichokes and pour hot liquid over. Place 2 or 3 onion rings on top of pickle. Seal jars while still hot. You can add 1 hot pepper to each jar if you like them hot.

title: Chinese Chicken-Cabbage Salad
instructions: Preparation takes 30 minutes; prepare at least 1/2 day ahead.

title: Apple Pudding Cake
instructions: Peel apples in thin wedge slices. Grease small pie dish well and flour. Mix all ingredients. Pour in pan. Arrange apple wedges around the top (slightly overlap). Fill in center. Mix 2 tablespoons of sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon; sprinkle over top. Dot generously with margarine or butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Peaches can be substituted for apples.

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening peanut butter sugars and egg thoroughly. Blend all dry ingredients and stir into shortening mixture. Roll dough in 1 1/4-inch balls. Place 3 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Flatten crisscross style with fork dipped in flour. Bake 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Place one layer on top of the other in the order given in a 9 x 13 baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Bavarian
instructions: Pour boiling water over Jell-O to dissolve. Stir in sugar and berries. May use up to one cup of juice from berries. Mix well. Put in refrigerator until mixture is starting to set up. Remove from refrigerator and beat mixture until foamy. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Vanilla Sour Cream Sauce
instructions: Gently combine and chill for 2 hours. Serve with fresh fruits cantaloupe chunks green grapes orange sections banana slices etc.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Mix and let pastry set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Quaker Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in oats. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie. Cool 1 minute. Makes 5 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Cream margarine and powdered sugar.\tAdd vanilla and water. Add flour. Mix well then add nuts. Roll batter into finger shaped dough about 1 1/2-inches long. Bake for about 20 minutes or until\tthey turn lightly brown at 300\u00b0. Cool. While still a little warm roll in powdered sugar.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and egg yolks. (Keep egg whites in a separate bowl for meringue.) Add sweet milk to mixture of flour sugar powder and yolks. Mix until smooth and pour into crusts. Bake at 325\u00b0 until crust and filling are brown.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Pralines
instructions: In a large saucepan mix sugar soda salt and buttermilk. Cook on medium heat until boils. Cook for 5 minutes after starting to boil. Add butter and pecan pieces; cook until soft ball forms. Mixture will be a dark brown color. Let stand for 1 to 2 minutes. Add pecan halves; beat until creamy and thick. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Praline Cheese Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crumbs sugar and margarine; press onto bottom of 9-inch springform pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Reserve 1/4 cup flour to dredge walnuts and raisins. Sift all dry ingredients into large bowl. Make a well in sifted dry ingredients. Add applesauce oil and eggs; mix. Dredge raisins and walnuts with 1/4 cup flour. Add to cake mixture. Bake in well-greased and floured angel food cake pan at 325\u00b0 for first 20 minutes and at 350\u00b0 the last 40 minutes. Let cool in pan before removing.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: May substitute or add other vegetables (carrots celery or zucchini etc.).

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Combine ingredients pat into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk; mix thoroughly. Add margarine; bring to a full boil stirring constantly.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Cream all ingredients. Put in greased dish. Cover with chopped pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. If doubled bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can make in advance. Best served with Triscuits or other snack crackers.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into hot 8-inch cast-iron skillet. Bake 20 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Carolina Peach Pie
instructions: Cut 1/2 cup butter into mixture of 1 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt until crumbly. Pat into 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle peaches with 1/4 cup sugar. Combine 2 tablespoons flour 3/4 cup sugar egg 1/4 teaspoon salt vanilla and sour cream in bowl; mix well. Fold in peaches. Spoon into prepared pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake 20 minutes longer. Sprinkle mixture of remaining 1/3 cup sugar 1/3 cup flour and cinnamon over pie. Bake 10 minutes. Delicious served with peach or pralines and cream ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and water in saucepan. Cook until thick and clear. Add jello powder and mix well. Cool slightly and pour over strawberries. Top with whip cream or ice cream.

title: Scallop Casserole
instructions: Fill a buttered casserole dish with alternate layers of scallops and cornflakes. Dot top layer of cornflakes with butter. Season cream with salt pepper and sherry. Pour slowly over scallops and cornflakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Mix together. Steam 3 hours. Grease 2 coffee cans. Put in a canner with 3 inches of water. Put covers on cans and boil 3 hours.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and chop the onions fine. Mix together remaining ingredients with mixer. Chill several hours and serve with crackers.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Prepare yellow cake mix as directed. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. After cake is baked poke holes in the top with fork and spread pineapple over top. Cool. Add milk to pudding. Beat at low speed until blended. Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture and spread over cooled cake. Refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Combine egg milk and butter. Mix together both mixtures just until moist. Spread in greased 9x9 baking dish.

title: Scallops In Chafing Dish (Or Electric Skillet)
instructions: Heat butter in top of chafing dish over low flame. Add enough scallops to cover bottom of chafing dish; cook until scallops lose their transparency (7 to 8 minutes). Push to side and continue until all scallops are cooked. Sprinkle with salt pepper dash of cayenne and either chives or parsley. Stir in lemon juice or wine. Heat thoroughly. Place top-pan over hot water to keep warm without over cooking scallops. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Grease 2 loaf pans. In a large bowl beat together the sugar oil and eggs. In a separate bowl sift together the flour salt baking soda and cinnamon. Add the dry ingredients to the sugar mixture. Add the vanilla apples and nuts. Pour the batter into the prepared pans. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour baking powder baking soda and 1/4 teaspoon salt.

title: Quick Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top pie crust; crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: With a mixer beat eggs. Fold in flour soda cinnamon walnuts oil and raw carrots. Pour into an ungreased cake pan and bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Pork Chops And Rice For Slow Cooker
instructions: Brown pork chops. Put rice and mushroom slices on each pork chop. Mix rest of ingredients adding a can of water in order to have enough liquid to cover chops. Bring to a boil and then simmer until rice is cooked and pork is well done.

title: Hot Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain and save juice from both cans of pineapple. Mix reserved juice flour and sugar; add to the pineapple and mix. Pour in a medium Pyrex dish. Grate cheese; sprinkle over pineapple. Mix crackers and butter and put on top of the cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Penne With Stir-Fried Beef And Red Bellpepper
instructions: In a bowl whisk together the cornstarch the soy sauce the broth the Scotch the sugar and the sesame oil. In a large heavy skillet or a wok heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil over high heat until it just begins to smoke and in it stir-fry the beef patted dry in 2 batches for 30 seconds or until it is browned but still pink within transferring it with a slotted spoon as it browns to a bowl. In the skillet heat 1 tablespoon of the remaining vegetable oil over moderately high heat until it is hot but not smoking in it stir-fry the bell peppers for 2 minutes or until they are crisp-tender and transfer them to the bowl with the beef. In the remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil stir-fry the garlic and the ginger root over moderately high heat for 30 seconds stir the cornstarch mixture and add it to the skillet. Cook the sauce stirring until it is thickened and stir in the beef mixture the scallions the red pepper flakes and salt to taste. In a kettle of boiling salted water boil the penne until it is al dente drain it well and in a large bowl toss it with the beef mixture. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hamburger Pot Pie
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion until tender. Add salt pepper mixed vegetables milk and tomato soup. Pour all together in a large baking dish. Add cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Place biscuits on top of baked mixture. Bake until brown.

title: Cutout Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla mixing well. Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Roll out and cut in your favorite shapes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes. Cool on racks.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place cut up chicken breast pieces (bite-size) in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix sour cream and undiluted soup together and pour over chicken pieces. Sprinkle crackers on top and pour melted margarine over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Caramel Cake
instructions: Place a rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease cake pan with solid vegetable shortening then dust with flour. Shake out the excess flour. Set the pans aside. Place the cake mix milk melted butter eggs and vanilla extract in a large mixing bowl. Blend with an electric mixer on low speed for 1 minute. Stop the machine and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula. Increase the mixer speed to medium and beat 2 minutes more scraping the sides down again if needed. The batter should look well blended.

title: Breaded Deboned Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken in beaten eggs; add dash of salt and pepper. Dip in Ritz crackers (crumbled) then dip in melted oleo on one side only. Place in pan with butter dipped side up. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (1/2 hour with covered foil and 1/2 hour without covered foil).

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Measure flour and sift 3 times. Measure sugar and sift 3 times. Cream butter well. Add sugar gradually to butter creaming until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour and soda that have been sifted together alternately with sour cream. Use any desired flavoring. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours or 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in a greased and floured tube pan. Cool in pan about 10 minutes. Turn out.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix the vinegar sugar salt and celery seed. Stir well until dissolved. Pour over cucumbers and onions. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain grease. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 1 hour on low.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix water and butter in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish until butter is melted. Stir in stuffing mix and 1/4 cup salsa. Arrange chicken over stuffing. Pour remaining salsa over chicken. Cover dish with foil; bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove foil. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 5 minutes until cheese is melted. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Sift salt baking powder and flour together in a bowl. Cream Crisco and sugar together with mixer. Add eggs one at the time; beat well. Add milk a little at the time with flour mixture and and also cocoa. Add add vanilla. Mix well.

title: Sweet Potatoes Anna
instructions: Toss potatoes with butter sugar and seasonings. Mix well. In foil-lined 9-inch cake pan arrange a layer of potatoes closely overlapping slices. Sprinkle with cheese. Layer remaining potatoes on top. Loosely cover pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until fork-tender. Remove foil and invert onto serving plate. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tona'S Arroz Con Pollo
instructions: Simmer chicken garlic and 1/2 teaspoon of salt in water in large saucepan for 30 minutes. Remove chicken; drain reserving 2 cups stock. Cool chicken to touch. Remove skin and bones. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Cook rice in oil in 10-inch skillet over low heat stirring occasionally until golden brown. Stir in reserved stock chicken picante sauce cumin pepper and remaining 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and continue cooking until most of the liquid is absorbed about 5 minutes. Serve with additional picante sauce. Makes 6 servings.

title: Holiday Mold Salad
instructions: Mix lemon Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Mix in cream cheese. Add crushed pineapple and juice. Pour into favorite mold. Refrigerate 6 to 8 hours or overnight.

title: Mmmate'S Masterpiece Macaroni Salad
instructions: Chop onions. Place onions and whole eggs in boiling water; lower heat to simmer and cook for 20 minutes. Drain eggs and onions being careful not to lose onions. Let eggs cool; peel. Chop whites and mash yolks.

title: Oatmeal Chewies
instructions: Combine the oats and sugar with the oil. Let stand at room temperature for an hour. Add the egg salt vanilla and coconut and combine well. The dough will have a crumbled appearance. Place level tablespoons of the dough on greased cookie sheets and bake in a moderate oven 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove immediately from the cookie sheets. Makes 3 dozen. I always bake this as a bar cookie in a 7 x 11-inch pan.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy Make Dressing
instructions: Bake a cake of cornbread. When cool crumble and mix together with all the soups. Add pepper and sage to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Beat egg yolks well and mix slowly with milk. Combine with dry ingredients in large saucepan. Cook over low heat (or double boiler) stirring constantly. Add margarine and vanilla. Pour over vanilla wafers in large Pyrex bowl after chocolate mixture thickens.

title: Italian Bundles
instructions: Cut each sheet of dough into 4 squares. Layer ingredients in center of each square. Repeat to form second layering. Fold up all sides and use water to stick. Place on baking sheet folded side down. Brush with beaten egg. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Makes 8 bundles approximately 2 per person.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Cook until syrup holds popcorn and nuts together. Pour and pack into tube pan to form cake.

title: Southern Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Grease and flour tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Burgundy-Berried Ham(Microwave Recipe)
instructions: In a 2 cup glass measure combine brown sugar cranberry sauce wine and mustard. Heat uncovered at High for 4 minutes until sugar is melted and mixture blended and heated through stirring after 2 minutes.

title: Sixty Minute Rolls
instructions: In large bowl mix 1 1/2 cups of flour sugar salt and yeast. In saucepan combine milk water and oleo. Heat until very warm. Add to dry ingredients. Add more flour until soft dough; knead in rest and let rise 15 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Banana Split Supreme
instructions: Combine melted margarine and graham cracker crumbs. Pat in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Combine sugar and flour with pineapple. Cook over medium heat until thickened; remove from heat and cool completely. Prepare pudding as directed on box. Layer bananas on graham cracker crust then pudding followed by pineapple mixture coconut and pecans. Cover top with softened Cool Whip. Sprinkle more coconut and pecans on top. Chill to serve.

title: Spicy Lemon Marinade
instructions: Combine ingredients. Use to marinate poultry or veal.

title: Chex Party Mix
instructions: Melt butter stir in Worcestershire sauce and salt. Pour over cereal and mixture. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Spread out to cool.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine flour cocoa and salt. Set aside. Cream sugar and shortening then blend in eggs and vanilla. Mix together cold water and baking soda. To creamed mixture alternately add flour mixture and water mixture beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Sprinkle chocolate chips and chopped nuts over top and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Fix noodles according to package let cool. Mix together onion cucumbers and green pepper. Add mayonnaise. Enjoy!

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix well. Do not add water until ready to cook. Spoon into hot clean oil.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place sliced potatoes and onions in layers. Sprinkle salt pepper parsley and oregano on each layer. Dot with butter. Pour soup and milk over potatoes. Bake in covered casserole dish for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut-Almond Butter Cookies
instructions: In large mixer bowl cream butter or margarine and 1 cup powdered sugar until fluffy. Add coconut and extract. Gradually mix in flour; stir in nuts. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in 325\u00b0 oven for 15 to 17 minutes. Place on rack. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over warm cookies. Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: In mixing bowl mix together the ground beef egg water bread crumbs and onion. Roll into small meatballs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20-25 minutes turning once.

title: Chocolate Clouds(Makes Approximately 30 Cookies.)
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar in large mixing bowl until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar and vanilla beating until stiff peaks hold sugar is dissolved and mixture is glossy. Sift cocoa onto egg white mixture; gently fold just until completely combined. Fold in chocolate chips (or chunks). Drop by heaping tablespoons onto foil covered insulated baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or just until dry. Carefully peel cookies off foil. Cool completely. Store covered at room temperature.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour with 3/4 cup sugar and salt 4 times. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Add remaining sugar 2 tablespoons at a time. Beat well after each addition. Sift 1/4 cup flour mixture by fourths. Turn into 10-inch tube pan. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done. Invert pan on funnel. Cool completely. Remove from pan. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash potatoes. Mix in sugar margarine eggs vanilla and milk. Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Melt margarine and mix in brown sugar flour and pecans. Sprinkle on top of potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs. Sift all dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Stir in oats nuts and raisins. Drop 1 heaping teaspoonful at a time on ungreased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pat'S Chicken
instructions: Defrost spinach and squeeze dry. Spread it in a 9 x 12 oiled pan. Add chicken. Pour soup and mayonnaise over dish. Add seasoned crumbs then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3/4 hour.

title: Aunt Susan'S Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix salad oil and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add to mixture the flour baking powder salt baking soda and cinnamon. Add carrots pineapple and pecans. Blend well. Pour into waxed paper lined pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes for layers or 45 to 50 minutes for loaf. Makes 3 layers or 10 x 13-inch loaf pan cake.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain green beans; mix with soup. Spread in casserole dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with onion rings. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
instructions: Beat the cream cheese until creamy. Beat in sour cream. Add chilies onion and cheese. Mix. Heat the flour tortillas. Spread mixture on the tortillas. Roll up and refrigerate. Slice when chilled and serve with salsa.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes until done. Slice top quarter off. Scoop the insides out. Leave 1/4-inch all the way around. Mash the scooped out potato and the insides of the cap together with butter Velveeta cheese and enough milk to make it creamy. Salt and pepper to taste. Put back in potato peels. Bake to heat through.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix and pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle box of yellow cake mix over this mixture. Top cake with 1 cup of chopped nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes with onion salt and milk in electric skillet. Cook covered with vent closed at simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or until tender. Sprinkle cheese pepper and bread crumbs over top. Continue cooking uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes. Reduce to warm for serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix and serve as dip for fresh fruit.

title: Orange Jello
instructions: Make Jell-O according to package but use 1/2 cup less water. When Jell-O starts to jell add mandarin oranges and whipping cream. Stir until smooth. Add cottage cheese and nuts. Stir and put back into refrigerator until jelled.

title: 7-Up Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with cream cheese. Boil 7-Up; add coconut nuts pineapple and marshmallows.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 1 egg. Spread in pan. Mix cream 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour on top of cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Do not overcook; let top get lightly brown.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple juice and jello to a boil. Take off and let cool. Stir in Cool Whip and four cups buttermilk. Add pineapple and nuts and stir. Let congeal.

title: Quick Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients. Just drop from teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 12 minutes. Cool 1 minute and eat.

title: Apple Butter(Using Apple Pulp)
instructions: Cook apples whole in about 2 cups of water until soft. Press through a sieve or food mill. Measure pulp. Add sugar and spices. Cook pulp until thick enough to round up in a spoon. As pulp thickens stir frequently to prevent sticking. (If too thick add a small amount of water.) Pour into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/4 inch head space. Adjust caps. Process pints and quarts 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Yield about 5 pints. Very good.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Combine milk 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce and soup mix and blend well. Let stand 5 minutes and add beef. Mix well. Shape into balls using 1 teaspoon for each. Broil 5 to 6-inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not turn. Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan. Cook until heated through. Add meatballs and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion until tender. Drain and season with salt pepper and 1 tablespoon of margarine. Stir in chicken soup and sour cream. In a bowl combine 1/2 cup margarine and dressing mix stirring until well blended. Combine one half of dressing mix with squash mixture. Spoon into casserole dish and top with remaining dressing mix. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Combine pineapple cornstarch sugar and salt. Cook until thick and clear stirring constantly. Add butter and lemon juice; pour into pie crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Deer Bologna
instructions: Mix deer and pork meats together. Mix all dry ingredients together then add to meat mixture. Add liquid smoke. Mix well. Roll into loaves and cover. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours. Freeze loaves if not used right away. Unthaw and slice.

title: Angel Custard Royal
instructions: Divide cake into 3 parts. Break into small pieces and line bottom of pan with 1/3 of cake. Combine sugar egg yolks lemon juice and grated peel. Cook over hot water (not boiling) until mixture coats spoon. Remove from fire and add gelatin which has been soaked in cold water. Cool until almost set. Beat egg whites; fold in 1 cup sugar and add food color. Arrange 1/3 cake in pan and alternately cake with custard. Chill overnight. Remove from pan and cover with whipped cream.

title: Icebox Christmas Cookies
instructions: Roll out dough. Sprinkle with fruits and nuts. Then shape into a roll. Refrigerate before baking. (Makes it easy to slice.) Will keep for 2 months. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven as needed 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Peach, Blueberry Or Blackberry Crisp
instructions: Place berries or peaches in long baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar and dot liberally with oleo. Mix flour sugar baking powder and egg until crumbly. Sprinkle evenly over fruit. Bake 45 minutes\tor until brown on top in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Drop Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in butter or margarine. Add milk and stir. Drop onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add strawberries pineapple and bananas to jello. Congeal 1/2 ingredients in dish then spread sour cream add rest of ingredients and congeal.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix zucchini sugar oil eggs and vanilla with a big spoon. Add flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Mix well. Fold in nuts and raisins. Grease and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Divide batter into 2 pans. Bake 70 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes in pan then cool on rack. Freezes well.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper. Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in skillet. Add chicken pieces and cook 5 minutes on one side until golden. Add onion celery garlic and curry powder. Stir well and cook 5 more minutes. Add bay leaf apples and banana and cook 5 more minutes stirring gently. Add chicken broth and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken pieces and stir cream or yogurt into sauce. Return chicken to sauce. Serve with rice.

title: Unexpected Company Casserole
instructions: In casserole dish put a layer of potatoes a layer of ground meat and a sprinkling of onions. Repeat 4 or 5 times. Salt and pepper to taste as you layer. Pour gravy over adding 1/2 can of water. Place in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Bake cake and cut into cubes. Make pudding. In glass bowl layer cake pudding Cool Whip and Skor bars twice. Chill 12 to 24 hours and serve.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer all ingredients in pan as such pineapple pie filling dry cake mix and nuts. Drizzle butter all over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 48 to 53 minutes.

title: Little Hats Cavandele(Curl Noodles)
instructions: Make a well with flour. Add beaten eggs. Add butter gradually. Add enough water to firm dough. Knead until smooth. Pinch off dough with thumb. Boil in salted water until done.

title: Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together in order given. Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Rice Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corn chips. Chill and add corn chips at serving time.

title: Corn Cob Jelly
instructions: Boil broken cobs in water for 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Strain liquid. Add enough water to make 3 cups.\tAdd pectin. Bring to a rolling boil. Add sugar and boil for 2 or 3 minutes. Remove from heat.\tPour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a casserole and bake for 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Brown cubed bread in butter. Mix some of the bread with the pineapple then cover top of pineapple with remainder of bread cubes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In a large oblong pan put chicken broth cream of chicken soup cream of mushroom soup salt and pepper. Stir all ingredients well. Add cubed potatoes onion English peas and corn. Add cubed chicken and mix thoroughly. Cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and cover top of mixture with 20 halves of flaky biscuits. Return to oven and cook until biscuits are done and a golden brown. This will brown in a few minutes as mixture is already hot. Biscuits are broken in halves to cover the top of mixture in pan.

title: Cocoa Syrup(Good On Ice Cream)
instructions: Mix sugar salt and cocoa dry. Add sufficient water to make a paste then remainder of water. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil 3 minutes and add vanilla. Pour at once into a jar. When cool keep in refrigerator.

title: Oatmeal-Carrot Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat margarine or butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds or until softened. Add about half of the flour then the brown sugar sugar egg baking powder vanilla cinnamon baking soda and cloves. Beat until combined scraping the sides of the bowl occasionally. Beat or stir in remaining flour. Stir in oats carrots and raisins if desired. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until the edges are golden. Remove from the baking sheet; cool on a wire rack. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Chocolate And Butterscotch Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt wax then add chips and peanut butter. Then add peanuts. Drop onto wax paper.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Trim any excess fat from ribs. Place in large shallow baking pan so that ribs are in a single layer. Measure seasonings and spices and mix together. Sprinkle generously over ribs on both sides. Slice onion over top and pour tomato sauce over all. Add water and sprinkle sugar over sauce. Bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0) for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until very tender. Baste often and turn ribs several times during cooking. Add more water if necessary but sauce should be thick enough to cling to meat when done.

title: Country Cafe'S Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients with fork. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Angus Barn Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Beat sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time until well incorporated. Sift cake flour and measure. Add baking powder to flour. Alternately add flour and sour cream to sugar and egg mixture. When well mixed add vanilla. Pour mixture into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cajun Breakfast Casserole
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish butter bottom and sides of dish. Layer bottom with 8 slices of bread. Cover bread with drained browned ground sausage. Sprinkle cheddar cheese until sausage is covered. Cover with remaining 8 slices of bread. Mix together in a large bowl beaten eggs and all other ingredients except butter and corn flakes. Pour over top of bread. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve melt butter and pour over top of casserole. Top with cornflakes. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 16.

title: Nuggets
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs. Mix well. Add flour salt baking powder and cinnamon which have been sifted together. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Add nuts and raisins or chopped dates. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Remove to wire rack. Cool and store in tight container.

title: Simple Baked Ham
instructions: Select right size baking pan. Lay aluminum foil in pan and then put ham on top of foil. Put brown sugar and pineapple on top of ham. Wrap the foil around ham. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Pour a little water around ham to prevent burning at bottom if ham starts to burn.

title: Grandma'S Biscuits Supreme
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt cream of tartar and sugar; cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk all at once. Stir only until dough is moist. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Tortilla Chip Dip
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain. Prepare taco mix according to directions on package. Mix in refried beans. Let simmer 15 minutes. Top with cheese sour cream and taco sauce. Dip with chips.

title: Turkish Shish Kebab
instructions: Place lamb in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients and marinate for at least 3 to 4 hours. Cook on skewers over charcoal fire after sprinkling meat lightly with salt.

title: Basic Cream Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in top of double boiler. Stir in cold milk. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Stir a little of the mixture into the egg yolks. Add to remaining mixture. Cook 2 minutes longer stirring constantly. Cool and stir in vanilla. Pour into pie shell and cover with meringue.

title: Corn Casserole(Yield:  6 Servings)
instructions: Melt margarine; stir in flour until smooth. Add half and half and simmer until it thickens. Put drained corn in baking dish. Pour sauce over it. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut beef across grain into thin strips (1/8-inch thick). Combine soy sauce garlic and ginger. Add beef toss and set aside while preparing vegetables. Heat oil in large frypan or wok. Add beef toss until brown. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In a large bowl sift all dry ingredients. Add oil pumpkin and water. Mix well with beater. Add whole eggs one at a time. Beat in each egg. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ranch Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Place in baking dish. Layer butter on potatoes. Then drizzle on dressing and bacon bits and top with cheese. Bake 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Mud Cake
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix all other ingredients together and pour over cake. Work in with marshmallows.

title: Crescent Roll Appetizer
instructions: Blend together mushrooms cream cheese and seasoned salt. Divide crescent rolls into rectangles and spread with mixture. Cut into one-inch strips and roll up. Sprinkle with poppy seed and bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Shrimp Chowder
instructions: Saute celery and onions in margarine. Add cream cheese and milk; stir over low heat until cream cheese is melted. Add remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly stirring occasionally. Makes approximately four 1-cup servings.

title: Christmas Nuts
instructions: Beat egg white with fork until frothy; add in water and beat again. Mix in nuts. On the side mix together sugar salt and cinnamon. Pour over nuts and mix. Place nuts on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Chicken-Cheese Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan cook carrot and onion in butter until tender (not brown). Blend in flour; add milk and broth. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Stir in chicken wine celery seed and Worcestershire sauce. Heat through. Do not boil. Add cheese; stir until melted. Makes 4 servings.

title: Luscious Lime-Berry Parfait
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Beat together cream cheese and sugar. Gradually add gelatin orange juice lime peel and juice to cream cheese mixture beating until smooth. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in whipped cream. Chill until partially thickened. Alternate gelatin mixture and raspberries with syrup in parfait glasses. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease bottom and sides of casserole dish. Layer ingredients as listed. Mix soup and water together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Potato Pancake
instructions: Put 1 tablespoon oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet. Set over medium heat until butter melts. Put potatoes in the skillet. Press them down into an even compact layer. Cook covered for 5 minutes. Uncover turn heat to low and cook for 15 minutes more. Slide the pancake onto a plate. Put 1 tablespoon oil and 1 tablespoon butter into the skillet. When the butter melts put the pancake back into the skillet with the browned side up. Press down to compact the potatoes and cook uncovered for 15 minutes more. Cut into 4 wedges and serve warm.

title: Cheesy Chicken Chowder
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender. Melt butter in Dutch oven over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbly. Gradually stir in vegetable mixture soy sauce cheese and chicken. Cook until cheese melts.

title: Chili Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain off grease. Add rest of ingredients plus 1/2 can of water per can added. Simmer all day.

title: Easy Vegetable-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Slice all vegetables into small pieces. In an oblong casserole arrange slices of vegetables in layers or randomly. Last season with salt and pepper and sprinkle shredded sharp cheese and Monterey Jack cheese on top of vegetables and bake in 350\u00b0 oven until vegetables are tender and cheese is melted about 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Also can dot with butter or margarine. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chuck Wagon Skillet
instructions: Saute onion until tender in butter melted in large roast pan. Add meat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Brown slowly stirring occasionally. Add layers of cheese celery and noodles. Pour stewed tomatoes and tomatoes on top. Cover and heat to steaming. Do not remove. Cover. Turn heat to low and simmer 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Curried Chicken And Rice
instructions: Season chicken with sweet basil salt pepper and curry powder. Saute chicken onion and green pepper together in olive oil (stir-fry). After it starts browning add 1/2 cup water cover and simmer 20 minutes. Wash rice and stir in; let water level with mixture. Cover tight on low fire. Yields 6 servings. Garnish with parsley.

title: Cream Cheese Tortilla
instructions: Mix cream cheese olives and chiles. Spread on the tortillas. Roll up. Let set in refrigerator overnight. Cut in slices.

title: Bryant'S Favorite Meal
instructions: Microwave 2 hot dogs until warm. Cut in bite size pieces. Mix mustard and ketchup together for dipping.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Boil vinegar water and salt. Prick each cucumber; pack in jars. Put 3 nice heads of dill and 1 or 2 cloves of garlic in each jar. Pour boiling solution into each jar. Seal.

title: Special Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients and pour over chickens or same amount of pieces. Cook 1 hour or until done in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Place chicken and all other ingredients in a large casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Melt together the cheese onion soup and sour cream. Stir in with the beans and corn. Put in large casserole dish. Combine the crackers and margarine and sprinkle over top. Cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix well the potatoes flour sugar (1/4 cup with canned sweet potatoes 1/2 cup with fresh sweet potatoes) butter salt and baking soda. Mix in enough buttermilk to form a soft dough. Coat hands with flour and toss dough gently back and forth to get the right consistency. Roll out on floured board to about 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter and bake on lightly greased pan for 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except shrimp with hand mixer. Add diced shrimp. Serve with Bugles.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Garnish with crushed potato chips if desired.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Combine flour cheese margarine and red pepper. Place one pecan half in each pitted date. Mold dough around each date. Place on cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Dissolve yeast in warm water and add to flour mixture. Add buttermilk and mix well. Turn out on a floured board or wax paper. Roll about 1-inch thick. Cut out biscuits. Dip in melted butter and fold over. Bake 15 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Dough can be stored in refrigerator and baked later. They do not have to rise before baking.

title: Pizza Rounds
instructions: Brown and drain meats. Combine meats with cheese until cheese is melted. Add all remaining ingredients except bread and mix until thoroughly mixed. Spread mixture on each slice of bread. Place on cookie sheet and freeze. Transfer when frozen to freezer bags. Use as many as needed. When you bake them bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. May be kept frozen indefinitely.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy. Add sugar very gradually beating constantly until stiff. Fold in crackers then oatmeal then nuts or coconut. Gently stir in vanilla. Pour into a well-greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Top with whipped cream and fresh strawberries. This pie makes its own crust.

title: Vegetable Salad(Very Good)
instructions: Mix pieces of broccoli onions cauliflower cheese and bacon bits in a large salad bowl.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken in seasoned flour. Lightly brown on all sides in butter. Arrange chicken in Dutch oven or small roaster. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Granola
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. In large bowl mix oats seeds wheat germ and flour. In large measuring cup mix honey oil and water; heat in microwave just until warm. Add vanilla to liquid. Mix liquid into bowl with oat mixture. Spread in pan (cookie sheet). Bake 20 minutes or until brown. Add dates and coconut. Store in covered container; if theres any left. Makes 7 cups.

title: Cajun Soup
instructions: Brown ground meat and drain. Add remainder of ingredients with ground meat and enough water to cook. Cook 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Bread
instructions: Fry meat; drain. Set aside. Mix first 6 ingredients. Grease skillet pour in 1/2 of batter. Sprinkle cheese pepper and onions into pan. Pour in remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Cover cucumbers salt and onions with water; soak for 3 hours. Drain and wash thoroughly.

title: Chicken In A Pot
instructions: Put all ingredients into a crock-pot and cook on low 8 hours. Serves 4.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Put in crock-pot. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Molasses Bars
instructions: Mix together flour sugars salt and shortening. Add eggs molasses and soda dissolved in water. Make into rolls 1 inch thick and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Raw Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight the cranberries marshmallows and pineapple. Then add sugar cream and pecans. Combine ingredients and chill until ready to use.

title: Festive Chicken Salad Log
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Stir well. Form mixture into log and roll in pecans.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Fold eggs and cherry pie filling into cake mix. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Rocky Road Ice Cream
instructions: In a large bowl mix coca powder and sugar. Gradually stir in milk. Stir over low heat until sugar and cocoa dissolve. Cool to room temperature. Stir in vanilla salt and whipping cream. Set aside. Shred chocolate with coarse side of grater. Stir shredded chocolate marshmallows and nuts into cocoa mixture. Pour into ice cream cannister. Freeze according to manufacturers directions. Stir marshmallows evenly throughout frozen mixture before ripening.

title: Hawaiian Beans
instructions: Fry hamburger in chunks. Season with salt and pepper. Add S & W beans. Add a little water to thin.

title: Grandma Helen'S Chinese Beef Skillet
instructions: Slice beef in very thin strips (easier when slightly frozen). Preheat frypan on medium heat for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Add oil and stir. Fry\thalf of beef\tuntil brown; remove. Brown remainder in onion and garlic. Return browned beef to pan. Add celery; cover and simmer for 5 minutes then add pea pods and water chestnuts until tender. Transfer meat and vegetables to serving dish. Combine cornstarch with 1/2 cup of water and soy sauce; stir into pan juices. Cook stirring until mixture thickens. Pour over meat and vegetables. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Poor Man'S Lobster
instructions: Add salt seasoning and vinegar to hot water and bring to boil. Add fish and boil 20 minutes. Drain and serve with melted butter.

title: Lela'S Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients. Sprinkle 1 package vanilla instant pudding over this; stir and chill. You may add 3 or 4 bananas before serving (optional).

title: Italian Sausage Soup With Tortellini
instructions: Remove sausage from casing. In a 5-quart Dutch oven brown sausage. Remove sausage from Dutch oven and drain reserving 1 tablespoon drippings. Saute onions and garlic in reserved drippings in Dutch oven until onions are tender. Add beef broth water wine tomatoes carrots basil oregano tomato sauce and sausage. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Skim fat from soup. Stir in zucchini tortellini parsley and green pepper. Simmer covered an additional 35 to 40 minutes or until tortellini are tender. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top of each serving.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix together thoroughly. Make into 8 rolls. Wrap in foil twist and tie ends. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Put in a large pan and boil for 60 minutes at a slow boil. Remove from water unwrap and cool. Rewrap to freeze or refrigerate. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chicken Francaise(Yields 4 Servings)
instructions: Beat approximately 2 to 3 eggs in one bowl and set aside. Fill another bowl with flour. Dip chicken in the flour completely then dip in the egg. Repeat 2xs always end with egg. Set aside chicken on a plate ready for cooking. In a nonstick frypan melt approximately 1/2 stick butter until good and hot. Add chicken and brown both sides. Cook chicken on medium heat for approximately 10 to 15 minutes until done. Dress chicken in frypan with parsley and lemon slices. There should be a lot of butter still in pan. If not add at least another 2 to 3 teaspoons more. Heat pan on medium-high to high for sauteing after chicken is dressed with parsley and lemons. When its good and hot add 1/2 cup of white wine. The white wine will boil and turn the butter and drippings into a sauce. Serve immediately. Enjoy!

title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix together the shortening peanut butter sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Dip a fork in flour and press into the top of the cookie to squash them down and make the traditional mark of peanut butter cookies pressing first one way and then the other. Bake 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Butter Pecan Nut Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread mixture in pan bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow(Party Mix)
instructions: In large bowl with a lid melt chocolate margarine and peanut butter. Pour cereal in the bowl. Stir well with spoon. Pour powdered sugar in with mix. Put the lid on the bowl and shake well. Enjoy!

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour in a 10-inch square pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Robert Redford Dessert
instructions: For crust mix flour pecans and melted butter; spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Celery Casserole
instructions: Place celery water and salt in covered pan. Simmer and cook 10 minutes. Drain and turn into a buttered casserole. Add water chestnuts pimento and soup. Mix gently. Top with bread crumbs and almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Avocado Cocktail Dip
instructions: Halve and peel avocado reserving 1 shell. Cube avocado and put in container of an electric blender. Add lemon juice onion mayonnaise Tabasco and salt. Process until pureed.

title: Chicken Lynn
instructions: Boil chicken until tender; cool and remove meat off bones. Cover bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan with chicken.\tMix sour cream with undiluted chicken soup and spread over chicken.\tCrush crackers and spread on top of casserole. Melt margarine and dribble over crackers. Sprinkle poppy seed over crackers.\tBake in\t350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix and press in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Vegetarian Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until soft. Drain and mash potatoes and mix with yogurt (or 1/4 cup milk) chives and parsley. Set aside.

title: Huckleberry Jam
instructions: Cook huckleberries with water until they start to boil. Add sugar and boil hard for 2 minutes. Add pectin juice of lemon and 2 teaspoons of grated lemon rind. Boil hard for 1 minute more. Remove from heat and pour into 8 (1/2-pint) sterilized jelly glasses. Seal with paraffin.

title: Chicken Milano(Serves 4)
instructions: Prepare rice or orzo as directed. Remove skin and bones from chicken breasts; cut meat into 1 1/2-inch chunks. In 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot butter or oleo cook onion and garlic until onion is tender stirring occasionally. Add chicken chunks; cook until chicken is lightly browned on all sides stirring frequently. Stir in undiluted tomato soup and remaining ingredients. Over high heat heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. To serve spoon chicken over rice or orzo. Contains 460 calories per serving.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli 5 minutes drain well. Combine the next 5 ingredients to make sauce add broccoli. Pour into a greased casserole dish and top with crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Porcupine Bread
instructions: Grease two 8 or 9-inch round cake pans. Measure bread flour and set aside. Combine wheat flour oats yeast sugar and salt in a mixing bowl. In a saucepan heat buttermilk water and oil until 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0. Add to wheat flour mixture. Blend with mixer at low speed until moistened; heat 3 minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in 1 to 2 cups bread flour raisins nuts and sunflower seeds to form a sticky dough. On a floured surface knead 1/4 to 1 cup flour until dough is smooth and elastic (10 minutes). Place in a greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and towel. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size (1 to 1 1/2 hours).

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate chips condensed milk and butter in microwave on High for 3 minutes. Take out and stir. Put in a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Put in refrigerator until hard. Cut into squares.

title: Hamburg Gravy
instructions: Brown hamburg add mushroom soup mix. Pour over potatoes or noodles. Can use deer meat cut up in place of hamburg also.

title: Strawberry Jello
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornmeal flour salt and soda; add buttermilk oil eggs and corn. Beat and mix well. Stir in jalapenos and onions. Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Heat well pour in half of batter; sprinkle with half of cheese repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or untildone.

title: Cherry Cream Crescents
instructions: Separate rolls into 16 triangles. Spread cream cheese onto each one and top with pie filling. Roll up as per directions on container. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pineapple-Cheese Christmas Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together pineapple and cheese; set aside. Mix sugar and flour together. Add to fruit and cheese mixture. Spread mixture in an 8 x 11-inch or 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Spread crushed Ritz crackers over top. Pour melted butter over all. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Let cool and serve. This dish is good hot or cold.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir as butter starts to melt and broccoli thaws.

title: Italian Tomato Dip
instructions: Mix the soup mix with Italian dressing and sour cream. Serve with potato chips or crackers.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: In skillet cook zucchini and onion in butter until tender. Stir in parsley and rest of seasonings. In large bowl blend eggs and cheese; stir into vegetable mixture. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until center comes out clean. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Chop pork chops into cubes and brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Cut up vegetables into cubes. Mix browned pork vegetables mushroom soup and water until well blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat well. Add condensed milk and 1 can of warm water. Mix well. Add other ingredients. Freeze in electric freezer. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Light Caesar Salad
instructions: In small bowl stir together mayonnaise parmesan sugar mustard anchovy paste Worcestershire and garlic. Gradually stir in lemon juice. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. In medium salad bowl toss lettuce with dressing. Sprinkle croutons over top. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mustardy Beef Tenderloin
instructions: In a small bowl stir together 1 tablespoon of the mustard with the olive oil pepper tarragon and salt. Spread mixture over the top and sides of meat. Let stand 15 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate up to 4 hours.

title: After Dinner Mint Pie(A Luxurious Frozen Dessert That'S Quick And Easy.)
instructions: Combine crumbs and margarine; reserve 1/2 cup for topping. Press remaining crumb mixture onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan or pie plate. Chill. Gradually add milk to Marshmallow Creme mixing until well blended. Add extract and food coloring; fold in whipped cream. Pour into pan; freeze until firm. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs or garnish with mint if desired.

title: Salmon Burgers
instructions: Drain salmon remove skin and bones. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Form into four patties. Pan fry in small amount of vegetable oil until browned on both sides.

title: Cooked Ice Cream
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and milk until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until thick. Cool then add one large can Pet milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Finish filling gallon freezer with milk.

title: Mom'S On Strike Casserole
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Add dry egg noodles water and salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce simmer until noodles are done then add vegetable soup. Continue to simmer until done.

title: Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Grease loaf pan and set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl combine butter orange juice and rind dates sugar and egg. In a separate bowl combine remaining ingredients. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and stir just until batter is moist and uniform. Bake 50 minutes or until done.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Pour pineapple into long pan 9 x 12-inch. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pineapple. Cut margarine into pieces over the pineapple and dry cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mrs. Bretel'S Noodle Recipe
instructions: Mix well; roll out and cut as desired.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Combine all ingredients; roll out. Cut in strips both ways and let dry. Put in boiling broth and cook uncovered.

title: Gelatin Finger Paints
instructions: In a saucepan blend cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water. Add the hot water and heat until boiling stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Mix gelatin powder with the remaining 1/4 cup cold water. Add the liquid soap; stir. Add the gelatin-soap mixture to cornstarch mixture; stir. Stir in powdered drink mix. Store in covered jar in refrigerator for 12 hours before using.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix in large saucepan and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup peanut butter and 4 cups uncooked oats. Mix well with spoon. Add 2 teaspoons vanilla. Drop onto wax paper with tablespoon to cool.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute oleo and onions. Add water and noodles; bring to a boil. Add broccoli and garlic powder. Cook until noodles and broccoli are done about 15 minutes. Cool and add milk and cheese. Return to burner and stir until cheese is melted. Cook on low until ready to serve.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger adding onion when about halfway done. Cook until onion is tender. Drain about 1/2 of liquid; add flour salt pepper and garlic powder. Cook for about 3 minutes stirring constantly. Add soups and water. Cook for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Reduce heat and add sour cream; let reheat to serving temperature. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Mexican Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Mix with all ingredients except cheese in casserole dish. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with cheese the last 5 minutes of baking time. Freezes well.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Cook tomatoes onion salt and pepper cayenne and sugar for 15 minutes. Melt butter; blend in flour. Add milk gradually. Gradually add tomato mixture to milk mixture stirring constantly. Serve.

title: Kiwi Fruit Sherbet
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar and water. Bring to a boil; stir until sugar dissolves. Boil covered over medium heat for 5 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff; gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Slowly pour hot syrup into whites; beat constantly until mixture has cooled. Pare and puree kiwi fruit to measure 3/4 cup.
