title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar oleo milk and salt. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil; boil 20 to 25 minutes or until a hard ball forms in cold water (use small coffee cup 1/2 full cold water). When a small ball forms remove from heat and add marshmallow cream and then peanut butter. Beat until it starts getting hard. Pour in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish greased with butter. Cool then put in refrigerator to set for 2 hours.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Chop raw squash (not too small). Cook until well heated through. In separate bowl beat eggs soup milk and grated cheese. Chop onion. Mix well. Stir in squash. Place in well greased casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Cut up margarine on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Spiced Cantaloupe
instructions: Remove the rind and seeds from the melon and cut into 1-inch cubes. In a large saucepan bring the vinegar water sugar cinnamon allspice and cloves to boil. Add the melon to the saucepan and boil for 15 minutes. Remove the melon cubes and continue to simmer the syrup until it starts to thicken about 20 minutes. Put the melon cubes back into the pan and pour the syrup and cubes into glass jars and let cool. Refrigerate until ready to serve. This will keep for 4 weeks in the refrigerator. The spicy flavor will improve with age. Serve with hot bread.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients; simmer until thickened.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Stir cocoa and sugar into Master Mix. Combine milk beaten egg and vanilla. Stir into mix and blend well. Drop by teaspoons on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put pie filling down first and put pineapple on bottom of a 9 x 13 dish or pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top. Pour melted butter on top of cake mix. Mix nuts and coconut together and place on top of butter. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serve from pan.

title: Shrimp Creole Soup
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium-high heat cook celery green onions and garlic in oil until celery is tender stirring often. Stir in soup mix tomatoes with their liquid water bay leaf sugar thyme pepper and hot pepper sauce. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 5 minutes. Stir in shrimp; cover. Simmer 5 minutes more or until shrimp are opaque. Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Creamed Green Beans
instructions: Cook beans according to directions; drain. Add seasonings melted butter and cream cheese. Cover after 5 minutes. Stir with fork and cover again for another 5 minutes.

title: Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Crush crackers. Mix with melted margarine. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix pudding and milk. Fold in softened 1/2 carton ice cream. Pour over crust; chill 1 hour. Top with Cool Whip and crushed candy bar. (Heath bar or Skor bar will work.) Chill several hours.

title: Ambrosia Spread
instructions: Mix all together and serve on date nut bread or banana bread. Delicious appetizer.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil and corn. Add the other ingredients. Put cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Mash squash well. Add onion egg flour meal and salt; mix well. Add 2 tablespoons of oil to frying pan and heat on medium. Drop squash in hot oil with tablespoon. Brown on both sides and drain on paper towel.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each. Mix soda and vanilla with sour cream. Add alternately with flour to the butter/egg mixture. Mix well. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 80 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan for 15 minutes before removing to a rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving (optional).

title: Corned Beef Ball
instructions: Mix together chill and roll in chopped nuts.

title: Easy Key Lime Pie
instructions: In large heat resistant bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in yogurt with wire whisk. Fold in whipped topping with wooden spoon. Spread mixture evenly into ready made pie crust. Refrigerate over night or at least 2 hours. Garnish as desired. Serve 8.

title: Ham And Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cheeses at room temperature or in microwave for 1 to 2 minutes. Blend them together. Add deviled ham and blend. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Form into 1 large ball or 2 smaller balls. Roll in coating of your choice (chopped nuts parsley dry beef). Wrap in plastic wrap. Serve with a variety of crackers. Finished cheese balls freeze well.

title: Cat'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain squash well. Mash with potato masher. Add eggs and blend in rest of ingredients. Pour into a greased baking pan. Cover with cracker crumbs that have been mixed with melted oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Curried Chutney Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mixing well. Pack into a serving dish or shape into a ball and roll in more pecans. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve at room temperature with crackers or garlic bagel crisps. Makes 2 cups.

title: Dynamite Sauce
instructions: Chop all vegetables. Shake in red pepper seed to taste. Cook celery 1/2 hour. Add onions and garlic. Cook 1/2 hour. Add green peppers and salt. Cook 1/2 hour. Keep just enough water so it doesnt catch on bottom of pan. Either can in jars. Makes 8 quarts. Process only long enough to seal jars. If serving all 8 quarts cook and add 3 pounds of hamburg. Serve on hot dog rolls or hamburg buns. Great for family outings. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on this if you like cheese.

title: Pound Cake(Using Confectioners Sugar)
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add flavoring. Add one egg at a time mixing well. Add flour and mix well. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Toti Fields Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit well. Mix milk pudding sour cream and orange juice very well. Add drained fruit (except bananas). Make a day ahead. Add bananas the day you serve salad.

title: Swiss Tuna Grill
instructions: Combine and spread on rye bread that has been buttered on outside. Grill in skillet until cheese melts.

title: Raspberry Shrub
instructions: Mix and cook raspberries sugar and 2 cups water in a saucepan for 10 minutes. Strain and cool. Add lemon juice and 2 quarts water or soda water. Serve with crushed ice.

title: Basic Yellow Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding mix sour cream oil eggs and vanilla all together and beat 4 minutes. Make a mixture of chopped pecans sugar and cinnamon. Pour half of batter in angel food pan; sprinkle half of sugar mixture and swirl in. Add remaining batter and swirl in rest of sugar mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: German Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: All of the above can be brought to a boil to thicken in large skillet. Put on salad of cut potatoes eggs onions and celery.

title: French Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Beat until smooth. Cover and let stand for at least 1/2 hour. Heat oil to 375\u00b0 in a deep fryer. Slice onions into 1/4 to 2/3-inch slices separating into rings. Dip each ring into batter and fry a few at a time until golden. Drain on paper towels and cool; then pack into plastic bags. Freeze immediately.

title: Leek-Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook spinach as directed on package. Squeeze out excess water. Mix with leek soup and sour cream. Put in center of rye bread with bread cubes for dipping.

title: Grandma'S Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve 1/4 cup sugar and the shortening in the potato water; cool to lukewarm. Add yeast salt and beaten egg. Stir in 3 cups flour (not sifted) one cup at a time (so its smooth). Let stand 15 minutes. Put in refrigerator overnight in a bowl covered with wax paper.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Slice carrots and cook until tender. Melt butter; add maple syrup and ginger. Simmer carrots in maple syrup mixture until glazed and hot.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and drain. Drain beans and rise. Add all ingredients to cooked beef and simmer for 30 minutes. Sprinkle top with crushed tortillas and grated cheese.

title: Chocolate Snowballs
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar; beat in egg. Add chocolate and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients and nuts. This will make a stiff dough. Roll dough a rounded teaspoonful at a time into a ball. Place 1-inch apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Baked Deer
instructions: Rub deer well with soda. Rinse well with cold water. Place in\ta deep roasting pan. Mix together first 9 ingredients. Pour over deer; cover\tand bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Uncover and put bacon\ton deer and cook 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 basting several times. Take out bay leaves and skim off grease. Cut up vegetables and place around deer. Add cornstarch to the sauce and cook 45 more minutes or until done.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix sugar salt and cornstarch together in a saucepan. Add hot water switch to hot until steaming; turn to low and cook until thick and clear. Stir constantly 6 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup of this hot mixture into the egg yolks stir this back into pan with the rest of hot mixture. Cook for 6 more minutes on warm stirring constantly. Remove and add lemon juice and lemon rind. Cool pour into cool baked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli eggs celery raisins and bacon. Mix together Miracle Whip sugar and vinegar. Pour over broccoli mixture and refrigerate. Serve chilled.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Chop apples and put in unbaked pie shell. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 until apples are done 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Add sugar and eggs; beat until creamy. Add can cream and vanilla. Beat a little. Finish filling churn with regular milk then add fruit if desired.

title: Cheese Sauted Tomatoes
instructions: Slice tomatoes 1/4 inch thick. Mix crumbs with cheese and basil. Melt butter. Coat slices with crumbs saute until golden.

title: Amaretto Slush
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into plastic pitchers or containers and place in freezer. Stir every few hours. Best if made the day before to form \slush.\

title: Lo-Cal Corn Meal Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 4 muffin tins treated with nonstick spray. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Lenten Salad
instructions: Combine salmon potatoes celery relish horseradish and onion. Season with salt and pepper and moisten with mayonnaise. Mix lightly with 2 forks. Serve on crisp lettuce.

title: Mashed Potato Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients adding enough salad dressing to blend well. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients. Add marshmallows to taste. Garnish with pineapple and maraschino cherries. Chill.

title: Venison Pepper Steak And Rice
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips or small pieces. Heat oil in skillet. Add meat and brown quickly. Stir in tomato soy sauce and other seasonings. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until meat is almost tender. Add green pepper and cook 10 minutes. Blend cornstarch and broth and stir into meat mixture; cover and simmer 10 minutes longer. Serve over bed of fluffy rice.

title: Grandma'S Manicotti Shells
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Heat a small nonstick frypan. Coat with oil using an oil coated paper towel. Spoon small amount into pan to spread evenly on bottom of frypan. Cook until ends begin to curl a little. Flip with fingers. Cook a little longer. Should be light.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Cut shortening into flour baking powder and salt with pastry blender until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in milk. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto hot meat or vegetables in boiling stew (do not drop directly into liquid). Cook uncovered 10 minutes. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer. Makes 10 dumplings.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over chops. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fancy Fast Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Top each piece with slice of Swiss cheese. Put mushrooms on top. Mix can of soup with wine and pour over chicken. Spread stuffing mix over top; drizzle melted oleo over top.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mash bananas or liquify in blender. Mix orange juice lemonade pineapple juice and water with the sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved. Stir in bananas and mix well. Freeze this mixture until ready to use. Thaw for 2 1/2-3 hrs. before party. Break up with fork and add 7-up and ginger ale. Yield approximately 60 c.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs and water; add brown sugar. Mix and add next 5 ingredients. Spread into flat cookie pan with a lip. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven. When done while warm spread with icing made of melted butter orange juice orange rind and enough powdered sugar to make a thin icing. Cut cookies into small squares while warm. Store in airtight container to prevent drying out.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions. Mix with brown sugar catsup mustard and beans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour; blend in other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell; cook at 350\u00b0 until brown and firm.

title: Chow Mein Candy
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels in double boiler then add remaining ingredients and stir until coated. Then spoon out on wax paper. Let set until firm. Keep at room temperature.

title: Scalloped Chicken And Potatoes Dinner(Serves 6 People)
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and mushrooms in butter until crisp-tender. Beat eggs cream and pepper; add to skillet. Cook over medium heat until eggs are almost set stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese and chives. Cover and cook until eggs are completely set and cheese is melted.

title: Fried Tomatoes
instructions: Take large green tomatoes slice; dip in egg and flour. Cover bottom of frying pan with oil. When hot put in your tomatoes; fry until brown. Salt and pepper your tomatoes when cooked.

title: Old-Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cover raisins with water and boil until they are puffed up. Cream together the sugars and Butter Buds. Add Egg Beaters oatmeal flour raisins and soda mixed with the raisin water. Next add vanilla spices and Grape-Nuts. Chill dough 30 minutes. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Bake 17 to 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Yields 6 dozen cookies.

title: Lalola'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake German chocolate cake mix according to directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While warm poke holes in top with fork. Pour over cake Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk. Cool. Then top with following layers Hersheys fudge topping Cool Whip and crushed Heath bars. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Pour cream of celery soup into baking dish. Place pork chops on top of soup. Pour onion soup over the pork chops. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pickled Beets And Eggs
instructions: Drain beets and save liquid. Bring beet liquid and remaining ingredients to a boil in medium saucepan about 5 minutes. Add beets and eggs to mixture. Boil another 5 minutes. Remove from heat cool. Put in jar. Refrigerate for several days to allow flavor to blend in eggs and beets.

title: Elaine'S Brisket
instructions: Put meat in roaster pan without lid and sear on high heat using oven at 450\u00b0. Turn after about 15 minutes. Now pour remaining ingredients in with brisket. Cover pan with lid or foil. Pour ginger ale halfway up pot (dont cover pan completely). Cook at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours covered. No fail recipe.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix the sugar flour salt and milk together. Melt butter. Pour your batter over the melted butter; spoon peaches on top. Do not stir! Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Mother'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Blend together sugar egg and shortening. Mix together flour baking powder soda and cocoa. Add flour mixture and buttermilk to 1st mixture. Add 1/2 cup boiling hot water and vanilla. Batter will be very thin. Bake at 325\u00b0 in glass pan at 350\u00b0 in aluminum pan 8 x 8-inches for 25 to 30 minutes. Double recipe for 9 x 13-inch pan but bake perhaps a little longer 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
instructions: Combine vegetables soup 1/2 cup cheese sour cream pepper pimentos and 1/2 can French fried onions. Pour into greased 1 quart casserole. Bake covered for 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

title: Egg Macaroni Salad
instructions: Prepare Kraft dinner as directed on package. Add peas tomato salad dressing celery onion and seasoning. Chop fine the eggs; add to dinner mixture. Mix lightly. Chill. Stir in additional salad dressing before serving. If desired garnish with remaining egg slices. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Bake pie shells as directed. Mix Jell-O instant pudding as directed. Put in desired coconut. Fold in 3/4 container Cool Whip; put in pie shell. Put on whipped cream then brown coconut in oven. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Chill 2 hours and enjoy.

title: Breakfast Burritos
instructions: Place scrambled eggs in center of the tortillas. Crumble bacon or sausage over the eggs. Then top with remaining ingredients. Fold up bottom of tortilla then roll up from the side.

title: Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix pretzels oleo and 3 tablespoons sugar together; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan (ungreased). Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cream together the cream cheese 1/2 cup sugar and Cool Whip. Mix together and spread over cooled pretzels. Dissolve strawberry jello and boiling water. Add strawberries. Stir until it sets up a little. Pour over cheese mixture; cool until set. Put Cool Whip on top.

title: Freezer Cucumbers
instructions: Cover cucumbers and onion with water and stir in salt. Soak 2 hours and drain well. Mix sugar and vinegar together. Stir well. Pour mixture over cucumbers and freeze.

title: Jambalaya A La Makia
instructions: Cut sausage in pieces and brown in a large heavy pan. Remove sausage. Dip chicken in mixture of flour salt pepper and garlic salt. Brown chicken in pan in which sausage was cooked. Remove chicken. Add onions pepper and garlic. Saute until onions are transparent. Return sausage and chicken to container. Season with Worcestershire sauce soy sauce and hot sauce. Add water to bring total liquid to about 6 cups. Bring to a boil. Add rice and shrimp. Cover and again bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 or 40 minutes. Do not cover. Remove from heat and allow to sit covered for 10 minutes. Serves 12. Its done when there is little to no liquid and rice is alone.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly except gravy. Shape into oblong patties in skillet. Brown patties and pour off fat. Add gravy and cover. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir and garnish with parsley.

title: Hamburger-Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef with onions; drain well. Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Spread green beans over top. Spread mushroom soup over beans. Put sliced cheese over this. Top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sausage Roll
instructions: Fry sausage. Add peppers onion and mushrooms. Let cool. Add eggs. Roll out one dough. Spoon 1/2 of sausage mixture on dough. Top with 1/2 of cheese. Fold up sides of dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bread is golden brown.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Spray an 8 or 9-inch spring-form pan or 9-inch pie plate lightly with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle bottom and side with the graham cracker crumbs.

title: Terry'S Impossible Taco Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Cook and stir beef and onion until brown; drain. Stir in seasoning mix. Spread in plate; top with chilies. Beat milk baking mix and eggs until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand blender. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Annie'S Butterhorns
instructions: Put in mixing bowl the flour sugar and salt; blend in margarine. Mix together yeast eggs and milk. Add to flour mixture. Stir until well mixed (your husband comes in handy for this job). Put dough on a floured board and roll out; spread with one cube of softened butter and fold three times. Chill overnight. Divide into 2 parts and roll out. Cut into pie shaped pieces; starting at outer edges roll to center. Shape into crescents on cookie sheets; let raise double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. This also makes good sweet rolls.

title: Tostadas
instructions: Crumble 2 tostada shells on each of 6 salad plates. Layer half each of the chicken pieces and Mexican Coleslaw on crumbled tostadas. Top with cheese remaining chicken and coleslaw olives and orange wedges. Sprinkle with chili powder. Top with taco sauce. Yields 6 servings.

title: Marinade Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large pan with a lid; use a whisk to mix. Insert meat making sure all meat is covered. Replace lid to pan and place pan in refrigerator at least 24 hours. Prepare meat before sauce. Cut off all fat and sinue.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and milk in saucepan; cook until first bubble appears. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat; stir in butter and let it melt. Stir in peanut butter and oats and add vanilla. Mix together; drop by spoonfuls onto foil. Let cool 45 minutes.

title: Red Beet Eggs
instructions: Drain beets reserving juice. Mix sugar salt vinegar water and beet juice in a small saucepan. Heat until sugar dissolves. Peel eggs. Put beets and eggs in a bowl. Cover with the liquid and refrigerate for several days.

title: Best Ever Banana Pudding
instructions: Separate eggs. Place egg yellow in saucepan along with sugar and milk. After adding milk fill 1/2 can with water and pour into mixture. Bring to rapid boil. Stir constantly. Boil until thick and creamy. Add extract. Remove from heat. Slice bananas. Place vanilla wafers in pan and layer bananas. Repeat once and pour sauce over it. Place egg white in bowl. Add 2 tablespoons sugar and beat until fluffy. Place over pudding. Refrigerate until cool. You can not eat just 1 bowl!

title: Grandmother'S Cake
instructions: Beat in butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the well beaten egg yolks. Sift flour twice with salt and baking powder. Add a little milk at a time with flour; add vanilla. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour batter into 2 iron skillets. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until done. Can use any pan of your choice.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water. Add oil salt hot water and sugar. Stir and add 1 1/2 cups flour; mix well and add egg. Add remaining flour to make soft dough. Put into greased bowl. Cover and allow to rise twice. Make into rolls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Brush with butter. (May punch down and put in refrigerator and allow to rise about 2 hours.)

title: Creamy Vanilla Icing
instructions: Mix milk and flour then cook until thick stirring constantly; cool. Cream sugar shortening and sugar; add vanilla. Add flour mixture and mix well.

title: No Calorie Cabbage Soup
instructions: Cut vegetables and cover with water in large pot. Boil 30 minutes. Cover lower heat and simmer until soft. Try pepper garlic or bouillon cube to season.

title: Savory Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Melt margarine. Add eggs milk salt and pepper. Cook slowly until eggs begin to set. Add cream cheese.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Blend dry mixture into moist mixture. Stir in 1 cup chopped nuts. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef In Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in butter; drain. Add garlic juice and simmer 20 minutes. Add tomato sauce salt pepper and sugar and simmer 15 minutes. In separate bowl mix cream cheese sour cream and chopped onions. Set aside. Cook noodles. In large casserole dish or 2 small ones layer noodles meat grated cheese and sour cream mixture in that order. Cover top with undiluted mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes. Sprinkle extra cheese on top.

title: Crunchy Romaine Salad
instructions: Mix lettuce broccoli onions and oranges. Brown nuts and noodles (crushed) in butter. Put nut and noodle mixture over lettuce mixture just before serving.

title: Layered Supper
instructions: Brown the ground beef. Drain and rinse meat. Salt and sprinkle on chili powder. In Dutch oven layer meat sliced onions potatoes and carrots. Finish with onions. Pour the tomatoes over layers. Bake uncovered until potatoes and carrots test tender. Great with cornbread!

title: Icing For Angel Food Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients together until light and fluffy. Tastes like whipped cream.

title: Scalloped Tuna And Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water 10 minutes and drain. Melt margarine; stir in flour mustard salt and pepper. Add milk gradually while stirring. Cook over low heat until smooth and thickened. Arrange potatoes tuna and onions in alternate layers in greased 2-quart casserole dish. Pour sauce over and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Marinated Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage and sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top. Bring to boil salt mustard celery seed oil vinegar and 1 tablespoon sugar. Pour over cabbage. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Herbed Pecans
instructions: In heavy skillet melt butter or margarine. Stir in rest of ingredients. Toss until nuts are coated. Place in single layer on 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1 baking pan. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes stirring often till nuts are brown and crisp. Makes about 4 1/4 cups.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms in butter. Add soup and milk; stir. Remove from heat. Add the egg and mayonnaise. Stir in stuffing then fold in crabmeat. Pour mixture into greased baking dish. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. This is very rich and will serve small portions to 5 or 6. Double the recipe for a larger group.

title: Tarragon Chicken Triesta
instructions: Slice mushrooms; saute in 2 tablespoons margarine until golden. Remove mushrooms and reserve. Add remaining margarine to pan; brown chicken well. Sprinkle with Beau Monde during browning. Add mushrooms; sprinkle with tarragon. Pour wine over chicken. Cover and simmer 45 minutes until tender. Spoon sour cream into pan juices; sprinkle with green onion to serve. Serve with rice.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook to soft ball stage.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Place butter in a baking dish in oven to melt. Mix flour milk and 1/2 cup of sugar; set aside. Pour 1/2 cup of sugar over peaches. Pour flour mixture over butter in baking dish. Do not stir. Last pour fruit on top. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken 1 hour. Cut cooled chicken into cubes and line a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with the chicken. Add the soup milk salt and pepper to the chicken then add the dressing. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Lemon Soup
instructions: Combine chicken vegetables and water to cover in a saucepan. Cook chicken until tender. Remove and chop chicken into pieces; set aside. Combine rice with broth in a saucepan. Cook just until rice is tender. Season to your taste. Beat egg yolks and lemon juice; whisk a small amount of hot liquid (soup) into egg mixture. Then whisk egg mix back into soup. Add chicken. Heat just to serve.

title: Fiesta Banana Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in mixer bowl. Blend in eggs vanilla and bananas. Add flour and salt alternately with sour milk mixing well after each addition. Stir in baking powder and soda. Pour into greased cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool completely. Frost with whipped cream. Garnish with cherries. Refrigerate.

title: Salmon Cheese Surprise
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add flour and blend well. Stir in milk and cook for several minutes stirring constantly until it comes to a boil. Turn off heat. Add cheese salmon salt and pepper and mix well. Place mixture in greased casserole and top with biscuits. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Batter
instructions: Mix eggs baking powder salt mayonnaise lemon juice and hot sauce. Add cleaned shrimp. Let stand for 1/2 hour to soak all flavorings. Prepare flour seasoned fish fry and baking powder. Roll shrimp into this mixture and fry in frypan.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly mix ingredients. Roll into long roll and place in refrigerator to chill well. When ready slice and bake 8 to 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Orange Pancakes With Sunshine Orange Sauce
instructions: Combine biscuit mix and sugar in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine eggs orange juice and milk in a small bowl stirring well. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto a hot lightly greased griddle. Cook pancakes until tops are covered with bubbles and edges appear cooked. Turn and cook other side. Serve with Sunshine Orange Sauce. Yield 14 (4-inch) pancakes.

title: Almond Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grind almonds to a coarse cornmeal like consistency.\tMelt butter in a small pan over low heat until clear. Add all other ingredients to the butter and heat until the mixture is well blended.\tDrop by teaspoons onto a Teflon cookie sheet about 5 inches apart. Bake only one sheet at a time for about 5 minutes or until the now spread out wafers are a light golden brown. Remove the pan and let it cool for about 30 seconds before beginning to take up the first wafer. A Teflon spatula works well here. Roll up as soon as the wafer is manageable leaving the hole through the roll about\t3/4 inches in diameter. Roll with the crunchy side out. This must be done quickly but if the mixture becomes too brittle put the pan back into the oven to soften wafers again. When rolls\tare cool and hard dip each end into melted chocolate and fill with unsweetened whipped cream using a pastry bag that you can make of\twaxed paper if you dont have one already.

title: Enchiladas Casserole
instructions: Saute onion ground beef and peppers. Add enchilada sauce 1 can chicken soup. Cut tortillas in strips and line casserole with them. Add layers of meat mixture and cheese. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Banana And Pineapple Cake
instructions: In mixing bowl thoroughly stir together the flour sugar salt and baking soda. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients. Combine egg bananas oil undrained pineapple and vanilla. Add all at once to dry ingredients stirring until well blended. Pour the batter into the greased and floured fluted tube pan (Bundt pan). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes. Cool on rack. Put homemade vanilla frosting or Cream Cheese Frosting on it.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Wash raisins in hot water and drain. Cream shortening with sugar then add beaten eggs and milk.\tCombine with oatmeal and raisins; mix well. Add flour sifted with soda salt\tand cinnamon. Beat thoroughly. Drop onto greased pans and bake about 12 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.\tMakes about 3 dozen medium-sized cookies.

title: Nestle Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Drop teaspoon size dabs onto cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together Bake in a lightly greased 9 x 9 inch pan at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until done. Cool and crumble in large bowl. Stir together rest of ingredients and add crumbled bread mix well. Keep refrigerated overnight. This dish keeps for 3 or 4 days. Optional top with grated cheese and /or crumbled bacon.

title: One Pot Meal
instructions: Cut potatoes and sausage into bite size pieces. Place all ingredients in a large pot or Dutch oven and cook on low heat until potatoes are done (about 25 or 30 minutes). Serve with rolls or cornbread.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Blend all ingredients except ham. Spread mix on ham slices roll up and secure with toothpicks. Cut into thirds. Chill for 1/2 hour.

title: Nutty Cinnamon Toast
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon in bowl. Spread 1 tablespoon of butter on each slice of bread. Sprinkle sugar-cinnamon mixture on bread. Bake for 5 minutes at 400\u00b0. Top with nuts or raisins. Serve with a glass of milk. Makes 2 servings.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a deep heavy cooking pot. Add celery and onion; stir-fry over moderate heat until onion is transparent but not brown. Add chicken broth; cover and cook over low heat 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Pinto Bean Pan Supper
instructions: Cook onion and pepper in shortening until tender. Add ground beef and brown. Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Add pinto beans and seasonings; simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with warm cornbread.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients. Add eggs one at a time and blend. Add remaining ingredients beat smooth. Pour in floured greased tube pan and place in cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients in a jar. Cover tightly and shake until well mixed; set aside. Place spinach in a large bowl. Just before serving pour dressing over spinach and toss gently. Garnish with crumbled bacon and egg slices. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 2-quart baking dish toss together the apples granulated sugar cinnamon and lemon juice. In a large bowl combine flour oats brown sugar and salt.

title: Herbed Spaghetti
instructions: Combine ground beef sausage onion and garlic in a Dutch oven; cook until meat is browned stirring to crumble meat. Drain off drippings. Add remaining ingredients except spaghetti; bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Uncover and simmer an additional hour stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf and spoon over spaghetti. Yield 10 cups.

title: Cheese Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 x 11-inch glass baking dish. Mix together eggs flour salt milk chiles Cheddar and Jack cheeses. Pour into prepared baking dish. Bake in preheated oven 35 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before cutting in squares.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Place chops on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Slice potatoes over top of chops to cover. Slice cabbage over top of potatoes to cover. Slice onions over top of cabbage. Mix mushroom soup with only enough water to rinse can out. Pour over all layers in dish. Add salt and pepper. Cook 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until chops are tender.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat together 1 minute at low speed salt nutmeg cinnamon eggs sugar and oil. Add and stir canned pumpkin and water. Sift together and add baking soda and flour. Beat for 1/2 minute at low speed. Fill 3 well-greased and floured 1 pound coffee cans 2/3 full or 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Loaf pans about 10 to 15 minutes longer.) Remove from can by running knife around side of can. If raisins or dates are added reduce sugar 1/4 cup.

title: Cream Of Asparagus Soup(Low-Fat)
instructions: Saute one large onion in microwave for three minutes with 2 to 3 tablespoons of water. Cut up raw or frozen asparagus. Microwave with 1/2 cup water for 7 to 8 minutes until tender. Puree in blender. Add puree chicken bouillon cubes 3 cups water and 2 cups of cut up pieces of asparagus and sauteed onions. Cook until asparagus are done. Add light oleo and skim evaporated milk. Heat until starting to boil. Stir often as will stick and burn. Mix flour in 1 cup water until smooth. Add to soup until slightly thickened. Add light Velveeta cheese.

title: Impossible Lasagne Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in plate. Mix beef herbs tomato paste and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Spoon on top. Beat milk baking mix eggs salt and pepper for 1 minute. Pour over meat mixture. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and stir in sugar. Let stand overnight. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Thaw spinach; drain well by squeezing water out with hands. Divide spinach equally into bottom of two unbaked pie shells. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of each cheese (Mozzarella Cheddar Swiss) into each pie shell. Mix eggs milk Worcestershire sauce and onions with wire whisk in a bowl. Pour egg mixture evenly into pie shells. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Sugar-Free Fudge
instructions: In a medium saucepan melt margarine over low heat. Add chocolate and stir just until melted. Remove from heat; stir in sweetener and vanilla. Add cream cheese and beat until smooth. Stir in nuts. Spread mixture in a buttered 8-inch square pan. Cover and refrigerate until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator. Yields 64 squares of fudge.

title: Curried Tuna Melts
instructions: Combine tuna celery raisins and green onion in a small bowl. In a measuring cup stir together mayonnaise lemon juice curry and salt. Fold in tuna mixture. Toast English muffins. Immediately spoon tuna mixture on muffins. Top each sandwich with slice of cheese. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve hot garnish with celery leaves. Makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Tuna Custard
instructions: Place 4 of the bread slices in bottom of buttered baking pan. Mix mayonnaise with fish and vegetables and 1 can of soup. Spread evenly over bread. Cover this with balance of bread and pour over it the eggs and milk which have been well mixed. Let stand at least 4 hours or overnight. Bake 20 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven. Remove from oven and spread remaining can of soup cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Return to oven to finish baking 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes and onion together and spread into a buttered casserole dish (9 x 13-inches). Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over potatoes. Place margarine slices over top. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Dump in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan but do not mix. Sprinkle with coconut and chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Senorita Mary'S Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Thaw hash browns apart. Combine all ingredients; bake 2 1/2 to 3 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Chip Beef In White Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add flour to milk and mix well. Add mixture to margarine. Stir until thickens. Tear chip beef into pieces and put in sauce. Simmer with cover on for awhile. Pour on toast.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together. Add milk to medium-thin consistency. Beat in egg. Mixture is ready to either pour or spoon onto grill. Turn only 1 time when golden brown. Butter while hot and serve with favorite syrup. Makes 8 saucer size pancakes.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine flour 1 cup sugar and salt. Dissolve cocoa in water. Add with mixture to milk and cook in double boiler until thickened. Add egg yolks. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour into cooled pie shell. Beat egg whites with 3/8 cup sugar until fluffy. Spread over filling. Bake at 300\u00b0 until golden brown. Yield 6 servings.

title: Carrot Slaw
instructions: Grate grind or chop the peeled carrotsadd the chopped pimentos or chopped red pepper.Add the chopped parsley. In a mug put about 1/3 to 1/2 cup of salad vinegar. Add honey one Tbsp. at a time until the mixture is sweet to your tastebe sure to stir this mixture all the timethen add a dash of salt and pour over the veggies. Let it chill in the refrigerator overnight or for several hours to blend flavors.

title: Crunch Mix
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Melt almond bark in double boiler. Pour into mixture and mix well. Pour combination over waxed paper and press into single layer. Cool overnight.

title: Christmas Cookie Canes
instructions: With electric mixer cream together butter salt vanilla and powdered sugar until light and fluffy. At low speed add flour and oats until just mixed. Form dough into large or small canes. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Place cherry halves on canes and bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly golden brown.

title: Cream Cheese Quiche
instructions: Beat cream cheese egg yolks heavy cream egg pepper and salt until smooth and blended. Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces and cook until lightly browned and crisp. Arrange the bacon in the pie shell. Pour cheese mix over bacon and bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes longer or until puffed and golden brown. Let stand a few minutes and serve hot. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Gelatin Base Punch
instructions: Boil sugar in quart of water until melted. Dissolve jello in hot water. Cool both liquids. Mix with other liquids. Add ice to serve. You can break this down to the amount you need. Serves 100.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Line bottom of rectangular pan with beef. Roll chicken with bacon slice skewer with toothpicks. Lay on top of beef. Mix soup and cheese. Add 1/2 soup can of water mix and pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0. This is excellent served with rice pilaf.

title: Old Fashioned Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk chocolate corn syrup and salt in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until chocolate melts and sugar dissolves. Cook to 234\u00b0 or until a little dropped in cold water forms a soft ball. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat. Add butter. Cool to lukewarm without stirring. Add vanilla. Beat until thick and no longer glossy. Quickly stir in nuts. Pour into buttered 8 to 9-inch square pan. When set cut into squares.

title: Honey Ham Tortilla Rolls
instructions: With electric mixer beat ham and cream cheese together until smooth. Stir in pineapple green onion and honey. Spread 1/4 cup ham mixture on each tortilla to within 1/2-inch of edges. Roll up each tortilla starting from one edge. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 8 hours before serving.

title: Mocha Punch
instructions: In a large saucepan bring water to a boil. Remove from heat. Add drink mix sugar and coffee; stir until dissolved. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight.

title: Peach Blueberry Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine sugar flour cinnamon and allspice. Add the peaches and blueberries; toss gently. Line pie plate with bottom crust. Add the filling. Dot with butter. Top with a lattice crust. Brush crust with milk. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly. Cool.

title: Steamed Shrimp
instructions: Season shrimp in shell with salt black pepper red pepper and garlic powder. Put shrimp in hot oil or butter and stir until all shrimp turn pink. Add onions celery and bell pepper. Mix well; cook covered for 15 minutes. When done using slotted spoon move shrimp to platter. Serve juice in small bowls. When eating suck on shrimp first then peel shrimp. Can be dipped in juice or dip juice with French bread. Serve with green salad. Delicious! If real hungry double recipe.

title: Raised Cornmeal Muffins
instructions: Soften yeast in water; pour milk over cornmeal salt sugar and shortening. Cool. Beat in eggs and 2 cups flour. Add yeast and mix well. Stir in flour. Cover and let rise until double in bulk about 1 hour. Stir down; spoon into greased muffin cups. Fill about 1/3 full. Cover and let rise until double in bulk. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Brush with melted butter. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Clair Cake
instructions: In saucepan bring water and butter to the boil until all butter is melted. All at once add flour and salt; beat until mixture forms a ball that leaves the sides of the saucepan. Cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Spread pastry mixture onto an ungreased jellyroll pan or cookie sheet. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Remove from oven; pierce bubbles with fork while hot. Cool completely.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Pour in graham cracker crust. Chill several hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Lay out sweet potato slices in a buttered baking dish or pan. Mix remaining ingredients except butter and pour over potatoes. Dot with butter. Place in oven and bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandpa Steck'S Cabbage Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water until tender; drain. Set aside. Melt butter or margarine in a Dutch oven or heavy pot. Fry coarsely chopped cabbage in butter until lightly browned. Cut Spam into 1/2 inch cubes and add to cooked cabbage. Cook 5 minutes longer. Mix in boiled noodles and add pepper to taste.

title: Breakfast Pizzas
instructions: Brown and crumble sausage in skillet. Drain well. Return to stove and add stick of butter. Stir until melted and mix with sausage. Add Cheez Whiz and combine with sausage. Place English muffin halves on cookie sheet and top with sausage mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meat Pie
instructions: Cook meats and other ingredients; add 2 cups water. When ready add mashed potatoes and put in crusts.

title: Outstanding Onions
instructions: Peel onions. Cut a slice off top and bottom so onions sit flat in a baking dish just big enough to hold them. Combine stock wine salt pepper rosemary and thyme. Pour over onions cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn onions over and bake 30 more minutes. Pour off liquid sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and return to oven for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: My Family'S Favorite Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix soup margarine and Cheez Whiz in a large saucepan and heat until well blended. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: California Tacos
instructions: Brown meat. Add onions pepper sauce beans and Tabasco. Add water if it seems dry. Simmer for taste.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook over medium heat until thickened. If not all used stores a long time in refrigerator.

title: Heavenly Salad
instructions: Cook yolks of eggs lemon juice and mustard in double boiler until thick. Cool. Add this mixture to the whipping cream. Add fruit and put in refrigerator for 6 hours. Do not freeze. Serves 8.

title: Baked Catfish(Serves 4)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly oil a baking pan large enough to hold 4 catfish in a single layer. Rub cut side of garlic into pan. Combine beaten egg and milk in shallow dish. Combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and seasonings in another dish. Dip each fillet into egg mixture and roll in Parmesan mixture; coat completely. Arrange fillets on baking pan and drizzle remaining oil on top. Bake 20 minutes until fish is flaky.

title: Carciofialla Romana (Artichokes Roman-Style)(Origin: Italian)
instructions: Remove the stalks tips and tough outer leaves of the artichokes. Keep the artichokes in cold water and lemon juice until ready for cooking (this will prevent them from turning black). Place artichokes in a pan (in which they fit tightly). Add all the other ingredients with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cover the pot and let simmer over reduced heat for a few minutes. Uncover the pot and cook for another 15 to 20 minutes. Place in serving dish. Serve hot or cold. Makes 6 servings. Serve with Fontana Candida the light sophisticated wine of Rome.

title: Kentucky One-Bowl Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Microwave chocolate and butter in large bowl on High for 2 minutes. Stir until chocolate melts. Stir in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla until well blended. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. If using glass dish reduce heat to 325\u00b0.

title: Tea Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour salt baking powder and sugar together. Add water and beaten egg to shortening. Mix with dry ingredients to make soft dough. Turn out on floured board and roll out to about half-inch thickness. Cut out with small biscuit cutter. Bake on greased pan in moderate oven about 25 minutes.

title: Green Beans With Water Chestnuts
instructions: Heat oil in uncovered wok or pan. Add next 4 ingredients; stir-fry 1 minute.\tAdd remaining ingredients; cover and cook until beans are crisp-tender (5 to 7 minutes). Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Butterscotch Supreme
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cream the powdered sugar cream cheese and 1 cup whipped topping. Spread on crust. Combine pudding and milk until firm. Pour over mixture. Spread whipped topping over pudding. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown the ground beef and drain the fat then add in the onions peppers salt pepper and garlic. Add mashed tomatoes and a can of tomato sauce or tomato juice and bring to a boil. Add in rice and bring to a boil. Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes. Add more tomatoes or juice if necessary.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In frying pan combine first 3 ingredients. Brown thoroughly and drain. Combine tomatoes sauce paste and meat mixture in large pot. Mix well and cook for 10 minutes on medium heat. Stir in oregano bay leaf and garlic salt. Cook sauce uncovered on low for 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; form into a ball. Sprinkle with additional chopped nuts if desired.

title: No Fat Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine and mix dry ingredients. Add and mix lightly remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan (spray with Pam first). Bake 25 minutes.

title: Swedish Coconut Cherry Drops
instructions: Cream shortening and butter; add sugar egg and almond extract. Then add flour salt and baking powder. Fold in cherries and coconut. Drop by teaspoonful on greased baking sheets. Flatten slightly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; roll out on floured board and cut cookies. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Check for doneness after 15 minutes.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spread butter or margarine on bread. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased baking dish. Set aside. Cook sausage until brown stirring to crumble; drain well. Spoon over bread slices; sprinkle with cheese. Combine eggs half and half (may substitute whole milk) and salt; mix well and pour over cheese. Cover and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: Boil berries and 2 cups sugar for 3 minutes. Add remaining 2 cups of sugar and boil 3 more minutes. Let stand overnight skimming before cooling. Put in sterilized jar and paraffin. Berries stay whole.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Cook both puddings and jello with 3 cups of water until thick. Cool. Add Cool Whip and mandarin orange slices.

title: Sausage Breakfast Strata
instructions: Spread bread with butter. Place in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole. Crumble sausage into skillet. Cook stirring to keep it in small pieces until no longer pink. Lift with slotted spoon. Spread over bread. Sprinkle cheese over sausage. In bowl combine eggs half and half and salt. Mix well and pour over cheese. Cover and chill overnight. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Remove casserole from refrigerator at same time letting stand 15 minutes to come to room temperature. Bake strata uncovered until set about 45 minutes. Let stand a few minutes before cutting into squares. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Cook cake and cool. Punch holes in cooled cake. Pour boiling water in jello and dissolve. Pour over cooled cake and spread cool whip on top.

title: Instant Cappuccino
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender covered and at high speed until powdery and well blended.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl beat eggs until foamy then beat in flour sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Blend in melted butter. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Pour into pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Pour butter sugar and milk in pan. Heat to boiling. Remove from heat. Combine Quaker oats and vanilla. Pour mixture from pan over oats. Stir well. Add cocoa and peanut butter. Mix well. Spoon onto wax paper on a cookie sheet. Put in refrigerator for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Spread pudding on cooled cake. Top with drained pineapple and then Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries and nuts. Keep chilled.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Pour soda and boiling water over dates and raisins; set aside. Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla then egg. Beat well. Add flour and mix. Pour in fruit mixture water and pecans. Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: In a skillet melt butter over medium-high heat. Saute squash and onion until crisp-tender. Remove from heat; stir in chilies crackers salt and pepper. Spoon into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together the Cool Whip and Eagle Brand milk then add the chocolate milk. Stir and pour into ice cream churn container. Churn until very firm.

title: Chicken And Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Brown chicken in oil. Remove chicken and saute onion bell pepper celery and garlic in grease. Add tomatoes and ham. Add liquid. Cover and simmer for about 20 to 30 minutes. Bring to a boil. Add rice chicken sausage green onions parsley and seasonings. Cook covered over low heat for at least 20 minutes or until rice is done.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni rinse and drain. Combine all ingredients and toss. Add mayonnaise and mix. Refrigerate for 1 hour; serve.

title: Chicken Cashew Casserole
instructions: Reserving half of noodles and nuts mix all ingredients in casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining noodles and nuts on top. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Halfway Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter sugars egg yolks and water. Add flour soda baking powder salt and vanilla. Put on greased cookie sheet and pat out thin. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Beat 2 egg whites until stiff; add 1 cup brown sugar. Spread over cookie dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Spectacular
instructions: Mix flour margarine and pecans together for crust; pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool. Cream together powdered sugar and cream cheese; fold in half of the Cool Whip whipped topping. Spread over cooled crust. Beat together pudding mix and milk for 2 to 3 minutes stir in vanilla. Spread over cream cheese layer then spread the remaining half of the whipped topping over the butterscotch layer. Top with a few additional chopped pecans. Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Cream butter until texture of mayonnaise. Gradually add 3/4 cup sugar then add the beaten eggs and finely grated rind of lemon. Alternately add flour baking powder and milk a little at a time. Butter pan (loaf pan 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) well and add filling and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cook lemon juice and 1/4 cup sugar until melted. Prick hot cake with a fork and pour the juice over the cake. Leave the cake in its tin until cool.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple to a boil. Remove from heat and mix dry jello into pineapple. Cool to the point where cottage cheese will not melt when added to the mixture. Add cottage cheese Cool Whip and nuts. Mix then put in container. Refrigerate.

title: Fruit Crisp
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and cut in shortening as per pie. Mix in eggs. Put half in bottom of 9 x 13 cookie sheet. Top with pie filling. Sprinkle with remaining dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until browned.

title: Celebration Poke Cake
instructions: Place cake layers top sides up in two 8 or 9-inch pans. Prick each cake with fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Dissolve each flavor jello separately in 1 cup of boiling water. Pour red jello over 1 cake layer and green jello over second cake layer. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Dip one cake pan in warm water for 10 seconds. Unmold cake layer onto serving plate. Top with one cup of whipped topping. Unmold second cake layer and place on top of first layer. Frost top and sides with remaining whipped topping. Can garnish with gumdrops.

title: California Baked Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Steam broccoli onion and pimento in 2-quart casserole dish sprayed with nonstick spray. In blender or food processor combine the rest of the ingredients. Pour over broccoli. Bake 35 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Mix ingredients; roll in small balls or drop by spoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from sheet before they cool.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together. Chill overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add onion vinegar and salt. Chill until mixture begins to set. Add cucumber and mayonnaise. Garnish with pimentos or tomato slices.

title: Chicken Ketchup
instructions: Combine. Spread over chicken pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Blueberry Crumb Bake With Tangy Yogurt Cream
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Butter a round 10-inch baking dish. Toss blueberries with lemon zest. In a large bowl combine 2 cups of flour with the sugar. Using your fingertips cut in butter until it resembles coarse meal. Set 1 1/2 cups of the mixture aside for the crumb topping. In a small bowl lightly beat the egg. Stir in the yogurt and lemon juice. Add to the dry ingredients in the large bowl and stir briefly until blended. Fold in 1 cup of the blueberries. Spread the batter in the dish and scatter the remaining 1 1/2 cups of blueberries on top. Sprinkle the reserved crumb mixture over the blueberries. Set the dish on a cookie sheet and bake for about 1 hour. Serve warm with the Yogurt Cream on the side.

title: Mushroom Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle fryers with salt pepper and paprika. Fry until brown in one cube margarine. Place in casserole dish(es). Brown sliced mushrooms. Add flour broth rosemary and sherry; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill. Serve with fresh vegetables of choice.

title: Nobby Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add egg and mix. Sift together flour cinnamon nutmeg salt and soda and stir into egg mixture. Stir in apples nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Mini-Blinies
instructions: Trim crust from bread and flatten with a rolling pin. Mix cream cheese egg yolks and 1/2 cup sugar. Spread with cream cheese mixture and roll each slice of bread like a jelly roll. Dip in melted butter and roll in mixture of 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Place on a cookie sheet and freeze.

title: Batter Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix all ingredients well. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Mostaccioli
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium skillet brown meat and drain well. Add onion green pepper and sauce; bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat. In 9 x 13-inch baking dish layer noodles sauce and Velveeta cheese. Repeat layers ending with Velveeta cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hungry-Man Casserole
instructions: Mix altogether in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Shrimp Curry
instructions: Combine water and 1 tablespoon salt in a Dutch oven; bring to boil. Add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes; drain well and rinse with cold water. Peel and devein shrimp; set aside. Saut onion and butter until crisp-tender. Add flour and curry powder stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add chicken broth and milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Stir in salt sugar ginger and lemon juice. Add shrimp and cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated. Serve over rice.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix according to directions. Prick with fork. Mix cream of coconut and Eagle Brand milk together and pour over cake. Spread with Cool Whip and coconut when cool.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix eggs and flour together; add remaining ingredients in order given. Dot with butter or strips of bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Friendship Cake(Healthy)
instructions: Sift together in a large bowl 2 Kings 422 Jeremiah 620 Leviticus 213 Amos 45 and 1 Chronicles 99. Add Judges 525 1 Samuel 1425 and Judges 419. Beat until smooth. Add Jeremiah 1711. Beat for 5 minutes by hand; add 1 Samuel 3012. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Find the ingredients by looking up the Bible verses.)

title: Croquant
instructions: This mixture may be made in advance and kept in a covered jar in the icebox. It can be used over any fresh canned or frozen fruit.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream oil margarine and sugar. Beat until fluffy; add egg yolks and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and buttermilk to batter beginning and ending with dry ingredients. By hand stir in coconut and nuts. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Stir 1 tablespoon of whites into batter and beat vigorously until blended. Carefully fold in remaining egg whites. Pour into 3 (8-inch) greased and floured pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool before icing.

title: Raisin Puffs
instructions: Cook raisins and water until water is gone. Add remaining ingredients. Cool all ingredients. Roll into 1-inch balls then roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs. Combine with all ingredients. Pour into greased casserole. Bake covered thirty minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover and bake a few minutes longer.

title: Corn Chip Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chips in a bowl with lid. Store in refrigerate overnight then 30 minutes before serving add the corn chips and stir to mix well.

title: Pumpkin Cookie Bars Homemade With Love
instructions: Combine flour oats brown sugar nuts and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Add butter and mix until crumbly. Press into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0.

title: Wild Strawberry Salad
instructions: Put fruit cocktail and water in large saucepan. Add jello and cook until dissolved. Cool. Add cottage cheese and Cool Whip and stir until well mixed. Refrigerate until set about 6 hours or overnight.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown beef and onion together. Drain off fat. Place beef and onion in large kettle and add other ingredients. Let simmer for about 2 hours.

title: Praline Pie
instructions: In small saucepan cook and stir butter and brown sugar over low heat until brown sugar melts and mixture bubbles. Remove from heat and add pecans. Pour into graham cracker crust. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions for pie filling. Cool slightly. Pour over butter and brown sugar mixture. Chill 4 hours or until firm. Just before serving garnish with whipped topping.

title: Red Rouser
instructions: Drop a scoop of vanilla ice cream into a tall glass and fill with cranberry juice. Stir until it all swirls together. If you like you can add a piece of cherry or pineapple slice on the side.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Drain mandarin oranges and pineapple. Mix all ingredients gently until thoroughly mixed. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Creamed Eggs And Medium White Sauce
instructions: Boil eggs and let cool. Slice eggs. Melt 1/2 stick butter in saucepan. Stir in enough flour to make thick. Add approximately 1 1/2 cups milk. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir together until thick. Add cheese. If this does not get thick you may have to mix more butter and flour together for thickening. Use your own judgement. Layer eggs in baking dish. Pour sauce over eggs. Continue to layer until gone. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Turn into greased 13 x 9 pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt in top of a double boiler. Mix in 1 whole egg and 3 egg yolks. Stir in milk. Cook uncovered over boiling water stirring constantly until thick. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour over bananas and wafers layered.

title: Chicken Breasts With Chipped Beef
instructions: Place beef in bottom of baking dish. Wrap a slice of bacon around each breast and place on beef. Mix sour cream and soup. Pour over chicken. (The sauce will cover up to 10 pieces of chicken.) Bake uncovered at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In saucepan cover the squash and onions with water and bring to a boil. Drain well and set aside. In bowl mix butter and dressing. Place half of the dressing mixture on bottom of a deep 8 x 8-inch or large casserole dish. In bowl mix squash/onions with sour cream soup and carrots. Pour into the casserole dish over the dressing and top with remaining dressing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until browned. Serves 8.

title: Sour Cream Waffles
instructions: Mix all ingredients to a smooth batter and let stand and swell 5 to 10 minutes. Bake the waffles over relatively low heat in an electric waffle iron or one heated on the stove. Should be crisp and golden brown.

title: Sanda'S Homemade Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour onto griddle on low heat. Makes 9 to 10 pancakes.

title: English Pasty
instructions: Place bottom crust in 8-inch pie pan. Spread diced potatoes evenly over bottom crust. Sprinkle minced onion over potatoes. Spread pieces of pork evenly on top of potatoes and onion. Season to taste. Cover with vented top pie crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Krinkle Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate with oil stirring until melted. Add sugar; stir until sugar is not grainy. One at a time add the eggs mixing well. Add vanilla. Stir in flour baking powder and salt; mix well. Chill several hours or overnight. Roll into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Dough is very sticky when rolling into balls. Take a small amount at a time and keep the rest in the refrigerator.

title: Pumpkin Layer Pie(Low Sugar For Diabetics)
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and Equal until smooth. Stir in whipped topping and spread on crust. Pour 1 cup milk into bowl; add pudding mix and beat with mixer until blended (1 to 2 minutes). Stir in pumpkin and spices and mix well. Spread over cheese layer. Refrigerate 3 hours. Garnish with Cool Whip.

title: Sugar Cookie Hearts
instructions: Beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in eggs and vanilla; mix well. Sift together flour salt and baking soda. Mix into sugar mixture until well blended. Chill 2 hours.

title: Pineapple Coconut Snowballs
instructions: In small bowl beat cream cheese and pineapple until combined. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. roll in 1 inch balls. Roll in coconut. Refrigerate overnight or 6 hours. Serve.

title: Salsa Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet brown chicken in oil; pour off fat. Add salsa and heat to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 30 minutes or until done turning chicken once.

title: Potato Skins
instructions: Prepare peas according to package directions. Drain. Spoon into potato skins. Place a slice of cheese on each half. Bake at 350\u00b0 until the cheese melts.

title: Spicy Tomato Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan stirring until well blended. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour uncovered stirring occasionally.

title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Cut whole breasts in half. Beat eggs with salt and pepper in bowl. Combine bread crumbs garlic powder and cheese. Dip chicken in eggs then coat with crumbs. Melt butter and oil in skillet. When butter foams add chicken. Cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden. Add Marsala. Cover skillet and reduce heat. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is tender. If sauce looks too dry add more Marsala. Turn chicken several times.

title: Fruitcake Bars
instructions: Melt margarine in rectangular baking dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over melted margarine. Sprinkle coconut then fruit. Cut dates in small pieces and mix with a small amount of flour to keep them from sticking together. Sprinkle dates then nuts over mixture. Press lightly with hands to level. Pour milk evenly over top and bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Heavenly Pound Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar butter and milk to a boil; boil 5 minutes. Add Hershey bar marshmallow cream and chocolate chips; beat well. Add nuts. Pour into large buttered cookie sheet; cool. Cut into squares.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Mix cake and bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool. Cut half of cake in cubes; reserve other half for another dessert. Dissolve Danish dessert in 3 1/2 cups cold water. Bring to boil 1 minute stirring constantly until thick and clear. Cool. Add strawberries. Spread over cake cubes in pan. Mix pudding milk and sour cream until smooth. Spread over strawberries. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with almonds.

title: Mound Bars
instructions: Mix 2 cups of crushed graham crackers 1/2 cup of sugar and 1/4 cup of melted butter. Spread in pan. Bake 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Take out and pour on 1 (14 ounce can) of sweetened condensed milk (if you like gooey bars add another can). Sread 2 cups of coconut over milk. Bake 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Turn off oven. Spread 1 package of chocolate chips over bars and let chocolate melt in oven. When melted spread evenly.

title: Polkie'S Prune Cake(A Sugarless Cake)
instructions: Grind together raisins prunes and carrots. Mix this with all the ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 until done 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
instructions: Shred cabbage fine. Salt and pepper to taste. Cut apples in slices and add to cabbage. Heat fat in frypan. Add a little boiling water to the cabbage and cook in the frypan until tender. Sprinkle with flour. Add sugar and vinegar and cook a bit longer. Serve hot.

title: Creole Steak
instructions: Sprinkle meat strips with salt and pepper. Brown in oil. Add onion tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder. Cover and cook 1 1/2 hours on low heat. Turn heat to medium add bell pepper. Cover and cook until tender about 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Sausage And Cheese Bread
instructions: Using plenty of flour roll out 1 loaf bread dough into oblong (rectangular) shape. Mix oregano with beaten eggs. Brush surface of bread dough with egg mixture. Sprinkle half of the sausage over surface of bread dough. Sprinkle half of each of the cheeses over the sausage. From the long side of bread dough roll the dough over until it meets the edge of the other long side. Bring the ends of the roll together to make a circle and press edges closed to hold in melted cheese. Brush top of roll with egg mixture. Repeat process for second loaf. Add more eggs and oregano if needed. Bake each on greased cookie sheet (or similar) at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: 20 Minute Apple Butter
instructions: Cook all together 20 minutes. Put in jar and seal.

title: Slow Cooker Beef
instructions: Cut steak into serving pieces. Heat oil in skillet and brown steak pieces. Remove steak from skillet and drain. Place carrot and onion in bottom of slow cooker. Place steak on top. Sprinkle salt and pepper. Place tomatoes on top. Pour broth over layers. Cover. Cook on low for 6 hours. If you use a more tender meat such as rib eye steak or rump roast cooking can be shorter. Serve over rice potatoes or noodles. Serves 4.

title: Jigglers
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill until firm about 3 hours. Makes 24 pieces. You can use cookie cutters to make fun shapes.

title: Hawaiian Festive Dip
instructions: Mix together filling and let set for several hours refrigerated. Hollow out bread reserving top and inside to be served with dip. Fill with filling. Serve with assorted crackers and bread.

title: Butter-Me-Nots
instructions: Soften in microwave the butter and margarine. Do not completely melt. Add sour cream and stir well. Add flour and mix well. Spoon into 1 3/4-inch muffin tins and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes until golden. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: With wooden spoon stir together the apples eggs vanilla and oil in a large bowl. Stir in dry ingredients one at a time until well blended. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with whipped cream when ready to serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion slightly in margarine. Add soup and milk. Mix in cheese broccoli rice and water chestnuts; simmer 10 minutes. Pour into a large greased casserole dish. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. (Mixture should be creamy not dry.) Casserole can be made a day or two ahead or frozen for later use.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix syrup oleo and sugar; bring to a boil. Boil 6 minutes (until thread forms when dropped from spoon). Remove from heat. Add cream of tartar soda and salt.\tStir until well mixed. Pour over popped corn; stir until all kernels are coated. Place in container that can be placed in oven. Bake 1 hour at 200\u00b0 stirring often. Keep in airtight container.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs and beat well. Add vinegar and food coloring; beat well. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternating with milk. Add vanilla; beat well. Pour into cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Hearty Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove to paper towels crumble and set aside. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of drippings. Saute onion and celery in drippings until onion is lightly browned. Add potatoes and water. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Stir in corn milk sausage dill and bacon. Cook until the potatoes are tender about 30 minutes. Makes 4 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Crowd-Pleasing Potato Salad
instructions: Place potatoes in large salad bowl. Separate eggs. Chop whites and add to potatoes with onion. Toss gently. In another bowl mash yolks with mayonnaise cream vinegar sugar mustard and salt. Pour over potatoes and stir to coat. Cover and chill. Yields 16 to 20 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix sauce ingredients and simmer 5 minutes. Pour over wings and toss lightly to coat. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Sticky Buns
instructions: Thaw bread dough. When thawed break half the loaf into small pieces and place in well-greased pie plate. Melt margarine in saucepan adding dry pudding brown sugar cinnamon and milk. Bring just to a boil. Pour over broken pieces. Add walnuts or pecans if desired. Break up remaining bread dough and place on top. Let rise to top of pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown. Invert on plate and serve warm.

title: Mexican Pork Or Beef Chile Verde(Microwave)
instructions: In 2-quart casserole dish combine onion and garlic. Cover. Microwave High 2 minutes. Stir in meat in cubes flour salt and pepper. Add tomatoes and green chiles. Stir to break up tomatoes. Cover. Microwave High 5 minutes. Stir. Reduce power. Cover for 30 minutes. Stir. Microwave uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes until meat is tender. Serve with warm tortillas. Serves 4 to 6. Total Cooking Time 57 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Use a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix confectioners sugar cracker crumbs peanut butter and butter in a medium size bowl until blended. Scrape into ungreased baking pan and press into an even layer. Spread melted chocolate over top. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until chocolate is firm. Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting with sharp knife into bars. Makes 36.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Let cool.

title: Breast Of Chicken
instructions: Soak chicken in beaten eggs at least 2 hours better if overnight. Roll the chicken in bread crumbs. (I use the Italian seasoning crumbs.) Brown pieces in skillet in butter or oleo. Place chicken in baking dish. Do not pile chicken on top of pieces just one layer. Add mushrooms including juice. Cover container with foil and bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Uncover and put a slice of cheese on each piece. Put back in oven until cheese melts.

title: Cocoa Fudge Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir flour and cocoa together; set aside. In saucepan melt margarine and shortening. Mix in sugar eggs and vanilla; stir until smooth. Blend in flour-cocoa mixture and nuts. Spread in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 2 dozen 2-inch bars.

title: Stove Top Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape in meat loaf shape. Brown top and bottom in frying pan (you can also make individual 1/4 pound loaves). Add 1 can whole tomatoes with some chopped celery. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
