instructions: Cook and drain broccoli and put into buttered casserole dish. Slice Velveeta cheese over top of broccoli or slice enough to cover. Melt oleo and crush one tube of crackers. Mix crushed crackers into oleo and spread on top of casserole. Bake uncovered in 300\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Butter Finger Bars
instructions: Blend above into coarse crumb mixture and press firmly into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Smothered Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving sizes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Dip meat into 1/4 cup milk then coat with flour salt and pepper mixture. Brown meat on both sides in oil. Remove to shallow baking dish. Blend 2 tablespoons flour into oil in skillet. Stir in milk and soup. Pour this mixture over meat in baking dish. Bake uncovered 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in microwave; add icing and nuts pour into cake pan and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix dry cake mix with 1 egg and 1/2 cup of oil (makes crunchy bottom layer). Reserve 1 cup of this mixture and pat out in pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Beat cream cheese sugar lemon and egg until light and soft. Spread this over baked layer and sprinkle with reserved mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for another 15 minutes. Allow to cool then cut into squares.

title: Simple Baked Crab
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a casserole. Mix bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until browned. Serves 4.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Stir in flour as long as you can stir. Put in tray and work just enough to handle soft dough. Roll real thin cut and bake. Leave plenty of room between cookies.

title: Chafing Dish Meat Balls
instructions: Simmer until brown. You may use a crock-pot and cook for several hours. Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook 1 cup of dry rice in 2 cups of water. Its better if it stands a little and dries out a bit after cooking so make the rice early in the day and let it stand then. In a heavy skillet brown 4 or 5 slices of bacon until crisp. Remove the bacon and turn down the heat. Slightly beat 3 or 4 eggs and pour them in the hot bacon drippings (after removing the bacon). Add the rice and 3 or 4 cut up green onions. Mix it all together. Add the bacon and if you have leftover pieces of pork beef or ham chop into small pieces. Last but not least add soy sauce until the rice is as brown as you like it. Stir well and simmer on low heat 15 to 20 minutes then serve.

title: Vegetable Chip Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and cream cheese. Add the rest of the ingredients to taste.

title: Ham Bake
instructions: Early in the day take one pound of ground chuck out of freezer. Spend rest of day cleaning up messes comforting sick little ones doing laundry and soothing colicky baby. Thirty minutes before husband is due home remember that you have a pound of thawed meat on kitchen counter that will ruin if you dont do something with it.

title: Greater Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes a little. Then mix all ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix all except sour cream. Pour half of mixture in pan and let congeal. Spread sour cream on this add remaining half of mixture and let congeal.

title: Chick Dip
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Put everything into blender and blend on high until smooth. Makes a great dip for vegetables and chips or spread on rice cakes Melba toast or pocket bread.

title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Put all ingredients into crock-pot and cook 8 hours. Before serving juice may be thickened with flour or cornstarch. Serve over rice or buttered cooked noodles.

title: Taco Salad Plate
instructions: Spread cream cheese on 8 or 9-inch plate. Add rest of ingredients as listed one by one in layers on plate. Top with cheese. Eat with nacho chips.

title: Easy Chicken Dressing
instructions: In a saucepan pour in cream of chicken soup and water; cook until boiling. Add remaining ingredients. Put in a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick margarine and mix with the 2 cups graham cracker crumbs. Pat mixture firmly in the bottom of an 8 x 11 x 2-inch pan.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix cream cheese and Cheddar cheese using fork. Add pepper garlic salt onion salt chopped onions and parsley. Mix well. Shape into ball or small log. Roll in finely chopped pecans and sprinkle generously with paprika. Wrap in foil and store in refrigerator a day before using. Serve on crackers. Freezes well.

title: Easy Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 covered. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Everyday Broccoli Cheese Chicken
instructions: In skillet over medium heat heat chicken in margarine. Cook chicken 10 minutes or until brown on both sides. Stir in soup water and pepper. Heat until boiling. Add in broccoli and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken and broccoli is fork-tender.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Boil raisins and water for 4 minutes. Cool add other ingredients. Mix well. Fill Number 2 cans half full. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Three-Bean Salad
instructions: Mix last 5 ingredients well. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir or toss to blend. Refrigerate for several hours before serving.

title: Potato Salad I
instructions: In a large kettle cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender. Drain and cool. Peel potatoes; cut into chunks. Separate egg yolks from whites. Set yolks aside. Chop whites and add to potatoes with onion. In a bowl mash yolks. Stir in mayonnaise milk vinegar dill relish mustard sugar salt and pepper. Pour over potatoes; toss well. Garnish with hard-cooked egg slices and paprika.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Make balls. Dip in sugar and press with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole combine all the ingredients except for the croutons. Cook at Medium-high heat 9 to 10 minutes. Stir twice. Crumble croutons over chicken mixture to form a crust. Continue cooking 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Goleer'S Rolls
instructions: Melt butter. Add milk and heat to lukewarm (105\u00b0 and 115\u00b0). Place yeast in a bowl. Add milk mixture and stir until yeast is dissolved. Add salt anise fennel cardamon (if used) syrup and rye flour. Mix. Add about 3/4 of all-purpose flour. Knead until dough is soft. Cover and let rise in warm place for 45 minutes. On lightly floured surface knead dough until smooth and satin adding flour as needed. Roll out to long roll and cut into 12 even pieces. Form pieces into oblong rolls. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Let rise about 35 minutes. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dora'S Hungarian Cucumber Salad
instructions: Pour over cucumbers. Mix and serve. Very good and low in calories.

title: Cheese Fondue(Serves 6)
instructions: Rub garlic halves around a saucepan and discard. Pour wine and lemon juice into pan and place over low heat. When liquid is hot add the cheese cubes and stir until they melt and mixture is blended. Add cornstarch mixture pepper and cayenne. Cook stirring constantly for 2 minutes or until mixture thickens. Do not allow to boil. Stir in Kirsch and beat for 1 minute. Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot over low heat. Serve with bread cubes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Frank-Veggie Hot Pot
instructions: Cut frankfurters into 1-inch pieces. Set aside. Heat to boiling chicken broth and water in a heavy saucepan or Dutch oven. Add macaroni basil salt and black pepper. Return to boiling. Cook uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir in frankfurters vegetables and onion. Simmer 5 minutes longer until macaroni is tender vegetables are cooked and water is almost all absorbed. Fold in sour cream and mayonnaise. If used garnish with chopped fresh green parsley chives or green peppers before serving.

title: Bacon Potato Treats
instructions: Arrange slices of potato in rectangular dish this may require a couple of layers depending on the size of potatoes. Cover dish with plastic wrap and microwave on High 4 minutes. Rotate and microwave another 4 minutes. When potatoes are cooked top with grated onion. Sprinkle with jalapeno; add bacon and cheese. Season very well with salt and pepper. Microwave on High 2 minutes uncovered. Serve.

title: Feather Light Pancakes
instructions: Heat griddle to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together in blender on high. Wipe small amount of salad oil over top of griddle. Pour batter onto griddle for pancake size desired. When bubbles occur flip and brown. Makes 12 small or 8 large pancakes.

title: Myrtle School Cafeteria Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix all together. Put thin layer in pan. Cook until done. Cool. Frost.

title: 6 Week Bran Muffin
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add wet ingredients. Mix well and store in refrigerator. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and salt. Mix well. Add melted butter. Mix well. Add eggs vanilla and milk. Mix well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn to 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Hot Wings
instructions: In saucepan melt butter. Add remaining ingredients. Let simmer 10 minutes. In large bowl add sauce to wings. You may preboil the wings or use wings frozen. Put in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. Cover baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Quick Fudge Frosting
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl stir together sugar and cocoa. Add margarine water and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer on low speed until combined. Beat on medium speed for 1 minute more. Cool for 20 to 30 minutes or until spreading consistency.

title: Kahlua Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased and floured bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Check often with toothpick. If you dont add pecans you dont have to flour pan.

title: Italian Casserole(Can Be Frozen; Easy To Make.)
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Saute sausages mushrooms and onion in skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange layers of macaroni sausages mushrooms and onion in two-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese slices. Make second layer. Top with marinara sauce. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves 6.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown onion and garlic in butter in large skillet. Add meat and brown. Add salt pepper flour and 1 can of soup. Heat for 5 minutes covered. Add other can of soup and heat 10 minutes covered. Stir in sour cream and mushrooms (optional) and heat through.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix sugar flour and milk. Melt butter in saucepan and pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour peaches with juice on top of butter in cake pan. Pour sugar flour and milk mixture on top of peaches. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven until golden brown. Different fruits can be used as well as sweet potatoes sugar and nutmeg. Eat warm or cooled tastes great either way. Enjoy!

title: Green Tomato Mince Meat
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook slowly for three hours. Place in pint or quart jars.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: Saute celery and onion in margarine until tender. (You can use broth instead of margarine to cut down on fat.) Add remaining ingredients except peas. Simmer about 20 minutes until potatoes and carrot are tender. Add peas and heat through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Pour hot water over sugar and shortening; cool to lukewarm. Add 1/2 cup flour; mix thoroughly. Stir in softened yeast half of remaining flour and egg; beat thoroughly. Add enough flour to form a soft dough. Turn out on lightly floured board; let rest 5 or 10 minutes. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover; let rise until double in bulk. Punch down; grease top. Cover with damp towel and refrigerate. When ready to bake shape into rolls and place in a well-greased pan. Let rise until double. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: In a bowl combine meat nutmeg pepper and salt. Shape meat into large patties and place on a rack. Broil 4 minutes on each side. Break patties into small pieces and place in a large saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer over low heat about 1 hour. Divide evenly. Yield 4 servings.

title: Buffalo Bills Chili
instructions: Brown the beef in your microwave on High (approximately 5 to 6 minutes). In microwave safe dish crumble beef and drain any fat. Add onion green pepper salt and pepper to taste chili powder crushed tomatoes tomato paste and kidney beans and microwave on High for approximately 23 to 25 minutes. Dish into bowls and serve. Enjoy!

title: Cream Cheese Party Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon parsley or nuts; form into a ball. Roll in bacon parsley or nuts. Refrigerate. Can also be used to fill cherry tomatoes.

title: Georgia Peach-Glazed Pork Roast
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Coat a roasting pan with cooking spray.

title: Apricot Steak
instructions: Season steak accordingly. Dredge in flour. Brown in skillet. Add onions 4 teaspoons flour and juice from canned apricots. Place in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Thirty minutes into baking put apricots on top of steak and return to oven.

title: Snickers Bars
instructions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dont grease. Boil the sugar milk and butter. Add the peanut butter marshmallow cream and vanilla. Cover the peanuts. Melt the caramels and hot water. Melt the chocolate chips peanut butter and butterscotch chips. Keep in refrigerator so chocolate doesnt stick to bottom of pan.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix buttermilk baking mix 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cocoa in greased 8-inch square baking dish. Stir in milk and vanilla until well blended. Sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/3 cup of cocoa and 1/2 cup sugar. Pour hot water evenly over top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until top is firm. Dust with confectioners sugar. Serve at once in dessert bowls with the sauce spooned over cake. Makes 6 servings. Good.

title: Low-Fat Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles; add olive oil to prevent them from sticking together. Brown ground beef onion and bell pepper. Drain fat from meat by putting in a strainer and \washing\ meat with hot tap water. Put meat back in skillet once drained and add mushrooms sauce oregano salt and pepper. Spray large pan with Pam. Layer sauce first noodles second cottage cheese then Mozzarella and/or Cheddar. Start over with sauce. Continue until pan is full.

title: Taco Crescent Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef in pan; drain. Stir in seasoning mix water and olives; simmer 5 minutes. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place triangles in ungreased 9 or 10-inch pie pan; press over bottom and up sides to form a crust. Sprinkle 1 cup corn chips over bottom of crust. Spoon meat mixture over crust and crushed corn chips. Spread sour cream over meat mixture; cover with cheese. Sprinkle remaining chips over top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. If desired serve in wedges topped with shredded lettuce and avocado slices. Refrigerate any leftovers. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables potatoes and cabbage in three cups water until soft. Add tomato juice and canned beef. Simmer a short time to blend flavors.

title: Michigan Pasties
instructions: Combine flour and salt. With pastry blender or 2 knives used scissor fashion cut in lard until it resembles coarse crumbs. Add water and work until the dough can be handled and is not sticky. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate. Frozen pie crusts can be substituted.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients with mixer. Place in buttered dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix milk sugar and cocoa. Add vanilla and eggs; mix well. Add flour and butter. Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat again. Add oil vanilla and zucchini. Add dry ingredients and raisins or nuts. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured loaf bread pans or four 3 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Test with toothpick to be sure it is done.

title: Six Week Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add liquid mixture. Store batter in refrigerator up to 6 weeks. Make muffins as needed. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Potato Salad
instructions: Steam potatoes until tender. Cool slightly and cut into large pieces. Transfer to a large serving bowl. Cook bacon very crisp and mince. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons bacon grease and return bacon to pan with onion. Cook about 1 minute then stir in flour and sugar. Gradually mix in vinegar and water and stir over low heat until mixture thickens. Pour the sauce over the potatoes; sprinkle with parsley celery seed and peppers. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Killers(Serves 30 To 50)
instructions: Place sour cream in microwave to soften. Unwrap cream cheese and remove from aluminum foil wrapping and place in microwave to soften. Mix sour cream and cream cheese in a large bowl. Add in olives jalapenos and garlic; mix well. Using a rubber scraper or similar instrument spread some of the mixture onto a tortilla leaving approximately 1-inch of the tortilla free from the mixture around the circumference of the tortilla. Starting at the bottom of the tortilla fold the edge into the center of the tortilla; next fold the opposite edge into the center of the tortilla. Now fold the top half of the tortilla onto the bottom half of the tortilla and press gently to make sure the filling is squeezed to but not out of the ends of the tortilla shell; set aside. When finished with the tortillas wrap tightly in plastic and place in refrigerator for several hours to stiffen (can be made a day in advance). Before serving slice folded tortillas on a bias into quarters. Arrange pieces on platter in a geometric design of your choice and garnish plate with thin strips of red green and yellow bell peppers amongst the killers.

title: Corn Sticks
instructions: Sift meal flour salt and soda 3 times. Add the milk and beaten egg yolk melted margarine and lastly beaten egg white. Pour small amount into piping hot greased corn stick pans and bake in hot oven (425\u00b0) for 15 minutes. Serve hot and with a generous amount of margarine. Yields 8 to 10 sticks.

title: Pecan Glaze
instructions: In a saucepan combine sugar tartar and water; stir as mixture heats until sugar dissolves. Wipe away any sugar crystals that may form on the side when dripped from a spoon. Using a long sharp pin dip pecan halves one at a time into glaze and place on a buttered dish. Work fast for glaze hardens rapidly. Dates almonds Brazil nuts Malaga grapes orange sections and even violets may be treated in this way.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
instructions: Mix together sugar evaporated milk margarine and salt. Then bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove mixture from heat and add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered pan and chill.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Heat and stir sugar syrup and 1 cup water in a heavy 3-quart saucepan until sugar dissolves. Cook over medium heat to soft ball stage (234\u00b0). Add nuts and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook to hard crack stage (305\u00b0) stirring often. Remove from heat. Quickly stir in butter and soda. Pour at once onto 2 well-buttered 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pans spreading with spatula. If desired cool slightly and pull with forks to stretch. Break up when cold. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Buffalo Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Dip chicken in mixture of melted butter pepper sauce and vinegar. Put in baking pan. Sprinkle with 1 package dry dressing mix. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Orzo With Onions And Peppers
instructions: Cook orzo until al dente. Melt butter; fry onion pepper and frozen peppers. Sprinkle with soup mix powder. Mix with orzo.

title: Baked Peaches And Cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Drain peaches reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Arrange peaches cut side up in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Add reserved liquid. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle evenly over peaches.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Mix sugar with sour cream. Stir into other ingredients.

title: Hawaiian Bread
instructions: Combine pineapple and coconut. Add beaten eggs and mix. Sift together the sugar flour salt and soda. Add to pineapple mixture. Pour into well-greased and floured pans. (Makes 2 large or 3 small pans.) Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie crusts. Top with Cool Whip. Place in refrigerator overnight or several hours. Makes 2 pies.

title: Peach Preserves
instructions: Boil peaches sugar and pineapple for 15 minutes. Remove from stove. Add jello and stir well and put in jars. Seal in hot water bath 10 minutes or turn jars upside down overnight.

title: Sausage Corn Bread Wheel
instructions: Brown links in pan over low heat. Drain off drippings. Arrange in pinwheel on bottom of round pan. Sift together dry ingredients into medium sized bowl. Add egg milk and drippings. Beat until smooth about 1 minute. Do not overbeat. Pour over sausage links. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Invert on platter. Garnish with parsley and apple slices if desired. Serve with sausage gravy.

title: Savory Pot Roast
instructions: Heat oil in large kettle then brown meat on all sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in mushroom soup onion soup mix and 1 cup water. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 2 hours. Add vegetables cover and cook 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove meat and vegetables. Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth. Gradually stir into soup mixture and thicken stirring constantly. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.

title: Apricot Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve the jello in the sugar and water. Add cream cheese pineapple and baby food. Blend until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Blueberry Yum-Yum
instructions: Combine blueberries 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup water in a medium saucepan. Cook over low heat until berries are soft about 15 minutes. Combine cornstarch and 3 tablespoons water in a small mixing bowl. Stir well. Add cornstarch to blueberry mixture. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Set aside to cool.

title: Honey Bread
instructions: In a large mixing bowl pour 1 1/2 cups of very hot water. Add salt butter and honey; stir until melted. Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of warm water and then add to other ingredients. Add flour mixing well after each cup is added. Dump dough onto a floured board and knead 10 minutes. Grease a large bowl with butter. Place dough into buttered bowl and turn once to coat entire surface of dough. Place wet cloth on top and allow to rise for 1 1/2 hours. Test dough by pressing with finger; when hole remains in dough punch down. Turn onto work table. Divide into 4 parts. Place each into a greased loaf pan. Let rise again about 1 hour. Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all fruit together. Sprinkle instant pudding 1 box at a time. Chill before serving. If desired use sugar-free puddings and lite fruit.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake about 1/2 hour or until set in the middle at 350\u00b0.

title: Nut Cups
instructions: Mix together. Roll into 24 balls the size of a quarter. Refrigerate until firm while preparing filling.

title: Cheddar Cheese Chowder
instructions: In large pot bring chicken stock to boil. Add vegetables. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until they are tender. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour; cook 1 minute. Gradually add milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Add cheese; stir until melted. Stir cheese sauce into vegetables. Cook over low heat until thoroughly heated. Do not boil. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: In medium size bowl mix Marshmallow Creme and cream cheese with mixer until well blended. Put in refrigerator until cool.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
instructions: Melt margarine and add to crumbs and place on pie plate in dish 11 x 8 or 12 x 9.

title: Sweet Sandwich Filling
instructions: Combine sugar egg and lemon in double boiler. Cook until thick. Allow to cool and add pecans raisins and mayonnaise. Spread onto bread; makes 2 dozen sandwiches.

title: Baked Spareribs
instructions: Bake ribs. Salt and pepper 1 1/4 hours uncovered at 350\u00b0. Mix all other ingredients and pour over baked ribs and bake 1 hour more uncovered. Serves 4.

title: Salmon With Lemon Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in heated butter until golden. Set aside. Drain salmon pouring liquid into measuring cup. Add enough milk to liquid to make 1/2 cup. Mix together onion salmon liquid bread crumbs eggs poultry seasoning parsley salt and nutmeg. Shape into 4 mounds and place in medium shallow baking dish. Mix together 1/2 cup milk soup lemon juice and paprika. Pour around salmon. Top each mound with 3 olive slices. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spiced Muffinsfort Morgan, Colorado
instructions: Mix all ingredients in usual manner. Put soda in hot applesauce to dissolve it and add to batter.

title: No Peek Casserole
instructions: Add all ingredients into a Dutch oven with lid; mix. Cook covered in 300\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. Do not peek! Serve on hot rice or noodles. May use sour cream if desired.

title: Cole Slaw With Buttermilk Dressing
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; toss well and set aside. Combine sugar and next 7 ingredients and stir well. Pour over cabbage mixture and toss gently. Cover and chill 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl and begin adding buttermilk until batter is stiff. Drop from spoon in hot cooking oil.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water add pineapple and pie filling. Stir and congeal. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually add sugar. Blend in sour cream. Spread over top congealed mixture. Top with nuts.

title: Fruit Bars
instructions: Mix all together like pie dough. Put half on bottom (pressed down) on cookie sheet with sides. Add prepared apricot filling or other fruit. Enough to cover the dough dont over do it. Put rest of dough on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Golden Potato Bake
instructions: Heat oven to\t375\u00b0. Mix cornflake crumbs and salt. Brush potatoes with margarine. Coat with crumbs. Arrange in ungreased baking pan. Bake until tender 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and celery in margarine. Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and eggs well. Sift flour soda and salt together. Add alternately to creamed mixture with mashed bananas. Mix well; add nuts and vanilla. Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Before serving cover with a layer of whipped cream and sprinkle some grated American cheese on top (optional).

title: Easy Baked Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Arrange in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Mix together soup and sour cream. Spoon mixture over chicken. Drizzle water over chicken mixture in dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: New West Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise ginger and salt. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Mix all together and pour over roast in crock-pot. Cook all night for lunch all day for dinner. While still in crock take fork and shred apart leaving in crock in gravy. Serve over rice potatoes or makes great submarine sandwiches.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients except sharp cheese. Cook in oven for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Add sharp cheese; cook until melted.

title: Jackie'S Quiche
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour into pie shells. Bake 40 to 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Three Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Microwave for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Set aside grated carrots cherries and nuts. Combine dry ingredients and sift into a large bowl. Add oil carrots and vanilla; stir by hand until well done then beat for 3 minutes. Add nuts and cherries. Bake in greased and floured angel cake pan for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Moist Dressing
instructions: Melt margarine. Cook onion and celery until tender. Mix with bread crumbs and cornbread crumbs. Add spices. Pour soup over mixture and mix all ingredients well. Pour enough chicken broth over mixture until desired moistness. Spread in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or stuff in turkey and roast. Serves 12.

title: Nachos Grande
instructions: Brown meat in large skillet; drain. Add taco sauce; simmer. Melt cheese with milk to make cheese sauce. Add more milk if needed for desired consistency.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into quarters. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Boil for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain potatoes and mash with sour cream cream cheese and chives. Grease large casserole dish add potato mixture and sprinkle with grated cheese and paprika. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes. Can be frozen before baking for up to 3 months.

title: Choc-Oat-Chips Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in oats chocolate morsels and nuts; mix well.

title: Jalapeno Cocktail Pie
instructions: Sprinkle peppers on well-greased 9-inch square pan; cover with cheese. Pour eggs over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm. Cool and cut into 1-inch squares.

title: At-Home Cappuccino
instructions: Combine all ingredients in covered shaker and shake until well blended. Pour in tall glass and relax!

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Blend oil eggs sugar and vanilla flavoring. Sift together flour soda salt and cinnamon. Combine mixture. Fold in nuts and apples. Bake in a tube pan 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Elegant Zucchini
instructions: Parboil the zucchini carrots and onion. Place 1 1/2 cups of croutons in buttered baking dish. Save 1 1/2 cups for top. Mix chicken soup and sour cream. Add vegetables to the soup mixture. Pour over croutons and cover with rest of croutons. Drizzle melted oleo over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Wonderful!

title: Spicy Oatmeal Cookies(A Delicious Cookie That Many Don'T Believe Are Oatmeal)
instructions: *Chop raisins and oatmeal together in food processor.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Pour morsels and milk into Pyrex dish and cook on High 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Let cool before cutting.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Pour sugar salt cocoa and cornstarch in saucepan; mix well. Stir in hot water. Add vanilla. Cook over medium heat until thick; stir constantly. Add butter.

title: Raspberry Quick And Easy Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Stir in raspberries and applesauce. Gel. Put a layer of sour cream or nonfat yogurt on top before serving.

title: Wheat Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix together Cool Whip pineapple and softened cream cheese. Sprinkle with pudding mix. Lastly stir in drained cooled wheat and mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Milwaukee German Toffee(To Make About 4 Pounds)
instructions: Use heavy pot like pressure cooker.

title: Taffy
instructions: Butter an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. In a 2-quart saucepan combine sugar corn syrup water cornstarch butter and salt. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly to 256\u00b0 on candy thermometer (above 200\u00b0 on meat thermometer) or until firm. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour into pan. When cool enough pull taffy until satiny and hard. Butter hands if taffy is sticky. Put into long strings. Cut into pieces and wrap. Serves 6.

title: Turkey Divan
instructions: In a flat Pyrex dish put a layer of broccoli and turkey. Prepare sauce by mixing remaining ingredients except bread crumbs and margarine. Pour sauce over broccoli and turkey. Top with bread crumbs and margarine. Make at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be made ahead and heated.

title: Cream Of Spinach Soup
instructions: Drain spinach thoroughly; set aside. Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender and add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk and stir in spinach salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Makes about 1 quart.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Empty one envelope Shake n Bake into its plastic shaker bag. Add Parmesan cheese and oregano. Place chicken breasts in the bag one at a time and coat.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar zucchini vanilla oil salt soda powder and cinnamon. Add nuts if desired. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage in a medium skillet until browned; drain and set aside. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles; place triangles with elongated points toward center in a greased 12-inch pizza pan. Press bottom and sides to form a crust seal perforations; sprinkle with hash brown potatoes Cheddar cheese and sausage. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes. Garnish with fresh oregano if desired.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add oil water and food color. Stir and knead until smooth. Fun for kids and grandmas. Store in covered tight containers.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Precook cornbread and cool. Precook 1 cup water 1/2 stick butter 1 chopped onion and 1/2 cup celery. In extra large pan mix (by hand with a whisk) chicken soups eggs and seasonings. Add cornbread milk and toast. Add precooked items while slightly warm. If dry add another can of broth and milk. This makes two large casserole dishes. Cook at 350\u00b0 until middle is firm. Time varies depending on size of dish. A clean knife test will work. This can also be prepared ahead of time and frozen.

title: Inferno Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a crock-pot. Stir often until the cheese is melted.

title: Cherry Jubilee
instructions: For crust add flour sugar pecans and melted oleo together and bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool and crumble in same pan or one of equal size. Reserve 1/2 cup. Spread 2 cans of pie filling over crumbled crust.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat together cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. Stir in 1/4 cup cereal chocolate chips and raisins. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Shape into ball. Roll into remaining cereal to coat. Serve with apple or pear wedges unsalted crackers or graham crackers. Can make up to 3 days ahead.

title: Oven French Fries
instructions: Combine Parmesan cheese and oregano and set aside. Cut each potato lengthwise into 8 wedges. Dip into egg white and dredge in Parmesan cheese mixture. Place fries on a baking sheet coated with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Dessert
instructions: Wash and cut up strawberries. Mix oranges and pineapple with strawberries. Beat pudding buttermilk and Cool Whip until thick. In large dish layer fruit then pudding. Top layer will be fruit.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
instructions: Prepare 1 box yellow cake mix as directed on the box. Bake in a 1 x 13 x 22-inch jelly roll pan for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool. Mix the pudding milk and cream cheese with a mixer. It will be thick. Fold in 9 ounces of Cool Whip. Place in refrigerator to set up a little. Place rest of ingredients of the cake in the following order spread pudding mixture on the cake thickly sprinkle well drained pineapple over pudding sprinkle chopped pecans over the pineapple and sprinkle coconut on top. Place the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. You may freeze the cake for a later day. Just thaw and serve.

title: Cheese Danish
instructions: Grease 11 x 13 Pyrex dish. Layer bottom of dish with 1 can rolls. Mix cream cheese sugar egg yolk and vanilla. Pour this mixture over rolls. Top with other can of rolls. Brush with egg white and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Snappy Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Place beef in a Dutch oven. Combine all ingredients except the rolls; pour over beef. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 hours turning beef occasionally. Shred beef with a fork. Serve on rolls or buns. Yield About 24 servings.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti and combine all ingredients except part of cheese. Place in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Rhubarb Jelly
instructions: Cook rhubarb sugar and water until tender. Remove from heat. Add jello. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Place broccoli in baking dish. Top with sliced chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine chicken soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Pour this over chicken and cheese. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top with additional cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serve with yellow rice.

title: End Of Garden Relish
instructions: Grind the first 6 ingredients and mix with 6 tablespoons of salt. Let stand for 20 minutes. Drain.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until brown (skillet). Drain excess fat. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place on a greased 12-inch pan with points toward center. Press bottom and sides to form a crust. Seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese. In separate bowl beat eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour into crust. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Payday Cake
instructions: Mix yellow cake mix 1/3 cup oleo and 1 egg in 9 x 13-inch pan for 12 to 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. When baked and while still hot put 3 cups mini-marshmallows on top. Then add following topping heat corn syrup 1/4 cup oleo peanut butter chips and vanilla. Heat until smooth stirring constantly. Then add rice crispies and salted peanuts. Spread over marshmallows. Tastes like a Payday candy bar.

title: Scalloped Salmon For Two
instructions: Drain salmon reserving liquid; remove skin and bones if desired. Flake salmon with fork. Dissolve bouillon in boiling water in a bowl. Add salmon liquid milk egg parsley and onion; mix well. Add salmon stuffing mix and cheese mixing well. Place in 2 greased 10-ounce custard cups or casseroles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with vegetable sauce if desired. (Vegetable sauce can be found in the Soup Salads and Sauces section of this cookbook.)

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: In measuring cup combine first 5 ingredients. Heat wok and add next 4 ingredients. Fry 3 minutes. Remove chicken. Add next 5 ingredients. Add sauce. Heat until it bubbles. Add chicken and serve over hot rice.

title: Pineapple Pie(Low Sugar)
instructions: Combine pineapple sour cream and pudding in bowl. Beat at medium speed until blended. Spoon mixture into crust. Top with whipped topping. Cover and chill at least 3 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain. Mix together soup egg onion cheese and salt and pepper. Pour over broccoli. Cover with bread crumbs. Pour on melted butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Chicken Imperial
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving in 1-quart saucepan over high heat heat all ingredients except chicken. Arrange chicken halves skin side up in large open roasting pan. Pour liquid mixture over chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately one hour basting frequently with pan juices.

title: Quick Italian Quiche
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs and then add all remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly and pour into lightly greased glass baking dish (13 x 8-inch). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until set and lightly browned. Cut into squares. Serve hot or cold. Can be frozen and reheated.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate. Set aside.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and let stand a full 20 minutes. Combine the next 9 ingredients with oatmeal mixture. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. While cake is baking combine butter sugar milk and vanilla. Combine in saucepan over medium heat. Beat until butter melts and sugar dissolves. Add 1 cup pecans and 1 cup coconut. Spread over cake. Put back into oven until coconut browns slightly.

title: Janis' Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and marinate for 24 hours. Drain. Reserve some of liquid in the event some of vegetables are left over. Store in refrigerator in closed Tupperware container. Will keep for several weeks.

title: Chocolate Chip Brandy Balls
instructions: In bowl beat cream cheese sugar cream brandy extract salt cinnamon and nutmeg until creamy. Stir in Toll House semi-sweet morsels. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet; chill 5 minutes. Roll into balls and roll in the nuts. Makes 3 dozen balls.

title: How To Preserve Children
instructions: Mix children with dogs and empty into field stirring constantly. Sprinkle field with flowers. Pour brook gently over pebbles. Cover all with deep blue sky and bake in hot sun. When children are well browned they may be removed and placed in bathtubs to cool.

title: Memories Chicken Salad (Caf Memories In Iuka)
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until tender then shred.\tMix chicken with remaining ingredients and serve with fruit on lettuce leaf and croissant.

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water; add lemon juice and rind. Chill until partly set. Whip canned milk until stiff then add Jell-O. Pour into glass baking dish in which crumbs are on bottom. Put crumbs over top. Set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Crab Bites(Great Appetizer)
instructions: Mix together. Serve on 6 split English muffins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Slice like pizza. Serve hot.

title: Olive'S Omelet
instructions: Layer bread cubes sliced sausage and shredded cheese in a casserole. Beat eggs. Add milk and seasonings. Pour over casserole and refrigerate overnight. Bake one hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar flour and sweet milk and add beaten egg yolks. Cook in a double boiler until thick. Pour over layer of bananas then top with wafers. Brown at 400\u00b0.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Add enough water to cover apples. Mix first six ingredients to a crumbly stage. Sprinkle on top of apples. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until browned.

title: Laine'S Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour sugar baking soda and cinnamon. Add oil then add the beaten eggs and the salt. Beat batter; it will be thick. Fold in chopped walnuts carrots and raisins (optional). Grease pan with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 13 x 9-inch pan for 45 minutes to 1 hour or in a 10 x 4-inch pan for 40 minutes.

title: Rachel'S Sweet Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottom of muffin pan or use muffin paper cups. Beat egg. Stir in milk oil and salt. Add egg. Add baking powder flour and sugar. Mix together all ingredients. Batter should be lumpy. Pour batter into muffin pan or muffin cups. Bake about 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with your favorite beverage!

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Combine sugar and flour. Add sweet potatoes melted margarine and water. Mix well. If needed add more water to make mixture moist. Roll into small biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Mystery Drops
instructions: Boil sugar and milk 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in other ingredients. Stir until thickened. Drop on wax paper.

title: Chocolate Bread Pudding(Microwave)
instructions: Melt butter with milk in microwave. Add dry ingredients; stir in beaten eggs. Pour over bread. Cook in microwave for 9 to 12 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Sprinkle in flour gradually add milk and bring to a boil. Add corn salt pepper and sugar. Heat thoroughly; remove from heat and add beaten eggs. Pour into 2 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Italian Pizzaburgers
instructions: Mix turkey cereal herbs and onions and form into 4 patties. On a nonstick pan sprayed with Pam fry until browned. Sprinkle on the cheese. Cover and cook until the cheese is melted.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Salt and pepper hash browns. Cream together the sour cream butter onion milk and soup. Mix creamed mixture with potatoes and place in casserole. Top with grated cheese and corn flakes. Drizzle 1/4 cup melted butter over top. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo in an electric skillet. Add sugar dates and egg. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat add cereal nuts and vanilla. Form into balls and roll in coconut.

title: Cube Steak Casserole
instructions: Place steak in large Pyrex dish. Layer onion carrots and potatoes on top. Heat soup with margarine and pour over casserole. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Honey Bars
instructions: Cream the first 4 ingredients together. Then add all other ingredients. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Level the dough evenly with a spoon. Bake in 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 30 minutes. Do not overbake. Bars are real chewy and moist.

title: Special Day Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients altogether; pat down in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat the eggs powdered sugar and cream cheese together for 5 minutes. Pour the mixture over the first mixture in the pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. May add chocolate chips if you wish.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large glass bowl. Put into jars with tight covers. Refrigerate for 2 weeks before using. These will keep for 2 years in the refrigerator. (A gallon sun tea jar works well if you have a glass one and enough room in the refrigerator.)

title: Jalapeno Hominy
instructions: Melt cheese in soup and mix with hominy. Add onions and top with Fritos. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corn Pone
instructions: Mix cornmeal bacon drippings salt and green onions. Pour enough boiling water to stick mixture together without being too dry or mushy. Form into oval cakes and fry in bacon drippings in skillet about 3 minutes on each side.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Make day before. Serve in hollowed out French bread.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
instructions: Slice 2 of the eggs into 1 1/2 qt. casserole. In a sauce pan melt butter blend in flour 1/2 tsp. and dash pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Cook sausage drain. Stir sausage and corn into sauce pour over eggs. Slice remaining eggs arrange atop mixture. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix in order. Let stand overnight. Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Tender Roast
instructions: Put all ingredients into a 10 x 10 x 3-inch Corning baking dish. Add 1-inch of water. Cover with lid. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda salt and cinnamon. Add sugar oil and eggs (mix well). Add carrots drained pineapple and nuts. Turn into 8-inch layer pans (greased and floured). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool in pan then turn out and cool on wire racks. Spread layer top and sides with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Flaky Pie Crust
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Use fork to mix in shortening. Then add cold water and vinegar. Mix well. Makes 2 pie crusts.

title: Rosemary'S Pink Salad
instructions: Mix together Cool Whip and sour cream. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directions indicate on package. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool cake. Then mix cream cheese and milk together until cheese dissolves. Add instant pudding and mix until thickened. Pour this over cake. Next pour drained pineapple on cake and top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Pepperoni Salad
instructions: Mix broccoli onions mushrooms pepperoni and dressing. Let stand for 2 hours. Toss in lettuce and top or toss with cheese.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Pour this mixture in a casserole dish and top with topping. Use Pam in dish first.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Combine with remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Pour in baked pie shell.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13 baking pan. In a large bowl mix jalapenos and creamed corn. Beat in the baking soda salt sugar and eggs (beating well). Add the buttermilk oil cheese and cornmeal. Mix well. Pour the batter into the greased pan and bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown. Serve it hot with butter!

title: Linguini Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together and refrigerate for several hours. May be served immediately if preferred.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Heat oil; add onion garlic and beef. Lightly brown meat-stir occasionally. Add tomato paste seasonings and tomatoes. Cover and cook over low heat approximately 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Alternate layers of cooked drained lasagna meat sauce cottage cheese Mozzarella slices and Parmesan. Repeat and end with Parmesan. Bake in large Pyrex dish approximately 13x9x2. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine sugar salt and cornstarch with milk over hot water. Cook over water on low heat until slightly thickened about 15 minutes. Beat egg yolks and add a little of hot milk mixture. Return to first mixture stirring constantly.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Sift together dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Add yeast and buttermilk to dry ingredients. Knead enough to hold together. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Will keep uncooked in covered pans in refrigerator for 2 to 3 days. No need to let rise.

title: Escalloped Corn
instructions: Pour egg into a 6-cup buttered casserole. Heat corn and milk; gradually stir into beaten egg. Add salt breadcrumbs and cheese; mix thoroughly. Bake uncovered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Freida'S Low Calorie Dessert
instructions: Pour in cooled pie crust and top with low-fat Cool Whip.

title: Potato Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add beaten egg yolks. Continue to beat adding milk and hot potatoes sifted flour with baking powder and beaten egg whites. Bake. Makes 6 layers.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Combine flour pecans and butter in bowl; mix well. Press into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Banana Split Salad
instructions: Mix banana pudding mix with crushed pineapple. Then add other ingredients leaving the whipped topping to be added last. Refrigerate.

title: Sandra'S Crab Soup
instructions: Boil crabs for 10 minutes. Turn heat off; let crabs soak in seasoned water for 20 to 30 minutes. Cool crabs and pick saving \roe\ if fortunate to have \she crabs.\ (The more crabs the better.)

title: Turtle Stew
instructions: Scald the turtle with boiling water and the hard shell. Clean well with lime then season with salt black pepper and garlic. Sprinkle with capers and Worcestershire sauce and let stand for 1 to 2 hours. Chop onions tomatoes and sweet pepper. Saute these ingredients in oil and butter. Add turtle and allow to brown then pour on 2 cups of warm water and steam until tender. Quarter potatoes and add to stew. Let simmer until gravy thickens. Add sherry just before serving. Serve piping hot.

title: Baked Onions
instructions: Layer in greased casserole onions cheese and bread. In a separate bowl mix egg milk salt and pepper. Pour mixture over the top. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Mix together margarine water peanut butter and oil in a large pan. Bring to boil. Take off heat and add remaining ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Pour into well-greased and floured pan (10 x 15-inches or 9 x 13-inches). Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in 10 x 15-inch pan at 350\u00b0. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0.

title: B~B~Q Tomato
instructions: Cut 1/2 way in the tomato in several spots. Wrap in aluminum foil. Cut butter and place in foil also. Wrap good and cook until tender.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into tube pan. Put into icebox for 24 hours.

title: Butterfingers
instructions: Mix thoroughly; shape dough into 2 1/2-inch logs and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 17 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Aunt Fanny'S Baked Squash
instructions: Wash and cut up squash. Boil until tender; drain thoroughly then mash. Add all ingredients except 1/2 of butter to squash. Melt remaining butter. Pour mixture in baking dish then spread melted butter over top and sprinkle with cracker meal or bread crumbs. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for approximately one hour or until brown on top.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Cut all vegetables into serving pieces preferably diagonally and in uniform sizes. Cut all meats and shrimp in bite size pieces and set aside. Wash Chinese mushrooms and soak them in 1/2-cup warm water. Saute garlic and onions in hot oil until all are golden brown. Add sliced shrimp chicken livers previously cut up and the cooked pork. Season with soy sauce and salt and pepper. Pour in chicken stock. Allow to cook for about 5 minutes. Then add carrots cauliflower cabbage and Chinese mushroom with the 1/2 cup water it was soaked in. Allow to cook in an open pan. Add the rest of the vegetables. Cook until vegetables are cooked.

title: Banana-Apple Bread
instructions: Cream shortening; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Stir in apple and bananas. Combine flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture stirring just enough to blend. Spoon batter into greased and floured pan. Bake for 1 hour. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Cool completely on wire rack.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Brown the meats; drain. Heat tomatoes and cheese together until cheese melts then add this to the meat mixture. Add hot sauce to taste. Serve over tortilla chips.

title: Easy Mini Cheesecakes
instructions: Mix crumb mixture as directed on package. Press onto bottoms of 12 paper-lined muffin cups. Prepare filling mix as directed on package. Spoon over crumb mixture. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until ready to serve. Garnish as desired. Makes 12 servings.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef; drain. Mix spaghetti sauce season and ground beef. Add a dash of oregano or to your taste; let simmer. Boil spaghetti until tender. Mix spaghetti sauce and spaghetti; take half and pour into casserole dish. Top with Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese. Add the rest of the mixture; top with Mozzarella cheese and Cheddar cheese. Place in the oven for 5 to 10 minutes then serve.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place butter in a 13 x 9 inch pan put in oven to melt butter. Remove from oven and sprinkle crumbs over butter pressing down with a fork. Sprinkle coconut over crumbs add a layer of chips and one of almonds. Drizzle condensed milk evenly over top. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool before cutting.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Cream this together and add 1 box powdered sugar. Mix with oleo and peanut butter. Make into balls. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes *
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Sift together soda and flour; add to first mixture. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain well. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and line bottom of pan with crescent rolls firmly pressing perforations to seal. Sprinkle sausage and Mozzarella cheese over dough. Combine eggs and milk and pour over sausage and cheese. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put Cheddar cheese on top and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken until thoroughly done and falls off the bone. Do not chop or grind chicken. Just cut into bite size pieces. Amounts of mayonnaise pickle cubes salt and pepper will vary to suit the taste of the cook.

title: Mrs. Lombardi'S Meatballs
instructions: Brown meatballs in olive oil. Remove. Saute onion and garlic in oil. Add meatballs. Pour on tomato sauce. Simmer in sauce about 3 hours. (Add 3 bay leaves.) Tremendous!

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring Karo sugar and water to a boil. Drop in peanuts. Cook until peanuts are done (they will pop and turn darker). Put in soda salt and vanilla. Pour on buttered plate; cool about 30 minutes and break.

title: Mexican Velveeta Cheese Dip
instructions: Saute onion chili and shortening. Add tomato juice and garlic salt. Mix all ingredients into melted cheese. If too thick add more tomato juice. Serve hot with corn chips.

title: Bubble Bread
instructions: Thaw loaves of bread. Place in greased pan (9 x 13-inch) in small chunks. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over bread. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Turn out on wax paper while hot.

title: Ritz Dessert
instructions: Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fried Zucchini
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet. Mix all ingredients together. Drop by tablespoon into skillet. Fry until golden brown approximately 1 minute on each side. Serves 5 to 8.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Beat cream cheese milk and vanilla in medium bowl on low speed until smooth. Gradually beat in powdered sugar 1 cup at a time until smooth and of spreading consistency. Frosts a 13 x 9-inch or fills and frosts two 8 or 9-inch cake layers. Refrigerate any remaining frosting.

title: Oatmeal Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour baking powder cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture alternately with milk. Beat well after each addition. Stir in oats raisins and nuts. Mix well. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Easy Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops leaving drippings in pan. Add both soups and let simmer for 30 minutes. Serve with any rice or potato.

title: Sweet And Sour Cukes And Onions
instructions: Peel cucumbers and slice very thin. Place in a glass bowl. Peel onion; slice very thin and separate into rings. Add to bowl with the cucumbers. Add sugar water vinegar and vegetable oil. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add dill weed. Stir and let stand at room temperature at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Tequila Berry Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve on shredded lettuce.

title: Shrimp And Rice Rockefeller
instructions: Cook onions in butter until tender but not browned. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp are just pink about 2 minutes. Stir in soup Swiss cheese and sherry; heat until soup is warm. Add rice water chestnuts spinach lemon juice and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Season to taste. Turn into greased shallow (2-quart) casserole. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes or until hot in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 8.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain water off in morning. Add fresh water and boil gently about 1/2 hour. Drain. Cut salt pork into 4 pieces. Add beans salt and remaining ingredients to bean pot. Cover. Cook all day at 300\u00b0 (at least 8 hours for best results). Add water if necessary. Great for a picnic! Freezes well.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix; beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into a 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of the wafers bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice ending with pudding. Chill thoroughly. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Stir in rice. When rice is cooked remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.

title: Canned Venison
instructions: Pack jars with raw meat to 1/2 inch from top. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to a quart jar. Add no liquid. Process in pressure canner for 90 minutes (70 minutes for pint jars). Or cook in a hot water bath for 3 1/2 hours.

title: Crab Pie
instructions: Beat eggs crush onion rings. Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 20 minutes until brown.

title: Spanish Slaw
instructions: In a bowl combine cabbage and green pepper. In a jar with tight-fitting lid combine remaining ingredients; shake well. Pour over cabbage mixture just before serving; toss to coat. Serve with a slotted spoon. Yield 6 servings.

title: Tori Age(Fried Chicken - Japanese-Style)
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Let stand at least 2 to 3 hours. Deep fry at 350\u00b0. Serve with mustard/shoyu sauce if desired.

title: Good For You, Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken breasts in mixture of egg and milk then shake in bag with herb mix. Place oil in large flat pan and place chicken skin side down. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes then turn chicken over for 15 minutes more.

title: Strawberry Cake Dessert
instructions: Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle marshmallows on the bottom. Combine strawberries and gelatin and set aside (use the syrup and dont add water to the gelatin).

title: Spiced Apple Spread(Using Sure-Jell Light)
instructions: Combine pectin with 1/4 cup of the sugar. Mix applesauce and spices in large bowl. Add pectin mixture gradually to fruit stirring vigorously. Set aside for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir remaining sugar gradually into fruit mixture until sugar is dissolved about 3 minutes. Pour into plastic containers; cover. Let stand at room temperature 24 hours. Spread is now ready to use. Store in refrigerator up to 3 weeks or freeze extra containers up to 1 year. Thaw in refrigerator. Makes about 5 (1 cup) containers.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. You can saute the onion and celery in the butter if you like first.

title: Holiday Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Sweet Potato Sausage Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Roll into balls and place on greased sheet pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Fantastic Squash Casserole
instructions: *Dried minced green onion can be used as a substitute.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Heat first 4 ingredients in saucepan until well mixed. Add milk vanilla and salt. Cook until thick. Serve over ice cream.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and shortening. Add dry ingredients alternately with tomato soup.

title: Polish Raisin-Walnut Puffs
instructions: In a medium sized saucepan bring raisins water and butter to a boil. Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook stirring constantly until thick. Remove from heat and stir in walnuts lemon peel juice and vanilla. Cool completely. Thaw puff pastry for 20 minutes and unfold. On a lightly floured surface roll each sheet to a 9 x 15-inch rectangle then cut into 3-inch squares. Put about 2 teaspoons of filling in the center of each square; moisten corners of pastry with water and bring together to make a four cornered puff. Press firmly to seal. Bake on a cookie sheet in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes until golden. Unbaked puffs may be wrapped tightly in plastic wrap and frozen until ready to bake. Makes 30 puffs.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Combine all ingredients except peaches in baking dish. Lay peaches on top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: White Bread
instructions: Mix 2 cups water 2 packages yeast and 2 tablespoons sugar. Let mix double. Add 2 cups very warm water salt and oil; add flour until stiff and knead. Put in greased pan and raise. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Stew
instructions: Cook ingredients until tender. Tiny shell macaroni 1/2 package. Add not too long before other ingredients are done.

title: Calizonas
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place frozen bread in bread pans and let thaw. Do not let rise just thaw. Scramble sausage in a skillet until browned. Shred cheese(s). Pinch bread into 3 to 4 separate sections (each loaf). Butter hands and press flat and stretch dough until about 6 inches across. Add sausage 4 to 5 tablespoons each on pressed dough. Add cheese about 1/3 cup each. Fold over to make a pastry like fold. Bake on a cookie sheet for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Family-Styled Short Ribs
instructions: Brown short ribs on all sides in oil. Pour off drippings. Season with salt and pepper. Add water bouillon vinegar Worcestershire sauce and the onion slices. Cover tightly and cook slowly for 2 hours or until meat is fork-tender. Pour out cooking liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups. Use water if needed. Thicken the liquid for gravy. Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Frozen Chocolate Delight(Good Summer Dessert)
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients in top of a double boiler. Bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cook until chocolate is melted. Remove from heat; set aside to cool.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve on spinach salad.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Put oatmeal into blender in small amounts and blend until it turns to powder. Measure first and then blend. Mix all dry ingredients together and then mix with sugar mixture. Add chocolate chips Hershey bar and nuts. Make golf ball sized cookies and place on cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Makes 112 cookies.

title: Old-Fashioned Sweet Potato Pie *
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes peel and mash then add margarine syrup white sugar flour and seasoning. Bake in 9-inch crust. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Vanilla-Butter And Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco margarine sugar and salt for 7 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour and milk alternately beginning and ending with flour. Fold in flavoring. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Start in COLD oven and do not open door while baking. Cool on rack and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Cheese-Spinach Soup
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan cook onion and celery in butter until onion is tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir until thickened. Stir in spinach and cheese. Cook and stir until cheese is melted.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake(Easy And Good For Potlucks!)
instructions: Grease and flour cookie sheet pan. Mix all together and pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs lightly in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Roll into walnut sized balls. Transfer to baking sheet. Bake until golden about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Mother'S Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Layer bottom of casserole dish with tortilla strips hamburger meat tomatoes beans onion and cheese. Mix soups together with small amount of water and spread over top of casserole. Begin layering again and end up with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or microwave on High for 10 minutes.

title: Mom'S Barbecue Buns
instructions: In a large bowl thoroughly mix 2 cups flour dry milk solids sugar salt and undissolved yeast. Add margarine.

title: Chocolate Syrup For Drinks
instructions: Boil sugar and water 5 minutes. Add chocolate salt and the cornstarch dissolved in cold water. Stir until smooth. Cook 3 minutes. Cool. Add vanilla. Store in a jar in refrigerator.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix the gelatin sugar and salt in a saucepan. Beat together the egg yolks lime juice and water; stir into the gelatin mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly just until the mixture comes to a boil. Remove from the heat; stir in the grated peel. Add the food coloring sparingly to give a pale green color. Chill stirring occasionally until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon. Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form; gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating to stiff peaks. Fold the gelatin mixture into the egg whites; fold the whipped cream. Pile into the pastry shell. Chill until firm. Spread with additional whipped cream and edge with grated lime.

title: Country Cookies
instructions: In the large bowl of an electric mixer cream shortening granulated sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; beat until blended. Add flour. Sprinkle baking soda and salt over top. Beat until no traces of flour can be seen. With a wooden spoon work in oats and coconut.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt in a big bowl. Add shortening peanut butter milk and vanilla. Beat well. Add eggs and beat again. Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Mother Ruth'S Pimiento Cheese
instructions: Blend in mixer blender or food processor. Add salt pepper hot sauce and garlic powder to taste. Fix a day ahead and keep in sealed container. Will keep for 2 to 3 weeks in refrigerator. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Easy Baked Crock Pot Beans
instructions: Brown meat green peppers and onions. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker for 4 to 6 hours on low.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut flowerettes from broccoli. Layer broccoli raisins onion bacon and water chestnuts in bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over salad. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Stain Glass Candy
instructions: Heat first three ingredients to 290\u00b0 with a candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Quickly add flavoring oil and food coloring. Pour onto cookie sheet that has been covered with aluminum foil. Let harden. Peel foil off. Hold one end up with one hand and break candy into small pieces with back of a spoon. Be sure to store in an air tight container.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender; cool. Combine all ingredients. Marinate at least 12 hours. Drain.

title: Broccoli-Beef Pie
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Drain off fat. Stir in flour salt and garlic. Add milk and softened cream cheese. Cook and stir until bubbly. Add moderate amount of hot mixture to beaten egg. Return to mixture in skillet. Cook until thickened 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in broccoli. Set aside.

title: Easy Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar in mixer bowl until light. Beat in eggs one at a time. Combine flour baking soda and salt in large bowl. Add to shortening mixture alternately with bananas mixing well after each addition. Stir in nuts. Spoon into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Jiffy Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Lightly grease 2 loaf pans. Put salt molasses oil and oats in a large bowl. Add boiling water. When the mixture is lukewarm add eggs and yeast; let stand until yeast is dissolved then add flour. Stir and let stand 20 minutes (no kneading). Turn out on floured board; knead and cut into 4 equal parts. Put 2 parts in each bread pan. Let rise until doubled in bulk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Skillet Hamburger Pie
instructions: In skillet cook beef celery and onion until meat is browned and vegetables are crisp and tender. Stir in Worcestershire sauce salt beans gravy mix and 1 cup water. Simmer to thicken and blend flavors. Whip potatoes according to directions. Spoon in mounds over meat. Top with paprika and shredded cheese. Cover. Heat until cheese melts. Serves 6.

title: Macaroni-Cheese Salad
instructions: Add all ingredients to the macaroni. Serves 6.

title: Microwave Chili Con Queso Dip
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave on High power for 1 minute. Stir and microwave for 1 additional minute. Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

title: Chocolate Filled Eggs(Easter Treat)
instructions: One egg at a time use a pin or the tip of a sharp knife to make a small hole in the top of each egg and a larger hole in the bottom (3/8-inch). (Hold egg over bowl.) Blow the egg white and yolk into the bowl (can be used for cooking). Carefully fill the egg with water and blow it out again. Rinse repeatedly to remove all traces of egg. Let the eggs drain and dry (an old egg carton is good for this) in a warm place for several days. Melt the chocolate over very low heat stirring constantly to 125\u00b0. When completely melted remove from heat and stir constantly while cooling until a dab placed just above your lip feels cool. Pour chocolate into hollow eggs. Let cool. Makes a great Easter surprise.

title: Pasta With Cauliflower
instructions: First brown bread crumbs in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Stir constantly; pour into a bowl. Set aside for later use. Clean cauliflower. Cut into small flowerets. Cover bottom of 4-quart pot with olive oil. Add garlic and cauliflower. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cook covered over medium heat 10 to 15 minutes. Stir often. Add chicken broth. Turn heat to high; bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix crackers and oil until well coated. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Store in Ziploc bag and enjoy.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add sherbet. Allow to cool and thicken. When mixture is thick add pineapple oranges and bananas. Fold in whipped cream. Let set several hours or overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt butter; stir in sugar. Cook and stir over low heat for 2 minutes. Add milk; bring to a boil. Cool to room temperature. Beat in powdered sugar until like fudge. Stir in nuts; pour in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate cheese in blender. Mix all ingredients together and form into a ball. Roll in chopped nuts. Wrap and refrigerate to set. Better overnight.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: In large punch bowl combine sugar and water. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add lemon juice orange juice pineapple juice grape juice tea and grapefruit juices. Mix well (chill thoroughly). At serving time stir in ginger ale and garnish with orange slices studded with whole cloves lemon slices and cherries.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shells. Bake 30 minutes or until light brown.

title: Bean-Pea Salad
instructions: Drain canned vegetables well. Add to chopped vegetables. Set aside. In small saucepan bring vinegar oil and sugar to a boil. Pour over vegetables. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Cut the Velveeta into 5 blocks. Place in crock-pot on high. Add jar of salsa. Stir frequently until all cheese is melted. Reduce heat to low and continue to stir occasionally. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Sudden Russian Tea
instructions: Mix well. Use 2 teaspoonfuls of mixture to one cup boiling water for each cup of this tea.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon crisp. Add onion and seasonings to bacon grease. Simmer for a few minutes. Add potatoes and crumble bacon on top. Serve hot.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Blend together first 3 ingredients. Then mix in lard like pie dough. Add eggs vanilla or lemon flavoring and buttermilk with soda. Roll out and cut.

title: Spinach Souffle Pie
instructions: Do not prick the pastry shell before baking. Partially bake the pastry shell in a 450\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes; remove from oven and cool on rack.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cream margarine and sugar blend in eggs. Add flour; mix well. Spread on bottom and 2 inches high around sides of 9-inch cheesecake spring-form pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Ground Meat Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and season with salt pepper and garlic powder. Add onion and green pepper. Simmer 30 minutes and then drain off any excess grease. Next add tomato and mushroom soup. Simmer for 10 minutes. Cook macaroni and drain. Add macaroni and beans with meat mixture in casserole dish. Top with grated cheese and place in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves 8.

title: Good Corn Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients; bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes. Thicken with 1/4 cup cornstarch dissolved in 1/2 cup water. Bring to boil again. Seal in jars 6 or 7 pints. I make this at Christmas time and use it for gifts.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in water in a covered saucepan or microwave until crisp-tender; drain. Place broccoli in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch (2-quart) baking dish; set aside. Combine chicken soup mayonnaise Parmesan cheese and curry powder; spoon over broccoli. Top with bread cubes and butter. Bake chicken casserole uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Chicken casserole serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil on low heat until soft ball forms in cold water. Beat until smooth. Pour into pan and let cool. Cut into very small pieces. Candy is very rich.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except coconut. Form into balls and roll in coconut.

title: Drum Stick Cake
