instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into 9 x 13 glass pan. Spread ice cream over Cocoa Krispie mixture. Spread hot fudge over ice cream. Sprinkle peanuts on last. Freeze overnight. Serve frozen.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Pour cherries and pineapple in cake pan. Stir in coconut. Pour cake mix on top of mixture. Slice butter in pats and place on top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sarah'S Strawberry Jello
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Chill 1/2 of this mixture. Spread sour cream over chilled Jell-O. Top with rest of the Jell-O mixture. Chill and cut to serve. Serves 15.

title: Cauliflower With Cheese
instructions: Microwave whole cauliflower in a covered casserole dish for 10 minutes. Mix together the mayonnaise grated cheese and mustard in a small bowl. Pour on cauliflower and microwave on High for 3 minutes uncovered.

title: Salad Dressing Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients mixing well. Bake in moderate (350\u00b0) oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix well and put into a loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or more.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into buttered casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hot Ham And Cauliflower
instructions: Cook cauliflower and/or broccoli in a small amount of boiling salted water. Cover until crisp-tender. Drain well. Remove from pan. Melt 1/4 cup margarine in the same pan. Stir in flour. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir until mixture is very thick and begins to bubble. Add cheese and sour cream. Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Stir in ham mushrooms and cooked vegetables. Turn in a 2-quart casserole pan. Combine bread crumbs and 1 tablespoon melted margarine or butter. Sprinkle atop casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla and egg. Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Chill dough. Roll very thin on floured surface and cut out with favorite cookie cutters. Decorate if desired. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Salmon Puffs
instructions: Combine ingredients. Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot fat about 3/4-inch deep. Turn each puff when brown on one side 3 to 5 minutes required. (These may also be fried in deep fat.)

title: Dearing Street Casserole
instructions: In a large saucepan saute celery onions green pepper and mushrooms in butter. Combine with rice shrimp crab and mushroom soup. Add salt and pepper. Pour into a buttered baking dish sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Place baking dish in a larger pan of water and bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Cream together Crisco margarine and vanilla. Add sugar and milk (1 spoon at a time) until desired consistency.

title: Irish Creme
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender. Chill overnight and enjoy.

title: Cream Tacos
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Mix next 3 ingredients for chili. In separate pan melt cheese then add cream. Then add to chili. Serve over Doritos. Top the taco (chili sauce) with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes. Top salad with Thousand Island dressing.

title: Pesto Sauce
instructions: Puree basil nuts and garlic. Mix in cheese. Add oil while machine is running. Toss into any textured pasta. Sprinkle top with cheese if desired or extra nuts.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add salt and flour. Blend thoroughly. Knead dough in 2 balls. Roll balls paper thin into 16-inch circles. Roll up like jelly rolls. Cut with sharp knife or piece of thread in 1/4-inch strips. Unwind strips and store in airtight container until ready to use. Drop into boiling soup; allow to cook for 2 minutes before serving soup.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together and chill. Serve with Kings Hawaiian bread.

title: Pecan Pie (1)
instructions: Beat eggs lightly mix all ingredients well. Bake at 325\u00b0F for about 45 min. Put foil over top if crust gets too dark.

title: John Wayne Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until almost done. Add pepper and onion. Cook until soft. Add ground beef; cook until done. Add green chilies tomatoes soup and beans. Just before serving stir in grated Cheddar cheese. Add German Polish sausage when you add the beans.

title: Butternut Squash
instructions: Wash squash and cut in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and string fiber. Sprinkle with salt. Dot with butter. Add one tablespoon of honey or syrup to each half squash. Place in a baking pan in oven at 375\u00b0. Bake until tender about 45 minutes. Baste occasionally with the butter-honey mixture. After squash has browned which will take 30 minutes add a little water to the pan. Cover for remainder of baking period.

title: Divinity
instructions: Boil sugar water and Karo until it spins a thread. Beat egg whites. Pour half of syrup mixture over whites and beat at medium speed. Cook other half of syrup until hard-ball stage (250\u00b0 to 266\u00b0 on candy thermometer). Add to the egg white mixture and beat by hand until stiff. Add vanilla (and nuts if desired). Put by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

title: Ham-And-Cheese Pie
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls separate into 8 triangles. Fit triangles into a 9-inch pie plate pressing edges together to seal. Combine chopped ham and next 4 ingredients spoon into pie plate. Cut remaining 3 triangles into thin strips; arrange over mixture. Bake on lower oven rack at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions; drain. Combine soup milk and cheese. Simmer stirring occasionally until cheese is melted. Mix macaroni cheese sauce luncheon meat and green pepper. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add all other ingredients and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until done.

title: 7-Up Jello Salad
instructions: Heat to boiling 7-Up and drained pineapple juice; dissolve jello with this. Pour into square or rectangle container. Mix cottage cheese Cool Whip pineapple and almost all nuts (leave a few to sprinkle on top). Mix with jello and chill.

title: Filling A Trifle Bowl
instructions: Break up or slice cake to fit bottom of trifle rifle bowl (or glass bowl). Brush liberally with chocolate liqueur. Cover with 1 layer of fruit and drizzle with sludge. Spread on whipped cream. Repeat layers until top of bowl is reached. Drizzle chocolate sauce on top. Chill for several hours or overnight.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop peppers and onion fine. Cover with boiling water and let stand 10 minutes; drain. Cover again with hot water and let come to boil. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Drain dry and add salt vinegar and sugar. Cook for 15 minutes and pack in hot jars. Process in water bath can at 212\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine sugar and oil; mix well. Add all remaining ingredients. Chill several hours or overnight. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Curried Rabbit
instructions: Soak the rabbit in salted water about 30 minutes. Wash and drain. Saute onion garlic and ginger in butter. Add curry powder chili salt and sage. Heat for about 1 minute and add the tomatoes. Saute and add the yogurt. Allow to cook with stirring for 20 to 30 minutes or so.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Drain crab meat and combine with other ingredients. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Good with crackers chips or vegetables.

title: Squash Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a baking dish. Cook for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 45 minutes longer.

title: Chocolate Tea Cake
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and vanilla. Sift flour with cocoa and salt. Blend dry ingredients into creamed mixture. Add pecans and mix well. Shape into balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. While warm roll in powdered sugar.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well and pour into greased loaf pan. Cover top with ketchup and bake uncovered in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Cook all until thick (except shell). Cool and pour over 1 1/2 cups sliced peaches that have been placed in pie shell.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine and brown sugar in saucepan. Add vanilla and salt. Beat eggs one at a time; add to butter mixture. Add flour and pecans. Pour mixture into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Rigatoni
instructions: Saute in pan. When cooked stuff into partially cooked large rigatoni. In baking dish put layer of rigatoni and cover with spaghetti sauce over all. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes to consume.

title: Microwave Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix ingredients together; coat chicken. Arrange pieces skin side up in rectangular dish (12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch) with thickest part toward edges. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave on High for 10 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Microwave until done 8 to 12 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mama Susanna'S Chicken
instructions: Pour half the cooking wine in bottom of casserole dish. Put chicken artichokes olives onion garlic and oregano in and then add the rest of the wine. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Garnish with Romano cheese. Put over your favorite pasta.

title: Four Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook on low in crock-pot 4 hours or 2 hours at 325\u00b0 in oven.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs and flour until smooth. Cook and drain spinach. Add all ingredients to egg mixture and stir. Melt margarine in 10-inch square pan. Pour mixture in; bake 30 minutes. Let set after baking for about 10 minutes.

title: Glazed Bacon Strips
instructions: Roll each slice of bacon in brown sugar covering both sides. Place on broiler pan or rack. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 30 minutes. Keep checking until bacon is browned and fat cooked from it. Place cooked bacon on foil to cool. It will crisp as it cools. Serve at room temperature.

title: Boston Cream Candy
instructions: Mix all together and cook until it forms a soft ball when tested in cold water. Add nuts and beat until creamy.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Soften and mix together. Make into 2 or more rolls. Roll in chili powder or Parmesan cheese.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding and Tang gently with fruit mixture. Chill. May be used as salad or dessert.

title: Cinnamon Sugar Treats
instructions: Thaw pie crust for 10 to 20 minutes in pan. Prick sides of crust thoroughly with a fork. Dot bottom and sides of thawed pie crust with butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture. Bake in preheated oven at 425\u00b0 for 8 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Cool then cut into pieces for serving.

title: Cream Cheese Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan. Heat until cheese melts and corn is tender. This recipe can be doubled easily and kept warm in a crock pot.

title: All Meat Spaghetti With Sauce
instructions: Prepare spaghetti by directions on package. Mix ground beef onions and salt; cook until well done. Drain; set aside.

title: Brown Rice #3
instructions: Brown onions in margarine. Add to remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Cover and bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hungry Jack Beef Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly; pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles. Place cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until biscuits are golden brown. Refrigerate any leftovers. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
instructions: Add heated liquids to flour mixture and beat. Add 2 beaten eggs and enough flour to make soft dough.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Drain pineapple well maybe overnight. Mix with mixer all ingredients. Roll into ball. Roll into crushed nuts. Serve with favorite crackers.

title: Nutty Glazed Pastries(Easy And Tasty!)
instructions: Blend powdered sugar butter or margarine and water. Add vanilla extract. (Or if in a hurry you can use white vanilla or almond flavor canned frosting.)

title: Pinto Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight in water salt and pepper. Keep water over the top of beans. Stir and discard bean pieces which float to the top. Cover with fresh water. Boil 1 hour; drain. Return beans to kettle. Add all ingredients and water to cover beans. Simmer several hours. Stir occasionally (too much stirring causes beans to get mushy). Always keep enough water in kettle. Eat as is or add to chili refried etc.

title: Czeck Cookies
instructions: Cream butter gradually adding sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks. Blend well. Gradually add flour and mix well. Fold in nuts. Pat half of batter into greased 8-inch square pan. Spread with filling. Cover with remaining batter. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Cool and cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar and salt. Add to milk and butter. Cook until thick. Add beaten egg yolks. Cook about 15 minutes longer until real thick. Remove from heat and add vanilla and 1/2 cup granulated sugar. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Almond Butter Krunch
instructions: Combine butter sugar and 1/2 cup almonds in heavy 3-quart saucepan. Heat slowly to boiling point. Boil gently until 305\u00b0 stirring constantly. Pour into large buttered sheet pan sprinkled with 1/2 of chocolate chips. Spread with spatula. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup almonds. Cool and turn over and put rest of chocolate chips and almonds. Place under broiler until chips melt. Spread chocolate chips and rest of almonds.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Cream together graham crackers margarine and 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Line bottom of 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Mix cream cheese 1/2 to 1 cup powdered sugar and vanilla together and add to Cool Whip Mix thoroughly. Spread mixture evenly over graham crackers crust. Spread cherry pie filling over whipped cream. Place in refrigerator and chill for several hours before serving.

title: White Potato Pie
instructions: Peel and quarter the white potatoes; boil them until tender. Put cooked potatoes in a large bowl. Mash potatoes until smooth then mix them with butter sugar salt lemon and vanilla. Add eggs milk and baking powder; beat until smooth. Add more sugar if desired. Pour mixture into pie crust shells and sprinkle lightly with grated coconut. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Baked Flounder
instructions: Arrange fish in 9 x 13 inch baking dish lightly greased or sprayed with Pam. Drizzle dressing over fish then sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until fish are flaky.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Divide the quantities by 450 and you will have plenty of mincemeat for two 10-inch pies.

title: Chicken Salad With Vegetables
instructions: Combine all ingredients except eggs and peas then carefully fold in eggs and peas. Place on crisp lettuce leaf and arrange quarters of tomatoes around.

title: Dessert Bars
instructions: Mix melted oleo and brown sugar. Let cool. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Sift flour soda baking powder and salt and add to first mixture. Add chocolate chips coconut and nuts. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Cut-Out Cookies
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients together; cut in the Crisco. Beat the eggs in a one cup measuring cup; add enough milk to make 1 cup. Add to dry ingredients with vanilla. Roll on floured covered surface; cut as desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except coconut and form into balls. Roll in coconut. Can use food coloring on coconut for holidays.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together and form into balls. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven about 15 to 20 minutes. May use mild or sharp cheese. May also use mild or hot sausage.

title: Delightful Cheesecake
instructions: Sprinkle 3 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs in 9-inch pan. Set aside. Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup water. Bring 3/4 cup juice to boil and stir in gelatin. Beat cottage cheese smooth. Add egg yolks skim milk lemon juice sweetener vanilla and salt. Beat well. Blend in gelatin at low speed. Chill. Stir occasionally until thick but not set about 1 hour. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form then fold into gelatin mixture by hand. Spoon over crumbs in pan. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Add pineapple tidbits on top. Chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Crumble cornbread. In separate bowl mix beans corn tomatoes onions peppers cheese and bacon. Mix in layers of vegetable mixture. Mix sour cream and picante sauce together. Combine with cornbread and vegetable mixture just before serving.

title: Broccoli Or Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables in large covered saucepan in chicken broth until almost tender (10 to 15 minutes). Do not drain. Set aside. In another bowl gradually add cream of potato soup; mix thoroughly. Blend water in cornstarch (in small cup). Pour into potato soup mixture. Mix together then pour all white mixture into vegetables and broth. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly (on medium heat).

title: Cabbage With Caraway
instructions: Melt margarine in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray. Add cabbage and next 4 ingredients; cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with caraway seed; cover and cook 1 minute. Yield 5 cups. Contains 39 calories per 1 cup serving.

title: Date Walnut Balls
instructions: Melt butter in heavy skillet. Stir in sugar egg yolk and dates. Cook and stir over low heat 5 minutes or until mixture is thick. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon juice peel and nuts. Cool. Drop or roll into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Delicious!! I double this recipe.

title: Viking Stew
instructions: Salt and pepper meat and dredge in flour; set aside. Fry bacon in large heavy pot and brown beef in remaining bacon drippings. Sprinkle with sugar. Add diced bacon onion garlic tomato sauce wine broth and seasonings. Cover and cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Add vegetables and continue to cook uncovered until vegetables are tender. If desired stew can be thickened. Mix 2 to 4 tablespoons flour with 2 cups water. Stir into stew and heat to boiling. Serves 8.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and shortening. Add egg flour and all other ingredients; blend. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Grandma Wheeler'S Banana Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour mixture (including salt and soda) sifting alternately with milk. Beat after each addition. Add vanilla and beat. Stir in mashed bananas and nuts. Pour into greased and floured rectangle pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese Squares
instructions: Combine ingredients. Put equal amount in two 9-inch square pans that have been sprayed with Pam or Cooking Ease. Bake at 350\u00b0 (preheated) for 35 minutes. Chill in icebox and cut in bite-size pieces. Serve as hors doeuvres. Yields 180 bite-size squares.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Spread pie filling on bottom of Pyrex dish. Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly. Spread over cherry filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: One Bowl Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Barbecue Party Franks
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Marinate overnight. Cook over medium heat in a saucepan for 30 minutes. Serve in a bowl with small amount of sauce; keep warm. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef. Add green pepper taco seasoning and tomatoes. While meat mixture is cooking cook noodles. Rinse and drain noodles. Put noodles in buttered baking dish. Add sour cream and 1/2 cup grated cheese. Mix together. Pour meat mixture over noodles and cover with remaining cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Seven-Up Salad
instructions: Let set until solid in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and oil; beat well. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to first mixture. Stir in zucchini nuts and vanilla. Bake in two loaf pans at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn out of pan.

title: Cherry Dream Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple pie filling condensed milk and nuts in a large bowl. Fold in whipped topping. Place in mold or a 9 x 13-inch pan. May be served immediately or chilled or frozen for later use.\tYield\t12 to 15 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Cook rice as directed on box. Brown onion in oil on medium heat. Add chicken and cook until tender. Add salt pepper and 1 tablespoon soy sauce. Add eggs. When eggs are cooked add rice and reduce heat. Add 2 to 3 more tablespoons soy sauce and serve.

title: Smoked Salmon And Dill Rollups
instructions: Combine the softened cream cheese with the fresh dill. Spread on the thin slices of smoked salmon and roll up jelly-roll fashion. Chill. Just before serving cut the rollups into slices about 1/2 inch thick.

title: Huevos Mexicana(Great For Using Up Leftover Hard-Boiled Eggs)
instructions: Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Stand 8 tortilla halves upright along sides of pan. Cover center of pan with 4 tortilla halves. Spread with 11 ounces of enchilada sauce. Top with eggs. Mix next 7 ingredients. Spread over eggs. Top with remaining 12 tortilla halves remaining enchilada sauce and cheese. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Garnish with sour cream and olives.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine over low heat or in double boiler. Take off burner and add sugar eggs flour and salt mixed together and vanilla stirring after each addition. Add nuts last. Bake in a 7 x 9-inch greased pan for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Finely chop the pepper onion and celery. Flake the crabmeat. Combine all together except for the cracker crumbs. Place in a buttered baking dish. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese and add Marshmallow Creme to blend. Add orange juice and\torange peel until well blended. Good with chunks of cantaloupe honeydew melon pineapple apple banana grapes strawberries etc.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Stir well. Let stand in freezer at least 2 hours (overnight is preferable). Make into small balls and place on wax paper. Put back in freezer and freeze for about 1 hour. Melt 12 ounce chocolate chips with 3/4 of one bar of paraffin. Dip balls by toothpick into chocolate mixture and place on wax paper. Keep in freezer until set good.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Shake well in jar.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Cut ends off the zucchini. Cut zucchini lengthwise. Do not pare the zucchini. Scoop out pulp. Cook (boil) pulp bread crumbs salt pepper onion and eggs for 5 minutes. Spoon into zucchini shells. Dot with butter. Sprinkle on cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dressed Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half. Remove yolks mash and mix with the remaining ingredients. Fill white with the mixture and serve.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients; pour into casserole dish. Top with roll of crushed Ritz crackers. Pour melted margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Butter two large casseroles. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Crush crackers into crumbs. In skillet saute mushrooms with 2 tablespoons butter. In bowl mix soup mushrooms and light cream. Put 1 fish fillet on bottom of each casserole. Add a layer of mushroom sauce then a layer of crumbs. Continue layering seafoods in casseroles with a layer of sauce and crumbs between each. Finish each with crumbs. Cut remaining butter into thin pats and place on top. Bake casseroles in a water bath for a little more than an hour. This dish may be frozen.

title: Cheesy Potato Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spray a 9 x 13 baking dish. Layer the pan with frozen Tater Tots. Mix together cream of chicken sour cream and cheese in a separate bowl.\tPour over the Tater Tots and evenly distribute the mixture. Top with shredded cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Place peaches in pan. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over peaches. Bake 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown. Serve warm and if desired with light cream ice cream or hard sauce. Makes 6 servings.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl beat eggs at high speed until foamy about 3 minutes. Beat in flour sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Beat in softened butter. Stir in walnuts and chocolate chips. Pour into pie shells. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between edge and center comes out clean and top is golden brown. Cool on wire rack. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream if desired.

title: Seven Up Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients putting seven up in last.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
instructions: Note Save some of crumb mixture for top.

title: Chew Bread
instructions: Butter pan well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix with the pie filling (do not add water). Bake mixture in 9 x 13 dish for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool. Cut into 12 equal pieces. Each piece is 2 points.

title: Quick Krimmel Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add in sugar while beating then add baking powder and vanilla. Beat well on slow speed and fold in crumbs and nuts. Press out into greased pie plate. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Cool for 20 minutes. Serve topped with whipped cream Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream.

title: Craig'S Stuffed Shells
instructions: Boil shells and let cool. Finely dice onion and pepper. Brown hamburger and sausage in frying pan while sauteing onion and pepper at same time. Drain grease from hamburger and sausage onion and peppers. In mixing bowl combine Ricotta cheese with hamburger sausage onions and peppers. Mix together. Add salt and pepper to taste to the mixture. Stuff large shells to capacity with mixture. Add 1/4 inch sauce to cover bottom of casserole dish. Place shells side by side filling dish. Cover shells with light coating of red sauce. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove dish and cover with Mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes let cool for 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix Dream Whip as directed on box. Add all other ingredients and chill for 1 hour.

title: Dora'S Chicken Pie Casserole
instructions: Combine all soups chicken peas carrots broth and cream. Pour mixture in a \large\ casserole dish. Tear biscuits in half and cover top of casserole.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: In large saucepan cook broccoli in 1 cup water with bouillon cubes. Bring to a very low boil; reduce heat to medium-low and cook about 7 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Put milk cheese cubes and flour in a blender. Process on medium speed. Add milk mixture to cooked broccoli mixture. Add cream. Cook stirring frequently over medium heat until mixture is thickened. Reduce heat. Simmer about 10 minutes.

title: Blackberry Jam Cake
instructions: Add sugar gradually to creamed butter. Beat in eggs and jam. Alternate flour allspice with buttermilk. Add nuts raisins and coconut. Bake in well greased pan at 300\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Quiche
instructions: Cook bacon; drain and chop up. Saute onion in bacon fat; drain. Combine eggs milk cream cheese bacon and seasonings. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. If you like add more cheese mushrooms crab meat or vegetables. Makes 1 pie. Serves 8.

title: Barbecue-Sauce Kabobs
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a bowl combine catsup brown sugar lemon juice vinegar and Worcestershire sauce. Brush zucchini pieces lightly with cooking oil. On 4 long skewers alternately thread beef potatoes and zucchini. Brush with catsup mixture. Broil the kabobs 4 to 5-inches from heat for about 20 minutes. Turn once and brush occasionally with sauce. Serve kabobs on rice. (Can be cooked on grill.) Makes 4 servings.

title: Noodles With Mushrooms
instructions: Saute first 5 ingredients for 6 minutes. Add broth and bring to a boil. Add noodles. Cook until all ingredients are absorbed about 7 minutes. Serves 4 to 6 as a side dish.

title: Date Fingers
instructions: Combine sugar margarine beaten egg and dates in a boiler. Cook over low heat stirring often until thick. Cool then pour date mixture over Rice Krispies and chopped nuts. Stir to mix well. Take small amounts and roll between hands to form finger shapes. Roll fingers in Angel Flake coconut. Yields approximately 1 dozen.

title: Corn Light Bread
instructions: Mix meal flour sugar eggs and buttermilk thoroughly. Add melted shortening. Pour into loaf pan to within 1-inch of top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Buffalo Style Hot Wings
instructions: Brown and drain meat; add onion. Spread half of the potatoes and carrots in a baking dish and cover with half of the meat and onion mixture. Season to taste. Cover with half of a can of condensed tomato soup. Layer remaining ingredients in same order topping with remaining half can of soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 8.

title: Oatmeal Crackers
instructions: Stir sugar salt 1 1/2 cups of water and oil together. Add oats and flour with more water if necessary to make a moist dough. Roll very thin on Pammed cookie sheets. Cut into squares and prick with a fork. Bake until light brown in a 300\u00b0 oven. Watch carefully as crackers around the edges will brown first. Remove these as they brown.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: In water put beef carrots parsley celery onion and bay leaf and simmer uncovered for 3 hours. Remove beef and carrots and strain. Combine remaining ingredients. Cook covered for 45 minutes. Cut up beef in small pieces. Makes 3 1/2 quarts of soup.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan; set aside. In a large bowl cream the shortening butter and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. In another bowl sift the flour and baking powder. Add the flour in small batches to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk beginning and ending with the flour.

title: Sugar Free Coconut Pie
instructions: Cook pudding by directions. Then add extracts and 1/2 of the coconut. Cool and top with Cool Whip and the rest of the coconut.

title: Wonderful Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pick cooked chicken from bone in large chunks; place in pan. Mix the sour cream and soup together; pour over chicken. Cook stuffing according to directions using chicken broth in place of water. Drop over chicken mixture. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Stir together and serve.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and egg yolks. Cream oleo and shortening together. Combine both mixtures. Mix buttermilk and soda; add alternately with flour. Beat slowly; add coconut and pecans. Fold in well beaten egg whites with sugar added to egg whites; add vanilla.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: In large bowl stir together the flour cinnamon and baking soda. In another bowl cream the sugar oil and eggs. Stir in carrots then add this mixture to the dry ingredients. Bake in 3 (9-inch) round pans or in a 9 x 13 pan.

title: Nacho Supreme
instructions: Spread refried beans in shallow dish. Mix sour cream with taco seasoning and spread over beans. Top with cheese tomatoes and black olives. Use tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Golden Sausage Egg Rolls
instructions: Cook sausage over medium-high heat in large skillet stirring frequently until no longer pink. Remove from heat and add the cole slaw mix ginger garlic pepper and salt; mix well. Transfer to colander to drain; cool 15 minutes. Assemble egg rolls as directed on wrapper package using 1/3 cup sausage mix for each roll. To cook in a wok Dutch oven or fryer add oil to 3-inches deep and heat to 375\u00b0. Fry 4 at a time for 3 minutes or until golden; drain on paper towels. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce. Yields 18 to 20 appetizers.

title: Savory Bran Muffins
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl stir together all-purpose flour whole bran cereal Parmesan cheese snipped chives baking powder salt and Italian seasoning. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients. In a small mixing bowl combine egg skim milk and cooking oil. Add all at once to flour mixture. Stir just until moistened (batter should be lumpy). Spray 12 muffin cups with nonstick coating. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until golden. Remove from pan; serve warm. Yield 12 muffins.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes and let sit and cool. Cut lengthwise and hollow out with a spoon. Set shells aside.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Boil sugar water raisins and carrots for 5 minutes. Add cloves cinnamon shortening soda flour and fruits. You may vary the amount of citron to your taste. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Velveeta Cheese Dip
instructions: Cube cheese and put in crock-pot on low. Brown meat. Add meat and salsa to cheese. When melted serve with tostito chips.

title: Corn Flake Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Cream margarine white sugar brown sugar and vanilla. Mix these together and add corn flakes and coconut. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 14 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Clean and slice strawberries; sprinkle sugar on top and let set for 1 hour. Drain strawberries and fold into Cool Whip. Put in baked pie crust. Put pie in freezer for 10 to 15 minutes to set. Then refrigerate and serve. Serves 8.

title: Tomatillo Salsa
instructions: Combine diced tomatillos sweet red pepper yellow pepper and onion in a large glass bowl. Stir well. Add vinegar sugar and juices; stir well to combine. Stir in cilantro cumin and red pepper. Stir well again to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve salsa with unsalted tortilla chips beef pork or chicken. Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Almond Roca
instructions: In a heavy saucepan melt butter. Add sugar and chopped untoasted almonds. Stir mixture occasionally with a wooden spoon over medium to medium-low heat. Cook until candy thermometer reads 280\u00b0. Quickly remove from heat. Pour into ungreased jelly roll pan and spread out evenly with knife. While still hot sprinkle chocolate chips wait a bit and spread when melted. Sprinkle toasted almonds over top. Let cool several hours. Break into small pieces.

title: Braised Chicken Breasts With Mustard Sauce
instructions: Remove skin from chicken breasts. Place on a rack in an electric frying pan or in frying pan on top of stove. Add 1 cup water to frying pan. Cover and cook on high until breasts are almost done. Remove breasts from frying pan. Heat grill. Place breasts on very hot grill for 10 minutes. Turn often and baste with honey/lemon mixture. Place on a bed of wild rice and top with 3 tablespoons of Mustard Sauce.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium size bowl. Spoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Melt butter; add bread cubes and onion and brown lightly. Then combine all ingredients and spoon into a casserole dish. Sprinkle fine bread crumbs on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheesy Garlic Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops on pan. Smear 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of minced garlic on each pork chop. Cover each pork chop with a thin layer of cheese then sprinkle Mrs. Dash. Broil pork chops until cooked but be sure to frequently check to ensure moist pork chops.

title: Pork Sausage And Sauerkraut
instructions: Form sausage into 12 patties; brown on both sides. Cook noodles in boiling water as directed on package. Drain and mix with 2 tablespoons pork fat. Spoon the noodles into buttered 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch rectangular dish. Mix sauerkraut with brown sugar and celery seed. Place on top of noodles. Place sausage on top. Pour beef broth over all and sprinkle top with buttered bread crumbs. Place uncovered on rack in large electric skillet preheated to 400\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour. Have skillet covered and vents closed. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Toad In The Hole
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain. Set aside 1 tablespoon drippings. Crumble bacon; set aside. In same skillet brown sausage; drain off fat. Stir together flour baking powder and salt. Add milk and eggs; beat until smooth. Spread reserved bacon drippings in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Place sausage pieces in dish; sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Pour batter over all. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 until set 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese and gradually add sour cream. Beat with mixer until creamy then add taco mix. Spread mixture in a glass pan. Top with lettuce cheese peppers onions olives and tomatoes. Serve with Doritos chips.

title: Honey Bites
instructions: Combine honey and peanut butter with dry milk powder; mix well. Chill thoroughly. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Roll in coconut. Yields 36 candies.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Heat beef and onion until meat turns color but do not brown it. Drain. Pour meat and onion mixture into a shallow casserole dish. Pour undiluted soup over mixture. Place Tater Tots on top and bake for 30 to 45 minutes at 359\u00b0 until it bubbles. Serves 12. Preparation time 20 minutes.

title: Funshine Fizz
instructions: Mix orange juice pineapple juice club soda and orange sherbet in blender. Blend on low speed until mixed completely. Makes a good summertime\ttreat\tor good for birthday parties!

title: Low Cholesterol Apple-Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: Stir together all dry ingredients. In small bowl combine buttermilk egg whites and oil. Add to dry ingredients; stir until moistened. Add apples. Spoon about 1/4 cup batter into muffin pan that has been sprayed with Pam coating. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins. 124 calories.

title: Harvest Pork Chops
instructions: In large skillet brown pork chops in butter. Remove and set aside. Cook apples and onions in skillet drippings until onion is tender. Stir in cider water brown sugar bouillon salt and pepper. Return pork to skillet and simmer covered for 30 to 35 minutes until pork chops are tender. Combine cornstarch and apple cider; stir into hot liquid. Cook until mixture thickens. Serve with rice. Serves 6.

title: Phyllis' Corn Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon. Remove bacon; leave 3 tablespoons of grease in pan. Add onion; cook until lightly browned. Add remaining ingredients and a dash of pepper. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 1 to 2 minutes. Top with crumbled bacon. Serves 6.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix together 1 egg melted butter and cake mix. Pat this mixture down in a 9 x 13 inch pan.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture. Mix well and fold in apples vanilla and nuts. Top with coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Use a 9 x 9-inch pan.

title: Sliced Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit. Put 1/4 cup juice and marshmallows in medium saucepan. Heat on low heat until marshmallows melt. In large mixing bowl soften cream cheese with a little whipping cream. Whip the remaining cream. Add salt and melted marshmallows to the cream mixture. Fold in whipped cream and fruit. Spoon into four (No. 2) cans. Cover with foil and freeze.

title: Sweet And Sour Meat Balls
instructions: Make meat balls; cook in large pot with sauce.

title: Reuben-Kraut Casserole
instructions: Drain sauerkraut and mix with onions and sour cream. Spread the mixture in the bottom of a 9 X 13 pan.\tEvenly distribute the corned beef and Mozzarella cheese over the top. Top with broken bite-sized bits of rye bread. Drizzle the entire dish with melted butter and bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Lemon Herb Baste For Cornish Hens
instructions: Brush mixture on hens while grilling for a delicious lemon flavor.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Brown ground chuck onion and garlic; cool. Add Mozzarella cheese bread crumbs parsley egg salt and pepper. Spoon enough sauce to cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Stuff cooked shells and place in pan. Cover with sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot.

title: Glazed Meatballs
instructions: In medium bowl combine ground beef bread crumbs onion salt and eggs; mix well. Shape into 3/4-inch balls. In a large skillet brown meatballs in oil turning occasionally. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally to coat meatballs with glaze. Serve warm in chafing dish. Makes 48 meatballs.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar and soda in mixing bowl. Bring to a boil the shortening butter and cola. Remove from heat and pour over dry ingredients. Add eggs and buttermilk; beat well. Stir in marshmallows and vanilla. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Scallops And Bacon
instructions: Cook scallops in margarine for 5 minutes. Cut bacon into 2-inch pieces. Arrange bacon and scallops alternately on skewer. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. To bake insert skewers in uncooked potato halves so they will stand upright. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Slice sausage into 1/2-inch pieces. Pre-boil potatoes carrots and onion. Mix brown gravy by package directions. Mix all ingredients and bake in casserole dish for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms remove stems and chop enough to make 1 cup. In a saucepan cook mushroom stems onion and garlic in margarine until tender. Stir in bread crumbs and cheese. Spoon mixture into mushroom caps. Arrange caps in a 15 x 10 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through.

title: Tomato And Basil Rice
instructions: Heat olive oil and saute onion until translucent. Add tomatoes and water. Bring to a boil and add salt pepper garlic powder and basil. Bring to a second boil and add rice and stir. Reduce to low heat and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Using fork break up tuna and place half of it in bottom of medium-size casserole dish. Pour half of the soup over it and cover with half of crackers which have been finely crushed. Repeat with rest of ingredients. Dot with margarine if desired. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Wild Rice With Raisins And Apples
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In mixing bowl combine cooked rices. Gently toss together raisins almonds parsley zest apple oil orange juice salt and pepper with combined rices. Place mixture in casserole. Cover with foil; heat thoroughly for 20 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Pudding
instructions: Roll graham crackers (or use a food processor). Mix with 1/2 cup sugar and butter. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with mixture saving 1 cup for top of pudding. Cook milk 1 cup sugar salt egg yolks flour and vanilla until thick. Pour into lined pan. Cover with meringue made with the egg whites left from the pudding. Then cover with reserved crumb mixture. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Nut Squares
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients and pour in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with cake mix. Drizzle melted butter over top. Top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes. Serve cold with whipped cream.

title: Layered Salad Deluxe
instructions: Layer first 6 ingredients in order listed in a large salad bowl. Combine salad dressing sour cream and dressing mix; mix well. Spread over top of vegetables sealing to edge of bowl. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired. Cover tightly and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Toss gently before serving. Yield 12 to 15 servings.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: In blender mix all ingredients except pie shell coconut and chopped nuts. Blend until thoroughly mixed. Stir in coconut and pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Mom'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place cut up chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix soup milk vegetables and onion in saucepan. Heat until blended and vegetables are slightly cooked. Pour over chicken. Melt margarine and pour over cornbread stuffing. Add 1 cup chicken broth and stir well. Spread over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar salt and milk and bring to boil stirring frequently. Cook to 232\u00b0 or until small amount of mixture forms a ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat and drop in oleo and peanut butter. Cool to lukewarm and add vanilla and beat until mixture thickens. Pour into buttered pan and cut into squares.

title: My French Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in a screwtop jar. Shake well. Store in refrigerator.

title: Salmon Mousse
instructions: Empty envelope of gelatin into blender. Add lemon juice onion slices and boiling water; cover blender and blend at high speed for 40 seconds. Add mayonnaise paprika dill and salmon. Cover and blend at high speed briefly. Add cream 1/3 at a time and blend after each addition. Blend 30 seconds longer. Pour into 4-cup mold which has been lightly coated with salad oil. Chill for at least 4 hours. Unmold.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute bell pepper onion garlic and squash in 1 tablespoon oil. Add mushrooms. Remove. Add sausage and saute; drain and discard remaining grease. Pour Hunts in skillet and add all of the ingredients. Serve over spaghetti and top with Mozzarella cheese. You may also layer spaghetti sauce and cheese and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add flour and nuts. Chill for several hours. Roll dough into small marble size balls. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes and roll in powdered sugar. After real cool roll them in powdered sugar again.

title: Butter Glazed Carrots
instructions: Steam carrots until tender; drain. Over medium heat combine in skillet the butter sugar lemon juice and salt. When bubbly add carrots and parsley. Remove from heat. Stir until carrots are coated. Serve immediately.

title: Pina Colada Punch
instructions: Stir ingredients together until lemonade mix is dissolved. Just before serving add 1 quart of ice cubes and 1 to 2 bottles of sugar-free 7-Up or ginger ale.

title: Raisin Squares
instructions: Cook raisins in water for 10 minutes. Add butter; let melt then cool. Add egg flour sugar nutmeg cinnamon baking soda allspice cloves and salt. Pour into ungreased cookie sheet with edges. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: 1-2-3 Shortbread
instructions: Knead the flour into the softened butter; then knead the granulated sugar into the flour-butter mixture. Press firmly into a well-greased 8-inch square pan or shortbread mold. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until a delicate brown. Cut in 36 squares while still hot. Return to oven a few minutes to dry out edges. Let cool in pan or on wire rack.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge Cake
instructions: Cream butter in large bowl at high speed. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add sugar slowly. Continue until light and fluffy. By hand stir in flour frosting mix and nuts until blended. Pour into well-greased tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Cool 2 hours and remove from pan.

title: Seafood Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Mix crabmeat cheese and onions. Place in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute by hand). Pour into pie plate. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Put sugar milk cocoa and butter in saucepan. Bring to boil and boil for 4 minutes. Set aside off heat. Add peanut butter vanilla and oats; mix. Drop onto cookie sheets to cool.

title: Watergate Pudding
instructions: Mix crushed pineapple and instant pistachio pudding in a bowl. Add Cool Whip and mix well with spoon. Add nuts if desired. Decorate with sliced pineapple and cherries. Put in refrigerator to cool.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Put pork chops in casserole dish then add a layer of potatoes and then a layer of onion. Salt and pepper then add cream of chicken soup. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Orange Coconut Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Make into balls. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or overnight. Then dip in chocolate.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and molasses. Add dry ingredients. Chill. Form into balls and roll in sugar. Bake at 350-375 degrees for 10 minutes.

title: Eggs Portugal
instructions: Brown sausage (Deans or Owens); drain. In a 9 x 13-inch pan cover bottom with 8 slices of bread cut in cubes. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese. Add drained sausage. Mix eggs (beaten) in milk and mustard and pour over sausage. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight. In morning top with can of mushrooms (drained) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8 people. Serve with fruit and pastries.

title: Savory Eggs(Christmas Brunch)
instructions: To yolks add ingredients and mix thoroughly. Replace yolk mixture in whites.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and chill. Makes 3 cups.

title: Apple Fritters(Club Member: Brandi Cook)
instructions: Beat egg with milk; stir 1 tablespoon melted Crisco with the fruit. Combine dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture and stir. Drop from tablespoon into deep Crisco. Fry about 4 minutes until brown. Serve hot. Makes 16.

title: Easy Chicken Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs slightly in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pack mixture into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Unmold onto hot platter. Garnish with parsley and hard-cooked egg segments. Yields 8 to 10 servings. Contains 191 calories per serving.

title: Faye And Hildy'S Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and blend.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix together sprinkle with sugar or Sweet N Low to taste. Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for at least an hour.

title: Cracker Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar. Add milk and crackers then coconut and vanilla. Cook until thick.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except dry cake mix pecans and melted butter. Line pan with wax paper. Pour mixture in pan. Sprinkle yellow cake mix on top (dry). Sprinkle pecans on that. Pour melted butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Turn upside-down. Take paper off and let cool.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix the flour and soda. Combine the butter sugar vanilla and pudding mix. Beat in eggs. Slowly add flour mixture and stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Molded Salad
instructions: Combine jello with boiling water. Add the cool water. When cool and jello-like fold in the remaining ingredients.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Mash sweet potatoes and mix in all the ingredients. Bake until firm and browned on top. Then add topping and let cook for 15 minutes on 375\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar syrup and butter. Beat together well. Add oatmeal and coconut stirring together well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. This is a rich pie very much like pecan. Pie is done when filling is set.

title: Linzertorte
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 butter a 10 inch spring form that is 2 inches high. Work the flour hazelnuts butter sugar egg 1 egg yolk cinnamon and lemon zest to a dough. Press 3 quarters of the dough into the bottom and sides of the pan. Fill with jam. Roll out the remaining dough 1/4 inch thick cut into strips criss-cross them over the filling brush with 1 egg yolk. Bake for 45 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Chocolate Mint Sugar Cookie Drops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking powder and salt and set aside. In a large bowl combine 1 cup sugar and oil. Mix well. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in mint chips. Shape into balls. Roll in remaining sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Blend in oleo flour and nuts and spread in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Combine cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on the baked crust. Add cold milk to pudding and beat with mixer until thick. Spread pudding on top of second layer. Refrigerate. More Cool Whip can be spread over top when pudding sets. Sprinkle chopped nuts over top.

title: Low-Fat Spanish Rice
instructions: In medium saucepan over high heat bring broth to a boil. Add rice cover and reduce to low setting. Cook 50 minutes or until rice is tender. Saute garlic onion green pepper and celery in 3 to 4 tablespoons juice from tomatoes in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until softened. Add tomatoes to skillet with remaining juice. Stir in seasonings and honey and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 10 minutes. When rice is tender stir into tomato mixture. Heat until hot approximately 5 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix the sugar eggs and oil. Sift together the cinnamon salt soda and flour. Add to the first mixture. Stir in the rhubarb. Mix and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on 3 tablespoons brown sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and ketchup together with mixer. Add onion and shrimp. Blend all ingredients; serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: *You can use bacon (crumbled up) Canadian bacon or ham.

title: French Bread
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cups flour sugar salt and yeast; add margarine. Gradually add water to dry ingredients and beat for 2 minutes. Stir in enough additional flour to make stiff dough. Turn on floured board and knead until smooth 8 to 10 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap or towel; rest 20 minutes. Divide dough in half. Roll out on lightly floured board to size of 15 x 10-inches; roll up taper ends.

title: Grilled Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes or leave on skins. Cut each potato into wedges (4 each). In mixing bowl combine oil salt garlic powder and pepper. Add cut-up potatoes; toss to coat. Wrap potatoes in heavy foil. Seal edges tightly. Grill packet on medium to hot grill about 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender. These can also be cooked in the oven.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Mix the top ingredients in a bowl and use this mixture in place of your usual milk when making biscuits. When your biscuits are done sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot.

title: Grandma Froning'S Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Note Fresh rhubarb is best! If frozen rhubarb is used defrost prior to adding to filling. Canned rhubarb must be drained first and isnt as good.

title: Easy Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together and pat in a pie pan. Prick with a fork. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Use a blender to mix.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger drain grease. Cook hamburger with the taco seasoning mix according to package directions. Line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with the refried beans. Layer the hamburger onion salsa and cheese over the refried beans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Mix olives and sour cream and top the baked mixture. Serve with nachos.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Melt together oleo and cream cheese. Add soup and onion; mix together until smooth. Put 1/2 of potatoes in a greased pan and pour on half of the sauce. Sprinkle the rest of the potatoes and add the remainder of sauce. Top with 1 cup grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 covered for 1 hour.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix ingredients together and roll chicken. Bake in lightly buttered pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Edna'S Punch
instructions: Stir sugar and water until sugar dissolves. Add all of the other ingredients except Sprite. Freeze overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Butter sides and bottom of pan. Cook 10x sugar oleo and evaporated milk. Stir constantly. When it starts to boil boil for 3 minutes. Remove from stove and add peanut butter Marshmallow Creme and vanilla. Stir and pour in pan. Cool completely. Cut and enjoy!

title: Easy Yeast Rolls
instructions: Melt yeast in warm water. Add egg oil sugar and flour. Mix well. Pan out. Bake in muffin pan at 425\u00b0.

title: Cajun Dirty Rice
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat cook livers green pepper celery and garlic in butter until vegetables are tender stirring often. Stir soup mix water and hot pepper sauce into skillet. Heat to boiling; stir in rice. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cranberry sauce. Use fork or wire whisk to dissolve cranberry sauce in jello mixture. Add pineapple undrained. Stir to blend. Let jello chill.

title: One-Pot Sunday Dinner
instructions: Dust roast with flour and brown. Put into large Dutch oven and surround it with potatoes carrots and the green beans. Slice onions over the top and cover with both cans of the soup which have been mixed together with 1/2 can of water to blend. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours or until done.

title: Hidden Hot Dogs
instructions: Turn oven to 450\u00b0. Open package of rolls and separate the little triangles. Flatten each triangle a little bit with your hands. Open hot dogs and wrap each one in a flattened roll. Pinch the dough together on top so that each hot dog stays wrapped. Put the wrapped hot dogs on a baking pan. Bake until they puff and are light brown about 10 minutes.

title: No Bake Fruitcake
instructions: In large bowl thoroughly combine first 7 ingredients then stir in next 4 ingredients. Add to graham cracker mixture and blend thoroughly. Pack firmly into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch aluminum foil pan. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 days. Let stand about 2 hours at room temperature before serving. Makes 1 (8 ounce) loaf.

title: Arctic Salad
instructions: In a bowl blend cream cheese and Miracle Whip. Stir in raspberries pineapple and pecans. Fold in whipped cream. Pour in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Freeze 8 hours. To serve set out 15 to 20 minutes. Cut and serve. Serves 12 to 18.

title: Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Press into 13 x 10-inch dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Do not overbake! Cool. Mix next 3 ingredients and spread over cooled pretzel mix. Stir together remaining ingredients; put mixture in the refrigerator to chill for 10 minutes. Pour over top of dish and refrigerate. All ingredients can be substituted for low calorie products.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl pour water over oatmeal and allow to stand 10 minutes. Add sugars and butter stirring until the butter melts. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Sift flour cocoa soda and salt together. Add to batter. Mix well. Stir in half of the chocolate chips. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle top of cake with walnuts and remaining chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook chicken and cut into bite-size pieces. Lightly butter a large casserole dish. Cover bottom of dish with broccoli florets. Spread chicken over broccoli. Mix soup mayonnaise and cooking sherry and stir together well. Pour mixture over chicken and spread out evenly. Cover sauce with grated cheese. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Jalapeno Pie
instructions: Spray pie pan with Pam; line bottom of pan with peppers. Put grated cheese over the peppers. Beat eggs and pour over top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until cheese and eggs are firm and will cut in slices. Great with seafood.

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: Cook rice as directed. Put in casserole. Blend 2/3 cup Cheddar cheese peppers and sour cream. Put remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until thick.

title: Blackberry Pie
instructions: Boil sugar and cornstarch with 1-cup water until thick; remove from fire and add blackberry gelatin. Thaw and drain 4 cups blackberries; fold into gelatin mixture. Pour into baked pie shell and cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Brown Sugar Custard Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Break eggs into mixture and fold in. Dont beat. Melt butter and add to milk. Stir the two mixtures together. Add salt and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake 1/2 hour at 400\u00b0 then reduce heat to 375\u00b0 until a knife inserted into center comes out clean.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Add rice can of broth (and enough water to make 2 cups) 2 tablespoons butter or oleo and onions. Cook according to rice directions. Mix with cream of chicken soup; salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole. Top with chicken breasts; salt and pepper chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Southern Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine Jell-O pudding egg yolks and milk in saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Remove from heat. Arrange layer of vanilla wafers on bottom and sides of 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Add a layer of banana slices and of pudding. Continue layering wafers bananas and pudding ending with pudding.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt in large bowl; cut in 3/4 cup butter thoroughly with pastry blender until mixture resembles very fine crumbs. Press mixture evenly into greased 13 x 9-inch pan using a piece of plastic wrap to press crumb mixture firmly in pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 17 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Cool 'N Easy Pie
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in bowl for 2 minutes or until dissolved. Mix water and ice to make 1 1/4 cups. Stir into gelatin until slightly thickened. Remove any remaining ice. Stir in whipped topping until smooth. Refrigerate 10 minutes or until mixture will mound. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate 4 hours or until firm. Garnish with additional whipped topping if desired.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Drain corn reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Sift together flour baking powder salt parsley flakes and paprika. Combine eggs melted butter and liquid from corn. Mix well. Add to dry ingredients all at once and stir until smooth. Fold in drained corn. Drop batter from a tablespoon into deep fat heated to 375\u00b0. Fry a few at a time until golden brown on all sides. Remove from fat. Drain on paper towel. Keep hot while frying remaining fritters.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain and rinse with cold water. Drain again. Brown meat; drain off fat. Add taco seasoning and mix well; cool. In large bowl mix macaroni green pepper onions cheese tomatoes lettuce and seasonings; chill. Just before serving stir in seasoned meat French dressing and chips; toss lightly. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Yogurt-Grilled Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 1-gallon Ziploc bag. Marinate in bag several hours or overnight in the refrigerator. Lift from marinade and grill over charcoal grill. (Based on Iranian cooking with yogurt!)

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Spread in a 9 x 12-inch pan (sprayed with Pam). Sprinkle yellow cake mix over pumpkin. Add pecans. Dot top with oleo. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix margarine cloves mashed garlic salt celery seed and black pepper together. Set aside.

title: Zucchini Dessert
instructions: Boil 30 minutes all ingredients together. Pack in pint jars. Process for 20 minutes in pressure canner. Yield 6 to 7 pints. Tastes just like real pineapple.

title: Chocolate Spice Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare 10-inch tube baking pan. Cream shortening and sugar. Mix flour soda cocoa and spices. Blend in eggs dry ingredients and applesauce until well mixed. Fold in raisins nuts and dates. Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Light And Lively Salad
instructions: Mix together with reduced calorie Ranch dressing.

title: Almost Better Than Sex Cakes
instructions: Prepare the cake mix and bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish according to package directions. When done remove from oven and while still hot poke holes in cake with end of wooden spoon. Pour sweetened condensed milk then caramel topping into holes. Spread entire cake with whipped topping. Sprinkle crushed candy bars on top of cake. Refrigerate cake until serving time. Cake can be frozen.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Ritz crackers and margarine. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix crushed crackers and margarine and cover top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Put sliced onion in bottom of an empty 3-pound peanut butter jar then fill with sliced cucumbers. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers. Refrigerate for 5 days then eat and enjoy.

title: Marshmallow Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk and marshmallows in a saucepan. Cook and stir until sugar and marshmallows melt. When bubbles cover entire surface boil and stir over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Beat in butter salt chocolate bits and vanilla until chocolate bits are melted. Add nuts if desired. Spread into buttered 9 inch square pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 64 squares and enjoy.

title: Peanut Patties
instructions: Cook sugar Karo milk and peanuts until 240\u00b0; remove from fire. Add remaining ingredients; stir good and spoon out on foil.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except peanut butter and oatmeal. Stir well. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and oatmeal; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Little Barbecue Wieners
instructions: Empty package into a medium sized saucepan. Let simmer in the whole bottle of barbecue sauce. This is a great appetizer.

title: Beefy Mushroom Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper roast. Brown roast in a pot on top of stove in Crisco. Drain grease; add beefy mushroom soup. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 2 hours (depending on size of roast). Will have enough for gravy.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Have cheese at room temperature. Mix cheese onion Worcestershire sauce and Accent until blended. Add 1/2 cup pecans and 1/4 cup parsley. Shape mixture into ball. Place in bowl lined with waxed paper. Chill overnight.

title: Marinated Onions And Cucumbers
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onions. Sprinkle with salt and let stand 6 hours. Drain. Mix sugar and vinegar. Dissolve then add sour cream. Mix and pour over vegetables. Let stand 24 hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bring to boil until clear and thick and bubbling. Cook for about 5 minutes then add 2 to 3 cartons of clean fresh cold strawberries. Put in prepared pie crust. Just before serving top with whipped cream.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Place sugar oil and pumpkin in large mixer bowl and beat well at medium speed. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift flour baking powder soda cinnamon and salt together and fold into batter. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until done. Do not open oven door under 1 hour. Let cool slightly in pan before turning onto cake rack.

title: Egg Salad
instructions: Hard boil eggs; remove 1/2 to 2/3 yolks. Chop remaining yolks and whites. Add chopped olives. Mix in mustard and salad dressing to taste.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar vinegar and mustard. Boil this stirring constantly on low heat until thick. Chill. Then add real Kraft mayonnaise dressing. Mix dressing with sliced cooked potatoes 8 boiled chopped eggs celery and onion.

title: Flavored Applesauce
instructions: Bring to boil 1 1/2 cups applesauce and 3/4 cup water. Add jello; apricot is great raspberry is good too. Stir well; add pineapple (no need to drain). Add remaining applesauce. To keep the sugar content low I use unsweetened applesauce and sugar-free jello.

title: Apple Turnovers
instructions: Mix all ingredients set aside.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Drain potatoes and mash well. Add vanilla flour margarine egg and sugar. Make small balls and put a marshmallow in center of each ball. Roll in coconut. Place on greased baking dish and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Bake
instructions: Mix together first 7 ingredients. Put in large pan. Melt butter. Mix with potato chips. Spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: T.V. Snacks
instructions: Combine last 5 ingredients. Pour over cereal and stir. Cook 2 hours at 200\u00b0.

title: Pump Up Your Pumpkin
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon half and half and whipped topping. Whip together. Spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup half and half and add pudding. Wire whip and let stand 3 minutes. Stir in pumpkin and spices. Spread over cream cheese layer. Chill 2 hours. Top with whipped topping and nuts (optional).

title: Baked Crackers
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour over crackers. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 20 minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onion. Toss with a dressing of remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Baked French Donuts
instructions: Mix butter and sugar until creamy. Add eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add to other mixture alternately with milk. Fill muffin tins 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Brush with melted butter. While hot sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Makes about 12.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spoon into buttered shallow 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly (about 1 hour).

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until tender (1 hour). Cool deskin debone and cut into bite-sized pieces. Set aside. Saute onions and butter. Add remaining ingredients except asparagus and almonds. Simmer until cheese melts. Add chicken and asparagus. Put into a 3-quart casserole and top with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 unti bubbly (about 30 minutes).

title: Cream Cheese Cookies(For Christmas)
instructions: Cream shortening until fluffy. Gradually add sugar and cream cheese making sure mixture is smooth. Beat in egg yolk vanilla and flour. Use a cookie press or chill until firm roll and cut with decorative cutters. Decorate for the holiday. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yield 3-4 dozen.

title: Any Flavor Slush
instructions: Boil water. Stir in Jell-O and sugar until dissolved. Add pineapple juice and water. Freeze. Makes a gallon of frozen slush base. Scrape and serve with 7-Up.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Store in an airtight container. Use 1/4 cup of mix to a cup of boiling water.

title: Grandmother'S Homemade Noodles
instructions: Bone raw fish and run through food chopper. Add vegetables salt and pepper. Stir in milk crumbs and egg. Mold into loaf and bake uncovered in fairly hot oven for 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Serve accompanied with sauce.

title: Dutch Apple Cake
instructions: Cream butter with 7/8 cup of sugar. Add well beaten egg then the milk and vanilla. Mix the dry ingredients together and add alternately to the milk mixture beating thoroughly.

title: Quick Corn Chowder
instructions: Saute the veggies in bacon drippings. Mix the soup and the milk and evaporated milk together and heat; add the sauteed veggies and heat through; dont boil. Serve in big soup cups. Makes 3 large soup cups or 4 small ones of chowder. Crumble bacon atop each as you serve the soup.

title: Fruited Ice Tea
instructions: Combine instant tea powder and the cold water; stir until the tea is dissolved. Add sweetener orange juice and lime juice. Mix thoroughly. Chill. Serve over ice in tall glasses. Makes 6 servings. Garnish with orange slices and fresh cranberries.

title: Oatmeal Caramel Bars
instructions: Mix first six ingredients together and pat one-half of mixture into 9 x 13 pan. Melt caramels with evaporated milk. Pour over crust. Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over caramel mixture and top with remaining crust mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jello in 2 c. boiling water. Add the cherry syrup plus enough cold water to make 1 1/2 c. Put in the refrigerator to thicken. When partially set add the cranberry sauce cherries cut in half and the nuts apples and marshmallows. Mix well. Refrigerate until set. This keeps well and can be made ahead.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13 x 2 1/2-inch casserole dish. Cook noodles; drain well. Make layer of noodles layer of sauce 1/2 cottage cheese 1/3 of the nuts layer of spinach layer of Mozzarella and Parmesan layer of sauce and layer of noodles. Repeat. Top with cheese and nuts.

title: Sugarless Blueberry Muffins
instructions: In a large mixing bowl sift together the flour salt baking powder cinnamon and nutmeg. In a small bowl whisk together the eggs oil and orange juice and add to the flour mixture. Before the flour and liquid ingredients are completely combined fold in the blueberries stirring gently. Fill well-greased muffin tin about 2/3 full. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Spanish Chicken And Rice
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add chicken onion and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is done. Add broth and tomatoes; bring to a boil. Stir in rice and cover. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 3 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Nancy'S Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Refrigerate for several hours before serving. Vegetable may be changed to your favorites.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Mix rice water juice and salt just to moisten in pan then bring to quick boil. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add marshmallows fruits and nuts. Cool to room temperature or in fridge. Fold in the cream. Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: To make pizza crust Spread rolls on greased jelly roll pan. Bake crust according to package directions.

title: Beef Cabbage Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook until veggies are tender about 1 hour.

title: Little Grandma'S Divinity
instructions: In a 1 qt. heavy saucepan combine sugar and corn syrup with 1/2 c. water over low heat cook stirring until sugar is dissolved. Cover cook 1 minute or until sugar crystallize on the side of pan melts. Uncover and bring to boil without stirring. Cook to 238\u00b0 on candy thermometer or until a small amount in cold water forms a SOFT ball. Meanwhile in large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed beat the egg whites with salt until stiff peaks form when beaters are slowly raised. In a thin stream pour half of hot syrup over egg whites beating constantly at high speed until stiff peaks form. Continue cooking rest of syrup to 256\u00b0 on candy thermometer (bringing it to 260\u00b0 wont hurt) or until a small amount in cold water forms a HARD ball.

title: Max'S Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix wet ingredients and add to mixed dry ingredients. Let rise for 1/2 hour. Spoon into 375\u00b0 deep fat oil. Cook until golden brown. Remove and serve. Makes 30 hush puppies. *Hot peppers chopped into batter makes them good.

title: No Peek Beef Casserole
instructions: In crock-pot put all ingredients except wine. Mix together well. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 hours. During last hour of cooking add wine and stir. Serve over egg noodles or rice.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: In a saucepan cook mushrooms and green pepper in butter until pepper is tender. Blend in soup. Gradually stir in milk. Add chicken and pimento. Heat stirring now and then. Serve in patty shells or on toast.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Combine all ingredients except bread. Beat until well blended. Chill until fairly stiff. Spread on pumpernickel rounds.

title: Six Weeks Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix bran cereal sugar flour baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Add eggs oil and buttermilk. Mix well. Grease muffin tins and fill 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: In saucepan cook green pepper and celery in oleo until crisp. Stir in soup water and soy sauce. Add vegetables and chicken; heat through. Serve with rice.

title: Lettuce Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into small pieces. Add nuts and berries and pour salad dressing over all and mix.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Grate cheese; set aside. Mix corn bread batter. Heat greased iron skillet. Put half batter in skillet then add browned beef with onions. Sprinkle cheese on top of this. Add remaining batter. Cook approximately 1 hour. Be careful not to let cheese touch sides of skillet or it will stick when turned out.

title: Homemade Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except flour and let stand until dissolved. Add about 1/2 the flour. Beat 5 minutes. Gradually add remaining flour to make a soft dough. Knead until smooth and no longer stretchy (about 10 minutes) adding a small amount of flour as needed. Place in greased bowl. Turn over to grease top. Cover with towel and let rise in warm place until double in size. Punch down; let rise again. Make into 5 or 6 loaves. Let rise. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. This recipe will serve 40 people.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Cook meat; mix taco season package in meat. Mix both cans of chili. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. First put some chips on bottom of pan. Make sure you mix chili with meat then put meat with chili on top of chips. Put more chips on top.

title: Texas Hash
