Chop fresh parsley; add and mix all until blended. Set aside in a large bowl. In a large frying pan saute the pasta and scallops. When the scallops turn opaque add zucchini eggplant and peppers. Continue cooking stirring constantly. When the vegetables are hot add the mixture to the bowl with the eggs and cream. Stir vigorously. When it begins to thicken add cheese. Mix well.

title: Coconut-Pineapple Pie
instructions: Beat eggs at medium speed with electric mixer until thick and lemon colored. Add butter and next 4 ingredients. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until filling is set. Yields one 9-inch pie.

title: Mom'S Date Crumbles
instructions: Mix together with fingers the flour soda oatmeal and brown sugar. Add margarine. Mix well and line a greased 9 x 13-inch pan (cover bottom well).

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix hash browns onion bell pepper; salt and pepper to taste. Place in a 9 x 13 pan. Pour half of margarine over mixture; add bacon crumbles if desired. Heat and stir sour cream cream of chicken soup and Cheez Whiz until mixed good; pour on top of potatoes. Add crushed corn flakes. Add remaining half of margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 1 hour or until done.

title: Horns
instructions: Mix flour and salt in large bowl. Take yeast and crumble over flour and salt. Add butter and lard (make substance like pie dough) Make hole in middle of dough and put egg yolks eggs and sour cream into it. Mix with hands.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Turn on oven at 375\u00b0 (high moderate). Beat eggs slightly in 2-quart bowl. Stir in sugar corn syrup butter and vanilla. Stir in pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake near center of oven 35 to 40 minutes or until filling is slightly firm. Center of pie may look soft when pie is gently shaken but will become firm when pie cools.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter and saute onions. Add onions to beef broth; cook for 10 minutes. Pour into ovenproof bowls. Lay sliced French bread on top of soup. Sprinkle with cheese and broil until cheese is golden.

title: Easy Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Add flour mixed with soda and baking powder. Add mashed bananas and pecans and mix well. Pour into loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 3/4 to 1 hour. When persimmons are in season you may substitute them for the bananas. One cup of peeled mashed persimmons equals 2 medium ripe bananas.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix broth soup and vegetables together. Then add chicken.

title: Pig Cake
instructions: This is a large cake. I use a 12-inch spring-form pan. Single ten-inch is too small. Great for a special party. Serves 16.

title: Baked Bananas From Africa
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Cut the bananas in half lengthwise. Put in an ovenproof dish with the cut sides facing up. Melt the butter or margarine in a pan over a low heat. Stir in the brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour over the bananas. Cover with dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Pittsburg Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook beef until brown; drain grease. Add onion garlic salt spaghetti sauce and undrained mushrooms. Mix well. Pour half of the cooked macaroni into deep casserole and cover with half of the tomato sauce. Spread half of the sour cream over the tomato sauce. Top with all of the Provolone cheese. Repeat the layers. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake until cheese melts. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Party Surprise
instructions: Slice off top of cake (1/2-inch thick). Scoop out a cavity all the way around the cake. Mix half of the Cool Whip and the package of strawberries together (reserve 2 or 3 strawberries). Empty into the cavity of the cake. Put top back on. Frost with remaining Cool Whip then put leftover strawberries on top.

title: Raspberry Creme
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water. Add berries and ice cream. Mix until smooth. Chill.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Cream together the sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Add soda to sour cream then add this to egg mixture. Combine flour baking powder and salt together and sift. Add gradually to egg mixture. Add vanilla. Drop by teaspoons on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables as shown on package. Drain and put into dish. Stir in soup and cheese. Mix together the cracker crumbs and melted butter. Sprinkle on top of vegetables. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Butter
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Gradually add the sugar to the stiffly beaten egg whites. Add chocolate chips. Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0. After baked turn oven off and leave it in overnight.

title: Applesauce
instructions: Core apples and slice into quarters. Place in a saucepan with water. Cook slowly until apples are tender about 20 minutes. Put apples through a food mill and discard skins (if mill is not available peel apples before cooking and after cooking mash them). Add cinnamon and lemon juice. If desired add sugar but it is not necessary.

title: Honey Spice Bars
instructions: Add sugar to egg. Add oil and honey to fill cup. Sift flour salt soda and cinnamon. Add vanilla. Combine with honey mixture. If egg is large and vanilla is generous the dough may be a little weak. Add 1/4 cup more flour. The dough should be stiff. Press dough into pre-greased large pan 11 x 16-inch. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. On removing from oven have already prepared the slightly runny glaze. Ice when cookies are still very hot.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar milk and flavoring. Be careful not to add too much milk and flavoring or the mixture will be soupy. Add Cool Whip and blend with mixer until creamy. Divide mixture between the two pie shells. Gently spoon half of cherry pie filling over top of mixture. Cover pies with plastic top from pie shells. Chill about 2 hours before serving. Makes 2 pies.

title: Pat Cary'S Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over salt sugar and shortening. Stir and cool. Add yeast to water; put yeast and egg in mixture. Stir in flour to make soft dough. Rub top with solid shortening. Cover loosely. Put in refrigerator (keeps 3 to 4 days). Put out about 2 hours before use. Make into rolls let rise. Bake at 450\u00b0 until browned.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix beaten eggs sugar and vanilla. Mix in Eagle Brand milk. Mix well and pour into freezer and add enough milk to fill container. Mix this ahead and sit in the freezer; when ready to make ice cream youll be ready.

title: Tomato Dumplings
instructions: Skin tomatoes if fresh. Place in large skillet on top burner at medium heat. Bring to a boil. Add sugar to taste (some days I like less sometimes more) approximately 1/2 to 3/4 cup. Cook until it becomes thick and clear; add lump of butter size of walnut (about 3 tablespoons). Add dumplings and continue to cook until done. Add seasonings (salt pepper and basil). Remove from fire and stir in a drizzle of evaporated milk (1/4 to 1/2 cup).

title: Quick Crisp Lemon Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. Cream shortening; add sugar and pudding mix. Cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs; mix thoroughly. Add flour mixture; beat thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Taco Dip By Suzie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and spread into dish. Pour picante sauce on top. Sprinkle cheese on sauce and put tomatoes on top of the cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Nutty Rice Stuffing Or Casserole
instructions: Saute onion celery mushrooms shallots garlic scallions and parsley in butter until limp. Add water chestnuts walnuts and herbs and cook over low heat for about 1 to 2 minutes. Mix with cooked rice and cool slightly. Combine egg and broth and stir into rice mixture along with prunes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Use as stuffing or a side casserole. Makes 4 cups or stuffs a 4 to 5 pound roasting chicken. If used as a side casserole put in 1 1/2-inch high roasting pan; oil the top and bake until golden on top (1/2 hour approximately).

title: Angel Feathers
instructions: Cook until thick in a double boiler the white sugar beaten egg yolks and milk. When cooled somewhat but still medium hot add unflavored gelatin cold water and vanilla. Let cool until solid. Then fold in packages of Dream Whip and egg whites and beat until stiff with mixer (at low speed). Set aside.

title: Darrell'S Goulash
instructions: Brown meat in oil and season with salt. Add onions and saute until tender. Add water soup base salt and paprika. Cook until meat is tender (falling apart). Add tomatoes. Heat to boiling. Mix cornstarch and water. Add to broth to thicken. Serve over noodles.

title: Yellow Rice And Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken and fry with onion and garlic. When done add tomatoes and water. Boil 5 minutes; add bay leaf salt rice saffron (seasoning out of yellow rice) and green peppers. Stir thoroughly and place in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Garnish with the pimentos and can peas. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Log Cabin Dessert
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in a little cold water and mix into hot milk. Let set until cool. Stir in whipped cream and pecans. Pour into dish lined with vanilla wafer crumbs. Top with a few crumbs. Chill thoroughly. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Mayonnaise
instructions: Grind egg salt juice and mustard for 70 seconds. Add oil while motor is running. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Grandma'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease 12x9 baking dish. Pour rice in bottom of dish put chicken on top of rice. Pour onion soup mix over chicken and rice. Heat mushroom soup and water until hot and pour over top. Add butter and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1-1/2 hrs. or until done.

title: Grilled Honey Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place chicken breast halves on a preheated barbecue grill for 20 to 30 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile in a medium-sized bowl combine the remaining ingredients then brush over cooked chicken and grill for 5 minutes more.

title: Coconut Pie(2 Pies)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Sock-It-To-Me-Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tMix ingredients together. Pour half of the batter into pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. Sprinkle over batter in pan. Pour other half of batter in pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes\tor until cake is golden brown or springs back at touch.

title: Sausage Soup
instructions: In skillet crumble and brown sausage. Pour off grease. Transfer sausage to very large stock pot. Add tomato juice tomatoes green beans butter beans okra and carrots. Cook over medium heat for 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Add potatoes. Cook for 15 minutes. Add corn and peas. Cook 15 more minutes. Serve hot with cornbread. Leftovers freeze well.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add cheese last. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Firecracker Casserole
instructions: Brown meat onion cumin and chili powder; drain off fat. Put meat mixture in pan. Layer with the beans. Top with Ro-Tel and soup then add the tortillas. Finish with cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Roach Killer
instructions: Add water to form small balls. Place all around.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Melt butter with 1 1/2 c. sugar; add dates lemon juice and milk. Cook until soft and mushy. Beat eggs. Add to fruit mixture with vanilla and salt. Add Rice Krispies and nuts; cool. Shape into balls and roll into coconut chopped nuts or powdered sugar.

title: Mix-In-The-Pan Chocolate-Date Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Prepare Chocolate Chip Topping (below); reserve. Pour hot water over dates in small bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain dates reserving water. Mix flour brown sugar cocoa baking soda and salt in ungreased square pan 8x8x2 inches. Stir in dates. Add enough water to date water to measure 1 cup. Stir water mixture and remaining ingredients into flour mixture. Sprinkle with topping. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Coconut Dream Bars
instructions: Mix ingredients well and put into a 9 x 12-inch ungreased pan. Bake 15 minutes or until slightly browned in a moderate oven.

title: Easy Time Holiday Squares
instructions: Add sugar to butter in mixing bowl; cream well until light and fluffy. At medium speed add eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Add flour and lemon extract. Pour batter into well-greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch cookie sheet. Mark off into 20 squares making holes with teaspoon carefully. Place a heaping tablespoonful of pie filling in each center. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. While warm sift powdered sugar over squares. Cut into 20 squares.

title: Cranberry Chutney
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pineapple in a heavy saucepan. Stir well. Cook over medium heat 15 or 20 minutes or until the cranberry skins begin to pop. Stir in the pineapple; reduce heat to low and cook an additional 30 minutes stirring often. Serve warm or cold.

title: Patio Blush
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients; divide among six 16-ounce glasses. Fill glasses with ginger ale. Top each with a scoop of sherbet. Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

title: Flowerpot Fruitcake
instructions: To prepare flower pots Use 3 new clay pots that are 4 inches wide at the top (inside rim) and 4 1/2 inches in depth. Pull off a 12-inch square of heavy duty aluminum foil. Turn clay pot over and press foil as smoothly as possible over bottom and up sides of outside of pot. Remove shaped foil then turn clay pot over and carefully press foil down into pot firmly and smoothly against insides of pot. Press extra foil over rim of pot for easy lifting later. Grease bottom and side of foil; dust with flour.

title: Wine Sauced Beans And Franks(From 1975 Edition)
instructions: Place franks in saucepan with wine. Cover and heat slowly to simmer. Turn off heat. Let stand to plump up. Cut a lengthwise gash in top of each frank.

title: Grilled Vegetable Kabobs With Rice
instructions: Combine dressing parsley and basil in a small bowl cover and chill. Alternate squash onions tomatoes and mushrooms on 8 skewers.

title: Ma Schell'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine. Add sugar a little at a time. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour soda salt and baking powder. Add alternately with sour cream. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Flatten with wet hand. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter French Toast
instructions: Spread peanut butter evenly over 4 bread slices. Arrange banana slices evenly over peanut butter. Top with remaining bread slices. Set aside. Combine eggs and milk in shallow dish. Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Dip each sandwich into egg mixture turning to coat both sides. Place in hot skillet and cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until brown. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar eggs vanilla milk and 1/2 cup butter. Beat with mixer until smooth. Spoon into a greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Combine brown sugar flour 1/3 cup butter and pecans; over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together; stand overnight.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown onion and meat together and drain. Mix all ingredients except beans. Add meat mixture and beans with other ingredients. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar; add beaten eggs sour cream and soda. Beat well; stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all together except sour cream. Fold sour cream in last. Grease ovenproof dish lightly (deep pie plate). Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Bananas
instructions: Cut bananas into 1-inch pieces. Place the lemon juice sour cream and coconut into separate bowls. Dip banana pieces into the lemon juice. Roll in sour cream and then in coconut. Make sure all sides are covered. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate several hours. Makes 24 pieces.

title: Broccoli Ring
instructions: Cook and drain the chopped broccoli. Soften gelatin in water. Add condensed chicken broth to gelatin; heat and stir until gelatin is dissolved. Beat mayonnaise sour cream lemon juice and minced onion with rotary beater until smooth. Add gelatin and beat again. Fold eggs and broccoli into partially set gelatin mixture.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill. For small crowd halve ingredients.

title: Frozen Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and freeze. Take out 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown drain and rinse hamburg. Fry onions. Can also add 2 large green peppers diced. Mix catsup sugar chili powder cornstarch salt and pepper. Mix and place in electric roaster. Simmer 2 to 3 hours stirring often. Serves 80 to 85.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Chuck Wagon Stew
instructions: Coat beef in first 4 ingredients brown. Add onion and garlic cook until soft. Add rest of ingredients. Cover and simmer 2 hours. Add potatoes and carrots cook another 45 minutes.

title: Elom Teriyaki Chicken Wings And Fried Rice
instructions: Cut chicken wings into drumettes. Discard tips or freeze for chicken stock. Wash chicken. Combine the light soy sauce teriyaki sauce and lemon juice. Pour over chicken and marinate for 3 to 4 hours. Heat oil in deep fryer or skillet. Drain chicken and fry.

title: Chinese Fried Walnuts
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or up to 2 weeks ahead In a 4-quart saucepan over high heat heat water to boiling. Add walnuts and heat to boiling; cook 1 minute. Rinse walnuts under running hot water. Drain. Wash saucepan and dry well. In a large bowl with a rubber spatula gently stir warm walnuts with sugar until sugar is dissolved. (If necessary let mixture stand 5 minutes to dissolve sugar.) Meanwhile in same saucepan over medium heat heat about 1 inch salad oil to 350\u00b0. With a slotted spoon add about half of walnuts to oil; fry 5 minutes or until golden stirring often.

title: Oven-Fried Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine and set aside. Combine stuffing Parmesan cheese parsley and garlic. Dip chicken into margarine. Roll in stuffing mixture. Arrange skin side up in shallow baking pan. Do not crowd. Sprinkle with margarine and stuffing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Marie Hardegree'S Vanilla Wafers
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and egg. Stir in milk and vanilla. Sift remaining dry ingredients together. Add to butter mixture and blend well. Stir in raisins or pecans if desired. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a lightly greased baking sheet. Allow room to spread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Super Nachos
instructions: Arrange chips in single layer on large microwave plate. Sprinkle cheese evenly over chips. Spoon teaspoonfuls of beans over chips; top with 1/2 teaspoonful of salsa. Microwave at medium (50%) 1 1/2 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Pare apples; cut in eighths and arrange in 9-inch pastry-lined pie plate. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Sift 1/2 cup sugar with flour; cut in butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening brown sugar and eggs. Stir in sour milk. Sift together the flour soda and salt; stir in. Mix in nuts cherries and dates. Chill. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Stir milk into rice; add sugar salt and eggs slightly beaten. Bake in a buttered shallow dish.

title: Charlotte Russe
instructions: Add gelatine to milk in a small pan. Heat and stir until dissolved. Cool. Beat 2 egg yolks well with 1 cup of sugar. Whip the cream until stiff. Beat 2 egg whites and add to yolks and sugar. Now add gelatine mixture and pour all of this into whipped cream and beat well adding vanilla. Put in refrigerator.

title: Texas Potatoes
instructions: Mix potatoes butter sour cream milk soup and 1/2 cheese. Save other half for top. Pour in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Green Stuff
instructions: Clean and separate broccoli into bite size pieces. Combine remaining ingredients and toss.

title: Easy Lasagna(No Precooking Of Pasta)
instructions: Brown ground beef; pour off fat. Add spaghetti sauce water and seasoning. Simmer 7 minutes.

title: Rosemary Walnuts
instructions: Put walnuts on a cookie sheet. Mix melted oleo crushed rosemary salt and cayenne pepper. Pour over walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Frosted Walnuts
instructions: Mix the buttermilk and sugar in a sauce pan and cook slowly until at soft ball stage (approximately 15 minutes). Take off heat and add the vanilla stir. Next add nuts and stir until covered. Spread onto waxed paper and let cool. Break apart with fork and store in tin.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Blend shortening brown sugar and granulated sugar in a large bowl. Beat in vanilla and eggs. Sift remaining dry ingredients together; add to the sugar-egg mixture blend well. Add 1/2 cup candy. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet; decorate tops with remaining candies. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Okra And Shrimp Stew
instructions: In skillet begin frying okra then add all remaining ingredients. Cook covered for 1 hour.

title: Yum Yum Delight
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake is done. Prick holes in the cake with a fork. Pour juice from one large can of crushed pineapple over cake while it is still hot. Prepare topping.

title: Stir-Fry Veggies And Chicken
instructions: Chop chicken and veggies; brown chicken in oil first then add onion and other veggies. Stir constantly until browned a little. Add soy sauce garlic and Italian seasoning and a little water. Cover and simmer until youre ready to eat.

title: Chicken Broccoli Fettuccine
instructions: Stir margarine and garlic 2 minutes. Stir in soup milk and cheese. Heat to boiling. Add chicken. Cook over low heat 5 minutes stirring often. Top with fettuccine.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: In a large bowl stir together sweetened condensed milk water egg yolks and vanilla. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into aluminum foil 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Freeze 6 hours or until firm. Scoop ice cream from pan or invert and slice for serving.

title: Wild Rice And Oyster Dressing
instructions: Measure water into a saucepan and add rice bouillon granules margarine and peppers. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and simmer until all water is absorbed (about 25 to 30 minutes). Add chicken livers that have been chopped in the food processor and the raw oysters. Cook for about 10 more minutes. Add green onions. Stir well and serve. This dish is relatively expensive to make but it is worth the expense. The Cobb children think that Christmas and Thanksgiving dinner is incomplete without their wild rice and oyster dressing. Serves 9.

title: Curried Rice Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl. Combine Italian dressing vinegar and curry powder; add to rice mixture and toss well. Cover and chill.

title: Butterscotch Breakfast Rolls(Overnight)
instructions: Put slices of dough in Bundt pan. Sprinkle with pudding and cinnamon. Mix melted butter brown sugar and nuts; pour over dough. Cover with foil and leave on counter overnight. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn over on plate.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a large plastic bag add all ingredients. Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking pan; discard bag. Bake stirring occasionally 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired. Makes about 8 servings.

title: S Mores
instructions: Grease 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Heat first 3 ingredients to boiling. Stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal in bowl until coated. Fold in marshmallows. Press in pan with buttered spoon. Let stand 1 hour.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover; chill. Makes 5 cups.

title: Hot Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and garlic. Drain grease. Add chili powder and cumin.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine softened cheeses and blend well. Add onions bell peppers and seasonings. Mix well and chill 1 hour or until firm. Shape into balls. Roll in finely chopped pecans or walnuts. This is better served after it has been allowed to sit 3 to 5 days.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions. Pour 1/2 of batter into greased medium roasting pan and bake for 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from oven and top with caramels melted with 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and pecans. Cover all this with the rest of batter. Bake 20 to 25 minutes longer. Top with frosting.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and fold in chocolate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until done.

title: Zucchini Squash Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; set aside. Peel squash remove seeds and grate as for cole slaw. Mix dry ingredients with sugar eggs and oil. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased and floured pans 2 large or 3 small pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Make the Potato Buds for 12. Add the cream cheese chives salt and pepper; mix with Potato Buds. Add the eggs; beat into mixture. Pour into buttered casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: My Mom'S Mexican Casserole(Student Favorite)
instructions: Crush 3/4 bag of Doritos in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole (remember to Pam). Put meat mixture as next layer. Sprinkle cheese for next layer. Pour sauce over. Top with remaining Doritos which have been left whole. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla coconut and nuts. Mix well. Fold in egg whites. Pour batter in three 8 or 9-inch cake pans that have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Minute Cherry Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a small mixing bowl combine pie crust mix sugar and cinnamon. Add butter. Mix until crumbly. Spread pie filling in 8-inch square pan. Sprinkle with pie crust mixture. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until light golden brown. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients in large bowl until blended. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake about 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes about 60 sausage balls.

title: Tossed Macaroni
instructions: Put Ricotta cheese in serving bowl. Crumble with a fork. Add butter and noodles; toss 2 to 3 times. Cook bacon in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat until crisp. Add peas and saute 2 minutes; drain fat. Add bacon and peas to noodles and toss. Add Parmesan cheese salt and pepper. Toss again and serve immediately. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cherry-Banana Bread
instructions: In a large mixing bowl with electric mixer combine butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour baking powder salt and nutmeg; add flour mixture and bananas alternately to butter mixture mixing just until ingredients are moistened. Do not overmix. Fold in dried cherries. Pour batter into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes. Best served the day after baking.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Combine flour salt soda and cinnamon. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into two greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Sugar 'N Spice Cookies
instructions: Mix the flour and cinnamon then add the sugar butter and eggs. Mix well then chill. Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl mix chicken pieces (cooked and cut up in strips) soup broth and sour cream. Pour into ungreased casserole dish. Cover with crushed Ritz crackers and pour butter over top. Bake 30 minutes until brown and bubbly.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese by letting sit at room temperature. Add Cheddar cheese to cream cheese. Mix together. You may add onions green pepper chopped ham chopped dried beef pineapple or pecans to your mix. Roll into a ball. Roll ball over chopped pecans if desired.

title: Beet Soup Or Borsch
instructions: Add the sliced beets with juice to the stock with a tablespoon or two of vinegar. In a separate bowl mix the flour and water to make a paste and add to the sour cream stirring or mixing with an eggbeater. The trick to not getting lumpy sour cream in soup is to add some hot soup (not boiling) to the flour mixture a ladle at a time stirring or mixing as you do this for 6 or 7 ladles. Add this mixture to the pot of soup stirring while adding. Make sure the soup is not boiling. If soup is still too sweet add another tablespoon or two of vinegar or dill pickle juice.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and oil; mix well. Add eggs and beat. Combine all dry ingredients and then add to mixture alternating with water. Stir in sweet potatoes and nuts. Pour batter into 3 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: Place potatoes carrots celery and onion in a large kettle; cover with water. Add salt and pepper. Cook until tender. Meanwhile in a mixing bowl; combine cream cheese butter and soup. Stir well. Add milk and bacon. Add to vegetables and heat through. For a thicker soup drain vegetables before adding cream cheese mixture.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Sprinkle onion powder garlic powder and salt on cubed chicken breasts to your liking. Fry until chicken cubes are browned.

title: Salmon Steaks With Dijon Sauce
instructions: Rub surface of fish with lemon juice. Place steaks or fillets on foil lined baking dish (or broiler pan) without track. Cut butter into pea size pieces; dot top of salmon. Broil 5 minutes. Combine sour cream mayonnaise mustard and dill or tarragon. Spread on broiled steaks (fillets); do not turn salmon. Broil an additional 2 to 3 minutes to brown.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain all canned vegetables. Combine oil sugar vinegar salt and pepper in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and let cool. Combine all vegetables in a covered bowl; pour cooled vinegar mixture over vegetables and stir well. Chill several hours before serving. Will keep several days in refrigerator.

title: Cook It Quick
instructions: Oil grill. Mix flour sugar and baking soda well. Beat egg in a bowl. Blend in buttermilk. Add dry ingredients; beat until smooth. Blend in margarine. If thinner pancake is desired add 1/4 cup more buttermilk. Use about 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Put on grill and fry. Serve immediately. Good with sausage or bacon.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Combine in a bowl for 2 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in a greased and floured 10 x 14-inch cake pan.

title: Spinach Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook shells according to package. Drain. Cook creamed spinach (follow package directions.) Empty spinach pouches into large bowl and cool. Stir in Ricotta cheese Mozzarella salt and pepper. Stuff each shell with tablespoon of cheese mixture. In skillet cook ground beef. Stir in jar of spaghetti sauce. Put stuffed shells in casserole and pour sauce over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spread cookie dough on cookie sheet. Bake until done. Cool.

title: Pizza
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve yeast and sugar in 1/4 cup warm water. Add remaining water oil and salt in big bowl. Gradually stir in flour one cup at a time until dough forms a ball and pulls away from sides of bowl. Turn out on a floured surface; knead 10 minutes. Return to oiled bowl; cover and let rise 1 hour. Punch down; divide in 2 parts. Roll out flat on floured surface. Sprinkle 2 cookie sheets with cornmeal. Spread out each dough on cookie sheet. Sprinkle each with equal amounts of sauce cheese oregano and favorite toppings. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Frances Phillip'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Partially cook broccoli in salt water and drain. Mix soup onion and mayonnaise. Layer broccoli soup mixture and cheese in a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with crumbled Ritz crackers and pour melted margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Coconut-Sour Cream Layer Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix and bake; cool and split layers. Blend sugar sour cream and coconut. Chill. Reserve 1 cup mixture for frosting. Spread remainder between layers. Combine reserved sour cream with whipped topping. Spread on top and sides of cake. Seal cake in an airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days before serving.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine sugar and cream cheese. Mix well. Add Cool Whip and vanilla. Mix well.

title: Walnut Crescents
instructions: In a large bowl cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add vanilla; blend well. Gradually blend in flour. Stir in nuts. Shape a spoonful of dough into rolls about 3 inches long. Place on an ungreased baking sheet. Pull ends down to form a crescent. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 16 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly on pan. Remove to wire rack to cool completely. Dip ends in chocolate glaze and then in jimmies or coconut.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Beat well the first 6 ingredients. Add the vinegar and a little celery seed. Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Pork Chop Sauce
instructions: Blend ingredients together. Bring sauce to boil; simmer for 15 minutes. Put on chops to charbroil on grill. Freeze sauce over and over.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Mix greens and dressing. Place croutons on top.

title: 24-Hour Vegetable Salad
instructions: In a large bowl place 3 cups of torn lettuce. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Layer eggs over lettuce. Sprinkle with salt. Next layer in order the green peas remaining lettuce bacon and cheese. Spread mayonnaise over top sealing to edge. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Garnish with sliced green onions and paprika if desired. Toss gently before serving. Makes 12 servings.

title: Corn Bread Stuffing
instructions: Saute celery and onions in margarine. Add rest of ingredients and bake until done.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Bring 6 ounces of Coke to a boil. Pour over cherry jello. Add the rest of the Coke and mix well. Add pineapple. Add pecans. Mix well; refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Paprika Chicken
instructions: *If using a pressure cooker use 1 teaspoon paprika 3 tablespoons flour 4 tablespoons fat 1 bouillon cube and 1 1/2 cups water.

title: Sangria
instructions: Pour lemon and orange juice into large pitcher. Add sugar; stir to blend. Add all other ingredients. Chill in fridge. To serve pour into wide wine glasses; place some fruit in each glass. Can be made well in advance.

title: Veal Scallopini
instructions: Saute garlic in oil over low flame for 5 minutes. Discard garlic. Brown cutlets in oil. Mix flour pepper and nutmeg; sprinkle over brown meat. Add onion and wine. Cover skillet and simmer about 20 minutes turning meat several times. Add more liquid (wine or tomato juice) if necessary. Add mushrooms; cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes longer. Serve on a warm platter with sauce garnished with paprika and parsley. Yield 4 servings. Approximate calories/serving 360.

title: Dry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese Cool Whip pineapple and dry jello together in large bowl. Chill.

title: Snow-Day Apple Pancake
instructions: Set the oven at 400\u00b0. Heat a 9-inch cast-iron skillet or other heavy-duty ovenproof skillet. Melt the butter. Combine the cinnamon and sugar. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of the mixture over the apples and saute them until tender over low heat stirring occasionally.

title: Cottage Cheese Delight
instructions: Mix together and sprinkle with nutmeg. Serve in pretty salad bowl.

title: Bubble Brew
instructions: Gently stir all ingredients together in a big plastic container.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Cut drained peaches into tiny pieces (or put drained peaches in blender for a few seconds). Sprinkle jello over peaches and stir; let set for just a minute or two. Add remaining ingredients and chill. Serve.

title: Herb Tea Blend
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a resealable plastic bag.

title: Date Nut Fingers
instructions: Melt margarine; add sugar eggs dates and nuts. Bring to a boil; continue cooking at a slow boil for 10 minutes. Add vanilla and stir well. Pour mixture over Rice Krispies. Shape into logs or balls and roll in coconut. Store in sealed container in refrigerator.

title: Carrot Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Sesame Shrimp And Asparagus
instructions: Trim asparagus and cut into 2 inch pieces. In wok or large skillet toast sesame seed until golden; set aside. In same skillet over medium-high heat oil add asparagus onions and shrimp. Cook until tender and crisp stirring frequently for 5 minutes. Stir in sesame seed soy sauce and salt. Just mix and stir. Serve over rice.

title: Chocolate Sugar Puffs
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs. Add chocolate which has been melted. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Stir in nuts. Form in 1-inch balls. Roll in 4x sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Rice With Grilled Pork Medallions
instructions: Cook onion and celery in olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat stirring constantly until tender. Add chicken broth and dried thyme; bring mixture to a boil. Rinse wild rice in 3 changes of hot water; drain. Add wild rice to broth mixture. Cover. Reduce heat and cook 30 minutes. Add black-eyed peas and next 7 ingredients; cover and cook 20 minutes or until rice is tender. Serve with grilled pork medallions and apple wedges. Garnish if desired. Yields 4 servings.

title: Raw Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries and sugar; let set overnight. Then add pineapple marshmallows pecans and Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all in bowl and chill.

title: Butterfinger Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and peanut butter. Add powdered sugar. Stir in crushed candy bars and Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and refrigerate.

title: Carilou'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar and oil. Beat eggs and add to sugar and oil mixture. Add other ingredients. Mix well and form a ball. Refrigerate overnight. Roll dough as thin as you like. Pinch a small portion of dough and form a ball in your hand. Flatten the small ball of dough and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Delicious Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger celery and onion lightly and drain. Add remaining ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Too Easy Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dip chicken into eggs then into bread crumbs to coat thoroughly. In large skillet place chicken in hot oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Brown chicken on both sides; remove from skillet and drain on paper towels. Pour 1 cup sauce in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Layer chicken and top with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for 45 minutes or until thoroughly cooked. Serves 8.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening. Add sugar. Beat well. Add egg yolks. Beat well. Combine flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla. Add coconut and nuts. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour batter into three greased and floured 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cakes test done. Cool.

title: Pig Pickin' Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cake mix oil eggs and oranges. Bake in 3 well-greased round cake pan or one 9 x 13-inch pan for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and spread with icing.

title: Cool Rise Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour sugar yeast and salt. Add oleo hot water and eggs. Beat with mixer for 2 minutes at medium speed. Gradually add remaining flour until it pulls away from sides of bowl. Remove and knead until elastic. Cover with plastic and towel and let rest 20 minutes. Punch down and divide in half. Roll out and spread with oleo brown sugar cinnamon and nuts. Roll into jelly roll and slice 1 to 1 1/2-inch slices. Place in jelly roll pan. Brush lightly with oil. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in refrigerator overnight.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Mix butter oatmeal flour and brown sugar until crumbly. Place half in bottom of 8-inch pan.

title: Hands Off Biscuits
instructions: Put all ingredients in a 1-quart freezer bag. Close bag; mix ingredients. Open bag occasionally to expel air. When mixed thoroughly snip one bottom corner with scissors about 1 inch. Squeeze dough on baking pan. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits. Sprinkle tops with flour; pat down to desired thickness with fork. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes at 425\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Creamy Honey Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix very well and refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Combine olive oil onion and garlic in a large skillet. Add all vegetables and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cook on medium-high heat (stirring occasionally) until vegetables are crisp-tender. Remove from heat. Serve over cooked pasta. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain spinach; salt and pepper to taste. Melt butter. Add flour and eggs and mix everything. Put into 9 x 12-inch dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until cheese turns slightly brown on top. Serves 12.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix ingredients and store in glass jar. Add mixture to water to taste and serve with ice.

title: Delicious Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine sugar oil and eggs; beat until light and fluffy. Stir in pumpkin. Combine dry ingredients; stir into pumpkin mixture. Add water and nuts (optional) mixing well. Spoon batter into 2 well-greased 9 1/4 x 5 1/4 x 2 3/4-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Petticoat Tails
instructions: Mix margarine sugar and flavoring until very creamy. Sift flour and salt together then mix all the ingredients until the dough is like modeling clay (the dough is not sticky). Roll in waxed paper or put into fruit juice cans. Put in refrigerator for 24 hours. Slice thin and bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly brown.

title: Smoky Broiled Fish
instructions: Brush inside of fish with mixed ingredients. Place in greased pan. Brush fish with sauce. Broil for awhile then turn. Brush with sauce. Continue to broil until done at 325\u00b0.

title: Quick Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tMelt together over low heat the cocoa and margarine. Remove from heat add sugar flour and eggs. Mix well and pour into greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan. Top with nuts. Bake 20 to 30 minutes. Center will be firm and moist. Cut into squares about 20.

title: Apple Crescent Snacks
instructions: Wash peel and core apple. Chop apple into small pieces. Measure sugar and cinnamon; combine in a small bowl (add nutmeg if desired).

title: Oven Beef Burgundy
instructions: Shake meat with flour salt and pepper in a plastic bag to coat well. Reserve any remaining flour mixture. Brown beef part at a time in hot butter in a large skillet or Dutch oven. Lift out beef as it browns and transfer it to a 2 1/4 to 3-quart baking dish. Heat brandy in a small pan. Ignite. Pour over beef. Add onions and mushrooms. Sprinkle with any reserved flour mixture. Stir garlic parsley and thyme into fat remaining in skillet. Cook 1 minute. Add beef broth and wine. Heat stirring to loosen browned bits until mixture comes to boiling. Pour over beef and vegetables. Add bay leaf. Cover. Bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until meat is tender. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Simple Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter margarine or peanut butter and powdered sugar. Add other ingredients and mix together well. Dough should be stiff. Roll into 1-inch balls and flatten with fork tines on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes until lightly brown around the edges only.

title: Hot Lettuce Salad
instructions: Toss dressing with lettuce (or spinach) and eggs just before serving.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Melt chocolate and add to melted shortening. Add sugar egg milk and vanilla then add sifted dry ingredients. Let stand 10 minutes. Drop from teaspoon onto greased baking sheet and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Frost if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Fudge
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar water and vanilla blending until smooth. Quickly stir in chocolate and nuts. Turn into buttered 8 x 8-inch pan spreading 1 inch thick. Chill and cut into squares.

title: Snack Time Favorite Cookies
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugars and beaten eggs. Add vanilla and beat well. Sift dry ingredients. Add nuts crushed Wheaties and oats. Mix well. Drop from a teaspoon onto lightly buttered baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Cabbage Fry
instructions: Place oil/butter in skillet; put cabbage green pepper and onion in skillet. Place sliced Polish sausage on top and let simmer until cabbage is tender. Season to taste. Best served with cornbread.

title: Fluffy Pancakes
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together adding the milk last while mixing to the desired texture. Pour onto hot griddle. Cook and enjoy!

title: Stir And Drop Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat eggs with a fork until well blended. Stir in oil vanilla and lemon flavoring. Blend in sugar until mixture thickens. Sift flour baking powder salt and nutmeg and stir into oil mixture. Drop with teaspoon 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with greased glass dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes to a delicate brown. Remove immediately from baking sheet. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Million Dollar Relish
instructions: Soak cucumbers (covered with water) and salt for 3 hours. Rinse and drain. Chop cucumbers peppers and onions. Add remaining ingredients. Boil for 20 minutes. Seal in pint jars which have been sterilized. Great on hot dogs and in salads.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Cut chicken into strips and layer in 9 x 13-inch pan over broccoli. Mix soup mayonnaise cheese and lemon juice together and pour over chicken. Put crumbs in melted butter and sprinkle on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes.

title: Johnny Appleseed Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large saucepan melt margarine over medium heat. Remove from heat. Blend in remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 9-inch square or 11 x 17-inch pan greased bottom only. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until top springs back when touched in center. Serve warm or cool plain or with whipped cream or frosting.

title: Sweet Potato Puff
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes pineapple and nuts. Spray a 2-quart casserole with Pam or oil with margarine. Alternate layers of sweet potato mixture and marshmallows ending with marshmallows. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Will serve 10 to 12.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted boiling water 10 to 15 minutes; drain and rinse in cold water. Place in icebox to cool for 10 minutes. Add in the rest of the ingredients draining tuna fish first; mix well.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil. Add vanilla; stir in zucchini. Sift flour salt cinnamon soda and baking powder. Stir into first mixture. Fold in nuts.

title: Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese instant jello and sugar. Add whip cream to soften and sugar to taste. Prepare pudding according to instructions. Layer cream cheese mix on bottom and pudding on top. Top with chocolate or strawberries as desired. Place in freezer for 45 minutes to allow to set.

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Add 1 cup water to zucchini. Bring to a boil and cook 6 minutes. Add next 3 ingredients and cook 6 minutes more. Add jello and stirring continue to cook until it is dissolved. Also stir jam while it is cooking. You can use other flavors of jello. Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Sally Lunn Bread(From Williamsburg)
instructions: Scald the milk or bring it almost to a simmer and add the butter sugar and salt. Let cool until tepid (95\u00b0). Dissolve the yeast in 1/4 cup of tepid water. Using your electric mixer if you have a powerful one beat the eggs and then add the milk mixture then yeast water and finally the flour. Beat until smooth about 5 minutes.

title: Double Decker Fudge
instructions: Line 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with aluminum foil. Place 1 cup peanut butter chips in medium bowl; set aside. In second medium bowl stir together cocoa melted butter and vanilla until mixture is smooth. Add remaining 1 cup chips; set aside. In heavy 4-quart saucepan stir together sugar Marshmallow Creme evaporated milk and 1/4 cup butter. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a rolling boil. Boil and stir 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Immediately add half of hot mixture to bowl with peanut butter chips only. Pour remainder into cocoa mixture; stir to blend. Beat peanut butter mixture until chips are completely melted. Spread evenly in prepared pan. Beat cocoa mixture until chips are melted and mixture thickens. Spread evenly over top of peanut butter layer. Cool until firm. Remove from pan; peel off foil. Cut into squares. Store in airtight container in cool dry place.

title: Berry Bananas
instructions: Slice the bananas. Wash and clean the berries. Layer the banana slices and berries in a dish. If desired add yogurt or milk and sprinkle with brown sugar.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: *Can use self-rising flour but eliminate salt baking powder and soda.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix above ingredients except vanilla. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Beat until cool.

title: Smoked Turkey Salad
instructions: In a bowl mix together the onion potatoes beans and turkey. Add dressing to moisten the mixture then add more dressing if desired. Garnish with sprinkling of fresh parsley and a dash of paprika.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken with enough water to cover until done. Remove chicken reserve broth. After cooling remove meat from bones and chop meat. Cook noodles in reserved broth according to package directions. Melt butter in large pan; add green peppers onions and mushrooms. Saut until soft. Add all ingredients to noodles stirring until Velveeta melts. Bake at 350\u00b0 until casserole bubbles add American cheese to top of casserole bake until cheese melts. This dish freezes well for potlucks etc.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Sift cocoa and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Add milk and lay margarine sticks on top. Do not stir. Cook on High for 6 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir thoroughly. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir until well mixed. Pour into buttered platter. Cool in refrigerator for 1 hour. Cut and serve. Do not double this recipe.

title: Lillie'S Layered Salad
instructions: Layer all ingredients and spread mayonnaise over the top. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese. Seal and refrigerate overnight. Mix before serving.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water; beat cheese and gradually add gelatin. Beat well. Stir in pineapple and baby food; fold in whipped topping. Pour into 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Cover and chill. Cut into squares and place on lettuce leaves.

title: Yogurt Salad
instructions: Chop apples. Peel and chop oranges. Place equal portions of chopped fruit into 4 small bowls. Top each with 1/2 cup yogurt and sprinkle with pecans.

title: Sausage Barbecue
instructions: Fry sausage; drain grease off. Add soup sauce paste and mushrooms. Let simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: German Coleslaw
instructions: Place cabbage onion and mango in a bowl. In saucepan bring vinegar sugar celery and mustard seed to a boil. Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes then pour over salad mixture and toss. Refrigerate overnight or longer. The longer it sets the better.

title: Asparagus Souffle
instructions: Place all ingredients in electric blender; blend well. Pour ingredients in greased souffle dish. Place souffle dish in a pan of water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife comes out clean.

title: Frozen Tomato Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large pan; cook until soft. Let cool then puree mixture in a blender. Bag and freeze.

title: Crystallized Ginger Pickles(Mrs. Buddy Quin)
instructions: Use overgrown cucumbers that yellow. Soak cucumbers in lime 24 hours. Wash. Soak in alum water 24 hours and wash. Soak in ginger water 24 hours. Do\tnot wash unless too strong with ginger. Just drain well.\tCombine vinegar water sugar and pickling spice. Soak cucumbers in the solution 4 hours. Then boil 1 hour. Stir frequently. Seal in sterilized jars.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Can be used over many vegetables casseroles and baked potatoes. Heat slightly before spooning over baked potatoes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake in ungreased loaf pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Peanut Butter Fingers
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl combine all ingredients except chocolate chips. Blend on low speed until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press in the bottom of prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Sprinkle immediately with chocolate chips. Let stand 5 minutes then spread evenly.

title: Cheesecake Cupcakes
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients and fill cupcake papers with cookie on bottom about 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 11 to 14 minutes. Top with cherries.

title: Marinated Steak
instructions: Prepare meat with tenderizer as directed on bottle. Combine with all other ingredients in shallow pan or plastic bag. Add meat and marinate in refrigerator for 6 to 12 hours or overnight. Place steak on grill 6 inches above hot coals. Grill 12 to 25 minutes basting occasionally turn over continue basting and grilling 10 to 15 minutes for medium. Makes a cheaper cut of meat tasty and tender.

title: Mexican Layered Dip
instructions: Layer in casserole dish (approximately 9 x 13-inch). Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Serve with chips. Quick and easy!

title: Ham-Potato-Pineapple Bake
instructions: Trim excess fat from ham. Place in an 11 x 7 x 1/2-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray. Arrange potatoes and pineapple over ham; set aside. Combine vinegar and remaining ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat until hot. Pour over ham. Cover; bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields servings for 4.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar with oleo. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with milk and vanilla. Bake in 10-inch tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together oil and dressing mix. Pour over crackers; toss lightly to coat. Spread crackers onto a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes stirring after 7 minutes. Makes 6 cups.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
instructions: Mix oil chocolate and sugar. Blend in one egg at a time until well mixed. Add vanilla. Measure flour by sifting. Stir flour baking powder and salt into oil mixture. Chill several hours. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Roll up teaspoonfuls and roll in powdered sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix together and serve with 7-up or Sprite. Can be frozen.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Mix all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook until broccoli becomes tender about 3 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
instructions: Spoon flour into dry measuring cup; level off and pour measured flour onto waxed paper. Add flour (not sifted). Stir to blend. Cream peanut butter sugar shortening eggs and vanilla thoroughly. Add blended dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Mix until smooth. Stir in chocolate bits and peanuts.

title: Orange Muffins
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in the center of mixture. Combine egg milk orange rind orange juice and oil mixing well. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. (Do not overmix.) Stir in raisins or dates. Spoon batter into greased muffin pans filling 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes one dozen.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together hash browns soup cheese sour cream salt pepper and onion. Place in large casserole dish. Crush corn flakes; place on top. Pour melted butter on top of corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Mix butter 1/2 cup of sugar and flour until crumbly. Spray an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan with Pam. Place apples mixed with 1/2 cup of sugar in pan and top with crumb mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Top with Cool Whip and nuts.

title: El Rancho Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add onions and cook until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pizza Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 8-inch round cake pan with nonstick spray. Unroll dough; form 14 x 10-inch rectangle. Place in sprayed pan with dough extending evenly over sides of pan. Press dough in bottom and up sides of pan. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese over dough. Spread pizza sauce over cheese. Top with pepperoni and remaining Mozzarella cheese. Cut 2-inch cut at each corner of dough. Bring all ends at center together. Twist to secure at top of pizza. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Oven Roasted New Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Wash and cut potatoes if large. Put potatoes in a 13 x 9-inch shallow dish. Add next 3 ingredients; toss to coat. Bake 35 minutes shaking pan twice or stirring until potatoes are lightly browned. Sprinkle with chives or parsley. Contains 3 g fat.

title: Crock-Pot Calico Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer on low heat in crock-pot all day. Serve with salad and bread.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add all other ingredients one at a time mixing well after each. Bake at 350\u00b0 in loaf pans.

title: Buttermilk Chess Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and flour; add eggs and buttermilk. Stir in butter and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0\tfor 45 minutes or until set.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Add flour and cream of tartar to remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad Finger Sandwiches
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients tossing well. Stir in mayonnaise; cover and chill.

title: Grape Pie
instructions: Make pastry for a two-crust 9-inch pie; line pie pan with one crust. Remove and save skins from the grapes. Put pulp into a saucepan without water; bring to a rolling boil. While hot rub through strainer to remove seeds. Mix strained pulp with skins. Mix lightly through grapes the sugar and flour. Sprinkle with lemon juice and salt. Pour grapes into pastry lined pie pan; dot with the butter. Cover with top crust which has slits cut in it. Bake until crust is nicely browned and juice begins to bubble at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve cool or slightly warm not hot.

title: Frozen Pudding Sandwiches
instructions: Gradually add milk to peanut butter in bowl blending until smooth. add pudding mix. With electric mixer at low speed beat until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. Can also use hand whisk. Let stand 5 minutes. Spread filling about 1/2-inch thick on 12 of the graham cracker squares. Top with remaining squares pressing lightly and smoothing around edges with spatula. Freeze until firm about 3 hours. Sandwiches can be stored wrapped in freezer 3 to 4 days.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Cook carrots and combine all ingredients. Chill.

title: Five Can Casserole
instructions: Combine soups and milk; stir in boned chicken. Add noodles and mix. Bake in a greased 2-quart oblong casserole dish for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Greek Walnut Cake
instructions: Sift flour and spices together. Beat eggs well; add sugar. Add flour and liquids alternately to egg mixture mixing thoroughly after each addition. Add walnuts; mix thoroughly. Stir baking soda into the cognac; mix it into batter. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake approximately 45 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. As soon as cake is baked remove from oven and cut into squares. Pour warm honey into all lines and around edges of warm cake. Grate walnuts over cake.

title: Moo Goo Gai Pan(Chinese Chicken And Mushrooms)
instructions: Skin and bone chicken breasts. Slice across breasts into 1/8-inch slices. In a medium bowl mix chicken soy sauce sherry cornstarch ginger sugar and garlic powder. Set aside. Thinly slice mushrooms. Cut each green onion crosswise into 3-inch pieces. In a 12-inch skillet or wok over medium-high heat in 1/4 cup hot salad oil cook mushrooms and green onions stirring quickly and frequently until mushrooms are tender (about 2 minutes). With a slotted spoon remove mushroom mixture to bowl. In same skillet or wok over high heat in 3 tablespoons hot salad oil cook chicken mixture stirring frequently and quickly until chicken is tender (about 2 or 3 minutes). Return mushroom mixture to skillet and heat through. Serve over rice.

title: Fuzzy Navel Punch
instructions: Combine orange juice peach Schnapps and champagne. Pour into punch bowl; add crushed ice or frozen ice ring. Yields 1 gallon of punch.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Layer tortillas chicken mixture and cheese 3 times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: London Broil
instructions: Preheat broiler. With sharp knife score both sides of flank steak for even broiling. Place steak in broiling pan. In bowl mix onions olive oil and salt. Rub mixture on both sides of steak.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and toss gently to coat. Turn into a baking dish. Blend dry topping ingredients and cut in margarine to make crumbs. Spread on top of peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Good served with ice milk vanilla yogurt or whipped topping.

title: Cabbage And Potatoes
instructions: Wash and separate cabbage. Wash and peel potatoes. Slice very thin. Slice onion. In large pot add all ingredients and cook over low heat until potatoes are done. Serve with corned beef.

title: Tangy Sachet
instructions: Mix together mint orange peel and cloves. Divide in half. Take 2 pieces of material placing the wrong sides together. Sew 3 sides together. Fill with half the mixture. Makes great gifts.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Mix together. Roll in small balls place 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees.

title: Sesame-Cheese Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle seed evenly on bottoms and sides of greased 2-quart casserole. Beat egg in large bowl on low speed then add remaining ingredients and beat on medium speed 30 seconds. Pour into casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean about 40 to 45 minutes. Immediately invert and remove from casserole. Great cubed for fondue or other dipping.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables celery and onions. Salt and pepper to taste then drain. Place half of vegetables in dish half of cheese and half of mayonnaise. Start over with rest of vegetables cheese and mayonnaise. Top with Ritz cracker crumbs mixed with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: Mix the ingredients and form into balls a little larger than a walnuts.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Partially freeze meat and cut meat into strips 3 inches long and 1/4-inch wide. In large skillet brown meat strips in hot Crisco; drain off excess fat. Drain tomatoes reserving liquid. Add reserved liquid the water onion garlic salt and pepper to meat in skillet. Cover and simmer 60 minutes or until meat is tender. Uncover and put in Worcestershire sauce. Stir in the water and flour mixture; cook until thickened and bubbly. Cut the green peppers in 2-inch long strips; add to meat along with the drained tomatoes which have been cut up. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: German Chocolate Apple Pie Cake
instructions: Beat cake mix eggs and pie filling 5 to 8 minutes. Pour in prepared 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and mix well. Combine remaining ingredients except oil and stir into dry ingredients. Drop by tablespoons into hot oil (375\u00b0). Fry until golden brown turning once. Drain on paper towels and serve warm. Makes twelve 2-inch fritters.

title: Time-To-Spare-Ribs
instructions: You will need 1 large 14 x 20 Reynolds cooking bag.

title: Mildred'S Oyster Stew
instructions: Heat the milk and cream in a pot. Do not boil. Add oysters and any oyster juice. Simmer for 5 minutes. Season to taste. Add butter. Heat until it melts and serve very hot.

title: Ed Harmon'S Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the water. Add salt sugar and vegetable oil and mix together. Add eggs and 3 cups flour; mix. Add 1 more cup flour and knead. (May need to add a little flour if sticky.) Let rise; knead again into rolls or bread. Use a greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown on top. Rub butter on top of each roll. This is a good recipe to use for cinnamon rolls/bread.

title: Doctor Janice'S Doodle Mix
instructions: Melt 2 pounds white almond bark and stir in above mix. Spread immediately onto wax paper. Break apart when cooled.

title: Lemon Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cream Of Broccoli And Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook celery onion and broccoli in microwave on High for 6 minutes stirring after 3 minutes. Set aside. Blend cottage cheese in blender or food processor until very smooth; slowly add milk while continuing to blend. Add chicken soup to cheese/milk mixture. Blend; add mixture to cooked undrained vegetables. Microwave until heated thoroughly (about 3 minutes) without boiling. Add salt and pepper. Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Cherry Macaroon Parfaits
instructions: Prepare pudding with milk as directed on package. Combine cherry filling and extract. Alternate layers of pudding crumbled cookies and filling in 6 parfait or dessert dishes. Garnish with topping. Makes 6 servings. Preparation time is 10 minutes.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: You can also use firm ripe tomatoes. Select firm ripe tomatoes or firm green tomatoes. Wash them and cut in 1/2-inch slices without removing the skins. Dip each slice in bread crumbs or flour; saute in hot oil or Crisco. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Brownie Cake
instructions: Prepare pudding as directed. Cool stirring occasionally while cooling. Stir in dry cake mix and stir well. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chip bits and nuts. Bake as directed on package. Cool completely before cutting.

title: Cottage Meat Loaf
instructions: In a large bowl combine ketchup tomato juice salt and pepper eggs bread crumbs onions and mustard. Mix until thoroughly blended. Add ground beef. Mix gently but thoroughly. Line a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with foil. Press in the beef mixture.

title: Aunt Florie'S Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put the oatmeal in a medium bowl. Pour boiling water on the oatmeal and let stand while preparing the rest of the ingredients. Cream butter and sugars (brown and granulated) until fluffy. Sift the dry ingredients (flour and cinnamon) then add them to the butter and sugar mixture. Pour in the vanilla and the oatmeal. Stir until well blended. Pour into 2 (9-inch) layer pans or one 12 x 9 x 2-inch utility pan. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Microwave Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Sift first 3 ingredients together into a 3-quart glass casserole. Add milk; mix until partially blended. Place margarine over top. Microwave for 2 minutes. Add vanilla; beat until smooth. Add pecans; mix well. Pour into 8 x 8-inch buttered dish. Chill in refrigerator for 1 hour. Cut into squares.

title: Bisquick Chicken Pie
instructions: Take chicken off bone and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add soup and broth pour over chicken. Mix Bisquick and milk; pour over chicken. Cut up margarine and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown together onion green pepper hamburger and rice. Add salt pepper tomato sauce water and mustard. Bring mixture to a boil then simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: After heating pour over vegetables and refrigerate overnight.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Boil the water out of the green beans. Place in a casserole dish and pour the mushroom soup over beans (add 1/4 cup water to can of soup). Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Place onion rings on top and brown.

title: Ruth'S Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine milk and pie filling. Add the mandarin oranges and crushed pineapple; add nuts. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover and freeze. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving. Cut into squares. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Seven Layer Casserole
instructions: Place rice and corn in layers in a 2-quart baking dish. Season to taste. Pour 1 can of tomato sauce and 1/2 can of water over the layers. Add layers of the onion and green pepper. Cover with a layer of seasoned meat. Pour remaining can of tomato sauce and 1/4 can of water over casserole. Top with bacon strips. Cover; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer. Yields 6 servings.

title: Consomme Rice(Brown Rice)
instructions: Dice onions and celery in small pieces. Melt oleo (margarine) in a large pot. Saute onions and celery. Combine French onion soup beef consomme soup and sliced mushrooms with sauteed onions and celery. Rinse rice and add to ingredients. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours uncovered. Stir every 30 minutes. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Gourmet Olives
instructions: Drain olives and transfer to large jar. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over olives. Cover and refrigerate 10 to 12 hours; shake olives occasionally to coat evenly. Olives can be stored in refrigerator no longer than 2 weeks. Drain well before serving.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour salt and pepper together. Coat chicken pieces with flour mixture. Place chicken in deep baking dish (3 or 4-inch).

title: Marinated Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage in a large bowl. Place chopped onion and green pepper on top of cabbage. Sprinkle sugar evenly on top. Bring oil vinegar mustard celery seed and salt to a boil. Pour over cabbage while hot. Dont stir. Refrigerate covered at least 4 hours (better if refrigerated overnight). Stir mixture and drain before serving.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook butter water and chopped broccoli for 3 minutes remove pan from heat then add Velveeta and Minute rice. Cover pan and let set for 4 minutes. Add cream of celery soup.

title: Fresh Ham With Sherry Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Roast 40 minutes per pound. With a sharp knife cut 10 or more one-inch deep holes in top surface of ham; press garlic slivers and pinch of black pepper in each hole. Place roast on rack in open pan. Rub surface with sherry and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roast 40 minutes per pound or until meat thermometer is 185\u00b0. Pour off fat and combine with 2/3 cup sherry; thicken with cornstarch for sauce.

title: Sweet And Sour Meat Loaf
instructions: Slightly mix ingredients together.

title: Fluffy Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Prepare whipped topping. Mix with 1 cup of milk as directed on package in small mixer bowl. Measure 2 cups of the prepared whipped topping and set aside. Add 1 cup milk and chocolate pudding mix to remaining topping in bowl. Blend and then beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Spoon into pie shell.

title: Enchiladas(Joe And Sonya Kuykendall, 11-3-78)
instructions: Put can of tomato sauce and enchilada mix in pan and mix. Heat over low fire. Brown beef and onion over low fire in skillet. After sauce heats 10 minutes add to the beef just enough to be slightly soupy (to your preference).

title: Pickled Jalapeno Peppers
instructions: Wash split and remove stems from peppers; set aside. In a medium saucepan combine vinegar water and oil; bring to a boil. Drop in peppers onion and carrot slices; cook just long enough for peppers to change color. Place peppers and vegetables into pint jars to which 1/2 teaspoon of salt 1 garlic clove and 1 bay leaf have been added to each. Distribute liquid into jars. Seal.

title: Warm Brie Salad With Hazelnut Vinaigrette(4 Persons)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Place hazelnuts on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes. Cool and rub in a dish towel to remove the skin. Chop the hazelnuts finely and set aside.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli with onions. Mix together soup mayonnaise and eggs. Stir into broccoli. Add cheese; mix well. Melt butter and mix with crackers. Add cheese then crackers on top as crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 50 minutes.

title: Mexican Dish
instructions: Brown beef and onions; drain. Add taco seasoning beans and tomato sauce and simmer five minutes. Press dough in a 9 x 13-inch pan and up the sides one inch. Brush on oil and sprinkle corn meal over dough. Pour meat sauce over dough and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes and cook until melted. Cut into cubes. Top with shredded lettuce chopped tomatoes taco sauce and sour cream.

title: Seafood Souffle
instructions: Line bread on the bottom of a slightly greased 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Combine the next 9 ingredients and pour on top. Sprinkle with Old Bay seasoning. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Let sit 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Happy Days
instructions: Take all of the ingredients and add a pinch of warm personality and a dash of humor. Measure the words carefully the heaping amount of time and patience. Keep temperature low. Do not boil. Add a dash of humor and a pinch of warm spice of life. Serve to individuals garnished with a big smile.

title: Peach Fruit Salad
instructions: Whip together the milk cream cheese and Cool Whip. Fold in pie filling pineapple and nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Peachy Dessert Off The Grill
instructions: Cut bananas and peaches into bite size pieces. Place fruit in a foil pan or make your own pan with heavy duty foil. In a bowl stir together honey butter and 1/2 tsp. cinnamon. Spoon over fruit and toss to coat fruit.

title: Rich'S Irish Creme
instructions: Combine all ingredients in jug or container; shake vigorously.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate for one hour. Make small balls. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Steak-On-A-Stick Over An Open Scaly-Bark Fire
instructions: You will need 3 sticks (1 healthy and long 2 in shape of a \Y\) and scaly-bark fire.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In large pan melt margarine. Add flour and make a roux. Stir and add chicken broth and 1 can cream of chicken soup (add water broth or milk if this is too thick). Add remaining ingredients and stir. Pour in 9 x 13 pan. Put uncooked biscuits on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken and celery. In a separate bowl combine all other ingredients. Add chicken and celery. Let chill for 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Cook and stir in hot oil 2 to 3 minutes. Mix cornstarch and soy sauce; add to pan. Add other ingredients. Bring to boil and turn down to simmer for 10 to 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Blend sugar flour nutmeg and margarine. Add eggs; beat until smooth. Pour over cut up rhubarb in 9-inch pastry lined pie pan. Top with pastry cut fancy shapes or just bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add sugar eggs butter and vanilla. Mix well until eggs are cooked in hot rice. Add milk and raisins. Return to low heat stirring continuously for about 5 minutes. Pour into serving dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg and brown sugar.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
instructions: Heat the oil; add dry salad dressing. Mix dill weed and garlic salt. Mix and pour over the oyster crackers. Stir with a wooden spoon.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix in bowl by hand. Bake 8 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gumbo
instructions: In a pot (not iron) saut okra onions celery and garlic until done or all the stringiness is gone from the okra.

title: Pie Crusts
instructions: Mix flour salt and Crisco until fine like meal. Add water egg and vinegar. Makes 3 pie crusts.

title: Ambrosia Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese powdered sugar and pineapple juice. Beat until smooth. Add Cool Whip. Fold in coconut drained pineapple and oranges. Pour into chilled cookie crust. Chill until firm.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Pie
