instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Remove meat from bones. Reserve broth. Cut chicken into small pieces and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 11 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towel crumble and set aside. Cook green onions in bacon drippings until tender. Stir in flour salt dry mustard paprika and pepper. Blend well. Cook until mixture is smooth and bubbly stirring constantly. Beat eggs in small bowl stir in milk. Gradually add to flour mixture. Cook until mixture thickens stirring constantly. Stir in corn. Cook until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with bacon.

title: Sharon'S Cinnamon Christmas Cut-Outs
instructions: Mix together; roll out using cinnamon for dusting. Cut out with cookie cutters. Let dry on cookie sheet for 3 to 4 days. Poke hole in top with toothpick and/or decorate. These make your house smell really nice. You can paint on them or stencil after they are dry. Probably frosting would work also.

title: English Rose Cherry Whip
instructions: Dissolve cherry jello in water. Chill until slightly set then whip. Add pineapple drained well. Pour into pan greased well with oleo and lined with crushed vanilla wafers.

title: Outrageous Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Use liners or grease and flour pans.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken until it easily comes off the bone. Mix flour and shortening well; add beaten egg and milk. Roll onto floured surface about 1/4-inch thick. Cut and drop into boiling chicken broth. Put chicken meat back into the dumplings and broth. Cover and cook until dumplings are tender about 20 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix together milk egg yolks and lime juice. Beat 1 egg white stiff and fold into mixture. Pour into baked pie shell. Beat 3 egg whites and gradually add sugar and cream of tartar. Spread over filling and bake at 350\u00b0 until egg whites are golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
instructions: Combine butter sugars egg peanut butter and vanilla; beat until smooth. Add flour soda and salt. Cover dough and chill until firm (1 hour). Make into walnut size balls and place in greased mini muffin tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes. Press a peanut butter cup in each and let cool in pan.

title: Pretzels
instructions: Put pretzels in cake pan. Break pretzels into smaller pieces. Mix all the mixture together then pour over pretzels. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Mix about three times while it is baking.

title: Old Fashioned Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add sugar and salt; blend well. Add milk and vanilla. Line a 9-inch pie pan with your favorite pastry recipe. (The secret of the crust is not to have it too thin. It should be thick so the custard wont run through.) Brush the pastry with melted butter pour custard into pastry shell and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Supreme
instructions: Combine flour salt and paprika; coat chicken well. Melt butter; brown chicken on both sides. Remove from pan; place into casserole dish. Add potatoes and carrots. Combine chicken soup with 1 can water; pour over chicken and vegetables. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 375\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Blend together eggs and sugar until light and well blended. Add oil and continue to beat. Sift and stir dry ingredients together and thoroughly beat into egg mixture. Add pumpkin and mix well again. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until done. Let stand in pan for 10 minutes before removing.

title: Crawfish Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake in covered dish for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done. Do not add salt.

title: Cut-Out Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill dough for 3 hours. Roll out on floured table for cutouts. Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool before icing.

title: Divinity
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan combine sugar corn syrup salt and water. Cook to hard ball stage (260\u00b0) stirring only until sugar is dissolved. Meanwhile beat egg whites to a stiff peak. Gradually pour syrup over egg whites beating at high speed on electric mixer. Add vanilla and beat until candy holds its shape in 4 to 5 minutes. Quickly drop from teaspoon onto wax paper. Makes about 40 pieces.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Layer the following in casserole dish

title: Cranberry Delight
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk. Beat in cranberry sauce and nuts. Chill for 45-60 min. Use as a dessert or late night snack. Makes 8-10 servings.

title: Donna'S Low-Fat Chili
instructions: Brown turkey in skillet. Drain off any fat. You may even wash over turkey with water if you wish. Mix all ingredients in a crock-pot and cook on low all day or all night. You can soak pintos in water all night first before putting into crock-pot. This will make pintos softer. Be sure to add enough water so chili does not dry out. Great for low-fat nachos.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil and debone chicken. Add soups and sour cream. Pour melted butter on top. Put cracker crumbs on top. Cook until cracker crumbs are brown at 425\u00b0.

title: Dipped Chocolate Candy
instructions: Work all but last two ingredients together and make into balls (for Easter I make mine the shape of Easter eggs). Melt chocolate chips and 1/2 block paraffin in double boiler. Dip candy using toothpick ice pick or two tine fork. Drain and put on wax paper. I find it works better to make my candy at night and dip it in the morning.

title: Oven Barbecue Country Spareribs
instructions: Brown ribs in oil for 20 minutes. Add cut up green pepper sliced onion rings and cut up celery to pan drippings (remove ribs before to baking dish). Mix tomato sauce paste and water; add to sauteed vegetables. When hot pour over ribs. Cover with foil. Bake for 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Beans 'N Meat
instructions: Heat in crock-pot for 2 hours.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening peanut butter sugar and brown sugar until blended. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Blend in dry ingredients. Shape scant teaspoon of dough into balls. Roll in sugar and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Top each cookie with Kiss pressing down until cookie cracks. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Pull Apart Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Layer pecans and dinner rolls. Combine sugar cinnamon and pudding. Sprinkle over top of rolls. Melt butter and pour over everything. Cover with a towel and let stand overnight. In AM bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chiffon Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Make a well and add in order corn oil egg yolks water lemon peel and vanilla. Beat with spoon until smooth. Add cream of tartar to egg whites. Beat until egg whites form very stiff peaks. Fold first mixture into egg whites until well blended. Do not stir. Turn batter into ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 70 to 75 minutes. Invert pan and cool. Loosen sides with spatula.

title: Popovers
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Gradually add milk to flour in a small bowl. Add butter. Beat eggs well and add to batter. Beat batter for 2 minutes with mixer. Fill hot muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 14 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 20 more minutes. Serve hot. They can be filled with creamed vegetables or creamed meat.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except noodles. Place 1/2 noodles on bottom of casserole. Add ingredients and top with remaining noodles. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and vegetable oil. Add sugar and eggs. Combine flour and soda. Add alternately with buttermilk. Stir in maple flavoring. Add coconut and nuts. Bake in 3 greased and floured 8-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Santa'S Whiskers
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Blend in milk and vanilla. Stir in flour cherries and nuts. Form into 2 rolls (each 2 inches in diameter and 8 inches long). Roll in coconut. Wrap in waxed paper and chill several hours or overnight. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Meat Loaf With Cheese
instructions: Combine meat with next\t8 ingredients. Place\thalf of this mixture in a loaf pan. Cover with half of cheese and top with half of the parsley. Repeat with the remaining meat cheese and parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0\tfor 1\thour or until done. Sprinkle with paprika and let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sunshine Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jello and sugar in hot water. Add pineapple and Mandarin oranges. Refrigerate. Add sour cream and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Corn Dog Bites
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in large bowl. Combine oil egg and buttermilk. Stir in flour mixture. Cut frankfurters into 5 pieces. Dip each piece into batter. Coat completely. Use wooden picks to aid in dipping. Pour oil 3 to 4-inches deep in Dutch oven or pan. Heat to 375\u00b0. Fry until golden brown. Turn once while frying. Serve with mustard and ketchup.

title: Cheese Fudge
instructions: Melt cheese in margarine. Add other ingredients and mix in a blender; cool. Pour into greased 12 x 9-inch cake pan. Refrigerate.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: In a 9 x 13 pan layer chicken on bottom onions and Doritos (crushed). Mix cream of chicken and Ro-Tel together. Pour soup mixture over Doritos. Slowly pour chicken broth over soup mixture. Cover with cheese. Cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven. Carefully remove foil. Bake additional 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and potato chips. Turn ingredients into shallow buttered casserole dish. Combine cheese and chips; spread over top. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Less-Than-An-Hour Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground meat draining away as much grease as possible; add chopped onion and brown with meat. Add seasonings and undrained tomatoes. Peel potatoes and cut into small cubes. Chop carrots and celery finely. Simmer 45 minutes or more according to size of vegetable pieces. Serves 4 meals. It freezes perfectly.

title: One Dish Pork Chop Dinner
instructions: Coat pork chops in flour; reserve excess flour. In a large Dutch oven heat oil. Brown pork on both sides. Season with salt and pepper. Remove and set aside.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion with salt and garlic; drain. Put into bottom of casserole dish. Add cooked potatoes then Cheddar cheese. Top with soup and sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix together. Bake for 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Sprinkle cheese on top to melt.

title: Bacon Wrapped Chicken
instructions: Lay chipped beef on bottom of pan. Wrap bacon around chicken breasts. Mix sour cream and chicken soup; pour over chicken. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Fried Venison Backstrap
instructions: Mix flour and milk in medium sized bowl with whisk until all lumps are out. Add spices and mix well.

title: Mother'S Icebox Sugarless Cake
instructions: In large saucepan heat milk and marshmallows stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted. Add in all the other ingredients and place in bowl or pan that has been lined with waxed paper and lightly greased with softened margarine. Cover refrigerate overnight. Take out of refrigerator the next day and remove from bowl discarding the waxed paper. Wrap in Saran Wrap and keep in refrigerator or freezer until time to eat.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant in salted water until tender. Mash eggplant and combine with next 7 ingredients. Place in casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cover top with bread crumbs. Bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Herbed Spinach Bake(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour into 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean. Cut into squares.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Toss chicken in bowl with mixture of soy sauce rice wine and cornstarch; set aside. Refrigerate for a couple of hours.

title: Cranberry-Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add orange juice and let stand until almost jelled. Combine cranberry-orange relish chopped apple and pecans. Fold into the almost jelled mixture. Pour into 1-quart mold. Chill until firm. Makes 10 small servings.

title: Chicken Enchilada Pie
instructions: Tenderize onion in stick of oleo. Add soups pimento green chilies and chicken. Cover bottom of casserole with torn soft tortillas. Add soup mixture. Top with cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Homemade Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
instructions: On stove cook in large saucepan the tomatoes and tomato paste. Saute celery and onions in separate skillet. When celery and onions begin to get tender add to tomato mixture. Brown ground beef in skillet drain and add to tomato sauce. Add seasonings to taste. Cook slowly and stir often. Prepare spaghetti noodles separately. Serve sauce over noodles and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil the squash in salt water to which the minced garlic has been added. When tender drain well. Thicken the tomatoes with the cornstarch and add the butter and minced onion salt and pepper to taste. Brown the ground beef in a skillet; add a little salt and pepper. In a greased casserole put a layer of squash beef tomatoes and cheese; then repeat in the same order. Cover the top with the crushed corn flakes. Bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Easter Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix well together pork ham one well beaten egg breadcrumbs and milk. Press evenly into a 10 x 10-inch casserole or cake pan. Bake for one hour in 350\u00b0 oven uncovered. Remove from oven pour off juices and brown pineapple slices in juice in a frying pan. While pineapple is browning mix together brown sugar vinegar water and mustard. Pour this syrup over ham loaf and return to oven at 350\u00b0 for at least 15 minutes. Arrange pineapple slices over loaf before serving.

title: Italian Cream Liqueur
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor fitted with a steel blade. Process briefly until completely blended. Pour into bottles or airtight container and refrigerate. Serve chilled. Yields about 2 1/2 pints of liqueur.

title: Praline Biscuits
instructions: Place 2 teaspoons margarine 2 teaspoons brown sugar and 3 pecan halves in each of 12 muffin cups 2 1/2 x 1 1/4-inch. Sprinkle cinnamon in each cup. Heat in oven until melted. Mix Bisquick applesauce and milk until dough forms. Beat 20 strokes. Spoon onto mixture in cups. Bake about 10 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Mix water and yeast together. Mix flour sugar margarine and egg together. Combine all ingredients. Put in airtight bowl and seal. Place in refrigerator. Dough is best if allowed to stand overnight. Grease muffin tins spoon out as needed. This dough does not have to sit out before baking. Will keep for 6 days in refrigerator. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Jello Salad In A Jiffy
instructions: Mix dry jello and cottage cheese then add pineapple. Stir in Cool Whip. Its done and ready to serve! Sprinkle with chopped nuts if desired.

title: Shrimply Cauliflower
instructions: Combine cauliflower with a small amount of water in a glass dish. Microwave on High for 6 to 7 minutes or until tender; drain. Place in a 9 x 11-inch baking dish. Combine milk onion and dill in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and strain; keep warm. Blend flour and margarine in a saucepan. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes or until smooth but not brown. Stir in warm milk gradually. Cook over low heat until thickened and smooth stirring constantly. Season with salt and white pepper. Stir in shrimp. Spoon over cauliflower; top with cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Parboil beans until tender and drain. Mix all ingredients together and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ableskiver(Swedish Shaped Pancakes)
instructions: Combine mix eggs butter and half and half. Beat until smooth. Heat Ableskiver pan over moderate heat until drop of water bounces or use muffin pan.

title: Heavenly Pineapple Pie
instructions: Whip the cream in small bowl. Refrigerate. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Beat together cream cheese reserved juice and pudding in medium bowl until smooth. Gently fold pineapple and whipped cream into pudding mix. Spoon into pie crust. Place in freezer until hard 8 hours or overnight. Remove from freezer 1 1/2 hours before serving. Sprinkle top with more crumbs. Serves 8.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Place water and margarine in a saucepan; bring to a boil. When margarine is melted add the flour while saucepan is still on the stove. Stir with a fork until dough forms a ball around the fork then remove from heat. This takes only a minute. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Do not underbeat. Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a well-greased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes in a 425\u00b0 oven then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for another 20 minutes. Turn off heat and open door but do not remove puffs from oven until they are cool.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients with 1/4 cup flour. Cream butter brown sugar and white sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift together 1 3/4 cups flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Fold in candy mixture by hand. Drop on cookie sheet with teaspoon. Bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Aunt Jan'S Southern Style Ham
instructions: Remove rind from ham. Rub fat with cinnamon ginger allspice and nutmeg. Prepare the pastry. Sift flour salt and baking powder. Blend in shortening. Add water to make dough. Roll out 1/4-inch thick. Place rolled dough around ham joining at the bottom or side. Cover pastry with well-greased and floured paper. Bake in slow oven at 300\u00b0 for about 6 hours. At the end of the fourth hour remove paper to brown the dough.

title: Sour Cream And Apple Coleslaw
instructions: Mix sour cream and egg yolks in medium bowl. Add lemon juice horseradish paprika sugar and salt; mix well. In large bowl mix shredded cabbage and apple. Pour dressing over all; toss until well coated. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Red Pudding(Rodgrot)
instructions: In a large saucepan place berries and water and cook for 5 minutes. Strain through a sieve; there should be about 4 1/2 cups of juice. Mix the cornstarch and sugar and add enough water to make a thin paste. Return the juice to the pan and again bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in cornstarch mixture. Bring quickly back to a boil for 2 minutes and then remove from the heat. Cool somewhat. Pour carefully into a large glass bowl or individual glass dishes. Sprinkle a little sugar on the top to prevent a skin from forming. Best made several hours to a day ahead. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Ernie'S Goulash
instructions: Let simmer uncovered 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Mini Fruitcake
instructions: Cut fruit; mix all ingredients well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 11 to 12 dozen. Buy mini cupcake cups.

title: Marinated And Grilled Shrimp
instructions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp in a shallow dish and mix well. Add shrimp tossing gently to coat. Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours stirring occasionally. Drain shrimp reserving marinade. Place shrimp in 6 (14-inch) skewers. Grill over medium-hot coals for 3 to 4 minutes per each side basting frequently with marinade. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Round Steak Casserole
instructions: Cut steak into strips; brown in small amount of oil. Slice raw vegetables according to family size; pour over meat.

title: Aunt Georgie'S Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling salted water for 7 minutes; save 3/4 cup water. Make white sauce with margarine flour water and milk. In buttered casserole put layer of cabbage layer white sauce 1/2 of cheese; repeat. Melt 2 tablespoons margarine with 1/2 cup bread crumbs; top casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine beans corn soup onion sour cream cheese and almonds. Mix together and turn into a 9 x 13-inch glass casserole dish. Melt butter or margarine in medium saucepan. Crumble crackers into margarine. Spread cracker mixture over top of casserole. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Romano Cheese Salad Dressing
instructions: Blend well together and coat each serving with dressing then sprinkle with Romano cheese.

title: Deep-Fried Zucchini
instructions: In medium mixing bowl combine 1 cup flour cornstarch baking powder salt lemon pepper onion powder milk and egg. Blend until smooth. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch diagonal slices. Rinse and pat dry. Shake slices in remaining 1/2 cup flour to coat.

title: Giblet Gravy
instructions: Mix all up and put into jar and shake real well.

title: Jiffy Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs and water on medium speed until thoroughly mixed. Pour in Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Creamy Beef-Cheese Dip
instructions: Place unwrapped block of cream cheese in a 1-quart glass casserole. Microwave on High 45 seconds to 1 minute or until cheese is softened. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended. Cover and microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes. Stir. Microwave on Medium an additional 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Serve with chips toast rounds or crackers. Yields 2 cups.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package. Make Jell-O and let stand until a little thick. Let cake cool; poke holes in cake with fork. Pour Jell-O over cake so it runs into the holes. Mix pudding and Cool Whip together and ice cake with mixture.

title: Achiote
instructions: Adobo is simply a mix of black peppercorns oregano and garlic. Sprinkle the meat with ground pepper garlic powder dried oregano and sometimes onion powder. Then marinate it in olive oil and vinegar. Others prefer fresh lime juice to the vinegar. If you adhere to strict standards then a basic Adobo mix would be

title: Impossible Seafood Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Mix crabmeat cheese onions and pimento in plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into plate; bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Bacon, Tomato And Herb Dip
instructions: In medium bowl stir together ingredients until well blended.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Prepare 6 muffin cups or one 10-inch cast-iron or other heavy ovenproof pan. Mix dry ingredients together. Stir pepper and cheese into the dry ingredients. In a small bowl whisk wet ingredients together. Mix dry and wet ingredients together and pour into prepared pan or muffin cups. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Makes half a dozen muffins or one 10-inch skillet.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut potatoes into slices but not all the way through. Put potatoes in a baking dish. Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs at 425\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Tuna Crunch Salad
instructions: Combine tuna and water chestnuts in a medium-size bowl; stir in lemon juice then mayonnaise or salad dressing and salt and pepper to taste. Chill.

title: Tuna Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. If too dry add more mayo and vinegar. I garnish with spanish olives. Chill and serve.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small bowl add all seasonings. Reserve 1/2 tablespoon of seasonings. Sprinkle majority of seasonings on chicken. Add the 1/2 tablespoon of seasonings to flour and corn meal. In a mixing bowl beat milk mustard and white wine. Dip the chicken in this mixture then dredge in flour and corn meal. Spray pan with vegetable spray then spray chicken. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Italian Beef Au Jus
instructions: Place beef roast in slow cooker; combine sauce ingredients and pour over beef. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Meat may be sliced and served with hard rolls; or shredded and served over rice or noodles. Thicken broth with flour.

title: Baked Ziti Casserole
instructions: Cook pasta as directed drain. Brown ground beef and flavor with garlic and onion powder. Mix pasta beef and spaghetti sauce. Put 1/2 of mixture in large casserole put 1/2 of cheese on top. Finish with rest of pasta mixture and top with rest of the cheese.

title: Mayonnaise Spice Cake
instructions: Mix mayo sugar and honey. Sift dry ingredients and add alternating with water.

title: Holiday Ham Balls
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease baking pan. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Place about 2-inches apart in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown. Immediately remove from pan. Serve warm. This makes about 7 dozen appetizers.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: In a bowl mix sugar self-rising flour and cocoa well. In a saucepan pour milk and add egg yolk. Gradually stir in sugar mixture and mix well. Cook on medium heat until thick (about 20 minutes). Add butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie crust. Top with meringue and brown in oven at 325\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sprinkle sugar substitute over bananas and stir; blend in eggs. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add walnuts. Blend thoroughly into banana mixture. Pour batter into greased loaf pan.

title: French Market Soup(Southern Living Magazine)
instructions: Sort and wash soup mix; place in Dutch oven. Cover with water 2 inches above soup mix; let soak 8 hours. To speed soaking time boil 2 quarts water; add bean mixture and boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 1 hour. Drain and proceed as directed. Drain soup mix and return to pan; add 2 quarts water and ham hock. Bring to boil; cover. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Stir in tomatoes and next 4 ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Remove ham hock; remove meat from bone. Chop meat and return to soup. Stir in salt and pepper. Yields 3 quarts.

title: Wheeling Station Pesto
instructions: Puree pine nuts and garlic with olive oil in food processor. Add basil spinach and pepper. Process on puree for 2 minutes. Add cheeses and puree for 1 additional minute. Serve over pasta for a very healthy and filling meal.

title: Apple Pecan Pancakes
instructions: In a bowl combine dry ingredients. Stir in milk egg yolks and vanilla. Add apples and pecans. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; fold into batter.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine chocolate sugar salt and milk in a saucepan and cook to 235\u00b0 or soft ball stage. Remove from heat and cool. When cool add butter vanilla and peanut butter. Pour into buttered pan and cool until set.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
instructions: Cream 1/2 cup sugar egg and shortening. Sift together flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Add creamed mixture alternately with milk beating well after each addition. Fill 12 greased muffin pan holes 2/3 full with batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. When done dip puffs while hot in melted butter then roll into 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon mixture. Freezes well. Serve hot or cold.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle coconut and nuts in the bottom of pan. Mix the cake mix according to directions on box. Pour over nuts and coconut. Soften cream cheese and oleo. Add confectioners sugar and mix with mixer. Pour over cake and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Leave in pan if too sticky to invert.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl mix bran cereal with boiling water stirring to moisten evenly. Set aside to cool. Add eggs buttermilk oil and fruit. Blend well. Stir together soda salt sugar and flour. Add to bran mixture. Bake now or refrigerate in a tightly covered container for up to two weeks. Spoon batter into muffin cups 2/3 to 3/4 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Fantasy Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: Microwave margarine in microwave dish on High for 1 minute or until melted. Add sugar and milk; mix well. Microwave mixture on High for 5 minutes or until mixture begins to boil. Stir after 3 minutes; mix well. Continue to microwave 5 1/2 minutes more again stirring at 3 minutes. Add chips stirring until melted. Add Fluff nuts and vanilla; mix well. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan or 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cool at room temperature; cut into squares.

title: Dutch Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: In mixing bowl blend pumpkin water egg cinnamon and mace. Add bread mix and stir until moistened. Turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done. Remove from pan and cool. If desired frost with confectioners sugar.

title: Chili Rellenos Bake
instructions: In a large skillet crumble together the beef and sausage. Cook over medium heat stirring until meat is browned. Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is limp. Drain off fat. Line a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with half the chilies; top with 1 1/2 cups cheese. Add meat mixture and top with remaining chilies; set aside. Beat together eggs and flour until smooth; add milk salt and Tabasco. Blend well. Pour egg mixture over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until knife inserted off center comes out clean. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup cheese on top. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet. In a large pot add beans seasoning mix chili powder and canned tomatoes together. Add ground beef and onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and simmer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Shell rinse and split eggs. Place whites on a tray. Set aside. In large bowl mix yolks onion pickles juice mustard and mayonnaise. (If mixture is too dry add a little more mayonnaise.) Add salt and pepper. Fill egg whites with yolk mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Cream Cheese Dainties(Sugary Or Sugar-Free)
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat the butter and cream cheese until well blended. Mix in flour. Divide dough into 4 sections. Cover and refrigerate until easy to handle.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl. Combine eggs milk and onion. Add to dry ingredients and mix well. Drop by large teaspoonfuls into hot deep oil at 360\u00b0 and fry about 2 minutes turning over once or twice until golden. Drain on paper towels.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix all but raisins then blend in raisins. Use greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour more.

title: Quick Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Bring soup to a boil. Sprinkle pasta in slowly so that boiling does not stop. Cook until tender. Reduce heat below boiling point. Drop beaten egg in by teaspoons stirring constantly. Do not return to a boil after adding egg.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Combine cornbread onions celery salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; mash and mix with potato masher. Add egg and mix well. Bake in a roasting pan at 450\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine flour eggs sugar soda baking powder salt and enough buttermilk to make it the consistency you prefer. Beat by hand until well blended. Best if made the night before you need it.

title: Teresa'S Cinnamon Raisin Popcorn
instructions: In greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan place popcorn and raisins. In 2-quart saucepan stir together remaining ingredients stirring occasionally. Bring to boil over medium heat and boil for 5 minutes.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
instructions: Layer ingredients as listed in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Do not mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Have cream cheese at room temperature. Place cheese sugar vanilla and 1 egg in a large mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer until slightly blended. Beat in remaining eggs one at a time. Beat until lumps are gone. Pour over graham cracker crust in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until toothpick inserted in cake comes out clean about 40 minutes. Yields 20 servings.

title: Holiday Fruit Bars
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Beat oleo and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Mix bran cereal milk and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients with cherries nuts and dates; mix well. Spread batter into two greased 9 x 9-inch baking pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut in squares and serve.

title: Cheese Log
instructions: Toast almonds at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes; cool. Chop 1/4 cup of the almonds and set aside. Grind together 1 cup almonds cheese (Cheddar) and cream cheese. Add lemon juice Worcestershire sauce onion and salt. Blend thoroughly and shape into log about 8 inches long by 2 inches in diameter. Roll in 1/4 cup chopped almonds. Wrap in moisture-proof wrap. Chill overnight and slice to serve.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Blend butter and sugar together until smooth. Add eggs one at a time; mix thoroughly after each one. Add water and pumpkin until blended and set aside. In a separate bowl mix all dry ingredients. Add nuts and raisins. Add dry mixture into pumpkin mixture a little at a time; blend thoroughly. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chili'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Crush crackers and mix with melted butter or margarine. Mix and press hard in bottom of two 9-inch pans. Put in freezer for a while until cheese mixture is poured into them.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add milk sugar and salt. Combine corn and other ingredients. Put in baking dish and bake for 1 hour. Serve hot with cheese. Serves 6.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Mix in large pot the tomato sauce tomato paste 2 1/2 to 3 cans water (15 ounces) onion 1 tablespoon sugar 15 to 20 shakes Italian seasoning 25 shakes sweet basil 3 to 4 chunks bell pepper. Sprinkle garlic powder to cover lightly. Cook on medium to high until boiling. Turn to low stirring occasionally.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
instructions: Boil raisins in 2 cups of water slowly for 20 minutes. When done add 1 cup water. Sift together dry ingredients. Blend in 1 cup shortening. Mix with raisins. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Jello Delight
instructions: Drain fruit juice into 2 cup measuring cup and add milk to make 2 cups. Add Jell-O and mix well then add fruit and refrigerate. Very low in fat. I use this for a quick dessert when I need one fast.

title: One Bowl Rocky Road Brownies
instructions: Microwave chocolate and margarine in large microwavable bowl at High (2 minutes) or until completely melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir in sugar; mix in eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and 1 cup nuts. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Immediately sprinkle marshmallows chips and remaining nuts over brownies.

title: Jane'S Cranberry Chutney
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple and place in saucepan. Add sugar cranberries raisins and spices. Heat to boiling. Lower heat and simmer 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Add nuts and pineapple. Excellent served with ham turkey and chicken. Keeps well in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Freezes well.

title: Chocolate Cinnamon Buns
instructions: In mixer bowl dissolve yeast in warm water. Add shortening salt sugar egg cocoa and 1 cup flour. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed of mixer or 300 vigorous strokes by hand. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl. Stir in remaining flour. Blend well. Scrape sides of bowl. Cover with cloth. Let rise in warm place until double in bulk about 1 hour. (If kitchen is cool place dough on rack over bowl of hot water. Cover completely with towel.) Stir down by beating 25 strokes. Turn soft dough on well floured cloth-covered board. Roll into rectangle 12 x 9-inch. Spread with butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture. Roll up beginning at wide side. Pinch edge into roll. Cut 12 pieces. Place on greased 9-inch square pan. Let rise in warm place until double about 40 minutes.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Fill gallon container with the ingredients.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix the ingredients; pour into 1 to 1 1/2 gallon ice cream mixer and freeze. Taste like Wendys Frosty.

title: Chocolate Cookie Cheesecake(Preparation Time: 38 Minutes)
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium bowl; firmly press mixture in bottom and 2 inches up sides of a lightly greased 10 inch spring form pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Set aside.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Chop apples and cover with sugar. Add oil and egg. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Bake in loaf pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chewies
instructions: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil. Stir in peanut butter. Remove from heat. Pour over cornflakes. Mix and spread on buttered cookie sheets. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and add to Cool Whip. Stir dry peach jello in Cool Whip and chill.

title: John Bigotti (Honest John)(Casserole)
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Brown meat add pepper onion mushroom soup and cheese; cook together. Add noodles and tomato soup. Pour into baking dish cover with grated cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Fancy Cookies
instructions: Add pecans or chocolate chips to other ingredients. Drop by teaspoonful 1-inch apart on well-greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Moisten spatula and remove immediately from cookie sheet.

title: Buttermilk Pie No. 2
instructions: To mix add sugar and flour to butter and blend. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and buttermilk and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cornish Hens With Pear Or Apricot Preserves
instructions: Fill each hen with 1/4 cup grapes which have been tossed lightly into sugar. Brush each hen generously with hot mixture of melted butter preserves salt and pepper.

title: Jabchai(Chop Suey)
instructions: Put noodles into boiling water of more than 180\u00b0 and cook 5 to 6 minutes. Rinse noodles with cold water and drain 2 or 3 times. Stir-fry sliced meats and vegetables. Flavor the rinsed noodles with such various spices as sesame oil sesame powder soy sauce and sugar. Add vegetables and meat.

title: Skinny Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve with chips of your choice (bagel tortilla or crackers).

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and heat until melted. Flour and brown chicken. Place in baking dish and pour sauce over chicken and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve over rice (if desired). For large groups use chicken wings.

title: Peanut Rounders
instructions: Combine sugar syrup milk and peanuts in a heavy saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until it reaches soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add butter vanilla and food coloring. Beat until mixture is creamy. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Let cool. Makes 25 to 30 patties.

title: Tarheel Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt together the butter and cocoa; add sugar flour eggs vanilla milk salt and nuts. Mix well and pour into two unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Latin Coleslaw
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix remaining ingredients for dressing. Toss all and chill.

title: Jan Hagel
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolk. Beat until light. Add flour and cinnamon; mix well. Spread evenly on a greased jelly roll pan (2 x 15 x 1-inch). Brush on egg white. Sprinkle chopped nuts and sugar on mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until light brown. Cut while warm.

title: Spicy Quesadillas
instructions: In small bowl combine tomatoes taco sauce 3 tablespoons onions lemon juice and peppers. Combine cheese with remaining onions. For each quesadilla sprinkle about 1/2 cup cheese mixture over it. Spoon 2 tablespoons sauce over cheese. Top with another tortilla pressing gently. Fry in skillet in small amount of hot oil until golden and cheese has melted turning once. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Heat remaining sauce and serve with quesadillas for dipping. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise and scoop out all seeds. Combine the hamburg rice onion salt and pepper oregano whole tomatoes and 1/2 can tomato paste. Mix well and fill squash with this mixture. To remainder of stuffing add the tomato juice (reserved) 1/2 can tomato paste and water to make very soupy. Extra rice may also be added. Put pan in a 350\u00b0 oven; cover and bake until squash is tender approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Oreo Icebox Cookies
instructions: Put crumbled Oreos in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Wedding Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add vanilla salt and nuts. Gradually add flour. Roll into balls. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Roll in powdered sugar when hot then again when cool.

title: Eggplant Quiche
instructions: Partially bake crusts in preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 6 minutes. Cook eggplant covered in boiling salted water for 8 to 10 minutes; drain well. Cook onion and pepper in butter until tender. Blend in flour soup salt sugar oregano and black pepper. Heat until bubbly. Remove from heat; stir into beaten eggs. Fold in tomato cheese and eggplant. Pour into pie shells; top with Parmesan cheese (sprinkle on top). Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Onion Dip
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Style Pork Chops, Rice And Savory Green Beans
instructions: Several hours before cooking wash and season pork chops well. Cover and refrigerate about an hour.

title: Special Chicken Breast
instructions: In shallow baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch) arrange single layer of beef. Top with chicken. Blend soup and sour cream. Pour over all. Top with bacon. Cover and bake 3 hours at 250\u00b0. Then bake uncovered for 1 additional hour.

title: Fried Tomato Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs in a large bowl. Now add just enough bread crumbs to make it stiff enough to drop ty tablespoonful into hot oil in frying pan. Brown on both sides. Serve hot. Makes about 10 or 12 cakes.

title: Mauntaine Cookies
instructions: Put butter brown sugar eggs baking soda flour nuts and raisins in bowl; mix and put on cookie sheet with spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 minutes.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cream cheese and beat until smooth. Add sugar vanilla and pineapple and beat again. Add food coloring and 7-Up cola and beat. Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice according to package. Transfer to large bowl; cool slightly. Combine dressing soy sauce and sugar. Stir in warm rice. Cover and chill. Fold in remaining ingredients before serving.

title: Great American Potato Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing mustard salt pepper and celery seed; mix well. Add potatoes eggs celery sweet pickles and onion; mix lightly then chill.

title: Simmered Smoked Links
instructions: Place sausages in slow cooker. Combine brown sugar ketchup and horseradish and pour over sausages. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. Serve with toothpicks.

title: No Crust Quiche
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. Spread in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer ham then cheese over broccoli.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring milk butter sugar and cocoa to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter vanilla and oats. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper or foil until cooled.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain juice and remove bones from salmon. Break up salmon in bowl. Add bread crumbs and milk; mix well. Distribute butter bits throughout. Add salt and pepper. Mix. Place in greased loaf pan. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In large skillet combine rice and 2 tbsp. butter. Cook until rice is brown stirring frequently. Slowly stir in 2 c. water seasoning mix and canned tomatoes bring to a boil. Reduce heat cook on low 15 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Pork Chop-Potato Casserole
instructions: Layer pork chops in casserole dish. Peel potatoes; slice in half layer on chops. Slice onion. Lay around over potatoes. Pour tomato soup on top. Cover with foil. Cook 1 hour in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix all together. Freeze (in plastic garbage bag). When ready to use take out of freezer 4 to 5 hours before using; let thaw partially. Place in punch bowl and chip up with large fork. Then put ginger ale over punch. Will be icy. Serves approximately 25 people.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Surprise
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Add broccoli ham milk and cheese. Cook over low heat until thick and creamy.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cook rice; mix hamburger and rice. Cut top off green peppers. Stuff rice and ground beef in peppers. Pour tomato sauce over peppers and bake. Stuffs about 6 green peppers.

title: Nut Fudge
instructions: Combine everything but nuts in double boiler. Stir until smooth. Pour in nuts. Spread candy in buttered pan. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Kountry Doughnuts
instructions: Cut off crusts n feed to chickens...make sandwitches wid the jelly..cut enyway you lak.

title: Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Place potatoes on a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown stirring once. Mix mayonnaise bacon eggs onions salt and pepper in large bowl. Add potatoes; mix lightly. Serve warm or chilled. Makes 6 servings.

title: School Rolls
instructions: In mixer combine 1/2 cup yeast and 1/2 cup sugar. Mix well with hand. Then add 1 quart warm water or 1 cup butter or 1 cup vegetable oil. Let rise until yeast works well.

title: Chili Relleno Bake
instructions: In a skillet brown together the meat onion and garlic. Grease an 8 inch or 9 inch square baking pan. Place one can of chilies on the bottom of the dish. Top with 1-1/2 c. cheese. Add meat mixture and top with second can of chilies. Beat together the eggs and flour. Add milk and seasonings and pour over the meat mixture. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add oil and eggs. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Orange Spinach Salad
instructions: Drain oranges; wash spinach and pat dry. Combine all ingredients; add dressing and serve.

title: Emma Janes Southern Casserole
instructions: Brown onions and meat in butter. Cook noodles until just tender. Mix all ingredients together. Garnish with olives. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Grilled Cheeseburgers
instructions: Cook desired number of hamburgers and grilled cheese sandwiches. Before putting the 2 pieces of bread together add a hamburger patty and your favorite condiment (ketchup mustard onion pickle etc.). Delicious!

title: Pancit Canton(Sauteed Noodles, Canton Style)
instructions: Slice chicken breast thinly; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and patis. Mix to coat chicken slices evenly and set aside. Drain mushrooms. Discard tough stems and slice thinly.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Put chicken on top of broccoli. Combine the remaining ingredients except cracker crumbs stirring well. Spoon mixture over chicken; top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Hot Bean Dip
instructions: In a large saucepan combine refried beans picante sauce and taco seasoning mix. Stir over medium heat until thoroughly heated. Garnish with sour cream and serve with tortilla chips. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix the apples sugar and nuts. Let stand an hour stirring occasionally so the mixture makes its own juice. Add dry ingredients to apple mixture. Add oil eggs and vanilla. Stir by hand. Pour batter into a greased tube pan. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sesame Seed Cookies
instructions: Sift first four ingredients into bowl. Cut in shortening until size of small peas. Stir in egg; add milk tablespoon at a time until roughly forms into soft dough. Form into 1-inch balls. Wet balls in beaten egg then roll in sesame seed. Place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten balls a little. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Pickles From Dills
instructions: Drain juices off dill pickles and pour boiling water over and let cool. Cut length wise and cover with the following syrup Boil sugar water and vinegar. Pour over split pickles. Refrigerate for 3 or 4 days.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Heat some oil in a cast-iron skillet. Cut tomatoes in thick slices. Dip in bread crumbs then in beaten egg and milk then back in crumbs again. Fry until tender and golden brown topping with cheese during last few minutes of cooking.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown ground chuck in skillet and drain off fat; cool. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients. Spread on split semi-hard rolls or buns. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes until bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Saute the ground beef and onion in the fat. Add the tomato sauce water rice salt pepper sugar and flour. Simmer for 15 minutes. Clean peppers; boil for 2 minutes and drain. Stuff the peppers with hamburger mixture. On top add 4 tablespoons buttered bread crumbs and 4 tablespoons grated cheese. Bake for 1/2 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Josephine'S Recipe For Out Of This World Pie
instructions: Measure sugar and cornstarch into saucepan; mix well. Add pineapple with its juice; mix well so no lumps form. Stir in pie filling and food color. Use a wooden spoon; stir gently to avoid mashing the cherries. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and is well thickened about 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in dry gelatin. Let cool.

title: Bully Pudding
instructions: Put all ingredients into a buttered baking dish; stir well and bake 1 hour in a moderate oven. Serve with cream. It is not necessary to cream the sugar and butter for the cake.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Allow vinegar and milk to clabber while mixing remaining ingredients (except soda) in order. When ingredients are well blended dissolve soda in clabbered milk. Stir into flour mixture. Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until top springs back when touched lightly. Cool in pan on wire rack before cutting.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Stir sherbet and orange sections into jello and chill thoroughly.

title: Asparagus With Mock Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Place asparagus and water in a 8 x 8 x 2-inch microwave dish. Cover with plastic wrap. Turn back one corner to vent. Cook on High for 7 to 9 minutes or until crisp-tender. Let stand covered while cooking sauce.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook beef onion and shortening in hot skillet. Stir with fork until meat has lost its redness. Pour off fat. Add tomato sauce tomato paste mushrooms seasonings and Worcestershire sauce. Cover skillet. Lower heat and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Pour over spaghetti.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease pan. Put in oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10-inch pie pan. Layer bacon and cheese in pan. Beat together the milk mayonnaise eggs Bisquick salt and pepper until smooth (15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater). Pour into pan. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Garnish with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Chicken And Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Mix together diced chicken soup sour cream chilies and flavor in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until boiling. Fry tortillas in oil until flexible. Place 2 heaping tablespoonfuls chicken mixture on each tortilla. Place in casserole. Top with cheese and onion. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Midwest Chowder
instructions: Melt margarine. Add flour and milk. Thicken to make sauce. Add cheese to create cheese sauce.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan in the order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Dog Munchies
instructions: Prepare corn muffin mix according to directions except with milk instead of water. Pour batter into mini-muffin pan with 24 cups. Fill to 3/4 full. Cut each wiener into 4 bite size pieces. Place one piece in each filled muffin cup. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown 1 pound ground beef in frypan. Season with garlic salt and pepper to taste. Add tomato soup and simmer 5 minutes. In second pan cook egg noodles as directed on package. Drain. Add 1 cup chopped onion and cottage cheese. Layer alternately in casserole dish beginning with noodle mixture and ending with meat mixture (about 2 layers of each). Top with grated cheese and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until onion is tender and cheese is melted. Freezes well. Serves 8.

title: Ham Bone Soup
instructions: Soak and cook beans according to instructions on package. Saute onion ham and garlic. Combine all ingredients except the sherry into a 6-quart pot. Simmer 4 hours. Add sherry just before serving. Serves 8 to 10 generous servings.

title: Chess Squares
instructions: Mix until smooth and pour over first layer. Bake at 325 degrees for one hour. Cool completely before cutting into bars.

title: Chocolate Delight Cheese Cake
instructions: Cut in together flour oleo and nuts. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Let crust cool. Mix cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip together and spread onto cooled crust. Mix milk and both packages of pudding together and spread onto cheese mixture. Cool 6 to 8 hours. Top with Cool Whip (optional). Serves 10.

title: Cheese Sheet Cake
instructions: Roll out 1 package of crescent rolls to fit bottom of 9 x 13-inch or 13 1/4 x 9 1/4 x 5/8-inch pan. Beat until creamy the cream cheese vanilla and sugar. Spread on top layer; roll out other crescent rolls. Put over cream cheese. Melt butter and spread on top. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Black-Eyed Peas Mexicana
instructions: Brown sausage; drain and crumble. Saute onion and garlic with sausage. Add black-eyed peas tomatoes water chili powder and salt. Simmer for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Oyster Cracker Snacks
instructions: Place ingredients in a 1-gallon plastic bag and shake well. Let it set for 24 hours.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Blend cottage cheese and yogurt in blender to remove all curds. Add skim milk to thin if necessary. Blend in coconut extract. Combine mixture with drained fruits. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Salmon Quiche
instructions: Saute onions in butter until tender. Add mushrooms reserving a few slices. Saute for a few more minutes.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crush pretzels. Mix pretzels with butter and 3 tablespoons sugar. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0 and lightly grease a 9 x 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle bacon cheese and onion evenly over bottom of pie plate. Place remaining ingredients in blender. Blend on high speed for 1 minute. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown. Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Serves 6.

title: Butter Thin Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and flour together until it forms little beads. Add cream and yolks. Mix very well. Roll out on floured board as thin as desired. Cut with cookie cutter. Dip in unbeaten egg whites; sprinkle with mixture of cinnamon and sugar. Place a few chopped nuts on top (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Poppy Seed, Almond Bread
instructions: Mix together sugar vanilla almond flavoring oil and milk. Add eggs and poppy seeds. Blend in flour salt and baking powder. For 1 loaf bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. For 6 mini-loaves bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. For 12 muffins bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and glaze with confectioners sugar milk and vanilla or almond extract.

title: Cranberry Nut Mold
instructions: Make jello as directed. Add can of cranberries. Allow to chill and set slightly. Add balance of ingredients and mix well. Pour into mold and let set.

title: Dill-Lightful Sour Cream Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream lemon juice dill weed and salt. Cover and chill. Serve with crackers or vegetables. Yields 2 cups.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Put 1 tablespoon of butter and salt into water and bring to boil. Add macaroni. Use just amount of water that when macaroni is done it wont have to be drained. Watch closely. Add 1/4 of the cheese to macaroni quickly. Mix well until cheese melts. Melt butter; add to milk and stir into macaroni so it wont be dry. (Add more milk if needed.) Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and poke rest of cheese cubes into macaroni. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until it bubbles.

title: Rolled Biscuits
instructions: (If using self-rising flour omit salt and baking powder.)

title: Pizza Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients well; do not brown meat. Spread meat mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread with tomato sauce. Place Mozzarella cheese on top. Top with oregano basil seasoned salt and Parmesan cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 60 minutes. Nice served with tossed salad and Italian bread.

title: Currant Jelly Fondue
instructions: Heat jelly and mustard together to boiling point. Put in fondue dish and keep hot. Provide skewers for people to dip the bread cubes into the fondue.

title: Pear Bread
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Alternate dry ingredients with liquid. Bake in greased pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Easy(Servings 6 To 8)
instructions: Layer first 4 ingredients as listed. Dribble melted butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Pie
instructions: Mix eggs flour sugars and milks in blender; pour into pie shell. Sprinkle top of pie with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes then at 350\u00b0 until center is set about 10 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers onions and bell peppers into thin slices and sprinkle with salt. Add 1 quart of cracked ice. Cover for 3 hours.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in oven. Mix Bisquick paprika salt and pepper; coat chicken. Bake 35 minutes. Turn chicken. Bake 15 minutes or until done.

title: Lagniappe Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Rinse beans twice. Place in at least 4-quart heavy pot. Add water ham and sausage. Place on medium heat. While beans are soaking and warming chop onions. Add to pot. When the mixture boils reduce and cover. Stir every 20 to 30 minutes for 3 hours. Then with a wooden spoon mash about 1/4 of the beans against the side of the pot. Forty minutes after mashing beans add cayenne pepper (not too much). Cook 30 minutes more while cooking rice. Serve over rice. Vegetables cook away to nothing. The mashed beans thicken sauce. Even better the next day.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken. Add water and cover. Simmer. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Combine brown sugar and cornstarch. Add pineapple juice vinegar soy sauce and salt. Pour over chicken. Let stand 10 minutes. Add pineapple green peppers and onion. Cook 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Nana'S Chili Soup
instructions: In pan fry hamburger; set aside. Peel potatoes cut into small pieces and boil with macaroni. (When it is finished boiling do not drain water.) Add onion chili stewed tomatoes salt to taste and chili powder to taste then add fried hamburger. The longer you let it simmer the better at least 30 minutes. Add water as needed. Goes really good with Nanas cornbread.

title: Baked Zucchini
instructions: Simmer all ingredients together for 1/2 hour. Layer in casserole dish with shredded Mozzarella cheese and cooked bacon (any amount). Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts approximately 15 minutes.

title: Chalupas
instructions: Put all ingredients in large pan and cover with water. Cook covered over low heat. Add water as needed. After approximately 6 hours take bones out of meat and break meat up. Then cook with lid off into thick mixture for 1 to 2 hours. Serve over corn chips and add the following as desired grated cheese chopped onion shredded lettuce diced tomatoes diced avocados and hot salsa. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Fat-Free Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese and marshmallow cream. Stir about 30 strokes or until mixed well. Chill about 1 hour before serving. Dip fresh fruit into fruit dip.

title: Dianes Delicious Dip
instructions: Mix and heat until cheese melts stirring occasionally.

title: Broccoli-Corn Bake
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Blend 1/4 cup cracker crumbs with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Oriental Pork Loin
instructions: Mix marinade marmalade garlic dry mustard and ground ginger in a bowl. Put pork tenderloins in gallon-sized Ziploc and pour marinade in bag and close. Marinate several hours; overnight is best.

title: Scotchy Peanut Bars
instructions: Cream butter. Add brown sugar and cream well. Blend in flour (mixture may be crumbly). Press into bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor. Blend until well mixed. This is a very pungent dressing but good on spinach salad. (Note Dont expect anyone to kiss you after eating this dressing!)

title: Tomato-Mushroom Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Remove mushroom stems. Place mushrooms round side down in a shallow baking dish. Cut cherry tomatoes in half.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and soda. Add remaining ingredients and mix as biscuits. Pinch off dough about the size of a walnut and roll out biscuits. Let stand a few hours to rise. Bake in 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. May store dough in refrigerator in a sealed bowl and use as needed. This will keep 4 or 5 days.

title: 8 Dozen Buns
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 Tbsp. sugar in 2/3 cup water. In 2 quarts water dissolve sugar lard and salt. Stir in egg yeast mixture and 5 cups flour. Mix well and add enough flour to make a soft dough. Knead lightly and place in a greased pan and let rise until double. Punch down and let rise again. Shape and place on greased jellyroll pan. Let rise until double and bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown. OR... you can use this recipe to make cinnamon rolls. You roll out the dough into a rectangle spread with butter or margarine and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. If desired you can add walnuts or pecans. Roll the dough up like a jellyroll and cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place into a pan and let rise until double and bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes. OR... you can make donuts by cutting circles and a hole in the middle letting them rise till double and deep fat frying them. Immediately dip in sugar or glaze after they have cooled a short time. OR...you can take a piece about the size of a lemon and stretch it out and deep fat fry it and put butter and jelly on it. They are better if you eat them right away while they are still hot.

title: Corn And Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
instructions: Mix baking soda and water together. Beat in eggs. Dump in cake mix and pumpkin pie mix. Beat all together. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Baked Zucchini With Cheese(Serves 3)
instructions: Put the zucchini in a colander or on towels to drain off the moisture. Combine the remaining ingredients. Add the zucchini and mix well. Pour into lightly oiled 2-quart casserole dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Beef Fiesta
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Mix all ingredients together except for potatoes. Put in a casserole dish. Spoon potatoes around top of casserole. Sprinkle a little chili powder on top of potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until potatoes are slightly brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken Croquettes
instructions: Melt butter or margarine; add flour and blend to a paste. Stir in heated stock and cook stirring until sauce is thickened. Cool. Combine remaining ingredients. Add sauce to chicken mixture; mix and chill. Shape into croquettes. Dip croquettes in milk or beaten egg; roll in bread crumbs. Place croquettes in greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Angel Food Cake
instructions: Whip egg whites until foamy. Add salt and cream of tartar and continue to whip until they hold a point and are not dry. Add 1/2 cup sugar slowly then the extract. Add flour remaining sugar and nuts. Bake in an ungreased pan for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs; add to corn. Add salt pepper flour cream and butter. Grease 2-quart casserole. Pour in mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Iced Tea(Flavored And No Calories)
instructions: Place tea bags in coffee filter of automatic coffee maker. Make tea as if making coffee. While hot add lemonade mix and Sweet N Low. Place in a container and add two additional coffee pots of water (1 to 2 proportions). This is very good to have on hand and I use decaffeinated tea bags.

title: Rich Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in a small pan. Set aside. In a separate pan warm milk. Stir cocoa and boiling water together to make a paste then mix in melted butter. Combine sugar cornstarch and salt and add to warm milk. Add the cocoa-butter mixture and egg. Cook over medium heat stirring until thickened 15 to 20 minutes. Dont let mixture boil. Remove from heat and mix in remaining butter and vanilla.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Cook frozen broccoli for 10 minutes; drain it. Melt butter and mix to Ritz crackers that should be crushed; set aside. In a large bowl mix together onion cream of celery soup beaten eggs Parmesan cheese mayonnaise salt and pepper then add broccoli. Pour mixture into a greased casserole and top with moistened crumbs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Bake uncovered. When top is light brown its done.

title: Nanaimo Bars
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup of the butter and mix with egg cocoa vanilla crumbs coconut and sugar. Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Add all ingredients together. Beat well. Bake in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Squares
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets until fork-tender. Cool. Peel and grate. Melt oleo over low heat. Stir in cheese. Add mixture to potatoes along with sour cream onion salt and pepper. Turn into a greased shallow 3-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until heated through. Cut into squares to serve. Makes 10 servings.

title: Sugar & Spice Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar eggs honey milk and vanilla. Add rest of ingredients. Put dough in refrigerator for 1/2 hour. Form in balls and flatten.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Sugarless Banana Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Mix cornmeal salt and sugar together. Scald with boiling water. Add melted butter. Beat eggs and add milk to eggs. Put the 2 mixtures together. Add baking powder. Pour into baking pan and bake 30 to 40 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine marshmallow cream sugar milk butter and salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. Continue to boil over moderate heat stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Spread into a greased pan. Sprinkle with a few peanut butter chips.\tMelt the rest of the peanut butter chips and spread over the fudge. Chill in refrigerator until firm.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Put candy in a bowl and microwave for 2 minutes. Take out and stir. If not melted completely put back in microwave for 15 second intervals until all melted. Take out and stir in peanut butter and nuts (any amount you want). You can add marshmallows if you want. Stir quickly until all melted. Pour out on waxed paper or in pan. Let stand until firm. Cut into squares. Easy and good!

title: Cranberry Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch; mix well. Add corn syrup water and orange rind. Bring to a boil. Stir in almond extract raisins nuts and cranberries. Cover and cook until cranberry skins burst stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Dot with butter. Allow to cool; do not stir.

title: Roasted Rosemary Chicken
instructions: In a small saucepan cook garlic cloves and rosemary in hot oil over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until garlic is soft (avoid burning). Remove garlic with a slotted spoon and set aside. Let oil mixture cool. Stir lemon juice pepper and salt into oil. Wash the chicken thoroughly; pat dry with paper towels. Season body cavity with salt. Twist wing tips under the back. Place chicken breast side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Cut five slits randomly in the chicken skin. Insert the five cloves of garlic under the skin. Brush chicken with some of the oil mixture. Insert meat thermometer into the center of one of the inside thigh muscles. Roast at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 3/4 hours or until thermometer registers 180\u00b0.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Mix pie filling and pineapple together in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over this. Add melted butter over cake mix. Add coconut and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (I put a brown bag over the cake for a little while or it will get too brown before it gets done.)

title: Dip For Fresh Fruit
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and use as dip for fresh fruit.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Into bowl put crushed pineapple; do not drain. Add pudding. Mix well and add Cool Whip. Mix thoroughly. Pour into graham cracker crust. Sprinkle top with graham cracker crumbs. Let chill.

title: Best Ever Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into pie crust.

title: Family Griddle Cakes
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Beat eggs and milk. Beat well. Add melted shortening. Pour in pitcher. Pour on hot grill. Cook both sides.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add vanilla and oil. Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Add zucchini and nuts. Bake in 2 greased loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Maple-Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients mixing well. Sprinkle pecans evenly in pastry shell. Pour syrup mixture over pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set. Yields 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Add taco seasoning mix water and olives to browned and drained ground beef. Simmer 5 minutes. Layer the following into pie crust refried beans Doritos ground beef mixture and sour cream Cheddar cheese and more crushed Doritos. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Pookey'S Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: Crunch up Oreo cookies and put in bottom of large oblong cake pan. Melt butter and pour over cookies. Mix up and pat to make the crust.

title: California Chili Beans
instructions: Sort and rinse beans. Cook until tender. Cook ground beef in skillet. Drain off fat. Add cooked beef and remaining ingredients to beans; stir. Cook until flavors are mixed. Can be frozen. Very good.

title: Brunch Egg Casserole
instructions: Break bread into small pieces; place in well-greased baking dish (9 x 13-inches). Cut cheese into cubes and sprinkle over bread. Sprinkle ham or bacon over cheese then pour margarine over ham or bacon. Beat eggs with mustard salt and milk then pour over casserole. Chill in refrigerator overnight. Bake uncovered in preheated oven for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Moey'S Apple Butter
instructions: Using a lard can put apples that have been cored quartered and peeled in can. Pour sugar on top covering apples. Place lid on can and let it sit over night. Cook apples next morning for 3 hours or until apples are tender. Remove from stove. Using a potato masher mash apples while adding cinnamon and ground cloves. Pack into hot jars and seal.

title: Fair Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion and drain. Add everything else but cornmeal. Cook until done. Mix cornmeal and a little water. Stir in and cook 20 minutes longer.

title: Ranch Style Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender on medium speed until smooth. Sprinkle parsley and chives in just before finishing to give a pretty color.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill before serving. This dip is nice for veggies crackers or sourdough bread.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese mixing until well blended. Add pimiento green pepper onion Worcestershire sauce lemon juice and seasonings. Mix well. Chill. Shape in one ball or smaller balls. Roll into nuts.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Bring raisins water and lemon juice to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Mix the sugar and flour and stir into boiling raisin mixture. Cook until clear and thick. Stir in the margarine and blend until melted. Pour into unbaked pie shell and cover with top shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: *Recipe found in Vegetables Section of this book.

title: Texas Onions
instructions: Peel onion and remove enough center layers to make a pocket. Mix sausage most of cheese garlic pepper salt egg and corn. Divide evenly and fill pockets in onion. Sprinkle remaining cheese and all the margarine over the onions. Place onions in 9 x 13-inch pan and pour in water. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Asparagus Au Gratin
instructions: Open cans of asparagus and drain. Put asparagus into an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Slice eggs on top of asparagus. Make cream sauce by melting butter then add flour and milk mixture to medium heat. Stir until thick. Add cheese. Once cheese is melted in sauce pour sauce over eggs and asparagus. Top with crushed crackers. Bake at 400\u00b0 in oven until hot. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Put half the batter in a greased skillet. Put half of the green chillies and half of the grated cheese on top. Pour rest of the batter over that. Then put the rest of the green chilies and cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40-45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup To Can
instructions: Cook the first six vegetables separate in a little water. When almost soft drain. Have it all ready before adding to boiling tomato juice. Add 1/2 cup sugar 1 teaspoon chili powder and salt to taste. Cold pack for 2 hours.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake. This is a soft and moist cookie.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Heat soup. Add cheese and stir until melted. Dissolve gelatin in water and stir into soup mixture. Let cool. Blend in mayonnaise and lemon juice. Chill until slightly set. Add celery onion olives and shrimp. Mix well. Lightly coat inside of fish mold; put an olive slice for the eye. Size should be 6 or 8 cups. You could also use a ring mold. Chill until firm. Unmold on bed of greens. If using ring mold fill center with parsley sprigs or parsley and whole shrimp.

title: Chocolate Chip Raspberry Jumbles
instructions: Prepare chocolate chip cookie mix following directions. Reserve 1/2 cup dough. Spread remaining dough into ungreased 9-inch square pan. Spread preserves over base. Drop reserved dough by teaspoons over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Scalloped Zucchini And Potatoes
instructions: Spread sliced potatoes over bottom of lightly greased 9 x 13-inch loaf pan. Saute onions in oil with garlic until softened. Mix together basil oregano and thyme. Add 1/2 of mixture to onions. Distribute onions evenly over potatoes; dribble with buttermilk. Arrange one layer of zucchini slices to cover potato-onion mixture. Sprinkle with remaining herbs; salt and pepper lightly. Spread Cheddar cheese evenly over zucchini then sprinkle on Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil; bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour sugar baking powder salt and baking soda. Stir in orange juice orange peel shortening and egg. Mix until blended. Stir in cranberries and nuts. Turn into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake for 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on rack for 15 minutes; remove from pan. Makes one loaf.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Cook hamburg in oil; add onion and cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients and cook on simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes and carrots are tender.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Tear bread into small pieces. Mix together with other ingredients in a food processor. Drop mixture onto cookie sheet from spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Quick 'N Easy Salmon Patties
instructions: Drain salmon; set aside 2 tablespoons of the juice. In medium bowl mix salmon egg and onion until sticky. Stir in flour; add baking powder to salmon juice. Stir into salmon mixture. Drop tablespoonfuls into hot shortening and fry until golden brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Earthquake Cake
