instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Pour in long pan like sheet cake and bake. Mix together caramel topping and milk. Punch holes in cake and spread over baked cake. Frost cake by mixing cream cheese Cool Whip and sugar in mixer. Spread over cake. Sprinkle with sprinkles.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Combine first 6 ingredients; let stand 5 minutes. Add onion and meat; mix well. Line a loaf pan (8 x 5 x 3-inch) with bacon across the width of pan. Pack meat mixture into pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven; invert meat loaf onto baking sheet and lift off pan. Raise oven temperature to very hot (450\u00b0); return meat loaf to oven for 10 minutes to crisp bacon. Makes 6 servings.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spray glass cooking dish with vegetable spray and pour in dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli; chop and set aside. Melt butter in large heavy pan. Add mushrooms and onion; saute until tender. Add flour and stir until bubbly. Gradually add 1 1/2 cups milk stirring constantly to prevent lumps. Add cheese and stir until smooth. Add remaining milk. Add broccoli and heat thoroughly.

title: Tamale Balls
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients except last 3 items. Pinch off small amount and roll into bite-size balls. Place on cookie sheets and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine and mix last 3 items and bring to boil; simmer for 30 minutes until sauce is slightly thick. Place sauce in large chafing dish and add meatballs.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: In a deep casserole layer the ingredients (do not pack beef). Pour juice over. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Quick Sock It To Me Cake Iii
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together cake mix sugar oil eggs pecans and vanilla. Fold in the sour cream. Put half the batter in a bundt pan. Mix the brown sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over the batter in the pan. Pour remainder of the batter on top. Bake for 70 minutes until cake tests done.

title: Chicken Biscuits
instructions: Cut center out of rolls. Melt margarine in saucepan. Add bread pieces canned chicken and chicken soup. Fill holes with chicken mixture; spread remaining mixture across top of rolls. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Fat-Free Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ketchup and honey; mix well. Turn mixture into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes until firm and brown on top. Combine ketchup and honey. Spread evenly over top of loaf and bake 5 minutes.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter well with sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in flour and baking soda alternately with the buttermilk until blended. Stir in lemon peel and lemon juice. Spread in greased and floured 10 x 4-inch tube pan. Bake 1 hour in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Dump Salad
instructions: Dump everything into a large mixing bowl; mix well. Chill before serving.

title: Angel Pie
instructions: Drain pineapple juice and add flour. Cook and stir constantly until thick. Cool. Whip cream and combine to cooled thickening. Add crushed pineapple and pour into cooled pie shells. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Chill and serve.

title: Country-Fried Steak
instructions: Rinse steaks. Mix flour with salt and pepper. Coat steak with flour mixture. Heat shortening in a large skillet. Add steaks and fry on both sides until browned and meat juices run clear. Remove steaks from skillet.

title: Magic Heath Bars
instructions: Cover cookie sheet with foil. Lay saltines on foil. Melt and boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes. Pour over crackers and spread. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Remove and cool one minute. Pour chocolate chips evenly over top; let soften and spread. Refrigerate to set. Break up and serve.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar. Add egg yolks. Add milk and flour then flavorings. Roll nuts coconut and raisins in flour and add to mixture. Fold in egg whites. Bake in four layers in moderate oven until done.

title: Equal To 1 Can Eagle Brand Milk
instructions: Mix well in blender or with a mixer until smooth. This is equal to 1 can Eagle Brand milk.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Make a cream sauce by blending butter with flour and salt. Stir in milk; cook until thickened (use rounded tablespoonful measure in this recipe so your sauce will be thick). Set aside until cold. Drain salmon; take out skin and bone. Add slightly beaten egg lemon juice and the white sauce to the salmon. Place in refrigerator to chill for at least an hour then shape into croquettes. Roll in fine cracker crumbs and fry in hot fat. Drain on paper towels.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Add beaten eggs. Combine juice of 3 oranges melted butter and enough boiling water to make 1 1/2 cups of liquid. Add liquid to flour mixture. Add walnuts and cranberries. Makes 3 loaves. Let stand in pans for 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Medium Seedless Rye Bread
instructions: In the order listed place the water oil honey molasses salt rye flour bread flour and yeast in the baking pan of a bread machine. Place the pan in the machine and bake the bread according to the manufacturers directions for a plain loaf. Makes 1 (1 1/2-pound) loaf (16 slices).

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes. Mix first 7 ingredients and place in 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole. Sprinkle cornflakes on top and drizzle with oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cover potatoes and onion with water; cook until tender. Do not drain. Mash slightly leaving some lumps. Add rest of ingredients and salt and pepper to taste. Additional sweet milk may be added if more broth is needed. Cook until hot and serve.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Grate and mix with light Miracle Whip.

title: Tater Tots Casserole(Topped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish with nonstick spray. In a 10-inch skillet cook onions and ground beef until meat loses red color. Drain off excess fat. Season with salt and pepper. Spread meat mixture in baking dish. Cover with undiluted soup and top with single layer of frozen Tater Tots. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: In a medium-size bowl put pineapple with juice. Add drained cans of peaches fruit cocktail and strawberries. Add vanilla pudding mix and orange juice. Mix all well and chill well.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spoon over chicken in baking dish. This will be enough sauce to do 2 chickens. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: In skillet brown beef. Stir to separate meat and pour off fat. Add soup sour cream and seasonings. Cook over low heat 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over noodles.

title: Toffee Crunch Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine at medium speed with a mixer until creamy. Add cake mix eggs and water beating until blended. Stir in brickle chips and pecans. Drop cookies by tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until edges are brown. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Cut up Cauliflower into bite size pieces. Mix together with frozen peas shredded cheese and 1/2 jar bacon bits. Mix ranch dressing according to direction. Then pour over salad and mix well. Let sit overnight. (May substitute 1 Broccoli for Cauliflower.)

title: Hashburgers
instructions: Garnish liberally with love and keep cool until it sparkles. If you have followed Gods cookbook in preparing your marriage your home is ready now!

title: Reese'S Cup Candy
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine sugar and margarine. Beat until smooth. Add peanut butter and continue beating until well blended. Roll into 1/2-inch size balls and place onto waxed paper. In a 1-quart saucepan place chocolate bar and paraffin. Melt on low heat or in microwave; stir to blend. Dip candy balls in chocolate; lift out with a fork. Place candy on waxed paper. Yield Approximately 80 pieces.

title: Friendship Cake
instructions: Day 1 Combine starter and peaches (only one can of juice). Let set 10 days stirring each day!

title: New Mexico Breakfast Of Champions
instructions: Slightly butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Butter bread and chop into cubes. Cook sausage and chorizo and drain. Place bread cubes in dish. Cover with chorizo and sausage. Add 1 cup cheese. Add eggs and milk beaten together. Pour over bread and sausage. Cover and let set overnight. Before baking add 1/2 cup grated cheese and chopped green chilies. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Combine soy sauce bourbon and sugar. Mix well. Marinate pork in mixture for 2 to 3 hours. This can be baked in marinade uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn meat halfway through. Slice on diagonal. Or this is wonderful cooked on grill. Serve with horseradish sauce or Rothschild Raspberry Salsa.

title: Make Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft mash. Put potatoes and all ingredients into crock-pot. Cook on low until heated through. Can be made the night before and put in crock-pot the next day to heat up.

title: Eggplant Creole
instructions: Cube eggplant and put in pot with water to cover. Cook for 10 minutes. Drain and place in greased baking dish.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Peel seed and grate 3 cups zucchini. Mix eggs sugar salt baking soda baking powder cinnamon vanilla Wesson oil and flour. Then add zucchini coconut and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Blueberry Tea Cake
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually. Cream until well blended. Add 1 egg. Beat until mixture is light and fluffy. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla. Pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cover with washed and drained blueberries. Sprinkle top with sugar. Dot with butter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Mom Mom'S Rice Lasagne
instructions: Beat egg. Combine with Ricotta and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover bottom of casserole dish with sauce. Add a layer of rice. Add a layer of Ricotta. Add sauce and a layer of Mozzarella and some Parmesan. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Put sauce on top and sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream the first 5 ingredients together. Add the rest of ingredients. Mix well together. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage. Beat eggs; add milk and salt. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread sausage in bottom of pan. Next layer bread cubes. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until center is done. Makes 6 servings. You may use bacon or ham instead of sausage.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar. Add eggs then add cake mix and sour cream. Then add flavoring flour and milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour and 10 minutes in tube pan. As soon as you remove from pan pour a real thin glaze of icing. I like to do this while the cake is still hot therefore most of the glaze is absorbed into the cake.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add M&Ms. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until lightly browned about 10 minutes.

title: Sausage-Potato Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage and fry in large skillet. Stir while cooking. As soon as all pink color of meat disappears push meat to one side and brown potato cubes slightly in sausage drippings. Stir potatoes and sausage together. Sprinkle flour. Add milk; cook and stir until slightly thickened. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cheese and paprika over top. Cover with lid or foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes. Serve hot. Yields 6 to 8 servings. Recipe can be refrigerated for later.

title: Oven-Fried Fish
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a shallow dish. Dip fish in milk and dredge in cornmeal mixture. Place in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and drizzle with butter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Garnish if desired. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice Bake
instructions: In a 3-quart oblong baking dish combine soup water rice mushrooms and 1/2 can of onions. Arrange chicken on rice mixture. Sprinkle with paprika and pepper. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. Top with remaining onions. Bake 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cover chicken with hot water and simmer until very tender. Remove from liquid and pick meat from bones. Return meat to liquid. Add vegetables and seasonings and simmer until vegetables are tender and the stew is thick.

title: Steak Fingers
instructions: Cut round steak into finger size strips. Soak overnight in mixture of remaining ingredients. When ready to cook remove strips from mixture and coat with flour. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix oleo sugar and eggs well. Add coconut vinegar and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli-Beef Pie
instructions: Cook broccoli in a small amount of boiling water for 5 minutes or until tender. Drain well and set aside. Brown ground beef in a large skillet stirring to crumble. Drain well. Stir in mushrooms 1 1/2 cups Cheddar cheese and onion. Remove from heat and set aside.

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: Cook onion green pepper and sausage until sausage is done. Drain grease. After bread dough has risen spread it out over a cookie sheet until it is about 1/4 thick. Spread cheeses in the middle of dough. Add sausage mixture. Pull sides up around filling. Pinch and roll edges to seal loaf. Fold ends to complete the seal. Place seam side down on cookie sheet. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Wednesday'S Chili
instructions: In a medium skillet heat oil and brown meat over medium-high heat until color disappears. Set aside.

title: Cheesy Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken breasts with Accent and pepper. Saute in oil about 4 minutes per side. Mix soup mayonnaise and lemon juice together.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat 3 egg whites until stiff. Add 9 teaspoons sugar and vanilla.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Season with black or white pepper and cayenne pepper. Add Tony Chachere seasoning sauce to taste.

title: Secret Biscuits
instructions: Bake at 475\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Melt 1/2 stick of butter; brush on while still hot.

title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered and 15 to 20 minutes uncovered.

title: Dumplings For Chicken
instructions: Put flour into a bowl. Add oil and salt. Put in a drop or two of yellow food coloring; mix a little. Add milk. Make dough stiff enough to roll out; cut in triangle. Drop in hot broth and cook 15 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown together ground beef and onion. Mix together enchilada sauce and soups; add chilies then add to beef. In greased 2-quart casserole dish layer meat mixture and tortillas starting with meat and ending with meat. Top with onion and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until browned and bubbly.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Sift together first 3 ingredients. Cut in Crisco; add buttermilk. Mix well. Roll out or cut out and place on greased baking sheet. Bake for approximately 10 minutes. Brush top of biscuits with butter or milk and bake another 5 to 8 minutes until golden brown in 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in milk jugs. Freeze until ready to use. Then mix with 2 large ginger ales.

title: Garlic And Dill Pickles
instructions: Boil your vinegar water and salt; put your grapes dill and garlic in bottom of your jars. Put your cucumbers in. Pour your boiling ingredients over pickles and seal.

title: Cornbread Stuffing
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Place in a 9 x13-inch dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes (or less).

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: In large pan boil 10 cups of water. Add all ingredients. Bring to a boil again. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes (noodles cooked).

title: Easy Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup Colby cheese. Mix well. Turn into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Pineapple And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple juice into mixing bowl; stir sugar and flour into juice. Add pineapple chunks. Pour into a 9 x 12-inch casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Add melted butter to crushed Ritz crackers sand sprinkle on top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. A great accompaniment for baked ham or pork.

title: Nancy'S Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Cream together and spread on roll. Then re-roll and refrigerate until served.

title: Best Breakfast Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt spices nuts and oil. Take out 3/4 cup for topping. To remaining mixture add egg and soda dissolved in buttermilk.

title: Hostess Twinkie Cake
instructions: Cut Twinkies in half lengthwise and place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan creme side up. Mix rest of ingredients together and place 1/2 of mixture on Twinkies in pan. Next layer Twinkies creme side down. Then top with rest of mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Super Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix together in a large mixing bowl with a large wooden spoon.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Melt together the Eagle Brand milk chocolate chips and butterscotch chips. Add the vanilla nuts salt and marshmallows. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate.

title: Gherkin Pate
instructions: Combine pork and bread crumbs. Beat egg Worcestershire mustard salt and sage together. Coarsely chop pickles and pimentos. Add juice and ground pepper and gently mix all ingredients together. Pack into loaf pan. Bake in water bath at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with crackers and mustard.

title: Sausage And Apples
instructions: Cook sausage in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat 10 minutes (until no longer pink). Drain well; discard juices. Cut sausage links crosswise in half. Return sausage to skillet. Core apples and cut each into 8 wedges. Add apple wedges to sausage. Sprinkle with brown sugar lemon juice salt and pepper. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 10 to 15 minutes until apples are tender stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Foolproof Fudge Cut-Outs
instructions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with foil extending foil over edge of pan. Set aside. In heavy saucepan over low heat melt chips with sweetened condensed milk and salt. Remove from heat; stir in walnuts if desired and vanilla. Spread evenly in prepared pan. Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm. Use foil to lift fudge out of pan. Place on cutting board. Peel off foil. Cut into shapes with cookie cutters. Store tightly covered in cool dry place. Makes about 2 pounds of fudge.

title: Mellow Cream Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into 2-inch pieces. Arrange one layer on a shallow tray.

title: Jo'S Special Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef onions and bell peppers. Add salt. Cook until beef is brown. Add other ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Granny Young'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs beating well. Add salt soda baking powder vanilla and buttermilk. Add flour 1 cup at a time. Dough will be fairly stiff. Lightly sprinkle your hands with flour; spoon a rounded tablespoonful of dough shaping cookies with your hands. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Layer 1/2 of each on top of each other in a sprayed pan. Layer again with remainder 1/2 of each ingredient.

title: Grape-Nuts
instructions: Mix to stiff dough with 2 or more cups of milk. Bake on large cookie sheet about 1/2-inch thick until done. Break in pieces when cool. Dry again in oven until very hard. Grind with coarse blade in food chopper or meat grinder.

title: Ripe Olive And Egg Sandwiches
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Blend well. Enough spread for 1 loaf of sandwich bread.

title: Reception Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; heat juice to boiling point. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add other ingredients. Pour into circular mold. Chill. Unmold onto bed of lettuce. Serve with hot Parker House rolls and coffee.

title: Mock Oysters
instructions: Separate eggs; put whites in small bowl. Let whites warm to room temperature.

title: Yellow Punch
instructions: Combine jello and sugar in 4 cups of water. Heat mixture until dissolved. Cool. Add ReaLemon the remaining 10 cups of water almond extract and pineapple juice. Chill. Freeze part of the punch for ice. Makes 2 gallons.

title: Caramel Crunch
instructions: Keep popped corn warm in a large shallow pan in a 250\u00b0 oven. Combine margarine sugar corn syrup and salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Continue to boil to firm ball stage (248\u00b0). This will take about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in baking soda. Syrup will foam. Pour hot caramel mixture over popped corn and nuts; stir to mix well. Divide mixture onto several cookie sheets and return to 250\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Cool and serve or store in airtight container in cool place.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Chicken Pie
instructions: Spray dish with Pam. Cook chicken until tender. Cut into small pieces and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In a saucepan mix and bring to a boil the reserved chicken broth and soup. In another bowl combine margarine pepper salt flour and buttermilk. Mix thoroughly to form batter. Pour broth mixture over chicken. Spoon batter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned on top.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Tie cinnamon sticks and cloves in a cheesecloth bag. Boil water. Put spices in water and boil for 5 minutes or longer. Remove water from heat and put in tea bags. Steep 5 minutes. Add sugar and juices. Keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream together cream cheese with sugar gradually. Mix in strawberries (with juice) then add crushed pineapple. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in dish and freeze hard. Before serving set out to thaw 45 minutes before serving (so fork can sink into it).

title: Old Fashion Cream Pie
instructions: Cream together the sugar brown sugar and egg yolks. Add salt flour and cream. Beat egg whites until near peaks then add to rest of ingredients. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Spicy Herb Marinade
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix well. In shallow dish or plastic bag pour over chicken beef or pork. Cover; marinate in refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight turning occasionally. Remove meat from marinade; head marinade. Grill or broil as desired basting frequently with marinade. Refrigerate leftover meat.

title: Macaroni And Beef Saute
instructions: Saute beef macaroni onion green pepper and garlic in hot oil until macaroni turns slightly yellow. Drain off excess fat. Add tomato juice and seasoning; bring to boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Uncover and simmer for several more minutes or until sauce is reduced to desired consistency. Makes 2 servings.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Mix oleo and flour together like pie dough; press in pan 11 x 7 x 2-inch. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs and add to other ingredients; season to taste. Bake in greased baking dish at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mom'S Egg Nog
instructions: In a bowl beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup of sugar until thick. In another bowl beat egg whites with 1/4 cup of sugar until thick. In a third bowl beat cream until thick. Add cream to the yolks. Fold in the egg whites. Add milk bourbon vanilla and a pinch of nutmeg. Chill in the freezer before serving.

title: Tuna Noodle
instructions: Cook pasta; drain. In bowl mix sour cream mayonnaise cheese milk and mustard. Salt and pepper to taste. Add to pasta tuna broccoli red peppers and onion.

title: Honey Orange Glaze Ham
instructions: Put orange juice water honey and salt in a saucepan. Blend cornstarch with 1/4 cup of the mixture and return to saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until it thickens and comes to a boil. Boil two or three minutes. Cool brush on ham. Honey glaze does not tend to run off as do some other glazes.

title: Dashday Dessert
instructions: Melt butter in pie pan. Mix flour sugar milk salt and baking powder. Pour over butter but dont mix. Pour fruit and juice (cherries or any kind of berries) over batter. Dont mix. Put in oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm or cold with cream.

title: Creamy Old Fashioned Rice Pudding
instructions: Scald milk in saucepan. Stir in salt and rice. Simmer on very low flame covered until milk is absorbed for about 45 minutes to 1 hour stirring occasionally. Combine half and half eggs sugar and vanilla with wire whisk; stir into rice mixture. Cook stirring constantly for 3 to 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Pour into serving dish stirring occasionally. Sprinkle top with cinnamon. Chill.

title: Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Mix margarine and sugars. Add egg yolks flour and oats. Blend. Spread in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. When baked sprinkle one cup chocolate chips over top while warm. Spread with knife.

title: Easy Taco Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients until well blended. Chill. Serve with assorted chips or vegetables. Yields 3 cups.

title: Grilled Salmon
instructions: 1. Mix garlic OJ ketchup honey and ginger in a shallow dish. Place Salmon steak in the shallow dish and let soak for at least 15 minutes but preferably for 1 hour. 2. Turn steaks several times to expose both sides to marinade. 3. Out Salmon and marinade in a tin foil dish and place on grill cover. Cook with medium heat until Salmon is flaky.

title: Hungarian Stuffed Cabbage - Mom'S Way
instructions: Core cabbage and place in enough boiling water to cover. With a fork in one hand and a knife in the other keep cutting off the leaves as they wilt. Drain and trim center vein of each leaf. Set aside.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix warm pasta with chopped vegetables. Mix dressing with mayo and sour cream. Thin some with skim milk. Mix through salad and chill.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar salt vinegar and water; boil until slightly thickened stirring constantly. Add beets to mixture and reheat. Serve hot.

title: Six Layer Casserole
instructions: Layer sausage rice potatoes onions and carrots in a casserole dish. Add tomato juice. Mix sugar salt and pepper. Sprinkle dry over top. Cover with foil. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Creamed Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cook until done. Pour into a mixer reserving some of the potato water. Mix at medium speed. Mix in other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: White Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Mix everything together with a fork. Press in bottom of 10-inch spring-form pan that has been sprayed with Pam.

title: Pepperoni Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and pepperoni together and put covered in fridge for 2 days before serving. Serve in hollowed out bread with removed bread cut into small pieces and served along side for dipping.

title: Cherry Fudge Tarts
instructions: In saucepan over medium heat melt chocolate with condensed milk and salt. Cook and stir rapidly until very thick and bubbly 5 to 8 minutes. Add water and egg yolks; cook and stir rapidly until thickens again. Remove from heat; add extract. Cool 15 minutes. Chill thoroughly about 30 minutes. Stir. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon into crust. Chill 1 hour. Top with cherry filling. Refrigerate.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Pour over hot cake. Serve as soon as possible for best flavor.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; cool and cut into small pieces. Melt butter; mix with herb stuffing. Heat soups adding can of water. Layer chicken soup and stuffing. End with layer of stuffing mix on top. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mohawk Corn(Modern)
instructions: Scrape corn from ears and add to pot along with 1/2 water walnuts and butter. Heat through.

title: Grated Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in water to cover until partially cooked. Peel and grate. Add onion 2 cups cheese soup and sour cream. Mix well. Add butter. Blend well. Spoon into 3-quart casserole. Top with remaining cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 10 to 15.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Cover beans with cold water. Saute garlic onions and parsley in butter. Add to other ingredients. (If you dont want to bother with this just dump everything in and boil. Ive tried it both ways and cant tell any real difference.) Boil until beans are tender and soup is thick. Serve topped with chopped onions sour cream and grated cheese. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Bubble Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; set aside. Pour scalded milk over 1 cup sugar shortening and salt. Add egg to milk. Add all together and mix well. Add 1/2 flour to mixture. Mix well. Let dough rise until doubled.

title: Chicken Creole
instructions: Cut off the skin from the chicken. Brown chicken in margarine. Remove and set aside. Add vegetables to drippings. Saute until vegetables are soft. Stir in tomatoes water bouillon and spices. Add chicken. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 30 minutes. Uncover and simmer for 30 more minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Combine Crisco brown sugar egg milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Combine oats flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Mix into creamed mixture at low speed just until blended. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chew Bread
instructions: Combine butter and brown sugar. Blend in remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine and chips in milk on low heat. Add powdered sugar and peanut butter. Pat into platter.

title: Beef And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Spread rice evenly in bottom of a large casserole dish. Brown ground beef and onion in a large skillet stirring occasionally. Add cabbage carrots pepper and salt to ground beef and stir. Spread over rice. Pour chicken broth over mixture cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. When ready to serve dot with butter and mix in gently.

title: Grandma'S Best Chili Sauce
instructions: Peel and chop tomatoes coarsely. Grind onions and peppers together. Mash garlic with salt. Tie spices in a cheesecloth bag. Combine all ingredients in a large kettle; heat to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer until mixture is thick. Ladle into hot jars; seal at once.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft. Cream like mashed potatoes. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Set aside. Brown hamburger meat drain and add taco seasoning. Let cook 5 minutes. Pour over potatoes in casserole dish. Put cheese over this. Cook at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Ready to eat.

title: Meta'S Dessert
instructions: Beat egg yolks with sugar until light and fluffy. Set aside. Mix gelatine with 1/2 cup warm water and dissolve. Set aside to cool then add orange juice. Beat heavy cream in a separate bowl. Mix ingredients together and pour into spring-form pan filled with 1 box of chocolate wafers crumbled in a blender and mixed with melted butter. Refrigerate overnight in refrigerator. When ready to serve cut pie and spoon fresh or frozen strawberries on top of pie.

title: W. V. Coal Miners Strawberries
instructions: Wash beans and then put in large pot. Cook pinto beans and ham halks together in water. When half done add lard and salt. Then cook low until done. You can use hog jowls instead of ham halks but omit the lard.

title: Holiday Goose
instructions: Rub goose inside with salt and pepper. Fill cavity with raw tart apples onion and celery tops. Truss bird. Place in foil and add melted butter paprika salt pepper thyme parsley and wine. Completely cover with foil. Roast in 350\u00b0 oven; baste often. When done remove foil from top and brown. Remove stuffing and discard before serving.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Combine all ingredients except margarine. Melt margarine in frypan over medium heat. Drop batter by tablespoons into margarine and cook on each side until golden brown.

title: Mandarin Orange Mold
instructions: Dissolve orange gelatin in boiling water. Add 2 cups fruit juices. Cool and refrigerate until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Add fruit and pint of orange sherbet. Mix thoroughly. Place in 12-cup ring mold. Refrigerate until well set. Unmold to serve. May be divided into two smaller molds.

title: Beef And Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Partially freeze steak; trim fat from steak. Slice steak diagonally across grain in 1/4-inch strips. Place in a Ziploc plastic bag. Combine wine 2 tablespoons soy sauce and cornstarch; pour over steak. Seal bag and shake until steak is coated. Marinate for 2 hours. Combine water honey remaining soy sauce and red pepper; stir well. Set aside. Coat a wok with cooking spray and 1 teaspoon oil. Place over medium high (375\u00b0) heat until hot. Add broccoli; stir-fry for 4 minutes. Remove broccoli from wok. Keep warm. Remove steak from marinade; reserve marinade. Add remaining teaspoon oil. Reheat wok to 375\u00b0. Add steak; stir-fry for 4 minutes. Remove steak from wok; drain. Wipe drippings from wok. Add steak honey mixture and marinade to wok. Cook until thoroughly heated. Arrange broccoli on plates; top evenly with steak mixture. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Put in a buttered square pan and pour over 2 cans tomato soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts or whole chicken. Remove from bone and cut chicken in small pieces. Set aside.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain; stir in butter and eggs. Add Parmesan cheese. Form spaghetti mix into 2 crusts in buttered 10-inch pie plates.

title: Grandma'S Best Beans Ever
instructions: Chop bacon and cook until crisp. Drain. In a large pot combine onions brown sugar vinegar and mustard. Heat well. Add bacon and all cans of beans (undrained). Mix well and heat slowly to blend flavors.

title: Hearty Chili
instructions: In 1 1/2 to 2-gallon stock pot heat oil; add turkey and garlic. Saute on high heat until meat is firm and slightly browned. Add red pepper and green onion stir and cook until onion turns clear. Reduce heat to medium; add black pepper chili powder cumin and oregano. Let simmer several minutes to allow seasoning to permeate. Stirring rapidly add enough masa harina to absorb excess fat. When mixture is smooth add wine vinegar tomatoes beef base and chilies. Stir thoroughly. Add bay leaves and enough Kitchen Bouquet to darken to a reddish brown.

title: Chili Casserole
instructions: Place 2 cups broken chips in a lightly greased 1-quart baking dish. Spread soups over chips. Spread chili over soups. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining chips and bake 5 minutes longer. Yields 4 servings.

title: Creamy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Pour into pie crust and put in freezer. Serve cold.

title: Marinated Cod Teriyaki(Microwave)
instructions: In small bowl combine teriyaki sauce water sherry garlic and ginger. Arrange fillets in 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Pour mixture over fillets. Turn fish over to coat both sides. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Microwave uncovered on High for 4 to 5 minutes (flakes easily with fork).

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Whoopie Pies(Cookies)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add shortening milk and egg. Beat well and add vanilla. Drop by tablespoons on greased cookie sheet. Smooth each cookie flat. Bake 5 to 8 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Pizza
instructions: Place above in baking dish in the order listed. Do not stir. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Combine and blend all the ingredients. Deep fat fry in hot grease in iron skillet or fryer. (Grease must be hot otherwise batter will sink to bottom and not cook well.)

title: Snickers Cake
instructions: Mix cake per directions. Pour 1/2 of batter into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Melt butter caramels and milk. Pour over warm cake. Add remaining batter and top with chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes longer.

title: Date Nut Pinwheels
instructions: Combine dates granulated sugar and water in a saucepan. Cook over low heat until thick about 10 minutes. Cool and then stir in nuts; set aside. Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually. Add eggs and beat well. Sift together flour salt and soda; add and mix well. Chill thoroughly. Divide mixture in half and roll each section into a rectangle a little less than 1/4-inch thick. Spread date fillings to edges and roll up from long side like a jelly roll. Wrap rolls in waxed paper and chill overnight.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together\tadding melted margarine last. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake 1 hour or more at 350\u00b0.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and divide in half. To one half add sugar cocoa cinnamon and chocolate bits. Swirl this half through top half with knife. Reserve small amount for top and sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Mini Micro Pizzas
instructions: Separate the hamburger buns then spread the pizza sauce over the buns. Next put the cheese over that. Arrange pizzas in microwave on High. Cook pizzas 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Layer all ingredients ending with cheese. Dont add onions yet. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until bubbling. Top with onions and bake another 10 minutes and away you go!

title: Oriental So-Good Salad
instructions: Melt butter and brown seeds almonds and crushed noodles. Drain on a paper towel.

title: Pasta And Tuna Salad
instructions: Toss first 4 ingredients together. Mix in mayonnaise. Serve warm or chilled over lettuce. Garnish with green pepper strips raw onion rings or slices and olives.

title: White Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar until fluffy; add egg yolks one at a time. Add chocolate and vanilla. Mix flour and soda; add with buttermilk. Do not overmix. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold gently; gently blend in coconut and pecans. Bake in 4 (8-inch) pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in baking dish. Top with ketchup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Candy Bar
instructions: Mix ingredients and place on Saran Wrap. Freeze.

title: No Bake Chocolate Treats
instructions: Mix in pan the sugar cocoa milk and margarine. Put on medium heat and cook until it starts to boil. Remove from heat; cool for 1 minute. Add vanilla salt peanut butter and oatmeal. Stir well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Easy Pound Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and beat for 12 minutes until well combined. Pour into a tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes; slice thinly. Wash and place in casserole dish. Peel and slice onion. Place onion in casserole dish. Mix soup milk cheese margarine and salt; pour over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lazy Day Stew
instructions: Place meat in single layer in casserole. Layer each vegetable on top of meat. Mix tomato sauce with one can water and sugar. Pour over meat and vegetables. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Seal casserole tightly. Place in 325\u00b0 oven bake for two hours. Do not uncover during baking time.

title: Oven Easy Pork Chops
instructions: Place butter in pan in oven to melt. In shallow bowl or pie plate combine crumbs cheese salt and pepper. In a separate bowl blend together egg and milk. Dip pork chops in egg mixture and coat chops with crumb mixture. Place in baking dish. Bake 30 minutes. Carefully turn chops and bake again for an additional 30 minutes or until done in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Crazy Custard Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender well. Put in pie pan. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Hot Potatoes
instructions: Put all ingredients into hot skillet except eggs. Cook until done. Add eggs. Continue to stir until eggs are cooked. Serve and enjoy.

title: Rio Grande Dip
instructions: Mix browned ground meat with refried beans; spread in bottom of casserole dish. Layer guacamole then sour cream. Cover with cheese; top with jalapenos and sliced black olives. Broil in oven to melt cheese.

title: Banana Muffins(Low-Fat)
instructions: Combine flour Bran Flakes oats and baking powder in large bowl. Beat egg whites in small bowl until stiff peaks. Add apple juice yogurt bananas and raisins in flour mixture; stir to blend. Fold in egg whites and mix well. Spoon the batter into paper lined muffin tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. One muffin = 178 calories.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Blend liquids and pour over sliced vegetables. Store in covered container and refrigerate. Keeps well.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix everything together and roll into tortillas. Cover with remaining mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (Toothpicks can hold enchilada together while cooking.) Yields 12 servings.

title: Orzo Cooked In Saffron Broth With Shrimp And Peas
instructions: Cook shrimp until tender; drain and cool; coarsely chop. Add peas to the orzo before cooking. When the orzo is tender add the shrimp. Toss just to blend.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Mash carrots diced cheese and olives. Combine all the ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste and top with butter and extra cracker crumbs. Bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and slightly brown.

title: Chili
instructions: In pot saute onions and green pepper in oil. Add hamburger; cook until browned stirring occasionally. Drain fat. Stir in tomatoes cut up and tomato sauce ketchup chili powder salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in chili beans. Simmer 15 minutes longer.

title: Cherry Nut Loaf
instructions: Sift flour salt soda and powder. In large bowl mix cherry filling sugar oil eggs and milk. Add to dry ingredients and mix until blended. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes in 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans.

title: Low-Fat Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix flour baking soda baking powder and cinnamon in a large bowl. Mix cereal sugar and milk in another bowl; let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in egg and applesauce (add banana here if using it). Add to flour mixture stir until just moistened. Spoon batter into muffin pan sprayed with Pam. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 12.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Stir and mix well. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Perfection Salad
instructions: Pour boiling water over gelatin; stir until dissolved. Add vinegar lemon juice and liquid artificial sweetener. Chill until liquid starts to congeal then add chopped vegetables. Stir and pour into square pan. Chill until firm. Cut into squares. Place on lettuce leaf. Yield 4 servings. Carbohydrate 5 g protein 3 g fat 0 g calories 32. One serving = 1 vegetable exchange.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients together. Alternately add flour and bananas to mixture. Mix well. Fold in nuts if desired. Bake in a well-greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix milk Cool Whip and lemonade together. Place in pie shells and allow to freeze before serving.

title: Fail Not Divine Divinity
instructions: In a heavy saucepan boil sugar water and salt of soft ball stage. Pour over marshmallow cream.

title: Orange Pineapple Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid sugar and water stirring well. Then add pineapple juice frozen orange juice and ginger ale stirring well. Put in refrigerator and chill.

title: Raisin Walnut Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Line 9-inch pan with one crust.

title: Unfried Catfish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray light vegetable oil cooking spray over baking sheet to coat well. Put cornmeal thyme and basil on a plate and mix well. Sprinkle fillets with garlic powder lemon pepper and a generous amount of blackening seasoning. Coat thoroughly with cornmeal mixture and transfer to a prepared baking sheet. Dust each fillet with 1/8 teaspoon of paprika and spray lightly with cooking spray. Bake on the bottom shelf of oven for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 5 minutes more until crust is golden and fish flakes evenly. Makes 4 servings with 5.2 fat grams and 172 calories each.

title: Blackberry Jelly
instructions: Put berries in a pan; cover with water. Bring to a boil. Mash berries and strain through cheesecloth. Use 3 1/2 cups of juice to 1 package of Sure-Jell. Bring to rapid boil. Add 5 cups sugar and bring to boil. Cook 1 minute; stir constantly. Pour into jelly glasses and seal.

title: Speedy Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in microwave until soft (approximately 10 minutes) rotating potatoes once while cooking. Allow to cool. Peel skin from potatoes. On stove top mix butter flour salt and milk in saucepan. Heat until butter has melted stirring constantly. Cut potatoes in cubes and add to white sauce. Simmer until slightly thickened.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in casserole dish and stir in Doritos to make the crust. Mix soups together and pour on crust. Add chicken and tomatoes. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Add grated Cheddar cheese and bake until cheese is melted.

title: Chocolate Oil Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients well together. Bake in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Crisp Pickle Slices
instructions: Do not pare cucumbers; slice thin. Add onions peppers and whole garlic. Add salt. Cover with cracked ice. Mix thoroughly. Let stand 3 hours. Drain thoroughly.

title: Pimiento Cheese
instructions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add all ingredients. Top with cover; pulse several times until coarsely blended. Cover and store in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix salt flour soda sugar egg and pineapple all together. Pour into greased long cake pan. Sprinkle brown sugar coconut and pecan mixture over the cake before baking. Bake for approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: May use strawberries apricots blackberries cherries or peaches.

title: Honey Baked Ham
instructions: Using a sharp knife remove the layer of skin from ham leaving a thin layer of fat to keep the meat juicy while baking. Score the surface of the ham in a diamond pattern without cutting into the meat. Place a whole clove in the center of half of the diamonds. Brush top of ham with Dijon mustard and place ham in a roasting pan. Combine sugar honey and cinnamon; heat over a low to medium temperature for about 2 minutes until the mixture is pourable but not thin. Spread the mixture over the ham. Pour the apple juice into bottom of roasting pan and roast at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Baste with the juices in the pan every half hour.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick\tbutter or margarine pour in Bundt pan. Then add 1/4 cup brown sugar milk and walnuts (however many you want).

title: Red Riding Hood'S Raisin Rice(Serves 4)
instructions: Sort wash and soak the rice for 1 hour. Heat the butter in a heavy large skillet. Add the cloves and cinnamon and if desired the caraway and turmeric. Keep the heat very low and fry these only for a minute or two. Then add the washed and drained rice salt and raisins. Mix and fry gently for a few minutes stirring all the time. Next add the hot water. Mix thoroughly and bring to a boil quickly. Turn the heat very low and cook either on the stovetop or better still in the oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes with the lid on.

title: 30-Minute Pasta Sauce
instructions: Chop garlic and onion very fine. Saute in olive oil until soft. Add tomatoes basil and rest of seasonings. Bring to a light boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken breasts with celery in broth. Remove from bone in medium chunks. Mix with almonds celery onion lemon juice mayonnaise salt and pepper. Spread mix in large baking dish. Add a little broth if dry. Cover with cheese. Crush potato chips. Spread over cheese. Cook about 1/2 hour until cheese is melted at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: In small bowl beat eggs well with a fork; set aside. With an electric mixer cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. In a small bowl mix sour cream and baking soda. Add to sugar and egg mixture. Beat well. Add bananas. Gradually add flour while still beating. Add vanilla and beat well. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: American Cheese Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Place tortillas on a flat surface. Spread each tortilla with 2 tablespoons peanut butter. Drizzle with 2 teaspoons honey. Arrange cheese slices over honey. Top with lettuce leaves. Roll up tightly jelly-roll style. Secure with a toothpick. Cut rolls crosswise in halves then into 1-inch thick slices. Or wrap uncut rolls in plastic wrap. Refrigerate up to 24 hours. Slice just before serving. Makes 4 portions.

title: Forever Cole Slaw
instructions: Bring oil vinegar salt dry mustard and celery seed to a hard boil. Pour over shredded cabbage onion and pepper. Cool and refrigerate. Will keep for several days.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Pie
instructions: In a large bowl melt chocolate squares in microwave for 15 seconds or until melted. Add Eagle Brand milk and peanut butter to melted chocolate and mix well.

title: Diabetic Fruitcake
instructions: Mix margarine sugar substitute egg and applesauce together and cream.

title: Lima Beans Western
instructions: Cook beans according to directions on package and drain. Cut bacon slices in 1/2-inch squares. Fry until crisp. Add bacon drippings and chili sauce to beans. Season to taste and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Iced Tea Punch
instructions: Steep 4 tea bags in 2 cups boiling water. Dissolve 2 cups sugar in 4 cups water on stove. Blend the two mixtures. Add vanilla almond and lemon juice; set aside.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Cut cheese in cubes. Add remaining ingredients. Put in a baking dish and cover. Bake at 200\u00b0 until cheese melts; stir only twice. Eat with fresh raw vegetables or bread sticks. A small crock-pot on low works well also. This is yummy!

title: Kentucky Kernels(No Bake Date Cookies)
instructions: Cook first 5 ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir and mash dates while cooking. Remove from fire and add the cereal and pecans. Put hands in Baggies to protect from heat and roll a spoonful of mixture into a ball then in coconut. Let set. Delicious! Even people who dont normally like dates seem to like these.

title: Cherry Frosting
instructions: Mix powdered sugar with butter. Stir in vanilla and milk. Add cherries food coloring and extract.

title: Rye Bread Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Take a loaf of rye bread and scoop out the center. Pour dip into the hollowed bread. Serve with raw vegetables of your choice.

title: Blue Ribbon Apple Pie
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Beat in eggs then add nuts apples and vanilla. Spread and bake in buttered 8-inch pie pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 2 loaf pans 9 x 5 x 3-inch or 3 loaf pans 8.5 x 4.5 x 2.5-inches. Mix shortening and sugar in large bowl. Add eggs zucchini and water. Blend in flour baking soda salt baking powder cinnamon cloves and vanilla. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into pans. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean about 60 to 70 minutes. Cool slightly. Loosen sides of loaves from pans. Remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing. To store wrap and refrigerate no longer than 10 days or you can freeze it.

title: Deviled Peas
instructions: Mix all except the last 2 ingredients together. Place layer of the mixture in a greased baking dish; top with mushroom soup and sliced eggs. Continue until all ingredients have been used. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Have ingredients at room temperature. This is most important for eggs and margarine. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease Bundt pan. Put all ingredients into mixer at once and beat until smooth (about 10 minutes). Pour in pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour or it tests done.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: In a skillet brown pork chops in oil on each side. In a large bowl combine the soup milk sour cream pepper 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup onions; fold in potatoes. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange chops on top; sprinkle with seasoned salt. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until pork is tender. Uncover; sprinkle with remaining cheese and onions. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Yield 6 servings.

title: Oriental Steak
instructions: Cut steak in thin slices and brown. In a 2 qt. casserole put your pea pods mushrooms celery onions and meat after browning. Take what you browned meat in and add brown gravy mix and water cornstarch soy sauce and ginger root. When thickened pour over vegetables and meat. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-60 minutes. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Round Steak Supreme
instructions: Brown steak in 1 tablespoon shortening on both sides. Place in a shallow baking pan. Melt remaining 3 tablespoons shortening and add mushrooms onions and green pepper. Cook 5 minutes or just until soft but not browned. Blend in chili sauce tomato juice wine salt pepper garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce. Pour sauce over browned meat. Bake in hot oven 425 degrees for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 350 degrees. Cover and continue cooking about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Caramel Layer Bars
instructions: Combine flour salt soda brown sugar and oatmeal. Cut butter until particles are fine. Reserve 1 cup. Press remaining mixture in bottom of 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine caramel and cream in double boiler. Cook over hot water until melted. Blend in 2 Tbsp. flour and spread carefully over base. Sprinkle with chocolate chips then top with reserved crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes or until delicately browned. Makes about 24 bars.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple and place in bottom of greased 9 x 13 cake pan. Make 2nd layer of pie filling. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pie filling. Melt butter and pour over cake mix. Mix coconut and pecans and sprinkle over butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cover lightly with foil.

title: Betty'S Cracker Pudding
instructions: While warming the milk beat egg yolks and sugar until frothy. Add to hot milk and stir in crackers and coconut. Cook until thick. Remove from heat and add stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla. Cool. Serves 8.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put cherry pie filling in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add pineapple. Pour dry cake mix on top. Pour on butter. Top with nuts and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool. Garnish with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except chips). Place in a casserole dish and bake for 45 minutes. Top with crushed potato chips about 15 minutes before done.

title: Northern Beef Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; set aside. In same frypan brown beef after rolling in flour. Brown mushrooms onion and green pepper. Parboil carrots 10 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon flour 2 cups bouillon (undiluted) and chili sauce. Put all ingredients in casserole. Dice bacon; spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 2 hours or until tender. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: *Coconut Caramel Pie*(Recipe Makes Two Pies)
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet. Add coconut and chopped pecans. Cook until golden brown stirring frequently. Set mixture aside. Combine cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer 1/4 of cream cheese mixture in each pie shell. Drizzle caramel topping on each pie. Sprinkle 1/4 of coconut mixture on top. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients ending with coconut. Cover and freeze until firm. Let frozen pies stand at room temperature for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Sweet And Sour Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; crumble and put aside. Into the skillet with the bacon drippings put drained beans vinegar and sugar. Stir cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Turn occasionally. When ready to serve top the drained beans with the crumbled bacon. Serves 2 to 3.

title: Zucchini Bake
instructions: Place zucchini in water and boil until almost soft. Do not overcook. Saute onions in butter. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick spray. Place a layer of zucchini in pan then a thin layer of onions. Sprinkle with bread crumbs Parmesan cheese Mozzarella cheese and mushrooms. Cover with 1/2 of tomato sauce. Repeat all layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 40 minutes.

title: Citrus Simmered Steak
instructions: In large frypan brown meat in oil on both sides. Add mushrooms onion barbecue sauce lemon or orange juice soy sauce lemon or orange peel salt and thyme. Simmer covered 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is tender.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Heat milk and margarine. While milk and margarine are heating add vanilla and dry ingredients; mix well. Then add hot milk. Mix slowly. Bake in greased and floured pan or use Pam. Cool in pan 15 to 20 minutes before removing from pan. `Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes for layers. For tube pan bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cake can be cut in half for a smaller cake. Reduce each item exactly in half.

title: Black Bottom Pie
instructions: Soak gelatin in cold water. Scald milk. Combine sugar and cornstarch. Beat egg yolks until light. Stir scalded milk into egg yolks. Using a whisk slowly add sugar mixture. Cook in double boiler stirring until mixture heavily coats spoon approximately 20 minutes. Remove 1 cup custard and add melted chocolate. Add vanilla. Pour into pie crust.

title: No Fat Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese cottage cheese and taco seasoning together. Spread into 9 x 12-inch glass cake pan or on 2 large serving dishes. Top with chopped lettuce onions cheese tomatoes cauliflower broccoli or carrots and olives (optional). Use taco chips to dip into and eat.

title: Texas Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine everything except crushed chips. Put in a 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle with chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered.

title: Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt granulated sugar and 2 tablespoons of cocoa. Add milk shortening and vanilla. Mix only until smooth. Add pecans. Put in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

title: Mom'S Apple Crisp
instructions: Butter a baking dish. Fill with apples water and cinnamon. Work together remaining ingredients until crumbly. Spread over apple mixture. Bake for about thirty minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve with cream.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Chill. Roll into balls. Cover with pecans and pepper. Wrap in wax paper. Refrigerate. Serve on onion or Ritz crackers or use as a spread.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Well grease muffin pan or small iron frying pan. Mix cornmeal egg oil and milk together in medium bowl. May need to add more milk. Add onion if you like. When mixed well put in pan and bake until golden brown. Butter top and serve.

title: Betty Bridge'S Squash Casserole No. 4
instructions: Boil together the squash and onions in water to cover. When tender mash by beating with mixer or blender or processor. Add all other ingredients. Top with more cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in Pyrex dish.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Other seasoning may be added according to taste.

title: Orange Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Drain juice from oranges. Mix juice with dry jello and heat on stove and stir til dissolved. Bring to boil. Let cool. Stir pineapple into cooled jello mixture. Fold in Cool Whip then fold in cottage cheese and oranges. Chill in refrigerator about 5 hours. Best to make the day before. (Can use green lime jello instead of orange.)

title: Potato Puff
instructions: Boil potatoes; mash with electric mixer. Add cream cheese sour cream salt pepper and grated onion. Beat at high speed until smooth and light. Spoon into a greased casserole. Dust with paprika and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until golden and heated through.

title: One Cup Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in casserole dish. Mix flour sugar and milk. Pour over butter add fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Brisket On The Grill
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in butter until golden brown. Marinate the brisket in the 2 cups of sauces in a large pan in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator. Leave in same pan just add sauteed vegetables on top and cover with foil. Bake for 4 hours in oven. Then place on covered grill for 2 hours. You can use charcoal but natural wood coals work best.

title: Zippy Zucchini
instructions: Place zucchini and onion in 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish. Cover with plastic wrap turning one edge back slightly to vent. Microwave at High 7 minutes; drain.

title: Bonbons
instructions: Mix butter and milk well; add powdered sugar a little at a time. Add coconut and pecans; mix well. Roll into balls about the size of walnuts. Chill for 45 minutes. Dip with toothpicks into chocolate that has been melted with paraffin. Cool.

title: Creamy Asparagus Soup
instructions: In a heavy 3 or 4-quart saucepan cook onion and celery in margarine about 5 minutes stirring several times until softened. Add rice asparagus and broth. Cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes. Puree in batches in food processor or blender. Return to saucepan. Add milk and heat to boiling point. Season with nutmeg and pepper. Makes 6 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars shortening peanut butter and egg. Stir in flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough into 3/4 inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until set but not hard about 10 minutes. Cool slightly before removing from cookie sheet; cool completely.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Add to meat and cook.

title: Mexican Sauce
instructions: Cook onion green pepper and garlic slowly in butter until soft stirring often. Add flour salt and chili powder; stir until smooth. Add meat stock and tomatoes. Cook until thick and smooth. Strain if desired. Can be used over rice spaghetti noodles or various meats.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Sift the flour and soda together. Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs. Add milk and flour alternately. Last add fruit nuts and cinnamon. Drop from spoon on greased baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes. Makes about 120 cookies.

title: Raisin Honey Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix honey sugar and shortening until crumbly. Add egg and beat well. Mix flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Stir into egg mixture. Mix in the rolled oats and raisins.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: In saucepan combine soup water chicken and corn. Over medium heat heat through stirring often. Makes 2 servings.

title: Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Drain off excess grease. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and seasonings. Cover and let ground beef mixture simmer for approximately 30 minutes. Prepare elbow macaroni per package instructions. Mix macaroni into ground beef mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese (optional) and serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put the celery pepper and onions in the bottom of a long casserole dish. Spread the rice over this then the cream of chicken soup. Place chicken pieces on top of rice. Salt and pepper if desired. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours and 15 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Candy Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa butter and milk together. Add oatmeal vanilla and peanut butter. Stir until mixed well. Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan prepared with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes until knife comes out clean.

title: Five Hour Stew
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cover tightly. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 5 hours or may be cooked in slow cooker for 8 hours.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix together jello water blueberries crushed pineapple and pecans. When congealed add topping of cream cheese and sour cream by blending them well and putting on top of congealed jello. Chill.

title: Chocolate Haystacks
instructions: Melt chocolate morsels in microwave (be careful not to overcook chocolate). Then add peanuts and chow mein noodles. Mix well so peanuts and noodles are covered and coated. Drop on wax paper and let them harden.

title: Broccoli Amandine
instructions: In a large skillet over low heat saute almonds in butter until lightly brown stirring constantly. Remove and set aside in another dish. In the same skillet bring water and salt to a boil. Add broccoli. Cover and cook until crisp-tender. Drain well and put in a heated serving dish. Return almond butter mixture to skillet to heat. Pour over broccoli.

title: Cocoa Drop Cookies
instructions: Blend Crisco salt vanilla and cocoa. Add brown sugar gradually and cream well. Add egg and mix thoroughly. Sift flour and soda together. Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with milk mixing well. Add nuts and blend. Drop from tablespoon on baking sheets greased with Crisco. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen. Deliciously tender tasty cookies.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Heat soup and add to gelatin. Cool; add cream cheese and whip with electric mixer. Add remaining ingredients and mix again. Let set in 2-quart mold for several hours. Unmold; serve with crackers.

title: Black Walnut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar corn syrup and salt; mix well. Stir in butter vanilla and walnuts. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until silver knife comes out clean.

title: Basic Muffin Batter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixer bowl. Beat until moistened well. Fill muffin pans and bake about 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Pumpkin Dip
instructions: In small mixing bowl beat cream cheese and sugar until well blended. Add pumpkin syrup and cinnamon; beat until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve as dip with fruit and cookies. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Brown chicken breasts in skillet; add soups and onion. Simmer on top of stove until tender. Serve over rice low fat noodles or plain noodles.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate. Can be served warm or chilled.

title: Russian Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all together; keep in airtight container. Use 3 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup add hot water and serve hot or add ice.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Make Rice-A-Roni according to directions. Empty corn soup and Cheez Whiz into a bowl. Add cooked Rice-A-Roni. Stir and cook in microwave for 7 seconds.

title: Strawberry Rice Cream Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Meanwhile dissolve gelatin in heated strawberry juice. Gently stir strawberries into cream cheese mixture and add dissolved gelatin. Stir rice. Fold in whipped topping. Turn into pie shell and chill at least 2 hours.

title: Raisin Squares
instructions: Cook raisins in 3/4 cup water just to boiling point. Remove and drain water using 1/2 cup of liquid. Dissolve soda in 1/2 of the raisin water. Cream butter sugar and egg. Add flour to which salt and cinnamon is combined. Add raisin water alternately with a little flour mixture. Add vanilla last. Bake in 10 x 15-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or less.

title: Family Dinner Meat Dish
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Rinse in hot water again; set aside. Brown meat in oil with garlic and onion in a large skillet. When beef has started to brown add celery bell pepper tomato sauce liquid from mushrooms Italian seasoning salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring occasionally about 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a large shallow casserole. Alternate layers of noodles meat sauce and cheese ending with cheese. Arrange mushrooms on top. Bake about 30 minutes. Will serve 12.

title: Pork Chop-Fried Rice Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: In 1-quart casserole put the 1 3/4 cups water. Heat to boiling. Stir in the rice. Cover. Set aside.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Add water to make 1 1/4 cups liquid. In a medium saucepan over high heat bring to a boil. Stir in rice and salt. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Add pineapple and cherries. Chill thoroughly. Fold in marshmallows and whipped topping. Makes 8 servings.

title: Hot Fruit Casserole
instructions: Combine fruit cocktail peaches pineapple apricot halves bananas and dates in a buttered casserole. Melt oleo and sugar; pour over fruit and bake 1 hour uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serve hot. Good holiday side dish.

title: Bake Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon together. Place in baking dish. Put bacon over the top (bacon can be raw or if you prefer cooked and then broken over top). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; drain. Add taco seasoning according to directions on package. Add drained beans to meat and cook over low heat until beans are warm. In large bowl toss lettuce and tomatoes. Add beans and meat. Break up chips and mix with lettuce and meat. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Put all ingredients except nuts in a bowl. Mix very well and make into ball. Then roll in nuts (pecans or crushed cashews). Put in refrigerator and let set for 1/2 hour. Then serve with crackers.

title: Janice'S Orange Salad
instructions: Mix jello and hot water until dissolved. Add pineapple and buttermilk. Mix well. Place in gelatin mold and congeal.

title: Fiesta Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix until blended Cheez Whiz mayo and chili powder. Toss together chicken celery olives and onions. Add cheese mixture and toss until mixed.

title: Cookies While You Sleep
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat until stiff the egg whites salt and cream of tartar. Gradually add sugar. Add vanilla and almond extract. When mixture peaks fold in chocolate chips and nuts. Grease cookie sheet. Drop meringue by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Place in oven close door turn off the heat and leave until morning. Do not peek! Makes approximately 4 dozen. Store in an airtight container.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Put a layer of beef layer of refried beans layer of sour cream and layer of cheese. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Eat with chips.

title: Spinach Madeleine
instructions: Cook spinach and drain. Reserve liquor. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth (but not brown). Add liquids slowly constantly stirring. Cook until smooth and thick. Add seasonings and cheese. Stir until all melted. Combine spinach. This can be frozen and heated slowly before needed.

title: Ground Beef Chili
instructions: In a Dutch oven cook beef onion green pepper and celery over medium heat until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Drain. Stir in the beans tomato puree salsa tomatoes broth water seasonings and browning sauce if desired. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes or until chili reaches desired thickness. Garnish with chopped onion if desired. Yield 16 servings.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Grate onion. Add other ingredients and mix well.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs With Rice(About 10 Servings)
instructions: Beat eggs in soup and water with fork. Add ground beef and shape in about 40 meatballs. Combine remaining ingredients (except rice). Pour 1/2 mixture in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Brown meatball mixture in 10-inch skillet about 1/3 at a time. Remove and drain off fat. Add on top of sauerkraut in baking dish. Pour remaining sauerkraut mixture over meatballs. Cover with foil and bake at 325\u00b0 in oven for 20 minutes. Uncover bake 15 to 20 minutes longer. Serve over hot rice.

title: Noodle Bake Supreme
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Pour into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart oblong baking dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over noodle mixture then dust with paprika. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until hot. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hawaiian Grilled Chicken
instructions: Marinate boneless chicken breasts for 36 hours before grilling.

title: Peach And Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt dry pudding mix (not instant) egg and milk. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie plate. Place drained peaches on top. Mix cream cheese sugar and peach juice and spread over peaches about 1-inch away from edge of pan. Mix 1 tablespoon of sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Magic Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Set aside. Spray bottom of a Bundt pan with nonstick cooking spray and sprinkle 1/3 cup pecans in the bottom of the pan. Cut up 2 cans of biscuits into 1/4s. Put on top of pecans in Bundt pan. Pour 1/2 of the mixture in saucepan over biscuits. Put another 1/3 cup pecans on top. Cut up other 2 cans of biscuits and put on top. Pour remaining mixture over biscuits. Sprinkle remaining pecans on top and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Invert onto serving plate immediately (be careful; contents of pan will be hot!). Allow to cool. Serve warm.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain off grease. In separate pan prepare Rice-A-Roni by directions.\tStir in meat salsa and chili powder with rice and simmer for 5 minutes.\tArrange chips lettuce meat cheese and tomato. Add taco sauce if desired.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Wash 4 pt. jars and keep them hot until needed. Prepare lids per manufacturers directions. Wash beans; trim stem ends so beans are 1/2 inch shorter than jars. Combine water vinegar and pickling salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Keep hot. In each hot jar place 1 dill sprig 1 garlic clove and 1/8 tsp. red pepper flakes. Pack beans lengthwise in 1 jar at a time. Add hot vinegar mixture to cover leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Release trapped air by slipping a plastic knife between the beans and the side of the jar. Wipe jar rim with a clean damp cloth. Attach lid. Fill and close remaining jars. Process in a boiling water bath 5 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Mix next 3 ingredients. Pour in pan. Do not stir.\tPour in peaches. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Tots
instructions: Put pork chops in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour soup that has been mixed with a small amount of water over pork chops. Top with Tater Tots. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Top with cheese the last 3 to 5 minutes.

title: James Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly oil a baking tray and a 9 x 13 inch pan.

title: Chilies Rellenos Bake
instructions: Mix ingredients until uniform. Pour into a well greased 9 by 13 baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Shanghai Noodles With Spicy Meat Sauce
instructions: Cook and drain noodles. Put ground beef onion and garlic in large skillet and stir-fry until meat is brown. In small bowl combine 1/4 cup chicken broth hoisin sauce and beef broth. Stir into meat mixture. Cover reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes stirring once or twice. Dissolve cornstarch in remaining chicken broth. Slowly stir into meat mixture; cook until thick. Serve over hot noodles. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mexican Enchiladas
instructions: Dip tortillas into enchilada sauce. Place large spoonful of tortilla filling on each and roll up. Arrange in an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Cover with more enchilada sauce; sprinkle with remaining tortilla filling. Heat to 375\u00b0. Serve to 6 Mexicans.

title: Chocolate Caramel Dessert Bar
instructions: Mix cake mix water eggs brown sugar and butter until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips. Spread mixture in 9 X 13 pan. Bake at 375 for 24 - 27 minutes until toothpick comes out almost clean.

title: Texas Cake
instructions: Cream flour butter and pecans together; pat into 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Freeze for 1 hour. Mix cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip together. Spread over crust. Sprinkle with half of coconut. Prepare pudding by mixing with milk for 3 minutes. Spread over cheese layer. Top with Cool Whip and remaining coconut. Chill overnight.

title: Grape Butter
instructions: Into a large heavy kettle place grapes and sugar. Bring to a boil stirring often. Boil rapidly 20 minutes. Put hot mixture through a sieve. Ladle into jars and seal.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix eggs sugar pumpkin oil and water then add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Grease loaf pans and add mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Cookies
