instructions: Combine all ingredients and roll into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Put a pecan half in center of each ball and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Baked Mushrooms
instructions: Saute mushrooms in own juice. Set aside. Mix stuffing as directed on package. Set aside. Layer all ingredients in a 9 x 12-inch pan using 1/2 of each. Repeat layers. Dot with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Beef And Barley Mulligan
instructions: In large skillet cook ground beef with onion and ground pepper until meat is browned; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for about an hour or until barley is tender stirring occasionally. Serve with salad and fresh baked bread.

title: Strawberry Freeze
instructions: Place strawberries and Equal in a food processor or blender. Mix until coarsely chopped. With motor running gradually add evaporated skim milk. Mix until smooth. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix together and put in tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Venison Stew(Crock-Pot Style)
instructions: This is a cooks delight. In the morning just before going to work place the ingredients in your crock-pot and season with Morton Natures Seasons. When you return home your stew will be ready.

title: Five Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Note If large eggs are used only use 3/4 cup milk.

title: Baked Halibut Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease a flat baking dish preferably one that can be brought to the table. Place halibut steaks in a single layer in baking dish. In a small bowl blend together the sour cream Parmesan cheese dill weed salt pepper and butter. Cover fish with the sauce. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the fish loses its translucency. Sprinkle lightly with paprika and serve at once garnished with lemon wedges.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together until smooth. Refrigerate. Serve with assorted raw vegetables.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple water and salt to boiling point. Add jello and cream cheese. Stir until dissolved and set until firm. Top with topping and sprinkle with nuts or graham crackers.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add raisins; coat with flour. Add remaining ingredients; stir until well blended. Pour into greased and floured layer cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Soft Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg. Sift flour with baking powder soda cinnamon cloves and nutmeg. Mix in raisins and oats. Add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce and beat well. Drop with teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Kathy'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add pudding mix vanilla and eggs. Beat well. Stir in flour and soda mixed. Add chips. Bake on ungreased sheets for 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Crackles(Cookies)
instructions: Combine cake mix eggs water and shortening. Mix with a spoon until well blended. Shape dough into a ball the size of a small walnut. Roll balls in confectioners sugar. Place on greased baking sheets. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 48 cookies. These cookies made with cake mix have a moist fudge center.

title: Ripe Tomato Pickle
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pan. Cook 2 to 3 hours until desired consistency.\tPlace in jars and seal.

title: Yummy Yum Punch
instructions: Make Kool-Aid; pour into punch bowl. Add sherbet (1/2 gallon). Roll gently with plastic or wooden spoon (large). Pour in 7-Up 1 ginger ale and 1 bottle of club soda. Roll gently again with spoon and serve.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cheese and 2 T. margarine until smooth. Add next 6 ingredients and mix well. Separate dough into 4 rectangles. Firmly press perforations to seal. Spoon 1/2 c. meat onto center of each rectangle. Pull four corners of rectangles to center of chicken mixture. Twist slightly and seal edges. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush edges with reserved margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 - 25 minutes or until browned. Serves 4.

title: Cinnamon Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add cinnamon and water. Cook over medium heat until thickened and transparent. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and eggs until light. Spoon flour into dry measuring cup. Add soda and salt to flour. Stir to blend. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with banana and lemon juice. Stir until all ingredients are moistened. Stir in nuts. Spread in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan immediately. Cool on rack.

title: Cinnamon Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except the brown sugar and cinnamon. In separate container mix together brown sugar and cinnamon. Grease and flour Bundt cake pan. Sprinkle 1/3 of brown sugar-cinnamon mix in bottom of cake pan. Pour 1/2 of batter over brown sugar-cinnamon mixture. Sprinkle 1/3 more brown sugar-cinnamon mixture on batter. Pour remaining cake batter in\tpan and top with remaining brown sugar-cinnamon mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes and 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Butter Fried
instructions: Cut zucchini in 1/4-inch slices. Dip in eggs and flour. Put 1/2 cup butter in skillet over medium. Turn over when browned. Sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning. Add butter as needed to skillet.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar butter Crisco and vanilla. Add eggs and flour alternately with 7-Up. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in a tube pan. Check cake at 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Vegetable Pouches
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon oil around top of a preheated wok coating sides. Heat on high for 1 minute. Add carrot and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add cabbage and cook stirring constantly 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in greens and next 6 ingredients. Mix cornstarch and water stirring until smooth; add to cabbage mix. Cook stirring constantly 1 minute or until thickened. Let cool.

title: Egg Noodles
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add water salt and flour. Roll paper thin and cut thin strips. Can be cooked immediately frozen or kept in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Mix first four ingredients until crumbly. Press in bottom of unbuttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Combine all remaining ingredients and beat well. Pour over crust. Then combine 1/2 cup pecans 1/2 cup brown sugar and 2 tablespoons melted butter together. Sprinkle over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until it sets.

title: Wedding Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and 1/2 cup sugar until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and flour. Continue beating until well mixed. Stir in nuts. Cover. Chill dough 1 hour. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar. Cool completely then roll in sugar again. Makes 3 dozen. Can freeze up to 3 months.

title: Speedy Beet Sauce
instructions: Cook for 5 minutes. Pour over 1 dozen small beets. Add 2 teaspoons of butter before serving.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix together. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done. Cool and cut.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir together the peanuts sugar corn syrup and salt in 8-cup measure. Place in microwave and cook on High 7 to 8 minutes stirring well after 4 minutes. (Wooden spoon can be left in bowl.) Add butter and vanilla to syrup blending well. Return to microwave and cook 1 minute more. Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot. Add baking soda and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour and spread mixture quickly onto lightly greased (flexible) cookie sheet; let cool 1/2 hour.

title: Crispy Crunch Bars
instructions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with foil. Butter the foil. In a large saucepan melt marshmallows and 3 tablespoons butter or margarine over low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Stir in half of the cereal at a time. Fold in raisins peanuts sunflower seeds nuts or snipped gumdrops if desired. Turn mixture into prepared pan. Press evenly with the back of wooden spoon or with buttered hands. Cool; cut into bars. Makes 24 bars.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix together flour brown sugar baking soda salt and cinnamon. Add oil and water. Stir well. Add eggs and carrots. Beat well. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Creamy White Chili
instructions: In a large saucepan saut chicken onion and garlic powder in oil until chicken is no longer pink. Add beans broth chilies and seasonings. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in sour cream and whipping cream. Serve immediately. Makes 7 servings.

title: Vanilla Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a saucepan mix white sugar brown sugar and milk. Cook 1 1/2 minutes. After it boils add peanut butter walnuts and Marshmallow Fluff; mix well. Pour into large 13 x 9 x 2-inch lightly greased pan. Cool.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix fat and peanut butter. Add both kinds of sugar (one at a time) and beat well. Beat in eggs. Sift flour salt and soda together. Stir into peanut butter mixture. Drop by teaspoons onto baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Layer sauerkraut and noodles in bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish. Crumble corned beef on top then cheese. Mix crumbs with butter. Sprinkle on top. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hash Brown Au Gratin
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put into 9x13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 to 1-1/4 hours.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Chicken
instructions: Dip washed and dried chicken in melted butter. Dredge in bowl of dressing mix the cheese and crumbs. Bake uncovered in well-greased baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden. Serves 4.

title: Savory Egg And Sausage Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer sausage mushrooms onions tomatoes and cheese in dish. Stir remaining ingredients until blended. Pour over cheese. Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and set. Makes 12 servings.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown ground beef and mix with other ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in covered dish.

title: Pumpkin Crunch Cake
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with wax paper. Melt butter or margarine; cool. Mix together and pour into the lined pan the pumpkin evaporated milk sugar cinnamon and eggs. Sprinkle yellow cake mix over mixture. Sprinkle chopped nuts. Pour melted butter over all. Bake in a 350\u00b0\toven for 1 hour. After its baked wait about 5 to 10 minutes then turn over while hot onto a serving tray. It may be a little soft when hot but hardens as it cools. Top with Cool Whip when cool or before serving.

title: Lemon Pecan Cake
instructions: Mix and let set in tube pan overnight. Bake at 275 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Put 1 tablespoon pineapple juice over cheese in saucepan over low heat until melted and completely cooled. Whip the cream and add remaining ingredients.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix and add to other ingredients. Hand beat until all are mixed well. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 20 minutes in 13 1/2 x 9-inch pan. Check for doneness with a straw.

title: Orange Fluff Salad
instructions: Put cottage cheese and crushed pineapple in bowl. Sprinkle powdered Jell-O over top. Stir well. Stir in Cool Whip.

title: Happy Home Recipe
instructions: Take Love and Loyalty; mix thoroughly with Faith. Blend with Tenderness kindness understanding and Forgiveness. Add Friendship and Hope; sprinkle abundantly with Laughter. Bake with Sunshine. Serve daily with generous helpings.

title: Date And Nut Bread
instructions: Pour water over dates. Add next four ingredients. Mix and let cool a little. When cooled add flour baking powder and nuts. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Let rise (set) for 20 minutes. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) about 1 hour.

title: Festive Roast Duck
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix apples parsley celery and leaves shallots and juniper berries. Stiff ducks with mixture and sew up cavity.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and margarine. Add eggs; mix well. Place pecans in unbaked pie shell. Pour in filling. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until center is set.

title: Quick Baked Pasta
instructions: Saute garlic and beef in oil. Drain fat. Add all remaining stuff except mozzarella and pasta. Simmer while boiling pasta. Drain pasta and mix with above. Pour into 3 quart baking dish and top with mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: No Crust Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Place all into a bowl; blend well. Spoon into a lightly greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes until lightly brown. Cool. Top with whipped cream.

title: Rhubarb-Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Cook rhubarb sugar and water until tender. Remove from heat. Add jello and stir until dissolved. Pour into serving dish and chill. Top with Cool Whip if desired.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Quarter biscuits and shake in a large bowl with cinnamon and sugar. (Let this sit while dissolving other ingredients then shake again.) Dissolve brown sugar and margarine. When dissolved add nuts. Grease a Bundt pan. Then place 1/2 biscuits in pan. Pour 1/2 dissolved mixture over them and then add remaining biscuits and mixture. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Combine ingredients as listed. Turn into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. (This is a good way to use a large amount of extra zucchini from your garden; good for a light summer supper or brunch.)

title: Pancakes For A Crowd
instructions: Beat eggs. Add milk. Add dry ingredients and oil. Mix well. Yields 85 servings.

title: Texoma Beans
instructions: Cook pinto beans. Saute onions and garlic with the ground beef. Mix all other ingredients into this mixture; add to the cooked beans and cook all together until the flavors are well blended.

title: French Lemon Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix all. Add lemon juice last. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use 8-inch pie pan.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Combine crumbs cheese salt and pepper. Dip chicken in melted margarine then in cracker crumbs being sure to coat each piece heavily. Place chicken in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes uncovered. Do not turn chicken.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain salmon; remove skin and bones and flake into a bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Shape into a loaf and place in a well-buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until the top is a delicate golden brown and loaf is firm but still moist and tender. Serve as is or with sauce.

title: Crystal Garden
instructions: Place the water bluing salt and ammonia in a jar and stir thoroughly. Set the coal or briquettes in an old pie tin in a single layer. Pour the solution on top. Put several drops of food coloring on coal (or briquettes) leaving some areas plain. Set it in a quiet place. The next day you will see gorgeous crystal-formations.

title: Ice Cream Salad
instructions: Let Jell-O set until it is almost jelled. Add the cream cheese nuts cherries and pineapple. Fold in the ice cream. Chill several hours.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Beat in flour sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Blend in melted butter. Stir in chocolate morsels and walnuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake 1 hour. Remove from oven. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix and cook the sugar milk cocoa and salt on heat until soft ball stage. Take off fire and cool enough to hold in hands. Beat and add the vanilla butter marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Pour into buttered greased pan.

title: Low-Fat Pudding Frosting
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients slowly until well blended. Fold in whipped topping.

title: Deep Dish Chicken Pie
instructions: Mash potatoes with milk oleo salt pepper and nutmeg until light and fluffy. In another large bowl mix remaining ingredients. Turn this mixture into a deep 4-inch pie plate. Cover with the mashed potatoes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Home Made Boursin Cheese
instructions: Blend all ingredients and chill for 24 hours before serving.

title: Pumpkin Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese powder sugar pumpkin pie filling and ginger together until well blended. Serve on ginger snaps.

title: Shrimp And Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream soup and Miracle Whip in bowl. Chop shrimp and add. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs. Beat well. Combine flour salt and soda. Add to oil mixture. Stir in vanilla apples coconut and walnuts. Mix well. Spoon batter into 9-inch tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake is done.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place chicken in pan with a little water and bake 30 minutes. Prepare sauce by melting butter and adding onion and browning lightly. In another bowl mix mustard and catsup then add all other ingredients. Pour into pan with butter and onion and bring to a boil and simmer at least 5 minutes. When chicken has baked 30 minutes pour sauce over chicken and bake another 30 minutes. Drain chicken before adding sauce.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken in water and keep the broth to cook spaghetti in. Add more water if necessary. Cook the spaghetti to soak up all of the water into the noodles. In frying pan melt butter. Saute bell pepper onion mushrooms and olives until tender. Add Ro-Tel to mixture. Add mushroom soup. Stir. Cut Velveeta and add to mixture and blend thoroughly. Add 3/4 of the Cheddar cheese to mixture. Stir mixture into noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheddar-Squash Bake
instructions: Cook squash until tender 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and sprinkle with salt. Set aside a few slices for garnish. Mix sour cream egg yolks and flour; fold in egg whites. In a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish put half the squash then 1/2 the egg mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 the cheese. Layer remaining squash egg mixture and cheese. Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over top. Top with bacon and parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Seafood Pizza Spread
instructions: Drain crabmeat (if using canned). Blend cream cheese lemon juice Worcestershire sauce mayonnaise onion and garlic powder. Spread on a round serving plate. Spread cocktail sauce over cream cheese. Sprinkle shredded crabmeat and shrimp on top. Refrigerate several hours before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Pour over salad and chill at least 1 hour.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Mix 1/2 cake and 1/3 cup evaporated milk together. Press in bottom of a greased pan (13 x 9-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Melt caramels with remaining milk stirring until smooth. Add margarine; mix well. Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over cake. Pour caramel mixture over spreading to edge of pan. Sprinkle remaining cake mix over top pressing into caramel mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool slightly. Refrigerate. Cut into bars.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Combine yogurt or sour cream mayonnaise cream cheese and seasoning. Mix well then stir in Cheddar cheese and crab. Cover 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve with crackers bread sticks or vegetables.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Shrimp
instructions: Cut bacon in half; wrap bacon around the shrimp. Secure with wooden toothpick. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour teriyaki sauce over shrimp. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until bacon is crisp.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix together and pour into oiled loaf pans. Makes 2 loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Poor House Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg. Mix together flour salt and baking soda. Add this to butter-sugar mixture. Add chopped nuts on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Bev'S Vegetable Spread
instructions: After grating and chopping vegetables use paper towels to press out excess liquid. Mix all ingredients. Spread on white sandwich bread with crusts trimmed. Cut into quarters or triangles. (Bread may need a thin spread of mayonnaise.)

title: Crab-Broccoli Bisque
instructions: Saute butter and onion until transparent. Add flour half and half and milk. Stir until thick. May thicken with cornstarch if preferred. Add pepper crab meat and broccoli and heat thoroughly. Add grated Parmesan cheese just before serving. Top with croutons or oyster crackers. May serve with warm crusty French bread.

title: Beef Tips On Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot and simmer all day. Prepare rice as directed on package.

title: Overnight Salad
instructions: Mix and chill overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butters and sugars until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs mix well. add dry ingredients. Then add chocolate chips. Roll into 2 inch balls and put onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10-12 minutes. About 10 dozen cookies. They go fast so youll need this big of a batch.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender. Chop it and the hard-boiled eggs. Soften the gelatine with cold water and melt into the heated consomme. Add this to the first mixture fold in mayonnaise. Season in amounts prescribed. Mold until firm. Serves 10 people.

title: 1, 2, 3, 4 Layer Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Beat 350 strokes by hand. Bake at 325\u00b0 in three (3) greased pans (round).

title: Crystal Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers. Put in a stone jar. Put a brine over them made of 2 cups coarse salt to 1 gallon of water. Dont boil the brine. Place a plate over the pickles with a weight on it to hold the pickles in the brine. Leave them for 2 weeks and skim the brine off every day. When you take them out drain and wash. Slice or chunk as desired and cover with cold water to which has been added 2 tablespoons alum. Let stand 24 hours; drain and wash. Make syrup.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix bulk pork sausage eggs and soft bread crumbs. Using palms of hands shape into meatballs. Saute in frying pan until browned on all sides; drain. Combine catsup brown sugar white wine vinegar and soy sauce. Pour over meatballs and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Shake
instructions: Blend and pour into tall glass.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Combine cabbage wedges and water in a large saucepan; cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes. Drain well and place cabbage wedges in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat. Add flour stirring until smooth. Cook over low heat 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Stir in salt and pepper. Pour mixture over cabbage and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Combine cheese mayonnaise chili sauce onion and green pepper. Stir well and spread over cabbage. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Cut cucumbers unpeeled in 3/8-inch slices. Dissolve pickling lime in cold water. Soak cucumbers in cold water solution 24 hours. Rinse cucumbers well and soak in clear water 3 hours. Dissolve the sugar in vinegar. Add salt cloves celery seed and pickling spices. Soak cucumbers in vinegar solution overnight. Cook on stove 35 minutes or until slices are clear. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Crumble very fine. Add tomato soup and chili powder to taste. Simmer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water. Cream the cream cheese and add along with gelatin to heated soup. Allow mixture to cool. Add mayo celery onions and seasonings. Let stand in refrigerator until thickened about 5 minutes. Add shrimp. Place in well oiled mold and chill until firm. Serve with crackers.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: *All chopped very fine.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white with water until frothy; coat pecans. Add sugar cinnamon and salt mixture. Bake on buttered cookie sheet in 225\u00b0 oven for 1 hour tossing every 15 minutes.

title: Cream Of Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix according to directions on box in a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan. While cake is still warm pour can of condensed milk over cake. (Pole holes in cake so milk will go into cake.) Let cool. Mix Cool Whip cream of coconut and 1/2 bag flaked coconut together. Pour over cooled cake. Add remaining coconut to top of frosting. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Fold dry pudding mix into whipped topping. Add pineapple and juice. Add marshmallows and nuts. Mix and pour into pan. Refrigerate until set.

title: Spicy Pecans
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine the egg white and water. Add the nuts. Mix well. In a small bowl combine the sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle the sugar mix over the nuts mixing well until the nuts are coated.

title: Black Bean Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover and refrigerate 8 hours. Drain liquids. Serve with tortilla chips. Yields 3 cups.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Put in a saucepan over low heat 1/4 cup margarine; add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Add Rice Krispies; stir until well coated. Using buttered spatula or waxed paper press mixture evenly into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes. Mix with soup sour cream onion oleo 1 cup cheese and salt and pepper to taste. Pour into a well-greased baking dish (9 x 13 x 2-inch). Bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 8 servings. Each has 243 calories 14 gr fat and 33 mg cholesterol.

title: Quick Crescent Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven at 375\u00b0. Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread rolls over bottom and 1/2-inch up side closing all holes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Pour combined ingredients over partially baked crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Orange Sherbet
instructions: Mix well and pour into can of ice cream freezer. Freeze until freezer stops or if you use hand-turned freezer until firm.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Keeps in refrigerator but separates. Shake well. Makes 1 quart.

title: Jiffy Creamy Corn Pudding
instructions: Starting with muffin mix stir in all ingredients. When thoroughly blended bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Simple but delicious.

title: Zucchini Crisp
instructions: Peel zucchini. Slice lengthwise in half remove seeds and cube. Place zucchini in a large skillet with the lemon juice. Cover and cook until zucchini becomes transparent and soft (about 15 to 25 minutes). Add sugar and cinnamon. Simmer for 2 minutes. Add 1/2 of remaining crumb mixture to zucchini. This will thicken it. Spread zucchini onto baked crust. Sprinkle remaining half of crumb mixture on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Tastes like apple pie.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Rinse beans with cold water and drain. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish combine beans with peppers corn tomatoes dip Cheddar chili powder and cumin. In a medium bowl stir together the cornbread mix egg substitute skim milk and oil. Spoon evenly over bean mixture. Bake until heated through and cornbread topping is lightly browned 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Add cranberry sauce and soy sauce. Mix well over medium heat. Place chicken in a baking pan. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Orange Cupcakes
instructions: Put softened butter sugar and orange rind of orange into food processor and process until soft. Add egg and segments of orange and process until smooth. Add orange juice and cranberries and process until the cranberries are coarsely chopped.

title: Homemade Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Coat an 8-inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cook the macaroni according to the package directions until firm; drain and set aside. In a large saucepan melt the butter over low heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Add the milk salt and pepper and cook over medium heat until the mixture starts to bubble stirring occasionally. Remove the mixture from the heat and add 2 cups cheese stirring until melted. Add the macaroni; mix well then pour into the baking dish. Top with the remaining 1/4 cup cheese and sprinkle with the bread crumbs. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the mixture is bubbly and the top is golden.

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Cream butter blend in sugar egg yolk and vanilla. By hand mix in flour 2/3 cup Heath bits and nuts. Press into ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Never Fail Fluffy Frosting
instructions: Put all ingredients in top of double boiler. Have water in bottom part hot or almost boiling. Begin to beat with mixer at once. Beat until desired thickness. Spread on cool cake. Enough for a 2 layer (9-inch) cake.

title: Granola
instructions: Mix first five ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add melted margarine and vanilla. Stir. Spread evenly on a 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir after 15 minutes. Add raisins after baking and sprinkle over top of granola.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and bacon; add other ingredients. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Freezes good.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat in butter. Add tomato sauce salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer until meat is tender. Mix cornstarch and water until smooth. Stir into meat mixture. Cover and cook 10 more minutes stirring to keep from sticking. Cool slightly and stir in sour cream. Serve over flat noodles.

title: Potatoes In Salsa(Serves 4)
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes 1/2 inch thick. Mince onion and garlic and saute gently in oil; add flour. Add potatoes and seasonings. Cover with water; cover pan and simmer slowly for 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Cracker Jack
instructions: Combine sugar syrup margarine and cream of tartar. Bring to a hard boil. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda. Pour over corn. Place in large roaster; bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir occasionally.

title: Millionaire Salad
instructions: Drain artichoke hearts hearts of palm olives pimentos and red peppers. Place with sliced mushrooms in a large glass container with lid. Combine other ingredients. Marinate vegetables in oil mixture overnight. Remove veggies from marinade with slotted spoon. Serve chilled in lettuce-lined bowl.

title: Rainy Day Vegetable Soup
instructions: Mix beef bones garlic clove salt barley celery tops and chopped onion in 2 quarts of water in kettle. Cover and simmer 3 hours. Skim soup; remove bones and meat. Add tomatoes. Melt butter in skillet; slightly cook carrots green beans potatoes and cabbage for 7 minutes stirring often. Add to soup. Cover; simmer for 20 minutes. Add peas and meat (cut into bite size pieces). Season with salt and pepper. Serve. Makes 5 quarts.

title: Carrot Pecan Crunch Pie
instructions: Puree carrots in a blender or food processor until smooth. Carrots should measure 2 cups. Set aside. Combine eggs sweetened condensed milk pumpkin spice and salt. Add carrots and mix well. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell. To make a topping combine the last 3 ingredients and mix well. Sprinkle evenly over pie. Cover the crust of pie with foil to prevent overbrowning and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove foil. Continue to bake for 20 to 25 more minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 8 servings.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. In a 2 1/2-quart baking dish mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours covered.

title: Mexicali Meat Pie
instructions: Brown the ground beef and drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into 8-inch baking dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar oleo and evaporated milk in heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan. Bring to a full boil stirring constantly to prevent scorching (boiling 5 minutes over medium heat). Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate pieces until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme nuts and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Pour into 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Cool room temperature. Cut into squares. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Lemon-Cheese Tarts
instructions: Beat eggs in top of double boiler until thick and fluffy. Continue beating while gradually adding sugar lemon juice and rind. Place over hot water and cook stirring constantly until custard is thick and smooth. Cool slightly. Gradually blend custard into cream cheese and when smooth fill tart shells. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Prepare crust of your choice. Stir together first 4 ingredients; mix with apples. Turn into crust; dot with butter. Cover with top crust that has slits cut in it; seal and flute. Cover edge with 2 to 3 inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning; remove foil last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Decorating Icing
instructions: Beat 5 minutes. Increase speed on mixer. Used for decorating wedding cakes. Very good icing.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine 3/4 cup flour and salt with pastry blender or two knives. Cut in 3 tablespoons margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add yogurt and mix thoroughly. Form dough into ball and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Exotic Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach in small quantity of water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine with dry soup mix and sour cream. Pour into casserole dish. Cover with crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Sunday Steak
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut steak in serving size pieces. Pour oil in skillet. Roll steak in flour and brown on both sides. Remove to baking dish. Add onions to skillet and brown lightly. Add rest of ingredients to make sauce. Simmer a few minutes and pour over browned meat. Bake in covered baking dish until tender about 3 hours.

title: Michigan Cherry Torte
instructions: Make cake according to package directions. Let cool. In a 9 x 13-inch pan crumble cake. Pour pudding over cake. Spread evenly with pie filling and chill. Mix whipped topping and spread evenly over pie filling. Cover and chill until serving.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken and save 2 quarts of broth. Saute onions and bell peppers. Cook vermicelli in broth saved; dont drain. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce; cook 3 or 4 minutes. Add drained peas mushrooms onions and peppers. Add cheese cut in chunks and stir until cheese is melted. Add cut-up chicken and stir thoroughly. Cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: Hamburger And Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water. Cook hamburger and onions together until done. Drain macaroni and put in casserole dish.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Saute pepper and onion strips in a small amount of oil until tender. Add hamburger and cook until brown. Then add sugar and vinegar. Stir. Add can of tomato sauce and stir. Heat on low for 10 minutes. Serve on buns.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together cream butter shortening and sugar. Add other ingredients (eggs one at a time and beat after each one) before adding dry ingredients alternately with milk. Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Freezer Green Beans
instructions: Use large pot. Place frozen beans from freezer in pot. After peeling onion cut in several pieces and place in pot. Open can of round potatoes and place in pot. Add the country cured ham. Pour water in pot. Cook on medium to medium-high for approximately 1 hour. Watch closely and check to see if salt is needed. Some salt will come from ham.

title: Main Dish Potato Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing mustard celery seed salt and pepper; mix well. Add potatoes broccoli cheese ham eggs celery onion and pickles. Mix lightly. Chill.

title: Do Ahead Breakfast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 baking pan. Arrange bread slices in two layers.

title: Beefy Spanish Rice
instructions: In a large skillet cook ground beef onion green pepper and garlic until the meat is browned; drain. Stir in the next eight ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender. Stir in tomato paste and heat through. Serve with French bread. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Refrigerator Relish
instructions: Chop vegetables. Mix sugar vinegar and oil together; pour over vegetables and eat and enjoy. This will keep in the refrigerator for days.

title: Basic Mayonnaise
instructions: Put egg seasonings vinegar lemon juice and 1/4 cup oil into blender. Process on whip; remove feeder cap and pour in rest of oil in a steady stream. Turn blender off and use rubber spatula to remove from blender.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into pie shell. Bake for 10 minutes at 425\u00b0 then reduce to 350\u00b0 and cook 30 to 40 minutes until firm.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Toss broccoli onion and raisins together. Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar and let stand 10 to 15 minutes to allow sugar to dissolve. Pour dressing over broccoli and toss. Refrigerate until just prior to serving. Before serving add bacon cheese and nuts and toss again.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter over low heat. Blend in sugar. Cool. Stir in egg flour powder and salt. Mix in vanilla and nuts. Spread in well greased square pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Do not over-bake!

title: The Ultimate Dip
instructions: Spread a layer of cream cheese on the bottom of a microwave-safe dish. Cover completely with chili and top with Cheddar cheese. Microwave on High for two minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve warm with plenty of corn chips.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
instructions: Brown onion lightly in oil. Add chicken soup milk Cheez Whiz pimentos cooked chicken and the cooked spaghetti. (Can be topped with shredded cheese if desired and cooked at 375\u00b0 for about 25 minutes). I make mine in iron skillet. After you mix all the ingredients just simmer until its as thick as you desire.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Mix sugar and butter in mixer until fluffy. Add eggs and continue to beat. Add flour a cup at a time. Mix until mixer wont mix anymore. Then add remaining flour by mixing with your hands. Roll in logs. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Cut log in sections and roll as thin as possible on floured surface. Cut in desired shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Drain. Mix with margarine egg and Parmesan. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with cottage cheese then spaghetti sauce. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Remove cover and top with Mozzarella. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Tear bread into pieces. Place in a 3 x 9-inch greased baking dish. Brown and drain 1 pound sausage. Drain and spoon over bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat eggs milk mustard salt and pepper. Pour over mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mabel'S Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients and sift. Add shortening and cut in with pastry blender. Add buttermilk all at once and mix with a fork until dough follows fork. Add just enough flour to work until able to roll out.

title: Chicken Marengo
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Brown chicken. Pour off oil. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover. Cook over low heat 45 minutes or until tender. Stir now and then. Uncover. Cook until desired consistency. Serve with buttered noodles. Serves 6.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Add raisins. In a separate bowl mix egg water vanilla and oil well. Make a well in the dry ingredients and add the liquid mixture. Mix well. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Blond Brownies
instructions: Mix well flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Melt butter. Add sugar and mix well. Beat egg and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture then nuts. Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown onions and garlic in shortening. Add meat and brown. Drain. Add salt sauce water chili powder and beans (drained and washed). Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix pie filling with 3 tablespoons Tang and mix with pineapple juice. Mix in fruit. Let chill.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix coloring and cocoa and set aside. Cream butter sugar and eggs. Sift flour and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk. Mix vinegar and baking soda and add to mixture. Add vanilla and coloring mixture. Put in greased pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except the corn flake crumbs and the 1/4 cup melted butter together.

title: Chocolate Mint Bars
instructions: Mix in order given and put into a greased 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well; let stand in refrigerator at least 10 to 12 hours. Makes 1 quart.

title: Frozen Pops
instructions: Dissolve Jello Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water. Add cold water; stir. Makes 14 (3-ounce) paper cups. Freeze and enjoy.

title: Orange Sherbet Party Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Add cold water. Combine juices and add to Jell-O mixture. Chill. Spoon sherbet into punch and add ginger ale just before serving. Serves 40.

title: Greek Tortellini Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine cooked pasta peppers onion and olives.

title: Apple-Walnut Cake
instructions: Mix apples and sugar. Let stand while mixing other ingredients. Mix eggs oil and vanilla. Add to apple mixture. Mix dry ingredients and walnuts into apple mixture. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Oven Potatoes
instructions: Amounts of ingredients are not listed as you may add any amount you desire according to your individual taste.

title: Cinnamon Graham Crackers
instructions: Spread whole graham crackers over a cookie sheet. Melt together margarine and brown sugar. Add nuts to this mixture. Spread mixture over graham crackers. Bake for 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Take out of oven and place on wax paper. Break apart for serving.

title: Olive Mccready'S Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mash potatoes with mixer. Add butter and rest of ingredients; top with topping and bake in greased pan. Cook for 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Oatmeal Crunchies(Diabetic)
instructions: Cream margarine and brown sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Combine flour Equal salt and baking soda; blend into egg and margarine mixture. Then stir in oats. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients; cook until thick. Let cool. Peel and dice the apples; mix with 1/2 cup chopped peanuts. Pour cooled mixture over apple mixture. Mix in the Cool Whip. Top with 1/2 cup chopped Spanish peanuts. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Frozen Strawberry Margarita Pie
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and oleo in a small bowl. Press into bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate. Beat condensed milk lime juice tequila and Triple Sec in a large bowl with mixer on medium speed for 3 minutes or until smooth. Lower speed; beat in strawberries and syrup for 1 minute. Fold whipped cream into strawberry mixture until no streaks of white remain.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine peanut butter Crisco light brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Add egg; beat just until blended.

title: Pizza Rounds
instructions: Brown both meats together over medium heat in skillet. Add the onion spices and then the cheese. Heat and mix until cheese melts. Top each slice of cocktail rye with a tablespoon of mixture. Freeze on cookie sheets. Once frozen you can freeze in Ziploc bags or plastic containers.

title: Baked Spiced Peaches
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange peaches cut side up in 1-quart shallow casserole dish. Combine syrup brown sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour over peaches. Sprinkle with corn flakes and dot with margarine. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Pasta E Fagioli(Pasta And Bean Soup)
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan heat oil over high heat; add onions celery and garlic and saute until onions are translucent. Add tomatoes and cook stirring constantly for 1 to 2 minutes; add water and kidney beans and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook until beans are tender 20 to 30 minutes. Add zucchini carrots green beans and peppers to soup and stir to combine. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender about 15 minutes. Stir in ditalini basil parsley and salt; cover and cook until macaroni is just al dente about 8 minutes. Serve each portion sprinkled with 1/2 ounce cheese. Yield 4 servings.

title: One Pan Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease the bottom of loaf pan 9 x 5 x 3-inch. Stir all ingredients in pan with fork until moistened. Beat vigorously 1 minute. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean 55 to 65 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and squeeze water from spinach. Mince onion. Chop water chestnuts. Blend ingredients. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Hollow out round loaf of bread to form bowl for dip. Serve with crackers.

title: Amish Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix thoroughly the oil egg mustard salt and 1/3 cup sugar. Set aside. Over low heat blend flour 1/3 cup sugar vinegar and water. Bring to a boil stirring constantly until thickened. Combine well with first mixture. Makes 3 cups. Tastes like Marzetti slaw dressing. Good with cabbage or any dish you want to have a sweet and sour taste.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook fresh broccoli until tender. Chop it up and put in a 1-quart casserole bowl. Add your 1 cup of cooked rice to broccoli. On stove melt butter and cook onion until tender. Mix in cream of mushroom soup and stir mixture together. Pour over broccoli and rice. Put cheese on top and cook for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together while pumpkin is warm. Use electric mixer. Pour in 2 brown pie shells. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt together the butter peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over Crispix cereal. Coat with powdered sugar. Lay out flat to dry 5 minutes.

title: Dinner Potatoes With Herbs
instructions: Choose uniform potatoes scrub and pare. Roll in flour which has been seasoned with salt pepper and herbs fresh or dried. Place in buttered casserole dish and dot with butter. Add bay leaf and garlic. Cover and bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Orange French Toast
instructions: Combine eggs and orange juice. Dip bread in egg mixture then into crumbs. Pan-fry in butter until lightly brown. Serve with your favorite syrup or honey.

title: Irish Kisses
instructions: To your favorite butter frosting add mint extract and green food coloring to your liking.

title: Mama'S Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream together butter and shortening; add sugar and eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and add with milk to other ingredients. Add vanilla and mix well. Bake for about 80 minutes.

title: Chicken - Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Cook chicken in 1 tablespoon of the margarine about 10 minutes. Remove from pan. In the remaining margarine cook onion mushrooms and garlic until onion is tender. Stir in the soup milk and pepper. Heat to boiling then add chicken and cook on low for 5 minutes. Mix with noodles and serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine the cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Mix until blended add remaining ingredients. Roll into ball. Chill roll in pecans.

title: French Baked Squash
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. In medium saucepan bring 2 quarts water to a boil. Add squash and zucchini. Cook 3 to 4 minutes or until almost crisp-tender. Drain. In 10 inch skillet cook bacon until crisp. Remove with slotted spoon and reserve. Add onion to bacon drippings. Cook and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes. Drain off drippings. Add reserved bacon soup red pepper salt and pepper. Mix well. Remove from heat. Fold in vegetables. Transfer to 2 quart baking dish. Cover with foil. Bake 30 minutes. Remove foil. Sprinkle with cheese. Place under broiler to lightly brown cheese if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Mix ingredients together as for a pie crust. Press into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Frost while warm with chocolate frosting. Cut immediately into squares.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Generously grease Bundt pan with butter. In plastic bag mix sugars and cinnamon. Shake a few biscuits at a time in plastic bag and place in Bundt pan. Spread remaining sugar on top. Melt butter and pour on top.

title: Barbecue Pork Sandwiches
instructions: In a large pot combine all ingredients except 1 teaspoon sweet pickle relish. Cover and simmer for about 4 hours or until meat falls apart easily. Skim off any excess fat. Remove meat from liquid; shred and return to liquid and heat through. Serve on hamburger rolls with sweet pickle relish for each sandwich.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Heat brown sugar and butter until sugar dissolves. Add carrots (already cooked) and dash of cinnamon. Turn carrots until well glazed and tender about 12 minutes.

title: Terry'S Favorite Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat with onions; drain. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain macaroni and return to pot. Add meat. Stir in tomatoes soup tomato paste and sour cream. Transfer to a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with shredded cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until hot through and bubbly.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel eggplant; cook in small amount of water until tender. Drain. Mash with potato masher. Add other ingredients and top with grated cheese.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a dry container (sealed).

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream margarine with sugar and add buttermilk. Add eggs beating after each. Add vanilla and coconut. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Perfect Cornbread
instructions: Sift flour with sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in corn meal. Add eggs milk and shortening. Beat with rotary or electric mixer until smooth about 1 minute. Pour into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in hot oven (425\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes. For sticks spoon batter into pans filling 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: In a large bowl combine eggs and sugar beating well. Add pumpkin and lemon juice mixing well until blended. In a separate bowl combine flour baking powder spices and salt. Add to egg mixture mixing well. Spread batter into greased and waxed paper lined 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool for 15 minutes. Place cake on clean tea towel. Cool 10 minutes longer. From 10-inch side roll the cake up in the towel; set aside.

title: Mildred'S California Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in oleo until golden. Cook rice and add while hot to onion mixture. Add sour cream cottage cheese bay leaf salt and pepper. Mix well. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer 1/2 of rice mixture half the chilies and half the cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 uncovered for 25 minutes. Sprinkle top with parsley.

title: Myrtle'S Turtles
instructions: Grease 8 x 8-inch pan with butter. Layer ingredients as listed. Pour milk over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Pidgeon Poop
instructions: Melt almond bark and mix with cereal and pretzels. Add marshmallows. Spread on wax paper. Cool and break.

title: Mystery Casserole
instructions: Slice potatoes. Put in ungreased casserole. Next put layer of celery. Then layer of raw hamburger; add onion. Pour over this the undiluted soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Dietetic Dessert
instructions: Mix. Pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheddar Dip
instructions: Toss ingredients with mayonnaise to desired consistency. Chill overnight. Serve with corn chips or crackers.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Stir milk sugar and butter in a large microwave-safe bowl. Cook on High temperature of microwave oven for 9 to 10 minutes. Stir twice during cooking. Remove from microwave oven and stir in chocolate chips marshmallow cream and vanilla. Stir until chocolate is melted. Add nuts. Pour into greased 8 x 11-inch dish. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Stuffed Burger Bundles
instructions: Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions. Add cranberries. Combine beef and milk. Divide into 5 portions. On waxed paper pat each into 6-inch circle. Place 1/4 cup of stuffing in center and close meat over. Place meatballs in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over meat. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 5 servings.

title: Salmon Pie
instructions: Mix salmon with potatoes. Add butter salt pepper eggs and milk; mix well. Add enough milk to make a thick batter. Beat well; turn into a buttered pan. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Muffins
instructions: Grease muffin tins (do not use paper cups). Beat the first 3 ingredients. Add the other ingredients; mix well. Fill muffin tins to the top; will not run over. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: In medium size saucepan combine celery soup and milk. Add onion and broccoli; bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer until broccoli is tender. This will take about 10 minutes.

title: Pink Smoothie
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender; process until smooth.

title: Baked Chicken Rolls With Cheese And Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. On each chicken cutlet spread 1/4 of cheese; roll tightly. Secure with toothpick. Place rolled chicken in 8 x 8-inch baking dish. In small bowl mix undiluted soup with wine (or both). Blend until smooth. Pour mixture over rolled chicken. Bake for 20 minutes until chicken is tender. Remove chicken to platter; spoon sauce over. Remove toothpicks. Garnish with parsley. Contains 270 calories per serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add mashed banana and vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk and nuts. Put into two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool for 10 minutes then remove from pan. Slice when cold. Keeps moist when tightly wrapped. Freezes well.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Mix good and put on second layer. Top with cool whip & sprinkle with pecans. (Use any flavor of pudding you want but lemon is the best.)

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Boil chicken with cut up onion and celery until done. Mix all together and pack into greased loaf pan. Bake until brown on top. Cool some before slicing. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Watermelon Slices
instructions: Line a 1 1/2-quart bowl with plastic wrap. Set aside. In another bowl mix 1/2 of the topping with the food coloring. Spread on bottom and sides of the prepared bowl. Freeze 30 minutes. Spread remaining topping over the green layer and freeze 1 hour. Mix sherbet with chopped chocolate and spoon into center of topping. Freeze at least 4 hours.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well. Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Bob'S World Famous Cancun Enchiladas
instructions: Chop crab meat to about 1/2-inch pieces. Mix crab with shrimp and Monterey Jack. Mix nacho cheese and Cheddar cheese soups together. Pour half into crab/shrimp/cheese mix and mix thoroughly. Roll generous amount of mix into soft shells but do not overstuff. Place stuffed shells into baking dish side by side. Sprinkle more cheese over top of rolls then pour remainder of soup over top of shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly and cheese is melted.

title: Stuffed Cheezy Chicken
instructions: Prepare stuffing as on box and set aside. Cut pockets in chicken breasts. Spray baking dish (9 x 13) with Pam. Stuff mixture into chicken pockets. Place into dish. Top with 2 slices of cheese per breast. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Dice very finely the tomatoes cucumbers and onions. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Makes very large quantity but keeps well refrigerated and can be halved.

title: Mom'S Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas add flour shortening egg baking soda sugar and salt. Mix well add nuts if desired. Grease 2 loaf pans and split the batter evenly. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool on the side.

title: Vegetable Soup(Nutritional)
instructions: Cooking time is 4 hours in crock-pot. Serve with cornbread muffins or saltines.

title: Egg And Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Spread half of cheeses on bottom of 9 x 13 dish. Add mushrooms on top of cheeses. Add pepper and onion and finish cheese on top of this. Mix Egg Beaters milk and flour and pour into dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla. Mix in flour and salt gradually mixing well. Roll in small balls then flatten out on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 until it turns golden brown.

title: Dutch Apple Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine apples condensed milk and cinnamon; set aside. In a large bowl cut 1/2 cup butter into 1 cup biscuit mix until crumbly. Stir in apple mixture. Pour into greased 9-inch square baking pan. Combine 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar. Cut in 2 tablespoons butter until crumbly. Add nuts and sprinkle evenly over apple mixture. Bake one hour or until golden brown. May serve with ice cream.

title: Dorito Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in large skillet drain. Add soups enchilada sauce and chiles mix well. Cook until mixture is bubbly. Place Doritos in bottom of 9 x 13 Pyrex dish pour ground beef mixture evenly over chips. Top with shredded cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients and form into balls. Pour sauce over meatballs. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until done.

title: Peanut Butter And Fudge Swirl
instructions: In bowl with electric mixer beat cream cheese sugar and peanut butter until smooth. Gradually fold in whipped cream. Spoon into prepared crust. Drizzle fudge sauce over filling draw a knife through sauce to swirl. Chill until firm about 4 hours. Makes 6 servings.

title: Minnie Byerly'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugars. Add eggs milk and flavorings. Sift dry ingredients together. Stir flour mixture into other ingredients until you have a soft dough. Chill overnight. Roll out thin and cut with a cookie cutter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Mom Hornke'S Czeck Plum Kuchen
instructions: Combine milk and 1/2 teaspoon of sugar. Heat to lukewarm. Crumble in yeast and let rise. With fingers crumble butter into sifted flour. Add sugar/milk/yeast mixture salt slightly beaten egg yolks and lemon rind. Mix well until dough is medium stiff. Divide into 2 parts and refrigerate or freeze one-half for another time.

title: Apple Pie Filling Cake
instructions: Cream sugar eggs and oil with mixer. Mix rest of ingredients by hand. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done. Enjoy.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Mix potato and vanilla. Add sugar to make stiff dough. Roll out like pie crust. Spread with peanut butter. Roll up like jelly roll. Cut into slices.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill. Use as a dip for any raw vegetables.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar shortening egg and vanilla. Add flour soda baking powder and sour cream with creamed mixture. Roll on floured surface. Cut with cookie cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Combine the oats and buttermilk to soften for 1/2 hour. Mix slightly beaten eggs with oatmeal and buttermilk after softening. Add to dry ingredients. Add oil last. Bake in greased muffin pans for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Dough will keep in refrigerator for 5 weeks. (Bake a little longer if taken from refrigerator.)

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: In mixing bowl stir together the flour sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in butter to resemble coarse crumbs. Combine the egg and light cream. Add all at once to flour mixture stirring with fork just to moisten. Spread dough in greased 8 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans or 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan building up edges slightly. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until done. Remove from pan and cool. Using a sharp knife gently split shortcake into 2 layers. Spread bottom layer with soft butter. Whip cream to soft peaks. Spoon half of strawberries and whipped cream over bottom layer. Top with second layer. Spoon remaining strawberries and whipped cream over top. Serve while still warm.

title: Chicken Breasts Lombardy
instructions: Place chicken between 2 sheets of wax paper; flatten to 1/8-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Dredge chicken lightly in flour. Place 4 pieces at a time in 2 tablespoons melted butter in a large skillet; cook over low heat 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until chicken is golden brown. Place chicken in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish overlapping edges. Repeat procedure with remaining chicken adding 2 tablespoons butter. Reserve drippings. Saute mushrooms in remaining 1/4 cup butter; sprinkle evenly over chicken. Stir wine and chicken broth into pan drippings in skillet. Simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon sauce evenly over chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine cheeses and sprinkle over chicken. Bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Ricotta Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oil and powdered sugar; mix until well blended. Heat oil in deep fryer until it reaches 350\u00b0. Now drop by 1 teaspoon into the hot oil and it will form a ball on its own. Fry until they turn golden brown in color. Put on paper towels to drain excess oil. Place on cake dish and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in tightly covered container. Mix with hot water to drink.

title: 7 Flavor Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Salata
instructions: Hand crush tomatoes to render juice. Add green onions garlic oil and vinegar to tomatoes; mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Chill in refrigerator at least two hours; the longer the better. Serve in individual bowls with French bread pieces and dont forget your spoon.

title: Homemade Baking Mix
instructions: In a very large bowl stir together the first 5 ingredients until well blended. With a pastry blender cut in shortening until coarse crumbs form. Store in airtight container in cool dry place up to 3 months. Stir before measuring. Makes about 16 cups.

title: Mothers Fruitcake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Line four 7x2 1/4 inch loaf pans with parchment paper. Grease paper. Combine dates pecans and candied fruit in large bowl and mix well. Add 1 cup of flour and toss to coat. Combine sugar and eggs in another bowl and blend until smooth. Stir in remaining flour and baking powder and mix well. A7dd fruit mixture and blend well. Pack mixture evenly into prepared pans. Place pan filled with water in bottom of oven. Set loaves on rack above. Bake until tester comes out clean about 2 hours. Cake will be moist. Let cool completely. Turn cakes out of pans cover with plastic wrap or foil. Store in cool dark place. Can be frozen.

title: Quick No-Cook Play Dough
instructions: Add food coloring to water. Mix flour and salt well. Add oil. Add water slowly until it begins to ball up (like pie crust). Knead until soft and smooth.

title: Kentucky Cream Cake
instructions: Cream shortening oleo and sugar; add egg yolks one at a time. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla coconut and nuts. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in two layers at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve cold as a main dish or side dish with chicken turkey etc.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute vegetables in the butter until soft. Stir in flour and cornstarch. Cook until bubbly. Slowly add stock and milk stirring to make a smooth sauce. Add soda and cheese. Heat gently until the cheese is melted. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In a 4-quart glass mixing bowl melt butter or margarine in microwave; mix in flour and add warmed milk. Microwave stirring occasionally until thickened. If it gets lumpy beat with a wire whisk or mixer. Then add the cheese and microwave until cheese melts. Add macaroni salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yields 6 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine. Mix with broccoli rice Cheez Whiz and soup.\tPour in large casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Do not add any salt or pepper. Cheez Whiz is very salty.)

title: Poor Man'S Cookies
instructions: Combine oats sugars salt and flour. Combine soda and water. Stir in oats mixture along with shortening and vanilla. Make into walnut-size balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to stand 2 minutes before removing from pans to wire rack. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Pineapple Carrot Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple juice and add enough water to make 1 cup. Heat to a boil. Add to Jell-O. Stir well until dissolved. Add sugar. Chill until slightly thickened. Add pineapple and carrots. Whip together whipped topping and cream cheese. Fold into Jell-O mixture. Pour into 8 x 10-inch mold. Chill until firm. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese and add bananas. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon into paper baking cups which have been placed in muffin tins. Freeze. When frozen remove from tins and place in plastic bags and return to freezer. Serve as a salad or dessert. Serves 24.

title: Creamy Dressing
instructions: Put cottage cheese soup supplement and water in blender and puree. Season to taste.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Drain potatoes. Mix all ingredients. Butter baking dish. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour until firm at 300\u00b0. Remove from oven and add topping.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding with milk. Fold in whipped topping. Place layer of crackers in bottom of 6 x 12-inch dish. Pour half of pudding over crackers. Layer crackers and pudding again. Top with third layer of crackers. Top with frosting. Chill overnight. Store in refrigerator.

title: Bubbles And Squeak
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cook sausage in skillet breaking it up with a fork as it cooks. When no pink is showing transfer sausage to a bowl. Place chopped onions to the sausage drippings and cook until limp. Drain and add to sausage and mix well. Spread the meat mixture in the bottom of casserole dish. Cover with cabbage leaves. Add salt. Pour White Sauce over mixtures and bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbling hot.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together then knead and roll out. Use any shape cookie cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Use cake tester until it comes out clean.

title: Fresh Fruit Ice Cream
instructions: In ice cream freezer container combine all ingredients; mix well. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix well. Put 2 large scoops of mix in 1 cup of hot water. Stir and enjoy!

title: Easy Drop Biscuits
instructions: In bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Cut in Crisco until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add milk; stir until blended. Knead lightly 8 to 10 times. Drop from spoon onto an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 biscuits.

title: Primavera Salad
instructions: Blanch broccoli and plunge in ice water. Cook pasta.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Combine sugar soy sauce ketchup and vinegar. Mix well in saucepan and heat to an easy boil stirring constantly. In a bowl mix water and cornstarch until smooth. Gradually add to sauce stirring often. Fry chicken until brown arrange in casserole dish and pour sauce over chicken. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Autumn Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil. Flavor improves if mixture stands a couple of days. Reheat to serve.

title: My Friend Betsy'S I Hate To Cook Chili
instructions: Brown beef in large skillet or saucepan. Add Manwich sauce kidney beans (with juice) and chili powder. Cook over low heat at least 15 minutes longer is even better.

title: Chocolate Stickies
instructions: Combine flour Crisco and cold water. Knead into stiff dough. Place on floured board; roll out to 1/4-inch thick. Butter large iron skillet; place dough in skillet with dough hanging over sides. Mix sugar and cocoa; sprinkle evenly over dough in pan. Dot with 1 stick of butter. Fold in dough; dot top with other stick of butter. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until brown on top. Cut into 1-inch pieces; pour 2 cups of water over Stickies while hot. Place back in oven for about 5 or 10 minutes until Stickies are bubbly.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Mix in given order. Put into two greased bread pans. Crumble 1 tablespoon melted butter and 1/2 cup brown sugar mixture on tops. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Summer Strawberry Drink
instructions: Place frozen lemonade strawberries and water in blender. Add a few cubes of ice and blend quickly. Serves 4.

title: Asparagus Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Trim crusts and flatten bread. Blend cheeses until workable and add Worcestershire sauce. Spread on bread. Drain asparagus and roll one spear on each bread slice. Baste each roll with melted butter and place on cookie sheet seam side down. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15-20 minutes or until slightly browned. Cut in thirds to serve as an appetizer.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Warm slightly oil vinegar salt and pepper. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Add drained vegetables. Refrigerate in covered container.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as package label directs. Drain well. In large bowl toss with French dressing; refrigerate covered 2 to 3 hours. Add remaining ingredients except salad greens; toss to combine well. Refrigerate until well chilled at least 1 hour. Serve garnished with salad greens.

title: Spicy Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a mixing bowl; make a well in the center. Combine oil eggs sugars and vanilla; mix well. Stir in shredded zucchini. Add to dry ingredients stirring until moistened. Spoon into two well-greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes then remove to wire racks and cool before slicing.

title: Raspberry Sauce
instructions: Strain juice from raspberries into a 1-quart saucepan; set aside raspberries. Stir in water sugar and cornstarch. Stirring constantly bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute. Gently stir in raspberries. Cool. Makes about 1 1/3 cups.

title: Waldorf Red Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Make paste of red food color and cocoa. Add to creamed mixture. Add buttermilk with salt; alternating with flour. Add vanilla. Lastly add soda and vinegar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Maid Of Honor
instructions: Mix flour salt baking powder and sugar. Rub in butter with a spoon add egg yolks and lemon juice. Mix to form a smooth dough. Roll out half at a time very thin on a floured board. Cut into 2- inch circles. Place in greased miniature cupcake pans (1 1/2 inch in diameter). Pastry will not reach to top of cups. Press in place.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Blend in blender. Best when refrigerated overnight.

title: Oriental Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put into greased casserole. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook chicken and broccoli. Layer in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine soups milk and mayonnaise. Pour over chicken and broccoli. Toss bread crumbs in margarine. Pour on top of chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbles appear around edges. Serves 6.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir quickly. Pour on a marble slab or buttered pan. When cool pull as thin as you can. When cold break into pieces.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Use approximately 1/2 cup of mixture with hot water for one-cup serving.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Mix 2 cups self-rising flour margarine and nuts. Spread in 9 x 12-inch or larger baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly browned. Cool completely.

title: Jello Mixture
instructions: Put cottage cheese in bowl. Sprinkle jello over it. Put orange slices and pineapple on top of the mixture. Fold Cool Whip over all. Put in refrigerator and let cool for about 4 to 5 hours or overnight.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Dice fruit. Sprinkle with salt. Whip the whipping cream. Add the vinegar or lemon juice sugar and salad dressing. Pour over diced fruit. Mix thoroughly. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix the water and oatmeal. Let set for 20 minutes.

title: Oragail'S Easy Mountain Dew Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Modern Pioneer Stew
instructions: Sprinkle Lipton mix over bottom of casserole dish or pan. (I use 2 1/2-quart casserole.) Put meat on top of soup mix. Mix can of soup with water; add splash of red wine. Pour soup mixture over meat. Add the cut up vegetables on top. Season with salt and pepper. Cover tightly. Bake 2 1/2 to 3 hours in 300\u00b0 oven. Serve with Bisquick biscuits or crusty French bread.

title: Marinade For London Broil
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in a plastic bag or bowl with meat and marinate overnight. Broil. Baste if desired. Slice on a slant.

title: Deer Meat Balls
instructions: Fry onion in 1/2 tablespoon oleo then add to meat with salt pepper and egg yolks. Mix in cream and bread crumbs. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Roll in small balls and saute until brown. May be frozen at this time. Make roux with 1 tablespoon oleo and flour. Add beef bouillon. Add meatballs to gravy cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Peach Melba Shake
instructions: Process first 5 ingredients in a food processor or blender until smooth stopping to scrape down sides. Pour mixture into glasses. Process raspberries and 1/2 c. sugar until smooth; swirl evenly into shakes. Serve immediately.

title: Oven Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Cut ribs into serving size pieces. In a large saucepan cover ribs with salted water. Cover and simmer about 1 hour until nearly tender. In saucepan melt butter. Add garlic. Simmer 4 to 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Drain ribs. Place in shallow baking pan. Pour boiling sauce over ribs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Baste with sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix eggs and cottage cheese. Add broccoli. Mix melted margarine and Jiffy cornbread mix. Add together. Put in a low pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Nut Bread With Zucchini
instructions: Heat oven at 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans 5 x 9 inch.

title: Eye-Scream Float
instructions: To make eyeballs dip melon baller or coffee scoop into warm water and scoop out 3 to 4 eyeball sized balls from the ice cream. Place a chocolate coated candy into the center of each ball as a pupil. Freeze to make a float. Fill serving glasses with root beer to 2-inches from top stirring as small scoop of vanilla ice cream. Drop in gummy worms and licorice as veins. Add eyeball. Serves 2.

title: Best Ever Pie Crust
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Dough will be soft. Store tightly covered in refrigerator overnight or up to 2 weeks.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Allow butter or margarine to soften at room temperature. Combine sugar butter and eggs in a large mixing bowl. Beat until mixture is smooth and creamy. Alternate adding small amounts of the cake flour and the milk and beat after each addition. Add a dash of salt and the flavoring. Continue beating the mixture until it is smooth and creamy. The mixture will look like softened ice cream. (Do not overmix.) Cook in a tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Allow to cool for 15 minutes before removing from the pan.

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Spread in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake until brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Dill Dip
