instructions: Mix all together. Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Chili Cheese Corn Bread(Microwave Recipe)
instructions: Blend all ingredients except cheese and chilies. Pour 1/2 batter into greased round tube pan. Spread chilies and 1/2 cheese over batter. Top with remaining batter and then remaining cheese. Cook uncovered in microwave 8 to 15 minutes on High. Turn 1/4 turn after each 3 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Invert on plate.

title: Sour Cream Twists
instructions: Knead and roll into oblong 24 x 6-inch pan. Spread half with 2 tablespoons butter. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Fold other half over and cut into 24 strips. Twist each strip and place on greased baking sheet. Cover. Let rise in warm place 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Frost while warm.

title: Mushroom Salad
instructions: Wash and chop vegetables. Toss gently in large bowl. Cover with salad dressings. Marinate in covered container at least 2 hours or overnight. Serve with a slotted spoon.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: Wash grapes drain and set aside. With mixer cream the cream cheese and sugar. Add a tablespoon of milk at a time until thinned enough to fold in grapes easily. Add grapes then chill.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger sausage and onion. Drain. Put into crock-pot. Add melted Velveeta cheese soup tomatoes and peppers. Cook in crock-pot until ready to serve. Stir often. Great with nacho chips. Yields 1 crock-pot full.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Combine sugar butter syrup and salt. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in baking soda. Pour over popcorn immediately in large roasting pan. Bake in a slow oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. After baking stir continuously until cool. Kernels will not stick.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown meats in skillet. Drain off excess fat. Add tomato sauce paste garlic oregano and fennel seed. Simmer 30 minutes. Meanwhile cook noodles according to package directions. In 9 x 13-inch pan layer noodles meat Cheddar and Mozzarella cheeses and sprinkle top of casserole with grated Parmesan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until ingredients are heated through and cheese has melted. This can be frozen.

title: Tagliarini
instructions: Cook noodles as per package instructions. Drain and rinse. In large frypan brown meat. Add onion and garlic and cook until starting to brown. Add tomatoes (if whole chop) paste corn salt pepper and olives. Put noodles back in large pan. Mix in the meat mixture with half of the cheese. Pour mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Jello Dessert
instructions: Dissolve jello with boiling water as directed. Then remove 1/2 cup and pour into a bowl; set aside. Add 1/2 cup cold water to gelatin. Pour into a pan and place in freezer.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Mix the ingredients by hand. Bake in a large rectangular pan greased and floured. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Decorator'S Frosting
instructions: Sift sugar cornstarch and salt. In mixing bowl cream the shortening. By hand slowly add sugar mixture. Blend to very fine crumbs. Stir in egg white. Do not beat air into mixture. If too stiff for even piping add 1/2 teaspoon water. Store tightly covered. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Lumpias
instructions: Dice the carrot celery and onion into very small pieces. Mix all ingredients together. Mix in the diced veggies. Place a spoonful of mixture on won ton wrap; fold it up. Fry in hot grease until brown.

title: Diabetic Fruit Bar
instructions: Stew dates raisins prunes and water and have hot. Stir in soft margarine. Add flour baking soda salt eggs vanilla and sugar substitute. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Pour into 7 x 11-inch or 9-inch square pan.

title: Gazpacho Cooler
instructions: In blender process tomatoes cucumber pepper onion and garlic until smooth. Stir in tomato juice vinegar and dill weed. Add hot sauce and black pepper to taste. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until chilled. Pour into glasses and garnish with sprouts. Serves 6.

title: Olive Nut Spread
instructions: Mash 8 ounces softened cream cheese (room temperature) with a fork then add 1/2 cup mayonnaise. Blend well. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped pecans and 1 cup chopped salad olives. Add 2 tablespoons of olive juice and a dash of pepper. Stir well. Put in a covered container and refrigerate for several hours. Serve with crackers.

title: June Kleeb Lemon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a tube pan. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Let cool. Stir oil and cooled jello into cake mix. Beat in eggs one at a time. Continue to beat 4 minutes after eggs are added. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Heat powdered sugar and lemon juice and pour over hot cake. Remove from pan when cake cools. Yields 8 to 10 pieces.

title: Overnight Egg Casserole
instructions: Place bread cubes in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese; set aside. In skillet brown sausage. Drain fat. Crumble sausage over cheese and bread. Beat eggs milk mustard soup and broth; pour over sausage. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Recipe For Greek Salad
instructions: Add ingredients in the order given toss gently and serve with your favorite crackers. I like to serve it with Wheatsworth stone ground wheat crackers. Recipe yields 6 large salads or 10 small salads. Enjoy!

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes in casserole dish and dot with butter. Mix together sour cream and cream of chicken soup. Spread over potatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Thaw spinach and drain. Beat eggs well. Add cheese and spinach to eggs. Pour into 8-inch pie plate lined with pie crust (or use purchased pie shell). Bake 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven or until inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Calico Bean Bake
instructions: Saute onion. Combine all ingredients. Mix well and bake at least 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Creole
instructions: In 3 quart buttered baking casserole dish layer chips zucchini onion green pepper and cheese. Repeat layers. Pour tomato sauce and mushroom soup over all. Top with chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until zucchini is cooked.

title: Frozen Fruit Delight
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.

title: Whipped Cream Angel Cake
instructions: Blend dry ingredients. Place strawberries in a saucepan and cook on low heat to which you have added blended dry ingredients eggs and lemon juice. Stir constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat; add food coloring to desired color.

title: Cinnamon Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift flour baking powder salt and cinnamon together. Put sugar and oil in mixing bowl; mix well. Add eggs then vanilla. Add flour mixture all at once; beat well. Shape into 1/2-inch balls; roll in sugar. Place on lightly greased baking sheets. Flatten with fork; sprinkle with sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Remove to cooling trays. Yields about 50.

title: Daffodil Pie
instructions: Mix together margarine flour and 2 cups nuts; press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl (except cheese) and pour in a greased 9 x 13 dish. Top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dish Quiche
instructions: Brown meat in skillet over medium heat; drain off fat and set aside. Blend milk mayonnaise eggs (that have been beaten) and cornstarch. Then add rest of ingredients and pour in unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Butterscotch Rolls
instructions: Grease Bundt pan or tube cake pan. Arrange rolls. Sprinkle pudding mix and nuts over rolls. Melt butter and mix with brown sugar. Pour over rolls. Set in cold oven overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let set for 5 minutes then turn out.

title: Sam & Daddy'S Blueberry Blast
instructions: Place crescent on cookie sheet with the big ends touching. Spread cream cheese down the middle (use only 1/2 pkg.). Add pie filling on top of cream cheese (use only 1/2). Criss-cross ends over top of filling. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes.

title: Grandmother'S Pound Cake
instructions: Work butter until creamy. Beat in sugar and eggs one at a time. When creamy fold in flour and flavoring with spoon. Spread in buttered and floured loaf pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Olive Relish
instructions: Chop olives into small pieces. Saute onion in butter (olive oil is preferred). Cool. Combine all ingredients. Store in refrigerator. Serve on sandwiches as accompaniment to beef or anywhere.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli and cauliflower into bite-sized pieces. Mix all ingredients together except bacon. Let marinate in a zip-lock bag overnight. Add bacon before serving.

title: Jumbo Pizza Loaf
instructions: Cut loaf in half lengthwise. Combine meat Parmesan onion olives seasonings and tomato paste. Spread on both halves of loaf. Broil about 5 inches from heat for 12 minutes or until meat is done. Top with tomato and cheese slices and broil until cheese begins to melt. Serves 8.

title: Portobello Mushroom Pasta(Servings: 8)
instructions: Add garlic to 3/4 cup of broth; bring to boil in large skillet. Add mushrooms and cook over high heat until soft and liquid is reduced by about half. Add cooked pasta to mushrooms with remaining broth and bell pepper. Stir until pasta is thoroughly coated. Sprinkle with cheese and serve. Good warmed up also.

title: Greco
instructions: Fry onion and pepper in small amount of oil until glossy. Add ground beef; break up and stir to prevent sticking. Add mushrooms and remove from heat. Boil macaroni until tender (according to package directions). Drain and add to ground beef mixture. Add tomato sauce and corn and mix well. Place in greased casserole. Grate lots of cheese on top and bake uncovered for 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Sawmill Gravy
instructions: Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium heat stirring until it crumbles and is no longer pink. Remove sausage and drain on paper towels reserving 1 Tbsp. drippings in skillet. Melt butter with drippings in skillet over low heat. Whisk in flour until smooth. Cook whisking constantly for 1 min. Gradually whisk in milk and cook whisking constantly over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Stir in sausage salt pepper and Italian seasoning.

title: Easy Breakfast Rolls
instructions: Dip each biscuit into 1/2 cup melted butter. Place buttered side up on a baking sheet. Make an indention on each; fill with favorite pie filling. Sprinkle with mixture of 2 tablespoons butter sugar and flour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Scrape icing from Oreos and mix with other ingredients before crushing the Oreos. Mix all of the ingredients except the Oreos. Alternately layer this mixture with the Oreos into a new flower pot ending with a layer of Oreos (to resemble dirt). Add a sprig of silk flowers to look like a newly potted plant. Gummy worms add a nice touch.

title: Marshmallow Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar and milk to a soft ball stage about 234\u00b0. Add Marshmallow Creme peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well and pour into buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Cool and cut. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine and pour over meat loaf and bake rest of time.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in skillet until beef is no longer pink. Drain. Add remaining ingredients except water to beef and onion. Add enough hot water to achieve desired consistency. Cook and stir until heated through.

title: Simple Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Place breasts in a well greased baking dish. Top each breast with a provolone cheese slice. Pour spaghetti sauce over provolone cheese slices. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with parmesan and serve.

title: Banana-Apple Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients set aside to cool. When cool add pineapple apples and bananas. Put in fridge to set.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Place 1/2 package crushed Oreos in 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix sugar cream cheese margarine and vanilla. Add milk to pudding mix with cream cheese mixture. Fold in whipped topping. Spread over cookies and top with remaining crumbs. Chill 24 hours before serving.

title: Soy Spaghetti With Vegetable Burger
instructions: Put spaghetti into boiling salted water. Put next 6 ingredients in heavy kettle or fryer and cook slowly until onion is clear. Add vegetable burger and cook 5 minutes. Add tomato paste mushroom liquid and seasonings. Cook slowly for 10 minutes. Drain spaghetti and pour half the sauce over it; mix lightly. Serve on platter. Garnish top with remaining sauce and chopped parsley. Serves 8 generously.

title: Baked Ocean Perch In Sauce
instructions: Mix soup and sour cream. Dice onion or slice in rings and scatter over fish. Spread cream mixture over all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Quick Vegetable-Beef Soup
instructions: Combine beef and onion in a Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat until browned; stir to crumble meat. Drain. Return meat to Dutch oven. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with oregano salt and garlic. Combine tomato sauce and enchilada sauce; heat. Dip tortillas in heated sauce. Spread 3 tortillas in greased casserole. Make layers of meat mixtures cheese onions olives and sauce beginning with tortillas and ending with grated cheese and sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Noodle Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let set overnight or for a few hours until set and jelled. Cover with 2 cups corn flake crumbs mixed with sugar and cinnamon to taste. Dot with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Will serve 20.

title: Icebox Pickles
instructions: Mix together and store in refrigerator.

title: Frosted Deviled Ham
instructions: Mix deviled ham and onion. Mound mixture on plate. Mix remaining ingredients. Frost ham mound with cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: No Guilt Potato Wedges
instructions: Scrub potatoes and cut into wedges (about the size of kosher pickle wedges). Dry with paper towel. Toss in a bowl with olive oil until lightly coated. Season with desired spices. Bake on a cookie sheet in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes until done.

title: Chicken Breasts In Orange Juice
instructions: Remove skin. Wash and pat chicken dry. Brown in large frypan in oil over moderate heat about 6 to 8 minutes. Sprinkle with poultry seasonings as it browns. Arrange chicken bone side down and dribble juice concentrate over it evenly. Rinse juice can with wine or water and add to sauce. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken Fillets
instructions: Flatten fillets with mallet. Marinate in dressing 30 minutes or overnight in refrigerator. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Spray baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Coat each fillet lightly with crumbs. Arrange in single layer in dish. Bake 5 or 6 minutes on each side.

title: Ham 'N Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown the onions and peppers in the 2 tablespoons of margarine. Grease a casserole dish with nonstick spray. Mix together in casserole dish browned onions and peppers shredded cheese ham mushroom soup milk and noodles. Butter 2 slices of bread and crumble finely and sprinkle over top of mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Eggplant Soup
instructions: Cook eggplant in water with salt until tender about 10 minutes. Add milk. Add flour paste to thicken. Add butter and pepper. Tastes like oyster stew!

title: Spinach Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix spinach eggs onion cheese and dressing. Spoon spinach mixture into greased 8-inch square baking dish. Top with combined bread crumbs and margarine. Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Preparation time 10 minutes; cooking time 55 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves and butter melts. Let cool slightly. Add eggs vanilla and salt to mixture stirring well. Pour filling into pastry shell and top with pecan halves. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: No Bake Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan combine gelatin spices salt condensed milk and eggs. Mix well let stand for one minute. Over low heat cook and stir constantly until gelatine dissolves and mixture thickens slightly about ten minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in pumpkin and mix well. Pour into crust. Chill three hours or until set. Serve with Cool Whip or plain. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Deviled Crab
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl then stuff crab shells (about 8). Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown (about 30 minutes).

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Remove chicken; cool and debone. In chicken broth mix chopped onion soups and chicken. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat until mixture comes to a small boil. Pinch biscuits in half and drop into boiling mixture. Reduce heat to low and cook 15 to 30 minutes or until dough is done.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Let ground cranberries orange and sugar mixture set overnight. Mix gelatin with warm water. When it starts to gel add pecans marshmallows celery and cranberry mixture. Refrigerate until set. Serve on lettuce leaf. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Boil 1 (8 ounce) package noodles; drain and rinse. Serve the noodles with 3/4 cup browned buttered bread crumbs either sprinkled on top or lightly stirred in.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix by hand 2 cups sugar flour soda eggs 2 teaspoons vanilla pineapple and nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.

title: Easy Low-Fat High Protein Veggie Dish
instructions: In large pot brown macaroni in oil. Add onion and pepper until tender. Dissolve bouillon in water and add to pot. Add remaining ingredients. Heat thoroughly for 10 minutes.

title: Stuffing(For 11 To 12 Pound Turkey)
instructions: Melt butter. Add onion green pepper and celery. Stir in seasonings eggs and broth. (Add broth milk or water only when not stuffing a bird.) Stir into bread cubes. Place in casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fruit Bars
instructions: *I use English walnuts but pecans are O.K.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix sugar eggs Wesson oil and grated carrots together. Add flour and nuts. Mix well. Pour mixture into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Pineapple Cream Pie
instructions: Heat milk and butter in saucepan. Combine sugar and cornstarch. Add 1 cup of milk to this; stir until smooth then add to hot milk stirring constantly until thick. Blend in well beaten eggs to which a little of the hot mixture has been added. Cook about 2 minutes more stirring constantly. Cool. Add vanilla.

title: Taco Salad With Pablano Buttermilk Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Then top with dressing.

title: Pickled Shrimp
instructions: Cover with boiling water. Cover and simmer (slow boil) until shrimp turns pink (about 5 minutes). Let cool.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in enough water to amply cover potatoes. Saute the carrots and onions in margarine. Stir in salt pepper and soup. Add sauce mixture to cooked potatoes. Use cooking liquid; do not pour off. When potatoes are cooked (approximately 20 minutes) mash 2 to 3 cups of diced potatoes and blend with diced potatoes. More water may need to be added to give desired thickness.

title: Applesauce Raisin Bread
instructions: Makes 3 to 4 mini loaf pans.

title: Impossible Bacon Pie
instructions: Grease bottom of a 9-inch pie plate. Place crumbled cooked bacon on bottom then onions cheese salt and pepper. Mix together eggs milk and Bisquick until smooth. Pour onto bacon onion and cheese mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Add Crisco to first 3 ingredients with fork until crumbly. Mix water vinegar and egg. Beat slightly. Pour over first mixture and mix well. Chill 15 minutes or overnight. Makes 4 to 5 crusts. Can freeze if needed.

title: Southwest Ragout
instructions: Cook potato in small pot of boiling salted water until almost tender (about 8 to 10 minutes). Drain and reserve. Meanwhile heat oil in heavy large saucepan over medium heat. Add pepper and saute 3 to 5 minutes. Add garlic and stir 1 minute. Add tomatoes with juices corn beans cilantro and the reserved potato. Simmer until potato is very tender and liquids are thick stirring occasionally about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Great as a meatless main dish or with steak chicken fish. This recipe is easily doubled.

title: Flank Steak With Wine Sauce
instructions: Brush steak with soy sauce; sprinkle with thyme salt and pepper. Let stand 1 hour. Brush again with soy sauce; grill 3 to 4 minutes on each side for rare.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Put squash onions green peppers and salt in large container; cover with ice water and let set 1 hour then drain well. Put vinegar mustard celery seed in saucepan and bring to a boil. Add drained vegetables and bring to a boil. Pack in hot jars and seal at once. Makes 4 pints.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Line 9 x 13-inch pan with 1 package graham crackers (whole). Melt butter and add to beaten egg milk and sugar. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add coconut nuts and crushed graham crackers (1 package). Pour this mixture over layer of crackers. Then top with another package of whole graham crackers.

title: Butter Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add softened butter and vanilla and blend thoroughly. Form into a roll and wrap in wax paper. Chill. When thoroughly chilled slice and bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Stuffed Manicotti
instructions: Mix meat garlic salt pepper pieces of bread and egg in bowl. Fill hard noodles with meat mixture. Place filled manicotti in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover with spaghetti sauce (entire jar) and top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Noodles will be very tender.

title: Spinach, Sausage And Cheese Manicotti
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Cook pasta according to package directions. Mix together remaining ingredients; add sausage. Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with 3 tablespoons spaghetti sauce. Fill pasta with cheese mixture and place in pan. Cover with remaining sauce and 1/2 cup shredded Mozzarella. Bake covered 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Uncover; cook 10 minutes until cheese is bubbly.

title: Apricot Bread
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes. Cool. Add egg. Sift the flour and soda together. Add to apricot mixture (I stir this into pan apricots are in). Mix until flour is mixed in well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Check at 45 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: In large bowl mix soups Ro-Tel and milk. Drain spaghetti. Toss gently with soup mixture; add chicken. Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated through.

title: Ginger Ale Lime Salad
instructions: Cream lime Jell-O and cream cheese together; add boiling water a little at a time while blending with a fork or hand mixer. Add ginger ale pecans pineapple and marshmallows (melted in microwave with the reserved 1/2 cup of pineapple juice). Mix well and pour into Pyrex dish. Chill until set.

title: Corn Muffins
instructions: Mix thoroughly and pour into a greased muffin pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Grease pan bottom only. Mix sugar and butter. Blend in eggs. Add banana and water. Beat for 30 seconds. Stir in all remaining ingredients until moist except nuts. Blend in nuts. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool for 5 minutes. Remove from pan. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar when cool.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix jello and pineapple; heat until jello is dissolved. Stir in buttermilk. Stir in Cool Whip until smooth; chill.

title: Deer Enchiladas
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Warm tortillas until pliable. Place 1/4 cup of each ingredient in tortilla and roll. Place in pan; pour sauce over tortillas. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Garnish with sour cream and chopped green onions.

title: Kraut And Frank Potato Soup
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan melt butter over low heat. Add onion and cook covered about 5 minutes or until tender. Add potatoes water and pepper. Cover and cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender 10 to 12 minutes. Add milk and cook until milk bubbles around edge of pan.

title: Casserole Rye Bread
instructions: Combine flours; in a large bowl thoroughly mix 1 1/2 cups flour mixture sugar salt caraway seed and undissolved yeast. Combine water milk and margarine in a saucepan. Heat slowly until liquids are warm (margarine need not be melted). Gradually add to dry ingredients and beat for 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer scraping bowl occasionally. Add 1/2 cup flour mixture or enough to make a thick batter. Beat at high speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Add remaining flour. Batter should be stiff. Stir until well blended or use dough hooks. Cover; let rise in warm place free from draft until more than doubled in bulk about 45 minutes. Stir batter down. Beat vigorously 1/2 minute. Turn into well-greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven about 40 to 50 minutes or until done. Remove from casserole and cool on wire rack. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Pretzel Cereal Snack
instructions: Mix the butter Worcestershire sauce garlic powder and celery salt in 3-quart casserole. Microwave uncovered on High 45 seconds to 2 minutes or until butter is melted. Stir in cereal pretzels and nuts until well coated. Let stand 8 minutes stirring every 2 minutes until toasted. Let stand about 30 minutes or until cool. Store in tightly covered container up to 1 week. Yields 8 cups. Contains 400 calories per serving.

title: Sicilian Chili
instructions: Brown and drain ground meat. Add all listed ingredients. Cook over low heat for 2 hours; stir often. Serve over mashed potatoes or rice if desired. Serve with Italian bread. Add spaghetti cheese and salt if desired.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls Or 1, 2, 3 Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Combine the ingredients and shape in balls the size of walnut (use hands). Bake on cookie sheets at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Easy Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: In a glass or crockery bowl alternately layer the sliced cucumbers and onions. In a medium saucepan combine sugar vinegar salt mustard seed celery seed and ground turmeric. Bring to boiling stirring just till sugar is dissolved. Pour vinegar mixture atop cucumber-onion mixture; cool slightly. Cover tightly; refrigerate pickles at least 24 hours before serving. Store up to 1 month in refrigerator. Makes 7 cups.

title: Breakfast Sausage And Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. When hot bake biscuits 11 to 13 minutes until golden. Slice pork sausage into 10 slices each approximately 1/2-inch thick. Fry sausage in ungreased frying pan on medium heat until brown and cooked completely through. Slice biscuits in half horizontally. Place a sausage patty on each biscuit and top with 1/2 slice cheese. Replace top of biscuit. Microwave on High for 30 seconds to melt cheese. Serve hot with jelly if desired. Biscuits may be frozen before adding cheese and reheated in the microwave by the following method.

title: Rich Dinner Rolls
instructions: Cool milk to lukewarm by adding 1/2 cup water. Add yeast; blend in egg. Add 3 cups flour; mix until dough is well blended and soft. Let rise until doubled. Punch down once. Roll into balls; place into greased muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: 3-Bean Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon drain; brown beef saute onion and add to 3 - 4 quart baking dish.\tStir all other ingredients into beef mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Mix flour and soda together and add to mixture also. Add sour cream and mix well. Fold in vanilla.

title: Colorvision Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directed on package except just before mixing add the Jell-O. Bake as directed on the box.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Candy
instructions: Melt butter. Add peanut butter and stir until creamy. Stir in powdered sugar. Pat into 17 x 11 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or other large pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread on top. Let set until firm.

title: Pot Roast Chicken
instructions: Dress chicken and rub thoroughly with sauce. Sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken. Heat pot and add peanut oil. Brown chicken evenly. Add ginger and garlic. Pour remaining sauce over chicken and cover pot. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove chicken from pot. To remaining sauce add sugar and ajinomoto; season to taste. Add onions to sauce just before serving. Chop chicken and pour sauce over chicken. Garnish with parsley. Serves 6.

title: Tropical Cream Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients; chill before serving.

title: Sour Cream Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream the oleo and sugar until light and fluffy. Add slightly beaten eggs syrup and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in chopped pecans and sour cream. Pour in unbaked pie shell and garnish with whole pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and cool. Beat eggs. Add sugar and dry ingredients. Then add oatmeal mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle brown sugar and chocolate chips over batter before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or more.

title: Molasses Crinkles
instructions: Mix together shortening sugar egg and molasses. Sift dry ingredients and stir in shortening mixture. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of large walnuts. Dip tops in white sugar. Place sugar side up 3 inches apart on a greased baking sheet. Sprinkle each cookie with 2 or 3 drops of water to produce crackled surface.

title: Depression Soup
instructions: Simmer broth and turkey for 1 hour. Add onions celery parsley salt and pepper. Simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. The next day add tomato paste and rice to remaining soup. Simmer 20 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar Crisco and margarine. Add eggs one at a time. Add cocoa salt vanilla coloring and baking powder. Add 1/2 of flour and 1/2 of milk. Mix well. Add remaining flour and milk. Bake in a large tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced squash onion salt and pepper until tender. Brown stuffing in butter. Oil a 2 1/2-quart baking dish with 1/2 of stuffing. Drain squash and add cream of mushroom soup. Stir well and layer over stuffing in baking dish. Put sliced pimento on top. Add sour cream as next layer. Top dish with remainder of stuffing. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Pineapple Stuffing (Warm Or Cold)(Serve With Pork Or Ham)
instructions: Beat eggs and add pineapple sugar and flour. Put into small casserole. Dice bread and brown in butter then top mixture in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pretzel Crust
instructions: Crush pretzels very fine in a blender or between 2 sheets of waxed paper. Add sugar and butter; mix thoroughly. Press half of mixture in a 9-inch pie plate.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Combine cranberries marshmallows and sugar. Chill overnight. Add remaining ingredients and fold in whipped cream.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers and onions; let stand 1 hour (can stand as long as 3 hours) in salt ice water. Drain. Simmer about 20 minutes in remaining ingredients (do not boil). Pack in sterilized cans and seal. Makes 2 quarts.

title: E-Z Baked Chicken
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Marinate chicken overnight or several hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/4 hours.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Chill dough 1/2 hour. Roll into balls (1/2 teaspoon). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Double Batch Punch
instructions: Place in punch bowl. Top with scoops of orange sherbet (be generous with the sherbet).

title: Shake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and mix.

title: Breadsticks
instructions: Put Bisquick in small mixing bowl. Add cold water a little at a time until dough is easy to handle and not very sticky to hands. Form into breadsticks. Brush on melted butter and sprinkle with salt or sesame seed as desired. Bake until light brown (approximately 10 minutes) at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Casserole Supreme
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions. Cook noodles; drain and blend in soup and milk. Grate cheese and crush potato chips. Mix all together and pour into ungreased pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Souffle
instructions: Cook sausage; drain grease off. Add bread cheese mustard and beaten eggs in milk with salt. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix the ingredients (except soup) well. Place in a loaf pan. Over the top pour the 1/2 can of soup and 1/4 can water. (Barbecue sauce is also good as a topping.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cecile Foresman'S Layered Salad
instructions: Make 1 to 2 days ahead and let set covered in refrigerator.

title: Big Mac Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all above ingredients in a large baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pumpkin Spice Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease twelve 1/2-cup muffin cups. Place raisins in small bowl. Pour enough boiling water over to cover. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain raisins. Mix flour sugar cinnamon and nutmeg in large bowl. Add oil pumpkin and eggs and mix just until combined. Mix in raisins and nuts. Divide batter among prepared cups. Bake until tester inserted in center of muffins comes out clean about 25 minutes. Cool slightly on rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Crunchy Potato Balls
instructions: In a bowl combine the potatoes ham cheese mayonnaise egg mustard and pepper. Mix well. Add enough of the flour to make a stiff mixture. Chill and shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in corn flakes. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot. Yields about 6 dozen.

title: Puppy Chow Mix
instructions: Put cereal in large sealable bag. Melt the margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips together. Pour over mix in bag and shake well to coat. Add powdered sugar and shake again to coat. Pour on cookie sheet to harden. Store in closed container or plastic bag.

title: Chocolate Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour sugar and cocoa; cut in margarine until crumbly. Add egg; mix until well blended. Reserve 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture. Press remainder evenly on bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Candy Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar margarine cocoa and milk. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Stir in vanilla peanut butter and oatmeal. Quickly drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Ready to serve in minutes.

title: Mildred'S Apple-Tomato Chutney
instructions: Peel and core apples and stew them in a very small quantity of water until they are tender and pulpy. Cut up tomatoes; chop onions and garlic. (Put through the coarse blade of food grinder.) Add to apples. Add sugar. Tie the mustard seed in muslin and add to the mixture along with spices and seasoning. Add the vinegar and cook gently for about 2 hours or until mixture is of required consistency. Put into jars and seal. Use water bath. Makes about 4 1/2 pints.

title: Fresh Apple Cake(Delicious)
instructions: Blend together the sugar oil and eggs. Add the apples nuts and raisins. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake in oblong 13 x 9-inch pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Can be baked in 6 small pans at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cry Baby Cookies
instructions: Into a 2-cup measuring cup pour molasses hot water and vinegar. Beat shortening sugar and eggs until creamy. Add flour and spices alternately with liquids. Add raisins. Batter is stiff and doesnt melt much in cooking. Place on a greased pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Frost if you like. Rich in iron and good for babies and teens and adults! Enjoy.

title: Chicken Salsa
instructions: Pound meat with meat mallet tenderizer. Place in baking dish sprayed with Pam or melt 4 tablespoons butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven; pour salsa over chicken and sprinkle cheese on top. Return to oven and bake another 15 minutes.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in a slightly greased 8-inch baking dish. Place casserole dish in a pan with 1 1/2 to 2-inches of water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Twists
instructions: Combine shortening sugar and salt. Pour milk over and let stand until lukewarm. Have yeast dissolved in 1/4 cup lukewarm water. Mix with other mixture. Blend in 1 1/2 cups flour and beat until smooth. Cover and let set 15 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Mix rest of flour and let rise in warm place until double in bulk. Dip out rounded spoonfuls and roll into mixture of nuts sugar and cinnamon. Stretch into long twisted pieces and place on greased cookie sheet. Let rise 15 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Tamales
instructions: Clean husks. Mix masa and butter well. Add other ingredients. Add sugar to taste. Put 2 tablespoons masa (prepared) in corn husk flatten and add fruit. Roll and fold. Steam for 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Tea Cake
instructions: Add all in order except 2/3 cup flour which is added with the berries. (Batter is quite thin.) Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Mushroom Patties
instructions: Mix cream of mushroom soup and eggs. Add enough crackers to make patties. Put enough cooking oil in skillet to cover bottom. Drop mushroom mixture in skillet by tablespoon. Fry until golden brown on both sides.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine shortening sugar and eggs; mix together. Sift together the flour cream of tartar soda and salt; add to shortening mixture. Roll the dough into small balls; roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Caramel Apple Walnut Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour oats sugar baking soda and salt. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Reserving 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture press remainder on the bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes. Add walnuts to reserved crumb mixture. In heavy saucepan over low heat melt caramels with sweetened condensed milk stirring until smooth. Spoon apple filling over prepared crust. Top with caramel mixture then reserved crumb mixture. Bake 20 minutes or until set. Cool; serve warm with ice cream.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour until it looks like coarse corn meal. Blend egg in a cup. Add the water and vinegar to the eggs. Blend well and add to mixture. Add salt and blend until it holds together well. Flour board lightly and roll out dough to fit pan. Makes 3 crusts.

title: St. Paul'S Rice
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Saute onions with celery sticks in a small amount of butter. Combine soup in boiling water and cook for 7 minutes. Add rice to soup mixture then add sausage and vegetables. Place in casserole and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Elfo'S Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Set aside. Heat 1/2 cup butter. Add minced garlic shrimp and chopped mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes in butter. Add spaghetti to skillet and sprinkle with Romano cheese salt pepper and monosodium glutamate. Using large spoon stir spaghetti being careful not to cut it. Continue until heated and be careful not to let butter brown.

title: Best Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender. Chill before using.

title: Green Beans And Tomatoes
instructions: Cut beans lengthwise. Chop onions. Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook covered for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Bake
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain and put into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine soup with milk stirring until smooth. Pour half of soup mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle grated cheese over soup layer; add remaining soup. Top with buttered bread cubes; bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield 6 servings.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: *Stew chicken. Strain and save broth. Remove skin and bones and break meat into pieces. Place on bottom of a 9 x 12-inch greased glass pan. Saute mushrooms in a little of the broth. Mix mushrooms soup and sour cream together. Place on top of chicken. Mix stuffing with 1/2 pound melted butter or margarine and 1 cup broth. Place on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until dressing is browned.

title: Taloren
instructions: Brown beef in 2 tablespoons cooking oil. Salt to taste. Cook until tender. Add celery peppers and onions. Combine all ingredients except cheese in a large bowl. Mix lightly. Put in casserole and bake until tender. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Spray small casserole with Pam. Add sliced eggplant mushrooms and 1/3 cup grated cheese mixed together. Sprinkle basil over ingredients or other herbs and spices to suit your taste. Cover with spaghetti sauce (add more basil if desired). Add remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Mexicali Roll-Ups
instructions: Spoon 1/4 of dip over each tortilla spreading to edges. Sprinkle each with 1/4 of chicken. Roll up. Place seam side down on a plate or flat dish. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Cut each roll into six 1-inch pieces. Serve with salsa. Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Breakfast Scones
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder soda and salt then cut in butter to make crumbles. Add dried fruit ginger and lemon peel mixing well. Add buttermilk. On a lightly floured board knead dough 6 turns then place on greased baking pan (12 x 15-inch) and shape into an oval loaf. Using a floured knife cut across loaf in triangles to form pie shaped slices. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until top is brown.

title: Raspberry Peach Parfait
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water. Stir in ice cubes until dissolved. Reserve 3/4 cup dissolved gelatin. Divide among and pour remaining gelatin evenly into 6 dessert glasses. Chill.

title: Moist Cornbread
instructions: Melt butter. Blend together sugar and eggs; add butter. Stir in buttermilk soda cornmeal flour and salt. Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Chiffon Pie
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Chill until partially set. Beat until fluffy. Fold in berries. Gradually beat sugar into egg whites; beat until mixture stands in peaks and sugar is dissolved. Fold egg whites and whipped cream into gelatin mixture. Pour into cooled baked pastry shell. Chill until set. Top with whipped cream. Garnish with sliced strawberries. Makes 6 servings.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and 1/2 stick margarine (melted); mix well. Add well beaten eggs; mix well. Add milk and flavoring; mix well. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Dot with remaining margarine. Sprinkle with nutmeg if desired. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Busy Day Fruit Cobbler(A Juicy Cobbler, Southern Style)
instructions: Place fruit in greased 8 x 8-inch pan. (If fruit is very juicy mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch with each cup juice.) Cream shortening and sugar. Mix in egg. Add flour and milk alternately; mix until smooth after each addition. Pour over fruit in pan. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Cut in squares. Serve warm with cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a 8 x 12-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until set. Cover with 1 cup bread crumbs.

title: Okra Pickles
instructions: Wash okra. Leave small amount of stem on okra. Pack into sterilized pint jars standing on end to get as many okra pods in jars as possible. For hot pickles add 1 pod of hot pepper to each jar. For dill pickles add sprig of dill weed to each jar. Boil vinegar; add 1/4 cup to each jar. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to each jar. Finish filling jar with boiling water. Seal jars while hot. Ready to eat in about 2 weeks.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Fry and brown bacon onions and green pepper in a deep skillet. Drain off all grease except 1 teaspoon. Combine all other ingredients mixing well. Cover and cook until rice is tender and thick.

title: Tortillas(For Tacos)
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking powder. Work in shortening until fine and crumbly. Add water. Mix well with hands and knead until soft and smooth. Divide into 8 or 12 parts. Roll into round shape very thin. Bake on hot ungreased griddle turning until both sides are brown. Keep warm in 150\u00b0 oven. (Be sure not to overcook browning doesnt take long.)

title: Country Fair Egg Bread
instructions: Heat 2 c. water and 1 c. milk. Soften yeast in warm water; let set. Combine sugar oil and salt in large bowl; add hot milk; then add cold water. Add eggs that have been whipped a little. Add yeast and mix. Add between 7 and 9 c. flour until a stiff batter. Spread a large quantity of flour and pour out batter. Knead dough for about 7 minutes. Put into a greased bowl and let rise until doubled. Punch down and turn over. Let rise 30 minutes. Turn out and shape into rolls or loaves and let rise double. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown. Brush with butter.

title: Pecan Bars
instructions: Fill bottom of a big cookie sheet with graham cracker squares. Melt brown sugar oleo with pecans in saucepan until it comes to a full boil. Boil 1 minute. Stir until boiling stops then pour over crackers and spread evenly. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take out let cool a little and pour on wax paper.

title: Zucchini-Carrot Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat; add zucchini carrots and onion. Saut 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat; stir in sour cream and next 3 ingredients. Spoon into a lightly greased 1-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yield 4 servings. Prep 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Beef
instructions: Heat butter in large pan and saute the meat until it becomes light brown on all sides. Add the salt pepper carrots celery parsley and the water or beef sauce and then lemon juice. Boil it for 2 hours. Let the meat cool and cut it in pieces. Put the pieces in the pan again and warm the pieces for awhile. Pour the gravy through the colander. Make the gravy thicker by adding 2 teaspoons of flour. Serve the meat with rice or sauteed mushrooms.

title: Squash Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Peel and seed squash. Dice into pieces. Cook in saltwater until soft and tender. Drain off water. Pure squash or beat with mixer. Mix flour and sugar together. Add to mixture. Beat on low speed. Add eggs milks and vanilla; mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Hot Brandied Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit. Reserve juices. Combine juices and stir well. Set aside 1/2 cup juices. Combine butter and sugar. Stir until smooth. Add reserved juice brandy and spices. Stir until blended. Combine fruit in 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Pour brandy mixture in. Microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Stir twice.

title: Whole Fruit Shake
instructions: Combine all in a blender. Whir until blended. Pour in tall glass. You can also put in a handful of ice cubes.

title: Cocoa-Pink Cuplets
instructions: Sift flour cocoa and salt together; set aside. Cream sugar and shortening together. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add soda to cold water; stir well. Add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Blend thoroughly after each addition.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat 2 eggs slightly and pour into a well of flour mixture (flour sugar baking soda salt and cinnamon). Add oil apples nuts and vanilla. Mix. Pour batter into a 15 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch greased pan. (I use lasagna size foil pans.) Sprinkle topping on cake. Put in cold oven. Set oven at 325\u00b0 and bake for 50 minutes.

title: Delectable Date Drop Cookies
instructions: Combine dates and water; bring to boiling. Simmer 5 minutes. Cool. Set aside 2 tablespoons of date mixture for frosting. Beat in egg sugar butter and milk. Stir together flour salt baking powder and soda. Add to egg mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool.

title: Spicy Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together the ingredients. Form loaf in pan (catsup on top). Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Christmas Cauliflower
instructions: In a large saucepan cook cauliflower in a a small amount of water for 6 to 7 minutes until crisp and tender. Drain well. In a medium saucepan saute bell peppers and mushrooms in butter for 2 minutes. Add flour and gradually stir in milk. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted. Add pimentos and salt. Place half of the cauliflower in a greased 2 quart baking dish. Top with half of sauce. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered at 325 degrees for 25 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Rum Slush
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Freeze 6 to 8 hours. Place a scoop of slush into a glass of ginger ale. Great for parties!

title: Rainbow Delight Cake
instructions: Beat whipping cream and confectioners sugar until stiff. To 2 cups of frosting stir in several drops of yellow food coloring and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract. To 1 cup of frosting add red food coloring and 1/2 teaspoon rum extract to make pink.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour in pie crust and chill for 1 hour.

title: Monkey Bread #1
instructions: Mix white sugar and cinnamon. Quarter biscuits with childs scissors. Toss quarters into the cinnamon sugar mixture. Put into greased Bundt pan; save extra sugar mixture. Bring brown sugar and butter to boil. A grown-up should help with this. Pour over the biscuits and dump the rest of the sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Invert onto plate; dont let cool in pan!

title: Corned Beef Mold
instructions: Stir until dissolved. Add and stir into first mixture. Pour into Tupperware ring or 2 small bowls and let set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown first 4 ingredients in skillet; place in crock-pot. Add remaining ingredients to crock-pot. Stir and cook 2 hours on low. May add hot pepper to taste.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Fry the onion in oil. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in oleo. Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle 1/2 cup corn chips on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrot Puff
instructions: Grease an 8-inch square baking dish. Steam or boil carrots until tender (about 20 minutes). Place margarine eggs sugar flour baking powder and vanilla in blender. Add carrots a little at a time and puree the mixture. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 9-inch pan for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool slightly.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Make rice according to package. When done mix in ground beef egg and seasonings. Arrange peppers in baking dish. Fill each with ground beef mixture.

title: Onion Biscuits
instructions: Add onion to butter; let stand a few minutes. Place biscuits on ungreased baking sheet. Press a hollow in center of each biscuit with floured bottom of small glass. Fill hollows with butter mixture. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until done.

title: Three Bean And Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except Corn Bread Topping; pour into ungreased baking dish 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Prepare Corn Bread Topping; spoon evenly over bean mixture to within 1 inch of edges. Bake until topping is deep golden brown 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine shortening and sugars. Add vanilla and eggs. Combine flour soda salt and oatmeal. Add to sugar mixture. Stir in chips. Chill dough before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Country-Style Pot Roast
instructions: In Dutch oven brown roast in shortening. Combine onion soup mix with 2 cups of water. Pour over roast; simmer turning occasionally for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. Or after browning put into crock-pot until almost tender then add potatoes and carrots. Blend flour and water. Stir into drippings where roast was browned and make gravy. Serves 6.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine in bowl the first 3 ingredients and let stand until the moisture is taken up. Add 1 egg and beat well. Sift remaining ingredients and add. Stir until combined. Grease muffin tins and fill 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before removing. Yields 12 to 15 (2 1/2-inch) muffins.

title: Kraut Dumplins
instructions: Let come to boiling until kraut is tender. Then drop in dumplings. Cook until dumplings are done. Add pepper if wanted (black or red pepper).

title: B & B Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken. Remove from bones and chop. Mix well all ingredients and place in casserole dish. Cover with another cup of Ritz crackers (crushed). Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Power Packed Smoothie
instructions: Puree strawberries. Add milk banana instant breakfast and frozen yogurt and blend until smooth.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain cans of fruit. Combine fruit cocktail pineapple apple marshmallows and nuts in a serving bowl. Whip whipping cream until thick add sugar salt and mayonnaise and mix. Add to fruit bowl and mix. Add bananas last just before serving.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Mix and toss with lettuce.

title: Pork And Noodles
instructions: Cook and drain noodles. Cut pork into thin strips. (Throw in the bones too.) Heat 2 large skillets. Put 1 tablespoon butter into 1 skillet and add the meat. Brown slightly. Add the onions. Add the beans. Cover and cook until the beans are done. In second skillet melt the rest of the butter until hot. Add the cooked noodles. Cook until crisp and brown. Turn over and brown other side. When noodles and meat are ready remove half the noodles to a bowl. Take half the meat and add it to the noodles in the pan. Put the noodles from the bowl into the other pan with the meat. Mix each pan to combine. You now have 2 pans of stuff. Enough to feed a crowd.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks margarine and milk together. Mix sugar and flour together. Add the two mixtures together in medium saucepan. Cook until thickened. Coconut is optional. Pour into 2 baked pie crusts or 1 deep-dish baked crust.

title: Cashew Coconut Brittle
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients into 3-quart pan. Cook over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Add cashews and coconut. Increase heat to high. Stir constantly until mixture becomes light brown. Remove from heat.

title: Oyster Stuffing
instructions: Cook 4 cups celery diced fine in 2 cups water until tender about 18 minutes; drain and save 1 cup liquid. Saute 1/2 cup minced onions in 1/2 cup butter over low heat. Drain 1 1/2 cups oysters. Add enough celery liquid to oyster liquid to make one cup. Mix well 4 quarts lightly packed day old bread crumbs with 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning 1 tablespoon salt and pepper. Then combine dry ingredients with liquid onions and oysters; blend well.

title: Sylvia'S Cheese Spread
instructions: Put cheese in double boiler. Melt and add rest of the ingredients. Pour into containers and serve.

title: Cold Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until done. Refrigerate until cold. When cold peel and dice in small squares. Dice boiled eggs.

title: Sinfully Delicious
instructions: Mix Lorna Doone cookie crumbs with melted butter. Press crust into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix pudding and milk until thick. Blend softened ice cream. Pour on crust. Chill until firm. Before serving spread Cool Whip and sprinkle with crushed Heath bars.

title: Mushroom Saute
instructions: Slice large mushrooms and leave small ones whole. Cut onion in half then into long thin strips. Melt butter with soy sauce. Add remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until onion is almost clear.

title: Frozen Punch
instructions: Put Jell-O in bowl. (Jell-O should be whatever color you want punch.) Add sugar and 4 cups of boiling water. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar. Add remaining 5 cups of water and pineapple juice then freeze. Set out of freezer 4 to 5 hours before time to serve. At time to serve add room temperature Sprite. Punch should be slushy.

title: Baked Hash Browns
instructions: Place hash browns on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soups and sour cream and pour over hash browns. Cover top with French fried onion rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Buddy Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl beat peanut butter and butter until smooth. Add sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Blend in flour and salt. Stir in one cup chocolate morsels. Spread in ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until edges begin to brown. Sprinkle remaining chocolate over cookie layer. Let stand 5 minutes. Spread evenly over top. Cool completely. Cut in 1 1/2-inch bars. Makes about 48 bars.

title: Bug Spray For Vegetable Plants
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spray plants. Be sure to spray under leaves.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and oil. Add all other ingredients and mix together. Put in slightly greased 10-inch glass pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Knife should come out clean when cutting.

title: Crabmeat Au Gratin
instructions: In a pan heat milk chicken base white pepper and Worcestershire to a simmer. Do not boil. In a pan melt butter; stir flour in and cook stirring 2 minutes until flour is incorporated. Stir in warm milk and cook stirring until sauce is thickened. Place crabmeat in a shallow 1 1/2 or 2-quart buttered casserole and sprinkle first with lemon juice then with Parmesan cheese. Cover with white sauce. Sprinkle grated Cheddar over the top. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes until heated through and bubbly. You may substitute crawfish tails for the crabmeat. Makes 6 servings.

title: Divinity Candies
instructions: May add pecan pieces if desired.

title: Mini Cheesecakes(Club Member: Terah Smith)
instructions: With hand mixer beat cream cheese sugar eggs and vanilla until smooth. Put cupcake liners in cupcake pan. Put a vanilla wafer in each flat side down. Put 1 tablespoon cream cheese mixture in each. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Do not overbake or cakes will dry out. Cool cakes. Remove from paper cups and top with 1 teaspoon pie filling. Top with whipped cream. Keep refrigerated. Makes 24.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in a soup pot; drain. Add all other ingredients and bring to a simmer. With lid on simmer for 4 hours. Serve with sour cream and cheese.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat eggs until light. Add mashed bananas and add lemon juice. Blend with creamed mixture. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Mix into banana mixture. Add nuts. Bake in greased loaf pan at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Ultimate Rocky Road
instructions: Melt over hot (not boiling) water the chocolate morsels; stir until smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows nuts and sunflower seeds. Spread in foil-lined 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix hash browns and oleo. Add salt pepper soup cheese sour cream and onions. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Light Salad
instructions: Mix together and put in small baking dish. Refrigerate several hours. Cut into squares.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender. Cool and grate. Saute the onion and add with all other ingredients to the grated potato. Season to taste. Top with crushed corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Put the first 3 ingredients in a pan over low heat. Let boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add the remaining ingredients. Stir until melted. Pour into a greased pan and let cool.

title: Salami
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate for 24 hours. Take out and mix well again and return to refrigerator for another 24 hours. Shape into loaves and bake on broiler pan at 160\u00b0 for 8 hours turning after first 4 hours. After it cools you can slice it and freeze it in sealed bags.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Bake 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Beans(Fat-Free)
instructions: Soak beans overnight or use quick cook method on package. Drain off 1/2 the water after cooking. Add remaining ingredients to cooked beans. Put in a casserole dish and cover to bake. Bake for 3 hours at 350\u00b0. Let stand covered for 30 minutes before serving (to thicken sauce). Serves 8 to 10.

title: Dainty Ham Biscuits
instructions: Slice rolls in half; spread half of mixture on each side. Layer ham beef and cheese. Spread a little of mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Saucy Stroganoff(Low-Fat)
instructions: In a nonstick skillet spray nonfat cooking spray generously. Saute beef or turkey onion mushrooms garlic powder and dry mustard over medium-high heat until meat is browned and onion is tender. Combine mayonnaise yogurt and beef broth and add to beef mixture. Cook over low heat 15 minutes. Serve over hot noodles. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Puffs
instructions: Cream shortening with peanut butter and salt until light and fluffy gradually adding confectioners sugar. Blend in vanilla then flour. Stir in peanuts; mix well. Shape dough into small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven 12 minutes or until golden brown. Roll immediately in confectioners sugar.

title: Baked Ham With Cornbread-Apricot Stuffing
instructions: Place ham on rack in a shallow roasting pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Slice to serve.

title: Three Week Coleslaw
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well. Place the remaining ingredients in saucepan and heat to rolling boil. Mix cabbage and dressing. Add 1/2 cup red wine vinegar. Marinate three days in refrigerator before eating. Keep in refrigerator in airtight container up to 3 weeks.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.\tGrease cookie sheet and lay in wax paper. Mix eggs sugar pumpkin flour spice and nuts in a bowl. Stir and pour in pan and bake. Place a tea towel on counter top and sift powdered sugar on towel until its very white. When pumpkin bread is done place on towel and roll up while its very warm. Let set. Roll up until cold. Unroll. Spread cream cheese filling and roll up again. Slice and enjoy.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Sprinkle vanilla wafer crumbs evenly in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Set aside.

title: Waffles
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat egg yolks with fork. Beat in milk and cooking oil. In a large bowl stir together the flour baking powder and salt. Add egg mixture to flour mixture all at once. Stir mixture until blended but still slightly lumpy. In small mixer bowl beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Carefully fold egg whites into egg-flour mixture. Leave a few fluffs of egg whites. Do not overmix. Lightly grease waffle maker. Cook; do not lift lid while baking. Makes 3 or 4 (9-inch) waffles.

title: Pizza On A Cracker
instructions: Place 12 crackers on uncoated paper plate. Spread 1/2 teaspoon tomato paste on each cracker. Top each with 1 slice pepperoni 1 teaspoon shredded cheese and sprinkle with basil.

title: Melissa'S Blue Ribbon Brownies(State Fair Blue Ribbon Winning Recipe)
instructions: In small saucepan slowly melt margarine and chocolate. In mixing bowl beat eggs until foamy. Add salt. Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Combine chocolate mixture and sugar then fold in flour and chopped nuts if desired. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut in squares when cool.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla in medium saucepan and cook over medium-high heat until it comes to a full boil; stir constantly. Continue to stir and boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Set aside to cool. Make 2 pie shells and bake them.

title: Carnival Lemonade
instructions: If you use 6 ounces lemonade concentrate you use 4 cans of water.

title: Green Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello and water together first then add all ingredients. Chill.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat cream cheese butter and vanilla until fluffy. Gradually add sugars and beat until just combined. Stir in chips. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Place mixture on plastic wrap and shape into a ball. Refrigerate 1 hour. Just before serving roll in pecans. Serve with graham crackers.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Eggs sour cream and butter should be at room temperature.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Add water to juice to make 2 1/4 cups. Saute onion in shortening in large skillet until tender. Add 1 1/4 cups water carrots and bouillon. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Combine sugar cornstarch and ginger. Add catsup vinegar and soy sauce and stir into vegetable mixture. Cook until clear and thickened. Add chicken green peppers and pineapple. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Creamed Onions
instructions: Coarsely chop onions. Boil onions in salted water. Add butter to liquid; stir until melted. Add white sauce to onion mixture. Serve hot. Serves 8 people.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in a greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Dump pineapple and cherries into pan and jiggle around to mix. Sprinkle cake mix over fruit. Crumble margarine and nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until crunchy.

title: Bruschetta Al Pomodoro
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place bread slices on baking sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden on each side. Rub one side of the toasted bread with garlic and drizzle with a little oil. Arrange a few slices of tomato over each slice of bread. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with basil. Drizzle tomatoes with more oil. Serve while warm. Serves 8.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute until soft in the margarine the celery onion and carrots. Add broth and milk reserving 1/2 cup milk. Combine flour and cornstarch in a bowl. Stir milk. Add soda and cheese last. Cook over low heat until cheese melts stirring constantly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Texas Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Add beans; mix well. Place 6 tortillas in casserole pan. Layer ground beef mix cheese and remaining tortillas in casserole. Mix soup and Ro-Tel in bowl. Pour over tortillas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients mix well. Chill. Serve on lettuce leaf. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Custard Type)
instructions: Beat all ingredients together until smooth. Pour into two 9-inch unbaked pie shells and bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes until silver knife comes out clean. May look soft but will set later.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients to make a dough. Use a cookie press to make different cookies (stars bells etc.). Sprinkle colored candy sprinkles on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Dark Brown Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Mix flour soda and cocoa. Add to sugar and oil alternately with buttermilk. Heat coffee to a boil and add to mixture last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Butter a small casserole dish and put in drained green beans. Slice hard-boiled eggs on top. Pour a mixture of mushroom soup and milk that has been heated. Place in 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Cheese-Zucchini Bake
instructions: Mix cottage cheese herbs olives egg and 1 tablespoon of the flour; set aside.

title: Peach Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello sugar and pineapple. Cook 5 minutes. Cool. Whip cream cheese (softened) and 1 cup cold water together. Add pineapple. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Mix Cool Whip in. Pat in molds and refrigerate.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown beef and drain off excess fat. Add sauce and water; simmer about 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients except noodles for filling. Pour about one cup of sauce on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Lavon'S Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and cook 10 to 15 minutes covered. Do not drain. Combine the next 3 ingredients and cook for sauce. Add broth and cheese. Combine all and heat until really hot stirring to prevent scorching. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel and cube eggplant; cook until tender. While eggplant is cooking saute onion bell pepper and celery in oleo. Mash eggplant leaving water in the eggplant. Add crumbled cornbread and egg to mixture. Add onion celery and bell pepper. Place in greased casserole. Top with cheese. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Milk Sponge Cake
instructions: While mixing eggs sugar salt baking powder and flour together heat milk and butter until near boiling point. Add heated milk to mixture; beat for 2 minutes. Add vanilla last. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 28 minutes or until cake leaves the side of pan. Will make 2 layer (9-inch) or sheet cake. Use 7-Minute Frosting or fudge icing on this cake.

title: Cheese Puff
instructions: In greased 6-cup souffle dish combine Ritz crackers cheese and mushrooms. In medium bowl with electric mixer at medium speed beat together eggs milk onion powder parsley and poultry seasoning. Pour over mixture in souffle dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until puffed and lightly browned. Serve hot.

title: Occidental Hotel Hot Fudge
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in medium saucepan. Add milk and cook until thick. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Keep refrigerated. May be reheated or serve cold.

title: Coconut Caramel Dessert
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; press into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool completely. Melt 1/4 cup margarine. Add coconut and 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Cook over low heat stirring often until coconut is golden brown. Cool.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Pour scalded milk over shortening sugar and salt. When cool add 2 cups flour; beat well. Add eggs. Beat. Add yeast which has been dissolved in 1/2 cup warm water. Add rest of flour to make stiff mixture. Let rise until doubled. Melt 1/2 cup oleo 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 tablespoon corn syrup. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on nuts. Roll dough until 1/4-inch thick. Spread with butter 1/4 cup brown sugar and sprinkle cinnamon on. Roll like jelly roll. Cut in 1-inch slices. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn upside-down on foil. Let stand 2 minutes. Makes 2 pans of rolls.

title: Funnel Bread
instructions: You will need 1 pie plate (bottom cut away).

title: Congress Tarts
instructions: Make pie crust. Either your own or pie crust mix. Cut pie crust with cutter and line muffin tins. Put teaspoon of jam on pie crust and then large tablespoon of batter mix on top. Bake until golden brown at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Red Lentil Chili
instructions: Wash lentils. Drain. Cover with vinegar and tomato juice. Let soak for 2 hours. Brown beef cubes and chopped onion. Add spices; add to lentils and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours adding hot water as necessary. Freshness and quality of the spices makes a lot of difference so check the flavor and correct the seasoning 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Wash apples; peel very thin. Core slice and place in shallow baking dish. Mix together white sugar spices and 1/4 teaspoon salt; sprinkle this and lemon juice over apples. Blend flour brown sugar dash of salt and margarine until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples; pat down gently with back of spoon. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Store in tightly covered container. To serve dissolve 1 tablespoon of mixture in cup of hot water. Yields 8 cups.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Heat milk on stove. Add to hot milk the sugar flour and salt (stir these together before adding to milk). Stir constantly and let boil on medium heat. Separate the eggs; beat egg yolks with fork until foamy. Stir eggs in fast when batter is ready. Put back on heat and stir constantly until it boils. Take off heat. Add vanilla 1 tablespoon of butter and coconut.

title: Oatmeal Brownies
instructions: In a bowl combine the first seven ingredients; mix well set aside 1 c for topping. Pat the remaining mixture into a greased 15x10x1 baking pan. Prepare brownie batter according to package directions. Spread over the crust. Sprinkle with the reserved oat mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Cut into bars. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Stew(Leprechaun Stew)
instructions: Heat oil in a 4-quart heavy covered kettle. Add lamb and garlic; cook until meat is browned. Add boiling water; cover and simmer for 3 minutes. Add carrots celery onion potatoes salt pepper and bay leaf. Cover and simmer until all is tender. Mix flour and cold water into a smooth paste. Stir into hot stew. Keep stirring until thickened. Serve with a garnish of chopped parsley. Stew tastes better next day or two days later.

title: Horseradish Sauce
instructions: In a bowl combine all the ingredients. Serve with beef.

title: Olive Corn Pie
instructions: Mix crumbs with melted butter. Reserve 1 cup; press remainder onto bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate. Set aside.

title: Cape Cod Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp and cut small. Remove from pan. Fry pork until golden brown. Remove from pan. Saute onions until soft. Drain clams saving juice then chop clams fine. Add to clam juice enough water to make 3 cups. Bring to a boil and add potatoes browned pork onions and bacon. Simmer until potatoes are done about 15 minutes. Blend flour to a smooth paste with cold water add to the potatoes stirring until it boils and thickens. Add clams and seasonings. Add the milk and add slowly to hot clam mixture. Add 2 tablespoons butter when done. Serves 6.

title: Drop Doughnuts
instructions: Cream sugar and eggs. Add other ingredients. Drop from teaspoon into hot lard until brown.

title: Chess Pie No. 1
instructions: Combine butter sugar and vinegar in a saucepan. Stir constantly over low heat until sugar is dissolved. Pour hot mixture over beaten eggs beating constantly. Fold in vanilla and salt. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Basil Linguine
instructions: In a large serving bowl combine the first seven ingredients. Let stand at room temperature for up to 1 1/2 hours. Cook linguine according to package directions; drain. Toss with cheese mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Stir all ingredients. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Boil vinegar sugar and water. Mix together cornstarch brown sugar and pineapple juice. Add to liquid cook until thickens. Saute pepper onions and chestnuts. Add oranges pineapple and chicken. Pour thickened mixture over. Cook rice as directed. Serve chicken over rice or Chinese noodles if preferred.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar and well beaten egg. Add remaining ingredients. Chill for 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Date Torte
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar slowly while beating. Fold in dates and nutmeats. Bake in buttered cake pan for 60 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Schnitzel Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; take out of skillet and drain. Add sugar and vinegar to bacon grease. Cook until sugar is dissolved. Add green beans and bacon crumbled. Simmer 20 minutes. Add onion.

title: Black Forest Cake (Schwarz Wald Torte)
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl stir until well mixed. Add shortening eggs milk and vanilla. Beat 3 minutes at low speed.

title: Lemon Glazed Persimmon Bars
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and oil; mix well. Stir 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice and baking soda into pulp. Combine flour salt and spices. Add to egg mixture alternately with persimmon mixture mixing well after each addition. Stir in walnuts and raisins. Spread in greased and floured oblong pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool for 5 minutes.

title: Uptown Beer Meat Balls
instructions: Combine first five ingredients and mix well. Make small size (1-inch diameter) meat balls and fry in small amount of oil (if necessary) evenly on all sides. Drain on paper towel.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer each ingredient beginning with the lettuce.

title: Meat Filled Jumbo Shells
instructions: Cook jumbo shells according to package directions; drain. Cool on paper. Brown beef and pork in skillet; drain.
