instructions: In electric skillet combine ring bologna (chopped bite size) kidney beans (dont drain) and stewed tomatoes (dont drain). Boil rice. Add to mixture. Add chili powder; salt to taste. Simmer on low about 20 minutes.

title: Aunt Jennie'S Butter Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream butter until light. Gradually beat in sugar. Beat in egg milk and vanilla. Add baking powder and salt mixing well. Gradually blend in flour mixing thoroughly.

title: Raisin Cream Pie
instructions: Boil raisins in water until tender. Drain liquid from raisins. Combine sugar flour and salt and gradually stir in milk. Add raisins. Cook and stir over hot water for 5 minutes. Add beaten egg yolks and cook until thick. Pour into baked shell. Cover with meringue.

title: Chicken With Pineapple Glaze
instructions: Mix this all together well and brush over chicken. Serve with rice or noodles. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into a ball. Refrigerate until ready to use. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Egg Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Butter bread on one side and dice into 1/2-inch cubes. Grate cheese. In 2-quart buttered casserole alternate layers of bread and cheese (4 layers). Mix rest of ingredients. Pour over bread and cheese. Refrigerate overnight and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Lasagna
instructions: Take an unbleached muslin bag put some sweet fresh hay in bottom of the bag; add the ham and put hay firmly all around ham. Tie the bag and hang in dry place. Ham treated in this manner will keep for years.

title: Strawberry Brownie Torte
instructions: Grease two 9-inch round layer cake pans. Line with wax paper extending up sides of pans; grease wax paper.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt oleo; add mixed dry ingredients. Combine eggs and vanilla and add to dry ingredients. Bake in a greased pie pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with ice cream.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Two bunches means 2 clusters as it is purchased.

title: The Ultimate Sugar Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine sugar and Crisco in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs syrup and vanilla. Beat well. Combine 3 cups flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add gradually to creamed mixture at low speed. Mix until well blended. Divide dough into quarters. If dough is too sticky refrigerate 1 hour. Keep covered until ready to roll. Place a quarter roll of dough on floured paper. Roll dough to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut out with floured cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Sprinkle with sugar or decors if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 to 9 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix together. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and spread on flour tortillas. Roll tightly and chill.

title: Sour Cream Cranberry Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter and flour two 7 x 5-inch loaf pans. In medium bowl sift flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In large bowl with electric mixer beat butter until creamy. Add sugar and orange peel; beat until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add sour cream and orange juice alternately with flour mixture. Blend in fresh cranberries. Pour into prepared pans and bake for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: *Low-fat cream cheese and reduced fat mayo may be used results are delicious.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In blender or food processor process oats until coarse flour. In a small bowl combine ground oats flour salt and baking soda. Set aside.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Combine margarine and cream cheese in microwave oven until soft. Combine with spinach artichokes black pepper and 1 teaspoon lemon juice. Stir well. Spoon into a lightly greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: In saucepan combine cider spices and lemon juice. Cover and heat over medium-low heat for 30 minutes. Strain. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Mini Pizza
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage; drain. Add cheese to meat. Add remaining ingredients. Spread on party rye bread. Place in 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes if not frozen. May be frozen first and baked as needed.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Put chicken in bottom of oblong casserole dish. Tear tortillas in pieces and place on top of chicken. Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and cook until tender. Add soup and tomatoes and let come to a boil. Pour over chicken and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Egg Puff
instructions: In bowl of electric mixer beat eggs until light and lemony. Add flour baking powder cottage cheese Jack cheese and melted butter. Blend smooth then stir in chilies. Pour mixture into buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until top is browned and center appears firm.

title: Cherry-Coconut Bars
instructions: Measure flour; mix with butter and powdered sugar until smooth. Spread this with fingers in ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Mix liquids and butter; add potatoes and onions and cook until done. Mix cracker crumbs flour and seasonings. Add to potato and onions mixture. Add red and green peppers after you have chopped and sauteed briefly in butter; mix well. Bring to a boil; add cream (or milk) and corn. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. This makes 2 or more quarts.

title: Jersey Baked Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken; pat dry. Place chicken in ungreased baking dish. Pour salad dressing over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Serve with white or brown rice salad and cranberry sauce.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening together. Beat eggs until light. Add mashed bananas and lemon juice; blend with shortening and sugar. Sift flour baking powder and salt together; mix quickly into banana mixture. Add nuts. Bake in greased loaf pan at 375\u00b0 for 90 minutes.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Drain salmon and remove bones if any. Mix all ingredients and form into patties. Fry on both sides until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and peanut butter together. Add sugar gradually and cream thoroughly. Add well beaten egg to creamed mixture. Sift flour soda baking powder and salt together and add to creamed mixture. Chill dough well then form into balls the size of a walnut. Place balls on lightly greased baking sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in flour making a crisscross pattern. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven. Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook together milk sugar and 2 tablespoons butter until it comes to a soft ball stage. Then add peanut butter and 1 tablespoon butter. Stir together and pour into buttered platter.

title: Chili Chip Casserole
instructions: Spread broken tortilla chips in bottom of casserole dish. Pour chili over chips. Top with cheese onion olives and/or peppers. Bake until warmed through. Serve with sour cream and lettuce.

title: Pork Chops And Vegetables
instructions: In a large skillet heat oil. Add chops 3 at a time; brown well on both sides. Remove and set aside. Add green peppers and onions; saute for 3 minutes. Remove and set aside. Stir in flour; cook and stir for 1 minute. Blend in onion soup Worcestershire sauce garlic powder and salt. Bring to boiling point. Return chops to skillet; spoon sauce over chops. Cover and simmer until tender abut 1 hour. Stir in tomatoes sauteed green peppers and onions. Cover and simmer 5 minutes longer.

title: Barbecued Beef
instructions: Rub seasoned salt into roast. Brown lightly. Add water; cover and simmer until tender (2 to 2 1/2 hours). Remove meat from juice to cool. Measure 2 cups meat juice. Add tomato sauce and beef stew mix. Add brown sugar. Simmer for 20 minutes. Shred meat and add to sauce. Makes delicious sandwiches. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pothead Pot Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper pot roast; brown on all sides in 1 tablespoon oil. Mix the rest of the ingredients together and pour over roast. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Green Tomato Sweet Pickles
instructions: Soak tomato slices in mixture of lime and water for 24 hours. Remove tomatoes from lime water and soak in clear water for 4 hours changing water each hour. Remove from water. Mix sugar vinegar and allspice (tied in gauze cloth loosely). Put tomato slices and sugar mixture together and bring to boil. Remove from heat and let stand 24 hours in solution. Cook gently 1 hour then seal in hot jars.

title: Cream Scones
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut margarine into flour sugar baking powder and salt until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in 1 egg the currants orange rind and just enough half and half so dough leaves side of bowl.\tTurn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead lightly ten times. Roll 1/2-inch thick.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Scrub and cut up new potatoes with skins on. Cook until tender; drain well. While potatoes are still hot add Ranch dressing. Put in serving dish. Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: V-8 Juice Hot
instructions: In a hurry? Serve V-8 hot for appetizer. Add small can spicy V-8 for a little spice.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. The thinner the batter the lighter the hush puppies. Drop into hot grease and brown both sides.

title: Texas Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients for a fantastic barbecue sauce.

title: Peanut Butter Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together and place in pie crust. Freeze.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Cook pie shell as directed; set aside. In skillet brown ground beef. Drain excess oil off. Add onion salt and pepper to taste. Place in cooked pie shell. Cover with American cheese. Place in oven at 150\u00b0 until cheese has melted.

title: Chess Pie Bars
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Put in bottom of 8 x 8 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Mix brown sugar 1/2 cup sugar and flour. Add to beaten eggs. Add melted butter and vanilla; mix well. Pour over baked pastry. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: 60 Minute Hot Rolls
instructions: Heat margarine milk and water to lukewarm. Add sugar salt and yeast. Mix thoroughly. Add flour until dough is no longer sticky. Let stand until dough has doubled in bulk. Press down; knead and roll into small balls. Let the dough rise again and bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Chicken Monte Carlo
instructions: Layer broccoli and chicken in 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish. Mix together other ingredients (soup mayonnaise lemon juice and cheese). Pour over chicken and broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Top with Pepperidge Farm mix and melted margarine. Return to oven and brown.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0; grease shallow 1 1/2-quart or 8-inch square baking dish. Set aside.

title: Graham Cracker Toffee
instructions: Line a large cookie sheet with aluminum foil dull side up. Spray with Pam. Break crackers into small sections at the perforations. Lay crackers close together (within 1/8 to 1/4-inch). In a medium saucepan bring the margarine sugar and flavoring to a rolling boil stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Pour mixture over crackers. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove immediately and sprinkle with chocolate chips if desired. Cool on wire rack. Break into sections; store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Fruitcake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour bottom and sides of 12-cup fluted tube pan or 10-inch tube pan. In large bowl combine eggs and water. Add remaining ingredients by hand. Stir until combined. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 75 to 85 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool 30 minutes.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Brown meatballs and add to sauce.

title: Frozen Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Layer these in large bowl. Let stand 2 to 3 hours mixing occasionally. Meanwhile mix vinegar and sugar until sugar is dissolved; pour over drained cucumbers. Put in containers and freeze.

title: Hidden Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions. With electric mixer beat cream cheese sugar egg and salt; set aside. Fill cupcake liners 3/4 full. Drop teaspoon of cheese mixture to which chocolate chips have been added into each cupcake-filled liner. Bake according to directions on cake mix package.

title: Shrimp Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in casserole dish. Combine all ingredients in dish with melted margarine. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spanish Coffee
instructions: Use red wine glasses with a large bowl. Heat water in glasses in microwave. Make one drink a a time. Place the Cointreau and sugar in the glass and swirl then flame caramelizing the sugar. Add coffee. Add rest of liquor. Top with whipped cream sugar and chocolate jimmies. Makes 1. Turn off the lights when flaming; a great show and a great drink!

title: Tuna Cheese Twist
instructions: Mix baking mix and 1/2 cup water until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 20 strokes. Gently smooth into ball on floured cloth. Knead 5 times. Roll into 14 x 11-inch rectangle. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.

title: Grandma'S Original Homemade Potato Pancakes
instructions: Pour oil 3/4 inch in deep frying pan. Grate potatoes in wooden bowl. Add salt pepper egg and cinnamon. Mix all ingredients except corn flakes and applesauce. Add corn flake crumbs a little at a time until slightly firm. Make sure oil is good and hot. Spoon batter in oil. Keep turning until golden brown. Serve with applesauce and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Steamed Broccoli
instructions: Arrange broccoli in a vegetable steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam 8 minutes or until crisp-tender.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix corn Jiffy mix eggs butter 1/2 sour cream and 1/2 grated cheese. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Spread top with remaining sour cream then remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mary Lou Lange'S Spaghetti Sauce For 100
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Combine all ingredients; simmer. Use with 15 pounds of spaghetti noodles 10 loaves French bread 3 bags salad and 2 quarts of salad dressing.

title: 15 Minute Pickles
instructions: In medium saucepan combine sugar vinegar salt and spice. Bring to a boil. Put cucumbers onions and peppers in alternate layers in 1-quart jars. Pour boiling liquid over all. Seal and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate-Banana Meal-In-A-Muffin(Contains All 4 Food Groups)
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients blending until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Stir just until mixed. Put into 12 muffin tins sprayed with Pam. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes.

title: Marinated Pork Roast
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pork loin in a jar and shake well making sure all is well blended. Pour over pork loin and cover. Refrigerate overnight. Turn pork several times. Place meat fat side up on rack in a greased shallow roasting pan; reserve marinade. Roast in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 3 hours. Baste pork with marinade several times while roasting. Marinade forms very dark crust on roast. This is one of my familys favorites.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat well with spoon. Add coconut then buttermilk. Pour into 2 unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown.

title: Raspberry Poke Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package baking in well-greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan 15 minutes then poke with fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water and spoon over cake in pan. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Top with thawed Cool Whip. Garnish with raspberries or colored sprinkles. Serves 8.

title: Beef And Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick coating. Mix Ricotta cheese cottage cheese parsley and garlic. Pour 1 cup of sauce in bottom of pan. Arrange 1/3 of the noodles in the pan so that they touch but do not overlap. Spread 1/2 of the cheese mixture over the noodles. Top with 1/2 of the Mozzarella cheese. Top this with 1 cup of sauce 1/3 of the noodles then remainder of cheese mixture and the rest of the Mozzarella cheese. Add another cup of sauce another layer of noodles and the remainder of the sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake covered lightly with aluminum foil for 1 hour. Yields 12 servings.

title: Poppy Seed Torte
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except crust). Cook until thick. Pour over crust. Beat 4 egg whites stiff. Add 8 teaspoons sugar two at a time. Spread over filling. Bake until egg whites are brown.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Cut stem ends off tomatoes and hollow out leaving 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick shells. Discard seeds. Chop tomato pulp and tops. Set aside. Halve seed peel and cut the avocado into chunks. Combine the chunks cottage cheese lemon juice garlic salt and pepper sauce in blender or food processor until mixture is smooth. Stir in chopped tomato. Makes 16 (2 tablespoon) servings of dip.

title: Chocolate Eclair Pie
instructions: Put a layer of graham crackers on bottom. Blend pudding and milk then blend Cool Whip in pudding. Put a layer of pudding then a layer of crackers then last layer of pudding. Melt chocolate frosting and pour over top.

title: Crab And Cheese Spread
instructions: Soften cheese and spread on a dinner plate. Sprinkle crab meat over cheese. Mix catsup and horseradish and spread over all. Serve with crackers.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour salt soda cinnamon and baking powder. Beat eggs; add sugar vanilla and oil. Then add zucchini. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 2 ungreased loaf pans. Cook about 1 hour.

title: Peanut Bars
instructions: Melt over hot water the milk chocolate chips and oleo. When melted add marshmallows and peanuts. Mix together. Press in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies well and set aside. Cream powdered sugar cream cheese and oleo together and set aside. Mix Cool Whip milk and pudding mix together and set aside. Layer in 8-inch diameter flower pot or plastic bowl.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Prepare jello and let stand until it starts to thicken. Grind and dice rest of the ingredients. Add sugar to ground cranberries oranges apples and celery (finely chopped). Add all ingredients to jello and chill.

title: Tater Tot Bake
instructions: In skillet brown the meat and onion; drain fat. Season with salt and pepper. Place in a greased 2-quart casserole. Top with potatoes. Combine soup and milk; pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Yields 2 to 3 servings.

title: Lazy Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 8-inch round or square baking dish. Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add milk stirring until blended. Spoon over batter. Do not stir. Add fruit. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Cajun Crawfish Etoufee
instructions: Melt butter then add onion and bell pepper. Cook on medium heat for 20 minutes. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and cream of mushroom soup. Bring to a boil. Lower fire to medium heat and let cook for 20 minutes. Add crawfish and cook for 15 minutes or until crawfish is tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream the shortening butter and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Add the flour alternating with the 7-Up. Add the flavorings and bake in a greased tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chili Corn Bread Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet stirring until crumbly. Drain. Add onion and green pepper. Cook for several minutes stirring often. Stir in salt seasoning mix and tomato sauce. Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine muffin mix and evaporated milk in a bowl. Mix well. Spread evenly over casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil. Divide into 4 portions forming each into a patty. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Heat oil over high heat reduce heat to medium and add patties. Cook turning once until browned about 3 minutes on each side. Serve on warmed platter with a seafood sauce. Yield 2 servings of 2 patties each.

title: Easy Pralines
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the pecans and cook at a low temperature until the sugar is dissolved. Then boil until the soft ball stage is reached. Add pecans. Stir until it just begins to harden. This candy hardens very quickly once it has started to thicken in the pan. Quickly drop by spoonfuls into 2-inch patties on wax paper. Let stand until firm.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 4 minutes. Drain. Place in buttered casserole. Place grated cheese on broccoli. Add milk and cream of mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Place onion rings on top and bake 10 minutes more. Serves 8.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown the meat with onion in oil until meat is browned. Drain well and add seasonings. In greased casserole alternate layers of cabbage and meat mixture. Pour tomato soup over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (If desired add 2 cups cooked rice alternating with other ingredients.)

title: French Dip Sandwich
instructions: Remove all visible fat. Place roast in slow cooker. Combine soy sauce bouillon and spices. Pour over roast add water to almost cover roast. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 to 12 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat from broth reserve broth shred meat with fork and serve on hard rolls or French bread. Dip into broth.

title: Quick And Easy Chili
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan over medium heat cook beef onion and garlic until beef is no longer pink stirring occasionally to break up meat. Drain. Add beans salsa chili powder and oregano. Cover and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve topped with cheese.

title: Wyoming Whopper Cookies
instructions: *I use Jif brand peanut butter. If unavailable use another brand but add several tablespoons water to mixture.

title: Orange Drop Cookies
instructions: Peel orange. Remove seed and skin. Combine sugar shortening orange orange juice eggs soda salt and flour in a large mixing bowl. Mix well. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on and ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees until lightly brown. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Transfer cookies to rack to cool completely.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pineapple in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place pie filling on top of pineapple. Sprinkle dry cake mix over; sprinkle nuts over the cake mix. Cut up oleo over all. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute first three ingredients in saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer one hour.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Quarter biscuits; roll in cinnamon and sugar that have been mixed together. Put in greased Bundt pan. Melt butter brown sugar and water; boil 2 minutes and pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Frozen Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in pie crusts. Freezer several hours until firm.

title: Hamburger Cookies
instructions: Color half of frosting red and half yellow. Pile coconut and green food coloring in sandwich bag and work coloring in for lettuce. Frost bottom half of 1/2 vanilla wafer with yellow and half red. Sandwich wafers with grasshopper cookie in between and coconut for lettuce. Boil water (1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon sugar). Cool. Brush on top of top wafer. Sprinkle with sesame seed.

title: Mexican Caviar
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Adjust salt to taste. Serve with chips.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 casserole dish with pam spray and line dish with crescent rolls. Layer on top of rolls sausage then cheese. Mix eggs and milk and pour over cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake in preheated oven at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef onion and garlic in large saucepan or Dutch oven until meat is brown and onion is tender. Add tomatoes; break up with a fork. Stir in tomato sauce 2 tablespoons parsley flakes the sugar 1 teaspoon salt and the basil. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 1 hour or until mixture is the consistency of spaghetti sauce.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Divide nuts and morsels in 2 unbaked pie shells. Over this pour mixture of margarine eggs sugar syrup and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes; may take less time.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Combine 2 cups raisins 3 cups boiling water and 2/3 cup sugar and boil 10 minutes. Add cornstarch mixed in a little water 1 egg nutmeg and butter. Cook until mixture thickens. Put into unbaked pie shell and add top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 400\u00b0 and continue baking until crust is brown.

title: Cinnamon Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs preserves and cinnamon. Combine soda and buttermilk; add to mixture then add flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Yam And Carrot Tsimmes
instructions: Cook carrots and yams until tender. Drain. Mix with other ingredients. Layer in a baking dish with brown sugar between layers. Add water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until apples are tender. Remove cover and continue baking until top is golden brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Stir together well cranberry sauce pineapple and sugar. Add chopped bananas and nuts. Stir well. Defrost Cool Whip and fold into mixture until all fruit is combined with the Cool Whip. Pour into plastic container (or several smaller containers) and freeze. Allow to sit out at room temperature about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
instructions: Combine eggs sugar peanut butter and vanilla. Blend well. Add dry ingredients and mix only until mixture is smooth. Spread into greased large baking dish. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 23 minutes.

title: Munchos Nachos
instructions: On a large microwave-safe plate arrange 8 to 10 tortilla chips or as many as will fit in one layer. Spoon about 1 tablespoon salsa in center of each chip. Top with a few pieces of tomatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Repeat until all tortilla chips are topped making 4 plates in all. Microwave each plate on High for 1 minute or until cheese is melted. Remove plate carefully as it may be hot. Top each nacho with about 1 tablespoon sour cream. Serve immediately.

title: Crock-Pot Meal To Serve Over Noodles
instructions: Cut meat in pieces. Mix other ingredients. Pour over meat. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve over noodles. Can cook in crock-pot on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Creamy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Prepare rice according to package directions. Spread rice in a buttered shallow 1- 1/2 quart baking dish. Arrange asparagus over rice. Top with chicken. Blend soup sour cream milk lemon juice and 1/2 cup of cheese. Add salt and pepper. Spread over chicken. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Sweet 'N Hot Mustard
instructions: Combine dry mustard with vinegar in glass bowl (do not use aluminum). Mix well and let stand for about 1 hour. Mix sugar and flour together. Combine all ingredients in double boiler or nonstick pan and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or desired thickness. Makes about 2 cups. Keeps in refrigerator for months.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Great to make the night before.

title: Kahlua Cheesecake
instructions: Blend cream cheese on low of electric mixer. When well blended add flour salt cocoa and half of sugar. Separate egg whites and yolks. On low speed blend whipping cream egg yolks and kahlua. Blend well; mix cream cheese mixture. On high speed in another bowl beat egg whites with remaining sugar until stiff. Fold in cheese mixture. Cover bottom of pan with aluminum foil. Grease sides of pan. Make crust of graham cracker and margarine. Pat 1/2-inch thick into bottom of pan. Spoon in cheese mixture into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours.

title: Chocolate Chess Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pie shells until sugar dissolves. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Center will be soft and set up as cools. Makes 2.

title: Buttered Breadsticks
instructions: In a medium bowl combine 1 1/3 cups flour baking powder sugar and salt. Gradually add milk. Stir in the remaining flour to form a soft dough. Turn onto a lightly floured board. Knead gently for 1/2 minute. Roll into a 1/4-inch thick rectangle. Cut in half widthwise then cut each lengthwise into 6 strips. Brush one side with butter. Place butter side down on a greased baking sheet. Butter other side and fold each strip nearly in half. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 1 dozen.

title: Sesame Potato Spears
instructions: Pare and cut potatoes in strips. Grease a cookie sheet and place potatoes on the sheet arranging them so they do not touch. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle salt paprika and sesame seed over the top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Turn if you wish. Serves 6.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: In small bowl combine refried beans and chilies; spread on serving plate. Combine sour cream and taco seasoning; spoon bean mixture spreading evenly. In another bowl mash avocados; stir in lime juice and salt. Spoon evenly over sour cream mixture. Cover; chill 3 hours.

title: Mama'S Jam Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk Crisco jam and eggs; mix well. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or in 2 (9-inch) pans for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Blend wet ingredients. Fold in dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Grandma Bonnie'S Favorite Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients except for 1/2 cup milk on low speed for 1 minute. Add 1/2 cup milk and beat 1 more minute. Pour into pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Hummingbird Cake With Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar with all other dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Add eggs and oil. Stir until moist; do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple nuts bananas and cherries. Spoon into three 9-inch cake pans (or tube pan) which has been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes for 3 layers or 1 hour for tube pan. Use Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Beans And More
instructions: Brown ground meat and drain off excess grease. Brown bacon and onions. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook slowly 3 to 4 hours.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: *Important to use escarole as it will not wilt.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese slices. Combine soup and wine stirring well. Spoon sauce evenly over chicken and sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: White Jello
instructions: Cream sugar and cheese together; add vanilla and milk. Dissolve gelatine in boiling water; add cold water. Set aside. Let cool but not set. To the cream cheese mixture add Cool Whip pineapple and nuts. When gelatine is cool add to mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish and refrigerate.

title: Seedless Grapes In Sour Cream
instructions: Wash and stem grapes. Put in glass bowl. Top with sour cream and sprinkle with sugar. Chill for several hours before serving.

title: Quick Chili Relleno
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 1-quart baking dish. Place 1/2 of cheese in baking dish and cover with chilies. Pour eggs over cheese and chilies. Add the stewed tomatoes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and slightly brown.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients with milk until stiff enough to drop into hot oil or grease. Fry until golden brown.

title: Orange Delight Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding mix dry jello and boiling water. Bring to a boil. Let boil for one minute. Cool. Blend in Cool Whip and oranges. Pour into dish or mold. Can be made ahead and holds up well.

title: Chinese Barbecue Sauce For Fish
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Let fish marinate in sauce 30 minutes to 2 hours or longer. Broil fish basting with marinade. Makes 2 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Grandma'S Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops on stove top. Place a layer in deep baking dish top with sliced onion rings and top that with tomato soup. Repeat until dish is full usually 4 to 5 layers. Bake uncovered at 475\u00b0 until mixture bubbles then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 1 hour covered. Serve with baked potatoes; use juices for topping.

title: Yummy Peanut Butter Cookies(Diabetic Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet lightly. Sift flour baking soda and baking powder. Work margarine and peanut butter with spoon until creamy; gradually add brown sugar substitute continue working until light. Add regular sugar substitute and egg; beat well. Mix in dry ingredients thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased heavy-duty aluminum foil; flatten with tines of fork. Bake about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Kraut Slaw
instructions: Heat sugar and vinegar until completely dissolved. Allow to cool. Pour over first 5 ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and chill well.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain fat from ground beef. Add onion and garlic powder. Add to preceeding ingredients the taco seasoning mix tomatoes salt and pepper to taste green chilies and tomato sauce. Simmer 5 minutes. Spoon in flour tortillas and roll up. Place in oblong pan. If you have meat mixture left over spoon over tortillas.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Combine soup oil vinegar sugar mustard and pepper. Pour over hot carrots. Add chopped celery onion and green pepper. Keeps up to 3 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Tuna Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in casserole. Spread tuna over the top. Add one-half can of the mushroom soup the stuffing mix and then the rest of the soup. Top with Cheddar cheese and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for one hour. Serves four.

title: Old Fashion Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 2 round pans or a 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong pan with Pam. In a large mixing bowl mix all dry ingredients. Add eggs milk oil and vanilla. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Remove beater. Stir in boiling water. Batter will be thin. Pour into prepared pans. Bake in round pans 30 to 35 minutes or 35 to 40 minutes in an oblong pan or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan to a wire rack. Cool completely. Frost with frosting of your choice.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. (This is easy to double).

title: Jam Sandwich
instructions: Place bologna on top of one slice of bread. Carefully center the second slice of bread over the bologna and then jam it together.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook chicken; let cool. Take off the bone. Cook noodles in broth of chicken. Saut bell pepper in butter. Add enough flour and milk to make a white sauce. It should be thick but not lumpy. Melt cheese in this mixture while it is hot. Then add cream of mushroom soup. Combine all ingredients and place in a large casserole dish. Top with corn flake crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly hot.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let set for at least eight hours.

title: Cafe-Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice coffee and butter in a double boiler for about 25 minutes. Combine all ingredients except cinnamon; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Set casserole in pan of warm water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Turn off heat; let stand in oven for 30 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water for 45 minutes or until tender. Let cool to touch; peel and mash. Combine potatoes sugar eggs vanilla milk and 1/2 cup butter. Beat at medium speed until smooth. Spoon into a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish then combine brown sugar pecan flour and 2 tablespoons of butter; sprinkle mixture over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Ice
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid as directed on package. Add remaining sugar and lemon juice. Mix well. In blender puree ice. Add enough lemonade mixture to satisfy your taste. Makes 4 drinks.

title: Sunny Fruit Fiesta
instructions: Use melon baller. Scoop flesh from cantaloupe and honeydew into balls and set aside. In a large glass bowl combine sugar lime juice lemon juice orange liqueur and lime zest. Stir well to dissolve sugar. Add cantaloupe balls honeydew balls strawberries and grapes. Toss gently. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour to blend flavors stirring once or twice. Spoon fruit mixture into serving bowls or hollowed out melon halves. Serve immediately.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs with 1 stick melted margarine. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 1 stick softened margarine sugar vanilla and eggs. Beat with mixer for 15 minutes. Pour over crust. Slice bananas lengthwise and lay side by side on previous layer. Drain pineapple lay over bananas. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts. Top with cherries.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add oil and carrots. Sift cake mix pudding and cinnamon. Mix all together. Bake in 3 round cake layers at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease round layer pan 9 x 1 1/2-inch or square pan 8 x 8 x 2 or 9 x 9 x 2-inch. Blend all ingredients; beat vigorously 1/2 minute. Add blueberries (roll lightly in flour so they will not sink).

title: Texas Pete Hot Wingers
instructions: Cut wings at all joints. Throw away wing tips. Place wings on paper towels to absorb all water.

title: Spanish Fried Rice
instructions: Soak rice in hot water for 1/2 hour; drain well. Spread in big shallow pan to dry a little about 1 hour. Cook bacon until crisp; crumble and set aside. Add rice to drippings and cook until rice is lightly browned. Add crumbled bacon beef broth tomato sauce green pepper onion garlic and cumin seed. Cover; cook over low heat stirring now and then until rice is done and liquid absorbed about 30 minutes (add extra water if needed).

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown ground meat in large frying pan breaking it up as it cooks. Drain fat. Add onion and bell pepper. Saute with meat until tender. Add tomato juice salt pepper and garlic powder. Add salsa in amount necessary to make spicy for your taste. Bring mixture to a boil. Add rice and olives. Stir cover and remove from heat. Let stand covered at least five minutes before serving.

title: Danish Sweet Rolls
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients like pie crust. Add the eggs milk and yeast mixture. Beat. Add 1 cup flour. Dough will be soft. Let set in refrigerator for several hours. Take out. Cut into 4 parts and roll out each part (like pie crust). Spread with butter. Cut into triangular wedges. Roll each wedge from wide side to point. Let rise and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Frost and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Baked Pizza No. 2
instructions: Make dough. Spread on pizza pan. Cover with onions which have been sliced and fried in oil and garlic pepper and salt. Lay on top of dough slices of fresh tomatoes with a few pitted ripe olives and a few filleted anchovies (washed of salt). Add several strips of pimentos. Bake in hot (400\u00b0) oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Jalapeno Hominy
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan and bring to a boil. Stir often to mix cheese. Serve immediately. Delicious!

title: Old-Fashioned Bread Pudding
instructions: Tear bread into small bite-size pieces. Add and mix all ingredients together. Pour into buttered baking dish. Bake about 30 minutes or until done at 350\u00b0. Can be served hot or cold. Fresh fruit garnish makes it more tempting.

title: Best-Ever Cake Layer
instructions: In a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer blend ingredients at high speed for 2 minutes. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and frost with Caramel or 7 Minute Icing.

title: Everything Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients then add chicken or turkey celery peas onions and green peppers. Pile lightly in a casserole dish. Cover with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Top with cheese and potato chips. Heat 5 minutes longer. Serves 8.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: You will need 1 pan size 12 3/4 x 9 x 2-inches (or approximately).

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Grease mold with mayonnaise. Heat tomato soup and cream cheese until softened. Add mayonnaise while still warm then add rest of ingredients. Gelatine is last to be added. Refrigerate overnight. Remove from mold when ready to use. Serve with crackers.

title: French Strawberry Pie(No Sugar)
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Wash and cap strawberries. Add sweetener. Press 1 1/2 cups strawberries through strainer. Add food coloring. If desired add lemon juice and bring to boil. Remove from heat and soften gelatin stirring to dissolve. Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Fold in remaining whole strawberries. Spoon in cooled pie shell. Refrigerate until set. Garnish with whipped cream.

title: Grandma Merritt'S Famous Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar. Mix well. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add milk. Slowly add flour*. When mixed well add flavorings. (*With salt and baking powder.)

title: Lentil-Spinach Stew
instructions: Rinse lentils; set aside. In a large saucepan or Dutch oven cook onion and garlic until tender not brown. Stir in lentils water tomatoes bouillon Worcestershire sauce salt thyme fennel seed pepper and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add carrots and frozen spinach. Bring to a boil breaking up spinach with a fork; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes or until lentils are tender. Add vinegar; discard bay leaf. Makes 4 servings.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well with pastry blender fork or mixer. Mix until mixture is like small peas. In small bowl beat together vinegar egg & water. Combine with the flour mixture until it is blended well. Divide into 5 portions and shape into flat patties. Wrap well in plastic or foil. Refrigerate or freeze. Will keep in refrigerator a week or months in freezer.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise milk seasoned salt and pepper. Mix well; set aside. Mix cauliflower broken up in small pieces onion peas and celery in a bowl. Add mayonnaise mixture and mix well. Set in refrigerator and chill.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Pour butter over topping ingredients and crumble over potato mixture. Bake 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Neighborhood Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add rest of ingredients. Cover with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Hot Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Roll pieces of chicken in cornstarch. Heat corn oil in frying pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken; quickly brown. Sprinkle with garlic. Add tomato water chestnuts mushrooms onions and celery; stir. Sprinkle with Accent. Stir in soy sauce. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add lettuce; toss. Serve with rice.

title: Animal Cracker Necklaces
instructions: Melt candy coating. Spread candy coating generously on flat side of 4 animal crackers. Place one pretzel in the coating on each cracker leaving top 2 holes of pretzel open to allow for threading ribbon of necklace. Allow to set. Repeat with remaining candy animal crackers and pretzels. Great for rainy days!

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with Parmesan cheese. Serve with goldfish crackers.

title: Low-Fat Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Combine rest of ingredients and fold in macaroni. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all of the dry ingredients in a bowl. Make a well in the center. Add eggs and oil. Stir well until moistened. Stir in strawberries and pecans. Pour batter into 2 lightly greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Meringue Kisses
instructions: Bring egg whites to room temperature. Beat together; add sugar slowly. Add salt. Beat 7 minutes in a double boiler; then add vanilla and nut meats. Place by tablespoonful on oleo-greased cookie sheet 1 inch apart. Bake in a slow 275\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until dry. If not dry allow 10 minutes more.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cook green bell pepper slices onion and garlic in shortening in covered skillet over low heat until tender. Stir in soup water lemon juice seasoning and shrimp. Cook about 10 minutes. Stir often. Serve over rice. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Rosenberry Steak Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour over steak. Marinate overnight or as long as you wish. We marinate it for up to 2 days.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain squash. Melt oleo in casserole dish. Stir in Stove Top cornbread stuffing. Set aside 1 cup of stuffing and oleo.

title: Gooey Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugars and eggs. Mix in remaining ingredients. This is a double batch. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar flour eggs soda and pineapple (and juice) with mixer on low speed. Then add nuts. Pour into a 9 x 12 inch greased pan and bake for 40 minutes. Stir together brown sugar cream cheese and margarine with spoon. Put frosting on cake while cake is still hot. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Crock-Pot Beef Stew
instructions: Put the ingredients in the order shown in crock-pot. Turn on high until it starts to boil then turn to low for 4 or 5 hours. Or leave on low all day.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef onion salt and pepper in skillet. Drain off grease and put in a slow cooker. Then add cheese tomato sauce and chiles. Mix until cheese is melted. Serve warm. Dip in your favorite chips.

title: Diet Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop onion and beef. Mix with cream cheese. Form in ball.

title: Noodles
instructions: Roll very thin on a floured board. Sprinkle a little flour on dough and let dry for 30 minutes. Cut and drop into broth. Let boil over slow fire for 30 minutes without raising lid.

title: Applesauce-Pecan Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Mix 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and next 4 ingredients. Gradually add to first mixture beat with spoon until well mixed. Stir in 1 cup nuts and the fruit. Spread in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Mix remaining nuts cinnamon and the brown sugar. Sprinkle evenly on top of batter and press lightly with hand. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. To keep top from getting too brown spread piece of foil over top during last 1/2 hour of baking. Wrap in foil and store in refrigerator will keep about one week.

title: Chicken Breasts In Champagne
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts with palm of hand. Combine flour salt and pepper and dust breasts on both sides. Saute full side down in butter and oil for 5 minutes shaking the pan to prevent sticking. Turn the chicken and add champagne. Cook for about 15 minutes until chicken is done and champagne is reduced by half. Remove to heated platter and keep warm. Add the cream to the pan juices and cook until thickened. Add sauteed mushrooms and pour sauce over the chicken. Serves 6.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: In a blender mix all ingredients except coconut. Pour into greased fluted pie plate. Sprinkle with 2 to 3 cups flaked coconut. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven covered with aluminum foil for 20 minutes. Continue baking uncovered for additional 15 to 20 minutes until cake test comes out clean. Refrigerate overnight. Enjoy!

title: Easy-Make Cake
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients together and use to dust a greased 10-inch tube pan. Mix butter and other flavoring with milk in a large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and beat for 20 minutes. Pour batter into pan and place in a cold oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Vegetables Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in wok or skillet over high heat. Add garlic and cook a few seconds then add frozen vegetables and stir frequently until warmed through. Cut chicken into 1/2 x 2-inch strips. When vegetables are barely cooked add chicken and stir until it becomes opaque. Stir in teriyaki sauce and serve over hot rice.

title: Apricot Bonbons
instructions: Combine coconut apricots and milk\tin large bowl. Cover. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Roll into balls using scant tablespoon. Place on wax paper and refrigerate. Melt almond bark and dip balls using a fork and swirl the top with a toothpick.

title: Mother'S Garden Goulash
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large iron skillet; cover and cook on medium heat until vegetables are almost done. Remove lid; reduce heat and cook until thick.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Follow directions on cake mix.\tAdd 1 package frozen coconut to batter. Bake as directed on cake mix. Punch holes in cake. Pour can of cream of coconut over hot cake. Let cool. Spread Cool Whip over cake.\tTop with package of frozen coconut.

title: Nanie'S Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and blend in sugar 1 cup at a time; mix well. Melt butter in 1 cup of hot milk. Cool a bit then add to egg-sugar mixture. Mix flour and baking powder together. Add to egg sugar and butter mixture slowly.

title: Veal Chops With Mushrooms(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: *Try shoulder and rib chops approximately 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Marinate in refrigerator for 2 days.

title: Spanish Potatoes
instructions: Fry in butter or margarine the green pepper pimentos and onion. Add potatoes ham salt and paprika. Continue frying until browned.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Drain bacon and crumble; set aside. Cook onion in bacon fat until tender; drain. Mix beans brown sugar catsup Worcestershire sauce mustard and onion together in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours. Stir. Top with bacon. Let stand before serving.

title: Artichoke Quiche
instructions: Cut artichoke hearts in half. Blend artichokes with eggs crab meat or pepperoni salt pepper and cheeses. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set. Serve warm or cold.

title: Sweet Potatoes(Caramel Glazed)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange sweet potatoes in ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Season with salt. Spoon caramel topping on potatoes. Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes basting occasionally with caramel topping in pan. Makes 4 servings.

title: Savory Roast Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch baking pan. Pare potatoes; roll in butter to coat well. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Bake uncovered for 1 hour. Remove pan from oven; turn potatoes. Add chicken broth. Bake 1 hour longer turning several times. Makes 8 servings.

title: East Arkansas Cheese Straws
instructions: Place butter in mixing bowl and sift flour over butter. Work flour and butter with fingers until it reaches the consistency of cornmeal. Add grated cheese work until a smooth consistency is reached. Put in spritz gun cookie press with star shaped template. Extrude onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in slow oven about 250\u00b0 to 275\u00b0 until dry throughout. Do not let cheese straws brown.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat together margarine sugar and eggs. Add pineapple and coconut. Mix and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Kentucky Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Add melted butter and blend well. Stir in eggs chips nuts and vanilla. Pour mixture into pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown. Serve with a dab of whipped topping. Best served warm. Very rich!

title: Apple Impromtuv
instructions: Put apple pie filling on bottom of 8-inch square cake pan. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread mixture over top of pie filling. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry Conserve
instructions: In a large skillet cook and stir brown sugar margarine or butter and vinegar over medium heat for 1 or 2 minutes. Add onions. Cook uncovered over low heat for 10 to 12 minutes or until onions are glazed and tender stirring often. Set aside.

title: Yellow Cake(Nice And Fluffy)
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder sugar and salt and set aside. Cream together the margarine Crisco 2/3 cup milk and vanilla extract. Mix creamed mixture and flour mixture together until creamy. Add eggs and 1/4 cup milk and mix well. Bake 20 to 25 minutes for layers (9-inch pans) or 35 to 40 minutes for loaf pans in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pizza Sandwiches
instructions: Cook sausage until pink is gone. Add seasonings. Spread on rye bread and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: No Bake Instant Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Add vanilla pudding to milk in bowl. Beat at lowest speed just until blended about 30 seconds. Blend in pumpkin spice and 2 cups Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Chill until set at least 4 hours. Garnish with remaining Cool Whip and pecan halves. Enjoy.

title: Diabetic Apple Crisp
instructions: Arrange apple slices in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Mix together the Equal flour and cinnamon. Cut in margarine until well blended. Sprinkle flour mixture over apples. Sprinkle lemon juice over all then pat until firm on top. Microwave on High uncovered 15 minutes. Turn dish every 5 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes. Serves 16. Contains 123 calories per serving.

title: Fresh Kielbasa And Sauerkraut
instructions: In a large kettle place kielbasa and cover with water. Bring to a boil lower heat and simmer for about 2 1/2 hours. While kielbasa is cooking in a large skillet saute onions until clear; add sauerkraut applesauce* salt pepper and tomato sauce. Simmer for about 20 minutes. When kielbasa is done cut into 2-inch pieces and add to sauerkraut. Also add about 1 cup of water that kielbasa was cooked in. Continue for another 15 minutes. Serve with boiled potatoes (quartered) and bakery fresh pumpernickel bread.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach; drain well. Fold sour cream soup mix water chestnuts and spices into spinach. Bake for 30 minutes uncovered at 325\u00b0. Top with grated cheese for the last 10 minutes of baking. Serves 6.

title: Jiffy Apple Crisp
instructions: Cut margarine into mix making sure its mixed thoroughly. Place pie filling in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cake mix over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Caramel Glazed Pear Cake
instructions: Toss together diced pears and one tablespoon sugar let stand 5 minutes. Beat eggs 2 cups sugar cinnamon and oil at medium speed with an electric mixer until blended. Combine flour salt baking soda and add to egg mixture. Beat until blended. Fold pecans pears and vanilla extract. Pour batter into greased and floured 10 inch Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Remove from pan and drizzle caramel glaze over warm cake.

title: Apricot Sauce
instructions: Wash and cook apricots in water as directed on package. Put the cooked apricots through a food mill or puree them about 3/4 cup at a time in a blender (or use a food processor). Add sugar and salt. Stir and cook 4 to 5 minutes over moderate heat. Add Cognac or apricot brandy to taste. Serve over puddings or plain cake. Makes approximately 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Frozen Cucumber Slices
instructions: Mix together sliced cucumbers onion and salt. Let stand 2 hours. Rinse and mix well. Mix sugar and vinegar together. Pour over cucumbers and freeze in small individual containers.

title: Delicious Candy
instructions: Boil cream until it is reduced to 2 tablespoons. Remove from heat; stir in Grand Marnier and chocolate. Return to low heat to melt chocolate. Whisk in butter. When mixture is smooth pour into bowl; refrigerate 1 hour. When mixture is firm shape into 1-inch balls. Roll balls in cocoa. Store truffles covered in refrigerator. Let truffles stand at room temperature 1 hour before serving.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in 9-inch unbaked pie shell at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chinese Spareribs
instructions: Have ribs sliced at joints. Rub split garlic cloves into meat. Baste with sauce and broil until done.

title: Grandma Wade'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream the margarine sugars peanut butter eggs and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. When well mixed fold in the chocolate chips raisins and nuts if desired. Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool on pan for 1 minute then remove to rack. Freeze in covered container.

title: Medallions Of Pork With Riesling Sauce
instructions: Season pork with salt and pepper. Coat in the flour; shake off excess. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic and saute until golden brown about 5 minutes. Transfer to bowl. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in same skillet over medium-high heat. Add pork and saute about 4 minutes per side. Transfer pork to plate. Add onion mixture Riesling raisins vinegar green peppercorns and herbs to same skillet and boil until sauce thickens about 4 minutes. Add pork to skillet to heat through. Divide pork among plates. Add 1/4 cup butter to sauce in skillet and whisk just until melted. Mix in pine nuts. Spoon sauce over pork.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: To the sour cream add the soda then add sugar and eggs. Beat well. Sift 1 cup flour salt and baking powder. Add sweet milk and extract. Beat well and then add enough flour to make a soft dough that can be handled. Roll and cut fry in deep fat and roll in powdered sugar to which a little cinnamon has been added.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Pork
instructions: Brown pork. Add water. Cover simmer until tender. Drain pineapple. Reserve liquid. Combine sugar and cornstarch. Add pineapple syrup vinegar soy sauce and salt. Add to pork. Cook and stir until thick. Add pineapple green pepper and onion. Cook 2 or 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Aplets
instructions: Combine grated apples with sugar in heavy pan. Slowly bring to boil. Soften gelatin in applesauce. Add to cooked apple mix. Bring to full boil for 15 minutes. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Add nuts and vanilla.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together until fluffy. Then add the remainder of the ingredients lastly the pecans. Pour in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake for 10 minutes at 450\u00b0; 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Grease large casserole dish. Slice eggplant thin. Do same to onion. Alternate eggplant tomato sauce and cheese in layers until all ingredients are gone. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes. Recipe will make a large casserole. May be cut in half.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Use 1 can soup and 16 oz. sour cream or 2 cans soup and 8 oz. sour cream or 2 cans soup and 16 oz. sour cream depending on how much you want to make.

title: Cocktail Franks In Whiskey Sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan. Simmer for 1 hour. Serve (use cocktail picks).

title: Russian Tea Mix
instructions: Mix and store in a jar. Add 2 teaspoons to one cup of hot water.

title: Filled Hungarian Cookies
instructions: Cream all ingredients oleo cheese and flour together until mixed thoroughly. Roll on floured board of mixed flour and powdered sugar. Cut into 2-inch squares or 2-inch circles with cookie cutter. Place 1/2 teaspoon filling on each and fold 2 sides towards center. Press hard enough to hold. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Add beaten egg to milk. Mix dry ingredients; sift. Stir in remaining ingredients. Mix slightly. Add blueberries. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Coat pork chops with mixture of paprika salt pepper ginger and flour. Brown in lard in skillet. Add pineapple juice and vinegar. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Simmer for 40 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: New Orleans Pralines
instructions: Place sugars water and butter in a pan over high heat. Boil for 2 minutes or to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add pecans and vanilla. Beat until mixture becomes creamy and begins to sugar on sides of pan then drop by spoon onto waxed paper to cool.

title: Fried Beaver Tail
instructions: Heat the tail in a moderately warm oven (about 300\u00b0) until the skin puffs and peels off. Boil until the meat is easily removed from the bone. Cut meat into cubes salt and pepper. Dip into egg and then flour. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Dissolve the Knox gelatine in the cold water. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add gelatine; stir well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Chill until set. Cut with knife or cookie cutters.

title: Friendship Salad
instructions: Pour liquid over vegetables and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Christmas Day Sausage Ring
instructions: Lightly grease a 7 inch ring mold. Sprinkle cornflakes in bottom of mold. Mix sausage onion bread crumbs parsley and egg. Pat meat mixture into mold. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Drain and bake another 15 minutes or until done. Invert mold onto heated platter garnish with fresh parsley. Fill center with scrambled eggs if desired. Sausage ring may be refrigerated or frozen before baking. Thaw and heat as directed.

title: Tsourekia - Easter Bread
instructions: In large saucepan warm milk. When milk is warm add salt yeast and 1 1/2 cups flour. Stir until yeast is melted. Put aside and let rise for 1 hour. When 1 hour is up add the eggs sugar melted butter lemon and orange peels. Stir in well with hand not mixer. When everything is mixed in begin adding flour slowly until it makes a soft nonsticky dough. Knead well. Put aside to rise 3 to 4 hours. When well risen knead again. Shape into braids or loaves.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix peaches with 1 cup sugar. Put butter in casserole dish and put in oven to melt.

title: Roast Chicken
instructions: Wash and dry chicken; crush garlic ginger pepper and salt. Combine with cinnamon turmeric cloves vinegar and butter. Rub this mixture all over chicken and allow to stand for 30 minutes. Place chicken in roasting tray together with margarine and cook in moderately hot oven for 1 1/2 hours basting occasionally.

title: Cheesy Hashburgers
instructions: About 20 minutes before serving preheat broiler. Blend hash sour cream or yogurt relish and horseradish. Set aside. Place halved buns cut side up on cookie sheet. Spread each half with some mustard. Spread one side of each bun with hash mixture. On the other side lay a tomato slice topped with a slice of cheese. Broil until cheese is bubbly then serve at once. Serve with French green beans salad pears and cookies.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and berries and let stand. Drain juice off berries and add enough water to make 2 cups. Cook a little then add Junket mix. Remove from heat and cool. Add berries and put in baked pie shell. Add whipped cream for topping.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put peaches and butter in 2-quart baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients in blender on high for 15 to 20 seconds. Pour over peaches and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Ham Salad
instructions: Using a meat grinder grind up eggs pickles and bologna. Add sugar and Miracle Whip; mix well. Store in refrigerator until well chilled. Spread on bread and enjoy!

title: Winter Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pasta. Simmer for 2 hours. Add pasta until heated through. Serve hot with cornbread and salad.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Can add any vegetables that you like.

title: Avocado Dressing
instructions: Peel and pit avocado. Mash thoroughly. Stir in lime juice green chiles cumin garlic salt and Italian dressing. Mix with wire whisk until smooth. Stir in additional Italian dressing as needed to make the right consistency. Makes about 1 1/2 cups dressing.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add syrup and salt; beat well. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Greta'S Pasta With Vegetables
instructions: Saute quickly in a pan (preferably on gas high heat) stirring often.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese in baking dish. Top with chili and then cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: In medium bowl beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Add condensed milk. Blend thoroughly. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Top with chilled cherry pie filling before serving.

title: Pennsylvania Chili (Sweet)
instructions: Place first 5 ingredients in large pot and bring to boil. Simmer until vegetables are tender 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile brown hamburger and drain fat. When vegetables are tender add cooked hamburger and undrained kidney beans. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes and add chili powder to taste (depends on how hot you like it).

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; set aside. Mix in order given adding flour mixture last. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour sugar salt soda and cinnamon. Add other ingredients in large bowl and stir thoroughly. Pour mixture into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured (or Pam sprayed) glass Pyrex. Can also put into Bundt pan that has been Pam sprayed. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Test by toothpick. Allow cake to cool before icing.

title: Belgium Vegetables
instructions: Heat until sugar dissolves then let cool and pour over vegetable mixture. Let stand in refrigerator for 8 hours and serve. Keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Rock Candy
instructions: You will need an 11 x 13-inch baking sheet.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Stir soup and milk until smooth. Mix in 1/2 can French fried onions beans and pepper. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle remaining onion on top and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Aunt Sally'S Red Devil'S Food
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar; cream thoroughly. Add eggs and cocoa alternately. Add flour sour milk and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Soup Bean Salad
instructions: In a large pan crumble corn bread and top with beans then tomatoes peppers onions and bacon. Set aside.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cook onion celery and green pepper in butter until tender stir in tomato sauce water and seasonings. Simmer 10 minutes. Add shrimp. Cook 10 to 20 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice. Yields 6 servings.

title: Carrots With Orange Sauce
instructions: Clean carrots well. Slice and cook. Combine remaining ingredients and cook until thick. Pour over cooked carrots. Cover and let stand a few minutes before serving.

title: Maple Glazed Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut chicken wings into 3 sections; discard wing tip section. In a large resealable plastic bag or shallow glass container combine remaining ingredients. Reserve 1 cup for basting and refrigerate. Add chicken to the remaining marinade and turn to coat. Seal bag or cover container; refrigerate for 4 hours turning occasionally. Drain and discard marinade.

title: Almond Tea Punch
instructions: Boil water and steep tea 5 minutes. Add sugar lemon juice vanilla and almond extract to tea. Add the water and stir well. Freeze. Remove from freezer in time to allow it to become slushy at serving time.

title: Zucchini Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Cook or steam zucchini in boiling salted water until just tender. Drain. In microwave casserole dish (1-quart size) melt 4 tablespoons of butter or margarine. Add carrot and onion and cook until tender. Stir in 2 1/4 cups stuffing cubes soup and carrot/onion. Mix into zucchini dish stirring gently. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter or margarine. Add remaining 1 1/4 cups stuffing cubes to butter and toss gently. Sprinkle cubes on casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes uncovered. Makes 6 to 10 servings.

title: Turkey Breast Tenderloins
instructions: In a bowl mix cracker crumbs garlic powder and Season-All. In separate bowl beat egg and water with a fork.

title: Rice Mushroom Sausage Skillet Dinner
instructions: Cook onion and sausage balls in skillet until onion is tender and sausage is lightly browned. Drain off excess fat. Add next 4 ingredients. Heat to boiling cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add peas and pimientos cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes longer. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chantilly Mayonnaise
instructions: Put mayonnaise in bowl. Whip cream shortly before serving and add to mayonnaise.

title: Lime Salad(Excellent)
instructions: Mix Jell-O and cream cheese with boiling water until dissolved. Smooth with an electric mixer. Add in remaining ingredients and stir with a spoon.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Add Ragu sauce to cooked beef. In greased 13 x 9-inch pan layer 3 noodles beef sauce cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Make 4 layers. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti With Tomatoes And Goat Cheese
instructions: Cut tomatoes into chunks; add olive oil garlic hot pepper flakes capers and salt to taste. Stir to blend. Cook pasta in salted water until al dente. Tear basil leaves into small pieces. Drain pasta and toss with goat cheese in a large bowl. Transfer into saucepan and saute 2 minutes on medium-high until garlic is released. Add basil and tomatoes. Toss and serve.

title: Meat Pies
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Mix all other ingredients; pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can use ham shrimp or bacon in place of hamburger meat.

title: Cranberry Relish Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Cool slightly. Stir in cranberry sauce drained pineapple celery and nuts. Pour into mold or bowl which has been rinsed out with cold water first. Chill in refrigerator until firm overnight. Remove from mold or brown and put on a chilled plate. Put a dab of mayonnaise on top.

title: Classic Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine first six ingredients. Mix with remaining ingredients. Cover and chill.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Tear cakes into pieces and place in oblong dish. Mix cream cheese and condensed milk together until smooth. Dribble almost all of this over cake. Mix strawberries with remaining mixture and dribble over cake. If wanted sprinkle pecans over this. Refrigerate for about 4 hours. Top with Cool Whip and pecans. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Ina'S Fish Salad
instructions: Mix together the first 7 ingredients for vinaigrette. Set aside.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Have cheese and butter at room temperature. Mix together and blend well. Add other ingredients and blend well. Run through cookie press. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: No Name Casserole
instructions: Brown first 3 ingredients together in skillet; drain. Add next 6 ingredients to beef mixture. Simmer 45 minutes. Top with cheese.

title: Irene'S Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar and milk 3 minutes. Add peanut butter and marshmallow. Mix thoroughly. Put into 8 x 8-inch pan until set.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Prepare pie shell. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat eggs lightly in large bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients in order given. Pour into pie shell.* Bake for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Chicken-Zucchini Stir-Fry
instructions: Put the oil in a large skillet. Turn the heat to medium. Add chicken. Stir. Cover the skillet. Cook about 5 minutes. Add the zucchini green peppers onion and celery to the skillet. Stir gently until the vegetables are coated with oil. Cook until the chicken and vegetables are hot. Put the lid on the skillet. Turn the heat to low. Cook about 5 minutes. Cook until the zucchini is tender and firm. If the mixture gets dry add a little water. If there is liquid in the skillet cook with the lid off. Add black and red pepper. Stir gently. Cut cheese and place on top if desired.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter or oleo and sugar until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Let set 5 minutes then dust with powdered sugar about 2/3 cup.

title: Janet'S Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs salt orange extract and applesauce. Next mix fruit with flour. Add dry ingredients with batter. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours and 45 minutes or until done. Cover and store 1 month before eating.

title: Ham And Corn Chowder
instructions: Mix ham milk corn and soup in 3 qt. saucepan. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally; reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with onions.

title: Big Orange Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar milk and margarine to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add white chocolate morsels and marshmallow cream. Mix well. Remove 1 to 1 1/2 cups of mixture and set aside. To remainder of mix add flavorings and food coloring. Mix well and pour into 9 x 13 buttered pan. Drop white chocolate by spoonfuls on top of the orange. Swirl through with a knife. Chill and cut with knife.

title: Chicken Corn Chowder
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Add water until desired consistency. Season with garlic and black pepper to taste. Simmer until heated through and well blended. Doubles well.

title: Apple Sauce Cake
instructions: Combine above ingredients. Bake in small tube pan for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Chicken Huntington
instructions: Stew chicken; bone and cut into small pieces. Cook macaroni cheese pimentos peas and mushrooms. Melt butter in saucepan and add flour and 2 cups of chicken broth. Cook until thick and add to chicken mixture. Mix thoroughly and place in buttered baking dish. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. The last 10 minutes add grated cheese and cook until melted and bubbly.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water until tender; drain. Cook chicken breasts and cut into bite sizes. Arrange broccoli in greased baking dish 9 x 11-inch. Place cooked chicken on top. Sprinkle cheese on top. Combine bread crumbs and melted butter; sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Angie'S Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in saucepan over very low heat stirring constantly. Cool slightly. Beat eggs sugar and vanilla in a large mixing bowl on high speed for 10 minutes. Add flour beating just to blend. Stir in walnuts. Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. (Do not overbake.) Cool in pan; then cut into squares.

title: Fluffy Rice And Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix mushroom soup and milk; reserve 1/2 cup of mixture. Mix remaining soup mixture the rice mushrooms (with liquid) and half the onion soup mix. Pour into an ungreased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Place chicken breasts on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken breasts; sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix. Cover with foil; bake 1 hour. Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer. (Can use whole chicken cut up.)

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Place cubed venison in a large pot with plenty of water and let it boil while preparing vegetables. Add vegetables salt and pepper. Cook until meat is tender about 1 1/2 hours. Add 2 tablespoons of browned flour and 1/2 cup of water; stir until thickened.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Dice up the potatoes and the onions. Cook in a quart of water until done. Then add 1/2 gallon of milk then the parsley flakes and Cheez Whiz. Salt and pepper to taste. You may add leftover mashed potatoes if you have them. Stir well for about 15 minutes.

title: Cheese And Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt butter; saute garlic and green peppers. Slowly add flour. Add milk one cup at a time. Slice Velveeta and add stirring until it melts. Add chicken broth broccoli and carrots. Simmer. Do not boil. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Ham Biscuits
instructions: Mix together margarine mustard Worcestershire sauce onions and poppy seed. Put ham and cheese in rolls as desired. Pour mixture over rolls. Cover with foil. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Heat for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Best served warm.

title: Sausage Biscuits
instructions: Mix all together. Make into small biscuits and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bacon And Egg Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Place bacon in 9-inch pie plate. Cover loosely with microwavesafe paper towel.\tCook on High 3 minutes. Drain off fat reserving 1 tablespoon in small custard cup; set aside. Stir pepper and mushrooms into bacon; cover and cook on High 2 minutes.

title: Fudge Krispies
instructions: Combine chocolate chips margarine or butter and corn syrup in medium size saucepan (stir over low heat until melted and smooth). Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and sugar. Add Rice Krispies mixing lightly until well coated. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into squares. Store in refrigerator.
