title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Line bottom of dish with crumbled crackers. Saute onions in butter until transparent. Pour over crackers. Mix egg milk and cheese; pour over onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Curd
instructions: Put sugar eggs lemon juice butter or oleo and lemon rind in a heavy pan and stir together. Bring to a boil. Turn down heat. Slowly boil for 4 minutes stirring constantly. Pour into jars and store in refrigerator. Use on toast etc.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook onion in bacon drippings until tender. Add all of the other ingredients; put into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: La Creme Whipped Topping
instructions: Pour evaporated milk into large metal bowl and place in freezer until ice crystals form along edge of bowl minimum of 30 minutes. Chill electric mixer beaters at the same time. Remove bowl and beaters from freezer.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: In large skillet over medium-high heat cook and stir steak mushrooms and onion in margarine until steak is browned and vegetables are tender. Reduce heat to medium. Add flour; cook and stir 1 minute. Add water and bouillon; cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Stir in sour cream; heat through (do not boil). Serve over noodles.

title: Ranch Cracker Snacks
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crackers and mix well. Pour over crackers and make sure all are coated. Place in sheet pan and cook in warm oven 20 to 30 minutes. Store in airtight container and enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and then press firmly into 12 x 8-inch pan. Blend cream cheese eggs white sugar and pecans together well and pour over graham cracker mixture. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Roll bread out to 10 x 15-inch. Mix butter seasoned salt parsley flakes and oregano. Spread some on bread. Cover surface with 3 1/2 ounce package sliced pepperoni. Add cheese. Roll up like jelly roll and spread some butter on top. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Brush on remaining butter mixture after it comes out of the oven.

title: Hot Dill Pickle
instructions: Place cucumbers garlic pepper onion and\tdill in large mouth quart jar. Bring to a rolling boil water vinegar and salt. Pour over cucumbers and seal. Ready for use after 6 weeks.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O and sugar. Add water; stir until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients. Blend well. Chill and serve.

title: Western Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Fritos and dressing. Add Fritos and dressing when ready to serve.

title: Archibald'S Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Slice onions into rings and saute with butter until clear and soft. In 9-inch casserole layer 1/3 of soup then onions then cheese making 3 layers. Spread cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until browned.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs in oil until foamy. Mix in sugar and then remaining ingredients. Add flour last 1 cup at a time. Pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaf pans.

title: Blarney Bars
instructions: Mix together egg yolk sugar flour baking powder hot water and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter. Put in a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Boil jalapeno peppers in water in a small saucepan until peppers soften. Drain. Pour whole tomatoes jalapeno peppers garlic salt and onion in blender until well blended. Use for a dip with chips or top on your favorite food. Enjoy! Be careful it may be hot. If so add more tomato.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Pour butter in large 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Layer other ingredients. Place Saran Wrap then aluminum foil over baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Cut green beans in bite size pieces; boil until tender. Drain green beans and set aside. Crush crackers in a paper bag with rolling pin or other utensil. Melt butter or margarine in pan (can use same pan as the green beans). Put crackers in melted butter or margarine and toss to warm on low heat. Then add in the green beans and serve.

title: Good Cheesecake
instructions: Make the cake according to directions in a big bowl. Mix in the remaining ingredients and divide into 2 glass dishes (long) 9 x 13-inches. First the cake mix then cheese mix. Makes two dishes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until golden brown on the bottom.

title: Quick Vegetable Soup
instructions: Mix all vegetables together. Season with salt pepper and 1 teaspoon Crisco. Add a small amount of ketchup and boil until thick.

title: Belgia Beer Stew
instructions: Coat beef cubes in flour and brown in hot oil. Place in an 8 to 10-quart casserole. Brown onions and garlic. Add to casserole. Add sugar 2 tablespoons vinegar parsley bay leaves thyme salt and pepper. Stir. Boil the beef broth in the skillet used to brown the meat and onions. Pour the broth over the meat mixture. Add the beer. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Place on stove top and add remaining vinegar. Cook until the sauce bubbles.

title: Orange Smoothie
instructions: Pour ingredients into a blender. Blend until smooth and ice cubes have dissolved.

title: Ollie Freeman'S Teacakes
instructions: Mix together. Make out cookies. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Noodles And Cheese
instructions: Cook noodles and keep them warm. Add Parmesan cheese Ranch dressing and sour cream to noodles and mix. Garnish with Parmesan cheese and serve.

title: Deviled Pecan Balls
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients then add the rest except for pecans. Pat chopped nuts onto the outside of the balls. Makes 2 balls.

title: Bermuda Fish Chowder
instructions: Take about 1 pound firm fresh or salt water fish fillet; cut in small bite-size pieces. Place in a pot with 1 pound of fresh peeled tomatoes cut in chunks. If fresh tomatoes are not available canned tomatoes may be used. Add 2 small onions (halved and sliced) and 2 to 4 small white potatoes (peeled and cut in small pieces). Flavor with thyme parsley salt and pepper to taste. Simmer slowly for 4 to 6 hours. Carefully add sherry or rum pepper to taste.

title: Marinade(For Boneless Chicken Breasts)
instructions: Mix all together in Ziploc bag or container. Add 4 chicken breast halves. Turn occasionally. Marinate for at least 2 hours to overnight whichever you prefer. Best done on gas grill. Great done under broiler 10 minutes each side.

title: Aunt Pat'S Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayo water and soup together. Stir in onion chicken almonds pepper rice salt celery and lemon juice. Carefully add sliced eggs. Place all in greased casserole dish. Top with potato chips and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add eggs. Slowly add oil beating constantly. Add vanilla. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake in a tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Jello Salad
instructions: Bring the can of pineapple to a boil and add box of Jell-O; mix well. Let cook and add 1 cup buttermilk and mandarin oranges with juice; mix well. Fold in Cool Whip; put in covered dish and let set overnight in refrigerator. You may add nuts and/or miniature marshmallows.

title: Potatoes Supreme
instructions: Cook potatoes in small amount of salted water; drain and refrigerate until cool. Chop potatoes coarsely. Mix well with remaining ingredients. Bake in 1 1/2-quart dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Filled Tartlets
instructions: Scald milk. Remove from heat and let cool. Stir in eggs cheese and seasoning. Divide mixture between two bowls. Add bacon to one mixture crabmeat to the other. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Arrange tartlet shells on greased baking sheet. Fill 14 shells with bacon mixture and 14 with crabmeat mixture. Bake for 15 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 28 appetizers.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Bring water and sugar to a boil; cool. Mix all ingredients together. Add to sugar syrup. Refrigerate.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes butter and brown sugar. Beat egg yolks; add salt cinnamon and mace. Mix thoroughly. Add walnuts and milk. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold in and pour into pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 375\u00b0 and bake 25 minutes longer or until firm. Cool. Top with whipped cream if desired.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Cook all ingredients but the soda to soft ball stage then add soda and mix well. It will be foamy. Pour over popcorn.

title: Pam'S Butter Cake
instructions: Soften margarine in microwave; add sugar. Add eggs. Put extract in milk. Add flour and milk to margarine and sugar alternating. Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with strawberries or peaches.

title: Sesame Shrimp And Asparagus
instructions: Cut asparagus into 2-inch pieces; set aside.

title: Grandmother'S Yeast Bread
instructions: Yields 6 or 7 loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl; dissolve and carefully add beaten eggs. Check temperature of mixture; if warm (around 100\u00b0) then add yeast 1/4 cup warm water and sugar which have been combined. Beat in half the flour (whole wheat or white). Work in remainder of flour. Turn out on board floured with white flour. Knead at least 10 minutes (board side will be \blistered\ when kneaded enough). Let rise to almost double; bake.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix batter like pancake dough. Melt 1/2 stick butter in baking pan. Pour mixed batter into pan. Spoon fruit of you choice on top of batter. As it bakes crust rises to the top. Bake at 425\u00b0. It is done when its a golden brown.

title: Chicken Fingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Dip chicken into melted margarine then roll in crumb mixture. Place in shallow pan and drizzle with remaining margarine. Bake for 25 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Spinach And Meat Combination
instructions: In a 3-quart pot with cover cook beef in 1 cup water for 1/2 hour then add chicken breast with spinach and other ingredients. Add water as needed. Cook for 45 minutes. Usually served over rice. Serves 4.

title: Foolproof Dark Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In a heavy saucepan over low heat melt chips with sweetened condensed milk and salt. Remove from heat; stir in nuts and vanilla. Spread evenly into aluminum foil-lined 8 or 9-inch pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off foil and then cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature. Yields 2 pounds.

title: Ritz Cracker Snacks
instructions: Combine dates and milk. Cook until thick in microwave. Cook 3 minutes; stir. Cook 3 minutes more; stir. Add pecans. Spread on crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Sun Burst Stir-Fry
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions; set aside. Drain pineapple reserving 1/4 c. juice Blend pineapple juice with 1/3 c. soy sauce 1 Tbsp. cornstarch pepper garlic powder and 1/2 c. water; set aside.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Prepare potatoes (slice thinly). Layer 1/2 potatoes in casserole. Place all onion and 1/2 sauce. Top with remaining potatoes and sauce. Dot with butter cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Bake uncovered for an additional 35 minutes.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together and chill. Dig in with raw vegetables.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Cook cranberries and 1 1/2 cups of water until popped open. Add sugar and simmer for 8 minutes. Dissolve jello in boiling water; add 2 cups cold water. Chill until thickened. Add cranberries pineapple and walnuts. Pour into greased mold.

title: Champagne Salad
instructions: Beat creamed cheese and sugar until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; blend well. Freeze in 9 x 13-inch pan or smaller molds. Remove from freezer 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in glass jar. Use 1 to 3 tsp. to cup of hot water according to taste.

title: Fruit Salad Medley
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pecans in a bowl and refrigerate. Stir in pecans just before serving.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise sour cream and sugar. Place everything in a glass bowl in the order given; do not stir. Should be done the day before; cover.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing with a fork. Form into 7 or 8 thick patties. Coat both sides with finely crushed saltine cracker crumbs on waxed paper and fry in skillet with minimum hot Crisco until lightly browned on each side.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion until tender; drain. Add soups and simmer a few minutes. Add rice and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Spring Temptation Pie
instructions: Stir boiling water into Jell-O in medium bowl for 2 minutes or until dissolved. Stir in sherbet; mix until melted. Refrigerate 25 minutes or until slightly thickened. Fold in Cool Whip marshmallows and pineapple. Pour into crust. Freeze until firm. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Vernon'S Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix per box directions. Add food dye and paste made from the cocoa and vinegar. Mix well and bake as directed on cake box. Frost with favorite frosting.

title: Pecan Roll
instructions: Mix sugar Karo syrup and milk together in saucepan. Place over lowered heat until mixture begins to thicken. Add vanilla. Pour onto waxed paper and roll into a long roll. Roll in chopped pecans.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add egg vanilla and nuts then add milk. Mix in flours. Drop by teaspoonful on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Stuffed Apples
instructions: Slice apples in half. Cut out core. Spread the peanut butter inside and eat.

title: Crab Canape
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add cheese and cream. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in crabmeat salt and pepper. Beat egg yolk lightly with sherry and add to crab mixture. Chill until serving time. Just before serving spoon into canape shells. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes until top is bubbly.

title: Kids Turn Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in bowl. Have child do the squishing. Have child form into a loaf and plop into a shallow baking pan. Squirt some more ketchup on top and bake uncovered for 45 minutes while Mom puts her feet up. Set the table. Dont forget the napkins.

title: Beef Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper meat. Brown on both sides in a large skillet. While meat is browning pour beef broth in slow cooker. Reserve 2 Tbsp. broth. Mix with cornstarch. Pour mixture and wine into slow cooker. Stir well. Add meat. Cook 7 to 8 hours on low. Use gravy over rice or potatoes.

title: Sweet And Sour Delight
instructions: Cut chicken or pork into 1/2-inch pieces. Brown in oil; reduce heat to low. Add onion and garlic. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Add carrots and green pepper. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir into skillet. Cover; simmer 10 minutes longer. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Melt shortening and cocoa together. Add sugar to eggs and beat. Add chocolate mixture to eggs and blend. Add flour and vanilla. Mix well. Spread in pan. Bake 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain. Add soup sour cream pimentos onion 1/3 stuffing and water chestnuts. Mix. Put one third of stuffing on bottom of pan. Pour mixture in pan. Add remaining stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves about 8.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into lightly greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Bizetti
instructions: Cook beef with onions stirring frequently. Add to remaining ingredients (EXCEPT cheese) in a large bowl. Turn into 9 x 13 pan or 3-quart casserole dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Top with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven. Serves 8 to 10. Can freeze. Can do ahead.

title: Shrimp Candelis
instructions: Heat margarine and olive oil. Add garlic which has been put through press. Cook until garlic is cooked. Add shrimp. Add pepper and salt heavily as salt has to penetrate shrimp shell. When shrimp are done add vermouth and lemon juice and cook about 2 minutes.

title: Tiara Cake Dessert
instructions: Prepare instant pudding using instructions on box then place in refrigerator to chill. Spray 2 fluted cake pans with Pam. Prepare cake using instructions on box and pour 1/2 of mix into each. Bake as directed. Allow cakes to cool before removing from pans.

title: Macaroni Pie
instructions: Beat the three eggs in a large bowl and hot noodles milk cheese salt and pepper; mix well. Put in large casserole dish. Put butter on top in 1 teaspoon pieces. Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top between 45 minutes and 1 hour.

title: Chicken Crumb Parmesan
instructions: In blender combine bread Parmesan cheese salt and parsley.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Melt butter and pour in an oblong cake pan. Add graham cracker crumbs. Sprinkle nuts over the graham crumbs then add chocolate chips coconut and Eagle Brand milk on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes at least.

title: Easy Side Salad
instructions: Cut lettuce into salad size pieces. Cut tomatoes and toss together. Mix with Miracle Whip to desired creaminess. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into an unbaked pie crust. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 and check. It may need to bake a little longer.

title: Vanilla Wafer Fruitcake
instructions: Place crushed vanilla wafers in large bowl. Add chopped cherries pineapple pecans and raisins. Mix well using hands. Beat eggs sugar milk and salt together. Pour over fruit. Mix well with hands. Place in greased tube pan and press down with hand. Wet hand before pressing it will not stick to cake. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Cool 15 minutes before removing.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Heat broth to boiling. Add rice and turn down heat; cover for 20 minutes stirring occasionally. In a small nonstick pan or wok on medium heat put butter or oil carrots and onion and cook until onion is translucent. Take out onion and carrot. Scramble 1 egg; add onion and carrot back to egg and add cooked rice. Cook over medium heat about 3 to 5 minutes. Add soy sauce if desired. Serve hot.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 1 large loaf or 2 small loaves.

title: Quick Tuna Casserole
instructions: Empty tuna into buttered baking dish. Add cracker crumbs. Pour egg and milk mixture over tuna and crackers. Cover with grated cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Trifle
instructions: Tear cake into bite-sized bits into 13 x 9-inch oblong pan. Mix hot water and jello; pour over cake. Then pour pudding over cake (cherry pie filling). Top with Cool Whip. You can multiply this to make as much as you need.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter together. Beat eggs one at a time and add to the mixture. Add vinegar pecans raisins and coconut. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 minutes in a 350 degree oven.

title: Hot Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Put tomatoes in large stainless steel or crockery container with salt. Toss well. Let stand 3 hours. Drain but do not rinse. In large pan put 1/2 gallon vinegar with 8 cups sugar. Heat to boiling. Add all vegetables. Return just to a boil and simmer 10 minutes only. Fill jars. Seal and process for 10 minutes in hot water bath. Do not boil (instead bring to a good simmer; turn off heat and allow jars to sit with lids covered for only 10 minutes).

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and simmer until sugar dissolves.

title: Trailside Oatmeal Treats
instructions: Stir flour soda and salt together. Set aside. Cream margarine peanut butter and sugars until creamy. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture then oatmeal and chocolate chips. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 42 cookies.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into a 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 until set. Can be served warm or at room temperature. Can be refrigerated.

title: Mexican One Dish Meal
instructions: Cook ground beef or turkey and onion in large nonstick skillet. Stir occasionally while cooking. When meat is lightly browned and onion is soft drain off fat. Add all remaining ingredients except corn. Cover and simmer over low heat stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender about 30 minutes. Add more water if needed. Add corn; cook long enough to heat through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cranberry-Strawberry Salad
instructions: Heat cranberry sauce. Add Jell-O and mix. Add other ingredients and mix. Refrigerate.

title: Too Easy Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place fruit in buttered 8 x 8-inch dish. Cut crusts from bread. Cut each slice into 5 strips. Place over fruit. In a bowl beat egg flour sugar and butter. Pour over bread. Bake 35 to 45 minutes until golden brown.

title: Marion'S Hot Poached Salmon
instructions: Add salt and spices to water. Add lemon juice and onion. Bring to a boil; add salmon. Lower the heat and poach very gentle allowing 10 minutes per pound.

title: Crunchy Beef Bake Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Brown ground beef. Combine all ingredients except onions. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and put onions on and continue to bake for 5 minutes longer.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
instructions: Measure first four ingredients into sifter. Set aside. Rinse raisins with boiling water to plump them. Drain. Set aside with walnuts.

title: Cream Cheese Pie Crust
instructions: Cream together butter and cream cheese. Add salt and flour. Mix with hands refrigerate overnight.

title: Black-Eyed Susans
instructions: Mix and roll out and cut with a small biscuit cutter. Put a date into each and fold over. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sugarless Cake
instructions: Boil the first 5 ingredients in 2 cups water for 10 minutes stirring. Remove from heat and add Crisco oil. Let cool well. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake in greased tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Italian Breakfast Pie
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Spread rolls over pizza pan sealing seams. Layer sausage potatoes and cheese. Combine eggs milk and pepper. Pour over pan. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until set.

title: Finger Paint
instructions: To 1-quart boiling water add all other ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Pour into jars and color with poster paint or vegetable coloring. Use on wet shelf paper.

title: Herbed Bread Sticks
instructions: In a large bowl mix the flour yeast salt and herbs. Add the olive oil and water and mix until a dough is formed. On a floured surface knead the dough until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes. Place the dough in an oiled bowl cover with a towel and set in a warm place to rise. When the dough has doubled in size about 30 minutes punch it down and divide it into 16 pieces. Roll each piece into a 12-inch \snake.\

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach and drain well. Combine spinach sour cream and onion soup. Put in a greased casserole. Sprinkle with Pepperidge Farm crumbs (mashed until fine) with Parmesan cheese. Cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine soup mix with breadcrumbs. Dip chicken in soup mixture coating well. Place in lightly greased large shallow baking pan; drizzle with butter. Bake turning once for 10 minutes or until tender. Makes about 2 dozen nuggets.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Pour hot water on yeast cakes; let cool. Add 2 cups flour; let rise 20 minutes. Add eggs and the 4 cups flour (add 1 cup bran if desired). Mix well. Can be refrigerated. Take out after 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Red Toy Salad
instructions: Place marshmallows and orange jello in bowl and pour boiling water over. Stir until dissolved. Mix cream cheese and salad dressing until smooth. Add pineapple. Then mix with the marshmallow mixture. Whip the cup of cream and fold into mixture. Pour into 9 x 13 glass dish and chill. When set top with 6 ounce red jello prepared as directed on box. Chill until set. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Prepare Mock Hollandaise Sauce. Set aside. Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Carefully break 1 egg into small dish and slide egg into water. Repeat with remaining eggs. Simmer uncovered about 5 minutes or until yolks are just set.

title: Golden Rich Bars
instructions: In a large bowl mix cake batter butter and 2 eggs. Spoon into ungreased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spread evenly. In separate bowl mix cream cheese sugar and 2 eggs until fluffy. Pour mixture over first layer. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. The cake will look somewhat like custard. Do not bake until firm. Cake should be soft in the middle. Yields 20 bars each bar contains 192 calories (45% from fat).

title: Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheets. Combine butter sugars egg and vanilla; beat until well blended. Combine flour cinnamon baking soda and salt. Add to butter mixture; mix well. Stir in oats and raisins. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in upper third of oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from cookie sheets; cool on wire racks. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Texas Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil flour applesauce and spices then add raisins nuts and gumdrops. Mix well. Bake 2 1/2 hours in a greased and floured tube pan at 275\u00b0. Place a pan of water under cake and steam will make it moist. Test for doneness.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs bananas and nuts. Put in greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Over low heat melt butterscotch chips. After melted remove from heat and add noodles and peanuts. Stir all together. Then using teaspoon scoop onto wax paper. Cool before eating.

title: Banana Oatmeal Bread
instructions: In bowl combine bananas oats and milk; set aside. In large bowl cream sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine all ingredients adding alternately with banana mixture. Spoon into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Contains 18 slices per loaf 180 calories a slice.

title: Popsicles
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O Kool-Aid and sugar in boiling water. Add cold water. Pour into frozen pop molds small paper cups or ice cube trays. Insert wooden stick or spoons into paper cups or cube trays. Freeze until firm.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Cook onion and hamburger; add salt and pepper bell pepper and seasoning mix tomatoes (chopped a little) tomato sauce and chili beans. Let simmer for 30 minutes. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cheese on top with corn chips. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Mix yeast sugar and water. In another bowl put 2 cups flour salt and oil; mix well. Add yeast mixture; mix. Add 2 additional cups flour. Add more warm water if needed to make a stiff dough. Let rise until double. Split dough in half. Roll out to pan size on floured board. Add toppings and sauce; bake at 425\u00b0 until done.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Put sugar corn syrup and water in heavy pot and let come to a boil. (Use medium heat throughout.) Add peanuts when mixture starts to boil. Cook until peanuts start popping and smell parched and sugar is medium brown in color about 20 minutes. Remove from heat immediately and add baking soda. Stir quickly. Do not beat. Pour on a large buttered cookie sheet. Let cool and break in small pieces.

title: Tiny Cream Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Beat cream cheese and butter at medium speed of an electric mixer 2 minutes or until creamy. Gradually add flour beating at low speed just until well blended. Spoon dough into ungreased miniature 1 2/4 inch muffin pans filling full. Bake at 400 degree for 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot. Yields 1 1/2 dozen

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix first five ingredients and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut soft butter into cake mix. Add nuts and crumble on top of pumpkin mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: German Pound Cake
instructions: Mix butter shortening sugar and eggs together. Mix at least 20 minutes until sugar is dissolved. Blend in flour and baking powder. Slightly warm milk and vanilla. Pour in and mix well. Bake in greased tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 8 x 14-inch pan. Spread coconut and pecans on bottom. Mix cake according to package directions. Pour this mixture over pecans and coconut. Melt butter; add softened cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix well. Spread over cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Chop tomato and boil eggs. Mix everything with mayonnaise.

title: White Layer Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add flavoring and mix well. Fold in well beaten egg whites. Bake in layers at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes in nonstick pans or well-greased floured pans.

title: Beef And Mushroom Pie
instructions: Fry bacon slowly in large heavy skillet. Remove when cooked crumble and set aside. Heat skillet until almost smoking brown the beef cubes a few at a time on all sides. Place beef and crumbled bacon in casserole and keep warm. When all the beef has been browned add the chopped vegetables to the skillet reduce heat and cook until wilted. Stir in 2 tablespoons flour cook for a minute or two add the wine broth and seasonings; bring to boil stirring to smooth out sauce. Pour over beef cover closely and simmer in a 325\u00b0 oven about two hours or until meat is tender. Make certain it does not boil. Remove casserole from oven and cool. (This is best made the day before baking the pie to facilitate removal of excess fat.)

title: Orange Cappuccino Mix
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender. Cover and blend on high for 15 seconds. Stir until well mixed. Blend for an additional 15 seconds. Yields 1 1/4 cups.

title: Kathleen'S Favorite Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Boil in lightly salted water just until tender. Do not overcook. Turn off stove. Drain potatoes and immediately return them to the hot pot. Set on hot stove eye that is turned off. Pour in amount of canned milk needed for beating. Do not disturb potatoes. Add 1 large spoonful of mayonnaise and the butter to the undisturbed potatoes. Let set until milk becomes lukewarm (this is important). When milk is warm mash potatoes slightly; add salt and pepper to taste. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth.

title: Tuna-Chip Casserole
instructions: Combine tuna condensed soup peas celery onion milk and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl mixing thoroughly. Spoon half of tuna into a 1-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of crushed potato chips. Spoon remaining tuna mixture into casserole. Sprinkle with remaining potato chips. Cook uncovered in microwave oven for 10 minutes at High or until thoroughly heated. Rotate casserole one-quarter turn once. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Raisin Bonbon
instructions: Rinse raisins in hot water; drain. Chop raisins with food chopper or knife. Blend in peanut butter and honey. Form into 1-inch balls. Roll in nuts.

title: Layered Green Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce onto bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish. Sprinkle with onions celery and water chestnuts. Break peas apart and sprinkle over all and add shredded cheese. Combine sugar cheese salt and garlic powder mixing well.

title: Seafood Lasagna
instructions: In a large skillet saute onion in oil and 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Stir in broth and clam juice; bring to a boil. Add the scallops shrimp crab and 1/8 teaspoon pepper; return to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 4 to 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and scallops are firm and opaque stirring gently. Drain reserving cooking liquid; and set seafood mixture aside.

title: Veal Oscar
instructions: Sprinkle veal on both sides with lemon juice then salt and pepper. Dust lightly with flour. Heat butter in large skillet and saute cutlets over moderately high heat for 4 minutes on each side until lightly browned. Remove to a warm platter. On each cutlet place 4 spears of asparagus and one crab leg. Top with Hollandaise sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Chess Pie
instructions: Blend sugar and flour. Add oleo then add eggs pineapple and coconut. Mix well. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 1 hour. Freezes well.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel and slice 6 large apples. Arrange in 6 x 10-inch greased baking dish. Mix together first 5 ingredients and spread over sliced apples. Pour Crisco oil over all. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Healthy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine at medium speed with an electric mixer. Gradually add sugars beating well. Add egg substitute and vanilla; mix well. Combine flour baking soda salt and oats. Gradually add to margarine mixture mixing well. Stir in raisins.

title: Broccoli Rice Salad(First Place Salads, 1994 Rice Contest)
instructions: Combine bacon broccoli onion raisins and rice. Mix well. Combine mayonnaise sugar and vinegar in a small jar. Mix well and pour over broccoli mixture immediately before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients in skillet. Place approximately a 2 pound chicken in skillet cover and let simmer 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Chicken Rolls
instructions: Roll chicken and cheese up in a crescent roll. Place in a cake pan. Heat soup and milk until smooth. Pour around crescents and cook in oven until crescents are brown. Sprinkle with cheese when done.

title: Honey Spiced Peaches
instructions: Combine honey vinegar spices and cinnamon. Boil 10 to 12 minutes. Strain. Return cinnamon to spiced syrup. Drain 1/2 of the syrup from the peaches. Add peaches to spiced syrup and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add wine. Store in covered glass dish in refrigerator. Leave about a day before using. More peaches may be added without reheating the syrup.

title: Marble Fudge
instructions: Line an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan with plastic wrap. Place corn syrup and milk in a 2-quart saucepan set on a medium-low heat burner. Add chocolate stirring constantly until chocolate is melted then remove from heat. Stir in the vanilla and the sugar with a wooden spoon until the mixture is smooth. Spread the mixture in the pan previously prepared. Using a teaspoon drop the peanut butter onto the fudge. To marbleize use a knife to swirl the peanut butter through the fudge. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Invert onto cutting board and remove the plastic wrap. Makes approximately 25 (1 1/2-inch) squares.

title: Oriental Chicken And Peppers
instructions: In medium bowl combine chicken with soup mix 1 tablespoon oil 1 tablespoon soy sauce garlic and 1 teaspoon cornstarch. Marinate 20 minutes.

title: Dry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix dry Jell-O into cottage cheese. Add drained fruit nuts and Cool Whip. Mix well and chill.

title: Asparagus And Chicken Salad
instructions: Wash and peel asparagus; cut diagonally into 1-inch pieces. Heat oil in a heavy saute pan. When very hot add the asparagus and stir-fry for 2 minutes stirring constantly with a large spoon. Add the seasoned salt salt and pepper stirring another 30 seconds. Pour in chicken broth and soy sauce. Cover; cook 1 minute longer. Remove from heat. Add the chicken and mix. Transfer to a serving platter. Cover; refrigerate until serving time. Just before serving add the vinegar and toss until well blended.

title: Miracle Whip Cake
instructions: Mix or sift together the first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in well-greased and floured 9-inch pan. Frost when cool with favorite frosting.

title: Eggnog Bread
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine all dry ingredients (flour sugar baking powder salt and nutmeg). Combine and add to dry ingredients the beaten eggs eggnog and vegetable oil; stir fast until combined. Stir in the pecans and apricots. Divide batter into 2 greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch bread pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool in pans for 15 minutes before removing breads to cooling rack.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar flour eggs salt milk and oleo in order and cook on top of stove in large heavy pot until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Beat the 3 egg whites and add 1 teaspoon cream of tartar and dash of salt until thick and forms peak. Add 3 tablespoons sugar one tablespoon at a time. Spread on top of pudding and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450\u00b0. This makes a large pudding.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill. Makes 3/4 cup of sauce.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Pour boiling water over rhubarb to soften. Drain after 5 minutes. Mix sugar egg and flour. Pour over rhubarb in lower crust. Put crisscross crust on top of pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 12-cup Bundt pan or 10-inch tube pan and set aside. Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add poppy seed filling and beat until blended. Beat in egg yolks 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla and sour cream and beat just until blended. Stir flour baking soda and salt until mixed add to poppy mixture gradually beating well after each addition. Beat egg whites in separate bowl with electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Fold beaten egg whites into batter. Spread batter evenly into prepared pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on rack. Dust with confectioners sugar just before serving. Yields 14 to 16 servings.

title: Blender Broccoli Soup
instructions: * Sour cream is for top of soup in bowl.

title: Easy Squash Casserole
instructions: Brown ground sausage. Slice and boil the squash and onion. Combine with 1/2 cup milk into a casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots only until still a little crisp not soft. Cook remaining ingredients and pour over carrots.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown beef and onion in hot shortening in saucepan. Add mushrooms and green pepper. Stir in the flour salt and pepper. Combine remaining ingredients except sour cream and mix well to meat mixture. Simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until meat is tender. Stir constantly adding sour cream and heat 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over cooked spirelli shell noodles or rice.

title: Light Yeast Biscuits
instructions: In a small bowl dissolve 1 tablespoon sugar in the warm water then add yeast. In a large bowl combine the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Using a pastry blender or two knives cut butter into dry ingredients until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Add buttermilk and yeast mixture to dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead 4 minutes or until dough becomes smooth and elastic. Place in a large bowl; spray with cooking spray turning once to coat top of dough.

title: Easy Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sesame-Sour Cream Meatballs(Makes 4 Dozen Meatballs)
instructions: Combine ground beef onion bread crumbs egg milk salt pepper and ginger in a large bowl. Shape into 1-inch meatballs. Heat oil and butter over medium heat in skillet. Add meatballs and brown on all sides. Add broth. Cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Prepare Sesame-Sour Cream Sauce. Place hot meatballs in serving bowl; top with sauce. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seed. Garnish as desired.

title: Rice Dish
instructions: Do not stir. Cook 35 or 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Combine all fruit and marshmallows; add to jello. Chill until thickened; spread on sour cream. Sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Put sugar salt milk margarine and peanut butter in medium saucepan and bring to a rolling boil. Reduce heat to low and cook 3 minutes stirring often. Remove from heat. Stir in oatmeal and almond extract. Stir until slightly cool. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper and chill until cool. Makes 2 dozen.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Add egg to milk. Mix flour and sugar and shake with pineapple juice. Add to milk and cook over medium heat until thickened. Set aside to cool. Drain fruit cocktail and mix with pineapple tidbits and marshmallows in a large bowl. Add cooled mixture. Fold in whipped cream and set in refrigerator overnight.

title: 3-Step Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Pour mix into graham cracker crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool; refrigerate at least 3 hours. Spread with 1 can cherry pie filling. Makes 8 servings.

title: Microwave Meatball Subs
instructions: In large bowl mix onion garlic mushrooms ground beef bread crumbs and basil until combined well. Sprinkle salt and pepper on this. Shape into 12 meatballs.

title: Chili (Mild)
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add diced tomatoes soup beans celery onions and parsley. Mix together. Add chili seasoning. Cook at least 30 minutes.

title: Date Dessert
instructions: Beat egg whites stiff and fold in all other ingredients. Bake in square 8\tor 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fricadellen
instructions: Combine beef onion bread 1/2 cup of the water 1/2 teaspoon salt pepper and nutmeg in large bowl; mix well. Shape into 4 patties. Cook patties in hot oil in large skillet until browned. Stir in gravy and 1/4 cup of water. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Carefree Cranberry Gelatin
instructions: Drain pineapple well and reserve the juice. Combine juice boiling water and gelatin. Chill slightly. Combine in pineapple sour cream and cranberry sauce. Chill for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Chocolate-Coconut Rice Squares
instructions: Combine water sugar and salt in medium saucepan. Bring to a full boil. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Add chips and coconut to hot rice and stir until chips are melted. Cover and chill. Fold whipped topping into rice mixture. Pour into waxed paper-lined 8-inch square pan or 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Cover and chill until firm about 1 hour. Remove paper and cut into squares.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef onion and celery. Add remaining ingredients except noodles. Bake covered for 1 hour. Sprinkle with noodles and bake 30 minutes longer. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Crabby Eggs
instructions: Shred crab meat. Discard any shell. Cut peeled eggs in half lengthwise. Remove yolks and mash or put through ricer. Add rest of ingredients to taste except paprika and mix well. Stuff each egg half with mixture and sprinkle with paprika. Cover and refrigerate until chilled before serving. Can substitute shredded shrimp.

title: Pink Arctic Freeze
instructions: Cream the sugar with cream cheese. Stir in mayonnaise. Fold in cranberry sauce pineapple nuts and whipped cream. Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and freeze. Cut in slices then squares to serve.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: You will need nonstick cooking spray.

title: Sicilian Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a large baking pan. Peel and cut potatoes in quarters lengthwise. Cut quarters in half again. Place potatoes in between chicken. Sprinkle herbs over all. Slice onion and place on top of potatoes and chicken. Drizzle the oil on top. Bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0 turning chicken and potatoes after first 1/2 hour.

title: Cream Cheese Potato Soup(Ready In 1 Hour Or Less.)
instructions: In a Dutch oven combine the water and boillion. Add the cream cheese; cook and stir until cheese is melted. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered for 18-20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together first 6 ingredients. Combine pumpkin sugar milk and eggs in bowl. Add dry ingredients and butter. Mix only until flour is moistened. Stir in nuts.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Rinse broccoli to thaw. Drain well. Mix together all ingredients. Bake for 45 minutes in a greased preheated cast-iron skillet.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add oil zucchini sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Combine flour salt baking soda cinnamon baking powder and pecans. Add to mixture. Mix well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in 2 greased loaf pans.

title: Lemon Whippersnappers
instructions: Combine cake mix Cool Whip and egg and stir well. Drop by teaspoon into powdered sugar; roll to coat. Place 1 to 1 1/2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Makes several dozen.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
instructions: Mix cream cheese and flavoring of your choice. At this point you can add a few drops of food coloring if you plan to use one color for the whole batch. Gradually add 2 to 2 1/2 cups powdered sugar. Knead until no longer sticky. Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Flatten balls with a fork. Let dry at room temperature. Store loosely covered in the refrigerator. Makes 6 to 7 dozen.

title: Mother'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all together until well beaten. Pour into oiled pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Party Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients and add mayonnaise and sour cream. Mix thoroughly and chill. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix Dream Whip by instructions on package; set aside. Cream sugar cream cheese and vanilla. Combine with Dream Whip. Mix melted margarine with cracker crumbs. Alternate layers starting with crumbs then pie filling then cheese mixture.

title: Skinny Minnies
instructions: Blend all together. Roll into 25 balls. Roll in sugar. Press with fork to flatten. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Garlic And Herb Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms; add soup cheese and broccoli in a casserole dish. Top mixture with crumbled toast and sprinkle with butter. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Onion Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Remove stems from mushrooms; discard stems. Fill caps with whipped cream cheese; broil 5 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Veggie Appetizer
instructions: Pat out crescent rolls in 9 x 13-inch pan to make crust. Bake as directed; let cool. Top with room temperature cream cheese buttermilk dressing and dill weed. Spread over cooled crescent rolls. Top with chopped vegetables then grated cheese. Chill 1 hour. Serves 24.

title: Carrots Vichy
instructions: Combine water butter salt nutmeg pepper and sugar with carrots. Simmer covered 8 to 10 minutes or until tender-crisp. Stir in lemon juice and parsley before serving.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Dissolve the jello in the hot water. Mix milk Miracle Whip jello hot water and vinegar and refrigerate. When it is set to the consistency of egg white add the remaining ingredients.

title: Pommes Frites
instructions: In a heavy deep pot or an electric fryer heat the oil to 360\u00b0. Add the potatoes in batches and fry until golden brown 3 to 4 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels and season with salt and pepper. Makes 4 servings.

title: Skillet Dinner
instructions: Fry hamburger; drain. Add sauce mix to meat. Cook spaghetti or noodles until done. Mix all together and season to taste.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix brown sugar with flour. Add egg yolks and sweet milk. Add butter. Cook until thick and put in vanilla. Put mixture into 8-inch baked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Foul Salad (Fava Bean)
instructions: Drain the foul wash it and put in a small pan. Add salt 1 cup of water and let cook until it boils. Pour mixture into bowl add lemon juice onion parlsey and oil. Mix well.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Combine margarine and stuffing mix. Spread 3/4 of stuffing mix in casserole dish. Layer chicken over stuffing mix. Pour 1 cup chicken broth and cream of chicken soup over that. Sprinkle rest of stuffing mix over all. Pour 1/2 cup chicken broth over stuffing mix.

title: Cucumber Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add next four ingredients and mix well. Stir in onion and cucumber. Put in covered container. Chill one hour before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Measure sifted flour; add soda and salt. Sift again. Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add yolks one at a time beating after each. Add chocolate and vanilla. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk beating after each addition until smooth. Beat egg whites to stiff peaks. Fold into batter.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Balls
instructions: Put a little grease in bottom of skillet and cook meat and onions until real brown. Add salt and pepper. Add chili powder sugar Worcestershire sauce Tabasco sauce tomatoes tomato sauce and tomato paste.

title: Meat Vegetable Loaf(Low Calorie)
instructions: Mix ingredients lightly in a bowl. Shape into a loaf in greased shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Combine flour and brown sugar in medium bowl. Cut in butter to make crumb mixture. Stir in nuts. Set aside 3/4 cup mixture for topping. Press remaining mixture into bottom of 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Combine cream cheese sugar pumpkin eggs cinnamon allspice and vanilla in a large mixer bowl. Blend until smooth. Pour over baked crust. Sprinkle with reserved topping. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool before cutting into bars.

title: Foundation Sweet Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast\tand 1\ttablespoon sugar in lukewarm water. Scald milk; add shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add 2 cups flour to make a batter. Add yeast and beaten eggs beat well.\tAdd remaining flour or enough to make a soft dough. Knead lightly and place in greased bowl. Cover and set in\twarm place free from\tdraft.\tLet rise until doubled in bulk about 2 hours. When light punch dough down and shape as desired. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Press into pan flour powdered sugar and butter and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 15 minutes in glass pan in oven at 325\u00b0. Mix very well eggs sugar and salt. Add rhubarb to mixture. Spread over top of crust and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 35 minutes. A double recipe fits in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Mixture is single recipe.

title: Meat Pies
instructions: Brown pine nuts in butter till lightly browned. Remove from pan and brown gd. chuck in butter with onion seasoning and juice. Add pine nuts. Cool. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Shape bread dough into balls 6-8 inch diameter circles. Fill with meat mixture and fold dough over meat into a rectangle shape. Pinch seams together. Brush bottom of a 2 inch jelly roll pan with melted rendered butter (no salt). Place meat pies on tray and bake 20 mins on bottom rack until golden brown. Raise to top rack to lightly brown. Remove from tray and brush with butter from tray.

title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake
instructions: In a large mixer bowl combine cake and pudding mixes. Add eggs oil orange juice Galliano and vodka. Beat on low speed of mixer for 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes scraping bowl frequently. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove to rack and pour glaze over cake while still warm.

title: Ripe Tomato Relish
instructions: Mix and add to first mixture. Stir once daily for 6 to 8 days. This will keep up to 1 year.

title: Fauschnaught'S(Mom-Mom'S)
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in 1 cup lukewarm water. Let stand 10 minutes. Mix flour salt sugar and Crisco fine like pie dough. Beat eggs. Add 2 cups warm water. Add to flour mix. Add yeast mix last. Work dough lightly 10 minutes. Add flour as needed. Cover and let rise. When doubled in size roll out dough cut donuts and let them rise until doubled. Deep fry to golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Coat with 10x sugar by shaking in paper bag.

title: Coconut Icing
instructions: While cake layers are baking put into mixing bowl the sour cream sugar and coconut. Heat in a saucepan 1 cup milk and 1 cup sugar. To this add one of the packages of coconut. Bring to a boil. When cake is cool spread milk and coconut between the layers. Let the layers set before placing coconut and sour cream between the layers. Keep refrigerated.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain. Mix all ingredients except broccoli in a casserole. Place the drained broccoli in the mixture. Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Three Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and pepper. Add other ingredients. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or put in crock-pot on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Lemon Cake Pie
instructions: Mix sugar with flour and salt; stir in milk until smooth. Add beaten egg yolks lemon juice and rinds. Beat egg whites. Fold into mixture. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Arrange skin side up in baking dish. In a bowl mix butter pineapple syrup lemon juice soy sauce ginger salt and pepper. Mix well. Spoon over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes basting frequently with sauce.

title: Cranberry-Mustard Turkey Tenderloins(Low-Fat)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 9-inch square or 9 x 11-inch baking pan arrange turkey tenderloins. In small bowl combine mustard and 1 teaspoon brown sugar; spread evenly over turkey. Bake uncovered 20 minutes.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Finely chop onions and peppers. Mix all vegetables with salt. Let stand overnight. Drain well. Tie mixed spices in bag. Add sugar and spices to vinegar and simmer 20 minutes. Add other ingredients; simmer until hot. Remove spice bag. Put chow chow into hot jars and seal at once.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place the sliced apples in a greased baking dish. Cover with a mixture of the flour sugar baking powder salt and egg. Pour the melted and cooled shortening over all. Sprinkle with the cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until apples are done. Good served warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixer. Blend well. Grease and flour cake pan. Pour in batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 60 to 90 minutes.

title: White Frosting
instructions: Bring the first 4 ingredients to boil until hard ball stage. Slowly add to beaten egg whites (soft peaks). Continue beating until stiff then add vanilla and powdered sugar. Beat until blended.

title: Broccoli-Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions until almost done and drain. Combine with remaining ingredients and put in a greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle the top with corn flake crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine yolks sugar and lime juice in stainless steel bowl. Mix with wire whisk. Place bowl over a sauce pan of boiling water and whisk constantly until thickened. Remove bowl and mix in condensed milk. Pour into pie crust. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Crunchies
instructions: Cream together the fat sugar and syrup. Add flour oatmeal baking powder and a few drops of vanilla. Knead until the mixture binds. Roll out about 1/4-inch thick; cut into rounds or fingers. Bake in moderate oven until golden brown for about 20 minutes. These biscuits keep well stored in airtight tins. (GE)

title: Layered Nacho Dip
instructions: Combine beans and seasoning mix; spread evenly in 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Layer remaining ingredients in order listed. Serve with large tortilla chips. Yields 6 cups.

title: Cake Like Banana Bread
instructions: Sift the flour sugar salt and baking soda. Blend in the shortening bananas and eggs or egg whites. Fold together quickly and do not overmix. Spoon or pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Loosen edges and cool on rack or cool completely in pan. Glaze with confectioners sugar and water mix.

title: Sweet And Sour Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender.

title: Spaghetti With Beef And Mushroom Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine soy sauce oil garlic and ginger in a mixing bowl. Add beef strips and toss well to coat. Cover and marinate for 1 hour. In wok or skillet heat 4 tablespoons oil. Add beef mixture and broccoli; stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add onions pepper strips and mushrooms; stir-fry until vegetables are crisp and tender. Blend water cornstarch bouillon and salt; stir into beef mixture. Cook until thickened; keep warm. Prepare spaghetti as directed and drain. Add beef mixture and toss to mix. Serve with soy sauce if desired.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake your empty pie crust in oven. Let it cool. Cut bananas in slices. Dip in lemon juice to avoid browning and line the bottom of pie crust with them. Cut up your washed strawberries and mix with a strawberry glaze (you can find this in the produce department of your grocery store). Pour a huge amount over the bananas. Then mix some whole washed strawberries with glaze and stick them all over the pie. Cover with Cool Whip.

title: Parmesan Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Beat together milk and egg. Roll chicken in egg mixture. Then roll in potato flake mixture. Melt a stick of margarine in a casserole dish. Place chicken in the dish and roll in margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is golden brown.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In saucepan combine all ingredients. Heat to boiling. Let simmer 30 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Cool Bars
instructions: Combine crumbs and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of 9-inch square pan. Grate or finely chop 1/2 package of the chocolate. Set aside. Heat remaining chocolate and milk in medium saucepan over low heat stirring until chocolate is melted. With whisk beat in cream cheese until smooth. Cool 5 minutes. Fold in 3 1/2 cups of whipped topping and the grated chocolate. Spread mixture over crumbs. Spread remaining whipped topping over chocolate layer. Freeze until firm about 2 hours. Garnish as desired. Cut into bars. Makes about 15.

title: Fruited Chicken In Cream
instructions: Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Place chicken breast halves in dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Drain off excess liquid. Combine remaining ingredients stirring well. Spoon over chicken. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Low Cholesterol Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain sausage. Spread over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Beat together milk egg substitute and margarine. Pour over sausage. Layer hash browns and Cheddar cheese. Bake 1 hour.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken on low till tender. Mix soup sour cream 1/3 of crumbs 1/3 of poppy seed in casserole dish. Add chicken. Top with crumbs and poppy seed. Bake at 350 til bubbly and light brown.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients together at low speed then blend together at high speed with eggs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Rice Casserole(Great With Beef.)
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole dish. Add both cans of soup. Stir in rice. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Chicken With Wine Sauce
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Coat chicken with mixture. Shake off and reserve excess flour. Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in large skillet over medium heat. Brown chicken; remove from skillet. Add remaining margarine mushrooms onion and 2 tablespoons chopped parsley. Saute until onion is transparent. Remove from heat. Stir in reserved flour. Blend in wine. Bring to a boil stirring frequently. Add chicken. Cover reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serve over rice. Garnish with remaining parsley.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread in small casserole dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Place bread on top and broil uncovered until the bread is browned. Serve immediately so the bread doesnt get soggy.

title: Shrimp Singapore
instructions: In skillet cook onions and garlic in butter for 2 minutes. Stir in soy sauce and salt. Add remaining ingredients except rice noodles. Mix well. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with rice noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spanish Noodles
instructions: In frying pan with cover melt shortening. Add meat and cook until brown. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and steam until noodles are tender. Takes about 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Hamburger
instructions: Brown beef in skillet and drain. Add water and seasoning from soup stir. Add cabbage and cover cook on low heat about one minute. `Boil water in saucepan. Add broken noodles from soup. Cook about 1 minute then drain water. Add cooked noodles to cabbage and meat mixture. Stir cover and cook on low heat about 1 minute. Cabbage should be slightly crunchy.

title: Kraft Macaroni Dinner
instructions: Cook dinner. Add cheese packet milk eggs onions ham parsley and soup. Mix well. Put in casserole dish. Top with Swiss cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Bread
instructions: Cook 1 medium potato in 2 1/2 cups water for 15 minutes. Reserve the water. Mash the potato (should be 1 cup). In a large bowl sprinkle yeast over 1/2 cup reserved potato water that has been cooled to 105\u00b0 to 115\u00b0. To remaining potato liquid add water (if necessary) to make 2 cups. Add salt sugar oleo and 1 cup mashed potatoes. To yeast mixture add mashed potato liquid and 3 1/2 cups flour. Beat with a mixer until smooth (2 minutes). Gradually add 3 1/2 cups additional flour mixing with hands until dough is smooth and stiff (leaves side of bowl). Knead until smooth and elastic about 10 minutes. Let rise until doubled (1 hour) covered.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat the eggs and sugar until thickened. Add salt warm milk and vanilla. Pour this mixture over the dried bread that has been crumbled up and placed in a buttered casserole. Sprinkle with cinnamon and raisins if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until thick in the middle. Serve with the Vanilla Sauce as a topping.

title: Montana Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into 6 serving size pieces. Combine flour salt pepper and chili powder; pound 2 tablespoons of mixture into meat. Heat shortening in 10-inch skillet; brown meat on both sides. Drain excess fat from skillet. Add undrained tomatoes onion celery carrot Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Cover. Simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove meat; place on a warm serving plate. Skim excess fat off sauce. Combine 1/4 cup water with remaining flour mixture and stir into sauce. Cook stirring for 2 minutes. Serve meat and sauce over hot cooked rice or noodles. Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Caramel Popcorn
instructions: In large shallow roasting pan place popcorn and nuts. Place in 250\u00b0 oven while preparing glaze. In heavy 2-quart saucepan stir brown sugar corn syrup margarine and salt. Stirring constantly bring to boil over medium heat. Without stirring boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and baking soda. Pour over warm popcorn and nuts. Stir to coat well. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven stirring constantly 1 hour. Cool; break apart. Store in tightly covered container. Makes 4 quarts.

title: Crockpot Dressing
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Mix all ingredients well. Put in crock pot and cook on low for 3 hours or high for 2 hours.

title: French Apple Pie
instructions: Arrange half of apples in pastry-lined pie pan. Mix sugar cinnamon nutmeg salt flour raisins and lemon juice; sprinkle half of mixture over apples. Add remaining apples. Sprinkle with remaining mixture. Dot with margarine. Place top crust on pie. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Congealed Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine soup and cheese. Melt in double boiler or microwave. Mix gelatin with water. Add to soup mixture. Add Miracle Whip. Add rest of ingredients. Put in 7 x 12-inch dish and refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Creamed Chicken Paprika(Tejfeles Csirke Paprikas)
instructions: Cut chicken into sections. Brown onion in fat in large pot add washed chicken salt paprika and water. Simmer until chicken is tender. Mix flour with sour cream until smooth in separate bowl. Add to chicken before serving. Serve with dumplings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Whip cream; when it peaks add yogurt and fresh (washed and drained) raspberries. Goes great with fresh strawberries bananas apple melon marshmallows etc.

title: Nachos Supreme
instructions: Prepare ground beef with taco seasoning according to package directions. If you are using a regular onion fry with the beef. Spread beans in a thin layer in the bottom of a 12-inch pizza pan. Next layer the taco mixture green chilies green onions taco sauce and cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and edge is bubbly. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

title: Scallop Casserole
instructions: Bring water and butter to slow boil. Place scallops and dressing in the baking dish. Add the boiling water. Add Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes with an aluminum foil cover. Take cover off for another 10 minutes.

title: Zucchini Fritters
instructions: Toss together zucchini and salt. Leave set to drain for 15 minutes then add beaten egg onion and flour. Pepper to taste. Drop by tablespoon into skillet with melted butter. Brown on both sides.

title: Chicken Simon And Garfunkel(Seasoned With Parsley, Sage, Rosemary And Thyme, Of Course!)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pound each chicken breast until thin. Brush liberally with butter. Season with salt and pepper. Lay each chicken breast on a slice of cheese and roll up fastening with a toothpick. Combine the beaten egg with water. Roll the chicken in the flour egg mixture and crumbs. Evenly space in a baking pan. Combine the melted butter with the parsley sage rosemary and thyme. Drizzle the herbed butter over the chicken rolls. Bake for 30 minutes. Pour the sherry over the chicken and bake an additional 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Four-Layer Delight
instructions: Crust Mix together first 3 ingredients. Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and brown.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine apple celery nuts and mayo; toss. If desired mound salad in lettuce cups and garnish with maraschino cherries.

title: Cheesy Veggies
instructions: Put veggies in butter lined casserole. Melt together Velveeta and 1/2 stick of margarine. Pour over cooked and drained veggies. Smash 32 Ritz crackers with 1/2 stick melted margarine. Put on top of veggies and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks for about 1 minute or until frothy and a deep lemon color. Add can of milk and beat\tfor another minute. Keeping beaters going slowly add lime juice. Mixture will thicken immediately beat until well combined and smooth. Turn filling into cooled pie crust and chill for at least 4 hours. Add whipped cream and serve.

title: Mandarin Salad
instructions: Mix oranges almonds lettuce and onion. Mix dressing ingredients and toss with salad. (Fresh strawberries can be used in season.)

title: Barbara'S Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Over low heat melt butter. Add cheese; let melt. Add sour cream green onions salt and pepper. Fold in potatoes. Grease a 2-quart casserole and add potato mixture. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Five Layer Dinner (Diabetic)
instructions: In a casserole dish layer the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Pork Fried Rice
instructions: Boil rice in a little less water than you normally would the night before you will fry it. Refrigerate.

title: Crunchy Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli spears for 3 minutes. Drain. Set aside. Cook macaroni. Combine macaroni and ham in 3-quart casserole. Blend soup sour cream and milk. Pour half of the mixture over ham and macaroni. Arrange broccoli on top. Pour remaining soup mixture over macaroni and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with crushed French fried onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Stir hot water margarine and contents of vegetable/seasoning packet in bowl until margarine is melted. Add stuffing crumbs and egg; stir until moistened. Spoon stuffing onto each chicken breast; wrap chicken around stuffing. Place seam side down in greased shallow baking dish. Brush with melted margarine. Place any remaining stuffing in center of dish. Bake 30 or 35 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Heat soup water and dill in a saucepan. Serve over chicken.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Boil the chicken (2 to 3 cups water). Bone it. Save the broth. Cook onion celery and carrot in chicken broth along with rice. Cook until rice is tender. Add 1/2 cup mushroom soup and the mushrooms. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour. Watch for dryness.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
instructions: Combine cream cheese and peppermint extract. Add powdered sugar until smooth. Knead in the food coloring. Form into small balls. Dip into the sugar. Press with glass (one with a design on the bottom). Dry (let dry overnight).

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour soda and salt together; cream shortening and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs and bananas beating until light. Alternately add flour mixture and milk. Beat after each addition until smooth. Add nuts. Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until done. Remove pan; cool on rack and store overnight before slicing.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly sugar shortening and egg. Stir in milk. Add flour baking powder and salt. Stir. Blend in berries. Spread in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with crumb topping. Bake 45 to 50 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Blueberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Add 2 cups boiling water to jello. Stir in pie filling and pineapple with juice and some pecans if desired. Pour in oblong dish; cover and let congeal overnight.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise curry powder and soy sauce together. Mix into remaining ingredients. Refrigerate and let stand for several hours. Serves 12.

title: Salisbury Venison Steak
instructions: In a large bowl combine first 10 ingredients Mix well. Shape into 10 patties; thoroughly coat each patty with flour. Heat 1/3 cup oil in skillet over medium heat. Add patties and brown on both sides. Transfer patties to a greased roasting pan. Place onion and mushrooms over meat.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients above. Put in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Cocoa Fudge
instructions: In medium saucepan mix cocoa and sugar; add canned milk and mix well. Over low heat bring mixture to boil; lower heat and continue cooking to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add vanilla butter and nuts. Let stand about 10 minutes. Beat mixture until it starts to lose its shine. Pour quickly into buttered 8 x 8-inch cake pan. Cool part way in fridge; cut into squares and return to fridge until completely cool.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Blend tomatoes and soup until smooth. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish layer 1/2 of each of the chicken tortillas onion soup-tomato mixture and cheese. Repeat a second layer ending with cheese. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 8 servings.

title: Deluxe Corn Bread
instructions: Beat eggs then mix in sour cream oil and corn. Add cornmeal. Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Can be doubled for 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well. This makes a lot! You can half with a friend or give as gifts. Add boiling water.

title: Jacob'S Pound Cake
instructions: Beat sugar and butter and a little more milk and flour gradually. Add vanilla. Bake in cold oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes to 2 hours.

title: Fae'S Kwik-N-Easy Party Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl. Cover. Refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with assorted vegetable dippers.

title: Baked Asparagus
instructions: Drain liquid off asparagus. Add juice to mushroom soup chopped pimientos and chopped mushrooms in a saucepan. Cook over low heat to pouring consistency. Place in layers in greased casserole starting with 1/2 the asparagus egg slices cheese cracker crumbs and soup mixture; repeat ending with grated cheese. Garnish with paprika. Bake until thick and bubbly at 300\u00b0.

title: Lemon Carrots
instructions: Boil carrots in salted water until tender-crisp. Drain. In saucepan mix sugar lemon juice and butter. Heat until boiling. Boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Add carrots and coat well. Serve warm.

title: Crawfish Iberia
instructions: Saute onions in butter until clear. Add crawfish and saute for 3 minutes. Add flour; stir until smooth. Add milk; simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in cooked spinach. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Green Chili Cheese Casserole
instructions: Place peppers cut and seeded in buttered casserole dish. Add grated cheese. In another dish beat eggs. Add milk gradually to eggs Bisquick and salt. Pour this over cheese and peppers. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Super Duper Bean Pot
instructions: Place all beans in casserole. Brown garlic and onion in grease. Add all other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Perfect Apple Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour spices and dash of salt; mix with apples. Fill pie shell with apple mixture. Dot with butter. Adjust top crust cutting slits for escape of steam. Seal and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients beating well. Add as much flour as can be worked in with a spoon. Roll the dough out thin as tissue paper. Let dry on one side then turn to dry on the other side. Use a noodle cutter to cut noodles.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine flour and seasonings; roll meat in mixture. Preheat electric frypan or skillet to 340\u00b0 or hot. Add fat; when melted add meat. Brown turning to brown all sides. Add onion garlic and mushrooms. Saute until partially tender. Add liquid all sauces and green pepper. When boiling turn down to simmer.

title: Pansy'S Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients together by hand adding apples and nuts last. Put in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Patch Punch
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a blender. Whirl to consistency of thick slush. Place 2 ice cubes in each glass. Fill 3/4 full of fruit slush. Fill remainder with ginger ale or 7-Up. Serves 4.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together shortening sugar eggs water and vanilla until creamy. Add combined remaining ingredients. Mix well. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham crumbs with 1 stick melted butter and put in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Next beat eggs 2 sticks butter and powdered sugar for 13 minutes at high speed and put on top of crumbs. Put a layer of sliced bananas and a layer of pineapple. Top with thawed Cool Whip and garnish with cherries and pecans.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except marshmallow cream. Bake in greased pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. When removed from oven spread marshmallow cream on top while hot. Top with icing.

title: Sweet And Sour Beef
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Remove and set aside. Combine brown sugar and cornstarch in skillet. Add vinegar soy sauce and juice from canned pineapple. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add pineapple chunks and meat. Simmer until 5 minutes before serving time. If necessary add water pineapple juice or apple juice to thin the sauce. Five minutes before serving time stir in carrots and green pepper.

title: Orange Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Cut fat from chops. Place in shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over pork chops. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Teenagers Favorite Taco Casserole
instructions: In a skillet cook ground beef and onions until beef is browned and onion is tender; drain. In a greased 9 x 13-inch dish spread refried beans; sprinkle beef mixture over beans. Add layers of olives (reserving some for garnish) green chilies and cheese. Spread taco sauce over all. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Stir in 4 mashed bananas. You can substitute strawberries or peaches for the bananas. Freeze. Yield 5 quarts.
