title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Fry bacon slowly. Drain. Saute onion in fat. Blend in flour sugar salt pepper and celery seed. Cook until smooth and bubbly. Add vinegar and water. Stir and boil for 1 minute. Add potatoes and bacon. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Randy'S Favorite
instructions: Slice bananas and arrange on plate. Microwave peanut butter for 30 to 45 seconds. Pour over banana slices. Drizzle with chocolate syrup. Serve while still warm.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain. Sprinkle and mix with flour (about 1/4 cup); stir in milk to make gravy. Cook on medium heat stirring occasionally until thick. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add sugar and cocoa; stir well. Add eggs one at a time and stir well after each addition. (Do not beat.) Add milk and vanilla. Pour into 2 pie crusts. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 25 minutes. Test center with a toothpick. If it comes out clean its done.

title: Perfect Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool completely on wire rack.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix milk eggs and oil. Mix at medium speed for 2 minutes. Fold in grated german chocolate bar. Pour into greased and floured baking pan and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes. Let cool for 15 minutes. Remove from pan and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash; drain and add other ingredients. Bake in glass baking dish until bubbly and slightly brown approximately 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Custard(For 2 Pies)
instructions: Makes 2 pies. Have pie crust already cooked and cooled.

title: Okie Corn
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in butter. Mix the cream-style corn whole kernel corn butter eggs onion and green pepper with cornbread mix. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 pan 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Add on top the sour cream and cheese. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Homemade Hamburger Helper
instructions: Brown hamburger meat in a large skillet; drain meat and return to skillet. Add macaroni and cheese and water. Simmer until macaroni is tender. More cheese may be added for cheesier flavor.

title: Walnut Beer Bread(Makes Two Loaves)
instructions: Heat beer to 105\u00b0 to 115\u00b0 and pour 1/2 cup into a small bowl. Stir in the yeast and let stand 10 minutes. Mix the flours sugar and salt in large bowl. Make a well in center. Pour yeast mixture oil and remaining 1 cup beer into the well and stir until blended. Knead dough on a floured surface until smooth and elastic about 10 minutes adding more flour if necessary. Grease large bowl with walnut oil. Cover with damp towel and let rise until double. May also let rise in fridge overnight.

title: Dr. Pepper Icing
instructions: Heat margarine Dr. Pepper and cocoa until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. If necessary add more powdered sugar or a small amount of margarine until of the proper spreading consistency. Frost cake.

title: Johnnie Mac Casserole
instructions: Boil macaroni according to package directions. Brown hamburger and drain. Add Sloppy Joe mix tomato paste or sauce (according to directions). Mix drained macaroni hamburger mixture and corn. Use half of cheese in mixture. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Crumble the hash browns into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine 1/2 cup melted margarine cream of chicken soup sour cream salt and onion; spread over hash browns. Cut the cheese into cubes and spread over the top of the casserole. Sprinkle the corn flakes over top. Drizzle the remaining 1/4 cup margarine over all. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Appleberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add frozen berries. Stir until fruit is thawed. Add applesauce and mix well. Pour into serving dishes. Chill until firm.

title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion and drain. Salt and pepper to taste. Add soups and sour cream and simmer for a few minutes. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Rotel Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in pan. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes. Brown hamburger and then add to cheese mix. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: 6 Month Slaw
instructions: Chop cabbage onion and sweet pepper and add salt. Mix and let stand 10 minutes.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet stirring until crumbly. Drain. Stir in next 3 ingredients. Add seasonings. Spoon into a 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Cut biscuits into halves. Place cut side down around edges and over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Place pork chops in large baking dish (13 x 9) sprayed with Pam. Mix soup broth and rice. Pour over the pork chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all together; add enough milk to fill freezer.

title: Sour Cream
instructions: Mix in blender. This makes a perfect sour cream that can be used in any recipe calling for sour cream.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Lightly oil a heavy skillet over high heat and brown the meat. Add the onion and peppers and cook until tender about 4 minutes. In large mixing bowl combine the cornmeal milk creamed corn eggs bacon fat and soda. Mix thoroughly.

title: Emerald Squares
instructions: Bottom Layer Combine 1/2 cup butter and cocoa in saucepan over low heat. Stir until well blended. Remove from heat; add 1/2 cup sugar egg and vanilla. Stir in crumbs. Mix well and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Drain tuna chop eggs and mix it all together. Chill and serve on crackers or in a sandwich for school! Enjoy!!!

title: Mother'S Cobbler
instructions: Melt the margarine in sheath cake pan. Sift the flour baking powder salt and sugar. Mix with the milk and pour over butter. Add fruit cinnamon and more sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 and cook until done.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Melt butter; beat in egg well. Add yogurt soda baking powder and sugar. Fold in flour. Pour in cupcake holders and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Salt Water Taffy
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils and sugar is completely dissolved. Continue cooking without stirring until temperature reaches 260\u00b0. After boiling has ceased stir in flavoring and coloring. Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Let stand until cool enough to handle. Grease hands and pull until it has a satin like finish and light color. Cut into 1-inch pieces. Wrap in waxed paper.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese mayonnaise sugar and lemon juice. Add pineapple; fold in Cool Whip. Freeze until firm. If kept in freezer good as long as lasts.

title: Easy Layer Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan in oven then add graham cracker crumbs. Press down. Put coconut and chips in pan. Drizzle milk over all. Bake 25 minutes. Cool completely and cut.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta following package directions and drain well. Mix in pepper onion olives artichokes and nuts. Toss together and set aside.

title: Diet 3 Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Toss cover and chill. Serve with slotted spoon. One-half cup serving equals 1/2 vegetable 1/2 bread or 1/2 protein; 10 optional calories.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain well. Combine next three ingredients in heavy saucepan. Cook over low heat until cheese is melted then add broccoli.

title: Dutch Apple Cake
instructions: Combine Bisquick mix and sugar. Blend eggs and milk with shortening and vanilla. Add liquid all at once to dry ingredients. Mix only until dampened. Pour into greased wax paper lined 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Peel apples and slice thin. Place over top of batter in pan.

title: Red Cabbage Salad
instructions: Toss sliced apples with lemon juice. Mix all ingredients and serve.

title: Meat Dish
instructions: Add onion green pepper and celery to spaghetti and meat; salt and pepper. Put in baking dish. Pour over all the tomato sauce or tomato juice. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Dip
instructions: Drain pineapple. Reserve 3 tablespoons syrup. Combine ingredients except pecans. Form into ball. Top with chopped pecans.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Simmer water coffee and sugar for 2 hours. Cool and add vanilla and vodka. Let stand 3 to 4 weeks.

title: Mock Crab Cakes
instructions: Drain oil from tuna and put tuna in a small bowl. Break bread into small piece add to tuna. Add all other ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape into cakes fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Tang Drink
instructions: Dissolve- drink mix in pineapple juice in pitcher or punch bowl. Stir in ginger ale and add ice cubes. Garnish with orange slices.

title: Parsley Potatoes
instructions: Cut a 1/2-inch strip of peel from around the middle of each potato. Place potatoes in 2-quart casserole dish. Add water. Cover with lid and cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Drain potatoes and stir in parsley butter salt and pepper. Makes 4 servings.

title: Beef Tips And Rice
instructions: Brown meat and onions in margarine. Add rest of ingredients. Simmer 1 hour. Serve over rice.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops in oil. Layer on bottom of Pyrex dish. Layer sliced raw potatoes over all chops to the top of dish. Pour 1 jar Heinz chili sauce over potatoes. Add salt pepper and garlic to taste. Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove foil. Top with 1 package frozen peas. Bake 20 minutes longer. May be doubled in a larger dish.

title: Country Style Cabbage
instructions: Cook ham with some water until tender. Put cabbage and potatoes with the ham; cook for 30 minutes. Take up and drain. Cut cabbage as small as you want.

title: Fluffy White Icing
instructions: Mix ingredients and put in double boiler. Mix with electric mixer while cooking until it forms peaks or is at spreading consistency.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: With electric mixer beat eggs; add sugar and beat until creamy. Add Eagle Brand and vanilla; beat well. Add peaches and milk. Freeze as usual in ice cream freezer.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: In skillet cook until brown the brown sugar shortening and cream. Add milk flour and egg yolk. Continue cooking until thickened. Pour into pie pastry and cool.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in mixing bowl and mix until smooth. Stir in flour one cup at a time until thoroughly mixed. Mix in nuts. Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Drop from soup spoon onto cookie sheet. Cook at 300\u00b0 until done.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine first three ingredients together to form a ball. Roll in chopped nuts and refrigerate.

title: Swiss-Gruyere Fondue
instructions: Toss together cheeses flour mustard and garlic powder. In a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole microcook the wine Worcestershire sauce and 1/4 cup water uncovered on 100% power (High) 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until hot. Add cheese mixture to hot liquid. Microcook uncovered on 50% power (Medium) for 8 to 9 minutes or until cheese is melted stirring every 2 minutes. Serve with bread cubes. Reheat as necessary in the casserole on 50% power (Medium) for 3 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sauerkraut Soup
instructions: Slice Polish sausage into 1/2 in pieces. Drain and rinse sauerkraut.

title: Cornish Game Hens
instructions: Thaw wash and remove giblets from hens. Rub salt all over inside and out. Sprinkle with tenderizer. Place in roasting pan breast side up. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 1 hour or until brown and very tender. Baste with liquid several times during cooking to keep moist. (To keep more juicy bake breast down and turn last 15 minutes to brown. Its more trouble but worth it.) Serve with wild rice and English peas.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugars. Add eggs. Sift together dry ingredients. Mix well. Chill dough 1 hour or overnight. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet. Press with small glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix eggs onions and mushrooms. Heat soup before pouring over top. Sprinkle grated cheese over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. If refrigerated before baking bake for 1 hour. Bake uncovered.

title: Mrs. Whitten'S Happi Time Punch
instructions: Use green food coloring and red cherries for a festive air.

title: Bill'S Fried Catfish
instructions: Wash fillets in lemon or lime juice. Place on paper towel to dry at room temperature for 30 minutes. Salt to your taste using a mixture of garlic salt cayenne black pepper chili powder and red pepper.

title: Microwave Sliced Bake Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if skin is tough. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Put in microwave-safe dish and sprinkle with melted butter and parsley. Microwave on High power 10 minutes; rearrange potatoes after 5 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with Cheddar and Parmesan cheese. Microwave 4 to 6 minutes on High until cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft.

title: Momma'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Melt 1/2 of butter with brown sugar and pour into Bundt pan. Top with nuts and cherries.

title: African Rice Dishes
instructions: Wilt greens in hot oil. Do not brown. Add water to cover. Cook rice according to the directions on box. Set aside keeping rice hot. Add 2 tablespoons tomato paste. Add 3 or 4 beef bouillon cubes crushed. Add meat halfway cooked. Simmer 1 hour or until meat is tender. Serve over hot rice.

title: Darlene'S Delight
instructions: Mix butter and graham crackers and pat down in bottom of cake pan. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and 1/4 cup milk. Pour over graham crackers. Mix pudding and pour over sugar mixture. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Sunday Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine. Heat broth and undiluted soups and pour over cornbread crumbs. Add onion and celery. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Pour half of dressing mixture in greased deep 3-quart casserole. Add chicken and top with rest of dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Separate egg whites; beat until stiff. Beat egg yolks (yellows). Blend egg whites and egg yolks with oil. Mix flour and other ingredients. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cream Of Tomato Soup(Yields 4 Servings)
instructions: Cook tomatoes onion pepper cayenne sugar and bay leaf together for 15 minutes; strain. Melt butter and blend in flour. Add milk gradually stirring constantly. Garnish with watercress.

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Beat eggs; mix sugar and flour together to keep down lumps. Add sugar and flour mixture to well beaten eggs. Add pineapple juice and butter. Cook to a cream sauce. Pour over pineapple and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes or until slightly brown on top.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 275\u00b0 (slow). Line two loaf pans with brown paper. Mix oil sugar molasses and eggs. Beat vigorously with spoon or mixer two minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and pineapple; add Cool Whip marshmallows and nuts. Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Beef Stroganoff Skillet
instructions: In skillet brown beef and cook onion until tender. Drain fat from beef. Blend in mushroom soup and sour cream; add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Cook 10 minutes or until noodles are done. Stir often. Makes about 5 cups.

title: Vegetables In Cheese Sauce(Melts In Your Mouth.)
instructions: In a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole dish stir soup until smooth. Stir in milk basil and garlic. Mix well. Add cauliflower onion and peas. Stir to coat well. Cover with lid. Microwave on High 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring twice during cooking. Let stand covered 5 minutes. Makes about 5 1/2 cups.

title: Mary'S Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and cream until light. Add chocolate and mix well. Sift together flour and soda Add flour and sour cream alternately ending with flour. Add vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake. Mix as directed for 2 (9 inch) layers. Cool and slice into 4 layers.

title: Creamed Onions
instructions: Cook onions in boiling salted water 20 minutes if using fresh onions. Drain onions; add milk margarine or butter salt and pepper. Heat over low heat until hot.

title: Grape Jelly
instructions: Wash off grapes. Pick off grapes and put in a pan. Cook without water until done. The way you know when grapes are done the inside will come out of the hull (skin). Strain and let the juice set. Add 2 cups of juice with every 2 cups juice and add 3 cups sugar. Stir and put on stove. Cook until it comes to a rolling boil. Stir until sugar dissolves. Pour in glass jars and seal. Let set until jelly becomes jelly.

title: Breakfast Casserole(Easy And Quick)
instructions: Tear up bread and place pieces in greased baking dish (13 x 9 x 3-inch). Brown and drain sausage in skillet. Drain off fat. Spoon meat over bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat together eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over mixture in baking dish. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Cheese will rise to top during baking. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Tender Brisket
instructions: You also need a cooking bag.

title: Chowder Parmesan
instructions: Add all of this to 2 cups boiling water; simmer until tender.

title: Hot Tamales
instructions: Soak corn shucks in hot water for about an hour or more; the longer the better. Boil the meat until tender; save the liquid broth. Chop the meat real good. On the stove put a frying pan with a little Crisco. Put the chopped pork in and brown a little. Add garlic salt cumin and a small amount of chili powder. Pour a little broth in and stir and cook for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute leeks and parsley in a saucepan with butter. In a large saucepan place potatoes sauteed leeks and parsley and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Add salt. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are cooked. Put entire mixture through a sieve or puree in an electric blender. Return to a saucepan and add milk. Beat in egg yolks. Serve with a teaspoon of butter and croutons in each bowl.

title: Candy Nuts
instructions: Combine sugar cinnamon milk and water. Cook on slow heat until it forms a soft ball. Pour out on waxed paper and separate.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in square metal pan sprayed with Pam. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake for 40 minutes at 400\u00b0 (uncovered) or until done. Serve over egg noodles. Garnish with sliced lemons if desired.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and simmer until potatoes are tender. Add remaining ingredients and heat thoroughly.

title: Sloppy Joe Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In large skillet brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in tomato sauce corn water (optional) and seasoning mix. Heat mixture until hot and bubbly; reduce heat and simmer while preparing crust. Separate dough into 10 biscuits; flatten slightly. Dip each in milk; dip in cornmeal. Arrange 7 biscuits around sides and 3 in the bottom of 9-inch pie pan; press biscuits to form crust. Sprinkle crust with 1/2 cup of the cheese. Spoon hot meat mixture over cheese; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 8 servings.

title: Rich And Thick Milk Shake
instructions: Pour milk into electric blender container. Add pudding mix ice cream and ice. Cover and blend at high speed for 1 minute. Serve at once. Makes about 5 cups.

title: Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Melt chocolate over low heat; stir in sugar milk vanilla and mace. Mix well. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Excellent over pound cake sponge cake bread pudding or ice cream. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix well and serve.

title: Chicken Old Mill
instructions: Layer broccoli and chicken in baking pan. Heat soup mayonnaise milk and sherry. Pour over layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Serve over rice. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: Brown meat; then layer everything in a greased casserole in order given. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Marble Squares
instructions: Blend the butter vanilla water and sugars. Beat in egg. Mix in flour mixture. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped nuts if desired.

title: Creamy Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar and juice in a small bowl; stir well and set mixture aside. Combine remaining ingredients. Add cream cheese mixture to apple mixture; toss gently. Cover and chill. Toss again before serving. Serve in lettuce lined bowl. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Clam Spaghetti
instructions: Heat sauce to boiling and add drained clams to sauce; cook for a few minutes for flavor. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Easy Stuffed Potato
instructions: Split potatoes and wrap in tinfoil. Bake until done. Scoop out inside and mix with butter cheese and bacon bits. Replace in shell and sprinkle with cheese. Broil until cheese melts.

title: Picadillo Tarts
instructions: Cook ground chuck beef and onion in a skillet until meat is browned; drain well. Stir in almonds and the next 6 ingredients. Place 1 sheet of phyllo on a damp towel (keep remaining phyllo covered). Lightly brush phyllo with melted butter. Top with another sheet and brush again with melted butter. Fold in half placing long edges together to make a 17 x 6-inch rectangle. Cut into 10 equal portions using a sharp knife. Repeat procedure with remaining phyllo. Press each portion of phyllo into a lightly greased miniature muffin cup forming a shell. Spoon about 1 teaspoon of the beef mixture into each shell. Cover with plastic wrap; refrigerate until ready to bake. Remove plastic wrap. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Gently remove from pan; serve warm or at room temperature. Garnish with chopped parsley. Makes 50 appetizers.

title: Coconut Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter and mix all ingredients. Roll into balls and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan. Add soup milk and green chiles and blend well on top of stove or in microwave at Medium. Roll tortillas with chicken and 1/2 the cheese and set side by side in casserole. Pour sauce over top. Work down in between. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or microwave 20 minutes on High. Serves 8.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together well. Put in unbaked 9-inch pie shell and cut margarine up and place all over top. Cover with strips. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven. Check in 20 minutes and bake until done (heat may need to be lowered after 20 minutes).

title: Potato Dressing
instructions: Cook onion and celery in butter until tender. Combine with potatoes bread crumbs eggs parsley and seasonings. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes in covered dish.

title: Luscious Flan(Pleases Eye As Well As Palate)
instructions: Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar in a heavy saucepan; put over medium heat. Cook stirring constantly until sugar melts and syrup is light golden brown. Pour syrup into six 6-ounce custard cups. Let cool.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Top should be golden. Cool on a rack and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken breasts set aside. Boil mixed vegetables and drain. In a bowl mix vegetables soups and deboned chicken with 1 cup of reserved chicken broth. Pour in casserole dish.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine flour 1 cup sugar and milk. Mix well. Pour over melted butter. Do not stir. Combine peaches and remaining 1 cup sugar in saucepan; bring to a boil. Pour over batter; do not stir. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until browned. Yield Approximately 10 servings.

title: Rufus'S Vegetable Stew
instructions: Cook meat in large saucepan until tender and add the vegetables and cook until done.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Grease 15 x 10-inch pan. Line with wax paper and grease. Beat eggs 5 minutes. Add gradually sugar then pumpkin. Add flour salt baking powder and cinnamon. Pour into pan; sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Take it out of the oven and turn over onto a towel with 10x sugar sprinkled on it. Roll long ways; let cool 1 1/2 hours. Roll out and spread with filling (recipe follows). May be frozen or refrigerated.

title: Cream Cheese Pecan Frosting
instructions: Mix powdered sugar softened cream cheese softened margarine salt and milk until smooth. Add pecans and coconut. Spread over cake layers.

title: Cinnamon Pickles
instructions: Mix lime and water together and pour over cucumbers; let stand 24 hours. Add enough water to cover pickles. Wash drain and put in fresh cool water for 3 hours; drain. Simmer alum 1 cup vinegar red color and enough water to cover cucumbers; simmer 2 hours then drain. Make syrup of 3 cups vinegar sugar red hots 3 cups water salt and cinnamon sticks; boil for 5 minutes then pour over cukes. Pour off syrup for 4 mornings; bring to boil and pour over cucumbers. On fourth morning pack in jars. Cover with boiling syrup and seal.

title: Chewy Coconut Macaroons
instructions: In large mixer bowl beat egg whites until soft mounds form. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks form. Fold in 1 cup sugar and remaining ingredients carefully half at a time until thoroughly blended.

title: Garlic Pasta Chicken
instructions: In large skillet generously cover bottom with olive oil. Saute garlic salt and fresh garlic. Add chopped chicken. Cook stirring 15 minutes. Add chopped red pepper. Stir and cook 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Orange Delight
instructions: Mix together tapioca pudding vanilla pudding orange extract and the 3 cups of water. Let stand for 10 minutes so tapioca gets soft. Cook until thick. Boil for 1 minute. Cool. Add Cool Whip pineapple and oranges. Stir until blended good. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: In a large bowl combine ingredients. Blend together and chill (can be made ahead).

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Spread graham crackers in cookie pan. Mix margarine brown sugar and pecans in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Pour over crackers. Cook on broil 2 to 3 minutes. Topping will look bubbly.

title: Speedy Taco Bake
instructions: Cook beef and onion until done. Spoon into baking dish. Stir in taco mix tomato sauce and corn. Sprinkle on cheese.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour measure and sift two times. Cream margarine and Crisco. Add sugar and cream well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flour and milk alternately. Begin with flour and end with flour. Add flavoring. Beat at slow speed. Bake in greased tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Start in cold oven. This does not use baking powder. May use 2 teaspoons vanilla instead of almond.

title: Spanish Spaghetti
instructions: Heat oil; add onions and green peppers. Cook until soft. Add ground beef salt black pepper and chili pepper. Cook until browned. Add tomato sauce tomato paste and 4 cups tomatoes and 1 teaspoon sugar. Cook together 15 minutes on medium heat. Break spaghetti into pieces and cook according to directions on package. Do not overcook. Drain and add to sauce mix and put into casserole. Put into oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Betty Bowen'S Noodles And Cabbage
instructions: Fry cabbage \slowly\ in 1 stick butter (should take about 1 hour on low). Be careful not to burn light brown is okay. While cabbage is cooking make noodles.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Brown on both sides in a skillet. In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer the vegetables and pour soup over. Remove chops from pan remove fat from skillet and add water to rinse and scrape particles from bottom of skillet. Pour this over vegetables. Sprinkle with thyme. Place chops on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. If chops get too brown during cooking cover with glass lid or foil.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add chili and mix well. Heat in microwave or on stove. Serve with corn chips.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender; drain. Combine noodles drained tuna mayonnaise vegetables and salt. Add soup milk and cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift remaining ingredients together and blend into mixture. Form into rolls; wrap in waxed paper. Refrigerate overnight. Slice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Combine kraut onion and parsley; toss until well mixed. Spread dressing on each slice of bread. Top 8 slices of bread with corned beef cheese and kraut mixture; top with remaining bread. Lightly butter both sides of sandwiches. Grill slowly until cheese melts and bread browns.

title: Chicken Soup With Meatballs
instructions: Bring chicken broth and water to boil. Add pasta and cook 5 minutes. Add spinach and simmer 5 minutes longer. Mix the ground meat cheese and garlic and drop from teaspoon into soup. Simmer 7 minutes until no longer pink inside. Stir in 3 cups of vegetables and simmer until done (onion carrots celery zucchini).

title: Banana Split
instructions: Blend the first 4 ingredients 5 minutes in mixer. Spread over crumbs made of graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Mix and pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate. Cut 5 bananas in 1/2 pieces. Layer in pan. Next layer pineapple. Spread with Cool Whip. Garnish with coconut maraschino cherries and chopped nuts. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Tuna Salad Mold
instructions: Heat soup and water to boiling point. Add Jell-O. When mixture is partly set add remaining ingredients. Pour into molds. Chill until set. Makes 8 molds.

title: Old-Fashioned Creamed Corn
instructions: Remove husks and silks from corn. Rinse corn and pat dry. Cut corn from cobs (about 3 cups); to cut corn from cob with very sharp knife first cut just barely take the top of the kernels second cut take about half-way of kernels and third cut use blade of knife and scrape down to cob. This gets the milk out of corn. Place butter in 2-quart casserole; microwave at High for 55 seconds until butter melts. Add corn 1/4 cup water and sugar stirring well. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap. Cook on High 8 to 9 minutes or until corn is tender stirring after 4 minutes. Shake 1/2 cup water salt pepper and flour in pan until flour is blended smooth. Stir into corn mixing well. Cook on High 3 minutes or until mixture slightly thickens.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let set till dry onions are limp and no longer crunchy. Use for fish topping or anything else you like to use tartar sauce on.

title: Picadio
instructions: Brown and drain beef. Add onion tomatoes garlic vinegar oil cinnamon cloves salt raisins with stock and green olives. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Slush . . . . Slush
instructions: Mix and put in freezer.

title: Corn Pone
instructions: Blend sugar and Crisco. Add egg which was beaten slightly to sugar and Crisco. Add sour milk. Sift together soda cornmeal flour and salt. Stir into mixture. Pour into a greased pan and bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Spoon Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs then cream again. Add bread and pineapple including juice from can. Pour into buttered dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Halve eggplant lengthwise. Hollow out center. Cook sausage; drain. In a large bowl mix sausage eggplant centers tomatoes squash onion salt and pepper. Mix well. Stuff into eggplant shells. Spoon 4 tablespoons of tomato sauce over each. Mix bread crumbs oregano egg and remaining tomato sauce. Spoon over eggplant. Cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart pan or slow cooker. Simmer for 45 minutes. Add more milk if needed. Add salt to taste. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Coconut Meringue Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy white and double in volume in a medium bowl. Beat in sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating all the time until meringue stands in firm peaks. Fold in vanilla and coconut. Drop by teaspoon 2 inches apart on greased and floured large sheets. Bake in very slow oven (250\u00b0) for 35 minutes or until lightly golden. Remove from sheet to wire racks. Let stand to cool completely.

title: Williamsburg Salad(Serves 12)
instructions: Soften gelatine in cold water. Add sugar pineapple juice vinegar salt and green coloring. Chill until slightly thickened then add pecan meats India relish pineapple and olives. Pour into molds or a flat serving dish which has been rubbed with oil. Chill until firm and serve. Unusual!

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt soda baking powder cinnamon and Wesson oil. Beat 2 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla and beat 2 more minutes. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake in a tube cake pan for 45 to 50 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine mushroom soup and 1 cup of broth and put in bottom of\tpan. Add half of stuffing on top of soup.\tAdd chicken on\ttop of stuffing. Put chicken soup with other cup of broth on chicken. Add the remaining stuffing on top. You can use frozen broccoli if desired on top of chicken. Bake with aluminum foil on pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift together flour salt soda cinnamon allspice nutmeg cloves and baking powder. Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Mix light but well. Add dry ingredients. Divide into 3 loaf pans greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion together. Drain; mash well. Drain again. Melt margarine in 9-inch baking dish. Pour melted margarine into squash. Mix all ingredients well except cracker crumbs. Pour in casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until firm and top is brown.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Grind pears peppers and onions in food chopper or processor. Add all the ingredients to the vinegar and sugar. Boil 30 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the chocolate bits and beat for 3 minutes. Fold in bits and pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0. After 1 hour check with cake tester. Bake until batter does not stick to tester. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: O'Charley'S Loaded Potato Soup
instructions: Bring water to a boil in large pot. Add potatoes to water along with chicken stock base salt and pepper. Cook 12 minutes or until potatoes are about half-done. Add Cheddar cheese soup and simmer 10 minutes. Melt butter or margarine in a heavy saucepan. Add flour and cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 3 to 4 minutes. Do not brown. Whisk flour mixture into the potato mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer an additional 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in half and half and heat to serving temperature. Do not boil. Serve with chives bacon bits and parsley.

title: Fran'S Easy Cobbler
instructions: Defrost pie crust. Butter 1 large baking pan. Line bottom and sides of pan with two of the pie crusts. Pour peaches into bowl. Mix all ingredients. Squash peaches and mix until flour is mixed well. Pour into pan and cut the two crusts you have left into strips. Cover top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Highland Griddle Scones
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar into mixing bowl. Cut in Crisco thoroughly until particles are fine. Break egg into measuring cup; add enough milk to measure 3/4 cup. Blend together. Add all at once to flour mixture; stir just until moist.

title: Easy Chili
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add spices and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Then add tomatoes V-8 and rice. Cook until rice is done. You may add more V-8 if desired.

title: Cashew Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; mix thoroughly. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together alternately with sour cream. Blend well. Fold in nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool and top with golden butter glaze.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook 7-Up sugar and cornstarch until thick and clear. Cool then pour over strawberries. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Mix all together; put in crock-pot. Cook for 2 or 3 hours. Great to take for carry-ins.

title: Decorating Dough
instructions: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl. Slowly add water. Form ball. Knead dough for 5 to 10 minutes. Add flour (if sticky) and water (if stiff). May refrigerate dough up to 5 days. Make ornaments crafts etc.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Brown onion in butter. Add chicken carrots bean sprouts corn and seasonings. Cook on simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Cool completely. Wrap 2 tablespoonfuls of mixture in each egg roll skin and seal edges. Place in deep fryer until browned.

title: Cream Cheese Dessert
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with other ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Baked Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan and top with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Crab Bisque
instructions: Drain crabmeat and remove any bits of shell. Set aside.

title: French Omelet
instructions: Separate yolks from whites. Beat whites until light; add salt and beat until stiff and dry. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored; add milk and pepper. Fold egg whites and baking powder into the yolks. Melt butter in frying pan; pour in egg mixture and heat slowly until omelet has set. Put in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until omelet browns on top. Serve immediately with Spanish sauce. Yield 5 servings.

title: Venison Roast
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients. Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Add meat. Spoon remaining mixture over roast. Combine water and wine. Pour over roast. Cover and marinate for 2 days in refrigerator turning occasionally. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until tender basting occasionally with pan drippings. Yield 8 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: In pan bring 1 cup pineapple juice to boil. Take off heat and add Jell-O. Mix real good then add Sprite. Mix pineapple cranberries and pecans. Mix and pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Chill until set.

title: Pickled Peaches
instructions: Stew peaches with 2 or 3 cloves. Simmer other ingredients 3 to 4 minutes. Pour over peaches. Store in refrigerator.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Roll out crescent rolls and press in jelly roll pan pressing seams together. Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let cool. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise and Ranch mix; spread on cooled crescent crust. Add vegetables making sure you press them into the cream cheese mixture. Top with grated cheese. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sloppy Jewels
instructions: Cook and drain beef. Saute onions pepper and garlic for 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Cook 15 minutes. Serve on rolls.

title: Mustard Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar mustard cornstarch and a pinch of salt in a heavy saucepan. Add egg yolk and mix well. Heat coffee cream to near boil. Add to egg mixture and mix well. Place over medium heat and stir until thick. Slowly add vinegar beating constantly. Serve warm over meat.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cook and stir onion in butter until onion is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except shrimp rice flour and water. Cook until pepper and celery are tender. Add flour shrimp and last of all water. Cook over low heat until shrimp are tender. Serve over rice.

title: *Little Jewels Salad
instructions: Mix lime jello with 1 cup of hot water and 1/2 cup of cold water. Put into pan to set. Do the same with the cherry and orange jellos. Chill in the refrigerator. Mix sugar pineapple juice and 1/4 cup water in saucepan; let come to a boil. Mix with lemon jello. Let set on counter until it jells. Mix the Dream Whip and milk. When thoroughly whipped add lemon jello mixture. Cut lime cherry and orange jellos into small cubes. Fold into whipped mixture and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Weight Watchers Soup
instructions: Use broth from chicken. Throw in chicken and other ingredients. Cook until thick.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Season to taste. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Pour hot water over Jell-O; add pineapple juice and while still warm. Add marshmallows and cheese. When cool add pineapple and nuts. When it begins to thicken and congeal fold in whipped cream. Chill.

title: Jessie'S Front Flip Fudge
instructions: Prepare pan by buttering bottom and sides of 9-inch square pan. Dice marshmallows. Set aside. Mix evaporated milk sugar and salt in saucepan. Heat mixture over low heat until it just boils then cook for 5 minutes stirring constantly with wooden spoon. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows chocolate chips nuts and vanilla. Stir until marshmallows melt. Pour in pan. Cool. Cut in squares.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Melt oleo in soup pot. Add onion carrots and celery. Saute until soft. Add flour and cornstarch.\tCook until bubbly. Add broth and milk and make a smooth sauce. Add soda and cheese. Garnish with parsley before serving.

title: Stir Crazy Cake
instructions: Put flour 1 1/2 cups sugar cocoa soda and salt into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch metal baking pan. Stir with a fork to mix. Form 3 wells in the flour mixture. Pour oil into one well vinegar in the second and vanilla in the third. Pour cold coffee over all ingredients and stir with fork until well mixed. Do not beat. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pixie Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the Crisco butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Sift flour salt and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla and lemon flavoring; beat well. Bake in a tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Combine cream cheese egg and salt. Beat until smooth. Add chocolate and butterscotch chips; set aside. Mix flour soda salt cocoa and sugar. Add oil vanilla and water. Beat together until smooth.

title: Chocolate Cake And Icing
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Bring butter water shortening and cocoa to boil. Pour over flour mixture and mix well. Add eggs buttermilk and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain and rinse in cold water. Add tuna peas onions cheese and salt to taste. Blend in enough mayo to make creamy.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Saute onion in oil until tender. Add ground beef. Cook until brown stirring until crumbly. Add tomato sauce and seasonings; mix well. Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Salmon Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain. Chop eggs. Mix mayonnaise and Ranch dressing. Mix all ingredients with macaroni. Chill in refrigerator or serve warm. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Chicken-Rice Twosome
instructions: Coat chicken with flour onion powder paprika and pepper. In skillet brown chicken in hot margarine. In a small saucepan heat water and bouillon cubes until dissolved. Stir in sherry. In bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole combine water mixture rice mushrooms celery and onion. Place chicken on top. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed and chicken is tender. Makes 2 servings.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Scallop
instructions: Prepare stuffing according to package directions. Spread in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with layer of chicken. In large saucepan melt butter. Blend flour and seasonings. Add cool broth. Cook and stir until mixture thickens. Stir small amount of mixture into eggs. Return to hot mix. Pour over chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes to set. Cut in squares to serve with pimento mushroom sauce. Serves 12.

title: Fluffy Pink Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Calico Bean Pot
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot and cook on high for at least 4-6 hours.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie(2 Pies)
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and eggs until light and fluffy. Combine dry ingredients then add alternately with milk beating well. Beat in bananas and vanilla. Pour in greased and floured pan (9 x 13 x 2-inches). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Tasty Taco Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat. Drain. Stir in tomato sauce and seasoning mix. Simmer 5 minutes. Unroll dough. Press onto bottom and sides of ungreased 12-inch pizza pan. Prick bottom and sides with fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cover crust with meat mixture and cheese. Continue baking until cheese begins to melt. Top with remaining ingredients. Serve with sour cream if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Lib'S Crab Appetizer
instructions: Spread cream cheese on bottom of a platter. Cover with the chopped onions. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over the onions. Mix ketchup horseradish and Tabasco and spoon over the layered ingredients. Top with the crab. Sprinkle a little lemon juice over crab. Finish off with chopped parsley. Serve with crackers. Delicious!!

title: Mini Blintzes
instructions: Mix the cream cheese sugar and yolks together. Cut crusts from the bread and roll the bread thin. Spread the slices with the cream cheese mixture. Roll up bread. Dip each in melted oleo then roll in the cinnamon and sugar mixture. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes at 400 degrees. Cut in half. Serve plain or with sour cream. You can freeze these to cook later.

title: Frozen Champagne Salad
instructions: Soften and blend cream cheese with sugar. Mix together drained pineapple strawberries with juice bananas nuts and whipped topping. Combine 2 mixtures. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze.

title: Rhubarb-Cherry Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand 15 minutes. Line 9-inch pie plate with pastry. Add filling. Add top crust. Flute edges. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Shred cooked chicken breasts in a baking dish. Saute onions and celery. Mix celery soup chicken soup celery and onions. Pour on top of chicken. Mix Stove Top stuffing according to package directions. Top chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add vanilla lemon juice and condensed milk and mix. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill 2 hours.

title: Sweet-Treat Fried Ice Cream
instructions: With scoop form 6 ice cream balls. Place on wax paper-covered tray; cover and freeze several hours or until very firm.

title: Marsha'S Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger meat and drain. Add spaghetti sauce sugar and mushroom soup. Cook for 10 minutes on medium. Pour in casserole dish cooked noodles and sauce. Then put cheese all in the casserole. Cut in 1-inch strips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Olive Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Mix with remaining ingredients and chill. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail oranges and cherries. In a large bowl mix fruit cocktail oranges and cherries. Add sour cream chopped walnuts marshmallows and coconut. Mix until all is blended. Place in another dish. Cool in refrigerator for 2 hours and serve.

title: Chile Cheese Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs; add salt and pepper to taste and a pinch of garlic. Open chilies and clean seeds from them. Spread in the bottom of well buttered 8 x 8-inch Pyrex baking dish alternating cheese and chilies in layers. Pour eggs over and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut into one-inch squares or smaller.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and pineapple well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix. Refrigerate.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in microwave; stir. Mix in all of peanut butter. Mix in all of Crispix. Make sure Crispix is covered with first mixture. Pour enough powdered sugar into a bag; add cereal. Shake well. Place in a covered container.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with salt pepper and paprika. Combine egg and milk. Dip chicken in egg mixture. Drop into paper bag with flour. Shake to coat. Place in hot oil in heavy deep skillet. Cover. Fry at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until brown. Serves 4.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Mix ground beef rice and onion together. Stuff it inside peppers. Pour jar of spaghetti sauce in pan. Add 1/2 jar of water. Add peppers and cook at medium heat for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Easy Pineapple Cake Frosting
instructions: Mix the pineapple with juice into the dry pudding mix. Stir until pudding mix dissolves. Stir in nondairy topping. Spread between and on the outside of your cake layers. Refrigerate cake after icing. Yields enough to frost 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan cake or 2 layers. Use white or yellow cake mix.

title: B~B~Q Sauce
instructions: Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 qt.

title: Vegetable Shira-Ae
instructions: Place tofu on paper towel changing paper towel until most of water has drained out. Put tofu in bowl and mash with fork or potato masher. Grind roasted sesame seed and add with rest of ingredients to tofu. Mix well. Use as dressing on boiled vegetables. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Spray saucepan and cooking pan. Melt margarine over low heat in large saucepan. Add marshmallows; stir until melted. Remove from heat. Add cereal; stir until coated. Use buttered spatula to press mixture into baking sheet. Remove from sheet and add decorations (decorations optional).

title: No Knead Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup water. Measure sugar salt and shortening; add 1 1/2 cups warm water in a large bowl. Beat in yeast and eggs. Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth. Stir in enough flour to make soft dough and mix well. Place in a greased bowl; cover and let rise until doubled (about 1 1/2 hours). Punch down cover tightly and refrigerate. (Dough keeps 3 to 4 days.) Remove dough from refrigerator. Shape rolls. Let rise until doubled (about 45 minutes). Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Brush top with butter. Makes 24 servings.

title: 10 Day Cole Slaw
instructions: Boil sugar oil salt dried mustard and celery seed for 5 minutes. Pour over cabbage onions and green pepper. Let cool; mix and refrigerate. This will keep at least 10 days.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat and leave juice in meat. Add diced onion and pepper. Let simmer 5 to 10 minutes then add remaining ingredients preferably tomatoes first. Also add 1 cup of water. Cook for about 2 hours and remove lid for the last 45 minutes for thicker chili.

title: Blueberry Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Fold together blueberries and 2 tablespoons flour. Set aside. Mix remaining ingredients and add floured blueberries. Put into muffin cups (may use liners and put 1/2 cup mixture into each). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes and onion in enough water to cover with salt and pepper until almost done. Add milk and butter. Cook until done stirring often. Can be thickened with cornstarch if desired.

title: Roasted Potato Salad
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Place potatoes on a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown stirring once.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients but stuffing and nuts. Empty into a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with stuffing and nuts. You may drizzle top with melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Very Good And Easy Zucchini Cheese Quiche
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add cheese zucchini Bisquick and margarine. Mix thoroughly. Mix soda baking powder and milk and pour into zucchini mixture. Mix well and pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Maple Nut Chiffon Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt into bowl. Make a well and add Wesson oil egg yolks water and maple flavoring. Beat until smooth with electric mixer using medium speed for one minute. In a large bowl add cream of tartar to egg whites. Beat with electric mixer until whites form very stiff peaks on high speed for 3 to 5 minutes. Do not underbeat. Pour egg yolk mixture gradually over beaten egg whites gently folding with rubber spatula just until blended. Add nuts. Do not stir. Pour into ungreased 10 x 4-inch tube pan. Bake 55 minutes at 325\u00b0 then increase to 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes longer or until top springs back when lightly touched. Turn pan upside-down and cool. Let hang until cold. Remove and frost with the following.

title: Punch Bowl Chocolate Mousse Cake
instructions: Punch holes in cake and pour Amaretto over; let set. Layer Crumbled cake mousse whipped cream and Heath bars. Make several layers with all ingredients.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Coca-Cola and marshmallows in large bowl; blend at low speed. Beat one minute at medium speed; add Coca-Cola and blend well by hand. Stir in marshmallows. Pour batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hungarian Goulash
instructions: In a large frypan flour beef with 1/2 cup flour; add onions and oil and brown. Stir in paprika marjoram pepper green pepper garlic tomatoes and 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer. Cook approximately 90 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Fettucini Alfredo
instructions: Melt butter in heavy skillet over low heat. Add chopped onion and saute until onion is transparent. Stir in whipping cream. Mix well. Now stir in Parmesan cheese. When this is mixed well add cooked peas. Continue to cook over low heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Serve over fettucini noodles. You can use broccoli shrimp etc. instead of peas.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Mix the flour buttermilk and oil together in a bowl until mixture becomes a dough. Sprinkle occasionally with flour as you knead this a few times. In another bowl mix the sugar and sweet potatoes together. Press dough in the center and add sweet potatoes to this. Begin kneading the dough until well mixed. Roll or pat out to desired thickness. Cut biscuits. Bake in oven oven at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese and Cool Whip. Mix the drained fruits and mix all ingredients together. Garnish if desired with halved cherries. Store in refrigerator.

title: Pepparkokar(Swedish Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Mix butter sugar egg and molasses together in mixer. Add flour soda and spices. Chill dough in refrigerator; roll thin and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. (Dough may also be shaped into \logs\ frozen and sliced from ends; not as pretty but much easier!)

title: Chocolate Brittal Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl. Add butter vanilla and eggs. Mix again. While mixing add chocolate chips and Bit-o-Brittal. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare chicken and let cool. Cook stuffing as directed on box. Do not cook peas or preheat gravy. Take glass baking dish and put either 1 box stuffing or a half of box to cover bottom. Layer chicken then peas and stuffing. Pour gravy on top and heat until hot or warm. Serves 8.

title: Easy Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan add coconut. Mix until coconut is coated with butter; add milk eggs and sugar. Mix well. Place in unbaked pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until brown. Makes 2 pies.

title: Non-Alcoholic Punch
instructions: Mix together the first 6 ingredients. Float orange slices on top. Add cherries.

title: Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Crust Mix flour sugar and oleo until crumbly and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Delicious Orange Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar vanilla and orange rind. Add milk alternately with dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoons onto baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together well; form into loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-o pineapple (juice included) 1 cup water and 2 Tbsp. sugar in saucepan. Dissolve Jell-o and cook until mixture comes to a boil. Set aside to cool completely.

title: Herb Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cut potatoes in slices like French fries and place in large bowl with other ingredients. Toss well and place on a nonstick baking sheet and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Guyanese Garlic Pork(Traditional Christmas Breakfast Dish)
instructions: You will also need 2 large airtight glass jars (Mason jars ideal).

title: Quick Cinnamon Twist
instructions: Pull each biscuit out to about 6-inches long. Dip in melted butter and roll in mixture of nuts cinnamon and sugar. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tomatoes Yemistess(Greece)
instructions: Cook meat butter and onion until browned in saucepan or electric skillet. Add parsley almonds cinnamon salt and sugar. Simmer 5 minutes. Add rice. Cook over low heat 5 minutes. Hollow out tomatoes reserving pulp and juice. Fill with rice mixture.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Combine salmon cracker crumbs egg onion parsley and pepper. Blend well. Shape into patties. Fry over medium heat.

title: Yummy Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice and milk. Add fruit (drained) and fold in topping. Put in icebox until set about 30 minutes.

title: Winter Soup
instructions: Simmer ham and sausage in 3 1/2 quarts of water. Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until tender. Remove ham and sausage and cut up. Return to water. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until vegetables are tender.

title: Persimmon Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add egg and continue beating the egg. Add persimmon pulp. Sift together flour soda and baking powder. Add to mixture. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch square pan which has been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter thoroughly. Add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Add eggs and flavorings. Sift dry ingredients together. Do this sifting 3 more times. Blend both mixtures together. Chill dough overnight. Roll dough out on floured cloth or board and cut in desired shapes. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 6 minutes. Watch carefully to avoid burning. Yields 10 dozen round cookies 3 inches in diameter.

title: Heavenly Salad
instructions: Blend sugar and cream cheese. Mix all other ingredients with sugar and cream cheese. Add the Cool Whip. Blend again. Spread all in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Will keep for a long time. Thaw 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Use either a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or a jelly roll pan/cookie sheet approximately 1 inch deep. Spray bottom of pan with Pam before you begin to layer sheets of filo dough. You will layer 10 to 12 sheets of filo dough making sure you brush butter on top of each new sheet. Keep a damp cloth over the filo dough so it does not dry out. After you have layered your last sheet of dough spread your cheese/spinach mixture. Now begin laying the next 10 to 12 sheets of filo dough again brushing butter on top of each sheet. Be sure to cut off excess dough and score or cut into squares before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cheese/spinach mixture Mix together the eggs drained spinach cheese salt pepper dill garlic and onion.

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Cream the cream cheese with sugar. Beat in egg. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop 1 rounded teaspoonful of mixture in each cupcake paper. Top with cake batter. Bake as directed on cake box.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid according to package directions. Combine Kool-Aid and pineapple juice. Just before serving add ginger ale and mix well.

title: Two Minute Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla and nuts in large glass bowl. Microwave for 2 minutes on High power. Blend in vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased dish and chill.

title: Icebox Delite
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream together eggs margarine and sugars; sift together flour soda and cream of tartar. Mix into cream mixture. Form into rolls (logs). Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate. Slice and bake in a moderate oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Bake on lightly greased pan.

title: Whoopie Pie Cake
instructions: Beat several minutes and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes in middle of oven. Grease flour and line 9 1/2 x 13-inch cake pan with wax paper. After it is baked and cooled lift cake out of pan onto oblong serving tray. Cut lengthwise through the middle. Lift carefully with both hands under top part. Put icing in the middle and replace the top.

title: Chinese Jello Salad
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 cup. Add to gelatin; add soy sauce and lemon juice. Stir until ice is melted and gelatin is slightly thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. Add remaining ingredients and spoon into individual dishes or a bowl. Chill until set at least 30 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 cups or 5 servings. Contains 25 calories per serving.

title: Parmesan Sauce
instructions: Combine milk and margarine. Bring to a boil. Add cheese seasonings and mushrooms; stir well.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and blend well. Shape into 1-inch meatballs. Combine remaining ingredients in medium saucepan and mix well. Add meatballs stirring lightly to coat with sauce. Simmer about one hour stirring occasionally. Makes 32 to 36 meatballs.

title: Tomato-Sherried Eggs
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Place in a buttered 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch casserole. Form 8 wells in tomato mixture. Crack 1 egg into each well. Sprinkle with cheese and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bake in a preheated oven at 375\u00b0 until eggs are set about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with cooked bacon or sausage and toast or biscuits if desired. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine oil sugar eggs and vanilla. Add zucchini and then sifted dry ingredients. Add nuts and raisins if desired. Bake 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yield with nuts and raisins 2 regular or 6 small loaves. Without nuts and raisins 2 medium or 3 small loaves.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole(Serves 6)
instructions: Melt butter; stir in flour broth and evaporated milk. Stir constantly until mixture begins to thicken and is smooth. Stir cheese into sauce. Drain onions and add to sauce with salt and pepper. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Fry beef and garlic gently and keep juice. Also add mushrooms and big onions. Mix ingredients and place in casserole.

title: Mom'S Muffins
instructions: Mix all together and bake in muffin cups at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Chili
instructions: Cook and stir hamburger onion and garlic in 3-quart saucepan. Drain. Stir in tomatoes (with liquid) celery chili powder salt sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and simmer 1 hour. Stir in beans; heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered about 15 minutes. For thicker chili continue simmering. Can be stored frozen for no longer than 4 months.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Mix together dressing soup mix and preserves. Place chicken in baking dish. Pour mixture over chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and return to oven for 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Chocolate Mint Creams
instructions: Stir together flour and baking soda. In a medium saucepan heat and stir brown sugar margarine and water over low heat until butter is melted. Add chocolate pieces. Heat and stir until chocolate is melted. Pour into a large mixing bowl and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes or until cool.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine sugar and eggs then dry ingredients nuts and cherries. Roll in small rolls. Roll in waxed paper and store in refrigerator. Cut very thin and bake in 325\u00b0 oven. This makes approximately 15 dozen.

title: Lorraine'S Apple Strudel
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix dry ingredients and add margarine. Blend well. Add eggs and mix well. Spread all but one cup in the pan. Use a wet spoon and push in place. Place apples in rows on the dough not too many (makes the dough soggy). Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Form the last dough and rub between hands over the apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 until the apples are soft about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Evergreen Punch
instructions: Mix and chill mixture. If using unsweetened Kool-Aid use 4 packages to amount.

title: Ginger Soy Sauce
instructions: In small 1-quart saucepan combine a small amount of soy sauce and ginger to form a paste. Heat on low simmer setting on range. Stir and gradually add soy sauce until mixture reaches a boil. Serve hot or cold. Makes 1/2 cup sauce.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Melt butter. Cut biscuits into quarters. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. If using pecans put in oven last 10 minutes of baking time or they may burn!

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and heat. Mix next 7 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Mix in sorghum mixture; beat 1 minute. Last beat eggs. Put in mixture and continue to beat 1 minute. Bake in a greased 8-inch square baking dish at 300\u00b0 approximately 20 minutes. Wonderful served warm with Cool Whip.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
instructions: In a medium bowl empty both cans of refried beans. You can add a package of taco seasoning. Whip with blender for 2 to 3 minutes. Spread into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Spread lettuce over beans. Pour salsa over lettuce evenly. Spread sour cream over salsa. Sprinkle green onions and black olives over sour cream. Top with Cheddar cheese. Chill for 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: *If using Miracle Whip add 1 tablespoon of sugar.

title: Beef Barley Soup
instructions: In a Dutch oven or soup kettle place soup bones water onion bouillon vinegar salt pepper and bay leaves. Slowly bring to boil; skim foam with slotted spoon. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 3 to 4 hours. Discard bay leaves. Set bones aside to cool; remove meat from bones and dice. Skim fat from the broth surface. Add meat carrots celery potatoes barley thyme and dill. Cover and cook for 1 hour or until barley and vegetables are tender. Serves 9.

title: Hot Pasta And Asparagus
instructions: In a skillet cook garlic pepper flakes and hot pepper sauce in oil and butter for 2 minutes. Add asparagus salt and pepper; saute until asparagus is crisp-tender about 10 minutes. Add most Parmesan cheese; mix well. Pour over hot pasta and toss to coat. Sprinkle with a little more Parmesan. Serve immediately. Serves 6 to 8 main course or 10 to 15 side dish.

title: Half Hour Apple Butter
instructions: Combine ingredients in heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil; cook 30 minutes. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Coke And Pie Cherry Salad
instructions: Bring cherries water and sugar to boil in saucepan. Add Jell-O and food coloring then let cool. Add Coke pineapple and nuts or celery. Chill as you would Jell-O.

title: Wonderful Roast
instructions: Place roast in heavy aluminum foil. Spread dry Lipton onion soup on top. Spoon cream of mushroom soup on top of the onion soup. Fold foil down to seal roast. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours until done.

title: 4 Cheese Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Brown meat and drain grease. Add tomatoes; cook uncovered until thickened. Stir in onions and cream cheese. Toss in remaining cheeses. Cook until cheeses melt. Serve with Italian bread.

title: Cindy'S Layered Salad
instructions: First Layer Tear lettuce in bite-sized pieces to cover bottom of dish.

title: Creamy Lemon Pie(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In medium bowl beat egg yolks with condensed milk lemon juice and food coloring. Pour into prepared pastry shell; bake 30 minutes. Cool. Chill. Spread with whipped cream; garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers. Preparation time is about 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions and drain (no salt). Combine eggs and cheese. Mix egg mixture with broccoli soup and mayonnaise. Pour into casserole dish (lightly greased). Sprinkle crushed crackers on top and pour melted margarine on crackers. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and pie filling. Chill until firm.

title: Oreo Delight
instructions: Melt the butter. Crush all cookies. Set aside half for topping. Mix cookies and melted butter; press into pan. Mix the cream cheese milk and pudding and beat on low speed. Pour over crust. Fold in Cool Whip and sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.

title: Stella'S Green Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and set aside in refrigerator. Mix Dream Whip according to directions on package and fold into pudding mix.

title: 5 Can Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken milk noodles and soups in a bowl; mix well. Spoon into greased casserole. Top with chips. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: L.B.J. Mop Sauce For Barbecue Meats
instructions: Make the bone stock; buy good stout beef soup bones from butcher shop and boil them. Add all other ingredients and let stand overnight before using. Makes about 6 quarts. Baste the meat frequently. As you use it the flavor will improve from the smoke and grease from the barbecue. I freeze whats left in 1-quart plastic freezer containers.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press crescent roll dough onto a large cookie sheet and bake as directed on can for 7 to 8 minutes. Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and dressing mix and spread onto cooled crust. Chop vegetables and place on top. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Refrigerate.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pudding with pineapple; add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Season both sides of steaks with garlic powder pepper and salt. Heat 1 teaspoon butter in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until butter is foamy. Add 4 steaks and cook about 2 minutes per side until browned. Remove to plate. Repeat with remaining butter and steaks. Add remaining ingredients to skillet. Bring to boil stirring to scrape up browned bits in bottom. Add steaks along with any accumulated juices. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 50 to 60 minutes until meat is tender.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Combine the cake mix melted butter and 1/3 cup canned milk. Press 1/2 of the mixture into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Red Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute clams in oil and butter mixture for 2 minutes; add garlic onions and parsley to clams. Saute for 2 more minutes; add wine parsley and tomato sauce. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low heat (simmer for 10 to 15 minutes). Serve hot over linguine or spaghetti. Serves 2 to 4 depending on desired amount of sauce your guests like.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Bring clams to a boil. Drain water off. Fry fatback meat and brown onion in the grease. Add meat and onions to clams; add 6 cups water. Salt and pepper to taste. Dice up potatoes and add to clams. Boil for 30 minutes. Cut biscuits up into quarters and roll into balls. Drop into boiling clam broth and cook until done.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel and quarter large apples (if small use 1/2). Roll out biscuits thin and cut in halves (20 halves). Take 1/2 biscuit and wrap around each apple quarter. Place on greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Melt 2 sticks butter and pour over dumplings. Mix together water sugar cinnamon and apple pie spice. Pour over dumplings.\tBake at 375\u00b0\tfor 1 hour. One can biscuits equal 20 dumplings. May halve recipe.

title: Golden Chicken Cutlets
instructions: Place chicken breasts on wax paper and pound flat to 1/4-inch. Mix flour salt pepper nutmeg and marjoram in shallow dish. Have egg mixture ready in shallow dish. Mix crumbs and cheese in 3rd dish. Coat chicken in flour egg and bread crumbs. Simmer butter and oil. Add chicken turning 1 time 2 to 3 minutes. Remove. Add wine to cooking pan and bring to a boil scraping particles free. Pour sauce over chicken. Delicious served with Risotto.

title: Great Salad
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Pour over remaining ingredients. Toss and serve. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Festive Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix jellied cranberry sauce and 1 cup boiling water in mixer until smooth. Dissolve both packages of gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Mix cranberry sauce and gelatin. Add pecans. Put half of mixture in an 8-inch square pan and chill in freezer until firm about half hour. Leave other at room temperature. Spread sour cream over top of chilled gelatin. Add other half of gelatin over sour cream. Refrigerate until firm. Serves 12.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel and slice the apples into the bottom of a deep baking dish (9 x 9-inch approximately). Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Make a syrup of the brown sugar water nutmeg and butter; heat until hot. Blend the flour salt baking powder sugar and shortening. Add the milk; stir until moistened. Drop small portions of dough on apples leaving space for dough to expand. Pour hot syrup over dumplings and apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve plain or with ice cream.

title: Enchiladas From Texas
instructions: Heat chili in skillet on stove with 1/2 cup of water. Place one corn tortilla at a time in skillet until soft. Coat both sides with chili. Fill with cheese and onion. Roll up. Place side by side in baking dish. Fill all tortillas (continuing to add water to chili if too thick). Pour remaining chili onion and cheese on top. Bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Will feed 4 to 6 hungry Texans.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with the skins on; cool peel and slice. Dice bacon onion and green pepper. Fry bacon pieces in a skillet. Saute onion and green pepper with bacon. Dice eggs; add to potatoes. Mix vinegar sugar and 2 teaspoons salt with 1/2 cup water. Add to bacon-onion-pepper mixture; heat to a boil. Pour over potatoes and eggs. Mix well; serve immediately.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Use all of the marshmallow cream. Put half of the cream cheese in and mix together. Then put fruit on plate and dip.

title: Fluffy Cocoa Frosting
instructions: Mix cocoa and sugar. Cream part of the cocoa and sugar mixture with margarine and butter. Blend in vanilla and half of the milk. Add remaining cocoa and sugar mixture and blend well.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Stir all ingredients until well mixed. Cover; chill. Makes 3 cups.

title: Saucy Baked Beans
instructions: Drain juice from beans. Mix with remaining ingredients. Bake in a 2-quart casserole at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until desired consistency.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add 3 cups flour and rest of ingredients; MIX WELL with electric mixer. Add remaining 2 cups of flour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Torte
instructions: Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Place ground beef onion celery and garlic in 2 quart microproof bowl. Cook on HI for 5-6 minutes stirring once to break up beef. Stir in rice egg 3/4 c. tomato sauce parsley Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Fill green peppers with beef mixture mounding top. Arrange peppers in a ring in round or oval microproof baking dish just large enough to hold peppers upright. Cover with casserole lid and cook on 70 for 12-14 minutes. Spread 1 Tbsp. of the remaining tomato sauce on top of each pepper. Serve with crusty garlic bread if desired. 4 servings. Total cooking time 17-20 minutes.

title: Chewies
instructions: Melt margarine and add all ingredients. Blend well. Bake at 325 degrees in a greased 9 x 13 pan for 30-35 minutes. Cool cut into squares.

title: Festive Appetizer Spread
instructions: Boil the water and sugar together in a medium saucepan for 5 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients to sugar water and boil 10 to 15 minutes until thickened. Cool. Spread the sauce over the cream cheese and serve with crackers of your choice. Yield 3 cups.

title: Cherry Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in a loaf pan. Mix flour sugar eggs and cherries. Pour in pan and bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Drain juice off tomatoes and mix all together and cook about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Put 1 tablespoon of canning salt.
