title: Creamy Chicken Or Turkey Lasagna
instructions: Reserve 2/3 cup Mozzarella cheese for top layer. Combine in bowl soup milk and pepper; set aside. In another bowl mix spinach egg and Ricotta cheese; mix well. In bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish spread 1/2 cup soup mixture. Arrange 4 noodles on mixture. Top 1/3 soup mixture 1/2 spinach mixture 1/2 Mozzarella cheese and 1/2 chicken. Repeat layers ending with noodles. Top with reserved 2/3 cup Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until bubbling. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken A La Can Can
instructions: Combine soup water chicken and 1/2 onions. Add rice; stir to mix. Bring quickly to boil. Cover. Reduce heat. Cook until rice is done (several minutes). Transfer to casserole dish. Top with the other half of onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Preheat 10-inch iron skillet. Mix all ingredients and blend well. Pour batter into preheated skillet and bake for 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Corn Chip Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a microwavable container. Cook on High until hot and cheese is melted. Eat with your favorite corn chips.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Chop all vegetables finely. Mix with cooked spaghetti and chill. Note Any kind of pasta may be used in place of spaghetti.

title: Pretzel Congealed Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels melted margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar; spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 8 minutes at 350\u00b0 then cool. Combine cream cheese 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over pretzel crust when it has completely cooled. Prepare jello according to package directions. Thaw and drain frozen strawberries. Mix strawberries into dissolved jello and chill until mixture thickens to a syrupy stage. Pour jello mixture over cream cheese mixture. Chill until firm. Cut into squares to serve. Serves 15.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown the ground beef. Add the next 6 ingredients. Simmer meat mixture for 45 minutes; stir occasionally. Combine the cottage cheese eggs salt Parmesan cheese and parsley. Set the cottage cheese mixture aside until ready to use. Prepare 6 lasagna noodles. Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Place 3 noodles on bottom. Cover with 1/2 of the cottage cheese mixture. Cover with 6 slices Mozzarella cheese. Cover with 1/2 of the meat mixture. Place remaining 3 noodles on top of mixture. Cover with remaining cottage cheese mixture 6 more slices Mozzarella cheese and remaining meat mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Potato Cheese Bake
instructions: Cook potatoes in jackets until tender. Peel and shred. Combine potatoes with sour cream 1 cup of cheese and remaining ingredients except paprika. Turn into buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks with the sugar. Add milk gradually salt then coconut and stiffly beaten whites. If desired mix 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch with the sugar and use only 2 eggs. Fill shell and bake 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add beef braise until brown. Stir frequently. Add onions celery garlic seasoning and bouillon (dissolved in 1 cup of water). Simmer until peppers and celery are cooked (DO NOT OVER COOK). Then add cornstarch blended with 1/4 cup cold water. Cook until thickened then add soy sauce. Serve over hot rice. Add chow mein noodles on top of pepper steak.

title: Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix barbecue sauce onion and seasoning in baking dish. Place ribs in sauce. Roast covered for approximately 2 hours until meat is done. For quicker cooking can be cooked in oven bag; cook approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar eggs vanilla and salt. Beat well. Add soda and cinnamon to flour; mix well then add to oil mixture. Mix well. Add apples and nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Oven Buttered Cornsticks
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in shallow pan. Combine biscuit mix and corn; stir until soft dough is formed. Knead about 15 strokes on lightly floured surface. Roll out and cut. Roll in melted butter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes approximately 20 cornsticks.

title: Baked Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook peel and dice potatoes. Slice cheese in strips. Chop onion. Fry bacon crisp and crumble. Combine first 4 ingredients. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with bacon. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Dream Pie
instructions: Mix together and put in pie crust. Chill about 2 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in Cheez Whiz. Mix well with other ingredients. Pour into greased casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Combine chocolate morsels and evaporated milk in a small heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until chocolate morsels melt. Stir in powdered sugar. Cook mixture over medium heat stirring frequently for 5 minutes or until sauce thickens. Yields 2 cups.

title: Chocolate Peppermint Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Add eggs and sugar after beating together. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake in buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Double Crust Pizza Casserole
instructions: Crust Combine flour potatoes milk and margarine or butter and set aside.

title: Pineapple Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice. Combine cooked rice with milk salt sugar eggs vanilla and pineapple. Pour into 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover with foil. Place on bottom of oven watch so it doesnt burn. Cook about 30 minutes at 350 degrees or until done.

title: Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Dissolve 2 scoops of the mix in 1 cup of boiling water for instant hot chocolate. Yields 50 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until fork-soft. Cool potatoes until you can comfortably peel them. While you slice potatoes in large container fry bacon pieces and boil eggs.

title: Cheese, Pea And Pickle Salad
instructions: Drain peas and add chopped pickle cheese and grated onion. Mix together with enough mayonnaise to moisten. Serve on crisp lettuce leaf.

title: Coconut Creme Pie
instructions: In heavy saucepan mix sugar and cornstarch. Separate egg yolks from whites putting yolks in mixture. Add milk small amount at a time with egg and sugar until thin. Then add rest of milk. Cook on medium heat stirring constantly so not to stick until thick.

title: Lime Fluff(Cooking For  A Crowd)
instructions: In a large bowl combine whipped topping gelatin and cottage cheese. Fold in oranges. Chill until serving. Makes 100 servings.

title: Easter Bread
instructions: Combine warm water 1 tablespoon sugar and yeast; let stand for 15 minutes. Combine remaining sugar and rest of ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add yeast mixture. Knead and turn dough until it becomes dry and springy when pushed down. Fold dough over; sprinkle with a small amount of flour. Cover; let rise in a warm place for 3 hours or until doubled in bulk. Knead again; let rise for 1 hour. Shape dough into 7 round loaves; cover. Let rise for 2 hours. Brush top of loaves with additional beaten egg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate until ready to serve. Can be used on baked potatoes or fish.

title: Willie'S Chili
instructions: Fry garlic onion and chili peppers until lightly brown. Add meat and brown. Add water tomato sauce chili powder and cumin powder. Cook for 30 minutes. Cook longer for better flavor. Last add oats to thicken.

title: 24-Hour Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer the first 4 ingredients in a covered dish or Tupperware container.

title: Toasted Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Separate the fiber from pumpkin seeds. Do not wash the seeds. Add the margarine or oil and the salt to the seeds. Spread in shallow pan and bake at 250\u00b0 about 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes until crisp and brown.

title: Asparagus-Potato Casserole
instructions: The listed amounts are just an idea. You may vary the amounts of any of the ingredients to suit the dish and amount needed.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Shape into a ball.

title: Easy Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast with 1/4 cup of warm water. Set aside. Cream sugar and Crisco. Add egg. Stir in the 1 cup of water. Add yeast. Stir in flour. Put in a large bowl. Let rise in warm place until double. Punch down and shape into rolls. Let rise until double in bulk. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and chop up 4 chicken breasts. Add cream of chicken and mushroom soup then mix chicken ala king chopped small onion Cheddar cheese (grated) and chicken broth to mixture for moisture. Place in casserole and top with can of dried onion rings. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until bubbles through and through.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook celery and onion in butter until tender not brown. Add chicken broth and seasonings. Simmer 15 minutes. Slowly add soup and cheese. Add spaghetti and let stand for 1 hour. Add chicken and olives.

title: Cottage Cheese And Salsa Spread
instructions: Crumble goat cheese coarsely and stir into cottage cheese. Spread should be slightly lumpy. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Heat oil in saucepan. Add garlic and onion and green pepper. Saute until onion in translucent being careful not to brown. Stir in tomatoes. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Add jalapeno. Cool to room temperature. Refrigerate covered if to be kept overnight. Pile cheese mixture onto plate. Drizzle salsa around it to form a red pool around creamy cheese. Surround with additional fresh chopped tomatoes and green peppers if desired. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Card Party Cheesecake
instructions: Place rolls on the bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat cream cheese sugar and sour cream. Add eggs 1 at a time beating all the time. Add vanilla. Pour over rolls. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Shirley Mckenzie'S Breakfast Dish
instructions: Place 4 slices of bread butter side down in oblong baking dish. Place a slice of cheese on each piece. Top cheese with the cooked sausage. Beat the eggs milk and salt together. Place remaining 4 bread slices butter side up over the sausage. Pour eggs over all. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chris' Magic Brown Rice
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter. Add remaining ingredients except for rice. Bring to a boil. Add rice. Cook uncovered for 20 minutes until liquid disappears.

title: Fish Fillet Skillet
instructions: Partially defrost the fish so that fillets can be easily separated. Pour oil into a skillet. Add chopped onion and cook over medium heat about 5 minutes. Add the other ingredients except for the fish and cook about 5 minutes. Add the fish; cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Pineapple Raisin Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and egg thoroughly. Stir in pineapple. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting. Stir together flour soda salt and nutmeg and blend. Mix in nuts. Chill at least one hour. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until no imprint remains when touched lightly. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Ham Chowder
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender and blend flour into milk. Simmer 10 minutes. Garnish with paprika and parsley. Add salt to taste. Serve with garlic bread and tossed salad.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Shape in ball. Roll in pecans.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a buttered casserole. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Heat oil and cook the chicken pieces in it until they are golden brown turning frequently. Add onions; cook a few minutes longer. Add garlic tomatoes basil salt and pepper. Cover pan and cook gently until chicken is done and tomatoes are cooked to a sauce. Stir occasionally. Continue cooking for about 45 minutes. Add wine. Cook another 15 minutes. Serve with Italian Rice and a green salad.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix Veg-All and soup together and pour into a casserole dish. Mix flour milk and melted butter together. Pour over the soup and Veg-All mixture. Bake 45 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Sunday Pot Roast
instructions: Pour carrots and potatoes in bottom of crock-pot without draining off the liquid. Season the pot roast to taste and put on top of carrots and potatoes. Pour Pepperidge Farm gravy on top. Cook on high about 4 to 5 hours. If you put this in the crock-pot about 800 on Sunday morning this will be ready for lunch right after 1100 church.

title: Grandma Aggie'S Ranger Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Tuna Pie
instructions: Cook onion and green pepper in boiling salted water until tender then drain.

title: Pralines
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in saucepan. Cook about 20 minutes over medium heat until it comes to a boil. Stir occasionally and continue cooking until mixture forms a small ball in cold water. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and stir until mixture begins to lose its gloss. Drop small portions onto waxed paper. (Put foil under waxed paper to keep it from sticking to your countertop.) Work fast keeping saucepan over a warm surface if it seems to harden too fast. Let pralines cool before removing from waxed paper.

title: Creole Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine the mayonnaise Creole seasoning dill weed and paprika. Mix well and set aside. Combine chicken bell pepper celery onion and relish. Toss to mix. Add flavored mayonnaise and mix well. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add salt cocoa confectioners sugar vanilla and milk. Mix well. Put on warm cake.

title: Uncle Steve'S Bean Delight
instructions: Wash beans until all bubbles disappear. Mix beans salsa and chopped vegetables in large bowl. Season to taste with Old Dutch dressing; mix well. Let marinate 1/2 hour. Delicious!

title: Yum Yum Dessert
instructions: Bring pineapple and juice sugar and water to a boil. Add jello and cream cheese. Stir until cream cheese is dissolved. Chill until it starts to set. Add cool Whip and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle nuts over top.

title: Meat Goulash
instructions: Combine meat salt pepper and onion; mix well. Brown in skillet. Add red beans corn spaghetti tomato juice and chili powder. Simmer for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: The Aiken Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs 1 at a time. Add flour sifted with mace. Pour in greased 9-inch tube pan and bake 1 hour beginning in cold oven. Can be baked as sheet cake with butter icing for teas.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring to boil the sugar butter and milk. Boil until soft ball stage then remove from heat and add peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Beat until smooth. Pour into buttered dish to cool.

title: Snowy Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Combine flour baking powder sugar 2 tablespoons cocoa and salt. Stir in milk vanilla and shortening. Pour into greased 8-inch baking pan.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes thin. Mix onion cream of mushroom soup and milk. Layer potatoes with butter. Add salt and pepper. Lay pork chops on top. Cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Defrost patties. Crumble 4 patties in 9 x 13-inch dish. Salt and pepper. Top with margarine and 1/2 of cheese. Repeat layers. Pour half and half over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Spread crushed cookies on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan reserving 1/2 cup crumbs for later use. Mix whipped topping cream cheese powdered sugar and butter. In separate bowl mix the pudding with the milk. Mix with cream cheese mixture; spread over the cookies. Top with the leftover crumbs. Chill well.

title: Northern Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Marinate chicken wings in mixture for as long as possible. If cooking a lot of wings double recipe. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce celery green pepper onion and peas. Spread mayo over all. Sprinkle sugar over mayo. Sprinkle cheese. Top with bacon. Refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Potato-Vegetable Skillet
instructions: Line a 10-inch skillet with 4 lettuce leaves. Set aside. Peel a 1/2-inch wide strip around center of each potato. Layer potatoes and next 3 ingredients over lettuce leaves. Add water and sprinkle with sugar salt and pepper. Dot with butter.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix together chicken soup and vegetables. Pour into baked pie crust. Sprinkle grated cheese on top of chicken mixture. Crumble Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot about 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple save juice. Mix sugar and flour together. Add pineapple and cheese. Put in buttered casserole dish. Cover top with crushed Ritz crackers. Melt butter; add pineapple juice. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Bring margarine cocoa and water to boil. Pour over sugar and flour. Mix eggs buttermilk and soda and add. Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix all together in blender. Beat well for 5 minutes.

title: Rum Sauce
instructions: In double boiler melt sugar and butter in milk. Dissolve cornstarch in a little water and add to hot milk. Stir until thick remove from heat and add rum.

title: Fiddle Faddle
instructions: Combine and pour over 8 qt. popped corn. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cauliflower And Pea Salad
instructions: Mix together dressing mix and mayo. Drizzle dressing over peas and cauliflower. Let stand overnight and mix together before serving.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in lemonade. Add cold water and cranberry juice cocktail chilled. Pour over ice in punch bowl. Slowly pour in ginger ale chilled. Makes 12 cups.

title: English Toffee Bars
instructions: Sprinkle pecans evenly in 9 x 9-inch pan. In saucepan combine brown sugar and butter. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil for 7 minutes. Pour hot mixture over nuts. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Cover so chocolate chips melt. Spread chocolate evenly. Slice when warm or refrigerate and break into pieces.

title: Chunky Applesauce
instructions: Peel and core apples. Slice apple in quarters. In a pan add water and apples. Cook over low heat. Lightly mash apples; add cinnamon and stir. Serve chunky warm or cold.

title: Peach-Orange-Pineapple Preserves
instructions: Combine ingredients in saucepan and cook for about 30 minutes. Seal in sterilized jars.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Heat strawberries and jello together; let cool. Mix instant pudding milk sour cream and Cool Whip together. Place in dish a layer of wafers layer of pudding and then layer of strawberries. Put another layer of wafers and strawberries; top with pudding. Keep cool!

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Cook first 5 ingredients until butter is melted. Add beef; when browned add tomato sauce.

title: Ham Delights
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients to make spread; cook over low heat for a few minutes to soften onions. Cut the rolls apart as one lengthwise (leave bottom half in the aluminum pan). Cover bottom half of rolls with spread. Add ham and sprinkle with cheese. Replace top half of rolls. Bake for approximately 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mayonnaise Dressing
instructions: Cook until thick. Cool; pour over slaw.

title: Camellia Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans. In a large mixer bowl beat the sugar butter eggs and vanilla for about 5 minutes. Add water whole wheat flour cocoa baking soda salt ginger and white of orange rind. Beat until blended. Pour into pans. Bake 28 to 33 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool completely. Can be eaten plain or with a white frosting. The more adventurous might try a coconut frosting.

title: Mini Morsel Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In large mixer bowl beat sugar butter and vanilla extract until creamy. Beat in eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually add flour mixture alternately with milk. Stir in mini morsels. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan or 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake for 70 to 80 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Remove from pan; cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Makes 16 to 20 servings.

title: Ham-Swiss Cheese Buns(Power Level: Low, 30% And High, 100%)
instructions: Mix all ingredients except meat and buns in a 1-quart casserole. Microwave on High (100%) for 2 to 3 1/2 minutes or until boiling. Stir occasionally.

title: Southern Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all together and cook for 1 hour. Drain fat and cover top with ketchup and brown top. If using cheese brown top after adding catsup.

title: Shakertown Inn Corn Pudding
instructions: Blend butter sugar flour and salt. Add eggs beating well. Stir in corn and milk. Pour ingredients into buttered casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir once when halfway through cooking period. When done pudding will be golden brown and a silver knife inserted will come out clean. Shakertown uses frozen corn however canned or fresh corn may be used.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Cook hamburger and drain. Add taco seasoning peppers mushrooms and onions and cook until mixed well (about 5 minutes. Cover bottom and sides of baking dish with tortillas. Layer meat mixture cheese and salsa. Top with tortillas and layer again. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven cheese is melted.

title: Banana Split
instructions: Mix together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies into crumbs in a food processor; set aside. Cream sugar cream cheese and butter; set aside. In a very large bowl mix pudding Cool Whip and milk. Add cream cheese mixture and blend it until it has a pudding consistency. Layer cookies and pudding into container. Begin and end with cookies. Chill 1 hour before serving. Put candied flowers on top and serve with a miniature shovel.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cook until thickening. Pour into cooked cool pie crust.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Baptist Meatballs
instructions: Combine milk bread onion egg and salt. Add hamburg. Form into patties (will be very moist). Brown in a skillet then put into a casserole. Pour soup over the meatballs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Bacon Bites
instructions: Mix shrimp garlic chili sauce and hot sauce. Cover and refrigerate for several hours. Cut bacon slices into halves. Cook bacon until limp; drain. Wrap each shrimp with a bacon piece; secure with a toothpick. Set oven to broil. Broil until bacon becomes crisp.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Lemon Custard Cake
instructions: Tear the angel food cake into bite size pieces. Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan. In a mixer bowl combine pudding mix milk and sour cream. Beat until thickened about 2 minutes. Spread over cake. Spoon pie filling on top. Chill until serving time. Yield 12 to 16 servings.

title: Grandmie'S Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In an 8 x 12-inch baking pan melt butter. In large bowl or in blender container combine 1 cup sugar flour milk and baking powder. Mix well. Pour mixture over butter in baking pan; do not stir. Arrange peaches on top.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Combine vegetable oil butter eggs and sugar. Add remaining ingredients except walnuts and dates. Mix well then add nuts and dates. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 layers.

title: Negative Calorie Soup
instructions: Chop cabbage into small pieces. Drain French-cut green beans. Bring water to a boil. Add bouillon cubes cabbage onions celery green beans and tomatoes. Cook (in large pot) until cabbage is tender. This soup is called \Negative Calorie\ because you will burn more calories making and eating this soup than are contained in the soup.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in cranberry sauce and undrained pineapple and finely chopped water chestnuts. Stir in with coarsely chopped walnuts. Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Holly Wreaths
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Add sugar beat in vanilla. Add flour. Blend. Chill. Use cookie press to make various cookies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: One-Step Yellow Cake
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Beat on high speed with a mixer for 4 minutes. Place in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch greased pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Put dry ingredients in bowl; add shortening water and applesauce. Beat. Add egg; beat well. Fold in raisins and nuts. Bake 35 minutes or longer at 350\u00b0. Makes large cake. Frost with boiled brown sugar frosting.

title: Rice And Beans
instructions: In covered pan bring beans to boil until skins start to crack. Drain. Add water to cover beans. Add garlic. Heat large knife on fire until hot. Bang and fold salt pork until it becomes a paste texture keeping knife hot. Add salt pork to beans. Add black and red pepper. Dash of salt is optional. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add rice to beans. Cook 25 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Place pretzels in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt oleo and 3 tablespoons sugar and pour over pretzels. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese rest of sugar and Cool Whip and spread over pretzels. Mix jello according to directions on box. Let partially jell. Add apples and pecans. Pour over casserole mixture and refrigerate to set.

title: Blueberry Muffins(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Spray muffin tins with Pam. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Swiss-Basil Broccoli
instructions: Melt margarine in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add breadcrumbs and basil; saute 2 minutes or until lightly toasted; set aside.

title: Chili-Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan; cook over medium heat until cheese melts stirring often. To serve transfer dip to a chafing dish. Serve warm with tortilla chips. Yield 5 3/4 cups.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and cool. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until set.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix melted margarine and pretzels in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Add Cool Whip and put over cooled pretzels. Heat pineapple juice to boiling and dissolve jello in juice. Add frozen strawberries and cool until starts to gel. Pour over pretzels.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon in skillet; remove and drain. Saute onion and green pepper in two tablespoons drippings. Add mushrooms hominy and remaining ingredients to skillet. Simmer for a few minutes until cheese is melted stirring often. Put mixture in baking dish and top with crumbled bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 20 minutes until bubbly.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in boiling water. Stir in orange juice and next 3 ingredients. Pour mixture into a large plastic container then freeze until firm.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill overnight. Serve with your favorite vegetables or chips.

title: Strawberry Jam Bread
instructions: In a large bowl cream the butter and sugar. Blend in vanilla and lemon extracts then eggs. Beat mixture thoroughly. In a separate bowl combine dry ingredients; set aside. In a third smaller bowl blend together the sour cream and jam. Stir dry ingredients into sugar-butter-egg mixture alternately with jam mixture. Stir until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour batter into a greased and floured bread pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Old Time Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix together; add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll out each time for 1 layer at a time. Cut out with a pie pan. Put in a greased pan and bake. Will make 5 layers of cake. Put cooked apples or apple butter between layers.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions rinse and drain. Mix together. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Walnut Caramels
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan combine sugar corn syrup butter and half of the cream. Heat to boiling\tover medium heat stirring constantly. Stir\tin remaining cream nuts and vanilla. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture reaches a temperature of 244\u00b0 on a candy thermometer (small amount dropped into very cold water will form a firm ball). As mixture becomes thick stir constantly. Immediately pour mixture evenly into a well-greased 8-inch square pan. Let stand until cool. Cut into 1-inch squares. Wrap individually in waxed paper or plastic film.

title: Pacific Northwest Barbecue For Salmon, Steelhead Or Trout
instructions: Salmon/steelhead fillet or steak cut out fins.

title: Tex-Mex Stew
instructions: In Dutch oven brown meat with garlic and chopped onion. Drain off grease. Drain and coarsely chop the tomatoes. Reserve juice. Add tomatoes juice picante sauce cumin salt and pepper to meat mixture. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Add corn and beans. Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with additional picante sauce. One dish dinner needs only a pan of cornbread or nacho chips.

title: Sausage And Tomatoes
instructions: Fry sausage until done. Pour off oil. Add pepper and water onion tomatoes and paste. Let simmer for 20 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook until done. If its too thick add water until desired consistency. Serve hot over rice.

title: Grandma Gongdon'S War Cake(Circa 1916)
instructions: Mix everything together except the flour and soda. Boil 5 minutes. Cool. When cool add the flour and soda sifted together. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 45 to 55 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Hobo Dinner
instructions: Layer ingredients in order given in a large pot. Simmer on low for 1 to 2 hours according to amount you have in pot. Do not overcook. Do not let potatoes go to mush. Meat will flavor the whole pot of vegetables. When potatoes are tender it is ready! Serve with cornbread. Very convenient and very good!

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
instructions: Sprinkle sugar water cinnamon and nutmeg over apples in loaf pan. Mix oleo flour and brown sugar together and top apples. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Grape Salad
instructions: Stir together mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Stir in broccoli and grapes.

title: Cornmeal Mush
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with 1/2 cup water to make a smooth paste. Add paste slowly to 1 1/2 cups boiling water stirring constantly until the mixture is thick and bubbly (approximately 10 minutes). Remove from heat and stir in eggs.

title: Saucy Dip
instructions: Heat wieners in hot water. Score through center. Add 1/2 slice of cheese. Dip tortilla in hot fat. Place wiener in tortilla and add sauce. Roll up and secure with toothpick. Deep-fry until crisp. Serve with refried beans.

title: Mock Pineapple Cheese Pie(Low-Fat)
instructions: Pour hot water in blender with gelatin. Blend. Add pineapple and blend for 3 minutes. Add sweetener and flavorings. Slowly add powdered milk. Blend well pour into 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon refrigerate.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Stir together. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 40 minutes or until firm to the touch.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Saute celery and onion until tender. Mix with other ingredients adding broth until desired consistency is reached. Bake uncovered 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Hancock'S Harbor Crab Cakes
instructions: Fold crabmeat into white sauce. Roll into round cake shapes. Dip into egg and milk mixture roll in \Shake and Blend\ flour. Roll in Italian flavored bread crumbs. Deep fry until brown.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert(Serves 4)
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels (small pieces) with melted margarine and 3 teaspoons sugar. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan press down and bake 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Mix well cream cheese and 1 cup sugar. Fold into medium Cool Whip and spread over cooled pretzel layer; chill until firm.

title: Chicken Vermicelli
instructions: Boil chicken and remove from broth and bone. Skim fat from broth. Add next 8 ingredients plus oregano. Cook until potatoes are tender. Add vermicelli noodles. Cook on low for 1 hour. Add water to broth as needed. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Marie'S Gingered Carrots
instructions: Peel and slice carrots. Place in saucepan with water and salt. Cook on medium heat until almost done. Add sugar butter and ginger. Simmer until most of the liquid is gone. Serve hot.

title: Panettone(Easter Or Christmas Fruit Bread)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add warm milk sugar and sifted flour. Cover and let rise for 1 hour. Cream butter with sugar; break in whole eggs and beat well. Add egg yolks and mix well. Add egg mixture to yeast sponge and rest of flour until dough is not sticky (loose from bowl). Knead good.

title: Turkey Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and rinse. Place in a 2 1/2-quart salad bowl. Add turkey celery onion and green pepper; toss to mix.

title: Caramel Date Drops
instructions: Cream butter sugar and egg together until fluffy. Mix in vanilla. In separate bowl stir together flour soda baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Stir in dates and nuts. Drop by a rounded teaspoonful onto greased baking sheets. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove immediately to wire racks and let cool. Spread with frosting. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Mulberry Pie
instructions: Lightly mix and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is light brown.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and add sugar and mix well. Stir in eggs then sift dry ingredients into mixture. Mix in chocolate chips and nuts. Cook in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in pan and cut when cooled.

title: Gnocchi, Fisherman-Style
instructions: In a food processor smoothly puree fish adding eggs one at a time. Pour in cream with motor running. (If using a blender smoothly puree fish and eggs; scrape container sides. Add cream with motor running.) If making ahead cover and chill up to 3 hours.

title: Creamy Swiss Egg Bake
instructions: In saucepan combine soup milk onions and mustard. Cook and stir until smooth and heated through. Remove from heat. Stir in cheese until melted. Pour 1 cup of sauce into each of two 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dishes. Break 6 eggs into sauce in each casserole. Carefully spoon remaining sauce around eggs. Stand bread slices around outside edge of casseroles. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes until eggs are set. Garnish with parsley.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Dice the cabbage and onions. Dice sausage. In skillet brown sausage. Add cabbage and onions to sausage. Season with soy sauce and a pinch of pepper. Cook all ingredients until cabbage is cooked.

title: Easy Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Stir in brown sugar. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Cool to lukewarm. Put in mixing bowl. Add sugar and vanilla. Beat until of spreading consistency. Put on cool cake.

title: Bursa Danasi(Baked Veal With Noodles)
instructions: Season veal with garlic pepper salt herbs and wine and marinate in the refrigerator for 5 hours. Turn steak after 2 hours. Drain. Pat dry with paper towels.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain according to directions on box. Mix with celery and bell pepper (diced) pickles tuna and Miracle Whip. Salt as needed. Better served chilled.

title: Pepperoni Cake
instructions: Mix yeast water and 1 cup flour; set aside. Beat eggs well; add flour mixing thoroughly. Add yeast mixture cheeses and pepperoni. Pour mixture in a greased (spray with Pam) Bundt pan. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for Swiss or Cheddar cheese and broccoli. Add well drained broccoli and mix well. Make into balls using ice-cream scoop (this can be frozen at this time). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove and add cheese (if you like you can also add cracker crumbs or onion rings at this time). Place back in oven and bake until cheese is melted. I usually make half of mine with Cheddar and half with Swiss cheese. You can also make this into a casserole instead of the balls. Makes 12.

title: Palm Sunday Brunch Quiche
instructions: Spray 9x13-inch glass baking dish with non-stick spray. Put bread in pan. In a bowl whisk eggs add mustard and stir then add milk and pepper and stir. Pour over the bread. Top with chopped ham onion green pepper and cheese. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or over night.

title: Sale Ham And Bean Soup
instructions: Cook ham hock until soft. Trim off all fat. Cook all vegetables separately. Mix together with cubed ham. Heat and serve. Good luck!

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Bring the cream cheese to room temperature. Add fruit juice to consistency desired. Add powdered sugar to thicken then whipped cream. Blend.

title: Paella
instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in 14-inch paella pan or heavy ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add chicken; brown lightly on all sides 10 to 15 minutes. Remove chicken with slotted spoon.

title: Charlene'S Spinach Dip
instructions: Heat cheese soup and cream cheese until soft; add bacon spinach and all other seasonings. Hollow out a loaf of round rye bread. Put spinach dip (hot) into loaf for serving. Cut the bread you hollowed out into pieces for dipping into dip.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta as directed; drain and let cool. In large bowl combine pasta and cut up vegetables. Pour dressing over pasta combination. Chill at least 1 hour before serving to marinate.

title: Noel Cherry Pie
instructions: Drain cherries; add juice and milk until thick. Fold in cream cherries and nuts. Pour in pie shell and chill!

title: Low-Fat Chicken And Rice Soup(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Combine broth and uncooked rice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes. Stir in onions and carrots and cook for 5 more minutes. Combine milk flour and pepper. Stir into rice mixture. Cook and stir until slightly thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minute more. Stir in sherry. Garnish with fresh parsley or chives before serving.

title: Potatoes Pooche
instructions: Cube raw potatoes. Place in saucepan. Add butter. Add remaining ingredients and pour over this just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil; lower heat and cook until potatoes are done. Above all dont disturb stir or mix. Let potatoes soak up flavor and juices which will thicken to nice consistency.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients except boiling water. Beat for 2 minutes then add boiling water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly. Cookies should be about 5-inches in diameter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes a huge amount.

title: Lemonade Or Limeade
instructions: Mix lemon or lime juice sugar water and ice cubes. Add peel. Chill.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Cream together oleo peanut butter and powdered sugar. Then mix in Rice Krispies cereal. Shape into balls. Put on cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm. Melt chocolate chips and wax together in a double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate and place on waxed paper to set. Refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Squash Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place whole squash in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil; simmer covered for 30 minutes or until skin is tender. Remove from water; cool. When cool enough to handle cut in two and scrape out inside discarding seeds and stringy center part. Butter casserole dish. Layer squash Mozzarella and sauce repeating layers. Top with Parmesan. Leftover squash may be served with butter and Parmesan at another meal. Freezes well. Serve both dishes hot.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Drain vegetables and mix. Bring last three ingredients to a boil. Pour over vegetables; refrigerate.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Heat soup and large cream cheese together then beat until smooth. Add gelatin (softened first in 3 tablespoons water). Add celery mayonnaise green onions and crab. Pour into mold. Chill.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats. Let stand 20 minutes. Beat butter until creamy. Gradually add sugar and beat until fluffy. Blend in vanilla and eggs. Stir in oats. Sift together flour soda salt and spices and add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch square pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Do not remove from pan.

title: Mom Pepp'S Date Drops
instructions: Sprinkle soda on dates; pour hot water over. Cream the butter and sugar together. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix flour and salt; add to egg mixture. Stir in date mixture; mix well. Drop from a spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Creamy Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Blend in relish chill until partially set. Beat together cream cheese and sour cream. Blend in cottage cheese and nuts. Fold cream cheese mixture into gelatin. Pour into a 4 cup mold. Chill until set. Unmold on bed of lettuce.

title: Baked Bananas
instructions: Place the unpeeled bananas in a shallow baking pan. Bake the bananas in a 325\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until a fork will pierce the bananas easily. To serve make 2 lengthwise slits 1/2 to 3/4-inch apart through the peel of each banana. Remove the peel between the slits. Sprinkle each banana with a little lemon or lime juice and a little brown sugar. Top each banana with a few finely chopped peanuts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw and mix broccoli with soup eggs mayonnaise cheese oil and salt. Top with crumbs and dot with butter. Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or double and bake 1 hour.

title: Simple Pesto Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor. Blend until well incorporated. Use by tossing into hot cooked pasta.

title: Strawberry Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients except red crystal sugar. Shape into strawberry shape and roll in red crystal sugar. Cut leaves from construction paper or silk green leaves. Dye toothpicks green and cut in half for stems.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Mince or chop peppers and onions. Cover with boiling water and let stand for 15 or 20 minutes; drain. Add the seed vinegar salt and sugar. Boil 20 or 25 minutes. Pack in jars.

title: Marinated Chicken
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Add chicken breasts. Coat well and refrigerate overnight. Remove chicken and roll in cracker crumbs. Arrange in shallow pan. Pour 1/4 of margarine over chicken and bake at 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Spoon rest of margarine over chicken and bake 45 minutes more.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Bring Carnation milk sugar margarine and salt to boil and boil 4 1/2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from stove and pour over the Marshmallow Creme nuts chocolate and chocolate chips. Stir with large spoon continuously until all chocolate is melted. Add vanilla. Pour into buttered pans and refrigerate until firm.

title: Mexicali Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook over low heat until cheese is melted and mixed well. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pear Honey
instructions: Peel pears and crush enough to make 8 cups. Combine crushed pears with the other ingredients. Simmer until thickened. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Chop beef in very small pieces. Brown meat with onion carrots peppers and celery. Scramble eggs very dry. Add this mixture together with cooked rice. Then add remaining ingredients.

title: Quick Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese jello and pineapple. Add Cool Whip. Sprinkle with ground nuts. Chill.

title: Springtime Lime Slushy
instructions: In freezer container dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in the cold water and sherbet until combined. Freeze for 4 hours or until set. Remove from freezer 45 minutes before serving. For each serving place 1 cup of slush mixture in a glass; add 1/3 cup ginger ale. Yields 8 servings.

title: Dill Dip For Vegetables
instructions: Mix together and keep refrigerated.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Simmer lentils and water covered 1 hour. Saute onion green pepper and garlic in margarine until tender. Add to cooked lentil stock remainder of ingredients. Simmer for 30 minutes. Serve with Italian bread.

title: French Cream Mint Brownies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; blend in eggs chocolate flour and baking powder. Put into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Chill.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Cook beef and onion and put in plate. Sprinkle cheese over meat. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth and pour over cheese. Cook 30 minutes; let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Hamburger Monterey
instructions: Dice bacon and fry until crisp. Set aside. Shape beef into tiny balls. Cook in bacon fat until brown. Remove. Slice onion and dice pepper. Cook until lightly brown. Add beans tomato soup chili powder macaroni salt and Accent. Simmer 10 minutes. Grate cheese. Add and stir until cheese melts. Add bacon and meat balls. Simmer 15 minutes. Serves 6. Delicious with corn bread.

title: Salmon Party Spread
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Blend in sour cream mayonnaise lemon juice onion and horseradish; chill until thickened. Fold in salmon and dill weed. Spoon into mold. Chill until firm at least 3 hours. Unmold. Serve as an appetizer surrounded with crackers or raw vegetables.

title: Cabbage Relish
instructions: Cut up vegetables and set aside. Bring remaining ingredients to boil and pour over cabbage while hot. Can keep in refrigerator for two weeks.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Sift together and set aside the flour soda salt and baking powder. Blend together shortening and sugars. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture and mix well. Stir in oats vanilla and chocolate. Dough is crumbly. Drop by teaspoonful on a greased cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 11 dozen.

title: Chicken Divan(Recipe Serves 5 To 6 People)
instructions: Simmer chicken until tender. Cook broccoli in salted water; drain. Arrange broccoli in greased casserole dish. Place halved chicken breast on top of broccoli. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice curry powder and pour over chicken. Sprinkle cheese and bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Prepare rice for six people and serve.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Using a 9 x 13-inch pan first layer the bean dip then browned hamburger then sour cream and cream cheese (creamed together with 1the taco seasoning) then spread 1 jar of salsa over top. Top with shredded lettuce diced tomatoes onions shredded cheese and olives.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Slice rolls. Put on cheese and ham. Put top on. Mix other ingredients and pour over rolls. Leave uncovered until margarine sets. Cover and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Can be frozen.

title: L. B. J. (Pres. Johnson'S) Favorite Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar syrup butter an salt and cook until dissolved. While this is cooking beat eggs until foamy. Add small amount of hot mixture gradually to eggs (stirring constantly with whisk). This will raise temperature of eggs to prevent separation when gradually added to the remaining hot mixture (stirring rapidly). Add pecans and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes or until the pie has set. Cool on rack.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil fryer celery onion and poultry seasoning until chicken is done. Remove chicken from bone and chop. Save broth. Toss stuffing mix with melted margarine and place a layer of stuffing mix in large Pyrex dish. Cover with a layer of chicken a can of mushroom soup and 1 1/2 cans of broth. Place another layer of chicken a can of cream of chicken soup and 1 1/2 cans of broth. Finish with layer of stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coleslaw, Sweet And Sour
instructions: Bring sugar and water to boil. Let cool and add vinegar. Pour over shredded cabbage. Season as desired. Refrigerate.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter. Add beaten egg and molasses then the dry ingredients. Add boiling water last. Beat until smooth. Bake in a greased shallow pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly. Very good when served warm with whipped cream.

title: Brownies
instructions: Combine ingredients. Beat flour mixture at medium speed. Spread in buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well. Will make 2 gallons. To make 1 cup Use 1/3 cup mix. Add boiling water to make 1 cup hot cocoa. Store in an airtight container. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Favorite Beef Stew
instructions: Brown meat in hot shortening in Dutch oven. Add water lemon juice Worcestershire sauce onion bay leaf and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Simmer covered tightly for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar gradually to eggs and continue to beat until mixture is very stiff. Add milk heavy cream vanilla and salt. Mix thoroughly. Pour into can and freeze as directed with ice cream maker.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello and hot water then add cranberries. Let cool but not gel. Add the pineapple orange celery and pecans. Refrigerate until firm. Serve. Keep refrigerated.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Bake potatoes until soft; peel. Beat in oleo sugar cinnamon nutmeg and vanilla; cool. Beat in egg and enough cream to make mixture smooth and thick.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken soups chilies and 1/2 bag Doritos. Put in casserole dish and top with cheese and remaining Doritos. Cook until bubbles at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine whole kernel corn creamed corn and beaten eggs. Add mixture of dry ingredients and minced onion. Stir in each 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup melted butter. Pour into greased 3-quart casserole. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 1 hour stirring once during baking.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine half and half water sugar rice oleo and salt in large saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer stirring frequently for 40 minutes or more. Add raisins. Remove from heat. Beat eggs with enough water to make 1 cup. Add to rice mixture beating in quickly with a spoon. Add vanilla. Return to stove and bring to a boil. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Cook the first 4 ingredients until a drop forms a ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add the peanut butter; stir until it is thick enough to spread. Pour in a platter; let it cool a while. Cut in squares.

title: Chesapeake Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon; mix well. Pour into large casserole. Lay bacon across the top of the beans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; add eggs one at a time. Beat in well. Sift flour salt and baking powder 3 times. Add flour and milk in small amounts starting and ending with flour. Add lemon and vanilla extracts. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 60 minutes in 10 1/2-inch angel food pan or 35 to 40 minutes in deep 9-inch layer pans. Ice as desired.

title: Cheesy-Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions omitting salt. Drain well. Saute onion and green pepper in butter in medium saucepan. Add broccoli and remaining ingredients to saucepan. Cook over medium heat until cheese melts stirring often. Serve immediately.

title: Burrito Casserole
instructions: Cook beef with onion and garlic; drain fat. Mix tomato sauce with browned hamburger and onions; set aside. Soften tortillas in microwave. Spread first tortilla with refried beans; sprinkle heavily with grated cheese. Put in the bottom of a round 1 1/2-quart casserole.

title: Sawdust Pie
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl mixing well. Stir in egg whites just until blended. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top each slice with whipped cream and banana slices. Serve warm.

title: Onion Pie
instructions: Slice onions; add salt and pepper and smother in butter until tender. Cover bottom of casserole with cracker crumbs. Cook bacon until crisp. When onions are very tender place on top of crackers along with butter they were cooked in. Crumble bacon on top of onions. Top with grated cheese. Beat eggs well; add sour cream and blend well. Pour over the cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until set about 35 minutes.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and pour in deep pie crust uncooked. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Combine mayonnaise sour cream lemon juice and sugar and pour over chicken mixture. Toss gently and chill thoroughly. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Country Carrot Frosting
instructions: Cream well the butter and cream cheese. Add sugar and vanilla. Beat well. Add pineapple.

title: Come On Over Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Crush crackers. Mix with nuts and baking powder. Beat egg whites and sugar with vanilla. Fold cracker mix into egg whites and bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool completely.

title: My Mom'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix as usual adding the hot water last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Use chocolate buttercream frosting for the icing.

title: Corinne'S Moist Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and place in loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hamburger Bake
instructions: Press hamburger in 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Add seasonings chopped green pepper and onion. Add undiluted soup on top. Top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Zucchini Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Stir in sugar zucchini oil and vanilla. Gradually add dry ingredients and spices. Stir in nuts.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. Cream butter or margarine and sugars. Beat in eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Blend in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8-10 minutes and let cool.

title: Meat Loaf - Barbecue Style
instructions: Mix together beef crumbs onion egg salt pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Form into loaf and place into shallow 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Combine rest of sauce and all other ingredients; mix well. Pour over loaf. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat sugars margarine peanut butter vanilla and egg in medium bowl with wooden spoon until creamy and well blended. Mix in flour oats soda and salt; stir. Stir in chocolate chips; drop rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Crusty Coconut Pie
instructions: Pour milk over coconut and set aside while creaming butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat mixture well. Add milk coconut and flavoring. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until pie is golden brown.

title: Ground Meat On Rye(Great Do Ahead)
instructions: Cook beef and sausage; drain well. Add cheese. Mix well. Spread on bread. Put on flat tray. Freeze. When frozen put into freezer bag. To serve Put under broiler until hot and bubbly.

title: Diamond Jubilee Dip
instructions: Blend milk mayonnaise and lemon juice until smooth. Add all other ingredients and stir. Serve with crackers or fresh veggies as a dip.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a large bowl. Refrigerate.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Cook hamburger and sausage in crock-pot. Drain off grease. Add 4 cups water lima beans onion (cut-up) and seasonings. Cover and cook all day on medium heat.

title: Basil Chicken And Rice
instructions: Remove skin and fat from chicken. Wash and place in a large skillet on high heat. Turn chicken on both sides until meat is cooked white on the outside. Add soy sauce basil garlic powder and Worcestershire. Make sure all pieces of chicken are coated in sauce. Turn heat to low and cover skillet. Cook until chicken is tender about 30 to 45 minutes. Serve juice as a gravy for rice.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Add sugar salt shortening and 1/2 cup water. Add yeast to other 1/2 cup of water. Add flour. When dough is stiff turn out on floured board and knead until smooth. Place in greased bowl and let rise. Punch down. Let rise again. Roll out and cut and let rise in pan. Ready to bake for 1 hour.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Clean mushrooms and chop finely. Add to cream cheese and chives. Place 1 teaspoon of mixture on ham slice add green onion and roll up. Serve chilled.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Combine cucumbers onions garlic and salt in large stockpot. Cover with cracked ice (about 2-inches). Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. Drain mixture well. Remove garlic. In same stockpot combine sugar vinegar mustard seed turmeric and celery seed. Heat to a rolling boil for 2 minutes. Add cucumber mixture. Return to boiling.

title: Ruby Wine Punch
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar water cinnamon sticks cloves and salt. Boil. Reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes. Strain spices. Add to liquid and chill. Yield 7 cups.

title: Baked Lasagna
instructions: In skillet brown beef and garlic. After browned drain oil and add everything except cheese and simmer for 30 minutes. Cook lasagna noodles. Mix cheeses together. Make two layers in baking dish noodles meat sauce and cheese mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Home Made Vegetable Soup
instructions: Leave vegetables in the water. Then mix the vegetables and spaghetti sauce. While this is cooking take a pan and brown meat. When vegetables are done mix in the meat and simmer. If more liquid is needed add blended tomatoes or add water. Add salt and pepper to taste. Nature seasoning is good instead of salt and pepper.

title: Cantaloupe Preserves
instructions: Peel cantaloupe and cut in thin slices 1-inch long. Mix sugar and cantaloupe and let stand overnight. Add lemon juice; cook until clear. Pour into Kerr half-pint jars to within 1/2-inch of top. Put on cap; screw band firmly tight. Process 5 minutes in boiling water bath. Yield 4 (8 ounce) jars.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Mix in sugar or honey bran and milk. Let set a few minutes. Add egg and shortening and beat well. Add dry ingredients and stir only to mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake For Diabetics(No Sugar)
instructions: Cook raisins in water until water disappears. Add applesauce eggs Sweeta and oil. Mix well. Combine dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into one large greased loaf pan and two smaller ones. (I use a tube pan.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Exchange for each 3 x 3-inch square 1 bread and 1 fruit.)

title: Ham And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix magarine mustard Worcestershire sauce poppy seed and onion together in skillet. Cook over low heat until onion is tender. Split rolls in half; brush margarine mixture over bottom and top half of rolls. Put ham on each slice of bottom layer; next spread cheese evenly and over ham layer. Put top of rolls back on ham and cheese. Place in same pan rolls came in. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Stuff
instructions: Cut meat in 1/4-inch slices. Put meat onion and garlic in a large frying pan and brown. Add vegetables and water. Simmer for 30 minutes. More water may be needed. Mix 2 tablespoons flour and 2 tablespoons water to make gravy. Add to meat and vegetables. Serve over rice or noodles. This is a great way to use leftover vegetables.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. This is best done using your hands to mix. Shape into a ball and roll in nuts or chopped olives if desired. Wrap in waxed paper and then in airtight container.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine and heat in microwave. Pour about 1/2 cup mixture in greased Bundt pan. Separate and arrange 2 cans Hungry Jack biscuits in pan. Pour remaining sauce over. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream first 4 ingredients together. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Roll and cut. Sprinkle with sugar then place on cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 12 minutes in preheated oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Sherry'S Sandies
instructions: Cream butter sugar water and vanilla and mix well. Blend in flour and nuts. Chill 4 hours. Shape in balls or fingers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix the cake according to directions. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan and pour 1/2 the batter into pan. Put this half of cake in oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. In a saucepan over low heat melt caramels with butter and milk. Remove cake from oven and pour the caramel mixture over the half-baked cake. Top with chocolate chips and pecans. Pour remaining cake mix over the top and return to oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for another 20 minutes.

title: Curried Rice Salad
instructions: Saute curry in butter stir in chicken broth and bring to boil. Add rice and green pepper cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat add onion and lemon juice; chill. Stir in mayonnaise milk peas and almonds.

title: 1 Dish Pork Chops
instructions: Mix brown sugar Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce together for sauce. Quickly brown pork chops on both sides in a deep skillet and put onion slice then the apple then the yam on top of each pork chop. Pour the sauce over. Put lid on and cook on low on top of the stove or 325\u00b0 in oven for 1 hour. You may add raisins if desired.

title: Dijon Chicken Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine the chicken celery green grape halves red grape halves apricots and onions. In a small bowl combine the mayonnaise honey mustard salt and pepper. Mix well. Stir into chicken mixture. Cover and refrigerate until serving. Serve on lettuce-lined plate. Sprinkle with almonds.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Cook meat onion tomato sauce chili powder salt and pepper. Put beans in casserole dish; cover with tortillas then half of cheese. Pour meat mixture over this; cover with rest of cheese. Cover with foil. Bake for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: Delmonico Potatoes
instructions: In greased 12-inch baking dish arrange potatoes. Pour cream over all and sprinkle with salt pepper and cheese. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Creamsicles
instructions: Whip dry milk powder with 2/3 cup ice water to soft peaks. Stir in juice concentrate and 1 cup of water. Pour into 6 popsicle molds and freeze firm.

title: Creamy Roquefort Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients. Serve on tossed salad greens. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Poor Man'S Butter
instructions: Blend well and put into refrigerator. Do not eat until chilled.

title: Lemon-Glazed Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and sugar. Blend in eggs and oil. Beat 6 minutes at medium speed. Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 50 minutes. Remove from pan onto cake rack; place rack on waxed paper. Top with Lemon Glaze.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti\taccording to package directions; then place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Place deboned chicken all across spaghetti.\tSaute onions and bell pepper with margarine until onions are\tclear.\tThen add pimentos mushrooms black olives and water chestnuts. Add soup and milk. Mix thoroughly. Pour on top of spaghetti and chicken. Place thin slices of Velveeta cheese all\tover top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbling.

title: Moon Cake
instructions: Boil water and butter.\tRemove from heat and add 1 c. flour. Add eggs one at a time. Spread on large cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool.\tMake vanilla pudding. Mix in cream cheese and spread on top of cake. Top with Cool Whip. Drizzle chocolate syrup over top.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Boil broccoli and onion for 3 minutes. Beat eggs; melt margarine in microwave and mix all ingredients together. Butter or spray two 13 x 9-inch pans. Pour into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Recipe may be halved.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Mix together and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Italian Chicken Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in 6 cups water with bouillon. Drain and set aside. In skillet pour 1 tablespoon olive oil and heat. Saute chopped garlic zucchini basil oregano salt and pepper for 1 to 2 minutes. Add chicken and cook until chicken is done and zucchini is tender tossing lightly. Add tomatoes; reduce heat. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve over pasta. Garnish with freshly grated Parmesan. Serves 2.

title: Cheese And Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan. Add onion and garlic; saute until tender. Sprinkle flour over and cook stirring constantly to make thickening. Gradually add broth and water stirring constantly. Bring to boil stirring frequently. Add broccoli thyme and pepper. Cover and simmer until broccoli is tender. Stir together cream and egg yolk. Stir a little soup into cream mixture until warm. Add to saucepan stirring constantly. Add cheese; stir until smooth and blended. Do not let boil. Serves 6.

title: Baked Pineapple Dish
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs pineapple and bread. Put in buttered baking dish and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peach Smash
instructions: In blender combine 2 ripe peaches (unpeeled) and cut in chunks (canned peaches will work) with can of frozen lemonade concentrate and rum. Fill blender with crushed ice and blend.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole(Serves 12 To 15)
instructions: Mix chicken rice celery cream of chicken soup onion and lemon juice. Add mayonnaise which has been mixed with water. Add hard-boiled eggs. Fold all together gently and place in 9 x 13 greased pan. Make the day ahead. Take out 1 hour before baking. Top with crushed barbecue or regular crushed potato chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Dont overcook.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix and store in refrigerator. Let stand at least 2 days before using. Keeps up to 6 weeks. Bake in greased muffin pans at 400 for 15 minutes. Yields 6 dozen. These can be baked immediately after mixing if you desire.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Cook spinach and reserve liquid (strain spinach). Mix spinach Ricotta Mozzarella and eggs together. Place 1 layer of uncooked noodles into a 9 x 13 pan. (I always spray with cooking spray first and put a bit of sauce on pan bottom.) Spread with a layer of cheese mixture. Sprinkle top with garlic oregano and Parmesan. Repeat process and end with top layer of noodles. Pour jar of sauce on top. Use spinach juice and added water to make 1 cup of liquid. Pour liquid along the perimeter of noodles. Cover tightly with foil. Cook 45 minutes to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Tang Salad
instructions: Make dressing for salad using reserved pineapple juice; dissolve Tang in juice. Add instant pudding to juice. Stir until smooth. Mix fruits in bowl; add dressing and stir well. Refrigerate.

title: Salsa Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Chill. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and salad dressing mixing until well blended. Stir in egg and parsley. Serve with crisp vegetables or cubes of dark bread.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Prepare tomatoes for canning then cut in chunks. Chop onions and peppers. Mix all ingredients in a large boiler and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or until thick. Pour into sterilized jars; seal.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Grind up all vegetables. Add 2 tablespoons salt. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain. Mix together mustard flour sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil. Boil hard 20 minutes with ground vegetables. Let stand overnight. In the morning add Miracle Whip and can cold. Seal with paraffin. You must use Miracle Whip. If it doesnt seal store in refrigerator. Yield 12 (8 ounce) jars.

title: 5 Minute Creamy Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat sugar and milk into cream cheese until smooth or put in blender. Fold in coconut then Cool Whip. Put in crust; freeze until firm. Warm at room temperature 15 minutes before serving.

title: Pastel Shower Jello(Great For Bridal Or Baby Showers)
instructions: Prepare 1 package jello using ice cream in place of cold water. Pour into 8 x 12-inch glass pan. When 1st jello is set spread with 1/3 pint sour cream. Prepare next package jello and spoon over sour cream gently. Repeat until all 4 jellos are used. When set frost with 1 carton Cool Whip.

title: Osso Bucco
instructions: In 8-quart Dutch oven over medium heat pour in olive oil. Cook veal a few pieces at a time until well browned on all sides. In drippings over medium heat cook onion celery carrots and garlic until browned and tender. Return veal to Dutch oven. Add tomatoes and next 5 ingredients over high heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours until veal is pork tender stirring occasionally. When veal is done skim off fat. Stir in parsley and lemon peel. Serve with rice and green beans.

title: Chow-Chow
instructions: Mix first four vegetables. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons salt over and let stand 2 to 3 hours. Mix well again. Squeeze out vegetables (by hand).

title: Barbecue Turkey Loaf
instructions: Can substitute ground beef.

title: Squash Souffle
instructions: Cook squash and onion together until tender; drain off water and mash squash and onion until fine. Add salt pepper cheese butter egg yolks and finely crumbled crackers. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into mixture. Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350\u00b0 until brown. Serve hot.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Combine with all other ingredients. Turn into buttered 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Garnish with parsley. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Twice Baked Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes in microwave or oven until soft. Carefully split potatoes lengthwise. Scoop out contents leaving about 1/8-inch of potatoes in skins all around.

title: Burnt Sugar Pie
instructions: Mix together the 3/4 cup sugar cornstarch salt Burnt Sugar Syrup* egg yolks milk butter and vanilla. Stir over heat and cook until thickened. Pour into a baked 9-inch pie shell. Top with meringue and bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread on bread.

title: Chocolate Caramels
instructions: Combine cocoa sugar milk and corn syrup in saucepan. Cook slowly stirring occasionally until when a small quantity dropped into cold water forms a hard ball. Remove from heat; add vanilla margarine and salt. Drop by teaspoonful onto a greased baking sheet. Cool and enjoy.

title: Parsleyed Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice. Place in a covered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Microwave on High until just tender (approximately 10 minutes depending on size of potatoes). Add butter to hot potatoes; sprinkle with flour and lightly stir potatoes to coat. Add cream salt and pepper and stir lightly. Add additional seasonings as desired. Microwave on High for 3 minutes more. Wash parsley and dry with paper towel. Chop parsley with food processor and sprinkle over potatoes to garnish.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Boil the first four ingredients for a few minutes. Pour over the tea and let stand 5 minutes. Strain and add the juice of the oranges and lemons. Add enough water to make one gallon.

title: Donnybrook Oatmeal Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Combine butter Sweet*10 vanilla and egg in large mixer bowl; beat for 2 minutes or until well blended at high speed of electric mixer scraping bowl occasionally. Add water flour soda salt and cinnamon. Beat at low speed for about 2 minutes or until well combined. Stir in oatmeal and raisins. Dough will be soft. Drop from teaspoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Store in refrigerator. Yields 36 cookies.

title: Fruit Loaf
instructions: Chop cherries pineapple nuts and candy. Mix all of the ingredients together in a large bowl. Mix well. Line loaf pan with foil and butter it real good. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 275\u00b0. Best if put in freezer for a month or longer.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix margarine and 1 egg. Pat this in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix for 5 minutes the cream cheese confectioners sugar and 2 eggs. Pour on top of other mixture. Bake for 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Mix together soups. Pour liquid into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle dry rice into liquid. Lay chicken on top. Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. (Dont peek.)

title: Peanut Butter-Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt into a bowl. Cut in peanut butter until crumbly. Add oats egg and milk; stir just until moistened. Pour into a greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until loaf appears golden brown. Cool on a wire rack. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Oil a Pyrex 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Spread rice evenly over the bottom. Place chicken pieces on top of the rice. Sprinkle paprika over chicken (liberally). Pour remaining ingredients over chicken after mixing in a bowl. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Molded Chicken Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot chicken broth. Stir well. Add another cup chicken broth grated onion salt and lemon juice. Mix well using a wire whip. Beat in mayonnaise chicken celery green pepper and pimiento. Pour into mold; sprinkle with paprika and chill.

title: Hot Shrimp Salad Or Scallop Appetizer
instructions: Clean lettuce dry and arrange on salad plates. Heat saute pan add olive oil and melt butter. Saute shallots first then add garlic and saute until wilted. Saute shrimp or scallops until done. Serve on bed of lettuce and dress with pinch of salt and ground black pepper. For more intense flavor brown 1/2 pound lean bacon reserve bacon and substitute bacon drippings for butter.

title: Sausage Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Cook raisins in water for 5 minutes. Strain; add soda into the hot juice. When cold add sugar cinnamon salt and sausage. Beat well; add raisins dredged in 1 cup flour and nuts. Sift 2 1/2 cups flour with baking powder. Must be real stiff no liquid at all. Must not drop from spoon.

title: Onion Buns
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or early in the day Prepare dough for hot roll mix as label directs but add instant minced onion with flour; let rise. Meanwhile in a small saucepan heat hot butter or margarine; cook chopped onion until tender. Stir in milk egg yolk and salt. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook beef pepper and onions together. Then add all other ingredients. Cook on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Yogurt Nut Loaf
instructions: Stir dry ingredients in one bowl. Stir wet ingredients in a second bowl. Then stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients just until moistened. Stir in raisins dates and nuts.

title: Shrimp Appetizer
instructions: Combine ingredients; season with salt and form into ball.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken (keep 3/4 cup of chicken water) lightly brown 1 pie crust. In 2 quart baking dish tear chicken into strips mix chicken water soup and veg. all. Pour into browned crust. Place 2nd crust over mixture slit top crust 4 or 5 times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: English Muffin Loaves
instructions: Combine 3 cups of flour yeast sugar salt and soda. Heat liquids until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to dry ingredients. Beat well. Stir in rest of flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch) pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal. Cover and let rise in warm place for 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from pans immediately and cool.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes(Serves 8)
instructions: In a large plastic bag add all ingredients. Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking dish. Bake stirring occasionally at 450\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until potatoes are brown and tender.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer about one hour. Makes approximately 2 quarts.

title: Greek Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.\tLayer (snuggly) with breaded chicken strips. Sprinkle\twith rice celery onion and green pepper. Sprinkle liberally with lemon pepper and Greek seasoning.\tMix soup and\twater and pour over all other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add grated cheese and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Easy Low-Fat Chocolate Cheesecake
