instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat an 8-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. In blender puree yogurt cream cheese Ricotta cheese syrup cocoa egg whites cinnamon and coffee liqueur. Pour into pan. Bake for 50 minutes or until set. Let cool.

title: Southern Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a large bowl combine cornmeal mix and sugar. Add vegetable oil to a 10 or 11-inch cast-iron skillet. Place in oven to heat for 10 minutes. Meanwhile in medium bowl combine egg buttermilk and 1/4 cup melted butter. Add all at once to cornmeal mixture. Stir until just moistened (batter should be lumpy). Remove skillet from oven and swirl oil to coat bottom and side. Pour batter into hot skillet. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown and a wooden toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Brush remaining 1/4 cup melted butter over top. Serve warm.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix together the cream cheese mayonnaise and garlic. Spread on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour picante sauce over mixture. Sprinkle chopped tomatoes on mixture along with olives and a few green onions. Top with cheeses. Refrigerate. Serve with corn chips.

title: Scalloped Green Beans
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole in microwave. Stir in flour. Add milk and stir. Add salt and pepper green beans water chestnuts mushrooms minced onion and cheese. Stir well. Bake at 325\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Stir occasionally. Ready to serve when hot and bubbly.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and onions until still crisp. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Make cream sauce with 2 tablespoons melted butter. Stir in flour then add milk. Stir over medium-high heat until starts to boil then add cream cheese and stir until melted. Add Cheddar cheese and stir until melted. Pour over broccoli and onions; stir. Place American cheese over the top. Cover with foil. Cook for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove foil and add bread crumbs over casserole. Bake another 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Heat cream of mushroom soup over medium heat. Add green chilies. Dip tortilla in hot oil for a few seconds then into soup mixture. Place the coated tortillas in the bottom of casserole dish. Layer the tortillas with chopped onion and grated cheese. Repeat until all tortillas are used. Top with remaining soup and chili sauce onion and cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with picante or other hot sauce.

title: Gus' Double Dip Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken up your way. Salt and pepper all pieces. Mix together eggs mustard and milk. Dust chicken in salt pepper and flour mixture then put into egg mixture then roll in flour mixture. In a heavy iron skillet pour about 1 to 1 1/2 inches of oil. Heat to 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Fry a few pieces at a time until golden brown about 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Cool Whip Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix together margarine flour and nuts. Pat on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool!! Mix together softened cream cheese sugar and 2/3 of Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Mix milk and pudding; spread over cheese mixture. Put rest of Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate!

title: Cheese And Chicken Ball
instructions: Drain chicken well; add salt and pepper. Place in a mixing bowl. Add cream cheese and chopped green onions. Mix well; shape into a ball on serving dish. Sprinkle with parsley for garnishment. Refrigerate until firm about 1 hour. Serve with Wheat Thins.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let cake cook before icing. Use a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. I use glass.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place in refrigerator one hour or longer to bring out flavor.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Prepare your favorite single crust pie shell baking for 5 minutes in a 450\u00b0 oven. Remove double thickness foil bottom lining and bake for 5 minutes more. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat egg yolks slightly with fork. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Gradually stir in milk. In a small bowl beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold whites into yolk mixture. Pour into partially baked pastry. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Quick-N-Easy Pineapple Inside-Out Cake(Microwave)
instructions: Mix all three items together thoroughly in a bowl. Spread evenly in a Bundt pan made to be used in the microwave. Wait 5 minutes then place in microwave for 13 minutes on high to cook.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Fry ground chuck; drain. Mix all together. Cook about 2 hours.

title: German Roast
instructions: Slowly brown the roast on all sides. When roast is browned to suit remove roast from pan and leave enough fat to make a gravy. Add ingredients also the browned roast and cook slowly until roast is tender.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugars milk and margarine to soft ball stage. Take off heat. Add peanut butter and marshmallow cream; dont stir until this dissolves some. Add vanilla. Stir until smooth. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish.

title: Easy Rice Meal
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crock-pot stir and cook. When done serve over rice fixed on package directions.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Melt butter and mix well. Beat eggs and add eggs milk coconut and vanilla to flour mixture. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown.

title: Rosettes
instructions: Dip rosette iron in hot grease then in batter. They slip right off.

title: Aunt Jack'S Cake
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Pat into ungreased sheet cake pan. Next combine the powdered sugar 2 eggs 2 caps vanilla and the cream cheese. Mix together and pour over other mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Cook apples in cider until tender. Press through a sieve or food mill. Measure 3 quarts of apple pulp. Cook pulp until thick enough to round up in a spoon as pulp thickens. Stir frequently to prevent sticking. Add sugar and spices. Cook slowly stirring frequently until thick. Pour hot into hot jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process pint and quart jars 10 minutes in boiling water bath.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Top salad with one sliced egg. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Karen'S Dill Dip(Servings:  4)
instructions: Mix and refrigerate for 1 hour. Put inside round 2 pound rye bread or use for vegetable dip.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Spray large microwave-safe bowl with Pam. Spray pizza pan with Pam. Mix sugar and Karo syrup in large bowl. Heat in microwave for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir halfway through time and when time is up mix peanuts in with sugar and syrup. Heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir halfway through time and when time is up stir in vanilla and butter. Heat for 1 minute. Stir in soda well. (This will cause it to \foam up.\) Pour into greased pizza pan. Do not try and spread with spoon; tilt pan to spread. Let cool for 30 minutes. Break into pieces. For an extra treat after breaking into pieces dip in chocolate.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook meat until brown. Add tomatoes sauce spaghetti mix and V-8 juice. Bring to a boil; turn stove down and simmer 10 minutes. Grease pan 17 x 9 x 4-inch. Cover with uncooked noodles and add a layer of meat sauce. Dot with cottage cheese. Use half the Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers. Pour all remaining sauce on top. Sprinkle with Romano or Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil and seal edges. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Lemonade
instructions: Boil sugar and water to form syrup. Cool. Add juice of lemons and oranges. Pour mixture over mint leaves and let stand one hour. Strain into large pitcher. Refrigerate overnight. Serve over crushed ice. Garnish with cherry or fresh mint leaves. Makes one quart.

title: Simply Delicious
instructions: Unwrap Twinkies and lay at the bottom of a baking dish. Mix both puddings in separate bowls. Pour one over the top of the Twinkies then the other. Chop Skor candy bars in small pieces. Sprinkle over top of pudding. Spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Refrigerator Slaw
instructions: Alternate layers of cabbage onion and sugar. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour boiling liquid over cabbage mixture and stir to mix. Refrigerate. Should keep up to 4 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Dixie Okra Gumbo
instructions: Heat oil and stir in flour; lightly brown onion garlic green pepper and celery. When onion is clean add okra tomatoes salt and pepper. Stir and add 2 cups boiling water. Cook for 45 minutes and serve over rice.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Cool before serving.

title: Garden Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan until bottom is covered. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown. Mix cream cheese ranch dip mix and sour cream together until creamy. Spread over baked crust (rolls). Top with vegetables and cheese.

title: Party Loaf
instructions: Slightly oil frozen loaves before thawing. Let rise. Spread dough to edges of an oiled cookie sheet. Layer with salami peppers mushrooms and then cheese. Fold to center. Fold under edges. Turn over so seam is on bottom. Repeat with other loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly browned.

title: Maple Syrup
instructions: Boil 1 cup of distilled water. Into water place honey and salt. Mix arrowroot powder or flour 1/2 cup water and maple flavoring in small bowl. Pour into honey mixture and stir as mixture continues to boil. Boil about 2 minutes longer. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes and slice. Cook in salted water until slightly tender. Drain and arrange in buttered casserole. Slice butter over potatoes. Add milk to about 3/4-inch the depth of potatoes. Sprinkle with pepper. Cover with thick layer of cheese. If desired add onion. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Daddy'S Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix in a bowl the soup and sherry. Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour mixture over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and almonds. Serve with rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lower-Calorie Eggnog
instructions: In large saucepan beat together eggs sugar and salt if desired. Stir in 1 1/2 cups milk and powdered milk. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture is just thick enough to coat a metal spoon and reaches 160\u00b0. Remove from heat and stir in the rest of the milk and vanilla. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled. Before serving garnish with dash of nutmeg or cinnamon and a cinnamon stick for stirring.

title: Deluxe Fajita Nachos
instructions: In medium skillet combine chicken spices and seasonings for fajitas and water; blend well. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes. In large shallow ovenproof platter arrange chips. Top with chicken and cheese. Place under broiler to melt cheese. Top with tomato olives green onions and desired amount of salsa. Serve with guacamole and sour cream. For a spicier version add sliced jalapenos.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Add flour soda salt and buttermilk; mix until smooth. Meanwhile soak 100% Bran in hot water until soft. Add to batter; blend. Add Bran Flakes and raisins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken And Grape Salad
instructions: Combine the dressing and ginger. Set aside. Mix the other ingredients; add the dressing and mix well. Spoon this over cantaloupe wedges.

title: Pizza Fondue
instructions: Brown meat in frying pan. Add sauce and seasoning. Stir in cheese. Pour into fondue dish to keep warm. Cut up French bread in cubes. Dip in.

title: Mandarin Orange Bavarian
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water. Drain fruits reserving 3/4 cup of the combined syrups. Add the measured syrup and orange rind to gelatin. Chill until slightly thickened (approximately 1 to 2 hours). Stir whipped topping into gelatin mixture until blended. Fold in fruits. Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Debone. Place back in broth. Stir-fry onion in oil. Put in broth. Add salt pepper and cream of chicken soup. Cook until smooth. Add 1/2 stick butter and rice. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes. Stir twice while you wait. Serve with French bread.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except egg whites until thoroughly combined. Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. Grease a 1 1/2-quart baking dish with butter and add mixture. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Missouri Chili
instructions: Soak beans 2 to 3 hours. Boil beans for 4 to 6 hours adding water as needed. While boiling add garlic and salt to taste. Fry hamburger; add to beans when brown. Add chili powder and beef powder; simmer 45 minutes. Grate cheese and serve with chili. Drink plenty of water.

title: Unreal Mayonnaise
instructions: Blend with 1 cup hot water then add 1 cup cold water and blend well. Slowly add oil while blender is running. Add Clearjel 1 tablespoon at a time and blend well. Add citric acid and let it sit overnight before using.

title: Turnip Slaw
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Using processor fitted with grating disk grate turnips. Transfer to bowl with dressing. Grate carrots and onion. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and chill 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pretzel Pie
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream the cream cheese and sugar together and spread on cooled crust. Mix jello and boiling water together. Add strawberries. Let stand for 10 minutes. Pour over cream cheese mixture and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. When you are ready to serve cover top generously with Cool Whip.

title: Delicious Hot Caramel Dip
instructions: Stir first 4 ingredients together in a saucepan (double boiler works best) and bring to a boil. Then add sweetened condensed milk. Continue to stir and cook being careful not to allow mixture to stick to bottom of pan or scorch. Use candy thermometer and bring to 230\u00b0 (just before soft ball stage). Remove from heat and add vanilla. If very thick mixture can be thinned with a little milk or water. Serve warm. Makes about 3 cups of dip or sauce. Very good with sliced apples or over vanilla ice cream.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Bars
instructions: Combine cake mix peanut butter 1/2 cup melted butter and eggs. Stir until well blended. Press 2/3 of mixture onto bottom of ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Reserve remaining mixture for topping.

title: Fruit Bowl
instructions: Mix box of pudding 1 tablespoon of Tang and juice from drained pineapple. Add fruit and refrigerate.

title: Sunny Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir together the mayonnaise onion raisins sugar and vinegar. Add broccoli and stir to coat. Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours. Stir in sunflower kernels and bacon just before serving. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Place strawberries in medium bowl. Sprinkle lightly with sugar. Thaw. Slice. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Combine flour sugar cinnamon salt and soda in large bowl and mix well. Blend oil and eggs into strawberries. Add to flour mixture. Stir in pecans blending until dry ingredients are just moist. Divide batter between pans. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Let cool 10 minutes. Turn loaves out to cool completely.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread bean dip on a platter. Mix mayonnaise sour cream and taco seasoning; spread over bean dip. Chop avocados; spread over mixture. Chop green onions and spread over avocados. Chop tomatoes and layer over onions. Chop black olives; spread over tomatoes. Sprinkle top with Cheddar cheese. Refrigerate. Serve with taco chips.

title: Chicken Broccoli Triangles
instructions: Note Be sure phyllo dough has been thawed and is at room temperature.

title: Jeannette'S Pie Crust
instructions: Beat the egg with a fork. Add vinegar and fill the cup with cold water. Mix flour salt and Crisco; add liquid. You can add 1 tablespoon sugar except for pork pies.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Steam or microwave spinach. Stir into butter; set aside. In large bowl combine cheeses flour and seasonings mixing well. Add beaten eggs and stir until mixed. Stir in spinach. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain well. Add spaghetti sauce water and salt; bring to a boil. Layer in casserole dish the sauce uncooked lasagna noodles cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese; repeat layers. End with sauce. Top with Parmesan cheese. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rocky Roads
instructions: Combine chocolate bits and peanut butter. Heat in microwave for 3 or 4 minutes until soft and melted. Add raisins which have been dipped in boiling water to soften. (Omit this step if raisins are fresh.) Stir in marshmallows. Turn into an 8 x 8-inch buttered pan. Cut into pieces when cold. Store in an airtight container in freezer until ready to use.

title: First Down Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine cheeses. Mix at medium speed with mixer until well blended. Add deviled ham and onion; mix well. Chill. Mold in shape of a football. Decorate with chopped nuts. Use pimento for football laces. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown beef with onions garlic and butter. Drain. Add mushroom soup tomato sauce tomato paste salt and green chilies. Simmer about 30 minutes. Pour over crushed corn chips. Top with large package Cheddar cheese (melt cheese and serve).

title: Leftover Meat And Potatoes
instructions: Brown beef and onion in butter. Mix in other ingredients. Place in casserole and bake 30 to 40 minutes. Use your imagination and add leftover vegetables too.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Add strawberries pineapple and marshmallows. Let stand overnight. Add whipping cream. Place whole strawberries on top.

title: Bluebarb Pie(Or Variation Of Peach, Apple, Strawberry.)
instructions: Roll out the bottom crust and fit into a 10-inch pie pan. Mix together the fruit sugar and flour. Pour this mixture into the crust and dot with butter. Roll out the top crust and place it over the fruit. Crimp edges. Cut a few steam vents with a knife or fork. Brush the crust with beaten egg and bake pie for 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn oven down to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 20 minutes or more. Remove pie from oven and allow to cool.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs margarine and milk in a large bowl until well blended. Add flour and sugar to liquid ingredients and mix just enough to make a creamy batter.

title: Cabbage Wedges With Tangy Hot Dressing
instructions: Cook bacon in large skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon with slotted spoon to paper towel; set aside. Meanwhile dissolve cornstarch in apple juice in a small bowl. Stir in vinegar brown sugar and caraway seeds; set aside. Add onion to hot drippings. Cook and stir until onion is soft but not brown. Place cabbage wedges on flat side in drippings mixture. Pour cornstarch mixture over cabbage wedges. Cook over medium heat 4 minutes. Carefully turn cabbage wedges over with spatula.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add Crisco buttermilk and bananas. Beat hard for two minutes. Add buttermilk and eggs. Beat two more minutes. Fold in chopped nuts. Pour into greased and floured pans.\tBake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 30 to 35 minutes. Frost with White Mountain Icing.

title: Old Fashion Sugar Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl with mixer at medium speed cream butter and both sugars. Beat in eggs one at a time until light and fluffy. Add shortening vanilla and lemon peel. Beat until well mixed.

title: Chocolate Chip Squares
instructions: Beat oil eggs sugars and vanilla until fluffy. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Stir in chips and nuts. Spread in ungreased sheet cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 minutes. Cool and cut.

title: Meat Loaf Italiano
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except 1/4 cup sauce. Shape loaf in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining sauce. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin-N-Spice Tea Bread
instructions: Blend sugar and oil well with electric mixer. *Beat in eggs one at a time and continue beating until light. Add pumpkin; blend. Sift flour baking soda baking powder cinnamon nutmeg cloves and salt into creamed mixture. Beat at low speed until blended. Pour batter into 4 greased 6 x 3 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pans or 2 greased 9 x 5 x 2 3/4-inch loaf pans. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1 hour or until lightly browned. When done leave in pans for 10 minutes on wire rack. Remove from pans and cool completely on wire rack. Sprinkle confectioners sugar.

title: British Tea Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add egg and vanilla and mix well. Sift flour and baking powder together; add to sugar mixture. Using 2 teaspoons make cookie into nut size balls. Roll each in a dish of oatmeal so it can be handled. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass dipped in oatmeal. Replenish oatmeal as needed. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Nut Cake
instructions: Mix eggs and butter and add all other ingredients except flour. Mix together good then add flour a little at a time. Grease and flour 2 pans and pour batter into them. Bake for 30 minutes or until done in a 400\u00b0 preheated oven.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients; bring to a boil for a few minutes.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: In saucepan melt cream cheese tomato soup gelatine and lemon juice until very smooth. Stir in drained shrimp (which should be crushed) onion and mayonnaise. Pour into mold and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine sugar coconut and flour in saucepan. Add milk eggs and margarine. Cook to thick. Add vanilla.

title: Zucchini Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil zucchini for 5 minutes along with the onion. Drain water off and remove onion. Mix soup and sour cream together. Add to zucchini. Mix stuffing in a bowl with melted margarine. Put half of the stuffing mixture into a rectangular 13 x 9 baking dish. Press into pan. Pour zucchini mixture on top. Sprinkle with remainder of stuffing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mama'S Green Beans
instructions: Drain cans of beans. Refill one can with water. Make a light roux with oil and flour. Saute onions in roux. Add the green beans plus one can of water to the onions. Season to taste. Cover and simmer 1/2 hour. If using fresh beans add water and cook the same. Also you can cook 2 slices of bacon and make a roux with bacon grease. Break up bacon and add to beans.

title: Sliders
instructions: Mix corned beef sour cream and onion soup mix. Spread mix on bottom of roll. Top with slice of pickle. Put top on roll. Put rolls on cookie sheet and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 40 appetizers that taste just like White Castle burgers.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Mix all the other ingredients and cook at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour into pan.

title: Lime Iceberg Pickles
instructions: Soak cucumbers in water for 24 hours. Rinse well. Soak another 3 hours in ice water and drain. Mix remaining ingredients; add cucumbers and soak overnight. Bring to a boil; simmer 35 minutes. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix with wire whisk. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Separate rolls into 8 triangles. Quarter each apple and peel. Wrap a quarter of the apple with a roll triangle. Put seam on the bottom. Place in 8 or 9-inch square Pyrex dish. Bring to a boil the orange juice butter and sugar. Pour on top of rolled apples. It will be a lot of liquid but will absorb when cooking. Sprinkle with a dash of cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Sprinkle pudding over pineapple and stir until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Chop zucchini onion pepper and celery. Mix with corn. Add dressing and mix together. Chill if desired. Serves 8.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water and fruit juice. Add sherbet. Stir until melted. Add fruit and chill. Add sour cream and small marshmallows to fruit mixture. Spread over gelatin. Serves 12.

title: White Chili
instructions: Saute the first three ingredients in olive oil. Place in 3 1/2 qt. or larger crockpot and add chicken broth. Add remaining ingredients save the cheese. Stir cover and cook for 3 hours on high or 7-8 hours on low. Prior to serving stir in cheese.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Boil cabbage in salt water until tender. Drain. Add oleo cheese and soup. Mix while hot. Put in baking dish and top with crumbled baked corn bread. Dot with oleo. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Helen Mcnair'S Punch
instructions: Note Use Jell-O and Kool-Aid flavor to obtain desired color.

title: Hot Sonoma Cheese Dip
instructions: 1st Layer 2 cans jalapeno bean dip.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Roll each piece of biscuit in white sugar and cinnamon mixture. Arrange in Bundt pan sprayed with Pam. Heat brown sugar cinnamon oleo and water until melted. Pour over biscuits and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. You can put nuts in or fruit if desired. When cool invert Bundt pan and serve.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Place sherbet in punch bowl. Pour champagne and Sauterne over top. Stir. Add ginger ale if desired. Serves 18 punch cups.

title: Corned Beef Spread
instructions: Mix corned beef and cream cheese together. Add garlic salt and seasoned salt to your own taste.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Season tomatoes with salt pepper and sugar. Alternately arrange layers of tomatoes cheese and bread crumbs in a baking dish. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Penne Pasta
instructions: Melt butter. Add tomatoes salt pepper and red pepper. Cook 15 minutes. Turn heat to low; add cream. Stir with wire whisk for another 10 to 15 minutes. Serve 1/2 sauce on pasta and other half in serving bowl.

title: Two Bean Chili
instructions: Combine onion and green pepper in a 2-quart microwave casserole; cover. Microwave on High 2 minutes or until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients including tomato liquid. Microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes or heated thoroughly.

title: French Toast
instructions: Melt margarine syrup and sugar. Pour into greased 9 X 13 pan. Place 6 slices Texas toast on top of mixture. Beat together eggs milk vanilla and salt. Pour over top of the bread. Cover with foil. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes. When ready to serve turn pieces of bread over and caramel will be on top.

title: Combo Casserole
instructions: Combine soup and cheese; add vegetables. Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cut corned beef into 6 slices; arrange atop vegetables. Toss crumbs with butter. Sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Cheese Pudding
instructions: In saucepan combine soup milk brown sugar and cinnamon. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer 2 minutes to blend flavors. Add butter toast almonds and raisins. Spoon 1/2 of soup mixture in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole; top with apples and remaining toast mixture. Cover; bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot. Uncover; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes more. Serve with whipped cream. Makes 6 servings.

title: Elgie'S Grandmother'S Breakfast Gems
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in Gem pans 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Good hot or cold. Best made a day ahead. Mix and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown onions green pepper garlic and meat then add beans and balance of ingredients in Dutch oven. Simmer 1/2 hour and serve.

title: Fruited Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and whipped topping until blended. Stir in dry jello. Fold in the pineapple and oranges. Chill 1 or 2 hours before serving.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Roll dough to fit a 15 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan. Bake according to package or until lightly browned. Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise until creamy. Spread on dough. Top with vegetables (red radishes cauliflower broccoli carrots etc.).

title: Amy'S Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Grease a 9-inch baking dish. Mix flour sugar cocoa milk and margarine. Blend in nuts. Spread in greased dish. Sprinkle brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa over batter. Pour hot water over entire batter. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Susan'S Summer Salad
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce and tear into bite-size pieces. Cut papaya and avocado into small chunks and add to lettuce.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Place sugar cinnamon and nuts in a plastic bag. Cut each biscuit in half and place all of them in the bag and shake until coated. It is best to use a Teflon Bundt pan. Arrange half of biscuits in pan and put half of margarine over this. Put remaining biscuits on top with rest of butter and sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon over top. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Easy Brunswick Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan; heat until bubbling stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O sugar pineapple and its juice in pan. Heat until mixture comes to a simmer. Add baby food. Set in refrigerator until it begins to thicken. Whip chilled Pet milk adding softened cream cheese as you beat milk. Fold into Jell-O mixture. Pour into large pan (9 x 12-inch glass dish is nice). Top with chopped nuts if desired.

title: Death By Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Bake brownies as directed on box. Make instant pudding as directed on box. Break brownies into chunks. Put 1/2 into 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour pudding over chunks. Put rest of brownie chunks over pudding. Spread Cool Whip over pudding. Crush candy bars and sprinkle over Cool Whip and then sprinkle nuts over also. Refrigerate.

title: Creamy Rice And Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook and stir onion in hot margarine in medium saucepan until tender but not browned. Stir in flour. Add bouillon cubes milk water broccoli garlic powder and thyme. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in rice; simmer 5 minutes longer.

title: Grandma'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and mix with sweet potatoes. Mix milk and eggs and combine with potato mixture. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes longer.

title: Juicy Roast Chicken
instructions: Combine all except chicken. Bring to boil. Add whole chicken cover and cook 10 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Let stand 20 minutes. Remove chicken from liquid. Place on rack and roast at 375\u00b0 about 40 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Bring milk to a boil. Add shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast over warm water. After 5 minutes stir and combine with cooled milk mixture. Add flour gradually. Beat well after each addition. Add enough flour to make a soft dough. Turn out on flour dusted board. Cover with mixing bowl and let rest 10 minutes. Knead about 10 minutes until smooth. Place dough in a warm greased bowl. Brush surface lightly with shortening. Cover and let rise in warm place (80\u00b0 to 85\u00b0) or place in refrigerator until time desired for rolls.

title: Polish Sausage Appetizers
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Soak gelatine in stock. Heat stock and melt gelatine. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour in loaf pan or mold.

title: Pizza Picnic
instructions: Brown meat and set aside. Beat eggs until light. Add grated cheese and set aside. Grease a 10 x 13-inch pan. Line bottom with 1 package rolls. Spread 1/2 of cheese-egg mixture over rolls. Layer the following over cheese-egg mixture meat and green pepper half Provolone ham remaining Provolone remaining egg mixture and salami slices. Cover with second package of rolls. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover; bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Prepare and bake brownies according to package directions; let cool. Set aside. Prepare chocolate pudding according to package directions. Break candy bars into small pieces.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease baking dish; brown the celery and onion with butter. Cook broccoli until just thawed. Mix all in baking dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Quick 'N Easy Salad
instructions: Cut vegetables into small pieces. Mix dressing mix mayonnaise and milk; pour over vegetables coating all pieces. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together in casserole. Top with one cup cornflakes and 1/8 cup melted oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Make instant potatoes. Add the cheese to potatoes after they are made. Saute onions in butter until soft. Add 1/3 cup of butter and onion mixture to potato mixture. Add salt and pepper to taste. Generously butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with butter. Put first layer of noodles in pan with part of the potato mixture on top. The top layer should be noodles. Pour remaining butter and onions over all. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 1 to 2 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Blend ingredients in blender and add ice blending on high speed.

title: Golden Delicious Apple Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Pour in well-greased pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and 1/2 cup nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon Pie
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool to lukewarm. Whip the cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add gelatin blending thoroughly. Fold whipped cream into mixture. Pour in pie shell. Sprinkle with peanuts. Chill for about 2 hours.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Beat well lemonade milk and Cool Whip on high speed. Pour into crust. Freeze.

title: Chocolate Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs. Sift and add flour and spices together with salt. Dissolve chocolate in hot coffee and soda in buttermilk. Stir until it foams. Add to other ingredients with vanilla and cake coloring. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Ice with your favorite icing such as chocolate cream cheese or 7 minute icing.

title: Packet Potatoes
instructions: You will need 1 sheet (18 x 24-inch) aluminum foil.

title: Herb Mix
instructions: Combine herbs in blender and blend on high speed until powdery. About 1 minute.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Brown meat diced onion and pepper in a frying pan. Add can of tomatoes ketchup Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Set steam on low for about 45 minutes. While this is steaming boil macaroni until tender. Drain and put in 2-quart casserole dish. Add and mix in the meat mixture. Top with a layer of cheese. Cook in 325\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes until brown on top.

title: American Fried Rice
instructions: Fry pork or chicken in large pot; set aside. Saute onions celery and peppers. Add chopped (bite size pieces) meat; saute together until done. Make hole in bottom of pot and drop mixed eggs. Stir immediately until eggs are cooked. Add rice soy sauce and salt; mix well.

title: Molasses Crinkles
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly. Blend in all dry ingredients; stir in and chill. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll dough into balls size of walnuts. Dip tops in sugar. Place sugar side up 3 inches apart on greased sheets. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Salmon Spread
instructions: Drain salmon and remove any bones. Cream salmon and cream cheese onion and horseradish. Put in bowl. Spread on crackers. Can be chilled and then rolled in crushed nuts.

title: Chocoholic Pudding Cake
instructions: Pour hot (not boiling) water into 9 x 15-inch sheet cake pan ungreased. Add brown sugar cocoa and marshmallows. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spoon over water mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.(optional)

title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Combine flour garlic powder and paprika in another bowl. Dip chicken in egg then coat with flour mixture. Brown chicken in margarine/butter in a skillet. Dissolve bouillon in boiling water and add to skillet with remaining lemon juice. Cover; simmer 20 minutes until tender.

title: Cauliflower Dip
instructions: Mix together. Refrigerate overnight and serve with fresh cauliflower or other vegetables.

title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Grease bottom only of 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper liners. Beat milk egg and cranberry sauce slightly in medium bowl. In separate bowl mix flour salt baking powder and sugar; add dry mixture to other ingredients and stir until moistened. Fill muffin cups one-half full; sprinkle on topping. Bake 18 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly before removing from pan.

title: Mom'S Homemade Apple Butter
instructions: Put diced apples in crock-pot with cider; cook 10 to 12 hours. Sieve through food mill. Add sugar cloves and cinnamon. Cook 3 more hours. Ladle into 6 sterile pint jars and seal.

title: Country Tavern Sauce For Ribs
instructions: Mix and cook slowly for about 30 minutes.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes into halves. Scoop potato from skins leaving 1/8-inch shell. Mash potato in large bowl. Add salt pepper butter milk and crumbled bacon; mix well. Spoon into shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until heated through. Yield 8 servings.

title: Burger Bundles
instructions: Make 4 large patties from ground beef. Place pattie in the center of a sheet of aluminum foil approximately 12 inches long. Slice potatoes and carrots thinly and place on top of beef pattie. Top with slice of onion and green pepper. Salt and pepper to taste. A.1. sauce or margarine can be sprinkled on top. Bring ends of foil together and seal. Seal all edges of foil so no steam can escape. Place on cookie sheet and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello; add juice and cool (do not let jell). Cream the cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Mix in jello. Beat Milnot to stiff peaks in separate bowl. Fold jello mixture into Milnot. Crush crackers and add melted margarine; pack all but 1 cup cracker crumbs in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan to form crust. Pour cake mixture into pan. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Chill several hours. Will get more firm when thoroughly cold.

title: Hearty Winter Soup
instructions: Brown sausage in a dutch over or large saucepan; drain well and remove from pan. Drain fat from pan and add bell pepper zucchini and onion. cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. Stir in tomatoes kidney beans broth water and cooked sausage. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer about 15 minutes to blend flavors.

title: Caramel Candy
instructions: Cook sugar milk and Karo over medium heat until soft ball stage. Remove. Add 1 stick butter 1 teaspoon vanilla and a pinch of salt. Beat until thick and add pecans. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Applesauce Breakfast Ring
instructions: Line a 2 1/2-quart ring mold with plastic wrap or wax paper.

title: Pear Salad
instructions: Heat pear juice and dissolve Jell-O. Cool. Put pears cottage cheese and cream cheese in blender or sieve until smooth. Put all in a bowl; add pineapple. Mix well. Turn into well-greased mold and chill until firm.

title: Lemony-Icebox Pie
instructions: Whip the condensed milk and lemonade together until it thickens and gets fluffy. Add Cool Whip. Fold into lemonade-milk-Cool Whip mixture the crushed pineapple (well drained) cherries (drained and cut up) and pecans. Pour into pie crusts and let chill about 2 hours. Bananas or strawberries could be added.

title: Fiesta Ribeye Steak
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of steaks with lime juice. Grill steaks turning once when steaks are just about done place shells wrapped in foil on the edge of the grill. When done place each steak on to shells and top with cheese and salsa. Add a salad for a fine dinner.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream together the shortening and 1 cup sugar. Add salt and vanilla and mix well. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour soda and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Stir in apples. Spoon batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Cow Pies
instructions: In a double boiler over simmering water melt the chocolate chips and shortening stirring until smooth. Remove from the heat; stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper. Chill until ready to serve. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Hamburger Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger celery and onion until meat is done. Turn into casserole or roaster. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. More water may be added if the casserole seems too dry.

title: Fried Mush
instructions: Boil water salt and margarine in a pot. Put corn meal in and cook it until it thickens. Add a spoonful of flour to the corn meal while it is cooking. Mix well. Pour out into a loaf pan until it cools and sets up. Slice it and fry in a skillet.

title: Perfection Salad
instructions: Soak gelatin in cold water. Add boiling water and stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add sugar salt vinegar and lemon juice. Cut vegetables into small pieces and add to gelatin mixture when it is cool. Put into molds and chill.

title: Sneaky Cheese Souffle
instructions: Remove crust from bread. Layer bread then cheese in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over bread and cheese. Store in refrigerator for 12 hours. Bake for 1 hour in 300\u00b0 oven. Serve immediately.

title: Seasoning Salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in a closed container. Store in a dry place. Use for salads steaks and vegetables.

title: Six Week Muffins
instructions: Mix corn flakes flour baking soda sugar and salt in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Fill greased muffin tin 2/3 full. Bake in preheated oven (400\u00b0) for 15 to 20 minutes. Keep rest of batter in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Cheese Stuffed Shells
instructions: In medium bowl combine eggs Ricotta cheese Mozzarella cheese 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese parsley salt and pepper. Spoon about 2 tablespoons mixture into each shell. Arrange in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with spaghetti sauce. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Con Queso #3
instructions: Cut cheese up and place in microwave safe bowl. Add milk and soup to cheese; cover with Saran Wrap. Microwave on medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese melts. Stir and serve.

title: Grandmother Holmes' Oyster Stew
instructions: In Dutch oven saute onions in butter until tender. Add remaining ingredients to onions. Cook over low heat until edges of oysters begin to curl and mixture is hot. Do not boil. Serve with crackers.

title: Potato Puff
instructions: Bring first 5 ingredients just to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in Potato Buds and cottage cheese. Mix well and put into casserole dish. Dot with butter and sprinkle with grated cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until hot.

title: Oatmeal Applesauce Yummies
instructions: Melt margarine and shortening in preparation to mixing with dry ingredients. Alternately mix the dry and wet ingredients until it is totally mixed. Keep stirring until no dry ingredients remain; the batter will be very stiff. Drop in small spoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet at least 2-inches apart. They will need a cooking time of up to 15 minutes or until golden. Small drops are best because they are so dense. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In skillet saute onions and celery in margarine until lightly browned. Boil rice and drain. Over low heat in skillet with onions and celery add soups and cheese. Cook over low heat stirring often until cheese has melted and blended well with soups. Add broccoli and rice to mixture. Pour in casserole dish lightly greased with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Napa Valley Salad
instructions: Saute oleo almonds sesame seed and noodles. Heat and cool vinegar sugar oil and soy sauce.

title: Turtle Cheese Cake
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart saucepan melt candy with milk over low heat stirring frequently until smooth. Combine wafer crumbs and butter; press into 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Pour melted mixture into crust; top with pecans.

title: Texas Vegetable Soup
instructions: Heat all ingredients to boiling in 2-quart saucepan; reduce heat. Break up tomatoes. Cover and simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and half of onion in salted water until tender. Drain and mash. Add margarine first (to melt). Add rest of ingredients with cheese last. Pour in small casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 until starts to brown.

title: Baked Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch chunks. Boil until tender. Drain. Mash potatoes then add 6 tbsp of the butter and milk. Whip until they are smooth. Stir in the cheese and salami. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Use some of the remaining butter to grease the sides and bottom of a high sided 3 quart casserole dish. Coat the bottom and sides with bread crumbs. Spoon the mixture into the dish. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until the top is golden brown.

title: Curried Chicken Mole
instructions: Have all ingredients ready to stir-fry in wok or heavy skillet (high heat). Saute garlic ginger and fenugreek in 2 teaspoons sesame oil and 2 to 3 tablespoons olive or canola oil for 1 minute. Add carrots and onions. Saute until onions are golden. Remove and reserve. Add oil heat then stir-fry chicken fast until very golden and crispy; remove and reserve. Add oil; stir-fry fenugreek poppy seed and broccoli or asparagus quickly as bhaji. Add reserved onions carrots and chicken. Cover with yogurt (may substitute or use part coconut milk). Dissolve curry paste and mole paste in a little liquid; add to mix and stir. Lay pepper over mixture and allow it to steam. Cumin or paprika may be added. Let simmer for 30 to 60 minutes. Serve over basmati or jasmine rice.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine; mix with stuffing. Put half of stuffing in 2-quart baking dish. Layer chopped chicken over stuffing. Microwave milk soup and onion until boiling. Pour over chicken and top with remaining stuffing. Pour broth over top of casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until brown and bubbly around edges.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Slice bacon into 1/2-inch strips. Combine bacon onion and garlic in a 1-quart microwave-safe dish. Microwave at High power for 5 minutes or until onion is soft. Drain beans. Add beans and remaining ingredients to onion mixture. Microwave covered with waxed paper at High power for 7 minutes stirring once or twice during cooking time. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix until smooth. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Coconut Balls
instructions: Combine vanilla wafer crumbs flaked coconut and confectioners sugar. Add syrup and vanilla; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in confectioners sugar and store in an airtight container. Reroll in confectioners sugar before serving. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Pie(Melt-In-Your-Mouth)
instructions: Cook chicken. Remove meat from bones cut up and put in 9 x 13-inch pan. In saucepan mix soup and broth and bring to a boil. Pour over chicken. In another bowl combine margarine pepper flour and buttermilk. Mix thoroughly to form batter. Spoon on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Nut Oatmeal Bars
instructions: In mixing bowl cream butter and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Combine oats flour baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Spread 2/3 in the bottom of an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan; set aside.

title: Plum Nutty Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar; add eggs. Sift flour cloves and cinnamon; add alternately with plums. Add nuts; mix well. Bake at 300\u00b0 in lightly greased Bundt pan. Cake is done when toothpick inserted comes out clean. Very moist and tasty!

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa milk and margarine in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil while stirring. Boil 2 minutes. Take off stove. Add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Stir well. Drop on wax paper with a tablespoon. Let cool.

title: Fruit Drop Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening sugar and eggs and mix well. Stir in buttermilk. Combine flour soda and salt and stir in. Stir in pecans cherries and dates. Chill at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Place a pecan half on each cookie. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until almost no imprint remains when touched lightly with finger. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Chicken-Basil-Cashew Pat
instructions: Cut chicken into 1/2-inch pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Melt butter in heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and garlic and saute until chicken is cooked about 3 minutes. Stir in cashews. Remove from heat and cool. Pour cooled chicken mixture into food processor. Add mayonnaise onion cheese and Tabasco. Process until smooth. Add chopped basil and process. Transfer to bowl; cover and chill at least 2 hours. Can be made 2 days ahead.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
instructions: Mix ingredients until moistened. Use in muffin pan or drop method in a 9 x 9-inch pan. This is yummy . . .\tespecially for those really cold mornings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Crumble 1 pack Ritz crackers into 1 stick melted butter. Sprinkle on top and bake until bubbly.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Pound flour into sides of steak. Brown in hot fat in heavy skillet. Add tomatoes onion and celery. Cover. Cook over low heat or in 300\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Uncover the last 30 minutes to cook down the sauce until thick. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Meat
instructions: Brown ground round breaking into small pieces (crumbled). Drain and add Ro-Tel and jar of picante sauce. Mix thoroughly. May rinse jar with small amount of water and add to meat. Lower heat and simmer 15 minutes. Serve as filling for tacos or see Mexican Pie recipe Mexican Taco Salad or Mexican Goulash recipes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Make this recipe the night before. Fry sausage and drain off grease. Combine eggs salt mustard and onion; beat well. Add half and half. Grease a 9 x 13-inch glass pan and line with bread cubes. Sprinkle sausage and cheese on top. Pour egg mixture over all. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Barley Hot Dish
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake in covered casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: All Butter Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sifted flour. Beat 5 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add sugar and baking powder; mix then add flavoring. Bake in greased tube pan at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Creamed Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Cook chili according to package directions. Combine ground beef with chili. Add Ro-Tel and Velveeta (cut up). Simmer 15 minutes stirring often. Add whipping cream and simmer 5 minutes longer. Place Doritos in a plate. Pour creamed taco mixture over Doritos. Sprinkle lettuce and tomato on top. Delicious and quick!

title: Chocolate And Cherry Ring Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir together flour sugar soda cinnamon and salt. In another bowl combine eggs oil and vanilla. Add to flour mixture; mix well. Stir in cherry pie filling chocolate pieces and nuts. Pour mixture into a greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes. Remove from pan; sift powdered sugar on top of cake. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Mix together the refried beans chilies and taco seasoning mix. Spread on 12-inch round platter. Spread on sour cream next. Top with lettuce cheese tomatoes and olives. Spoon on taco sauce.

title: Rigatoni And Chicken Dijon
instructions: Cook rigatoni as directed drain. Meanwhile in large skillet melt butter brown chicken in butter. Add beans. In small mixing bowl combine broth cream mustard and flour until smooth. Stir into chicken and beans. Stir in hot rigatoni. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Caramel Pudding
instructions: Remove can labels. Using a canner or other large pan boil unopened cans of Eagle Brand for 4 hours. Keep water line above cans! (Great to do on cold dry winter days!) After cooked store unopened can(s) in cupboard. Chill when ready to use. Open can at both ends and push out roll of caramel pudding. Slice (and maybe halve or quarter the slices) and serve with a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Cherry Cottage Pudding
instructions: This will look very messed up. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Very good with ice cream or whipped cream. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Dilly Bread
instructions: All ingredients must be at room temperature. Use 1 1/2 or 2-quart casserole dish. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Stir in cottage cheese sugar egg (unbeaten) butter and salt. Add flour. Mix well using your hand. Let rise 50 minutes. Remove from dish and punch down. Wash casserole and grease well. Return dough. Let rise again for 50 minutes.

title: Quick Cobbler Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a pan a little smaller than 9 x 13-inch. Spoon sweetened peaches or fruit on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: Saute rice onion pepper and garlic in oil until browned. Stir in chicken broth salsa and Tabasco. Bring to boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Pie Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: *If you dont like coconut but like the flavor use 1/2 teaspoon coconut flavoring.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs and vanilla. Mix in dry ingredients. Add alternately to creamed mixture with buttermilk. Drop on cookie sheet and top with colored sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Wash quarter and remove stems from apples. No need to peel or core. Cook apples slowly in cider until tender. Put through a food processor. Add 1/2 cup (or more) sugar for each cup of apple pulp. Add spices. Cook in the oven or in a slow cooker for several hours. Stir often. Test for desired thickness by spooning some mixture on a cold plate. When no liquid oozes around the edges its thick enough. (May be canned while hot and it may be frozen. Although if youve just made some fresh bread in your bread machine your family may just eat it all up.) Keep refrigerated.

title: Banana Boats
instructions: Slice skin off top side of a banana; leave it attached at the stem. Peel this back and make 3 slits at 2-inch intervals; pop out the pieces of banana. (Pop these in your mouth and enjoy them.) In each slit put 1 section of Hershey bar (about 1-inch square) and 1 marshmallow (or half a marshmallow if it doesnt fit). Place toothpicks beside each slit to hold banana peeling over the top so it looks like a little \boat.\

title: Banana Layer Cake
instructions: Mix shortening and sugars. Beat the eggs and vanilla. Dissolve soda in milk. Add with bananas to creamed mixture. Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Put in greased layer pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Creamy Peanut Butter Pudding
instructions: In a small bowl mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup milk. In medium size saucepan over moderate heat heat remaining 1 1/2 cup milk. When milk is just under boiling add peanut butter honey and salt. Mix thoroughly then stir in cornstarch mixture and continue cooking about 5 minutes until thick and creamy. Pour about 1/2 cup of the hot mixture into beaten egg then return this mixture to the saucepan and cook 1 minute longer. Remove pan from heat add vanilla and heat about 1 minute. Cool. Pour into individual dessert dishes cover and refrigerate several hours before serving. Yield 4 servings.

title: Double Plain Cake With Caramel Icing
instructions: Pour the milk in a double boiler with water in the bottom boiler. Heat the milk until almost hot. Add the butter. Add the granulated sugar. Stir constantly until the sugar is dissolved. Add the vanilla. Cook until the soft ball stage then remove from the heat. Spread between the layers and on the top of the cake while still warm.

title: Easy Salad Dressing
instructions: Put in jar and shake well. Refrigerate. This salad dressing is not tart. Especially good on pasta salad or mixed green salad.

title: Rigatoni In Vodka Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and saute thinly-sliced garlic in saucepan. Drain juice from tomatoes and pour tomatoes into saucepan. Cook on medium heat. Boil for approximately 1 hour. Season to taste (basil oregano parsley salt and pepper). While this is cooking add crushed red pepper to vodka and soak for the hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix in order given place in casserole dish. Bake 45 minutes to an hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cappelini And Zucchini And Gargonzola
instructions: In a wok stir-fry oil garlic paste and garlic. Then add zucchini. Stir-fry until coated with garlic and oil. Add broth and wine or vermouth. Add Gorgonzola cheese until melted. Do not cook away broth. Add to this mixture the cappelini. Delicious.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple and juice with pudding mix. Add marshmallows and pecans. Fold in whipped topping. Refrigerate in covered container overnight.

title: Copper Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling salted water until fork-tender. When cool alternate layers of carrots with green pepper and onion slices. Combine Worcestershire sauce and remaining ingredients over heat. Pour sauce mixture over layered vegetables. Cover and refrigerate. Flavor is best after a few days of refrigeration.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Cook all ingredients except hamburger together for 3 minutes. Add cooked hamburger. Cook 3 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Funnel Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients first then add milk and egg. Fry in deep fat or oil 375\u00b0 until light brown turning once. Drain on paper plate lined with paper towel. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Toast and butter bread. Break bread into casserole dish. Mix all ingredients and add to bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (about 1 hour).

title: Almond Joy Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake according to package directions. Punch holes in cake. Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar and 1 cup Pet milk. Bring to a rolling boil. Boil for 1 minute. Stir in marshmallows and coconut. Spread over hot cake. Bring 1/2 cup Pet milk 1 1/2 cups sugar and butter to a full boil boiling for 1 minute. Then add chocolate chips and almonds and spread over coconut mixture.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: In covered 12-inch skillet in 1-inch boiling water cook cabbage leaves 5 minutes. Drain. Set aside. In same skillet over medium heat in hot butter cook onion 5 minutes or until tender stirring occasionally. Add tomato sauce brown sugar 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Mix well. Set aside. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Divide mixture into 12 portions. In center of each cabbage leaf place a portion of meat mixture. Fold 2 sides of leaf towards center. From one narrow edge leaf roll up jelly roll fashion. Place filled leaves stem sides down in sauce in skillet. Over medium heat heat sauce and filled leaves to simmering. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 45 minutes.

title: Polynesian Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cut 1-inch thick slices from top of pineapple leaving green leaves on top. Reserve top. With curved knife cut out fruit from shell leaving 1/2-inch wall. Cut fruit into cubes removing any fibrous core. Place olive in curve of each shrimp; skewer with plastic pick. Place pineapple cube on pick. Stir together sour cream curry powder and salt. Place in custard cup in pineapple shell. Cover with reserved pineapple top. Attach shrimmp and pineapple cubes in spiral design to shell of pineapple. Serve immediately or cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. Serves 6.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place 4 chicken breasts (halved and boned 8 fillets) in mayonnaise coated casserole dish. Cover with slices of Swiss cheese. Mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup with 1/4 cup sherry or wine; pour over chicken and cheese. Cover top with bread crumbs or croutons and dot with butter. Bake at 325 degrees for 3/4 to 1 hour.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Melt marshmallows oil and margarine; pour over other ingredients. Press into Bundt or angel food pan (greased). Let set 1 to 2 hours. Turn out on tray.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Line pan with pastry and brush with egg whites beaten. Combine eggs vanilla sugar and salt. Add milk; mix well. Pour in pie crust. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger. Season with salt pepper garlic powder and oregano to your taste. Add spaghetti sauce. Combine 1/2 of mixture to cooked spaghetti.

title: Beef Stew With Dumplings
instructions: Cook beef until tender; add chopped vegetables. Add 1 tablespoon of cornstarch dissolved in 1 cup of cold water. Add 1 teaspoon of salt and a dash of black pepper.

title: Mango Ice Cream
instructions: Start with a good portion of love stir in a few smiles and one or two good belly laughs. Add a pinch of each understanding cheerfulness compassion a prayer or two or three and honesty.

title: Meat With Rice And Lentils
instructions: Combine meat with yogurt and all the spices and leave to marinate for 2 to 3 hours. When youre ready to cook fry the onion in a large stew pot with oil. Add the marinated meat mixture and simmer until liquid is slightly thickened. Set aside.

title: Kiwi Fruit Popsicles(Serves 10)
instructions: Peel kiwi fruit. Process in blender or food processor just until smooth; do not crush seeds. Stir in lemonade concentrate and water.

title: Bean Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix gently but well. Place in beanpot or casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 uncovered for 5 to 6 hours. Cover last hour. Or place in a slow cooker and heat on low overnight. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Baked Spareribs And Sauerkraut
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut ribs into serving size pieces. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Season with salt and pepper. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Remove ribs; drain fat from pan.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Beat eggs; add all the other ingredients. Stir in broccoli. Top with 1 stick margarine. Sprinkle 1 stack Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cornbread
instructions: * If using self-rising flour decrease baking powder to 1 teaspoon and omit salt.

title: Delicious Yams(Microwave)
instructions: Arrange jams in 1 1/2-quart casserole. In medium bowl combine orange juice and cornstarch; stir until cornstarch is completely dissolved. Blend in brown sugar and butter. Add walnuts and pour over yams. Microwave at High (10) for 10 to 12 minutes. Arrange marshmallows on top and microwave at High (10) for 1 to 2 minutes. Rotate casserole 1/4 turn after 45 seconds. Total Microwave Cooking Time 11 to 14 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Apple Pie
instructions: Slice apples. Mix cinnamon and sugar together. Mix flour sugar egg and margarine. Put apples on bottom of pie dish. Do not grease. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar over apples. Dab flour mixture over apples and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Waldorf Salad(Jellied)
instructions: Let raisins stand in boiling water; drain. Combine raisins carrots apples and walnuts. Divide equally into three individual molds. Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add cold water. Pour over mixture in the molds. Chill until firm. Serve on crisp lettuce leaf. Yield 3 servings. Carbohydrate 11 g protein 1 g fat 4 g calories 84. One serving = 1 fruit exchange 1 fat exchange.

title: Apricot Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well blended. Form into a ball. Chill.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Cook carrots until just tender.

title: Microwave Spaghetti
instructions: In a covered 2 1/2 to 3-quart dish break up spaghetti and add 4 cups water with about 1 tablespoon oil. Place in microwave for 10 minutes on High. Pour into colander and rinse with cold water. Leave draining while preparing sauce.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Mix together and serve.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a bowl thin the mayo with the dressing. Add remaining ingredients except peanuts. Toss to coat with dressing. Add the peanuts just before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Squares
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour butter and brown sugar. Blend on low speed to form fine crumbs (about 2 or 3 minutes). Stir in nuts. Reserve 3/4 c. crumb mixture for topping. Pat remaining crumbs into an ungreased square 9 X 9 X 2 inch pan. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly brown at 350. Meanwhile prepare filling. Remove the crumbs from the oven and spread filling over warm crust. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Garnish with cherry halves. Return to oven and bake until lightly brown. Cool cut into squares and store in the refrigerator.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Fill a 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish 1/2 to 3/4 full with cooking apples. Mix 1/2 cup white sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Mix brown sugar cooking oats flour and melted margarine in amounts stated then press and place over apple mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until brown. If desired can serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Layer crackers in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Add a layer of pudding onto crackers. Continue layers of crackers and pudding and end up with crackers on top. Spread icing on top layer of crackers and top with layer of Cool Whip. Let chill for several hours before serving.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Pour over first three ingredients. Top with cooked crumbled bacon and sunflower seeds.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix dry ingredients and cut in shortening. Add milk and yeast. Cover and refrigerate until cold. Roll out on floured surface and cut out. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Dill Potato Salad
instructions: Toss potatoes and green beans together. Combine vinegar onion salt sugar and dill. Pour over potatoes and toss to coat evenly. Cover and chill to blend flavors. Add chopped eggs sour cream and pimento and toss lightly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: Mix gelatin (water and pineapple juice to equal 2 cups) and pour into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish. Add pineapple and blueberry filling. Let congeal in refrigerator. Combine other ingredients and spread over congealed mixture chill and serve. Keep refrigerated.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Add all together. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill overnight.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix half of the crushed soda crackers with the ground beef tomato paste egg onion green pepper salt and pepper. Mix half of the crushed soda crackers with the cottage cheese mushrooms parsley and oregano. Put cheese mixture between layers of meat in 6-inch square dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Florida Raisin Pie(Miami Senior High Home Ec. Class, 1944)
instructions: Add juices water sugar and salt to raisins. Cook together 5 minutes. Moisten cornstarch in a little water and add to hot mixture stirring constantly. Cook until thick always stirring. Cool. Fill 9-inch unbaked pie crust and adjust top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes and then 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Yummy Pineapple Stuffing
instructions: Blend butter and sugar and add eggs one at a time. Add drained pineapple and bread cubes. Mix all well and pour into buttered 8 inch square pan. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sounds nasty but is great!

title: Taco Chicken
instructions: You will need a plastic bag.

title: Nana Funk'S Plain Pastry
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Work in the shortening using fingertips 2 knives a fork or special pastry blender. The mixture should be of the consistency of coarse meal. Take care not to work it to a smooth greasy paste. Add water to make a dough that will just hold together mixing lightly. This amount is sufficient for a double crust pie.

title: Laotian Fried Rice
instructions: Cook 4-5 c rice. Slice thawed chicken into edible pieces or thaw and peel shrimp. Cook meat in oiled wok or other pan thoroughly; set aside. Beat eggs cook with oil in scrambled fashion; set aside. Fry vegetables in oil until desired tenderness; set aside.

title: Russian Potato Pancakes
instructions: Into a large bowl half filled with cold water coarsely shred potatoes and small onion. In a colander lined with a clean towel or cheesecloth drain shredded potatoes and onion. Wrap potatoes and onion in towel. Squeeze towel to remove as much water as possible. In the same large bowl beat eggs. Add the shredded potatoes and onion flour salt and pepper. Toss together until well mixed. In 12-inch skillet over medium heat in hot salad oil drop mixture by scant 1/4 cupfuls into 4 mounds. With pancake turner flatten each mound to make a 4-inch pancake. Cook until golden brown on one side. This is about 4 minutes. Turn and brown on the other side. Remove to paper towel-lined cookie sheet to drain. Keep warm. Repeat to make about 12 more pancakes stirring mixture occasionally. Garnish with parsley sprigs or sour cream.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake as directed; let cool. Poke holes in cake all over. Mix Jell-O with 1 cup hot water and pour over cake. Top with Cool Whip. Slice strawberries and place on top of Cool Whip (optional).

title: Mincemeat Bread
instructions: Cream eggs sugar vanilla and oil. Mix mincemeat and blend well. Add flour salt baking powder and nuts. Blend ingredients well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in two 9 x 5-inch pans.

title: Marshmallow Caramel Balls
instructions: Melt caramels butter milk and flavoring in top of a double boiler. Dip marshmallows in mixture of cereal and nuts. Put on wax paper to dry.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Shred cabbage. Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Layer cabbage sauerkraut ground beef onion rice tomato soup salt pepper and Parmesan cheese. Layer until pan is full. Pour a can of water over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: German Style Spinach
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp and remove from skillet. Crumble; set aside. In bacon drippings blend in flour. Slowly add milk stirring to make a smooth sauce. Add salt pepper and chopped onion. Cook spinach following directions. Add cream sauce and let simmer until thick (5 to 8 minutes). Serve and top with crumbled bacon.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain water then add other ingredients. You may refrigerate until needed. Then bake in an uncovered greased 8 x 8-inch dish for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together and use 1 cup of nuts into ball. Roll the ball in the remaining nuts. Serve with wheat crackers.

title: Country Chicken Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Add a little more water or broth if needed to make a thick soupy consistency. Add a can of cream of chicken soup. Pour into a greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Stir Crazy Cake
instructions: Put flour 1 1/2 cups sugar cocoa soda and salt into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch metal baking pan. Stir with a fork to mix. Form 3 wells in flour mixture. Pour oil into one well vinegar in one and vanilla in one. Pour cold coffee over all ingredients and stir with a fork until well mixed. Do not beat.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Combine cherry pie filling Cool Whip pineapple and milk. Pour into a 13 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover with coconut; garnish with nuts. Chill 1 hour. Serve.

title: Cornish Game Hen Flambe(An Elegant Dinner - Easy)
instructions: Remove giblets and discard. Season inside of hens with salt and pepper. Cut bacon in half and lay across hens.

title: Self-Rising Biscuits - Low-Fat
instructions: Put flour into large bowl. Mix oil and milk together then pour into flour while mixing with a spoon. Add more flour or milk if needed to get a stiff not sticky dough.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: In large bowl beat eggs lightly. Add remaining ingredients except bacon and cheese. Mix well. Press into 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Top with bacon. Bake for 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Place cheese slices on top and continue baking until cheese is slightly melted about 5 to 6 minutes.

title: Raita
instructions: Boil cleaned potatoes until tender. Remove skin and mash potatoes. Mash mixed potatoes and yogurt. Cut jalapeno pepper into two halves. In a skillet warm the oil and add pepper. This makes a sizzling sound. Add this to the potato-yogurt mixture. Add salt and mix again. Wash cilantro dry and mince. Add cilantro to potato mixture. Refrigerate or serve at room temperature. (Substitute cut tomatoes or peeled grated cucumbers for the potatoes. Or use steamed bell pepper omitting jalapeno pepper.)

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti (or use leftovers). Wash drain and cool. Add cut-up vegetables cut rather small. Add Salad Supreme seasoning and Italian salad dressing. Marinate overnight.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Make gelatin according to the package. Drain pineapple use it as part of the water for the gelatin. Chill until slightly thickened. Grind cranberries and orange. Add celery and add sugar to this. Let stand until sugar is well dissolved. Then add this to the gelatin and add the walnuts.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Season the chops with flour salt and pepper and brown them in a little oil. When browned remove them from the pan with a slotted spoon. Fry the onions garlic and green peppers slowly until soft and return the chops to the pan adding the tomatoes tomato paste and thyme. Allow to boil for a couple of minutes. Season to taste lower the heat and simmer until the meat is tender about 45 minutes adding more liquid if required.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Mix 1 roll Ritz crackers with 1 stick melted margarine and sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Divide into 2 parts. Shape each part into a roll. Roll in wax paper and chill overnight. Slice thin and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Drain cooked raisins. Mix together the remaining ingredients and blend in raisins. Beat well. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
instructions: Spread butter on bread. Sprinkle lightly and evenly with oregano Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with grated Mozzarella cheese.

title: Peanut Butter Tandy Cake
instructions: Beat egg. Add rest of ingredients and mix. Grease large sheet pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes (no longer cake will not brown). Remove cake from oven; wait 1 minute and spread with peanut butter (the heat from the cake will melt peanut butter and make it easier to spread). Refrigerate until cake is cooled. Melt chocolate and spread on top of peanut butter. Score chocolate while still soft (for size of cuts). Refrigerate.

title: Diabetic Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix eggs milk sweetener and salt together. Pour into an already made pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Cups
instructions: Drain pineapple and cherries. Quarter cherries and dice bananas. Combine all ingredients. Fill muffin tins which have been lined with paper cups. Freeze until firm. Store in plastic bags. Just before serving remove paper liners and invert cups on lettuce leaf. Makes 18 (2 1/2-inch) cups.

title: Tempura Vegetables
instructions: Beat first 6 ingredients together until smooth. Dip vegetables in tempura batter and cook in hot oil until brown.

title: White Fruitcake
instructions: Grease a paper-lined spring-form tube pan with butter or margarine.

title: Swiss Treat
instructions: Cream margarine. Add egg yolk sugar and vanilla and beat well. Sift dry ingredients and add to the creamed mixture. Then cut cherries and add to the mix. Next add chopped nuts chocolate chips and coconut. Use hands to mix and form a ball. Then pat onto cookie sheet. I use a rolling pin to flatten out even. Bake 20 minutes on ungreased 10 x 15 x 1-inch cookie sheet at 375\u00b0. Cool then cut into squares.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add carrots and eggs then margarine. Mix well. Add a dash of cinnamon. Place in greased casserole dish.

title: Indian Fry Bread
