instructions: Mix yeast sugar milk meal and salt in bowl. Heat the water and oleo to very warm. Not hot! Add the liquid to the dry ingredients beating for about 2 minutes. Add 1/2 cup flour. Add the rest of the flour 1 cup at a time. Immediately put on a floured surface and roll out to about 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick. Cut in circles (about a 5-inch diameter). Wrap each circle in Saran Wrap freeze until ready to use. Makes 8 to 10 circles.

title: Biscuits And Gravy
instructions: Cook hamburger or sausage until done; save 1/3 to 1/2 of the grease. The grease is the secret to good gravy sauce. Mix flour and milk mixture and make a roux. Add to meat and grease. Cook until the thickness is what you want and has turned lightly brown. Season to taste. You can add to the flavor with chicken bouillon cubes. Serve over biscuits.

title: Calypso Pie
instructions: Combine crushed Oreos and melted oleo. Pat into a 10-inch pie plate or square pan. Melt chocolate in 1 tablespoon oleo. Add sugar and milk. Cook until thick; cool. Place coffee ice cream over crust. Add cooled sauce. Add Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts on top. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Crock-Pot Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in crock-pot. Cook 3 to 4 hours or until potatoes and carrots are tender. Add the mushrooms and corn. Make a paste with reserved liquid and flour. Add to soup. Cook on high until slightly thickened. Add cheese. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Stuffed Apples
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Core apples; pare a thin slice of peel from the stem end. Place apples pared side up in a shallow 2-quart baking pan. In a small bowl combine raisins walnuts 3 tablespoons apple juice and 3 teaspoons of cinnamon. Spoon an equal amount of mixture into apple cavities. Combine 1 cup apple juice and remaining 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon. Pour over apples. Dot tops with butter. Bake covered until apples are tender 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheesey Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine soup milk pepper. Arrange alternate layers of potatoes onions cheese and soup. Dot with butter sprinkle with paprika. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for one hour. Uncover and bake for another 15 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cookies(For Diabetics)
instructions: Sift together flour salt cinnamon nutmeg cloves and baking soda. Combine margarine sugar substitute vanilla and egg until creamy. Add flour mixture and applesauce alternately to creamed mixture. Fold in raisins and bran cereal. Drop on nonstick cookie sheet 1-inch apart. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: In a skillet cook sausage until browned; drain off fat. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles; place in ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward center. Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust; spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes; top with Cheddar cheese. In a bowl beat eggs milk salt and pepper; pour into crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Remove meat from bones (about 4 cups of meat). Mix melted margarine and stuffing mix. Add soups and stock or water. Spread 1/2 of the chicken in a 9 x 12-inch baking dish (or equivalent). Cover with 1/2 of soup mixture. Cover with 1/2 of stuffing mix. Repeat layers. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Christmas Mints
instructions: Let Crisco melt (not hot). Remove from heat. Add sugar and 2 teaspoons mint extract. Knead; may add drops of water. Divide and add colors. Roll in balls and use fork or glass to flatten.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Cut onions peppers and pimentos into thin strips. Mix together. Mix oil vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Pour over beans and leave overnight. Stir and serve.

title: Conga Squares
instructions: Melt margarine and cool. Add brown sugar and vanilla and beat in eggs one at a time. Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Add to sugar mixture stirring well then add chocolate chips and pecans mixing well. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes (underbake). Cool and cut into squares.

title: Captain'S Casserole
instructions: Cut beef into cubes and set aside. Chop one onion. Saute chopped onion and garlic in oil. When golden add beef and season with spices. Add chopped tomatoes. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Quarter second onion. Add to meat and add water. Cover and cook until meat is tender. Serve over white rice.

title: Church Beef Stew
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease casserole dish and layer meat potatoes carrots celery and onions. Sprinkle with salt. Combine soups. Spoon on top of casserole. Top with ginger ale. Cover and bake for 3 hours.

title: Sunday Slaw
instructions: Mix well and chill at least 2 to 4 hours. A great complement to summers hot dogs and hamburgers.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: If cake mix has pudding in it omit the instant pudding and use 3 eggs instead of 4 and 1/3 cup oil instead of 1/2. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube or a 12-inch Bundt pan. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan. Mix rest of ingredients. Pour over nuts. Bake 1 hour. Cool and invert over plate. Prick top and spoon and brush glaze on top and sides. Allow cake to absorb glaze slowly. Repeat until all glaze is used.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix 2 packages Kool-Aid to 1 gallon water. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Add 1/2 cup of sugar or to taste. You may freeze some of the mixture in ice cube trays.

title: Shrimp Sauté
instructions: Melt butter in large heavy skillet over medium heat. Add all ingredients except parsley and French bread. Cook about 10 minutes; add parsley. Serve with toasted French bread. Yield 4 servings.

title: Bonnie'S Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and slice vegetables. Place in a 2-quart saucepan. cover with water and cook until very tender. Pour in blender (water too); add salt pepper milk and butter to taste leaving a few vegetables out to add at the last for some body. Blend until smooth. Reheat in saucepan. (You may add Polish sausage to this to make it a heartier soup.)

title: Raspberry Yogurt Crunch Cake
instructions: Line bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan with circle of waxed or parchment paper. Into prepared pan spoon raspberry frozen yogurt. With back of spoon smooth to make an even layer. Evenly top with granola. Spoon vanilla frozen yogurt over granola. With back of spoon smooth to make even layer. Tightly cover; freeze 4 hours. Unwrap and remove side of spring-form pan. Invert cake onto a serving platter; remove pan bottom and pull off paper. Drizzle the top of cake with raspberry pourable fruit. Garnish with raspberries and mint. Makes 12 servings. Per serving 265 calories.

title: Corn Pancake N Ham
instructions: Mix ingredients well and fry on a greased griddle. When starts to bubble turn pancake over.

title: Easter Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll out half of dough and line 9-inch buttered pie pan. Saute peppers and ham in oil 3 minutes; season with pepper. Whisk 2 eggs and Ricotta in large bowl. Spread mixture in pastry shell. Pat spinach dry. Sprinkle on top. Sprinkle saute mix over spinach and top with Mozzarella. Add basil. Roll out remaining dough and cover pie. Trim edges. Cut 4 vents and brush top with beaten egg. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until golden brown. Set 20 minutes and serve.

title: Hot Pepper Butter
instructions: Chop peppers (do not remove seeds). In large pot combine peppers (with seeds) mustard vinegar salt and sugar. Bring to a boil. Combine 1 1/2 cups water with 1 1/2 cups flour (I use a quart jar and add 1 ice cube to flour/water mixture and shake well). Add to other ingredients. Bring to a boil; boil 5 minutes (STIRRING CONSTANTLY). Pour into hot jars (canning jars following canning directions).

title: Super Cake
instructions: Boil crushed pineapple and sugar for 5 minutes; cool. Bake cake according to directions. While still hot spread cooked pineapple on top. Sprinkle instant pudding on top of pineapple \dry.\ Cover cake with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans and coconut. Good!

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; place juice in a small saucepan. Add to the juice the sugar flour and egg. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Let cool.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time. Add 2 cups flour to baking powder alternately with orange juice. Save 1 cup flour to mix with fruit. Beat egg whites and add last with coconut. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 2 hours. Make 2 cakes in tube pan or 2 loaf cakes.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Mash potato while hot and beat in the sugar. Roll out on a board. Cover with peanut butter. Roll up and slice.

title: Pigs In A Blanket
instructions: Fry sausages until brown on all sides. Wrap a refrigerator biscuit around each sausage link. Bake on cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Grape-Nut Puff Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except egg whites) and beat well. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour into a buttered casserole and place in a pan of hot water. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. This has been a long time favorite.

title: Cheezy Hash Browns
instructions: Heat soup cream cheese milk and butter. Mix in hash browns. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apple Date Dream
instructions: Sift together flour sugar soda salt cinnamon and allspice. Combine eggs pie filling and oil; add vanilla. Stir in flour mixture and mix well. Stir in dates and nuts. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Add boiling water to package of jello and stir well. Add cold water and pineapple juice. Chill until partially set about an hour. Add remaining ingredients and chill until firm. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Noodle Clusters
instructions: Melt butterscotch and chocolate pieces in double boiler. Cool. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper covered cookie sheet. Place in refrigerator to set about 2 hours. Makes 2 to 3 dozen.

title: Chocolate Caramel Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom and sides of a 9 inch springform pan. Melt chocolate morsels and margarine in a large saucepan over low heat; cool slightly. Stir in oats flour and brown sugar. Mix well. Press firmly onto bottom and 1 inch up side of pan. Bake 10 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in quiche pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Microwave Hearty Beef 'N Potato Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes on bottom and up sides of 9 x 13-inch casserole. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Meanwhile crumble beef in large bowl. Cook on High 4 to 5 minutes; stir halfway through cooking time. Drain well. Stir in broccoli 1/2 can Durkee onions soup milk 1/2 cup cheese and spices. Cook uncovered on High 6 minutes; stir halfway through. Add tomatoes; spoon into potato lined casserole. Cook uncovered on High 8 minutes; top with remaining cheese and onions. Cook on High 1 minute.

title: Spanish Amanda
instructions: Fry or bake pork chops then spread them in a long casserole dish. Put 1 slice of onion on each chop then 1 whole tomato and a slice of bell pepper. Spoon 1 tablespoon of rice on each chop. Pour juice from can of tomatoes over each chop. Season to taste. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes a complete meal!!

title: Barbara'S Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Cut shortening into flour. Combine buttermilk\tand soda and add to flour along with the sugar and yeast. Place in airtight container and keep refrigerated. Will keep for several days. Drop by spoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Melt jello in two cups of boiling water. Add cranberry sauce and mix well; add crushed pineapple (with juice) and chopped nuts. Mix well. Add 1/2 cup cold water and mix. Pour into bowl.

title: Veal Scallops With Roquefort
instructions: Heat oil and butter in skillet. Dredge veal scallops in flour and sprinkle with salt and pepper on top. Cook 2 minutes on each side on medium-high heat. Remove from skillet; keep warm.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package adding pudding mix and sour cream. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake using cake mix directions. Cool and frost with chocolate fudge frosting.

title: Root Sherbet Float
instructions: In a tall glass pour root beer soda until the glass is half full. Next place 2 scoops of orange sherbet into the glass. Mix the two ingredients with a spoon until desired thickness is achieved. Place a straw in the glass; sit back and sip.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: For first layer spread the refried beans in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. For second layer mash avocados; add lemon juice salt and pepper. Spread on top of first layer. For third layer mix sour cream mayonnaise and taco mix. Spread on top of second layer. For fourth layer grate cheese and spread on top of cream cheese mixture. For fifth layer add tomatoes chopped lettuce and onion if desired. Top with chopped black olives.

title: Marinated Grilled Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Marinate at least 2 hours. All day works great! Cook on grill using marinade as baste.

title: Chili(Second Place Winner - Chili Cook Off - 1994)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer at least 1 hour after bringing to a boil. Also good in slow cooker on low setting all day.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: In large bowl cream oleo and sugars. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Beat well. Combine dry ingredients and mix well. Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Stir in water; mix until smooth. Pour in floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Charlie'S Chicken
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soup rice and water in pan. Place raw chicken on top and sprinkle 1 package dry onion soup mix on top. Cover with foil. Cook for 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Salmon Party Log
instructions: Drain and flake salmon removing skin and bones. Combine salmon with cream cheese lemon juice onions horseradish salt and liquid smoke; mix thoroughly. Chill several hours. Combine pecans and parsley. Shape salmon into an 8 x 2-inch log. Roll into nut mixture. Chill well. Serve with crackers.

title: Molded Chicken Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in water. Heat soup to boiling and pour in gelatine. Take off heat; cool and stir in mayonnaise and remaining ingredients. Pour in mold and refrigerate.

title: Peach Melba Topping
instructions: Reserve 2/3 cup syrup drained from the frozen red raspberries. In small saucepan combine reserved syrup currant jelly and cornstarch. Cook and stir until slightly thickened and glossy. Cool. Stir in the raspberries. Drain the peach slices. Arrange on cake. Top with sauce.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt the first 2 ingredients over low heat; set aside. Combine the rest and add to chocolate mixture. Pour into a 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 23 minutes (will be shiny on top).

title: Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Blend sugar mustard and salt together in mixer bowl. Add vinegar and mix at medium speed. Slowly add oil. Continue beating for 10 minutes. Add celery seed grated onion and food coloring. Mix well. Store in refrigerator. Keeps well for several weeks. Very good dressing for fruit or any salad.

title: Swedish Tea Ring
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Combine scalded milk shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add 1 cup flour and egg. Beat well. Add enough flour to make soft dough. Knead lightly on floured surface. Place in greased bowl turn once to grease surface. Cover. Let rise until double in bulk. Roll into rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Brush with melted butter. Spread brown sugar cinnamon cherries and pecans evenly over dough. Roll up lengthwise. Seal edges. Shape into ring on greased cookie sheet. Snip almost to center at 1-inch intervals with scissors or hot knife. Let rise again until doubled in bulk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
instructions: Combine cucumbers and green onions in a large bowl. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Combine all remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers and mix well. Refrigerate for several hours. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve fresh and chilled.

title: Double Cheese Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Alternate layers of macaroni and Cheddar and cottage cheese in greased 2-quart baking dish beginning with macaroni and ending with cheese. Melt the 1/4 cup butter in a saucepan; stir in flour to make a smooth mixture. Blend in milk gradually. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Cook until sauce has thickened about 2 minutes. Add salt and pepper. Pour sauce over macaroni and cheese. Mix bread crumbs if used with melted butter. Sprinkle over macaroni and cheese. Casserole may be covered and refrigerated at this point if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. If refrigerated increase baking time by 10 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Blueberry Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first 6 ingredients. Gently fold in blueberries. Combine yogurt and buttermilk; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups two-thirds full. Bake at 400 degrees for 18 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes before removing from pan to wire rack.

title: Smoked Turkey Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend the first 3 ingredients well. Chill for several hours. Shape into ball. Roll in pecans and parsley. Wrap well and refrigerate.

title: Foolproof Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In a heavy saucepan\tover low heat melt chips with Eagle Brand milk. Remove from heat; stir in remaining ingredients. Spread evenly into wax paper-lined 8-inch square pan. Chill 2 to 3 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board. Peel off paper\tand cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Jello Kisses(Easy)
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in Jell-O and sugar; continue beating until stiff and glossy. Add 1 cup coconut. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet and bake at 275\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Oriental Wings
instructions: Fry wings until brown and set aside. Mix all other ingredients and toss in wings.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and remove fat. Place in a pot and cook with vegetables and bouillon cubes for approximately 1 hour. Cover pot while cooking.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: In Dutch oven or heavy soup kettle heat oil. Add onion and garlic. Saute until softened. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes stirring gently every 10 minutes until vegetables are tender. Serve over hot cooked rice or with French bread. Top with grated Parmesan cheese and chopped black olives.

title: Lime Delight Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Mash cream cheese and stir into Jell-O. Add marshmallows and stir to melt. After chilling fold in Cool Whip and pineapple. Add nuts and chill until set.

title: Chocolate Malt Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Arrange 4 ice cream sandwiches long sides touching on a serving plate. Squirt an even layer of chocolate whipped cream over top. Scatter with 1/3 cup of chopped malted milk balls. Repeat layers twice garnishing top with a few whole malt balls if desired. Freeze 6 hours of until firm. If not serving immediately cover tightly with plastic wrap and freeze up to 1 week.

title: Biftech Au Poivre Vert
instructions: Trim steak of all fat and quickly dip into cold water. Drain but do not pat dry. Apple Pam to a skillet; sear the steak on both sides over high heat. Lower the heat to cook as desired adding a little extra water as necessary. Place the cooked steak on a warm serving platter while preparing the sauce.

title: Cranberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and add sugar gradually. Add unbeaten eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together alternately with the sour cream ending with the dry ingredients. Add 1 teaspoon extract. Pour half batter in greased and floured 9 x 3-inch tube pan. Spread evenly with half the cranberries. Add rest of batter and top with remaining cranberries. Sprinkle with chopped walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool 5 minutes and remove from pan. Combine powdered sugar water and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract. Dribble over cooled cake. Serves 12.

title: Chop Suey Casserole Or Hamburger Hash
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and celery; add soups rice and soya sauce and water. Bake for 1/2 hour in a covered casserole dish. Take cover off and top with chow mein noodles. Continue cooking 1/2 hour uncovered. Serve hot.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Measure butter dates and sugar into medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture becomes a soft paste. Remove from heat. Add cereal and nuts mixing thoroughly. Portion by level measuring tablespoon onto waxed paper. Shape into balls. Let stand until set. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Butter Cream Icing
instructions: Boil milk and flour until very thick and cool. Cream sugar and butter until smooth. Beat in milk and flour mixture until consistency of whipped cream.

title: Cottage Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream and blend the Crisco sugars vanilla eggs and cottage cheese. Mix flour baking powder cocoa and soda and add to first mixture. Mix well. Chill for 1 hour. Roll in balls then in powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Hot Corn
instructions: Melt butter milk and cheese. Drain corn. Add garlic salt and peppers. Bake until bubbly 350\u00b0. I substitute whole kernel corn for the Shoepeg when I dont have the Shoepeg and its very good also.

title: Pasta Bake
instructions: Brown beef with pepper and onion. Cook noodles until tender; add cream cheese and sour cream. Layer beef noodles and Ragu in a baking pan. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake 30 minutes until hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cabbage-Green Bean Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan. Heat ingredients to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until cabbage is crisp and tender. Toss occasionally while heating for 5 minutes.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 5 minutes. Mix the bananas and lemonade in the blender. Combine all ingredients except ginger ale. Pour into 2-quart containers and freeze. For each 2-quart container use 1 quart ginger ale.

title: Onion Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook stirring until thickened. Pour over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix Bisquick milk and cheese until soft dough forms. Beat 30 seconds. Drop dough by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown. Mix margarine and garlic powder; brush over warm biscuits before removing from sheet. Serve warm. Makes 18 to 20 biscuits.

title: Herbed Egg Salad Sandwiches
instructions: In a bowl stir together all ingredients except bread. Season with salt and pepper to taste and combine well. Assemble sandwiches and serve.

title: Bird'S Nest
instructions: Cream butter; add next 3 ingredients and egg yolk. Beat until light; add flour. Mix well. Wrap dough in waxed paper and chill. Make into 1-inch balls. Dip into lightly beaten egg white. Roll in almonds. Grease cookie sheet. Press center and fill with raspberry jam. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: 20 Minute Apple Butter
instructions: Cook applesauce sugar and vinegar for 15 minutes. Add gelatin and cook 5 minutes longer.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine shortening and sugar together. Whip 3 minutes to blend. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Alternately add flour baking powder and milk to egg mixture. Beat after each addition. Add lemon butter and vanilla flavorings. Beat well. Pour into floured and greased Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup bread crumbs and 3 tablespoons melted butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Make sure 1 hour.

title: Peas Or Beans In Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in 1/4 cup of oil. Add carrot and simmer until the oil becomes nice and orange. Add red pepper powder and sour cream. Add salt to your liking.

title: Utah'S Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together the butter brown sugar and sugar. Add the vanilla and eggs. Beat for 3 minutes. Add the flour salt and baking soda. Mix together all the ingredients as directed. Fold in the chocolate chips and nuts. Put spoonfuls of dough on a sheet of foil on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Grilled Halibut, Cod Or Salmon Steaks
instructions: Place fish in a shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over fish. Cover dish and refrigerate for 30 minutes turning once. Remove fish reserve marinade for basting. Place fish on lightly oiled grill 4 to 6-inches from moderately hot coals. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Serves 4.

title: Taco Pinwheels
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients to a smooth mixture and spread on tortillas. Roll up and wrap in Saran Wrap. Refrigerate. When ready to use slice like pinwheels and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Let butter melt; add sugar and brown. Add milk and bring to a soft ball stage on candy thermometer. Remove from heat and beat with mixer until of spreading consistency. Spread on cake. Makes enough to frost 2 (9-inch) layers.

title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix sauce brown sugar onion and water mixing bowl and set aside to warm to room temperature.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Put toothpick or fork in middle. Its done when toothpick or fork comes out of cake clean.

title: Slush
instructions: Combine sugar and boiling water. Stir and cool. Add bananas and remaining ingredients. Mix and freeze. Take out 30 minutes before serving and use a knife to make into slush. Makes 1 gallon and keeps frozen well.

title: Granny Ebert'S Hash
instructions: Cover meat with water 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper. Simmer until tender about 2 hours. Remove meat. Save broth.

title: Sandman Cookies(Or No Bake)
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan then add sugar cocoa and milk and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter oats and vanilla; stir. Put on wax paper by teaspoon. Let cool.

title: Butterscotch Candy
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels in microwave or double boiler. Add peanut butter and almonds which have been toasted with a brushing of margarine. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper and let set. This makes a large batch which can be frozen for an indefinite period.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni then add Italian dressing and chill 1/2 hour. Add mayo olives onions salt pepper and cheese. Chill until needed.

title: 3 Cheese And Carrot Tart
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 9-inch pie dish with 1 tablespoon oil. Rinse shredded potatoes and squeeze dry in a kitchen towel. Place potatoes in dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and toss to blend. Spread in a layer over the bottom of the dish and bake 25 minutes until browned. Reduce heat to 375\u00b0. Heat remaining oil in skillet over medium heat. Add carrots and onion and cook stirring frequently until softened about 3 minutes. Whisk eggs cottage cheese milk Swiss cheese salt pepper and parsley in mixing bowl. Add carrots and onion. Pour over potato crust and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 30 minutes until puffed and lightly browned. Serve hot. Makes 4 main dish servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Lemonade
instructions: Cut lemon in thin slices. Place in a bowl and cover with sugar. Mash thoroughly until all juice is extracted. Add water. Let stand 1 hour. Allow 1 or 2 tablespoons of the strained lemon juice for each serving. Pour into glass filled with shaved ice and fill with water. Garnish with maraschino cherry and slice of lemon. Serves 3 or 4.

title: Heavenly Punch
instructions: Mix everything together and freeze in Tupperware. Thaw until slushy and add 2 bottles ginger ale.

title: Spaghetti With Oil And Garlic
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water. Drain. In a small skillet heat the oil. Add the garlic and quickly saute until garlic begins to brown. Place spaghetti in a serving bowl. Add the garlic and oil; toss. Season with salt and pepper. Serves 4.

title: Texas Fried Okra
instructions: In a plastic bag combine corn meal flour salt and pepper. Cut okra into 1/2-inch slices and pour buttermilk or milk over okra and toss. Place okra in plastic bag and shake. In a skillet heat oil and add okra. Fry on moderate heat turning frequently until crispy and brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately.

title: Sour Milk Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix sour milk with soda. Add sugar salt and the softened yeast. Add well beaten egg and margarine. Add enough flour to make a firm dough. Knead until smooth. Let rise in warm place until double. Punch dough down and shape into small balls. Place in greased baking pan 1 inch apart. Cover and let rise until double. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 20-25 minutes. Makes 24 rolls.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Put milk rice sugar lemon rind and salt in pot and simmer approximately 1 hour. When rice is cooked remove from stove and add the eggs sugar and vanilla which have been mixed together. Stir constantly for 2 minutes. Pour into serving dish and cool. When cool refrigerate.

title: Green Stuff
instructions: Combine ingredients until well mixed. Pour into a container.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Place cooked ham on bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Spread 2 cups cheese over ham. Add cooked noodles over mixture. Add cream of mushroom soup mixed with 1 can of milk. Put remaining cheese over top and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour in greased baking pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Chocolate Fudge(2 Pounds)
instructions: Put chocolate pieces broken candy bar Marshmallow Creme butter and nuts into bowl. Combine evaporated milk and sugar in saucepan over medium heat. Bring to boil; cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and pour over other ingredients. Stir until chocolate has melted and mixture is smooth and glossy. Pour in ungreased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Whip cream cheese with milk. Add rest of ingredients and mix.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except crackers and cheese. Place in ungreased 3-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with topping (crackers and cheese). Bake uncovered in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Marinated, Browned Beef Tips (Stew Beef)
instructions: Prepare marinade of red wine vinegar red wine (optional) balsamic vinegar soy sauce Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce (optional). Cut stew beef/chuck steak into 1-inch cubes. Marinate in the marinade for at least 4 hours overnight in refrigerator if possible in non-metallic container. Light coat marinated beef tips in \flour mixture\ and brown over medium-high heat. After browned add residual marinade and cook until it forms a thick sauce.

title: Banana Boat
instructions: Prepare mix as package directs for pudding. Fold in Cool Whip miniature marshmallows and banana slices. Line bottom and sides of a 10 x 6-inch baking dish with wafers. Pour in pudding mixture. Garnish as desired.

title: Picante Pot Roast
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat brown meat in oil. Drain. Sprinkle onions over meat. Combine tomato sauce picante sauce cumin oregano and garlic. Pour over meat and onions. Reduce heat; cover and simmer gently about 2 to 2 1/2 hours adding green pepper during last 15 minutes of cooking. Begin checking meat for tenderness after 1 hour and 45 minutes of cooking. Remove meat to serving platter; keep warm.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Reserve 1/2 cup oyster liquid.\tSeason oysters with salts and peppers; frizzle in their own juice until slightly curled.\tSet aside. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour; blend. Add onions; stir until onions are cooked. Add oyster liquid. Add milk 1 cup at a time stirring constantly. Cook about 10 minutes. Add oysters. Check for additional seasoning. Sprinkle onion on top just before serving. Serves 6-8.

title: Fried Spinach Balls
instructions: Beat egg and set aside. Mix together remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until cold. Shape into balls; roll in crumbs then in beaten egg. Deep fry in fat until brown.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend together all ingredients and chill. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Frito Salad
instructions: Mix beans tomatoes pepper and onion in a large bowl. Right before serving add corn chips and toss with dressing.

title: Party Rolls
instructions: Slice each roll several times and put on platter. Looks very pretty and tastes delicious.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Candy
instructions: Melt butterscotch chips in a large pan over water. Stir in peanuts. Add noodles and mix. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Makes about 30.

title: Golden Raisin Buns
instructions: Combine water butter sugar and salt in a saucepan. Heat to boil. Add flour all at once then over low heat beat with wooden spoon about 1 minute or until a smooth thick dough. Remove from heat. Continue beating 2 minutes to cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating after each until mixture has satiny sheen. Stir in raisins. Drop heaping measuring tablespoons about 2 inches apart on greased sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until doubles. Remove to wire rack. Cool. While still warm spread frosting. Makes 20.

title: Home-Made Waffles
instructions: Beat whites till stiff. Mix other ingredients and fold into whites. Cook.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Work fast and mix everything together. Add Cool Whip last. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients except avocado and Doritos. Heat in a large pot (do not boil).

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Grease 2 10 inch pie plates and put sweetened fruit on bottom. cover with the above mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Use 2 deep dish pie plates. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch casserole or cake pan (or large bowl) shred lettuce. Then add the rest of the ingredients in the order listed.

title: Barbecued Beef
instructions: Cook beef for 2 1/2 hours adding water as needed. When the beef is tender drain and shred. Add remaining ingredients and heat. Serve on a bun. Makes 6 sandwiches.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Makes 2 regular loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Summer Squash Surprise
instructions: Slice squash and cook with onion (just to crisp; drain if necessary). Mix chicken soup sour cream salt pepper and nutmeg. Melt butter and pour over 1/2 package of dressing. Save some to sprinkle on top. Place dressing in bottom of casserole dish. Add squash and onions. Top with sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with reserved dressing and Parmesan cheese if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot through.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop by spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Jewish Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except apples together in a large bowl and beat for 10 minutes on medium speed. Grease tube pan. Put 1 layer of batter then one layer of apples and repeat this by making the top layer batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Last 1/2 hour cover with foil.

title: Orange Date Cake
instructions: Mix together sugar flour salt and soda. Add melted butter buttermilk and eggs. Mix well and stir in pecans dates and orange rind. Pour into tube pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Andrea'S Pie Crust(Makes 1 Pie)
instructions: Work Crisco into flour then sprinkle tap water over this and work in with a fork. When moist enough ball up in a wax paper and set aside and let set at least 1 minute or longer. This can be refrigerated for sometime then roll out on floured board. Turn over and roll again. Roll thin.

title: German Sweet And Sour Cabbage
instructions: Pour sugar over shredded cabbage and let stand for several minutes. Combine other ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil. Pour boiling mixture over cabbage; let stand overnight before using. This will keep for at least 10 days. Store in a covered dish but not a metal container. This is very good with ham for a buffet dinner.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Dont overbake!

title: Strawberry Orange Delight
instructions: In medium bowl stir boiling water and jello together for at least 2 minutes. Stir in cold water. Refrigerate about 1 1/4 hours or until slightly thickened. Reserve a few oranges for garnish if desired. Gently stir in remaining oranges into thickened gelatin. In a separate bowl beat cream cheese and sugar with a wire whisk until well blended. Gently stir in 2 c. whipped topping. Spoon into large serving bowl cover with gelatin mixture. Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm. Garnish with remaining whipped topping and reserved oranges.

title: Dirt
instructions: Grind up the package of Oreos and set aside. Combine the cream cheese powdered sugar and the butter. Cream together and set aside. Combine the milk Cool Whip and pudding mixes in a large bowl and mix together. Add in the cream cheese mixture and stir until there are no lumps. Starting with the pudding mixture layer it into a flower pot looking bowl then put a layer of the Oreos to cover the pudding. Alternate back and forth and make sure that the Oreos end up on top and place artificial flowers in it.

title: Banan-Za Bread
instructions: Warm honey and oil in a saucepan until easily blended. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk and add to the honey and oil mixture. Beat eggs and add in order the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Yummy Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff. Gradually add vanilla and brown sugar. Fold in pecans by hand and coat well. Place on cookie sheet with pecan bottoms flat side down. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cream Cheese
instructions: Mix ingredients using fork to cut margarine into mixture. Pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool before adding cream mixture.

title: Mini Meat Balls
instructions: Mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup beef bread crumbs egg onion salt and 1/8 teaspoon each pepper sage and thyme. Shape firmly into 6 mini meat loaves in a skillet. Brown loaves in shortening. Pour off fat. Stir in remaining soup and seasoning and water. Cover; cook over low heat 20 minutes or until done. Stir occasionally. Serves 6.

title: Lemonade
instructions: Squeeze the juice from 4 of the lemons limes and oranges; pour into a gallon container. Thinly slice the remaining fruit and set aside for garnish. Add water and sugar to juices and mix well. Chill garnish and serve on ice with fruit slice garnish.

title: Cold Green Beans
instructions: Boil beans. Stir 1/2 teaspoon sugar and salt while boiling. Cook 5 to 7 minutes; leave crispy. Drain under cold water. Combine shallot vinegar and salt. Drizzle in olive oil; add beans and cilantro and toss to coat. Sprinkle sesame seed on top.

title: Cherry-O Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cheese milk juice and vanilla; mix well! Pour into a graham cracker crust and top with cherries. Refrigerate.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Slice onions and separate into rings. Saute until tender in 1 stick butter. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Melt other stick of butter and mix with crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle buttered cracker crumbs over onions and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Mix well bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: German Cheese Cake
instructions: Place ingredients in order given in large mixing bowl. Beat with mixer start on low move to medium and finish 10 minutes on high. Batter should be smooth and liquid. Grease and flour a round 10-inch baking pan 3-inches high; pour into pan and bake 1 hour in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Leave cake in oven with door closed for 1 additional hour after heat is off. Cool on rack in refrigerator. Makes 20 servings.

title: Chocolate Mocha Pie
instructions: Soften gelatin in water. Bring cocoa coffee salt sugar milk and cold water to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add gelatin. Cook until slightly thickened. Beat the cooked mixture until smooth. Beat cream. Add vanilla. Fold whipped cream into cooked mixture. Pour into pie shell and top with nuts or shredded chocolate chips.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix first five ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add the other five ingredients and mix well. Nuts or raisins can be added. Pour in greased and floured bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Makes two loaves.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except pie crust) together. Place in a 10-inch pie plate. Place top crust on. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes. Cool 10 minutes then slice.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix filling ingredients in the order given. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a preheated oven for 45 minutes to one hour or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean. Cool before serving. Makes two pies.

title: Drumstick Torte
instructions: Mix vanilla wafers 2/3 cup peanuts and butter. Put in 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Arrange a layer of potatoes layer of onion and another layer of potatoes in casserole. Mix water and cream of mushroom soup; pour over layers of onion and potatoes. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 8 servings.

title: Honey Ham
instructions: Fry ham in bouillon soup until brown on one side. Turn over and add honey on top of ham. Continue to add enough bouillon soup to keep it from being dry. Add coffee at the end of cooking. When all is done there should be a brown sauce for top of ham.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pot and let heat until almost to a boil.

title: E-Z Georgia Jambalaya(Mild)
instructions: Cut chicken and sausage into small pieces; lightly brown and set aside.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel quarter and core apples. Wrap each piece in a roll. Press dough around apple to seal. Bring to a boil. Mix orange juice sugar and butter. Place dumplings in ovenproof dish. Pour juice mixture over dumplings and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream. Its delicious!

title: Salsa
instructions: In large saucepan bring all ingredients to a boil simmer for 15 minutes. Add 6 Tbsp. cornstarch mixed in water. Continue cooking until desired thickness. Will thicken more after cooled. (Can in hot water bath for 20 minutes).

title: Turtle Stew 1
instructions: Boil the turtle meat for 20 minutes. Melt butter in a pot and cook the sliced garlic until browned. Coat the cooked turtle meat with flour and add it to the pot along with the onion. Cook the meat until browned. Pour in the stock in which the turtle was boiled. Simmer for several hours or until the meat is tender. Add potatoes stir in the soup and cook an additional 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: About 40 minutes before serving cut half of cheese into 6 slices; shred remaining cheese. Make a 2 1/2-inch horizontal cut in meatier part of each chicken breast half to make a deep pocket. Place 1 slice of cheese in each. On waxed paper combine flour and salt. In bowl mix egg and milk; on another sheet of waxed paper place cornmeal. Dip each chicken breast into flour egg mixture and then in cornmeal. In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot oil brown chicken on both sides about 5 minutes; remove to plate. To same skillet add salsa taco sauce and 1/3 cup water over high heat heat to boiling. Arrange chicken in sauce reduce heat to low simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and cook until cheese melts. Serves 6. Has 480 calories per serving 22 grams fat 147 mg. cholesterol and 1405 mg. sodium.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
instructions: Boil cranberries in 2 quarts water for 20 minutes. Boil the sugar water and cinnamon for 30 minutes. Strain cranberries and combine juice with the remaining ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Watermelon Sherbet
instructions: Put plastic wrap in bottom of bowl. Smash lime sherbet on bottom and sides (rind). Soften raspberry sherbet and mix with chocolate chips (fruit and seeds). Put mixture in middle of bowl. Cover with plastic; freeze. Turn upside down. Put warm rag on bottom of bowl remove bowl and slice. Use warm water to dip knife for slices.

title: Moro De Frijoles(Rice And Beans Cooked Together)
instructions: Clean and wash rice. Set aside. Mix bacon tomatoes and stir-fry in 1 tablespoon of oil. Add onions garlic coriander pepper oregano vinegar salt and tomato paste. Stir-fry and add a bit of water if necessary. Add beans and stir 3 minutes. Add rice and keep stirring for an other few minutes. Add hot water and let cook. When rice is tender add the remaining oil and cook gently for 5 minutes. Serve with chicken or beef stew Dominican style and avocado and tomato salad. Serves 6.

title: Sour Cream Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 225\u00b0. Tear dried beef into pieces and cover bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Wrap chicken with bacon and lay on top of the dried beef. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix mushroom soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken and sprinkle with paprika. Cover with foil and bake at 225\u00b0 for 2 hours. Uncover and bake one more hour.

title: Jello Pinwheels
instructions: Spray 8 or 9-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray on bottom and sides. Wipe out excess with paper towel. Mix Jell-O (any flavor) and water in 2-quart microwave bowl. Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir until completely dissolved. Add miniature marshmallows and microwave 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until they are puffed and almost melted. Stir until marshmallows are completely melted and mixture is smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Refrigerate 45 minutes. (Creamy layer will float to top.) Roll Jell-O and cut into 1/2 inch slices.

title: 24-Hour Slaw
instructions: Empty package of shredded cabbage and carrots into a large bowl. Add pepper and onions. In medium saucepan combine sugar oil vinegar celery seed salt to taste and parsley flakes. Stir together over medium heat until sugar is dissolved. Pour hot dressing over cabbage. Cover and let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Yield 8 servings.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add beaten egg. Add sifted dry ingredients. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in 8-inch square pan. May be doubled and put in 9 x 13-inch but use only 1 1/2 cups of sugar when doubled.

title: Chicken And Stuffing
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Mix stuffing direction from box with melted butter or margarine (reserve 1/3 dressing for the top). Mix all ingredients together and put in greased casserole dish. Cover with reserved dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: 3 Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Angel Food Delight
instructions: Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip set aside. Break up angel food cake in small pieces and mix with Cool Whip mixture. Spread out in long cake pan. Mix strawberries with strawberry glaze and spread over cake mixture. Chill. (You can use fresh strawberries if you have them.)

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs in small bowl. Add raisins and vanilla and mix. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Minted Chocolate Pears(Microwave)
instructions: Combine sugar water and vanilla in glass baking dish. Microwave covered on High for 5 minutes or until mixture boils. Peel and core pears; cut into halves. Place in hot mixture. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Microwave on Medium for 5 minutes until pears are tender. Cool. Combine mint patties and cream in a small glass bowl; microwave on Medium for 2 minutes or until mints are melted. Mix well. Drain pears; place in serving dishes. Top with chocolate mint sauce. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Yields 4 servings.

title: Fresh Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine canned chicken stock cream of chicken soup and 2 cups water; set aside. Cook all other vegetables and chicken until very tender; cut in small pieces. Puree all vegetables and chicken breast in blender. Add pureed vegetables and chicken breast to stock. Simmer on low flame 1/2 hour. Serve with garlic crackers or corn muffins.

title: Easy Yeast Rolls
instructions: Place water in large bowl. Add dry yeast and stir. Add salt and sugar; stir. Add 3 cups flour; stir. Add egg and Crisco and stir well. Add 3 cups flour; stir well. Cover and refrigerate. When ready to bake divide dough in half. Knead half dough lightly. Roll into about 8 x 16-inch piece. Spread with half the oleo. Fold dough lengthwise in pan. Let rise to double in bulk. Brush other half of oleo on dough. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. May bake other half following day or use as follows.

title: Marinade For Swordfish
instructions: Mix all together. Pour over fish and marinate 30 minutes in refrigerator (if there is any leftover sauce from marinade if you wish boil it and use over the cooked swordfish).

title: Ina'S 11 Day Pickles
instructions: Soak whole cucumbers in salt brine in crock (1 1/4 cups salt and cold water to cover). Let stand 3 days. On days 4 to 6 rinse daily with clear water. On the seventh day cut in very thin slices and boil in a solution of 5 cups water 3 tablespoons alum and 2 1/2 cups vinegar. Drain and cover with hot spiced vinegar made as follows 3 pints vinegar and 7 pounds sugar and tie cinnamon and cloves in cheesecloth bag. Drop in solution. On days 8 to 10 reheat vinegar and pour over pickles. On eleventh day seal in jars covering with hot spiced vinegar. Makes 10 to 12 pints.

title: Ginger Snaps
instructions: Cream 1 cup sugar 3/4 cups shortening.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Mix everything except rice and pork chops. Reserve 1 cup of liquid mixture; mix rice with remainder. Place in casserole with meat on top. Cover with remaining cup of liquid. Bake 1 hour covered at 350\u00b0. Uncover and bake another 15 minutes.

title: Sweet And Pungent Carrots
instructions: Heat oil; add carrots and stir 3 minutes. Add 1 cup water sugar vinegar and salt. Boil covered until carrots are tender. Blend and add cornstarch 1/4 cup water and soy sauce and add to carrots. Stir and continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes until mixture thickens. Serve hot.

title: Tender Eye Of Round Roast
instructions: Combine tomato sauce onion water and beef bouillon; pour over roast in a deep casserole or baking dish. Cover and bake 3 to 4 hours at 350\u00b0. Turn roast over several times while it is baking.

title: Crab Appetizer
instructions: Mix in small mixer bowl. Spread on 12 English muffin halves. Quarter. Broil about 5 minutes until browned. If not wanting to use right away freeze on flat pan. Store in freezer bags.

title: Pumpkin Fritters
instructions: Beat egg sugar and salt until fluffy. Blend in pumpkin. Sift together the dry ingredients. Fold into egg mixture. Add margarine and mix well. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls into greased frying pan. Turn when golden watching carefully. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Can be served with dinner or as a dessert.

title: Dip For Raw Vegetables
instructions: Will keep in refrigerator a long time.

title: Homemade Mayo(Boiled)
instructions: Mix first 4 items until smooth. Then mix next three items. Bring to full boil. Stir constantly. Cool and refrigerate. Vary sugar and/or vinegar to suit taste.

title: Overnight Caramel French Toast
instructions: Combine sugar butter and syrup in small saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thickened stirring constantly. Pour syrup mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place 6 slices of bread on top of syrup. Top with remaining 6 slices of bread.

title: Creamy Clam Dip
instructions: Gently stir together all ingredients and serve. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Tammy'S Meat Balls
instructions: If you use 2 pound ground meat double your ingredients.

title: Slovak Potato Soup
instructions: Boil 10 medium potatoes (diced). Cover with water to 1/2 of the pot. Boil until soft. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add milk almost to top of pot. Bring to a boil again. Mix about 2 tablespoons flour with a little milk to make a paste. Pour into potato mixture. Bring to a boil to thicken it. Add 1/2 pint sour cream and dill weed cut up fine. Heat through; dont boil. Add 3 tablespoons vinegar.

title: Ham Delight
instructions: Cut package of rolls into upper and lower half. Put bottom half back into pan. Mix margarine poppy seed Worcestershire sauce mustard and onion together.

title: Mindie'S Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix tuna and cream of mushroom. Boil noodles until tender. Mix noodles tuna and soup together. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown around the edges approximately 20 minutes.

title: Irish Potato Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake in layers. Fill with marshmallow filling.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour and baking soda. In another bowl combine butter sugar and vanilla. Beat. Beat in egg. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in M&Ms and nuts. Bake 9 to 11 minutes.

title: Seafood Wild Rice Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder in a 2 1/2-quart bowl. Add rice pepper and shrimp; toss. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Spoon onto lettuce lined dish. Garnish with cherry tomato halves and parsley.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Melt jello with water on low heat. While jello cools tear cake in small pieces. Cut strawberries in fourths.

title: Tomato Casserole
instructions: Put the tomatoes and onion in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Add margarine sugar salt and oregano. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 5 minutes. Add bread and stir. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart lightly greased casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Superb Sausage Dressing
instructions: In large skillet crumble sausage. Cook sausage onion and celery until sausage is no longer pink. Stir in pecans; cook until sausage is lightly brown. Pour mixture into large roasting pan to mix. Add corn mushrooms butter sage and fruit. Stir well until blended. Stir in eggs then mix in the cornbread. Add broth and stir to mix. Beat the eggs and add to mixture. Let set for 15 to 20 minutes to absorb the liquid. If moister dressing is desired add more broth. Bake in same roasting pan or transfer to two 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until crusty brown on top.

title: Chicken Soup With Homemade Noodles
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until tender; shred. Put shredded chicken in pot with chicken broth and water; add celery carrots and onion. Season with garlic salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Make noodles by adding egg oil milk salt and pepper to flour. Mix until not sticky. Roll dough on floured surface to about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into strips. Add to chicken broth. Cook on medium heat for 20 minutes.

title: Amish Lemon Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add flour salt and lemon juice rind and milk. Blend well. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into lemon mixture. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool and top with Cool Whip. Serves 8.

title: Corncake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together into bowl. Mix together eggs milk and oil. Add all at once to dry ingredients and stir just to moisten. Turn into greased 8-inch cake pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Or cook in glass pan in microwave on 50% power for 3 minutes; turn for last 3 minutes (6 minutes total).

title: Broccoli-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on package. Cook soup and milk on medium heat until smooth. Drain broccoli after cooking and put into 1-quart buttered casserole dish. Pour soup mixture on top. Crumble 1/2 package Ritz crackers and put on top of soup. Dot crackers with 1/8 stick margarine. Bake until golden at 375\u00b0 about 45 minutes. Put 1 can French fried onions on top about 5 minutes before taking out of oven.

title: Cranberry Orange Salad
instructions: Squeeze orange. Pare apple. Wash cranberries. In food processor mix apple cranberries and nuts; add orange and pineapple.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Have cured ham and fresh pork ground together. In large bowl to ground meat add crackers and mix. Add eggs and salt; mix. Add milk until mixture will absorb no more. Shape into loaf. Put in roasting pan; pour water around loaf to about 1/2-inch. Cover. Bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Check about halfway through. May need to add water.

title: Grandma Lil'S Pineapple Pudding Cake
instructions: Cook cake according to directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Mix next 3 ingredients together. After cake is cool spread pineapple over the cake then spread the cheese/pudding mixture evenly over the pineapple. Spread Cool Whip over next and scatter chopped nuts over all.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and oats; beat well. Sift flour salt and soda. Blend into first mixture. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts. Dip in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Bake on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Million Dollar Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; add marshmallows. Mix cherries sugar salad dressing and cream cheese. Mix well. Fold in whipped cream. Add nuts and coconut if desired. Chill and serve.

title: Peach-Marshmallow Refrigerator Pudding
instructions: Soak gelatin in water. Soften butter in top of double boiler. Add sugar quartered marshmallows and egg yolks. Take off stove; add gelatin. Cool. Add whipped cream and egg whites (beaten stiff). Pour over peaches. Line pan with vanilla wafer crumbs saving a little for top of filling. Let stand in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Measure flour soda cinnamon salt and sugar. Sift all together. Dice bananas add to dry ingredients with oil eggs vanilla and pineapple with juice. Stir to blend. Do not beat. Bake in greased tube pan one hour and 20 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Large Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes and drain. Mix everything. Pour in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle topping and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0. Will serve at least 12 to 15.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and pat down in 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Mix the next 3 ingredients and spread over cooled crust. Mix the last 3 ingredients; let set until slightly thickened. Pour over cream cheese mixture and refrigerate

title: Cherry Chocolate Upside-Down Cake(Microwave)
instructions: Generously butter 12-cup ring cake dish; sprinkle with sugar to coat. Spread half of pie filling in dish. Mix remaining ingredients (including rest of filling). Beat 3 minutes with mixer. Pour into dish. Cook at Medium 12 minutes rotating every 3 minutes. Increase power to High for 1 to 8 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched and begins to pull away from sides. Let stand 10 minutes. Invert onto serving plate. Let cool completely before slicing. Makes one ring cake.

title: Grandma Jacobs' Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake the cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. In bottom of punch bowl or very large bowl break cake into larger than bite size chunks (use only 1/2 the cake at this point) then layer half of the pineapple and juice half of the pudding half of the bananas 1 can of pie filling half the nuts and half the coconut. Spread with 1 carton of whipped topping. Repeat the above. Garnish with cherries nuts and if you want to be fancy chocolate curls. Serves 25.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend ingredients in large bowl. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Chop nuts in chopper until fine. Mix in batter. Bake in greased and floured tube pan until brown. Cool in pan for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Goo
instructions: Make sure egg whites are beaten. Add other ingredients and fold in Cool Whip. Pour over graham crackers (crushed) or try corn flakes or Grape-Nuts or bran flakes; anything you want for crunchies. Freeze for 24 hours.

title: German Pizza
instructions: In a 12-inch stove top or electric skillet over medium heat brown beef with onion green pepper 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. Remove meat mixture from skillet and drain fat. Reduce heat to low. Melt butter. Spread potatoes over butter and sprinkle with remaining salt. Top with beef mixture.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Remove seeds and seams from peppers; boil 5 minutes. Brown meat and onions. Add rice and tomato juice. Simmer until thick; season. Stuff peppers with meat mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mile High Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Sift together cake flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk beating well after each addition. Add egg whites; beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Pour batter into three waxed paper-lined 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 25 more minutes or until cake tests done. Cook for 10 minutes. Spread Vanilla Filling between layers of cake. Top with Orange Butter Frosting.

title: Texas Hash 2
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion until onion is tender; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix well. Bring to a boil; cover and reduce heat. Simmer 40 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Roast Pork With Sauerkraut
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Rub roast with salt and pepper. Put in large roasting pan; put in oven turning to brown for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove roast; lower oven to 250\u00b0. Scatter sauerkraut around roast. In a bowl mix the apples onion sugar mustard and caraway seed. Sprinkle this mixture over sauerkraut and drizzle wine over top. (Can be refrigerated at this point and roasted later or next day.) Cover and roast at 250\u00b0 for about 4 hours or until tender. Moisten with more wine if it becomes dry. Let rest 10 minutes before slicing. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onion in oleo. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Pasta With Sun Dried Tomatoes And Pine Nuts
instructions: Saute garlic in olive oil. Add herbs. Remove from heat. Add sun dried tomatoes. (Cut tomatoes in 1/8-inch slices.) Toss lightly with cooked pasta. Top with pine nuts. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Party Mix With White Chocolate
instructions: Melt margarine and white chocolate in double boiler. Mix dry ingredients in a big bowl. Add melted white chocolate and mix until coated. Spread on wax paper to harden. Break into pieces.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken pieces on bottom of pan. Cover with soup. Prepare box of Stove Top stuffing according to package directions. Layer over the soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Orange Chiffon Pie
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in pineapple juice; add eggs. Cook in double boiler until thick. Cool. Whip milk until stiff. Add cooled Jell-O mixture; blend. Pour into graham cracker crusts. Chill.

title: Quick Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix well. Serve as is or frozen.

title: Crab And Cheese Wontons
instructions: Mix crab and cheese. Put tablespoonfuls in middle of wonton wrappers. Bring the 4 corners together and seal. Fry in hot oil about 3-inches deep until light brown. Serve hot.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Cover bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan with marshmallows. Prepare cake mix according to directions. Pour over marshmallows. Crush strawberries and mix with dry gelatin. Pour this over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Shortcake
instructions: Mix together rhubarb orange juice sugar and honey. Simmer about 10 minutes until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in strawberries. Cover and chill. To serve spoon fruit mixture over shells and add topping.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread on crackers.

title: Ilse'S Onion Pie
instructions: Put onion and bacon in skillet and cook until glossy. Remove from heat add eggs sour cream and stir. Add salt and caraway seed to taste.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Brown round steak in large skillet in small amount of fat. Drain. Add rest of ingredients and simmer until tender (1 to 2 hours). May need to add a little water and stir occasionally to keep from sticking.

title: Aunt Jeanette'S Rolls
instructions: Combine hot milk salt sugar and shortening. Let cool to room temperature. Dissolve yeast in warm water; add to cooled mixture. Add egg and flour. Mix and set aside to rise 1 time approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes. Shape and let rise 1 hour. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cut when cool. Should be golden brown.

title: Best Ever Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan saute onion in oil over low heat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes. Keeps up to 2 months in refrigerator. Yields 2 1/4 cups.

title: Buttery Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and water in 3-quart saucepan. Cook and stir until sugar dissolves using high heat. When syrup boils blend in butter. Stir frequently. After it reaches a syrup stage (approximately 230\u00b0) reduce heat to medium when temperature reaches soft crack stage. Add nuts. Stir until temperature reaches hard crack stage approximately 305\u00b0. Remove from heat and quickly stir in baking soda. Mix thoroughly. Pour onto 2 cookie sheets with 4 sides. Spread candy evenly over cookie sheets loosen from pan as soon as possible and turn candy over. Break into pieces when cooled.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion together until tender and cooked down. Mash cooked squash and add sour cream soup and salt and pepper. Melt 1 stick of margarine and herb stuffing.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix together beating lightly after each addition the butter sugar eggs flour baking powder and vanilla. Pour into a prepared 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with crumb mixture made by blending together the brown sugar flour butter salt and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add hominy. Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with crushed Fritos. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chips
instructions: *Or 1 cup each chocolate chunks or chips and toasted nuts (pecans walnuts unsalted peanuts or Macadamias).

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine gelatin 1/2 cup of the sugar and salt. Beat together yolks lemon juice and 2/3 cup water. Stir into gelatin mixture. Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and gelatin dissolves. Remove from heat and stir in peel. Chill; stir occasionally until partially set. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add remaining sugar beating until stiff peaks form. Fold in gelatin mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Pile into cooled pastry shell. Chill until firm.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Crumble Fritos and cover bottom of casserole dish. Chop onion; cook in small amount of oil. Add ground beef. Brown and drain. Add other ingredients except cheese. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. When cool add 2/3 cheese. Pour in casserole dish. Use remaining Fritos on top of meat mixture and remaining cheese on Fritos. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together and pour into loaf pan. Bake 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Barbecued Beef Ribs
instructions: Dip ribs in flour and brown. Remove browned ribs from pan. Add the ingredients to the pan. Add ribs. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 220\u00b0 or medium-low heat. Turn once or twice.

title: Ground Meat And Vegetables With Bean Paste Over Noodles
instructions: Heat 5 tablespoons oil in preheated wok. Stir-fry onion until fragrant. Add ground meat; stir-fry until thoroughly cooked. Add bean paste; stir-fry until fragrant. Add water cornstarch sesame oil and sugar. Bring to boil. Cook until thickened. Cook noodles by boiling water adding noodles bring to second boil and cooking over medium heat about 4 minutes. Drain noodles; place in bowls (individual). Top with shredded vegetables and meat topping. Serve hot. Mix well in bowls. Serves 2.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Combine Eagle Brand milk cherry pie filling pineapple and sliced bananas. Mix them together and add nuts if desired. Fold in Cool Whip. Add red food coloring to make a pink color. Chill about 1 hour before serving.

title: White Bread
instructions: Add yeast to warm water and sugar (1 teaspoon). Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Marinated Chicken
instructions: Mix together the ingredients. Marinate the chicken 2 hours or overnight. Drain and broil 4 minutes (each side) or grill until done. Top with Monterey Jack cheese. Melt then top with chopped onion and tomato.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together sugar cocoa and flour in large bowl until no lumps remain. Stir in melted butter. Mix in eggs one at a time until smooth. Stir in milk and vanilla. Pour mixture into pie shell.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Boil carrots until just tender (8 to 9 minutes). Layer onion carrots and green pepper in a large bowl. Heat remaining ingredients to boiling stirring occasionally. Cool slightly. Pour over vegetables. Cover and place in refrigerator for at least 8 hours. They will keep about 1 week.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix together. Bake in an 8 x 8-inch pan in a 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Ham Shanks And Lima Beans
instructions: Pick clean and wash beans. Put in Dutch oven large enough to hold all ingredients.\tPlace remaining ingredients in oven and let simmer for 4 hours adding water as needed.

title: Breakfast Casserole - 4
instructions: Tear bread into pieces and place in 9 x 9-inch baking dish or pan. Brown sausages in a skillet and drain. Place sausage over bread. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Beat eggs milk and seasonings; pour over sausage and cheese mixture. Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cheese will rise to the top. Best if made the night before and refrigerated until baking.

title: Microwave Potatoes
instructions: Put potatoes in casserole dish. Add salt pepper and pats of margarine on top. Cover and microwave on High until potatoes are done. Stir occasionally.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and cornstarch well. Add milk oleo beaten eggs and vanilla and mix well. Pour in pie shell and bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

title: Green Pea Salad
instructions: Combine peas celery lettuce and red onion in bowl. Mix juice from peas with mayonnaise and pour over pea mixture. Top with cheese and bacon bits.

title: Fish Fiesta
instructions: If fish fillets are large cut into 5 or 6 serving pieces. Arrange fish in ungreased square baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with onions and tomato slices. Sprinkle with lime juice oil and parsley. Cover and cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Uncover and cook until fish flakes easily with fork about 15 minutes longer. Garnish with lime wedges if desired. Makes 5 or 6 servings.

title: One-Bowl Trifle Chocolate Oatmeal Jumbles(Makes 2 Dozen Cookies)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place spread in large microwavable bowl. Cover loosely with waxed paper. Microwave on HIGH (100%) for 30 seconds or until melted; cool slightly. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until well blended (dough will be very stiff). Drop dough by level 1/4 measuring cupfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets; flatten slightly. Bake 13 to 17 minutes just until set. (Do not overbake. Centers will be soft.) Let stand on cookie sheets 1 minute. Using wide spatula transfer to wire racks. Cool completely.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain and set aside. Blend soup and cheese. Blend mayonnaise with milk and stir into soup. Place broccoli in baking dish and cover with sauce. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
instructions: Wash cucumbers and cut in sticks. Cover with boiling water and let stand 4 to 5 hours. Then drain and pack into six pint jars.

title: Vanilla Wafer Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in bowl. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add milk alternately with wafer crumbs mixing well. Stir in coconut pecans and vanilla. Pour into prepared tube pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Yields 16 servings.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until lightly browned.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Chop onions. In large pan melt butter and cook onions until golden but not brown. Add enough flour to absorb butter about 4 to 5 tablespoons. Add chicken broth 1 1/2 cans water and wine gradually while stirring well to avoid lumps. Add more water or broth to taste and consistency; salt and pepper. Simmer fifteen minutes until bubbly. Pour in individual serving bowls. Place a slice of fried or toasted crunchy French bread and sprinkle generously with grated Swiss cheese. Broil until brown. Serves 6.

title: Fruit Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and form into ball and roll in coconut.

title: Velvet Almond Fudge Cake
instructions: Chop almonds and toast at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle 1/2 cup on bottom of well-greased tube pan. Set aside almonds and chocolate chips. Measure remaining ingredients into mixing bowl. Blend. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Stir in chocolate chips and almonds. Pour into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pan. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove and finish cooling on rack. Garnish with whipped topping.

title: Grandma'S Lye Soup
instructions: Mix grease lye and 1 quart water the night before and stir hard. In the morning add salt 20 Mule Borax and 1 quart water. Boil 5 minutes then leave on medium heat for 1 hour. Set off the stove to cool. Cut in any size cake desired and dry. Age improves lye soup.

title: Light Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add flour one cup at a time. Beat well after each addition. Add flavorings and mix well. Cut fruit in small pieces and mix with coconut and nuts. Pour batter over fruit and nut mixture and mix well. Bake in tube pan. Start baking at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Then turn down temperature to 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. This cake can be frozen.

title: San Francisco-Style Chicken
instructions: Flour and pan-fry chicken breasts in a small amount of oil until brown. Drain and set aside. Cook rice as directed on package. Dont overcook. Mix chicken soup with 1 soup can of water. Spoon rice into a 10 x 13-inch baking dish. Lay chicken breasts on rice. Add about half the soup on this layer then put broccoli on fillets. Add rest of soup and top with cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes.

title: Easy Filled Coffee Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl dissolve yeast in water. Stir in Bisquick egg and the tablespoon of sugar. Mix well. Turn dough onto surface dusted with extra Bisquick and knead gently 20 times. Place in center of greased 15 1/2 x 12-inch baking sheet. Roll out to 14 x 9-inch rectangle.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Mix well and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes in lightly greased pan/skillet etc.

title: Quick Coffee Ring
instructions: Grease a large Bundt pan (cake pan). Layer frozen rolls in pan. Mix cinnamon with sugar and pour over rolls. Layer one at a time chopped nuts brown sugar and pudding mix. Slice margarine and place around the rolls. Cover pan with cloth and set in warm draft free place overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Invert pan over serving dish and let stand a minute so syrup will cover cake. Decorate with cherries on top if desired. Best served while warm.

title: Easy Beefy Crescent Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large frying pan brown ground beef with onion salt and pepper; drain. Stir in sour cream. Separate crescent dough into 2 large rectangles. Place rectangles in ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Press over bottom and 1/2 inch up sides to form crust. Spoon hot mixture into crust. Top with cheese slices. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes until deep golden brown and crust is no longer doughy. Refrigerate any leftovers. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello. Fold in all ingredients and chill until firm.

title: Hershey Bar Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs milk and margarine together. Bake 3 layers at 350\u00b0 until done. Mix cream cheese granulated sugar and powdered sugar until smooth and creamy. Add 8 ounces Cool Whip. Grate frozen Hershey bars into frosting mixture. Mix well and frost layers.

title: Morgan'S Korean Kal-Bi Ribs(From Morgan'S Restaurant, Bellevue, Wa)
instructions: Run all of the ingredients in\tblender for a minute or two. Combine flavors for 24 hours. Marinate 3 to 5 pounds beef short ribs (or chicken pieces) at least overnight.\tGrill meat or barbecue until brown or\tunder broiler quickly.\t(I use the crock-pot to cook meat then brown on the grill.)

title: Salad Supreme
instructions: Drain pineapple juice and add water to equal 2 cups of liquid. Then dissolve Jell-O by boiling and add the pineapple cream cheese and marshmallows to melt. Cool. When cool add the cream and put in a 13 x 15-inch pan and chill.

title: Coconut Pecan Cake
