instructions: Combine oil brown sugar and sugar; beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Combine flour and the next 4 ingredients beating well. Gradually add buttermilk a little at a time then stir in vanilla 1 cup coconut and 1 cup chopped pecans. Pour batter into two greased 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: Deep Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 2 eggs together. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese eggs and vanilla together and spread over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Quick Potato Bake
instructions: Boil potatoes until done. Slice the potatoes very thin. Place in a 2-quart casserole or a 13 x 9-inch pan. Alternate layers of potatoes grated cheese and soups mixed with milk. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish top with more grated cheese and sprinkle with parsley. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet-Sour Spareribs
instructions: Place spareribs in shallow pan. Cook in slow oven uncovered for 1 hour. Drain off fat. Mix all other ingredients and cook until mixture thickens. Cut ribs in small pieces. Pour sauce over them and cook covered at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Add taco seasoning. Mix well. Layer tortillas meat mixture and cheese in round casserole dish ending with tortillas and cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or for 5 minutes in microwave. Serve with chopped tomato shredded lettuce and sour cream. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Cream Cheese Dip For Fruit
instructions: Blend well. Eat with apple slices pears strawberries etc.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix Crisco eggs and sugar. Mix in buttermilk extract and vanilla. Stir in flour soda and salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes.

title: Chocolate Caramel Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Spread 2 cups of mix on bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Ham Vegetable Chowder
instructions: Heat water broccoli ham carrots celery onion and salt to boiling in 4-quart Dutch oven. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Gradually stir milk into baking mix in small bowl (mixture will be lumpy). Stir into ham mixture. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat; stir in cheese. Cover and let stand until cheese is partially melted (5 minutes). Stir before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Karen'S Bread
instructions: Thaw garlic bread. Open the split halves and place on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. While bread is baking mix shredded Cheddar cheese green onions dill and mayonnaise (do not use Miracle Whip). Mixture will be thick; you can add more mayo if desired. Take bread from oven and spread mixture evenly on top of both sides (will be a nice thick layer). Shake paprika on top. Place in broiler for approximately 3 to 5 minutes until nice and bubbly. Watch it doesnt burn! Cut into slices and enjoy!

title: Chicken Rice Pilaf(Djaj Mah Ruz M'Falfal)
instructions: Cook chicken in the water until tender. Remove from liquid debone and set aside. Save the liquid. Place almonds pine nuts and butter in a saucepan. Turn heat to low. Stir browning the nuts to a golden color. Drain rice and add to the nuts. Stir on low heat for 1 minute. Add chicken pieces broth salt and pepper. Bring to boil on high heat. Lower heat cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve on a platter with a sprinkle of cinnamon on top.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg and molasses mixing well. Combine flour soda cinnamon salt ginger and cloves. Gradually add to creamed mixture blending well. Chill dough at least 1 hour. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes until done. While still hot cut in half lengthwise and scoop out potato leaving skins intact. Mix potato with butter sour cream 1 1/2 cups of the cheese and onions. If necessary thin with more sour cream. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place mixture back in skins. Top with remaining cheese and reheat until cheese melts.

title: Garden Macaroni Salad
instructions: Stir together first 4 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and chill. Makes about 8 cups.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onions peppers and celery in olive oil until browned. Add remaining ingredients. Cook slowly over low heat for 1 hour or until liquid is reduced by half.

title: Layered Banana Pudding
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine the flour and brown sugar. Stir in the milk; cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minute more. Remove from the heat. Gradually stir about 1 cup hot mixture into egg yolks. Return all to the saucepan. Bring to a gentle boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat; stir in butter and vanilla. Cool to room temperature stirring occasionally. Fold in the whipped cream.

title: Chicken Cheese Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and take off bones. Cook noodles in chicken broth. Add some water if necessary. Leave broth on noodles. Do not drain. Cream the margarine and flour. Add milk and cheese (melt cheese in milk). Pour sauce over cut up chicken noodles onion and pepper. Cook at 350\u00b0 until bubbles in middle. Will serve 20 people.

title: Southern Spoon Bread
instructions: Stir the cornmeal into the boiling water with the salt and sugar. Stir 1 minute. Remove from fire. Add butter. Beat well and add eggs. Beat well. Add milk beating again. Pour into greased 8 or 9-inch baking pan (Pyrex). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Delicious!

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine flour sugar baking powder salt and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Melt butter. Combine butter and milk to the rest of ingredients and mix well. Pour into dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Grannie'S Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven at 400\u00b0. Beat egg; stir in milk and oil. Add rest of ingredients. (Batter will be lumpy.) Fill 12 muffin cups about 3/4 full. Bake until golden brown about 20 minutes.

title: Light Summer Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in salt (no oil or shortening). Drain on paper towel. Spray casserole with Pam. Layer zucchini slices (unpeeled) 1/2 of meat onion slices tomato chunks and croutons. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Applesauce Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cake mix (save marbling pieces) applesauce water oil and eggs together. Pour 1 1/2 cups\tof batter into smaller bowl; add marbling package and beat. Pour yellow batter into pan. Put mounds of chocolate mixture on top and marble. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 33 to 38 minutes. Cool completely.\tServe with Cool Whip or applesauce.

title: Lemon Angel Food Cake
instructions: Mix dry cake mix pie filling and lemon juice and beat well. Pour in a jelly roll pan. Do not spray pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. When cool frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Season meat and coat sides with flour. Brown in oil. Add liquid from tomatoes plus 1 3/4 cups water to it. Add cut-up onions and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Cut green peppers into strips and add to meat. Simmer for 15 minutes. Add whole tomatoes to gravy and simmer 15 minutes more. No extra seasoning is needed for gravy. Serve over rice.

title: Very Ritzy Chicken(Great Company Dish)
instructions: Dip chicken breasts into beaten eggs; coat with bread crumbs. Heat oil in a frying pan on medium heat. Add coated chicken and brown lightly on both sides. Remove from pan and place in a baking dish topping each breast with a slice of Mozzarella cheese. Mix together remaining ingredients in a saucepan and cook until mixture gets hot and thickens. Pour over chicken and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Serve over angel hair pasta.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ham. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly on one side of each ham slice. Roll up and secure with wooden pick. Cover and chill. Carefully slice each roll into 1/2-inch pieces. Serve with toothpicks. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash mushrooms. Remove stems and mince finely. Mix egg yolk with cream cheese. Add onion and minced stems. Stuff mushroom caps with mixture. Place on cookie sheet and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 10 minutes. (May be made ahead of time.)

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix and pour all ingredients into pie shell. Bake 5 minutes at 425 degrees. Reduce heat to 325 degrees and bake until pie doesnt shake.

title: Christmas Jelly Roll
instructions: Mix batter as directed on box of cake mix. Pour batter into 2 jelly roll pans (11 x 15-inch) and bake for 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes. Invert on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll up and let cool. After cooling unroll and spread sherbet on cakes (about 1 pint per cake either use all one flavor or half of each). Dont spread too thick to roll. Roll up wrap in foil and freeze. Slice just before serving.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix the margarine flour and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar together (first 3 ingredients). Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pecan-Butterscotch Coffee Cake
instructions: The night before partially defrost dough. Place nuts evenly in bottom of greased Bundt pan. Place rolls on top of nuts. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over rolls mixed with cinnamon. Combine margarine and brown sugar and heat to a simmer. Pour over dough. Let rise overnight. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn upside down on serving dish. Let cool.

title: Aunt Vollie Pound Cake
instructions: Put all together and beat for 12 minutes. Pour into greased tube pan and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Jello Pie
instructions: Put one large and 1 small jello in bowl and 2 cups of steaming hot water. Add strawberries. Let it jell and put on top of mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix peanut butter and powdered sugar until well blended. Add melted butter; mix well. Put in refrigerator and chill. Roll in balls. Melt chocolate chips and wax in double boiler; dip balls into chocolate mixture with toothpick. Put on waxed paper or buttered pan. Keep balls in a cool place.

title: Jello Delight
instructions: Layer crushed pretzels in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle sugar and butter over pretzels and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool completely. Blend cream cheese Cool Whip and sugar. Layer over pretzels and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Dissolve Jell-O in water then add strawberries. Layer onto Cool Whip and cream cheese then refrigerate.

title: Sour Cream Rolls
instructions: Heat sour cream. Add sugar melted margarine and salt and stir to dissolve. Cool to lukewarm. In a large warm bowl add 1/2 cup warm water and sprinkle yeast into water. When dissolved add sour cream mixture then eggs and stir in flour. Put batter in refrigerator overnight. Divide into 4 parts. Roll each section into round circle on floured surface. Cut into pie shaped wedges. Roll into crescent rolls. Put on greased baking sheet and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Oven Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Melt 1/3 cup oleo and add 2 tablespoons liquid smoke. Dip chicken pieces in this (coating well). Place chicken in casserole dish and bake at 320\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook ground chuck in medium skillet over medium heat until browned. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Wipe skillet with paper towel. Return meat to skillet and stir in tomatoes water garlic and Italian herb seasonings. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes. Cook noodles according to package directions omitting salt and fat. Drain well and set aside. Cook spinach according to package directions omitting salt and fat. Drain well and squeeze excess moisture from spinach. Combine spinach and next 4 ingredients. Stir until well combined. Set aside. Place half of cooked noodles in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Top each half each of cottage cheese mixture and American cheese. Spread half of meat mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chocolate Fudge Frosting
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter (I use microwave). Combine powdered sugar milk and vanilla. Pour hot chocolate mixture over and beat until spreading consistency. If more liquid is needed use a few drops of hot water. Makes enough frosting for 10 x 14-inch pan or 2 layers.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mix up whatever amount you need and pour the dressing over according to your own taste.

title: Sidewalk Chalk
instructions: Combine paint and water in a container. Slowly stir in the plaster of Paris. Pour into waxed paper cups plastic cups (grease with vegetable oil) or candle molds. Remove chalk when hard (about 3 hours) then allow it to dry for 4 days.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place cooked and drained broccoli in baking dish. Mix in chestnuts. Add cheese to top of mixture. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons melted butter over mixture. Mix crumbs with remaining butter and sprinkle on top. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in Bundt pan for 38 to 40 minutes.

title: Easter Eggs
instructions: Mix sugar butter and cream cheese together. Add your choice of listed fruits. Shape into eggs. Let dry for a while. Dip into dipping chocolate or roll in chopped nuts.

title: Delicious Apple Cobbler
instructions: To form dough mix together flour Crisco and milk. Spread out on floured surface and roll out. Sprinkle dough with sliced apples cinnamon to taste and apple pie spice. Roll dough with apples inside to form a jelly roll effect. Slice up dough and lay sideways in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Easter Ham Pie
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and let stand. Make dough by combining flour 2 eggs and water. Roll out and place in a 9-inch pie pan. Fill with ham mixture and top with crust. Beat 1 egg and brush on top of pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cover chicken in water that just barely covers the chicken. Add onion salt pepper garlic oregano green pepper Italian seasoning and parsley flakes. Cook until chicken is tender (save broth).

title: Northern Michigan Salad
instructions: Use as many of the ingredients as desired for the salad. Mix as you would any other salad.

title: Spiced Iced Coffee
instructions: Add spices to coffee. Boil 5 minutes; strain. Add sugar and chill. Serve in glasses containing little cracked ice and top with cream. Dust with additional cinnamon.

title: Mrs. Law'S Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and Crisco then add sugar eggs milk and vanilla. Then add all dry ingredients and mix well. Bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes at 325\u00b0 in 10-inch tube pan.

title: Tomato Salad
instructions: A large platter works better than a bowl. This way you can display each ingredient and the presentation is excellent. Remove core of lettuce and break in 3-inch pieces and place on bottom of platter.

title: White Christmas Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar sour cream milk butter corn syrup and salt in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture reaches a boil. Boil over moderate heat 9 to 10 minutes to 238\u00b0 soft-ball stage. Remove from heat and allow to stand until lukewarm (110\u00b0) about an hour. Add vanilla and beat until mixture just begins to lose its gloss and hold its shape. Quickly stir in walnuts and turn into oiled pan. Let stand until firm before cutting. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello as directed (1/4 cup less water). Add sugar and cool. Then add apples bananas and pineapple. Let set up in refrigerator. Boil 1/2 cup pineapple juice 1/4 cup sugar flour and beaten egg stirring all the time. Let mixture get cold. Prepare Dream Whip; fold into cold mixture and spread over jello. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Artichoke Puffs
instructions: Cut artichokes and swiss cheese into fourths. Combine mayo and parmesan cheese. Add other ingredients. Place one piece artichoke on bread. Spread mixture over artichoke and top with swiss cheese. Put under broiler until hot and cheese melts.

title: Slow Ball Dip
instructions: Cut a round circle in the bread and hollow out. Set aside. In a large bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Stir in the clams clam juice onion beer Worcestershire sauce lemon juice red hot sauce salt and pepper until well blended. With 2 sheets of aluminum foil large enough to cover loaf fill loaf with cream cheese mixture and seal tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Yule Delights
instructions: Cream margarine and cheese together then add other ingredients and mix well. Roll into long rolls and refrigerate several hours. Slice into thin rounds and place on slightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until edges brown. May be frozen and baked later.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix eggs and oil. Combine buttermilk and soda. Add this to eggs and oil. Stir in flour cornmeal and salt. Add corn onion peppers and cheese. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Herbed Pasta-Tuna Bake
instructions: In greased 2-quart baking dish toss shells tuna and celery. In blender mix mayonnaise milk parsley and green onions until smooth. Pour over tuna mixture; toss to coat. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven 15 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Chop cranberries apples (cored and peeled) and oranges (peeled) in food processor. Prepare jello according to package directions. Combine all ingredients; let set. (Will take about 18 hours to jell.)

title: Vickie'S Lettuce Salad
instructions: In a large bowl break up lettuce cauliflower and bacon. In a small bowl mix the mayonnaise cheese and sugar. Add the dressing to the lettuce mixture and mix well.

title: Hidden Valley Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine oil with Hidden Valley dressing mix and other spices. Pour over crackers. Stir well. Heat in warm oven 15 to 20 minutes stirring once or twice. Cool on paper towels. Store in Tupperware.

title: Thai Cucumber Salad
instructions: Put cucumbers onions and chili peppers in salad bowl. Stir together ingredients and pour over vegetables in bowl. Store in refrigerator until ready to eat.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix pumpkin eggs oil and water. Set aside. Mix flour sugar pumpkin spice soda salt nuts nutmeg and cinnamon. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients slowly. Mix well. Place into greased and floured loaf pans (2). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Cook cake as directed on box. After cake is cool tear cake into pieces then layer all ingredients in a large bowl and top with Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Grease large glass bowl or casserole dish. In large bowl mix all ingredients. Do not drain whole kernel corn. Use the water in can. Pour mixture into glass bowl or casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes until golden brown on top uncovered. Very good. Very easy.

title: Dependable Divinity
instructions: Mix water and sugar. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes. Place marshmallow cream in bowl and pour hot syrup into cream. Beat until the mixture loses its gloss. Add nuts vanilla and salt. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Beefy-Tortilla Pie
instructions: Coat bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate with vegetable cooking spray and line with tortillas. Set aside. Cook ground chuck in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until browned stirring to crumble. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Combine meat chilies onion and cheese. Stir well. Spoon mixture into prepared dish.

title: Chocolate Chip Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Coat bottom and sides of an 8-inch pie plate lightly with butter.

title: Quickie 8 Can Soup
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain. Add remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly.

title: Quick Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: In large pan (Dutch oven pot) mix all the can contents together along with chicken and spices. Bring to boil stirring frequently. When its good and hot turn off burner and add chips standing them up all over the pot. Do not stir. Then sprinkle cheese on top. You can put in oven 15 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0 but this is optional.

title: White Bread
instructions: Mix water yeast and sugar together. Add shortening flour and salt. Mix well for about 5 minutes if using a mixer or knead by hand for 5 minutes.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Chop tomatoes onions and peppers very fine. Then add sugar salt and vinegar. Add spices tied in a cheesecloth bag. Cook slowly uncovered for 2 hours until thick. Remove spice bag. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal. Makes 4 pints.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar and flour. Add egg yolk then gradually add milk and stir. Add lemon flavoring and coconut. Cook over medium heat until thick. Stir slowly while cooking. Pour in baked pie crust and add meringue. Sprinkle with coconut and brown in oven.

title: Sour Cream And Dill Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in single layer in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine soup soup mix sour cream lemon juice dill and mushrooms; pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Red Cabbage With Apples(160 Calories)
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-heat in hot oil toss sliced cabbage until well coated and slightly wilted. Add apple wine sugar salt and pepper. Over high heat heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes tossing occasionally until tender-crisp. Yields 4 servings.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables as directed on package and place in greased casserole. Mix onion celery cheese and mayonnaise and spread over vegetables. Melt butter then put in crumbled crackers; sprinkle over casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Classic Jalapeno Dip
instructions: In food processor mince artichoke hearts also jalapeno peppers. Combine all ingredients in ovenproof bowl; mix then smooth top of mixture. Bake uncovered until edges are brown at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with blue corn chips.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add coloring cocoa and vanilla. Beat well; add sifted flour salt and baking powder. Alternate flour mixture with buttermilk. Put soda in vinegar and sprinkle over batter; fold in until well blended (dont beat). Bake in three 8 inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Seasoned Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Pour over crackers stirring to mix. Place on baking sheet and bake at 275\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice according to directions. Thoroughly combine all ingredients together and put into 2 pans that are 12 x 20 x 2-inches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes about 50 servings.

title: Red Velvet Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each one. Mix flour salt and baking powder together. Add flour and milk alternately beginning and ending with flour. Add coloring with milk. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in milk. Add other ingredients and stir well. Pour in a pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in a deep dish baking dish. Put blackberries in a saucepan with 1/2 cup sugar. Heat until hot. Combine 1 cup sugar Bisquick and milk. Pour in baking dish over melted margarine. Do not stir. Add blackberries. Do not stir. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Whiskey Pralines
instructions: Cook sugar and milk over medium heat for approximately 10 minutes. Do not stir. Add butter whiskey and pecans. Whip until mixture hardens. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls into hot oil until brown. Turn over and brown on other side. Sprinkle powdered sugar over them and serve.

title: Cheese And Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potatoes onion and water in heavy saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender about 20 minutes. In heavy skillet melt butter; add flour. Cook and stir until thickened. Stir mixture slowly into potatoes; cook and stir until thick. Add cheese and seasonings. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Black Bean And Pasta Soup
instructions: Heat oil in 4-quart pot. Add onion and garlic. Stir until onion softens. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Add pasta. Reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered 8 to 10 minutes until pasta is tender. Remove from heat. Stir in vinegar. If desired garnish with pepper strips. Good accompanied with corn bread.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Pour boiling water over rice and let set for 3 minutes. Combine all ingredients well and pour into 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 (or until sides are brown and top begins to brown).

title: Milky Snacks
instructions: Put bananas eggs and honey in a blender and blend until smooth. Add orange juice milk and cinnamon and blend again. Pour into tall glasses and serve.

title: Jalapeno Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook rice. Saute onion celery and pepper. Mix all together. Put cheese on top. Put jalapeno to taste. Put in hot oven until cheese melts.

title: Chewy Peanut Butter Strips
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and cut into strips.

title: Brown Sugar Icing
instructions: Combine sugar and water. Boil to soft ball stage (236\u00b0); pour slowly beating constantly onto egg whites. Add flavoring. Continue beating until icing holds its shape when dropped from spoon.

title: Lamb And Potato Korma
instructions: Wash and remove excess fat from meat set aside. In a pressure cooker or pot add oil and warm over medium-high heat. Add cardamom cloves cinnamon and zeera. When it sputters add the meat onion ginger/garlic cayenne salt and turmeric. Brown the meat. Cover and cook for 15 minutes in pressure cooker or 1 hour in a regular pot. The meat should not be fully done at this point.

title: Ambrosia Pie
instructions: Combine coconut and margarine. Reserving 2 tablespoons coconut mixture press remainder firmly on bottom and up side to rim of 9-inch pie plate; chill. In large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk ReaLemon fruit cocktail almonds and cherries; mix well. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared crust. Garnish with reserved coconut and additional fruit if desired. Chill 4 hours or until set. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and saute with onions. Add both sauces and mix well. Boil noodles until done. Drain and rinse well.

title: Venison Chili
instructions: Brown meat in skillet; drain and add rest of ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes in the skillet or cook in crock-pot for 1 hour.

title: Turkey Spaghetti
instructions: Mix and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pralines
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bring to soft ball stage (238\u00b0 to 240\u00b0). Remove from heat and stir until mixture cools and thickens. Spoon out on buttered wax paper aluminum foil or parchment paper.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars shortening peanut butter and egg. Stir in flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Cover; refrigerate for 3 hours. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough into 1 1/4-inch balls. Place about 3 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten in a crisscross pattern with a fork dipped in flour. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Oriental Surprise Salad
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in large bowl and toss well. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Add cashews and noodles; toss again. Serve on lettuce. Serves 6.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Combine milk cream salt and pepper in a large heavy kettle. Heat over medium heat until milk is scalded.

title: Ashley'S Crispy Chocolate Bars
instructions: Combine chocolate and butterscotch morsels with peanut butter in large saucepan. Stir over low heat until smooth. Add corn flakes and stir until well coated. Spread mixture into 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm. Let stand at room temperature about 10 minutes then cut into bars.

title: Ezy Bars
instructions: Put melted butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs chocolate chips coconut and nuts. Pour sweetened condensed milk over the top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Swiss Apple Pie
instructions: Mix egg sugar flour baking powder vanilla and salt. Add chopped apples and walnuts. Place in an 8-inch square baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Cook syrup butter and sugar for 5 minutes. Add vanilla and baking soda. Stir well. Pour over popcorn and mix well. Put in 2 baking pans and bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts and remove from bone. Place in casserole dish and pour mushrooms over chicken. Mix cream of chicken soup with sour cream. Spread over chicken. Melt margarine and mix with Ritz crackers and poppy seed. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until knife blade comes out clean. Ovens vary so you may want to lessen the heat.

title: Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Sprinkle ribs with garlic salt. Make sauce with remaining ingredients and pour over ribs. Bake in deep pan at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: 24 Hour Slaw
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in large bowl. Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in casserole baking dish.

title: Split Pea Soup(With Rye Croutons)
instructions: In a dutch oven or large pot heat oil over medium heat. Add carrots onion potato sweet potato and garlic. Cook stirring until softened about 3 minutes. Add broth and split peas. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer partially covered until vegetables are tender and peas have broken down about 40 minutes. Season with pepper. Meanwhile in a small skillet cook bacon until crisp 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate lined with a paper towel. Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with bacon and croutons.

title: Green Peas And Onions
instructions: Slice large ripe tomatoes in 1/2-inch rounds or wedges and place in a large flat pan or dish one layer deep. Sprinkle generously with salt coarsely ground pepper and crumbled oregano. Carefully pour oil so that tomatoes are just covered. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve. Allow at least 1 hour to marinate.

title: Crock-Pot Baked Beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low heat setting for 4 to 6 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare stuffing as directed on box. Boil chicken for 30 minutes. Dice chicken. Put in bottom of casserole dish. Pour soup over chicken. Top with prepared stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Ooie Gooie Bars
instructions: Slice one pack of cookies and flatten in 9 x 11-inch glass dish. Mix cream cheese sugar and eggs. Spread over cookie dough. Layer second roll sliced cookies on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients together. Add vanilla then peanuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper lined cookie sheets. Chill.

title: Chicken - Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Fix stuffing according to directions. Mix milk soup and chicken. Cook for 5 minutes. Place 1/2 stuffing in bottom of pan. Pour soup and chicken over stuffing and place remaining stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Separate egg yolks and whites. Put egg whites in separate bowl; beat well for several minutes. Add 1/4 to 1/2 cup sugar. Mix the Eagle Brand lemon juice 3 tablespoons sugar and egg yolks well; pour into pie crust. Pour meringue over pie mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until meringue is brown. Chill and serve.

title: Haystack Eggs
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter 8 or 9-inch glass pie plate or round baking dish. Spread shoestring potatoes evenly over bottom of pan. Makes 4 indentations into potatoes down to bottom of dish each about 1 1/2-inches across. Carefully break 1 egg into each indentation. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 10 minutes; add cheese and parsley. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts and eggs are set. Cut into 4 wedges and serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and cornstarch. Add egg yolks beating thoroughly. Add milk gradually while mixing. Cook mixture in a double boiler until it thickens stirring constantly. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into a baked pie shell. Top with meringue. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Moist Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat until smooth. Mash the bananas; add to sugar and butter. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add gradually to banana mixture. Add chopped nuts. Fold in well beaten eggs. Pour into an 8 or 9 x 4 x 2-inch greased and floured loaf pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Cheesy Enchiladas
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add seasoning water and beans; mix well. May need to add a little more water. Fry tortillas a few seconds on each side in hot oil. Divide meat mixture on tortillas and roll up. Place seam down in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together 2 cans soup; spread over enchiladas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Cheese 1
instructions: Cook macaroni by directions on box and drain. Add margarine to cooked macaroni. Beat eggs and milk together. Pour egg and milk mixture over cooked macaroni. Sprinkle grated cheese over macaroni and stir it into the egg and milk mixture saving some to sprinkle on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until mixture is firm.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients into large kettle and cook until tender. Season with oregano garlic powder salt and pepper.

title: Impossible French Apple Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie pan. Mix apples and spices; turn into pan. Beat remaining ingredients except Streusel until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into pan. Sprinkle with Streusel. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Slowly add the crumbled cream cheese to the sugar and mayonnaise. Add crushed pineapple and the cherries. Whip heavy cream and fold into the mixture. Freeze in trays or in 8 x 8-inch pan. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce. Serves 6.

title: Lasagne(Authentic Italian Recipe)
instructions: Chop onion garlic and parsley fine; fry slightly in hot oil. Add tomatoes tomato paste bay leaf salt pepper and water; stir until well mixed. Toss in hamburger and sausage. Break up meat with fork in little pieces. Now cover the tomato sauce and cook on low for 45 minutes stir occasionally.

title: Seafood Lasagne
instructions: Peel off the shells from the shrimp starting at head end so tail can be nipped off easily. Make a shallow cut along the back of each shrimp and remove the dark intestinal vein. If the shrimp are large cut them lengthwise in half. If necessary remove and discard the tough muscle at the side of each scallop. Rinse scallops with cold water; drain and pat dry with paper towels. Cut large scallops crosswise in half. Rinse the sole fillets with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut (slicing across fillets) into several pieces. Refrigerate until ready to use. Peel the shallots and separate into sections if necessary. Slice horizontally toward the root leaving the slices attached at the root. Slice vertically again leaving the root end uncut then cut across the shallot to make fine dice. Heat butter in a medium saucepan. Add the chopped shallots and saute stirring until soft but not brown 1 to 2 minutes. Add the shrimp and scallops and season with salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat until shrimp turn pink and scallops become opaque 2 to 3 minutes. Add the white wine and bring just to a boil. Remove the pan from the heat. Lift out shrimp and scallops and reserve them. Set the cooking liquid aside.

title: One Pan Supper
instructions: Fry in shortening or bacon grease until potatoes start to brown. Cut up into thin slices a Polish sausage. Add to ingredients in pan. Cover and let cook until potatoes are golden brown.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Defrost the bread dough until soft enough to pull off and roll into small balls. Arrange approximately 48 small balls in a 9 x 12-inch greased pan.

title: Sweet Cherry Soda
instructions: In a blender container combine cherry sauce and ice cream. Cover and process until smooth. Pour half of mixture into each of 2 tall glasses. Fill glasses with club soda. Garnish each serving with a whole cherry.

title: Swiss Corn Chowder
instructions: Add potatoes carrots celery onion salt and pepper to boiling water. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes. Do not drain. Make a white sauce with margarine flour and milk. Add cheese stirring until melted. Add corn and undrained vegetables. Heat; do not boil. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Diet Pickles
instructions: Wash and cut cucumbers into slices about 1/4-inch thick. Mix cucumbers and salt. Let stand overnight. In the morning drain and press out all the juice possible. Rinse once in cold water. Combine vinegar sugar substitute and spices. Boil 1 minute. Add cucumbers and simmer 5 minutes. Pack cucumbers into clean hot sterile jars to within 1-inch of top. Fill jars with hot liquid to top. Seal tightly. Makes about 12 pints. Cucumber Slices 46 calories per pint.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients together first then fold in 9 ounces Cool Whip. Put in graham cracker crust.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour hot water over oats and let stand. Cream white and brown sugars and oil. Beat eggs into creamed mixture. Add flour cinnamon and salt into oats; beat well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Dont use mixer. Sprinkle coconut on top of cake before baking.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter sour cream and sugar until light and fluffy. Sift plain flour and baking soda together. Add flour to mixture alternating with the eggs. Add flavor and bake in Bundt or tube cake pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Rye Bread Dip
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sour cream parsley onion flakes and dill in a bowl. Cut dried beef into small pieces and fold into mixture. Cut rye bread into chunks. Dip the bread!

title: 7 Layer Bars
instructions: Melt butter and mix with cracker crumbs. Press crumb mixture into 9-inch square baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Layer coconut chocolate chips butterscotch chips and nuts. Pour condensed milk evenly over mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into 1 1/2 inch squares. Cool.

title: Sour Cream And Chive Mayonnaise
instructions: Combine egg salt and vinegar in bowl of food processor fitted with steel blade. Pulse just to blend. With processor running very slowly add the oil until the mixture emulsifies (or thickens). Add sour cream and chives. Pulse again just to blend.

title: Hanky Pankies
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage together and drain well. Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce. Melt in Velveeta cheese. Spoon mixture onto slices of party rye bread. Broil for a few minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Mayonnaise Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently for 30 seconds. Roll out dough about 1/2-inch thick. Use biscuit cutter to cut out rolls. Place rolls into lightly greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. May also be cooked in muffin pan or floured and spooned into pan.

title: Barley With Monterey Jack One Dish Dinner
instructions: In a large saucepan cook barley in 3 tablespoons butter stirring for 2 minutes. Add 4 cups water and salt. Bring liquid to boil and simmer covered for 45 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Let cool. Mix tomatoes half and half scallions olives mushrooms and chili peppers 3/4 of the cheese salt and pepper in a bowl. Combine well and transfer to a baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Mash cheese. Add well drained clams. Moisten with clam juice to proper consistency. Add lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. For color add chopped parsley. Serve cold with crackers or potato chips.

title: Quick-Haluski With Cabbage And Low-Fat Cottage Cheese
instructions: Chop cabbage; boil until tender. Boil shells as per directions on box and drain. Melt oleo; drain cabbage and add to oleo. Combine shells with cabbage then add 1 carton of low-fat cottage cheese. May be topped with dry or chopped fresh dill.

title: Fruit Slush
instructions: Combine sugar and water in saucepan. Bring to a quick boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Cool syrup. Mix fruit and juice into syrup and freeze at least 3 hours. Before serving remove from freezer and thaw to slushy consistency. (This can be made several days ahead of serving and frozen but can take up to 8 hours to thaw.)

title: Fluffy Fruit Dressing
instructions: Blend marshmallow cream and orange juice with rotary beater. Stir in salad dressing and vanilla. Makes 1 1/2 cups. For fruit salads.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Sprinkle coconut and pecans on bottom of pan. Make cake mix according to package. Pour over coconut and pecans.

title: Spicy Tea Mix
instructions: Mix together. Store in tight container. For 1 serving place 1 well rounded teaspoonful in a cup of boiling water. For 1 quart dissolve 1/3 cup mix in 1 quart of boiling water.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Bake
instructions: Place chicken and broccoli in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt. Combine remaining ingredients and spread over chicken and broccoli. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Vermont Maple Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt oleo and blend in flour until stiff mixture. Beat eggs and white sugar until fluffy. Add oleo-flour mixture and beat again. Blend in white Karo and maple syrup and water. Add to egg mixture along with chopped pecans. Save a few half pecans to garnish top of pie. Bake in uncooked pie shell about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Let stand for 5 minutes. Add flour salt and pepper to the yeast sugar oil and warm water. Mix well. Knead 5 minutes. Let rise 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: In top of double boiler melt morsels over boiling water. Stir in sweetened condensed milk. Remove from heat. Stir in cereal and peanuts. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper lined baking sheets. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Store at room temperature in loosely covered container. Makes about 2 pounds or 48 candies.

title: Colorful Punch
instructions: Mix liquids together. When ready to serve add sherbet. Serves 50.

title: Wine Cookies
instructions: Blend sugar wine and oil well. Add flour gradually stirring until a wet but not sticky dough is formed. Take small pieces and form into rings. Dip one side into sugar. Bake sugar side up on cookie sheet for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Heath Candy Cake
instructions: Bake German chocolate cake according to directions on box in 9 x 13-inch pan. Poke holes in cake using the handle of a wooden spoon. Make lots of holes but dont overlap. While cake is still warm pour Eagle Brand milk over cake. Then pour caramel topping over cake. Let set in the refrigerator to cool. Crush 3 Heath bars; sprinkle over top. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle 3 more crushed Heath bars over Cool Whip.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except soup and milk. Place in baking dish and form a loaf. Mix soup and 1/2 can milk. Pour over meat loaf and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Is very good with potatoes placed around meat and some of the soup mixture poured over them also.

title: Nutty Oatmeal-Chocolate Chunk Cookies
instructions: Process oats in a blender or food processor until ground. Beat butter and sugars at medium speed with an electric mixer until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat until blended.\tCombine ground oats flour and next 3 ingredients. Add to butter mixture beating until blended. Stir in chocolate and pecans. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7-8 minutes or until golden brown; remove to wire racks to cool. Yield 6 dozen.

title: Lemonade Pies
instructions: Stir lemonade and milk in large bowl until well blended. Add food coloring to suit your taste. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip until well blended. Pour into graham cracker pie crusts. Chill for several hours or overnight.

title: Chocolate Chip Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix well flour sugar soda cocoa cinnamon nutmeg allspice cloves and salt. Add shortening applesauce eggs 1/2 cup nuts 1/2 cup chocolate chips and raisins. Beat until smooth; pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on top brown sugar nuts and chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fruit Pizza(Makes 2 Pizzas)
instructions: Bake cookie dough 8 to 10 minutes. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on cookie dough while still warm. Add fresh fruit.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries; add sugar. (Let set for 1 hour.) Add marshmallows to Cool Whip. (Let set for 1 hour.) Drain pineapple. Mix all together. Put in glass bowl.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Spread the 2 packages of crescent rolls on a large baking sheet to make crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip horseradish and pepper. Spread on cooled crust. Top with vegetables and sprinkle with grated cheese. Keeps well. It can be made a day ahead of time. (Doesnt take many veggies.)

title: Never Fail Rolls
instructions: Mix shortening sugar salt and hot water with electric mixer. When this mixture has cooled to lukewarm add yeast which has been dissolved in 1 cup lukewarm water. Add eggs mix well. Sift flour slowly into mixture beat well. Cover place in refrigerator until chilled. Shape into rolls and let rise in warm place for 2 hours. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until brown. Brush with butter if desired. Makes 36 rolls.

title: Stay-In-Bed Stew
instructions: Combine in crock-pot. Cook all day on low or in oven at 250\u00b0 for 5 hours.

title: Breakfast Bake
instructions: Butter bread and place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Top with bacon (can substitute sausage or a vegetable) and cheese. Mix eggs milk salt and mustard. Pour into dish. Cover and let set in refrigerator overnight. In the morning mix cornflakes and melted butter. Pour on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Muffins
instructions: Combine 1 cup sugar and margarine; cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour with milk and vanilla to creamed mixture beating well.

title: Cherry Sauce For Ham
instructions: Drain cherries. Combine juice wine and cornstarch. Add lemon juice salt and allspice. Cook and stir until clear and slightly thickened. Add butter and cherries. Serve warm with baked ham.

title: Queen Anne Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time then flour and baking powder. Have cookie sheets greased and floured lightly. Spread the mixture very thin with spatula. Sprinkle with chopped nuts (pecans peanuts or almonds) then with sugar. Bake in a moderate oven at about 400\u00b0 until a delicate brown. Cut into squares; remove from baking sheet immediately. Makes about 80 (2-inch) cookies. Store in airtight tins.

title: Todd'S Favorite Pancakes
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Combine egg milk and salad oil. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Bake on hot griddle. Makes about 12 dollar size or 8 (4-inch) pancakes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels butter and 2 tablespoons of sugar; put in baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Let cool. Mix cream cheese and 1 cup of sugar with mixer. Stir in Cool Whip. Spread on top of pretzels. Mix jello water and strawberries and let partially jell then pour over Cool Whip mixture and let chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: My Mother'S Cornstarch Pudding
instructions: Line sides and bottom of serving bowl with sponge cake. Warm milk. In a small mixing bowl mix together the cornstarch sugar egg and vanilla; mix until creamy. Pour into warm milk; stir to boiling. Pour over prepared layer; sprinkle shredded dark baking chocolate on top. Allow to cool at room temperature then put in refrigerator.

title: Texas Company Eggs Sunday Rest Meal
instructions: Whip eggs and milk. Scramble until they just hold their shape soft and a little runny. Spread eggs in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. While hot spread with sour cream. Top with cheese and bacon. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until done. Peel and cool. Cut lengthwise. Put in 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix all other ingredients until melted. Pour over potatoes. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Drop Biscuits
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Add eggs and cream. Stir to mix (dough should be lumpy and soft). Drop from tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) for 15 minutes. Makes 12 large biscuits.

title: Chicken Broccoli Alfredo
instructions: Slice chicken into chunks and fry in tbsp of butter with garlic pepper seasoning salt and cook thoroughly. Set aside with 3 cups cooked broccoli well strained cook 1 pound of your favorite pasta. * Sauce = melt one stick butter on medium heat then add cream cheese and melt. With wire whisk slowly stir in milk and then add parmesan cheese and pepper. Heat till well blended then combine chicken broccoli pasta and sauce. Yummy!

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Mix ingredients together and cook over medium heat for about 30 minutes or until beets are softened.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix everything together. Chill in refrigerator before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Fingers
instructions: Cream together the first 4 ingredients. Blend in the remaining ingredients. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Beef Bourguignonne
instructions: In large fry pan brown meat in butter. Add mushrooms and onion; continue browning until tender. Add remaining ingredients except wine. Simmer stirring frequently until sauce thickens. Add red wine; continue simmering for 15 to 20 minutes until meat is tender. Serve over buttered noodles or rice.

title: Shirley'S Open Candied Yams
instructions: Parboil yams and then peel. Cut in thick slices. Place in baking dish. Mix all dry ingredients. Cover yams with mixture. Dot with margarine. Put lemon juice over yams. Pour water in. Cut 1/2 orange in slices. Place on yams. Other 1/2 of orange squeeze over yams. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until yams are tender. Syrup is thick baste after. Yields 6 servings. Eat with love from the kitchen of Shirley Murden.

title: Blueberry-Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Blend cream cheese sugar and vanilla well. Whip cream. Fold cream into cheese mixture and pour into pie shell. Spread blueberry filling over top and chill.

title: Easy Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine pie filling mix and sugar. Gradually blend in lemon juice and water until smooth. Stir in egg yolks. Bring to a full boil over medium heat. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Add lemon peel and pour into baked pie shell. Top with Meringue sealing well at edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool 2 hours before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Blend flour sugar soda and salt. Add to mixture oil eggs and buttermilk and mix well. Add raisin bran. Cover tightly. Bake as needed at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Big Soft Ginger Cookies
instructions: Combine flour ginger soda cinnamon cloves and salt; set aside. In a large mixing bowl beat margarine with an electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds to soften. Gradually add the 1 cup sugar beat until fluffy. Add egg and molasses; beat well. Stir dry ingredients into beaten mixture. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls (1 heaping tablespoonful dough each). Roll in the 2 tablespoons sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 1/2 inches apart. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven abut 10 minutes or until light brown and still puffed (do not overcook). Let stand for 2 minutes before transferring to rack to cool. Makes 24 (3-inch) cookies.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix water and sugar together in a large pan. Heat until sugar is dissolved; set aside to cool. In a large container mix pineapple orange and lemon juices; add cooled sugar water mixture to Jell-O (dry); mix well. Add bananas (that have been mashed thoroughly); mix well and freeze until ready to use.

title: Honey Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in mixing bowl. Heat last three ingredients to 110\u00b0 to 115\u00b0 warm to touch. Pour liquid mixture over flour mixture. Blend at low speed for one minute. By hand stir in 1 cup additional whole wheat flour and 4 to 4 1/2 cups all-purpose flour. Knead on floured surface about 5 minutes. Place dough in greased bowls; cover and let rise 45 to 60 minutes until doubled in bulk. Punch down dough; divide in half. Shape each half into a loaf shape. Place in two 9 x 5-inch greased loaf tins. Cover loaves; let rise 30 to 45 minutes until light and double in size. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until loaf sounds hollow when tapped. Remove from pan; cool on rack. Slice when cool.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Mix in heavy pan and stir with wooden spoon. When this begins to boil fast time for 8 minutes. Remove from heat and add chocolate chips and Marshmallow Fluff. Stir until chocolate and marshmallow are blended. Add walnuts. Pour into a 14 x 9-inch pan. Spray pan with Pam before emptying the fudge into pan to set.

title: Garlic Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and drop by spoonful onto a greased baking sheet. Bake 7 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. You may brush with melted butter while still warm. Yields 8 to 10 biscuits.

title: Flounder With Lemon Butter Sauce
instructions: Season flounder fillets with garlic salt and white pepper. Coat fillets with flounder and then beaten egg. Next fry fillets in skillet using vegetable oil. Cook fillets for about 3 minutes on each side. Place flounder fillets on a serving plate. In the same skillet add butter lemon juice salt pepper and garlic. Mix until blended and pour on top of fillets.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly and add everything else except nuts and mix. Add nuts in with mixture. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Use either red or green peppers. Remove seeds from peppers; blend peppers in blender. Use vinegar for liquid. Mix in sugar; bring to rolling boil and add Certo. Bring to full boil again stirring constantly for 4 minutes. Skim off foam. Pour into jelly jars.

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick spray. Dip chicken in margarine then coat with remaining ingredients. Place in prepared pan. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Quick Hoppin' John With Cabbage
instructions: In a large heavy bottom pot fry ham onion and green pepper in canola oil over medium high heat for 5 minutes. Add cabbage chicken broth red pepper flakes bay leaf and parsley. Stir. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 15 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Drain and rinse black-eyed peas. Add peas to pot; stir and simmer uncovered for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
instructions: Mix dry pudding and cream in bowl with spoon. Chill until thick. Beat on high until it looks like whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Milkshakes
instructions: In covered blender container at high speed blend all ingredients until smooth. Pour mixture into chilled 12 ounce glasses. Serve milkshakes with large straws.

title: No-Bake Cake
instructions: Cut cake into 1-inch cubes. Prepare pudding with milk. Place cake and marshmallows in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour prepared pudding over top completely covering cake. Chill at least 1 hour. Cover top with Cool Whip.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Combine ingredients as listed and mix well in large Tupperware container with cover. Refrigerate. May have to be stirred down. Take out by spoonful roll in flour and shape biscuits. Bake in moderate to hot oven until golden brown.

title: Popovers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine eggs flour milk and salt in bowl. Mix just until moistened. Fill greased muffin cups 3/4 full. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 12 popovers.

title: Easy Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine with electric mixer; chill. Dip apples bananas strawberries etc.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs and melted margarine. Pat in bottom of pan.

title: Celery Relish
instructions: Soak first 3 items in salt water overnight. Drain well. Add chopped celery and remaining ingredients. Mix well; bring to full boil and can hot.

title: Butter Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Mix sugar and flour; add to margarine. Add milk; cook until thick like a gravy. Remove from stove. Add vanilla. Spoon some over your favorite piece of cake.

title: Grandma Dooley'S Jam Cake
instructions: Sift together flour cinnamon allspice and cloves. In a separate bowl add soda to buttermilk. In a third bowl cream shortening and sugar. Add jam and mix well. Add milk and flour mixtures alternately to creamed mixture blending well after each addition. Stir in nuts. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until done.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Add 1 cup coconut to cake mix. Mix and bake according to directions\tusing a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan. While cake is hot punch holes in cake. Combine Eagle Brand milk and cream of coconut. Pour over cake. Frost when cool. Combine Cool Whip pecans and coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops on both sides in small amount of cooking oil; drain off any fat. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chops. Simmer 30 minutes or until fork-tender. Serve with white rice or noodles.

title: Fresh Apple Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.

title: Crabmeat Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mixer. Spread on muffin halves. Quick freeze. Remove and cut in quarters. Freeze in plastic bags until ready to use. Broil for 5 minutes or until just browned and bubbly.

title: Cranberry-Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add cranberry and beat until smooth. Add orange juice. Chill until slightly thickened. Add celery and apple. Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan or mold. Half a recipe would fill an 8 x 8-inch pan. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cheesy Onion Bake With Toasted Rounds
instructions: Grate the cheese and mix with the onion mayonnaise and cracked red pepper. Bake in a covered baking dish in a 225\u00b0 to 250\u00b0 oven for about 25 minutes. Using an electric knife thinly slice the French breads into rounds. Lay the slices on a cookie sheet and lightly brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with coarse ground black pepper and bake 20 to 25 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven. Serve the hot cheesy onion bake as a dip with the toasted rounds.

title: Grilled Potatoes In Foil
instructions: Mix salad dressing and seasonings in large bowl until well blended. Stir in potatoes and onions to coat. Divide potat mixture evenly among six 12-inch square pieces of heavy-duty foil. Seal each to form packet. Place foil packets on grill over medium-hot coals (coals will have slight glow). Grill covered 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Polish Hamburgers
instructions: Mix hamburger pork eggs chopped onion green pepper and milk together. Add bread crumbs to form a patty. Brown patties in a little oil until browned on both sides. Remove patties. Add water to juice and thicken with flour water to make gravy. Put patties back in gravy and let simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sheath Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and flour; set aside. Mix margarine shortening cocoa and water in a saucepan and bring to a rapid boil. Pour over dry ingredients and stir well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into a greased 16 x 11-inch pan and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Make into little nest or just put into bottom of greased baking dish. Dice onions and tomatoes. Set aside.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl stir together oat bran flour baking soda and salt. In a separate large bowl cream the butter or margarine with sugar and vanilla extract. Beat in egg whites. Gradually add oat bran mixture and mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop from a level tablespoon onto cookie sheets sprayed with nonstick vegetable spray. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese sugar and peanut butter. Stir in milk and whole container Cool Whip. Put in pie crust. Freeze 4 to 6 hours. Top with crushed peanuts or grated chocolate.

title: Coconut-Orange Chess Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients mixing well. Combine eggs and next 3 ingredients. Add to sugar mixture stirring well. Add coconut. Pour into pastry shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until filling sets. Yield One 9-inch pie.

title: Cornmeal Rolls
instructions: Cook meal sugar salt shortening and milk in a saucepan until thick (like cereal). Cool to lukewarm. Add yeast that has been dissolved in warm water. Add eggs and beat. Add flour to form soft dough. Knead. Cover and let rise. Punch down. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Brush with butter. Let rise. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fudgesicles
instructions: In mixing bowl combine sugar and cocoa. Add eggs and corn syrup. Stirring constantly mix a little hot milk into cocoa mixture. Gradually add more milk until all milk is used stirring constantly until mixture is smooth thickened and coats the spoon. Pour into molds ice cube tray paper cups etc. and freeze until stiff. Add sticks. Freeze thoroughly.

title: Microwave Rhubarb Pudding
instructions: Combine rhubarb water and sugar in a 2-quart microwavable bowl; cook uncovered 8 minutes. Add pudding mix. Cook 1 minute. Serve warm.

title: Paradise Cove Cheesecake
instructions: Blend cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk until creamy. Add lemon juice and blend into mixture. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate at least an hour. Serve.

title: Brown 'N Serve Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in milk sugar salt shortening and 2 1/2 cups of the flour. Beat until smooth. Mix in remaining flour to form soft dough. Turn dough onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl; turn greased side up. Cover; let rise in warm place until double about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: In a large skillet brown pork in fat. Add 1/4 cup water; cover and simmer until tender (about 1 hour). Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Combine sugar and cornstarch. Add pineapple syrup vinegar soy sauce and salt. Add cornstarch mixture pineapple green pepper and onion rings to skillet. Cook (continue stirring) over medium heat until mixture thickens. Cover and simmer 5 minutes longer. Serve over cooked rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Gary'S Creole Cabbage
instructions: In large pot brown meat pepper and onion; drain. Add chopped cabbage Ro-Tel and tomatoes. Add cheese soup. Cook about 2 hours on slow heat or simmer. Good served with cornbread. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender; set aside. Add cream of chicken soup to stuffing mix and mix. Add 1 to 2 soup cans of water (mixture should be slightly soupy). Add squash. Place in greased baking dish; dot with margarine. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown and firm to touch.

title: Chocolate Lush Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together well. Put into an 8 x 12-inch Pyrex dish. Bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0 or until golden brown. Let cool.

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Mix together and press into a 9-inch spring-form pan.

title: Easy Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine crumbs with sugar and butter. Press on bottom of 9-inch pan.

title: Sand Cups
instructions: Mix milk and pudding mix together. Beat 1 to 2 minutes or until well blended. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in Cool Whip. Gradually stir in 1 cup of crushed wafers. Spoon into serving dishes. Top with remaining crushed wafers. Refrigerate until ready to serve. This will make 8 servings.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add the egg milk and flour and baking powder mixture. Add the berries. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Eat while warm with butter.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice eggplant 1/4 inch thick; sprinkle with salt and let stand 15 minutes. Blot off moisture with paper towel. Fry eggplant in olive oil until lightly brown or soft to touch. Saute ground beef with onion and garlic; salt and pepper slightly. Add tomato sauce and cook for about 30 minutes. Layer eggplant then beef mixture and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Use 8 x 10-inch casserole to layer eggplant. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown chili meat and drain. Add all other ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Double Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in square pan. Sprinkle brown sugar in pan. Arrange pineapple and cherries over sugar mixture. Mix cake as directed on label. Pour batter in pan. Bake for 50 minutes. Turn upside-down on cake plate.

title: Mom'S Guacamole
instructions: Peel avocados and break into chunks; do not smash. Add sour cream lemon juice garlic and salt. Mix well but dont smash the avocados. Strain a jar of salsa to remove liquid. Add strained salsa to avocados and mix. Serve with warm corn tortillas or tortilla chips.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: In a 10-inch Dutch oven heat margarine until sizzling. Add corn sugar salt and water. Fry for 6 minutes.

title: Asparagus Parmigiana
instructions: Cook asparagus until just barely tender; drain. Add butter. Arrange in shallow buttered baking dish and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Over this pour egg and milk blended together. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and oregano. Dot with butter. Sprinkle lightly with more cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Tequila Sour
instructions: Blend with ice in blender. Pour into cocktail glasses. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Put butter and marshmallows together in a pan over low heat until melted. Stir in popped corn and beat well. Press into a tube cake pan and let cool.

title: Baked Seafood Salad
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients then add the next ingredients except for the butter. Stir into seafood mixture. Spoon into a 6 x 10 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Combine 1 cup breadcrumbs with melted butter. Sprinkle over seafood mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cabbage Gumbo
instructions: In a large pot saute onion and pepper in oil for one to two minutes; add tomatoes okra and cabbage. Stir well. Add water; and on high heat bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium cover pot and cook 30 to 45 minutes. Add salt to taste. Stir occasionally. Great with corn bread.

title: Divinity
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Cook sugar syrup and water to hard ball temperature. (Will form a ball when dropped in glass of cold water and \clink\ when tapped against side.) Beat into the egg whites pouring in very slowly. Add vanilla and chopped nuts. Beat until stiff.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
instructions: Thirty minutes before roast beef is done prepare Yorkshire Pudding. Heat square 9 x 9-inch pan in oven. Heat 1/2 cup vegetable oil in pan over stove. Mix flour salt milk and eggs. Mix all ingredients with hand beater just until smooth. Take out heated pan from oven; pour in 1/2 cup heated oil and add the mixture. Put in 425\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. When golden brown remove from oven and immediately cut into squares and remove from pan. Usually there is still oil in the pan. If you wait to remove the Yorkshire Pudding from the pan the excess oil will be absorbed into the pudding and will stick to the pan. Serve with butter.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; salt and pepper to taste. Cut cabbage coarsely. Chop onion. In a 3-quart casserole dish add 1/3 of the cabbage 1/2 of the hamburger meat and 1/2 of the onion. Layer these. Add 1/3 of the cabbage and the last 1/2 of the hamburger meat and the last 1/2 of the onion and the remaining 1/3 of the cabbage. Pour tomato soup over the top. Do not stir or mix. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 60 minutes.

title: Mushroom Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine soup 1/2 cup cheese onion salt and milk. Add potatoes and mix well; put in greased baking dish. Top with 1/4 cup cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until potatoes are tender about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Super Nachos(Easy Layer Meal)
instructions: Cook ground meat in a skillet; drain. In an oblong baking dish spread refried beans on bottom; spread the meat on top of beans. Spread Old El Paso salsa over meat; sprinkle cheese. Bake for approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool. Spread the sour cream over top and garnish with black olives. Serve as a meal with tortillas or as a dip with nacho chips.

title: Mother'S Lemon Apples
instructions: Peel apples and slice thin. Bring to rolling boil all ingredients except apples. Add the apples stirring carefully to cover with liquid. Cook on medium to medium-high until apples are transparent. Remove apples with slotted spoon leaving juice to continue cooking until slightly thickened. Pour over apples and allow to cool before serving.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Arrange bread slices in greased baking dish. Cover bread with browned drained sausage. Mix together beaten eggs mustard and milk. Pour over sausage. Sprinkle cheese on top and cover with undiluted soup. Put in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook together until veggies are cooked; add chicken. Cook this in a 5-quart stew pan. Eat with cornbread.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown bacon hamburger and onion. Mix in other ingredients. Bake 1 1/2 hours or put in crockpot and cook on high for 2-3 hours.

title: Craver Dip
instructions: Blend catsup gradually into cream cheese. Add salad dressing onion horseradish Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco; blend thoroughly. Fold in shrimp; chill at least 1 hour. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Saute
instructions: Fry chicken in butter until white on the outside. Take chicken out and saute broccoli and cauliflower in remaining butter. When thawed mix in broccoli cheese soup and milk. Heat until simmering then pour chicken back in and cook for about 10 minutes.

title: Brew
instructions: Stir juices water and sugar together in pitcher until sugar is dissolved. Just before serving add ginger ale. Pour over cracked ice which has been placed in glasses. Serves 4 cups.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix mayonnaise water and vanilla. Then mix together flour soda sugar and cocoa. Add to liquid mixture. Bake in 2 layers in a 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Walcie'S Hamburger Soup
instructions: In large stewer brown hamburger; drain. Add water. Bring to a boil. Add all ingredients. Stir well until mustard is dissolved. Lower heat and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Cream Chicken With Parsley
instructions: *Individual pieces (i.e. breasts thighs) may be used.

title: Light Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions omitting salt and oil in the water. Drain and combine with the tuna mayonnaise celery onion bell pepper and peas. Set aside.

title: *Whole Wheat Rolls
instructions: In a large bowl pour in scalded milk. Add salt shortening 5 tablespoons sugar and beaten eggs. In a small bowl combine 1 tablespoon sugar and yeast with the warm water. Let yeast mixture set for at least 10 minutes and then blend with the ingredients in a large bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups whole wheat and 1 1/2 cups white flour. Blend this mixture to a soft dough. Continue to gradually add the rest of the flours remembering to keep the dough soft. Keeping the dough soft is the real secret to making light rolls.

title: Dietetic 3 Minute Delite Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; add liquids and mix until smooth. Add 1 can poppy seed filling and/or 1 cup of chopped nuts (optional). Beat well on medium speed for 2 minutes. Use a 10-inch tube pan. Do not grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until tested done. Cool cake before removing from pan.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Saute onion in 1 stick of margarine; add to other ingredients. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (Dot with butter before baking.) (This tastes better if it is made in a long dish so it will be thin.)

title: English Toffee
instructions: Melt butter and add sugar. Mix and add nuts. Cook until mixture reaches 290\u00b0. Cook 5 minutes longer. Pour on cold board (I used cookie sheet). Spread. Place 2 Hershey bars on top and then spread chocolate as it melts. Let cool completely. Crack up.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup bread crumbs 1/2 cup milk 1 egg and 4 tablespoons ketchup together. Make into balls in pan.

title: Jane'S Baked Rice
instructions: Mix all together in a 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Stir once during baking.

title: Spinach Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover and cook 4 to 6 hours on low heat. Serves 8.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and spices then mix with remaining ingredients. Toss and serve.

title: Fresh Tomato Soup
instructions: In 3-quart pan heat oleo. Cook onions until tender. Stir in flour. Slowly stir in water. Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients (except lemon slices). Heat to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Stir frequently. Add more water if needed. Makes 4 servings.

title: Apple Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in shallow baking dish. Cover with apple slices. Pour apple juice on top. Sprinkle with cinnamon; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Take off cover and bake 15 more minutes. Serve and enjoy!

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Hollow out a round loaf of bread (preferably rye or pumpernickel). Save the pieces of bread removed and use them for dipping. You can use crackers or cut up vegetables.

title: Zucchini Cake(Just Like Apple Pie)
instructions: Mix together the flour sugar and melted margarine; set aside. Cook the zucchini with lemon juice until tender. Add the sugar cinnamon and nutmeg; cook 1 more minute then add 1/2 cup of the flour mixture that was set aside. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Take 1/2 of the flour mixture; pat down into pan. Put zucchini mixture on top. Top with remaining flour mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Enjoy! Tastes like apple pie.

title: Shrink-Ups
instructions: Cut shapes out of the lids (often you can get them from meat department of grocery stores). Color and draw on the plastic. Place them on a cookie sheet and bake them at 350\u00b0 for a few minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed. While cooling mix vanilla pudding as directed adding cream cheese. Layer strawberries on cake. It is best to slice strawberries. Next pour pudding and ice with strawberries. Serves 12.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in a casserole dish in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Navy Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans and place in a large kettle. Cover with the 2 quarts of cold water. Simmer for 3 minutes and then allow to soak for 1 hour. Add ham salt pepper bay leaves carrot and celery. Cover and simmer for 3 1/2 hours. Add onion during the last 1/2 hour. Mash beans slightly. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Quick Corn Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Stir in mayonnaise; salt and pepper to taste.

title: Meat Loaf Recipe
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Shape into loaf. Prepare sauce to pour over before baking.

title: Party Mix
instructions: In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish place first 3 ingredients and microwave on High for 1 minute. Stir well. Add cereals pretzels and nuts mixing to coat. Microwave 5 to 6 minutes stirring after 3 minutes until evenly toasted. Yield 2 1/2 quarts.

title: One Bowl Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all in one bowl. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ambrosia Mold
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Add cold water to juice to measure 1 cup. Stir boiling water into Jell-O in large bowl until completely dissolved. Stir in measured liquid. Refrigerate until slightly thickened. Stir in whipped topping until smooth. Stir in pineapple oranges marshmallows and coconut. Spoon into mold. Refrigerate 3 hours or until firm. Makes 10 servings.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake in a greased floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Mix together. Marinate 20 minutes to 2 hours. Great on chicken pork or shrimp.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
