instructions: Put flour and sugar in large bowl. In pan bring to boil butter shortening cocoa and water. Pour over flour and sugar; mix well. Add buttermilk vanilla cinnamon and soda. Mix well and pour batter into greased and floured sheet pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put pineapple plus juice and pie pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix over and pour melted oleo over that. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Chinese Meatballs
instructions: Make small meatballs with hamburger onion bread crumbs salt egg tomato sauce and garlic powder. Shape into balls.

title: Banana Tea Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Work shortening with a spoon until fluffy and creamy. Add sugar gradually while continuing to work with a spoon until light. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour mixture alternately with the bananas a small amount at a time beating smooth with a spoon after each addition. Turn into a greased loaf pan 9 x 5 x 3-inch. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in baking dish. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Curried Herring With Dill(This Recipe Sounds Odd, But It'S Consistently A Hit!)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except herring and mix well. Add the herring and refrigerate until it is time to serve. Great with pumpernickel bread. Serves 25 to 30 people as hors doeuvres. Keeps indefinitely in refrigerator.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle cubed cheese and onion over potatoes. Place pimento garlic salt and parsley on top. Put bread cubes over top of casserole. Pour margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Icing For Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Cook to a boil stirring constantly. When it foams up reduce heat then cook down again. Add a big spoon of butter and 1 spoon vanilla. Beat well and spread on cake. Cooking time is about 15 minutes; will be soupy.

title: Simplified Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with wet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serves 1 dozen.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole dish. Beat 8 eggs and milk with seasonings. Pour over croutons and cheese. Fry and drain meat and crumble over casserole. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake covered 350 for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake additional 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Bread Or Rolls
instructions: Mix well and let rise 1 hour and work down. Let rise another hour and work out into either 6 loaves of bread or about 6 dozen rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour for rolls or 45 minutes for bread.\tGrease top after baking with lard.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Drop by 1/3 to 1/2 cupfuls or by ice cream scoops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 12 minutes. Makes a bunch!

title: Bacon-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Prepare the night before serving. Use large bowl that can be covered tightly. Break lettuce and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Dice onion. Layer in this order lettuce onion bacon and cauliflower. Combine the remaining ingredients and spread on top. Cover tightly. Mix well just before serving.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spread rice in 9 x 13-inch pan. Put chicken on top and add 1/2 envelope dry onion soup on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. (May increase temperature and cook for shorter time.)

title: Orange-Glazed Scallopini With Rosemary
instructions: On wax paper mix flour 1/2 teaspoon of the salt half of the pepper and half of the rosemary. Coat chicken in flour mixture; shake off excess. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken; saute 5 minutes or until just cooked turning once. Place on platter.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies and put half of crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese and margarine until smooth. Mix in sugar and fold in Cool Whip. In separate bowl mix together pudding mixture and vanilla. Fold cream cheese mixture into pudding. Pour into pan on top of crumbs. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Refrigerate to set.

title: Fruit Fritter Batter
instructions: For apple fritters add 4 tablespoons of sugar 1 1/2 cup pared chopped apples and 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon.

title: Pork Chops Crock-Pot
instructions: Dredge pork chops in mixture of flour salt dry mustard and garlic powder. Brown in oil in large skillet. Place browned pork chops in crock-pot. Add can of soup. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours (high for 3 1/2 hours).

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake for 40 minutes at 375 degrees.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water until not quite done. Mix mushroom soup with 1/2 cup milk and add onion juice. Place layer of broccoli in casserole dish layer of bread crumbs layer of mushroom soup mixture and layer of cheese. Repeat making 2 layers. Top with buttered crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Croissant
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray glass pan 9 x 13-inch or 2-quart. Spread crescent rolls across bottom and sides of pan. Brown hamburger and 1/2 an onion in pan. Drain.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered.

title: Pork Chops With Dried Cherries
instructions: Sprinkle chops lightly with salt and pepper. Heat oil in large skillet. Cook pork chops on high heat 4 to 5 minutes each side. Transfer to plate. Cover. Keep warm. Add shallots and thyme to skillet. Cook 1 minute. Add Port wine chicken broth and cherries to skillet. Bring to boil. Cook until reduced by half about 3 minutes. Return pork chops to skillet. Cook until meat is heated through. Sprinkle with parsley when serving.

title: Easy Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Cut ends off cucumbers and pack in a gallon big-mouth jar. Cover with vinegar and let set for 6 weeks.

title: Party Treats Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff then mix the rest of ingredients and dip pecan halves and put on buttered foil. Bake at 275\u00b0 until light brown about 20 minutes.

title: Crab Meat Salad
instructions: Drain crab meat. Chop eggs. Blend all ingredients. Serve as stuffing for tomato on lettuce leaf. Top with slices of avocado and sprinkle with paprika. Serves 8 or 9.

title: German Honey Cookies(Makes 100 To 125 Cookies)
instructions: Heat sugar Crisco honey and molasses in pan until shortening is melted. Cook over low to medium heat and stir to prevent scorching or crystallizing.

title: Graham Cracker Treats
instructions: Line cookie sheet with foil. Separate graham crackers and lay side by side. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter margarine and sugar; cook for 2 minutes. Add pecans and pour over crackers. Bake 10 minutes. Let cool about 3 minutes; remove from cookie sheet. Cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Golden Broccoli Soup
instructions: In 8-cup measure place the broccoli carrot onion and water. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.

title: Banana Chips
instructions: Slice bananas very thin. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake in oven on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 until crisp.

title: Greek Summer Vegetable Salad
instructions: Place the tomatoes onions bell peppers and cucumbers on a serving platter. In a bowl whisk together the olive oil and vinegar. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour the vinaigrette over the vegetables. Crumble the feta over the salad sprinkle the olives and oregano over the top and serve immediately. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Shape into cakes. Fry in shortening (or oil) until done browning on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

title: Hot Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cut vegetables in 1/2-inch pieces. Place in large skillet and saute. Brown sausage. Put vegetables and sausage in casserole. Add juice paste garlic salt sugar oregano and allspice. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sour Cream Pecan Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; fold in vanilla and sour cream and mix gently. Combine brown sugar cinnamon and pecans. Spoon half the pecan mixture into a greased and floured Bundt or tube pan. Cover with half the batter. Spoon on remaining pecan mixture and cover with batter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until wooden skewer inserted in center comes out clean. Do not overbake. Set aside for 10 minutes. Run sharp knife around edge. Invert onto plate. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar when cool. Yield 12 to 15 servings.

title: Macaroni Cheese Bake
instructions: Melt margarine and add flour. Cook stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Do not brown. Stir in milk salt and pepper. Cook until smooth and thickened. Combine drained macaroni with white sauce. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Place under broiler for a few minutes if a browner crust is desired. Serves 8.

title: Rice Cooker Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Brown smoked sausage in skillet. Place all ingredients together in an electric rice cooker. Cook just as you would cook rice. When the bell rings on rice cooker the jambalaya is ready. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 5-inch dish dissolve the raspberry Jell-O in the hot water; add the grape juice. Add the pineapple and chopped pecans. Chill until set. Combine the cream cheese and Cool Whip and spread over Jell-O mixture. Sprinkle nuts over top and chill.

title: Sweet Graham Snacks
instructions: Line a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with graham crackers. In a saucepan bring butter and sugar to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Stir in nuts. Spoon over the graham crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Immediately remove from pan onto foil. Cool. Break apart. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Sorghum Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix separately from cake. Pour this mixture over unbaked cake mix. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add the rest of ingredients and mix well. Knead 5 minutes. Spread on greased cookie sheet. Add sauce cheese etc. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes until crust is brown on bottom. Makes 1 crust.

title: Apple Bread Puddings
instructions: Toast bread. Break into cubes and turn into 8 1/4 x 1 3/4-inch ovenware dish. Add hot milk. Let stand 15 minutes. Beat together eggs cinnamon nutmeg salt and sweetener until light. Add apples and raisins into bread mixture. Place into shallow baking pan. Fill with water. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife inserted in center comes clean 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm or cold. Serves 8.

title: Shrimp Fettucine
instructions: Saute in butter; onion garlic celery parsley and bell pepper. Add shrimp and cook 10 minutes. Combine cheeses half and half and flour.

title: Shells And Tuna
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; rinse and drain. Add tuna eggs pepper and celery to suit your taste. Add salt and pepper. Mix and sprinkle chopped tomato on top for garnish. Refrigerate.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Cook sausage in large skillet until light in color. Remove from pan leaving all sausage drippings. (With fork tear up sausage and reserve.) To drippings blend in flour salt and pepper (to taste). To this add milk slowly stirring. When mixture begins to thicken add sausage. Delicious over homemade baked biscuits or crunchy buttered toast.

title: Chicken Chow Mein Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; save broth. Mix all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve over fluffy rice.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large baking pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Vanilla Custard
instructions: In a large bowl slightly beat eggs. Add sugar gradually. Slowly add scalded milk vanilla and salt. Pour into slightly greased custard cups. Place cups in pan of hot water. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Test with knife. When knife comes out clean custard is done. Cool then refrigerate.

title: Wimpy'S(Linda Baker'S Sloppy Joe Recipe)
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add onion pepper and rest of ingredients. Simmer for 30 minutes; serve on rolls.

title: Sweet Dill Pickles
instructions: Soak pickles in cold water a couple of hours. Put a head or\ttwo of dill and several onion slices in jars.\tSplit each pickle or\tslice and fill jars. Put alum the size of a pea in each quart jar also 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring syrup (vinegar water sugar) to a boil and pour over pickles hot. Seal. Put jars into canner.\tCover with water. Bring water to a boil. Turn off heat. Let cool in water. Pickles will shrink but will fill out in a couple of weeks. Will be good to eat in 2 weeks.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Bring to boil all ingredients. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Rice
instructions: Brown meat and onion in large skillet; drain fat. Stir in water catsup mustard salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice; cover. Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese; cover. Let stand until cheese melts.

title: Meat Loaf #2
instructions: Soak bread in water; squeeze out excess moisture. Combine bread meat egg seasonings onion and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Mix well. Shape into a loaf in a shallow baking dish. Combine remaining tomato sauce brown sugar vinegar mustard and water. Pour sauce over meat loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour basting occasionally. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Old-Time Buttermilk Fudge
instructions: Put soda in buttermilk and let stand 3 minutes. Cook all ingredients including buttermilk to soft ball stage. Cool and beat until creamy. Pour into buttered pan or plate. Cut into squares when set.\tNuts coconut or other flavorings may be added.

title: Kahlua Number 1
instructions: Simmer water sugar and coffee gently uncovered for 1 hour. Add vanilla and vodka.

title: Fast Fixin' Fish
instructions: In medium skillet melt butter; stir in soup mix and parsley blended with water. Add fish. Simmer covered 10 minutes or until fish flakes. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Layer casserole dish with chicken chips and cheese. Mix soups and Ro-Tel in saucepan; heat to boiling. Pour half over layer. Make another layer of chicken chips and cheese. Pour remaining soup mixture on top. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbling hot.

title: Easy Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco together. To butter and Crisco add sugar until creamed. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Alternately add flour milk and water. Beat well. Pour in floured and greased tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes longer. Put pan in cold oven; set temperature and do not open door while baking.

title: Uncooked Lye Soap
instructions: Pour water into small enamel stone or glass containers. Dissolve the lye in the water stirring gently with wooden spoon until dissolved. Mix in a well ventilated room but not in a breeze. Let the lye water cool until the container feels cool to the hand. Melt the fat in an enamel pan and stir with a wooden spoon. Cool the fat until the spoon begins to leave a track in the mixture. Pour the lye solution into the fat in a small steady stream stirring until the mixture is honey-like in texture. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Pour into molds or boxes that have been lined with wax paper. Cover the soap and let stand 24 hours. Cut into bars. Place soap in open air but avoid drafts and cold. Let cure for several weeks before using. Makes about 9 pounds.

title: Herb Sausage Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and form into small balls. Bake on a rack in a shallow pan for 20 minutes.

title: Corn Bread Taco Bake
instructions: In skillet brown meat; drain. Stir in taco seasoning water corn green pepper and tomato sauce. Pour into 2-quart casserole. In a separate bowl prepare corn muffin mix according to package directions except add 1/2 can French fried onions. Spoon corn muffin mixture around outer edge of casserole. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top corn bread with cheese and remaining onions; bake 2 to 3 minutes longer.

title: Southern Smokies
instructions: Brown sausage 5 to 10 minutes. While browning sausage mix in crock-pot on high setting jelly and barbecue sauce. Drain sausage then mix in crock-pot. Simmer at least 30 minutes then serve.

title: Mccartney Fudge
instructions: In a large bowl mix semi-sweet chocolate chips chopped nuts marshmallow margarine and vanilla. In a 3-quart saucepan mix sugar and milk. Cook over medium high heat; stir constantly. When mixture boils continue cooking 6 minutes. Stir constantly. Pour ingredients in bowl; stir until chips dissolve and mixture is smooth. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Let set 6 hours or overnight. Refrigerates well. Let stand at room temperature for easy cutting.

title: Easy No-Cook Fudge
instructions: Cream the cream cheese until soft and smooth. Slowly blend in sugar; add melted chocolate and other ingredients. Press into well-buttered shallow pan; refrigerate until firm. For softer fudge blend in 1 teaspoon milk.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and soup. Place on bottom of casserole dish then drain green beans and put over meat mixture. Add mashed potatoes then top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Heat oil in large pot. Add chopped onion celery and carrot. Cook 2 minutes. Add cauliflower; cover. Cook 15 minutes. Add broth and bring to boil 5 minutes.

title: Split Pea And Potato Soup
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan melt the margarine. Add the onion and cook uncovered until soft about 5 minutes. Stir in the beef broth and water and bring to a boil about 4 minutes. Add peas and potatoes. Adjust heat so that the mixture bubbles gently cover and cook for 30 minutes or until the peas and potatoes are tender. Remove from heat and cool 10 minutes. In an electric blender or food processor puree the soup in 5 batches whirling each batch about 15 seconds. Return to the pan set over low heat and bring to serving temperature stirring often. Add pepper. Serves 4.

title: Deluxe Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix all together beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Special Cheesecake
instructions: Crust Mix together Zwieback crackers butter and sugar. Line bottom of cheese cake pan (9 1/2 x 3-inch).

title: Linguine With Shrimp Scampi And Broccoli
instructions: Melt 1/2 butter in oil and saute shrimp for 2 minutes. Put aside. Put 1/2 butter 2 cloves garlic and olive oil in. Add broccoli wine parsley and pepper. Mix together then add shrimp. Serve over cooked linguine.

title: Sole Casserole
instructions: Butter an 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole. Lay fish in serving size pieces on bottom of pan. Pour shrimp soup over fish (undiluted). Crumb the croutons and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Melt shortening and mix with sugar add eggs one at a time. Add flour nuts and chocolate chips. Batter will be sticky! Spread in a greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool before cutting. (These dont cut too neatly!)

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Over low heat saute squash and onions until tender-crisp. Salt and pepper to taste. Stir in shrimp soup and water chestnuts. Place in greased casserole and sprinkle with buttered crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Cut the pork chops off the bone in small pieces. Put in pot and fry. Get the link sausage slice thin. Put aside until the pork is done then fry the sausage. Get out of pot and drain most of the grease leave enough to fry the onion (cut up in small pieces) green onion (cut in small pieces) and bell pepper (cut in small pieces). When that is done add the meat and fry a few minutes more then add the rice and fry about 10 minutes all together; then add spice salt and pepper. Add water and cook until it is done.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples sugar and chopped pecans by hand. Let stand 1 hour. Mix flour baking soda cinnamon and salt until well blended. Add oil and eggs. Bake in a greased and floured bundt pan at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Ranch Potato Salad
instructions: Combine the boiled potatoes celery and red onion; set aside. Separately combine the last 3 ingredients and add to potatoes; toss to coat. Chill. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Company Breakfast
instructions: Place bread in bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook sausage and\tcrumble over bread. Beat eggs with milk; add cheese mustard salt and pepper. Pour over sausage. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Place in cold oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Add rest of ingredients and bake in 1-quart casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Stir together juice of lemon egg yolks and salt; cook until thick. Cool. Prepare pineapple grapes and marshmallows. Now stir lemon mixture into the whipped cream. Stir into fruit mixture. Refrigerate for 24 hours. This salad is not to be tasted or eaten before time is up.

title: Dolly'S Hot Seafood Dip
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Saute onions and celery with Tabasco until soft. Drain tuna and shred. Mix in mayonnaise bread crumbs half and half 1 cup cheese pepper and almonds. Stir in onions and celery mixture spoon into 3 to 4-quart casserole and top with remaining cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Fresh Apple Pie Cake
instructions: Peel and slice apples thinly into a 9-inch (2-inch deep) pie pan (or glass layer cake pan). Mix sugar (1/2 cup) and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples. Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt into bowl. Add orange juice (or milk) egg water and melted butter (or margarine). Mix until smooth with wooden spoon. Pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Put potatoes onions and celery in a small amount of water. Cook until tender. Add 2 cups corn ham milk and soup. Stir well while heating.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Simmer ground beef water and vinegar for 30 minutes. Add catsup mustard sugar salt and onion. Cook on low heat for 30 minutes. Serve on hot dogs or hamburger buns.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spray iron skillet with nonstick buttery flavored Pam. Bake at 450\u00b0 about 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Indian Summer Apple Cake
instructions: Blend together eggs oil and sugar until creamy. Add flour a small amount at a time blending well after each addition. Batter will be stiff. Fold in apples coconut and pecans. Place in greased and floured 10 inch tube pan; bake at 350 degrees about one hour or until wooded pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Cool in pan for 30 minutes; remove cake.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Place whole can of crushed pineapple (undrained) on bottom of 8 x 12-inch pan. Spread can of pie filling on top of pineapple. Sprinkle cake mix over this. Melt margarine and pour over the mix then pour nuts on top of this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: White Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Gradually add sour milk or buttermilk. Put into prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Take dressing mix; pour in sour cream onion basil and oregano. Mix well. Stir in cooked spinach; chill 1 hour. Serve with raw vegetables or any type of wheat crackers.

title: Quick And Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake covered in greased casserole at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 20 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and garlic in oil. Add 3 tablespoons of flour until it gets brown. Throw in everything except meat. Cook for 20 minutes. Take bay leaves out and reheat for 5 minutes more. Then add meat. Meanwhile have your rice cooked to mix in when done cooking.

title: Prune Bar Cookies
instructions: Chop prunes. Add to chopped nuts with brown sugar flour baking powder and salt. Mix. Fold into well beaten eggs. Spread in greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pan for 5 to 10 minutes. Cut into 25 pieces. Roll in confectioners powdered sugar if desired.

title: Window Cleaner
instructions: Combine and put into a spray bottle. Shake before using.

title: A Wonderful Marinating Sauce
instructions: Simmer all this for several minutes. Then store in refrigerator. Meat marinated in this doesnt burn easily as it does hot have tomato sauce in it. Very good for any kind of meat. I soak my meat about 1 hour before cooking.

title: Raspberry Slush
instructions: Combine pineapple lemonade lemon juice powdered punch sugar and raspberries in a large container. Add enough water to make 2 gallons. Place in freezer and freeze. About 2 hours before serving remove from the freezer. Using a potato masher or pastry mixer \slush it\ then mix in the pop.

title: Beef Quiche
instructions: Brown the meat; drain and set aside. Blend mayonnaise milk eggs and cornstarch until smooth. Stir in the meat grated cheeses onion salt and pepper. Turn into the pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Oatmeal Carmelitas
instructions: Melt caramel topping combined with 1/4 cup flour. Combine remaining ingredients except chocolate chips and pecans in mixing bowl. Press half of crumbs into bottom of greased 13 x 9 pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans and spread caramel topping on cooked crumbs. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until golden brown. Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Wassail
instructions: Place spices in a spice ball or bag. Combine all ingredients. Cover and simmer at least 45 minutes.

title: Best-Ever Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Cook on High for 4 minutes. Stir until smooth. Cook 4 to 5 minutes until thickened. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla stirring until smooth and glossy. Serve hot. Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Whipping Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and beat well. Add whipping cream eggs and flour (alternately). Mix well. Add vanilla. Bake in a greased and floured Bundt pan in a cold oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bucket Of Dirt
instructions: Prepare pudding as directed on package. Mix pudding cream cheese and Cool Whip. Blend Oreos to crumbs then layer in pail starting with crumbs then pudding and ending with crumbs.

title: Asparagus Casserole(An Extra Easy Side Dish)
instructions: Empty the drained asparagus into an ovensafe casserole dish. Spoon soup evenly over asparagus. Bake at 350\u00b0 until mixture bubbles about 15 to 20 minutes. Add cheese and bake another 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13 casserole dish. Spread chicken on bottom of dish. Mix celery soup water chestnuts mushrooms and mayonnaise together. Pour over chicken. Mix stuffing with melted butter. Spread over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

title: Spiced Peaches
instructions: Drain the peach syrup into a saucepan. Add sugar vinegar and spices and boil 5 minutes. Add peaches and simmer 5 minutes. Allow fruit to stand in syrup overnight. Serve chilled.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs pumpkin and water. Mix. Blend in dry ingredients. Stir in nuts and raisins. Bake in greased and floured (2) loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes or until done.

title: Cheese Pie
instructions: Partially bake pie shell. Sprinkle all of the Monterey Jack half of the Cheddar and the chilli peppers in shell. Beat remaining ingredients together and add to pie shell mixture. Sprinkle remainder of Cheddar on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a mixing bowl stir together flour baking powder rice bran apple fiber and salt. Or you could do this in a food processor. Add milk all at once; stir until ingredients are just combined. If you are doing this in a food processor pulse the machine a few times just until dough is combined. If the dough seems a little dry sprinkle on a tablespoon of water and work it in.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add Cool Whip and stir well. Pour into glass 13 x 9-inch serving dish and freeze. Salad can be made 2 to 3 weeks in advance and frozen. When served let thaw then cut into square pieces. Pretty to serve.

title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar egg and molasses thoroughly. Add dry ingredients. Stir in. Chill.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken in bottom of pan with broth and pepper. Mix flour baking powder and milk. Pour over chicken. Melt margarine and pour over flour mixture. Bake in a moderate oven until crust browns. (I like to use 2 cups of chicken broth as it makes more gravy.)

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar well. Add slightly beaten egg yolks. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add alternately with flour to which the salt has been added. Fold in egg whites. Add coconut nuts and vanilla. Bake in 3 (8-inch) pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chile Rellenos
instructions: Roast and peel peppers. Slit them down the center lengthwise and fill with both kinds of cheese. Seal and roll in flour. Continue until all peppers are done. Separate eggs and whip whites until medium peaks form.

title: Papa John'S Portuguese Malasadas
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Add eggs and beat well. Add cream butter flavorings and yeast. Allow dough to rise work down and allow to rise a second time. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Tamale Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use a baking dish peel tamales and slice in half lengthwise. Place layer of tamales 1/2 can corn and top with 4 slices cheese. Repeat 1 more layer. Bake in oven for 1 hour or until cheese melts on top.

title: Lime And Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Combine 3/4 cup sugar with cornstarch and lime peel in medium saucepan and mix well. Add lime juice and stir until smooth. Blend in half and half and butter. Place over medium heat and stir until mixture thickens and starts to boil. Remove from heat and let cool stirring occasionally. Fold in sour cream. Turn into pie shell. Combine whipping cream and sugar. Whip until soft peaks. Spread atop pie.

title: Shrimp Diane
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in skillet; add garlic. Lightly saute. Add cubed tomatoes and juice from can; cook 1 minute. Add wine salt fresh black pepper basil and oregano. Cook over moderate heat for 10 minutes. Heat remaining olive oil in a separate skillet. Saute shrimp for 1 minute turning once. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes; remove from heat. Spoon shrimp and pan juices into a large baking dish. Crumble Feta cheese over shrimp. Pour tomato sauce over all. Just before serving bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven until sizzling. Serve over cooked linguine.

title: Honey Lemon Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine rhubarb sugar flour and lemon rind; mix well. Blend in honey. Put the pie crust in a pie pan and fill with mixture. Put top crust on and seal edges. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Skillet Squash Au Gratin
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add summer squash onion salt pepper and tomatoes. Cook covered for 10 to 15 minutes or until squash is tender. Sprinkle with cheese and soy sauce if desired.

title: Macaroni With Seasoning Salt
instructions: Put 5 rice in a bowl and put in the microwave and push the buttons for 38 pounds.

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Crush cookies with a rolling pin or in blender until you have 2 cups. Mix with cinnamon and 1/2 cup melted butter. Press into bottom and sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Chill. Beat sugar with eggs until light and fluffy; add cream cheese gradually beating well after each addition. Melt the chocolate and add to the egg mixture along with vanilla and sour cream beating constantly. Add melted butter and mix well. Pour mixture into chilled pie dish and bake at about 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Chill overnight. Serves 20.

title: Delicious Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken. Saute mushrooms in butter. Place chicken in casserole dish. Pour soup over the chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and top with mushrooms. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Paul'S Potato Salad
instructions: Boil clean unpeeled potatoes and eggs together until potatoes are to desired firmness. Cool potatoes and eggs in cool water until comfortable to handle. Rub the peeling off potatoes using fingers (faster than with knife!). Remove eggshells from eggs. Dice or mash eggs and potatoes in large bowl along with rest of ingredients and mix well. Chill (or serve room temperature) and serve. Even better the next day!

title: Non-Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and shortening together with hand pastry blender. Beat egg in separate container and add water and beat together. Add this mixture to dry ingredients.

title: Cheesy Pasta
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Saute garlic and add pasta and cheese. Mix on low heat until cheese is melted. Serve on plate and top with your favorite sauce.

title: Triple Good Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. In medium saucepan combine the first 4 ingredients (raisins milk etc.) Cook over medium heat stirring constantly just until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat; cool slightly and set aside. Beat margarine sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients; blend until evenly mixed and crumbly. Reserve 2 cups. Press remaining mixture onto bottom of prepared pan. Spread raisin mixture to within 1/2-inch of edge. Sprinkle with remaining oat mixture; pat lightly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool; cut into 1 x 2-inch bars. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Drain beets reserving liquid. Add enough water to beet juice to make 2/3 cup liquid. Combine cornstarch and pepper in saucepan. Add liquid and vinegar. Stir until smooth. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil 1 minute stirring. Add sliced beets and sugar. Heat through.

title: 1 Dish Bistro Stir-Fry
instructions: In large skillet blend soup mix with water. Boil and continue boiling stirring for 1 minute until thickened. Add chicken. Cut into strips and add partially thawed and drained vegetables (ex. broccoli cauliflower and carrots). Cook uncovered stirring frequently for 5 minutes or until chicken is done. Serve over hot rice.

title: Mamaw'S Raw Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop all together. Add 1/2 cup salt to vegetable mixture. Let stand 2 hours. Drain off juice. Mix 6 cups of sugar and 1 teaspoon celery seed. Mix all; put in jars unsealed.

title: Slow-Cooked Mac N Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Place in a 3-quart slow cooker.

title: Vinaigrette Sauce
instructions: Mix together the vinegar mustard salt and pepper then slowly add the olive oil. If the sauce is too thick add some water. Serve with asparagus salad or your favorite vegetable.

title: Plain Pastry Or Pie Shell
instructions: For pie shell add 1/2 cup sugar and 1 egg.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add shortening brown sugar eggs vanilla and milk. Beat until smooth about 2 minutes. Stir in oats. Drop from teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients together for 3 minutes. Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Add to mixture. Put into freezer to thicken. Whip cream to a peak then beat in cream cheese and add to jello. Mix all. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sour Cream Crescents
instructions: Heat sour cream in top of double boiler until slightly yellow around edges. Soften yeast in water let stand 5-10 minutes. Put butter suger and salt in a large bowl immediately pour sour cream over ingredients in boel and stir until butter is melted. Cook to luke warm. Blend 1 cup flour into sour cream mixture beating until smooth stir softened yeast and add to flour mixture mixing well. Add 1 cup of remaining flour and beat until smooth. Thoroughly beat in eggs and remaining flour. Cover bowl and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Divide dough into 4 parts. On a lightly floured surface roll each portion into a round (1/4 inch thick). Cut each round into 12 wedged shape pieces. Roll up beginning at the wide end. Place rolls on greased sheets with points underneath. Curve into crescents. Let stand in warm place 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Arrange stalks in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch Pyrex baking dish with flowerets facing outward. Place chicken on top of broccoli. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Garnish with pimento strips. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Crumble uncooked chuck in bottom of 8 x 8-inch casserole. Add onions cheese salt and pepper. Mix soup and milk; pour over top. Add Tater Tots on top and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until Tater Tots are brown.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well. Place in 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Top mixture with bread cubes. Melt butter and pour atop bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix all-bran and boiling water. Let stand. Cream Crisco sugar eggs and buttermilk. Add bran mixture. Add flour Kelloggs Bran salt and soda. Bake in greased muffin pans at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Shape meatball mixture into balls. Brown in a skillet then drain off grease. Place in crock-pot.

title: Ann'S Old Fashioned Egg Custard
instructions: In a large 10-inch glass pie plate melt margarine; set aside. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs one at a time with a fork. Add sugar; stir well. Add flour; stir well. Add flavoring and stir. Add milk; mix and pour into pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes; turn down to 300\u00b0 and bake 30 more minutes. Cool at least 2 hours before cutting.

title: Tuna Ring
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in jello mold. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Hot Cross Buns
instructions: Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine 2 cups flour sugar salt yeast cinnamon and lemon peel; blend well. In small saucepan heat water milk and butter until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add warm liquid and egg to flour mixture. Blend at low speed with electric mixer until moistened; beat 3 minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in 3 to 4 cups flour until dough pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl. Stir 1 cup raisins into dough. On floured surface knead in 1 to 2 cups flour until dough is smooth and elastic with blisters under the surface about 10 minutes. Place dough in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel. Let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size about 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix juice and flour. Add sugar; mix and add pineapple and cheese. Pour into a casserole dish. Crush crackers and mix with melted margarine. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix well the eggs sugar oil zucchini and vanilla. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Fold in 1 cup coarsely chopped nuts. Bake in 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Keeps well and very good.

title: V-8 Turkey Soup
instructions: Brown turkey with onions and add to a large kettle with the other vegetables and juice. Cook until the vegetables are tender. Water or chicken broth may be added if too thick. Freezes well. I use zucchini carrots potatoes green beans onion peas and celery.

title: Luau Casserole
instructions: Squeeze moisture from vegetable. Combine all ingredients except vegetable. Beat until smooth. Fold in chopped vegetable. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Fish Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add frozen strawberries. Let stand until firm.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Chop onion and garlic (fine) browning in shortening. Add chili powder and bay leaves. Add meat. Add puree mashed tomatoes and water then cook slowly for 1/2 hour or until meat is done. Thicken with 1/2 cup flour or enough to thicken it. Salt to taste.

title: American Applesauce Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients down to cloves on low speed of mixer then on high until well blended. Stir in nuts and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve with fresh vegetables...cucumbers carrots celery etc or with chips as a dip.

title: Dark Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Bring to a boil. Let cool. Mix altogether. Spread into 2 loaf pans greased. Bake slowly at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into small balls. Press top with fork that has been dipped in flour to prevent sticking. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned on top 10 to 12 minutes. Cool.

title: Delightfully Different Chicken Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in frypan over medium heat. Add mushrooms and onion. Cook 5 minutes. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Brown 2 minutes. Add broth; stir until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in chicken water chestnuts and parsley. Cool. Make rice shell. Sprinkle 1/4 cup olives in rice shell. Pour chicken mixture in. Top with remaining olives. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: In frying pan melt butter. Stir in olive oil lemon juice scallions garlic salt and pepper. Place shrimp in the frying pan. Toss around until coated with mixture and slightly pink.

title: Triple Cheese Potato Bake
instructions: You will also need 1 Reynolds| Pot Lux| cookware 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: White Punch
instructions: Pour into punch bowl and serve. One gallon equals 32 cups.

title: Holiday Cut Outs
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add beaten eggs and flour which has been sifted twice with salt and baking powder. Add extract. Divide dough into 3 balls and wrap in foil. Place in refrigerator and chill. Roll cookies thin and cut into shapes. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 7 dozen cookies.

title: Asparagus Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken breasts in butter then place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix the soup sour cream and mushrooms; pour 1/4 of this mixture over the chicken breasts. Make a layer of asparagus spears. Cover with 1/2 Parmesan cheese. Add remainder of soup mixture; cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Peel and slice vegetables. Place roast and vegetables in slow cooker. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add water. Cook until roast and vegetables are tender.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Peel off skin of eggplant. Slice into medium slices a little less than 1/4 inch thick. Place in a colander and let drain for a few hours. Dip slices in flour then into batter of eggs salt pepper minced garlic Romano cheese and chopped parsley. Dip slices into bread crumbs then into flat dish lined with waxed paper. Use wax paper between each layer. After all slices are breaded place in refrigerator for at least 4 - 5 hours or preferably overnight.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil and drain potatoes and onions. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Walnut Wafers
instructions: Mix in order given and drop by teaspoons 2-inches apart onto a greased baking sheet. Bake in a hot oven 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool 1 minute before taking from the pan.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix buttermilk and pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. Add fruit and nuts. Refrigerate.

title: H.R.E.S.  Cafeteria Rolls
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Mix all dry ingredients in mixer bowl using dough hook. Blend well. Mix oil and 1 cup of water and pour into the dry ingredients and blend. Add warm water until dough is wet but stiff. Mix on high until dough leaves sides of bowl. Cover bowl and let dough rise to double in size. Punch down and knead 2 to 3 minutes. Form rolls by pinching off 2-ounce pieces. Place on lightly oiled baking sheet. Let rise until doubled in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease an 11 x 15-inch pan and sprinkle with nuts and coconut. Prepare cake mix as directed on box and pour into pan. Melt margarine and cream cheese together. After melted stir in powdered sugar. Spoon over top of cake mixture. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Shaker Pumpkin Loaves
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Beat in eggs one at a time until light and fluffy then beat in pumpkin. In separate bowl sift dry ingredients together. Beat dry into wet until it is blended well. Divide batter between 3 greased loaf pans. Bake for 60 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Old-Fashioned Spanish Bar Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cream the shortening and sugar. Add egg. Stir in applesauce flour mixture raisins and nuts. Pour into 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. When cool dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Maple Syrup
instructions: Bring to boil on high (4 minutes) the sugars and cold water. Boil slow for 6 minutes. Remove from heat. Add maple flavoring.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Drain juice from clams and pour over vegetables. In small pan add enough water to cover vegetables. Simmer until tender.

title: Creamy Potato And Ham Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine the potatoes peas and ham. In a small bowl mix the flour parsley salt and pepper into soup. Pour over potato mixture and blend well. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch baking dish sprayed with butter-flavored cooking spray. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Overnight Salad
instructions: Layer in a large bowl the lettuce (broken up in bite size) sliced onions cut up cauliflower and bacon bits. Sprinkle the sugar. Spread the Miracle Whip. Sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese. Cover tightly and refrigerate 4 hours to overnight. Toss before serving.

title: Nestle Fudge
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spray pan with Pam. Pour in ingredients and put in freezer for 30 minutes.

title: Bev'S Cheese Ball
instructions: In a bowl mix by hand the cream cheese and dry Ranch dressing. Shape into ball; wrap in foil and chill overnight.

title: Venison Or Beef Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper roast and brown well. Add all ingredients and roast in oven at 325\u00b0 for approximately 2 1/2 hours or until done. For best results use a cooking bag. Leftover juices make an excellent gravy.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13 pan. In a large bowl combine cake mix pie filling and eggs. Beat 2 minutes. In small bowl combine sugar and cinnamon. Pour 1/2 cake batter in pan. Sprinkle 1/2 sugar mixture on batter. Add remaining batter and sprinkle with remaining sugar. Bake 35 minutes or until done.

title: Green Pea Soup
instructions: Cover the green peas with hot water to which the sliced onion has been added and cook until the peas can be mashed. Mash the peas and add the one pint of hot water. Blend the margarine and flour and cook a minute or so with constant stirring but do not brown. Add the peas then the milk and cream. Season to taste with salt and white pepper and allow to boil up once. Strain and serve. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Beat white sugar eggs Crisco brown sugar salt and molasses well then add sour milk soda cinnamon flour applesauce baking powder and allspice. Beat thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes in loaf pan. Top with whipped cream to serve.

title: Orange Dessert
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and heat slowly stirring until sugar is dissolved. Stir in crumbs cereal and chopped nuts. Press half of crumb mixture into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan reserving remaining mixture for topping. Heat undiluted orange juice. Add marshmallows stirring until they are melted. Cool until mixture begins to thicken then whip until light and fluffy. Whip cream and fold into orange mixture. Pour orange mixture over crumb layer. Top with remaining crumbs. Freeze until firm. Serves 15.

title: Sugar And Spice Snack
instructions: Heat oven to 275\u00b0. Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan with shortening. Mix snacks and nuts in large bowl. Beat egg whites orange juice sugar and cinnamon in small bowl using wire whisk or hand beater until foamy. Pour over snack mixture and stir until evenly coated. Spread in pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes stirring every 15 minutes until light brown and crisp. Cool; store in airtight container. Yields about 10 cups snack.

title: Cranberry Pork Chops(Easy, Tasty And Festive)
instructions: Brown chops in bacon drippings; season with salt and pepper. Meanwhile mix remaining ingredients in a bowl. Place chops in a baking dish spread with cranberry mixture and cover. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour. Serve with baked sweet potatoes. Serves 4.

title: Butternut Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or can bake in oblong baking pan for 45 minutes.

title: Key Lime Fudge
instructions: Line 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with foil extending foil over edges of pan; butter foil. Set aside. Stir baking pieces and condensed milk in heavy large saucepan over low heat just until pieces are melted and mixture is smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in lime peel and lime juice. Stir in 1 cup Macadamia nuts; spread mixture evenly into the prepared pan. If desired sprinkle a few coarsely chopped Macadamia nuts on top. Cover and chill for 2 hours or until firm. Lift fudge from pan using edges of foil. Peel off foil. Cut into pieces. Store in airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week or in the freezer for up to 2 months. Makes 2 1/2 pounds (64 servings).

title: Salmon And Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Melt 1/4 cup butter; stir in flour. Add chicken broth salt pepper and nutmeg. Add sherry and reserved liquid. Simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in cream and blend well. Remove from heat. Saute mushrooms in remaining 1/4 cup butter in small skillet until tender. Add to sauce and mix half of sauce with cooked spaghetti and place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Combine salmon with remaining sauce and pour over spaghetti. Sprinkle with cheese and crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until brown. Serve hot.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put in ungreased baking dish. Dice American cheese on top. Add crushed potato chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add milk then sifted dry ingredients. Mix well and add vanilla. Chill 20 minutes. Roll very thin on floured surface. Cut and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Bacon And Horseradish Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and mix well. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Rice Dish
instructions: Cook rice as directed. In skillet saute onion peppers squash carrots and broccoli. Add cubed cooked chicken or pork. Add all of mixture to rice. Use a little soy sauce for flavor. Really good!

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour the boiling water over the oatmeal. Let stand 20 minutes. Mix the margarine white sugar brown sugar eggs flour soda cinnamon salt and vanilla. Add oatmeal. Mix and bake in 9 x 13-inch greased pan 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Mix well; top with slivered almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve hot with buffet bread or crackers.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix dough; divide into two loaves. Wrap in wax paper and put in refrigerator for 2 or 3 hours or it can be frozen. Slice thin and bake at 325\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Candied Carrots
instructions: Set out a small baking dish. Wash carrots and scrape. Cook whole carrots 15 to 25 minutes or until just tender. Meanwhile combine brown sugar water and margarine in small saucepan. Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved. Drain carrots and place in baking dish. Cover with sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes or until carrots are completely glazed. Baste occasionally.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Grate cheese in bowl. Add sausage and Bisquick. Mix until dough gets very stiff. Roll into small balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done or brown. Turn 2 times 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 80 balls.

title: Seasoned Oyster Crackers For Snacking(Just Like Potato Chips, It'S Hard To Eat Only One!)
instructions: Shake all ingredients together in a brown paper bag. Let stand in brown paper bag for 24 hours. Store in tins or tightly sealed containers.

title: Ginger Creams
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and molasses. Sift dry ingredients together and add to butter mixture alternately with water. Spread onto 2 jelly roll pans 11 x 16-inch. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Frost and cut into squares.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 40 to 45 cheese balls.

title: Bar-Be-Que Spareribs
instructions: Put country style spareribs in roaster (as many as you want). Add salt lemon pepper onion flakes and water.

title: Southern Spoon Bread
instructions: Bring milk to full rapid boil. Stir in cornmeal. Cook until very thick stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Beat eggs well. Add to cornmeal mixture with salt butter and baking powder. Beat for 5 minutes. Pour into well-greased 1-quart round casserole. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Honey Ham Tortilla Rolls
instructions: With electric mixer beat ham and cream cheese together until smooth. Stir in pineapple green onion and honey. Spread 1/4 cup ham mixture on each flour tortilla starting from one edge. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 8 hours before serving.

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Place lettuce and onions in a salad bowl; set aside. In a skillet fry bacon until crisp. Remove bacon; set aside. In the drippings combine all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Immediately pour over salad. Crumble bacon and add to salad; toss well. Serve immediately. Yields 4 servings.

title: Hot German Green Bean Salad
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Remove half of fat. Add onion vinegar and sugar. Simmer 5 minutes. Drain beans reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Add reserved liquid to beans and vinegar mixture. Heat through and serve hot. Yields 4 servings.

title: Jumbo Shrimp In Spicy Wine Sauce
instructions: In a frying pan saute the shrimp in olive oil for 1 minute sprinkle with jalapeno and red pepper flakes. Add lemon juice and wine to\tpan and cook shrimp covered over medium heat for 3 more minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Remove shrimp to a serving bowl. Strain the sauce and reduce it over high\theat to make 1/2 cup.\tPour sauce over shrimp. May be served hot or cold. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tennessee Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix butter eggs sugar lemon juice and vanilla together. Mix together the flour baking powder fruits and pecans. Add this to butter mixture. Pour into tube pan. Place in a cold oven; bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Julia'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt baking soda and baking powder together. Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Add flour and sour cream by alternating.

title: Amigos Party Wings(Guatemala)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 F. Mix dressing and chiles in a blender until smooth. Transfer to a small bowl chill. Combine flour and taco mix in a shallow dish mix well. Stir in oil until mixed well. If using wings remove tips first. Coat chicken with mixture on all sides. Place on slightly greased cookie pan. Bake for 15 minutes turn over and bake an additional 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Mix parsley in with ranch dressing. Use dressing as a dipping sauce.

title: Apple Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel apples and slice thinly. Put into saucepan with water and raisins. Cover and cook 15 minutes until soft. Cut bread into fingers and arrange half in a pie dish buttered side down. Cover with apple mixture then bread butter side up. Top with sugar and spices. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pudding And Cake
instructions: Sift the first 5 ingredients in a 9-inch pan. Stir in milk and melted butter. Mix together in a separate bowl 1/2 cup white sugar 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa. Sprinkle over mixture in pan. Do not stir. Pour water over this mixture; do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top this layer dessert with ice cream or Cool Whip for an extra treat.

title: Brownie Pudding
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients. Add milk oil and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Treats
instructions: In a large boiler heat peanut butter Karo and sugar over medium heat until warm. Stir in Rice Krispies. Stir until Rice Krispies are mixed in well. Place on buttered sheets. Cut and serve.

title: Banana Breakfast Smoothie
instructions: Process all ingredients in a blender stopping to scrape down sides. Pour mixture into chilled glasses.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise cheese onions garlic powder and pepper. Toss with potatoes and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Crumble 1/2 pound cooked bacon. Cover casserole with bacon and sliced green olives. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes and carrots. Salt and pepper chicken. Arrange chicken in casserole dish. Place potatoes and carrots in dish around chicken. Then add cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soups on top of ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sausage With Cabbage, Sweet Potatoes(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: Stir chicken broth and mustard in deep 12-inch skillet. Add sweet potatoes and onions. Reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook about 5 minutes until potatoes are tender stirring occasionally. Add smoked sausage and cabbage. Cover and cook 15 minutes longer stirring once or twice until potatoes are tender and cabbage is crisp-tender. Stir in apples. Cover and simmer 3 minutes until apple is crisp-tender.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until done.

title: Meme'S Spice Prune Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together and put into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients just before serving.

title: Miniature Cheesecakes
instructions: Line cupcake pans with liners. Place a vanilla wafer in bottom of each liner. In small bowl beat cream cheese sugar eggs lemon juice and vanilla until light and fluffy. Fill the liners 3/4 full with cheese mixture. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until set. Top each with spoonful of filling and 1 teaspoon nuts. Chill.

title: Salsa Cruda
instructions: In food processor (you can skip dicing steps) process peppers salt garlic oregano and cumin on \momentary\ until finely chopped. Quarter onion. Add to mixture and dice. Add 1/2 cup V-8 (hot) and tomatoes (quartered) and process until diced. Add vinegar and cilantro. Process briefly. Yields 2 cups.

title: Party Mints
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Add powdered sugar until mixture is stiff enough to work with.

title: Triple Layer Chocolate Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crumbs 1/4 cup cocoa sugar and butter. Press firmly into 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In large mixer bowl beat Eagle Brand milk flour remaining 1/4 cup cocoa egg vanilla and baking powder. Add walnuts. Spread over crumb mixture. Top with chocolate chips. Bake 20 minutes or until set. Cool. Store covered at room temperature.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan combine soup milk cheese garlic powder and pepper. Add broccoli and carrot. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Cover; cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring occasionally. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Use double boiler. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and mix. Add flour and cocoa. Mix. Add milk and water. Cook until thick. Stir occasionally. When thick add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shells. Beat egg whites. Put on top of pie. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden. Makes 3 pies or 2 deep dish pies.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft. Peel and slice. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (uncovered).

title: Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix all together and put in refrigerator.

title: Hamburg Delight Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in hot shortening and add seasonings onion carrots celery green pepper and tomato soup. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add corn olives mushroom soup and spaghetti. Pour into baking dish; top with cheese. Bake at 350` for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add powdered sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Stir in flour; press into jelly roll pan. Prick all over with fork. Chill 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake 25 additional minutes. Cut into squares while warm. Sprinkle with sugar. Yield 72 cookies. These are better if stored in a tin box for several days. Cookies get sweeter with age.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in bowl. Beat eggs and add the milk and stir into dry ingredients. Mix well. Add the sliced apples. Drop batter by spoonfuls into hot oil and fry.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook beef and drain. Spoon into dish. Top with pizza sauce and cheese. Combine Bisquick mix milk and eggs; beat until smooth. Pour over casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease well a baking sheet. Place vinegar in measuring cup; add enough evaporated milk to vinegar to make 1 cup. Set aside. In a large bowl cream butter until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla blending well. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Add milk mixture and dry ingredients alternately to creamed mixture stirring well after each addition. Stir in chopped nuts

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook drain rinse and cool spaghetti.

title: Italian Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a screw-top jar. Cover tightly and shake vigorously to blend well. Store covered in refrigerator. Shake well before using.

title: Crock-Pot Cowboy Stew
instructions: Brown beef and drain well. Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low for 12 to 15 hours.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Spray inside of double grocery bag with Pam. Combine brown sugar margarine salt cream of tartar and white syrup for 3 minutes on stove or 2 minutes in microwave. Remove from heat and add soda. Stir.

title: Homemade Champagne
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Heavenly Rice
instructions: Cok rice according to directions on box. Rinse rice with cold water. Drain well. Put into bowl. Add sugar; let set. Drain pineapple. Add to rice; stir in marshmallows. Beat 1 container whipping cream with sugar (1/4 cup) and vanilla (1/2 to 1 teaspoon). Fold into rice. Let set in refrigerator overnight or several hours.

title: Applesauce Cakes
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Roll in butter and then into sugar and cinnamon mixture.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms. Cook bacon until crispy. Pop out stems on mushrooms. Mix cream cheese and bacon. Fill tops of mushrooms with cream cheese mixture. Grease cookie sheet with bacon grease. Place mushrooms on pan and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Chocktaw Poke Greens(Modern)
instructions: Pick tender young shoots; boil in water to cover. Pour off water and rinse. Add water to cover and simmer until tender. Drain well. Toss with bacon drippings and serve at once.

title: Jean'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease bottom of 9 x 2 x 13-inch pan. Spread diced chicken on bottom. Spread Stove Top evenly over chicken then cheese and then pour mixture of soup and milk over stuffing and cheese. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix Crisco sugar and eggs; add applesauce. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Dredge raisins and nuts in flour and fold in. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Rocky Road
instructions: Combine chocolate and peanut butter chips in a large glass mixing bowl. Microwave on High until melted. Blend in remaining ingredients in order listed. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Let stand at room temperature before cutting.

title: Crawfish Fettucine
instructions: Cook fettucine according to directions. Melt margarine in a large pan; saute onion bell pepper and celery until golden. Stir in soups garlic and sherry. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in sour cream and crawfish. Simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Serve over cooked fettucine. Serves 6.

title: Kay'S Corn And Sour Cream
instructions: Cook onion in butter until soft; blend in flour and salt. Cook bacon and drain. Gradually add sour cream to first mixture stirring constantly. Heat to boiling; add corn. Bring to boil; fold in 1/2 cup crumbled bacon. Turn into serving dish; garnish with remaining bacon. Can be fixed ahead and cooked in 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well in a large bowl. Store in a tight container. Makes 1 gallon of dry ingredients. Mix 1/4 to 1/3 cup of mix to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Cheesy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in skillet. Add chicken; cook until browned. Remove chicken. Add broth 1/2 cup water and broccoli. Stir. Heat to a boil. Stir in rice and cheese. Top with chicken; cover. Cook on low heat for 5 minutes or until cooked through. Gently stir until cheese is melted.

title: Swiss Cheese Broccoli
instructions: Grease a 10 x 6-inch baking dish. In 2-quart saucepan over high heat in 1-inch boiling water heat broccoli and 1/2 teaspoon salt to boiling; cover and cook 10 minutes. Drain. Set aside.

title: Tuna Croquettes
instructions: Make mashed potatoes as directed. Stir in mustard egg and tuna; shape and roll in butter and bread crumbs. Bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with mushroom or tomato sauce.

title: Cool And Creamy Garden Wedges
instructions: *Use as many and as much as you like.

title: Hot Cinnamon Cocoa
instructions: In the top of a double boiler stir together cocoa sugar and salt. Gradually add boiling water. Place over direct heat and boil for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Add milk and cinnamon sticks and place over boiling water. Stir and heat 10 minutes. Remove sticks and stir in vanilla. Beat with a wire whisk to froth milk. Serve immediately. Yields 4 servings.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Into a bowl sift together flour baking soda and a pinch of salt. In the top of double boiler set over simmering water heat coffee and bourbon for 5 minutes (this removes most of alcohol; baking removes the rest). Add chocolate and butter all cut into pieces and heat the mixture stirring until the chocolate and butter are melted and the mixture is smooth. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in sugar. Let the mixture cool for 3 minutes and transfer it to the bowl of an electric mixer. Add the flour mixture to the chocolate mixture 1/2 cup at a time beating at medium speed and continue to beat the mixture for 1 minute. Add the eggs and vanilla and beat the batter until it is smooth.

title: Heyward'S Good For What Ails You Salad(Makes Enough For A Dozen People)
instructions: Mix fruit and sprinkle with lemon juice to prevent darkening. Serve in a large glass bowl. Good for Potluck suppers.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Crumble Oreo cookies and place in bottom of a 9 x 9-inch container. Pour chocolate syrup on top. Dip out desired amount of ice cream and spread on top of chocolate.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts (place between 2 pieces of plastic wrap and use rolling pin to flatten to uniform thickness). Dredge breasts in flour with oregano pepper and salt; shake off excess. Lightly brown in olive oil and butter. Drain on paper towels. Set aside. Saute mushrooms in remaining oil; remove from skillet. Pour over breasts. Add lemon juice chicken stock and Marsala to skillet and simmer. Add about 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed into 1/4 cup water and add to the skillet mixture. Stir constantly until becomes thick and smooth. Add 2 tablespoons butter and stir in. Pour sauce over chicken and mushrooms. Keep warm until you serve and garnish with lemon slices.

title: Sun Dill Pickles
instructions: Pack cukes in jars with all other items except vinegar and water. Bring vinegar and water to a boil. Pour over cukes within 1/2 inch of top. Seal and set in the sun for 7 to 10 days. Dont open until 5 weeks later.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Melt jello in hot water and add rest of the ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all above ingredients and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Put top crust on. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 90 minutes.

title: Jeannie And Lela'S Overnight Layered Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer lettuce celery onion water chestnuts and frozen peas. Top and seal side to side with Miracle Whip salad dressing. Do not stir together. Spread on like you were frosting a cake. Sprinkle with sugar seasoned salt garlic powder Parmesan cheese. Cover and leave overnight. Just before serving top with chopped eggs and chopped crumbled bacon. Be sure to drain bacon well after cooking it.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Cook beef and onion until meat is browned; drain well. Stir in tomato sauce and sauce mix; cook over low heat for 10 minutes stirring frequently. Spoon into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with sour cream; sprinkle with cheese. Unroll crescent rolls and place on top of cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Butterfinger Trifle
instructions: Cook brownies. Crumble half of brownies in bottom of trifle bowl. Layer 1/2 crushed Butterfingers layer vanilla pudding then layer Cool Whip. Repeat layers using chocolate pudding. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Low Sugar, Low-Fat Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut up fruit and sprinkle with Equal. Add peanuts and marshmallows. Stir in mayonnaise. When served with nachos this is a complete meal for 2.

title: Grasshopper Pie
instructions: Heat marshmallows and milk in top of double boiler over boiling water. Stir until melted. Cool thoroughly. Mix creme de menthe and creme de cocoa and most of the Cool Whip. Fold into cooled marshmallow mixture. Pour into crust. Chill until firm.

title: Chocolate Coated Fondant Balls
instructions: Beat butter until soft. Gradually add sugar and milk alternately. Divide into several sections coloring and flavoring as desired (rum orange cherry almond mint etc. perhaps a very small amount of vanilla as well). Chill until good and cold.

title: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix cereal flour soda and salt. Mix sugar oil and eggs. Beat well then add buttermilk. Mix dry and\twet ingredients together. Bake in greased muffin tins at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Keep rest of batter in refrigerator as long as 6 weeks. Use as needed.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook the spaghetti as directed and drain. Saute the onion and green pepper in butter until tender. Combine spaghetti onion and pepper soup pimento chicken and half of the cheese. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion. Combine rest of ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Chiffon Pie(Low Fat)
instructions: In large bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in cold water. Refrigerate until slightly thickened. Fold in the whipped topping and 2 cups strawberries. Pour into crust. Refrigerate for 3 hours or until set. Garnish with the remaining strawberries. Yield 8 servings.

title: A Cheap And Quick Pudding
instructions: Beat up 4 eggs; add a pint of milk and a little salt (dash). Stir in the 4 large spoonfuls of flour a little nutmeg and a little sugar to your taste. Beat it well. Pour into buttered teacups (custard dishes) filling them a little more than half full. Bake in an oven (moderate) for about 15 minutes.

title: Deer Roast
instructions: Use a small roaster with lid. Place all ingredients in roaster. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 4 hours. Serve over rice or noodles if desired. Serves 6.

title: Bettie Cook'S Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger with garlic salt then drain. Add oregano; simmer for 30 minutes. Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cook noodles then arrange in pan with alternate layers (meat cottage cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese ending with Mozzarella on top). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cabbage With Hot Vinegar Dressing
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling water until tender about 10 minutes. Drain. Cook bacon until crisp. Stir in vinegar sugar and salt. Heat and pour over cabbage. Serve.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Beat together thoroughly cake mix egg and butter. Put on buttered sheet cake pan. Mix confectioners sugar cream cheese and 2 eggs. Spread over first layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Fritters
instructions: Stir milk into well beaten eggs. Add flour and beat until smooth. Stir in fat and mix until well blended. Cut up fruit or vegetables (see following). Add to or dip in fritter batter. Drop into hot fat (375\u00b0) and fry until brown. Drain and serve hot with syrup or gravy. Yields 12 to 15 small fritters.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in 8 x 11-inch pan. Sprinkle grated cheese on top cover and bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Cream peanut butter oleo 10x sugar and flavoring. Mix well. Will be thick. Roll into balls. Melt chips and paraffin in double boiler. Dip balls into chocolate with toothpick. Always place on foil.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: For Sauce Cook onion in the margarine until tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
instructions: Mix above ingredients together until creamy. Store in refrigerator.

title: Johnny Marzetti
instructions: Saute celery\tonion and peppers lightly in butter. Remove from pan. Brown beef in same pan. Drain well to remove fat.

title: Okra Creole
instructions: Chop bacon and fry until crisp. Remove from drippings. Chop onion and pepper and cut okra into 1-inch pieces. Add to bacon drippings and stir-fry until onion is transparent. Add seasonings and tomatoes and cook about 5 minutes longer.

title: Pizza Dip And Sticks
instructions: In medium bowl beat cream cheese with electric mixer until smooth. Beat in pizza sauce green onion and oregano. Refrigerate until ready to use. Use Mozzarella cheese sticks celery carrots or wheat crackers for dipping.

title: Spring Salad
instructions: Mix together the sugar water turmeric and mayonnaise. Add celery and onion. Cook rotini. Put in colander and drain. Run cold water over. After cold add dressing.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Pour all ingredients over ice into punch bowl. Stir and ladle into cups. If recipe is doubled you do not need to double the strawberries.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan cut up apples. Cover with brown sugar and cinnamon which have been combined. Combine in a bowl the Bisquick white sugar and oats. Cut into this one egg. Put this mixture on top of the apples. Slice 1 stick of margarine over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until sides are bubbly.

title: Paul'S Hot Wings(Buffalo)
instructions: Heat oil to 400\u00b0. Recommend that you use enough oil to cover wings in deep fryer or electric skillet. Carefully place in oil. Cover.

title: Yogurt Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and pour into crust. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Makes 2 pies.

title: Aunt Vic'S Baked Beans
instructions: Mix beans sugar mustard and ketchup in baking pan. Cook bacon in frying pan. Crumble bacon; add to above mixture along with grease. Lay remaining bacon on top of beans. Lay onion in middle of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Sprinkle rice over margarine. Place chicken on the rice. Season with salt and pepper as you like. Spoon the undiluted soup over the chicken and rice. Pour the water over all. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Spanish Chicken
instructions: Place all ingredients in pot with just enough water to cover. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. If there is too much liquid remove cover and cook until most of it is evaporated. Yields 4 servings. Good served with rice.

title: New England Sponge Cake(This Was My Mother'S Recipe)
