instructions: Beat eggs vigorously. Add sugar and continue to beat rapidly. Add boiling water beating constantly the more the better. Add flavoring (vanilla may be used). Sift flour salt and baking powder. Add to first mixture and continue to beat rapidly. Pour into well-greased pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 35 to 40 minutes. Can be baked in tube pan or 13 x 9-inch if you want to use it for shortcake.

title: Coated Pecans
instructions: Roast pecans 10 to 12 minutes at 300\u00b0. In large saucepan combine remaining ingredients. Cook on high approximately 2 minutes or until forms soft ball in water. Remove from heat. Add pecans and stir by hand until sugared. Pour out on wax paper and separate.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Crumble yeast; add sugar salt and water. Beat in egg. Add 1/2 of the flour and beat. Add 1/2 of the butter and the other 1/2 flour. Let rise to double original size. Punch down cover and place in refrigerator. Dough may be used as needed for rolls. Keeps about a week.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli tops and drain. Combine with other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in a 2-quart dish. Sprinkle crushed crackers on top and brown.

title: Spicy Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients together 3 times. Mix eggs sweetener and fruit liquid. Beat at top speed of mixer until fluffy and thick (about 10 minutes). Decrease speed; add applesauce and beat 3 minutes. Carefully fold in dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Place 1/4 almond on each cookie. Bake about 10 minutes. Cookie will spring back at light touch when done. (May be placed under broiler to give deeper finish.)

title: Blueberry Pound Cake
instructions: Grease a 10-inch tube pan with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar; set aside. Cream remaining 1 cup butter. Slowly add 2 cups sugar beating well. Add eggs 1 at a time. Add vanilla. Combine 2 3/4 cups flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Dredge blueberries in 1/4 cup flour. Stir to coat well. Fold blueberries into batter. Pour into pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool and remove from pan. Let cool completely.

title: Broccoli, Cauliflower And Carrot Salad
instructions: Cut up the vegetables and mix together. Mix the mayonnaise sour cream and Ranch dressing and add to the vegetables.

title: Crawfish Pie
instructions: Add bell pepper onion and celery to butter; saute until tender. Add crawfish green onions and other seasonings. Simmer for 10 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch dissolved in water; cook long enough to thicken. Place in 9-inch pie crust and crust cover. Bake pie in preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then lower heat to 375\u00b0 and cook 35 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
instructions: Mix peanut butter and 1 cup sugar together. Add beaten egg and mix well. Add 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Press flat with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. While the cookies are cooling melt chocolate over low heat. Melt butter in chocolate. Remove from heat and add hot water. Then add confectioners sugar gradually until icing is thick enough (you may not need to use all the sugar). Add vanilla. Spread icing on top half of the cookies. Place plain cookies on top of iced cookies to make sandwiches. Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Baked Popcorn
instructions: Fill 1 large roasting pan full of popped corn free of unpopped kernels. Combine remaining ingredients in pot. Heat until it almost comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Add 1/4 teaspoon soda and mix well. Pour over popcorn and mix well. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine water cauliflower potatoes celery carrots and onion in a large pan; boil for 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Set aside. Melt butter in separate pan over medium heat. Stir in flour. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and slowly stir in milk. Return to heat and cook until thickened. Stir in vegetables with cooking liquid then stir in cheese until melted. Use salt and pepper to taste.

title: Broccoli Dip And Potato Topping
instructions: Melt butter; add onions and broccoli. No need to drain broccoli first. Cook thoroughly over low heat. Add mushrooms and soups and cook until well heated. Add cheese and almonds. This is good served warm with chips or use leftovers on toast for dinner. Serve over baked potatoes.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil 2 chicken breasts until done. Remove; cool. Cook spaghetti in same water. Drain. Melt margarine. Add soups mushrooms sour cream and garlic powder (if desired) to taste. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Add chicken and spaghetti. Mix well. Pour into greased casserole. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Stir together and pour over chopped cabbage green pepper celery and carrots. Let set overnight.

title: Butterscotch Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar milk and oleo to a quick boil (do not scorch). Cook for 6 to 9 minutes at 225\u00b0 to 230\u00b0 on thermometer. Add marshmallow cream and butterscotch morsels. Stir to melt and blend well together. Remove from heat and add vanilla.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Flatten each chicken breast to about 1/4-inch. Salt and pepper to taste top with ham. Add cheese and roll up. Secure with a toothpick. Roll in flour. Melt butter in skillet add mushrooms and onions. Saute until tender. Add water chicken bouillon parsley and chives. Boil. Add chicken rolls. Lower heat cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove chicken and bring sauce to a boil. Stir in cream. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour sauce over chicken.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Mix and marinate for a couple of hours or overnight in the refrigerator. Cook in saucepan on high heat with lid on. Bring to a boil and then lower heat. Cook until tender about 45 minutes. Skim off fat. Bring mixture to a rapid boil and add vinegar or juice from pineapple with 1/2 cup vinegar and pineapple. Taste sauce and adjust seasonings. Add 2 to 4 tablespoons more sugar if desired. Add remainder of juice from pineapple can. Make a paste of cornstarch and water and add to boiling mixture. Boil until thickened then lower heat to simmer. Add pineapple chunks. Place lid on pan and simmer until served. Yields 6 servings with some leftover. Leftovers taste better the second day. Serve with rice.

title: Peanut Butter Pops
instructions: Cream first 4 ingredients well. Roll frozen bananas in mixture. You can cut bananas in half and insert popsicle stick in each. Bananas pops may be rolled in chopped peanuts if desired. Freeze.

title: Overnight Egg Casserole
instructions: Cut crust off bread and cut into cubes; set aside. Combine milk eggs salt mustard and pepper. Lightly combine together milk mixture bread crumbs and ham or sausage. Pour mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch glass dish greased lightly. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven about 1 hour or until knife inserted comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spoon Corn Bread
instructions: Stir meal into 2 cups milk; let come to a boil stirring constantly making a mush. Add balance of milk well beaten egg salt baking powder and butter melted. Turn at once into a quart size well-greased glass baking dish. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 32 minutes or until done. Serves 6.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan. Combine cake mix and all ingredients in large bowl and beat well. Pour into pan. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until tester shows its done. Cool for 10 minutes and turn out of pan. Glaze with 1 cup powdered sugar and enough hot water to pour. Pour over cake while cake is hot.

title: Harvest Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil and vanilla; mix in about 1/4 of dry ingredients. Fold in apples nuts and remainder of dry ingredients sifted together. Bake in greased tube pan lined with wax paper. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Danish Puff
instructions: Blend and mix to a paste the first two ingredients. Round into a ball and divide in two. Put into two long strips on ungreased baking sheet. Then mix the butter water and almond. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add flour and sugar. When smooth add eggs one at a time beating well. Divide in two and spread evenly over pastry. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Do not underbake. Makes 2.

title: Sunshine Toddy
instructions: Combine ingredients in saucepan; bring to boiling. Simmer 5 minutes. Strain; pour into heated punch bowl. Float orange slices on top. Makes 8 servings. A cheerful pick-up on a blustery day!

title: Cheesy Cheddar Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients breaking up potatoes if necessary. Put in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hawaiian Style Veggie Mix
instructions: Drain pineapple; measure syrup and add water to make 1 1/2 cups. Combine liquid butter pineapple soy sauce ginger and salt in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice carrots and chives. Cover. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Tuna-Noodle
instructions: Cook noodles according to package. Meanwhile in a saucepan cook onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour soup and milk. Cook until thick and bubbly. Stir in tuna pimiento and drained noodles. Turn mixture into a casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese and bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in a greased loaf pan. Blend remaining ingredients until crumbly. Spread over apples. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Great with vanilla ice cream. Makes 2 generous servings. Can easily be doubled or tripled.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Measure and sift together flour soda and salt. Cream margarine; add sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir until mixed. Stir in mashed bananas. Fold in dry ingredients and nuts. Place in a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick Sweet Dills
instructions: Drain pickles. Slice. Return to jar. Bring mixture to a boil pour over pickles. Let cool and refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Fingers
instructions: Cream together oleo white sugar and brown sugar. Stir in egg peanut butter salt soda vanilla flour and oats. Spread in oblong pan. Do not grease. Put in oven and turn on heat at 350\u00b0. Bake 20 minutes. Do not overbake. Let cool for 1 hour and then spread with Betty Crocker chocolate frosting. After frosting mix the Icing.

title: Easy Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg salt cinnamon nutmeg and vanilla. Combine flour and baking soda and blend into mixture. You may add anything at this time. Example M&Ms raisins chocolate chips nuts etc. Drop by teaspoon onto lightly buttered cookie sheet and pat slightly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes until lightly browned.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Fry bacon till crisp. Chop into small bits. Add some of bacon grease to potatoes. Saute onion celery in remaining grease. Then mix with potatoes and bacon. Add water to skillet with vinegar and sugar. Dont make it too sweet! Simmer for a few minutes. Add a bit of cornstarch to thicken. Combine with potato mixture and stir.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Mix together in saucepan the egg sugar dates and butter. Simmer on top of stove approximately 10 minutes stirring constantly. Let cool one minute. Add Rice Krispies. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Shape into balls. Roll in chopped nuts.

title: Devonshire Sauce
instructions: Mix well by hand. Do not use blender. Spoon over the strawberries or peaches. Sprinkle nutmeg on lightly. Enjoy.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine shortening and sugars until blended. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until blended. Add flour. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Brownies
instructions: Sift flour cocoa and salt. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine flour mixture with creamed mixture. Add nuts. Grease and flour 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Weed'S Salad
instructions: Cook pineapple sugar and salt. Boil 10 minutes. Add to Jell-O and refrigerate until at least soupy. Fold in cheese and whipped cream. Refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Sift flour and sugar together; cut in butter until it looks like oatmeal. Chill 1 hour and then press into a 9-inch pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Sauce
instructions: In small saucepan mix sugar cocoa and cornstarch. Add milk. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Serve warm or cold. Refrigerate any remaining sauce. Makes 8 (2 tablespoon) servings.

title: Poached Lobster Delights And Garden Vegetables(Fish - Low Calorie)
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in saucepan. Cook and stir on medium heat until mixture thickens and boils. Add mushrooms lobster and vegetables. Cover; reduce heat. Simmer about 10 minutes or until tender-crisp stirring once. Stir in lime juice and margarine. Makes 4 servings 111 calories per serving.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix according to package directions in three 8-inch layers. Cool. Take sweet milk 3/4 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon vanilla flavoring and pour this over each layer as you ice them (prick with fork).

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; mix wet ingredients. Combine both. Add nuts. Turn into ungreased angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve frosted or plain.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Pick over crabmeat to remove shells. Add all other ingredients except bread crumbs and toss lightly. Shape into cakes roll in bread crumbs and fry quickly in hot fat. Makes 6 to 8 cakes.

title: Fruit And Nut Scones
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in margarine. Beat eggs and milk together then add date crystals to soften. Stir egg mixture into flour mixture; blend well. Turn dough onto lightly floured board and pat to 3/4-inch thick. Cut into 12 scones; place on greased baking sheet. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hobo Beans
instructions: Brown onions in oil; add ground beef. Stir with fork until brown. Add all but beans. Stir well and add beans. Put in casserole dish; bake at 400\u00b0 in oven approximately 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Serrano Salsa
instructions: Cook Serrano peppers in a cast iron skillet on high heat 10 minutes or until blackened turning peppers. Combine Serrano peppers tomatoes and next 7 ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Grilled Fish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. Spray the vegetable oil over the baking sheet 3 times to coat. Put the cornmeal thyme and basil on a large plate and mix well. Sprinkle 1/8 teaspoon of the garlic powder 1/8 teaspoon of the lemon pepper and 1 teaspoon of the blackening seasoning on each of the catfish fillets. Coat the fillets thoroughly with the cornmeal mixture and transfer them to the prepared baking sheet. Dust each fillet with 1/8 teaspoon of the paprika. Coat the catfish lightly with the cooking spray. Place the baking sheet on the bottom shelf of the oven. Bake for 20 minutes. Reduce the heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for about 5 minutes more until the crust is golden and the fish flakes easily.

title: Spaghetti Salad Supreme
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and cool. Add to spaghetti chopped onion bell pepper diced tomato and cucumber. Marinate with Italian seasoning. Add salad seasonings. Cover; refrigerate. Serve cool.

title: Low-Fat Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Chill overnight.

title: Aunt Brenda'S Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate together. In a bowl mix sugar and eggs. Beat well. Add flour and salt which have been sifted together. Blend thoroughly. Add melted butter/chocolate mixture. Blend well. Add vanilla and nuts. Mix. Spread on lightly greased bottoms of 2 shallow 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pans or 1 large shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Do not overbake. Cut in squares while hot. Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

title: My Mother'S Rolled Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter sugar milk and vanilla. Add flour a little at a time. Roll out a small amount of dough at a time to approximately pie crust thickness. Cut with cookie cutters. Decorate with colored sugars etc. (or frost after baking). Using a greased cookie sheet bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Blend
instructions: Mix in blender or by hand. Can be stored in a food container in the fridge to use by the cup or spoonful in a myriad of ways.

title: Pretty Holiday Divinity
instructions: Butter sides of 2-quart saucepan and place first 4 ingredients in. Cook; stir constantly until sugar dissolves and mix comes to a boil. Cook to hard ball stage (250\u00b0) without stirring. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually beat in gelatin until stiff peaks form. Pour hot syrup slowly over egg white mixture. Beat constantly at high speed until soft peaks form and mixture starts to lose its gloss. Stir in nuts and coconut. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Mexican Hot Chocolate
instructions: In a large saucepan combine 1 cup milk sugar chocolate and cinnamon. Cook and stir over medium-low heat until chocolate is melted. Gradually stir in remaining milk. Cook and stir until milk is very hot almost boiling but do not boil. Gradually stir 1 cup of hot mix into eggs then return all to saucepan. Cook and stir for 2 minutes over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Beat with beater until frothy. Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream. Makes 6 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Pineapple-Mandarin Frost
instructions: Combine mandarin pineapple and lime juice and chill thoroughly. To serve pour fruit juice mixture into chilled bowl with mandarin Ice Ring Carefully pour in carbonated water swirl gently to mix. Float scoops of sherbet on top. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cookies From Cake Mix
instructions: Mix well. Add whatever you want to use; white yellow or chocolate cake mix.

title: Toasty Breakfast Pockets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Using 3-inch Cut-N-Seal cut 6 circles from cheese slices on Cutting Board. Cut each circle into quarters using My Safe Cutter. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate. Cut the remaining scraps of cheese into small pieces and place in Classic 2-Quart Batter Bowl.

title: Hearty Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 4-quart Dutch oven. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Beef 'N Rice Skillet
instructions: Lightly brown meat and butter in a large skillet. Season with 1 teaspoon salt and crushed pepper. Meanwhile thinly slice onion and pepper. Add to pan. Stir in rice. Saute over high heat until rice is lightly browned. Add tomatoes mustard and remaining salt. Mix well. Boil and simmer 5 minutes uncovered.

title: Berried Delight
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and butter. Press firmly in bottom of cake pan. Chill. Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in half of Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Arrange fruit in even layers. Using milk prepare pudding as directed. Pour over fruit. Chill overnight. Before serving cover with remaining Cool Whip. Different fruits may be used in place of pineapple (3 sliced bananas 4 cups sliced peaches or 2 pints strawberries).

title: Mother'S Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar and egg together. Dissolve soda into applesauce and add. Sift flour cinnamon and cloves with part of flour. Add to the first mixture. Add enough flour to make a fairly stiff batter (amount depends upon the thickness of the applesauce). Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Praline Supreme
instructions: Spoon ice cream onto pie crust. Place crumbled cookies over ice cream. Combine pudding mix sugar and milk in bowl. Blend with mixer on slow speed for 1 minute. Fold in carton of Cool Whip. (Save a tablespoon for dollop.) Place Heath crunches over topping and a dollop of Cool Whip for garnish.

title: Uncle Vern'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Chop the first 3 ingredients fine. Mix the water sugar and salad dressing together. Pour dressing over cabbage. Mix well. Better if sits overnight.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Sift together the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Add the egg and milk; mix well and beat until smooth. Hold finger over bottom of funnel. Pour in 1/3 cup batter. Remove finger and let batter drop in a spiral motion in hot oil. Fry until golden brown on both sides. Remove; drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve warm. Yields 3 large cakes.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Mix Jell-O and water. Use a 2-cup container. Pour in cran-orange and enough water (I use orange juice) to make 2 cups. Add to Jell-O plus the celery and nuts. Pour into mold and enjoy a couple of hours later.

title: Dan Patrick'S Crabmeat Melts(Celebrity Favorite)
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except crackers. Top each cracker with 1 tablespoon of the crabmeat mixture. Place on a cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes. Makes 36. These hot and spicy appetizers are fast and easy enough to make as a snack during halftime. Enjoy!

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time; mix by hand. Add vanilla. Combine dry ingredients; sift into above mixture. Add milk a little at a time. Add nuts. Grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 10 x 15-inch pan. While still hot spread Marshmallow Creme over top. Let cool. Frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in pan. Drain. Crumble beef and mix with remaining ingredients. Mix well. Put in a greased casserole and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. It is better looking if you sprinkle some grated cheese on top before baking. Freezes well.

title: Chocolate Fudge Sauce
instructions: Boil slowly until a ball can be formed in cold water.

title: Marinara Pasta Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in large pot. Peel and slice garlic and add to oil. Immediately add tomatoes and tomato puree. Do not brown the garlic! Stir once. Cover and simmer sauce for at least 3 hours stirring occasionally. The sauce will turn from a bright red to more of an orange color when it is done. Serve over pasta with grated peccerino romano cheese.

title: Prompt Meat And Potatoes
instructions: Using a small casserole flat dish layer these ingredients in order of the letters PROMPT. Grease dish well with butter and begin layer with potatoes uncooked rice chopped onion raw ground beef pepper and salt. Top with tomato sauce. Bake 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with shredded cheese if desired before serving. This is an easy and quick recipe.

title: Appluscious Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Beat for 3 minutes at medium speed. Blend together the flour baking powder soda salt and cinnamon and fold in apples and walnuts. Grease and flour a spring-form angel food pan. Pour in batter and bake for 1 1/2 hours. Remove carefully as it tends to stick to sides.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into baking dish. If too dry add a little chicken broth. Bake\tat 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Slice squash; place a layer. Sprinkle with flour salt and pepper. Sprinkle grated cheese and diced onions. Repeat 3 or 4 layers.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add Certo. Boil hard for 1 minute. Ladle into hot jars and seal. Immediately invert jars for 5 minutes then turn up right (helps to seal). About 1 hour later shake jars to mix peppers before completely set. Great with cream cheese and crackers. Yields about 6 to 8 half-pints.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together. Add salt and pepper. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Melt margarine and mix with crushed crackers and spread on top of vegetable mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Place cheese in bowl. Add half and half to make of spreading consistency. Stir mustard in. Spoon into serving dish. Serve with crackers vegetables or apples. Yields 8 servings.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and drain mushrooms. Remove stems and discard. Melt 1/4 c. butter on each of two cookie sheets. Mix all ingredients and stuff. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 making sure the meat is well-cooked. Drain on towels and serve hot.

title: Granny'S Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Boil pineapple and jello until dissolved. Cool. Mix buttermilk and Cool Whip. Mix all together; chill and serve.

title: Pecan Sandies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth and creamy. Add the vanilla and water. Beat well. Gradually add flour and salt until well blended. Add pecans and beat until well mixed. Cover and chill for 1 hour.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add spaghetti sauce mix and tomato sauce. Simmer 12 to 15 minutes. Pour into large casserole dish. Drop spoonfuls of sour cream on meat and cover with grated Mozzarella cheese.

title: Sunflower Seed Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and shortening together. Add eggs beating well. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture; mix. Add chocolate chips or raisins. Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in oil until transparent and thoroughly cooked. Add broth and black pepper. Simmer 30 minutes. Divide into 6 ovenproof casseroles or bowls. Top each with a slice of toasted French bread. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place in oven or under broiler until cheese is melted. Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Boil chicken. Melt butter and blend in flour salt and pepper. Add chicken broth and cook until mix thickens. Add heavy cream. Stir in cream and wine in pan. Put all broccoli crosswise. Pour mix over it. Put chicken in dish. Sprinkle cheese over ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Dill Weed Dip
instructions: Mix all together. Keep in refrigerator. Very good with vegetables or chips.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13 pan. Pour graham cracker crumbs over butter. Pour Eagle Brand milk over graham crackers. Then layer remaining ingredients. Press lightly into milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or golden brown.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture forms a stiff ball. Add food coloring if desired. Knead. Store in refrigerator in a plastic bag or container.

title: Oreo Cake
instructions: Crumble cookies and add milk. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan . Mix cheese Cool Whip and sugar. Spread this on the crust. Mix chocolate pudding and milk; spread on top. Cover with cookie crumbs. Refrigerate.

title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine butter flavor Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Beat egg into creamed mixture. Combine salt flour and baking soda. Mix into creamed mixture just until blended. Stir in pecans or walnuts and chocolate chips. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 3-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake one sheet at a time from 8 to 10 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool for 2 minutes.

title: Spicy Peaches In Syrup
instructions: Place peach halves in two 1 quart jars. In medium saucepan combine reserved peach syrup vinegar cinnamon and allspice. Bring to a boil. Pour syrup over peaches in jar. Cool. Cover. Refrigerate at least 8 hours to blend flavors. Serve as an accompaniment for ham or pork. Yields 16 servings.

title: Last Minute Rolls
instructions: About 1/2 Hour Before Dinner Into scalded milk in a large bowl stir sugar salt and shortening. Cool until lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast into warm water in measuring cup. Stir until dissolved. Stir into lukewarm milk mixture. Add flour. Stir until well blended about 1 minute. Cover batter with wax paper and towel. Let rise in warm place (80\u00b0 to 85\u00b0) until doubled in bulk. Stir well then beat vigorously about 1/2 minute. Fill greased 3-inch muffin pan cups about 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Remove from pans while hot. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Soak poppy seeds in milk for 2 hours. Then sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter with vanilla. Add sugar gradually creaming until fluffy after each addition. Beating only until smooth after each addition alternately add dry ingredients in fourths poppy seed/milk in thirds to creamed mixture.

title: First Down Dip
instructions: Microwave process cheese spread and sour cream in small bowl on HIGH 2 1/2 to 3 minutes or until smooth stirring after 1 minute. Stir in remaining ingredients. Serve warm with soft pretzels and vegetable dippers. Yield 1 1/2 cups.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Melt margarine and saute onion until tender. Add rice soup and cheese to the onion. Stir in the drained broccoli and blend all ingredients. Pour into a greased casserole and sprinkle top with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbling. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Yeast Rolls W-R
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Beat egg; add to yeast and water 1 teaspoon sugar; set aside. Mix oil water sugar milk and salt together; add to yeast mixture and mix. Add flour 2 cups at a time until bouncie. Put in lightly oiled pan; let rise until doubled in bulk or size. Knead lightly and make into rolls. Let rise 2 to 3 hours. Put in warm place. Do not set over pilot light as they will rise too fast. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Brush with butter and brown.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar melted margarine buttermilk and vanilla. Add coconut last. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Put into preheated 375\u00b0 oven. Bake 10 minutes. Then lower heat to 300\u00b0 and bake for approximately 30 minutes or until set and begins to brown.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli and cauliflower in bite-size pieces. Toss vegetables with bacon. Mix sugar vinegar onion and mayonnaise. Pour on vegetables and toss. Add raisins and stir well. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Soak raisins for half a day in 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil after soaking. Add remaining ingredients except corn starch. Thicken with cornstarch with a bit of raisin juice. Makes 2 pies.

title: Cappuccino Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Store in airtight container. Makes 3 cups of dry mix.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine chocolate and water; bring to a boil and stir until chocolate melts. Cool; stir in vanilla and set aside. Cream shortening; gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each addition. Add chocolate mixture; beat until blended. Combine flour soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) until stiff peaks form; fold into batter. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9 inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely. Spread coconut-pecan frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake. Garnish with pecans if desired.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients well and pour into 2 separate iron skillet and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Break up cake and put in a cake pan. Mix Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water and 1 1/2 cups cold water. Mix in strawberries and 1/2 tub Cool Whip. Pour over cake. Add remainder of Cool Whip to top of cake. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 days before serving.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and pumpkin. Mix egg and vanilla. Stir in rest of ingredients. Drop by tablespoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Happy Birthday Cake
instructions: Sift first 3 ingredients into bowl. Add shortening sugar 1/2 cup milk extracts and 1 egg. Beat 2 minutes on low speed. Add 1/4 cup milk and 2 eggs. Beat 2 minutes on low speed. Pour into greased layer pans and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Yields 2 (9-inch) round layers.

title: Pizza Potatoes
instructions: Brown beef. Place potatoes and onion in large buttered baking dish. Add beef. Mix soup and little milk until smooth and add to meat and potatoes. Mix together. Combine tomato sauce salt pepper and sugar. Pour over top of mixture. Dot with butter. Cover and bake at least 1 1/2 hours uncovered. Place cheese on top. Return to oven until cheese melts about 15 minutes.

title: Green Beans Mornay
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish alternately layer beans and onions. Combine soup milk and marjoram. Pour over beans and onions. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake uncovered for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Pina Coladas
instructions: In blender add 2 1/2 to 3 cups chipped ice pineapple juice 3 tablespoons cream of coconut and 1 tablespoon pineapple. Mix well. Then add 2 1/2 to 3 ounces of rum (size of blender cap of lid).

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix crab meat seasoning salt and baking powder. Mix egg and mayonnaise; add to crab mixture. Make into 8 cakes and fry until browned.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Saute the onion celery and green pepper in a large skillet or wok. Cook and stir until the onion is tender about 3 minutes using medium-high heat. Stir in the rice the soup base and soy sauce. Cook on low heat stirring frequently for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Sweet And Savory Meat Ball
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and shape into balls. Brown in skillet and pour off accumulated fat. Mix other ingredients. Place meat balls into a baking dish and cover with soup mixture. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 6.

title: Cheese Biscuits (Red Lobster)
instructions: Combine Bisquick milk and cheese until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Combine butter and garlic. Brush over biscuits while warm.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat brown sugar and water. Boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat; add vanilla and margarine. Mix well. Pour a little hot mixture into eggs. Put egg mixture back into pot. Heat together until thickens. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Add pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned.

title: Escalloped Oysters
instructions: Butter a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Check oysters for shell pieces. Layer crushed crackers\toysters butter salt and pepper about 2 or 3 layers. Pour any oyster juice over top. Scald milk. Pour over all. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Insert knife in center;\tshould come out clean like a custard pie. This can be doubled easily; use a larger casserole.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Mix graham crackers and oleo in 14 x 9 x 2-inch pan for crust. (May use pre-made graham cracker crust.)

title: Aunt Sally'S Cocoa Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar and egg. Add buttermilk vanilla and chopped nuts. Sift flour soda salt and cocoa. Chill 1 hour. Grease sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Have all cheeses at room temperature. Grate or cut fine American and sharp cheese. Cream all in electric mixer. Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce while mixing. Chill several hours or overnight. Make into 3 or 4 balls. Roll in chopped nuts or in parsley.

title: Sage Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: John Wayne'S Chili Cheese Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Remove seeds from chilies and dice. Combine grated cheeses and chilies. Put in buttered shallow 2-quart casserole dish. Beat egg whites until stiff. In another bowl combine egg yolks milk flour salt and pepper and mix until well blended. Gently fold egg whites into egg yolk mixture and then pour over cheese mixture. Using a fork ooze it through the cheese mixture. Bake for 30 minutes. Arrange tomatoes on top and then bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Chop Stick Casserole
instructions: Mix lightly except save 1 cup noodles for the top. Put in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Smoky Salmon Spread
instructions: Mix well; shape into ball or log. Wrap in wax paper and chill (may be frozen). To serve roll in chopped pecans or parsley.

title: Ice Box Fruitcake
instructions: Melt 1 lb. of marshmallows and can of Carnation milk in double boiler. Crush 1 lb. box of graham crackers and pecans. (Cut top of box across top so cake can be placed in box once all ingredients are mixed together.) Combine cherries raisins and marshmallows. Mix all ingredients together and put in graham cracker box and let set in freezer for a couple of days.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook cabbage in enough water to cover; cook for 2 minutes. Drain and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients and place on cabbage leaves. Roll up and secure with toothpick. Wrap rolls in foil and place in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cider Wassail
instructions: Simmer all ingredients (put spices in a cloth if desired) for 20 minutes. Remove spices and serve hot. A few red hot candies may be added to each cup if desired.

title: Blueberry Pound Cake
instructions: Grease 10-inch tube pan with 2 tablespoons of butter. Sprinkle pan with 1/4 cup of sugar. Set aside.

title: Gourmet Turkey Dressing
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Saute onions celery and mushrooms. Pour over torn toasted bread. Add browned hamburger eggs seasonings and chicken broth. Mix together well. Stuff turkey or chicken or place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 until top is brown. Serves 12.

title: Mary'S Persimmon Beer
instructions: Place pine straw at the bottom of the crock. Fill crock with whole persimmons leaving a 3-inch air space at top. Sprinkle with sugar. Add warm water to cover. Seal. Let stand for 1 week. Strain free-flowing liquid through spigot and drink. Try it.

title: Broiled London Broil With Purple Plum Sauce
instructions: Score the steak quite deeply with a sharp knife all the way down its length on the diagonal about every 1/2-inch. Turn steak around and repeat scoring in opposite direction so score marks become little squares.

title: Date Bar Dessert
instructions: Prepare date bar mix as directed. Let cool. Crumble and mix in whipped cream.

title: Bloody Mary'S For A Crowd
instructions: In large pitcher combine all except lime or lemon slices; refrigerate to chill. To serve pour into tall glasses with ice cubes. Top with lemon or lime slice. Also a stalk of celery may be added to each drink.

title: Easy Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in 8 to 9-inch baking dish. Add sugar to blackberries and lemon juice. Let come to boil. Add muffin mix and milk. Stir until well blended. Spoon into baking pan with butter (dont stir). Spoon hot blackberries and juice evenly over batter (do not stir). Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Batter For Chicken(Wing Dings)
instructions: Mix together and dip wings until completely covered. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Easy Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients and pour into large baking dish. Arrange pieces of chicken on top. Sprinkle with parsley flakes paprika and dot with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours uncovered or until tender. Add a bit more water if necessary; do not salt. Soups have plenty of salt in them. Serves 8.

title: Wild Rice Shrimp Bake
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on package. In a large skillet saute mushrooms green peppers onions and shrimp. Shrimp will turn pink. Add soup to the rice and stir. Add shrimp mixture to rice and soup. Stir and transfer to a well-greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole(Serves 4 To 8)
instructions: Saute celery; add chicken and cook until chicken turns white then brown. Combine all ingredients to mix except for cornflakes. Place in an 8 1/2 x 11-inch greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cornflakes and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease jelly roll pan. Mix brown sugar butter and eggs until well blended. Sift dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture; mix well. Add chips and pecans. Spread in prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes. Let stand for several minutes before cutting into squares.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Mix soups onion pepper chili powder garlic and tomatoes. In a buttered casserole layer tortillas layer chicken layer soup and layer cheese. Continue to layer in order until all ingredients are used ending with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve over rice or plain. Freezes well.

title: Mock T-Bone
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and blend with hamburger. Shape into small t-bone 1 to 1 1/4-inch thick. Douse with Worcestershire sauce on broiler pan. Broil 5 minutes on each side.

title: Creamy Orange Pie
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter press firmly on bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate. Chill. In large mixing bowl beat cheese until fluffy gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk then juice concentrate until smooth. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into crust. Chill 2 hours before serving. Garnish with fresh orange slices and whipping cream if desired. Store in refrigerator.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Beat egg add buttermilk and mix. Set aside. Shake together flour parsley pepper and paprika. In another bag shake together cornflake crumbs and cheese. Drop chicken in egg mixture the flour mixture back in egg mixture then the cornflake mixture. Take chicken and press down in cornflake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cake With Fruit
instructions: Mix ingredients. Cook in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 and sprinkle with powdered sugar or microwave in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch microwave dish for 8 1/2 minutes turning 1/2 turn every 2 minutes or place in Dutch oven with charcoal (9 on top and 9 on the bottom) and cook for 45 minutes (good on a campout).

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. In separate pan saute onion and green pepper in the margarine until tender. Meanwhile cook spaghetti as directed on package and drain. Put spaghetti in a shallow pan. Add ground beef to drained sauteed onion and green pepper. Add spaghetti sauce. Pour on top of the spaghetti. Sprinkle top with Mozzarella cheese until lightly covered. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes until cheese is lightly browned. Let stand for 10 minutes. You may add extra Ragu and Mozzarella cheese if needed.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute zucchini onion and tomatoes in olive oil. Add corn salt pepper and garlic salt. Cover with shredded Cheddar cheese. Cover with lid and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Anginetti Cream Puffs
instructions: Prepare Anginetti cookies by slicing off tops (about half the cookie). Set aside. Drain crushed pineapple leaving a little juice. Mix whipped topping and cream cheese together in a bowl for about 1 minute at medium speed. Add crushed pineapple and blend all three ingredients for about 1 minute at low speed. Drop about a tablespoonful of filling onto the bottom of cookies and replace tops. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Filling should be enough to fill all of the cookies in a package.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Saute celery green pepper medium onions and garlic in 2 tablespoons bacon grease or margarine for 10 minutes.

title: Poncho'S Jambalaya(240 Servings)
instructions: Total liquid for jambalaya should be 8 gallons including sauces soup and water.

title: Chocolate Chiffon Pie
instructions: Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Combine chocolates and 1/2 cup water; stir over low heat until thick and blended. Remove from heat. Add gelatin and stir until dissolved. Beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup sugar until light. Add chocolate mixture salt and vanilla extract and cool in refrigerator to room temperature. Gradually beat 1/2 cup sugar into beaten whites; fold into chocolate mixture and pour into cooled pastry shell. Chill until firm. Whip the heavy cream until stiff and add 1 tablespoon sugar and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract. When ready to serve use the heavy whipped cream as topping for the pie.

title: Baked Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). In a 1-quart casserole dish combine mushrooms onion garlic green pepper Italian seasoning seasoning salt pepper and parsley. Pour water and butter over mixture; cover. Bake in preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add and mix the rest of the ingredients with the jello. Chill until set.

title: Sour Cream Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes.

title: Russian Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Dawn'S Frozen Strawberry Pie
instructions: Blend Cool Whip sweetened condensed milk and daiquiri mix together. I use mixer to make sure it is mixed well. Pour into pie shells and place in freezer.

title: Baked Eggs
instructions: Combine eggs milk salt and dry mustard. Pour over bread. Top with butter. Refrigerate overnight covered. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grandma'S Poultry Dressing
instructions: In a skillet brown sausage. Drain and discard the drippings. In a large mixing bowl combine sausage and remaining ingredients; mix well.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a crock-pot which has been greased with 2 tablespoons shortening. Cut several strips of cheese and put on top. Sprinkle with paprika. Cook 3 to 4 hours on low.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour in a big bowl and pack down in middle leaving a hole in middle. Pour in milk and oil. Mix with hand slowly until thick. Then clean hand. Flour hand and knead over dough until it is just stiff enough to pinch off and roll up in your hand. Place on greased baking pan and pat down with melted margarine. Bake at 450\u00b0 to 500\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and remove bones. Place in bottom of casserole dish. Use broth to prepare stuffing mix; set aside. Heat together both cans of soup; pour over chicken. Spoon stuffing mix over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease baking dish. Crumble bread into crumbs. Mix all ingredients; pour into baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Sift the first 3 ingredients 2 or 3 times. Put in bowl the egg plus enough milk to make 1/2 cup. Beat and combine with dry ingredients. Drop into liquid 1/2 tablespoon at a time. Bake or cook 10 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Take a fork and punch a couple of holes in each one. Place in baking dish. Pour a bottle of Italian dressing over the chicken. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover with aluminum foil; marinate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 until a golden brown (about 1 hour).

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: There will be enough dressing for 2 salads.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients; cook until thick. Cool; pour over sliced strawberries in a cooked pie shell or a graham cracker crust.

title: Meat Sauce
instructions: Mix flour curry and mustard; blend into butter. Add other ingredients; bring to boil and simmer 2 hours. Serve over London Broil.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute sausage celery onion bell pepper and garlic. Put in a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Add mushroom soup chicken soup wild rice chicken broth chestnuts mushrooms and spices. Mix and top with almonds. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Quick Cinnamon Bread Snack
instructions: Spread butter on bread slices. Sprinkle on cinnamon and sugar. Place in microwave and cook for 2 minutes on medium. Remove and roll them. Enjoy with milk.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: *May also use 1/2 cup Cheez Whiz.

title: Banana-Pecan Pie
instructions: Mash half of the banana and cube the other half. Blend all the ingredients; pour into the pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes until crust is golden and filling is set. Let cool at least 2 hours before cutting.

title: Seafood Pasta
instructions: Saute the first 4 ingredients. Add shrimp and crab meat. Mix together spaghetti and serve warm. Serve with Greek salad.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Chip Cookies
instructions: In small bowl combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt. In large bowl cream butter brown sugar granulated sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually beat in dry ingredients. Stir in Nestle milk chocolate morsels oats and walnuts.

title: Peach Or Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar water and cornstarch and boil until thick stirring constantly. Stir in jello. Place sliced fruit in a cooked pie crust. Spoon mixture over fruit and chill for several hours. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes in halves or quarters; place in baking dish. In a small saucepan bring to boil brown sugar water salt and butter. Pour over sweet potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes basting occasionally.

title: Irish Soda Bread Aunt Gussies
instructions: Sift together into a mixing bowl the flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Stir in raisins and caraway seed with eggs buttermilk and melted butter in mixing bowl. Add dry ingredients and mix lightly. Pour into greased loaf pan 9 x 5 x 3-inch. Bake at 375\u00b0 for one hour or until done.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a bowl with a beater until fairly smooth. Amounts of salsa and sour cream may be increased to suit taste and/or to increase smoothness.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Heat sugar corn syrup and milk to a boil on medium-high and boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and butter. Beat by hand until cool and pour onto buttered platter. Dont try to make fudge on a rainy day; it wont set properly.

title: Poor Mans Almond Roca
instructions: Sprinkle nuts onto well greased pan. In a saucepan melt butter. Add brown sugar. Stir constantly for 7 minutes. Pour mixture over nuts immediately. Top with chopped chocolate. Let chocolate melt; then spread over batter with a table knife. Place pan in freezer about 20 minutes. Then cut into squares. Store in refrigerator.

title: Main Dish Cabbage
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef in skillet. In a 1 1/2 quart casserole layer half the cabbage and half the ground beef; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Layer the other half cabbage and ground beef; again sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with tomato soup. Bake covered in 350 degree oven for 1 hour.

title: Hawiian Spareribs
instructions: Beat together eggs flour salt and pepper. Coat ribs with this batter and brown on all sides in fat. Cover and cook slowly for 45 minutes. Pour off drippings. Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Stem and seed peppers and cut into one-inch squares. Add peppers and pineapple to meat. Cover and cook slowly for 10 minutes. Add enough water to reserved pineapple juice to make one cup liquid. Mix cornstarch soy sauce sugar vinegar and pineapple liquid. Cook stirring until thickened. Pour over meat mixture and cook slowly for five minutes. Serves three or four.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Butter casserole dish; arrange alternate layers of potatoes onions cheese and margarine. Sprinkle each layer with salt and black pepper. Pour cheese sauce over all; add more cheese if you like. Sprinkle with generous amount of paprika. Cover and bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Remove cover and bake 15 more minutes.

title: Jello Pudding Pecan Pie
instructions: Blend pudding mix with corn syrup. Gradually add evaporated milk and egg stirring to blend. Then add pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 until top is firm and just begins to crack about 40 minutes. Cool at least 3 hours.

title: Sinful Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine Jell-O and boiling water. Stir with rubber spatula until Jell-O is completely dissolved. Cool. Add bananas pecans strawberries and pineapple to Jell-O stir to combine. Divide in half. Pour half the Jell-O mixture into a 12 x 8-inch pan and refrigerate until set about 1 hour keeping remaining Jell-O at room temperature. Spread sour cream or cream cheese evenly over set Jell-O. Pour on remaining Jell-O. Cover and refrigerate until set about 1 1/2 hours or overnight.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order listed except the cheese. Pour half of the batter in greased baking dish then half the cheese sprinkled on the batter. Add the rest of batter and cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Sweet Potatoes With Apples
instructions: In a large saucepan cover sweet potatoes with water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until just tender. Drain and cool slightly. Peel and cut into 1/4-inch slices. Alternate layers of potatoes and apples in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour orange juice over potatoes and apples. Mix brown sugar ginger and cinnamon then sprinkle over potatoes and apples. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Reuben Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in baking pan. Cover with sauerkraut. Cover them with the dressing and sprinkle the cheese. (I use the slices.) Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is done in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Crystal Cucumber Pickle
instructions: *Tie spice in cloth.

title: Braised Cabbage
instructions: Saute green onions in melted butter in large skillet or wok until tender. Add cabbage and carrots. Saute 4 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in salt and pepper. Can use oil instead of butter if desired.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a greased casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Layer all ingredients in casserole dish. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or microwave approximately 5 minutes.

title: Peppermint Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Add peppermint chips and mix well. Have sheet of wax paper spread out. After mixing chocolate and mint chips well pour mixture onto wax paper as thick or as thin as you want. Put in refrigerator for about 1 hour then break into pieces.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients. Heat to dissolve sugar and cool. Mash bananas well. Stir in juices bananas and cooled sugar mixture; mix well. Divide mixture into 3 containers and freeze. One hour before serving remove mixture from freezer. Spoon into punch bowl and add 1 liter of ginger ale for each frozen container used. Mix well.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Cut Velveeta into cubes and chop onion. Put all ingredients into a double boiler and cook until all cheese cubes are melted. Remove from heat. Keep stirring until there is no film on top. Dip tortilla chips and enjoy. Refrigerate when not using. Can be served warm or cold.

title: Heavenly Ambrosia
instructions: Drain pineapple. Reserve liquid. Add cold water to liquid to measure 1 cup. Stir boiling water to jello in large bowl. Stir until completely dissolved. Stir in measured liquid. Refrigerate about 1 1/4 hours. Stir in Cool Whip with whisk until smooth. Refrigerate for 10 minutes. Stir in rest of ingredients and chill for about 4 hours. Yields 10 servings.

title: Blueberry Supreme
instructions: Blend cream cheese and sugar. Fold cream cheese mixture into Dream Whip mixture; pour on cool crust. Spread blueberries on top. Let cool good; then enjoy.

title: Steamed Cabbage And Smoked Sausage
instructions: Core and shred cabbage and wash well. Cut sausage in 4 to 6 pieces then slice down the center. Place cabbage in large skillet. Cover with just enough water to steam it about 1 cup water. Place sausage on top of cabbage. Cover; cook over low heat until sausage is done and cabbage is tender. Serves 4.

title: Cinnamon Twist Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Pour milk over sugar salt and shortening; cool to lukewarm. Beat in half of flour and beaten eggs. Stir in yeast raisins and rolled oats. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead until satiny about 10 minutes. Round dough into ball and place in greased bowl. Cover. Let rise until double or 1 hour. Divide dough into 2 parts. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Fudge For Ice Cream Topping
instructions: Melt the oleo salt and chocolate. Stir in the condensed milk powdered sugar and vanilla. Bring to boil for a few minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Dressing(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt margarine and beat eggs slightly. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and pour into an unbaked 8-inch pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 until filling is firm.

title: Parsley Garlic Rolls
instructions: Coat a 12-c. muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl combine the melted butter parsley garlic and salt; mix well. On a lightly floured surface roll the bread dough into a 12 inch square. Spread the parsley mixture over the dough leaving a 1/2 inch border on the top and bottom edges. Roll dough tightly jelly roll fashion starting at the bottom edge. Pinch to seal the edge. Cut the roll of dough into 1 inch wide slices. Place each slice flat side down into a cup of the muffin pan. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled in size. Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. Bake the rolls for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden. Remove from the pan and serve warm.

title: Papaw'S Favorite Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and shortening gradually. Add 2/3 cup powdered sugar and flavoring beating until light and fluffy. Gradually add flour and mix well. Stir in chopped pecans.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Top Ramen and sugar together in large bowl. Break up the Top Ramen noodles but dont cook. Mix the noodles with the sugar. Toss into salad.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake and crumble small amount in bottom of tall glass bowl. Layer pineapple pudding and cherry pie filling; start over with rest of cake and layer again. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with nuts coconut and cherries. Makes enough for large group.

title: Kristie'S Jello Cut Outs
instructions: Use cherry or strawberry flavored Jell-O for Christmas and Valentines; orange for Halloween and pineapple flavored for Easter. Use your choice of cookie cutters pumpkin Christmas trees rabbits etc.

title: Green Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts. Add nuts just before serving.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Fill 9-inch pie pan 2/3 full of peeled and sliced apples. Combine 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples. Mix together 1 cup sugar flour nuts butter vanilla and egg. Spoon this mixture over apples and pat down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with whipped cream to serve.

title: Quick And Easy Spicy Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients. Marinate in the refrigerator for 24 hours. Transfer to a fondue pot and serve bubbling. Recipe will feed several.

title: Cold Bread Pudding
instructions: Pour milk over biscuits; let set until milk is absorbed. Beat sugar eggs and vanilla; add to bread mixture. Pour into a greased 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Ham And Cheese Logs
instructions: Have Cheddar cheese at room temperature.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: *White beans or limas may be used.

title: Corn Pudding Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it sets about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Leftover Meat And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown onion in hot shortening; add meat and rice. Cook slowly until rice is golden brown. Add tomatoes water and seasoning. Stir well and pour into greased casserole. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes then remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer. Serve at once from casserole.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: In a medium saucepan pour whole bottle of chili sauce and jar of grape jelly. Over low heat stir occasionally until jelly melts. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine meat finely chopped onions bread crumbs salt and pepper. Form into small balls and place in a deep baking dish. Pour sauce mixture over meatballs making sure all are covered. Bake 35 minutes.

title: Irish Potato Casserole
instructions: In casserole dish place half of the potatoes half the cheese and 1/2 the margarine. Then add remaining potatoes cheese and margarine. Top with soup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Burritos
instructions: Cook chicken in a skillet until done. Mix mayo sour cream cumin mustard salt and pepper. Stir and add chicken; mix. Add shredded cheeses and mix. Place 2 spoonfuls on a tortilla shell. Roll up and place in baking dish. Spoon salsa over and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Alabama Rice
instructions: Simmer ingredients in skillet 20 minutes. Add consomme and water. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Stir before serving. Serves 4.

title: Low-Fat Applesauce Raisins Drops
instructions: Cream the margarine until fluffy. Blend in brown sugar and egg. Alternately add sifted dry ingredients and applesauce. Blend well. Stir in vanilla oats and raisins. Drop by tablespoons on nonstick cookie pan. Flatten dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen. Cookies stay moist.

title: Banana-Raisin Cookies(Low-Fat; No Sugar Except From Fruit)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. (Batter should be a little stiff.) Drop by teaspoon onto a nonstick or lightly greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly. Bake for about 15 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Put oatmeal into boiling water and let stand. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add oil; add oatmeal mixture and all other ingredients. Mix well as you go along. Add bread flour until you get a stiff workable dough. Knead well. Let rise. Knead again and shape into loaves. Let rise and bake at 350\u00b0 until done (approximately 20 to 25 minutes).

title: No-Knead Wheat Bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over lukewarm water. Add 2 teaspoons honey. Leave to \work\ while preparing dough. Warm whole-wheat flour by placing in oven (250\u00b0) for 20 minutes. Combine molasses with 2/3 cup water. Combine yeast mixture with molasses mixture. Stir this into warmed flour add salt and wheat germ and finally 1 1/3 cups water. (Dough will be sticky.) Butter loaf pan. Turn dough into pan. Smooth dough in pan with spatula which has been held under cold water. Sprinkle sesame seed over top of loaf. Leave to rise to top of pan in warm draft-free place. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until crust is brown and sides are firm. Set pan on rack to cool for about 10 minutes then remove. Cool completely before serving.

title: Pizza Sandwiches
instructions: Spread the butter on first; spread mixture on cut side of bread. Place cut side up on baking sheet pan. Top with thin slices of ripe tomatoes. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 20 minutes. Take out of oven. Top with 8 slices of cheese until melted about 5 minutes. Cut into 8 pieces.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter and sugars. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Add dry ingredients. Shape into balls; roll in sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Place Hersheys Kiss or star in center of each cookie while hot. Serves 48.

title: Butterscotch Bars(Unbaked)
instructions: Combine eggs sugar salt and butter in a saucepan. Heat to a boiling point. Boil 2 minutes stirring constantly. Cool. Stir in graham cracker crumbs and marshmallows. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill. Melt chips and peanut butter at low speed. Add vanilla. Spread over crumb mixture. Refrigerate. Cut into 3 dozen bars.

title: Chili Bake
instructions: Melt shortening in large skillet. Add onion green pepper and beef; brown lightly. Add tomatoes with juice to mixture in skillet. Add kidney beans chili powder salt and pepper; mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Top with cornbread mixture and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Spiced Walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix walnuts with egg white until well coated and sticky to the touch. Mix together sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over walnuts tossing until sugar mixture completely coats walnuts. Spread on ungreased baking sheet for 20 minutes stirring once. Cool. Store in tightly covered container. Makes 2 cups.

title: Double Chocolate Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir together flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Stir into egg mixture.

title: Green Bean And Potato Delight
instructions: Combine beans potatoes bacon grease and salt in pressure cooker. Cook for 1 hour on medium-high heat. Let steam escape before removing lid. Simple and easy to prepare.

title: Tan Fudge
instructions: Mix over stove the light brown sugar sugar and butter. Cook until it comes to a boil that cant be stirred down. Cook an additional 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add 1 (12 ounce) jar peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Stir and mix thoroughly. Pour onto greased cookie sheet.

title: Easy Kielbasa Bean Soup
instructions: In large saucepan or Dutch oven bring vegetables and water to boiling; reduce heat and simmer about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add kielbasa and bean soup. Heat thoroughly. Makes 6 generous servings.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole dish layer thinly sliced potatoes onion frozen vegetables and chicken. Pour in broth and soup. Cover with pie crust or biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: In a double boiler melt chocolate. Add sugar and milk. Bring to a boil stirring frequently. Reduce heat and simmer to desired consistency. Add 1 tablespoon butter. Stir until melted. Frost cooled cake.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potatoes onions water salt garlic salt oregano and pepper in a large saucepan. Cover; bring to a boil then simmer until potatoes are tender about 20 minutes. Mash potatoes slightly. Add milk and butter. Heat thoroughly. Serve. Hm good.

title: Golden Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Beat together the eggs sugar and flour; mixture will be very thick. Next heat butter and milk together in microwave about 2 minutes. Blend in the egg mixture; will become very soupy. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Can be used for sheet cake or cupcakes!! Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until toothpicks come out clean.

title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Follow directions on package of hollandaise sauce for the sauce. Heat slices of Canadian bacon. Poach eggs. Split open the muffins and toast them. Put English muffins on plate; place a piece of Canadian bacon on muffin; place poached egg over bacon (upside down); cover with sauce.

title: Cow Pies
instructions: In a double boiler over simmering water melt the chocolate chips and shortening. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Cheddar Baked Potatoes
instructions: In small pan mix soup paprika and pepper (grease pan). In 2-quart baking dish arrange potatoes in overlapping rows (go around pan). Sprinkle with cheese. Spoon soup mixture over cheese.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan and cool. Mix stuffing cheese and parsley together. Dip boned chicken in melted butter and then in stuffing mix. When all are coated place in 9 x 12-inch dish or pan and sprinkle balance of stuffing mixture on top. Drip small amount of butter on top also. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put mixture in refrigerator overnight. Roll out on floured board and cut like biscuits. Bake at once for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Frozen Cherry Delight
instructions: Combine Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Add the pie filling and crushed pineapple. Pour into 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan and freeze. Cut into squares.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix with fork. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a jelly roll cake pan. Cool. Frost with Bakery Frosting.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl; whip at medium speed for 3 to 5 minutes. Pour into crust. Chill to set and serve.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine and melt cream cheese and soup. Add all other ingredients. Stir and chill to serve.

title: Doughnuts(From Inga'S Article On Cookcars)
instructions: Flour enough to handle easily maybe 8 to 9 cups. Lard piping hot. The rolling pin was a great big log real heavy and the cookie cutter was a saucer. The doughnuts were not rolled as thin as cookies.

title: Grandma'S Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in square or oblong baking pan in a 350\u00b0 oven. Mix milk flour and sugar in mixing bowl. Pour into melted margarine; do not stir. Add flavoring to 1 large can of fruit (or fresh or frozen sweetened to taste). Pour into dough; do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until browned. Very good!

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Slowly add sugar and egg yolk. Beat until fluffy. Add flour and vanilla. Chill dough at least 1 hour. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Gently press a pecan half or cherry in center of each ball. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Yields approximately 4 dozen.

title: Boston Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Grease bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Prepare cake mix as directed on package; pour batter evenly into spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Brownies
instructions: Carefully place 2 cups water in a pot then place pot on stove and cover. Turn on heat to high. Water is ready when bubbles form.

title: No Bake Skillet Cookies
instructions: Melt the first 3 ingredients in a pan stirring until smooth. Remove from heat. Add vanilla coconut and oats. Mix thoroughly. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Refrigerate.

title: Hot Spiced Drink
instructions: Combine ingredients in saucepan and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 6.

title: Quick Brown Sugar Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar half and half and butter. Bring to a boil. Boil 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Cool to lukewarm then beat until creamy and thick enough to spread. Add cream if it gets too thick. Great for applesauce or spice cake.

title: No Fat Gazpacho Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl tossing gently to mix. Cover and chill at least 1 hour.

title: Hot Dish
instructions: Mix all together and cover with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Corn And Sausage Casserole
instructions: * Turkey sausage may be used instead of pork sausage.

title: Steamed Vegetable Platter(Serves 4)
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet heat the oil and stir in the curry powder until blended. Add the onions; when its sizzling add the broth and cabbage. Cook over medium heat stirring until slightly wilted about 2 minutes. Add more liquid if needed. Cover and cook stirring occasionally an additional 6 minutes until tender-crisp. Sprinkle with peanuts and serve.

title: Mulligan Stew
instructions: Melt shortening in soup kettle or Dutch oven. Add the beef and cook slowly until brown. Add remaining ingredients and stew until vegetables and rice are cooked.

title: Grandma'S Salad
instructions: Put dry Jell-O in bottom of bowl. Add fruit cocktail; stir. Add mini marshmallows any amount you want. Add cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Mix and let stand to set. Mix before serving.

title: Chinese Noodles Cookies(Very Good)
instructions: Melt together morsels and peanut butter over hot water (not boiling) or in a microwave for 1 minute and stir. If not long enough give it another 30 seconds to 1 minute. When melted stir in Chinese noodles. Mix well and drop on wax paper by teaspoon. Let harden.

title: Jimmy Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugars. Separate eggs; add yolks to mixture. Mix flour and baking powder. Add alternately with coffee. Add nuts and jimmies. Beat egg whites; fold into batter. Put into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Done when toothpick comes out clean.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Boil cider and spices for 15 minutes. Add honey juices and orange peel. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Brown Bag Apple Pie
instructions: Make pie shell using your own recipe. Pare core and quarter apples then halve each quarter. You should have about 7 cups of apples. Place in a large bowl.

title: Peanut Butter Yogurt Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients together. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate. May be frozen.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Spread bean dip on pizza pan. Peel pit and mash avocado and mix with lemon juice salt pepper sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix. Put on top of bean dip. Sprinkle top with onions tomatoes and olives. Cover with shredded cheese. May be served cold or heat in oven or microwave to melt cheese. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Shelley'S Salsa
instructions: *May add additional jalapenos if desired or if a hot salsa is needed add 1 Scotch bonnet pepper.

title: Italian Steak Rolls
instructions: Bone and remove the fat from the steak. Cut into 8 pieces. Beat pieces with a meat tenderizer until flat and as even as possible.

title: Praline Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Butter one 2-quart casserole dish. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (175\u00b0C). In a mixing bowl combine the sweet potatoes sugar vanilla extract eggs and cream. Blend well and spread evenly in casserole dish.

title: Fudge Pudding
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Add 1/2 cup milk and 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Blend slightly and stir in 3 tablespoon of melted butter. Put in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch greased pan.

title: Banana Fruit Cake
instructions: Beat shortening and gradually add sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs. Beat until thick and lemon colored. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with bananas. Blend in fruit raisins and nuts. Pour into a 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes. Cool and spread with glaze.

title: Strawberries And Cream
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine condensed milk and water. Mix well. Add pudding mix and beat until well blended. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 2 cups pudding mixture into 4-quart serving bowl. Top with half the cake cubes half the strawberries and half the remaining pudding mixture. Repeat layering ending with pudding mixture. Garnish with strawberries. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Ooh Yuck!
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in seasoning packet from noodles soy sauce and cooked broccoli. Cook noodles using package directions. Add to ground beef mixture. Mix well; cook until heated through. Serve with additional soy sauce.

title: Buckeye Balls
instructions: Cream peanut butter and oleo until creamy and gradually add sugar. Roll in small balls.

title: Sailor'S Salad
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions; drain. Combine macaroni celery onions crabmeat and eggs. Blend mayonnaise and French dressing. Toss macaroni mixture with dressing; chill. Serve on lettuce. Yields 8 servings.

title: Potato Au Gratin
instructions: Place potatoes in lightly greased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with rosemary and pepper. Combine with milk and gravy mix; pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until tender. Yields 6 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add bananas and eggs; beat well. Sift together flour baking soda and salt; add to batter. Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Zany Winter Drink
instructions: Break up the cinnamon sticks and put them in a \tea ball\ along with the cloves. Put the water in a large pot (should be at least a six-quart size) and bring to boil boiling for three minutes. Turn off heat; put in the tea bags and \tea ball\ containing the whole cloves and broken cinnamon sticks. Let tea steep for 30 minutes. Remove the tea ball and bags; pour in the sugar stirring until dissolved. Add pineapple juice and lemonade; stir. Heat until brew is hot enough to drink.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Slice potatoes eggs and lettuce. Blend dressing and pour over vegetables. Garnish with sliced tomatoes. Serves 4.

title: Chicken And Succotash Skillet
instructions: Lightly coat chicken pieces with 1 tablespoon of flour. Melt half the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cool 5 to 7 minutes turning once until lightly golden. Remove to plate with slotted spoon. Reduce heat to medium. Melt remaining butter in skillet; add onion and cook about 4 minutes stirring often. Add bell pepper and cook 2 to 3 minutes until onion is translucent and pepper is crisp-tender.

title: Spinach Dip In Bread Bowl
instructions: Slice top off bread. Scoop out inside of bread. Cut bread which was scooped out into bite size pieces. Set aside. Squeeze out spinach. Combine with all other ingredients to make dip. Spoon dip into bread. Chill until ready to serve or if desired wrap in aluminum foil and heat at 200\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve with bite size bread pieces and fresh vegetables.

title: Baked French Toast With Blueberry Sauce
instructions: Slice bread into 12 to 14 slices about 3/4-inch thick. Place on a 10 1/2 x 15 1/2 x 1-inch cookie sheet.
