Whisk egg milk baking powder and vanilla together and slowly pour it over the bread turning to coat the bread completely. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours or overnight.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil sliced zucchini and onions in salted water until barely cooked. Drain. Place in buttered casserole dish. Add cheese salt and pepper. Beat egg and milk. Pour over zucchini. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Patties
instructions: To potatoes add egg onion salt and pepper. Mix well. Shape in 6 patties . Dip in flour then brown slowly in butter about 5 minutes on each side. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ora Avant'S Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water to dissolve. Mix plain gelatin with cold water. Add plain gelatin to hot gelatin; stir to dissolve. Stir all ingredients into Jell-O mixture. Chill in refrigerator until set or firm. May also add chopped apple and nuts to this.

title: Peanut Chicken
instructions: Mix peanut oil soy sauce and sugar together in a large pan. After the sugar is dissolved add chicken parts. Bring chicken in sauce to a boil stirring occasionally.\tCover and cook for about 45 minutes or until wings are tender. Remove chicken from sauce and place on serving tray. Chop the stems of 3 green onions and mix together with 1/4\tcup chopped peanuts. Pour sauce over chicken and sprinkle with onion and peanut mixture.

title: Chipped Apple Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust. Place chipped apples into crust. Combine sugar cinnamon salt and melted margarine. Add beaten egg. Pour over chipped apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Place preceding ingredients in your slow cooker in order given. Stir until mixed then cover and cook on low heat overnight or 10 to 12 hours.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Can be baked 1 hour or longer.

title: Diabetic Peachy Pie
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over water in small mixing bowl. Place in pan of hot water. Heat until dissolved. Add ginger ale; stir. Add peaches. Chill until it begins to thicken. Spoon into pie crust and chill until firm. May be served with low calorie whipped topping. Equals 1 fruit 1 bread and 2 fats.

title: Hawaiian Cabbage
instructions: Dissolve the Jello and gelatin in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Add 1 cup ice cubes. Add lemon juice and chill until partially set. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in 9x13 pan. Chill until set.

title: Chicken Under Yum
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13 inch pan. Dip chicken in butter and arrange in pan. Place a slice of cheese on top of each piece of chicken. Sprinkle dry stuffing mix over chicken and cheese. Mix soup and milk. Pour over top of stuffing mix. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate. Serve with chips.

title: Angel Food Lemonade Cake
instructions: Soften ice cream; add can of lemonade and stir until well mixed. Slice cake in 2 or 3 layers. Spread with ice cream in between layers. Ice with remainder of ice cream mixture. Serve immediately topped with strawberries or return to freezer. Let set out 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Tapioca Pudding
instructions: Add tapioca to milk. Beat together the eggs sugar and cornstarch; add to milk-tapioca mixture when about cooled. Add some hot milk. When cold add whipped cream bananas nuts pineapple or whatever you wish.

title: Un Aperitive De Ensalada
instructions: In food processor chop green onions cilantro and cheeses. In large bowl layer the green onions diced tomatoes diced avocados cheeses and salsa; sprinkle with Lawrys seasoned salt. Marinate in refrigerator overnight. Toss before serving with chips.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a Bundt pan for 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 5-Hour Beef Stew
instructions: Place all ingredients in an ovenproof covered bowl and cook at 250\u00b0 for 4 1/2 to 5 hours.

title: Shrimp Scampi(Microwave)
instructions: Place margarine in 2-quart casserole. Microwave at High until melted 1 to 2 1/2 minutes. Stir in lemon juice garlic and salt. Add shrimp; toss to coat. Cover. Microwave at High until shrimp is pink opaque and tender 4 1/2 to 7 minutes stirring twice.

title: Indian Pudding
instructions: Mix all together adding the margarine last. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours stirring three times while cooking. Serve with favorite topping.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: In a pan combine soup and milk. Bring to a boil stirring often. Remove from heat and add cheese mayonnaise and salt. Stir until cheese melts. Blend in sherry. Add shrimp noodles onions and mushrooms. Mix well and turn into casserole dish. Bake covered 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover and add a bit of shredded cheese on top. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat all but corn with eggbeater. Stir in corn. Pour into well-buttered casserole. Set in a pan of water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lamb Stew - Vintage Recipe
instructions: Cook lamb for 1 3/4 hours. Let the lamb cool until the fat rises to the top. Then scrape the fat off and take the meat off of the bone. Add onions carrots celery salt and pepper to the lamb and cook for 1 hour. Add the potatoes and cook the stew for another 3/4 to 1 hour until the potatoes cook down and thicken the stew. Serves 8.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together except last 2 ingredients. Mold into a loaf pan. Cook for 1 hour. Mix together mushroom soup and tomato sauce. Heat. Pour over meat loaf and cook for 30 minutes.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown pork chops; then add cabbage and peppers. Steam 10 minutes. Then add rest of ingredients. Add salt to taste. Cover and cook on low heat for 3/4 hour.

title: Yankee Doodle Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and cheese according to directions on the box adding the butter milk and cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill before serving.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Mix margarine curry powder and brown sugar and pour over fruit. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Goes well with ham or chicken.

title: Pfeffernuesse
instructions: Mix the butter and molasses in a saucepan and melt over low heat. Cool to room temperature. Stir together all dry ingredients in a large bowl; set aside. Stir the egg into the molasses mixture and gradually stir in the flour mixture. Cover and chill one hour or until dough is easy to handle. Divide dough into 12 portions. On a lightly floured surface roll each piece into a 10-inch rope. Cut the ropes into 1/2-inch pieces. Place the pieces 1/2-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350 for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are firm and bottoms are lightly browned. Cool on paper towels.

title: Hamburger Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger and set aside.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes 1/2 cup butter (melted) onion soup sour cream and cheese; stir well. Spoon into a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole. Pour remaining butter over top. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef egg onion and salt. Prepare meatballs and set aside. Mix in large saucepan chili sauce lemon juice and grape jelly. Add meatballs. Simmer 1 to 2 hours. (To reduce the fat in the sauce you may cook the meatballs first in the microwave and drain; then add to sauce and simmer until heated through.)

title: Baked Turkey-Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Cut a slice off top of each tomato and scoop out pulp; reserve for other use. Sprinkle inside of tomatoes with salt and turn upside-down to drain. In small saucepan melt butter and blend in flour. Cook stirring until bubbly. Off heat stir in milk. Put back over low heat and cook stirring until smooth and thickened. Stir in turkey celery onions nuts and 1/4 cup cheese. Season to taste with seasoned salt and pepper. Fill tomato shells with the mixture. Arrange in shallow baking dish or pie plate. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; chill until thickened. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into lightly greased mold or individual molds. Chill until firm. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
instructions: Season raw shrimp with salt pepper and cayenne pepper (to taste) and set aside. Melt margarine. Add onions celery bell pepper and garlic. Cook slowly in uncovered heavy pot until onions wilt. Add shrimp and let simmer stirring occasionally 30 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in water. Add to mixture. Cook 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Blackberry Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and add lemon juice and mix. Place in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 after putting butter on top. Cover with strips and then bake. Check after 20 minutes. Temperature adjustment may be necessary. Bake until done.

title: Chicken Fried Steak
instructions: Using a meat mallet or rolling pin pound each beef cutlet to 1/4-inch thickness. Sprinkle garlic salt on both sides of each cutlet. Pour flour onto a pie plate or shallow bowl and coat each cutlet. Refrigerate until most of the flour has been absorbed (10 to 20 minutes). Pour buttermilk into a shallow bowl or pie plate. Dip each cutlet into buttermilk then dredge each in another coating of flour shaking off excess. (Reserve remaining gravy for making gravy.) Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 of the steaks and cook until golden brown on both sides about 4 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a serving platter. Repeat with remaining 2 steaks adding remaining oil as needed. Stir remaining flour into skillet. Stir in broth milk salt and pepper with a wire whisk. Cook stirring constantly over high heat until thickened. Pour over steaks and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mocha Float
instructions: Into 8 ounce glass measure first 3 ingredients. Gradually add enough club soda to fill glass 3/4 full; stir until sugar is dissolved. Add chocolate ice cream; stir. Serve with spoon and straw.

title: Ham And Cheese Rolls
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray muffin pans with nonstick spray. Mix first five ingredients together. Use enough mustard to stick ingredients together.

title: Our Traditional Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill overnight.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
instructions: Melt almond bark and chips; stir in peanuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool.

title: Swiss Pecan Pleasers
instructions: Press rolls into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour on top of crescent roll dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let set 5 minutes. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares and serve hot!

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Layer meat soup cheese chops and Ro-Tel in 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer until pan is full. Top with cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Crackerjack Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Sift together flour baking powder and soda. Combine flour and egg mixture. Add oatmeal coconut and cereal. Mix well. (If too sticky may need to add a little more flour.) Drop by heaping spoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto greased baking sheet. Bake in oven preheated to 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove at once. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Thaw peas and drain well. Add rest of ingredients and season to taste with salt and pepper. Toss lightly and refrigerate.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix sugar oleo syrup and salt. Bring to boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from stove. Add soda; stir well. Spray Pam on inside of large brown sack. Put popped corn into sack. Pour syrup over the popcorn. Stir well. Cook in microwave on Full power for 1 1/2 minutes. Take out. Shake well. Cook 1 1/2 minutes more. Shake well. Cook for 30 seconds. Shake. Open bag. Let cool.

title: Chocolate Yum-Yum
instructions: Mix Oreos and 1/3 cup of melted butter and press in 9 x 12-inch pan and freeze. Mix softened ice cream with instant coffee; spread over Oreo mixture and freeze. In saucepan mix chocolate squares or cocoa 1/3 cup sugar 2 tablespoons margarine and Pet milk. Cook until thickened. Cool and put on top of ice cream mixture.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook water sugar cornstarch jello and Karo syrup until thickened then cool. Slice or quarter strawberries into a 9-inch baked pie shell. Pour cooled thickened mixture over strawberries. Refrigerate. Top with Cool Whip when serving. Yield 6 servings.

title: Kahlua Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed on package and use a 13 x 9-inch pan. After cake cools poke all over top of cake and pour Kahlua over it. Let stand overnight.

title: Super Burgers
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup soup with remaining ingredients except oil. Shape into patties. Heat oil in large skillet and brown burgers on both sides. (Drain excess fat.) Combine remaining soup with 1/2 cup water. Pour over burgers and cook over low heat about 20 minutes turning occasionally and stirring sauce as needed. Add water as needed to sauce if it becomes too thick.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Cook to a rolling boil. Do not stir. Pour over warm cake.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add syrup and sugar. Bring to a boil and boil 3 minutes on stove top. Add soda and salt and stir. Pour over popcorn in brown grocery sack and shake or stir in large bowl. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes. Stir or shake. Microwave for another 1 1/2 minutes. Spread on cookie sheet to cool.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Put bacon potatoes and onion in baking dish. Add butter milk salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 until potatoes are tender.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: With mixer blend cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Add pecans. Wash and slice Granny Smith apples to serve with dip.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill for an hour. Take out of refrigerator; roll in nuts. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Microwave Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Form meatballs. Place 8 to 10 on paper towel-lined plate. Cover with paper towel and microwave 3 minutes on High.

title: Barbie'S Breakfast Drink
instructions: Blend juice and sugar in blender for a frothy delight!

title: Cinnamon Nut Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cream margarine sugars and egg yolk until light and fluffy. Combine flour cinnamon and salt. Add to beaten mixture and continue beating until blended. Spread into ungreased jelly roll pan. Beat egg white until just foamy. Spread evenly on top of dough. Sprinkle with nuts and press in lightly. Bake 40 minutes. Cut into squares while still hot.

title: Diet Cabbage Soup
instructions: Add water to cook. Cook until all vegetables are tender. Add beef broth if desired.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler. Cook over low heat stirring frequently until cheese melts. Serve warm with taco chips. Yield About 1 1/2 quarts dip.

title: Taco Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Meanwhile place pizza crust on pizza pan or baking sheet. Mix tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Spread over crust. Dot with beef; sprinkle with chili peppers and cheese. Bake in 425 \u00b0oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until meat is cooked and cheese is melted. Sprinkle with lettuce tomato and corn chips. Serves 4.

title: Grandma'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Make Jell-O as directed less 1 cup cold water. Add remaining ingredients stir and chill overnight. Stir well before serving.

title: Maple Nut Squares
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Slowly add oil. Add remaining ingredients mixing until blended. Spread batter in greased 7 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Zucchini Parmesan
instructions: Saute onion until soft. Add zucchini salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes. Toss with cheese before serving.

title: Coconut Pancakes
instructions: Combine egg sour cream and buttermilk. Sift together the flour soda baking powder salt and sugar. Add dry ingredients to liquids. Mix until batter is lumpy; add coconut and extract but dont overbeat. Spoon batter onto hot griddle. When done place on plate and sprinkle with flaked coconut. Serve with cream of coconut (takes the place of syrup). Makes 8 to 10 pancakes.

title: Chris' Lo Mein
instructions: Boil 5 quarts water. Drop noodles in boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain and rinse thoroughly. Fry onions in 4 tablespoons oil until brown. Add all other ingredients. Stir in gravy and mix.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Press a crisscross on each cookie with a fork dipped in water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until golden. Cool on cookie sheet about 1 minute before removing.

title: Leila'S Feather Rolls
instructions: Combine yeast 2 teaspoons sugar and warm water. Stir until dissolved. Scald milk and add shortening 1/3 cup sugar and salt. Stir until shortening is melted. Beat eggs and stir into milk mixture. Stir in yeast and 3 cups flour. Beat well with a mixer. Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups flour it will be a sticky dough. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Turn out on a floured board and shape into crescent cloverleaf or Parker House rolls. Let stand 4 hours covered with a cloth. Brush with melted butter and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 36 to 48 rolls.

title: Green Bean-Onion Bake
instructions: Alternate layers of green beans and onion rings in a 2-quart casserole ending with onion rings on top. Blend together soup and milk. Pour over vegetables. Blend slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 portions.

title: Jarrett House Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chipped Beef Spread Or Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pecans and butter; mix well and put into heatproof serving dish. Saute pecans in the butter and sprinkle over top of cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes or until warm but not runny. Serve with corn chips.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortilla chips. Let simmer for 30 minutes. Serve with crumbled tortilla chips in bowls.

title: Cheesy Green Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain bacon reserving 1/4 cup drippings. Crumble bacon. Reserve 2 tablespoons. Microwave beans as directed on package; drain well. Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in skillet. Cook and stir on medium heat 10 minutes. Drain. Add bacon hot cooked green beans and pepper; mix lightly. Spoon into 2-quart serving dish. Microwave Cheez Whiz as directed on label. Pour over green bean mixture. Sprinkle with reserved crumbled bacon. Makes 10 servings.

title: Orange-Flavored Pecans
instructions: Cook milk and sugar slowly to a soft ball stage. Add orange rind. Cook for a few minutes more. Add margarine and pecans. Stir to coat all pecans. Turn out on waxed paper and separate.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a loaf pan lightly with some shortening. Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten eggs mashed bananas and lemon juice until well blended. Mix all dry ingredients together. Add to shortening/banana mixture. Mix until well blended. Add nuts and lemon zest if desired. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Following is both basic dough and feeding.

title: Cranberry Salad Ring
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Combine next 6 ingredients and mix well. Fold fruit mixture into gelatin mixture. Pour into slightly oiled 10-cup ring mold. Chill until set. Unmold on lettuce leaves. Fill center of ring with mayonnaise and garnish with orange slices if desired. Makes 20 servings.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Brown beef add onions and cook until tender. Add tomatoes mixed with chili powder cumin garlic and kidney beans. Simmer for 1/2 hour (at least). Add cracker crumbs just before serving.

title: Grandma Jane'S Easy Chicken Dinner
instructions: Remove fat from chicken and cube. Place cubed chicken in bottom of crock-pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on high for at least 2 hours or until chicken is done stirring occasionally.

title: Poppy Seed Coffee Cake
instructions: Let the poppy seed soak in the buttermilk in refrigerator overnight. Cream the shortening with the sugar well. Add the eggs one at a time and beat until light and fluffy. Add flour baking powder soda and salt together. Add alternately with the buttermilk mixture. Blend in vanilla. Grease Bundt mold well or angel food cake pan. Pour into mold. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool in mold before removing. Plain powdered sugar or a glaze may be drizzled over the cake when cooled.

title: Georgia Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar and Crisco. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and baking powder gradually. Add vanilla. Add milk last. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Cook for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Turn oven off and leave cake in for 10 minutes. Let cake sit in Bundt pan 20 minutes before removing.

title: Butterfinger Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spoon into little balls and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Place all ingredients in pan and heat. Serve with oyster crackers plain or seasoned. See recipe for Party Crackers.

title: Baked Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with garlic salt and seasoned pepper in large baking pan. Mix syrup with barbecue sauce. Pour over chicken and bake at 400\u00b0 in covered pan for 35 minutes and then uncover and bake for another 35 minutes basting until well glazed.

title: Chocolate Layered Dessert
instructions: Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mix; beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Gently stir in 2 cups Cool Whip. Arrange 1/2 of the cake cubes into 3 1/2-quart serving bowl. Drizzle with 1/2 of the chocolate syrup. Layer with 1/2 of the chopped candy bars and 1/2 of the pudding mix. Repeat layers ending with pudding mix. Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve. Garnish with remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle with additional chopped candy bars. Makes about 12 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening sugar vanilla egg and milk; beat until fluffy. In another bowl mix separately combining the flour baking powder and salt. Add with creamy mixture. Roll and separate into half. Chill for 1 hour. Roll out on floured surface and cut into shapes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Add sugar crystals if desired.

title: Grits And Cheese
instructions: Heat the water to a boil. Remove from heat and add the remaining ingredients. Stir until all blended. Put back on fire and bring to a boil. Place in greased 13 x 9-inch dish and bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Cranberry Pie
instructions: Grease 10-inch pie plate. Spread cranberries on bottom. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar and nuts over cranberries. Mix the rest of the ingredients together; pour over top of cranberry mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine Crisco and sugar. Add egg yolks beating one at a time to creamed mixture. Sift flour and soda three times; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Add vanilla coconut and nuts to creamed mixture. Beat egg whites to peaks and fold into mixture. Pour into three greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Mix together butter cheese flour salt and red pepper. Add ice water and knead together. Roll out to 1/4-inch thick. Cut in strips. Sprinkle with paprika. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven until browned. Sprinkle again with red pepper while hot. Cool thoroughly before storing in airtight container.

title: Mother'S Fudge
instructions: Thoroughly combine dry ingredients in a heavy 4-quart saucepan. Stir in milk and bring to a bubbly boil on medium heat stirring constantly. Boil without stirring to a soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add margarine and vanilla. Do not stir. Cool at room temperature (110\u00b0).

title: Crepes
instructions: Beat all ingredients with rotary beater until smooth. Grease a pan with butter. Cook until light brown like pancakes. Turn and brown other side. After you can spread with jam honey or sugar or I put some apple or pineapple or peaches inside.

title: Beary Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place stick of margarine in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish and melt in oven while preheating. Meanwhile combine dry ingredients. Stir in 3/4 cup milk (batter will be thin). Pour batter into center of melted margarine. Pour pie filling into center of batter. Bake about 50 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serve warm or cold with whipped cream.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter or margarine. Mix sugar flour and milk together. Stir until smooth. Pour melted butter in dish that you are going to cook in. Then put fruit in bottom. Do not stir. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. You can use any kind of fruit (peaches cherries blackberries etc.).

title: Glazed Lemonade Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Blend well then beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Turn into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until done. Prick cake with fork or skewer completely through to bottom of cake. Thoroughly blend lemonade concentrate and confectioners sugar. Gradually spoon glaze over cake until completely absorbed. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Apple Butter Stack Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter together. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour baking powder soda and cinnamon. Then add buttermilk and vanilla. Mix well. This will be very thick and resemble cookie dough. Grease 8 cake pans. I used Pam spray and made 4 layers at a time. You can use either 8 or 9-inch pans. Divide the dough into 8 equal parts and then pat it into the pans.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in a greased cake pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Mustard
instructions: In a saucepan whisk together all ingredients. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thickened. Pour into small jars. Cover and refrigerate. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Grease and flour three (3 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch) pans. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese and chicken with hands. Roll into big ball. Roll ball in bacon bits. Place ball on cheese ball serving dish. Chill until firm. Serve with Town House crackers.

title: Lo-Cal Garlic Chicken
instructions: Mix garlic in with the Butter Buds. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn breasts 3 times. Serves 4. Contains 150 calories per serving.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Stir lemon juice into peach pie filling. Cut pie crust into strips. Place filling in small casserole. Place pie crust strips over. Dot with butter; sprinkle with sugar. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until crust is brown.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Dip eggplant in egg and then crumbs. Brown in hot oil. Set aside.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Thaw frozen bread but do not let rise. Sprinkle nuts in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan if desired. Pinch sections of bread off and roll into balls about the size of quarters. Roll the balls in the cinnamon-sugar mixture and place in pan. Heat together the brown sugar margarine milk and pudding. Pour the mixture over the dough balls. Let the bread rise a couple of hours or overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Invert immediately on a cookie sheet.

title: Creamy Broccoli Bake
instructions: Heat 1 inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) to boiling. Add broccoli. Cover and heat to boiling. Cook until stems are almost tender 10 to 12 minutes; drain. Place broccoli in ungreased 1 1/2-quart round casserole. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat soup and milk with hand beater until smooth; pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix baking mix and margarine until crumbly; sprinkle over cheese. Bake until crumbs are light brown about 20 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Enchiladas Acapulco
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add tomato sauce and 1/2 cup green peppers. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add beans and 1/4 pound cheese cubes. Cook until cheese melts. Remove from heat. Dip tortillas in hot oil; drain on paper towels. Fill each tortilla with a 1/4 cup meat mixture then roll up. Place seam side down in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Pour remaining mixture over tortillas. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake 5 additional minutes to melt cheese. Remove and top with remaining peppers cheese and tomatoes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix and store in large container. Use 1/4 cup mix in 1 cup hot water.

title: Turkey Surprise
instructions: Brown turkey and drain any juices. Sprinkle flour over meat and mix well. Add sour cream and mushrooms. Cook over low heat until bubbly. Remove and serve with pasta. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Sweet Monkey Bread
instructions: Sprinkle pecans evenly in bottom of well-greased bundt pan.

title: Play Doh
instructions: Mix ingredients and knead like dough. Add food coloring if desired. Store in airtight container.

title: Skillet Enchiladas
instructions: In saucepan combine soup enchiladas sauce milk and chilies; heat until bubbly. Dip tortillas one at a time in sauce until limp or place in warm skillet until limp. Drain tortillas.\tSet aside 1/2 cup cheese. Place 1/4 cup cheese on each tortilla and roll.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in bowl. Chill until ready to serve. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Confetti Salad
instructions: Cook bows according to package directions; drain. Rinse with cold water to cool quickly; drain well. In large bowl combine dressing mayonnaise salt and pepper. Add cooked bows and remaining ingredients; toss lightly until pasta and vegetables are evenly coated. Chill. Makes 6 servings.

title: Saturday Night Special
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Add pork and beans tomatoes and salt. Pour half of mixture in baking dish add layer of onions. Add rest of mixture.

title: Crock Pot Chili
instructions: Cook ground beef stirring to crumble. Add onion and the next 7 ingredients; cook for 7 minutes. Place in crock pot with beans and tomatoes; cook for 4 hours. Serve in bowls; top with cheese.

title: Company Spanish Rice
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Add garlic celery and beef; brown stirring constantly. Mix rice tomatoes tomato paste salt bay leaf and cayenne pepper with hot water. Add to garlic and celery; stir well and cover. Bring to boil; reduce heat and add beef bouillon.

title: Grecco Casserole
instructions: Fry onion and pepper in small amount of oil until glossy. Brown meat. Keep moving to prevent burning. Add mushrooms and remove from heat. Boil macaroni until tender; drain and add. Add tomato sauce and corn; mix well. Place in a well-greased casserole and refrigerate until ready to bake. Grate lots of sharp Cheddar cheese on top. Place in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Aunt Lucy'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook hamburger celery and onion until done. Drain. Then add rest of ingredients; bring to a boil then simmer 30 to 45 minutes. Serve over spaghetti noodles.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Put cracker crumbs and milk in a greased casserole. Let stand for 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Mix well. Refrigerate 1 hour. Bake in preheated oven (330\u00b0) for 50 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake another 10 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix and freeze first 6 ingredients. Set out 1 to 1 1/2 hours before serving. Pour ginger ale over and stir. Ready to serve.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine chocolate chips and margarine and melt over low heat. Stir until well blended. Cool slightly. In mixing bowl beat eggs with wire whisk until light (do not use electric mixer). Beat in sugar and vanilla to chocolate mixture. Stir together flour soda and salt. Stir in egg mixture. Add nuts. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 45 minutes or until pulls away from edges of pan and sets in the center. Cool completely before cutting into squares. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Tuna Broccoli Combo
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small casserole dish except cheese. Top with cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 1.

title: Polish Pierogi Dough
instructions: Mix flour eggs sour cream and salt. Add a little water at a time until all is used. Knead dough until firm and elastic texture.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until lightly browned. Cook in Pyrex or long pan.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in olive oil. Add all other ingredients except shrimp. Let sauce stand for 15 minutes. When ready to cook add shrimp and sauce to skillet and cook for 15 minutes stirring often. Divide shrimp into individual bowls. Pour sauce over shrimp and serve with French bread for dipping.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple and finely chopped nuts; add bananas. Pour batter into 3 well-greased pans lined with wax paper. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool cake and ice with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Bean Pot Supper
instructions: Brown hamburger diced onion and bacon. Simmer. Add rest of ingredients. Simmer 2 hours.

title: Quick Chicken Primavera
instructions: Spray large skillet with Pam. Heat then add chicken and garlic. Cook and stir until chicken is no longer pink about 3 or 4 minutes. Add milk and frozen vegetables with pasta. Cover and simmer 4 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Stir before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Pour into graham cracker crust or regular pie shell. Freeze. Garnish with Hersheys chocolate syrup and peanuts.

title: Brown Sugar Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter. Mix brown sugar butter flour and eggs together. Gradually add milk. Pour into crusts and bake. When top of pie starts to brown turn oven down to 300\u00b0 until pie is done.

title: Chili #2
instructions: Brown meat; drain fat. Add rest of ingredients. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Food Dessert
instructions: Bake the angel food cake according to the directions on the box. Let cool.

title: Zucchini And Watercress Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large pot; saute onions. Lower heat; cover. Stir occasionally until tender and lightly cover 25 minutes. Add broth. Chop zucchini (trim ends). Drop in broth. Return to boil. Reduce heat until tender 20 minutes. Pull leaves and smaller stems off watercress. Rinse well. Remove soup from heat. Add watercress. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Pour soup through strainer; reserve liquid. Put solids in food processor. Add 1 cup of liquid. Process until smooth. Return to pot and add about 2 more cups of liquid and/or* 1 cup cream and 1 cup liquid. Season. Simmer to heat through.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Blend first 7 ingredients; carefully stir in blueberries. Sprinkle topping over batter and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Fiddlehead Salad(Summer Dish)
instructions: Blanch carrots until fork tender. Put the fiddleheads carrots onions mushrooms and cucumbers in a big bowl. Add dressing and toss together. Best to let\tset 4\tor 5 hours before serving.

title: Candied Yams
instructions: Wash yams. Cover and bring to boil. Boil for about 5 minutes. Drain peel and slice in half lengthwise. Place the slices in a heavy 4-quart saucepan. Add the sugar spices butter and boiling water. Cook uncovered for 1 hour until the syrup has thickened and almost cooked away. Turn the yams occasionally during the last half of the cooking time but do not stir. Serve hot.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook and stir garlic and meat in a Dutch oven until meat loses its red color. Add beans (if wanted) with their liquid. Add onions and green pepper. Pour in tomato sauce. Add salt cumin and chili powder. Stir and simmer over low heat stirring occasionally.

title: Fruit Kabobs
instructions: You will need one (6-inch) wooden skewer.

title: Christmas Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking soda and baking powder together in large mixing bowl. Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly then beat in eggs and sour milk. Add sugar and vanilla and mix well. Mixture will still feel rather dry. Form about 1/3 of mixture into a ball and work with hands. Place on floured board and roll out with rolling pin and cut into desired shapes. Repeat with remaining dough. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until dough starts to crack on top of cookie. Ice if desired. These make great cookies for you to let your kids help make at Christmastime.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
instructions: Heat juice and apples until apples are limp. Add remaining ingredients and cook 5 minutes. Bake in double crust pie shell at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook frozen broccoli as directed. Stir in 1/2 stick butter and the cheese. Mix together 1/2 stick of butter and crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle cracker mixture over broccoli and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and pour in baking dish. Melt margarine; add corn flakes. Mix and spread over potatoes. Bake in medium oven until lightly browned.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown steak on medium heat slowly. Transfer cooking pot to heating base using hot pads. Combine ingredients garlic onion salt pepper ginger sugar and soy sauce. Pour over steak. Cover; slow cook at setting #3 for 6 to 8 hours or setting #4 for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Take chicken broth and onion and cook until onion is clear in color. Mix flour and cream and stir in gradually on low heat until bubbly. Add in chicken peas mushrooms and pimento. Cook until warm. Serve on biscuit rice or toast points.

title: 3 Bean Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook limas according to package; drain. Put in large casserole dish and add baked and kidney beans. Simmer sausage in small amount of water for 5 minutes in covered skillet. Drain liquid and fry until brown. (do not prick sausage cut sausage into small pieces). Add sausage and ham to beans. Stir together other ingredients and pour over beans. Mix gently. Bake uncovered for approximately 1 hour. Yields a lot.

title: Baked Potatoes
instructions: Wash and slice potatoes but not all the way through. Use the handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way. Put potatoes in baking dish and fan slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheeses. Bake additional 10 to 15 minutes until tender.

title: Apple Butter Spice Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 5/8-inch loaf pan. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Set aside. Sift and mix flour baking powder salt baking soda and allspice. Add to creamed mixture alternating with apple butter and stir in nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake 60 to 70 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove bread from pan; cool thoroughly before slicing.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Put beans in large kettle filled half full of cold water; bring to a\tboil. Add salt and salt pork. Boil until tender keeping kettle half full of water.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Boil mixture. Let cool. Pour into sterilized bottles and cap.

title: Spaghetti Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream green pepper and dry sauce mix. Chill and serve with vegetable dippers.

title: Happiness Cake
instructions: Cream together and add 1 tablespoon each of neatness and ambition a pinch of humor and enough temper to flavor. Mix all thoroughly and add a generous quantity of love. Place in the sunshine of a devoted husbands smile and the result will be a perfect wife and homemaker.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in order given in a large bowl. Refrigerate overnight stirring just before serving.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook and drain carrots. Let cool. Mix together the other ingredients and pour over carrots. Marinate 12 hours. Serve cold.

title: Whipping Cream Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in the order given. Start cooking in a cold oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Test for doneness.

title: Muffin Cones
instructions: Mix muffin mix as directed. Place the 10 cones in a muffin pan. Cookie sheet can also be used. Fill the cones with the batter approximately 1-inch from the cones rims. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Test for doneness. Decorate with yellow frosting and make \happy faces\ with raisins etc. or with a tube of chocolate icing. Children can eat entire cone; contains no messy wrappers.

title: Maggie'S Peach Pie
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees. While oven is heating place margarine in 9x13 pan and place in oven. Mix together flour sugar milk vanilla and cinnamon until just combined. Mixture will be lumpy. Carefully add peaches and juice. Mix well. Remove 9x13 pan from oven. Carefully pour mixture into pan. Return to oven till crust is brown about 45 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Corn Cakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in large bowl. Add oil and egg and mix. Slowly stir in milk a little at a time until batter is the consistency of pancake mix. Heat two tablespoons of bacon grease or oil in large skillet. Drop batter by large spoonfuls into skillet and cook the same as pancakes. Serve with butter and syrup. Serves 8.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed with mixer. Pour into pie shell. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Sally'S Easy Lasagne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat butter and sugars until creamy. Combine flour baking soda and cinnamon; add to butter mixture. Stir in oats and raisins; mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Spiced Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Makes about 1 (16 ounce) bottle. A delicious treat with any of your salads.

title: Smoked Sausage And Bean Soup
instructions: In a 4 quart Dutch oven cook the onion and garlic in margarine or butter until tender but not brown. Add the water potatoes sausage beans and bouillon granules. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer covered for 15 minutes. Add cabbage or cole slaw mix tomato paste or catsup and vinegar. Simmer covered 10 minutes more. Makes 6 main dish servings.

title: Dorothy'S Pound Cake
instructions: Let butter soften. Cream butter and sugar. Add flour and whipping cream. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Beat until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 hours. (We check ours after 1 hour.)

title: Uncooked Tomato Relish
instructions: Soak 2 1/2 hours in the 1/2 cup salt. Mix sugar with vinegar and place vegetables (chopped) in mixture. Let stand for 2 hours. Fill jars with tops and keep refrigerated.

title: Molded Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add berries and stir until thawed. Add pineapple then bananas. Pour half the mixture into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm. Spread on sour cream. Add remaining mixture. Refrigerate. For best results make day before serving. For Christmas color sour cream green and have red and green salad.

title: Pan Coating
instructions: Mix ingredients to smoothness and store in covered container on pantry shelf.

title: Squash Bisque
instructions: Cook all of ingredients until tender. Run through food mill or puree in blender until very creamy in texture. If soup is too thick at this point add more chicken broth or milk. Garnish with croutons or other seasonings to taste.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add melted butter eggs and vanilla. Mix with a fork and add chopped pecans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in buttered square glass pan.

title: Basque Skillet Dinner
instructions: Cut turkey sausage into bite-sized pieces and brown in skillet. Add onion and pepper and cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Italian Olive Bread
instructions: Mix butter and mayo together and melt. Spread over each slice of bread. Chop olives and layer on bread. Grate cheese and layer. Bake until cheese melts.

title: Dutch Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix these ingredients and pour over the meat loaf in the oven. Continue baking 1 1/4 hours longer basting occasionally. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hildy'S Cheese Strada With Ham And Broccoli
instructions: Cut 12 doughnuts and holes from the slices of white bread. Fit the resulting scraps of bread (crust removed) in the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer sliced cheese cooked and drained broccoli and ham over the bread. Arrange doughnuts and holes on the top with doughnuts down the sides and holes in the middle. Combine slightly beaten eggs milk onion salt and mustard; pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Apple Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream together Parkay egg and brown sugar. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add apples pecans and raisins by hand. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheets. It is better to let mixture set before baking so apples have a chance to mix about 15 minutes then stir good. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting or plain vanilla frosting.

title: Health Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 (1 pound) shortening cans or other 2 1/2-cup cans. There are small (2 1/2 cup) loaf pans. Mix all ingredients except 1 tablespoon wheat germ and the water in a medium size bowl. Stir in water until just blended. Spoon into cans smooth top and sprinkle with remaining wheat germ. Bake until tops are golden brown and pick inserted in center comes out clean. As soon as out of oven remove from cans and put in zip-lock bags. Great with split pea soup.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all well. Chill and serve.

title: Cake And Pie Filling
instructions: Pour oil into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread on bottom of pan. Put cake mix eggs and water into pan. Stir until blended about 2 minutes. Spoon pie filling into batter to create a marble effect. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Scotch Tea Tarts
instructions: Mix butter flour and cream cheese; chill for 30 minutes. Place a rounded teaspoonful of dough in each tart cup. Press dough to bottom and sides with thumb. Sprinkle each cup with chopped pecans. Mix the brown sugar eggs melted butter salt and vanilla together. Spoon in the cups over top of the pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine Crisco and sugar. Add beaten eggs vanilla and milk. Blend together in another bowl the flour baking powder soda and salt. Stir into egg mixture; blend thoroughly. Wrap in waxed paper (better in small packages). Store in refrigerator at least 3 hours. Roll out on floured board; cut into shapes. Decorate with colored sugar nuts raisins etc. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Anginettes (Italian Cookies)
instructions: Cut together with a pastry blender the flour and butter. Stir in the sugar and baking powder. Add to this mixture eggs milk lemon juice and zambucca. Form dough and chill 1/2 hour. Roll into ropes and tie in knots. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Ice with the following.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Stir in pineapple and bread. Bake in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix in pan the sugar cocoa milk and margarine. Put on medium heat and bring to a rolling boil and boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Quickly add vanilla salt and peanut butter. Stir. Add oatmeal. Stir well. Drop by teaspoonful onto wax paper. Let cool then remove from paper.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread
instructions: Combine and mix well. Pour into a hot greased skillet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Grape Juice
instructions: Mix grapes and sugar; pour into a 1/2 gallon jug. Fill with water. Cook in pressure cooker for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Italian Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Soak raisins in rum for a day (the longer the better). Mix all ingredients well. Roll into small balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 18 to 25 minutes at 350.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir together peanuts sugar syrup and salt in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Microwave on HIGH for 7 to 8 minutes stirring well after 3 minutes. Add butter and vanilla to syrup blending well. Microwave on HIGH for 1 to 2 minutes more. Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very HOT. Add baking soda and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet; let cool 30 minutes to 1 hour. When cool break into small pieces and store in airtight container.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Break cauliflower into flowerets. Combine Parmesan cheese and mayonnaise. Toss all ingredients except bacon together. Refrigerate 6 to 8 hours. Add bacon just before serving. Serves 8.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mash potatoes. Melt butter and add to potatoes. Add sugar and salt. Beat with electric mixer until smooth. Add eggs one at a time or all together. Beat until smooth. Add milk and beat again until smooth. Lastly add spices. Pour into 4 to 5 pie shells (4 full or 5 medium-full pies). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until browned.

title: Vegetable Soup(Ukrainian)
instructions: Cook the onion in the butter until slightly wilted. Add the vegetables soup stock and water. Cook until vegetables are tender. Add the tomato juice. Blend the flour with the cream; add some hot soup to it and stir into the contents of the kettle. Bring to a boil. Season to taste with the salt and pepper and flavor with the parsley or dill.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients (corn meal sugar salt flour and baking powder). Add the egg milk salad oil corn and cottage cheese; stir lightly. Pour half of batter into a 9-inch square casserole (well-greased). Add the cheese and peppers. Pour rest of batter over this. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until golden on top. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Broccoli Mushroom Chowder
instructions: Clean and cut broccoli into 1/2-inch pieces. Steam in 1/2 cup water until tender. Do not drain. Set aside. Wash and slice mushrooms. Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat. Add flour to make a roux. Cook for 2 to 4 minutes. Add chicken stock stirring with a wire whip and bring to a boil. Turn heat to low. Add broccoli mushrooms half and half and spices. Heat but do not boil.

title: Egg Pie Crust
instructions: Measure flour and salt into bowl. Add shortening. Mix with pastry cutter (or two table knives) until crumbly. Add egg water in small amounts mixing with spoon. Makes six 8-inch crusts.

title: Grandma Carter'S Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Chicken Croquettes
instructions: Stir all together and put hot butter in frying pan and add onions milk and flour to prepare a creamy sauce when done add chicken. Put in the refrigerator for 3 hours. Afterward give form of croquettes and mix them with eggs and crushed crackers and fry them.

title: Tortilla Rolls
instructions: Mix cream cheese Cheddar cheese finely chopped green onions paprika and bacon bits. Spread mixture thinly on tortilla and roll up. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Slice into half-inch thickness and serve.

title: Salted Peanut Chews
instructions: Combine all crust ingredients except marshmallows at low speed until crumbly. Press firmly in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with marshmallows. Bake 1 to 2 minutes more until marshmallows begin to puff. Cool.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Butter light bread on both sides and line bottom of casserole dish. Beat eggs and milk. Sprinkle sausage over bread. Pour egg mixture over sausage and bread. Spread cheese over this and refrigerate overnight. Bake 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Can be frozen unbaked for up to 2 months.

title: Chicken Excellent
instructions: Place chicken in shallow baking pan. Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover with foil and refrigerate at least 3 hours. When ready to bake spoon sauce over chicken and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours covered with foil.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
instructions: Beat eggs 5 minutes on high speed. Gradually add sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Stir. Add flour baking powder etc.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Beat egg slightly with fork. Stir in milk. Add salad oil or butter. Sift together and add flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir just until flour is moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Do not overmix. Put in blueberries. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Can use cupcake pan.

title: Terri'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients all together then stir in crackers. Shape meat in baking dish. Cover with ketchup. Pour reserved juice from tomatoes around meat loaf. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0. Pour 1 cup brown gravy or cajun gravy (from mix) around meat loaf. Bake another 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Mix pecan halves or English walnut halves into beaten egg white and water. Mix all until well coated. Then put into sugar and spice mixture and mix until sugar is gone. Spread nuts on greased cookie sheet and bake at 250\u00b0. Stir every 15 minutes for 1 hour. Cool on waxed paper then separate nuts.

title: Country Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a large skillet over medium heat heat 2 tbsp. oil. Add chicken and saute 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown. Remove and set aside. Add remaining oil and flour to skillet and cook stirring for about 3 minutes until golden. Add chicken broth and mustard. Cook stirring until sauce is smooth and thick. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in vegetables. Shred chicken and add to vegetables.

title: Cocktail Franks
instructions: Mix and heat until warm.

title: Yam Muffins
instructions: Rinse raisins\tand pecans in boiling water.\tMix all ingredients together and bake in greased muffin pans. (Papers may be used in the pan.) Batter may be baked as loaf bread or a pancake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mrs. Early'S Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix together and let marinate. The bacon bits croutons and chopped eggs are optional. You may also prefer to go a little lighter on the dressing. One-half of the package may be plenty for some tastes. Serves four to six.

title: Christmas Jam
instructions: In large pan combine apricots pineapple and syrup water and cherry syrup. Let stand 1 hour then cook slowly until apricots are tender. Add sugar; cook slowly stirring often until thick (216\u00b0). Cut cherries in quarters; add and cook a few minutes longer. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal. Makes 6 1/2 pints.

title: Sangria
instructions: Combine and let stand 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown meat. Add onion and tomato sauce. Season to taste. Set aside. Line a large dish with corn tortillas. Add tamales. Add half of the meat on top of the tamales (may split tamales lengthways if desired). Make second layer of corn tortillas tamales and meat. Place grated cheese on top. Add approximately 10 ounces water to dish. Cover with foil loosely. Cook at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes until cheese melts evenly. Uncover and cook for about 5 or 10 minutes more. You may serve with picante sauce as desired.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Soak oatmeal in buttermilk for 1 hour. Add egg and beat well. Add sugar and milk. Add flour sifted with salt powder and soda. Add cooled shortening. Bake in greased muffin pans in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Southern Date Nut Cake
instructions: Combine nuts and dates; mix well. Add flour sugar baking powder and salt. Continue to mix well. Use your hands to mix evenly. Beat eggs in a bowl. Add vanilla and chopped cherries. Mix with hands to work the batter thoroughly. The mixture will seem a little dry. Grease and flour a tube pan generously. Line the bottom with wax paper. Pack mixture into the tube pan and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Mock Chow Mein
instructions: Fry hamburger and diced onion; drain off fat. Mix raw rice soups and hamburger in covered baking dish. Add mushrooms; do not drain juice. Put in with mixture; add soy sauce to taste. Mix about 4 cans of water into mixture. Add celery. Bake at 350\u00b0 until rice is done. Add more water if needed to finish cooking rice. Stir mixture every 1/2 hour.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: In medium bowl beat the cream cheese until light and fluffy. Slowly add sweetened condensed milk; beat until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla until well mixed. Pour into crust. Chill 3 hours until firm then top with cherry pie filling.

title: Pita Pizzas
instructions: Individual pizzas Arrange pita bread (whole) on cookie sheet. Spoon on pizza sauce. Then arrange toppings on bread. Place cookie sheet in oven preheated to 400\u00b0. Cook pizzas for 15 to 18 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Thinly slice cucumbers; add onions peppers and whole garlic cloves. Add salt. Cover with cracked ice; mix thoroughly. Let stand 3 hours. Drain well. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over cucumber mixture. Heat just to boil; seal in hot sterilized jars. Makes 5 pints.

title: Spinach Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well. Let stand overnight. Use as a dip for a vegetable tray.

title: Fried Ice Cream
instructions: Take one scoop of ice cream and form into ball. Make as many as needed. Put them into freezer until hard. Mix crumbs sugar and cinnamon together. Take ice cream balls from freezer and roll in mixture pressing into ice cream. Have deep fryer ready with Crisco oil as hot as you would have for French fries. Put ice cream ball on slotted spoon and dip down in oil and right back out. Beat bottom of spoon lightly on paper towel then put ball in a sherbet dish. Top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry and serve.

title: Chicken Noodles
instructions: Boil chicken; take meat off bones. Cook egg noodles. Mix chicken and noodles in baking dish with cream of mushroom soup. Put shredded Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese melts or is hot. Serve with mashed potatoes and corn.

title: Adam'S Different Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown the meat; drain. Pour into a large pot with rest of ingredients. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. It is very aromatic while cooking and tastes as good as it smells.

title: Cream Cheese Pineapple Pie
instructions: Drain syrup from pineapple chunks and add enough water to make 1 cup. Chill chunks. Bring syrup to a boil and stir slowly into lemon jello. When dissolved stir half of this jello mixture into softened cream cheese. When smooth and thoroughly blendedplace this mixture in crumb crust and chill thoroughly.

title: Savory Italian Rice Bake(8 Servings)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare rice as package directs. Crumble and brown sausage and onions. Drain and reserve 1 tablespoon drippings. Saute zucchini and garlic 3 minutes until crisp-tender. Combine rice sausage and 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce and basil. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with half of cheese. Top with zucchini and then remaining sauce and then rest of cheese. Bake 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Lutheran Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet and brown chicken pieces. Remove chicken and add vegetables to skillet. Brown lightly.

title: Pear Amber
instructions: Wash oranges; cut up and remove seeds then dice or grind coarsely peeling and all. Add drained pineapple and peeled and diced pears to orange mixture. (The orange and pineapple mixture keeps the pears from getting dark.) Measure this mixture into a large broad kettle. For each cup add 3 cups of sugar. Heat slowly to boiling stirring constantly. Boil stirring frequently 20 to 30 minutes longer until pears are transparent and mixture is as thick as you like. Add cherries. Remove from heat; let stand overnight. Stir occasionally while cooling. Heat to boil; pack into jars. Makes 3 1/2 pints.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: Use 2 tablespoons to 1 cup hot water (or to taste).

title: Tom'S Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Melt margarine in saucepan; add sugar. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture gradually. Mix well. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch (lightly greased) pan. Sprinkle with chips and nuts. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut in bars. Makes 48. Great for tailgate parties!

title: Banana Roll
instructions: Peel and cut bananas in half lengthwise or slice. Spread with peanut butter. Roll in coconut and chill until served. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pat Valley'S Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Mix peppers sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add color and Certo. Pour into jars and seal.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat egg. Add other ingredients and beat well. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 375\u00b0. Cook until browned and a knife inserted comes out clean (about 1 hour). Turn oven down to finish cooking if it browns too much.

title: Shantell'S Favorite Snack
instructions: Mix the onion soup mix into the sour cream. Stir well. Place on crackers and eat.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In small mixing bowl beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy. Add peanut butter and beat well. Gradually beat in milk. Fold in topping. Pile into pie shell. Sprinkle with peanuts. Freeze until firm then wrap in moisture proof wrap.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Add half of the hash browns. Mix soup sour cream milk and onions. Pour half of the mixture over the potatoes. Spread cheese over mixture. Spread remaining soup mixture cheese and 2 tablespoons butter on top of the corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers. Beat milk and pudding mix until thick; add Cool Whip. Spread half of the pudding mixture over the graham crackers. Add another layer of graham crackers. Add the remaining pudding on top of the second layer. Add third layer of graham crackers.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Oriental
instructions: In bowl stir together first 4 ingredients until blended. Stir in chicken celery water chestnuts and onion. Add macaroni; toss to coat well. Spoon into 2-quart casserole. Top with chow mein noodles. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven 20 to 25 minutes or until heated. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Steak Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions in oil. Add potatoes carrots seasonings and water; simmer gently 20 minutes or until vegetables are soft. Pour into a deep casserole and cover with short biscuit crust (according to package) and bake until crust is brown (about 25 minutes) in hot oven at 400\u00b0. My mom usually makes this as a two crust pie instead of using biscuit dough.

title: Christmas Bread
instructions: Scald milk. Add sugar butter and salt cool to lukewarm. Add yeast mixture and 3 cups flour. Let rise 1 hour then add vanilla and eggs. Mix fruit and raisins with 1/4 cup flour add to dough then add enough flour to handle (about 4 cups). Knead well and let rise until light. Put in greased loaf pans. Let rise until doubled. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake about 40 minutes. Frost with confectioners sugar. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Prune Nut Bread
instructions: Drain prunes; save liquid. Add enough water to make 1/2 cup liquid. Combine with buttermilk; set aside. Mix flour baking soda baking powder and wheat flour. Combine prunes nuts and 1 cup of dry ingredients.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine egg milk 2/3 cup cracker crumbs 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Stir in corn onion and pimento; mix well. Turn into a 1 quart casserole. Toss butter with remaining crumbs; sprinkle on top of corn mixture. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Hot Dog Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare potato puffs for 4 servings as directed on package. Stir pickle relish mayonnaise onion and mustard. Spoon into ungreased 1-quart casserole dish. Cut each frankfurter lengthwise in half then cut crosswise in half. Insert frankfurter pieces upright around edge of mashed potatoes. Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Balls(They'Re Really Good!)
instructions: Unwrap crescent dinner roll dough. Cut each individual triangle into three equal triangles. Wrap around cocktail wiener leaving seam at bottom.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Lay pork chops in 2-quart casserole. Put a slice of onion on each. Sprinkle with a few drops of lemon juice and a small teaspoon of brown sugar. Put a few drops of ketchup on each one. Repeat in layers until all chops are used. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Homemade Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and salt together in a large saucepan. Add milk stir well. Bring to a boil; do not stir again until fudge comes to a soft ball at bottom of a cold cup of water. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla extract. Beat with electric beater until smooth and thick (takes about 5 minutes). Put on a greased (with butter) cookie sheet. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Dip in flour then egg mixture. Dip in bread crumbs with a little Parmesan cheese mixed in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta; drain well. Add salad dressing and Salad Supreme; marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Next day add tomatoes pepper and cucumber.

title: Strawberry Snow Cake
instructions: Cut cake in half. Tear into small pieces and spread on bottom of glass or metal dish. Mix Dream Whip as directed. Add powdered sugar and cream cheese to Dream Whip. Mix well. Spread over broken pieces of cake. Tear other half of cake and place on top of that. Mix strawberries in glaze and spread over cake. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Parsley Rice
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in melted butter; add to rice. Beat egg and milk. Add egg mixture grated cheese and chopped parsley to rice mixture. Bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place sliced apples in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Blend remaining ingredients until crumbly; spread over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown. Serve warm with cream or ice cream. Serves 12.

title: Creole Style Green Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon saving 3 tablespoons drippings. Cook onion and green pepper in this until tender. Blend in flour sugar and seasonings. Add tomatoes and cook until thickened. Add beans. Heat thoroughly. Put in casserole and sprinkle with diced bacon. Keep warm in oven.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs lightly. Blend in remaining ingredients. Pour in 9-inch pie shell and bake for 1 1/2 hours in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Cornflake Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat butter sugars egg and vanilla together. Mix flour soda baking powder and salt. Stir into sugar mixture (mix well). Stir in coconut and corn flakes. Drop by teaspoon on baking sheet 2 inches apart. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned. Cool slightly. Remove from pan to cooling rack. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Tea
instructions: In heated tea pot pour boiled water over tea bags cinnamon cloves orange juice and brown sugar. Let steep 3 to 4 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook chicken and pull from bones. Cook together beef pork and onion in 1 cup chicken stock and just enough water to cover meat. Cook slowly for 1 hour. Salt to taste. Add catsup and tomatoes; cook another hour. Add corn chicken and 1 teaspoon ground red pepper. Cook slowly another hour and stir often. (Three hours cooking time.)

title: Heavenly Cake
instructions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan according to box directions. When done poke holes in cake. While cake is cooling combine pineapple and sugar. Boil for 5 minutes. Pour over cake while hot. Let stand until cool; then prepare pudding mix according to box directions. Spread over cake. Spread whipped cream topping over this. Refrigerate.

title: Orange Jello, Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water. Add orange sherbet. Let set partially and add whipped cream and mandarin oranges. Put in mold and let set. (Drain mandarin oranges well.)

title: Tomato, Mozzarella, Red Onion Salad
instructions: Clean and dry tomatoes; cut into 1/4-inch slices. Peel and cut red onions into 1/4-inch slices. Slice cheese lengthwise thinly using knife or cheese slicer. Arrange tomatoes onions and cheese circularly around platter one layer on top of the next. Drain can of olives and pour olives evenly over platter. Season with salt pepper and parsley. Add fresh basil leaves over the platter in layers or in pieces. Drizzle olive oil and vinegar to taste over platter. Refrigerate after covering with plastic wrap. Serve cold with fresh Italian bread.

title: Phyllis'S Pimiento Cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken Fajitas
instructions: In heavy plastic bag combine chicken strips and dressing. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight turning bag occasionally. Drain. Heat a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat; stir-fry chicken strips and onions for 2 minutes. Add pepper strips and mushrooms; cook and stir until chicken is done and peppers are tender-crisp. Season with garlic salt lemon juice salt and pepper. Serve in warm tortillas. Top with picante sauce and sour cream. (Also fresh chopped tomatoes if in season.)

title: Zucchini Cakes
instructions: Combine grated zucchini beaten egg and melted margarine. Add seasoned bread crumbs onion and Old Bay and mix well. Shape into patties. Broil.

title: Baked Seasoned Potatoes
instructions: Spread diced potatoes (peelings optional) in shallow baking dish. Pour melted margarine over potatoes. Sprinkle seasonings evenly over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Test for doneness. Stir before serving.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Put potato chips on top (crushed). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a large pan. Mix well at this point only add about 1/2 gallon milk. After mixing is complete place on stove and warm to insure everything is dissolved. Once warmed pour everything in ice cream freezer. Add remaining milk to fill line on freezer. Freeze in ice cream freezer until frozen; then pack freezer with ice for an hour to insure it is good and frozen.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients and put in a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex dish. Add a little chicken broth if mixture seems dry. Mix crushed chips and cheese and place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: No Weep Meringue
instructions: Boil water salt cornstarch and vanilla until it is clear. Cool. Add sugar and 3 egg whites that have been stiffly beaten. Beat into cooked mixture. Put on top of pie; brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Warm Spinach 'N Cheddar Dip
instructions: In 1-quart casserole dish combine vegetable recipe soup mix sour cream spinach and 3/4 cup cheese until smooth. Top with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes about 3 cups dip.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Arrange red leaf lettuce on individual salad plates. Place either red or white onion slices alternately with grapefruit slices which have been peeled and all pith removed. Mayonnaise or any fruit dressing may be used.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and meal. Add eggs. Beat until creamy. Add butter milk and lemon juice and rind. Beat until smooth. Put in unbaked pie crusts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Note Prepare in an 11 x 7-inch pan.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients; mix well. Shape into 2 balls; roll in pecans. Cover and chill. Remove from the refrigerator 15 minutes before serving.

title: Make Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft. Mix with remaining ingredients. Place in serving bowl and top with paprika. These may be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen until serving. Reheat extremely well in oven or microwave. Great time saver on holidays.

title: Baked Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine eggs milk sugar vanilla and salt. Mix well. Add rice and raisins. Pour into 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean about 30 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
instructions: Combine jello pineapple and boiling water. Let partially congeal in refrigerator. Add remaining ingredients. Fold together; let congeal in refrigerator.

title: Smothered Corn
instructions: Fry bacon and reserve drippings. Clean corn and cut lengthwise 1/4 inch from top; scrape corn with side of blade of knife to get corn milk. Mix all ingredients except grease; season and pour in hot grease/oil. Reduce fire to low. Cook 45 minutes covered and stirring occasionally. Add water if it starts to stick.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add tomatoes and chilies and garlic. Add cheese cut into 1-inch cubes. Cook until cheese is melted. Serve warm with Fritos. Makes a great filling for an omelet too.

title: Bacon Rolls
instructions: Soak water chestnuts in soy sauce for 10 to 15 minutes. While soaking cook enough bacon to wrap around the number of soaking water chestnuts. Bacon should only be cooked a little bit (brown not crisp). Roll bacon around chestnuts and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in this order lettuce cauliflower green pepper onion bacon and green peas. Completely cover with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with sugar. Top with Cheddar cheese. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight. Mix together before serving.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Line 13 x 9-inch pan with crescent rolls add sausage. Mix eggs milk and onion. Pour over sausage. Cover with both cheeses. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine sugar and water. Cook until syrupy (10 to 15 minutes). Cool. Add apricot nectar strawberries pineapple and bananas. Spoon into small cups. Freeze until firm. Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies. Stir.

title: Sunset Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and lemon juice. Chill until very thick. Then fold in carrots and pecans. Pour into individual molds or a 1-quart mold or bowl. Chill until firm. Unmold. Garnish with additional pineapple if desired. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine flour and powdered sugar. Cut in butter until crumbly. Press flour mixture into ungreased 8 or 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon in a 3-quart pot 5 to 6 minutes until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon to paper towel to drain. Discard fat. Add onion to skillet. Cook 4 to 5 minutes until translucent. Stir in soup milk and corn until blended. Bring to a simmer. Stir in fish and thyme. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes longer until fish is opaque in center. Sprinkle with bacon. Serve with oyster crackers and a spinach salad.

title: Beef Dip
instructions: Chop dried beef and green onion tops. Mix all ingredients together. Chill. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Pour into ungreased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Boil broccoli and drain. Put in bottom or casserole dish. Mix soups and grated 1/2 of cheese into soup mix. Add mayonnaise and lemon juice to soup mixture. Cook chicken. Cut it up and spread it over broccoli. Pour the soup mixture over the chicken. Use croutons and bread crumbs on the top and the rest of the cheese and melt in 350 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bake
instructions: In 2-quart shallow baking dish combine all ingredients except reserve 1/2 of the margarine and 1/2 stuffing mix. Melt margarine. Toss remaining stuffing mix with melted margarine and spoon over vegetable mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: French Cherry Pie
instructions: Combine milk sour cream and almond extract in bowl. Add pudding mix. Slowly beat until well blended about 1 minute. Pour into pie shell. Chill at least 2 hours. After cutting chilled pie into wedges spoon pie filling over each serving. Serves 6.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach very well. Mix all ingredients and make into small balls. Use a tablespoon to make balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Can be frozen and reheated.

title: Pineanna Nut Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0; grease and flour 3 round pans 9 x 1 1/2-inch. Mix flour sugar baking soda salt and cinnamon in a large bowl; add oil and eggs.
