Stir until all dry ingredients are moistened (do not beat). Stir in bananas pecans vanilla and pineapple. Divide batter evenly among pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely on wire rack. Fill layers and frost side and top of cakes with Cream Cheese Frosting. Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans on top of cake. Refrigerate any remaining cake.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Beat all ingredients until blended.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add sliced thin carrots celery and onions (small pieces). Salt and pepper. Put in oblong dish. Put mashed potatoes on top of hamburger mixture. Dot potatoes with butter. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven until potatoes are light brown. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Matriciana(Pasta With Bacon)
instructions: In medium saucepan saute onion olive oil and bacon until golden. Add crushed tomatoes basil salt and pepper. Cook for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: African Ground Nut Stew(Serves 8)
instructions: Boil chicken; remove skin and set aside with hard-boiled eggs. Save stock. In wide pot (tall pot makes process take longer) bring okra to a boil. After lowering heat slowly add peanut butter stirring constantly. If sauce becomes too thick add some of saved chicken stock stirring constantly. Add chicken and hard-boiled eggs to sauce and serve over white rice. No seasoning necessary.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Spread crushed pretzels in bottom of large Pyrex dish. Mix butter and 3 tablespoons sugar over pretzels. Bake 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool 25 minutes. Blend 1 cup Cool Whip and cream cheese. Spoon on top of pretzels. Refrigerate. Prepare jello in 2 cups boiling water. Mix partially thawed strawberries with jello. Pour over cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate until set.

title: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Saute onions until transparent. Add beaten eggs to other ingredients. Bake in a greased 7 x 10-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let cool before cutting small squares. Reheat on serving pan when ready to use.

title: Soft Cornbread
instructions: Place first four ingredients in a bowl. Scald with boiling water stirring vigorously. Add milk eggs slightly beaten. Place bacon drippings in a medium size Pyrex bowl and heat in oven. Pour hot drippings into mixture and stir. Pour all into Pyrex bowl and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in 425\u00b0 oven or until brown on top. Serve with spoon. Delicious served with butter. Excellent with beef hash and gravy. Serves 4.

title: Congo Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Add dry ingredients. Mix all well. Place mixture in a 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool slightly cut into squares.

title: Chicken Skillet
instructions: Put everything in skillet. Cook on medium heat for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Emma Wolfe'S Chow-Chow
instructions: Caution Wear rubber gloves in preparing. Chop onions peppers cabbage and green tomatoes. Mix all vegetable with 1/2 cup canning salt or table salt. Let stand overnight. Drain. Tie mixed spices in bag; add sugar and spices to vinegar. Simmer 20 minutes then add all other ingredients and simmer until hot and well seasoned. Remove spice bag. Pack hot chow-chow into hot jars and seal at once. (Food processor may be used to chop vegetables and peppers but do not chop veggies too fine.) (Caution - Wear rubber gloves and do not get directly over processor because of fumes and liquid of hot pepper.)

title: Mushroom Florentine
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter. Line greased 9-inch square pan with spinach. Mix salt 1/4 cup melted butter and onion. Sprinkle over spinach. Sprinkle on half of cheese. Now spoon mushrooms on top of cheese. Sprinkle with garlic powder and add second half of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. If you use a 9 x 13-inch pan double the recipe. Single recipe serves 4 to 6 persons.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Pare and slice potatoes into dish. Season with salt and pepper. Peel and thinly slice onion in a layer on top of potatoes. Spread the ground beef in a layer over onions. Season the ground beef. Add beans and soup. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and moisten with mayonnaise to desired consistency.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese onto large microwave dish. Pour chili over cream cheese; cover with Cheddar cheese. Microwave until cheese is melted and bubbly. Add lettuce sour cream tomatoes and olives. Serve warm with tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Line 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with aluminum foil extending foil above sides of pan. Combine coconut and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of prepared pan. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients except whipped topping mix well. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared pan. Freeze 6 hours or until firm. To serve remove from pan peel off foil. Slice to serve. Freeze leftovers.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Sift 1/2 cup flour baking powder salt and cocoa together. Cream 1 cup sugar oleo and 2 eggs. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. In large bowl add dry ingredients. Stir well. Add nuts.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in a small greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Judge A. Frye'S Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Best if chilled overnight.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add strawberries pineapple and pecans. Halve mixture putting half in pan and leaving other half in bowl. Put pan in refrigerator; let gel. Afterwards spread with sour cream. Pour remaining half on top; let gel.

title: Hamburger Noodle Bake
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add garlic salt and pepper and tomato sauce. Simmer while cooking noodles. Mix sour cream cottage cheese and onions together. In a large casserole make 2 or 3 layers of noodles cream mixture and meat sauce ending with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Bourbon Hot Dogs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer 1/2 hour. Serve in a fondue or heatproof dish over a candle warmer.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight. Cover ham with water and boil until tender. Skim fat from broth. Add beans drained then celery onions parsley and pepper. Simmer all together until ham is well cooked the beans soft and the whole well blended. Serves 6.

title: Working Woman'S Dinner
instructions: Just wash meat and veggies and cut up. Of course you peel the potatoes! Throw everything in one pot. Simmer at 350\u00b0 until tender to preference or chicken is done. Serves 3 to 6 people depending on how much you eat! Can be served over rice. Is definitely not fattening unless you make gravy.

title: Quickie Beef Stew
instructions: Drain vegetables reserving liquid. Combine flour and soup mix in large skillet. Add water to reserved liquid to measure 3 cups; stir into mixture in skillet. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in vegetables and beef. Cover; cook over low heat about 10 minutes or until heated through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Spaghetti Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Wash cook and dice chicken. Saut pepper celery and mushrooms in 1/8 pound of butter. Make white sauce with 2/3 stick butter flour broth and milk. Combine chicken spaghetti vegetables and pimento. Pour sauce over chicken mixture. Pour into casserole dish. Bake 400 degrees for 1 hour or until light brown.

title: Tapioca Pudding
instructions: Slowly put into boiling water tapioca; stir this frequently. Boil 1/2 hour until clear. Remove from heat. Pour into hot mixture the jello; add sugar. Let cool. Mix in Dream Whip bananas and miniature marshmallows.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut celery cauliflower and broccoli ends into small pieces. Add drained pimentos olives and cheese. Mix together with mayonnaise.

title: Texas Potatoes
instructions: Cover potatoes onions and salt with water. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Drain. Add pimento and place in a greased 8-inch baking dish. Add pepper and cheese to white sauce and pour over potatoes. Top with crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Easy Chicken Dinner
instructions: Place uncooked rice in casserole dish. Arrange chicken on top. Pour on soups and water. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Turn chicken after 1 hour.

title: B O C Cookies
instructions: In small bowl crush Wheaties. Add oats coconut and chopped nuts. In another bowl add flour baking soda salt and baking powder. Cream margarine and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix. Add cereal mixture last. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0.

title: Butter Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Pour in Bundt pan and bake 45 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Grease cookie sheet and top of bread then let rise for several hours. Cut dough in half. Roll each section as thin as possible (12 x 15-inch).

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Add yeast mixture and mix well. Put in a tight plastic covered container and put in refrigerator overnight. Pinch amount of dough you need and knead it on a floured board. Roll or cut into biscuits. Place on a greased pan. Bake at 450\u00b0. When biscuits begin to brown brush tops with melted butter. Dough will keep in refrigerator about 25 days.

title: No Name Pie
instructions: Mix together flour and sugar; add remaining ingredients mixing thoroughly. Pour into pie shell. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan combine soup milk cheese garlic powder and pepper; add broccoli and carrots. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Cover; cook on low heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring occasionally. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot juice from drained pineapple (add water to make 1 cup). Add 1 cup frozen orange juice prepared as directed on can. Let set until partially jelled. Add fruit and chill.

title: Brownie Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease or spray with nonstick coating a baking dish 13 x 9-inch.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Cut pork chops and zucchini into bite size pieces. Fry pork pieces along with bones in ungreased pan until cooked. Transfer meat into a deep pot. Add zucchini drained corn and tomato sauce. Add enough water to cover ingredients and season to taste. Let boil on medium heat until cooked or until zucchini is soft enough to eat. Pour over cornbread if desired when serving.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; chill thoroughly. Serve on lettuce leaves. Serves 6.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and put in casserole. Crush potato chips and sprinkle over top. Melt 1 stick of butter and drizzle over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Discard stems and shred cauliflower and broccoli. Combine with remaining ingredients. Marinate 24 hours for extra good flavor or can eat right away.

title: Poi Puff
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Spoon poi mixture. Drop into oil.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all together. Put in freezer to make slush. After slushy add 16 or 32 ounces 7-Up.

title: Seven Layer Dip
instructions: Mash avocados and stir in garlic lemon juice and mayonnaise. Spread into 8 x 12-inch pan. Cover with 1/2 of sour cream. Spread on salsa. Cover with remaining sour cream. Sprinkle on olives. Sprinkle on tomatoes. Sprinkle on cheese. Serve with nachos or Dorito chips.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Combine applesauce margarine egg vanilla and sweetener. Add the applesauce mixture to the dry ingredients and mix well until moistened. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Palatschinken (Viennese Pancakes)
instructions: Beat butter and peanut butter together until creamy. Add graham cracker crumbs and confectioners sugar a little at a time until well blended. (Note This mixture is very thick and heavy. I use a food processor to blend the ingredients. If you use a mixer dough hooks are helpful.) Press the mixture into a 9 x 13-inch edged cookie sheet.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Put in oven at 375\u00b0 about 1 hour. If too dry add a little water and cook a little longer.

title: English Muffin Pizza
instructions: Lightly toast the English muffins. Spread pizza sauce on muffins and top with cheese. Place zucchini and mushrooms on top. Put in the toaster oven or microwave until cheese is melted. Enjoy.

title: Almond Tea
instructions: Boil tea bags in 2 cups water 5 minutes. Set aside. Boil sugar in 4 cups water 5 minutes. Combine with tea. Stir in lemon juice vanilla and almond extract. Chill and serve on ice.

title: Bridget'S Burger Veggie Soup
instructions: Cook hamburger and drain grease. Add to large kettle with vegetable broth 2 cans stewed tomatoes whole tomatoes broken up onion veggies and garlic. Then add water to cover contents in kettle and continue to add as needed during cooking. Add pepper salt and rosemary if desired. Cook on medium heat for 2 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Chicken In Nest
instructions: Melt fat and blend in flour salt and pepper. Add chicken stock and cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add chicken and more seasoning if necessary. Serve in macaroni ring. Serves 4.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Cook potatoes and mash. Mix with sugar and butter thoroughly. Wrap marshmallows with potato mixture. Roll each ball in corn flakes. Place in greased baking dish and bake for 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cereal Kisses
instructions: Add salt to egg whites and beat until foamy. Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating after each. Continue beating until stiff. Add vanilla and fold in cereal. Drop from teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Ritz Bits Cracker Snack
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine crackers and nuts on large greased cookie sheet. Combine in saucepan butter or margarine sugar and corn syrup. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla and soda. Pour over crackers and nuts. Bake for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. When done put on wax paper to cool. Break into pieces when cool enough to handle.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Bake at 325\u00b0 approximately 3 hours uncovered.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Stir together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Combine egg milk and oil. Add to dry ingredients stirring until combined. Stir in nuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Pineapple Parfait Pie
instructions: Combine marshmallows and pineapple in saucepan and cook over medium heat until marshmallows are completely melted. Cool thoroughly. Whip the cream and fold pineapple mixture into whipped cream. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill several hours or overnight. May be topped with more whipped cream and toasted coconut if desired.

title: Kahlua Mousse
instructions: Mix gelatin sugar and salt in 2 1/2-quart saucepan. Stir in milk and chocolate pieces. Place over medium heat and stir constantly until gelatin is dissolved and chocolate is melted. Remove from heat; beat with rotary beater until chocolate is blended. Stir in Kahlua and vanilla. Chill stirring occasionally until mixture mounds slightly. Fold in whipped cream. Turn into a 4-cup mold. Chill until firm. Unmold. Garnish with chocolate curls.

title: Corn Bread Muffins
instructions: Mix mixture until thin (not running). Bake in well-greased muffin pan at 400\u00b0 until top is brown.

title: Libby'S Famous Pumpkin Pie(2 Pies)
instructions: Combine filling ingredients in order given. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 40 to 50 minutes or clean knife test. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Jolly Ranchers Candy
instructions: Go see Dad H. Hold out hand and say please. Unwrap Rancher; put candy in mouth. Give Dad H. the wrapper. Eat. Fighting over flavors is optional.

title: Pepperoni Wiches
instructions: Combine cream cheese soup and pepperoni. Spread on toasted muffins. Put on a cookie sheet and broil for 5 minutes or until cheese browns evenly. Cool for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken in water. Cut away skin and fat. Discard. Cut the chicken into pieces dip in cold water and wipe dry. Shake the\tchicken pieces in a paper bag with seasoned flour (flour salt and pepper). Preheat the Dutch oven.\tWhen it is hot put in 2 tablespoons of cooking oil and add the chicken pieces. Brown until golden. Put lid on oven and add coals on top. Bake basting the chicken occasionally for 15 minutes. Turn the pieces over and cook 15 minutes more.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil oleo cocoa sugar and milk. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat quickly and mix in peanut butter oatmeal and vanilla. Drop on wax paper on cookie sheet.

title: Pioneer Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter and mix in sugar eggs biscuit mix and nuts. Spread in an 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cool cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Makes approximately 1 dozen brownies.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan saute onion in margarine until soft. Stir in flour mustard pepper and nutmeg. Gradually add broth cook stirring constantly until smooth. Add milk heat through. Remove from heat. Add cheese stir until melted. Serve immediately. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired. Serves 4 approximately 3/4 cup each.

title: Cheese-Sauced Tuna Salad
instructions: Place bacon on a rack in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover with paper towels. Microwave at High for 4 to 6 minutes or until bacon is crisp. Drain bacon; crumble and set aside. Combine tuna coleslaw and pepper; stir well. Core tomatoes; cut to but not through the base of each tomato. Place on individual salad plates. Spread wedges slightly apart; fill each tomato with tuna mixture.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and cauliflower according to directions (microwave if you have). Drain then add soup and Cheez Whiz. Pour into greased casserole. Put onions on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Macaroon Kiss Cookies
instructions: Cream butter cream cheese and sugar in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add egg yolk almond extract and orange juice and beat well. Combine flour baking powder and salt and gradually add to creamed mixture. Stir in 3 cups of the coconut. Cover tightly.

title: Matzo Balls
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat egg yolks until light. Add salt pepper and melted oleo or butter. Fold into egg whites. Fold in matzo meal one spoonful at a time. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Wet hands and form batter into balls the size of a walnut. Drop into rapidly boiling soup or water. Reduce heat and cook slowly covered about 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Roskette
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter. Add eggs flour cornstarch and vanilla. Mix until well blended and smooth. Add cream. Make small balls about 1 inch in diameter then roll about 9 inches long and twist into a figure eight. Grease cookie sheet lightly and sprinkle with flour before putting roskette dough on the sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 in preheated oven for about 20 minutes. While still warm carefully remove from cookie sheet to cool. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Crunchy Carrot Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Toss again before serving.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Cream oil sugar and eggs. Add flour and milk alternately. Stir in vanilla. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Mix flour sugar and milk together. Pour mixture over melted butter. Drop peaches on batter in pan. Sprinkle with sugar and nutmeg (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Heavenly Egg Plant
instructions: Cut eggplant in round 1/2 inch slices. Beat eggs dip eggplant in egg then in bread crumbs. Coat completely and shake off excess crumbs. Slowly heat half of the oil in a a large skillet. Saute eggplant slices in oil until light brown on both sides about 2 minutes per side. Drain eggplant on paper towel. Add more oil as needed to brown remaining eggplant. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a baking dish put eggplant then cover with ricotta cheese spaghetti sauce mozzarella cheese Italian seasoning and parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Philly Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove mushroom stems. Chop enough stems to measure 1/2 cup. Cook half of mushroom caps in 3 tablespoons of margarine over medium heat for 5 minutes. Drain. Repeat with remaining mushroom caps and margarine.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water mix in a large bowl with other ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls into greased muffin tins. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 20 minutes. Make sure margarine is cool enough so it wont cook the egg when you add it.

title: Pizza Snacks
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Melt cheese with meat over low heat. Add remaining ingredients and put in a teaspoon of meat and cheese mixture on rye bread. Serve. Can freeze for later use.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix vanilla wafers and margarine; press in bottom of pan. Set in icebox to chill.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix milk eggs salt pepper and butter. Then mix remaining ingredients except for a small amount of cheese. Pour into 9 1/2 x 11-inch baking pan. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top and bake for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Fran'S Cheese Wafers
instructions: Have margarine and cheese at room temperature; whip until light and well mixed. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased pan and press with fork dipped in flour. Bake 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 60.

title: Pickle And Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Take slices of ham and spread on a layer of cream cheese. Cut ham into strips big enough to roll a pickle in. Take a pickle; roll it up in the ham and then slice into bite-sized pieces.

title: Anita'S Pickled Shrimp
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Sift together the first 6 ingredients. Cream shortening and sugar; add egg and beat until light and fluffy. Blend in applesauce. Add dry ingredients. Stir in raisins and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Meme'S Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add mashed bananas pineapple and juice and strawberries and mix well. Refrigerate overnight and serve.

title: One Hour Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add buttermilk sugar and Crisco. Stir to melt Crisco. Sift in flour soda and salt. Beat until smooth and let stand 10 minutes. Divide in half and roll out each half on slightly floured board fairly thin. Cut each circle into 12 pie-shaped wedges. Roll from wide end to point. Put in greased pans and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 24 rolls.

title: Cherry Or Blackberry Dessert
instructions: Mix thoroughly graham cracker crumbs sugar and oleo. Mix cream cheese with sugar and eggs. Put graham cracker mix in loaf pan and spread with mixture. Bake 15 minutes at about 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Spicy Banana Bars
instructions: Sift together the first 8 ingredients. Combine shortening and bananas. Beat shortening and bananas for 2 minutes. Add egg; beat 1 minute. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Blend thoroughly after each addition. Stir in pecans; spread well in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 22 to 25 minutes.

title: Pickled Fish
instructions: Fillet fish removing the skin. Cut into 1/2-inch cubes or squares. Use a glass or crock container. For each quart of fish use 5/8 cup of pickling salt and cover with cider or white vinegar. Stir well. Place the jar in the refrigerator for one week. Stir thoroughly every day. Rinse thoroughly in cold water and let stand in cold water for one hour. Drain well pack loosely in jar using a layer of fish and layer of onion. Over this pour a syrup of 1 pint vinegar 1 1/4 cups sugar and 1 teaspoon pickling spice. Bring to a boil and let cool. Remove spices. Pour syrup over fish. Seal and store in refrigerator. Ready in 3 to 4 hours.

title: Take Everywhere Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix Mexicorn with creamed corn. Add remaining ingredients except Parmesan; blend. Pour into buttered 9 x 12-inch casserole; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0; bake until firm about 40 to 45 minutes. Marvelous!

title: Cauliflower Cheese(Casserole)
instructions: Separate cauliflower into flowerets. Drop into boiling water with salt. Cook five minutes or until tender-crisp. Drain. Arrange in a shallow 2-quart well-buttered baking dish.

title: Cher'S Strawberry Freeze
instructions: Place strawberries and Equal in a food processor or blender. Mix until coarsely chopped. With motor running gradually add evaporated skim milk. Mix until smooth. Serve immediately. Serves 4 with 167 calories each.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Saute meat; drain fat. Sprinkle with packaged seasonings. Blend well. Add tomato sauce and tomatoes mixed in blender. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes stirring frequently. In a very lightly buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish spread a thin\tlayer of\tsauce then a layer of quartered tortillas chilies and cheese. Repeat for a second layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Low Calorie Crust For One Pie
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Pour vinegar then oil then milk into a small cup and add all at once to flour mixture. Stir to blend. Then press into a ball. Flatten slightly. Roll out between 2 sheets of wax paper to fit an 8-inch pie plate. Flute edges. Pour in filling and bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Holiday Squares
instructions: Gradually add sugar to butter in large mixer bowl cream at medium speed until light and fluffy. At same speed add eggs one at a time beating well after each. At low speed add flour and lemon extract. Pour batter into well-greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Mark off 20 squares. Place 1 heaping tablespoon pie filling in center of each square. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. While warm sift confectioners sugar over cake. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Turtle Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Unwrap caramels and set aside in saucepan. Mix cake according to package. Grease and flour pan. Bake 1/2 of cake mixture in greased pan for 15 minutes. Melt together butter milk and caramels on low heat. Remove cake from oven. Pour caramel mixture over cake. Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans over caramel evenly. Spread rest of cake batter over top. Bake another 20 to 25 minutes. When toothpick comes out clean (in top layer of cake) cake is done. Cool for 1 hour. Use oblong cake pan.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Put butter sugar and dates in large boiler. Cook until thick and bubbly. Mixture will make a ball when 1/2 teaspoon is put into a cup of cold water. Remove from heat; add nuts Rice Krispies and vanilla. Mix well. Let cool. Make into small balls. Place on waxed paper. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Strawberry Angel Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add sugar and lemon juice. Stir and add frozen strawberries. Stir well. Fold in whipped cream. Crumble cake in small pieces. Place half in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour Jell-O mixture over cake. Place second layer of cake and pour remainder of Jell-O mixture. Refrigerate until set.

title: Irish Scones
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Add in margarine. Add sugar and currants or raisins. Add milk and work into soft dough.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Saute onions in margarine until tender. Stir in bread crumbs sugar salt and pepper. Set aside. Arrange half of the tomatoes in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with half of crumb mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Granny'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash onion salt and sugar. Simmer with small amount of water for 20 minutes. Drain well. Mash with potato masher. Add eggs melted butter flour milk and cheese. Add seasoning salt to taste. Bake in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with crumbs and bake 10 minutes more. It can be stored in a refrigerator for 2 or 3 days unbaked. Freezes very well. Makes 8 servings.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Combine tomatoes cheese vinegar oil pepper sauce garlic and salt. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Makes about 3/4 cups.

title: Cold Pork And Bean Salad
instructions: Using a colander thoroughly rinse the beans removing all the juice. In a mixing bowl combine the beans mayonnaise onions and cucumbers. Mix thoroughly and add pepper generously. Salt to taste. Chill for at least two hours (overnight is better). Yields 4 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Pizza Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix everything together but ham and cheese. Put enough sauce in meat to make it red. You can also add some onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until meat is brown. Sprinkle some Mozzarella cheese on top Swiss and ham chunks.

title: Chop Suey Cake
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a bowl and stir with spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes in a 14 x 10-inch pan. Frost with the icing while the cake is still warm.

title: Yogurt Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating until mixture is light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine flour soda and salt; add to creamed mixture mixing just until blended. Add lemon rind vanilla and yogurt. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on a rack. This cake is so moist and delicious all you need do is dust the top with powdered sugar. Yields 1 (10-inch) cake.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix as package directs. Pour 2 cups batter into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix butter powdered sugar peanut butter and vanilla. Form into small balls. Melt chocolate chips with Crisco. (I do it in the microwave.) Put toothpick into balls and dip in chocolate to give the appearance of a buckeye. Place on waxed paper. Refrigerate to harden.

title: Veggie Bars
instructions: Unroll crescent roll dough. Place in a lightly greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan pressing edges and perforations together to line pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes until browned. Cool and press down.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour; the last 5 minutes sprinkle a small amount of grated cheese on top. Very tasty.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until done. Reserve broth (1/4 cup). Skin and bone chicken. Use kitchen scissors to cut into small chunks. To remainder of broth add potato carrots and celery. Cook a while then add peas and cook until tender. Drain vegetables. Melt margarine in pan. Add flour and salt to make a sauce base then slowly add reserved broth and milk. Cook stirring frequently until sauce thickens. At desired consistency add chicken and vegetables. Season to taste. Cover with crust; slit the crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 until crust is brown.

title: Creme De Menthe Mousse
instructions: Combine marshmallows and milk in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows melt. Stir in creme de menthe. Chill until thick.

title: Seven Layer Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve 1 package of Jell-O in bowl with boiling water. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate to set. Bring milk to boil. Add sugar. Add the unflavored gelatin dissolved in cold water. Mix well. Add sour cream and vanilla. Mix well. Cover first layer with sour cream mixture (1 1/2 cups). Refrigerate until set. Repeat with 3 packages Jell-O and boiling water. Alternate layers of Jell-O with sour cream mixture. Let each layer set before adding the next layer.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine flour oats sugar salt and cinnamon. Add melted butter mixing until crumbly. Sprinkle crumb mixture over apples. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Weiner Schnitzel
instructions: Cut veal into thin slices dip in beaten egg and then into the bread topping Shake and Bake. Bake in the oven at 350\u00b0 until done. Mix a brown gravy packet per directions and add a can of mushrooms. Salt and Pepper to taste. After the veal is cooked pour gravy mixture over the veal and serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Boil turkey remove skin and shred turkey. Add to stock along with all other ingredients. Add sugar last after simmering for a short while. Simmer approximately 1 to 2 hours.

title: Valley Burger Or Dog Relish
instructions: In small bowl combine all ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with hamburgers or hot dogs. Makes about 2/3 cup.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Beat eggs and milk until frothy in bowl. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Stir with wire whisk. Heat oil. Dip onion in batter. Fry 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Dial 662-5555 (Pizza Hut).

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Place washed chicken in pot; cover 2/3 with water. Boil chicken reserving stock to desired doneness. Debone chicken; set aside. Warm 1 cup stock with 1/3 of grated carrot. Add onion green pepper and chicken stock mixture; set aside. When cool add cornstarch; mix well. Set aside. Cut vegetables (remember cut thinly). Heat oil in wok to 350\u00b0 to 380\u00b0. Add onions; stir for 2 minutes. Add rest of vegetables; stir-fry until glossy or desired doneness. Add stock; stir until slightly thick. Splash on soy sauce to taste. Seve over rice or noodles.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Clean chicken and dry. Combine bread crumbs cheese and parsley flakes; mix. Melt margarine and add lemon juice; set aside. Coat each piece of chicken in bread crumb mixture and place in baking dish. Drizzle margarine and lemon juice mixture over each piece of chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lazy Day Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles to package directions. Cool ground beef to warm. Mix meat cheeses and sauce together. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Brandy Slush
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until sugar is pretty well dissolved. Freeze. Use one ice cream scoop per cocktail glass and add wine or 4% mixer to dilute. Stir and serve.

title: Chocolate Velvet Icing
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in medium saucepan. Stir until well blended. Add boiling water stir until well blended. Put on stove and cook until mixture thickens stirring constantly. Add chocolate and butter to mixture continue cooking and stirring until chocolate and butter melts. Remove from heat. Add vanilla stirring constantly. Let cool a little. Spread over cake.

title: Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Blend sugar mustard and salt in bowl. Add vinegar. Mix at medium speed. Slowly add oil and continue beating 10 minutes. Add celery seed onions and coloring.

title: Mother'S Jam Cake
instructions: Cream oleo with sugar. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Caribbean Pork Roast
instructions: Blend the oil and spices in a small bowl. Rub mixture over the entire roast. Place in shallow pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until internal temperature is 155\u00b0. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a microwave safe container stir together sugar and corn syrup. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts; microwave on High for 3 to 5 minutes or until light brown. Add butter and vanilla; blend well. Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes more. Nuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot!! Add baking soda and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Let cool 30 minutes to 1 hour. Break into small pieces. Store in airtight container.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together eggs oil sugar and zucchini. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: In a skillet melt butter; add sugar beaten egg and dates. Cook for 5 minutes after it begins to bubble. Take off heat and add Rice Krispies and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons in coconut and roll to make a ball.

title: Date Nut Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder over whole dates and walnuts. Add sugar. Separate eggs. Add beaten egg yolks to mix. Beat whites to stiff and add vanilla. Add to mix. Bake in loaf pan 1 hour or more at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: *If using raisins soak in cool water for 10 minutes then drain.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook green pepper celery onion oregano garlic powder and cayenne red pepper until vegetables are tender-crisp stirring often. Add 1 cup tomato juice. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes with skin on. Peel and mash with fork (not mixer). Add brown sugar margarine and vanilla. Spoon into hand; add marshmallow and spoon more in hand with marshmallow in middle. Form a ball. Roll in coconut. Put in buttered baking dish in 425\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. Delicious!!

title: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook and mash potatoes. Add the rest of the ingredients and beat until fluffy. If necessary add a little milk.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Layer in ungreased 2-quart casserole first 3 items. Mix bread crumbs cheese and butter; sprinkle on top of soup. Bake uncovered one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chow Mein Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add celery and onion. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add soup. Stir and pour into casserole dish. Place chow mein noodles on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut meat in bite size pieces. Roll in flour and brown in oil. Brown onion in grease. Mix sauce. Add steak and onion to sauce. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours in crock-pot stirring often. Serve over rice.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix all together just before serving.

title: Quick Tartar Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and vegetables until noodles are done.

title: Cheddar Cheese Ball
instructions: Bring Cheddar cheese cream cheese and margarine to room temperature. Add milk onion pimiento Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce. Beat until combined. Cover and chill 4 to 24 hours.

title: Margaret Miller'S Candy
instructions: Melt the chips add noodles and nuts. Drop on cookie sheet and place in refrigerator and cool.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Add flour and press out on pizza pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Cool then add this filling on top.

title: Baked Eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs well. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into a baking dish sprayed with Pam. Bake 45 minutes.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion. Add soup sour cream and chiles. Put a little of the mix on bottom of a pan. Put mixture by the tablespoonful onto the flour shell. Roll up and put into pan. Pour sauce on top of enchiladas. Add cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: In huge mixing bowl beat egg whites and water until frothy not stiff. In a small bowl mix together sugar cinnamon and salt. Pour pecans into egg whites and stir until well coated. Add sugar mixture and stir until pecans are covered. Spread pecans on large baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Remove immediately from baking sheet to cool.

title: No Crust Coconut Pies
instructions: Mix beaten eggs with milk; add butter. Mix sugar and flour together. Slowly add to milk mixture; mix in coconut. Pour into greased pie tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Place breast between waxed paper and pound flat. In pie pan combine crumbs Parmesan 1 teaspoon oregano garlic salt and pepper. In bowl stir together butter parsley and 1/2 teaspoon oregano. Spread herb butter on breast. Add strip of cheese fold and roll. Drip in melted butter and roll in crumb mixture. Place seam side down in 9 x 13-inch pan. Drizzle remaining butter over. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Bake uncovered 20 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Marinated Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate for 2 hours. Bake in shallow dish uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Toast In Oven
instructions: Set oven at 400\u00b0. Mix margarine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. With a knife spread the mixture on one side of the bread. Place the bread on an ungreased cookie sheet. Toast in the oven for 8 minutes.

title: Aunt Lou Ella'S Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook to hard ball stage. Pour over popped corn. Mix good. Batter hands and make into balls.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart ungreased casserole dish. Set casserole dish in a large baking pan. Add hot water to pan to come about halfway up the outside of the casserole dish. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Coconut Cake With Sour Cream Filling
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions adding 2 whole eggs. Bake in 2 layers. When cool split layers with knife or thread making 4 layers. Mix together coconut sour cream and sugar. (Save enough coconut to cover the top and sides of cake.) If possible mix coconut and sour cream with the sugar the day before baking the cake. After the cake has cooled and been sliced spread the coconut mixture on each layer. Stack layers using toothpicks to hold the layers in place then spread the top and sides of the cake with whipped topping and sprinkle with coconut. Refrigerate 2 days before serving to improve the flavor.

title: Frontier Land Sandwich
instructions: Brown and drain meat; add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender. Add barbecue sauce mushrooms and salt. Simmer 15 minutes. Cut bread in 1/2. Scoop out center. Place 6 slices of cheese in bottom. Fill with hot meat. Cover with remaining cheese. Put top back on bread and wrap loaf in tinfoil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs one at a time. Beat in flour and half and half (alternate). Add flavoring. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Double for two cakes; freeze one for later.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; reserve half of the cheese to sprinkle on top. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 baking pan or dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut into squares.

title: Miniature Cheese Cakes
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar eggs and vanilla and beat until smooth. Line the cups of a muffin tin (12 cup muffin tin) with paper liners. Put a vanilla wafer into the bottom of each cup then fill three quarters full with cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. When cool top each cake with pie filling.

title: Chicken Salad(18 Seven Ounce Servings)
instructions: Cook chicken tenders until done. Pinch the tendon off of each tender being careful not to waste any meat. Discard the tendons. Cut tenders in 1/2-inch pieces. Place tenders in bowl; cover and place in refrigerator while you prepare the other ingredients for the chicken salad.

title: Crispy Cooky Coffeecake
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Combine flour salt lemon rind and 1/4 C of sugar in a large bowl. Cut in margarine.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Press into 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix confectioners sugar cream cheese softened and egg. Spread over crust. Add bananas sliced over cream cheese mixture and crushed pineapple drained. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle nuts on top. Refrigerate.

title: Potluck Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown bacon slices and set aside. Brown the hamburg and onion in part of the bacon fat. Partially drain the Great Northern beans and mix with the pork and beans in a large casserole (5-quarts). Add the hamburg and onion. Season with remaining ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Put bacon slices across other ingredients for the last 15 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Quarter biscuits. Put in plastic container or Baggie. Pour brown sugar and cinnamon mixture over balls. Cover and shake until well coated. They may clump together just pull apart and shake a little more. Arrange evenly in Bundt pan. Sprinkle nuts and/or raisins on top (optional). Pour melted butter over whole thing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Turn out of pan immediately.

title: Cherry Icebox Pie
instructions: Line 8 x 8 dish with whole graham crackers. Drain juice from cherries and set juice aside. Spread drained cherries over whole graham crackers in dish. Sprinkle sugar over cherries and set aside.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: In small bowl mix sugar cocoa and salt thoroughly. In large bowl beat together eggs margarine milk and vanilla. Gradually beat in sugar mixture. Pour filling into unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until filling is set but still somewhat soft in center approximately 45 to 50 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Twenty-Minute Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar; mix well. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add together. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk to egg mixture; stir well. Pour into greased 8 x 12-inch pan. Pour melted butter over batter; sprinkle with additional sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Round Steak Roll-Ups
instructions: Take round steak pieces and lay them out. Brush top side with melted butter. Salt and pepper each one. Layer onion and garlic on each side. Roll up each piece and stick with a toothpick to hold the roll. Dip in flour and brown on all sides. Take 2 cans of mushroom soup and either put in a baking pan with 1 can of water or in a crock-pot. Place meat in receptacle. When baking cover with foil and place in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook eggs and shred; set aside. Start with well-chilled cooked rice. Break up the rice into loose rice. Oil wok and heat. Put rice into wok and cook constantly turning it. Add salt Accent soy sauce sesame oil meat and vegetables. Cook until done. Serves 4.

title: Freezer Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten eggs and beat well. Add dry ingredients beating well. Add oatmeal vanilla and nuts. Shape in rolls and wrap in waxed paper. Place in freezer and bake as needed. Slice 1/4 inch thick. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Chestnut Cream Dessert
instructions: Cut chestnuts in half; place in medium hot oven until shells and inner\tbrown skins peel off easily. Peel\tthe chestnuts and put in enough water\tto cover. Add sugar and salt; boil until chestnuts are very tender. Remove from heat; drain and mash or puree in blender with remaining ingredients. Can be garnished with whipped cream fruit etc. Serves 6.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together and stir until smooth. Serve with all kinds of fruit (sliced bananas apples mandarin oranges and pineapple chunks).

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Flatten crescent rolls out on cookie sheet and bake 10 minutes (cool). Mix cream cheese mayo sour cream and dressing. Mix together and spread on top of cooled rolls. Top with choice of cut up veggies such as lettuce broccoli tomatoes mushrooms and olives. Sprinkle with grated cheese and cut into squares.

title: Jazzy Sausage Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients by hand. Form the balls the size of half dollars. Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 1 inch apart. Bake for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Forget 'Em Kisses
instructions: Add whites to sugar. Add nuts chips and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Place in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Turn off oven and leave overnight. Tops may be decorated to fit occasion.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Spread apples evenly in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Sprinkle apples with water and cinnamon. With pastry blender mix sugar flour and butter until crumbly. Spread mixture over apples. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat egg water butter oil sugar cinnamon and 1/2 the cake mix until smooth. Add remaining cake mix oats raisins and nuts. Blend and spread in two 9 x 9 x 2-inch square pans or a cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Rice And Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; chill and serve on lettuce.

title: Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: Beat eggs and add remaining ingredients; cook until it starts to thicken. Remove for heat and cool.

title: Gene Autry'S Texas Chili
instructions: Brown the first 4 ingredients until tender; add all remaining ingredients except cheese. Simmer for 1 hour on very low temperature. Add Jack cheese to thicken just before you serve. Top with chopped fresh onions if desired. Serves 6.

title: Scalloped Potatoes(Basic Recipe)
instructions: Cook sliced potatoes in 1/2-inch boiling salted water 10 minutes. Drain and arrange in alternate layers with onions in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Pour White Sauce over and bake uncovered in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 4.

title: Tomato And Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in small skillet. Add green pepper and onion. Saute until tender. In a mixing bowl toss together zucchini bread crumbs Parmesan cheese salt and pepper. Add sauteed vegetables and mix well. Place the mixture in buttered 1-quart casserole. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Arrange tomato wedges on top of casserole and bake 5 additional minutes. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over tomatoes and continue to bake until cheese is melted. Serves 6.

title: Blasted Mahi-Mahi With Tomatoes And Okra
instructions: Saut onion in oil in Dutch oven 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in tomatoes and remaining ingredients. Reduce heat and cook stirring often 10 minutes or until okra is tender.

title: Breakfast Before
instructions: Beat together eggs and milk; set aside. Fry sausage and drain grease. Place in casserole dish then add grated cheese and bread crumbs. Pour in egg mixture. Cover with Saran Wrap. Place in refrigerator overnight. Next day cook uncovered 45 minutes to 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Apple Pecan Pie
instructions: In a 9-inch pie pan spread butter on bottom and sides. Press pecan halves rounded sides down into butter. Put brown sugar evenly over pecans. Roll out enough pastry for lower crust. Place in pie plate over brown sugar and pecans. Pare and slice apples. Sprinkle apples with lemon juice. Combine flour sugar cinnamon nutmeg and dash of salt; toss with apples. Put apples in pie pan. Roll out top crust and put over pie. Pinch edges. Prick top of pie with fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool 5 minutes; invert and remove pie pan carefully. Serve warm or cool.

title: Ham And Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles until almost done and drain. Combine in saucepan the rest of the ingredients and heat until the bouillon cubes are dissolved. After draining the noodles pour the mixture over the noodles and cook until not soupy.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat until brown. Put all other ingredients together and cook for 40 minutes. Allow to stand for 1 hour and reheat.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: In medium saucepan heat butter and water to rolling boil. Add flour and stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball about one minute. Remove from heat add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly. Drop from spoon onto ungreased baking sheet 3-inches apart. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for large 40 to 50 minutes. Small ones 30 minutes. Cool; fill with whipped cream.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables. Put salt in mixture and let stand 2 hours. Drain rinse once and drain again. Squeeze out vegetables. Mix rest of ingredients except cornstarch into vegetables; boil 10 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch and water. Pack into hot jars and seal.

title: Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Mix fruit sugar and cinnamon and put in lightly greased casserole. Mix brown sugar flour pecans butter and Quaker oats and sprinkle over fruit mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: In saucepan heat cream of mushroom soup Ro-Tel and cream of chicken soup. Crumble the Doritos chips. Layer the ingredients as follows chips chicken and liquid. Repeat layers; top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes in a casserole dish.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Saute zucchini and onion in margarine until tender (10 minutes). Mix in seasonings.

title: Creamy Shrimp Bisque
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook mushrooms green onion and garlic until tender stirring occasionally. Add broth and shrimp; heat to boiling.

title: Calla Lilies
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar then sifted dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet no more than 6 at a time. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Roll into cone shape while hot (before rolling fill with Cool Whip and pineapple); fasten with toothpicks.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion; drain. Layer meat beans and cheese on top of tortilla chips which have been spread on the bottom of an oblong baking dish. Mix Ro-Tel with soup and pour on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until cheese is melted.

title: Chichi Dango(Microwave)
instructions: Mix mochiko and sugar. Add milk and water. Stir until well mixed. Add extract and food coloring. Mix well. Spray a 5 cup microwave Bundt or ring pan with Pam. Pour mixture into pan. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Remove and cool (be careful the mochi will be very hot and sticky). When completely cooled cut with plastic knife and roll in potato starch or kinako.

title: Old-Fashioned Pot Roast
instructions: Sprinkle the roast with 1 tablespoon flour. In a Dutch oven brown the roast on all sides in half of the butter. Add the water bouillon onion celery salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add carrots; cover and simmer 45 to 60 minutes longer or until meat is tender. Remove meat and carrots to a serving platter and keep warm. Strain cooking juices; set aside. In the same Dutch oven melt remaining butter. Stir in remaining flour; cook and stir until bubbly. Add 2 cups of the cooking juices and blend until smooth. Cook and stir until thickened; add additional cooking juices until gravy has desired consistency. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Creamy Hot Chocolate
instructions: In large saucepan combine sweetened condensed milk cocoa vanilla and salt. Mix well. Over medium heat slowly stir in water; heat through stirring occasionally. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients until thick. Add coconut. Spread on devils food cake mix.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels in a double boiler. Stir until all melted. Remove from heat and stir in cocktail peanuts and chow mein noodles. Drop by spoonful on wax paper and cool in refrigerator.

title: Sugared Pecans
instructions: Pour melted butter into 9 x 11 x 2-inch pan. Beat egg whites until foamy gradually add sugar. Pour sugar mixture over pecans; spread in pan over butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Powdered Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Roll in small balls and press down slightly with a fork that has been dipped in water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. While still quite warm roll in powdered sugar.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients with hands. Shape loosely into small balls and bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Hot And Sweet Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pickling spice and vinegar. Pack into gallon jar placing bag of pickling spice in center. Pour vinegar over all. Place a layer of plastic wrap over jar and seal with lid. Every day turn jar. Do this for 30 days. Then place in refrigerator and serve chilled.

title: Mock Kolaches
instructions: Dip both sides of the biscuits in melted margarine then roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture. Put in greased pan. Make indentations with finger; fill with pie filling. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. When cool drop powdered sugar frosting in center.

title: Chocolate Toffee Trifle
instructions: Prepare brownie mix and bake according to package directions in 9 x 13-inch pan. Prick top of warm brownies using fork. Drizzle with coffee-flavored liqueur. Let cool and crumble. Prepare pudding mix according to directions omitting chilling.

title: Cocoa Puffs Candy
instructions: Bring to a boil the sugar and Karo. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove and add chunky peanut butter and butter. Stir well. Add Cocoa Puffs. Stir. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Let cool and set.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut beef in thinnest possible slices. Pound flour salt and pepper into meat. Cut into strips about 3 x 1/2-inch. Dice onions and fry slowly until soft and just turning yellow. Then add meat and saute until well seared. Add tomato paste and enough beef stock to just cover. Add soy sauce to taste. Simmer until tender. Transfer to top of double boiler and add sour cream and mushrooms. Serve with rice.

title: Savory Meatballs In Gravy
instructions: Mix ground beef salt eggs margarine and onion together. Shape in 2-inch balls and roll in flour. Brown on all sides in the margarine. Add 1 1/2 cups bouillon and the bay leaf. Bring to boil cover and simmer 1/2 hour. Mix 1/4 cup flour with remaining bouillon until smooth. Stir into mixture and cook stirring gently until thickened. Good with mashed potatoes.

title: Wild Rice Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Let stand at least 2 hours (overnight is better). Serve at room temperature.

title: Turkey Soup With Egg Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour with salt. Stir into butter in medium-size mixing bowl. Add eggs beating until well blended. Bring broth to boil in large saucepan or kettle with salt pepper thyme and turmeric. Add onion corn limas and turkey. Return soup to boiling. Drop dumpling batter by teaspoonsfuls into boiling soup to make 12 dumplings. Lower heat to keep soup simmering; cover and cook 20 minutes or until dumplings are cooked through. Serve in warm soup plates or bowls. Sprinkle with finely chopped parsley if you wish. Serves 6.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Heat Presto cooker and brown pork. Add onions and cook slightly. Add potatoes water salt and pepper. Close cover securely and place pressure gauge in place. Cook for 5 minutes with pressure up. Let pressure drop on its own. Add milk corn and butter and reheat. Thicken chowder if you like.

title: Corn Chowder Soup
instructions: In a saucepan saute the onion in butter. Add corn milk and spices. Simmer for about 15 minutes. Add clams with juice and cook about 5 more minutes.

title: Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Mix and press in pie pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 until light brown. For pecan pie bake for few minutes before adding pie filling.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients until batter is smooth then fold in fruit cocktail. Pour into greased and floured cake pan. Sprinkle the top with the 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Add salt to flour and sift. Work in shortening with two knives until shortening is evenly mixed. Stir and moisten into dough with water; pat into ball and chill. Later cut off amount needed and roll out on a floured board with light quick strokes to 1/8-inch thickness working into circular form.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Melt oleo and mix with cracker crumbs. Beat Dream Whip with milk until stiff. Add sugar and cream cheese; mix well and pour 1/2 of crumbs in dish then 1/2 of the Dream Whip and cream cheese mixture. Spread pie filling over cream cheese mixture then other 1/2 of crumbs. Chill.

title: Dump Salad(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Dump all ingredients into a bowl and mix together. Great as a last minute pot luck dish.

title: Pina Colada Squares(Diet Snack)
instructions: Blend gelatine Sweet N Low and pineapple juice together in saucepan until boiling while stirring constantly. Then stir in the last 3 ingredients. Pour in flat pan and refrigerate until set. Cut into squares.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Oil a large platter or cookie sheets. Combine sugar Karo and water in heavy pan. Stir until dissolved. Bring to boil and wash sides of pan down; wash all sugar that sticks to sides of pan. Add peanuts when mixture reaches soft ball stage (235\u00b0). When mixture begins to boil again start stirring. Cook to hard crack stage (310\u00b0) and add soda salt butter and then vanilla and coconut. Remove from heat first and stir well. Spread as thin as possible on greased platter. Run knife under brittle as soon as possible to let air beneath candy and platter. As soon as candy is hard enough to handle stretch in all directions.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar with oil and eggs and beat until creamy. Sift salt and soda together with the flour. Add the cocoa food coloring and vinegar to sugar and eggs. Beat well. Slowly add flour mixture. Then add buttermilk and vanilla and beat well. Bake at 325 degrees using toothpick to separate edges from sides of pan. Does well in any kind of pan.

title: Carrot Bars
instructions: Beat together first 4 ingredients. Add flour soda cinnamon salt cloves and black walnuts (you may use other walnuts). Pour into large greased jelly roll pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven. Test after about 25 minutes. Freezes well. You may cut recipe in half and use 9 x 12-inch pan or make two pans from full recipe.

title: Delicious Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt butter in oven. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over butter. Pour Eagle Brand evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients. Press down firmly with spoon. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Beef Jerky
instructions: Mix ingredients. Cut 3 to 4 pounds beef 3/16 to 1/4 inch thick. Soak 24 hours. Dry in food dehydrator until hard or what you like.

title: Vegetable Beef Stew
instructions: Place ingredients in casserole in order given. Cover tightly with foil. Bake for 4 hours in a 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Shell Bake
instructions: Prepare shell macaroni according to directions. Drain and set aside. In medium saucepan combine soup milk and cheese. Cook and stir until cheese melts. Stir in remaining ingredients. Turn into a 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Beef Noodles
instructions: Put noodles in pot any size with water. Let noodles boil for a minute or until done. Put in rest of ingredients (does not matter which order put in).

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together and place in casserole dish. Spread crushed potato chips and grated cheese on top. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken
instructions: Grease a casserole. Put in a layer of dried beef. Over beef lay the chicken breasts number of portions determines number or pieces. On each breast lay 1/4 strip of bacon. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Shrimp Creole 1
instructions: Chop onion green pepper and celery and mince the garlic. Saute in cooking oil about 5 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce water salt pepper and spices. Simmer about 10 minutes. Add frozen shrimp. Simmer 5 to 8 minutes. (If shrimp is raw simmer until it turns pink.) Remove bay leaf before serving. Serve over hot rice. Serves 4 people.

title: Chicken With Spanish Rice
instructions: In nonstick skillet warm oil. Sprinkle chicken with paprika. Add chicken to skillet and cook until golden on both sides. Remove chicken and cover loosely with foil. Add rice and onion to skillet. Cook stirring frequently until rice is golden and translucent 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in broth tomatoes with liquid parsley and pepper crushing tomatoes with a spoon. Bring to a boil. Return chicken to skillet. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in green beans. Cover and cook about 15 more minutes.

title: Renee'S Cheesecake
instructions: Mix graham crackers sugar and melted butter well; line the bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Yummy Banana Pineapple Punch
instructions: Boil water and sugar then cool. Add fruit juices and bananas. Freeze in four 1/2-gallon milk cartons. Sit frozen carton in refrigerator the night before serving to get slushy. Add 1 quart of cold ginger ale to 1/2 gallon of punch. Stir until mixed. I have added extra ginger ale to stretch. Makes 50 (5 ounce) servings.

title: Hot Dutch Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in Jackets peel and slice. Brown bacon and onion to taste. Make a sauce of flour sugar vinegar and water. Mix altogether and fry.

title: Salsa Chicken
instructions: Sear and brown chicken in oil on both sides; drain. Cover with salsa. Put lid on and cook 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Crispy Potato Wedges
instructions: Combine oil and seasonings in a bowl. Add potatoes stir to coat and arrange in a single layer on an ungreased 15 x 10 inch pan. Bake uncovered at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp tender. Serves 6.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: In a small saucepan bring first 3 ingredients to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Pour 1/2 cup of syrup mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange potatoes in syrup. Top with remaining syrup. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven basting often 20 minutes or until glazed. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sugar-Free Carrot-Pineapple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat butter in a large bowl until creamy. Blend in eggs pineapple juice concentrate and vanilla. Combine flour baking powder baking soda spices and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture beating until well blended. Stir in carrots. Spread batter evenly into a greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Bake 30 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool completely on a wire rack. Prepare icing; spread over cooled cake. Sprinkle with pecans if desired.

title: Peach Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar beating well. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Combine milk shortening and extracts. Add to egg mixture alternately with flour. Spread batter into a greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Arrange 4 cups sliced peaches on top of batter. Sprinkle with mixture of 1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill about one hour.

title: Pizza Sandwiches
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Spread on rolls. Bake at 400\u00b0 on cookie sheet for about 15 minutes or until meat is cooked. Remove from oven. Place Mozzarella cheese on top. Put back in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together and place all ingredients in shallow baking dish. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove from oven. Allow to set 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dad'S Portuguese Sopas (Meat Soup)
instructions: Bring water to boil; add meat spices tied in a clean cloth (cheesecloth) wine onion sauce mint and salt. Cover and cook until meat is tender about 3 hours. Add sliced cabbage cook until tender. Place bread slices and a sprig of mint on top in a deep dish. Pour hot broth and cabbage over bread. Remove meat to a separate platter and serve. Makes 6 to 10 servings.

title: Shrimp Feta
instructions: Combine last 5 ingredients for sauce and simmer for 1 hour. Spread shrimp in single layer in shallow ovenproof dish. Cover with warm tomato sauce. Sprinkle with Feta cheese. Cook in 450\u00b0 oven until shrimp are done. It doesnt take long. Serve with French bread or over orzo type pasta.

title: Quick Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in casserole. Top with buttered bread crumbs if desired. Heat in oven at 375\u00b0 until mixture is bubbly and hot about 1/2 hour or so.

title: Wonderful Window Wash
instructions: Fill jug about 3/4 full with water; add the 3 ingredients. Finish filling jug with water; shake. Pour into spray bottle as needed. Store with household chemicals. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Tiger Cookies
instructions: Crush Frosted Flakes and measure. Should have 1 1/2 cups. Melt chocolate. Stir together flour soda and salt. Set aside.

title: First Prize Winning, 1776 Flag Cake
instructions: Place flour sugar baking soda and baking powder in the baking pan. Sift cocoa powder into pan and stir all together. Add water mayonnaise eggs and vanilla to the pan; mix well until all the flour is moistened and batter is smooth. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool. Place 1/2 cup of the frosting in a small bowl. Stir the food color into the frosting a few drops at a time until you like the shade. Spread it neatly in the upper left corner of the cake to make a 4 1/2-inch square. Arrange marshmallows in a circle on the blue frosting to make stars.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease and flour 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.

title: German Brown Potato Soup
instructions: Cut bacon into 2-inch pieces. Fry until crisp. Remove bacon. Set aside. Remove all but 4 tablespoons of drippings. Dice potatoes onion and celery. Cook potatoes onion and celery in Dutch oven having water about 2 inches above the vegetables. Cook until almost soft. Add cauliflower while vegetables are cooking brown. Add flour in drippings to soup. Add bacon. Cook over medium heat until thick. Garnish with hard-boiled eggs. Serve.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Stir in jello and stir until smooth. Stir in vanilla oranges pineapple soda and pecans. Chill until jello mounds using a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Fold in 3/4 of whipped topping. Refrigerate until set. Garnish with remaining topping.

title: Italian Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in large heavy kettle; drain. Add all other ingredients except the macaroni. Bring to boil. Lower heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add macaroni; bring to boil and simmer until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
instructions: Thaw strawberries and drain reserving juice. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Dissolve jello in boiling water and add juices (should make 2 cups of juice). Fold in all fruits and nuts. Turn half of the jello mixture into a mold or pan. Chill until set in refrigerator. Spread carton of sour cream over set jello. Then carefully pour remaining jello mixture over the top. Return to refrigerator and chill until set. Serves 12.

title: Lime Sherbet
instructions: In large bowl mix gelatine with sugar. Add boiling water and stir until gelatine is completely dissolved. Add lime juice food coloring and lime peel. Cool mixture completely. Stir in milk. Freeze 1 1/2 hours or until mixture is frozen about 1/2 inch around sides of bowl.

title: Naomi'S Progressive Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced zucchini in boiling water until soft drain. Put in large bowl. Saute carrots onions and green peppers in butter (oil) until tender. Add to bowl. To bowl add 1 1/2 cups stuffing cubes sour cream and soup; mix. Put in 2-quart casserole dish. Melt margarine. Add remaining cubes. Toss and put over top of casserole. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Let set overnight. Very good with ham or turkey over the holidays.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar in which flour is mixed; beat well. Add butter and coconut then milk; mix well. Add vanilla. Bake in uncooked pie shell at 375\u00b0 until filling shakes like jelly and pie is golden brown about 45 minutes. Makes 3 small pies.

title: Hawaiian Lemonade
instructions: Add ice and serve.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Cream together the butter and brown sugar; stir in vanilla cinnamon and nutmeg. Keep refrigerated. To serve put 1 tablespoon of butter mix in a mug. Add 1 ounce of dark rum and 6 ounces of water. Stir and serve.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown beef with onions in Dutch oven. Add taco seasoning salad dressing mix beans chilies hominy stewed tomatoes and water. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with taco chips and top with sour cream and sprinkle with shredded cheese.

title: Brown Chess Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients with mixer for 5 minutes. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Makes 1 large pie.

title: Fiddle Faddle
instructions: Boil sugar margarine and Karo 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add soda and vanilla. Pour over popped corn. Place in oven on cookie sheets and stir every 15 minutes for 1 hour baking at 200\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Rinse stem and dry mushrooms. Place on greased baking sheet. Combine ingredients. I use a food processor. Reserve 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Spoon mixture into mushroom caps. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix pretzels 3 tablespoons sugar and butter together. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Beat together cream cheese and powdered sugar. Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows. Spread over crust. Add Jell-O to boiling water; stir to dissolve. Add berries. Pour over Cool Whip layer. Refrigerate several hours or until firm.

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
instructions: With fork mix first 4 ingredients. In separate bowl beat remaining ingredients. Combine the 2 mixtures stir with fork until moistened. Then with hand mold into a ball. Chill 15 minutes before rolling out.

title: Easy Barbecue Kielbasa
instructions: Combine all in slow cooker on low heat or in deep pot on stovetop. Cook on low heat until thoroughly heated.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and pepper together 3 or 4 times. Cut in shortening then crumble with tips of fingers. Add just enough sweet milk to make a very very stiff dough. Roll out on a well floured dough board about 1/8-inch thick. Cut into strips or squares and drop into boiling stock in which chicken has been previously cooked. The stock should be boiling madly when dumplings are dropped in; add milk to chicken stock for a richer gravy. Lower heat and cook slowly about 20 minutes.

title: Kathy'S Cavatini
instructions: Cook noodles until done. Drain in colander. Set aside. Brown hamburger meat; drain in colander. Mix noodles and hamburger. Add pepperoni. Then mix pizza sauce and spaghetti sauce and put into glass baking dish. Add shredded cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Layer pan with crushed pineapple then spread 1 can cherry pie filling then 1 box cake mix (dry). Cut 2 sticks of margarine evenly on top. Sprinkle top with pecans and bake at 350\u00b0 until done 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Frozen Cucumber Or Zucchini
instructions: Mix and store in refrigerator 5 days and freeze.

title: Chicken Chili
instructions: Warm oil in large pot over high heat. Add garlic and onions; saute 5 minutes stirring often. Add chili powder cumin and cayenne; cook 1 minute stirring. Add tomatoes then broth. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer for 15 minutes or until slightly thickened stirring occasionally.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Boil chicken in water to cover for about 2 hours. Bone and dice. Let stock set.

title: Ambrosia Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl. Add everything else and stir with a spoon to mix well. Do no beat. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Place unopened can of milk in pan of water (cover can). Boil for 4 hours. Remove from water and when cool enough to handle open can and smooth caramel in crust. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Wendy'S Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Bake as directed in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Poke holes in warm cake and pour caramel topping on top. Cool. Top with Cool Whip and crumbled Heath bars.

title: Solid Jello
instructions: Mix until dissolved and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan until cool. Cut in 2-inch squares. Add fruit if desired.

title: Cheese-Baked Halibut
instructions: Arrange steaks in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with vinegar salt pepper and basil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Combine bread crumbs and cheese. Spread over steaks; sprinkle with melted butter. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes longer or until halibut flakes easily. Serve 6 on a heated platter garnished with parsley.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Cook onions peppers and garlic in oil. Cook spaghetti in salted water; drain. Put all ingredients except Parmesan cheese in a large bowl; mix well. Pour into a large greased baking dish. Cover with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Freezes well.

title: Granny'S Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Adjust oven racks so that one is in the middle. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10 x 10 x 4-inch heart-shaped or round angel food cake pan with movable bottom. Mix sugar and butter in a large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until crumbly. Add eggs gradually increasing mixer speed to high and beat until mixture is creamy and pale. Then add 2 cups of nuts. Reduce speed to low. Beat in chocolate and vanilla then cornstarch and baking soda. Scrape down sides of bowl. Add half the flour and sour cream.
