Before fully blended add remaining flour and sour cream. Still at low speed beat in milk just until blended.

title: Peanutty Giant Cookies
instructions: Beat together the margarine peanut butter and sugars. Blend in eggs. Add combined flour soda and salt; mix well. Stir in oats and 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Place 1/2 dough onto 1 or 2 foil lined and lightly greased 12 or 13-inch pizza pan(s). Spread dough within 1 inch of pan edge. Sprinkle each cookie with the remainder of chocolate chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 22 minutes. Cool.

title: Chile Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray shallow 2-quart casserole or 12-inch by 8-inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. Discard seeds from chiles. Slice cheese into same number of pieces as there are chiles. Place 1 slice of cheese in middle of each whole chile. Arrange stuffed chiles in casserole. In bowl whisk eggs flour and milk until blended. Pour egg mixture over stuffed chiles in casserole. Bake 35 minutes or until top is golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ranch Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix 1 package dry dressing mix with 1/2 cup of mayonnaise and 1/2 cup of milk. Add cream cheese and beat with electric mixer. Add Cheddar cheese and blend. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Before serving sprinkle with almonds or bacon bits. Good with Ritz crackers or Wheat Thins.

title: Pot Roast Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients in 1 1/2-quart bowl. Shape into loaf in center of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Peel and slice 1/4-inch thick 3 medium potatoes and 3 medium onions. Peel and quarter lengthwise 3 medium carrots. Mix 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes 1 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Place vegetables in layers around meat. Sprinkle each layer with part of salt mixture. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven (high moderate) for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more to brown meat. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Drain and soak shrimp as label directs. Beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in lemon juice. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill to blend flavors. Garnish as desired. Serve with crackers or fresh vegetables. Yields 3 cups.

title: Cheerio Treats
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows until melted. Remove from heat. In large bowl pour marshmallow mixture over cereal. Stir until well coated. Spray pan with Pam cooking spray; press evenly into a 15 x 18 x 2-inch pan. Cut into 2 x 2-inch squares. Set aside to cool.

title: 3 Bean Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine corn oil vinegar sugar and salt. Add beans and onion. Toss to coat well. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Makes 4 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Breast Casserole
instructions: Roll dried beef around chicken breast then roll 1 strip of bacon around. Place in a casserole dish. Mix sour cream and golden mushroom soup; pour over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Toss lightly with fork the first 3 ingredients. Add other ingredients; beat until smooth and blended well. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until brown. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Pumpkin Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese and pumpkin then fold in cool whip. Mix together sugar and spice; add to cheese mixture. Pour into prepared shell. Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash save the juice when you drain it. Fix the Stove Top dressing using juice from squash and more water if needed. Mix squash and stuffing mix together. Pour in greased 8 x 13-inch baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Break egg over apples in bowl. Add oil sugar cinnamon nutmeg and walnuts. Mix well. Add mixture of flours and baking soda stirring just until moistened. Spoon into greased 8 x 8-inch cake pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until tests done. Let stand in pan for 10 minutes before slicing. Yields 9 servings.

title: Filling La Smolnik
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put into a greased and floured spring form. Bake slowly at 325 to 350\u00b0F for 1 hour.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon drain and return 1/4 c. to skillet. Add celery and onions. Cook for one minute. Blend in flour. Stir in water and vinegar. Cook stirring constantly until mixture is thick and bubbly. Stir in sugar salt and pepper. Pour mixture over potatoes and bacon. Mix lightly. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: First cover cucumbers onions and salt with ice water for 3 hours. Mix sugar and spices. Bring to a boil. Pack jars with cucumbers and onions. Pour hot mixture over cucumbers and seal.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Melt margarine. Crush graham crackers with a rolling pin. Sift powdered sugar. Mix margarine graham crackers peanut butter and sugar together in large bowl. Spread mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and milk chocolate and pour on top of peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Put in casserole dish.

title: Mrs. Field'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together the first 5 ingredients. Mix together separately the flour oatmeal salt baking powder and soda. Combine all ingredients. Make into balls the size of golf balls and place 2 inches apart. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Lisa'S Night Before Christmas Morning Breakfast
instructions: You will need a deep 2 to 3 quart covered casserole dish. This recipe you layer in the casserole dish. Start with croutons some butter sausage cheese and repeat until you are close to the top (about 1 to 1 1/2 inches from top). In a separate bowl mix eggs milk garlic salt mustard and onion until well blended and pour over layered ingredients in casserole dish. Cover and chill overnight. Bake in the morning at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: In large bowl blend shortening brown sugar and white sugar. Beat in vanilla and eggs. Add rest of ingredients. Blend well. Stir in M&Ms candy saving 1/2 cup to put 3 on each cookie. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish melt butter in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients. Press down firmly.\tBake 25 to 30 minutes until browned lightly. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Mexican Pizza
instructions: Brown half of the pork and onion at a time in oil in a skillet. Drain off the fat. Transfer pork cubes and onion to the crock-pot.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
instructions: Beat egg whites stiff. Add sugar. Continue to beat until very stiff (10 minutes). Melt chocolate chips in double boiler and add to egg whites. Add vanilla chopped nuts and coconut. Drop by spoon onto wax paper on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove quickly from paper.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice and water; set and cool. Prepare pudding as directed on package. When cool mix together with Cool Whip. Put in fridge and let set.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Pull meat from bone. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle crushed Ritz crackers over chicken mixture. Sprinkle poppy seed over crackers. Place a few pats of butter on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pecan Chewies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour; stir well. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Pour batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cut into squares. Yields 30 squares.

title: Whole Wheat Rolls
instructions: Heat milk to 110\u00b0 to 115\u00b0; remove from heat. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm milk in small bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Combine remaining milk honey shortening salt and whole wheat flour. Beat at medium with electric mixer until smooth. Gradually stir in enough all-purpose flour to make it stiff.

title: Heath Bar Cookies
instructions: Line cookie sheet with foil; lay down the crackers. Melt butter and brown sugar. Boil for 3 minutes. Pour over crackers. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Take out of oven. Pour 1 package of milk chocolate chips on crackers. Let set until melted. Spread with knife. Chill; break into pieces. Enjoy!

title: Irish Coffee(Caife Gaelach)
instructions: Heat a stemmed glass. Add sugar. Pour in strong black coffee to about 1 1/2-inches of the rim. Stir well. Add Irish whiskey to within 1/2-inch of top. Pour in cream over the back of the spoon to put a \head\ on the contents.

title: Tropical Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake in **two 9-inch cake pans for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until tests done. Cool then frost with the following frosting; chill overnight before serving. **I use 9x13-inch pan; bake for 35-40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs. Pour into a square well-buttered baking dish. Sprinkle top with crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cottage Pudding(Cake Or Muffins)
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder. Cream shortening; add the sugar salt and well beaten egg. Add milk and flour alternately. Pour into a greased 8-inch square pan (or muffin cups). Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0) for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Clay For Children(Children Use It For Making Objects.)
instructions: Cook over low heat stirring. It looks like thick mashed potatoes. Put on waxed paper. Knead until it can be handled. Use for school projects.

title: Spring Breeze Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in topping and blend well. Spoon into crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Chicken Rice Hot Dish
instructions: Mix rice water celery and cream soups together in 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay pieces of raw chicken on top. Sprinkle 1 package of onion soup mix over the top. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours. Do not peek!

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together in casserole dish and top with Cheez Whiz. Bake in moderate oven until cheese melts and browns lightly.

title: Creamed Spinach
instructions: Wash spinach thoroughly. Remove stems. Tear leaves into large pieces. Cook in a small amount of boiling water 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Place on paper towels and squeeze until barely moist. Melt butter in a large skillet; saute onion and garlic until tender. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Add the spinach and cook over low heat until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with paprika. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Mix all by hand until well mixed. Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Test it.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix and serve. Keeps well in fridge for several days.

title: Peanut Crisp Bars
instructions: Melt sugar syrup and salt. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and Rice Krispies. Pat in container. Melt butter and brown sugar add milk vanilla and beat in confectioners sugar and spread over mixture; chill.

title: Fried Fish
instructions: Wash and cut fish in serving portions. Put bread crumbs salt and pepper in plastic bag. Shake fish in seasoning and crumbs. Take fish out of bag and put in frypan of hot oil. Cook until tender; place on paper towel to drain.

title: Brownies
instructions: In a large bowl mix well the sugar eggs and oil. In another bowl combine flour cocoa salt and baking powder. Mix dry and moist ingredients a little at a time until well blended. Add nuts and mix well. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Store in airtight container.

title: Tuna Log
instructions: Mix together; form into log. Roll in parsley flakes. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Bama'S Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Saute bacon pieces in large skillet. Remove bacon and saute strips of beef until evenly browned. Add garlic mushrooms bay leaves parsley salt thyme pepper and bacon. Make a roux by melting margarine in a saucepan and adding flour stirring constantly. When thick add the consomme (and wine). Cook until slightly thickened stirring. Add to beef mushroom mixture. Cover and simmer until beef is done about 1 1/2 hours. Makes 4 quarts or 16 servings. Serve with rice.

title: Little Pizza
instructions: Mix all items except dinner rolls and spread on rolls which have been opened up to form a rectangle. Roll up like a jelly roll. Place in refrigerator for about 15 minutes for easy handling.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain and rinse. Cook meat; drain. Chop into small fine pieces. Pour spaghetti sauce over spaghetti; mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle meat over top. Cover with cheese slices and bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mulligatawny Soup
instructions: Simmer all ingredients but the chicken and rice which are added when the vegetables are done.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Measure flour and sugar. Mix in a saucepan; bring to a boil oleo shortening water and cocoa. Pour over flour and sugar mixture. In another bowl beat eggs well; add buttermilk and vanilla. Mix into flour mixture. Bake in a greased baking pan at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Myrtle'S Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix and bring sugar corn syrup and water to 240\u00b0. Add peanuts and continue to cook at 300\u00b0. At this temperature add soda vanilla and margarine. Have about 3 cookie sheets buttered and at this time pour your brittle on the cookie sheet and then pull with knife or fork to the thinness you want. Let cool and store in cool place in Ziploc bags. This makes about 2 1/2 pounds of brittle.

title: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream butter and 2 cups sugar until fluffy. Add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt; add alternately with sour cream beating just enough after each addition to keep batter smooth. Spoon 1/3 of batter into a greased 10-inch tube pan. Combine cinnamon nuts and remaining sugar. Sprinkle 1/3 over batter in pan. Repeat layers two more times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pan to a wire rack to cool completely. Yield 16 to 20 servings.

title: Chili Johns Chili
instructions: Fry ground beef and suet until almost done. Add onion (diced) unsweetened baking chocolate red peppers salt garlic powder paprika white pepper red pepper chili pepper cumin powder and water. Simmer 2 hours. Serve over kidney beans or spaghetti prepared separately.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Mix all other ingredients in bowl and pour the mixture into buttered baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes.\tBrown lightly on top.

title: Spanish Links
instructions: Brown sausage\tin large skillet. Drain reserving 1 tablespoon\tdrippings in skillet. If onions and chilies are used wilt at this time.\tAdd rice-vermicelli mix. Continue cooking until vermicelli\tis slightly browned.\tAdd water contents of seasoning packet and tomatoes (chopped in blender or food processor). Bring to a boil.\tCover; reduce heat and simmer 15\tto 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.

title: Cannelloni
instructions: In a large skillet cook beef until brown. Drain and remove from skillet. Add sausage cook 12 to 15 minutes until well browned. Remove from skillet.

title: Fresh Raspberry Pie
instructions: Place mashed raspberries in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Add sugar and water. Bring to a boil. Thicken with cornstarch. Remove from heat. Blend in the raspberries unmashed. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients first add melted butter and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chow-Chow
instructions: Chop all vegetables. Soak overnight in 1/4 cup of salt. Be sure water covers the vegetables. In the morning drain all the salt water off of the vegetables. Place all spices in a cheesecloth bag. Boil for 10 minutes in the vinegar (use a large pot). Remove spice bag from vinegar. Add sugar and mix well. Add all vegetables. Stir in well. Bring to a boil then turn stove off.

title: Chicken Adobo (Braised)
instructions: Cut chicken at joints. Wash then pat dry with paper towel. Heat oil in a deep skillet and brown chicken slightly over medium heat. Add next five ingredients. Bring to a boil uncovered without stirring. Add onions salt and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes allowing sauce to thicken. Transfer chicken and sauce to an ovenproof casserole or baking pan and bake 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly brown in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Tuna, Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together except cornflakes and butter. Mix cornflakes and butter together and put on top of the other ingredients. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Died And Went To Heaven Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly oil 12-cup Bundt pan; dust with flour. Invert and shake out excess. In large mixing bowl whisk together flour granulated sugar cocoa baking powder and salt. Add buttermilk brown sugar eggs oil and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes. Whisk in hot coffee. The batter will be thin. Pour into prepared pan; bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes.

title: Cranberry Relish Mold
instructions: Drain pineapple. Reserve syrup add water to make 1/2 cup. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in 1 cup hot water. Add syrup and lemon juice. Chill until partially set. Add fruits celery and nuts. Chill in 5 cup ring overnight. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chicken Macneel(From The Leanard M. Restaurant)
instructions: Pound chicken until 1/2-inch thick. Mix together mayo and mustard. Coat chicken with mayo mustard mixture then coat with Special K. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Use foil-lined cookie sheet with approximately 1/2-inch sides.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix 1 stick butter milk 1/2 cup sugar and salt together. Heat until melted. Let cool. Mix yeast 1 teaspoon sugar and 2 tablespoons of hot water. Let stand. Add eggs to mixture then add 2 cups flour and mix well. Add yeast mixture and 1 1/2 cups flour (save remaining 1/2 cup flour). Let rise until mixture doubles in size. Take remaining 1/2 cup flour and spread on bread board. Roll and knead dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with biscuit cutter and dip into 1 stick of melted butter. Twist and place into 13 x 12 x 1/2-inch baking pan. Let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until browned.

title: Taro Cakes
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Save drippings. Chop bacon. Blend taro salt and bacon. Shape into cakes. Fry in bacon drippings until brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to directions for empty baked crust; cool. In a small bowl combine cream cheese and 1 tablespoon sugar. Beat until smooth; spread into bottom of baked crust. (I use half of strawberries.) In a 1-quart saucepan combine pureed berries remaining sugar and cornstarch. Cook over medium-low heat until mixture thickens and becomes clear; stir often (about 7 to 10 minutes). Remove from heat. Stir in remaining strawberries. Let cool for 10 minutes then pour into crust. Refrigerate at least 3 hours then serve with whipped topping. Yields 8 servings.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Put cooked rice milk sugar and nutmeg in medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat for about 1 hour stirring occasionally until thick. Remove from stove. Add vanilla. Let cool. After cool sprinkle with cinnamon and refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook tomatoes chopped onion and peppers for 1 hour. Run through blender. Add all the other ingredients and cook another hour.

title: The Perfect Man
instructions: No trouble at all. Sweet as can be. Never talks back. Hell even help decorate the tree.

title: Venison Jerky
instructions: Cut meat in strips 1/2 x 1/4 x 4 to 6-inches long. Mix all other ingredients and pour over meat. Marinate overnight in fridge. Drain meat and pat dry with paper towels. Let meat cure in oven using pilot heat or lowest setting. Turn oven off periodically. Process until done.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Fry meat salt and pepper to taste drain. Place generous amount of meat onion and cheese on each tortilla. Roll up and place end side down in baking dish. Set aside. In saucepan add flour chili powder tomato juice salt water and oil. cook until slightly thickened. Pour over each tortilla. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes until cheese melts and warms up.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Put milk and butter in saucepan. Heat until butter melts but do not boil. Add oysters and salt and pepper. Let get real hot but dont boil. Serve with saltines.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine vegetables. Stir in dressing. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Happy Apple Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine Wheat Chex crumbs and apples; mix well. Pour apple juice over crumb mixture. Combine biscuit mix nutmeg and cinnamon; mix well. Stir into crumb mixture; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto buttered baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 16 to 18 servings.

title: Lemon Refrigerator Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites in large bowl. Fold in sugar and beat until stiff. Fold into custard mixture. Place layers of cake broken in bite size. One layer of cake and one layer of custard until all custard and cake is used. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Unmold and frost with whipped cream.

title: Marinated Bottom Round Roast
instructions: Take a plastic bag and pour into it approximately 8 to 12 ounces of Worcestershire sauce. Add garlic powder onion salt lemon pepper paprika Italian seasoning and seasoned salt (if desired). Amounts are not important and depend upon personal preference. Place roast in bag and marinate a minimum of 24 hours in refrigerator. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes for medium to well done.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine oleo egg and sour cream. Add corn and Jiffy mix. Stir well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased dish.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes slice thin. Melt butter and add onion to saute. Add flour and blend. Gradually add milk. Cook until smooth and thickened. Add remaining ingredients (including cheese if making au gratin potatoes). Simmer 7 minutes. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Beef Taco Casserole
instructions: Saut onion in oleo. Add meat and beans. Add salt garlic tomato sauce vinegar and chili powder. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Lightly butter 10-inch baking dish. Cover bottom with chips; sprinkle with cheese and half of meat sauce. Repeat layers. Top with corn chips cheese and olives. Bake uncovered 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Perfect Waffles
instructions: Let stand for 5 minutes. Bake approximately 9 minutes in waffle iron. Spray waffle iron with Pam every other time.

title: Zucchini Cakes
instructions: Heat oil in 10-inch skillet. Mix zucchini cheese parsley egg salt and pepper; stir in baking mix. Drop by rounded tablespoon into hot oil. Fry until golden brown about 1 minute on each side; drain. Makes about 2 dozen cakes.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Sprinkle chicken over medium size dish. Heat broth and soup together. Pour over chicken. Melt margarine; add milk and flour. Mix and pour over top of chicken mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Choco-Mallow Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar and milk. After it starts to boil add marshmallows and boil for 6 minutes. Add butter nuts chips and vanilla after you take off the heat. Blend thoroughly and pour into shallow baking pan to set.

title: Good Hot Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Mix and let come to a boil. Cook until tomatoes begin to change color. Jar and seal. Delicious on peas or lima beans.

title: Latkes(Potato Pancakes)
instructions: Peel and grate potatoes onion and apple on coarse grater. Beat eggs lightly; add grated potatoes onion and apple and blend well. Add salt flour and baking powder and mix thoroughly. Pour 1-inch oil into skillet and heat. Drop mix by tablespoons into hot oil. Fry and brown both sides. Serve hot. Drain off any liquid before frying each cake. Serve with sour cream or applesauce. Makes 20.

title: Picnic Potatoes
instructions: Cut the potatoes in quarters leaving the peel on. Place the potatoes in a baking dish. Sprinkle with a small amount of olive oil and the onion soup mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tender. Serves 6.

title: Maide-Rites
instructions: Cook in double boiler the hamburger until 1/2 done then add pepper sugar and mustard. Add salt when done.

title: Marquise Au Chocolat(Avec Une Sauce De Creme A L'Anglaise)
instructions: Melt chocolate in a double boiler; add a few drops of water if necessary to smooth out chocolate. Let cool; meanwhile beat yolks sugar and butter until smooth and silky. Add this mixture to the cooled chocolate; it should be smooth and thick but not stiff. Gently fold in the beaten egg whites then pour into a small mold which has been lightly buttered. Set the mold in a bowl of ice cubes and refrigerate until set 4 to 5 hours. Dunk the bottom half of the mold in hot water and the Marquise will slip out very easily. Cut into wedges to serve.

title: No Roll Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix well; chill. Spread on 12-inch round pizza pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Mix ground beef onion pepper and rice. Stir over high heat until browned. (Pour off excess fat.) Add tomato sauce and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil quickly. Cover tightly and let simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Batter(For Onion Rings, Corn Dogs, Etc.)
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking powder. Beat in milk until smooth. Add melted butter and egg. If too thick add more milk. Coat desired item (onion rings corn dogs mushrooms etc.) and fry.

title: Blackened Catfish Filets
instructions: Combine paprika onion powder garlic powder red pepper white pepper black pepper thyme and oregano in shaker bottle; mix well. Spray cast-iron skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Heat until very hot. Sprinkle catfish filets with seasoning mixture. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. May cook over hot coals on grill. Yield 2 servings.

title: Chipmunk Pie
instructions: Mix altogether and put in a 9-inch greased pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Pie
instructions: Place undrained chilies in bottom of glass pie plate. Grate cheese and sprinkled on top of chilies. Beat eggs milk and salt. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve with triscuits or tortilla chips.

title: Apple Crisp (1935)
instructions: Fill 9x13 pan with sliced apples. Spread sugar and cinnamon over apples dot with butter and a dash of salt. Mix remaining ingredients together. Place on top of apples. Bake 375 degrees for 35-40 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together potatoes sugar salt eggs oleo milk and vanilla. Place in a well-greased baking dish. Mix well brown sugar flour nuts and oleo. For topping place over potato mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done. (My oven heats so fast I cant use 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.)

title: Molded Cranberry Nut Salad
instructions: Soften unflavored gelatin in 1/2 cup water. Set aside. In a 3-quart saucepan combine cranberries sugar and wine or cranberry juice; heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Add lemon gelatin and softened unflavored gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Stir in remaining water. Chill until mixture is partially set. Fold in celery and walnuts. Pour into greased 8-cup mold. Cover and chill until set.

title: Canned Salmon
instructions: Place salmon in pint jars. Leave 1/2 inch at top. Add the remaining ingredients. Cook in pressure canner for 90 minutes.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until slightly browned.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Prepare 9 x 13-inch casserole with margarine or cooking spray. Drain sausage well; refrigerate separately. Place bread in bottom of dish. Mix egg milk and mustard well and pour over bread. Sprinkle cheese over entire mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Salmon Spread
instructions: Drain and flake salmon. Mix all ingredients. Chill 2 hours; form into ball and roll into 1/2 cup nuts and parsley flakes. Serve with crackers.

title: Moist Bundt Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Pour into cake pan. Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Remove from oven. While hot add glaze. Allow to cool and remove from pan.

title: Sweet Sour Fillets
instructions: Arrange fillets in single layer. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook in microwave on High 5 to 7 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Let stand 5 minutes. In 1-quart casserole combine sugar and cornstarch. Stir in pineapple juice. Add green pepper vinegar soy sauce onions and garlic. Cook at High 3 to 4 minutes or until mixture thickens. Stir twice. Stir in pineapple chunks and almonds. Arrange fillets on serving dish. Spoon mixture over fillets.

title: Milky Wonder Cake
instructions: Combine candy bars and 1/2 cup butter in medium saucepan; melt over low heat. While candy is melting prepare batter. Cream 1/2 cup butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Add flour and baking soda alternately with buttermilk stirring until smooth. Add melted candy mixture mixing well. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased and floured Bundt or 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done. Remove from oven. Cool a few minutes; remove from pan.

title: Zucchini Squash Bread
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl and mix until well blended. Blend flour soda cinnamon nutmeg and baking powder into mixture on low speed until smooth. Add squash carrots and nuts. Stir until well blended. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Homemade Potato Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients except evaporated milk and chives in crock-pot or large pot on stove. Stir in evaporated milk and chives when soup is done.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Mix all ingredients together and add to butter mixture. Add fruit nuts and soaked raisins. Mix well and drop on a greased cookie sheet. Make them small teaspoon drops. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Top Of Stove Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix soup and water. Use 1/2 of mixture to make up hamburger patties. Make into 4 patties and brown on both sides. Pour balance of soup mixture over patties. Cover and let simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Add one cup flour one cup at a time mixing well after each addition. This crust may be refrigerated until used.

title: Popo Cookies
instructions: Cook until thick. Remove from heat and add 1 1/3 cups coconut and 1 cup nuts. Mix well and drop on wax paper.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice into thin slices. In a casserole dish put potatoes onion milk and butter. Season with salt and pepper. Mix everything together. In microwave cook 14 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. (Stir every 2 to 3 minutes while cooking.) After potatoes are tender add cheese and stir together. Cook 1 more minute in microwave (until cheese is melted).

title: Banana Nut Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease muffin cups. Stir together flour and sugar in mixing bowl. Beat egg in separate bowl; stir in milk butter and banana. Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients stirring just until blended. Batter will be slightly lumpy. Fold in pecans. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups filling each 2/3 full. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 12 muffins.

title: Pineapple Buttermilk Sherbet
instructions: Combine. Freeze these ingredients until they are a slushy consistency. Place in a chilled bowl. Add 1 slightly beaten egg white and 1 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. While still slushy this should be beaten from front to back of tray to reduce ice crystals. Repeat beating at 1/2 hour intervals. Will give this the consistency of a course churn frozen water ice. Remove from freezer to refrigerator about 20 minutes before serving. May use sugar substitute.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Blend in flour salt and sugar. Stir until smooth. Add milk and cook until thick. Stir in corn and beaten eggs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until the knife comes out clean.

title: Scalloped Potatoes Supreme
instructions: Cook and slice potatoes. Saute mushrooms and onion in butter. Combine cottage cheese and sour cream. In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish layer first potatoes with salt and pepper. Second mushroom mixture. Third cottage cheese mixture then Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered; uncovered bake 15 minutes. Add more cheese.

title: Microwave Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: In small mixing bowl beat egg and buttermilk. Mix in all other ingredients and stir well. Spoon batter into 6 paper-lined custard cups or microproof muffin pan filling about half full. Cook 6 muffins at a time on High (max power) 2 or 3 minutes or until no longer doughy. Repeat twice. Yields 18 muffins. Cooking time 6 to 9 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Boil rice until tender. Let rice stand then drain. Brown hamburger until done. Dice up bell pepper and onion. Add these and tomato sauce to hamburger. Add hamburger mixture to cooked rice; simmer for about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
instructions: Place the first 5 ingredients in mixing bowl. In smaller bowl make dressing with mayo sour cream curry powder lemon juice and salt; pour over chicken mixture and toss. Chill 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Twinkles
instructions: Mix and bake as regular sheet cake.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Add salt vanilla and vinegar. Fold in remaining ingredients and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 until well browned.

title: Smothered Cabbage
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat melt butter and saute onion until golden; about 8 minutes. Add shredded cabbage and toss to mix it with the onion and coat it lightly with butter. Cover the pot reduce heat to low and let steam 8 to 10 minutes; until just tender.

title: Done And Buttered Biscuits
instructions: Mix Bisquick and sour cream. Add melted butter and mix well. Fill greased miniature muffin tins 3/4 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Walking Taco Salad
instructions: Spread the beans on a large platter (about 10 x 13-inches). Mix together the cream cheese sour cream and taco mix; spread this on beans. Spread taco sauce over top. Cover with lettuce then tomatoes and cheese. Serve with round tortilla chips. Can also use chopped onion black olives hot peppers etc. on top.

title: Ann'S Potato Soupstilwell, Kansas
instructions: Melt butter in a large pan. Add onion potatoes and carrot. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Cook green beans in the microwave on high for 5 to 6 min. Toss walnuts on the beans. Mix all other ingredients together and pour over the beans and walnuts. Set in refrigerator to cool for 2 hours and serve. Serves 6.

title: Walnut Brownie Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and flour. Stir in eggs milk butter and vanilla. Blend well. Add nuts and stir. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into unbaked shell and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crystal Pickles
instructions: Mix pickles and sugar stirring until sugar is partially dissolved. Let stand a few days stirring a few times.

title: Steamed Broccoli
instructions: Wash and remove outer skin from broccoli and cut into small pieces. Mix sugar cornstarch oyster juice chicken broth and ginger (a jar works great!). Place broccoli pieces in pan with approximately 1/4 cup of water. Cover and steam approximately 3 to 4 minutes until broccoli is tender not too done! Drain any excess water; toss in ginger and stir-fry 30 seconds. Add sauce; stir again until broccoli is coated and remove to warm plate.

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Put all ingredients together in a bowl. Add lukewarm water to make a soft yeast-like dough. Let rise for 1 hour. Drop into hot fat and deep fry until brown. Serve with honey.

title: Crunchy Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Chop cauliflower and broccoli into small pieces. Add chopped eggs and chopped onion. Drain water chestnuts and add to mixture.

title: Colt'S Snack Mix
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Store in a large bowl.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine oil and sugar. Add eggs. Sift flour salt soda and cream of tartar. Stir into creamed mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Place small balls of dough on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with small glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Raisin Caramel Pie
instructions: Combine sugar water and salt; cook down until a rich brown color. Add 1 1/2 cups milk and cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Combine cornstarch spice remaining 1/2 cup milk and egg yolks; beat until well blended. Add raisins to hot milk mixture and cook and stir until thick and cornstarch is cooked (about 3 or 4 minutes). Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue made with the 2 egg whites and brown in a slow 300\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve with chips. This recipe will serve 4 people.

title: Strawberry Salad Delight
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in large bowl. Add strawberries; stir until melted. Stir in pineapple pecans and bananas. Chill until partially set. Pour 1/3 of the gelatin mixture into glass bowl. Chill for 30 minutes. Spread half the sour cream over congealed layer. Spoon half the remaining gelatin mixture over sour cream. Chill for 30 minutes. Spread remaining sour cream over congealed layer. Cover with remaining gelatin mixture. Chill until firm.

title: French Silk Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter; gradually mix in sugar.\tBlend in chocolate and vanilla. Add eggs 1 at\ta time beating 5 minutes after each addition. Pour into shells; chill at least 1 hour.

title: Chicken Wing Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Simmer remaining mixture 10 minutes then add sauteed onion and celery. Mix with cooked chicken and then bake an additional 10 minutes.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt chips over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat and quickly stir in noodles and nuts so they are evenly covered. Dip out by teaspoons onto wax paper. Chill and refrigerate.

title: Party Cocktail Sausages
instructions: In a large skillet (or Pan) combine sausages and barbecue sauce; stir over medium heat until heated through. Gradually stir in marmalade. Serve warm.

title: Lucy'S Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix peaches and sugar together; set aside. Melt margarine in pan. Mix batter; pour onto margarine. Put peaches on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Mix in order listed. Sprinkle top with cinnamon and sugar mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Danny'S Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except tomato sauce. Roll in small balls. Put tomato sauce in large pan. Bring to a boil. Add meatballs. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours in covered pan stirring occasionally so meatballs dont stick.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Cream the cheese and sugar. Add cheese-sugar mixture to Cool Whip. Melt butter; add cracker crumbs to butter. Pat layer of crumbs. Layer Cool Whip mixture all of the pie cherries and another layer Cool Whip mixture. Top with crumbs.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill and serve with fresh veggies crackers or chips.

title: Candy Bar Brownies
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Combine flour baking powder salt and cocoa then stir into sugar mixture. Fold in chopped Snickers. Spoon into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with chopped Hershey bars. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add chicken. Stir until golden brown. Add taco seasoning and 2 tablespoons or so of water. Add cilantro and simmer for 4 minutes. Cover and set aside. Divide and place chicken onto a half side of each tortilla. Add green onions cheese and a small amount of salsa if desired. Fold over tortilla. Carefully place one folded tortilla in clean dry skillet over medium heat. Cover and let cook 5 minutes. Carefully turn onto other side and heat 3 to 5 minutes until golden and ingredients are melted inside. Repeat with other quesadillas.

title: Low-Fat Bran Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix cereal milk and sugar in one bowl and let stand 5 minutes. In another bowl mix flour baking powder soda and cinnamon. Add egg and applesauce to first mixture and then add to flour mixture. Stir until just moistened. Batter will be lumpy. Spoon into muffin pan sprayed with a no stick preparation. Bake 18 to 20 minutes. Serve warm. Contains 130 calories per muffin 4 g protein 28 g carbohydrate 2 g fat 20 mg cholesterol 200 mg sodium 5 g dietary fiber.

title: Mom'S Gingerbread
instructions: Mix flour soda and spices; sift. Combine molasses and buttermilk. Cream the margarine. Add sugar and cream well. Add egg and beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with the milk-molasses mixture beating after each addition until smooth. Bake in a 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 until done about 1/2 hour.

title: Filled Angel Food Cake
instructions: Place milk sugar eggs and salt in top of double boiler. Place over boiling water; stir constantly until custard lightly coats spoon. Do not overcook. Soften gelatin in cold water and pour custard over it. Stir until dissolved. Add flavorings. Chill until partially thickened. Stir frequently. Fold in whipped cream. Split cake in 2 layers. Spoon filling between layers on sides and top of cake. Sprinkle with almonds. Chill. Serves 16.

title: Chocolate Candy Cane
instructions: Put the chocolate in 1 bowl (3 cups) then dip the candy canes in the chocolate. Freeze for 5 minutes then eat! Enjoy!

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Form into balls. Add more powdered sugar if too sticky. Refrigerate.

title: Church Supper Ham Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large mixer bowl lightly but thoroughly combine the meats and crumbs; use your hands if necessary. In a medium bowl beat the eggs and add the sour cream onion lemon juice and spices. Mix well. Pour over the meat mixture and blend.

title: Fun Salad
instructions: In blender blend cottage cheese milk and pineapple juice. In a large bowl combine cheese mixture and fruits. Mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Mexican Meatball Soup
instructions: Mash 1 clove garlic and combine with beef egg 1/2 teaspoon salt rice chili powder and 2 tablespoons parsley. Shape into small meatballs. Dice remaining garlic; cook in 2-quart pan in oil along with onion until tender. Add remaining salt water broth celery and lemon pepper. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Drop in meatballs. Simmer 20 minutes. Add tomatoes and parsley. Simmer another 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in stick of butter until just translucent. Put layer of cracker crumbs in bottom of buttered 9 x 11-inch baking dish. Top with 1/2 of the sauteed onions. Dab 1/2 of mushroom soup over onions then cover with remaining onions and the rest of the soup. Sprinkle light layer of cracker crumbs over onion/soup layers. Beat the milk and eggs together then pour over the top of the onions. Finish with shredded cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until casserole is set and starting to lightly brown.

title: Swedish Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel and core apples. Sift flour with 4 tsp. baking powder and 1/2 tsp. salt. Cut in shortening. Add milk. Stir with fork to make soft dough. Roll out on floured board. Cut dough into 6 squares about 4 inches. Roll thin. Put apple in center of each square. Pour sugar in the core of each apple. Fold dough up over apple. Pinch edges together. Place in baking pan. Bring water cinnamon sugar and butter to a boil. Pour over the dumplings. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes in oven at 400 then for 30 minutes at 300.

title: Dill Weed Dip
instructions: Mix all together and chill.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly and add sugar and flour. Add melted butter or margarine; mix well. Add buttermilk and flavoring; pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 until custard is set.

title: Eggless Pancakes
instructions: Mix oil salt baking powder and milk. Add flour. Stir together. Bake on griddle or skillet.

title: Louisiana Gumbo
instructions: In large gumbo pot make a Roux with oil and flour. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until Roux is dark caramel color. Remove from fire and add remaining ingredients except 1/2 cup file and rice. Boil for about 2 hours or until meat is tender and gumbo is thickened. In the last 15 minutes add reserved green onions. Remove from heat.\tAdd file. Serve on hot rice. Serves 5 to 6 people.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugar and shortening. Add wet ingredients. Add the dry ingredients; add the raisins and nuts (optional). Grease a 9 x 13 pan. Put the batter into the pan and bake for 30 to 45 minutes. Use the butter cream frosting recipe on the confectioners sugar box or Cool Whip for a quick frosting.

title: Rice And Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms in butter. Add soup and water then rice and seasonings; stir. Bake in greased casserole covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or 1 hour.

title: Mary Raper'S Blondies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add remaining ingredients in order given; mix well after each addition. Spread in a shallow greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Do not overbake. Take out while soft and chewy.

title: Cherry-Lemon Cobbler
instructions: In a bowl combine pie filling peel juice and nutmeg. Pour into greased 10 x 6 x 2 pan. Combine flour sugar and salt. Cut in butter with fork; stir egg mixture (egg beaten with vanilla) into flour mixture until moist and crumbly. Sprinkle over cherry mixture and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve with ice cream or topping. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pizza Sauce
instructions: Cook about 20 minutes until thick.

title: Glazed Pecans
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large saucepan. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add pecans and continue cooking 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Place pecans individually on wax paper. Cool completely. Yields 2 cups.

title: Cinnamon-Apricot Glazed Salmon
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until reduced to 3 cups (about 30 minutes). Strain mixture through sieve and discard solids.

title: Dixie Chili
instructions: Brown beef and onions. Add rest of ingredients. Cook over low flame for 3 hours. Skim off excess fat. Serve over spaghetti. Top with grated cheese and raw chopped onions. Serve with oyster crackers.

title: Vegetable Meat Loaf
instructions: Fry hamburger; drain and put in bottom of small casserole. Add beef soup. Put about 2 inches of mashed potatoes on top. Dot the top with buttered bread crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar vanilla cream and buttermilk. Stir and add flour baking soda salt baking powder and nutmeg. Chill dough before rolling out. Fry at 375\u00b0.

title: Charlene'S Burritos
instructions: Salt roast; put in pan with water. Simmer 3 to 4 hours until roast shreds easily. During last hour add your potato. When its done mash potato and shred your roast together. Add soup chillies and chopped onion. Place back on stove and heat just long enough to stir together. Lightly brush each tortilla with butter then place a scoop of beef mixture in each tortilla and top with a large spoon of sour cream and cheese. Fold tortilla. Place in a large pan. Spread rest of sour cream and cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Bring water to a boil and add tapioca jello pudding and jello. Stir and boil for\t1 minute. Cool 1 1/2 to 2 hours completely. Add thawed strawberries and Cool Whip. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Hot Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except Fritos. Put in large casserole dish or 9 x 13-inch pan. Crush Fritos and put on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Jelly
instructions: You will need 6 (8 ounce) jars.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Mix soup milk and butter together and heat over medium heat stirring occasionally. Add broccoli wine and tarragon. Bring to a boil and serve.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Layer carrots peppers and onions in Tupperware. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over carrots. Marinate 2 days in refrigerator.

title: Oatmeal Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Stir together the oats flour baking powder soda and salt; set aside. With mixer at medium speed beat peanut butter and margarine until smooth. Beat in sugars until blended. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Add oat mixture; beat well. Chill dough if necessary; shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Flatten with floured fork making crisscross pattern. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Okra-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all well. Put into 2 1/2 to 3-quart buttered casserole. If too dry add 1/3 cup water or tomato juice. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Funghetto Sauce For Beef
instructions: Saute vegetables with garlic in butter; remove garlic. Add tomato paste and wine. Simmer briefly but do not overcook vegetables. May be prepared early in day. When ready to serve add additional wine to taste and heat thoroughly. Serve with sliced tenderloin steak or other cooked beef.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain fat. Add salt oregano marjoram pepper bay leaf tomato paste water and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer at least 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine and beat well the eggs sugar and oil. Add pumpkin. Mix together flour nutmeg cinnamon salt and baking soda. Add alternately with water. Pour into 2 loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sift dry ingredients into an 8 x 8 inch pyrex baking dish or pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Mix well. Make 3 holes; pour oil vinegar and vanilla in separate holes. Pour water over all. Mix well with a fork but do not beat. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Leave in pan and frost while warm.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In a saucepan heat enchilada sauce. While it is heating spray or grease rectangular baking dish. Heat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Chews
instructions: Mix powdered sugar shortening and softened butter together. Stir in flour. Press in ungreased 18 x 26-inch bun pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 conventional oven and 325\u00b0 in convection oven until just golden brown about 12 minutes. Oven temperatures vary and you may need to adjust cooking time to your oven.

title: Honey Cake
instructions: Cream together the butter or oil and honey. Add eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Pour batter into 2 oiled 9-inch cake pans. Bake for 35 minutes in oven preheated to 350\u00b0.

title: Val'S Peanut Butter Finger Bars
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips. Press into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle immediately with chocolate chips. Let stand 5 minutes. Spread chocolate evenly.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix well and spread 3/4 inch thick on serving tray or plate. Refrigerate all day. Just before serving layer the following on top 1 small jar El Paso taco sauce (mild) grated sharp Cheddar cheese shredded lettuce chopped tomatoes and chopped avocado. Serve with Doritos.

title: Holiday Peas
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet; add celery and mushrooms. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until celery is crisp-tender stirring often. Add onions rosemary peas chicken broth salt and pepper. Cook until thoroughly heated. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Combine sugar water and butter. When mixture begins to boil rapidly add pecans. Boil stirring constantly until mixture forms large bubbles on top and looks sugary. Remove from fire. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto well buttered marble slab or platter.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs and add to ingredients. Mix well. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. If desired sprinkle with brown sugar before baking.

title: Ellie'S Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Chop onions.\tAlternate layers of potatoes and onions in greased 2 or 3-quart baking dish. Season each layer with salt and pepper. Mix mushroom soup cream of celery soup and milk and pour over potatoes. Place ham slices on top. One-half cup of grated sharp Cheddar cheese may be added as topping instead of slices of ham. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until potatoes are tender about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Oven Fried Fish
instructions: Cut fish in 2 or 3 portions according to size. Dip fish into beaten egg then into bread crumbs. Place coated fish in a well-greased shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Drizzle a mixture of melted butter or margarine and lemon juice over fish. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 until golden brown. Allow 5 to 6 minutes for each 1/2-inch of thickness. Makes 3 servings. Freeze leftover portions.

title: Frozen Caramel Cheesecake
instructions: Beat the cream cheese and Eagle Brand together. Add Cool Whip to mixture. Pour 1/4 of this mixture into 1 crust. Drizzle 1/4 of the caramel on top of each pie. Melt oleo in skillet. Add coconut and pecans. Stir until toasted. Sprinkle 1/4 of the mixture on top of the caramel in each pie. Repeat each step using the remainder of the ingredients. Place in freezer and serve frozen. This is very good to have on hand as an emergency dessert.

title: Creamy Tuna Topped Broccoli
instructions: Wash broccoli. Remove long leaves and tough pieces of stalks. Cut stalks lengthwise into quarters. Place broccoli in large saucepan with 1-inch boiling salt water. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp-tender. Drain broccoli well. Reserve cooking water. In a large saucepan melt butter over medium heat and saute celery and onion until soft. Stir in flour blending well. Combine reserved cooking water and milk. Gradually stir into saucepan. Cook until mixture is slightly thickened and comes to a boil. Add cheese and stir until melted. Stir in tuna. Serve hot over cooked broccoli. Makes 4 servings. Preparation time 20 minutes. Cooking time 15 minutes.

title: Chip Beef Dip
instructions: Chop beef into small pieces. Mix rest of ingredients with beef and mix well. Chill until serving. Serve with bread or crackers.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. Cool. Divide in half. Prepare instant pudding as directed on box.

title: Moo Goo Gai Pan
instructions: *If the button mushrooms are used additional broth will be needed to cover and simmer them.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mix together oil rice wine vinegar sugar salt and spice packet. Pour mixture over shredded cabbage. Break up noodles on cabbage; add toasted sesame seed and mix well. Chill before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Raised Oaties
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butter peanut butter and brown sugar; beat until light and fluffy. Add water egg and vanilla; mix well. Combine flour cinnamon and baking soda. Stir into butter mixture; mix well. Stir in oats and raisins. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheets. Bake in upper third of oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from cookie sheets to wire racks. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Cheese Potato Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese and mayonnaise in saucepan. Put potatoes in bowl and mix with cheese. Add 3/4 cup bacon bits on top. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Cook covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine 3/4 cup granulated sugar flour 3 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and salt. Blend in milk butter and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour batter into an 8 or 9-inch square pan or dish.

title: Tomato Tortellini Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan heat oil. Add carrot onion and garlic. Cook stirring frequently 4 to 5 minutes. Stir in basil oregano and bay leaf. Cook 1 minute longer. Stir in tomatoes broth and 2 cups water. Simmer 15 minutes.

title: 15 Minute Supper
instructions: Mash corned beef and potatoes. Add onion and seasonings. Cook 15 minutes. Serve with greens and salad.

title: 24 Hour Fruit Salad
instructions: Beat eggs; add juice and sugar. Cook in double boiler stirring until thick and smooth. Remove from fire. Add butter and cool. Add to fruit mixture and whipped cream. Put in refrigerator for 24 hours before serving.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine cheese chicken soup sour cream butter and onions. Spread mixture over potatoes. Top with corn flakes. Bake at 425 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Follow directions for the cake mix; bake. Mix jello with hot and cold water. When cake is done punch tiny holes in cake and pour in jello mixture. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours. Top with whipped topping.

title: All-Purpose Yeast Dough
instructions: Scald milk. Put margarine sugar and salt in work bowl. Pour scalded milk in bowl. Let cool to lukewarm. Add yeast; mix. Add egg; mix. Add flour a cup at a time and mix after each addition. Put dough into a bowl and cover; let rise. Shape into desired rolls. Let rise. Bake at 400\u00b0 until nicely browned. This dough can be used for sweet rolls cinnamon rolls coffee cakes raised doughnuts etc.

title: Easy Turkey Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix dressing flour bouillon and pepper in saucepan; gradually add milk. Cook stirring frequently over medium-low heat until thickened. Add turkey and vegetables. Cook until thoroughly heated. Spoon into 8-inch square baking pan. Unroll dough and place over turkey mixture to cover. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Squares
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates and let set 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except chocolate bits and nuts. Put chocolate bits and chopped nuts on top before baking. Pour into greased and floured large loaf pan 9 x 14-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Beef Corn Bread
instructions: Sprinkle 1 tablespoon corn meal in bottom of a 10-inch skillet (well-greased). Cook over medium heat until corn meal is slightly browned. Combine corn meal salt and soda. Mix well. Add milk corn eggs and oil. Mix well. Pour 1/2 batter into skillet; sprinkle with cheese onion peppers and ground beef. Top with remaining batter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Egg And Vegetable Pie
instructions: Mix well the milk cheese eggs oleo flour and sherry. Add the vegetables. Pour into a 9-inch greased pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Company Oven-Browned Mashed Potatoes
instructions: You will need 9-inch glass pie pan buttered well.

title: Liver Sausage Spread
instructions: Soften sausage and cream cheese. Blend together then add other ingredients. Refrigerate. Serve on crackers.

title: Chocolate Pizza
instructions: In a heavy saucepan or top of a double boiler melt 6 ounces white chocolate and all the chocolate chips. Stir in peanuts marshmallows and cereal. Pour into a greased 10-inch pizza pan or a 10-inch circle of cardboard covered with foil. Spread to even out top. Sprinkle with coconut. Top with cherries. Melt remaining white chocolate; drizzle over pizza. Chill. Yield 16 to 20 servings.

title: Cherry Cobbler(Microwave Recipe)
instructions: In 8-inch square dish spread pie filling. In small bowl mix together cake mix butter nuts and cinnamon until crumbly. Sprinkle evenly over cherries or in three rows so cherries are visible. Cover with wax paper. Microwave on Auto Cook 2 if you have the Automatic Cooking Cycle if not cook on 20% power for approximately 11 to 15 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Big Batch Fudge
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan put the sugar and evaporated milk. Bring slowly to a rolling boil. Let boil for no longer than 8 minutes stirring constantly to keep from scorching. Remove from heat and add the marshmallows chocolate chips and butter or margarine. Stir until melted and well blended. Add broken nutmeats and vanilla. Spread in large ungreased (at least 9 x 13-inches) pan. When cool cut into squares. Makes a huge batch about 4 to 5 pounds of fudge.

title: Easy Fruit Pudding
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour in parfait glasses or just a plastic bowl. Chill 3-4 hours. Parfait glasses look nice when lined with thin sliced fruit and topped with extra whipped topping.

title: Orange Dump Salad
instructions: With a slotted spoon dip cottage cheese from the carton into a large mixing bowl. Dump into dry gelatin. Mix well; add the drained fruits. Dump in whipped topping and fold well. Chill 1 hour or overnight. This keeps well for 3 to 4 days. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Beat well. Add bread and pineapple. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Mama'S Sweet Pickles
instructions: Place cucumbers in gallon jar. Cover with a brine of 1 c. coarse salt and 11 c. boiling water. Cover jar and let set for two weeks. Pour off brine rinse and then cover with cold water to which Alum has been added. Let set for 24 hours. Pour off water. Cover with cold cider vinegar to which pickling spices have been added. Let set for 24 hours. Drain off vinegar but leave pickling spice. Add 3 c. sugar let set for 24 hours add 3 more c. sugar let set for 24 hours and then add 3 more cups sugar. This makes a juice to cover the pickles. Just leave pickles in the gallon jar and set on a shelf. Take out as needed to serve. These have a long shelf life and are very crispy.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Soften butter. Add sugar and eggs. Beat well. Add flour flavorings nuts and fruit. Mix well. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 45 minutes. If desired you may add 1 teaspoon lemon flavoring and an additional 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place 6 tart cut-up apples in a well-greased baking dish. Mix dry ingredients together until crumbly and sprinkle over the apples. Melt the butter and pour on top sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible Brunch Pie
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Spread cooked broccoli in pie plate. Beat together sour cream cottage cheese Bisquick margarine and eggs. Pour in pie plate. Top with thin tomatoes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. When knife inserted in center comes out clean it is done. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together. Grate lemon and wash from grater with cup of cold water. Mix in sugar and cornstarch. Add beaten egg yolks and pinch of salt. Taste for sweetness and lemon flavor. Stir while cooking.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan or kettle brown meat and pour off fat. Add peas spices and onion soup mix. Stir in boiling water tomato sauce and soy sauce. Cover and simmer 25 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Boil water pineapple and sugar. Remove from heat add box of jell-o and stir thoroughly. Put in freezer stirring occasionally until it starts to jell. Blend mixture and cream cheese. Mix in cool whip and add pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Coconut Eggs
instructions: Moisten very sparingly with coconut milk. Shape into eggs; coat with chocolate. Place on cookie sheet lined with wax paper. Let stand to cool.

title: Butterscotch Fudge Bars
instructions: In large saucepan melt butter and chocolate over low heat. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients except confectioners sugar. Blend well. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool; sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Cut into squares. Makes 36 bars.

title: Cottage Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion until cooked. Use an herb gravy packet and mix in with onion and meat. Dice potatoes and boil for 20 to 25 minutes. Mash with butter and milk. Put meat onion and gravy in medium sized casserole dish. Add mashed potatoes on top of the meat. Place oven on broil and brown top of pie.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Add eggs to other ingredients one at a time. Bake in a large long greased cake pan at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 to 55 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Short Ribs And Noodles
instructions: Brown short ribs in fat. Add remaining ingredients except noodles. Cover tightly and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until ribs are done. Add noodles and cook 15 minutes longer or until noodles are tender. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Hamburger Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain liquid. Add remaining ingredients and heat until cheese is melted. Can be prepared in crock-pot. Serve hot with chips of your choice.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Combine sugar peanut butter milk and extract in a large mixer bowl. Blend thoroughly. Combine dry ingredients and gradually add to peanut butter mixture. Pour batter into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about one hour and 10 minutes or until bread tests done. Turn out of pan onto cooling rack. Cool 10 minutes. Makes one loaf.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: With a sharp knife cut beef across grain into thin strips 1/8-inch thick. Combine soy sauce garlic and ginger. Add beef; toss and set aside while preparing vegetables. Heat oil in large frying pan or wok. Add beef; toss over high heat until browned. Test meat. If not tender cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over low heat. Turn heat up; add vegetables to meat. Toss until vegetables are crisp (about 10 minutes). Mix cornstarch with water; add to pan. Stir and cook until thickened. Add tomatoes; heat through.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Add to green peppers and hot peppers 6 cups sugar and 1 1/2 cups white vinegar. Boil 9 minutes; remove from stove. Add 1 bottle of Certo and green food coloring. Stir. Put in hot clean jars and seal. To be eaten on cheese not toast.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken. Take off bones and place in casserole dish. Moisten stuffing well with broth and place over chicken leaving enough to top dish with. Boil chicken soup with broth and pour over chicken and stuffing. Top with rest of dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: In large mixer bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in Eagle Brand until smooth. Stir in ReaLemon and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill for 3 hours or until set. Top with desired amount of pie filling before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Descant Lemon Delights
instructions: Combine all ingredients except confectioners sugar. Mix well; shape into small balls. Roll in confectioners sugar. Place on baking sheet. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Dijon Potato Salad
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover; chill. Makes 4 1/2 cups.

title: Sour Beef And Dumplings
instructions: Boil beef in 5 cups water for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender having added the onion salt bay leaf allspice and cloves. Cool 2 cups of hot juice. Add gingersnaps; mix. Stir in brown sugar. Simmer 45 minutes or more.

title: Beefy Mexican Lasagna
instructions: In large skillet brown beef; drain. Add canned tomatoes and taco seasoning; simmer uncovered 5 minutes. Stir in 1/2 can French fried onions. In bowl combine cottage cheese 1 cup Cheddar cheese and eggs. Place 3 tortillas on the bottom of a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Overlap 6 tortillas around sides of baking dish. Spoon meat mixture evenly in dish. Top with 3 tortillas then with cheese mixture. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Place remaining onions in center of casserole; bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Before serving arrange tomatoes and lettuce around edge of casserole. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cooked Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice milk and salt in a double boiler for 1 hour then add sugar eggs and vanilla. Cook for about 10 minutes more. Chill. Top with cinnamon (optional).

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together.

title: Chicken Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with flour salt and pepper and Accent. Fry breasts in oil until light brown. Cook asparagus and drain. Place in bottom of large casserole. Place chicken over asparagus.

title: Pasta A Olio
instructions: Place pasta into a boiling pot of water. Lower heat and let simmer until pasta is al dente.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat together the eggs sugar salt butter and syrup. Sprinkle pecan halves in unbaked pie shell. Pour mixture over pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Makes 1 pie.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies(By Walt Swisher)
instructions: Cream butter beat in sugars add other ingredients and more flour (about 1/2 cup) to make mixture stiff enough for drop cookies. Arrange by spoonfuls on buttered cookie sheet. Press flat with\tspoon and mark with floured fork. Bake in moderate 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown about 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 60.

title: Sliced Zucchini Pickles
instructions: Bring vinegar sugar salt and spices to a boil; pour over zucchini (sliced and unpeeled) and onions. Let stand 1 hour. Cook 3 minutes. Pack in hot jars. Put lids on and process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes. Makes 6 or 7 pints.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken. Do not salt. Cut into pieces. Save broth. Melt margarine and stir into dressing. In a greased 13 x 9-inch dish put a layer of dressing crumbs a layer of chicken then a layer of mushroom soup (diluted with 1 can broth). Again layer the crumbs chicken can of chicken soup (diluted). Top with crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown (45 minutes to 1 hour). Use no salt at all.

title: Cream Cheese Tuna Balls And Hot Mustard Sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine 1 cup potato flakes onion salt and garlic. Add tuna cream cheese and eggs; mix well. In a small bowl combine corn flakes and 1/4 cup potato flakes. Shape tuna mixture into 42 (3/4-inch) balls. Roll in corn flake mixture. Place tuna balls on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly golden brown.

title: Oven Swiss Steak
instructions: Trim steak cut into serving size pieces. Place in a 9 x 13 pan sprinkle with pepper and top with onions mushrooms and tomato sauce. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 2 hours or until meat is tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Vegetable Sandwich Spread
instructions: Mix pickles olives onion celery and green pepper in food processor; drain on paper towels and squeeze. Blend cream cheese with rest of ingredients. Add the processed vegetables; mix well.

title: Hot Wine And Cranberry Juice
instructions: Cook 2 cups cranberry juice. Add all ingredients except wine. Bring to a boil. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Remove spices let cool. Add remaining cranberry juice and wine. Heat and serve. Delicious!!

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in water vinegar and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Dice potatoes and eggs; add vegetables and bacon crumbles. Mix Miracle Whip and salt. Chill. Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Vanilla Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Add vanilla pudding orange juice and chopped up fruit. Roll into ball. Roll cheese ball in nuts.

title: Pigs In A Blanket Apple Pie
instructions: Slice in narrow wedges 2 big Granny Smith apples. Take biscuits; pull apart and use 2 layers of a biscuit to wrap each slice of apple. Melt a stick of oleo. Add cup of water cup of sugar and 1 teaspoon of vanilla flavoring to the butter or oleo. Pour mixture over Pigs in a Blanket (or apples). Sprinkle cinnamon sugar all over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Coleslaw
instructions: In large bowl toss together green cabbage onion and parsley. Place red cabbage in a small bowl.

title: Yoghurt
instructions: Fill bathtub with warm/hot water. Add something nice like bubblebath or baby oil etc. Turn on sound system. Uncork a bottle of wine or your favorite beverage fill a glass. Take a sip. Unplug the phone. Grab something to read (dont forget a towel to dry your hands). Steer clear of anything work-related. Bring the bottle into bathroom. Close the door (lock if needed). Repeat often.

title: Jellied Confetti Slaw
instructions: Cook cabbage for 2 minutes in a large pot of boiling water. Drain under cold water. While cabbage cooks put the 2 cups of water in saucepan. Sprinkle gelatin over top and let stand for 1 minute. Place over low heat and stir 3 minutes or until liquid is almost simmering gelatin granules are completely dissolved and mixture is clear. Remove from heat and stir in sugar until dissolved. Stir in lemon juice.

title: Chocolate Chip Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar; beat in eggs. Stir in flour cinnamon salt applesauce baking soda and cocoa. Pour mixture into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips. Sprinkle on top with 2 tablespoons sugar nuts and remaining chocolate chips. Serve with whipped topping or ice cream if desired.

title: Strawberry Tapioca Salad
instructions: Boil water add tapioca and simmer with lid for 25 minutes. Remove from heat. Add sugar and dry jello. Cool. Add frozen strawberries and Cool Whip. Pour in bowl and refrigerate.

title: Stir-Fry Minced Chicken With Vegetables
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into cube size then add soy sauce cornstarch and cooking wine and soak for a while. Meanwhile cut green peppers celery water chestnuts carrots bamboo shoots and onions into cube size. Stir-fry chicken in 3 tablespoons oil for 3 minutes; remove to a bowl. Heat the other 3 tablespoons oil to fry onions bamboo shoots water chestnuts celery carrots and green peppers. Then add chicken to the pan. Mix well.

title: Italian Carbonara
instructions: Brown bacon and drain. Saute ham and garlic in a little butter. Add all ingredients except eggs. Mix well. Turn off the heat and pour eggs over and quickly toss to coat spaghetti mixture. Add olives.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables salt and pepper. Mix oil sugar and vinegar together and pour over vegetables. Allow to set a few hours.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased pans at 400\u00b0 until brown about 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple Topping (To Be Used On Cakes)
instructions: Cook until it looks clear. This topping is great between layers of white or yellow cake. Then top with Cool Whip or make a cream cheese icing for the top.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and milk well. Cook the chicken with celery and onion (salt and pepper). Take off the bone. Save the liquid celery and onion. Put chicken into a large Pyrex dish. Pour mushroom soup chicken soup and milk mixture over chicken. Mix Pepperidge Farm stuffing (using liquid celery and onion). Mix the dressing according to directions. Put dressing on top of mushroom mixture. Bake about 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Homemade dressing can be used.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Saute together green pepper onion and oil for 5 minutes. Mix Italian seasoning and garlic powder then add to pepper onion and oil mixture. Add cottage cheese and egg whites to chopped spinach and mix with shredded Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese.

title: Speedy Pizza
instructions: Put salt and pepper and flour it real good. Then put oil in pan and fry until its done.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs oil and sugar. Mix well. Add grated zucchini and vanilla; mix. Add flour and dry ingredients. Then add nuts or raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Low-Fat Berry Pie
instructions: To pre-bake crust Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place foil or waxed paper over crust weight it down with dried beans or grains. Bake for 15 minutes remove foil and beans and bake 10 more minutes until lightly browned. Remove from oven and cool completely. Place about 2 cups berries in food processor. Add 1/3 cup sugar and puree. Taste to adjust sugar; set aside. Place remaining berries in the cooled crust and gently spread into place. Put cornstarch into small saucepan and whisk in pureed berries. Bring to boil then lower heat and simmer whisking frequently until thickened (5 minutes). Remove from heat and pour over berries in the crust. Cool to room temperature or chill before serving.

title: Pizza Sticks
instructions: Separate and unroll breadsticks. Place 3 pepperoni slices in single layer over 1/2 of each breadstick. Fold remaining half of breadstick over top; seal end and twist. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Combine cheese Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Sprinkle evenly over each breadstick. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with pizza sauce. Makes 8 pizza sticks.

title: Eggplant With Mac Nuts
instructions: Halve each eggplant and scoop out the pulp leaving a 1/4-inch thick shell. Dice the pulp finely. Heat oil in a skillet and cook onion and garlic in it until tender. Add eggplant pulp and cook slowly until lightly browned and almost tender. Season with salt and pepper. Add tomato and Worcestershire and simmer 3 minutes.
