Stir in eggs and nuts and use to stuff eggplant shells. Top with bread crumbs. Set in an oiled shallow roasting pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until shells are tender. Serves 6.

title: Dried Beef Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend soup and milk in large bowl. Stir in cheese onions macaroni and beef. Fold in eggs if using. Pour mixture into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover tightly. Bake 30 minutes or until heated through. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour first two ingredients together and let stand for 10 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Place in a greased 9x13 pan and bake 350 degrees for 25 minutes. This is a very moist and delicious cake it can be topped with a sprinkle of powdered sugar instead of frosting.

title: Parmesan Eggplant Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook and stir eggplant onion garlic and parsley in oil until onion is tender about 8 minutes. Stir in the rest of the ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally 15 minutes. Put on spaghetti and top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Meatless Chili
instructions: Heat oil in a 6-quart pot. Saute onion until brown. Add beans tomatoes celery ketchup dry mustard and pepper. Add chili to taste. Simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Can be frozen. Serves 8. Calories 265. Fat 3 gm. Chol. 0.

title: Jam Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cream together shortening sugar vanilla and flavoring. Add egg. Sift together flour baking powder cinnamon cloves and salt. Add to first mixture and blend well. Spread half in a buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan. Cover with layer of jam or jelly. Pat rest of dough on top. Bake 25 minutes. Cool. Cut in bars. Makes about 20.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Dump ingredients in dish in order (cherry pie filling undrained pineapple dry cake mix and nuts). Smooth after each layer; do not mix. Place the butter pieces on top. Bake for 1 hour. Serve with ice cream. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well by hand. Put into pan and refrigerate at least 1 hour before cutting.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Prepare jello according to directions on box.\tWhen it starts to congeal add pineapple bananas and marshmallows. Refrigerate while making topping.

title: Hot Pimiento Dip
instructions: Combine mayonnaise cheese olives pimientos and garlic in small baking dish. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Mabel Hill'S Peanut Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream all ingredients except peanuts and chips. Add peanuts and chips; mix well. Drop on cookie sheet and bake 9 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix gelatine sugar and salt thoroughly in a small saucepan. Add 1/2 cup of the water and place over low heat stirring constantly until gelatine is dissolved. Remove from heat and stir in remaining 1 cup of water and vinegar or lemon juice. Chill mixture to unbeaten egg white consistency. Fold in diced apples chopped celery and chopped nuts. Turn into a 4 cup mold or individual molds and chill until firm. Unmold by slipping mold in warm water to the depth of the gelatine. Loosen around edge with tip of a knife. Place serving dish on mold and turn upside down. Shake holding serving dish on mold turned upside down. Shake holding serving dish tightly to mold. Garnish with fruit.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar add hot applesauce. Mix and sift dry ingredients and spices. Add to the applesauce mixture. Add nuts and chopped dates or raisins. Pour into greased pan and bake at 375\u00b0 20-30 minutes.

title: Ume Pasta
instructions: Put salt and pasta in boiling water. Cook until well done. Drain pasta. While pasta is still hot add butter and Umeboshi. Mix until butter is completely melted. Decorate with parsley.

title: Marshmallow Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix apples marshmallows grapes celery walnuts and enough mayonnaise to moisten. Refrigerate.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: In pizza pan spread refried beans. Mix cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning until smooth. Pour over beans and spread. Dice tomatoes green peppers and olives. Sprinkle cheese on top. Serve with taco chips.

title: Syrup Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Ashville Salad
instructions: Heat soup and cheese until melted. Add gelatin and stir until smooth. Cool a bit then add mayonnaise and vegetables.

title: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Store in refrigerator covered. Makes 8 ounces. Use as you would Eagle Brand milk.

title: Lime Pickles
instructions: Prepare lime solution with the 5 quarts water and the hydrated lime. Wash cucumbers thoroughly and slice. Soak cucumbers in lime solution for 24 hours. Wash cucumbers in several waters to remove lime.

title: Cottage Cheese Delight
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl and chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Yellow Buns
instructions: Cook milk and corn meal until thick. Add butter sugar and salt. Dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand for 20 minutes; then add eggs and flour. Combine with corn meal mixture and add enough additional flour (3 to 3 1/2 cups) to make a soft bun dough. Knead on floured board. Set covered in a warm place. Let rise until full size. Punch down and let rise again. Then form into buns. Rise and bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix green beans & corn put in greased casserole dish. Mix soup sour cream cheese onions and salt spread over beans and corn. Mix melted butter with cracker crumbs & almonds. Spread over casserole. Bake for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0 uncovered. Can be mixed & refrigerated over night before baking.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Sprinkle dry Jell-O over all other ingredients and add Cool Whip. One-half cup of chopped pecans may be added.

title: Grilled Or Broiled Teriyaki Chops(Serves 4)
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients except chops. Marinate chops in mixture in refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours. Remove. Broil or grill chops for 12 to 15 minutes. Brush with marinade; turn once.

title: Old-Fashioned Applesauce Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease well and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sift flour sugar baking powder baking soda salt and spices into large bowl of electric mixer. Add shortening and applesauce; beat 1 minute at low speed just to combine. At medium speed beat 2 minutes constantly cleaning side of bowl with rubber scraper and guiding batter into beaters. Add eggs; beat 2 minutes. Combine raisins and walnuts; fold into batter with rubber scraper. Turn batter into prepared pan. Bake 45 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Let cake cool completely in pan on wire rack. Frost as desired. To serve cut into rectangles.

title: Bean-Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise Durkee mustard cooking oil Worcestershire sauce and boiled eggs. Put mixture in beans and peas and mix well. Heat in 375\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Add French onions. Return to oven until onions are warmed.

title: Mississippi Fudge Cake
instructions: Melt the butter and add the first four ingredients together. Mix well. Stir in 1 1/2 c. chopped nuts. Bake 30 minutes on 350\u00b0. After cake is done place marshmallows on top of hot cake and place back in oven to toast lightly.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Let this set up before adding second layer.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Cover hamburger with water and break into bits. Add celery and onion and any other veggie you wish. Potatoes tend to mush up. Add can of beef broth and water to cover contents. Add seasoning salt pepper and garlic salt if you prefer. Put in crock-pot. Put in refrigerator overnight. Skim any fat next day. Reheat and eat. Makes a thick soup.

title: Crustless South Of The Border Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Butter a 10 x 15 x 2-inch baking pan. In large bowl beat eggs until slightly thickened; add flour and baking powder and blend well. Add Jack cheese Cheddar cheese cottage cheese chiles and butter; stir until smooth. Pour into prepared pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake for 45 minutes or until quiche is set and lightly golden on top. Allow to cool slightly cut into 1 1/2-inch squares and serve hot or at room temperature.

title: No Roll Sugar Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream sugar powdered sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add oil vanilla and eggs; mix well. Stir in flour baking soda cream of tartar and salt until well blended. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight for easier handling.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix butter sugar and eggs in large bowl. Add dry ingredients (sift together). Combine using heavy spoon or hands. Add nuts fruit and flavoring. Bake 1 pound loaves at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours and tube pan at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours. Half hour before done take out of oven and brush with honey and corn syrup. Continue baking. Turn upside down to cool. Wrap in a wine cloth. Store in a plastic bag in a cool place.

title: Fruit Crisps
instructions: Cut butter into dry ingredients until crumbly. Press mixture over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Mincemeat
instructions: Chop oranges raisins apples and cherries and put in large kettle. Add remaining ingredients. Cook for 30 minutes. Then simmer and stir occasionally (covered). If canning cook in pressure cooker 15 minutes at 10 pounds pressure. If not canning cook additional 30 minutes.

title: Weenie Chowder
instructions: Cut weenies and veggies into small pieces. Saute in margarine. Stir in flour. Slowly add 1/2 cup milk stirring constantly to make a paste. Add rest of the milk and stir. Remove from heat; add cheese. Stir until melted.

title: Patchwork Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown meat; drain. Add peppers and onion; cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients except cheese; mix well. Spoon half of meat and potato mixture into a 13 1/2 x 8 1/4-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole dish. Cover with half of cheese. Top with remaining meat and potato mixture. Cover with aluminum foil or dish cover. Bake 45 minutes. Uncover dish. Top with remaining cheese. Let stand 5 minutes. Serve with salad. Makes 12 servings.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except butter together. Melt butter in 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Pour in mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until it starts to brown on top.

title: Deviled Eggs With Ham
instructions: Tip Eggs may be filled ahead covered and refrigerated up to 8 hours. At serving time arrange atop lettuce and sprinkle with reserved egg yolk and ham.

title: Make-Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook or boil pared potatoes until tender; drain. In a large bowl mash with a potato masher or beat with electric mixer on low speed. Add sour cream cream cheese 1 tablespoon margarine or butter salt pepper and thyme. Gradually beat in enough of the milk to make smooth and fluffy. Turn into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with foil and chill up to 24 hours.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Pour 1/2 of batter into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 15 minutes. Melt oleo caramels and milk; stir. Pour mixture over cake. Sprinkle remaining nuts and chocolate chips. Pour remaining batter over top. Bake another 20 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Spicy Potato Soup
instructions: In a Dutch oven or large kettle brown ground beef. Drain. Add potatoes onion and tomato sauce. Stir in water salt pepper and hot pepper sauce. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and the soup has thickened.\tYield\t6-8 servings or 2 quarts.

title: American Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and garlic. Add tomatoes and seasonings. Simmer for 20 minutes. Cook lasagna noodles according to directions on package. After draining cover with cold water until used.

title: Marinated Turkey Breast
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon in a 1-gallon zip-seal bag; marinate 24 hours in the refrigerator. Remove meat from marinade; lay in a greased baking pan and cover each piece with a strip of bacon. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes then turn oven to broil and watch closely until browned.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Saute sausage beef\tmushrooms onions and garlic in olive oil. Drain excess liquid.\tAdd oregano peppers tomato sauce and tomatoes. Let simmer for 30 minutes. Mix pasta and 8 ounces of cheese in a large casserole dish. Pour sauce over top of pasta fully covering it.\tPut remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sausage And Egg Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Just as good reheated as when freshly baked.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Cut bacon into 1/2-inch pieces. Cook in large kettle until crispy brown. Turn often. Remove bits of bacon and reserve.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Cook raisins for 10 minutes or until water has cooked down. Cool butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and raisins. Fold in egg whites. Pour into pie shell. Bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix first 6 ingredients by hand. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Turn down oven to 300\u00b0 and continue baking 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain off grease. Add garlic salt pepper parsley and oregano. Mix well. In a bowl crumble the bread. Add milk egg and 8 ounces Mozzarella cheese. Mix well. Add this to the ground beef mixture. Cook until cheese melts.

title: Caramel And Chocolate Slice
instructions: Base Combine flour brown sugar coconut and 9 tablespoons melted butter. Mix well and press into greased 28 cm x 18 cm x 1 cm pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Texas Trash
instructions: In an 11 x 15-inch cookie sheet combine Chex pretzels nuts crackers and Fritos. In a saucepan melt margarine then add Worcestershire sauce garlic powder onion salt chili powder and if desired Tabasco sauce and dry onion.

title: Quick And Easy Risotto
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan. Add mushrooms and onions. Cook and stir on medium heat 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in rice water and wine. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir in 1/2 cup of the cheese and half and half. Serve with remaining cheese. Makes 4 to 6 servings. Preparation time 10 minutes. Cooking time 25 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and pineapple together. Add marshmallows nuts and Cool Whip and blend. Chill before serving.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: Cut corn from cob and add milk salt and pepper. Put butter in heavy skillet. When hot add corn. Cook until tender stirring occasionally. Just before ready to serve add beaten eggs and blend in well. Serve hot.

title: Quick Potato, Meat Meal
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together as meat loaf but press it into 8-inch pie tins. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until done. Fill meat crust with mashed potato filling. Shave cheese and place on top. Place back into oven. Bake until cheese has melted in oven at 375\u00b0 to 475\u00b0. Serve hot.

title: Marie'S Date Cookies
instructions: Cook dates sugar and water until thick. Stir often and blend in lemon juice and margarine. Cool.

title: Sauteed Zucchini Strips
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch thick strips about 2 to 3-inches long. In nonstick skillet melt butter and saute zucchini onion and garlic stirring constantly. Add tomatoes salt pepper and oregano. Simmer until tender. Turn into greased casserole dish. Cover with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chili
instructions: In large pan empty pork and beans. Add enough water about 2 cans. Bring to a boil while preparing hamburger meat. In a skillet brown meat onion and garlic. When brown add tomato sauce and chili powder. Cook for a minute then add to beans. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Imitation Crabmeat Imperial
instructions: Saute green pepper celery and pimiento in melted butter in a large skillet until tender. Stir in parsley Old Bay seasoning mustard hot sauce and red pepper.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter brown sugar and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. In another bowl mix together flour oatmeal salt baking powder and soda. Mix everything together and add chocolate chips Hershey bar and nuts.

title: Good Quick Hot Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast sugar and warm water. Let stand for 3 minutes. Add salt. Mix rest of ingredients and add to yeast mixture. Let set at least 30 minutes in warm place. Punch down and make into rolls. Let set 10 to 15 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer first 6 ingredients in a large salad bowl. Mix mayonnaise sugar and cheese. Spread over other ingredients. Sprinkle with bacon bits.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl. Slowly whisk in oil. Store in refrigerator.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed adding coconut flavoring and 2/3 cup coconut. Bake as directed using 9 x 13-inch pan. Remove cake from oven. Punch holes throughout and pour over the following mixture. Mix water and milk to make 2 cups liquid. Dissolve powdered sugar into this and add 1 teaspoon coconut flavor. When cake is cool frost with Cool Whip. Sprinkle top with remaining coconut.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Whip sweet potatoes then add sugar and cream. Melt 3/4 stick margarine and marshmallows. Add marshmallow mixture to cream mixture then add eggs and vanilla. Pour in greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Top with 3/4 stick melted margarine 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup cereal or nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Bahamian Salad
instructions: Basic ingredient is cabbage or use whatever you have in your dehydrator such as onion pepper celery carrot radish tomato etc. Add salt and pepper. Secret is mayonnaise mixed with lime (fresh) juice. Use your own taste buds!

title: Scrumptious Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine in saucepan over low heat stirring constantly. Cool slightly.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cheese until creamy; gradually add sugar. Beat in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip. Blend well. Spoon into a graham cracker crust. Chill.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine/butter in 2-quart baking dish. Combine dry ingredients and stir into melted butter. Add milk and stir again. Bring fruit and sugar to boil. As soon as it boils remove from heat and pour over batter. Dont stir. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Pleated Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes crosswise into 1/4-inch slices taking care not to cut all the way through so that potato remains intact. Place cut side up in a shallow pan coated with cooking spray. Combine remaining ingredients stirring well. Brush potatoes with margarine mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender and slices have fanned out. Baste occasionally with pan drippings. Yield 6 servings (90 calories per serving).

title: Sloppy Joes For 60
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion (salted) then drain. Add water oats chili powder and catsup or catsup and Manwich. Cook slowly 1 hour.

title: Cutout Cookies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients with butter. Cut in with 2 knives or pastry blender. Add egg and vanilla; mix with hands. Dough will be very soft. Knead a little flour into dough as you roll it out. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes according to thickness of cookies and oven.

title: Marshmallow Popcorn Balls
instructions: Combine marshmallows and butter in a Dutch oven. Cook over low heat until marshmallows melt stirring mixture occasionally. Place popped corn tossing to coat. Coat hands with vegetable cooking spray. Shape mixture into balls on wax paper to cool. Wrap individually in colored cellophane or plastic wrap. Store in cool dry place. Yield 16 balls.

title: Rice And Green Chili Casserole
instructions: Mix and place in greased dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with Cheddar and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Dessert-A-La-Ritz
instructions: Crush Ritz crackers reserving 1/2 cup crumbs. Stir melted margarine into remaining crumbs and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill.

title: Light Caramel Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except yogurt in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil 8 minutes without stirring. Cool to room temperature. Add yogurt; blend well.

title: Small Pecan Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix well and form into balls. Press down with a fork. Bake for 7 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix and beat 4 minutes. Bake in 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes.

title: Microwaved Baked Potatoes
instructions: With medium potato stick 3 or 4 times with fork. Cook on High power for 3 minutes per potato. Take out when finished and place potato on 2 layers of paper towels and cover with glass dish for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together margarine peanut butter and powdered sugar. Roll into bite-size balls and refrigerate or place in freezer until ready to dip in chocolate.

title: Date Loaf
instructions: Boil sugar milk and dates until it forms soft ball in water. Remove from fire and let cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla and nuts and beat until firm enough to form 1 or 2-inch roll. Pour in wet cloth; tie each end. Hang up and let remain until cold. Then slice.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Clean carrots with vegetable brush; slice the fresh carrots (not too large). Steam fresh carrots or drain canned carrots. Slice green bell pepper and onion into rings. Combine with cooked carrots. Combine all other ingredients and pour over vegetables. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. This keeps very well.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10-inch pie plate. Cook and stir beef and onion until brown; drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spread beef in pie pan. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour over beef. Bake until brown about 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Poor Man'S Crab Cakes
instructions: Grate zucchini. Add all ingredients. Mix well. Drop in hot pan with very little Crisco by heaping tablespoons. Cook on medium heat. Turn cake one time. Makes about 8. Truly delicious!

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream together butter powdered sugar and vanilla. Sift flour and salt together; add to butter mixture with the nuts. Chill dough 3 hours.

title: Spicy Turkey Roast
instructions: Put turkey breast in pan skin side down. Combine garlic pepper salt and rosemary in blender. Add oil; chop all together. Spread 1/2 of mixture over turkey. Bake on rack in roasting pan (300\u00b0) for 1 hour. Put remaining mixture on turkey roast. Finish baking at 300\u00b0 until done. Use juices from turkey to baste during cooking time.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: In heavy pan (better iron skillet) brown until dark the 1 cup sugar stirring constantly. At the same time mix 1/2 cup sugar flour salt egg yolks and milk in saucepan. Place over medium heat stirring constantly until somewhat thickened. Pour into burnt sugar and cook over low heat until smooth. Add margarine and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. May add meringue. Stirring both requires some coordination.

title: 5-Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar butter and shortening until creamed. Add eggs one at a time. Add baking powder and flour. Add all flavorings and milk. Mix well. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Caramel Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and dry ingredients and knead well. Form in long rolls and chill. When real firm slice and bake in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Pineapple Topping Or Cake Filling
instructions: In a heavy pan combine all ingredients; bring to boil. Stir 2 minutes or until clear. Remove from heat. Cool. This is good on cheesecake or as a cake filling layer.

title: Easy Chicken Stroganoff
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat in 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook half the chicken until browned stirring often. Remove; set aside. Repeat with remaining chicken. Reduce heat to medium. In same skillet in remaining 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook mushrooms and onions until vegetables are tender and liquid is evaporated stirring often. Stir in soup and sour cream. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Heat through stirring occasionally. Serve over noodles. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 4 servings. Preparation time 15 minutes; cooking time 20 minutes.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening; add sugar gradually. Beat until smooth. Add egg yolks; beat well. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans; fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into 3 greased and paper-lined 8-inch pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes; let cool.

title: Chicken Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Remove chicken from bones and cut into bite size pieces. Spray a 7 x 10 x 2-inch pan with Pam and arrange drained green beans over bottom. Place half of the boned chicken over green beans. Top with whole crackers. Cover the crackers with cheese slices; arrange remaining chicken over the cheese. Combine soup broth onion flakes and 1/4 cup grated cheese. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle casserole with cracker crumbs and mushrooms. Drizzle with melted margarine. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. This can be doubled for a larger casserole.

title: Herbed Potatoes
instructions: Coat large baking dish with cooking spray. Layer half each of potatoes onion and tomatoes in dish; sprinkle with half of salt thyme and rosemary. Repeat layers and drizzle with the olive oil. Cover and bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or tender. Sprinkle with parsley. (If no fresh parsley sprinkle with 1 tablespoon dry crushed before baking.)

title: Hamburger Barbecue
instructions: In a large skillet cook together beef peppers and onions stirring with a fork to break up meat until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain off excess drippings. In a small bowl mix together remaining ingredients except buns. Add to beef mixture in pan. Mix well; cook over low heat for 50 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon on buns. Serve immediately.

title: Pizza Omelet
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter or margarine in 8-inch skillet. Beat eggs with milk and pour into hot skillet. Tilt pan to spread eggs over bottom. When eggs are almost dry spread sauce oregano and cheese over one-half of eggs. Add optional toppings if desired and carefully fold unfilled half over fillings. Cover and warm over low heat until cheese is melted.

title: Ham-Stuffed Rolls(Microwave)
instructions: Combine ham with eggs onion pepper mustard relish and mayonnaise. Cut off tops of rolls; scoop out. Fill with ham mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Place in 7 1/2 x 12-inch baking dish. Cook on Medium for 3 minutes. Turn dish. Cook 2 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 sandwiches.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring to a boil lower heat and boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat add peanut butter mix and blend until it starts to thicken. Pour into 8 inch greased pan. Let cool and cut.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Drain spinach thoroughly. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Form into balls. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Pork And Macaroni Casserole(Yields 100 Servings)
instructions: Place ground pork in a 21 x 13 x 2 1/2-inch pan. Cook meat in a 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Mix well to break into small pieces. Pour off drippings and save. Season with salt and paprika. Break tomatoes and add instant minced onion. Let stand 20 minutes. Cook macaroni in salted water and oil; do not overcook. Drain. In saucepot or kettle combine soup garlic salt pepper basil and savory. Mix well and heat. Add tomato and onion mixture. In 2 pans (21 x 13 x 2 1/2-inch) place half the pork and half the macaroni then half of the celery and tomato mixture. Cover and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until hot. Uncover and sprinkle with 8 ounces grated cheese. Heat until cheese is melted.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Blend soup and milk in a 6 cup casserole. Mix in tuna noodles beans and onions; top with buttered bread crumbs (toast butter and crumble). Bake in a hot 400\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Pistachio Pudding
instructions: Drain pineapple but save some juice. Mix all ingredients with your hands adding some of the pineapple juice. Put in bowl or casserole dish and refrigerate.

title: Salsa Dip
instructions: Brown sausage over medium heat. Drain the grease off the sausage. In a medium size casserole dish mix the salsa and the sausage together. Then cut 1/2-inch square cubes of cheese and add them to the salsa. Place dish in microwave and heat for about 3 minutes. Stir salsa thoroughly. Complete this cycle until cheese is thoroughly melted.

title: Lazy Pierogis
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together. You may need a little more flour. Roll dough 2 inches in diameter. Cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Cook in boiling water about 5 minutes (when pieces come to the top). Put into colander to drain. Butter a serving dish and place these pieces on it. Pour some sauteed onions over the layers.

title: Hot Mulled Punch
instructions: Put the juices in a 22-cup coffeemaker. Put the sugar and spices in the basket of the coffeemaker. Perk and serve. Great for the holidays. Serves 20.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Layer in 9 x 12-inch pan as follows ground beef (raw place in thin layer) Cheddar cheese soup corn and Tater Tots. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 55 minutes. Sprinkle grated cheese over top and return to oven until cheese melts. Serve immediately.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Keeps the mess in your oven not all over your kitchen. Coat chicken pieces with flour in a plastic bag. Make sure they are coated well. Heat butter and Crisco in a 13 x 9-inch pan in 425\u00b0 oven until melted. Place chicken in pan. Bake 30 minutes. Turn. Bake 30 more minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Sprinkle the cucumber with salt and let stand 25 minutes. Sprinkle the onion rings with the paprika. Place all the ingredients in a glass jar and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
instructions: Leave crescent rolls in their rectangular shapes. You should have 4 rectangles. Spread sausage onto the rolls. Roll up into rolls. Slice into thin slices and bake in hot oven until sausage is cooked and rolls are brown. These are delicious served warm.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Dump cake mix in bowl and reserve 1 cup to the bowl. Add melted margarine and beaten egg. Stir and spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. (Batter will be stiff). Set aside. Make Filling.

title: Red-Hot Cinnamon Cider
instructions: In medium saucepan combine apple cider and candies. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes or until candies dissolve. Serve hot or cold. May be frozen.

title: Graham Cracker Crunch
instructions: Cook butter and sugar over low fire. Cook over low fire until starts to brown around edges of butter and sugar. Take off fire and add your pecans and vanilla and drop onto graham crackers.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Lightly grease and flour pan (large tube pan). Set oven at 350\u00b0. Mix together first 8 items. Mix apples cinnamon and sugar. Put thin layer of batter then apples. Alternate and end with a layer of apples. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes. Cool. Remove from pan and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream(Sorbet)
instructions: Mash the fruit in a food processor. Add the sugar and lemon juice and mix until the sugar is dissolved. Mix with the whipped cream. Pour in a freezerproof container preferably a flat one so it will freeze faster. Set freezer at maximum freezing capacity and put the container in the freezer. After an hour remove the container from the freezer and stir its contents well. Use mixer or food processor if you like. Reduce freezer setting to normal operating temperature/freezing capacity. Put the container back in the freezer. Preferably repeat this procedure after another hour again. Count on a total freezing time of at least 3 hours. Serves 4 persons.

title: Never-Fail Divinity
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup 3/4 cup water and salt in a 2-quart glass casserole. Microwave on High for 19 minutes stirring every 5 minutes or to 260\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Heat egg whites until very stiff. Pour hot syrup gradually over egg whites beating at high speed for about 12 minutes or until thick and candy begins to lose gloss. Fold in vanilla and pecans. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Kensington Club Marinade
instructions: Meats can be marinated in this sauce up to 8 days. Can also be used as a basting sauce. Terrific for chicken pork beef and fish. With fish only marinate overnight or a few hours.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease and flour pan (9 x 13 x 2-inch). Spread the pecans in pan. Sprinkle the coconut in the pan. Mix cake mix as directed; pour over coconut. Melt margarine and cream cheese. Add powdered sugar; pour over cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pound Cake(Norsk Sandkake)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and flour. Mix well. Place in buttered and floured bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and rest of ingredients together. Mix well; chill and shape into ball before serving.

title: Date Nut Pudding
instructions: Mix everything together. Put in well-greased baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Blend and pat flat in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Family Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Make a well in center of dry ingredients. Add eggs oil and vanilla. Stir in pineapple carrots and nuts. Turn into tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or bake in 3 round pans for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and starting to separate from pan.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Blend butter and sugar well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add buttermilk alternately with sifted dry ingredients. Stir only enough to blend. Add flavoring. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in tube pan at 300\u00b0.

title: Bourbon Slush
instructions: Steep the tea bags in 1 cup boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove tea bags. Stir in sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Mix until sugar is dissolved. Pour into a freezer container and freeze until firm. Spoon slush into glasses. Add Fresca 50-50 Squirt ginger ale or 7-Up.

title: Health Bread
instructions: Combine raisins and 1 cup water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl. Add raisins and water. Mix well. Grease 9 x 5 loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and eggs. Add melted margarine Karo salt and vanilla. Mix well. Add pecans last. Bake pie shell in oven until lightly browned at 325\u00b0 for about 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from oven. Pour pecan mixture in pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Gazpacho Soup
instructions: Into blender combine cukes and tomato juice. Place in a non-metal container. Blend all other vegetables except only 1/2 of onion. Add juice of 2 lemons and pimientos salsa spices and sliced tomato. Refrigerate and serve after a couple of hours or days.

title: Marzetti
instructions: Brown beef with onion. Add the remaining ingredients being generous with the garlic powder. Simmer all until noodles are done. Stir to keep from sticking. Serves 4 generously.

title: Oatmeal Scotchies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda salt and cinnamon set aside. In large bowl combine butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in oats and morsels. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes for chewier cookies or 9 to 10 minutes for crisper cookies. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Always Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Mix first three ingredients until grainy. Mix remaining with rest of mixture. Roll crust. Makes 3 pie crusts. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet with onion and salt. Drain off excess fat. Put in a 2-quart casserole. Add sauerkraut brown sugar and tomato juice. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Brunswick Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients except fowl and spices. Cook until beans are almost done. Add the chicken or turkey and spices and simmer about 30 minutes.

title: Devil Food Cookies
instructions: Mix above ingredients together and roll in small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet. Remove from oven and let cool. Fill with Betty Crocker can white (vanilla) icing. Makes about 30 double cookies.

title: Grilled Turkey
instructions: Inject legs thighs breast and all other meaty parts of turkey with Cajun injector. Store turkey covered in refrigerator overnight. Place turkey in 4-inch deep foil pan (disposable). Cover with foil. Fill pan with water (at least 2-inches deep). Place on very hot grill (high on gas grill) for 2 hours. Turkey will be brown and very tender. Check occasionally during cooking to add more water if necessary.

title: Spaghetti - Italian Sauce
instructions: In large skillet cook sausage until brown in olive oil. Remove sausage and wilt onions in oil. Remove or drain oil from skillet. Add rest of ingredients and cook about 5 minutes. Add sausage and simmer stirring often for about 30 minutes.

title: Sausage-Onion Snacks
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Cook and stir sausage and onion over medium heat until sausage is brown; drain. Mix baking mix milk and 1 egg. Spread in pan. Sprinkle with caraway seed. Top with sausage mixture. Mix sour cream salt and remaining egg; pour evenly over sausage. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered until set 25 to 30 minutes. Cut in rectangles (approximately 2 x 1 1/2-inch). Makes 32 appetizers.

title: Chocolate Layer Dessert
instructions: To Assemble in Bowl or Punch Bowl Put 1/3 of the crumbled chocolate cake and top with 1/3 of the pudding then sprinkle with 1/3 of the candy. Top with 1/3 Cool Whip. Repeat until ingredients are used. Garnish with crushed candy or nuts. Refrigerate. Great dish to make ahead.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream sugar margarine\tand eggs. Beat in extracts fruit and pecans. Bake in greased tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool before removing from pan. Can be baked in 2 loaf pans.

title: Maryann Sawyer'S Wassail
instructions: Put all but spices in large kettle. Tie cloves and allspice in cheesecloth (add cinnamon sticks if you are not going to use individual cinnamon sticks in cups). Add nutmeg and spice packet to liquid. Simmer covered for 20 minutes. Remove bag; serve with individual cinnamon sticks if desired.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Let the cream cheese soften. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

title: Marshmallow Krispie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Prepare brownies following package directions for original recipe. Remove from oven. Sprinkle marshmallows over hot brownies. Return to oven; bake 3 minutes longer. Combine chocolate chips peanut butter and butter in medium saucepan. Cook on low heat stirring constantly until chips are melted. Add Rice Krispies and mix well. Spread over marshmallow layer. Refrigerate until chilled. Cut into bars. Makes 24.

title: Dutch Cake
instructions: Mix sugar flour and oleo like pie dough. Save 1/2 cup for use as topping. Add egg milk with soda and vanilla. Mix well all in 1 bowl. Pour in well greased and floured cake pan (8-inch square pan). Sprinkle with topping and cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Butterflies
instructions: Put 2 egg roll skins together. Cut into thirds. (Each third makes one butterfly or bow.) Seal both ends together with water. Cut a 1 1/2-inch slit in the center of each egg roll skin. Fold skin back and around through the slit to form loose \bow\ or \butterfly\ shape. Heat oil to 375\u00b0. Deep fry skins to a golden brown color. Drain on paper towel. Sift powdered sugar or drizzle Karo syrup or light corn syrup over skins.

title: Finger Cheesewiches
instructions: Have ingredients at room temperature and mix. Remove crust from bread. Spread cheese mixture on 3 slices and place them together then cut into 3 strips and cut these 3 strips in half (end up with 6 pieces). Frost sides and top with cheese mixture thinly. Place cubes on cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen put into plastic bag and keep frozen.

title: Easy Fruitcake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease 6 mini loaf pans and 4 (6-inch) loaf pans.

title: Scrumptious Ice Cream Torte
instructions: Crush Heath bars. Soften ice cream. Split ladyfingers in half and line the bottom and sides of a 10 or 12-inch spring-form pan. Spoon layer of chocolate ice cream over ladyfingers. Cover with half of crushed Heath bars. Add layer of vanilla ice cream. Cover with remaining Heath bars. Add top layer of peppermint ice cream. Freeze at least 8 hours. Unmold and top with sweetened whipped cream. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Mrs. Sullivan'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together flour sugars nutmeg salt and oil. Set aside 3/4 cup. Continue adding buttermilk soda and egg. Turn into a 9 x 13-inch pan. To reserved flour mixture add the nuts and cinnamon to make streusel topping. Sprinkle topping over cake and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: *I always bake my pie shell some before adding filling but do not brown them.

title: Aunt Bill'S Candy
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla and pecans in 4 1/2-quart glass bowl. Mix well. Microwave on Roast for 15 minutes. Mix well. Microwave on Roast for 13 to 15 minutes longer to soft ball stage or 236\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Stir in vanilla. Beat until soft peaks form. Stir in pecans. Spread in 7 x 12-inch baking dish. Cool. Cut in squares.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Sheet Cake
instructions: Cream oleo oil and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and sour milk. Beat well. Sift flour and rest of dry ingredients together. Stir in zucchini. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch oblong pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes on top shelf of oven. Check before 45 minutes.

title: Bacon And Cheese Cornbread
instructions: Heat cornmeal and 1 1/4 cups milk over medium heat until thick and dry stirring frequently about 3 minutes. Spoon cornmeal mixture into a bowl. Add remaining milk butter and eggs. Beat until smooth. Stir in salt baking powder and red chiles. Stir in cheese and bacon. Pour into cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Microwave Jelly
instructions: In 2 quart microwave bowl put sugar and juice. Stir well. Add lemon juice and stir. Put in microwave for 10 minutes. Add Sure-Jell and stir well. Put back in microwave and let boil 2 minutes. Makes 2 pints.

title: German Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cake is done when toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Tennessee Chip Salad
instructions: Stir Jell-O until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients. Pour 1/2 mixture into oblong Pyrex dish and chill until firm then spread 1 cup sour cream over it. Pour remaining Jell-O over and chill until firm.

title: Our Soup
instructions: Combine ingredients in large pot. Cook for about 2 hours.

title: Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand in refrigerator two hours. Serve.

title: French Cookies
instructions: Cream butter eggs sugar. Then flour and vanilla. Use 6 eggs first. After all is combined if batter is too thick add other 2 eggs. Spoon batter by tablespoon and bake in a waffle iron until lightly browned. All depends on size of waffle iron--you can make 1 big one or smaller ones at same time.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix. Serve cold with potato chips. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Marinate meat (chicken beef or ribs) 1 hour. Can be marinated overnight. Baste meat with sauce while broiling. Yields 1 1/4 cups.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Butter bread cut in quarters and place in bottom of 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Brown sausage. Drain and crumble the sausage. Sprinkle sausage over bread. Cover sausage with Cheddar cheese. Mix together the eggs milk and dry mustard. Pour over bread and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Spinach Lasagne
instructions: Mix cottage cheese 2 cups shredded Mozzarella and 1 egg. Drain and squeeze defrosted spinach; add salt oregano and pepper. In greased 9 x 12-inch dish spread small amount of sauce later 1/3 noodles 1/3 cheese mixture 1/3 cheese slices and 1/3 sauce. Repeat 2 times more. Sprinkle with remaining shredded Mozzarella. Pour water around edges. Seal tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Remove foil and serve.

title: Barb'S Cream Filling
instructions: Drain pineapple or mandarin oranges chopped leaving just a little juice. Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together for approximately 1 minute at medium speed. Add pineapple and blend about 3 minutes at high speed.

title: Pork-N-Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Cook for about 30 minutes on medium heat. Serve.

title: Cauliflower Bake
instructions: Cook cauliflower until tender. Combine all ingredients except Parmesan cheese and paprika. Gently mix cauliflower. Pour into greased baking dish and top with Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Canadian Cheese Soup
instructions: Put carrots celery onion water and bouillon cubes in saucepan and cook until tender. Cook milk flour and cheese over low heat until smooth; pour into vegetables and simmer until thoroughly blended.

title: Sam Houston White Cakedallas, Texas
instructions: Bake in lightly greased 9 X 12-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple 1 cup pecans and bananas.

title: Beef Roast With Mushroom And Onion Soup
instructions: Line a pan with a large piece of foil. Sprinkle onion soup mix in bottom of pan. Lay roast on top of dry soup mix. Sprinkle roast with salt and pepper. Pour mushroom soup over top of roast. Fold foil loosely over top of roast. Cook in oven at 325\u00b0 about 2 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Beat in eggs until smooth. Add milk baking powder salt and vanilla and beat in. Add flour a little at a time beating until smooth. Then add poppy seed mixing thoroughly. Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about one hour.

title: Cracker Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese and soup until blended. Stir in onions and dried beef. Refrigerate. Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Pour all ingredients except sherbet in large punch bowl. Add scoop of sherbet.

title: Chicken Pot Pies
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables according to package directions; drain. In a saucepan melt butter over medium heat; saute onion and mushrooms until tender. Stir in flour salt pepper and sage. Combine milk bouillon and water. Slowly pour into saucepan stirring constantly. Cook and stir until mixture boils. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Stir in chicken pimiento and parsley. Spoon into 6 individual casseroles. Roll and cut pastry into circles 1 inch smaller than top of casseroles. Place atop filling. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until the crust is lightly browned. Yields 6 servings.

title: Summer Tea
instructions: Make the tea. Add both concentrates and stir. Serve in clear pitcher with ice cubes.

title: Graham Bread
instructions: Thicken water with flour to a thin batter. Add sugar salt and yeast and stir in more flour until quite stiff. In the morning add a small teaspoon soda and flour enough to make the batter stiff as can be stirred with a spoon. Put into pans and let rise again then bake in even oven not too hot at first (keep warm while rising). Smooth over the loaves with a spoon or knife dipped in water.

title: Jerrie'S Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. If not moist enough to stick together add water a tablespoon at a time. Roll into small balls (about 1-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until done. Drain on paper towels. May be frozen warmed and served. Best when served hot.

title: Guava Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in bowl layer of onions layer of chicken etc. until used up. Heat the jelly and ketchup until jelly melts; add lemon juice. Pour over chicken. Let stand overnight. Bake skin down 1/2 hour turn and bake another 1/2 hour.

title: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Remove stem ends from tomatoes; cut thin slice from bottom of each tomato to prevent tipping. Remove pulp from each tomato leaving a 1/2-inch wall; chop enough pulp to make 1/3 cup. Mix tomato pulp green pepper cheese croutons and salt. Fill tomatoes. Place in ungreased oblong baking dish. Cook uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until tomatoes are heated through. Garnish with parsley sprigs or crumbled crisply fried bacon if desired.

title: Hot Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions; drain well. Combine remaining ingredients with spinach; mix well. Chill mixture for at least 2 hours or overnight. Form spinach mixture into 1-inch balls. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 4 to 6 dozen.

title: Rice Waffles
instructions: If using fresh cook them till tender. Canned ones drain most of the liquid away an place in kettle add butter and sugars. Cook on medium heat till all is melted and stir well.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add 1/2 pkg. taco seasoning mix. Set aside to cool. Combine next 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Gently mix in meat. Combine dressing mayonnaise ketchup and remaining taco seasoning in a bowl to make dressing. Pour over salad and toss. Makes 10-12 servings.

title: Drop Donuts
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Add to liquid mix the sugar nutmeg flour and baking powder. Combine these dry ingredients and mix before adding to liquid mixture. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon (approximately) into grease (approximately 375\u00b0). Fry until well browned for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Cool. If desired add sugar or cinnamon and sugar. I put them in plastic bags to do this.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients into bowl. Add egg and buttermilk; beat until smooth. Grease baking pan or heat pan first. Bake at 350\u00b0 for until brown.

title: Jello Dessert
instructions: Pour jello into hot water. Mix thoroughly then cool for 10 minutes. Add pineapple and strawberries. Mix well and pour into an 11 x 7-inch pan. Place in refrigerator. To make the topping mix the cream cheese marshmallows and whipping cream together. Cover and let stand overnight in the refrigerator. The next day whip the cream cheese mixture until well blended. Pour over jello. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Vegetable Rice Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl stir first 5 ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; toss to coat well. Cover and chill. Serve.

title: Natchez Plantation Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil and tea is ready to serve. Serve cool or hot. Place sliced oranges and lemons on top for color. Keep in refrigerator. Serves 20.

title: Devil Dogs
instructions: Put everything in bowl and blend well. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Elvis Presley Cake
instructions: Cook Duncan Hines butter cake mix according to directions. Let cool. Punch holes in cooled cake. Mix crushed pineapple and sugar and bring to a boil then simmer about 5 minutes. Pour over cooled cake when cooled. Mix oleo cream cheese chopped pecans and confectioners sugar. Spread this on cooled cake.

title: Shrimp And Fish Creole
instructions: Saute onions green pepper and garlic in margarine until tender. Add tomatoes parsley paprika sugar cayenne and bay leaf. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add fish to sauce then add shrimp. Cook about 5 minutes stirring occasionally until shrimp turns pink and fish flakes easily with fork. Blend together cornstarch and water. Add to creole and cook stirring until slightly thickened.

title: Broiled Quail
instructions: Split cleaned birds down back. Rub with olive oil butter and salt and pepper. Place 2 inches under preheated broiler for 8 minutes; basting again with olive oil. Serve on buttered toast with mushrooms. Allow 1 quail per person.

title: Avocado Salza
instructions: In a medium bowl combine all ingredients except avocado. Store in sealed container at room temperature for 6 to 8 hours. Before serving add diced avocados. Serve with chicken or your favorite grilled meat. Makes 3 cups.

title: Fresh Apple Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry. Mix sugar flour nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Stir in apples. Turn into pastry lined pie plate. Dot with margarine. Cover with top crust that has slits cut in it. Seal and flute. Cover edge with 3-inch strip of aluminum foil. Remove foil during last 15 minutes of baking. Bake until crust is brown and juice begins to bubble through slits in crust 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute vegetables in margarine until soft. Add flour and mix until smooth. Add chicken stock. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Add cheese and ham. Cook 10 minutes longer. Add milk salt and pepper. Heat to serving temperature. Makes approximately 2 quarts.

title: Chocolate Cherry Ice Cream
instructions: In a large saucepan stir together sugar and cocoa. Stir in egg yolks with 2 cups of cream. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until very hot. Do not boil. Cool to room temperature. Stir in remaining cream almond and vanilla extracts. Refrigerate 6 hours. Freeze according to ice cream freezer instructions. Immediately fold in cherries and almonds.

title: Halibut With Wine And Lemon
instructions: Arrange the fish fillets in a single layer and close together in a shallow pan. Beat together egg 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice 1/2 cup of the wine salt and pepper and pour over the fish. Cover and chill for about 1 hour. Lift fish from marinade draining. Heat 1 tablespoon of the butter in a wide frying pan; add fish fillets and brown on both sides. Place fish on a heated platter in a warm place. In a pan melt the remaining butter; add 1/8 cup of the marinade the remaining lemon juice and wine. Bring to a rapid boil. Pour some of the sauce over fish and pass the remainder to add to each serving. Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 2.

title: German Pancake
instructions: Melt margarine in ovenproof skillet about 10 minutes in diameter. Combine flour milk eggs and nutmeg in bowl. Pour into hot skillet. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and lemon juice and serve immediately.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Put cream cheese in a bowl; mix until softened. Add egg and onion; mix well. Heat water to boil. Add beef bouillon; let dissolve. When water is slightly cooled add to cream cheese mixture and blend together. Remember the water should not be too hot or it will cook the egg. You dont want that to happen. Thaw spinach; squeeze out excess water. Add spinach to cream cheese; mix well. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Put spinach in casserole. Bake covered for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove cover and bake additional 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lazy Man'S Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Saute meat onions pepper and garlic. Mix with rice and cabbage. Put in 11 x 13-inch pan. Mix 1 can tomato soup and 1 cup tomato juice or sauce and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 minutes covered. Serves 8.

title: Meat-Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger (you may add onion if preferred). While browning meat cook macaroni and drain. Add soup cheese and mushrooms to hamburger mixture. Pour into casserole dish and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add salt and pepper as desired. (This is a great dish to make 3 or 4 of and store in freezer for baking later. Great especially when you work and have little time to get dinner.)

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Boil together in saucepan the enchilada mix tomato sauce and water. Brown ground beef and drain fat. Stir in 3/4 cup of sauce to meat. Also add 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese to meat. In a 9 x 13-inch pan pour enough sauce to cover the bottom. Dip tortilla shells into sauce and fill with 3 tablespoons of meat mixture placing them seam down. Pour remaining sauce over prepared enchiladas and remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes and garnish with lettuce tomato and sour cream before serving.

title: Crab Meat Appetizer
instructions: Combine all ingredients; blend well. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Combine the flour salt and baking powder. Cut the shortening into the flour mixture with a pastry blender. Add the milk; stir thoroughly with a fork. Turn mixture out onto a floured board; roll or put to desired thickness. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Orange Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together well. Bake in any kind of pan at 300\u00b0 about 1/2 hour.

title: Blackberry Jam Cake
instructions: Mix and sift flour baking powder soda salt and spices. Cream shortening until soft and smooth. Add sugar eggs and jam. Add buttermilk and mix into batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy; add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Add crushed wafers alternately with milk. Add coconut and pecans and mix well. Pour into a large greased tube or bundt pan. Bake in preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 45 minutes. Cool completely before removing from pan. Wrap in heavy-duty foil and leave on cabinet for 3-4 days or put in freezer. (Do not cut right away because it will be dry and tasteless.)

title: Extract Pound Cake
instructions: Combine shortening butter oleo and sugar until fluffy. Alternately add milk eggs and flour beating well after each addition. Add extract. Bake for 2 hours in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Start in cold oven then turn to 325\u00b0. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Mix pie filling and pineapple together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread cake mix over top. Drizzle melted oleo or butter over top of dry cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden. When cool top with whipped cream.

title: Crescent Roll - Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together cream cheese egg yolk sugar and vanilla; set aside. On a slightly greased cookie sheet spread one can crescent rolls. Pinching together at all seams. Spread cream cheese mixture on top of rolls. Take second can of rolls and put on top of cream cheese layer. Pinch together all seams. Beat the egg white until foamy; brush the top of the rolls with it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Can be served warm or cold.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Mix together eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Then mix with dry ingredients. Fold in apples nuts and raisins. Bake in a tube or loaf pan for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Mix dates baking soda and butter into boiling water. Stir and let cool. Combine flour sugar salt vanilla and nuts. Mix all ingredients. Fill bread pans 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Sunday Entree
instructions: Pan-fry pork chops or steaks in water. Cook until tender. Before meat is half done toss in a few cauliflower and broccoli flowerets. Cover and finish cooking meat. Add only enough water to not scorch. Turn down heat. Add chopped bell pepper with flowerets if you like. Open up a can of chicken and dumplings. Spoon onto skillet mixture and heat without lid. Be sure water is almost cooked away before adding dumplings. Can be served from frying pan or pour into Pyrex dish spooning meat over into dish first. Finish in 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 to 25 minutes to set and brown around edge of dish. Serve with salad and sliced tomatoes.

title: Stir And Roll Pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Mix flour and salt. Pour Wesson oil and milk into a measuring cup (dont stir). Add all at once to flour. Stir until mixed. Press into balls. Smooth and flatten slightly. Roll between 2 sheets of waxed paper. Press into pie pans.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Put cream of mushroom soup in a casserole dish; add a little water for moistness. Alternate layers of hamburger sliced (thin) onion and potatoes and finally pour Cheddar cheese soup on top (add a little water). Put lid on dish and bake in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Bake
instructions: Boil zucchini in water until tender. Drain well. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth. Set aside. Mix pudding with milk until firm. Mix pudding and cheese mixtures together with a whisk. Fold in Cool Whip and vanilla. Starting with crushed cookies alternately layer cookies and Cool Whip mixture in pot ending with crumbs. Arrange worms on top of \dirt.\ Insert flower into center of pot. You can put worms in between each layer. Chill before serving.

title: Mommy'S Easy Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken until done then chop. Cook spaghetti according to package directions and drain. Add chicken tomatoes soup and cheez whiz. Stir until cheez whiz is completely melted and all ingredients are thoroughly mixed together.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Line large cookie sheet with waxed paper. In double boiler top over hot not boiling water melt butterscotch pieces with salad oil stirring occasionally. In large bowl mix chow mein noodles and marshmallows. Pour on butterscotch; mix well with fork. Onto cookie sheet drop mixture by heaping teaspoonfuls (if mixture thickens place over hot water a few minutes). Refrigerate until set. Makes about 30 pieces.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift flour and mix all dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Add oil carrots and eggs. Stir until well mixed. Pour in lightly greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting or your favorite kind.

title: Egg Nest
instructions: Grease a 12-cup muffin tin. Remove crusts from bread. Place 1 slice of bread in each muffin cup. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Drop a raw egg into each cup. Top each with 1/4 teaspoon butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until eggs are cooked and bread is toasted.

title: Raisin Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt. Add yolks and enough milk to form smooth mixture. Stir in rest of milk. Cook over low heat until thick. Remove from heat. Add vanilla butter and raisins (including juice). Pour into 2 baked pie shells. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Sift together flour salt baking soda and baking powder. Stir nuts into flour mixture. Set aside. Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and sour milk. Combine well and stir in apples. Stir in dry ingredients. Spread batter evenly in the prepared pan and bake 50 to 60 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Apricot-Lemon Warmer
instructions: In medium saucepan combine apricot nectar orange juice and lemon juice. Add cinnamon (if desired). Bring just to boiling and reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and discard the stick. Stir in Equal until dissolved. May be garnished with lemon slice and cinnamon stick. Makes 5 (6 ounce) servings. Diabetic Exchange 1 1/2 Fruit.

title: Cherry Cheese Torte
instructions: Press graham cracker crumbs melted butter and sugar in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Put over top of potatoes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix together. Right before serving pour mixture over cut/torn lettuce shredded Cheddar cheese and crushed nacho or plain tortilla chips in large bowl and toss adding more dressing if necessary.

title: Ooey Gooey Treats
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and press in a 9 x 12 pan.

title: Rice With Lamb Sauce(Riz Bi Yahkna)
instructions: In saucepan brown meat and onion in oil. Add tomato sauce and seasoning. Let cook over med. heat till meat is cooked through and sauce thickens a bit. Meanwhile in another saucepan melt butter and add rosemarino. Stir constantly till golden brown. Add rice and water to cover all. Cover and slowly boil till water is absorbed and rice is cooked. In a frying pan brown onion in oleo. When rice is cooked add onion mixture to rice. Serve sauce over rice.

title: Potato And Shrimp Soup
instructions: In heavy 4-quart pan saute onion in 1/4 cup butter until limp; add green onions potatoes salt and water. Bring to a boil and then simmer partially covered for 45 minutes or until potatoes are very tender. Mash. Add shrimp and cook 20 to 30 minutes until shrimp are done. Cool. Add 1/4 cup butter cream and chives. Adjust seasoning. Heat through but do not boil or cream will curdle.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Pour milk into a large mixing bowl. Add dry pudding mix and beat for 1 to 2 minutes until pudding starts to thicken. Fold in whipped topping.

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Fill paper cups in pans 1/2 to 2/3 full.

title: Delicious Dip
instructions: Mix yogurt and cottage cheese stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill for 2 hours to blend flavors. Serve as a dip for crackers chips or raw vegetable pieces or serve as dressing for green salad.

title: Modeling Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients in pan. Cook over medium heat until mixture pulls away from sides of pan and becomes doughy in consistency. Knead until cool. Ready for play.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Whisk together the first 5 ingredients and pour over crackers stirring to coat. Place on baking sheets and bake at 275\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese And Macaroni Chili
instructions: In saucepan heat oil and saute onions green pepper and celery. Add tomatoes chili powder and simmer uncovered about 30 minutes. Add kidney beans and uncooked macaroni. Simmer another 12 to 15 minutes stirring frequently or until macaroni is tender. Top with cheese and serve.

title: Hearty Beef Stew
instructions: Coat beef cubes with mixture of 1/4 cup of flour salt and pepper. In 5-quart Dutch oven brown meat in oil. Stir in 2 cups of water tomato sauce bouillon cubes celery and onion. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Add carrots and potatoes. Cover. Simmer an additional 30 to 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Nutty Shake
instructions: Blend vanilla ice cream chocolate syrup and peanut butter. Add milk. Beat until frothy.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: For sauce in a small saucepan stir together the tomato sauce onion brown sugar tomato paste vinegar Worcestershire sauce dry mustard garlic and if desired hot pepper sauce. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until desired consistency stirring occasionally. Remove half of the sauce (about 1/2 cup). Cover and store in the refrigerator for another use for up to 2 weeks.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: *Broccoli cauliflower carrots onions mushrooms peppers tomatoes etc.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa milk and margarine. Bring to boil and boil for 1 minute. Add peanut butter and oatmeal. Stir well and drop by teaspoons onto wax paper.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix Crisco brown sugar egg milk and vanilla. Blend well. Combine oats flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Mix to creamed mixture. Mix on low speed until just blended. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: In A Hurry?  Potato Dish
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Add mushroom soup in hot potatoes. Stir. Add dash of Greek seasoning or salt and pepper.

title: Ginger-Raz Freeze
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Cover and process until smooth. Serve immediately. Yields 2 cups (serving size 1 cup).

title: Shrimp And Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: In large kettle or Dutch oven cook sausage ham onion green peppers and garlic in oil until sausage is brown. Stir in remaining ingredients except shrimp parsley and Tabasco sauce. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in shrimp. Cook uncovered 5 to 8 minutes longer or until liquid is almost absorbed. Garnish with parsley and serve with hot sauce if desired.

title: Sugar Cookies 2
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together then mix in salt vanilla and baking powder. Gradually add flour so it is well blended. Drop dough on cookie sheet by spoonful. Grease bottom of small glass and dip in sugar before pressing down each cookie gently. Add chocolate chips or M&Ms if desired. Bake 8 to 10 minutes (until golden brown on the edges) at 375\u00b0.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Cornbread
instructions: Brown meat and drain well. Break into small pieces. Add other ingredients and mix well. Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan that has been well-greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tests done.

title: Chicken With Rice
instructions: Put rice on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan ungreased. Place chicken parts over rice. Mix soup and juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle soup mix on top; cover with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature until softened. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in condensed milk. Add lemon juice and vanilla. Stir until mixed well. Pour into crust. Chill until firm about 3 hours. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Easy Mexican Casserole(Can Be Made Ahead Of Time)
instructions: Prepare 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with Pam. Cook spinach according to package directions; drain well. Brown meat and onion in skillet. Drain off excess fat. Add tomatoes and cooked spinach. Combine soup sour cream and garlic salt; set aside.

title: Drain Opener Or Cleaner
instructions: Pour each in drain in order given. Rinse with lots of very hot water. Let faucet run for 15 minutes.

title: Franciscan Sandwiches
instructions: Combine the olive salad ingredients. Toss to blend. Let marinate about half an hour at room temperature if possible. Slice the rolls. Brush with olive oil. Layer with the cheese ham and salami. Top with the olive salad. Replace top of the roll. Serve or wrap for a bag lunch or picnic.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes until golden brown. Cut into 2 x 1-inch pieces. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Mix together the first four ingredients. Cook sugar egg and pineapple juice together and pour over cool jello. Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese and top.

title: Frozen Strawberry Mile High Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites sugar strawberries and lemon juice at high speed for 15 minutes in large bowl. Fold in whipped cream and pat mixture in baked pie shell and freeze until serving.

title: Macaroni And Cheese In A Crock-Pot
instructions: Toss together macaroni and oil. Grease crock-pot. Stir all ingredients together. Place in crock-pot. Either place on high for 3 hours or place on low for 7 hours.

title: Fruit Spread
instructions: Combine cream cheese and milk. Add rest of ingredients. Serve with crackers. Freezes well.

title: Can'T Believe It'S A Brownie
instructions: In saucepan melt caramels and 1/2 can milk; set aside and keep warm. Mix cake mix melted margarine and 1/2 can milk until moistened. Mixture will be thick. Spread half of this mixture in a well-greased floured pan (9 x 13-inch). Bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool briefly. Spread chocolate chips evenly over baked cake. Spread caramel mixture over chocolate chips. Put remaining cake mixture over top. Bake for 14 to 18 minutes until top is set. Brownie will pull away from sides. Do not overbake. Cool; cut into small squares.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Make jello according to package directions. Add dissolved gelatin and refrigerate until it congeals. Fold in mayonnaise and all other ingredients. Beat with Mixmaster to blend. Pour into 11 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Aunt Pee Wee'S Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken in salted water until tender and take meat off bones. Saute celery and onions in oil until tender. Add flour one spoon at a time to the onions and celery and blend. Add salt pepper and margarine. Add chicken broth stirring to blend then add soup. Add milk stirring constantly. Bring mixture to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Add chicken and pour in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Cover with Pinwheels. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue(Low-Fat)
instructions: Place roast in crock-pot. Turn heat on low. Cook 14 to 16 hours. Remove roast and cool. Break meat into pieces; remove all fat. Pour juices from crock-pot and discard. Place meat in layers back in pot.

title: Crescent Cheese Squares
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan with 1 package of crescent rolls. Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla until very smooth. Spread mixture evenly into pan. Top with second package of crescent rolls. Melt butter and pour over entire pan. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top and bake at 325\u00b0 until medium brown. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Delicious Holiday Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat pumpkin milk sugars eggs and spices together. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with cake mix. Pour melted margarine on top; sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of dessert comes out clean. Top with whipped topping.

title: Boeuf Bourguignon
instructions: In a skillet brown beef cubes in oil. Transfer to covered baking dish. Pour wine into skillet. Scrape up brown bits and pour over beef. Add seasonings tomato paste and broth to meat. Cover and bring to a boil. Transfer to baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours. Discard bay leaf. Remove beef. Make a roux of flour and 2 tablespoons butter. Saute mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter. Add to first mixture along with beef and onions. Mix well. Serve over rice. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cream Of Vegetable Soup
instructions: In large kettle saute onion in butter until tender. Add flour; cook and stir until bubbly. Gradually add chicken broth; cook and stir until thick about 5 minutes. Stir in milk cream and seasonings. Add vegetables; cook until good and hot.

title: Buttered Noodles
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In saucepan over low heat add remaining ingredients. Heat until butter is melted; stir in hot pasta. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart saucepan combine soup water and salsa. Over medium heat heat through stirring occasionally. Sprinkle each serving with tortilla chips cheese and onion; top with spoonful of sour cream.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: You will need an 8-inch diameter flowerpot a small hand shovel and artificial flowers. Plug holes of flowerpot. Grease inside of flowerpot with margarine.

title: Chewy Homemade Breadsticks(Appetizer)
instructions: In a large mixer bowl sprinkle yeast over the 1/4 cup water. Let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in salad oil sugar salt milk and 2 cups flour. Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes or until dough pulls from side of bowl in stretchy strands. Stir in more flour (about 1 cup) to form a stiff dough. Turn onto a lightly floured board. Knead for 10 minutes or until smooth. Turn dough over into a lightly greased bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Let rise in warm place for 1 hour or until doubled. Turn dough out onto board. Knead to expel trapped air. Cut into 12 equal pieces. Cover and let rest for 5 minutes.

title: Unusual Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in the hot water. Drain the thawed frozen strawberries and pineapple and add water to make 1 cup liquid and add to gelatin. Chill the gelatin until it begins to congeal then add the berries crushed pineapple cranberry sauce and the diced marshmallows. Return to refrigerator until congealed. Serve on lettuce with a little mayonnaise.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients. Add pineapple coconut and pecan pieces. Break but dont crush wafers and layer with mixture in large loaf cake pan. Top with Cool Whip. Decorate with cherries and crushed nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Fig Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter with brown sugar. Add eggs soda (dissolved in sour cream) the cinnamon and figs. Add flour. Roll out and cut into desired shapes. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl combine butter sugars and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs.
