Gradually add flour mixture; mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corn flakes. Turn into greased casserole. Top with buttered corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Serves 12.

title: Creamy Sweet Corn Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan heat vegetable oil or butter until melted. Add onion and cook stirring over medium-low heat until tender about 5 minutes. Add 2 cup corn kernels potatoes chicken broth and bay leaf. Cover and cook over low heat until tender about 15 minutes. Remove and discard bay leaf. Cool slightly; transfer to a food processor with metal blade and puree in batches if necessary. Press mixture through a sieve set over the saucepan. Pour milk through the sieve. Add remaining 1/2 cup corn to the saucepan. Heat over low heat stirring until warm; do not boil.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jello in 1 c. boiling water; onion. Let set partially then fold in rest of ingredients and chill. When set unmold and serve on a bed of lettuce trimmed with either radish roses or carrot curls.

title: Chicken Dumplings(Instant)
instructions: Bring broth and chicken to a rolling boil. Add thumb-sized pieces of biscuit dough slowly; allow ample time to cook. If prefer chicken soup then use only 6 biscuits.

title: No Oil Chiffon Cake
instructions: Separate eggs; beat yolks well. Beating is very important. Add water to egg yolks; beat until light. Add sugar; beat until creamy or until you can not feel the grain of the sugar. Add flour salt and baking powder. Beat well. Beat egg whites; add cream of tartar and beat until stiff. Add vanilla. Fold egg whites into cake batter; do not stir too much. Bake in ungreased tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Invert cake pan; let cool before removing from pan.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar water cornstarch and jello until thick. Cool and add strawberries. Pour in baked pie crust. When cold top with whipped cream.

title: Veal Scallopini Marsala
instructions: Pound veal cutlet with rough side of mallet. Place in wax paper and pound with flat side of mallet. Cut into 4 pieces (or get butcher to slice as many thin veal fillets as needed). Salt pepper and flour veal. Saute veal in skillet with olive oil 2 minutes on each side. Remove from pan. In same pan saute onion garlic bay leaf parsley mushrooms and oregano for 5 minutes. Add wine chicken stock and Kitchen Bouquet; bring to a boil. Add veal. Cover pan and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until veal is tender. Thicken sauce with cornstarch or Buerre Manie. When sauce thickens sprinkle with parsley and oregano. Serve.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Put rice in 8 x 8 square pan. Cover with onion and beef soup. Dot with margarine. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until rice is done.

title: Auntie'S Spaghetti
instructions: Brown meat and onions; pour off grease (or blot with paper towels). Add other ingredients and cook until warm. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Broccoli-Rice Quiche
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add broccoli and onion; cover. Reduce heat and simmer 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Drain well and set aside.

title: Mamaw Ruby'SKetchup
instructions: Boil down until thick.\tPut into jars and seal.

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Put sugar over rhubarb and let set overnight. Cook over low heat until soft. Remove from heat; add Jell-O and Kool-Aid. Mix well until Kool-Aid and Jell-O is dissolved.

title: Pennsylvania-Dutch Lettuce
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Combine remaining ingredients except the lettuce; add to bacon. Heat just to boiling stirring constantly. Tear lettuce into bowl. Pour hot dressing over lettuce and toss lightly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Season with salt pepper chopped onion and garlic salt; drain fat. Add soup and tomatoes; let simmer. Layer tortillas meat mixture and grated cheese in baking dish. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Deep-Dish Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl mix prepared fruit with 1 cup sugar set aside. Place butter in a 2-quart baking dish; place in oven until butter melts. Remove from oven set aside. Meanwhile in a medium bowl combine 1/2 cup sugar with flour and milk. Pour batter over melted butter in baking dish do not stir. Spoon prepared fruit over top of batter. Bake uncovered for 50-60 minutes. Batter will rise to the top brown and crisp. Yields Makes 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix water cornstarch and cocoa. Add other ingredients. Cook until thickens. Pour into baked pie shells.

title: Southern Praline Bars
instructions: Melt shortening in 2-quart saucepan. Add remaining ingredients except frosting and mix well. Spread in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool slightly in pan on rack. Spread with Praline Frosting. When cool cut into bars. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chili Ala Ono
instructions: Brown bacon; add vegetables and cook for 3 minutes. Add hamburger and cook. Add remaining ingredients except kidney beans. Cook for about 1 hour stirring occasionally. Just before serving add beans with sauce and cook another 5 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Orange Jam
instructions: Bring to a boil and stir constantly 12 to 15 minutes. Pour into hot jars and seal or cover with paraffin.

title: Cooked Pineapple Sandwich Spread
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt together then add egg lemon juice and juice drained from pineapple. Mix together and cook over low heat until real thick stirring all the time to keep from sticking. Let cool then add the crushed pineapple and mayonnaise to spread. Refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: Hull wash and mash the berries. Add the sugar. Stir up real well. Add 1/2 teaspoon butter. Put on stove. Bring to a full rolling boil one that cant be stirred down. Stir occasionally before it comes to a hard boil. Add the Certo stirring constantly. Boil real hard for 1 minute. Remove from stove. Stir and remove any foam then pour into hot jars and seal immediately. Fill jars 1/8-inch from the top.

title: English Custard Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cut buttered bread lengthwise into 3 pieces. Scald milk (heat to almost boiling) and pour over the beaten eggs which have been mixed with sugar and vanilla. Add cinnamon.

title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine shortening brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Beat egg into creamed mixture.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut stems from mushrooms. Finely chop enough stems for 1/3 cup.\tSaute chopped mushroom stems onion and green pepper in margarine until tender approximately 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in bread crumbs salt thyme turmeric and pepper. Heat margarine in shallow baking dish until melted. Fill mushroom caps with stuffing mixture. Place mushrooms filled sides up in baking dish. Bake 15 minutes. Remove from oven and top with cheese. Return to top rack of the oven. Set\tto broil or 550\u00b0 for 2 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Butterfinger Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 1 gallon ice cream bucket. Finish filling bucket with whole milk. Freeze for about 30 minutes or until freezer stops. Makes about 16 servings.

title: Hot Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Reserve liquid. Mix sugar flour and 1/3 cup of reserved juice. Add cheese and pineapple and mix well. Pour in greased casserole dish. Mix Cheez-Its with melted margarine; sprinkle on top of pineapple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Diabetic Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients; mix well. Bake in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan. Bake about 1 hour. Makes 8 servings.

title: Ground Beef One Dish Meal
instructions: Brown ground beef; add onion and green pepper. Cook until onion and green pepper are done. Add tomato soup dried noodles and sour cream; cover and simmer. When noodles are done add Velveeta cheese on top.

title: No Fat Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll. Cut with tea cake cutter. Mash with fork. Bake on 325\u00b0 until edges begin to brown.

title: Layered Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cut butter into flour using fork or pastry cutter. Add 1 cup chopped nuts and spread evenly in bottom of 8 x 12-inch baking pan to form crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Frozen Black Bottom Pie
instructions: Pour 3/4 cup of the chocolate sauce into chocolate crumb crust spreading lightly to cover bottom and sides of crust. Refrigerate until set. Fill crust with ice cream. Freeze until firm about 2 hours. Let stand at room temperature about 10 minutes before ready to serve. Top with remaining 1/4 cup chocolate sauce.

title: Crisp Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers paper thin leaving peel on. Slice onions into thin rings. Dissolve salt in water and pour over vegetables; put about 2 quarts crushed ice on top. It is the ice and salt that gives an almost brittle crisp pickle. Let stand 3 hours weighted with a plate; drain.

title: Dreamsicle Punch
instructions: Put concentrate rum (use O.J. can for measure) and vanilla in a large container an old water jug works well. Shake well until ingredients are mixed. Place in the freezer until it becomes slushy. Once slushy add ice and shake again until mixed. Slowly add the cream soda. Agitate the container a few times to mix. Do not shake hard.

title: Apple Delight
instructions: Combine water and vanilla; set aside. Grease large glass baking dish. Add apples; sprinkle with cinnamon and then pour water mixture over top. Cut 1/2 cup butter into sugar and flour. Cover apples evenly with this mixture then bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 55 to 60 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream. Serves four.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Debone chicken and cut into bite-size pieces. Cook spaghetti in chicken stock. Cook green pepper and celery in stock. Mix chicken green pepper mushrooms pimentos and spaghetti. Pour in soup (add water if needed). Place in lightly greased casserole dish and bake in moderate oven until bubbles. Top with grated cheese and continue baking until cheese melts. Total Baking Time 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Calico Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans for 12 hours. Drain beans; add 8 cups water and ham hocks. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 hours. Add tomatoes onions carrots chili powder salt pepper and lemon. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 30 minutes. Remove bones from soup; cut meat from bones. Return meat to soup. Remove and discard lemon slice. Makes 10 (1 1/4 cup) servings.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown meat draining off and discarding fat. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour 1/2 cup sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3 noodles (the noodles wont quite fill the bottom). Just space them evenly and they will expand to fill gaps. Mix cottage cheese eggs salt pepper Italian seasoning garlic powder and Parmesan cheese. Top with 1/3 of the cheese mixture mashing it with your fingers or a fork to spread it around the noodles. It wont be even but thats okay. Top with 1/3 of the sauce. Next layer 3 noodles cottage cheese meat and sauce. Top layer 3 noodles cottage cheese rest of sauce 8 ounces grated Mozzarella cheese. Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour. Remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer. Let sit 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place butter in 1-quart bowl. Microwave on High for 1/2 minute or until melted. Blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually stir in milk. Microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes stirring every 3 minutes. Layer half of potatoes onion and sauce in greased 2-quart casserole. Repeat the layers. Cover and cook on High 17 to 19 minutes stirring after 10 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesy Chicken Wings
instructions: Wash chicken and pat dry. In bowl combine bread crumbs cheese and spices. Mix well. Melt butter. Dip chicken wings in butter then into coating. Arrange chicken wings in lightly oiled ovenproof baking dish. Bake chicken wings at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown and done. Chicken wings should be tender.

title: Apple Fritters(Breakfast)
instructions: Make pancakes according to the directions on the box. Add chopped apples and fry until brown. Remove from frying pan and dip lightly into confectioners sugar and serve.

title: 8 Day Pickles
instructions: Wash and cut up cucumbers. Put in churn. Mix salt in 1 gallon water and pour over cucumbers. Let stand 3 days. Drain off salt water. Cover with alum water (1 tablespoon to 1 gallon water). Let stand 1 day. Drain and cover with ginger water (1 tablespoon ginger to 1 gallon water). Let stand 1 day. Drain and rinse cucumbers once and drain well. Put back in churn. Mix vinegar sugar and pickling spice and bring to a boil. Put over cucumbers. Let stand 1 day. Next day put cucumbers in jars. Boil liquid and pour over pickles. Seal and store.

title: White Chile With Salsa Verde
instructions: Boil chicken 1/2 hour in water lemon juice and cumin. Saute garlic onion and oil. Add to chicken. Also add Shoepeg corn green chiles cumin lemon or lime juice and Northern beans. Cook until heated through. In bowl put tortilla chips and chiles over it. Top with Salsa Verde and Monterey Jack cheese.

title: French Bread Dip Appetizer
instructions: Mix all together tearing apart corned beef. (This is better if made day before use.) To serve carve out center of loaf of Italian bread. Place dip mixture in empty center. May use scraps to dip or cut up another loaf to dip. May also use other kinds of hard crust bread.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Whip until smooth. Slice Granny Smith apples; dip in lemon juice to keep from browning.

title: One Bowl Fudge
instructions: Microwave chocolate and milk in large bowl on High 2 to 3 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted stirring every minute. Stir until blended. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread in foil-lined 8-inch square pan. Refrigerate 2 hours. Cut into squares.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Chop off mushroom stems. Saute in butter with grated onion. Add cooked and crumbled bacon to stems and cream cheese. Mix well. Brush mushroom caps with butter and bake 5 to 8 minutes. Fill caps with cream cheese mixture. Bake 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Broil until golden brown.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook seashells for 10 minutes or 3/4 of the way done. Brown ground meat; add onion green pepper and seasonings. Mix egg with cottage cheese; add to the ground meat and a little Parmesan cheese.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease an 11 x 8-inch baking pan with shortening. Stir the corn meal flour sugar baking powder and salt in large bowl until mixed. Beat in milk oil and eggs. Beat by hand.

title: Turkey Dressing
instructions: Boil turkey giblets until done. Boil eggs to hard-boiled stage. Cut up onions. In a large bowl combine stuffing mix onions eggs meat from turkey giblets and salt and pepper to taste. Add enough juice from turkey giblets to mix ingredients to a thick soupy mix. Place in baking dish and bake at approximately 400\u00b0 until set and lightly brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts and pull off bone into pieces. Break up spaghetti and cook according to package directions then cool.

title: Grandma'S Quick Chick Trick
instructions: Place chicken pieces in bottom of greased baking dish. Mix soup and sour cream. Heat and pour over chicken pieces. Crumble crackers over mixture. Melt butter and pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Lasagne
instructions: Fry hamburg in medium frying pan until cooked. Cook macaroni according to directions on box; drain. Add hamburg Ricotta cheese and tomato sauce. Mix well. Pour into glass baking dish. Sprinkle pizza cheese on top. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ding Dong Cake
instructions: Mix as package says and pour in 2 round pans.

title: Malia'S Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix together the jello and hot water to dissolve jello. Add Kool-Aid and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Add cran-strawberry juice and pineapple juice. Mix. Add cold water.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken. Cool and take off bones. Shred chicken and add tomato sauce chili and garlic salt to taste. Heat tortillas on ungreased skillet until warm. Wrap in tinfoil to keep warm. Put meat mixture (spoonful) in warm tortilla. Also spoonful of each grated cheese. Roll tortillas and line in greased pan. Top with enchilada sauce and grated cheese. Heat until enchiladas are heated through and cheese is bubbly at 325\u00b0 about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Favorite Apple Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine 1/2 cup of butter and the cream cheese and let come to room temperature. Add 2 cups of flour and blend well. Chill. Roll out half of the dough and place in a 9-inch pie pan. In a saucepan combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour the mixture into the crust. Roll out the remaining crust and place over the filling. Cut slits in the top crust and allow steam to escape. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with ice cream if desired.

title: Fantastic Punch(For A Large Group)
instructions: Boil the sugar and the 2 cups water together to make a syrup about 10 minutes. Add tea lemon juice orange juice and pineapple juice. Chill several hours. Add the thawed strawberries and juice remaining water and ginger ale. Pour over block of ice or ice cubes. Serves 75 generously.

title: Beef Stroganoff Sandwich
instructions: In a skillet brown ground beef and onion; drain. Add salt garlic and pepper. Cut bread lengthwise in half; butter both halves and place on baking sheets. Remove meat mixture from the heat; stir in sour cream. Spoon onto the bread. Sprinkle with tomatoes pepper and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. (Bake longer for crispier bread.)

title: Lime Jell-O Mold
instructions: Drain juice from crushed pineapple. Mix together all ingredients. Chill overnight.

title: 5 Minute Chili
instructions: Put all ingredients in a medium size saucepan over medium heat. Heat about 4 minutes stirring 2 or 3 times. Try this topped with shredded jalapeno Jack cheese and sour cream or plain yogurt. Good served with cornbread.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well. Bake in tube pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Reese'S Cups
instructions: Cream the peanut butter margarine and vanilla. Add powdered sugar until mixture is of consistency to form balls. Pat out in pan or form into long rolls. Melt chocolate bits in top of double boiler. Brush on top of candy in pan or dip logs into chocolate. Place logs on waxed paper to allow to harden. Place in refrigerator for quicker hardening. When hard slice to serve.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Mix together and put in greased casserole. Top with 2 cups crushed corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes covered. Uncover and bake for another 25 minutes. This makes a crisp top. Can be frozen.

title: Lazy Day Pie
instructions: Heat peaches until hot. Melt butter in 1 1/2-quart deep baking dish. Mix flour and milk. Pour in greased baking dish. Pour hot peaches on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crust is done.

title: Black Bean Salsa
instructions: Drain and rinse beans peas and corn. Mix all together and refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Heavenly Apple Salad
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Allow to set. Combine sugar lemon juice and eggs. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Add whipped topping and spread over top of first mixture.

title: Hot Cocktail Canapes
instructions: Mix sour cream and mayonnaise with dressing mix. Fold in cheese and pepper or ham or shrimp. Mound on 40 bite size cuts of a variety of breads and broil until puffed and browned about 2 minutes. Decorate if desired.

title: Cheesy Broccoli 'N Mushroom Baked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange broccoli in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Whip together soup salad dressing and milk. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese and croutons. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until heated through. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Scallion Dip
instructions: In bowl mix first 3 ingredients well; add olives and mix again. Chill for 10 minutes. Remove and roll into ball. Roll onto chopped nuts. Place back in fridge for 1/2 hour or so. Serve with crackers.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Combine strawberries oil eggs and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Sift dry ingredients together and add to strawberry mixture. Add nuts and stir until blended. Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together; set aside. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add to cucumber mixture. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in milk; add 1/2 cup butter water salt and 1/2 cup sugar. Stir in 1 cup flour then add 2 eggs. Mix in 5 to 6 cups flour; knead for about 15 minutes or use food processor for 7 minutes. Cover and let raise until double in size then punch down and let raise for 30 minutes. On floured surface roll dough in oblong 14 x 18-inch shape. Spread evenly with 1/3 cup softened butter and sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar and desired cinnamon. Roll and cut 12 rolls 1 1/4-inches thick. Prepare a 9 x 12-inch pan by spreading evenly with 1/2 cup softened butter and sprinkling with 3/4 cup brown sugar and cinnamon as desired. Place rolls in prepared pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 40 minutes. Invert pan right out of oven onto parchment paper. Makes 12 rolls.

title: Ham And Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute first 6 ingredients in large skillet until vegetables are tender. Add water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile combine salad dressing mix and milk. Mix thoroughly. Stir into ham and vegetables. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped parsley if desired. Makes 6 1/2 cups or 6 servings.

title: Homemade Pizza
instructions: Slightly thaw bread or rolls enough to spread out on baking dish. Spread amount of sauce you desire on the dough. Add any toppings you like. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes depending on thickness of your crust.

title: Parmesan Noodles
instructions: In large saucepan stir soup until smooth; blend in milk and cheese. Heat; stir occasionally. Just before serving toss hot noodles with butter; combine with soup mixture. Serve with additional cheese.

title: Ham Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half; remove egg yolks. Mash up with fork. Add ham onion flakes salt pepper curry powder and Miracle Whip to mashed egg yolks. Blend well. Take tablespoon and stuff egg whites. Add olive to top of each half.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick of margarine. Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Add graham cracker crumbs. Press down to make crust. Beat eggs and rest of margarine and confectioners sugar together. Spread evenly over crust. Spread pineapple. Cut bananas over the pineapple and spoon Cool Whip on top. Add cherries and chocolate syrup (to taste) over the top. Refrigerate for 5 hours.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix together and pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberries
instructions: Mix together the Jell-O pecans coconut milk and vanilla. Shape dough into strawberries. Chill 1 hour. Roll into berry shape balls; roll in sugar crystals. Tint almonds with green food coloring for garnishing. Keep in cool place. Makes 48 strawberries.

title: Yugoslavian Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with 1/2 cup sugar; add egg yolk and salt. Stir in flour. Pat mixture into 10 x 15 inch pan. Stir jelly over dough. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Add remaining cup of sugar beating slowly. Fold in most of nut and the lemon extract. Spread meringue over jelly. Top with the rest of the nuts.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies in a 9 x 13-inch pan. In one bowl mix the cream cheese and butter. Mix in powdered sugar and fold in Cool Whip. Second mix pudding milk and vanilla. Fold in the cream cheese and pudding mixture. Pour over cookies. Put crushed cookies on top.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix the jello in with the cream first then add other ingredients. Chill and serve.

title: Macho Nacho Dip
instructions: Combine beans and seasoning mix. Spread mix in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Drain olives well. Layer remaining in order listed. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours. Bring to room temperature and serve with tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Mexican Pizza Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in a flat casserole dish. Heat at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

title: Nilla-Orange Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in refrigerator to stiffen. Roll into balls. Will freeze.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix together strawberries eggs and oil. Sift dry ingredients into strawberry mixture. Stir to blend thoroughly. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or 3 medium or 4 small loaf pans. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out dry. Makes 2 large loaves. Bread freezes well.

title: Shrimp Almondine
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain and rinse. Melt margarine; add almond and pepper and brown lightly. Stir in salt flour and caraway seed. Add milk. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Put in spaghetti shrimp and corn then Tabasco and pepper. Pour into buttered casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Bran 'N Raisin Molasses Muffins
instructions: Combine All-Bran milk and molasses; let stand until most of the moisture is taken up. Add egg; beat well. Sift together the flour soda and salt. Add with raisins to first mixture stirring only until combined. Fill greased (with Crisco) muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in moderately hot oven (400\u00b0) for about 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pans. Yields 12 to 15 muffins 2 1/2 inches in diameter.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and rice according to directions; drain and place in casserole dish. Add all ingredients; mix well. Put pats of butter on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour. Combine egg water and vinegar. Pour into flour mixture all at once. Blend only until moistened with spoon. An easy crust to handle without toughening. It will keep up to 2 weeks or longer. Bake at 375\u00b0 or 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Watch.

title: Nana'S Turkey Stuffing
instructions: In saucepan cook turkey neck. Cover with water. Add 1/2 cup celery and onion for about 1 1/2 hours until neck is cooked. In large bowl combine 1 cup celery onion apples and walnuts with 1 package stuffing mix. Take some of the neck meat and add to mixture. Add water from pan until mixture is moistened. Add melted butter with sage and poultry seasoning. Salt and pepper to taste. May add some stuffing bread too.

title: Lemon Refrigerator Dessert
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; add juice salt and rind. Chill until slightly thickened. Whip Milnot until very stiff; gradually beat in sugar then jello mixture. Line bottom of 8 x 12-inch dish with vanilla crumbs. Pour mixture over crumbs. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Chill.

title: Elaine'S Favorite Hamburger Patties With Gravy
instructions: Mix ground beef into patties. Roll in flour. Brown in fat on both sides making sure patties are well browned. Mix other ingredients in cup. Pour over meat patties. Add water. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Quick Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Sprinkle yeast from hot roll mix over water in a large mixing bowl stirring until dissolved. Add flour mixture from hot roll mix beating well. Turn out dough onto lightly floured board. Knead 3 to 5 minutes or until smooth. Cover with bowl. Let rest 10 minutes. Divide in half and roll each into 12-inch circle. Fit each circle into 12-inch pizza pan pressing edges onto side of pan. Brush with oil. Spread with pizza sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. Place pans on cookie sheets. Bake pizzas 35 minutes or until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly. Makes 2 pizzas.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Make roux by slowly browning flour in shortening. When golden brown add onion celery garlic and pepper. Cook at low heat until vegetables separate from fat. Brown chicken in some extra shortening using enough to sear chicken well. Add chicken to roux mixture and cook together for a few minutes stirring occasionally. Pour off fat in which chicken was browned leaving drippings at the bottom. To this add water and bring to a boil. Pour over chicken adding enough extra boiling water to cook the chicken tender and to give gumbo the desired consistency. Add bay leaves.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; reserve 2 cups of broth. Place cut up chicken in 3-quart baking dish. Combine soups plus 1 cup broth. Pour over chicken. Mix butter and 1 cup broth; stir in stuffing mix. Spoon over chicken. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes until brown.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash in salt water until tender drain and mash. Add butter cheese beaten egg onion milk and 3/4 cup cracker crumbs. Put into buttered baking dish. Sprinkle rest of cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
instructions: Cook turkey in small amount of oil. Drain. Add small can of chipped chili peppers soups and tomato sauce. Cook until well blended and fairly thickened.

title: Lynn'S Spiced Turkey
instructions: Slice eggplant onions and peppers. Chop garlic. Put all in a roasting pan. Fill the pan 1/4 full of water. Add the turkey breast. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until done. Slice turkey and enjoy hot.

title: Simple(Ly) Wonderful Biscuits
instructions: Mix together in bowl. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice Dinner
instructions: Dredge chicken pieces in flour. In a skillet heat oil and brown chicken on all sides. Combine rice poultry seasonings salt pepper milk and water. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Top with chicken. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until rice and chicken are tender. Sprinkle with parsley before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken Satay
instructions: Cut the chicken breasts on the diagonal into very thin strips and place in a shallow dish. Combine the marinade ingredients and pour over the chicken. Stir once cover and leave to marinate overnight.

title: Leila'S Eggplant Salvia
instructions: Slice eggplant onion and tomatoes into very thin slices. Arrange in layers in greased casserole eggplant onion and tomatoes (in that order) seasoning lightly between layers. Combine lemon juice and oil; drizzle on top. The dressing will penetrate even though it appears scant. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes basting occasionally with juices that form in the dish. Leftovers freeze well.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine in order given. Mix well and top with butterscotch chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Do not grease pan.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix sugar oil and eggs. Stir in buttermilk and bananas. Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to above ingredients with nuts. Grease and flour bread pan and let stand 20 minutes before baking. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Remove seeds; put through food grinder. Use all of the juice. Boil slowly 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the pectin. Boil hard 1 minute. Put in small jars. Makes 5 jars.

title: No Fat Lo-Cal Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Whisk eggs. Add milk and pumpkin. Mix well. Add the rest of ingredients. Mix well. Spoon into Pam sprayed 12 tin muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Favorite Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients in double boiler. Gradually add milk. Cook over hot water until mixture is smooth and thick stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour into cooked pie shell. Cover and refrigerate until set.

title: Special Corn Bread
instructions: Mix by hand or in blender all the ingredients and bake for 20 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Smoked Brisket
instructions: The brisket is the lowest priced cut and is usually ground into hamburger. This marinade and slow cooking process tenderizes and adds flavor. The meat will fall apart in slivers that you can add barbecue sauce and serve on a bun for a delicious sandwich.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Measure and sift dry ingredients together. Cut shortening into mixture. Add milk and yeast. Stir until well blended. Store in refrigerator about 1 hour before baking. Roll dough 1/2-inch. Cut into biscuits. Let rise for 1 hour. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown. Yields 24.

title: Chocolate Bavarian Pie
instructions: Soften in a 1-qt. saucepan the gelatin in cold water. Stir in sugar cocoa and salt. Stir over medium heat until gelatin and sugar dissolve completely about 5 minutes. Dont boil. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 c. Pet milk. Chill in small bowl until firm. Beat in with mixture at low speed until mixture is broken up. Add 2/3 cup Pet milk and the vanilla. Beat at high speed until mixture fills bowl. Let stand a few minutes or until mixture mounds when dropped from spoon. Heap into a graham cracker crust. Shave a Hershey bar over the top. Chill.

title: Mushroom-Rice Casserole
instructions: Butter a 2-quart casserole dish with the stick of margarine and place the rest of the margarine stick in dish. Add rest of the ingredients; stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. For first 45 minutes rice will appear raw but it is always done in an hour.

title: Apricot Oat Muffins
instructions: In a small saucepan heat orange juice until boiling. Mix in apricots and brown sugar. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Combine oat bran wheat germ whole wheat flour and baking powder. Set aside. In a mixing bowl beat together oil skim milk and egg. Add dry ingredients and apricot/orange juice mixture; mix until just moistened. Fill greased muffin tin or cupcake papers 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 muffins. Contains 135 calories per muffin.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl. Lightly dust raisins with flour. Add coconut fruit and nuts and stir well. Add eggs oil and vanilla stirring only until combined. Spoon batter into cupcake tins and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Muffins should \ripen\ for 24 hours for maximum blending of flavors.

title: Overnight Scalloped Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk and cheese in large bowl. Add chicken macaroni and eggs. Stir in 1/4 cup melted butter. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Toss the bread crumbs with remaining butter; sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown. Serves 12.

title: Chocolate Fudge Frozen Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour cocoa baking powder salt and sugar. Add chopped walnuts. Warm milk and butter together; whisk into dry ingredients. Beat well. Add melted chocolate; beat well. Pour into pan and level the top. Drizzle with sauce.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil in small saucepan over medium heat until Equal is dissolved. Remove from heat and cool 30 minutes. Stir together all other ingredients in a large bowl. Gently stir in dressing. Cover and chill up to 8 hours. Serve with slotted spoon. Makes 8 cups.

title: Almost A Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Turn on; count slowly to 10. Turn off. Pour into 9-inch pie pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In casserole dish add soup mushrooms water chestnuts and cheese. Mix together well. Add green beans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and cream cheese. Add the remaining ingredients. Put in a Pyrex dish and freeze until ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Crisps(Makes About 30 Crisps)
instructions: Cover a cookie sheet with wax paper. Melt chocolate in double boiler over hot but not boiling water (lowest heat) stirring occasionally. Let\tchocolate cool for 1 minute and add cereal and marshmallows. Mix well and add flavoring nuts and raisins. Shape the mixture into balls about the size of walnuts. Place them on the cookie sheet and put in refrigerator until firm (about 2 or 3 hours).

title: Chocolate Crackles
instructions: Melt chocolate; combine with brown sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add vanilla. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add to chocolate mixture. Stir in nuts. Chill dough then drop by teaspoonfuls into powdered sugar and roll to coat. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on rack. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Ketchup Beef Stroganov
instructions: In a medium glass bowl mix all ingredients together and stir well. Refrigerate over night. In a medium skillet over medium heat cook the marinated meat with juices for about 45 minutes or until meat is tender stirring occasionally. When almost done stir in 1 cup of ketchup and let boil about 1 minute stirring constantly. Serve over fries.

title: Potato Lefse
instructions: When potatoes are cooked add butter while mashing then rice. Add the cream sugar and salt. Cool for about 2 hours in refrigerator. Add the flour. From into balls. Roll thin and bake on lefse griddle. Makes about 12 to 15. Best served with butter cinnamon and sugar.

title: Mom'S Four Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all beans together and pour sauce over and mix into beans.

title: Quick Skillet Stew And Dumplings
instructions: Brown beef and onion in large skillet; pour off excess fat. Add 1 can sauce vegetables water salt thyme and pepper. Combine well and bring to a boil.

title: Speedy Tartar Sauce
instructions: Just mix in blender or shaker and serve over your favorite fish. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Breakfast Delight
instructions: Arrange bread cubes in greased casserole dish. Beat eggs well; add milk cream cheese and maple syrup and pour over bread. Let set overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Delicious Portabella Mushroom
instructions: Mix oil wine garlic salt and shallot in a bowl. Pour over sliced mushrooms. Marinate at least 2 hours. Grill or saut mushrooms in a medium-hot skillet with little olive oil.

title: Heavenly Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl; transfer to a 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned and smelling wonderful approximately 45 minutes.

title: Winter Tea
instructions: Put broken cinnamon sticks in a tea ball. Add everything except tea bags in pot and boil 3 minutes. Add tea bags and let steep until strong enough for you.

title: Chili
instructions: When olive oil is hot in a 6-quart pot add the meat and sear until it is grey. Add one quart water cover and cook at simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add all the remaining ingredients except the flour and cornmeal. Cook 30 more minutes. Next add the flour and meal mixed with one cup water. Cook 5 minutes more to see if more water is needed for the right consistency. If there is too much fat skim off before adding the flour and meal.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken. Remove bones and break into pieces. Cook rice according to package directions (1 cup of uncooked rice makes 2 1/2 cups cooked). Mix soup mayonnaise onion and lemon juice. Add chicken cheese and rice. Mix well. Put in a baking dish sprayed with Pam and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight.

title: Marinated Peas
instructions: Boil salad oil salt vinegar pepper hot water and sugar. Pour over remaining ingredients. Chill 3 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Sour Cream Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Fold all ingredients into potatoes except 1 cup cheese. Pour into 3-quart casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with reserved cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Creamy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender. Drain well. Place in lightly oiled 8 x 8 x 1/2-inch baking dish. Combine soup cheese mayonnaise and lemon juice; mix well. Pour over broccoli. Top with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breakfast Muffins
instructions: In large bowl stir together flour oats sugar baking powder and salt; set aside. In small bowl mix egg milk and oil. Pour all at once into oat mixture stirring just until moistened. Fold in bacon (crumbled) cheese green pepper and onion. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 18 minutes. Makes 1 dozen muffins.

title: Ham-Cheese Broccoli Strata
instructions: Lay 8 slices bread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer cheese and broccoli with ham. Cut 4 slices in 1/2 to make triangles and arrange on top. Combine all other ingredients and pour over. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Bake uncovered for 55 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes.

title: Cantaloupe Pie
instructions: Cook cantaloupe and 1 1/2 cups sugar. Mix remaining 1/2 cup sugar flour salt and egg to cooked cantaloupe butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Cool and cover with whipped topping. Makes 2 pies.

title: Easy Beef And Noodles
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon reserving drippings in a skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute onion in drippings until tender; add ground beef and cook until meat is browned stirring to crumble. Drain off drippings; stir in tomatoes green pepper chili sauce salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add noodles and water; bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until noodles are tender. Stir in bacon; sprinkle with cheese. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into bite size pieces and mix together with other ingredients.

title: Possin A La Nicoise
instructions: Coat a baking dish with 1 teaspoon olive oil. Place fish fillets in a single layer. Season with salt and pepper. Add garlic parsley and oregano to the mashed tomatoes. Add wine and mushrooms if desired. Spread the mixture on the fish and sprinkle the remaining 4 teaspoons olive oil over the fillets. Dot with bits of 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes more or less depending on thickness of fish. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Appetizer A La Groppuso
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and stir until well blended. Fill regular or mini muffin tins half full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. May be served hot or cold.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Thirty minutes before serving preheat broiler. Remove mushroom stems and finely chop. Reserve mushroom caps. In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat melt butter. Cook mushroom stems onions and next 4 ingredients until onion is tender (about 5 minutes) stirring occasionally. Stir in bread crumbs and cheese.

title: Fruit And Cheese Kabobs
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Combine juice and apple pieces tossing to coat. Arrange fruit and cheese onto straws. Yields 12 servings.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Cut fruit into bite size and mix. Let stand for 2 hours and serve with love.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Mix margarine sugar egg and dates. Cook for 10 minutes or until thick stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add nuts and Rice Krispies. Cool. Make into small balls and roll in coconut. Makes about 50.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour oil and milk to make dough. Peel and cut apples of choice. Roll out dough and wrap around apples. Sprinkle a little sugar and cinnamon on the apple before wrapping. Boil 2 cups sugar water and butter; pour over dumplings. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Yields 8 to 12.

title: Fudge Royale
instructions: Combine sugar and cocoa in a saucepan. Add milk. Stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved and then bring to a boil. Stir occasionally and cook to 236\u00b0 or until a small amount of candy dropped in cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla but do not stir. Allow to cool for 15 minutes; then beat until mixture thickens. Stir in nuts and quickly pour into a buttered 8-inch pan. Cut into squares.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef uncooked rice onion celery salt salt & pepper. Roll into small balls. Place in a greased casserole dish. Pour tomato soup mixture over them. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Moussaka
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Brown eggplant slices in a non-stick frypan. Set aside.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: On medium heat melt margarine and add flour stirring until smooth. Gradually add milk stirring until well mixed. Add potatoes and green onions; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except for cheese. Sprinkle cheese on top of soup when served.

title: Peppernuts
instructions: Beat together eggs sugar and shortening in large bowl at high speed until creamy about 3 minutes. Turn mixer to low speed. Sift all dry ingredients except soda together. Add gradually to creamed mixture alternately with sour milk to which soda has been added. Increase to medium speed 1 to 2 minutes when mixture becomes stiffer. If possible allow dough to stand in cool place to stiffen before rolling and cutting. May decorate with sugars or raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes on greased cookie sheets.

title: Swiss Creamed Peas
instructions: In large saucepan cook peas according to package directions.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar eggs and vanilla. Add flour salt soda cinnamon nutmeg and apples. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Top with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Coat chicken. Place in shallow baking pan. Drizzle melted butter over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn. Bake 15 minutes. Turn again and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant-Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Peel slice or cube eggplant and cook in boiling water with salt added until tender. Drain and mash. Place half of cracker crumbs butter onion celery and crabmeat in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining cracker crumbs. Combine egg and milk. Pour over contents of casserole. Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown on top. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hot Fudge Sundae Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl combine 3/4 cup sugar flour 3 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and salt. Blend in milk melted butter and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour batter into an 8 or 9-inch baking pan.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese soup mix and dried beef and form into a ball. Roll in chopped pecans and serve with crackers.

title: Dr.  Kuracina'S Pasta Party Sauces(For Family And Friends)
instructions: In a food processor with steel blade or blender place ingredients except cheese and process until smooth. Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Easy Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli just until it is tender; drain. Mix cheese soup and milk in a saucepan; bring just to a boil stirring constantly. Mix well. Butter glass Pyrex dish. Arrange broccoli in dish. Pour cheese soup on broccoli. Make sure broccoli is covered. Place slices of cheese on top of broccoli. Cook at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and sliced cheese just starts to brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or 3 small individual loaf pans. Cream sugar and oil together. Add eggs and pumpkin. Mix well. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with water. Pour into prepared pans. Bake larger loaf pans for 1 hour 20 minutes. Bake small loaf pans approximately 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool on wire rack.

title: Avocado Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender; mix well. Use as topping on tacos or tossed salad.

title: Butter Fudge Lemon Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl with a wooden spoon. Pour wet ingredients into a small bowl; mix with electric mixer on medium for 20 seconds or until smooth. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Continue mixing with electric mixer on medium another 30 seconds or until dough forms. Make a 1/2 inch ball with your fingers formed around 3 chocolate chips. Place on a dry cookie sheet in rows 4 across and 6 down. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 7 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet and cool 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all together except cheese. Pour half batter in greased baking dish. Add half cheese. Add remaining batter. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Bacon Dressing
instructions: Dice bacon in small pieces and pan-broil over moderate heat until crisp. Add remaining ingredients stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Pour over salad greens and toss gently until well blended. Season to taste and serve at once.

title: Shaker Lemon Pie
instructions: Remove seeds from lemons. Mix lemons with sugar and let stand overnight. Add beaten eggs and stir. Pour into pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Lower heat to 375\u00b0 and bake for 20 minutes. The Shaker recipe calls for a top crust but this is optional.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt oleo. Stir in sugar syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in baking soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popped corn mixing well. Turn into 2 large shallow baking or roasting pans. Bake in a 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool completely. Break apart and store in covered container. Yields 5 quarts. This recipe can be halved.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Pie
instructions: Mix broccoli chicken and onion together in a bowl. Beat milk eggs bisquick salt and pepper until smooth. Pour the milk eggs etc. over the chicken broccoli cheese and onion in greased pie pan. Bake 25 to 30 min. in 400\u00b0 oven. I usually bake it 10-15 min. more in my oven. The pie will be done when a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: In crock-pot cook on high for about 3 hours.

title: Nutty Cracker Delights
instructions: Place crackers in a single layer in a foil-lined 15 x 10-inch baking pan. In a saucepan over medium heat melt butter. Add sugar; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add vanilla. Pour evenly over crackers; sprinkle with nuts.

title: Applesauce Cake(This Is A Good Breakfast Cake.)
instructions: Before mixing sprinkle dates and raisins with some flour so they dont stick together in mixture.

title: Apricot Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking soda cocoa salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add apricots. Mix in shortening walnuts and raisins. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then turn oven down to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes more. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Rice And Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in 2 tablespoons oil. Mix soups and milk together; add to rice. Cook broccoli; drain. Add rest of ingredients; bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Broccoli Saute
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat put 1 tablespoon margarine; cook chicken for 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove chicken; keep warm.

title: Summertime Melon Melba
instructions: Cut melon in half crosswise and remove seeds. Slice melon into 1-inch rings. Remove rind. Fill each ring with scoops of ice cream. Top with melted preserves. Serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Nut Zucchini Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt chocolate over hot not boiling water and cool. Grease well and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Sift flour with baking powder soda and salt. Set aside. In large bowl beat eggs until thick at high speed. Gradually add sugar 1/4 cup at a time beating well after each addition. Add oil and cooled chocolate; beat until well blended. At low speed add sifted dry ingredients mixing until smooth. Add zucchini and nuts with wooden spoon. Stir until well combined. Turn batter into prepared pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until surface springs back when pressed lightly with fingertip. Cool in pan on wire rack 15 minutes. Remove from pan; cool thoroughly on rack.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Put in saucepan 1/2 cup sugar and let brown; add little water and cook until light syrup (dont let sugar get too brown). Stir and mix well 1/2 cup sugar flour or cornstarch egg yolks and whole egg. Add to syrup and cook until thick. Put in baked crust and top with meringue and brown.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Stir together dry ingredients. Stir in next five ingredients. Beat eggs oil and vanilla and stir into first mix until just combined. Fill greased tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt in a 2-quart bowl. Add in syrup and mix well. Beat eggs in with fork one at a time. Mix in remaining ingredients. Pour into a 9-inch pie pan lined with unbaked pastry. Bake near center of 375\u00b0 oven for about 50 minutes or until firm. Cool before serving.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Lay meat on chopping board and sprinkle meat with flour mixture. Pound in flour mixture turn meat over and repeat. (This pounding also tenderizes the meat.) In hot oil in skillet brown meat. Add rest of ingredients. Stir well. Simmer about 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Serve over rice. Serves four people.

title: Mound Bars
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk confectioners sugar and coconut. Form or shape into bars or balls and chill. Melt 12 ounces chocolate chips and 1/3 of a block of paraffin in double boiler. Dip each bar or ball in chocolate mixture.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Remove crusts from bread; spread bread slices with butter. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside. Cook sausage until browned stirring to crumble; drain well. Spoon sausage over bread slices; sprinkle with cheese. Combine beaten eggs milk salt and pepper; mix well and pour over bread and cheese. Cover casserole; refrigerate overnight.

title: Roasted Loin Of Pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Rub the sage cinnamon and cloves over the surface of the pork. Place it on a rack and roast the pork for 1-1/2 hours or until it registers 160\u00b0 on a meat thermometer. Let the roast rest for 15 minutes then slice and serve.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (You can cook bacon to lay on top.)

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
instructions: Lightly toss the chicken pineapple dates celery and almonds until mixed. Chill well before you add the mayonnaise. Serve on crunchy bed of lettuce - serves 6.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake one hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 (3 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch) loaves.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all together in a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Orange Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl combine the first five ingredients. In another bowl combine egg orange juice water butter and orange peel. Add to dry ingredients just until combined. Fold in the blueberries. Pour into a greased and floured 8x4x2-inch loaf pan. Bake for 65-70 minutes or until test done. Cool for 10 minutes remove from pan to wire rack.

title: 7-Layer Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish in the order listed. Refrigerate. Serve with Doritos or Fritos.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: After cooking apples stir in soda and set aside. Cream sugar and butter together. Add eggs. Combine flour and dry ingredients together. Use apples for milk. Fold in nuts and raisins. Pour in tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease large casserole. Add rice celery onion mushrooms broccoli and parsley. Heat and mix in a saucepan the remaining ingredients. Pour the heated sauce into the casserole. Mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Let cheese stand at room temperature until soft enough to grate. With your hands mix sausage with grated cheese adding Bisquick and baking powder until well mixed. Then roll into medium size balls. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: How To Preserve A Husband
instructions: Be careful in your selection. Do not choose too young and take only such as have been raised in good moral atmosphere. Some insist on keeping them in a pickle while others keep them in hot water. Or worse yet over their heads in debt. This only makes them sour hard and sometimes bitter. Even poor varieties may be made sweet tender and good by garnishing them with patience well sweetened smiles and flavored with kisses to taste. Wrap them in a mantle of charity; keep them warm with a steady fire of domestic devotion. Serve with 3 good meals a day. When thus prepared they will keep for years.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Cooking Time 45 minutes. Servings 4 to 6.

title: Venison Filet - Hunter'S Style
instructions: Have steak cut in 3/4-inch slices. Season with salt and place in shallow glass dish. Mix peppercorns onion carrot parsley thyme bay leaf wine and 5 tablespoons olive oil; pour over meat. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Turn meat in marinade from time to time. Remove meat from marinade; pat dry. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in skillet; cook venison 3 minutes on each side or depending on desired doneness. Remove meat and keep warm. Make sauce in same pan.

title: Creamy Spinach Bake
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Crumble and set aside. Combine spinach sour cream and soup mix; stir well. Spoon into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle cheese over spinach mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with crumbled bacon. Yields 6 servings.

title: Grandma Thelma'S Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Simmer on stove at least 1 hour. Serve over pasta. I also add mushrooms Parmesan cheese and oregano.

title: Beef Sirloin Tip Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Shake flour in large size (14 x 20-inch) Reynolds oven cooking bag; place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Add tomato sauce water instant bouillon and pepper; squeeze bag gently to blend ingredients. Place roast in bag. Peel and quarter vegetables; add to bag. Turn bag gently to coat ingredients with sauce. Close bag with nylon tie; make 6 (1/2-inch) slits in top. Insert a meat thermometer through slit in the bag into thickest part of the roast. Bake 1 3/4 to 2 3/4 hours or until meat thermometer registers 160\u00b0. Slice roast thinly across the grain. To serve spoon gravy from bag over roast and vegetables. Makes 6 to 10 servings.

title: Springerle
instructions: Stir sugar into beaten egg yolks. Beat whites until stiff add to egg yolks and sugar. Stir vigorously for 10 minutes. Crush ammonium carbonate thoroughly and add to mixture along with anise oil and lemon rind. Add flour in several portions combining well. Divide dough into 3 or 4 portions. Turn one out onto floured board and place others in refrigerator. Roll out 1/4-inch thick. Dust springerle board with flour by tying flour into a twist of cheesecloth and striking it lightly against the board. Stamp sheet of dough firmly with the floured springerle board.

title: Chicken Breast Veronique
instructions: Remove skin from chicken breasts and cut them in half. Combine cracker crumbs salt pepper tarragon and nutmeg. Coat chicken in mixture.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup of boiling water; let cool. Beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla; set aside. Beat cream until stiff. Mix all together and spread over crust.

title: Sweet Bread (Christmas Cake)(Virgin Islands Native Recipe)
instructions: Dissolve yeast cake into 1 cup of warm water. Add flour enough to make stiff batter. Add 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon; beat until smooth. Cover and set to rise. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add prepared yeast mixture and salt. Add fruits and beat well. Sift flour with spices add alternately with hot milk. Beat until light. Add nuts. Pour into greased tins; allow to rise double in size. Brush with syrup before and after baking. (Syrup is made of brown sugar and water.) Bake at 375\u00b0. The addition of 1/4 cup of cherry cordial or guavaberry liquor gives it the Christmas touch!

title: Black-Eyed Pea Jambalaya
instructions: If using dried peas add 1 small onion and garlic and 1 quart water. Bring to a boil lower flame and let simmer slowly until beans are tender and creamy. Add cooked rice stirring gently until rice is coated with bean mixture. Add parsley and onion tops. Chopped ham or bacon may be added to this.

title: Chicken With Cauliflower And Black Olives
instructions: Saute chicken in olive oil with garlic salt and pepper to taste over moderate heat in wide uncovered skillet. While chicken is cooking blanch cauliflower in boiling water (or microwave). Drain and set aside but keep warm. When chicken is brown add vinegar rosemary and parsley. Cover lower heat and simmer for 3 minutes. Take off cover turn up heat and boil until vinegar has evaporated. Add tomatoes and when they begin to boil add black olives and cauliflower. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes (careful not to overcook cauliflower). Serve with white rice. Serves 6.

title: Herbed Green Pea Soup
instructions: In a soup pot saute the scallions in the oil for 1 minute. Add the thyme and tarragon; saute for another minute. Stir peas nutmeg salt and pepper and hot water. Cover; bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes until the peas are tender but still bright green. Using a slotted spoon remove about 1 cup of the peas and set aside. In a blender or food processor puree the rest of the soup. Return the pureed soup into the pot; stir in the milk and reserved peas. Gently reheat or chill for about 1 1/2 hours. Garnish with scallions adding croutons if you wish. Serves 4. Preparation time 30 minutes.

title: Fiesta Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet combine tomato sauce orange juice onion raisins pimiento oregano chili powder garlic and hot pepper sauce. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in chicken; return to boiling. Cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes more or until chicken is tender and no longer pink. Meanwhile combine cornstarch and water; stir into skillet. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Toss parsley with rice. Serve chicken mixture over rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Wash navy beans and then run them through hot water until the beans are white again. Boil slowly 3 1/2 hours in a covered pot containing 4 quarts of water and smoked ham hocks. Braise onion in a little butter and add it to the soup. Season with salt and pepper. Serves 8.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables and pepperoni. Add to cold spaghetti; add spice. Toss with entire bottle of dressing. Mix well. Better served next day.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Allow spinach to thaw. Chop scallions and water chestnuts into small pieces. Add all ingredients together (except spinach) and mix. After all is mixed well add drained (make sure its drained well) spinach and mix. Chill. Great with Sociables crackers and vegetable crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend ingredients together. Pour in pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes more or until center is set.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Combine all ingredients saving 1/2 cup grated cheese for the top. Place in casserole and bake for 45 minutes in a 450\u00b0 oven. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Almond Tea
instructions: Mix instant tea with remaining ingredients. Store in refrigerator. When ready to use add 2 parts water to 1 part mixture. Serve over ice.

title: Party Meatballs
instructions: Combine everything except the soup and form into balls. Place in deep casserole and cover with undiluted soup. Bake uncovered for two hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Grandma'S Dressing
instructions: Mix corn meal buttermilk and eggs for corn bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Crumble biscuits in bowl and add milk. Let stand. Simmer until tender the celery onion margarine and 1 cup water. Combine corn bread biscuit mixture onion-celery mix chicken chicken broth chicken soup salt pepper and garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown on edges.

title: Cheddar-Broccoli Noodles
instructions: Cut chicken tenders into small pieces and fry until golden brown; set aside. In 3-quart saucepan over high heat heat water to boiling. Add noodles and broccoli. Return to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 5 minutes or until noodles and broccoli are tender stirring occasionally. Stir in seasoning packets; drain off most of liquid. Add cheese soup sour cream pepper and chicken. Heat through stirring occasionally.

title: One Bowl Dinner Rolls
instructions: In large bowl mix 3/4 cup flour sugar salt and yeast. Add softened margarine; gradually add hot water to dry ingredients and beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Add egg and 1/2 cup flour or enough flour to make thick batter. Beat at high speed 2 minutes scraping bowl. Stir in enough additional flour to make a soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead until smooth and elastic about 8 to 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover. Let rise in a warm place until double in bulk about 1 hour.

title: Creamy Broccoli Cheese Dip
instructions: Beat all ingredients in a bowl. Serve with vegetables crackers.

title: Cuban Shredded Beef
instructions: Slice flank steak in strips (1/2-inch thick by 2 inches long). Use enough water to cover strips in pressure cooker. Close lid; cook on high until steam comes out. Put cap on lid; lower heat to medium. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; add eggs and milk stirring well. Add onion and blend (mixture will be thick). Dip a large spoon into hot salad oil then into batter for each hush puppy; drop by spoonfuls in hot salad oil. Cook until golden brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Cheese And Potato Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Combine wild rice and water in saucepan and cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Drain. Set aside. Fry bacon pieces and onion in skillet until bacon is crisp. Drain bacon and onion on paper towel. Place soup in large saucepan; dilute as directed. Stir in milk (1 quart) bacon onion cheese and cooked rice. Stir until cheese is melted. Garnish with carrot. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Spinach Soup
instructions: Heat water to boiling and add bouillon. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Transfer to blender or food processor and puree until smooth (in several portions if necessary). Reheat if necessary or serve at room temperature. Makes 6 servings at 40 calories each.

title: Halloween Party Mix(16 Cups)
instructions: In large bowl combine the pretzels crackers and peanuts. In large pan combine sugar butter and corn syrup. Bring to a boil over medium heat; boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and baking soda (mixture will foam). Pour over pretzel mixture and stir until coated. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1 baking pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes stirring every 10 to 15 minutes. Break apart. Add M&Ms and candy corn.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix peaches with 1 cup sugar. Set oven at 350\u00b0. Put butter in casserole dish and put in oven to melt. Make batter of 1 cup sugar baking powder flour and milk. Pour over melted butter; do not stir. Put sugared peaches on top; do not stir.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Can also use Monterey Jack garlic Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese too. Best served in a little crock-pot to keep it warm and supply crackers to dip in.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix together pineapple sugar flour and cheese. Put into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown first 3 ingredients. Mix remaining ingredients. Add to hamburger mixture. Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Hot Wings
instructions: Bake chicken in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to one hour until fully cooked. In a medium saucepan melt the margarine. Stir in the remaining ingredients and baste the cooked chicken. Cook the chicken for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Shrimp Chowder
instructions: In a large pot cover onions and potatoes with water. Simmer covered for 25 minutes until vegetables are tender. In large saucepan melt butter and blend in flour. Gradually add milk and cook until thickened stirring frequently. Add milk mixture and shrimp to the soup pot. Simmer 5 minutes. Add half and half. Stir well and reheat. Do not boil. Add salt and pepper and serve. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Refrigerator Roll Dough
instructions: In a measuring cup dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup water. Set aside. Cream Crisco in large bowl. Alternately add flour with 2 cups lukewarm water and salt. When half the ingredients have been mixed mix in yeast mix. When all ingredients have been added cover and refrigerated. Make and let rise at least 2 hours before baking.

title: Kentucky Chocolate Pie
instructions: Blend together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until firm.

title: Lemon Fish
instructions: Season fish with salt pepper and garlic. Set aside for 15 minutes. Cut up onion and green pepper. Squeeze lemon juice over fish. Put in covered dish. Add onion green pepper and s/c lemon over the entire dish. Cook slow in oven for one hour. Serve hot.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine ingredients in bowl and mix well. Drop by spoonfuls into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Cool and remove from pan.

title: Green Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain grease. Add soup milk and chilies. Bring to a simmer. The longer you cook the hotter it will be.

title: Easy Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dip chicken into egg. Coat with bread crumbs. In skillet over medium heat heat oil. Cook chicken 10 minutes or until done. Set chicken aside. In same pan heat Prego sauce to a boil. Return chicken to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is done. Top chicken with cheese and heat until cheese is melted. Serve with spaghetti. Top with Parmesan cheese and parsley. Serves 4.

title: Barbecue Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger meat chopped onion and chopped bell pepper in skillet. Drain. Add barbecue sauce and let simmer for 10 minutes or until mixture is cooked good. Cook rice in pan and rinse in a colander with cold water to keep rice from sticking together. I leave both dishes in pans and we dip rice out and add as much meat mixture as we want on top of rice. Very good.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Put soda in buttermilk. Sift dry ingredients together adding alternately with the buttermilk. Add eggs; blend and fold in jam and raisins. Bake in 10-inch tube pan at 350\u00b0 for about 1 or 1 1/2 hours according to your oven. Test with toothpick. I always line my pan with greased brown paper sack.

title: No Stir Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in a 2 1/2 to 3-quart dish. Mix flour sugar and milk and pour mixture into center of melted butter; do not stir. Add peaches that have been sweetened with another cup of sugar. Do not stir. Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender. Debone. Combine sour cream and both soups and pour over chicken in dish. Mix dressing mix with butter. Pour broth on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Butter a 2-quart casserole. Mix all ingredients and place in dish. Cover with potato chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Let cool. Poke holes all throughout cake. Pour pineapple over top. Mix pudding as directed on box. Pour over pineapple. Arrange bananas over pudding. Frost with Cool Whip and sprinkle pecans over top.

title: Breadsticks(Kid'S Corner)
instructions: Brush the cut sides of buns with butter. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Combine cheese and seeds; sprinkle over buns. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Quick And Easy Fudge
instructions: Line bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish with wax paper; set aside. Combine first 6 ingredients in a 2-quart casserole stirring gently. Add butter; microwave uncovered at High for 2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated through. Stir until smooth. Stir in pecans. Pour mixture into prepared dish. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares. Yields 16 squares.

title: Oatmeal Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk and butter; mix thoroughly. Boil 1/2 minute. Mix in oatmeal vanilla and peanut butter. Mix thoroughly. Pour into buttered pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Combine butter sugar and vanilla; mix well. Add eggs and beat well. Stir in flour. Gradually stir in chocolate nuts and coconut. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Onion Dip
instructions: Bring water sugar and vinegar to a boil. Pour over onions and set overnight. Drain well. Add the 1/2 cup mayo and 1 teaspoon of celery seed.

title: Potato Lasagna
instructions: Put sliced potatoes in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix soup with hamburger and oregano. Pour over potatoes. Pour Prego over hamburger. Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle cheese over lasagna last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli raisins onion and bacon. Combine mayo vinegar and sugar. Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: Chicken With Corn Stuffing
instructions: Combine soup celery onion and paprika. Spoon into 9-inch pie plate that has been sprayed with nonstick vegetable spray. Spread stuffing mix over evenly. Arrange chicken over stuffing. Combine sugar and mustard; spread evenly over chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Pastry (8 Or 9-Inch)(Double Crust)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll out on floured board.

title: No Cook Marshmallow Frosting
instructions: Beat egg whites and salt with beater until soft peaks form. Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until smooth and glossy. Continue beating and add Karo a little at a time beating after each addition until frosting peaks. Fold in vanilla.

title: Philly Chocolate Tunnel Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix according to package directions substituting margarine for oil. Reserve 1 cup batter. Pour remaining batter into 12-cup greased and floured fluted tube pan. Combine cream cheese and sugar mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Blend in eggs one at a time. Pour over batter in pan. Spoon reserved batter over cream cheese mixture. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool 30 minutes; remove to wire rack. Combine margarine chocolate and corn syrup. Pour over cooled cake. Makes 12 servings. Preparation time 15 minutes; cooking time 35 minutes.

title: Divinity
instructions: Combine sugar water and corn syrup in large boiler being careful not to get mixture on sides of pan. Place over high heat. When mixture begins to steam turn unit to low. Cook mixture to hard ball stage. Beat egg whites until stiff. Pour one cup of cooked mixture over egg whites beating constantly. Cook remaining mixture to light to medium crack stage. Gradually pour this mixture over egg whites beating constantly. Add vanilla. Beat until mixture loses its gloss. Drop onto waxed paper.

title: Galopita(Greek Baked Custard)
instructions: Heat milk. Add 1/2 cup sugar salt and farina. Mix and cook until thick. Add butter and stir until melted. Beat eggs and sugar. Add to mixture. Pour into a greased 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Cinnamon-Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: In large bowl with electric mixer combine butter sugar and eggs. Beat until the mixture is light and fluffy. Blend in sour cream. Sift flour soda and baking powder into the creamed mixture; add vanilla. Blend well. Spoon half of batter into a 9-inch tube pan or a 10-inch Bundt pan which has been buttered and floured. Sprinkle half the cinnamon-nut mixture over batter. Spoon in remaining batter and top with rest of nut mixture. Place in cold oven set at 350\u00b0 and bake about 55 minutes. Serve warm or cool. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Chop chestnuts and mix with beef and sausage; shape meat into balls and bake on cookie sheet in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
instructions: Melt peanut butter and chips in large pan; add peanuts and stir well. Drop onto wax paper and refrigerate.

title: Filling Balls
instructions: Form into balls and place in a well-greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Mom'S Beans
instructions: Fry bacon and reserve grease. In 9 x 11-inch pan combine beans onions brown sugar and catsup. Crumble bacon and add 2 tablespoons of the grease. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Skillet Pork And Sauerkraut
