instructions: Broil chops on preheated broiler 4 inches from heat 2 minutes on each side. Heat oil in large skillet. Add onion and garlic. Cook over medium heat until softened. Add 1/4 cup water and remaining ingredients except apple. Top with chops and simmer covered on low heat about 1 hour or until chops are tender. Then stir in apple slices and simmer about 3 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Baked Steamed Rice
instructions: Saute onion in margarine until tender. Combine other ingredients and pour into casserole dish (13 x 9). Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Garden Turkey Pockets
instructions: Combine turkey (skinned and cooked without salt) carrots celery and yogurt. Stir well. Cover and chill.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Chop beef. Boil in water. Add salt and pepper. After beef is partially cooked add vegetables and cook 15 minutes. Add batter made of rest of ingredients. Drop into stew. Cover and cook 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients and chill about 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes and mash. Add sugar milk eggs margarine and coconut. Place in casserole and bake 45 minutes or less at 350\u00b0.

title: 1-2-3 Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a casserole. Mix together all the other ingredients and pour over the chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients over low heat stirring constantly until it thickens. Cool. Fold apples and 1/2 cup of peanuts into mixture. Fold in Cool Whip and sprinkle remaining peanuts on top. Refrigerate overnight (but good same day too). Makes about 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Chicken Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ranch Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cube. Put in casserole dish with parsley chopped onion and cut butter all over. Cook at 400\u00b0 until potatoes are done. While still hot add bacon bits and grated cheese. Pour Ranch dressing all over. Cover all; let sit until all is melted.

title: Basic Loaf Recipe
instructions: Saute vegetables in 3 tablespoons water with garlic. Mix together all ingredients. Loaf should be moist but not runny. Bake in sprayed pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients gently but well. Put in low flat casserole. Toss corn flakes and nuts in margarine and put atop chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or if made ahead and refrigerated increase baking time to 1 hour. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix mayonnaise soup margarine eggs and cheese together. Add and mix in vegetables. Pour into a sprayed casserole dish. (Size 10 x 13-inch for thin casserole or 10 x 10-inch foil pan for thicker.) Top with stuffing mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 2 bread pans 9 x 5-inches. Beat eggs until frothy. Beat in remaining ingredients. Divide into two greased pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool thoroughly before slicing.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except hash browns and 1/2 of cheese. Then mix in potatoes. Pat in greased baking pan/dish. Sprinkle on rest of the cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cover while baking for 20 minutes and cook uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Doritos Casserole
instructions: Brown beef with garlic salt and chili powder; drain. Mix soups and enchilada sauce. Crush Doritos and put in bottom of dish. Pour meat over Doritos. Top with onions chilies and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Add by teaspoons to taste to 1 cup hot water.

title: Caramel Popcorn(Microwave)
instructions: Put margarine brown sugar Karo syrup and butter flavoring in a microwave-safe dish and cook on High until it boils. Stir and cook for 2 more minutes; then add baking soda and stir. Put popcorn in a large brown grocery bag; pour syrup in and stir. Close top of bag and shake. Microwave in bag on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Shake and repeat 2 more times. Pour into a large bowl and stir until dry.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and oil together. Add flour soda and salt sifted together. Add vanilla coconut nutmeats and apples. Pour into a large baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain fat off. Add onion and potatoes; cook for about 20 minutes. Add tomatoes corn salt and pepper. Cook for 20 minutes more.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef and drain. Add salt and pepper. Add mushroom soup and dry onion soup. Spread mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan. Lay American cheese slices over the top. Cover the top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 until food thermometer reads 165\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cube squash and cook in salted water until crisp and tender. Drain. Saute onions and peppers in butter. Stir in mushrooms and spaghetti mix. Add squash tomato paste and cheese. Pour all ingredients into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix the ingredients and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Dice cooked chicken into large pieces. Spread rice on bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place chicken pieces on top. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over chicken and rice. Heat in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Do not overbake. Serves 12.

title: Tropical Dump Cake
instructions: Spread cherries evenly over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour in pineapple but do not mix. Sift cake mix on top. Pour butter on evenly. Sprinkle with coconut and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and coconut is toasted.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pour boiling water over rice. Salt and pepper chicken and lay on top of rice. Mix soups together and heat. Pour over top of chicken. Bake in oven 1 hour or until chicken is done.

title: Frozen Fudge Fantasy(For All Chocolate Lovers!)
instructions: Cook first 5 ingredients until melted and smooth; take off of heat. Add eggs. Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Coat 9-inch spring-form pan with butter and cocoa powder. Pour mixture in pan. Place cookie sheet under the pan as it runs. Bake 2 hours; turn oven off. With door open let sit in oven for 1/2 hour. Cool completely on a wire rack. Remove from pan; put on plastic wrap in foil. Freeze 6 to 12 hours and add whipped cream.

title: Zesty Stuffed Vegetables
instructions: Stir together cream cheese pimento olives lemon juice and seasoning until well blended; set aside. Cut each pepper lengthwise into 6 wedges; remove seeds and membrane. Cut cucumber into 12 slices on the diagonal. Spoon the cheese mixture into a decorative bag or a heavy large food storage bag; snip one corner. Pipe the mixture onto the vegetables. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Lemon Sheet Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat the cake mix and eggs until well blended. Fold in pie filling. Spread into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put pumpkin into large mixing bowl. Break eggs into pumpkin and mix slowly in electric mixer. Add sugar coffee cream milk salt and vanilla and mix well. Pour into crusts. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour then lower temperature to 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 and bake another 1/2 hour or until testing knife comes out clean. Makes 2 pies.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and chop chicken breasts. Mix soup and sour cream together. Grease the bottom of a casserole dish. Place cooked chicken in dish and top with soup mixture.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine 1/2 bag of chips with all other ingredients except cheese. Put in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Top with cheese and remaining chips. Bake until cheese melts and casserole is warm about 45 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzel sticks 3 tablespoons sugar and melted butter. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Cool 1 hour or more.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: In butter saute onions until pale yellow. Place in large casserole. Add remaining ingredients let stand all day. Bake uncovered 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Into medium size bowl sift flour baking powder salt cream of tartar and sugar. With pastry blender cut in shortening until quite fine pieces. Add milk all at once. Stir just until dough follows fork around the bowl. Turn out on lightly floured board and gently knead a few times just to smooth out dough. Pat or roll out to 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Gather scraps of dough. Gently mix together and press out. Cut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes. Gives baking powder a chance to start action and they bake up lighter. Bake in a preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 12 to 16.

title: Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients on High 4 minutes. Stir. Microwave 4 more minutes on High. Stir. Add butter and vanilla. Stir and microwave 1 1/2 minutes. Add soda and stir and pour on greased baking sheet.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream Wesson oil sugar and applesauce. Add baking powder cloves nutmeg cinnamon soda and salt; stir to blend. Mix together flour raisins and nuts; add to batter. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Chop chicken in blender. Place in bottom of baking dish. Mix dressing according to directions on box and spread on top of chicken. Heat soup and milk in saucepan until blended. Pour over dressing. Dot top with butter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until heated approximately 30 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Put Rice Chex in a bowl. In a separate pan mix chocolate chips peanut butter and margarine and melt. Dump over Rice Chex. In a grocery bag put powdered sugar. Dump in mix. Shake well (until all are white).

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Boil sugar syrup and water until it strings (dip spoon in mixture let drip cook until it make a thread-like string). Add peanuts and boil until peanuts turn in color (295\u00b0 on candy thermometer). Remove from heat and add soda mixing well and quickly. Mixture will be foamy. Immediately spread as thin as possible onto large buttered cookie sheet or greased marble slab. After cooled break up into pieces. Store in covered container. Makes 36 servings.

title: Regal Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken drained pineapple grapes celery and peanuts. Stir in tarragon. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice and 2 tablespoons pineapple juice. Gently fold into chicken mixture. Serve on lettuce with parsley or small celery leaves as a garnish. Serves 8.

title: Lady Ashburnham Pickles
instructions: Cut very fine as for relish the cukes peeled and with seeds removed. Add 1/4 cup of salt and let stand overnight. Drain in morning and add onions chopped fine vinegar sugar flour turmeric dry mustard mustard and celery seed. Cook 1 hour and put in hot jars.

title: Perfect Iced Tea
instructions: Steep tea bags in boiling water for 15 minutes.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Boil potato until done. Mash potato (do not add anything). Then add powdered sugar to dough consistency. Roll out to about 1/16-inch thick. Spread peanut butter all over. Roll up and slice. May add food coloring at beginning for color.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Spray 2 loaf pans with Pam. Divide mixture between pans. Top with catsup or barbecue sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and marshmallows in hot water. Add juice from pineapple. Chill until set. Blend mayonnaise and cream cheese. Add pineapple. Beat well with gelatin mixture. Add pecans and whipped cream. Refrigerate until firm. Serve on lettuce.

title: Cantaloupe Pie
instructions: Cut cantaloupe into about 1-inch cubes. Place in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Mix sugar flour and salt and sprinkle over cantaloupe. Then sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with margarine. Bake at 425\u00b0 until thick and brown.

title: Sunday Potatoes
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 50 minutes. I havent found anyone who didnt love this dish. Freezes well also.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Boil shells until done. Mix Ricotta cheese Parmesan cheese and eggs in bowl. Stuff shells with mixture. Line in a 9 x 12- inch baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over stuffed shells and top with cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Let sit for 15 minutes then serve.

title: Filled Mocha Thumbprints
instructions: Reserve 1/4 cup frosting. In large bowl combine remaining frosting graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Blend well. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and immediately roll each ball in ground nuts. With finger make imprint in center of each ball. Place in single layer in 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Bake 30 or 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise salt lemon juice onion juice and pimentos. Add chicken celery and hard-boiled eggs; stir gently to coat. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with grated Cheddar cheese and then top with crumbled potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Yield 8 servings. Excellent when served with spiced peaches and soft rolls. Spice peaches with sprinkles of one or more of your favorite spices cinnamon nutmeg ginger cloves etc.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Blend together first 3 ingredients. Pat in 9 x 14-inch pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Blend 4 eggs 2 cups sugar and 1/2 cup lemon juice. Add 1/4 cup flour and 1/2 teaspoon baking powder; pour over crust and bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fantastic Cheesecake
instructions: Put cottage cheese in blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Add cream cheese and mix until blended and creamy. Blend in sugar then eggs. Add cornstarch flour lemon juice and vanilla. Mix until well blended.

title: No-Name Cake
instructions: Follow directions on cake mix (bake in oblong pan). Let cake cool on serving platter. Beat softened cream cheese. Add milk then package of instant pudding; mix well. Spread on top (not sides) of cooled cake. Spread pineapple over that (not sides). Spread Cool Whip over entire cake. Then place strawberries on Cool Whip after you have washed them. Keep refrigerated.

title: Never Fail Potato Salad
instructions: Cook cubed potatoes in boiling water until tender. Drain well. Mix mayonnaise sugar celery seed vinegar mustard and salt. Add onion celery and sweet pickles. Add mayonnaise mixture to potatoes. Toss lightly to coat mixture. Carefully fold in chopped eggs. Cover tightly and chill. Makes about eight servings.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: *Three level tablespoons of cocoa + 1 tablespoon of oil = 1 square chocolate.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add beaten eggs and buttermilk. Add melted butter and vanilla.

title: Best Fudge
instructions: In a 6 to 8 quart container heat together candy bars broken into pieces marshmallow cream butter vanilla and semi-sweet morsels. In a 4 to 6 quart sauce pan combined granulated sugar and evaporated milk. Let sugar and milk come to a hard boil. Cook stirring constantly for 6 minutes. Pour sugar and evaporated milk over remaining ingredients. Blend until smooth and creamy. Fold in chopped pecans. Pour mixture into a cook tray or jelly roll pan lined with wax paper. Let stand 4 to 6 hours until completely set before removing. Yield 6 pounds fudge.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: *Vegetables Green onions chopped broccoli cauliflower shredded carrots green peppers and whatever you have.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese and add Eagle Brand milk. Blend in lemon juice and vanilla. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Garnish with cherry pie filling and put 1 fresh cherry in center.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Chill in refrigerator before baking. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 16 to 19 minutes. Batter can be frozen or kept tightly covered in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Orange-Buttermilk Shake
instructions: Measure all ingredients into blender; mix on high speed until smooth (or beat all ingredients with rotary beater). Yields 2 servings (about 3/4 cup each).

title: Herb Baked Chicken Breast
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Wash chicken; put in colander to drain and wipe dry with paper towel. Prepare chicken first and set aside. Place chicken in large baking plan flat and pour over chicken. Refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours. Cover with wax paper.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: In large bowl soak bread crumbs in cream. Mix in meat thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients except shortening. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Melt shortening in large skillet. Brown and cook meatballs. Serve meatballs from chafing dish. Keep \seconds\ warm in the oven. Makes 25 servings.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Wash and seed peppers and grind together with the onions. Scald and let set for 5 minutes then scald for the second time and drain. Add sugar vinegar and salt and cook for about 15 minutes to thicken. Pour in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Quick And Easy Rolls
instructions: Mix together. Drop into greased muffin tins. Yields 12 rolls.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in unbaked pie shell. Cook for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 250\u00b0 in a tube pan.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Cut the salt pork into 1-inch pieces and simmer for one hour. Wash and remove the wilted leaves of the cabbage cut into the size you want. Add the cabbage carrots and potatoes to the salt pork. Simmer until vegetables are cooked. With this recipe you can also cook it in 1 pint of milk and 1/4 cup flour to give it creamy sauce. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add buttermilk and vanilla. Melt margarine separately and add dry ingredients. Add egg mixture and pour into small pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until well blended. Pour into freezer can of a 5-quart hand turn or electric freezer. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions. Let ripen at least 1 hour before eating.

title: Scripture Bars
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in large mixing bowl. In another large bowl sift together next 3 ingredients. Chop next 2 ingredients; add with last ingredient to sifted mixture. If entirely too thick to spread add a little bit more of second ingredient. Spread in buttered and lightly floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool on rack before cutting into small bars. Makes about 50.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut the elephant into small bite size pieces. Salt and pepper to taste. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Cook over kerosene fire about 4 weeks at 465\u00b0. This will serve 3800 people. If more are expected 2 rabbits may be added. But do this only in an emergency as most people do not like hare in their stew.

title: Tarragon Chicken And Rice(Serves 4)
instructions: Sprinkle chicken on both sides with salt and pepper. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 6 minutes turning once or until lightly browned but not cooked through. With slotted spoon remove to a plate.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into buttered casserole dish. Bake at 325 \u00b0 for 2 hours. Onion and/or bacon may be added for flavor and I think they greatly improve the beans.

title: Salmon Loaf Supreme
instructions: About 1 hour before serving start heating oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl with fork combine bread crumbs milk eggs salt Tabasco m.s.g. and poultry seasoning until mixed. Add chunks of salmon with fork; mix well. Lightly turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan; smooth off top. Bake for 45 minutes or until firm in center. Turn out. Place right side up on heated platter. Serve sliced with peaches as the garnish and Creamy Pea and Scallion Sauce over each slice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Baby Food Bundt Cake
instructions: Beat oil and sugar together. Add slightly beaten eggs. Add all ingredients together (except flour) then add flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (I bake at 325\u00b0 after about 15 or 20 minutes.)

title: White Chocolate Crispy Treats
instructions: Melt white chocolate in double boiler over medium heat. Add peanut butter. Stir as needed. Remove from heat. Combine nuts and crisp cereal in a bowl. Pour melted chocolate and peanut butter over mixture; stir in marshmallows. Use a teaspoonful to drop small amount of mixture onto wax paper; let cool.

title: Tuna Fish And Egg Bows Salad(Italian)
instructions: Cook bows according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Chop vegetables and mix well with bows salt pepper and paprika. Combine pickles and mayonnaise. Add vegetable mixture. Arrange tuna fish on top. Serve on bed of lettuce. Serves 4 to 6. Preparation time 15 to 20 minutes. Cooking time 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Glazed Chicken Breasts
instructions: In a small bowl thoroughly combine onion soup mix preserves and water; set aside. In an aluminum foil-lined broiler pan arrange chicken breasts and peppers. Top with soup mixture. Broil 20 minutes or until chicken is done turning once while broiling. Serve over hot rice.

title: Scotch Treasure Bar Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo and brown sugar. Add quick oats baking powder and salt. Press into greased or buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Lacy'S Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together thoroughly. Form a loaf and place in loaf pan.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Blend soup and milk in buttered 1 1/2-quart dish and arrange layer of potatoes onion and sauce. Dot top with butter and sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake in 375\u00b0 oven 1 hour and uncover and bake 15 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix together and serve.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Fry ground meat and onions. When done drain off fat and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan or a large casserole dish. Cook potatoes and drain leaving 1/2 cup of water in potatoes. Put butter in potatoes. Add mixed vegetables and mix well. Pour over ground meat mixture. Pour creamed corn over entire mixture. Mix Jiffy cornbread as directed on box. Pour over all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Cheese Crisps(Appetizer)
instructions: Combine butter cheese flour hot sauce and salt. Mix well. Gently fold in Rice Krispies. Shape into walnut size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine and put in greased casserole dish.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Grease bottoms of 12 medium muffin cups. Pour milk over cereal in 2 1/2-quart bowl. Let stand for 2 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened. Divide batter evenly among cups. Bake until brown and firm at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Italian Chili
instructions: Fry the burger sausage onion and green pepper in the butter. When cooked add cumin hot sauce Tabasco and salsa. Simmer for about 30 minutes. Add V-8 juice. Bring to boil and add pasta. Cook until pasta is just tender. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Italian Spaghetti Frittata
instructions: Julienne the green pepper and zucchini. Slice onion thin. Finely chop the garlic. Peel the tomatoes; seed and drain. Beat eggs and Parmesan together. In a 12-inch nonstick omelet pan saute green pepper and onion until onion begins to brown. Add tomatoes and garlic; saute 5 to 10 minutes. Add shrimp zucchini and drained spaghetti. Toss until well mixed. Pour egg and Parmesan mixture over the contents in pan. Cook until eggs begin to set and mixture browns. Slide Frittata onto an oiled plate. Invert pan over the Frittata; flip over and fry on the other side until brown.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar oil and eggs together. Blend in vanilla and sour milk. Sift flour cocoa soda cinnamon cloves and salt together and add to batter mixing well. Blend in zucchini. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chips and nuts over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix and serve cold. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken breasts for 45 minutes with plenty of water. Remove chicken and add bouillon cubes; stir in cream of chicken soup. Mix dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Add milk; mix and put on floured board. Roll to 1/8-inch thickness then cut into 1-inch squares. Drop into pot of boiling broth and cook about 15 minutes. Cover pan and reduce heat for cooking time. Cut up chicken and add to dumplings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add 1 egg at a time continually beating. Add dry ingredients to oil. Mix thoroughly. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. To bake form small balls and place on greased and floured cookie sheet. Press with glass that has been dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 12 to 13 minutes or until edges are brown.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Mix all together (soften ice cream). Pour into pan and freeze. Can serve with chocolate sauce. Great for childrens party.

title: Eggnog Pie
instructions: Combine graham crackers and 1/4 cup sugar; add gradually to softened butter; stir in water. Press into pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Soak gelatin in 1/4 cup of the milk for 5 minutes. Scald rest of milk. Separate eggs; beat yolks slightly; add 1/3 cup sugar and salt. Pour scalded milk over them gradually while stirring. Return to heat and cook stirring until custard coats spoon. Remove from heat and add gelatin; stir until dissolved. Beat egg whites stiff; fold into custard; add brandy and nutmeg. Chill until thickened. Pour into crust. Chill until set and top with whipped cream.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix and store in airtight container. To serve add 3 tablespoons of mix in a cup of boiling water.

title: Microwave Autumn Soup
instructions: Mix ground beef onion and celery in 5-quart casserole. Microwave on High (100%) until ground beef loses its pink color 5 to 7 minutes stirring after half the cooking time.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Mix all other ingredients in 5-quart saucepan. Add ground beef and cook until cabbage is tender then drain. Take 1/4 cup of mix and place in corner of one egg roll wrapper. Roll wrapper to corner. Fold over opposite ends. Continue rolling. Dab water on edges to seal. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Chickpeas With Tahini (Ground Sesame Seed)
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender. Mix until chickpeas are smooth. Store hummus in covered container in refrigerator. Serve well chilled. Garnish with chopped parsley. More garlic may be added if desired. Thin with additional lemon juice if served as dip with chips.

title: Super Easy Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake in greased muffin pan about 2/3 full at 425\u00b0 until lightly brown. The dough can be made ahead of time and refrigerated.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick margarine; mix with graham crackers. Spread and pack in 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill. Beat 2 eggs 2 sticks margarine (soft) and powdered sugar. Spread over crust and slice bananas until covered. Spread drained pineapple over bananas. Top with Cool Whip; sprinkle nuts. Place a cherry on each serving or cutting size; drizzle with syrup over top. Serves 16 to 20.

title: Silver Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar salt and baking powder in mixing bowl. Add Crisco and first cup milk called for in the recipe. Beat vigorously by hand or electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes. Add egg whites additional 1/3 cup milk and lemon flavoring. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. Pour into two 9-inch layer pans which have been greased with Crisco and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Orange Rice And Chicken
instructions: To start take whole chicken and boil in about 8 to 10 cups of water and chicken bouillon cubes; makes broth. Have this ready to go before beginning rest of recipe.

title: Smothered Okra
instructions: Simmer onion and pepper in oil for approximately 5 minutes. Add okra then tomato sauce. Let simmer; cover for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls(Makes Approximately 50)
instructions: Combine all ingredients with hands until well blended. Shape into small balls and bake on cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve warm. Freezes well.

title: Party Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese together. Add pimentos green pepper onion Worcestershire sauce lemon juice cayenne and salt. Mix well. Chill for 1 hour. Shape into a ball and roll into finely chopped pecans.

title: Butter Gooey Cake
instructions: Mix with electric mixer until creamy. Pour on top of cake. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with xxx when cool.

title: Reuben Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and warm on Medium power in microwave until cheese melts (not too hot; do it slowly). Serve with rye crackers or pumpernickel bread.

title: Caramel Chews Candy
instructions: Melt caramels and cream in double boiler or microwave. Gradually add other ingredients and drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper. Makes two dozen.

title: Taco Pie(Sandy Kartheiser)
instructions: Separate rolls; pat them around pie tin. Press chips into dough. Brown meat. Drain grease. Add seasoning plus water. Bring to boil and simmer. Blend in sour cream and add to pie crust. Sprinkle grated cheese and more corn chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Mashed Potatoes
instructions: In large mixing bowl mash hot potatoes. When all lumps are removed add cream cheese in small pieces and then butter. Beat well until cheese and butter are both melted and well mixed. Mix in sour cream. To the milk add eggs and onions. Add to the potato mixture along with the salt and pepper. Beat well until fluffy. Place in a greased casserole dish and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add vanilla and combine flour baking powder salt and soda. Combine spread and yogurt. Add dry ingredients and strawberry mixture to creamed mixture (beginning and ending with dry ingredients). Pour into a loaf pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Mini Hamburger Loaves
instructions: Combine ingredients and form into mini loaves. Put loaves in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with sauce. Bake.

title: Magical Mayo Cake
instructions: In a large bowl blend all dry ingredients; set aside. In a small bowl blend all wet ingredients and add to dry ingredients mixing well.

title: Aunt Pat'S Frozen Dessert
instructions: Mix peanut butter and maple syrup. Add Rice Krispies. Put half mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread softened ice cream on top of mixture. Put rest of Krispies mixture on top. Freeze. Enjoy!

title: Chicken-Dressing Casserole
instructions: Mix together soup and sour cream. Stir in chicken.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter and brown sugar in bottom of 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Drain pineapple (leave some juice); pour over butter and brown sugar. Mix cake as directed. Pour over pineapple mix. Bake until cake is done (350\u00b0) for about 1 hour. When done turn upside down.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix crust ingredients together and pat in a 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Rinse. Combine ham and 3/4 cup cheese. Combine soup milk and onion. Place 1/2 noodles in bottom of 2-quart dish. Sprinkle 1/2 ham and cheese mixture over noodles. Pour 1/2 soup mixture over ham mixture. Repeat 1 2 3. Sprinkle top with rest of cheese. Dot with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain juice off of canned corn beans and peas. Mix all ingredients together then put into refrigerator. Let set 24 hours before serving.

title: Casserole Of Shrimp
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole dish combine butter and mushrooms 2 to 3 minutes on High in microwave stirring once. Stir in soup soy sauce and white pepper. Microwave on High 3 minutes or until hot. Stir once. Stir in shrimp and sour cream. Cover with lid and cook on Medium in microwave 4 to 5 minutes or until heated. Stir once. Serve over rice.

title: Oriental Marinade For Beef Or Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and blend well. Pour over chicken or steak. Marinate 4 to 6 hours. Turn once during marinating. Grill!

title: Sunday Chicken  Soup
instructions: Saute first 4 ingredients in 1/4 cup butter. Add flour and cook 2 minutes. Heat milk and broth to boiling. Slowly add vegetables. Stir constantly. Add rice pimento chicken and parsley. Simmer until thick.

title: 1St Prize Rice
instructions: Make white sauce in given proportions of milk flour and margarine. Add cheese olives seasoning and grated onion. When cheese is melted pour over rice in casserole and bake half hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Red Snapper
instructions: Combine onion orange juice oil orange peel and salt in greased (12 x 8 x 2-inch) pan. Arrange snapper fillets in this mixture turning to coat evenly. Leave at room temperature for 30 minutes (lightly cover dish). Add nutmeg and pepper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 12 minutes or until fillets flake easily. Baste. Serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Cupcakes
instructions: Mix in large mixing bowl with mixer on high. Mix for 4 to 5 minutes or until smooth. Line muffin pan with bake cups. Pour batter in bake cups (2-inches). Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in the middle comes out clean.

title: Spicy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Boil for 5 minutes. Reduce heat and simmer until mixture thickens. Serve on any meat of your choice. Store unused portion in the refrigerator.

title: Eggplant Bake
instructions: Sprinkle eggplant in colander with 1 1/4 teaspoons salt. Let drain 30 minutes. Place tomatoes cut side down on paper towels. Drain 30 minutes. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in skillet. Saute garlic and onion. Discard garlic; dont break onion into rings. Drain. Rinse eggplant and drain. Brush with oil and broil 5 minutes; turn and repeat. Arrange in alternating layers slightly overlapping. Sprinkle with spices and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 6 servings.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together\tbutter sugar\tand vanilla; add potato chips and pecans. Stir in flour. Form mixture into small balls. Place on cookie sheet and press thin with a glass that has been dipped in sugar and a little flour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 15 minutes until light brown (golden).

title: Pastry For 9-Inch Pie
instructions: Sift flour and salt into a bowl. Cut in shortening using a pastry blender or fork until the pieces are the size of small peas. (For extra tender pastry cut half the shortening into the flour and salt until the mixture looks like cornmeal. Then cut in remaining shortening until the mixture looks like small peas.) Sprinkle 1 tablespoon water over part of mixture. Gently toss with fork; push to side of bowl. Sprinkle next tablespoon of water over dry part; mix lightly. Push to moistened part at side. Repeat until all is moistened. Form into ball. Flatten ball on lightly floured surface. Roll from center to edge until dough is 1/8-inch thick. Fit pastry into 9-inch pie plate. Trim 1/2 to 1-inch beyond edge; fold under and flute. Prick bottom and sides well with a fork. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.

title: Heritage Coleslaw(Serves 8)
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a suitable container toss and refrigerate.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix ingredients. Store in clean jar. To make hot tea add 1 teaspoon to 1 tablespoon mix to a cup of hot water. May be made in microwave very easy. You may reduce sugar and add a small amount of Equal or Sweet N Low.

title: Feta Veggie Pasta
instructions: Soak sun dried tomatoes in warm water for 30 minutes. Cook rotini as directed (al dente). Cook chopped broccoli in microwave on High for 4 minutes. Add red pepper and chopped sun dried tomatoes to broccoli. Cook 1 minute in microwave. Saute chopped garlic in oil until hot. Add vegetables chopped Feta cheese and garlic and oil to rotini. Cover with parsley and serve.

title: Fantastic Apple Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs beating well after each. Stir in milk and apples. Mix dry ingredients and stir in. Add nuts. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Let stand 20 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Turn out and cool on rack.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Put butter sugar and vinegar in a bowl and melt thoroughly. Then add to 3 slightly beaten eggs. Stir well but do not use electric mixer. Add vanilla and pour into an unbaked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 300\u00b0 until set. Do not overcook.

title: Cajun Cabbage
instructions: Put cabbage on top of meat mixture. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes. Cook until cabbage is done then serve.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add sugar lemon juice and pineapple syrup. Then add the rest of the ground up ingredients. Put in refrigerator to set. Excellent for Thanksgiving.

title: Mushrooms-Spinach Casserole
instructions: Wash spinach; cook in small amount of water 3 to 5 minutes. Drain well. Wash and pat dry mushrooms. Slice and saute mushrooms in butter. Combine soup milk 1/2 cup cheese salt and pepper to taste. Heat sauce stirring until smooth and cheese is melted. Layer spinach mushrooms and sauce in greased 1-quart casserole. Top with remaining cheese. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar brown sugar vanilla peanut butter eggs and\twater.\tBeat creamed ingredients for 2 minutes. Mix flour soda and salt in a separate bowl. Add to creamed mixture and beat 1 minute more. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake for 7 to 11 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Hot Panini Sandwiches
instructions: In food processor mix 1 part sun dried tomatoes and 1/4 part water until pasty. Cut Foccaio bread into 4 x 4-inch squares and slice so that you have two 4 x 4-inch sides of bread. Lightly brush bread with olive oil. Spread tomato mixture on the bottom side of bread. Place 2 ounces of chicken breast on top of tomato mixture. Put 2 leaves of fresh basil on chicken broken into small pieces. Put 1 ounce of cheese on top of basil and chicken. Cover with top slice of bread. Grill or bake until cheese is melted.

title: Real Cajun Roux
instructions: Note Always use equal amounts of flour and cooking oil for whatever quantity of roux you desire.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef if not already cooked. Add frozen vegetables and bring to a boil. Lower heat; add remaining ingredients (except tomatoes). Keep a check on the water content and add more as needed. Cook until potatoes and vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes; cook another 15 minutes. Serve with cornbread.

title: Ambrosia Bavarian Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O sugar and salt in boiling water. Stir in orange juice. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until fluffy and light. Stir in whipped topping until well blended. Fold in undrained pineapple and coconut. Pour into a large serving bowl. Chill until firm.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels margarine and 1 cup sugar and press in 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Take Cool Whip cream cheese and sugar; mix and spread on pretzels. Put pineapple and cornstarch in saucepan; bring to a boil until thickens. Spread on top of cream mixture. Chill!

title: Stephen King'S Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast. Add milk sugar salt shortening and half the flour; mix until smooth. Mix in rest of flour until dough is easy to handle. Knead on floured surface until smooth (10 minutes should do it). Put in greased bowl cover with dish towel and let it rise about an hour until double. Divide dough in half shape into loaves. Place in greased loaf pans. Brush with butter and let rise another hour. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 25 to 30 minutes until brown. To test for doneness tap to see if they sound hollow. Brush with butter if you like. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Baked Ham
instructions: The sausage patties should be no more than 1/2 inch thick. They should be cooked slowly so as not to destroy the taste of the spices. Turn often so the sausage will cook all the way through.

title: Pickled Squash
instructions: Combine squash onion and pepper with salt. Let stand 1 hour. Combine sugar vinegar and celery seed; bring to boil. Add squash onion and green pepper; boil 3 minutes. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Blend oil and brown sugar. Stir in egg. Blend flour and baking powder and add to egg mixture. Add vanilla. Pour in greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Cook 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Serve Marshmallow Creme and cream cheese with strawberries sliced apples and orange slices.

title: Lentil Soup Ii
instructions: In soup pot combine lentils beef stock onion carrots celery cloves pepper parsley thyme and ham hock. Bring to boil; turn down to simmer. Cook covered 35 minutes or until lentils are tender. Remove ham hock and set aside.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer 1 can refried beans mixed with salsa or taco sauce and sour cream mixed with taco seasoning. Top with onion pepper cheese tomatoes black olives or whatever you choose. Dip in unseasoned taco chips.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until well blended. Pour in unbaked pie crust and bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 then bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender.

title: Zesty Chicken 'N Rice
instructions: Place chicken breasts in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour salad dressing over chicken. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Place rice vegetables 1/2 cup French fried onions around and under chicken. Combine bouillon and Italian seasoning; pour over chicken and vegetables. Bake uncovered 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions; bake 2 to 3 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Peel eggs; cut in half. Take out yolks. Mash fine; add all ingredients but paprika. Mix until smooth. (May need a little more liquid if so use pickle juice or salad dressing.) Place mixture back in egg whites and sprinkle with paprika. Can decorate with olives. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Prepare noodles as per package directions. Add all soups but only 1/2 the water required for soups. Heat over low heat until bubbling.

title: Mexicorn Dip
instructions: Drain corn and place in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Serve with tostitos.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Mash potato and cool slightly. Add vanilla and enough powdered sugar to make a pie dough consistency. Roll between wax paper. Spread with peanut butter. Roll up like a jelly roll. Slice.

title: Rum Butter Sweets
instructions: Heat oven at 350\u00b0. Cream margarine; add sugar salt and flavoring and cream well. Add flour gradually. Shape into balls the size of a marble. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press a hole in the center of each ball. Bake 12 to 15 minutes until delicately browned. Fill with Creamy Pecan Filling while warm. Cool before frosting.

title: Blue Ribbon Winner Wacky Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in mixing bowl. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Add strawberry gel and cut up strawberries together. Put in cooled pie shell. Top with Cool Whip. Put strawberries on top to make it look nice.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Melt oleo in a casserole dish. In another bowl mix remainder of ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole with melted oleo. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until sides are brown.

title: Kids Party Punch
instructions: Make Kool-Aid with water and sugar; mix well. Add 7-Up and stir. Garnish with thin slices of orange and/or lemon. Slice thinly so they will float in punch bowl.

title: Main Dish Casserole
instructions: Brown turkey in a little oil. Add 2 cups water and mixed vegies. Throw in the noodles and stir. Cover pot and simmer about 10 minutes. Add the soup mix and more water if it needs it. Let simmer until all the vegies are done. Dont let it suck up all the liquid. Real good with corn bread. Serves 4.

title: Philadelphia Butter Cake
instructions: In a bowl put the cake mix. Melt the butter and pour into cake mix. With a fork mix until it forms a dough. Press mixture into glass baking dish. Mix softened cream cheese confectioners sugar vanilla and eggs. Pour over the cake mixture. Bake 25 to 28 minutes at 325\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Do not let bottom overcook. Cool and enjoy.

title: Crab And Cheese Appetizer
instructions: Combine eggs mayonnaise and pepper; stir in cheese and onions. Gently stir in crab. Bake at 325\u00b0 until puffed and golden. Serve warm with crackers.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Mix browned meat and onion with other ingredients. Top with the remaining Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Pour pudding over top of fruit except bananas. Do not stir in pudding. Let set in fridge for 24 hours. Then cut up bananas. Mix well and serve.

title: Pineapple Party Punch
instructions: In a large punch bowl combine pineapple juice cranberry juice lemonade concentrate sugar and food coloring if used. Just before serving pour in the ginger ale. Garnish with ice ring or serve over ice. Makes 36 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Easy Cheese Bread 2
instructions: Combine biscuit mix and cheese in a large bowl. Combine egg and milk. Add to biscuit mix stirring vigorously for 2 minutes. Spoon into a lightly greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chinese Style Country Ribs
instructions: Combine soy sauce marmalade catsup and garlic. Brush on both sides of ribs. Place in slow cooker. Pour remaining sauce over all. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Chicken, Broccoli And Ziti
instructions: In a large frypan fry and simmer the chicken in 2 tablespoons of butter. When the chicken is 80% cooked remove it from the pan and place it in a large bowl and set aside. In another large pan saute the garlic and onions in 2 tablespoons of butter. Once sauteed add the chicken broth with 1/2 cup of water then add the chicken bouillon parsley and pepper. Simmer until the seasoning has dissolved then add the Velveeta and American cheese. Stir occasionally until the cheese has melted then add the cooked chicken. Simmer and stir occasionally. Cook the broccoli (do not overcook). Add sour cream to the sauce mixture that is simmering. Keep the sauce stirred you dont want to burn it. Cook the ziti in lightly salted water (dont overcook). Drain the ziti however do not rinse. Put ziti back into pot. Pour the sauce mixture into the ziti pot and mix. Pour all into a baking pan; sprinkle top with grated cheese if desired and place the cooked broccoli on top. Bake in preheated oven a 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour uncovered. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Chicken-Sour Cream Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken breasts; cool. Remove chicken from bone. Tear into bite-size pieces. Combine butter and cracker crumbs mixing well. Spoon 1/2 of crumbs into a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Top with chicken. Combine sour cream soup broth salt and pepper. Pour over chicken and top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Creole Jambalaya
instructions: Saute onion green pepper celery and garlic in melted butter. Add shrimp and ham. Fry about 5 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and cook 10 minutes. Stir in rice. Add seasoning and liquid. Bring to boil. Cover; simmer until rice is done about 30 minutes. Serves 4. Use soy sauce if you like.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Sift and measure flour. Add salt and baking soda and sift again. Put aside. Cream butter well; add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately beating until well mixed. Add flavoring. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in greased tube pan.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs until firm; break up into small pieces. Set aside. Marinate chicken pieces with 1/2 soy sauce cornstarch and 1 tablespoon water for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Heat oil in frying pan (medium-high heat). Fry chicken pieces separating pieces at the same time for 2 1/2 minutes or until chicken is cooked. Set aside. Using the same frying pan stir-fry onion green onion and frozen peas for 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low; add cooked rice soy sauce and oyster sauce. Mix and stir; add cooked egg and chicken. Mix well. Makes 4 servings.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix by hand. Melt butter. Mix all ingredients except eggs. Beat egg slightly and add to mixture. Add melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until set in center.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Mix ground beef sausage regular rice onion garlic 1 can tomato sauce and seasonings in bowl. Prepare cabbage by simmering in boiling water until tender. Remove core before placing in water. Roll meat mixture into sausage link shape and wrap with cabbage leaves. Place seam side down in heavy baking pan. Cover with sauerkraut and juice and second can of tomato sauce. Add enough water to partially cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours. Cover loosely with foil for first 2 hours. Makes 20 to 24 rolls. Reheats well.

title: Dorothy'S Old Fashioned Saltwater Dills
instructions: Bring to boil. Place cucumbers in sterilized jars wide-mouth if possible. In each jar place a clove of fresh garlic hot pepper if desired a fresh grape leaf and fresh green dill. Pour the boiling brine over the cucumbers. Seal tightly and store about 30 days.

title: Easy Brown Hot Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Combine flour dash of salt sugar and baking powder; beat. Add butter and eggs. Add enough flour so dough will be easy to handle and thoroughly knead the dough. Place dough in a greased bowl and allow dough to rise. Punch it down and it is ready to cook. You may spoon batter into greased muffin pans or cut rolls out. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Finger Steaks
instructions: Trim round steaks and slice in desired size. Dip into egg and milk mixture then roll in Frosted Flakes and flour (mixed together just enough flour to make Frosted Flakes stick). Fry in butter (using margarine or oil gives a different taste).

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour and nuts; press into bottom of dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Salsa Picante
instructions: In medium bowl combine ingredients; mix well. Cover. Chill. Serve with tortilla chips. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Batter Rolls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl (use mixer). Beat in egg. Mix yeast and 2 cups flour separately. Add separate mix to liquid and beat with mixer until smooth. Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour (or enough for a very soft dough). Cover bowl with towel and let rise for about 30 minutes or until doubled. Punch down and place in well-greased muffin pan. Let rise until doubled about 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Country Dinner Hamburger And Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger with several strips of bacon cut up. In separate bowl cut up onion. Add beans and remaining ingredients. Add hamburger and bacon; stir well. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Combine the flour salt and sugar in a medium bowl. Beat the eggs and add the buttermilk butter and vanilla. Blend in the dry ingredients. Pour into the pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well. Sprinkle 1/4 cup pecans in an oiled 7-cup ring mold and press cheese mixture into mold. Chill until firm. Unmold on platter and pat remaining pecans onto cheese ring. Garnish with parsley sprigs. Serve on crackers with strawberry preserves.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: You can prepare this early in the day or even weeks ahead and freeze it.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts
instructions: Marinate chicken overnight. Brush with olive oil before grilling.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix one stick margarine with graham cracker crumbs. Pat out into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix sugar eggs and 2 sticks margarine; beat until thick. If needed add another cup of sugar. Spread over top of crumb mixture. Slice bananas on top of mixture. Spread pineapple over bananas. Mix nuts with Cool Whip; spread over pineapple. Top with cherries. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Shrimp Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients to form a spread. Cut Pepperidge Farm French loaves into thin slices and spread mixture evenly on bread. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. May be made ahead and frozen. Increase baking time 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hungarian Cheese Dumplings
instructions: Place cheese in bowl. Add eggs. Mix well. Add salt and flour and mix. On floured board knead lightly until smooth and it doesnt stick to hands. Drop by spoonfuls into boiling salted water. Cook until dumplings rise to the top or until tender about 10 minutes. Drain. Fry onion in butter; pour over dumplings. Serve with sour cream.

title: Silver Diet Dinner For Two
instructions: Place 1 chicken piece and half of the remaining ingredients on each of 2 foil squares. Seal tightly. Place in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Elderberry Crisp
instructions: Place the elderberries in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix together the next 7 ingredients. Crumble over berries. Pour the melted oleo over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown on top. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Chicken Sopa
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and place in a large greased casserole dish or 2 smaller ones. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

title: French Custard Toast
instructions: Beat eggs slightly in a shallow pan and add a dash of salt. Cut bread diagonally about 1 to 1 1/2 inches thick. Place bread in egg mixture and soak for 15 minutes on each side. Heat oleo in a large skillet and fry bread slowly (about 5 minutes each side) until brown. Serve hot. You may use syrup honey or jam over bread or sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Better if made a day ahead.

title: Applesauce Cake (Chocolate)
instructions: Mix thoroughly; pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven 1 hour.

title: Fruit Delight
instructions: Place fruit in large bowl. Combine vanilla mix Tang and pineapple juice. Pour over fruit and stir gently. Chill before serving.

title: Banana Boat
instructions: Keeping the banana in its skin make 2 cuts forming a \V\ opening along the length of the banana. Put it aside. It will be used later.

title: Rise And Shine
instructions: Cook sausage until done (well browned). Slice bread about 1/2-inch thick and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Drain sausage and spoon over bread (reserve 1/2 cup). Now beat eggs and milk together; pour this over the sausage and bread. Top with remaining sausage and cheese. Bake 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Roll in pecans (crushed). Add Tabasco sauce if desired.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Place 1/2 of Tater Tots in bottom of 2-quart casserole. Brown hamburger meat. Add onion and cook until done; drain. Add cream of mushroom soup and water. Mix well. Add grated cheese. Pour over Tater Tots and place remaining Tater Tots on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly and browned on top.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour cocoa milk 2 egg yolks and 1 whole egg (save other egg whites for meringue). Cook until thick on medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla and butter. Pour into a baked pie shell. Top with meringue. Brown in oven. Cool. Serve.

title: Oven Barbecued Meat Balls
instructions: In a bowl moisten the bread crumbs with the milk and combine them with the meat salt and pepper. Shape the mixture into 24 meat balls and place them in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In another bowl combine the remaining ingredients to make the barbecue sauce. Pour the sauce over the meat balls and bake them covered at 475\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Microwave Texas Meatballs And Rice
instructions: Mix ground beef egg chili powder salt and pepper. Shape into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls. Place in 2 quart casserole. Microwave on High until meatballs are set and lose the pink color (4 to 7 minutes) rearranging meatballs after half the cooking time. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover. Microwave on High until mixture is\tbubbly\tand onions are tender (4 to 7 minutes). Stir after half the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender (2 to 3 minutes).

title: Seven Layer Torte Cake
instructions: Make instant pudding as directed per package. Mix the flour butter sugar and nuts together. Press the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch flat pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until done. Cool for 30 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Bring 8 cups water to a boil.\tAdd tea bags and remove from heat. Keep covered for 5 minutes. Add sugar. Boil 4 cups water. Add cloves and simmer for 5 minutes. Mix tea and clove water with orange juice lemon juice and pineapple juice. Makes about 1 gallon. Serve warm.

title: Raisin-Cinnamon Batter Loaf
instructions: Mix together 1 1/2 cups of the flour sugar salt cinnamon and undissolved yeast in large bowl. Combine milk water and butter in saucepan. Heat to very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Gradually add to flour-yeast mixture. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs and 1/2 cup of the flour; beat 2 minutes at high speed. Stir in raisins and enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Cover; let rise until doubled about 50 minutes. Stir down. Turn into 2 well-greased 1 1/2-quart casseroles. Cover; let rise in warm place until double about 40 minutes. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until done. Remove from casseroles; cool on racks. Makes 2.

title: Okra And Tomatoes
instructions: Saut bell pepper and onion in bacon drippings until onions are translucent. Add the remaining ingredients and stir gently. Cover and simmer until okra is tender about 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole Supreme
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water. Do not overcook. Drain. Mix together soup sour cream salt pepper carrots and onions. Mix broccoli in the sauce. Melt butter. Mix in bread crumbs and spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Orange-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Stir in frozen orange juice. Add pineapple (with juice). Drain oranges; add. Mix all together. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Dried Tomato Focaccia
instructions: * Chives (1/4 cup) oregano (3/4 teaspoon) and rosemary (1/2 teaspoon may be substituted for dried herbs. Also as a variation substitute 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour.

title: Rich Party Nut Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast a little in milk. Add remaining milk and beaten egg yolks. Mix shortening into flour and salt. Add liquid to make a soft dough. Chill thoroughly. Roll out as pie crust on sugar sprinkled lightly floured board and cut into pieces about 3 x 4-inches. Make a paste of the walnuts egg whites sugar and salt. Spread onto the dough and make into tiny rolls. Place on cookie sheets and bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert(Serves 10 To 12)
instructions: Cook pudding as directed and cool. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with whole Oreos. Spread cooled pudding on top. Chill. Top with Cool Whip and crushed Oreos.

title: Chocolate Icebox Cake
instructions: Combine and press in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Golden Baked Potatoes
instructions: Quarter potatoes and cut in small chunks. Moisten with water. Mix cheese salt pepper and flour in a paper sack. Drop potatoes into sack and shake to coat. Pout coated potatoes in shallow baking pan. Melt butter and drizzle over potatoes. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0 turning once after 30 minutes.

title: Orange Peel Cup
instructions: Cut one orange in half remove and eat the pulp. Fill the cavity with an egg or hamburger. Place on a bed of coals and cook until done.

title: Raspberry Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in 10-inch baking dish in oven. Mix flour 1 cup sugar and baking powder. Stir in milk and mix until blended. Spoon batter over melted margarine. Heat berries with 2 tablespoons sugar just until hot. Pour over batter in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crust is golden. Serve warm.

title: Turkey Medallions With Orange Teriyaki Sauce(Light And Easy)
instructions: In a 1-quart saucepan over medium heat in 2 teaspoons corn oil cook celery onion salt and ginger until tender. In medium bowl mix turkey vegetable mix horseradish and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley until blended. With slightly dampened hands shape turkey mixture into 8 medallions.

title: Friendship
instructions: Lay chicken on its back on a flat work surface. Using a sharp knife make a cut between the leg. Bend the leg away from the body and press fingertips into the back of the joint to pop the joint loose. Continue to cut leg away from breast then make a cut through the joint connecting the drumstick and the thigh. A thin line of fat over the joint will act as a cutting guide.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Salt pepper garlic powder and thyme to taste. Cook spinach and drain very well. Combine all ingredients and roll into balls using about 1 teaspoon mixture for each. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes on greased cookie sheet. Remove from cookie sheet at once and drain on paper towels. Serve hot. Makes 75 balls.

title: Hawaiian Pie
instructions: Slice bananas and spread over crust. Mix condensed milk lemon juice and sugar; spread over bananas. Spread crushed pineapple over condensed milk mixture. Spread Cool Whip over pineapple. Sprinkle chopped nuts and cherries on top. Refrigerate to set. Serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocados to a lumpy consistency. Mix all ingredients except the garlic. Stick the toothpicks with garlic into the mixture. Refrigerate. Remove toothpicks with garlic before serving.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Blend egg yolks and milk. Stir in the pancake mix. Continue stirring until smooth. Fold in the corn. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into mixture. Pour cooking oil into an iron skillet a half to 1-inch deep and heat. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Cook until golden brown on both sides.

title: Molasses Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar and oleo into very fine crumbs. Set 1 1/2 cups aside to use as topping. In large bowl combine Brer Rabbit boiling water and baking soda; add the crumbs and mix by hand very well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Turkey-Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Use half of seasoning mix in rice mix. Combine all ingredients and let stand overnight in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 15.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef egg salt and pepper together. Shape into meatballs. Combine Rice-A-Roni seasoning packet with 2 1/2 cups of water; pour over meat. Cover and let simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Put in 9 x 9-inch greased and floured pan.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread in baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Classic Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare pasta as directed. Combine pasta meat spaghetti sauce and 2 c. of cheese in large bowl and mix well. Turn into greased 9x13 pan. Cover and bake 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Uncover and top with remaining cheese. Bake additional 10 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Angel Hair Primavera
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Place pasta in large serving bowl.

title: Jello Pies
instructions: Place can of milk in freezer until cold. Combine eggs sugar and pineapple juice. Cook over medium to low heat until eggs are cooked approximately 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add jello to mixture while still hot. Cool. Take can of milk from freezer. Beat on high for 5 to 6 minutes. Fold in with cooked cooled mixture. Pour into graham cracker crusts. Refrigerate. Be sure congealed before cutting. A cool dessert for summer.

title: Foiled Pot Roast(Method:  Foil)
instructions: Sear both sides of roast over hot coals. Place in a large piece of heavy-duty foil. Add sliced potatoes onions carrots and any other vegetables. Season. Seal in double foil. Cook on hot coals about 1 hour; turn occasionally.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup of sugar crushed pretzels and melted oleo. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Lake'S Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute onions peppers and celery in bacon drippings. Add stewed tomatoes and sliced whole skinless tomatoes garlic and spices. Add 1/2 cup water and let simmer for at least 20 minutes. Add shrimp and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes or until shrimp are done. Serve over hot white rice. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken (add no salt). Skin and debone. Reserve 2 cups chicken broth. In a 9 x 13-inch pan place half of chicken. Mix 1 cup chicken broth and cream of chicken soup. Pour over chicken. Put remaining chicken on top of soup. Take the other cup of broth and mix with the cream of mushroom soup. Pour over the next chicken layer. (If you are using mushrooms use half each time with chicken layers.) Melt butter and mix with the stuffing. Put over top of second soup layer. Cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cake mix cooking oil and water; mix. Add eggs; mix. Add peanut butter; mix well. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Press crisscross on each cookie with fork prongs that have been dipped in water.

title: Crab English Muffins
instructions: Cream butter and cheese in bowl. Add garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce. Mix in crab meat. Spread mixture over toasted halves of muffins. Place on cookie sheet. (You can now freeze well wrapped until needed.) Heat oven and bake until hot. Cut in quarters to serve.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Roll chicken in margarine. Roll in mixture of bread crumbs and cheese. Place in Pyrex dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until crispy and browned. Serves 4.

title: Fried Tofu
instructions: To Make Sauce Boil\tthe dashi broth with carrots celery and onion until\tthe vegetables are tenderly cooked. Add soy sauce and thicken it with a little cornstarch (about 1 1/2 tablespoons) mixed with about 2 tablespoons water.

title: Roasted Root Vegetable Soup
instructions: Place the vegetables broth 2 cups of water and celery seeds in a soup pot and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cover loosely and reduce heat to simmer until vegetables are very tender 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a food processor and puree until very smooth. This may have to be done in batches. Return the soup to the pot. Add salt and pepper to taste and cook over medium heat until just heated through. Taste and adjust the seasonings if necessary. Serve garnished with parsley.

title: Lemon Torte
instructions: Beat the first 3 ingredients together until stiff. On brown paper or parchment lined cookie sheet shape meringue into shells either with pastry bag or spoon. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Cook until thick; take off stove and add lemon juice coconut and butter. Blend well. Pour into a baked pie shell. Add meringue made with the 2 egg whites.

title: Banana Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. In a separate bowl combine flour baking soda and salt. Add bananas and half of flour mixture. Mix well. Add chips and nuts; then rest of flour. Drop on greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake for about 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes a soft cookie and a large batch.

title: Sausage Stars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine sausage cheeses salad dressing olives and pepper. Grease mini muffin tin and line with wonton wrapper. Brush with oil. Bake 5 minutes until brownish. Remove from tins place on cookie sheet and fill with mixture. Bake until bubbly.

title: Mountain Mama
instructions: Mix together the flour butter and pecans. Press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: King Ranch Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine soups chicken broth and tomatoes; set aside. Oil a 3-quart casserole. Layer half of tortilla pieces half of chicken half of onion and half of cheese in the casserole. Pour half of chicken broth mixture over layers. Repeat layers of tortillas chicken and onion then pour remaining chicken broth over top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Shirley'S Christmas Candy
instructions: Beat melted chocolate and peanut butter together. Add Rice Krispies. Mix well. Add peanuts and mix well. Add marshmallows. Mix well. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Cook over medium heat stirring until mixture forms a ball. Knead lightly until smooth. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Mix ingredients well in large bowl. Cover and put in refrigerator. Keeps for a week. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Do not wait for them to rise. Bake at about 400\u00b0 until brown. Makes 3 dozen. If you want to bake some as soon as you make them they do not have to be refrigerated first. Bake a few or as many as you choose at one time and put remaining batter back in refrigerator.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl; mix well. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sausage And Pepperoni Pizza Pie(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Fry sausage in heavy medium skillet over medium heat until cooked through turning occasionally. Drain. Dice sausage. Dust one side of pie crust with 1 teaspoon of flour. Gently transfer crust into pan. Arrange half of Mozzarella over bottom of crust. Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce over Mozzarella. Sprinkle half of Jack cheese atop sauce. Drizzle 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce over cheese. Repeat layering with remaining Mozzarella 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce remaining Jack cheese pepperoni and sausage. Sprinkle with olives and drizzle with remaining 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce. Top with remaining pie crust. Pinch edges of crust together to seal. Crimp edges to make decorative border. Bake until golden brown about 40 minutes. Let pie stand 30 minutes before serving.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Caramel Rolls(Made With Frozen Bread Dough.)
instructions: These light tender sweet rolls feature a rich caramel topping made with brown sugar and heavy cream.

title: Mocha-Almond Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place chocolates margarine or butter and instant coffee in a large microwave-safe bowl. Cook on High (100% power) for 2 minutes until margarine is melted. Remove from oven; stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir in sugar and corn syrup. Beat in eggs sour cream and vanilla. Pour into pie shell; sprinkle with almonds. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from the center comes out clean. Cool on rack. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in pan. Mix together sugar flour and milk. Pour peaches in margarine. Add sugar mixture. Bake until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Heat soup. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add to soup along with all the other ingredients. Pour into loaf or mold pan and chill overnight. Serve with crackers or celery. \Excellent with Triscuits.\

title: Beet Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add other ingredients. Use any desired salad dressing (optional). Very good.

title: Turkey Crunch
instructions: Combine all ingredients except noodles and put into greased casserole. Sprinkle noodles over casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pork Chops And Hash Browns
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Sprinkle pork chops with seasoning salt and brown in hot skillet. Set aside. In large mixing bowl combine soup sour cream black pepper potatoes and cheese. In 9 x 13 baking dish layer potato mixture with pork chops on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Cover with onion rings and return to oven for 5 more minutes. Serves 6.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Peel and thinly slice apples and fill a crock-pot. Cook on low 18 hours. Stir and mash using an electric mixer. Add sugar cinnamon and cloves. Cook 4 hours longer on low. Put in clean hot jars and seal. Makes about 9 cups of apple butter.

title: Buttermilk Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together the sugar butter salt vanilla and egg. Add the buttermilk-soda mixture with flour to first mixture. Mix just enough to be able to handle the dough. Roll out and cut. Sprinkle with sugar; place on cookie sheets. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Cookies
instructions: Cut 36 large marshmallows in half. Combine all ingredients except marshmallows and mix. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Put marshmallows on center of cookies and bake 2 minutes longer. Cool and frost if desired.

title: Lemon Jello Salad
instructions: Make Jell-O according to package directions; let set. Whisk. Add can of crushed pineapple and marshmallows. Whip the cream. Add to Jell-O mixture. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Stir together and cook in crock-pot or oven for 4 hours at 275\u00b0. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Ginger Dipping Sauce
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Makes about 3/4 cup.

title: Pinwheel Coffee Cake
instructions: Sift flour and measure out 3 cups. Scald milk in small saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar salt and shortening. Cool until lukewarm. Pour water into bowl; sprinkle yeast in and stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm mixture and eggs; mix well. Add flour 1/2 cup at a time until mixture is a soft pliable ball. Sprinkle remaining flour on board and knead mixture until firm. Place in greased bowl and cover with dish towel. Keep in a warm place and let rise until double in bulk. Put back on floured board and knead. Make 3 balls of dough the same size. Add fruits and nuts at this point. Make balls into long cones. Place side by side and braid as hair. Place in a greased bread pan. Let rise again for approximately 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Make a glaze of milk and powdered sugar; drizzle over coffee cake while still warm.

title: Fruit Cocktail Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Sift flour and measure. Add salt baking powder and sift again. Cream butter or margarine. Add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time then flour alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Then melt 1/2 cup butter or margarine in pan or baking dish. Add brown sugar and smooth over sides and bottom of pan.

title: Blueberry Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add remaining ingredients but do not overmix. Cook on a greased griddle.

title: Pork Chop And Rice Casserole
instructions: Layer in 13 x 9-inch pan rice onion green pepper pork chops and consomme. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until liquid is cooked away.

title: Baby Meat Balls
instructions: Mix eggs onion and 1/2 package seasoning in blender. Add to beef and mix well. Roll in meat balls the size of a large marble. Put in shallow pan and bake until they are cooked through. Put tomato sauce in pan with the other half of seasoning; heat. As the meat balls are cooked put them in tomato sauce and cook as long as you want to cook down the sauce.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs. Spoon into a greased baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Baked Custard
instructions: Heat milk until hot but not boiling. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Add sugar and salt. Add milk slowly stirring all the time. Mix in vanilla. Pour into a baking pan. Sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until a knife stuck in the center comes out clean.

title: Greek-Style Yogurt
instructions: Dissolve the milk powder in the milk and simmer 5 minutes. Pour into a heatproof bowl and let cool until you can just dip your finger into it. Add the yogurt and stir. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; wrap it in a thick towel and leave it in a warm place for 5 to 6 hours. Alternatively you can make the yogurt in a wide-necked vacuum bottle.

title: Zucchini Casserole
