instructions: Cook zucchini in boiling water. Brown hamburger and onion. Add seasonings rice and soup. Drain zucchini well. In large casserole place 1/2 of the zucchini 1/2 meat 1/2 cottage cheese 1/2 shredded cheese. Repeat layers. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter eggs and flour until smooth. Add lemon extract and 7-Up a little bit at a time until it is all mixed in and smooth. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Vanilla Crescents
instructions: Combine the flour sugar and almonds in a food processor. Cut in the butter. Turn the mixture onto a pastry board and quickly knead into a smooth ball. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Laham Be-Ajeen(Meat On Pasta)
instructions: Thaw bread dough. Let rise for about one hour (follow package instructions). Form and cut dough into disks of about 2-inches in diameter and 2-inches thick. Grease your fingertips with the olive oil. Press each dough piece into 1/2-inch thick disks. Place dough disks in a lightly greased baking sheet about 2-inches apart. Set aside in a warm place. Mix lamb (or beef) onion green pepper tomato tomato sauce Tahini spice and salt. Spread one to two tablespoons of the meat mixture on the dough disks. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until dough is golden brown. Let cool for few minutes then transfer to a platter. Serve warm or cold.

title: Bran Loaf
instructions: Mix cereal raisins brown sugar and milk well and let stand for 1 hour or longer. Then add the flour and baking powder. Put in a small greased loaf pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or less until done. When cool refrigerate. Doubles well.

title: Vegetable Squares
instructions: For crust unroll crescent rolls; gently pat into rectangle on cookie sheet. Bake according to package directions. Cool on wire rack. Meanwhile in a small mixing bowl stir together the cream cheese salad dressing and dill weed or basil. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly over the cooled crust. Sprinkle with desired chopped vegetables and shredded cheese. Gently press vegetables and cheese into the cream cheese mixture. Chill 1 hour before cutting into squares.

title: Banana-Praline Muffins
instructions: In a small bowl stir together brown sugar sour cream and the pecans and set aside. To the bananas add egg sugar and oil. Stir until well blended. Add Bisquick stirring just until moistened.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter oil and sugars. Add eggs then dry ingredients. Mix well.

title: Hot Or Cold Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Bake potatoes on greased cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Stir occasionally while baking so they dont stick. Add all other ingredients in bowl and stir together. Serve warm or cold. Makes 6 servings.

title: Buttery Crunchy Microwave Fish Fillets
instructions: Pour butter over single layer of fish in a 10-inch Corning Ware or any microwavable dish. Pour lemon juice over fish. Sprinkle with parsley and all of the Ritz cracker crumbs. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Microwave 5 minutes on High. Rotate dish and cook 6 more minutes on High.

title: Mexican Bean Dip
instructions: Smooth beans on large plate. Mix sour cream and taco seasoning together. Add additional seasoning to your taste mild or strong. Layer all over beans. Add lettuce tomatoes cheese all by layering. (Kids love this dip.)

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Stir in lemonade concentrate. Add cold water and cranberry juice. Place in large punch bowl with two trays of ice cubes or a molded ice ring. Pour punch over ice. Slowly pour in chilled ginger ale. Makes 25 servings.

title: Preacher'S Casserole
instructions: Brown onions and celery. Add ground turkey and brown. Add salt pepper chili powder soups and water. Add chow mein noodles. Sprinkle remaining noodles on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mushroom-Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Bring water and salt to boil in large Dutch oven; stir in macaroni. Return to a rapid boil and cook 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Rinse in cold water. Drain. Combine macaroni soup mayonnaise cheese and mushrooms. Add pimentos. Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish. Combine cracker crumbs and butter. Sprinkle evenly over macaroni mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Lightly beat eggs sugar and oil. Add mixture to dry mixture. Fold in zucchini vanilla and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in greased loaf pan. Check with toothpick.

title: Crustless Quiche
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onions in shortening. Mix all in bowl with whisk; reserve 2 ounces of the cheese. Pour into greased 9 or 10-inch pie plate; bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and spread remaining cheese on top; bake 5 minutes more.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa. Add milk. Let come to a hard boil. Boil 2 minutes. Reduce heat to cool then add 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Beat until it loses its gloss and starts to get hard. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Put brown sugar butter and milk in saucepan; cook on low heat until sugar dissolves. Boil 5 minutes. Let cool 2 minutes. Pour into mixing bowl. Add confectioners sugar and mix well. Add vanilla and more milk if needed.

title: Festive Cranberry Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine milk and lemon juice; mix well. Stir in the pineapple cranberry sauce banana marshmallows and pecans. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Freeze overnight. Cut into squares. Makes 12-16 servings.

title: Caramel Sauce
instructions: Mix brown sugar and flour together; add water. Bring to a boil and cook until thickened. Add margarine. Serve over plain cake hot.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut 1 large steak in cubes and flour. Brown in oil. Add onion and garlic; brown slightly. Add mushrooms soup and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until done; cool 20 minutes. Add about 1/4 cup sour cream. Serve on noodles. Serves 4.

title: Daiquiri Fruit Salad
instructions: In large saucepan bring liquid to boiling. Stir in gelatin to dissolve. Remove from heat; stir in limeade concentrate and rum. Using wire whisk or electric mixer blend in mayonnaise. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in pineapple whipped cream and bananas. Spoon into 12-cup fluted tube pan. Chill until firm. Makes 10 to 12 servings. Recipe may be halved for 6-cup fluted tube pan.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: *(You can use hash browns instead of OBrien potatoes but add 1/2 cup of minced onion.)

title: Oat Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients well and spread in 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes; cool. Cut into 1 x 2-inch squares. Refrigerate 1 hour and enjoy!

title: Ellen'S Boiled Cookies
instructions: Mix milk margarine sugar and cocoa. Bring to a boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add oats peanut butter vanilla and pecans. Mix well. Drop by teaspoons on buttered wax paper. Cool.

title: Italian Pasta Salad With Salami
instructions: In shaker or jar mix light-tasting olive oil fresh or frozen lemon juice garlic (minced fine) parsley flakes dried basil salt and pepper. Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain rinse in cold water and drain again. Seed green red and yellow peppers and slice into small chunks. Cut salami into cubes. Slice pepperoni lengthwise then crosswise in thin slices. Cut cheese (preferably part skim) in bite-sized cubes.

title: Coconut Pie(Very Old Recipe)
instructions: Stir constantly over boiling water until thickenedabout 8 minutes. Cool. Whip 1 cup cream. Pour cooled custard mixture into whipped cream. Pour into meringue pie shell. Be sure all pockets of meringue are filled. Let stand in refrigerator several hours. Serve with fresh strawberries or any seasonable fruit.

title: Raspberry Sauce
instructions: In blender puree raspberries sugar and Grand Marnier or orange juice.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Stir gelatine into cold water. Stir jello (any flavor) into boiling water. Combine both mixtures into pan about 10 x 12-inch. Chill then slice. May be eaten like cookie.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Saute onions with butter and margarine. Put 1/2 into bottom of dish. Layer macaroni cheese and potatoes (2 layers). Top with rest of onion mix. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Puff Pastry
instructions: Mix everything together. Chill for several hours or overnight. Roll out dough into a thin rectangle. Spread jar of mincemeat over 1/2 rectangle. Add nuts if desired. Roll up like a jelly roll. Make slits across top of roll. Bake on a cookie sheet for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0; then for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats and cut up margarine let stand 20 minutes. Add sugars and eggs. Sift together flour salt soda nutmeg and cinnamon. Add to oatmeal mixture. Add vanilla. Bake at 350 for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Sunshine Barbecue Chicken
instructions: You will need 1 large size Reynolds oven bag (14 x 20-inch).

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes or use sliced or diced leftovers. Put in casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Mulled Apple Cider
instructions: Boil 2 sticks cinnamon cloves and 2 cups apple cider. Boil spices for 15 minutes. Strain spices and add 1/2 can frozen orange juice to remaining hot cider and serve.

title: Chicken In Carrot And Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Brown chicken in oil and remove from pan. Add mushrooms and carrots and cook until tender. Mix in soup and sherry scraping bottom of pan. Put chicken back into pan and simmer 15 minutes or until tender.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Peel and cut up apples. Put in pan. Top with sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Top with cobbler dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mike'S And Other'S Famous Chili
instructions: Fry ground sirloin 1 onion 1 stalk celery and chili powder in skillet until almost done. Add salt and pepper to taste. Then mix in crock-pot with rest of ingredients.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onions bell pepper garlic and parsley in butter until tender. Add crabmeat and saute for approximately 20 minutes. Soak bread in milk. Add this to crab mixture and stir. Cut off heat and add beaten eggs. Salt and pepper to taste and stir. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish and top with bread crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Mushroom Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat mushroom soup and water on stove until warm. Add chicken breasts; bake 30 minutes on each side.

title: Cream Of Tomato Soup
instructions: In a saucepan simmer tomatoes onion bay leaf sugar and 1/2 teaspoon salt for 10 minutes. Put through food mill and set aside. In same saucepan melt butter; stir in flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Add milk. Cook and stir until thickened. Slowly stir in tomato mixture.

title: Raisin, Apple Or Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: Spray muffin tins or use paper liners. Mix first 6 ingredients in large bowl. Mix other ingredients together except yogurt. Mix with oat mixture. Stir in yogurt. Spoon into muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Overnight Green Salad
instructions: Spread half of lettuce in 2-quart casserole. Add celery onions green pepper and peas as second layer. Use remaining lettuce as top layer. Mix mayonnaise with sugar and spread over top. Refrigerate overnight. Before serving fry 1/2 pound of bacon very crisp and crumble; sprinkle over top of salad.

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Sift sugar flour baking powder and salt into a bowl. Stir in dates and nuts. Add eggs mix thoroughly. Spread in greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1 inch pan. Bake at 375 degrees for about 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm. Roll in confectioners sugar. Yield 6 dozen.

title: Creamy Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Combine ingredients in large bowl. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with 2 cups corn flake crumbs which have been mixed with 1 stick melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Mixture will be dry so you may need to use your hands to knead together well. Shape mixture into small balls and place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken Angelo
instructions: Place half the mushrooms in a 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Dip chicken into beaten eggs and roll in bread crumbs. In skillet melt butter over medium heat. Brown both sides of chicken in skillet. Place chicken on top of mushrooms. Arrange remaining mushrooms on chicken and top with cheese. Add chicken broth to pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes. Serve chicken over hot cooked rice or noodles with chopped fresh parsley.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Boil macaroni and eggs until done. Pour into bowl to cool; add eggs onion tomato and cucumber. Mix.

title: Kahlua Mousse
instructions: Beat egg yolks and 2 tablespoons Kahlua in a 3-quart microwave-safe dish. Add 1/4 cup sugar. Beat until slightly thickened and color lightens. Cook egg yolk mixture on Medium-high power 3 to 4 minutes until thickened. Stir every 45 seconds. Set dish in a bowl of cold water. Beat until thick 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Bars
instructions: Using an electric mixer cream butter.\tGradually add brown sugar mixing well. Mix in eggs. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add flour mixture gradually blending until smooth.\tAdd vanilla flavoring.\tSpread batter into a greased 9 inch x 13 inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into bars and enjoy.

title: Zucchini Bars
instructions: Mix melted margarine oil and sugar. Beat eggs and combine with water vanilla and nutmeg. Add to sugar mixture. Add both flours and baking soda. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Combine flour and cinnamon in a small bowl. Beat together butter sugars and egg. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats and half of chocolate chips and nuts. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 22 to 28 minutes. Immediately sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips. Let stand 5 minutes or until chips are glassy and sprinkle with remaining nuts.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine eggs and milk; stir in crumbs onion parsley salt sage and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Add beef; mix well. Pat into a 5 1/2 cup ring mold; unmold in a shallow baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes. Spoon off excess fat. Combine catsup sugar and mustard; spread over meat. Return to oven for 10 minutes. Serves approximately 6.

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Combine all solid ingredients in greased loaf pan. Cover with liquid and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cornbread Pie
instructions: Brown meat. Chop pepper and onion; add to meat and cook until tender. Add chili powder black pepper and salt. Add soup and corn; simmer 15 minutes.

title: Valentine Pie
instructions: Prepare crumb crust (1 1/2 cups crumbs and 1/4 cup melted butter). Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Cheese Cake
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water. Chill slightly. Cream together cheese sugar and vanilla. Beat bananas into cream cheese until fluffy. Blend in Jell-O. Chill until thick stirring occasionally. Mix cracker crumbs and butter. Press half into bottom of 12 x 7-inch dish. When Jell-O mixture is partially set whip milk. Add lemon juice. Beat until stiff. Beat Jell-O mixture slightly and fold into whipped milk. Pour in dish. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Chill. Garnish with maraschino cherries and banana slices.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to boil. Immediately add next 3 ingredients. Mix gently then add buttermilk eggs vanilla and marshmallows. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done. Cake may be frosted while warm.

title: Holiday Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk marshmallows butter and salt on medium heat. Leave until it starts to boil. Take off heat. Stir in chocolate bits and vanilla until all blended. Pour into buttered pan. Finally cut into your favorite size bites.

title: Egg Salad-Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl; season with salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. This spread can be used on your favorite bread rolls or crackers.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt butter; add Eagle Brand milk and chips over low heat until chips are melted. Pour into cooled buttered pan or platter immediately. Let cool for 2 hours and cut into 2-inch squares. Store in tightly closed container to prevent drying out.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Pour 1/2 c. butter into bundt pan (for best results do not use Teflon coated). Baste stem and sides well. Cut each biscuit into 6 pieces. Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Sprinkle appr. 1/2 c. sugar mixture in bottom of bundt pan. Roll each piece of biscuit in sugar and cinnamon mix and drop into pan. After each layer of biscuits sprinkle additional sugar mixture. After youve placed all of the biscuit pieces in the pan sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top. Pour 1/2 c. of butter over biscuits. Bake in 350\u00b0 preheated oven for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Crunchy Kisses
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat. Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Blend well. Pour over corn flakes in large mixing bowl. Stir lightly until covered. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs. Add milk salt and mustard. Add bread and stir. Add cheese and sausage. Mix well and pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Allow to stand a few minutes before cutting into squares and serving.

title: Vegetable Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Parboil green peppers. Stuff peppers with vegetable mixture. Place in baking dish and pour tomato soup and vinegar over peppers. Bake about 1 hour.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Dice and fry bacon until crisp. Add to drippings diced apple diced green pepper and diced onion. Saute until tender. Add 2 large cans of Hunts small red beans (drain before adding). Add 1 large can of chopped up tomatoes. Add curry powder and brown sugar. Mix together. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover; set overnight. Before serving bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and rice as usual. Set aside. Saute celery and onions in butter. Melt Cheez Whiz and soup. Mix together and spoon in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Apple Surprise Shurdel
instructions: Pour pears into pan (with juice). Pour in apple pie filling. Spread evenly. Pour in cake mix and sprinkle ginger. Cover top with butter. Cover butter with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Heat first 3 ingredients. Place remaining ingredients in jar. Pour liquid into jars and close tightly. Refrigerate for 3 weeks.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Put egg into a 1 cup measure. Beat the\tegg and fill the cup with water. Pour into a well made\tin the shortening and flour mixture.\tMix only enough to form a ball. The mixture will seem too moist but you will be adding flour as you roll the pie crust. Use what you need and freeze the rest.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: This makes one pie.

title: Oh Suzanna Pie
instructions: Mix together milk and cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Put margarine and coconut in skillet and lightly brown. Mix in 2 cups of nuts. Sprinkle on top of pie mixture. Melt caramel in microwave and drizzle all over pies. Makes 3 pies.

title: Mama'S Yeast Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. In pan put sugar shortening milk and salt; heat and stir until dissolved. Pour into large bowl; cool to lukewarm. Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour; beat well. Add yeast and eggs. Beat good and stir in about 3 cups flour. Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth. Put in greased bowl; cover and let rise until double in bulk 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Punch down and let rest 10 minutes. Shape into rolls. Cover and let rise in warm place for 30 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 or 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until done.

title: Biscuits Good
instructions: Sift self-rising flour into bowl. Make hole in middle. Add soda buttermilk and shortening. Mix with hand all this stirring in flour as needed to right consistency. Squeeze up between index finger and thumb.

title: Diane'S Squash
instructions: Cut up and peel squash. Cut up 2 apples. Mix and pour over oleo brown sugar mace and salt. Bake until done.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly mix shortening sugar and egg. Stir in buttermilk. Combine dry ingredients and add. Stir in pecans dates and cherries. Chill. Drop teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Top with pecan half. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mixture should be very moist but not soupy. Pour into buttered 9 x 12-inch or larger baking dish. Place into non-preheated oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serve warm with sauce.

title: Cinnamon-Cheese Toast
instructions: In a small bowl mix cottage cheese with sweetener and cinnamon. Spread on toast. Sprinkle with coconut. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Lemon Salad
instructions: Make jello as usual according to the directions on the box.

title: Speedy Spinach Lasagne
instructions: Empty spaghetti sauce mix into saucepan; add tomato paste tomato sauce and water. Heat stirring until well blended. Remove from heat. Beat eggs in a large bowl and add Ricotta or cottage cheese spinach salt and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Lightly grease bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Cover with a little sauce. Layer noodles 1/2 of cheese/spinach mixture 1/2 of Mozzarella and 1/2 of tomato sauce mixture. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover dish with lightly greased foil and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 60 minutes or until noodles are tender. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Combine pudding mix with 3 cups milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer in a casserole dish (9 x 13-inch) with a layer of graham crackers. Top this layer with pudding mix. Continue layering crackers and pudding mix ending with a layer of crackers.

title: Layered Banana Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs sugar and margarine; press evenly in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange banana slices over crust. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in milk and add pudding mix. Beat until well blended. Spread evenly over banana slices. Spoon pineapple evenly over pudding mixture. Spread Cool Whip over pineapple. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Sour Cream Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Place rhubarb in pastry shell. Blend together sugar tapioca salt egg and sour cream. Pour over the rhubarb. Bake for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 25 to 45 minutes. Filling should be firm and lightly browned. It makes a lot of filling and so requires a deep dish.

title: Date Cookies
instructions: Mix together and blend well butter brown sugar white sugar and eggs. Add salt baking soda vanilla flour dates and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on buttered baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Grate squash and onion on large section of grater. Mix all other ingredients except margarine in a 375\u00b0 oven. Place a slightly greased iron skillet or casserole dish in oven until almost smoking hot. (It is very important to do it this way or it will not brown properly.) Remove from oven and pour melted margarine over top. Cook until brown (375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Yummy Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all fruits together. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Eat and enjoy.

title: Corn Cob Jelly
instructions: Run water over cobs to take off last of the chaff. In a large pan (roaster oven) cover the cobs with water and boil 30 minutes. Use a lot of water the cobs absorb a lot. Strain. Stir 3 cups of the red corn liquor into a pan and add Sure-Jell. Let this come to a boil then add sugar. When this comes to a hard boil let it boil a minute or until it starts to jell. Test by dipping fork. The liquid collects a minute on the groves.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except sugar and cheese. Mix cheese and sugar together and sprinkle over salad. When ready to serve toss with mayonnaise.

title: Pineapple Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine brown sugar and undrained pineapple. Spread on warm cake. Refrigerate until cool.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. In large bowl combine all ingredients. Pour salad dressing over and mix just before serving.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Mix salt zucchini and onion. Let stand overnight. Rinse off salt; drain well and add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 minutes. Add dash of green food coloring then seal in jar.

title: Southern Fried Apples
instructions: Combine sugar nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Wash core and slice apples in 1/2-inch slices. Heat butter in heavy skillet. Add apple rings and one half the sugar mixture; cook about 3 minutes. Turn sprinkle with remainder of sugar mixture and continue cooking until apples are almost transparent. Serve hot; makes 6 servings.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Fry hamburg; add the beans and taco seasoning. Put in 8 x 8-inch frypan and top with sour cream and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with taco chips.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix salad dressing eggs water and cinnamon mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Stir in carrots and walnuts. Pour into greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting. Makes 10 - 12 servings.

title: Chicken Wellington
instructions: Brown chicken in small amount of oil. Season with pinch of rosemary salt and pepper. Drain! Buy Pepperidge Farm puff pastry 2 sheets per package and thaw. Cut in quarters. Take 1 quarter roll out a little to cover chicken breast. Set breast in center (drain on paper towels first). Sprinkle small amount chopped green onion over top. Take cream cheese slice chunks size of butter patty and spread on chicken. Fold pastry and seal (pinch). Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Put chicken in and immediately turn to 400\u00b0. Cook until golden brown about 1/2 hour. Serve with Mushroom Sauce.

title: Sweet Shop Pudding(Serves 4)
instructions: Pour milk into medium bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Stir in candy just before serving.

title: Key Lime Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Press into a 9-inch pie plate. Bake pie crust at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned; cool. Stir together sweetened condensed milk and lime juice until blended. Pour into prepared crust. Top with meringue and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 28 minutes. Chill 8 hours.

title: Chocolate Delight(Refrigerate)
instructions: Mix together and bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes in 10 x 13-inch pan. Let cool.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend first five ingredients together until smooth. Pour into a baked graham cracker crust. Freeze at least two hours before cutting. Wrap and store in freezer. To serve you may sprinkle some chopped nuts on top if desired.

title: Grandma'S Zucchini Bread
instructions: Dates and nuts may be left out. Raisins may be added in their place also.

title: Grannie'S German Steak Roll-Up
instructions: Sprinkle salt and pepper on steak. Thinly spread mustard on top. On top of steak layer the following bacon strips onions and mushrooms. Roll up steak and pin together with toothpicks. Grease or spray pan. Sprinkle flour on top of steak for crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot Swiss Tuna(Microwave)
instructions: Split hamburger buns. Combine tuna cheese celery mayonnaise catsup and lemon juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Divide tuna mixture among 4 buns. Wrap each sandwich in waxed paper and twist ends of paper. Cook one at a time 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until rolls are hot.

title: Turkey Noodle Soup
instructions: Put turkey carcass pieces in large kettle and cover with water. Cover kettle and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Skim surface to remove excess fat. Add vegetables and salt and simmer 15 minutes. Add noodles and simmer about 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Cabbage Crunch(Chinese Salad)
instructions: Break noodles into small pieces. Noodles and almonds may be toasted if desired. Place noodles almonds and sunflower seeds in a plastic bag or sealable container. Combine sugar vegetable oil vinegar and Soy sauce and mix well to make dressing. Combine ingredients immediately prior to serving as it will not keep the dry ingredients get soggy.

title: Baba'S Favorite Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. With electric mixer cream butter cream cheese and sugar until very light and fluffy. Add eggs vanilla flour salt and blend well. Pour into large greased and floured tube pan.

title: Orange Cream Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine oranges and juice apricot jello and Knox gelatine in saucepan; heat. Add cream cheese which has been cut into cubes and mix. Cool slightly. Fold in Cool Whip (reserve some Cool Whip for topping). Place in slightly oiled pan (9 x 12 x 2-inch). Cover with foil and refrigerate. Cut into squares and top with Cool Whip and orange segments. Serve on lettuce leaf with sprig of mint or sprig of watercress.

title: Scripture Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Catfish
instructions: Mix cornmeal with Cajun seasoning. Dip catfish into mixture of milk eggs and mustard. Coat well with cornmeal mixture. Heat oil. Drop fish into hot oil and cook until golden brown.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except soup and make into meatballs. Brown on baking sheet turning over once. Move meatballs to casserole and add mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or a little longer. These freeze very good so you can double batch and have ready for next batch of company.

title: Standard Butter Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar and well beaten egg yolks. Add milk and flour. Add beaten egg whites then vanilla. Pour into greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with your favorite frosting.

title: Amanda'S Beans
instructions: Combine the drained beans with enough dressing to coat and place them into a casserole dish. Marinate them in the refrigerator for about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Lay the bacon strips on top of the beans and cook uncovered until the beans are heated through and the bacon is crisp about 30 minutes. This is amazingly simple by amazingly delicious! You can also add sliced almonds if you like.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar cocoa butter cream and milk for 3 minutes. Add the oats. Drop by tablespoons on wax paper. The cocoa may be omitted and add some peanut butter.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Save out 1 cup corn chips and mix remaining chips with other ingredients. Pour into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch lightly greased baking dish. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until hot. Spread top with 1 cup sour cream an additional 1/2 cup shredded cheese and circle with reserved corn chips around edge. Bake an additional 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hot-N-Quick Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in 1-quart casserole. Cover tightly and microwave on Medium-high (70%) 4 to 5 minutes stirring after 2 minutes until hot. Serve warm with thin slices French bread or rye crackers if desired.

title: Pecan Wafers
instructions: Cover large cookie sheet with foil; grease with vegetable shortening. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Boil noodles according to directions. While they are cooking mix in a bowl the soup milk and drained tuna. Drain cooked noodles. Add tuna mixture and put into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Vinegar Sauce For Cut Up Vegetables
instructions: Bring to a good boil. Store in gallon glass jar. Cool and store. Put over cut up fresh vegetables or bean salad. Keeps for a long time.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Bread
instructions: Beat together until creamy the butter brown sugar and egg. Add other ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until cracks are dry. Use loaf pan greased and floured.

title: Easy-Do Sweet Dough
instructions: Measure water into large mixer bowl. Blend well. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed of mixer. By hand gradually add remaining flour to form a stiff dough beating well after each addition. Cover and let rest 15 minutes. Toss dough over lightly floured surface until no longer sticky. Knead 1 minute. Shape.

title: Cucumber And Yogurt Dip
instructions: Scrub cucumber to remove wax. Grate the unpeeled cucumber and drain very well until almost dry. Combine with other ingredients. Serve with crackers.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits(Appetizer)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine baking mix milk and cheese to a soft dough. Drop by the spoonful on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Mix melted butter or margarine with the garlic powder and brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet. Serve warm. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Crisco Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Sift flours together and add alternately with milk and flavoring. Bake for 1 hour and 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes a large cake.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Run cold water over macaroni and let cool. Add green pepper onion and celery seed. Make dressing with mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Stir until mayonnaise is smooth. Pour over macaroni and mix well. If macaroni is dry make more dressing. Best if refrigerated.

title: Strawberry Surprise
instructions: Mix strawberries and glaze together. Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar together. Break 1/2 angel food cake in pieces and place in a 9 x 13 pan. Cover with 1/2 Cool Whip mixture. Then cover with 1/2 strawberry mixture. Repeat again.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix the cream cheese 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon half and half. Whisk until smooth. Stir in Cool Whip and spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup of half and half into bowl. Add pudding mix. Blend well. Let stand 3 minutes. Stir in pumpkin and spices. Mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Garnish with additional Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Nachos
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart saucepan combine soup and salsa. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes stirring often. Serve over tortilla chips. Top with tomatoes green onions olives and pepper. Makes 6 servings. Preparation Time 10 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Slice apples and put into water with the lemon juice to keep them from turning brown. (Use any good cooking apple; we use Granny Smith apples as they cook done easily.) Red or Gold Delicious do not do well in this recipe.

title: Turkey Stuffing(Moist)
instructions: Soak bread almost two days old in milk until soft. Press out all the moisture and add an equal amount of quickly cooked hoe cakes or corn bread. Place in saucepan with onion butter and bacon. Cook 10 minutes without browning. When cold season with salt and pepper celery seed and minced parsley. Use sage and thyme and the yolk of 1 egg.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll roll mix and press flatly onto cookie sheet. Bake according to package directions. Mix together cream cheese salad dressing and dill weed in mixing bowl until smooth. Spread onto top of cooled roll mix. Cut into squares. Place assorted vegetables on top. Sprinkle cheese over top of vegetables. Place olive if desired on top of each pizza square. Keep refrigerated until use. Recipe can be easily doubled. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: In a large pan (frying pan) fry cut up bacon until crisp. Drain off grease. Pour in wine and simmer. Meanwhile as bacon is simmering cook the spaghetti. Then mix eggs and cheese together in a mixing bowl. When spaghetti is ready drain and return to pan. Add the cheese and egg mixture covering the spaghetti. Mix thoroughly. Finally add wine and bacon mixture; mix thoroughly. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Egg Rolls From Thailand
instructions: Chop all (except pastry squares and egg) ingredients and stir fry. Drain off any grease. Fill center of pastry squares; fold up bottom and sides then roll up; seal with a beaten egg. Fry in hot corn oil.

title: Salsa
instructions: *Stewed tomatoes or diced are really the best.

title: Aunt Minnie'S Crisp Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Beat in eggs water and vanilla. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt; add to creamed mixture. Add nuts. Roll out on floured board; cut. Sprinkle on decorative sugars if desired. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cookies should be golden brown. Cool. Frost if desired.

title: Cream Of Crab Soup
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour. Stir in chicken broth. Cook until mixture begins to thicken stirring constantly. Add half and half parsley crab meat chives sherry Old Bay and salt. Mix well. Heat just to serving temperature. Do not boil.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Combine salad ingredients in a serving bowl. Toss with desired amount of dressing and serve.

title: Swedish Fruit Soup
instructions: Combine fruit tapioca and grape juice in a crock-pot. Add enough water to cover (about 3 cups). Cover and cook on low setting for 8 or 10 hours. Before serving stir in remaining ingredients. Serve warm or cold as a soup or dessert. Makes 10 to 12 servings (about 2 1/2 quarts).

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger bell pepper and onion. Cook and drain macaroni. Mix all together real good. Put in casserole dish. Place in oven for about 15 to 20 minutes until cheese is real bubbly.

title: Ham Salad
instructions: Buy a small ham (Bryan Gooch) about 2 to 3 pounds. I usually buy a ham and serve with rice salad. A couple of days later take leftover ham and make a ham salad and if I have even more I make a ham and cheese pie (recipe included in cookbook).

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Place one cake layer or one-half of 9 x 13-inch cake in bottom of a 1 gallon or larger punch bowl. (I use Tupperware cake box because I make 2 round layers.) Cover with 1/2 of instant vanilla pudding 1/2 can cherry pie filling 1/2 can of fruit cocktail 1/2 pineapple and coconut and 1/2 of the Cool Whip. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup nuts.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Boil the Chicken then remove all bones and skin. Tear meat into chunks.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: For 10 minutes cook broccoli onion and celery. Drain; put in a baking dish. Add cream of mushroom soup cooked rice Cheez Whiz and jalapeno Cheez Whiz. Mix together and bake for 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Then mix stuffing with butter and spread over the top. Bake another 5 to 10 minutes until the top is a light golden brown.

title: Wheat Germ Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients\ttogether in a small bowl. In another bowl beat egg. Add cooled margarine molasses milk and wheat germ. Add dry ingredients.\tDrop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put into casserole dish in layers soup diluted with 3/4 cup water noodles chicken and celery. Garnish with mandarin oranges and cashew nuts. (Can put cashews throughout if desired.) Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 (six times the amount serves 40).

title: Stella Adamek'S Rye Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Combine next 3 ingredients in a cup and add to dry ingredients. Work in 9 cups white flour. Place on floured board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes. Place in greased container and let raise to double the size.

title: Chocolate Pizza
instructions: Grease pizza pan; melt almond bark (all but one square) and chocolate chips on low heat until melted. Take off heat and add marshmallows Rice Krispies and nuts. Pour into pizza pan spread out to sides and sprinkle with coconut. Cut cherries in half and arrange on top. Melt one square of almond bark and drizzle over top. Looks like pizza! Cut in small wedges and serve.

title: Pizza Burger
instructions: Grind bologna cream cheese and Colby cheese through a food grinder alternately. In a bowl mix ground-up mixture Mozzarella cheese oregano and pizza sauce. Spread on open face buns. Place face up in oven or under broiler and heat until bubbly.

title: Pea Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain the peas. Add water chestnuts mushroom soup and pimentos chopped fine. Saute celery onions and green pepper in oleo. Add this mixture to the pea mixture. Pour into two greased casserole dishes. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put crushed potato chips on top and heat.

title: Mama'S Beets
instructions: Cook until thick and pour over beets.

title: Pizza Quiche
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to package directions for a filled one-crust pie using 9-inch pie pan or 9-inch quiche pan. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Layer Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese in pie crust lined pan. Top with pepperoni and mushrooms.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar eggs and vanilla in large bowl. Mix flour salt and baking powder in separate bowl. Add flour mixture to shortening mixture about a cup at a time. This recipe does not have to be refrigerated.

title: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all 4 ingredients in an electric blender until very smooth. Yields about 1 1/4 cups or an amount equal to a 14 ounce can. Store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Knox Blox Shapes
instructions: You will need cookie cutters to shape.

title: Green Bean Delight
instructions: Drain 1/2 the water of green beans put the rest of the water and beans into a medium saucepan. Add the can of soup. Cook over medium heat (about 10 minutes). Add cheese to desired taste. Cook until cheese makes a creamy sauce over the green beans.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Cook onions until tender. Fry bacon until crisp. Add 2 tablespoons bacon drippings to softened cream cheese. Add onion and crumbled bacon. Wash mushrooms; remove stems. Stuff mushrooms with cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Put butter in an 8 x 8-inch square Pyrex pan in oven at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 to melt. Then mix sugar flour milk and baking powder together. Pour over butter then add fruit (any type of fruit filling will do). Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hamburg Lasagna Cheese Bake
instructions: Brown hamburger. Mix with tomato sauce and spices. Mix cream cheese cottage cheese sour cream with diced green pepper and diced scallions. Layer over egg noodles. Spread in greased pan 1/2 egg noodles 1/2 sauce and hamburger then cheese mixture. Repeat layers. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool cut and enjoy!

title: Chicken Oriental(Broiled Or Grilled)
instructions: Place chicken on grill or rack of broiler pan. Brush with half of sauce. Grill or broil about 10 minutes turn and brush remaining sauce and broil or grill for 10 minutes or until tender. Serves 4.

title: Couscous With Chickpeas And Feta Cheese
instructions: In medium saucepan bring broth to boil. Stir in couscous. Remove from heat; cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Transfer couscous to large bowl and fluff with fork. Let stand 5 minutes; fluff again. mix in chickpeas scallions cheese and olives. Pour dressing over mixture and toss lightly with fork. Serve on bed of lettuce. Serves 6. Enjoy.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Octopus Casserole
instructions: Boil octopus slowly 1 1/2 to 2 hours until tender when pierced. Rinse off black covering. Cut up octopus into bite size pieces. Cut up both cheeses into bite size pieces. Toss all ingredients together and place in casserole dish. Season to taste. Pour small amount of oil over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Ground Beef Relish Patties
instructions: Mix the ground beef with the salt pepper and parsley. Shape mixture into 8 patties 4-inch diameter. On each of 4 patties arrange an onion ring a tomato slice and a slice of cheese. Cover with the other 4 patties and press edges together to seal. Broil on both sides for a total of about 20 minutes.

title: Pheasant
instructions: Wash pheasant well. Salt and pepper. Line Dutch oven with tin foil and place bird in center. In a bowl mix wine marmalade cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour over bird. Cut butter in squares and put on and around bird. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Baste every 20 minutes. Tighten foil after each basting.

title: Baked Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms with dampened paper towels and remove stems. Pour some oil in a bowl. With fingers wipe oil on outside of each mushroom cap. Add a drop of oil to the center of the inside. Chop stems fine and combine them in a bowl with 1/2 cup bread crumbs and cheese; toss together. Add onion chervil (or tarragon) salt and dash of pepper. Toss again. Add milk or stock. Lightly mix. Mixture should be moist enough to hold together.

title: Three Bean Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Crumble and set aside. Place onion rings garlic powder mustard brown sugar and vinegar in a large skillet. Cover and cook 20 minutes over medium heat. Combine beans in 3-quart casserole. Stir in bacon and onion mixture blending ingredients. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Cold Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Partially cool. Add margarine and stir. Add Salad Supreme and stir. Marinate overnight. Add cucumber tomatoes and salad dressing. Stir and ready to serve.

title: Beef Kabobs
instructions: Add beef cubes to marinade turning to coat. Refrigerate 24 to\t36 hours to give marinade time to tenderize the beef; turn the meat occasionally. Fill skewers alternating meat cubes with mushroom caps or other kabobs tidbits of your choice. Place skewers 4\tto 5 inches from the heat. Broil about 25 minutes turning frequently and basting often with marinade. About last 5 minutes of cooking add small tomatoes to ends of skewers.

title: Tomato And Squash Pie
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients into greased 9 or 10-inch round or square pan and mix. Next 4 ingredients beat until smooth with electric mixer and then beat for 1 minute. Put this into the dish and mix with other ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let sit for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Flourless (Soft) Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonful onto baking sheet and press with fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes. Cool before removing from baking sheet. Yields 2 to 3 dozen.

title: Pineapple Rum Sauce
instructions: In large bowl combine brown sugar and rum; mix until combined. Add pineapple; toss gently to combine. Store in refrigerator. Makes 4 cups.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Melt butter in a large heavy saucepan; blend in flour. Cook over low heat until bubbly stirring constantly. Gradually add broth and milk; cook until thickened stirring constantly. Stir in chicken peas and carrots and seasonings; heat.

title: Baked Cinnamon Apples
instructions: Bring sugar and water to boil. Add cinnamon candy. Stir until it melts. Pour over cored apples. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Dip syrup over apples when finished.

title: Grandma Kirby'S Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and water to soft ball stage (294\u00b0) on candy thermometer. Add peanuts; cook to amber color. Add soda; stir. Add vanilla and butter. Pour onto greased marble slab. Cool and break. Store in airtight container.

title: Luncheon Sandwichlobster Or Crabmeat
instructions: Mix cream cheese with the juice of the fish. Add the other ingredients. Spread on the rusks. Top with tomato slice and slice of processed cheese. Bake until cheese melts about 25 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: French Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter with sugar. Stir in chocolate; add eggs. Beat one at a time for 3 to 5 minutes (after adding each egg). Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Let chill for 2 hours or freeze.

title: Meat Pie
instructions: In a skillet put stew meat and blade meat. Cook until light brown. Together mix meat and crushed crackers. Get pie crust and put meat and crackers cooked together and then put it in the pie shell. Bake at about 350\u00b0 in oven for 1/2 hour. Roll out the dough for pie crust and put on bottom of pie shell and on top of the stew meat.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Mix the shortening butter sugars eggs and vanilla; then mix dry ingredients with shortening mixture. Add raisins. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly before removing from pan.

title: Old-Tyme Chili Pie
instructions: Mix cornbread as directed. Pour batter into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Heat chili with 1/4 cup water to simmering point spoon over cornbread batter sprinkle grated cheese and minced onion over chili. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven 15 to 18 minutes. Cornbread will rise above chili mixture. Serve hot; makes 4 generous servings.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Lower heat and cook all day until thick and dark. Stir occasionally. Place in small jars; cool and freeze.

title: Mixed Vegetable Tempura
instructions: Pour vegetable oil at least 2-inches deep into wide skillet. Heat to 375\u00b0. Beat the eggs with wire whisk; blend in 1/2 cup water. Sprinkle the cake flour evenly over the liquid. Stir in flour with whisk only until moist and large lumps disappear. Mix the shrimp mixed vegetables and onion into flour mixture. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until lightly golden.

title: Asparagus-Cheese Canapes
instructions: Blend egg with cream cheese and Blue cheese. Trim crust from bread slices; roll each slice lightly with a rolling pin. Spread with cheese mixture. Cut asparagus stalks length of bread; place on edge of bread. Roll as for jelly roll; brush with margarine. Place in covered plastic container and freeze. Remove from freezer; cut each roll crosswise in 1 1/2-inch lengths. Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in saucepan. Cook over low heat until chocolate and butter melt. Stir constantly until mixture boils. Boil for 1 minute; stir constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Beat at high speed until spreading consistency. Immediately spread on cake. Yield Will frost top and sides of one 3 layer cake.

title: Pasta And Mozzarella Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Toss macaroni with Dressing. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; chill. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese over each serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fired Up Chili Dip
instructions: Combine chili and Ro-Tel in medium saucepan. Heat until hot stirring occasionally. Pour into shallow 1 1/2-quart bowl. Arrange lettuce along outside edge to form a circle. Continue to arrange remaining ingredients in a circular pattern in the order listed. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chilled Crab Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese grated onion Worcestershire sauce mayonnaise lemon juice and garlic salt well. Spread on bottom of serving dish. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. In small bowl mix chili sauce ketchup horseradish sauce and lemon juice. Mix well. Add to chilled dish. Cover with backfin crabmeat and chill at least 1/2 hour.

title: Favorite Ham Balls
instructions: Mix and roll into balls.

title: Luau Burgers
instructions: Shape ground beef into patties. Place each patty on a square of foil. Top with pineapple ring. Fill hole with chili sauce or barbecue sauce. Wrap in foil. Broil in oven or over charcoal until done. Serve on a bun.

title: Hot Potato Rolls
instructions: Mix shortening milk sugar salt potato and egg. Add yeast. Add flour. Mix. Place in refrigerator for 6 to 8 hours before using.

title: Chicken Monterey
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Brown chicken in butter remove from skillet and set aside. Saute onion and peppers in butter until semi-tender and remove from skillet. Return chicken to skillet add onions and peppers cover and simmer until chicken is done. Add cheese to skillet cover and continue to simmer just long enough to melt cheese. May be served with Mexican-style rice.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Peel baked potatoes or not. Mash with a fork. Melt butter in a Dutch oven pan over medium heat. Add onion and saute until tender. Add flour stirring until smooth. Stir in potatoes half and half milk salt and pepper. Cook over low heat until thoroughly heated. Top each bowl with cheese and bacon.

title: Preserved Kumquats
instructions: Wash the kumquats in warm water; drain and dry. Gently prick each kumquat with a skewer in 2 or 3 places. Combine the water and sugar in a saucepan (not aluminum). Bring to a boil and add the kumquats. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes or until syrup is thick and clear. Stir in the ginger and lime juice. Pack in sterile jars and seal. Makes about 3 pints.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese and add Cheddar cheese and dressing mix. Mix well and roll in large ball and roll in nuts. May be frozen.

title: Mom'S Best Pecan Pie(Ethel Greenwood Chadwick)
instructions: Cream butter sugar and flour. Add eggs. Add syrup salt vanilla and nuts. Bake in 9-inch pie shell for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions; slightly drain. In the same skillet add 2 tablespoons cooking oil. Coat zucchini in flour salt and pepper. Brown lightly on each side. Drain on paper towel. Use 2-quart casserole dish and alternate sliced zucchini sliced tomatoes and hamburger. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. Take out and sprinkle cheeses on top and bake 10 minutes longer or until cheeses melt.

title: Rich Raisin Bread
instructions: In a large mixer bowl combine 2 1/2 cups flour yeast sugar and salt; mix well. In a saucepan heat milk water and butter until warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to flour mixture add eggs. Blend on low until moistened. Beat for 3 minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in raisins and enough of the remaining flour to make a firm dough. Knead on floured surface for 5 to 8 minutes. Place in a greased bowl and let rise until doubled about 1 hour. Punch down dough and divide into 2 parts.

title: Lou'S Gooey Butter Coffeecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Blend cake mix with eggs and melted butter. Pat evenly into lightly greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. In another bowl combine cream cheese 2 eggs vanilla and all but 2 tablespoons of confectioners sugar. Mix well until smooth. Pour over batter in pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle reserved confectioners sugar on top. Return to oven and continue baking for 25 minutes longer.

title: Spicy Low-Fat Jambalaya
instructions: In nonstick 12-inch skillet heat oil on medium; saute onion and bell pepper for 1 minute. Add chicken broth tomato sauce water ham garlic parsley thyme and cayenne. Stir. Bring to a boil. Add rice. Stir. Add bay leaves on top. Reduce heat to a simmer cover and cook for 20 minutes. Uncover; let sit 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve. Makes 2 large servings (352 calories and 4 1/2 grams fat per serving).

title: Overnite Cookies
instructions: Mix brown sugar white sugar butter and lard or margarine together. Add eggs and vanilla and mix well. Sift salt flour soda and cream of tartar together then add. Mix well. Form into loaves (wrapped in wax paper) and refrigerate overnite. Chocolate bits and/or nutmeats may be added if desired.

title: Chewy Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Melt peanut butter and margarine in bowl over hot water or in microwave. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended. Spread into greased and floured 9x13 pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 mins. Cool completely. Add chocolate frosting if desired. Cut into squares.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake by directions on box using half the batter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt in saucepan caramels butter and milk. Pour over cake. Spread the chocolate chips and pecans on top of this. Pour the remaining cake batter over this and bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Buckeye Balls
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Dip in melted chocolate chips (or use 1/2 choc. chips & half butterscotch chips). Cool to firm.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Mix together jello and pineapple (do not add water). Heat until jello is dissolved. Let cool. Add buttermilk and Cool Whip. Put in large dish; sprinkle top with chopped pecans. Store in refrigerator.

title: Cocktail Sauce(Shrimp)
instructions: Mix well. Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Cook the beets until tender. Slip off skins. Combine vinegar water sugar spices and salt. Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes. Add the beets and simmer 5 minutes longer. Pack the beets into (hot) sterilized jars. If not enough liquid to cover beets add hot vinegar. Seal immediately. Makes about 4 quarts.

title: Summer Mincemeat
instructions: Core tomatoes and apples. Put in food chopper. Add ingredients. Bring to boil and boil for 5 minutes. Immediately put in jars. Ready for pie.

title: Calorie On A Ritz
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Let come to a boil. Boil hard for three minutes. Have Ritz crackers placed on a cookie sheet. Pour mixture over crackers. Take a spoon and make sure mixture is spread well on crackers. Put chopped nuts on top of crackers. (Nuts are to be chopped fine.) Put in a 300\u00b0 oven and bake 10 minutes (preheat oven). Remove from oven and place on aluminum foil until cool.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in an ungreased 9-inch pan. Makes three holes in the dry ingredients. In the first hole put the oil. In the second hole put the vinegar. In the third hole put the vanilla. Pour the water over all and mix with a fork until blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Frost right in pan or dust with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Cook chicken pieces in margarine at medium temperature. When chicken pieces are browned add picante sauce and water. Cover and simmer until all moisture has evaporated.

title: Chunky Granola Bars
instructions: Combine egg peanut butter and honey in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture starts to bubble. Remove from heat; add granola and mix well. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package; drain. Cook vegetables as directed; drain. Combine all ingredients and chill several hours. Makes a large salad.

title: Senator Russell'S Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes granulated sugar eggs vanilla milk and 1/2 cup butter. Place in greased casserole. Combine brown sugar flour 1/3 cup butter and nuts. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix soup milk soy pepper beans and 2/3 cup onions in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Stir; sprinkle remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Potluck Dinner
instructions: In a 5-quart stockpot cook cabbage in boiling water until tender. Add carrots potatoes and onion. Cook until tender. Add hot dogs and add pepper. Cook until hot dogs are done. Salt to taste. Eat with cornbread.

title: Crimson Pie(A Great Holiday Dessert)
instructions: Coarsely grind orange in processor. Transfer to heavy saucepan. Add berries 1 1/2 cups sugar and cornstarch. Boil over medium-high heat until thick stirring constantly for about 3 minutes. Cool completely.

title: German Kraut
instructions: Bring vinegar sugar and chili sauce to a boil. Mix the other ingredients together and pour the hot mixture over it (do not use the juice from the vegetables).

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: lst Layer Mix together pretzels pecans butter and granulated sugar. Place in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan and bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Mix chocolate squares and margarine in a glass bowl in microwave (about 1 1/2 minutes on high setting). Stir mixture until smooth. Add sugar eggs and vanilla blending thoroughly. Stir in dry ingredients mixing well. Add nuts. Spread brownie mixture in greased 8 or 9-inch round cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Cut into 8 pie shaped wedges. Serve topped with hot fudge sauce.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Grease cookie sheet and line with wax paper. Grease wax paper. Pour mixture on pan evenly. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Sprinkle powdered sugar on towel and dump cooked mixture. Peel off wax paper. Roll in towel long way. Cool for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Oven-Smoked Fish
instructions: Cut fish into fillets. Place fish in single layer in cake pan. Brush both sides of fish with equal parts of soy sauce and liquid smoke. Sprinkle with garlic salt paprika salt and pepper. Bake at 375\u00b0 until desired doneness.

title: Baked Fudge
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Will fall after rising.

title: Working Girl Rolls
instructions: Combine shortening sugar and salt in mixing bowl. Pour boiling water over top. Add eggs and yeast mixture; mix into flour. Place in refrigerator for 4 hours. To make rolls place in greased pans. Let rise for 3 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown. Dough will keep in refrigerator for 10 days.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well sugar oil eggs. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add flavorings and coconut. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pan.

title: Fresh Creamed Corn
instructions: Cut corn from cob; set aside. In 8-inch skillet cook bacon until crisp; remove and crumble reserving drippings. Add corn milk sugar salt and pepper to reserved drippings. Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally. In screw top jar shake together light cream and flour until combined stir into corn mixture. Add butter or margarine cook stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Garnish with crumbled bacon.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar 1/2 cup butter eggs milk and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in large pan. Top with brown sugar flour 1/2 cup butter and pecans. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Tuna And Rice Casserole
instructions: Lightly grease 8 x 8 casserole dish. Combine rice cheese tuna onion parsley and season-all salt. Stir in eggs and milk. Mix thoroughly. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 375 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until set and slightly browned on top. Serve with tangy butter sauce.

title: Creamed Corn
instructions: Combine last 4 ingredients add corn bring to a boil and boil for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from stove and cool. Freeze or enjoy.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken pieces until tender. Remove from bone and cut into bite size pieces. Cover bottom of oblong dish with chicken. Crumble crackers over chicken.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts. Set aside broth. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Mix celery and chicken soups and sour cream together. Add chicken to mixture. Pour in an 8 x 12-inch dish. Cover the top with stuffing mix. Spoon some broth over the stuffing mix. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown on top. Cook noodles by package directions. Serve over noodles and enjoy.

title: My Best Rhubarb Pie(Rhubarb Grows Like A Weed, But Such A Tasty Weed!)
instructions: Place tomatoes in pie shell; sprinkle with nutmeg. Mix together butter sugar and flour; pour over tomatoes then pour vinegar over. Add top crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until thick. Add sugar slowly. Fold all ingredients together. Spoon on 2 cookie sheets. Cover with foil. Turn oven on to 350\u00b0 then turn off when you put cookies in. Peel cookies off the next morning!

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: After slicing all vegetables place them in a bowl and pour Zesty Italian dressing over the vegetables. Let the mixture chill for an hour.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix together cream cheese egg cheese and soup mix. Grate potatoes into bowl of water. Place potatoes (by handfuls) on a clean dish towel and squeeze out water. Immediately mix potatoes cheese mixture salt and pepper. Add about 2 heaping tablespoons sour cream (dont make mixture too moist). Fry pancakes in oil in nonstick pan for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.

title: Easy Fruit Mix
instructions: Drain the juice from the oranges. Add pineapples and juice and pudding mix. Stir. Add sliced bananas. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Fry hamburger until crumbly; add garlic onion and celery. Cook until tender. Stir in tomato paste water and seasonings. Blend well; cover and simmer 50 minutes. Drain off grease. Arrange alternately noodles cheese and sauce using a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Cream Fruit Salad
instructions: Slice top third of each loaf. Remove bread inside each loaf leaving about 1/2-inch shell. Save inside of bread for bread crumbs. Place lentils in large soup pot with 1 1/2 quarts water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes or until tender. Drain lentils reserving liquid. Puree lentils in blender adding enough reserved liquid to make 3 cups of soup. Return soup to pot; reserve. Saute onion and garlic in nonstick skillet until onion is tender. Stir into soup along with spinach lemon juice and thyme. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer until spinach wilts and soup is hot. While soup heats place bread bowls on baking sheets and heat in 375\u00b0 oven 5 minutes or until crisp. Ladle soup into bowls and replace bread tops. Sprinkle with cheese. Broil to melt cheese. Serve promptly. Serves 4.

title: Tomato And Shrimp Salad
instructions: Put tomatoes into a bowl. Mix olive oil and lemon juice together; stir in herbs and onions. Pour over tomatoes. Add shrimp combining gently. Check for seasonings and add salt and pepper as desired. Let stand marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes then chill. Serve on lettuce sprinkle wheat germ on salad.

title: Three Layer Jello
instructions: 1st Layer Dissolve 2 small packages lime jello in 2 cups boiling water and 1 1/2 cups cold water. Add crushed pineapple. Let set until firm and add 2nd Layer.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Start cooking slow. Bring to a rolling boil. Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes.\tStir well. Pour into jars and seal. Can be served over cream cheese with crackers.

title: Golden Creamy Potato Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan combine potatoes carrots onions celery parsley salt and pepper and water to cover vegetables. Cook until tender about 20 minutes. Gradually add milk to flour mix until well blended. Gradually add to potatoes. Cook until thickened. Add cheese. Stir until melted.

title: Frozen Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ice cream. Fold in ice cream. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. Freeze until firm. Garnish with whipped cream and nuts.

title: Chinese Style Spareribs
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in water. Add all remaining ingredients except spareribs. Place ribs in large baking pan. Pour mixture over them. Let marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours turning meat a few times. Place ribs on rack in baking pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Keep egg whites in separate bowl.

title: Lite Lemon Angel
instructions: Mix pudding mix and milk; chill until firm. Slice cake into 3 layers. Divide pudding between layers. May be frosted with lite Cool Whip just before serving.

title: Soft Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: In a medium bowl mix molasses with soda until it foams. Beat in egg and butter. Add water. Mix ginger with flour and add to mixture. Mix well. Put in greased 9 x 11-inch shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Cut in 12 squares.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl stir together all ingredients except potato chips. Spread into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with chips. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until heated through.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook rice in beef bouillon. Saute onion. Add ground beef and brown. Add cream of chicken soup and cook slowly for about 30 minutes or until done. Add sour cream.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Combine cottage cheese sour cream egg and salt and pepper. Add Cheddar cheese and mix well. Add macaroni. Stir until coated. Put into 2-1/2 qt. baking dish.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Separate rolls; pat on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes; let cool. Mix with a mixer the cream cheese oleo and dry Ranch dressing mix until smooth then spread mixture on the rolls. Add the chopped vegetables (whichever are your favorites). Top with grated carrots and grated cheese. Cut into bars and enjoy!

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg yolks and jam. Beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk beating vigorously. Fold in egg whites beaten. Put in greased lined pan. Use caramel icing on cake. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9-inch glass pie dish. Place frozen berries in bowl. Add 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1 tablespoon flour; toss to coat berries. Spoon mixture into prepared pie dish. In medium bowl rub remaining 1 cup flour and butter together with fingertips until coarse meal forms. Mix in remaining 1/2 cup brown sugar. Add milk egg lemon peel and vanilla; stir to blend. Pour batter over berry mixture. Bake pudding until firm in center and top is golden brown about 55 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes. Serve with ice cream if desired.

title: Cheese Dip(Microwave)
instructions: Cube cheese in 1/2-inch cubes. Put in microwave-safe bowl. Empty Ro-Tel in blender container and blend at high speed until liquefied. Pour over cubed cheese. Microwave on Medium-high for 4 minutes. Let set 2 minutes and stir. Microwave again if cheese is not melted. Good chilled as dip or heated for nachos.

title: Cracklin Bread
instructions: Crumble the cracklin and pour 1/2 cup hot water over them. Add this to the meal. Use enough hot water to mix into a dough. Let stand about 5 minutes. If dough is too stiff add a little more water. Shape into small pones and put into greased hot pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes according to size of pones.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Break or cut up broccoli. Mix with other ingredients.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
instructions: Mix oil cocoa margarine and granulated sugar. Blend in 1 egg at a time until well mixed. Add vanilla. Add flour baking powder and salt; stir into mixture. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Use unbaked pie shell and cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Lori'S Zucchini Crescent Pie
instructions: Saute zucchini and onions in butter in a large frying pan over medium heat until tender. Stir in parsley salt pepper garlic powder basil and oregano. Remove from heat. Stir together eggs and cheese in a large bowl then add to vegetable mixture.

title: Eleanor'S Ginger Cookies
instructions: Boil together sugar molasses and Crisco. Cool and add eggs spices and salt. Add baking soda to warm water then mix all ingredients together. Let stand overnight or freeze for future use. Roll about 1/4-inch thick. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 10 to 15 dozen. Easy to roll out; great for Christmas cookies.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Let spinach thaw out. Once thawed squeeze out water. Mix all ingredients and let stand in refrigerator about 2 hours before serving.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Shell cooled eggs. Cut in half lengthwise. Take out yolks and put in bowl. Break up yolks with fork. Add all ingredients except paprika. Mix until fluffy. Fill egg whites with yolk mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Makes 12 deviled eggs.

title: Kosher Dills
instructions: Boil sugar vinegar and spices and cool. This makes a good sauce. Rinse kosher dills in cold water. Pour sauce over dills that have been put in a jar. Let stand 2 weeks in refrigerator turning daily.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Combine the sugar flour and cornmeal in a mixing bowl. Stir lightly then add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into pie shells and bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Mock Chicken Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Tear chicken into little pieces. Mix all ingredients together until thoroughly combined. Spray loaf pan with cooking spray. Press mixture into pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 60 to 90 minutes. Turn out onto serving platter; garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Applesauce Cake 1
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well add eggs then applesauce. Mix the flour soda cinnamon nutmeg cloves and allspice. Use some of this to dredge the raisins nuts and dates. Add flour and other ingredients and mix well. Bake 3 loaf pans or 2 large tube pans at 275\u00b0 about 2 hour.

title: Hurry-Up Pie
instructions: In a bowl mix crushed pineapple with container of Cool Whip. Place mixture into pie crust. Refrigerate then serve.

title: Tasty Taco Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat; drain. Stir in tomato sauce and seasoning mix; simmer 5 minutes. Unroll dough; press onto bottom and sides of ungreased 12-inch pizza pan. Prick bottom and sides with fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cover crust with meat mixture; top with process cheese spread. Continue baking until process cheese spreads begins to melt. Top with remaining ingredients. Serve with sour cream if desired. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place thick layer of broken Ritz crackers in an 11 x 13-inch casserole dish. Drizzle melted margarine over crackers. Place bite size pieces of chicken over this. Combine sour cream chicken broth and cream of chicken soup; pour over all. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until light brown.

title: Crab Regal
instructions: In a 1-quart casserole or mixing bowl combine all ingredients. Spoon into 2 individual casserole sauce dishes or shells. Cook uncovered 1 minute and 30 seconds or until edges bubble. Makes 2 servings.

title: White Velvet Bars
instructions: Layer One Spread unbaked pie crust in an oblong pan.

title: Artichoke Balls
instructions: May be refrigerated up to 8 hours prior to serving. Freezes well. Allow 5 minutes extra cooking time if it has been chilled.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar salt spices and milk. Add margarine to potatoes. Blend with milk and egg mixture. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake 30 to 40 minutes until filling is firm.

title: Baked Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cook potatoes. Blend hot potatoes with butter sour cream salt and pepper on low speed then on high speed until light and fluffy. Spoon into buttered casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour uncovered.

title: Creole-Style Flounder
instructions: Saute green pepper and onions in butter until tender but not brown. Stir in tomatoes tomato sauce 1 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper thyme and bay leaf. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Arrange fish in a lightly greased shallow baking pan. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon sauce over fillets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve over beds of fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings. Calories per serving 247.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli bacon raisins and onion. In another bowl combine mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Toss with broccoli mixture. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving tossing occasionally.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Heat the frying pan. Add butter and brown the onion and celery. Remove and add the rice. Cook until brown stirring constantly. In a separate kettle heat the tomatoes with the seasoning and the stock then add the rice onion and celery. Simmer slowly over a low fire until rice is tender about 1/2 hour stirring occasionally with a fork to prevent sticking. Fifteen minutes before serving fry the hamburg which has been shaped into small balls and add to rice.

title: Chocolate Cream Cake
instructions: Butter and flour a 10-inch spring-form pan. Melt butter and chocolate chips in a double boiler. Separate eggs. Beat yolks until thick. Slowly add 1/2 cup sugar. Stir in nuts Frangelico vanilla and melted chocolate. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until they form soft peaks. Slowly add 1/2 cup sugar. Beat until stiff.

title: Quick Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Put first three ingredients in saucepan and boil for three minutes. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Do this quickly and drop by teaspoonful on wax paper.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Beat for 2 minutes. Bake in greased and floured tube pan 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Grease an angel food or Bundt pan. Shake biscuits in a bag with the cinnamon-sugar combination. Put biscuits into the greased pan. Boil the brown sugar and margarine. Pour over biscuits and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream cream cheese (optional) and taco mix; spread on a dish. Top with shredded lettuce Cheddar cheese and small chunks of tomato. Chopped onions green peppers and black olives may be added for extra flavor. Use nacho or tortilla chips to dip. Serve chilled.

title: Oven Baked Stew
