instructions: Place everything in large casserole with tight cover. Stir well and several times while cooking. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 5 to 6 hours. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put in a loaf pan and bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Set on platter with mashed potatoes and string beans.

title: French-Style Cinnamon Coffee Mix
instructions: Mix thoroughly. For 1 cup of beverage use 1 tablespoon to 3/4 cup boiling water. Serve with a cinnamon stick and a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening oil and sugar. Add egg and beat well. Add oatmeal vanilla coconut and Rice Krispies. Add flour soda cream of tartar and salt. Put in refrigerator until the dough is firm. Roll in balls the size of a walnut. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 90 cookies.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Boil potato with peeling on until done. Peel when done and mash potato and add a little butter while mashing with fork. Add powdered sugar with the potato. Pat out like biscuit dough. Spread peanut butter on the dough like you would on a sandwich. You will pat dough pretty thin because you are going to roll the dough. After you have rolled the dough lengthwise put in fridge until chilled then cut into bite-sizes and put in airtight container and keep in fridge.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats; cover and let stand 20 minutes. Beat butter until creamy; gradually add sugars and beat until fluffy. Blend in vanilla and eggs. Add oat mixture; mix well. Sift together flour soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Pour batter into well-greased and floured 9-inch square pan. Bake in preheated moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Do not remove from pan. Spread Lazy Daisy Frosting (recipe follows) over top and broil as directed.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Rum Or Bourbon Balls
instructions: Crush wafers fine. Mix with chopped nuts cocoa corn syrup and rum until mixture forms soft paste. Dust palms of hands with confectioners sugar. Shape paste into balls about the size of a walnut. Set aside one hour then roll in sugar. Store in an airtight container. Makes about 30 balls.

title: Fluffy Frosting
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat shortening and vanilla for 30 seconds. Gradually add powdered sugar; mix well. Add milk. Beat in enough additional sifted powdered sugar to make a frosting of fluffy consistency.

title: Barbecued Beef
instructions: Bake beef at 350\u00b0 for four hours. After beef is done cut meat up in little pieces and mix all ingredients together. Put meat back in oven for another hour and a half.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into graham cracker crust. Keep refrigerated.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Place 1 medium stick cinnamon and 1 tsp whole cloves in 3 quarts of water and bring to a boil. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Then add 6 tsp of orange pekoe tea. Let this simmer for another 5 minutes. Pour in the juice of 4 oranges and 2 lemons and 1 1/4 c. sugar and remove from fire. If mixture is not spice enough let it simmer for a while longer.

title: Penn School Bar-B-Que
instructions: Cook stew beef; peel and dice potatoes; cook rice. Mix all ingredients add onions and season with salt and pepper. Serve with soda crackers.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix and serve 2 heaping teaspoonfuls per cup of hot water.

title: Mike'S Muffins
instructions: Using large mixing bowl mix together first four ingredients. Add buttermilk eggs sugar and oil to mixture. Sift together flour and baking soda then add to mixture.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Combine milk and salsa. Transfer to a slow cooker coated with nonstick cooking spray. Stir in cream cheese crab onions and chilies. Cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours stirring every 30 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Soft Sugar Cakes
instructions: Cream eggs Crisco and sugar. Stir in buttermilk. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and cream of tartar. Add dry ingredients to rest of mixture. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Sprinkle sugar on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Put onion in enough water to cover in large saucepan. Boil until onions are transparent. Check oysters for shells then add oysters with liquid to onions and boil; add canned milk and heat slowly; stirring constantly. Add margarine salt and pepper. Add fresh milk and bring almost to a boil. Remove from heat and serve with saltines catsup and hot sauce if desired.

title: Cajun Country Pork Soutache
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown pork in skillet. Drain fat. Add next 4 ingredients. Add green pepper. Cook 5 minutes on low heat. Add cream cheese green onion and parsley. Stir until cheese melts. Unroll dough on lightly greased cookie sheet. Roll to 12 x 10-inch rectangle. Spoon filling down center of dough leaving 1-inch of dough on both ends and 3-inches on both sides. Cut dough on each side into 3/4-inch strips (diagonal). Brush egg over strips. Lay strips alternately over filling on diagonal. Should resemble a braid; brush dough with remaining egg. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat 4 egg yolks. Add milk and lime juice until thick. Beat 1 egg white until stiff then fold into mixture. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Oatmeal Snacks
instructions: Beat egg; add other liquid ingredients. Blend thoroughly. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Shoe Peg Marinated Salad
instructions: Mix all and drain in a colander.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Grate zucchini with skin; add flour baking powder Parmesan cheese milk and then beaten eggs. Mix well. Fry as you would pancakes. Serves 4.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and top with bread crumbs or crushed Ritz crackers. Put butter on bake and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Carrot-Apple Cake
instructions: Grease a 9-inch tube pan. In a bowl mix flour sugar soda cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Add applesauce and oil. Stir until blended. Add eggs and stir. When batter is smooth add carrots and mix well. Pour batter into pan and bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until a cake tester inserted in center of cake comes out clean.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Stir all and put into a 9 or 10-inch pie crust. Beat 3 eggs and 1 cup milk and pour over pie. Prepare a lattice top crust. Bake for 10 minutes at 450\u00b0 then 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Macadamia Cheese Hors D'Ouevres
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a large bowl cut butter into biscuit mix until coarse crumbs. Stir in egg nuts cheese and pepper. Mix well. Drop by teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 minutes. Makes 48 pieces.

title: Cream Of Crab Soup
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Mash potato chunks in soup first then add soup. Add half and half and seasonings. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Add crabmeat and simmer about 10 minutes.

title: Salmon Pate
instructions: Mix salmon cream cheese lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and onion. Roll mixture into a long roll and roll in pecans and parsley flakes. Refrigerate.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Ground turkey can be used instead of sausage. Brown sausage or turkey. Cut zucchini into bite size pieces. Place all ingredients into soup pot. Add water and cook until vegetables are done.

title: Punch(Two Gallons)
instructions: One gallon equals 36 cups.

title: Peas With Vegetable Sauce
instructions: Cook peas and drain. Combine all ingredients and mix with peas. Refrigerate.

title: Mincemeat Fruit Cake
instructions: Cook mincemeat in water for 1 minute. Combine all remaining ingredients; pour mincemeat mixture over other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured baking pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for about an hour or until toothpick comes out dry.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Drain salmon and remove waste and bones. Crumble into a bowl. Add beaten raw egg cracker crumbs salt and pepper. Mix well. Shape into salmon croquettes and roll into corn meal to coat completely. Fry in preheated cooking oil until lightly browned on all sides.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour once; measure and add soda and salt. Sift together 3 times. Cream Crisco thoroughly. Add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Melt chocolate and blend into egg mixture. Add flour alternately with milk a small amount at a time beating after each addition until smooth. Add vanilla. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in two 9-inch cake pans at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Cool and frost with White Icing.

title: Chocolate Clair
instructions: Mix pudding with milk according to the box directions. Add Cool Whip; stir until well blended. Layer in a 13 x 9 pan with graham crackers 1/2 of the pudding and graham crackers. Spread chocolate frosting on graham crackers. Add other half of pudding layer of graham crackers and spread with frosting. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in margarine; season with salt and pepper. Remove chicken and in same pan saute onions. In 9 x 13-inch casserole dish arrange chicken and top with onions and 1/2 jar salsa. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and add rest of salsa; dollop sour cream and cheese and bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Our Lord'S Scripture Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to create this divine fruitcake. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes. May the richness of Gods blessings fill your heart.

title: Baked Potato And Onions
instructions: Make slits 1 1/2-inches apart in baked potato. Do not slice all the way through potato. Place a slice of Vidalia onion in each slit. Wrap in foil. Bake.

title: Finger-Lickin' Snack Mix
instructions: Combine first six ingredients. Divide between two (9 x 13-inch) cake pans. Stir together remaining ingredients. Pour over cereal mixture gently coating evenly. Bake at 250\u00b0 about 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on paper towels to cool. Store in airtight containers.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix pumpkin sugar cinnamon and vanilla. Add beaten eggs and milk. Pour into 2 pie shells. Bake at 400\u00b0 until crust is brown. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake an additional 15 or 20 minutes until knife inserted in center comes out dry.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour. Mix with spinach cottage cheese and eggs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Country Style Steak
instructions: Roll steak in seasoned flour and brown on each side in margarine. Put in Dutch oven and cover with water. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until meat is tender and gravy is thickened. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cover potatoes and onions with water in large pot. Season with salt and celery seed. Cook until potatoes and onions are tender.

title: Microwave Tacos
instructions: Crumble beef into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add chopped onion chopped green pepper and minced garlic. Cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap; fold back a small edge of wrap to allow steam to escape. Microwave at High 6 to 7 minutes or until beef is browned stirring every 2 minutes. Drain. Stir in tomato sauce and next 4 ingredients. Cover and microwave at High 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Spoon about 2 tablespoons meat mixture into each taco shell. Top meat with lettuce chopped tomato cheese and taco sauce. Serve immediately. Yields 12 servings.

title: Garlic Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook in saucepan spinach according to package directions; drain. Place garlic in blender. Add cooked spinach milk salt and pepper sauce. Add cheese.

title: Miracle Cookies
instructions: Place graham crackers on cookie sheet. Melt butter on stove and stir in brown sugar. Cook for few seconds. Add pecans. Pour mixture on crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes; serve.

title: Snack Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix in water and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix well then stir in cereals. Form small balls and press down on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Yields 6 to 7 dozen cookies. These chewy cookies are delicious with a glass of cold milk.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: Roll chicken in flour and place in baking dish. In small bowl mix together preserves salad dressing and soup mix. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Sage Dressing
instructions: Mix together and bake. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lima Beans And Pork Sausage
instructions: In a Dutch oven bring beans water and salt to a boil. Remove from heat; cover and let stand for 1 hour or soak overnight. (Do not drain.)

title: Amish Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients and chill overnight. Roll balls of dough in\tsugar and space 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Using a glass with a design on the bottom press cookies down. (Dip glass in sugar to keep from sticking.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix together. To serve add 2 to 3 teaspoons to one cup of hot water.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream the first 2 ingredients. Add eggs; beat. Add flour; beat. Add syrup; beat. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes using a jelly roll pan.

title: Never Fail Meringue(You Will Never Fail With This Meringue Recipe.)
instructions: Moisten cornstarch with teaspoon of water. Add to boiling water and stir until mixture is clear. Add eggs sugar and salt; beat until stiff. Spread on top of pie and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: School Lunch Peanut Crunch
instructions: Bring sugar syrup and peanut butter to a boil. Be sure to stir to prevent scorching. Stir in peanuts and corn flakes until coated. Spread in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Butter Pecan Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 9-inch square pan. Break eggs in mixing bowl. Beat with slotted spoon or mixer about 1 minute. Add brown sugar to egg and mix well. Add granulated sugar and mix well. Melt butter or margarine. Pour over egg and sugar mixture. Mix well. Add flour chopped nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes (when done the inside will still be moist). Cut into bars or squares while slightly warm. Makes 3 dozen small.

title: Butterscotch Frosting
instructions: Combine brown sugar butter Crisco and salt in saucepan; bring to boil stirring constantly. Add milk. Cook over low heat 3 minutes. Cool. Add powdered sugar; beat until thick enough to spread.

title: Oatmeal And Sour Cherry Soda Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease large baking sheet. In large bowl with fork combine whole wheat and all-purpose flours 1/2 cup oats salt baking powder baking soda cherries and caraway seed. In 2 cup glass measuring cup or small bowl combine yogurt 3/4 cup skim milk and the honey until well blended. Add yogurt mixture to dry ingredients and mix lightly with fork just until mixture clings together and forms a soft dough; do not overmix. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface. Knead gently 8 to 10 times or about 30 seconds. Shape dough into an 8-inch round loaf and place on greased baking sheet. Brush loaf with remaining tablespoon skim milk and sprinkle top with remaining tablespoon oats. With knife score top of loaf into quarters. Bake bread for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Brown the hamburger and onion; drain. Add tomato sauce beans and seasoning. Cook 5 to 10 minutes. Put in 2 pie plates. Let cool. Spread on top the sour cream and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. To freeze extra pie dont put the sour cream and cheese on until ready to use.

title: Bar-B-Qued Special
instructions: Sauce to be prepared ahead must simmer before adding meat.

title: Shoupe(Shrimp And Rice)
instructions: Cook shrimp for 5 minutes (save water). Peel and clean shrimp. Saute onion tomatoes bell pepper and garlic in oil. Then add to small amount of water with potatoes and cook until potatoes are done. Add cut up shrimp catsup and Lea & Perrins sauce. Then add hard-boiled eggs cut up salt pepper and dash of hot sauce. Serve with white rice.

title: Creamy Chicken Divan
instructions: Make sauce by melting butter. Then add mayo flour and salt. Mix well. Add milk and stir until thickened.

title: Ryan'S Fathers Day Cake
instructions: Follow directions on box for cake batter. Add honey to batter. Fold in chocolate chips. Bake following box directions. Allow to cool. Then frost with vanilla cake frosting.

title: Double Chocolate Snack Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch. In small mixing bowl combine flour sugar cocoa baking soda and salt. Add water oil vinegar and vanilla; beat until smooth.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Season steak with salt and pepper. Brown steak in hot oil in heavy skillet on both sides. Remove steak and brown onions in the oil. Remove onions.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Melt Cheddar cheese in double boiler. Mix all 3 ingredients together and roll into 1-inch balls. Freeze and prepare when needed. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together and pour into casserole dish. Top with Ritz crackers and pour butter over them. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Split Pea Soup(Debbie Hates Peas, But This Soup Is Very Tasty.)
instructions: Soak peas overnight in water. In a large kettle boil for 30 minutes all of the ingredients. Turn burner to simmer and cook until peas are soft (4 to 5 hours). Dilute with water or milk if mixture becomes thick. Season to taste. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix berries (will thaw in hot mix) with Jell-O. Divide in 2 parts and put sour cream (whipped) between 2 layers of mix.

title: Crescent Chicken Rolls
instructions: Cream butter and cheese; mix with lemon pepper mushrooms and chicken. Flatten each roll. Add chicken mixture placing at large end of roll. Roll together. Dip in melted butter; roll in Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0; brown 12 to 15 minutes. While chicken rolls are baking heat mushroom soup and sour cream until hot. Spoon over baked rolls and serve. These chicken rolls may be prepared and frozen for later date.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Use a 9-inch spring pan greased with margarine. All ingredients should be at room temperature. Use mixer and mix in the order listed.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Bake brisket covered at 250\u00b0 for 8 hours. Brown together the butter onion and garlic. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer 15 minutes. The last 45 minutes of cooking brisket pour sauce over to cover. Save remaining sauce to pour over as served.

title: Tomatoes With Corn And Basil Filling
instructions: Cut 1/2-inch from the stem end of each tomato. With a melon ball cutter scoop out and discard the seeds and pulp leaving a 1/2-inch shell. Sprinkle the shells with salt and let them drain inverted on paper towels for 10 minutes.

title: Yummy Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cream butter and shortening; add sugar and mix well. Beat in eggs and vanilla; mix well. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Drop spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening salt and peanut butter; mix well. Gradually add sugars. Cream after each addition. Add eggs and milk; mix well. Sift together the flour and soda. Blend with first mixture. Drop onto a greased cookie sheet or roll into 1-inch balls. Press with a fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 10 to 12 dozen cookies.

title: Squash Goulash
instructions: In large skillet put oleo or oil. Add onion; saute 3 minutes. Add Ortega and carrots; simmer 8 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water squash cabbage and tomato; simmer 10 minutes. Add water as needed.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes into large pieces (approximately 1/2 x 1-inch). In large pot put diced potatoes chopped onions chopped celery water chicken base pepper and Crazy salt. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Add milk to the soup and simmer altogether to 170\u00b0. In a separate pan blend melted margarine and flour together to form a smooth paste. Remove approximately 1 quart of soup broth and blend it with the margarine paste until smooth. Using a wire whip add this back with the rest of the soup. Blend well and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add to creamed mixture. Pour flour in large bowl and add dates orange slices and nuts. Stir to coat each piece and add this mixture with the coconut to creamed mixture. This makes a very stiff dough that can be mixed with hands. Put in a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 3-inch cake pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 or 3 hours.

title: Pickled Vegetables
instructions: Cook carrots and beans until tender; drain. Chop vegetables; sprinkle on 1/2 cup salt and let set overnight.

title: Sorghum Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in the order given. This makes stiff dough. Chill dough then roll in balls then roll in granulated sugar. Do not press down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Store in tight container at room temperature.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Remove beet tops and wash. Cover with boiling water; cover and cook until tender. Drain.

title: Sour Cream And Chive Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in a large Dutch oven. Cover with water. Add 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and cook until potatoes are tender (20 to 25 minutes). Drain.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup of boiling water. Dissolve cranberry sauce in other cup of water. Mix together. Add nuts. Put half in mold and refrigerate until set. Put sour cream on firm Jell-O then add rest of mixture and let set. Ready to eat.

title: Shrimp Toast
instructions: Chop chestnuts medium fine in food processor. Remove. Process shrimp eggs onions butter cornstarch salt and sugar until onions are tiny flecks. Stir into chestnuts. Mix well. Mixture will be wet. Spread each slice of bread with 1 tablespoon of mixture. Cut into triangles. Let set in refrigerator for 15 minutes. Fry shrimp side down 6 to 8 at a time for 1 minute until done.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower
instructions: Cut veggies and mix together with cheese and bacon. Blend 2 cups mayonnaise (must be mayonnaise) 1/2 cup sugar 4 tablespoons vinegar. Mix well and pour over vegetables.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add pineapple to mixture with 1/2 of the juice. Slowly blend in flour. Add vanilla and salt. Bake at 300\u00b0 for an hour and 15 minutes. Oven temperature may vary.

title: Hershey'S Syrup Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour syrup and vanilla. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Rinse chop and drain flowerets. Mix all ingredients.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Mix and let rise 15 minutes in a warm place after mixing. Knead lightly on a floured board and shape into balls. Place in oiled pan and let rise until double in bulk usually about an hour. Bake 15 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Combine sugar oil and eggs. Beat well. Add milk then stir in flour. Add salt vanilla and baking soda. Stir. Mix in poppy seed and nuts. Pour into two greased 8 x 4 x 3-inch bread tins. Bake 35 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Auline'S Icing
instructions: Boil sugar butter and milk until thick. It will get bubbly and change colors when thick. Add nuts and coconut; stir well.

title: Miniature Cheese Cake
instructions: Butter\tsmall muffin pans generously. Sprinkle crushed graham crackers until pans are well coated. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. In an electric mixer beat soft cream cheese sugar and egg yolks real well. Beat egg whites stiff and fold into cheese mixture. Fill muffin tins 3/4 full. Bake 15 minutes. Cool and allow to fall. Mix sour cream with sugar and vanilla well. Put a dab on top of each muffin. Top with strawberry preserves or any type fruit as cherry pie filling blackberry etc. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Allow to cool or chill as they will come out of pans easier. These freeze very well. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Taco Tossed Salad
instructions: Cook beef until done. Drain. Stir in taco sauce. Toss lettuce green pepper tomato olives kidney beans cheese and chips; stir in meat mixture. Stir in salad dressing. Serve with more taco chips.

title: Apple Salad Crunch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cinnamon and chill until thickened. Fold in apples celery and nuts; chill until firm.

title: Easy Supper
instructions: Saute hamburg and onion until brown. Add tomato soup Veg-All salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly. Serve over toast mashed potatoes or rice. Quick and easy. Adjust amounts according to family size.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dry ingredients and set aside. Mix shortening sugar and eggs and mix until fluffy. Stir in apples and then dry ingredients. Bake for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Beat egg yolks and add 1/2 cup milk. Mix well then add remainder of milk. Add milk and egg mixture to dry ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Put a layer of wafers in baking dish. Slice bananas on top of wafers and a layer of pudding over bananas. Continue to layer until all is used. Beat egg whites until frothy. Add 1/4 cup sugar and beat until peaks form. Top pudding. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 5 to 7 minutes until brown.

title: Sarah'S Snickerdoodles
instructions: Whip margarine eggs and 1 1/2 cups sugar until smooth. Sift flour soda and salt in a separate bowl. Slowly fold dry ingredients while stirring. Mix remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon. Form small balls of cookie dough and roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Stuffed Peppers(Low Calorie)
instructions: Cut off tops of peppers and remove seeds. Precook in boiling water for 5 minutes. In skillet brown meat with onion. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients (except Parmesan cheese) and spoon mixture into peppers. Place in a 10 x 6 x 3 3/4-inch baking dish. Put 1 cup water in dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 8 servings 312 calories per serving.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Heat juice from cherries and pineapple. Add jello and cream cheese then add cherries pineapple nuts and cola. Pour into mold and congeal.

title: Holiday Essence(May Prepare Ahead.  Smell Fills The Whole House.)
instructions: Wash a large purple top turnip and peel. Cut 3 (1/2-inch) slices out of middle. Take slice on left and put in hand. Take second slice and lay on top of the other. Take third slice and put on top. You now have a turnip sandwich. Enjoy!

title: Peanut Butter Yo-Yo
instructions: Mix thoroughly the shortening peanut butter sugars and egg. Blend in remaining ingredients except jelly. Cover and chill.

title: Pancake Mix
instructions: Mix all. To make pancakes use equal amount of mix to milk. May add 1 egg.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix well in blender.

title: Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crumbs; mix lightly. Pour into a 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Fig Preserves
instructions: In a saucepan combine all ingredients and mash with a potato masher. Bring mixture slowly to a boil stirring constantly. Cook for 15 minutes. Pack in hot sterile jars and seal while hot. Set aside to cool.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix rice vegetables and onion in a casserole. Heat soup margarine milk and water to dissolve real good together. Pour over mixture and dot with Cheez Whiz. Bake 1 hour until cheese is brown.

title: Dessert Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add egg. Beat. Add dry ingredients alternating with milk. Spread half of mixture in greased 8-inch pan. Cover with Date Filling. Add remaining batter.

title: Barbecue Boston Butts
instructions: Cover Boston butt with salt and pepper. Put in crock-pot with the chopped onion. Cook for 3 hours or until it falls apart with a fork. Drain well. Shred. Add barbecue sauce; reheat and serve on buns.

title: Cranberry Dope Salad
instructions: Grind the cranberries and sprinkle with the sugar. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes. While standing mix the pineapple and marshmallows together and add the nuts. Whip the cream and then mix all of the prepared ingredients together. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Serve at holiday times. It is both pretty and delicious.

title: Skillet Hero Chicken
instructions: Season flour with salt pepper garlic powder and parsley. Coat chicken with flour mixture and brown evenly in oil. Mix soup and milk and pour over chicken. Top with onion slices and thyme. Simmer 30 minutes basting often.

title: Shrimp Or Crawfish Fettucini
instructions: Saute vegetables for 5 to 8 minutes. Add garlic and seafood. Cook for 10 minutes. Add flour half and half and cheese; stir frequently. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add cooked noodles. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pig Pickin Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Then add oranges with juice (fold in). Makes 3 layers or one 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or longer. Cool.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Salt chicken lightly. Dip each piece into oil then roll in cracker crumbs. Place on a baking sheet; do not let pieces touch. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven about 30 to 45 minutes until tender and brown.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Mix the first 2 ingredients. Fold in the Cool Whip. Put on graham cracker crust in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate!

title: Mexican Luncheon
instructions: Cook sausage until lightly browned. Pour off drippings. Add onions and green pepper. Continue cooking 5 minutes. Add tomatoes macaroni and seasonings. Cover tightly and cook slowly 30 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Cook until heated.

title: Escalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix all together (hash browns frozen) in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Cover with crushed corn flakes and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. (Its a big hit at potlucks!)

title: 24 Hour Party Bean Salad A La Italiana
instructions: In a jar mix oil vinegar and spices; shake well. Set aside. Drain and wash all beans in colander. Place in a bowl; add green pepper. Pour dressing over. Store in refrigerator overnight. Toss gently and serve.

title: Cheese And Pasta In A Pot
instructions: Cook ground beef in a large deep frying pan until brown stirring often with a fork. Drain off any excess fat. Add onions garlic spaghetti sauce tomatoes and undrained mushrooms; mix well. Simmer 20 minutes or until onions are soft.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potatoes. Cut potatoes into wedges about 8 wedges per potato. Dip potatoes into mixture. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Combine cornmeal baking powder salt and eggs (if cornmeal is self-rising do not add baking powder). Stir in milk a little at a time.

title: Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix 1 egg with cake mix and press into pan. Mix cream cheese 3 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour over bottom layer and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Double Quick Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix 1 1/4 cups flour sugar salt and yeast in large bowl. Add water shortening and egg; beat until smooth. Stir in remaining flour until smooth. Scrape batter from side of bowl. Cover and let rise in warm place until double (30 minutes). Sunny window is great. Stir down batter and beat 25 strokes. Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups. Let rise 20 to 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen. Can be made while cooking dinner.

title: Moss Ball
instructions: Cream all ingredients together. Shape into ball and roll in chopped parsley (fresh or ground). Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Maretti
instructions: Brown beef celery and onion; drain. Add noodles. Stir in all ingredients. Put in a large casserole dish; cover with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Puree bananas in blender. Mix with other ingredients in large container. May be kept in refrigerator until ready to use. Mix with 3 quarts 7-Up.

title: Pumpkin Whoopie Pies
instructions: Combine egg yolks brown sugar and oil; beat with electric mixer until smooth. Sift together dry ingredients and combine with egg mixture; alternate with pumpkin. Add vanilla. Bake in 6-inch circles on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Delicious Trail Mix Without Those Annoying Sunflower Seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store them in an airtight container. The listed amount should be used within 2 weeks as the almonds will start to soften.

title: Shrimp Curry
instructions: Melt the butter; add the flour salt pepper and onion juice. When bubbling gradually stir in the milk. Cook and stir until boiling. Then add the curry powder dissolved in a little extra milk. Add the shrimp and let stand about 10 minutes to become very hot. Serve poured over mounds of flaky rice.

title: Godmother'S Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Grease 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Beat all ingredients until smooth 1 minute in blender on High. Pour into pie plate. Set oven at 350\u00b0. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife can cut clean. Let cool and add whipped cream if wanted.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugars. Add eggs sifted flour salt and soda. Stir together and add vanilla and chocolate chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Karo Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9-inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray. Combine dry ingredients until well mixed in large bowl. In a medium bowl whisk egg whites water and corn syrup. Stir into dry ingredients until smooth. Pour into pan. Bake until cake springs back when lightly touched. Cool on wire rack. Serves 16.

title: Shrimp Salad Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add 1 1/2 cups cold water. Pour 1 1/2 cups jello into mold and chill until sticky. Mix remaining jello with Miracle Whip and beat until foamy. Chill until almost firm. Fold in shrimp carrots celery and pecans. Spoon mixture into mold on top of jello. Chill until very firm. To unmold cut around edges and dip mold in warm water for about 20 seconds.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine butter sugar and egg. Add flavoring of choice. Combine flour and baking powder; add to butter mixture. Blend and chill. Roll out on lightly floured board and cut out. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Ribbon Salad
instructions: Dissolve lime gelatin in 2 cups hot water; add 2 cups cold water and pour into 14 x 10 x 2-inch pan. Chill until partially set. Dissolve lemon gelatin in 1 cup hot water in top of double boiler; add marshmallows and stir to melt. Remove from heat and add 1 cup drained pineapple juice and cream cheese. Beat until well blended and stir in pineapple. Cool slightly. Fold in whipped cream and mayonnaise; chill until thickened. Pour in layer over lime gelatin. Chill until almost set. Dissolve cherry gelatin in 2 cups hot water; add 2 cups cold water and chill until syrupy. Pour over pineapple layer. Chill until firm.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Precook chicken with salt and pepper in small amount of water. Bone chicken. Break it up and dice it. Melt butter in skillet. Add onion green pepper celery garlic and lemon juice. Cook until tender. Add chicken and stir. Then add to curry sauce. Serve over hot rice.

title: Shooting Star
instructions: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 1/4 cups of ice and water. Add to gelatin stirring until gelatin is slightly thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. Refrigerate until gelatin is thick enough to softly mound. Spoon thickened gelatin into dessert dishes alternately with spoonfuls of whipped topping to form clouds. Refrigerate until set about 1 hour. Garnish with additional whipped topping then marshmallows cut into star shapes and slightly moistened. Sprinkle with colored sugar. Makes 4 servings.

title: El-Paso Burgers
instructions: Chop onion and green peppers finely with food chopper. Add with taco seasoning. Mix with meat. Divide meat into 8 equal pieces and form patties. Grill or fry. Top with a slice of cheese sour cream and salsa. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Baked Beans Supreme
instructions: Saute bacon; drain on paper towels. Crumble into beans. Add all ingredients. Mix in a heavy deep baking bowl. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Smells like heaven and tastes even better.

title: Sunshine Potato Salad
instructions: Place all of the above in a large serving bowl.

title: Rice And Pork Chops
instructions: In 12 x 12-inch casserole mix together uncooked rice soups onions and pimentos. Stir in browned pork chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix together and store in airtight container. To use mix 3 heaping teaspoons of mix to 1 cup of hot water.

title: Wasetti
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain. Cook noodles and drain.\tMix all ingredients together and pour into a large casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20-30 minutes. Serve with salad and French bread. My family loves this. It takes about 30-45 minutes to prepare. Serves 8-10.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch blueberries and water in saucepan. Cook until thick. In a bowl mix Bisquick milk 1/4 cup sugar melted butter and vanilla. Drop biscuits on top of hot blueberry mix in baking dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Oysters Internationale
instructions: Spread butter on bread. Place in a 250\u00b0 oven until hard (not brown). Grease flat baking dish with bacon fat. Crush bread; place about 2/3 on bottom of dish. Make a layer of oysters on top of crumbs. Place onion rings on top of oysters. Cover with remaining crumbs. Take oyster liquid and add milk to make 1 1/2 cups. Add Worcestershire sauce wine salt pepper and garlic salt; stir well. Pour over bread just to moisten. Sprinkle cheese on top. Cut bacon in 1-inch strips. Place on cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes and under broiler for 3 minutes.

title: Tomato Macaroni
instructions: Heat tomatoes butter 1 teaspoon salt and the oregano to a boil. Reduce heat simmer 10 or 12 minutes stirring occasionally. While tomato sauce cooks heat 6 cups of water and 3 teaspoons of salt to a boil. Add macaroni and heat to a boil. Boil uncovered stirring occasionally 7 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and put macaroni into serving dish pour sauce on macaroni and sprinkle with cheese. Serves 6.

title: Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix together all ingredients and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool.

title: Caramel Poppy Corn
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan combine the butter or margarine corn syrup and sugar. Stir until blended. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Clip a candy thermometer on the side of the pan. Continue simmering slowly until the syrup reaches the hard crack stage (300\u00b0 to 310\u00b0).

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add melted butter sugar flour vanilla and milk. Beat well. Stir in coconut. Pour into ungreased 11 x 7-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until firm. Makes its own crust.

title: Chicken Taco And Rice
instructions: Saute chicken in oil until opaque about 2 minutes. Add chicken broth tomato sauce and taco seasoning mix. Bring to a boil then simmer covered 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add corn and red pepper. Bring to a full boil. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Serve with cheese and tortilla chips. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fiesta Sandwich
instructions: Cut off top 1/3 of loaf of bread and set aside then hollow out; leaving 1/2-inch thick crust all around. Spread cut surfaces with bean dip. Layer as follows Colby Jack half the red pepper Monterey Jack with jalapeno olive slices tomato cubes Cheddar and avocado. Top with remainder of red pepper. Combine shredded taco cheese with salad dressing and spoon on top. Replace top of bread loaf. Wrap tightly in foil and keep cool until ready to serve. If desired heat in oven or over coals to warm and melt cheese. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
instructions: Mix together 1 1/2 cups sugar shortening and eggs. Sift together flour cream of tartar salt and soda. Combine and chill thoroughly or overnight. Pinch off small balls and roll in a blend of 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon (could also use chopped nuts or cocoa). Place 2 inches apart and bake on an ungreased pan until light brown but still soft. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Mix soups milk margarine and pepper until smooth over medium heat. Gently add broccoli and sour cream. Heat very gently so cream will not curdle.

title: German Style Potato Balls
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins; cool then remove skins. Potatoes are then riced into a large pot lined with a towel to absorb the moisture. Allow to stand covered with another cloth overnight.

title: Crazy Crust Apple Pie
instructions: In small mixer bowl combine flour baking powder salt sugar egg shortening and water. Blend well. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour batter into a 9 or 10-inch pie pan.

title: Simple Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown hamburger drain; set aside. Saute onions and garlic. Mix together meat onions garlic canned sauce canned mushrooms seasonings and let simmer at least an hour or use crock-pot. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Caramel Sauce(This Sauce Is Good On Ice Cream Or Cobbler.)
instructions: In a double boiler mix sugar cornstarch salt and milk; cook until well blended. Stir in eggs and cook for 3 or 4 minutes longer. Chill then add vanilla and chilled cream. Fill ice cream freezer container no more than 2/3 full. Start cranking!

title: Pineapple-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Crush 1 package Ritz crackers. Mix crackers with 1 stick melted butter. Sprinkle on top of mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Soft As A Cloud Biscuits
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Mix sour cream and half and half; add to flour mixture. Stir with a fork until moistened. Turn out on floured surface; knead 4 to 5 times. Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness and cut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients together then add Cool Whip. Stir; add oranges and stir again. Chill 5 to 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Marmalade Tea Bars
instructions: Combine marmalade walnuts and coconut. Set aside. Sift baking powder soda salt with flour. Cream butter in mixing bowl. Gradually add brown sugar. Continue creaming until light and fluffy. Add egg and orange juice and beat well. Stir in rolled oats and dry ingredients. Spread half of batter in well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with orange/nut mixture. Drop remaining batter by teaspoons over filling. Spread carefully. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown. Frost warm. Cool and cut into bars or omit frosting cut into 3-inch squares and top with vanilla ice cream.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Resift flour with sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Stir in currants/raisins. Combine beaten eggs buttermilk and shortening. Stir in dry ingredients mixing until moist. Turn into greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Remove from pan; allow to cool before slicing.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Cook hamburger onions and pepper. Drain. Put in crock pot with beans. Cook two hours on high.

title: Roasted Pecans
instructions: Roast pecans in margarine for about 12 to 15 minutes. Pour salt over nuts. Microwave for 90 seconds the almond bark and butterscotch morsels. Remove and mix well. Place back in microwave for 30 seconds. Pour in nuts and stir well. Drop on wax paper and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken (Buffalo) Wings
instructions: Sprinkle wings with seasoned salt. Place in a large Tupperware container. Pour the teriyaki sauce over wings; place in refrigerator overnight. In the morning broil wings until brown turning often. Place in large roaster; pour sauce over. Bake in low oven for a few hours.

title: Crisp Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken pieces skin side up in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with salt garlic powder pepper and paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown. Yields 6 servings. Contains 175 calories per serving.

title: Cabbage Tomato Soup
instructions: Shred cabbage. Add enough water to cover. Add salt. Cook until tender. Add sour cream gradually to flour. Add to cabbage along with the tomato juice. Bring to a boil. Serve.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni in 1 teaspoon salted water; when tender pour off water. While hot add oleo and cheese; stir cover and let oleo and cheese melt.

title: Raisin Bars
instructions: Cook raisins in a little water for 10 minutes; drain and cool. Cream brown sugar and butter. Add oatmeal baking soda and flour. Pat 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 7 minutes at 350\u00b0. While baking mix yolks sour cream sugar cornstarch. Mix and boil until thick stirring constantly. Add raisins and vanilla. Pour over baked crust. Crumble rest of oatmeal mixture over top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Chop onions and cut potatoes in small pieces. In a large pot melt margarine and cook onions until tender. Add water and potatoes. Cover and boil gently about 15 minutes or until potatoes are fork tender. Partly mash potatoes up with fork without draining them. Add milk salt and pepper. Heat slowly stir to keep from sticking. Do not boil. Serves about 6.

title: Stuffed Eggplants
instructions: Peel eggplants. Slice in rounds deep fry and set aside on paper towels.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Dilute juices with the amount of water stated on can. Add apricot juice. Just before serving add softened sherbet and ginger ale. Makes about 50 servings.

title: Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and garlic. Add ground meat and brown. Add egg and olives.

title: Good Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Pop corn and measure. Boil brown sugar corn syrup and oleo for 5 minutes after it reaches boil. Stir in soda. Pour over popcorn; mix well. Spread on ungreased cookie sheet loosely. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 40 minutes. For darker color add soda before boiling.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chips. Spread crushed chips over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes until bubbly and chips are browned.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and cream well. Combine flour soda and salt together then add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk to the shortening and sugar mixture. Mash banana and add to cake mixture. Last add cup of chopped pecans and vanilla. Bake in slow oven until top springs back when pressed. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Bake in an angel food pan or a 12-cup Bundt pan.

title: Honey Baked Ham
instructions: Crisscross ham. Place clove sticks at crisscrosses. Mix honey mustard and vinegar together and pour over ham. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Best Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Cut butter into remaining ingredients to make coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over apples and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until done. Serve warm. If using tart apples sprinkle a little sugar before adding crumbs.

title: Christmas Eve Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Crush chocolate wafers. Blend with melted butter. Press into bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Millionaire Fudge
instructions: Melt Hershey bar and paraffin in double boiler. In separate pan over low heat melt caramels with milk. When melted add pecans to caramel mixture. Dip spoons of caramel mixture into the chocolate mixture. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Blueberry Brunch Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and set aside. Combine egg milk oil and lemon juice. Add dry ingredients mixing well. Pour batter in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Sprinkle with the blueberries. Combine remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over blueberries. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef oatmeal egg and onion; shape into 1-inch balls. Heat oil; add meatballs and brown. Remove to paper towel. Add pepper and pan drippings. Cook 2 minutes. Drain oil except 1 tablespoon; add remaining ingredients. Cook and stir over medium-low heat until sauce is smooth and thickened. Add meatballs bell pepper and pineapple. Serve over rice.

title: Stuffed French Bread
instructions: Slice top off bread. Remove about 2 cups crumbs from bottom part of bread. Mix crumbs with hamburger onion green pepper and salt. Place mixture in scooped out hollow in bread. Leave top off loaf and wrap in foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Open top of foil place bread top on loaf and return to oven for 10 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: Mix above ingredients thoroughly. Shape into 1 or 2 inch balls. Brown on cookie sheets in 350\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. Add to spaghetti sauce and simmer for at least an hour or two.

title: Hearty Meatball Soup
instructions: With hands lightly shape chuck into 1-inch balls. In hot butter in a 6-quart pan. Saute meatballs turning until browned all over. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients and bring just to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered 45 minutes stirring occasionally to break up tomatoes. Serve very hot. Is better the second day. Serves 6.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 to 60 minutes or until peas are tender. Makes 8 servings.

title: Wassail
instructions: Stir and serve; very pretty. Booze can be added.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cheese and pineapple; add half of nuts reserving rest. Stir in remaining ingredients; shape into ball. Roll in remaining nuts. Chill well and serve with assorted crackers.

title: Tubettini Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine fruit juice sugar salt eggs and flour. Cook on low heat until it bubbles and thickens. Remove from heat; let cool. Add the fruit to the tubettini. When sauce has cooled pour into the tubettini salad mixing in large container. Add marshmallows.

title: 7 Layer Bars
instructions: Take a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put margarine in the pan and melt it in a slow oven. Now sprinkle graham cracker crumbs. Then coconut. Then chocolate chips. Then butterscotch chips. Then sweetened condensed milk. Top with chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Will be the best seven layer bars you ever ate. Be sure to cool well before cutting.

title: Three C Bread
instructions: Combine beaten eggs oil and milk. In large bowl sift the dry ingredients together (flour sugar baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon). Add the egg mixture; mix just until thoroughly combined. Stir in carrots coconut cherries raisins and pecans. Have four 16-ounce fruit or vegetable cans washed well-greased and floured. Pour mixture into these cans and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Remove from cans; cool thoroughly. Wrap and refrigerate overnight or until ready to use. Slice.

title: French Onion Soup For Two
instructions: In a saucepan saute onions and sugar in 3 tablespoons of butter until golden brown. Stir in the flour pepper and nutmeg until blended. Gradually stir in broth. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for two minutes. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in the Parmesan cheese. Meanwhile in a skillet melt the remaining butter add slices of French bread. Cook until golden on both sides. Ladle soup into oven-proof bowls. Place a slice of provolone cheese in each bowl. top with bread and remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Escabeche Sauce
instructions: In a heavy cast-iron or enameled pot cook the garlic in olive oil until hot. Add chopped carrot and onion and the next 5 ingredients. Cook and stir with a wooden spoon for 5 minutes. Add the red wine vinegar and water; simmer for an additional 10 minutes. Add parsley and remove pot from heat. Stir in the juice and grated rind of the orange.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt butter and peanut butter. Stir in powdered sugar and mix well. Pour into cake pan and let it set.

title: Vegetarian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In olive oil gently saute zucchini mushrooms green pepper onion and garlic powder. Add tomatoes tomato paste water and additional spices. Stir to break up tomatoes. Bring the sauce to a boil and continue cooking uncovered 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve over pasta veal chicken or beef. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs oil and sugar until well blended. Gradually stir in shredded carrots. Add flour baking soda baking powder cinnamon and salt; mix until combined. Stir in pineapple. Grease Bundt pan or 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Pour batter in pan; cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 49 minutes. Let cool completely before cutting. Cake freezes very well.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Mix jello and boiling water until dissolved. Add can of cranberries and crushed pineapple (with the juice). Mix well place in refrigerator (uncovered) until firm. (May add chopped pecans and/or diced celery.)

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Have cream cheese at room temperature. Blend the cheese egg sugar and salt in bowl; fold in chocolate chips. Set aside.

title: Diabetic Orange Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Chill for several hours. Yields 6 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Shrimp
instructions: Saute pepper and onion in oil until tender. Add next 5 ingredients; stir well. Add shrimp; heat thoroughly stirring often. Transfer to dish. Serve with cooked rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Kielbasa Sauce
instructions: Combine sauce ingredients and pour over kielbasa. Put in oven and bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Boil the chicken debone and chop. Saute the onion green pepper and celery. Add onion green pepper and seasonings to chopped chicken. Add soups. Mix well. Soak tortillas in chicken broth to soften them. Grease casserole dish lightly. Arrange layers of tortillas chicken mixture alternately. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: Heat slowly; simmer for 15 minutes. Strain and serve steaming.

title: Sausage Cheese Bake
instructions: Cook sausage done and crumble and drain. Combine sausage and all other ingredients except garnishes. Mix well. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Cover; refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Garnish with pepper rings parsley strips and cherry tomatoes.

title: Herbed Chicken Saute
instructions: Combine lemon juice olive oil and water. Add onion powder basil leaves and black pepper. Brush over chicken breasts. Saute in nonstick skillet until lightly browned and thoroughly cooked. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pimento Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients with electric mixer and mix until spreading consistency. May need to add more pickle juice if not creamy.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Cube potatoes and place on bottom of casserole dish then slices of onion over this. Brown the chops (doesnt have to be done) and place over the onion. Stir mushroom soup along with about 1/4 can of water together and pour over all. Place a few dots of butter over this and cover with foil. Cook 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Israeli Chicken
instructions: Use large deep skillet over medium-high heat. Melt margarine. Saute onion until tender. Add chicken coated with flour and cook until light brown on both sides. In a small cup combine orange juice honey powdered mustard salt and apricots. Bring liquid to a boil. Cover skillet tightly with lid. Lower the heat and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Use slotted spoon to transfer chicken and apricots to a heated serving dish (shallow). If sauce is thin raise heat and cook down until thicker. Pour sauce over the chicken and serve with rice green beans or stuffing (like Pepperidge Farm harvest vegetable and almonds).

title: Bramborak(Potato Casserole)
instructions: Pare and grate potatoes. Combine with remaining ingredients and blend well. Grease well a shallow baking pan (about 7 x 12-inch) and pour mixture into it. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until well set. If you prefer an extra crust place the pan under the broiler for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato And Apple Bake(Tzimmes)
instructions: Coat a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Overlapping slices layer half of potato carrot apple and prunes in dish. Repeat with remaining potato carrot apple and prunes. Combine orange juice honey brown sugar and orange rind; pour over mixture. Cover baking dish with foil. Cut 8 (1-inch) slits in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 hour at 300 degrees.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Fry sausage and drain. Melt cheese with sausage. Add Bisquick and milk. Mix well. Roll into balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes.

title: Cranberry Dessert
instructions: Mix jello with 1 cup hot juice from pineapple and water if needed. Add marshmallows cranberries drained pineapple nuts and Dream Whip. Add a small chopped apple if desired.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Sift first 6 ingredients together in mixing bowl. Stir in oats and raisins. Combine applesauce shortening or oil egg vanilla and sweetener. Blend well; add to dry ingredients. Mix until well moistened. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Be sure to get 24 cookies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Korean Barbecue
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Marinate overnight or for 8 hours in a covered dish. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour in a covered dish.

title: Citrus And Spinach Salad
instructions: Wash spinach remove stems and dry well. Tear leaves into bite size pieces. Place in serving bowl. Add grapefruit sections. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream cheese sugar and cherry juice. Add cherries and rest of ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip and freeze. Thaw 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all together. Serve with chunked fruit pieces of your choice. Yields 2 cups.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all by hand! Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Quick Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Cook rice with water about 12 minutes. Melt margarine and Cheez Whiz with cream of chicken soup until smooth. Add to rice. Pour over broccoli (in buttered dish). Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Vidalia Onions
instructions: Peel onions and cut out all of the hard core on the root side leaving a good size hole. Place in baking dish. Fill hole with margarine and instant chicken or beef flavored bouillon. Salt and pepper. Cover and cook 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes per onion depending on size. Baste at least once during cooking.

title: No Peek Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place pieces of chicken over rice and soups. Sprinkle 1/2 package dry onion soup mix (or whole package) over chicken. Cover casserole with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Dont peek. If you want it a little brown uncover the last 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Line bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish with tortillas. Mix everything else except cheese and pour into dish. Place remaining tortillas on top and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Place unpeeled shrimp in a single layer in a large flat pan. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes turning shrimp after 10 minutes. Baste with butter mixture every 5 minutes. Serve in the pan with fresh French bread to sop the butter mixture.

title: Cracker Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks; add sugar salt cream cheese and lemon juice. Cook in double boiler stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Cool. Fold in sour cream and stiffly beaten egg whites. Line pan with 1/2 of cracker crumbs. Pour in mixture and cover top with remaining crumbs. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or until firm. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In a large bowl combine soup (undiluted) sour cream onions and chiles. Top tortillas with pieces of chicken a bit of shredded cheese and several tablespoons of soup mixture. Roll and arrange in greased baking dish. Pour remaining soup mixture over enchiladas; top with remaining shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fruit Dessert
instructions: Slice about 3 pounds fruit in bowl and sprinkle with lemon juice. Place in buttered pan. Mix until crumbly flour brown sugar butter and cinnamon. Sprinkle over top of fruit. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until fruit is cooked.

title: Honey Baked Onions
instructions: In small pan heat honey butter and salt. Arrange onions slices in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice and Tabasco. Pour honey-butter mixture over onions. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Plum Good Cake
instructions: Mix well; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Burrito Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain then add refried beans mushrooms and taco seasoning. Heat. Mix together 1 cup sour cream and mushroom soup. Spread 1/2 of sour cream mixture on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Wrap meat mixture in tortilla shells; put on top of sour cream mixture. Put rest of sour cream mixture on top; sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serve with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Fruit Squares
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add vanilla. Stir in one egg at a time. Stir in flour. Add nuts. Mix well. Spread in greased 10 x 15-inch pan using 3/4 of batter. Cover with pie filling. Drop remaining batter on filling. Glaze icing.

title: Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water. Add cold water and unsweetened pineapple juice; freeze. Add 7-Up or ginger ale and serve.

title: Fluffy Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Make well and pour in the milk. Stir until dough makes a ball and knead until smooth. Roll out and cut into circles. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 14 minutes.

title: Pink Fluff
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese together. Bring to boil the pineapple and jello; let cool. Stir in Cool Whip mixture.

title: Italian Almond Cake
instructions: You will need an 8 or 9-inch spring-form pan buttered.

title: Uncle Eddie'S Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours covered. Uncover and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Cocoa Cake
instructions: Heat the first 4 ingredients and pour over the sugar flour and eggs. Beat with spoon and add buttermilk soda salt and vanilla. Beat all and pour into greased pan. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Bar-B-Q Chicken For Sandwiches
instructions: Place chicken breasts in crock pot with enough water to cover and simmer several hours. Remove chicken from crock pot and discard broth. Debone and shred chicken. Mix in sauce and serve on hamburger buns.

title: Instant Hot Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in airtight container. Put 2 teaspoons to each cup of boiling water.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese and butter until creamy. Mix in remaining ingredients. Grease and flour Bundt pan and pour batter into pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Chop enough peaches to measure 1 cup. Puree remaining peaches to measure 2 1/2 cups puree. Combine milk and gelatin in medium saucepan. Heat stirring until gelatin dissolves. Remove from heat. Add chopped peaches puree yogurt sugar and vanilla extract to gelatin mixture mixing well. Pour mixture into ice cream canister. Prepare an ice cream maker according to manufacturers directions. Makes 7 cups 85 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

title: Cheese Buds
instructions: Combine cheese and butter. Mix well. Add flour and peppers. Roll 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured board then cut into rounds. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush with egg white and top with pecan half. Bake at 425\u00b0 until light brown (10 to 15 minutes).

title: Biscuit Recipe
instructions: Melt butter and stir in sour cream. Add 4 cups flour mix and pour in 1/2 can Sprite. Stir while adding sugar. Add other 2 cups of mix and remainder of Sprite; stir well. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0. Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Take 1 tablespoon of dough and roll into ball. (Prevent sticking to your hand by dusting with flour.) Place onto cookie sheet and bake until tops are brown.

title: Double Orange Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl cream sugar and butter until fluffy. Add sour cream and eggs. Beat until well blended. Remove 1 tablespoon orange juice. Add remaining juice and dry ingredients to creamed mixture; mix well. Stir in orange peel. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 9 to 10 minutes or until edges just begin to brown; cool. Ice with an orange frosting.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Add vanilla. Combine dry ingredients. Add to mixture. Fold in pecans and apples. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done.

title: All Occasion Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Stir in sugar until dissolved. Add juice and food coloring to enhance color. Add ginger ale right before serving. Serves 100.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil and cube potatoes. Saute in small amount of oil pepper and onion. Make white sauce with butter flour and milk and add 1 cup shredded cheese. Mix potatoes sauteed pepper and onion with sauce in a casserole dish; add pimientos salt and pepper and mix well. Sprinkle reserved 1/2 cup cheese and crushed chips over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 just until cheese is bubbly.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp discard most of grease. Cook onions in remaining grease until soft but not brown. In another pan mix sugar and flour. Add vinegar and heat until thick. Add seasonings. Set aside for flavors to mix. Cook potatoes. Cool slice and pour the first mixture over potatoes. If you wish to serve warm cook potatoes while you are preparing the dressing and pour warm mixture over potatoes.

title: Lemon Honey Chicken
instructions: Brush chicken with butter then coat with flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Put skin side down on a lightly oiled foil-lined pan (9 x 13-inch) and bake in a hot (400\u00b0) oven for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll out between 2 pieces of wax paper. Makes enough for 1 pie crust.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Combine crackers and seasonings in grocery sack. Shake to mix. Add oil and shake again. Let stand five minutes.

title: Corn Vegetable Medley
instructions: In saucepan heat soup and milk to boiling stirring often. Stir in vegetables. Return to boiling. Cover; cook over low heat for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring often. Stir in cheese. Heat through.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix syrup from peaches flour and sugar. Add beaten yolks melted butter and nutmeg. Place layer of crescent rolls in dish then peaches then syrup mixture. Top with remaining crescent roll dough. Bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Large Poultry Casserole
instructions: In large bowl put cubed chicken or turkey. Add flavored stuffing mix; mushroom soup mushrooms beans and water chestnuts. Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Miracle Whip Cake
instructions: In mixing bowl measure flour cocoa salt and pepper. Add warm water Miracle Whip and vanilla; mix until smooth and creamy. Pour into cake pans or 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Ice with Chocolate Fudge Icing.

title: 7 Layer Bean Dip
instructions: Mix can of refried beans and half package of taco seasoning. Spread into 8 x 10 pyrex dish. Spread sour cream on top then shredded cheese. Chop tomato and green onion. Spread across top. Drain black olives and jalapenos and spread across top. Refrigerate until chilled. Serve with Frito scoops.

title: Taco Burgers
instructions: In skillet brown ground beef and drain fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes chili powder Worcestershire sauce garlic salt pepper and dry mustard. Bring to boil and reduce heat. Simmer uncovered until thickened (15 to 20 minutes). Spoon meat mixture onto toasted buns. Sprinkle each burger with lettuce and cheese. Can add sliced or chopped tomatoes.

title: Old Time Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Start heating oven to 375\u00b0. Arrange a layer of potatoes in a greased 2-quart casserole. Cover with some of the onions. Sprinkle with some of the combined flour salt and pepper. Dot with some butter. Repeat layers until all is used and ending with butter. Pour the scalded milk over all; sprinkle with paprika. Bake covered for 45 minutes then uncover and bake for 15 minutes longer or until tender. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Aunt Ruth'S Chicken
instructions: Line casserole dish or pan with dried beef. (One piece of dried beef under each piece of chicken.) Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Mix together creamy chicken mushroom soup and sour cream. Put slices of cheese on top of each chicken breast. Pour the soup and sour cream mixture over the chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Special Meat Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except fat. Form in balls. Brown in hot fat turning frequently. Cook slowly for 30 minutes.

title: Cool Summer Peas
instructions: Thaw peas; drain and toss with remaining ingredients. Serves 8.

title: Wedding Day French Toast
instructions: Place half of bread cubes in a 13 x 9 pan. Top with cream cheese and layer on remaining bread cubes. Whip eggs; add milk syrup vanilla cinnamon and sugar. Pour over bread and cheese. Sprinkle with pecans. Cover dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

title: Peach Or Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake and cool pie shell. Mix Jell-O cornstarch and sugar with boiling water. Cook until thick and clear (2 or 3 minutes). Add food\tcolor.\tCool. Fill baked pie shell with sliced fruit. Cover with cooled Jell-O mixture.\tServe with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Banana Pops
instructions: You will need 9 wooden ice cream sticks or skewers.

title: Pecan Pie Or Tarts
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and flour. Add beaten eggs. Mix well. Add syrup and mix. Add pecans and stir well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes for pie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes for tarts. This recipe makes 1 pie or 12 tarts.

title: Pork Chops In Spanish Sauce
instructions: In skillet brown pork chops on both sides then pour off drippings. Place onions and green pepper ring on each chop. Pour soup can of water over this. Cover and cook on low heat for 45 minutes. Stir now and then.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and both sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; mix together with flour oatmeal salt baking powder and soda. Add chocolate chips grated Hershey bar and nuts. Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes only. Cookies will firm after they cool.

title: Sweetheart Pudding
instructions: Mix all together. Line a pan with mixture like a pie crust saving 1 cup for topping.

title: Orange Loaf Cake
instructions: Combine and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Sausage Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a large cookie sheet. Remove meat from casings. Brown meat in large skillet stirring to break into small pieces. Drain off fat. Pour in juice. Cover. Simmer 15 minutes. Drain off liquid. Stir in cheese parsley and oregano. Remove from heat. Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to 16 x 6-inch rectangle. Brush with half the melted butter. Sprinkle sausage mixture over dough. Roll up from long end jelly roll fashion. Pinch lightly along long seam to seal. Cut crosswise in 8 equal pieces. Pinch ends tightly to seal. Brush rolls with melted butter. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare Jello using water. Cool. Mix softened cream cheese with pineapple.

title: Orange-Cinnamon Coffee
instructions: Oh heavenly Father make me a better parent. Teach me to understand my children to listen patiently to what they have to say and to answer all their questions kindly. Keep me from interrupting them or contradicting them. Make me as courteous to them as I would have them to be to me. Forbid that I should ever laugh at their mistakes or resort to shame or ridicule when they displease me. May I never punish them for my own selfish satisfaction or to show my power. Let me not tempt my child to lie or steal. And guide me hour by hour that I may demonstrate by all I say and do that honesty produces happiness. Reduce I pray the meanness in me. And when I am out of sorts help me Oh Lord to hold my tongue. May I ever be mindful that my children are children and I should not expect of them the judgement of adults. Let me not rob them of the opportunity to wait on themselves and make decisions. Bless me with bigness to grant them all their reasonable requests and the courage to deny them privileges I know will do them harm. Make me fair and just and kind. And fit me Oh Lord to be loved and respected and imitated by my children. Amen.

title: Cheesy Chowder
instructions: Cook vegetables (except parsley) in butter and chicken stock for 30 minutes. Blend together milk and flour. Add to cooked vegetables and cook until thickened. Add cheese pepper and parsley. Stir until cheese melts. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Little Sweet Ears
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together in large bowl and make a well in the center. Blend eggs butter milk and orange peel. Add all at once to flour mixture. Stir to blend well. Cover and chill thoroughly\tabout 2 hours. Roll out one-half the dough at a time to 1/8-inch\tthickness. Cut into 4-inch rounds. Fry 3 or\t4 at a time in deep hot fat until puffed and golden 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Drain. Keep warm. Drizzle with honey or warm praline sauce. Makes 16.

title: Winter Strawberries
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Shape like strawberries; place green almond sliver in top.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Use a 1 1/2-quart Pyrex dish. Mix sugar and syrup; cook on High for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts and cook for 4 minutes and 15 seconds. Stir in margarine and vanilla and cook for 1 minute. Add baking soda and stir to mix (this will foam). Quickly pour onto buttered cookie sheet as thin as possible. Cool and break apart.

title: Coconut Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and coconut in large bowl. Make a well in center. Combine wet ingredients and stir into dry ones. Spoon into muffin cups (greased or paper lined) filling 3/4 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Fruit Curry
instructions: Mix and cook on low heat until well combined. Lay fruit out in bottom of baking dish. (Examples pineapple peaches pears or apples canned or fresh fruit can be used.) Drip cooked mixture over fruit. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Corn And Green Pepper Casserole
instructions: Drain corn; spread in shallow pan. Set aside. In saucepan add chopped green pepper and onion; saute in butter for 3 minutes. Add flour and milk; cook until mixture thickens stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add salt and Worcestershire sauce. Pour mixture over corn; dot with butter and crushed cracker crumbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Rhonda'S Brownies
instructions: Mix butter eggs vanilla cocoa flour and pecans together. Pour in prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 of 20 to 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Men'S Delight
instructions: Put Jell-O hot water pineapple juice and marshmallows in pot and stir over low heat until dissolved. Chill in refrigerator until it starts to jell then beat with mixer. Add Cool Whip Philadelphia cream cheese crushed pineapple and pecans. Fold in and chill again.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix ingredients. Best if served chilled.

title: Ossie'S Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients together until fluffy. Sift together next 3 ingredients. Stir in alternately with milk and vanilla. Fold in egg whites. Pour into two well-greased and floured layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Almond Snaps
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In large bowl cream together the sugar and margarine. Add the eggs and oil. Beat until well blended. In medium bowl combine flour ground almonds baking soda and salt. Stir to mix. Add flour/almond mixture and the lemon extract to the creamed mixture. Beat well. Drop dough from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet spacing cookies about 2 inches apart. Using the bottom of a glass that has been dipped into sugar flatten the dough. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.
