Remove from cookie sheet immediately and cool on rack. Makes about 5 to 5 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Peppy Lasagna(55 Minutes Cooking Time)
instructions: Advance Preparation Cook sausage onion celery and carrot until meat is lightly browned. Drain off fat. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste water salt oregano and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Simmer covered 15 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts Tuscany
instructions: Combine all ingredients and set aside covered for 15 to 30 minutes. Place breasts on hot grill after removing garlic and basil from surface of chicken breasts. Cook on each side from 5 to 10 minutes depending on size of breasts.

title: Soy Base Mayonnaise
instructions: Except for lemon juice blend all ingredients in blender. Remove from blender. When smooth stir in lemon juice.

title: No Peek Crock-Pot Corn
instructions: Do not lift lid. Do not stir until done! Cook in a crock-pot for approximately 2 hours on high until cheese and margarine melts. Switch to low for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Cook sugar salt soda and buttermilk to soft ball stage. Add nuts butter and vanilla. Remove from heat and stir until candy gets creamier and starts to harden. Drop from teaspoon on waxed paper. (Be prepared to work fast!) Place waxed paper on newspaper and pralines will come up easily.

title: Sunshine Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Remove from oven and punch holes in cake with a fork. Mix together Coco Lopez and Eagle Brand milk. Pour milk mixture over cake. Top with Cool Whip then coconut. Must be refrigerated.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Bake
instructions: Cook rice. Add Cheez Whiz; mix well. Saute onions and celery in margarine. Combine with rice mixture. Add broccoli and mix. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef And Pepper With Rice
instructions: Slice partially frozen beef into thin strips. In large skillet heat margarine to high and quickly stir-fry beef strips onion rings and green pepper strips until beef has lost red color. Add salt pepper and soy sauce to taste. Serve over hot rice. Serves 3 or 4.

title: Hamburger Chow Mein
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet. Add vegetables. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Mix cornstarch with soy sauce. Add bouillon and cornstarch mixture to meat. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with chow mein noodles or cooked rice if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: World War Cake(Copyright 1908 - 1933)
instructions: Boil together for 3 minutes the sugar water fruit shortening spices and salt. Let cool then add the flour and baking powder sifted together and the vanilla. Mix well and bake in a well-greased loaf pan in moderate oven for about 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given. Chill overnight. Drop by teaspoon on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Freeze well.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in small amount of water; drain. Season with salt and pepper to taste and 1 tablespoon of margarine. Stir in soup sour cream and pimento; set aside. Combine half of stuffing mix and 1/2 stick margarine melted; blend well. Combine half of the stuffing mixture all all of the squash mixture. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Top with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Salsa
instructions: Stir and serve with tortilla or corn chips.

title: Ding Dong Cake
instructions: Bake in 2 round pans. Split with thread when cooled.

title: Steak And Potato Casserole
instructions: Batter steak in flour salt and pepper. Brown on both sides with oil in a heavy skillet. Arrange browned meat in casserole dish (do not crowd pieces). Place potatoes sliced thin on top of browned steak. Sprinkle with onion soup mix and pour 3 1/2 cups of water over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 2 hours or until tender.

title: Low-Fat Skillet Hamburger Cabbage
instructions: Brown hamburger meat in a skillet without added fat until meat remains separated. Rinse under hot running water in a colander or strainer to remove excess fat. Shred cabbage not too fine. Add to skillet with meat. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook over medium heat until cabbage is tender.

title: Lemon Bisque
instructions: Boil milk for five minutes in can in pan of water. Chill overnight. Dissolve gelatin in 1 1/4 cups boiling water and add sugar salt lemon juice and rind. Beat milk until stiff and whip gelatin mixture into it.

title: Navy Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans. Place beans in 15-quart pot with water to just cover. Boil the beans until very tender and soupy adding water as needed for approximately 4 hours. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for 1 hour. May be frozen. Makes 12 quarts.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in a 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Edible Play Dough
instructions: Mix well until blended. If sticky add confectioners sugar until at desired consistency.

title: Mexican Pinwheels
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread mixture on each tortilla and roll tortilla up and stick toothpick through to keep in rolled position. Put in refrigerator to chill 2 hours.\tRemove from refrigerator and slice each tortilla so that each slice looks like a pinwheel. Each tortilla should be sliced in approximately 10 pinwheels. Serve with salsa for dipping.

title: Chestnut And Wild Rice Bisque
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Score an X in chestnuts and roast for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven; cool peel and coarsely chop. Set aside. Cook bacon and butter over medium heat until bacon is crisp. Reduce heat to low. Add onion carrot and shallots. Stir and allow vegetables to cook slowly for about 5 minutes without browning. Add chestnuts and stir for 1 minute. Increase heat and add brandy wine and broth. Simmer for 20 minutes. Puree in processor or blender. Return to low heat. Stir in cream and wild rice. Season to taste.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Add water salt and cream. Let come to a boil and serve at once with salt wafers. Serves 4 people.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix Jello and boiling water. Add cranberry juice lemonade and cold water. Add ginger ale or lemon lime soda when ready to serve. Yield 25 servings.

title: Santa Fe Stew
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions and drain. Add all other ingredients and cook for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Garlic Monkey Bread
instructions: Thaw frozen bread dough. Cut each loaf lengthwise then in small pieces. Roll each piece in melted margarine and garlic powder. Place pieces in a well-greased Bundt pan; let rise to top of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. (Burns easily watch.) Turn over onto plate. Serve warm. (Good with lasagna etc.)

title: Cucumber Relish
instructions: Grind the cucumbers onions and peppers; mix together with the salt and 2 quarts boiling water. Let stand for 1 hour; drain well. Add spices vinegar and sugar. Boil for 1/2 hour. Add a few drops of green food coloring. Seal hot. Yields 6 to 8 pints.

title: Finnish Bread
instructions: Mix together the milk yeast and about 1/3 of the flour. Beat well and let stand 1 hour. Stir in the sugar salt butter eggs and cardamom seed; beat well. Add the rest of the flour and knead the dough thoroughly. Let rise until double in size. Shape in loaves or rolls and let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Torte
instructions: Crush half the macaroons and sprinkle in the bottom of an oiled 8 to 10-inch spring-form pan. Slightly soften coffee ice cream and spread evenly over macaroons. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons chocolate sauce. Crush remaining macaroons and spread on top of coffee ice cream. Soften chocolate chip ice cream and spread evenly over second layer of macaroons. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons chocolate sauce. Spread crushed Heath bars on top. Freeze for 4 to 5 hours. Remove from pan and leave at room temperature 5 minutes before serving. Serve with remaining chocolate sauce. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Crab Mousse
instructions: In saucepan heat soup. Mix gelatine in 4 tablespoons water until dissolved and add to soup. Stir in the cream cheese until blended. Let\tcool. Add all the other ingredients to the soup mixture. Pour into oiled mold. Chill overnight. Can be served with crackers or on lettuce leaves.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Melt oleo in 13 x 9-inch pan. Put chicken over oleo. Mix soup and broth; pour over chicken. Pour vegetables over mixture. Mix milk and Bisquick; pour over pie. Cook at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Grandma'S Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon; mix all ingredients well. Add bacon. Put in crock-pot on high for 3 hours or bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: These biscuits are served in a restaurant in Outer Banks North Carolina.

title: French Market Soup
instructions: Wash and soak 2 cups of 15 bean mix overnight. Drain. Add ham pieces 1 tablespoon salt 3 quarts water parsley 3 celery stalks bay leaves and thyme. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Add water as needed. Add tomatoes onions garlic 6 celery stalks and peppers. Cook uncovered for 1 1/2 hours to creamy stage. Cook chicken pieces and broth to other mixture. Add this to soup about 1 1/2 hours before soup is done.

title: Zucchini Delight
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl. Put into 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until top is lightly browned.

title: Marshmallow Fudge(In The Microwave)
instructions: Line 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil; set aside. In the microwave melt chocolate chips 2 tablespoons butter sweetened condensed milk vanilla and salt all together. Remove from microwave; stir in nuts. Spread evenly into prepared pan. In the microwave melt marshmallows with remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Spoon onto fudge. With table knife swirl through fudge. Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm. Remove from pan; peel off foil. Cut into squares. Makes about 5 dozen pieces or 2 pounds.

title: Spoon Bread Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Melt margarine pour in yeast water. Add sugar. Beat eggs add to mixture. Add flour cup at a time. Bake in greased muffin pan 20-25 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Put chicken in bottom of a large casserole dish set aside. Combine veg-all chicken broth in a pan. Cook to thicken. Add milk and flour mixture if mixture does not thicken. Pour on chicken set aside. Roll crescent rolls out on a cookie sheet toast on each side (one side darker than the other). Put on chicken mixture. Bake at 350 degree for 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and store in a covered container. Use 2 teaspoons to 1 cup hot water.

title: Strawberry Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sugar until well blended. Fold in Cool Whip. Put into graham cracker crust. Mix fresh strawberries and strawberry glaze. Pour on top of cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate until firm.

title: French Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter with sugar. Stir in 2 squares cooled melted chocolate. Add eggs one at a time beating 5 minutes after each addition at high speed. Fold in thawed Cool Whip. Pour into baked pie shell after it cools. Chill until firm about 2 hours or freeze.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Combine crackers and margarine and put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish to form a crust. Let ice cream soften at room temperature then add vanilla pudding mix and milk to ice cream. Blend well with mixer. Cover the crust with ice cream mixture and let set in the refrigerator. After set spread Cool Whip and drizzle chocolate syrup over the top. Sprinkle with nuts sprinkles cherries or strawberries. Set in refrigerator and serve cold.

title: Four Layer Dessert
instructions: Mix flour oleo and pecans and pat in pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip and spread on cooled crust and chill 1 hour. Mix pudding and milk and spread on cream cheese layer. Spread other 1/2 package Cool Whip over pudding. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup pecans.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Slice onion in bottom of baking dish. Salt and pepper chicken and flour well; place on top of onion skin side up.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and butter in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add soda cream of tartar and salt. Immediately pour over popped corn. Mix lightly but thoroughly. Place in a large roaster and bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour. Pour on waxed paper and separate grains. Yields 20 servings. Store in airtight container.

title: Fudge Cupcakes
instructions: Melt butter or margarine and chocolate on lowest heat. Beat eggs. Add sugar flour and chocolate mixture. Cool. Mix well. Add vanilla. Put in 12 paper baking cups. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: O.F. Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Line pie pan with rolled out dough. Prick dough all over with fork and cover with a piece of foil and dry beans or pie weights. Bake 5 minutes; remove foil and bake 3 to 4 minutes more or until it begins to brown. Remove from oven and reduce heat to 375\u00b0. Thoroughly mix sugar flour and salt. Pour into half-baked pie shell and spread evenly across bottom.

title: Bar Nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. On a baking sheet spread nuts and toast in middle of oven until golden about 10 minutes. While nuts are toasting in a large bowl toss together remaining ingredients. Toss nuts with rosemary mixture and serve warm. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Turkey Strata
instructions: Sprinkle 2 cups stuffing cubes over bottom of greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer turkey celery and onion over cubes. Top with remaining cubes. In large mixing bowl beat together remaining ingredients until well blended. Blend in soup milk and poultry seasoning. Pour over stuffing mixture in dish. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Tortilla Trap
instructions: Get out tortilla. Slice approximately 3 slices of cheese. Place cheese slices on tortilla. Place tortilla and cheese on a plate. Put in microwave for 30 seconds or until cheese is melted. You can either roll up or fold in half vertically then horizontally.

title: Super Energy Balls
instructions: Combine peanut butter margarine and honey in medium bowl. Stir in milk powder and raisins. Add cereal until all pieces are evenly coated. Drop by 1 teaspoon cereal mixture into coconut; roll into a ball. Repeat. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Mix tomatoes and salt. Let stand 12 hours. Drain. Heat vinegar sugars and spices to boiling. Pour in 4-quart saucepan. Add sliced onions to hot vinegar; mix and boil gently 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and peppers. Bring slowly to boiling and simmer 5 minutes. Stir occasionally. Makes 9 half pints.

title: Crocked Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut round steak into serving pieces. Season flour with salt and pepper. Dredge meat in seasoned flour. Place onions in bottom of crock-pot; add meat. Top with carrots and celery. Cover with tomato sauce. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours or high 3 to 5 hours.

title: Pineapple Refresco
instructions: Put everything in a blender and puree until in liquid form.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate with butter over low heat; stir until blended. Remove from heat; gradually blend in milk. Mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually blend in chocolate mixture; pour in pie shell. Mix coconut and pecans; sprinkle over chocolate filling. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Zucchini And Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Slice squash. Boil until tender in water that doesnt quite cover the squash. Boil until all the water is gone (using just a little water). Mash squash salt and pepper. Brown meat with onion until done (drain). Add to squash bread crumbs meat cheese and egg. Butter a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Add a small amount of Cheddar cheese on top before baking.

title: Low Calorie Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together and chill.

title: Fried Catfish
instructions: Pour oil into a deep large skillet. Get it hot. Check oil by putting a pinch of flour in the oil. If it sizzles its ready. Mix flour corn meal and salt and pepper together. I use equal amounts. Dip fish in mixture. Place in hot oil. Turn when the fish is light brown then brown the other side. Take out and drain on paper towel. Eat while hot.

title: Zucchini Bars(Like Apple Crisp)
instructions: Simmer but do not stir zucchini and lemon juice until clear. Add nutmeg cinnamon and sugar. Blend well. Set this mixture aside.

title: Luscious Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake German chocolate cake as directed on box cool slightly. With a wooden spoon poke holes in cake. Pour the Eagle Brand milk then the caramel topping over cake and cool completely. When cool top with the Cool Whip and then the crushed Heath bars.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/2-inch crosswise slices. Mix flour salt and pepper; dip both sides of tomato slices into mixture. Heat shortening in a skillet until sizzling hot; put in tomatoes and cook quickly until browned on underside. Turn tomatoes carefully; reduce heat and cook until thoroughly hot and soft through center. Remove to a hot platter and serve. Yield 4 servings.

title: Saucy Garden Patch Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine soup sour cream milk seasoned salt vegetables 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup French fried onions. Spoon into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Top with remaining cheese and onions; bake uncovered 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Pistachio Nut Cake
instructions: Bake in Bundt cake pan in oven at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Betty Armstrong'S Copper Pennies
instructions: Steam sliced carrots (salted) until nearly done. Heat sauce ingredients; pour over drained carrots pepper and onion. Marinate in refrigerator. Keeps a long time.

title: Freezer Peach Jam
instructions: Cook peaches to soften and crush with spoon. Add pineapple. Add sugar. Boil for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and add jello. Stir until dissolved. Pour into jars with lids. Let cool to room temperature and store in freezer until ready to use. Makes 5 to 6 pints.

title: Scrumptious Crab-Wich
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Toast English muffins lightly and spread with mayonnaise. Place tomato on muffin and salt then mound crabmeat salt and pepper. Top with Colby cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves 1.

title: Fcc Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer only for about 2 hours. Do not boil. Add more catsup and salt if vinegar is too strong.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water with salt until tender; drain. Add tuna cheese onion margarine soup and milk. Mix well. Place in baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Beat butter and cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar and beat until light. Add egg yolk grated orange rind and vanilla. Add flour and salt. Knead into dough. Form into 1 1/2-inch diameter rolls chill 1 hour or longer. Use dough in cookie gun or slice and press with bottom of glass (dipped in sugar after each cookie). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Easy Sausage Swirls
instructions: Separate rolls into 4 rectangles. Spread with mustard. Spread with thin layer of sausage. Roll up and chill. Slice each roll into 10 swirls. Place on ungreased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour 1/2 mixture into prepared skillet. Spread cheese over this. Add remaining mixture over cheese. Bake as you would cornbread. If you would like cornbread to be hot add 1 to 2 pods of hot pepper.

title: Berried Delight
instructions: Combine crumbs and sugar. Mix in butter. Press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Beat cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in half of topping. Spread over crust. Arrange berries in even layer. Mix pudding with cold milk as directed on package. Pour over berries. Chill several hours or overnight. Just before serving spread rest of Cool Whip and garnish with whole berries.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Combine carrots raisins nuts and apples; pour lemon juice over and stir. Let stand 5 minutes. Then mix sour cream and mayonnaise and mix together. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli buds discarding thick stems. Peel and chop onion. Mix broccoli onion cheese and bacon in bowl. Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar and add to broccoli. Marinate at least 8 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well pour into dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix uncooked oatmeal in boiling water. Let stand 10 minutes then add brown sugar white sugar oleo eggs flour baking soda cocoa and 1 cup chocolate chips. Pour into 11 x 7-inch greased pan. Sprinkle on top 1 cup chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Spiced Almonds
instructions: Beat egg white until foamy. Add almonds tossing to coat. In small bowl combine remaining sugar and spices; toss with almonds to coat. Spread on greased baking sheet in single layer. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and break apart. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to directions on bag and drain. Saute onions green peppers and celery. Stir together tuna pimentos tomatoes mushrooms soup and water until blended well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted and casserole is hot.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Use 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Mix all ingredients well (except almonds). Place in dish and cover with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Lamb
instructions: In one dish mix salt pepper and garlic. Make slits in the lamb and insert the garlic. Put the meat in a roasting pan. Rub the meat with the rest of the salt and pepper mixture. Pour lemon juice over the meat. Peel potatoes and cut into pieces. Do the same as with meat (rub with salt pepper and lemon juice). Add the potatoes to the pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 2 to 3 hours. Good Luck! and Kali Oreksi!! (have a good appetite).

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Place pie filling in long dish. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples sprinkle dry cake mix over sugar mixture. Cut margarine up over cake mix. Sprinkle nuts over the top of the margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Muddy Animal Crackers
instructions: Place chocolate chips and vegetable shortening in a medium microwave-safe bowl. Cover and microwave on High 2 minutes or until chips are melted. Stir at 1 minute. Stir in nuts. Dip animal crackers in the chocolate mixture. Remove with a fork. Place on waxed paper and refrigerate until cool.

title: Tomato Fans
instructions: Rinse vegetables; pat dry. Core tomatoes. Slice each very thin vertically to but not through bottom. Slice cucumbers thinly. Insert cucumber slices between tomato slices. Place tomato fans on lettuce-lined plates. Yield 4 servings.

title: Piccalilli
instructions: Mix together cabbage tomatoes peppers and onions. Mix with salt and let stand overnight. Next morning drain and press to remove all liquid possible.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: With mixer on low speed beat egg yolk in large mixer bowl until softened (about 30 seconds). Add the sugar egg yolk and vanilla; beat until fluffy. With mixer on low speed beat until well mixed. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes and mash. Measure out 2 cups mix with eggs 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/2 of margarine milk nutmeg and cinnamon. Pour into greased casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Mix corn flakes brown sugar nuts and remaining butter. Spread over casserole and bake 10 more minutes.

title: Alma'S Biscuits
instructions: Mix together; bake in quick oven for 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs melted butter and sugar. Press into a well-greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish.

title: Crayfish Salad(Yield: 4 Servings)
instructions: Put crayfish into a large saucepan of boiling water. Bring to a boil then simmer about 5 minutes until they turn red. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool. Set aside about 4 crayfish for garnish. Peel the rest twisting off the heads and peeling away the tail shells; set aside.

title: Heidi'S Crock-Pot Or Slow Cook Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken; pat dry. Brush with butter; salt and pepper. Pour dry salad dressing over it. Turn on crock-pot or slow cooker; cook for 5 to 6 hours. Forty-five minutes before its done mix the cream cheese wine onion and soup in a pot over low heat; stir until smooth. Pour over chicken; cook 30 minutes more. Serve over wide egg noodles.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Break cake up in pieces. Make layers of cake in bowl and layer other ingredients as listed. End with Cool Whip coconut and nuts.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam. Melt margarine in baking dish. After it is melted add the rest of the ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Penuche
instructions: Mix sugar and milk together and cook until it forms a soft ball in water. Remove from stove and add a piece of butter the size of a walnut. Add vanilla. Stir in nuts and pour out on a greased platter to cool. Cut into squares.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Wash tomatoes off; slice to desired size. Let dry on paper towel. Mix corn meal salt pepper and paprika in bowl or bag. Coat tomatoes in mixture. Place coated tomatoes in hot vegetable oil and fry until golden brown.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar well. Add eggs one at a time. Mix dry ingredients or sift together. Add 3 cups of the flour alternately with the canned milk. Add vanilla. The other 1 cup of flour should be used on rolling surface. Bake about 8 to 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. (If this browns cookies too rapidly reduce to 325\u00b0.) Cool and frost.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onions in 3 tablespoons butter. Add thyme and wine. Simmer until liquid is reduced to 1/4 cup.

title: Sand Cups
instructions: Pour milk into large bowl and add pudding mix. Beat with whisk until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in Cool Whip and half of crushed cookies. Place 1 tablespoon crushed cookies in cups. Fill cups 3/4 full with pudding mixture. Top with remaining cookie crumbs. Refrigerate 1 hour. Decorate.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt morsels and peanut butter together. Add noodles and drop on wax paper. Let cool.

title: Waffles
instructions: I mix milk and waffle batter and flour together. I cook it. All I know is after that you put the syrup on it and eat it.

title: Cherry-Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar egg yolk and extract together until smooth. Remove rolls from cans. Save 4 pieces of dough and arrange the other 12 pieces on 15 inch baking stone with the long points in the center. The pieces will hang over the edge of the baking stone. Push the dough together to cover the stone leaving the center open. Fold up the center tips of dough to leave hole in the middle. Spread cream cheese mixture over dough. Top with pie filling. Press perforations on saved dough and cut lengthwise into 8 strips. Twist each strip and lay over filling like spokes on a wheel. Fold dough over spokes around outer edge and also fold tips of dough in center. Brush dough with beaten egg white.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Layer this twice in punch bowl and top with nuts.

title: Green Bean Bake
instructions: In a 5-quart microwave container spread 2 cans of green beans. On top of that spread 1/3 of onion rings. Mix Cheddar cheese soup with 3/4 cup of water and stir until smooth then pour 1/2 of this over onion rings. Repeat for second layer placing last of onion rings on top. Microwave until warm and bubbly throughout.

title: Chicken Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook shells 8 to 10 minutes (do not cook until completely done). Mix cooked chicken peas carrots mayonnaise Stove Top stuffing and chopped onions. Stuff into shells.

title: Katy'S Crispy Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Crush Rice Krispies in a Ziploc plastic bag with a rolling pin. In the meantime melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan in the oven. Shake each piece of chicken in bag with crushed Rice Krispies separately. Be sure each piece is coated. Place chicken in pan. Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes turning once with 15 minutes left to go.

title: Vegetable Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and roll in nuts or bacon bits. Chill.

title: Corn Spoonbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except Swiss cheese. Pour into a 6 x 10-inch pan or casserole dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over top and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Quick Apple Pie
instructions: Cut apples into a Pyrex dish. Mix together flour sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Top with oatmeal and pour melted margarine over oatmeal. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Natural Dog Biscuits(Excellent For That Pampered Pet!)
instructions: Oil cookie sheet. Mix dry ingredients; add oil. Mix in egg and other ingredients. Add water so mixture forms a ball. Roll out to 1/4-inch thick and cut. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve. Serve with fresh fruit. Great with strawberries grapes pineapple apples peaches and any other fruit you like.

title: Copper Carrot Pennies
instructions: Slice carrots and boil in salty water until tender. When cool alternate layers of carrots and thinly cut slices of pepper and onion. Make a marinade of remaining ingredients heating well until blended. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate.

title: Veggie Casserole
instructions: Mix together veggies cheese sugar and mayonnaise. Put into Pam-sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix crackers and margarine. Put on top of casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place bread cubes in lightly greased 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle with raisins. Combine eggs sugar salt cinnamon vanilla and milk; beat well. Pour over bread cubes. Set casserole in baking pan in about 1-inch hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 65 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg yellows together. Add flour spices and milk. Fold in egg whites. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Cheese Puff
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix rest then add broccoli and cheese. Place in 1 1/2-quart dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until sides are lightly browned.

title: Squash Or Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole dish that has been sprayed. Cook 40 minutes at 375 degrees.

title: Noodles Alfredo
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on package. Do not overcook! Drain well but do not rinse. Meanwhile in a medium-size skillet saute garlic in butter. Add parsley salt and pepper half and half and Parmesan cheese. Stir over heat but do not boil. Place pasta in heated bowl. Pour sauce over pasta and serve. Serves 4.

title: Col. Sanders Style Chicken Coating
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Melt butter in saucepan. Coat chicken in dry mixture. Place chicken in baking dish and drizzle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. You can also use this coating for pan-frying the chicken.

title: Calico Bean Bake
instructions: Brown hamburger bacon and onion; drain off grease. Combine browned meat with the remaining ingredients and put into a casserole. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Walnut Rolls
instructions: In a small bowl combine water yeast and the 1 teaspoon sugar. Stir to dissolve yeast. Set aside.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Cream butter and sugar add crushed pretzels. Bake in 375 degree oven for 10 minutes. Dissolve jello in boiling water 2 cups. Stir well. Add strawberries. Put in refrigerator until almost congealed. Mix cool whip with sugar. Pile on top of baked pretzels pour strawberries and jello mixture on top of cream cheese. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Easy Cobbler
instructions: In casserole dish melt 1 stick margarine. Mix flour sugar and milk. Pour over fruit. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Serve with ice cream or Cool Whip.

title: Easy Snack Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in a tightly covered container.

title: Transparent Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and mix together until smooth. Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake until done. Knife inserted in filling should come out clean.

title: Best Meat Loaf
instructions: Crumble ground beef in a large bowl. Add 1/2 can mushroom soup diced onion eggs milk and salt. Mix crackers in until desired texture for loaf. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven. Top with 1/2 can mushroom soup.

title: Cornbread Pie
instructions: Brown the beef and onion in a skillet. Drain. Add the soup water seasonings corn and green peppers. Mix well and allow to simmer 15 minutes. Then fill a greased pie dish or casserole 3/4 full leaving room for the cornbread topping. (Jiffy mix cornbread can be used.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix. Put in greased dish for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Grate 3/4 cup cheese. Bake until brown.

title: Best Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. In a bowl cut Crisco into flour. Then add buttermilk to mixture. Mix well. Turn out on floured board. Knead lightly. Bake 12 minutes. This will make 6 biscuits.

title: Menehune Chicken
instructions: Disjoint chicken wings discard tips. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Add chicken cover and marinate 30 minutes. Remove chicken and place in a shallow baking dish skin side down. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn pieces and baste with marinade and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Potatoes Consulate
instructions: Cut slice off one-side so potato lies firm. Slice down in 1/8-inch slices to about 1/4-inch from bottom (flat side). Place in oiled baking pan. Brush with butter.

title: My Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter separately until its soft and light. Add sugar gradually creaming together after each addition until fluffy. When sugar and butter are thoroughly blended add eggs cream and lemon rind. Beat until well blended. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to sugar mixture a little at a time. Beat until smooth. Turn dough onto floured board and roll into thin sheet. Sprinkle with sugar and cut with cookie cutter. Bake in a hot 400\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes.

title: Icebox Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine all vegetables and set aside. Bring to a boil all other ingredients. Cool slightly and pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Keeps good for several days.

title: Honey-Glazed Chicken
instructions: Place flour salt and cayenne in a bowl or bag. Add chicken pieces one at a time to coat with mixture. Pour melted oleo into 9 x 13-inch pan; place chicken in pan turn once to coat. Bake uncovered skin side up at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 another 45 minutes or until tender basting several times with pan drippings. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese Barbeques
instructions: Mix cheese green pepper onions eggs and olives in food processor or grinder. Add tomato soup and butter. Mix well. Spread on 1/2 buns and put under broiler until cheese melt.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Combine molasses boiling water and baking soda. Pour over prepared shell. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until filling is set and crumbs golden brown.

title: Best Peach Pie
instructions: Fill uncooked crust with quartered peaches stone side up. Do\tnot use too many peaches. Make mixture of sugar butter flour water and egg.

title: Sour Milk Cake
instructions: In a bowl dissolve the soda in the sour milk. Add sugar salt and shortening. Mix well. Sift in the dry ingredients. Mix well. Add the cup of your chosen fruit; mix in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes.

title: Fake Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Spread bread with mustard or mayonnaise. Put smoked turkey or ham on one slice of bread. Weight Watchers cheese on the other slice of bread. Squeeze all of the juice out of kraut and put on meat. Wrap in foil and put in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Matzo Balls
instructions: Beat yolks and whites separately. Beat whites until almost stiff then in fold egg yolks. Add salt and Matzo meal. Stir until smooth. Refrigerate or set aside for about 30 minutes. Form into small balls by rolling in palms of hands (dampen palms with cold water). Drop into gently boiling clear chicken broth. Allow to boil slowly (covered) for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Custard Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to package directions. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Yellow Or Zucchini Squash Casserole
instructions: Coat 1/2 cubes in margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix squash sour cream soup carrot onion and green chilies. Spread over cubes. Top with remaining cubes. Sprinkle with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Chocolate Syrup
instructions: Boil cocoa sugar hot water and salt for 3 minutes then add vanilla. Put in jar and cool. Keep in refrigerator. Makes 2 cups of syrup. Great for chocolate milk or ice cream topping.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix cream cheese and Miracle Whip until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate. Serve with assorted crackers and vegetables. Makes 2 cups.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt 3 times. Beat egg whites stiff; set aside. Cream butter and sugar; add beaten egg yolks. Beat together. Add the flour mixture with milk. Fold in egg whites and vanilla. Lastly add the floured blueberries. Place in floured and greased bread pan or muffin tins. Sprinkle top of batter lightly with sugar. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly except tomato sauce. Put into loaf pan and cover with 2 strips of bacon. Pour the tomato sauce over all. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Cookies
instructions: You also need a mini-muffin pan.

title: Frozen Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Mix flour oleo brown sugar and chopped nuts until crumbly. Press into 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until light brown. Cool then break into crumbs. Put back into 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Save some crumbs to sprinkle on top.

title: Fruity Yogurt Muffins
instructions: Combine rhubarb and 2 tablespoons of flour in a small bowl. Toss well and set aside.

title: 7-Up Cherry Salad
instructions: Combine water and cherry pie filling in pan and bring to a boil. Remove from stove. Add both packages cherry jello and stir until dissolved. Add 1 can 7-Up very slowly. Place in the refrigerator until jelled. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Grandma'S Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: In a 6-quart pot over medium to high heat 1 to 2 tablespoons of oil. Brown chicken on both sides; remove. Saute onion 2 to 3 minutes. Add mushrooms; continue to saute until mushrooms are golden brown and onion is soft. Add wine and scrape pot with wooden spoon. Add remaining ingredients; stir and cover. Reduce heat and cook about 1 hour. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in pineapple. Add flour sifted with baking powder. Mix well and pour in an 11 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Opal'S Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together and place in ovensafe ware. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: California Carrots
instructions: Cook and stir carrots and celery in butter and water until crisp-tender about 5 minutes. Stir in sugar and lemon juice.

title: Melting Moments Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Make into small balls and flatten on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Cream butter and vanilla. Add sugar egg yolks sour cream and baking soda. Fold in flour poppy seed and egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour in angel food cake pan.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Quick Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain fat. Spoon into 8-inch baking dish. Top with pizza sauce and cheese. Mix biscuit mix milk and eggs. Pour evenly over casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pecan Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat egg with pecans in blender. Add mixture to flour salt and baking powder and mix well. Roll on floured board and wrap in wax paper. Makes 5 to 6 rolls. Chill.

title: Mini Cherry Cheese Cake
instructions: Place cupcake liners in muffin pan with one vanilla wafer in\teach. Cream sugar and cream cheese together. Add eggs; blend in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour over wafer in muffin pan 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake for 15 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Cool; then spoon 1 teaspoon pie filling on top.

title: Marshmallow Pudding(Without Marshmallows)
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water. Add 1/2 cup boiling water. Set aside to cool while beating egg whites.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown bacon and ground beef; drain. Mix in the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Abby'S Choco-Chip Cakes
instructions: Preheat griddle to 375 degrees.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil. Add chocolate chips. Mix while mixture cools. Frost cake.

title: Icebox Fruitcake
instructions: Chop cherries and nuts. Roll crackers into crumbs. Melt margarine and marshmallows. Combine marshmallow mixture with crumbs and cherry liquid. Add cherries raisins and nuts.

title: Panhandle Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain. Layer sausage cheeses and chilies in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix eggs milk and flour until well blended. Pour over layered mixture. Decorate top with chili strips in lattice design. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook over medium heat until thickened.\tPour into pie crusts; top with crust. Cut slits in top crusts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35-45 minutes or until crust is done. Makes 2 pies.

title: Rice Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and rice in oil until rice is soft. Add all ingredients. Mix in casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be made ahead frozen thawed then baked.

title: After Dinner Mints
instructions: Combine egg white cream vanilla oil flavoring and desired amount of coloring. Mix well. Add sugar all at once mixing thoroughly. Add butter and additional sugar if necessary to make mixture firm. Shape into balls.

title: Press In Pie Dough
instructions: Mix oil and milk. Put dry ingredients together and mix with fork then add oil and milk mixture. Press in a 9-inch pie plate and stick with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix and bring to a boil. Boil 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool and beat until thick. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla when cool.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar eggs salt and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Add flour and soda. Then mix together milk and poppy seed and add to mixture. Add chopped walnuts pineapple (drained) and maraschino cherries (drained). Pour into a non-stick tube pan. Bake at 350 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add shortening eggs milk and vanilla; mix well. Add bananas and walnuts; put in greased bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chili Non Carne(No Salt)
instructions: In large pot saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft. Mix in chili powder basil oregano and cumin. Stir in zucchini and carrots until well blended cooking for about 1 minute over low heat stirring occasionally. Stir in chopped tomatoes undrained and drained kidney beans. Bring to boil then reduce heat and simmer 30 to 45 minutes until thick. Top with chopped fresh onion tomatoes lettuce or green peppers.

title: Cake
instructions: First you pout the flower in a bowl then you pout the eggs in it and vanala then you pout sugar milk in it than you pout it in a pot. Then you put it in a avin then you pout sprincels then your done.

title: Hamburger Salami
instructions: Mix well; shape into rolls. Wrap in Saran Wrap. Refrigerate overnight. In the morning bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 on rack over pan for drainage.

title: Hi-Ho Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar then beat again. Add baking powder. Beat again for 1 minute. Crush crackers and stir into mixture with spoon. Stir in nuts. Cook on 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool. Add Cool Whip before serving.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well. Store in canister. Use 1/4 to 1/3 cup mix per 1 cup beverage. Pour boiling water over. Stir and serve!

title: Crisp Toffee Bars
instructions: Cream together butter brown sugar and vanilla. Add flour; mix well. Add chocolate chips and nuts; blend. Press out firmly onto a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut bars while warm. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Mindie'S Stir-Fried Onions
instructions: Cut up onions. Cover with butter salt pepper and garlic. Fry until tender. Keep turning every 2 minutes or so. (You may need more butter; depending on preference of taste.)

title: Tra-La-La
instructions: You can make as little or as much as you want! Mix equal parts. Add brewed coffee to taste. Top with whipped cream. Invite your friends! Makes great gifts at Christmastime!

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Simmer onion in butter until soft. Stir in flour salt and celery salt. Gradually add milk and liquid from peas (1/2 cup). Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick and smooth. Combine sauce peas and macaroni in casserole. Put thinly sliced meat on top; bake 1/2 hour.

title: Jesse Stuart'S Cheese Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Stir in chopped parsley coarse pepper and bottled hot sauce to taste. Simmer 30 minutes. Drop in cheese and stir until it melts. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine flour sugar and baking powder. Mix egg butter milk and add to dry ingredients blending well. Add blueberries. Batter will be lumpy.

title: Applesauce Dessert Waffles
instructions: Toast waffles according to package directions. In a small saucepan combine syrup applesauce and cinnamon. Cook and stir over medium heat 3 minutes. Place heated waffles on any dessert-style plate. Top each waffle with frozen yogurt. Spoon warm applesauce mixture over yogurt. Serve immediately.

title: Charleston Oysters
instructions: Combine bread and cracker crumbs and mix with butter. Put a thin layer in bottom of baking dish and cover with layer of oysters. Season with salt and pepper. Add 1/2 of cream and oyster liquor. Repeat and cover with remaining crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes at 450\u00b0. Never have more than 2 layers of oysters.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar and flour. Mix well and stir in all of pineapple. Melt margarine in skillet. Add cubed bread and turn until light brown. Put on top of pineapple mixture.

title: Seven Course Dinner
instructions: Layer ingredients in order given in buttered casserole adding salt pepper and rice each time. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Blackberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add 1 cup juice from fruit. Add drained fruit and chill until firm. Combine cream cheese sugar sour cream and vanilla. Spread over jello and chill until firm. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts (9 x 13-inch pan).

title: Luscious Layered Blueberry Delight
instructions: Line 9-inch square pan with whole graham crackers breaking where needed. Prepare pudding as directed on package; let stand 5 minutes then blend in whipped topping. Spread half the pudding mixture over the crackers. Add another layer of crackers. Top with remaining pudding mixture and then remaining crackers. Spread pie filling over top of crackers. Chill 3 hours. Makes 9 servings.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Pack cucumbers in large Mason jar or bowl. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over cucumbers. Refrigerate.

title: Pepperoni Roll
instructions: Thaw bread dough for 4 hours (dont thaw overnight it will rise). Flour surface. Roll out thawed dough into a rectangle. Spread sauce over dough overlap pepperoni on top of sauce. Put cheese on top of pepperoni. Roll up filled dough into a tube shape. Fold under ends. Pinch seams together. Place on cookie sheet. Bake according to bread dough directions. Periodically brush dough with milk to aid in browning. Cool.

title: Orange Dip
instructions: Place cream cheese and concentrate in blender or food processor; cover. Blend until smooth. Refrigerate and then serve with assorted fruit dippers.

title: Mexican Bean Spread
instructions: Blend ingredients in a food processor or blender adding more ketchup if needed for desired consistency. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Roll out into small balls; drop on cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Egg And Ham Brunch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate mix for 12 hours before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Mock Reuben Sandwiches
instructions: Spread ham thick on bread. Layer Swiss cheese and sauerkraut. Top with Thousand Island dressing. Spread outside of bread with butter and grill as you would grilled cheese.

title: Coney Island Topping For Hot Dogs
instructions: In frypan put oil; add meat and the spices. Add water and cook slow about 1 hour. Add more water if it becomes dry.

title: Dutch Almond Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter sugar egg and almond flavoring then add flour. Make round balls with teaspoonful of dough. Beat another egg. Take a glass and dip in raw egg and flatten balls of dough. Top with sliced almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Baby Ruth Cookies
instructions: Place cornflakes in a large mixing bowl and set aside. In a large saucepan combine corn syrup brown sugar and sugar. Bring to a boil stirring often. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and peanuts; mix well. Pour over cornflakes. Blend. Spread evenly in a well oiled 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over surface. Bake 10 minutes at 250\u00b0. Remove and smooth over top. Cool and cut in 1-inch squares.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large pan. While the ground beef is cooking cut the Velveeta cheese into cubes. After the ground beef is cooked drain. Put ground beef back into pan and put Velveeta cheese in with the ground beef on medium heat. add the enchilada sauce and chili. Stir occasionally until cheese is melted. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Boiled Raisin Cake
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients together; boil for 5 minutes and cool. Add rest of ingredients; blend well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Carrot-Zucchini Bread(Dietetic)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Sift together flour cinnamon baking powder soda and salt. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Gradually add Sugar Twin beating until thick. Add flour mixture to liquid ingredients all at once and stir just until combined. Stir in carrots and zucchini. Pour batter into pan. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes. Remove bread from pan and cool completely. Cut into 16 slices. Yield 16 servings.

title: Cauliflower Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt Cheez Whiz along with soup in a pan. Cook vegetables until almost tender. Combine ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Put onion rings on the last 10 minutes.

title: Ho Ho Cake
instructions: Combine the cake mix flour and pudding. Add the oil eggs and milk. Beat on medium speed about 2 minutes or until well mixed. Pour into 4 greased cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or tested done. Cool.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Separate eggs reserving egg whites for meringue. Beat egg yolks. Combine powdered sugar with peanut butter. Blend until crumbly. Spread 3/4 mixture into pie shell. Combine sugar salt and scalded milk together and mix well. Pour small amount over egg yolks and mix well. Return to mixture. Cook in double boiler until mixture thickens. It should look like pudding. Add butter and vanilla. Remove from heat and pour into pie shell. Top with meringue and sprinkle top with balance of peanut butter crumbs. Add shaved chocolate for decoration and taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 until meringue is brown.

title: Butterscotch Candy
instructions: In a double boiler melt morsels. Remove from heat add noodles and nuts. Stir until well mixed. Spoon on waxed paper and cool. Can be frozen or sealed in airtight container.

title: Powder Puff Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add egg. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add vanilla and then nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Fruitful Squares
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cream brown sugar and butter; add eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture a little at a time. Mix well. Add the rest of the ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. When cooled cut into 2 x 2-inch squares.

title: Swiss Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients with 1/4 cup tomato sauce and form into loaf. Bake in shallow baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Spoon remaining tomato sauce over top cover with cheese slices and garnish with parsley continue baking 15 minutes.

title: Saucy Skillet Pasta
instructions: In a large skillet brown ground beef with onion. Stir in tomatoes reserved liquid water loose tea salt and pepper. Bring to a boil; stir in uncooked macaroni. Simmer covered stirring occasionally 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Top with cheese. Makes about 6 servings.

title: The Cleveland Special Fried Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken pieces with garlic powder lemon pepper and salt. Season the flour with paprika and dip chicken into this mixture. Fry in deep hot fat until golden brown and crispy.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs with fork.\tAdd sugar vanilla milk bread and margarine.\tPour into greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until thick and brown about 25 minutes.

title: Hot Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix Treet cheese onion and hot sauce. Cut crust from slices of bread. Roll bread with rolling pin and spread with meat mixture. Roll up jelly roll fashion and cut in halves or thirds. Place seam side down on a baking sheet. Brush with melted butter and garnish with paprika. Broil about 8 inches from heat until golden brown and cheese melts. Serve hot. Makes 12 to 16.

title: Lentil Pot Pie
instructions: Cook vegetables in broth. Brown flour. Add 1 cup of hot liquid from vegetables. Cook until thickened and combine with rest of vegetable mixture. Add lentils sage parsley and salt. Cover with pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Braised Pork Chops Ala Dorner
instructions: In a frying pan or electric frying pan add one teaspoon of olive oil. Cover one side of the pork with paprika and brown (takes about 3 to 5 minutes). While browning put paprika on the other side and brown that also. After both sides are brown reduce heat to a very slow simmer and add the contents of one small can of the soup. Do not add additional water (makes it far too dilute). Cover chops and simmer for about 30 minutes depending on the thickness of the chops. In a separate pot cook the rice or noodles until they are done. Drain and add to the pork chops about ten minutes before they are done. This will make a rich gravy the rice or noodles will be coated with the gravy and hopefully if you have done it right the chops will be moist and tender. I serve this with a green vegetable and applesauce. Do not overcook.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Mix onion and hamburger. Brown. Add cheese. Melt into mixture. Add oregano spaghetti sauce and tomato paste. Stir. Put mixture on buns or English muffins. Top with shredded Mozzarella cheese. Place under broiler for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Three-Bean Salad(Club Member: Jason Harvey)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stay in refrigerator overnight. Will keep for 2 or 3 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook mushrooms and onion in butter for 3 minutes. Remove and put in saucepan with beef stock (or bouillon cubes with water). Add floured 1-inch cubes of round steak or beef cubes. Add more butter if needed. Brown quickly then put in saucepan of beef stock. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. Cover tightly and cook 1 hour or until meat is tender. Add 1 package of gravy mix. Ten minutes before serving stir in sour cream. Serve with or on top of wide noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Shirley Clarke'S No Roll Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and shortening well. Beat in egg and milk then add dry ingredients and extract. Roll into balls about the size of a walnut. Dip each ball into granulated sugar and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass to desired thickness. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes until delicately browned.

title: Potatoes Chantilly
instructions: Mash potatoes with butter and Carnation milk. Put in 13 x 9 glass dish. Melt slowly Old English cheese with 1 stick butter and enough Carnation to make sauce consistency. Pour sauce over potatoes. Saute fresh mushrooms in butter until tender. Spread mushrooms over potatoes and sauce. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 25 minutes or until peaks turn brown.

title: Fry Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Sprinkle work surface with flour. Roll out dough. Cut in strips of desired widths. Fry in hot oil about 1-inch in skillet or deeper in deep fryer until golden brown on both sides.

title: Recipe For A Happy Family
instructions: Mix thoroughly and sprinkle with awareness. Bake in moderate oven of everyday life using as fuel all the grudges and past unpleasantness. Cool. Turn out onto a platter of cheerfulness. Garnish with tears and laughter. Serve God country and community.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Butter bread and cut into 1 inch cubes. Beat egg; add milk. Put bread in 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam or butter. Pour eggs and milk over bread. Put sausage on top. Cover with grated cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Loaf
instructions: Combine shortening and sugar in large bowl; mix well. Add egg; blend. Add remaining ingredients; stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn into greased floured bread pan. Sprinkle topping over mixture.

title: Sloppy Bob'S
instructions: Brown ground meat and drain all fat and water. Add all other ingredients and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix until crumbly the flour brown sugar butter and oil. Reserve 1/2 cup. Add syrup egg warm water and water mixed with baking soda. Beat mixture until smooth. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 and then 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans; add onion and pepper. Mix together vinegar salad oil sugar and salt. Add to bean mixture. Toss to blend. Refrigerate for several hours. Drain and serve.

title: Campfire Goulash
instructions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven saute sausage until lightly browned on both sides. Add onion and saute until transparent. Add potatoes and sauce mix. Gradually stir in water. Bring to a boil and cover. Simmer for 15 minutes stirring often. Add tomatoes and green pepper. Mix well. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes longer. Yields 6 servings.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Dice rhubarb into unbaked pie shell. Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Slowly adding whipping cream. Pour over rhubarb. Sprinkle nutmeg over pie. Bake 50 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven or until set in middle.

title: Spicy Texas Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain and add onions and green pepper. Saute. Stir in tomatoes rice chili powder salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Salmon Burgers
instructions: Drain salmon reserving 1/3 cup liquid. Flake. Cook onion in oil until tender. Add salmon liquid 1/3 cup crumbs eggs spices and salmon; mix well. Shape into 6 cakes; roll in crumbs. Fry in a heavy pan in about 1/8 inch of oil over moderate heat. Brown on one side. Turn carefully; brown on other side. Total cooking time is 5 to 8 minutes. Drain on paper towel. Place on buns. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Potatoes And Pennies
instructions: Put potatoes celery onions and franks in a casserole or slow cooker. Combine soup and milk and pour over potatoes. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. This can be made early in the day and put in a slow cooker.

title: Crab Stroganoff
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. In skillet over medium heat cook mushrooms in butter until all liquid is absorbed. Stir in undiluted soup milk and wine (increase milk to 1 1/4 cups if not using wine). Cook until sauce boils. Reduce heat. Add crabmeat peas and sour cream. Heat through; do not boil. Toss with noodles and parsley.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Put 3 tablespoons of margarine in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Microwave at High until melted 30 seconds to 1 minute. Blend in flour salt mustard pepper and cayenne pepper. Stir in milk. Microwave on High until thickened 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Line 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan with foil extending foil over edges. Butter foil. Set pan aside. Butter sides of heavy 3-quart saucepan. Combine sugar milk and butter in prepared saucepan and bring to boil stirring over medium-high heat. Clip candy thermometer to side of pan. Cook and stir over medium heat to 236\u00b0 soft-ball stage (about 12 minutes). Remove saucepan from heat; remove thermometer. Add peanut butter chips marshmallow cream peanuts and vanilla; stir until chips are melted. Spread in prepared pan. Score into square while warm. When firm cut fudge into squares. Store in refrigerator. Serves 36.

title: Rotel Dip
instructions: Heat cheese in slow cooker until melted. Add tomatoes. Keep hot to serve with tortilla chips or little Smokies.

title: Mediterranean Chicken With Artichokes
instructions: In medium bowl combine mushrooms onions oil garlic tomato sauce and\tpaste.\tAdd wine olives basil oregano salt and pepper. Stir to mix ingredients. Remove and discard skin from chicken parts. Place chicken in 2-quart microwave safe rectangular dish.\tArrange chicken so that meatier areas are toward outside of\tdish (if using breasts turn them bone side up). Pour\ttomato\tmixture over chicken and cover dish lightly with wax paper. Microwave on High 10 minutes. Turn each piece of\tchicken over. Spoon sauce over chicken. Cover with waxed paper and\tmicrowave on High 10 to 12 minutes. Place artichoke hearts in baking dish spacing among chicken. Sprinkle cheese over all. Cover with waxed paper and let stand 5 minutes. If reheating is necessary microwave on High 2 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Low-Fat Vanilla Pudding
instructions: In mixing bowl combine milk yogurt pudding mix and vanilla. Beat on high speed for 2 minutes. Spoon into serving dishes. Chill.

title: Freezer Tomato Sauce
instructions: Bring slowly to boil stirring often. Lower heat and simmer 30 minutes or until thick. Cool slightly. Measure 3 cups at a time into a blender or food processor. Cover and process on high until smooth (about 1 minute). Pour into freezer containers in serving sizes leaving 1/4-inch headroom. Seal label and freeze. Makes 16 cups.

title: Sherry'S Ohio Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring oleo water and cocoa to a rolling boil. Sift together in a separate bowl the sugar flour and salt. In large bowl beat together eggs buttermilk vanilla baking powder and baking soda. Add first and second mixture to third mixture. Mix well. Batter will be thin. Pour in cookie sheet pan (11 1/2 x 17 1/2 x 1-inch). Grease and flour if not nonstick. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix with sugar then other ingredients. Place in graham cracker crust. Chill before serving.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix as given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes in 2 pans 8 x 4-inches.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Squares
instructions: Butter a 9 x 9-inch pan. Heat chips 1/2 syrup and butter in 2-quart saucepan over low heat stirring until smooth. Remove from heat; stir in 2 cups of cereal until well coated. Spread in pan. Heat peanut butter remaining syrup and the vanilla. Remove from heat when smooth; stir in remaining cereal until well coated. Spread over mixture in pan. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Potatoes Au Gratin With Sausage
instructions: Slice potatoes and sausage into 1/4-inch round pieces. Place potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Cover with thinly sliced pieces of margarine. Place sliced sausage on top of layered potatoes. Add sliced cheese to cover sausage. Repeat ending with cheese as top layer. Pour milk evenly over mixture. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Myrtle'S Marshmallow Orange Dessert
instructions: Melt the marshmallows with the orange juice in a double boiler. Cool and add the whipped cream. Refrigerate in a 9 x 9-inch pan.

title: Iowa Cookies
instructions: Mix together first 7 ingredients; mix together and add remaining ingredients. Place a spoonful or larger if you like on cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Honey Pecan Barbecue Sauce(From Dakota'S Restaurant, Dallas: Yields 1 Quart)
instructions: Saute onion in\toil. Add peppers and garlic and saute. Add remaining ingredients and cook 40 minutes and strain.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Mix soups enchilada sauce green chilies and hamburger in a bowl. Cover bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with the hamburger mixture. Layer tortillas on top of mixture. Layer cheese on top of this. Layer like this ending up with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour. Save 1/4 of the dough to dot the top. Spread out remainder of dough in jelly roll pan 10 1/2 x 15 1/2-inch. Spread with Smuckers apricot preserves and sprinkle with chopped pecans if desired. With teaspoon dot remaining dough on top. Bake for 30 minutes. When cool cut into bars.

title: Stove Top Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and put in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together stuffing mix water and oleo. Put on top of chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: All-Night Drop Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium size bowl with electric mixer at high speed beat egg white and salt until soft peaks form. Beat in sugar 1 tablespoon at a time until stiff and glossy. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto foil covered cookie sheets. Place in oven close door turn oven off; do not open door. Leave cookies in oven at least overnight. Remove from foil; stor in airtight containers. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Mom'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; mix all ingredients. Add salt and pepper to season and chili powder for taste. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until yolks and whites are blended. Add sugar salt nutmeg and vanilla. Mix well. Add milk slowly stirring. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in hot oven 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake for 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted into center comes out clean. Makes one pie.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients in a jar. Shake well. Pour over spinach; toss gently. Garnish with crumbled bacon and egg slices. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wipe mushrooms with damp cloth. Remove stems. Chop and set aside.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Melt butter and sugar. Add 2 ounces of the Mountain Dew to the mixture. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring. Roll out crescent rolls pulling apart the sections. (You should have 8 sections.) Using one section at a time roll 1 quarter section of apples within the rolls. Seal the edges together. Place the rolled sections in a baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Pour remaining Mountain Dew over the top of the sections. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: Mix well. Serve 2 teaspoons per cup in hot water.

title: Everything Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given and drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake about 5 minutes on bottom rack and another 5 minutes on top rack. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Double Fudge Brownie Bar
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Grease bottom only of 3 x 9 inch pan.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Soak lentils in large bowl overnight. Cover with water to soak. In large pot saute onion celery and carrots in oil. Add soaked lentils in water tomatoes seasonings and sugar. Cook until lentils soften. Add water if too thick.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Put all ingredients in roaster. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 6 hours. Flake with fork.

title: French Peach Pie
instructions: Put peaches cut side up. Spoon mixture over peaches and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce to 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Old Tennessee Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix salt with cornmeal. Cut in shortening. Slowly pour in boiling water stirring as you pour. Beat eggs in the milk to blend well and stir in. Add baking powder and blend all ingredients well. Grease casserole and pour in ingredients. bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown on top. Stir 2 or 3 times while baking before ingredients congeal. Serve hot from casserole. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Gradually add half and half stirring constantly. Add broth. Add broccoli nutmeg and potato soup. Cook over low heat for 25 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: In a food processor grind bell and jalapeno peppers. Rinse out processor with vinegar and add vinegar to a small saucepan along with sugar and ground peppers. Bring to boil and boil briskly for 5 minutes. Skim off any foam and add pectin. Bring to boil again and boil another 1 minute. Remove from heat; skim again if necessary and pour into prepared jars and seal.

title: Poppy Cox
instructions: Mix together popped corn and pecans. Combine sugar Karo butter or margarine and salt in saucepan and stir until it boils. Cook syrup stirring occasionally for 10 to 12 minutes until it turns caramel color. Remove from fire and add vanilla. Pour over popcorn mix and stir until covered. Spread on waxed paper until cool. Break in pieces and store in a closed container.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Remove the skin from 1 whole chicken or chicken pieces (hold under warm water and pull skin off; skin removes rather easy). Place chicken or chicken pieces in pan; add enough water to cover chicken (about 5 to 6 cups). Add celery that has been cut into 1 to 2-inch pieces (including few leaves) chopped onion parsley salt and pepper. Cover and cook until tender. Add water if chicken broth decreases below desired level. Remove chicken from broth; cool and remove from bone. Be sure that small bones do not remain in broth (I strain the broth to be assured of removing all small bones). Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and set aside.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine cheese parsley and crumbs. Set aside. Salt and pepper chicken. Melt butter in medium saucepan adding garlic to flavor. Dip each breast in butter and roll in crumbs.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Bring to a boil first 3 ingredients with 2 cups water. Steep 6 tea bags in 3 cups boiling water for 7 minutes. Add last 3 ingredients and 2 quarts water.

title: Grape Wine
instructions: Place ingredients in crock jar mixing well. Cover with dish towel. Change dish towel occasionally (if mixture gets on towel). Let set in warm place for 2 weeks. Skim off foam and stir daily. Place in bottles after mixture stops working. After placing in smaller bottles cover with balloons (not caps) until mixture is done working (approximately 6 to 8 weeks).

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together the first 4 ingredients. Form into a ball. Roll in nuts until covered.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine first 9 items. Put in large baking dish (13 x 9-inch). Mix last 3 items together and sprinkle on top. Chill at least overnight. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Break up baked cake. Lay in punch bowl. Use 1/2 of crushed pineapple over crumbs press down into cake. Alternate layers of cherry pie filling pudding crushed pineapple Cool Whip and coconut and nuts on top. Chill.

title: Seafari'S Savannah Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup and bring to a boil. Add butter and slowly pour hot mixture over 3 beaten eggs. Add pecans and pour into unbaked pie shell which has been sprinkled with 1 Tbsp. sugar and 1 Tbsp. flour. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes or until done.

title: Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: Beat all ingredients in a medium bowl with a hand beater until smooth. (For thinner pancakes stir in 2 to 4 tablespoons of additional milk.) Grease a heated pan or griddle.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Beat oil and eggs until fluffy. Add berries and mix well. Combine flour soda salt and cinnamon and sugar and add to egg mixture stirring until blended. Stir in chopped pecans. Pour batter into 2 greased and lightly floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar. Cut frozen cookies and overlap on pizza pan. Bake according to package then cool completely. After completely cooled then put Cool Whip mixture on and start on outside arranging fruit; put in any order you want. Then chill and slice. Enjoy! If you want you can sprinkle coconut on top.

title: String Beans In Sour Cream And Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cook the green beans in lightly salted boiling water. Dont overcook. Drain and set aside. Melt butter in a large skillet and add onions and green pepper. Stirring occasionally cook 5 to 8 minutes until tender but not brown. Stir in tomatoes and basil. Boil rapidly 1 to 2 minutes until most of the juice has evaporated. Stir in the green beans. Mix salt sour cream chopped egg and a few grindings of pepper. Stir into hot vegetables and serve.

title: Hot Asparagus Canapes
instructions: Trim crusts from bread and cut slices of ham to fit bread. Dip each asparagus spear in mayonnaise. Fit it at one edge of bread and roll up as a jelly roll. Fasten with a toothpick. Place on broiler rack and toast. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Green Beans
instructions: Cook beans in boiling salt water until tender; drain. Heat olive oil in large skillet. Add onions parsley garlic ham and bacon; cook until ham and bacon are done. Add wine nutmeg and salt. Add beans and small amount of water if necessary. Cover; simmer until heated through. Coarse black pepper sprinkled on top can be added. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Chop bacon into bite size pieces. Fry with garlic until crisp. Drain off fat and reduce heat to warm. In the mean time beat eggs and add cream and Parmesan. Beat until blended. Add egg mixture to warm bacon and slowly warm to hot. Do not cook the eggs. While doing this have a pot of water boiling. Cook spaghetti until done but still firm. Drain and put back in the hot pan. Pour egg mixture on spaghetti and toss until the hot noodles finish cooking the eggs. Serve immediately. This is great with French bread and a green salad.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until bubbly. Remove from heat. Serve immediately as topping.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening with sugar. Add eggs. Blend well after each egg. Sift all dry ingredients. Add alternately with milk. Add vanilla and cook in a greased and floured pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Toss together and pour over mixed vegetables.

title: Beef Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Line pan with tortillas just lapping edges over each other. Layer ground beef and onions. Spread beans and 1 teaspoon salt. Place pieces of cheese over this. Season with 1 teaspoon chili powder or garlic powder. If desired another layer of tortillas. Mix soup chilies and tomatoes in separate bowl. Spread evenly over the top. Bake 1 hour turning oven to 250\u00b0 last 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Delight
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar a small amount at a time as you continue to beat whites. Crush the crackers and mix in with the egg whites. Add the pecans and flavoring. Pour into a buttered pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Put in Cool Whip and sprinkle coconut on top. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Dutch Ginger Cake
