instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and line base of 8-inch cake pan. Cut butter into flour. Stir in sugar and ginger. Bind with most of the egg. Knead dough until pliable. Turn into pan. Push down to smooth surface. Pinch edge to decorate. Using a knife mark surface lightly in a lattice. Glaze with remaining egg. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until firm to touch. Cool in pan. Serves 8.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Peel apples; put in buttered pie plate. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over apples. Cream butter sugar salt and egg; add flour and spread over apples. You can add 1/2 cup walnuts if you wish. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. This is apple pie without crust.

title: Mexican Bean Salad
instructions: Mix the above except Fritos. Add Fritos just before serving.

title: Chow Mein Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions. Cook celery (water to cover) until tender. Save the liquid. Mix all the ingredients except the noodles. Cook about 1 hour at low temperature. Before adding the noodles alternate in layers in a baking dish. Makes 6 or more servings. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Torte
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients. Mix the sugar and flour; mix together. Add vanilla. Mix the crumbs melted butter or oleo 1 cup sugar and cinnamon; mix well. Save 1 cup for topping. Use rest to make crust with fingers in glass 8 x 12-inch pan. Form crust evenly. Spoon in egg mixture carefully. Sprinkle reserved topping on top. Bake for about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour salt and baking powder together 3 times. In a separate bowl cream shortening and add peanut butter. Add sugar slowly beating thoroughly. Add eggs and beat again. Add flour mixture and milk alternately. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan in oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Check for doneness.

title: Baked Fish Florentine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Arrange fish fillets in a single layer in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Christmas Noel Coffee Braid
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water (110\u00b0). Combine milk shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add softened yeast and eggs. Beat well. Add flour sifted with cinnamon and raisins. Mix to soft dough.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli and cauliflower into florets. Shred cheese. Chop onion. Mix all ingredients together.

title: Apple Pie In A Jar
instructions: Cook until thick and bubbly. Add 3 tablespoons lemon juice. Peel and slice apples into 7 jars. Cover apples with the syrup. Process 20 minutes in water bath.

title: Bake Potatoes
instructions: Heat coals or gas grill. Spray 18 x 13-inch piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil with cooking spray. Place potatoes on foil. Drizzle with oil; sprinkle with seasoned salt. Wrap foil securely around potatoes. Grill 4 to 5-inches from medium heat 30 minutes turning once. Open packets; sprinkle cheese over potatoes. Cover loosely and let stand for 4 to 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 6 servings.

title: Saucepan Brownies
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Remove from heat and add cocoa sugar flour eggs and salt. Stir together with spoon not electric mixer. Then add vanilla extract and chopped nuts. Pour batter into greased 9 x 9-inch dish and bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Mold
instructions: Oil a 12-cup mold or Bundt pan or two 6-cup molds; set aside. In a large bowl mix cream cheese and sour cream until fluffy. Stir in fruit cocktail pineapple oranges marshmallows and walnuts. In a medium bowl whip whipping cream until stiff. Fold whipped cream into fruit mixture. Pour into prepared mold. Cover with foil and freeze until solid. May be frozen for several months.

title: Shimmering Shrimp Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add cold water and vinegar; chill until thickened. Add 1 1/2 cups shrimp celery pimiento and 1 1/2 cups jello. Spoon into 6-cup ring mold. Chill until set but not firm. Add sour cream parsley onion and curry to remaining jello. Spoon into mold. Chill until firm about 4 hours. Unmold and serve with salad greens if desired. Garnish with remaining shrimp.

title: Potato Puffs
instructions: Beat the egg and mashed potatoes together. Add flour and baking powder. Mix well and drop by spoonful in deep fat (hot enough to brown a cube of bread). Fry until golden brown.

title: 9 Can Soup
instructions: In a large pot combine diced potatoes onions and butter. Cook over low heat until potatoes are almost done. Add cream soups and milk. Simmer until blended well. Add crabmeat and shrimp. Ready to eat.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time beating after each one. Stir in bananas. Beat well. Add flour and soda mixture. Add walnuts and vanilla. Stir until blended. Pour into a greased loaf or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Do not use an electric mixer.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Mix and press in large baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes; cool.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to package and bake 20 minutes in large greased jelly roll pan. Then take vanilla pudding and 1 cup milk and cook until thick. Put Saran Wrap on top and cool. Then take margarine Crisco and 1 cup sugar; cream well. Add cooled pudding to creamed mixture. Beat 10 minutes. Spread on cooled cake. Take pineapple (juice and all) add cornstarch and 1 cup sugar cook until thick. Cool then spread on top of pudding mixture. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken soup and sour cream. Place in baking dish sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle crushed Ritz on top. Drizzle butter over Ritz crackers. Sprinkle with poppy seeds. Bake @ 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Frosted Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water; then add 7-Up. Chill until partially set. Add pineapple bananas and marshmallows. Chill until set.

title: Cherry Supreme
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Put 1/2 mixture in a 9 x 9-inch pan and pat down. Spread cherry pie filling on mix and sprinkle with water. Put rest of dry mix on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: People Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt together the butter chocolate chips and peanut butter. Pour mixture over Rice Chex. Cool. Put into large plastic bag containing powdered sugar. Shake until well coated.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into bite-size pieces. Add dressing croutons and cheese. Toss and serve.

title: Chew Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and margarine together. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Mix in flour and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Beat egg whites stiff. Mix all ingredients except egg whites then fold them in carefully. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Can be made the day before and refrigerated. If you do this take it out an hour before you want to bake it.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt cinnamon nutmeg and sugar into bowl. Make a well and add eggs salad oil water and pumpkin. Mix well. Add pecans. Put into 3 small loaf pans greased and floured. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Keep refrigerated.

title: Scrambled Eggs Supreme
instructions: Fry bacon in large skillet; drain off all but 3 tablespoons drippings. Combine remaining ingredients in container of electric blender. Process on low speed until light and fluffy. Pour into skillet with bacon and hot drippings. Cook over low heat stirring gently until done. Serve immediately. Yields about 6 servings.

title: Sausage-Bean Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook lima beans as directed on package; drain. Turn into ungreased 4 1/2 quart casserole. Add baked beans and kidney beans. In covered skillet simmer sausages in small amount of water 5 minutes. Drain liquid from skillet; pan fry sausages until brown on all sides. Cut each sausage into 2 or 3 pieces; add with ham to beans. Stir together remaining ingredients; pour over casserole. Gently mix all ingredients. Bake uncovered 1 hour. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Ash-Cor'S Caramel Apples
instructions: Mix together apple chunks and oranges and divide equally into 4 bowls or dessert dishes. Prepare caramel according to package (or melt caramels on low heat). Drizzle by spoonfuls over fruit as much as desired. Sprinkle with butterscotch chips. Serve immediately. Caramel thickens as it cools and gets really gooey!

title: Sweet Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables and squeeze out as much juice as possible. Add sugar vinegar celery seed and mustard seed. Add turmeric. Cook and bring to a boil. Seal in jars. Makes 7 to 8 pints.

title: Round Steak
instructions: Cut steak up into frying size pieces. Roll in flour and fry like you would fry chicken. As you take it up place it in a pot on burner. Add more water & onions. Turn temperature down to low. Keep stirring or it will stick. Let cook until steak is tender & gravy thickens.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Generously butter a casserole dish. Mix the soup with about 1/2 to 3/4 can of water. Heat to almost boiling. Add to potatoes in a casserole dish. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake in oven or microwave until tender. Remove from oven and top with bacon bits if desired.

title: Speedy Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Blend Ricotta egg 1/2 cup Mozzarella 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning and 2 tablespoons Parmesan in bowl. Stir remaining Italian seasoning into tomato sauce. Spread 3/4 cup of sauce in bottom of 8 x 8 x 2-inch square baking dish. Place single layer of noodles over top. Spread 1/2 of Ricotta mixture on top. Layer lasagna noodles 3/4 cup sauce lasagna noodles remaining Ricotta lasagna noodles 1/2 cup sauce plus cooked chicken and lasagna noodles. Top with remaining sauce Mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil. If you wish you can freeze for up to 1 month. Thaw in refrigerator before baking. Bake the lasagna covered in 400\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Remove foil. Bake another 10 minutes or until golden and heated through.

title: Fruity Orange Refrigerator Muffins
instructions: In large bowl combine flour bran cereal sugar and baking soda baking powder salt allspice and orange peel. Add buttermilk oil and eggs. Mix well. Stir in fruit bits.

title: Bean Casserole(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Drain beans and place in casserole. Add spices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fresh Hot Salsa
instructions: In a large frypan or Dutch oven sweat onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons of oil. Cook until onion is translucent. Add peppers tomatoes and jalapeno peppers. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Serve hot with chips.

title: 6 Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat 2 minutes after adding each egg. Mix together the dry ingredients and set aside. Mix all 6 flavorings; add milk. Then add dry and liquid ingredients to cream mixture alternately. Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Do not open oven door while cake is baking.

title: Cranberry Spice Cake
instructions: Combine flour baking powder cinnamon soda and salt. Beat together shortening and sugar at medium speed in an electric mixer about 3 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually add dry ingredients mixing well after each addition. Fold in 1 cup cranberry sauce raisins and nuts; spoon into well-greased 9-cup Bundt pan. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 1 hour or until wooden pick in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan inverting on wire rack. Heat remaining cranberry sauce and dash of cinnamon in small saucepan. Pour warm sauce over cooled cake. Yield 1 (9-inch) Bundt cake.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Scramble sausage in pan; slightly brown. Pour off all grease. Add Bisquick cheese and water. Make in small balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown. Can be frozen and baked as needed. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
instructions: Peel apples and slice thin. In an unbaked pastry shell place 1/2 the apples. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon together. Sprinkle half of this over the apples in the pastry shell then add remainder of apples; sprinkle the rest of the sugar and cinnamon on top of apples.

title: Herb Rolls
instructions: Place oleo parsley dill onion flakes and cheese in 9-inch pie plate. Melt over low heat or in oven cut biscuits in quarters. Swish each piece in oleo mixture. Place close together. Bake at 425 degrees (12 to 15 minutes).

title: Ground Beef Or Turkey Skillet Dinner
instructions: Brown ground chuck or ground turkey. Drain. Layer noodles over meat and sprinkle with dry soup mix. Pour tomato sauce and 2 cups water over all. Press noodles down into liquid but do not stir. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and cook for 20 minutes. Stir before serving.

title: Cheese-Ham Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients then pour in unbaked pie shell. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies. Bake both pies at same time at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix together sweetened condensed milk and thawed lemonade. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into 2 pie shells.

title: Minute Butterscotch Pudding
instructions: Mix brown sugar shortening milk and salt in saucepan. Stir over low heat until shortening melts. Bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute (220\u00b0). Remove from heat and beat until lukewarm (120\u00b0). Stir in vanilla. Continue beating until a smooth spreading consistency.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large bowl; mix well. Place batter in 3 (5 x 9-inch) or 4 (3 x 7-inch) greased loaf pans. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Amaretto Cake
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan sprinkled with 1/2 cup chopped walnuts. While hot take out of cake pan and flip so that walnuts are on the bottom. Poke holes in cake with large serving fork.

title: Sausage Surprise
instructions: Brown sausage in a Dutch oven. Remove and drain on paper towels. Drain off drippings reserving 1 tablespoon in Dutch oven. Saute onions in reserved drippings 3 to 5 minutes. Add sausage cabbage carrots potatoes and water. Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add brown sugar and regular sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add vanilla and chopped walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes in tube pan (cool 10 minutes). Remove from pan and glaze.

title: Squash Relish
instructions: Mix squash bell peppers onion and salt; let stand one hour then drain. Mix vinegar sugar mustard seed and celery seed; bring to a boil and cook 20 minutes; add vegetables. Boil for 1 minute; pack and seal in sterile jars. Chill before serving.

title: That Meat(Swiss Steak)
instructions: Cut up round steak. Saute onion in oil. Dip steak in mixture of flour salt and pepper (and any other spices). Brown meat in pan with onion. Add enough water to cover meat. Cover pan and simmer 1 hour. (Add more water as it evaporates.) Add Kitchen Bouquet to brown gravy. Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease. Turn once.

title: Chocolate Covered Candy
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients. Chill. Roll into small balls put on toothpick and dip.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together. Shape into a ball. Chill 2 hours.

title: Chicken With Cheese Sauce
instructions: Arrange chicken skin side up in large dish; top with one piece bacon and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Spoon off fat. Meanwhile melt butter in saucepan and stir in flour and salt until smooth. Gradually stir in milk and cook (while stirring) until mixture thickens. Gradually add both cheeses to the mixture and spoon over chicken. Broil several minutes or until lightly browned. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Neiman-Marcus Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine margarine cake mix and 1 egg. Stir together until dry ingredients are moistened. Pat mixture into bottom of well-greased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Beat remaining 2 eggs lightly then beat in cream cheese and powdered sugar. Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour over mixture in jelly roll pan spreading evenly. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Cool pan on wire rack to room temperature. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Oyster Balls
instructions: Mix well. Cover with foil. Mix every once in awhile by turning the bowl upside down. Keep in icebox overnight.

title: Biscadeder'S
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix flour and shortening until it gets crumbly. Blend milk into flour mixture with fork. Put sausage in mixture and continue to blend with a fork. Add more flour if it is too sticky. Knead it and roll it out into a flat 1/2-inch thick sheet. Cut or roll. Bake 10 minutes. Makes 14 rolls.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar eggs vanilla and shortening together. Add dry ingredients and then chocolate chips. (This batter is real stiff so if you dont have a heavy-duty mixer you may want to use a spoon.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 8 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour and sugar. Cut in butter until coarse like meal. Add egg cream and vanilla. Roll on floured board. Cut and bake about 8 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Sara'S Breakfast Strata
instructions: Trim crust from bread. Butter slices lightly and fit into buttered 7 x 11-inch dish. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups cheese. Top with ham. Mix eggs onion mustard etc. together and pour over layered ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Strawberry Pie Ii
instructions: Line unpricked pastry shell with double thickness of heavy-duty foil. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove foil; bake 5 minutes longer. Cool on a wire rack. In a saucepan combine the sugar cornstarch and water until smooth. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Remove from the heat; stir in gelatin until dissolved. Refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes or until slightly cooled. Meanwhile arrange strawberries in the crust. Pour gelatin mixture over berries. Refrigerate until set. Garnish with mint if desired. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Plain Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs then stir in flour. Mix 2 minutes at low speed. Add milk and flavoring. Beat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in Bundt pan.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Simmer ingredients for 1 to 2 hours. Top with shredded cheese Fritos and sour cream when serving.

title: Waldorf Astoria Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs beating well. Sift all the dry ingredients but soda and add alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla and food coloring. Then combine vinegar and soda and stir into the creamed mixture. Bake in 2 (9-inch) well-greased cake pans or 3 (8-inch) cake pans at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello sugar and water together. Add all the remaining ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Jezebel Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Bring to boil; stirring constantly. Cool. Store in refrigerator. Serve over cream cheese or use as a relish for ham/pork. Makes 3 cups.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Add 1 pound (2 cups) crab meat (back fin best). Best if made at least 2 hours before cooking.

title: Never Fail Rare Roast Beef
instructions: Place onion on roast with toothpicks. Pour Worcestershire sauce over roast. Season with spices. Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Cover roast with aluminum foil. When oven is ready place roast in oven and cook 5 minutes per pound. Turn off oven and leave door closed for 2 hours. Dont peek!

title: Hot Spiced Apple Cider
instructions: Mix all together and heat in crock-pot for 4 hours or greater.

title: Peach Pudding
instructions: Place peach halves in buttered custard cups or 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish. Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored. Add sugar blend in cinnamon and breadcrumbs. Stir in melted margarine. Spread over peaches and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Combine in large bowl; cook on High in microwave for 2 minutes. (Cover with Saran Wrap.) Blend in with mixer vanilla and nuts. Pour in a greased square pan. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before cutting. Once cut into squares I store it in the refrigerator.

title: Idiots Delight Bars
instructions: Mix and pat into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan the first 5 ingredients. Bake 12 minutes at 375\u00b0 or longer for crispness. Set aside to cool. Melt chocolate chips and blend in peanut butter. Spread over crust; refrigerate to cool. Cut into squares.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Cook all together; seal in sterilized jars.

title: Herb-Bran Muffins
instructions: Stir together the flours baking powder salt sugar sesame seed dry mustard and herb of choice. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl combine the bran cereal and the milk. Let stand 2 minutes. Add the egg and butter or margarine blending well. Add the flour mixture stirring only until combined. Coat a 12-muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray or line with muffin cups. Fill each 2/3 full with muffin mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center of a muffin comes out clean.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage(The Easy Way)
instructions: Mix soup and mustard. Break corned beef into bite-size. Combine all ingredients and pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Spread\tbeans in a large plate. Peel and mash avocado(s). Spread over beans. Add taco seasoning to sour cream. Put\tover avocado(s). Sprinkle cheese over sour cream then black olives. Put sauce in middle of dish inside half of a cleaned out green pepper.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake chocolate cake according to directions. Immediately after taking cake from the oven use a fork to poke holes in the cake. Pour the can of sweetened condensed milk over the hot cake. Next pour a jar of hot fudge topping over the cake. Cool cake in refrigerator. Before serving top with chocolate Dream Whip.

title: Lima Hamburger Skillet
instructions: Dice onion; slice celery and fry both in oil until soft about 5 minutes. Add hamburger; cook and stir until meat is browned. Stir in tomatoes catsup soy sauce Worcestershire sauce and lima beans. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cover tightly and simmer over low heat about 15 minutes.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine egg milk shortening and add to dry ingredients. Stir until moist. Cook on greased griddle.

title: Iced Tea Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour cocoa and salt. Add alternately with iced tea and soda. Add vanilla. Bake about 50 minutes (or until toothpick inserted into center comes clean) at 325\u00b0 in a Pyrex baking dish (8 x 11 1/2 x 2 1/4-inch) or 350\u00b0 in metal pan. It takes a little longer to bake in glass pan.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine above ingredients and put in an ovenproof bowl. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown about 25 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in milk vanilla and butter until smooth. Add chocolate chips and brown sugar; pour in ungreased deep dish baker. Sprinkle in the remaining 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa. Place the ingredients on oven rack then add boiling water. Bake for 35 minutes; cool for 10. Serve over ice cream. Serves 8.

title: Sand Bakkels
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 placing one rack on top of oven and one rack on lower shelf in oven. In bowl cream together sugar butter and margarine. Add egg yolk vanilla and half and half. Add dry ingredients starting with flour. Mix well. Press dough into sand bakkel tins. Bake placing on lower shelf for 7 minutes then top shelf for 2 minutes (9 minutes total). Slide off sheet. Leave them right side up until cool enough to handle. Pop out of tin with a slightly squeeze. Makes about 45 bakkels.

title: Easy Cheese Eggs Ala King
instructions: In a saucepan cover and cook celery green pepper and onion in butter or margarine until tender but not brown. Stir in celery soup cheese and milk; heat and stir until cheese melts. Gently stir in sliced eggs and pimiento. Serve spooned over buttered toast. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add beaten eggs and vanilla then the dry ingredients and nuts. Form in long rolls. Wrap in wax paper and let stand overnight. I usually put them in the freezer until you can slice them off nicely. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for about 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Makes quite a lot of cookies.

title: Pizza Twists
instructions: Separate the breadsticks. Stick the ends together so each one forms a circle and then twist it into a figure 8. Sprinkle with garlic powder and Italian seasoning.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat and mix with all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spice Strips
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in the order given. Chill dough. Remove from refrigerator and divide dough into 6 parts. Roll each part in sugar until 10-inches long and 3/4-inch wide. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness. Place 2 rolls on each of 3 foil lined cookie sheets. Sprinkle rolls with sugar. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Slice on diagonal while still warm. Allow to cool thoroughly on cookie sheet. May be frozen.

title: Sweet Potato Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 1 1/2-inch muffin tin. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Blend in sweet potatoes. Sift flour with baking powder salt cinnamon and nutmeg; add alternately with milk. Do not overmix. Fold in nuts and raisins.

title: Cocktail Sausages
instructions: Combine chili sauce and grape jelly in large sauce pan; cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 3 minutes or until mixture begins to boil. Add sausage; cook an additional 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated stirring often.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Have sausage at room temperature. Combine all; mix well. Roll into bite-size balls. Bake in 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Makes 100 balls.

title: Potatoes On The Grill
instructions: Using heavy duty aluminum foil use a 12-inch square. Place on the foil the potato onion grease and salt and pepper. Fold edges overlapping tightly. Place on grill. Turn occasionally. Check for doneness after 1/2 hour.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: In bottom of pie plate put part of blended dry ingredients with margarine cut into it. Add peaches then add the rest of dry mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Easy Lasagne Casserole(Doris Kmiec, Brenham, Tx)
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender. Cook ground beef and onion in skillet until ground beef is brown. Drain. Stir in tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce mix. Cook until thickened. Drain noodles. Combine cream cheese and evaporated milk in warm saucepan until smooth. Stir in noodles and garlic salt. Pour into 9-inch square baking dish. Spread meat mixture over. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sour Cream Fan Rolls
instructions: In a bowl dissolve yeast in water. Add 2 tablespoons sugar; let stand for 5 minutes. In a large mixing bowl combine the sour cream eggs butter salt and remaining sugar. Stir in baking powder yeast mixture and 4 cups of flour until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Turn onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic about 6 to 8 minutes. Place in a greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 hour.

title: Wonderful Steak Marinade
instructions: Marinate the steaks 1 hour on each side. Recipe is for 2 1/2 pounds of steak about 5 servings.

title: Wonderful Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook Rice-A-Roni according to package directions. Meanwhile cut up chicken into 1/2 to 1-inch pieces. Saute in pan. When partially cooked add chopped broccoli and cover. Steam cook for 8 minutes. Drain liquid. Sprinkle cheese chunks on top. Cover and cook over very low heat until cheese is melted. When rice is cooked and all liquid is absorbed add sour cream. Mix well. Add rice/sour cream to the chicken/broccoli/cheese. Mix well and put in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and serve. Delicious!

title: Coconut Cream Pie(Made In Blender)
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in blender. Pour into 9-inch pie pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: My Mom'S Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour and Crisco. Add buttermilk until mixture becomes easy to roll. Add 2 tablespoons sugar. Knead mixture. Roll out dough. Crisco the bottom of the pan/glass Pyrex dish. Cut out round-shaped biscuits. Place in pan/dish. Brush top of biscuits with buttermilk. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown on top.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Mix all but last 3 ingredients and spread in a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with mixture of brown sugar and cocoa. Pour boiling water over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream on top.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in tightly covered jar. Put 1 or 2 teaspoons in cup of boiling water.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and water in heavy skillet. Cook slowly. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook to soft ball stage. Add salt and peanuts. Cook to hard crack stage stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and soda (mixture will be bubbly). Pour on buttered cookie sheet.

title: Strawberry Daiquiris
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender container. Cover and blend on high speed until foamy about 25 seconds. Serve immediately.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add one egg at a time. Add flour and cream together. Mix together with all other ingredients and bake in a tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: German Apple Pancakes
instructions: Combine pancake mix brown sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Add milk oleo and egg. Beat these ingredients and fold in apples. Bake on greased griddle. Combine the 1/2 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon and top pancakes when done.

title: Corn Flake Squares
instructions: Bring karo and sugar to boil. Stir in peanut butter and then stir in corn flakes. Press in 9x13 in. pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Hurry Up Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in a 1-quart saucepan over low heat. Stir to prevent sticking and to blend. Add sugar flour egg salt and vanilla. Beat with spoon until well blended. Spread mixture in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle nuts over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cut in squares while still warm.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef in skillet. Mix pork and beans and add drained kidney beans. Stir in ground beef and onion. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time beating between additions. Add vanilla then alternately the dry ingredients and milk. Stir in prunes and nuts. Bake in an 11 x 8 x 2-inch pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add buttermilk milk and beaten eggs mixing well. Add melted butter. For each pancake spoon about 1/4 cup batter onto a hot lightly greased griddle or iron skillet. Turn pancakes when tops are covered with bubbles and edges are brown. Serve with butter and syrup.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first 5 ingredients tossing together lightly with a fork. Gradually blend the salad dressing and seasonings into whipped cream. Pour over salad ingredients in bowl; fork-toss to mix lightly but thoroughly. Cover; chill thoroughly. Serve on chilled crisp greens or use to fill center of a tomato.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in bottom of crock-pot; sprinkle Good Seasons Italian dressing mix over chicken. Add celery soup (do not add water) spreading soup over chicken. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Half hour before serving add 8 ounces fat-free sour cream. Serve over rice or noodles. Leftovers may need another can of soup added.

title: Squash Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt butter in pan or baking dish. Spread rice around in pan. Spread squash over rice. Add onions over squash. Add salt and pepper to taste. Mix water with the soup and pour over the mixture and cover with foil. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Arrange in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Place chicken over broccoli. Combine soup mayo and lemon juice. Pour over chicken and sprinkle with cheese. Combine butter and bread crumbs; spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares for serving.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to a boil the oil water and chocolate. Take off heat and add sugar stirring until dissolved. Add flour and salt. Beat together well the eggs sour cream and baking soda. Add to other mixture. Grease pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger in heavy kettle. Add vegetables seasonings and the rice and water. Simmer slowly for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl; mix well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Diabetic Spice Cookies
instructions: Mix water shortening raisins cinnamon nutmeg and boil together cool. Add remaining ingredients. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Salad(Number Of Servings: 4)
instructions: In a large bowl combine chicken celery grapes and parsley. Combine the next 7 ingredients; mix well. Pour over chicken mixture and toss. Chill for at least 1 hour. Before serving sprinkle with sliced almonds.

title: All In One Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Tater Tots; put into casserole. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes (until firm). Good idea to mix night before. Great breakfast dish served with fruit!

title: Honey Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a baking pan. Mix butter honey mustard and curry powder together. Pour over the chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Baste frequently.

title: Sweet Rolls
instructions: Beat water milk salt oil sugar and eggs until mixed; add yeast. Stir until it is dissolved. Add flour and knead until smooth and elastic. Let rise until double about 1 hour. Punch down and make rolls. Take 1/3 of dough at a time roll out; put on butter cinnamon and brown sugar with chocolate chips cherries pecans or raisins. Roll like jelly roll; cut slices and put on cookie sheet. Let rise until double in size. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Apple Cider
instructions: Mix all together in crock-pot stirring occasionally until red hots are melted. Squeeze juice of other 1/2 orange and float other half. Serve hot.

title: Baked Seasoned Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 or 450\u00b0. Arrange a single layer of salmon in a shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour half of the sauce mixture over the fish or salmon. Bake for 20 minutes basting with the remaining sauce. Sprinkle with paprika and chopped parsley. Serves 4.

title: Catalina Stew
instructions: Brown meat in dressing. Add water and vegetables. Simmer slowly in electric skillet or Dutch oven.

title: Mrs. Batch'S Pie(Original Recipe From The White House, 1965)
instructions: Mix together lemon juice Eagle Brand milk pineapple and pecans. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill.

title: Chocolate Pie(2 Pies)
instructions: Cook until thick. Pour into 2 baked pie shells.

title: Johnny Mazetti
instructions: Saute hamburg add celery onion and green pepper (chopped or ground). Simmer to cook. Add soup paste sauce water garlic olives and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes. Add cooked noodles and mix well. Cover with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (if frozen 2 hours). Makes two large dishes.

title: Arroz Con Pollo(A Classic Central American Dish)
instructions: Put chicken carrot 1 cup each onions and celery 1/2 teaspoon comino 1/2 teaspoon oregano 1 clove garlic salt and pepper and water to cover. Poach gently until tender approximately 35 to 45 minutes. Let simmer do not boil.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients and place in an 8-inch square baking dish. Make 3 wells in the dry ingredients. In the largest well put the oil or shortening. In the next put the vinegar and in the third put the vanilla. Pour the water over all the mixture and thoroughly mix with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Bring mixture to a boil and simmer until it thickens. This freezes very well.

title: Sauteed Zucchini And Mushrooms
instructions: Saute mushrooms onions and zucchini in vinegar in a nonstick skillet until just crisp-tender. Stir in remaining ingredients and remove from heat. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Heat liquid Butter Buds in a nonstick skillet and brown chicken onion and garlic. Add all other ingredients except mushrooms. Bring to boil then cover and simmer about 30 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook 10 minutes more. Remove chicken from pan; boil down sauce until slightly thickened. Serve over cooked pasta.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in airtight jar. Put in 2 to 3 teaspoons in cup of boiling water.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: In bowl mix together sugar milk margarine cinnamon and pudding. Cut 1 loaf of bread into 12 pieces. Place in a greased 10 x 13-inch pan. Pour 1/2 pudding mixture over top of bread. Cut remaining loaf into 12 pieces. Place on top of other bread. Pour remaining pudding mixture over bread. Let rise until double (about 1 1/2 hours). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. While still hot invert onto aluminum foil. Clean pan and return rolls in foil to it.

title: Pitas
instructions: Cook ground beef and drain well. Add seasoning mix water tomatoes and green chilies and corn. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut bread rounds in half. Place on baking sheet and bake at 250\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until warm. Fill each pocket half full with meat mixture and top with lettuce and cheese. Yield 10 sandwiches.

title: Pineapple-Cheese Spread
instructions: In a medium bowl combine Cheddar cheese pineapple green pepper chives soy sauce pecans and mayonnaise. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours; serve cold. Makes 2 cups.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel boil drain and mash potatoes. Beat and add remaining ingredients until fluffy. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with cooking spray.

title: Punch
instructions: Make ice cubes with one bottle of Sprite. Make ice cubes with 1 bottle punch. Mix three cans of water with frozen orange juice and also make into ice cubes.

title: Easy Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Combine rice shrimp onion pepper and dressing in a 2 to 3-quart casserole dish. Top casserole with raw bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Septic Tank Cleaner
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Pour into the toilet bowl and flush.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil milk and sugar until forms soft ball. Add butter and peanut butter and beat until hardens around edges of pan. Pour into buttered pan to cool.

title: Cucumber Relish
instructions: Cook on medium heat until thick.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Note Taste before adding salt; most canned beets already have salt added.

title: Oreo Ice Cream
instructions: In a large bowl beat egg yolks. Stir in Eagle Brand water and vanilla. Fold in cookies and whipped cream. Pour into aluminum foil-lined 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or a 2-quart container. Cover and freeze.

title: Super Steak And Kidney Pie
instructions: Place steak onion and kidneys in pan and cover with water. Bring to boil and skim off liquid. Simmer about 1 hour having added bay leaf salt and pepper to taste. Drain saving liquid. Place meat and onion mix into 9-inch pan. Cover with mushroom halves; thicken liquid with flour and add a dash of Worcestershire sauce. Place pie crust holder in center of dish. Cover with flaky pastry. Brush with egg whites beaten and bake in oven until pastry browns.

title: Fruit Fizz
instructions: Mix well and freeze until slushy the Hawaiian Punch pineapple juice and lemonade. Put into punch bowl; add Sprite or ginger ale. Mix and serve. Makes 20 servings.

title: Fluffy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 1 cup juice in small saucepan. Set pineapple aside. To saucepan add sugar flour eggs orange juice lemon juice and oil. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute; remove from heat and let cool.

title: Baked Cabbage
instructions: Steam shredded cabbage; drain and place in 2-quart casserole dish. Mix or shake in jar remaining ingredients; pour over cabbage.

title: Garlic Herb Spread
instructions: In a small bowl mix all ingredients until well blended. Excellent for garlic bread or to season fish or chicken for grilling. Store in covered container. Refrigerate.

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly. Make into small balls about the size of a large marble. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Tea
instructions: Pour 3 cups boiling water over the two tea bags. Let set for a few minutes. Pour sugar and hot tea together into one gallon tea jug. Stir until sugar melts. Add orange juice and lemon aid. Fill the gallon jug with water.

title: Throw Together Soup
instructions: In large pot or crock-pot add beef potatoes carrots onions and water; simmer 3 hours on stove or overnight (6 to 8 hours) in crock-pot on low. Add seasonings noodles and sauce. Cook 1 more hour on stove or 3 to 4 more hours in crock-pot stirring occasionally.

title: No Bake Cheesecake Squares
instructions: In a saucepan melt margarine. Stir in crumbs and sugar. Press firmly on bottom of 8 or 9-inch square pan. Chill. In a large bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Mix in sweetened condensed milk. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared pan. Chill 4 hours. Cut into squares. Serve plain or with fruit on top. Makes 9 to 12 servings.

title: Kringle Sticks
instructions: Cut margarine into flour as for pie crust. Add cream cheese; mix well. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Make up like biscuit dough. Put in the refrigerator 1 hour or overnight to cool. Pinch off what you want to roll out. Put a little oil in pan. Cut out as biscuits. Flip over in oil. Let rise 1 hour in a warm place until doubled in size. Cook in 450\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Blueberry Nut Crunch
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour drained pineapple into dish spreading evenly over bottom. Add blueberries; spread evenly. Add 3/4 cup sugar over this mixture (sprinkle). Sprinkle box of cake mix over the mixture. Drizzle melted butter over cake mix. Top with chopped nuts. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Take spoon cut down through mixture several times so juice can come to top. Cook for an additional 20 minutes or until crunchy on top. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Blend 24 hours before use.

title: Creamy Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Arrange in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange chicken pieces on top. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Stir well to blend. Pour over chicken. Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese and return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 12 servings.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: In large bowl combine crumbs nuts and coconut. Add milk and rum. Mix well. Chill 4 hours. Dip palms in sugar. Shape into balls. Roll in sugar. Re-chill mixture if it becomes too soft. Cover and store in refrigerator. If desired re-roll in sugar again before serving.

title: Funnel Cake Batter
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Heat oil in pan until hot. Pour batter through a funnel making designs by holding finger partially over funnel hole. Cook until light brown on both sides. Drain and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Place cheese in a small bowl; let stand at room temperature until smooth. Add onions and Worcestershire sauce. Blend on low speed. Beat on medium speed until fluffy scraping sides and bottom of bowl. Cover and let chill 8 hours.

title: Canned Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Boil first 6 ingredients until thick stirring constantly. When thick add lemon juice. Pour over 10 quarts of peeled sliced apples. Pack into jars. Cold pack for 30 minutes. Seal until ready to use. One quart makes 1 pie.

title: Rotini Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta until tender. Drain and rinse with cold water. Cut up vegetables and mix with pasta. Pour dressings and salad pepper juice over pasta a little at a time. Taste and add liquids until you like the taste. Remember that as this salad marinates it will get stronger. Sprinkle liberally with Parmesan cheese and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Combine jalapeno peppers garlic tomato paste sugar vinegar alum and spices in blender. Process until smooth. Combine with chopped vegetables in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Pour into hot sterilized pint jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Seal. Process in boiling water bath for 15 minutes. Yield 3 pints.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise salt and onion; add chicken rice broth soup and celery. Place in baking dish. Cover with crushed potato chips. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening eggs and sour milk. Add flour and other dry ingredients to creamed mixture then add hot water. Add bananas. Beat well. Add vanilla. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan in 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Poor Man'S Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion; drain. Cook egg noodles and drain. Mix all ingredients together in a large casserole dish. Break the 6 or 7 pieces of bread on top and pour melted margarine over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toasted or about 15 minutes.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix juices water and sugar well and freeze in 2 gallon size Ziploc bags. Remove from freezer and let thaw until slushy. Add 1 bottle Sprite or ginger ale to each bag of juice in punch bowl. Makes 30 servings.

title: No-Fail Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs just to blend; add sugar. Scald milk; add milk vanilla and salt to egg mixture. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 5 minutes; reduce heat to 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. It will be jiggly in the middle but sets when cool. Very good smooth custard.

title: Cocoa Mix
instructions: Sift and mix all ingredients. Serve by using 1/2 cup of mix and 1/2 cup hot water.

title: Broccoli, Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Mix with other ingredients but use only 1/2 can cheese soup. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Top with rest of Cheddar cheese soup. Crumble Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes until bubbly.

title: Crab Casserole
instructions: Check crab meat for pieces of shell. Prepare white sauce per package instructions using half and half in place of milk. As soon as white sauce thickens mix in remaining ingredients. Spread in 10 x 10-inch or 10 x 12-inch or similar size buttered casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then turn on broiler until casserole is lightly brown on top.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: In microwave cook frozen broccoli 6 to 7 minutes on High then drain. On stove heat remaining ingredients in saucepan for 1 minute on medium. Add to drained broccoli.

title: Steak And Rice
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips. In a large skillet brown meat in oil on high heat. Add onions. Saute until crisp. Blend soup liquid from mushrooms and garlic salt. Pour over steak. Add mushrooms. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 1 hour or until steak is tender. Serve over beds of fluffy rice.

title: Garam Masala(Indian Spice Mix)
instructions: In 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan combine and roast in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. In blender place roasted spices. Cover tightly; blend until fine. Cool and store in covered container.

title: Trifle
instructions: Slice pound cake (1/4-inch thick) and line bottom of large rectangular pan (9 x 13) with pound cake. Make Jell-O (as directed) and pour while warm over pound cake. Spoon crushed pineapple over Jell-O. Make pudding (as directed) and pour over pineapple. Spread Cool Whip over top covering all. Refrigerate. Add strawberries just before serving. Best made day before needed.

title: Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Spread mustard on slice of ham. Lay slice of cheese on top of mustard. Roll jelly roll style. Cut into 3rds. Put toothpick in each one to hold it together. Serve on pretty party tray.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet. Drain well. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Spread soup over ground beef. Place Tater Tots on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Take out and put about 1/4 cup grated cheese on top. Return to oven long enough to melt the cheese.

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
instructions: Cut 6 tortillas into 1/2-inch wide strips; set aside. Cut remaining into triangles; fry until crisp. Set aside. Saute onion in oil. Add all except cheese and paprika. Simmer for 1 hour. Add tortilla strips and cheese; simmer 10 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika and serve with reserved chips.

title: Sunshine Slush
instructions: Mix all together in blender adding ice cubes one at a time. Serve immediately. Great for breakfast.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix condensed milk with Cool Whip then add chocolate milk. Put in ice cream freezer and freeze.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder soda and salt together. Combine the orange juice rind shortening and enough water to make 3/4 cup juice. Add the beaten egg. Pour mixture into dry ingredients mixing just enough to dampen well. Fold in cranberries and nuts.

title: Laura Lee'S Apple Crisp
instructions: Wash pare quarter and core apples. Cut each quarter lengthwise into 3 or 4 slices. Put sliced apples in bottom of a buttered baking dish. Add water.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine; mix with dressing packets. Line greased baking dish with 1/3 of crumbs then layer of chicken then can of cream of chicken soup diluted with one can broth. Put another layer of crumbs a layer of chicken then can of cream of mushroom soup diluted with one can of broth. Cover with layer of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet And Spicy Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large skillet melt 2 tablespoons butter. Add chicken. Brown over medium-high heat. Place skin side up in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quickie Fruit Cake
instructions: Disregard instructions on cake package. Spray a Bundt pan with Pam and dust lightly with flour. Mix all ingredients together and pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until inserted toothpick comes out clean approximately 45 to 60 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream if desired.

title: Spicy Tomato Aspic
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Simmer together 15 minutes tomato juice salt sugar cayenne pepper celery salt bay leaf onion and celery leaves. Strain. Add softened gelatin and lemon juice stirring until dissolved. Cool; add celery black olives and onion. Chill until firm.

title: Brownies
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Spread in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Potato Helper
instructions: Layer cooked potatoes in the bottom of a casserole dish then a layer of ground beef and then a layer of cheese. Repeat layering until you run out of ingredients. Let cool. Enjoy!

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions. Melt butter and mix in flour until smooth. Add eggs and milk. Layer macaroni and cheese in casserole dish. Pour liquid mixture over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until done. Do not overcook.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans. In medium bowl combine thawed strawberries eggs and oil. In large bowl combine flour sugar baking soda salt and nuts. Add strawberry mixture to dry ingredients and stir just until blended. Pour into pans. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Contains about 195 calories per 1/2-inch slice.

title: Potato Wedges
instructions: Place cut potatoes on broiler pan. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Broil for 5 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Mix together. Pour into greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and turn into a towel. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Roll towel and cake into a roll together. Let cool completely or refrigerate.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix oil sugar vanilla and eggs. Add milk salt and baking powder. Stir in flour. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Combine butter flour and nuts. Pat into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Mix sugar cream cheese and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over cool crust. Mix milk and instant pudding. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate!

title: Garden Cheddar Soup
instructions: In stockpot combine carrots zucchini tomatoes celery mushrooms onion garlic beef broth and V-8 juice. Heat to boiling reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes or until vegetables are just tender. Stir in basil red wine salt pepper and parsley. Add cheese just before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken wings in large roasting pan. Wash chicken wings and cut into two pieces. Add to sauce. Marinate in refrigerator turning several times. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Turn again before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes then at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Place under broiler a few minutes until brown and crispy.

title: Swedish Meatballs In Sour Cream Sauce
instructions: Mix together beef bread crumbs egg milk onion and seasonings. Form into small balls. Brown meat in oleo. Add garlic beef extract and flour that has been blended in the bouillon. Cook over low heat until sauce is thick. Just before serving stir in sour cream. Serve with hot buttered noodles.

title: Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Cream sugar shortening and salt. Add boiling water. Add a little flour to cool. Add egg mixture and a little flour. Add water yeast and rest of flour. Roll and put in icebox. Remove 1 1/2 to 2 hours before cooking.

title: Sour Cream Frosting
instructions: Mix and boil until soft ball forms in cold water. Before removing from stove add 3 tablespoons butter. Remove from stove and let cool. Do not stir until cold. Beat.

title: El Chepo Dip
instructions: Mix all together in bowl or saucepan and mash beans to desired consistency. If too thick add some of reserved juice.

title: Apple Crisp Cake
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and oil. Add salt cinnamon walnuts baking soda flour and vanilla. Fold in apples. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Needs no frosting.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Grease a 9-inch square pan. Combine sugar flour and cinnamon. Cut in the butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Stir milk and oil in to beaten eggs. Mix dry ingredients together then add egg mixture and remaining ingredients. Beat well and pour into well-greased 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Taco Filling
instructions: Brown the ground beef and onions. Drain. Add other ingredients and simmer over low heat until most of the liquid is absorbed. Easily increased for more than 1 pound.

title: Salmon Casserole
instructions: Put in dish. Cover with crushed potato chips. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Rhubarb And Blueberry Jam
instructions: Cook rhubarb until soft. Add sugar and blueberry pie filling. Stir and put into jars. Keeps well frozen.

title: Mama'S Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all together and cook in uncooked pastry shell.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Pour milk over oats and let stand while creaming sugar and shortening. Add eggs to these four ingredients and stir in flour cinnamon and raisins and drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased and floured baking tin. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until brown. Yields about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Taffy Apple Pie
instructions: Mix caramel pieces with flour; add apple pieces caramel topping and lemon juice. Put into pie shell and sprinkle pecan pieces on top. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 approximately 40 minutes. Enjoy!

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: In a small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt. In a large bowl combine butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture then stir in M&Ms with a spoon. Drop by the spoonful onto a baking sheet. Bake about 9 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until light brown.

title: Chicken In Honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine honey mustard and lemon juice. Butter bottom of 9 x 9-inch square pan. Add chicken. Season with salt and pepper. Top with honey mixture. Bake for 30 minutes. Turn and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder cream of tartar salt and sugar together. Add Crisco and cut into dry mix then add the milk. Roll out dough and cut into biscuits. Bake at 425 degrees until golden brown.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cut cheese into cubes. Place in a saucepan with 1/4 cup butter. Heat over medium until melted and smooth stirring often. Place vegetables in a 1-quart casserole dish. Pour cheese mixture over and mix well. Melt remaining butter. Stir in cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve at once. Makes 4 servings.

title: Brownies
instructions: Blend butter sugar and vanilla in mixing bowl. Add eggs and beat well with a spoon. Combine dry ingredients and add gradually to egg mixture until well blended. Spread in greased square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Primavera
instructions: Saute vegetables in butter until tender; set aside. Brown sliced sausage and drain. Combine sausage vegetables and cream. Simmer 2 minutes. Add cheese and serve over cooked fettucine. Serves 6.

title: Upside-Down Supper
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix ham beans corn cheese onion and Worcestershire sauce. Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake 15 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients; spoon over hot meat mixture spreading batter evenly to edge of casserole. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Cut into wedges. Invert each onto plate. Makes 4 servings.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first 6 ingredients well with mixer. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon in separate bowl. Spread 1/2 cake batter into 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 of brown sugar mixture and swirl with knife. Spread rest of batter sprinkle with rest of brown sugar and swirl again. Bake for 40 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool. Mix powdered sugar vanilla with enough milk to make a smooth glaze. Spread on cake.

title: Italian Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Brown beef with celery; drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes. In large bowl combine cooked macaroni eggs Parmesan cheese and garlic salt; toss lightly. Place mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Press evenly in bottom of pan. Pour meat mixture over macaroni; cover with foil.

title: Grandma Celia'S Pink Apples
instructions: Core pare and cut 6 apples in halves crosswise. Boil 1 cup sugar with 1 1/2 cups water and 1/4 cup cinnamon hearts for 5 minutes. Add apple halves and simmer until just tender. Put apples and pink syrup in a Pyrex dish. Serve around a roast or use as a dessert with whipped cream. Yields 2 halves per person.

title: Potato Surprise
instructions: In a large skillet combine the potatoes ham onion and green pepper in the oil over moderately high heat. Cook 8 to 10 minutes stirring constantly. Pour beaten eggs over the mixture; continue to stir until eggs are set. Serve hot.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Wash berries and place in a 2-quart casserole dish. Combine sugar and flour; add water small amounts at a time. Stir in lemon juice. Mix well and pour over berries. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and place crust on top slitting in 3 to 4 places.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt candy bars and marshmallows in milk in a double boiler; cool. Whip the whipping cream and fold into cooled mixture. Pour into crust and chill.

title: Greek-Style Pasta Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl whisk together oil lemon juice oregano mustard salt and pepper. Mix in the tomatoes Feta cheese and parsley and allow to marinate. Add to cooled pasta and toss gently. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dry ingredients together (sugar flour salt baking powder baking soda and cinnamon). Beat eggs with fork. Add vanilla and mix together with grated zucchini. Add zucchini mixture to dry ingredients alternating with oil. Blend in nuts (optional). Lightly grease and flour two bread pans. Bake for 1 hour. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Three Cheese Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Cook onion and green pepper in butter until tender. Stir in soup mushrooms pimento milk and basil. Lay 1/2 the noodles in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with half each the sauce cottage cheese chicken and American and Parmesan cheeses. Repeat layers except for the last 2 cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with remaining cheeses. Bake a few minutes more. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Drain kraut. Mix all together and chill overnight. Add pimento for color if desired.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Bring water and margarine to a boil; remove from heat and stir until margarine is melted. Whisk in flour. Whisk in eggs one at a time; blend very well. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan (sprayed with Pam); bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Christmas Pie
instructions: Mix cherries pineapple sugar cornstarch together and cook until thick. Stir in dry jello and let cool. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into pie shells and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Bean Delight
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

title: Tuna Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in 3-quart serving bowl lettuce macaroni cucumber tomatoes tuna green peas and Cheddar cheese. Spread salad dressing or mayonnaise over salad sealing to edge of bowl. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Toss to serve. Yield 8 servings. Preparation time 20 minutes plus refrigerating.

title: Upside-Down Apple Pie
instructions: Arrange nuts flat sides up in butter in deep 9-inch pie pan. Pat brown sugar over nuts. Roll out 1/2 of pastry 1/8-inch thick and line pie pan. Mix remaining ingredients and spoon into pastry; cover with top crust. Seal edges well and cut a few slashes in top crust. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes then carefully turn out on serving plate.

title: Buns
instructions: Scald milk. Heat to boiling point. Add butter sugar and salt. Cool. Dissolve yeast and water. When milk mixture is cool add yeast. Mix well and add enough flour to make soft not sticky dough. Put in greased bowl and grease top of dough. Cover with damp cloth. Let rise until doubled. Punch down. Make into rolls coffee cakes buns etc. Let rise until double and bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Quick Vegetables And Beef
instructions: In saucepan over medium heat heat oil. Add broccoli and cook until tender-crisp. Add soup Worcestershire sauce and rice. Heat thoroughly. Serves 2.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Crepes
instructions: Sift flour and chocolate powder. Mix with milk until batter is smooth. Add sugar 1/2 teaspoon vanilla eggs and butter; blend well. Make very thin crepes with batter; allow to cool.

title: Beef Stew With Limas
instructions: Melt butter in hot Dutch oven. Saute onion until golden. Add chuck and brown lightly. Now add tomatoes cinnamon stick salt and pepper. Simmer covered 1 1/2 hours until meat is fork-tender. Skim off fat. Refrigerate stew covered.

title: Rawpy Pie (Nova Scotia)
instructions: Boil chicken until well done. Add coarsely chopped onions. Grate potatoes into white cloth over a bowl catching all liquid. Discard this juice\ but save the starch portion and add back to potatoes. Separate chicken from broth and remove bones and skin.

title: Corn Pone
instructions: Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix cheese and sausage then add Bisquick. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hot Stuff
instructions: Cook everything together with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil on high. Reduce heat to a steady simmer. Cook until tender. Good with cornbread.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Mix warm water yeast and sugar and let set for 2 minutes. Stir. Let set for 5 minutes. Mix 1/3 cup water olive oil salt and flour. Add to first group of ingredients. Mix well. Knead. Let rise 1 1/2 hours. Grease well one large pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Southern Pie
instructions: Combine cereal and water. Let stand until water is absorbed.

title: Beef Hash
instructions: Thicken 2 cups beef broth by mixing well flour and 1/2 cup cold broth or lukewarm (not hot); flour will lump stir well. Pour in broth when it boils. Add chopped onions. Cook about 3 minutes. Add beef. If gravy is too thick add more broth. Cook 5 minutes. Pour in baking dish and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except grated cheese. Grease pan or skillet. Pour half the mixture into skillet and sprinkle on cheese. Do not stir. Cover with remaining mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Put drained Veg-All in a greased casserole dish. Mix cheese mayonnaise celery and onions then spread over Veg-All. Melt oleo and mix with crackers. Sprinkle on top and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Boil sugar Karo and water until thread spins. Add the peanuts and then stir continuously after the peanuts are added. Cook until it turns a brownish gold. Take from fire. Add butter salt and soda. Pour onto buttered board and cool.

title: Country Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Grease an 8 x 12-inch baking dish and combine the first 4 ingredients and 1 cup cheese. Blend soup and 3/4 cup milk. Bake covered for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Turn the heat off. Add peanut butter marshmallows and vanilla. Pour into greased dish. Cool and cut into 1 or 2-inch squares.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
instructions: Cream oleo and powdered sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and store in refrigerator overnight. The next morning roll small dabs (size of walnuts) and place on greased cookie sheets for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let cool. Roll in powdered sugar and store in airtight container.

title: Potato-Carrot Foil Bake
instructions: Cut off 2 large sheets of foil. Lay them like a cross. Onto foil slice potatoes carrots and onion. Sprinkle with salt pepper and margarine. Fold foil to seal pouch securely. Grill until done 55 to 60 minutes. Open pouch and sprinkle cheese over vegetables. Close pouch; return to grill until cheese melts about 1 minute. Serves 6.

title: Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a microwave-safe dish brown meat with water* stirring occasionally. Drain and set aside.

title: Raisin Loaf Cake(Diabetic)
instructions: Cover raisins with water. Cook until water is absorbed. Add applesauce eggs liquid sweetener and oil; mix well. Blend in sifted dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 3 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until cake tests done. Yields 16 servings.

title: Norwegian Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage and toss with salt. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. In a saucepan heat sugar vinegar mustard and celery seed. Cook until the sugar dissolves about 10 minutes. Cool completely. Add to the cabbage along with remaining vegetables; toss. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 week before serving. Keeps for 4 to 6 weeks in the refrigerator. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Tea Balls
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add vanilla and chopped nuts then add flour and mold into small balls. With a teaspoon press an indentation in top of each ball (for frosting after baking). Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool and add frosting.

title: Classic Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine 1 tablespoon flour with salt. Dredge meat in mixture. Heat skillet and add 2 tablespoons butter. When heated add sirloin strips and brown quickly flipping meat to turn all sides. Add mushrooms onions and garlic. Cook 3 or 4 minutes until onion is barely tender. Remove meat and mushrooms. Add 2 tablespoons butter to pan drippings. When melted blend 3 tablespoons flour. Add tomato paste slowly. Pour cold meat. Cook and stir until thickened. Return meat and mushrooms to skillet and stir in sour cream and sherry. Heat briefly. Keep warm over hot water. Serve over hot buttered noodles.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Add oil water eggs and pumpkin to dry ingredients; mix well. Add nuts and raisins. Pour into 3 medium loaf pans well greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. Bake in 3 large 9-inch layers at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Busy Day Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in 3 tablespoons butter heating through not browning. Add ground beef plus 3 teaspoons salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Spread into 2 quart baking dish. Spread 3 cups cabbage; cover with meat mixture. Top with 3 cups cabbage. Spoon over top 10 1/2 ounce can of condensed tomato soup. Bake covered 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Potato Cake
instructions: Combine soft oleo sugar mashed potatoes and melted chocolate. Add eggs. Combine flour and soda; add to other mixture and add milk. Add raisins and nuts. Bake in 2 greased and floured 8-inch round pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool and ice.

title: Stewed Tomatoes
instructions: Place tomato quarters juice salt and pepper in small pan. Bring to a boil. Simmer until tomatoes begin to soften. Remove from heat. Stir in sweetener bread and margarine. Serve. Equals 1/2 #A limited veggies lunch bread and 1/6 fat allowance.

title: Orange Slice Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into 3 logs. Slice when chilled.

title: 5 Flavors Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar until fluffy; add eggs. Mix flour and baking powder and add to mixture alternately with milk. Stir in extracts. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Partially freeze steak; slice across grain into 2x1/4 in. strips. Brown steak in oil in a skillet over medium-high heat 4-6 minutes. Add beef broth and next four ingredients. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Combine cornstarch sugar and soy sauce; stirring well. Add to beef mixture and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add tomato wedges and toss gently. Serve over rice.

title: Reese'S Cups
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together; press in a long pan. Melt chocolate chips in the top of a double boiler. When all chips are melted in a smooth mixture pour over top of candy. Let cool 30 minutes before cutting into bars.

title: Lemon Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix Cool Whip egg and lemon cake mix together by hand. (Batter is very stiff.) Roll cookie dough into a log shape and coat lightly with 10x sugar. Pinch off small pieces of cookie dough (approximately quarter size) and drop in 10x sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Kalops Swedish Beef Stew
instructions: Dredge meat in flour; set aside. In Dutch oven melt butter over medium heat until golden brown. Add meat and brown well. Sprinkle with any leftover flour and salt allspice bay leaves and 1 1/2 cups water. Stir to loosen pan drippings. Cover; simmer 1 hour and 15 minutes. Stir occasionally until meat is almost tender. Add carrots and onions and more water if necessary to cover and simmer until meat and vegetables are tender. Discard bay leaves. Serve with mashed potatoes and pickled beets.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil. Sift dry ingredients together. Then add to egg mixture. Fold in carrots nuts raisins and flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat pudding and milk on low speed for 2 minutes. Fold in half of the whipped topping and 1/2 to 3/4 cup of coconut. Pour into crust. Spread with remaining whipped topping; sprinkle with remaining coconut. Chill. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Zucchini Mexicana
instructions: In medium skillet saute onion in oil. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 5 to 10 minutes. Place zucchini mixture in an 8-inch square baking dish; top with cheese. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Spicy Whipped Cream
instructions: Whip and chill for 1 hour.

title: Salad Dressing For Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; beat smooth. Use as needed. This will keep in refrigerator several weeks.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put 1/2 of stuffing mix and spice packet on bottom of a casserole dish. Mix the soups and sour cream together in a bowl then put broken up chicken on top of stuffing mix then soup mixture on top of that then add the rest of the stuffing mix and season pack on top. Pour over the broth and melted butter. Bake for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: On-Call Salad
instructions: In a blender container or food processor bowl combine garbanzo beans mayonnaise or salad dressing and Green Goddess salad dressing. Cover and blend until mixture is smooth. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the mixture over each lahvosh cracker. Sprinkle shredded lettuce shredded Cheddar cheese and sliced almonds over each cracker. Layer lahvosh 3 in a stack to form 4 stacks. Cover the salads with clear plastic wrap; refrigerate up to 4 hours. Makes 4 servings.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions and separate into rings; set aside. Mix flour corn meal salt sugar and egg together. Add milk to the thickness or thinness to suit you just so it sticks to onions. Drop into hot oil in deep fryer or saucepan until golden brown.

title: Soda Cracker Bars
instructions: Line jelly roll pan with foil. Put soda crackers (salt side up) in pan. Heat butter or margarine. Add brown sugar. Boil hard for 3 minutes. Pour over crackers. Bake for 5 minutes at 400\u00b0 until crackers float. Cool for just a second. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Spread when melted. Top with chopped nuts. Cut when warm.

title: Cheese-Spinach Souffle Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray or butter a 15 x 12-inch jelly roll pan. Line the pan with heavy wax paper and spray again. In a large skillet melt the butter. Using a whisk blend in the flour and pepper. Gradually stir in the cream and cook until thickened. Beat in the cheeses. Gradually add the egg yolks stirring constantly. Beat the egg whites and 1 teaspoon of salt until foamy. Add 1/2 teaspoon of cream of tartar and continue beating until stiff. Carefully fold into the cheese sauce one-third at a time. Pour into the prepared pan. Bake for 20 minutes or until the center when touched feels firm. Turn the sheet of souffle out on a sheet of aluminum foil.

title: Era'S Shipwreck Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread in the pan the chopped pecans and coconut. Mix the cake according to directions and spread on top of nuts and coconut.

title: Butter Pastry
instructions: Sift flour and salt into a mixing bowl. Cut butter into the flour with a pastry blender until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle on the ice water a little at a time blending it quickly into the dough by gathering up the mixture working it lightly with your fingers then squeezing it together. (Work fast as the mixture must stay cold.)

title: Moussaka
instructions: Lightly coat eggplant slices with flour. Brown on both sides and set aside. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat then stir in tomato sauce and salt. Simmer 1 or 2 minutes.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Melt the butter; stir in the brown sugar. Refrigerate until cool. Add the sour cream and vanilla. Chill; serve with fruit.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar and peppers; bring to a rolling boil. Cook 7 minutes. Add Certo and stir. Take off heat; let stand 5 minutes. Add a few drops of food coloring; pour into jars and seal. This is good with beans meats etc. It can also be used as a snack. Spread Ritz crackers with cream cheese and top crackers with Pepper Jelly.
