title: Chocolate Eclair Pie
instructions: Mix together pudding and milk. Blend in Cool Whip. In a 9 x 13-inch dish layer graham crackers (do not crush); then add pudding mixture. Repeat until youve made 3 layers finishing up with crackers on top.

title: Walnut Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Pour croutettes stuffing mix into large mixing bowl. Set aside. Cook celery and onion in margarine until tender. Add to stuffing mix tossing gently. Stir lightly while adding hot water. Gently stir in walnuts.

title: Salad Pickles
instructions: Peel and slice cucumbers and let stand overnight in brine made with 1/2 cup salt to 3 quarts water. Slice thin or chop fine the onions. Mix sugar spices flour and vinegar. Add cucumbers onions and pimentos. Cook 10 minutes. Pack in jars while hot and seal at once.

title: Chicken Ring With Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Cut up chicken; combine ingredients in order given and mix well. If stock is used in place of milk use less salt. Pack mixture in two generous sized buttered ring molds and bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) for 45 to 60 minutes. Allow chicken rings to stand for 10 minutes or longer in a warm place (this insures easy removal) then turn onto two large platters and fill centers with mushroom sauce.

title: Red Beet Eggs
instructions: Drain juice from beets and add water if necessary to make 1 cup. Heat everything (except beets and eggs) to boiling. Pour hot liquid over beets and cover. Refrigerate 12 hours. Remove beets and place eggs in beet juice. Place beets on top of the eggs. If necessary add enough water to cover eggs completely with beet juice. Cover. Refrigerate 48 hours. Slice eggs lengthwise to serve. Great for a picnic.

title: Meatball Stroganoff
instructions: Mix beef onion egg bread salt and pepper; shape into 16 meatballs. Brown in skillet (use shortening if needed). Pour off drippings. Add soup and water. Cover and simmer 10 minutes stirring now and then. Blend in sour cream. Heat. Serve over noodles. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: In spring-form pan fill bottom and sides with open ladyfingers. Fill sides first then go across bottom.

title: Great-Great Aunt Clara'S Broccoli Supreme
instructions: In mixing bowl combine egg broccoli corn onion salt and pepper. In small pan melt butter add stuffing mix tossing to coat. Stir 3/4 cup mix into vegetables. Put in ungreased 1-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining mix. Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Sukiyaki
instructions: Blend soy sauce chicken broth sugar and cornstarch in small bowl; set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons of Crisco oil in skillet. Add beef and cook over medium heat until browned. Remove beef and drippings; set aside. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in skillet. Cook carrots until tender. Add onions mushrooms and rest of ingredients as desired (as many as can). Stir-fry until onions are tender-crisp. Stir in soy sauce mixture; cover and cook for 3 minutes. Add beef; stir-fry 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese with enough clam juice to make creamy. Drain remaining juice from clams and stir clams into cream cheese then stir in sour cream.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown pork (cut into cubes) in vegetable oil. Add diced onions and celery. Cover with water. Simmer about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Add Chop Suey vegetables and mushrooms. Add a little water for juice. Add 3 tbsp. LaChoy Sauce salt and pepper and bring to a boil. To thicken add a little corn starch with water.

title: Quick Franks & Potatoes
instructions: Split each frankfurter lengthwise and arrange in baking dish. Spoon 1 tbsp tomato sauce into each pocket. Spoon mashed potatoes between frankfurters. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Place pie in preheated 450\u00b0 oven. Bake for 45 minutes (do not peek). To test a silver knife inserted should be come out clean. Cool. Serve with or without whipped cream.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Mix 3/4 cup water milk sugar salt and shortening. Heat. Let cool to lukewarm then add beaten eggs. Add yeast then enough flour to make a stiff dough. Grease top of dough. Cover and place in refrigerator. Let rise about 4 to 6 hours or overnight. Knead well. Roll out and cut. Brush with butter and fold over. Put in warm place and let rise until double. Bake at 350\u00b0 or 375\u00b0 until brown. Makes 5 dozen rolls.

title: Chicken Elegante
instructions: Place contents of vegetable-seasoning packet and 2 tablespoons of the margarine in a large bowl. Add hot water (I use more water probably 2 1/2 cups because I like moist dressing); stir to partially melt margarine. Add stuffing crumbs; stir to moisten. Let stand until water is absorbed.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in an iron skillet or 9 1/2 x 12-inch baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. If you use a glass dish lower oven to 325\u00b0. I use a tablespoon or so of pimento to add color.

title: Giant Old Fashion Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
instructions: Beat butter sugars and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs beating until well blended. Combine flour cinnamon baking soda and salt gradually add to butter mixture. Stir in oats raisins and nuts. Drop by 1/4 cup on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 15-17 minutes until edges begin to brown. Let stand 3 minutes before removing. Makes 2 dozen really big cookies. Can be made smaller if desired.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage and break up in small pieces; drain. Heat 4 1/2 cups water. Add rice and soup; boil for 7 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vegetables and sausage; mix well. Put in baking dish; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Dedy'S Mayo Muffs
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix just until moistened. Fill greased muffin tins. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 6 muffins.

title: Chili Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix cheese and chili powder in pie plate. Add chicken; turn to evenly coat on all sides. Place chicken on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and peppers in a large pan. Drain fat. Stir in soup salsa water and olives. Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes. Meanwhile prepare cornmeal mixes according to package. Put 1/2 in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Then layer hot meat mixture real carefully. Add remaining cornmeal on top. Bake 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove from oven; top with grated cheese and halved cherry tomatoes.

title: Diabetic Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl. Put in pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: French Beef Casserole
instructions: Dont brown meat. Put all ingredients in a covered dish. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 3 to 4 hours. Makes its own gravy. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Chicken Dumplings
instructions: First put in pressure cooker for 35 minutes; then let pressure cooker cool. Take off lid put on stove and let it come to a boil; then add 3 boiled eggs in it 2 big cans biscuits or make own dough. Let it cook 10 minutes until done. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.

title: Big Mama'S Homemade Rolls
instructions: Dissolve shortening in hot water. Make sure it is cooled a little. Add sugar salt egg and yeast in lukewarm water. Spoon in flour a little at a time and let rise overnight. Roll out in the morning and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Noodle Soup
instructions: Combine chicken broth water and noodles. Add vegetables and cook 3 to 5 minutes until tender. Add beaten egg. Stir quickly. Looks like egg drop soup.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Wash the potatoes. Bake until done. Cool peel and dice into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Chop the onions. Mix through potatoes. Melt Cheez Whiz (microwave). Pour (into) over the potatoes and mix through. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered. Let stand about 5 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream\tmargarine and Crisco. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add\teggs one at a time beating between each addition. Beat until you cant\tfeel any sugar on spatula. Add flavoring.\tFold in milk and flour that has been sifted 3 times. (Sift measure. Add baking powder and salt.) Put into a large tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Party Oyster Crackers
instructions: Pour mixture over oyster crackers. Mix well. Pour into shallow pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Pickles Made Over
instructions: Slice pickles 1/4-inch. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over pickles; leave overnight. Bring vinegar water and sugar to a boil. Add celery seeds. Pour over pickles. Place in refrigerator 4 to 5 days before serving.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a gallon container. Finish filling with water to make 1 gallon. Kool-Aid color is color of punch.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and put in a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with Pepperidge Farm (seasoned) or Stove Top stuffing mix. Melt 1 stick of butter or margarine and pour over the stuffing. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain beans and mix with first 5 ingredients. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with can of onion rings and heat another 5 minutes.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar and salt. Slowly add milk stirring constantly. Add well beaten egg yolks; cook until thickened. Remove from heat add vanilla and coconut. Cool. Pour in baked pie shell.

title: California Veggies
instructions: About a peck of dandelion leaves will be required for a pint when cooked. Look each over carefully and wash well in several waters; lay them in cold water for twenty minutes. Put over to cook in an abundance of boiling water; put in a tablespoonful of salt and cook from thirty to forty minutes. They will require a longer time if the leaves are not tender. When done put in a colander; drain and press out all the water. Return to the stove in a saucepan; season with a little pepper and a teaspoonful of butter. Cut through with a sharp knife and mix thoroughly. Put in a hot dish and garnish if liked with slices of cold hard-boiled eggs. Serve with vinegar. Some prefer to boil a small piece of fat salt pork well washed with the dandelions putting it in when the water is changed. Dandelions make very nice greens and are considered very wholesome but can rarely be obtained outside of rural districts. They certainly should be as marketable as spinach.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Mix together coconut sugar flour and salt. Stir in egg whites and almond extract. Drop from teaspoon onto lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Remove from cookie sheet immediately.

title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream the Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla. Blend in egg. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Stir in chips. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Leglio E'Olio
instructions: Saute garlic in olive oil over low to medium heat about 10 minutes. Do not brown. Cover and keep hot. Add salt to boiling water and cook noodles until tender. Drain reserving 1/4 cup water. Stir reserved water into garlic mixture. Pour over spaghetti and toss. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Painless Pudding
instructions: Crumble fig bars. Add chopped nuts and moisten with Muscatel wine. Chill. Top with vanilla ice cream.

title: Fiesta Chili
instructions: Melt fat in deep heavy pan; add chopped onions and diced jalapenos and cook over low heat until done but not browned. Add ground beef and cook until browned about 10 minutes. Drain liquid from beans into small bowl and save. Add beans soup chili powder and salt to beef in pan. Stir well. Cover pan and let chili cook slowly over low heat for about 30 minutes. If chili gets too dry add desired amount of bean liquid. Can be made ahead of time and reheated. It even tastes better the next day.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Pour into greased muffin pan or cups lined with paper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes. So simple and yet so delicious!

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In 3 quart oblong baking dish combine soup milk thyme and pepper. Stir in vegetable and chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble. Meanwhile cut each biscuit into 1/4s and arrange biscuits over mixture. Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put cherry pie mix pineapple and juice in pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Pat down. Pour melted oleo over coconut and nuts. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Or Shrimp Wedges
instructions: Combine all ingredients except seafood and muffins. Gently stir in crabmeat or shrimp. Spread mixture on split muffins and place on cookie sheet to freeze. When frozen cut each muffin into 6 wedges. Bag and freeze until needed. When ready to serve take out amount needed and place on cookie sheet. Broil until slightly bubbly and browned. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Ham Crescents
instructions: Drain pineapple well reserving juice. Reserve 2 spears for sauces chop and set aside. Unroll crescent rolls. Wrap ham and cheese around pineapple. Place at widest part of crescent and roll up. Place on baking sheet . Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden. In saucepan boil reserved juice with mustard until thickened about 10 minutes stirring frequently. Stir in chopped pineapple. Serve with crescents. Makes 8 sandwiches.

title: Corn Pone Pie
instructions: Combine meat onion sugar and chili sauce and saute in butter until meat changes color. Add tomatoes and beans and simmer for 15 minutes. Place meat mixture in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spread cornbread batter on top of meat mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Hot Dog Cheese Rolls
instructions: Combine bologna and cheese cubes with green onions boiled eggs and olives. Toss mixture with salad dressing and chili sauce; mix well. Spread into hot dog buns; wrap in foil tightly. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until cheese begins to melt. Nice for after church snacks.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In saucepan bring sugar and milk to a boil and boil for 3 minutes. Then add peanut butter and mix well. Add marshmallow and mix well. Pour into an 8 inch square pan and chill until set.

title: Favorite Pecan Pie
instructions: Prick bottom and sides of pastry shell; bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Set aside to cool. Beat eggs until light and lemon colored; add sugar and corn syrup beating until fluffy. Add butter salt and vanilla; stir well. Pour filling into pastry shell. Top with pecan halves. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until center is firm. Yield One 9-inch pie.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten whole eggs. Add vanilla vinegar and salt. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Start cooking at 300\u00b0. Raise heat in 10 minutes to 350\u00b0. It takes about 45 minutes in all to cook. Makes 2 pies.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve the circus peanuts and jello in the hot water. When cool add the pineapple and Cool Whip.

title: Basic Pudding Or Pie Filling
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and salt. Stir in a small amount of milk until blended. Beat in egg yolks then add rest of milk and butter. Cook over medium heat (stir constantly until thick). Then add vanilla.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Heat soup slowly; do not boil. Add gelatine and salt then set aside. Mix with Miracle Whip and cream cheese. Add celery onion and soup. Then add shrimp. Pour into quart mold and let stand in refrigerator at least 8 to 12 hours. Very good on Triscuit crackers.

title: Caramel Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well with mixer. Serve with sliced apples that have been brushed with lemon juice to prevent browning.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix all and put in greased 9X13 pan. Top with topping.

title: Sloppy Joe
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil and meat to the pan. Spread the meat around the pan and begin to break it up. Combine brown sugar and steak seasoning. Add sugar and spice mixture to the skillet and combine. When the meat has browned add onion and red peppers to the skillet. Reduce heat to medium and cook onions peppers red wine vinegar and Worcestershire sauce with meat for 5 minutes. Add tomato sauce and paste to pan. Stir to combine. Reduce heat and simmer Sloppy Joe mixture 5 minutes longer. Using a large spoon or ice cream scoop pile sloppy meat onto toasted buttered bun bottoms and cover with bun tops. Garnish with sliced tomatoes and/or pickles.

title: Easter Sunday Pork Sausage Ring
instructions: Beat eggs; add the rest of the ingredients and mix thoroughly. Grease a 6-cup ring mold. Press meat mixture into mold. Cover. Chill overnight in the refrigerator. Next morning unmold onto a foil covered broiler pan. Poke a few holes in foil to allow grease to drain away while baking. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Scramble enough eggs for your guests; place ring on a serving platter and put scrambled eggs in the center. Garnish with fresh fruit. Absolutely delicious! I have to make two for our family.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar until well blended. Add eggs and blend well. Add flour vanilla and 7-Up. Bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chinese Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake.

title: Dutch Apple Hot Bread
instructions: Add milk sugar butter and salt to scalded milk. Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast cake in lukewarm water. Add beaten eggs. Combine first mixture. Add flour to make very stiff batter. Cover batter and let set in warm place to rise about 25 minutes. Work down and then spread in greased baking pan to a depth of 3/4 to 1-inch. Brush with butter and let rise again. Peel apples and slice. Arrange slices on dough pressing slightly. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0) about 30 minutes.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients as you would a tossed salad. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Serves 6 to 8. Recipe can easily be halved. Especially good with a vegetable soup or your favorite pot of beans.

title: Neil'S Hearty Italian Soup
instructions: Saute sausage onions and garlic; drain if necessary. Add beef broth tomatoes wine sugar and herbs. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add pasta; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 to 6 minutes longer or until vegetables and pasta are tender. Sprinkle with pepper and parsley. Serve with Parmesan cheese. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage in medium skillet. Cook until brown and drain well. Line the bottom of a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with crescent rolls firmly pressing perforations to seal. Sprinkle with sausage and cheese.

title: Marshmallow Peach Pie
instructions: In double boiler heat marshmallows and milk until melted. Dice peaches and pour sugar over the top of them. Stir and let stand until juicy. When marshmallow mixture is cool and a little thick fold in the peaches and whipped cream. Pour into baked cooled pie shell. Chill until firm.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Using large kettle boil first four ingredients until thread stage (238\u00b0). Add butter and peanuts. Stir; cook until golden brown (300\u00b0). Remove from heat and add baking soda. Mixture will bubble up. Mix well. Pour into a well-greased cookie sheet. When cool break into pieces and store in an airtight container.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Cream in butter. Add sugar gradually. Add eggs one at a time. Add bananas. Mix well. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce pepper cauliflower onion radishes and peas in a large bowl. Mix mayonnaise with sugar. Spread over salad to seal moisture in. Spread cheese and bacon pieces on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Toss well before serving.

title: Cinnamon Fingers
instructions: Roll in cinnamon and sugar. Bake 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Crock-Pot Dressing
instructions: Combine the corn meal flour celery onion and eggs. Add milk and mix to make batter. Melt 1/2 stick margarine in each of two iron skillets. Add half the batter to each and bake until done. Break up bread in a large bowl. Add 1 stick melted margarine soups sage chicken and broth and black pepper. Pour into crock-pot and cook 45 minutes.

title: Hungarian Nut Rolls
instructions: Mix flour salt and sugar together. Add butter and margarine and mix like for pie dough. Add egg yolks to cooled milk.\tMake well in flour mixture and add milk mixture and yeast. Blend together with hands (do not over knead). Cover and place in refrigerator for few hours or overnight if desired. Make into 1/2 pound balls (will make 6).

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Put drained salmon in bowl and remove skin as desired. Add sour cream egg onion salt and pepper. Crush corn flakes and add to mix until it holds shape (about 2 1/2 cups). Flatten into patties and place in more crushed corn flakes. Fry until golden brown.

title: Pinwheels
instructions: Spray 8 to 9-inch square pan with no-stick cooking spray. Spread on bottom and sides of pan with paper towel. Mix gelatin and water in a 1 1/2 to 2-quart microwavable bowl; microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes stir to dissolve completely. Count or measure marshmallows. Add the marshmallows; microwave 1 minute or until marshmallows are puffed and almost melted. Stir mixture slowly until marshmallows are completely melted and mixture is smooth. (Cream layer will float to top.) Pour into prepared pan. Refrigerate 45 minutes or until set. Loosen edges with knife. Starting at one edge roll up tightly. With seam side down cut into 1/2-inch slices. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 10 to 12 pieces.

title: Velvet Shrimp
instructions: Preheat cooking oil to 375\u00b0. Mix flour and Old Bay seasoning in a Ziploc bag. Rinse shrimp; place in Ziploc bag; shake evenly to coat shrimp. Carefully place shrimp in hot cooking oil for 3 to 4 minutes or until the shrimp float on surface of oil. Drain shrimp on paper towels and serve with Cocktail Sauce.

title: Vegetables Mornay
instructions: Cook vegetables as directed on package until barely tender. Melt 3 tablespoons of butter. Blend in flour but do not brown. Add milk and cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Add seasonings and cheese stirring until cheese melts. Place drained vegetables in greased 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole. Cover with sauce. Toss bread in remaining butter and scatter on top. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Garden Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Remove tops and seeds from peppers. Cut in half lengthwise and cook in boiling salted water 5 minutes; drain. Cook onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender but not brown. Add limas corn and tomatoes. Mix well. Season pepper; fill with vegetable mixture. Combine bread crumbs with melted butter; sprinkle over stuffed peppers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy Bake Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil. Remove from heat. Add next 7 ingredients. Mix well. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Hungarian Beef Goulash
instructions: In Dutch oven (8-quart size) brown beef shanks in hot oil until browned on all sides. Remove meat and bones to plate. In remaining drippings cook onion until tender. Stir in paprika. Cook 1 minute. Return beef and bones to Dutch oven. Add celery carrots tomatoes with their liquid salt and 5 cups water to boiling. Reduce heat to simmer. Cover for 40 minutes.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Roll crescent rolls out on a flat cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for only 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Tiffany'S Poppy Seed Cake (Bread)
instructions: Mix together well; pour in greased and floured tins. You also can use a Bundt pan to bake this in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Gold Rush Brownies
instructions: Mix together and put into an 8 x 8-inch pan (well-greased). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let brownies cool 10 minutes. Cut into squares and remove from pan.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Sift together\tthree times the flour cornstarch salt and baking powder. Set aside.\tCream butter Crisco and sugar well. Add eggs one at\ta time beating well. Add milk and flour mixture to creamed sugar and Crisco beginning with flour and ending with flour.\tAdd vanilla and coconut. Stir. Beat with electric mixer for 5 minutes. Cook at 325\u00b0 in a 9-inch tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done when tested by inserting and removing a toothpick that doesnt have dough on it.

title: Chicken Shells
instructions: Cook large macaroni shells then cool. Mix broken pieces of chicken with mayonnaise and onion. Mix. Fill shells. Place in baking dish. Mix cream of chicken soup with water; pour over shells. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie Muffins
instructions: Combine sugar flour and pecans; set aside. Mix melted butter eggs and vanilla. Stir into flour mixture. Fill mini muffin pans (makes 2 dozen). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from pans immediately.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Mix sugar and butter in bowl. Stir in eggs until well blended. Add bananas buttermilk and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients except nuts just until moistened. Stir in nuts. Pour mixture into pan. Bake about 1 1/4 hours or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool about 5 to 10 minutes. Loosen sides then remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Strawberry Gelatin Salad
instructions: Mix jello hot water and Coke or 7-Up and cool to jelly point then add pineapple and marshmallows. Congeal mixture.

title: Cream Cheese Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost cookies when cool with cream cheese frosting.

title: Beef Roll Ups
instructions: Prepare stuffing as per directed on package. Cut steak into 6 pieces (6 x 4-inches). Place 1/4 cup stuffing in center of each piece of steak. Starting at narrow end roll up tuck ends in and fasten with toothpick or cord and tie together. In skillet with shortening brown on each side. Pour off excess fat; cover with soup and water. Put cover on and cook over low heat 1 hour or until done. Turn occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Challah Bread
instructions: Early in the day or a day ahead In bowl combine sugar salt yeast and 1 cup flour. In saucepan heat oil and 3/4 cup water until very warm (125\u00b0). With mixer at low speed beat liquid into dry ingredients. Beat at medium for 2 minutes. Reserve 1 egg yolk. To mixture in bowl add egg white 2 eggs and 1 cup flour; beat 2 minutes. Stir in 1 1/4 cups flour. On floured surface knead until smooth and elastic about 10 minutes working in about 1/4 cup flour.

title: Low-Fat French Fries
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes for French fries. Spray large cookie sheet with low-fat cooking spray. Place potatoes on cookie sheet. Spray potatoes with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn potatoes and bake until light brown about 5 more minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar margarine cream cheese salt almond extract vanilla and egg yolk; blend well. Stir in flour until well blended. Refrigerate dough at least 2 hours or overnight. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll out on floured surface using 1/3 of dough at a time to 1/8 inch thick. Cut with floured cookie cutter. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes. Leave cookies plain or brush with egg white (slightly beaten) and sprinkle with colored sugar before cooking. Makes 5 to 6 dozen depending on how big and thick cookies are.

title: Baked Nuts
instructions: Toast nuts at 300\u00b0 on baking sheet for about 20 minutes. Cool completely. Beat egg whites and fold in sugar and dash of salt. Beat until stiff. Fold in nuts. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread nuts in dish. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Put sliced tomatoes into baked pie shell. Mix cheese mayonnaise and basil. Pour over tomatoes. Bake at 450\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Karen'S Pizza Casserole
instructions: Salt and cook noodles and drain. Fry sausage then take out of casing and saute onions. Add everything except cheese. Put half of it in casserole and then place cheese strips on top. Put rest of mixture on top and then rest of cheese. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Drop by spoonful into hot broth. Cook 10 minutes with the lid off and 10 minutes with the lid on.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Crumble raw ground meat loosely in 8 x 8-inch pan. Sprinkle with chopped onion. Spread undiluted soup over all. Place frozen Tater Tots in rows across the whole pan. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Serves 5 or 6.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Salt and pepper pork chops; lightly brown chops and drain on absorbent paper. In a medium bowl combine soup and milk. Reserve 1/2 cup for topping; add rice and 1/2 of dry soup mix. Pour mixture into a lightly greased 12 x 9-inch baking dish. Place pork chops on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chops and sprinkle with remaining dry soup mix. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Nuts And Bolts Party Mix
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Melt butter in large roasting pan. Stir in Worcestershire sauce garlic salt and celery salt. Mix well. Add the rest of the ingredients. Bake 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Let cool on paper toweling.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Pour rum over raisins fruit cake mix and cherries. Let set for 1 hour. Cream butter sugar and eggs.\tSift dry ingredients together. Mix creamed mixture with dry mixture add fruit and nuts. Refrigerate overnight. Roll mixture into walnut size balls and bake at 325 degrees for 10-12 minutes.

title: Hot Spiced Tomato Juice
instructions: Boil together all ingredients; strain and serve hot. Garnish with sour cream dollops and parsley flakes (or fresh sprigs). May be reheated. Wonderful for cold weather.

title: Easy Sunday Roast
instructions: Place roast in crock-pot the night before serving. Add all ingredients. Cook on low. Next morning add potatoes and carrots. Ready to serve for lunch.

title: Easy Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: In oil brown onion well. Add shrimp and cook until pink. Add egg and stir constantly until cooked. Add 5 cups cooked rice Season-All soy sauce peas and carrots. Mix together and cook over low fire about 5 minutes more stirring constantly.

title: Purple People Cooler
instructions: Put juice milk and ice cream in blender and mix. Pour into cups; top each with a seedless grape.

title: Chicken-A-La Hawaiian
instructions: Combine barbecue sauce orange juice brown sugar oil flour and salt. Mix well. Cook in skillet until mixture comes to a boil and thickens slightly. Cut chicken in small pieces. Put in baking dish. Pour gravy mixture over chicken. Add pineapple water chestnuts and ginger in sprinkling method over the top. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven 1/2 hour. Serve over rice with sprinkled almonds.

title: Barbecued Brisket
instructions: Place brisket on foil in a large baking pan. Mix first 5 ingredients together and spoon over both sides of brisket. Wrap in the foil and marinate overnight. Sprinkle salt and spoon barbecue sauce over meat in the morning. Wrap in foil and bake 4 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook mostaccioli according to package directions. Add food coloring during cooking time. Drain and then toss with a sufficient amount of oil so pasta doesnt stick together. Place all other ingredients over pasta and stir. Refrigerate and allow flavors to blend for a day or two. Will keep in refrigerator about 3 weeks.

title: Morning Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Rub muffin tins with Crisco. Fill 2/3 full. Bake in moderately hot oven (350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 large muffins. Serve with jelly or cream cheese.

title: Swiss Steak With Rice
instructions: Mix flour salt paprika and pepper. Rub garlic into steak. Saute meat in oil with onion and green pepper. Put remaining flour mixture in skillet then add hot water to make gravy to pour over all. Cover meat with onion green pepper rice and tomatoes. Cover tightly and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolks until light and fluffy. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Beat egg whites and fold into the rest. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13 inch pan. Mix dry ingredients and milk. Pour batter into pan of melted margarine. Add filling or peaches and cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Parmesan Potato Sticks
instructions: Cut potatoes into 6 or 8 wedges lengthwise. Place shallow baking pan in a 425\u00b0 oven with butter or margarine to melt. Add potato sticks and bake for 20 to 30 minutes turning occasionally. Sprinkle with salt and cheese. Return to oven 2 to 3 minutes. (This is like French fry without the fry.) Makes 6 servings.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Mix smooth the sugar vanilla milk and cream cheese. Fold in a carton of Cool Whip. Break angel food cake and place in a large fruit bowl. Pour mixture over cake and top with cherry pie filling.

title: Busy Day Chicken And Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of 13 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Cover bottom evenly with rice. Arrange chicken pieces on rice.

title: Cheddar Nut Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix vigorously (by hand) for 30 seconds or until blended. Spoon into a buttered 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Recipe For A Vital Marriage
instructions: Blend with much Understanding and lots of Forgiveness. Bake continuously in the oven of Commitment and Trust. Baste often and liberally with a Sense of Humor. Serve with plenty of Communication in a Problem-Solving Atmosphere (especially good when shared with loving Family and Friends).

title: Easiest Ever Biscuits
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix and handle lightly. Put out on floured surface and lightly roll. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place in greased pan. Bake 13 minutes then turn oven to broil. Broil 2 minutes or until browned. Makes about 15 biscuits.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup crushed potato chips and bake for another 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Soap
instructions: Cook when the moon is going full. Heat water and then add grease. Add lye and stir as needed. Dont let it overflow. Hold stir paddle up and it will thicken and string when ready. Let fire die out naturally. Set overnight or longer. Skim off top as necessary. Cut in bars.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Stir in brown sugar. Arrange pineapple in mixture. Stir shortening to soften. Stir in dry ingredients. Add juice lemon peel and egg; mix until all flour is dampened. Beat 2 minutes. Pour batter over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until done. Let stand 10 minutes; invert on plate.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks with milk in a double boiler; set aside. In a bowl mix flour sugar and cocoa together; add to milk and eggs then add vanilla and butter. Cook until thick. Pour into pie shell. Save the egg whites for meringue.

title: Apricot Squares
instructions: Simmer apricots in 1 cup water for 20 to 25 minutes. Combine sugar 2 tablespoons flour and cinnamon. Stir into apricots; cook until bubbly then 1 more minute. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Combine flour oats and bran cereal. Cut in margarine. Set aside 1/2 crumb mix. Stir in 3 tablespoons water into remaining crumbs. Press into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Top with apricot mixture then reserved crumbs. Press together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Make cake by directions on package and bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Let cool. Also make vanilla pudding by package directions. Start by crumbling 1/3 of cake in bottom of punch bowl or large salad bowl. Spoon 1/3 of pudding over cake. Spoon cherries and pineapple (use slotted spoon) leaving enough for 2 more layers. Spread layer of Cool Whip over this. Repeat until all ingredients are used ending with Cool Whip on top.

title: Grits Angela(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: In a large box mix melted Velveeta cheese tomatoes and crumbled sausage. Stir. Add cooked grits to mixture. Stir. Beat egg. Slowly mix 2 to 3 teaspoons of hot grits mixture into beaten egg so egg warms slowly. Stir the egg-grits mixture into full pot of grits tomatoes and sausage. (The egg step can be omitted but it makes the final product fluffier.) Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with 1 1/2 to 2 cups freshly grated Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: First boil potato with skin on it. Peel potato after its cooked. Mash potato into sugar while hot. Mix into stiff ball. Roll out onto wax paper. Spread peanut butter on it. Roll up like a jelly roll. Now slice into slices.

title: Date, Nut Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients into a large mixing bowl; add Crisco eggs and pumpkin. Mix 2 to 3 minutes with electric mixer. Stir in dates and nuts. Drop by large teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 depending on oven 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 6 dozen medium cookies.

title: Barbecue Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage to base in 4 quarters but do not cut all the way through. Open cabbage and alternate layers of onion pepper and tomato. Add margarine. Add bacon slices. Wrap twice in heavy-duty foil must be wrapped twice. Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes in coals.

title: Ruth'S Date Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over mixture of dates walnut pieces and soda and let stand. Cream together sugar and lard or Crisco. Add eggs. Add water from dates. Add flour and salt. Add dates nuts and vanilla. Do not frost. Serves a lot of people. Can be cut when cool into small loaf sizes. Wrap in Saran Wrap and then aluminum foil. Freeze. Makes nice small gifts by adding brightly colored ribbon.

title: Working Girl'S Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with salt pepper and garlic powder. Dilute soup with milk. Place chicken in buttered casserole or baking dish and cover with diluted soup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Basic Sugar Cookie Dough
instructions: Cream sugars eggs butter and oil. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Chill for an hour or overnight. Roll in balls or drop and flatten with a glass dipped in sugar.

title: Fantastic Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together and freeze.

title: Fantastic Fudge Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Sift together sugar flour and cocoa. In bowl beat eggs; add flour mixture butter flavoring and pecans. Pour in large baking dish. Put in another pan with hot water. Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Do not overbake. They will firm up as they cool. Will be like candy with crust. Makes 36.

title: Tamale Dip
instructions: Mix cheese tamales and chili until cheese melts. Stir often. Then add Ro-Tel tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve over chips.

title: Humus(Chickpea Dip)
instructions: Drain liquid from chickpeas; reserve 1/4 cup liquid. Place chickpeas lemon juice and reserved liquid in blender container; cover. Puree scraping sides of container frequently with spatula until smooth. Transfer chickpea mixture to medium size bowl; stir in sesame seed oil garlic snipped mint and salt. Pour chickpea mixture into shallow serving bowl; make well in center. Pour olive oil into well. Garnish with mint leaves olives and parsley. Sesame seed oil is called tahina in Middle East supermarket.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Cook corn until soft in boiling salted water in a saucepan; drain thoroughly reserving 1 cup liquid. Melt butter with corn liquid in a saucepan. Add flour and cook stirring rapidly until mixture is smooth and rolls away from the sides of the pan. Remove from heat. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in cooked corn.

title: Magic Cookie Bar
instructions: Pour melted butter or margarine in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs even over. Scatter chocolate morsels over nuts. Sprinkle coconut evenly over chocolate pieces and nuts. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Cool 15 minutes; cut into bars.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form into loaf or into two loaves. Place in oven with small amount of water and in covered container. Roast at 350\u00b0.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and cheese as per package instructions and cool completely. Chop tomato cucumber and onion and add to the cooled macaroni and cheese. Stir in Miracle Whip. Chill.

title: Cinnamon Crisps
instructions: Combine water and vanilla. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Lightly coat both sides of 3 tortillas with cooking spray. Lightly brush each side with water mixture and sprinkle each side with about 3/4 teaspoon sugar mixture. Place on a wire rack in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Contains 2.7 grams fat.

title: Scrumptious Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: With an electric mixer combine first 8 ingredients. Beat until well blended. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until set. Cool on wire rack. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Mix in a large pan the sour cream cream of chicken soup and mushrooms. Cut up chicken in large pieces and spread over the mixture. Then add prepared stuffing and spread over top of chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apricot Layered Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; stir in cold water and then remaining ingredients. Pour into oblong baking dish. Refrigerate until set.

title: Veggie Hot Dish
instructions: In a 9 x 12-inch dish place vegetables (frozen or thawed). Pour can of soup and rinse can out with small amount of milk. Cover veggies and soup with croutons and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Pour corn oil into fryer or skillet. Clip the thermometer to edge. Sift together flour salt baking powder and sugar in a mixing bowl. Measure 1 1/2 tsp. corn oil into bowl; mix with fingers until combines. Then add lukewarm water and evaporated milk; use finger tips to work liquid into dough until you can form sticky ball. Pour dough out and knead for about 1 minutes with flour. Cover dough with damp towel to rest for 15 minutes. Divide dough evenly into 3 balls cover dough with damp towel for another 20 minutes. Take 1 ball and roll out with flour into circle. Trim off rough edges cut into 6 wedge shapes. Roll out other balls. Heat oil to 380-390 degrees until light brown. Remove from oil and place on paper towels.

title: Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Let cool. Drain all syrup off of crushed pineapple into measuring cup. Add enough cold water to make 1 cup and add to Jell-O. Add sour cream. Using electric mixer blend on medium-low speed until all of sour cream is dissolved and mixture is smooth. Stir in crushed pineapple and cherries if you wish. Grease lightly 10 to 12-cup mold with mayonnaise. Pour mixture by cupfuls into mold. Refrigerate 4 to 6 hours or overnight.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into a greased floured Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. After cake cools drizzle with powdered sugar icing (optional).

title: Peanut Butter Haystacks
instructions: Melt peanut butter chips and chocolate chips in double boiler. Stir in peanuts. Mix well. Drop on wax paper. Let set until hard.

title: Cranberry Waldorf
instructions: Grind cranberries and combine with marshmallows and sugar. Cover and chill overnight. Add apples grapes and walnuts. Fold in container of Cool Whip.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Place chicken onions parsley flakes bouillon cubes salt and pepper and 4 cups water in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Boil until chicken is done. Remove chicken to cool. You should have 3 to 4 cups of broth left. Add soups to broth. Bring to a boil. Turn down heat and let simmer. Cook egg noodles according to directions. Cut chicken into cubes. Add to soup. Drain noodles and add to soup. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve with toasted barbecue bread.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Place meat in Earthenware or china dish. Combine salt pepper brown sugar bay leaves and mixed spices with enough 1/2 cider vinegar and 1/2 water mixture to cover meat. Heat to boiling and pour over meat. Allow meat to cool. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 days covered. Turn occasionally. Put meat in a roaster with a little spiced vinegar. Roast at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours or until meat is brown and tender. Remove meat from pan.

title: Hot And Spicy Chicken Wings
instructions: Follow directions on Shake n Bake box. Double chicken pieces for wings. Bake in oven until done.

title: Creamy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Gently simmer chicken until tender (approximately 20 minutes). Remove chicken from the bone and cut up in small chunks.

title: Betty'S Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in airtight container. Just add 1/3 cup mixture and cup water to make chocolate drink.

title: Sweet And Juicy Cheesesteak
instructions: In large frying pan cook onions and chip steak until done. Add sweet pepper strips including the juice. Let the juice cook down a little about 5 minutes. Place 2 slices of cheese in roll and add steak mixture and serve.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Boil cabbage leaves that have been separated for 2 to 3 minutes. Place meat rice salt pepper and lemon juice in a bowl and mix well. Stuff and roll cabbage leaves with meat mixture into small firm rolls. Arrange the rolls in baking dish. Place 2 cloves garlic between each layer. Add water tomatoes and tomato paste and cover and bake until done.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms 1
instructions: Remove stems and toss mushrooms with 1 large clove garlic (minced). Saute mushrooms and garlic in 3 tablespoons sweet butter or olive oil for parsley (minced) pepper to taste 1/4 cup Mozzarella cheese 1/3 cup fresh bread crumbs 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves (minced) or 1 teaspoon dry leaves. Stuff mushroom caps and place in buttered 8 x 11-inch gratin dish. Add 1/2 cup dry white wine to pan and bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Place under broiler for 1 minute or until tops are golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook potatoes; peel. Add butter or hot mash with masher. After thoroughly mashing pour into pie crust. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Makes 2 pies.

title: Turtle Hot Dogs
instructions: Split hamburger rolls into halves and place under broiler until toasted. Keep warm. Heat beans in small saucepan or microwave until heated through. Keep warm. Split frankfurters into halves lengthwise. Melt butter in small skillet. Add frankfurters and cook until lightly browned. Spread pickle relish on bottom halves of toasted rolls. Top each with 2 frankfurter slices forming X. Spoon on beans then top with tops of rolls. Push carrot sticks into olives then insert carrots into rolls to form turtle head. Makes 4 servings.

title: Herb Roasted Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cut chicken into serving pieces. Arrange chicken in 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

title: Sweet Potato Raisin Patties
instructions: Mash sweet potatoes. Beat in egg and salt. Add flour only if potatoes are wet. Mix in raisins. Drop by tablespoon on heated greased frypan. Brown slowly on both sides.

title: Theresa'S Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter and sugars until smooth and creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour baking soda butterscotch chips and oatmeal. Stir well. Drop tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Drain water from tuna; break up with fork. Add chopped onion celery and apple. Sprinkle lemon juice over. Add mayonnaise and stir up good. Use as is or make a sandwich.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine and sugar. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour over graham crackers arranged on cookie sheet close together. Place in oven and bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool in pan.

title: Bagels
instructions: Combine yeast and 1/2 cup warm water in measuring cup stirring with a fork until dissolved. Combine 2 cups flour salt and sugar in a bowl. Add dissolved yeast and remaining cup of warm water. Beat vigorously with a fork for two minutes. Gradually add enough of remaining flour 1/4 cup at a time to make a soft dough. Turn out of bowl; knead until smooth and elastic (about 8 to 10 minutes) adding a little flour. Place dough back in clean greased bowl; put in a warm place until doubled in size.

title: Cheese Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Mix all the ingredients in casserole and refrigerate overnight. Top with Ritz crackers and bake at 350\u00b0 until hot.

title: Cherry Coconut Bars
instructions: Mix together 1 cup flour confectioners sugar and butter. This mixture will be very coarse. Press into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine eggs cherries coconut and nuts; mix well. Mix in flour baking powder and sugar. Spread onto baked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: *Use all sauce except 1 cup.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes and then lower heat to 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until custard is set.

title: Congealed Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve sugar and gelatin in boiling water. Stir in wine. Refrigerate until mixture thickens. Fold in blueberries and oranges. Spoon into mold. Chill until firm.

title: Lime-Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello and marshmallows in water; cool. Combine cottage cheese pineapple and nuts; chill. Mix Cool Whip and both chilled mixtures together. Pour into an oiled 2-quart mold. Chill until firm.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Melt chocolate chips in top of double boiler and add 1/2 square paraffin. Roll peanut butter mixture into small balls and dip in chocolate mixture. (Use a toothpick and swirl in chocolate.)

title: 7-Layer Casserole
instructions: Wash and drain rice. Drain corn. Layer rice and corn; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour over 1 can of tomato sauce and 1/2 cup water. Layer onion and green pepper then ground beef. Sprinkle with pepper and salt. Pour over second can of tomato sauce and 1/4 cup water. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake about 30 minutes longer. Add strips of bacon if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Water Rolls
instructions: Work first 7 ingredients into a dough and add rest of flour. Place in refrigerator until ready to use. Make rolls and let rise 2 hours. Bake at 450\u00b0.

title: P. B. And Fudge Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and honey. Stir mixture into softened ice cream. Spoon half of ice cream mixture into pie crust. Sprinkle with half of chopped cashews. Drizzle 4 ounces fudge sauce over cashews. Spoon remaining ice cream mixture in pie shell. Sprinkle with remaining cashews. Drizzle 2 ounces fudge sauce over cashews. Freeze overnight. Garnish with Cool Whip.

title: Cucumber And Onion Salad
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine cucumbers and onions. In a small bowl combine the remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour this over the cucumbers and onions and toss. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Butter bread and cut crust off. Cut into cubes and sprinkle with mustard and salt. Add grated cheese. Beat eggs and add milk. Pour over bread and cheese. Place in refrigerator overnight. Pile cornflakes on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until center is set. Use 7 1/2 x 12-inch or 8 x 13-inch pan.

title: Stove Top Chicken And Noodles
instructions: In large saucepan mix soup milk cheese pepper chicken and noodles. Over medium heat heat through stirring occasionally. Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix crumbs and 2 sticks of butter. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat together 2 sticks softened butter powdered sugar and eggs. Spread onto crust.

title: Ham, Potato And Bean Dinner
instructions: The amounts you use will depend on how big your family is.

title: Ham And Cheese Log
instructions: Let cheese stand until soft. Cut ham into small pieces. Cream the cheese and remaining ingredients and form into ball. Chill.

title: World'S Best Sugar Cookie
instructions: Cream together sugar powdered sugar and margarine. Add oil eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Roll into small balls. Place on cookie sheet and press with glass bottom dipped in sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix in order given and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes in loaf pans.

title: Super Good Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add marshmallows and heat until dissolved. Add softened cream cheese and heat well. Cool slightly. Fold in grated carrots pineapple nuts and Cool Whip and chill.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs; mix until blended. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Top with cherry pie filling. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix eggs and oil together. Add remaining ingredients and beat 15 to 20 minutes. Makes four layers. Cook at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Chicken Ole
instructions: Lightly grease bottom and sides of crock-pot. In large bowl mix together soups sour cream diced chilies and onion. Arrange alternate layers of tortillas with chicken and mixture. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours. Sprinkle with cheese and cook on low another 15 to 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Pizza Fondue
instructions: Combine soup mix tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce and oregano. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Add cheese gradually stirring constantly until all cheese melts. Serve with French bread cubes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix together mashed avocados with lemon juice. Mix all ingredients and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Mix oatmeal and hot water and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl. Add the oatmeal mixture. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake the cake mix as directions say in an 11 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cooled cake will be first layer. Second layer Cream the sugar cream cheese and 1 cup of Cool Whip together and spread on cake. Refrigerate until set.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Mix above ingredients together and chill.

title: Pressure-Cooked Wild Turkey
instructions: Place prepared turkey in a pressure canner. Add all other ingredients. Cook until done according to directions in your pressure canner booklet. Remove turkey from canner and put in a large baking pan. Broil very carefully until brown. Rub with a stick of butter or margarine during broiling if meat appears to be drying out. Also place foil over breast if it starts to burn. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mama'S Cold Biscuit Pudding(Over 50 Years Old)
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt in the top of a double boiler; stir in milk. Cook over boiling water stirring until thick. Beat egg yolks and stir into hot mixture. Cook 5 minutes more stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla.

title: Mock Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients. Press into 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes. Let cool.

title: Puttanesca Pasta Sauce
instructions: Cut olives into small pieces. In large skillet heat oil over low heat. Add garlic and cook stirring 1 minute or until golden. Stir in tomatoes with juice roasted pepper tomato paste olives capers oregano and red pepper. Cook over medium heat about 15 minutes until sauce thickens. Stir in anchovies and parsley and simmer 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat and cool. Serve over your favorite pasta.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute celery onion and bell pepper in butter. Mix with remaining ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fat-Pinto Beans
instructions: Clean pinto beans. Rinse and let soak in water all night. The next day boil pinto beans with salt and onion. The beans will be big fat pinto beans.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter. Cook broccoli. Cook rice. Combine sauteed vegetables soups rice Cheez Whiz broccoli and salt. Bake in a casserole dish at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles around edges and in the middle approximately 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Cream together sugar and margarine. Add to the sugar mixture eggs and vanilla; mix well. Add flour baking soda and salt alternately with bananas with the sugar mixture. Stir in oatmeal and nuts. Pour into 3 medium or 2 large lightly greased glass loaf pans. Bake 5 minutes in microwave on High or Roast/Medium to keep the tops from cracking. Can be baked in a regular oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Blend cake mix 1 egg and margarine together. Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan. Blend together powdered sugar cream cheese and 2 eggs until smooth. Pour over cake mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Olive Cheese Ball
instructions: In medium bowl combine softened cream cheese with both types of olives onions and Tabasco sauce; mix thoroughly. Set cheese mixture in refrigerator about 15 minutes to harden slightly for easier handling. Shape cheese mixture into ball. Roll in chopped parsley to coat well. Return to refrigerator chill 15 to 20 minutes or until serving. Serve with assorted crackers. If made day ahead wrap loosely in wax paper. Leftovers can be used as a sandwich spread on rye bread for lunch.

title: Yellow Layer Cake
instructions: Mix sugar Crisco and eggs. Add and mix remaining ingredients. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and frost.

title: Baked Eggs
instructions: Brown first 4 ingredients. Beat eggs milk salt and pepper. Mix together and pour over 6 slices bread pieces in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Cover and set overnight in refrigerator. Put in oven and bake 45 or 50 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and chopped onion in water until tender. Drain. Add soup salt pepper and mix well. Pour into a buttered casserole dish. Pour in 1/2 of dried onions and stir. Cover with remaining onions and shredded cheese. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix both soups and Ro-Tel until well blended. Coarsely crush chips by pounding on a slightly open bag. Spray the bottom of a 9 x 9-inch casserole dish with Pam and richly cover with chips. Add a generous layer of chicken and cover with 1/2 of the soup mixture. Repeat all layers and top with cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with a salad. No need for bread. This is wonderful!

title: Creamy Pineapple Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage and carrot in large bowl. Combine mayonnaise and next 4 ingredients. Add to cabbage mixture tossing gently. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Mom'S Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Remove from heat to cool. Add sugar. Mix well. When cool add flour and beaten eggs. Mix well. Add salt and vanilla. Mix. Put in 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool before cutting. Enjoy!

title: Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan spread 1 can crescent roll mix. In separate bowl beat cream cheese sugar vanilla and egg yolk until creamy. Spread on the crescent roll mix then spread second crescent roll on top pinch all sections together. Brush egg white on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Cooking too long dries the squares.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas in a bowl. Sift flour sugar salt and baking soda together. Add to bananas. If using nuts add now. Stir well. Put in a buttered loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Hayley'S Spiced Pecans(Yields 2 Cups)
instructions: Melt butter and add spices. Coat the nuts in this mixture and toast them at 375\u00b0 until brown (20 to 30 minutes). Shake the nuts occasionally as they toast. Drain on brown paper.

title: Louisiana Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook macaroni as directed. Cook and stir ground beef until brown; drain off fat. In ungreased 2-quart casserole mix macaroni beef and remaining ingredients except potato chips. Cover; bake for 40 minutes. Sprinkle top with chips. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Pasta Seafood Salad
instructions: Cool elbow macaroni as directed on package; drain rinse with cold water and hold aside. Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes drain and rinse with cold water. Combine elbow macaroni broccoli green and red peppers olives and tuna fish. Add Italian dressing and toss gently but well. Makes 13 1/2 cups or 8 servings.

title: Traditional Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixer bowl combine all ingredients except pastry shell. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake for 50 minutes or until a knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean. Cool. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
instructions: Peel pit and mash avocados. Add lemon juice salt and pepper and set aside. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix and set aside. To assemble/layer Spread bean dip on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with avocado mixture. Spread sour cream mixture on top of this. Sprinkle with onions jalapeno peppers and/or olives then tomatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese.

title: French Cream Cake
instructions: Melt butter. Mix in flour and nuts. Pat into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Refrigerator Cake
instructions: Make crumbs of vanilla wafers. Place 1/2 in bottom of buttered pan. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat until smooth and creamy. Pour mixture over crumbs. Whip cream; add pineapple and nuts. Pour over 1st mixture. Cover with remainder of crumbs. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Heat berries sugar and jello just to melt. Mix pudding and milk. Add sour cream. Fold in half of the Cool Whip. Layer wafers pudding and strawberries. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with strawberry and mint leaf.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Cream butter with brown sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Then beat in vanilla and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Sift flour and baking soda and beat mixture into butter mixture in 3 parts alternating with buttermilk. Fold in rhubarb. Pour batter in standard 8 x 8 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Blend sugar and remaining cinnamon and sprinkle over top. Bake until toothpick comes clean 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Top with whipped cream.

title: Spooky Pudding
instructions: Prepare pudding with milk as directed on the package. Pour pudding into 4 dessert dishes. Set pudding in refrigerator to chill for 5 minutes.

title: Cream Chicken On Egg Bread
instructions: Brown onion and celery in butter. Add flour to chicken broth. Add peas pimiento salt and pepper. Add cooked chicken and cook until thick. Make your favorite corn bread and cut in squares. Cover with cream chicken.

title: Henry'S Pork Chops
instructions: In skillet with margarine add salt pepper and chili powder to taste. Cook until brown.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Mix 1/2 can soup hamburger egg onion bread crumbs milk parsley flakes salt and pepper. Put in a 9-inch pie plate and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Frost with 2 cups mashed potatoes and top with remaining soup. Sprinkle shredded cheese over top. Bake an additional 10 minutes.

title: White Bark Cookies
instructions: Melt together white bark and peanut butter. Cool. Mix remaining ingredients with bark mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Bakery Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: In large bowl combine the mashed potatoes and potato water. Add the shortening blend well. Add the salt sugar and egg. In a small bowl combine yeast and lukewarm water stir until dissolved; add to the potato mixture. Add the milk alternately with the flour. Knead dough place in a large bowl. Grease the top of the dough with oleo. Place in the refrigerator overnight. Grease two 9 x 13-inch baking pans turn the dough onto a floured board. Roll out a large even pastry. In a bowl mix a generous amount of brown sugar raisins and cinnamon. Sprinkle the mixture over the rolled out dough. Make several large rolls from the pastry and then cut individual buns from the rolls. Place on the prepared pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Watch the rolls carefully.

title: Breakfast Rolls
instructions: Line 9 x 13 pan with crescent rolls. Pinch seams together. Brown sausage and drain. Add cream cheese and stir until smooth. Spread sausage mixture over crescent rolls. Top with 2nd can crescent rolls. Cook according to crescent roll directions.

title: Scallops Au Gratin
instructions: You will also need a 9 x 13 glass baking dish.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine oats and boiling water; cover and let stand for 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients to oats mixture; mix thoroughly with a spoon until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Oat 'N Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small bowl combine flour baking soda cinnamon and nutmeg; set aside. In a large bowl beat butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla extract until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats and raisins. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Goulash
instructions: Saute onion. Brown beef. Wash and drain. Add beans and 1/2 cup water. Add chili powder celery salt salt and pepper. Cook on medium heat for 10 minutes or until gravy thickens stirring frequently.

title: Kartoffelsalat(German Potato Salad)
instructions: In a skillet combine all ingredients except potatoes sour cream and parsley. Add potatoes. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer 25 minutes or until done. Let stand 30 minutes.

title: Kitty'S Kasserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Season to taste. Drain excess fat. Boil noodles while meat is frying. Mix all ingredients in 2-quart casserole. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Wilted Red Cabbage And Bell Pepper Slaw
instructions: In a saucepan bring vinegar and water to a boil with sugar salt and mustard seed; simmer stirring occasionally for 3 minutes.

title: Allspice Wassail Bowl Punch
instructions: Combine. (Tie cloves and allspice in cheesecloth.) Cover. Simmer for 20 minutes. Serve hot with a cinnamon stick in each mug.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Stir together the flour soda powder and salt. Set aside. In a large bowl beat the margarine and peanut butter until smooth. Beat in sugars until well blended then add eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture. Shape into 1-inch balls. Flatten with fork dipped in water. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes a lot of cookies.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown hamburger and onion. Put meat in bottom of casserole dish. Drain beans and put beans on top of meat. Place Tater Tots evenly on top of casserole. Put soup in separate pan to mix well. Pour soup over casserole and then place in hot oven. Bake 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Enchilada Suisa
instructions: Remove papery husks from tomatillos. Wash tomatillos and chiles well. Cook covered in a little boiling water until tender about 15 minutes. Remove stems and seeds from chiles. Place chiles and drained tomatillos in blender container. Add onion garlic and cilantro and blend until pureed.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl; add walnuts. Add eggs pumpkin oil and water. Blend lightly. Pour into 2 greased bread tins and bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: Macaroni And Cheese And Spam Casserole
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed except use 3/4 cup milk. Add peas and soup; mix well. Pour into 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Arrange meat squares in checkerboard pattern. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: In a large bowl cream the shortening brown sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. Sift together the flour baking powder baking soda and spices. Add to creamed mixture. Blend well. Stir in oatmeal apples nuts and raisins. Spread in greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut in squares. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Tropical Cream Pie
instructions: Put pineapple juice cream cheese sugar coconut and extract in blender. Cover and process until well mixed. Remove to bowl and add pineapple. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into prepared crust. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan (ungreased). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched with finger. Cool in pan.

title: Baked Chicken Breast
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Roll in flour. Brown in cooking oil; place in casserole dish. Make a little brown gravy in oil where you browned chicken and add mushroom soup. Pour over chicken and bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix dry instant pudding mix with pineapple. Fold in pecans marshmallows and Cool Whip. Top with cherries. Chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Polish Sausage Appetizer
instructions: Put sausage pieces in baking dish. Pour undrained pineapple and chili sauce over sausage. Sprinkle brown sugar on top. Cover and cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fish Stuffed Bell Pepper(Appetizer)
instructions: Grind fish or put through food processor. Saute onions and parsley in olive oil. Add 1 cup wine chopped garlic Louisiana hot sauce soy sauce salt and chopped pepper. Cook until onions and pepper are done or real tender. Let cool for a few minutes.

title: Pork Chops With Amber Rice
instructions: Brown chops in skillet. Salt and pepper. Place rice in Pyrex baking dish; pour orange juice over rice. Arrange browned pork chops over\trice. Pour chicken rice soup over all. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Dream Salad
instructions: Boil water with lemon and lime jello for 3 minutes. Then add pineapple and boil 3 minutes more. Chill until partially set. Stir in tub of cottage cheese and marshmallows. Then whip cream cheese (or use Cool Whip) and fold into other ingredients and let set. Add nuts.

title: Spanish Bean Soup
instructions: Heat oil on medium; saute onion and garlic for 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil then reduce to a slow simmer for at least 2 hours. Let cool slightly before serving for maximum flavor. Serve with toasted Cuban or French bread for dipping.

title: Vanilla Taffy
instructions: Combine sugar syrup water and cream of tartar. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves. Continue cooking without stirring to hard ball stage. Remove from heat stir in vanilla and margarine. Pour into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Let stand until cool enough to handle. Pull candy with fingers until it has a satin-like finish and milky-white color. Pull into long strips 3/4-inch wide. Cut into 1-inch pieces with scissors. Wrap in wax paper.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix coconut and pecans. Spread in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix according to package directions. Pour batter over coconut and nuts. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and butter. Pour over batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. When cut turn squares upside down.

title: No Roll Pie Crust
instructions: Put all ingredients in pie pan. Mix and pat around pan. Ready to bake.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as per directions on box. While it is still hot punch full of holes. Boil milk sugar and coconut for 10 minutes. Pour over cake. Cool completely. Top with 8-ounce container of Cool Whip. Put rest of coconut on top. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Old Settlers Beans
instructions: Cook ground beef and bacon; drain. Combine all ingredients except bacon in casserole dish. Lay bacon strips on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Liver And Onions
instructions: In hot oil cook onions 10 to 15 minutes until very tender stirring often. Remove onions to platter; keep warm. Cut liver into 4 portions. Coat liver with flour. In same skillet over medium-high heat in 2 tablespoons oil cook liver 4 minutes or until browned on both sides turning once. Place liver on onions. Serve hot.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut the steak\tinto slices 1/8-inch thick. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. In a large skillet heat the oil add the steak onion and garlic; cook until the meat is browned on all sides. Add the green peppers and bouillon cover and simmer 10\tminutes. Add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes. Mix the cornstarch\tor flour soy sauce and water and stir into the meat mixture. Cook stirring until the mixture has thickened. Serve with hot boiled rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups chili chicken broth together. Cut tortillas bite size. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Cut olives bite size as well. In a 2 quart casserole dish layer starting with the soup mixture chicken olives tortillas and cheese. Continue until all ingredients are used. Put in oven at 350 degrees until it bubbles about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken-Stuffing Delight
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. In bottom of baking dish put the chicken. Add soup. Cover with Stove Top and bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or sheet cake pan. In a saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour; add milk and stir with fork until dough leaves the side of bowl. Turn out onto floured board; knead just until smooth.

title: Baked Chicken With Orange Nut Rice
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels. Combine flour 1 teaspoon salt and pepper. Coat chicken pieces on all sides with flour mixture. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add chicken and brown on all sides.

title: Finger Paint
instructions: Combine flour and water mix until creamy. Add detergent mix well. Add food coloring mixing well. Store in air tight container. Have fun!

title: Jessie'S Divinity
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients and cook for 19 minutes on High in microwave in a 2-quart bowl. Stir every 5 minutes.

title: Curried Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken apple celery and dill. Stir curry powder into mayonnaise. Add lemon juice and sugar. Add more curry powder if desired. Fold in cream. Spoon curry mayonnaise over chicken mixture; toss lightly. Chill thoroughly. Garnish with egg slices and tomato wedges.

title: Romanoff Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine fruit and celery in a bowl. Stir remaining ingredients together and stir into salad mixture. Chill. Serves 6.

title: Curry Chicken
instructions: Mix chicken salt pepper curry onion and green pepper together. Cover bottom of heavy Dutch oven with desired type cooking oil. Slightly brown chicken mixture then add vegetables and liquids. Cover; simmer until chicken is very tender (30 to 40 minutes).

title: Beef Casserole For A Crowd
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Drain. Add cooked noodles soups and Cheez Whiz. Prepare and drain mixed vegetables. Add to beef mixture.

title: Chili
instructions: Saute sausage and beef onion green pepper and garlic in a large heavy saucepan until browned stirring to crumble sausage. Drain excess grease. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Additional water may be added if needed. Yields 8 servings.

title: Oven-Fried Yellow Squash
instructions: Combine corn meal salt and pepper; set aside. Combine egg and water; beat well. Dip squash in egg mixture. Lightly coat a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with vegetable spray. Place squash slices in a single layer in pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown turning once.

title: Five Pound Fudge
instructions: Bring milk sugar and butter to a boil stirring continually. Boil for 8 minutes. Remove from heat add chips and marshmallow cream. Stir until melted add nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased pan to cool. Cut into squares turn out onto wax paper and separate.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Clean and wash the black beans. Cover beans and soak overnight. Use same water medium onion (chopped finely) and salt to taste. Add garlic if desired. Allow beans to boil until the liquid has thickened and has nearly boiled away. Put the beans through a food grinder. This will be a paste. Chop the small onion and fry in the shortening. Add paste with sufficient water to make desired thickness. Cook slowly for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with croutons or fried tortilla strips.

title: Cheese Pudding
