instructions: Melt butter and pour over bread. Cut into cubes. Place mustard egg yolks milk and grated cheese together. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in egg mixture. Pour in buttered baking dish and refrigerate overnight. Cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Yummy Bean Soup
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boil. Simmer about 1 hour covered and 30 minutes uncovered. Makes 8 servings.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Mix and simmer about 30 minutes.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Blend butter sugar and dates; bring to a boil. Let cool. Add other ingredients and roll into small balls then roll in powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter. Boil chicken. Debone. Set broth aside. To sauteed onion add soups sour cream milk salsa and half of both cheeses. Salt and pepper to taste. Some may prefer more garlic powder. Grease baking dish. Boil chicken broth dipping each\tflour tortilla in broth to soften. Put 1 tablespoon mixture in tortilla roll and fold ends. When baking dish if full put remaining mixture over tortillas.\tTop with remaining cheese. Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Candy
instructions: Combine sugar syrup water butter and salt. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Uncover and cook until syrup begins to brown. Remove from fire. Add peanuts baking soda and flavoring. Pour quickly into well buttered shallow pan. When cold cut in squares.

title: Sour Cream Substitute
instructions: Combine water and cheese in blender on high speed for 20 seconds or until cheese is liquified. Mix remaining ingredients. Serve on salads baked potatoes or as a dip.

title: Chicken Salsa Casserole
instructions: Bake chicken in foil for 1 hour at 400\u00b0 then bone. Cut in large pieces. Season. Cut tortillas in strips. Mix soup milk onion and chili salsa.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Chicken
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine all the ingredients except the ketchup. Bring mixture to a boil and cook it over moderately low heat for 20 minutes. The sauce should be thick. Stir in ketchup and remove sauce from heat.

title: Edible Play Dough
instructions: Mix well until blended. If sticky add powdered sugar until desired consistency.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Cream the cheese margarine and flour together. Press into miniature muffin tins sides also (makes 24). Blend vanilla margarine egg brown sugar and pecans. Fill tarts 3/4 full. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Place pecans on top and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Vegetable Tofu Salad
instructions: Marinate tofu for 1 hour in mixture of oil tamari vinegar water honey and garlic. Combine tofu with celery mushrooms and cabbage. Serve.

title: Souper Chicken
instructions: Place all together in a baking pan. Place chicken on top and season. Sprinkle Lipton onion soup (dry) on top. Cook covered until chicken is done. Full time 1 1/2 hours; 400\u00b0 1/2 hour; 350\u00b0 1 hour.

title: Liverwurst Pate
instructions: Mix sausage onion mayonnaise and horseradish; form into a ball. Cover with softened cream cheese (soften with a bit of milk and Tabasco sauce to taste). Roll in dry parsley.

title: Walnut Raspberry Brownie
instructions: Melt chocolate with shortening over warm water; cool slightly. Mix together eggs sugar vanilla and salt. Stir in chocolate mixture. Add flour and stir. Add nuts; stir. Pour into well-greased square pan. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0. Spread jam over hot brownies.

title: Party Salmon Ball
instructions: Drain salmon thoroughly. Flake carefully. Combine with softened cream cheese. Add next 5 ingredients; mix thoroughly. Cover bowl. Refrigerate a few hours until firm. Shape salmon into ball; roll in pecans. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap; return to the refrigerator until serving. If using fish mold use 2 cans of salmon.

title: Friendship Tea Mix
instructions: (Add 1/2 teaspoon or more of each spice if you like your tea highly spiced.)

title: Luscious Lemon
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Mix next three ingredients and spread on crust after crust is cool. Mix pudding with milk and spread over cream cheese mixture. Serve with Cool Whip on top.

title: Rice Chex Treats
instructions: Melt all ingredients except cereal and sugar together. Pour over cereal then put in bag of confectioners sugar and shake to coat.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar cornstarch water syrup and salt. Cook until clear. Remove from heat. Add Jell-O and food coloring; stir to dissolve. Cool completely. Mix berries in gently; pour into pie shell. Chill served with Cool Whip.

title: Red Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Freeze. Just before serving maybe 1 hour add 2 quarts ginger ale. Makes 2 gallons.

title: Easy Apple Moon Pies
instructions: Separate biscuits and one at a time on floured board roll out flat. Place about 1/2 cup apples on biscuit. Sprinkle with sugar. Dot with butter and a dash of cinnamon. Fold dough over and crimp edges. Place on cookie sheet and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Dot with butter. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 until nice and brown.

title: Easy Sweet Pickles
instructions: Mix salt alum pickling spice and\tcucumbers with enough vinegar to cover. Let set 3 months; drain and rinse. Drain thoroughly again. Cut cucumbers in thick slices and put back in gallon jar and cover with 8 cups sugar.

title: Herby Hamburgers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and form into patties. Brown on both sides in large skillet. Pour soup and milk that has been mixed together over patties. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. The gravy is wonderful over mashed potatoes.

title: Refrigerated Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix vanilla wafers and condensed milk. Add cherries pineapple and nuts. Pour into lined loaf pan. Cover with wax paper. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat eggs until light and add. Add lemon juice to mashed bananas. Blend with creamed mixture. Sift dry ingredients together and mix into creamed mixture. Add nuts. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Test for doneness.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in small amount of water. Drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Fold in vegetables. Prepare stuffing mix. Spread half in a 12 x 7-inch dish. Spoon in vegetables. Top with remaining mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Best Ever Homemade Pizza
instructions: Let rise 2 hours. Spread onto pizza pan and pie. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Mustard Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler and cook until thick stirring frequently. Can be served either hot or cold with baked ham. This has been a holiday \must\ in our family since the early 1950s. It will keep for weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Kick The Can Ice Cream
instructions: You will need a 1 pound can or plastic container with lid and a 3 pound can or plastic container with lid.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Combine pineapple oranges grapes marshmallows coconut and nuts. Mix sour cream and sugar. Stir into fruit mixture. Chill.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Soak raisins in orange juice for 5 minutes. Do not drain. In large mixing bowl beat eggs; stir in pumpkin sugar cloves cinnamon and salt. Add oil mixing well. Stir together flours baking powder and soda. Add to pumpkin mixture with the raisin-orange juice mixture and stir to mix. Fill paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Yields 18. Serving size 1.

title: Chocolate Funny Pie(No Crust)
instructions: Blend the butter sugar and cocoa then blend flour and salt. Blend in eggs one at a time and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Canoli Shells
instructions: Cream Ricotta cheese. Whip the whipping cream. Add confectioners sugar to cream. Mix cheese and cream; mix well. Cut up very fine the cherries chocolate and watermelon rind. Then mix all together with cheese and cream.

title: Jean'S Original Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat the eggs well and add sugar; mix well and add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients with a hand mixer for 2 minutes. Place batter in bread pans sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0. To bake 3 large loaves bake 1 hour. To bake 6 small loaves bake 45 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Into a rectangular pan (9 x 13-inch) dump crushed pineapple (juice and all). Dump cherry pie filling over pineapple. Sprinkle coconut over this. Sprinkle box of cake mix over the mixture. Sprinkle pecans over this. Chip margarine over all this. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook beef and onion together. Add mushrooms soup and salt. Heat until bubbly. Add sour cream just before serving. This is good served over rice or wide noodles.

title: Cabbage And Beef Soup
instructions: Brown ground chuck with garlic salt and pepper; drain. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Sunrise Punch
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a pitcher stir well and chill. Fill each of 6 tall thin glasses with ice and add orange juice mixture. Slowly pour 1/2 teaspoon grenadine down inside of each glass (do not stir before serving). Garnish with lime slices if desired.

title: Ham And Turkey Loaf
instructions: Chop ham (I use processor); mix with turkey. Add onion and eggs; mix well. Break bread into pieces; pour milk over it. Stir to break up bread then add to meat. Combine well. Spray loaf pan. Sprinkle brown sugar in bottom; sprinkle pineapple juice over sugar. Place 3 pineapple rings over sugar. Carefully spoon meat mixture over pineapple. Place loaf pan in larger pan with 1 inch water in larger pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Place 3 more pineapple rings on top; bake 15 minutes longer. Add more water if needed. To serve loosen edges and invert loaf onto platter. Serve leftovers cold later.

title: Garlic Mashed Red Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes and garlic in a large saucepan; cover with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until the potatoes are very tender. Drain well. Add the butter milk and salt; mash. Stir in Parmesan cheese.

title: Frosted Marshmallow Brownies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa then add shortening. Beat in one egg at a time. Add vanilla flour salt and nuts. Bake in a jelly roll pan 17 x 11-inch at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes. Remove from oven and cover with a 10 1/2 ounce package of miniature marshmallows. Bake for 2 more\tminutes longer. Cool\tand frost.

title: Chocolate Dipped Pretzels
instructions: Dip pretzels in melted chocolate. Place on wax paper. Let set until chocolate hardens. To store place in airtight container.

title: No Cholesterol White Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Whip egg whites into soft peaks. Fold egg whites into batter. Add lemon flavoring. Pour into prepared tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Heat oleo and milk. Add to corn then add sugar salt pepper and eggs. Crumble saltine cracker crumbs and add to corn mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chopped Liver Dip(Pate)
instructions: Saute chicken livers and onions in the salad oil. Add salt to\ttaste.\tPut in blender to mush with 4 hard-boiled eggs. To moisten use a little oil you cooked with.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour Crisco and salt and mix with hands or cut in with a knife. Add cream or water and mix until you have a dough mixture you can make into a ball. Take small balls about what you would need for a single pie crust and wrap in Ziploc bags and store in the freezer until you are ready to use them. You will have about 17 individual pie crusts.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries in food chopper. Add sugar and refrigerate overnight. Add marshmallows and apples. Mix with whipped cream. Garnish with green grapes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: You will also need a 6 or 9-inch clay pot (flowerpot; I used a plastic one)

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Spread on baked cake and put in oven until topping bubbles.

title: Orange Glazed Cranberry Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix together flour sugar baking soda pumpkin pie spice salt and baking powder. In second bowl stir together remaining ingredients until well mixed. Add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture and stir until all ingredients are well moistened. Pour batter into two 9 1/4 x 5 1/2 x 2-inch greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 minutes or until bread tests done with wooden picks. Cool in pans 10 minutes then remove to cooling racks. Completely cool bread then drizzle glaze over top and sides. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Quick Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake crusts until light brown. Break into bite size pieces. Wash and slice strawberries and sweeten to taste. In a large glass bowl alternate crust pieces and strawberries. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Delicious Butterhorns
instructions: Add butter to milk; scald and stir until butter has melted. Combine yeast and warm water stir in sugar. Set aside while combining other ingredients. Sift flour and salt add eggs to milk mixture beat in sifted flour lemon rind and vanilla. Add yeast mixture. When smooth place in greased bowl and cover with greased wax paper and set in refrigerator overnight. When ready to use let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Roll 1/2 of dough in a circle cut into pie shaped wedges and roll up starting in with wide end. Let rise. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool. Frost with powdered sugar nuts and cherries.

title: Oyster Fritters
instructions: Sift together the flour soda and baking powder with salt to taste. Beat the eggs; add to flour. Add pepper to taste. Mix with the buttermilk. Add oysters and juice. Heat oil to 375\u00b0. Drop with long teaspoon; fry until brown.

title: Broccoli Nut Salad
instructions: Break or cut broccoli and cauliflower into bite-sized pieces. Add pecans raisins red onions and bacon.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix all together and chill. Serve with any kind of crackers as an appetizer or snack.

title: Baked Banana Doughnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. In large bowl beat bananas egg whites oil and brown sugar. Add flour oatmeal baking powder soda nuts and spices. Mix well and let stand for 5 minutes. Scoop out a heaping tablespoon of dough onto baking sheet. Using a knife round out doughnut hole in center of dough then smooth outside edges of dough into round doughnut shape. Repeat until all dough is used. (If dough sticks to knife spray with cooking spray or dip in water.) Sprinkle tops with a little sugar and cinnamon mixed together. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 16 to 18.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except butter. Pour into unbaked pie shell; dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Bacon Wrapped Shrimp
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Combine 1/3 cup soup ground beef bread crumbs egg salt and pepper in bowl; mix well. Shape into 6 oval patties. Brown patties in skillet; drain. Add remaining soup catsup Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Blend 1/4 cup water into flour until smooth. Stir into soup mixture. Cook covered over low heat for 20 minutes. This is a low-fat recipe.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and add to 5 cups sliced fresh peaches. Mix.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in ice cream churn.

title: Bacon Relish
instructions: In a pot combine brown sugar and vinegar. Cook stirring constantly until heated. Stir in bacon. Remove from heat; mix well. Serve at once. Yields 1 1/4 cups.

title: Holiday Drink Irish Creme
instructions: Blend well in blender and let set overnight.

title: Frozen Barbecued Meatballs(Makes 80 Meatballs)
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into walnut size ball; place meatballs in a single layer on waxed paper-lined cookie sheets. Freeze solid store in freezer bags until ready to cook.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook over low heat and stir frequently to keep from scorching. Better when made the day before serving. This will serve 30.

title: Chinese Chop Suey Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butterscotch morsels in a double boiler over hot water. Mix in noodles and peanuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and chill. Serve when chilled thoroughly. Makes 3/4 dozen.

title: Cream Cheese Rolls
instructions: Mix and spread on flour tortillas and roll. Chill overnight and cut in slices. Serve with picante sauce.

title: Pineapple Dessert Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into ball. Roll in pecans or coconut. Serve with cinnamon graham crackers. Very refreshing.

title: Granny'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam or boil broccoli (do not over cook). Put rice water broccoli cream of mushroom soup onion and salt into baking pan. Mix ingredients lightly. Dot butter over the top and spread Cheese whiz evenly as possible over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Forgotten Minestrone
instructions: In a slow cooker combine beef water tomatoes bouillon onion parsley salt thyme and pepper. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 9 hours or until meat is tender. Add zucchini cabbage beans and macaroni; cook on high covered 30 to 45 minutes more or until the vegetables are tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: No-Fat Frozen Yogurt Cake Roll
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Beat the next 3 ingredients with mixer until thickened. Sprinkle flour mixture over egg mixture. Using rubber spatula gently fold together. Bake 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes in jelly roll pan lined with wax paper sprayed with cooking spray. Invert cake on powdered sugar sprinkled towel and roll up quickly. Cool completely on wire rack.

title: Pickled Polish Sausage
instructions: Cut sausage into 2 to 3-inch pieces. Simmer 1 hour and drain and rinse. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer 10 minutes. Let cool. Pour this mixture over cooled sausage and some chopped onion in a large glass jar. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine oats and water. Let cool. Combine vegetable oil sugars eggs and vanilla. Mix till smooth. Sift together flour salt soda and cinnamon. Add to batter. Stir till well blended. Add nuts. Pour into greased and floured 8 x 10 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs with milk and cream. Add bread crumbs and let stand 20 minutes. Add onion walnuts and salt. Turn into buttered 1-quart baking dish and bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Fancy Deviled Ham
instructions: Boil eggs. Mix deviled ham salt pepper and salad dressing together. After eggs are boiled take 3 of them and chop up and put in mixture. Take the other 4 and slice up and arrange around the deviled ham mixture. You could also put lettuce under the eggs you have arranged on the side of the mixture.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Cream margarine or butter and mix with flour sugar egg yolks sour cream vanilla and salt. Spread mixture on greased cookie sheet with sides. Cover with the apples mixed in the sugar and cinnamon topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: In a pan boil sweet potatoes until tender. Drain. Mash sweet potatoes set aside.\tIn a mixing bowl combine eggs sugar salt nutmeg milk and margarine mix well; add potatoes and blend until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie crust; bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes reduce heat to 350\u00b0 bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Nachos
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook ground meat and drain. Mix taco seasoning into ground beef following directions on package. Using a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish layer tortilla chips on bottom. Sprinkle 1/2 ground beef on top of chips 1/2 olives scallions and jalapenos on top of ground beef. Sprinkle 1/2 of Cheddar cheese. Repeat for second layer. Bake in oven 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and nachos are heated through. Serve hot. Have salsa and sour cream for dipping.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter in large pan for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Add bouillon Worcestershire sauce Tabasco Kitchen Bouquet pepper and salt if needed. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 4 hours. Pour into crocks; top with toast and Mozzarella cheese. Put under broiler to melt cheese.

title: Pepperoni Casserole
instructions: Cook shells according to directions on box; drain. Add to meat sauce. Add 1/4 pound Mozzarella cheese. Add 1 cup Parmesan cheese. Add 1 stick pepperoni sliced into quarters. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1/4 pound remaining Mozzarella cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Wedding Cake(White)
instructions: Mix and bake as directed on box. Frost with Philly cream cheese frosting.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli seasoning as desired with salt and pepper. Drain. (Personally the mushroom soup has enough seasoning so you dont have to add salt and pepper. However you may want to.)

title: Vidalia Onion Pie
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick margarine. Stir in 1 cup crushed Ritz crackers. Put in pie plate. In frying pan melt 2 tablespoons margarine and put in 2 cups of sliced Vidalia onions. Saute until soft. Pour in pie shell. Mix milk eggs salt and pepper and pour on top of onions. Sprinkle 1 cup grated sharp cheese on top and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: 3-Bean Soup In Crock-Pot
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and put in crock-pot. Add all other ingredients and cook all day! Taste is similar to chili.

title: Blueberry Crunch 2
instructions: Use a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Line pan with crushed pineapple. Add berries. Pour dry cake mix on that. Pour butter next and last nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Orange Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice and milk. Add Cool Whip until thoroughly mixed. Add 2 drops each food coloring. Before removing from mixer add oranges and pecans. Pour into pie crusts. Chill. Can be frozen.

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Stir in nuts and dates. Mix eggs well. Spread in greased 15 x 10 x 19-inch pan. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Modified Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Combine mayonnaise flour eggs and milk. Add cheeses and tuna fish. Pour mixture into pie shell and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Mix together sugar egg milk and margarine. Stir in flour and baking powder. Pour cherries in greased 9 inch square pan. Spread batter over cherries. Bake at 350 degree for 30 minutes. Makes about six servings.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion together for 5 minutes. In saucepan melt butter or margarine and mix in flour salt pepper and milk. Cook and stir until bubbly. Blend in cream cheese until smooth. Place broccoli and onion mix in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Pour cream cheese mixture on top of broccoli. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. (This is my favorite of all broccoli casseroles.)

title: Poached Trout
instructions: In a poaching pan or a large\tshallow pan put enough water and white wine (half and half) to cover the fish. Add salt to taste peppercorns bay leaf onion and thyme or dill. Bring the liquid to a boil for 10 to 15 minutes. Add the fish and enough white wine\tto cover them if necessary. Poach gently. Simmer; do not boil until done. Cooking should take only approximately 5 minutes.

title: Chow Chow Pickle
instructions: Chop all vegetables up. Put spices in cheesecloth and tie well so they dont spill in pickle. Put vegetables vinegar water sugar and spices in kettle. Cook until well done. Remove spice bag. Put in pint jars and process in boiling water bath 5 minutes.

title: Orange-Ginger Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in the water with 1 1/2 teaspoons salt; drain. Combine sugar cornstarch 1/4 teaspoon salt ginger and orange juice in a saucepan. Cook until thickened. Stir in butter. Pour over cooked carrots and heat through. Serves 4.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix together onion and cream cheese and put in 8-inch pie plate spreading evenly. Pour cocktail sauce over this and spread. Top with mini shrimp. Chill well before serving with crackers.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon and 4 tablespoons sugar; set aside. In large bowl mix 2 cups sugar and oil. Add eggs vanilla and juice of orange. Mix together. Add flour and baking powder. Mix thoroughly. Put 1/2 of batter in greased tube pan (not Bundt pan) and add 1/2 of apple mixture. Cover with remaining batter and top with rest of apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients; heat well and serve.

title: Marjorie'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour salt sugar and cocoa. Cream together the shortening buttermilk and eggs. Add flour mixture. Mix soda and baking powder in water. Add this and vanilla to batter. Bake in 3 layers at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Orange Pineapple Sherbet Ice Cream
instructions: Pour drinks into 4-quart ice cream churn. Mix condensed milk and pineapple into the drinks. Churn as directed on your ice cream churn.

title: Cranberry Pie
instructions: Spread Cranberries in a well greased 10-inch Pie Plate. Sprinkle with Sugar and Nuts. In a separate bowl beat eggs gradually beat in 1 c. Sugar. Add Flour Butter and Shortening beating well. Pour mixture over Cranberries and bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Good served warm or cold with Vanilla Ice Cream.

title: Eggplant En Casserole
instructions: Slice eggplant 1/2-inch thick after removing skin. Dice to make 5 cups. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in skillet and saute the eggplant slowly for 5 minutes. Place in casserole with alternate layers of sliced onions diced tomatoes and cheese (saving 1/4 cup for to). Season each layer. Top with crumb which have been mixed with remaining cheese and dot with remaining butter. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 until vegetables are tender and surface nicely browned about 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 5 generous servings.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Cookies
instructions: Mix all together and drop about 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Top each with marshmallow half cut side down. Continue baking until softened. Cool and frost.

title: Party Fruit Salad
instructions: Allow cheese to reach room temperature; then beat until creamy and blend in mayonnaise. Add remaining ingredients except heavy cream. Whip cream until stiff and carefully fold into fruit mixture. Spoon into 13 x 9-inch glass dish. Freeze overnight.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Layer Doritos 1/2 of chicken small amount of green pepper and onion can of cream of chicken soup mixed with 1/3 can milk to make creamier 1/3 of cheese then more Doritos rest of chicken green pepper and onion can of cream of mushroom soup mixed with 1/3 can milk to make creamier 1/2 of remaining cheese then more Doritos Ro-Tel tomatoes poured over top and add the last of the cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese vanilla and sugar on medium speed. Blend in eggs. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour batter in graham cracker crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Salt and pepper to taste. Remove chicken from bone. Combine soups and 2 cups chicken broth. Bring to a boil. Add rice and chicken. Pour into a covered casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Fold ingredients together and spoon into 1 pint cartons. Place in the freezer.

title: Bay Scallop Chowder
instructions: Put vegetables in large pot; cover with stock and boil. Add spices. Simmer covered until vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf. Blend with hand blender until pureed or smooth. Saute mushrooms in butter. Add scallops and wine and cook 1 minute. Stir in cream mixed with egg. Add to pureed vegetables and broth. Heat through and serve with sprinkling of parsley.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring rice to a boil in milk. Add sugar and salt. While heating beat eggs and vanilla together. Put hot milk mixture in a 2-quart bowl add eggs and raisins. Set bowl in shallow pan of water. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 stirring after each 15 minutes the last 15 minutes with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Mix in top of double boiler the sugar oleo water and bourbon. Put over boiling water. Mix pecans and crumbs to taste. Using 2 forks dip cake pieces in bourbon mixture. Allow excess to drip back into pan. Roll quickly in crumb mixture in small bowl. Place on rack to dry. Store in dry tins. (Sometimes one runs out of either of the mixes but remixing takes little time.)

title: Breakfast Mix With English Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Spoon onto English muffin halves. Broil or bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Baked Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes until top is golden and cheese is bubbly. Serve with taco chips or crackers.

title: Frozen Strawberry Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine muffin mix and butter. Pat into an ungreased 8-inch square pan and bake 10 to 12 minutes. Beat softened cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Stir in whipped cream. Spread over cooled crust. Top with strawberries. Freeze until firm. Thaw 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown beef with the onion. Drain and add chilies taco sauce and tomato sauce. Simmer in saucepan heat soups and milk over low heat. Add to meat when heated well. Cut tortillas in strips and layer with cheese and meat mixture in greased casserole dish. End with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add all ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased muffin tins. Bake 15 to 20 minutes on 425\u00b0. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Separate eggs and beat whites until foamy. Gradually add 1 cup sugar and beat until thick. Beat yolks and 1 cup sugar. Add Eagle Brand milk. Cut up pecans and brown in butter stirring constantly. Add brown sugar; mix egg mixture together and add pecans. Stir well or beat mixture thoroughly. Pour into freezer and fill with milk. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on water; stir in margarine. Add 2 cups of flour and salt. Beat well. Stir in remaining flour. Knead for 5 minutes until elastic. Let double. Cover with your favorite sauce and pizza fixings.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Bring vinegar water garlic and hot pepper to boil and put salt in each pint on top. Pack okra in jars.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef along with onions. Add remaining ingredients including the juices. Cook in crockpot about 1 hour or until flavors blend. Garnish with taco chips cheese and sour cream.

title: Easy Caramel Dip For Apples
instructions: Melt caramels in double boiler or microwave. Stir in cream cheese until smooth. Serve with fresh apple slices.

title: Ultimate Carrot Cake
instructions: Add all dry ingredients eggs oil and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Add pecans coconut carrots and pineapple. Grease two 9-inch pan (no flour). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Sauerkraut Pie
instructions: Make up 3 cups mashed potatoes and set aside. Fry the sausage; drain well. Wash the sauerkraut and let it drain. In a large deep dish pie pan pat 1/2 the mashed potatoes about 1/4-inch thick on the bottom and sides. Layer 1/2 of the sauerkraut sausage cheese and make a second layer using the remaining sauerkraut sausage and cheese. Using the rest of the mashed potatoes pat a crust on top and pinch the ends together. Rub the dash of butter on the top and sprinkle pepper lightly on the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until the top turns a golden brown.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put on the stove. Bring to a boil for 5 full minutes. Stir constantly. Add 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda while you are stirring all of the ingredients. Do not add until all has been mixed together.

title: Greek Pasta Salad
instructions: In large pot of boiling salted water cook pasta to desired doneness; drain and cool by rinsing in cold water then drain again. In large bowl mix together all remaining ingredients thoroughly but gently; add pasta and toss. Serve or refrigerate until ready to serve (best served at room temperature).

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown meat green pepper and onion. Add soup water spaghetti sauce mushrooms and spices to taste. Simmer. Cook spaghetti and drain. Add mixture and mix well. Pour half in 9 x 13-inch pan and top with sliced cheese. Top with remaining spaghetti. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pie
instructions: Fry bacon and sausage. Drain well. Combine meats and cheese. Spread in pie shell. Sprinkle with onions and lay on green peppers. Beat eggs and milk. Pour over pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Pralines
instructions: Mix together sugar buttermilk and soda. Cook until it makes a soft ball in cool water or until it reaches 236\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Then add vanilla and pecans. Mix. Drop from a tablespoon on waxed paper. Work fast as possible as it cools fast and the last ones will not be smooth. Cook in large pan as the buttermilk and soda foams up and is likely to boil over.

title: Caramel-Pecan Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 15-inch jelly-roll pan. To prepare cookie base In a large mixing bowl beat butter brown sugar vanilla and salt until light and fluffy. Stir in flour 1/2 cup at a time blending well after each addition. Spread evenly in prepared pan. Cover solidly with rows of pecan halves. Bake 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown. Cool in pan on rack.

title: Sweet Tooth Treats
instructions: In a bowl combine peanut butter corn syrup sugar and coconut until blended. Stir in cereal. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. In small saucepan over medium heat melt chocolate chips and shortening. Dip balls halfway into chocolate; place on wax paper-lined baking sheets to harden. Yield 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Baked Raccoon And Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil raccoon until tender about 2 hours. Remove from liquid and drain. Put in a rectangular baking dish and season well with salt and pepper.

title: Salisbury Steak Deluxe
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and blend well. Set aside. Combine beef with egg bread crumbs onion salt pepper and 1/4 cup of the soup mixture. Shape into 6 patties. Brown patties in skillet. Drain drippings from pan. Combine remaining soup mixture and 1/2 cup water and pour over patties. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Basic Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni drain and rinse with cold water. For dressing mix salad dressing sour cream milk relish and salt. Toss dressing with macaroni mixture. Cover and chill for 4 to 24 hours. Stir in additional milk if necessary.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Dissolve salt and sugar in the milk. Add the oil and cool to lukewarm. Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of lukewarm water. Mix the yeast and water mixture with the milk mixture. Add lightly beaten eggs. Add half of flour and beat. Add the remaining half of the flour and knead. Let rise until its doubled. Then shape into rolls and let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Betty'S Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes; boil until done (approximately 25 minutes). Boil eggs with potatoes. Remove eggs to cool. Drain potatoes. Add ingredients one at a time as listed and mix with fork. (Dont mash potatoes.) Peel and chop eggs; stir in. Best if served hot but it is good refrigerated too.

title: Holiday Orange Salad
instructions: Drain oranges reserving syrup; add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups liquid. Place liquid in saucepan; bring to boil. Remove from heat; stir in gelatin. Add sherbet stirring until dissolved. Chill until thick. Stir in oranges. Pour into a 2 quart ring mold; chill until firm. Wrap in moisture proof paper; freeze. Unwrap and thaw in refrigerator.

title: Foil Sandwiches
instructions: Thoroughly mix together the ham bacon chili sauce and relish. Mixing by hand is easiest. Butter the insides top and bottom of the buns. Place a slice of cheese in each bun. Fill buns with ham mixture. Wrap each sandwich in foil. Heat sandwiches in a 250\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. (Sandwiches can be made ahead and refrigerated. Increase heating time if refrigerated.)

title: Apricot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts. When mixture is blended well. Fold in nuts. Pour into baking pan 13 x 9-inch and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Check after 45 minutes.

title: Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Saute vegetables for 5 minutes. Drain and cool. Add mayonnaise. Butter a casserole dish. Layer buttered croutons and mushroom mixture. Cover with soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Top with grated cheese the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Garlicy Bread Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat add the olive oil. When the oil is hot add the onions garlic crushed bay leaf and crushed red pepper. Season with salt. Saute until slightly caramelized about 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in the stock. Bring the liquid up to a boil then reduce to a simmer and simmer for 40 minutes. Turn the heat up and whisk in the bread and cream. Continue whisking until the bread has dissolved into the soup about 10 minutes. With a handheld blender puree the soup until smooth. Whisk in the Parmigiana-Reggiano cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Ladle into individual soup bowls and serve. Garnish with parsley. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Linguine And White Clam Sauce
instructions: Brown onion and garlic. Add bottled clam juice and juice from the canned clams. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer. Add oregano parsley peppers marjoram lemon juice and grated cheese. Simmer for 20 minutes. Throw clams in and simmer 15 minutes. Boil and cook linguine; top with sauce.

title: Jay'S Stuff
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables a few minutes in grease or oil. Add seasonings. Cook until done.

title: Cranberry-Apple Casserole
instructions: Combine apples cranberries and 2 tablespoons flour tossing to coat fruit. Add 1 cup sugar mixing well. Place in 2-quart casserole. Combine oatmeal chopped pecans 1/2 cup flour and brown sugar; add butter and stir well. Spoon over fruit mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Garnish with pecan halves and cranberries. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Combine all ingredients except breadcrumbs. Stir well; cover and chill 8 hours. Ladle into serving bowl; sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Makes about 2 quarts.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs well; add sugar and mix thoroughly. Add both cans of condensed milk\tand continue mixing.\tAdd milk and vanilla extract. When all ingredients are thoroughly mixed pour into freezer using either electric or hand mixer.

title: Healthy Muffins
instructions: Pour into greased muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Stuffed Hot Peppers(Canning Recipe)
instructions: Core peppers (dont break) wearing rubber gloves. Wash and boil 2 minutes. Cool in ice water. Stuff with sauerkraut. Pack in sterilized jars. Add garlic and alum. Cover with solution of water vinegar and salt. Boil in hot bath for 3 to 5 minutes. Seal.

title: Mexican Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. Do not use beaters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Food For The Gods
instructions: Preheat stove to 350\u00b0. Grease and line a 13 x 9 x 2 rectangular pan. Sift flour baking powder baking soda and salt together. Take 1/2 cup of this mixture and dredge dates. Set aside. Cream butter until soft and fluffy. Add granulated sugar and brown sugar and blend well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Fold in the flour mixture and dates into the creamed mixture. Add walnuts. Stir to completely blend batter. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Lower heat to 300\u00b0 and continue baking for 30 to 40 minutes more. Cool slightly then cut into bars. Individually wrap in cellophane if desired.

title: What'S Today'S Salad
instructions: Put all fruit on lettuce leaves. Top with chives and favorite dressing.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Cook in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Leaving cake in pan pour Eagle Brand milk cream of coconut (mix cream of coconut well) and crushed pineapple (including juice) over cake. Let cake cool then top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with coconut; decorate with cherries. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Crusty, Crunchy Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Remove bones and skin from salmon and flake with fork. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Sift dry ingredients together into mixing bowl. Add milk and egg and beat until smooth. Fold salmon into this batter and drop by tablespoons into hot oil and fry until golden brown about 3 or 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve with ketchup or your favorite sauce.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix oatmeal and coconut in bowl. Mix sugar milk oleo and flavoring in saucepan. Bring to boil and let boil slowly for one minute. Remove from heat and pour over dry mixture. Stir well. Drop by spoon on waxed paper and cool.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs sugar pumpkin and lemon juice on high speed for 5 minutes. Then add flour and spices. Beat slightly. Spread into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan lined with wax paper. Top with 1 cup finely chopped nuts (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn onto towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Starting at end roll towel and cake together. Leave until cool.

title: Beans And Biscuits
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain. Stir in brown sugar pork and beans salt and barbecue sauce. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles. Place cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Meat Glop
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Stir well. Serve with Fritos or carrot sticks.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Arrange apples in buttered 9-inch pie pan. Combine brown sugar flour oats and cinnamon. Cut in butter until crumbly. Press mixture over apples. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until top is brown. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Upside-Down Chocolate Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions. Pour in an oblong baking pan. In a separate bowl mix powdered sugar cream cheese and butter. Pour this mixture around in cake mix. Bake according to directions on cake mix. Cake will be very moist. Top with icing when cooled.

title: Red Apple Slaw
instructions: Combine apples cabbage and raisins. Combine mayonnaise and sour cream; add to cabbage mixture. Toss until well blended. Makes 6 servings.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix corn soup and sour cream together. Put in baking dish. Crumble up crackers; add butter to crackers. Sprinkle over corn mix. Put sliced almonds on top. Bake in oven at 250\u00b0 until bubbles; remove.

title: Pecan Balls Or Coconut Balls
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add milk and mix. Add pecans and mix until very stiff. Roll out into balls about 1 inch or less in diameter. Place in waxed paper and cover. Let sit for 2 hours or overnight in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Cheese Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken in water with chicken broth cubes for about 20 to 30 minutes. Remove chicken and brown in skillet over medium heat in hot margarine. Cook 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup broth or milk and pepper; heat to boiling. Add broccoli; reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 10 minutes or until broccoli is tender and chicken is done stirring occasionally.

title: 3 Cheese Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add onion. Cook until tender. Stir in tomatoes paste water and seasonings. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Sift flour soda and salt. Cream the shortening. Blend in sugar and eggs one at a time. Beat well until fluffy. Add flour mixture alternating with bananas and liquid beating after each addition. Turn into greased loaf pan and bake 60 to 70 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan and cool several hours or overnight before slicing.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces; set aside. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Add water to juice to make 1 1/2 cups. Combine juice with brown sugar cornstarch cider vinegar soy sauce ginger and bouillon cube. Stir until smooth; set aside.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Quarter biscuits and roll in a mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Arrange in a tube pan. Melt over low heat the butter 3/4 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons cinnamon. Pour over biscuit quarters and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. (Bread will spring back when lightly touched.)

title: Mary'S Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Mix flour baking powder soda and salt. Set aside. Beat butter until fluffy. Gradually add peel and sugar. Add egg yolks to butter mixture. Mix thoroughly. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture alternately with sour cream. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into batter. Pour batter into an 8-inch greased and floured round cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Mix strawberries liqueur and sugar. Set aside. When cake is done let cool 15 minutes. Turn onto a platter or cake plate. Cut into two layers. Scoop ice cream onto first layer. Top with strawberry mixture and add second layer. Garnish with whipped cream and strawberries. Sprinkle with orange peel.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder sugar and salt. Blend milk and egg; add to dry ingredients. Stir in corn. Drop by tablespoon into hot oil; fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve with maple syrup.

title: Mashed Potatoes Supreme
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into small pieces. Cook until tender. Drain. Mash with butter salt pepper and onion salt to taste. Cream cheese can be softened by leaving out for 1 hour so it reaches room temperature or in the microwave on defrost. Be very careful not to get it hot! Add cream cheese and sour cream to mashed potato mixture. Stir thoroughly. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place in large casserole dish cover. Place in oven for one half hour or until hot. (May also heat in microwave on half power until hot.) Stir. Top with pat of butter or margarine. Sprinkle with pepper and paprika. Serve.

title: Smoked Salmon Cheese Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Mix all ingredients. Roll in chopped nuts grated cheese or crushed crackers. Chill.

title: Cheesy Brat Stew
instructions: Brown bratwurst lightly. Add remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until done. This is about 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple in casserole dish. Mix flour and sugar and sprinkle over pineapple. Top with grated cheese; add cracker crumbs and melted butter. Pour over casserole. Cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot.

title: Butterfinger Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in a flat pan. Punch holes in top with end of wooden spoon. Mix Eagle Brand milk and caramel; pour over cake. Cool. Spread cake with Cool Whip. Top with crushed Butterfinger bar. Store in refrigerator.

title: Easy Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in pie crust at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until pie doesnt shake in middle.

title: Venison Chili
instructions: Cook meat and suet together until pink is gone. Add all other ingredients; cook 2 or more hours. Freeze in family size containers and use as needed.

title: Tea Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Dissolve yeast in one of the cups of water; add the other cup of water. Put in refrigerator 2 hours before serving. Knead roll and cut out biscuits. Let rise and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Smoky Beef Dip
instructions: Beat cottage cheese until fairly smooth. Add beef onion parsley and pepper. Blend well. Serve with crisp vegetables such as carrot green pepper and celery sticks.

title: Italian Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook meat in frying pan until it loses red color; drain. Add tomatoes tomato paste onion and seasonings. Simmer slowly for 30 minutes; stir as needed. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cook macaroni in boiling water following package directions. Drain. Combine macaroni and cottage cheese. Pour a little meat mixture in bottom of 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with half of macaroni mixture; half the Cheddar cheese and half the meat mixture. Repeat layers. Sprinkle Parmesan on top and bake for 40 minutes or until well heated. Remove from oven and serve. Yields 6 servings.

title: Wyoming Whopper Cookies
instructions: If using another brand of peanut butter add several tablespoons of water to mixture. In a large saucepan melt butter over low heat. Blend in sugars eggs and peanut butter. Mix until smooth. Add oats baking soda raisins and chocolate chips (dough will be sticky). Drop on greased baking sheet using large spoon. Flatten slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Slice the venison into 3/8-inch thick strips to ensure total saturation of the meat when it is marinating. Stir the remaining ingredients well. Place meat in marinade. Be sure the meat is covered with the liquid. Turn if necessary. Marinate for 24 hours. Lay strips on racks of oven. Cook for 6 to 8 hours at 150\u00b0 or use microwave for 20 minutes.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise flour eggs and milk. Add crabmeat Swiss cheese onion pepper mushrooms and bacon. Put in a pastry shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: In a pot make sauce with the onion garlic basil oregano Italian seasoning tomatoes water soup and cheese. Cook spaghetti slightly; drain. Add to sauce. Serve with tossed salad and hot garlic bread. Enjoy.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Spray frying pan with Pam. Saute beef and drain. Add rest of ingredients except cheese. Simmer 5 minutes. Add cheese and stir until melted. If too thick add water. Keep hot. Serve with chips. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Easy Baked Fish
instructions: Cut fish into serving portions. Place in a single layer in well greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine sour cream green onion and Parmesan cheese. Spread mixture over fish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. Serves 6.

title: Finger Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread on both sides of rolls. Add layer of ham and Swiss cheese. Wrap in foil and heat in a 350\u00b0 oven about 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix the cream cheese powdered sugar peanut butter and coffee creamer together. Fold mix into Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill for at least 2 to 3 hours.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding mix water and Crisco oil. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add vanilla and nuts; pour into 3 x 8 or 9-inch greased and floured cake pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Put crock-pot full of thinly sliced apples. Cook on high for 2 hours with lid on. Drain off liquid. Mash or puree apples. Add sugar vinegar cinnamon allspice and cloves. Stir and cook on low with lid off for at least 2 more hours. Put at once in jars and seal.

title: Pie Crust Mix
instructions: Crumble and keep in plastic bag in refrigerator. One cup of this makes a pie crust.

title: Microwave Oven Fudge
instructions: Put first 2 ingredients in microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir in vanilla (and nuts if desired) and pour into greased pan.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Pour a small amount of oil into 10-inch iron skillet; heat in oven. Add ingredients to cornmeal in order that they are listed. Stir until well mixed. Pour in iron skillet and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and egg. Mix. Add sour cream and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Mix. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Italian Skillet Supper
instructions: Brown ground meat onion and pepper in a 10-inch skillet; drain. Combine oats and egg in bowl and mix until oats are coated. Add oats to meat mixture; cook over medium heat about 3 minutes or until oats are dry separated and lightly browned stirring constantly. Add combined tomato sauce water seasoned salt pepper garlic salt and oregano; continue cooking for 5 minutes or until liquid evaporates stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in crust; chill.

title: Holiday Relish
instructions: Quarter oranges and seed. Leave peeling on oranges. Chop or grind cranberries oranges and pecans. Add sugar and blend. Refrigerate in covered bowl for at least 4 hours before serving. Can be frozen. Serves 6 to 8. Great for the holidays.

title: Yeast Rolls(Makes About 15 To 18 Rolls)
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Add oil egg and water. Mix well. Place in covered bowl and place in refrigerator. Remove as much as needed. Knead on floured board. Roll 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Let rise 1 or 2 hours. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Keeps in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Sara'S Watergate Strawberry Salad
instructions: Cream together sugar and cream cheese; add pineapple and juice. Blend strawberries and bananas together until smooth then add to cream cheese mixture along with nuts and Cool Whip. Freeze in baking cups and keep in freezer until serving.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking soda cinnamon and salt; set aside. Beat eggs. Add vegetable oil and walnuts. Add beaten eggs oil and nuts to thawed strawberries with juice. Blend this strawberry mixture into the dry ingredients without beating. Blend only with a rubber spatula. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans (9 1/4 x 5 1/4 x 2 3/4-inch). Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool on rack in pan. Cool 15 minutes. Remove. Cut when completely cooled.

title: Pecan Kisses
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. With an electric mixer beat egg whites until stiff not dry. Gradually beat in sugar vinegar and vanilla; fold in pecans. Drop teaspoonful of dough 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until firm. Cookies should remain light. Remove from sheet at once. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chicken Hawaiian
instructions: Dip chicken parts in egg then matzo meal and brown. Place on foil-lined baking sheet. Mix preserves horseradish sugar and salt and heat until bubbly. Pour sauce over chicken and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour. Re-baste. Put one pineapple chunk on each breast (optional) and bake for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Doo Dads
instructions: Cream the margarine and brown sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Combine flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture. Add dates and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage Sandwiches
instructions: On 4 slices of pumpernickel bread spread mustard-mayonnaise sauce. Top with lettuce Swiss cheese corned beef red cabbage and remaining bread slices. Makes 4 main dish servings.

title: Buffet Baked Beans And Franks
instructions: Mix beans onion garlic brown sugar and mustard until blended. Split frankfurters lengthwise and fill with pineapple chunks. Pour beans into a shallow baking dish. Press frankfurters on top of beans. Drizzle with bacon drippings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip(Preparation Time:  10 Minutes; Cooking Time:  25 Minutes)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Spoon into 9-inch pie plate or shallow ovenproof dish. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Sprinkle with sliced green onions and chopped tomatoes if desired. Serve with tortilla chips crackers or assorted cocktail bread slices. Makes 2 cups.

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mix together (with your hands) the first 5 ingredients until you can form it into a big ball. Spray Pam or grease a large cooking pan. Turn meat onto wax paper or into the pan. Flatten out like a big square burger. Spread the cheese along the top of the flattened meat. Spread the rice across the meat and cheese. Take both ends of the flattened meat and turn them towards the center. Shape it the best you can to cover all rice and cheese with meat. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. If not done continue cooking until done checking every 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix pineapple flour sugar and egg and pour into casserole. Top with the cubed bread. Moisten bread slightly with juices from pineapple mixture without stirring. Spoon slid down along side works well.

title: Green Salad
instructions: Make as you would milk gravy just add a small can of diced tomatoes and mix well. For more tomato taste mash chunks of tomato; mix well. This is great on homemade biscuits and fried potatoes.

title: Democrat Jackass Stew
instructions: Cut Jackass in 1-inch cubes (this takes about 1 week unless you are extra slow). Season and place in a large wash tub casserole with vegetables. Bake for 6 days at 425\u00b0. This serves 1200 people. For larger crowds you can add 2 rabbits however some people object to hare in their stew.

title: Fluffy Meringue
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: One Egg Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter until light and fluffy. Gradually add the sugar vanilla and egg to the butter. Stir in half the flour mixture and 1/4 cup milk. Add the rest of the flour mixture and milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Makes one 8 x 8-inch layer or 12 cupcakes.

title: Mexican Layer Dip
instructions: Use a large casserole dish.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Simmer chicken and pepper in 2 quarts of water covered for 1 hour or until tender. Remove chicken.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole(Or 10 To 15 Casserole)
instructions: Spray casserole dish with oil spray or oil dish. Cover bottom of dish thickly with Ritz cracker crumbs. Melt butter in skillet. Saute onion rings then remove to casserole dish with drippings. Salt and pepper lightly. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until hot.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Mix other ingredients except potato chips. Pour 1/2 mixture in casserole dish and crumble 1/2 potato chips on it. Add other 1/2 mixture and cover with the rest of the potato chips. Bake in hot oven about 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into casserole dish. Melt butter and crush crackers for topping. Place on top of casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Peel pit and slice peaches into already baked pie crust. Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil. Boil until clear approximately 1 minute. Stir entire time. Remove from heat. Add 3 tablespoons peach jello. Pour over fruit and chill well before serving.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Unwrap tamales and dispose of wrappers. Cut tamales into 1/4 to 1/2-inch pieces and place a layer on the bottom of a casserole dish. Cover with a layer of Fritos. Pour over a layer of chili. Continue until all is used up ending with a layer of chili. Cover with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Dried Apples And Cinnamon Cut-Outs Part 1(Non Edible)
instructions: Mix warm applesauce and cinnamon together to form a ball. Sprinkle a board with additional cinnamon. Roll mixture out to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter. Use a pencil to punch a hole in the top of each shape if it is to be used as an ornament. Place cut-outs into a 150\u00b0 oven for 6 hours.

title: Cevapici
instructions: Season ground lamb with salt and pepper to taste. Shape meat into cylinders 1 1/2 to 2-inches long. Refrigerate overnight. Cook meat on charcoal or wood grill turning until done. Toast pita rounds until slightly brown but still flexible. Fill each half with meat. Top with chopped onion. Makes 12 pita pockets.

title: Tuna Rice
instructions: Saute onion and celery in oleo. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; boil 10 minutes on low flame. Serve hot.

title: Sour Cream Apple Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off. In large bowl combine first 3 ingredients. Blend at low speed until crumbly. Stir in nuts. Place 2 3/4 cups of crumb mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. To the remaining mixture add cinnamon salt soda sour cream vanilla and egg. Blend well. Stir in apples. Spoon evenly over crumb layer in pan. Bake 25 to 35 minutes until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cut in squares. Serve with whipped cream if desired. Yield 12 to 15 squares.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream butter oil and sugar in large mixing bowl. Add eggs vanilla and buttermilk. Beat. Mix together flour baking powder cinnamon cloves cocoa and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture. Beat well. Stir in zucchini. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle top with chocolate chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: In a small bowl blend first 5 ingredients. Add and blend well the remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked 9-inch shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 for 25 more minutes.

title: Garlic Herb Butter
instructions: Soften oleo and stir in remaining ingredients. Use to make garlic bread; put on chicken. Cook 1 cup spiral pasta according to package directions and drain well. Put into serving bowl or dish. Add 2 tablespoons or more to taste and toss well to coat pasta.

title: Egg Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together.\tAdd egg yolks to buttermilk and stir into dry ingredients. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into greased black iron skillet. Bake at 400 degrees 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Mama'S Dressing
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken until tender; debone and cube. Cook onion celery and green pepper in 1 cup chicken stock. Cook spaghetti in remaining broth; drain. Mix all ingredients together and turn into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Chocolate Pecan Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In large bowl combine flour sugar and cocoa; cut in margarine until crumbly (mixture will be dry). Press firmly on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes. Meanwhile in medium bowl beat sweetened condensed milk egg and vanilla; mix well. Stir in nuts. Spread evenly over crust. Bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Store covered in refrigerator. Freeze well too.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Bake in unbaked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Walnut Frosties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Form dough into 1 inch balls. Make depression in the center. Fill with topping.

title: Beef With Broccoli
instructions: Put beef slices and add soy sauce cornstarch salt pepper wine broth ginger sugar onions into a big bowl until smooth. Set aside for 20 minutes at least (they can be marinated up to 24 hours. Sealed and covered in refrigerator).

title: Chewy Fudge-Cake Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate and oil in a saucepan. Stir in sugar eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour baking powder and salt and add to chocolate mixture. Chill 1 hour. Then with damp hands form into balls; roll in powdered sugar. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Corn Meal Cookies
instructions: Add the shortening sugar and egg together; stir well. Add the flour corn meal baking powder and salt; stir well. Stir in the vanilla. Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 or 10 minutes.

title: Fudge Clusters
instructions: Stir sugar cocoa and milk together until dissolved. Bring to boil and boil one minute. Remove from heat and add butter peanut butter and vanilla. Beat until butters have melted. Add oatmeal. Drop on waxed paper. Enjoy!

title: Sugar And Spice Pecans
instructions: Beat egg whites and water until frothy (not stiff). Stir in sugar salt and cinnamon. Mix well. Add pecans and stir until all are coated and spread on large baking sheet and bake and stir every 15 minutes. When cool store in airtight container. So good.

title: German Chocolate Upside Down Cake
instructions: In a large bowl combine cake mix water oil and eggs. Beat at low speed until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at high speed. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle coconut and pecans evenly over bottom of pan. Spoon batter over coconut and pecans.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: In a medium saucepan cover the raisins with water and cook them over medium-high heat until they are very plump and tender. Drain the raisins; return them to the saucepan. To the raisins add the sour cream and boil for 10 minutes. To the sour cream and raisins add the sugar flour egg yolks vanilla and salt. Cook until thick then add the pecans and remove from heat. Pour the mixture into a prebaked pie shell; top with meringue made from left over whites and 4 tablespoons of sugar. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until the meringue is brown.

title: Beef Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in skillet. Add onion and garlic and brown. Add remaining ingredients and pour in a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 4 to 5 servings.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Beat pudding and milk until thick. Add Cool Whip. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers. Pour half of pudding mixture over crackers. Repeat with another layer of crackers the remaining pudding and another layer of crackers. Add icing to last layer of crackers. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken And Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Drain chicken; reserve broth. Mix chicken spinach and 1/4 cup cheese. Top each muffin with onion and 1/4 of the chicken mixture. Mix broth and milk. Combine with remaining cheese egg and mustard. Spoon over chicken. Bake 5 minutes. Serve at once. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Pink And Perky Punch
instructions: Add ingredients in order written and you have the perfect pink and perky punch!

title: Noodle Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add onion and hamburger; brown lightly. Cook noodles; drain. Add browned meat to noodles. Stir in tomato soup water grated cheese and seasoning. Pour into greased casserole at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sugarless Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Press with a fork before baking. You may wish to add food coloring for special holidays.

title: Heart Smart Cocoa Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 200\u00b0. Line 2 large cookie sheets with foil. In small bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg whites cream of tartar and salt until soft peaks form. At high speed gradually beat in sugar 2 tablespoons at one time. At low speed beat in cocoa and extract. Fold in almonds. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes until set. Cool on sheets. Remove to wire rack. Makes about 25 cookies.

title: Shrimp, Asparagus And Basil Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Prepare spaghetti as directed on package and drain. Cover lightly with foil in an ovenproof bowl and keep warm in oven. While spaghetti is cooking make the sauce.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix sugar and water; bring to a boil. Let cool. Add Kool-Aid and pineapple juice. You may refrigerate this overnight if necessary. Add 7-Up when ready to serve. Makes approximately 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Meat And Potato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a 9-inch pan stir together vegetable oil and potatoes. Press evenly into pie crust shape. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven. Layer on cheese meat and onion. In a bowl beat together milk eggs salt and pepper. Pour egg mixture over other ingredients. Sprinkle with parsley flakes. Return to oven and bake 30 minutes or until lightly brown. Pie is done when knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean. Allow to cool 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix as directed but add lemon curd and use 1/4 cup less water. Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Cool.

title: Green Tomato-Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. To peel tomatoes easily place in boiling water 2 to 3 minutes until skins slip off easily. Combine tomatoes apple brown and granulated sugars flour cinnamon and salt. Place in 9-inch pie plate lined with 1 pastry crust. Dot with butter. Adjust top crust and flute edges. Cut vents for steam. Bake in preheated oven 50 to 60 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Saute onion in butter until slightly brown. Put that with rest of the ingredients in a casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until rice is done.

title: Party Rye-Finger Food
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on cocktail rye or party rye bread (2 loaves). Broil and serve.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Prepare pastry; roll 2/3 dough into 14-inch square roll remaining dough into 14 x 7-inch rectangle. Cut into 2 squares. Place an apple on each square. Mix raisins and nuts; fill center of each apple. Moisten corners of square; bring 2 opposite corners of pastry up over apple and press together. Fold in sides of remaining corners. Bring corners up over apple and press together. Place dumplings in ungreased baking dish. Heat brown sugar and water to boiling. Pour around dumplings. Bake for about 40 minutes at 425\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Cucumber Relish
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and let set for 3 hours; drain well. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cucumber mixture. Bring to a boil. Put in jars and seal.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salt and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes or until tender then salt and pepper to taste. Excellent frozen. Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all together with wire whisk and let set.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: Cut chicken breast into four strips per breast. Spread rice in the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place chicken on rice. Mix soup and water; pour over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top. Bake for one hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with a garden salad.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together form into a ball and refrigerate. Can be made a day ahead. Serve with crackers.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together the shortening brown sugar and eggs. Add soda salt flour and oatmeal. Drop by tablespoons into greased cookie sheet. (Makes large cookies.) Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Do not overbake. Remove as soon as set. Only bake 1 sheet at a time in the center of the oven.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: In large bowl combine potatoes sour cream cream cheese chives and garlic powder. Turn into a greased 2-quart casserole. Combine bread crumbs with butter; sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Top with cheese and serve immediately. Dish can be assembled a day ahead and baked just before serving. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars shortening egg peanut butter and flour together. Place far apart because they will spread; mash down with fork crisscrossing. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Cornflake Crunchies
instructions: In a small saucepan combine sugar Karo and vanilla. Bring to a boil and boil about 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Stir well then pour in cornflakes. Mix well then drop tablespoonfuls onto greased wax paper or foil.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook and stir celery mushrooms and onion in butter until onion is tender. Stir in parsley salt and 1/2 cup bread crumbs. Trim fat from pork chops. Make a slit in each to form a pocket. Fill pocket with celery mixture. Dip each pork chop into mixture of eggs and milk. Roll in mixture of 3/4 cup bread crumbs 1/2 teaspoon salt and the paprika. Place in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake uncovered 30 minutes; turn pork chops over. Bake about 15 minutes or until pork chops are tender.

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
instructions: Bring to boil the salt and water; stir in grits and follow the package directions. Turn off heat. Add butter milk garlic powder and 1 1/2 cups of the shredded Cheddar cheese mixing well. Let cool so that eggs will not cook when added. Add eggs and pour into a buttered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. During last few minutes of baking sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese on top of the casserole.

title: Andre'S Favorite Fried Turkey Wings
instructions: Season and boil turkey wings until well done; let cool. Heat shortening while battering turkey wings in flour. When the shortening is hot place turkey wings in the hot pan of shortening and fry each turkey wing for about 2 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in nuts and powdered sugar. Cake can be frosted hot out of the oven.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dip chicken pieces in melted butter. Combine bread crumbs parsley garlic and cheese. Roll chicken in this mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Good served with French green beans Caesar salad and Vienna bread.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil and chicken. Stir in dressing. Mix to coat chicken. brown chicken. Add 16 ounces vegetable oil and 2 tablespoons water. Stir 2 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fajita Pizza
instructions: Brush both sides (top and bottom) of the pizza crust with olive oil. Set aside. Saute green pepper and onion in olive oil until tender. Set aside. Cut chicken tenders into small pieces and saute in olive oil; sprinkle with fajita seasoning while cooking. Spread salsa evenly onto pizza crust. Top with peppers and onions. Next spread chicken pieces on top and sprinkle with more fajita seasoning. Cover with Monterey Jack cheese. Place pizza directly on oven racks in a preheated 450\u00b0 oven and bake until golden brown. Watch carefully.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine all of your ingredients except the biscuits and the melted butter in a small dish. Take your biscuits and dip them into the melted butter and then into your other ingredients. Place them in together in a Bundt pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fresh Vegetables With Horseradish-Mustard Dip
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. (Can be prepared 2 days ahead.) Place dip in center of platter. Surround with assorted vegetables (such as carrots celery cucumber bell pepper strips snow peas endive spears and cherry tomatoes).

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Place the flour sugar and salt in the pie pan and mix with your fingers until blended. In a measuring cup combine oil and milk and beat with a fork until creamy; pour all at once over the flour mixture. Mix with fork until flour mixture is completely moistened. Pat the dough with your fingers first up the sides of the pan then across bottom. Flute the edges. Shell is ready to be filled. If you are preparing a shell to fill later preheat the oven to 425\u00b0. Prick the surface of the pastry with a fork and bake 15 minutes. Check often pricking if needed.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Peel and remove seeds from cucumbers. Grate and blot on paper towels along with grated onion. Mix all ingredients together.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cook the water or water and milk bouillon cubes raw potatoes onions and celery for 20 minutes then add the frozen broccoli and cauliflower. Cook for 10 minutes then add the soup and cheese.

title: Fantastic Dessert
instructions: Melt butter and mix sugar flour and nuts. Press into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Chop chicken into bite-size pieces. Mix together the rest of the ingredients except for the crackers and cheese. Crumble the crackers and spread 1/2 cup of the crumbs over the bottom of a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Put mixture into dish and sprinkle cracker crumbs and cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Spoon over hot biscuits or toast to serve.

title: Squash Dish
instructions: Place margarine and carrots in large skillet. Cook until half done. Add rest of ingredients except tomatoes. Cook until tender. Do not overcook. Squeeze juice out of tomatoes. Add tomatoes and hot sauce to mixture and cook for 1 additional minute.

title: Taco Chip Dip
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Melt cheese. Mix all ingredients in crock-pot; let simmer on low for 30 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Sixty Minute Rolls
instructions: Scald milk; let cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast and sugar in the cooled milk. Add 2 cups of flour; beat for 5 minutes. Add melted shortening and beat for 1 minute. Add the cups of flour and salt. Turn onto board with 1 cup flour; knead well. Cover; let rise for 30 minutes. Roll 1/2-inch thick and bake (no need to knead the second time; just punch down and make into rolls).

title: Fried Ramps
instructions: Pull off outer skin of ramps to clean them. Chop ramps fine and fry in an iron skillet in bacon grease adding salt to taste. When done break eggs into ramps and scramble them. Cook until done. For a milder taste substitute chopped green onions for ramps in this recipe.

title: Cracker Brittle
