instructions: Line a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with foil. Arrange crackers on pan. In small saucepan combine butter and sugar. Bring to boil over medium heat. Boil 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Pour and spread over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden. Break into pieces.

title: Pixie Pie
instructions: Melt butter in a 10-inch baking dish. Coat berries with 1 cup of sugar. Mix dry ingredients. Stir in milk gradually; beat well. Pour batter into melted butter and mix lightly. Pour berries in pan spreading them evenly over batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Berries will sink into batter while baking. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Turtles
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave about 90 seconds; stir well. Continue to melt in microwave in 15 second intervals until completely melted stirring well. After melted place on top of boiler of heated water. Melt caramel in microwave about 1 minute only enough so that you may stir it. Do not overheat! Mix caramel and pecans together to form little patties or balls whichever you prefer. Using a fork dip the caramel and pecans into the chocolate and drop on aluminum foil. Cool completely. Makes about 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Olive Cheese Nuggets
instructions: Blend cheese and butter. Sift flour salt and paprika into that mixture. Shape around olives using about a teaspoon of dough for each. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and hamburger until crumbled. Drain excess. In crock-pot melt cheese. Add meat soup tomatoes green chilies and onions; mix well. Makes a large amount and can be frozen.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks 1/2 of the sugar and melted margarine. In another bowl mix cocoa and flour with just enough hot water to dissolve sugar. Add chocolate mixture to egg mixture and stir well. Add vanilla and salt stirring well. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm. Top with whipped cream and almond slivers.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Combine milk flour and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Add to the melted margarine. Add peaches and do not stir. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream if desired. (Canned or frozen peaches may be substituted for fresh.)

title: Mandarin Shrimp Salad
instructions: Boil shrimp. When cool enough to handle peel and remove tails. Mix all ingredients. Chill at least 30 minutes.

title: Hard Candy
instructions: Boil sugar corn syrup and water until it reaches a hard-crack stage. Add flavoring and food coloring. Spray a cookie sheet or mini ice cube tray with Pam. Pour hot liquid into this. Cool and crack. Shake pieces in powdered sugar. Use caution; very hot.

title: Hay Stacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch in double boiler. Mix in marshmallows and chow mein noodles. Drop on wax paper and let cool.

title: Boiled Cake(Grandpa'S Favorite)
instructions: Mix sugar raisins coffee shortening cinnamon baking soda cloves and nutmeg in 2-quart saucepan. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Cool. Mix flour baking powder and salt into cooled mixture in saucepan. Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Spread mixture into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely. Serve each slice topped with applesauce and whipped cream.

title: Sunshine Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate until firm.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix together pineapple sour cream and Cool Whip. Add instant pudding. Mix well and pour into crust. Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Pie In Orange Shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut the top fourth off each orange; then hollow oranges with a grapefruit spoon or a melon baller. Blend the scooped orange together with the remaining ingredients; then fill each orange shell with the mixture. Bake for 20 minutes or until juice begins to run from the oranges. Makes 6 servings.

title: Lite Mac-N-Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a large bowl mix all ingredients (except 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese). Add macaroni. Top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Belgium:  Beef And Beer
instructions: Combine the flour salt and pepper. Dredge the meat in the seasoned flour. Heat the oil in skillet; add onions and garlic until tender but not brown. Remove from skillet and reserve. Put meat in the skillet and brown on all sides adding a little more oil if necessary. Put meat onions beer bay leaf and thyme in a casserole; cover and put in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for three hours or more until meat is tender. Remove from oven; remove bay leaf and sprinkle with parsley. Serve with hot boiled potatoes.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch sheet pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Cook peeled apples to a sauce using as little water as possible. Fill crock-pot 3/4 full adding ingredients as listed. Cook 8 to 10 hours on high. Pour in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Cabbage Pickles
instructions: Chop cabbage and onions fine. Add vinegar and boil for 10 minutes. Add sugar and salt. Mix seasonings with flour adding enough water to make a paste. Stir paste into boiling pickles and boil for 20 minutes. Bottle and seal while hot.

title: Kay'S Chicken Almond
instructions: Saute onions and celery in 2 tablespoons butter. Add ginger. Bring to boil. Add rice and soup mix. Boil 1 minute. Add all other ingredients. Mix well and pour into large casserole dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 10 to 20 depending if served alone or on buffet with other main dishes.

title: Barbecue Wieners
instructions: Dust paprika and black pepper over wieners. Pour mixture over wieners split lengthwise in baking dish. Cook 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until tender.

title: Deviled Egg And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise. Scoop out yolks and mash with remaining ingredients except broccoli. Fill eggs with stuffing. Arrange drained broccoli in baking dish and place eggs on top. Pour Cheese Sauce over all and top with bread crumbs.

title: Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Cut strips of floured tortillas size of about 3-inches wide. Mix tomatoes soup and sour cream together in blender or mix real well. Layer like lasagna the tortilla strips chicken and cottage cheese; repeat for second layer then add sauce to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let set for awhile before eating.

title: Instant Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place in a covered jar. Place 2 teaspoons in cup of hot water to serve. Yield 25 to 30 servings.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: Braised Oxtail
instructions: Wash and clean cut up oxtail. Season with salt and garlic powder. Coat with flour and fry until brown. Put in a roaster; add chicken broth and bake in 350\u00b0 oven until meat separates from bone. Cool and serve. Finger licking good!

title: Peanut Butter Crunch
instructions: Heat sugar and syrup to boiling point; pour over peanut butter crunch and vanilla. Mix well. Add Special K cereal. Press in buttered pan. Melt both packages of chips and pour over mixture.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all together. Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with sugar when still hot or cool and spread with icing. (Children love this cookie when you use several colors for icing.)

title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
instructions: Toss cucumbers with salt. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled. Combine sour cream lemon juice onion sugar and pepper; blend well. Reserve 1/4 cup of mixture. Combine cucumbers with remainder of the sour cream mixture. Refrigerate until well chilled about 2 hours. To serve place remainder of mixture over top for garnish.

title: Coney Island Dogs
instructions: Cook hot dogs. Place in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks; beat well. Add sour cream flour soda and lemon extract. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into batter. Pour in tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 300\u00b0 oven. Let cool 10 minutes before turning out.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pull cooled chicken from bone in small pieces and mix with soup and sour cream. Spread into 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread crackers on mixture. Pour margarine over crackers. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken N' Dressing
instructions: Mix dressing mix with melted margarine. Put 2/3 of Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix in bottom of large casserole dish. Layer chicken soup and stock. Top with remaining dressing mix. Bake at 300\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: English Muffin Loaves
instructions: Combine 3 cups flour yeast sugar salt and soda. Heat liquids until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to dry mixture; beat well. Stir in rest of flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into two 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal. Sprinkle tops with cornmeal. Cover; let rise in warm place for 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from pans immediately and cool.

title: Mincemeat Bread Stuffing(For Turkey Or Chicken)
instructions: Toast bread cubes until slightly crisp. Add mincemeat salt pepper and butter. Toss lightly with 2 forks until well blended. Use to stuff chicken or turkey.

title: Sugar And Spice Nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. In large bowl combine mixed nuts and butter; set aside. In small bowl blend remaining ingredients; stir into nut mixture. On ungreased baking sheet evenly spread nut mixture. Bake stirring occasionally 40 minutes or until nuts are golden. Great for holiday appetizers and homemade snack gifts!

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll into 3/4-inch balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Oyster Ritz
instructions: Mix oil garlic and dill weed well. Put oyster crackers in bowl with lid. Pour oil mixture over crackers. Cover and shake well. Refrigerate at least overnight.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients; add 1/2 cup pecans (more if desired). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes more. Use an unbaked pie shell.

title: Skillet Squash
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon reserving 1 tablespoon of drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Rinse the beans. In a large Dutch oven cover beans with the 6 cups water. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover; let stand 1 hour. (Or soak beans in water overnight in a covered pan.) Drain and rinse beans.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Melt butter; stir in brown sugar. Remove and stir in vanilla and sour cream. Fix the night or day before to thicken. Suggested fruit to dip Bananas apples strawberries and pineapple.

title: Zucchini Bran Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 12 to 15 (2 1/2-inch) muffin pan cups. In medium mixing bowl combine flour brown sugar baking powder salt and soda. In small bowl blend egg milk and oil; stir in 100% bran. Let stand 5 minutes. Add zucchini walnuts and cinnamon; mix until well combined. Stir into flour mixture just until blended. Do not overmix. Fill baking cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In large kettle cook vegetables in water until tender. Drain reserving liquid. Set vegetables aside.

title: Martini
instructions: Over cracked ice in cocktail shaker pour gin and vermouth. Stir. Strain mixture into 2 chilled cocktail glasses. Garnish with either olives or lemon twists.

title: Chicken Baked In Sour Cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange four 12-inch squares of foil on baking sheet. Blend garlic salt celery seed and sour cream. Dip chicken in butter sour cream and then crumbs. Arrange each in square foil to form sealed package. Bake for 1 hour. Open foil and bake 15 minutes longer or when chicken is brown.

title: Favorite Dinner Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottoms of 12 medium muffin cups or spray with Pam cooking spray. Beat egg whites stir in oil and milk. Mix in flour until just moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Fill cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Immediately remove from pan. **NOTE To make sweeter muffins increase sugar to 1/2 cup and for variety add 1 cup fresh well-drained blueberries.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken cabbage and onion in a large bowl; mix well and set aside.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix potatoes egg and pepper. Pat into patties and roll lightly in flour. Fry in hot oil until browned turning only once. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mama'S Mexican Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In saucepan brown ground beef. Drain fat. Add canned items. Let simmer 10 minutes. Pour into baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake until cheese melts.

title: Yummy Dessert
instructions: Bake cake mix in 9 x 13-inch pan about 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Will be a thin layer. Beat cream cheese pudding mix and milk together. Spread over cake. Spoon pineapple over pudding mixture. Cover all with whipped topping. Chill.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs until fluffy. Beat in sugar oil and vanilla until it is thick and lemon colored. Add rest of ingredients and pour into 2 loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Invert on rack and let cool completely.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop cauliflower and broccoli. Combine sugar and mayonnaise and add to vegetables. Add crisp bacon; mix well. Refrigerate covered overnight.

title: Chicken And Broccoli With Rice
instructions: Bring water to boil. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until water is absorbed.

title: Whole Wheat Rolls
instructions: Let yeast 2 tablespoons sugar and warm water stand until dissolved. Combine eggs salt and 2/3 cup sugar; beat well. Scald milk and add shortening. Stir until shortening is melted. Cool. Combine yeast mixture milk mixture and egg mixture. Stir in flours and mix well. (Mixer can be used.) Place in large bowl and let rise until double in size. Knead down and roll on floured surface to about 2/3-inch thick. Cut into rolls with biscuit cutter. Place on baking sheet. Brush tops with melted margarine. Let rise at room temperature for 2 hours. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: French Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Peel onions under water. Slice in bowl of milk. Let stand 15 minutes. Drain. Beat eggs. Add salt pepper milk and flour to make smooth batter. Dip onions in batter and drop in deep hot fat or dip onions in flour and fry.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Saucy Asparagus
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat combine the soup and milk. Heat until it boils. Add asparagus. Cover and cook over low heat 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender. Serve with grated Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Tomato-Onion-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes. Cool and store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet And Sour Slaw
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Heat to boiling the oil vinegar and salt. Pour over cabbage mixture. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Chocolate Clusters
instructions: In a 2 cup microwave-safe bowl cook chocolate pieces and shortening on 100% power or High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until melted. Stir in nuts noodles or marshmallows. Drop from a spoon onto waxed paper. Cover; refrigerate until firm. Makes about 18 pieces.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients with enough water to hold together. Roll into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 (about 15 minutes) until golden brown. May be frozen and reheated.

title: Sweet Trash
instructions: Mix white Karo butter and brown sugar together and melt in microwave. Mix Crispix pretzels and nuts together in large bowl then pour into a greased large baking sheet. Pour sugar mixture over and toss well to coat. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. When ready as soon as cool enough to handle put in gallon Ziploc bags and toss until cool to keep from sticking. Lie flat.

title: Mother'S Cracker Dumplings
instructions: Grind first 4 ingredients in food grinder. Add milk and oleo; heat until oleo melts. Combine with cracker mixture. Roll into 1-inch balls. Cook in chicken broth 7 to 10 minutes. Add to your favorite chicken stew.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients in large bowl with dressing. Add Fritos just before eating.

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with no-stick spray. Dip chicken in margarine and coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in prepared pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes or until thoroughly cooked. Makes 6 servings at 270 calories each.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and shortening. Add milk flour spices vanilla and lemon flavoring. Add nuts and raisins. Bake in 3 x 8-inch layer pans at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Arkansas Baked Beans
instructions: Saute onion celery and bell pepper together. Saute ground beef until done but not brown. Thoroughly mix all ingredients. Pour into bean pot or other casserole type dish. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pastel De Choclo
instructions: Drain the corn and cook at low heat for 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Add the milk slowly; it must be creamy. Add salt and pepper.

title: Life Like Cookie Dough
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Cream together margarine sugar and vanilla. Dissolve soda in milk. Add to creamed mixture. Mix all ingredients together. Chill slightly. Roll out on floured surface; cut in desired shapes. Decorate before or after. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients. Serve on rye bread or crackers.

title: Poor Man'S Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix together and fry until desired brownness over medium heat.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and chill. Serve with raw vegetables or with rye or pumpernickel round.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk cocoa and oleo together 1 1/2 minutes. Mix in peanut butter vanilla and cooking oats. Let cool a few minutes. Drop from a teaspoon onto wax paper.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Beat eggs and milk together. Dip pieces of chicken in egg and milk mixture. Roll in crumbs. Place in well greased baking dish using butter or oleo. Salt to taste. Sprinkle with poultry seasoning. Bake at 325 until meat loosens from bone.

title: Chicken With Asparagus Sauce
instructions: Dip chicken in egg whites then coat with bread crumbs. Cook chicken in skillet until tender. Add soup milk and water. Serve over rice.

title: Bunt Bread
instructions: Mix cinnamon and 3/4 c. of the sugar in a plastic bag and shake. Cut biscuits into quarters and add to bag and shake. Place into ungreased Bunt pan. In saucepan bring butter remaining sugar brown sugar to a boil. Mix pecans pour over biscuits. Let rise overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 min. Remove from pan immediately after cooked.

title: Quick Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Put 1 cup sugar in cherries and let set. Melt 1 stick butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan in oven. Mix together flour baking powder sugar salt and milk. Pour batter over melted butter in pan. Spoon cherries over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti until well done and set aside on warm. Fry ground beef with onion sauce mushrooms and green pepper. Add the spices and add to spaghetti and mix well. Serve with garlic or French bread.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar and cinnamon then add eggs oil and strawberries. Add chopped pecans last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Roasted Spice Pecans
instructions: Melt butter. Add garlic Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce. Spread pecans on a cookie sheet. Pour mixture over it. Slow roast at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour. They should be shiny and tan when finished.

title: Rice Cakes
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water until tender; drain and add beaten eggs flour and salt. Mix well. Spoon into skillet of hot cooking oil. Let brown on each side by turning. Put on paper towels; let drain then serve. Serves as bread for breakfast lunch or dinner.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix together the broccoli (chopped) bacon onion and raisins. Blend together the sour cream mayonnaise and sugar and spread over salad mixture.

title: Curried Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef curry powder stuffing mix salt and pepper. Shape into teaspoon size\tballs and saute in butter over high heat for 5 minutes or until brown. Yields 32 balls.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks vanilla and salt; beat well. Add flour gradually; dough will be stiff. Fill cookie press. Place cookies on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Golden Delight Pancakes
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender cover and blend at high speed for 1 minute stopping once to stir down. Bake on greased griddle using 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Makes 20 (4-inch) pancakes. Good for waffles also. Bake extra and freeze. Reheat in toaster.

title: Great Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Prepare corn bread according to instructions on Jiffy mix box. Fry/saute onion (chopped); combine cooked onion pieces 1 can of creamed corn and diced Ro-Tel tomatoes. (If using canned Ro-Tel drain before emptying contents.) Mix 3/4 of cheese in with corn bread mix onions Ro-Tel and creamed corn. Grease pan 9 x 13-inch; cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Watch to see when edges turn lightly brown and it looks done. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top of corn bread while hot.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Put apple slices into pie crust. Add 3/4 cup of sugar and cinnamon. Mix together 1/2 cup of sugar flour and margarine. Mix until crumbly and put on top of apples. Cover with foil and bake covered at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and cook 20 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 minutes or until apples are done.

title: Sesame Pralines
instructions: Toast sesame seed in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. In 3-quart saucepan combine both sugars and cream. Cook over medium heat stirring until dissolved. Wash crystals from sides of pan. Cook to 230\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Add butter pecans and sesame seed. Continue cooking stirring occasionally to 234\u00b0 (soft ball stage). Remove from heat. Cool 2 to 3 minutes then stir until thickened. Working fast drop from spoon onto buttered waxed paper. Cool.

title: K.C.'S Killer Smoked Salmon
instructions: Cut salmon into small pieces. Put remaining ingredients in large bowl. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add fish and just enough water to cover. Soak for 8 to 12 hours. Place on rack and let sit for 1 hour. Pepper top of fish if you like. Smoke to desired consistency.

title: Cream Cheese Desserts
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Place a vanilla wafer in the bottom of a cupcake wrapper inside a muffin pan. Pour mixture in each cup 3/4 full. Place 3 to 4 cherries on top of each. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 18.

title: Rosemary Grilled Chicken With Red Pepper Sauce
instructions: Combine mustard and 1 tablespoon lemon juice stirring well. Spread mustard mixture on both sides of chicken and sprinkle with pepper. Cover and chill 2 hours.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding fruit last. Pour into baking dish and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 30 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream. You can substitute any fruit seedless grapes pitted cherries plums etc.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form into balls. Mash out on cookie sheet with fork to form design on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Rusks(Bread Rolls)
instructions: While hot combine 1 cup mashed potatoes 3/4 cup sugar and 1 cup potato water in a large bowl. Dissolve 1 cake yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.

title: Oreo Ice Cream
instructions: Thaw ice cream a little. Mix ice cream and Cool Whip. Add crushed Oreo cookies and mix slowly. Place in serving dishes or containers to thicken. Put in freezer for awhile before serving.

title: Mexican Noodles
instructions: Brown onions in bacon fat or oil. Remove onions and fry noodles and ground beef until they are brown turning frequently. Drain excess fat. Add onions green peppers tomatoes chili powder and salt to noodles and meat. Cover and simmer until noodles are tender. Stir occasionally.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water. Add pineapple and pie filling. After mixed refrigerate. After congealed mix sour cream cream cheese sugar and nuts. Spread over top of congealed salad. Refrigerate and enjoy.

title: White Chili
instructions: Sort and wash beans. Place in Dutch oven. Cover with water 2-inches above beans; let soak 8 hours. Drain and wash beans; return to Dutch oven. Add broth and next 4 ingredients. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Add chicken chilies cumin oregano and cloves to bean mixture; cover and cook 30 minutes. Spoon into serving bowls. Top each with grated cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cool carrots. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour over drained cool carrots. Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

title: Too Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Crumble hamburger meat/sausage into frying pan. Cook until done; drain. Add all ingredients into slow cooker or similar. Mix well and heat slowly until all the cheese has melted. Serve with chips tacos or vegetable tray. Refrigerate any unused portion. Also leftover cheese dip tastes good cold as a cheese spread.

title: Easy Beef Stew
instructions: Roll meat in flour and brown in margarine. Add tomato sauce salt pepper thyme bay leaf and water. Simmer 1 1/2 hours until meat is tender. Add onions carrots and potatoes. May also add peas. Cook 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Baklava
instructions: Keep phyllo leaves under a damp cloth until needed. Using 1/2 of phyllo leaves layer spreading each with melted butter. Fold leaves as necessary to fit into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine nuts sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over the leaves and butter. Top with remaining leaves brushing each with melted butter. Cut into diamond shape and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown about 40 minutes. Honey is poured over each while they are hot.

title: Date And Nut Cookies
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Cream butter. Add sugar and beaten eggs. Add dates and nuts. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 18 minutes.

title: Candy Bar Pie
instructions: Spread ice cream evenly in bottom of crust. Freeze until ice cream is firm. Spread caramel sauce over ice cream; sprinkle with peanuts. Cover with whipped topping. Freeze 4 hours or until firm. Let stand at room temperature 20 minutes or until pie can be easily cut. Garnish with additional caramel sauce and peanuts. Makes 8 servings.

title: German Apple Pancakes
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Place 2 round layer pans 9 x 1 1/2-inch in oven. Beat eggs flour milk and salt in small mixer bowl on medium speed for 1 minute. Remove pans from oven. Place 2 tablespoons margarine in each pan; rotate pans until margarine is melted and coats sides of pans. Arrange half of apple slices in each pan; divide batter evenly between pans. Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar mixture over batter in each pan. Bake uncovered until puffed and golden brown about 25 minutes.

title: Rum Sauced Bananas
instructions: Add brown sugar and margarine to the apple juice and simmer over medium heat. Add bananas and cook until bananas become very soft. Add rum and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Serve over ice cream or cake. Serves 3. Recipe doubles easily.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together adding milk till mixture is mixed well. You might need more or less milk depending on how you would like your batter. When everything is mixed together it should look like cornbread that is why you need to be the judge about how much milk you need. Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 - 45 minutes or until done.

title: Brer Rabbit'S Carrots
instructions: Pare the carrots with a vegetable parer. Cut them into thin slices. Place the carrots in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Cover the saucepan and heat over medium-high heat until the water starts to boil Turn the heat down to low. Remove the cover and cook 15 minutes longer. When the carrots are tender pour the contents of the saucepan into a colander in the sink. (If you are a child get help dont do it yourself.) Shake the colander to drain off all the water.

title: Quick Peach Pie Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread melted margarine evenly in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine baking mix sugar and milk in bowl; mix well. Batter will be thin. Pour into prepared dish; do not stir. Top with peaches; do not stir. Bake until batter rises to top and browns. Yield 10 servings.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all together and place in freezer can. Freeze according to your ice cream freezer directions. Can be stored in refrigerator freezer and will not get too hard but remain just right to eat.

title: Apple Nobby Cake
instructions: Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add egg and vanilla; mix until smooth. Sift together the flour and all dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in apples and nuts; mix well. Pour batter into greased 8-inch square pan (8 x 8-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until a toothpick thrust into center of cake comes out clean. Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Use rectangular pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix coconut and nuts together and sprinkle in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix as directed. Mix stick of margarine and cream cheese together heat until soft enough to mix. Add powdered sugar with margarine and cream cheese. Pour cake mix into pan then pour mix of margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Three Week Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred or chop cabbage. Shred or chop onions and leave on top of cabbage (do not stir). Bring to a boil other ingredients and pour over cabbage and onions. Do not stir. Refrigerate 4 hours. Stir and serve. Can be kept up to 3 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Snowball Salad
instructions: Mix together topping sour cream sugar and lemon juice and add bananas pineapple pecans and cherries.

title: Microwave Toffee
instructions: Spread pecans evenly in a buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. In a 2-quart casserole combine sugar and margarine. Microwave at High for 4 1/2 to 8 1/2 minutes or until sugar is dissolved stirring after 2 minutes then every minute. Do not overcook! Spread mixture over nuts in pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Let stand 20 seconds until chocolate is melted. Spread chocolate over candy. Cool. Break into pieces. Yield 1 pound.

title: Leche Quemada(Caramel Milk Pudding)
instructions: Pour milk into 8 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish; cover with foil. Place in shallow pan; pour boiling water around it to a depth of 3/4-inch. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serve warm or cold. Top with coffee liqueur and cream. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks; stir in sugar cornstarch water lemon juice and rind. Cook until mixture is thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Beat egg whites and put meringue on top of pie.

title: Chocolate Waffles
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately. Cook on waffle iron. Serve hot with ice cream.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil and bone chicken breasts. Tear up and place in baking dish. Mix soup and sour cream; spread over chicken. Crumble 1 stick Ritz crackers over. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Boston Brown Bread Or Bug Bread
instructions: Simmer water and raisins for 15 minutes. Add dry ingredients. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine peanut butter Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat until well blended. Add egg. Beat until blended. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Flatten slightly with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes or until beginning to brown. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet before taking off sheet. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with a pastry blender or fork. Spread and press in a well greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips and spread over top. Let dry and cut in bars.

title: Potato Bacon Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Saute onion in butter. Put all ingredients in a pan except sour cream. Add crumbled bacon and cook until done. Do not drain potatoes. Add sour cream and let heat 5 to 10 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Arkansas Chocolate Gravy
instructions: In iron skillet mix together all dry ingredients. Gradually add milk to this mixture. Stir until completely mixed. Cook over low heat until thickens. If this doesnt thicken add 1 teaspoon each sugar and cocoa plus 1 tablespoon flour. Serve with hot buttered biscuits.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix peanut butter sugar and melted butter. Form in little balls and refrigerate. Melt chocolate almond bark; put a little in bottom of aluminum cup cake and put a peanut ball on top of chocolate. Press slightly. Pour a little more chocolate on top. Makes 90 small cups.

title: Coffee Urn Punch
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in coffee urn. Layer cloves cinnamon and salt in urn basket and perk. Serve hot.

title: Apple Snack Cake
instructions: Combine oil eggs and sugar in large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed until well mixed. Combine flour soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. Stir in pecans half the butterscotch morsels and apples. Spread batter (will be very stiff) into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with remaining morsels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 55 minutes or until done.

title: Cowboy Baked Beans
instructions: Saute onion and ground beef. Mix thoroughly all ingredients. Put in deep casserole dish. Bake in moderate oven 30-40 minutes.

title: Brownie Cake
instructions: Cook chocolate pudding according to directions on box. Let cool slightly. Pour chocolate cake mix into pudding. Stir well. Pour mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan. Before baking put chocolate chips and nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jerry'S Pink Peanut Patty
instructions: Mix peanuts milk Karo sugar and margarine. Cook until thick forms ball 240 degrees. Remove from heat; add vanilla and red food coloring. Beat until cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine with chopped onion. Add all other ingredients except shredded cheese. Pour into greased casserole dish; top with sharp cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually. Add beaten egg and applesauce. Stir in flour and spices alternately with water and soda mix. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Cream the cheese. Add all ingredients and mix. Chill. Serve with crackers or party bread.

title: Holy Cow Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package and punch holes in top. Pour Eagle Brand milk and ice cream topping over cake. Then cover with Cool Whip. Crush up candy bars and put over Cool Whip.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Combine carrots stock and brown sugar in a heavy saucepan with lid; bring to a boil then reduce the heat and cover tightly. Cook the carrots until they are about half done 10 to 15 minutes; then remove the lid from the pot. Return the heat to medium-low and reduce the cooking liquid to a thick syrup. As the syrup thickens shake the pan frequently to keep the carrots from sticking. When the syrup is thick add the butter pepper nutmeg and salt. When the butter is melted shake the pan again rolling the carrots gently in the glaze so each piece is covered. Makes 4 servings.

title: Diabetic Cheesecake
instructions: In a medium saucepan beat egg yolks and orange juice together. Sprinkle with gelatine. Let stand 1 minute. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until gelatine is dissolved about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in sweetener lemon juice and flavoring. Pour into blender or food processor. Cover and blend at high speed until smooth about 30 seconds. Chill stirring occasionally until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon about 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown together beef chilies and onions. Add chicken soup cheese soup evaporated milk water garlic powder salt and pepper. Bring to boil. Make 2 layers of chips. Then beef mixture then cheese in 8 x 12-inch oblong pan. Bake in oven 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 until brown and hot throughout.

title: One Hour Dinner Rolls
instructions: Crumble yeast\tin lukewarm water. To lukewarm buttermilk add sugar and shortening. Sift into buttermilk mixture flour soda and salt. Beat smooth by\thand. Let stand 10 minutes. Work and roll out dough. Shape in rolls.\tLet rise 30 minutes in warm place.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put whole strawberries in baked pie shell. Put water sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan. Boil until clear and thick. Remove from heat and stir in jello until mixed. Pour over strawberries in pie crust. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for coconut in a blender on low for 3 minutes. Pour into 8 or 9 inch pie pan. Let set for 5 minutes. Shake coconut over pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: 5-Cup Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crisp lettuce. Serve on crisp lettuce leaves. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pasta Primavera(Springtime Pasta)
instructions: Cook pasta. Saute onion and garlic in medium skillet about 1 minute. Add vegetables and saute 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in reserved tomato juice tomato paste and water. Simmer 5 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes and basil salt and pepper. Simmer another couple of minutes. Serve over pasta. Garnish with olives.

title: Sharon'S Easy Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Chop vegetables and saute in oleo. Boil vermicelli in chicken broth. Add all the rest of ingredients and simmer a few minutes.

title: Batterway Rolls
instructions: Pour water in a large bowl. Add yeast; let stand a few minutes. Stir until dissolved. Add half the flour sugar salt and shortening. Add egg; beat 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Add remaining flour; beat another 2 minutes. Cover with oiled plastic wrap. Let rise in warm place until double about 1 hour and 30 minutes. Grease 2 dozen small muffin tin holes. Stir batter 20 to 25 strokes. Spoon half full. Let rise until batter reaches top of tins. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Brush with butter when they come out of oven.

title: Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Put boiling water and oats in large mixing bowl. Stir thoroughly and let stand 1 hour. Add molasses salt and butter. Put warm water and yeast into small bowl. When yeast is dissolved add to the oatmeal mixture. Stir in flour. Beat thoroughly and let rise until double in bulk. Add enough more flour to make the dough just firm enough to knead. Shape into 2 loaves and put in greased pans. Let rise until almost double. Bake about 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: St. Paul'S Rice
instructions: Toss and brown sausage; drain on paper towel. Pour off grease. Boil for 7 minutes the soup rice and water. Put all ingredients together in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mazell'S Country Buttercream Ribbon Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Combine cream cheese 1 egg and 1/4 cup sugar in a medium mixing bowl. Beat on high speed of an electric mixer until smooth. Gradually add 3 tablespoons milk and next 3 ingredients beating well. Set aside.

title: Moussaka
instructions: Brush both sides of eggplant slices with the oil. In a large skillet brown eggplant slices over medium heat about 2 minutes per side. Drain; set aside.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Soup
instructions: I use the stems of the cauliflower and broccoli that was leftover from the broccoli and cauliflower salad to make the soup. Boil until tender; mash and remove any stems that are stringy. Proceed with your favorite cream soup recipe.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Remove skin from chicken. Rinse chicken and pat dry. In a small mixing bowl stir together the bread crumbs herb and pepper. Add the melted margarine and toss to coat. Sprinkle the skinned side of each chicken piece with the crumb mixture pressing onto the chicken to coat. Arrange chicken pieces coating side up in a 12 x 17 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink. Do not turn. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix together vinegar and sugar. Heat until sugar dissolves; set aside to cool. Shred together in food processor the cabbage onion and green pepper. Add celery seed mustard seed and salt to cabbage mixture and add black pepper to taste. When vinegar mixture is cooled pour over cabbage mixture and mix well. Chill in a closed container. This will keep in refrigerator for 2 to 3 weeks.

title: Baked Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Brush chicken with Miracle Whip Light. Coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish/pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry-Pineapple Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3-quart pitcher or punch bowl. Serve over ice. Makes 11 cups.

title: Weesie'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add sugar and beat. Add melted butter then milk vanilla and coconut. Pour into an unbaked pastry shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Yummy Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter with sour cream. Add seasoning salt. Pour over cooked potatoes. Pour into baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Sprinkle yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar in 1/2 cup warm water. Wait 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Add together. Add flour to make a stiff dough. Let rise until dough is double in bulk. Make into rolls. Let rise again until double in bulk. Bake.

title: Hildy'S Roasted Peppers
instructions: Roast peppers and tomatoes until black in a 450\u00b0 oven. Keep in foil to keep warm while peeling. Slice and seed. Add garlic powder salt and pepper to taste. Coat with olive oil. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: No Calorie Soup
instructions: Cut up and place in a large pot with enough water to see in. Let simmer until done. Eat until you cant eat any more.

title: Chicken Balls
instructions: In large bowl combine mayonnaise cream cheese garlic salt curry powder and lemon juice. Add chicken and mix well. Shape into ball or log. Roll in chopped cashews and serve with crackers. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Molasses Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar shortening and molasses. Beat in egg. Add sifted dry ingredients and applesauce at one time. Stir in nuts. Drop on lightly greased sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil the zucchini and onion in a little water for about 5 minutes. Drain. Mix soup sour cream and carrots. Melt butter or margarine and mix with stuffing cubes. Place half the stuffing mix in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish. Mix zucchini and onion with soup sour cream and carrot mixture. Put mixture in casserole dish. Top with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake for approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Spanish Beef Rice
instructions: Add beef onion green pepper and rice in skillet. Stir until meat is brown. Drain grease. Add tomato sauce and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 25 minutes. One-half cup grated cheese may be added before serving.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugars then add eggs and oil. Now mix in remaining ingredients. Chill dough overnight. Make into small balls and put on greased cookie sheet. Press down with sugared fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 10 minutes or until edges lightly brown.

title: Pecan Pies
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and melted butter. Add beaten eggs and pecans to syrup mixture mixing thoroughly. Pour filling into pie shell. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 20 minutes in a well buttered pan or muffin tin.

title: Homemade Orange Ice Cream
instructions: Freeze according to freezer directions. Also good with crushed pineapple added.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In saucepan cook onion and garlic in margarine or butter until tender. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and seasonings. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Dip each tortilla into tomato mixture to soften. Place 1 piece of chicken and about 2 tablespoons shredded cheese on each tortilla. Roll up and place seam side down in 13 1/2 x 8 3/4 x 1-inch baking dish.

title: Artichoke Dip Or Spread
instructions: Chop artichokes very fine. Add cheese and mayonnaise and mix well. Microwave on High in small serving dish until hot about 4 minutes. Stir twice while heating. Serve warm with crackers or on raw vegetables.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a greased and heated 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Ham What Am
instructions: Combine pineapple and sugar. Simmer about 15 minutes at low heat. Add Blue cheese. Remove from heat at once. Stir to mix and dissolve cheese. Spread on top of ham slice that has been fried just enough to heat thoroughly.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake according to box directions. Makes two layers. Cool and split to make 4 layers.

title: Squash Casserole 2
instructions: Put well drained hot squash in large mixing bowl. Add egg margarine mayonnaise sugar half of cheese and half of cracker crumbs. Season with cayenne pepper salt pepper and herbs (oregano is especially good in this dish). Mix all ingredients well. Put into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole and top with remaining cheese and crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Crookneck squash or a mixture of crookneck and zucchini may be used.

title: Chinatown Red-Cooked Pork Treasures
instructions: In a 1-gallon self-sealing plastic bag combine all ingredients and mix well. Seal bag and marinate in the refrigerate 8 to 12 hours or overnight. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Remove pork cubes from marinade discarding marinade. Pat pork dry with paper towel. Place cubes in a single layer not touching in a shallow baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until pork is just tender and lightly browned. Remove to serving platter or chafing dish and serve hot as an appetizer. Makes 16 servings.

title: Quick Krispie Balls
instructions: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil. Turn off heat and add peanut butter and chips; stir until melted. Mix with Rice Krispies. Pour real quick into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Wild Rice And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice. Cook onion and celery in butter until tender. Stir in soup sour cream wine and curry powder. Stir in chicken and wild rice. Turn into baking dish. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Stir before serving.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix thoroughly flour margarine and powdered sugar in a small bowl. Press evenly with hands in bottom and about 5/8-inch up sides of an ungreased square 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes. Beat remaining ingredients in a medium bowl on medium speed until light and fluffy. Pour over base and bake until no indentation remains when touched lightly in the center about 25 minutes. Let stand until cool; then cut into about 1 1/2-inch squares.

title: Crepes A La Alexa Zoe
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth. Let stand in refrigerator for 1 hour. Lightly wipe a 7-inch skillet with vegetable oil and heat over medium/high heat. Add 2 tablespoons of batter. Quickly tilt the pan back and forth to spread batter evenly over skillet. Cook until lightly browned then turn and cook other side until brown. Repeat with remaining batter stacking crepes between sheets of wax paper to prevent sticking. Serve hot with maple syrup and ice cream (add sliced bananas if you like).

title: Cheese Cake -Diet
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Pour into spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Log Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. In another bowl mix flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Fold in pumpkin mixture. Spread into greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. On top sprinkle nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Dont let cool. Turn out on dish towel lightly sprinkled with confectioners sugar. Turn nut side onto towel. Leave until cool. Unroll flat.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook chicken and debone; cook ground beef and drain. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Saute onions in butter. Combine all ingredients in a large container and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. May be frozen.

title: Zucchini Bread(Yields 2 Loaves)
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil sugar sugar substitute vanilla pineapple and zucchini. Sift flours baking powder baking soda cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Add to egg mixture. Add nuts if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 in well-greased loaf pans for 40 minutes. Cool on wire rack. May be frozen.

title: Shrimp Salad With Grapes
instructions: Bring 4-quarts water to boil. Add salt and bay leaves. Add shrimp cook 1 minute. Pour into colander. Cool.

title: Easy Drop Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and shortening together for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes (or until melted). Stir in your choice of fillers. (I mix 3/4 cup nuts and 3/4 cup marshmallows for Rocky Road type candy.) Drop from spoon onto waxed paper. Put in refrigerator until firm.

title: Onion Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop teaspoonful in hot oil. Pat out flat. Can be kept in oven 1 hour on low heat while frying all of them.

title: Chocolate Coconut (Bourbon) Balls
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients well (takes awhile). Mold into small balls. Put in refrigerator overnight. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin over low heat in a double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate mixture with a toothpick. Let cool.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Sift together flour soda and salt; add to liquid ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 4 medium loaves.

title: Bacon And Vegetable Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butter and cheese into small bowl. Roll each biscuit piece into mixture. Arrange 1/3 of the biscuits in a Bundt pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Put a layer of bacon green pepper and onion. Repeat ending up with a layer of biscuits on the top. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Invert onto a serving plate. Garnish with strips of green peppers.

title: Corned Beef Spread
instructions: Crumble corned beef. Add horseradish and mayonnaise mixing very well. Serve with crackers as a spread.

title: Coconut-Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar. Beat well at medium speed on electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after adding each. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternating with milk; begin and end with flour. Mix after adding each. Stir in flavoring. Pour batter into three greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool. Spread one layer with half of pineapple filling. Sprinkle 1/3 cup coconut over filling. Repeat with the next layer. Spread frosting on top and sides of cake and sprinkle with remaining coconut.

title: Sauteed Zucchini(Lo-Fat)
instructions: In nonstick skillet heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and saute until just tender and slightly browned (5 to 8 minutes). Combine remaining ingredients and add to zucchini. Remove from heat. Toss gently and serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Oatmeal Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs and peanut butter and beat well. Combine oats flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture beating well. Stir in raisins or chocolate chips.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Mexi-Corn Lasagna
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in large skillet. Simmer 5 minutes stirring frequently. Combine cottage cheese eggs Parmesan cheese oregano and garlic salt; mix well.

title: Black-Eyed Peas Headliner Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt margarine or butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix together all other ingredients except Cheddar cheese. Do not drain broccoli. Pour batter over margarine or butter. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top of batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Almond Joy Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake as usual in 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat to boiling 1 cup Pet milk and sugar. Add marshmallows; when melted add coconut. Pour over hot cake. Melt 1/2 cup Pet milk with butter and chocolate chips. Spread on top of coconut. Sprinkle with almonds.

title: Herb-Baked Fish And Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In 8 x 12-inch baking dish combine hot bouillon uncooked rice and seasonings. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top with broccoli 1/2 can onions and the cheese. Place fish fillets diagonally down center of dish. Sprinkle fish with paprika. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes until fish flakes. Stir rice. Top fish with Cheddar cheese and remaining onions. Bake uncovered 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: 4 Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Mix sugar vinegar oil water and salt together. Pour over beans celery and onion. Let stand 24 hours. If you so desire you may add mango and green pepper.

title: Pork Chops And Potato Combo
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook pork chops in shortening until brown; sprinkle with salt. Heat water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan. Stir in remaining ingredients; heat to boiling. Pour into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Place pork chops on top. Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour. Remove foil; bake until pork chops are done 10 to 15 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients then refrigerate for 1 hour. Melt together wax and Hershey bars. Dip peanut butter balls in chocolate mix then in ice water.

title: Baked Mochi
instructions: Mix dry ingredients except potato starch. Add water and coconut milk gradually until well mixed. Add vanilla and coloring and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with foil and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Do not underbake. In fact overbake. Cool completely. Cut into smaller pieces and roll in potato starch.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Layer 1/2 the ingredients then repeat and layer other half. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover and brown cheese.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir together peanuts sugar syrup and salt in Corning dish (1 1/2-quart casserole). Place in microwave and cook 7 to 8 minutes stirring well after 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla to syrup blending well. Return to microwave and cook 1 to 2 minutes more. Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot. Add baking soda and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet; let cool 1/2 to 1 hour. When cool break into small pieces and store in airtight container. Makes about 1 pound.

title: Granny Hazel'S Spaghetti Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in warm water. Add sugar salt and garlic powder. Mix in 2 cups flour. Soften yeast in the 1/4 cup warm water with the 1 teaspoon sugar added. Mix this with the dough and add enough flour to make a soft dough. Let the dough rise while you butter muffin pans. Stir dough well and drop by tablespoon into cornmeal. Roll to cover and place in muffin pan. Let rise until double. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Jubilee Layer Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Continue to cream until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour alternately with milk. Beat well after each addition. Add vanilla. Bake in 3 (9-inch) pans in 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Dice chicken into bite size pieces and mix with all other ingredients. Put into a greased flat casserole or baking pan and top with 2 cups crushed Fritos or potato chips. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Line dish with tortillas broken in fourths. Spread layer of chicken over. Pour 1 can of soup cheese and 1/2 can of tomato peppers then alternate layers again topping with cheese. Cook 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Banana Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Sift flour and baking soda together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Add bananas nuts and vanilla. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Meal Pie
instructions: Beat together and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add eggs milk vanilla and oil. Beat 2 minutes. Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin). Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool. Frost with Buttercream Frosting.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and bell pepper in a skillet. Drain off the fat. In a mixing bowl combine sauce soup and milk. Stir in the meat. Break the tortillas into small pieces. Put some meat in the casserole dish to cover the bottom. Alternate meat tortillas and cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Lentil Spinach Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large soup pot or crock-pot. Cook on low for 6 hours. If using a crock-pot set crock-pot to high and cook 6 hours. Add ground pepper to taste. Can also add two chopped Italian sausages to ingredients for different flavor before cooking.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Brown hamburger meat pepper and onions. Add tomato sauce. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and layer pepperoni ham mushrooms etc. Then put Mozzarella cheese on top. Mix together eggs milk flour and oil. Pour over the cheese. Sprinkle more cheese on top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. In a large bowl beat eggs well. Add flour milk and baking powder. Mix well. Add cheese cooked spinach (well drained) and onion. Spoon into baking dish. Level off. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Squash Rolls
instructions: Put milk oleo salt and sugar in saucepan until oleo melts. Dissolve yeast in warm water in another bowl. Add squash to saucepan mixture. Stir in 2 cups of flour at a time. Place 2 balls in each muffin pan hole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lite Eclair Dessert
instructions: Prepare 12 hours in advance. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray (Pam). Line bottom of pan with whole graham crackers. Mix pudding milk Cool Whip and yogurt with mixer at medium speed until blended. Pour over graham crackers. Place whole graham crackers on top side by side. In microwave heat frosting until soupy (about 1 minute) and pour over top. Cover and refrigerate 12 hours.

title: Chicken Caruso And Rice
instructions: Season chicken with garlic salt and pepper. Saute in butter about 2 minutes. Stir in spaghetti sauce and Italian seasoning; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add celery; continue cooking until celery is tender-crisp. Serve over rice. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Serves 6.

title: Butterscotch Milk Chocolate Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl beat brown sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs mix well. Add flour baking powder and salt; mix well. Reserve 1 cup chocolate chips for frosting. Stir in remaining chips and nuts. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Cool completely and frost.

title: Butterscotch Chip Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large bowl beat the sugar brown sugar margarine and peanut butter until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and egg. Blend well. Stir in flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in butterscotch chips. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Flatten slightly with fork dipped in flour or sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Cool completely. Yields 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients with 1 cup of cheese. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle other cup of cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Blend cheese with butter. Stir in flour salt and paprika. Mix well. Wrap about 1 teaspoon of mixture around each olive covering it completely. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes on a greased cookie sheet. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Non-Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil 1 cup sugar and 1 cup syrup 1 minute. Add a few chocolate chips. Take off burner. Add 1 cup peanut butter and 2 1/2 to 3 cups crushed Post Toasties. Drop on wax paper.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix onion chestnuts cheese vegetables and mayonnaise together. Place in baking dish; sprinkle Ritz crackers on top and dab with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook up lasagna like directions advise. Cook up hamburg. Drain grease off. Add tomato sauce and seasonings. Continue to simmer for 1 hour. When done use 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread a little sauce in bottom of pan. Lay down a row of noodles then sauce then cheese (both kinds) then drop cottage cheese by teaspoons. Then do it all again until pan is full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut squash in 1-inch cubes. Add onions; cook in a little water until tender (approximately 20 minutes). Drain; add soup and sour cream. Set aside.

title: Wright'S Savory Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in oil until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes. Use with chicken ribs or hamburgers. Makes 1 quart.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix the chicken almonds chestnuts pimentos and celery. Then blend mayonnaise sour cream lemon juice salt and pepper. Combine the chicken mixture with the blended ingredients. Place in a 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Easy Tuna Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Spread tuna over bottom of pie shell. Sprinkle cheese and onion over tuna. Top with sliced mushrooms. Beat together eggs milk lemon juice and seasonings; pour over tuna mixture. Bake on a cookie sheet for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0; bake an additional 12 to 15 minutes or until center is set. Crab or shrimp may be substituted for tuna. Serves 6.

title: Half Time Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine beef egg bread milk onion parsley salt and mustard. Shape in 4 loaves. Put in baking pan spoon ketchup over it and bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix well. To make cocoa add 4 tablespoons to 1 cup hot water. Stir well.

title: Indonesian Pork Chops(Or Chicken)
instructions: Season meat with salt and pepper. In hot skillet brown meat on both sides in oil. Drain peach halves and set aside. Combine peach liquid and all other ingredients except pepper and peaches. Pour mixture over browned meat. Simmer 30 minutes. Cut peppers into diamond shapes. Add peppers and peaches when meat is done. Cover and simmer 5 minutes more. Serve over fluffy rice and French bread.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Combine in bowl the pineapple pistachio pudding and cottage cheese; mix well. Add pecans and Cool Whip; stir well. Pour in salad bowl and refrigerate 1 hour minimum; overnight for best results.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Apple-Nut Thing
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cream eggs and brown sugar. Add vanilla nuts and apples. Add dry mixture. Pour into 2 (10-inch) pie tins (buttered).\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool in pans. Serve with Cool Whip but extra good with whipped cream and flavored with sherry.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Mix 2 teaspoons per cup of boiling water.

title: Ma Ma'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Use half as much milk as sugar (or twice as much sugar as milk). Cook to soft ball stage. Put in hunk of butter some vanilla pinch of salt and a gob of peanut butter. Stir well and put into buttered dish. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Double-Good Fudge
instructions: Coat eight (4 ounce) shallow baking dishes with vegetable cooking spray; set aside. Combine 1 package powdered sugar chunky peanut butter and 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons milk in a large microwave-safe bowl stirring well. Add 1/2 teaspoon vanilla; stir until smooth. Cover with wax paper and microwave at High 2 to 3 minutes. Spread evenly into prepared dishes. Place 1/2 cup butter in a separate microwave-safe bowl. Microwave at High 1 minute or until melted. Stir in 1 package powdered sugar 1/4 cup milk and 1/2 cup cocoa. Cover with wax paper and microwave at Medium-high (70%) power for 2 to 3 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla; stir until smooth. Spread chocolate mixture evenly over peanut butter layers; cool.

title: Baked Potatoes
instructions: Place 4 cups of potatoes into 2 x 12 x 17-inch greased pan. Mix other ingredients together. Pour over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 1 hour. Uncover; bake 45 minutes.

title: Onion Casserole Number 3
instructions: Heat first four ingredients in saucepan. Add onions and cook covered until tender (about 15 minutes). Turn onion mixture into 1-quart casserole and pour a mixture of egg yolks sour cream and cheese over onions. Top with cracker crumbs. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Barbecue Baby Beef Ribs
instructions: Wipe ribs with wet towel or with damp paper towel. Place ribs in a single layer in a shallow roasting pan. Roast ribs at 450\u00b0 for about 20 minutes turning once. Prepare basting sauce. Mix all ingredients together. Remove ribs from oven. Brush ribs with sauce on both sides. Return to oven. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 20 minutes longer or until ribs are tender. Baste with remaining sauce from time to time while baking. If ribs start to get too dark cover with aluminum foil and reduce heat to 400\u00b0 for the last 10 minutes of baking time.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except potato chips and margarine). Pour into large casserole dish. Top with crushed potato chips mixed with margarine. Bake uncovered 30 to 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven or until thoroughly heated. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift together the first ingredients. In pan put margarine oil cocoa and water. Bring to a boil. Pour over flour mixture and stir well. Add buttermilk eggs soda and vanilla. Mix well. Batter is thin. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pralines
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan over medium heat. Boil until soft ball can be formed in cup of cold water*. Remove from heat. Stir until thick. Spoon onto buttered wax paper.

title: Pretzels
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 2 large baking sheets. In a large bowl sprinkle yeast over warm water. Stir until blended and yeast is dissolved. Gradually with wooden spoon stir in sugar salt and enough flour for sticky dough.

title: Virginia'S Apple Cheese Dessert
instructions: Fill shallow greased baking dish with apples. Sprinkle with lemon juice and 1/4 cup sugar. Mix flour cinnamon salt and 1/2 cup sugar. Cut in butter or margarine until mixture is granular. Stir in cheese. Pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Beat the eggs. Add the milk oil and vinegar. Add flour and salt. Beat until free from lumps. Add the water and mix well. Leave the batter for 30 or more minutes. Pour a little oil into a frying pan and allow the pan to heat well. Pour the excess oil off and fry the batter.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix oleo and Crisco together; gradually add sugar. When mixed add eggs 1 at a time. Mix baking powder and salt with flour; add to creamed mixture. When all flour has been added add flavorings and sour cream. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours; test with toothpick to be sure cake is done. Let cool in pan for 20 minutes before removing cake.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Pick chicken from bone; cube. Combine chicken Veg-All and soup. Put in pie crust and cover with remaining crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Fish In Herb Butter
instructions: Bake fish for about 5 minutes. Put mushrooms and green onions on top. Melt together in saucepan the margarine soy sauce oregano garlic salt and thyme. Pour the butter mixture on top of all. Make sure that the mushrooms are well basted then bake for about 8 minutes more at 400\u00b0 to 450\u00b0. If the fish are very thick add a couple of minutes to baking time before or after pouring on the sauce.

title: Italian Flat Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In small bowl combine mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese; stir in basil oregano green onions and garlic. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. On ungreased cookie sheets press or roll out each biscuit to 4-inch circle. Spread about 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture over each circle to within 1/4-inch of edge. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Veggie Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients except rolls in a bowl. Unroll crescent rolls in a rectangle. Overlap two rectangles and pinch seams. Spoon stuffing down middle of the two rectangles. Cut slits at 1-inch intervals along the sides of the rectangle. Braid slits over stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Jiffy Tater-Turkey Or Beef Casserole
instructions: Press meat (uncooked) into an 8-inch square pan. Season with salt pepper and onion. Pour on soup. Sprinkle peas over soup. Top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Applesauce Cake
instructions: Soak raisins in hot water drain on paper towel. Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy then beat in eggs then applesauce and vanilla. Mix and sift flour salt soda baking powder and spices. Stir into mixture. Add raisins and nuts and mix well. Bake in oblong pan (9 1/2 x 13 x 2-inch) at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool on rack frost if desired.

title: Blushing Betty
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and place in an oblong 12 x 8-inch pan. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs; beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla. Pour over rhubarb and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place chicken in bottom of baking dish. Drain mixed vegetables and cover chicken. Mix mushroom soup with broth and pour over vegetables. Mix Bisquick and milk to make thin batter and pour over chicken mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Microwave Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together ingredients and shape into loaf. Put in microwave dish. Put it in the microwave oven and put wax paper over it. Cook 8 minutes then take it out. Cut the meat loaf in two and put it back in the microwave oven and bake another 5 minutes.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Mix melted margarine flour and nuts. Press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Cool completely. Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar then stir in Cool Whip. Spread on crust then pour pie filling on top; place in fridge until firm.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Empty 2 cans of corn into baking dish. Make a white sauce with flour butter and milk. Add 2 beaten eggs. Add to corn and mix. Salt as desired about 1/2 teaspoon. If desired sprinkle a little grated cheese on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Place in dish of water to bake.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar and butter or margarine by hand like pie dough. Mix vanilla sour milk soda salt and egg with spoon. Bake in long pan. Take out 1 cup crumbs before you put liquid in. Beat with spoon. Spread crumbs on top. You may sprinkle with cinnamon if you wish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Hot Corny Cornbread
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients (dry) in bowl. Make well in middle; add next 4 ingredients (wet). Beat liquids well; widen strokes to include dry. Do not overmix (batter should be lumpy). Fold in last 4 ingredients. Pour into greased loaf pan or muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Stir boiling water and oatmeal together and let stand 20 minutes. Cream shortening with the sugars. Add eggs and beat in. Sift dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mixture. Add oatmeal and beat well. Bake in a greased and floured 9-inch square pan at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Frost with Coconut Topping.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Cook bacon slices and cut them up. Mix beans vinegar brown sugar and catsup in large bowl. Add hamburger and bacon pieces. Mix well. Spread in large casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Desire
instructions: Lightly grease or spray casserole dish. Place chicken in dish and cover with slices of Swiss cheese. Spread soup over cheese. Mix margarine and stuffing and put on top of soup. Bake 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Salad
instructions: Mix this all together.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix the first 9 ingredients and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the next 5 ingredients for the icing. Spread on after it has cooled.

title: Vegetable Bars
instructions: Press crescent rolls to cover the bottom of a 15 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool completely. Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and dressing mix until smooth. Spread on cooled crust. Sprinkle vegetables on filling. Press vegetables into filling slightly. Refrigerate and cut into bars. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Friendship Cake
instructions: Take starter juice and add 2 1/2 cups sugar and large can sliced peaches (juice too). Stir daily for 10 days. Then add 2 1/2 cups sugar and chunked pineapple. Stir daily for 10 days. Add 2 1/2 cups sugar maraschino cherries and fruit cocktail. Stir daily for 10 days. Drain juice from fruit.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 2 Tbsp juice. Combine brown sugar and butter in 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange pineapple slices in pan. Place a cherry half cut side up in center of each slice. Sprinkle with reserved juice and nuts.

title: Cucumber Slices
instructions: Mix water vinegar and salt. Bring to a boil. Put 1 head of dill and 1 section of garlic in each jar before cucumbers are added. Wash and slice cucumbers long way (about 1/4 or 1/2 inch slices). Place in jars and add boiling vinegar mixture. Seal jars. Yields 6 or 7 quarts.

title: Lemon Cooler
instructions: Melt butter; add flour and nuts. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Comfort Eggnog
instructions: Chill ingredients. Blend in punch bowl by beating; dust with nutmeg.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add salt. Pour into buttered casserole. Put frozen onion rings on meat. Drain beans; save the liquid. Spread beans on top of this. Mix liquid from beans with the can of chicken soup; pour over top. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cookie Cake
instructions: Place the sugar and flour in a mixing bowl. Place the water oil margarine and cocoa in a saucepan. Bring mixture in saucepan to a boil stirring constantly. Pour cooked mixture over flour and sugar. Beat well. Add the eggs and buttermilk. Add the vanilla; mix well. Pour into floured and greased sheet pan 1/2-inch deep. Cook in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Start topping 10 minutes before cake is done.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Mix together the oil sugar and eggs and add to dry ingredients. Blend well. Add carrots and nuts stirring to blend. Bake at 325\u00b0 in a greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Frost with cream cheese icing.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix everything together and refrigerate a few hours to allow flavors to blend.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Melt oil and butter in pan. Add onions. Stir well cover and cook stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. When onions are soft add sugar and salt. Increase heat for 2 minutes. Stir in flour and cook until golden brown. Pour in broth and wine with pepper. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Slice bread in half and toast on grill on both sides. Pile a little of cheese on each piece of toast and return to grill to melt. Add cognac to soup then float the toasted bread on top just before serving.

title: Crunchy Date Chewies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg almond extract and evaporated milk and beat well. Sift together and add flour soda baking powder and salt. Add to the batter. Mix a little and add nuts dates coconut oats and corn flakes. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 10 to 12 minutes. Let cool 2 minutes before removing from pan. Yield about 3 dozen.

title: 7 Layer Dip
instructions: Layer in glass casserole dish in order given. Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Lasagna
