instructions: Brown ground beef and garlic lightly in salad oil over medium heat. Add tomato sauce tomatoes and seasonings; simmer for 30 minutes. Cook noodles according to package leaving them slightly uncooked. Drain.

title: Southern Banana Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix oil and sugar. Add 2 eggs bananas and baking soda. Add vanilla and Bisquick. Grease and flour loaf pan and place mixture in 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 1 hour. Recipe can also be used for \magic muffins\.

title: Mother'S Noodle Pudding
instructions: Cook noodles to desired doneness as directed on package; drain. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Lightly grease 2-quart casserole. In large bowl combine cream cheese and margarine; blend well. Add sour cream cottage cheese salt sugar and eggs. Stir in noodles. Pour into prepared casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes or until set. Serve warm. Makes 12 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Microwave Beef Jerky With Fresh Ginger
instructions: Combine ginger honey sesame oil soy sauce wine garlic and cayenne. Add steak to marinade tossing to coat well. Marinate at room temperature tossing occasionally for 3 hours. Remove meat from marinade and arrange half the strips flat and close together on a microwave bacon rack. Cover with paper towels and cook on Medium-low 20 minutes. Rotate strips so that drier strips are in the center. Cover with fresh paper towel and cook on Medium-low for 15 to 20 minutes until meat is dry but slightly pliable. Remove to a large wire rack and let stand overnight. Repeat with remaining strips.

title: Pico De Gallo
instructions: Finely chop all ingredients and combine. If too spicy add fewer peppers.

title: Rex Jelly
instructions: Mix beet juice and Sure-Jell together and cook 1 minute. Add 2 boxes raspberry jello and sugar. Cook 6 minutes. Pour into hot sterilized jars. Yield 6 pints.

title: Date Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Blend date filling and water. Sift dry ingredients together. Add dry ingredients alternately with date mixture to butter mixture. Beat 1 minute. Add nuts. Pour into 2 prepared 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Melt margarine in iron skillet or baking dish.\tCombine all ingredients including the melted margarine from the skillet. Mix and pour into greased skillet. Bake 20 minutes or until brown at 450\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Boil chicken breasts and save broth. Cut up chicken into bite-size pieces. In 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish layer 1/2 of stuffing mix that has been mixed with melted butter. Next layer 1/2 of chicken. Mix 3/4 cup of broth to cream of chicken soup and pour this over 1st layer. Next layer remainder of chicken then mix 3/4 cup of broth to cream of mushroom soup and pour over top then layer remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Chicken Ala King
instructions: Dissolve bouillon in water. In saucepan melt butter; blend in flour. Add broth and stir. Cook until thick. Add remaining ingredients and cook until done. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Cook sliced zucchini chopped onion parsley and spices together (use big frying pan); really cooks down. Drain. Mix eggs and cheese together. Spread crescent roll dough in pie plate. Spread yellow mustard over dough. Mix zucchini mixture egg and cheese mixture; put in pie crust and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine brown sugar water and margarine; bring to a full boil. Boil 1 minute; set aside. Combine and mix together biscuit mix 1/4 cup brown sugar and raisins then add the milk. Spread in an 8 x 8-inch greased dish. Pour on the hot syrup. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot with ice cream.

title: Over The Rainbow Cookies
instructions: Allow dough to soften at room temperature. Divide dough into four equal parts. To first portion of dough add 2 drops blue food coloring; to second portion add 2 drops green coloring; to third portion add 2 drops red coloring and to fourth portion add 2 drops yellow coloring. On plastic wrap or waxed paper shape green dough into 8-inch log. Press dough slightly to flatten one side. Cover roll carefully with blue dough keeping semi-circular shape. Continue layering yellow and red doughs in same manner gently pressing layers of dough together. Wrap; chill until firm about 3 hours.

title: Polly Olson'S Tea Cookies(Polly Was Pastry Chef At Oviedo Inn, Oviedo, Florida)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream margarine and sugar together. Add vanilla and flour mixing well. Add soda and salt; mix well. Add nutmeg and eggs. Mix on medium speed until blended. Pour out on well floured table or board. Divide in half. Roll out 2 strips about 2 inches thick. Chill for about 2 hours. Cut into 1/4-inch thick slices and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven until light brown. Let cool before removing from cookie sheet.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream together sugar butter and cocoa then add the egg vanilla flour and nuts. Grease a deep 7-inch square pan and dust with flour. Spread the dough evenly in the pan and bake in an oven at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Grate cheese. Add butter. Let these reach room temperature. Cream with mixer; gradually add flour salt and pepper. Use star plate or cookie press to shape on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Yields 12 dozen.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch. Mash 1 cup berries. Add water to make 2 cups and stir into sugar mixture. Cook stir and boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter gelatin and lemon juice; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Chill until partially set. Pour 1/3 mixture in pie shell. Add whole berries and cover with remaining mixture. Chill and serve with whipped topping.

title: Beer Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt; add beer and mix well. Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs nuts dates and spices. Combine beer and flour mixture and mix well. Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool and put on icing.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Brown onion in oleo. Add soup and broth; mix well then add cheese and stir until cheese melts. Add chicken and salt (or season to your choice). Cook noodles 10 to 15 minutes. Pour chicken mixture over noodles or spaghetti and enjoy.

title: White Chile
instructions: Combine everything and simmer for 1-2 hours. Top with grated jack cheese before serving.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown sausages onion and celery. Drain well. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 in a covered container for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Sift flour and meal together. In a separate bowl beat egg; add buttermilk and oil. Pour liquid ingredients into bowl with dry ingredients. Stir good. Grease pan with Pam or margarine. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

title: Cajun Burgers
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Mix well. Form into patties. Broil fry or grill to desired doneness. Toast buns. Top each burger with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Doritos Dip
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients thoroughly. Spread on cookie sheet. Add choice of toppings. Serve with Doritos.

title: Flan
instructions: Place 1/4 cup of sugar in a saucepan and melt over low heat to caramelize. Sugar will liquify and turn light brown. Pour into a 1-quart baking dish and coat bottom.

title: Crabmeat Hors D'0Euvres
instructions: Mix all together. Spread on split English muffins. Freeze then cut into quarters. Broil (still frozen) until browned. Serve while still warm.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place raw chicken in Pam sprayed 9 x 13-inch dish. Top with other ingredients in order listed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered with foil. Remove foil last 10 minutes. Can easily be cut in half. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Powdered Sugar Balls
instructions: Blend together all but flour and nuts. Slowly add flour and nuts. Roll into small 1-inch balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while hot (the 1/2 cup listed goes into cookie dough).

title: Impossible Chicken Quiche
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Spread into greased deep dish pie pan. Combine the remaining ingredients in blender. Pour over the other mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Forgotten Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix soup and water. Put rice in bottom of pan and pour half soup mixture over rice. Put in chicken pieces and pour the rest of the soup over the chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix over top. Cover with foil and forget it for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Add flour soda and cinnamon (be sure to sift). Mix well and add carrots. Bake in 3 layers at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Devilish Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and beat at high speed for 5 minutes. Add chocolate. Sift flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternating and ending with ice water. Mix in vanilla. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with a fluffy white icing.

title: Spaghetti Au Gratin
instructions: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Saute onion with butter until soft. Add flour. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Gradually add 2 1/2 cups milk. Cook stirring constantly until sauce thickens and bubbles for 1 minute. Stir in salt pepper and mustard. Remove from heat and add 3/4 of the Parmesan cheese.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and pour off grease. Add onion garlic celery and bell pepper. Simmer until tender. Wash rice and add to mixture. Add soups and pour into baking dish. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 stirring occasionally.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients together in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. (Right in the pan not in a bowl!!) Now with your fingers or a spoon make three holes in the dry ingredients.

title: Orange-Glazed Carrots
instructions: Mix sugar salt flour and orange peel. Add orange juice and cook until thickened. Add margarine. Mix with cooked carrots. Serves about 10.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients adding a small amount of water to thick consistency. Drop in deep oil; cook in temperature of 375\u00b0.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Divide popcorn into two ungreased pans. Place butter brown sugar syrup and salt in saucepan. Cook until bubbly and then cook 5 more minutes. Remove from heat and add soda. Pour over popcorn and stir. Bake 1 hour; stir every 15 minutes.

title: Italian Corn And Rice Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the salsa tomato juice brown rice onion seasonings and 2 cups of water. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Choco-Crumble Bars
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt. Cut in butter. Mix and pat in pan. Bake \crust\ at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over baked crust. Refrigerate until \set.\ Cut into bars to serve.

title: Cranberry-Brandy Punch
instructions: To serve warm combine all ingredients in large saucepan or Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed; drain and mix with other ingredients except cheese. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish and top with cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted or browned. Makes 6 large servings.

title: Kraut Relish
instructions: Mix and store in refrigerator. Will keep for days. Very good.

title: Polish Rafts
instructions: Fry together meats drain off grease. Add in cheese and melt in with meat. Put on party rye and bake for about 20 minutes. Very Good Very Easy.

title: Mustard Steak
instructions: Lay steaks out. Season with salt and pepper. Spread mustard over meat. Top with chopped onion and press onion into meat with hand. Flour lightly and place in hot skillet with about 1/4 cup oil. Cook on medium heat until done. Turn once and brown other side. Serve on hot platter onion side up. Cook side with onion first.

title: Oven-Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions 1/4-inch thick and separate into rings. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick coating. In a small mixing bowl stir together bread crumbs melted margarine salt and if desired ground red pepper. Spread mixture on a sheet of waxed paper. Using a fork dip onion rings into egg whites then bread crumb mixture. Arrange in a single layer on prepared baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until onions are tender and coating is crisp and golden.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Boil vegetables in broth until tender. Cut bread into chunks. Crumble cornbread. Mix all ingredients together. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Spread on graham cracker crust. Spread 1 can cherry pie filling on top of this. Top with chopped nuts (optional). Refrigerate.

title: Corn Bread(60 Muffins)
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into hot greased 13 x 9 pan or muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Will make about 60 muffins.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Mash sweet potatoes. Add butter brown sugar milk salt and orange rind. With a tablespoon scoop up about 1/4 cup of mixture and shape around a marshmallow using more potato if needed to form a ball. Roll each ball in cornflakes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix Jell-O and cake mix. Add eggs 1 at a time. Add oil water and strawberries (save 1/4 or more berries for icing on cake). Cook layers in 3-inch cake pans. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake about 30 to 35 minutes. Cool cakes completely before icing.

title: Diabetic Reese'S Cups
instructions: Line a jelly roll pan with wax paper. Butter paper slightly. Melt chocolate in a double boiler until melted. Pour 1/2 of chocolate into pan to make a thin layer. Let cool until hard. Mix graham cracker crumbs and peanut butter (amount of each depends on your desires). Spread evenly over hardened chocolate. Pour remaining chocolate over peanut butter mixture. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all but cinnamon together. Put cinnamon on top. Serve with different fruit slices or strawberries.

title: Lavender Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In medium bowl cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs vanilla and lavender and mix well. Combine flour and baking powder; add to lavender mixture until well blended.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed on box. Remove from oven when done and poke holes all over it. Pour the milk and cream of coconut over and let soak in. When cool spread with whipped topping and sprinkle with coconut. Keep refrigerated.

title: Crabbies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for muffins. Spread on muffin halves (12 pieces). Broil until hot. Slice each muffin half into quarters.

title: Scallopini Chicken
instructions: Season flour with nutmeg salt and pepper. Dredge breasts in flour mixture then in eggs then bread crumbs and cheese which have been combined. Melt butter in a skillet and brown breasts on both sides. Continue cooking for about 5 minutes or until done. Yield 4 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine sugars milk and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter and dry ingredients. Drop teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Press with floured fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form into balls. Cook in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Red Tomato Relish
instructions: Bring all ingredients using as many hot peppers as desired to a boil. Reduce heat cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until desired thickness. Stir occasionally. Pour in 5 pint jars and seal.

title: Cornmeal Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook on griddle until golden brown.

title: Big Boy Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and gelatin; add water and lemon juice. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Cool. Fold in gently into 1 quart strawberries. Pour in 9-inch baked shell. Top with whipped cream.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients as listed.

title: Flat Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening together. Add buttermilk gradually; mix in salt and whole wheat flour. Sift remaining dry ingredients together add all at one time. Mix well. Roll out on a pastry cloth until almost paper thin. Place on a cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes or until brown and crisp.

title: Cheese Pudding
instructions: Soak bread in margarine. Add grated cheese milk pepper salt mustard and egg yolks. Mix together. Fold in egg whites into mixture. Pour into buttered dish. Chill 12 to 24 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients into mayonnaise. Mix in crab meat. Bake at 375\u00b0 until bubbly. Use crackers for dipping.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients thoroughly. Press in loaf or Bundt pan. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and drain off excess fat.

title: Caramel Corn(Cracker Jacks)
instructions: Bring all ingredients except popcorn and soda to a boil. Boil 5 minutes stirring often. Stir in soda quickly. Pour over popcorn and peanuts; stir well. Place in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Stir while cooling. Reduce salt to 1/2 teaspoon if no peanuts or salted peanuts are added.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Sift together flour and cocoa. Mix flour and cocoa mixture with sugar. Add milk and well beaten egg yolks. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Remove from heat; beat in butter or margarine; add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Using remaining egg whites make meringue and spread on top of pie. Let brown.

title: Maraschino Cherry Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar. Stir well and add shortening cherry juice cherries and milk. Beat for two minutes. Add egg whites; beat 2 minutes. Fold in walnuts. Pour mixture into 2 round waxed layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Many Ways Meatballs
instructions: Mix hamburger bread crumbs onion egg and salt. Shape into 24 meatballs. In skillet brown meatballs; pour off drippings. Stir in soup water and parsley. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes. Stir often. Can serve over mashed potatoes or noodles.

title: Ranch Beans
instructions: Cook bacon and onion. Drain fat. Use all juices from beans except yellow bean juice. Combine all ingredients and bake in 4-quart casserole at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Paul Henry'S Cheesecake
instructions: Mix and press into bottom and sides of spring-form pan.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cut zucchini like French fries. In frying pan fry zucchini with onions in butter. Place lid on pan and continue cooking until onions are tender. Add salt and pepper. Put zucchini mixture into a large casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Add the mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese cheddar cheese stuffing and sauce; mix well. Sprinkle some cheese on top and back at 375 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Toss to mix.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine flour and sugar. Heat butter cocoa and cola; bring to boil. Pour over mixture. Add buttermilk eggs baking soda vanilla and marshmallows; mix well. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Glaze Baked Ham
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Place ham fat side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Roast about 15 to 18 minutes per pound or until a meat thermometer registers 140\u00b0 about 4 to 4 3/4 hours. While ham is roasting mix orange marmalade corn syrup and dry mustard together. Remove ham from oven and cut off rind. Increase oven temperature to 375\u00b0. Score ham with a sharp knife making diagonal cuts 1/8-inch deep and about 3/4-inch apart in one direction and then in a crosswise direction. Stud ham with cloves and brush with some of the glaze. Bake 15 to 20 minutes basting frequently with more glaze until glaze is golden brown. Remove the ham to a warm serving platter. Serves 16 generously.

title: Ricotta Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Mix Ricotta sugar eggs and vanilla with mixer until blended. Grease and flour pan 9 x 13-inch. Pour batter in pan (cake). Top with Ricotta mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let cool; top with pie filling.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: In skillet heat corn oil over medium heat. Add beef; brown on all sides. Add next 4 ingredients and 4 cups of the water. Cover; bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add carrots and onions. Simmer 1/2 hour or until tender. Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup water. Stir into beef mixture. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Makes 6 servings.

title: Potatoes Parmesan
instructions: Cut peeled raw potatoes into bite sized pieces. Melt the margarine on a lipped cookie sheet. Combine in a bowl the cheese flour salt and pepper. Dip the pieces in the melted margarine. Coat with the cheese and flour mixture. Place coated pieces on cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until fork-tender.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pat into deep 9-inch pan. Place in refrigerator 1 hour before filling.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook noodles in water until done. While cooking mix together eggs milk and margarine in a bowl. Add salt and pepper. When noodles are ready put into a sheet cake pan or something similar and pour mixture of eggs milk and margarine over the top. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until completely cooked.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion in margarine until tender (about 10 minutes). Stir in parsley and seasonings.

title: Dried Tea Mix Lemon Allspice
instructions: Dry peel in 200\u00b0 oven. Mix ingredients and store in airtight jar.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar butter oatmeal and cinnamon. Press half of mixture into a greased baking pan. If desired reserve half of mixture for topping. Cover with rhubarb. Cook sugar cornstarch water and vanilla. Pour over rhubarb. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Serve warm topped with whipped cream if desired. Yield 9 to 12 servings.

title: Doris' Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar eggs oil oleo and vanilla thoroughly. Add sifted flour soda baking powder and salt. Mix well with creamed mixture. Add corn flakes oatmeal coconut and nuts. Blend well. Drop by teaspoon or roll into balls and press with fork. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 15 dozen.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs. Add apples raisins and nuts. Mix thoroughly. Add soda salt cinnamon and vanilla. Stir in flour until batter is very stiff. Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crawfish Imperial
instructions: In large skillet saute onions bell peppers garlic and celery until tender in about 1/2 cup of butter flavored Crisco. Add about 1/4 cup flour to thicken. Add parsley flakes tomatoes tomato sauce and crawfish. Lower heat and cook covered for 30 minutes to an hour. When ready to serve stir in Cheez Whiz. Serve over rice.

title: Fresh Fruit Ice Cream
instructions: In 2-quart ice cream freezer container combine all ingredients; mix well. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions.

title: Dressing For Spinach Salad
instructions: Cut up spinach in a bowl. Combine above ingredients. Pour over spinach. You can add bacon and boiled eggs if desired.

title: Pork Tenderloin Stuffed With Sausage
instructions: Trim all fat from the loin. Cut a slit down the middle of the loin and season to taste. Stuf loin with sausage and secure with toothpicks. Add butter to a 12-inch skillet and heat until butter foams. Brown loin in butter approximately 5 minutes on each side. Remove loin to a baking dish. To the remaining butter add onions and water. Reduce on medium heat about 8 minutes. Pour sauce over loin and cover with foil. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours or until loin is tender. Bake uncovered for last 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken without salt. Take meat off bones. Melt margarine; stir into dressing mix. Grease large dish and put a layer of dressing crumbs and a layer of chicken layer of chicken soup mixed with 1 can of chicken broth. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and sour cream. Add remaining ingredients. Serve with crackers.

title: Butterfinger Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed. Cool. Make holes in top of cake and pour butterscotch topping over cake (reserve 1/8 of jar to drizzle over icing). Ice cake with Cool Whip. Crumble Butterfingers and sprinkle over Cool Whip. Drizzle remaining butterscotch topping over this. Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Italian Tomato Salad
instructions: Cut tomatoes about 1-inch thick. Dice onions. Slice green and yellow peppers. Mix with Italian dressing.

title: Cheesy Gravy
instructions: In saucepan combine all ingredients. Heat until cheese melts stirring constantly. Serve over chicken or mashed potatoes. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Mocha Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs one at a time. Measure dry ingredients into a bowl then sift. Blend dry ingredients with the creamed mixture (spoon works best; batter is very thick at this point). Add vanilla and sour cream mixing until thoroughly blended. Spoon into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan spreading evenly. Bake about 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan and tester comes out of the center clean. Let cake stand in pan for 10 minutes before inverting pan on a rack to remove cake. Cut into thin slices.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Line casserole pan with sliced potatoes. Spread meat over potatoes then other ingredients. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Maple Chicken Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut off chicken wing tips and snip the skin between the joints. Place in a disposable large baking pan. Add the maple syrup soy sauce teriyaki sauce garlic garlic powder onion powder and pepper toss to coat.

title: Toasted Pecan Pudding
instructions: In a medium bowl combine butter coconut flour pecans and sugar. Spread into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned stirring occasionally. Cool.

title: Brownie Pudding
instructions: Sift together flour sugar cocoa powder and salt. Add milk salad oil water and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Mix together brown sugar and cocoa; sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except grated cheese). Bake in greased casserole dish 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with grated cheese and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Mediterranean Pilaf
instructions: Bring broth and water to a boil in a saucepan. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 19 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Yields 4 cups. Serving size is 1/2 cup.

title: Block Party Beans
instructions: In a large Dutch oven brown beef over medium heat. Drain fat. Add onion and celery. Cook until tender. Stir in soup tomato paste and ketchup. Simmer 15-20 minutes. Spoon into a large kettle or roaster. Add all remaining ingredients; stir well. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield about 25 servings.

title: After Christmas Salad
instructions: Toss meat and macaroni together until blended. Add remaining ingredients mixing well after each addition. Serve on crisp lettuce leaves.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco until soft then add eggs and sugar; mix well. Add cake flour and milk; mix until well blended then add the vanilla orange and butter flavorings. Make sure everything is mixed well together. Pour batter into a Bundt cake pan and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 1 hour.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve with crackers.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Mix crumbs and melted margarine and pack into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Layer the remaining in order given coconut chocolate chips butterscotch chips and chopped pecans. Pour Eagle Brand milk over layers and bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Tamale Corn
instructions: Mix chilies and grated cheese. Mix eggs creamed corn cornmeal garlic baking powder and oil. Place all of corn mixture in baking dish then layer with cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Layered Potato Salad
instructions: In large glass bowl layer a third of the cabbage and a third of the potatoes. Next layer a third of the onion rings pepper rings and egg slices. Cover completely with mayonnaise. Repeat layers twice always ending with egg and mayonnaise. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Jelly
instructions: *Note Wear gloves (rubber) when working with jalapeno peppers!

title: Tuna Vegetable Souffle
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Prepare 4 servings mashed potatoes (omit butter). Fold in mayonnaise. Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat until fluffy. Stir into vegetable mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in. Pour into greased 2 quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife comes out clean. Serve at once.

title: Ho-Bo Steaks
instructions: Make ground beef into round patties. Place on foil-lined sheet. Top each patty with salt pepper and one slice of onion. Place potatoes and carrots on and around. Cover cookie sheet with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: * Elephant Stew *
instructions: Cut elephant into 1-inch cubes frequently adding pinches of salt and pepper (this should take approximately 72 days). Add enough gravy to cover. Cook over kerosene fire about 4 weeks at 465\u00b0. If more than 3800 people are expected 2 rabbits may be added but do this only if necessary as most people do not like to find hare in their stew.

title: Weight Watchers Stir-Fried Cabbage
instructions: In 10-inch nonstick skillet heat margarine over high until bubbly and hot. Add celery and cook stirring quickly and frequently for 1 minute. Add cabbage bell pepper and onion; continue to stir-fry until vegetables are tender-crisp 2 to 3 minutes. Add soy sauce and pepper. Stir well. Cook for 1 minute longer. Makes 4 servings. Each serving provides 1 3/4 vegetable exchange 1/2 fat exchange. Per serving contains 40 calories 1 g protein 2 g fat 5 g carbohydrate 33 mg calcium 508 mg sodium and 0 mg cholesterol.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Put some meat in barbecue sauce and put some corn and fire on it.

title: 9 Day Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage pepper and onions. Heat remaining ingredients and bring to full boil over high heat stirring. Pour over cabbage mixture. Let cool. Cover and store in refrigerator. Will keep for days.

title: Icebox Pie
instructions: You can use orange juice and orange jello to make an orange pie.

title: Old-Fashioned Biscuit Pudding
instructions: Crumble biscuits into bowl. Add cocoa and milk. Let soak about 30 minutes or until biscuits are soft. Add sugar and eggs. Mix thoroughly.

title: Diet Jello Salad
instructions: Pour the pineapple over any flavor Jell-O. Stir until Jell-O is melted. Add cottage cheese. Stir until blended then blend in the whipped topping. Stir until completely mixed. Pour into any container with a lid and store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Keeps good. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in the boiling water. Add the cold water pineapple juice lemon juice and almond extract. Place punch into a plastic gallon ice cream bucket and freeze. Thaw 4 to 6 hours and place into punch bowl. Add the 7-Up and serve. Makes 1 1/2 gallons of delicious punch.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine and peanut butter together. Add eggs sugar vanilla Karo and soda. Stir in oatmeal and candies last. Bake at 375\u00b0. Make the cookies large. Serves 150.

title: Buttermilk Bread
instructions: Mix in a bowl dates sugar butter and boiling water. Stir until the butter melts. Cool. Stir in egg baking soda flour salt and chopped nuts. Put in a buttered loaf pan 9 x 5-inches. Bake about 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Salmon Croquets
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Take large amounts of mixture and form cakes. Place in hot oil and fry until brown.

title: Russian Tea Ball Cookies
instructions: Shape in balls after baking roll in powdered sugar while hot then when cold. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fried Rabbit
instructions: Rabbits to fry must be young or parboiled. Cut into joints; soak for an hour in salt and water. Dip in beaten egg then in powdered cracker and fry brown in sweet lard or butter. Serve with onion sauce; garnish with sliced lemon.

title: Asparagus Tomato Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs with next 4 ingredients. Stir in cheese. Chop 4 asparagus spears into 1-inch lengths and lay them in bottom of pie shell. Pour in egg mixture. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven and quickly arrange tomato and the other 6 asparagus spears on top. Bake another 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Country Ribs And Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown ribs on both sides in large skillet. Spread kraut over the ribs. Sprinkle brown sugar over the sauerkraut. Pour water slowly over all. Put lid on and cook over low to medium heat for 50 to 60 minutes or until tender. Spoon the brown juices over the kraut and serve.

title: Cheese Crackers
instructions: Mix cheese and margarine. Add flour and Rice Krispies. Mixture will be dry and will have to be kneaded like biscuit dough. Drop 1/2 teaspoon cookies on cookie sheet and press with a fork. Bake 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Frozen Punch(Beverage)
instructions: Mix and freeze. Remove from freezer 1 1/2 to 2 hours before serving. Will be a slush type punch.

title: Southern Fried Okra
instructions: Wash and cut okra into 1/2-inch slices cutting across as you cut through the cut pieces into a large mixing bowl. The cut okra will have a slimy feeling to it. For about every 3 cups of cut okra youll want to add 1 egg; stir well. Okra should be well coated with egg.

title: 3-Step White Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla with electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs; mix until blended. Stir in 1/3 C. of the white chocolate.

title: Grandmother'S Oatmeal Pie(1930)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Ramen Noodle Vegetable Salad
instructions: In a bowl break up uncooked Ramen noodles. Do not use the seasoning packet. In a saucepan cook vegetables until tender. Drain and rinse in cold water. Blend into Ramen noodles. Pour over Italian dressing and stir. Refrigerate for at least 5 hours before serving.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Crumble Ritz crackers on top and melt 1 stick of margarine; pour over topping. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet  And Sour Sauce For Wings
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cornstarch and bring to a boil. Mix the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water then add to mixture for thickening. Serve over cooked chicken wings.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients in a heavy skillet stirring constantly for 3 minutes on medium heat. Add vanilla Rice Krispies and nuts. Cool and form into small balls. Roll in coconut.

title: Best Bean Soup(Serves 8)
instructions: Place beans in a large pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil and boil 1 hour. Drain and discard water. Add 8 cups of water and the rest of ingredients then simmer for 2 hours over very low heat.

title: Hamburger Mazetti
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Cook beef onion celery green peppers salt and pepper. Spoon off fat or drain on paper towels. Place noodles in casserole dish; toss with butter. Stir in meat mixture with cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Just For Kids: Kassie'S Kandi-Bar Surprise
instructions: Place a 4-square portion of milk chocolate bar on 1 graham cracker. Place 2 marshmallows on long fork. Roast slowly over open fire or coals. Let brown gradually so the center will melt. With a spoon move the toasted marshmallows off the fork onto the chocolate. Top with another graham cracker. Squeeze together.

title: Apricot Brandy Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze until ready to serve.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Place chicken with water to cover in pot; add granules. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and cook until done. Let cool in broth then remove skin and bones and fat. Pull chicken into pieces of desired size.

title: Beef Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion in oil. Add pepper corn beans and seasoning. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Pour into baking dish. Add tomatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheesy Veggie Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and warm over low heat stirring often. Serve over vegetables and baked potatoes. Makes 1 cup.

title: Choco Butternut Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl beat margarine and brown sugar. Add vanilla; mix well. In medium bowl combine cereal and flour. Add cereal mixture to margarine mixture. Add pecans and mix thoroughly. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 17 minutes. Let cool 2 minutes on cookie sheet. Remove to cool on wire racks. If desired roll in powdered sugar while still warm and again when cool. Makes 3 dozen. Enjoy.

title: Mama Springer'S Homemade Bread
instructions: In large bowl sift 6 cups of flour. Add salt. Mix with wire beater. In small bowl place margarine and 3 cups flour. Mix together with wire food cutter. Save water from potatoes you cook to eat. Small pieces of potatoes left in water is okay. Heat potato water and add sugar. Cool to 100\u00b0. At 100\u00b0 add yeast. Mix well with wire beater. Add potato water with sugar and yeast to large bowl with 6 cups of flour. Mix well then add contents of small bowl. Mix together well. (You will need to add more sifted flour now and then.) Work well with hands until it molds together.

title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix cake mix oil and eggs. Add chocolate chips and drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Welcome Home Frances Potluck Carrots
instructions: Using coarsest disk in food processor chunk carrots. Add 1/4 cup water and cook in microwave on High 3 minutes or until tender-crisp. Stir carrots cooking liquid and all with the mayonnaise onion horseradish salt and pepper. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with crumbs and dot with margarine. Sprinkle with parsley and paprika. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Rhubarb And Strawberry Pie
instructions: Let stand 15 minutes. Pour into pie crust. Sprinkle with butter. Put topping on it. Put Reynolds Wrap around pie crust and cook at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Take off wrap and bake another 25 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Glazed Nuts
instructions: Mix egg white and water. Whip until frothy. Add cinnamon sugar and salt. Then add nuts or pecans. Spread on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Toss every 15 minutes.

title: Baked Rice Pudding
instructions: Add a jar of cooked prunes with the pits removed to a 6 ounce package of Jell-O dissolved in the proper amount of water (according to directions on Jell-O box). Let it set while chilling. Beat heavy cream (1/2 pint) and sweeten to taste. Beat Jell-O mixture and cream together and serve or keep chilled until serving time.

title: Cheese Salsa Dip
instructions: Mix salsa and eggs together. Combine cheeses. Put half of cheese mixture in bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan. Pour egg mixture over cheese. Top with remaining cheese. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut in squares and serve with Town House crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Sift sugar milk and cocoa. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Blend well. Add water until you can form in ball. Roll in coconut. Chill.

title: Golden Granola
instructions: Combine all ingredients except raisins in an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan or 3-quart microwave casserole dish. Mix well. Bake in a conventional oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Or microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes stirring every 2 minutes. Stir in raisins. Cool thoroughly. Store in tightly covered container in cool dry place.

title: Donuts
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Add milk then flour sifted with salt baking powder and spices. Roll out on floured surface 3/8-inches; cut with doughnut cutter. Let stand 15 minutes. Fry in deep hot Crisco (375\u00b0); drain on paper towels. Makes 3 dozen. Can ice if desired.

title: Noodle Lasagna
instructions: Pour spaghetti sauce and water into large pot. Bring to a full boil. Stir in noodles; cover and cook 7 minutes stirring occasionally until noodles are barely tender. Blend ricotta cheese with seasonings and egg. In greased 9 inch square pan alternate layers of noodles/sauce with ricotta cheese and mozzarella cheese ending with noodles in sauce for top layer. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes and let stand 15 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Party Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Drain pineapple reserving 1/2 cup syrup. Add to gelatin mixture; mix well. Chill until thickened. Fold in cottage cheese Cool Whip pineapple cherries and almonds. Pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or individual molds. Chill until firm. Unmold. Serve on lettuce leaf with mayonnaise and shredded cheese if desired.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and butter in mixer. Add beaten eggs. Dissolve baking soda in sour milk and add to first mixture.\tAdd bananas nuts vanilla and salt in flour. Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour then cover it with foil and bake another 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool 10 to 15 minutes before shaking pan gently to loosen loaf from pan edges. Leave in pan another 10 to 15 minutes before removing and cooling on a wire rack.

title: Fried Donuts
instructions: Take biscuits and flatten each one. Cut biscuits into fours and roll into a ball. Heat oil in frying pan under light fire. Place biscuits in oil cook until golden brown on each side. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with sugar. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Orange Candy Slice Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add 1 cup buttermilk. Beat well. Add soda to the other half cup buttermilk. Add to mixture. Combine dry ingredients. Add orange slices halved. Add dates and nuts. Blend well. Line tube pan with well-greased brown paper. Bake slowly at 275\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Waffles
instructions: Mix all together in bowl.

title: Chicken With Dill Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Halve cutlets and pound to 1/4-inch thick. Dredge in flour seasoned with 1 tablespoon dill weed and salt and pepper to taste. Heat a 10-inch skillet and add 2 tablespoons butter. Saute chicken until golden on both sides. Remove chicken to an ovenproof pan and cover with foil. Bake for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain vegetables corn and beans. Add soup sour cream onion pepper and celery. Mix these ingredients in a baking dish. Dot with butter salt and pepper. Sprinkle cheese on top of mixture. Mix margarine and crackers together and sprinkle over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Meal In A Skillet
instructions: Combine meat bread crumbs 1 teaspoon salt and pepper; brown in a heavy skillet stirring frequently. Cover with corn and onions. Sprinkle with 3/4 teaspoon salt. Add tomatoes and do not stir. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Thumb Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add flour and vanilla; beat well. Shape dough in balls size of a marble. Place on lightly greased baking sheet and make a hole in the middle with thumb. Fill hole with preserves or jelly. Pull dough up around the filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove promptly and cool on wire rack.

title: Pink Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix thawed lemonade milk and Cool Whip. Pour into crust and chill until firm.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Simmer chicken in water to cover until tender. Bake pork until done at 325\u00b0. Shred meat with fingers into smallest possible pieces discarding skin fat and bones. Combine in large heavy pot with vegetables and reserved chicken broth. Simmer 6 to 8 hours until thickened. As stew thickens season to taste with all other ingredients. The secret is in long slow simmering.

title: Mexican Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 12-inch pizza pan. Mix Bisquick cornmeal and 1/2 cup water until dough forms. Beat vigorously 20 strokes. Put in pan with floured hands forming 1/2-inch rim. Bake 10 minutes. Cook beef until brown; drain. Stir in chilies taco mix and 3/4 water. Heat to boiling. Stir frequently; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered stirring frequently until thick 5 to 10 minutes. Spread beans over baked crust top with beef mix and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 minutes longer. Top with lettuce onion and tomatoes.

title: Tangy Lemon Frosting
instructions: Mix together the shortening salt 1 cup sugar and lemon peel. (Eight to 10 drops of yellow food coloring can be added if desired.) Add lemon juice water and remaining sugar and mix until smooth and creamy.

title: Indian Curried Beans
instructions: Heat oil in a nonstick frying pan. Add garlic ginger and chopped onion and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Add diced tomatoes and cook 10 minutes stirring frequently. Add curry powder and prepared beans. Bring mixture to a boil and cook on medium heat for 10 more minutes. Garnish with Garam Masala and finely chopped cilantro.

title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
instructions: Place chicken into bowl. Pour buttermilk over; marinate 1 hour. In another bowl mix flour parsley oregano salt and pepper. Remove the chicken from buttermilk; roll chicken pieces in seasoning mixture. Reserve the buttermilk and pour into buttered casserole. Heat shortening and margarine in heavy skillet; fry chicken just until brown. Remove scrape up brownings and add chicken broth. Cook for 2 minutes. Place chicken on top of buttermilk in casserole. Pour all your scraped up brownings over the chicken. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven until tender about 1 hour. Makes 4 servings.

title: Rich Coconut Cream Pie By Wanda Smith
instructions: Mix sugar salt and cornstarch in saucepan. Stir in egg yolks. Turn heat on medium and slowly stir in milk. Boil over medium heat stirring constantly. When mixture thickens remove from heat and add butter coconut and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Chill for 2 hours. Add meringue or whipped topping and sprinkle with 1/4 cup coconut.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Tie all spices except nutmeg in a cheesecloth bag. Heat cider and brown sugar together; add spice bag and let simmer about 10 minutes. Remove bag and serve with dash of nutmeg in each mug. Makes 7 cups.

title: No-Cook Fruit Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl; let stand for a few minutes. Add remaining ingredients stir well. Pour batter into a greased 10-inch tube pan packing mixture with hands a small amount at a time. Store in refrigerator until serving time. Yield 12 to 16 servings.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms. Take center of mushroom and cut up sausage and mix. Add Parmesan cheese. Stuff mushroom with mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chopped Steaks And Gravy
instructions: Spray baking dish with vegetable spray. Mix thoroughly in small bowl flour and Tony Chacheres seasoning. In large skillet heat enough oil to barely cover bottom. Flour one steak at a time by lightly shaking side to side. Turn steak flour other side. Shake off excess. Brown on both sides. Place in baking dish. Put onion soup mix on top. Cover with water. Cover with foil tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Cook beets until tender; skin and slice. Mix vinegar sugar and water; bring to a boil. Add sliced beets. Return to a boil; cook 3 to 5 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix beans and both soups into a baking dish cover with onion rings then cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook tomatoes onions celery and peppers until soft. Press through a food mill or sieve. Cook on high until it starts to thicken. Add remaining ingredients and cook on low until thick. Stir frequently. Do not let it stick to the bottom of the pot. When sauce is as thick as you like remove the bay leaf and let it cool. When cooled enough put in refrigerator for 2 days. It is now ready to use. Just add meat or freeze some. Makes about 3 quarts.

title: Meat Loaf With Glazed Onions
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Work together beef pork 1 teaspoon salt pepper onions catsup egg milk and crumbs. Shape into a loaf; place in a 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Arrange onions in a 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt; cover onions. Bake meat loaf and onions 1 hour. Remove both from oven. Sprinkle onions with sugar. Return to oven uncovered for 5 minutes. Arrange meat and onions on warm serving platter.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Brown in hot fat the pork and onion. Add celery green pepper rice stock salt pepper and soy sauce. Cover and simmer 40 minutes. Uncover last 10 minutes. Serve hot in shallow bowls. Serves 6.

title: Zesty Snack Mix
instructions: In large bowl combine popcorn and nuts. Set aside. In small bowl combine margarine mustard and salad dressing mix. Pour over popcorn mixture tossing to coat well. Spread in 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes stirring after 10 minutes. Remove from oven; stir in raisins. Spread on paper towel to cool. Store in airtight container. Yields 6 cups.

title: Hamburger Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add soy sauce for flavor. Feeds 4 people well.

title: Cranberry Sangria
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill at least 3 hours. Yield 2-1/2 quarts.

title: Pumpkin Bread (Caribbean)
instructions: Beat together brown sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each addition. Mix in vanilla extract. Sift all dry ingredients together and beat into the batter gradually alternating with the coconut milk until smooth. Stir in pumpkin puree with a wooden spoon and fold in nuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured loaf pans and set on middle rack of 350\u00b0 oven until bread tests done. Cool in pans on rack for about 30 minutes then unmold on rack and cool completely. Good warm with butter.

title: Belgium Waffles
instructions: Mix flour and sugar in a large bowl. Make a well in the center of this mixture. Mix eggs separately. Put eggs vanilla and melted margarine in the well. Stir well. Scoop approximately 1 teaspoon of batter in each square of waffle iron. Using medium setting cook until lightly browned. If cookies tend to dry out place a slice of bread inside container.

title: Oven-Fried Vegetables(Low-Fat)
instructions: Spray cold baking sheet with nonstick spray. Set aside. In a 9-inch pie plate stir together bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and paprika until well mixed. In a mixing bowl place vegetables. Drizzle vegetables with salad dressing. Toss until coated. Roll in crumb mixture. Place vegetables in single layer on baking sheet. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 9 to 11 minutes. Makes 4 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Maraschino Splash
instructions: Combine everything but the maraschino cherry in a shaker and shake until well combined. Pour in a tall glass and add the cherry.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix the potatoes vanilla milk and eggs. Place in baking dish. Stir the margarine sugar and flour to make a topping. Add the pecans (1 cup) on top and bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: White Clam Sauce Over Linguine
instructions: In saucepan heat oil and garlic; saute for 2 minutes. Stir in flour and clam juice wine red pepper flakes and salt. Bring to boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Add minced clams baby clams and parsley. Return to boil and remove from heat. Cook linguine according to package and then serve with sauce.

title: Grandmother'S Brown Beans
instructions: Soak the beans in hot water for 10 minutes. Bring to boil 4 cups of water. Add the bacon or ham hock; add beans. Boil for 3 hours. Lower flame; cook until juice thickens.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Place lettuce in oblong dish. Sprinkle celery over lettuce then onions peppers eggs peas and bacon bits. Spread mayonnaise over all these ingredients. Sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Angel Sweets
instructions: Sift the sugar. Melt chocolate and butter over low heat. Remove from heat; blend in egg. Stir in sugar nuts and marshmallows blending well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in coconut. Chill. Makes about 48.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Mix the 3 ingredients. Serve with apple slices.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Cook ziti. Saute sausage. Drain fat. Saute onion and pepper. Mix sausage cheese onion and pepper with ziti. Pour on a jar of spaghetti sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Miracle Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Make 3/4-inch balls and flatten with a floured fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 on an ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes. Cool completely before removing. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix sugar mustard salt vinegar and lemon juice. Add onion juice and stir thoroughly. Add salad oil slowly beating constantly and continue to beat until thick. Add poppy seed and beat for a few minutes. Store in a cool place or refrigerator.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: In a large bowl lay your lettuce celery onion and peas. Spread mayonnaise. Sprinkle peas with sugar and cheese. Cover airtight. Refrigerate several hours. Before serving toss. Garnish with tomato and croutons.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole. Mix everything together at once and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in salt water; drain. Melt margarine in pan. Add flour and blend. Add milk gradually. Stir in cheese. Cook until smooth and thick. Alternate cabbage and cheese sauce in dish. Top with buttered bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Spread hash browns over 1 stick melted oleo in a baking dish. Mix soup sour cream onions cheese salt and pepper. Spread over hash browns. Mix corn flakes with 1/3 stick oleo and spread over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cumin And Cayenne Spiced Cashews
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Whisk egg white with 1 tablespoon water until foamy. Add cashews and toss until coated. Strain nuts; shake and drain for 2 minutes. Wipe out bowl and add remaining ingredients. Add nuts and toss until coated. Spread nuts on a large baking sheet in a single layer and bake for 40 minutes. Stir with a spatula and reduce temperature to 200\u00b0. Bake 30 minutes longer until dry. Use spatula to loosen from sheet. Let dry completely and store in an airtight container up to 1 week.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Mix cherry pie filling and cherries in ungreased square baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Spread evenly. Mix baking mix nuts sugar and cinnamon. Cut in margarine until crumbly; sprinkle over cherry mixture. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until brown about 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: No Bake Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping; blend well. Spoon into crust. Chill until set at least 4 hours. Spoon pie filing over top of pie.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo; stir in eggs and pumpkin and blend in dry ingredients alternately with water. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into 2 greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pans. Bake about 70 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done when tested in the middle with toothpick.

title: Yum-Yum Pie
instructions: Combine graham crackers nuts and vanilla. Add egg whites and sugar. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chewy Macaroon Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat egg yolks and salt together. Add sugar 1/2 at a time. Blend well. Beat in milk butter lemon juice and almond extract. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold egg whites and coconut in egg yolk mixture. Pour filling into frozen pie shell. Bake 35 minutes.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Mix okra green tomatoes Jiffy mix and flour. Put in skillet with hot oil and turn down heat. Stir frequently to keep from scorching.

title: Piglickin' Cake
instructions: Mix together the above ingredients and bake according to box.

title: Easy Boston Cream Pie
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. When cool cut into small squares. Mix pudding as directed on box. Pour pudding over cake and garnish with nondairy topping. If you like add cherries.

title: Granola
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl; mix well. Spread in large shallow pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir often as it browns and burns easily. Serve \as is\ with milk or use in cookies and bread.

title: Old Fashioned Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix sugar with rhubarb. Mix eggs with sugar and rhubarb. Mix all other dry ingredients and add to mixture. Turn into 9-inch pastry shell and bake in oven preheated to 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0. Continue baking until done. Cool and add meringue and brown.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in greased pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar margarine syrup vanilla flour salt and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Quiche
instructions: Mix together cream milk eggs mustard and pepper. Meanwhile cook bacon. Break up bacon and put in bottom of pie shell. Spread cheese on top of bacon. Pour egg mixture over top of cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes to an hour. Put knife between center and edge to check if done. It should be fairly clean. During last 15 minutes add strips of bacon to top of quiche if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Puffs
instructions: Combine first three ingredients. Cut cookies in half. Fill and put together making a mini cream puff.

title: Seafood Linguine
instructions: Heat oil saute chopped garlic. Toss in seafoods and saute for 3 to 5 minutes. Add\twine half and half lemon wedge parsley and cheese. Heat linguine and arrange seafood on top. Serve with garlic toast.

title: Sugarless Cranberry Sauce
instructions: In medium-sized saucepan combine rinsed cranberries orange juice and water. Stir over medium heat until berries pop. Add chopped oranges and rind. Cook 3 to 5 minutes longer. Makes 3 1/2 to 4 cups. Rich in vitamin C and delicious!

title: Beef Stroganoff (Governor Jim Guy Tucker'S Favorite Recipe)(Grandma'S Recipe)
instructions: Trim fat from beef and cut filet crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices. Cut each slice across grain into 1/2-inch wide strips (about 2 inches long). Slowly heat large heavy skillet. Melt 1 tablespoon butter; add beef strips just enough to cover skillet bottom. Over high heat sear quickly on all sides. Remove with tongs as meat finishes browning (it should be brown on outside and rare on inside).

title: Pina Colada Muffins
instructions: Beat egg slightly in medium bowl with fork. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened. Bake in greased muffin tins or use cupcake papers at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Date Loaf Candy
instructions: Cook milk sugar and butter to soft ball stage. Remove from heat; stir in chopped dates nuts and vanilla. Beat until too heavy to move spoon. Turn out on cloth sprinkled with 1/2 cup powdered sugar mixed with 2 tablespoons cornstarch. Roll firmly into a roll (like sausage). Refrigerate until easy to slice.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Pour mixture over potatoes and stir.

title: Chicken And Leeks
instructions: Boil and debone chicken. Cut leeks up to dark green then cut light green part of stem into 1/2 to 1-inch pieces. Cut those pieces in half lengthwise and rinse. Flake or pull apart leaves and put in frying pan along with oil and garlic. Saute until soft. Add chicken salt pepper and nutmeg. Warm chicken. Add cream and cook until cream is \saucy\ 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar; mix well. Add 2 eggs and the vanilla; mix well. Stir in flour; mix well until mixture is stiff. Add chocolate chips; mix well. Place teaspoonfuls of mix onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Combine and chill. Yield Approximately 1 pint.

title: A. R. P. Punch
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in a gallon jar and mix. Add water to fill jar. Chill. When ready to serve add chilled ginger ale. I add green food coloring.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients for meatballs except for Worcestershire sauce. Roll into small balls and place on a cookie sheet. Color meatballs with Worcestershire sauce. Bake until crisp at 500\u00b0 and drain grease.

title: Easy Potato Soup
instructions: Melt margarine in microwave bowl. Blend in flour with whisk until smooth. Gradually add milk and continue to blend well. Add other ingredients and microwave on High about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender stirring every 5 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Combine flour and soda and sift into creamed mixture. Add vanilla and nuts and mix. Add mashed bananas. Pour into 2 greased (or spray with Pam) loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour half of the batter into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove and set aside to cool.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain grease. Spread refried beans in bottom of casserole dish. Mix salsa with hamburger; pour over refried beans. Cover with Saran wrap and microwave 4 minutes. Add cheese; cover and microwave 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Spread sour cream on top. Add garnishes of your choice and serve with tortilla chips and lettuce.

title: Hawaiian Banana Bread
instructions: Cream margarine with sugar and eggs. Add milk and mashed bananas. Sift flour soda and baking powder together. Add 1/2 to 1 cup chopped nuts if desired. Combine with creamed mixture and mix well. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus layer in casserole dish; asparagus soup bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly and crumbs are browned.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Trifle
instructions: Mix cream cheese milk sugar and Cool Whip. Mix until smooth and fluffy. Break cake in small pieces and place in bottom of pan. Spread with filling then add more cake pieces. Top with fruit filling and refrigerate overnight or until set.

title: Tuna Shortcake
instructions: In a saucepan combine all ingredients. Heat stirring often. Thicken if necessary. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Gooey Cheesecake
instructions: Mix well. Spread dough in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Mix butter milk salt and pepper. Add Cheez Whiz Velveeta Cheddar and Worcestershire sauce. Heat until cheese is melted. Add sliced eggs and mushrooms. Serve over toasted English muffins and sliced Canadian bacon.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion\ttogether. Mash; add margarine eggs and soup in dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Add cheese and crackers. Return to oven to brown.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and eggs then add oil and blend well. Add pumpkin; mix well. Sift dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture. Add water. Beat well and pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Add pudding mix. Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook cornstarch sugar and water until thick. Cool slightly; add gelatin. Set aside. Cover bottom of pie shell with strawberries. Add gelatin mixture. Top with whipped cream. Chill.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Whip all ingredients with mixer. Place in medium bowl and refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes. This salad adds a spark to any meal.

title: Cream Mints
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Add sugar a little at a time until mixture is stiff enough to knead. Knead until smooth and creamy. Roll into small balls and roll in fine coconut. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Marble Loaf Cake
instructions: Stir the shortening to soften. Gradually add sugar and cream together until light and fluffy. Add vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and salt together 3 times; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk a small amount at a time. Beat until smooth after each addition. Fold in egg whites. Combine chocolate water and soda; add to 1/2 the batter. Alternate light and dark batters by spoonfuls in paper-lined 10 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 60 minutes. Cool and frost with creamy chocolate frosting.

title: Cabbage Beef Soup
instructions: Cook the cabbage in a large pan. Fry hamburger and onion together. Add tomatoes red beans and other ingredients. Simmer.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese peanut butter powdered sugar milk and whipped cream together. Spoon the mixture into the pie crust. Drizzle chocolate sauce over the top. Refrigerate.

title: Butterscotch Pecan Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease 12 cup Bundt pan. Spread pecans on bottom of pan. Place frozen rolls as evenly as possible in pan. Sprinkle with dry pudding mix. In a saucepan on medium heat melt and stir together butter brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour this mixture over rolls. Cover with towel and let stand in cool draft-free place overnight. Do not refrigerate. Next morning after rolls have risen bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Stir-Fry Rice
instructions: Spray pan with butter flavored spray. Add mushrooms and chicken. Cook until hot. Add vegetables and seasonings. Pour in 1/2 cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water and rice. Cover and continue to cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and nuts; set aside. Beat eggs lightly in a large mixing bowl; add sugar oil and vanilla and beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon batter into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans; turn out on rack and cool completely. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute onions in oil until limp. Add potatoes and water. Cook 10 minutes or until tender. Add milk spices and clams just before serving and bring to a boil. Allow to cook a few minutes before serving.

title: Cheesy Broccoli & Rice
instructions: Combine rice mix and water in saucepan bring to a boil. Stir in 2/3 Cup french fried onions vegetables and cheese. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes or until rice is tender stirring occasionally. Sprinkle 2/3 Cup onions over rice just before serving.

title: Fruit Salad Mixup
instructions: Use 3/4 cup pineapple and orange juice; boil and add to gelatin. Add ice cubes; stir 5 minutes until thickened. Remove ice. Stir in sour cream. Reserve 1/2 cup pineapple 1/4 cup oranges and 1 tablespoon walnuts for garnish. Stir remaining fruit and walnuts into gelatin with marshmallows. Top with reserved fruit and nuts. Refrigerate 4 hours. Makes 8 servings.

title: Tuna, Broccoli And Shells
instructions: Steam broccoli covered in 2 inches of boiling water until tender-crisp about 5 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. In a large bowl combine broccoli with remaining ingredients. Toss gently until combined. Chill several hours stirring occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

title: Ever-Ready Coleslaw
instructions: Place the first 7 ingredients in a quart container and microwave 3 to 4 minutes or until mixture boils. Cool and pour over the cabbage pepper onion and pimento all chopped together.

title: Poppy Seed Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients for pound cake for 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes then remove from pans.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Saute garlic and onion in olive oil. Add zucchini celery potato and parsley. Cook together until vegetables are softened. Add chicken broth (or 2 cups water and 2 chicken bouillon cubes) pepper and salt. Cook for 30 minutes. Put through blender; adjust seasonings. May be served hot or cold.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Peel husks and silk from corn. Trim blemishes. Boil corn 5 minutes then quickly dip in cold water. Cut kernels from cob; measure 2 1/2 quarts cut corn. Combine corn with onions and remaining ingredients in saucepan. Simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Pack into clean jars to within 1/2-inch of top making sure vinegar solution covers vegetables. Immediately adjust covers (lids) as jar manufacturer directs. Process 15 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 6 to 7 pints.

title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder salt and baking soda into a large bowl. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Add egg orange peel and orange juice all at once. Stir until mixture is evenly moist. Fold in cranberries. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups 2/3 cup full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 15 muffins.

title: Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Mix cocoa cornstarch sugar and water. Cook over medium heat until thickened; stir constantly. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 3 tablespoons oleo. Stir well. Serve over ice cream cake or pie. Refrigerate leftovers in sealed jar.

title: Deviled Crab
instructions: Put 3 tablespoons butter in pan and lightly saute onions. (Before rinse crab meat in cold water and remove ligaments if any.) Stir flour in butter mixture; add milk gradually and cook mixture until it thickens. Add slightly beaten egg yolk and crab meat then season with Worcestershire sauce mustard salt sage pepper and red pepper. Cook 3 minutes then stir in parsley and lemon juice. Fill crab shells with the mixture then sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake in an oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Carousel Mandarin Chicken
instructions: Combine chicken celery lemon juice onion and salt. Chill well. Add mayonnaise grapes oranges and almonds to chicken mixture and toss well. Serve on lettuce leaves. Makes 12 servings.

title: Baked Sliced Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place overlapping slices in a buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix butter and oil. Brush potato slices with mixture. Pour remaining over potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic salt and thyme. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are done and browned at edges. Serve immediately.

title: Skillet Vegetable Pork Chops
instructions: Lightly sprinkle pork chops with salt and pepper. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Brown pork chops on both sides. Reduce heat. Drain tomatoes and add liquid to pork chops. Coarsely chop tomatoes and add to pork chops; stir in rice. Place a green pepper ring on each chop. Cover and simmer 40 to 45 minutes or until chops are tender. Yield 4 servings.

title: Chili(Meatless)
instructions: In large saucepan cook the onion and green pepper in 1/2 cup water until tender. Add beans tomato paste and tomatoes. Stir in chili powder salt pepper and remaining water; bring to boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish then layer other ingredients in the order given. Do not mix. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Rice Meatballs
instructions: Combine first six ingredients and shape into 18 balls and place in skillet.

title: Super Chippers
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Add eggs and beat well. Sift together salt baking powder soda and flour. Add along with vanilla to butter mixture. Grind oatmeal until fine in food processor and add with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Roll in small balls and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Marinated Olives
instructions: Discard brine from the jar of olives and slice olives the long way 4 times. Return olives to jar and fill with water. Change water frequently for 1 day and keep refrigerated at all times. Drain the water and put olives in a big pot. Add remaining ingredients. Mix everything with olives and put back into jar. Refrigerate for at least 4 days turning over frequently.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Butter or spray a large long casserole dish. Mix both stuffings and put half in dish. Mix soups sour cream and chicken. Spoon over stuffing. Layer other half of stuffing over this. Melt butter in chicken broth and carefully spoon on top. Cook about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mostaccioli
instructions: In large pot boil noodles according to package directions; drain. In large skillet brown beef or turkey onion and celery until meat is browned and celery is tender. Drain fat. Add the remaining ingredients except the noodles and cheese. Bring to boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Pour meat mixture and drained noodles into a 3-quart baking dish and mix. Then top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serves 6 to 8. Great with garlic bread and salad.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail and mix well with Jell-O. Add sour cream and fold in whipped topping.

title: Sugarless Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil and mix. Add vanilla and dry ingredients; mix well. Add applesauce and mix. Stir in nuts oatmeal and raisins. Drop by teaspoonful and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Sweet Pickled Beans
instructions: Cook large green or yellow string beans in salted water until tender. Put in sterile jars. Cover with equal parts of sugar and vinegar that have been brought to a boil. Add one clove of garlic that has been slit and a pinch of dried red pepper to each jar.\tSeal in jars.\tReady to use in 10 days. Yield 4 pints.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir until blended.

title: Red Cake
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugar. Add and beat until fluffy the eggs. Sift together the flour and cocoa. Add alternately with buttermilk. Dissolve the baking soda in the vinegar. Add to batter. Mix in the food coloring. Pour into greased and floured cake pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Mustardy Fried Chicken Breasts
instructions: Wipe chicken breasts with damp paper towel. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. In a bowl beat together egg and mustard. In separate bowl combine Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs mixing well.

title: Mama'S Old Timey Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light. Add 6 egg yolks one at a time beating after each addition. Add baking soda to sour cream and stir well. Add flour and sour cream to creamed mixture alternately beginning with flour and ending with flour mixing well after each addition. Beat 6 egg whites until fluffy and add to mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Banana Date Nut Cake
instructions: In food processor or blender process bananas until pureed. In large bowl combine flour granulated sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Beat in bananas butter and sour cream. Stir in dates and walnuts. Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool in pan on wire rack. Dust with powdered sugar before serving. Serves 12.

title: Poor Man'S Chop Suey
instructions: Brown together the hamburger onion and celery. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in casserole dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cheese onion dip and 1/2 beef when smooth. Roll in remainder of beef that was chipped in blender.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in skillet on stove over medium heat. Add rice and cook stirring 5 minutes. Add meat green onions ginger pepper and peas. Push rice mix to side. Break eggs into middle of skillet. Cook stirring 1 minute and serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Remove meat from bones and place meat cut up in pieces in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. In a saucepan bring to a boil the soup and chicken broth; pour over chicken. In another bowl combine margarine pepper salt flour and buttermilk. Mix to form a batter. Pour over top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until top is brown.

title: Alice'S Roast
