instructions: Place roast in large roasting pan. Put onion soup mix on top of roast. Pour mushroom soup and water around roast. Cover with heavy foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Add carrots and potatoes and cook for 2 more hours.

title: Tater Topped Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Saute chopped onion and celery. Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain off fat and add salt to taste. Spread meat onion and celery in baking dish. Pour undiluted celery soup over everything. Add chopped pimentos for garnish. Top with 16 ounce package of Tater Tots. Bake 45 minutes until bubbly. Serves 5.

title: Hot Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Layer potatoes green onions and celery. Dot with butter salt and pepper. Spread half of Cheez Whiz over this and repeat layers. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 or until potatoes are tender.

title: Carol'S Creole Black Beans
instructions: *Andouille or Tasso is preferred but in a pinch Italian sausage will do.

title: Mint Chocolate Chip Drops
instructions: Whip the egg whites stiff adding the sugar. Beat. Add the salt and chocolate mint chips. Mix. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet lined with wax paper. Put in oven and turn off heat. Leave in oven about 12 hours. If using plain chocolate chips add mint flavoring.

title: For Kids Only Play Dough!
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cook on high stirring constantly. Let cool and let the kids play. Its edible too!

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use 9 x 11-inch glass baking dish. Put one layer of beans then sour cream taco sauce (salsa) and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Rum Balls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; stir well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Let stand for 10 minutes. Sprinkle additional powdered sugar over the balls. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Dissolve pistachio pudding mix over pineapple. Mix well. Add other ingredients and serve on lettuce leaf. Freezes good.

title: Brown Sugar Pie
instructions: Mix cream sugar and beaten eggs together. Melt butter or margarine; cool a little and beat into egg mixture. Pour into the unbaked pie shell. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 additional minutes or until pie filling is brown on top and shakes like jelly in the center.

title: Orange Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in butter. Add salt and pepper. Mix together brown sugar cornstarch ginger orange marmalade orange juice and lemon. Add to chicken in frying pan. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally for 25 to 35 minutes until tender. Add 1 thinly sliced orange. Simmer an additional 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Cheese Ball Or Log
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into a ball or log. Roll in chopped nuts.

title: Creamy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. In medium bowl combine onion chicken broth cream bay leaf salt pepper and nutmeg. Wash potatoes cut into 1/4-inch slices and arrange in overlapping pattern in baking dish. Gently pour broth mixture over potatoes. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake 45 minutes. Remove cover and baste potatoes with juices in pan. Bake uncovered 45 minutes longer.

title: Texas Tumble Weed
instructions: Put white chocolate in a large bowl. Place in microwave until melted stirring frequently. Pour shoe string potatoes into white chocolate and mix well. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan; cool and cut.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Saute mushrooms onions peppers and celery in one stick of butter or margarine then add cheese soup two cups broth and lemon juice. Cut up chicken and add to mixture. Cook noodles as directed on package except use broth instead of water. When done mix everything together. Place in casserole dish. Heat and serve.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add milk with baking soda. Add flour and salt. Fold in rhubarb and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done in a 9 x 5-inch pan.

title: Salad Nicoise
instructions: Blanch green beans; marinate in small amount salad dressing for 2 hours. Arrange lettuce on bottom and sides of large bowl. Mound potato salad in center. Flake tuna fish on and around potato salad. Layer green beans tomato eggs and black olives. Dress and toss at the table.

title: Famous Crock Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock pot sprayed with Pam. Cook on low for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Double recipe to fill a large crock pot.

title: Three Herb Popcorn
instructions: Place popcorn in a large container or oven roasting pan. salt to taste set aside. Melt butter in a small saucepan. Remove from heat stir in spices. Drizzle butter mixture over popcorn and toss lightly to coat evenly. Stir in nuts if desired.

title: Sparkling Orange Punch
instructions: In a large container combine orange juice lemonade and water. Chill mixture. Add lemon-lime drink just before serving. Makes 24 (1/2 cup) punch cup servings.

title: Roquefort Chicken
instructions: Rub the broilers with salt and pepper. Melt the butter in skillet. Brown the chicken. Remove from skillet and place in a baking dish. Mash Roquefort cheese with a fork and blend in garlic and sour cream. Spread over chicken. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tender. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cover chicken with water and boil until tender; debone and cut into small pieces. Melt 1/2 stick margarine in bottom of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Place chicken in bottom of dish. Mix sour cream chicken soup and hot broth until smooth; pour over chicken. Crush Ritz crackers into very small crumbs mix poppy seed with crackers and spread over other ingredients. Melt 1 stick margarine and pour over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Toss apple with water and lemon juice. Spoon into greased 8-inch casserole dish and sprinkle with flour mixture. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Mad Mod Mostaccioli
instructions: Brown ground beef in large skillet. Add onions and green pepper; cook until tender. Stir in sauce mix tomatoes tomato paste and water. Simmer 5 minutes. Combine meat sauce and noodles; mix lightly. In a 2 quart casserole layer half the noodle mixture and cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fruit Loaf
instructions: Mix. Line loaf pan with brown paper grease well. Then put waxed paper on top of brown paper. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole(A Hearty Breakfast)
instructions: Mix the soup and 1/4 cup milk together. Mix in a blender eggs 2 1/2 cups milk salt and dry mustard. In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer half the bread sausage and cheese. Repeat the layers. Pour soup over the layers and egg mixture. Let set 12 hours in refrigerator or freeze ahead. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sausage Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown and saute together green peppers onion celery and sausage. Drain if necessary. Stir together soy sauce water and rice; add to sausage mixture. Put in 2-quart casserole. Put mushrooms on top. Put frozen vegetables on top of mushrooms. Cover and bake until liquid is absorbed about 45 minutes. Stir vegetables in let stand 10 minutes and serve.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: In electric fry pan or large skillet brown beef with onion. Add salt and pepper. Drain grease. Combine remaining ingredients and add to meat mixture. Heat to boiling then reduce and simmer.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs alternating with flour and sour cream. Add soda and vanilla. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 in large tube pan.

title: Hot Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt and red pepper; cut in shortening and cheese until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Drop by heaping teaspoonful about 2 inches apart on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Blend together the sugar salt flour and cornstarch; stir in water. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Stir a little of this hot mixture into beaten egg yolks. Combine mixes and cook a minute longer stirring constantly. Add lemon juice rind and butter. Pour into baked shell. Cool. Top with meringue.

title: Baked Flounder Italian Style
instructions: Shake fillets with bread crumbs in a bag until well coated. Arrange aluminum foil on a cookie sheet; lightly grease the foil. Place fillets on foil.

title: Butterfly Bites
instructions: Cut celery in half crosswise. Fill with cheese add 2 pretzel wings. Use pieces of pretzels for antennae and raisins for decoration.

title: Jalapeno Jelly
instructions: Bring vinegar and sugar to a boil in saucepan over high heat. Stir mixture until sugar is dissolved; lower heat to a simmer. Add peppers; simmer 10 minutes (while skimming foam from top). Stir in pectin and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute; remove from heat. Let stand for 20 minutes. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal with paraffin.

title: Kyle'S Rice And Shrimp Gumbo
instructions: In a large saucepan combine onion and green pepper and saute in 1/4 cup of water for 3 to 5 minutes. Add undrained tomatoes. Add garlic basil and pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of water and rice; bring to a boil. Add frozen shrimp. Return to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until rice is tender and shrimp are pink.

title: Pralines 2
instructions: Put all of the ingredients except margarine and vanilla in a heavy boiler and cook at 232\u00b0 or soft ball stage. Remove from heat; add margarine and vanilla. Beat until candy begins to thicken and loses its glaze. Drop onto waxed paper.

title: Double Delicious Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with chips; press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Sweet Lemon Chicken
instructions: Flour and salt fryer and fry in cooking oil. Blend remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Simmer 45 to 50 minutes. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Stir about 3 minutes. Add ice cubes and stir until thick. Remove unmelted ice. Blend in Cool Whip. Fold in fruit. Chill. Spoon into crust.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: To make batter beat egg. Add milk and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients and beat just until smooth. Peel and core apples. Slice in 1/4-inch rings. Dip in batter and drop into skillet containing 1/2-inch hot grease. Fry until golden brown turning once. Drain on absorbent paper. Mix cinnamon and sugar and sprinkle over fritters or roll in confectioners sugar. Serve at once. Yields 16 to 20 fritters.

title: B.L.T. Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse under cold water drain and transfer to large bowl. Add bacon tomatoes and lettuce. 2. In small bowl whisk together mayonnaise vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Toss mayonnaise mixture with pasta and serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Almond
instructions: Skin uncooked chicken breast; cut in thin strips. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons soy sauce; marinate for 10 minutes. Beat flour salt and eggs until smooth. Dip chicken in batter; fry in hot oil (370\u00b0) until browned. Remove chicken and keep warm. Add chicken broth to skillet. Mix in bamboo shoots chestnuts celery and 2 tablespoons monosodium glutamate. Bring to boil; cover and cook 5 minutes. Blend cornstarch and cold water; add to chicken mixture stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Add chicken almonds and salt to taste. Cut lettuce in strips and toss with mixture just before serving over hot fluffy rice.

title: Cherry'S Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and Eagle Brand thoroughly and let stand covered in refrigerator overnight. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Let stand several hours before serving.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour on hot griddle until done.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix pineapple juice and all with pudding mix. Drain fruit cocktail. Add other ingredients. Stir all together and chill.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Add pecans. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Cornflakes And Ground Beef
instructions: Scramble lean ground beef. Drain. Pour dry cornflakes in a bowl. Pour ground beef over the cornflakes. Add ketchup to suit your taste. Mix and enjoy.

title: Cheesecake Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites on high until stiff while gradually pouring in the cup of sugar. Cut each brick of cream cheese in half and beat into the egg whites until smooth. Pour in the teaspoon of vanilla and beat until thoroughly mixed. Spray cooking spray into a 9 inch spring form pan 3 inches deep. Dust the pan with the one cup of graham cracker crumbs. Pour the mixture into the pan and bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until the cake doesnt look or shake like soup. Take the cake out of the oven and heat the oven to 450\u00b0. Mix in another bowl the sour cream 2 tablespoons of sugar and 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Pour mixture onto the cheesecake and put it back in the oven for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden brown on the edges. Chill for at least two hours. Overnight is best.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Shape into balls or crescents with 1 tablespoon of dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cover with powdered sugar.

title: Fried Apple Pies
instructions: I take Hungry Jack biscuits or Texas biscuits or Big Country and sprinkle flour on your board and roll out to desired size. Add about 3 Tbsp. apple mixture to each one and fold over sealing ends all around pricking with fork. Fry in oil or crisco.

title: Nancy Sherman Special
instructions: Saute sausage and flank steak with garlic for 3 to 5 minutes. Place in slow cooker with soup; cook on low 5 hours. Dice pepper and onion; saute each with garlic salt (separately) and add to meat mixture. Stir until peppers and onions thoroughly mixed and serve over rice or noodles.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add one egg at a time. Add the crushed vanilla wafers alternately with the milk. Add the pecans and coconut. Pour batter into a tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Gingered Pineapple Lamb
instructions: Preheat broiler. Meanwhile trim fat from chops. Place chops on the unheated rack of broiler pan. Broil 3-inches from heat for 6 minutes. Turn chops over and broil for 4 to 6 minutes until desired doneness. Make sauce in a small saucepan. Stir together sugar and cornstarch. Stir in pineapple juice green peppers soy sauce and ginger. Cook stirring mixture until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir for 2 minutes more. Serve sauce over chops.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Thumbprints
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat sugar oleo eggs and vanilla until smooth. Add 1 cup melted chips; mix well. Stir in oats flour baking powder and salt; mix well. Cover. Chill 1 hour. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Press centers with thumb. Place cherry into each center. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set. Remove to wire rack; cool completely. Drizzle cookies with remaining melted chips.

title: Beefy Noodle Stew
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven. Add beef and brown. Add broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer. Cover and simmer until meat is tender. Bring soup to a boil. Add noodles and cook until tender (around 10 minutes). Stir in cream of mushroom soup drained mushrooms and sour cream.

title: Louisiana Chicken Wings
instructions: Wash wings; split at each joint and discard tips. Deep fry at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes until crispy. Drain well. Melt butter and combine with hot sauce. Dip wings in sauce. Serves 8 to 10 as an appetizer.

title: Ham On Pineapple
instructions: Add mustard and mayonnaise to ground ham; mix well. Shape into 4 patties. Place patties on top of pineapple slices. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients until thick. Add the butter and vanilla.

title: Kniphla
instructions: Using water a little at a time mix ingredients. Work until stiff. Drop teaspoon size into boiling water lightly salted. Cook about 5 minutes. Garnish with fried bread crullers.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in 13 x 9 baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and stuffing mix. Combine soup and sour cream. Spread over stuffing. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until meat juices run clear.

title: Russian Salad
instructions: Dissolve both Jell-Os in 4 cups of boiling water. Add 2 cups cold water and juice from pineapple. Add other ingredients.

title: Coffee Date Loaf
instructions: Combine flour baking powder baking soda salt instant coffee and sugar. Add nuts and dates.

title: Easy Crepes
instructions: Mix flour and eggs. Add milk a little at a time mixing well each time. Add remaining ingredients except butter.

title: Orange Smoothie
instructions: Place in blender; blend until smooth. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chipped Beef Spread
instructions: Shred chipped beef and combine with cream cheese which has been softened; add green pepper onion and black pepper. Fold in sour cream. Pour into small baking dish top with pecans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with crackers. Serves 10.

title: Bread Dressing
instructions: Combine bread crumbs onion parsley beaten egg seasonings and enough stock or water to make a dressing which will hold together.

title: Dilly Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Makes 3 cups.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Place potatoes onion celery water and milk in medium saucepan. Add salt dill weed and butter. Simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are soft.

title: Vicki'S Ginger Soy Chicken
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients and pour over chicken. Bring slowly to a simmer. Cook 45 minutes or until fork-tender. (If sauce thickens too much add more water.) Leftover sauce keeps indefinitely in glass jar refrigerated. Serves 6.

title: Tomato Dumplings
instructions: Mix together juice tomatoes salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Tear canned biscuits in pieces and drop into juice mixture. Cook until done.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients creaming well. Gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour to creamed mixture stirring until combined. Add vanilla. Pour batter into well-greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove and cool completely.

title: Chocolate Cake Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line a 15 x 10 inch jelly roll pan with waxed paper. Grease and flour lined pan; tap out excess. In medium bowl combine flour cocoa powder cornstarch baking soda baking powder and salt. Mix well. In a separate bowl using an electric mixer set on medium speed beat egg yolks and 1/4 c. sugar until fluffy. In a small bowl using clean beaters beat egg whites on high until foamy. Gradually add 1/2 c. sugar beating until stiff but not dry peaks form. Fold 1/3 beaten egg whites into egg yolk mixture. Alternately fold in remaining whites and flour mixture. Pour batter in pan; smooth top. Bake until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean about 15 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine all above ingredients and drop by heaping teaspoonfuls into hot deep oil until golden brown.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut chicken in pieces. Marinate in salad dressing celery and mayonnaise overnight. Cover with Cheez Whiz and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour until cheese becomes bubbly. Spread with French fried onions and bake 5 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Pour pie filling in 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish. Spread cake mix over pie filling. Drizzle melted margarine on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Delicious topped with vanilla ice cream.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Saute onions and butter. Mix eggs and milk until blended. Add corn and corn bread mix. Spread batter into pan. Spread onions over batter and sour cream over onions. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 35 minutes at 425\u00b0 until puffed and golden. Let stand a few minutes before cutting.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in hot fat. Remove from skillet. Brown steaks slightly; salt and pepper to taste. Place steaks in casserole pan in single layer if possible. Mash canned tomatoes; add sugar. Mix in onion and pepper. Spoon vegetables over steak. Bake covered for 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake uncovered at 250\u00b0 all day or all night.

title: Broccoli-Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook the spinach and broccoli a little less than instructions say adding a tablespoon of vinegar to each. Add the seasonings to the soup and then mix in drained spinach and broccoli. Pour into a flat buttered baking dish and arrange onions on top. (If you want also add 2 peeled and quartered tomatoes.) Sprinkle on the cheese and bake for 35 minutes at 325\u00b0 or for 45 minutes at 250\u00b0. (If you double this recipe use a can each of mushroom and celery soups.)

title: Butterscotch Cream Pie
instructions: Combine brown sugar cornstarch salt and egg yolks together and mix thoroughly. Gradually stir in evaporated milk and water. Add butter. Cook and stir over low heat until thickened. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour into baked 9-inch pie shell and top with meringue from the egg whites.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Using a large Tupperware bowl sift cocoa and sugar together. Place butter on top and add milk. Microwave on High 2 minutes. Stir and add nuts. Spread in a buttered 8 x 8-inch dish.

title: Peanut Butter And Pork Stir-Fry
instructions: In wok or large skillet heat 1 tablespoon oil. Stir-fry pork 3 minutes or until pink is gone. Remove from pan. Add rest of oil carrots pepper celery and onion; stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add beans; stir-fry for 1 minute or until veggies are tender-crisp.

title: Pinwheels
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortillas. Spread mixture on tortillas. Roll up. Slice into pinwheels 1/2-inch thick. Serve along with picante sauce or salsa for dipping.

title: Corned Beef Stew
instructions: Cook potatoes and carrots; save the water. Combine all ingredients in a 3 or 4-quart boiler. Bring to a boil. Boil and allow to simmer for 20 minutes. If needed add water from potatoes and carrots to make stew thinner. You can add more or less of the Worcestershire sauce hot sauce salt and pepper to suit your taste. You may blend and strain tomatoes to remove pulp and seeds.

title: Baked Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash potatoes and cut them into medium-size cubes. You can peel them if you like but they are great with the skins on. Spray a 9 x 13 casserole dish with nonstick spray. Place potatoes in the dish and bake for an hour or until tender.

title: Dump Salad
instructions: Mix in large bowl in order given. Stir in jello until dissolved. Serve cold.

title: Herbed Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and place in casserole dish. Mix soups with 1 cup broth and pour over chicken. Mix butter and 1 cup broth and stir in stuffing mix. Spoon this over chicken. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemony Chicken Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In saucepan stir together all ingredients. Heat to boiling and simmer stirring occasionally.

title: Nancy'S Holy Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocado in a bowl. (I have found that a pastry cutter does a great job.) Add remaining ingredients. Chill. Serve with chips or with fresh tomato slices.

title: Lucille'S Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar well; add sour cream Pet milk and pudding mix. Mix on slow for about 2 minutes. Fold in cream that has been whipped. Add vanilla. Pour into freezer container and finish filling with milk. When making strawberry or peach use about 1 quart of sweetened fruit that has been chopped in blender. When making peach ice cream use a half teaspoon almond extract. If you make vanilla use the French vanilla instant pudding.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream together sugar and cream cheese. Add pineapple strawberries bananas and pecans. Mix. Fold in Cool Whip and freeze.

title: Stuffed Artichokes(Serves 6)
instructions: Cut tips from fresh artichokes and brush with lemon juice. Cook until tender in boiling water to which salt and olive oil has been added. Remove; drain. Remove center of artichokes. Saute mushrooms garlic and onion in butter until browned. Stir in parsley cheese and bread crumbs; mix well. Spoon into artichokes and heat at 325\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Serve hot with melted butter on the side.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Grate zucchini; stir in rest of ingredients. Oil skillet or griddle and heat to usual pancake temperature.

title: Orange Whip
instructions: Mix together all but Jell-O. Add dry Jell-O and mix slowly but very thoroughly. Put in sealed container and chill.

title: Aunt Nettie'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix and roll out quite thin. Cut with large cookie cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with sugar immediately when removing from oven.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O with water. Fold in strawberries and juice. Drain pineapple and add the pineapple bananas and nuts to Jell-O. Pour half of mixture into a 2-quart oblong pan. Put in refrigerator for 1 hour or until firm. Spread sour cream on and put remaining mixture on top. Return to refrigerator.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Mix oil and sugar in separate container. Add half flour mixture. Mix well and beat in carrots pineapple and nuts. Stir in vanilla and remaining flour mixture. Add eggs one at a time beating after each egg until well blended. Bake in greased 8 x 12 x 2-inch pan until brown (toothpick will be clean when tested).

title: Dressing For Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put on your favorite salad.

title: Red Snapper Steaks
instructions: Thaw frozen steaks. Cut into serving size portions and place in well-greased hinged wire grill. Combine remaining ingredients except paprika. Baste fish with sauce and sprinkle with paprika. Cook about 4 inches from moderately hot coals for 8 minutes. Baste with sauce and sprinkle with paprika. Turn and cook for 7 to 10 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serves 6.

title: Delicious Enchiladas
instructions: Brown burger in large skillet. Place burger in large pan with beans; save grease from meat. Add flour to medium hot grease; stir to keep from clumping. Cook to golden brown; add chili mix and tomato sauce stirring constantly. Roll burger and bean mixture into tortillas. Pour sauce over enchiladas enough to cover completely. Cover with shredded cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Delicious topped with lettuce onion black olives tomato and picante sauce.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Add to a mixing bowl with mixed liquid ingredients. Beat just until smooth. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13 inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Dinner Rolls
instructions: Combine shortening and sugar. Cream. Scald milk and pour into mixture. Stir to dissolve. Add egg and let cool. Mix salt and yeast in one cup of flour and add to cooled mixture. Then add 3 cups of flour. Set one hour covered. Beat. Add additional flour (about 1 cup) to make smooth dough. Let rise double in bulk. Put in greased pans (muffin tins two balls of dough). Let rise again and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Rice Cream Pie
instructions: Stir corn syrup and peanut butter until well mixed in a large bowl. Add Rice Krispies; mix until well coated. Press mixture evenly and firmly into a buttered 9-inch pie pan. Chill until firm. Spread ice cream evenly into pie shell. Cut into wedges to serve. Top with fresh fruit peaches strawberries. I like to thicken my fresh fruit a little. Refreshing after a hot summer day!

title: Nacho Salad Or The 15 Minute Meal
instructions: Heat chili with beans. Tear lettuce and place in bowl with carrots. Add diced tomatoes. Then add most of the cheese. Pour on chili with beans. Remaining cheese is sprinkled on top. Sour cream can be added. Nachos can be placed around the bowl or mixed in with the ingredients. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter margarine sugar eggs and vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Fold in sour cream. Pour half mixture in greased and floured tube pan. Top with half mixture of nuts cinnamon brown sugar and sugar. Repeat these layers. Swirl the batter with knife. Bake 50 to 60 minutes. Serves 16.

title: Heavenly Pie
instructions: Combine Cool Whip milk lemon juice and then fold in the other ingredients. Pour into 2 baked crust or 2 graham cracker crusts. Refrigerate one hour or more. This is delicious and easy to make.

title: Bread Machine Dinner Rolls
instructions: In bread machine pan place the first 9 ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer. Select dough setting (check dough after 5 minutes mixing; add 1 teaspoon flour or water as needed). When cycle is completed turn dough onto lightly floured surface and punch down. Divide dough in half. Roll each portion into 3/4-inch thickness. Cut with 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Cover. Let rise in warm place until doubled about 1 hour.

title: Oven-Fried Sesame Chicken
instructions: Place soy sauce in a shallow dish; add chicken turning to coat. Remove chicken from soy sauce; discard soy sauce. Combine sesame seeds and next 3 ingredients in a large zip-top heavy-duty plastic bag. Add chicken; seal bag and shake to coat chicken with sesame seed mixture. Place chicken in a 13 x 9 baking dish coated with cooking spray. Drizzle margarine over chicken. Bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Val'S Favorite Salad
instructions: Clean all vegetables. Mix together sour cream and ranch dressing. Pour over cut up vegetables and let set in the fridge overnight. Eat em up! Yummy yummy!!

title: Oven Fried Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In first bowl combine flour pepper and paprika. In second bowl beat egg whites and milk. In third bowl mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Remove skin and fat from chicken if using pieces that have skin. Coat chicken with contents of 3 bowls in order. Let stand 10 minutes. Put in baking pan. Bake 30 minutes. Turn chicken over. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Trim excess fat from chops. In ovenproof skillet brown chops on both sides. Remove chops from pan and pour off drippings. Blend in soup milk and thyme. Stir in green beans. Arrange chops on top and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 45 minutes or until chops are tender. Remove cover and cook to desired consistency about 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Black Russian Cake
instructions: Mix at low speed 1 minute then at medium speed for 4 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes in a greased Bundt pan. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan and glaze.

title: Shrimp Or Crabmeat Fettuccine
instructions: Saute vegetables in oleo. Add shrimp or crabmeat. Cook 15 minutes. Add jalapeno cheese until melted. Add half and half. Combine with cooked noodles in casserole dish. Top with grated American cheese. Bake until cheese melts at 350\u00b0.

title: Charcoal Grilled Pork Loin (Tenderloin)
instructions: Pat pork loins dry. Combine mustard and marmalade jam or jelly. Coat loins with mustard-marmalade mixture. Tie with string if pork is in 2 sections. Put on grill and cook until done. Salt and pepper while cooking. Slice into 1/2-inch slices.

title: Divinity Candy
instructions: Cook 1/2 cup syrup salt and water until it spins a thread. Beat egg whites until they are stiff. Pour syrup over egg whites all this at the same time. After beating this until it begins to thicken or about ready to dip out add your nuts and vanilla. Use the size spoon to dip according to size of pieces of candy you want.

title: Parmesan Sausage Wraps
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Cut each in half lengthwise to make 16 long triangles. Place 1 sausage on shortest side of each triangle. Roll up starting with shortest side. Dip in milk; place on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes until golden brown. Remove immediately and serve warm. Makes 16 appetizers.

title: Mike'S Chicken Chili
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Cool and pull off bone. Add onions peppers water and crushed tomatoes. Bring to simmer for about 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour (best next day).

title: Mom Riley'S Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together. Add 1/2 cup milk; mix until smooth. Add egg yolks; mix well. Add remainder of milk and vanilla. Cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue. Brown in 425\u00b0 oven for 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Provolone Sandwich
instructions: Slice loaves in half lengthwise. Brush cut sides of bread with olive oil (about 4 teaspoons). Combine remaining oil and vinegar and set aside. Arrange 1/4 of tomato on each bottom half. Brush with vinegar mixture. Arrange 1/4 of cucumber cheese and onion over tomato. Brush with remaining vinegar mix.

title: Christmas Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well. Blend sugar and margarine and mix all other ingredients. Pour into pie shells and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. This will make 3 bought pie shells.

title: Fancy Hash Browns
instructions: Mix partially thawed potatoes soup cheese salt and pepper. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour the melted butter evenly over the top. Sprinkle with the cereal.

title: Curried Pork Chops
instructions: On waxed paper combine flour curry powder salt and pepper. Use to coat both sides of pork chops. In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot salad oil cook pork chops 7 to 8 minutes until tender and golden brown on both sides turning pork chops once. Makes 4 main dish servings.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix with mixer. May be left chunky. Refrigerate several hours to blend flavors. Serve with crackers chips or Bugles.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Roll out each half of biscuit wrap each slice around apple piece and lay in large pan. Mix remaining ingredients together. Pour over apples. Melt 1 stick margarine; pour on top. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Bring broth and oleo to a boil. Add noodles and simmer 45 minutes. Add 3 small cans or 1 large can white chicken chunks. Cook 15 minutes more. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Swiss Steak Quickie
instructions: Dot the center of a 20-inch sheet of heavy aluminum foil with 1 teaspoon butter or margarine. Shake half the contents of 1 envelope onion soup mix on the foil (dry). Over this place chuck or round steak with remaining soup mix and 1 teaspoon butter. Add fresh mushrooms around steak. Bring foil up over meat and double-fold edges. Place in a shallow baking pan. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Cookies
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg. Add flour and baking soda mix well. Stir in bacon cornflakes and raisins. Drop by rounded tablespoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 - 18 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool for 2 minutes before removing to wire racks. Store in the refrigerator. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake in 2 layers according to package directions and cool completely. Make pudding according to package directions. In large bowl break one layer of cake into 4 or 5 large chunks and layer in bottom of bowl. Pour 1/2 of the pudding over the cake. Spread 1 carton of Cool Whip over pudding. Top with 5 broken candy bars. Repeat each layer and chill overnight. Garnish with maraschino cherries if desired.

title: Olive-Cheese Tea Canapes
instructions: Cream butter flour and cheese. Add other ingredients and roll mixture into little balls. Make a hole in the center of each and insert a stuffed green olive. Place on a tray in the freezer until ready. Bake for 15 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Serve with a good red wine and fruit cubes on picks. Serves 6.

title: Mocha Torte
instructions: Slice cake into 4 or 5 layers. Cream butter. Gradually add sifted confectioners sugar. Add salt vanilla and egg yolks; beat for 2 or 3 minutes. Add baking chocolate melted with coffee. Fold in egg whites. Spread this mixture between layers; chill overnight. Frost with whipped cream.

title: Southern Corn Soup
instructions: Combine corn and chicken broth in blender or food processor and puree. In a 3-quart saucepan combine butter and corn mixture and simmer slowly 5 minutes stirring to keep corn from sticking to bottom of pan. Add milk garlic oregano salt and pepper and bring to boil. Reduce heat and add green chilies and chicken. Simmer 5 minutes. Remove soup from heat and add cheese and baking soda (to prevent curdling). Stir until melted.

title: Cheddar Ham Chowder
instructions: Bring water potatoes carrots celery onion salt and pepper to a boil. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes until tender. Remove from heat. In another pan melt butter. Blend in flour; add milk. Cook and stir until thick. Add cheese; stir until melted. Mix these together. Add corn and ham; heat thoroughly.

title: Italian Shrimp Salad
instructions: In medium saucepan cook rice with water and Italian dressing until done. Refrigerate in a large bowl until cool. Fold in peas mushrooms scallions water chestnuts olives artichokes and mayonnaise. Chill at least 24 hours. Gently stir in shrimp or chicken. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Note May use crunchy peanut butter for nuts.

title: Aunt Julia'S Crunchy Granola
instructions: Mix oats wheat germ coconut cinnamon and brown sugar together. Add oil honey and vanilla; mix with hands. Spread in 10 x 15-inch baking pan or jelly roll pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes; stir occasionally. Serve with milk.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: In large heavy saucepan saute ground beef and onion lightly. Sprinkle with salt; add spaghetti sauce and remaining ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until macaroni is tender. Stir once or twice. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Ninety Minute Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix 3/4 cup flour sugar salt and undissolved yeast. Heat milk water and butter until liquids are very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Butter need not melt. Gradually add to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer. Add 1/4 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes. Stir in enough additional flour to make a soft dough. On floured board knead 2 to 3 minutes until smooth.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Bring all ingredients except ground chuck to a boil. Add raw ground chuck. Simmer for 3 to 4 hours stirring frequently.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and put in a baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Glaze For Cakes
instructions: In a sauce pan heat the chocolate chips and butter over low heat until melted. This will need to be stirred often. Set aside. In a heavy saucepan mix whipping cream and corn syrup. Bring to a gentle boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate mixture. Cut your favorite cake and drizzle over top of each serving. Good on any cake.

title: Suko
instructions: In a deep pan brown stew beef. Add garlic salt to meat. Fill pan with water over half-full. Add tomato paste tomato sauce sugar and lots of garlic salt. Cook 2 1/2 hours.

title: Boston Cream Dessert
instructions: Make pudding as directed then fold Cool Whip into mixture. Line the bottom of 9x13 pan with graham crackers then add half of pudding mixture. Place a second layer of graham crackers over pudding mixture and then add remaining pudding. Top of with another layer of graham crackers and then pour melted chocolate frosting over crackers. Refrigerate overnight. This is a favorite with all ages.

title: Stella Adamek'S 3 Bean Salad
instructions: Drain vegetables and combine. Make dressing of sugar vinegar oil and seasonings. Pour over beans. Let set overnight. I add lima beans and chili beans.

title: Skinny Soup
instructions: Cook cabbage carrots and celery first (a few minutes). Add rest of ingredients. Heat.

title: Tortellini Soup
instructions: Brown sausage; add onion and garlic then remaining ingredients. When serving sprinkle with cheese.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid sugar water pineapple juice and ginger ale.

title: Church Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes and chopped onion in baking pan. Sprinkle with salt pepper and Cavenders seasoning. Pat stick of butter over top; cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Steamed Brown Bread
instructions: Step 1 Sift flour (1/4 cup) salt and soda in bowl. Add meal and whole wheat flour.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain. Combine with remaining ingredients. Put into 1-quart casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Holiday Punch
instructions: Chill the pineapple juice. Mix with limeade. Add a little sugar if desired. Add ginger ale and spoon in lime sherbet.

title: Dilled Broccoli
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over broccoli florets.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cover the beans with water 2 inches above the beans. Let stand overnight. Drain just before using. Place the ham hocks 10 cups of the water onions bell peppers bay leaves and seasonings in a 5 1/2-quart pan or large Dutch oven; stir well. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer until meat is fork-tender about 1 hour stirring occasionally. Remove ham hocks from pan and set aside. Add the drained beans and 4 cups of the water to the pan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Add the remaining 2 cups water and simmer 30 minutes stirring often. Stir in the sausage and continue simmering until the beans start breaking up about 35 minutes scraping pan bottom fairly often. (If beans start to scorch do not stir. Immediately remove from heat and change to another pot without scraping any scorched beans into the mixture.) Take meat off of ham hock bones and add to the pot; cook and stir 10 more minutes.

title: Chicken Alouette
instructions: Unfold pastry sheets into 14 x 12-inch rectangle on floured surface. Cut one sheet into 4 (7 x 6-inch) rectangles. Cut second sheet into two. Set aside. Shape into oval (cut off corners). Spread evenly with cheese.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix sugar flour milk and baking powder in bowl. Dough will be thin. Pour dough in pan with butter. Pour fruit over dough and this bakes around the fruit like a cake. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until done in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pineapple Ice Cream
instructions: Combine evaporated milk sugar and salt. Drain pineapple and reserve 1/3 cup juice. Stir pineapple juice and vanilla into milk mixture. Mix well and spoon into hand turned or electric ice cream freezer. Freeze according to instructions. Let stand 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Yield 1 quart.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar for 5 minutes. Add oil and beat 5 minutes more. Sift dry ingredients and fold in. Add nuts and apples. Use greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients in a pint jar until mixed well. Add catsup and mix. Add vinegar and shake until well blended. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour prior to serving. Shake again before serving. Makes 1 pint.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots 5 minutes and drain. Mix with remaining ingredients and refrigerate. Keeps 8 to 10 days.

title: Versatile Beef
instructions: Cut meat in 1/4-inch pieces. Brown in skillet and add onions wine salt pepper and bouillon cubes. Lower heat cover and simmer for 2 to 3 hours. Serve this as you would any pot roast.

title: Baked Turkey Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Put into large shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Chill several hours or overnight. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Soak the beans in water overnight. The next morning bring to a boil. Add the baking soda. Skim the foam and drain. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Add the butter sugar and salt. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Empty cake mix and gelatin in bowl. Mix and add oil. Beat in eggs and 1 cup strawberries. Pour into greased pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. When cake is cool ice with mix of 1 stick melted butter powdered sugar and 1/2 cup strawberries.

title: Easy German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Chop nuts and mix with coconut and spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the cake mix as directed on box and pour over nuts and coconut. Mix cream cheese and margarine. Then add the sugar. Spoon this on top of cake mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sausage And Eggs Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain off fat. Mix together beaten eggs milk salt and mustard. Break up bread; add cheese and sausage. Pour into greased glass baking pan 11 x 7-inch. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Touch Of Heaven
instructions: Chill milk beaters and bowl well. Whip milk stiff and fluffy or use Dream Whip. Fold in extract and preserves. Break cake into small pieces. Place layer of cake in bottom of 2-quart casserole. Top with whipped mixture and repeat layers ending with whipped mixture. Chill overnight.

title: Chunky Applesauce
instructions: Wash peel and quarter apples. Cook until soft in covered saucepan using just enough water to keep from scorching. Stir occasionally during cooking. Break up quarters with fork and sweeten to taste with sugar.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Soak bananas in pineapple juice for a few minutes. Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Praline Cheese Cake
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and margarine. Press into 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine softened cream cheese sugar and flour. Blend well. Add eggs one at a time. Blend in vanilla and chopped nuts. Pour over baked crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Loosen the rim and cool. Chill. Pour a little maple syrup over and garnish with pecan halves. Serves 12.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Prepare lime Jell-O; pour into 8-inch glass square baking dish. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in crushed pineapple and chill until firm. Gradually add mayonnaise to softened cream cheese; blend well. Add nuts. Spread over molded Jell-O. Chill until firm. Prepare strawberry Jell-O; cool. Pour over cheese mixture and chill until firm. Cut in squares. Serve on lettuce and top with mayonnaise.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
instructions: Mix first three ingredients (it should fizz). Mix next five ingredients and set 1 cup aside. Mix liquid and crumb mixtures together. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle top with the cup of crumb mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Corn-Zucchini Saute
instructions: Saute zucchini in oil in large skillet or wok 5 minutes or until tender-crisp. Add corn garlic salt and Italian seasonings and saute 3 to 5 minutes until corn is tender-crisp. Add pimiento.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots until tender; drain. Mix other ingredients. Add to carrots and let set overnight.

title: Tomato Basil Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Using lightly floured dough roller roll out pizza crust on a rectangle baking stone or pan. Sprinkle crust with 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese; set aside. Thinly slice tomatoes; arrange in a single layer over the mozzarella cheese on the crust. Mix all the remaining ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Then spread to cover evenly over the crust. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until top is golden brown and bubbly.

title: Kentucky Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into serving portions; steam until tender. Pat dry refrigerate until time to fry. If a large quantity is cooked steam the day before.

title: Slim Jim Sour Cream
instructions: Whiz in blender until smooth. Chill until firm.

title: Layered Mixed Vegetable Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into bite-size pieces. In a large bowl or 13 x 9-inch pan layer lettuce and onion. Spoon 1/2 cup mayonnaise evenly over top. Layer chopped celery next. Then layer diced green pepper. Thaw and drain peas. Layer peas. Spread remaining mayonnaise over top. Sprinkle sugar and cheese. Fry the bacon slices and then drain and crumble. Add bacon over top. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours. If desired add drained water chestnuts. Toss before serving.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Brown meat onion and seasonings. Add 1 cup tomato sauce 1/2 cup milk egg 1/4 cup catsup 3/4 cup rice and 1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Stuff peppers. Place in roaster or Dutch oven. Cover with 2 cups tomato sauce 3/4 cup catsup and 1/2 cup water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: In sauce pan mix sugar jello and pineapple. Heat just until dissolved. Whisk in buttermilk Cool Whip and pecans. Pour into 9x13 inch casserole dish. Chill.

title: Spanish Pizza
instructions: Slice bread in about 1-inch slices. Melt butter with garlic and butter bread. Mix cheese green chiles and mayonnaise. Spread on bread. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Serve at once. Great appetizers; you cant eat just one!

title: White Potato Medley
instructions: Dice potatoes and soak in salted ice water for at least 20 minutes. In the meantime saute the onion bell pepper and garlic in the butter over low-medium heat for 20 minutes; dont brown. Drain the potatoes and add them to the onion and bell pepper; cook an additional 30 minutes or until potatoes are slightly browned and done. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Bring beets to a boil. Tie spices in cheesecloth; add vinegar sugar and boil 5 minutes.

title: Slam Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Layer with shells on bottom of 10 x 13-inch dish. Spread beans meat and cheeses. Repeat and pour can of sauce over entire dish. Top with remaining cheese olives and peppers. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Brown and drain beef. Stir in tomato sauce onion and seasonings. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Place biscuits in greased muffin tins pressing to cover bottom and sides. Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mixture into biscuit lined cups; sprinkle with cheese. Any other toppings may be added. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Country-Style Steak
instructions: Brown steak in Crisco oil; when you turn your steak add butter. Lay steak out. Mix flour in drippings; brown real brown and add salt and pepper to taste. Add water and stir continually until you get consistency you want. Place steak back in gravy and let simmer on medium for 30 minutes.

title: Fried Shrimp And Okra
instructions: In frying pan cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon from pan. After washing the okra cut into slices taking off tops and bottoms. Add onion okra and bell pepper to pan; cook until tender stirring constantly to keep from burning. Add salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Add in shrimp and cook until shrimp turn a bright pink stirring often. Serve as a side dish or over rice.

title: Microwave Okra Creole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole dish heat onion and butter 3 1/2 to 5 minutes until onion is tender. Add okra tomatoes Worcestershire sauce and pepper sauce. Heat covered 22 to 25 minutes until vegetables are tender stirring twice. Season with salt and pepper. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Baklava
instructions: Butter 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Line bottom with 2 sheets of phyllo. Sprinkle with butter and chopped nuts. Put on another layer of phyllo. Sprinkle with melted butter and alternate layers of nuts and phyllo sprinkling butter on each layer until about 1 1/2-inch thick. Finish with 3 layers of phyllo. With a sharp knife cut through the first 3 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes then increase to 400\u00b0. Bake until golden brown. Let cool.

title: Can-Can Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except noodles in a large skillet. Stir to mix. Bring quickly to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove from heat; stir. Serve with the noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Lime Swirl Pie
instructions: Grease a 10-inch pie pan. Crush cookies and mix with melted margarine. Press cookie mixture into pie pan to form a crust. Save 2 tablespoons cookie mixture for top. Chill the pie crust. Dissolve jello in hot water. Add the lemon juice and sugar. Let stand while you whip the chilled milk to a stiff froth. Add jello and mix. Continue whipping until stiff peaks are formed. Mix in lemon rind and food coloring. Pour into crust and sprinkle crumbs on top. Chill until firm.

title: Banana Pie
instructions: Combine in heavy pot first sugar and flour (blend them well) then add milk using a whisk. Add egg yolks. Turn on the stove burner cook until thickened continue stirring or it will lump up and stick. Pour over bananas and vanilla wafers alternately layered. Beat egg whites for topping or you can use whip cream for the topping. If using egg whites you have to bake the pie until egg whites are golden brown. Let cool and serve.

title: Broccoli Cheese Quiche
instructions: Beat eggs milk salt and pepper. Mix cheese flour and broccoli and put into pie shell. Pour egg mixture over this and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Artichoke Pita Crisps
instructions: Combine water artichokes and celery in small saucepan. Simmer covered for 15 minutes. Drain artichoke mixture well. Finely chop ham green onions olives and artichoke mixture in food processor. Scrape into large bowl. Puree cottage cheese in processor. Add to bowl with mayonnaise and lemon juice.

title: 5-Minute Play Dough
instructions: In a medium saucepan put all ingredients. Stir and cook over medium heat until mixture resembles mashed potatoes and comes away from sides of saucepan. (If it is still sticky it is cooked enough.) Dump dough onto kneading surface and knead until all lumps are gone.

title: Cinnamon Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick spray. Press one package crescent rolls on the bottom of the prepared pan.

title: English Muffin Loaf
instructions: In a large bowl combine 3 cups flour sugar salt soda and yeast. Heat liquids until very warm. Add to dry ingredients. Beat well. Stir in reserved flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into 2 greased and cornmeal sprinkled loaf pans. Sprinkle tops with cornmeal. Cover and let rise 45 minutes. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven 25 minutes.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
instructions: Crush cookies. Mix 3/4 of the cookies with the margarine (melted). Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 3/4 cup sugar and cream cheese. Spread on cookie mixture. Mix pudding and milk. Pour over mixture; add Cool Whip. Top with remaining cookie crumbs.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix well and store in closed jar. Use 3 teaspoons per cup of water.

title: Baked Halibut
instructions: Dip steaks in salted milk then in crushed cornflakes to coat thoroughly on both sides. Place on greased baking sheet. Drizzle tops of steaks with melted butter. Add dash of paprika. Bake in hot oven to 500\u00b0 to 550\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cool As A Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Add lemon juice. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 1/4 cups. Add to gelatin stirring until slightly thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. Blend in sour cream; add remaining ingredients. Chill soft set in 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Easy Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed drain and stir in other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until casserole is dry approximately 45 minutes.

title: Potato Dressing(Grandma'S Recipe)
instructions: Cook potatoes. Mash with butter when cool. Grind together onion salt pork and crackers and add to potatoes. Add salt pepper sugar and Bells seasoning. Combine and stuff breast and tail cavities. Bake turkey according to package directions.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in warm water and set aside. Cut shortening into the dry ingredients. Stir in the buttermilk and the water-yeast mixture. Blend thoroughly. Refrigerate or make into biscuits. Let the biscuits rise slightly and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until lightly browned.

title: Mexican Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a medium bowl; make a well in center of mixture. Combine buttermilk egg whites and oil; add to dry ingredients stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour batter into an 8-inch round cake pan coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Scotch Shortbread
instructions: Set oven slow at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0. Cream butter. Add sugar gradually; beat until fluffy. Sift flour into creamed mixture thoroughly; blend using hands. Press into oblong cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil. Prick surface with fork. Bake in preheated oven for about 1/2 hour or until firm when pressed gently in center. Should be only light brown.

title: Mixed Fruit Casserole
instructions: Layer pineapple pie filling dry cake mix and pecans in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Do not stir. Cover with butter slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 can French fried onions. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until onions are golden. Makes 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and water in a saucepan. Stir until sugar and cornstarch are dissolved and blended. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until clear. Add gelatin and stir until dissolved. Cool thoroughly at room temperature.

title: Chicken-N-Spaghetti
instructions: Saute seasonings in butter; add chicken pieces Ro-Tel tomatoes soup and cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Add spaghetti and serve.

title: *Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Pour in pie crust. Pour 1/2 jar pizza sauce over meat and mix in with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until crust begins to brown. Remove from oven; cover with sliced cheese and bake until cheese melts and makes a golden crust.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Drain peas on paper towels. Break lettuce in bowl. Put green peppers onion and peas in bowl. Beat mayonnaise until fluffy. Spread over vegetables. Sprinkle sugar over. Sprinkle cheese over all. Top with crisp bacon strips. Cover tightly and chill for 8 hours.

title: Spinach-Mushroom Salad
instructions: In medium salad bowl combine spinach with mushrooms and red pepper strips. In small bowl combine vinegar with water sugar and mustard. Add oil salt and pepper; mix well. Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs. Blend flour salt and baking powder. Alternately add milk and flour mixture to creamed ingredients. Stir in flavorings. Pour in a 10-inch Bundt or tube pan that has been greased. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Chile And Cheese
instructions: Cook chile on stove top when hot. Put 1/2 jar of cheese in. Stir until melted. Use dip for chips or on hot dogs. Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs; stir in pumpkin. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until well blended. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Brown spareribs; drain grease. Combine the rest of ingredients mixing well. Pour over spareribs. Simmer until tender approximately 4 to 5 hours. Remove spareribs from pan. We use the barbecue sauce over baked potatoes with sour cream on top.

title: Chicken A La Queen
instructions: Saute macaroni onion and green pepper until macaroni turns yellow. Add tomato sauce water salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Simmer 15 minutes. Mix in chicken and broth. Sprinkle cheese over top and simmer 5 minutes more.

title: Easy Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dip chicken in egg then coat with breadcrumbs. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken 10 minutes. Set aside. Heat sauce in same skillet over medium heat then return chicken to skillet. Cover and cook 5 minutes over low heat. Top chicken with cheese and heat until melted.

title: Cream Cheese Crescents
instructions: Mix ingredients. Roll out and fold up in square 3 times. Then roll dough out thin. Cut in 2-inch squares. Put 1/2 teaspoon Smuckers apricot preserves in each. Fold. Bake on ungreased pan at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Brown Fudge Squares
instructions: Combine butter and cocoa in a small saucepan. Heat just until margarine melts. Set aside. Combine eggs and sugar in a large bowl beating well. Add flour and vanilla. Mix well. Add chocolate mixture beating until blended. Stir in pecans and/or chocolate chips. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 15-inch pan in a preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle 2/3 of onion soup in bottom of baking dish (9 x 12-inch). Place chicken in baking dish and add the mushroom soup and remainder of onion soup. (I add a little water to mushroom soup.) Cover with aluminum foil and bake for about 1 1/2 hours or until tender at 400\u00b0.

title: Agnes Lyons Pepper Relish
instructions: Wash clean and drain peppers. Grind peppers fine. Squeeze and drain again after grinding. Grind onion. While grinding onions prepare a pot of boiling water. Onions should have boiling water over them for 10 minutes. Drain and put 3 trays of ice cubes to cool onions. Put onions in pot and add all other ingredients except spices. Put spices in cheesecloth and let it float in pickle after it starts to boil for 10 minutes. Makes 12 pints.

title: Sweet Potato Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients and egg yolks; beat until combined. Pour mixture into pastry shell and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 additional minutes or until set. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar and vanilla until soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/3 cup sugar one tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form. Spread meringue over filling sealing to edge of pastry. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Cool completely before serving. Yield 1 (10-inch) pie.

title: Rotel Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in broth. Add mushrooms and Ro-Tel simmer. Cook noodles drain and mix all ingredients except cheese. Add cheese last. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder soda sugar salt cloves nutmeg and cinnamon; add the raisins. In another bowl beat together the eggs oil pumpkin and 1/3 cup of water. Mix the pumpkin mixture into the flour mixture until combined. Pour into buttered and floured loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let bread cool in pan for 15 minutes then turn out.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; mix pudding with pineapple juice. Add Cool Whip; mix well. Fold in marshmallows pineapple and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Old Family Barbecue Joes
instructions: Cook together ground venison and onions until meat is browned and onion is transparent. Drain. Add ketchup vinegar and spice. Simmer over low heat for 2 1/2 hours stirring and moving spice bag every half hour. Remove bag and serve on buns or bread. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
instructions: Mix everything together. Cover and let set in refrigerator at least 3 hours.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix all together for 1 minute at low speed then 3 minutes at high speed. Add cherries and nuts. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except tomatoes thoroughly. Cut thin slices from top of each tomato. Remove pulp and turn upside-down to drain. Stuff tomatoes with cheese mixture. Garnish each top with a caper.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash potatoes and gradually add sugar while mixing with mixer. Add eggs and enough milk to make a soft consistency. Put in rectangular casserole dish.

title: Banana Smoothie
instructions: Put in blender in order shown and blend until smooth.

title: Apricot Sauced Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook first 6 ingredients until apricots are tender about 10 to 15 minutes. After cooked sweet potatoes are cooled peel and cut into 6 or so slices (about 1/2-inch thick). Arrange in baking dish. Spread with pecans. Pour sauce over all. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until potatoes are glazed. Baste once or twice while baking. Serve hot.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Beat egg. In a mixing bowl combine the milk egg and melted butter. Add the orange juice rind chopped apples (leave skin on) and vanilla.

title: Festive Ribbon Fudge(Choco-Holics Enjoy!!)
instructions: Combine 3 cups sugar 3/4 cup margarine and 2/3 cup evaporated milk in heavy 3-quart saucepan. Bring to full roaring boil. Continue boiling over medium heat 5 minutes or until candy thermometer reaches 234\u00b0 stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add 1 jar marshmallow cream. Beat until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Repeat with remaining ingredients substituting peanut butter for chocolate. Spread over chocolate. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares.

title: Cheese-Potato Casserole
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except 1/2 of the cheese; mix well and put in a buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Place apples in square baking dish. Combine first 5 ingredients. Add egg and mix until crumbly. Pour over apples. Dot with margarine. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Slit with knife.

title: Lemon Puff Pudding(Cake On Top; Lemon Sauce On Bottom.)
instructions: Cream butter 1/2 cup sugar and flour in a mixing bowl. Add egg yolks. Beat well. Stir in lemon rind lemon juice and milk. Add salt. Beat egg whites until stiff gradually beating in 1/2 cup sugar. Fold into first mixture. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish; set dish in shallow pan containing boiling water 1-inch deep. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool.

title: Oatmeal Cookies For A Crowd(96 Calories Per Serving)
instructions: Combine oatmeal flour sugar pecan meat or walnuts and oil. Blend and add water milk molasses salt and vanilla to first mixture. Add and mix raisins and walnuts well. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet; flatten. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Yields 8 dozen.

title: 1-2-3 Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add enough mayonnaise to mix up well.

title: Mexican Supper
instructions: In large container add meat beans corn sauce and tomatoes. Cook together about 5 to 7 minutes. Have grated cheese and nacho chips. Put chips in bowl. Pour Mexican mix over; add cheese on top. Serve green salad on side. This makes a lot and freezes well.

title: Oyster Casserole
instructions: Drain oysters. In a buttered 1-quart casserole place a layer of oysters a layer of crackers another layer of oysters and top with cracker crumbs. Season. Pour liquid from oysters or milk to measure 1/2 cup liquid over casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes (jackets on) until tender. Drain and cool thoroughly. Peel and dice potatoes. Add onion pickles and eggs and toss with mayonnaise. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Hot Corn
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Add cheese and remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Fruit Cake(No Bake - Keep In Refrigerator)
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; heat in pan slowly until oleo and marshmallows are melted. Mix dry ingredients. Pour the melted ingredients over the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Put in oiled Bundt pan to chill and set. Turn out and slice. Store in refrigerator. It also keeps well in freezer.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put into casserole dish.

title: 7 Can Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and pull meat from bones. Saute celery onions and bell pepper in butter for long time then set aside to cool.

title: Box Oven Dinner Pizza
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread crescent roll dough on bottom. Pinch seams together to form crust. Spread crust with pizza sauce then cheese meat and other toppings. Bake 20 to 30 minutes in box oven at 425\u00b0 (until cheese is bubbly and crust is browned).

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Lightly grease large Pyrex dish with margarine. Line bottom with dried beef. Open chicken cutlets and place small amount of butter in middle. Roll cutlets and hold in place with 1/2 strip bacon. Place on top of dried beef. Mix soup and sour cream together and pour on top of chicken. Bake slowly at 275\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Serve with rice.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Work first 5 ingredients until very fine crumbs. Remove 2 cups of crumbs and set aside. Add remaining crumbs to remaining ingredients. Beat until smooth. Divide batter into 3 (8-inch) greased round pans. Top with remaining crumbs that were set aside. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Spread in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Spread cream of mushroom soup over broccoli. Place sliced water chestnuts over this. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Spread cheese and French fried onions over dish. Bake for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Coconut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease Bundt pan with shortening then coat with sugar. Set aside. Mix together cake mix pudding eggs oil and sour cream until well blended. Fold in coconut walnuts and chocolate chip morsels. Pour into prepared Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour or until done.

title: Dark Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In heavy saucepan over low heat melt chips with milk and salt. Remove from heat and stir in walnuts and vanilla. Spread in greased 8 or 9-inch pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm.

title: Mom'S Drop Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In mixing bowl stir together flour powder and salt. Add shortening. Stir until it looks like corn meal. Add milk in parts until stiff. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until brown. Good with milk gravy.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Mix marshmallows and sour cream and let stand for several hours. Mix remaining ingredients and blend with sour cream and marshmallows.

title: Big-Wheel Burger Skillet
instructions: Mix together onion ground beef egg rolled oats salt pepper and milk. Mound in a 10-inch skillet. With a wooden spoon handle make 5 to 6 holes in mound. Combine spaghetti sauce and kidney beans (with liquid). Pour over and around meat mixture. Place over medium heat. When hot reduce heat and simmer 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 5 to 6 people.

title: Martha Washington
instructions: Mix above by hand. Shape into balls and refrigerate for 1 hour until firm. In top of double boiler melt 12 ounce chocolate bits with 3/4 square of paraffin. Get this real hot. Either at the stove or with chocolate in a cup dip the candy balls by using a toothpick in each. Put the candy immediately on a piece of wax paper. Remove toothpick and put a drop of chocolate in each little hole. Cool and eat.

title: Grandma Billie'S Marshmallows
instructions: Place gelatin and 1/2 cup cold water in bowl; let stand while you put sugar salt and 1/2 cup cold water in deep stew kettle. Boil to soft ball (235\u00b0). Pour gelatin mixture into the hot syrup. Beat it and beat it and beat it. Grease flat pan well on bottom and sides. Powder with powdered sugar and cornstarch. Pour mixture into pan and dust top; cool. Cut into squares and dust bowl on all sides.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine macaroni boiled eggs and onion; set aside. Combine sugar salt mustard and flour; add eggs and vinegar. Mix well; add water and stir until smooth. Cook until thickened. Pour over macaroni mixture. Do not add celery and lettuce until ready to serve. Sprinkle top with grated carrots.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Slice tomatoes; dip in corn meal. Put in skillet containing heated oil. Fry until corn meal turns lightly brown. Eat hot. Cook only what you can eat.

title: Shrimp Appetizer
instructions: Stir together shrimp and cocktail sauce. Place cream cheese on serving platter. Pour shrimp/sauce mixture over cheese. Place crackers around platter and serve.

title: Cornbread Sausage Dressing
instructions: Chop onions finely. Brown sausage and drain. Melt butter in a pan. Mix all ingredients. Stuff turkey neck and body cavity or can be cooked separately. In a 9 x 13-inch pan pour a little chicken broth over.

title: Pepperoni Rolls
instructions: Thaw dinner rolls and allow to rise in warm place until about double in size (approximately 3 hours). Flatten roll dough (each one separately) on cutting board or plate. Put 4 or 5 pieces of pepperoni and a generous amount of Mozzarella cheese. Roll into a ball keeping pepperoni and cheese inside. Bake on cookie sheet according to directions on rolls or until golden brown (approximately 12 to 15 minutes).

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook milk and sugar until a soft ball forms when a drop is put in cold water. Remove from flame. Add peanut butter and mix well. Pour into an 8 x 10-inch pan to cool.

title: Microwave No Fail Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together in 10 x 8-inch dish. Drop butter onto sugar mixture in 4 or 5 pieces. Pour in milk. Microwave 2 or 3 minutes on High or until bubbly. Stir lightly. Thoroughly stir in nuts and vanilla so nuts are evenly distributed. Spread fudge evenly in dish. Refrigerate 1 hour then cut into squares.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Put green beans in a casserole dish and add soup. Add 1/2 of the onion rings. Mix together well. Sprinkle top with remaining onion rings and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese And Vegetable Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the sour cream mayo and lemon juice. Add the broccoli cauliflower peas cheese and onion; toss to coat. Refrigerate covered until chilled at least 1 to 2 hours. Serve sprinkled with the bacon.

title: Bacon-Buttermilk Dressing
instructions: Prepare and chill this creamy mixture at least an hour in advance so the flavors can blend and mellow.

title: Consumer Union'S* Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together sugars and softened margarine. Add vanilla and eggs; beat until creamy. Sift dry ingredients together. Gradually add dry ingredients to the other mixture. Add the chocolate chips mixing for 10 to 15 seconds. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 11 minutes. Cool and eat.

title: $100 Coconut Cake(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box for 9-inch cake layers. Cool and slice each layer. You will have 4 layers after sliced.

title: Lillian Hellman'S Pot Roast
instructions: Place roast in large pan. Mix all other ingredients together and pour over roast. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 3 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place into a deep pie shell. Top with another pie shell. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage until done and drain. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Mix well about halfway through.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli onion and celery in 2 cups water until tender (do not drain). Melt margarine. Add flour and bouillon. When bubbly add 2 1/2 cups water. Combine pans until boils. Stir in cream. Garnish with shredded Cheddar cheese if desired.

title: Rhubarb Jello Salad
instructions: Cook rhubarb then add sugar to hot rhubarb and jello. Stir well and then add pineapple. Do not drain pineapple. Mix well and put in a bowl to jell.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes and take insides out and set peel aside to fill later. Mix remaining ingredients. Put into potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chinese Noodle Salad With Shrimp
instructions: To the drained cooked noodles add the celery shrimp green onion pepper and pimento. Mix well. Add enough Best Foods mayonnaise so that you can stir easily. Add seasoning. Decorate with olives and parsley. This salad is better if it sits overnight.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Mash egg yolks with mustard. Add milk sugar Miracle Whip vinegar and salt. Add chopped egg whites celery green peppers and onions.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
