instructions: Brown sausage add celery onion and bell peppers and saute in grease. Mix soup and Cheez Whiz well while warming. Combine cooked rice sausage mixture and soup and cheese mixture all together in large casserole dish. Cook in oven at 400\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Layered Fruit Salad
instructions: Layer apples apricots pears peaches and pineapple in a large bowl. Combine orange juice and lemon juice. Pour over fruit. Spread cherry pie filling on top then cover and chill 2 hours. Arrange bananas over pie filling. Sprinkle with coconut. Serve immediately. Yields 14 to 16 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Thaw shrimp and blend in blender. Add all other ingredients and season with the seasonings to taste.

title: Poor Man'S Dinner
instructions: In skillet brown meat. Season with pepper and garlic powder. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish thinly layer the beef potatoes and onion slices. Pour soup over all. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Aunt Millie'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook broccoli in the boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and set aside.

title: Broccoli Ham Ring
instructions: Slice potatoes in skillet with olive oil or canola oil for frying. Season to taste (pepper and salt). Add a pinch of sugar if desired. Slice 1/2-inch pieces of green peppers onions mushrooms kielbasa or Polish sausage on top. Fry until golden brown turning once or twice.

title: Diet Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pie filling in large glass casserole dish. Spoon and spread pineapple over pie filling. Sprinkle dry cake mix over top of fruit. Pour liquid Butter Buds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown and looks \done\. Best served warm.

title: Broccoli-Mandarin Salad
instructions: *Scatter in shallow pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until lightly toasted. Dont let burn.

title: Plain Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat for 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake shrinks from sides of pan (greased 13 x 9-inch pan). Good for strawberry shortcake.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Cook onion in small amount of hot fat until tender but not brown. Add meat and seasonings; brown lightly. Add drained beans and soup. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Mash potatoes while hot. Add milk egg and seasonings. Drop in mounds over meat. If you like sprinkle potatoes with 1/2 cup shredded cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cherry Breeze Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until light and fluffy. Add Eagle Brand milk (condensed) and beat thoroughly. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Turn into crust. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours until firm. Top with cherry pie filling before serving.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Fold in peanut butter milk and Cool Whip; mix well. Let set about 4 hours in the refrigerator.

title: Mixed Nut Bars
instructions: Mix flour sugar and butter like a pie crust. Pat into 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt other ingredients until melted. Add nuts and pour over cooled crust. Return to oven and bake for additional 10 to 15 minutes until bubbly. Remove and cut into squares while still warm.

title: Low-Fat Ranch Dressing
instructions: In small bowl combine all ingredients. Cover and chill.

title: Honey Dressing For Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together in blender. Refrigerate. Shake well before adding to salad.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all fruit together. Stir pudding mix into pineapple juice. Mix with fruit. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Make a sponge cake mixture by beating eggs and adding salt sifted sugar and water. Then add flour and baking powder. Spread 1/4 c. butter on bottom of cake pan. Add 1 c. brown sugar 1 can shredded pineapple. Pour the sponge cake mixture over this and bake in a moderate oven. When done turn on a platter cover with whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Pour strawberries into pastry shell. Mix water sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Boil until clear and thick. Remove from heat. Add jello and let cool. Pour over strawberries and let set in the refrigerator.

title: Cream Of Tomato Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan combine chicken broth onion tomato and basil. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Place half of mixture in blender. Cover and blend 30 to 60 seconds until smooth. Pour in a bowl; repeat with remaining mixture. Set aside.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter in a large iron frying pan. Lay in pineapple slices with cherries in the middle.

title: Low Calorie Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine together. Add vanilla or almond extract. Mix in egg yolks. Mix dry ingredients with butter mixture alternating with strawberries. Beat egg whites until they form stiff peaks. Fold in egg whites and turn into a buttered loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50-60 minutes. Nice with coffee or tea.

title: Fruit Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil macaroni in 3 quarts boiling water. Drain fruit (save juice). Bring juice sugar and flour almost to a boil. Blend in 4 beaten eggs until thickened. Cool macaroni and juice mixture. Mix together. Add in fruit and Cool Whip. Blend well. Add in more drained fruit as desired.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar soda cocoa and salt. Put in oblong cake pan. Make 3 holes in dry ingredients. Put 3/4 cup oil in one hole 1 teaspoon vanilla in one hole and the other hole vinegar. Pour cold water over all. Mix with fork. Do not beat. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Prick each potato 3 times. Arrange in a circle in microwave. Microwave on High 14 minutes. Remove and let stand 5 minutes. While potatoes are cooling cook bacon on High for 4 1/2 minutes. In a bowl mix vinegar cornstarch sugar salt celery seed and pepper. Stir in onion. Microwave 8 minutes. Cut potatoes in 1/2-inch pieces. Add to broth mixture along with pimentos. Toss to mix and coat. Crumble bacon over top. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Cook nuts in oil 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Mix vinegar brown sugar salt cornstarch and soy sauce. Dredge chicken pieces in mixture. Fry vegetables in oil. Remove them and fry chicken until sightly brown. Return vegetables and broth. Cook until vegetables and chicken are tender stirring often. Add nuts just before finished cooking. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Mash wafers and mix with fruit and nuts. Add enough condensed milk to hold together. After firm sprinkle with whiskey.

title: Banana Brickle Muffins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. In a large bowl combine the eggs banana oil and milk; mix well. Add the flour brown sugar and baking powder stirring just until moistened. Set aside 1/4 cup of the toffee bits; stir the remaining toffee bits into the batter. Lightly grease 18 muffin cups or line them with paper baking cups. Fill the cups 2/3 full with batter. Sprinkle with the reserved toffee bits and bake for about 20 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in the center of a muffin comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes in the pan on a wire rack. Remove muffins and cool completely on the wire rack. Yields 18 muffins.

title: Barbecue Hash
instructions: Cook beef and pork covered with 2 or 3 inches of water and cook until meat is in small pieces. Then add other ingredients and cook for 3 or 4 hours stirring constantly. Serves 5 to 8 persons.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs until fluffy. Stir in drained pineapple. Fold in bread cubes. Bake uncovered in a greased casserole for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Tippsy Squire
instructions: Into a large Tupperware bowl with lid break pound cake into small pieces. Add nuts apricots and bourbon. Into a heavy saucepan add eggs milk and sugar. Stir well. Cook over medium heat until mixture will coat a wooden spoon. Pour cooked mixture over pound cake apricots nuts and bourbon. Stir until well mixed. Cover and place in refrigerator for 4 hours or longer. When ready to serve place serving in a parfait glass; top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry.

title: Easy Skillet Potatoes
instructions: In a large skillet over medium flame cook onion slices in melted butter until tender about 5 minutes. Remove the cooked onion to a plate and keep warm for later use. Add potatoes and salt to the remaining butter in skillet; cover and cook over medium flame until potatoes are golden brown. Add onions to potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook until cheese melts. Yield 6 servings.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Remove skin and bones from breast. Halve them. Wrap a piece of bacon around each piece of chicken. Spray 13 x 9-inch pan with nonstick spray. Line bottom of pan with chipped beef. Arrange chicken on beef. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours or until chicken is thoroughly done. Serve over rice.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix in order listed. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes on 350\u00b0.

title: Homemade Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: In a large bowl stir together the cocoa sugar powdered milk non-dairy creamer and salt. Store in air tight containers or glass jars.

title: Marinated Cucumbers
instructions: Mix sugar salt and vinegar. Pour over cucumber slices and chill for 4 hours. Keep several days in refrigerator.

title: Dip
instructions: Mix beef taco seasoning tomatoes and cheese. Mix well. If you like it warm heat in microwave for a few seconds and keep warm in small crock-pot.

title: Mahogany Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugars beating well at medium speed. Add egg yolks one at a time beating after each. Sift flour and cocoa together. Combine sour cream and baking soda. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Stir in vanilla. Beat egg whites; fold into batter.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix together the ground beef corn flakes egg sweet relish mustard and onion. Roll into balls and place in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until half way done; cover with tomato soup and continue cooking until done. Serve with cooked spaghetti.

title: Willie'S Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Mix peanut butter graham cracker crumbs sugar and margarine together. Mix well! Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips in microwave and spread over mixture. Let set at least 2 hours in refrigerator. Cut in squares.

title: Cream Cherry Pie
instructions: Cook milk flour egg yolks sugar and salt until mixture starts to thicken. Add margarine marshmallows and vanilla. Pour into cooked crust. Then add on top already prepared pie cherries. Top with meringue and bake until lightly brown. Let set.

title: Barbecue(Spicy-Sweet)
instructions: Cook roast until it falls apart. Cool and tear apart. Place in a large pot. Mix all other ingredients and add to meat. Simmer at least 40 minutes.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and mix. Place in jar and store in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook sugar syrup water and salt until mixture threads or 290\u00b0 to 300\u00b0. Add butter and peanuts. Cook until mixture turns light brown in color. Add soda. Pour a thin layer in a pan to cool.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Sift flour in a tray or long dish. Make a hole in the middle of the flour with your hands. Put the potatoes in the hole. Add Crisco baking powder water and salt. Mix by hand like you would other biscuits. Pinch off dough in biscuit size pieces. Roll in floured hand until smooth. Place in greased biscuit pan and bake in oven at 475\u00b0 until done. Serve warm with butter. Makes about 24.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Cover bottom of iron skillet with grease. Add mixture to pan. Heat on burner before putting in oven. Cook 25-30 minutes at 400 degrees. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Creamy Coleslaw
instructions: Whisk together mayo sour cream mustard lemon juice and sugar. Core and quarter the cabbage. Cut quarters into 1/8-inch julienne to make approximately 6 cups. Peel carrots and grate coarsely. Wash and core apples; grate coarsely. Combine cabbage carrots and apples. Add dressing and toss thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate overnight to let slaw marinate.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch the gelatin and boiling water until dissolved. Add pineapple (undrained) and blueberry pie filling. Stir and let set. Mix sour cream with cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Do not overbeat. Spread on top of gelatin mixture. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets. In a medium size bowl mix flour with baking soda salt and cinnamon. In a large bowl beat margarine peanut butter and both sugars until creamy. Add eggs; blend in milk and vanilla. Stir in flour and cinnamon mixture; blend well. Fold in oatmeal and raisins.

title: Italian Cheesecake
instructions: Combine ingredients in order in baking dish (glass or Corning Ware). Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour until top begins to turn light brown. Bake in glass or Corning Ware dish 13 x 8 3/4-inch.

title: Roasted Venison(Hind Quarter)
instructions: Clean all fat from meat. Poke holes in meat. Place meat in a roasting pan; cover with your favorite oil based salad dressing (Italian red wine and vinegar Caesar etc.). Slice 2 large onions and add to pan. Marinate for 2 to 12 hours. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0; cook meat (covered) at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is pulling from the bone. Do not overcook. Drippings make good stock for gravy. Just add flour and water mixed. Will feed 12 to 15 people.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Cut dates up and put warm water over them. Let stand until you have the rest mixed together. Then drain well and throw away the water. Add dates to other mixture and bake in a greased and floured 11 x 7 x 1/4-inch pan until done. Cool. Cut into bars and roll in powdered sugar. These require no shortening!

title: Caramel Pecan Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix brown sugar cream and 1/4 cup melted butter in angel food pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Mix cinnamon and sugar in bowl or on waxed paper.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Combine 1 cup meal salt and soda; mix in bowl. Add eggs milk corn and bacon grease. Stir until smooth; set aside. Saute beef and sausage; drain. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cornmeal in greased skillet and heat. Pour half of batter in the skillet; sprinkle with cheese ground beef sausage and onion then pepper. Pour remaining batter over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand in skillet about 10 minutes.

title: Croutons
instructions: Cut bread slices in 1/2-inch cubes. Bake on cookie sheet until dry. You can sprinkle with cheese garlic or herbs after drizzling with butter (if so desired). Bake at 225\u00b0 about 2 hours.

title: Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix in bowl. Bake for 15 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Can brown bread crumbs in butter. Put cheese on top.

title: Chicken Breasts With Bulgur Wheat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 5-quart Dutch oven or casserole combine all ingredients in order given. Stir to combine. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours.

title: Blueberry Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare Jell-O and add the pie filling. Put in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass pan. Set in refrigerator. Allow it to set for at least 4 hours. Combine the sour cream and powdered sugar. Spread over set Jell-O. Serve after chilled.

title: Pesto Pizza
instructions: Spread pesto sauce over pizza shell. Top with grated Mozzarella cheese. Saute in olive oil the cubed tofu sliced and ringed or chopped onions sliced mushrooms and about 2 tablespoons sesame seed. Add to top of pizza. Add cut up artichoke hearts chopped or torn spinach pine nuts (worth the expense) pineapple (optional) and sliced tomatoes. Top with Parmesan cheese and crumbled Feta cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange apples in ungreased square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Stir together oats brown sugar and cinnamon in medium bowl. Cut in margarine. Stir in cereal. Sprinkle over apples. Bake uncovered 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Date Cake
instructions: Cut dates into small pieces. Place in bowl. Sprinkle soda over dates. Pour boiling water over dates and let stand until cool. Beat together eggs oil sweetener and vanilla. Add flour salt and baking powder. Add cooled date mixture and nuts. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cut all vegetables into bite sized pieces. Toss lightly. Add remaining ingredients after mixing over vegetables. Chill at least 3 hours.

title: Laverne'S Quick Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix all ingredients together pour in oblong pan. Dont stir. Pour fruit over the top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Melt margarine mince garlic and simmer together 3 minutes. Add shrimp and all other ingredients except cornstarch mixture. Cook about 10 minutes on low flame. Then add cornstarch and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Crusty Beef, Cheese And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Heat oil; add onion and cook until golden. Add meat and cook until meat loses its red color. Add mushroom sauce and heat. Arrange in casserole half of noodles half of sauce and half of cheese. Make another layer of noodles. Add sauce and top with cheese. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour until top is nicely browned. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix all ingredients together. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake until golden brown approximately 25 minutes.

title: Okra Gumbo
instructions: May have to add more water. Boil until cooked.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all juice from first 2 ingredients. Put marshmallows in large bowl. Pour fruit over; let stand for 1 hour. Fold in sour cream. Let stand overnight.

title: Microwave Broccoli And Cauliflower Cheese Sauce
instructions: Microwave first 3 ingredients 2 minutes on High stirring after each minute. Add milk gradually. Microwave 4 minutes stirring after each minute. When sauce is thick add cheese slices and blend in. Pour over vegetables.

title: Twisted River Ranch Cabbage Salad
instructions: Poach chicken; let cool and chop. Toast sesame seed. Break up noodles (do not cook). Add cabbage onions sesame seed and chicken.

title: Old Fashion Cream Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Keep heat on medium. Add sugar and stir. Add cornstarch and stir. Add milk and stir until it boils. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Pour immediately into baked pie shell. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Baked Lemon Catfish
instructions: Place fish on foil. In skillet melt oleo and saute celery carrots and onions. Spread over fish. Sprinkle with lemon juice salt and pepper. Seal foil well. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 or 25 minutes depending on thickness of fish. Contains 322 calories 26 grams fat 14 grams carbohydrates 106 mg cholesterol and 298 mg sodium.

title: Baked Steak
instructions: Salt and pepper the round steak and brown on both sides. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add onions green peppers mushroom soup and water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans in large bowl. When thoroughly mixed add pecans; stir to coat well. Spread peanuts on foil covered cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Stir once or twice to crisp and dry evenly.

title: Loaf Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk. Bake 2 hours at 300\u00b0 in a greased tube pan. Cool. Great plain or topped with fresh strawberries and Cool Whip.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and salad oil. Stir until dry ingredients are moist. Do not beat. Stir in pineapple vanilla nuts and bananas. Spoon batter into three 9-inch cake pans. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cake tests done. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Remove and cool thoroughly. Spread frosting between layers and on top of cake.

title: Easy Italian Chicken
instructions: Prepare Italian dressing according to directions but substitute red wine vinegar instead of apple cider vinegar. Marinate chicken breasts in dressing. Bake at 450\u00b0 until chicken is done.

title: Vegetable Kabobs
instructions: Place broccoli and cauliflower in water in a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole. Microcook covered on 100% power (High) for 5 minutes. Gently stir in potatoes tomatoes (quartered) and wedged onions. Cover; cook 4 to 6 minutes or until nearly tender. Drain and cool slightly. Put cooked veggies on skewer. Add uncooked zucchini between veggies. Brush with salad dressing and grill 10 to 12 minutes. Brush with dressing as they are turned.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Put rhubarb in pan. Cover with water and cook 5 minutes. Drain. Mix egg yolks sugar flour cream and butter well. Add rhubarb and cook until thick. Pour into pie shell. Top with meringue and brown.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine soups water butter and mushrooms. Heat and stir over moderate heat. When warm blend. Remove 1 cup of mixture and set aside. To remaining add rice and stir. Pour mixture into 13 x 9-inch glass dish. Place chicken on top. Pour the reserved 1 cup soup mixture over chicken. Place in a 325\u00b0 oven. Bake 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cincinnati Chili
instructions: Add ground beef to water in a 4-quart pot; stir until beef separates into a fine texture. Boil slowly for 1/2 hour. Add all remaining ingredients. Stir to blend bringing to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 3 hours. Last hour may cover if desired consistency is reached (will not be as thick as conventional chili). May refrigerate overnight and skim fat from top before reheating. Serve over spaghetti with Cheddar cheese. (May also add chopped onions if to your taste.)

title: Stuffed New Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes on a medium heat till soft and cool in fridge . Combine the rest of the ingredients together. Cut cooled potatoes in half. With a melon scoop or a small spoon scoop out a bit of potato and discard. Spoon some of the mixture into the potato about a Tbsp. Bake 375\u00b0 15-20 minutes. Serve immediately. If any of the mixture left save in the fridge. It works great on top of a baked potato!

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
instructions: Use a large glass bowl if available. Layer lettuce in bottom of bowl. Add a layer of sliced eggs standing some up on the side of bowl. Add a layer of chopped onions celery and pepper. Add another layer of lettuce. Add a layer of English peas. Add a layer of chopped tomatoes. Add a layer of shredded cheese. Spread a layer of mayonnaise over the top of it all sealing to the edge of the bowl. Sprinkle with a layer of bacon bits. Cover and let set overnight. Toss before serving.

title: Cucumber Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Refrigerate. Serve with vegetable dippers in red or green bell pepper. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Pour oil in a large frying pan add chopped onion and garlic; brown. Add hamburger; brown. Add eggs and scramble. Add rice and soy sauce until rice turns light brown in color. Add drained shrimp.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and take off bone. Cook noodles. Add cream of chicken soup. Stir together. Add a little sweet milk. Top with herb stuffing or toasted bread crumbs. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain corn and beans or broccoli. Mix together with above ingredients. Pour into buttered casserole dish.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Place in baking dish. Bake for 45 minutes at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Ovens may vary.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
instructions: Brown meat with onions in a skillet. Place in crock-pot (low) with all other ingredients except potatoes. Cook 3 hours (up to 6 hours on low). Add potatoes approximately 45 minutes prior to being served. To thicken add a little flour and water (in a shaker mix) to mixture. The longer you can let simmer the better. (Dont forget the corn bread!)

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Put into casserole dish and sprinkle with cornflake crumbs. Dot top of casserole with 2 tablespoons margarine. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Trifle
instructions: Spread half the ladyfingers with preserves. Top with remaining halves. Line sides and bottom of 5 cup 3-inch deep serving dish with ladyfingers. Moisten with sherry (or brandy etc.). Fold whipped cream into eggnog until well blended. Pour carefully in center of dish. Cover with plastic wrap. Chill several hours or overnight. Garnish with whipped cream preserves and almonds is additional and optional. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a buttered dish. Crumble approximately 15 Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top. Dab with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Twenty-Four Hour Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit and set aside. Mix together beaten egg yolks pineapple juice flour and sugar. Cook until thick then let cool. Add cherries to cooked mixture. Pour mixture over pineapple and fruit cocktail. Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Add bananas marshmallows and whipped topping.

title: Green Pea Casserole
instructions: Drain cooked frozen peas or canned peas. If frozen peas are used cook in 1/2 cup boiling salted water. Put 1 cupful in a buttered baking dish.

title: Wimpies
instructions: Saute onion and celery (chopped) in small amount of oil. Add hamburg and brown. Add ketchup Worcestershire and chili sauce. Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer slowly (low heat) for 1 hour stirring often.

title: Turkey Divan
instructions: Heat margarine in 1-quart saucepan over low heat until melted. Stir in flour and nutmeg. Cook stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in 1/2 cup cheese and the apple juice.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie
instructions: Cream margarine in small mixer bowl. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Combine sugar and flour; add to butter/egg mixture. Stir in chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Cool for 1 hour and serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Brussels Sprouts Supreme
instructions: Place Brussels sprouts celery and a small amount of water in a saucepan; cover and cook for 8 minutes or until crisp-tender. Meanwhile in another saucepan melt butter. Stir flour until smooth. Gradually add milk; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Add cheese salt and cayenne if desired; stir until cheese is melted. Drain sprouts and celery; top with cheese sauce. Yield 4-6 servings.

title: Zucchini Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Best Ever Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water along with cream cheese and marshmallows; beat until smooth. When semi-thickened add nuts pineapple and whipped cream. Nuts and pineapple may be left out.

title: Freezer Tomato Sauce
instructions: In a large kettle bring 4-inches of water to boiling. Immerse tomatoes in boiling water for 1 minute.\tDrain in a colander. Peel seed and chop tomatoes. (You should have 10 cups.)

title: Cold Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and put in freezer until its like slush.

title: Campfire Eclairs
instructions: You will need 1/2-inch or larger 18-inch wooden dowels and 1 campfire.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Mix meat and the next 4 ingredients to make meat balls. Form into balls and saute in butter. Heat pizza sauce and jelly in pot until jelly melts and sauce is hot. Add meat balls; cook and serve. Makes 40 meat balls.

title: Snicker'S Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Pour half batter into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Melt caramels with margarine and milk in saucepan over low heat stirring frequently. Pour over baked cake. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Spoon remaining cake batter over caramel layer. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Increase temperature to 300\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes longer. Yield 16 to 20 servings.

title: Deep-Fried Okra
instructions: Wash okra and slice into 1/4 inch wheels. Salt well then sprinkle hush puppy mix (about 1/2 cup) over okra to coat. Place okra in a colander and run cold water over to wet. Mix remaining hush puppy mix with flour and sugar in a large bowl with a tight fitting lid. Take the okra from the colander place into mixture cover and shake until okra is completely coated. Shake excess mixture from okra and fry in oil until golden brown. Oil needs to be hot when you put the okra in it.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cut strawberries into pie shells until approximately 1/2 full. Mix water sugar and cornstarch. Cook on medium heat until thickened stirring constantly. Add small box jello. Mix well. Pour over strawberries into pie shell. Let completely cool until set. Cover with Cool Whip and serve.

title: Cathedral Candy(Makes 4 Rolls)
instructions: Melt chocolate chips with butter. Beat eggs and vanilla. Boil 5 minutes. Cool. In large bowl mix marshmallows with nuts. Pour chocolate mixture on marshmallows. Mix together. Cut 4 (1 foot) pieces of foil. Sprinkle confectioners sugar on foil. Place some marshmallow mixture on foil. Roll up. Freeze 2 hours. Slice.

title: Blueberry Tea Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. In medium bowl with wooden spoon beat egg; gradually beat in 2/3 cup sugar. Sift together flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. Add to sugar mixture alternately with milk. Add margarine and vanilla. Beat thoroughly. Fold in blueberries.

title: 4 Layer Marshmallow Bars
instructions: Mix cake margarine and water until blended. Pat into 13 x 9-inch baking pan. (Use Pam or grease pan if not a nonstick pan.) Bake until done or 22 to 24 minutes at 375\u00b0. Layer marshmallows then candies and nuts on baked cake. Put back in oven 2 to 3 minutes or until marshmallows are melted.

title: Mom'S Burritos
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Pour off grease. Add 1 package taco seasoning and 1 taco seasoning package of water. Add refried beans and chiles. Mix well and simmer for about 20 minutes. Fill tortillas with meat mixture Cheddar cheese and other condiments as desired.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer in a large bowl lettuce 2 teaspoons sugar cauliflower chopped onion 2 teaspoons sugar bacon 2 teaspoons sugar. Cover top of salad with mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese. Cover and chill.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Fresh Tomatoes
instructions: Heat oil in medium saucepan. Add zucchini squash and garlic; cook for 3 minutes; Add tomatoes and basil; cook for 5 minutes or until hot and slightly thickened. Toss pasta with sauce. Garnish with Parmesan cheese.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Boil mushrooms until tender (about 1/2 hour). Remove stems; snip into small pieces. Combine stems with remaining ingredients. Roll mixture into small balls and place inside caps. Place on greased (Pam) baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix eggs and water 3 to 5 minutes with mixer. Add 1 cup sugar. Mix again. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla then add dry ingredients. Grease and flour 10 to 15-inch pan. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven 10 to 15 minutes. Turn out on towel dusted with powdered sugar. Unroll when cool and spread with favorite jelly. Remove towel and roll back up.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; add beaten eggs sugar and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Ham Delights
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Blend margarine mustard onion poppy seed and Worcestershire sauce. Spread top and bottom of party rolls with the mixture. Place boiled ham and Swiss cheese on rolls. Cut into squares and wrap in foil. Bake for 10 minutes. Great party or shower food! Freezes well!

title: Thanksgiving Day Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; cool. Add strawberries and cranberry sauce. Stir. Add nuts. Pour into 2-quart ring mold. Refrigerate overnight. Put on lettuce leaves to serve.

title: Sweet Cucumber And Dill Salad
instructions: Place cucumber slices in colander; sprinkle with salt. Toss. Let drain for 15 minutes. Combine vinegar sugar and cayenne pepper. Pat cucumber slices dry and toss with dressing and dill. Serve chilled or at room temperature. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put can of cherry pie filling spread evenly in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Next put can of pineapple; spread this evenly over cherries. Next put box of dry cake mix on top of pineapple; spread evenly. Next cut butter into patties then drop over top of cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Luncheon Meat
instructions: Mix last 3 ingredients; spread on top of luncheon meat that has been sliced and placed in a casserole dish. Cover and heat for 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove cover and let cook 10 minutes longer.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Peel avocados; take seed out and mash. Add lemon juice; mix well. Place into pizza pan. Mix the sour cream garlic powder and salt; pour on top of avocados. Mix up picante sauce; pour on top of sour cream mixture. Add chopped peppers onions black olives and cheese to top. Cover; chill several hours. Serve with Fritos.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in large bowl. Crush 1 roll Ritz crackers; mix with 1/2 cup melted butter. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind raw cranberries orange and apple quarters. Leave the peelings on. Mix well with sugar and allow to stand 24 hours before serving.

title: Texas Red
instructions: Brown beef in skillet. Add remaining ingredients. Great over spaghetti or macaroni.

title: Real Fruit Cake
instructions: Chop or cut fine all fruit and nuts; mix well and combine with old fashion pound cake dough using 10 eggs to corresponding proportions. This recipe makes two nice cakes unexcelled.

title: Easy Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together until well blended (with electric mixer about 2 minutes). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes in greased and floured tube pan. After baking turn onto plate and pour sugar glaze over slightly warm cake.

title: Carita'S Banana Pudding(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Mix instant pudding according to box directions. Set aside while you slice the bananas; pudding will thicken slightly. Add bananas and vanilla wafers to pudding; stir to mix. Fold in whipped topping. Refrigerate; garnish with extra vanilla wafers or banana slices. Makes about 10 servings.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine bread milk and cream in a bowl. Beat eggs with sugar; add to bread. Add vanilla spices butter and raisins. Butter baking dish. Set in shallow pan. Pour hot water in pan (1-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and pudding. Add pineapple with juice and marshmallows. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Light Alfredo Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of electric blender; process until smooth stopping once to scrape down sides. Pour into a small saucepan; cook sauce over low heat stirring constantly until thoroughly heated. Yield 2 3/4 cups. Serve over pasta.

title: Crescent Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls out flat on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Mix together cream cheese and mayonnaise. Spread on rolls. Press onto cheese spread small bite size pieces of celery broccoli carrot cauliflower or whatever vegetables you want.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in small amount of fat; drain. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Flubber(Non-Edible, But Kids Love It!)
instructions: You will also need 2 large bowls measuring cups strainer measuring spoons and a spatula.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed and mash very fine. Add Cheez Whiz Velveeta cheese and chopped chestnuts. Sprinkle top of mixture with grated cheese and serve warm.

title: Baked Beans(For 75 People)
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a large container or electric oven and mix well. Heat at 375\u00b0 until bubbly on sides. Then reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and cook 1 1/2 hours more. Stir frequently.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground chuck; drain and add taco seasoning according to package directions. Set aside to cool. Tear lettuce into large bowl; add cheese tomatoes and cooled meat. In separate bowl combine taco sauce and mayonnaise. Pour over lettuce mixture and toss until all is coated. Serve and sprinkle crushed Doritos over top.

title: Apple Butter Bars
instructions: Combine flour soda and salt in a large bowl. Add oats and sugar. Stir in butter and mix well. Press half of mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking pan; top with apple butter. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture; press gently with a spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until browned. Cool. Cut into bars. Yield 3 dozen bars.

title: Noodle And Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Heat soups and milk. Add noodles and meat mixture. Pour into buttered baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until the noodles are done about 1 hour.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Mix mayo pimento Worcestershire mustard and 1/2 cheese in blender until smooth. Add rest of cheese. Blend until smooth.

title: Luncheon Meat-Hot Dish
instructions: Stir in chow mein noodles. Bake in a covered dish for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cube bread slices; fry in butter. Pour over the top 15 minutes before done and put back in oven with cover off for 10 to 15 minutes until crisp. This freezes well.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: *Make your own cornbread or use 2 packages Korn Kits and mix according to directions and bake. Let cool.

title: Butterscotch Bars
instructions: Place eggs and brown sugar in top of double boiler. Cook for 20 minutes. Add flour baking powder and salt. Mix well and add pecans. Pour in greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar and cut in squares.

title: Bouillabaisse
instructions: Cook broth with tomato (break up) and bay leaf. Add clams and shrimp. Add crab and fish just to cook.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling salted water drain. Melt butter blend in flour salt and dash of pepper. Add chicken broth all at once cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles. Stir in whipping cream. Place broccoli crosswise in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Add half of the sauce. Top with chicken pieces. To remaining sauce add Parmesan cheese; pour over chicken and sprinkle with extra Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Then broil just until sauce is golden. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except butterscotch chips. Pour into 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Pour the butterscotch chips on top of batter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lexington-Style Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer adding salt and pepper to taste. Cook stirring until the sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and let stand until cool. (Make tangy and hot to suit your taste.)

title: Grilled Onions
instructions: Peel onions and cut in half. Place on a sheet of foil large enough to cover onion. Sprinkle generously with Tonys and lemon pepper (about 1 teaspoon each) over onion. Add about 1 teaspoon of oleo on top of onion and wrap in foil. (It should look like a large Hersheys Kiss.) Grill or bake in oven for about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Hill Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs diced apples walnuts and raisins. Sift together flour salt cinnamon nutmeg and baking soda. Add flour mixture to apple mixture. Mix and pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 1 hour in preheated oven at 350\u00b0. Dab each piece with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Chicken And Basil Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions except omit any oil and use 1/4 teaspoon salt. Drain pasta. Rinse with cold water; drain. Meanwhile rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Spray an unheated large skillet with nonstick coating. Preheat over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Sprinkle with the salt and pepper. Remove chicken from heat. In a large mixing bowl toss together cooked macaroni chicken tomatoes zucchini or summer squash and green onions. Drizzle with salad dressing. Sprinkle with basil. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 6 hours. Toss salad before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix sour cream and egg together. Next add corn and corn bread mix to sour cream. Put in casserole and top with butter. Cut in small squares. Cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until golden brown.

title: Pork Chops A La Vineyards
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a saucepan and simmer 5 minutes. Add cornstarch mixture to thicken. When thickened add parsley and paprika. Bake pork chops 30 minutes at 450\u00b0. Remove chops to another dish. Add sauce and bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Boil rice without stirring until tender. Raisins boiled with the rice is an improvement in which case add little more water. Beat eggs sugar milk salt butter nutmeg and vanilla. Add this mixture to rice. Place in moderate oven. Bake slowly for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Open oven door every half hour and with spoon break the crust and stir up the rice. Be sure to bake very slowly. It will dry.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries sugar and water 5 minutes and chill. Dissolve jello in boiling water then add cold water.When it begins to congeal add nuts celery and pineapple. Chill cranberry mixture and let congeal.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Melt butter until soft. Add vanilla and stir combine all other ingredients. Mix with your hands. Roll dough on floured surface into medium size balls. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Meatballs In Mushroom Sauce With Noodles
instructions: Bring water and salt for noodles to boil. In medium bowl combine stuffing onions and milk. When soft add beef egg and Worcestershire sauce. Mix until combined. Shape into 2 dozen meatballs. Add noodles to boiling water.

title: Texas Hot Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large kettle. Pour off fat. Place soup into kettle; add about one soup can of water then add all the other ingredients. Mix well; bring to a boil then simmer slowly until mixture thickens about 2 hours. If desired a tablespoon or two of flour dissolved in a small amount of water may be added near the end of the cooking time. Remove bay leaves before serving; serve over grilled hot dogs. First spread mustard over dog then add chopped onions and top with sauce.

title: Washday Mini Reubens
instructions: Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into triangles. Place one slice corn beef across wide end of triangle. Spread 2 tbsp sauerkraut on corned beef. Top with two strips of Swiss cheese. Add dab of Thousand Island dressings. Roll up beginning at wide end of triangle. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 while arranging sandwiches on an un-greased baking sheet. Put baking sheet into oven for 10-15 minutes. Check sandwiches. Do they look brown? Good! Transfer to a large plate plate and eat all eight!

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Divide juice between 4 bowls. Do same with all vegetables. Chill until serving time. Just before serving swirl 1 ounce sour cream into each serving. Makes 4 (1 cup) servings.

title: Old Fashioned Stew
instructions: In Dutch oven combine stew 1 1/2 cups water salt Worcestershire sauce paprika pepper and bay leaf. Cover and cook on low heat about 20 minutes. Add carrots and potatoes until tender. Remove bay leaf. Blend flour with 1/2 cup water. Stir slowly into hot liquid. Cook and stir until thickened. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until soft. Mix in separate bowl mayonnaise soup onion cheese and eggs. Pour over broccoli in casserole pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and bananas then combined dry ingredients. Fold nuts and bake in two smaller or one large loaf pan. The pans should be one-half full. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Stir all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mom'S Best Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. Sift together dry ingredients salt baking powder and spices. Add eggs oats flour and raisins. Spoon teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes (do not overbake). Soft and chewy.

title: Classic Green Bean Bake
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Add beans and 1/2 can of onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 more minutes. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Seafood Mold
instructions: Mix liquids and spices. Add everything else. Mix well. Place in mold. Mold will be firm in 2 hours in refrigerator. If placed in individual molds will firm up in approximately 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss to mix well. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Yields 12 servings.

title: Apricot Balls
instructions: Grind or dice apricots. Add coconut and milk. Shape into balls. Melt together Hershey bar chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip apricot balls in chocolate mixture and put on waxed paper to cool.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Mix in flour salt and pepper. Add grated cheese and as it begins to melt; add milk. Cook until thick. Place 1/2 of bread crumbs in bottom of casserole. Put remaining ingredients in layers beginning with asparagus sliced eggs pimentos mushrooms then pour over part of sauce. Make another layer and top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef. Then add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 1 1/2 hours or until rice is cooked.

title: Mexican Style Eggs
instructions: Whisk together eggs egg whites salt and pepper in a bowl. Heat butter in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add onion tomato jalapenos and cilantro. Saute 2 to 3 minutes until onion is clear. Add egg mixture to skillet. Cook stirring until desired consistency 4 to 6 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Coke Salad
instructions: Heat Coke to melt jello. Add rest of ingredients and chill.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Sausage and cheese need to be at room temperature. Mash sausage. Sprinkle cheese and flour in a little at a time. Put on greased cookie sheets. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Turn and cook 10 to 12 minutes longer. To keep warm put in crock-pot on low heat. Great for parties.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Empty 1 can pork and beans into bottom of greased casserole. Combine sugar and mustard; sprinkle half of mixture over beans. Sprinkle the rest of sugar-mustard chopped bacon and catsup over beans. Or if you prefer you may combine all of the ingredients together. Bake uncovered in slow oven (325\u00b0) for 2 1/2 hours. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crabmeat And Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake in casserole dish at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Serve hot with chips crackers or party breads.

title: Lazy Woman'S Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter. Pour in an 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Mix dry ingredients and milk. Mix well. Pour over melted butter in baking dish. Pour fruit over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Embelle'S Squash Pie
instructions: Saute the onion and pepper in the butter. Add to the cooked and mashed squash. Add the egg. Salt and pepper to taste. If too soupy crumble saltines until suitable. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions; drain. Combine next 9 ingredients. Add spinach rice and cheese. Pour into 8 x 8-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Company Carrots
instructions: Cook the whole carrots in boiling salted water until tender. Reserve 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Drain carrots; cut lengthwise into narrow strips and arrange in shallow baking dish (8 or 9-inch square). Combine reserved cooking liquid with mayonnaise onion horseradish sauce and salt and pepper. If desired at this point the carrots and sauce may be refrigerated.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Grate the sharp cheese. Mix with the pie crust mix. This blends better if grated cheese is room temperature. Add pepper to suit. Chopped nuts optional. If needed add small amounts of butter melted to form ball of dough. Shape into long roll the size of a half dollar. Refrigerate or freeze. When ready slice and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 until lightly browned approximately 8 to 10 minutes. (Do not use pie crust sticks.)

title: Taco Salad *
instructions: In a 10-inch deep-dish nonmetal pie pan (a glass quiche plate is perfect) spread the beans evenly over the bottom. Sprinkle the cheese over the beans. Microwave for 30 seconds on High or until the cheese melts. Spread the guacamole over the cheese then a thin layer of the salsa. Gently spread the yogurt over the salsa. Arrange the tomatoes in a ring around the outer edge of the pie pan. Make an inner ring by sprinkling the chopped green onions inside the tomato ring. Serve with nacho chips on the side for dipping.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Boil together brown sugar syrup molasses and margarine for 4 to 5 minutes stirring often. Remove from heat and add soda. Have popcorn and peanuts in deep pan (I use a roaster) and pour syrup mixture over popcorn and nuts. Mix and put in oven at 250\u00b0. Stir every 15 minutes for 1 hour. Remove from oven and put on waxed paper to cool. Store in a tightly closed container.

title: Golden Rice Salad
instructions: Blend together salad oil vinegar mustard salt and pepper. Pour over hot rice; toss and set aside to cool. Add remaining ingredients and toss. Chill thoroughly. Serve on lettuce leaf and garnish with extra sliced eggs. Makes 8 one cup servings.

title: Baked Broccoli
instructions: Partially cook broccoli. Drain. Saute celery and onion in butter until tender. Combine broccoli celery onion cheese soup and rice in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Easy Banana Bread
instructions: Blend butter egg and sugar. Dissolve baking soda in teaspoon water and add to the mixture. Add salt bananas flour and nuts. Mix and pour in a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour (bake 15 minutes longer if needed).

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter until golden about 20 minutes. Add flour and cook about 5 minutes stirring to prevent flour burning on pan bottom. Add broth and Worcestershire sauce stirring to prevent lumping. Bring to boil; season to taste. Simmer a while.

title: Lasagna(Italian)
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion drain. Add garlic salt parsley flakes salt pepper tomato paste and water and simmer 30 minutes. Cook lasagna as directed on package. Mix together eggs and cottage cheese. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan spread about 1/2 cup sauce then alternate layers of lasagna sauce and egg mixture and Mozzarella until pan is filled. Top with sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fluffy Strawberry Mold
instructions: Pour gelatin in an electric blender. Add boiling water; blend 30 seconds at low speed. Scrape sides with a rubber spatula. Cover and blend 15 seconds longer. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and blend 40 to 50 seconds at medium speed until most of the strawberries are pureed. Pour immediately into a 4-cup mold or glass serving bowl. Refrigerate for 4 to 5 hours until set. Unmold onto plate before serving or leave in glass bowl. Makes 3 1/2 cups or 8 servings.

title: Pork Roast And Gravy
instructions: Season pork roast with seasoned salt and black pepper. Heat oil in Dutch oven. Dredge the roast in flour and brown on all sides in oil. Heat soups and water together in saucepan. Add onion and garlic. Drain fat from pork. Pour soup mixture over pork roast in the Dutch oven. Cover. Place in a 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven. Bake until well done.

title: Grandma Shirley'S Never-Fail Matzoh Balls
instructions: Separate the eggs. Beat whites until peaks form. Beat yolks with fat. Add water salt and pepper to yolks and beat again. Fold in whites gently. Slowly put in matzoh meal a little at a time. Refrigerate your mixture 3 to 4 hours.

title: Beef Slices In Onion Sauce
instructions: Season meat with salt and pepper and brown on both sides in heated shortening in a heavy skillet or Dutch oven. Add 1/4 cup of the water cover tightly and simmer gently from 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is almost tender. Add remaining water 1/4 cupful at a time as needed to keep pan from going dry. Push meat to one side of pan and carefully place onions in the shortening. Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes longer or until meat is tender and onions are transparent and soft. Carefully transfer meat and onions to a hot platter and cover to keep warm. Stir combined flour and sugar into drippings adding more water if desired. Heat to boiling and pour over meat and onions. Serve at once. Makes 4 servings.

title: 9-Layer Salad
instructions: Break lettuce in bite size pieces. Chop celery and green pepper very fine. Slice the onion thin. Do not cook peas; layer all these and then sugar over this. Sprinkle 2 or more teaspoons grated Cheddar cheese. Fry the bacon crisp and crumble on top. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. The salad will do its own combining during this time. Dont stir. Should any be leftover it will keep nicely for 2 or 3 days if covered tightly with foil.

title: Veggie Bars
instructions: Unroll dough. Press lightly into greased 15 x 10 x 1 jelly roll pan pressing edges together to line bottom of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Pineapple Slush
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until smooth.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 15 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Line with paper or foil; grease top of lining. Sift flour once to measure. Combine baking powder salt and eggs in top of double boiler over water. Beat with electric hand mixer on high for 3 minutes. Add sugar gradually. Remove from heat; beat 2 more minutes adding flour and vanilla. Pour batter on a clean dish towel dusted with confectioners sugar. Remove paper. Spread with jelly and roll up. Wrap with dish towel to cool.

title: Six Bean Bake
instructions: Drain the first 3 cans of beans. Do not drain the last 3 cans. Brown meat and crumble into a large baking dish; add beans and all other ingredients except bacon. Mix well and place several bacon strips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until thickened. Can be used as a vegetable or main dish.

title: Onion Bread(Teacher'S Favorite)
instructions: Soak onion in water 5 minutes. Combine egg milk and Tabasco. Add to biscuit mix and stir until blended. Stir in onion and water. Pour into 8-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with caraway seeds. Spoon melted butter over all. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast 5 minutes in 1 cup water. Combine shortening sugar and salt. Add 1 cup water and egg; mix until blended. Add 3 cups flour; stir until smooth and elastic. Add remaining flour stirring; knead. Refrigerate in greased bowl. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Wash cranberries; drain. Cut orange into quarters. Chop cranberries and orange quarters and stir in pecans and sugar. Add boiling water to gelatin stirring until gelatin dissolves. Cool. Stir in cranberry-orange-pecan mixture. Chill until jelled. Makes 3 cups.

title: Russian Tea Cookies
instructions: Combine the oleo sugar and vanilla. Add the flour and salt which have been mixed together. Add nuts and roll into 1-inch balls. Bake until set (not brown) and roll in powdered sugar before and after they cool.

title: Tuna And Noodles
instructions: Place a layer of noodles in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread tuna evenly over noodles. Place another layer of noodles over the tuna. Spread mushroom soup on top. Pour half and half over the top then pour in milk to cover noodles. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place small amounts of margarine on top. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for about an hour.

title: Tuna Linguine Primavera
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions adding vegetables during last 4 minutes of cooking time. Drain; return to pan. Add remaining ingredients; toss to cool.

title: Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Set oven at 350\u00b0. Add cream of tartar to egg whites; beat until stiff. Gradually add sugar. Add vanilla. Chop nuts and crumble saltines; fold into whites. Spread in pan; bake until golden and firm. Let cool completely then spread on Cool Whip then pie filling.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix Master Mix and sugar together. Blend slightly beaten egg with fork to water. Stir water/egg mixture into dry ingredients. Drop onto preheated skillet that has been sprayed with Pam. Skillet should be on medium-high. Yields 8 to 10 pancakes.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli and cauliflower into small pieces and place in boiling water for 2 minutes then drain and cool. Cube onion. Mix equal parts of sour cream and mayonnaise. Add lemon juice and garlic salt. Pour mixture over vegetables and refrigerate for 4 hours.

title: Gumbo(For Ten)
instructions: Brown 6 slices of bacon and remove from pan. Add flour and brown. Add celery onion okra tomatoes and 2 quarts boiling water. Boil and then simmer for 2 hours. Add salt pepper and sugar. Stir with wooden spoon until mixture thickens. Then blend in last of all raw shrimp bacon and the crab meat. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Crab Shrimp Gumbo
instructions: Measure broth into 5 quart Dutch oven.\tAdd tomatoes parsley and celery. Heat butter in skillet; add peppers onion garlic and okra. Cover and saute without stirring until onion is soft but not browned. Add mixture to broth. Add all of the ingredients except seafood and tabasco. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered 2-1/2 hours. Stir in tabasco and seafood and cook an additional 15 minutes. May be served over hot rice. Serves 10-12.

title: Ham, Cheese & Broccoli Fondue
instructions: Make a doughnut from each bread slice by using 2 different sized round cutters. Butter doughnut and hole pieces and set aside. Place the crusts and scraps of bread in the bottom of an 8 x 12-inch casserole. Sprinkle cheese over bread. Add a layer of broccoli then ham. Arrange doughnuts and holes on top. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 and bake uncovered for about 50 minutes or until set and brown. Remove from oven and allow to set 10 minutes before serving. Let it set in refrigerator before freezing.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Combine cheese and margarine. Add flour pepper and salt. Add Rice Krispies. Shape into balls. Place on greased cookie sheet or press down with a fork. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Cool. Beat eggs; add milk salt mustard and mushrooms. Add bread and stir until softened. Stir in cheese. Pour in baking dish and refrigerate overnight. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Holiday Wieners
instructions: Heat jelly in fondue pot or crock pot and add wieners. Heat to boil and serve.

title: Chicken Salad For 50 People
instructions: Bake chicken (do not dry out meat) and cut into large cubes. Mix celery salt pepper mayonnaise juice/vinegar together. Add chicken cubes and mix well. Extras that can be added to salad green onion to taste pineapple tidbits diced apples sliced green grapes nuts. Chill and serve.

title: Noodle Dough
instructions: Sift flour and salt onto a pastry board. Make a well in the center and add eggs and water. Work the flour into the egg mixture adding more water if necessary to make a stiff but workable dough. Knead on board until smooth. Divide dough in half and let it rest for 30 minutes covered. Roll out as thin as possible and cut into desired shapes. Spread noodles on the board and let them dry well before using. Freezes well.

title: Lemon-Garlic Pasta
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water to desired doneness; drain. Mince garlic. In pan heat oil and butter. Add garlic. Cook for 1 minute. Add to other ingredients. Toss well. Test for seasoning. Add pepper and salt for taste. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: *One-half nuts and 1/2 cup flakes are nice for special occasions.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
instructions: Whip Pet milk until stiff. Add sugar. Beat until sugar is dissolved. Add Kool-Aid and mix well. Mixture will congeal quickly. Pour into crusts and refrigerate. Great summertime dessert. No cooking.

title: Holiday Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender but not browned. Add vegetables with sauce chicken broth cream and pepper. Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated about 5 minutes. Makes 5 1/2 cups or 6 servings.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Cook fruit and jello until jello is dissolved. Cool. Add 2 packages of Dream Whip prepared according to directions on package. Add cream cheese softened. Mix and put in a mold. Will keep several days in refrigerator.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Saute zucchini and chopped onion in oil. Whip cottage cheese with basil and oregano in blender. Place alternating layers of squash cottage cheese and tomato in a 1 1/2 qt. casserole dish. Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: 3 Way Pool Room Chili
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour. Cook kidney or chili beans on side. Cook spaghetti on side. Serve in layers bottom spaghetti second beans with sauce on top. Serve with oyster crackers. Serves 4.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Top with cheese; melt.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Empty milk into large bowl and stir in lemon juice. Add fruits and Cool Whip. Stir well. Pour in crust and refrigerate.

title: Great Grandma'S Green Tomato Sweet Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables coarsely together. Put in colander and drain. Put in a bowl and add canning salt. Let stand 1/2 hour. Drain again; put in kettle. Add 1/2 pint (8 ounces) of water and 1/2 pint white vinegar. Cook 8 minutes. Stir so it wont scorch. Drain again; put back in kettle. Add 1 pint white vinegar and 1 pint of water. Bring to boil then add turmeric celery seed and mustard seed. Stir well. Cook about 5 minutes and stir.

title: Strawberry Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes in layer cake pans.

title: Busy Housewife Slaw
instructions: Mix together cabbage onions pepper and pimentos. Make a syrup from vinegar mustard seed turmeric sugar celery seed and salt. Stir and simmer syrup for 6 minutes. Cool and then pour over slaw mixture. Let set at least 24 hours before using. The longer it sets the better it is. Will keep as long as 5 or 6 months. Store in glass jar or similar container.

title: Oat Crackers(Wheat Free)
instructions: Place oats in a bowl. Blend remaining ingredients. Add liquid to 4 cups oat flour. Mix together and knead slightly adding more flour or water as needed. Roll out into long roll about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Slice into 1/2-inch pieces. Roll out between 2 pieces of plastic or press flat with a tortilla press. Place on a lightly Pammed baking sheet. Makes 4 dozen 3-inch crackers. Or you may roll entire dough directly on cookie sheet and cut in the desired size. Bake at 400\u00b0 until lightly browned. Burns easily.

title: Opal'S Chocolate Pecan Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar soda and cinnamon. Set aside. Put cocoa water cooking oil and butter in a saucepan. Cook until it comes to a boil or it melts. Then mix the first 4 ingredients and the 2nd four ingredients together stirring well then add the eggs buttermilk and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes in oblong 9 x 13 pan.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter until soft and creamy. Add sugar and beat until mixture is light and fluffy. In another bowl mix flour salt baking powder baking soda and spices together. Add dry ingredients alternately with applesauce to creamed mixture making 3 or 4 additions beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Stir gently and quickly until batter is well blended. Do not overmix. Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Let cake cool for 15 to 20 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with 1 pkg. of Ritz Crackers crumbled and pour 1/2 stick of melted margarine over crackers. Bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Magic Pickles
instructions: Pour off pickle juice into a large bowl. Add sugar and Tabasco and stir to dissolve. Pour pickle juice back over the sliced pickles. You will probably have more than enough.

title: Burrito Pie
instructions: Combine Bisquick water and refried beans. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread browned ground beef taco sauce and grated cheese on next. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Serve with lettuce tomatoes onions sour cream etc.

title: Creamy Mustard Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender. Blend well. Chill. Serve with crab or vegetables. For a change try adding chopped onion or garlic.

title: Whipped Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel the potatoes while theyre hot. Mix with the butter salt and pepper. Use a hand mixer to beat until smooth. Serves 6.

title: Mindie'S Cabbage
instructions: Cut core out of whole cabbage. Put bouillon cube into hole; stuff hole with butter. Wrap cabbage with foil (very well). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 hours or until tender. Can cook on grill it takes a while.

title: Granny Hobdy'S Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Grind cranberries and apples. Add remaining ingredients. Mix together and congeal.

title: Sweet-Sour Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in casserole. Spoon apricot preserves evenly over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix evenly over chicken. Pour Russian dressing evenly over chicken. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Remove cover and stir sauce gently last 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients; cut in shortening until like coarse cornmeal. Combine orange juice and egg. Pour over dry ingredients all at once and mix just enough to dampen. Fold in coarsely chopped nuts cranberries and orange peel. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for (1) one hour.

title: Chesapeake Imperial Crab
instructions: Thoroughly combine mayonnaise egg green pepper pimento dry mustard salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Add crab meat; stir carefully into mixture. Divide mixture between 4 cleaned crab shells or individual casseroles heaping mixture lightly. Top with thin coating of mayonnaise. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve hot or chilled. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. Saute onion and pepper in margarine until tender. Mix all ingredients together including 1 to 1 1/2 cups chicken broth. Put in large baking dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Squares
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; add coconut and almonds. Brown. Add brown sugar stirring until melted. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with 1/2 of the mixture. Spread with ice cream. Top with remaining mixture; freeze. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef mix in refried beans and taco seasoning. Spread on bottom of 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix together picante sauce and sour cream. Spread over meat mixture. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly. Serve with corn chips.

title: Yogurt Pancakes
instructions: Whisk together eggs yogurt milk and melted butter. Mix together flour salt baking powder and sugar. Mix wet ingredients and dry until just mixed. Fold in any kind of fruit (example microwave blueberries 30 seconds to 1 minute to thaw strawberries also go well).

title: Steak-N-Gravy
instructions: Salt and pepper steak to taste. Place in crock-pot; add cream of mushroom soup and water. Let cook on low 6 to 8 hours.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Peel onions and thinly slice. Put butter in 4-quart saucepan and heat until melted. Add onions and black pepper. Saute until tender and golden brown. Sprinkle with flour and stir until flour disappears. Cook 1 minute longer stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Gradually add beef broth stirring constantly. Stir in water and bay leaf. Return to heat and bring to boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and cook soup uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Raspberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix and pour into Bundt cake pan. Allow Jell-O to set.

title: Egg Drop Soup With Peas
instructions: Add chopped pork and peas to chicken broth. Bring to a boil. Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes. Pour in eggs slowly while stirring the soup. As soon as the last bit of eggs are in shut off heat. Serve with chopped scallions on top. Serves 4.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: In skillet brown and crumble sausage; drain and set aside. In large bowl beat eggs; add milk salt and mustard. Stir in bread cubes cheese and sausage. Pour into greased 11 x 7 x 2 baking dish. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven 40 minutes or until center is done. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar flour and salt. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir small amount hot mixture into yolks; immediately return to hot mixture. Cook 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add butter vanilla and coconut flavoring. Pour into cooled baked pastry shell. Spread margarine on pie; sprinkle with coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream oleo. Add sugar. Stir in eggs and vanilla. Beat. Add flour soda and baking powder until well blended. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pudding Dessert
instructions: Mix flour margarine and nuts like pie crust and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Sugarless Fruitcake
instructions: Cream margarine with sweetener. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Mix dry ingredients reserving 1/2 cup flour. Mix chopped nuts and fruits and add the 1/2 cup flour to them. Mix all ingredients together in a large container. Turn out into a ten inch tube pan or two loaf pans. Bake at 250 degrees for two hours and fifteen minutes for tube pans or two hours for loaves. Let set until cool before removing from pan.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix Crisco sugar and eggs on high speed of mixer. Add sifted flour alternating with milk. Add baking powder near end of mixing. Add vanilla and other flavoring at end on slow speed of mixer. Bake in a Bundt pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt the chocolate and margarine in a pan. Beat eggs. Fold the sugar and melted chocolate mixture into the beaten eggs. Add flour baking powder salt vanilla and nuts. Bake in a 8 x 8-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook cabbage until tender; drain. Carefully separate leaves from stem end. In a large bowl mix hamburger sausage rice sauerkraut onion egg salt and pepper; mix well.

title: Hot Pickles
instructions: Drain liquid from pickles. Add all other ingredients and heat to boiling. Remove garlic buds. Pack drained pickles into sterilized jars. Pour hot liquid over pickles and seal.

title: Watermelon Spice Pie
instructions: Cut green outer rind and most pulp from watermelon rind; cut into 1/4-inch cubes. Combine 1 1/2 cups cubes with water to cover in saucepan. Simmer until tender. Drain; add sugar cinnamon nutmeg cloves salt flour vinegar and raisins; mix well. Pour into pastry shell in 8-inch pie pan. Top with remaining pastry; seal edges and cut vents. Bake at 450\u00b0 until browned. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake until filling is set.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Mix pudding and milk; add Cool Whip. Layer graham crackers in pan. Spread over graham crackers one-half of pudding mixture. Layer another layer of graham crackers then spread the rest of pudding. Layer another layer of graham crackers. Spread melted frosting over the top.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Combine cake mix eggs water and shortening; dough will be stiff. Shape into balls about the size of walnuts. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Dehaven'S Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar and salt. Blend until peaks form. Add chips and nuts. Mix. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Place in preheated oven at 350\u00b0. Turn off heat and leave in oven over night.

title: Cheese Muffins
instructions: Bake in ungreased muffin pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Waffle Cookies
instructions: Heat waffle iron. Mix all ingredients together. Pour batter into waffle iron just as you would for making waffles. Dont let cookies get too brown. Remove and cool.

title: Venison Stew(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Flour stew meat and brown. Set aside next 4 ingredients in crock-pot. Sprinkle next 4 ingredients over vegetables. Put meat on top. Pour vegetable juice cocktail over. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Double Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugars margarine eggs milk and vanilla. Stir in flour baking powder and salt. Stir in oats peanut butter chips and chocolate chips. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 11 to 14 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Cook sausage until done. Crumble then drain. Prepare pie shell. Mix cheese and sausage. Sprinkle in shell. Lightly beat eggs in bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture. Pour in shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool on rack 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Enjoy!

title: Zucchini Pizza
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cups
instructions: Drain pineapple; pile into peach halves. Top each with 1 teaspoon brown sugar and 1 teaspoon butter. Put on greased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve with ham sausage or pork chops.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: In glass jar dissolve yeast and 1/2 cup warm water. Stir in 1 cup warm water sugar and potato flakes. Let mixture sit out all day then refrigerate 2 to 5 days uncovered or lightly covered. Remove from refrigerator after 5 days and feed again with 1 cup warm water 2/3 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons of potato flakes. Stir well and keep at room temperature for 10 to 12 hours. Ready to use.

title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
instructions: Mix all together and bake in two well-greased/floured loaf pans for 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let stand for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Pumpkin-Filled Coffeecake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 13 x 9-inch baking pan with no-stick cooking spray. Beat 1 cup sugar and 1/3 cup margarine until fluffy. Add egg whites and vanilla; mix well. Stir in milk and combined flour 1 cup oats and baking powder. Combine 1 cup batter pumpkin and spice; set aside. Spread half of remaining batter into pan. Top with pumpkin mixture; spread other half of batter over pumpkin.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat the oven to 350\u00b0. Divide the apples between 2 (10 ounce) custard cups. Sprinkle water over apple slices. Mix flour sugar margarine and cinnamon with a fork until crumbly; sprinkle over apples. Bake uncovered until the topping is light golden brown and apples are tender 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Oven Roasted Meatballs With Spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In large bowl with hand mix bread zucchini egg white cheese garlic salt and pepper until evenly moistened. Add ground turkey and mix just until evenly combined.

title: Dressing(15 Pound Turkey)
instructions: Melt butter in large cooker. Pour in onions celery and parsley; cook until tender. In large bowl add bread seasonings and 1/2 giblets. Add cooked mixture to this. Add broth to get desired moisture.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots 8 to 10 minutes in small amount of water. Drain and combine with other ingredients; mix well cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight before serving. Serve hot or cold. Saves 2 to 3 weeks.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Sauce Heat oil in large kettle. Add onions and garlic. Saute 5 minutes. Add ground beef. Saute until browned breaking up meat. Stir in remaining tomatoes paste and spices. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 3 hours until thick. Remove bay leaves and skim off grease. Cool and skim again. Refrigerate until needed.

title: Walnut Horse Shoe Cookies
instructions: Roll into hand like ball. Shape them into horse shoe. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dried Beef Gravy
