instructions: In a large saucepan melt butter or margarine. Add flour salt and pepper. Stir until smooth and bubbly. Add milk. Continue stirring until mixture thickens and boils. Add eggs and beef. Stir and simmer until hot. Serve over potato or rice.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes sugar spice eggs milk vanilla extract and melted margarine and place into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Cover with the topping.

title: Apple-Carrot Bake
instructions: Combine carrots and 1/2 cup water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain carrots and set aside.

title: Ham-Chicken Delight
instructions: Fry country ham. Brown chicken in ham drippings. Do not add salt. When brown place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place ham on top of chicken. In ham-chicken drippings heat the soup and pour over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sparkling Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple reserving juice. Set fruit aside. Add enough water to juice to make 1/2 cup. Set aside. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in juice mixture. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Stir in cranberry sauce pecans oranges and pineapple. Pour into a lightly oiled 4-cup mold. Chill until firm. Yields 8 servings.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole
instructions: Dip chicken pieces in egg then bread crumbs. Brown in a little oil. Put chicken in baking dish and add cheese and ham pieces. Mix together soup and milk. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Artichoke Appetizer
instructions: Saute artichokes in their oil with onions parsley and garlic. Cool. Beat eggs with fork. Add salt and pepper. Add crackers and cheese. Add artichokes mixture; bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Set 10 minutes before cutting (7 x 10-inch).

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes. For use as is on pork. If used to baste chicken add 3 tablespoons butter or margarine.

title: Texas Barbecue
instructions: Cook roast in water. Saute onion garlic and butter. Add and cook together all other ingredients. Add roast that has been cooked and cut fine. Mix thoroughly.

title: Wine Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients 5 minutes on medium speed. Pour into greased floured Bundt or tube pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Chop fine the lettuce celery and onion. Mix with can of peas. Spread in bottom of casserole dish. Mix together mayonnaise and sugar. Seal over salad. Sprinkle heavily with cheese and bacon bits. Refrigerate 12 hours.

title: Snitz And Knepp
instructions: Boil 1/2 hour with ham before adding Knepp.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Cream together cream cheese 10x sugar and milk then place in pie shell. On top put bananas and crushed pineapple then cover with Cool Whip nuts and cherries.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple- cut in halves. Mix cream cheese and sugar- add pineapple. Stir in Cool Whip and pecans. Chill before serving.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: In a large bowl pour undiluted tomato soup. In small saucepan heat 2 cans of water to boiling. Remove from heat and stir in bouillon until dissolved. Gradually add broth to tomato soup stirring until blended. Stir in vinegar and remaining ingredients. Refrigerate at least 2 hours until well chilled.

title: Hot Pecan Spread
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream with green pepper onion beef garlic onion salt and pepper. Put into small casserole. (Can be made ahead.) Toast pecans in melted butter in small skillet for about 2 minutes. Sprinkle over cheese mixture. At serving time bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 until hot. Serve with Melba toast rounds or crackers. Can also be served cold.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients until crumbly. Press into greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix together the eggs creamed corn 1 cup bread crumbs evaporated milk and salt. Put in a 3-quart buttered casserole. Top with 1/4 cup bread crumbs and 1/2 stick butter sliced and placed on top of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 1 1/2 hours or until knife inserted comes out clean. Good served with meat dishes (ham turkey etc.). Serves 10.

title: Buttermilk Banana Bread
instructions: *Add 1 tablespoon vinegar to milk to make buttermilk.

title: Turkey Hash
instructions: Cook and stir celery onion and green pepper in butter in heavy skillet over medium heat until tender. Stir in potatoes turkey and seasonings. Cook over low heat about 5 minutes stirring frequently. Add gravy; cook and stir until mixture is hot.

title: Easy Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes thoroughly. Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick slices. In a 1-quart microwave safe casserole combine potato slices and water. Cook covered on 100% power (High) for 5 to 7 minutes or until tender stirring after every 3 minutes. Drain potato slices well. Dollop cheese spread onto the potato slices. Cook uncovered on High for 30 to 60 seconds or until cheese is melted. Gently stir the melted cheese into the potato slices. Serves 2.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs milk and extract. Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Roll on floured surface to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into shapes. Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 7 minutes. Cool then decorate.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube cake pan. Beat 3 eggs well; add 1 1/4 cups oil and 2 cups sugar. Add 2 1/2 cups flour 2 medium apples (peeled cored and chopped) 1 cup shredded coconut and 1 cup chopped walnuts or pecans. Batter will be stiff. Pour into tube pan and bake 1 hour (more or less). Remove from pan after cooled about 30 minutes and top with following while still warm.

title: Watergate
instructions: Crust Mix together flour oleo and pecans. Press in bottom of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 to 30 minutes or until slightly browned. Let cool.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix; then press like a pie crust into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake until light brown about 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Melt butter dump all ingredients together. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Pie(Makes Two 8-Inch Pies)
instructions: Bake pie shells at 350\u00b0 until brown. Cool.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix all. Put in graham cracker crust. Sprinkle with nuts and coconut. Chill.

title: Cabana Cafe'S White Chili
instructions: Soak beans overnight in cold water. Wash chicken and cover with 1/2 spice mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Heat oil in skillet. Saute onions until translucent. Add chiles garlic and spices and saute 1 minute. Drain beans and add beans and stock to pot. Add onions spice mixture and beer. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer about 2 hours or until beans are tender. Dice chicken into quarter-sized pieces. Add to stock. Simmer. Remove from heat. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Creamy Jello Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple and juice to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in Jell-O until dissolved. Let cool. Take out of refrigerator and add the buttermilk and Cool Whip. Fold in until lumps disappear. Then add the nuts. Pour in an 8-inch square dish. Cool at least 4 hours.

title: Broccoli, Rice And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter or margarine until tender. Mix with chicken and mushroom soups cheese broccoli and one cup rice. Grease a large casserole dish. Put mixture in dish. Top with remaining rice. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Take teaspoonful and roll into balls then roll in coconut 1/2 cup should be enough for entire batch. Cool. Can also be frozen.

title: Italian Bars
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan; remove from heat and cool. Combine eggs sugars and beat with wooden spoon. When dissolved add baking soda cinnamon and stir then add melted butter. Lastly add flour 1 cup at a time. Arrange into baking sheet making 3 rows. Smooth top with little water and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove and pour icing. Cut when cooled. Makes 3 logs.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in greased casserole dish. Top with Cheez Whiz. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Wash potatoes well. Depending on your preference peel or leave skin on. Thinly slice about 4 cups. I use my grater (it goes fast). Heat butter in saucepan over medium heat. Cook onion in butter about 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Cook stirring constantly until bubbly; remove from heat. Stir in milk and 1 1/2 cups of cheese. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Spread potatoes in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes. Bake uncovered 1 hour. Mix remaining cheese and the bread crumbs. Sprinkle over potatoes; sprinkle with paprika. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until top is brown and bubbly.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Press crescent rolls into a pan. Cook sausage and drain. Sprinkle over rolls. Sprinkle hash browns over sausage then top with Cheddar cheese. Pour egg mixture over cheese and bake for 30 minutes in an 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Crock-pot will make 3 layers depending on size of the crock-pot. Boil the chicken. Then debone it.

title: Never Last Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large bowl and let set for 2 minutes. Use spoon only and mix well but do not beat. Pour in greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Shape basic dough/roll recipe into small balls. Brush with melted butter. Arrange 4 balls in greased muffin tin cup. Bake according to directions on recipe.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken until done at least 30 minutes. Let cool; debone and skin. Place back in broth. Put soup in. Bring to boil; pour in rice. Simmer until done. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cook noodles and broccoli as directed and drain. In double boiler mix yogurt flour and mustard. Heat. Add milk slowly. Cook stirring until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in cheese until melted. Layer noodles broccoli and turkey in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over all and bake uncovered 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix ingredients. Put in an 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook until thick. Cool. Stir in 1 pint fresh strawberries. Put in baked pie shell. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Eclair Dessert
instructions: Mix pudding and milk in large bowl; add whipped topping and mix until smooth. Line 8 x 11 1/2-inch pan or dish with graham crackers. Pour 1/2 of mixture over crackers. Cover with a layer of crackers and pour the other half of mixture. Add another layer of crackers. Top with frosting beginning at edges and spread to center. Sprinkle chopped pecans on top. Garnish with cherries. Keep refrigerated.

title: Jill'S Crab Meat Dip(The Special Occasion Dip)
instructions: Microwave cream cheese to soften; spread evenly in serving dish (about 1/2-inch deep). Evenly place crab meat over cheese and then cover with cocktail sauce. Best with Ritz or club crackers.

title: Mom'S Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Pour into prepared pie crusts. Makes 2. Bake at 325\u00b0 until center is firm. (May need to reduce heat during baking depending on your oven.)

title: Banana Nut Chiffon Pie
instructions: Soften gelatin in water and set aside. In saucepan mix 1/2 c. sugar salt and milk. Cook over low heat stirring until scalded and remove from heat. Take half the cooked mixture stir with egg yolks and return to saucepan. Cook over low heat until it comes to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in gelatin. Cool over bowl of ice. When mixture is partially set beat with mixer until smooth. Blend in vanilla. Gently fold thawed Cool Whip into mixture. Make meringue with egg whites cream of tartar and sugar. Gently add to cooked mixture. Add bananas nuts and cherries. Pile into pie shells and chill about 2 hours.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo. Mix sugar and oleo together with egg milk and vanilla. Put dough in refrigerator for 2 hours or more to chill. Roll out the dough on wax paper sprinkled with flour. Cut dough with cookie cutter. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine and sugar. Cool. Add beaten egg baking powder salt and baking soda into flour. Stir in nuts and chocolate bits. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut into about 24 small squares.

title: Mom'S Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and continue to beat until mixed well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour in canister of ice crem freezer. Add milk to fill line if necessary. Start freezer.

title: Jam Kolaches
instructions: Cream together margarine and cream cheese until light and fluffy. Add flour; mix well. Roll dough to 1/8-inch thickness on lightly floured surface. Cut with 2-inch round cutter. Place on lightly greased (Pam) cookie sheet with sides touching. Combine jam and walnuts (nuts keep jam from spreading out too much); drop 1 to 2 teaspoons on dough rounds. Fold opposite sides together and pinch with thumb and forefinger once each. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack. Dust with powdered sugar while warm. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Measure flour salt baking powder and baking soda into sifter. Cream butter with sugar until well blended in a large bowl. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift in flour mixture; adding alternately with sour cream and blending well to make thick batter. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 4 inches apart on greased cookie sheets. Spread into 2 inch rounds and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) for 12 minutes or until lightly golden around edges.

title: Strawberry Snow
instructions: Mix jello water and sugar. Mash strawberries; mix in and chill for 1 1/2 hours. Fold Cool Whip into mixture. Crumble cake; put into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour mixture over top. Chill.

title: Pork And Soy Sauce With Onions
instructions: Thinly slice the pork and onions. Heat the oil in pan and fry the pork. Add the onions; continue cooking over medium heat until tender. Add the sugar salt soy sauce soup stock sherry and m.s.g.; boil for 10 to 15 minutes. Add pepper to taste. Mix the cornstarch in the cold water; add to the soup to thicken. Add the green peas and serve piping hot.

title: Italian Sausage
instructions: Cook sausage until almost done and add the onion and green peppers. Cook to desired tenderness. This makes enough for two people.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Stir well. Put in greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hollywood Squares
instructions: Combine margarine graham cracker crumbs powdered sugar and peanut butter; mix well. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Chill until firm. Melt chocolate chips; spread over peanut butter mixture. Chill until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Dipped Fruit
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat melt chocolate chips and shortening stirring constantly until smooth. Spear fruit with toothpicks; dip into chocolate. Place on waxed paper or stick toothpicks into a block or styrofoam to harden.

title: Libby'S Bean Dip
instructions: Put in glass casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese and cream cheese melts. Mix thoroughly. Magnificent on tortilla chips.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Place strawberries in pie crust. Heat sugar cornstarch Jell-O food coloring and water over medium heat until thick. Pour over strawberries. Chill 2 hours then top with Cool Whip.

title: San Francisco Clam Dip
instructions: In medium skillet saute onion and bell pepper in margarine until transparent. Add remaining ingredients; stir until creamy and heated through. Serve warm with assorted crackers or chips.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Halve avocado; with spoon remove pulp and mash. Mix in all of the ingredients except for the corn tortillas. Use them to dip.

title: Dirt Pie
instructions: Pour milk into medium bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping. Stir 1 cup of the cookies into pudding mixture. Spoon into pie crust. Sprinkle with remaining cookies. Freeze until firm (about 4 hours). Garnish with gummy worms if desired.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to directions; drain. Add margarine to hot spaghetti stir in eggs and Parmesan cheese. Form into a crust in greased 10-inch pie pan. Spread with cottage cheese. In skillet cook sausage until brown. Drain fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce and heat through. Turn meat mixture into spaghetti crust. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella and bake until melted 5 minutes.

title: Lemon Batter Fish
instructions: In a medium bowl mix flour water 1/3 cup lemon juice egg baking powder salt and sugar. Dip fish in lemon juice. Coat with\tflour\tthen dip in batter. Fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain on towels. Serve hot.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix juices; add club soda. Float ice ring. Serves 32.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Process 1 can of corn flour and next 6 ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth stopping to scrape down sides. Transfer to a bowl. Stir in remaining 3 cans of corn. Pour mixture into a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until set. Makes 12 servings.

title: Banana Coffee Shake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients until smooth in blender. Pour into wine glasses or goblets. Garnish each serving with shaved chocolate. Makes 2 servings.

title: Macaroni Salad For Two
instructions: Combine all ingredients stirring lightly; cover and chill several hours before serving.

title: Moe'S Chicken And Dumpling Stew
instructions: Melt butter in a large pan or Dutch oven. Put your chicken and coat. Add your onions garlic 1/3 cup Saucerie salt and pepper to taste. Add some water or milk and stir. Cook for about 5 minutes. Add your carrots potatoes and more of the Saucerie up to 1/3 cup more go by taste. Cook until the carrots and the potatoes are done. If you need to add more liquid (milk or water) do so for a good consistency. About 10 minutes before stew is done take biscuits out of can and put on top of stew. Cook with the lid on for about 5 to 7 minutes. Take lid off and cook for another 5 to 7 minutes. Feeds 4 to 6 people.

title: Austin'S Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Drain. Mix dressing as instructed on the back of the package. Drain mushrooms and olives. Mix all ingredients together. Chill.

title: Cool And Creamy Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In large mixer bowl combine pumpkin 1/2 carton whipped topping pudding mix and spice. Beat at low speed until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. Spread into crust. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Quick chill in freezer 10 to 15 minutes until ready to serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Put water and salt in kettle; stir and heat to 80\u00b0 or until bubbles on bottom. Remove from heat and add oil alum and food coloring. Add flour quickly; stir to prevent lumps and knead. Will keep soft in plastic airtight container or will harden if left out to dry.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Melt margarine and add graham cracker crumbs powdered sugar and peanut butter. Pat in 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips in double boiler and frost over the top. When chocolate is set cut into small squares.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Combine water yeast and sugar. Let sit 5 minutes. Add salt margarine egg and 3 cups flour. Beat smooth. Work in remaining flour to make a stiff dough. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 24 hours.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Add pimento onion sauce and salt. Mix well. Shape into ball or log. Chill\tseveral hours. Roll in pecans or parsley. Serve with crackers.

title: Crayfish Etouffee
instructions: Saute the first 4 ingredients until veggies are soft then add crawfish and saute a little. Add soup and water. Simmer awhile.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Put chops in a baking dish. Put rice over them. Add onion and pepper; pour in boiling water and tomatoes. Add salt and pepper. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored. Blend in condensed milk; slowly add lime juice and mix well. Add cream of tartar to egg whites; beat until foamy. Continue to beat and add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time until forms peaks. Fold 7 tablespoons of meringue into filling. Pour into 9-inch pie shell and top with remaining meringue. Bake at 330\u00b0 until brown.

title: Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water. Add pineapple juice orange juice and lemonade. Mash bananas; blend in blender. Freeze. Add chilled Sprite to partially thawed punch. Serves 50.

title: Applesauce(Makes 3 Cups)
instructions: Put apples and water into saucepan. Turn heat to medium and cook stirring often until the apples become tender about 5 to 6 minutes. Add sugar and lemon juice. Stir to blend. Cook another 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and mash with fork.

title: Sweet And Creamy Pumpkin Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Add pumpkin and remaining ingredients. Blend. Chill 30 minutes. Serve with gingersnaps apples sweet breads.

title: Connie'S Crazy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Put the ingredients in a mixing bowl in the order given. Do not stir until the water is added. Beat for 3 minutes. Bake on 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 to 45 minutes until done. Cake is done when a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Kelly'S Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and noodles until done. Saute mushrooms in butter. Add frozen carrots to potato mixture. Add Velveeta and soups. Stir until cheese is melted. Add mushrooms. Cook in crock-pot up to 6 hours.

title: Steamed Asparagus With Tomato-Basil Dip
instructions: Whisk together first 5 ingredients until blended. May chill up to 2 days if desired. Snap off tough ends of asparagus; remove scales with vegetable peeler if desired. Cook in boiling water to cover 3 minutes until crisp tender. Plunge asparagus into ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain. Cover and chill until ready to serve with dip. Yields 12 to 15 servings.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Mix until crumbly press into a 9 x 13 pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Buffalo Chips Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl combine melted oleo and Crisco brown sugar white sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Combine and add to mixture flour soda baking powder and salt. Mix well. Now stir in oatmeal Rice Krispies chocolate chips coconut and nuts. Drop by 1/4 cup on large cookie sheet (6 to a sheet). Bake at 275\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oleo until creamy. Alternate flour and eggs. Add vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Butterscotch Bread Pudding
instructions: Cook sugar and butter together until brown. Heat 2 cups of milk and add to sugar. Remove from heat; let stand for about 5 minutes. Soak bread in remaining 1/2 cup of milk in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Beat the 2 eggs; mix with the sugar mixture. Mix in the vanilla and pour over the bread. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve hot or cold with whipped cream.

title: Dinner In Foil
instructions: Starting with a patty place 4 ingredients on a large sheet of foil. Season to taste. Wrap and seal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Sift the first 4 ingredients into bowl. Add the remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased pan. Bake for 1 hour in the oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend milk eggs sugar and baking mix in blender on high for 15 seconds. Add softened cream cheese and blend on high for 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Pour into greased 9 x 11-inch pie plate. Serve with fruit topping or Sour Cream Topping.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat oil to 350\u00b0. Mix milk and egg. Put breasts in milk and egg mixture then dredge in bread crumbs. Brown lightly in oil. Place breasts in baking dish and sprinkle remaining bread crumbs over top. Pour lemon juice and wine over crumbs making sure the crumbs are wet. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes then reduce temperature to 325\u00b0 and cook another 20 minutes. Serve with noodle roni with herb sauce.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and butter. Add coconut raisins nuts and vinegar; mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
instructions: Heat sugar and Karo syrup until sugar melts. Add peanut butter to sugar and Karo. In large bowl add mixture to the 6 cups of Rice Krispies and mix well. Butter bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour Rice Krispie mixture into pan and press evenly.

title: Pork Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in 350 degree oven for 10 to 15 minutes; reduce to 325 degrees and cook until tooth pick comes out clean when inserted in the middle of the cake.

title: Hubbard Squash
instructions: Cut the squash into fairly large pieces. Boil in salted water 15 minutes. Drain. Sprinkle with pepper. Make a sauce by combining the remaining ingredients. Pour over hot drained squash and toss gently. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli-Rice-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Saute onion in margarine and then add soup and 1 can water. Add broccoli Cheez Whiz and cooked rice. Mix thoroughly. Put in casserole sprinkle with paprika and bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. This will serve 12.

title: Pink Panther Poop
instructions: Mix sweetened condensed milk pie filling Cool Whip pineapple and pecans in large bowl. Chill in refrigerator for one hour. Sprinkle with coconut and miniature marshmallows before serving if desired. Serves 12.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Mix the sugar vinegar mustard salt pepper and garlic powder. Add chopped onion and chopped cucumber. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes over the noodles. Marinate for 2 days. Add 1 chopped tomato and chopped green pepper. Will keep for 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and toss with stuffing mix. Set aside. Mix all other ingredients in large bowl. Add 1/2 stuffing mix and pour into greased casserole dish. Top with remaining stuffing mix.

title: Strawberry Loaf Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add eggs and oil berries and nuts. Stir until well mixed. Pour into well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Layer the following ingredients on a large serving place

title: Caramel Dip With Fruit
instructions: Melt caramels and milk in a microwavable dish in microwave. Cool slightly. Stir in pudding. Soak apple wedges in pineapple juice to prevent browning. Serve apples and dip together.

title: Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Combine apples sugar and cranberries in a 2-quart casserole. Top with rest of mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until light brown and bubbly.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef in oil. Drain. Add tomato paste water and seasoning. Cook slow. Mix milk and cheese. Melt and set aside. Cook lasagna in saltwater. Layer in 9 x 13 pan 3 lasagna hamburger mixture then cheese. Repeat these layers until there are three layers of each.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: In saucepan cook celery and onion in hot oil until tender-crisp. Combine soup and milk; mix with all remaining ingredients. Pour into 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Spicy Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients and mix well. Add eggs and oil and mix. Now add carrots and beat on medium speed with electric mixer about 2 minutes. Grease and flour 3 (9-inch) cake pans. Pour cake batter into pans and bake 25-30 minutes.

title: Yellow Cake(Scratch Cake; I Use For Coconut Cake)
instructions: Mix as you usually do when making cakes. Mix all ingredients well. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done. Use your favorite 7 minute frosting or the White Mountain Frosting from Betty Crocker cookbook. Eat and enjoy!

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove bones and tear chicken into small pieces. Mix with both soups. Add salt. Pour into 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish. Crumble crackers and add to melted butter. Sprinkle over chicken mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 1 hour or until crackers are brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli until almost tender and drain. Put in casserole dish and add mushroom soup and mayonnaise cracker crumbs cheese salt and pepper. Mix all together. Put more cheese and cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peach Jam
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in 5-quart casserole dish. Microwave uncovered at High for 5 minutes. Stir well. Microwave uncovered at High for 15 to 17 minutes or until mixture reaches a full rolling boil. Stir in pectin. Skim off foam with spoon. Pour into hot jelly jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Cover with lids. Let stand at room temperature until cool. Store in refrigerator.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill at least 2 hours or longer so flavors can blend.

title: Caramel Apple Pie
instructions: Combine candies flour apples topping and lemon juice. Mix well. Pour mixture into frozen regular 9-inch pie crust and sprinkle with 1/2 cup pecan pieces. Bake at 375\u00b0 on preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes. Store at room temperature.

title: Spicy Beef Dip
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add all ingredients and simmer 15-20 minutes. Then add cream cheese with the meat mixture to a crock pot. Stir well on low heat. Serve with corn or tortilla chips.

title: Scotcharoos
instructions: Mix sugar and corn syrup; bring to a boil. Add peanut butter; blend well. Pour over Rice Krispies mixing well. Press into a buttered cake pan. Melt butterscotch and chocolate chips. Smooth over top.

title: Buccellato(Easter Bread)
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and oil. Prepare yeast according to package instructions. Add to egg mixture. Add flour a little at a time until soft dough is formed. Put into greased large bowl or kettle. Let rise until double in size. Shape into desired forms. Let rise again until double in size. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Be sure to grease tin before placing desired form.

title: Low-Fat Pot Pies
instructions: Brown turkey and onions. Mix soup vegetables and turkey together. Put in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Place in oven and heat until nice and hot. Put biscuits on another pan and bake until almost done. Take soup mixture out of oven and place biscuits on top. Bake another 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Steak Stir-Fry On A Bed Of Rice
instructions: Cut steak into strips and halve the strips. Saute onion bell pepper and mushrooms in 2 tablespoons margarine or cooking oil. Stir constantly. Never overcook. When desired doneness is reached put these ingredients in another container and put your stripped steaks in the container with the cooking oil or margarine. Cook until tender constantly stirring. Add tomato sauce and cover for 15 minutes. Then add your onion bell pepper and mushrooms. Cover for 5 more minutes. Thats it! Start the rice to boil and lower heat. Upon completion place stir-fry on a bed of rice.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables; drain. Melt butter being careful not to get it too brown. Stir in crackers. Grease 3-quart casserole 9 x 13-inch size. Put vegetables in; add cubed cheese on top and then put cracker mixture on top of this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter and sugar. Add egg salt soda and flour. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Press down with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Debone chicken. Place in a large casserole dish. Pour chicken soup over chicken. Mix other ingredients; pour over chicken. Pour broth over above mixture. Cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Dark Chocolate Frosting
instructions: In double boiler combine sweetened condensed milk chocolate and salt. Cook until chocolate melts and mixture is very thick. Add water and vanilla and stir rapidly until smooth. Cool 10 minutes. Use to frost one 8-inch or 9-inch two layer cake or one 13 x 9-inch cake or 2 dozen cupcakes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Rub chicken in oil and brown in skillet. While browning chicken sweat the vegetables in Dutch oven casserole. In casserole make a bottom layer of carrot celery onion and garlics. Over first layer lay the chicken and sprinkle with salt and pepper then with parsley. Make one more layer of the vegetables ending with chicken. Add cognac warmed and flambe carefully. Season the top layer and add the wine. Place a double layer of foil over the casserole and then add the lid. Heat briefly on top of stove burner then place in the preheated oven for 1 1/4 hours. Serve chicken directly from the casserole. A delicious sauce is self made the garlics cook down to a soft and wonderful nutty flavor. Serve with plenty of crusty French bread wine fresh fruits for dessert.

title: Baked Chicken Liver And Onions
instructions: In a flat casserole dish slice onions very thin to cover bottom. Place livers in a single layer over onions. Sprinkle with pepper. Slice another layer of onions on top. Drizzle 2 tablespoons soy sauce over this. Dot with 1 to 2 tablespoons butter. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until livers are firm.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Blend all ingredients well. Pour in a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat together until creamy. Pour into buttered Pyrex baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. This makes its own crust! Take from oven; cool for 10 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Add corn. Beat egg whites; add to corn. Bake (in water) 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0 for until it puffs up.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Beat until smooth. Make 4 layers in pans that have been sprayed with Pam. Use wax paper in bottom of pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crust Melt margarine in 8 x 12-inch dish. Stir in crushed pretzels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Wassail
instructions: Put all in percolator and let perk. Makes about 8 to 10 cups.

title: Taco Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add taco mix and water. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Put into pie shell. Add chopped onion and green pepper on top of meat mixture. Sprinkle cheese on top and cover with egg and milk mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 4 minutes.

title: Crispy Oven Chicken
instructions: Crush corn flakes until very fine. Stir in salt and pepper. Dip chicken pieces in milk then corn flake crumbs. Place on lightly greased baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Chinese Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet heat oil until hot. Place water chestnuts celery carrots and cabbage in skillet. Cover; cook over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes. Add baked chicken. Pour chicken broth in center of mixture. Cover and steam 1 minute. Dissolve cornstarch in water. Add soy sauce; toss with chicken-vegetable mixture to thicken sauce to cover all ingredients. Serve immediately over rice noodles or chow mein noodles.

title: Sweet Chicken
instructions: Mix dressing preserves and onion soup. Cover chicken. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered then 30 minutes more covered.

title: Layered Hamburger Pie
instructions: Mix beef with egg crumbs salt herbs mustard cumin and garlic powder. Pat evenly into a 9-inch pie pan to make a crust.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill. Best if made the day before.

title: Four Layer Delight
instructions: Mix together and spread (as best you can) into a large oblong cake pan. Bake 10 minutes or until browned at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Asparagus With Mushrooms
instructions: Cook asparagus as directed on can. Drain in small saucepan. Combine margarine mushrooms almonds basil and pepper. Beat well. Heat thoroughly. Place asparagus on serving platter; pour mushroom mixture over spears. Serve at once.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach squeeze out and chop. Add sour cream and mayonnaise. Finely chop water chestnuts and green onions or onion; add vegetable soup mix. Add this mixture to the spinach sour cream and mayonnaise mixture. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: First get milk. Then put in sugar. Then put in cinnamon. Then you need to put in sprinkles. Then put in vanilla. Then stir it. Then let it sit for a while about 1 minute. Then put it in the freezer for 1 hour and a half.

title: Foolproof Fudge
instructions: In top of double boiler melt morsels with condensed milk. Remove from heat. Stir in other ingredients. Spread evenly onto waxed paper lined 8-inch pan. Chill until set. Store at room temperature.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Melt oleo; add mustard and Durkee sauce. Mix well. Add all other ingredients and heat slowly until heated. This will scorch if heated too fast. Delicious on barbecued chicken.

title: Face Paint
instructions: In each cup of the muffin tin mix 1 teaspoon cornstarch 1/2 teaspoon water 1/2 teaspoon cold cream and a couple drops of food coloring a different color for each cup. Stir. Youre ready to go use the paint.

title: Pecan Cocoons
instructions: Beat butter or margarine until lemon colored. Then add other ingredients gradually. Roll into cocoon shapes and place on cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. While they are still hot roll in powdered sugar. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Seafood Treat
instructions: Cut off crusts from bread slices; roll them thin. Melt butter and cheese over low. Add meat and onion juice; spread on bread slice and roll like a jelly roll. Freeze rolls on a tray then seal in freezer bag. When ready to serve cut little frozen roll in 1/2; dip in melted butter. Place on jelly roll pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Eggnog Christmas Salad
instructions: Soften unflavored gelatin in the undrained pineapple and the lime juice for 5 minutes. Cook and stir over medium heat until gelatin dissolves. Cool to room temperature. Stir in eggnog. Chill until partially set. Fold in celery. Turn into a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Chill until almost firm. Heat cranberry juice to boiling; stir in raspberry gelatin until dissolved. Chill until partially set. Stir in cranberry relish. Pour over eggnog layer and chill until set.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix and put in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine mayonnaise onion 1/4 cup cracker crumbs egg sugar salt and pepper. Add squash; mix well. Pour into lightly greased 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs over squash mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Continental Punch
instructions: In quart punch bowl or large glass salad bowl combine fruit juices and sugar. Pour over ice and stir in gingerale. Serve with an ice cube or crushed ice in each glass.

title: Hocus Pocus Cake(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: In small bowl mix cookie crumbs sugar flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In a large bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg yolks until thick about 5 minutes. At medium speed gradually blend in flour mixture alternately with water melted chocolate and vanilla. Fold into batter. Spread batter into foil lined and greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Mimaw'S Cool Rice Salad
instructions: In a covered saucepan bring peas salt and water to boil. Remove from heat. Stir in instant rice and onion. Cover and let stand 13 minutes. Cool. Stir in mayonnaise and pickles. Chill.

title: Custard
instructions: Scald milk. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and salt. Stir constantly when adding to the hot milk. Return to double boiler. Stir until thick. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into custard. Serve cold.

title: Pineapple Bread Pudding
instructions: Place bread into bowl; mash. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Pour into bread pan. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Drop onto a cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour and baking soda. Blend into creamed mixture. Stir in chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Sift together the first 5 ingredients. Cream together the margarine eggs (added one at a time) and milk. Add to the first mixture. Add the mixture of fruits and nuts. Pour apricot brandy over fruit mixture. Drop by teaspoon. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 20 dozen.

title: Low Calorie Muffins
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Set aside. Add water to egg whites. Add sugar and cream of tartar; beat until stiff. Add orange peel and flavoring. Quickly fill greased muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until golden brown. Makes 16 muffins. One muffin equals 39 calories or 1/2 bread exchange.

title: Better Than Robert Redford Cake
instructions: Mix flour nuts and margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cream sugar and cream cheese. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Put in baked crust. Prepare pudding according to box directions and layer on top of cream cheese mixture. Add remainder of Cool Whip and cool.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine last 4 ingredients with 1/2 cup of milk mix with a mixer. Add to rest of milk and bring to a boil slowly. I use a hand mixer to make pudding creamier.

title: Grandmother'S Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter gradually; add sugar. Then add eggs and vanilla. Combine flour baking powder and salt; add to creamy mixture. Place 1 tablespoonful of mixture per a cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Tally Ho Salad Dressing
instructions: Put ingredients in a jar and shake well. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Skinny Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix with diet Coke. Bake according to directions on cake mix.

title: Strawberry Angel Dessert
instructions: Add boiling water to jello and sugar; stir until dissolved. Add strawberries; stir until thawed. Place in refrigerator until syrupy then stir in whipped cream. Place 1/2 the pieces of angel food cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan then pour 1/2 the strawberry mixture over cake. Repeat layers. Let set until firm; cut into squares to serve.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Place chickens in a deep kettle. Add water sherry salt curry powder onion and celery. Bring to a boil and cover tightly. Reduce heat; simmer 1 hour. Remove from heat and strain broth. Refrigerate chicken and broth at once. When chicken is cool enough to handle remove meat discard skin and bones; cut into bite size pieces. Saute mushrooms in butter. Remove fat from chicken broth and measure broth. Follow package directions for cooking rice including seasoning packet using chicken broth as the liquid. Add water if there is not enough broth. Mix sour cream with undiluted mushroom soup then add chicken cooked rice and mushrooms. Mix all ingredients together and put in a greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stir first 5 ingredients together. Heat margarine and broth together until margarine is melted. Pour half of stuffing mix in bottom of casserole dish. Pour the chicken mixture over mix and spread evenly. Pour broth and butter over top of this. Beat together the milk and eggs and add. Place in refrigerator overnight. Spread mushroom soup on top. Add rest of stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes uncovered. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix in bowl sugar flour and soda. In a saucepan put oleo shortening and cocoa. Add 1 cup water and boil. Pour this mixture over the flour mixture. Add buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Stir and put in a sheet cake pan. Be sure to grease and flour the pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Top with Texas Sheet Cake Topping.

title: Delmonico Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes 5 to 8 minutes. Cool. Grate into 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish.

title: Five Day Pickles
instructions: First Day Dissolve salt in half gallon boiling water. Pour over cucumbers. If this does not fill jar finish filling with boiling water. Drain after 24 hours.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Cook each item separately until tender; mix all items together. Salt to taste. Add a little Worcestershire sauce to taste. Simmer until ready to eat.

title: Feed The Crowd Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; add onions and pimento and cook at medium temperature for 10 minutes. Salt to taste. Put in 2 1/2-quart casserole and add 3 cups of cooked noodles. Mix cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soup plus 8 ounces sour cream and corn together. Pour on top of meat and noodles into casserole and top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Fried Chicken With Walnuts
instructions: Toast walnuts at 300\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Cut chicken in 1/2-inch cubes and mix with egg white and 1 tablespoon cornstarch and ginger. Stir-fry in hot oil in wok or skillet for 3 minutes until chicken changes color. Add wine and soy sauce. Cook 2 or 3 minutes then add cornstarch and water mixture and walnuts. Mix well and stir to heat through. Serve over steamed rice. Serves 4.

title: Cass' Wedding Day Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water in saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring until sugar dissolves. Cool. Combine next 4 ingredients with sugar mixture. Pour into a 5-quart freezer container and freeze until firm. Remove mixture from freezer several hours before serving (mixture should be slushy). Pour into punch bowl and stir in ginger ale. Yields 2 1/2 gallons.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine melted margarine with salt and pepper in shallow bowl. Place bread crumbs in shallow dish. Unfold chicken and dip one piece at a time into margarine then bread crumbs pressing to coat all sides. Arrange chicken in single layer on baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown and fork can be inserted in chicken with ease. When done chicken will not be pink when sliced through thickest part.

title: Donna Louise'S Slaw
instructions: Coarsely cut cabbage with knife or chop with dough cutter. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Goulash(Slop)
instructions: Crumble and fry hamburger; drain. Cook and drain 1 box macaroni. Combine in frypan with corn tomato sauce and seasonings. Cook on low for 10 minutes. Add cheese and continue cooking until cheese melts.

title: Mike'S New York Style Taters
instructions: Peel and cut in half potatoes; boil for 25 minutes. Let them cool after cooking. Chop up onions and microwave for 10 to 12 minutes (keep covered while in microwave). Cut up potatoes in chunks and let cool. Mix soup mayonnaise onions sliced mushrooms and Cheez Whiz first. Then add cooled chunks of potatoes and mix all together. In a 10-inch Corning Ware bowl spray with Pam or butter spray. Put everything into bowl and sprinkle over top with 100% Parmesan cheese. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook for 55 minutes.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Cook raisins about 5 minutes; drain. Add flour to sugar then to raisins. Put in butter. Stir in egg yolks one at a time. Add pecans and cook until thick. Put into an unbaked double crust pie shell. Bake until brown.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Rinse in hot water. Combine noodles with drained tuna celery and green onions. Blend in sour cream mustard mayonnaise thyme and salt. Spoon half mixture into buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with half zucchini. Repeat layers. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with chopped tomato.

title: Sliced Apples And Dip
instructions: Quarter apples with peel; put in salt water and let stand awhile before using. Mix together brown sugar and cream cheese and use as dip for apples.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together in a large bowl. Make a well in the center. Beat together the wet ingredients; add to flour mixture stirring just until moistened. (Batter will be thick.) Mixture may be stored in the refrigerator up to 3 weeks. Bake in muffin tins for 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Yields 40 muffins.

title: Connie'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In a large bowl mix milk soup and rice; add broccoli and mix. Add cheese. Saute onion in butter until tender (do not brown). Add onions and butter to mixture. Put in a large casserole. Crush crackers and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: Marinated Cucumber And Onion Slices
instructions: Place cucumbers and onions in covered container. Combine sour cream vinegar salt and pepper; pour over slices. Marinate until ready to serve. Will keep several days in refrigerator. Yields 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
instructions: Lightly brown pie crust. Mix all ingredients together and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 pies.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased cake pan. Blend sugar and cinnamon mix in lemon juice and water; pour over apples.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Rinse beans; set aside. In large pot or Dutch oven saute onion and garlic. Add clean beans ham smoked sausage salt pepper cayenne marjoram and enough water to cover. Cover and cook until beans are done. May need to add water from time to time. To serve place cooked white rice on plate and add cooked beans; garnish with chopped green onions.

title: Chocolate Chip-Brandy Souffle
instructions: Measure off a length of aluminum foil long enough to encircle 4-cup souffle dish. Fold in half lengthwise. Fasten to dish with tape or string so collar is about 6 inches higher than rim.

title: Holly Cookies
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows in double boiler. Add vanilla and coloring. Stir in corn flakes. Mix until well coated. Keep warm while dropping by teaspoonfuls on wax paper. Top each with red hots. These are great to make with children.

title: Spiced Peach Dumplings
instructions: In saucepan mix peaches sugar butter and lemon juice. Bring to boil. In large bowl mix all other ingredients except nuts. Drop this mixture by spoonfuls into hot peach mixture. Sprinkle with nuts. Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Serve hot with light cream or ice cream.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well; store in an airtight container. Mix 1/3 cup mix and 1 cup hot water.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix together the Cool Whip and pudding until green in color. Add marshmallows and drained pineapple. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 8 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Cinderella Crisps
instructions: Trim crusts off bread and cut in 4 strips for 24 crisps or cut in half for 48 crisps. Using 2 forks roll bread in Eagle Brand coating all sides. Then roll in coconut. Place on well-greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove at once from baking sheet. Makes 24 to 48 crisps.

title: Hot Milk Sponge Cake
instructions: About 1 hour ahead set out eggs. Start heating oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. With electric mixer at high speed beat eggs until very thick and light about 5 minutes. Add sugar gradually beating constantly. Beat in lemon juice. Fold in flour mixture small amount at a time. Add hot milk. Stir quickly until blended. Immediately turn batter into ungreased pan. Bake 35 minutes or until done. Use 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan or tube pan.

title: Lime Fruit Dip
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat the cream cheese until smooth. Beat in marshmallow creme and fold in yogurt and food coloring. Cover and refrigerate until until serving time.

title: Teriyaki Burgers
instructions: Shape ground beef into 4 patties each about 3/4 inch thick. Mix remaining ingredients. Spoon onto patties. Turn patties; let stand 10 minutes. Grill patties about 4 inches from medium coals turning once until desired doneness 5 to 7 minutes on each side for medium. Serve on toasted sesame seed buns.

title: Crunchy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together in large bowl the margarine sugars eggs and and vanilla. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture. Stir in by hand the oatmeal and corn flakes.

title: Apple Pie Cake
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan melt butter. Remove from heat. Blend in sugar and egg. Add remaining ingredients and mix until well blended.

title: Quick Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Cut 1/2 cup butter into flour with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly 3 or 4 times. Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes. Brush with melted butter.

title: Lots O Brownies
instructions: Melt oleo and cocoa; turn out fire and add sugar. Mix eggs flour salt and vanilla. Add this to cocoa mixture. Add nuts. Pour into greased and floured (2) 10-inch square cake pans or (1) large grill pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut while warm.

title: Chinese Beef With Peppers
instructions: Heat pan. Add oil and garlic. Remove garlic when brown. Add beef; fry a few minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add soup stock and continue to cook a few seconds. Add mixture of cornstarch soy sauce and water. Cook until sauce thickens stirring slowly. Add green pepper and fresh chopped ginger. Heat thoroughly and serve hot with rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Delicious Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl (medium speed) for 10 to 12 minutes. Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan. Pour in batter. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until a toothpick comes out clean. When cake is baking make sauce.

title: New York Style Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Spray the sides of a 9-inch springform pan with vegetable cooking spray.

title: Nana'S Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach; drain well. Add all ingredients; mix well. Put in greased casserole; cover with remaining stuffing mix (3/4 cup). Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Eggplant Provencal
instructions: Peel and cut eggplant. Peel and cut tomatoes into 6 slices; cut green pepper into 4 rings each. Combine herbs; set aside. Place 6 eggplant slices in greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Drizzle with 1/4 teaspoon olive oil. Lightly salt and pepper and 1/4 teaspoon herb mix. Layer 6 onion rings 6 tomato slices and 6 green peppers on top. Repeat oil and seasonings. Sprinkle each stack of vegetables with 1/4 teaspoon minced garlic. Repeat seasoned layers with remaining ingredients in a second 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan and Gruyere. Bake 5 minutes more. Makes 12 servings.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix everything in bowl the night before serving to insure proper blend of flavor. Serve with crackers.

title: Fig Preserve--To Jar
instructions: Wash and cut off tops of figs. Cook for at least 2 1/2 hours. Give 4 quarts.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt and cool shortening; add sugar eggs and molasses. Mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and add slowly. Chill dough. Form into small balls. Roll in sugar and bake on a greased cookie pan for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Wieners
instructions: Use same amount of jelly and mustard. Mix jelly and mustard in crock-pot. Add wieners that have been cut in 1/2-inch pieces. Marinate for 2 hours. Serve hot.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Mix and sift flour baking powder and salt. Add milk and well beaten egg. Pare and core apples. Slice about 1/4-inch thick. Dip each piece in batter and fry until golden brown. Drain on a paper towel. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve hot.

title: Perfect Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Add all ingredients together and mix well. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown stew beef in the oil in a Dutch oven. Add onions tomatoes beef broth celery and spices. Cook until meat is tender. Add carrots and potatoes; cook until they are tender. Before serving add enough cornstarch to thicken. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done; remove skin and bones and cut up. Saute celery and onions until tender. Mix with stuffing and 1/2 can chicken broth. Mix the 2 cans of soup together and add rest of broth. Grease casserole dish and layer stuffing mix chicken and soup. Reserve some stuffing for top of layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: Peach And Blueberry Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix peaches lightly with 2 tablespoons of sugar then cornstarch and then the lemon juice. Roll out the pie dough and press into a 9-inch pie plate crimping the edges. Arrange peaches around the sides leaving the center for the blueberries. Toss the blueberries with the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar. Pour into the center of the filled pie. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until the pastry is golden and the fruit is soft and bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Oatmeal Waffles
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir together flour oats baking powder cinnamon and salt. Set aside.

title: Mayonnaise Biscuits
instructions: Mix ingredients together; drop into a greased muffin pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber and onion and mix with other ingredients. Pour over cooked noodles and refrigerate.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Cream together the eggs sugar and butter. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Put in a buttered baking dish. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Italian Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream crisco and sugar; add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour soda and pinch of salt. Add to creamed mixture. Alternating flour and buttermilk. Add vanilla coconut and nuts. Blend in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into 9 x 13 in pan. Bake at 350 degrees about 30 minutes. Frost with cream cheese icing.

title: Chicken Bundles
instructions: In a small bowl beat cream cheese milk dill weed salt and pepper until smooth. Stir in chicken celery and onions. Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into 12 rectangles 4 from each tube. Press perforations together. Spoon 1/3 cup of the chicken mixture into the center of each rectangle. Bring edges up to the center and pinch to seal. Brush with butter and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 6 servings.

title: Demon Cake
instructions: Melt the chocolate over simmering water. Cream together the butter and 2 1/4 cups sugar. Add the melted chocolate to this mixture. Sift the flour salt baking soda and baking powder together and add alternately with buttermilk. Add well beaten egg yolks and stiffly beaten egg whites to mixture. Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Pour the batter into three well-greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at\t350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Superb(Diabetic)
instructions: Mix together flour salt and half the pepper. Lightly coat chicken with flour mixture. Cook chicken in margarine until golden using a tightly covered pan. Turn breasts meat side down; add remaining ingredients and cover. Stirring occasionally simmer gently until tender (about 30 minutes). Serve over noodles or rice. Yields 4 servings.

title: Yogurt Pie
instructions: Fold yogurt into the Cool Whip; spoon into crust. Freeze firm for 4 hours. Remove from freezer for 30 minutes before serving. Garnish with strawberries or use any kind of yogurt.

title: Penuche
instructions: Mix sugars cream milk and butter in saucepan. Boil to soft stage or 238\u00b0 stirring only if needed. Remove from heat. Cool to lukewarm (110\u00b0) without stirring. Add vanilla. Beat vigorously until fudge thickens and loses gloss. Add nuts. Spread in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Score; cut when firm.

title: Bacon-Corn Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain. Saute onion in drippings for about 5 minutes. Blend in flour and mix to a smooth paste. Gradually add water and stir until smooth. Add potatoes celery and bay leaves. Cover and cook over low heat. Blend in corn milk seasonings and bacon. Heat and serve.

title: Tri-Berry Salad
instructions: Mix both jello packages with 1 cup of boiling water. Add thawed berries. Mix well and add cranberry sauce. Chill and serve.

title: Seedless Grape Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Mix pineapple with grapes. Make sauce of pineapple juice sour cream and brown sugar.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup Au Gratin
instructions: Cook onion in butter until tender. Add water and contents of rice and seasoning packets. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Combine flour and dry mustard in a small bowl. Gradually add about 1/2 cup broth stirring until smooth. Stir remaining broth flour mixture and milk into rice mixture. Heat to simmer stirring occasionally. Stir in cheese. Sprinkle with green onion.

title: Sheryl Stuff
instructions: Spray pan with pam and add all stuff. Cook until tender.

title: Zucchini Bars
instructions: Cream together the first 5 ingredients. Add the flour salt and baking powder. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Beat together 2 minutes in mixer the eggs cake mix lemon jello and water. Add oil and beat 1 minute. Pour into 10 x 14-inch oiled pan or 2 shallow pans. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Save liquid from asparagus melt butter and blend in flour and salt. Add liquid and cook until thickened stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Add cheese; stir until cheese is melted. Alternate layers of hard-boiled eggs asparagus and cheese sauce. Cover with bread crumbs in greased casserole. Sprinkle paprika over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Praline Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Cream the oleo with 1/3 cup brown sugar; stir in pecans. Press evenly in a layer in pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove and cool 10 minutes on wire rack. Lower oven temperature to 350\u00b0.

title: Franklin'S Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken in water until done. Remove chicken from broth and debone. Add chicken back to broth and add rice and soup. Add seasonings. Cover and cook until rice is done using medium heat and then turn gradually to low heat on top of range.

title: Tex-Mex Cornbread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in large bowl and into a hot greased 9 x 14-inch pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown (more golden than brown).

title: Lemon-Honey Chiffon Pie
instructions: Soften gelatin in water. Beat egg yolks and combine with honey salt lemon rind and juice in top of double boiler. Cook over hot water stirring until mixture starts to thicken. Remove from heat. Add gelatin and stir to dissolve. Cool stirring occasionally. When cooled completely fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and pour in pie shell. Bake in a 9-inch pie shell. Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Donut Muffins
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Sift flour with baking powder salt and spices. Mix alternately with milk. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove and roll in 6 tablespoons melted butter then in 1 cup confectioners sugar.

title: Hot Mustard Sauce For Dipping
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Keeps in refrigerator.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients reserving a small amount of stuffing for topping. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Torte
instructions: Cream together in a large bowl the butter and sugar. Add egg and beat until light and fluffy.

title: Chicken Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water according to package directions. Drain broccoli and spread into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix chicken soup mayonnaise mushrooms curry powder and 1/2 cup grated cheese in a medium bowl. Spread chicken mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese over top.

title: Buffet Beef Cubes
instructions: Shake beef in bag with flour. Brown in electric or regular 10-inch fry pan. Combine next 7 ingredients and add to browned meat. Add onions and bay leaf. Cook. Simmer covered for 2 hours until tender and liquid is of gravy consistency. Serve over hot rice seasoned with butter and parsley over buttered noodles or mashed potatoes. Discard bay leaf.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients into bowl. Make 3 depressions. Into one pour vinegar into another vanilla and into the other pour the oil. Pour cold water over all and mix. Do not beat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 9 x 9-inch ungreased pan.

title: Easy Apple Dumplings
instructions: Place half of apple in center of square. Put on top of apple 1 teaspoon oleo 1/2 teaspoon sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Bring up points of square to top of apple and moisten as needed to seal. Place on lightly greased sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar egg and vanilla. Sift together flour soda salt and cinnamon; add to butter mixture. Mix until smooth. Stir in oats and raisins. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Mix all in top of double boiler except vanilla. Beat one minute to blend. Cook over boiling water for 7 minutes. Add vanilla; dont overcook. Beat 2 more minutes.

title: Berry Lite Mousse
instructions: Mix gelatin and boiling water in blender at low speed until gelatin is dissolved about 30 seconds. Add ice. Stir until partially melted. Add strawberries. Blend well. Blend in whipped topping. Pour into dessert glasses. Chill about 2 hours. Garnish. Makes 6 servings. Contains less than 45 calories.

title: Hot Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together then stir in the mayonnaise. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Brown the Ritz crumbs in the margarine then spread the crumbs over the vegetable mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until heated through and bubbling. Serves about 8 to 10.

title: Heavenly Hushpuppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add enough buttermilk until mixture has a coarse consistency. In a large pot heat vegetable oil to 325 degrees. (Try to maintain a constant temperature.) Spoon mixture into hot oil. Cook until golden brown.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook noodles as directed (drain). Pour Italian dressing over noodles and serve chilled.

title: Ham Strata(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Trim crust off bread when bread is dried. Place bread in cookie sheet covering whole bottom. Sprinkle grated cheese (1/2 pound) on top of bread then all ham on top of cheese. Then sprinkle remaining cheese on top of ham. Beat eggs together then add rest of ingredients to egg mixture. Mix well and pour over cheese and ham. Cover pan with foil; refrigerate overnight or 6 hours minimum. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 or 60 minutes uncovered. Cool 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.

title: London Broil
instructions: Score meat combine marinade and pour over meat. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours. Turn several times.

title: First Lady'S Pralines
instructions: Blend sugar salt and evaporated milk. Cook to 232\u00b0 (soft ball stage). Remove from heat. Add vanilla butter and pecan halves. Beat just until candy begins to thicken. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto wax paper (work fast for candy hardens quickly). Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Cream together sugar butter and flour. Add eggs corn and milk. Add baking powder just before baking. Bake in a 325\u00b0oven for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Will serve 8. (I bake in a lasagna pan.)

title: Old Fashioned Cream Of Tomato Soup
instructions: In a saucepan combine the first six ingredients. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Heat cream in the top of double boiler over simmering water; add to the tomato mixture just before serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Browned Rice
instructions: Brown onions rice and beef in oleo in large skillet. Place in a large baking dish and add other remaining ingredients. Cover with foil and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until rice is done.

title: Keebler 15 Minute Cherry Burst Pie
instructions: In a medium bowl combine condensed milk lemon juice and vanilla. Mix until well blended. Fold in remaining ingredients one at a time mixing well after each addition. Mound mixture into crust. Freeze until firm about 2 to 3 hours. Let stand at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Green Beans
instructions: Remove wrappers from green bean boxes; place boxes in a flat baking dish and pierce with a fork. Microwave at High for 12 to 15 minutes rearranging boxes once. Drain beans and place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Cover and microwave at High for 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yield 8 servings (about 35 calories per serving).

title: Canzadia'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut up the fruit and nuts.

title: Quick Dinner
instructions: Saute beef and onions (until cooked) in pan. Pour in casserole dish. Top with can of English peas. Put potatoes on top of peas. Cook 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. About 5 minutes before you take out sprinkle with cheese.

title: Lemon Cheesecake
instructions: Stir cream cheese until very soft. Gradually blend in 1/2 cup milk until smooth and creamy. Add 1 1/2 cups milk and lemon instant pudding mix. Beat slowly with mixer 1 minute. Pour at once into a cooled baked graham cracker crust. Chill 1 hour or until firm.

title: Bar B Q Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a boiler. Simmer for\t20 minutes. This will not burn easily if used on meat cooked on grill. Good on poultry beef or pork.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Hot Sauce Pape'
instructions: * Adjust to taste.

title: Fillet Of Sole Oscar
instructions: Wash drain and dry fillets. Cut into serving portions. Place 2 stalks asparagus on each portion of fish and roll up jelly roll style and secure with toothpick. Place in baking dish sprayed with butter-flavored Pam (11 x 13 x 2-inch casserole or whatever size will hold number of fillets preparing). Sprinkle with lemon juice and dot lightly with butter or margarine. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily. Pour sauce over the fish and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Lambert'S Throwed Rolls
instructions: Combine sugar and yeast in warm water. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes or until yeast begins to foam. Thoroughly mix milk butter sugar eggs and salt in a large mixing bowl. Stir in the yeast mixture and 3 1/2 cups of flour adding a bit more if necessary to make a soft pliable dough. Turn dough out on a floured board and let rest while you clean and butter a bowl. Knead dough gently for 4 to 5 minutes adding flour until the dough is smooth and silky. Return the dough to the bowl; cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until the dough is doubled in size. Butter a 12 cup muffin pan. Punch down dough; pinch off pieces about 1 1/2-inches in diameter or enough to fill 1/2 of muffin cup and roll into smooth spheres. Place two such pieces in each prepared muffin cups. (It should be a tight fit.) Cover dough loosely with plastic wrap for 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake rolls 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown. Serve as soon as they cool enough to throw. Makes 12 thrown rolls.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Fry the onion and the chicken. Mix the chicken onions cream of chicken soup sour cream and chili powder in a large mixing bowl. Set aside. Mix the two cheeses together in a bowl. Lay out tortillas. Spoon 2 heaping tablespoons of the chicken mixture into the tortillas. Sprinkle cheese on top. Roll tortilla. Repeat this step until you have used all the tortillas. Put the tortillas into a large baking dish. Pour the remaining mixture over top of the rolled tortillas. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Cook uncovered at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast in oven at 500\u00b0 for 30 minutes (do not preheat). Add soups and water; cover pan and cook 2 hours at 325\u00b0. Add vegetables; cook additional hour at 325\u00b0. Serve; use sauce for gravy.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Shortly before serving empty frozen fruit juice concentrates pineapple juice cranberry juice and cold water into large punch bowl. Stir to hasten thawing. Just before serving gently pour in ginger ale and sparkling water. Float fruited ice ring on top. Makes 50 servings.

title: Gummy Gooey Cake
instructions: Mix together. This will be stiff. Spread evenly in a long pan.

title: World'S Best Roast
instructions: Use deep long pan. Line with foil. Place roast in bottom. Cover with onion slices and mushrooms. Pour soup over roast. Add vegetables. Cook at 225\u00b0 to 250\u00b0 overnight at least 8 hours.

title: Veal Chops And Squash
instructions: Combine flour salt garlic and basil. Roll chops in mixture. Brown chops in a large frying pan. Pour off drippings. Add 1/2 cup of water. Cover and cook 45 minutes. Drain tomatoes to make 1 cup. Combine remaining flour mixture with tomato liquid and stir into cooking liquid. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add tomatoes and zucchini and cook covered 20 minutes.

title: French Fruit Au Gratin
instructions: Mix fruits and cognac and let marinate for 2 hours at room temperature. Pour mixture into 2-quart shallow baking dish. In saucepan mix egg yolks sugar and cream and stir over low heat until thickened. Do not boil. Stir in vanilla. Pour mixture evenly over undrained marinated fruit. Place under preheated broiler and broil 8 to 10 minutes or until fluffy and golden brown. Serve warm. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Surprise
instructions: In large skillet cook chicken and onion. Add broccoli florets mushrooms and mushroom soup with 1 cup milk. Let simmer 10 minutes. Turn off heat. Cover with sharp cheese. Serve over rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Sift and stir in flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Chill dough for 2 hours. Roll in small balls and drop in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 8-10 min.

title: Crusty Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed. Beat in cream cheese until fluffy. Alternately add cocoa and flour. Add eggs. Begin and end with flour when mixing. Stir in vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove.

title: Creamy Apple Squares
instructions: Combine cake mix and butter. Mix until crumbly. Reserve 2/3 cup for topping. Add brown sugar and cinnamon to this reserved topping. Mix well and set aside.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Brown meat all your seasonings and onion. Add tomato paste sauce tomatoes and water. Add bell pepper. Cook 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Yummies
instructions: Mix cheese with butter. Add flour until well mixed.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour salt and soda. Blend into mixture; add flavor. Bake in greased pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Do not open oven for 1 hour.

title: Cucumbers With Pasta
instructions: Peel and seed the cucumbers. Dice the flesh into 1/4-inch pieces and toss with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 2 tablespoons wine vinegar. Let set for 30 minutes and drain. Peel seed and dice the tomatoes and combine with the cucumbers onions garlic herbs and olive oil. Taste and add more vinegar salt and pepper if necessary. Boil the spaghetti in several quarts of salted water until cooked through but still chewy. Toss the hot pasta with the cucumber-tomato mixture serve with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Strawberry Salad Mold
instructions: Make gelatin and let cool until syrupy. Add softened cream cheese drained pineapple and nuts. Put into mild and chill to set.

title: Rice Krispy Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies and additional flavorings if desired. Stir until well coated. Press mixture evenly into a 13 x 9 x 2 pan coated with cooking spray. Cut into squares when cooled.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of a square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inches) with shortening. Heat margarine and 1 package chocolate chips in a 2-quart saucepan over low heat stirring constantly until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients except nuts and 1/2 cup chocolate chips real hard with a wooden spoon until smooth. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips. Spread in pan with a rubber spatula.
