Bake until the center is set about 30 minutes. Cool completely; cut into 1 3/4 x 1 1/2-inch brownies. Store brownies tightly covered. Makes 20 brownies.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into small balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Pork Chops And Potatoes
instructions: Brown pork chops; drain fat. Put onion soup flour and 2 cups water in pan. Add pork chops carrots and potatoes; sprinkle with thyme. Cook on simmer in electric frypan until carrots are ready about 1 hour.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add very slowly sugar and continue to beat. Fold in dates and nuts. Drop batter on well greased cookie sheet. Put in oven and turn oven off. Leave overnight or at least 2 hours.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix water 100% bran shortening and sugar together and let cool. Mix and add eggs flour soda buttermilk and bran flakes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Apple Butter - No Sugar
instructions: Put all ingredients into large saucepan and simmer uncovered about 15 minutes. Apples should be soft. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Put half in blender and blend until smooth. Blend the other half. Keeps well in refrigerator or freeze.

title: Hot Cocoa
instructions: Mix all together and heat.

title: Vanilla Cream Pie Or Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt; gradually stir in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Stir small amount of hot mixture into yolks. Return to hot mixture. Cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla; cool. Pour into pie crust. Top with meringue.

title: Pomander In A Pot
instructions: In a saucepan cover spices with water and warm over low heat. Check occasionally and add more water as needed.

title: Broccoli Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill at least one hour.

title: Filet Belmont House
instructions: Season steaks with salt and pepper to taste. Grill 4 minutes per side. Mix broth brandy and rosemary and boil (about 5 minutes). Spoon over steaks and top with Blue cheese.

title: Barbecued Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan. Add onion; saute until soft and transparent. Stir in ketchup water Worcestershire sauce sugar vinegar tomato paste dry mustard and red pepper. Stirring occasionally simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Immediately stir shrimp into sauce covering completely. Let stand 15 minutes.

title: Sunday Chicken
instructions: Place the chicken breasts in a casserole dish with a pat of butter on each breast. Pour cream of mushroom soup over top. Bake covered for 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. This is called Sunday Chicken because it cooks while you are at church. Pour over rice when done and serve.

title: Ada'S Baked Beans
instructions: Bake in greased loaf pan for 1 hour or longer at 350\u00b0.

title: Butter Pecan Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk. Heat to boiling point and boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add chips pecans marshmallows and vanilla. Stir until marshmallows melt. Pour into a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Cut in squares.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix macaroni and cheese as usual according to the box directions. Add the soup. Add the chopped mango. Cook over low heat until mixture thickens.

title: Salsa
instructions: Finely chop tomatoes garlic cilantro jalapeno (use jalapeno only no juice) and onions. Mix together in bowl and refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips. The salsa gets hotter when it is refrigerated. Do not add more jalapenos than the recipe calls for.

title: Zucchini Dressing
instructions: Mix stuffing according to directions on box. Add chopped celery. Then slice and peel squash. In a greased baking dish layer squash and stuffing. Beat egg and cream of mushroom soup together and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 to 50 minutes or until squash is done.

title: Tortilla Pie
instructions: Mix spinach and cottage cheese; set aside. Brown turkey onion and garlic then add chilies tomato sauce bread crumbs chili powder and cumin. Simmer 10 minutes. Layer in 13 x 9-inch pan tortillas 1/3 meat 1/3 spinach and 1/3 cheese. Repeat until done. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes covered and 10 minutes uncovered.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into small meatballs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Place in casserole dish and pour sauce over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for another 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Texas Trash
instructions: Melt butter with spices and Worcestershire sauce. Combine cereals in roaster. Pour butter mixture over cereals; cover and bake at 250\u00b0 for one hour stirring every 20 minutes. Remove cover and bake another 30 minutes. Add nuts. Cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Annie Floye'S Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except eggs thoroughly. Beat one egg at a time into the mixture. Bake in 3 cake pans (8-inches) for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and frost.

title: Broccoli Salad(Easy, Delightful, Cold Summer Salad)
instructions: Steam broccoli flowerheads until just crisp. Add Feta cheese. Pour vinaigrette dressing over all. Serve warm or cold.

title: Kentucky Jam Cake
instructions: Mix sugar margarine eggs jam and milk together then add dry ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour in Bundt pan.

title: Crab And Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Never Fail Bake Turkey
instructions: Massage bird with salt and pepper inside and out. Peel peeled onion and chopped celery inside the cavity of turkey. Add water to roasting pan. Place turkey back side up in roaster on a rack and put lid on roaster fitting tightly. Place covered roaster in a cold oven and turn to bake at 500\u00b0. Do not open oven door at any time. Let cook for one hour. Turn off the oven and forget the turkey for several hours. Meat will be brown and moist and plenty of broth.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Steam or cook vegetables in a small amount of water until tender. Drain. Combine soup base and milk (enough for a good soup base consistency). Add vegetables salt and pepper. Heat (not too long). Put in bowls and top with Colby.

title: Gladys' Polish Mistakes
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage; add salt to taste. Drain. Add oregano. Chunk the Velveeta cheese. Add cheese to meat mixture; mix well while meat is hot so cheese will melt. Spread on rye bread. Can freeze on cookie sheet then bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Instant Cocoa Mix
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Use 2 heaping tablespoonfuls to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix first four ingredients fold in frozen blueberries. Allow to sit several hours. Serve in baked pie shell tart shells or in sherbet dishes with no crust.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together. Roll into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Savannah Sunshine Cake
instructions: Stir together pineapple apple pie filling cinnamon mix and raisins. Pour into greased and floured 8 x 8 cake pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over mixture. Slice cold butter into squares and place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Resift 2 cups flour with powdered sugar into medium bowl. Add butter and mix thoroughly. Pat dough evenly into bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake until golden about 25 minutes.

title: Broasted New Potatoes
instructions: Pour oil into plastic bag. Add potatoes and shake to coat well. Add dressing mix and shake well until all potatoes are coated. Place potatoes in crock-pot and cook 8 hours on low or 4 hours on high.

title: Almond Gingersnaps(Skurna Pepperkakor)
instructions: Work butter until creamy. Add sugar molasses spices baking soda almonds and flour. Turn onto floured baking board and knead until smooth. Shape into 2 thick slightly flattened rolls. Wrap each in waxed paper and chill thoroughly. Cut crosswise with sharp knife in thin slices. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0) 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Apple Potato Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients; turn into foil-lined loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour turn into serving dish. Serves 6.

title: Kitchenette Cake
instructions: Sift in bowl the flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add the shortening milk and vanilla. Beat vigorously for 2 minutes. Add the egg and beat 2 more minutes. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and cut up. Mix all together and put in large casserole or loaf cake pan. Cover with crushed potato chips if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Three Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In a a large saucepan combine first four ingredients. Cook and stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved. Bring to a rapid boil boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from the heat stir in marshmallows until melted. Stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add chocolate bars and baking chocolate stir until melted. Fold in vanilla and pecans mix well. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1 in. baking pan. Chill until firm and cut into squares.

title: Possum Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Spread onto bottom of crust. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. In another bowl combine pudding mixes. Add milk and vanilla. Beat on low speed for 2 minutes. Spoon over the pecans. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Top with whipped cream and pecan halves.

title: Congealed Beet Salad
instructions: Bring water beet juice vinegar and sugar to a boil. Pour over jello. When jello begins to set add beets and seed. Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Refrigerate. Serves 12.

title: Beef Patty And Peppers
instructions: Coat patty with flour. Place on large pieces of foil or in small foil pan. Place pepper strips around meat. Sprinkle with soy sauce sherry and pepper. Seal or cover tightly. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 serving. Good with potato nuggets sprinkled with garlic or onion powder (1 cup) and sliced tomato and lettuce.

title: Yule Cake
instructions: Place nuts dates cherries and raisins in a large bowl. Measure flour baking powder and salt into sifter. Sift over nuts and fruit; mix well.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients then add 5 cups powdered sugar and mix. Will be stiff. Roll into balls. Melt the chocolate chips. Dip balls into chocolate and place on wax paper. Keep cold.

title: Cream Cheese Olive Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding milk slowly to achieve dipping consistency. Chill and serve with potato chips or Ritz crackers.

title: Gourmet Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Blend oatmeal in blender to a fine powder. Cream butter and both sugars together. Add eggs vanilla and almond extract. Mix together flour blended oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture. Add chips grated Hershey bar and nuts.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in large skillet and cook on low 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Mix oregano basil onion flakes cheese and bread crumbs in a mixing bowl. Dip chicken into butter then into bread crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Combine apple juice onion and remaining margarine. After 45 minutes pour over chicken and return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: My Grandmother'S Scones
instructions: Grease 12 bun tins. Sift flour baking powder salt and sugar. Beat egg and milk together. Pour into flour. Mix until creamy. Fill bun tins about 2/3 full.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend and chill for 1 hour. Use pears apples grapes and melons of all kinds. Cut in bite size pieces. Arrange around bowl of dip.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers onions and salt. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain off liquid. Combine sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil until sugar is dissolved. Add celery seed. Put cucumbers and onions in plastic freezer containers; pour syrup on top. Close tightly and freeze.

title: Creamed Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli in salt water in saucepan. Drain. In saucepan melt butter blend in flour add milk salt pepper and cook until thickened. Add onions to drained broccoli and then combine onion and broccoli to cream sauce. Beat until light. Place in baking dish. Top with crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Saucy Budget Steak
instructions: Brown shoulder or steak in preheated 425\u00b0 oven 20 minutes; drain fat. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0. Combine water catsup brown sugar Worcestershire and salt. Pour over meat. Cover; bake until tender about 1 1/2 hours. Spoon sauce over meat. Can be made ahead refrigerated and reheated covered.

title: Olives In Cheese
instructions: Mix the cheese and sauce. Add enough cream to make a smooth thick paste. Roll olive in cream mixture. Be sure that each is well coated. Roll in chopped nuts.

title: Fried Oysters
instructions: Roll oysters in cracker crumbs or corn meal. Melt fat in a skillet or heavy frying pan. Add oysters and sprinkle with salt. Fry on medium heat until a golden brown on both sides.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a small bowl mix the Miracle Whip sugar and vinegar together to make a dressing. Combine all the veggies cheese and bacon. Add the dressing and mix well. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve juice. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Rub with garlic and thyme. Brown in hot oil. Combine 2 tablespoons juice with cornstarch. Combine honey and mustard. Stir in skillet with remaining juice. Spoon sauce over chicken. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.\tStir cornstarch mixture into pan juices. Add pineapple. Cook stirring until sauce boils and thickens. Serves 4.

title: Cherry Sauce
instructions: Drain juice from cherries and pineapple and combine for 3/4 cup liquid. Mix together in a saucepan the sugar vinegar and 1/2 cup of the combined fruit juices; add cloves and cinnamon stick. Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes over low heat. Mix the flour with the balance of the combined fruit juices and blend into the hot syrup. Stirring constantly cook until smooth and thickened. Add cherries pineapple and lemon juice and heat until hot. Serve the sauce hot with hot or cold ham.

title: Strawberry Preserves
instructions: De-cap strawberries and wash. Place berries in colander. Pour boiling water over them completely then spray (or rinse) with cold water thoroughly. Place in a large pot and add 2 cups of sugar and juice from half of a lemon. Turn stove on high stirring until juice is a rolling boil. Boil 5 minutes. Remove. Add 2 cups more of sugar. Bring to a rolling boil again 5 minutes. Pour in a large bowl. Let stand 2 days. Remove white residue from top. Stir every so often. Boil jars. Add preserves and put a paraffin layer on top. Let set then paraffin layer again. Put on lid.

title: Fudgy No-Bakes
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar cocoa milk and butter or margarine. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Remove from heat. Add oats and vanilla. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto was paper forming slightly with fingers if needed. Cool completely. Makes approximately 5 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Southern Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add vanilla milk and dry ingredients. Blend well. Place dough on lightly floured surface. Sprinkle a little flour over dough and roll to about 1/2-inch thick. Cut with cookie cutter and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Prick tops with fork and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until lightly browned on top.

title: Caramel Candy
instructions: Put all ingredients (except vanilla and walnuts) into stainless steel pan. Boil 20 minutes. (Do not overboil.) Add nuts and vanilla and pour in greased pan.

title: Rose Petal Jam
instructions: In a large stockpot combine sugar and water over medium-high heat; stir constantly until sugar dissolves. Stir petals and rose flower water into syrup. Bring to a rolling boil. Add pectin; stir until dissolved. Bring to a rolling boil again and boil 1 minute longer. Remove from heat; skim off foam. If desired tint with food coloring. Pour into jars. Cool and store in refrigerator.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Break crackers coarsely into one pie shell. Combine water sugar and cream of tartar in saucepan; boil 15 minutes. Add lemon juice and rind. Cool. Pour syrup over crackers dot with oleo and sprinkle with cinnamon. Add top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Mix flour and sugar; add to beaten eggs. Add lemon juice and apricot juice and cook to medium sauce. When cooled place layers of apricots cheese and nuts in bowl. Pour sauce over all. Chill.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and salt. Boil butter cocoa and water. Mix together eggs buttermilk and soda. Mix all three parts together. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a greased sheet pan.

title: Copper Penny Carrots
instructions: Drain carrots; arrange carrots bell pepper and onions in layers in container. Make marinade of other ingredients and beat well. Pour over and refrigerate. Will keep for weeks.

title: Seven Layer Dip
instructions: Spread beans on a 10-inch serving platter. Blend sour cream and salad dressing mix; spread over beans. Layer remaining ingredients. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreos; put one layer in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. (Save some of the crushed Oreos to sprinkle on top of cake.) Mix pudding milk and vanilla; pour over crushed Oreos. Mix the cream cheese and margarine until smooth then mix in powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Put this mixture over the pudding mixture. Put remaining crushed Oreos on top.

title: Orange Pork Chops
instructions: Trim fat and brown chops in oil. Remove chops and keep drippings. Add onion and saute. Return chops to pan. Add rest of ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover skillet and simmer 30 minutes or until tender. Remove cover; increase heat to medium-high and continue to cook until liquid is almost evaporated about 3 minutes.

title: Frozen Oreo Pie
instructions: Crumble Oreo cookies finely. Stir in melted butter. Pat cookies flat in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice softened ice cream to fit in pan evenly. May decorate top with extra cookie sprinkles or whole cookies. Freeze. Serve slightly thawed.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix preceding ingredients together and pour into unbaked crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients salt and pepper to taste. Save half of dressing mix for top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Frankfurter Pizzas
instructions: Place muffin halves on paper plate. Spread cut sides with equal amount of pizza sauce. Carefully make 5 cups into frankfurters 3/4-inch apart and almost through. Arrange frankfurter in a circle on each muffin half. Cover with half slice of cheese. Sprinkle with oregano. Microwave on High 1 minute.

title: Summer Melon Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients with mayonnaise except lettuce and melon slices. Place lettuce leaves on plate. Place melon slices on lettuce. Fill circle of melon with chicken melon salad.

title: Meat-Za-Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in pie plate with fork. Press 1/2-inch from top of pan. Spread catsup on meat then mushrooms cheese and oregano. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Loaf
instructions: Combine apples pecans and sugar. Let stand one hour stirring often; do not drain. Combine flour sugar salt and spices. Stir in butter vanilla and eggs. Spoon into 2 greased 1 pound coffee cans. Tie a 2-inch band of foil around top of cans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center is clean. Cool in cans for 10 minutes. Remove from cans and complete cooling.

title: Smoked Sausage Casserole
instructions: Slice the smoked sausage and place in the bottom of an electric skillet or baking dish. Top with sliced potatoes and onions. Sprinkle with Cajun seasoning and cook until done. Do not stir while cooking. Easy and delicious!

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour cocoa soda and salt. Cream mayonnaise and sugar; blend well. Add flour and water. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate over low flame. Pour over sugar and mix. Add eggs and flour which has been sifted vanilla and chopped nuts. Put in greased pan (about 7 x 10-inch); bake very slowly for about 30 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0. Cut into squares when taken from oven. Let cool before removing from pan. Yields about 30.

title: Sugarless Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cook raisins and dates in 2 cups water until water is evaporated. Watch carefully! Combine all dry ingredients and add raisins and dates. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mad Hatter Meatballs
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add green pepper and onion and cook until tender. Stir in soups and water. Heat to boiling then turn down heat and simmer sauce stirring occasionally. While sauce cooks make meatballs. Beat egg slightly in large bowl. Add ground beef bread evaporated milk and salt. Mix well. Shape meat into balls about the size of ping pong balls. Drop balls into simmering sauce and cook slowly about 1 hour or until sauce has thickened. Can serve over rice or mashed potatoes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Corn With Basil
instructions: Melt oleo in 3-quart saucepan. Saute onions and pepper until tender (5 minutes). Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat through. Makes approximately 8 servings.

title: Quick Refrigerator Relish
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients. Place in refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in paper sack with Bisquick salt paprika and pepper. Shake until chicken is well coated. Use shortening to coat sides of baking pan 9 x 13-inch. Bake for 45 minutes in 425\u00b0 oven. Turn chicken over and bake 15 minutes longer. Last 15 minutes put 1/2 cup water and cover with aluminum foil.

title: Salsa And Cheese
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Pour the jar of salsa over the cream cheese and enjoy with Fritos or tortilla chips.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Make pudding with milk in a bowl until thick. In separate bowl mix boiling water with Jell-O then add strawberries. In separate bowl break bread in pieces. In large bowl layer cake Jell-O pudding Cool Whip until gone. Cool in refrigerator overnight.

title: Hash Browns
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut up or shred. Combine potatoes onion salt and pepper in a large skillet with melted butter. Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes until bottom is crisp. Turn over and cook 10 more minutes.

title: Veggie Pizza Appetizer
instructions: Pam a 13 x 15-inch baking sheet. Unroll rolls and spread them out to fit pan as a crust. Bake according to package directions; let cool.

title: Grilled Kielbasa Sausage And Potatoes
instructions: Slice sausage into 1/2-inch sections. Cut potatoes in half; slice into thin pieces. Place in pan with sausage; cover with pieces of margarine. Sprinkle diced onion on top to season. Cover with foil; place on grill. Gently turn frequently to prevent potatoes from sticking. Cook for approximately 30 to 45 minutes until potatoes become soft.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Beat eggs. Combine with milk. Sift dry ingredients together and mix thoroughly with milk mixture. Heat deep fat in heavy skillet. Pour batter through funnel into fat. Move funnel to make different shapes. If batter is too stiff add milk. If too thin add flour. When cake is golden brown drain and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Linguini With Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute clams in butter and oil and garlic for 3 minutes or so. Add remainder of ingredients except cornstarch. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Add cornstarch which was mixed with 2 teaspoons water and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Thin with reserved juice if too thick. This will be enough sauce for a one pound package of linguini or spaghetti. Recipe is easily cut in half.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole dish. Pour into squash mixture and add eggs and milk. Beginning with squash layer into casserole dish. Then layer either crumbled or whole saltine crackers and grated Cheddar cheese. Make at least 2 layers ending with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until lightly browned. Onion or grated carrot may also be added to this.

title: Coconut Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
instructions: Mix ingredients in order stirring well after each addition. Pour in a 10-inch pie plate. Cook at 350\u00b0 about 30 to 45 minutes or until brown and firm.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Do not mix any of these ingredients! Place ingredients in pan in layers as they are called for starting with the pineapple and ending with cut up butter on the top. Place in preheated oven and bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Use a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan.

title: Lorraine'S German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes. Cool peel and slice them in a large bowl. Add chopped onion. Add sugar. Cook diced bacon until crisp. Pour over potatoes onion and sugar. Bring to boil the vinegar. Pour over potatoes. Mix. If you need more vinegar add 1/4 cup at a time.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender (with top on) for 10 seconds at high speed. Pour into buttered baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger (drain). Add taco mix tomato sauce and olives; simmer. Spread out crescent rolls. Spread 1/2 crushed chips. Pour hamburger mix over. Spread sour cream over top. Spread shredded cheese. Cover with remaining chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Easy Crock Pot Mac And Cheese
instructions: Add all ingredients into a lightly greased crock pot. Cover and cook on high 2-3 hours. Stir once or twice.

title: Orange Diet (Sugar-Free) Salad
instructions: Drain the oranges; combine with other ingredients except Jell-O. Sprinkle dry Jell-O over the mixture. Let set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Blender Pie
instructions: Put all in blender and mix well. Grease and flour a 9-inch pie plate. Pour all into pie plate and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until solid and brown. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pasta With 3 Colored Peppers
instructions: In saute pan place margarine oil and onion. On medium-high heat saute onions until translucent. Add all peppers and cook on medium-high until tender but not mushy. Stir gently. Add salt and pepper and cream. Mix gently. Cook uncovered until reduced in half. Add a dash of white wine.

title: Shrimp Christmas Tree
instructions: Place frozen shrimp in salted boiling water. Let the shrimp return to boil. Cook from 2 to 3 minutes. Do not overcook. Drain and chill. Separate and wash endive. Drain well. Chill. Place cone in the center of the styrofoam square and draw a circle around the base of cone. Cut out the circle and insert cone. Cover base and cone with overlapping leaves of endive. Fasten endive to styrofoam with toothpick halves. Start at the outside edge of the base and work up. Cover fully with greens to resemble Christmas tree. Attach shrimp to tree with toothpicks. Add cherry tomatoes with toothpick around cone to look like ornaments. Provide cocktail sauce for dunking.

title: Low Cholesterol Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine and sift 1 3/4 cups flour sugar and baking powder. Combine milk Scramblers and oil; beat with rotary beaters until well mixed. Make a well in center of dry ingredients. Pour liquids into well. Stir until dry ingredients are moist. Do not overmix.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Prepare jello with boiling water and cold water. Add pineapple. Pour into 9 x 12 dish and refrigerate until set. To the cream cheese (room temperature) add milk and mix until like soft butter. Spread over lime jello and chill thoroughly.

title: Fresh Pineapple And Macadamia Nut Pie
instructions: Twist crown from pineapple and cut the pineapple into quarters. Remove fruit from shells. Core and cut pineapple into bite size chunks. Combine sugar cornstarch lemon peel and nutmeg in a large saucepan. Stir in water and food coloring. Cook stirring constantly until sauce is clear and thickened. Remove from heat. Add pineapple. Cool. Spoon fruit into baked pie shell or Macadamia Nut Crust. Pour sauce evenly over fruit. Cover and chill overnight. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Drops
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan combine sugar flour milk and butter. Bring to a full boil. Boil for three minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool completely.

title: Hog Maw(Pig Stomach)
instructions: Dice the raw potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes. Mix sausage salt potatoes and onion. Stuff pig stomach. Sew up the opening. Place in a roast pan with 1/4 cup of water. Cover. Bake 3 hours at 300\u00b0 (uncover for 1 hour). I use 1 1/2 pounds spareribs.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Cook hamburger. Season with salt pepper chili powder (optional) and garlic salt. In a separate pan fry tortillas in deep fat; very short time to make tortillas soft and pliable. Dip tortillas in sauce. Lay tortillas in pan. Fill with meat onions olives cheese and sauce. Turn over so seam is on the bottom. Continue this step until pan is filled. Pour or spoon sauce over top of enchiladas. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Hamburger Hot Dish
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Add cheese mushroom soup and milk. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove and add olives and cashews if you prefer. Stir into mixture and top with a can of Chinese noodles. Return and bake 15 minutes.

title: Fig Preserves
instructions: Cook sugar and vinegar until boiling. Drop in figs; try not to stir very much. Cook until syrupy.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: In large bowl combine first 3 ingredients (dry) with spices. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Store in airtight container. Use 2 heaping teaspoons (more of less to taste) for each cup of boiling water. Makes about 30 servings. Yields 2 1/2 cups dry mix.

title: Mamaw Johnson'S Nut Loaf Cake
instructions: Beat shortening sugar and eggs. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk. Mix well. Add nuts and vanilla. Pour into well-greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups together (no water added). Spread in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread chicken evenly over soup. Mix stuffing according to directions using chicken broth instead of water. Spread over the chicken. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Prize Winning Zucchini Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans. Beat eggs oil sugar and vanilla until thick. Mix in flour spices baking powder and soda. Stir in pineapple and zucchini until well mixed. Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar cocoa milk and butter. Place on medium heat. Stir until butter and sugar are melted and dissolved. Bring to a boil one minute. Remove from heat. Quickly add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Mix well and drop on waxed paper or cookie sheet by the teaspoonful. Cookies will become firm in a few minutes.

title: Grape-Nuts Pudding
instructions: Mix cereal with margarine. Beat sugar into eggs; add cereal mixture and remaining ingredients blending well. Pour into 1-quart baking dish; place in pan of hot water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir thoroughly. Bake 20 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from center comes out clean. Serve warm or cool with whipped cream.

title: Ruth'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to rolling boil.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix butter peanut butter sugar and vanilla until smooth. Make into 1-inch balls. Place in freezer on cookie sheet.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Heat milk; pour in juice of cherries. Add marshmallows. When dissolved crumble in graham crackers. Add raisins coconut and nuts. Pour into tube pan lined with waxed paper. Decorate with cherries and nuts. Keep refrigerated.

title: California Icebox Fruitcake
instructions: Mix fruits nuts and crumbs. In double boiler or microwave melt marshmallows with milk. Cool. Pour into dry ingredients. Makes 3 wax paper lined loaf pans or 1 tube pan.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Panboil first 3 ingredients. Mix with the rest of the ingredients. Place in buttered casserole. Add more crumbs and cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl combine lemon juice oil garlic and pepper. Arrange chicken in a shallow casserole or baking pan; pour on the lemon mixture. Cover and bake 40 minutes or until tender basting occasionally. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer to brown. To serve sprinkle with chopped parsley. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions; drain. Add cheese (cubed) and chili. Cook over low heat until cheese is melted stirring occasionally. Serve with crackers tortilla chips (Eagle white corn rounds) or Dorito chips.

title: Rice Pilaf(Yields 6 Servings)
instructions: Saute onion noodles and rice in butter until lightly toasted. Add water garlic cinnamon and orange slices. Bring to a full boil. Reduce heat to simmer and cook covered for 40 to 45 minutes. (Do not lift lid during cooking.)

title: Vanilla Sauce
instructions: Scald milk with sugar and salt. In bowl mix cornstarch with cold water. Add to scalded milk until slightly thickened. Add flavoring. Serve on plain white cake plum or carrot pudding.

title: Nasi Goreng
instructions: Fry onions in oil until tender. Add meat and cooked rice and stir until well mixed. Add Worcestershire sauce curry powder salt and pepper; stir until hot. Make well in center of rice and break eggs into it. Stir eggs until partly scrambled; then mix rice into it. Stir until well blended. Serve on platter surrounded by 2 tomatoes thinly sliced.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Prepare raw rice and frozen broccoli according to directions but without salt. Melt butter or margarine with the onions. Heat only until butter is completely melted. Pour this mixture into a long Pyrex dish. Add the cooked rice cheese and soup and mix well. Drain the cooked broccoli and spread it over the rice mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Maple And Brown Sugar Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix sauce sugar vinegar and mustard until sugar is dissolved. Combine ground beef oatmeal egg onion salt pepper and 1/2 cup of tomato sauce mixture; blend thoroughly. Shape into an oval loaf and turn into shallow pan. Pour remaining sauce mixture on top of loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour basting occasionally.

title: Four Layer Delight
instructions: Cream oleo salt flour and pecans with a fork. Press into 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. For second layer cream sugar cheese and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Using low speed mix pudding with milk until thick. Spread over second layer. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in a greased shallow baking dish and sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry ingredients; add melted butter and mix until crumbly. Sprinkle crumb mixture on top of apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot or cold with milk or whipping cream.

title: Mom'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Make pudding using juice from pineapple chunks to equal 1 1/2 c.\tIf short of juice add a little lemon juice. Cool slightly. Mix in all other ingredients.

title: Creole Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan. Add onion green pepper celery and garlic and saute over medium heat until tender; do not brown. Add tomatoes tomato puree bay leaf thyme salt and pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours. Taste for seasoning. May need some sugar to cut acidity of tomato products. Add shrimp scallops or any other seafood item.

title: Scallopini Of Veal Avocado(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Pound the scallops until thin. Rub flour lightly into each piece of meat. Cut the avocado in half lengthwise peel and remove the seed. Cut the halves lengthwise into thin slices and coat with lemon juice to keep from discoloring. Heat 3 tablespoons of butter in a heavy skillet and add a drop of Wesson oil (this will keep the butter from burning too quickly). Add the scallops and saute over medium heat until golden brown. Season with salt and pepper. Remove the scallops to a platter and keep in a warm place.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Beat. Bake in 2 loaf pans for 30 minutes.

title: Old-Timey Pickles
instructions: Wash and cut large cucumbers. Pack into clean jars. Add to each quart jar 1 teaspoon salt and 3 tablespoons sugar. Fill each jar 1/3 full of vinegar. Finish filling jar with water; shake to dissolve salt and sugar. After sealing put into hot water bath for 10 minutes after water starts to boil then remove at once. Check to see that jars are sealed.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter in a large Dutch oven until tender. Add potatoes water bouillon cubes seasoned salt rosemary garlic powder and black pepper. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and mash potatoes. Add milk and cheese; cook stirring constantly until cheese is melted. Yields 10 cups.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Prepare the cake according to the package directions and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let the cake cook then pierce it with a fork and drizzle the Kahlua over the cake. Chill overnight.

title: Old-Fashioned Molasses Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat butter until soft. Gradually add sugar. Beat in egg and molasses. Add buttermilk and flour ingredients alternately; beat until smooth after each addition. Drop batter from a teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Smothered Potatoes
instructions: Dice potatoes and along with onions brown quickly in small amount of grease in skillet. After browning add enough water to cover cover and simmer until tender. Add water if they cook down and are not quite soft enough. Serves 3 to 4 people.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Prepare crust; do not cook.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Stir together flour salt sugar and cocoa in large bowl. Add butter eggs and vanilla stirring until smooth. Spread batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle hot cake with marshmallows.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Boil sliced carrots in boiling salted water until tender. Alternate carrots pepper and onion slices. Mix dressing well. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate overnight.

title: French Toast Casserole
instructions: Cut bread in small squares. Mix everything except sugar and nuts. Pour over the bread and refrigerate overnight or until bread it totally soaked. Sprinkle nuts and brown sugar over bread mixture. Bake in a 12# Dutch Oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve with syrup a breakfast meat and coffee. Yield 10-12 servings.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Pour hot milk over bread in large bowl. Blend eggs sugar and vanilla together; add to bread and mix well. Add raisins. Pour mixture into baking dish. Bake 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until firm and golden brown. Makes 24 servings.

title: Betty Salad Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender.

title: No-Bake Pineapple Cheese Cake
instructions: Prepare Jell-O first so it can cool. Pour melted margarine into crumbs and stir until thoroughly mixed. Set aside. Whip Milnot and 2 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Cream together cream cheese and cup of sugar. Mix in Jell-O. Add to Milnot and then stir in pineapple. Press crumb mixture into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add layer of filling and sprinkle additional graham cracker crumbs over top. Chill.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter over low heat; blend in flour and onion powder. Slowly stir in the heated milk. Stir with a wire wisk or wooden spoon over low heat until thickened and smooth. Remove from heat and stir in the cheese until melted; add hominy. Pour into greased casserole dish; top with buttered cracker crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello water; let jell slightly and add pineapple bananas. Let jell. Blend juice sugar egg flour and butter. Cook until thick and add one 3 oz. pkg. cream cheese. Stir until melted and smooth. Let cool then pour on top of jello. Very good! Makes large dish.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Place vegetables in casserole dish. Cut up chunks of Velveeta cheese and place on top of vegetables. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place in microwave until cheese is melted. Stir together. Melt butter in skillet. Add crushed Ritz crackers and mix well. Spoon cracker mixture over top of vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Chicken Pepper Pasta
instructions: Melt Country Morning Blend in a skillet. Stir in onion peppers and garlic. Cook over medium-high heat until slightly tender (2 or 3 minutes). Remove from skillet leaving juices in pan. Add chicken salt and pepper. Continue cooking stirring occasionally until chicken is brown and tender (7 to 9 minutes). Add vegetables half and half Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese to chicken mixture. Reduce heat and continue cooking until cheese melts (3 to 5 minutes). Add cooked vermicelli to mixture. Toss gently to coat. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sand Cake
instructions: Cream together the margarine cream cheese and 10x sugar. Set aside.

title: Sweet Relish
instructions: Combine cucumbers peppers and onions. Sprinkle with turmeric. Dissolve salt in 2 quarts cold water. Pour over vegetables and let stand for 3 to 4 hours. Drain; cover vegetables with cold water and let stand for 1 hour. Drain. Tie the spices in a bag; add to the brown sugar and vinegar. Heat to boiling and pour over the vegetables. Cover and let stand for 12 to 18 hours in a cool place. Simmer until vegetables are hot. Bring to a boil; pour into jars and seal.

title: Fresh Peach Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sprinkle peaches with lemon juice and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients adding flour last. Fold in fruit. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Prize Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine with sugars; add eggs and beat until smooth. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Add to batter and blend well. Add oatmeal and vanilla; blend well. Add coconut and pecans. Drop onto greased cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until brown.

title: Crisp Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Place shredded zucchini in colander. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt; set aside for 30 minutes. Squeeze as much liquid out of zucchini as possible. Saute onion in hot butter until tender. Put zucchini and onion in large bowl. Add eggs flour 1/4 teaspoon salt pepper and wheat germ. Pour oil into skillet and heat. Drop slightly rounded tablespoonfuls of zucchini mixture into oil; flatten to 3-inch diameter with back of spoon. Cook 1 minute on each side or until golden. Remove with slotted spoon; drain on paper towel. Keep hot until all pancakes are ready. Can melt cheese over top of each one.

title: Dinner Rolls Or Loaves
instructions: Beat together all ingredients except flour. Sit in a warm place about 15 minutes or until real \bubbly.\ Add flour to mixture and work until smooth. Sit in a warm place until it doubles in bulk. Punch down. Shape into rolls. Makes 48 rolls or can make 4 loaves bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Horseradish Cheese Spread
instructions: Melt cheese in top of double boiler. Remove from heat. Stir in mayonnaise and horseradish. Pour into small crock or bowl. Chill. Serve with crackers. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Homemade Hot Fudge Sundae Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla. Cook in saucepan until it reaches soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Cool in water bath in sink stirring 2 to 3 times while cooling down. Serve over ice cream. We like to think Sunday is a great day for a \Sundae\.

title: Chicken Divan(Microwave)
instructions: Remove outer wrapping from broccoli packages and microwave at High for 3 minutes or until each package is flexible. Arrange broccoli in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. In medium bowl mix soup sour cream lemon juice soy sauce and garlic powder. Stir in chicken; pour over broccoli. Set aside. Melt butter in small bowl in microwave. Stir in Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave at High for 12 to 14 minutes or until hot.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with water using pineapple juice for part of water. Add pie filling pineapple and nuts. Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar Cool Whip and vanilla. Spread over Jell-O mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Cook manicotti. Drain. Fill with meat mixture and place in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with remaining meat. Pour spaghetti sauce over all and top with cheese. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Cookies(The Best)
instructions: Combine eggs raisins and vanilla and let stand for 1 hour covered with plastic wrap. Cream together the butter and sugars. Add four salt cinnamon and soda to sugar mixture. Mix well. Blend in egg-raisin mixture oatmeal and chopped nuts. Dough will be stiff. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet or roll into small balls and flatten slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pork Chops With Herb Dumplings
instructions: Cook pork chops until brown on both sides. Mix soup mushrooms water and sage. Layer onion on chops. Pour soup mixture over top. Heat until boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Nana'S Little Bear Soup
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients and bring to a boil. Mix 1/2 cup milk and 2 tablespoons flour together. Gradually stir into soup mixture. Continue to cook stirring constantly until soup mixture thickens.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Melt butter in iron skillet on low to medium heat. Saute onions celery bell pepper and garlic. Add Tabasco and Tonys (to taste). Add crawfish and cook down 4 to 5 minutes. Add Cream of Chicken soup. Serve over rice. Makes 4-6 servings.

title: Pink Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple to a boil. Add Jell-O mix and cool. Add cottage cheese and stir. Stir in Cool Whip and nuts; then refrigerate.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Spray Pam in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In a small bowl mash the canned shrimp and mix with softened cream cheese. Add dill and blend.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon Pie
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften. Beat egg yolk and sugar together in top of double boiler. Stir in gelatin and cook the mixture over boiling water stirring constantly until thick and fluffy. (Takes about 4 minutes.) Remove saucepan from heat and stir in peanut butter. I find that if you keep the mixture over hot (not boiling) water the peanut butter will blend into the egg yolk sugar and gelatin mixture better. Let cool a little before adding egg white and cream. Beat egg white until it stands in peaks. In separate bowl beat cream until it holds its shape. (If you use sour cream no beating is necessary.) Gently fold beaten egg white and whipped cream into gelatin mixture. Pour into cool pie shell and refrigerate until firm. May be garnished with dollops of whipped cream and crushed peanut brittle if desired.

title: Auntie Mickey'S Italian Stuffed Peppers
instructions: My grandmother made the best stuffed peppers. She could not read or write so it was difficult to get a recipe from her. She would sometimes add raisins or \Gods Fingers\ (pine nuts) to her peppers.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon reserving 3 tablespoons of drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Cook onion in drippings until tender. Stir in beans brown sugar ketchup Worcestershire sauce and prepared mustard. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Stir and top with bacon.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat broccoli butter and Cheez Whiz until melted. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. After boiling pour into a greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Jiffy Dinner Stew
instructions: Saute onion with hamburger; drain. Add tomatoes potatoes beans and sugar. Cook until beans are tender (20 minutes). Mix water and flour; stir into stew. Cook stirring 1 minute. Serve.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt margarine; stir in brown sugar syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil for 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat; stir in baking soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popcorn. Pour into 2 cookie sheets and bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn corn every 15 minutes while baking.

title: Aunt Thursa'S Breast Of Chicken In White Wine
instructions: Wash and dry chicken; brown in butter in 6-quart Dutch oven. Remove chicken. Add mushrooms onion and garlic; saute 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add flour and seasonings; slowly add broth and cubes. Bring to boil. Stir. Reduce heat and add wine. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Add chicken to sauce and bake covered for 30 minutes. You may divide into 3 portions and freeze or continue baking about 40 minutes more.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix hamburger egg bread crumbs onion and black pepper. Roll out meatballs. Put in microwave or oven until brown.

title: Peach Custard Cake
instructions: Mix butter with flour and salt with a pastry blender until mixture looks like coarse meal. With back of a spoon press mixture firmly on bottom and halfway up sides of a greased 8-inch square pan.

title: Icebox Pudding Supreme
instructions: Cut cake into slices about 1/2-inch thick and line bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Prepare pudding according to directions on box. Spoon one half of pudding over cake. Cover with another layer of cake then the rest of the pudding. Refrigerate for about 2 to 3 hours or overnight. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle chocolate jimmies on top. Cut in squares and serve.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in 11 x 14 x 2-inch pan. Let cool; divide into thirds. Mix pudding according to directions; let set. In a clear punch bowl crumble 1/3 of cake. Spread 1/3 pudding over it then 1/3 of pineapple on this. Add 1/3 of strawberry filling and nuts over pineapple. Repeat twice. Cover completely with Cool Whip and garnish with nuts and fresh strawberries.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill. Great with vegetables.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale and freeze overnight. Mix in 2 bottles ginger ale when serving.

title: Polish Cabbage Rolls(Gobabki)
instructions: Parboil cabbage until leaves may be separated (about 30 minutes); cool enough to handle. Separate leaves and cut off thick membrane.

title: Cherry Cool Whip Salad
instructions: Mix together well and chill for several hours. (Blueberry pie filling is good also.)

title: No Peek Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; place in a 2-quart baking dish and cook covered for 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Rice Primavera
instructions: In large skillet cook mushrooms onions celery pepper bouillon and seasoning in oleo. Add rice cheese and carrots. Cook 5 minutes; toss lightly.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Bo Biscuits
instructions: Mix together flour sugar baking powder and shortening. Mix until dough resembles corn meal. Add buttermilk and stir together. Knead 5 mintues. Roll dough to 1/2 inch thick. Cut with large biscuit cutter. Dip biscuits in melted margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Heat milk. Before it boils add rice and 1/2 the sugar. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Keep on medium to medium-high heat and cook 25 to 30 minutes stirring constantly.

title: Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Bake and cool pastry. Fill pastry shell with ice cream. Spread evenly. Wrap in foil; fold edges under to seal. Freeze. Just before serving top with fresh frozen or canned fruit and whipped cream.

title: Janey'S Election Day Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cream cheese soften. Chop or cut dried beef and green onions. Mix all ingredients and put in refrigerator until firm. Roll in large ball or balls roll in nuts and serve with crackers.

title: Diabetic Rice Cereal Crust
instructions: Press into bottom and sides of 8-inch pie pan. Chill well before filling.

title: Hot Cran Apricot Drink
instructions: In large saucepan combine all ingredients. Simmer over low heat 10 to 15 minutes until hot. Serve hot in mugs or cups. Garnish with orange slice. Yield 6 cups. Serving 1 cup. Calories 156. Fat 0 grams.

title: Old-Fashioned Egg Custard
instructions: Bring milk and butter to boil. Beat eggs and sugar together. Fold eggs and sugar into milk then add vanilla. Pour into pie crust and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes (the temperature is important).

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix coconut flour sugar and margarine in a large bowl reserving about 1/2 of the coconut for later use. Put the mixture in an 8 x 12-inch dish or pan. Bake it 45 minutes or until brown at 300\u00b0. Remove from stove and cool. Mix pudding by directions on box.

title: Pizza Bagels
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Place spoonful sauce on 1/2 bagel and put on pepperoni slices. Place about 2 tablespoons shredded Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Meal In One
instructions: Place potato slices in layers in bottom of ungreased casserole dish. Salt and pepper each layer. Separate onion slices into rings. Place on top of potatoes. Arrange ground meat on top of onion slices. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour tomatoes and juice on top of meat layer. Break up tomatoes. Insert knife around edge of casserole to allow juice to run down inside. Bake 1 hour in 425\u00b0 oven. Serves 4 or 5.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Coat meat with combined flour and seasonings. Brown in oil; drain. Combine meat tomatoes peas mushrooms and onions; mix well. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cover; bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until meat and onions are tender. Combine potatoes and process cheese spread; spoon around edge of casserole. Broil until process cheese spread begins to melt. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and onion; drain off fat. In a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish layer potatoes and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Put sausage and onion over potatoes. Beat eggs milk and dry mustard and pour over dish. Place cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops; pour off excess fat. Drain fruit reserving syrup. Add remaining ingredients to syrup; pour over chops in skillet. Cook covered over low heat 1/2 hour or until tender turning chops once or twice. Remove meat to platter. Stir fruit into sauce; heat to boiling. Spoon some sauce over chops; pass remainder. Makes six servings.

title: Avocado And Black Bean, Mango Salad
instructions: Place the beans onion tomatoes pepper corn avocado and mango in a large bowl; toss lightly. Then add lettuce leaves and mix in salad dressing. Makes 6 servings.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa. Add milk then the butter. Beat egg yolks\tand add to mixture. Cook until thick. Add vanilla. Pour into\tbaked pie shell and top with meringue. Bake until top is light brown.

title: Baked French Toast
instructions: Line bottom of 11 x 13-inch pan with half of the bread cubes. Layer cream cheese cubes on top of bread. Arrange remaining bread cubes on top. Beat together eggs maple syrup and milk in a large bowl. Pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Jeweled Fruitcake Miniatures
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Place baking cups in a muffin pan. Spoon batter into each cup.\tBake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes or line 6 miniature loaf pans 4 3/4 x 5/8 x 1 1/2 inches with aluminum foil; grease. Divide batter among pans; spread evenly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Mix shortening eggs and sugar together. Slowly add dry ingredients. Mix well then add chocolate chips nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: Easy Stew
instructions: Layer onion in bottom of Dutch oven or crock-pot; then layer stew meat potatoes and carrots. Pour soups on meat and vegetables. Do not mix. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or low in crock-pot for 6 to 8 hours. Stir to mix gravy and serve. You may add any vegetable you choose.

title: French Fry Casserole
instructions: Brown meat. Add soups; mix well. Add vegetables; mix well. Top with French fries. (You can mix them in also.) Bake at 350\u00b0 until fries are done.

title: Poppy Seed Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour sugar baking powder and salt in a large bowl. Whisk oil milk eggs and almond extract in another bowl until smooth. Add dry ingredients; mix only until evenly moistened. Stir in poppy seed. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Melt the chocolate and oleo. Stir in the sugar and evaporated milk. Bring to a rolling boil; remove from heat. Add vanilla. Very good on vanilla ice cream or plain cake.

title: Stewed Chestnut Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces. Heat oil in frying pan. Add ginger green onion and chicken; stir-fry until chicken changes color. Add salt sugar and soy sauce. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add 1/2 cup of water; simmer for another 30 minutes. Add chestnuts; simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all vegetables together and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Nutty Noodles
instructions: Melt chips and pour in noodles and peanuts. Stir until covered well. Spoon out on wax paper by teaspoon.

title: World'S Best Cookie
instructions: Mix well and form into small balls; place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in water. Bake 12 minutes at 325\u00b0. Allow to cool on cookie sheet.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Arrange broccoli in 11 x 7-inch baking dish (I use 9 x 13-inch). Combine mayonnaise soup lemon juice and curry; mix well. Slice chicken and arrange on broccoli. Pour sauce over this and top with cheese bread crumbs and melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Hot Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown meat onion and salt to taste. Drain fat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes. Transfer to 10-inch square baking dish. Make corn bread batter and pour over top of meat mixture. Bake uncovered in a 425\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown. Serves 6.

title: Black Beans And Rice
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine broth coconut and margarine. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in beans and onions. Cover and cook an additional 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Makes 6 (2/3 cup) servings.

title: Coconut Easter Eggs
instructions: Cream together butter salt and milk. Add powdered sugar vanilla and coconut. Shape into egg and place in freezer until very cold and ready to dip. Put into double boiler the chocolate and wax. Dip eggs. Keep stirring chocolate. Keep pan over hot water but remove from gas. Store eggs in refrigerator or freezer.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Place the dry ingredients into a mixing bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients. Mix the batter but do not let it be too thick or too loose. In a large pot boil water. Turn the heat down to medium. Drop by tablespoon into the boiling water. Do not crowd the pot. Cook the dumplings in the water until you can put a fork into them and they are not soggy (about 10 minutes). Cover for another 3 to 5 minutes continuing to cook them on medium heat.

title: The Salad
instructions: Cook the carrots in small amount of boiling salted water until crisp-tender. Drain and chill. Cook the peas according to package instructions. Drain and chill. Place the lettuce in large glass or other salad bowl and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the carrots celery peas onion sliced olives and bacon in layers over lettuce. Spread 1 cup Blender Mayonnaise over top and sprinkle with sugar. Garnish with whole olives and parsley and serve with remaining Blender Mayonnaise. Commercial mayonnaise may be substituted for Blender Mayonnaise. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Butter Rolls
instructions: Take a piece of aluminum foil and pour some flour onto it. Flatten each biscuit with rolling pin. Place 2 pats of butter and a tablespoon of sugar in the middle of the rolled out biscuit. Fold over and pinch edges together. Place this in baking dish. Continue until all biscuits are used. After filling up the pan place butter pats on each top and sprinkle with sugar. Pour enough milk around sides that the tops are just above the milk. Place in 450\u00b0 oven and bake until golden brown. Deelish!!!

title: Oven-Fried Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a nonstick baking sheet with the vegetable oil. Scrub the potatoes thoroughly under running water; pat dry. Slice them lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick slices then cut into fries of the desired size. Pat the fries dry. In a medium bowl beat the egg whites with a whisk until foamy. Add the potatoes and toss until coated. Arrange the fries in a single layer on the baking sheet. Bake until crisp and lightly brown and tender 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Makes 2 servings.

title: Roast Turkey
instructions: Rinse bird well on the outside as well as inside the body and neck cavities. Be sure to remove giblets from both cavities. Reserve for making giblet gravy. Rub salt (and pepper if desired) in cavities and on outside of bird. Place onion and celery in body cavity. Pull neck skin to the back and fasten with a small skewer. Tuck drumsticks under band of skin at the tail or tie them securely to the tail; thread can be used. Place bird breast side up in covered roasting pan. Brush skin with melted oleo. Add 2 cups water to roaster. Cover bird with water-drenched cheesecloth or doubled paper towels. Cover roaster and bake in a preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 4 to 4 1/2 hours. Every hour remoisten toweling with broth from roaster. Remove roaster cover cut skin band or thread on drumsticks. Cook uncovered during the last 30 minutes to allow for light golden browning of bird. When done drumsticks should feel very soft when pressed.

title: Sauerkraut Meatballs
instructions: Mix chili sauce water sauerkraut sugar and cranberry sauce in pan; heat to blend. Mix remaining ingredients; form into small walnut size meatballs. Place meatballs in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Pour sauce over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with toothpicks or spoon for appetizer or main dish. The men love it especially.

title: Easy Pie
instructions: Fold together the condensed milk lemon juice pineapple and Cool Whip. Pour into pie crusts. Set in refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Low Sodium Super Rice(Diabetic)
instructions: Dissolve 2 chicken bouillon cubes in 2 cups boiling water. Add rice; bring to a boil again. Cover; let simmer for 14 minutes. Cook peas adding sweetener at the last minute. In a skillet saute onion and mushrooms in oil. Add peas onion and mushrooms to rice. Garnish with parsley. Yields 8 servings.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in pan pour in fruit with juice. Mix flour sugar and milk together and pour over butter and fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Scald milk; beat eggs well. Mix all ingredients; beat well. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until firm.

title: Peanut Butter Marshmallow Fudge
instructions: Measure all ingredients before you commence. Cook sugar and milk to soft ball. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into buttered dish. (Be sure dish is buttered before you start cooking.) Yield 2 pounds.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Pour vinegar over anchovies in bowl; cut anchovies up with knife and fork then mince with 2 forks. Let stand. Add salt and pepper to torn lettuce in bowl; toss. Let stand. Squeeze juice of lemon into another bowl; add coddled egg Worcestershire sauce and minced garlic. Add minced anchovies and vinegar. Mix well before adding to lettuce. Toss well then add olive oil and cheese; toss again. Add croutons; toss again and serve. Serves 2 as a dinner.

title: Dried Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Cut beef into small pieces. Mix remaining ingredients with beef and add to cream cheese. Makes 1 large or 2 small balls. (Save some of the pieces of beef to lay on top if you wish.)

title: Leftover Turkey
instructions: Place broccoli in baking dish. Layer with bite-size turkey. Mix milk with soup. Pour over top. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Good And Easy Dessert
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed using a sheet cake pan 2 x 10 1/2 x 15-inch. Drain the pineapple well. While cake is cooling beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add pudding mix and milk slowly to make a smooth pudding.

title: Cheese Pit
instructions: Butter casserole. Alternate bread and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over bread and cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Cheese Cake
instructions: Follow directions for instant cheesecake adding the peanut butter to filling mix. Chill and cut into small squares. Very rich but heavenly taste.

title: Bermuda Summer Salad
instructions: Fry bacon and slice mushrooms; set aside. Tear lettuce into bite-size pieces. Slice onion and separate into rings. Layer lettuce and onion rings on a platter. Combine sour cream 3 teaspoons of sugar and enough milk to thin mixture. Drizzle over the lettuce and onions. Combine the mayonnaise remaining sugar and enough milk to thin the mixture to drizzle over the sour cream mixture on the lettuce and onions. Sprinkle on the sliced mushrooms crumbled bacon and Parmesan cheese. Do not pre-mix the 2 glazes and do not toss the salad. Chill for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Quincy'S Potato Soup
instructions: Saute butter onions and parsley until onions are tender. Add water to the potatoes and salt. Cook until almost done. Add soup milk and sour cream stirring occasionally until it comes to a boil.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain off grease then add all of the ingredients.

title: Crescent Surprises
instructions: Break peanut butter cups in half. Wrap 2 pieces in crescent roll and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Sunflower Fettuccine
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water according to package directions; drain. Return noodles to saucepan. Stir in light cream and margarine until margarine melts. Toss in sunflower kernels Parmesan cheese and parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown (1 hour).

title: Linguine A La Marinara (Sauce)
instructions: Pour olive oil in pan and add all ingredients except macaroni. Simmer for 45 minutes. Boil macaroni; drain. Pour sauce on top. Finish off with Parmesan or Locatelli cheese.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken. Melt butter and pour over casserole. Crush crackers and cover casserole. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables; mix remaining ingredients and pour over salad. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Drain before serving.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cup
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs peanut butter sugar and butter. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips with 2 tablespoons margarine. Pour over mixture. Refrigerate 15 minutes. Cut and refrigerate again.

title: Strawberry Shortcut Cake
instructions: Grease large pan (15 x 10 x 1-inch) well; sprinkle all marshmallows in pan. Prepare strawberries by combining with the strawberry Jell-O; let stand. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add vanilla; blend well. Pour batter over marshmallows. Spoon strawberry mixture over the batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain off fat. Add onions salt pepper 1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning and 1 can tomato paste. Blend well. Unroll and separate dough into 8 triangles. Place in ungreased 9-inch pie pan pressing pieces together to form crust. Turn meat mixture into unbaked crust and top with cheese slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with sauce made from combined remaining ingredients.

title: Russian Spice Tea
instructions: Mix all together well. Store in tight jar. To mix add 2 to 3 teaspoons to 1 cup of hot or cold water. For larger quantities add 1 cup of mixture to 10 cups water.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Melt butter and peanut butter together. Mix with powdered sugar vanilla and graham cracker crumbs and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter together. Pour over first mixture. Chill. Good!

title: Chili Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Drain. Add mustard ketchup chili powder salt and pepper. Put this in a crock-pot. Add tomato juice kidney beans and as much red pepper to your taste. Add more salt and pepper if needed.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Bring juice and water to boil and dissolve the gelatins. Add cherries and sherry. Pour into a ring mold and chill. Unmold and mix equal parts of sour cream and mayonnaise and fill the center of mold.

title: Zucchini Muffins
instructions: Combine with first ingredients in a large bowl. Fill muffin tins to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. These are delicious.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Take strip of bone from salmon. Cook potatoes and mash. Add the salmon to the cooled potatoes also shredded carrots and cut up celery. make patties from this mixture and dip into flour. Fry in Crisco or cooking oil.

title: Salmon Delights
instructions: Pour juice of salmon into cup and set aside. Add salmon to egg and mix real well. When mixture is gummy add flour. Stir in flour with a fork. Mixture will be thick. Do not add salt (pepper is okay)! Add 1/4 cup salmon juice to baking powder and beat with a fork. It is going to foam. Pour foamy mixture into salmon mixture. Mix again with a fork. It may be really thin this time. Drop by teaspoons into deep fat and fry until crisp and golden brown. Serves 8.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix and work in flour until stiff. Roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Bake on greased cookie sheet until done.

title: Italian Sausage Dish
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet then saute green pepper in 1 teaspoon butter. Put in crock-pot and pour Ragu over. Let simmer on low about 1/2 hour. Cook noodles then drain real good. Add sausage and sauce in crock-pot or put noodles on plate and put sausage sauce on top.

title: Casserole Of Squash
instructions: Wash squash and onion and cut into pieces. Cook both in salted water for about 20 minutes or until done. Drain veggies and add butter. Let cool slightly. Add egg and crumbs. Beat all ingredients with eggbeater.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Cook beef until no red remains. Add water then all the other ingredients. Cook until potatoes and cabbage are done. Enjoy.

title: Mashed Potato Boats(From Valentine Dinner - Youth)
instructions: Mix boiling water with cream cheese. Add butter to soften. Add all other ingredients to water mixture and beat. Fill foil potato boat shells or put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with grated cheese. May be refrigerated overnight and reheated in a 325\u00b0 oven or serve immediately.

title: Orange Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jellos in one cup boiling water. Add Mandarin oranges and pineapple. Pour into 2-quart shallow dish and cover with marshmallows while warm. Let congeal. Then frost with sour cream. Cut into squares and serve on lettuce.

title: Spring Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Just before serving sprinkle with walnuts and brown sugar. Yields 6 servings.

title: Summer Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Add vegetables and saute until tender (about 10 minutes). Season with salt and pepper. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted and top light golden brown (15 to 20 minutes). May be frozen by pouring into freeze wrap lined casserole dish. Fold and seal freezer paper. Freeze. When frozen remove from casserole dish and return to freezer immediately.

title: Broccoli Noodle Pudding *
instructions: Boil noodles then drain. Mix all ingredients with noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Peel shell from eggs. Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove egg yolks. Place in small bowl. Lay egg whites on plate and put aside. Add mayonnaise mustard salt and pepper to yolks. Blend well until slightly smooth texture. If too thick you can add a little extra mayonnaise and/or mustard to taste. Replace egg yolk mixture to holes in egg whites with spoon or cake decorating bag with large star tip. Lightly sprinkle tops with paprika. Cover and keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk soy sauce pepper beans and 2/3 c. onions in 1 1/2 qt. casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot. Stir. Sprinkle with remaining onions. Bake 5 additional minutes.

title: Meringue Pecans
instructions: Mix egg white sugar and vanilla together; add nuts. Take out and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn oven off and leave in stove for 1 hour.

title: Buffet Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes and cut lengthwise in strips as for French fries. Place potatoes in center of a large piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil fitted to an 8 x 8-inch square baking dish. Dot potatoes with butter. Sprinkle with salt pepper parsley and cheese. Pour cream over.

title: Chili Rellenos - Jose(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Carefully rinse seeds from chiles with cold water. Spread chiles in single layer on paper toweling. Carefully pat chiles with another piece of paper toweling until they are dry. Slip a strip of Monterey Jack cheese into each chile.

title: Dip In A Bread Bowl
instructions: Scoop out center of bread to form a bowl. Mix all ingredients together and put in bowl. I usually make the dip a day in advance and chill overnight then put it in the bowl the next day. Chop bagels in bite size pieces and dip in.

title: Hippo Stew
instructions: Cut hippo into bite size pieces. This should take about 2 months. Peel and cut potatoes into small pieces. Takes about 10 days. Slice carrots. Add other ingredients except rabbit meat. Simmer for 3 weeks. Should feed up to 3000 people. If more are expected add the 2 rabbits.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix syrup sugar salt and butter well. Add slightly beaten eggs. Add pecans (chipped or broken). Pour into uncooked pie shell. Preheat oven at medium temperature and cook for 45 minutes or until it will not shake in middle.

title: Reese'S
instructions: Melt margarine with peanut butter. Add confectioners sugar and mix well. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt chips and pour over peanut butter mixture. Cool and cut in 1-inch squares.

title: Peanut Butter Fingers
instructions: Cream butter and white and brown sugars well. Blend in egg 1/3 cup peanut butter soda salt and vanilla. Add flour and oats. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan slightly greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Sprinkle immediately with morsels. Let stand 5 minutes. Spread melted chips over cookies. Combine powdered sugar 1/4 cup peanut butter and milk. Mix to drizzle consistency. Drizzle over chocolate. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Pizza Sticks
instructions: Separate and unroll breadsticks. Place pepperoni over half of breadsticks. Fold remaining half of breadstick over top seal end and twist. Place on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a greased iron frying pan at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until brown and firm.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook broken noodles in boiling salt water. Melt butter in top of double boiler. Mix in flour and mustard. Add salt and pepper. Blend well; add milk and stir until thickened. Place noodles in greased casserole. Cover top with tuna then with white sauce mixture. Spread top with broken potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Ranchers' Omelet
instructions: Fry bacon; remove from pan. Fry potatoes and onion in bacon fat. When potatoes and onion are done add eggs. Stir until eggs are cooked. When served add bacon on top.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: You will need an 11 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch Pyrex dish.

title: Pineapple Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Blend with an electric beater. Add the pineapple and bread. Toss. Pour into greased 9-inch square casserole. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Mix all above ingredients together and put in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown. Take out and top with Cheddar cheese. Ready to serve.

title: Kentucky Corn Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sour cream and margarine. Mix corn and Jiffy mix. Pour into greased baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
