title: Banana Cream Cake
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients together and stir for 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and beat 1 minute. Pour in two 8 or 9-inch cake pans and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add oil sugar vanilla and zucchini. Stir dry ingredients and add to first mixture then add nuts and other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Leave in pans 10 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Fry chicken with mushrooms celery and garlic for 3 minutes in oil. Add water chestnuts and onions. Fry 3 minutes. Mix cornstarch water soy sauce salt and pepper. Pour into pan. Stir and cook 2 minutes. Add tomatoes and cashews and cook 2 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Salmon Casserole
instructions: Cook peas and macaroni according to package directions and drain. Combine soup mayonnaise milk and cheese. Mix. Drain and flake salmon. Add salmon and soup mixture with macaroni and peas. Mix. Pour into casserole. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Pudding
instructions: Stir beaten egg into fruit cocktail. Mix together flour sugar soda salt and walnuts.

title: Spaghetti Gravy
instructions: In large Dutch oven or skillet saute onions in olive oil until clear. Add garlic tomato paste water wine and remaining spices. Stir and bring to a simmer. Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Add cranberry pineapple and nuts. Take half of mixture and let jell until firm. Cream together the cream cheese mayonnaise and enough pineapple juice to spread easily. Spread on top of Jell-O that is congealed. Pour remaining Jell-O on top and let congeal until firm. Very pretty and good for the holidays.

title: Summer Surprise Salad
instructions: Add water to juice to make 2 cups. Bring to boil. Pour over Jell-O and dissolve. Cool at room temperature. Add pineapple to watermelon and mix well (dont drain this mixture). Pour cooled Jell-O over fruit and stir gently. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Refrigerate until set. Slice into squares. Drizzle with cream cheese powdered sugar and whipped cream which has been beaten together until smooth.

title: Fried Cornbread
instructions: Mix well and drop by spoonful into hot fat about 1/4 inch deep in frying pan. If you like your cornbread to be fried lacy add more water to make a thinner batter and have the pan hot. Fry turning to allow both sides to brown.

title: Chicken Parisienne
instructions: Place chicken in crock-pot. Season with salt and pepper. Mix wine and soup. Pour over chicken. Add mushrooms. Cover and cook 7 to 9 hours on low. Remove chicken to a warm serving platter; stir in sour cream mixture and allow to heat for about 30 minutes. Serve sauce over chicken with rice or noodles. Serves 6.

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Wash eggplant and slice 3/4-inch thick. Dip in flour then egg then bread crumbs. Saute in olive oil a few at a time until nicely browned on both sides. Add oil as needed.

title: The Easy, Easy Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and margarine. Add powdered sugar and cream it for about two minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Add vanilla and lemon extract. Sift flour. Add salt to flour. Fold in the flour to the creamed mixture. Stir just enough to blend in the flour well. Bake in a 10-inch tube pan at 325\u00b0 one hour and 5 minutes. Test to see if cake is done by inserting a toothpick in the center. If it comes out clean the cake is done.

title: Citrus And Papaya Salad
instructions: For dressing in a screw top jar combine orange peel orange juice salad oil and poppy seed. Cover and shake well. Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and sugar. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Cool.

title: Creamy Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine margarine (butter) crumbs and sugar to make crust. Pat in greased plate. In bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Beat in Eagle Brand milk eggs and salt until smooth. Stir in lemon juice. Pour into pie shell. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until cake springs back. Cool at room temperature. Spread sour cream over cake. Garnish as desired.

title: Million Dollar Bread Or Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water until it bubbles. Add milk and remaining ingredients. Add more flour if needed to make a stiff dough. Knead well and let rise until double in size. Make into two loaves of bread or rolls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Brush with oleo after taking from oven.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Bars
instructions: Cream together shortening brown sugar eggs and vanilla. Add flour oatmeal salt and soda. Melt together chocolate chips condensed milk and butter or margarine. Press 2/3 of dough into greased jellyroll pan. Spread chocolate mixture on top. Add nuts to remaining dough if desired. Sprinkle over chocolate mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Barbecue Venison
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; let set while browning venison in 1/4 cup oil. Drain; put venison in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with sauce. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over spareribs. Bake about 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Choco-Nut Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate in a large saucepan. Remove from heat and add sugar; mix well. Add eggs 1 at a time beating vigorously. Add flour salt vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until tested done. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except marshmallows and pour into buttered casserole dish. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cover top with marshmallows for last few minutes of baking until set and brown.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs and beat well. Add vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and salt together; add to first mixture. Add nuts. Spread thinly over large shallow greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Yield 32 brownies.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bake 15 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Mix crab onion cheese and pour liquid over; put mixture in pie shell.

title: Gala Slush Punch
instructions: In a blender or food processor place half of the cut up grapefruit. Cover and process until nearly smooth; strain into a large bowl. Repeat with remaining grapefruit. Add half of the carbonated beverage (about 4 cups) to the grapefruit juice. Stir in the sugar until dissolved. Pour into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cover and freeze 4 to 5 hours or until nearly firm stirring 3 times during the freezing time.

title: Layered Pie
instructions: Mix butter flour and pecans. Press into baking dish. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 250\u00b0. Cool. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Put on cooled crust. Mix Jell-O pudding mix and milk. Spread on cream cheese layer. Put Cool Whip on top. Chill before serving.

title: Chow Mein Candy
instructions: Melt chips slowly and add noodles. Also add 1 to 1 1/2 cups peanuts. Stir until well coated. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Maple Bars
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until thick and lemony color. Blend in oil. Stir in flour baking powder and salt. Add flavoring and nuts. Spread in greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into bars. Cool in pan.

title: Alpine Spinach And Noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook lasagna noodles. Drain. Spread noodles in pan. Cover with 1/2 jar of spaghetti sauce.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all fruits together. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over fruit; stir until dissolved and fruit juice is thickened. Chill and serve.

title: Tacos
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add pepper salt tomato paste and water. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Heat shells about 5 minutes. Dice tomatoes shred the cheese and shred or chop lettuce. Serve with tablespoon.

title: Lemon-Tarragon Grilled Chicken
instructions: Place skinned chicken in shallow dish. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Mix to coat chicken pieces with marinade. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Angel Buns
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Add other ingredients. Smooth into ball; knead 10 times. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Separate 5 eggs. Beat the egg whites until stiff and set aside.

title: Gumbo
instructions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp. Cook until green beans and cabbage are tender. Add shrimp and cook additional 15 minutes over low heat.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Mix together the first 7 ingredients. Put in ungreased pan. Sprinkle with dry cake mix over top. Pour melted margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Low-Fat Waffles
instructions: Whirl eggs in blender; add milk and oil. Blend 2 minutes; add dry ingredients and whirl. Bake in preheated Teflon waffle iron. Makes 4 large waffles.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa oleo and sweet milk and cook 1 minute; add remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonful on wax paper. Let harden.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix vegetables and water chestnuts in 2-quart baking dish. Mix 1/2 cup margarine and cheese together. Mix with vegetables. Spread crackers over top of vegetables. Pour 1/4 cup melted margarine over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bunny Cake
instructions: You will need 2 round cake pans.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown bacon until crisp. Put bacon on paper towel. Brown celery onion and green pepper in bacon fat. Combine all ingredients except bacon in a large bowl. Crumble in bacon and mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Hungarian Goulash
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Mix remaining ingredients and put in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Caramel-Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Sprinkle pecans evenly in unbaked pastry shell; sprinkle with chocolate pieces and drizzle with caramel topping. Set aside. In a medium mixing bowl combine cream cheese sour cream and vanilla. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until smooth. Add eggs beating at low speed just until combined. Pour over caramel topping in crust. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 45 minutes or until center appears set. Cool on wire rack. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Sift cocoa over pie if desired.

title: Chicken Chalupas
instructions: Combine sour cream soup chilies 3/4 of the cheese green onions grated onion and olives. Mix well and set aside about 1 1/2 cups of this mixture for the top. Combine chicken with remainder of mixture. Divide evenly on 12 tortillas. Roll up (I fold mine into square) and place folded side down. (I use Pam in my dish for easy clean-up.) Spread 1 1/2 cups mixture over top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Let set overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes large amount.

title: Easy Cheese Souffle
instructions: Grease a shallow casserole. Remove crust and butter enough slices of white bread to cover bottom of casserole. Put a slice of sharp cheese on each slice. Beat 3 eggs for each 2 cups milk; enough to cover bread and cheese. Soak in fridge overnight. In morning place casserole in pan of boiling water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes until knife comes out clean.

title: Sweet Rice
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease dish. Pour in cooked rice. Saute brown butter and sugar in separate pan. Be careful not to burn. When melted pour over rice. Poke holes in rice so it can seep through. Cook for 30 minutes in preheated oven. Great with roast beef and brown gravy. Also good with salad with avocados with Italian dressing.

title: Quick And Easy Sausage Cheese Spread
instructions: Crumble and brown sausage. Pour off fat. Stir in soup and Tabasco. Heat through. Keep warm to serve. Spread on party bread or crackers.

title: Creamy Zucchini Soup
instructions: Heat butter in 10-inch skillet until melted. Saute onions and garlic until tender not brown. Combine chicken broth zucchini celery parsley salt dill weed basil and pepper in large saucepan. Heat to boil. Stir in onion mixture. Simmer 30 minutes. Blend soup in 3 batches in blender until smooth. Return to saucepan and stir in milk. Heat. Can be served hot or cold. Garnish with freshly grated cheese or lemon slices or sour cream. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Pickles - Bread And Butter
instructions: Combine zucchini onion and salts in a large bowl and cover with crushed ice. Let stand for 3 hours and drain well. Combine remaining ingredients and heat to boiling (I tie spices in a cloth). Pour over zucchini and let stand for 2 hours. Bring all this to a boil and then simmer for 2 hours. Ladle into clean hot jars. Leave 1/2 inch and seal. Process in boiling water for 5 minutes. Yields 4 pints. Use some yellow squash for color.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Put aside. Mix broth and soup. Bring to a boil. Pour over dry ingredients. Add eggs last. Mix well with a potato masher. Add finely chopped onions. Microwave at Medium-high for 13 to 15 minutes. Cover with Saran Wrap.

title: Homemade Applesauce
instructions: Dice apples. Place a few pieces in a blender at a time and puree. Add other ingredients.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar vanilla and nutmeg; mix until well blended. Mash 3/4 cup of strawberries and add to cream cheese. Add confectioners sugar to cream; beat until stiff peaks form. Fold into cream cheese mixture. Pour into crust. Chill several hours or overnight. Garnish with additional strawberries.

title: Fried Apples
instructions: Core apples. Do not pare. Cut in 1/2-inch slices. Melt butter in large heavy skillet. Add apple slices. Sprinkle with brown sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Cook over medium heat turning apples until golden brown and tender. Makes 8 servings.

title: Artichoke Bread Circle
instructions: Roll thawed dough on floured board to make a 12 x 18-inch rectangle. Let rest 5 minutes. Brush half of marinade on dough. Sprinkle artichokes garlic and half of cheese. Sprinkle basil and oregano and roll dough from the long side and pinch to seal making a long roll. Place on a 12 x 12-inch baking sheet lightly greased. Join ends together and pinch to seal. Brush with remaining marinade and cover with plastic wrap. Allow to stand about 30 minutes. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Sprinkle remaining cheese on ring and bake 15 minutes more. Store airtight. Keeps well for 2 days or can be frozen.

title: Quiche
instructions: Mix and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake about 30 minutes. Makes 1 pie. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Italian Beef In The Crock-Pot
instructions: Place roast bouillon cubes garlic salt and Italian dressing in crock-pot. Add enough water to cover beef. Cook on low for 8 hours. Heat up garlic bread or spread garlic spread on French bread. Wrap in foil and heat in oven for about 10 minutes. Shred beef with fork and knife; serve with gravy on garlic bread. Add a salad and a vegetable to this \delicious\ sandwich.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
instructions: Blend sour cream and cream cheese until smooth. Add remaining ingredients (except for tortillas) and mix well. If tortillas are not flexible enough to roll easily wrap in foil and warm in a 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Spread cheese mixture on tortillas. Roll up and place seam side down in a glass dish. Chill for several hours until firm. Slice into 1/2-inch sections and serve.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Let set 5 minutes. Add cherry pie filling and pineapples. Pour 1/2 of mixture into a 9 x 13 glass dish and let it congeal. Cream the cheese (add a little milk if necessary to make smooth) spread over the congealed mixture. Sprinkle nuts over the cheese. Add other 1/2 of gelatin mixture and chill. Let set overnight.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Heat together the syrup water and sugar until sugar dissolves. When mixture boils blend in the butter. Stir constantly until it reaches 280\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add soda. Pour onto 2 greased cookie sheets. Spread as thin as possible without making holes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: In a casserole dish add 1/2 cup of the bread crumbs (or more) to cover the bottom of the casserole. Spread the drained asparagus on top. Stir the mushroom soup to eliminate lumps and cover the asparagus. Sprinkle the grated cheese (medium sharp or mild Cheddar) over top of the asparagus. Then add the remainder of the bread crumbs or enough to cover the top layer. Dot with butter and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10-inch pie plate. Cook and stir beef and onion. Drain. Spread in pie plate. Beat milk Bisquick eggs salt and pepper until smooth. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes. Top with tomatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean about 5 to 8 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Grind dice or shred tomatoes. Place all vegetables in a large bowl; sprinkle with salt. Let set for 1 hour. Drain.

title: Frozen Noel Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese; blend with mayonnaise. Add cherries and remaining fruit and nuts. Fold whipped cream into mixture. Spoon into an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Cover tightly; freeze. To serve unmold and slice. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Place one package of crescent rolls on the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 12-inch pan and flatten. Mix together the cream cheese sugar vanilla and the egg yolk only. Spread over the crescent rolls. Top with the other package of crescent rolls and seam together. Beat the egg white until fluffy; spread over cake and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. This coffee cake is best when enjoyed the same day.

title: Pizza Cornbread
instructions: Saute in pan with 1/4 cup oil the onions. Mix in tomato sauce tomato paste oregano basil and garlic powder. Stir well and let set.

title: Fried Corn Cakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add onion. Stir in buttermilk and add the beaten egg. Drop batter by spoonfuls into the hot oil. Flatten the cakes and fry on both sides until golden brown. Drain on paper and serve hot.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Combine flour and baking powder; set aside. In a mixing bowl beat egg yolks and vanilla with electric mixer on high for 5 minutes or until thick and lemon colored. Gradually add the 1/3 cup sugar beating on high until sugar is nearly dissolved. Wash beaters.

title: Tiny Cream Puffs(Servings: 12.  Preparation Time: 1 Hour.)
instructions: Place butter in water and bring to a boil. Sift flour with salt and add to butter mixture. Cook stirring vigorously until batter leaves sides of pan and forms a ball. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs one at a time. Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto a well-greased baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Oil Cake
instructions: Mix all together in one bowl. Pour into an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in crock-pot or saucepan. Heat until thoroughly warmed.

title: Corn Casserole Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all together. Pour in baking dish for 45 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and heat to boiling. Place chicken pieces in 13 x 9-inch baking dish and cover pieces with sauce. Seal with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Mincemeat-Date Bars
instructions: Grease oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Mix date filling and crumbly mix (date bar mix). Stir in mincemeat egg nuts and hot water. Spread in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Cool. May be frozen thawed and iced. To serve frost with powdered sugar icing.

title: Magic Bars
instructions: In 13 x 9-inch pan melt butter. Remove from heat. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour sweetened condensed milk equally over crumbs. Top with chips coconut and nuts. Press down gently. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool; cut into 3 x 1 x 1/2 inch bars.

title: Brownies For Diabetics
instructions: Start heating oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl cream the butter or margarine and non-nutritive sweetener until light and fluffy. Add chocolate; beat until smooth. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and walnuts. Beat until smooth. Spread batter in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes or until surface of brownies is shiny. Cool in pan. Cut into 16 pieces. Serve cool. Exchanges per brownie 1/2 bread and 2 fats.

title: Crisp Ginger Cookie
instructions: Sift flour and spices. Cream shortening. Add sugar egg and molasses. Add flour mixture and mix well.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Dice and cook first 5 ingredients until tender; while vegetables cook make white sauce of next 5 ingredients. Add cheese to make white sauce. Stir constantly so it doesnt scorch; add to vegetables (dont drain). Add corn. Serve with oyster crackers.

title: Zucchini Lasagna
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Add zucchini slices. Mix together. Bake in 9 x 13-inch dish at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Microwave Pralines
instructions: Mix whipping cream and brown sugar in 4-quart bowl. Microwave on High for 13 minutes. Quickly add pecans and margarine stirring to mix. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto foil. Yields 40 pralines.

title: Rum Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Place cold milk in food processor or blender. Add gelatin. Process or blend to soften about 30 seconds. Add boiling milk. Blend another 30 seconds to a minute to dissolve gelatin. Add remaining ingredients except cream and ice cubes. Blend or process until smooth. Add cream and ice cubes. Blend until ice cubes melt. Pour into bowl or parfait glasses. Chill. Serve with whipping cream if desired. If you are doubling or tripling do it in batches.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in casserole dish. Top with Topping.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Thaw bread according to package directions. Flour a cutting board and roll the bread until it is elongated and air bubbles are out of dough. Spread pepperoni over rolled dough. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Roll the bread as tightly as you can from end to end. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In large pan heat together sour cream soup chili powder corn and cooked chicken. Spread 1 tablespoon of sour cream on open tortillas. Fill with 2 to 3 tablespoons of meat sauce. Roll up and place seam down in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon remaining meat sauce over top. Carefully spread salsa over; top in a thin coat. Bake for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Sprinkle with cheese and cook another 10 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips salsa and sour cream.

title: Tamale Pie(Serves 4)
instructions: Brown ground meat and onion; drain. Add soup corn salt pepper and chili powder. Bake in greased dish. After 25 minutes pour cornbread batter on top and cook until lightly browned. Add cheese on top and return to oven to melt. May be served with taco sauce or salsa.

title: Recipe For Healthy Children
instructions: Sprinkle with pebbles and flowers; moisten in running brook water. Cover with blue sky and bake in the sun. When they are done brown remove children and set to cool in bathtub.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole(Serves 4)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook rice according to directions. In a large bowl combine broccoli celery rice and pimentos. Mix well. In a separate bowl combine soup sour cream salt and pepper. Mix with broccoli mixture until well blended. Pour ingredients into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. (To add a little flavor you can add a little Cheez Whiz to taste into the soup mixture.) Bake for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Oven Stew Italiano
instructions: Coat beef with flour toss with oil in a 3-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir once. Combine remaining ingredients add to meat and mix well. Cover then bake for 2 hours or until meat is tender. The 2 hours baking time is at 375\u00b0.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into baked crust or graham cracker crust.

title: Jo'S 7 Layered Salad(For A Crowd)
instructions: In a large pan break up lettuce in bite size pieces. Spread evenly. Sprinkle celery all over. Sprinkle eggs all over then sprinkle peas all over. Sprinkle onions all over and pepper. Crumble bacon and sprinkle all over. Mix mayonnaise and sugar and spread like frosting. Sprinkle cheese all over. Refrigerate 8 to 12 hours or overnight covered.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Mushroom A La King
instructions: Heat soup; stir in remaining ingredients except chow mein noodles. Heat through. Serve on chow mein noodles. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Pudding Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add sugar vanilla and oil. Mix well. Stir in zucchini. Add mixed dry ingredients. Stir. Fold in coconut dry pudding and chips. Pour into 3 small greased and floured bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until done. Cool in pans for 5 minutes then remove and cool completely.

title: Chicken Diane
instructions: Pound chicken flat between sheets of plastic wrap or wax paper. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon each of oil and butter in large skillet. Cook chicken over high heat for 2 minutes on each side. Do not cook longer or they will be dry and overcooked. Transfer to warm serving platter. Add chives or green onion lime juice brandy cilantro or parsley and mustard to pan. Cook for 15 seconds; whisk constantly. Whisk in broth; stir until sauce is smooth. Whisk in remaining butter and oil. Pour sauce over chicken. Serve immediately. Great served over buttered pasta broccoli side and fresh salad.

title: Kielbasa Stew(Stove Top)
instructions: In a large skillet cook bacon until crisp; remove to paper towel to drain. Add sliced kielbasa and onion to pan drippings and cook until onion is tender. Drain. Return to skillet; add beans tomato sauce chilies carrots and green pepper. Stir in thyme Italian seasoning and black pepper. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer for 45 minutes until vegetables are tender stirring occasionally. Crumble bacon and sprinkle on top.

title: Peanut Clusters(Makes 4 Dozen)
instructions: Line cookie sheets with waxed paper. In top of double boiler over hot water melt butterscotch and chocolate chips until smooth. Stir in peanuts until well coated. Drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets. Chill in refrigerator until set.

title: Low-Fat Sweet-Sour Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in baking dish. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Set aside in separate saucepan. Combine cranberry sauce vinegar brown sugar and broth. Then mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water until smooth. Add to sauce. Cook sauce until thickened. Add pineapple chunks to sauce and pour over chicken.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli and rice as directed on package. Place chicken in slightly greased large baking dish. Arrange broccoli on chicken; top with rice and cheese.

title: Molded Waldorf Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Stir in oranges with syrup pineapple with syrup apple banana and nuts. Pour into 5 individual (1 cup) molds or 8 x 10-inch mold. Chill until firm. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Okra Patties
instructions: Combine salt pepper okra onions and bell pepper. Add meal and tomatoes. Shape into patties and fry in small amounts of hot grease. Drain on paper towel.

title: Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease muffin pan or use baking cups. Mix ingredients. Batter will be slightly lumpy. Rest for 3 to 4 minutes. Fill cups half full. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop into hot fat. Fry until golden.

title: Creole Muffins
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt sugar and corn meal. Combine beaten eggs and milk. Add to dry ingredients. Begin to stir. Add melted shortening green peppers onion pimiento and cheese. Stir only enough to dampen dry ingredients. Fill greased muffin pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yields approximately 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole Delight
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Pour into buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with topping and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix together; put in 9 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until done and frost with any white powdered sugar frosting.

title: Easy Chicken A La King
instructions: In a medium skillet over medium heat saute mushrooms in butter or margarine for 3 minutes or until limp. Stir in peas and onions breaking pieces apart. Cover and steam for 4 minutes or until peas are tender. Stir in soup and milk until blended. Stir in chicken pimiento and pepper. Stirring bring to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in cheese until melted and blended. Serve over buttered toast patty shells biscuits or hot cooked noodles. Serves 4.

title: Creamy Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place chicken in greased baking dish. Top with Swiss cheese then soup and stuffing mix. Sprinkle butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Black Midnight Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together; add other ingredients in order listed. Batter will be very thin. Bake in 2 greased and floured round pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Walnut Mocha Torte
instructions: Grease and lightly flour two 8 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans. Set aside.

title: Betty'S Little Bits
instructions: Butter 1 1/2-inch muffin tins and coat generously with graham cracker crumbs set aside. Cream egg yolks sugar and cream cheese until fluffy. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into creamed mixture. Spoon cream cheese mixture into muffin tins filling three-fourths full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool (centers will fall forming an indentation). Remove from tins. Spoon 1 teaspoon Sour Cream Filling into each indentation.

title: Fruit Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Crumb Mixture Combine flour oats sugar butter baking soda salt and vanilla. Beat at low speed. Scrape bowl often until mixture is crumbly (1 to 2 minutes). Reserve 1 cup mixture; press remaining mix into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Chop cabbage and put into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Slice onions over this and sprinkle with minced onion salt and pepper. Add corned beef and spread over cabbage and onions. Mix soups and water together and pour over the cabbage corned beef and onions. Sprinkle with grated cheese if desired. Make a making of cornbread (1 or 2 boxes of Jiffy mix cornbread) depending on the thickness you desire. Pour prepared cornbread mix over other ingredients. Bake about 45 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Microwave Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: Place almond bark in large microwave dish. Microwave on High about 2 minutes or until melted. Add chocolate chips and stir until melted. Pour in peanuts; stir until well coated. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Savory Tomato Butter
instructions: Saute the onion over medium heat in the 2 teaspoons of butter until it just begins to color 3 to 4 minutes. Add the tomato puree; bring to a boil. Turn the heat down to a simmer; cook for about 5 minutes. Strain the mixture through a fine strainer pressing to get out most of the liquid. Put the liquid in a clean saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-low heat and cook stirring occasionally until reduced to 2 or 3 tablespoons about 30 minutes. During the last 10 minutes or so take care to keep it from scorching. Let it cool. Beat the reduction into the remaining butter. Refrigerate until ready to use. Makes about 3/4 cup.

title: Picante Chicken
instructions: Saute chicken in Pam-sprayed nonstick pan until opaque. Place opaque chicken in ovenproof pan and pour picante sauce over all. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and bell peppers. Add mushroom soup and grated cheese. Mix together well. Then slice zucchini into shallow pan. Layer with onion bell peppers soup grated cheese mixture and seasoned bread crumbs. End with bread crumbs. Bake until zucchini is tender approximately 45 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Mix eggs milk and sugar in blender. Pour into glass. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Serve.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Grease 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour pineapple and juice in pan. Add blueberries 3/4 cup sugar then cake mix; melt oleo and drizzle over cake. Put pecans on top. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Jerky
instructions: Slice venison or beef steak thin. Mix the first six ingredients together. Marinate with meat about 5 hours in refrigerator. Spread on single thickness on a baking sheet. Bake at lowest temperature in the oven approximately 2 to 4 hours.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Place all ingredients in slow cooker. Simmer 4 hours. To serve top with grated cheese chopped lettuce sour cream chopped green onions chopped avocados tortilla chips etc.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening (butter) together. Add the soda to the persimmon pulp and mix. Add beaten egg to pulp. Sift dry ingredients together. Add persimmon and dry ingredients to creamed mixture; blend well. Stir in nuts and raisins. Drop batter from a tablespoon onto a well-greased cookie sheet and top each cookie with a raisin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Put pecans in bottom. Mix all ingredients (batter will be thick). Pour on top of pecans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Prepare instant mashed potatoes according to package directions omitting salt or prepare mashed potatoes from scratch using your favorite recipe. Stir dry salad dressing mix into mashed potatoes. Add butter or margarine if desired. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Favorite Company Dessert
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip and spread over crust. Mix pudding with milk and spread over then cover with remains of Cool Whip. Garnish with toasted coconut or chopped nuts.

title: President Harding'S Limburger Cheese Spread(Appetizer)
instructions: In a blender or with a fork mix cheese and butter well. Fold in chopped scallions. Serve at room temperature with toast points dark bread or crackers. Generously serve 6 to 8 as a cocktail spread or cheese course.

title: Chicken Breasts Supreme
instructions: Put rice in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soups water and salt. Pour over rice. Dip chicken in melted butter and place on top of rice. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Candy Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar margarine milk and cocoa. Bring to a good boil. Boil for 3 minutes. Drop by spoonful on waxed paper and let cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole With Rice
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender. Drain and mix all together. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix and divide into three round layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: In large mixer bowl let ice cream and butter stand at room temperature until soft; beat together then stir in sugars nutmeg and cinnamon. Blend until smooth. Put mixture in a large plastic container; cover and freeze. Mixture remains spoilable. To serve spoon three tablespoons of batter into a mug; add a jigger of rum and 6 ounces boiling water. (Or use boiling cider and two tablespoons of batter.) If desired use cinnamon sticks as stirrers. Makes about 30 servings.

title: Fudgy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar milk butter and cocoa. Bring to a full boil for 1 minute timing accurately. Add salt and vanilla. Blend in peanut butter and oats. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper to become firm in 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Crater Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inches. In a large mixer bowl combine baking mix sugar milk egg and vanilla. Beat on low speed until moistened. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed until smooth. Pour 1/2 of batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle chips over batter in pan. Top with remaining batter completely covering chips. Sprinkle Topping Mix evenly over batter. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until top springs back when touched lightly. Cool completely. Cut into squares. Makes 9 servings.

title: Baked Ham Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips in large bowl. Mix well. Place in 8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Marshmallow Cheese Salad
instructions: Melt marshmallows and milk in double boiler. Cream two cheeses. Add melted marshmallows slightly cooled. Cool. Add pineapple and nuts. Fold in whipped cream. Chill.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Mix ketchup salt brown sugar and vinegar. Add to beans and meat. Put all together in a crock pot and cook overnight or for three to four hours.

title: Cheese Tidbits
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Form into balls about the size of marbles. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down with fork in crisscross fashion. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Crisp but not brown.

title: Peach Punch
instructions: Mix Hi-C and Sprite. You may slice fresh peaches to float serving 1 slice per cup. Chill or serve over ice.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix together the cornmeal flour sugar baking powder and powdered milk. Beat egg until thick then add warm water and butter. Mix the dry ingredients to wet ingredients. Pour batter into an 8-inch greased pan. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Tastes sweet and does not crumble.

title: Roasted Pecans
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter on cookie sheet. Add nuts to melted butter and mix well. Sprinkle with salt. Put back in oven and turn oven off. Set in oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Light N Lean Chicken Breast
instructions: Coat skillet with cooking spray heat until hot. Add chicken sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Cook until brown on both sides. Reduce heat to low add garlic. Cook 10 minutes more until chicken is done. Remove chicken and keep warm. Add broth and wine to garlic bring to a boil over high heat and boil 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Stir cornstarch into milk and slowly add mixture to skillet. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Cook and stir until thickened. Return chicken to skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and sprinkle with chives. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Watermelon Salad
instructions: Cut up watermelon into balls or cubes place on lettuce leaves on individual plates or serving bowls. Mix together all dressing ingredients. Put 1 to 2 tablespoons of dressing on top and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

title: Porcupines In Cabbage Leaves
instructions: Cook cabbage leaves in saucepan in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine ground beef egg 1/4 cup onions rice salt and pepper in bowl. Melt shortening in skillet. Brown meat mixture in shortening. Place 1 tablespoon meat mixture on each cabbage leaf. Fold edge in. Roll up. Fasten each leaf with toothpick. Pour tomato over cabbage and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Company Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix oil eggs milk and sour cream in a bowl. Sift 3 cups flour sugar baking powder and salt; mix well. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix 1/4 cup flour and remaining ingredients and sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Serve warm (may be frozen and reheated). Can be doubled to serve 40.

title: Canned Tomatoes
instructions: Peel tomatoes then cut into pieces. Cook for 30 minutes. Put into jars and add salt and sugar. Use quart size jars and seal with lids.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Stir hot water with jello until dissolved; add cold water and let set until jello begins to congeal. Mix pineapple bananas and marshmallows with jello; let set well. Cook together pineapple juice sugar flour and egg. Cook until thick; let cool. Spread over jello mixture after it has set.

title: Sour Cream Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup sugar over rhubarb in an unbaked pie shell. Let set for awhile. Mix remaining ingredients together. Beat with eggbeater until blended. Pour over rhubarb and bake at 450\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large boiler and simmer for about 30 minutes. Makes approximately 7 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in oil until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Ready to use. Better if allowed to set for a while in refrigerator.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Combine and knead. Add food coloring as desired.

title: Glazed Apples
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Stir in brown sugar cinnamon and salt. Add apples. Cook 10 to 15 minutes stirring constantly until apples are tender and glazed.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Blend first column of ingredients together. Add to these 3 ingredients 1 box yellow cake mix and mix well. Add blueberries and pecans. Bake in tube pan or sheet pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 1 hour.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Put all vegetables through food chopper. Mix well cook 30 minutes. Put into jars and seal while hot.

title: Crunchy Granola
instructions: Stir oats wheat germ bran and walnuts in a large mixing bowl. In separate bowl stir together brown sugar water oil vanilla and cinnamon. Pour over dry ingredients and stir well. Pour into 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Add raisins or other dried fruits (coconut etc.) after baking. Cool completely. Store in airtight containers. Keeps for weeks.

title: Light Fudge
instructions: Cook to soft boil stage medium heat 230 degrees. Remove from heat and add 1 cup peanut butter 1 cup marshmallow creme. Beat and mix. Pour into butter pan. Cut before it gets too hard.

title: Dejean Shrimp Salad
instructions: Place softened cream cheese and grated onion into bowl. Pour jalapeno relish into colander and shake until all liquid is drained. Pour into bowl. Place shrimp into colander and run under cold water until rinsed thoroughly. Mash shrimp by hand and place into mixture. Mix thoroughly until well blended. Serve with crackers.

title: Dr. Grundy'S Killer Dip
instructions: Set out cream cheese and allow to warm to room temperature about 2 hours. Put onion soup in a 1 cup Pyrex measuring cup and add milk until level is 1/2 cup. (Do not put in a whole 1/2 cup of milk.) Allow to stand at room temperature for 45 minutes with occasional stirring until mixture hydrates and onion bits are soft. Peel garlic cloves and chop very fine or run through garlic press.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix and bake cornbread according to directions. Let cool and crumble. Add all other ingredients and lightly toss. Chill and serve cold with crackers.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Boil 2 hours or more.

title: Iva Cookies
instructions: Cream fat; add sugar. Mix together flour salt and soda. Add alternately to creamed mixture along with eggs and milk. Add vanilla and pecans. Drop by spoonfuls on greased pan. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Microwave Glazed Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix meat egg milk bread crumbs onion salt pepper green pepper (optional) and tomato sauce together. Dont overmix or your meat loaf will be tough. Put meat mixture into a glass loaf dish or microwave dish. Microwave on Medium-high (70%) for 22 to 24 minutes. Meat should no longer be pink. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pecan Pie Surprise Bars
instructions: Set aside 2/3 cup cake mix. Combine remaining cake mix oleo and 1 egg in a large bowl. Mix with fork until crumbly. Press crumbs into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients except eggs. Beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake until pie is firm (does not shake).

title: Taco Chicken Wings
instructions: Remove wing tips from chicken and discard. Cut wings at joint. Combine bread crumbs and taco seasoning mix; mix well. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Dip each chicken piece in taco sauce. Roll in bread crumbs. Coat thoroughly. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in unsalted water until done. Combine soup milk corned beef cheese onion and noodles in 1-quart casserole. Top with chips or crumbs and bake at 475\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Mix everything but meat; heat. Brown meat and add to other ingredients and heat together. Serve with grated cheese over each bowl and Doritos. You can also use chicken in place of ground meat.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Traders Pie
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Cook broccoli; drain. Combine 1 1/4 cup milk cream cheese flour and salt. Cook stirring until smooth. Beat egg; add a little hot mixture to egg and then egg to the hot mixture. Cook until thickened. Add beef onion and broccoli. Pour into a 9-inch crust. Top with cheese. Cover with crust and seal. Prick top of pie with fork. Brush with 1 Tbsp. milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 20 minutes.

title: Pasta With Fresh Tomato Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in olive oil in a large nonstick skillet until golden. Add tomatoes and simmer until tender 3 to 5 minutes. Add broth basil and oregano simmer to thicken sauce 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in salt and pepper. Serve over hot cooked pasta. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Line casserole with chipped beef. Wrap chicken breasts with strip of bacon. Place in dish without overlapping. Mix cream of mushroom soup sour cream and water. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered in 300\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. If it gets too brown cover with foil for last hour of cooking time. Serves 6.

title: Neiman-Marcus Dip
instructions: Mix cheese mayonnaise onion and pecans and shape into ball. Roll in crumbled bacon. Serve with crackers.

title: Orange Jello
instructions: Mix together in large bowl and pour into long casserole dish. Cool until firm. Fix lemon pudding and allow to cool. Whip whipping cream and add to pudding. Pour pudding over Jell-O in dish. Sprinkle grated cheese on top.

title: Lower Manhattan
instructions: In shaker combine cola bitter lemon soda and syrup to taste. Stir with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with maraschino cherry. Makes 1 serving.

title: Tomato Aspic Salad
instructions: Mix lemon jello and tomato juice. Add rest of ingredients and pour into mold.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter margarine and shortening. Add sugar and cream together. Add an egg at a time and beat. Add flour gradually with milk and beat. Add vanilla. Very last add baking powder. Sprinkle around on top beating quickly. Pour into greased and floured pan. Start in cold oven. Put cake in and turn oven on to 350\u00b0. Bake approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Separate into two balls. Roll into approximately 1-inch tube. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate. After chilled slice into very thin wafers. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. May top with a pecan half before cooking.

title: Rotini Salad
instructions: Cut flowerets from broccoli. Peel stalks; cut into chunks. Cook broccoli in boiling salted water in medium saucepan over medium heat just until broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp. Drain; rinse under cold water and drain. Combine broccoli rotini olives tomatoes onion and salad dressing in large bowl. Add cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Toss gently to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Homemade Brownies
instructions: Cream together oleo sugar eggs and vanilla. Add to mixture cocoa flour salt and nuts. Put in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; add butter to broccoli. Cook. Add crackers and soup; mix well. Put in casserole dish. Top with cheese cut into cubes. Cook in microwave on High until cheese is melted. Check at one minute intervals.

title: Hidden Valley Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine Ranch mix and oil. Add seasoning. Pour over crackers. Stir to coat. Place in warm (200\u00b0) oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Baked Beans With Ground Meat
instructions: Brown ground meat and drain.\tAdd all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crabmeat Spread
instructions: Rinse and drain the crabmeat. Blend cream cheese crabmeat and cocktail sauce. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Combine corn eggs and sour cream mix. Melt butter; mix with corn muffin mix. Place on top of corn mixture in greased Pyrex dish. Bake 50 minutes on bottom rack at 400\u00b0 then top rack at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cream the cream cheese sugar and mayonnaise together. Fold in other ingredients. Freeze. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Winter Cabbage Salad
instructions: In a saucepan bring the first six ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer unconvered for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to cool.

title: Blueberry Cornbread
instructions: In large bowl beat sugar butter and eggs until smooth. Add pumpkin milk and cornmeal; beat until smooth. Sift flour with baking powder and salt then stir in flour mixture mixing just until combined. Gently stir in blueberries and nuts. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Spread batter evenly into pan. Bake 1 hour or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Steam carrots until slightly tender. Mix and cook until thickened other ingredients. Add 1/4 pound Velveeta cheese cut up. Stir in until melted. Mix with carrots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until top is a little browned.

title: Jordan Marsh Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Cream the shortening and 1 cup sugar. Add eggs one at a time; mix until blended. Mix dry ingredients together; fold into egg mixture. Add vanilla blueberries and milk. Grease a 12 muffin pan. Pile muffin batter high in pan; sprinkle 2 teaspoons sugar on top. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Combine flour salt baking powder baking soda cinnamon nutmeg raisins and oatmeal. Mix thoroughly. Beat in sugar replacement melted margarine egg and milk (add small amount of water if dough is too stiff). Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 36 cookies. Exchange 1 cookie 1 bread item. One cookie equals 37 calories.

title: Not So Hot Chili
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onions. Drain off grease. Add beans catsup and chili powder. Cook about 1 hour and serve with crackers.

title: Avgolemono (Greek)(Egg And Lemon Soup With Rice)
instructions: Boil broth then add rice and cook until tender. Meanwhile mix egg yolks lemon juice salt and pepper and mix well. Then add part of the chicken broth to the egg yolk mixture slowly stirring constantly. Then return the mixture into the remaining soup slowly stirring constantly.

title: 5 Bean Bake
instructions: Drain and rinse kidney beans green beans wax beans and lima beans. Remove pork from pork and beans. Brown sausage; drain grease. Saute onion and celery. Combine all ingredients in a large casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (uncovered).

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage(Makes Full Nesco)
instructions: Slow cook beef in roaster with water until tender. Cool and cut up. Pressure cook onions and cabbage until done. Save juice. Add all together in roaster cook until potatoes and carrots are done.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Heat vinegar water and sugar to a boil. Place beets in and cook until they are heated. Put beets in jars and cover with liquid. Seal.

title: Lo-Fat Chicken And Rice
instructions: Pour rice in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix all other ingredients except chicken in a large bowl. Pour half of soup mixture over rice in pan; mix together and spread out in bottom of pan. Arrange chicken pieces on top of wetted rice and pour the remaining half of the soup mixture over the chicken/rice in the pan. Cover.

title: Chili Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan brown beef and cook green peppers and onion with chili powder until tender. Stir in chili beef soup 1 soup can water and chopped tomatoes. Heat stirring often. Makes about 6 cups.

title: Poppy Seed Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl stir together flour poppy seed salt and baking soda. In a large bowl beat sugar and butter with mixer for 2 minutes. Beat in eggs one at a time until blended. Beat in sour cream and vanilla. Gradually beat in flour mixture until well combined. Spoon into prepared muffin cups. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.\tCool for 5 minutes before removing from cups. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix well with spoon. Add 2 cups of plain flour. When well mixed roll into balls and place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0. When lightly browned remove from oven. Let cool on cookie sheet.

title: French Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Let chill and then roll in little balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Fat-Free Banana Bread
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together; set aside. Mix remaining ingredients together then mix with first mixture. Spray pan with Pam. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Exquisite Pie
instructions: Mix butter eggs and sugar together. Blend well and add rest of ingredients. Pour into 9-inch pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Fettuccine
instructions: Saute or grill boneless chicken. Break pieces (bite size) using salt pepper and Greek seasoning. Prepare 2 boxes of Uncle Bens fettucine alfredo according to package directions. Mix noodles with cooked chicken pieces and top with Parmesan cheese. Serves 4.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Cook squash and onions in a small amount of water 10 to 15 minutes until tender; drain. (Should yield 2 cups cooked squash.) In a bowl combine hot cooked squash and margarine stirring to melt margarine. Add eggs blend well. Mix in cornbread and cream of chicken soup. Place in a greased 1-1/2 quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered 40 to 45 minutes. Make 6 to 8 servings.

title: Congealed Peach Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients as you would for Jell-O. Put in cups or mold and the guests will try to guess what they are eating.

title: Corn Balls
instructions: Beat egg in large bowl. Add onion salt pepper corn bacon and bread pieces; mix well. Melt butter in 1-quart baking dish. Scoop corn mixture into balls with an ice cream scoop. Place in prepared baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. May use fresh corn but it should be cooked for 3 minutes before proceeding with recipe instructions. Yield 8 servings.

title: Tangerine Blossom Compote(6 Servings)
instructions: Wash fruit; score peel into quarters. Remove sections of peel with fingers leaving fruit whole. Sliver peel as directed to yield 1 cup; reserve. Rinse peeled fruit in cold water and gently scrape off excess white membrane with a small knife. Carefully remove center white core and slightly separate sections at one end to resemble \petals\; set aside in deep medium bowl. Pour boiling water over spices and bay leaf; steep 5 minutes and strain liquid into saucepan. Add slivered peel sugars and tangerine juice; bring to a boil stirring until sugar is dissolved. Boil briskly for 10 minutes until syrupy; immediately pour syrup over tangerines and baste for several minutes. Refrigerate several hours preferably overnight until thoroughly chilled basting several times. Serve on individual dessert plates with some of the syrup and peel; sprinkle tops with coconut.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Lightly brown chicken breasts in 2 tablespoons margarine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. If serving in individual casseroles arrange 2 pieces of broccoli each end to end with buds toward outside of dish. Arrange chicken over broccoli.

title: Herb Butter
instructions: Cream all ingredients together.

title: Herbed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes. Put potatoes in bowl. Add melted margarine herbs salt and pepper. Stir to coat slices. Wrap securely in heavy aluminum foil making as flat as possible. Cook on barbecue grill turning regularly for 20 minutes or until done. Serves 4.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix all ingredients together by hand. Put mixture into cookie press. Place cheese straws on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in slow oven at 300\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Don'S Chicken
instructions: Cook first 5 ingredients until done. Mix cornstarch with a little water then some of the broth. Add to pot and cook until thickened. Serve as is or over cooked rice or Chinese noodles.

title: Easy Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend all ingredients in a large bowl then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Bake in a greased 10-inch tube pan at 350\u00b0 for about 45 to 55 minutes until center springs back when touched lightly. Cool right side up for about 25 minutes then remove from pan.

title: Chewy-Gooey Fruit Cobbler(Heart Healthy Recipe)
instructions: *For prune puree use blender or food processor. Add only enough water to prunes to make puree.

title: Mincemeat
instructions: Grind meat apples suet and 2 packages of raisins and place into large canner and then add 1 package of raisins molasses sugar nutmeg cinnamon cloves and allspice. Add apple cider vinegar until moist. Cook slowly until apples are tender. Stir occasionally for 4 to 5 hours. Pack into hot jars.

title: Birds' Nests
instructions: Place bread on cutting board. Cut a hole out of the center of the bread using a small drinking glass. Gently remove the bread from the opening of the glass so as not to tear the bread. Melt butter in skillet and put the slice of bread in the butter. Break the egg gently into the hole of the bread. Toast the middle of the bread in the skillet beside the piece of bread. Add salt and pepper to the egg. Gently turn when the egg white is set and cook until desired doneness. Serve the toasted middle of the bread on the side of the Birds Nest.

title: Ever-Lasting Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift and measure flour. Combine all dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Melt margarine and combine applesauce and eggs. Mix well. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients using the well method. Stir all ingredients until completely moistened. Lumps are okay overmixing will cause muffins to be tough and have tunnels. Fold in pecans (optional). Spray muffin tins with spray shortening. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Put water in empty muffin cups to equalize heat. Bake 15 to 18 minutes. Leftover batter will keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator up to 3 weeks. Yields 24 muffins.

title: Celeried Coleslaw
instructions: Combine sugar salt celery seed vinegar tarragon mustard pepper and salad dressing (or mayonnaise). Chill. Add to cabbage green pepper and scallions. Serve cold.

title: Six Item Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add sour cream and beat with mixer. Add whipped topping and mix. Stir in marshmallows and fruit. Chill.

title: Tomato And Artichoke Casserole(Exotic But Easy)
instructions: Fry onion in butter until transparent. Mix in bread crumbs sugar salt pepper thyme and basil. Remove from heat.

title: Chicken Artichoke Soup
instructions: Saute garlic onion thyme and artichoke hearts in butter for 15 minutes over medium heat. Add water chicken and bouillon cubes. Simmer covered over medium heat for 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tarragon Trout And Lime
instructions: Preheat broiler. Brush torn skin and cavities with oil. Season with salt and pepper. Chop tarragon to equal 2 teaspoons chopped parsley to 4 tablespoons. Place 1/2 herbs in cavities of fish together with 2 to 3 slices of lime. Spread remaining herbs on broiler pan. Place rest of sliced limes on top of herbs then fish. Broil 4-inches from heat until skin is brown (about 5 minutes). Carefully turn and broil 4 more minutes. Place on plates and garnish with lime wedges. Serves 2 people.

title: Raised Doughnuts
instructions: Roll dough to 3/8-inch thick on well-floured surface. Cut with floured doughnut cutter. Cover about 1 hour on floured surface so they can rise. Heat oil (2 to 3 inches) in a deep fryer to 375\u00b0. Slide doughnuts into oil with a wide spatula. Turn doughnuts as they rise to the surface. Fry until golden brown. Remove from oil. Do not prick doughnuts. Drain on paper towel. Refrigerator Roll Dough recipe included in this cookbook.

title: Orange Date And Nut Bread
instructions: Squeeze juice of oranges into 2 cup measure. Fill with enough boiling water to make 2 cups. Put orange rind through grinder or grate and add to dates. Put in bowl and add hot juice. Stir in soda then sugar oil and vanilla. Add beaten eggs then add sifted flour baking powder and salt. Beat thoroughly; stir in nuts. Pour in greased loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Cheese Bread(Healthful Eating)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water; add sugar salt oil and half of the flour. Mix. Add remaining flour. Knead into a soft dough for about 5 minutes. Divide dough into 2 loaves; knead 1 1/2 cups cheese into each loaf. Shape into round loaves; flatten slightly. Bake on a Teflon baking sheet or in individual loaf pans at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Cranberry Chicken(Serves 6)
instructions: Mix 5 ingredients together. Place chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan and cover with the sauce and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat well. Add ingredients in given order into uncooked pie shells dividing evenly. Add 1 cup pecans. Pour mixture over pecans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until crust is brown.

title: Aunt Susan'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Place first 7 ingredients in top of double boiler. Cook until thick. Let cool. Add vanilla extract.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well and serve with various and assorted vegetables.

title: Oysters Maxwell
instructions: Cut bacon strips into thirds and cook until almost done. Open fresh oysters and take them out of the shell. Set one piece of bacon on the bottom of each shell. Place the oyster on it and top with another bacon strip the jalapeno pepper slices and the cocktail sauce. Place oysters in the oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake until brown and bubbly. Serve on a plate of heated rock salt with fancy cut lemon half dusted with paprika. If desired serve with cocktail sauce.

title: American Fried Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes in large skillet; heat oil and onion. Fry over low heat until golden brown.

title: Zucchini And Beef Casserole
instructions: Wash slice and simmer zucchini in a little salt water. Drain and put in casserole dish.

title: Beef And Onion Soup Casserole
instructions: Bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0. Serve over noodles.

title: Jewish Apple Cake(Yields 12 Servings)
instructions: Beat eggs and gradually add sugar and oil. Mix dry ingredients together. Add to egg mixture. Then add vanilla. Fold in sliced apples and chopped nuts. Put into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons of sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Recipe may be doubled and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Ruby'S Fried Cornbread
instructions: Combine ingredients and fry in medium hot grease. Can be served with syrup or as a main dish.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Combine shortening butter and sugar; cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla. Stir in crushed pineapple. Pour batter into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Place in a cold oven; bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Invert onto serving plate; drizzle Pineapple Glaze over top and sides.

title: Hamburgers In Sauce
instructions: Cook hamburgers and set aside. Mix barbecue sauce butter and brown sugar in large saucepan; thin mixture with ketchup as needed. Bring to low bubble. Add meat patties. Let cook slowly about 15 minutes covered. Serve on large hamburger buns.

title: Mexican Enchiladas
instructions: Fry tortillas in hot salad oil one at a time just until softened about 3 min. each side. Heat enchilada sauce; dip tortillas in sauce. Spoon 1-2 t. cheese sauce on each tortilla; sprinkle with about 2 t. tomato and 2 t. onion; roll up. Place seam side down in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2 in. baking dish. Combine remaining cheese sauce an enchilada sauce; pour over casserole. Bake in moderate (350\u00b0) oven for 25 min. (Serves 6.) (Can add chicken or ground beef.)

title: Roasted Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 200\u00b0.\tBake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove and salt to taste.

title: Cranberry Apple Casserole
instructions: Mix chopped apples with cranberries and put in greased 2-quart casserole dish. Pour granulated sugar over apples and berries and lightly toss to coat. Mix other ingredients except nuts and put on top of apple mixture. Put nuts on top. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour then uncover and brown. Serve warm. Yields 6 to 8 servings. Excellent side dish for ham and turkey.

title: Chicken Linguine
instructions: Saute mushrooms in sherry and 1 tablespoon margarine in a nonstick skillet over high heat 5 minutes. Place chicken in a saucepan. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Drain. Let cool and shred. Coat a saucepan with cooking spray. Place over medium heat until hot. Add onion and saute until tender. Combine flour and 1/2 cup broth. Add 2 1/2 cups broth and flour mixture to onion. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream. Cook linguine according to package directions omitting salt and fat. Drain. Combine mushroom mixture chicken sour cream mixture Monterey Jack cheese 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and pepper. Stir in linguine. Spoon into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Combine bread crumbs remaining Parmesan cheese and margarine. Sprinkle over chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

title: Apricot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour in a greased and floured bundt cake pan at 325 degrees.

title: Hot Buttered Rum Mix
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat together the butter and the ice cream. Slowly add the powdered sugar and brown sugar then the nutmeg and beat until smooth. Store in the freezer. To serve put a heaping tablespoon in a mug with a shot of rum then pour in hot water to fill the cup.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach. Combine all ingredients. Chill 4 hours before serving. Serve as dip with snack crackers chips or fresh vegetables.

title: Swiss Steak In Vegetable Sauce
instructions: Set out electric skillet with tight lid. Tenderize meat with meat hammer. Mix flour Accent salt and pepper. Dip meat in flour mixture. Heat margarine in skillet add steak and brown evenly on both sides. Add beef broth water and bay leaf to meat. Cover and simmer 1 1/4 hours (may have to add more water). Remove meat to warm platter. Pour vegetable soup and catsup into skillet and heat thoroughly and pour sauce over meat. Remove bay leaf. Serves 6.

title: Crock Pot Lasagna
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and place into a greased slow cooker. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together the hash browns sour cream soup salt and onion; place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with corn flakes mixed with cooking oil. (If desired add ground beef or chopped ham and use as a main dish.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Heavenly Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add remaining ingredients. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple-Cheddar Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drain the pineapple reserving 3 tablespoons juice. Arrange the pineapple on the bottom of a greased 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Combine the flour and sugar; sprinkle over pineapple. Drizzle the reserved pineapple juice on top. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Combine the crackers and melted butter; sprinkle over cheese. Bake covered for 15 minutes then uncover and bake 10 minutes longer. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Easy Chicken Dinner
instructions: Mix chicken soups (not diluted) sour cream and pepper in an 8 or 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6. Can be doubled.

title: Vermont Cheddar Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine milk cheese salt sugar and shortening in saucepan. Heat slowly stir until bubbles appear around edge and cheese is melted. Cool to lukewarm. Measure water into large bowl dissolve yeast. Add lukewarm mixture to yeast along with eggs and 8 c. flour. Beat until smooth. Add enough remaining flour to make stiff dough. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl; cover & let rise in warm place until doubled. Punch down.

title: Millard'S Candy Orange Slice Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time creaming well after each addition. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add them together alternately with the milk and vanilla to the creamed mixture. Take out 2 cups of cake batter and blend the cocoa into it. Alternately spoon the light and chocolate batters into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or a 10-inch cast-aluminum Bundt pan. Bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) for 70 minutes for a 10-inch tube pan or 90 minutes for Bundt pan or until cake tests done. Cool in pan about 10 minutes. Invert cake onto wire rack and remove the pan. Cool the cake thoroughly. Sift on confectioners sugar.

title: Victorian Iced Tea
instructions: Place tea bags in a teapot; add boiling water. Cover and steep 5 minutes. Remove and discard tea bags. Refrigerate tea in a covered container. Just before serving combine cranberry-raspberry concentrate and cold water in 2 1/2 qt. pitcher stir in tea. Serve on ice. Garnish with mint. Yield 10 (1 c.) servings.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Simmer zucchini and lemon juice until just tender. Add cinnamon salt nutmeg and sugar. Simmer until thick.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Boil water and noodle soup; add rice and cook 15 minutes. Cook and drain sausage. Saute celery onion and green pepper until celery is tender. Mix with other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cornish Game Hens
instructions: Prepare rice according to box. Add onion and celery. Thoroughly clean game hens. Season hens according to your taste. Stuff game hens with rice. Place in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. When cooking more than 3 or 4 hens add more cooking time.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix in bowl the cottage cheese and dry jello. Drain syrup from oranges. Mix oranges with cottage cheese and jello. Add coconut. Chill.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Beat margarine shortening sugar eggs and vanilla until fluffy. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Bake in large tube pan 1 1/4 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli for 10 minutes or until tender; drain. combine broccoli soup eggs cheese mayonnaise onion. salt and pepper. Pour into lightly greased 2 qt. casserole. Toss cracker crumbs with melted butter. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes.

title: Tacos
instructions: Heat taco shells according to package directions. For filling in a large skillet cook meat onion and garlic until meat is brown. Drain fat. Stir in chili peppers chili powder and hot pepper sauce. Heat through. Fill taco shell with meat mixture. Top with lettuce tomatoes onion and cheese.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Mix all ingredients with stew meat. Place in covered casserole. Bake 3 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve over noodles or rice. Gravy will be nice and brown.

title: Fluffy Cheese Puffs
instructions: Melt cream cheese butter and Cheddar cheese in a pan either over hot water or over very low heat stirring until smooth. Cool to lukewarm. Beat egg whites stiff and fold into the cooled cheese mixture. Cut bread into 1-inch cubes. Dip each cube into the cheese mixture. Using a fork swirl it around to coat completely. (Often youll have to spread cheese mixture on bread with a knife.) Place on greased sheet and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake for 8 minutes or until light brown. Yields 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Fruit Delight Cookies
instructions: Combine fruit and nuts. Set aside. Combine dry ingredients and set aside. Cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add eggs and beat well. Mix part of dry ingredients with the fruit. Mix other part of dry ingredients with the creamed mixture and then stir in fruit mixture. Drop with spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Creole Chicken Dinner
instructions: Mix all ingredients except rice in 3-quart saucepan. Break up tomatoes. Boil then stir in rice. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Fluff with fork.

title: Sweet And Sour Wings
instructions: Cut wing tips off; disjoint. Rinse and dry off. Salt. Heat oil in large frypan. Roll wings in cornstarch then in eggs to coat evenly. Fry until crisp about 5 minutes. Place on cookie sheet. Place last 7 ingredients in saucepan and simmer 10 minutes. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mocha Fudge
instructions: In a heavy saucepan melt chocolate milk sweetened condensed milk dissolved coffee and vanilla (over low heat). Remove from heat and stir in nuts. Spread evenly into aluminum foil lined 8 or 9 inch square pan. Chill at least 3 hours before cutting. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix together jello and cornstarch. Cook on low heat until thick. Add strawberries and sweetener. Pour into graham crust. Makes 3 servings. Each serving equals 1/4 protein 1 bread 1 fruit and 23 calories.

title: Snicker Pie
instructions: Let yogurt thaw so that is can be mixed. Mix all ingredients and pour into pie plate. Freeze for 2 to 3 hours. Cut into 10 pieces. Weight Watchers Points 3.2 per slice.

title: One Dish Meal
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Spray skillet with Pam and add carrots bread crumbs eggs salt pepper and onion; brown on both sides. Place all in baking dish and cover with potatoes. Cover dish with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Saute bell pepper and onion. Cook noodles. Cut up chicken. Mix with rest of ingredients and put in a large casserole dish. Cook 20 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. If desired may sprinkle layer of cheese on top before baking.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: With mixer mix canned milk sugar flour egg yolks and vanilla together until blended well. Pour mixture into uncooked pie shell. Cook in oven for approximately 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Use egg whites to make topping. Mix 3 egg whites with 1/4 cup sugar on high until firm. Put on pie; let brown in oven.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Roll chicken in flour brown both sides in oil. Add barbecue sauce and cola. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Combine corn eggs sugar flour and salt. Drop by tablespoons into hot fat; fry until golden brown. Makes 10 servings.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese in bottom of pie plate. Layer with chili onion and top with cheese. Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
instructions: In large pot place oil chicken base onion and spices. Saute until onions are soft and clear about 5 minutes. In another container combine Masa Harina with 1 qt. water. Stir until all lumps dissolve. Add to sauteed onions and bring to a boil. Once mixture starts to bubble cook 2-3 minutes stirring constantly. This will eliminate any raw taste from Masa Harina. Add remaining 3 qts. water to pot. Add tomatoes; return to boil stirring occasionally. Add cheese. Cook stirring occasionally until cheese melts. Add chicken; heat through. Makes 1 1/2 gallons 16-20 servings. Can easily be halved.

title: Crispy Dogs
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Mama'S Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Arroz Con Pollo(Chicken 'N Rice)
instructions: Cook the chickens. For flavor cook with an onion green pepper tomato salt and pepper. When done remove chicken from bones. Cook the rice in 1/2 cup oil all the raw vegetables and spices. Stir-fry for 15 minutes. Add bouillon cubes. Pour broth from chicken to cover the rice. Add margarine in small pieces. Cover and cook until done. Mix chicken into rice. Add green peas. May need to add more broth.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix together sugar shortening and salt. Then add eggs. Mix together crushed bananas and soda. Then mix with other ingredients. Add flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Grease and flour pans.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate. Cook and stir beef and onion until brown. Drain. Spread beef mix into pie plate. Sprinkle cheese over meat.
