Beat milk biscuit mix and eggs until smooth. Pour over beef. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean. Garnish as desired. Try catsup.

title: Oduol'S Bundt Cake
instructions: Combine buttermilk and sweet milk; add sugar eggs and margarine together. Slowly pour in cake mix. Blend and pour into Bundt pan that has been greased and floured. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Quiche
instructions: Mix milk eggs salt pepper and Bisquick for 1 minute in blender. Add onion bacon and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. You may add chopped spinach drained or mushrooms chopped or ham depending on your taste. Um-Um good.

title: Cheesy Bulgarian Potatoes And Sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Generously grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix cottage cheese butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper.

title: Bean Thread Soup(Guamanian)
instructions: In large stewpot brown beef and add onion. Cook 5 minutes and add 4 cups water and bring to boil. Add tomato paste and stewed tomatoes. After 5 minutes add bean threads. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes and add mixed vegetables. Lower heat and simmer until beef is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste and serve with crusty French bread.

title: Chicken On Sunday
instructions: Dip chicken into melted margarine. Mix all soups and water. Pour over rice which has been placed in a casserole. Place chicken on top and cook uncovered in 250\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours. The last 10 minutes turn oven up higher to brown chicken on top.

title: Potluck Potatoes
instructions: Place unpeeled potatoes in saucepan and cover with water. Cook until tender but firm. Drain.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole stir undiluted soup mayonnaise eggs and onion until well blended. Stir in broccoli and cheese. Sprinkle top of mixture with bread crumbs. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Beef In Casserole
instructions: Put all ingredients in a 3-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven stirring occasionally for 3 hours. Good served over noodles. Serves 8.

title: Stuffed French Toast
instructions: Remove crust from bread. Place bread and cream cheese in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together eggs milk and maple syrup. Pour over bread and cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Whip with an electric mixer until smooth. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Peppered Rib Eye Steaks
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Brush steaks with oil; rub with pepper mixture. Cover and chill 1 hour. Grill covered with grill lid over medium high heat (350 -400\u00b0) 8 to 10 minutes on each side or to desired doneness. Garnish if desired. Yield 6 servings.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Cheese Rolls
instructions: In double boiler mix all ingredients. Stir slowly and constantly. Mixture will thicken. Pour mixture into 8 x 10 or 12-inch pan. Butter pan before putting in cheese mixture. Let stand and chill. Cut into bars of equal size and if you want roll in nuts. Serve.

title: Fresh Tropical Fruit Salad(Serves 6)
instructions: Mix together flour and sugar in saucepan. Over medium heat stir in egg and fruit juices. Stir constantly until thickened (about 5 minutes). Add lemon zest and chill. Fold in sour cream.

title: Fudge
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until forms soft ball in cold water (240\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add the chocolate bits marshmallow whip and vanilla. Beat until chocolate bits are melted. May sprinkle chopped nuts over top. Makes large batch.

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients in 2-quart saucepan. Cook to soft ball stage. Add nuts. Stir until creamy. Quickly turn out on waxed paper and separate with fork.

title: Wilted Spinach Salad
instructions: After frying bacon leave 5 tablespoons fat in skillet. Add the onion sugar vinegar and mustard. Heat until onion is soft and sugar dissolved. Add salt and pepper. Pour hot dressing over spinach and toss. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Red Hot Salad
instructions: Dissolve candies in boiling water and pour over Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Stir in applesauce. Pour in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm. Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise folding in chopped celery and nuts. Spread over Jell-O. Chill. Serves 12.

title: All Day Crock-Pot Delight
instructions: Dredge beef in flour mixed with celery seed pepper and salt. Place the onions in the crock-pot. In a large skillet over medium-high heat brown the beef in the oil. Transfer to the crock-pot. Add the garlic powder. Mix together the broth honey vinegar and browning sauce. Pour into the hot skillet and stir to get all browned bits. Pour mixture over the beef and onions. Cook on low for 7 to 9 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours. really good over noodles or rice.

title: Ceviche
instructions: Mix all ingredients and salt to taste. Marinate stirring frequently 1 hour or more. Serve chilled with crackers.

title: Cocktail Sausage Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients with hands until thoroughly blended. Roll into small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; tear or cut into bite size pieces. Cook rice and mix with soup. Cook broccoli and drain. Place rice mixture in casserole dish; top with chicken. Add broccoli then cheese. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: In large saucepan heat oil; add onions and carrot. Cook over medium heat stirring frequently 3-5 minutes until onions are softened. Add garlic; cook stirring frequently 5 minutes until onions are golden brown.

title: Creamy Milk Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Line an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan with waxed paper. In heavy medium-sized saucepan over low heat melt all chips with sweetened condensed milk marshmallows and salt; stir until smooth and well blended. Remove from heat; stir in nuts and vanilla extract. Spread evenly into prepared pan. Chill overnight. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares.

title: Stir Fry Pepper Steak
instructions: Saute garlic and 2 Tbsp. oil until golden brown. Add ginger and pepper to the garlic mixture. Meanwhile slice frozen Steak-Ums into thin strips and add to browned garlic and cook until done. Remove from wok into another dish.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Crumble bacon. Cook onion in reserved drippings until tender but not brown. Add with crumbled bacon to remaining ingredients mixing well. Turn into 1 1/2-quart bean pot or casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs then mix ingredients together. Bake 1 hour; after baking 45 minutes glaze with brown sugar dry mustard and catsup. Return to oven for 15 minutes.

title: Pizza Meat Loaf
instructions: Blend soup water oregano and garlic. In bowl combine 1/4 cup soup mixture bread onion parsley egg salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly with beef. Shape firmly into loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Pour remaining soup over loaf. Top with cheese. Bake until melted.

title: Pineapple-Orange Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and lightly flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. In a mixing bowl blend the cake mix eggs water and oil. With an electric mixer beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add the oranges and continue beating for 1 minute. Pour into pan and bake 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely.

title: Frozen Creme De Menthe Pie
instructions: Combine wafer crumbs with softened butter. Press into a 9-inch spring-form pan or 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Turn ice cream into a large bowl to soften. Stir creme de menthe into ice cream. Fill wafer shell with ice cream mixture and freeze. Melt chocolate squares in ice cream over low heat. Add sugar and salt. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Stir until cooked. Let stand until cooled thoroughly. When pie is frozen spread chocolate sauce over top. Return to freezer until firm. Serves 10.

title: Secret Salad
instructions: To the drained juices add enough water to make 3 cups of liquid. Cook puddings in these juices. Cool completely. Add all the above fruit. Chill.

title: Cherry Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip Eagle Brand milk pineapple and cherry pie filling. Mix well and add pecans. Mix with mixer for about 2 minutes. Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

title: Pineapple-Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill for 1 hour before serving. Serve with crackers. Best with Ranch flavor Wheatables.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and Karo syrup until smooth. Spread on bottom pie shell. Sprinkle grated chocolate over peanut butter. Reserve this and make filling. Bring to a boil milk salt sugar cocoa and cornstarch. Mix together and add egg yolks and 1/2 cup milk. When all is smooth add to the boiling milk. Keep stirring until bubbling. Cool until just warm. Add vanilla and margarine. Stir well. Pour into pie shell over the peanut butter ingredients. Chill and top with whipped cream.

title: Hearty Rice Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a greased 4-quart baking dish; mix well. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Grilled Burgers
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup water and soup mix. Blending well stir in ground beef until well mixed. Shape into 10 patties. Place on grill over hot charcoals. Cook to desired doneness. Arrange lettuce on bottom halves of buns then patty tomato slices and onion rings. Put top on and enjoy!

title: Cheese And Rice
instructions: Separate yolks and whites. Beat yolks until thick. Add rice and seasonings milk melted butter and cheese. Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into buttered baking dish; bake for 40 minutes in moderate oven (350\u00b0).

title: Pork Potato Casserole
instructions: Butter a casserole dish. Peel and slice potatoes into the dish. Salt and pepper. Spread the can of mushroom soup over potatoes. Salt and pepper the tenderloin chops and lay on top. Pour 1 cup evaporated milk over it all. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Applesauce-Honey Muffins
instructions: Stir together flour baking powder cinnamon and ginger. Combine egg applesauce honey oil and juice. Add to flour mixture. Stir just until moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Fold in pecans and raisins. Fill 12 muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Sour Gravy
instructions: Brown rabbit or chicken (after rolling in flour) in small amount of grease. Place meat in oven to bake until done. When meat is nearly done heat reserved fry drippings. Add water sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil. Make thin paste of flour and water. Gradually stir into meat mixture. Cook until thick.

title: Molasses Cake
instructions: Mix and sift the first 7 ingredients. Cream shortening and sugar. Blend in the molasses stir in 1/2 cup of flour mixture. Beat in eggs. Add hot water alternately with remaining flour mixture. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool and ice.

title: Congealed Apricot Salad
instructions: Drain apricots and measure 1 cup of juice - heat juice and pour over Jello stir until dissolved. Mix remaining juice (apricot) and lemon and orange juice and water to make second cup of liquid. Add to gelatin mixture. Puree apricots in blender and add to gelatin. When mixture begins to congeal add nuts. Mix cream cheese with a little milk to serve or serve with mayo.

title: Fitch Casserole(We Call It That In The Family; You Don'T Have To.)
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. In the meantime brown meat in 1 tablespoon butter in a heavy skillet. Stir in tomato sauce; remove from heat. Combine next 5 ingredients. Spread 1/2 the noodles in a buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover with the cheese mixture then with the remaining noodles. Pour the melted butter over all. Spread meat mixture over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8. If this casserole must be held reduce temperature to 250\u00b0.

title: Hearty Beef And Vegetable Soup
instructions: Day before serving Place beef marrowbone 1 tablespoon salt and water in very large kettle. Cover and bring to boiling. Skim surface. Add cabbage onions carrots celery green peppers and tomatoes. Bring to boiling; then simmer covered 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and simmer covered 3 1/2 hours. Remove meat and bone. Discard bone. Let meat cool. Cut into cubes and add to soup. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. May also divide batter into 3 loaf pans filling half full. Bake about 1 hour and 15 minutes. If using glass pans reduce heat to 325\u00b0. Raisins may be substituted for dates.

title: Microwave Roux
instructions: In 4-cup glass measure combine oil and flour; mix well. Microwave on High for 6 minutes or until as dark as desired. (Stir when there are 2 minutes left on the timer and when there are 30 seconds left on the timer.) Stir when timer counts to zero. If this is not dark enough for you continue to microwave on High for 30 seconds. Add onions and celery. Mix well. Microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes or until onions are soft but not brown. Add green onions parsley and garlic. Microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until done. Yields 1 batch roux.

title: Barbecue Chipped Ham
instructions: Mix together and simmer. Recipe is for 1 1/2 pounds of chipped ham.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place chicken pieces in a baking pan with 1/2 cup water. Sprinkle with lemon juice then garlic powder and last with paprika. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes basting chicken periodically with juices. Serve.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger; drain. Cook vegetables and drain. Mix all together. Top with cheese and Tots (cover). This amount times 3 is plenty for 15 to 20 people.

title: Sour Cream Apple Bars
instructions: Blend the cake mix and butter together; reserve 2/3 cup for topping. Press rest in the bottom of a square pan. Place apple slices over pressed down cake mix. Mix egg and sour cream; pour over apples. Mix the brown sugar and cinnamon to the reserved 2/3 cup cake mix. Sprinkle over sour cream for topping. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes until golden brown. Yummy!

title: Aged Eggnog
instructions: Beat egg yolks well and gradually add sugar. Beat well again. Slowly add liquors and stir well. Keep cool at least overnight up to 1 month!

title: Rice Krispies Wedding Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into balls. Put on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 9 minutes only. Let set until cold then roll in powdered sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Bars
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Beat first 4 ingredients at medium speed of an electric beater until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla beat well. Add flour to butter mixture beating well. Spread batter in an ungreased 9 x 13 inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Remove from oven run a knife through batter to swirl chocolate. Return to oven bake 30 more minutes. Cool completely in pan on a wire rack. Cut into bars.

title: Ruglach
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Dissolve the yeast in warm water. Add yeast to melted butter. Add 3 egg yolks sour cream and flour to yeast and butter mixture. Put in refrigerator overnight. Divide dough into 8 parts; roll each part in the sugar and cinnamon mixture. Cut each into 8 parts like pie. Place some chopped nuts and raisins at wide end and roll into crescent shape. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients pour in 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in whole egg and egg yolk. Sift flour and soda with nutmeg. Mix into batter. Fold in nuts and raisins. Drop from teaspoon 2 inches apart onto a buttered cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Carrot Bread
instructions: Cook carrots; place carrots in blender and grate coarsely but do not puree. In a large bowl combine flour salt baking soda cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir together carrots oil eggs water and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Stir until blended. Pour batter into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes or until done. Check every so often to see if done. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pan and serve.

title: Allie'S Cabbage Salad
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil and let cool. Shred the cabbage. Salt with the 2 tablespoons salt. Let stand 2 hours. Rinse with cold water and drain well. Chop the celery and green pepper. Add the celery seed and mustard seed. Cover with syrup and let stand several hours. Keeps indefinitely and stays crisp.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Mix together brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour 1/2 batter in 13 x 9-inch square pan then sprinkle all brown sugar and cinnamon mix over the batter. Take a fork and swirl real good then pour the remainder of the batter over this mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a preheated and oiled pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about an hour or until done in the center.

title: Company Meat Balls
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Roll out into balls. Roll in flour pepper and paprika which has been mixed together. Brown in butter. When browned pour cream of chicken soup and water over it and simmer for 30 minutes. Prepare this in an electric skillet.

title: Mint Prunes
instructions: In a hot pot combine prunes water to cover vinegar and cinnamon. Bring to a low boil. Cook until prunes are tender. Remove from heat. Add mint extract. Cover; let stand 12 hours. Chill in refrigerator. Yields 1 pound.

title: Black And White Cream Cheese Cakes
instructions: Beat together the first 4 ingredients thoroughly; stir in chocolate bits. Sift together the remaining dry ingredients. Make a well. Blend in liquids. Grease and flour 12 to 15 muffin tins or paper liners. Fill 1/3 full with cocoa mixture. Top with heaping teaspoon of cream cheese mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. They freeze very well!

title: Marinade For Meat
instructions: Put in a Ziploc bag with meat and marinate 1 to 4 hours in refrigerator. Grill or cook as desired.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together and serve chilled.

title: Cherry Angel Dessert
instructions: Place broken up angel cake into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan (lasagna type). Mix pudding with sour cream and milk; and beat about 2 minutes with hand eggbeater or until it is all blended together. Pour pudding over cake pieces covering well. Cover this with pie filling and refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares to serve. Whipped topping may be used to top it if desired.

title: Spiced Apple Butter
instructions: Core and slice apples but do not peel. Add only enough water to cook apples until soft. Press through a sieve and measure. Combine all ingredients. Cook until mixture remains in a smooth mass (when a small amount is cooled) about 1 1/2 hours. During cooking time stir frequently to prevent burning. Pour into hot sterilized pint jars and seal. Makes 8 pints.

title: Rhubarb Punch
instructions: Simmer rhubarb and water until cooked soft. Strain. Add sugar orange juice and lemonade concentrates with strained liquid. Pour over ice cubes. Makes 6 cups. Is a \mystery taste\ and is delicious.

title: Saguaro Chicken Salad
instructions: Prepared Cilantro-Lime Grilling Sauce; add chicken to coat. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add milk and yeast mixture. Knead. Roll out on floured board; cut into biscuits. Let stand 15 minutes to rise. Bake in a 475\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until done.

title: Lemon-Lime Refrigerator Salad
instructions: Add hot and cold water to Jell-O. When cool add remaining ingredients. Mix together. Store in refrigerator. Makes a large salad and keeps well. Make in large oblong glass pan.

title: Monterey Chicken(Recipe Stated As Per Serving; Add Accordingly.)
instructions: Grill chicken or cook it in a skillet until it is done. Top chicken breast with barbecue sauce bacon and cheese. Broil chicken breast in the oven until the cheese is melted. If desired sprinkle with a small amount of cold chopped tomatoes and chives.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Cream together flour butter and powdered sugar until crumbly. Pat into a pizza pan and bake at 350 degrees until brown. Cool.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat. Blend in flour. Add milk gradually stirring constantly. Flavor with sugar and lemon. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Cottage Cheese Lime Dessert
instructions: Press first 5 ingredients in pan and bake 12 to 15 minutes. Drain crushed pineapple and bring juice to a boil. Dissolve jello into juice and cool until slightly jelled. Cream the cream cheese sugar pineapple and cottage cheese. Add whipped cream. Fold all together and pour on crust.

title: Easy Chicken Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and lemon juice in bowl. Add other ingredients and mix lightly. Cover and refrigerate several hours or chill until served.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Put meat and veggies in large heavy pan like a Dutch oven. Put meat in bottom layer with veggies then salt and pepper. Cover with the soup; pour water over top. Bake in covered pan in a slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Dont peek!!

title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Drop from teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake 8 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit in quarters; roll in mixture of 2/3 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. (I either do this in a covered Tupperware bowl or large Ziploc bag.) Bring remaining ingredients to a boil. Butter Bundt pan and alternate layer of biscuits and layer of boiled mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Steam Brown Sponge Cake(Philippine Native Dessert)
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add brown sugar slowly while beating until thick. Pour in milk and mix well. Sift flour and fold into egg mixture. Set aside 4 hours or overnight.

title: Cookie Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray. Slice 1 roll cookies thin and layer on bottom of pan. Mix cream cheese sugar and eggs well. Pour over cookies. Slice other roll of cookies and place on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 45 minutes. Cake will sink when cooled.

title: All In One Pan Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients into ungreased cake pan. In the pile make 3 holes of graduated size with a spoon. Into the largest pour the oil into the medium the vinegar and into the smallest the vanilla. Cover with cold water and stir well with fork. Make sure it is mixed well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: French Creme Mint Brownies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; blend in eggs. Add syrup flour and baking powder. Put in greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown meat over medium heat. Quarter onion slices and add to meat. Lower heat and simmer. Peel potatoes and cut into chunks. Slice carrots. Cut up beans and celery. Add to meat and onion. Will make its own juice. Simmer 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

title: Kurma(Quick Chicken Curry From South Africa)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in Dutch oven or large heavy pan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until chicken is done stirring occasionally. Serve with hot rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Prepare mashed potatoes; set aside. In a large skillet cook ground beef and onion till meat is no longer pink and onion is tender. Drain off fat.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Butter sides of a heavy 2-quart saucepan. Combine sugar and milk. Heat and stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to a boil. Then cook to a \soft ball\ stage (234\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients and stir until blended. Pour into buttered 9 x 9 x 2-inch glass pan. Score in squares while warm.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in an oblong pan (9 x 13-inch) at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Frost when cool.

title: Saucepan Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening in saucepan; cool slightly. Add and beat well sugar salt egg molasses and vanilla. Sift together flour soda cinnamon cloves and ginger and add. Mix well. Roll in 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Cook 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: No Bake Cookie
instructions: Cook sugar margarine cocoa and milk slowly until sugar is dissolved then bring to a boil and boil one minute. Remove pan from heat and add peanut butter stirring until melted then add oatmeal (uncooked). Mix until oats are coated. Drop while hot be teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Granola Bars
instructions: Mix oatmeal flour sugar and cinnamon. Add butter. Separate in 2 parts. Spread half on bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased glass baking dish.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Beat first 7 ingredients with mixer then add zucchini and chocolate chips. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. After cooling sprinkle with powdered sugar or top with favorite icing.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Cook in saucepan with water enough to cover. Add salt to taste. When done drain and cool. Mix all ingredients together; add a little black pepper. Sprinkle a little paprika on top.

title: Tostadas
instructions: Heat oil and fry tortillas until crisp. Put on paper towels to drain. Cook hamburger and mix with package of taco sauce. On top of tostada put a layer of refried beans and sprinkle with hamburger. Top with cheese onion lettuce tomatoes olives and salsa or sauce.

title: Easy Burritos
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Add pinto beans and taco sauce; stir well and simmer over low heat until it thickens slightly. Spoon mixture into shells. Top with onion tomatoes lettuce sour cream and cheese.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix together then put in pie crust. Bake 35 minutes or until done. Makes two pies.

title: Chicken Breast Supreme
instructions: Place chicken breasts on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dissolve bouillon chicken cube in hot water and mix with the mushroom soups. Lay cheese slices on top of mixture over chicken and cheese. Melt butter or margarine and mix with herb dressing. Sprinkle on top of chicken. Bake uncovered in 305\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs and salad oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in pineapple 1 cup nuts and the bananas. Spoon batter into 3 well greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Salsa
instructions: Chop tomatoes and peppers; mix with chopped onions and minced garlic. Mix the rest of the ingredients and cook until thick. This can be canned in pint jars. Bring salsa mixture to a boil over medium heat; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Ladle into hot pint jars leaving a 1/2-inch headspace. Process in boiling water bath 40 minutes.

title: Crusty Crescent Taco Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat and onion; drain. Stir in taco seasoning mix beans and tomato sauce. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage and set aside. Chop lettuce and add to cabbage. Add onion carrot tomatoes apple raisins salt pepper and pickle juice. Mix together with enough mayonnaise to make it mix easily.

title: Grandma Sullye'S Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour an 8 x 8-inch pan. Crush graham crackers in blender or by rolling between two pieces of waxed paper until fine to make 1 1/4 cups. Combine crumbs in a bowl with the condensed milk and chocolate bits. Spread into prepared pan. Bake about 30 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes then cut into squares. These keep well in a tin box.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine dry ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry ingredients and stir only until moistened. Pour into a greased 9-inch square baking pan or 10-inch heavy skillet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until bread is golden brown and tests done. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream powdered sugar and cheese together. Add peanut butter. Beat with mixer. Add Cool Whip and pour in baked pie shell or graham cracker pie shell.

title: Tempura Batter
instructions: Blend 1 yolk and 1 cup beer. Stir in 1 cup of flour. Place 1 cup flour in another bowl. Dip food to be fried in liquid mixture roll in flour and deep fry. When needed make a new batch of mixture with remaining ingredients.

title: Diane'S Chicken Sour Cream
instructions: Mix sour cream soup and milk and pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4 to 6. Enjoy!

title: Quick And Easy Rolls
instructions: Melt margarine; let cool. Add remaining ingredients; stir until well blended. Place in air-tight covered container. Place in refrigerator for several hours. Spoon into greased muffin pan. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until fluffy. Add milk juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Cover with pie filling. Let set 2 hours.

title: Iceberg Layered Salad
instructions: Core rinse and drain lettuce thoroughly; refrigerate in plastic bag or crisper. To prepare chop enough chilled lettuce to measure 2 quarts. Blend mayonnaise sour cream seasoned salt and garlic powder for dressing.

title: Pancake Syrup
instructions: Bring sugar water and butter to a boil in a saucepan. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Store in refrigerator in a microwave-safe container. Reheat when needed.

title: Artichoke Galore
instructions: Wash artichoke and remove unwanted leaves. Boil in saucepan until tender. Add other ingredients one at a time to each artichoke. Let simmer in water for 15 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake in a preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Lower heat to 200\u00b0 to finish baking. This makes 2 nice pies.

title: Potato Corn Chowder
instructions: Chop potatoes in small squares. Finely chop carrots and onion. Boil potatoes carrots and onion until tender with salt and pepper. Fry meat in separate skillet. When potatoes etc. are finished pour 1/2 of water off. Add all other ingredients. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes on low.

title: Ice Cream Yummy Dessert
instructions: Put cookies in food processor and reduce to a fine crumb mixture. (You can also use a nut chopped or a rolling pin with sheets of wax paper.) Set aside 1/4 cup of the crumbs for topping. Add enough butter to the remaining crumbs to make them stick together a little. Press into the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan and put in the freezer to set.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into greased pan or skillet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Herb Buttered Pasta
instructions: Cook linguine in 3-quart saucepan according to package directions. Drain. Melt butter in the same pan. Stir in linguine and remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until heated about 2 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Pepperoni Lasagna
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to directions. Brown ground meat. Butter 13 x 9-inch casserole. Spread macaroni on bottom then put ground meat and 1/2 of the cheeses. Add 1/2 of the pepperoni and 1 can of sauce. Repeat procedure ending up with pepperoni on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Do Not Peep Stew
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into a well greased baking dish. Cover and bake at 325 degrees for 3 hours. DO NOT PEEP! Serve with bread or rice and crackers.

title: Easy Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a 9 by 13 container. This dessert can be frozen.

title: Monterey Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on box. Mix sour cream chilies salt and pepper. In deep casserole dish spread a layer of rice mixture and top with cheese slices. Repeat layers ending with rice mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Bars
instructions: Place a layer of graham crackers on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Leave crackers whole. Melt butter and add sugar milk and egg. Cook until it comes to a full boil stirring constantly. Pour over crackers. Add coconut nuts and crushed graham crackers.

title: Shrimp Newberg
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Stir in flour. Add milk slowly. Add spices Worcestershire sherry and lemon juice. Heat through. Add shrimp. Top with cheese. Heat in oven until brown. Serve over rice.

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Fry bacon; save grease. Add to grease the sugar vinegar and water. Heat until hot. Chop carrots and eggs; toss with lettuce. Pour hot sauce over lettuce and mix well. Crumble bacon over salad and serve.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and put in jars with dill. Mix 1 quart of vinegar 3 quarts of water 1 cup coarse salt and 1 teaspoon powdered alum. When mixture boils pour over pickles while hot and seal. Put layer of pickles and then dill.

title: Blue Cheese Ball(Appetizer)
instructions: Mix all together and shape into a ball. Roll in ground pecans; refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Bran Bars
instructions: Beat until smooth sugar oleo eggs and vanilla. Add 1 1/2 cups flour baking\tsoda powder and salt. Beat until smooth. Fold in 1 cup chocolate chips 1 cup nuts and 1 cup All-Bran. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Mama'S Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except marshmallows in mixing bowl. Mix with electric mixer or by hand. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes in greased 9 x 9-inch dish. Top with marshmallows. Bake until melted and browned.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Mix all together in paper bag. Shake until potatoes are very well coated. Place in large baking pan. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 until brown and tender. Garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Pistachio Marble Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients except Bosco into a large mixing bowl. Then beat with an electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes.

title: Monte Cristo Au Gratin
instructions: Place 2 slices ham and 2 slices turkey between 2 slices of bread. Dip sandwich in egg mixture. In a frying pan heat oil and butter. Fry both sides of sandwiches until golden brown. Place in baking dish. In a saucepan combine cheese milk and mayonnaise. Heat stirring constantly until cheese melts and mixture is smooth. Pour over sandwiches; broil 3 to 5 minutes 6 inches from broiler until bubbly.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding enough buttermilk to make batter thick. Drop by spoonful into cooking oil. Deep fry until brown.

title: Herbed Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 275\u00b0. Begin with a brown paper bag; combine ingredients.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time; beat after each egg. Add lemon extract. Combine dry ingredients in separate bowl; add 1/2 of the flour mixture at the time. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Whiskey Balls
instructions: Stir in all ingredients together. Shape into balls about 1 1/2-inch size.

title: Oven Baked Apple Slices
instructions: Quarter core and peel the apples. Cut the quarters into lengthwise thirds to make slices about 1/2 inch wide at the outside edge. Toss in a bowl with the sugar then with the lemon juice and finally with the melted butter. Let sit 3 or 4 minutes to render juices and absorb flavor. Taste and fold in more sugar if needed. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Turn apples into 6 x 9-inch baking dish and set in the middle level of the oven basting every 8 to 10 minutes with accumulated juices. Apples are done when slices are tender. If juices have not thickened remove with bulb baster and boil down in small saucepan. Pour over apples.

title: Honolulu Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken in seasoned flour; brown in small amount of oil. Drain. Mix preserves barbecue sauce onion and soy sauce. Pour chicken; cover. Simmer 40 minutes or until chicken is tender. Add water chestnuts and green pepper the last 10 minutes of cooking time. Serve with rice.

title: Pecan Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spread over cake and broil 2-3 minutes keeping about 4 inches from heat. Makes enough for 13 X 9 cake.

title: Italian Bread Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut Italian bread in half and cut both pieces in half longways so you have 4 equal size pieces. Put pizza sauce on then the cheese and any toppings youd like. Put on cookie sheet. Bake for about 12 minutes. Serves 4.

title: People Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt butter chocolate chips and peanut butter. Pour over Crispix in a large pan; mix well. Pour powdered sugar over the mixture and toss. (May pour into a small kitchen bag and shake.)

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter. Sift in flour and baking powder; mix well. Shape into one-inch balls and place on baking sheet. Flatten with a fork. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Fried Apples And Ham
instructions: Place apples and margarine in skillet. Stir until margarine is melted then add sugar. Stir until sugar is melted. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Uncover and add ham nutmeg and cinnamon. Continue to cook until apples are done. Serves 2.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Thoroughly mix the crab meat and mayonnaise together. Add celery and red peppers; mix well. (Add lemon juice if desired and mix.) Cover; refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Boil cranberries water and cloves together until cranberries are soft. Press through a colander. Add sugar and juice to cranberry juice. Serve hot or cold.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: In a saucepan bring broth and water to a rapid boil. Add rice. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed. Set aside.

title: Chops A La Chuck(20 To 30 Minutes)
instructions: Pound pork chops to tenderize them. Mix milk and egg. Dip chops in mixture one by one; sprinkle on pepper then dredge in bread crumbs. Fry in canola oil until golden brown. Turn frequently to avoid getting too hard.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple in bottom of casserole. Mix sugar flour and grated cheese. Pour over pineapple. Crumble stack of Ritz crackers over mixture. Melt butter and dribble over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cajun Potatoes
instructions: Barely cover potatoes with water. Add butter and all other ingredients and cook until tender. May have to drain part of water.

title: Thick And Chewy Cookies
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter vanilla and sugar. Add eggs. Stir in oatmeal soda and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain well. Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs stirring well. Spoon into a lightly greased 2 1/2-quart casserole; top with bread crumbs if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 8 servings.

title: Open House Punch
instructions: Mash bananas with small amount of orange juice. Combine with remaining orange juice lemonade pineapple juice water and sugar. Mix. Freeze in containers that will fit into punch bowl. Two hours before serving place in punch bowl and add ginger ale.

title: Easy Oven Potatoes
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Add cooking oil and onion soup mix; mix well. Place in baking dish. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken-Sesame Stir-Fry
instructions: In large skillet or wok heat oil. Saute chicken 5 minutes until tender. Remove to boil. In drippings add chicken broth and soy sauce. Boil then add broccoli. Stir-fry until tender-crisp. Remove broccoli to bowl with chicken. Blend cornstarch sugar and vinegar. Stir into pan. Boil 1 minute. Return chicken and broccoli. Toss to coat; heat until warm.

title: Okra Supreme
instructions: Cook okra (gumbo mix) with picante sauce water pepper garlic powder tomato sauce and salt. Cook until almost done then add Owens sausage Hillshire sausage and cooked rice. Stir and cook another five minutes or until done. Serve.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Put chicken pieces in bottom of casserole dish. Put egg slices on top of chicken. Mix together soup stock and margarine. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour over chicken and eggs. Mix self-rising flour and milk and pour over other mixture. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Breakfast Souffle
instructions: Place buttered bread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour eggs milk and seasoning mixture over bread. Crumble meat over this. Cover with grated cheese American or Cheddar. Refrigerate overnight covered. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes covered. Uncover and continue another 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats and let stand. Cream the margarine eggs and sugars. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes.

title: Cabbage Patch Stew(Lo-Cal)
instructions: Brown beef with onion. Drain and rinse with hot water. Add garlic powder cabbage carrots bay leaf thyme 1 cup of the water and 1 cup of the tomato juice. Cook about 10 minutes. Stir in the remaining water and juice. Bring to a boil and simmer until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in the parsley and potato flakes. Remove bay leaf. Has 280 calories and 4 grams of fat.

title: Roast
instructions: Pour catsup and Worcestershire sauce in a 1-cup measuring cup and 1/2 cup of water and add enough water to mixture to make 1 cup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours or until tender. If you wish after cooking 2 hours add potatoes carrots and onions and sprinkle seasoned salt over them. Cook in big roasting pan with lid. I always cover the pan with foil and then put the lid on to keep as much moisture in as possible.

title: My Mom'S Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Add pickle relish and chopped celery and onion to your liking. Chill.

title: Spicy Christmas Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flour. Add flour gradually to creamed mixture. Form smal balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Using thumb make imprint in center of ball to form cookie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until puffy. Make imprint on cookie again.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients for 3 minutes after it comes to a full rolling boil. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop on wax paper. Store in covered container.

title: Lucille Huffman'S Hershey Brownies
instructions: Cream the sugar and margarine. Add the eggs. Add Hersheys syrup and vanilla. Add flour and salt. Bake in an 8-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Ice Tea Syrup
instructions: Boil water. Add tea bags and boil for one minute. Remove from heat and steep for 15 minutes. Add sugar; keep syrup refrigerated. To make tea mix 5 (water) to 1 (tea).

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown onions hamburger peppers and celery in oil. Meanwhile measure salt pepper oregano sugar and garlic in bowl. When meat is brown add tomato paste wine mushrooms seasonings and chili pepper. Simmer very slowly at least one hour preferably 3 or 4. Just before serving take out chili pepper and stir in 1/4 teaspoon baking soda.

title: Dottie Perotti'S Onion Dip
instructions: Mix together with mixer. Sprinkle top with paprika. (If using clams or shrimp add 1 teaspoon horseradish.)

title: One A Day Banana Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar and butter until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla then beat together. Stir in bananas. In another bowl mix flours and baking powder. Mix both mixtures until combined. Stir in carob chips. Pour into 9 x 11 greased pan. Bake 25 minutes.

title: 7-Layer Casserole(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Spray bottom of frying pan with Pam. Cook onions until soft but not brown. Add hamburger or ground turkey. Saute until brown or well-cooked. Add tomato sauce corn and olives. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Add milk and corn meal; stir and simmer 15 minutes. Be careful not to burn. Add chili seasoning depending upon desired hotness. Cover with grated Cheddar cheese and pop into 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Serve with green salad and French bread. Serves 6.

title: Linda Davis' Fantastic Zucchini Relish
instructions: Shred together the first 4 ingredients. Sprinkle with the salt. Let stand overnight.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil and to that add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients. Add vinegar and food coloring to sugar and egg mixture; mix well. Add flour and dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla and beat well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes for 2 layers in 10-inch cake pans. Cool thoroughly before frosting.

title: Pat'S Trifle
instructions: Prepare pudding with skim milk according to package directions. Stir in Cool Whip saving enough for topping. Layer cake pieces pudding and berries in a large glass bowl. Top with remaining Cool Whip and a few whole berries. You can vary the pudding flavor the fruit and even the type of cake.

title: Crock-Pot Pork Chops
instructions: Mix all together and coat 6 to 8 lean pork chops. Fry pork chops in 2 tablespoons shortening. Brown only. Put into crock-pot with 1 can cream of chicken soup. Put crock-pot on low 6 to 8 hours. This is a delicious recipe and it makes lots of gravy.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix thoroughly the first 5 ingredients. Form ham mixture into balls. Boil sugar vinegar and water until it thickens a little. Pour over ham balls and bake 45 minutes. Turn over several times.

title: Macaroni And Tuna Fish
instructions: Cook macaroni; add peas during last minutes and drain thoroughly. Mix tuna and mayonnaise into macaroni. Serve on a bed of lettuce. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Ham Chowder (Soup)
instructions: Saute celery and onions in margarine at low heat until tender. Chop broccoli and cook in water until it begins to tender. Drain; mix with celery and onion mixture. Add the cubed cooked potatoes (drained). Add salt pepper milk cheese and the chopped cooked ham.

title: Festive Refrigerator Fruit Cake
instructions: Put Pet milk marshmallows and orange juice in a bowl and let stand until needed. Put graham cracker crumbs into a large bowl. Add\tcinnamon nutmeg cloves dates raisins English walnuts candied pineapple candied orange peel and cherries. Add milk mixture. Mix with spoon then hands until crumbs\tare moistened.\tPress firmly into pan lined with waxed paper. Top with fruit and nuts. Cover tightly. Chill for 2 days before slicing. Keep in\tcool place. Makes 1 (2 1/4 pound) fruit cake.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: *Add a little oil to noodles while cooking so they wont stick.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix rum and oil. Beat in eggs and pudding. Prepare Bundt pan; spray with Pam and sprinkle with chopped walnuts (about 1/4 cup). Fill with cake batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Test with skewer; let cool. Cut into it with a knife all over the top. Drizzle glaze over it. Let cool; remove from pan.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed. Brown beef with onions and bell pepper. Mix with noodles.\tAdd salt pepper and oregano. Add soup and mushrooms. Top with cheese. Melt in moderate oven.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Add strawberries partially thawed to ginger ale and lemonade. Add mint leaves. Serve ice cold. For best results add ginger ale prior to serving.

title: Cowboy Nachos
instructions: In saucepan combine Wolf chili and Ranch Style Beans heat. Arrange chips on a large plate. Top with chili mixture. Pour desired amount of heated cheese sauce over chili. Top with Rotel tomatoes onions olives and guacamole; amount you desire. Add sour cream.

title: Sandies(Cookies)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add vanilla and water. Add Wondra flour; form into balls (walnut size). Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven. Remove hot cookies and roll in powdered sugar; let cool.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup milk in double boiler over boiling water. Cover and stir until melted. Keep warm. Mix cake mix butter and remaining 1/3 cup milk at medium speed for 2 minutes. Spread 1/2 of batter in 13 x 9-inch greased baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Cool 2 minutes. Spread warm caramel mixture carefully over baked layer. Sprinkle chocolate chips over this. Stir 1/2 cup nuts into remaining batter and drop by spoonfuls over chocolate chips. Sprinkle remaining cup of nuts over top of this and bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Linguini And White Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute 1 stick butter with garlic and parsley for 3 minutes. Add 3 cans of clams (with juice) clam juice optional shrimp and wine. Simmer covered on High for 15 minutes until broth thickens a bit. Continue to simmer for 15 minutes more on low. Cook pasta and drain. Pour sauce over linguini in large bowl. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fluffy Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Add peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk blending thoroughly. Fold Cool Whip into mixture. Pour into prepared crust. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts. Chill until firm.

title: 24 Hour Slaw
instructions: Bring vinegar sugar mustard and salt to a boil. Remove from heat\tand add oil. Shred cabbage and chop onions in jars and pour sauce over all. Cover and place in refrigerator.\tIt may be kept in refrigerator for as long as 3 weeks.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk as directed on box. Mix in about 1/2 of Cool Whip. Layer cookies bananas and pudding. Spread remaining Cool Whip on top.

title: Wilma'S Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Cook the cornbread in a large hot and greased cast-iron skillet about 20 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Fruit Squares
instructions: Mix shortening eggs flour sugar and vanilla together. Put 3/4 of batter in 9 x 13-inch pan. On top of batter pour pie filling. Put remainder of batter on top dropping by teaspoons. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool then cut into squares.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all together. Use on fruit coleslaw and lettuce salad.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Dice up and set aside. Combine all other ingredients. In a 3-quart casserole dish pour alternate layers of stuffing mix and then chicken ending with a layer of stuffing mix. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Garlic Oyster Crackers
instructions: If you have the blues read the 27th Psalm.

title: Hamburger Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Spread meat on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle dry soup on meat. Mix chicken soup with milk and pour over meat. Arrange frozen Tater Tots on top. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Three Step Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sprinkle cornmeal onto 13-inch pizza pan (well-greased). Roll dough to form a 12-inch circle. Spread sauce evenly over crust. Add both cheeses and toppings. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Cut and serve.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery fruit and enough mayonnaise to mix well.

title: Fat-Free Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Spray a 9-inch round cake pan with cooking spray. Add brown sugar corn syrup and lemon juice. Stir to combine. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven 3 minutes. Arrange pineapple rings and cherries in pan. Set aside. In a large bowl combine flour cornstarch baking powder and salt. In medium bowl stir sugar and milk until sugar is almost dissolved. Add egg whites corn syrup and vanilla. Stir until blended. Gradually add to flour mixture stirring until smooth. Pour into pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Immediately loosen edge of cake with spatula and invert onto serving plate. Remove pan. Makes 12 servings.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix cheese corn Milnot eggs butter and pepper. Place in a baking dish and crumble toast on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Combine squash and onions in pan. Sprinkle with salt; let stand 1 hour then drain (do not rinse). Mix other ingredients in pan. Bring to a hard boil. Add squash and onion; boil 15 to 20 minutes. Pack in jars. Seal jars and process in hot bath for 10 minutes. Yields 3 pints.

title: Millet Fruit Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl; mix well. Form into a ball or log. Roll in copped nuts. The mixing may be done in a food processor. Yields twenty 1-inch balls.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine peanuts sugar corn syrup and salt in a 2-quart baking dish. Stir and microwave on High (100%) for 8 minutes. (Stir again after 4 minutes.) Stir in butter and vanilla and microwave an additional 2 minutes on High (100%). Add baking soda and stir until light and foamy. Pour immediately onto a greased baking sheet. Spread out thinly and allow to cool. Break into small pieces.

title: Potato Bread
instructions: Note Need 4 (1 pound) coffee cans.

title: Hocus-Pocus Crispies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Unroll rolls into 2 long rectangles. Overlap edges to form 14 x 8-inch rectangle. Press together. Combine brown sugar pecans and cinnamon. Sprinkle over rolls that are coated with margarine. Start at short side and roll up. Seal ends. Cut into 8 slices. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten into circle. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon sugar. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Quick Baked Catfish(Low-Fat)
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Rinse and pat dry fillets. Dip in milk. Place skin side down in foil-lined pan (spray with cooking oil spray). Mix bread crumbs and seasonings. Add oleo to moisten and sprinkle or spoon over fish. Bake uncovered for about 12 to 15 minutes (a little longer for thick fillets). (Guilt free.)

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together and stir until smooth. Serve all kinds of fruit (sliced bananas apple slices mandarin oranges pineapple chunks etc.).

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Stir together first 3 ingredients. Press crumb mixture into bottom and 1 1/2 inches up sides of a lightly greased 9-inch spring form pan. Bake crust at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Ham And Broccoli Quiche(Makes 2)
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add soup and milk mixing well. Sprinkle cheese ham and broccoli into pie crust. Pour soup mixture over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until center is set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine peanut butter Crisco oil light brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat with mixer on medium speed. Add egg and beat on medium speed until well blended.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package. Drain and rinse in cold water. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and chill.

title: 22 Minute Chocolate Cake
instructions: Put flour and sugar in mixing bowl. In saucepan bring to boil water shortening margarine and cocoa or squares. Pour into dry mix and blend. Add eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla. Mix well. Bake at 400\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan for 20 minutes.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain all three beans and mix with Italian dressing. Serve cold.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown onions in oil and add garlic salt oregano sugar tomatoes tomato puree and tomato paste. Fry sausage and add to sauce after it has boiled 1/2 an hour. Simmer 2 hours.

title: Rosie'S Banana Icee
instructions: In blender put Slim Fast dry milk ice and water. Blend until completely blended ice completely chopped. Add frozen banana pieces. Blend just until banana is blended. A wonderful healthy summer treat.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: This recipe was handed down from my grandmother. One of Rons favorites.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Coat chicken with flour. In a large skillet brown chicken and garlic in 3 tablespoons of oil. Remove chicken from pan. Add pasta sauce then chicken. Stir. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes adding peppers during last 5 minutes. Uncover. Top each breast with half cheese slice. Toss hot cooked macaroni with remaining 1 tablespoon oil and parsley. Serve with chicken and sauce.

title: Thanksgiving Potatoes
instructions: Peel and boil potatoes; drain. Mash potatoes. Add milk and butter as needed. Add cream of chicken soup to mixture. Layer mashed potatoes sour cream and shredded cheese in a rectangular baking dish. (Spray sides and bottom of dish with a little Pam.) Last layer should have cheese on top. Sprinkle green onions on top. Cover with foil bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Slice and wash carrots into coin size. Cook until tender and drain well. Marinate in remaining ingredients. Cover tightly and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed. Pour half the mix into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Melt the caramels Eagle Brand milk and 1 stick butter in saucepan. Pour over cake then pour remaining batter on top of caramels. Sprinkle the nuts and chocolate chips over top. Bake 25 minutes more or until done.

title: Tarragon Scallop And Shrimp Salad
instructions: Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in large skillet. Slice scallops in and simmer 1 1/2 minutes or until opaque halfway through. Drain and spread out on a large plate to cool quickly. Put oil lemon juice vinegar mustard salt tarragon pepper and sugar in small bowl or jar with tight-fitting lid. Whisk or shake until well blended. Toss scallops shrimp and half each of the chives and parsley with half the dressing in a medium size bowl to coat well. Chill at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours. Just before serving gently toss lettuce with remaining dressing. Arrange loosely on 4 large salad plates. Spoon salad in center of each. Sprinkle with the remaining chives and parsley then the pepper. Makes 4 servings 331 calories each.

title: Overnight Scalloped Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk and cheese. Add meat macaroni and eggs; stir in 1/4 cup melted butter. Transfer to greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Toss bread crumbs with remaining butter and sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs well; add sugar corn milk and lemon flavoring. Dissolve cornstarch in water. Add to egg mixture. Dot with butter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Combine chicken pimiento onion and seasonings. Set aside. In skillet melt margarine over medium heat. When margarine bubbles add flour and stir until mixture is smooth and bubbly. While stirring pour in broth (2 cups). Stir and heat to boiling. Add hot mixture to chicken mixture and stir. Gently fold in peas and pour into crust. Add top crust and flute edges. Pierce top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 until crust is done.

title: Chicken Scallop
instructions: Prepare dressing. Melt the butter. Add flour and seasonings; gradually add the broth. Cook until thick stirring. Stir small amount into eggs and mix forming custard. Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan; fill with layers of dressing then chicken. Cover with custard. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Way Sauerbraten
instructions: Line a baking pan with heavy-duty foil and place meat in the center. Pour vinegar over the meat and sprinkle bay leaf garlic and pepper over meat. Bring foil up over meat and let marinate at room temperature for one-half hour or in the refrigerator for two or three hours.

title: Oven Fries
instructions: Getting Ready Peel potatoes; cut in long wedges (about 8 wedges per potato). Put them on a cookie sheet. Melt 2 or 3 pats of butter per potato in a small pan. Brush a little on the cookie sheet to keep things from sticking. Use the rest to brush on the potato wedges (use a basting brush for this).

title: Green Rice Casserole
instructions: Thaw and drain broccoli. Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Melt 1/2 stick of margarine and pour on top.

title: Baker'S Icing
instructions: Beat butter and Crisco. Add salt vanilla and hot water. Add sugar and milk. Beat for 10 minutes until consistency of whipped cream. Enough to frost 2 cakes. Freezes well.

title: Magic Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in medium size 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix flour sugar salt baking powder and milk. Pour batter over melted butter. Add 1 quart can of any fruit. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on package. Drain well and cool. Mix with other ingredients. Place in 2-quart casserole. Chill at least 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Munkie'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour into thawed crusts. Bake at 325 degrees for 40-45 minutes or until center doesnt jiggle.

title: Savannah Anderson'S Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar egg applesauce soda and boiling water. Sift together flour salt cinnamon cloves and allspice and add gradually to creamed mixture. Add raisins and nuts gradually. Beat well and pour into oblong pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender; cool and debone. Reserve broth. Place 1/2 of dressing mix in buttered casserole dish. Next layer 1/2 of the chicken.

title: Mandarin Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken lettuce onions pea pods oranges and chestnuts. Combine noodles almonds and poppy seeds. Add dressing and cilantro and toss. Serve with Hawaiian sweet bread.

title: Jalapeno-Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix flour and cream in double boiler. Add margarine and cheese; melt. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until thick stirring occasionally. Serve warm as a dip or as spread for crackers and sandwiches.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies in food processor and set aside. Mix pudding and milk according to directions on box and set aside. Cream together cream cheese and butter. Add powdered sugar. Mix pudding cookies and cream cheese mixtures. Fold in whipped topping. Put in flower pot arranging in layers beginning and ending with cookie crumbs. Refrigerate. Just before serving add shovel and artificial flowers.

title: Banana-Strawberry Truffle
instructions: Tear angel food cake into pieces. In a large bowl mix pudding and milk; beat well. In a large brandy snifter or glass bowl layer cake bananas and berries. Top with a layer of pudding mix. When all are used top with whipped topping and garnish with fresh strawberries. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread on tray in order as listed. May top with diced tomatoes ripe olives onion lettuce cheese etc. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Wine Stew
instructions: Brown bacon with chopped onion in pan then place in casserole dish. Cut beef then brown in bacon fat. Add beef to casserole. Put soup and sherry in pan. Slice onion and carrots into liquid and bring to a boil. Pour over meat in casserole and place in oven at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

title: Chicken, Mushroom, Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Salt and pepper both sides of chicken. Place chicken in a baking dish; add 1 can mushrooms and 1 can green beans (drained). Take 2 packages chicken gravy mix add mushroom and green bean juice and water to make 2 cups. Pour over chicken mushrooms and green beans. Cover and bake about 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 or until chicken is tender. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Grandmas Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all together adding hot water last. Bake 20-30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in floured pans (1 13x9 or 2 round or 2 8x8) until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool and serve dust with powdered sugar or frost.

title: Cinnamon Biscuits
instructions: Mix biscuit mix brown sugar and cinnamon in a mixing bowl. Add milk. Drop by tablespoon onto greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Dutch Bread
instructions: Cover; let stand until double in size. Knead and let set again for 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium bowl; stir well. Add egg and next 2 ingredients and stir well. Pour oil to depth of 2 or 3-inches into a Dutch oven. Heat to 375\u00b0. Carefully drop batter by rounded tablespoon into oil. Cook only a few at a time. Cook until golden brown. Serve immediately. Yield about 4 dozen.

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
instructions: With fork or pastry blender mix together dry ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients and mix with dry ingredients stirring until moistened. Use hands to make dough into balls. Chill for 15 minutes before rolling or freeze until ready to use. Dough will remain soft in refrigerator and can be taken out and rolled at once. No matter how much you handle this dough it will always be flaky and will do exactly as you want it to. Makes 2 double crusts or enough for a large (Watts Family Picnic Size) cobbler.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Beat eggs oil sugar and milk. Add almond and vanilla flavoring. Combine dry ingredients and beat until well blended (2 minutes). Pour into loaves and bake at 350\u00b0 (2 loaf pans for 1 hour and 15 minutes 3 loaf pans for 1 hour or 5 loaf pans for 45 minutes).

title: Simple Cocoa Layer Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 8-inch round baking pans. In large mixer bowl beat butter sugar and vanilla until creamy. Add egg yolks and beat well. Stir together flour cocoa baking powder baking soda and salt. Add alternately with milk to butter mixture.

title: Five Minute Fudge
instructions: Combine butter evaporated milk sugar and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows chocolate chips vanilla and nuts. Stir really well and pour onto a buttered platter. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: *Can use Pam cooking spray for health conscious adults. Spray several times during cooking process.

title: Pumpkin Puff Pancakes
instructions: In a small mixer bowl beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes or until thick and lemon colored. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls onto medium-hot ungreased griddle. Bake until puffed and bubbles break. Turn and bake other side until golden brown. Makes about 5 dozen 2-inch pancakes.

title: Apple Cheese Torte
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar and vanilla. Blend in flour and spread in the bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan and 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 inches up the side.

title: Butterscotch Delight
instructions: Cut ingredients together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes and cool.

title: Macaroni-Chicken Dinner(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Gradually add macaroni and salt to rapidly boiling water so water continues to boil. Cook uncovered stirring until tender. Drain macaroni after cooking. Beat egg and 2 tablespoons water until mixed. Dip chicken pieces into egg mix then in cheese. Brown chicken in large skillet in hot oil. Pour off drippings. Add undrained tomatoes. Stir well to loosen brown bits in skillet. Add chicken onion green pepper and macaroni. Cover and cook 45 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.

title: Cream Puff Dessert
instructions: Bring to a boil the water and butter. Add the flour until it forms a ball. Remove from stove. Add eggs one at a time until smooth. Add salt. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour then at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Orange Spiced Peaches
instructions: Drain peaches reserving 1/2 cup syrup. Tie spices in cheesecloth. In saucepan combine reserved peach syrup vinegar sugar orange slices peaches and spices. Heat to boiling; simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Cover and let cool to room temperature. Remove spice bag. Serve peaches warm or chilled. An average can of peaches contains 6 or 7 halves.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Pour large bag of beans in pot. Add water and ham hock. After 1 hour divide beans and put in second large pot. After 2 hours add third pot and divide beans from pot 1 and 2. Do the same for pot 4. Get on the phone and call everyone you know and invite them for dinner. Start cooking cornbread and making salad. Thirty-two came for dinner that night. (It was a sight.) Next night more beans there were leftovers.

title: Chicken Lickin
instructions: Cook debone and cut in bite size pieces the chicken. Add rice. Saute in margarine the celery onion and pepper. Mix all ingredients. Add chicken and mushroom soups and bake in oven 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or microwave covered with waxed paper for 10 minutes on High.

title: Chicken Fajitas(Yields 50 Servings, 2 Fajitas Per Serving)
instructions: Cover diced chicken with sauce at least 1 day before serving. Store in walk-in. Heat mixture in steamer 45 to 60 minutes. Place tortillas covered on warmer 1 to 2 hours before putting fajitas together. Place 1 ounce of mixture in center of tortilla. Wrap tortilla around mixture. Wrap 2 tortillas in foil for serving. Store in warmer until serving time. Have already cupped for serving one serving each of fajitas 1/2 ounce grated cheese 1/4 cup diced tomato and 1/4 cup chopped lettuce.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour and measure. Sift with baking powder baking soda and salt. Cream butter. Add the sugar gradually creaming as sugar is added. Add eggs one at a time beating each one thoroughly. Mash bananas and add to the first mixture. Stir in dry ingredients gradually. When well mixed add the nuts. Put in a greased pan. Bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0) from 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook potato and onion until very tender in the smallest amount of water possible. Watch closely. Do not let it burn. Cut Velveeta cheese into small pieces and add along with milk. Add to potato and onion. Simmer for 5 minutes but do not boil. Salt and pepper to taste. Makes 4 servings.

title: Apple Strudel Cake
instructions: Combine both sugars salt and flour until well blended. Then add oil eggs molasses and vanilla. Beat well. Add all spices and continue to beat for 2 minutes. Fold in apples. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Dust top of cake lightly with confectioners sugar.

title: Rice Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Place everything in a casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chili
instructions: Heat shortening in a skillet and brown beef. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or cook on high for 5 hours or cook on auto for 6 hours.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook potatoes and onions in 6 cups of water until done (soft). Add corn and half and half cream. Add butter. Serve hot with biscuits.

title: Snickers Pie
instructions: Melt marshmallows candy bars and milk in double boiler. Let cool for approximately 10 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip and vanilla. Fill crust with mixture; refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Ole Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Fry meat; remove fat. Add everything but noodles and simmer until well mixed. Then mix noodles and put in a 4-quart casserole dish and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jimmie Austin'S French Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Top with other crust; cut slits in top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with glaze.

title: Alice'S Pickled Asparagus Or Okra
instructions: Mix together the canning salt water and vinegar. Fill jars to 1/4-inch from top. Process 10 minutes in water bath. If a spicier taste is wanted add 1 to 2 hot peppers to each pint.

title: Theresa'S Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Combine vinegar sugar and oil. In saucepan heat until sugar is dissolved. Cut up onion. Put beans and onion in large bowl. Pour liquid over beans. Cover. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Seven Layer Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place ingredients in layers in 2-quart baking dish with tightly fitting cover.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Cream the cheese and 2 tablespoons butter until smooth. Add next 6 ingredients. Separate rolls into 4 rectangles. Put 1/2 cup meat mixture on each roll. Bring the 4 corners to top and twist. Brush top with 1 tablespoon butter. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 4 servings.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Put cheese on bottom of crust. Mix eggs cream and seasonings; pour on top. Sprinkle crushed bacon on top. Bake for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Add other ingredients. Cook 30 to 60 minutes. Sprinkle bowls of soup with Parmesan cheese. Serve with French or Italian bread.

title: Feather Bed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender; drain and mash. Add 2 teaspoons salt butter and eggs mixed with cream or evaporated milk. Whip until fluffy. Place in 3-quart baking dish. Whip cream until stiff. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and pour over potatoes. Top with grated cheese and brown in hot oven at 425\u00b0.

title: Curried-Yogurt Chicken
instructions: In small bowl beat orange juice yogurt soy sauce and honey with wire whisk until smooth. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Place chicken in small baking dish. Pour yogurt mixture over chicken; cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to overnight. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium skillet heat oil over medium heat; add garlic. Saute until lightly browned. Keep chicken in dish; spoon off yogurt mixture and add to garlic. Stir in curry paprika ginger cumin and cornstarch. Cook stirring until mixture thickens into a sauce about 10 minutes. Pour sauce over chicken in baking dish; sprinkle with raisins. Bake 30 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender. Serve over hot rice.

title: Turkey Supper Gravy
instructions: Melt margarine. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add other ingredients and cook over medium to low heat stirring constantly until thick and pasty color changes.

title: Airline Chocolate-Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine and brown sugar until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat until light and fluffy. Gradually add in flour soda and salt mixture. Stir in chocolate and nuts. Drop by tablespoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Let stand 2 minutes before removing from pan. Makes 3 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Mix together persimmons and soda. Let stand while creaming together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg vanilla lemon juice and brandy. Add persimmons and mix until blended. Sift flour measure and sift again. Add baking powder salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Gradually blend into creamed mixture. Add currants and nuts. Mix until just well blended. Drop a level tablespoon of dough 2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until brown. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Salmon Cheese Pate
instructions: Blend cheeses with salmon and seasonings until smooth. Mold into small bowl lined with plastic wrap. Chill several hours. Unmold to serve garnishing with sprigs of parsley. Serve with crackers toast rounds or thin rye bread.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Keep potatoes covered with water to keep potatoes from turning black. When ready to make the recipe drain potatoes thoroughly.

title: Putting On The Ritz
instructions: Stir and cook until it boils and thickens. Beat by hand a few strokes and put on Ritz crackers. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes and cool.

title: Robin'S Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese and peanut butter and beat until light and fluffy. Gradually add whipped topping and powdered sugar. Beat until smooth. Divide between crusts and freeze at least 8 hours before serving. Can be topped with shavings from chocolate candy bar.

title: Best Yet Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed on box in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Meanwhile simmer pineapple and sugar. Remove cake from oven. Punch holes in it with handle of wooden spoon and cover with pineapple mixture; chill. Mix instant pudding as directed on box. Add coconut. Spread the mixture over pineapple. Cover with whipped topping and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash with onion. Drain off water and mash squash. Beat eggs and add milk salt and pepper. Add cracker crumbs and sugar. Put in dish and bake 35 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Place grated cheese on top during last five minutes.

title: Baked German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Peel slice and place in a 2-quart greased casserole dish. Cook bacon until crisp. Reserve 1/4 cup drippings and set bacon aside. Add onions to drippings. Cook about 5 minutes. Add flour; cook 2 minutes. Whisk in water vinegar sugar mustard salt and pepper. Cook until thickened. Add bacon. Pour over potatoes and stir gently. Top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and paprika together. Add beaten egg yolks and milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Fry in deep hot fat until golden brown. Drain and serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Breakfast Casserole
