instructions: Mix eggs milk mustard and bread cubes. Stir in cheese and sausage. Pour into casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine ingredients with a wooden spoon until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Banana Delight Salad
instructions: Mix sour cream lemon juice salt sugar and pineapple in large bowl; stir well. Add pecans and bananas along with Cool Whip. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan or fill cupcake papers in muffin tins. Freeze.

title: Chicken Riganato
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper lemon juice oregano garlic and oil. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown (approximately 1 1/2 hours) basting frequently.

title: Seafood Salad With Mushrooms
instructions: Rub salad bowl with cut clove of garlic. Put all remaining ingredients into bowl. Toss.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put into 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Cover with cheese and chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Saturday Brunch
instructions: Options Add mushrooms onions and green peppers.

title: King Crab Paella
instructions: Thaw crab legs. In large skillet saute garlic and onion in oil. Push to one side of pan add chicken and brown well. Remove from pan. Crumble sausage\tinto pan and\tadd rice. Cook and stir over high heat until rice is lightly toasted. Return chicken to cooked mixture with seasonings and chicken broth. Bring to boil simmer covered for 20 minutes or until rice is tender. Carefully fold in crab tomato peas and pimiento. Simmer covered 15 minutes longer. Remove cover from skillet and cook until all moisture is absorbed. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Easy Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine Bisquick and milk in bowl; mix well. Add Cheez Whiz and sausage; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Drain. Yield 48 servings.

title: Chunky Chocolate Cookie Squares
instructions: Mix flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In a large bowl mix at medium speed the butter and sugar; beat until fluffy. Slowly beat in corn syrup then egg and vanilla. Beat in flour mixture until blended. Stir in pecans and half of the chocolate chunks and spread evenly in ungreased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining chocolate on top. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on rack. Cut into squares. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Southern Grits Casserole
instructions: Microwave the water on High until boiling in a 1 1/2 quart casserole or use\tthe conventional range to boil. Add grits butter salt and pepper to the water. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave at High 5 minutes stirring twice. Stir some of the hot grits into the beaten eggs. Stir in 1 cup of cheese and add egg-cheese mixture to grits. Stir well to mix. Microwave on High 5\tminutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn after 2 minutes. Sprinkle the reserved 1/2\tcup cheese on top of mixture. Cover. Microwave on High 2 minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand 3 to 4 minutes before serving. Serve hot. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Oven Roasted Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and then into 3 wedges per half. Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well. Bake in shallow baking pan for 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are light brown and tender turning occasionally. Serve potatoes hot. Makes 4 servings.

title: Frozen Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream together with mixer peanut butter and cream cheese. Add milk and sugar. Mix well. Add Cool Whip. Mix well. Pour in 3 graham cracker crusts. Freeze. Top with chocolate syrup or hot fudge or eat plain.

title: Paper Bag Apple Pie
instructions: Peel apples. Cut into chunks (should have 7 cups).

title: West Indies Salad
instructions: Place half the onion in mixing bowl. Arrange crabmeat over onion. Sprinkle with remaining onion. Blend remaining ingredients; pour over top. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Toss and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Swedish Apple Cake
instructions: Sift flour soda cinnamon and salt. Beat eggs add sugar oil and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Fold in chopped apples and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch greased pan for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 12 to 15. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Broccoli Delight(Even George Bush Would Try This Dish!)
instructions: Mix it well with love.

title: Spanish Rice And Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine garlic salt celery salt and paprika. Sprinkle over chicken. Bake uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove chicken from pan.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Peel cooked eggs and cut in quarters. Carefully scoop out. Mix yolks mayonnaise and relish. Fill quartered eggs with mixture.

title: Donna D'S Banana Cake
instructions: Mix in order. Sift together flour and baking soda. Mix and blend ingredients. Pour into buttered and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp And Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Irish Coffee
instructions: Whip the heavy cream with 4 teaspoons of sugar and vanilla. Keep chilled. Make full strength coffee and pour into 6 Irish coffee mugs. Fill each cup to within one inch of the top. Add 1 teaspoon sugar and stir. Into each mug pour 1 jigger of Irish whiskey. Then add 3 tablespoons of whipped cream and serve.

title: North Carolina Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Saute hamburger and onion; drain. Place back in deep skillet or heavy 2-quart pot. Add tomato sauce water chili powder vinegar salt and pepper. Cook on low heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Add small amounts of water to prevent sticking. Cook until most of liquid has evaporated. Serve on hot dogs and rolls with slaw mustard and onion.

title: Pecan Pie(Heritage Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Beat sugar eggs oleo and vanilla together. Add the eggs one at a time. Add the syrup and beat well. Stir in chopped pecans.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Dip tomato slices in flour; coat well. Dip into egg then into breadcrumbs mixed with salt and pepper. Refrigerate 1/2 hour or more. Fry in 1/2-inch oil at 375\u00b0 in electric skillet until brown.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil zucchini for 3 minutes in salt water. Drain. Add cream of chicken soup. Mix dressing (spice and all) with butter in an 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Layer 1/2 dressing mix cream of mushroom soup and rest of dressing. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes a large dish.

title: Potluck Ambrosia
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients. Stir gently until well blended. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Chicken Kiev With Mushrooms
instructions: Bone chicken breasts and cut in half down center. Flatten each fillet by pounding gently with cleaver. Be very careful not to break the fillet. Next place a 1-inch slice of chilled butter (2 inches long) in the center of each fillet. Sprinkle with salt pepper and the minced mushrooms and minced parsley. Roll up and tuck in the ends so that butter is well enclosed. Dip the rolled chicken fillets into a beaten egg and roll in bread crumbs. Fry in oil and butter for 5 minutes browning it on all sides. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Hamburger Barley Vegetable Soup
instructions: In 5-quart Dutch oven brown ground beef. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until vegetables and barley are tender. Remove bay leaves. Makes 10 (1 1/2-cup) servings.

title: Red Roasted Pepper Dip
instructions: Drain peppers rinse and dry in colander. Puree in a blender. Combine with other ingredients and blend until smooth.

title: Freddie'S Fruit Dessert
instructions: Put sliced peaches with juice in a large oblong Pyrex. Spread crushed pineapple with juice over peaches. Sprinkle sugar over pineapple. Sprinkle yellow cake mix over pineapple. Cut slices of oleo and place on top of cake mix. Sprinkle coconut on oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Beat together the orange juice butter egg and sugar. Add the walnuts and cranberries. Sift together the flour salt and baking soda. Add this to the batter. Spoon into a buttered loaf pan (9 x 5-inch). Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Potato, Corn Stew
instructions: Cut potatoes up like fries. Add salt and pepper and cut up onion. Cook potatoes and onion in Crisco until done. Add cream-style corn. Cook about 5 minutes. Add Cheddar cheese then cover. When cheese melts its ready to serve.

title: Potato Skins (Appetizer)
instructions: Mix all spices well. Put into a salt shaker.

title: Cabbage Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Make into balls. Brown in large skillet. Drain off excess grease. Add soup and water. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Garden Salad Pizza
instructions: Roll out crescent rolls and press into pizza pan sprayed with low-fat cooking spray. Cook until golden brown at temperature on roll can. Mix cream cheese and dill weed; spread over cooled crust. Top with remaining ingredients. Sprinkle top with lemon pepper. Refrigerate.

title: Shower Punch
instructions: Add 7-Up and sherbet together in a punch bowl. Let stand for 10 minutes. Stir and serve.

title: Breakfast Before
instructions: Saute sausage. Drain all the grease off beat eggs with milk salt and mustard. Layer the cubes of bread sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour liquid mixture on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serve with fresh fruit and English muffins. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Bryson
instructions: Cut chicken into small bite size cubes. Fry in 2 tablespoons butter or margarine. When cooked remove from pan and drain any fluid. Place on pan on medium-high and melt butter. Add flour to make paste then add milk cheese and mustard. As mixture boils it will thicken. If not add 1 to 2 more tablespoons flour. Add chicken. Best served over brown rice.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine jello and boiling water. Stir with rubber spatula until jello is completely dissolved. Cool. Add bananas pecans strawberries and pineapple to jello; stir to combine. Divide in half. Pour half the jello mixture into 12 x 8-inch pan; refrigerate until set. Keep remaining jello at room temperature. Spread sour cream evenly over set jello in pan. Pour on remaining jello. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Missouri Cookies(No Cook)
instructions: Mix and boil the sugar cocoa margarine and milk for 3 1/2 minutes over medium heat; bring to a full boil. Remove quickly and add the oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. Drop by spoonful onto wax paper and cool. Makes 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

title: George Washington Chicken
instructions: Pound chicken breasts until flat; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Sprinkle each with 1/2 teaspoon parsley 1 1/2 teaspoons butter and 1 teaspoon cheese. Roll up and secure with toothpicks. Dip rolls in milk and roll on coating mix. Place in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes; drain. Combine soup and broth. Pour over chicken; bake 30 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Spaghetti Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half and de-seed. Put 1/2 cup water on a baking sheet. Place squash skin side up on baking sheet and cook 20 minutes at 300\u00b0 or until soft. Scrape or grate like spaghetti. Top with spaghetti sauce and serve.

title: Shelly'S Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken breasts with carrots celery and onion. Drain of all liquid and vegetables. Place chicken in a pan and put in freezer. Cut grapes in half. Mince up nuts. Mix in a separate bowl the mayonnaise poppy seed and honey. Cut up almost frozen chicken into chunks. Combine everything in a bowl; salt and pepper to taste. Chill for at least two hours. Serve.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together cornmeal flour baking powder and salt. In another bowl combine egg milk and cracklins. Combine with dry ingredients. Beat well and pour into a greased pan or skillet. Bake in a moderate oven until done and brown on top. Aint nuthin better with a big pot of red beans.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown beef; add next 5 ingredients and simmer covered for 30 minutes. Cook lasagne noodles. Whip the cream cheese sour cream and onions together. In a greased dish (13 x 9-inch) put a layer of lasagne noodles to cover bottom then spread half of cream cheese mixture on noodles then half of meat mixture on top of cream cheese mixture; repeat once. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes; let set up about 30 minutes before cutting.

title: Sourdough Starter
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Let set for 3 hours.

title: Dora'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Add enough flour to make stiff enough to roll. Chill overnight. Roll real thin. Cut out with desired shapes. Bake 400\u00b0 for 8-10 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: In 10-inch skillet cook ground meat; add chopped onion and cook until done. Drain off excess grease. Mash pork and beans in bowl and set aside. To the ground meat and onion add taco sauce and cook 10 minutes. Add pork and beans and cook until dry. Pour mixture into glass 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Add sour cream over entire mixture. Spread thick and chunky salsa over sour cream and make all even. Put both packages cheese over this. Bake in oven for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheesy Onion Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Spread on one side of tortillas and roll up tightly. Wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Slice into 1 inch pieces. Serve with picante sauce. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese until softened in 2-quart mixing bowl. Add lemon juice and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into pie crust evenly. Add cherry topping. Refrigerate for 2 hours before serving. Makes 5 servings.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except soup. Roll into balls (about golf ball size). Roll balls in flour and brown in a greased skillet. Place in a baking dish and cover with the soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef Oriental(Leftovers)
instructions: Combine beef and broth in a large skillet; simmer about 2 minutes. Add celery onion and soy sauce; cook covered about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and pea pods. Combine water and cornstarch; add to meat mixture and toss gently. Cook until thickened. Serve over rice. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Aunt Mozelle'S Chess Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and vinegar. Beat eggs. Add to mixture. Bake mixture 30 minutes or until firm in the middle of a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix sugar oleo Karo and salt. Bring to boil and boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla and soda. Pour over corn and peanuts. Bake 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Stir occasionally. When cool store in tight containers.

title: Crab Fettuccini
instructions: Cook fettuccini and drain. Lightly brown garlic in butter. Add half n half crab and pepper. Heat 3 minutes or just until bubbly stirring occasionally. Add Parmesan cheese and stir one minute. Remove from heat and toss.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Sift flour and sugar together in bowl. Mix butter cocoa and Coca-Cola together in saucepan; bring to a rapid boil and pour over dry ingredients. Dissolve soda in buttermilk; add with remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour in well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cover top with marshmallows and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Rich N' Creamy Hot Chocolate
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan melt chocolate chips over low heat stirring constantly. Stir in sugar water and salt. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly with wire whisk until mixture comes to full boil (4 to 5 minutes). Boil stirring constantly 2 minutes. Stir in milk and whipping cream. Continue cooking over medium heat stirring occasionally until heated through (12 to 15 minutes). DO NOT BOIL. Add vanilla. Beat with wire whisk or rotary beater until frothy. Pour into mugs. If desired add 1 to 2 tablespoons liqueur to each serving. Top each serving with a dollop of sweetened whipped cream. If desired garnish with one of the following grated chocolate grated lemon peel grated orange peel cinnamon or nutmeg. Makes 8 cups.

title: Fruit Cocktail Dee-Lite
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Then fold in Cool Whip. Chill for about 2 hours before serving.

title: Vegie Bar
instructions: *Broccoli cucumber zucchini cauliflower carrots celery and radishes purple onions bell pepper yellow squash and Roma tomatoes are best.

title: Waffles
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. A tablespoon of sugar may be added if desired. Add yolks of eggs and sweet milk. Beat until smooth. Add melted butter or other shortening. Beat egg whites separately and fold in.

title: Mulled Cider
instructions: Combine all ingredients; simmer for 3 minutes. Add few drops of lemon extract. Serve hot with slight dash of nutmeg.

title: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugars. Add peanut butter and eggs. Add half of flour mixed with soda. Mix well. Add vanilla and mix in rest of flour by hand. Add chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Traders Punch
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and pour over block of ice to chill. Just before serving pour ginger ale down side of bowl. Add fruit. Makes 4 quarts.

title: Carrot Raisin Salad
instructions: Place carrots and raisins in a bowl. In another bowl mix together salad dressing sugar and enough milk to reach a salad dressing consistency. Pour over carrot mixture and toss to coat. Yield 8 servings.

title: Molasses Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients; cook until thickened (thicken with cornstarch). Pour into unbaked pie shell. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt in heavy saucepan until smooth. Add milk. Mix well. Beat egg yolks; strain and add to mixture. Add butter; cook until thick (stirring constantly with wooden spoon). Remove from heat; add vanilla and 1/2 of coconut. Mix. Pour into baked pie shells. Sprinkle with rest of coconut on top of meringue and slowly brown.

title: Million Dollar Cookies
instructions: Combine ingredients. Roll in balls (size of walnuts). Dip in sugar. Put on cookie sheet sugar side up. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Fruit 'N Nut Salad
instructions: On salad plates arrange salad greens chicken apple and grapes. Drizzle with dressing. Garnish with walnuts. Excellent with fat-free honey Dijon dressing. Makes 2 servings.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: In large baking pan mix sugar flour milk and butter. Cover mixture with blueberries. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven until crust rises to top and is good and brown (about 30 minutes).

title: Venison Steaks
instructions: Place enough oil in black iron skillet to cover bottom. Brown 1 medium onion. Add steak. Cook 5 minutes each side. Add 1 can mushrooms. Simmer approximately 8 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately with egg noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Fish Baked In An Herb Crust
instructions: Rub fish all over with 1 teaspoon olive oil. Set aside 5 minutes to marinate. Place peppers and remaining 1 teaspoon oil in large nonstick pan over medium heat. Saute for 5 minutes. Add stock and tomatoes. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables soften. Transfer to blender or food processor and puree. Mixture should lightly coat back of spoon. Keep warm. Chop basil; add bread crumbs. Dredge the fish in the crumb mixture to coat both sides. Press firmly so mixture adheres. Sear fish for 3 minutes on each side. Transfer to baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 4 minutes on each side or until crispy. Serve with tomato mixture.

title: Fisherman'S Soup(Fast And Easy)
instructions: *Any type of fish can be substituted

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored. Blend in condensed milk slowly. Add lime juice and mix well. Add cream of tartar to egg whites and beat until foamy. Continue beating adding sugar 1 tablespoon at a time until egg whites peak. Fold 6 tablespoons of the meringue into the filling mixture.

title: Corned Beef Dinner
instructions: Place corned beef in Dutch oven; barely cover with hot water. Add onions garlic and seasonings. Cover; simmer about 1 hour per pound of meat or until fork-tender.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Roll into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 on a cookie sheet until brown.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute pepper celery onions and tops in margarine in a skillet. Add tomato sauce and chopped chicken. Simmer in a large container 1 hour with the broth. Cook spaghetti; drain. Add spaghetti to chicken mixture along with 1 can mushroom soup and 3/4 pound grated Longhorn cheese. Bake in a buttered casserole dish for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Cream together the first 3 ingredients; add milk. Mix together the next 3 ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Fold in blueberries. Grease or spray muffin tins with Pam. Fill muffin tins to top and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bake
instructions: Lightly spray a 9 x 13 baking dish. Lay in the broccoli spears and cover with the chicken. Combine the mushroom soup and the sour cream and pour over the chicken. Cover and bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Prepare a topping of bread crumbs parmesan cheese and slivered almonds and sprinkle over the top. Return to the oven uncovered and bake 25 additional minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken. Mix chicken soup sour cream and poppy seed in casserole dish. Crumble Ritz crackers and put on top. Melt stick butter and pour on top of crackers. Cook on 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Carrot Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and oil; blend thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Mix flour baking powder soda and salt together; add to egg mixture. Stir in carrots and nuts. Spread batter in 2 greased 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Recipe For Happiness
instructions: Mix with a dash of tenderness faith hope and charity. Add a generous pinch of sympathy sprinkled with ability to laugh at little things. Add thoughtfulness and kindness. Bake in warmth and all your friends will beg for your recipe.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Combine corn egg sugar salt pepper and butter. Mix and sift flour and baking powder. Add to first mixture. Mix well. Drop batter from spoon into little fat in hot frying pan and brown on both sides. Serves 6.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients adding flour last. Mix all together. Let rise until doubled. Punch down. Knead. Shape into rolls. Let rise again in pans that have been well-greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; put into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Put onion salt and pepper on top of the meat. Mix soups and milk. Pour over meat and onion. Place Tater Tots on top. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage in small amount of water until crisp not tender. Cook bacon and reserve drippings. Starting with cabbage layer cabbage green pepper bacon and cheese. Pour White Sauce over layers and top with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in large saucepan. Add 1 teaspoon salt. Stir in 10 cups water and cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Add lemon juice and food coloring. Pack apples into hot jars leaving 1-inch headspace. Add hot syrup to 1/2-inch from top. Use spatula to help distribute syrup. Adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath (pints for 15 minutes and quarts for 20 minutes). Use 1 quart apple filling in pie crust. Add top crust. Cut slits (so steam can escape) and seal edges. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Mud Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease round pan (8 x 1 1/2-inches) or 8 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate with shortening. Mix granulated sugar butter vanilla salt eggs flour and cocoa in a medium bowl with a wooden spoon; stir in nuts. Pour into pan. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken remove from bones and cut in bite-size pieces. Cook onion in oleo until tender and mix with dressing. Spread half of dressing in baking dish. Spread layer of chicken. Mix both cans of soup and broth. Pour over chicken. Spread remaining dressing over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water; cool and add the rest of the ingredients. Put in refrigerator to set.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles.\tCombine soup milk mayo celery onion and salt. Mix\twell. Stir in cheese shrimp and noodles. Pour into casserole. Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Heat margarine over low heat until melted. Blend in flour onion salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in chicken and vegetables; set aside. Prepare Celery Seed Pastry. Line a 13-inch square pan with 2/3 of the pastry that has been rolled out. Pour filling into the pastry lined pan. Roll out remainder of the dough and place over the filling. Flute edges; cut slits in center. Cook uncovered in 425\u00b0 oven until crust is brown 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pistachio Delite Dessert
instructions: Pour pineapple and juice into bowl. Add the pudding and with a mixer at lowest speed beat until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. Fold in whipped topping and nuts. Spoon into dessert dishes. Pudding will be soft-set and ready to eat in 5 minutes. Store in refrigerator.

title: Oysters
instructions: Mix together spinach oysters onions and Tabasco and put into casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs butter and Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Scald milk. Gradually add the box of vanilla pudding. Then add 2 1/4 cups sugar. Cook until thick. Beat eggs real good. Add 1 cup sugar to eggs. Add egg mixture gradually to the cooked mixture and cook another 20 minutes. Add Carnation Milk. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour into ice cream freezer. Yields 5-6 quarts of ice cream.

title: Coconut Chews
instructions: *Self-rising flour can be used.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil sugar water and cornstarch. Cook until thickened. Add Jell-O. Cool. Pour over berries and put into a baked pie shell. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Calzones With Sun Dried Tomatoes And Sausage
instructions: Oil cookie sheet or pizza pan. With rolling pin roll pizza dough on floured board as thick as pizza. Arrange sausage and dried tomatoes over dough. Top with basil cheese and olive oil (no salt). Fold dough to form a pocket (log). Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 3/4 hour.

title: Lemon Cheese Bars
instructions: Mix together cake mix egg and oil until crumbly. Save 1 cup. Put remaining mixture in oblong pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Beat together cream cheese sugar lemon juice and 1 egg until smooth. Spread over baked layer. Sprinkle with 1 cup crumb mix. Bake 15 minutes. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Macaroni Saute
instructions: Saute raw macaroni onion green pepper and garlic in hot cooking oil just until macaroni turns slightly yellow. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. May need to add more water.

title: Delicious Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat together until very creamy. Refrigerate. Delicious with cantaloupe honeydew grapes pineapple strawberries etc.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given. Drop by teaspoons on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Butter baking dish 9 x 13-inch. Place chicken in dish. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Mix cracker crumbs and poppy seed. Pour over mixture. Melt margarine and pour over crumbs. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbling on top.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 6-quart bowl. Chill. Serve over ice. Makes approximately 30 (4-ounce) cups.

title: Chocolate Praline Torte
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Sprinkle about 3/4 cup of walnut mixture in each of 4 ungreased 9-inch round cake pans pressing lightly into pans. Prepare cake mix according to package directions; pour batter over walnut mixture in prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove layers from pans immediately and let cool completely.

title: Santa Fe Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer for 2 hours. Serve topped with cheese and sour cream.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Mix oil sugar brown sugar and vanilla. Add eggs and beat then add flour mixture. Add 2 cups oatmeal and chocolate chips. The batter will be crumbly. Drop on greased cookie sheets and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or spread on a large greased jelly roll pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples sugar and soda. Let stand 30 minutes stirring several times. Add oil and eggs; stir in flour salt and cinnamon. Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch tube pan. Pour the following over the cake before baking Melt margarine; stir in brown sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Barberton Coleslaw
instructions: Shred cabbage; you should have about 8 cups. Combine vinegar oil and sugar and whisk until sugar has dissolved. Pour dressing over cabbage and season with salt. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Light Dilled Potato Salad
instructions: Put potatoes in a large bowl; sprinkle with olive oil and vinegar tossing lightly to coat. Mix mayonnaise yogurt mustard salt and pepper in a bowl; stir in onion and dill. Pour over the potatoes; toss to coat. Cover and chill. Best if prepared a day or two before serving. This always gets rave reviews!!

title: Mrs. Harry V. Hand Pralines
instructions: Boil all ingredients except vanilla gently for about 8 minutes. Remove from heat. Add a lump of butter (about the size of a walnut) and the vanilla. Beat with a wooden spoon until candy loses its gloss. Drop quickly by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Betty Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add remaining ingredients. Mix together; simmer and cook 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Skillet
instructions: Slice green pepper and onion thin. Saute in oil until soft. Slice zucchini and chop tomatoes. Mix all ingredients (cornstarch and water will thicken mixture). Simmer for about 10 minutes. Put in baking dish and sprinkle cheese on top. Broil to melt cheese.

title: Dungeness Crab And Basil Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: In a medium bowl combine cheese bread crumbs green onions and basil. In a separate smaller bowl combine the Tabasco sauce wine lemon juice garlic and egg and add to the bread crumb mixture. Without breaking up the crab too much add the crab meat to the bread crumb mixture and mix until well blended. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook pie shell. Fill with raw berries (about 1 quart). Cook sugar 7-Up cornstarch salt and red food coloring. Pour over berries (warm). Set in refrigerator. Cover with whipped cream and serve.

title: Frittata
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet saute over medium heat all ingredients but eggs and cream until tender (about 8 minutes). Remove from heat. Beat eggs and cream in a bowl. Put skillet back on heat. Pour egg mixture over vegetables. Do not stir. Cook until eggs are softly set. Cover the mixture until the top sets. Salt and pepper to taste. Can add Parmesan cheese for added touch. Can also add imitation crab meat for special touch.

title: That All-Time Favorite Pecan Pie
instructions: In 1 1/2-pint bowl mix sugar flour and salt. Stir in corn syrup. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in milk pecans and vanilla.

title: Scotcheroos
instructions: Two cups sugar one cup butter three eggs one cup of sour cream one-half teaspoonful soda; flavor with lemon or vanilla extract. Flour enough to roll out not stiff. Three teaspoonfuls baking powder.

title: Okra And Tomatoes
instructions: Fry bacon and save to crumble into mix later. Fry okra and onions in bacon drippings on medium heat until okra quits stringing. Add tomatoes salt pepper and garlic. Cook until liquid has reduced. Add crumbled bacon. Stir and serve. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Chili-Cheese Rounds
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix beans onion and pepper sauce; set aside. Mix baking mix and sour cream until soft dough forms; beat 20 strokes. Gently smooth dough into ball on floured board. Knead 20 times. Roll dough 1/2 inch thick. Cut with floured 2-inch cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press an indentation about 1 1/4 inches in diameter in center of each round with floured hands. Fill each with generous teaspoonful of bean mixture. Spread within indentation. Top with chilies and cheese. Bake until brown about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Will keep in refrigerator for several days.

title: Scotch Crispies
instructions: Melt over hot (not boiling) water the butterscotch morsels and peanut butter. Stir until morsels melt and mixture is smooth. Transfer butterscotch mixture to large bowl. Add rice cereal; mix well. Press mixture into aluminum foil lined 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill in refrigerator until firm (about 1 hour). Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Makes 48 (1 1/2-inch) squares.

title: Saltless Salt
instructions: Whats a super way to add zip to salads meat poultry and vegetables? Mix your own blend of saltless seasoning! To make saltless salt combine ingredients cover tightly and store in a cool dry place. \Saltless salt\ is a great way to keep tabs on sodium consumption.

title: Luscious Baked Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine margarine crumbs and sugar. Press on bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. In a large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 1 hour and 5 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Cool to room temperature. Chill thoroughly. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Carrot-Nut Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil until well blended. Add eggs. Sift dry ingredients. Combine with creamed mixture and beat well. Stir in carrots and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. When completely cooled frost.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Boiled Dinner
instructions: Place ham quarters and juice from package around the bottom of a large kettle with about 2 inches from each piece sticking up from the side.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix everything together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Senora
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Mix in bowl onion soups salsa chili  milk and Tabasco. Slice tortillas into small squares and shred cheese. Layer in greased baking dish chicken 1/2 of tortillas 1/2 sauce 1/2 cheese and repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. Makes 1 large casserole or 2 smaller. Can be frozen and baked later.

title: Corn Bread You Will Like
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix cornmeal flour sugar baking powder and salt. In another bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Add all this to cornmeal mixture. Pour into greased baking pan (13 x 9-inch). Bake at 425\u00b0 about 30 or 35 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Zucchini Bread(Don'T Tell The Kids It'S A Vegetable)
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Then add other ingredients. Pour into greased and floured pan. (I use a Bundt pan for a different look.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool before removing from pan.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix apples sugar flour milk and spices together until well blended. Place mixture in bottom crust. Cut butter in little pieces and place over top. Place strips or pie crust over top. Fasten securely at edges. You may sprinkle tiny bit of sugar over top and little dots of butter then sprinkle a little cinnamon on top. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes. When done and still hot cut a piece and put one scoop of vanilla ice cream on top then ready to eat. Enjoy it; worry about your weight later.

title: Chicken Piquant
instructions: Place sliced mushrooms in bottom of a casserole. Top with chicken pieces. Mix all other ingredients and pour over the chicken. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with wild rice French-style green beans with almonds and tossed green salad. Serves 4.

title: Country Fair Baked Beans
instructions: In 1-quart casserole combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

title: Champagne Raspberry Punch
instructions: Mix all together in a large punch bowl. Enjoy!!!

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Dream Whip. Top with Dream Whip or Cool Whip.

title: Pecan Puffs
instructions: Beat the butter until soft. Add the sugar and blend until creamy. Add vanilla. Stir the pecans and flour into butter mixture. Roll the dough into small balls. Place them in a 300\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Roll puffs while they are hot in confectioners sugar. When they are cool roll them again in confectioners sugar.

title: Aunt Mable'S Mints
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Add all together. Add more sugar if needed to make it right to roll out. Cut in your choice of shapes.

title: Triple Treats
instructions: Over hot (not boiling) water melt chips and shortening until smooth. Remove from heat and pour half of mixture in foil-lined 8-inch square pan spread evenly. Refrigerate until firm (about 15 minutes). Return chocolate to hot water. Over boiling water melt caramels butter and water. Stir until smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour over chocolate in pan. Spread evenly. Refrigerate until tacky (15 minutes). Top with remaining chocolate; spread evenly. Return to refrigerator until firm (about 1 hour). Cut and refrigerate until ready to serve. These taste like Snickers Bars.

title: Roast Pork Tenderloins
instructions: Make a marinade of all ingredients except meat and bacon. Tie the tenderloins to form the meat in as even thickness as possible. If one tenderloin is large enough to be used alone then fold over this end. If using 2 small tenderloins tie them together. Pour marinade over meat cover and refrigerate overnight turning several times. When ready to cook drain marinade and reserve. Wrap meat with bacon securing with toothpicks. Place in pan on rack; pour marinade over. Roast at 300\u00b0 uncovered for 1 3/4 hours. Baste every 15 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Best Bran Muffins(Makes 1 Dozen)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine bran cereal and milk in mixing bowl. Let stand 2 minutes or until most of the moisture is absorbed. Add egg substitute and margarine. Beat until well blended. Sift together the flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add the dry ingredients to cereal mixture and stir just until all are moistened. Spoon batter into oiled muffin cups (3/4 full) and bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into the 2 crusts. Chill for 15 minutes in freezer.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and put into a baking dish.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and combine with onions. Mix remaining ingredients and toss with vegetables. Cover. Marinate several hours or overnight. Drain before serving. Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix and set aside.

title: Big Batch Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugars; add eggs and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Sift together flour salt and soda; stir into mixture. Add chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yields 8 dozen.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add frozen strawberries and break apart with a fork until they melt. Add pineapple and banana. Pour half of jello mixture in a long baking dish. Chill until firm; spread with sour cream. Spoon remaining jello over sour cream and chill until firm; cut into squares and serve.

title: Salmon-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti drain and set aside. Prepare Alfredo sauce as indicated on package (add half cup of additional milk). Add noodles back to sauce and mix together. In baking dish put salmon and broccoli; mix in noodle mixture. Sprinkle parsley on top to garnish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Jiffy Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Grease 7 x 10-inch pan. Place the raw rhubarb in pan. Sprinkle with sugar then dry gelatin then dry cake mix. Gently pour the cup of water over all and dribble butter over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Slow Cooker Vegetable Soup
instructions: Set slow cooker to low setting. Add the meat corn green beans carrots potatoes tomatoes soup mix and salt and pepper to taste to the slow cooker and stir together. Cook on low for at least 6 hours. Add water if necessary.

title: Pam'S Icebox Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine peanut butter sugar and cream cheese. Mix in Cool Whip; beat with mixer until nice and smooth. Place in frozen crust and freeze.

title: Cream Cheese And Crab Dip
instructions: Combine and bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serve hot with party crackers.

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
instructions: Mix sugar egg and cream cheese. Mix chocolate chips into the mixture. Preheat oven as cake directs. Mix cake as directed and spoon into cupcake tins until half full each. Spoon 1 tablespoon of cream cheese mixture onto cupcakes and bake as cake directs for cupcakes. Do not frost!

title: Western Burritos(Ten Minutes)
instructions: In skillet on medium heat cook and stir eggs until almost done to your liking. Add cheese and onion. Gently stir and cook 1 minute. Remove to plate. Quickly heat tortilla on dry skillet. Spread egg mixture on tortilla. Spoon barbecue over and fold up burrito style.

title: Fran'S Mini-Cheesecakes
instructions: Line muffin tin with foil liners. Place one vanilla wafer in each liner. Mix cream cheese vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs. Mix well. Pour over wafers filling 3/4 full. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from pan when cool. Chill. Top with fruit preserves nuts or chocolate. Be creative! Makes 12.

title: Heavenly Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix in order. Pour in round mold or flat pan and freeze. Keeps well.

title: Christmas Eve Punch
instructions: Combine first six ingredients and chill or freeze until slushy.

title: Sausage Primavera(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Slice and brown sausage. In separate pan combine sausage and 1 cup heavy cream. Simmer. Serve with Parmesan cheese and parsley over cooked fettucini. (Add salt and pepper if desired.)

title: Quiche
instructions: Combine eggs cheese and milk; mix. Combine rest of the ingredients. Add a dash of salt and pepper. Top with parsley sprinkles. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until crust is brown and custard is set. Cool before serving. Serve warm.

title: Cranberry Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Take 3/4 cup of stuffing and form into a ball using your hands. Wrap one piece of chicken around it as far as it will go. Place in casserole dish and repeat with rest of chicken. Melt butter and mix with the cranberry sauce until smooth. Pour sauce over chicken and stuffing until even. Bake 30 minutes or until the chicken is white all the way through.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package drain and rinse. Cook onion and mushrooms in butter until soft. Blend in flour; add hot milk and stir until thickened. Add sherry. Fold in cheese reserving about 3 tablespoons for the top. Add noodles chicken and ham. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: My Friend Jean'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and place in refrigerator for several hours so flavors can blend.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain and quarter artichokes. Mix ingredients together until well blended and place in a small casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until mixture bubbles.

title: Fig Muffins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Combine flour baking powder and spices. Add to creamed mixture alternating with milk stirring lightly. Add preserves and nuts; stir to blend well.

title: Squash Squares
instructions: Mix well and bake in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Greek Rice And Spinach
instructions: Cook covered for 1/2 hour stirring 3 to 4 times. Serve.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all together except for French fried onions. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take out and sprinkle onions on top. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Spread
instructions: Add butter and coffee to powdered sugar to a thick spread consistency. Add raisins and walnuts. Spread on graham crackers.

title: Six Layer Dinner
instructions: In order given layer ingredients in greased 2-quart casserole. Season each layer with salt and pepper. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs; add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Pour into a greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden (35 to 45 minutes). Makes a 9 x 13-inch casserole or can bake in an 11 x 17 x 1-inch pan for hors doeuvres. Can be made ahead and reheated. Good with sweet breads and fruit. Serves 10.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Do not beat with a mixer. Stir with a spoon. Freeze.

title: Crescent Roll Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Company Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine nuts and fruit with vinegar; let stand. Cream together butter and sugar; add eggs vanilla and spices beat well.\tStir in nut and fruit mixture into batter. Turn into an unbaked pie shell bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: In mixer combine cream cheese and powdered sugar until well blended. Then add Cool Whip. Add well drained pineapple. Mix until well blended. Pour mixture into pie crust. Cover and store in freezer or refrigerator.

title: Hobo Dinner
instructions: Make 4 large hamburger steak size patties. Place on foil (large sheet of foil enough to cover and seal each separate patty and vegetables). Peel and slice onions bell pepper and potatoes into thin slices or rings and place on each hamburger patty. Salt pepper and Lea & Perrins each packet to your taste. Seal and cook in 350 degree oven for about 45 minutes to an hour until done.

title: Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with peel on. Peel and dice potatoes; salt to taste. Fry bacon crisp; break into pieces. Peel and dice onions. Add bacon and onions to potatoes. Heat cheese and mayonnaise until cheese is melted and mixture is smooth. Pour cheese mixture over potatoes. Put in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Escallop Potatoes
instructions: Cook ground meat in large skillet until brown; drain. Add meat and chicken soup to potatoes. Place in greased casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 until potatoes are done.

title: Go Chicken In Puff Pastry
instructions: Saute chicken garlic and butter until chicken starts to brown; drain. Save butter; set aside.

title: Skyline Chili Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese onions and chili peppers together and put on the bottom of a baking dish. Mix chili with a dash of hot pepper and Mozzarella and Provolone cheese. Place this on top of the cheese mixture. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add Cheddar cheese on top. Serve with nachos corn chips and etc.

title: Old Fashion Brownies
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar; add melted margarine and vanilla. Sift together flour cocoa and salt; add to sugar-egg mixture. Add nuts. Bake in lightly greased 13 x 5 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with the following frosting while still warm.

title: Glazed Ham
instructions: Bake ham according to label directions. Meanwhile combine next 3 ingredients in saucepan. Heat slowly; add cornstarch and water until thickened. Thirty minutes before ham is done remove from oven. Score surface; spoon on glaze. Continue basting with glaze during last 30 minutes of baking.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Break sausage in pieces and brown with celery and onion. In bottom of casserole place uncooked rice and chicken noodle soup mix. Add sausage mixture and hot water. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Stir all ingredients together saving a sprinkling of Parmesan cheese for top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Very good served with Triscuits crackers.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Mix shortening with 1 cup sugar. Stir in egg (beaten). Add milk. Sift flour with baking powder and salt and add to mixture. Stir well and add vanilla. Mix berries (washed and well drained) with 1/3 cup sugar and a little flour. Stir carefully and add to cake mixture. Mix all well and pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan (greased). Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cake tester comes clean. When cake is cool sprinkle top with confectioners sugar or use thin coat of icing.

title: Krispy Walnut Chews
instructions: Mix butter sugar and flour and press in bottom of pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 300\u00b0. Beat eggs and add remaining ingredients. Spread on top of first part. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cut in squares.

title: Peanut Butter 'N Fudge Filled Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl beat brown sugar butter and 1/4 cup peanut butter until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. Add combined flour baking soda and salt. Beat until well mixed. Stir in oats; mix well. Reserve 1 cup oat mixture; set aside. Spread remaining oat mixture evenly onto prepared pan.

title: Boston Cream Pie
instructions: Cream shortening sugar eggs and vanilla in a large mixer bowl. Combine flour baking powder and salt; add alternately with milk to creamed mixture. Pour batter into one greased and floured 9 inch layer pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes remove from pan. Cool completely. Prepare cream filling. Slice cake horizontally into two thin layers. Spread filling on one layer; top with remaining layer. Prepare Chocolate Glaze. Pour onto top of cake allowing some to drizzle down the sides. Chill before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In double boiler over simmering water melt chocolate peanut butter and butter. Set aside to cool. Beat together eggs sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Beat in the chocolate mixture. Stir in flour salt and sour cream. Pour batter into a greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Bake for 30 minutes and cool.

title: Party Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread. Stir until well blended. Hollow out middle of bread. Fill with dip. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated through (about 15 minutes). Serve while warm with crackers or tortilla chips. This is a great party dip because the serving container (round bread) is so unique and is also edible.

title: Elvis Presley Cake
instructions: Make cake according to box directions. Mix pineapple with juice and sugar. Bring this mixture to a boil for 3 minutes. While the cake is still very warm take the end of a wooden spoon and punch lots of holes in the cake. Pour pineapple mixture over the cake. Refrigerate until cool.

title: Gold Rush Punch
instructions: Combine sugar fruit juices and water in pitcher. Stir until sugar dissolves and chill. Just before serving pour in club soda. Garnish with mint leaves and cherries if desired. Makes about 10 servings.

title: Toffee Dessert
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and oleo. Mix well. Place 2/3 crumb mixture in 9x13 pan.

title: Vegetable Stew
instructions: Heat margarine in a 4-quart Dutch oven. Add mushrooms onion and garlic. Saute until golden. Carefully add 3 cups water. Stir in carrots potatoes garbanzos oregano cumin and salt. Cover and cook gently until potatoes are just tender. Gradually stir remaining 1/2 cup water into flour. Stir into stew. Cook until thickened. Fold in pepper and peas. Cook gently 5 minutes.

title: Master Mix
instructions: Mix well and store in an airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Kay Crum'S Punch
instructions: Mix Jell-O with boiling water. Dissolve. Add sugar (I think Kay used more sugar but 3 cups is sweet). Add cold water pineapple juice and lemonade. Freeze in gallon or 1/2 gallon plastic milk jugs.

title: Caramel Chews
instructions: Melt caramels with milk over low heat. Pour over remaining ingredients and mix until well blended. Shape into small balls. Chill in refrigerator. (Use butter on hands to make balls.)

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Combine sugar vegetable oil and buttermilk; stir enough flour to make a soft dough. Place dough on lightly floured surface. Knead 1 to 2 minutes or until smooth and elastic. Roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with floured 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place a bat of butter in center and fold roll in half. Place rolls on heavily greased baking sheet; cover and let rise until double in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Drop Cookies Beat first 6 ingredients until creamy. Mix in flour. Stir in chips. Drop onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Allow pie crust to cool. Wash and stem and sort berries. Leave whole unless very large. Cut large berries only in half. Over medium heat combine water sugar and cornstarch. Cook until clear and thick stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in jello powder. Let this mixture cool to tepid heat. Arrange berries evenly in crust and pour jello mixture over as a glaze. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Whip the cream adding 2 teaspoons sugar at the end. Fold whipped cream over berries and glaze and serve.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add onions and then hot water. Mix eggs in last. Let set while frying fish. Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease or oil. Let fry to golden brown.

title: Turkey Divan
instructions: Steam and drain broccoli. Arrange in bottom of 2-quart casserole. Place turkey over broccoli. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour. Cook 1 minute. Stir in broth and cream. Cook until thick. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour sauce over broccoli and chicken. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken in melted margarine and then dip in bread crumbs. Then re-dip into margarine and dip in Parmesan cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 or 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: World'S Easiest Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake uncovered for about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serve with rice. Its great. Serves 4 to 6. Lite soups can be used.

title: Baked Chicken Maryland
instructions: Trim chicken pieces removing loose ends of skin. Bone or not as you like. Shake chicken in a paper bag with flour salt and pepper. Break an egg into a pie pan. Add 2 tablespoons water; beat with a fork until blended. Dip the chicken pieces into the egg then coat well with crumbs. Place in a well-greased shallow baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until tender (35 to 50 minutes) basting several times with melted butter (1/3 cup for 6 to 8 pieces).

title: Chocolate Cream Roll
instructions: Sift together well the flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Beat egg yolks until light in medium bowl. Gradually add 3/4 cup sugar beating until thick and creamy. Beat in water and vanilla. Beat egg whites until frothy. Gradually beat in the remaining sugar and beat until stiff. Fold egg whites into the egg yolk mixture. Fold in dry ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13 1/2-inch shallow (jelly roll) pan that has been lined with wax paper and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Quickly invert the cake onto a towel which is dusted with powdered sugar. Cut off crisp edges and remove paper. Roll up cake in towel and cool well.

title: Lyla Dee'S Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix chili sauce cream cheese and mayonnaise in blender until smooth. Use spoon to stir in shrimp and onions. Serve with Fritos.

title: Fruity Angel Food Trifle
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat milk and pudding mix on low speed for 2 minutes. Set aside. Split cake horizontally into thirds. Place one layer in a trifle bowl (or in 5-quart serving bowl that is 9-inch in diameter). Top with a third of the pudding whipped topping and fruit. Repeat layers twice. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours. Yield 16 to 20 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly shortening butter sugar egg and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients with a wooden spoon. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown. Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet. Enjoy with a cold glass of milk or ice cream.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer according to ingredients. Store in refrigerator. Do not put croutons on top until ready to serve.

title: Cherry Dumpling Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. In a 9 x 13-inch pan pour pineapple and cherries. Cover with dry cake mix. Melt butter and pour on top of dry cake mix.

title: 3 Minute Microwave Fudge
instructions: Microwave on High for 3 minutes in microwave-safe dish. Make sure all ingredients are well blended. Remove after 3 minutes and add nuts. Pour into a waxed paper lined 8-inch square dish. Chill and cut.

title: Spinach Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; toss thoroughly. Chill at least 6 hours or overnight to blend flavors. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Etouffee(Easy Microwave Recipe)
instructions: In a 2 qt. microwave safe dish combine margarine onion green onion bell pepper garlic and celery. Heat on High settings for 8 to 9 minutes. Stir in parsley tomato paste soup shrimp salt Tabasco and cayenne. Heat on High setting for 5 minutes. Stir and cook for another 5 minutes until mixture thickens. Serve over white rice.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix thoroughly with wire whip. Add 3 tablespoons mayonnaise or salad dressing and mix well. Refrigerate before using.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake With Real Fudge Icing
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Sift dry ingredients together. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately about 1/3 at a time beating constantly. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Creamy Cocoa Frosting
instructions: Combine cream cheese vanilla and salt mixing until well blended. Add combined sugar and cocoa alternating with milk beating until fluffy.

title: 30 Minute Chili
instructions: Brown meat in large pan. Add onion soup mix chili powder kidney beans water and chopped tomatoes. Dice potatoes and add. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Blackberry Acid
instructions: Thoroughly crush berries. Pour boiling water over them. Let stand overnight 12 hours. Strain through a flour sack and let drain thoroughly. Do not squeeze. To each measure of this liquid add the same amount of sugar to the mixture. Add the bottle of acid to the mixture. Put mixture in a container and seal.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix together flour sugar salt and Crisco. Mix vinegar egg and water together and add to flour mixture. Form into 5 balls; chill 1 to 2 hours before using. Can freeze also.

title: Shirley Pound Cake
instructions: Beat cream cheese and butter together until light; add sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flour vanilla lemon juice and orange juice. Pour into prepared pan (9 X 13 or Bundt). Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Joggin In A Jar
instructions: Drink or sip 2 ounces daily to make you feel good.

title: Cheesy Corn Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan combine all ingredients. Stir occasionally cook soup on medium-high heat until heated through.

title: Barbecue Chicken Sauce
instructions: Mix well in a pot over low heat. Pour over cut up chicken in a baking pan. Cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cavatina
instructions: Boil macaroni until tender; set aside. Brown hamburger and add onion and green pepper. Add sauce and tomato sauce. Mix and then add pepperoni mushrooms and seasonings. Simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes. Pour drained macaroni into sauce and put into baking dish. Top with cheese and put in oven at 400\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach drain and press out all water. Mix all ingredients together. Make into balls (about 1 inch) and put on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 55 to 60 balls.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter. Blend in flour; add milk. Cook over low heat until thickens stirring constantly. Add salt pepper and onion. Stir with potatoes in a casserole dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes; then uncover for 30 minutes more.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Brown meat in shortening. Mix rest of ingredients and pour over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours or until tender. Remove meat from pan and using two forks shred meat. Return to sauce and serve on buns. This can also be made in a slow cooker.

title: Batter Buns
instructions: Put water and yeast in mixing bowl stirring to dissolve. Add sugar salt shortening and egg along with 1 cup flour. Mix at low speed until blended. Add remaining flour. Beat until smooth.

title: Easy Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in small crock or baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Spread over crackers. Its a real crowd pleaser!

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a medium size bowl or in a food processor combine flour whipping cream and cheese. Mix until the mixture forms a ball. Roll out on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/2 inch (thinner if you want thin biscuits). Dip in melted butter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add strawberries and chill until slightly set; beat until fluffy. Add whipping cream (whipped) or Cool Whip. Add food coloring if desired. Add cake pieces and mix well. Pour into greased cake mold and chill overnight. Place under warm water to help unmold if needed. Allow to re-chill if needed before frosting. Frost with whipping cream or Cool whip. Garnish with strawberries.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix chill and serve.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Melt butter and let cool. This is important. Combine ingredients in order. Stir. Place in an unbaked pie shell and cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Baptist Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and oleo adding sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add baking powder to flour and then add this alternately with milk while mixing. Add flavorings; mix well. Grease and flour a large tube pan. Bake starting in a cold oven at 350\u00b0 approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes. Do not open oven door first 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fruit Dip
instructions: In medium saucepan combine syrup and cream. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat. Add chocolate. Stir until completely melted. Serve warm as a dip for fruit.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch; beat egg yolks until lemon colored. Add milk and stir into sugar mix. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Remove mixture from heat; add butter vanilla and coconut. Pour into cooled pie shell. Top with meringue. Make meringue using egg whites and 4 tablespoons sugar.

title: Larue'S Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown beef and onion with chili powder; drain off fat. Mix remaining ingredients into beef mixture. Clean soup can with little water and add to mixture. Pour cornbread (made by mixing 1 cup self-rising cornmeal 2/3 cup milk and 1 egg) over top and bake in 450\u00b0 oven until cornbread on top is done.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat eggs milk salt and flavoring well. Mix in peanut butter and pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until firm to touch. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Burek
instructions: Fry onion until soft and transparent; add meat and chicken soup base. Simmer until brown. Drain. Cool. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan with warm oil. Put 4 layers of filo dough in sprinkling each with a little oil. Add 1/3 of the meat mixture. Add 6 more layers of dough; add another 1/3 of meat mixture. Make a third layer of dough and meat mixture. Save about 4 sheets of filo dough for the top. Beat eggs until foamy. Add remainder of oil and beat well. Add club soda and mix well. Put last 4 sheets of dough on top. With a sharp knife cut burek into serving pieces; pour egg mixture over and let sit 30 to 35 minutes. Be sure sides are pressed down. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tupperware Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put eggs and milk in large Tupperware mixing bowl with seal and shake. Add flour salt pepper and Italian seasoning and shake again. Spray Pam on 2 pizza pans. Pour on crust and brown about 25 minutes.

title: Muddy Worms
instructions: Prepare pudding according to instructions on box. Place gummy worms in individual cups; spoon in pudding so that none of the gummy worms show. Top with Cool Whip if desired. Serve to your young friends and surprise!

title: Vegetable Cheese Bake
instructions: Place broccoli or cauliflower in shallow baking pan or dish. Blend soup milk and cheese together. Pour over vegetables. Top with crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bubbling. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and celery until tender. Add ground beef. When brown add soup bean sprouts water chestnuts rice and soy sauce. Pour into a large casserole and bake covered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Stir casserole. Bake 30 minutes more uncovered. Add noodles to top if desired toward end of baking time.

title: Hershey'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and syrup alternately. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cut margarine into flour sugar baking soda baking powder and salt until mixture is like fine crumbs. Stir in raisins and just enough buttermilk so dough leaves side of bowl. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth 1 to 2 minutes. Shape into round loaf. Place on greased cookie sheet. Cut an \x\ about 1/2-inch deep through loaf with floured knife. Bake until golden brown 30 to 45 minutes. Brush with melted butter.

title: Pecan Pie Squares
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Press into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Make a filling of rest of ingredients. After mixing together add 2 1/2 cups chopped pecans. Pour filling into baked crumb layer. Bake about 25 minutes or until filling is set. Cool and cut into 1 1/2-inch squares.

title: Best Baked Beans
instructions: Crumble bacon. Mix all ingredients in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 12 hours (high 3 to 4 hours). Can be doubled for 5-quart crock-pot.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuit
instructions: Boil and mash potato until free from lumps. Sift the flour salt and baking powder. Add the potato and cut in the shortening. Mix to a light dough with the egg and milk. Roll out a little thinner than ordinary biscuit. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 12 to 18 minutes until done. Serve hot with molasses.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 4 cup Pyrex combine first four ingredients. Cook on High for 8 minutes stirring occasionally. Add margarine and vanilla. Cook on High for 2 minutes. Stir in the baking soda. Pour on cookie sheet sprayed with an aerosol pan coating. The first cooking time must be adjusted to the wattage of your microwave. My microwave is 450 watts and requires 8 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: Blend oil sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Add eggs; beat well with a spoon. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add flour mixture to egg mixture. Stir in nuts. Spread in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan. Cool in pan. Cut into squares. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Spicy Shrimp
instructions: Cook broccoli and snow peas in a small amount of water in separate saucepans over medium heat until tender-crisp; drain. Combine broccoli snow peas shrimp and red pepper in a large bowl. Mix soy sauce picante sauce Italian dressing and ginger in bowl; mix well. Pour over shrimp mixture.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook noodles. Steam spinach. Mix together noodles spinach and onion. Salt and pepper. Pour tomato sauce over mixture. Pour into casserole dish sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Double Bean Soup
instructions: Heat butter in large saucepan over medium heat. Add onions and cook stirring frequently until golden but not brown about 8 minutes. Add green beans and garlic; stir to coat with butter. Add broth water cannellini beans salt and the peppers. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Process soup in batches in food processor or blender until finely pureed. Return to saucepan and stir in ginger and lemon zest. Heat through. Mix sour cream and pepper sauce in small bowl. Stir lemon juice into soup and adjust seasonings. Ladle soup into bowls and top with dollop of sour cream mixture.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix flour milk sugar and baking powder. Pour on top of butter. Place fruit on top (any amount). Berries or rhubarb should be sweetened first. Bake at 375\u00b0 until butter comes up over fruit and browns on top (about 45 minutes). Best served same day.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix altogether and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Forgotten Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place rice in bottom of shallow greased baking pan. Combine cream of chicken soup and water. Pour some of the soup mixture over rice and let stand a few minutes. Place chicken pieces on top of rice. Salt and pepper chicken and then pour remaining soup mixture over it. Top with dry onion soup mix. Cover with foil. Place in oven and forget about it for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Combine ingredients adding eggs and margarine last. Drop by spoonfuls on oiled griddle. Cook on both sides until brown. Serve immediately.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: *Either a 20 ounce package of frozen or 1 can of whole kernel and 1 can of creamed corn.

title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream sugar and shortening; add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Combine flour salt baking powder soda and spices. Add alternately with milk to the creamed mixture. Stir in oats raisins and nuts. Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Hearty Hamburger Soup
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Brown meat and onion until transparent. Stir in remaining ingredients except flour and milk. Cover and cook over low heat until vegetables are tender 20 to 25 minutes. Combine flour and 1 cup milk. Stir into soup mixture. Boil and add rest of milk; stirring often. Do not boil. Yields about 4 quarts.

title: Cherry Oatmeal
instructions: Spread pie filling in a greased 9-inch square baking pan. In a bowl combine next 6 ingredients. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over filling. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream if desired. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Karlie'S Easy Oat Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Beat well. Add combined flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats and nuts. Mix well. Press dough onto bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool completely. Cut into bars. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Black Magic Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls out on pizza pan. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Mix cream cheese and Hidden Ranch together. Spread on crust. Put chopped veggies on top. It is delicious.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese and mayo. Fold in whipped cream (or Cool Whip) pineapple and cherries. Pour into ice cube trays or a loaf pan and freeze.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook until potatoes are tender. Add 2 cups milk. Thick with 2 tablespoons flour mixed with 1/4 cup warm water. Simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pyrex pie plate. Sprinkle with hot sauce.\tCover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.\tServe with tortilla chips.

title: Fancy Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon and save the grease. In bacon grease cook the onions bell pepper and wieners. Then add other ingredients to this and cook on top of the stove for 15 to 20 minutes. Crumble bacon on top to serve.

title: Southern Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix chocolate with butter in saucepan. Place over low heat stirring constantly until melted. Remove from heat. Blend in evaporated milk gradually. Mix sugar cornstarch and salt in a bowl. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Blend in chocolate mixture gradually. Pour into pie shell. Combine coconut and pecans. Sprinkle over filling. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until puffed and browned. Cover loosely with tin foil during last 15 minutes of baking if topping browns too quickly. Cool for at least 4 hours. Filling will set while cooling. 10 to 12 servings.

title: Garden Salad
instructions: Bring combined liquids to boil and cool. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate overnight.

title: Corn And Pea Salad
instructions: Drain white corn yellow corn and peas. Add diced celery onion green pepper and pimento. Bring salad oil vinegar sugar salt and pepper to a boil. Pour over vegetables and let set for 24 hours. Will keep for 2 weeks.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix well the cake mix pudding mix 4 eggs oil and 7-Up. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dad'S Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion together until color of meat changes. Add cottage cheese and set aside. Cook noodles until half tender. Layer noodles and hamburger in casserole starting and ending with noodles. Mix soup and milk together and pour over casserole ingredients. Beat egg and pour over top. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour.

title: Rum Cake(Good, Good)
instructions: Mix well. Bake in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Italian Soup
instructions: In microwave cook separately ground beef and vegetables. Combine cooked ingredients in kettle with remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer for flavors to mix well. Eat!

title: Crunchy Ham And Swiss Appetizers
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corn flakes. Chill. Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in corn flakes. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Pork Chop - Potato Dinner
instructions: Arrange potatoes in baking dish or casserole. Brown chops and arrange on top. Combine soup milk salt pepper and onions and pour over all. Cover and bake 1 1/4 hours at 375\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Peas And Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients then add peas cheese celery pickles onion and hard-boiled eggs. Mix altogether and chill.

title: Refrigerator Sheet Cake
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 3/4 cup boiling water. Add 1/2 cup cold water; set aside at room temperature. Mix and bake cake as directed in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool cake 20 to 25 minutes. Poke deep holes through top of warm cake (still in pan) with a meat fork or toothpick. Space holes 1 inch apart. With a cup pour gelatin mixture into holes. Refrigerate cake while preparing topping.

title: Cinnamon Spread
instructions: Soften butter to room temperature. Mix with remaining ingredients. Blend well. Serve immediately or refrigerate for later use.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients and add liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Ice with Fudge Icing.

title: Perfect Meringue
instructions: Cook cornstarch sugar and water until clear. Add a bit of salt to egg whites and 2 tablespoons sugar for each egg. After whites are stiff add the cornstarch mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Torte
instructions: Beat yolks until thick. Add sugar and beat. Add ground carrots and nuts. Beat thoroughly. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and flavoring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand in oven until it cools down a bit. (Bake in a spring-form pan.)

title: Cinnamon Nut Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease and flour 8-inch square pan. Mix together egg sugar milk and butter. Add sifted flour baking powder and salt. Mix only until blended and pour into prepared pan. In separate bowl combine brown sugar cinnamon flour butter and nuts and sprinkle over batter. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm directly from pan.

title: Broccoli Casserole
