instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; save juice. Add melted margarine to stuffing mix. Place approximately 2/3 to broccoli in bottom of a casserole dish. Layer stuffing mushroom soup then onions. Add remaining broccoli on top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Pour broccoli juice over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until bubbly using a 9 x 9-inch dish. Serves 9.

title: Refried Beans
instructions: Soak beans in water to cover in bowl overnight. Drain. Add boiling water to cover and salt pork. Simmer for 2 hours or until tender. Stir in chili powder garlic and salt.

title: Holiday Cutouts
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and beat until light. Beat in egg. Add vanilla sifted dry ingredients and cream; mix well. Chill several hours. Roll to 1/8-inch thickness and cut with fancy cutters. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Decorate. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Sweet Pickle Relish
instructions: Combine cucumbers onions and green and red pepper in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Cover with cold water. Let stand 2 hours. Prepare lids and canning jars according to instructions.

title: Warm Crab Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese jalapeno liquid and jalapenos in medium-heavy pan over low heat. Cook until cheese melts. Stir in artichoke hearts and sour cream. Stir often until mixture is hot. Stir in crab and Parmesan cheese. Add salt and pepper and cook until mixture just simmers (do not boil). Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Italian Stew
instructions: Put first 7 ingredients in large pot. Add potatoes and carrots. Cook until almost tender (about 45 minutes to an hour). Add sausage and zucchini. Cook until all vegetables are tender. Add macaroni and let simmer for about 1 to 2 hours. Stir occasionally.

title: Quick 'N Cheesy Cocktail Swirls
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine cream cheese crumbled bacon chopped onion and milk. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles. Press perforations to seal. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons cheese mixture on each rectangle. Starting at long side roll up; seal. Cut each roll into 8 pieces. Place pieces cut side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Lightly sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 32 appetizers.

title: Chocolate Jumbo Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar cocoa soda and salt in a large bowl. Add Wesson oil vinegar and water. Mix real good. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef Chili Beans
instructions: Simmer chili beans and one can of tomato sauce in saucepan while ground beef is being prepared. Brown ground beef onions green pepper and garlic in skillet until done add one can tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes. Add to beans and simmer until blended. Can be put in small containers and frozen. It always taste better the following day.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to directions. Brown ground beef; drain fat. Add spaghetti sauce leaving small amount for pan. In bowl mix 1 cup Mozzarella cheese cottage cheese and egg. Layer ingredients beginning with small amount of spaghetti sauce noodles beef mixture and cheese mixture. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Fry bacon; remove leaving fat. Cook onions until transparent; remove leaving fat. Fry hamburg. Mix all together in large serving bowl. Cook macaroni according to box directions. Add to bowl. Heat soup just to boiling; add to bowl. Mix all together and serve. This is a winner. Serves 8.

title: Delicious Crock-Pot Dressing
instructions: Crumble breads and add all remaining ingredients except margarine. Pour mixture into crock-pot that has been sprayed with Pam cooking spray. Dot with margarine. Cover cook on high for 2 hours or 3 to 4 hours on low. Makes 16 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Hershey Pie
instructions: Combine marshmallows Hershey bars and milk in top of double boiler. Heat until chocolate and marshmallows melt. Cool then fold in whipped cream. Pour mixture into pie crust; sprinkle a few graham cracker crumbs on top. Refrigerate. Serve cold.

title: Pork Chop Supreme
instructions: Salt and pepper pork chops and brown. Mix soup catsup and Worcestershire sauce together. Pour over chops. Slice onion and spread over chops and sauce. Let simmer for 30 to 45 minutes. Great served over rice.

title: Crunchy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute celery in butter until tender; remove from heat and add next eight ingredients. Spoon into an ungreased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Combine melted butter and cornflakes; sprinkle with almonds. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quick Heavenly Hash
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well. Chill 30 minutes or more before serving. Double recipe if need to.

title: Japanese Ingredients Used In Recipes
instructions: Miso is a seasoning in paste form made from soybeans. It has a salty and unique flavor and is used primarily in miso soup. It is also used for marinating meats and fish before cooking and as a seasoning in boiled and sauteed dishes.

title: Chocolate Dream
instructions: Melt margarine; add flour and nuts. Press down in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Four Layer Coconut Cake
instructions: Beat first 7 ingredients at medium speed with an electric mixer until well blended. Add extracts beating well. Add eggs 1 at a time beating until blended after each addition. Stir in coconut. Pour batter into 4 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans on wire racks 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on racks. Spread Coconut Filling between layers.

title: Oven Baked Pot Roast
instructions: In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan place heavy duty foil (enough to wrap around roast and seal). Rub roast on all sides with A.1. sauce. Set roast on foil in pan. Mix together last 3 ingredients and pour over roast. Seal foil tightly across top and at ends. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Serve with buttered noodles.

title: Tater Tot Casserole(Chase Pumphrey'S Favorite!)
instructions: Brown Vegeburger and onion in oil. Spread on bottom of round 2-quart dish. Cook vegetables; drain and spread evenly over Vegeburger. Top with undiluted soup. Top with enough Tater Tots to cover. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Roll(Polish Dessert)
instructions: Combine 1 cup flour sugar salt and yeast. Heat milk water and butter to 120\u00b0. Add to dry ingredients. Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Add egg and 1/2 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes. Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough.

title: Finger Jello Or Gigglers
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin; dissolve completely. Pour mixture slowly into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill at least 3 hours. To cut gigglers dip bottom of pan in warm water for 15 seconds to loosen gelatin. Cut shapes with cookie cutters all the way through gelatin.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: In large pot bring stock and water to boil; add zucchini. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until tender. In skillet cook onion in olive oil over moderately low heat stirring until softened. Add curry powder; cook stirring for 1 minute. In blender or food processor puree onion mixture with zucchini. Return soup to pot. Add chickpeas chicken and seasonings. Simmer over moderately low heat for 15 to 20 minutes until vegetables are desired tenderness. Adjust consistency by adding water white wine or broth. Serve hot chilled or at room temperature with croutons and dollops of nonfat yogurt or sour cream. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Tsoi Yan Beng(Sesame Cakes)
instructions: Sift first four ingredients together. Gradually add the milk butter and egg to the flour. Mix into a smooth batter. Spread thinly on a well-buttered pan. Sprinkle with sesame seed and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into small squares when cold.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Raisin Chews
instructions: Mix all ingredients except raisins. Add raisins and mix well. Press out 1/2-inch thick in a pan. Cut into pieces. Chill before serving. Makes about 25 pieces.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Cream together eggs sugar and salt. Stir in milk; add vanilla. Pour into pie shell; sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: In a double boiler melt cheese margarine milk and pepper until smooth. Combine warm peeled cut up potatoes and sauce in a 9 x 13-inch buttered baking dish. Top with buttered croutons parsley and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple and pudding. Stir. Add Cool Whip and marshmallows to taste and nuts. Chill.

title: Barbecued Franks
instructions: Brown onion in drippings. Add vinegar brown sugar Worcestershire sauce mustard ketchup water celery and seasoning. Simmer sauce for 30 minutes. Arrange franks in a shallow pan. Pour barbecue sauce over and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar syrup flavoring butter and pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and side comes out clean.

title: Lemon Supreme Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and bake in greased tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. While cake is warm glaze with mixture of 1 cup powdered sugar and juice of 2 lemons.

title: Crescent Chicken Rolls
instructions: Cube and cook chicken; set aside. Saute green onions in butter. Soften cream cheese. Mix everything together. Open crescent rolls and leave in rectangle forms. Total should be 8 rectangles. Spoon chicken mixture inside. Wrap up. Sprinkle with parsley flakes and Parmesan cheese. Cook in oven as directed on roll package and serve!

title: Grandma'S French Dressing
instructions: Mix in blender or mixer for 2 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Hash
instructions: Cover diced potatoes and onion with water. Boil until tender. Add corned beef and bring back to boil. Mix flour and milk and add slowly. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender. Add chicken breast then add soy sauce garlic powder and mayonnaise. Stir until well mixed. Serve over rice or noodles. (May increase or decrease soy sauce garlic powder and mayonnaise to taste.)

title: Mandarin Orange Delight
instructions: Mix pudding and Jell-O with water. Cook over low heat until thick. Cool. Add pineapple oranges and Cool Whip. Mix and serve.

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Put first 5 ingredients in heavy saucepan. Stir over medium heat until well dissolved. Add pecans and stir continuously until all syrup has well coated nuts and no syrup is left in pan. Takes 5 to 8 minutes. Spread nuts on buttered cookie sheet or wax paper. Let cool for 5 to 8 minutes. Break apart.

title: Fumi Salad
instructions: Dressing Mix sugar pepper oil salt and vinegar together.

title: Marie Wisman'S Stuffed Pickles
instructions: Slice ends off of pickles. With apple corer core out insides of pickles leaving approximately 1/2-inch hole. Be careful not to split the sides. Dry center of pickles out with strips of paper towels. (If you have time you can leave the towels in the pickles overnight in the fridge.) Once the insides are dry remove towels and stuff with cheese a little at a time so you dont split the sides. Once the insides are full place back into the fridge until the cheese sets about an hour. When you are ready to serve just slice them. One pickle equals about 6 to 8 slices.

title: Pigs In A Blanket
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. You will need 1 ungreased cookie sheet. On lightly floured surface spread out crescent rolls and separate into 8 triangles. In a small cup mix mustard and Worcestershire together and using brush or teaspoon spread sauce onto each triangle. With scissors cut each triangle into 3 smaller triangles making 24.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Line baking dish with pineapple. Cover with graham crackers. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over graham crackers.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix pudding and milk together. Add softened ice cream and mix well. Fill pie shell and refrigerate until set. Generously frost pie with Cool Whip. Top with almonds or shaved sweet chocolate.

title: Crunchies
instructions: Melt morsels in top of double boiler. Add noodles and peanuts. Mix well and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Cora Sue'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar oleo and canned milk for 5 minutes (start counting when mixture comes to a boil). Stir while boiling. Turn down heat. Take off stove and add Marshmallow Creme. Stir well. Add peanut butter. (Use more or less per your taste.) Stir well. Put pan in cold water and stir until shapes. Put into 8 x 8-inch buttered pan.

title: Spinach Florentine Stuffed Mushroom Caps
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Clean mushrooms; separate stems and caps. Chop mushroom stems. Cook spinach with chicken bouillon added to the water. When spinach is cooked drain well. Saute chopped mushroom stems in butter. Combine spinach and seasonings with chopped mushroom stems. Lightly saute mushroom caps in butter or margarine until slightly browned; drain. Fill caps with spinach mixture and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place in a shallow pan and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Makes 18 appetizers.

title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Mix all other ingredients except fruit to make a smooth batter. Pour batter over butter. Do Not Stir. Add fruit and juice. Do Not Stir. Cook in 300\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Walnut Dream Bars
instructions: Blend butter 1/2 cup brown sugar and flour. Press mixture firmly into shallow pan (two 8 x 8-inch pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Beat eggs. Add sugar and mix well; add remaining ingredients. Spread mixture on top of previously baked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown on top. Do not overbake. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Plum Nelly Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 in Bundt pan (greased and floured) for 45 minutes or until done. Glaze with powdered sugar and milk.

title: Sunshine Ham And Mac
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions to have 2 cups. Drain. In a large saucepan saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour and salt. Gradually stir in milk and water. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to boil and thickens. Remove from heat. Add Cheddar cheese; stir until melted. Add mustard ham green pepper hot sauce and macaroni. Heat to serving temperature or pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole to heat at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Yields 5 1/2 cups.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening; add milk and mix to a smooth dough. Divide into six pieces. Roll. Place apple on each piece; fill with cinnamon and sugar. Wrap and fold. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Oven Steak Dinner
instructions: Place meat in center of aluminum foil that is large enough to make a good wrap over all the ingredients. Sprinkle meat with soup mix and cover with vegetables. Dot with butter and sprinkle with salt. Fold foil and seal to hold juices. Place on a baking sheet. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix together and shape into small balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cook and freeze until solid. Put in bags in freezer. Defrost before serving. Makes 100 small balls. (Can be enjoyed fresh from oven too.)

title: Fruit Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oleo banana eggs pineapple and cherries. Combine flour salt and soda. Stir into mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir and pour into tube pan. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Glaze with powdered sugar and cherry juice.

title: Herb Dressing
instructions: Combine together shake and chill.

title: Tang Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and Tang together. Serve as a dip for fruits.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Pound out breasts to 1/4-inch thickness. Combine milk Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper to taste. Pour over chicken; set aside in the fridge for about an hour.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce in a bowl; cut cauliflower into pieces and place over lettuce. Cut onion in thin ringlets and place over cauliflower. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over onion. Spread a layer of mayonnaise over mixture. Sprinkle sugar salt and pepper over mayonnaise; top with crumbled bacon and cover. Make 24 hours ahead and toss salad before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cook raisins until soft set aside. Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add sweetener and beat until smooth. Add oil and beat 2 minutes. Add applesauce and beat 2 more minutes. Sift flour with baking soda and powder cinnamon and nutmeg and add to mixture. Beat until stiff and add skim milk. Stir until smooth. Then stir in chocolate zucchini and extract stirring well after each addition. Stir in raisins. Bake in an 8 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done. For cupcakes fill cups about 1/2 full. Bake 15 minutes. For cookies drop dough onto greased cookie sheet and bake 10 minutes. Cool cake or cupcakes on rack for 10 minutes. Cool cookies about 5 minutes.

title: Favorite Barbecue Chicken Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to boil. Pour over uncooked chicken in baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until chicken is done.

title: Vegetable Kugel
instructions: Saute onion celery and carrot in oil for about 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook spinach and drain. Combine vegetables. Add eggs salt pepper melted margarine and matzo meal. Spoon into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Buttermilk Jello Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O pineapple and sugar. Heat in a large saucepan on low heat until Jell-O is melted stirring often. Put aside and let cool. Then add buttermilk and fold in Cool Whip good. Put in a 10 x 12 x 2-inch deep pan and refrigerate until Jell-O is set. If you like add 1 cup of pecans after you put in Cool Whip.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Beat eggs then add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Cream together. Sift and measure out 3 cups flour then sift together flour soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture and mix until thoroughly blended. Add nuts. Bake in 2 loaf pans at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: Place salad ingredients in a large bowl and toss.

title: That Stuff Gina Made(Brunch Casserole)
instructions: Cook sausage until completely done. Drain and remove sausage to a medium size bowl. In the same pan as you cooked the sausage put in the cream cheese and cook until melted. Pour over sausage and mix well. In a 8 x 11 baking dish roll out one can of crescent rolls and pinch together the perforations so that the dish is covered. Pour in sausage mixture and sprinkle with the Cheddar cheese. Roll out the second can of crescent rolls on top of the mixture. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until the crescents are golden brown. Cut into 2 inch squares.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Cut shortening into flour. Add milk; stir until dough follows spoon around bowl. Knead\tgently. Place biscuits on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 8 to 12.

title: Pinto Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Put in casserole dish. Pour pinto beans over ground beef. Chop onion and green pepper and sprinkle over the beans pour tomato juice over that then sprinkle both cheeses over that. Mix your cornbread according to package and pour over top. Cook for about 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Delicious!!

title: Huntington Chicken
instructions: Cook vegetables in chicken broth leaving 2 quarts of liquid to cook noodles in. Season vegetables with salt and pepper to taste. Cook large package of noodles in reserved broth until tender. Add chicken that has been boned. Combine mushroom soup and grated cheese. Mix chicken vegetables and cheese mixture. Pour into a large casserole and heat in 400\u00b0 oven until hot. Grated cheese may be added to top. Chopped mushrooms may also be added to this casserole and it may be served in pastry shells instead of a casserole.

title: Cabbage And Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles and set aside. Brown in skillet cabbage chopped fine browned in butter. When brown pour this mixture over the cooked noodles and serve hot. Good as a side dish with pork.

title: Mom'S Chili
instructions: Saute in butter onions peppers and garlic. Add ground chuck; cook and drain. Place in large pot and add other ingredients. (I add more chili powder to my liking.)

title: Superb Crab Fondue
instructions: Heat 2/3 cup Chablis garlic Velveeta cheese and Swiss cheese. When melted add liqueur. Mix sour cream mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce; add to cheese mixture. Add arrowroot dissolved in a little of Chablis if the fondue is too thin. Heat until the fondue thickens. Add green onions and cook 5 minutes. Add crab meat and serve.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Toss together the first 8 ingredients. Stir dressing ingredients together and pour over seafood salad. Toss. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Fold in at once strawberries pineapple nuts and bananas. Pour mixture in bowl and refrigerate.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish or 12-inch shallow round baking dish. Mix whole corn and creamed corn together with melted butter sour cream and beaten eggs. Stir in corn meal mix. Pour into prepared pan and let rest 10 minutes. Bake for 30 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Main Dish Pie
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and make this mixture like a pie crust in a deep-dish pie pan. Combine remaining ingredients and place this mixture in meat crust and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes uncovered. Sprinkle 1/2 cup grated cheese over the top and bake 10 more minutes. This is excellent to warm up for leftovers.

title: Creamy Primavera
instructions: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet. Add broccoli carrots and garlic; cook 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Remove vegetable mixture from skillet. Melt remaining butter in skillet over medium heat. Blend in flour oregano and salt. Gradually add milk; cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add vegetable mixture and remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly stirring occasionally.

title: Seafood Fettucini(Recipe For 14)
instructions: Cook seafood in lemon juice and water. Blanche veggies; boil in water. Cook noodles. Put cream in pan first on stove; heat it up. Put 1 cup of grated cheese. Stir until it melts; add spices and cook. Add seafood. Add fettucini and more cheese. Last add veggies; toss. Add more cheese. Top it with parsley. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Blend the cream cheese and milk until light and creamy. Add the remaining ingredients. Use for raw vegetables.

title: Hot Kolbassi Appetizer
instructions: In skillet cook Kolbassi and beer covered for 10 minutes. Combine other ingredients and add to Kolbassi. Cook and stir until bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Broccoli Cheese Tarts
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray miniature muffin pans with cooking spray. Brush one side of each wonton skin with butter. Carefully press wonton into muffin pan butter-side up. In medium bowl combine egg and flour. Beat with wire whisk until blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into wonton skins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until mixture is set and wontons golden brown. Immediately remove from pan.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Crush graham crackers very fine. Then add all ingredients except chocolate chips. Mix with hands. Mixture will be very dry. Spread and press into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Granny Comer'S Fried Apples(Real Good ... And Easy)
instructions: Cook with top on until tender. Sort of a very chunky apple pie filling effect.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Baste with 3/4 cup tomato sauce 2 tablespoons dry mustard 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 2 tablespoons vinegar.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat first 8 ingredients for 7 minutes. Pour 1/2 of mix into tube pan greased and floured.

title: Have Fun Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix baking soda with milk then add to ingredients. Divide dough into 4 pieces. Add a couple drops of different food color into each dough ball. Top with sprinkles candy pieces or dried fruit. Mostly have fun with the kids. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Boil Dime Brand milk in can (unopened) for 3 hours. Keep covered with water or can will explode. Cool completely before opening can. Pour caramel into graham cracker crust and top with Cool Whip and nuts. Delicious!

title: Grandma'S Summer Sausage Chocolate
instructions: Melt chocolate in a double boiler and remove from heat. Add egg and peanuts; stir. Sprinkle powdered sugar on a sheet of wax paper or board. Put chocolate mixture on the board and shape mixture into \sausage\ links. Sprinkle rolls with more 10x sugar. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate chocolate until hard. Slice to serve and store in airtight container.

title: Rice Dressing
instructions: Brown all meat in large Dutch oven. Pour off grease. Salt and pepper meat. Add celery onion and bell pepper and cook until vegetables soften. Add chicken broth and cook about 45 minutes until almost dried out but still moist. Remove from heat. Add cooked rice and mix well. Add raw green onions and mix well. Serve hot.

title: Grits-Crispy Parmesan Squares
instructions: In medium saucepan bring salted water to boil. Slowly stir in grits. Cover; reduce heat and cook stirring occasionally until liquid is absorbed. Stir in 1 cup Parmesan cheese. Spread this into 9 x 13 baking dish. Cool until firm. Cut into 2-inch squares. In medium bowl combine flour seasoned salt pepper and remaining Parmesan cheese. Coat the grit squares on all sides until well coated. Melt butter in skillet and fry grit squares until crispy on both sides.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in cup of lukewarm water. Stir and let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile measure remaining liquid into large bowl. Add salt and sugar then stir in softened yeast shortening and flour. Mix well. Knead into a medium firm dough. Brush with softened shortening cover and let stand in warm place free from drafts until double in bulk. Knead down and let rise again. You can make yeast rolls loaves of bread or cinnamon rolls from this dough.

title: Stuffed Cornbread
instructions: Cook meat and drain. Mix together with other ingredients and heat until cheese melts. Make cornbread mix. Pour 1/2 of cornbread mixture into skillet. Pour meat sauce on top then rest of cornbread mixture. Bake cornbread as usual.

title: Favorite Pecan Pie
instructions: Place pecan halves in a pattern in bottom of unbaked pastry shell. Beat eggs slightly. Mix in syrup sugar margarine vanilla and salt. Gently pour into unbaked shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and cook an additional 30 minutes. (Filling should be slightly less set in center than around edges.)

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts and cranberries. Then add nuts and cranberries mixing well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a large loaf pan for 1 hour.

title: Miniature Pumpkin Cakes
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl; make a well in center of mixture. Combine eggs pumpkin and oil; add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Spoon into greased and floured miniature Bundt pans or paper-lined muffin pans filling three-fourths full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until done. Remove from pans immediately and allow to cool completely on wire racks.

title: Deviled Ham Dip For Chips
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Mix well with fork or blender. Let set for couple hours. Serve.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Serve with crackers.

title: Creamy Dutch Pie
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients well with mixer. Gradually add flour until mixture forms a soft dough. Press into bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie pan.

title: Old-Time Spice Cake
instructions: In medium bowl beat butter and brown sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat after each. Beat in soup. On waxed paper mix flour baking powder cinnamon nutmeg baking soda and cloves. Add to soup mixture alternately with milk. Begin and end with dry ingredients; combine well. Fold in raisins and nuts. Divide batter evenly in the pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes (or do toothpick test). Cool in pans for 10 minutes then turn on wire racks to cool completely. Use cream cheese frosting.

title: Bonnie'S Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let stand in refrigerator for few hours or overnight before serving to bring out flavor.

title: Grilled Bass With Veracruz Sauce
instructions: Brush fish with 1 teaspoon cooking oil and sprinkle with lime juice including cavity. Place in well-oiled grill basket or on oiled aluminum foil with holes poked in it and place on the grill. Cook over moderately high heat until thickest part of fish is done. Meanwhile make the sauce. Heat olive oil in saucepan. Saute onion and garlic until tender stirring occasionally. Mix in tomatoes and olives and continue cooking over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until slightly thickened. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Remove from heat and reserve; reheat when ready to serve. Serves 6.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Beat 4 minutes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes then drain. Mix everything together. Place in casserole dish. Cover top with cracker crumbs. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: No Fail Microwave Divinity
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in 3/4 cup water in a 2-quart casserole dish. Microwave on High for 19 to 20 minutes or to 260\u00b0 on candy thermometer stirring every 5 minutes. Pour hot syrup gradually over egg whites beating constantly at high speed until candy thickens and loses its gloss. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Party Sandwich Spread
instructions: In a bowl mix together the eggs Spam carrots onion pepper pickle and salt. Add Miracle Whip vinegar and sugar. Mix well and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Butter Twist Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and other shortening thoroughly. Add sugar and continue to cream.

title: Pumpkin Pudding
instructions: Mix well. Use a 9 x 15-inch glass pan. Bake 20 minutes in a 425\u00b0 oven. If using metal pan bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Chewy Brownie Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine Crisco brown sugar water and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Beat eggs into creamed mixture. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt. Mix into creamed mixture at low speed until just blended. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop rounded measuring tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake one baking sheet at a time at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes or until cookies are soft. Cookies will appear soft and moist. Do not overbake. Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes. Place sheets of foil on countertop. Remove cookies to foil to cool completely. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Beat cake mix margarine and one egg together. Press into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Mix cream cheese 3 eggs and powdered sugar together. Pour over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Ron'S Beef Stew
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper; dip meat and brown in oil. Add all other ingredients and simmer for a couple of hours.

title: Evergreen Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water. Cool. Mix Kool-Aid juice sugar and water. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread Or Cake
instructions: Put ingredients in bowl as given. Mix for 4 minutes. Place in 3 small bread pans or 1 cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together. Beat for 3 minutes. Fold in chocolate chips and grated German chocolate. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 in greased tube pan.

title: Green Bean Plaki(Armenian Bean-Vegetable Dish)
instructions: In a large saucepan bring water and 1/2 teaspoon salt to a boil. Add green beans; bring to a boil. Cover and cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Drain and set aside. In same saucepan saute onion and garlic in oil until tender (5 to 7 minutes). Stir in green beans tomatoes parsley pepper and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until beans are crisp-tender stirring occasionally. Serve hot cold or at room temperature. Garnish with additional parsley (and lemon slices if desired). Makes 3 cups (approximately 4 servings).

title: Bess Truman'S Ozark Pudding
instructions: Blend beaten egg and sugar together. Add dry ingredients then stir in nutmeats and apple. Pour into a greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix pumpkin sugar salt and spices. Blend in eggs milk and evaporated milk. Pour into shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool before serving.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine and blend well cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Add all other ingredients except nuts. Mix well and chill. Shape into a ball and roll in chopped nuts. Cheese ball may be stored in refrigerator or freezer.

title: Black Joe Cake
instructions: Sift in bowl first 6 dry ingredients. Blend in the eggs oil coffee and milk until well mixed. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake 2 (9-inch) rounds or 3 (8-inch) rounds.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
instructions: Put first six ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan in order given. Pour condensed milk over top. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Beef Jerky
instructions: Slice brisket 1/4-inch thick and cut in 1 1/2-inch wide and 3-inch long strips. Soak in mixture 15 hours. Place oven on warm or lowest setting. Put toothpick through one end of each piece and hang on oven rack. Let dry for about 8 hours or until all moisture is gone. For best results leave oven door open about 1 1/2 inches while drying.

title: Turkey Fingers
instructions: Combine eggs and pepper sauce. Dip turkey into eggs then bread crumbs salt and pepper. Place between 2 sheets of wax paper and chill. Fry for one minute until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Dip in Bleu cheese dressing or your choice of dressing.

title: Shannon'S No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar margarine cocoa and milk 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. Drop by spoonful on wax paper and let stand.

title: Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chips. Chill for several hours or overnight. Drain and serve with chips.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Fry meat until crumbly; drain well. Add ketchup and melted cheese. Spread on bread. Add pizza sauce A.1. sauce oregano and garlic salt. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Freeze on cookie sheet and then store in plastic bags or cans. When ready to use bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sardi'S Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring rice and milk to a boil. Simmer 50 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Beat together egg sugar salt and vanilla. Add hot milk and rice to egg mixture. Stir well. Add cream. Place raisins in bottom of baking dish; pour in rice mixture stirring to distribute rice evenly. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven in pan of water for 30 minutes. Remove from oven; cool then chill. (I find both cooking times need to be increased slightly.)

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Wash rice. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with salt. Add milk and lay chicken on rice skin side up in single layer. In saucepan mix soups and butter. Heat until blended and butter melts. Pour over chicken. Cover with foil and cook in oven for 2 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Lattice Pie
instructions: In a saucepan bring water vegetable and bouillon to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 3 -5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. In a small bowl combine cornstarch and milk until smooth; add to the vegetable mixture. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 - 2 minutes or until thickened. Add the turkey cheese parsley salt and pepper. Pour into a greased 8 inch square baking dish.

title: Hot Beef Dish
instructions: Brown meat and onion in a frying pan. Add other ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with crushed taco or Fritos chips. Top with shredded cheese. Heat in oven long enough to melt cheese.

title: Marinated Fresh Rattlesnake
instructions: Skin the snake. Fillet like a fish slicing strips from the ribs. Cut meat into 2-inch pieces and marinate for 3 hours in juice of oranges. Add some lemon juice peppercorns and dash of nutmeg. Drain and wipe meat dry. Sprinkle with salt. Dip in beaten eggs and roll in fine bread crumbs. Saute meat in hot butter until golden brown.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flavorings. Sift together dry ingredients. Add half at a time with milk. Mix well. Light oven when you put in cake at 350\u00b0. Bake in stem pan greased and floured.

title: 60 Minute Whole Wheat Rolls
instructions: Mix water honey oil and yeast; let set for 10 minutes. Add salt eggs and flour; knead well. Shape into rolls; let rise until doubled. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Apple Cinnamon Dump Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Dump into a greased Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Green Onion Dip(Makes 2 Cups)
instructions: Blend in food processor until smooth. Cover; chill. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve on crackers.

title: Chili Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Layer cheese between and on top. Cover with foil and bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Mix syrup and bourbon until smooth. Add dry ingredients. Roll into small balls. Roll in powdered sugar and refrigerate.

title: Butterscotch Heavenly Delight
instructions: Even the most strong-willed dieter cant refuse a slice!

title: Sausage Brunch Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a greased 3-quart baking dish layer the sausage onions mushrooms tomatoes and cheese. In a large bowl whisk the pancake mix eggs milk oregano salt and pepper; pour over cheese. Bake uncovered for 45 to 50 minutes or until top is set and lightly browned. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Yield; 6 to 8 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: *Can use crushed crackers oatmeal (regular or quick) or bread crumbs (enough to firm up mixture so that it holds shape well).

title: Lydia'S Turkey Stroganoff
instructions: In a bowl combine ground turkey chili sauce bread crumbs and garlic. Form meat mixture into small balls. In skillet heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil. Add meatballs and brown slowly. After meatballs are brown lower heat and cover for 15 minutes or until meatballs are firm when pressed with a fork. Add mushrooms and cook until tender. Add sour cream and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Boil brown sugar Karo syrup margarine soda vanilla and salt for 5 minutes. Stir in nuts. Pour over popped corn (slowly) in a deep roasting pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Store in airtight containers.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 or 60 minutes.

title: Our Favorite Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken breasts for 25 minutes. Chop into small pieces. Mix chicken with cream of chicken soup 1 1/2 pints of sour cream and green chilies. With an oil sprayer spray a frying pan with a little oil and heat each tortilla until softened. Spread some creamed mixture down the middle of each tortilla (reserving some creamed mixture for topping). Sprinkle some chopped onion and cheese on the filling of each tortilla (reserving some cheese for topping). Roll up each tortilla and place seam side down in a greased pan. Pour remaining cream mixture over tortillas and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Garnish with sliced olives if desired.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Drain the broccoli as much as possible after cooking. Put broccoli in casserole dish; place the Cheez Whiz on top of broccoli. Crumble Ritz crackers on top of broccoli and cheese. Pour melted butter over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients. Serve with chips or vegetable sticks.

title: White Chocolate Lace Basket
instructions: Press a piece of foil firmly over outside of heart-shaped 8-inch cake pan. Place pan in freezer. In small saucepan over low heat melt candy coating stirring constantly until smooth. Cool slightly. Pour melted coating into small squeeze bottle or pastry bag fitted with small writing tip. Drizzle coating randomly over bottom and sides of foil pan; apply heavy coating around edges and corners. Freeze for 30 minutes. Unmold by carefully lifting foil from pan. Carefully peel away from chocolate. Place on tray. Refrigerate until ready to use. Fill with candy or cookies. Yields 1 basket.

title: Rich Rolls
instructions: Combine scalded milk shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Soften yeast in lukewarm water; stir and combine with cooled milk mixture. Add about half the flour and beaten eggs and beat well. Add enough of remaining flour to make a soft dough and mix thoroughly. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead about 10 minutes or until smooth and satiny. Place dough in warm greased bowl; brush surface lightly with melted shortening or butter. Cover and let rise in a warm place 80\u00b0 to 85\u00b0 about 2 hours or until doubled in bulk. Turn out on board and shape into rolls. Place on greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise 1/2 to 3/4 hour or until doubled in size. Brush with melted butter. Bake in moderate oven 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Caramel Zucchini Bars
instructions: Sift together the first 5 ingredients. Cream together the next 5 ingredients. Add last 3 ingredients to dry ingredients. Mix together all ingredients. Pour in a 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add cold water and remaining ingredients. Chill until firm.

title: Gluten Burger
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Mix together wet ingredients and add to wet. Spray coffee can or equivalent canister with Pam. Place gluten in container and cover with wax paper. Pour one inch of water in crock-pot. Place canister in crock-pot. Cover and steam 4 hours on high. Remove and cool. Slice or use in burger recipe.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
instructions: Mix biscuit mix and milk together. Fold and pat on floured board. Rol into long roll. Sprinkle 1 pound uncooked sausage onto dough. Shape into a roll. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Filling For Kolaches
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. When making cottage cheese kolaches instead of making balls spread the golf ball size dough out flat to about 1/4 inch thickness and place about 1 heaping teaspoonful of filling in center. Then bring the dough up to enclose the filling and pinch dough together to form a ball. Put pinched side of kolache on greased pan. Brush lightly with melted margarine. Let rise in a warm place until light about 15 or 20 minutes. Make a depression in center of each kolache and fill with about 1 teaspoon of topping (Posipka). Let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 or 20 minutes or until slightly browned. While warm brush lightly with melted margarine.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix chill and serve.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Season pork chops with dry mustard and sage. Add water with bouillon cubes. Bake at 300\u00b0 for approximately 2 hours.

title: Aunt Nettie'S Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix crushed vanilla wafers nuts and butter in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Pack into pan. In a bowl beat eggs. Add cream cheese sugar and vanilla and beat until smooth. Pour over crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15-20 minutes. Let cool. Spread 1 can blueberry pie filling over. Whip cream with sugar and vanilla. Top over cheesecake. Refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Melt yeast in warm water. Add shortening sugar salt and eggs. Add flour and stir into soft dough. Keep in refrigerator with damp cloth over it. Keeps up to 1 week. When ready to cook roll into ball. Place in greased pan and let rise double. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Snicker Doodles
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together add eggs and beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Shape into balls and roll in cinnamon and sugar. Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 8 minutes at 400 degrees.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil in a medium saucepan until tender. Add zucchini and peppers; cook for 3 minutes over medium heat. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Discard bay leaf. Store relish in airtight containers in refrigerator up to 5 days. Yields 3 cups.

title: Mother'S Day Kisses
instructions: Preheat oven to 225\u00b0. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add cream of tartar and salt. Beat until soft peaks form. Sprinkle sugar in gradually a spoonful at a time. Continue beating until the whites are very stiff. Beat in vanilla. Drop heaping spoons on baking sheets. Bake for 1 hour or until golden brown. Makes about 30.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Heat oil in skillet; add chicken. Brown on both sides. Melt butter in saucepan; add flour and salt. Make a smooth paste. Slowly add chicken broth stirring until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in cream. Put broccoli and chicken in casserole dish. Pour sauce over it. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with more Parmesan cheese. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Lemon Coconut Surprise
instructions: Drain pineapple well.\tCombine sour cream and pudding. Add coconut and pineapple; mix well. Chill. Garnish top with coconut and lemon slices before serving.

title: Mandarin Orange Sweet Potato Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Boil potatoes in jackets and set aside. Combine sugar cornstarch salt and cinnamon in a saucepan. Add apricot nectar and orange rind. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in Butter Buds. Pour over sliced peeled sweet potatoes and Mandarin oranges that have been placed in a casserole dish sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Sprinkle Grape-Nuts cereal on top. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Licken Good Pork Chops
instructions: Combine flour salt dry mustard garlic powder and place in Ziploc bag. Coat pork chops and brown in skillet. Place in crock-pot and add soups. Heat for 8 hours on low or 6 hours on high.

title: Meat Gravy
instructions: Chunk roast into 1-inch squares. Put chunks into good sized pot. Fill with water. Boil beef 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until beef is real tender. Prepare thickening in saucepan (flour salt pepper and enough warm water until thickened to medium consistency). Add to beef soup to make gravy.

title: Pistachio Pudding Jello
instructions: Mix drained pineapple with dry pudding. Stir in Cool Whip marshmallows and nuts and blend. Put in pan and freeze in freezer. Let set a few minutes before serving.

title: Old Fashion Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift salt flour and baking powder together. Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add vanilla milk and dry ingredients. Blend well. Place dough on lightly floured board. Sprinkle a little flour over the dough and roll to about 1/4-inch thick. Cut with cookie cutter. Place on cookie sheet and bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned on top.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Heat oil. Add meat. Cook. Stir in tomato sauce crushed tomatoes spaghetti mix and V-8 juice. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and mix with crackers. Mix vegetables onion and mayonnaise. Layer the mixture and cheese in dish; top with crackers. Bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: English Pea Creole Casserole
instructions: Cook celery onion and green pepper in butter until tender but not brown. Add 1 can tomato soup. Place remaining ingredients in layers in casserole and pour tomato mixture over all. Cover top with bread crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or longer.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix the cookie mix as directed on package. Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Let cool. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar; spread on cookie mix. Arrange fruit in rows starting at center with kiwi. Then go around with strawberries then around with blueberries etc.

title: Sauerkraut Soup
instructions: If using raw meat preboil and rinse clean. Pour kraut with juice into pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Drain. Put kraut in soup pot with 5 to 6 cups water bay leaf caraway seed and ham bone or ribs. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Chuck'S Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Mix jelly chili powder and catsup well. Bake pork at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Baste with mixture several times while baking.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper. Put in soup and add milk. Add grated cheese and put in. Add already cooked macaroni tuna and pimento. Do this in skillet. Transfer to casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Skillet Corn And Chicken
instructions: In skillet in hot margarine brown chicken. Remove. Set aside and spoon off fat. Combine remaining ingredients in skillet and heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and broccoli is tender-crisp stirring often. Garnish with tomato wedges and fresh thyme if desired. Serves 4.

title: Frosting For German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and boil until thick over medium heat. Add chopped nuts and coconut. You can add more coconut if not thick enough. Good on any chocolate cake.

title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes(Makes Approximately 16 Pancakes)
instructions: In a medium-sized bowl combine beaten eggs (or substitute) cottage cheese melted butter (or olive oil) and salt. Sift together the flour; add to the other ingredients and mix. Brown on a hot griddle in a mixture of melted butter and light olive oil. Serve with fresh fruit applesauce jam molasses or maple syrup.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Mix pudding according to directions. Fold in half of the tub of whipped topping. If desired mix in a few mini chocolate chips. Top with remaining whipped topping. Sprinkle with chips confetti or colorful candies.

title: Dream Cake
instructions: Mix together the diced apples and sugar and set aside for at least 10 minutes. Beat eggs lightly and stir into the apple sugar mixture. Then add dry ingredients; stir until thoroughly mixed but be careful to not overmix. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake in a preheated oven for approximately 1 hour. Shortly after removing cake from oven prepare the following topping

title: All American Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients; shape into 2 (7 1/2 x 4-inch) loaves. Place on a lightly greased rack of a broiler pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apricot Whip
instructions: Make Jell-O; chill until firm. Whip drained apricots until puree form. Mix with Jell-O; chill until ready to serve. Serve in glass dishes. Wine or parfait glasses look great. Very good.

title: Never Fail Divinity
instructions: Bring first three ingredients to boil over medium heat until soft ball stage. Pour over Marshmallow Creme. Beat until forms small peaks. Add nuts. Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.

title: Apricot Coconut Balls
instructions: Put apricots and coconut in chopper (cut fine). Mix in powdered sugar and roll in granulated sugar. Let \ripen\ in refrigerator at least a week.

title: Macaroni-N-Pea Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Drain and cool under cold water. Drain off all water then add peas 1/2 onion (chopped small) 1/2 jar (small) Miracle Whip and top with eggs chopped or sliced.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Cream shortening sugar and vanilla together until fluffy. Blend in remaining ingredients except cinnamon and 1 tablespoon sugar.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine cornmeal flour baking powder salt and onion in large bowl. Add egg and milk stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Let batter stand 5 minutes.

title: Custard
instructions: Mix sugar and eggs; add scalded milk salt and vanilla. Pour into buttered casserole. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Set casserole in pan of water (about 1-inch deep). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until silver knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine cover and chill for minimum of 3 hours. Salad is better if chilled overnight. Low-fat mayonnaise may be used.

title: 1-2-3-4 Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Place in bottom of 3-quart casserole dish. Then add layer of onions (sliced thin). Spread one can of soup over onions. Next layer carrots (sliced very thin) and finish up with potatoes (also sliced very thin). Spread second can of soup on top of potatoes. Cover dish and bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: B & B Salad
instructions: Cut up the broccoli and cauliflower; place in a large bowl. Fry the bacon and drain. Fry the onion and drain. Place in bowl with other ingredients. Chop the cheese and green or red pepper.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil sugar syrup and butter until golden shade. Pour syrup over popcorn. Mix together. Pour mix onto cookie sheet. Let cool. Break up.

title: Drop In Salad
instructions: In a large salad bowl combine the first four ingredients. Combine vinaigrette and lemon juice; drizzle over salad. Toss to coat. Serve immediately. Yield 8-10 servings.

title: Velveeta Fudge
instructions: Melt cheese and margarine over low heat. Remove from heat. Stir in cocoa sugar vanilla and nuts. Pour in greased pan. Refrigerate until cold then cut in squares.

title: Company Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Drain potatoes. Beat until smooth. Add salt and pepper then cream cheese and beat again. Blend in onion eggs flour and parsley and beat again. Turn into buttered casserole dish. Spread crushed onion over top and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: New Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix together well the cream cheese and beaten eggs. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Spread mixture into crusts and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool. Meanwhile mix pudding with the milk. Fold in potatoes cinnamon and Cool Whip. Blend well.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine sugar and vanilla together. Add flour oats and soda. Blend well. Pinch off into small balls and flatten on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Scald milk and cool to lukewarm. Combine yeast milk and one teaspoon of sugar in a large bowl. Sift in 1/2 cup of flour. Stir until flour is dampened. Cover bowl with a clean cloth and set in a warm place for about one hour.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Chill 2 hours and serve.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add beaten egg. Add lukewarm water and mix well with wooden spoon. Add bread. Mix well and roll into oblong dumplings or in 2 pieces if desired. Place in boiling water. Cover and cook about 10 minutes on one side. Turn over and cook on the other side. Cut with string.

title: Old Fashion Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift-measure flour. Sift again with the other dry ingredients. Combine milk slightly beaten eggs and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients beating until smooth. Cover dough tightly and chill overnight or until cold. Turn dough onto floured surface and roll out to about 1/2-inch thickness. Cut out with round cookie cutter or into squares with a knife. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in hot oven at 425\u00b0. Cool. They will be crisp when cool.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg yolks until light. Stir in milk and juice. Beat one egg white until stiff and fold into the filling. Pour into prepared pie shell. Beat remaining 3 egg whites adding sugar 1 tablespoon at a time until thick and glossy. Spread meringue over filling making sure it touches the edges of crust. Bake for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together 1 cup sugar 24 marshmallows and 1 cup milk. Bring to boil. Remove from heat and add coconut. Place on cake as soon as out of oven. Let cool. Place 1/4 cup margarine 3/4 cup sugar and 1/4 cup milk in pan. Bring to boil. Stir in chocolate chips. Top cake with chip mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool slightly then roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Chocolate Fondue Supreme
instructions: Combine cocoa cornstarch and salt and blend with butter until smooth. Add milk and sugar substitute and cook over moderate heat stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Put pan in cool ice water and stir until cool. Yield 16 tablespoons. Carbohydrate 2 g protein .7 g fat 1 g calories 17. Free food exchange.

title: Mexican Cottage Cheese Sauce(Use As A Dressing On Lettuce Wedge Or As A Dip)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender until smooth. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Meat Loaf #1
instructions: Mix all together good and shape. Put into pan. Cook in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 1/2 hours. Will be brown. Drain and cool before slicing.

title: Chinese Dish
instructions: Brown and cook meat in shortening; add celery onions water and mushrooms with liquid. Mix soy sauce and cornstarch together then gradually pour in cooked ingredients to thicken. Add drained bean sprouts.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Sift the first 5 ingredients in ungreased pan. Make a well and put in the vinegar vanilla oil and water. Mix well. Sprinkle top with chocolate chips walnuts and sugar. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Karo Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Cream butter; add Karo syrup salt and sugar alternately beating until smooth. Add enough milk to make frosting of spreading consistency.

title: Lemon Poke Cake
instructions: Bake cake in a large dish according to directions on box of cake mix. Cool thoroughly. Pierce cake with fork at 1/2 inch intervals. Stir 4 cups of boiling water into the lemon Jell-O and stir for 2 minutes until completely dissolved. Carefully pour hot mixture over cake. Cool in the refrigerator. Then pour 1 cup cold milk into bowl; add 1 package (4 serving size) lemon flavor instant pudding and powdered sugar. Beat with a wire whisk 2 minutes. Stir in Cool Whip and spread on cake.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Ice when cool. For best results refrigerate mix overnight and bake the next day.

title: Basic Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients then add eggs and milk. gradually add the oil. You can add blueberries or cooked rice or tsp. of cinnamon and 2 Tbsp. sugar. Pour onto griddle heated with a small amount of heat. When cooked on edges turn cook for about 1 minute more. Remove and serve immediately.

title: Gregary'S Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Whip the cream and chocolate syrup until stiff. Fold in sugar and brandy. Chill in champagne glasses.

title: Tiny'S Pie Crustdallas, Texas
instructions: Blend the flour and Crisco and salt. Add egg vinegar and enough water to make a dough. Roll out on a floured wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown or fill and bake. This recipe makes 4 single crusts.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Mix all together (adding nuts and chips last). Batter will be very stiff. Spread in an 11 x 17-inch greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Quick Veggie Casserole
instructions: Heat the cheese soup milk and butter. Pour over veggies and rice. Bake in buttered casserole for 1 hour.

title: Easy Cocoa Pudding
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Mix until smooth with 1 cup milk. In a large iron skillet scald the rest of the milk. Add the cornstarch mixture. Stir constantly until it boils and thickens. Stir in margarine.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Cook beef and onion until meat is slightly browned. Drain. Add salt and pepper. Stir in catsup and tomato sauce. Heat thoroughly. Turn into pan. Cut cheese into 3-inch strips; place over meat. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Lentil-Ham Soup
instructions: Rinse lentils. Combine lentils and water in a 4-quart Dutch oven. Stir cubed ham carrots onion bay leaf pepper marjoram and garlic powder into lentils in the Dutch oven. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer covered about 30 minutes or until lentils are tender. Stir in undrained tomatoes and parsley. Heat through. Discard bay leaf. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine lime Jell-O pineapple and sugar. Boil for 3 minutes. Let cool. Whip Dream Whip. Add cottage cheese. Whip well. Add the Jell-O mixture. Fold in pecans. Put in serving dish. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate.

title: Confetti Meat Loaf
instructions: In a medium bowl combine first 5 ingredients. In a foil-lined baking pan shape beef mixture into an 8 x 5-inch loaf. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. If desired serve with tomato sauce.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix with pastry blender everytime you add something else. Start with drained tomatoes then the chopped onions green chilies jalapenos Crisco olive oil and salt.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and crabmeat. Spread in dish then top this with cocktail sauce. Eat with crackers.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well; add the remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Reese'S Twinkles
instructions: In double boiler melt chocolate bar and 1/2 cup peanut butter and set aside. Melt remaining 1 cup peanut butter in microwave only until soft. Place 1 package bake cups in muffin pans and fill 1/4 with chocolate mixture. Let stand in refrigerator until firm. Repeat with peanut butter and remaining chocolate (close enough to fool the experts). Makes about one dozen.

title: Pickled Carrots And Zucchini
instructions: In saucepan mix sugar vinegar water mustard seed cinnamon and cloves. Add carrots cover and simmer until carrots are crisp-tender. Add zucchini strips return to boiling. Transfer mixture to bowl. Cover and chill at least 8 hours. Makes 3 cups.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: In large bowl combine 2 cups flour and yeast. Heat milk shortening and salt until warm. Add eggs. Beat at low speed with mixer about 1/2 minute then continue beating at high speed for 3 minutes. By hand stir in 1 1/2 to 2 cups flour to make a moderately stiff dough. Knead on floured surface for 8 to 10 minutes. Shape into ball. Cover. Let raise until double. Punch down and divide in half. Cover and let raise about 10 minutes. Roll out and spread with preferred filling. Place into prepared pans and let raise until double in bulk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Yield 24 rolls.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Melt butter over low heat and add flour gradually. Stir until no longer lumpy. Add next 6 ingredients gradually stirring. Stir until no lumps are left; salt and pepper to taste. Stir until it comes to a boil then lower heat. Cover and let it simmer until the potatoes are done. Makes 12 servings; 190 calories and 2 grams fat.

title: Chili Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Cover 8-inch square baking dish with 1-inch of your favorite chili. Top with cheese. Mix cornbread mix with evaporated milk. Pour on top of chili and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chicken Gumbo Soup
instructions: Take the chicken meat off bone and put broth in refrigerator to let fat separate. When ready to make soup skim fat from broth and put in kettle. Heat to boiling and add the onion celery and okra. Cook until barely tender. Add tomatoes and chicken cut up. Season with chicken bouillon salt and pepper. Add rice. This will make enough for 12.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cover bottom of large baking dish with chicken pieces. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Crumble crackers over mixture. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until bubbly and tender.

title: Hot Pork Chops
instructions: Dip tomatoes and peppers into a pan of very hot grease until the skins burn loose; then remove peels and mash tomatoes and peppers. Brown the pork chops in about 2 tablespoons grease. Add tomatoes and mix when pork chops are thoroughly browned. Let simmer about 30 minutes. Add seasonings to taste (salt pepper garlic paprika and chili powder).

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Combine eggs and liquids in a bowl. Beat into dry ingredients. Cook on hot griddle using 2 tablespoons of batter for each pancake.

title: Pork Chops In Sauce
instructions: In skillet brown chops on both sides. Season with salt and pepper. Top chops with onions. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chops. Simmer 45 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Eggplant Dip
instructions: Peel cut and cube the eggplant; leave soaking in water with salt for 15 minutes. Saute in pan 1/2 of the garlic in olive oil. Drain eggplant well and add to garlic. Cook until eggplant is soft. Dissolve the flour in 1/2 cup water then add to eggplant. Stir until thickens. Mash with fork. Add the other 1/2 of garlic salt and mayonnaise. Serve with onion pita bread.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Mix together; place in casserole and cover with grated cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 or until crumbs are brown.

title: Triple Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining chips on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Punch For At Least 100
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; heat and stir until combined and sugar melts. Freeze in shallow pans (such as jelly roll pans). May be made days in advance. When ready to serve spoon out individual portions in large punch bowl. Pour 7-Up or ginger ale over the frozen portions. Keeps well in freezer for days or as long as it lasts.

title: Pink Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients; let stand in refrigerator for 1 hour and serve with crackers.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and butter. Press on bottom and 1/4-inch up sides of a 9 x 12-inch pan. Beat together cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Pour over shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Let stand 10 minutes. Mix the last 3 ingredients well. Pour over cake. Refrigerate when cool.

title: Norwegian Meat Balls And Noodles
instructions: Cut onion in small pieces and saute in 2 tablespoons of oil or butter for a few minutes. Then add the remaining ingredients. Form into meatballs and brown in oil or butter until done. Add meatballs to a can of golden mushroom soup and simmer a few minutes. Serve over your favorite noodles.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven. Brown meat; add onions garlic Worcestershire bay leaf oregano salt pepper and 3 cups water. Simmer covered for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Add potatoes and carrots and continue cooking about 30 minutes or until vegetables are done. Mix flour and cold water; stir into stew until thickened. Heat until bubbly hot. Add browning sauce if desired. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix well Cream cheese milk peanut butter and sugar. Blend in Cool Whip. Fold into pie shell. Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Meatball Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together. Mix all dry ingredients together. Add eggs to creamed margarine and sugar. Add all dry ingredients. Roll into small balls about 1-inch in diameter. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 5 to 10 minutes. Roll twice in confectioners sugar while still warm.

title: New Orleans Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook together. Before serving add 3 cups of cooked rice.

title: Apple Pecan Coffee Cake
instructions: In large bowl cream together shortening sugar and eggs with an electric mixer. Sift together flour soda baking powder 1/4 teaspoon salt and cinnamon. Add to the cream mixture. Stir in apples and pecans (batter will be thick). Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until firm in the middle.

title: Papa'S Country Chicken Soup
instructions: Quarter and boil chicken with salt pepper and onion and garlic powders until done. Remove chicken. Let cool; strain broth. Add vegetables (celery carrots and onion). Let cook until real tender. Debone chicken cut into bite-size pieces. Add cream of chicken soup to vegetables and let dissolve. Add chicken and cooked noodles. Let simmer for 10 minutes then serve.

title: Cranberry Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients. Form into balls. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine cream cheese olives chilies and 1 teaspoon picante sauce. Spread on flour tortillas and roll up. Refrigerate at least one hour. Slice into 3/4-inch slices. Insert toothpicks and dip into picante sauce for serving. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients together except barbecue sauce. Shape into medium size balls. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over each ball. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cream Of Squash Soup
instructions: Combine butter and oil in a large Dutch oven. Add onion and garlic; saute until tender. Stir in squash and chicken broth; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Spoon a third of squash mixture into container of electric blender and process until smooth. Repeat with remaining squash mixture.

title: Aunt Dene'S Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove bones and skin. Place chicken in casserole. Pour melted butter over chicken. Mix flour and milk. Pour over chicken. Mix the soup and broth together. Pour over the other mixture. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven until thickened.

title: Sandwich Filling
instructions: Mix together. This makes enough filling for one sandwich loaf of bread.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Roll into 1 large ball or 2 smaller balls. Roll cheese ball in chopped nuts.

title: Butterscotch Yams
instructions: Arrange yams in single layer in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. In a saucepan stir together brown sugar corn syrup cream margarine salt and cinnamon. Stirring constantly bring to boil over medium heat and boil 3 minutes. Pour over yams. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes basting once.

title: Homemade Wine
instructions: Soak sugar and yeast in warm water until yeast dissolves. Add frozen grape juice. Mix together and pour in gallon jug. Fill up to neck with water. Place a wide neck balloon on neck of jug. When balloon goes down the wine is ready (about 30 days). Keep jug in a cool place.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Bring sugar vinegar and catsup to a slow boil mixing well. Mix a little cornstarch and water together and add to sauce. Use small amounts and repeat until desired thickness. This is excellent on anything you can put it on.

title: Cottage Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes with skin on. Peel and dice potatoes. Grate cheese chop onion and pepper. Add all ingredients to potatoes except corn flake crumbs and butter. Mix and pour in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Cereal Bars
instructions: Mix syrup cream and sugar in a pan and cook to firm ball stage. Pour over cereal mixture. Makes a large pan of bars.

title: Esther'S Favorite Christmas Fudge
instructions: Thoroughly combine and mix all the dry ingredients in a heavy 4-quart saucepan; stir in milk. Bring to a bubbly boil on medium heat stirring constantly. Boil without stirring to 234\u00b0 (to a soft ball stage). Remove from heat and add butter or margarine and vanilla. Do not stir. Cool at room temperature to 110\u00b0. Beat until fudge thickens and loses some of its gloss. Quickly spread on a lightly buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan let cool and cut into squares.

title: Zucchini Casserole(Serves 6)
instructions: Combine zucchini and onion in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Add 1/4 cup water. Cover. Cook in countertop microwave oven about 15 minutes or until zucchini is tender. Stir every 3 minutes. Drain.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Peel slice and boil carrots until tender-crisp. Drain well. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate. Keeps well in fridge. Flavor gets better with age!

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco. Add 10x sugar 1/2 cup at a time. Beat in vanilla and milk.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Tear spinach leaves into medium pieces. Add tomato wedges sliced onion rings and eggs; toss. Serve in salad bowls with poppy seed dressing. (Recipe in cookbook.)

title: Buttermilk Chess Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and flour in bowl. Add eggs and buttermilk; stir until blended. Stir in butter and vanilla and pour in pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Sandies
instructions: Add vanilla to margarine then confectioners sugar and cream until mixture is fluffy. Add water to creamed mixture then gradually add flour to mixture and last add your pecans. Shape dough into small balls about 1/2-inch thick. Place rolls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Do not brown! Take out and roll through some confectioners sugar as desired.

title: Minted Peas
instructions: Shell peas and combine with onion sugar salt mandarin peel and mint. Add a small amount of water cover and cook until barely tender. Water should be evaporated when peas are done. Remove mint sprig toss peas with butter serve at once. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Convention
instructions: If not using croutons trim butter and cube slices of toast. Put half of bread cubes on bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Saute green pepper onion celery and pimiento; mix with mayonnaise and cooked chicken. Spread mixture over bread cubes; then cover with remaining cubes. Beat eggs and milk together and pour over casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove; spread soup over casserole. Sprinkle cheese on top. Return to oven for 30 more minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting into squares. Serves about 8.

title: Kodiak Casserole
instructions: In a Dutch oven brown ground beef with onions and garlic; drain. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Mix well. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with the cheese just before serving. Yield 16 to 20 servings.

title: Sausage Pinwheels
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Pour in milk; mix lightly with a fork. Turn out on board and knead about 1 minute. Roll dough thin (about thickness of a cookie). Spread with the sausage. Roll up as a jelly roll. Wrap in waxed paper and chill for several hours. Remove wrap and slice 1/4 inch thick. Bake on a cookie sheet for 25 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Yields approximately 40 pinwheels.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Cut shrimp into very small pieces along with eggs. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Nanie And Charlene'S Orange Slice Candy Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth. Beat eggs one at a time. Dissolve soda in buttermilk; add to creamy mixture. Place flour in large bowl. Add dates orange candy and nuts. Stir to coat. Add flour and coconut to mixture. This will make a stiff mixture and should be mixed by hand. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. After cake is done mix Glaze.

title: Meat Loaf(He Even Asks For It!!)
instructions: Mix all ingredients until mixture sticks to your hands. Shape mixture into a rounded square and place on a baking pan sprayed with vegetable spray. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ranger Crispies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheets. In large bowl cream margarine shortening and sugars. Add eggs and beat until blended. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup. Level off. Add flour baking powder soda salt and vanilla to creamed mixture. Stir until well blended. Stir in crisp rice cereal. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto prepared pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes. Let stand 1 minute before removing from pan. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs oil and sour cream together for 3 minutes. Pour 1/2 mixture in greased 9 x 13 pan. Mix 1 c. brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour over first half. Pour rest of cake mixture over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Punch holes in cake while it is still hot. Mix powdered sugar milk and vanilla. Pour over cake and enjoy!

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
