instructions: Sift flour sugar salt and soda. Lightly beat fruit cocktail juice with eggs. Add oil and liquid to dry mixture and mix well. Fold in fruit cocktail. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. In a separate bowl mix brown sugar and orange or lemon juice. Dribble over baked cake. Top with pecans. Bake another 10 minutes. Cake will be moist when done.

title: Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage and carrot in bowl. Dice tomatos in same bowl. Add mayonnaise salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sweet Nothings
instructions: Melt butter. Add chocolate chips. When melted add peanut butter. When all is smooth and creamy pour over cereal. Stir gently until all cereal is coated. Shake with powdered sugar (grocery bag or large bowl) until completely covered. Store uncovered until cool.

title: Chicken With Basil Cream Sauce
instructions: About 30 minutes before serving cut each chicken breast in half. Pour milk into pie plate. Place bread crumbs on waxed paper. Dip chicken breasts into milk then into bread crumbs to coat.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan mix gelatine and 2 tablespoons of the sugar. Blend in egg yolks beaten with lemon juice and water. Let stand 1 minute. Stir over low heat until gelatine is completely dissolved about 5 minutes. Stir in corn syrup and lemon peel. Pour into large bowl and chill. Stir occasionally until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon.

title: Dried Apple Stack Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease seven 9 inch round pans. Cream shortening and sugar together; beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir buttermilk baking soda baking powder together and mix into batter. Blend in flour and salt; pour into cake pans. Bake about 10 minutes. Stack layers with hot apple filling between them.

title: Guaranteed No-Lump Gravy
instructions: Measure oil into skillet. Measure sifted flour into small bowl. Measure milk in large container to warm (works best if milk is not ice cold). Heat oil to hot. While stirring with slotted spoon sprinkle flour into oil and continue stirring. Cook until turns golden brown lower heat. While stirring slowly pour in milk. Continue stirring and heat until thick will thicken some as it cools. Trick is continuous stirring with slotted spoon. Same trick will work with any gravy.

title: London Broil Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Then pierce your London Broil. Lay London Broil on mixture. Turn every hour for 4 hours. Then broil your London Broil to your preferred doneness.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook onion in oil until tender. Add 6 cups water and noodles. Cook until noodles are tender. Add broccoli and garlic powder. Add milk and cheese. Cook until cheese melts.

title: Potatoes And Cheese
instructions: Mix everything together except milk oleo and corn flakes. Melt oleo and add milk. Put potato mixture in a 9 x 12-inch pan and pour the oleo and milk mixture over it. Top with corn flakes. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown meat; cover and braise until tender. Put in large kettle with molasses and rinse jar with water for liquid. Add chopped celery and onions. Slowly cook covered for 1 hour. Season to taste stirring often. Add drained vegetables. Fifteen minutes before serving add cornstarch mixed with 1/2 cup water. Serve with rice and/or chow mein noodles.

title: Marinated Tomatoes
instructions: Arrange tomato slices in a long baking dish. In bowl mix oil vinegar sugar salt oregano and green onions. Spoon dressing over tomatoes. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours. Makes 10 servings.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight or bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes; turn off heat cover and let stand 1 hour.

title: Tuna Lunch
instructions: Mix ingredients and serve over a bed of lettuce with saltine crackers. Makes 2 servings.

title: Orange-Pineapple Slush
instructions: Combine all ingredients stirring well to blend. Pour mixture into a freezer tray or an 8-inch square baking pan and freeze until almost firm.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco. Gradually add sugars beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: MIx first 3 ingredients and let set overnight. Next day add apples grapes walnuts and salt. Fold cream or Cool Whip into mixture. Chill and serve.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cold Gazpacho
instructions: Skin tomatoes by plunging them into boiling water. Leave for 1 to 2 minutes. Then plunge them into cold water and peel off skins. Then place tomatoes in blender. Remove seeds from pepper. Chop and add to tomatoes. Peel and chop cucumber and onion. Add with the garlic and egg to the ingredients in the blender. Measure remaining ingredients into blender. Cover and liquidize thoroughly. Add cold water to thin. Pour soup into bowl. Serve immediately. Takes 20 minutes to make. Good source of Vitamin A and C.

title: Peanut Butter Nut Cake(Tube Or Sheet Cake)
instructions: Put raisins and soda in hot water to cover 1 inch over raisins. Let stand until cool about 2 hours. Mix sugar peanut butter and eggs. Mix well. Add flour allspice and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool.

title: 1800'S Spice Cookies
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients until creamed; add eggs and milk. Add flour until thick enough to roll into little balls. Roll in sugar and place on cookie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pasta And Clams
instructions: Simmer the olives clam juice chopped bacon bacon grease and garlic for 5 minutes. Add butter and simmer 15 minutes. Add clams and simmer 5 minutes. Toss mix over linguine. Toss parsley or Parmesan cheese.

title: Luby'S Shredded Carrots
instructions: *To plump raisins soak in water and drain before using.

title: Mackerel Patties
instructions: Drain juice from mackerel into a bowl. Debone mackerel under slow running water and drain. Break up mackerel into bowl of juice add the egg and crackers mix well. Shape into eight patties. Cook in a well buttered skillet and top with a pat of butter on uncooked side. Brown on both sides.

title: Peanut Butter Rite Sandwich
instructions: On one piece of bread put the peanut butter. Split the Ritz in half and spread on the bread. Put it together and enjoy.

title: Kathy'S Favorite Pie Crust Recipe
instructions: In a large bowl cut shortening into flour using a knife or pastry cutter until coarse and crumbly. Add beaten egg ice water and vinegar. Mix together and work into a dough. Makes two 9-inch pie crusts.

title: Creamy Lime Fruit And Nut Salad
instructions: Add boiling water to Jell-O in mixing bowl. Stir until dissolved. Cool slightly then stir in milk. Cool until partially set stirring frequently while cooling to keep smooth. Fold in remaining ingredients. Turn into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm (2 to 3 hours). Cut in squares and serve.

title: Greek Bread
instructions: Melt butter and mix in other ingredients. Chill for several hours. Spread on bread and cook until melted.

title: Gobbler Snacks
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread until well blended. Place this mixture on rye slices. Place on cookie sheet and broil a couple of minutes until bubbly. Watch carefully. Serve hot.

title: Pork Scallop
instructions: Wash and pare potatoes. Cut in thin slices. Cook tomatoes onions sugar salt pepper and shortening for 10 minutes. Put a layer of potatoes in a baking dish and cover with some of the tomato mixture. Add another layer of potatoes and repeat until all ingredients are used. Trim off excess fat on pork chops and lay on top of potatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put pie filling on bottom; spread evenly. Put pineapple on top of cherry pie filling; spread evenly. Put dry cake mix on top. Put 2 sticks of oleo on top and spread evenly (sliced or melted). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Put pecans or walnuts on top. Add a dab of Cool Whip ice cream or whipped cream. Serves 20.

title: Crock Pot Turkey Breast
instructions: Place turkey breast down in crock pot. Combine melted margarine or butter lemon juice and Italian salad dressing and pour over turkey breast. Cook all day on low.

title: One Pan Chocolate Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix bake and serve all in same 8-inch square pan. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Put flour granulated sugar 1/4 cup cocoa baking powder and salt into ungreased 8-inch square baking pan. Stir with fork to mix well. Add milk and oil; stir until well blended. Sprinkle brown sugar remaining 1/4 cup cocoa and the chocolate chips over the batter. Mix vanilla with water; pour evenly over top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until surface looks dry and brownie like. Serve with a spoon warm or at room temperature.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and place in two-quart microwave casserole. Set aside. Place butter in four cup measure. Microwave for one minute or until melted. Stir in flour until blended. Pour milk into two cup glass measure and cook in microwave for three minutes. Stir in flour-butter mixture. Cook six to eight minutes or until thickened stirring frequently. Add salt and onion. Add cheese; stir until melted. Pour over macaroni. Blend well. Serve immediately.

title: Polish Mazurki
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Blend sugar butter and flour. Pat and press mixture into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Cool. Spread baked layer with jam. Mix remaining ingredients in bowl and spread over jam. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook in saucepan until thick. Pour into baked pie crusts. Cover filling with meringue. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: *Turkish Coffee(Cafea Turteasca)
instructions: Place water in brass Turkish coffee maker or small saucepan. Add sugar and coffee. Stir vigorously. Place over heat and bring to a boil. Remove from heat until foam goes down then replace over heat. Repeat twice. Skim 1 teaspoon of foam into each demitasse cup and pour remaining coffee into cups.

title: Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put nuts all around mound. Refrigerate for a few hours. Use as spread with assorted crackers.

title: Comfort Eggnog
instructions: Chill all liquids before mixing. Separate eggs; beat egg whites until stiff and set aside. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar. Stir in all milk and Cool Whip. Add whiskey. Fold in egg whites. Chill. Dust with nutmeg if desired. Serves 10.

title: Deep Dish Fruit Pie
instructions: Pit peel and slice fruit. Mix together and place in deep 8-inch baking dish with the white sugar and lemon juice. Bake at 375\u00b0 until fruit is tender (about 45 minutes for apples). With pastry blender mix together flour brown sugar oil and cinnamon until it is crumbly. Place atop cooked fruit and continue to bake until brown and bubbly. Top each serving with ice milk or sherbet. Yield 6 servings. Approximate calories/serving 200.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Place all ingredients except nuts in a large microwavable bowl. Microwave at Medium (50%) until chocolate chips are melted 3 to 5 minutes stirring once halfway through cooking time. Remove from microwave and stir in nuts. Pour into well-greased square dish 8 x 8-inch. Refrigerate until set. Yields about 2 pounds.

title: Broken Glass Dessert
instructions: Dissolve each of the first three Jell-Os separately in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Pour in separate pans (9 x 9-inch or such). Refrigerate until solid.

title: Rapid Raspberry Torte
instructions: In mixing bowl beat cream until soft peaks form. Add powdered sugar; beat until stiff peaks form. Place pudding in a different bowl and then fold in whipping cream. Split cake in 3 horizontal layers. Spread half of jam over bottom layer; repeat layers. Top with third cake layer cut into slices. Top with pudding mixture. 7-10 serving.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Mix eggs and milk then add onion cheese flour salt and pepper. Mix. Add zucchini. Fry in hot butter in skillet until brown on both sides.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients alternately with pumpkin mixing well after each addition. Stir in raisins.

title: Ma'S Sop Chocolate
instructions: In medium saucepan thoroughly mix sugar cocoa and flour. Gradually add milk until mixture is well blended. Add boiling water. Cook on medium heat until mixture reaches desired thickness. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla flavoring stirring until butter is melted. Serve warm or cold and \sop\ with biscuits bread rolls etc. of your choice. Yields enough for 5 or 6 people.

title: Bacon And Tomato Canapes
instructions: Hollow out tomatoes and drain upside down on paper towels overnight. Fry bacon crisp. DRAIN WELL. Crumble mix with other ingredients and fill tomato shells.

title: Hot Crab Dip(Serves 10)
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise in a large bowl; stir in lemon juice pepper sauce and scallions. Fold in chopped crabmeat salt and pepper. Spread in baking dish and sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly and top is golden. Serve hot or warm.

title: Natalie'S Bake Beans
instructions: Brown onion and pepper in 1 tablespoon bacon grease until tender. Cook all ingredients until thick.

title: Brown Sugar Squash
instructions: Clean squash and cut in half. Clean out seeds with a spoon. Remove stem. Fill a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with 1/4 cup water. Place squash upside-down in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. While squash is baking melt butter in pan. Stir in brown sugar salt and nutmeg. Leave mixture on low heat until 1/2 hour is up. Take out squash turn them right side up and fill them with butter mixture. Place squash back in oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix pimento onion cheese pickles and eggs lightly. Add peas and salt to taste. Mix with enough salad dressing to hold all ingredients together. Be careful not to mash peas when mixing. Chill well. Serve on lettuce leaves or alone as a vegetable. Be sure to use LeSueur peas. This is the secret to this recipe.

title: Crackers
instructions: Sift dry ingrediments...heat the milk n shortenin...mix up the aig n the flour mixture n work on til well blended...now dump in melted shortenin n milk...mix til hit makes a stiff dough...this you beats wid a rollin pin til the dough pops when broken. Now divide in bout 4 parts n roll each part az thin az papur...stick reel gud wid a fork n cut in strips n sections lak a sto bought cracker. Bake at 300\u00b0 til a reel delikate brown color. Theys ready!

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Boil until tender and drain.\tBeat softened cream cheese and sour cream at medium speed until well blended. Add hot potatoes gradually beating until light and fluffy. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add chives and toss carefully. Put in a 2 quart greased casserole. Dot with butter and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Wash and slice tomatoes. Combine meal salt pepper and paprika. Dredge tomatoes in this and fry in skillet with a 1/4-inch of oil until brown turning once. Serves 6.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
instructions: Mix oil dressing mix and garlic powder and pour over oyster crackers. Mix real good.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef or turkey. Drain and mix with taco seasoning according to directions. Tear 1 head of lettuce into bite-size pieces and put in very large (7 quart) salad bowl or large roasting pan. In another bowl mix the drained can of kidney beans salsa tomatoes avocados and olives. This mixture can be made up to 6 hours in advance if refrigerated. Crush the Doritos in the bag and combine the meat mixture vegetable mixture chips and lettuce together and serve right away.

title: Stuffed French Bread
instructions: Cut off crusts from bread and cube bread. Place in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Cube cream cheese and spread over bread cubes. Beat eggs; beat in maple syrup and milk. Pour over cubes in pan; cover with plastic wrap and store overnight in refrigerator. When ready to use bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together (do not use beater) then add apples and pecans and mix well. Then add flour salt soda and cinnamon. Batter will be stiff. Grease and flour 9 x 12-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Puttanesca
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic; stir. Remove pan from heat and allow hot oil to turn garlic pale gold (5 to 10 minutes). Stir in tomatoes capers olives red pepper flakes basil oregano and black pepper. Return to medium-low heat and simmer 10 minutes. Add salt and pepper if needed. Reduce heat to very low.

title: Peanut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a loaf pan. Put the flour sugar baking powder and salt in a large bowl. Add the peanut butter milk and egg. Mix until well blended. Spoon into the pan and bake for about 50 minutes. Remove from the pan and cool on a rack.

title: Betty'S Brown Bread
instructions: Mix 4 cups flour with dry ingredients. Add raisins mixing them with fingers to separate. Add buttermilk and mix with fork until mixture forms a dough. Sprinkle 1/4 cup flour on surface turn out and knead dough about 5 minutes. Form into smooth round loaf.

title: Grandma'S Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Add melted butter or margarine. Press half of the mix on bottom of pan. Add cherry pie filling. Put remaining crumbs on top of cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Salad
instructions: Chop all ingredients and toss then pour on your favorite dressing.

title: Walnut Cake
instructions: Beat the egg yolk until very light; add the sugar gradually and beat well. Sift together the flour baking powder and salt; add the nuts and then combine with egg mixture. Beat well. Stir in the stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla. Bake in 2 layer cake tins in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven from 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Holden Village Eggs Florentine
instructions: Saute chopped onion. Stir in spinach and season with garlic salt and pepper to taste. Spread mixture in pie pan. Make 8 indentations for eggs. Break raw eggs into indentations. Cover with Mornay Sauce. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with water. Add cake pudding mixes and melted butter. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake for 50 minutes at 325\u00b0 in buttered and floured pan.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on box; drain and let cool. Mix the cucumbers tomatoes and onion with cooled spaghetti. Pour dressing over all toss and sprinkle with Salad Delight seasoning. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Rich Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Melt peanut butter and margarine in bowl over hot water. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares. Yields approximately 2 dozen.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to package directions. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cool cake completely. In blender mix vanilla pudding with 1 cup of milk. Add cream cheese and Cool Whip. Fold in pineapple and coconut. Spread on cake and chill.

title: Imperial Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each addition. Add flour and blend. Pour in greased and floured Bundt pan or two large loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blue Cheese Salad Dressing
instructions: In small bowl with fork mash the Blue cheese. Gradually work in the sour cream buttermilk and vinegar. Add salt and pepper. Add oil; beat hard preferably with a wire whip to make as smooth as possible. Makes 1 1/4 cups. Put in jar cover tightly and store in refrigerator.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Mix in bowl sugar flour and eggs. Add pineapple coconut walnuts and soda. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Grilled Salmon With Lime Butter
instructions: In glass or stainless steel bowl combine lime juice and ginger root; add salmon and let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes turning fillets over every 5 minutes. In small bowl combine butter and lime peel; set aside. Spray grill or fish basket with nonstick cooking spray. Grill salmon approximately 10 minutes per inch or until flaky. Remove from grill. Spread immediately with lime butter.

title: Orange Vanilla Wafer Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Press into balls; let dry 30 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar. Makes 40. Especially nice when you need cookies the weather is hot and you dont want to use the oven.

title: Peanut Butter Rocky Road Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Refrigerate candies to make cutting easier. Mix butter and graham cracker crumbs well. Press into bottom of a 9 inch square pan. Bake 8 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: About 45 minutes before serving in medium bowl mix first 5 ingredients and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Shape beef mixture into 1-inch meatballs. In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot salad oil cook meatballs until browned on all sides; removing meatballs to bowl as they brown. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons dripping from skillet. Cut cream cheese into chunks. To drippings add cream cheese remaining ingredients and 1/8 teaspoon salt; cook over low heat stirring with wire whisk or spoon until melted and smooth. Return meatballs to skillet; heat stirring occasionally. Makes 4 main dish servings.

title: Quick And Easy Banana Nutbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and blend.\tStir in bananas. Mix flour soda and salt and stir in. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until done.

title: White Taffy Candy
instructions: Cook all together except vanilla without stirring until candy forms hard ball stage when tried in cold water or reaches 250\u00b0. Remove from heat. Pour onto buttered platter. When cool pull until creamy white working in the vanilla. Stretch into long strips about the size of a finger. Cut into 1-inch lengths. Wrap in waxed paper.

title: Dry Apples For Art Projects
instructions: Slice apples into 1/4-inch circles. Soak in lemon juice for at least 20 minutes. Bake at 150\u00b0 for 6 hours. Bake on a wire screen or oven rack. Do not place on a cookie sheet. Turn off oven before apples turn brown. Open oven door and allow apples to cool gradually.

title: Buffet Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes and 1/2 cup of butter with other ingredients; pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Top with crushed corn flakes and butter (use 1 1/2 cups of flakes and 1/4 cup butter). Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 or 1 1/2 hours.

title: Family Favorite
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed. Brown meat drain and add onions and green pepper; cook until tender. Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Angel Pie
instructions: With electric beater mix until very stiff the egg whites sugar vanilla salt and cream of tartar. Fold in the pecans. Grease a 9-inch pie pan. Turn mixture into pan forming a nest on bottom and up on sides. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter to soften. Add sugar gradually and cream until fluffy. Add syrup and salt; beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each. Hand stir in peanuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Ribbon Jello Salad
instructions: Bring milk to a boil and add sugar until dissolved. Add Knox gelatine. Also add sour cream and vanilla. Mix with electric mixer. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam or oil pan. Make Jell-O one box at a time. Each layer will need to set. Add a milk layer between each jello layer. Finish top with milk layer.

title: Fruitcake Squares
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 12-inch pan and sprinkle evenly with crumbs. Sprinkle next four ingredients over crumbs. Drizzle milk over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Place shortening sugar egg water and vanilla in mixing bowl; beat thoroughly. Sift together the flour salt and soda. Add to shortening mixture; mix well. Blend in oats. Drop by spoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
instructions: Mix all together and line pie pan.

title: Greek Chicken
instructions: About 40 minutes before serving in small bowl with fork mix Feta cheese lemon juice and oregano until smooth. On work surface with meat mallet or dull edge of French knife pound each chicken breast half to 1/2-inch thickness. With knife or small metal spatula spread cheese mixture over each breast half to within 1/2-inch of edge. Fold chicken breasts crosswise in half to enclose filling; secure with toothpick. On sheet of waxed paper mix salt pepper and 1 tablespoon flour; use to coat chicken. In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot olive or salad oil cook chicken until golden brown on both sides turning once.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Place meat onion water and salt in large soup kettle. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Remove meat from broth and cube. Remove fat. Replace meat in broth; add tomatoes celery cabbage potatoes and carrots. Simmer 1/2 hour to an hour. Other vegetables may be used. If canned or leftover vegetables used add 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add refried beans and taco seasoning. Spread into 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer sour cream green taco sauce and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Karen'S Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Mix in beans picante sauce and jalapenos. Prepare tortillas per package instructions. Divide beef mixture between the 10 tortillas. Roll tortillas and place in a 13x9 baking dish. top rolled tortillas with taco sauce then sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350 degrees or until heated thoroughly. Yields 5 servings.

title: Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Wash eggplant; boil for about 10 minutes. Cut in half lengthwise; scoop out pulp to make 2 shells about 1-inch thick. Reserve pulp. Sprinkle shells with salt. Cook bacon slightly; add mushrooms and onion. Cook over low heat for about 10 minutes or until soft and lightly browned. Add soft bread crumbs cucumber horseradish chili sauce seasonings and chopped eggplant pulp. Fill the eggplant shells with the mixture. Sprinkle with buttered crumbs. Place in a shallow baking dish containing a little. Bake in a moderate oven (375\u00b0) for about 35 minutes or until tender. Makes 8 servings.

title: Green Pepper Jelly
instructions: Combine peppers sugar and vinegar. Bring to a hard boil over high heat. Remove and set aside for 20 minutes. Return to heat. Bring to a full rolling boil and boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add liquid pectin and food coloring. Stir skim off foam and pour into hot jars. Cover with thin layer of paraffin wax.

title: Overnight Brunch Eggs
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Break eggs; add milk mustard and salt. Add bread cheese and sausage.

title: Colcannon
instructions: Cover potatoes with water in large Dutch oven or pot; boil until tender about 20 minutes. While potatoes cook trim and slice cabbage. Add to pan adding more water as necessary. Combine onion and evaporated milk in medium saucepan and simmer over medium heat until onion is soft about 15 minutes. When potatoes and cabbage are tender drain water from pan. Spoon potatoes into bowl and mash. Add cabbage and milk-onion mixture; season with pepper to taste and serve. Yield 8 servings.

title: Old Time Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except cucumbers in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Drop clean whole small cucumbers in vinegar and heat. Simmer for a few minutes but do not boil. Remove cucumbers and place in clean jars. Return vinegar to boil and pour over cucumbers and seal.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Prepare soup as stated on can; bring to boil. Add rice and tuna with water salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour 1/2 into greased 2-quart baking dish. Add layer of sliced cheese. Pour other half over cheese and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 until hot and cheese bubbles.

title: Pickled Beets(Canned)
instructions: Mix syrup ingredients and boil for 10 minutes before adding to beets.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat the eggs flour and the sugar together; add the ground pecans then top with the pecan halves and bake for 55 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Cranberry Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour lemon pudding mix and baking soda together. Add flour and milk alternately ending with flour. Add cranberries sprinkled with 3 tablespoons powdered sugar and nuts sprinkled with flour. Pour in large tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: John'S Crab Stew
instructions: Place crab meat in water. Bring to a boil. Add other ingredients and let simmer for about 15 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Vichyssoise
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add onion and celery stirring constantly. Add chicken stock potatoes and garlic salt. Cook until potatoes are tender about 30 minutes. Put in blender. Add other ingredients. Stir to blend. Serve hot or very cold. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lime-Pineapple Jello With Topping
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. When completely dissolved add ginger ale and pineapple. Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Refrigerate until firmly set.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 2 layers as directed on package. Cool. Put one layer in punch bowl pressing down into bowl to fit bottom. Pour 1 package pudding mix prepared according to directions. Let set until cool. Add half of remaining ingredients. Add second cake layer and second package of pudding mix. Let set. Add remaining ingredients. Finish with whipped topping. Decorate with sliced peaches and whole strawberries.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Mix gelatin and 2 cups water and set aside. Combine jello 2 1/2 cups water and sugar in cooker. Bring to boil. Mix 2 mixtures together; add 1 cup cold water. Pour into pan/dish and let set until it jells. Then refrigerate until chilled. Cut into squares.

title: Chili-Cheese Corn Bread
instructions: Chop pepperoni. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. In large bowl measure flour corn meal sugar baking powder and salt. With wire whisk beat eggs milk oil and sour cream until smooth. Stir egg mixture into flour mixture. Stir in pepperoni cheese onion and green chilies. Spoon batter into pan. Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown and toothpick inserted comes out clean. Makes 14 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Baked Beans
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients with small amount of bacon drippings in pan. Simmer for 10 minutes. Combine beans onions and sauce in casserole mixing well. Top with bacon. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with a fork. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Baked Ham With Pineapple Glaze
instructions: Combine ingredients to make a smooth paste. Place ham in baking dish on rack. Smooth glaze over. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: In a buttered casserole dish put layers of onions potatoes ground beef celery and kidney beans seasoning each layer with salt and pepper. Pour soup over top. Cover and bake 2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients; put into a Pyrex baking dish. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Dilled Green Beans
instructions: In saucepan over medium heat cook broth onion green pepper and dill seed for several minutes or until thoroughly heated. Add beans. Cook covered 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Great Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: In mixing bowl combine pumpkin milk eggs sugar and pumpkin pie spice. Pour into a 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle with dry cake mix. Drizzle with melted butter then sprinkle walnuts over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a knife comes out clean.

title: Pork Marinade
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and marinate a pork loin roast or pork tenderloins. Bake roast at 350\u00b0 and baste sauce over the top of the roast.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together in a baking dish. Crush crackers and brown in the oleo. Put browned crackers on top of chicken mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix flour oatmeal soda and salt together and add to first mixture. Add raisins and juice. Drop from teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In large pot cook just until done (but not mushy) in enough water to cover them. Add small amount of parsley flakes salt and pepper to taste. Add 1 can of cream of celery soup. Add cheese and cut heat off. Stir frequently until all the cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Cook until it spins a thread and flies away. Add peanuts and cook until slightly brown. Remove from fire. Add soda. Stir very quickly and pour in greased sheet. Can add more peanuts.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken salt pepper onions and bouillon cubes. Take chicken off bone and set aside. Save 5 cups broth and mix margarine with it and stuffing mix. Pour stuffing mix in pan sprinkle chicken over stuffing mix and mix lightly until moist. Pour some more broth over top and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix and beat well together. Bake for 1 hour in a Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 or less according to your stove oven.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Bring to boil the first 3 ingredients then boil for 8 minutes more stirring all the time. Add chocolate chips and marshmallow cream. Stir until well blended. Add vanilla and blend. Add chopped nuts.

title: Pineapple Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Mix dry ingredients then add to sugar and oil. Add carrots and blend well. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each. Add nuts and pineapple. Blend well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch (lightly greased) pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Family Favorite
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Heat soups with milk stirring until smooth. Do not add water to soup. Remove from heat. Stir in uncooked rice and pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Lay pieces of chicken on top of rice. Sprinkle dry soup mix over top. Cover with foil. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until chicken is done. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Boil sugar and molasses 5 minutes (no longer). Remove from heat. Add butter and soda. Stir mixture until it becomes foamy. Pour over popcorn. Mix well. Keep hands slightly buttered; form into balls.

title: Green Chile Chicken
instructions: In medium skillet over medium-high heat cook chicken onion and garlic in oil until chicken is no longer pink. Add salsa chiles and oregano. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Serve over rice or in tortillas. Top with sour cream if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Upside-Down Strawberry Meringue Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites with vinegar and salt to soft peaks. Gradually add the 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla beating to stiff peaks. Spread on bottom and sides of baked pastry shell. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes. Cool.

title: Mary Talley'S Rolls
instructions: Add eggs and 4 cups of flour to mixture. Then add the rest of the flour 1 cup at a time mixing well. Do not knead. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate or can use immediately.

title: Carrot Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots until done. Alternate layer of sauce. Let set for 6 to 8 hours and enjoy.

title: Baked Zucchini
instructions: Melt butter and mix with stuffing. Precook onion and zucchini for 10 to 12 minutes. Mix cooked onion and zucchini with sour cream and cream soup. Use 1/2 of stuffing in bottom of baking dish. Spread zucchini mixture over the stuffing. Cover with rest of stuffing and bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: No Bake Carob Cookies
instructions: Combine first four ingredients and bring to a rolling boil. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix thoroughly. Place on waxed paper and refrigerate.

title: Country Fried Steak
instructions: In plastic bag or bowl combine flour salt and pepper. Place buttermilk in shallow pan or bowl. Coat steaks with flour mix then dip into buttermilk and coat with cracker crumbs.

title: Baked Ham, Cooked With Brown Sugar And Pineapple
instructions: Take a shank ham portion. Get a large broiler pan. Take a sort of aluminum foil bowl. Put the ham in. Take a long sharp knife and punch holes deeply in the ham. Prepare the brown sugar and pineapple. Mix the juice with 3 tablespoons of brown sugar in a small boiler. Stir well while heating on low.

title: Bacon-Onion Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Measurements depend on amount desired.

title: Microwave Pecan Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish stir together corn syrup and sugar. Cook on 100 percent power for 4 minutes. Stir in nuts. Cook on 100 percent power for 3 minutes. Add butter and vanilla to syrup and blend well. Cook on 100 percent power for 1 to 2 minutes. Add baking soda and stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. When cool break into pieces. Keep in a tight container.

title: Pizza Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain fat. Mix pizza sauce garlic and oregano and pour over hamburger. Put in bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan. Add on top the Mozzarella cheese. Mix eggs milk oil and flour. Pour mixture on top of Mozzarella cheese. Top with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fig Spice Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs pudding mix water and oil. Beat well. Fold in figs and nuts last. Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Stays moist and freezes well.

title: Sweet Bread(Scandinavian)
instructions: Melt butter in hot milk and set aside. Add yeast to cool milk and add sugar cardamom salt and eggs. Combine the two sets of liquids in a large bowl. Add approximately 8 cups flour. Knead into a rather stiff dough. Let stand overnight. In the morning divide the dough into 6 pieces. Roll out into strips 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Braid 3 strips together into a loaf. Set on a greased flat pan or cookie sheet; let dough rise lightly about 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes (until nicely browned). Remove from oven; brush top with sugar melted in a little hot coffee. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix sugar oil and 7-Up together. Add eggs one at a time. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Mix 1 cup powdered sugar and juice of 1 lemon. Pour over cake while still warm to make glaze.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Coat large (10-inch) pan or skillet with Pam. Heat pan brown cubed beef; drain off excess fat by pouring pan contents through a colander. Return beef cubes to pan. Season lightly with Lawrys seasoned salt. Add French onion soup (2 cans) water and Burgundy. Cover and simmer for 2 hours; stir occasionally. Uncover and cook down to desired thickness. Serve over noodles or rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Enchilada Pie
instructions: Combine and cook all but tortillas for about 15 minutes. Fry tortillas in oil in skillet.

title: New Orleans Praline Bacon
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. On rack of a large broiler pan arrange bacon slices in one layer and cook in middle of oven 10 minutes or until it just begins to turn golden. In a small bowl mix together sugar and chili powder. Remove pan from oven and sprinkle bacon with sugar mixture and top with pecans. Return to oven and cool for as long as you desire. Freezes well for future reheating.\tDo not count on any leftovers.\tI usually make a lot of the sugar - chili powder mix with the chopped pecans mixed in and store in zip-lock in the freezer. Then it is handy for quick fixing. Do not overcook or sugar will blacken.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Spread chopped cabbage in 13 x 9-inch pan. Brown meat and onion. Stir in rice over chopped cabbage. Add meat and onion. Heat tomato soup and water to boiling. Pour over cabbage and meat. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover with foil and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cook meat and drain; butter 9 x 13 pan. Put in layer of white bread cubes or hash browns. Put meat on top of bread or hash browns. Add layer of Cheddar cheese. Pour over the mixture 4 beaten eggs 1 teaspoon salt and 2 cups milk. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour (covered). Add onion and green peppers to top. Also add microwaved Cheez Whiz on top. Also can add sour cream and salsa for topping.

title: Icebox Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix by directions on the box. Add frozen coconut and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Lunchtime Pizza
instructions: Mix together until a firm dough forms. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and divide into 4 equal pieces. Using a floured rolling pin roll each piece into a 7 to 8-inch circle. Place on greased baking sheet.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together with a wire whip and chill at least 4 hours.

title: Cottage Cheese
instructions: Heat sour milk to a temperature of about 98\u00b0 and let stand until it is uniformly warm throughout and the curd separates from the whey. Drain the whey off; add melted butter or cream salt and pepper and serve while fresh. It may be flavored with pimentos chopped olives or chopped nuts. The curd and whey may be separated by pouring boiling water over the milk.

title: Potato Omelet
instructions: Well grease a 12 X 12 pan. Put tater tots in pan. Mix eggs and milk and pour over tatet tots. Top with crumbled bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Top with grated cheese while still hot.

title: Chili Bean Pie
instructions: In medium size casserole dish put 1/2 can chili and beans. Chop onions and add to layer of chili and beans. Add layer of crushed corn chips. Add half of grated cheese. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Bake at 350\u00b0 until onions are done.

title: Basic White Sauce
instructions: Slowly melt margarine. Add flour and salt. Pour in milk gradually stir until thickens. May add onions and mushrooms to margarine before adding flour. After mixture thickens add Worcestershire sauce.

title: Cream Nuts
instructions: Combine sugar and sour cream in a pan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until medium soft-ball forms when dipped in water. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir until light sugar coating.

title: Baked Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until it is almost firm.

title: Molasses Custard Tart
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar flour molasses and butter. Put in unbaked tart shells. Makes 6 small tarts. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until appears done as the consistency of a chess pie.

title: Strawberry, Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Line 9-inch pie plate with half the pastry. Combine rhubarb strawberries sugar salt tapioca and cinnamon and pour mixture into pie shell. Dot with butter. Cover with a lattice top crust. Bake in a hot oven (400\u00b0) for 45 minutes.

title: Ramen Skillet
instructions: Brown ground beef. Sprinkle seasoning packets on cooking ground beef. Drain off grease. Add tomato sauce salsa and onion. Stir well then add broken Ramen noodles. Stir in just a little. Cover and simmer until noodles are tender stirring occasionally. When noodles are done stir until all is combined. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Cover just long enough to melt. Serve with salad and garlic bread. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles(Microwave)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on High for 7 to 8 minutes stirring twice until cucumber is crisp-tender and onion is translucent. Ladle into a glass jar (rinsed with hot water to prevent cracking). Cover; cool slightly and refrigerate. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake.

title: Honeybee Cookies
instructions: Heat the oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine brown sugar honey and egg in a medium bowl on medium speed scraping bowl constantly until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop the dough by teaspoons onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until set and light brown around edges (surfaces of cookies will appear shiny) 7 to 9 minutes. Let stand 3 to 5 minutes before removing from cookie sheet then remove from cookie sheet with metal spatula onto a wire rack. Makes 36 cookies.

title: Roquefort Grapes
instructions: Toast walnuts on a baking sheet in a preheated 275\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Cool and chop coarsely. In the bowl of an electric mixer combine cream cheese Roquefort and cream and beat until smooth. Drop grapes into the cheese mixture and gently stir by hand to coat them. Then roll the coated grapes in the chopped walnuts and put on a sheet pan lined with wax paper. Chil until ready to serve.

title: 2-Chocolate Marble Bars
instructions: Grease loaf pan and line with plastic wrap. Leave extra over edges.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine add sugar cocoa and milk. Boil 2 minutes. Add pecans oatmeal and vanilla flavoring. Stir well and drop on wax paper to cool.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Place pecans on bottom of greased Bundt pan. Place frozen dough rolls on top of pecans. Sprinkle with pudding mix and cinnamon. Melt oleo and brown sugar and drizzle over rolls. Cover with a light cloth and allow to rise overnight (or 6 to 8 hours). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Invert pan over large platter or tray and allow to drip for a few minutes then remove pan.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Cook ground beef; add sauces mushrooms and bell pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes. In a large baking dish place a layer of noodles beef mixture and cheeses. Repeat layers until all are used up. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix butter eggs white sugar and vanilla. Add soda salt flour and chocolate chips. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes large batch.

title: Pretzel Rounds
instructions: Lay round pretzels on foil. Melt square almond bark or white chocolate in microwave; dip by spoon and fill pretzels. Top with M&Ms or for Easter top with small jelly bean.

title: Cherry  Cream  Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until creamy. Add sugar and vanilla and beat until blended. Fold in cool whip. Pour in crust and put 1 or 2 cans cherry pie filling over the top. Refrigerate.

title: Huckleberry Pudding
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat. Add milk and beat. Add sifted dry ingredients. Finally add huckleberries. Do not beat more than necessary after adding dry mixture. Bake in greased pan 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Combine mayonnaise flour eggs and milk. Mix until blended. Stir in crab meat cheese and onions. Pour in a 9-inch pie plate (no crust). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Festive Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together and put them in a greased pan or casserole dish. Combine the remaining ingredients. When well mixed sprinkle on top of potatoes and bake at 375\u00b0 about 25 minutes until golden brown.

title: Berry Special Breakfast Drink
instructions: Blend ingredients in blender until smooth.

title: Not Your Mom'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Cut bread into 1-inch cubes. Spread in a shallow baking pan. Cover loosely and let dry overnight.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat soups water and margarine until margarine melts. Put rice on bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish. Place chicken on top of rice. Pour soups over chicken and rice. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad(Sugar-Free; Good For Dieters)
instructions: Cut fruit into bite size pieces. Add juice for liquid. Sweeten to taste with your favorite non-sugar sweetener.

title: Provencal Dressing
instructions: Put mustard lemon juice garlic and yogurt in a glass bowl. Slowly whisk olive oil in and whisk thoroughly until the mixture thickens. Refrigerate at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend. Especially good with salads containing meat.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle 1 cup grated sharp cheese on top and bake another 15 minutes.

title: Sharon'S Famous Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Place oatmeal in blender or food processor and blend until a fine powder. Combine oatmeal flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Mix well and set aside. Cream butter and sugars until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix butter mixture with flour mixture until completely combined. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by heaping tablespoon on an ungreased cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes (12 minutes for soft and 15 minutes for crisp).

title: Toffee Nut Bar
instructions: Mix flour 1/2 cup brown sugar and butter. Pat this into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Bows And Brie
instructions: Saute garlic crushed in olive oil. Add chopped tomatoes. Stir in Brie; pour bow ties into tomato mixture. Add pine nuts basil salt and pepper.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Soak cucumbers in 1 tablespoon salt and water for 2 hours. Bring to a boil the vinegar sugar and celery seed; pour over cucumbers. Will keep in refrigerator for up to 6 months.

title: Eggless Spice Cake
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together with a fork. Add oil vinegar and water. Stir quickly batter will be thin. Add raisins if desired. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of a 10-inch baking dish or pie plate. Stir together the flour granulated sugar and cinnamon; stir in egg until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches. Pour melted butter over top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Delicious Dip
instructions: Using an electric mixer combine ingredients well and chill. Delicious with potato chips or Fritos.

title: 6 Week Muffins
instructions: Mix together flour soda and salt; add to cereal. Mix oil sugar and eggs together. Mix into dry ingredients. Mix in buttermilk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chili Citrus Chicken
instructions: In small dish mix together chili powder cumin garlic salt and cayenne pepper. Rub mixture on each chicken breast half. In frypan place oil and heat to medium temperature. Add chicken and cook turning about 12 minutes or until chicken is brown and fork can be inserted in chicken with ease. Remove chicken to warm platter and keep warm.

title: Crisscross Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening egg and sugar together. Stir in milk and lemon extract. Sift flour salt cream of tartar and soda together; stir in creamed mixture. Add raisins. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Put on ungreased baking sheet; flatten with fork dipped in water. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Pour in baking dish. Mix next 4 ingredients together and sprinkle over batter mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Green Flash
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Fill tall glasses with ice and pour vodka mixture over ice. Garnish with lime slices and enjoy.

title: Layered Nacho Dip
instructions: Combine beans and seasoning mix. Spread bean mixture in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Layer remaining ingredients in order listed. Serve with chips. Yields 8 cups.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in the buttermilk. Set aside. In large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Stir in yeast/buttermilk mixture. Mix well. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 3 to 4 times. Roll to a 1/2 inch thickness. Cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on a greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm place about 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Lightly brush tops with melted butter. Yield about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat; add other ingredients and place in a pie shell.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Combine flour and brown sugar. Cut butter into the mixture to make coarse crumbs. In another bowl combine molasses egg and 3/4 cup hot water. Stir soda into 1/4 cup hot water. Immediately fold into molasses mixture. Pour half of the molasses mixture into pie shell. Top with half of crumbs all but 1/4 cup of remaining molasses mixture in a spiral over top of pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until nicely browned and center appears firm when pie plate is gently shaken. Cool to room temperature before cutting.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar margarine milk and cocoa in a large saucepan. Stir this often as you bring the mixture to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter oatmeal and vanilla; mix quickly. Spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet and let them cool. Kids love them!!!

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion and garlic powder. Add meat and brown. Add flour salt pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup; simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through. If sherry is used double the amount of flour and add sherry with soup. Serve over egg noodles or rice.

title: Sue'S Hominy Pudding
instructions: Mix hominy with eggs milk sugar salt and sliced fruit. Place in a buttered deep baking dish and sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon. Set dish in a pan with 1/2 cup of water (the water should come halfway up sides of dish). Bake in a preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Test after 45 minutes with knife edge. If knife comes out clean pudding is done. The center will set as pudding cools.) Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa together. Remove from heat. Add sugar and eggs. Mix well with mixer. Add flour salt nuts coconut and vanilla. Pour in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Put marshmallow cream on while warm.

title: Savory Pot Roast
instructions: Brown meat slowly in small amount of hot oil. Sprinkle meat with salt.\tCombine vinegar oil catsup soy sauce worcestershire rosemary garlic powder and mustard; pour over roast. Cover tightly and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until tender. Remove roast and heat sauce to skim excess fat; spoon sauce over meat. Serves 6 to 8. Delicious with mashed potatoes.

title: Apea Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and add sugar lard and margarine. Work with hands and then add sour milk. Work it like you do pie dough. Then roll in batter cake.

title: Sweet Potato Pear Bake
instructions: 1. Drain pears reserve 2 Tbsp. of juice (discard remaining juice or save for another use).

title: Strawberry Kiwi Tart
instructions: You can use any fresh fruit not frozen.

title: Easy No-Fail Pot Roast
instructions: Line pan with heavy-duty foil large enough to wrap around roast. Place roast in foil and sprinkle top with 2 to 3 tablespoons steak sauce. Add mushroom soup and onion soup. Seal foil around roast and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour a pound. Serve with rice. Different types of creamed soup will result in a variety of gravies.

title: David'S Perfect Pizza Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water in bowl. Stir in sugar oil egg and flour. Knead until smooth and elastic. Let rise in warm place for 20 minutes. Punch dough down. Spread into 2 nonstick pizza pans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top with your favorite pizza toppings. Bake until cheese is lightly browned. Yields 2 pizza crusts.

title: Frozen Passion
instructions: Blend ingredients well. Pour into ice cream freezer. Proceed according to the operating instructions for freezer. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Diabetic Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift first 7 ingredients. Add shortening mashed bananas and eggs. Beat until smooth. Fold in oats. Drop cookies by teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes approximately 32 cookies.

title: Zucchini Bisque
instructions: Simmer the onion zucchini and chicken stock for 15 minutes.

title: Baked Fudge
instructions: Beat eggs until lemon colored; add dry ingredients. Mix well. Add melted butter and stir in remaining ingredients with the exception of the whipped cream. Pour into 12 x 8-inch pan. Set pan in a larger pan of water and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until set like custard. Serve warm with whipped cream. A chocolate lovers dream!

title: Mrs. Smearly'S Potato Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Combine potatoes shortening sugar salt and warm milk. Cool to lukewarm. Add yeast and egg. Stir in flour. Knead on floured board until smooth. Place in greased bowl turning once to grease all sides. Cover and let rise 1 hour; punch down. Roll in a ball and let rest for 10 minutes. Roll out on floured board; shape into rolls or cut. Place on greased pan and let rest 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields approximately 2 dozen.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Put pecans and coconut in bottom of pan. Mix up cake mix according to the directions on the box. Pour over nuts and coconut. Melt oleo and cream cheese in microwave. Mix in powdered sugar. Pour into cake mix swirl being careful not to stir up nuts and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Enchilada Pie
instructions: Brown the hamburger and chopped onion. Add the enchilada sauce mushroom soup cream of chicken soup Ortega peppers ripe olives and milk. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add the corn tortillas cubed. Mix and top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix first 5 ingredients. Add elbow macaroni celery green peppers and onion. Toss to coat. Cover and chill. Makes 5 cups.

title: Fresh Tomato Casserole
instructions: In skillet melt butter. Add seasonings. Saute celery pepper and onion until crispy tender. (This may be done ahead of time.) Add stuffing and toss. Add tomatoes and sugar; toss gently. Cover and cook until tomatoes are hot yet firm 10 to 12 minutes. Serves 5.

title: Oven Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line baking sheet with foil and coat well with vegetable cooking spray. Scrub potatoes well and cut into 1/2-inch thick strips. In a large bowl toss potatoes with oil sugar salt and cayenne pepper. Spread on baking sheet in one layer. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Hermits
instructions: Cream butter in a bowl. Add all other ingredients except flour. Mix well then add flour gradually until well mixed. Drop on cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Saute onions in 1/4 cup of bacon drippings. Add sugar salt garlic powder dry mustard and vinegar. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Mix this with all the beans (drain the butter lima and kidney beans but not the baked beans) and the molasses in crock-pot. Cook on low 5 or 6 hours.

title: Black Bean Salsa
instructions: Combine. Chill and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth then all the remaining ingredients. Mix well and chill.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Layer in the order listed. Bake for 1 hour. Good served warm or cold.

title: Cauliflower Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook the cauliflower until firm yet tender. Coarsely mash cauliflower with potato masher. Add the sour cream onion cheese salt and pepper. Mix well.

title: Hot Milk Sponge Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in last. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream And Hamburger Layered Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef in melted butter in a large skillet over medium heat until meat is browned stirring to crumble meat; drain well. Add tomato sauce and next 4 ingredients; stir well. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Transfer meat mixture to a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Set aside. Beat cream cheese and sour cream at low speed of electric mixer until smooth. Add green onions stirring gently to combine. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly over meat mixture. Top with noodles. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over casserole. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Yield 8 servings.

title: Million Dollar Spaghetti(Casserole)
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Saute beef in butter until brown. (If too fatty drain off.) Add tomato sauce salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Combine cottage cheese cream cheese sour cream scallions and green pepper. In a square 2-quart casserole spread 1/2 of the spaghetti and cover with cheese mixture. Add remainder of spaghetti and pour melted butter over spaghetti (optional). Spread tomato/meat sauce over top and chill. Remove from refrigerator 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Especially good served with green salad and French bread. Serves 6.

title: Low-Fat, Low Sodium Biscuits(Variation:  Old Fashioned Biscuits)
instructions: Fix two 8-inch cake pans with enough safflower oil to dip biscuits in.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour oatmeal salt soda and baking powder. In another bowl cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix in dry ingredients and chocolates. Can add 3 cups chopped nuts if desired. Roll into balls and place 2-inches apart on a cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine chunky peanut butter chocolate syrup and milk in a bowl. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and freeze.

title: Mom'S Beer Bread
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Brush top with butter while hot.

title: Turkey Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles-drain-rinse-drain again. In large bowl stir together soups Parmesan cheese garlic powder sour cream and chopped onion. Add turkey. In a 9 X 13 inch casserole/cake pan layer 1/3 of cooked noodles spread with 1/3 of turkey mixture sprinkle with 1/3 of shredded cheese. Repeat 2 times. Save cheese to sprinkle on before serving. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45-60 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cap'N Crunch Candy
instructions: Melt white chocolate. Mix together all other ingredients. Mix chocolate with the other ingredients and press into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan or drizzle chocolate over other ingredients in 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Chill until firm. Break or cut into pieces or squares.

title: Surprise Pound Cake
instructions: Follow directions on cake mix. Drain pineapple and save juice. Add water to juice to make a cup. Add to batter then add remaining ingredients. Mix and pour into tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oleo and crackers; mix well. Spread in greased 9 x 12-inch dish. Mix oleo and crushed crackers together. Sprinkle over vegetables. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls. Press into slightly greased pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Oatmeal Carmelitas
instructions: Blend together flour oats brown sugar baking soda and salt. Add enough margarine to hold mixture together. Press 1/2 of mixture into a greased 9 X 13 pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans over first layer. Blend caramel with 2 Tbsp. flour and spoon over chips and nuts. Sprinkle the other 1/2 of crumb mixture on top. Bake 20 minutes or more. Cool completely or chill before cutting.

title: Good Old Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen beans according to package directions; drain. Combine beans milk soup and pepper. Add 1/2 can onions; pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or microwave covered 8 to 10 minutes. Top with 1/2 can onions and pimiento; bake 5 minutes longer or microwave uncovered on High 1 minute then let stand 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer all ingredients topping with the combined mayonnaise and dressing mix. Sprinkle the cheese on top of the dressing and chill.

title: Graham Cracker Pralines
instructions: Line cookie sheet with graham crackers. Heat butter and brown sugar in saucepan. Add pecans and stir together. Spoon out onto graham crackers. Bake 10 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven. Cool before taking out of cookie sheet.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the first 3 ingredients. Sift the flour cream of tartar soda and salt together and stir into first mixture. Chill dough. Roll into small balls. Roll balls in a mixture of the sugar and cinnamon. Place about 2-inches apart on ungreased pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 until lightly browned but still soft. These puff up at first and then flatten out with crinkled tops. Makes about 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Skillet Supper
instructions: Place cabbage pieces in skillet. Add carrots potatoes and meat. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour 2 cups of water over all. Place lid on skillet. Simmer for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Stephanie'S Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine onion Rot-tel tomatoes soup (no water added) chicken Velveeta (cubed) and Doritos (crushed). Mix well and pour into casserole dish. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Microwave 5 to 6 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Garbanzo Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except onion in blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into bowl and add chopped onion. Refrigerate until ready to serve on bread or crackers.

title: Gouda Zucchini
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter in a large skillet. Add mushrooms. Salt and pepper to taste. Lay zucchini slices on top. Add pimento. Cover skillet and cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Lay cheese slices over top. Cover skillet until cheese melts. Leftovers are good. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: In small saucepan sprinkle gelatin over 1/4 cup orange juice. Cook over low heat; stir constantly until gelatin dissolves. Remove from heat; stir in balance of orange juice lemon juice rind and Sweet N Low. Chill until syrupy. In small bowl combine dry milk and water. Beat at high speed until peaks. Gently stir in gelatin mix. Blend well. Pour in shallow pan. Freeze until firm. Makes 4 servings.

title: Block Party Beans
instructions: In large dutch oven brown beef over medium high heat. Drain fat. Add onion and celery; cook until tender. Stir in soup tomato paste and ketchup. Simmer 15-20min. Spoon into large kettle or roaster. Add all remaining ingredients; stir well. Bake uncovered 350\u00b0 1 hour. Yields 25 servings.

title: Garden Salad
instructions: Stir and refrigerate for later use.

title: Pink Bride Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Dissolve Kool-Aid in cold water. Add sugar; mix well. Add pineapple juice. Add sherbet and 7-Up when ready to serve.

title: Low-Calorie Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Brown chopped meat drain and add to spaghetti sauce.

title: Pineapple Delight Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add the remaining ingredients. The horseradish is important in this recipe. Do not omit.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Remove crusts from bread and spread bread slices with butter or margarine. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside. Cook sausage until brown stirring to crumble; drain well. Spoon over bread slice; sprinkle with cheese. Combine eggs half and half or milk and salt. Mix well and pour over cheese. Cover casserole and chill overnight.

title: Stew(6 Hours)
instructions: *You can use 3 tablespoons flour or cornstarch in place of tapioca.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute mushrooms onions and celery in butter. Mix together all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 just until bubbly.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: In a large bowl thaw strawberries and add eggs and oil. Mix well. In another bowl sift flour soda salt cinnamon and sugar together. Add strawberry mixture to flour mixture. Add pecans if desired and mix well. Pour into two buttered and floured loaf pans; bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix graham crackers and melted margarine together and press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan and set aside. Cream sugar and cream cheese together and pour over crust. Sprinkle chopped nuts over cream cheese mixture. Mix 2 packages of Dream Whip according to directions on box and spread over nuts. Refrigerate for 2 hours until Dream Whip sets. Cover with cherry or blueberry pie filling and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Steamed Veggies With Rice(Serves 4)
instructions: In a 2 1/2-quart saucepan bring 1 1/2 cups water and salt to a boil. Add rice. Cover with tight fitting lid. Bring mixture to a boil then remove pan from heat. Let stand 30 minutes. Do not lift the lid during this time.

title: Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes in half. Scoop out potatoes leaving thick shells. Mash potatoes with other ingredients. Refill shells. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Fat free.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Mix hard to remove lumps. Makes two (1-quart) cans or one (3-pound) Crisco can. Steam 1 hour for 1-quart can and 3 hours for 3-pound can.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a 370\u00b0 oven for approximately 35 minutes or until lightly brown using a large rectangle pan. Refrigerate leftovers. This freezes well.

title: Rose'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown sausage. Add onion and other ingredients. Simmer until thick stirring often about 2 to 3 hours.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers into 1/8-inch slices without paring. Slice the onions likewise. Cut green peppers into fine bits. Mix the salt through the combined cucumbers onions and green peppers. Place a weighted lid on them and let stand 3 hours. Drain and set aside.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Open chilies and squeeze juice into the refried beans. Mix with 1/2 package taco seasoning. Spread bean mixture on platter. Mix other half of package seasoning into sour cream. Spread sour cream over beans. Arrange chilies then olives then tomatoes and onion over sour cream. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over dish right before serving. If you take this somewhere keep cheese in separate container then add before serving. Serve with Doritos.

title: Petite Pecan Pies
instructions: Divide into walnut size balls and shape into muffin tin.

title: Tomato Zucchini Stew
instructions: In a 4-quart Dutch oven brown and crumble sausage. Add celery and cook for 15 minutes; drain. Add tomatoes tomato juice zucchini and seasonings. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add corn and peppers. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Combine cornstarch and water; stir into stew. Bring to a boil and cook and stir until mixture thickens. Sprinkle with cheese. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Chop marshmallows and dissolve marshmallows and jello in hot water. Add juice from pineapple. Chill until syrupy. Combine cream cheese and pineapple; add nuts. Mix in jello mixture. Put in mold. Serves 11 to 12.

title: Chicken In A Skillet
instructions: Coat chicken in flour then brown in skillet in oil. Peel and slice carrot and lay slices over the chicken pieces. Mix soup and seasoning. Pour over chicken. Cover and cook slowly over medium heat for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: O' Henry Bars
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter stirring until smooth. Put cereal in large bowl and pour peanut butter mixture over it. Mix well. Press into buttered 12 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Melt chocolate chips and spread over top. Allow to cool and cut into bars or small squares.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Bake cake mix according to the directions in a tube or 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice into slices when cool. Layer slices of cake pineapple strawberries and pudding until large bowl is full. Spread Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Best if refrigerated for several hours before serving.

title: Instant Cocoa
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container. Add heaping 1/3 cup mix to a full cup of hot water.

title: Festival Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage red cabbage carrot onion and cashews in a medium bowl; toss gently. Combine vinegar and remaining ingredients. Cover and chill thoroughly. Yield 8 servings (43 calories per 1/2 cup serving).

title: Creamy Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O pudding and 2 cups water in pan. Cook to a boil; cook for 5 minutes longer. Cool and put lid on pan and put in freezer until it congeals about 1 hour. Beat in Cool Whip and stir in oranges; place in dish.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream the sugar and oil together. Add eggs and pumpkin. Mix well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients alternately with water. Pour into two well-greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove from pan to cool. May add nuts.

title: Summer Pasta
instructions: In a large serving bowl mix all ingredients except pasta and cheese. Cook pasta according to package directions. Toss pasta with tomato mixture. Chill. Add cheese before serving and toss gently.

title: Roast Pork Tenderloin With Vegetables
instructions: Salt and generously pepper pork tenderloin. Mix together lime juice and wine. Pour over tenderloin. Marinate in refrigerator for 30 to 45 minutes. Reserve liquid. Spray glass roasting pan with olive oil spritzer (or cover bottom of dish with 2 tablespoons olive oil). Place tenderloin in center of roasting pan. Place prepared vegetables on both sides of pork. Pour reserved marinade liquid over pork and vegetables. Sprinkle salt garlic powder oregano paprika and remaining black pepper. Pour stewed tomatoes over mixture. Drizzle remaining tablespoon of olive oil over vegetables or give vegetables a quick spray of oil with spritzer. Cover loosely with foil. Roast in 450\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Uncover for last 20 minutes.

title: Pancakes
instructions: This is best if left in the refrigerator overnight so that it gains some volume. It is very thin if used as soon as made but it is still delicious.

title: Chicken Fried Pork Chops
instructions: Mix eggs and milk. Dip meat in egg mixture then in crumbs. Brown on both sides in skillet. Season with salt. Add water and cover. Cook over low heat 45 to 60 minutes. Lift chops occasionally to prevent sticking.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Mix together and drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool slightly before removing from pan.

title: Angel Food-Sherbet Cake
instructions: Slice angel food cake horizontally in middle; separate. Slice 1-inch pieces of sherbet and place on bottom layer of cake. Cover all of bottom layer with sherbet. Place top layer of cake. Refreeze. Cut wedges and serve. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Put dressing mix and flour in plastic bag and shake with chicken one piece at a time. Melt margarine and mix with lemon juice. Spray baking pan with Pam. Place chicken breasts in pan. Spoon lemon juice mix over chicken pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Add 3/4 cup water and bake 15 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Apple Slice
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Cut in Crisco. Put egg yolk in cup; add enough milk to measure 2/3 cup. Add to crust mixture mixing well. Roll into 11 x 15-inch rectangle. Place in raised edge cookie sheet. Cover with crushed corn flakes and apples mixed with the cinnamon and 1 1/2 cups sugar. Roll the rest of the dough for top crust. Brush top with egg white. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Glaze.

title: Microwave Soap
instructions: Save your broken pieces of bath soap by dropping in a quart jar with lid. Keep closed. When full place soap in bowl in microwave. Set on Medium power about 10 minutes. When soap chips begin to puff up stir. Do this several times. Spray small plastic containers with pan coating. When soap chips are melted use a spoon back dipped in water to pat soup firmly down in containers. Let dry overnight and cut to size if too large. Let dry a week before use.

title: Grinch Pudding
instructions: Boil water for Jell-O as directed on packages. Mix both packs of Jell-O with the boiled water. Stir until dissolved. Put several ice cubes in and stir until Jell-O begins to thicken. Remove the remaining ice and chill Jell-O in refrigerator until it becomes firmer but not completely set. Mix in Cool Whip whatever amount looks good to you. Mix in drained pineapple tidbits and chopped walnuts and refrigerate for at least 2 more hours.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together well. Form into a ball. Chill. Top with preserves before serving.

title: Polenta(Microwave)
instructions: Mix together until smooth in a large microwave-safe bowl. Add 3 cups boiling water; stir well. Cover with Saran wrap and microwave on High for 7 to 10 minutes. Remove; stir well. If too thick more water may be added. Put back into microwave for 7 to 10 more minutes on High. This is done in 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Fudge
