instructions: In large bowl mix chocolate chips peanut butter and marshmallow and stand aside. In large saucepan melt butter slowly. Add evaporated milk and sugar; stir continuously to rolling boil for 7 minutes. Pour over chocolate chip mix. Add vanilla; stir until blended. Put in pan and chill.

title: Cheddar Ball
instructions: Bring Cheddar cheese and cream cheese to room temperature. Add milk green onion pimento and Worcestershire sauce to cheeses. Mix well. Cover after shaping into a ball. Chill 4 to 24 hours.

title: Pineapple Squares
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add dry ingredients. Mix until crumbly. Add half the beaten eggs. Mix well. Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Spread with pineapple. Mix 1 cup sugar butter and coconut. Add remaining eggs. Mix well. Spread over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Cream butter; add cocoa and sugar alternating with milk. Beat to spread. Blend in vanilla. Makes 2 cups of frosting.

title: P.B.K. Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use floured hands to mix together all ingredients. Roll into 1 1/4-inch balls and bake 12 minutes. Remove and immediately push a Hersheys Kiss into the center.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix food coloring and cocoa; set aside. Cream Crisco and sugar together. Add eggs to sugar and beat. Add food coloring mixture and mix well. Add buttermilk. Add remaining ingredients and beat. Mix well. Bake in well-greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes (2 pans).

title: Sunset Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O gelatin and salt in boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and lemon juice. Chill until very thick. Then fold in carrots and pecans.\tPour into individual molds or a 1-quart\tmold. Chill until firm. Unmold. Garnish with additional pineapple if desired. Makes about 3 cups or 6 side salads.

title: Christmas Ribbon Salad
instructions: Add 1 cup boiling water to lime Jell-O. Dissolve and add 3/4 cup cold water. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill until set. Add 1 cup boiling water to lemon Jell-O; dissolve. Stir in marshmallows. Let cool and add cream cheese. Beat until blended. Chill until slightly thickened then blend in whipped cream pineapple and salad dressing. Chill until thick. Spoon over lime Jell-O and chill until set. Dissolve raspberry in 1 cup boiling water then add 3/4 cup cold water. Let stand until thick then pour over lime and lemon mixture. Chill until firm.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix. Use an 8 x 8-inch square pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix all prepared ingredients in large bowl. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Brown cornflakes in butter for topping. Put first ingredients into baking dish and top with cornflakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tuna And Potato Chip Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Place 1/3 of crushed chips in 1 1/2-quart casserole. In medium bowl combine remaining ingredients except chips. Spread half of tuna mixture over chips. Top with another 1/3 of chips and remaining tuna. Sprinkle remaining chips over top. Microwave at High 4 to 6 minutes or until heated rotating dish 1/4 turn after half the cooking time.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Pull mushroom stems and wash. Mix all other ingredients. Fill mushroom caps with cream cheese mixture. Broil until brown and bubbly.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Blend in egg; add milk. Sift dry ingredients together and blend into first ingredients. Spread batter in greased 9-inch pan. Arrange apple slices on top of batter pressing them slightly into the batter. Combine sugar substitute and cinnamon and sprinkle on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Yield 16 (2 inch) squares. Carbohydrate 23 g protein 2 g fat 4 g calories 136. One square = 1 bread starch exchange 1 fat exchange 1 fruit exchange.

title: Banana Split
instructions: Mix together cracker crumbs and oleo. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat powdered sugar eggs and oleo until fluffy then add vanilla and beat again. Spread over cracker crumbs. Cut bananas and put on filling. Drain pineapple and put over bananas. Top with Cool Whip. Add nuts and cherries on top. Chill overnight.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix together; bake in a loaf pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Melting Moments
instructions: Mix flour cornstarch and sugar. Blend in butter to form a soft dough. Cover and chill until dough is firm. Shape into small balls or teaspoonfuls. Roll in coconut. Place on ungreased baking sheet 1 1/2 inches apart. (For Christmas sprinkle with colored sugar.) Flatten with fork. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and chill. Serve with raw broccoli cauliflower carrots celery and cucumbers.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: In medium-sized bowl mix cream cheese onion Worcestershire sauce and ham or beef. Stir until well mixed and keep in refrigerator until ready to use. Serve on crackers or mini-rye loaf bread.

title: Shrimp Paste
instructions: Combine shrimp and onion in a food processor or blender. (If you dont own a food processor then chop finely for dip.) Cover and process. Combine shrimp mixture Worcestershire sauce vinegar pepper and salt. Stir in enough mayonnaise to make of spreading consistency. Serve with bread or crackers. Makes 2 cups.

title: Betty'S Zuke Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in greased bread tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Golden Pie Crust
instructions: Mix and blend. Add to flour mixture. Lift with 2 forks until blended. Pat into ball and refrigerate at least 15 minutes. Makes 4 one crust pies or 2 doubles. Can be frozen and rolled later. Brush top crust with canned cream.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Beat in sugar syrup butter salt vanilla and pecans. Pour into 2 pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Put peppers sugar vinegar and butter in large pot and mix thoroughly. Place over high heat and bring to a full boil stirring constantly. Stir in pectin. Bring back to full boil. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Ladle quickly into hot jars to within 1/8-inch of top. Place covers on and invert jars for 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 jars.

title: Caramel Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well until creamy. Ready to eat. Serve with sliced Granny Smith apples.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Put browned hamburger in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix other ingredients and spread over hamburger. Sprinkle cheese then Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Sheath Cake
instructions: Cake Combine in saucepan and bring to a boil; 1 stick margarine 1/4 c. cocoa shortening and water. Combine in a bowl; flour cinnamon sugar and soda. Combine the two mixtures together. Gradually add buttermilk and eggs. Pour into sheath pan and bake for 20 minutes in 400 degree oven.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwich
instructions: Saute beef onion and celery in skillet until lightly browned. Add all other ingredients except buns. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve over buns. Serves 6.

title: Better Butter Beans
instructions: Saute celery and onion in margarine for about 3 minutes. Add tomatoes and chilies salt sugar and pepper. Add butter beans; cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Blend into sauce in blender. For thick sauce chill for 2 hours.

title: Hot Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: In skillet saute pecans with butter over low gas flame until lightly browned; drain and set aside. Combine all remaining ingredients mixing well. Spoon mixture into a buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish; top with pecans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 gas oven for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serve hot with assorted crackers chips or breadsticks. Yield about 4 cups.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Mix jam sugar and mayonnaise. Add soda hot water spices and flour. Bake in two 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool; frost with caramel icing.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Combine ingredients; bake in greased 2-quart casserole pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until rice is done.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: First add all wet ingredients including zucchini. Then add all the dry ingredients. Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in mixing bowl. Leave 1/2 of the catsup. Form into loaf and place in baking dish. Pour remaining catsup over loaf and bake in moderate oven for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter an 8 or 9-inch square pan. In small bowl mix the flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. In large bowl at medium speed beat peanut butter and butter until well blended. Gradually beat in brown sugar and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each addition. Beat in banana and vanilla. Add dry ingredients; beat just until blended. Stir in nuts and chips. Spread in baking pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until cake pulls away from pan. Cool on wire rack; cut into squares. Cover with plastic wrap. Serve the next day. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Makes about 16 (2-inch) squares.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Layer in casserole. Put dry crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until squash is tender.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat eggs. Add all ingredients. Cook 40 minutes at 225\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Cut up potatoes tomatoes and onions. Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple and juice to a boil. Add jello and remove from heat. Mix well. Cool. Combine Cool Whip and buttermilk together. Mix well. After pineapple and jello are cooled mix all ingredients together and mix well. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in baking dish. Cover with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Aggression Cookies
instructions: Put all ingredients in huge bowl and mash knead squeeze slap and beat. Form dough into walnut size balls. Butter bottom of small glass then dip the glass in granulated sugar and use the glass to smash the balls flat. You need to butter glass 1 to 2 times but re-dip it in sugar for each ball. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12minutes.

title: Chicken Fricassee
instructions: In a plastic bag combine the flour salt pepper and paprika. Set aside. Skin chicken and rinse. Add chicken to the bag shaking to coat well. In a skillet cook chicken in hot oil over medium heat till lightly browned. Remove chicken from skillet set aside. Drain fat reserving 2 tbsp. of the drippings in the skillet. Add mushrooms onion green pepper or celery to skillet. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Stir in chicken broth and desired herbs. Bring to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Bring to a boil again and then reduce heat. Cover and simmer 35 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken and vegetables from skillet set aside. Skim fat from pan. Measure 3/4 cup of the pan juices and return to the skillet. Stir milk into 1 tbsp. of flour. Stir mixture into pan juices. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir one minute more. Spoon some of the sauce over chicken. Spoon remaining sauce over hot cooked noodles.

title: Homemade Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in the top of a double boiler. Add very gradually the water or milk. Stir and cook these ingredients over not in hot water for 8 to 12 minutes or until it thickens. Cover and cook for 10 minutes more. Stir occasionally. Remove mixture from the heat. Pour a little of it over 3 beaten egg yolks; beat this and return to mixture in a double boiler. Cook and stir gently about 5 minutes more. Remove from heat. Beat in 3 tablespoons butter 1/3 to 1/2 cup lemon juice (real juice 1 large or 1 1/2 medium lemons) and 2 teaspoons grated lemon rind. Cool. Pour custard into the cold pie shell. Cover with meringue.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix crushed pretzels 1/3 cup sugar and margarine. Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 10 minutes; cool. Beat cream cheese 1/4 cup sugar and milk until smooth. Stir in Cool Whip. Spread over crust; refrigerate. Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved. Stir in cold water. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours or until thickened. Stir in strawberries. Spoon over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate 3 hours or until firm. Cut into squares. Garnish as desired. Makes 15 to 18 servings.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar. Brown in iron skillet. Gradually add water. Beat egg yolks. Add small amount of milk. Add the balance of milk and salt. Pour this slowly into the sugar mixture; cook until thick stirring constantly until thick. Cool and pour into a baked pie shell.

title: Apple Cake(Good And Very Easy!)
instructions: Peel and dice apples into a bowl. Add eggs cooking oil sugar vanilla and butter flavor extract. Mix well. Stir in flour which has been sifted in baking soda and cinnamon. Mix well. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes (test with a toothpick).

title: Supper Strata
instructions: Place flour slices of bread on bottom of 8-inch square baking dish. Cover with 6 process cheese spread slices ham and remaining process cheese spread slices. Combine eggs milk onion and seasonings. Pour half of egg and milk mixture over process cheese spread. Top with remaining bread and egg and milk mixture. Cover. Refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Burna Broed(Brown Spice Cookies)
instructions: In a large bowl mix all of the ingredients except the granulated sugar. Knead quickly. Chill. Shape the dough into a long roll 1/2-inch wide. Cut off small pieces of the dough and roll into balls. Dip the balls into the granulated sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 on a buttered cookie sheet for about 12 minutes.

title: Big Batch Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine eggs brown sugar sugar and vanilla. Mix well until creamy. Add flour salt cinnamon baking powder and soda that has been sifted together. Mix well. Add oatmeal and mix. Add chips or candies or nuts. Drop by tablespoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes. Makes 275 to 300 cookies.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix well together all ingredients. Put into buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle topping on top of potato mixture.

title: English Trifle
instructions: In large trifle bowl or punch bowl break angel food cake in small pieces. Mix jello as directed on boxes. When cool pour over cake pieces-slice bananas on top of this-Next layer sliced strawberries. Mix pudding as directed on box when thick pour over sliced fruit. Spoon cool whip on top and garnish with fresh strawberries and roasted chopped nuts. Chill in refrigerator. Very pretty as well as cool and refreshing.

title: Milk And Cinnamon Ice
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove cinnamon stick and lemon rind; let mixture cool. Beat egg whites until they form soft peaks gradually adding the 1/4 cup sugar while beating. Gently fold egg whites into milk mixture. Pour into 2 ice cube trays; freeze 2 to 3 hours (stirring occasionally) until set. Spoon into sherbet glasses and sprinkle lightly with powdered cinnamon.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix flour margarine and pecans. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Mix 1 cup Cool Whip powdered sugar and cream cheese; spread over crust. Mix both puddings and milk until thickened; spread over cream cheese layer. Top with the rest of the Cool Whip and chill for 2 to 3 hours before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Put popped corn in a doubled brown paper grocery bag. In a 2-quart casserole put the brown sugar margarine syrup and salt. Bring to a boil on High and microwave for 2 minutes. Stir then take out and add baking soda. Stir well and pour over popcorn. Roll bag up tight and shake. Microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes then shake. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes more and shake.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix oil dressing and dill weed. Add crackers and mix well. Stir again every 15 minutes. Ready in about an hour. These crackers keep well if sealed in a Ziploc bag.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and red pepper 3 times. Mix butter with cheese. Add dry ingredients using a fork and/or fingers.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix together for 15 minutes the powdered sugar margarine and eggs. Crumble the graham crackers into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Drain well 1 large can crushed pineapple and spread on top of egg mixture. Slice 4 to 5 bananas on top of pineapple. Top with 1 large Cool Whip. Cut maraschino cherries in half and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Refrigerate for 12 hours.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix together. Batter should be kind of stiff. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Turn once. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Deep Dish Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In saucepan cook celery in margarine until tender. If using celery soup add to chicken broth. Thicken chicken broth with flour and milk. Do not make it real thick. Pour in chicken carrots potatoes and peas.

title: Hawaiian Sunset Cake(3 Layer Cake)
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Stew
instructions: Brown sausage and onions together. Drain off grease. Put drained sausage and onions in cooking pot. Add beans (do not drain beans). Add diced tomatoes and salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low to med. heat for 20 to 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Saute onion and spices in oil for 1 minute. Add soy sauce peas and water. Bring to a boil; simmer 1 hour. Add potato and celery; cook an additional 30 minutes.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together pineapple and sugar; bring to a boil. Pour over warm cake. Cook pudding according to package directions. While still warm pour over pineapple mixture. Cool and top with Cool Whip. Must be kept in the refrigerator.

title: Healthy Chili
instructions: Saute turkey onion and bell pepper in a skillet that has been sprayed with Pam. Peel tomatoes chop and add to turkey mixture along with cilantro and chili powder. Stir add bouillon cubes and water. Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour.

title: Koch Kasse
instructions: Cut up cheese and oleo. Add milk and flour. Cook over medium heat until melted and the right texture for spreading. Add caraway seed and pour into container.

title: Basic Quiche
instructions: You can also add broccoli or whatever you desire.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix water and sugar in a pan and bring to a boil. Boil 4 minutes and let cool.

title: Cheese And Potato Soup
instructions: Add broth and other ingredients listed above to pot. Bring to a boil reduce heat to medium and cook for 10 minutes. Check for doneness of potatoes and adjust cooking time to allow for tenderness of potatoes (very soft). 3 cups milk Slowly add milk to broth and stir thoroughly until milk/broth is warmed together. 1/3 cup flour 1 cup cold water In separate mixing cup slowly add flour to COLD water and mix thoroughly. Pour mixture slowly into broth/vegetables stirring as you add it. This will thicken the broth. 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese (mild or medium); 1/4 cup (approx.) at a time Add cheese to broth stirring until melted. Repeat until all cheese has been added.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together leaving one bacon strip to place on the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Never-Fail Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together in 10 x 8-inch utility dish. Drop butter onto sugar mixture in 4 to 5 pieces. Pour in milk. Microwave 2 to 3 minutes on High or until bubbly. Stir lightly. Thoroughly stir in nuts and vanilla so nuts are evenly distributed. Spread fudge evenly in dish. Refrigerate 1 hour. Cut into squares. Makes approximately 2 dozen pieces.

title: Karen'S Baked Fish Soupreme
instructions: Place fish fillets in a greased baking dish. If using small shrimp sprinkle them over fish and pour soup over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until fish is tender and flakes.

title: Quick Stuff Turkey Breast
instructions: Cook Stove Top stuffing as directed. Cut cheese in strips. Take one slice of turkey breast and add 2 strips of cheese and 1 tablespoon of stuffing to turkey breast; roll up as many as you want and put in large frypan. Then add gravy. Let simmer on top of stove for 10 minutes covered. Serve with mashed potatoes and your favorite vegetable.

title: Golden Nut Bars
instructions: Blend crumbs pecans sugar and baking powder. Beat egg whites and salt until stiff not dry peaks are formed. Fold in the crumb mixture a small amount at a time. Turn into an ungreased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan and spread evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into bars. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Cheese Strata
instructions: Arrange bread slices in bottom of lightly buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups of cheese. Beat eggs milk and seasonings in medium bowl until well blended. Pour over cheese. Sprinkle with remaining 1 1/2 cups cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until light golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Beat with mixer the peanut butter margarine and vanilla real well. Add powdered sugar and mix well. Add nuts and coconut. Mix well. Roll in small balls and place on cookie sheets lined with waxed paper. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Chop the cabbage and put in salt. Let stand 1 hour. Drain and add celery and pepper. Boil the vinegar sugar celery seed and mustard seed. While hot pour over cabbage. Cool and store. Real good on barbecue sandwiches.

title: Cheese Log
instructions: Place cream cheese and Cheddar in bowl until room temperature. Once room temperature add garlic. Place mixture on wax paper. Form into log. On another piece of wax paper pour chili seasons. Then roll log through seasoning and wrap up in wax paper and refrigerate overnight. This should make 2 large logs.

title: Salmon Balls
instructions: Pour juice from salmon into measuring cup. Set aside 1/4 cup juice.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix together. Form into balls and brown; drain.

title: Mock Mayonnaise(30 Calories Per Tablespoon)
instructions: In covered blender container at medium speed blend all ingredients until smooth scraping the container with a rubber spatula as necessary. Cover and refrigerate. Use within 2 weeks. Makes 1 cup.

title: Honey Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine fruit and nuts in a large bowl. Combine orange juice lemon juice and honey in a small bowl; mix well. Pour over fruit tossing gently. Chill thoroughly.

title: Chicken Creole
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in oil until limp. Add chicken rice spaghetti sauce and nutmeg. Simmer covered over low heat for 45 minutes or bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all together and put in buttered dish. Add a few cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots just until tender then cool. Mix all ingredients and pour over carrots. Marinate 12 hours and drain.

title: Cookie Brittle
instructions: Cream butter salt and vanilla; add sugar gradually. Add flour and chocolate chips. Press in pan and sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Break into pieces.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Stir in egg milk and vanilla. Fold in flour baking powder and salt. Refrigerate overnight. Knead dough. Roll out and cut. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 8 1/2 minutes only. Cool.

title: Cheese Rice
instructions: Bring water to boiling point. Add butter salt and rice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook covered for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Stir cheese onion and mustard into hot rice.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Cook sugar and cream until mixture reaches the soft ball stage. Beat until creamy. If the frosting gets too hard before you get it all on beat in a little cream.

title: Homemade Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. In large bowl pour boiling water over shortening and dissolve. Add sugar salt eggs flour and dissolved yeast. Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Delmonico Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in casserole dish. Mix soup and milk until smooth. Add salt pepper onion and 1 c. cheese. Add to potatoes. On top place remaining cheese bacon bits and bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in a large saucepan over low heat. Stir until smooth and creamy. Remove from heat and slowly stir in sweetened condensed milk. Add marshmallows and pecans. Drop by tablespoonful on greased cookie sheets. Chill until firm. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Uncooked Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into baked shell. Let stand 3 hours in refrigerator.

title: Sweet And Sour Smokies
instructions: Combine brown sugar flour pineapple juice vinegar dry mustard and soy sauce in saucepan; mix well. Bring to a boil. Add cocktail franks; reduce heat. Simmer for 30 minutes. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Easy Pudding Cake
instructions: Prepare chocolate cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool in refrigerator. After cool spread a layer of whipped topping on the cake approximately 1/4-inch thick. In a bowl prepare pudding according to manufacturers instructions and let set for 1 minute. When pudding starts to set pour over whipped topping and with a toothpick marble the pudding and whipped topping. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix cream cheese egg sugar and vanilla. Top with cherries and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Sauce For Fish Fillets
instructions: Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls over cooked fish fillets. Brown under broiler. Just takes a few seconds.

title: Gayle'S Butter Tarts
instructions: Put pastry in tart shells. Mix all ingredients and put in shells. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake until thoroughly browned.

title: One Day Root Beer
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Put in gallon jug and set in sun for four hours. Chill. Ready to drink the next day.

title: Strawberry Surprise(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes. Cool completely. Mix cream cheese and Sweet N Low liquid; add lite Cool Whip. Place on cooled pretzel mix. Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water; add berries and place in refrigerator freezer until thickened. Spoon over Cool Whip with cream cheese mix.

title: Nana'S Christmas Pudding And Ice Cream Sauce
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add moist ingredients. Steam in can* or plum pudding mold for 2 hours in water bath. Make sure water comes halfway up the can and simmers but does not boil.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Stir together cake mix and jello. Add Wesson oil; stir. Add eggs and stir one at a time. Let strawberries thaw. Mash strawberries. Put 1 cup of strawberries into batter and stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Zucchini Snack Cake
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar and mix well with oil and vanilla. Combine separately then add rest of dry ingredients. Then mix in zucchini nuts and raisins. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Tuna-Swiss Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. To hot rice in saucepan add butter garlic and 1 slightly beaten egg. Mix thoroughly. Spoon rice mixture into ungreased 9-inch pie plate. Press rice mixture firmly across bottom and up sides to form a crust. Layer 1/2 cup of onions 1/2 cup cheese and the tuna evenly over rice crust.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients and chill. Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Delicious Potato Doughnuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients as listed except oil. Pat out to 3/4-inch thickness. Cut with a floured doughnut cutter.

title: Crab Or Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and stir in rice and cream. Add seasoning and shrimp. Boil 5 minutes. Place in casserole and leave in warm place for several hours to improve taste. Brown in oven and serve immediately.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Thaw bread dough. Melt margarine. Mix sugars and cinnamon in bowl. Grease a Bundt pan. Make small balls with bread dough. Dip each ball in melted margarine then roll in sugar mixture. Put in Bundt pan and put remaining sugars and melted margarine over top. Let rise. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes then cover with foil and bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 more minutes. To remove flip over on serving dish tray etc.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order given. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Smoky Cheese-Olive Spread
instructions: Advance preparation Line a 2-cup mold or bowl with clear plastic wrap or foil. Beat cheeses together until well blended; stir in olives. Turn into mold. Chill 4 hours or overnight.

title: Sauce For Dried Beans, Turnip Greens, Etc.
instructions: Mix tomatoes sugar pepper salt and vinegar. Simmer about 45 minutes uncovered. This keeps well in the refrigerator.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa well. Make a hole in the center and put in butter and milk. Microwave 4 to 5 minutes until it bubbles. Remove and beat until smooth. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into a buttered dish. Let cool.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Combine water butter and sugar in a saucepan; heat until butter melts stirring occasionally. Cool to 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0. Combine 2 cups flour salt and yeast in a large mixing bowl; stir well. Gradually add liquid mixture to flour mixture beating well at high speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs and beat an additional 2 minutes at medium speed. Gradually stir in remaining flour making a soft dough. Cover and refrigerate up to 3 days; punch dough down and cover if it begins rising out of bowl.

title: Sweet Dills
instructions: Fill 8 quart jars with sliced cucumbers. Add 2 bunches dill and 3 or 4 garlic cloves. Bring the first 4 ingredients to a boil. Pour over cucumbers in jars and seal. Cold pack 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch dish. Cook debone and chop chicken. Place chicken in dish. Mix soups broth and vegetables in saucepan over low heat until warm. Blend together margarine milk and flour. Pour over chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Favorite Corn Sticks
instructions: Combine dry ingredients then add eggs milk and oil. Stir until smooth. Place a well-greased cast-iron corn stick pan in a 425\u00b0 oven for 3 minutes or until hot. Spoon batter into pan filling 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Skillet Macaroni And Beef
instructions: Cook meat until brown then add all other ingredients. Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Cream Cheese Rolls
instructions: Combine cheese vanilla and egg well. Remove crust from bread and flatten. Spread mixture on slices and roll tightly. Dip in melted butter and then in cinnamon sugar mixture. Can be frozen at this point.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: In large skillet saute green pepper and onion in margarine until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients mixing well. Heat to boiling. Simmer covered for 12 to 15 minutes or until shrimp are firm and pink stirring occasionally. Makes 5 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together to break up lumps. Add wet ingredients and mix according to directions on cake mix. Add chocolate chips. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Seven Layer Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in a small casserole dish beginning with beans and ending with cheese. Chill 1 hour before serving. Serve with tortilla or Fritos chips.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong baking dish with the thicker meatier portions facing toward the outside of the dish.

title: Pumpkin Trifle
instructions: Mix cake water and egg. Bake in 8 inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 - 40 minutes. When cool crumble. Reserve 1/4 cup for garnish. In bowl whisk pudding and milk for 2 minutes. Let stand until becomes soft set. Stir in pumpkin and spices. In trifle bowl layer with cake and pudding mix. Repeat ending with pudding. Garnish with reserved cake and nuts. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil and debone chicken. Place in bottom of casserole dish. Mix together soup poppy seed and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Melt margarine and mix with stack of crackers (crumbled). Sprinkle over soup mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Layered Chalupa Dip
instructions: Arrange lettuce around the edge of a large serving platter. Heat refried beans and sausage until hot. Spread on bottom of platter. Add Cheddar cheese; sprinkle evenly over beans. Do same with chopped tomatoes. Add sour cream (does not have to be spread evenly). Next add mashed avocado. This goes over the sour cream (will extend beyond sour cream or you may surround sour cream). Sprinkle pitted chopped black olives on top of avocado. Add large chips around platter for dipping.

title: Susan'S Slaw(Easy)
instructions: Grate cabbage pour vinegar and sugar over cabbage. Mix well. Cover and place in the refrigerator over night. Drain liquids before serving.

title: Everyday Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and form into a loaf. Place in greased baking dish; cover with Piquant Sauce. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Mix all together. Cook until rice is done.

title: Taco Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Stir in seasoning mix. Simmer until mix is well blended. Line casserole dish with chips. Pour meat and other ingredients (mixed well before) into dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vinegar Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl combine eggs sugar butter vinegar and vanilla; mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake until firm about 50 minutes. Cool on a rack. Serve garnished with chopped nuts or whipped cream if desired.

title: Microwave Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: In small mixing bowl cream together butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg milk and vanilla; mix well. Stir together flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Blend well. Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate pieces and nuts. Spread in paper towel-lined 8-inch square dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup chocolate pieces. Microwave at High 5 to 7 minutes rotating dish 1/4 turn every 2 minutes until done. Cool and cut into bars. Makes 24 bars.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together in a bowl. Heat shortening or oil 1-inch deep in a skillet to 375\u00b0. Pour batter (about 1/4 of it at a time) into a funnel then pour in a circular motion in the hot oil. Start in the center of the pan. Do not pour it thick. Fry each side about 1 1/2 minutes or until brown. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Spinach Bisque
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan saute onions in butter until tender. Stir in flour salt and nutmeg until smooth. Gradually whisk in milk and water. Add cheese; cook and stir over medium heat until melted. Add spinach; cover and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through. Serve with oyster crackers. Yield 5 to 6 servings.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add boiling water; cook until thick and clear stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add butter lemon juice and rind. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cinnamon Cheese Bars
instructions: Press 1 pack crescent rolls in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream the cream cheese 1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla and spread on the crescent rolls. Press on the other pack of rolls. Pour 1/2 cup melted butter over top. Sprinkle 3/4 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon of cinnamon on top. Mix the cinnamon and sugar together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Eggnog Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl. Add next 6 ingredients. Stir in enough flour to make soft dough. Turn out onto floured surface and knead about 6 to 8 minutes until smooth and elastic. Shape into ball and place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover and let rise in warm place for 1 hour. Punch dough down; place on lightly floured surface. Divide into thirds. Shape each third into a 16-inch rope. Place rope onto greased baking sheet. (Do not stretch.) Braid ropes together pinching ends to seal. Cover and let rise in warm place about 45 minutes or until double in bulk. Combine egg yolk and 1 tablespoon eggnog. Gently brush over loaf. Sprinkle with almonds and 2 teaspoons sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Crispy Honey Mustard Chicken Strips
instructions: Line baking sheet with foil. Spray with no stick cooking spray and set aside. Slice 4 partially thawed breasts crosswise into 8 - 10 strips. (4 breasts = 32-40 strips.) Mix 1/2 c. Grey Poupon honey mustard and 3/4 c. of evaporated milk in shallow bowl. Pour corn flake crumbs into 1 gallon zipper style plastic bag add 1 teaspoon seasoned salt. Toss chicken strips in mustard mixture. Spoon slightly drained strips into crumbs shake until all strips are well coated. Place strips on prepared pan spray tops with non-stick spray. Bake 500\u00b0 oven 5 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for additional 5 minutes. Place on paper towel to drain. Serve with additional honey mustard.

title: Baby Pizza Snacks
instructions: Take English muffins and slice in halves. Place halves on cookie sheet. Put 1 tablespoon of pizza sauce on each muffin. Put your own topping on then sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted or you can cook under broiler.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Chop bologna and add to remaining ingredients. Add catsup last. Bake in moderate oven until done.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and let it cool in the broth. When cool remove from the bone. Thaw broccoli. Stir undiluted soup to blend. In a greased casserole layer the chicken broccoli soup and Parmesan cheese. Make 2 layers. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and oils. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in dry ingredients. Add zucchini. Pour into greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Grate zucchini. Do not blend. May freeze.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put ingredients into blender in order listed. Blend at blend speed for\t1 minute. Pour into 9 or 10-inch pie pan which has been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Combine 1 stick butter and vanilla or graham cracker crumbs. Press into a 7 1/2 x 12-inch pan.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: In a skillet cook bacon until crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain; crumble and set aside. Drain off drippings from skillet. Brown beef; drain. Add onion and cook until tender.

title: Christmas Custard(1 Gallon)
instructions: Pour 3 1/2 quarts milk into a kettle and place on a low burner on stove. Never let milk boil. Heat until when a spoon is dipped slightly over the top of the milk a little skin is formed on the spoon. While waiting for the milk to heat until it forms a skin break eggs into a bowl or kettle. Stir (mix) with a spoon until all yolks are mixed thoroughly (do not use mixer).

title: Chicken Basting
instructions: Mix 1 week ahead and store in refrigerator. Place chicken skin side up on medium hot fire (10-inches above charcoal) and baste. Turn every 15 minutes and baste. Cook for 1 hour.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Dump all ingredients in blender and blend on high just a few seconds. Pour into pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Layer in order on platter or serving dish. Chill 1 hour before serving. Serve with tortilla chips and salsa.

title: Hollandaise
instructions: In glass container microwave margarine for 1 minute on High. Add remaining ingredients. Microwave on High 1 minute; stir every 15 seconds.

title: Soft Nestle Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening brown sugar and sugar; add eggs and beat mixture until fluffy. Dissolve baking soda in water then add to mixture. Sift flour with salt and gradually add to mixture. Add chocolate chips and 1/2 cup chopped nuts if desired. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients 2 minutes at high speed. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: East Indian Rice Ring
instructions: In skillet melt butter. Cook onion and almonds until golden. Add raisins; heat until plump. Add cooked rice. Mix gently. Press mixture lightly into greased 6 1/2-cup ring mold. Unmold at once on platter. Fill with chicken curry. Top with shredded coconut.

title: Pot Roast Of Beef
instructions: Rub salt and pepper into beef. Brown on all sides with vegetable oil in heavy roaster. Add 1/2 cup of water. Cover tightly. Simmer until tender about 3 hours. Turn occasionally. Vegetables (carrots and potatoes) may be added during last hour of cooking roast.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese pineapple onion pepper and 1 cup nuts. Form a ball; roll in remainder of nuts. Makes one large or 2 small balls.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: In a heavy cast iron skillet put cooking oil. Pour corn in bowl and mix with flour sugar and pepper. Pour ingredients into skillet that has been preheated with oil. Reduce heat to low and add about 1/2 of the water. Cover and cook slowly for 30 minutes or more stirring occasionally. When corn begins to stick add more water. When ready add butter and a few dashes of paprika and salt to taste. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Cool and crumble. Cut up broccoli and cauliflower in small pieces. In large bowl mix vegetables onion and cheese together. In small bowl mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Pour over the vegetables and marinate overnight. Sprinkle with bacon before serving.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Cook and drain spinach; melt the butter and cheese into spinach. Mix all other ingredients into a bowl then mix together. More cheese can be used if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes then cut and serve.

title: Mustard Sauce
instructions: Cook all ingredients in a double boiler for 1/2 hour. This would be a wonderful addition to a special ham dinner. Serves 18 nicely.

title: Sweet Pretzel Nuggets
instructions: Place pretzels in a microwave safe bowl. In a small bowl combine oil sugar and cinnamon; pour over pretzels; toss to coat. Microwave uncovered on high for 2 minutes; stir. Microwave 3-4 minutes longer stirring after each minute or until oil is absorbed. Cool to room temperature.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Butter bread; cut into cubes. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish; sprinkle with sausage. Top with cheese. Beat eggs milk pepper and mustard. Pour over cheese. Chill 8 hours. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Crab Salad Casserole
instructions: Toss green pepper onion celery crab eggs and 1/3 cup bread crumbs. Season mayonnaise with pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Add to vegetable/crab mixture. Pour into greased casserole and top with remaining bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Cream oleo; sift flour and red pepper together. Add flour mixture to oleo; mix. Add grated cheese. Mix. Add Rice Krispies and mix. Make into small balls and flatten with fork. Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Mix milk and chocolate over low heat until melted. Add salt vanilla and nuts. Dont let it stick to pan. Pour in a 9 x 12-inch pan lined with wax paper and smooth out. Let it set until hard.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain. Stir margarine Parmesan cheese and eggs into cooked spaghetti. Spoon mixture into a buttered 9-inch pie plate pressing to form a \crust\. Spread cottage cheese over crust.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Fill pie shell with sliced pears. Add sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Crumble together oleo brown sugar and flour. Spread over pears and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes.

title: Aunt Shelli'S Cranberry-Pear Crisp
instructions: Peel core and thinly slice the pears. Wash and pick over the cranberries. Toss the pears and berries in a bowl with sugar and cinnamon. Spread across the bottom of a 10-inch pie dish. Combine flour brown sugar rolled oats and salt in a bowl. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Spread evenly over cranberry mixture. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Cool 1 hour. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Beat well. Mix in milk and vanilla. Mix well. Then add salt baking powder and flour. Roll out on floured counter and make the dough thick or thin depending on your taste. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Hot Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Microwave on medium for 3-4 minutes. Stir several times. Serve with crackers.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil together. Combine flour salt soda baking powder and cinnamon. Add remaining ingredients and mix all together. Pour into bread pans. Makes 3 loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until it leaves sides of pan. This freezes very well. I use for Christmas and Easter dinners.

title: Louise'S Baked Grits
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients until thick. Add butter and cheese. Stir until melted. Add eggs milk and pepper. Mix well and pour into buttered baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook in double boiler until thick then pour into baked pie shell. Graham cracker crust is delicious with this pie.

title: Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Unroll dough and press out with your hand on a greased pan. Top with pizza sauce Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients until thick. Let cool. Pour into pie crust. Sprinkle coconut over filling. Spread Cool Whip (1/2) over coconut. Sprinkle coconut again and top with remaining Cool Whip. Makes 1 pie.

title: Vietnam Beans
instructions: Fry bacon; saute onion in grease (make sure bacon is crisp). Add beans; stir in other ingredients. Simmer 10 minutes. Crumble and add bacon. Serves 1 to 4 depending on how much you eat.

title: Chili Burgers
instructions: In glass casserole saute ground beef onion and celery 6 to 8 minutes stirring every 2 minutes. Drain off drippings. Add vinegar catsup tomato sauce mustard water Worcestershire sauce salt pepper and chili powder; stir to blend. Cook covered 8 to 10 minutes. Heat buns wrapped in terry towel 1 minute. Spoon mixture on heated buns.

title: My Mother'S Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add beaten eggs and buttermilk and then the oil. Makes about 36 four-inch pancakes.

title: Brown Bag Pickles(For 1 Gallon Glass Jar)
instructions: Melt yeast in bottom of glass jar in cool water with 1 tablespoon sugar. Then add dill weed few garlic pods and a leaf of horseradish if you have it. Bring to boil the water vinegar and salt. Let cool. After cooling pour over cucumbers that are packed in jar. Place jar in brown paper bag close top of bag with a couple of clothespins. Sun for a couple of days from there put in icebox. Eat cold out of jar. Delicious cold.

title: Hearty Dinner Salad
instructions: Prepare macaroni as directed; drain. Combine all ingredients including Kraft grated cheese. Toss lightly. Chill.

title: Popeye'S Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with assorted vegetables chips or crackers.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut off and discard small tips of wings. Cut remaining wing bones apart. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Heat oil in large frying pan. Add half wings; cook for about 10 minutes stirring occasionally until golden brown and crisp. Remove; drain well. Repeat with remaining wings. Melt butter in saucepan; add hot sauce and vinegar. Put chicken wings on a warm serving platter. Cover with butter mixture. Serve with Blue cheese dressing and celery sticks.

title: Grandma Power'S Ole Time Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. In separate bowl mix 1 cup flour and remaining dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture. Mix in flour 1 cup at a time to right consistency. Flour board well roll dough and cut. Sprinkle with sugar or sprinkles.

title: Polenta Pound Cake
instructions: Combine in a bowl; toss. (Can be made ahead covered and refrigerated up to 4 hours.) Beat 1 cup heavy or whipping cream to soft peaks; beat in 1 tablespoon confectioners sugar and 1 tablespoon dark rum. Slice cake into wedges and place on dessert plates. Serve with berries and cream.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate at least 12 hours.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind peppers and onions combine with other ingredients and boil 30 minutes. Pack in sterilized jars and seal. Makes 6 pints.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place water oleo and onion in sauce pan and bring to a boil. Add one package of chopped broccoli and boil for 5 minutes. Add minute rice to boiled mixture- turn off heat and let stand 10 minutes. In a bowl mix 1 can of cream of mushroom soup and 8 oz. jar of cheese whiz. Mix all ingredients together and place in a 2 qt. casserole dish. Bake for 45 minutes at 325 degrees.

title: Starlight Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar. Add margarine milk and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Add eggs. Beat 2 more minutes. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Cream Pie
instructions: Combine flour nuts brown sugar and oleo. Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir once while baking. Reserve 1/2 cup crumbs for top. Using a spoon press warm crumb mixture in pie plate. Chill. Blend cream cheese and sugar and spread over the crust. Whip the cream and sweeten to taste. Fold pie filling into whipped cream. Spoon over cream cheese layer. Sprinkle with crumbs.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt the margarine in a casserole. Mix together all ingredients. Pour into casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until it begins to brown.

title: Parmesan Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Place in a bowl. Immediately add remaining ingredients and toss well. Makes 4 servings.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Season to taste. Remember corned beef is salty. Mix and pour into greased casserole. Dot the top with butter and 1/2 cup crumbled potato chips or buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until smooth. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla wafers alternately with milk. Add coconut and pecans. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Blend soup and milk. Add noodles tuna pimento and parsley. Pour into casserole. Top with crumbs. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbling.

title: Broccoli And Raisin Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise vinegar and sugar in large bowl; mix well. Add broccoli raisins onion pecans and bacon; mix well. Chill at least an hour but better if chilled overnight.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if the skin is rough otherwise just scrub and rinse them. Cut the potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Put the potatoes in a baking dish fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes for 50 minutes at 425\u00b0. Remove from oven sprinkle with cheeses. Bake potatoes for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside. Check with a fork.

title: Bacon Cheddar Puffs
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bring milk and margarine to boil over medium heat. Add flour all at once stirring constantly until mixture forms a ball and leaves sides of pan. Remove from heat. Add eggs one at a time stirring constantly until it is smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased foil lined cookie sheet. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Pepper Roll
instructions: Mix cream cheese and dressing mix together. Sprinkle with seasoned pepper.

title: Scalloped Corn Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart-size casserole dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Drop Rolls
instructions: Put flour in bowl first. Then sugar then yeast. Next add water 1 egg beaten and oil. Mix together with wooden spoon. Spray muffin pan with Pam. Fill 1/2 full. bake 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Pour rest of mixture in Tupperware container and refrigerate. Stir well each time you use. No rising necessary.

title: Delicious Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Wash and prepare chicken. Sprinkle with allspice on both sides of chicken. Sprinkle with Season-All on both sides of chicken and sprinkle with garlic powder on both sides of chicken. Place on grill until done. Add honey barbecue sauce to chicken on both sides. Let chicken finish cooking on grill. This is a mouth watering recipe you will enjoy!

title: Baked Beans And Meat Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and bell pepper. Add seasoning. Pour beans in casserole dish. Pour other ingredients over them. Bake 30 minutes uncovered at 350\u00b0 and then 15 minutes covered. Serve with buttered French bread and green salad.

title: Low Carb Cheeseburger Quiche Lunch Snacks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown hamburger in a heavy skillet; add onion. Remove and mix in bowl with bacon pieces breaking up any larger clumps with a fork or pastry mixer until you have a fine mix. Drain well of any excess grease and press into the bottom of a deep-dish pie pan. Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in mixer bowl and whip well. Pour mixture over beef \crust\ and bake 40 to 45 minutes until top is browned and \set\. Cool for 15 to 20 minutes to slice. This can be packaged in Ziploc or plastic containers for meals quickly microwaved over the next 3 to 5 days. (Does not freeze well though.) Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Salad
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail. Save syrup and add enough water to the syrup to make 1 cup liquid. Bring liquid to boil. Dissolve gelatin in hot liquid; stir until dissolved. Add ginger ale. Refrigerate until slightly thick; fold in fruit and marshmallows. Pour into mold. Chill until firm.

title: Lemonade Stand Pie
instructions: Beat lemonade concentrate in large bowl about 30 seconds. Spoon in ice cream; beat until blended. Stir in whipped topping until smooth. Place in freezer if necessary for mixture to thicken. Spoon into crust. Freeze 4 hours or overnight.

title: Taffy Apple Dip
instructions: In a small bowl beat cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread mixture on a small serving plate; top with nuts. Serve with apple wedges. Yields 6 servings.

title: Rabbit With Noodles
instructions: Boil the rabbit in salted water with the onion until meat falls from bones. Dice the meat. Prepare noodles by adding milk and some salt to the eggs. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll the dough out to a thickness of 1/4-inch or less. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Cover the bottom of a greased (margarine) baking pan with noodles followed by a layer of rabbit meat. Continue alternating noodles with meat until both are gone. Pour the broth in which the rabbit was cooked over this and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Wing Dings
instructions: Singe wings if needed. Cut off tips and discard. Divide each wing in half. Place in single layer or rack in broiler. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Mix sugar cornstarch salt ginger pepper water lemon juice and soy sauce in small saucepan. Stir constantly until mixture boils; boil 3 minutes. Brush over chicken. Cook chicken 40 minutes more and continue turning and basting with remaining mixture.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Cook butter and sugar over low heat until bubbly and cool. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Add vanilla and sifted dry ingredients and nuts. Mix thoroughly.

title: Many Way Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs onion egg and salt. Shape into 16 meatballs. In skillet brown meatballs. Pour off fat. Stir in soup water and parsley. Cover. Cook over low heat 15 minutes. Stir now and then. Serves 4. Very good with other cream soups.

title: Cheesy Potato Souffle
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water to cover 8 minutes or until tender. Drain and mash potatoes. Add sour cream; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until smooth. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Add yolks cheese onion chives and pepper to potato mixture; stir well. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) and baking powder until stiff peaks form. Fold into potato mixture. Spoon into a buttered 1 1/2-quart souffle dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until set. Serve immediately. Yield 6 servings.

title: Ella'S Brownies
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for around 30 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend for 30 seconds.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Sift flour baking powder sugar and cinnamon. Mix milk egg and mashed bananas and add to flour mixture with melted margarine. Stir only to mix. Bake for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Quick Tater Tot Bake
instructions: In a skillet brown the meat and onion. Drain any fat. Season with salt and pepper. Place in a greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole. Top with green beans and potatoes. Combine soup and milk or water. Pour over the potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 2 to 3.

title: Banana Cupcakes
instructions: Cream shortening and vanilla. Add sugar gradually creaming until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift together dry ingredients. Add alternately with bananas and buttermilk to creamed mixture beating well after each addition.

title: Lesby'S Surprise Cake
instructions: Sprinkle this mixture over the bottom layer in pan. Add remaining half of batter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and allow to cool 15 minutes in pan. Turn out of pan and cool completely.

title: Turkey Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Cover and chill for 2-3 hours. Makes 8 servings.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix butter and 2 eggs; blend and beat 1 minute. Spread batter in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in 2 eggs and vanilla. Set aside 1/2 cup of 10x sugar. Beat in remaining. Pour over batter in pan. Top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with 10x sugar you set aside (after you bake).

title: Falafel And Tehina
instructions: Drain can of chickpeas. Mash. Add next seven ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Taking a spoonful of the mixture at a time roll into balls about 1-inch in diameter. Heat oil and deep-fry falafel until browned. Drain. Serve hot on a gyro bread or in a pita bread pocket with tehina on top Tehina recipe follows.

title: No Cook Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk together. In separate bowl mix condensed milk and cream cheese together. Combine until evenly mixed. Layer cookies bananas pudding etc. Spread Cool Whip on top.

title: Spinach Pesto
instructions: In blender or processor puree all ingredients until smooth. Toss with hot cooked pasta (approximately 1 pound). Makes 4 servings.

title: Quick Herb Rolls
instructions: Spread butter over bottom of 9-inch pie pan. Combine next 3 ingredients and sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook cool and cut chicken into small pieces. Mix together croutons broth and butter; line casserole dish. Add chicken.

title: Mexican Hot Sauce
instructions: In saucepan combine chili sauce onion vinegar salad oil brown sugar garlic salt dry mustard and Tabasco sauce. Bring to a boil. Simmer 10 minutes stirring constantly. Serve warm or cool.

title: Pecan Tart
instructions: Combine flour cream cheese and butter. Form balls about the size of walnuts. Drop in small muffin tins making a shell.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts Supreme
instructions: In a large bowl combine first eight ingredients. Place chicken in mixture and turn to coat. Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator. Remove chicken from marinade; coat each piece with crumbs. Arrange on shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until juices run clear. Serves 8. Exchanges 3 1/2 lean meat 1 starch 1/4 skim milk and 271 calories.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix well and put on top of cream cheese. Put rest of Cool Whip on top.

title: Chicken Wellington With Port-Currant Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Cook wild rice according to package directions. Stir in orange peel. Set aside. Roll out sheet of puff pastry 1/8-inch thick. Divide pastry into quarters. Place chicken breast on each pastry quarter. Spoon 1/4 cup rice on top. Roll up. Place seam side down on jelly roll pan. Beat 2 egg yolks and water. Brush on dough. Bake 50 minutes. Heat currant jelly mustard wine and lemon juice. Serve sauce warm with chicken. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Pone Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients until moist. Add enough water to make a smooth mixture (but mixture needs to hold its shape). Form into pones. Grease iron skillet and heat. Place pones into hot skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown.

title: Cream Puff Cake
instructions: Bring water and oleo to a boil. Take off heat and stir in flour. Beat in eggs one at a time. (Mixture will be smooth.) Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan (greased) and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool! Cream the cream cheese with 1/2 cup milk. Add rest of milk. Add pudding. Refrigerate pudding for 15 minutes. Spread pudding over crust and top with Cool Whip.

title: Seafoam Frosting
instructions: Mix egg whites sugar salt and water in top of double boiler. Beat over boiling water with sturdy beater or at high speed of electric mixer 7 minutes or until peaks form. Remove from water; add vanilla. Beat 1 minute. Frosts two layers.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Peel eggs; cut in half. Mix egg yolks salad dressing mustard salt pepper and bacon bits together. Stuff back into white parts.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and margarine. Add sugar then eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Mix ingredients and then add nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and mushrooms. Drain off grease. Add soups water rice Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Transfer mixture to a large covered casserole dish. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for approximately 1 hour.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar evaporated milk and margarine in a saucepan; let come to a boil. After bubbles begin stir constantly for 6 minutes. Remove from heat and add chocolate chips marshmallow cream pecans vanilla raisins and peanut butter. Mix until stiff. Pour into 2 greased 9 X 13 pans. Let cool. Slice.

title: French Meat Pie
instructions: Mix and cook all together until a little over being raw. Put in double pie crust and bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or more. Makes 2 pies.

title: Tuna Bacon Rolls
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Cut pieces of bacon in thirds. Place small amount of mixture on bacon piece. Roll up and close with a toothpick. Broil 10 minutes on each side.

title: Sally'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream together the shortening butter sugars and peanut butter. Add eggs. Mix well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture blend well. Mix in oatmeal. Shape dough into small balls. Do not flatten. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Spread butter on both sides of the bread. Cut slices in half and set aside. Brown the ground beef. Add onion celery prepared mustard and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. In a buttered 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish place alternate layers of toast beef mixture and cheese. In a small bowl beat the egg then stir in the milk dry mustard and the remaining salt. Pour mixture over the cheese. Sprinkle with paprika and bake uncovered for 25 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix this mixture and put into the potatoes. Pour into casserole dish. Top with a little more cheese. Sprinkle 2 cups of corn flake crumbs on top and drizzle 1/4 cup of margarine over the crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Lore'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Line 10-inch pie plate with pastry. Boil sugar and syrup together for about 2 minutes. Pour slowly over slightly beaten eggs stirring vigorously. Add butter vanilla rum salt and nut meats. Pour into unbaked pastry-lined pie plate. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Granny'S Blackberry Pudding
instructions: In 4 quart casserole cream\tthe following sugar butter flour salt baking powder and milk. Stir well and then pour in blackberries. Add boiling water. Place in oven and cook at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Serve hot spooning the berries and juice from bottom over the top.

title: Crunchy Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mix above ingredients and add dressing.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion until tender. Drain and mash well. Mix stuffing with margarine and put half over bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix soup sour cream pimiento and pepper. Mix with squash and onion mixture. Pour over stuffing and sprinkle remaining stuffing over squash mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese-Tomato Grill
instructions: Cut each tomato into 3 thick slices. Broil on one side and turn. Mix cheeses; add salt and pepper. Spread generously on tomato slices. Broil until golden brown and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine soup and milk in casserole dish. Cook Stove Top stuffing according to directions on box. Add chicken to soup and milk mixture. Mix well so that all chicken is coated. Cover chicken mixture with stuffing (do not mix). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until stuffing gets brown on top. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Green Bean Bundles
instructions: Cut bacon slices in half. Wrap around a bunch of green beans and secure with a toothpick to fasten. Make a glaze from the oleo brown sugar garlic salt and pepper. Pour over beans. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover the last few minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well with hands. Form into 1 inch balls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Favorite Iced Tea
instructions: You will need a 1-gallon container.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Cook and stir until it starts to thicken then add zucchini peppers and onions. Mix well. Cook and stir slowly for 30 minutes. Put in hot jars at once. If zucchini are small do not remove the seeds. Do not peel big or little.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter; pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill 1 hour. Whip together powdered sugar and butter until creamy. Beat in eggs until mixture is fluffy. Add vanilla and mix. Spread mixture over crust. Top with sliced bananas and drained crushed pineapple. Frost with Cool Whip. Add cherries and chopped nuts.

title: Morning Paradise
instructions: Heat large skillet on high. Fry onions peppers then mushrooms in margarine. Then add meat. Scramble eggs with milk and spices. Add to skillet after veggies and meat are fried to your liking. Let simmer for 2 to 4 minutes. Turn on broiler to 350\u00b0. Add Provolone slices to cover most of egg surface (use whole slices). Then top cheese with diced tomatoes. Put skillet under broiler for 2 to 4 minutes until cheese is melted and slightly browned.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spray 9 x 13 pan with Pam. Roll out biscuits or rolls and put in pan. Put crumbled sausage over biscuits. Spread cheese over sausage. Mix eggs and milk and pour over cheese. Salt and pepper. Add onions if desired. Sprinkle with oregano. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 27 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Bean Dip
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except corn chips. Heat until cheese melts stirring occasionally. Serve warm sprinkled with grated cheese as a dip for corn chips.

title: Sunshine Slush
instructions: In 2-quart freezer container stir together thawed juice concentrates and corn syrup. Stir in water and rum. Seal container and freeze overnight. Before serving thaw 30 to 60 minutes or until slushy. Fill glasses 2/3 full with slush. Top with club soda and stir gently. Garnish with orange slices.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix in order listed. Bake in bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix soup sour cream and poppy seed in bowl. In separate bowl mix crackers and butter. Prepare rice according to directions. Place rice in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Spread bite size pieces of chicken across rice. Pour soup mixture on top of chicken. Top with crushed crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Surprise
instructions: Melt shortening. Add garlic and saute slightly. Stir in flour and cook until bubbly stirring constantly. Add broth or chicken bouillon (2 cubes in 2 cups boiling water) soy sauce turkey and seasonings. Cook until thickened about 20 minutes. Serve over cooked rice fried noodles or biscuits.

title: Cloud Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Using pastry blender cut in butter until consistency of coarse meal. Add milk and egg. Stir with fork until soft dough forms. Turn onto floured surface. Knead gently 10 to 12 times. Roll to 1/2 inch thickness. Cut with 2 inch cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Diane'S Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Combine hash browns and onion. Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Combine cream of chicken soup sour cream and cheese. Pour over hash brown mixture. Top with crushed cornflakes. Dribble margarine over flakes. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
instructions: Rinse peas in hot water; drain. Combine vegetables nuts and bacon with sour cream. Mix dressing mustard and garlic together; pour over salad. Toss gently. Chill.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into balls and roll in coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Steam or boil carrots until barely tender. Fold in onions and peppers. In a separate bowl mix together oil vinegar sugar tomato soup mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Add to vegetables and marinate for 2 to 3 days.

title: Vegetable Okra Gumbo
instructions: In a large skillet fry bacon crisp then remove. Add chopped onion pepper and okra to bacon grease. Cook 15 minutes until okra is slightly browned. Add tomatoes and bacon (broken up in 1-inch pieces) sugar salt and pepper. Cover skillet and simmer 15 minutes. Gumbo should have consistency of stewed tomatoes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole dish. Mix 3/4 of cream soups with rice; put on bottom of casserole. Lay in chicken breasts. Cover with remaining cream soup mixed with water. Sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Cover with foil. Bake for 90 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain well. Bring water milk salt and pepper to a boil; add instant potatoes. Stir with a fork. Mix potatoes and ground beef together. Place in baking dish. Cover with cheese slices. Lightly brown cheese in oven.

title: Saffron Rice
instructions: Butter inside of 2 1/2-quart casserole. Place ingredients inside. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Leave lid off the last 10 minutes.

title: French Onion Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Cook in microwave on High for about 8 minutes in 2 tablespoons water. Meanwhile make white sauce with butter flour and milk. Add cheese and onion dip. Let cheese melt and stir until smooth. Drain potatoes and place in 2-quart baking dish. Pour sauce over potatoes. Bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: You will also need 1 tin flower pot or sand bucket garden trowel for server and gummy worms.

title: Spicy Bean Dip
instructions: Saute onion. Add 3 cans of soup and enough water so it will be dip consistency. Add olives. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook cubed eggplant in salted water; drain. Add bread crumbs tomatoes and corn. Saute onion and bell pepper in butter. Add to eggplant mixture. Add salt and pepper. Put in greased casserole; top with cheese and bread crumbs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Season to taste. Spread in greased pie plate. Mix Bisquick eggs and milk until almost smooth. Pour over meat. Bake for 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Top with tomatoes and cheese. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes until inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add remaining ingredients and simmer on low heat 45 minutes to 1 hour. This will work well in a crock-pot.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix butter sugar eggs coconut raisins and pecans. Pour into shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Put in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes and then reduce to 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Hash
instructions: In a 1-quart casserole cook onion and butter or margarine covered on 100% power (High) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in potatoes beef parsley (if desired) Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Cook covered on high about 3 minutes or until heated through. Stir together evaporated milk and flour then stir in the meat mixture. Cook uncovered on high about 3 minutes or until thickened and bubbly stirring each minute until the mixture starts to thicken then stirring every 30 seconds. Cook uncovered on high for 1 minute more. Serve atop green pepper wedges if desired. Serves 2.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough otherwise just scrub and rinse them. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way. Put potatoes in a baking dish; fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs.

title: 6 Week Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix Bran sugar flour soda and salt. Add eggs shortening and buttermilk; mix well and put in covered container. When ready to use fill cupcake tin 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Will keep 6 weeks and gets tastier at end.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix and pour over first half of bread cubes. Add remaining cubes. Beat 2 eggs slightly and add 1 1/2 c. milk and pour over top of mixture and let stand 1 hour or over night. When ready to use spoon 1 can of cream of mushroom soup over. Sprinkle buttered cubes over top.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter over medium heat in saucepan. Saute onion in butter. Add consomme and garlic powder. Simmer on low for 30 to 45 minutes. Pour into soup bowls; add croutons and shredded cheese. Heat under broiler until cheese melts. Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Tasty Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook linguini; rinse in colander with hot water. Return to pot; mix with melted butter and mushrooms (melt butter with garlic). Mix soup with milk. Add to noodles. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese (generous). Garnish with parsley.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs with 1 stick of margarine. Put mixture in bottom of dish. Beat powdered sugar eggs and 2 sticks of melted margarine for 15 minutes and pour in crust. Slice bananas on top of filling; drain pineapple and put on bananas; top with Cool Whip. Chill before serving.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Put the 6 peppers in a pan with sides like a cake pan. After the mixture is mixed together put into the peppers. Top with ketchup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until ketchup on top is cooked until brown.

title: Cherry Freeze
instructions: Combine all except topping. Fold in topping. Put in a flat dish. Cover and freeze. Take out of freezer about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients (fold in Cool Whip) together. Layer wafers bananas and mixture in layers. Cover with small carton of Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: Pickled Fresh Ginger
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 or 2 minutes depending on thickness of ginger slices. Cover and store in refrigerator. Keeps for several weeks.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread each of the ingredients in a large oblong Pyrex baking dish in order listed. Do not mix. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Add seasoning mix and water; simmer 5 minutes.

title: Cheese Omelet
