instructions: Heat butter in 9-inch pie plate on High for 1 minute or until melted. Turn plate to coat bottom with butter. Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients. Pour into pie plate. Cook covered with plastic wrap. Cook on Medium for 2 to 3 1/2 minutes or until omelet is almost set. Stir after 1 minute. Let stand covered for 2 minutes. With a spatula loosen edges of omelet from plate. Sprinkle 1/4 cup shredded cheese down center. Fold into thirds to serve.

title: Creole Eggplant(Southern Living Cooking Light Cookbook)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a skillet. Cover and cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes or until tender stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings (about 38 calories per serving).

title: Scalloped Mushroom Potatoes
instructions: Combine soup and milk until well blended. Add cheese pimento mushrooms and salt. Blend well. Add potatoes and mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil in a large saucepan over medium heat until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer on low uncovered 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Saccharin And Mustard Pickles
instructions: Dissolve your salt mustard alum and saccharin in small amount of hot vinegar stirring very well. Place dissolved brine in 2 gallon jars.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown bacon and onion in large skillet. Add catsup brown sugar vinegar mustard and salt stirring to combine. Combine sauce with pork and beans lima beans butter beans and kidney beans. Cook covered in 2 1/2-quart casserole in slow oven (325\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Remove cover and continue cooking 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: One-Dish Ham Bake
instructions: Mix broccoli soups 1 cup milk ham and onion powder in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix baking mix and milk. Pour evenly over soup mixture. Sprinkle with parsley if desired. Bake 30 minutes or until light golden brown at 450\u00b0. Let stand at least 5 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in shallow dish. Combine 1 cup water vinegar and dressing mix in a jar; cover tightly and shake vigorously. Pour over vegetables tossing lightly to coat. Cover and chill overnight. Serve on leaf lettuce.

title: Spiced Shrimp Kebabs
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve 1/4 cup syrup. In skillet heat oil over medium-high heat. Saute garlic spice and tomato paste 2 minutes. Add shrimp; saute 2 minutes. Stir in pineapple syrup and remaining ingredients; boil. Add pineapple place in bowl. Accompany with picks to make kebabs.

title: Rosie'S Homemade Sausage
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; knead together cover and refrigerate for three days. On the fourth day shape into three or four 6-inch rolls. Bake at 150\u00b0 for ten hours or 185\u00b0 for eight hours on broiler rack pan so that it is not laying in its own grease. Wrap in Saran Wrap foil etc. Refrigerate. Will keep in refrigerator for seven to ten days or freeze.

title: White Fruitcake
instructions: Cream butter well; add sugar and cream together until fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla and lemon extracts; beat well. Sift flour and salt together in a separate bowl and set aside.

title: Horseradish Dressing
instructions: In a blender blend well everything but chives. Add chives after blending with spoon. Mix well. Chill.

title: Zucchini Mortola
instructions: Peel zucchini. Cut in half and half again. Boil in salted water for about 5 minutes then drain well. Put on bottom of a greased dish.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Blend together. Press down mixture into a 9 x 11-inch pan.

title: Pistachio Pudding Salad
instructions: Prepare pudding according to directions. Add pineapple to unset pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill in refrigerator for 2 hours.

title: Creamy Parmesan-Pepper Dressing(Low-Fat)
instructions: Place the cottage cheese in a food processor. Process for 3 minutes or until very smooth. With the machine running pour in the buttermilk and vinegar. Process until smooth. Add the Parmesan and pepper. Blend briefly to distribute evenly.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Immerse cabbage in boiling water; boil 5 minutes. Plunge in ice water. Peel off limp outer leaves and repeat process. Drain leaves (10 to 15 leaves). Chop remaining cabbage and place in large bowl. Peel and mince onion and add to chopped cabbage. Add ground beef seasonings garlic egg 1/2 cup tomato puree bread crumbs salt and pepper and blend thoroughly. Place about 1/4 cup beef mixture in cup part of cabbage leaf. Carefully fold over sides and roll up. Place all cabbage rolls in roasting pan. Add remaining tomato puree to pan. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Butter Spice Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Sift together flour baking powder soda cinnamon and nutmeg. Add sugar eggs and oil; stir to blend. Fold in apple butter pecans and raisins. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.\tLet cool in pan for 15 minutes then turn out onto wire rack to cool completely. Makes nice gifts for holidays.

title: Stir And Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar and oil; add eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and salt. Drop by tablespoon. Butter the bottom of a drinking glass and dip in sugar. Smash cookie. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Watch closely and remove from cookie sheet immediately.

title: Almond Cookies
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda together. Cream shortening; add egg and almond extract. Gradually add dry ingredients and mix well. Roll into 1 inch balls and place on a cookie sheet. Press in one almond in center of cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes approximately 50 cookies. Note Sesame seed may be used instead of almonds.

title: Quick Skillet Supper
instructions: In a large skillet brown meat and drain. Stir in seasonings Veg-All broth and macaroni. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in sour cream and 1/2 the French fried onions. Heat through. Do not boil. Top with remaining onions.

title: Cinnamon Apple Salad
instructions: Add boiling water to gelatin and cinnamon red hots. Stir until all are dissolved. Chill until gelatin is almost set. Whip thickened gelatin at low speed of electric mixer for a few seconds then gradually beat in cold evaporated milk. Turn mixer speed to high and whip until gelatin mixture is double in volume. Fold in apples marshmallows and walnuts lightly but thoroughly. Turn into mold (5-cup) that is lightly oiled. Chill until firm about 4 to 5 hours.

title: Special K Bars
instructions: Cook brown sugar white syrup and margarine for 2 minutes. Add peanut butter. Pour over Special K. Mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Mardi Gras Cake
instructions: Melt morsels in water. Sift together flour salt soda and baking powder. Cream sugar shortening and eggs. Add dry ingredients alternating with milk and morsels. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Cookies
instructions: Cream the Crisco and sugar. Beat in eggs. Add buttermilk; mix well. Stir in flour. Roll dough on floured surface. Add additional flour if necessary. Cut into shapes.

title: California Carrots
instructions: Pare carrots; cut diagonally in thin slices. Combine with raisins water and salt in a medium-size heavy saucepan; cover. Heat to boiling then simmer 30 minutes or until carrots are tender drain. Sprinkle with brown sugar; add butter and lemon juice. Heat slowly until butter melts then cook stirring often 10 minutes or until carrots are richly glazed.

title: Mississippi Mud Brownies(Microwave)
instructions: Place butter in a 2-quart mixing bowl. Microwave on High 1 minute or until butter melts. Stir in sugar and eggs; set aside. Combine flour salt and cocoa. Stir well. Stir dry mixture into egg mixture. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Spread batter in a greased and floured 8-inch square baking dish. Shield corners with triangles of aluminum foil keeping foil smooth and close to dish. Place dish atop a microwave-safe cereal bowl inverted in the oven. Microwave on Medium (50% power) 6 to 7 minutes giving dish a half turn after 3 minutes. Remove shields; microwave on High 2 to 3 minutes or until top is almost dry. Remove from oven and place directly on countertop to cool. Sprinkle marshmallows over brownies; cover with aluminum foil. Let stand 2 minutes. Remove foil. Spread with Chocolate Frosting. Cool completely on a wire rack. Cut into squares to serve. Yields 16 brownies.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In a medium saucepan cook onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons broth 5 to 7 minutes or until softened over medium-high heat. Add tomato sauce honey oregano basil and white pepper. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer gently for 20 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cream Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar oil and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients alternately with sour cream; add to egg mixture. Fold in blueberries. Spoon in greased muffin tins or paper cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yield 24 muffins (large).

title: Iced Coffee Special
instructions: Make a pot of your favorite flavored coffee or regular and turn off heat immediately after it is brewed. Let sit about 20 minutes. Pour into a covered pitcher and place in refrigerator for at least 1 hour (the colder the better). When you want a cool refreshing drink put some ice in a tall glass. Pour coffee in with milk and Sweet N Low to your taste. I usually put 1/2 packet of Sweet N Low and 3 tablespoons milk. Stir and enjoy!

title: Easy Steak Supreme
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot and stir. Cook on low all day. Serve on rice.

title: Cucumber-Radish Dressing
instructions: Stir all ingredients. Chill 1 hour. Serve with mixed greens. Make about 1 cup. Prep time 10 minutes.

title: No Crust Coconut Pie
instructions: Grease 2 pie plates. Blend eggs sugar flour and margarine. Add milk and coconut. Pour into greased pie plates and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until golden brown.

title: Marinade For Vegetables
instructions: Mix marinade ingredients in a very large bowl. Gently stir in celery sticks carrot sticks bell pepper rings onion rings 1 pound of mushrooms green and black olives a small jar of pimentos cauliflower cherry tomatoes (halved) and broccoli. Refrigerate 6 to 12 hours re-mixing occasionally.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Mix sugar vinegar oil and salt. Add rest of ingredients and marinate overnight. Drain before serving.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Beat the eggs. Add sugar flour and baking powder together. Add vanilla. The last thing you add before baking is the hot milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Beef Noodle Bake
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Brown beef. Pour off grease. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat slowly until bouillon cube is dissolved. Transfer to large mixing bowl before adding noodles. Stir in noodles. Pour into greased 8 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 10.

title: Pearl'S Bars
instructions: Cut cookie roll in half and slice each half. Place half of the slices in the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch pan and press to cover. Beat the other ingredients together and spread in the pan. Then cover with the remaining slices of dough. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool then cut into squares. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Scandinavian Almond Bars
instructions: Stir together the flour baking powder and salt. In a large bowl beat butter or margarine until softened. Add sugar; beat until fluffy. Add egg and almond extract; beat well. Add flour mixture; beat until well mixed. Divide dough into fourths. Form each into a 12-inch roll. Place two rolls 4 to 5 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten until 3 inches wide. Repeat with remaining rolls. Brush flattened rolls with milk; sprinkle with almonds. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 12 to 14 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. While cookies are still warm cut them crosswise at a diagonal into 1-inch strips. Cool. Drizzle with Almond Icing. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Cool Summer Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. A few drops of green food coloring may be added if desired.\tPlace in refrigerator until chilled. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Best Apple Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients to sugar mixture. Add chopped apples and nuts and bake in greased jelly roll pan or 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery peppers cucumbers and grapefruit in bowl. Add French dressing. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Swedish Pepparkaka Slices(Ginger Slices)
instructions: In large bowl sift flour ginger soda cinnamon cloves and salt. Set aside. Cream butter. Gradually add sugar and cream well. Blend in molasses. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Shape dough into balls. Wrap in wax paper and chill for several hours. When dough is stiff cut into quarters. Roll out 1 quarter; take cookie cutters (any you have available) and cut out cookies with floured cutters. Place on greased cookie sheets and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: My Mom'S Coffee Bars
instructions: Sift together first five ingredients. Cream next three then add alternately flour and coffee. Add vanilla dates (cut up) and nuts (in small pieces). Pour into 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done like a cake. Cook then sprinkle powdered sugar on top. Cut in bars and try and eat just one!

title: Applesauce Date Cake
instructions: Sift first 7 ingredients in a bowl. Add eggs brown sugar margarine and 1 cup hot applesauce. Beat until combined on low speed of mixer; then beat 2 minutes on medium speed. Add remaining applesauce dates and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Cornmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie pastry. Cook very slowly at about 300\u00b0 until thick. Use 1 teaspoon flavoring. Test with toothpick. Old old recipe but very very good.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Saute onions and green pepper in butter or margarine. Add soups tomatoes and chicken. Layer bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish with soup mixture. Add a layer of tortillas and 1/2 of the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Tasty Chex Mix(Will Stay Fresh 5 To 7 Weeks)
instructions: Melt margarine and add next four ingredients. In large turkey sized roaster pan mix together remaining ingredients.

title: Noodle Ting-A-Lings
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave for 2 minutes on High. Mix in peanuts and noodles. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Mississippi Sin
instructions: Slice top off of bread and hollow out saving bread pieces. Mix rest of ingredients pour into hollow bread and put top back on. Wrap in foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Use bread pieces crackers or chips for dipping.

title: Spring Salad
instructions: Mix sugar oil and vinegar; bring to boil then let cool. Drain the white corn green beans and peas; put in large bowl. Chop or slice to taste the green pepper celery and onion (small pieces are better). Mix the sugar mixture and vegies together. Cover; let set overnight chilled.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Mix brown sugar and Miracle Whip together; spread this on top of layers. Sprinkle cheese on top of Miracle Whip mixture then top with bacon. Best if made a few hours ahead.

title: Banana Fudge Walnut Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of 8-inch square pan. Melt in 2-quart saucepan over low heat stirring constantly the butter and chocolate chips. Beat in thoroughly with spoon the flour sugar walnuts banana vanilla baking powder salt and egg. Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake about 30 minutes or until center is set.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes one 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 2 loaf pans.

title: Chili
instructions: Cut up bacon in 1/4-1/2 inch pieces with kitchen shears. Brown bacon and ground meat together until cooked through. If using ground chuck drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer for at least an hour.

title: Spaghetti Supper Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed and drain. Add eggs Parmesan and parsley. In a greased 9-inch pie plate layer half of the spaghetti then half of the Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Heat sauce; add mushrooms. Cut pie into wedges and serve with sauce over top.

title: The Chewy Oatmeal Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine Crisco brown sugar egg milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended and fluffy. Combine oats flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Mix into creamed mixture at low speed just until blended. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheets. Remove to rack.

title: Ritz-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in casserole. Mix onion mayonnaise cheese egg mushroom soup and pimento together and pour over broccoli. Cover with cracker crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until lightly browned and set. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli as directed and drain. Mix soup with milk. Bring water to boiling; add dressing mix and cut margarine. Mix. In 1 1/2-quart casserole layer broccoli soup mixture and dressing mixture. Repeat. Top with shredded cheese (optional). Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Imperial Cookies
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Form quarter size balls and press down on cookie sheet with a water tumbler that has been dampened and then dipped in sugar. Bake at 300\u00b0 until golden about 25 minutes.

title: White Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together until fluffy the first 5 ingredients. Mix together next 5 ingredients and add to above mixture. Add chocolate chips and nuts to batter. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 6 or 7 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Laredo Supper
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve with corn chips.

title: Baked Pasta Supreme
instructions: Cook rigatoni; keep warm. In skillet brown sausage breaking up until no pink remains. Drain thoroughly. Reserve meat. In medium size bowl mix Ricotta cheese nutmeg salt pepper and parsley. Set aside. Generously grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon 1/3 sauce over bottom of pan. On top of sauce spread even layers of 1/2 cooked rigatoni then all of cooked sausage then Ricotta mix then remaining cooked rigatoni then remaining tomato sauce and finally Parmesan sprinkled evenly over all. Cover with foil. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0; bake covered 15 minutes. Remove cover; bake another 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture is browned and bubbling.

title: Waldorf Salad With Raisins
instructions: In medium bowl place in diced apples. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Add celery raisins and salt. Blend in mayonnaise and sour cream. Pour over fruit and toss. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar; set aside.

title: Ern'S Skillet Macaroni And Beef
instructions: Brown beef in large skillet; remove and cook macaroni onions and pepper in meat fat until macaroni is yellow. Return beef to skillet; add tomato sauce water salt pepper and Worcestershire. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until macaroni is cooked to suit. If it cooks out too dry another can of tomato sauce can be added. Very good either way.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Stir together flour cornmeal sugar baking powder and salt. Add eggs milk and oil. Beat just until smooth (do not overbeat). Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 or 9 servings.

title: Strawberry Streusel Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line muffin cups with paper liners. Sift together flour sugar brown sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon into medium bowl. Make a well in the center. Put the egg melted butter and milk in the well. Stir until combined. Quickly stir in strawberries and lemon zest. Fill each cup 3/4 full with batter.

title: Snowflake Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese until fluffy; add Cool Whip. Mix well. Fold in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Mushrooms Florentine
instructions: Combine and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts and debone; cut into small pieces. Save the broth then cook noodles in broth the chicken was cooked in. Mix in a large bowl the cream of chicken corn and sour cream. Stir in egg noodles and chicken. Mix together. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch covered baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Oven Lemon Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken pieces in mixture of flour and paprika. Melt butter in baking pan add chicken pieces and coat evenly with butter. Arrange in a single layer. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn chicken pieces and pour basting sauce over them. Continue baking until chicken is brown and tender about 30 minutes. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Magic No-Mix Bars
instructions: Combine and bake in the same pan. Melt butter or margarine in 9 x 13-inch oblong pan. Add cracker crumbs chocolate chips coconut and nuts. Pour over entire mixture the milk. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until slightly browned. Cool 15 minutes. Makes 32 bars.

title: Party Ham Biscuits
instructions: Slice top off whole package of rolls. Layer ham and sliced cheese. Put top back on rolls. Cut into separate pieces. Stir other ingredients into melted margarine. Pour over rolls and let set for 30 minutes or overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole dish.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and bananas then combine dry ingredients. Fold in nuts. Bake in two small or 1 large loaf pan. The pans should be half full. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Mint Fluff
instructions: Put cookies through food chopper. Pack crumbs into 9-inch spring-form pan. Keep some for topping. Soak gelatin in milk for 1 hour. Beat egg yolks sugar and salt in top of double boiler. Add gelatin and cook until thick (5 to 7 minutes); cool thoroughly. Beat egg whites stiff. Whip cream with vanilla and few drops food coloring. Fold egg yolks mixed with egg whites and whipped cream. Pour into pan; put crumbs on top. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Add 2 cups boiling water to Jell-O stir until dissolved. Add Coca-Cola stir in pineapple cream cheese (cut up) and nuts. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce (optional). Makes 8 servings of about 1/2-cup each.

title: Hot Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Combine first nine ingredients in a saucepan; cook and stir constantly over medium heat until cheese melts. Stir in crabmeat and remaining ingredients. Transfer to dish and keep warm.

title: Plum Cake
instructions: Blend together flour sugar oil and eggs. Beat well then add remaining ingredients. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Place quartered potatoes in shallow baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over potatoes. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Stew
instructions: Combine chicken tomatoes potatoes onion and okra in 5-quart crock-pot. Set on low and cook 8 hours or until potatoes are tender. Add corn ketchup and barbecue sauce. Cook 10 more minutes and serve.

title: Sour Cream N' Chive Pop Corn
instructions: Combine pop corn and butter. Sprinkle sauce mix over buttered pop corn. Stir until mix is well distrubuted.

title: Family Favorite
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed on package. Brown meat; drain. Add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender. Combine ingredients. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Herbed Cheese Spread
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add the parsley chives chervil garlic tarragon and lemon-pepper; mix well. Transfer to a serving dish. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Remove from the refrigerator 15 minutes before serving. Serve with crackers. Yield 1 1/2 cups.

title: Lemon Pineapple Ring
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sherbet a spoonful at a time stirring until melted. Add undrained pineapple. Chill until partially set. Fold in cottage cheese. Pour into 6 1/2-cup ring mold. Chill until set. Unmold onto serving platter. Center can be filled with fruit or decorated with mint leaves.

title: Squash Souffle
instructions: Cook squash and mash. Put slices of bread in dish and add warm milk. When bread is soft add hot squash and the rest of the ingredients except bread crumbs. Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in a 2-quart casserole. Spread crumbs over top and put back in oven and brown.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixer. Pour into buttered pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 min.

title: No-Bake Strawberry Bottom Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Beat sugar sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip blending well. Spread thin layer of glaze over bottom of crust. Place strawberry slices on glaze and cover with another thin layer of glaze. Gently spoon mixture over glazed berries in crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In 9 x 12-inch pan melt butter. Stir in macaroni to coat. Cover with grated cheese. Stir. Salt and pepper. Pour milk over all. Do not stir while baking. Cook 1 1/2 hours on 350\u00b0.

title: Bolts And Nuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Place on a cookie sheet and bake at 250\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: No Bake Hawaiian Cream Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into graham cracker crusts. Refrigerate several hours (at least 3 hours) and serve. This is a cool and refreshing dessert and very easy to prepare.

title: Shrimp-Olive Salad
instructions: Mix together and add dressing salt and pepper.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown all meat. Chop all onion. Combine in large casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except soup. Form into meatballs. Brown in skillet. Pour soup over browned meatballs and simmer. Quick and easy.

title: Ranch Beans
instructions: In large Dutch oven on medium heat brown diced bacon. Pour off excess grease. Use rest to saute onion rings until soft. Stir in all remaining ingredients; add bacon. Cook 20 minutes stirring often. Pour into casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered one hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Place in a greased bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pasta Salad(Italian Style)
instructions: Cook pasta (dont overcook). Drain and put in large bowl. Add tomato sauce and Italian dressing. Cut the rest of the ingredients into bite size pieces; add everything together and toss. Chill at least 1 hour; toss again before serving. (The longer it chills the better!!!)

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together; set aside. With mixer mix eggs margarine milk vanilla and bananas. Slowly add dry ingredients. Pour into greased and floured loaf pans. Fill pans 1/2 to 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Check with toothpick.

title: Grandma'S Favorite Stuffing
instructions: Combine all ingredients except broth butter and eggs. Toss ingredients well. Add broth butter and eggs. Mix well. Use to stuff neck and body cavities of turkey or for ease in preparation and serving. Cook separately in a well-greased baking dish or casserole during the last 45 minutes of roasting time.

title: Cheese Souffle For Two
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium-high heat melt butter. Blend in flour and salt. Cook stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Stir in milk all at once. Cook and stir until mixture boils and is smooth and thickened. Stir in cheese until melted. Set aside.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: In large skillet melt 3/4 stick of margarine. Saute onion and green pepper. Add beaten egg and sliced mushrooms. Add soy sauce to taste. Add cooked rice and mix well. Season with salt pepper garlic salt and more soy sauce if needed. If rice seems dry add remaining margarine.

title: Favorite Popcorn Snack
instructions: Mix together in large bowl or plastic bag. This is a Welcome School favorite its not messy!

title: Ranch Biscuits
instructions: Melt shortening; let cool. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of warm water (not hot). Mix all dry ingredients together then add all the liquids to form dough. Roll out on floured surface; cut with a large biscuit cutter. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Can be dotted with butter. Makes about 24 large biscuits.

title: Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Pat dry pork tenderloin (usually long tubular in shape and packaged with two together). Rub on Dijon mustard to meat; coat approximately 1/8-inch thick. Sprinkle with tarragon approximately 1 teaspoon per pound. Wrap tenderloin with bacon. Use toothpicks to secure two pieces together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes per pound or until cooked to 160\u00b0.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Fold in egg and milk mixture into flour then fold in lard to become firm. Roll out 1/4 of dough for one pie crust. Yields 4 pie crusts.

title: Florentine Potatoes
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in butter until soft. Add potatoes saute 2 minutes. Add tomatoes. Cook over high heat until slightly thickened. Add spinach heat through. Sprinkle with Cheese.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Layer bottom of pie crust with sugar and peanut butter mixture. Save a little to decorate top of pie. Use vanilla or peanut butter pudding using 1/4 cup less milk (cooked instant or frozen). Spread pudding over crumbs in the pie crust. Cover with Cool Whip then place crumbled topping to decorate.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Put fresh peaches in boiling water for a few minutes. Remove peel and cut into slices. Put peach slices in a 2-quart baking dish. Peaches should reach only halfway up the sides of the baking dish.

title: Chilie Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Spray pan. Lay whole chilies in pan. Stuff each chilie with chunk of Jack cheese. Mix eggs milk flour and seasonings. Pour over chilies and put cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Zucchini Patties
instructions: Combine zucchini egg carrot onion cheese green pepper 1/4 cup flour and salt and pepper and mix well. Shape this mixture into patties whatever size you choose and coat them with a mixture of 1/4 cup flour and 1 1/2 cups cornflake crumbs. Fry patties in a skillet with hot oil until brown.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Mix taco seasoning corn and beans with juice into meat. Crumble chips in bottom of long casserole pan. Pour meat mixture over chips and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over top and heat until melted. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve on crackers.

title: Mexican Tossed Salad
instructions: Place tomatoes beans and onions in a large salad bowl. Toss gently. Layer lettuce on top. Can be covered at this step and refrigerated. Just before serving add cheese corn chips and dressing. Toss and serve.

title: Homemade Mustard
instructions: Cook in double boiler until done.

title: Carrot-Pineapple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients well in a medium size mixing bowl. Pour into cake pan. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Four Layer Dessert
instructions: Melt margarine; add flour and nuts. Work together well with fork; spread over the bottom of large baking dish (13 1/2 x 9-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Set aside to cool. Cream the cheese adding sugar; fold in small carton Cool Whip. Spread over cooled first layer. Mix chocolate pudding using 3 1/2 cups milk. Spread over second layer. Spread large carton Cool Whip on top for final layer. Refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours before serving. May sprinkle chopped pecans or chocolate curls on top.

title: Gramma'S Irish Soda Bread
instructions: In a huge bowl stir first 4 ingredients. In another bowl cream margarine sugar and eggs. Stir creamed mixture into the flour along with buttermilk. This will be very stiff and heavy. Stir in caraway and raisins. Spoon into buttered heavy casserole dish. Cut an X on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 75 minutes.

title: Super Quick Buns
instructions: Lay open each hot dog bun. Put 1 slice of ham and cheese. Pull bun closed and push shredded lettuce on top. Sprinkle with garlic powder (to taste). Pour a teaspoon of dressing on top. Stick 2 toothpicks in bun to hold together. Wrap in plastic wrap. Microwave just until cheese melts.

title: Fresh Tomato Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients in glass or plastic bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour to blend flavor. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Orange Jello Dessert
instructions: Mix pineapple oranges and cottage cheese. Sprinkle dry jello over pineapple mixture. Fold in one 8 ounce Cool Whip (easy). Refrigerate in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut cauliflower pepper and onion into bite size. Mix all ingredients and chill before serving.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Logs
instructions: Combine powdered sugar and butter in large mixing bowl and beat with electric mixer until smooth. Stir in peanut butter and cereal (mixing with hands if needed). Shape into 1 1/2 x 1/2-inch logs. Chill. Spread tops of cookies with your choice of frosting.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and lard; add egg. Beat well. Add rest of ingredients and stir thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Quick Pineapple Pie
instructions: In a cake pan empty contents of can of pineapple with juice. Then evenly spread powder cake mix over pineapple. Melt butter in microwave or in a pan over low heat. Pour melted butter over the contents in cake pan. Then bake in oven at 325\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Healthy Brown Rice
instructions: Combine brown rice and sweet rice in a pot. Rinse the rice a couple of times. Pour in water add salt and soak for about 1 hour. Cover and cook on medium heat until it boils then lower heat and cook for about 45 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave the pot on the burner for 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Carrot Cookies
instructions: Mix all together and drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake With Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix cocoa in hot water. Mix all ingredients together and beat well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Raisin Filled Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add milk flour egg and baking powder.

title: Mom'S Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Mix together and heat. Serve over rice meatballs chicken or ribs.

title: Best Ever Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add milk. Chill dough for 30 minutes in refrigerator. After dough has been chilled roll out dough to 1/8-inch thick and cut into strips. Drop into soup.

title: Basil Chicken Medley
instructions: Heat oil in skillet; saute garlic. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink; remove and keep warm. Combine remaining ingredients except rice or pasta. Toss to coat vegetables well. Add to skillet and stir-fry about 3 to 5 minutes. Return chicken to skillet and heat thoroughly. Serves 4. Serve over rice or pasta.

title: Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Wash strawberries; stem them. Pour sugar over berries. Place over low flame until sugar dissolves. Boil for 20 minutes or use thermometer to temperature of 218\u00b0. Pour into glasses and top with melted paraffin wax.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Place in a shallow casserole dish and place cheese slices on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and roll into balls about the size of a quarter. Place under broiler for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until thick. Add sugar milk vanilla coconut and melted margarine. Pour into three unbaked pie shells. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Cantonese
instructions: Cut hippo into bite size pieces. Add spicy gravy enough to cover. Cook over open pit fire for 3 weeks. This will serve 2500 people. If more are expected a rabbit may be added but beware most people do not like hare in their stew!

title: Swiss Steak With Vegetables
instructions: Cut Swiss or round steak into individually sized pieces. Pound flour into both sides of meat. Brown both sides in hot fat in a large heavy skillet with cover. Add water celery stewed tomatoes onion carrot sticks and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for 1 hour with cover on. When meat and vegetables are tender remove from pan. Add brown gravy mix to juice in pan. Add more water if necessary. Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Jennifer'S Lasagne
instructions: Brown beef onion and garlic. Drain off fat. Stir in the undrained tomatoes tomato sauce tomato paste basil and salt. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes stirring frequently. Boil water in large pan. Add the lasagne noodles and oil. Cook until tender. Drain and rinse noodles. Beat eggs. Add 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese Ricotta parsley and pepper.

title: Crock Pot Potatoes
instructions: Peel and quarter the potatoes and boil until soft. Mash them and add cream cheese sour cream onions salt pepper and egg whites. Place in a crock pot or a casserole dish. The potatoes can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 7 days at this point.

title: Chocolate Mousse Cake
instructions: Prepare angel food cake according to package directions except add grated square of chocolate to batter before pouring into tube pan. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool in pan by inverting over bottle. Mix the cream sugar and cocoa; refrigerate until very cold. Sprinkle gelatin over 2 tablespoons cold water; let stand 5 minutes then heat stirring over hot water until dissolved. Let cool.

title: Chocolate Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients to make a cake-like batter.

title: Southwestern Chicken And Brown Rice
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with cumin chili powder and salt. Heat oil in 10-inch skillet over medium heat. Add chicken; cook and stir until no longer pink. Add onion and garlic; cook and stir 2 minutes. Drain tomatoes; set aside. Add water to reserved liquid to make 3/4 cup. Add liquid and picante sauce to skillet. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice; reduce heat. Cover tightly and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in beans and chopped tomatoes. Remove from heat. Let stand covered about 5 minutes until all liquid is absorbed. Sprinkle with cheese and garnish with sliced avocado. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place potatoes in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix margarine salt pepper soup milk and sour cream. Pour over potatoes. Scatter half of cheese over top and gently stir into potatoes. Bake for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and then mixture of corn flakes and margarine. Bake an additional 20 minutes.

title: Stephanie'S 7 Layer Bars
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add graham cracker crumbs. Press down to make crust. Pour in chocolate chips butterscotch chips coconut and nuts each time making a layer. Then pour Eagle Brand milk over entire pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Cool then cut into squares with greased knife.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch casserole pan put rice on bottom. Lay chicken on top of rice. Pour melted butter over chicken. Mix soup and water together and pour over chicken and rice. Sprinkle envelope of seasoning from box of rice on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes. Really delicious and so easy!

title: Coca-Cola Pork Chops
instructions: Place the pork chops in a baking pan; season with salt and pepper. Mix the ketchup and Coca-Cola; pour over the pork chops. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until pork chops are tender. Serves 8.

title: Annie'S Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix together diced apples and sugar. Add oil nuts eggs and vanilla. In another bowl sift together flour soda cinnamon and salt. Add to apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Pop popcorn. Boil sugar syrup and margarine about 5 minutes. Place popcorn in 9 x 13-inch pan. Scatter nuts on top. Pour syrup mixture over popcorn and nuts. Stir. Place in oven at 250\u00b0 for at least 1 hour. Stir every 20 minutes while cooking.

title: Salt Cod Fritters
instructions: Soak salt cod in water overnight. Combine the flour and egg in a bowl. Stir in enough water to make a thick paste and reserve. Remove any skin and small bones from the fish and chop very fine. Add the scallions garlic parsley thyme allspice salt and pepper. Stir in reserved flour paste until thoroughly combined. Heat enough oil in a heavy pan to deep fry the fritters. Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture in the pan at a time. Allow the fritters to cook until well browned. Remove fritters from the oil and allow to drain on paper towels. Makes 25 fritters.

title: Sauteed Tenderloin
instructions: Cook and stir mushrooms onion garlic salt lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce in 1/4 cup butter or margarine. Cook until mushrooms are tender. Stir in parsley. Keep warm. Melt 2 tablespoons of butter or margarine in skillet. Saute tenderloin slices over medium-high heat until browned turning once. Serve with mushroom/butter sauce.

title: Spinach Cheese Bake
instructions: Combine first six ingredients and stir until blended. Spoon mixture into greased 9 by 13 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes; top with cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Pralines
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large heavy saucepan mixing well. Bring to a boil. Stir in pecans; cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture reaches soft ball stage (234\u00b0). Remove from heat; beat with a wooden spoon 2 to 3 minutes or until mixture is creamy and begins to thicken. Working rapidly drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool. Yields 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Pie
instructions: Slice bananas into prepared pie shell. Spoon apple pie filling over bananas then pineapple over the apples. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of nuts over the pineapple then mound the Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle remaining nuts over the Cool Whip and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Melt oleo in skillet and brown on both sides before serving.

title: Summer Squash Tomato Casserole
instructions: Cut squash into halves. Remove seeds and cover with tomatoes and onions. Sprinkle with next 4 ingredients and top with bits of butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Red Cabbage
instructions: Saute onion in fat in saucepan until transparent. Add sugar vinegar caraway seed water salt and pepper. Mix well. Add cabbage and apples. Steam tightly covered 1 hour stirring occasionally.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream shortening and sugar. Beat in egg and molasses. Combine flour baking soda ginger cinnamon and salt. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Roll teaspoonfuls of dough into balls. Dip one side of each ball in sugar. Place with sugar side up on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Red Pepper Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill overnight. Garnish with chives. Serve with raw veggies or chips.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except jello and water. Mix jello and water and pour over other ingredients. Refrigerate until set.

title: Five Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans and mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Pizza Deluxe
instructions: Prepare spaghetti as package directs; drain. In medium bowl blend milk and egg. Add spaghetti; toss to coat. Spray a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with vegetable cooking spray. Spread spaghetti mixture evenly in prepared pan. In large skillet cook beef onion green pepper and garlic until beef is no longer pink; drain. Add tomato sauce and seasonings; simmer 5 minutes. Spoon meat mixture over spaghetti evenly. Top with mushrooms and cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Lemon Angel Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar to form soft peaks. Gradually add sugar. Beat till stiff. Fold cracker crumbs into egg whites. Spread on greased cookie sheet cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes let cool. Spread Cool Whip on crust. Top with cooled lemon pie filling.

title: Rhubarb Custard Cake
instructions: Pour prepared cake mix into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix together rhubarb and sugar. Spread on top of cake mixture and pour whipping cream (not whipped) over the rhubarb. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake is done.

title: Applesauce Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine butter sugar and cinnamon. Add syrup applesauce pecans and eggs. Blend well. Pour into pie shell. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and continue baking for 25-30 minutes more. Cool before cutting.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together sweetened condensed milk and lemon juice. Stir until thick. Fold in rest of ingredients. Freeze. Serve in squares with a dab of mayonnaise.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl except blueberries. Melt butter in deep pan. Pour raw berries in pan over butter then pour other mixed ingredients in pan over berries. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Mornin Biscuits
instructions: Melt margarine mix with other ingredients. Pour in square 8 x 8-inch pan. Dip biscuits in mixture and place in pan to bake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Parboil squash until tender. Dont cook too long. Mix squash onions salt pepper cheese egg and crackers; mix lightly with melted margarine. Sprinkle 5 or 6 crushed crackers on top. Bake 30 minutes or until browned on top and bubbly.

title: Broken Angel Food Cake
instructions: Mix together cream cheese sugar and prepared Dream Whip. Break angel food cake into pieces. Stir into cream cheese mixture; top with pie filling of your choice.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Freeze evaporated milk to a mush. Combine pineapple eggs and sugar. Bring to a boil. Add lemon jello. Cool. Whip evaporated milk stiff and fold into fruit mixture. Pour in graham cracker pie crust. Refrigerate. Makes enough for 2 pies.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Cut filet crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices. Cut each slice across grain into 1/2-inch wide strips. Slowly heat large heavy skillet. In it melt 2 tablespoons butter. Add just enough beef strips to cover skillet bottom. Over high heat sear quickly on all sides. With tongs remove beef as it browns. (It should be browned outside rare inside.) Brown rest of beef; set aside.

title: Oklahoma Style Picante
instructions: Put all peppers onions and carrots through food processor. Combine all ingredients in large pot and cook for 1 hour. Pack into hot sterile jars and they should seal themselves.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef in 2 tablespoons shortening. Add chopped onion and garlic (or use 1/2 teaspoon onion powder and 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder). Simmer until onion is tender. Add Mexene chili powder salt tomato paste and hot water. Cook in covered pan for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Mix 4 tablespoons flour with a little cold water and stir into the chili. Let simmer for a few minutes.

title: Hot Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach and drain squeezing out all liquid. Mix all ingredients. Chill 2 hours or more. Roll into 1-inch balls. Freeze or refrigerate until ready to use. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients and pour into a buttered 9 x 12-inch dish. Combine cornflakes and 1/2 stick melted margarine. Spread on top of potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 12.

title: Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: In Dutch oven brown meat. Add onions celery and garlic that have been sauteed for 5 minutes. Add bouillon soup. Worcestershire; season to taste. Bring to boil and simmer for 30 minutes. Mix in 4 cups corn bread and 1/2 cup onion tops. Bring seasoning up to taste. (Chicken gizzards are optional. You may increase the ground meat to substitute.) Always a hit!

title: Herb Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Saute leeks in 1 tablespoon butter in large skillet 8 to 10 minutes until just tender. Remove half of leeks. Add garlic and thyme; saute 2 minutes.

title: German Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix ingredients and store in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Pour uncooked broccoli cuts into casserole dish and sprinkle uncooked rice over the broccoli. Combine melted butter soup and cheese. Pour over broccoli and rice. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour into pie pan lined with pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Frank'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugars milk and butter in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until a firm ball forms in cool water stirring so it does not stick. Remove from heat; add vanilla and peanut butter and beat until thickens. Pour into buttered pie plate. This fudge sets up fast.

title: My Favorite Winter Salad(Makes 8 Or 10 Servings)
instructions: Combine gelatin and cranberry sauce over medium heat; stir until almost boiling and gelatin is dissolved. Stir in nuts mandarin oranges undrained pineapple and ginger ale. (I add 1/3 pint cottage cheese.) When fizzing stops pour mixture into a mold or glass dish. Allow to chill and set.

title: Punch For 300
instructions: Boil water and dissolve sugar. Add all other liquids. Mix well. Use any food coloring you like. Put in open containers and freeze. It freezes in about 12 hours; set out to thaw. Do not add ice; just stir.

title: Earth Bread
instructions: Mix egg oil sugar and vanilla. Add dry ingredients that have been sifted together. Stir in zucchini carrots bananas and nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 1/2 x 5 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain beans and corn. Mix onion cheese celery soup sour cream salt with beans and corn. Place in casserole.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Place quartered chicken 6 cups water 1 teaspoon salt peppercorns and bay leaves in a large pot. Bring to a boil; reduce heat cover and simmer 45 minutes or until tender. Allow chicken to cool; skin bone and dice it. Skim fat from broth. Discard bay leaves and peppercorns and save 4 cups broth. Cook spaghetti until barely tender and drain. Combine all ingredients. Place in a 2 1/2-quart greased casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until most broth is absorbed.

title: Escarole Soup
instructions: Wash escarole leaves in cold water to get all dirt and sand off. Soak for 1/2 hour drain and cut up into small pieces. Add to pot with 1 1/2 quarts water. Add salt and pepper; let it come to a boil and cook until escarole is soft. Meanwhile boil 2 quarts water in a saucepan to cook macaroni. When finished (about 10 to 12 minutes) drain and rinse in cold water. Set aside. Reduce escarole to a simmer. Add kidney beans (do not drain) tomatoes mushrooms and chicken broth. Bring back up to a boil reduce to simmer and add macaroni. Serve hot sprinkled with Parmesan cheese.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cut diagonally across grain into 1/4-inch wide strips. Brown in butter; push meat to one side. Add mushrooms and onion; cook until tender. Add broth; heat just to boiling. Blend sour cream and flour; stir into broth. Cook and stir until mixture thickens. Season to taste. Serve over hot buttered noodles. Yields 4 to 5 servings.

title: Dottie'S Hot Dogs
instructions: Melt jelly and mustard over low heat. Boil hot dogs and drain. Cut up hot dogs if they are regular size. Add the hot dogs to the hot jelly mixture. Serve in chafing dish or container that holds heat. Have a supply of toothpicks for spearing.

title: Starlight Double Delight Cake
instructions: Combine the shortening and frosting mixture thoroughly. Blend in one egg at a time; beat for 1 minute. Sift together the flour soda and salt; add to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk beginning and ending with the dry ingredients. Blend thoroughly after each addition. Pour into 2 well-greased and lightly floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes (9 x 13-inch pan for 45 to 55 minutes). Cool; frost with remaining Chocolate Frosting. Serves 12.

title: Pink Champagne Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sugar together. Mix all together and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Garnish with chopped nuts. Freeze several hours. Thaw 20 minutes before serving.

title: Cracker Pie
instructions: Mix chopped pecans and crushed crackers in large bowl and set aside. In small mixing bowl beat egg whites salt vanilla and Karo syrup until stiff. Add sugar. Fold mixture in with pecans and crushed crackers. Bake in 9-inch greased pie pan at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until golden. It will sink as it cools. Let cool completely then top with Cool Whip and grated coconut. Refrigerate. Yield 1 pie.

title: Korean Chicken Or Beef
instructions: Mix all ingredients except meat in a large bowl. Add the meat and mix thoroughly. Marinate for at least 24 hours. Then bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or barbecue.

title: Thomas Jefferson'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; rinse and drain thoroughly. Meanwhile melt butter in saucepan. Stir in flour and blend well over low heat. Stir in milk slowly. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Cook 1 minute. Add 1 3/4 cups grated cheese and stir to blend. Add ham bits and macaroni. Pour into well-buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Animals Soup
instructions: Combine the two scoops of ice cream and chocolate syrup together and stir until creamy then add animal crackers to the \soup\ and enjoy your animal soup.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into one unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Old Fashion Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream first five ingredients together. Add last three ingredients. Roll out on cheesecloth or pillow case. Sprinkle lightly with sugar. Cut out and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies(Makes 5 Dozen)
instructions: Beat Eagle Brand milk peanut butter egg and vanilla until smooth. Add Bisquick and mix well. Chill 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet and flatten with fork. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 6 to 8 minutes. Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in a little water until almost tender. Drain then add oleo and sugar. Cool slightly then add milk and eggs. Fold in salt and pepper then cheese.

title: Boiled Custard(My Grandmother'S Recipe)
instructions: Pour milk in double boiler and scald. Mix egg yolks sugar and salt together. Add 4 tablespoons cornstarch. Mix and add to scalded milk. Cook on low heat; stir until thick. Cool and fold in beaten egg whites and vanilla. Cool before serving.

title: One Pan Fruit Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease bottom of 10 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Stir all ingredients in a 3 or 4-quart bowl with fork until moistened. Then beat vigorously for 1 minute. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean 35 or 40 minutes (or sometimes sooner it will be nice and brown). Cool l5 minutes. Run spatula on edge of pan.

title: Scalloped Corn Bake
instructions: Boil corn uncovered 20 minutes before tasting. Drain well. Combine corn milk eggs onion pepper and 3/4 cup cheese. Turn mix into 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish or 1-quart casserole. Toss bread crumbs with the melted butter and the remaining cheese. Sprinkle over corn mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Garnish with green peppers if desired.

title: Old-Fashioned Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes with sharp knife; thinly slice potatoes. In greased 2-quart casserole arrange half the potatoes. Sprinkle with half the onion; pour half the sauce on top. Repeat with remaining potatoes.

title: Molded Lime Horseradish Salad
instructions: Mix jello and water. Cool until it starts to set then whip. Add cottage cheese etc. Chill in 9 x 9-inch glass dish.

title: Patio Bean Salad
instructions: Mix sugar salt pepper vinegar oil or garlic and salad oil. Pour mixture over beans onion and pepper. Let stand 2 hours.

title: Pueblo Chicken 'N Rice
instructions: Combine rice tomatoes onion and chicken. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon 1/2 mixture in an even layer in greased 2 1/2 quart shallow casserole. Cover with 1/2 of sour cream and 1/2 chile strips half of cheese and all of olives. Repeat layering with remaining chicken mixture sour cream chiles and cheese. Cover and chill as long as 24 hours. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hungarian Nut Crescents
instructions: Combine flour and salt. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Blend sour cream egg and vanilla with fork. Gradually add to flour mixture. Mix until well blended. Chill for 3 to 4 hours or until firm enough to handle. Divide dough into 3 parts. On a lightly floured board roll each part into a 9 to 10 inch circle about 1/8 inch thick. Cut each circle into 12 wedges. Combine nuts sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle 3/4 of the mixture over the wedges. Roll each wedge from the widest end to point. Brush with egg white and sprinkle with remaining nut mixture. Bake on a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot in the order listed. Cover and set on low 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours). Push cabbage wedges down into liquid after 6 hours on low (or 3 hours on high).

title: Creamed Onions
instructions: Parboil onions until tender. Meanwhile make a white sauce. Melt margarine in saucepan. Blend in flour and add milk gradually. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture has thickened. Drain onions and add to cream sauce. Season to taste. Yields 4 servings.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients with mixer. Grease pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Better if served hot.

title: Cracker Cookies
instructions: Layer crackers in a cookie pan. Melt butter and oleo; add sugar. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Add vanilla and pecans. Pour over crackers and bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cabbage Cheese Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Saute onion in drippings until soft. Add tomato sauce. Chop up cabbage; add to mixture and steam. Add 2 cups of water; let it boil. Add 1 cup of rice. Let all cook for 20 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Boiled Cabbage
instructions: Place in large pot. Cover with water. Cook until tender; serve. You can also fix turnips this way.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain; rinse with cool water. Let pasta dry on paper towels. In a medium bowl stir together 3 cups Mozzarella Ricotta and basil. Carefully stuff pasta with cheese mixture. Spray 13 x 9-inch baking dish and spread 2 cups Marinara Sauce on bottom of dish. Arrange stuffed pasta over sauce. Pour remaining sauce on top. Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake for 15 minutes. Top with Parmesan; bake 10 minutes longer. Serve hot.

title: Iowa Corn Chowder
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat heat butter. Cook celery onion and green pepper with sage until tender. Stir in soup. In a covered blender container or food processor at medium speed blend soup mixture until smooth. Return mixture to saucepan. Add corn. Gradually stir in milk and cream. Heat thoroughly stirring occasionally. Garnish with cheese. Makes 3 1/3 cups.

title: Spread Or Dip
instructions: Cut sausage into thin slices. Place in boiler and boil until all fat is out of sausage. Boil eggs until done. Place sausage sandwich spread and eggs in blender. Start blender on chop until well blended. Makes 1 pint. Use assorted crackers or chips.

title: Apple Dumplngs
instructions: Peel core and slice each apple into 8 slices. Pull apart each biscuit into three flaky stacks. Wrap each apple slice with 1/3 of biscuit stretched to fit around it. Place wrapped apples in a greased baking dish. Bring water sugar and margarine to a boil. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour over wrapped apples. Sprinkle ground cinnamon on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Relish
instructions: Mix well with hands. Put in refrigerator overnight. Will keep 3 months in refrigerator. Do not use a metal bowl.

title: Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add other ingredients. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured tube pan.

title: Betty'S Spinach Bread
instructions: Boil spinach as directed. Salt to taste. Drain and set aside. Saut onion and garlic in butter. Add spinach and cream cheese. Add Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle garlic powder onion powder and pepper to taste. Open frozen garlic bread. Spread spinach mixture over frozen bread. Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Bake as directed.

title: Hawaiian Sweet And Sour Ribs
instructions: Boil ribs in water for about 30 minutes; drain. Add all ingredients (except the garnish) and cook about 15 minutes on high to coat well and tender. Layer platter with shredded daikon and carrots mixture. Pour ribs on top and serve.

title: Tomato And Onion Salad
instructions: Finely dice equal amounts of the tomatoes and onions. Toss with lemon juice and chill thoroughly (may be placed in freezer for 10 to 15 minutes). This is a good salad to serve with highly spiced foods such as curry.

title: Cheese Strata
instructions: In casserole dish line buttered bread on bottom. Layer cheese then bacon or ham then bread again cheese meat. Combine eggs and milk; pour over layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Candy Cane Cookies
instructions: Mix together Basic Batch and candy pieces. Beat egg with milk. Add to dry mixture; blend well. Knead dough slightly with hands to fully mix. Drop by teaspoons 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from oven; immediately sprinkle with decorator sugar or candy pieces. Cool slightly before removing from sheet. Yields 2 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Add sugar and cream of tartar gradually to egg whites. Beat until stiff. Fold in crackers. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan (glass pan looks nice) at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. While cooling will fall some.

title: Fluffy White Frosting
instructions: Bring sugar cream of tartar salt and water to boil. Let cook until sugar dissolves. Add unbeaten egg white and marshmallows beating constantly with electric mixer until frosting is in peaks. Add vanilla and spread on cake.

title: Fried Pie Dough
instructions: Mix all together in a bowl. Roll into balls and put in Tupperware (with a lid) and put in the refrigerator. Take out as needed. Roll out dough and fill with cooked fruit. Will keep 1 week in the refrigerator.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Pour milk into medium bowl. Add pudding mix and mix. Fold in whipped topping. Stir 1 cup cookies and spoon into pie crust. Sprinkle with rest of cookies. Freeze about 4 hours.

title: Simple Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop on a cookie sheet about 1 tablespoon each. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Can be iced.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 1 hour until done.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown meat and drain if too much fat. Add all other ingredients along with meat in a large saucepan and simmer several hours. When the recipe is doubled add 3 packages taco seasoning. Simply delicious with cornbread.

title: Banana Shake
instructions: Puree banana lemon juice and sugar in blender or food processor until smooth. Add milk and yogurt; blend until thoroughly mixed. Pour into glasses. Top with dab of whipped cream. Makes 3 cups.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients keep on a double boiler. Take marshmallows. Roll one marshmallow at a time in caramel mixture and then in a bowl of Rice Krispies. Place on waxed paper.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Melt butter in medium casserole dish. Mix with remaining ingredients and bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.

title: Almost Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. When cake is done and still hot poke holes in cake with the end of a wooden spoon. Pour milk in holes and cover entire cake with topping. Cool cake completely. Spread Cool Whip over cake and sprinkle with crushed Heath bars.

title: Amy'S Fabulous Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl and stir well. Serve chilled.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring water to a boil and add rice. Simmer until the rice has absorbed all the water.

title: Any Occasion Punch(Serves 20)
instructions: Combine pineapple juice lemonade concentrate sugar and drink mix in 1 gallon container; mix well. Add enough water to fill container. Chill until serving time.

title: Old Fashioned Swiss Steak
instructions: Let rise knead to a soft dough. When raised turn on board and roll to a 14 by 10 rectangle. Spread dressing over the middle. Leave sides to turn over. 1/4 c. thousand Island dressing 6 oz. sliced corned beef or dried beef 4 oz. swiss cheese. 1 small can drained sauerkraut. Pull sides over and pinch together. Spread one egg white and poppy seeds over. Let rise 10 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Chop the onion green pepper and pimentos. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix and pour into greased covered dish (1 1/2 to 2-quart size). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Great with Mexican food!

title: Pink Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix in large bowl the Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Add crushed pineapple oranges and coconut. Fold in marshmallows nuts and pie filling. Mix well and chill. This can be frozen for later use.

title: Pasta Hut Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce. Mix with remaining ingredients and let set at least 2 hours.

title: Stir-Fry Cabbage
instructions: Saute in oil the cabbage onion and celery until soft (not fried). Add season packet. Cook Top Ramen as directed on package. Drain. Toss noodles in cabbage mixture. Diced leftover chicken can be added if you like. Use soy sauce as desired. A very quick and easy meal.

title: Homestyle Beef
instructions: Slice steak into thick strips. Slice onion. Heat oil on medium heat. Cook onions 3 minutes. Add beef and fry 3 minutes. Add gravy to pan. Heat on low. Simmer 5 minutes. Heat muffins in microwave for 30 seconds. Serve mixture on muffins.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and cream cheese with mixer. Stir in pineapple strawberries and nuts. Stir in Cool Whip and bananas. Place in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish and freeze.

title: Barbecued Beef(Pulgogi)
instructions: Slice the beef thinly and score lightly with a knife to make it more tender. Cut it into bite size pieces and marinate it in the sugar and rice wine. Mix the marinated beef thoroughly with the soy sauce chopped garlic sesame salt and sesame oil. Broil the seasoned beef over hot charcoal on a grill or in a frypan.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Heat to boiling the Jell-O sugar pineapple and water. Cool items. Soften cream cheese Cool Whip (use whisk on these items) chopped celery and pecans. Fold into apricot mixture. Pour into 8 x 10-inch Pyrex dish and chill.

title: Zippy Broiled Whole Catfish
instructions: Clean wash and dry fish. Brush inside with lemon juice; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roll fish in flour; shake off excess. Place fish on well-greased broiler pan. Brush with salad dressing. Broil about 4-inches from source of heat for 4 to 6 minutes basting occasionally. Turn carefully and brush with salad dressing. Broil 4 to 6 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily with fork. Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; cut up onions and pepper. Mix in meal. Add melted oleo; add cheese. Save enough cheese to sprinkle on top. Put in greased iron skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Oven-Fried Eggplant
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients. Stir well. Spread evenly over both sides of eggplant slices. Combine bread crumbs cheese and Italian seasoning in a shallow bowl. Dredge eggplant in bread crumb mixture. Place eggplant on a baking sheet sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Turn eggplant over and bake 12 minutes or until golden. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and peanut butter. Add sugar. Add egg. Add sifted dry ingredients. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Layered Salad(Great For Dinner Parties)
instructions: Note Looks good in clear round bowl.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine flour butter and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Spread preserves over crust. Combine cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over preserves. Add layer of sliced banana. Prepare pudding as label directs and spread over bananas. Top with Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Place broccoli cheese bacon and onion in bowl. In a separate bowl mix the salad dressing vinegar and sugar well. Pour this mixture over the broccoli mixture. Chill overnight and serve.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Salt potatoes to suit taste.

title: Andale-Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. If too dry add some of reserved tomato juice. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with Doritos or Fritos. Yields 2 cups.

title: Truffles
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water. Stir in condensed milk salt and vanilla. Put mixture in refrigerator for about 45 minutes. With buttered hands shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in cocoa coconut or chopped nuts. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Banana Split Snack Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. In a large bowl cream margarine sugar and eggs. Stir in buttermilk bananas and vanilla mixing well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. Stir in flour oats soda and salt; mix well. Stir in chips. Spread batter in prepared pan. Sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Microwave Smothered Pot Roast
instructions: Puncture meat with fork on all sides. Spread 1/2 of each soup mix on the bottom of cooking bag. Place meat on top. Spread rest of soups on top of meat. Seal the bag; do not slit any part of bag. Place in microwave bowl. Let sit about 1/2 hour. Place in microwave; cook for 20 minutes per pound at power level 5. When halfway through cooking turn roast around in the bag. Reseal.

title: Date-Nut Bites
instructions: In medium bowl combine dates almonds sugar vanilla and egg white. Refrigerate 1 hour. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease large cookie sheet. Shape date mixture into balls; top each with a cherry half and place on cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Cool on cookie sheet 5 minutes. Remove balls to wire racks to cool. Makes about 24 pieces or 1 pound.

title: Marinated Veggie Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain well. In a large bowl combine macaroni broccoli cauliflower mushrooms artichoke hearts ripe olives and green onions. Toss with Italian dressing and cover. Chill several hours. At serving time toss vegetable mixture with avocado and tomato.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in oven. Pour off drippings. Mix salt and black pepper with meat. Saute onion bell pepper and celery in butter. Mix together then add cheese sauce. Pour in a casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pumpernickel Caraway Bread
instructions: Place all ingredients in machine bread pan according to manufacturers instructions. Select basic bread setting. Choose crust color and size loaf if available. Bake according to machine directions. Check dough after 5 minutes of mixing; add 1-2 Tbsp. water or flour if needed. Yields a 1 lb. loaf.

title: Rural Fried Chicken Batter
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and roll chicken in mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Quiche(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Place cooked broccoli in greased pie pan. Sprinkle cheese on top. Combine remaining ingredients in blender for 15 seconds. Pour mixture over broccoli. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Egg Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Slowly stir in hot milk. At once pour into pie shell. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 5 minutes; reduce heat to 425\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes or longer until knife inserted comes out clean. Do not overcook!

title: Vanilla And Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and lightly flour 2 (8-inch) pound cake pans. Prepare vanilla sugar by stirring 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla into 1 cup sugar until well blended. Beat together the sugar mixture and butter until mixture is creamy. Add remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla. Sift together the flour baking powder salt and baking soda. Add to sugar mixture alternately with sour cream beating just until mixed. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into cake mixture.

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: In medium saucepan saute onion carrot and garlic in oil for 3 minutes. Add rice; cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in water picante sauce and diced tomatoes and green chilies. Cover; reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Let stand covered for 5 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Mexi-Chili Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread 1/3 cup on each tortilla. Roll up (like a jelly roll) place in a covered container at least 2 hours. Slice into 1-inch slices. Serve with additional salsa.

title: Cajun Cake
instructions: Mix together and beat by hand for 1 minute. Place in a greased 11 x 14-inch pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 300\u00b0. Remove and spread with topping while hot.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and margarine in 2 1/2-quart bowl. Stir in eggs until blended. Add bananas beat 30 seconds. Stir in remaining ingredients except nuts just until moistened. Stir in nuts. Pour into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Long Grain And Wild Rice-A-Roni
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni as directed adding chicken and salt with liquid. Stir in green pepper mushrooms and tomato during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Stir and serve. Makes 5 (1 cup) servings.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Use a pan 10 inches long 6 inches wide and 2 inches deep. Grease pan with margarine. Butter the bread and cut into squares. Put 1 layer of buttered bread into greased pan. Shake raisins in flour and place some on the first layer of bread. Put second layer of buttered bread. Put raisins on second layer of buttered bread then pour the mixture of eggs milk sugar and vanilla over the bread and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Southwest Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook sliced carrots in water until almost tender (use 4-quart pan). Add all other ingredients except tortillas. Cover and simmer on low heat for 45 minutes. Remove from heat. Cut tortillas into 1 x 2-inch strips and stir into soup. Let soup sit for 5 minutes and stir again.

title: Sweet Minglers Crispix Mix
instructions: In a large microwave-safe bowl melt chocolate at high for 1 minute. Stir and heat an additional 30 seconds at high or until melted. Stir in peanut butter and peanuts. Gently stir cereal into chocolate-peanut butter mixture until well coated. Place powdered sugar in 2-gallon storage bag. Add coated cereal and close the bag. Gently toss cereal mixture until well coated. Store in airtight container in refrigerator. Yield about 8 cups.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix everything except broccoli green beans and topping. Grease casserole. Arrange 1/2 of cooked broccoli in bottom of casserole and put 1/2 sauce on top then cover with green beans and layer of broccoli and rest of sauce. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sweet Potato Pone
instructions: Melt butter; mix ingredients all together. Pour in dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Apricot Slush
instructions: Put in ice cream bucket and freeze. Scoop into glass and fill with 7-Up.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Beat well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour in 3 pie shells.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients well and put into greased 10 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Pour Cream Cheese Frosting over cake while hot.

title: Salmon Soup
instructions: In large saucepan combine potatoes garlic onion celery chicken broth salt and marjoram. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
