instructions: Cook margarine milk and powdered sugar to soft ball stage. Add peanut butter marshmallow cream and vanilla. Blend together well. Spread in Pam sprayed 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish. Allow to cool and enjoy.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Combine ground beef and 1/2 envelope soup mix bread crumbs and egg. Shape into 12 balls. In preheated skillet brown meatballs in shortening and drain fat. Blend in remaining soup mix and flour and gradually stir in water and parsley. Cook covered over low heat for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Gradually stir in sour cream. Serve with noodles or rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach-Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Place cream cheese and margarine in a large casserole dish. Melt in microwave over low heat stirring frequently to blend. Add spinach artichoke hearts salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until heated throughout (about 30 minutes).

title: Mud
instructions: Finely crush 6 whole graham crackers in a large Ziploc bag. Put chocolate pudding and milk in a jar. Shake for 2 minutes and pour into 6 cups. Stir in crushed graham crackers. Dig holes for \seeds\ and gummy worms. Eat and enjoy!

title: Bonbons
instructions: Mix ingredients together and chill. Take out; roll into balls and chill again.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Add flour salt and soda; alternate with buttermilk. Add bananas and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 until sides loosen in Bundt pan. Needs no frosting very moist.

title: Artichoke Spread
instructions: Drain artichokes; dry with paper towel coarsely chop. Mix together with rest of ingredients spread into shallow ovenproof dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with crackers or party rye.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown the hamburger with the onion. Layer in cake pan the hamburger cream soup mixed veggies 1 cup shredded cheese and mashed potatoes. Sprinkle rest of the cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Taco Quiche
instructions: In a skillet brown beef; drain. Add taco seasoning and prepare according to package directions. Spoon meat into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a bowl beat eggs and milk. Add biscuit mix and pepper. Mix well. Pour over meat. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool 5 to 10 minutes. Spread sour cream over top. Sprinkle with lettuce tomatoes green pepper onions and cheese.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: Cook mostaccioli noodles. Drain. Pour cooking oil over top of mostaccioli; let drain. Mix vinegar sugar salt pepper garlic powder and Dijon mustard. Add chopped green onions including the greens and the chopped cucumber. Add the mostaccioli. Stir and refrigerate. Can refrigerate for 2 to 3 days stirring occasionally. Before serving add cherry tomatoes and stir.

title: Holiday Fruit Soup
instructions: Place fruit tapioca and 4 cups water in a large saucepan. Cover and let stand overnight. Add apples sugar and remaining water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour or until tapioca is transparent. Add additional water if necessary. Serve warm or cold with a dash of cinnamon. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chocolate Spice Bars
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with sugar eggs and vanilla. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread into two 9 x 13-inch greased pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put pineapple (juice and all) in dish then add cherries. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Chunk margarine on top. Add nuts. I use pecan halves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Pies
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Beat egg yolks and add milk. Mix with dry ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Add vanilla and coconut mixing well. Pour into baked pie crusts. Beat egg whites until stiff adding 2 tablespoons sugar gradually. Add to top of pies and brown.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Toss together first 7 ingredients. Mix French dressing and salsa. Pour on salad. Top with broken Doritos. Do not add dressing until ready to serve or lettuce will wilt.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops. Place rice in 9 x 12 baking pan. Drain mushrooms saving liquid. Sprinkle mushrooms over rice. Sprinkle onion soup over rice. Add water to mushroom liquid to make 3 cups liquid. Pour over rice etc. Place pork chops on top of rice mixture. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Cook and drain the potatoes. Beat sour cream cream cheese and potatoes until blended (add milk if too stiff). Season to taste with salt. You may add garlic salt too if desired. Add chives last and then put in casserole. Dot with butter. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. If you make a day ahead of time bake 1 hour to warm.

title: Sour Cream Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut maraschino cherries in half. Reserve portion of cherries and coconut for garnish. Place sour cream in large mixing bowl. Add cherry juice; blend well. Add fruit cocktail pineapple and cherries; mix well. Stir in marshmallows coconut and red cherries. Refrigerate covered overnight.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix with fork. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons with each cup of boiling water.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Crush bananas and whip until very light. Cream the butter sugar and eggs together. Add flour soda powder and chopped nuts. Mix well. Add bananas and mix lightly. Turn into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake for 60 to 75 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package. Meanwhile simmer pineapple and sugar in pan. Remove cake from oven; while hot punch holes in top of cake. Cover with pineapple and sugar. Chill overnight. Mix pudding as directed on package. Add coconut to pudding mix; pour over pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and refrigerate. Enjoy!

title: Ground Beef And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion until browned. Drain and add rest of ingredients. Pour into baking dish and bake at 325 degrees for 35-40 minutes.

title: Georgia Peach Bread
instructions: Place peaches and 6 tablespoons sugar in blender. Process until pureed (mixture should yield about 2 1/4 cups).

title: French Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: In a heavy pan or the top of a double boiler combine egg yolks milk sugar and salt. Cook gently stirring it until it is thick enough to coat a spoon (like a custard) and let cool. Stir in cream and vanilla. Pour mixture into a freezer can and freeze for basic vanilla. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour into a greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Bars
instructions: Mix butter graham crackers peanut butter and sugar by hand. Press mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate. Melt chocolate bits. Frost peanut butter mixture with melted chocolate. Cut into small squares; they are very rich.

title: Italian Envelopes
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients. Place wonton wrapper with corner toward you. Put 1 tablespoon of mix in center. Brush edges with water. Fold right and left corners inward overlap slightly. Bring top and bottom inward overlap in middle. Heat oil; fry single layer of wonton until golden on both sides. Remove. Sprinkle immediately with Parmesan cheese. Drain. Serve warm. Makes 18 to 20 servings.

title: Chicken, Broccoli And Ziti
instructions: Saute chicken in oil and butter until brown. Add cream of chicken soup and chicken broth. Stir and simmer for 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked. Add broccoli. Cook ziti as directed. Drain; mix with chicken and broccoli.

title: Mini Quiche Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare mini muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray. Place biscuit mix in large bowl. Combine butter milk and egg in 2-cup glass measure. Mix well. Pour into biscuit mix; stir just until moistened. Add remaining ingredients; stir. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 8 to 12 minutes until golden brown. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen mini muffins.

title: Chocolate Chess Cake
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with 1 egg and cake mix. Press into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and 2 eggs. Pour over top of cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until light brown. Cool completely before cutting.

title: Easy Oven Stew
instructions: In a Dutch oven brown the steak in oil. Add the next 8 ingredients; cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours stirring twice. Add the peas during the last 30 minutes of cooking time. This is a good recipe for a busy day. You meal is ready for dinner.

title: Do-Ahead Slaw
instructions: Toss cabbage sugar onion olives and green pepper in a large bowl; set aside. Boil celery seed mustard pepper vinegar and oil 3 minutes. Pour hot mixture over cabbage. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours before serving. Stir occasionally. Serves 8.

title: Roasted Maple Squash
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Peel squash and cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks. In shallow roasting pan toss squash with oil maple syrup and salt. Arrange in a single layer in pan and roast 35 to 40 minutes turning every 10 minutes until tender and golden.

title: Oyster Snack Crackers
instructions: Combine ingredients and stir stir stir. Store in covered container.

title: Tarts
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Place unbaked tart shell on baking sheet and fill (not all the way to top). Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust edges are well done.

title: Cool Lime Drink
instructions: Mix together and add ice cubes. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Cheesecake Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cream cheese. Add sugar and vanilla and blend well. Add eggs. Blend well. Pour into lined cupcake tins until 3/4 full. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cups rise and fall in the center. After cooling fill the indentation with cherry pie filling.

title: Bran Bread
instructions: Mix the All-Bran with the 2 cups boiling water. Mix the yeast and sugar with the 1/4 cup warm water. Combine all ingredients. Knead. Let rise and then put in 3 greased pans. Let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg milk and vanilla. Add flour and stir until just moist; leave lumpy. Fill muffin tins 1/2 full; top with teaspoon of jam. Cover each with remaining batter. Sprinkle muffins with cinnamon/sugar mixture before baking. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 9 to 12 muffins.

title: Spinach And Cheese
instructions: In a very large bowl beat eggs. Add flour milk pepper and baking powder and mix. Boil spinach and drain well. Add cheese spinach and finely chopped onion to bowl. In pan melt a little butter. Wipe excess with paper towel. Pour mix into 13 x 9 x 2-inch Teflon pan and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Best if covered and refrigerated overnight. Cut like brownies when cold. Heat in oven or microwave before serving.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well together and roll in chopped pecans.

title: Green Bean Bundles
instructions: Cut bacon slices in half. Wrap around a bunch of green beans and place seam side down in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Place bundles in a single layer. In a small saucepan over medium heat combine butter brown sugar garlic powder and pepper. Heat until bubbly and sugar is dissolved. Pour over beans. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover the last few minutes. Serves 6.

title: Graham Cracker Pie
instructions: Blend graham crackers 1 teaspoon flour 1/2 cup sugar softened butter and cinnamon thoroughly. Press one half of mixture firmly in even layer on bottom and sides of a well-buttered pie pan (9-inch).

title: Crock-Pot Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Cook ingredients in crock-pot until cheese is melted and heated through. Cook on low for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Cinnamon Buns
instructions: Mix 2 1/4 cups flour and yeast. Heat milk and 1/3 cup butter 1/3 cup sugar and salt. Heat until warm and butter is almost melted. Add to flour mixture eggs. Beat with mixer on low speed for 30 seconds. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes. Use wooden spoon to stir in remaining flour. Turn dough on lightly floured surface and knead. Shape into ball; put in greased bowl. Let raise 1 to 2 hours. Punch down and let raise a little more. Roll out a 12-inch square; let rest. Sprinkle filling over dough. Top with raisins and nuts. Roll up like jelly roll and pinch ends.

title: Spiced Tea - Liquid
instructions: In 1 quart water simmer cloves and cinnamon for 30 minutes. Strain and mix with other ingredients. Serve hot. Keeps in refrigerator a long time. Heat it up as you need it.

title: Braunschweiger Ball
instructions: Mash cream cheese at room temperature and mix enough mayo to spread; set aside. Blend together braunschweiger chili sauce and horseradish. Spread cream cheese over and garnish with olives.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar until creamed well. Add eggs flour baking powder and milk; beat well. Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: *Kadaifi 1(Shredded Dough)
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread pan with 1/3 of Kadaif. Sprinkle with 1/3 of melted butter and half the nuts. Continue with another layer of Kadaif butter and nuts. The final layer is Kadaif and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until lightly browned. Let cool and cut into squares. When completely cool pour hot syrup gradually.

title: Creamed Spinach
instructions: Stir together the cream cheese butter milk salt and hot pepper sauce over low heat until smooth. Add spinach. Heat thoroughly. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Doughnuts For Selling
instructions: Let the first 7 ingredients rise until double. Add the rest of flour. Roll out cut and let rise. Makes 5 pounds in all.

title: Pear-Ginger Tart
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 10 inch quiche pan with vegetable cooking spray. Peel and slice pears; arrange in pan. In blender combine milk sugar egg whites yolk ginger vanilla salt and flour. Blend. Pour batter over pears. Top with sliced almonds. Bake 1 hour or until knife into center comes out clean. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar when cooled. Per slice Calories 158; Fat 39.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except chow mein noodles. Pour into pan. Sprinkle with noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stew
instructions: Place meat in bottom of casserole dish. Put soup mix salt and paprika over meat spreading evenly; mix well. Arrange carrots onions and potatoes on top of meat. Spread soup (cream of celery) over all. Bake covered for 2 hours or until meat is done in 325\u00b0 oven. Add catsup and parsley over stew. Serve with tossed salad and rolls.

title: Mississippi Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pie shell in order listed. Blend well and pour into pie shell. Bake in a hot oven (450\u00b0) for 10 minutes; reduce temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes or until a silver knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Clam Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Form into 1-inch balls. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Stir in cranberries until sauce dissolves. Add pecans. Pour half of mixture in pan or mold and refrigerate until set. Spread on sour cream and pour on remaining jello mixture. Refrigerate until set.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Mix water and yeast in a warm bowl. Blend in other ingredients including half of flour. Add rest of flour to form dough. Knead about 8 to 10 minutes. Put in greased bowl (grease all over). Let rise 45 minutes (twice the size). Split into 2 loaves. Let rise in pans for 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Stir and mix ingredients very well. Makes 2 1/2 cups. Replace avocado pit into dip to keep from turning brown. Chill before you serve.

title: Chicken And Sunshine
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Stir in peppers and green onion. Add chicken and cook until browned. Add tomatoes. Sprinkle dressing mix and basil over top. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 25 to 30 minutes until chicken is done. Yield 4 servings. Ooh so good over rice or noodles!

title: Egg Bake(Prepare Night Before)
instructions: Brown pork sausage. Combine other ingredients in bowl; add pork sausage. Mix all ingredients together and stir well then pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate overnight. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Blend sugar cornstarch and salt; stir into boiling water. Cook and stir until thick and clear. Stir in beaten egg yolks; cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat; add lemon juice. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue made with stiffly beaten egg whites and 6 tablespoons of sugar. Brown in oven.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: If using jalapeno chop fine and remove seeds.

title: Chicken Bobbie
instructions: Melt oleo in a small skillet. Add crushed Ritz crackers and mix well. Set aside. Boil chicken breasts until tender. Cool. Cut in bite size pieces. Add sour cream soup dill weed and paprika. Mix well. Pour in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch casserole sprayed with Pam. Place cracker crumbs on top; bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with salad and green beans. Enjoy!

title: Orange Delight
instructions: In large bowl fold in cottage cheese pineapple and oranges (drained). Chill. Mix until blended. Sprinkle dry Jell-O on top and serve.

title: Apricot Rum Cake
instructions: Mix eggs oil and apricot nectar in bowl. Add cake mix and beat 4 to 5 minutes on medium speed. Pour into greased and floured tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. While cake is baking melt together over heat sugar butter and rum. As soon as cake is done pour rum mixture all over top slowly while still in pan allowing it to seep in. Let cool several hours before removing from pan. Serve plain or as shortcake.

title: Italian Bread Salad
instructions: Stir stuffing mix and water in large bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients and toss. Let stand at room temperature at least 30 minutes.

title: Annie'S Rice Pudding
instructions: Put rice milk and butter in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Stir in 3/4 cup sugar and salt. Return to oven; bake about 45 minutes more stirring several times. Remove from oven. Turn oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in an 11 x 13 x 2-inch pan (greased).

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Dice onion and potatoes thinly. Heat vinegar and bacon drippings to a boil. Pour over potato mixture. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Serve warm.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix well the potatoes 1 cup sugar eggs milk salt 1/3 stick butter and vanilla. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Yummy Rhubarb
instructions: Cut rhubarb into small pieces. Wash the rhubarb in cold water. Put rhubarb sugar and raisins into a casserole and mix well. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 45 minutes or until the rhubarb is soft. Serve hot or cold.

title: Ham And Cheese Broccoli Bake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a covered Pyrex dish. Bake 40 to 50 minutes until broccoli is tender and cheese is creamy. Stir 2 to 3 times while baking. Bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Dottie'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat together margarine sugars egg water and vanilla. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix into margarine mixture blending thoroughly. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Quarter and separate biscuits. Put in sealed bag. Put in 1 tablespoon cinnamon and 1 1/2 cups sugar and shake. Put in pan. Pour melted butter cinnamon and sugar over top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Wait 10 minutes and turn out of pan.

title: Okra Patties
instructions: Combine all and shape into patties and fry in hot oil until golden brown. Serves 8.

title: Pecan Sandies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Gradually work flour into creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Form into small balls. Bake on an ungreased sheet in a 325\u00b0 gas oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar. Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Smothered Pork Chops
instructions: Brown desired number of seasoned pork chops or steaks on both sides. Cover with mushroom soup then add water. Cover and let simmer for 1 to 2 hours. Chops will melt in your mouth and can be served over rice.

title: Corn Soup
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a mixer. Serve hot or cold.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Prepare brownies according to package directions. Punch holes in baked brownies with a fork; pour liqueur over brownies. Set aside. Prepare chocolate mousse a package at a time according to package directions. Refrigerate while continuing recipe. Break up candy bars. Break up half of the brownies and spoon into bottom of a clear glass bowl. Layer with half the chocolate mousse half the candy bars and half of the whipped topping. Repeat layers. Makes 12 servings.

title: Pretzel Pie Crust
instructions: Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 and cool.

title: Tangy Pork Chops
instructions: Place crushed cereal in a bowl. Set aside. In a second bowl beat egg and lemon juice together. In a third bowl combine flour salt and pepper. Dip pork chops in flour mixture then in egg mixture. Coat with crushed cereal. Melt margarine in large frypan over low heat. Increase heat to medium. Brown chops on both sides. Reduce heat to simmer. Cover. Cook about 20 minutes or until tender. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
instructions: Prepare Jell-O as directed and add pineapple. Chill until partially jelled. Add cheese and whipped cream. Chill until set.

title: Divine Date Nut Loaf
instructions: Beat together eggs sugar and oil. Add dry ingredients and mix. Add dates and pecans. Mix. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Place in cold oven. Turn the oven to 300\u00b0 and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until cake is firm in the middle. Cool. Remove from pan and slice with a sharp knife or wrap and freeze. Makes one 3 pound loaf.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine eggs sugar oil and vanilla; beat 1 minute.\tAdd flour and 7-Up beat until creamy. Oil Bundt pan then pour in mixture.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool about 30 minutes before removing from pan (tube pan cool 15 minutes). Let cake cool completely before adding glaze topping.

title: Peanut Mallow Bars
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat the cake mix water butter and egg until blended (batter will be thick). Spread into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes. Sprinkle with marshmallows. Bake 2 minutes longer. Remove and set aside. In a large saucepan combine the peanut butter chips corn syrup and butter; cook and stir over medium low heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla cereal and peanuts. Spread over marshmallows. Cool completely. Cut with a sharp knife.

title: Candy Recipe(For Children To Make)
instructions: Mix ingredients. Roll into little balls then eat.

title: Best Bean Dip
instructions: Spread bean dip on a serving platter. Mix together the sour cream and taco mix. Spread over bean dip until well covered. Garnish top with diced tomato and green pepper. Serve with corn chips.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Boil chicken until done; remove chicken from the bone and shred pieces. In medium bowl mix together the cream cheese and 2 tablespoons butter. Add milk salt pepper and pimiento. Add chicken; mix well. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles. Spoon 1/2 cup chicken mixture onto center of each rectangle. Pull 4 corners of dough to top of mixture; twist and seal edges. Brush top with reserved 1 tablespoon butter. Bake on cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Methodist Home Of Versailles Kentucky(Yeast Rolls)
instructions: Scald 3/4 cup of the milk. In separate pan heat the remaining milk to lukewarm. Mix together salt sugar Crisco and slightly beaten eggs. Then mix the lukewarm milk with the yeast until dissolved. Now add the yeast and milk to the salt sugar Crisco and egg mixture. Let the scalded milk cool to lukewarm and add to the mixture. Then add (a little at a time) to the flour mixture.

title: Molded Chicken Salad
instructions: Chop or dice chicken. Soak gelatin in cold water and dissolve in boiling water. Add salt lemon juice and onion extract. Add to chicken and cool. Whip cream and fold into chicken. Pack into ring mold and when set turn into a bed of fresh lettuce leaves. Fill center with 2 cups diced pickled beets.

title: Amaretto Cake
instructions: Grease and flour bundt pan. Sprinkle almonds in bottom and slightly up sides of pan. Mix remaining ingredients together and beat 2 minutes with mixer. Pour batter in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes. As soon as cake comes out of oven punch as many holes as you can in it with an ice pick. Slowly pour on about 1/2 of glaze. Invert cake on plate and spoon on remaining glaze.

title: Spinach And Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions; drain well. Combine beaten egg sour cream milk and the first 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese onion salt and pepper. Add Monterey or Cheddar cheese and mix well. Add drained spinach and spaghetti and mix well. Turn into an ungreased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes more or until heated through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Crackling Cornbread
instructions: Combine cornmeal flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in milk and egg. Gradually stir in cracklings and shortening. Pour batter in a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan muffin pan or corn stick pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Pound chicken between heavy duty plastic wrap to 1/4 inch thick with meat mallet.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cornbread crumbs. Sprinkle 2 cups cornbread in bottom of large casserole dish. Add squash mixture on top of crumbs. Sprinkle with remaining 2 cups of crumbs. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Tips And Rice
instructions: Cube roast in about 1 inch cubes. Add soups (do not add any water) mix well. Cook in crock pot on low over night and all next day. Serve over rice.

title: Crabbies
instructions: Cream butter; add cheese. Add other ingredients except muffins and mix with fork. Spread on muffin halves. Cut into fourths and broil for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Noodle Pudding(Kugel)
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake in a greased baking dish for about 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Asparagus Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients well; set aside. Trim crust from bread; roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Spread each with a rounded teaspoonful of butter mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese sparingly. Place asparagus spear on each slice. Roll jelly roll fashion; secure with a wooden pick. Brush with melted butter; place on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove picks; serve warm.

title: Easy Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Pop the popcorn. Place in a large bowl; melt butter brown sugar and marshmallows in saucepan until thick. Pour over popcorn and stir.

title: Red Candied Apples
instructions: Mix in boiler. Cook to 300\u00b0 hard crack stage. Use candy thermometer. Then dip apples in mixture.

title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large soup kettle. Chop and add onion and broccoli stirring until crisp-tender. Remove to bowl. Heat vegetable stock adding chopped potatoes parsley and all spices. Add broccoli and onion mixture and cook until desired texture is reached. Add cheeses and remaining butter milk and cream.

title: Flavored Crackers
instructions: Mix and pour over 2 (12 ounce) packages of oyster crackers or 1 (12 ounce) package oyster crackers and 1 (12 ounce) package of cheese crackers. Mix and set aside for at least one hour.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Sweeten blackberries to taste; set aside in a large saucepan. Combine milk flour salt baking powder and shortening. Roll out dough. Place 1/2 of dough in pan. Cook blackberries until they reach a rolling boil. Add flour or cornstarch and butter; cook until they begin to thicken. Place remainder of dough on top; sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Mix ground beef salt and pepper. Press mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan or slightly larger. Cover with onion next layer mushroom soup and next spread grated cheese on top. Place Tater Tots over cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Veal Parmesan
instructions: Flatten cutlets to 1/8-inch thickness by pounding. Season and coat evenly with grated cheese. Brown in hot olive oil 3 minutes on each side.

title: Grilled Cheese
instructions: You will need a sandwich machine.

title: Beef And Bacon Chili
instructions: In large saucepan cook bacon until crisp. Remove to paper towels. Pour off drippings except 1 tablespoon. Add ground beef onion and bell pepper. Drain. Add cooked bacon and remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut butter into dry cake mix until crumbly. Mix in coconut. Put mixture lightly into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes. Arrange apples on warm crust. Blend sour cream and eggs; drizzle over apples. Bake 25 minutes or until edges are light brown. Serve warm.

title: Kringla
instructions: Mix the sugar and cream together until all the sugar is dissolved. Add the rest of the ingredients (put the soda in the flour). Drop on a greased cookie sheet or use a cookie press and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Sausage Ring
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place mix in a Bundt or tube pan (greased). Bake for one hour at 375\u00b0. Every 20 minutes drain fat. Let cool and invert onto plate. Can be frozen and reheated.

title: Preacher Cookies
instructions: Combine quick oats vanilla peanut butter and salt; set aside. Mix sugar milk margarine and cocoa in heavy saucepan. Bring to a rolling boil for 1 1/2 minutes (no longer). Stir in combined ingredients quickly. Spoon onto wax paper. Let cool. Great cookies when the preacher calls.

title: Veal Lemonato
instructions: Slice veal into serving pieces. Brown in olive oil and margarine in a large saucepan. Add water to mixture and bring to a boil. Allow to boil awhile. Remove meat then add flour (dissolved in 1 tablespoon water) and lemon juice to remaining sauce. Add salt and pepper and boil until sauce thickens then add meat again and cook awhile longer.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix flour butter and confectioners sugar thoroughly. Press evenly in square pan. Bake 20 minutes. Mix rest of ingredients together and pour over crust. Bake 20 to 25 minutes longer.

title: Sparkling Red Velvet Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 c. hot cranberry juice. Add remaining juice and lemon juice. Let cool pour into punch bowl and add sprite and ice ring or cubes. Serves 28 - 4 oz. cups.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken 1 hour; remove chicken to cool. Save broth. Add frozen vegetables potatoes onion and seasonings. Bring to a boil then turn down to low and simmer. Debone cooled chicken and cut to bite size chunks. Add to vegetable mixture. Bring to a boil again. When boiling slowly blend in Wondra flour until broth is thick and gravy like. Follow directions for ready made crusts. Add chicken-vegetable mixture to crusts. Do not add too much gravy! Makes two nice pies. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Put cookie trays underneath to avoid spillage. Save excess gravy for top of pies to taste.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a Dutch oven. Cover with water; simmer one hour. Remove chicken from broth. Reserve 1 1/2 cups broth. Remove chicken from bone. Chop. Saute celery onions carrots and potatoes in butter until crisp-tender. Add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute. Gradually add reserved broth and half and half. Cook over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Stir in salt pepper and chicken. Pour this mixture into pastry lined casserole.

title: Chicken Dish Delicious
instructions: Brown chicken in skillet. Cook rice and drain. Mix together mushroom soup milk and onion mix sauce. Lay mixture in casserole and place chicken over mixture. If mixture is too thick you may want to add more liquid. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions and cool. Drain artichokes (save juice) and chop. Add chopped vegetables and chopped artichokes to cold rice. Mix juice from artichokes mayonnaise and curry; pour over rice/vegetable mixture. Marinate for 20 minutes.

title: Crunchy Granola
instructions: In a large saucepan heat together oil honey and vanilla until the mixture is very thin. Stir in remaining ingredients in the order given coating each one lightly with the honey mixture. Put on cookie sheet and heat in 350\u00b0 oven until brown about 10 minutes.

title: Pie Dough
instructions: Mix flour salt and oil with fork until moist. Add water; mix to absorb. Take 1/2 of mixture and roll out between 2 layers of plastic wrap. Take top layer and place in pie plate. Make sure bubbles are removed from second layer. Fill pie plate with ingredients for pie. Add second layer of dough to top of pie or line another pie plate/tin. Makes 2.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix shortening sugar and egg thoroughly. Stir in applesauce. Measure flour and blend in dry ingredients. Mix in raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Irish Stew
instructions: Sprinkle the meat with salt pepper and flour; brown it with the onion in the fat. Add water to cover. Cover pan and cook slowly until meat is almost done about 1 1/2 hours. Add potatoes carrots and turnips and cook until tender 20 to 30 minutes. Add parsley.

title: Frozen Fudge Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients in pan and cook as directed on package. Cool 5 minutes. Pour into bowl. Freeze until crystals form and stir again. Place in paper cups ice cube trays or Tupperware popsicle containers. May place popsicle stick in before freezing.

title: Aunt Edna'S Apple Pie
instructions: Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0. Bake for 30 minutes or until done. Cool and garnish with cream if desired.

title: Fudge Walnut Brownie Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly greased 9-inch pie plate. Beat eggs in large bowl. Stir in sugar butter and vanilla. Stir together flour cocoa and salt. Stir into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Do not overbake.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Stir well and chill. Add the ginger ale just before serving. Makes a great Valentines Day punch!

title: Cranberry Quick Bread(Makes 1 Loaf)
instructions: Combine flour with sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon; sift into bowl. Combine the egg with orange peel milk and butter or oil; pour all at once into the dry ingredients. Mix just until thoroughly moistened. Stir in cranberries. Spoon mixture into a well greased loaf pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven until bread is brown and tests done with a toothpick about 1 hour. Serve warm or cold. To reheat wrap in foil.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Debone chicken; mix broth and cream of chicken soup. Grease casserole dish (9 x 12-inch). Put chicken in dish. Slice eggs; lay on top ingredients. Mix buttermilk and flour. Put on top of this mixture. Melt margarine. Pour over ingredients in casserole. Put in oven. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Chocolate Dip
instructions: Put chocolate and milk in a saucepan; stir until chocolate melts. Add marshmallow cream; add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Serve with fresh fruits.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch chips. Add peanuts and noodles. Drop on wax paper by spoon.

title: Appetizer Meat Balls
instructions: Combine meat onion crumbs seasonings eggs and milk. Mix with a fork. Shape into 48 small balls. Brown a few at a time in shortening. Drain off all fat from pan. Return meat balls. Pour consomme over balls. Simmer covered 15 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon. Keep hot.

title: Mom'S Easy Yummy Chicken Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except egg. Spoon all into 1 pie crust. Top with other pie crust and crimp edges tightly. Punch top of pie with fork. Brush top of pie with beaten egg to brown. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Salmon Ball
instructions: Mix salmon and cream cheese. Add lemon juice onion and horseradish. Mold into ball. Chill at least 3 hours or overnight. Roll in pecans and parsley. Serve with crackers.

title: Breakfast Boosters(Great Use For Those Ripe Bananas.)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender until smooth.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill. Serve on crackers.

title: Fiesta Wax Beans
instructions: Drain beans reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Cook celery in butter until tender. Add reserved bean liquid and bouillon cube. Simmer until dissolved. Stir in chili sauce and beans. Heat through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pickled Hot Peppers
instructions: Wash peppers thoroughly. Cut off stem end only trimming longer peppers to fit jar. Place peppers in bowl cover with boiling water. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain. Combine vinegar water and sugar in saucepan. Heat to boiling then simmer 5 minutes. Pack peppers in clean hot jars. Add to each jar 2 cloves garlic and salt. Pour simmering liquid over peppers to within 1/2 inch of rim making sure the liquid covers peppers. Place lids on jar at once. Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 4 pints.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping blending well. Spoon into crust. Chill until set at least 4 hours.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine butter and sugar until well blended then add syrup flour eggs and flavoring. Beat until well blended. Add nuts and pour into pie shell. Bake for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Harvest Bread
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs pumpkin and oats. Beat well. Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture. Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Beef Pot Pie
instructions: Mix stew onion and celery in bowl. Pour into one pie shell. Sprinkle cheese over top. Place other pie shell over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Barbecue Onion Bake(Side Dish)
instructions: Remove outside skin of onion. Cut a hole in top of onion. Put 1 teaspoon of butter and 1 beef bouillon cube in hole. Wrap onion in aluminum foil. Place on grill. Cook until onion becomes soft. Can be cooked in oven.

title: Diabetic Date-Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add egg Sucaryl and vanilla which have been beaten together. Sift dry ingredients together and add to other mixture. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Turn into buttered loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef And Broccoli
instructions: In wok stir-fry beef garlic sugar and salt in hot oil. Stir in sake and soy sauce. Cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Remove meat and set aside. Add broccoli and 3/4 cup water. Cook 2 to 5 minutes until crispy. Add meat.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix and bake in greased pan 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: In baking pan spread mixture of 3 cans of soup and rice. Place chicken on top. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover pan with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat butter and sugar together until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Combine flour soda cinnamon and salt. Mix well and add to batter. Mix well. Stir in oatmeal 1 cup chips and nuts. Spread in ungreased 9 x 13 metal baking pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. While bars are still warm sprinkle 1 cup more chocolate chips on top. Spread when soft to frost. Wait until cool to cut.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients until clear. While hot add Jell-O; mix well. Cool; add berries. Put into baked pie shell; chill. If you use 9-inch pie shell you wont need all those berries.

title: Crispy Pickles
instructions: Mix together the cucumbers cauliflower garlic onions and peppers; cover with 1/3 cup pickling salt. Cover completely with ice cubes. Stand for 3 hours. Drain well. Bring the remaining ingredients to a boil. Pack sterile jars with pickles and pour this hot liquid over. Close cover. Make small or pint jars.\tThey are a great gift idea for that extra little something at Christmas. They will shelf store for several months.

title: World'S Best Brownies
instructions: Combine 3 parts steeped caffeine free tea with 2 parts fruit juice. Heat to boiling; strain and serve.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil and sugar; beat well. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift flour salt and soda. Add to oil mixture. Stir in nuts and apples. Pour into greased 9 x 14-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cabbage. Trim off thickest part of stem from 12 cabbage leaves. Divide meat into 12 portions; wrap each in a leaf and fasten with wooden picks. Brown cabbage rolls in oil. Add contents of 2 (8 ounce) cans tomato sauce and 1/4 cup water. Cover and cook slowly about 45 minutes. Makes 6 servings at 315 calories per serving.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
instructions: Wash the shrimp well and spread out in a shallow pan. Do not peel. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan and simmer on low for 10 minutes. Pour sauce over shrimp. Mix well. Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Baste and turn the shrimp every 30 minutes. Bake shrimp at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes turning every 10 minutes. Serve with French bread.

title: Carrot Corn Bread
instructions: Cream oil and sugar. Add eggs. Sift together flour and cornmeal; add to creamed mixture. Add carrots nuts and raisins; mix thoroughly. Pour into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 to 50 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Pinch off marble size pieces and place on lightly greased baking sheet. Flatten slightly with back of fork. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 4 dozen. Serve as an appetizer.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix the sugar shortening and eggs. Blend in the molasses and set aside. Sift together the flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Mix in the oatmeal and nuts (optional). Mix dry ingredients into molasses mixture. Drop by spoonful 2-inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Do not overbake. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Creole Black-Eyed Peas(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: Cover peas with water. Boil 2 minutes. Let stand 1 hour. Add red peppers. Bring to boil and boil for 30 minutes covered until tender. Add water as needed. Stir in chopped red pepper and green peppers and cook longer. Season with oleo salt and pepper. Garnish with onions.

title: Impossible Cheese Burger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Cook beef and onion over medium heat until brown. Drain. Spread in pie plate. Beat milk baking mix eggs salt and pepper in blender on high until smooth 15 seconds. Pour over meat in pie plate and bake for 25 minutes. Top with tomatoes and cheese. Bake until knife in the center of pie comes out clean. Serves 5 to 8.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt the margarine and chocolate chips together over low heat. Stir in the peanut butter. Pour chocolate mixture over cereal in large bowl and toss to coat. Put powdered sugar in large Tupperware bowl; add cereal mixture. Place lid on bowl and shake to coat. Keep refrigerated.

title: Mexican Super Supper
instructions: Stew chicken until thoroughly cooked and allow to cool slightly. Remove meat from bones and cut in chunks. Mix chicken with all other ingredients except cheese and pour into 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve with crisp green salad and Texas toast. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Marbled Choc Rum Pie
instructions: In top of double boiler mix gelatin 1/4 cup sugar and the salt. Beat in egg yolks milk and rum. Cook over boiling water stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate until thoroughly blended. Chill until thickened but not set. Beat egg whites until they are foamy and gradually stiff. Fold into chocolate mixture. Whip cream with rest of sugar and vanilla until stiff. Alternate the two mixtures in cold shell; swirl with a spoon. Chill until firm.

title: Fried Peppers Salad-Romania(Salata De Ardei Prajiti)
instructions: Wash peppers take out cores and cut into thin strips. Chop onions and fry in oil until soft. Mash up tomatoes until pasty. Add tomatoes salt (to taste) and peppers into frying pan. Fry at slow heat until most of the liquid is absorbed. Serve cold.

title: Low-Cal Pumpkin Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan and cook on medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Spices can be increased to taste. This is a good pudding for diabetics.

title: Dutch Oven Steak
instructions: Pound steak with tenderizer or fork. Pour flour into shallow pan. Add salt and pepper. Press steak into flour mixture and turn several times. Heat oil in Dutch oven. Brown steak on both sides then add chopped onion. Mix mushroom soup with equal parts water. Stir well and pour over steak. Lower temperature and let simmer for 2 hours. Add more water if necessary. Stir from bottom as necessary. Makes own gravy. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Beat well. Add flour alternately with milk. Fold in nuts dates and candy. Reserve 1/4 cup flour to coat dates nuts and candy. Spoon into 10-inch tube pan. Bake 2 hours at 300\u00b0. Glaze while hot.

title: Whipped Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello according to package directions. Chill until it just starts to set. Whip evaporated milk. Add cottage cheese and pineapple. Mix into jello mixture and chill until set.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Pour 1 cup boiling water over the chopped dates nut meats butter and soda. Let cool before adding the remaining ingredients. Bake in moderate oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Cheesy Potato Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9-inch square baking dish with vegetable spray. Wash potatoes thoroughly. Cut into 1/4-inch slices. Toss potatoes and dressing in baking dish until potatoes are coated. Cover with cheese. Bake for 55 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 servings. Per serving 111 calories and 1 gram fat.

title: Cucumbers And Onions In Sour Cream
instructions: Slice cucumbers peeled. Cut Vidalia onion in quarters and slice. Sprinkle with salt and put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Drain. If less salt desired rinse under cold water. Wad up a couple of paper towels and stir through cucumbers and onions to remove excess moisture. Mix together sour cream mayonnaise dill weed dash of garlic salt. Fold in cucumbers and onions. Store in refrigerator.

title: Vanilla Wafers
instructions: Cream oleo shortening and sugar. Add vanilla and salt. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Stir in flour and mix well. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Flatten and bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Stone Soup
instructions: Go the library and take out the book Stone Soup by Marsha Brown. Read the story before dinner. Make the soup then read the story again. See if the children remember the ingredients. Scrub and chop all vegetables. Put clean stone in pot. Add all ingredients and cook for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. See if your child doesnt agree if the soup isnt better when you remember the stone.

title: Banana Muffins (Low-Fat, High Fiber)
instructions: Mix dry muffin mix and wheat bran. Stir in applesauce milk and banana. Spray muffin tins with Pam and spoon in batter. Bake as directed on muffin mix box. Yield 1 dozen muffins.

title: Toasted Pecan Pudding Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a bowl combine butter flour pecans coconut and sugar; mix well. Spread onto an ungreased 15 x 10 x 2-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned stirring occasionally; cool.

title: Chocolate Almond Pie
instructions: Cut cake in half; reserve half for another use. Cut remaining half into 8 slices. Cut each slice in half. Line bottom and sides of 9-inch pie plate with cake slices.

title: Banana Slush
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 3 minutes. Mix with the rest of the ingredients and freeze. When ready to use mix with ginger ale. Can freeze them in ice cube trays.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and put in pie crust and top with meringue; or graham cracker crust and top with Cool Whip.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese; mix together with remaining ingredients. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Cranberry Spice Loaves
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg. Stir in raisins and nuts. Combine dry ingredients and sift. Add to first mixture. Stir in cranberry sauce. Spoon into 2 greased and floured loaf pans (9 x 5-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool. Cut into slices to serve. Freezes well.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins and water. Drain. Add water to measure 1/2 cup. Cream shortening sugar eggs vanilla. Stir in raisin liquid. Add dry ingredients. Stir in oats nuts and raisins. Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes.

title: Nut Cake
instructions: Mix sugar butter and eggs; then add flour nuts and vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Harvest Cake
instructions: Mix together apples and sugar; let stand 1 hour. Sift together flour soda and spices. Beat eggs; add oil and vanilla. Add apple mixture. Combine flour mixture with eggs. Stir in walnuts. Bake in a greased and floured angel food cake pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done. Frost with plain white icing and top with a sprinkling of chopped nuts.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together. Microwave 30 seconds. Mix together. Microwave 30 seconds. Mix again. Roll into balls. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or 375\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Sheet Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Separate eggs. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add flour and milk alternately add vanilla. Add beaten egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with favorite frosting.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Brown the meat in a pan add broth and water. Add onions carrots celery and garlic; simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Add potatoes and cook 1/2 hour. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Shredded Beef(Party Size Amount)
instructions: Cook at 325\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Use potato masher to shred up.

title: Pumpkin Pie Filling(No Sugar - No Eggs)
instructions: Whiz all ingredients in blender. Pour into pie plate that has been lined with Quick Pie Crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set about 35 minutes.

title: Funnel Cake
instructions: Heat 2 inches of oil in deep frying pan to 350\u00b0. Combine flour sugar milk and eggs in mixing bowl and beat until smooth. Drizzle 1/2 cup of batter in a circular design into hot oil. Fry until golden brown on both sides. Drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Canned Hot Peppers
instructions: Put the first 4 ingredients in bottom of jar. Add hot peppers which have been cut lengthwise and seeds removed then add 1 cup vinegar to each quart jar. Fill with cold water and put 1 tablespoon salad oil on top. Put lid and ring on. You dont have to heat anything and do not cold pack. Ready to eat in 2 weeks.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Put chicken celery lemon juice and mayonnaise in a large bowl. Stir to blend. Add salt and pepper; mix thoroughly. Chill before serving.

title: Spinach Brownies
instructions: Thaw spinach and drain. Mix ingredients and put in 7 x 5-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 35 minutes.

title: Baked Ham With Fruit(Serves 6 To 8 Generously)
instructions: Bake ham in 300\u00b0 oven for 2 hours.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Combine the last 7 ingredients together. Soak zucchini and onions in salt overnight. Drain; put through food grinder and drain again. Add drained ground celery and green and red pepper. Add vinegar mixture; stir into all vegetables and cook slowly 10 minutes. Pack into hot jars and process 20 minutes.

title: Oven Baked Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a large heavy Dutch oven or soup pot. Saute onions over medium-low heat stirring occasionally until light brown. Sprinkle flour over the onions; stir into onions. Stir in beef broth wine salt and pepper. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Place slice of toasted French bread in each of 6 small ovenproof soup dishes. Ladle soup over bread. Place one slice cheese in each soup dish; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese melts about 5 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Herbed Potato Wedges(A Quick Version Of French Fries)
instructions: Preheat broiler. Meanwhile place butter or margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Then place pan under preheating broiler until butter or margarine is melted. While the broiler is preheating and butter or margarine is melting scrub potatoes. Then cut each potato into 8 wedges. Stir basil oregano or tarragon; onion or garlic salt; and pepper into melted butter or margarine. Then add potato wedges. Stir to coat potatoes with butter mixture. Place pan containing potatoes 3 inches from heat. Broil potatoes for 5 minutes. Using a wide spatula turn potato wedges over and broil about 5 minutes more or until tender. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat eggs in a large mixing bowl. Add next 6 ingredients and mix well. Stir in chocolate chips. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Ground Beef Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook beef and onion in oil until tender. Use a Dutch oven. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for an hour. Stir occasionally. Makes 6 main dish servings. Freezes well.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Hot Dogs
instructions: Melt jelly and mustard in crock-pot. Add hot dogs. Cook about 1 hour on low.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch corn syrup and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook stirring constantly until clear and thickened. Add gelatin stirring until dissolved. Cool. Place strawberries in pie shell. Pour in gelatin mixture. Chill until firm.

title: Onion Pie
instructions: In a large skillet saute onions in oil until soft but not brown. Drain. In mixing bowl beat eggs. Add bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and parsley. Mix well. Place in greased 10-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until a knife inserted near center comes out clean. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cowboy Baked Beans
instructions: Brown the ground beef and onion. Mix with other ingredients. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour. Sprinkle cheese on top. Serve.

title: Lightening Spaghetti
instructions: In skillet brown ground beef and cook onion until tender. Stir to separate meat; pour off fat. Add soup and spaghetti. Heat stirring occasionally. Serve with cheese. Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

title: Oyster Chowder
instructions: You can keep ingredients on hand to make this chowder on short notice.

title: Crab Cakes Southern Style
instructions: Mix crabmeat bread 1/2 cup baking mix mayonnaise egg Worcestershire sauce salt paprika and nutmeg. Drop by 1/3 cupfuls into 1/3 cup baking mix turning to coat on all sides. Shape into 2 1/2-inch cakes.

title: Noodles With Tuna Fish
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until done. Separate tuna into flakes. Mix with soup milk and seasonings. Combine noodles and tuna mixture in baking dish. Sprinkle top with paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Ball
instructions: Stir together peanut butter and margarine. Gradually add sugar stirring until combined. Shape into 1-inch balls; place on wax paper. Refrigerate about 10 minutes. Melt chocolate bark in microwave. Dip balls in chocolate. Lay out to dry.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook on high in crock-pot 5 hours with lid on and 5 hours with lid off. This can be frozen or stored in refrigerator or canned.

title: Freezer Pie Crusts
instructions: Mix all together. It will be very sticky. Make into balls just big enough for 1 pie crust. Put in plastic bag. Makes about 15 to 20 pie crusts. Put in the freezer. Remove one at a time for a single crust pie and let thaw a little then make pie.

title: Mallow Apples In The Coals
instructions: Ask someone older to light the charcoal and watch the fire. Wash and core 6 apples to within 1/2-inch of bottoms. Carve out the tops slightly to make little wells about 1 1/2 inches across. Place each apple in the center of square of aluminum foil. Fill each cavity with 1 caramel 4 miniature marshmallows and 1 teaspoon raisins. Bring the 4 points of each square of foil together at the top of each apple and twist to close securely. Place the foil packets directly on the hot coals with tongs. Cook about 20 minutes or until soft. Open foil carefully. Serve warm with a spoonful of the vanilla pudding over each apple.

title: Bread Souffle
instructions: Cut off crust on bread slices. Discard. Brush each side of slices with melted butter. Cut into 1-inch cubes. In a 10 x 10-inch casserole layer 1/2 bread cubes. Add 1/2 milk and egg that have been whisked together and 1/2 of cheese. Remaining bread on top milk and cheese. Let stand at least 3 hours before baking. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Salt to taste (1 teaspoon).

title: Beans And Wieners Or Vienna Sausage
instructions: Combine beans and wieners with remaining ingredients. Place in small casserole; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together the drained fruit peach pie filling and the sliced bananas. Refrigerate until ready to eat.

title: Drop Doughnuts
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar until light. Stir in beaten eggs. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture and milk. Set in fridge and chill approximately 2 hours. Take out. Drop doughnut from teaspoon.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In large plastic bag add all ingredients. Close bag and shake until all potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking dish or roasting pan. Bake stirring occasionally 40 minutes or until tender and golden brown. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix hot water with gelatin and stir thoroughly. Add pineapple juice and cool. Pour sugar over ground cranberries and let stand while gelatin mixture is cooling. When gelatin starts to thicken add cranberries crushed pineapple celery and nuts. Place in a mold and chill.

title: Lean Picadillo
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion bell pepper and garlic; saute 2 to 3 minutes. Add beef; cook until meat is browned on all sides. Drain off fat. Add tomato sauce olives capers Worcestershire sauce oregano and cinnamon; mix well. Cook 15 minutes to blend flavors.

title: Road Runner Casserole
instructions: Prepare stuffing according to directions. Butter bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread 1/2 of stuffing mix on bottom. Cover with diced chicken or turkey. Spread cooked string beans on chicken. Add a layer of fresh mushrooms.

title: Ranch Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients; stir well. Cover tightly. Chill 8 hours.

title: Tammy'S Easy Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach until most of the water is out. Mix all ingredients together. Serve cold with Ritz crackers.

title: Rolled Rump Roast
instructions: Bake rolled rump for 1 hour at 400\u00b0. Let set in roaster overnight in juices in refrigerator. Next day slice and replace in roaster. Add 2 cans of Campbells onion soup and 1 can beer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Be sure and cover it. Can add 3 tablespoons brandy. Serve with hoagie buns.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Make into small balls and press on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Place crackers on foil lined cookie sheet. Mix sugar and butter and boil for 3 to 5 minutes. Dip over crackers and bake at 325 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes. Melt chocolate and pour over baked crackers. Let cool and then break into pieces.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix Jell-O Crisco oil 1 cup thawed strawberries and eggs. Mix at medium speed about 2 minutes. Pour into three greased and floured cake pans. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: In blender add and beat slow 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients; mix well. Pour into a greased casserole dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cook a little longer if needed to be sure middle is done.

title: Ham Barbecue
instructions: Brown ham and onion. Add other ingredients and heat slowly. Serve warm on bun.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Add finely chopped onions bell peppers celery and garlic. Cook these ingredients until clear. Add tomato sauce and seasoning. Let simmer for 30 minutes. Add shrimp and cover with tight lid. Cook on low heat about 30 to 40 minutes or until shrimp are well done. Serve over hot rice. Serves 4 persons.

title: Dolly Varden Cake(A Four-Layer Beauty)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until they are fluffy. Add the eggs. Sift the flour measure and sift with baking powder. Add the flour mixture alternately with the milk to the egg-butter-sugar mixture. Divide in half. Bake 1/2 of the batter in two 8-inch layer cake pans and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0 or a moderate oven. To the other half of the batter add remaining ingredients. Bake this batter in two 8-inch cake pans. Put layers together alternately with white icing.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Saute chicken in 1/2 stick of margarine. Add soups and use broth from chicken to dilute to equal 2 cans of liquid. Add 1 can tap water. Bring to boil. Add broccoli. Cook until broccoli is thawed. Add rice. Stir and let stand for 5 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello with water and add 1 cup marshmallows while hot. Set aside to cool. Mix remaining ingredients and add to jello mixture. Place in refrigerator to set.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix stuffing as directed on box. Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place stuffing. Pour mushroom soup diluted with 1/2 can water over. Add diced chicken over top of soup. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chop Chey(Korean Spaghetti)
instructions: Brown meat in sesame seed oil. Add carrots and cook until tender. Add mushrooms onion and green onions. Boil spinach about 3 minutes (do not overcook). Drain. Cut spinach to break up bigger pieces.

title: Mincemeat
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and simmer until mixture is cooked and well blended. This freezes well.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: In an ovenproof skillet melt margarine; add brown sugar and mix thoroughly. Arrange pineapple slices and cherries over mixture. Cream together until fluffy the shortening sugar and eggs. Add flour vanilla and juices; mix well. Pour batter over pineapple and brown sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Glazed Vegetables
instructions: Place vegetables in a pan with the water and vinegar. Bring to a boil reduce heat to medium and cover. Cook 10 minutes. Remove lid and turn heat up and allow liquid to reduce and glaze the vegetables. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Lipticook
instructions: Beat egg whites slightly. Add salt baking powder sugar and cake flour. Spread thin on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or so. Cool and cut into small pieces.

title: Fried Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to form dough and use for fried pies.

title: Mexican Pizza
instructions: Unroll crescent roll dough and place in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Flatten dough to fit the pan sealing seams and perforations. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly golden brown; cool.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix salmon potatoes eggs onion and pepper. Then take small amount roll into a\tball then mash until thin. Dip in corn meal.\tFry in shallow skillet until brown on both sides. Will feed 8 to 10 people.

title: Tex-Mex Turkey Casserole
instructions: Spray 9 by 13 dish and place meat and beans in bottom. Cut tortillas in squares and place on top. In pot combine the soup milk salsa and heat; pour over the tortillas and bake 45 min. When done sprinkle with cheese on top and serve.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Heat brown sugar margarine and water until well blended. Add cinnamon and nuts. Pour some of the mixture into bottom of Bundt pan quarter biscuits over the mixture then pour rest of mixture over the biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Andouille Gumbo
instructions: Make roux with flour and oil. Add onion bell pepper shallots and garlic. Saute for 10 minutes. Add andouille and saute again for 20 minutes covered. Add water and cook for 1/2 hour. Add chopped cabbage and cook for 25 minutes. Let set for 1 hour before serving. Serve over hot rice. Add file salt and pepper to taste.

title: Quick Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Spray large skillet or wok with a nonstick cooking spray. Add chicken strips and garlic. Stir-fry 3 minutes. Add vegetables. Stir-fry 3 more minutes. Add chicken broth. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in mayonnaise soy sauce and ginger. Simmer until vegetables are tender-crisp. Do not overcook. (I you want a thick sauce thicken it with cornstarch and cold water.) Serve over hot rice.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Mix well and roll in either nuts or bacon bits.

title: Cherry Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk and whipped topping; gradually stir in lemon juice. Fold pecans and pie filling into mixture. Spoon into graham cracker crusts. Chill 2 hours. Makes two 8-inch pies.

title: Blueberry Bar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Wash blueberries and set aside to drain. In a large bowl combine dry muffin mix oats and sugar; cut in the butter. Reserve about 1 1/2 cups of this crumb mixture; press the rest on the bottom of a greased 8-inch square pan. Gently fold drained blueberries into jam or preserves. Spoon over crumb mixture in pan; spread evenly. Sprinkle the rest of crumbs and pat them evenly onto the berry mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Cool completely and then cut into bars.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: In a large skillet fry hamburger and onion. Drain grease. Add tomato paste kidney beans taco seasoning and 1 1/2 cups water. Simmer 15 minutes or until thickens. In a large bowl crush 1 bag of chips on bottom 1/2 layer of peppers lettuce and tomatoes. Layer 1/2 of cheese on top then add hot meat mixture then rest of cheese then rest of pepper tomato and lettuce. Top with 1 bag of chips (not crushed).

title: Orange Flip Cake
instructions: Mix according to package directions. Bake in 3 layers. Split each layer to make 6 thin layers.

title: Sinful Chess Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix margarine and 1 egg together. Spread in 13 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Make more shallow at edges. Combine powdered sugar cream cheese and eggs. Pour the mixture over the cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Winter Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook elbow macaroni according to package directions; drain well. Cool. (Rinse with cold water to cool quickly; drain well.)

title: Strawberry Angel Delight
instructions: Heat water to boiling and dissolve Jell-O in it. Add strawberries and juice. Fold in small pieces of cake. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill before serving.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water; cool. Add mixture of cranberry sauce and drained pineapple. Refrigerate to set. Takes only minutes to prepare.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Combine juices and chill thoroughly. Just before serving add ginger ale. Pour over ice. Makes about 3 quarts.

title: Microwave Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in microwave. Mix in picante sauce. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until tender and remove from bone. Cut into small pieces. Mix together with soup sour cream and poppy seed. Pour into large (11 x 14) greased baking dish. Crush crackers and pour over mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 30 to 40 minutes or until brown. Great for potlucks.

title: Hors D'Oeuvres Meat Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients blend well and make into 1-inch meat balls. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for one hour (oven time may vary time may be less).

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Marinated Asparagus(Double Or Triple For Party.)
instructions: Bring everything except asparagus to a boil; pour over spears. Cover and refrigerate 6 to 24 hours.

title: English Peas-Asparagus
instructions: Drain asparagus saving 1/4 cup juice. Drain peas. In 2-quart casserole dish combine mushroom soup and asparagus juice. Add 1 1/2 cups cheese. Mix well. Add peas and asparagus. Top with remaining cheese and onion rings. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Spring Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add soup vinegar onion and mayonnaise. Stir until blended. Add peppers and cucumbers. Pour into a 1-quart mold or 6 individual ones. Chill until firm. Unmold on lettuce and garnish with additional mayonnaise if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: In bowl beat eggs until frothy. Gradually beat in milk. Stir in flour sugar baking powder and salt until smooth. Pour into container with spout or use medium or large size funnel to pour with. In small skillet or saucepan heat oil. Pour batter quickly into oil. Cook until golden brown. Place on paper towel to drain and sprinkle with confectioners sugar immediately.

title: Lemon Cheese Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine cake mix one egg and oil; mix until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup of the mixture. Lightly pat the remaining mixture into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until set.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine chocolate and butter in a saucepan; cook over low heat stirring until chocolate melts. Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk; set aside. Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in a bowl; add eggs and vanilla mixing well. Gradually stir in chocolate mixture using a wire whisk. Pour into pastry shells and sprinkle with coconut and pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Pie may appear soft but will become firm after cooling.) Cool at least 4 hours. Yield two 8-inch pies.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Do not braise. Cover brisket with chili sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately four hours covered with foil. Cool 10 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Danish Pastry
instructions: Mix first three ingredients as for pie dough. Press into 2 long strips on cookie sheet.

title: Cream Of Artichoke Soup
instructions: Cook artichokes as package directs. Set a few artichoke hearts aside. Blend the rest with stock until smooth. Return to pot and add milk half and half butter salt and pepper. Heat but do not boil. Chop remaining artichoke hearts and stir into soup. Serves 6.

title: Meatballs With Grape Jelly
instructions: Mix beef with corn flakes salt pepper and sufficient water to bind. Form approximately 90 cocktail size balls. Combine and bring to boil the chili sauce lemon juice and jelly. Add balls singly. Simmer 25 to 30 minutes covered; uncover and cook 10 to 15 minutes more.

title: Mushroom And Chicken Marinara Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil. Wash and cut mushrooms and add to onion and garlic. Add the chicken; brown chicken before mushrooms. Then add mushrooms. When mushrooms are practically cooked add tomatoes and peppers. Salt and pepper. Cook for about 1 hour. Add extra basil.

title: Country Egg Casserole
instructions: Toast the bread if desired. Layer in greased pan. Cook the sausage; crumble drain well and sprinkle over bread. Sprinkle cheese over sausage. Beat eggs milk salt and mustard. Pour over other ingredients. Let stand overnight. Partially cover with foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour; uncover and bake 10 more minutes. Can freeze; reheats well. Nice with fruit salad and sweet rolls.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Early American Cornbread
instructions: Stir in cornmeal to boiling water and mix well. Add shortening molasses and salt and set aside to cool. Dissolve the yeast in the warm water for 5 minutes. Add flour and cornmeal mix; knead until smooth and put in greased bowl in warm place and let rise until double in size. Knead; let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Best Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drain beans reserving 1 cup of liquid. Set beans and liquid aside. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Remove bacon reserving 3 tablespoons drippings in pan. Crumble bacon and set aside. Add onion to drippings in pan and cook 10 minutes until golden brown stirring often. Stir in bacon sugar vinegar and mustard. Cook over medium-low heat until thick and bubbly stirring often. Combine beans reserved liquid and onion mixture in a 2-quart casserole pan coated with spray Pam. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening together. Add eggs. Sift together flour baking powder salt and soda. Add apples that are peeled cored and diced nuts and vanilla. Put into greased bread pan and sprinkle top with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Crystallized Flowers
instructions: Thin the egg white with water. Spread the leaves and blossoms in a single layer on a sheet of wax paper.

title: Real Easy Crescent Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Line bottom and sides of pan with one package of crescent rolls.

title: Swiss Onion Bake
instructions: Cook onions in 1 stick butter until limp and transparent. Add soup and milk until well blended. Pour into a 2-quart greased casserole dish. Place Swiss cheese on top of onion mixture. Melt remaining 1 stick butter and dip the French bread slices in it. Place on top of cheese. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix all together and let rise for 2 hours. Mix again and put in pans. Let rise again and bake in 375\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Cream Cheese Chewies
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients and press into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. On top of this add the nuts and coconut. Mix together the cream cheese eggs and confectioners sugar. Mix this together and pour over the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Hamburger Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes then drain. Brown ground chuck then drain. Put potatoes and ground chuck together. Add can of mushroom soup and 1/2 can of water. Add onions. Also add salt and pepper to taste. Let simmer 30 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Place all ingredients together. Pour in crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Barbecued Catfish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate fish overnight in refrigerator. Grill while basting frequently with the marinade sauce until the fish are done.

title: Steak Sandwich
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise; hollow out loaf and save bread crumbs. Mix next 5 ingredients with bread crumbs. Pat mixture into hollow loaf. Add top of loaf; spread with butter. Wrap in aluminum foil. Bake 1 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in crock-pot and cook on low overnight (or all day). Great with hamburgers! Yields 10 servings.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Fill bottom of cookie sheet with solid crackers. Over slow heat bring margarine and sugar to boil. Boil 2 minutes. Pour syrup over crackers and sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Wine Ciamelle Cookies
instructions: Place all the liquids together and all the dry ingredients in a separate bowl. Mix the two mixtures together and work into a soft dough. Roll out into a long rope and cut sections to form a ring. Dip each circle in milk and then sugar and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 - 375\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Watch for light color.

title: Homemade Waffles
instructions: Combine all ingredients except eggs in a large bowl. Separate egg whites into a small bowl and use mixer to whip egg whites to fluffy stage. Combine egg yolks with dry ingredients in large bowl. Using mixer beat egg yolks and dry ingredients to a batter; fold egg whites lightly into batter. Spoon batter into waffle iron and cook.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pack into container and place in refrigerator. Let stand in refrigerator for 10 days.

title: Creamy Jello Delite
instructions: *Note Butterscotch and chocolate pudding may be substituted.

title: Lazy Woman'S Pickles
