instructions: Pack whole cucumbers into gallon jar. Add alum pickling salt and pickling spices. Cover with apple cider vinegar. Place lid on jar. Let stand in a cool dark place for 3 months (do not refrigerate). Take cucumbers out and slice. Sprinkle 6 to 8 cups sugar over cucumbers. Let stand until sugar melts. Pack into jars; cover with the syrup and seal. Do not heat.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Measure sugar and flour in a large bowl. In a saucepan mix butter Crisco cocoa and Coca-Cola. Bring to a rapid boil and add to flour and sugar. Then add eggs buttermilk baking soda and marshmallows. Put in buttered pan; bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chippy Oatmeal Raisin Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Beat sugar margarine eggs and vanilla until creamy. Gradually add flour; mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread into pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Cut into bars. Makes 32 bars.

title: Some Relish To Relish
instructions: Put green beans pineapple onion and pimentos in a large bowl. Beat together 1/3 cup garlic-flavored wine vinegar and 3 tablespoons olive oil with salt and dill weed to taste. Pour over the bean mixture and chill overnight. Great with sandwiches.

title: Sweet And Sour Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans; chop green pepper. Combine first 5 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to boil. Mix drained beans green pepper and onion. Pour dressing over them. Let mixture stand overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Quick Easy Roll-Ups
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and pork sausage together. Drain off excess fat. Add picante sauce and Velveeta cheese chopped. Simmer until cheese is melted constantly stirring it. Remove off burner. Roll up in soft tortillas. Warm tortillas if desired.

title: Italian Delight
instructions: Brown ground beef and season with garlic salt black pepper and a dash of italian spice. Drain excess fat. Saute bell pepper and onions in a little margarine until tender. Add all ingredients except noodles and cheese. Mix well and set aside. Cook noodles and add to meat mixture. Mix well and add into large casserole pan. Cover top with grated cheese and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees in oven.

title: Lite Bites
instructions: Spread soft cream cheese evenly on each tortilla. Layer remaining ingredients as follows lettuce onions tomatoes 1 slice each of turkey ham and cheese. Roll tightly and cut into 1-inch pinwheels. Arrange on serving plate cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: The Dip
instructions: Mix together the cans of dip mayonnaise sour cream onions and taco seasoning. Spread mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Then layer tomatoes then the olives and then the cheese on top. Serve with plain tortilla chips.

title: Strawberry Daiquiri
instructions: In a blender put all ingredients except ice. Cover and process. While mixture is blending remove feeder cap and add ice. Blend until smooth. Yields 4 cups.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook tomatoes and make juice. Mix all ingredients and cook 1 hour. Yield 22 pints or 11 quarts.

title: Candied Yams
instructions: Bake sweet potatoes and cool. Peel and slice place in casserole dish. Mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil. Pour over potatoes and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Simple Broiled Fish
instructions: Wash and dry fish. Place fish in single layer in foil lined shallow baking pan. Brush with butter and seasonings. Broil 4 inches from heat source for 5 to 8 minutes per side until fish is browned and flakes when tested with fork.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit; reserve juice from the pineapple. Add this juice to the vanilla pudding and Tang. Add fruit cocktail pineapple and bananas.

title: Corned Beef Dip
instructions: Chop corned beef into small pieces. Beat cream cheese and onion dip until smooth. Fold in corned beef. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Serve with your favorite crackers. Makes enough for a party.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Crust 1 (20 oz.) package refrigerated sugar cookies. Press onto greased pizza pan or 15 X 10 baking pan. Using floured fingers press dough evenly into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes until golden brown. Cool.

title: Zucchini And Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Simmer until tender zucchini dill and garlic; drain and save 3 tablespoons liquid. Saute mushrooms and butter. Add 2 tablespoons flour and 1 cup sour cream; heat slowly. Put both mixtures in casserole; top with buttered breadcrumbs. Boil until brown.

title: Zucchini-Broccoli Bake
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Add vegetables; cook until tender. Beat egg slightly; stir in Swiss cheese milk salt and pepper. Place vegetables in a 1-quart casserole dish. Pour egg mixture over vegetables. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hello Dollies
instructions: Melt butter in a pan. Press vanilla wafer crumbs in pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips coconut pecans and milk over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut while warm.

title: Sloppy Joes(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Brown ground beef and salt. Add remaining ingredients and simmer a few minutes before serving.

title: Meat Sauce
instructions: Brown meat in heavy skillet; drain off fat. Add onion garlic and spices. Cook until onions are translucent. Add tomatoes and paste; simmer for 2 hours stirring occasionally. Add water if needed and adjust seasoning to your taste. Serve over cooked pasta. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan and chopped parsley.

title: Oklahoma Potatoes
instructions: Mix together thawed potatoes onion cream of chicken soup sour cream and salt. Layer in greased 13 x 9-inch pan with corn flake crumbs and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes covered and uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Crumble beef into a microwave-safe colander. Place colander in a 9-inch pie plate. Cover with wax paper; microwave at High for 5 to 6 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink stirring after 3 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix sugar milk peanut butter and cream cheese. Fold in whipped topping. Pour in pie shells and freeze.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Crumble the bacon into shell. Cover with the cheese. Beat eggs milk and salt and pepper. Pour into shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In mixing bowl stir together oats sugar butter and flour. Fold in egg whites until well blended. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Applesauce Cupcakes
instructions: Cream brown sugar and Crisco. Add egg and mix well. Combine applesauce and soda; stir into creamed mixture. Stir in salt and spices; add flour and mix thoroughly. Fill greased pans or baking cups half full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Lasagna A La Popeye
instructions: Preheat skillet and saute onion and garlic until golden. Next add sweet sausage and cook until meat is done. Drain off grease. To Ricotta cheese add egg parsley basil and Romano cheese; whip until incorporated.

title: Indian Cornbread
instructions: Mix ingredients except cheese and bacon drippings. Pour half of bacon drippings in mixture and the other half in skillet. Pour half of mixture in skillet then sprinkle with cheese. Add rest of mixture then top with remaining cheese. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 45 minutes. Let set 30 minutes before serving.

title: Hot Florentine Dip(Microwave)
instructions: Microwave cream cheese in 2-quart casserole at High for 30 seconds. Add seasonings and milk to cheese and cream together. Place package of spinach on plate; microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes or until defrosted rotating 1/2 turn after 3 minutes. Drain spinach thoroughly. Stir ham and spinach into cheese mixture. Fold in sour cream and pecans. Microwave at High 4 to 6 minutes or until very hot stirring gently after 2 minutes then every minute. Place casserole on candle warmer or warming tray and serve with crackers. Makes 3 cups.

title: Dumplings
instructions: In a bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Mix in 2 beaten eggs to flour mixture. Add enough water to make a biscuit like dough. Drop in hot broth or gravy and cook covered for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix first five ingredients until creamy. Sift flour salt and baking soda into mixture and mix well. Add chips and pecans if desired.

title: Green Chili Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add taco sauce and a little water and simmer. Drain grease.

title: Mexican Stew
instructions: Brown onion with ground beef. Add tomato sauce and paste. Add 3 paste cans water. Add spices and chopped garlic; simmer 40 minutes. Stir in instant rice; let sit 5 minutes without heat. Spoon over corn chips; top with lettuce tomatoes avocados and cheese. Add taco sauce as desired.

title: California Cole Slaw
instructions: Blend soup mix with sour cream. Add other ingredients.

title: Bie-Rocks Or Beuroc
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Remove from pan. In butter (if needed) cook cabbage until wilted. Add hamburger onion salt and pepper. Mix well. Cool. Roll dough into 9-inch square. Place 3 tablespoons of meat mixture in center. Fold corners together. Place folded sides down. Place in a warm place to rise. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Stash some late summer fruits in the freezer to enjoy all year. Just three steps for freezing melons

title: Easy Tempura
instructions: Chop vegetables into smaller pieces. Mash drained tofu and then mix in surumi. Add the egg and chopped vegetables. Salt and pepper to taste. Drop by tablespoon into a heated frying pan with vegetable oil heated at medium setting. Cook both sides until each piece is lightly brown.

title: Rich Hot Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Add margarine sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast on warm water. Stir to dissolve. Add 1 1/2 cups flour to milk mixture. Beat well by hand or with electric mixer at low speed 1 minute. Beat in eggs and yeast. Gradually stir in enough remaining flour a little at a time to make a soft dough that leaves the sides of bowl. Turn onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth satiny and no longer sticky 5 to 8 minutes. Place in lightly greased bowl; invert to grease top. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Punch down and turn onto board. Divide and shape into rolls. Cover with light towel and let rise until doubled. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 30 rolls.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Cook chicken until done. Pick meat off when cool. Cut in bite-size pieces. Mix dry ingredients. Make a depression in center. Add eggs milk and food coloring. Mix until bowl is clean. Dough will be stiff. Roll dough out cut into noodles drop in chicken broth and cook until done. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Friendship Cake(30 Day Process)
instructions: Combine starter (if available from a friend) sugar and peaches (halved with juice). Mix well and put in 1 gallon glass or crock jar with lid. Cover and set on counter; stir daily for 10 days then add 2 1/2 cups sugar and crushed pineapple and juice. Stir well for 10 days covered. Add fruit cocktail and juice and 2 1/2 cups sugar. Stir well for 10 days covered. Add maraschino cherries with juice and 2 1/2 cups sugar. Stir well 10 days covered. At end of 30 days strain. Divide fruit into 4 portions and juice into 1 1/2 cups portions. Keep 1 for yourself. Next time give friends each of 1 1/2 cups juice and their recipe.

title: Special Occasion Punch
instructions: Chill pineapple juice and soda. Just as party begins mix chilled juice and soda with coconut cream and add ice cream or sherbet and serve.

title: Odorless Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Garlic-Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs cheese and garlic powder in a shallow dish. Melt margarine in a shallow dish. Dip each chicken breast in the margarine then coat with crumb mixture. Place on lightly greased baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes depending on thickness of chicken.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushroom Caps
instructions: Brush mushroom caps with butter and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients and fill caps. Place on baking pan filled side up. Broil 6 inches from heat about 5 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and mushrooms are heated through.

title: Microwave Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Bake zucchini and onion in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch microwave dish covered with plastic wrap; turn back corner to vent. Microwave on High for 7 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; cover with paper towel and microwave on Medium-high for 8 to 10 minutes. Stir after 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Deviled Sprouts
instructions: Cook Brussels sprouts in boiling water until tender-crisp (5 to 7 minutes). Drain. Melt butter in skillet; add onion mustard and thyme. Cook for 2 minutes. Add bread crumbs salt and pepper to taste. Cook 1 more minute. Add this mixture to the drained Brussels sprouts. Shake/stir to cover the sprouts with the seasoned mixture. Cook until desired doneness.

title: Praline Cookies
instructions: Arrange graham\tcrackers on 13 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan. Bring brown sugar and butter to a boil; boil and stir for 2 minutes. Add nuts; mix together and pour over graham crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes; cut into squares while warm.

title: Peach Pickle
instructions: Put spices in bag and mix. Then mix everything except peaches and boil for 20 minutes. Peel peaches and put in boiling mixture slowly. Put into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Baked Fruit
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan place pineapple slices and peach halves pit side up. Drop a pat of margarine in each peach half. Sprinkle brown sugar and curry powder on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in casserole dish. Crush 1 tube Ritz crackers and combine with 1 stick melted butter. Spread over potato mixture; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Green Beans Pennsylvania Dutch
instructions: Fry bacon in skillet until crispy. Remove bacon and crumble. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon drippings. Add onions and brown lightly. Stir in cornstarch salt and dry mustard. Cook green beans reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Stir reserved liquid in skillet. Cook stirring until mixture boils. Blend in brown sugar and vinegar. Add green beans and heat thoroughly. Turn into serving dish and garnish with egg and crumbled bacon. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In large pan cook onion and green pepper in 2 tablespoons margarine until tender. Combine in a bowl with chicken and green chilies; set aside. In same pan melt 3 tablespoons margarine. Blend in flour cumin and salt. Stir in chicken broth at once. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat stir in sour cream and 1/2 cup of cheese. Stir 1/2 cup sauce into chicken. Dip each tortilla into sauce to soften fill with 1/4 cup of chicken mix. Roll up. Arrange rolls in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour remaining sauce over all. Sprinkle remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Green Bean Stew
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil. Cut beans in half. Add to onion and garlic. Cover and let steam for 30 minutes stirring frequently. Add water and tomatoes until even with beans. Add seasonings to taste. Cook 15 minutes or until tender.

title: Lucky Seven Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine meat cornstarch and soy sauce; let stand 10 minutes. Stir-fry meat in 2 tablespoons hot oil in wok or large skillet over high heat 2 minutes; remove. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in same pan. Add vegetables; stir-fry 2 minutes. Combine Lucky Seven Stir-Fry Sauce and red pepper; pour mixture over vegetables. Cook stirring until sauce boils and thickens. Stir in meat to combine.

title: Poppy Seed Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix sugar mustard salt vinegar and onion juice; blend thoroughly. Add oil slowly beating constantly and continue to beat until thick. Add poppy seeds and beat until well mixed.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter in 9-inch skillet. Add brown sugar. Stir until just melted. Pour over pineapple cubes that have been arranged in bottom of square pan. Sift flour salt and baking powder 3 times. Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Beat sugar in gradually. Fold in lemon juice 1/3 cup reserved pineapple juice and dry ingredients alternately. Mix only enough to blend. Pour batter over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until golden brown. Let set 5 minutes and flip over onto serving plate or cardboard lined with paper.

title: Chili Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Top with shredded cheese. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Great for cookouts!

title: Fried Turkey
instructions: Thaw turkey. Mix all ingredients and thoroughly cover the turkey on all sides. Refrigerate. Fry in a deep pot at 300\u00b0 for 4 minutes per pound.

title: Sesame Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in a small saucepan. Stir in vinegar and water. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Cool completely.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour. Mix and take off heat. Add cocoa. Heat milk in another pan. Add milk to other mixture. Add sugar and boil. Stir until thickened. Serve over ice cream.

title: Opossum Pie
instructions: Blend the flour or graham cracker crumbs oleo and chopped nuts (optional). Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Let cool.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs until fluffy. Beat in sugar oil and vanilla until it is thick and lemon colored. Add rest of ingredients and pour into two loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Invert on racks and let cool completely.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops. Put in the bottom of a casserole dish. Top each pork chop with a slice of onion and a green pepper ring. Cover with cooked rice. Top with a can of tomato soup. Spread evenly over the rice. Cover tightly and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. May want to uncover the last 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and shortening. Blend all dry ingredients (except soda) and fruit. Heat applesauce. Add soda to it then alternate a little at a time to sugar and shortening. Add raisins and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can use Bundt pan or loaf.

title: Raised Donuts
instructions: Combine yeast sugar and water. Let stand until it bubbles. Scald milk; stir in shortening. Let cool. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Turn out onto floured board and knead will. Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with donut cutter or glass. Fry in hot grease until golden brown; sprinkle with sugar.

title: Chicken Or Seafood Aspic Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in the hot water and let cool. Mix all ingredients and pour in glass 9 x 13-inch casserole. Cool and let harden.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together in order given. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Let cool in pan until barely warm. Ice cake with following recipe.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix margarine and sugar in a medium bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients. Place dough in cookie press. Form desired shapes on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 6 to 9 minutes or until set (not brown). Remove from cookie sheet. Cool on wire rack. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Barbara Bruu'S Sourdough Bread And Starter
instructions: Combine Sourdough Starter sugar salt oil and warm water in large mixing bowl. Using heavy-duty mixer and dough hooks gradually mix in all the bread flour. Place dough in large oiled bowl brushing oil over top to keep from drying out. Cover with clean dish towel and let rise all day or overnight.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute onions peppers and celery in margarine until tender not brown. Add rest of ingredients and bring to a boil. Add shrimp last and simmer until shrimp are tender. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Russian Teacakes
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix thoroughly butter sugar and vanilla. Work in flour salt and nuts until the dough holds together. Shape the dough into 1-inch balls and place them on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not brown. While warm roll in 10x sugar. Cool and roll in sugar again.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan melt butter and stir in flour. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Sour Slaw
instructions: Mix sugar and vinegar until sugar is melted. Add salt and mayonnaise. Mix with cabbage.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook ground beef loose with diced onion. Cool after draining fat. Chop lettuce tomato and green pepper into small pieces. Mix in large bowl with cooked cooled meat. Add Catalina dressing crush Doritos in bag and mix 3/4 of bag in salad. Toss and add remaining Doritos on top.

title: Aunt June'S Sky-High Biscuits
instructions: In a bowl combine the flour baking powder sugar salt and cream of tartar. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Add egg and milk stirring quickly and briefly. Knead lightly on floured board. Roll or pat gently to 1-inch thickness. Cut into 1 to 2-inch biscuits. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Toss cabbage and carrots together in a large mixing bowl. Add mayonnaise and sweet pickle juice. Blend together. Add salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle paprika on top.

title: Double Delicious Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with chips; press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Methodist Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes.

title: Tangy Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix pudding into fruit. Mix Tang into pineapple juice and pour over the mixture.

title: Spanish Bar Cake
instructions: Put apple pie mix into blender with eggs apple pie spice and cloves. Blend until smooth. Dump into 2-quart mixing bowl and beat in cake mix with electric mixer on medium speed blending thoroughly. Remove beaters. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool. Frost.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine butter and crumbs and press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat eggs sugar and butter for no less than 15 minutes; pour into crust. Top with bananas and pineapple. Spread on Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and cherries. Serves 14 to 16.

title: Cranberry-Pear Crisp
instructions: Peel core and thinly slice pears or apples. (You may use two of each if available.) Wash and pick over cranberries. Toss pears and berries in a bowl with sugar and cinnamon. Spread on bottom of 10-inch pie dish or other flat baking dish. Combine flour brown sugar rolled oats and salt. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Spread evenly over cranberry mixture. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Cool 1 hour. Serve plain or with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Fruit Salad(Working Family Recipe)
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and milk. Stir in remaining ingredients. Serve.

title: German Farmers Breakfast
instructions: Fry bacon crisp. Crumble into small pieces. Add green pepper onion potatoes salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat about 5 minutes or until potatoes are golden brown. Break eggs over potato mixture and cook until eggs are set.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole mix sugar and syrup. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir in nuts. Microwave for 3 to 5 minutes on High until light brown. Add butter and vanilla; stir well. Microwave on High for 1 to 2 minutes more. Add soda and stir until light and foamy. Pour onto greased sheet. Let cool for 1 hour. When cool break into pieces.

title: Grandma Pierson'S Easy Pudding Cookies
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in mixing bowl until mixed thoroughly. Roll balls of dough (the size of walnuts) until smooth. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Flatten tops of balls with the bottom of a glass. Decorate with pecans sprinkles colored sugar Hersheys Kisses etc. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned on bottom. Cookies should be soft. Place on wax paper to cool. Yield 12 to 20 cookies.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour; add eggs and the rest of ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until custard is firm approximately 45 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Leave chicken breasts whole or cut in strips. Cook chicken in large nonstick frying pan. Add dressing when chicken is 3/4 of the way cooked; reduce heat until done. Serve with rice or mixed vegetables.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in chicken broth. Mix noodles diced chicken soup sour cream mixed vegetables salt and pepper to taste. Pour in casserole dish and cover top of casserole with thin biscuit layers. Pour melted margarine over top of casserole and bake at 400\u00b0 until biscuits are brown (about 15 minutes).

title: Pizza Cookie
instructions: Press cookie dough in a pizza pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Beat cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar together. Spread cream mixture on cookie. Top with fruit or nuts. Suggestions Bananas grapes strawberries kiwi and pineapple.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix together baking soda vanilla and salt; set aside. Cook sugar syrup and water until it forms a soft ball in water. Add raw peanuts; cook until it reaches hard crack on a candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Add soda mixture and mix well. Pour up while foaming into greased jellyroll pans and spread thin. Let cool and break into pieces.

title: Candied Pecans
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake on cookie sheet for 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased pie dish for 45 minutes. Springtime fresh!

title: Spinach Rarebit Casserole
instructions: Partially cook spinach and drain. Thaw rarebit on top of double boiler. Place 1/3 rarebit in bottom of casserole. Add spinach bacon and water chestnuts. Top with remaining rarebit. Sprinkle with French fried onions. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes in rectangular casserole. Serves 8 generously.

title: Easy Chili
instructions: Cook hamburger until no longer pink. Drain. Add kidney beans and sauce. Add chili to taste. Serve with cornbread.

title: Tomato Soup Spice Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sift flour with soda cinnamon cloves and nutmeg; set aside. In large bowl with electric mixer at high speed cream 1 cup butter until light. Gradually beat in brown sugar until light. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Combine soup with enough water to measure 2 cups. Mix well. At low speed add flour (in fourths) to sugar mixture alternately with soup mixture (in thirds) beginning and ending with flour mixture. Beat just until combined. Fold in nuts and raisins. Turn into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven 55 to 60 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack 30 minutes. Turn out of pan and let cool completely on rack. Frost top with cream cheese frosting. Cut into squares. Makes 15 to 18 servings.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Mix flour salt baking powder and cinnamon. Add to pumpkin mixture. Spread in greased and floured cookie sheet. Top with walnuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out on dish towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Starting at narrow end roll towel and cake together. Cool. Unroll and fill.

title: Quick And Easy Donuts
instructions: Roll out biscuits and cut hole in the middle. Place oil in deep fryer or frying pan. Fry until brown; take out. Drain; sprinkle with powdered sugar or frosting of your choice.

title: Corny Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased pan at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Buffet Cheese Eggs
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover bottom of pan with flour tortillas cut to fit (can overlap). Sprinkle with 1/2 of chilies 1/2 of ham and 1/2 of cheese. Repeat layers ending with cheese. In medium bowl combine eggs milk and salt. Pour over layered ingredients. Decorate with strips of pepper on top. Refrigerate 1/2 hour or overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until puffed and bubbly. Cool 5 minutes and cut in squares.

title: Ida Duff'S Orange Marmalade
instructions: Removes seeds of lemons and oranges; chop in food processor. Mix together. Add pineapple sugar and water. Stir to dissolve sugar. Slowly bring to a boil stirring frequently. Boil for 1/2 hour after mixture starts to boil and not more than 3/4 hour at the most. Pour into sterilized jelly glasses and cover with paraffin. Makes 8 jelly glasses.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar butter and then add eggs. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Set aside. Add baking soda to water and stir. Alternately add dry ingredients and liquid ingredients soda water vanilla and buttermilk until well mixed. Drop by heaping teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes in center of oven.

title: Jane'S Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes for 2 hours. Mix first 6 ingredients together. Add Cheddar cheese and sour cream and mix. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan; top with cornflakes and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. May add chunks of ham for a main-dish casserole.

title: Braised Red Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage in half. Wash and drain then core and shred. Melt margarine in a heavy type kettle on low heat. Add shredded cabbage and saute for five minutes. Add sugar salt vinegar and water. Toss until mixed. Cook 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Tortellini Salad
instructions: Cook Tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain. Rinse with cold water.

title: Cherry Vanilla Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar salt cream milk corn syrup and butter in large heavy saucepan or skillet. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Continue cooking stirring occasionally until candy thermometer reaches 238\u00b0 (soft ball stage). Remove from heat and cool (100\u00b0). Add vanilla. Beat briskly until fudge thickens and begins to lose its gloss. Stir in cherries. Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan. Cool and cut into squares when firm. This fudge is pretty to serve at Christmastime. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Sweet-Sour Pork Roast
instructions: Sprinkle roast with salt and pepper. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Pour off fat. Combine tomato sauce lemon juice water rind 1/2 teaspoon salt brown sugar and nutmeg in saucepan. Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Add juice to mixture; simmer 10 minutes. Add pineapple and raisins. Pour over roast. Roast until done about 2 hours.

title: Lime Cheese Salad
instructions: Add 1 cup boiling water to jello. Stir in crushed pineapple and let stand until partly congealed. Then prepare Dream Whip as directed on package. Stir Dream Whip and grated cheese into the congealed mixture. Chill.

title: Hot Wieners
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Supreme
instructions: Lightly brown hamburger onions and green pepper in shortening. Stir occasionally. Add and heat rest of ingredients except for 1/2 cup cheese including cooked spaghetti. Mix well. Place in casserole dish and top with 1/2 cup sharp cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Molasses Bread
instructions: Bring water to a boil and add to rolled oats. Mix in oil molasses salt and cool to lukewarm. Add yeast solution and eggs stir altogether. Add flour. Mix and knead until waxy. Cover. When double in bulk punch down and rise again (not necessary but makes better bread). Shape into 2 loaves. Let rise again in bread pans until slight indentation shows. Bake about 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. After 20 minutes cover with foil to keep from browning too much.

title: Nut Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar eggs and vanilla. Roll nuts in flour then mix all together. Line pan with waxed paper. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into an unbaked pastry shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Beef And Cheddar Goulash
instructions: Brown beef in butter or margarine. Add onion; cook until tender. Blend in flour and seasonings. Stir in mushrooms and tomato sauce. Simmer mixture 5 minutes. Add noodles and green beans; toss lightly but well. Pour into greased shallow baking pan; sprinkle cheese over top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Glorified Chicken
instructions: In skillet using medium heat cook chicken until brown on all sides. Remove from heat and drain off fat. Stir in soup black pepper thyme and milk. Return to low heat cover and simmer 35 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over toast or rice. Serves 4.

title: Microwave Orange Glazed Chicken For Two
instructions: Split chicken breast; rinse and pat dry. Place chicken in 9-inch round microproof baking dish thick edges toward rim. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Cover with waxed paper and cook on High for 3 minutes. Pour off fat and set aside.

title: Banana Split
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and 1 stick melted margarine. Pat evenly in 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat powdered sugar 2 sticks softened margarine eggs and vanilla for 15 minutes. Spread on crust. Slice bananas long way. Top with pineapple Cool Whip nuts and maraschino cherries.

title: Corn Fingers
instructions: Melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in a 425\u00b0 oven. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and mix until blended. Knead 6 to 8 times. Roll into strips 3 x 3-inches and roll in margarine. Arrange in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until well browned. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Applesauce Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg. Add oil and applesauce. Sift in dry ingredients. Mix well. Add walnuts and cherries. Pour batter into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes. Yields 15 servings.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring Karo syrup and sugar to a boil at medium heat for 1 minute. Add peanuts. Cook 25 minutes at slow boil. Mix salt and soda on waxed paper. Pour in and stir fast. Place tinfoil on cookie sheet and grease. Pour candy on foil and cool. Break candy into pieces.

title: Quick Lunch
instructions: Cook steak in a little fat until done; do not season. Reduce heat. When meat is done pour the can of mushroom soup over the meat. Stir. Serve hot on buttered toast.

title: Apple Brown Betty
instructions: Melt butter and mix with bread cubes. Reserve 1/2 cup for topping. Combine other ingredients; stir in water. Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with reserved bread cubes. Cover and bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove cover and bake 30 minutes more. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown beef. Drain. Add all 4 cans of soup and heat. Place chips in bottom of a large casserole dish. Pour meat and soup mixture over it and top with grated cheese. Bake for 5 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat whipping cream in a chilled bowl until stiff. Beat eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy; fold into whipped cream. Mix remaining ingredients. Fold into mixture.

title: Apricot Mochi
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Cover tightly with tinfoil and bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and after 15 minutes remove tinfoil. Cool for several hours; cut into bite size pieces and roll in potato starch or kinako (soybean flour). Shake off excess starch. Makes 48 servings.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Fold in remaining ingredients except sour cream. Pour 1/2 mixture into oblong dish and let set. Spread top with sour cream. Add remaining mixture. Place in refrigerator until time to serve. Yields 12 servings.

title: Enchilada
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions and drain off oil. Add flour chili powder cumin salt and garlic. Mix well; add water and cook on low heat until thickened. You will need to taste it to make sure you will not need anymore chili powder. It needs to have a taco seasoning taste.

title: Inside Out Chocolate Bundt Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix by hand until well blended about 2 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 12-cup tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed with finger. Do not overbake. Cool 15 minutes in pan remove and continue cooling on rack. When cool dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: In bowl beat eggs butter and milk together. In a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole dish layer bread cubes half of cheese sausage and mushrooms. Pour egg mixture over all and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. For glass dish bake at 325\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Chocolate Chews(Diabetic)
instructions: Blend first six ingredients with fork. Round into balls. Roll in nuts. Freeze.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Cook sugar flour milk and egg together until thick. Add butter and vanilla. Slice strawberries and cover with sugar. Crush vanilla wafers. Put vanilla wafers in bottom of dish. Cover with pudding. Add sweetened strawberries on top of pudding. Sprinkle some strawberries on top of pudding. Sprinkle some more vanilla wafers on top of that. Also pecans. Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle some more vanilla wafer crumbs and pecans. This is good frozen. Cut in squares and serve. Needs to be set out of freezer ahead of time.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in salted water. Drain. Add milk soup corned beef green peppers onion and cheese. Mix together and pour into casserole. Cover with potato chips or chow mein noodles. Bake.

title: Hummus Party Dip
instructions: In a blender or food processor fitted with the metal blade combine 1/4 cup bean liquid and remaining ingredients. Process until mixture is smooth paste. Add more liquid if needed to make desired consistency. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Serve with crackers or pita bread. Use as a dip for crudites or use as a stuffing for celery. Makes 1 cup.

title: South-Of-The-Border Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Set aside. Cream margarine and instant coffee. Cut orange into thin strips add to creamed mixture; blend well. Gradually add sugar beat well after each addition. Beat in one egg at a time. Add part of flour mixture part of orange and molasses; beat well. Add remaining flour mixture orange juice and molasses. Beat well. Pour into waxed paper-lined pan 10 x 5 x 13-inches. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Yeast Rolls
instructions: Combine oleo sour cream sugar and salt and cook over low heat until oleo melts. Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand 5 minutes. Stir into above mixture. Add flour. Stir. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. Punch down and divide in half. Roll into 12-inch circle. Cut each circle into 12 wedges. Roll each wedge into jelly roll fashion starting at wide end. Place on greased sheet. Cover and let rise until double. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix and chill before serving about 4 hours. Serves 12.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Scald milk and remove from heat. Fold in six beaten egg yolks then add vanilla and condensed milk. (This may be prepared ahead of time and put in refrigerator until ready to use.) Fold in six beaten egg whites and finish filling freezer with milk.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in covered container.

title: Manwich Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and put in casserole dish. Top with Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually. Beat in eggs; add bananas. Beat well. Add flour sifted with soda & salt. Add walnuts. Bake 50-60 minutes in greased bread tin at 350\u00b0.

title: Peachy Cream Dessert
instructions: In a bowl cut butter into the flour until crumbly. Stir in the pecans. Press into a 13 x 9 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Sunshine Golden Yellow Cake
instructions: In mixing bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add 3/4 cup milk and Crisco. Beat vigorously by hand or at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs 1/2 cup milk and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes more. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2 or two 9-inch round greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chow-Chow
instructions: Cook vinegar sugar and spices 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and cook 30 minutes. Put in hot clean jars and seal.

title: Sophie'S Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring milk and water to a boil. Add pinch of salt then lower flame to a simmer. Add rice. Let it simmer until all liquid is almost absorbed. Remove pot from flame. Add vanilla and drop of yellow food coloring. Stir in cup of sugar. Cook 1 hour or more when dissolved. Pour into bowl. Add a sprinkle of cinnamon. Chill.

title: Mincemeat Squares
instructions: Cook mincemeat in boiling water for 3 minutes. Cool. Cream shortening; add sugar. Gradually beat in molasses; add dry ingredients and mix well. Spread half the oatmeal mixture over greased shallow pan (9 x 9-inches). Press mixture down firmly. Spread mincemeat filling over oatmeal mixture. Spread remaining half of oatmeal mixture over mincemeat. Press down firmly with fingers. Bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool and cut in squares. Makes 16 pieces.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix hamburger salt eggs pepper onion and corn flakes together. Make sauce with ketchup brown sugar mustard and vinegar. Heat sauce mixture until hot. Put half of sauce in the meat mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350 degrees. Pour remaining sauce over meat loaf and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Quick Chocolate Sheath Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix sugar and flour together in mixing bowl. Heat oleo cocoa and water in saucepan until it reaches boiling point. Pour hot mixture over dry ingredients and add buttermilk with soda eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Pour batter into pan 11 x 15 x 1-inch. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Bulgogi(Korean Style Marinated Thin Beef Steak)
instructions: Mix sauce portions together. Add meat and stir. Allow mixture to set in refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours. Stir-fry in small to medium batches over medium heat. May be served on roll or a bed of rice.

title: Fix-Ahead Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken; place in 2-quart casserole. Stir soup milk and seasonings together; add vegetables and cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Pour chicken in casserole. Cover; can be kept in refrigerator until 1 hour before serving or can be used right away. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. Uncover and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Nut Crescents
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients and 1 tablespoon water. Stir in flour and nuts; mix well. Shape into crescents. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool on a rack; roll in powdered sugar. Makes 60 crescents.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Cook over medium heat turning occasionally until brown for about 20 minutes.

title: Mama'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook vermicelli according to package directions. Drain and combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Place sliced cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Drain canned vegetables and combine with other vegetables. Mix together the vinegar sugar and oil. Pour over vegetables and chill several hours. To serve drain the juice and save to pour over unused portion.

title: Zuni Succotash
instructions: Brown beef well in oil. Add vegetables and simmer until meat is tender. Add sunflower seeds to thicken and salt to taste. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Place in casserole dish; top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Stir flour and spices together. Add sugar and oats. Mix in thoroughly the oil milk and egg. Add nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes about three dozen.

title: Corned Beef Dinner(From Recipes For Diabetics)
instructions: Cover meat with cold water in Dutch oven. Bring to a boil; drain. Add water to cover; again bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Cook until meat is nearly tender (about 3 hours) skimming off as much fat as possible from cooking water. (If you remove meat from broth and refrigerate fat will harden and remove easily.) Add vegetables. Cook until vegetables are done (about 15 minutes). Remove vegetables from water; drain and trim fat from meat. Makes 16 (3 ounce) servings. Contains 300 calories per serving.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Blend flour milk sugar baking powder and butter. Heat fruit and pour into buttered baking dish. Then pour batter over fruit and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Magic Bars
instructions: Melt butter in 13 x 2 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs over butter evenly. Sprinkle coconut chocolate chips and butterscotch chips over coconut. Pour milk evenly over top. Press nuts into mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Fritters
instructions: Combine the flour and the salt. Beat the egg with the water and add to the flour. Beat until the mixture is thick. Dip the cheese in the batter and fry until golden brown.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs sugar salt butter and syrup with rotary beater. Stir in nuts. Pour into frozen pie crust shell. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until filling is set.

title: No-Fat Fruit Salad
instructions: May omit pineapple and use 2 cups orange juice.

title: Baked Pork Chops And Dressing
instructions: Brown chops on both sides. Mix together bread cubes poultry seasoning onion water and melted butter. Place chops in a baking dish and place a mound of stuffing on each chop. Blend cream of mushroom soup and water. Pour over chops and stuffing. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 about 1 1/4 hours.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cooking oil together. Drop by spoonfuls in hot oil and cook until a golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Cook frozen spinach and onion in 3/4 inch water. Mix rest of the ingredients with spinach and onions. Pour into greased casserole and bake in a 350 degree oven for 25-30 minutes until the center is set.

title: London Broil
instructions: Make marinade of wine olive oil garlic salt peppercorns mustard and thyme. Cut away fat and score meat cross-wise on both sides. In large container pour the marinade over steak. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours (preferably overnight) turn occasionally. Before cooking drain and retain marinade. Press peppercorns into scored steak. Let stand 30 minutes season with salt.

title: Macaroni By Catherine
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Dot with butter and set aside.

title: Shrimp Soup
instructions: Use soup pot. Add water. Bring water to a boil on top of stove adding all the ingredients except shrimp. Then add shrimp and cook until tender. Drain reserving fluid. Place shrimp in blender with 2 cups of liquid. Blend until finely chopped. Add to remaining liquid in pot. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Easy-Does-It Donuts
instructions: In medium mixing bowl beat\teggs; set aside. Drain both cans of apples or blueberries from muffin mixes; add to beaten eggs. Stir in flour and dry muffin mixes. On well floured pastry sheet roll out dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut out doughnuts with a floured 2 1/2-inch diameter doughnut cutter pressing straight down. Meanwhile in a large saucepan or deep fat fryer heat cooking oil to 375\u00b0. Fry the doughnuts and holes a few at a time for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or\tuntil golden brown turning several times. Drain on paper toweling. If desired sprinkle\tpowdered sugar over tops or roll in granulated\tsugar or cinnamon sugar. Store cooled doughnuts in a sealed container.

title: Prairie Hot Dish
instructions: Brown meat and add onion. Mix in salt pepper corn soup water and cheese. Spread it in a large cake pan and top with noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter until tender. Stir in meat oregano and gravy. Season with salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Heat through.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease pan (heat in oven). Mix all ingredients together and bake 30 minutes or until it is golden brown.

title: Cheesecake Dip
instructions: Beat cheese sugar and milk until well blended and smooth. Fold in whipped topping and vanilla. Store in refrigerator.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread on party rye bread slices. Bake in slow oven (250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0) for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hearty Hamburger Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions drain. In large pot (at least 8 quarts) mix all ingredients except salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 to 3 hours. Check about 30 minutes before serving and add salt and pepper. If soup is to thick add water to desired consistency. Soup can be frozen or canned for later use.

title: Potato Cheese Patties
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients except oil; mix well. In large skillet drop mixture by heaping tablespoonfuls a few at a time in small amount of hot oil. Fry until golden on both sides. Serve hot.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Take a large size mixing bowl and add ingredients as follows Line bottom and sides of bowl with lettuce. Add celery red onion green peppers and sweet peas. Mix Miracle Whip with sour cream. Smear over top like a frosting. Let set several hours or overnight. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and Bac*Os or crumbled crisp bacon bits.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time 1 1/4 hours.

title: Donna'S Zucchini Moussaka
instructions: In large skillet brown zucchini and onion in oil. Place in 2-quart baking dish. Brown beef; drain. Stir in tomato sauce garlic salt and cinnamon. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Spread over zucchini and onion. Blend cottage cheese and egg; spread over meat. Sprinkle Parmesan over all. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine cinnamon and sugar. Toss biscuits in mixture a few at a time. Place sugared biscuits on a greased bunt pan. Combine margarine and remaining sugar mix and pour over biscuits. Bake at 359 degrees for 40 minutes or until brown. Turn onto serving plate. Pull off pieces.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar. Add molasses and eggs; beat well. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with hot water. Bake in a greased 9-inch square pan for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Good luck!

title: Orange Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening sugar and egg. Add the orange juice and rind alternately with the dry ingredients. Drop by tablespoon onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool and ice. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Texas Rice Delight
instructions: Cook sausage and onions until sausage is golden brown stirring constantly. Add sausage and onion mixture to rice and pour into well-greased casserole. Make a layer of grated cheese. Top with tomatoes to which Tabasco sauce has been added. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken tender in 1 1/2 cups water (save broth). Cool. Tear into bite size pieces and place in 10 x 10-inch casserole dish. Cover with cream of chicken soup (undiluted). Chop celery and onion. Saute in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Cool. Mix with broth from chicken beaten egg sage salt and pepper. Add this mixture to enough chicken flavored Stove Top stuffing to make desired consistency. Top casserole with it. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Melt margarine and pour over brown sugar. Cream the two. Add eggs one at a time and beat after each addition. Sift flour and baking powder together and add gradually to the creamed mixture. Beat well. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips. Turn into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry Champagne
instructions: Pour all ingredients over crushed ice in punch bowl. Serve at once.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
instructions: Fold milk and Cool Whip together. Add cherries drained pineapple and nuts. Put in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Put in freezer. Take out about 15 or 20 minutes before serving. Cut in squares and serve. Always a dessert ready for company!

title: Russian Borsch
instructions: Add cabbage and onion to boiling stock. Meanwhile cook and puree other vegetables then add to the soup and cook about 10 minutes more. Salt to taste.

title: Sirloin Tips
instructions: Slice sirloin steak into thin strips. Brown in oil. Add salt and pepper soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce to suit taste. Cover and cook about 10 minutes or until tender. Add cut up peppers and onions with water. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes. Serve with baked potatoes and salad.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mash sweet potatoes in blender using 1/3 cup syrup in can. Mix other ingredients in sweet potatoes. Spread in greased glass dish.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Combine the first 11 ingredients in a large bowl; beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Garden Tuna Pasta Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first 6 ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover; chill. Makes 8 cups.

title: Butter Pecan Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pan 9 x 13-inch. Beat eggs for 1 minute. Add brown sugar and mix; add white sugar and mix. Add melted oleo then add flour chopped nuts and vanilla. Bake 35 minutes. (When done insides will be slightly moist.) Cut when warm. Store in tight container.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Blend powdered sugar and cocoa in a mixing bowl. Add milk and margarine. Do not mix.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Boil beans 10 to 15 minutes. Pack in jars and put garlic pepper an dill seed on top of beans. Boil vinegar salt and water and pour over beans. Wait 15 days before opening. Makes 6 pints.

title: Crumble Burgers
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add onion green pepper and celery. Simmer until onion is soft. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1/2 hour uncovered. Serve on buns.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Pour off pineapple juice and mix with pudding. Mix in other ingredients. Place in bowl. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Thaw the potatoes. Mix all the ingredients. Take 2 cups corn flakes and mix with 1/4 cup butter. Put it on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Applesauce Picnic Cake
instructions: In large saucepan heat margarine and applesauce until butter is melted. Beat eggs. Sift together dry ingredients. Add with beaten eggs to applesauce mixture. Add walnuts and put in greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Scald peel and drain tomatoes. Cut up or put in blender the peppers and onions. Put in blender. Add some of the vinegar with it so you have some liquid. Mix all together and cook. Slow boil; cant be stirred out. Cook about 2 hours or until thick.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except sugar. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour. Spoon into small balls and roll in sugar. Store in refrigerator.

title: Zucchini & Hot Sausage Supper
instructions: Cook onions in 2 Tbsp. oil. Add celery. Then sausage. Brown and Drain. Put in a large pot and add peppers in sauce and roasted peppers tomatoes with chilies. Cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Add parmesan cheese and rice. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. You can use Fresh peppers and tomato sauce if you want. Very good with Italian Bread.

title: Jello Delight
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Mash the frozen raspberries into dissolved jello then put in the vanilla ice cream. Beat up well. Put in refrigerator to set.

title: Chocolate Truffles
instructions: Put the cream cheese sugar and cocoa powder in the mixing bowl and stir until well blended. Roll the mixture into marble size balls in the palms of your hands. You can make them bigger if you like. Spread the chocolate sprinkles on the work surface and carefully roll the truffles in them then put each one in a paper cup.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix together; store in tightly sealed container. Use approximately 2 teaspoons per cup hot water.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar water and cornstarch. Cook until thick (not too thick). Stir in Jell-O. Put whole strawberries in cool pie shell. Cover with Jell-O mixture. Cool completely. Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Mix together the grated cheese flour salt and red pepper. Melt margarine and pour over cheese-flour mixture. Mix well. Add Rice Krispies. Mix well. Using hands roll into 1-inch balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten slightly with fork. Bake approximately 15 to 20 minutes at 300\u00b0 or until edges are slightly brown. Let cool. Remove carefully with spatula.

title: Microwave Peanut Patties
instructions: Combine sugar syrup water and salt in 2 to 2 1/2-quart glass container and stir. Microwave 3 to 4 minutes on High until mixture boils. Remove and stir well. Add 2 cups raw peanuts. Microwave 10 minutes on High. Remove and add butter vanilla and food coloring. Stir well until mixture loses gloss but is still runny. Spoon by tablespoon onto buttered cookie sheet or wax paper. Makes 25.

title: Brown Sugar Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Add boiling water to quick oats; set aside to cool. Combine margarine brown sugar white sugar eggs and oat mixture. Sift together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon; add to first mixture.

title: Tea Sandwich
instructions: Cut bread crusts off and cut bread into rectangle shapes (3 rectangles per slice). Smash shrimp with a fork and combine with mayo and dye. Spread on bread and sprinkle with chives.

title: Grilled Mushrooms
instructions: Thread mushrooms on skewers. Combine butter dill and garlic salt; brush over mushrooms. Grill over hot coals for 10 to 15 minutes basting and turning every 5 minutes. Yield 4 servings.

title: Crunchy Sunflower Coleslaw
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients with 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons white vinegar. Sprinkle sunflower seeds and bacon on each serving.

title: Cheese Pennies
instructions: Let margarine and cheese come to room temperature. Mix well adding flour salt and soup mix. Form into four rolls with circumference the size of a penny. Wrap each and freeze.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cream cheese with butter. Add chicken salt pepper milk chives and pimento. Mix thoroughly. Divide rolls into 4 squares pressing seams between each 2 triangles together. Spoon 1/4 chicken mixture onto center of each square. Pull sides to center to cover chicken. Brush each square with melted butter. Sprinkle croutons over squares and bake on a cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pecan Candy
instructions: Mix pecans and oleo. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Stir once in a while. Melt cream cheese in a double boiler. Mix in one box of powdered sugar. Add pecans and vanilla. Put out into buttered dish. Cut when firm.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Separate rolls. Place in greased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward center. Press. Spoon meat over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes followed by Swiss and Cheddar cheese.* Beat eggs and milk with salt and pepper. Pour on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Onion
instructions: Put flour in 1 turkey size cooking bag and shake until dusted. Clean onions and cut off ends so they will sit level. Put butter on each onion. Sprinkle with mint and salt to taste. Put onions in bag. Punch 10 to 12 holes in top side of bag. Bake at 325\u00b0 until tender. This takes about an hour.

title: 15 Minute Chicken And Rice
instructions: Heat oil in deep skillet add chicken and cook until browned Remove chicken. Add soup water paprika and pepper. Stir. Heat to a boil. Stir in rice and broccoli Place chicken back on top. Season chicken with a little more paprika and pepper. Cover and cook on low heat for 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.

title: Raspberry-Chocolate Cream
instructions: Layer 1/2 of whipped topping 1 Tbsp. syrup and 1/8 of raspberries in each of 4 dessert dishes. Repeat with remaining ingredients.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Put onion and vinegar in blender until fine. Mix all together. Sprinkle with parsley to serve.

title: Sausage Nuggets
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly with hands and form into balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 for about 20 minutes (watch them) or until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. After cool they can be frozen then reheated as needed.

title: Adrienne'S Cole Slaw
instructions: *Substitute You can use already-prepared cabbage; comes in 8 ounce bags.

title: Chicken Hawaiian
instructions: Mix dressing sauce and juice of pineapple to make a sauce. Coat chicken in this sauce; sprinkle garlic salt on the top of each piece. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Put bread in toaster. Put butter on the bread after it is toasted then put sugar-cinnamon on bread.

title: Cream Cheese Fruit Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. To prepare crust in a medium saucepan place 1/4 cup sugar and butter. Heat until butter is melted stirring occasionally. Stir in graham cracker crumbs; press evenly over bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. In a large bowl with a mixer beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in rest of sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time and vanilla until blended. Spoon pie filling evenly over crust. Pour cream cheese mixture over pie filling. Bake just until set 45 to 50 minutes. Cool. Chill until cold about 2 hours. Cut into 24 squares.

title: English Trifle - A Layered Dessert
instructions: Drain all liquid from canned fruit and reserve for use in cake mix as part of the water needed in box recipe. Follow cake directions for sheet cake. Let cool.

title: Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Crush pretzels and set aside. Melt butter in saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar and 1 cup of the crushed pretzels. Pat mixture into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Let crust cool.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Crisp
instructions: Butter an 8 x 8-inch square baking dish. Place sliced apples in dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon salt and water. In a small bowl mix together flour sugar and butter. Drop mixture over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and fill jellyroll pan or pizza pan (may be too much for one pan). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool!

title: Far East Casserole(Vegetable Casserole)
instructions: Cook celery in boiling water for 8 minutes just until slightly crisp. Mix all ingredients together and place in 1 1/2-quart greased casserole.

title: Water Whip Pie Crust
instructions: Mix water shortening and milk. Whip until creamy with a fork or mixer. Mix flour and salt together; add to shortening. Stir until mixed. Roll out to fit pie pan. Bake in hot oven 425\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Stain Remover
instructions: Put in a large bucket using the hottest water available. Stir well. Add stained clothes and leave overnight. Wash as usual in washing machine.

title: Oven Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes and cut into bite-size pieces. Place potatoes and oil in mixing bowl and mix until potatoes are well coated. Add onion soup mix. Mix well. Place potatoes in shallow baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 or 400\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until brown and tender.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix all together and make into a roll. Wrap in foil (shiny side in) and refrigerate 24 hours. Poke holes in bottom of foil and place on rack on broiler pan. Put a little water in broiler pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Unwrap to cool. Slice off and eat.

title: Never Fail Rolls
instructions: Mix Crisco sugar and salt in 1 cup very hot water in large bowl of mixer. Mix yeast in 3/4 cup warm water. Mix with Crisco mixture when it cools to lukewarm. Add beaten eggs and 5 cups flour. Mix well and use dough hook to knead. Add 1 cup flour slowly. Put in large greased bowl; cover and refrigerate overnight. About 3 hours before time to bake roll and cut with biscuit cutter. Brush with melted butter fold and pinch edge together. Place on greased large 14 x 17-inch pan. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 4 to 5 dozen rolls.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Put into loaf pan. Cover with two strips of bacon (if you like that flavor). Pour over all one 8 ounce can of tomato sauce. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Apple Butter Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar and add egg; beat well. Combine milk and soda. Combine flour and spices. Add to cream mixture alternating with buttermilk mixture beginning and ending with flour. Stir in apple butter and nuts.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and debone in small pieces. Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Warm Taco Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese on bottom of an 8 x 10-inch pan. Spread chili then green chilies and chopped onions then salsa and cover with shredded cheese; warm in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Apple-Orange Pinwheel Salad
instructions: Cut unpared apple into wedges. Arrange apple wedges and orange sections in pinwheel design on salad greens. Drizzle Honey Dressing on fruit. Makes 2 servings.

title: Banana Bread Lite
instructions: Mix all wet ingredients then mix in dry. Spray loaf pan with nonstick spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Yield 1 loaf.

title: Japanese Fruitcake Pie
instructions: Mix melted butter and sugar; let cool to room temperature. Add eggs; mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and pour evenly into unbaked pie shells. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Beat cream cheese until blended. Add powdered sugar and blend thoroughly. Spread cream cheese mixture on top of cracker crumbs. Add pineapple on top of cream cheese mixture. Slice bananas on top of pineapple. Top with whipped topping. Decorate with cherries and nuts.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain well. Melt margarine; drizzle a couple of tablespoons of melted margarine over cracker crumbs and mix. Add Velveeta to remaining margarine and melt together while stirring. Pour melted cheese over broccoli in a casserole dish; mix. Sprinkle buttered cracker crumbs over top.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix margarine and sugar; beat until creamy. Add eggs individually. Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with milk to batter. Stir in coconut. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Angel Delight
instructions: Tear angel cakes into bite size pieces. Set aside. Mix together cream cheese 10x sugar and Cool Whip. Stir in angel pieces. Place in Tupperware container. Pour pie filling over top. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients; simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. It can be put directly into refrigerator or canned in glass containers.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar together. Add eggs; beat well. Blend in the dry ingredients. Add carrots nuts and vanilla. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until well done.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl combine flour sugar and cocoa. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Press on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes. In saucepan melt 1 cup chips with sweetened condensed milk and vanilla. Pour over crust. Top with walnuts and remaining chocolate chips. Press down firmly. Bake 20 minutes or until set. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Jello Pies
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar and pineapple juice. Cook a few minutes add Jello. Mix well. Let cool. In a large bowl whip ice cold Pet milk. Add cool Jello mixture. Line pie plates with vanilla wafers stand them around the edges. Pour Jello mixture into pie plates. Put in refrigerator for several hours before serving. Makes two pies.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Mix all ingredients except noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with noodles. Bake 5 to 10 minutes more.

title: Margaret'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and shortening together until smooth. Add eggs. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture blending just until dry ingredients are moistened. Add milk vanilla and lemon flavoring. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Tap pan on flat surface several times to remove air bubbles from batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 275\u00b0 and bake for 2 to 3 hours or until wooden pick inserted comes out clean. Cool in pan for 10 minutes then remove and cool on wire racks. Yields 16 servings.

title: Crispy Peanut Butter Balls(Candy)
instructions: Combine peanut butter marshmallow cream and Rice Krispies (mix until well blended). Shape into small balls and set aside.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim fat from meat; cut into strips. Heat oil in large skillet. Add meat and cook turning often until brown. Stir in water onion garlic salt and ginger. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes. Add peppers (cut into strips) and tomatoes (cut into strips) the last 5 minutes. Blend cornstarch sugar and soy sauce; stir into meat mixture. Stir constantly until thickened. Boil and stir 1 minute. Serve over rice.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Put mixture in an unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and chill. Use Cool Whip on top for serving.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Make jello according to directions. Mix in all ingredients. Let congeal while making sauce.

title: Chicken And Pimento Rice
instructions: Cook rice in broth add cream of chicken soup. Put in baking dish garnish with pimento bits placing boned chicken on top. Pour remaining broth over top if any is left and heat in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Rinse the peas and drain well. Set aside. Peel the potatoes and cut into 1/4-inch cubes. Set aside in cold water. Cut carrots into 1/4-inch dice. Set aside. Heat oil in a kettle and add the sausage pieces. Cook about 1 minute and add the onion and garlic. Cook stirring about 1 minute. Add the carrots. Cook stirring about 2 minutes. Drain the peas and potatoes and add them. Add the chicken broth salt and pepper. Bring to boil and cook about 1 hour and 15 minutes or until peas have become quite liquid. Serve hot.

title: Berlin Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a large skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Crumble bacon. Set aside. In the same skillet cook the onion in reserved drippings until tender. Add spinach. Heat through. In a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish or oval 2-quart dish combine potatoes and dry sauce mix from package. Stir in the boiling water and milk as directed on the package omitting the margarine or butter. Stir in bacon spinach onion mixture and caraway seed. Bake uncovered in a 400\u00b0 oven about 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 2 to 3 minutes more or until melted. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 to 10 servings.

title: Orange Nut Loaf
instructions: Combine baking mix sugar eggs orange rind and juice in a large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 3 minutes. Fold in the nuts. Pour batter into a well-greased 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on a wire rack. Drizzle with Orange Glaze and garnish with orange zest if desired. Slice and serve.

title: Oatmeal Hermits
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients. Mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls on foil-lined cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Let cool then eat.

title: Simple Pizza Dough
instructions: In a small bowl dissolve the yeast and sugar in the lukewarm water. Let rest until foamy about 15 minutes. Mix the flour and salt in a large bowl. Add the olive oil to the yeast mixture. Make a well in the flour and add yeast mixture. Stir to combine. Add extra flour if too sticky. Knead on a floured board or countertop until smooth and elastic adding flour as needed. This should take about 5 minutes. Pat the dough into a ball; put in large bowl and set in a warm place (near oven) covered with a clean towel. Let rise for 1 hour or until doubled in bulk.

title: Blueberry Breakfast Sauce
instructions: In a 2-qt. saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch; gradually stir in water. Add blueberries; bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Serve warm or cold over French toast pancakes or waffles.

title: Lynn'S Skillet Barbecue Chicken
instructions: In large frying pan add ingredients. Cut up one fryer. Set in pan and cook uncovered over medium heat turning to brown evenly. Cook until tender about 35 minutes. Remove chicken to a platter. Skim off oil from sauce. Add 1 cup water. Stir. Serve over chicken.

title: Meat Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in enough boiling water with 2 teaspoons salt; cover and cook for about 5 minutes or until tender-crisp and drain. Add butter syrup marjoram and pinch of salt. In another bowl mix the beef bread crumbs milk eggs salt and pepper. Butter 2-quart casserole and layer the cabbage and meat beginning with cabbage. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until meat is done.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and then add sugar and other ingredients. Heat slowly to melt butter. Cool in an unbaked pie shell at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: 5-Cheese Pie Appetizer
instructions: Place 1/2 of crescent rolls in bottom of ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan; pinch seams together. Layer the cheeses on top in order given.

title: Glazed Ham
instructions: Slice ham in 1/4 inch slices. Layer in a 13 x 9-inch microwave-safe baking dish. Drain juice off of pineapples and cherries in a bowl. Add honey mustard sauce and brown sugar. Mix well. Place pineapple slices on top of ham; put cherries in centers of pineapples. Pour mixture over ham. Bake in microwave until desired tenderness about 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Enchirito Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger. Drain. Add refried beans. Cook until heated. Warm tortillas (until soft enough to fold). Spoon beans and hamburger mixture into middle of tortillas. Fold bottom up and take one slice and roll over to close. Place rolled tortillas in square casserole pan. Pour salsa over tortillas and cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated and cheese is melted.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour oblong pan (13 x 9 x 2-inches) or 2 round layer pans (8-inch or 9 x 1 1/2-inches). Beat all ingredients in large mixing bowl on a low speed scraping bowl constantly for 30 seconds. Beat on high speed scraping bowl occasionally for 3 minutes. Pour into pan(s). Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until wooden toothpick that is inserted into the center comes out clean. Let cake cool. Frost the cake.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute vegetables in margarine. Reduce heat to low. Add process cheese spread and milk. Stir until cheese spread is melted. Stir in macaroni and spoon into 2-quart casserole. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: Cook and stir pepper and onion in hot oil in saucepan until tender but not browned. Add corn salsa and broth; bring to boil. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Add cheese; fluff with fork. Makes 8 servings.

title: Barbecue Brisket
instructions: On the first day marinate brisket overnight in refrigerator in liquid smoke (I like Wrights) Worcestershire sauce garlic onion and celery salt. On the second day do not pour off marinade. Sprinkle with salt pepper brown sugar and sweet pickle juice. Put foil over pan and bake covered at 250\u00b0 for 5 to 6 hours. Cool and refrigerate overnight. On the third day spoon off fat. Remove brisket and slice thinly across grain. Replace in baking pan. Mix flour and barbecue sauce with marinade mixture. Pour over brisket. Cover and bake 1 hour at 250\u00b0. You may wait as many as three days to slice and bake brisket. Freezes well.

title: Quiche Pie
instructions: Fry sausage with onions and bell peppers. Add 1/2 of cheese; let melt. Layer mixture and cheese into pie shells. Pour eggs over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Good hot or cold.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Pour hot milk over sugar shortening and salt in a large bowl. Cool to lukewarm. Blend in 1 cup flour and beat until smooth. Stir in yeast. Add about half the remaining flour and beat until very smooth. Beat in the eggs. Beat in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface.
