Cover and let rest 5 to 10 minutes. Knead dough until smooth and elastic. Form into a ball and put into a greased deep bowl. Turn dough to bring greased surface to the top. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled (about 1 hour). Punch down dough; pull edges to center and turn completely over in bowl. Cover and let rise again until almost doubled (about 45 minutes). Again punch down the dough and turn onto a lightly floured surface. Shape rolls as desired. Place rolls 1-inch apart on lightly greased baking sheets. Cover and let rise again until rolls are light. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Brush with melted butter.

title: Italian Dinner In A Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger onions and peppers. Add cooked noodles and spaghetti sauce.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together last 5 ingredients set aside. Place broccoli on bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish with heads along the edge. Lay chicken on top of broccoli leaving the heads showing. Pour sauce over all. Brown 1/2 cup bread crumbs in 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Looks very pretty when made in glass casserole.

title: Tangy Herb Salad Dressing
instructions: In a jar with lid combine all ingredients. Chill. Shake well before serving. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Refrigerated Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Make potatoes according to directions. Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth. Cool and place in refrigerator for 24 hours. Use within 2 weeks.

title: Pumpkin Bars(Microwave)
instructions: Microwave butter for 30 seconds to melt. Blend in brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Blend in remaining ingredients; mix smooth. Lightly grease bottom only of a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Spread mixture evenly. Microwave for 8 to 9 1/2 minutes at High shielding bars after 4 minutes and turning dish every 2 minutes. Cool. Spread icing on bars and sprinkle on nuts. Makes 24 bars.

title: Garlic Butter
instructions: Peel and crush garlic. Whip into butter or margarine. Add parsley. May be used on vegetables pasta or bread.

title: Lasagne(Made With Uncooked Noodles)
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef and onion. Mix meat with stewed tomatoes tomato paste water sugar parsley flakes and basil. Mix together cottage cheese Parmesan cheese parsley flakes and oregano. Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan 1/2 sauce mixture 1/2 noodles all cottage cheese mixture 1/2 noodles remaining sauce and top all with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered then 15 minutes uncovered. Let stand a few minutes before cutting. Makes 8 servings.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Heat together soup milk cheese celery salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add ham then add mixture to macaroni. Pour into greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts; put in 9 x or 10 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Meatloaf Sause
instructions: Mix all in sausepan Medium heat till all sugar is melted. Enjoy!

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix salad ingredients. Stir in dressing. Store in refrigerator. Better to eat the second day.

title: Ham And Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Melt ham fat and blend in flour pepper and onion. Add milk gradually and cook slowly stirring constantly until sauce thickens slightly. Add potatoes and ham. Stir. Put in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with cheese and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Pecan Brickle Bars
instructions: Stir first three ingredients together and pat with greased spatula in bottom of 9 x 13 greased pan. Then stir last three ingredients together and pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello using 3 cups hot water and 2 cups cold. Let mixture only begin to gel. Chop cranberries orange and apple together in food processor. Add these three chopped fruits to sugar. Let this mixture set 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine 1 cup of the flour and first 7 ingredients. Add rest except nuts and raisins. Beat with electric mixer on low and then on high for 2 minutes. Then add remaining flour. Beat well. Stir in nuts. Pour in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes. Test with toothpick.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all of the above ingredients together in a large bowl. Place mixture in a casserole dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers. Dot with butter or margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Nutritious Poppin Fresh Bars
instructions: Mix together first 9 ingredients; press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Press chocolate bits peanut butter bits and nuts on top. Bake for 17 minutes at 375\u00b0 until edges brown.

title: Holiday Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Place in muffin tins or in large baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 12.

title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
instructions: Chop nuts dates figs cherries raisins and gumdrops. Mix in a large container. Mix cream and marshmallows and let set overnight or warm cream and add marshmallows. Add to fruit and nuts with half of crushed crackers and spices. Mix well. Add the rest of the crackers. This may seem dry but do not add more liquid. Press firmly into a mold or tube pan lined with foil.

title: Breaded Herbed Fish Fillets
instructions: Combine first eight ingredients. Coat fillets with spray; dredge in bread crumb mixture. Place on a broiler pan coated with spray and bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. (225 calories 6.2 grams fat)

title: Best Pound Cake(Low-Fat)
instructions: Blend together with hand mixer liquid Butter Buds sugar Egg Beaters and vanilla. Alternate adding a little flour and then a little milk. Keep alternating until you have added all the flour and milk. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold egg whites into cake mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour in a Bundt pan sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Banana Loaf
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add soda to mashed bananas. Mix all other ingredients. Put into floured loaf pan; let stand 20 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice veggies; brown onion in oil. Add pepper strips and add chicken and vinegar; cook until chicken is cooked. Spread lettuce on the tortilla. Add chicken mixture. Spread with the cheese mixture; add sour cream and salsa. Fold the tortilla over. Eat like a sandwich.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Beat egg and pour into saucepan. Add flour sugar vinegar and pineapple with juice. Cook over medium heat stirring until thick. Put in refrigerator to cool. Meanwhile chop apples (Granny Smith for tartness or Jonathan for color) and do not peel. Fold apples into cooled mixture and add Cool Whip and nuts. Put into serving bowl. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Grape Wine
instructions: Place in big-mouth gallon jar. Cover with cloth and leave until fermented then squeeze through sieve and strain through rag. Takes about 2 1/2 months.

title: Butternut Crunch Candy
instructions: Combine sugar salt water and butter. Heat to boiling. Cook to light crack stage (285\u00b0). Add 1/2 cup nuts. Pour into well-greased cookie sheet. Cool. Spread half of chocolate mixture over top and sprinkle with 1/2 cup walnuts. Cool. Turn over and spread remaining chocolates and sprinkle with remaining nuts. Break into pieces to serve. Makes 2 dozen pieces.

title: Wassail
instructions: *Or mix 1 (12 ounce) can frozen orange juice and pineapple juice with water.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat cheese until creamy and add the remaining ingredients. Shape into a ball and roll in chopped nuts. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix with brown sugar. Mix in eggs. Add flour and vanilla. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Diabetic Pudding
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in blender or beat well. Pour in double boiler and cook until thick. Add chopped bananas or unsweetened pineapple. Blend well. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Southern Sweet Potato Pecan Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease bottom only of 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Stir together flour baking powder salt and spices. Stir in sugar eggs oil and milk. Fold in potatoes nuts and raisins. Pour in pan. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Easy Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in meat loaf pan. Top with ketchup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fresh Sautéed Mixed Squash
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add onion dressing mix salt and garlic powder. Cook 1 minute stirring frequently. Add squash zucchini and mushrooms. Cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring occasionally. Serves 8.

title: Party Appetizer
instructions: Mix in crock-pot until melted. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Crank up oven to 350\u00b0. Dump flour soda salt and cinnamon together in a big bowl. Beat the egg. Stir everything else into flour and mix. Drop on cookie sheet with teaspoon and bake until edges turn brown.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Pour first 4 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil for 2 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; fold in oatmeal and peanut butter quickly or mixture will harden.

title: Moss Cake
instructions: Beat full speed 7 to 8 minutes all ingredients except chocolate; grate the chocolate and fold into batter. Grease pan. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Beat together the above ingredients until well blended. Pour into 3 well-greased pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown hamburg onions green pepper and mushrooms together. Add spaghetti sauce. In a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan layer noodles then sauce mixture Mozzarella cheese cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese two or three times until everything is gone. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 4. You can also throw in pepperoni sausage ham etc.

title: Stuffed Bread
instructions: Cook onion and pepper in small amount of olive oil until tender. Set aside.

title: Lime Jello Punch
instructions: Heat water (not too hot) to dissolve Jell-O and sugar. Slice some lemons for floating in punch and squeeze some for juice. Add juices and ginger ale to Jell-O mixture when ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Pecan Goodies
instructions: Combine chips and peanut butter in double boiler over medium heat. Stir until well blended and melted. Remove from heat and add marshmallows and nuts. Mix well. Spread in buttered 8 x 8 pan. Chill until firm. Cut in 1-inch squares. Store in refrigerator.

title: Vegetarian Pizza
instructions: Cut vegetables into bite size pieces. Steam until crisp-tender. Spread vegetables over boboli shell. Sprinkle with oregano. Arrange sliced tomato over vegetables. Sprinkle with cheese. Slice mushrooms on top. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool slightly. Serve.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Squeeze lemon; add milk pineapple and Cool Whip last. Pour into pie shells and refrigerate.

title: Mackerel
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Make out into patties and fry in hot oil until brown.

title: Spicy Cranberry Cheese
instructions: Combine cranberry sauce and pepper jelly. Stir well. Spoon mixture over cream cheese. Serve with crackers or shortbread cookies. Makes 10 servings.

title: Clam Quiche
instructions: Bake pie shell at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes and remove. Reduce oven to 325\u00b0. Combine bacon chowder eggs onion sour cream flakes and pepper. Pour in shell. Add cheese. Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Wait 20 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Salad Supreme
instructions: Combine chicken grapes and almonds. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice sour cream chutney salt and pepper.\tAdd to chicken mixture and toss well. Cover and chill. Serve on lettuce leaves. Garnish with hard-cooked eggs. Yields about 6 servings.

title: Toffee
instructions: Put ingredients in heavy pan. Cook until 240\u00b0. It will be medium brown color. Do not let it burn; stir constantly. Pour onto waxed paper that has been put onto a cookie sheet. Put chocolate chips on top while still hot. Spread the chocolate out after it has melted. Break into pieces when cool.

title: Strawberry And Cream Roll
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom and sides of 13 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan. Line with waxed paper; grease paper. Beat eggs and sugar in large bowl until thick and triple in volume. Beat in vanilla. Sprinkle flour over top. Fold in until blended. Spread in pan. Bake 13 to 15 minutes until brown. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Sprinkle kitchen towel with confectioners sugar. Invert cake on towel. Peel off paper. Roll up cake and towel from small end. Cake must be room temperature before you unroll and fill.

title: Carrot-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots. Melt oleo; stir in onions chopped fine pepper mustard and celery seeds. Mix well. Cook 5 minutes. Add milk and flour; cook until thick. Put layer of carrots then cheese another layer of carrots and cheese in 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole. Pour sauce over the carrots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Texas Gold Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine cake mix first egg and melted margarine. Press firmly into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pennywise Steaks
instructions: Combine crumbs and milk. Combine all other ingredients; add to crumb mixture and blend. Shape meat in form of T-bone steak. Sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce. Spread with butter lightly (pats). Broil 6 to 10 minutes to desired doneness. Turn and broil other side.

title: Piquant Meat Balls(Makes 60)
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Form into balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown meat and onion in large skillet. Add rest of ingredients; simmer for 5 minutes. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Cover; bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Grilled Tuna Teriyaki
instructions: In a shallow dish large enough to hold the tuna combine soy sauce sherry garlic and ginger. Place tuna in marinade and turn to coat it; cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together flour baking powder and salt. Set aside. Put walnuts into blender; blend for 10 seconds. Put in blender the sugar butter egg bananas and milk. Blend for 15 seconds. Put walnuts in with dry ingredients. Pour ingredients together. Mix until well mixed. Pour batter into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Cool on rack.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar warm milk egg and flour with egg beater or wire whisk. Cook very slowly stirring constantly until it thickens. (I use a small SilverStone frypan to prevent it from sticking.) Cool completely. Cream butter shortening 1/2 teaspoon of milk and vanilla. Beat in cooled cooked mixture. Beat until fluffy about 5 minutes.

title: Asparagus With Sesame Ginger Sauce(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Snap off tough ends of asparagus. Remove scales with a knife if desired. Set aside. Combine sesame seeds and margarine in a small bowl. Microwave mixture uncovered at High about 3 to 6 minutes or until lightly roasted stirring every 30 minutes. Set aside. Combine orange juice and remaining ingredients in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish; stir well. Add asparagus; toss gently. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at High 4 to 6 minutes or until crisp-tender tossing asparagus every 2 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seed mixture. Yield 4 servings (about 37 calories per serving).

title: Celery Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced celery in salted water for 4 minutes. (Do not overcook.) Drain and toss with soup almonds and pimientos. Place in buttered casserole and cover with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes (until crumbs are brown). This is good with chicken.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Bake cornbread mix as directed on package. In large mixing bowl crumble cornbread. Add bread. Chop onion and saute in butter until onions look transparent. Add. Moisten breads with milk. Add eggs salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Add chicken stock a cup at a time until moistened and \goopy\ as you like. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased 2-quart casserole.

title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook mashed potatoes as normal add in ingredients one at a time. Butter a baking dish and pour in ingredients. Add 2 or 3 pats of butter to top. Place in refrigerator for 2 or 3 days. When needed place in oven and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40-60 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Surprise
instructions: Coarsely chop graham crackers and combine with butter and sugar. Press into bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch dish. Combine whipped topping pudding and sour cream. Pour half of the filling over the crust. Slice bananas and layer on top. Pour remaining filling over bananas. Finely chop pecans and sprinkle over top. Chill. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Philly Ham Dip
instructions: Mix well and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetable. Add half of margarine (melted). Place half in casserole. Slice cheese. Put on. Add rest of vegetable. Crush crackers and add rest of margarine. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Licken Pork Chops
instructions: Salt pepper and flour pork chops. Brown lightly in hot oil. Place in crock-pot and pour can of chicken and rice soup (undiluted) over. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or high for 3 to 4 hours. Chops will be very tender.

title: Chili For 100 People
instructions: Saute ground beef onions celery and green pepper until meat is no longer pink. Add chili mix. Add water to thin tomato paste. Make the thickness of chili to personal preference. Simmer several hours.

title: Margarita Pie
instructions: Melt butter in 9-inch pie plate. Add crumbs and sugar; mix well. Press mixture into bottom and sides of pie plate.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and put in casserole dish.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ground beef onion green pepper tomato sauce and eggs. Mix thoroughly. Add enough crackers to absorb the liquid and make the mixture hold its form. Pour into an oblong baking dish. Cover with catsup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Yummy Marshmallows
instructions: Melt caramels milk and butter. Dip marshmallows in mixture. Roll in Rice Krispies. Place on cookie sheet or tray.

title: Grandma'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine peanut butter Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Mix well. Add egg and beat until blended. Combine flour salt and soda and add to creamed mixture. Mix until blended. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes on ungreased baking sheet.

title: Quick Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine Bisquick and sausage. Add cheese (melted) and mix well. Roll into 1-inch balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mahogany Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour cocoa and spices together. Add soda to buttermilk. Add flour and milk to sugar butter and eggs mixture. Add nuts coconut and preserves. Cook in tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Turn off and leave 30 minutes more.

title: Black Forest Trifle
instructions: Bake cake as package directs. Cool and cut in cubes. Prepare pudding as package directs. Arrange one half cake cubes in glass bowl. Layer one half of pudding then one half of cherry pie filling then one half of Cool Whip. Repeat layers in same order.

title: Cobbler Pie
instructions: Melt oleo in casserole dish. Mix sugar flour milk and vanilla. Pour in dish on top of butter. Put drained peaches on top of dough. Pour juice over all. Top with lid. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Bake on a cookie sheet as it runs over some. Easy!

title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and nuts; set aside. In a large bowl beat eggs lightly. Add sugar oil and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients. Stir only until dry ingredients are moist. Spoon batter into well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes before removing out of pan.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain melt oleo add flour and stir 2 minutes. Salt and pepper; stir until combined. Add cheese. Microwave 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken Soup
instructions: In saucepan stir-fry the chicken pieces in the oil until lightly browned. Add onion celery and garlic and cook until crisp-tender. Stir in basil pepper broth and tomatoes. Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in corn and vermicelli. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until vermicelli is tender. If desired garnish each serving with Parmesan cheese.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Blend in flour and seasonings. Add chicken stock. Cook stirring until thickened. Stir in mushroom soup chicken and stuffing. Cook egg noodles according to directions on package. Drain. Combine noodles with chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in order. Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 30 minutes. Turn on broiler for 2 to 3 minutes to brown top. Cool slightly. Cut into squares.

title: Teriyaki Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut round steam in thin strips. Marinate in teriyaki sauce 1 tablespoon of oil and cornstarch for 30minutes. Stir-fry bell peppers and green onions in 1 tablespoon of oil for 3 minutes and remove. Stir-fry beef (1/2 at a time) 2 to 3 minutes. Put all ingredients in pan and cook until hot. Serves 4 (247 calories per serving).

title: Spinach Mushroom Quiche
instructions: Prepare pie crust mix using package directions. Roll dough into 15 x 17-inch rectangle on lightly floured surface. Line 9 x 13-inch baking dish with pastry. Crimp edges with fork; cover. Refrigerate until needed. Saute mushrooms and onions in 2 tablespoons butter in skillet until tender. Remove from heat; stir in spinach. Beat next 4 ingredients with seasonings and 1/4 cup melted butter in bowl. Spoon spinach mixture into crust. Sprinkle with cheese. Pour egg mixture over spinach. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake for 40 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Garnish with carrot strips dried parsley and cherry tomatoes. Makes 6 servings; 596 calories per serving.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine cream cheese and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks. Sift flour 3 times. Add to sugar and magarine mixture. Beat egg whites and fold in. Add vanilla. Pour in Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Custard
instructions: Cream sugar and eggs. Add buttermilk. Add margarine. Put 1/2 of coconut in bottom of each pie crust. Pour batter over coconut and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Holiday Chocolate Turtles
instructions: Melt caramels in cream over low heat; cool abut 5 to 10 minutes. Place nuts on wax paper in groups of three. Spoon caramel mixture over nuts leaving tips showing. Let stand until set (about 1/2 hour). Meanwhile melt chocolate over low heat; cool to lukewarm. Spread cooked chocolate over caramel. (Can be placed in refrigerator to harden.) Yield Approximately 24.

title: Tex Mex Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta drain and rinse with cold water until completely cool. In large salad bowl blend mayonnaise Italian dressing green chilies chili powder and cumin. Toss with pasta and remaining ingredients. Cover and chill. Garnish with additional parsley.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat egg. Add sour cream honey and vanilla. Mash bananas and add to egg mixture. Add nuts. Sift remaining dry ingredients and add to banana mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased loaf pan.

title: Swiss Vegetable Melody
instructions: Combine vegetables soup sour cream pepper pimentos and 1/2 cup cheese. Stir in half the onions and mix well. Pour into an ungreased 1-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining cheese and onions. Return to the oven until cheese is melted about 5 minutes.

title: Nilla Wafer Pudding
instructions: Beat milk and pudding until thick; add Cool Whip and mix thoroughly. Add Eagle Brand milk and banana flavoring. Line bowl with vanilla wafers. Pour pudding over. Repeat with wafers and pudding until bowl is filled. Refrigerate. Kids love this and there are no bananas to turn brown.

title: Bagels
instructions: Combine the yeast and 1 3/4 cup flour then add water sugar and salt to the mixture. Beat at low speed for 1/2 minute constantly scraping the sides of the bowl. Beat at high speed for 3 minutes. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make moderately stiff dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead until smooth. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes. Divide the dough into 12 portions. Shape into smooth balls and punch a hole in the center of each ball with a floured finger. Pull gently to enlarge hole. Keeping uniform shape cover and let rise 20 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon sugar to 1 gallon of water. Bring to a boil. Reduce to simmer. Cook bagels in water 4 or 5 at a time for 7 minutes turning once. Drain on paper towel. Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Secret Strawberry Filled Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directed on package. In small microwave-safe bowl sprinkle gelatin over cold water; let stand 2 minutes. Microwave at High power for 40 seconds; stir well. Let stand 2 minutes or until gelatin is completely dissolved. Cool slightly. In medium bowl stir together yogurt strawberry syrup and gelatin mixture until smooth. Refrigerate until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon. Place cake on serving platter with rounded side down. Cut 1-inch layer with a serrated knife from top of cake. Lift off in one piece. Using serrated knife cut trench in cake 1 inch wide and 1 1/2 inches deep. Leave 1 inch walls on cake. With fork remove cake without breaking through sides or bottom. Spoon strawberry mixture into trench. Put top back on cake. Cover and refrigerate. Make a chocolate syrup topping by mixing whipped cream Hersheys syrup and cream of tartar. Beat until stiff. Cover cake with topping. Refrigerate for 4 hours or until center is set. Keep refrigerated.

title: Wassil
instructions: Place defrosted orange juice and lemonade (un-diluted) in bottom of large percolator. Add sugars ground spices whole cinnamon sticks and whole cloves to basket. Pour apple juice over basket and allow to percolate.

title: Althea'S Italian Delight
instructions: Add to macaroni shells or rice (cooked) brown veggies and beef. Add remaining ingredients. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Uncover last 1/2 hour. Serves 10 hungry adults.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients until smooth. Pour into an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Busy Day Beef
instructions: Put all in crock-pot and cook on low all day (8 hours). Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt together margarine chocolate chips and peanut butter. Pour melted mixture over cereal. Place in large covered container or bag and add confectioners sugar. Shake until fully coated. Store in an airtight container. Yields 7 cups.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Mix salt flour and baking powder. Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Beat egg yolks. Add flour mixture with milk add black walnuts. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in. Bake 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar together until light and fluffy. Add peanut butter vanilla and milk; beat well. Fold whipped topping into peanut butter mixture. Spoon into baked crust and chill.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together well and chill. Serve with sliced apples strawberries or fruit of your choice.

title: Kim'S Quicky Chicky
instructions: In skillet heat 1 tablespoon oil. Add chicken and cook until browned. Add soup 1/2 cup water and veggies. Cover and cook 5 minutes stirring often. Serves 4.

title: Diet Delight Ice Cream
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth. Put in an ice cube tray and freeze. Cut into serving size pieces before it freezes too hard. Remove from freezer and wrap each serving in cling wrap. Return to freezer.

title: Tuna Chip Casserole
instructions: Drain tuna and break into chunks and place in bowl. Stir in soup and milk. Add 3/4 cup crushed potato chips. Mix well. Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining chips over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Cranberry Torte
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Stir in dates nuts cranberries and rind. Combine eggs buttermilk and oil. Add to flour and fruit mixture. Stir until blended. Pour into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Combine 1 cup orange juice and 1 cup sugar. Remove cake from pan. Place on rack. Pour juice over cake at least 3 times. Wrap in heavy foil. Refrigerate 24 hours before serving. Keeps 2 weeks or more.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
instructions: Cook cake as directed in two 8-inch cake pans and cool completely. After cake cools slice the layers. Then mix sour cream coconut and sugar together good and spread between the 4 layers of cake.

title: Fresh Apple Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and cream well. Stir dry ingredients and milk into creamed mixture. Add chopped nuts apples and raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until they spring back to touch. Frost while still warm with confectioners sugar icing.

title: Divinity
instructions: Boil 2 minutes. Add marshmallow cream whipped with mixer. Add pecans.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown beef. Cook macaroni. Cook onion celery and pepper together for 10 minutes. Add tomato sauce to beef; salt and pepper to taste. Add vegetables macaroni along with 2 tablespoons soup and 1/2 of bread crumbs. Brown in slow oven. Remove from oven. Cover with remaining soup and bread crumbs. Return to oven and brown. Can be prepared ahead of time. Improves taste in reheating.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; grate cheese. Add cheese to juice and bring almost to boiling. Take off stove and cool. While that is cooling whip milk in large bowl until peaks form. Mix dry jello and pineapple together. Add cheese/juice mixture mayonnaise and whipped milk and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish. Chill.

title: Easy Italian Casserole
instructions: Cook and stir beef onion and garlic until brown; drain. Stir in sauce mushrooms sugar Italian seasoning salt and pepper. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Reduce heat. Simmer stirring occasionally 10 minutes. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix baking mix milk and egg. Spread half in pan. Top with 4 cheese slices. Spoon beef over cheese. Top with remaining cheese slices; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Drop remaining dough by spoonfuls onto cheese. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Bake until light brown about 20 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Confetti Rice
instructions: Cook rice in stock for 20 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Place in a large serving bowl. Let cool. Add diced vegetables to rice. Add dressing. Stir well. Chill.

title: Persimmon Cake
instructions: Sift all together the flour sugar salt baking powder and baking soda. In a second bowl beat the eggs butter milk and oil. Mix well all ingredients together and put in a baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until knife comes clean.

title: Cranberry Nut Loaf
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Add shortening. Combine orange juice and rind with egg. Pour all at once into dry ingredients. Mix slightly. Carefully fold in cranberries and nuts. Spoon in two greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Combine all ingredients just 1/2 of cheese. Put in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and pat into greased casserole.

title: Poppy Seed Pound Cake Muffins
instructions: In small bowl stir together flour poppy seed salt and baking soda. In a large bowl cream together sugar and butter. Beat in eggs one at a time. Beat in yogurt vanilla and lemon peel. Stir in flour mixture until moistened thoroughly. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet. Drain grease. Add all of the remaining ingredients and cook on low (about 2 or 3 on the stove) for about 45 minutes. Make sure you stir on occasion. Remove the bay leaves before serving.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken and debone or cook chicken pieces. Grease casserole dish. Break chips up in bottom of pan. Pour soup over it. Lay chicken on soup and garnish with olives and jalapenos if desired. Grate cheese on top. Bake at 350 F till the cheese has browned.

title: Yummy French Toast
instructions: In a shallow dish whisk together egg and cinnamon. Dip each side of bread one at a time in egg mixture. In a skillet melt the butter and add your coated bread slices one or two at a time. Cook over medium heat until light brown on both sides. Serve with your favorite syrup.

title: Aunt Alice'S Escalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Saute the onions until tender in the butter. Add 2 cups soft bread crumbs the sugar and salt and pepper. In a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish arrange alternating layers of tomatoes then the bread crumb mixture starting and ending with tomatoes. Combine 1/4 cup crumbs with 1 1/2 teaspoons melted butter and sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Stir in sugar and strawberries. Cool until mixture begins to thicken. Fold in Cool Whip. Cover bottom of 8 x 10-inch pan with half of mixture then layer of cake pieces. Top with remaining mixture. Refrigerate for 4 to 5 hours or until set.

title: Dilly Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Heat cottage cheese to lukewarm. Put cottage cheese in a large mixing bowl along with sugar minced onion butter dill seed salt soda egg and softened yeast. Mix. Slowly stir in flour to form a stiff dough. Let dough rise in a warm place until it has doubled in bulk about 50 to 60 minutes. Stir dough down.

title: Scalloped Eggplant
instructions: Cook diced eggplant in boiling salted water until tender 6 to 7 minutes; drain. Gradually stir milk into soup blend in egg. Add drained eggplant onion and 1/4 cup stuffing; toss lightly to mix. Turn into greased 10 x 6 x 1/2-inch baking dish.

title: Butter Muffins
instructions: Mix butter and sour cream. Add flour. Bake in small muffin tins at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese lemon juice and milk until smooth. Spoon into baked crust and cool for 6 hours.

title: Mama'S Angel Food Cake
instructions: In a large bowl let egg whites warm to room temperature (approximately 1 hour). Meanwhile preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift flour with 3/4 cup sugar; resift 3 more times and set aside. Beat egg whites with salt and cream of tartar at high speed until peaks form. Beat in remaining sugar 1/4 cup at a time beating well after each addition. Continue beating until soft peaks form. With rubber scraper or whisk fold extracts into beaten egg whites. Sift flour mixture 1/4 cup at a time over egg whites. With wire whisk fold each addition with 15 strokes rotating bowl a quarter turn after each addition. Fold an additional 10 strokes. Flour mixture should be blended into egg whites. Gently push batter into ungreased 10-inch tube pan. With spatula or knife cut through batter twice. Bake on lower oven rack for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Allow cake to cool on rack.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken pieces into eggs until well coated. Sprinkle 1/4 cup cornstarch over chicken. Toss until well coated. Melt shortening in medium skillet. Add chicken pieces; cook over medium heat until brown. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.

title: Pumpkin Quick Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside. In a large bowl beat eggs for 2 minutes. Add both sugars. Beat until well combined. Beat in pumpkin butter and juice until blended. Pour batter into prepared pans (4 to 5 mini or one 9 x 5-inch) coated with nonstick spray. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean at 350\u00b0. Bake mini pans 30 minutes; 9 x 5-inch pan 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs and beat. Combine flour soda and salt. Add to cream mixture. Mix well. Stir in vanilla chips and pecans. Spoon onto ungreased pizza pan. Makes two. Dont go all the way to edge of pan with dough. Leave 1-inch hole in center of dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Decorate like the pib cookies at the mall. Makes two cakes.

title: Biscuit Mix
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together in bowl. Cut in shortening. Use as needed. Add enough milk to make a soft dough. Store mix in closed container until needed.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in bowl; blend well. Fold in fruit; spoon into pie shells and chill for several hours.

title: Italian Chicken Diane
instructions: Put more than enough flour in a bowl to coat the chicken breasts. Mix approx. 2 tsp. Italian seasoning into flour. In a separate bowl mix the eggs and milk together. Pour about 1-inch of cooking oil in a skillet and heat to Medium-High. Dip the chicken breast in the egg wash press gently in seasoned flour mixture dip again in egg wash and one last time in flour mixture. Place in hot grease. Once the chicken is very brown on both sides turn down temperature and simmer approx. 10 min. Remove chicken from skillet and drain on paper towels (nobody likes greasy chicken). In the bottom of a 9x18 casserole dish spread a thin layer of spaghetti sauce. Place chicken breasts in casserole dish and cover 1/2 to 3/4 up with spaghetti sauce. Place the mozzarella cheese on top of the chicken and place a little spaghetti sauce on the cheese. Bake covered 45-50 min. on 375\u00b0.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Chill for 2 hours. Serve with corn chips.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken with chicken bouillon garlic powder parsley salt and pepper. Cool and cut up chicken. Cook broccoli and let cool. Mix soup mayonnaise sour cream cheese and lemon juice. Mix this with chicken and broccoli and put into 9 x 13 dish sprayed with Pam. Top with Parmesan cheese paprika and butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Custard Ice Cream
instructions: Heat milk in double boiler. Beat eggs together with salt and sugar mix well. Thin with a little warm milk. Pour mixture into hot milk and cook until mixture coats a spoon. Add vanilla and cool. Add whipping cream just before freezing. Freeze in electric or hand cranked freezer.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until brown; drain. Spread crescent rolls on greased 12-inch pizza pan like a crust. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle hash browns over sausage. Top with cheese (Cheddar and Swiss). Beat eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over pizza. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and vegetable oil. Stir in grated zucchini. Mix in flour and cinnamon. Fold in chopped nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour in loaf pans. Let cool before slicing. Makes 2 or 3 loaves in 4 1/2 x 8 1/2-inch pans.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Mash the cooked squash and season to taste. Add corn meal and onion. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls into deep hot oil. Drain on paper towels.

title: Lemon Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs and add milk butter and lemon peel. Add salt baking powder and sugar and mix well. Add flour and mix only until just blended. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Potato Chowder
instructions: Slice onions and separate into rings. Brown until golden in butter or vegetable oil. Add diced potatoes sliced olives salt and boiling water.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Divan
instructions: In 10 x 6-inch microwave-safe baking dish arrange broccoli. Cover with vented plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 6 minutes rearranging broccoli halfway through cooking. Drain. Top with chicken.

title: Pink Lassies
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender. Cover and process on low until smooth. Serve.

title: Avocado Dip
instructions: Gradually add the smooth avocado to the cream cheese blending until smooth. Add the lemon juice onion salt and Worcestershire sauce and mix well. Serve with chips.

title: Blueberry Gingerbread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together and add wet ingredients. Add tea last. Fold in berries. Use greased floured 9 x 13-inch pan or make into muffins. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (about 20 to 25 minutes less if muffins are made). Use cake tester.

title: Freezer Dessert
instructions: Beat the cream cheese strawberries and sugar together then add the bananas pineapple coconut and pecans. Stir well. Add Cool Whip and mix. Put in container with well fitting lid and put in freezer. Will keep for 2 months.

title: Meat-Cabbage Casserole(Lihakaalilaatikko)
instructions: Cook the cabbage (in enough boiling water to cover) for about 5 minutes or until tender-crisp. Drain. Add the butter syrup salt and marjoram. In another bowl mix the ground beef bread crumbs milk and eggs. Butter a 2-quart casserole and layer the cabbage and meat mixture in it beginning and ending with the cabbage. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1 hour or until the meat is done. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: In a double boiler melt cream cheese and butter. Add crabmeat and seasonings. Serve in a chafing dish with crackers or in small pastry shells.

title: Cheese Nachos
instructions: Spread bean dip lightly on taco chips. Top with cheese. Place 8 to 10 chips at a time on paper plate. Microwave 30 seconds on Power 5 or until cheese begins to melt. Yield 30 pieces.

title: Spanish Noodles
instructions: In large skillet cook 2 slices bacon until crisp; drain. Reserve drippings. Crumble bacon; set aside. Add 1/2 cup chopped onion to reserved drippings in skillet; cook until tender. Add 1 pound ground beef; brown.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill. Serve on lettuce or salad greens if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add onion soup mix tomato paste and sauce water and seasonings. Stir. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Place a layer of meat sauce in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish. Add a layer of cooked noodles Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Add additional layer with final layer of meat sauce on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake for 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chinese Not Fried Rice
instructions: Coat medium saucepan with cooking spray. Place over medium heat until hot. Add onions and saute 2 minutes. Add chicken broth and next 4 ingredients bring to a boil. Stir in rice and simmer 25 minutes. Remove from heat stir in green onion and pine nuts.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Cook 3 minutes on low; will get lumpy and thick but when cools wont be lumpy. Add food coloring. I divided my dough into separate parts then use food coloring and flavoring such as lemon almond etc. Lemon turned out best.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Put into pot the first 8 ingredients and cook about 15 minutes or until tender. Mix flour with small amount of milk then add mixture and rest of milk. Stir until thick then add butter and clams. Do not boil after you add the clams.

title: Red Heart Apples
instructions: Place apple slices in baking dish (may be several slices deep). Sprinkle with red hearts. Cover and bake on High in microwave. Stir after hearts have melted and apples are done. Cooking time is approximately 5 to 6 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup water in a large saucepan. Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups water pudding mix and sugar. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Chill until mixture mounds from spoon. Pour Carnation into ice cube tray or 8-inch metal cake pan. Chill in freezer compartment until sift ice crystals form around edges of tray (10 to 15 minutes). Whip until stiff (about 1 minute). Add lemon juice. Whip very stiff (about 2 minutes longer). Fold into cooled pudding. (If pudding is lumpy beat until smooth.) Spoon into pie shell; swirl top. Chill 2 hours or until firm.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook and drain beef. Mix all ingredients and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Pare core and slice apples. Arrange in a buttered baking pan. Combine dry ingredients and mix well. Cut in the butter and sprinkle mixture over the apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
instructions: Put liquid into bottom of 12 cup percolator. Put sugar and spices in basket or top of percolator. Perk 15 minutes. Add 4 or 5 drops of red food coloring.

title: Salsa
instructions: Prepare tomatoes. Combine all ingredients. Cook to boiling. Pack in half pint jars and process in hot water bath for 15 minutes.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix Miracle Whip macaroni tuna celery green pepper onions and pimiento. Season to taste with salt and pepper; refrigerate. Serve on lettuce. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all together except crust and put in an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Jennifer Vail'S Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Mix onion soup and sour cream together. Bake potatoes for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. When done cut in half and scoop out potato pulp into a bowl. Dump sour cream mixture into bowl and add the margarine. Beat until smooth. Fill up skins. Sprinkle Cheddar on top with bacon bits and chives. Reheat until cheese melts in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Beat mix egg and milk until smooth. Cut apples crosswise in 1/8-inch slices dip in batter. Cook in oil in hot skillet until golden brown turning once. Serve hot with syrup jelly or powdered sugar.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together well. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 425\u00b0 oven. Bake in an 8-inch square or round pan.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in flour sugar and salt until blended. Slowly add milk stirring until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in corn then eggs. Pour into 1-quart greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Combine all and bake in greased Bundt pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hurry-Up Appetizers
instructions: Serve with Bremer crackers or rice crackers.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Melt oleo and combine with graham crackers. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons confectioners sugar. Mix and press in 8 or 9-inch square pan. Whip up Dream Whip. Add 1 cup confectioners sugar to cream cheese. Add this to Dream Whip. Spread over graham crackers mix. Pour cherry pie filling over Dream Whip mixture.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu(Serves 6)
instructions: Roll chicken pieces boned side up on cutting board. Working from center out pound chicken with wooden mallet to 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle with salt. Place 1 ham slice and 1 cheese slice on each cutlet. Tuck in sides of each and roll up tightly then skewer. Coat rolls with flour. Brown\tin margarine and remove to baking pan.

title: Barbecued Turkey Cutlets
instructions: Cut turkey cutlets into 2-inch cubes. Brown in a nonstick skillet sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Remove turkey and place in a large casserole dish. Heat liquid Butter Buds in skillet adding onion and cook for 3 minutes. Add all other ingredients bring to a boil and pour over turkey chunks. Cover and bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until turkey falls apart in shreds when probed with a fork. Serve over steamed rice or as sandwiches on toasted buns. Serves 8.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Put bread cubes on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan casserole dish. Crumble sausage over bread then cheese. Mix eggs milk salt and dry mustard together; pour over cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes onion and celery together. Melt oleo and add flour pepper meat sauce Worcestershire sauce and salt. Cook until thick. Add milk and Velveeta cheese; add tomatoes and corn. Add potatoes onion and celery. Simmer on low-medium until hot.

title: Aunt Nellie'S Salad
instructions: Combine cottage cheese lemon jello and boiling water. Let cool. When thickened but not set whip until fluffy. Fold in remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Zucchini Puffs
instructions: Put zucchini in casserole. Mix onion and grated cheese together. Mix oil and eggs together add Bisquick. Mix oil mixture and cheese mixture together and season it. Then put it into the zucchini and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until puffy and brown.

title: Foamy Lime Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid water sugar and pineapple juice. Chill. To serve combine chilled mixture and ginger ale in a punch bowl. Drop sherbet by scoops into punch.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all together. Store in a container. Use 1/4 cup mix to 1 cup hot water. Enjoy!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to directions. Do same with the broccoli. Mix all ingredients together and place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Herbed Popovers(Makes 12 Muffins)
instructions: Butter 12 muffin tins or spray them with a vegetable oil spray. In a large mixing bowl whisk the egg whites with the milk and margarine until frothy. Beat in the flour herbs and Parmesan cheese and allow the batter to sit for 5 minutes. Divide the batter among the prepared muffin tins and place in the center of a preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes then reduce the heat to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake for 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Ranch-Style Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat and onion in oil. Mix with remaining ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Sift together the peanut butter and margarine. Gradually add sugar stirring until combined. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on waxed paper; let stand until dry (about 20 minutes). Melt confectioners coating; cool slightly. Dip balls into melted coating. Let excess drip off. Place on waxed paper. Let stand until coating is dry. Makes about 30 pieces.

title: Cornbread Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat soup; cook onion in oleo until tender. Add to soup mixture. Add salt. Cook chicken until tender cool and cut into cubes. Pour soup mixture in baking dish; sprinkle cubed chicken over top. Mix cornbread according to directions on package. Spoon cornbread over top of soup and chicken mixture covering entire top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until cornbread is done. Serve hot.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine onion vinegar sugar celery seed and mustard seed. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. In a separate bowl combine corn pickle relish pimento and celery. Pour hot vinegar mixture over corn mixture and mix well. Allow to cool. Chill 24 hours to allow flavors to blend. The next day fill small glass jars with mixture. Share with friends. Store in refrigerator. Keeps about 1 month.

title: Cha Cha Chili Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine first 5 ingredients. Toss lightly. In a small bowl whisk together all remaining ingredients. Pour over salad mixture and toss lightly. Let it stand at least 4 hours before serving. Serve at room temperature.

title: Baked Apple Pudding
instructions: Combine margarine sugar and egg in mixer; beat until light. Gradually blend in combined flour baking soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Stir in vanilla apples and walnuts. Turn mixture into an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done. Serve warm or with Cool Whip. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Overnight Eggs
instructions: Brown sausage; drain and spread over bread cubes in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat eggs milk salt and mustard; pour over sausage. Sprinkle cheese over top. May refrigerate overnight and bake in the morning at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Shepard'S Pie
instructions: 1. Brown hamburger in skillet. Add seasoning to taste. 2. Add onion soup and water (I usually use the water I cooked the potatoes in). Add dissolved bouillon add flour water until gravy thickens. 3. Put in baking dish. Top with mashed potatoes and cheese then bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Prepare broccoli according to directions (no salt however). Drain well reserving 1/2 to 3/4 cup of the liquid. Stir into the broccoli the reserved liquid the cheese and 1/2 stick of margarine until all is melted and combined. Pour into an ungreased casserole. Crumble the crackers; stir in the other 1/2 stick of margarine melted. Sprinkle crumbs on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and browned lightly.

title: Mom'S Swiss Cheese Bread
instructions: Slice bread. Then put a slice of Swiss cheese between each piece. Add mustard to butter. Pour over bread. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted and top of bread is brown. Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and shortening well. Add water and knead lightly. Roll out lightly. Makes one crust.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and oil. Add pumpkin water salt cinnamon baking soda and flour. Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Makes 3 loaves or one 9 x 13-inch.

title: Cheese Blintzes
instructions: Blend together cheese egg yolk vanilla and 2 tablespoons sugar. Spread mixture on bread one piece at a time and roll up bread. Roll bread rolls in melted butter. Then roll bread rolls in a mixture of one cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Freeze until ready to serve.

title: Bisquick Banana Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat until well blended. Pour into paper lined muffin tins. Bake at 300\u00b0 until light brown. Dont over cook. Makes 14 medium sized muffins.

title: Chicken Bake
instructions: Mix raw rice with 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can water and package onion soup mix in a bowl; let set at least 1/2 hour. Transfer mixture into large cake pan; place pieces of chicken on top. Brush with melted butter; salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours depending on chicken. If rice appears dry before chicken is done add a little water. Serve with a salad for a tasty meal!

title: E-Z Lasagne
instructions: Spread one cup of spaghetti sauce in bottom of lasagne pan press first layer of uncooked noodles into the sauce. Top with a portion of each of the cheeses and about 1 cup of sauce. Repeat layering until cheese is used. Top with remaining sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Allow to stand 15 minutes before cutting into squares for serving. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Oyster Nips
instructions: Mix dill weed dressing garlic powder and oil. Put crackers in a bowl or pan. Pour mixture over crackers. Stir together well and let set covered 1 hour. Stir before serving.

title: Creme Brulee* * * * *
instructions: The Asparagus Tenderloin is another pleasing dish. It is easy to do and different. Creme Brulee is a traditional French dessert. This recipe came from a wonderful restaurant on Stanislas Square in Nancy France. I have tried putting sugar on the Creme and broiling it but the easiest way is to use a blow torch. Thats right. Just put the sugar on the creme and caramelize with the blow torch. Julia Child did it on T. V.

title: Rich Fruit Pie
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Line the dish with 1 stick of butter and graham crackers. Beat eggs and 2 sticks of butter together; spread over the graham crackers. Cut the bananas in slices. Layer all the remaining ingredients (except Cool Whip) until all are used up. Put the Cool Whip on top.

title: Spaghetti Squash With Garlic Sage Cream Sauce
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise; remove seeds. Place face down in baking dish with about 1 inch of water. Cook squash in oven until it can be easily pierced with a fork. Scrape inside of squash into a serving bowl.

title: Husband'S Delight
instructions: Cook noodles until almost done. Drain and add cold water to prevent further cooking. Set aside. Brown meat and drain. Add tomato sauce and spices. Simmer 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Put the meal in a small bowl and\tgrate the onion directly into it.\tAdd milk a little at a time stirring constantly until the batter is moist yet stiff enough to hold shape when\tformed\tor when dropped with a spoon into hot oil. Drop into hot oil and fry at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until brown. Turn once. Makes 3 or 4 servings.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Take a small bun and put a slice of American cheese in middle; microwave on High 10 to 15 seconds until cheese melts.

title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Fold into each pie crust; top each pie with 1/2 can of strawberry pie filling. Top each pie with 1/2 container of Cool Whip. Chill 3 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans; rinse and drain again. Combine all ingredients. Add mayonnaise to your taste.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Remove chicken from bone. Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Put cheese on top pour diluted soup over the chicken. Cook stuffing according\tto directions\ton package. Place on top of soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 30 minutes. Bake 15 minutes longer without cover.

title: Crab Stew
instructions: Pick crabmeat to remove any broken shells. Combine all ingredients and cook over very low heat stirring occasionally for one hour.

title: Copper Penny Salad(Diet Version)
instructions: Cook carrots; cut into small chunks. Combine onions and peppers. Bring remainder of ingredients to boil. Combine with rest of ingredients. Let set a few hours in refrigerator.

title: Italian Butterfly Pork Chops
instructions: Cut pork chop down the center to butterfly open. Set oven at 350\u00b0. Brown chop on both sides. Put half and half cream in a saucepan (enough to cover the bottom). Add 1/8 stick of butter a little salt and a little garlic powder. Place on a very very low fire. When pork chop is brown on both sides place a slice of Mozzarella cheese on each side. Replace in oven to melt down. Pull out and put ham stuffing in the center of the pork chop and close the pork chop. Put another slice of Mozzarella cheese over pork chop. Let this melt down also. Raise a fire a little on the saucepan. Add Parmesan cheese to sauce; stir until creamy. When pork chop is ready (after cheese melts down) pour sauce over the pork chop and serve. Enjoy!

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake for 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Top with cheese and bake another 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid water sugar pineapple juice and lemon juice. Freeze in gallon jugs. Take out of jugs frozen and pour ginger ale over it. Ready to serve.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat until fluffy. Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Add 1 cup to chopped fruits and nuts. Mix juice and seasoning and add alternately with flour mixture to shortening mixture. Fold in floured fruit and nuts; mix well.

title: Blt Dip
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Crush bacon. Mix all ingredients together. Best if made the day before. Then use the plain Melba rounds to dip.

title: Antipasto Salad
instructions: Cook pasta as directed drain rinse with cold water drain well. In bowl combine pasta and remaining ingredients. Stir gently cover and refrigerate. Serves 12.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let simmer 1/2 hour. The longer the better. Serve with tortilla chips. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken & Noodles
instructions: Cook chicken debone and cut in small pieces. Set aside.

title: Chip Dip
instructions: With cream cheese at room temperature blend in horseradish. Add milk a little at a time to get the consistency for dip. Add the smoked chipped beef that is chopped in small pieces. Serve with chips.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add eggs orange juice and rinds (which have been mixed together). Do not stir too much. Fold in 1 cup chopped cranberries and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Spoon into well-greased pans making edge higher than center. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Edible Finger Paints(Gelatin Paint)
instructions: Supervise as you have children follow these steps Wet finger paint paper on the glossy side. Sprinkle 2 to 3 tablespoons of dry gelatin on the wet paper. Use as a finger paint.

title: Baked Ham
instructions: Mix items in pot or bowl. Place cloves (whole) in cooked ham. Put 1/2 of syrup with ham in oven for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Later put rest of syrup. Put back in oven for 20 minutes. Take out and place cherries onto ham with a toothpick and sliced pineapple at the same time. Then put into oven for 15 minutes more.

title: Ultrasmooth Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate bits and butter in top of a double boiler. Add condensed milk and cook. Stir constantly for 4 minutes; remove from heat. Add Marshmallow Fluff; stir well. Add miniature marshmallows and nuts. Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan. Chill well before serving.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour baking powder and salt. Alternate with milk and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Big Batch Cookies
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a bowl; beat with electric mixer until blended. Add sugars and mix well. Combine flour soda and salt and add to sugar mixture beating until well blended. Stir in cereal and remaining ingredients. Drop by level tablespoons on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 9 dozen.

title: Apple Pancakes
instructions: Sift the flour and salt into a bowl. Beat the egg and milk into the flour to make a batter. Peel core and slice the apples. Put them in a pan with water and simmer for five minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook all until vegetables are mushie (45 minutes). Mash with potato masher. Add 10 ounces light Velveeta cheese. Heat only until melted.

title: Pinwheels
instructions: Mix cream cheese dressing mix and green onions and spread over tortillas. (Put in microwave to soften tortillas.) Sprinkle remaining ingredients and roll up. Chill for 2 hours. Cut in 1-inch slices. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Can be prepared a day ahead. Will taste even better.

title: Hawaiian Sangria
instructions: Combine all frozen juices in large pitcher. Stir in wine until blended. Add ice lime and lemon slices. Stir in club soda to serve. Makes approximately 20 servings.

title: Famous Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine cornstarch sugar lemon juice and lemon rind. Beat egg yolks; add to cornstarch mixture. Gradually add boiling water. Heat to boiling over direct heat and then boil gently for 4 minutes stirring constantly. Pour into pie shell.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix vegetables cheese sour cream and soup in casserole dish. Prepare topping of cheese crackers 1/2 stick of melted butter and almonds. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese together; add vanilla. Mix Jell-O with 1 cup hot water and mix with cheese mixture. Whip the cream (Pet milk chilled thoroughly) until stiff and fold into cooled cheese mixture.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Boil together and cool the sugar and vinegar. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour syrup over mixture. Then cover and let sit overnight to season.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients together. Then mix in all the rest until all blended. Pour batter into a greased Bundt pan (floured) for 10 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Candy
instructions: Heat in pot until melted and pour in pan. Cut in squares and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Potatoes Supreme
instructions: Defrost potatoes and combine in a large bowl with butter. Add rest of ingredients except buttered bread crumbs. Put in 3-quart buttered casserole. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Combine flour and chili powder; dredge chicken in flour mixture and brown in hot oil in electric skillet. Remove chicken from skillet. Add onion green pepper and garlic to skillet; saute until tender. Stir in rice tomatoes and water. Arrange chicken over rice and vegetables. Cover and simmer 35 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. If necessary stir in one to two tablespoons of sour cream until frosting is of spreading consistency.

title: Mustard Relish
instructions: Boil the first 7 ingredients. Mix the water and flour and make a paste (no lumps). Pour paste mixture into first mixture and bring to a boil then pour into warm jars and seal. Makes 6 to 7 pints.

title: Corn Pone Special (Cornbread)
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except butter.

title: Country Sausage Muffins
instructions: Brown sausage stirring to crumble. Drain well reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Combine flour cornmeal sausage and pimiento. Add reserved drippings onion dip and milk. Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 1 dozen muffins.

title: Homemade Fresh Vegetable Mix For Soup
instructions: Wash core and peel. May be frozen whole or cut in pieces. Pack in wide mouth jars to within 1 inch of top. Put on cap. Screw band tight and freeze. Tomatoes that are frozen are to be used only as cooking or seasoning tomatoes as they will not be solid when thawed.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Butter a baking dish and spread out the sliced apples. Sprinkle on cinnamon salt and water. Rub between fingers until crumbly flour sugar and butter. Sprinkle on top and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into muffin pans (greased). Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Paste
instructions: Sift flour and alum until smooth using the cold water. Add boiling water stirring thoroughly. Strain so as to remove lumps. Boil mixture until it is like starch. Remove from stove; add oil of cloves then put into small jars.

title: Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Beat egg yolks 5 minutes. Add water. Cook in double boiler and keep on beating egg yolks. Add cold butter in little lumps beating continuously. When sauce is thick add lemon juice salt and pepper to taste.

title: Rhubarb Shortcake
instructions: Cut enough rhubarb into fine pieces to fill a 9 x 13-inch pan about half full. Sprinkle the 1 cup sugar and marshmallows over it. Sift the flour baking powder salt and 1 cup sugar. Add to this the milk soft butter eggs and vanilla. Beat for 1 minute and spread over the rhubarb. Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Test with toothpick for doneness. I have used peaches and apples instead of rhubarb.

title: Chicken Dip
instructions: Melt cream cheese in a double boiler. Add soup almonds mushrooms and chicken. Mix all thoroughly and add seasoning to taste. Can be served as a dip over toast or in pastry shells as a main dish. Will serve about 20 if used as a dip.

title: Grilled Peaches On The Half Shell
instructions: Wash and halve ripe peaches; remove pits and place each peach half flat side up in center of a square piece of doubled aluminum foil. Fill cavity of each peach half with fresh or frozen raspberries or blueberries. Sprinkle with 2 teaspoons brown sugar and 1 teaspoon lemon juice. Wrap in foil. Grill approximately 15 to 20 minutes over hot flame turning once. One peach equals one serving with 80 calories and 0 grams fat per serving.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together hash browns chicken and 1/2 cup butter. Add onion and sour cream and stir. Add cheese on top or mix in the casserole. Stir cornflakes in 1/4 cup melted butter and put on top of casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Christmas Popcorn Snowball
instructions: In greased large kettle toss popped popcorn with cherries until well mixed. In medium saucepan over medium-high heat corn syrup vinegar and salt until the mixture boils stirring occasionally. Set candy thermometer in place and continue cooking without stirring until temperature reaches 250\u00b0 or until a small amount dropped into very cold water forms a hard ball. Remove syrup from heat; stir in vanilla. Slowly pour syrup on the popcorn balls. Makes 12 balls.

title: Mark'S Secret Crab Casserole
instructions: Put noodles in casserole dish. Heat milk cream of shrimp soup mayo and cheese until cheese is melted. Add crab into soup mixture. Mix with noodles in casserole dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until noodles are tender stirring a couple of times.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: *Use two cans of chicken broth from cooked whole (deboned) chicken.

title: Lauree'S Pesto Sauce
instructions: Put basil leaves into a processor and blend to a fine paste. Add garlic pine nuts and cheese. Scrape down sides of bowl as necessary.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Place broccoli onion raisins and bacon in bowl; mix salad dressing vinegar and sugar. Pour over broccoli mix and toss.

title: Judy'S Caramel Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 1/3 cup evaporated milk with a spoon. Press 1/2 of the mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Do not overbake. It will be soft. Melt caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in microwave or on stove being careful not to scorch.

title: Secret Kiss Cookies
instructions: Beat butter sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add flour and nuts. Blend and chill. Unwrap kisses and use 1 tablespoon dough to completely cover the kiss. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: City And Country Casserole
instructions: Place 8 slices buttered bread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Put slices of ham and cheese on each and cover with remaining 8 slices of buttered bread (butter side down). Mix eggs milk and seasonings. Pour over top and let soak overnight. Before baking mix butter and corn flakes. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Foreshmak(Hot Appetizer)
instructions: Saute meat and onion. Grind meat onion herring potato and butter through meat grinder. Add 3 yolks sour cream and cheese. Beat the egg whites until foamy. Gradually fold into the meat. Grease the Pyrex. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Snickers Bars
instructions: Melt together 6 ounces chocolate chips 1/4 cup butter scotch chips and 1/4 cup peanut butter. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan let cool. In saucepan combine sugar milk and oleo; boil 5 minutes. Cool and add 1/4 cup peanut butter vanilla marshmallow creme and chopped peanuts. Mix and spread over chocolate layer; cool.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Instant Pudding)
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter then sugars vanilla and pudding mix in large mixer bowl; beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture then stir in chocolate chips and nuts. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by rounded tablespoons about 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

title: Scripture Cake(Look Up The References In The Old Testament)
instructions: Cream butter add sugar gradually beating until light. Add egg yolks one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Beat in honey. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with the milk beating only until smooth. Stir in nuts and fruits. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan lined on bottom with waxed paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 in preheated oven 1 hour or until done. Cool cake in pan 5 to 10 minutes turn out on rack and peel off paper. Turn right side up to cool.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees 325 for glass. In 13 x 9 pan melt margarine. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs evenly over bottom of pan. Pour sweetened condensed milk over graham cracker crumbs and sprinkle with chocolate chips coconut and walnuts. Press down firmly with a spatula. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and chill thoroughly. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Yummy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter or margarine and sugars until smooth; beat in eggs and vanilla. Combine and blend thoroughly flour cinnamon baking soda and salt; beat into creamed mixture. Stir in oatmeal and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 14 minutes. Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Pickles & Peanuts
instructions: Whip together and put in container and refrigerate. Serve with crackers. Can be made 3 days ahead. Crazy but good!!

title: Microwave Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine corn milk egg and onion salt in 1 quart casserole. Combine corn flakes crumbs and cheese. Spread over corn mixture.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown onion in fat. Add meat and seasonings. Brown. Add remaining ingredients and simmer. Put in casserole. Mash potatoes. Add hot milk and egg. Drop in mounds over top of casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Rocky Road S'More Bars
instructions: Beat margarine and brown sugar until fluffy. Add combined flour and crumbs. Mix well. Press onto bottom of greased 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Cheesy Vegetables
instructions: Cook and drain mixed vegetables per instructions on bag. Add salsa to cheese mixture and stir. Serve hot.

title: Fig Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Gradually add eggs and preserves. Sift together flour and spices soda and salt. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk. Add nuts. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and beat. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add bananas nut meats and vanilla. Mix. Bake in loaf pan 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
instructions: Put 1/2 potatoes in pan. Add 1/2 ham. Sprinkle 1/2 onions over. Add 1/2 butter. Sprinkle 1/2 flour over all. Add 1/2 cheese. Repeat process. Pour milk in pan until you can see it halfway up the pan. Cover. Bake on 425\u00b0 until done (about 1 hour).

title: Corn Light Bread
instructions: Melt shortening in loaf pan. Mix excess with remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blue Cheese And Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix well. Shape into Christmas tree cover with pecan halves.

title: Mom'S Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter with brown sugar. Add water and honey. Stir and boil until you can make a little ball in cold water.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients for cake (flour eggs sugar soda pineapple vanilla and nuts) and spread on greased cookie sheet pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
instructions: Lightly freeze steak so it will slice easily. Cut steak into thin strips. Heat oil in a large skillet (electric is fine) and add garlic salt ginger and pepper. Saute until garlic is golden. Add steak and brown lightly.

title: Chicken Wild Rice Casserole(Serves 8)
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions. Cook onion in butter until tender but not brown. Remove from heat and stir in flour. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid. Add enough chicken broth to liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups. Gradually stir into flour mixture. Add cream; cook and stir until thick. Add rice mushrooms chicken pimento parsley salt and pepper. Put into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle top with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be made the day before refrigerated then baked just before serving but will take longer to bake.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together in casserole. On top of this lay several pieces of chicken according to the size of your family. Brush chicken with butter salt pepper and paprika. Bake 2 1/2 hours or 3 hours (depending on amount) at 275\u00b0.

title: No Fool Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in an 8 x 10-inch pan. Pour batter mixture over melted margarine then sprinkle fruit. Cook at 350\u00b0 until golden brown about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in crock-pot. Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded cheese on top. You can also sprinkle 1 teaspoon of paprika on top. Turn on high heat until bubbling then reduce heat to low for 3 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine and peanut butter in saucepan over medium heat. Remove from heat; add other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into pan. Set in refrigerator until set. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Lemon Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water. Add frozen lemonade and stir until dissolved. Refrigerate for exactly 20 minutes (no more no less). Remove from refrigerator and beat in Cool Whip. Pour into large mold or bowl. The jello will separate into 2 layers.

title: Garden Patch Barbecue Sauce
