instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender until raisins are pulverized. Remove and place in a saucepan. Simmer on top of stove for about 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 2 cups. Great for pork!

title: Sausage And Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Fry sausage. When done combine each in pot. Crumble sausage in rice. Mix well. Use tomatoes as garnish on top. Recipe serves 3; can easily be doubled.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Stir ingredients until crumbly. Cover bottom of a greased casserole with 6 large apples sliced. Spread crumbly mixture over top. Melt 1/4 cup margarine; drizzle over crumbs. Bake in a preheated oven about 40 minutes.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise. Cut each half into 7 pieces. Grease a Bundt pan. Toss generous amount of chopped nuts in bottom. Place cut dough into pan. Sprinkle dough with cinnamon. Sprinkle 1/2 package pudding on top. Melt butter. Add both sugars. Pour over dough. Add more nuts. Cover with towel. Let rise overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Beer Bread
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in a large bowl gradually adding beer and stirring just until moistened. Spoon mixture into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until loaf tests done. Brush top with margarine. Cool loaf in pan for 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack. Slice with electric knife. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Plum Torte
instructions: Note Blueberries sliced peeled peaches apples or combinations may be used on top.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring to a rolling boil margarine sugar cocoa and milk. Remove from heat and add peanut butter rolled oats and vanilla. Dip out with spoon or melon ball dipper. Drop on wax paper sheet. Let cool.

title: Alabama Cocoa Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour cocoa and salt in small bowl; set aside. Combine the eggs dark corn syrup cream melted butter and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Add the dry ingredients stirring until smooth. Stir in pecans. Pour into 9-inch pastry lined pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes until center is firm to the touch. Cool. To serve garnish with whipped cream mound and top with pecans.

title: Chicken Broccoli Vegetable
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in 1 tablespoon hot butter cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove chicken. Keep warm. In same skillet in remaining butter cook broccoli carrots and mushrooms 5 minutes stirring often. Stir in soup milk and pepper. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes or until done. Serve over rice.

title: Dijon Pork Chops
instructions: Mix mustard and milk. Dip chops to coat both sides. Mix breadcrumbs and spices and coat chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat margarine in 2 quart saucepan until melted. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until bubbly. Remove from heat; stir in milk and broth. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir for 1 minute. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 2 quart casserole dish (10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch). Bake uncovered 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pizza Wheels
instructions: Combine the basil and oregano with tomato sauce. Spread sauce on toasted muffins and sprinkle on cheese. Drizzle on oil and place muffins on cookie sheet. Broil until cheese melts. Top with sliced olives chopped green peppers or chopped green onions if desired. Serves 3.

title: Nut Torte(Serves 8)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat the egg yolks in a mixer until thick and light. Then beat in the sugar. When it forms a ribbon stir in the flour salt baking powder orange juice (or Jamacian rum) and the chopped nuts. Beat the egg whites until stiff. Fold them in. Pour into two 8-inch layer cake pans which have been greased and lined with greased wax paper. Bake for 25 minutes or until a cake tester comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes on a wire rack. Remove from the pans. Before serving put the layers together with whipped cream flavored with the grated orange rind.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar cooked carrots oil baking powder cinnamon and eggs in a mixing bowl. Beat well. Add nuts/and or raisins. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Peel and core tomatoes. Add all ingredients. Cook on top of stove in heavy boiler until thick. Stir constantly. Can in jars. Try this on tacos.

title: Seafood Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Melt butter. Add bread crumbs and mix. Add mushroom stems seasonings and seafood. Stuff caps with mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add rest of ingredients folding in chocolate chips and grated chocolate bar last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Ice Cream
instructions: In saucepan combine rhubarb 3/4 cup sugar and water. Cook covered for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender. Cool slightly. Add lemon juice salt and coloring. Pour into 8-cup freezer container. Freeze firm. Break into chunks. Place in chilled bowl and beat smooth with electric beater. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating to stiff peaks. Fold whipping cream into rhubarb mixture along with egg mixture. Freeze firm. Makes 1/2 gallon.

title: Okra And Tomato Gumbo
instructions: Cut okra and cook with chopped onions in a little fat until tender. Then add a pint of whole tomatoes a little sugar salt and pepper. Cook until thick. Delicious.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: *Can be substituted with low-cal or low-fat; still just as good.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese and taco mix. Press on 8-inch plate. Spread salsa over mixture. Chop tomatoes onion and black olives and layer over cheese and salsa mixture. Chill 5 to 7 hours. Surround with chips.

title: Spiced Orange Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in an airtight container. To make one cup put spiced-orange tea mix in a cup of boiling water and stir until dissolved. Can be iced. Serves 40.

title: Tuna, Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli celery and mushrooms together until tender then drain. In large glass bowl mix soup and tuna first then add all other ingredients. Mix well with spoon. Microwave on High for 4 minutes then stir. Microwave for another 3 to 4 minutes until all is hot.

title: Cream Of Carrot Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy bottomed saucepan. Add flour and stir until well blended. Gradually add milk and stir constantly until thick. Add carrots and broth. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve hot sprinkled with parsley.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients thoroughly. Fold crabmeat and 3/4 cup of cheese into mixture. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Cheese-Chive Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt with fork. Cut in shortening. Stir in cheese and chives. Mix and turn onto lightly floured board. Roll and cut in small size biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes. Brush with melted butter before or after baking.

title: Broccoli
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add broccoli and cook until tender. Add soup cheese Accent mushrooms and 3/4 c. almonds. Pour into casserole then sprinkle reserved almonds and bread crumbs on top. Bake at 325 degrees until bubbly.

title: Hamburger Noodle Bake
instructions: Brown meat. Mix garlic salt pepper sugar and tomato sauce. Add to meat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Chop onions and tops; mix with cream cheese and sour cream. Cook noodles according to directions. Drain. Layer noodles in lightly greased casserole dish with onion cheese and sour cream mix and meat sauce. Repeat. Add grated cheese to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Hamburg Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburg and onion together. Drain. Cook macaroni and cheese according to directions. Mix hamburg onion soup mushrooms and milk into macaroni. Bake in a large casserole dish for 20 minutes or until heated through in a 375\u00b0 oven. No need to grease casserole dish.

title: Chicken And Biscuits(Serves 6)
instructions: In 3-quart oblong baking dish combine soup milk thyme and pepper. Stir in vegetables and chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble. Meanwhile cut each biscuit into quarters. Arrange biscuit on chicken mixture. Bake 15 minutes or until biscuits are golden.

title: Creamy Tuna Deluxe
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed on package except use 3/4 cup of milk. Saute onion and green pepper in margarine. Add to dinner with remaining ingredients. Mix well. Heat thoroughly stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: In double boiler melt chocolate and butter. In separate bowl combine flour and baking powder. In another bowl beat 2 eggs 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla and 3/4 cup sugar with electric mixer until thick.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Put cloves and cinnamon in cloth bag. Drop into hot water sugar and juices. Simmer 15 minutes. Add tea bags (number depends on desired strength). Simmer 5 minutes longer. Store in refrigerator and reheat as needed. Never boil.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: Pour peaches with juice into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over it. Add nuts and slice oleo and put it over top of nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in 9 x 9-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 until cake pulls away from sides of pan or test with toothpick.

title: Egg-Spinach Casserole
instructions: Thaw spinach and put in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan. Put mushrooms on top of spinach and then crumble croutons and sprinkle on top of mushrooms. Beat eggs and spices and pour over top. Pour milk over top and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: White Trash
instructions: Melt chocolate; stir in peanut butter and peanuts. Mix with Crispix in large bowl until well coated. In a Ziploc bag add cereal to confectioners sugar; coat well.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Layer as in order listed. Can be made up the night before. Add dressing just before serving and mix well.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage with water in covered frying pan until tender approximately 20 minutes. Remove sausage and cook green pepper and onion for 5 minutes then add the condensed tomato soup and heat through. Combine sauce with macaroni and mix well. Place in casserole with sausage arranged on top. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Broccoli With Lemon Butter
instructions: Thaw shrimp; pat dry on paper towels. In a 10-inch skillet heat half of the butter or margarine over medium-high heat. Add broccoli and celery. Cook for 3 or 4 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender stirring often. Remove from the skillet. Keep warm. In the same skillet heat remaining butter or margarine over medium heat. Add shrimp; cook about 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink stirring often. Return vegetable mixture to the skillet. Stir in lemon juice and sesame seed. Can be served over rice if desired.

title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water; cool. Grease and flour two 9-inch round pans. Sift flour soda and salt together. Beat butter until soft in large bowl. Add brown sugar and eggs; beat at high speed for 5 minutes. Beat in vanilla and cooled melted chocolate. Stir in dry ingredients alternately with sour cream beating well with a wooden spoon after each addition until batter is smooth. Stir in boiling water. Pour at once into prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Raw Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together well. Chill several hours. Serve with assorted raw vegetables (carrots celery green onions broccoli cucumbers cherry tomatoes cauliflower or whatever your favorite veggie is).

title: Squash Puppies
instructions: Mix and drop in hot oil by spoonfuls. Cook until brown.

title: Arroz Con Pollo(Chicken And Rice - Spanish)
instructions: Rub chicken with oregano mixture. Brown chicken in lard. Reduce heat to moderate fire and add onions and green pepper; cook for 10 minutes. Add tomato sauce and olives and cook for 10 minutes more. Pour 2 cups of rice into 3 cups of boiling water; cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add chicken and sauces to rice and cook at moderate flame 15 minutes. Cover pot and cook on low for another 15 to 20 minutes. While cooking turn rice from bottom to top with large spoon not too often. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Almond Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all together in large bowl. Grease skillet and get hot; pour into skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Whole Wheat Pancakes
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients (flours sugar or honey baking powder and salt). Use 1 cup dry mix with egg milk and melted butter.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit. Let cream cheese soften.

title: Snow Punch(Garnish Each Serving With Flaked Coconut)
instructions: Advance preparation Pour lemon juice into blender container. Slice bananas into container. Cover; blend until pureed. Combine banana mixture cream and sugar; chill.

title: Broccoli With Peppers
instructions: In a heavy skillet (12-inch) heat olive oil over moderate heat one minute. Add onion garlic water broccoli red pepper oregano and red pepper flakes. Cook stirring 2 minutes. Cover skillet; reduce heat to low and cook 6 to 8 minutes longer stirring often until broccoli is tender but still crisp.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray-grease muffin tins and press biscuits in one at a time stretching out into it. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a bowl and spoon equal amounts into biscuit-lined muffin tin. Can put water in muffin tins not being used. Can eat hot or cold after being cooked in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Contains 166 calories per serving.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. If beans are very dry add a little water.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Put meat in roaster - add everything. Cover and roast at 350\u00b0 40 minutes to the pound - do not overcook.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add alternately sifted dry ingredients and milk beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Add vanilla and lemon.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Beat well. Place in greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Frozen Pineapple Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine first 6 ingredients. Spoon salad evenly into 8 custard cups; cover and freeze 8 hours or until firm. Before serving place in refrigerator for 1 hour; garnish with pineapple chunks. Serve chilled. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fruit Slush Punch
instructions: In a large container combine the first four ingredients. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Pour into containers and freeze.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix flour sugar and baking powder. Cut in butter until mixture is fine crumbs. Mix egg milk and vanilla; stir into flour mixture. Fold in frozen blueberries. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Lauren'S Favorite Dinner
instructions: Heat olive oil; add onions until semi-translucent. Add beef. When beef is browned add a jar of brown gravy and marinara. Mix thoroughly while still heating. Turn down to a simmer; add cream and white wine. Add all to pasta and pour into a baking pan. Put Mozzarella cheese on top; add seasonings. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 and bake for half an hour or until bubbly. Enjoy!

title: Hobo Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add salt pepper corn and tomatoes; simmer a few minutes. Boil noodles according to package directions. Drain. Make alternate layers of noodles meat and cheese. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Peach Yogurt Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Refrigerate.

title: Ripe Olive Rice
instructions: Cook crumbled sausage until lightly browned. Add onion and garlic; continue to cook until onion is tender. Stir in rice. Add broth tomatoes mushrooms olives oregano salt and pepper. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and cook slowly for 20 minutes if raw rice is used. (Leftover cooked rice may be used). Heat thoroughly over low heat. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Spinach-Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Combine spinach and artichokes. Combine cream cheese and next three ingredients. Stir into spinach mixture. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes and uncovered for an additional 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix and roll in balls then roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Bites
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and cheese together. Place shrimp on a cracker dot with mayonnaise mixture and broil until golden.

title: Chocolate Mousse Pie
instructions: Let Cool Whip warm to room temperature. Melt chocolate chips and mix with Cool Whip; pour into graham cracker crust. Garnish with chocolate shavings if desired. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons of juice drained from pineapple with mayonnaise mustard curry powder and salt. Set aside. Cut chicken into small slivers and mix with remaining ingredients. Add flavored mayonnaise and blend well. Refrigerate 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: 6 Layer Cookie
instructions: Grease sides of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt butter and pour into pan. Add the crushed graham crackers. Pour over butter. Pour milk over crackers. Spread chips over milk then spread coconut over chips and last sprinkle nuts over chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. If baking in a glass pan bake at 325\u00b0 for the same amount of time. Bars should be lightly browned. Chill in pan for at least 4 hours. Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: In a double boiler mix flour cocoa and sugar together. Add 1/3 cup milk. Mix together well. Add yolks blending well. Add remaining milk and vanilla. Cook (stirring to keep from scorching) over medium heat until thickened. Pour into baked deep dish pie shell.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake With Praline Sauce
instructions: Use butter to grease 9-inch spring-form pan. Combine other ingredients and press into bottom and up sides of pan. Refrigerate.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix spices baking powder and sugar. Put butter in hot potatoes. Beat eggs until frothy. Add soda to buttermilk. Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie crusts. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake 45 minutes longer. This makes 2 pies.

title: Iowa Stuffing
instructions: Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 hours or until the popcorn blows the end out of the turkey.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Wash peppers and take out seeds. Put peppers in cold water and bring to a boil. Boil approximately 3 minutes or until they just start to soften. Drain good. Salt and pepper inside of peppers. Put peppers in baking dish and fill with the following

title: Hoke Cakes
instructions: Combine the ingredients in mixing bowl. Mix thoroughly. In large skillet pour in oil. When hot spoon in batter to make pancake like cakes. Brown on both sides. (After oil gets hot reduce heat to medium-low.)

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 1 egg in bowl. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar extract cream cheese and 2 eggs. After mixing well pour over other ingredients in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until brown to your taste.

title: Pralines
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in large heavy saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring gently until sugar dissolves. Cover and cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes to wash down sugar crystals from sides of pan. Uncover and cook to soft-ball stage (234\u00b0) stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla. Beat with wooden spoon just until mixture begins to thicken. Working rapidly drop by tablespoons onto greased wax paper. Let stand until firm. Makes approximately 2 dozen.

title: Fruity Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Line 12 medium muffin cups with paper baking cups. Combine oats flour baking powder and cinnamon. Combine remaining ingredients and mix with dry ingredients just until moistened.

title: Fruit Squares
instructions: Mix the flour salt sugar and baking powder; cut in butter until particles are small pea-size. Put baking soda in egg yolks and sour cream. Stir. Mix into dry ingredients. Roll out to fit 9 x 12-inch cake pan including sides. Place dough in pan (leave 1/4 for top). Add pie filling. Make lattice top with remaining dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Fruit Salad (For Weight Watchers)
instructions: Drain fruit save juices!!! Use juice in place of milk as directed on pudding box. Pour pudding mixture over fruits chill and serve. Most any type fruits can be used and this stores well in refrigerator.

title: Bean And Pea Salad
instructions: Mix and set aside.

title: Cranberry-Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Combine flour cinnamon baking soda salt and nutmeg. In another bowl combine eggs sugar mashed cranberries mashed banana and cooking oil. Add this mixture to the flour mixture. Stir well. Add nuts and stir.

title: Delicious Chocolate Icing
instructions: Sift sugar and cocoa together and put in saucepan. Add oleo canned milk and the vanilla. Mix real well and bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute after it comes to full boil. After boiling 1 minute beat as it cools. Very good icing and easy to make.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables in unsalted water for 10 to 15 minutes. In another pan slowly saute oleo and onion until onion is tender. Add the soup and cheese; heat until cheese is melted. Pour boiling water over the rice; cover and set aside. When rice is tender add to the cheese mixture. Pour drained vegetables and cheese mixture into casserole dish. Top with buttered crumbs French fried onions or potato chip crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (or less).

title: Marinated Tereyaki Chicken Wings
instructions: Clean chicken. Mix ingredients and pour over chicken in a 13 by 9 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour turning occasionally.

title: Southern-Style Sausage Stuffing
instructions: Combine sausage celery and onion in large skillet. Saute mixture over medium heat until sausage is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain well. Pour sausage mixture into large bowl. Add cornbread and remaining ingredients in order listed. Blend well. Stuff mixture into bird. Roast according to standard roasting directions. Mixture may also be baked in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown. Makes 12 cups stuffing.

title: Salmon Puff
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in greased casserole uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Crabmeat Crepes
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add margarine. Place over medium-high heat until margarine melts. Add mushrooms green onions and 1 teaspoon thyme; saute 2 to 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Reduce heat to low; stir in flour. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat; stir in crabmeat and next 5 ingredients.

title: Hot Cheddar Dip
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Nut Chewies
instructions: Beat eggs in a large bowl. Beat in sugar vanilla and butter until creamy. Combine flour with baking powder and salt. Add egg mixture. Mix at low until blended. Stir in nuts. Mixture will be stiff. Spread evenly in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain grease. Mix everything together and put in a casserole dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 until bubbly through and through. Put cheese on top. You can put some cheese in the mixture too before cooking it. Serve with flour tortillas and salad.

title: Shrimp Fritters
instructions: Bring water to a boil with butter add flour all at once stirring well until mixture leaves the side of saucepan. Remove from heat and add well beaten eggs stir until smooth and thick. Stir in shrimp and cheese. Drop by small spoonfuls into shallow hot fat. Brown on both sides. Serves 6. May double recipe.

title: Cabbage-Beef Casserole
instructions: Chop cabbage. Place in greased baking dish. Brown meat and onions stir in rice. Pour over cabbage. Mix soup and water. Pour over entire casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Add more water if needed. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Walnut Bread
instructions: Beat sugar oil and eggs. Combine dry ingredients; add to first mixture alternately with zucchini. Stir in raisins walnuts and vanilla. Bake in 2 greased and lightly floured loaf pans at 350\u00b0 on lowest baking rack for about 55 minutes.

title: Egg Casserole Supreme
instructions: This is a yummy luncheon or appetizer recipe. Be sure to use mild green chilies not the hot ones.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Stir first 6 ingredients. Then add remaining ingredients.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: In a large pot combine all ingredients. Cook down for 3 1/2 hours. Pour into clean jars; seal and hot water bath for 10 minutes.

title: Toby Soup
instructions: Saute the onion celery and garlic in oleo. Add the next 4 ingredients. Cook 45 minutes to 1 hour. Add 1 cup precooked rice the last 15 minutes. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt or to taste. Add McKays seasoning. Before serving add milk. Serve with a scoop of cottage cheese in soup bowl.

title: Amish Chicken Soup
instructions: Cook chicken until tender; remove from broth and cut into small pieces. Add celery onions salt pepper and garlic to broth. Cook until tender. Add chicken and corn and cook about 1/2 hour. Thicken a little with flour and water. Very good.

title: Heavenly Stew
instructions: Mix together in crock-pot on high heat 5 to 7 hours. If more soup needed add another can tomato soup and another 1/2 can water.

title: Cream Cherry Frosting
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin into cherry juice to soften. Heat in microwave for 10 to 15 seconds. Cool a minute or two. Then whip mixture into topping with wire whip. Frost cake garnishing with sliced almonds. Refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Minute Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Pour boiling water over gelatin. Stir and dissolve. Add frozen strawberries; stir to break berries apart. When mixture is partially set pour into baked pie shell. Chill until set. If desired serve with whipped cream.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Cream together peanut butter margarine and powdered sugar. Roll into balls and refrigerate. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin together; dip balls. Cool on wax paper.

title: Raisin Pudding
instructions: Add the first mixture without stirring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Ho Ho Bars
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Pour batter into a 10 x 15-inch greased pan. Bake 12 - 15 minutes at 350 degrees. Let cool. Combine sugar margarine shortening milk vanilla salt. Beat till fluffy 10 - 15 minutes. You must use an electric mixer. Spread over cooled cake. Melt frosting in microwave for 20-25 seconds to soften. Spread over cream layer.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Blend together all the ingredients; form in 2 x 10-inch rolls. Beat egg white; dip rolls in or brush on. Then roll the rolls in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Refrigerate for better handling. Cut 1/4-inch slices and bake on a greased cookie sheet until brown.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Mix well and knead to make a roll. Chill overnight. Slice and bake on greased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Raspberry Torte
instructions: Spread the 2 1/2 cups crushed vanilla wafers in the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch pan. Beat the egg powdered sugar and oleo; spread over crumbs. Spread the raspberries. Spread the Cool Whip. Sprinkle 1/2 cup crushed wafers on top. Refrigerate 4 hours.

title: Deer Summer Sausage
instructions: Day 1 Mix all ingredients by hand. Put in large airtight container. Refrigerate.

title: Spanish Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ingredients and form into a loaf. Place in Pyrex dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Chicken Rolls
instructions: Microwave chicken for 10 minutes until chicken is white let cool. Cut into tiny pieces. Roll chicken up in crescent rolls. Put soup in bottom of casserole dish. Lay chicken rolls on soup. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Turn rolls after 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheese and cover. Let cheese melt and serve.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients together. Add the eggs oil and pineapple. Beat 2 minutes. Pour into a sheet cake pan that has been oiled and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool Whip can be used for frosting or use the following frosting.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt butter blend in flour and salt and add milk. Cook and stir until thickened. Add cheese and stir until melted.

title: Chicken Breasts Bridget
instructions: Pound chicken breasts thin. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat 1 teaspoon each of oil and butter in large skillet. Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side. Transfer to warm platter. Add green onions lemon juice wine parsley and mustard to pan. Cook 15 seconds stirring constantly. Whisk in broth. Stir until sauce is smooth. Whisk in remaining butter and oil. Pour sauce over chicken and serve immediately.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Cream butter or shortening and brown sugar.\tAdd eggs and molasses. Sift together flour cinnamon and ginger. Add flour mixture and milk alternately. When well mixed add soda dissolved in small\tamount of hot water. Stir well. Bake in moderate oven until knife\tcomes out clean. Serve with hot lemon sauce or whipped cream.

title: Potato Cakes With Cheese
instructions: Roll potatoes into flat sheet. Sprinkle cheese on top. Fold over and cut into small squares. Fry until light brown in butter.

title: Low Fat Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl; add oil and milk. Knead dough until mixed. Pat down dough to 1/2-inch thickness and cut biscuits. Bake on a cookie sheet at 450\u00b0 until brown.

title: Best Yet Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese together. Add sugar then eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and the flavoring. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Add batter. Place in cold oven. Set temperature at 300\u00b0 and bake for 3 hours 35 minutes. Secret for this delicious cake is all ingredients are to be out of the refrigerator for 2 hours before preparing.

title: Mushrooms On Toast
instructions: Cook onion in margarine until tender but not brown. Add mushrooms and flour; toss to coat. Stir in water bouillon cube salt basil and hot pepper sauce. Cook stirring constantly until mixture boils. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve piping hot on toast.

title: Italian Potato Wedges
instructions: Slice potatoes into wedge shaped slices leaving skins on. Put into baking pan. Sprinkle with steak and Italian seasonings. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Turn after 25 minutes. (A great alternative to French fries.)

title: Christmas Tree Cookies
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well. Add egg and lemon juice; mix well. Combine flour soda and salt; add to butter mixture mixing well. Divide dough in half; wrap each portion in plastic wrap and chill at least 1 hour or until firm enough to handle. Roll each portion to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Cut with a 5-inch tree shaped cookie cutter; place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Transfer to wire rack to cool. Spread green frosting on cookies; let dry. Yield 2 dozen 5-inch cookies.

title: Buttermilk Scones
instructions: Soften the yeast in warm water. Pour warm buttermilk into a large warm bowl. Add the sugar eggs oil salt baking powder and baking soda; mix well. Add the softened yeast and mix. Add 4 cups of flour and beat until smooth. Add the remaining 4 cups of flour to make dough soft. Cover; let the dough rise in a warm place about 1 hour or until double in bulk. Punch the dough down to its original size. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mommom'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In a saucepan melt oleo over low heat. Stir in flour salt and pepper until smooth. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in milk until smooth. Stirring constantly cook over medium heat about 10 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the cheese until melted. Turn macaroni into greased 2-quart casserole. Pour cheese mixture over macaroni; mix well. Mix remaining cheese and bread crumbs. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Coat pan with olive oil. Return drained broccoli to pan and add other ingredients. Cook a few minutes until cheese melts. Cool. Stretch and roll dough 16 x 5 inches. Spread mixture to 1/2 inch of edge. Fold over and pinch edges. Put seam on bottom. Put on greased pan. Put 1-inch slit on top. Brush top with egg and water (beat egg with 1 teaspoon water). Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Phill Henke And Glen Parker'S Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Ro-Tel tomatoes. Blend on lowest setting of blender. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes.

title: Sherry Wine Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and beat 4 minutes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and pierce holes in cake with large fork or skewer and pour mixture of last 3 ingredients over cake. Return to oven for another 10 minutes. Use a 10-inch greased tube pan.

title: Sauterne Scallop Bake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium saucepan; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir scallops and mushrooms into liquid mixture; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove scallops and mushrooms from saucepan reserving liquid in pan; set scallops and mushrooms aside. Bring liquid to a boil and cook uncovered 10 minutes or until liquid is reduced to 1/2 cup.

title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
instructions: Wash the roast and place it in a slow cooker. Cover with onion soup mix and stewed tomatoes. Cook on high for one hour then turn to low setting and cook for six hours or until tender. Thicken the gravy with flour or cornstarch if preferred.

title: Pecan Fingers
instructions: Cream butter sugar vanilla and water. Beat well. Add flour and pecans. Chill for 1 hour. Shape dough into small finger-like rolls. Bake 1 hour at 250\u00b0.

title: Country Chicken Stew
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. In hot drippings cook onion and oregano until tender. Stir in soup water potatoes and carrots. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Stir in beans; cover. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in crumbled bacon chicken and parsley. Heat through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Church Salad
instructions: Thaw the broccoli and cauliflower; layer in large Pyrex dish. Add layer of chopped onions and green pepper. Pour over this the mayonnaise covering\tcompletely. Over this place layer of chopped lettuce then add the cheese. Over the cheese sprinkle 1 jar of Bac*Os. Crumbled crisp bacon could be used. Refrigerate several hours or overnight\tbefore serving. Makes a very large salad.

title: Chicken In Crumb Basket
instructions: Combine bread crumbs with onion seasoning and butter. Line large casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan with crumb mixture. Press in place; bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Melt butter; blend in flour. Add milk chicken broth and seasoning. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add peas and chicken. Serves 6.

title: Odessa'S Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook slowly for 4 to 6 hours. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Cole Slaw Dressing
instructions: Mix all together before combining with shredded cabbage for cole slaw.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes and pat dry; prick each potato several times with a fork. Arrange potatoes end to end and 1 inch apart in a circle on paper towels in microwave oven. Microwave on High for 12 to 14 minutes turning and rearranging potatoes after 6 minutes. Let potatoes stand for 5 minutes.

title: Pizza Pockets
instructions: Put soft tortilla shells on a pan. Spread sauce on it. Just a little. Then sprinkle both cheeses on the sauce. Add pepperoni on cheese. Cook until cheese melts at 375\u00b0.

title: Easy Supper
instructions: Brown hamburger onions salt and pepper. Place in bottom of casserole. Cover with drained corn. Cover with leftover mashed potatoes. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Warm in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Add melted chocolate. Beat yolks; add water and extract and blend. Gradually add yolk mixture to chocolate mixture; beat until light and fluffy. Sift together flour salt and baking soda. Alternately add flour mixture and milk blending well after each addition. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold into batter. Turn into two greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans or one greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake layers or loaf in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients in pan. Then add the remaining dry ingredients. Pour over all 1 1/2 cups of hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lobster Casserole
instructions: Put all together in casserole with grated cheese on top and croutons on the very top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve on or with rice or wide noodles.

title: Vegetable Beef Biscuit Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Easy Fruit Pie
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes and cool.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Layer 1 Mix 1 stick butter and graham cracker crumbs. Press in cake pan.

title: Cranberry Molded Salad
instructions: Drain crushed pineapple reserving 1 cup of the syrup; set aside. Combine gelatin boiling water and sugar. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add cold water reserved pineapple syrup and lemon juice. Mix well. Add cranberries celery nuts orange zest and crushed pineapple. Mix well. Pour into 6-cup mold. Chill until set. Remove from mold. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Easy Rice Pudding(Microwave)
instructions: Make pudding according to package directions. Mix in raisins and rice until well blended. Pour into 3-quart casserole. Cover. Microwave on High for 2 minutes rotating dish after first minute. Serve warm or cold.

title: Goli-She-Was
instructions: Mix flour cornmeal baking powder salt onion and green pepper. Add milk to form a rather stiff batter. It should be about the consistency of dumplings stiff enough to barely drop from the spoon. Add enough potatoes to double mixture. Drop by teaspoons into 375\u00b0 fat and fry until golden brown. Drain and serve hot.

title: Hamburger Delight
instructions: Cook potatoes in oil in skillet but do not brown adding the oil as it is needed. Lift out potatoes with a slotted spoon and arrange in buttered baking dish. Dot with butter and season with salt and pepper. Cook burger in same skillet; drain. Add the sauce to beef; mix thoroughly and heat. Pour meat mixture over the potatoes. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. During last 5 minutes of cooking remove and sprinkle on cheese.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drain and cut artichokes into pieces. Mix remaining ingredients together. Grease a pie pan or quiche dish. Pour all ingredients in and sprinkle with garlic powder. Cook for 45 minutes. Serve with crackers and enjoy!

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup melted butter pepper sour cream cheese salt onion and soup. Blend and pour over potatoes in a 3 quart casserole dish. Mix corn flakes and 1/2 cup melted butter and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions on box adding softened butter. Bake in a 17 x 11 1/2-inch jelly pan or a large cookie sheet with sides at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Combine the milk sugar marshmallows and coconut in a saucepan until marshmallows are melted. Spread over cake. In a saucepan cook remaining ingredients over low heat. Spread over the coconut layer. Refrigerate. Makes 30 servings.

title: Blueberry Banana Bread
instructions: In a bowl combine the flour baking soda and salt. In a large mixing bowl cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Beat in bananas. Gradually add the dry ingredients beating just until combined. Fold in blueberries. Pour into 3 greased 5 3/4 x 3 x 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire rack. Yield 3 mini loaves.

title: Beef Loaf
instructions: Saute onion in salad oil. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pack into greased loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil then strain.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put pineapple in pan. Cover with cherries. Cover with cake mix and top with nuts. Cut margarine in pieces and put over top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Fry beef and onion until browned. Stir in seasoning mix. Spread in greased pie plate. Top with chillies. Beat milk baking powder Bisquick and egg until smooth. Pour over hamburger mixture. Bake until done (25 minutes or more). Take out of oven and top with cubed tomatoes and cheese. Bake until cheese is melted. Serve hot topped with shredded lettuce olives and sour cream. Makes a whole meal.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan and stir with a fork until blended about 2 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed. Cool in pan and cut into squares. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar if desired.

title: Chocolate Dipped Peanut Butter Cookies(Makes About 5 Dozen)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixer bowl beat condensed milk peanut butter egg and vanilla extract until smooth. Add biscuit mix and mix well. Chill 1 hour. Shape in 1-inch balls. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Partially dip cookies into candy coating. Place on wax paper lined baking sheet and stand until firm. Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and pour off excess fat. In a 2-quart casserole mix SpaghettiOs cream of mushroom soup onion and bacon. Add ground beef and stir to mix. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1/2 hour. Its ready to go! Good with a green salad.

title: Sweet And Sour Shrimp
instructions: Place pea pods and pineapple in crock-pot. Stir together cornstarch and sugar. Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water and add pineapple juice soy sauce and ginger. Bring to boil and cook for 1 minute. Blend sauce into pea pods and pineapple. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Beef Burritos
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Add taco sauce to meat. Spoon meat on tortillas. Roll and place in pan. Mix sour cream soup and chiles. Spread over tortillas and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Turkey Schnitzel
instructions: In small shallow plate combine egg whites and mustard. Blend well and set aside. Place bread crumbs on shallow plate; one at a time dip each cutlet first into egg mixture then bread crumbs coating both sides. In medium skillet heat 1 teaspoon oil; add cutlets. Cook over medium-high heat until golden brown about 5 minutes. Add remaining oil; turn cutlets. Cook until golden brown about 5 minutes longer. Serves 4.

title: Primavera Linguini(Simply Delicious)
instructions: In medium saucepan melt butter and flour. Stir in the soup mix and blend all with milk. Bring to a boil and simmer stirring occasionally until sauce is thickened and vegetables are tender about 10 minutes. Stir in cheese. Toss sauce with hot linguini and add more Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Philly Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix Cheddar and cream cheese until well blended. Add remaining ingredients mix well. Mold into bell or ball shapes. Chill until firm. Garnish with pimiento strips spread on Triscuits. Makes 12 balls.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion together. Chop up tomatoes. Mix in saucepan tomatoes tomato paste parsley flakes sugar salt basil garlic and oregano. Heat to boiling. Stir occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer covered 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Super Z Ice Cream Sundaes
instructions: For each serving place scoops of ice cream in sundae dish. Serve with topping. Top with whipped topping. Garnish with coconut chopped nuts or sprinkles if desired. Preparation time 10 minutes.

title: Louisiana Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in unbaked pie shell (9-inch); bake one hour at 350\u00b0. Garnish with finely chopped pecans. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in butter. Add Cavenders seasoning soups cheese and milk. Cook until cheese melts. Add diced chicken and spaghetti. Simmer until warm throughout. For extra spice add 1 can of Rotel.

title: Cracker Salad
instructions: Crush crackers and combine all the other ingredients. Mix with crackers and refrigerate overnight.

title: Sauerkraut And Noodles
instructions: Saut sauerkraut mushrooms and onions in butter until lightly browned. Stir in boiled noodles and browned kielbasa. Serves 8 to 10 people as a side dish.

title: Peanut Butter Chip Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar eggs and vanilla in large mixer bowl. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; blend in. Stir in peanut butter chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool 1 minute before removing to wire rack. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Rice Salad
instructions: Put on lettuce halves and top with boiled eggs and paprika. You may also add any type of meat ham chicken tuna or bacon bits. This is very good hot or cold.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Slice chestnuts and mix all ingredients. Mix 1/2 cup oil 1/2 cup vinegar 3/4 cup sugar and salt and pepper (to taste). Pour over vegetables and let stand overnight.

title: World War I Fruit Cake
instructions: Boil margarine sugar water raisins and spices together for 3 to 4 minutes. Cool. Mix dry ingredients and add to the cooled mixture. (Optional Add 2 eggs and 1 cup nuts or coconut.)

title: Marshmallow Fudge Brownies And Icing
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in 8 x 12-inch pan 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take from oven and put marshmallows on top. Return to oven for 3 minutes. Spread until top is covered with marshmallows. Let cool. Frost with icing.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Form into 40 bite size meatballs using a full teaspoon for each. Brown meatballs lightly in vegetable oil. Cover; simmer 5 minutes. Drain excess fat. Combine chili sauce and grape jelly. Pour over meatballs. Heat stirring occasionally until jelly is melted. Simmer 10 to 12 minutes until sauce has thickened. Baste occasionally. Makes 40 appetizers.

title: Mushroom Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Chili
instructions: In a dutch oven over medium heat cook beef onion and green pepper until meat is no longer pink. Drain.

title: Oven Fried Fish
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Cut fish into serving pieces. Stir salt into milk. Dip fish in milk and coat with crumbs. Place fish in greased oblong pan. Pour butter over fish and place pan on middle rack of oven. Cook uncovered at 500\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes with fork.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In sauce pan melt cheese soup milk onion oleo and worcestershire sauce. Cook broccoli as directed and then drain. Combine broccoli ham rice to cheese mixture. Cook at 350 for 1 - 1 1/2 hours.

title: Low Cholesterol-Low Fat Chili
instructions: Brown meat in pan. Add onion green pepper garlic crushed tomatoes kidney beans tomato sauce soy sauce and chili powder. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer about 20 minutes.

title: Big John'S Steamed Shrimp
instructions: Combine Old Bay salt and pepper in small bowl. In a steamer combine water and vinegar; bring to a boil and place a layer of shrimp. Sprinkle generously with seasonings. Repeat process for approximately 3 layers of shrimp. Steam for 8 to 10 minutes. Stir gently; cover again until tender. Peel and eat! Serve with cocktail sauce and lemon wedges.

title: Howard Glenn'S Sourdough Bread
instructions: Dump all ingredients in a bowl. Measure 6 cups bromated bread flour and sift into mixture. Stir ingredients with a large spoon until a stiff batter is formed. Spray a large bowl with cooking spray and place dough therein. Cover with Saran Wrap and let rise on counter overnight.

title: Quick Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Stir in vanilla and flour mixing well. Spread evenly in buttered 9-inch round cake pan. Place apple wedges into cake batter to form a circular pattern. Mix together 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over cake. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Potato Salad From Ireland
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins until done. Drain and cube. Toss other ingredients gently and stir in potatoes. Chill. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Form meat egg and onion in loaf and cook until done at 275\u00b0.

title: Stacie'S Fruit On A Stick
instructions: Take fruit balls and arrange them in your own way on bamboo skewers. Chill in refrigerator for 1/2 hour. Serve.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and eggs. Blend in oil. Stir together soda salt flour cinnamon and salt. Mix and blend. Add carrots. Bake in three 8-inch square or three 9-inch round pans at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Insert toothpick for testing; if comes out clean cake is done.

title: Sunny Sipper
instructions: In a 4 cup glass measure stir together all ingredients. Cover with vented plastic wrap. Microwave on High 3 minutes or until boiling. Makes about 2 cups or 2 servings.

title: Simple Macaroni Salad
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water until no longer hot. Transfer noodles to a large bowl. Stir in red and green bell peppers green onions celery and olive oil. Mix in mayonnaise and soup mix. Mix well. Refrigerate for a few hours before serving.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In 1-quart casserole stir soup and soy sauce. Mix in 1/2 can onions pepper and green beans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Add rest of onions and cook 5 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs coconut flour vanilla salt and milk. Pour in uncooked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Fettucini With Parsley
instructions: Cook fettucini noodles according to package directions; drain well. Add next 5 ingredients and toss well until noodles are well coated. Add Parmesan cheese and toss gently.

title: Parmesan Baked Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes; slice into 1/4-inch pieces. Butter a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan. Put a layer of potato slices; brush with melted butter then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese pepper and salt. Put another layer of potatoes in; follow directions for first layer. Continue layering until all potatoes are used. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered until a fork will go through easily about 1 hour.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Trim excess fat from chicken and twist the tip of the chicken wing under. Melt butter or margarine in a large skillet. Remove from heat. Stir in Italian salad dressing mix. Roll each piece of chicken first in butter mixture then in potato flakes on wax paper. Arrange in a single layer on several aluminum foil lined 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pans. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Caps
instructions: Saute mushroom stems in butter. Combine mushroom stems with all the other ingredients adding breadcrumbs until desired consistency. Stuff caps and bake on a cookie sheet for 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Parmesan Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes but do not peel. Cut into 1/4-inch slices and coat with next 4 ingredients (mixed well). Arrange slices in a greased baking dish. Dot with margarine and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Skillet Chicken And Wild Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients in 10-inch skillet. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Prepare according to directions on back of box. Make into three layers.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together the sour cream Cool Whip sugar and vanilla then add fruit cocktail pineapple and nuts. Freeze.

title: Tortilla Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except tortillas together in a bowl. Spread mixture over uncooked flour tortillas. Roll tortilla tightly. Slice into 1-inch thick bite size pieces.

title: Good Salad
instructions: Layer in the order given.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: In large Dutch oven brown meat and onion; drain. Puree tomatoes in their liquid; add to pan with sauce water beans corn and seasoning. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Can top each serving with chopped tomatoes shredded Cheddar cheese sour cream and corn chips.

title: Wassail
instructions: Stick cloves in orange. Place in juice and simmer for 6 hours.

title: Boston Baked Beans(Serves 12)
instructions: In heavy 4 to 5-quart casserole bring 2 quarts of water to a boil over high heat. Drop in the dried beans and boil them for about 2 minutes. The water should cover the beans by at least 2-inches. Add more if necessary. Turn off the heat and let the beans soak for 1 hour then add the peeled onion and 1 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a boil again. Reduce the heat to low; partially cover the pan and simmer for about 1 hour or until the beans are tender. Check from time to time and add more boiling water to the pot if necessary. (The beans should be covered with water throughout the cooking.) Drain the beans through a fine sieve set over a bowl. Pick out and discard the onion. Reserve the cooking liquid. There should be about 2 quarts of liquid; add water if necessary.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix graham crackers butter and sugar in bottom of pan. Bake 5 minutes. Save 1/4 of mixture for the top. Mix lemon juice cream cheese 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Mix jello and water. Let cool. Add lemon juice mixture to jello. Beat Milnot until stiff. Fold all ingredients together into crust. Sprinkle top with remaining graham crackers. Chill for at least 4 hours.

title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Mix together sugar cocoa milk and butter. Bring to a full boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter vanilla and oatmeal. Stir together. Drop by heaping teaspoons on wax paper and let cook. Mixture hardens quickly so you must work fast.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: In a skillet cook beef with onion until brown stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Add soup water Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Heat through stirring often. Serve on buns.

title: Jim'S Best Oatmeal Chippers
instructions: Cream the butter and shortening. Add and cream the brown sugar and white sugar. Add eggs and vanilla to butter and sugar; beat well. Add flour baking powder and baking soda to mixture; beat well. Add oats and chocolate chips to mixture; combine well.

title: Mexican Potato Salad
instructions: Boil the potatoes until just soft. Cool and quarter. Toss in the remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve immediately at room temperature or refrigerate.

title: Preston'S Mama'S Tomato Pie
instructions: Brown pie shell; let cool. Place ham or bacon on bottom of pie shell followed by sliced tomatoes and onion. Make 2 tiers of meat tomatoes and onion. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Mix grated cheese and mayonnaise together; spread on top of pie. Sprinkle with more Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes until cheese is melted and browned.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corn flakes and almonds. Sprinkle them over the top of the casserole. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until browned lightly.

title: Crisp Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 2 hours. Serve on lettuce. Great in hot weather; simple and refreshing.

title: Lazy Man'S Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion together and season as you wish. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with half of cabbage. Layer ground beef mixture on top. Then cover with remaining cabbage. Mix the two soups and pour over the top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Southwest Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cook pasta according to package directions. Whisk together the milk and egg; mix in the hot pasta. Spread the mixture in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook the pork onion green pepper and garlic together in a large skillet for about 6 minutes over medium heat until the pork is cooked through. Drain or spoon off excess fat. Stir the chili powder cumin oregano salt and black pepper into the pork and cook for about 2 minutes. Stir in the tomato sauce and cook for 2 minutes more.

title: Green Beans With New Potatoes
instructions: Wash beans twice or three times. Place in kettle. Cover with water and put in the salt pork and bacon grease (about 3 tablespoons). Cook about 3/4 hour. Scrub the potatoes and put on top of the beans. Cook until the potatoes are tender.

title: No Fat Italian Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill for an hour. Makes 12 servings. 2 Tbsp. 9 calories. Fat 0 gms. Fat 0%.

title: Oatmeal Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar margarine and milk for 2 minutes. After done boiling add peanut butter and marshmallow; beat until mixed. Add oatmeal and vanilla; mix all together.

title: Sunshine Cake
instructions: Sift both the sugar and flour before measuring. Sift the flour 4 times after measuring.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Brown sausage and ground round. Boil shrimp in shrimp boil. Stir in 2 1/2 cups of water and 2 (6 ounce) boxes of Zatarains jambalaya mix. Bring to a boil; stir. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in sausage shrimp (peeled) and 1/2 jar of Pace picante sauce.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar. Add 1 egg at a time beating well after each egg. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Blend in milk alternately with flour and flavoring. Blend in flavoring. Bake in 3 (9-inch) cake pans at 350\u00b0.

title: 3 Day Dill Pickles
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and bring to a boil. Place dill garlic onion and hot pepper in bottom of a quart jar. Place cucumbers in jar. Pour hot vinegar mixture over cucumbers and seal. Set in sun for 3 days.

title: Barbecue Slaw
instructions: In large bowl toss cabbage onion carrots green pepper and pickles. Add red pepper salt and sugar; mix well. Mix ketchup and vinegar together; pour over vegetables. This is better if it is made the night before. Keeps forever in the refrigerator.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Store in an airtight container. Yield 36 servings.

title: Creation Crunch
instructions: Have children combine various foods in small bowls to create their own \Creation Crunch.\ As kids create affirm them for their God-given creativity because theyre made in Gods image.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend mayonnaise with cream cheese; add whipping cream. Then add all other ingredients. Also nuts may be added. Chill.

title: Caramels
instructions: In a 3-quart heavy saucepan combine sugar corn syrup and salt. Cook over medium-high heat until mixture reaches firm ball stage (244\u00b0) stirring occasionally. Add butter and gradually add milk so mixture does not stop boiling. Stirring constantly cook rapidly to firm ball stage again. Remove from heat add vanilla flavoring and pour mixture into buttered 9-inch square baking dish without scraping the sides of the saucepan. Cool thoroughly before cutting. Makes 81 caramels (1 x 1-inch).

title: Chicken Wings In Oyster Sauce
instructions: Boil mixture until thick. Pour over cooked wings. Enjoy.

title: Miss Pat'S Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish that has been greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Check by sticking a cake tester in it. Take out of the oven and put 15 large marshmallows on top. Put back in oven just long enough to soften so you can spread them with a knife. Spread filling on top.

title: Deep South Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine bread milk and cream. Beat eggs. Add sugar and mix well. Stir in bread crumbs. Add vanilla and spices. Stir in butter and raisins. Pour into buttered 2-quart baking dish. Set in pan of warm water. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Wash okra leaving short stems. Pack into ten clean hot pint jars. Place pod of pepper and one clove of garlic in each jar. Combine salt vinegar and water. Heat to boiling. Pour over okra. Seal jars. Let stand for several weeks before using. Yields 10 pints.

title: Easy Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the first 3 ingredients together and pour over chicken breasts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Red Wine Vinaigrette
instructions: Mix well. Serve over cold cooked vegetables or fresh green salad.

title: Dad'S Fruit Delight
instructions: Mix together softened cream cheese milk lemon juice and vanilla. Pour filling over pie crust. Chill until set. Put pie filling on top.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Beat egg in small bowl. Add crackers salt evaporated milk and catsup. In large bowl mix beef with onion and pepper. Mix in egg mixture. Pat into loaf pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs. Add 1 cup heated milk. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until it bubbles. Pour over vanilla wafers and banana slices. Sprinkle with crushed vanilla wafers. Let cool. Serve and keep refrigerated.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and water in large saucepan or Dutch oven. Cook over low heat until 230\u00b0 to 234\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Add peanuts. Stir constantly until thermometer reaches 290\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Spread onto buttered pan; cool. Break into pieces.

title: Beef Bourguignonne
instructions: Mix together and bake covered for 3 hours at 350.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and whipped topping. Add other ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate until it sets.

title: Kentucky Cornbread Salad
instructions: Crumble cooled cornbread in oblong pan. Layer onions cucumbers tomato green pepper kidney beans and black pepper. Mix mayonnaise and pickle juice. Spoon over top of beans then sprinkle cheese on top of salad. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Summertime Fruit Slush
instructions: Peel and seed fruit as needed. Place an assortment of fruits in blender. Add honey. Blend thoroughly. Pour into 8 ounce plastic cups and place in freezer until slushy but not solid. Eat with a spoon. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat together sugar and eggs. Stir lemon juice into pumpkin. Sift together dry ingredients. Fold flour mixture into sugar and pumpkin mixture. Mix until smooth. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Turn onto a towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll towel and cake together. Unroll bread. Spread with filling and roll again making a pumpkin roll. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Ala Kel
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl beat eggs and set aside. In a large bowl combine all dry ingredients and mix well. Dip chicken tenders in eggs then dredge in breadcrumb mixture coating well. Place chicken pieces on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all together and freeze in ice cream maker.

title: Spanish Beans
instructions: Brown about a pound of ground chuck in small amount of oil. When meat is browned add onion. Let this cook for several minutes. Next add celery and bell pepper then a can of tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Let these ingredients cook slowly for about 5 minutes. At this point if mixture is too juicy it may be thickened by adding about a tablespoon of flour to make a smooth paste. Add red kidney beans. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Pattie'S Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk into mixture blending thoroughly. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into prepared graham cracker crust (optional sprinkle with chopped nuts). Freeze until firm and serve.

title: Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening margarine and sugar. Beat until mixture is smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda and add creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla and walnut flavoring coconut and nuts. Fold in egg whites. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9 inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Kentucky Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add eggs butter nuts chips and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Test with a straw or toothpick to see if filling is set.

title: Cinnamon Bread Sticks
instructions: Cut crust off slices of bread. Roll thin then spread with the mixture of cream cheese sugar egg yolk and vanilla. Spread on each slice as if you were putting on butter. After you have spread on the mixture roll the slice up and roll it in melted butter or margarine. You then roll the stick in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Put each stick on baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until brown. You can store in the freezer and use as needed.

title: Tally Ho Tomato Pudding
instructions: For 10 minutes boil the tomato puree boiling water brown sugar and salt. Pour over the buttered bread cubes in a buttered casserole. Bake covered for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven in the casserole. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Banana-Nut Bread
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar in a bowl. Beat in eggs salt and vanilla; mix well. Sift together soda and flour. Add to creamed mixture. Add bananas and nuts; mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until bread tests done.

title: How To Make Self-Rising Flour(One Pound)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in tightly covered container and use in any recipe calling for self-rising flour.

title: Quick And Easy Hot Rolls
instructions: Melt margarine and set aside. Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar salt and margarine; mix and add flour. Cover and let rise for 1 hour. Mash down. Shape into rolls and let rise again about 1 hour or more depending on temperature of room. Bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Brush with margarine when taken from oven.

title: Six-Layer Bars
instructions: Mix the graham cracker crumbs with melted butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Press on bottom of pan. Sprinkle with nuts chocolate chips and coconut. Pour milk over top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven (until lightly browned). Cool; cut into bars.

title: Italian Roast Beef
instructions: Cook 5 hours at 300\u00b0. Leave set 20 minutes and shred.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk; add jello. Stir until dissolved. Add pineapple and oranges. Cool for 1 hour. Soften cheese; mix with salad dressing Dream Whip and nuts. Add to jello mixture.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Blend sugar and eggs together; add melted butter. Add other ingredients as listed; mix. Pour into 2 nine-inch pie pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Cross Buns
instructions: The day before buns are to be baked mix sugar with 1/2 c. melted butter. Add four of the egg yolks well beaten and milk. Soften yeast in warm water; add to sugar mixture. Sift 4 c. flour with salt nutmeg and cloves; beat. In separate bowl beat egg whites until frothy but not stiff; fold into the batter. Add raisins and candied fruit; stir. Add remaining flour 1 c. at a time until you have a soft dough. Place dough in oiled bowl; oil top of dough. Cover with a damp cloth and plastic wrap; store in warm place for 2 to 3 hours. Store in refrigerator overnight.

title: Shrimp Stir-Fry
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp; combine soy sauce sherry ketchup sugar and pepper. Heat oil in wok or skillet. Add garlic; stir-fry for 30 seconds; remove garlic. Add ginger; stir-fry for 30 seconds; add shrimp stir-fry for 5 minutes or until shrimp turn\tpink. Add onion celery mushrooms water chestnuts and bamboo shoots. Stir-fry 30 seconds; stir in soy sauce mixture. Add pimento and pea pods; heat through.

title: Pickled Mushrooms
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a two quart saucepan. Bring to boil and let simmer for about 10 minutes. Place in covered dish and chill for several days stirring occasionally. Drain and serve. Makes about four cups.

title: Holiday Sweet Potato Cake
instructions: Combine oil and sugar; beat until smooth. Add egg yolks; beat well. Add hot water and dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Stir in sweet potatoes nuts and vanilla; beat well. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture. Bake in 3 greased 8-inch layer pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes. Cool completely before frosting with your choice of icing.

title: Three C Casserole(Corn, Crackers And Cheese)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into an 8 cup casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. So delicious.

title: Jennifer'S Apple Crumble
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Grease the baking pan. Put the sliced apples in a deep dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice sugar cinnamon and ginger. Mix together and pour into baking pan. Mix the flour butter and three-quarters cup of sugar until mixture crumbles. Pat this mixture on top of the apples loosely. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Break eggs into casserole. Beat slightly. Mix in flour and sugar. Add corn. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Deep Dish Brownies
instructions: Mix butter sugar and vanilla in bowl. Add eggs. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Boxcar Children Brownies(Microwave)
instructions: Add melted margarine cocoa and sugar. Mix well. Add eggs flour vanilla and nuts. Mix well and pour into the baking dish. Cook in the microwave on High 6 to 7 minutes turning 1/4 turn every 2 minutes. When brownies are done the top will look dry and spring back when touched.

title: Cry Babies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar egg and molasses. Add dry ingredients and hot water alternately with shortening mixture. Drop by spoonfuls on greased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 12 minutes. Frost with powdered sugar icing.

title: Happiness Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly; add tears of joy sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith. Blend well into daily living. Bake well with warmth of human kindness. Serve with a smile all the time.

title: Baked Bananas
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Arrange bananas in 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with raisins. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour over bananas. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Corn Casserole No. 2
instructions: Drain corn and green beans. Combine corn green beans celery soup and sour cream in mixing bowl. Stir in minced onion. Pour in casserole dish and top with Ritz crackers and shredded cheese.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into a 9 x 5-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Alf'S Special Hot Cakes
instructions: Put eggs in bowl and whip until yellow and frothy. Blend in sour cream and cottage cheese until smooth. Add flour; mix until flour is blended. Pour batter into hot skillet with melted butter. Cook until golden brown.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan; bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Cover reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Yields 4 cups.

title: Cheesy Chicken Breasts
instructions: Combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese on a plate. Beat egg and oil in a bowl. Dip chicken in egg then bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes on a cookie sheet or baking pan until tender and slightly browned. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 minutes more to melt the cheese.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Blend in milk and vanilla. Add flour soda cream of tartar and salt. Premix dry ingredients in separate bowl. Add nuts (optional). Form into 1-inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet.

title: Sherried Chicken
instructions: Lightly season chicken with seasoned salt (remove the skin and bones first). Brown in a Dutch oven; add sherry. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove chicken to a serving dish. Measure pan juices and add water to make 1 1/4 cups liquid. Blend liquid and gravy mix in Dutch oven. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and blend in sour cream. Pour over chicken.

title: Salted Pecans
instructions: Place pecan halves in shallow pan with enough melted butter to moisten each half. Place in moderate oven and toast until pecans are a light brown then remove and salt. Turn pecans often during toasting process so they will not burn.

title: Medallions Of Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Dry meat with towels. Combine salt pepper and flour; dredge medallions. Shake off excess. Beat eggs with water. Dip medallions in eggs and coat with bread crumbs. Press meat with heel of palm to adhere bread crumbs; dry for 10 minutes.

title: All-In-One-Dinner
instructions: Mix ground chuck with onion soup mix and place on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put uncooked veggies over meat. Mix sour cream cheese butter and soup together. Mix with hash browns. Place over veggies. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Salt to taste. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together if mixture is too dry add about 1/8 cup milk. Make into walnut-sized balls. Freeze. Bake as needed at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add egg yolks and part of milk to moisten. Add milk gradually cooking on medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. When thick remove from heat. Add vanilla and butter. Let cool. Line deep pan or dish with vanilla wafers bottom and part of sides. Cover with layer of bananas layer of pudding etc. Top with meringue and brown.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Mix all together; roll in tiny balls then roll in granulated sugar. Place on baking sheet and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan (layer). Layer ingredients starting with the cherry pie filing pineapple and juice dry cake mix coconut oleo on top and chopped walnuts on top of the oleo. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Vanilla Sand Cookies
instructions: Work all ingredients together with your hands until you have a smooth stiff paste. To form cookies break off a small chunk a spoonful. Roll into a ball between the palms of your hands. Flatten into a round and you will have a circle with fine cracked edges. Arrange these on baking sheet and press a design in the top if you wish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or until golden in color. They complement fresh fruit nicely.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and blend. Sift dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients with buttermilk into creamed mixture. Fold in mashed bananas and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan or two greased 8-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Frost with Butter Cream frosting.

title: Nut Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Add nuts (flour nuts). Beat all together. Pour into tube pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Grease one 9 x 13 pan. Arrange rhubarb in bottom of pan. Sprinkle dry gelatin over top. Sprinkle with sugar and then cake mix. Drizzle butter over top followed by cold water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Festive Salad
instructions: Heat 1 1/3 cups juice until hot; dissolve jello in juice. When slightly thickened add cream cheese. Mix in fruit cocktail; fold in Cool Whip. Put in mold and chill about 3 hours.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Add onions; cook until onions are transparent. Add mushrooms seasonings and thawed spinach. Cook until spinach is warmed through. Remove from heat. Stir in soup and sour cream. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese; bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese is bubbling. Serve over noodles or rice. Add a salad and French bread. Ummm!!!

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat eggs in boiler; add flour then add small amounts of sugar and milk beating each time by hand until all lumps are out. Then add chocolate. Cook over medium heat until it thickens; remove from heat and add butter salt and vanilla. Pour in a baked pie crust. Whip egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy; add 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Spread over pie and brown top under broiler.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
